items.title: 文化一周 Culture Journal
items.title_zh: 香港美食彩灯

cues.zh: 其中展览香港彩灯会
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 zhan3 lan3 xiang1 gang3 cai3 deng1 hui4
cues.en: One exhibition is the Hong Kong Lantern Festival.

cues.zh: 于华山文创园区展出
cues.pinyin: yu2 hua4 shan1 wen2 chuang4 yuan2 qu1 zhan3 chu1
cues.en: It's held at Huashan Creative Park.

cues.zh: 现场展示许多
cues.pinyin: xian4 chang3 zhan3 shi4 xu3 duo1
cues.en: The exhibition features many lanterns

cues.zh: 以香港道地美食为造型的彩灯
cues.pinyin: yi3 xiang1 gang3 dao4 di4 mei3 shi2 wei4 zao4 xing2 de5 cai3 deng1
cues.en: shaped like Hong Kong's local food.

cues.zh: 有好喝的丝袜奶茶
cues.pinyin: you3 hao3 he1 de5 si1 wa4 nai3 cha2
cues.en: There's delicious silk-stocking milk tea,

cues.zh: 香喷喷的蛋挞
cues.pinyin: xiang1 pen1 pen1 de5 dan4 ta4
cues.en: fragrant egg tarts,

cues.zh: 好吃的菠萝油
cues.pinyin: hao3 chi1 de5 bo1 luo2 you2
cues.en: and tasty pineapple buns with butter.

cues.zh: 哇
cues.pinyin: wa5
cues.en: Wow!

cues.zh: 还有冒着烟的车仔面摊呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 mao4 zhe5 yan1 de5 che1 zai3 mian4 tan1 ne5
cues.en: There's even a steaming noodle stall!

items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI
items.title_zh: 住在香港的台湾女孩

cues.zh: 大家好我是啾啾妹
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 jiu1 jiu1 mei4
cues.en: Hi everyone, I'm Chuchumei.

cues.zh: 大家都知道
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: As you all know,

cues.zh: 我是嫁到香港的台湾媳妇
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jia4 dao4 xiang1 gang3 de5 tai2 wan1 xi2 fu4
cues.en: I'm a Taiwanese woman who married into Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 身为一个在香港生活三年的人
cues.pinyin: shen1 wei4 yi2 ge4 zai4 xiang1 gang3 sheng1 huo2 san1 nian2 de5 ren2
cues.en: After living in Hong Kong for three years,

cues.zh: 会讲一两句广东话
cues.pinyin: hui4 jiang3 yi1 liang3 ju4 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: being able to speak a little Cantonese

cues.zh: 还是很正常的吧
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 hen3 zheng4 chang2 de5 ba5
cues.en: is pretty normal, right?

cues.zh: 虽然不是很流利
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu2 shi4 hen3 liu2 li4
cues.en: I'm not very fluent,

cues.zh: 但是日常对话是OK的哦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ri4 chang2 dui4 hua4 shi4 de5 o2
cues.en: but everyday conversation is fine.

cues.zh: 很多baby咨询我怎么学广东话
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zi1 xun2 wo3 zen3 me5 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4
cues.en: Many of you ask how I learned Cantonese.

cues.zh: 今天我就来分享
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 lai2 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: Today I'll share

cues.zh: 我学广东话的神秘历程
cues.pinyin: wo3 xue2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 shen2 mi4 li4 cheng2
cues.en: my journey learning Cantonese.

items.title: 啾啾妹 CHUCHUMEI
items.title_zh: 慢慢练习就会进步

cues.zh: 以上就是我学习广东话的经验
cues.pinyin: yi3 shang4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 xue2 xi2 guang3 dong1 hua4 de5 jing1 yan4
cues.en: That's my experience learning Cantonese.

cues.zh: 但语言这种东西
cues.pinyin: dan4 yu3 yan2 zhe4 zhong3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: But when it comes to language,

cues.zh: 每个人吸收力不同
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 xi1 shou1 li4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: everyone learns at a different pace.

cues.zh: 所以也不用太着急啦
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ye3 bu4 yong4 tai4 zhao2 ji2 la5
cues.en: So there's no need to rush.

cues.zh: 一天一天慢慢练习
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 yi1 tian1 man4 man4 lian4 xi2
cues.en: Practise a little every day.

cues.zh: 会在不知不觉中进步的
cues.pinyin: hui4 zai4 bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 zhong1 jin4 bu4 de5
cues.en: You'll improve without even noticing.

cues.zh: 像我就超想学好英文的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 jiu4 chao1 xiang3 xue2 hao3 ying1 wen2 de5
cues.en: I really want to improve my English.

cues.zh: 从国小开始学英文
cues.pinyin: cong2 guo2 xiao3 kai1 shi3 xue2 ying1 wen2
cues.en: I started learning English in primary school.

cues.zh: 至今也学了十年了吧
cues.pinyin: zhi4 jin1 ye3 xue2 le5 shi2 nian2 le5 ba5
cues.en: It's been about ten years now.

cues.zh: 那你们留言分享学英文的妙招
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 liu2 yan2 fen1 xiang3 xue2 ying1 wen2 de5 miao4 zhao1
cues.en: Share your English-learning tips in the comments.

cues.zh: 给我吧
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 ba5
cues.en: I'd love to hear them.

cues.zh: 那今天的影片就到这啰
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 de5 ying3 pian4 jiu4 dao4 zhe4 luo1
cues.en: That's all for today's video.

cues.zh: 我们下次再见拜拜
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ci4 zai4 jian4 bai4 bai4
cues.en: See you next time. Bye!

cues.zh: 你喜欢吃甜米糕吗

cues.zh: 还好还好

cues.zh: 要不要拜一下

cues.zh: 就拜一下吧

cues.zh: 我真的好久没

cues.zh: 因为这些东西在韩国

cues.zh: 然后贴得还蛮稳的

cues.zh: 我这次又买了一些回去

cues.zh: 想说既然都买了

cues.zh: 就囤着吧

cues.zh: 这个还要分夜用跟日用
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hai2 yao4 fen1 ye4 yong4 gen1 ri4 yong4

cues.zh: 我觉得还蛮酷的

cues.zh: 用用看

items.title_zh: 戴牙套后的生活

cues.zh: 主要是因为觉得它长得蛮可爱的
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 yin1 wei4 jue2 de5 ta1 zhang3 de2 man2 ke3 ai4 de5
cues.en: Mostly because I thought it looked cute.

cues.zh: 就是很简单
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: It's very simple.

cues.zh: 然后想说就一起试试看
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xiang3 shuo1 jiu4 yi4 qi3 shi4 shi4 kan4
cues.en: So I thought I'd try it too.

cues.zh: 没有看错这边就是
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 kan4 cuo4 zhe4 bian1 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: You're seeing that right. These are

cues.zh: 我这一次买的牙膏大军
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 yi1 ci4 mai3 de5 ya2 gao1 da4 jun1
cues.en: all the toothpastes I bought this time.

cues.zh: 因为自从戴牙套之后
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 cong2 dai4 ya2 tao4 zhi1 hou4

cues.zh: 就刷牙次数变多

cues.zh: 今天的咖啡时光

cues.zh: 刚刚阴天所以就随便穿出门
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 yin1 tian1 suo3 yi3 jiu4 sui2 bian4 chuan1 chu1 men2
cues.en: It was cloudy, so I dressed casually.

cues.zh: 没想到天气这么好
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 tian1 qi4 zhe4 me5 hao3

cues.zh: 不然就穿得可爱一点出门了
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 jiu4 chuan1 de2 ke3 ai4 yi4 dian3 chu1 men2 le5

cues.zh: 应该会点这个戚风

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 挑选脆爽的小黄瓜

cues.zh: 大家好我是小高姐
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 xiao3 gao1 jie3
cues.en: Hi, I'm Xiaogaojie.

cues.zh: 今天我们来做拍黄瓜
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 pai1 huang2 gua1
cues.en: Today we're making smashed cucumber.

cues.zh: 我用的是这种小黄瓜
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 de5 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 xiao3 huang2 gua1
cues.en: I'm using these small cucumbers.

cues.zh: 它的皮儿比较薄个头也小
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 pi2 er2 bi3 jiao4 bao2 ge4 tou2 ye3 xiao3
cues.en: They have thin skins and are small.

cues.zh: 里头的黄瓜籽也很小
cues.pinyin: li3 tou5 de5 huang2 gua1 zi3 ye3 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: The seeds inside are small too.

cues.zh: 而且口感比较脆
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 kou3 gan3 bi3 jiao4 cui4
cues.en: And they have a crisp texture.

cues.zh: 洗干净去掉两头
cues.pinyin: xi3 gan1 jing4 qu4 diao4 liang3 tou2
cues.en: Wash them and trim both ends.

cues.zh: 直接拍
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 pai1
cues.en: Then smash them.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 拍黄瓜的小技巧

cues.zh: 但是呢你不要把它拍到完全断开
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ne5 ni3 bu2 yao4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 wan2 quan2 duan4 kai1
cues.en: Don't smash it completely apart.

cues.zh: 然后切长菱形
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 qie4 zhang3 ling2 xing2
cues.en: Then cut it into long diamond shapes.

cues.zh: 我不把它拍到断开
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ba3 ta1 pai1 dao4 duan4 kai1
cues.en: I don't smash it all the way through,

cues.zh: 切出来的黄瓜条形状完整
cues.pinyin: qie4 chu1 lai2 de5 huang2 gua1 tiao2 xing2 zhuang4 wan2 zheng3
cues.en: so the cut pieces keep their shape.

cues.zh: 也不会有很多黄瓜的小碎块
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 hui4 you3 hen3 duo1 huang2 gua1 de5 xiao3 sui4 kuai4
cues.en: And there aren't lots of little bits.

cues.zh: 拍散的黄瓜心儿呢
cues.pinyin: pai1 san4 de5 huang2 gua1 xin1 er2 ne5
cues.en: The smashed cucumber center

cues.zh: 还可以吸收很多调料的汁水
cues.pinyin: hai2 ke3 yi3 xi1 shou1 hen3 duo1 tiao2 liao4 de5 zhi1 shui3
cues.en: can soak up plenty of dressing.

cues.zh: 放盐先腌几分钟入味儿
cues.pinyin: fang4 yan2 xian1 yan1 ji3 fen1 zhong1 ru4 wei4 er5
cues.en: Add salt and let it season for a few minutes.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 黄瓜皮和籽怎么处理

cues.zh: 如果你买的黄瓜皮比较厚呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 mai3 de5 huang2 gua1 pi2 bi3 jiao4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: If your cucumber has thick skin,

cues.zh: 可以用刮刀刮去一部分皮
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 yong4 gua1 dao1 gua1 qu4 yi1 bu4 fen4 pi2
cues.en: peel some of it off.

cues.zh: 切开看看里面
cues.pinyin: qie4 kai1 kan4 kan4 li3 mian4
cues.en: Cut it open and look inside.

cues.zh: 这个黄瓜的籽儿不算大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 huang2 gua1 de5 zi3 er2 bu4 suan4 da4
cues.en: This cucumber's seeds aren't very big.

cues.zh: 你可以留着
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 liu2 zhe5
cues.en: You can leave them in.

cues.zh: 如果黄瓜籽比较大的话呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 huang2 gua1 zi3 bi3 jiao4 da4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If the seeds are large,

cues.zh: 可以像这样刮掉
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 xiang4 zhe4 yang4 gua1 diao4
cues.en: scrape them out like this.

cues.zh: 不过用那样的黄瓜的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yong4 na4 yang4 de5 huang2 gua1 de5 hua4
cues.en: But with that kind of cucumber,

cues.zh: 口感会打折扣
cues.pinyin: kou3 gan3 hui4 da3 zhe2 kou4
cues.en: the texture won't be quite as good.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 为什么要把蒜捣成泥

cues.zh: 捣碎的蒜是成泥状的
cues.pinyin: dao3 sui4 de5 suan4 shi4 cheng2 ni2 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: Crushed garlic becomes a paste.

cues.zh: 它比较容易附着在黄瓜的表面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 fu4 zhuo2 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 biao3 mian4
cues.en: It clings more easily to the cucumber.

cues.zh: 吃到嘴里蒜味会很足
cues.pinyin: chi1 dao4 zui3 li3 suan4 wei4 hui4 hen3 zu2
cues.en: So each bite has plenty of garlic flavor.

cues.zh: 要不然这个菜也叫蒜泥黄瓜
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 zhe4 ge5 cai4 ye3 jiao4 suan4 ni2 huang2 gua1
cues.en: That's why it's also called garlic cucumber.

cues.zh: 如果是用刀把蒜切小颗粒
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 yong4 dao1 ba4 suan4 qie4 xiao3 ke1 li4
cues.en: If you chop the garlic into little bits,

cues.zh: 它不容易挂在黄瓜的上面
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 rong2 yi4 gua4 zai4 huang2 gua1 de5 shang4 mian4
cues.en: it doesn't stick to the cucumber as well.

cues.zh: 你吃完黄瓜呢你会发现
cues.pinyin: ni3 chi1 wan2 huang2 gua1 ne5 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After eating the cucumber, you'll find

cues.zh: 有一盘子底的小蒜粒
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 pan2 zi5 di3 de5 xiao3 suan4 li4
cues.en: little garlic bits left on the plate.

items.title: 小高姐的 Magic Ingredients
items.title_zh: 调出酸辣开胃的味道

cues.zh: 夏季开胃小菜
cues.pinyin: xia4 ji4 kai1 wei4 xiao3 cai4
cues.en: For an appetizing summer side dish,

cues.zh: 少不了酸和辣的味道
cues.pinyin: shao4 bu4 liao3 suan1 he2 la4 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: you need sour and spicy flavors.

cues.zh: 一大勺醋和一勺辣椒油
cues.pinyin: yi1 da4 shao2 cu4 he2 yi1 shao2 la4 jiao1 you2
cues.en: A tablespoon of vinegar and a spoon of chili oil.

cues.zh: 加一点糖来平衡它们的味道
cues.pinyin: jia1 yi4 dian3 tang2 lai2 ping2 heng2 ta1 men5 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: Add a little sugar to balance the flavors.

cues.zh: 生抽增加它的鲜味
cues.pinyin: sheng1 chou1 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xian1 wei4
cues.en: Light soy sauce adds savoriness.

cues.zh: 点一点香油增加它的香味儿
cues.pinyin: dian3 yi4 dian3 xiang1 you2 zeng1 jia1 ta1 de5 xiang1 wei4 er2
cues.en: A little sesame oil adds aroma.

cues.zh: 拌匀就可以装盘了
cues.pinyin: ban4 yun2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhuang1 pan2 le5

items.title: History Odyssey
items.title_zh: 一口氣看完中華五千年歷史：從三皇五帝到清朝滅亡！誰是最強王朝？｜歷史之旅

cues.zh: 今天我们一口气来聊聊中华五千年历史
cues.en: Let's take a quick tour of five thousand years of Chinese history.
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 yi4 kou3 qi4 lai2 liao2 liao2 zhong1 hua2 wu3 qian1 nian2 li4 shi3

cues.zh: 开始大约在西元前三千年左右的时候
cues.en: We begin around 3000 BCE.
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 da4 yue1 zai4 xi1 yuan2 qian2 san1 qian1 nian2 zuo3 you4 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 中华大地上的原始部落发展得非常旺盛
cues.en: Tribal communities were flourishing across the land.
cues.pinyin: zhong1 hua2 da4 di4 shang4 de5 yuan2 shi3 bu4 luo4 fa1 zhan3 de2 fei1 chang2 wang4 sheng4

cues.zh: 慢慢的一些比较强的部落就把比较弱的给并吞了
cues.en: Over time, stronger tribes absorbed weaker ones.
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 yi1 xie1 bi3 jiao4 qiang2 de5 bu4 luo4 jiu4 ba3 bi3 jiao4 ruo4 de5 gei3 bing4 tun1 le5

cues.zh: 在中原形成了两个很厉害的部落群
cues.en: Two powerful tribal groups emerged in the Central Plains:
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 yuan2 xing2 cheng2 le5 liang3 ge4 hen3 li4 hai4 de5 bu4 luo4 qun2

cues.zh: 炎帝部落和黄帝部落
cues.en: the tribes of the Yan Emperor and the Yellow Emperor.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 bu4 luo4 he2 huang2 di4 bu4 luo4

cues.zh: 这两个部落在阪泉打了一仗
cues.en: The two tribes fought at Banquan.
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 zai4 ban3 quan2 da3 le5 yi1 zhang4

cues.zh: 黄帝打败了炎帝两个部落慢慢融合成华夏族
cues.en: The Yellow Emperor won; the tribes gradually became the Huaxia people.
cues.pinyin: huang2 di4 da3 bai4 le5 yan2 di4 liang3 ge4 bu4 luo4 man4 man4 rong2 he2 cheng2 hua2 xia4 zu2

cues.zh: 炎帝跟黄帝也成了华夏的始祖
cues.en: Both emperors became ancestral figures of the Huaxia.
cues.pinyin: yan2 di4 gen1 huang2 di4 ye3 cheng2 le5 hua2 xia4 de5 shi3 zu3

items.title: History Odyssey
items.title_zh: 一口氣看完中華五千年歷史：從三皇五帝到清朝滅亡！誰是最強王朝？｜歷史之旅

cues.zh: 这就是炎黄子孙的由来
cues.en: That's the origin of 'descendants of Yan and Huang.'
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 yan2 huang2 zi3 sun1 de5 you2 lai2

cues.zh: 没多久黄帝又在涿鹿之战中把东南方的蚩尤部落给打败了
cues.en: Later, the Yellow Emperor defeated Chiyou's tribe at Zhuolu.
cues.pinyin: mei2 duo1 jiu3 huang2 di4 you4 zai4 zhuo1 lu4 zhi1 zhan4 zhong1 ba3 dong1 nan2 fang1 de5 chi1 you2 bu4 luo4 gei3 da3 bai4 le5

cues.zh: 黄帝也成了三皇五帝里五帝的第一位
cues.en: He became the first of the legendary Five Emperors.
cues.pinyin: huang2 di4 ye3 cheng2 le5 san1 huang2 wu3 di4 li3 wu3 di4 de5 di4 yi1 wei4

cues.zh: 三皇五帝简单来说就是三皇加上五个帝王
cues.en: The title refers to Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.
cues.pinyin: san1 huang2 wu3 di4 jian3 dan1 lai2 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 san1 huang2 jia1 shang4 wu3 ge4 di4 wang2

cues.zh: 其实就是一群很厉害的部落领袖
cues.en: Essentially, they were celebrated tribal leaders.
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 qun2 hen3 li4 hai4 de5 bu4 luo4 ling3 xiu4

cues.zh: 三皇指的是燧人氏伏羲氏和神农氏
cues.en: The Three Sovereigns are Suiren, Fuxi, and Shennong.
cues.pinyin: san1 huang2 zhi3 de5 shi4 sui4 ren2 shi4 fu2 xi1 shi4 he2 shen2 nong2 shi4

cues.zh: 燧人氏发现了钻木取火
cues.en: Suiren discovered how to make fire by drilling wood.
cues.pinyin: sui4 ren2 shi4 fa1 xian4 le5 zuan1 mu4 qu3 huo3

cues.zh: 教老百姓用火煮饭抵御敌人
cues.en: He taught people to cook and defend themselves with fire.
cues.pinyin: jiao4 lao3 bai3 xing4 yong4 huo3 zhu3 fan4 di3 yu4 di2 ren2

cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 niu2 rou4 mian4 a5
cues.en: or beef noodle soup

cues.zh: 蛋蛋面啊
cues.pinyin: dan4 dan4 mian4 a5
cues.en: or dandan noodles

cues.zh: 你喜欢吃哪一种
cues.pinyin: ni3 xi3 huan1 chi1 na3 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: Which kind do you like

cues.zh: 那下一次我也去尝尝看
cues.pinyin: na4 xia4 yi1 ci4 wo3 ye3 qu4 chang2 chang2 kan4
cues.en: I'll try that next time too

cues.zh: 好的别忘了留言
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 bie2 wang4 le5 liu2 yan2
cues.en: Okay, don't forget to leave a comment

cues.zh: 按赞订阅
cues.pinyin: an4 zan4 ding4 yue4
cues.en: Like and subscribe

cues.zh: 我们下期见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 ge1
cues.en: See you next time

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 为了一条鱼这个人连命都不要了
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 yi1 tiao2 yu2 zhe4 ge5 ren2 lian2 ming4 dou1 bu2 yao4 le5
cues.en: For the sake of one fish, this man was even willing to risk his life.

cues.zh: 这个人是林叔
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 shi4 lin2 shu1
cues.en: This man is Uncle Lin.

cues.zh: 他说自己已经追寻马林鱼 40 多年了
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 yi3 jing1 zhui1 xun2 ma3 lin2 yu2 40 duo1 nian2 le5
cues.en: He says he's been chasing this marlin for over 40 years.

cues.zh: 今天终于钓到了梦寐以求的巨型马林鱼
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhong1 yu2 diao4 dao4 le5 meng4 mei4 yi3 qiu2 de5 ju4 xing2 ma3 lin2 yu2
cues.en: Today he finally caught the giant marlin he had always dreamed of.

cues.zh: 他甚至用自己老爸的名字给这
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen4 zhi4 yong4 zi4 ji3 lao3 ba4 de5 ming2 zi4 gei3 zhe4
cues.en: He even used his own father's name

cues.zh: 条咬住他不放
cues.pinyin: tiao2 yao3 zhu4 ta1 bu4 fang4
cues.en: to name this marlin that had bitten him and wouldn't let go

cues.zh: 的马林鱼命名
cues.pinyin: de5 ma3 lin2 yu2 ming4 ming2
cues.en: — that's how he named the marlin.

cues.zh: 真的拿这条马铃鱼当爹一样的供着了
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 na2 zhe4 tiao2 ma3 ling2 yu2 dang1 die1 yi1 yang4 de5 gong1 zhe5 le5
cues.en: He really worships this marlin like it's his own father.

cues.zh: 医生们说鱼在腿上没办法做 CT
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 shuo1 yu2 zai4 tui3 shang4 mei2 ban4 fa3 zuo4 CT
cues.en: The doctors said they couldn't do a CT scan with the fish still on his leg.

cues.zh: 必须把鱼切割然后拿掉才行
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 ba3 yu2 qie1 ge1 ran2 hou4 na2 diao4 cai2 xing2
cues.en: The fish had to be cut off and removed first.

cues.zh: 可是林鼠还真的像护着他老爸一
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lin2 shu3 hai2 zhen1 de5 xiang4 hu4 zhe5 ta1 lao3 ba4 yi1
cues.en: But Uncle Lin really guarded it like it was his own father—

cues.zh: 样护着这条鱼
cues.pinyin: yang4 hu4 zhe5 zhe4 tiao2 yu2
cues.en: —protecting this fish.

cues.zh: 发誓要跟马林鱼共存亡
cues.pinyin: fa1 shi4 yao4 gen1 ma3 lin2 yu2 gong4 cun2 wang2
cues.en: He swore to live or die together with the marlin.

cues.zh: 就好像心有灵犀一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hao3 xiang4 xin1 you3 ling2 xi1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: As if they were on the same wavelength,

cues.zh: 马林鱼也开始扭动身体
cues.pinyin: ma3 lin2 yu2 ye3 kai1 shi3 niu3 dong4 shen1 ti3
cues.en: the marlin also began to writhe its body,

cues.zh: 表达自己对医生的不满
cues.pinyin: biao3 da2 zi4 ji3 dui4 yi1 sheng1 de5 bu4 man3
cues.en: expressing its displeasure with the doctors.

cues.zh: 鱼不能切
cues.pinyin: yu2 bu4 neng2 qie4
cues.en: The fish can't be cut.

cues.zh: 但是检查一定要做
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jian3 cha2 yi2 ding4 yao4 zuo4
cues.en: But the examination still has to be done.

cues.zh: 医生们没办法
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: The doctors had no choice,

cues.zh: 只好把鱼跟林叔一起推到核磁共振室
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 ba3 yu2 gen1 lin2 shu1 yi4 qi3 tui1 dao4 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4 shi4
cues.en: so they wheeled the fish and Uncle Lin together into the MRI room.

cues.zh: 估计鱼做梦也没想到
cues.pinyin: gu1 ji4 yu2 zuo4 meng4 ye3 mei2 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: The fish probably never imagined, even in its dreams,

cues.zh: 在他死后居然还有幸体验一次核磁共振
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 si3 hou4 ju1 ran2 hai2 you3 xing4 ti3 yan4 yi1 ci4 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: that after death it would get to experience an MRI scan.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 可是或许核磁共振让马林鱼不开心
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 huo4 xu3 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4 rang4 ma3 lin2 yu2 bu4 kai1 xin1
cues.en: But maybe the MRI upset the marlin,

cues.zh: 于是他炸了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 zha4 le5
cues.en: so it exploded.

cues.zh: 鲜血喷的到处都是
cues.pinyin: xian1 xue4 pen1 de5 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4
cues.en: Blood sprayed everywhere.

cues.zh: 整个核磁共振室里一片狼藉
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4 shi4 li3 yi1 pian4 lang2 ji2
cues.en: The whole MRI room was a complete mess.

cues.zh: 负责检验的医生心有余悸
cues.pinyin: fu4 ze2 jian3 yan4 de5 yi1 sheng1 xin1 you3 yu2 ji4
cues.en: The doctor in charge of the exam was left shaken,

cues.zh: 说这条鱼体内应该是有鱼钩一类的金属
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 tiao2 yu2 ti3 nei4 ying1 gai1 shi4 you3 yu2 gou1 yi1 lei4 de5 jin1 shu3
cues.en: saying there was probably a fish hook or similar metal inside the fish.

cues.zh: 所以做 CT 的时候会爆炸
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zuo4 CT de5 shi2 hou4 hui4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: That's why it exploded during the scan.

cues.zh: 还好林叔没事
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 lin2 shu1 mei2 shi4
cues.en: Luckily, Uncle Lin was fine.

cues.zh: 但是他明显更关心鱼的情况
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 ming2 xian3 geng4 guan1 xin1 yu2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: But he was clearly more worried about the fish's condition

cues.zh: 而不是关心自己的健康
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 guan1 xin1 zi4 ji3 de5 jian4 kang1
cues.en: than about his own health.

cues.zh: 原本仅仅咬在林叔腿上的鱼嘴
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ben3 jin3 jin3 yao3 zai4 lin2 shu1 tui3 shang4 de5 yu2 zui3
cues.en: The fish's mouth, which had only been biting onto Uncle Lin's leg,

cues.zh: 突然掉了下来
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 diao4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: suddenly fell off.

cues.zh: 林叔的腿上出现了一个血洞
cues.pinyin: lin2 shu1 de5 tui3 shang4 chu1 xian4 le5 yi2 ge4 xue4 dong4
cues.en: A bloody hole appeared on Uncle Lin's leg.

cues.zh: 鲜血如喷泉般狂喷
cues.pinyin: xian1 xue4 ru2 pen1 quan2 ban1 kuang2 pen1
cues.en: Blood gushed out like a fountain.

cues.zh: 林叔很快就休克了
cues.pinyin: lin2 shu1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 xiu1 ke4 le5
cues.en: Uncle Lin quickly went into shock.

cues.zh: 情况紧急
cues.pinyin: qing2 kuang4 jin3 ji2
cues.en: The situation was critical.

cues.zh: 小布赶紧用手堵住林叔的血洞
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 gan3 jin3 yong4 shou3 du3 zhu4 lin2 shu1 de5 xue4 dong4
cues.en: Xiao Bu quickly pressed his hands over Uncle Lin's wound.

cues.zh: 送到手术室紧急抢救
cues.pinyin: song4 dao4 shou3 shu4 shi4 jin3 ji2 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: He was rushed to the operating room for emergency treatment.

cues.zh: 止血的手术并不复杂
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xue4 de5 shou3 shu4 bing4 bu4 fu4 za2
cues.en: The surgery to stop the bleeding wasn't complicated.

cues.zh: 只需要在出血的动脉上
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xu1 yao4 zai4 chu1 xie3 de5 dong4 mai4 shang4
cues.en: They just needed to, on the bleeding artery,

cues.zh: 切下两个口子连上就行
cues.pinyin: qie4 xia4 liang3 ge4 kou3 zi5 lian2 shang4 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: make two cuts and reconnect it.

cues.zh: 比较难的是不能碰到神经末端
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 nan2 de5 shi4 bu4 neng2 peng4 dao4 shen2 jing1 mo4 duan1
cues.en: The hard part was avoiding the nerve endings.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 抗生素怎么会对癌症有用呢
cues.pinyin: kang4 sheng1 su4 zen3 me5 hui4 dui4 ai2 zheng4 you3 yong4 ne5
cues.en: Why would antibiotics work on cancer?

cues.zh: 医生们赶紧拿林叔腿部的溃疡组织去检查
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gan3 jin3 na2 lin2 shu1 tui3 bu4 de5 kui4 yang2 zu3 zhi1 qu4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: The doctors quickly took a sample of the ulcerated tissue on Uncle Lin's leg for testing.

cues.zh: 检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The test results came back.

cues.zh: 果然在林叔的腿上有一个血管肉流
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 zai4 lin2 shu1 de5 tui3 shang4 you3 yi2 ge4 xue4 guan3 rou4 liu2
cues.en: Sure enough, there was an angiosarcoma on Uncle Lin's leg.

cues.zh: 好在边缘十分清晰
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 bian1 yuan2 shi2 fen1 qing1 xi1
cues.en: Fortunately, its margins were very clear.

cues.zh: 医生们把林书的伤腿截肢了
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ba3 lin2 shu1 de5 shang1 tui3 jie2 zhi1 le5
cues.en: The doctors amputated Uncle Lin's injured leg

cues.zh: 阻止肿瘤向全身扩散
cues.pinyin: zu3 zhi3 zhong3 liu2 xiang4 quan2 shen1 kuo4 san4
cues.en: to stop the tumor from spreading through his body.

cues.zh: 这是一个好消息
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: This was good news.

cues.zh: 林书虽然失去了一条腿
cues.pinyin: lin2 shu1 sui1 ran2 shi1 qu4 le5 yi1 tiao2 tui3
cues.en: Although Uncle Lin lost a leg,

cues.zh: 但是毕竟因祸得福
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bi4 jing4 yin1 huo4 de2 fu2
cues.en: it turned out to be a blessing in disguise.

cues.zh: 要是没有这次的意外
cues.pinyin: yao4 shi4 mei2 you3 zhe4 ci4 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: If not for this accident,

cues.zh: 这个肿瘤很有可能有朝一日
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhong3 liu2 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 you3 zhao1 yi1 ri4
cues.en: this tumor might one day

cues.zh: 就会转移到林书全身
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 lin2 shu1 quan2 shen1
cues.en: have spread throughout Uncle Lin's body,

cues.zh: 他就性命难保了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 xing4 ming4 nan2 bao3 le5
cues.en: and his life would have been in danger.

cues.zh: 林书果然十分高兴
cues.pinyin: lin2 shu1 guo3 ran2 shi2 fen1 gao1 xing4
cues.en: Uncle Lin was indeed very happy,

cues.zh: 不过他高兴的不是因为他的生命保住了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 gao1 xing4 de5 bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 sheng1 ming4 bao3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: but not because his life had been saved—

cues.zh: 而是因为他的马铃鱼保住了
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 ma3 ling2 yu2 bao3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: it was because his marlin had been saved.

cues.zh: 虽然经历了爆炸
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 jing1 li4 le5 bao4 zha4
cues.en: Although it had gone through an explosion,

cues.zh: 但是马铃鱼还真是十分顽强
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ma3 ling2 yu2 hai2 zhen1 shi4 shi2 fen1 wan2 qiang2
cues.en: the marlin was remarkably resilient

cues.zh: 还保存着应有的外形
cues.pinyin: hai2 bao3 cun2 zhe5 ying1 you3 de5 wai4 xing2
cues.en: and still kept its proper shape.

cues.zh: 林书亲切的呼唤着马铃鱼的名字
cues.pinyin: lin2 shu1 qin1 qie4 de5 hu1 huan4 zhe5 ma3 ling2 yu2 de5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: Uncle Lin affectionately called out the marlin's name:

cues.zh: 弗兰克林
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 lin2
cues.en: Franklin.

cues.zh: 不知道在天堂的林书的老爹
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 zai4 tian1 tang2 de5 lin2 shu1 de5 lao3 die1
cues.en: I wonder if Uncle Lin's late father, up in heaven,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 确认了小米的病因确实是胆囊炎
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 le5 xiao3 mi3 de5 bing4 yin1 que4 shi2 shi4 dan3 nang2 yan2
cues.en: It was confirmed that Xiaomi's condition was indeed cholecystitis,

cues.zh: 而且比较严重了
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bi3 jiao4 yan2 zhong4 le5
cues.en: and it was fairly severe.

cues.zh: 需要马上手术切除
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 ma3 shang4 shou3 shu4 qie1 chu2
cues.en: It needed to be surgically removed right away.

cues.zh: 手术的主导医生就选择由小布担任
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 de5 zhu3 dao3 yi1 sheng1 jiu4 xuan3 ze2 you2 xiao3 bu4 dan1 ren4
cues.en: Xiao Bu was chosen as the lead surgeon for the operation.

cues.zh: 这真是一个让人兴奋又紧张的消息
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhen1 shi4 yi2 ge4 rang4 ren2 xing1 fen4 you4 jin3 zhang1 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: This was exciting yet nerve-wracking news.

cues.zh: 因为这是小布第一次担任主刀医生
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 shi4 xiao3 bu4 di4 yi1 ci4 dan1 ren4 zhu3 dao1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Because this was Xiao Bu's first time serving as chief surgeon.

cues.zh: 小布再次回到住院部的时候
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 zai4 ci4 hui2 dao4 zhu4 yuan4 bu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When Xiao Bu returned to the inpatient ward again,

cues.zh: 刚好赶上小米的妈妈来医院探望
cues.pinyin: gang1 hao3 gan3 shang4 xiao3 mi3 de5 ma1 ma1 lai2 yi1 yuan4 tan4 wang4
cues.en: he happened to arrive just as Xiaomi's mother came to visit.

cues.zh: 按说女儿生病妈妈应该是最着急的
cues.pinyin: an4 shuo1 nv3 er2 sheng1 bing4 ma1 ma1 ying1 gai1 shi4 zui4 zhao2 ji2 de5
cues.en: Normally, when a daughter is sick, the mother should be the most worried,

cues.zh: 可是眼前的女人不但不着急
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yan3 qian2 de5 nv3 ren2 bu4 dan4 bu4 zhao2 ji2
cues.en: but the woman in front of him wasn't worried at all—

cues.zh: 反而根本不相信小米有什么重病
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 gen1 ben3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 xiao3 mi3 you3 shen2 me5 zhong4 bing4
cues.en: in fact, she didn't believe Xiaomi had any serious illness.

cues.zh: 在她的眼里
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 de5 yan3 li3
cues.en: In her eyes,

cues.zh: 小米只是一个装病不想带孩子的坏女孩
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 zhi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhuang1 bing4 bu4 xiang3 dai4 hai2 zi5 de5 huai4 nv3 hai2
cues.en: Xiaomi was just a bad girl faking illness to avoid taking care of the kids.

cues.zh: 她告诉小布
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 xiao3 bu4
cues.en: She told Xiao Bu

cues.zh: 小米身体壮如牛
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 shen1 ti3 zhuang4 ru2 niu2
cues.en: that Xiaomi was as strong as an ox.

cues.zh: 而且如果住院她会耽误很多课程
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ru2 guo3 zhu4 yuan4 ta1 hui4 dan1 wu4 hen3 duo1 ke4 cheng2
cues.en: And if she stayed in the hospital, she'd fall behind on a lot of schoolwork,

cues.zh: 也会耽误她照顾弟弟妹妹
cues.pinyin: ye3 hui4 dan1 wu4 ta1 zhao4 gu4 di4 di5 mei4 mei4
cues.en: and it would also keep her from taking care of her younger siblings.

cues.zh: 家里有三张嗷嗷待哺的嘴等着小米伺候呢
cues.pinyin: jia1 li3 you3 san1 zhang1 ao2 ao2 dai4 bu3 de5 zui3 deng3 zhe5 xiao3 mi3 ci4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: There were three hungry mouths at home waiting for Xiaomi to feed them.

cues.zh: 米妈没有给小布很多时间
cues.pinyin: mi3 ma1 mei2 you3 gei3 xiao3 bu4 hen3 duo1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Xiaomi's mom didn't give Xiao Bu much time.

cues.zh: 她说自己待在医院很难受
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 dai4 zai4 yi1 yuan4 hen3 nan2 shou4
cues.en: She said staying in the hospital was very uncomfortable for her,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 家里也花不起钱让小米治病
cues.pinyin: jia1 li3 ye3 hua1 bu4 qi3 qian2 rang4 xiao3 mi3 zhi4 bing4
cues.en: and the family couldn't afford to pay for Xiaomi's treatment.

cues.zh: 小布自然据理力争
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 zi4 ran2 ju4 li3 li4 zheng1
cues.en: Xiao Bu naturally argued back with solid reasoning.

cues.zh: 这孩子已经病了一阵子了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hai2 zi5 yi3 jing1 bing4 le5 yi1 zhen4 zi5 le5
cues.en: This child had already been sick for a while.

cues.zh: 胆囊上的病变已经很明显
cues.pinyin: dan3 nang2 shang4 de5 bing4 bian4 yi3 jing1 hen3 ming2 xian3
cues.en: The lesion on her gallbladder was already quite obvious,

cues.zh: 说明这种腹痛在之前也时有发生了
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 zhe4 zhong3 fu4 tong4 zai4 zhi1 qian2 ye3 shi2 you3 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: which showed this kind of abdominal pain had happened before too.

cues.zh: 身为妈妈你不但没有关注
cues.pinyin: shen1 wei4 ma1 ma1 ni3 bu4 dan4 mei2 you3 guan1 zhu4
cues.en: As her mother, not only did you fail to pay attention,

cues.zh: 居然阻止医生为她治疗吗
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 zu3 zhi3 yi1 sheng1 wei4 ta1 zhi4 liao2 ma5
cues.en: you're even trying to stop the doctor from treating her?

cues.zh: 米妈很生气的质问小米
cues.pinyin: mi3 ma1 hen3 sheng1 qi4 de5 zhi4 wen4 xiao3 mi3
cues.en: Xiaomi's mom angrily confronted Xiaomi,

cues.zh: 为什么没有将这些告诉她
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 mei2 you3 jiang1 zhe4 xie1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: asking why she hadn't told her about any of this.

cues.zh: 小米张张嘴似乎想说什么
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 zhang1 zhang1 zui3 si4 hu1 xiang3 shuo1 shen2 me5
cues.en: Xiaomi opened her mouth as if about to say something,

cues.zh: 可是突然医疗仪器集体报警
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 tu1 ran2 yi1 liao2 yi2 qi4 ji2 ti3 bao4 jing3
cues.en: but suddenly all the medical equipment started alarming at once.

cues.zh: 小米捂着胸口十分痛苦的声音
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 wu3 zhe5 xiong1 kou3 shi2 fen1 tong4 ku3 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: Xiaomi clutched her chest, making sounds of intense pain.

cues.zh: 她的血氧饱和度迅速下降
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xue4 yang3 bao3 he2 du4 xun4 su4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Her blood oxygen saturation dropped rapidly.

cues.zh: 心率也变得十分快
cues.pinyin: xin1 lv4 ye3 bian4 de2 shi2 fen1 kuai4
cues.en: Her heart rate also became very fast.

cues.zh: 经过检查
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: After examination,

cues.zh: 小米发生了肺栓色
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 fa1 sheng1 le5 fei4 shuan1 se4
cues.en: it turned out Xiaomi had suffered a pulmonary embolism.

cues.zh: 从扫描的结果来看
cues.pinyin: cong2 sao3 miao2 de5 jie2 guo3 lai2 kan4
cues.en: According to the scan results,

cues.zh: 是她腿部有一个大血块
cues.pinyin: shi4 ta1 tui3 bu4 you3 yi2 ge4 da4 xue4 kuai4
cues.en: there was a large blood clot in her leg.

cues.zh: 血块的碎片顺着血流来到肺部
cues.pinyin: xue4 kuai4 de5 sui4 pian4 shun4 zhe5 xue4 liu2 lai2 dao4 fei4 bu4
cues.en: Fragments of the clot traveled through her bloodstream to her lungs,

cues.zh: 引发了肺栓色
cues.pinyin: yin3 fa1 le5 fei4 shuan1 se4
cues.en: triggering the pulmonary embolism.

cues.zh: 这是致死率很高的病
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhi4 si3 lv4 hen3 gao1 de5 bing4
cues.en: This is a disease with a very high mortality rate.

cues.zh: 引发了肺栓塞
cues.pinyin: yin3 fa1 le5 fei4 shuan1 se4
cues.en: Xiao Bu told Xiaomi

cues.zh: 腿部的大血块很有可能是由于她长期服用
cues.pinyin: tui3 bu4 de5 da4 xue4 kuai4 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 you2 yu2 ta1 chang2 qi1 fu2 yong4
cues.en: that the large blood clot in her leg was likely caused by her long-term use of—

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子被巨型鱼咬住，天才医生们想将鱼切割，男子却执意不肯，这可是我的祖宗！这集布朗的母亲出车祸去世了！

cues.zh: 小米转过身背对着小布
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 zhuan3 guo4 shen1 bei4 dui4 zhe5 xiao3 bu4
cues.en: Xiaomi turned her back on Xiao Bu.

cues.zh: 她拒绝聊这个话题
cues.pinyin: ta1 ju4 jue2 liao2 zhe4 ge5 hua4 ti2
cues.en: She refused to talk about this topic.

cues.zh: 小布也不着急
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 ye3 bu4 zhao2 ji2
cues.en: Xiao Bu wasn't in a hurry either.

cues.zh: 索性坐在病房里等待着小米
cues.pinyin: suo3 xing4 zuo4 zai4 bing4 fang2 li3 deng3 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 mi3
cues.en: He simply sat in the ward and waited for Xiaomi,

cues.zh: 看她什么时候愿意对她敞开心扉
cues.pinyin: kan4 ta1 shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 yuan4 yi4 dui4 ta1 chang3 kai1 xin1 fei1
cues.en: to see when she'd be willing to open up to him.

cues.zh: 小米终于忍不住寂寞
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 zhong1 yu2 ren3 bu2 zhu4 ji4 mo4
cues.en: Xiaomi finally couldn't bear the loneliness any longer.

cues.zh: 她告诉小布自己是寄养的孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 xiao3 bu4 zi4 ji3 shi4 ji4 yang3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She told Xiao Bu that she was a foster child.

cues.zh: 她的养母带回家了三个孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yang3 mu3 dai4 hui2 jia1 le5 san1 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Her foster mother had brought three children home,

cues.zh: 这些孩子的饮食起居
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 hai2 zi5 de5 yin3 shi2 qi3 ju1
cues.en: and these kids' daily meals and care—

cues.zh: 日常生活都是她在照顾
cues.pinyin: ri4 chang2 sheng1 huo2 dou1 shi4 ta1 zai4 zhao4 gu4
cues.en: their everyday life—were all looked after by her.

cues.zh: 所以她连上医院都带着妹妹
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 lian2 shang4 yi1 yuan4 dou1 dai4 zhe5 mei4 mei4
cues.en: That's why she even brought her little sister with her to the hospital.

cues.zh: 她实在太压抑
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi2 zai4 tai4 ya1 yi4
cues.en: She was simply too repressed,

cues.zh: 太憋屈
cues.pinyin: tai4 bie1 qu1
cues.en: too stifled,

cues.zh: 才会自残的
cues.pinyin: cai2 hui4 zi4 can2 de5
cues.en: which was why she hurt herself.

cues.zh: 小布试图说服米妈
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 shi4 tu2 shuo1 fu2 mi3 ma1
cues.en: Xiao Bu tried to persuade Xiaomi's mom

cues.zh: 找个心理医生
cues.pinyin: zhao3 ge4 xin1 li3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: to find a therapist

cues.zh: 为小米疏导一下
cues.pinyin: wei4 xiao3 mi3 shu1 dao3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: to counsel Xiaomi,

cues.zh: 但是被米妈拒绝了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bei4 mi3 ma1 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but her mom refused.

cues.zh: 小布便自作主张
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 bian4 zi4 zuo4 zhu3 zhang1
cues.en: So Xiao Bu decided to act on his own,

cues.zh: 找了心理医生来看望小米
cues.pinyin: zhao3 le5 xin1 li3 yi1 sheng1 lai2 kan4 wang4 xiao3 mi3
cues.en: and brought in a psychologist to see Xiaomi,

cues.zh: 却反而被米妈投诉了
cues.pinyin: que4 fan3 er2 bei4 mi3 ma1 tou2 su4 le5
cues.en: but instead got reported by Xiaomi's mom.

cues.zh: 这场闹剧的代价
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 nao4 ju4 de5 dai4 jia4
cues.en: The cost of this whole fiasco

cues.zh: 就是小布失去了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xiao3 bu4 shi1 qu4 le5
cues.en: was that Xiao Bu lost

cues.zh: 小米主导医生的资格
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 zhu3 dao3 yi1 sheng1 de5 zi1 ge2
cues.en: his position as Xiaomi's lead doctor.

cues.zh: 由梅医生代替她来完成手术
cues.pinyin: you2 mei2 yi1 sheng1 dai4 ti4 ta1 lai2 wan2 cheng2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Dr. Mei took over to complete the surgery instead.

cues.zh: 可是小米不同意
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao3 mi3 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: But Xiaomi didn't agree.

cues.zh: 她歇斯底里地拒绝手术
cues.pinyin: ta1 xie1 si1 di3 li3 di4 ju4 jue2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: She hysterically refused the surgery.

cues.zh: 那如果你有一天觉得非常的懒惰
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 you3 yi1 tian1 jue2 de5 fei1 chang2 de5 lan3 duo4
cues.en: If one day you feel very lazy

cues.zh: 就是不想要煮东西
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bu4 xiang3 yao4 zhu3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: and don't want to cook anything

cues.zh: 还想要喝燕窝也没有问题
cues.pinyin: hai2 xiang3 yao4 he1 yan4 wo1 ye3 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: but still want to have bird's nest, that's no problem

cues.zh: 那在一个大碗里呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 wan3 li3 ne5
cues.en: In a large bowl

cues.zh: 我们放入一杯水
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 yi1 bei1 shui3
cues.en: we add one cup of water

cues.zh: 把 Sim ply Swift 的燕窝放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 Sim ply Swift de5 yan4 wo1 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: and put in the Simply Swift bird's nest

cues.zh: 放进微波炉里煮 4 分钟
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 wei1 bo1 lu2 li3 zhu3 4 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Put it in the microwave and cook for 4 minutes

cues.zh: 4 分钟过后呢
cues.pinyin: 4 fen1 zhong1 guo4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After 4 minutes

cues.zh: 我们就可以调味了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 tiao2 wei4 le5
cues.en: we can season it

cues.zh: 放进冰糖
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 bing1 tang2
cues.en: Add rock sugar

cues.zh: 搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: give it a stir

cues.zh: 再放进枸杞
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 jin4 gou3 qi3
cues.en: then add goji berries

cues.zh: 做好了

cues.en: is ready

cues.zh: 赶快品尝一下它的味道

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 原来毒奶粉不光某国在生产
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 du2 nai3 fen3 bu4 guang1 mou3 guo2 zai4 sheng1 chan3
cues.en: It turns out contaminated baby formula isn't only made in one country.

cues.zh: 在漂亮国同样有一款毒奶粉
cues.pinyin: zai4 piao4 liang4 guo2 tong2 yang4 you3 yi1 kuan3 du2 nai3 fen3
cues.en: The US ('Pretty Country') also has a brand of poisoned formula.

cues.zh: 害死了一名婴儿婴儿的父母悲痛欲绝
cues.pinyin: hai4 si3 le5 yi1 ming2 ying1 er2 ying1 er2 de5 fu4 mu3 bei1 tong4 yu4 jue2
cues.en: It killed an infant, and the baby's parents were devastated.

cues.zh: 法官和陪审团却并不站在他们这边
cues.pinyin: fa3 guan1 he2 pei2 shen3 tuan2 que4 bing4 bu4 zhan4 zai4 ta1 men5 zhe4 bian1
cues.en: But the judge and jury weren't on their side.

cues.zh: 甚至说是他们对婴儿照顾不利才导
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 shuo1 shi4 ta1 men5 dui4 ying1 er2 zhao4 gu4 bu4 li4 cai2 dao3
cues.en: They even claimed the parents' negligent care was what

cues.zh: 致婴儿死亡的
cues.pinyin: zhi4 ying1 er2 si3 wang2 de5
cues.en: caused the baby's death.

cues.zh: 老练律师第六集火爆上线
cues.pinyin: lao3 lian4 lv4 shi1 di4 liu4 ji2 huo3 bao4 shang4 xian4
cues.en: Episode 6 of 'The Veteran Lawyer' is now live.

cues.zh: 毒奶粉背后的真相是什么
cues.pinyin: du2 nai3 fen3 bei4 hou4 de5 zhen1 xiang4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What's the truth behind the tainted formula?

cues.zh: 这对父母能为他们的孩子讨回公道吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dui4 fu4 mu3 neng2 wei4 ta1 men5 de5 hai2 zi5 tao3 hui2 gong1 dao4 ma5
cues.en: Can these parents get justice for their child?

cues.zh: 老练律师马蒂以 75 岁高龄重返职场
cues.pinyin: lao3 lian4 lv4 shi1 ma3 di4 yi3 75 sui4 gao1 ling2 chong2 fan3 zhi2 chang3
cues.en: Veteran lawyer Marty returns to work at age 75.

cues.zh: 很快以自己出色的能力征服了一众同事
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 yi3 zi4 ji3 chu1 se4 de5 neng2 li4 zheng1 fu2 le5 yi1 zhong4 tong2 shi4
cues.en: She quickly won over her colleagues with her outstanding skills,

cues.zh: 彻底在律所站稳脚跟
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 zai4 lv4 suo3 zhan4 wen3 jiao3 gen1
cues.en: and firmly established herself at the firm.

cues.zh: 而马蒂也成功拿到了通往律所云
cues.pinyin: er2 ma3 di4 ye3 cheng2 gong1 na2 dao4 le5 tong1 wang3 lv4 suo3 yun2
cues.en: Marty also managed to get hold of the key to the firm's cloud

cues.zh: 服务器的钥匙
cues.pinyin: fu2 wu4 qi4 de5 yao4 shi5
cues.en: server.

cues.zh: IT 部工程师的指纹
cues.pinyin: IT bu4 gong1 cheng2 shi1 de5 zhi3 wen2
cues.en: The IT engineer's fingerprint.

cues.zh: 只要将指纹复刻出来
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 jiang1 zhi3 wen2 fu4 ke4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: As long as the fingerprint is replicated,

cues.zh: 就可以打开 IT 部工程师的电脑
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 da3 kai1 IT bu4 gong1 cheng2 shi1 de5 dian4 nao3
cues.en: it can unlock the IT engineer's computer,

cues.zh: 从而登录云服务器
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 deng1 lu4 yun2 fu2 wu4 qi4
cues.en: and log into the cloud server.

cues.zh: 寻找那份被隐藏起来的文件
cues.pinyin: xun2 zhao3 na4 fen4 bei4 yin3 cang2 qi3 lai2 de5 wen2 jian4
cues.en: to find that hidden file.

cues.zh: 眼看胜利在望了
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 sheng4 li4 zai4 wang4 le5
cues.en: Victory seemed within reach.

cues.zh: 可马蒂的身份差点败露
cues.pinyin: ke3 ma3 di4 de5 shen1 fen4 cha4 dian3 bai4 lu4
cues.en: But Marty's true identity nearly got exposed.

cues.zh: 不明真相的热心同事比利
cues.pinyin: bu4 ming2 zhen1 xiang4 de5 re4 xin1 tong2 shi4 bi3 li4
cues.en: A well-meaning coworker, Billy, who didn't know the truth,

cues.zh: 悄悄将马蒂的个人信息发布到
cues.pinyin: qiao1 qiao1 jiang1 ma3 di4 de5 ge4 ren2 xin4 xi1 fa1 bu4 dao4
cues.en: quietly posted Marty's personal info

cues.zh: 了相亲的 APP 上
cues.pinyin: le5 xiang1 qin1 de5 APP shang4
cues.en: onto a dating app.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 却不料一个神秘男士竟然认出了马蒂
cues.pinyin: que4 bu4 liao4 yi2 ge4 shen2 mi4 nan2 shi4 jing4 ran2 ren4 chu1 le5 ma3 di4
cues.en: Unexpectedly, a mysterious man recognized Marty

cues.zh: 还表示要见马蒂
cues.pinyin: hai2 biao3 shi4 yao4 jian4 ma3 di4
cues.en: and said he wanted to meet her.

cues.zh: 好在马蒂还有一个黑客小外孙
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 ma3 di4 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 hei1 ke4 xiao3 wai4 sun1
cues.en: Luckily, Marty has a hacker grandson.

cues.zh: 他偷偷潜入相亲网站服务器
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou1 tou1 qian2 ru4 xiang1 qin1 wang3 zhan4 fu2 wu4 qi4
cues.en: He secretly hacked into the dating site's server

cues.zh: 将马蒂的资料删除了
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ma3 di4 de5 zi1 liao4 shan1 chu2 le5
cues.en: and deleted Marty's profile.

cues.zh: 马蒂才勉强放下心来
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 cai2 mian3 qiang3 fang4 xia4 xin1 lai2
cues.en: Only then could Marty finally relax a bit.

cues.zh: 处理完私人问题
cues.pinyin: chu3 li3 wan2 si1 ren2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: With her personal matter handled,

cues.zh: 马蒂就要全身心投入工作当中了
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 jiu4 yao4 quan2 shen1 xin1 tou2 ru4 gong1 zuo4 dang1 zhong1 le5
cues.en: Marty was ready to throw herself fully into work.

cues.zh: 他的上司小傲和前夫哥朱利安
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 shang4 si1 xiao3 ao4 he2 qian2 fu1 ge1 zhu1 li4 an1
cues.en: Her boss Xiao Ao and Xiao Ao's ex-husband Julian

cues.zh: 从前负责的一个案件
cues.pinyin: cong2 qian2 fu4 ze2 de5 yi2 ge4 an4 jian4
cues.en: once handled a case together

cues.zh: 最近迎来了重审
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 ying2 lai2 le5 chong2 shen3
cues.en: that's now getting a retrial.

cues.zh: 这是一起毒奶粉杀婴案
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi4 qi3 du2 nai3 fen3 sha1 ying1 an4
cues.en: It's a case about a baby killed by tainted formula.

cues.zh: 年轻父母安娜和瓦内萨
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 fu4 mu3 an1 na4 he2 wa3 nei4 sa4
cues.en: The young parents, Anna and Vanessa —

cues.zh: 他们的孩子喝了某品牌的奶粉后去世
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 hai2 zi5 he1 le5 mou3 pin3 pai2 de5 nai3 fen3 hou4 qu4 shi4
cues.en: their child died after drinking a certain brand of formula.

cues.zh: 两人认为奶粉被污染了
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 ren4 wei2 nai3 fen3 bei4 wu1 ran3 le5
cues.en: The couple believed the formula was contaminated,

cues.zh: 所以将奶粉厂商告上法庭
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiang1 nai3 fen3 chang3 shang1 gao4 shang4 fa3 ting2
cues.en: so they sued the formula manufacturer.

cues.zh: 可奶粉厂却说污染发生在父母的公寓里
cues.pinyin: ke3 nai3 fen3 chang3 que4 shuo1 wu1 ran3 fa1 sheng1 zai4 fu4 mu3 de5 gong1 yu4 li3
cues.en: But the company claimed the contamination happened in the parents' apartment,

cues.zh: 奶粉厂不应该承担责任
cues.pinyin: nai3 fen3 chang3 bu4 ying1 gai1 cheng2 dan1 ze2 ren4
cues.en: and that the company shouldn't be held liable.

cues.zh: 最后小奥和朱利安败诉
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 xiao3 ao4 he2 zhu1 li4 an1 bai4 su4
cues.en: In the end, Xiao Ao and Julian lost the case.

cues.zh: 如今迎来了重审的机会
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 ying2 lai2 le5 chong2 shen3 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: Now they have a chance for a retrial,

cues.zh: 他们十分珍惜
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi2 fen1 zhen1 xi1
cues.en: and they treasure this opportunity.

cues.zh: 可经过一阵子的相处
cues.pinyin: ke3 jing1 guo4 yi1 zhen4 zi5 de5 xiang1 chu3
cues.en: But after spending time together,

cues.zh: 小奥对马蒂已经有了感情
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 dui4 ma3 di4 yi3 jing1 you3 le5 gan3 qing2
cues.en: Xiao Ao has grown fond of Marty.

cues.zh: 他知道马蒂失去了自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 ma3 di4 shi1 qu4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She knows Marty lost her own child,

cues.zh: 所以担心这个案子刺激到马蒂
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dan1 xin1 zhe4 ge5 an4 zi5 ci4 ji1 dao4 ma3 di4
cues.en: so she worries this case might hurt Marty emotionally.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 这对夫妻不断自责
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dui4 fu1 qi1 bu4 duan4 zi4 ze2
cues.en: The couple kept blaming themselves,

cues.zh: 都认为是自己的疏忽才导致孩子死亡的
cues.pinyin: dou1 ren4 wei2 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 shu1 hu1 cai2 dao3 zhi4 hai2 zi5 si3 wang2 de5
cues.en: believing their own negligence caused their child's death.

cues.zh: 这样可不行
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ke3 bu4 xing2
cues.en: That won't do.

cues.zh: 如果连他们自己都觉得自己有错
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 lian2 ta1 men5 zi4 ji3 dou1 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 you3 cuo4
cues.en: If even they themselves feel guilty,

cues.zh: 那对方律师必将抓住这一点
cues.pinyin: na4 dui4 fang1 lv4 shi1 bi4 jiang1 zhua1 zhu4 zhe4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: the opposing lawyer will definitely seize on that

cues.zh: 将过错全都推到父母身上
cues.pinyin: jiang1 guo4 cuo4 quan2 dou1 tui1 dao4 fu4 mu3 shen1 shang4
cues.en: and pin all the blame on the parents.

cues.zh: 小奥安慰他们
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 an1 wei4 ta1 men5
cues.en: Xiao Ao comforted them,

cues.zh: 天下没有完美的父母
cues.pinyin: tian1 xia4 mei2 you3 wan2 mei3 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: saying no parent is perfect.

cues.zh: 你们做得已经很好了
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 zuo4 de2 yi3 jing1 hen3 hao3 le5
cues.en: You've already done a great job.

cues.zh: 不要给自己太大压力
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 gei3 zi4 ji3 tai4 da4 ya1 li4
cues.en: Don't put too much pressure on yourselves.

cues.zh: 你们必须证明是奶粉的错不是你们的错
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 bi4 xu1 zheng4 ming2 shi4 nai3 fen3 de5 cuo4 bu2 shi4 ni3 men5 de5 cuo4
cues.en: You need to prove it was the formula's fault, not yours.

cues.zh: 可显然安娜和瓦内萨很难做到这一点
cues.pinyin: ke3 xian3 ran2 an1 na4 he2 wa3 nei4 sa4 hen3 nan2 zuo4 dao4 zhe4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: But clearly, Anna and Vanessa found that hard to do.

cues.zh: 于是小奥有了一个大胆的决定
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 ao4 you3 le5 yi2 ge4 da4 dan3 de5 jue2 ding4
cues.en: So Xiao Ao made a bold decision:

cues.zh: 不让他们两人出庭作证
cues.pinyin: bu4 rang4 ta1 men5 liang3 ren2 chu1 ting2 zuo4 zheng4
cues.en: not to let the two of them testify in court.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 马蒂劝瓦内萨
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 quan4 wa3 nei4 sa4
cues.en: Marty tried to persuade Vanessa.

cues.zh: 她在十年前失去了女儿
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 shi2 nian2 qian2 shi1 qu4 le5 nv3 er2
cues.en: She had lost her own daughter ten years earlier.

cues.zh: 原以为能走出悲痛
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yi3 wei2 neng2 zou3 chu1 bei1 tong4
cues.en: She'd thought she could move past the grief,

cues.zh: 可悲伤一波接一波
cues.pinyin: ke3 bei1 shang1 yi1 bo1 jie1 yi1 bo1
cues.en: but the sorrow kept coming in waves.

cues.zh: 想真正走出悲伤
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zhen1 zheng4 zou3 chu1 bei1 shang1
cues.en: To truly overcome grief,

cues.zh: 必须正面面对
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 zheng4 mian4 mian4 dui4
cues.en: you have to face it head-on.

cues.zh: 瓦内萨有所感触
cues.pinyin: wa3 nei4 sa4 you3 suo3 gan3 chu4
cues.en: Vanessa was moved by this.

cues.zh: 她想考虑一下
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 kao3 lv4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: She wanted to think it over.

cues.zh: 于是小奥
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: So Xiao Ao,

cues.zh: 朱利安和马蒂退出了会议室
cues.pinyin: zhu1 li4 an1 he2 ma3 di4 tui4 chu1 le5 hui4 yi4 shi4
cues.en: Julian, and Marty left the meeting room.

cues.zh: 就在这时马蒂接到了一封邮件
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 ma3 di4 jie1 dao4 le5 yi1 feng1 you2 jian4
cues.en: Just then, Marty received an email.

cues.zh: 竟然是相亲一屁屁上那个
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 shi4 xiang1 qin1 yi1 pi4 pi4 shang4 na4 ge5
cues.en: It was from that person on the dating app

cues.zh: 认出他的神秘人发过来
cues.pinyin: ren4 chu1 ta1 de5 shen2 mi4 ren2 fa1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: who had recognized her — the mystery man.

cues.zh: 马蒂心慌意乱
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 xin1 huang1 yi4 luan4
cues.en: Marty panicked.

cues.zh: 那个神秘人说自己距离马蒂工
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 shen2 mi4 ren2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 ju4 li2 ma3 di4 gong1
cues.en: The mystery man said he was close to

cues.zh: 作的律所很近
cues.pinyin: zuo4 de5 lv4 suo3 hen3 jin4
cues.en: the law firm where Marty worked,

cues.zh: 想跟马蒂在一起
cues.pinyin: xiang3 gen1 ma3 di4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: and that he wanted to be with her.

cues.zh: 可明明小外孙已经将马蒂的消息
cues.pinyin: ke3 ming2 ming2 xiao3 wai4 sun1 yi3 jing1 jiang1 ma3 di4 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: But her grandson had clearly already

cues.zh: 从一屁屁上删除了
cues.pinyin: cong2 yi1 pi4 pi4 shang4 shan1 chu2 le5
cues.en: deleted her info from the app.

cues.zh: 为什么神秘人还是能给他发邮件呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 shen2 mi4 ren2 hai2 shi4 neng2 gei3 ta1 fa1 you2 jian4 ne5
cues.en: So why could the mystery man still email her?

cues.zh: 他是怎么找到自己的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 zen3 me5 zhao3 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5
cues.en: How had he found her?

cues.zh: 好在他第一时间回邮件拒绝了神秘人
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 ta1 di4 yi1 shi2 jian1 hui2 you2 jian4 ju4 jue2 le5 shen2 mi4 ren2
cues.en: Luckily, she immediately replied, turning the man down.

cues.zh: 就在这时小奥走了过来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 xiao3 ao4 zou3 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Just then, Xiao Ao walked over.

cues.zh: 他发现马蒂情绪不对
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 ma3 di4 qing2 xu4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: She noticed Marty seemed off

cues.zh: 以为他被麻烦缠身了
cues.pinyin: yi3 wei2 ta1 bei4 ma2 fan2 chan2 shen1 le5
cues.en: and assumed she was in some kind of trouble.

cues.zh: 马蒂借口说死去的老伴留下了不少债务
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 jie4 kou3 shuo1 si3 qu4 de5 lao3 ban4 liu2 xia4 le5 bu4 shao3 zhai4 wu4
cues.en: Marty made up an excuse, saying her late husband had left a lot of debt

cues.zh: 现在讨债人找到他了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 tao3 zhai4 ren2 zhao3 dao4 ta1 le5
cues.en: and that debt collectors had tracked her down.

cues.zh: 小奥一下子担心了起来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 yi1 xia4 zi5 dan1 xin1 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Xiao Ao immediately grew worried

cues.zh: 说马蒂要是需要钱
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ma3 di4 yao4 shi4 xu1 yao4 qian2
cues.en: and said if Marty needed money,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 律所可以提前给他发工资
cues.pinyin: lv4 suo3 ke3 yi3 ti2 qian2 gei3 ta1 fa1 gong1 zi1
cues.en: the firm could pay her salary in advance.

cues.zh: 马蒂表示自己可以应付
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 biao3 shi4 zi4 ji3 ke3 yi3 ying4 fu4
cues.en: Marty said she could handle it herself

cues.zh: 并希望小奥帮他保密
cues.pinyin: bing4 xi1 wang4 xiao3 ao4 bang1 ta1 bao3 mi4
cues.en: and asked Xiao Ao to keep it quiet.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 去奶粉厂调查的比利和沙拉也有了消息
cues.pinyin: qu4 nai3 fen3 chang3 diao4 cha2 de5 bi3 li4 he2 sha1 la1 ye3 you3 le5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: Billy and Sarah, who went to investigate the formula factory, had news.

cues.zh: 奶粉厂的主管被开除了
cues.pinyin: nai3 fen3 chang3 de5 zhu3 guan3 bei4 kai1 chu2 le5
cues.en: The factory's supervisor had been fired.

cues.zh: 小奥还记得当年主管态度十分嚣张
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 hai2 ji4 de5 dang1 nian2 zhu3 guan3 tai4 du4 shi2 fen1 xiao1 zhang1
cues.en: Xiao Ao remembered the supervisor had been very arrogant back then,

cues.zh: 对他们的调查并不配合
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 men5 de5 diao4 cha2 bing4 bu4 pei4 he2
cues.en: uncooperative with their investigation,

cues.zh: 而且还有点瞧不起小奥这个黑人女律师
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 you3 dian3 qiao2 bu4 qi3 xiao3 ao4 zhe4 ge5 hei1 ren2 nv3 lv4 shi1
cues.en: and had even looked down on her for being a Black female lawyer.

cues.zh: 朱利安无奈只好在奶粉厂员工
cues.pinyin: zhu1 li4 an1 wu2 nai4 zhi3 hao3 zai4 nai3 fen3 chang3 yuan2 gong1
cues.en: With no other choice, Julian had to gather evidence

cues.zh: 之间调查取证
cues.pinyin: zhi1 jian1 diao4 cha2 qu3 zheng4
cues.en: among the factory's employees.

cues.zh: 小奥注意到员工里有一个老黑人
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 zhu4 yi4 dao4 yuan2 gong1 li3 you3 yi2 ge4 lao3 hei1 ren2
cues.en: Xiao Ao noticed an older Black man among the workers.

cues.zh: 老黑人似乎被排解了
cues.pinyin: lao3 hei1 ren2 si4 hu1 bei4 pai2 jie3 le5
cues.en: He seemed to be ostracized by the others,

cues.zh: 独自站在一个角落吸烟
cues.pinyin: du2 zi4 zhan4 zai4 yi2 ge4 jiao3 luo4 xi1 yan1
cues.en: standing alone in a corner smoking.

cues.zh: 于是小奥打算以老黑人作为突破口
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 ao4 da3 suan4 yi3 lao3 hei1 ren2 zuo4 wei2 tu1 po4 kou3
cues.en: So Xiao Ao decided to use him as her way in.

cues.zh: 老黑人看到小奥这个小黑人
cues.pinyin: lao3 hei1 ren2 kan4 dao4 xiao3 ao4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 hei1 ren2
cues.en: When the old man saw Xiao Ao, a young Black woman like himself,

cues.zh: 果然十分亲切
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 shi2 fen1 qin1 qie4
cues.en: he was indeed very warm toward her.

cues.zh: 在一个种族歧视严重的社会
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 zhong3 zu2 qi2 shi4 yan2 zhong4 de5 she4 hui4
cues.en: In a society plagued by serious racism,

cues.zh: 若是群体更容易抱团取暖
cues.pinyin: ruo4 shi4 qun2 ti3 geng4 rong2 yi4 bao4 tuan2 qu3 nuan3
cues.en: marginalized groups tend to band together for support.

cues.zh: 小奥希望老黑人能说说奶粉厂的内幕
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 xi1 wang4 lao3 hei1 ren2 neng2 shuo1 shuo1 nai3 fen3 chang3 de5 nei4 mu4
cues.en: Xiao Ao hoped he could tell her the inside story of the factory.

cues.zh: 老黑人告诉他
cues.pinyin: lao3 hei1 ren2 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: He told her

cues.zh: 这里的违规行为十分严重
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 wei2 gui1 xing2 wei2 shi2 fen1 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: that the violations there were extremely serious

cues.zh: 而且从来没有得到整改
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 de2 dao4 zheng3 gai3
cues.en: and had never been corrected.

cues.zh: 小奥希望老黑人能出庭作证
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 xi1 wang4 lao3 hei1 ren2 neng2 chu1 ting2 zuo4 zheng4
cues.en: Xiao Ao hoped he would testify in court,

cues.zh: 可老黑人拒绝了
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 hei1 ren2 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but he refused.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老太太大显身手！勇斗毒奶粉集团！2024最新复仇美剧《老练律师》06

cues.zh: 老主管终于被弄烦了
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhu3 guan3 zhong1 yu2 bei4 nong4 fan2 le5
cues.en: The old supervisor finally got fed up

cues.zh: 亲自出来给马蒂开门
cues.pinyin: qin1 zi4 chu1 lai2 gei3 ma3 di4 kai1 men2
cues.en: and came out himself to open the door for Marty,

cues.zh: 但没让马蒂进屋
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 rang4 ma3 di4 jin4 wu1
cues.en: but wouldn't let her inside.

cues.zh: 马蒂赶紧把一只脚塞到门缝里
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 gan3 jin3 ba3 yi1 zhi1 jiao3 sai1 dao4 men2 feng4 li3
cues.en: Marty quickly wedged a foot into the doorway.

cues.zh: 他表示我 75 了
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 shi4 wo3 75 le5
cues.en: She said, 'I'm 75,'

cues.zh: 患有骨质疏松
cues.pinyin: huan4 you3 gu3 zhi4 shu1 song1
cues.en: 'I have osteoporosis,'

cues.zh: 今天你要是敢关门
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ni3 yao4 shi4 gan3 guan1 men2
cues.en: 'if you dare close that door today,'

cues.zh: 我就敢骨折给你看
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gan3 gu3 zhe2 gei3 ni3 kan4
cues.en: 'I'll break a bone right in front of you.'

cues.zh: 无奈之下老主管只能听着马蒂提出问题
cues.pinyin: wu2 nai4 zhi1 xia4 lao3 zhu3 guan3 zhi3 neng2 ting1 zhe5 ma3 di4 ti2 chu1 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Having no choice, the old supervisor had to hear Marty out.

cues.zh: 马蒂问他为什么工厂管道从不
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 wen4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 gong1 chang3 guan3 dao4 cong2 bu4
cues.en: Marty asked him why the factory's pipes were switched from

cues.zh: 锈钢换成铜的
cues.pinyin: xiu4 gang1 huan4 cheng2 tong2 de5
cues.en: stainless steel to copper.

cues.zh: 老主管表示铜的便宜
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhu3 guan3 biao3 shi4 tong2 de5 pian2 yi5
cues.en: The supervisor said copper was cheaper.

cues.zh: 马蒂又问他为什么离开工厂
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 you4 wen4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 li2 kai1 gong1 chang3
cues.en: Marty then asked why he'd left the factory.

cues.zh: 老主管表示我乐意
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhu3 guan3 biao3 shi4 wo3 le4 yi4
cues.en: He said, 'Because I wanted to.'

cues.zh: 马蒂什么都没问出来
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 wen4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Marty got nothing useful out of him,

cues.zh: 但他还有最后一个要求
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 hai2 you3 zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: but she still had one last request.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国年度犯罪喜剧黑马，上映首日超100万人次观影，首周破600万人次，影片为喜剧与犯罪的融合开启新的篇章！

cues.zh: 这是两个杀手之间的巅峰对决
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 liang3 ge4 sha1 shou3 zhi1 jian1 de5 dian1 feng1 dui4 jue2
cues.en: This is the ultimate showdown between two hitmen

cues.zh: 然而事实并不像看上去那样
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 shi4 shi2 bing4 bu4 xiang4 kan4 shang4 qu4 na4 yang4
cues.en: But the truth isn't what it seems

cues.zh: 两人都是资深杀手
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 dou1 shi4 zi1 shen1 sha1 shou3
cues.en: Both are veteran hitmen

cues.zh: 其中一个是靠着狗屎运逆天改命的穷鬼
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 shi4 kao4 zhe5 gou3 shi3 yun4 ni4 tian1 gai3 ming4 de5 qiong2 gui3
cues.en: One is a poor bastard whose fate got flipped by sheer dumb luck

cues.zh: 而另一个虽然有真功夫
cues.pinyin: er2 ling4 yi2 ge4 sui1 ran2 you3 zhen1 gong1 fu5
cues.en: The other, though he has real skills

cues.zh: 但也并不是心狠手辣的亡命之徒
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye3 bing4 bu2 shi4 xin1 hen3 shou3 la4 de5 wang2 ming4 zhi1 tu2
cues.en: isn't a ruthless, cold-blooded killer either

cues.zh: 两人生活轨迹原本不会产生任何交集
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 sheng1 huo2 gui3 ji4 yuan2 ben3 bu2 hui4 chan3 sheng1 ren4 he2 jiao1 ji2
cues.en: Their life paths were never meant to cross

cues.zh: 但一次意外彻底将两人绑在一起
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 ci4 yi4 wai4 che4 di3 jiang1 liang3 ren2 bang3 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: but one accident ties the two of them together completely

cues.zh: 如果说在澡堂子里最应该注意的是什么
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shuo1 zai4 zao3 tang2 zi5 li3 zui4 ying1 gai1 zhu4 yi4 de5 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: If you had to name the one thing to watch out for in a bathhouse

cues.zh: 那一块出溜滑的肥皂绝对排名第一
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 kuai4 chu1 liu1 hua2 de5 fei2 zao4 jue2 dui4 pai2 ming2 di4 yi1
cues.en: a slippery bar of soap would absolutely rank number one

cues.zh: 老男人刚踏进浴室
cues.pinyin: lao3 nan2 ren2 gang1 ta4 jin4 yu4 shi4
cues.en: The old man had just stepped into the bathroom

cues.zh: 便不慎踩中一块掉落的肥皂
cues.pinyin: bian4 bu4 shen4 cai3 zhong1 yi1 kuai4 diao4 luo4 de5 fei2 zao4
cues.en: when he accidentally stepped on a dropped bar of soap

cues.zh: 整个人向后翻倒
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 ren2 xiang4 hou4 fan1 dao3
cues.en: and fell flat on his back

cues.zh: 手牌恰好落在穷小伙在城脚边
cues.pinyin: shou3 pai2 qia4 hao3 luo4 zai4 qiong2 xiao3 huo3 zai4 cheng2 jiao3 bian1
cues.en: His locker tag happened to land right by the feet of the poor guy, Jaeseong

cues.zh: 在城拾起手牌
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 shi2 qi3 shou3 pai2
cues.en: Jaeseong picked up the tag

cues.zh: 内心陷入激烈的天人交战
cues.pinyin: nei4 xin1 xian4 ru4 ji1 lie4 de5 tian1 ren2 jiao1 zhan4
cues.en: and was caught in a fierce internal struggle

cues.zh: 他想到自己三十多岁
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 dao4 zi4 ji3 san1 shi2 duo1 sui4
cues.en: He thought about how he was already in his thirties

cues.zh: 仍一事无成
cues.pinyin: reng2 yi2 shi4 wu2 cheng2
cues.en: yet had accomplished nothing

cues.zh: 口袋里空空如也
cues.pinyin: kou3 dai4 li3 kong1 kong1 ru2 ye3
cues.en: his pockets were completely empty

cues.zh: 外面还牵着一屁股债
cues.pinyin: wai4 mian4 hai2 qian1 zhe5 yi1 pi4 gu3 zhai4
cues.en: and on top of that he was buried in debt

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国年度犯罪喜剧黑马，上映首日超100万人次观影，首周破600万人次，影片为喜剧与犯罪的融合开启新的篇章！

cues.zh: 连个安稳的住处都没有
cues.pinyin: lian2 ge4 an1 wen3 de5 zhu4 chu4 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: He didn't even have a stable place to live

cues.zh: 甚至已经做好了了结生命的准备
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 yi3 jing1 zuo4 hao3 liao3 liao3 jie2 sheng1 ming4 de5 zhun3 bei4
cues.en: He'd even gotten ready to end his life

cues.zh: 看着眼前昏迷不醒的男人
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhuo2 yan3 qian2 hun1 mi2 bu4 xing3 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: Looking at the man unconscious before him

cues.zh: 一个邪念在他心中滋生
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xie2 nian4 zai4 ta1 xin1 zhong1 zi1 sheng1
cues.en: a wicked idea took root in his mind

cues.zh: 他趁没人注意
cues.pinyin: ta1 chen4 mei2 ren2 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: While no one was watching

cues.zh: 偷偷调换了两人的手牌
cues.pinyin: tou1 tou1 diao4 huan4 le5 liang3 ren2 de5 shou3 pai2
cues.en: he secretly swapped their two tags

cues.zh: 竟然已经打算离开这个世界
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 yi3 jing1 da3 suan4 li2 kai1 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: Since he'd already planned to leave this world anyway

cues.zh: 他不先体验一天富人的生活
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xian1 ti3 yan4 yi1 tian1 fu4 ren2 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: he figured he might as well try a rich man's life for one day first

cues.zh: 也算没白来这世上一趟
cues.pinyin: ye3 suan4 mei2 bai2 lai2 zhe4 shi4 shang4 yi1 tang4
cues.en: That way his time on earth wouldn't be wasted

cues.zh: 扎手被救护车送往医院后
cues.pinyin: zha1 shou3 bei4 jiu4 hu4 che1 song4 wang3 yi1 yuan4 hou4
cues.en: After the old man was taken to the hospital by ambulance

cues.zh: 再承换上了男人价值不菲的西装
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 huan4 shang4 le5 nan2 ren2 jia4 zhi2 bu4 fei1 de5 xi1 zhuang1
cues.en: Jaeseong put on the man's expensive suit

cues.zh: 当走出澡堂
cues.pinyin: dang1 zou3 chu1 zao3 tang2
cues.en: When he walked out of the bathhouse

cues.zh: 他就撞见了早上来催促的房东
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 zhuang4 jian4 le5 zao3 shang4 lai2 cui1 cu4 de5 fang2 dong1
cues.en: he ran into the landlord who'd come to hound him that morning

cues.zh: 他刻意模仿着有钱人的左派
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke4 yi4 mo2 fang3 zhe5 you3 qian2 ren2 de5 zuo3 pai4
cues.en: He deliberately imitated the airs of a rich man

cues.zh: 从真皮钱包里抽出几张钞票塞给房东
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhen1 pi2 qian2 bao1 li3 chou1 chu1 ji3 zhang1 chao1 piao4 sai1 gei3 fang2 dong1
cues.en: pulling a few bills from a leather wallet and stuffing them at the landlord

cues.zh: 又额外多力了几张
cues.pinyin: you4 e2 wai4 duo1 li4 le5 ji3 zhang1
cues.en: then threw in a few extra

cues.zh: 说剩下的钱请房东吃碗拌面
cues.pinyin: shuo1 sheng4 xia4 de5 qian2 qing3 fang2 dong1 chi1 wan3 ban4 mian4
cues.en: telling him to treat himself to a bowl of noodles with the rest

cues.zh: 接着他从口袋里掏出一个精致的车钥匙
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 ta1 cong2 kou3 dai4 li3 tao1 chu1 yi2 ge4 jing1 zhi4 de5 che1 yao4 shi5
cues.en: Then he pulled an elegant car key from his pocket

cues.zh: 街角那辆马沙拉蒂立刻亮起灯光
cues.pinyin: jie1 jiao3 na4 liang4 ma3 sha1 la1 di4 li4 ke4 liang4 qi3 deng1 guang1
cues.en: and the Maserati on the street corner instantly lit up

cues.zh: 发出清脆的回应
cues.pinyin: fa1 chu1 qing1 cui4 de5 hui2 ying4
cues.en: letting out a crisp chirp in response

cues.zh: 他挨家挨户还清了所有债务
cues.pinyin: ta1 ai1 jia1 ai1 hu4 huan2 qing1 le5 suo3 you3 zhai4 wu4
cues.en: He went door to door paying off every debt he owed

cues.zh: 又特意绕路去偶遇前女友
cues.pinyin: you4 te4 yi4 rao4 lu4 qu4 ou3 yu4 qian2 nv3 you3
cues.en: and deliberately took a detour to "run into" his ex-girlfriend

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国年度犯罪喜剧黑马，上映首日超100万人次观影，首周破600万人次，影片为喜剧与犯罪的融合开启新的篇章！

cues.zh: 护士丽娜则告知她身份证上显
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 li4 na4 ze2 gao4 zhi1 ta1 shen1 fen4 zheng4 shang4 xian3
cues.en: Nurse Lina then told him his ID card showed

cues.zh: 示她名叫在城
cues.pinyin: shi4 ta1 ming2 jiao4 zai4 cheng2
cues.en: that his name was Jaeseong

cues.zh: 今年 32 岁
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 32 sui4
cues.en: 32 years old this year

cues.zh: 两人看着身份证上的信息
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 kan4 zhe5 shen1 fen4 zheng4 shang4 de5 xin4 xi1
cues.en: The two of them looked at the information on the ID

cues.zh: 在对照杀手脸上的沧桑门路
cues.pinyin: zai4 dui4 zhao4 sha1 shou3 lian3 shang4 de5 cang1 sang1 men2 lu4
cues.en: then compared it to the weathered lines on the hitman's face

cues.zh: 一时间都陷入了沉默
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 jian1 dou1 xian4 ru4 le5 chen2 mo4
cues.en: and both fell silent for a moment

cues.zh: 证件上的年龄与她的外貌实在不服
cues.pinyin: zheng4 jian4 shang4 de5 nian2 ling2 yu3 ta1 de5 wai4 mao4 shi2 zai4 bu4 fu2
cues.en: The age on the ID really didn't match his appearance

cues.zh: 丽娜送杀手回家
cues.pinyin: li4 na4 song4 sha1 shou3 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Lina took the hitman home

cues.zh: 推开门的瞬间
cues.pinyin: tui1 kai1 men2 de5 shun4 jian1
cues.en: The moment the door swung open

cues.zh: 杀手愣在了原地
cues.pinyin: sha1 shou3 leng4 zai4 le5 yuan2 di4
cues.en: the hitman froze in place

cues.zh: 房间里满目狼藉
cues.pinyin: fang2 jian1 li3 man3 mu4 lang2 ji2
cues.en: The room was in total disarray

cues.zh: 房梁上还挂着一根绳索
cues.pinyin: fang2 liang2 shang4 hai2 gua4 zhe5 yi1 gen1 sheng2 suo3
cues.en: and a rope was still hanging from the ceiling beam

cues.zh: 这真的是自己的家吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhen1 de5 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 jia1 ma5
cues.en: Was this really his own home?

cues.zh: 她模糊的记忆里
cues.pinyin: ta1 mo2 hu2 de5 ji4 yi4 li3
cues.en: In his hazy memory

cues.zh: 自己从不是如此邋遢的人
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 cong2 bu4 shi4 ru2 ci3 la1 ta1 de5 ren2
cues.en: he'd never been such a slob

cues.zh: 这是丽娜接到医院的紧急呼叫
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 li4 na4 jie1 dao4 yi1 yuan4 de5 jin3 ji2 hu1 jiao4
cues.en: Just then Lina got an emergency call from the hospital

cues.zh: 只能匆匆离去
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 cong1 cong1 li2 qu4
cues.en: and had to rush off

cues.zh: 留下杀手独自面对这个凌乱不堪的局所
cues.pinyin: liu2 xia4 sha1 shou3 du2 zi4 mian4 dui4 zhe4 ge5 ling2 luan4 bu4 kan1 de5 ju2 suo3
cues.en: leaving the hitman alone to face this wrecked home

cues.zh: 她开始着手收拾房间
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 shi3 zhuo2 shou3 shou1 shi2 fang2 jian1
cues.en: He started tidying up the room

cues.zh: 将每一处角落都打扫得一尘固然
cues.pinyin: jiang1 mei3 yi1 chu4 jiao3 luo4 dou1 da3 sao3 de2 yi1 chen2 gu4 ran2
cues.en: cleaning every corner until it was spotless

cues.zh: 同时试图拼凑记忆的碎片
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 shi4 tu2 pin1 cou4 ji4 yi4 de5 sui4 pian4
cues.en: while trying to piece together fragments of memory

cues.zh: 他在本子上写下自己叫在城
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 ben3 zi5 shang4 xie3 xia4 zi4 ji3 jiao4 zai4 cheng2
cues.en: He wrote in a notebook that his name was Jaeseong

cues.zh: 32 岁存款两仙汗冤
cues.pinyin: 32 sui4 cun2 kuan3 liang3 xian1 han4 yuan1
cues.en: 32 years old, savings of 2,000 won

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国年度犯罪喜剧黑马，上映首日超100万人次观影，首周破600万人次，影片为喜剧与犯罪的融合开启新的篇章！

cues.zh: 而是一个性感美女的多角度
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yi2 ge4 xing4 gan3 mei3 nv3 de5 duo1 jiao3 du4
cues.en: but rather multiple angles of a sexy woman

cues.zh: 及时监控花脸
cues.pinyin: ji2 shi2 jian1 kong4 hua1 lian3
cues.en: on the real-time surveillance footage

cues.zh: 宰成盯着监控画面
cues.pinyin: zai3 cheng2 ding1 zhe5 jian1 kong4 hua4 mian4
cues.en: Jaeseong stared at the surveillance screen

cues.zh: 在城盯着监控画面
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 ding1 zhe5 jian1 kong4 hua4 mian4
cues.en: his throat going dry without him realizing

cues.zh: 咽了眼口水
cues.pinyin: yan4 le5 yan3 kou3 shui3
cues.en: and he gulped nervously

cues.zh: 他索性换上屋里的舒适睡衣
cues.pinyin: ta1 suo3 xing4 huan4 shang4 wu1 li3 de5 shu1 shi4 shui4 yi1
cues.en: He simply put on the comfy pajamas lying in the house

cues.zh: 躺在柔软的真皮沙发上
cues.pinyin: tang3 zai4 rou2 ruan3 de5 zhen1 pi2 sha1 fa1 shang4
cues.en: and lay down on the soft leather sofa

cues.zh: 慢慢观察
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 guan1 cha2
cues.en: watching slowly

cues.zh: 不知不觉中
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 zhong1
cues.en: Before he knew it

cues.zh: 他竟沉入梦乡
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing4 chen2 ru4 meng4 xiang1
cues.en: he actually drifted off to sleep

cues.zh: 口水顺着嘴角流到昂贵的地态上
cues.pinyin: kou3 shui3 shun4 zhe5 zui3 jiao3 liu2 dao4 ang2 gui4 de5 di4 tai4 shang4
cues.en: drool ran down his chin onto the expensive carpet

cues.zh: 半梦半醒见
cues.pinyin: ban4 meng4 ban4 xing3 jian4
cues.en: Half asleep, half awake

cues.zh: 半梦半醒间
cues.pinyin: ban4 meng4 ban4 xing3 jian1
cues.en: he suddenly jolted up

cues.zh: 却惊恐的发现
cues.pinyin: que4 jing1 kong3 de5 fa1 xian4
cues.en: only to discover in horror

cues.zh: 监控中的女人正举之利刃
cues.pinyin: jian1 kong4 zhong1 de5 nv3 ren2 zheng4 ju3 zhi1 li4 ren4
cues.en: the woman on the surveillance screen was holding up a blade

cues.zh: 在城下的魂飞魄散
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 xia4 de5 hun2 fei1 po4 san4
cues.en: Jaeseong was scared out of his wits

cues.zh: 慌乱中抓起手机
cues.pinyin: huang1 luan4 zhong1 zhua1 qi3 shou3 ji1
cues.en: In a panic he grabbed his phone

cues.zh: 就要报警
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: about to call the police

cues.zh: 可下一秒
cues.pinyin: ke3 xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: but the very next second

cues.zh: 他却看到女人安然无恙的站起身
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 kan4 dao4 nv3 ren2 an1 ran2 wu2 yang4 de5 zhan4 qi3 shen1
cues.en: he saw the woman get up completely unharmed

cues.zh: 又换了一把虎头钱继续表演
cues.pinyin: you4 huan4 le5 yi1 ba3 hu3 tou2 qian2 ji4 xu4 biao3 yan3
cues.en: switch to another prop weapon, and keep performing

cues.zh: 再成彻底蒙了
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 che4 di3 meng2 le5
cues.en: Jaeseong was totally baffled

cues.zh: 这到底是多么奇怪的行为
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 di3 shi4 duo1 me5 qi2 guai4 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: What on earth kind of behavior was this?

cues.zh: 或许是被刚才的场景吓坏了
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 shi4 bei4 gang1 cai2 de5 chang3 jing3 xia4 huai4 le5
cues.en: Maybe still rattled from what he'd just seen

cues.zh: 在城突然感到一阵饥饿
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 tu1 ran2 gan3 dao4 yi1 zhen4 ji1 e4
cues.en: Jaeseong suddenly felt a wave of hunger

cues.zh: 他在屋里翻箱倒柜
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wu1 li3 fan1 xiang1 dao3 gui4
cues.en: He rummaged through the house

cues.zh: 找到一个饼干盒正准备拆开
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 bing3 gan1 he2 zheng4 zhun3 bei4 chai1 kai1
cues.en: found a box of cookies and was about to open it

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国年度犯罪喜剧黑马，上映首日超100万人次观影，首周破600万人次，影片为喜剧与犯罪的融合开启新的篇章！

cues.zh: 又想着去酒柜选拼红酒搭配
cues.pinyin: you4 xiang3 zhe5 qu4 jiu3 gui4 xuan3 pin1 hong2 jiu3 da1 pei4
cues.en: then thought about picking a bottle of wine from the cabinet to go with it

cues.zh: 就在他伸手去拿红酒时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 ta1 shen1 shou3 qu4 na2 hong2 jiu3 shi2
cues.en: Just as he reached for the wine

cues.zh: 意外出发的酒柜后的隐藏机关
cues.pinyin: yi4 wai4 chu1 fa1 de5 jiu3 gui4 hou4 de5 yin3 cang2 ji1 guan1
cues.en: he accidentally triggered a hidden mechanism behind the cabinet

cues.zh: 一到暗门缓缓打开
cues.pinyin: yi1 dao4 an4 men2 huan3 huan3 da3 kai1
cues.en: A secret door slowly slid open

cues.zh: 暗门后陈列着各式武器和不同身份的证件
cues.pinyin: an4 men2 hou4 chen2 lie4 zhe5 ge4 shi4 wu3 qi4 he2 bu4 tong2 shen1 fen4 de5 zheng4 jian4
cues.en: Behind it were displayed all kinds of weapons and IDs under different identities

cues.zh: 墙上还贴满了密密麻麻的线索图
cues.pinyin: qiang2 shang4 hai2 tie1 man3 le5 mi4 mi4 ma2 ma2 de5 xian4 suo3 tu2
cues.en: and the wall was covered with a dense web of clue charts

cues.zh: 在城这才明白
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 zhe4 cai2 ming2 bai2
cues.en: Only then did Jaeseong understand

cues.zh: 监控中的女人恩珠
cues.pinyin: jian1 kong4 zhong1 de5 nv3 ren2 en1 zhu1
cues.en: that the woman on the surveillance footage, Eunju

cues.zh: 很可能是杀手老催的保护对象
cues.pinyin: hen3 ke3 neng2 shi4 sha1 shou3 lao3 cui1 de5 bao3 hu4 dui4 xiang4
cues.en: was very likely the person the hitman Old Choi was protecting

cues.zh: 恩珠因要举报政府要员而遭到追杀
cues.pinyin: en1 zhu1 yin1 yao4 ju3 bao4 zheng4 fu3 yao4 yuan2 er2 zao1 dao4 zhui1 sha1
cues.en: Eunju was being hunted because she planned to expose a senior government official

cues.zh: 而老崔很可能是负责保护他的执法人员
cues.pinyin: er2 lao3 cui1 hen3 ke3 neng2 shi4 fu4 ze2 bao3 hu4 ta1 de5 zhi2 fa3 ren2 yuan2
cues.en: and Old Choi was likely the law enforcement officer assigned to protect her

cues.zh: 不仅老崔失忆
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 lao3 cui1 shi1 yi4
cues.en: Not only had Old Choi lost his memory

cues.zh: 保护任务陷入情治
cues.pinyin: bao3 hu4 ren4 wu4 xian4 ru4 qing2 zhi4
cues.en: the protection mission was now in trouble

cues.zh: 恩珠的处境危急
cues.pinyin: en1 zhu1 de5 chu3 jing4 wei1 ji2
cues.en: Eunju was in grave danger

cues.zh: 再诚决定暂时承担起保护女人的责任
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 jue2 ding4 zan4 shi2 cheng2 dan1 qi3 bao3 hu4 nv3 ren2 de5 ze2 ren4
cues.en: Jaeseong decided to take on the responsibility of protecting the woman for the time being

cues.zh: 可是恩珠住在哪里呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 en1 zhu1 zhu4 zai4 na3 li3 ne5
cues.en: But where did Eunju even live?

cues.zh: 这是监控画面显示
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 jian1 kong4 hua4 mian4 xian3 shi4
cues.en: Just then the surveillance footage showed

cues.zh: 给恩珠送外卖的小哥
cues.pinyin: gei3 en1 zhu1 song4 wai4 mai4 de5 xiao3 ge1
cues.en: the delivery guy bringing Eunju her food

cues.zh: 竟然就是刚刚那个红毛
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 jiu4 shi4 gang1 gang1 na4 ge5 hong2 mao2
cues.en: turned out to be that same red-haired guy from before

cues.zh: 这代表恩珠与自己住在同一栋楼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dai4 biao3 en1 zhu1 yu3 zi4 ji3 zhu4 zai4 tong2 yi1 dong4 lou2
cues.en: which meant Eunju lived in the same building as him

cues.zh: 于是他假扮成物业检察员逐户寻找
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jia3 ban4 cheng2 wu4 ye4 jian3 cha2 yuan2 zhu2 hu4 xun2 zhao3
cues.en: So he posed as a building inspector, searching door to door

items.title: 外星人探案

cues.zh: 一跃成为网红餐厅
cues.pinyin: yi1 yue4 cheng2 wei2 wang3 hong2 can1 ting1
cues.en: it instantly became a viral restaurant

cues.zh: 丽娜也对她刮目相看
cues.pinyin: li4 na4 ye3 dui4 ta1 gua1 mu4 xiang1 kan4
cues.en: Lina started seeing him in a new light too

cues.zh: 好感见生
cues.pinyin: hao3 gan3 jian4 sheng1
cues.en: A spark of affection began to grow

cues.zh: 某些稿催翻日历时
cues.pinyin: mou3 xie1 gao3 cui1 fan1 ri4 li4 shi2
cues.en: One day as Old Choi was flipping through a calendar

cues.zh: 她线上面标记着一个地点
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 shang4 mian4 biao1 ji4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 di4 dian3
cues.en: he noticed a location marked on it

cues.zh: 她猜测这或许是恢复记忆的线索
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai1 ce4 zhe4 huo4 xu3 shi4 hui1 fu4 ji4 yi4 de5 xian4 suo3
cues.en: He guessed this might be a clue to recovering his memory

cues.zh: 便按照地址找了过去
cues.pinyin: bian4 an4 zhao4 di4 zhi3 zhao3 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: so he headed to that address

cues.zh: 可到了地方
cues.pinyin: ke3 dao4 le5 di4 fang1
cues.en: But when he got there

cues.zh: 她却被剧组的人误认成群演
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 bei4 ju4 zu3 de5 ren2 wu4 ren4 cheng2 qun2 yan3
cues.en: he was mistaken by the film crew for an extra

cues.zh: 拉紧了片场
cues.pinyin: la1 jin3 le5 pian4 chang3
cues.en: and pulled onto the film set

cues.zh: 由于缺乏表演经验
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 que1 fa2 biao3 yan3 jing1 yan4
cues.en: Since he had no acting experience

cues.zh: 他闹出了不少笑话
cues.pinyin: ta1 nao4 chu1 le5 bu4 shao3 xiao4 hua4
cues.en: he caused quite a few blunders

cues.zh: 走正步时音腿短跟不上节奏
cues.pinyin: zou3 zheng4 bu4 shi2 yin1 tui3 duan3 gen1 bu4 shang4 jie2 zou4
cues.en: marching in step, one leg kept failing to keep up with the rhythm

cues.zh: 表演动作僵硬的频频被导演替换
cues.pinyin: biao3 yan3 dong4 zuo4 jiang1 ying4 de5 pin2 pin2 bei4 dao3 yan3 ti4 huan4
cues.en: his acting was so stiff the director kept swapping him out

cues.zh: 直到领薪水时
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 ling3 xin1 shui3 shi2
cues.en: Until payday came

cues.zh: 他在公子单上看到一个陌生的地址
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 gong1 zi5 dan1 shang4 kan4 dao4 yi2 ge4 mo4 sheng1 de5 di4 zhi3
cues.en: he spotted an unfamiliar address on his pay stub

cues.zh: 顺着地址找去
cues.pinyin: shun4 zhe5 di4 zhi3 zhao3 qu4
cues.en: Following the address

cues.zh: 竟找到了在城附近开的理发店
cues.pinyin: jing4 zhao3 dao4 le5 zai4 cheng2 fu4 jin4 kai1 de5 li3 fa4 dian4
cues.en: he ended up finding a barbershop run by his own father, near where Jaeseong lived

cues.zh: 然而在城附近看到陌生人还以为是客人
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 zai4 cheng2 fu4 jin4 kan4 dao4 mo4 sheng1 ren2 hai2 yi3 wei2 shi4 ke4 ren2
cues.en: But his father saw the stranger and assumed he was a customer

cues.zh: 直接示意他坐下
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 shi4 yi4 ta1 zuo4 xia4
cues.en: and waved for him to sit down

cues.zh: 接着老崔听见老人向顾客诉说
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 lao3 cui1 ting1 jian4 lao3 ren2 xiang4 gu4 ke4 su4 shuo1
cues.en: Then Old Choi overheard the old man telling a customer

cues.zh: 对儿子的期望
cues.pinyin: dui4 er2 zi5 de5 qi1 wang4
cues.en: about his hopes for his son

cues.zh: 希望儿子能在演艺圈闯出点灵堂
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 er2 zi5 neng2 zai4 yan3 yi4 quan1 chuang3 chu1 dian3 ling2 tang2
cues.en: hoping his son could make something of himself in showbiz

cues.zh: 老崔深受触动
cues.pinyin: lao3 cui1 shen1 shou4 chu4 dong4
cues.en: Old Choi was deeply moved

cues.zh: 暗下决心不让父亲失望
cues.pinyin: an4 xia4 jue2 xin1 bu4 rang4 fu4 qin1 shi1 wang4
cues.en: and quietly resolved not to let his father down

cues.zh: 老师发考卷给小明叫小明拿回家签名
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 fa1 kao3 juan4 gei3 xiao3 ming2 jiao4 xiao3 ming2 na2 hui2 jia1 qian1 ming2
cues.en: The teacher gave Xiaoming a test paper and told him to take it home to get it signed.

cues.zh: 第二天老师问小明
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 lao3 shi1 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: The next day the teacher asked Xiaoming,

cues.zh: 你爸爸说了什么啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba4 ba4 shuo1 le5 shen2 me5 a5
cues.en: "What did your dad say?"

cues.zh: 老师脏话的部分要去掉吗
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 zang1 hua4 de5 bu4 fen4 yao4 qu4 diao4 ma5
cues.en: (Should the swear word part be edited out?)

cues.zh: 那当然啊哦那他一句话都没说
cues.pinyin: na4 dang1 ran2 a5 o2 na4 ta1 yi1 ju4 hua4 dou1 mei2 shuo1
cues.en: "Of course... oh, actually he didn't say a single word."

items.title_zh: 笑话90｜骂脏话｜修理孩子｜考零分｜铅笔姓萧｜挡住了光｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我家孩子经常弄坏电器
cues.pinyin: wo3 jia1 hai2 zi5 jing1 chang2 nong4 huai4 dian4 qi4
cues.en: My kid is always breaking appliances.

cues.zh: 幸好我老公会修理是啊
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 wo3 lao3 gong1 hui4 xiu1 li3 shi4 a5
cues.en: Luckily my husband knows how to fix them.

cues.zh: 我家孩子也常弄坏电器
cues.pinyin: wo3 jia1 hai2 zi5 ye3 chang2 nong4 huai4 dian4 qi4
cues.en: My kid also always breaks appliances.

cues.zh: 也幸好我老公会修理
cues.pinyin: ye3 xing4 hao3 wo3 lao3 gong1 hui4 xiu1 li3
cues.en: Luckily my husband can fix them too.

cues.zh: 你家老公也会修电器哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 jia1 lao3 gong1 ye3 hui4 xiu1 dian4 qi4 o2
cues.en: Your husband can fix appliances too, huh?

cues.zh: 不是才会修你孩子
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 cai2 hui4 xiu1 ni3 hai2 zi5
cues.en: No — he's just good at "fixing" your kid.

cues.zh: 有一个美国人出国旅游
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 mei3 guo2 ren2 chu1 guo2 lv3 you2
cues.en: An American went abroad traveling.

cues.zh: 到了当地的蔬果摊
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 dang1 di4 de5 shu1 guo3 tan1
cues.en: He arrived at a local produce stand.

cues.zh: 老板这个番茄多少钱
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 zhe4 ge5 fan1 qie2 duo1 shao3 qian2
cues.en: "Sir, how much is this tomato?"

cues.zh: 哦美金五元
cues.pinyin: o2 mei3 jin1 wu3 yuan2
cues.en: "Oh, five US dollars."

cues.zh: 外国人掏出十美金说
cues.pinyin: wai4 guo2 ren2 tao1 chu1 shi2 mei3 jin1 shuo1
cues.en: The foreigner took out ten dollars and said,

cues.zh: 我要两个番茄
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 liang3 ge4 fan1 qie2
cues.en: "I'll take two tomatoes."

cues.zh: 没想到这里的番茄这么贵
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 zhe4 li3 de5 fan1 qie2 zhe4 me5 gui4
cues.en: "I can't believe tomatoes here are so expensive —

cues.zh: 比美国还贵
cues.pinyin: bi3 mei3 guo2 hai2 gui4
cues.en: even more expensive than in America."

cues.zh: 又到了发考卷的日子
cues.pinyin: you4 dao4 le5 fa1 kao3 juan4 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: It was test-paper return day again.

cues.zh: 爸爸问儿子
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 wen4 er2 zi5
cues.en: The dad asked his son,

cues.zh: 上一次你考十分被我打了十下
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ci4 ni3 kao3 shi2 fen1 bei4 wo3 da3 le5 shi2 xia4
cues.en: "Last time you scored a 10 and I hit you 10 times.

cues.zh: 这一次要打几下啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 yao4 da3 ji3 xia4 a5
cues.en: How many hits this time?"

cues.zh: 爸爸这一次你不用打了
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 zhe4 yi1 ci4 ni3 bu4 yong4 da3 le5
cues.en: "Dad, you don't need to hit me this time —

cues.zh: 我考零分
cues.pinyin: wo3 kao3 ling2 fen1
cues.en: I scored a zero."

cues.zh: 大大我问你哦
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Dada, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 你知道星期天哪里最多美国人吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 xing1 qi1 tian1 na3 li3 zui4 duo1 mei3 guo2 ren2 ma5
cues.en: Do you know where there are the most Americans on Sundays?"

cues.zh: 教会啊教会最多美国人啊
cues.pinyin: jiao4 hui4 a5 jiao4 hui4 zui4 duo1 mei3 guo2 ren2 a5
cues.en: "Church! Church has the most Americans —

cues.zh: 星期天都要做礼拜啊
cues.pinyin: xing1 qi1 tian1 dou1 yao4 zuo4 li3 bai4 a5
cues.en: everyone goes to Sunday service."

cues.zh: 不对哦是美国哦
cues.pinyin: bu2 dui4 o2 shi4 mei3 guo2 o2
cues.en: "Wrong, it's America —

cues.zh: 因为美国人都在美国啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei3 guo2 ren2 dou1 zai4 mei3 guo2 a5
cues.en: because all Americans are in America."

cues.zh: 月考的考卷发下来
cues.pinyin: yue4 kao3 de5 kao3 juan4 fa1 xia4 lai2
cues.en: The monthly exam papers were handed back.

cues.zh: 老师问
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 wen4
cues.en: The teacher asked,

cues.zh: 这一次只答错一题的举手
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 zhi3 da2 cuo4 yi1 ti2 de5 ju3 shou3
cues.en: "Raise your hand if you only got one question wrong this time."

cues.zh: 结果全班没人举手
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 quan2 ban1 mei2 ren2 ju3 shou3
cues.en: No one in the class raised their hand.

cues.zh: 老师失望地问
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 shi1 wang4 di4 wen4
cues.en: Disappointed, the teacher asked,

cues.zh: 那只答错两题的举手
cues.pinyin: na4 zhi3 da2 cuo4 liang3 ti2 de5 ju3 shou3
cues.en: "Then raise your hand if you got two wrong."

cues.zh: 只见小明缓缓地举起手
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 xiao3 ming2 huan3 huan3 di4 ju3 qi3 shou3
cues.en: Only Xiaoming slowly raised his hand.

cues.zh: 由于小明平时成绩并不好
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 xiao3 ming2 ping2 shi2 cheng2 ji4 bing4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Since Xiaoming's grades were usually not good,

cues.zh: 因此老师十分惊讶
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 lao3 shi1 shi2 fen1 jing1 ya4
cues.en: the teacher was quite surprised.

cues.zh: 你真的只错两题
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhen1 de5 zhi3 cuo4 liang3 ti2
cues.en: "You really only got two wrong?"

cues.zh: 是啊
cues.pinyin: shi4 a5
cues.en: "Yep."

cues.zh: 因为我
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3
cues.en: "Because I —

cues.zh: 我只写了两题
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 xie3 le5 liang3 ti2
cues.en: I only answered two questions."

cues.zh: 小美你的笔记簿上面都密密码码我的名字
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ni3 de5 bi3 ji4 bu4 shang4 mian4 dou1 mi4 mi4 ma3 ma3 wo3 de5 ming2 zi4
