cues.pinyin: ni3 xi3 huan1 wo3 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 zhi2 jie1 gao4 su4 wo3 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: "If you like me, why not just tell me directly?"

cues.zh: 又不是那是因为你早上上厕所的时候
cues.pinyin: you4 bu2 shi4 na4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ni3 zao3 shang4 shang4 ce4 suo3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "It's not that — it's because this morning, when you went to the bathroom,

cues.zh: 老师刚选我当秩序长啊
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 gang1 xuan3 wo3 dang1 zhi4 xu4 zhang3 a5
cues.en: the teacher just picked me as class monitor."

cues.zh: 小小我问你哦
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Xiaoxiao, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 彩色比姓彩原子比姓圆
cues.pinyin: cai3 se4 bi3 xing4 cai3 yuan2 zi5 bi3 xing4 yuan2
cues.en: A colored pencil's surname is 'Color,' a ballpoint pen's surname is 'Round' —

cues.zh: 那么链笔姓什么你知道吗
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 lian4 bi3 xing4 shen2 me5 ni3 zhi1 dao4 ma5
cues.en: so what's a pencil's surname, do you know?"

cues.zh: 铅笔姓铅啊
cues.pinyin: qian1 bi3 xing4 qian1 a5
cues.en: "A pencil's surname is 'Lead.'"

cues.zh: 不是铅笔姓肖
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 qian1 bi3 xing4 xiao4
cues.en: "No, a pencil's surname is 'Xiao.'"

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为肖铅笔
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao4 qian1 bi3
cues.en: "Because you 'xiao' (sharpen) a pencil."

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 行还是不行，不是我说了才算吗？

cues.zh: 面对抑郁症有的人拼命有的人认命
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 yi4 yu4 zheng4 you3 de5 ren2 pin1 ming4 you3 de5 ren2 ren4 ming4
cues.en: Facing depression, some people fight hard, others resign themselves to fate.

cues.zh: 我既不拼命我也不认命
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji4 bu4 pin1 ming4 wo3 ye3 bu4 ren4 ming4
cues.en: I neither fight hard, nor do I resign myself to fate.

cues.zh: 从一个对任何事都提不起兴趣
cues.pinyin: cong2 yi2 ge4 dui4 ren4 he2 shi4 dou1 ti2 bu4 qi3 xing4 qu4
cues.en: From someone who had no interest in anything,

cues.zh: 后来因为我的车我有了想法
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 yin1 wei4 wo3 de5 che1 wo3 you3 le5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: later, because of my car, I started having ideas.

cues.zh: 车都可以人为什么不可以
cues.pinyin: che1 dou1 ke3 yi3 ren2 wei2 shen2 me5 bu4 ke3 yi3
cues.en: If a car can change, why can't a person?

cues.zh: 以前经历的所有的果实都消化成自己内心
cues.pinyin: yi3 qian2 jing1 li4 de5 suo3 you3 de5 guo3 shi2 dou1 xiao1 hua4 cheng2 zi4 ji3 nei4 xin1
cues.en: All the fruits of what I've experienced before have been digested into

cues.zh: 的一笔财富了
cues.pinyin: de5 yi1 bi3 cai2 fu4 le5
cues.en: a fortune within my own heart.

cues.zh: 我才发现原来我自己的人挺精彩的
cues.pinyin: wo3 cai2 fa1 xian4 yuan2 lai2 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5 ren2 ting3 jing1 cai3 de5
cues.en: I realized that my own life is actually quite wonderful.

cues.zh: 小明坐在门口玩
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 zuo4 zai4 men2 kou3 wan2
cues.en: Xiao Ming was playing by the doorway.

cues.zh: 有一个中年男子问他
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 zhong1 nian2 nan2 zi5 wen4 ta1
cues.en: A middle-aged man asked him,

cues.zh: 你爸爸在吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba4 ba4 zai4 ma5
cues.en: "Is your dad home?"

cues.zh: 在啊
cues.pinyin: zai4 a5
cues.en: "Yes, he's home."

cues.zh: 中年男子便去按门铃
cues.pinyin: zhong1 nian2 nan2 zi5 bian4 qu4 an4 men2 ling2
cues.en: So the man went to ring the doorbell.

cues.zh: 按了很久却没有人应门
cues.pinyin: an4 le5 hen3 jiu3 que4 mei2 you3 ren2 ying4 men2
cues.en: He rang for a long time but no one answered.

cues.zh: 便生气的对小明说
cues.pinyin: bian4 sheng1 qi4 de5 dui4 xiao3 ming2 shuo1
cues.en: He angrily said to Xiao Ming,

cues.zh: 你爸爸在家为什么不开门
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba4 ba4 zai4 jia1 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 kai1 men2
cues.en: "Your dad's home, why isn't he opening the door?"

cues.zh: 我怎么知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: "How would I know?

cues.zh: 这里又不是我家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you4 bu2 shi4 wo3 jia1
cues.en: This isn't even my house."

cues.zh: 他去了一间吃到饱的餐厅
cues.pinyin: ta1 qu4 le5 yi1 jian1 chi1 dao4 bao3 de5 can1 ting1
cues.en: He went to an all-you-can-eat restaurant.

cues.zh: 他想要捞本
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 yao4 lao1 ben3
cues.en: He wanted to get his money's worth.

cues.zh: 为什么我们都不买房子呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 men5 dou1 bu4 mai3 fang2 zi5 ne5
cues.en: "Why don't we ever buy a house?"

cues.zh: 爸爸没钱买啊
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 mei2 qian2 mai3 a5
cues.en: "Dad doesn't have the money to buy one."

cues.zh: 那要怎么样才有钱
cues.pinyin: na4 yao4 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 you3 qian2
cues.en: "Then how do you get money?"

cues.zh: 你要认真读书
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 ren4 zhen1 du2 shu1
cues.en: "You have to study hard."

cues.zh: 长大后才能有好工作
cues.pinyin: zhang3 da4 hou4 cai2 neng2 you3 hao3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: "Then when you grow up you can get a good job,"

cues.zh: 赚很多的钱
cues.pinyin: zhuan4 hen3 duo1 de5 qian2
cues.en: "earn a lot of money,"

cues.zh: 才能买大房子
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 mai3 da4 fang2 zi5
cues.en: "and then you'll be able to buy a big house."

cues.zh: 那你为什么小时候不认真读书
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 xiao3 shi2 hou4 bu4 ren4 zhen1 du2 shu1
cues.en: "Then why didn't you study hard when you were little?"

cues.zh: 今天举办了

cues.zh: 后脸皮大赛

cues.zh: 裁判说开始的时候

cues.en: "I just walked up and took the trophy home."

cues.zh: 大我问你哦
cues.pinyin: da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 什么是人们说的时候很崇拜
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 ren2 men5 shuo1 de5 shi2 hou4 hen3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: What's something people say they admire a lot

cues.zh: 但是却不想见到呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 que4 bu4 xiang3 jian4 dao4 ne5
cues.en: but don't actually want to see?

cues.zh: 很崇拜
cues.pinyin: hen3 chong2 bai4

cues.zh: 很崇拜就应该
cues.pinyin: hen3 chong2 bai4 jiu4 ying1 gai1

cues.zh: 怪很想见到啊
cues.pinyin: guai4 hen3 xiang3 jian4 dao4 a5

cues.zh: 没有
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3
cues.en: "No."

cues.zh: 有一个是很崇拜
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 shi4 hen3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: "There's one thing people admire a lot"

cues.zh: 但是不想见到哦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 xiang3 jian4 dao4 o2
cues.en: "but don't want to see."

cues.zh: 不知道耶
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ye2

cues.zh: 是上帝

cues.zh: 上班时我都从不请假
cues.pinyin: shang4 ban1 shi2 wo3 dou1 cong2 bu4 qing3 jia4
cues.en: "I never take a day off work."

cues.zh: 那你真是个模范员工
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhen1 shi4 ge4 mo2 fan4 yuan2 gong1
cues.en: "Then you're really a model employee."

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "No."

cues.zh: 我是怕我一请假
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 pa4 wo3 yi1 qing3 jia4
cues.en: "I'm afraid that if I take a day off,"

cues.zh: 公司会发现
cues.pinyin: gong1 si1 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: "the company will realize"

cues.zh: 有没有我都是一样
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 wo3 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: "it's exactly the same whether I'm there or not."

cues.zh: 杉杉我问你
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3
cues.en: Shanshan, let me ask you.

cues.zh: 小美和妈妈买了八个橘子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 he2 ma1 ma1 mai3 le5 ba1 ge4 ju2 zi5
cues.en: Xiaomei and her mom bought eight oranges.

cues.zh: 然后妈妈让小美把这些橘子
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ma1 ma1 rang4 xiao3 mei3 ba3 zhe4 xie1 ju2 zi5
cues.en: Then mom told Xiaomei to

cues.zh: 要装进去五个塑胶袋里面
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhuang1 jin4 qu4 wu3 ge4 su4 jiao1 dai4 li3 mian4
cues.en: put these oranges into five plastic bags

cues.zh: 每一个塑胶袋里面都要双数
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 su4 jiao1 dai4 li3 mian4 dou1 yao4 shuang1 shu4
cues.en: with an even number of oranges in each bag.

cues.zh: 你能不能做得到呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 bu4 neng2 zuo4 de2 dao4 ne5
cues.en: "Can you do that?"

cues.zh: 我不行太难了
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 xing2 tai4 nan2 le5

cues.zh: 大家也可以想想看喔
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ye3 ke3 yi3 xiang3 xiang3 kan4 o1
cues.en: You all can think about it too.

cues.zh: 知道答案的可以在下方留言告诉大家喔

cues.en: If you know the answer, leave a comment below to tell everyone.

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 必吃泰式糯米芒果 |必吃甜点|【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 芒果糯米是一道经典的泰式点心
cues.pinyin: mang2 guo3 nuo4 mi3 shi4 yi1 dao4 jing1 dian3 de5 tai4 shi4 dian3 xin1
cues.en: Mango sticky rice is a classic Thai dessert.

cues.zh: 泰文我们叫它靠鸟妈木
cues.pinyin: tai4 wen2 wo3 men5 jiao4 ta1 kao4 niao3 ma1 mu4
cues.en: In Thai we call it "khao niao mamuang."

cues.zh: 靠鸟就是指这个糯米妈木是芒果
cues.pinyin: kao4 niao3 jiu4 shi4 zhi3 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 ma1 mu4 shi4 mang2 guo3
cues.en: "Khao niao" refers to the sticky rice, and "mamuang" is mango.

cues.zh: 它也是我最爱的点心之一
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shi4 wo3 zui4 ai4 de5 dian3 xin1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: It's also one of my favorite desserts.

cues.zh: 哈喽你好各位美食家各位爱做饭的人们
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 mei3 shi2 jia1 ge4 wei4 ai4 zuo4 fan4 de5 ren2 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone, foodies and all of you who love cooking!

cues.zh: 我是 C C 又见面了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 C C you4 jian4 mian4 le5
cues.en: I'm CC, and we meet again.

cues.zh: 在泰国长大的时候呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 tai4 guo2 zhang3 da4 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When I was growing up in Thailand,

cues.zh: 常常都会吃到糯米芒果
cues.pinyin: chang2 chang2 du1 hui4 chi1 dao4 nuo4 mi3 mang2 guo3
cues.en: I often got to eat mango sticky rice,

cues.zh: 特别是在四五月
cues.pinyin: te4 bie2 shi4 zai4 si4 wu3 yue4
cues.en: especially in April and May,

cues.zh: 泰国最热的这个季节
cues.pinyin: tai4 guo2 zui4 re4 de5 zhe4 ge5 ji4 jie2
cues.en: the hottest season in Thailand,

cues.zh: 也是芒果的旺季
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 mang2 guo3 de5 wang4 ji4
cues.en: which is also peak mango season.

cues.zh: 那个时候有好多好吃的这个糯米芒果
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 you3 hao3 duo1 hao3 chi1 de5 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 mang2 guo3
cues.en: At that time there was so much delicious mango sticky rice.

cues.zh: 我每次吃呢都会吃到两三份
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 ci4 chi1 ne5 du1 hui4 chi1 dao4 liang3 san1 fen4
cues.en: Every time I ate it, I'd have two or three servings.

cues.zh: 越吃越爱
cues.pinyin: yue4 chi1 yue4 ai4
cues.en: The more I ate, the more I loved it.

cues.zh: 所以我相信呢这个食谱也会成为你的最爱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 xiang1 xin4 ne5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3 ye3 hui4 cheng2 wei2 ni3 de5 zui4 ai4
cues.en: So I believe this recipe will become your favorite too.

cues.zh: 首先这个糯米我们要给它洗个几次
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 wo3 men5 yao4 gei3 ta1 xi3 ge4 ji3 ci4
cues.en: First, we need to rinse the sticky rice a few times,

cues.zh: 直到这个水呢变得非常的清澈
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 shui3 ne5 bian4 de2 fei1 chang2 de5 qing1 che4
cues.en: until the water becomes very clear.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 必吃泰式糯米芒果 |必吃甜点|【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 在一个蒸锅中我们把水给煮到沸腾
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 zheng1 guo1 zhong1 wo3 men5 ba3 shui3 gei3 zhu3 dao4 fei4 teng2
cues.en: In a steamer, bring the water to a boil.

cues.zh: 把这个糯米放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Add the sticky rice in.

cues.zh: 然后用这个高温呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 gao1 wen1 ne5
cues.en: Then on this high heat,

cues.zh: 给它蒸个 20 分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zheng1 ge4 20 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: steam it for 20 minutes,

cues.zh: 直到这个糯米呢
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 ne5
cues.en: until the sticky rice

cues.zh: 完全熟
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 shu2
cues.en: is fully cooked.

cues.zh: 它看上去呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 shang4 qu4 ne5
cues.en: It will look

cues.zh: 会有一点是这种半透明的样子
cues.pinyin: hui4 you3 yi4 dian3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 ban4 tou4 ming2 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: a bit translucent.

cues.zh: 如果你有电饭锅
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 you3 dian4 fan4 guo1
cues.en: If you have a rice cooker,

cues.zh: 你也可以直接把糯米放到电饭锅里
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 zhi2 jie1 ba3 nuo4 mi3 fang4 dao4 dian4 fan4 guo1 li3
cues.en: you can also put the sticky rice directly into it.

cues.zh: 然后水的高度呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 shui3 de5 gao1 du4 ne5
cues.en: Then the water level

cues.zh: 是跟糯米同样的高
cues.pinyin: shi4 gen1 nuo4 mi3 tong2 yang4 de5 gao1
cues.en: should be the same as the rice level.

cues.zh: 在一个小锅中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 guo1 zhong1
cues.en: In a small pot,

cues.zh: 我们现在放入椰奶
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 fang4 ru4 ye1 nai3
cues.en: we now add coconut milk

cues.zh: 还有盐
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yan2
cues.en: and salt.

cues.zh: 用中火煮
cues.pinyin: yong4 zhong1 huo3 zhu3
cues.en: Cook over medium heat,

cues.zh: 然后就是一直给它搅拌到
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 yi4 zhi2 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 dao4
cues.en: stirring constantly until

cues.zh: 这个糖全部都化掉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tang2 quan2 bu4 dou1 hua4 diao4
cues.en: the sugar is completely dissolved,

cues.zh: 再给它煮到沸腾
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 ta1 zhu3 dao4 fei4 teng2
cues.en: then bring it to a boil.

cues.zh: 将煮好的糯米放到一个大的搅拌碗里
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zhu3 hao3 de5 nuo4 mi3 fang4 dao4 yi2 ge4 da4 de5 jiao3 ban4 wan3 li3
cues.en: Put the cooked sticky rice into a large mixing bowl.

cues.zh: 我已经把三分之二刚刚煮好的椰奶汁
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 ba3 san1 fen1 zhi1 er4 gang1 gang1 zhu3 hao3 de5 ye1 nai3 zhi1
cues.en: I've taken two-thirds of the just-cooked coconut milk sauce

cues.zh: 放到这个量杯里
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 liang2 bei1 li3
cues.en: and put it into this measuring cup to cool.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 必吃泰式糯米芒果 |必吃甜点|【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 我们现在把它倒到糯米里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ba3 ta1 dao4 dao4 nuo4 mi3 li3 mian4
cues.en: Now we pour it over the sticky rice

cues.zh: 快速的给它们搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: kuai4 su4 de5 gei3 ta1 men5 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and quickly give it a stir.

cues.zh: 那我们在搅拌的时候呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 zai4 jiao3 ban4 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When we're stirring,

cues.zh: 我们这个动作要快一点
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 ge5 dong4 zuo4 yao4 kuai4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: we need to move a bit faster,

cues.zh: 因为这个糯米在热的时候呢
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 zai4 re4 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: because while the sticky rice is still hot,

cues.zh: 它才比较容易吸收这个酱汁
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai2 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 xi1 shou1 zhe4 ge5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: it absorbs the sauce more easily.

cues.zh: 然后这个时候呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: At this point,

cues.zh: 可以盖上一个盖子或者是保鲜纸
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 gai4 shang4 yi2 ge4 gai4 zi5 huo4 zhe3 shi4 bao3 xian1 zhi3
cues.en: we can cover it with a lid or plastic wrap

cues.zh: 给它放在那里 15 分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 fang4 zai4 na4 li3 15 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and let it sit for 15 minutes.

cues.zh: 15 分钟过后这个盖子掀开
cues.pinyin: 15 fen1 zhong1 guo4 hou4 zhe4 ge5 gai4 zi5 xian1 kai1
cues.en: After 15 minutes, lift the lid,

cues.zh: 你会看到那个糯米呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 kan4 dao4 na4 ge5 nuo4 mi3 ne5
cues.en: and you'll see that the sticky rice

cues.zh: 已经把许多的这个椰奶汁吸收进去了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 ba3 xu3 duo1 de5 zhe4 ge5 ye1 nai3 zhi1 xi1 shou1 jin4 qu4 le5
cues.en: has absorbed a lot of the coconut milk sauce.

cues.zh: 我们再给它搅拌一次
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: We stir it once more,

cues.zh: 然后再把盖子盖上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ba3 gai4 zi5 gai4 shang4
cues.en: then put the lid back on

cues.zh: 再放个 15 分钟
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 ge4 15 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and let it sit for another 15 minutes.

cues.zh: 好现在呢我们把剩余的四分之一
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 sheng4 yu2 de5 si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: Okay, now we take the remaining quarter

cues.zh: 的椰奶酱汁呢
cues.pinyin: de5 ye1 nai3 jiang4 zhi1 ne5
cues.en: of the coconut milk sauce

cues.zh: 放在中火上
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 zhong1 huo3 shang4
cues.en: and put it over medium heat,

cues.zh: 然后再加入玉米粉水
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 jia1 ru4 yu4 mi3 fen3 shui3
cues.en: then add in cornstarch slurry,

cues.zh: 然后也是不断的搅拌直到它变得粘稠
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 bu4 duan4 de5 jiao3 ban4 zhi2 dao4 ta1 bian4 de2 nian2 chou2
cues.en: stirring constantly until it thickens.

cues.zh: 在另外一个锅中我们也是把水煮到沸腾
cues.pinyin: zai4 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 zhong1 wo3 men5 ye3 shi4 ba3 shui3 zhu3 dao4 fei4 teng2
cues.en: In another pot, we also bring water to a boil

cues.zh: 加入这个去皮的绿豆
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 zhe4 ge5 qu4 pi2 de5 lv4 dou4
cues.en: and add the peeled mung beans,

cues.zh: 用这个小火给它煮大概三分钟
cues.pinyin: yong4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 huo3 gei3 ta1 zhu3 da4 gai4 san1 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: cooking them over low heat for about 3 minutes

cues.zh: 直到变软把水沥干净
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 bian4 ruan3 ba3 shui3 li4 gan1 jing4
cues.en: until softened, then drain off the water completely.

cues.zh: 那现在是在一个煎锅上
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 shi4 zai4 yi2 ge4 jian1 guo1 shang4
cues.en: Now, in a frying pan,

cues.zh: 我们涂上薄薄的一层植物油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tu2 shang4 bao2 bao2 de5 yi1 ceng2 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: we spread a thin layer of vegetable oil,

cues.zh: 把这个煮好的绿豆放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhu3 hao3 de5 lv4 dou4 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: add in the cooked mung beans,

cues.zh: 然后我们给它这样子稍微的烤
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 zhe4 yang4 zi5 shao1 wei1 de5 kao3
cues.en: and toast them lightly like this

cues.zh: 到酥酥脆脆的
cues.pinyin: dao4 su1 su1 cui4 cui4 de5
cues.en: until crispy,

cues.zh: 大概是 5 分钟的时间用高火高温
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 5 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1 yong4 gao1 huo3 gao1 wen1
cues.en: for about 5 minutes on high heat.

cues.zh: 好的今天就这样子了

cues.en: Kids often ask me what Bitcoin actually is.

cues.zh: 我们准备通过两期节目
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhun3 bei4 tong1 guo4 liang3 qi1 jie2 mu4
cues.en: We're going to cover this over two episodes.

cues.zh: 我给大家介绍一下比特币的基本原理
cues.pinyin: wo3 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 bi3 te4 bi4 de5 ji1 ben3 yuan2 li3
cues.en: I'll introduce the basic principles of Bitcoin.

cues.zh: 那今天我们首先来介绍一下挖矿到
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 wa1 kuang4 dao4
cues.en: Today, let's first talk about mining —

cues.zh: 底是怎么回事
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: what it actually is.

cues.zh: 比特币是什么呢
cues.pinyin: bi3 te4 bi4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what is Bitcoin?

cues.zh: 比特币实际上是一种电子货币
cues.pinyin: bi3 te4 bi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 dian4 zi5 huo4 bi4
cues.en: Bitcoin is actually a kind of electronic currency.

cues.zh: 或者叫数字货币
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 jiao4 shu4 zi4 huo4 bi4
cues.en: Or you could call it digital currency.

cues.zh: 它是基于密码学的一种货币
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ji1 yu2 mi4 ma3 xue2 de5 yi1 zhong3 huo4 bi4
cues.en: It's a currency based on cryptography.

cues.zh: 这种货币跟我们以前用银行卡里面那个货
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 huo4 bi4 gen1 wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 yong4 yin2 hang2 ka3 li3 mian4 na4 ge5 huo4
cues.en: This kind of currency is different from the money

cues.zh: 币它不太一样
cues.pinyin: bi4 ta1 bu4 tai4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: we used to have in our bank cards.

cues.zh: 它的出现是一种传奇
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 chu1 xian4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 chuan2 qi2
cues.en: Its creation is something of a legend.

cues.zh: 在 200 8 年的时候金融危机
cues.pinyin: zai4 200 8 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 jin1 rong2 wei1 ji1
cues.en: Back in 2008, during the financial crisis—

cues.zh: 200 8 年 11 月 1 日的时候有一个网络极客
cues.pinyin: 200 8 nian2 11 yue4 1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou4 you3 yi2 ge4 wang3 luo4 ji2 ke4
cues.en: On November 1, 2008, an internet geek

cues.zh: 他化名叫中本聪
cues.pinyin: ta1 hua4 ming2 jiao4 zhong1 ben3 cong1
cues.en: used the pseudonym Satoshi Nakamoto.

cues.zh: 这个中本聪我们到目前为止也不知
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhong1 ben3 cong1 wo3 men5 dao4 mu4 qian2 wei2 zhi3 ye3 bu4 zhi1
cues.en: To this day, we still don't know

cues.zh: 道他到底是谁
cues.pinyin: dao4 ta1 dao4 di3 shi4 shui2
cues.en: who this Satoshi Nakamoto really is.

cues.zh: 他在网络上发表了一篇文章
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wang3 luo4 shang4 fa1 biao3 le5 yi4 pian1 wen2 zhang1
cues.en: He published an article online.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币和区块链啥原理？矿机和挖矿是咋回事？（一）

cues.zh: 这篇文章我们现在管它叫白皮书
cues.pinyin: zhe4 pian1 wen2 zhang1 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 bai2 pi2 shu1
cues.en: We now call this article the white paper.

cues.zh: 全名叫比特币一种点对点的电子现金系统
cues.pinyin: quan2 ming2 jiao4 bi3 te4 bi4 yi1 zhong3 dian3 dui4 dian3 de5 dian4 zi5 xian4 jin1 xi4 tong3
cues.en: Its full name is 'Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System.'

cues.zh: 他在这个白皮书里面提出了这样一种构想
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 bai2 pi2 shu1 li3 mian4 ti2 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 yi1 zhong3 gou4 xiang3
cues.en: In this white paper, he proposed an idea.

cues.zh: 就是说呢我们可以设计一种去中心化的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ne5 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 she4 ji4 yi1 zhong3 qu4 zhong1 xin1 hua4 de5
cues.en: That is, we could design a decentralized

cues.zh: 电子记账系统
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 ji4 zhang4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: electronic ledger system.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币和区块链啥原理？矿机和挖矿是咋回事？（一）

cues.zh: A BC D 它们进行交易买东西卖东西之类的
cues.pinyin: A BC D ta1 men5 jin4 xing2 jiao1 yi4 mai3 dong1 xi1 mai4 dong1 xi1 zhi1 lei4 de5
cues.en: A, B, C, D conduct transactions, buying and selling things.

cues.zh: 那所以相互之间就要进行支付对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 suo3 yi3 xiang1 hu4 zhi1 jian1 jiu4 yao4 jin4 xing2 zhi1 fu4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: So they need to make payments to each other, right?

cues.zh: 支付的时候比如说有一次
cues.pinyin: zhi1 fu4 de5 shi2 hou4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 yi1 ci4
cues.en: For example, one time when making a payment,

cues.zh: A 先支付了 10 个比特币给 B
cues.pinyin: A xian1 zhi1 fu4 le5 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 B
cues.en: A first paid 10 bitcoins to B.

cues.zh: 这件事情 A 要记账
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 qing2 A yao4 ji4 zhang4
cues.en: A needs to record this transaction.

cues.zh: 记账了之后你不能自己留着
cues.pinyin: ji4 zhang4 le5 zhi1 hou4 ni3 bu4 neng2 zi4 ji3 liu2 zhe5
cues.en: After recording it, you can't just keep it to yourself.

cues.zh: 因为你自己留着别人不信对吧
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 zi4 ji3 liu2 zhe5 bie2 ren2 bu4 xin4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Because if you keep it to yourself, others won't trust it, right?

cues.zh: 所以你要把这个账单要广播出去
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhang4 dan1 yao4 guang3 bo1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: So you need to broadcast this record.

cues.zh: 要告诉所有人
cues.pinyin: yao4 gao4 su4 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: You need to tell everyone.

cues.zh: 所以说 A 把这账单告诉 B
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 A ba3 zhe4 zhang4 dan1 gao4 su4 B
cues.en: So A tells this record to B,

cues.zh: 告诉 C 又告诉 D 了
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 C you4 gao4 su4 D le5
cues.en: tells C, and also tells D.

cues.zh: 广播到网络上所有人
cues.pinyin: guang3 bo1 dao4 wang3 luo4 shang4 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: Broadcasts it to everyone on the network.

cues.zh: 过了一会 B 要进行支付
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 yi1 hui4 B yao4 jin4 xing2 zhi1 fu4
cues.en: After a while, B needs to make a payment.

cues.zh: 比如说 B 支付了 5 个比特币给 C
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 B zhi1 fu4 le5 5 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 C
cues.en: For example, B pays 5 bitcoins to C.

cues.zh: 同时 B 把这个账单告诉 D 告诉 A 再告诉 C
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 B ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhang4 dan1 gao4 su4 D gao4 su4 A zai4 gao4 su4 C
cues.en: At the same time, B tells this record to D, to A, and to C.

cues.zh: 然后这个 C 又支付
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 C you4 zhi1 fu4
cues.en: Then C makes another payment.

cues.zh: 比如支付了 2 个比特币给 D
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zhi1 fu4 le5 2 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 D
cues.en: For example, pays 2 bitcoins to D.

cues.zh: 同时 C 也要把这个账单告诉其余
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 C ye3 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhang4 dan1 gao4 su4 qi2 yu2
cues.en: At the same time, C must also tell this record to everyone else.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币和区块链啥原理？矿机和挖矿是咋回事？（一）

cues.zh: 因为每个人的账单可能是不一样的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 zhang4 dan1 ke3 neng2 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: Because everyone's record might be different.

cues.zh: 比如说 A 他可能会先记录
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 A ta1 ke3 neng2 hui4 xian1 ji4 lu4
cues.en: For example, A might first record

cues.zh: A 把 10 个比特币给 B 这件事
cues.pinyin: A ba3 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 B zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: that A gave 10 bitcoins to B,

cues.zh: 后记录 B 把 5 个比特币给 C 这件事
cues.pinyin: hou4 ji4 lu4 B ba3 5 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 C zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: and later record that B gave 5 bitcoins to C.

cues.zh: 但是因为网络的延迟效应
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wang3 luo4 de5 yan2 chi2 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: But because of network latency,

cues.zh: D 这边可能不是这样
cues.pinyin: D zhe4 bian1 ke3 neng2 bu2 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: D's side might not see it this way.

cues.zh: D 的顺序可能是先记录了 B 负 5
cues.pinyin: D de5 shun4 xu4 ke3 neng2 shi4 xian1 ji4 lu4 le5 B fu4 5
cues.en: D's order might first record B minus 5

cues.zh: 个比特币给 C
cues.pinyin: ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 C
cues.en: bitcoins paid to C,

cues.zh: 然后 A 又负了 10 个比特币给 B
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 A you4 fu4 le5 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 B
cues.en: then A minus 10 bitcoins paid to B.

cues.zh: 对吧每个人的账单可能不太一样
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 zhang4 dan1 ke3 neng2 bu4 tai4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Right, everyone's ledger might be a bit different.

cues.zh: 你到底是以谁为准
cues.pinyin: ni3 dao4 di3 shi4 yi3 shui2 wei4 zhun3
cues.en: So whose record do you go by?

cues.zh: 第二个就是我们为何要记账
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 wei4 he2 yao4 ji4 zhang4
cues.en: The second question is, why should we even keep the ledger?

cues.zh: 凭什么你广播给我我就要收着呢
cues.pinyin: ping2 shen2 me5 ni3 guang3 bo1 gei3 wo3 wo3 jiu4 yao4 shou1 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: Why should I accept it just because you broadcast it to me?

cues.zh: 凭什么我要去花我自己的电脑资源
cues.pinyin: ping2 shen2 me5 wo3 yao4 qu4 hua1 wo3 zi4 ji3 de5 dian4 nao3 zi1 yuan2
cues.en: Why should I spend my own computer resources

cues.zh: 记录一个跟我无关的这个账目对不对
cues.pinyin: ji4 lu4 yi2 ge4 gen1 wo3 wu2 guan1 de5 zhe4 ge5 zhang4 mu4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: recording an account that has nothing to do with me, right?

cues.zh: 为什么要记账第二个问题
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 ji4 zhang4 di4 er4 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Why keep the ledger — that's the second question.

cues.zh: 第三个问题就是如何防伪什么叫防伪呢
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ge4 wen4 ti2 jiu4 shi4 ru2 he2 fang2 wei3 shen2 me5 jiao4 fang2 wei3 ne5
cues.en: The third question is how to prevent forgery. What does that mean?

cues.zh: 比如说这个 B 广播了一条消息
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 B guang3 bo1 le5 yi1 tiao2 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: For example, B broadcasts a message

cues.zh: 说 A 支付了 10 个比特币给他
cues.pinyin: shuo1 A zhi1 fu4 le5 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 gei3 ta1
cues.en: saying A paid him 10 bitcoins.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币和区块链啥原理？矿机和挖矿是咋回事？（一）

cues.zh: 但实际上 A 并没有支付给他
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi2 ji4 shang4 A bing4 mei2 you3 zhi1 fu4 gei3 ta1
cues.en: But actually A never paid him.

cues.zh: 那这就是一个伪造的记录
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 wei3 zao4 de5 ji4 lu4
cues.en: Then that's a forged record.

cues.zh: 我们怎么去防伪对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zen3 me5 qu4 fang2 wei3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: How do we prevent forgery, right?

cues.zh: 怎么去防止篡改
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 qu4 fang2 zhi3 cuan4 gai3
cues.en: How do we prevent tampering?

cues.zh: 之前的记录我把它改掉这个怎么办
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 de5 ji4 lu4 wo3 ba3 ta1 gai3 diao4 zhe4 ge5 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: What if I change a previous record — how do we deal with that?

cues.zh: 如何去防止篡改
cues.pinyin: ru2 he2 qu4 fang2 zhi3 cuan4 gai3
cues.en: How do we prevent tampering?

cues.zh: 还有很多很多其他的问题
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 qi2 ta1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: There are many, many other questions too.

cues.zh: 比如说如何防止双重支付
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ru2 he2 fang2 zhi3 shuang1 chong2 zhi1 fu4
cues.en: For example, how do we prevent double spending?

cues.zh: 一个人同时发给两个人 10 个比特币
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 tong2 shi2 fa1 gei3 liang3 ge4 ren2 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4
cues.en: Someone sends 10 bitcoins to two people at the same time,

cues.zh: 但它实际上一共就只有 10 个比特币
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 shi2 ji4 shang4 yi1 gong4 jiu4 zhi3 you3 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4
cues.en: but they actually only have 10 bitcoins in total.

cues.zh: 还有就是如何进行保密你这个信
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 ru2 he2 jin4 xing2 bao3 mi4 ni3 zhe4 ge5 xin4
cues.en: There's also the question of privacy — this information

cues.zh: 息都是公开的
cues.pinyin: xi1 dou1 shi4 gong1 kai1 de5
cues.en: is all public.

cues.zh: 那别人不就知道你有多少钱了吗
cues.pinyin: na4 bie2 ren2 bu4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 ni3 you3 duo1 shao3 qian2 le5 ma5
cues.en: So wouldn't others know how much money you have?

cues.zh: 怎么去保密等等一系列的问题
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 qu4 bao3 mi4 deng3 deng3 yi1 xi4 lie4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: How to keep it private, and so on — a whole series of questions.

cues.zh: 我们今天主要就研究前两个
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zhu3 yao4 jiu4 yan2 jiu1 qian2 liang3 ge4
cues.en: Today we'll mainly look at the first two.

cues.zh: 以谁的账单为准
cues.pinyin: yi3 shei2 de5 zhang4 dan1 wei4 zhun3
cues.en: Whose ledger should we go by,

cues.zh: 还有我为什么要记账
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wo3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 ji4 zhang4
cues.en: and why should I keep the ledger at all.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说一下为什么要记账
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 ji4 zhang4
cues.en: Let's first talk about why we keep the ledger.

cues.zh: 记账是因为记账有奖励记账的奖励
cues.pinyin: ji4 zhang4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ji4 zhang4 you3 jiang3 li4 ji4 zhang4 de5 jiang3 li4
cues.en: We keep the ledger because there's a reward for it —

cues.zh: 记账的奖励
cues.pinyin: ji4 zhang4 de5 jiang3 li4
cues.en: a mining reward.

cues.zh: 那么每一个比特币系统中的这个用户
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 mei3 yi2 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 xi4 tong3 zhong1 de5 zhe4 ge5 yong4 hu4
cues.en: So every user in the Bitcoin system

cues.zh: 他都可以去记账
cues.pinyin: ta1 dou1 ke3 yi3 qu4 ji4 zhang4
cues.en: can go record the ledger.

cues.zh: 如果他记了账
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 ji4 liao3 zhang4
cues.en: If he records it,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币和区块链啥原理？矿机和挖矿是咋回事？（一）

cues.zh: 过了 4 年之后每打一个包会奖励
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 4 nian2 zhi1 hou4 mei3 da3 yi2 ge4 bao1 hui4 jiang3 li4
cues.en: then for the first 4 years, each block mined rewards

cues.zh: 你 25 个比特币
cues.pinyin: ni3 25 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4
cues.en: you 25 bitcoins.

cues.zh: 如果你要是再过 4 年就奖励 12 5
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 yao4 shi4 zai4 guo4 4 nian2 jiu4 jiang3 li4 12 5
cues.en: If another 4 years pass, the reward becomes 12.5.

cues.zh: 也就是每过 4 年之后它会减半
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 mei3 guo4 4 nian2 zhi1 hou4 ta1 hui4 jian3 ban4
cues.en: In other words, every 4 years it halves.

cues.zh: 咱们来算一算比特币一共有多少个
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 lai2 suan4 yi1 suan4 bi3 te4 bi4 yi1 gong4 you3 duo1 shao3 ge4
cues.en: Let's calculate how many bitcoins there are in total.

cues.zh: 首先每过 10 分钟你会打一个包
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 mei3 guo4 10 fen1 zhong1 ni3 hui4 da3 yi2 ge4 bao1
cues.en: First, every 10 minutes you mine a block.

cues.zh: 这一个包有 50 个比特币的奖励对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi2 ge4 bao1 you3 50 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 de5 jiang3 li4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: This block has a reward of 50 bitcoins, right?

cues.zh: 一个小时有 6 个 10 分钟可以打包 6 次
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xiao3 shi2 you3 6 ge4 10 fen1 zhong1 ke3 yi3 da3 bao1 6 ci4
cues.en: An hour has six 10-minute periods, so you can mine 6 blocks.

cues.zh: 然后每天有 24 个小时每年有 36 5 天
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 mei3 tian1 you3 24 ge4 xiao3 shi2 mei3 nian2 you3 36 5 tian1
cues.en: Then each day has 24 hours, and each year has 365 days.

cues.zh: 前 4 年的时候都是这样我再乘个 4 年
cues.pinyin: qian2 4 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 dou1 shi4 zhe4 yang4 wo3 zai4 cheng2 ge4 4 nian2
cues.en: For the first 4 years it's like this, so I multiply by 4 years.

cues.zh: 但是第二个 4 年就不是这样
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 di4 er4 ge4 4 nian2 jiu4 bu2 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: But the second 4-year period isn't the same.

cues.zh: 第二个 4 年会减半对吧
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 4 nian2 hui4 jian3 ban4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: The second 4 years will be halved, right?

cues.zh: 所以我要再乘个第 1 个 4 年
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 yao4 zai4 cheng2 ge4 di4 1 ge4 4 nian2
cues.en: So for the first 4-year period, I multiply by 1,

cues.zh: 第 2 个 4 年会乘个 1
cues.pinyin: di4 2 ge4 4 nian2 hui4 cheng2 ge4 1
cues.en: the second 4-year period multiplies by 1/2,

cues.zh: 第 3 个 4 年会乘 1 的平方
cues.pinyin: di4 3 ge4 4 nian2 hui4 cheng2 1 de5 ping2 fang1
cues.en: the third 4-year period multiplies by (1/2) squared,

cues.zh: 第 4 个 4 年 1 的三次方这样一直加下去
cues.pinyin: di4 4 ge4 4 nian2 1 de5 san1 ci4 fang1 zhe4 yang4 yi4 zhi2 jia1 xia4 qu4
cues.en: the fourth 4-year period by (1/2) cubed, and so on, adding them all up.

cues.zh: 如果我们把它都算出来

cues.zh: 那你问我的原因

cues.zh: 真的是很幸福的感觉
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 xing4 fu2 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: it really is a very happy feeling

cues.zh: 好那我们现在呢赶快开始吧
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ne5 gan3 kuai4 kai1 shi3 ba5
cues.en: okay let's get started now

cues.zh: 首先在这个锅子里面我们加进来六杯水
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo1 zi5 li3 mian4 wo3 men5 jia1 jin4 lai2 liu4 bei1 shui3
cues.en: first we add six cups of water into this pot

cues.zh: 然后这里呢我有一杯米饭
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 li3 ne5 wo3 you3 yi1 bei1 mi3 fan4
cues.en: then here I have a cup of rice

cues.zh: 我已经放在这个水里面泡了半个小时了
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 fang4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shui3 li3 mian4 pao4 le5 ban4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 le5
cues.en: I've already soaked it in water for half an hour

cues.zh: 那现在呢我就把它放到锅子里
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 jiu4 ba3 ta1 fang4 dao4 guo1 zi5 li3
cues.en: now I'll put it into the pot

cues.zh: 好我们先用大火一直把这个锅里面
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 men5 xian1 yong4 da4 huo3 yi4 zhi2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 guo1 li3 mian4
cues.en: let's first use high heat to bring the water in the pot

cues.zh: 的水呢给煮开
cues.pinyin: de5 shui3 ne5 gei3 zhu3 kai1
cues.en: to a boil

cues.zh: 然后转小火再继续煮十分钟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhuan3 xiao3 huo3 zai4 ji4 xu4 zhu3 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: then turn to low heat and keep cooking for ten minutes

cues.zh: 这个时候我们放进来一杯的这个南瓜
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 bei1 de5 zhe4 ge5 nan2 gua1
cues.en: at this point we add in a cup of this pumpkin

cues.zh: 然后我们也是给它煮二十分钟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 zhu3 er4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and we also cook it for twenty minutes

cues.zh: 那时不时的话呢我们给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 bu4 shi2 de5 hua4 ne5 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: stirring it from time to time

cues.zh: 不然的话呢这个米饭很容易连锅
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 de5 hua4 ne5 zhe4 ge5 mi3 fan4 hen3 rong2 yi4 lian2 guo1
cues.en: otherwise the rice will easily stick to the pot

cues.zh: 好的最后呢我们这边有一汤匙的这个枸杞
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 zui4 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 zhe4 bian1 you3 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 zhe4 ge5 gou3 qi3
cues.en: okay finally we have a tablespoon of goji berries here

cues.zh: 我们今天这个粥呢

cues.zh: 就是非常简单的做

cues.zh: 他从十个月以后就很爱喝粥了

cues.zh: 我做给他各式各样的粥

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 在发生这件事之前
cues.pinyin: zai4 fa1 sheng1 zhe4 jian4 shi4 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Before this happened,

cues.zh: 他一直是江老板身旁的红人
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 shi4 jiang1 lao3 ban3 shen1 pang2 de5 hong2 ren2
cues.en: he had always been the right-hand man by Boss Jiang's side.

cues.zh: 做事也是心狠手辣
cues.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 ye3 shi4 xin1 hen3 shou3 la4
cues.en: He was ruthless and efficient in handling things.

cues.zh: 这天手下来报
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 shou3 xia4 lai2 bao4
cues.en: One day a subordinate came to report

cues.zh: 有人在店里敲诈
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 zai4 dian4 li3 qiao1 zha4
cues.en: that someone was extorting money at the shop.

cues.zh: 江老板定了每晚十点关店的规矩
cues.pinyin: jiang1 lao3 ban3 ding4 le5 mei3 wan3 shi2 dian3 guan1 dian4 de5 gui1 ju3
cues.en: Boss Jiang had set a rule to close the shop at 10pm every night,

cues.zh: 可一群黑帮分子到点不走
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi1 qun2 hei1 bang1 fen4 zi3 dao4 dian3 bu4 zou3
cues.en: but a group of gangsters wouldn't leave when closing time came.

cues.zh: 善宇没惯着
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 mei2 guan4 zhe5
cues.en: Seon-woo wasn't going to let it slide

cues.zh: 直接把人打残
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 ba3 ren2 da3 can2
cues.en: and beat them until they were crippled.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 清算完营收
cues.pinyin: qing1 suan4 wan2 ying2 shou1
cues.en: After settling the day's earnings,

cues.zh: 第二天一早就把钱交给江老板
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 zao3 jiu4 ba3 qian2 jiao1 gei3 jiang1 lao3 ban3
cues.en: he handed the money to Boss Jiang first thing the next morning.

cues.zh: 善于的江老板是当地城北帮的老大
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu2 de5 jiang1 lao3 ban3 shi4 dang1 di4 cheng2 bei3 bang1 de5 lao3 da4
cues.en: Seon-woo's boss, Jiang, was the leader of the local North City gang,

cues.zh: 没人敢破他的规矩
cues.pinyin: mei2 ren2 gan3 po4 ta1 de5 gui1 ju3
cues.en: and no one dared break his rules.

cues.zh: 可被打的是本地黑帮朴代表的手下
cues.pinyin: ke3 bei4 da3 di1 shi4 ben3 di4 hei1 bang1 pu3 dai4 biao3 de5 shou3 xia4
cues.en: But the ones beaten were subordinates of the local gang's Representative Park.

cues.zh: 江老板提醒善宇
cues.pinyin: jiang1 lao3 ban3 ti2 xing3 shan4 yu3
cues.en: Boss Jiang warned Seon-woo

cues.zh: 若不好解决他可出面
cues.pinyin: ruo4 bu4 hao3 jie3 jue2 ta1 ke3 chu1 mian4
cues.en: that if it couldn't be resolved, he himself could step in.

cues.zh: 善宇让江老板放心说自己能处理
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 rang4 jiang1 lao3 ban3 fang4 xin1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 neng2 chu3 li3
cues.en: Seon-woo told Boss Jiang not to worry, he could handle it himself.

cues.zh: 这时集团二把手文星推门进来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ji2 tuan2 er4 ba3 shou3 wen2 xing1 tui1 men2 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Just then the group's second-in-command, Munsung, pushed open the door and came in.

cues.zh: 坐下就吃东西
cues.pinyin: zuo4 xia4 jiu4 chi1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: He sat down and started eating right away.

cues.zh: 这一层夜总会本是他管
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ceng2 ye4 zong3 hui4 ben3 shi4 ta1 guan3
cues.en: This floor's nightclub had originally been under his management.

cues.zh: 他一边吃一边谢善宇帮忙
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 chi1 yi1 bian1 xie4 shan4 yu3 bang1 mang2
cues.en: While eating, he thanked Seon-woo for the help,

cues.zh: 还跟江老板说能打电话搞定这事
cues.pinyin: hai2 gen1 jiang1 lao3 ban3 shuo1 neng2 da3 dian4 hua4 gao3 ding4 zhe4 shi4
cues.en: and also told Boss Jiang he could settle the matter with a phone call.

cues.zh: 江老板冷冷问他是不是来吃饭的
cues.pinyin: jiang1 lao3 ban3 leng3 leng3 wen4 ta1 shi4 bu2 shi4 lai2 chi1 fan4 de5
cues.en: Boss Jiang coldly asked if he'd only come here to eat.

cues.zh: 文星没反应过来
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 mei2 fan3 ying4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Munsung didn't catch on,

cues.zh: 就被江老板下令滚出去等着
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 jiang1 lao3 ban3 xia4 ling4 gun3 chu1 qu4 deng3 zhe5
cues.en: and Boss Jiang ordered him to get out and wait.

cues.zh: 文星瞪了善宇一眼
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 deng4 le5 shan4 yu3 yi1 yan3
cues.en: Munsung glared at Seon-woo

cues.zh: 灰溜溜的走了
cues.pinyin: hui1 liu1 liu1 de5 zou3 le5
cues.en: and slunk away in embarrassment.

cues.zh: 江老板不想掺和这事
cues.pinyin: jiang1 lao3 ban3 bu4 xiang3 chan1 huo5 zhe4 shi4
cues.en: Boss Jiang didn't want to get involved in this matter

cues.zh: 让善宇自己处理
cues.pinyin: rang4 shan4 yu3 zi4 ji3 chu3 li3
cues.en: and let Seon-woo handle it himself.

cues.zh: 随后说出真正目的
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 shuo1 chu1 zhen1 zheng4 mu4 di4
cues.en: Then he revealed his real purpose:

cues.zh: 明天中午要去上海出差
cues.pinyin: ming2 tian1 zhong1 wu3 yao4 qu4 shang4 hai3 chu1 chai1
cues.en: tomorrow at noon he had to go on a business trip to Shanghai.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 西秀快步跑出去和男人上车
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 kuai4 bu4 pao3 chu1 qu4 he2 nan2 ren2 shang4 che1
cues.en: Seo-soo hurried out and got into a car with a man.

cues.zh: 善宇发动车子远远跟着
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 fa1 dong4 che1 zi5 yuan3 yuan3 gen1 zhe5
cues.en: Seon-woo started his car and followed from a distance,

cues.zh: 看着两人在餐厅有说有笑吃饭
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 liang3 ren2 zai4 can1 ting1 you3 shuo1 you3 xiao4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: watching the two of them laughing and chatting over dinner at a restaurant.

cues.zh: 饭后去夜总会跳舞
cues.pinyin: fan4 hou4 qu4 ye4 zong3 hui4 tiao4 wu3
cues.en: After dinner they went to dance at a nightclub.

cues.zh: 后半夜两人回别墅
cues.pinyin: hou4 ban4 ye4 liang3 ren2 hui2 bie2 shu4
cues.en: In the middle of the night, the two returned to a villa.

cues.zh: 善宇对着方向盘低声念叨
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 dui4 zhe5 fang1 xiang4 pan2 di1 sheng1 nian4 dao1
cues.en: Seon-woo muttered quietly to himself over the steering wheel,

cues.zh: 觉得他们大概是在一起了
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 ta1 men5 da4 gai4 shi4 zai4 yi4 qi3 le5
cues.en: thinking the two of them were probably together.

cues.zh: 机械刚进门善于就接到文星的集电
cues.pinyin: ji1 xie4 gang1 jin4 men2 shan4 yu2 jiu4 jie1 dao4 wen2 xing1 de5 ji2 dian4
cues.en: As soon as he got through the door, Seon-woo got a call from Munsung,

cues.zh: 说朴代表那边打来电话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 pu3 dai4 biao3 na4 bian1 da3 lai2 dian4 hua4
cues.en: saying Representative Park had called.

cues.zh: 善宇赶到后
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 gan3 dao4 hou4
cues.en: After Seon-woo arrived,

cues.zh: 朴代表又打来电话
cues.pinyin: pu3 dai4 biao3 you4 da3 lai2 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Representative Park called again.

cues.zh: 他接过手机
cues.pinyin: ta1 jie1 guo4 shou3 ji1
cues.en: He took the phone

cues.zh: 让朴代表亲自来酒店说
cues.pinyin: rang4 pu3 dai4 biao3 qin1 zi4 lai2 jiu3 dian4 shuo1
cues.en: and told Representative Park to come to the hotel in person to talk.

cues.zh: 别老打电话烦他
cues.pinyin: bie2 lao3 da3 dian4 hua4 fan2 ta1
cues.en: Stop calling and bothering him, he said.

cues.zh: 文星在旁边看着
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 zai4 pang2 bian1 kan4 zhe5
cues.en: Munsung watched from the side,

cues.zh: 深知这些混混撞到了铁板
cues.pinyin: shen1 zhi1 zhe4 xie1 hun4 hun4 zhuang4 dao4 le5 tie3 ban3
cues.en: well aware that these thugs had met their match.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 两人有一搭没一搭的聊
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 you3 yi1 da1 mei2 yi1 da1 de5 liao2
cues.en: The two made halfhearted small talk,

cues.zh: 没什么共同话题
cues.pinyin: mei2 shen2 me5 gong4 tong2 hua4 ti2
cues.en: with nothing much in common to talk about.

cues.zh: 离开餐厅后
cues.pinyin: li2 kai1 can1 ting1 hou4
cues.en: After leaving the restaurant,

cues.zh: 善宇问西秀和江老板怎么认识的
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 wen4 xi1 xiu4 he2 jiang1 lao3 ban3 zen3 me5 ren4 shi2 de5
cues.en: Seon-woo asked Seo-soo how she knew Boss Jiang.

cues.zh: 西秀没接话
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 mei2 jie1 hua4
cues.en: Seo-soo didn't answer.

cues.zh: 冲进灯具店
cues.pinyin: chong1 jin4 deng1 ju4 dian4
cues.en: She rushed into a lighting shop,

cues.zh: 问红色台灯价格却没买
cues.pinyin: wen4 hong2 se4 tai2 deng1 jia4 ge2 que4 mei2 mai3
cues.en: asked the price of a red lamp but didn't buy it,

cues.zh: 随后说要走
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 shuo1 yao4 zou3
cues.en: then said she wanted to leave.

cues.zh: 两人走到音乐室门口
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 zou3 dao4 yin1 yue4 shi4 men2 kou3
cues.en: The two walked to the door of a music room.

cues.zh: 西秀接过善宇手里的琴道谢
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 jie1 guo4 shan4 yu3 shou3 li3 de5 qin2 dao4 xie4
cues.en: Seo-soo took the instrument from Seon-woo's hands and thanked him,

cues.zh: 说只是不想一个人吃饭
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhi3 shi4 bu4 xiang3 yi2 ge4 ren2 chi1 fan4
cues.en: saying she just didn't want to eat alone.

cues.zh: 不让善于等饭练完琴送他
cues.pinyin: bu4 rang4 shan4 yu2 deng3 fan4 lian4 wan2 qin2 song4 ta1
cues.en: She told Seon-woo to wait, and after she finished practicing she'd see him off.

cues.zh: 善于坐在室外长椅上看稀朽白泪
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu2 zuo4 zai4 shi4 wai4 zhang3 yi3 shang4 kan4 xi1 xiu3 bai2 lei4
cues.en: Seon-woo sat on an outdoor bench waiting, looking a little forlorn.

cues.zh: 没多久接到小弟电话
cues.pinyin: mei2 duo1 jiu3 jie1 dao4 xiao3 di4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Not long after, he got a call from a subordinate,

cues.zh: 说今早有人跟文星一起去酒店找他
cues.pinyin: shuo1 jin1 zao3 you3 ren2 gen1 wen2 xing1 yi4 qi3 qu4 jiu3 dian4 zhao3 ta1
cues.en: saying that someone had gone to the hotel with Munsung that morning looking for him.

cues.zh: 善宇心里一紧
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 xin1 li3 yi1 jin3
cues.en: Seon-woo's heart sank,

cues.zh: 立马往酒店赶
cues.pinyin: li4 ma3 wang3 jiu3 dian4 gan3
cues.en: and he rushed straight to the hotel.

cues.zh: 一进包厢
cues.pinyin: yi1 jin4 bao1 xiang1
cues.en: As soon as he entered the private room,

cues.zh: 就看见文星和朴代表碰杯喝酒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 kan4 jian4 wen2 xing1 he2 pu3 dai4 biao3 peng4 bei1 he1 jiu3
cues.en: he saw Munsung and Representative Park clinking glasses and drinking.

cues.zh: 文星招手让他坐
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 zhao1 shou3 rang4 ta1 zuo4
cues.en: Munsung waved for him to sit.

cues.zh: 善宇坐下就让朴代表有话直说
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 zuo4 xia4 jiu4 rang4 pu3 dai4 biao3 you3 hua4 zhi2 shuo1
cues.en: Seon-woo sat down and told Representative Park to speak plainly,

cues.zh: 还把屋里的女孩都赶出去
cues.pinyin: hai2 ba3 wu1 li3 de5 nv3 hai2 dou1 gan3 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and had all the girls in the room sent out.

cues.zh: 朴代表盯着善宇
cues.pinyin: pu3 dai4 biao3 ding1 zhe5 shan4 yu3
cues.en: Representative Park stared at Seon-woo.

cues.zh: 文星想打圆场
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 xiang3 da3 yuan2 chang3
cues.en: Munsung tried to smooth things over

cues.zh: 被善宇骂得闭嘴
cues.pinyin: bei4 shan4 yu3 ma4 de2 bi4 zui3
cues.en: but was scolded into silence by Seon-woo.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 善宇对朴代表毫不客气
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 dui4 pu3 dai4 biao3 hao2 bu2 ke4 qi4
cues.en: Seon-woo showed Representative Park no courtesy at all,

cues.zh: 说若只是来道歉就不必了
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ruo4 zhi3 shi4 lai2 dao4 qian4 jiu4 bu4 bi4 le5
cues.en: saying that if he'd only come to apologize, there was no need.

cues.zh: 别把他们当软柿子捏
cues.pinyin: bie2 ba3 ta1 men5 dang1 ruan3 shi4 zi5 nie1
cues.en: Don't treat them like pushovers, he said.

cues.zh: 文星急了说
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 ji2 le5 shuo1
cues.en: Munsung got anxious and said

cues.zh: 朴代表是他客人
cues.pinyin: pu3 dai4 biao3 shi4 ta1 ke4 ren2
cues.en: Representative Park was his guest.

cues.zh: 善于骗了文星眼
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu2 pian4 le5 wen2 xing1 yan3
cues.en: Seon-woo glared at Munsung —

cues.zh: 这换作别人早就躺下了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 huan4 zuo4 bie2 ren2 zao3 jiu4 tang3 xia4 le5
cues.en: anyone else would already have been knocked flat.

cues.zh: 文星气得脸色铁青
cues.pinyin: wen2 xing1 qi4 de2 lian3 se4 tie3 qing1
cues.en: Munsung was so furious his face turned livid,

cues.zh: 说善宇会后悔
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shan4 yu3 hui4 hou4 hui3
cues.en: saying Seon-woo would regret this.

cues.zh: 善宇没理他起身就走了
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 mei2 li3 ta1 qi3 shen1 jiu4 zou3 le5
cues.en: Seon-woo ignored him and got up and left.

cues.zh: 西秀从音乐室出来在走廊等车
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 cong2 yin1 yue4 shi4 chu1 lai2 zai4 zou3 lang2 deng3 che1
cues.en: Seo-soo came out of the music room and waited in the hallway for a car.

cues.zh: 善于大哈见干过来
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu2 da4 ha1 jian4 gan4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Seon-woo looked up and saw her coming.

cues.zh: 看见西秀旁边站着昨晚送他回来的男人
cues.pinyin: kan4 jian4 xi1 xiu4 pang2 bian1 zhan4 zhe5 zuo2 wan3 song4 ta1 hui2 lai2 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: He saw standing beside her the man who had driven her home the night before.

cues.zh: 男人和西秀打招呼
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 he2 xi1 xiu4 da3 zhao1 hu1
cues.en: The man greeted Seo-soo.

cues.zh: 善宇没停留
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 mei2 ting2 liu2
cues.en: Seon-woo didn't stop,

cues.zh: 转身悄悄跟在男人车后
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 shen1 qiao1 qiao1 gen1 zai4 nan2 ren2 che1 hou4
cues.en: but turned and quietly followed behind the man's car,

cues.zh: 看着他送西秀回别墅
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 ta1 song4 xi1 xiu4 hui2 bie2 shu4
cues.en: watching him take Seo-soo back to the villa.

cues.zh: 西秀看着男人的车开远才进屋
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 kan4 zhe5 nan2 ren2 de5 che1 kai1 yuan3 cai2 jin4 wu1
cues.en: Seo-soo watched the man's car drive off into the distance before going inside.

cues.zh: 善宇坐在车里盯着别墅亮着的窗户
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 zuo4 zai4 che1 li3 ding1 zhe5 bie2 shu4 liang4 zhe5 de5 chuang1 hu4
cues.en: Seon-woo sat in his car staring at the villa's lit window,

cues.zh: 心里像堵了块石头
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 xiang4 du3 le5 kuai4 shi2 tou5
cues.en: feeling as if a stone were lodged in his chest.

cues.zh: 善宇看着男人的车开远才准备离开
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 kan4 zhe5 nan2 ren2 de5 che1 kai1 yuan3 cai2 zhun3 bei4 li2 kai1
cues.en: Seon-woo watched the man's car drive off before preparing to leave.

cues.zh: 楼上的西秀隔着窗户看在眼里
cues.pinyin: lou2 shang4 de5 xi1 xiu4 ge2 zhe5 chuang1 hu4 kan4 zai4 yan3 li3
cues.en: Upstairs, Seo-soo watched it all through the window.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 又壹部嘎嘎生猛的韩国黑帮电影，上映首周夺得韩国票房冠军，拿奖拿到手软，被众多网友评为“最真实的生活”

cues.zh: 他搬来凳子坐下说给他们一次机会
cues.pinyin: ta1 ban1 lai2 deng4 zi5 zuo4 xia4 shuo1 gei3 ta1 men5 yi1 ci4 ji1 hui4
cues.en: He pulled over a stool, sat down, and said he'd give them one chance.

cues.zh: 让两人永远别见面
cues.pinyin: rang4 liang3 ren2 yong3 yuan3 bie2 jian4 mian4
cues.en: Told the two of them to never see each other again

cues.zh: 忘了当晚的事
cues.pinyin: wang4 liao3 dang4 wan3 de5 shi4
cues.en: and forget about what happened tonight.

cues.zh: 让男人赶紧穿衣服滚
cues.pinyin: rang4 nan2 ren2 gan3 jin3 chuan1 yi1 fu2 gun3
cues.en: He told the man to get dressed quickly and get out.

cues.zh: 男人爬起来就跑
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 pa2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 pao3
cues.en: The man scrambled up and ran.

cues.zh: 西秀气冲冲的走到街上
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 qi4 chong1 chong1 de5 zou3 dao4 jie1 shang4
cues.en: Seo-soo stormed angrily out onto the street.

cues.zh: 善宇抓住她
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 zhua1 zhu4 ta1
cues.en: Seon-woo grabbed her

cues.zh: 让她别瞎折腾
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 bie2 xia1 zhe1 teng5
cues.en: and told her not to act recklessly.

cues.zh: 西秀甩开他说
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiu4 shuai3 kai1 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: Seo-soo shook him off and said

cues.zh: 没人能说忘就忘
cues.pinyin: mei2 ren2 neng2 shuo1 wang4 jiu4 wang4
cues.en: no one can just forget something on command.

cues.zh: 善宇说这是最好的办法
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: Seon-woo said this was the best way,

cues.zh: 却被西秀打断
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 xi1 xiu4 da3 duan4
cues.en: but Seo-soo cut him off,

cues.zh: 让他走
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zou3
cues.en: telling him to leave.

cues.zh: 说自己会照做
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zi4 ji3 hui4 zhao4 zuo4
cues.en: She said she would do as he asked.

cues.zh: 善宇还想拉她
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 hai2 xiang3 la1 ta1
cues.en: Seon-woo tried to pull her back,

cues.zh: 被她甩开
cues.pinyin: bei4 ta1 shuai3 kai1
cues.en: but she shook him off

cues.zh: 头也不回的走了
cues.pinyin: tou2 ye3 bu4 hui2 de5 zou3 le5
cues.en: and walked away without looking back.

cues.zh: 善宇憋着气开车回家
cues.pinyin: shan4 yu3 bie1 zhe5 qi4 kai1 che1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Seon-woo drove home choking back his anger.

cues.zh: 半路遇到路怒
cues.pinyin: ban4 lu4 yu4 dao4 lu4 nu4
cues.en: Halfway there he ran into some road rage —

cues.zh: 有人故意别车
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 gu4 yi4 bie2 che1
cues.en: someone deliberately cut in front of his car.

cues.zh: 直接别停对方
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 bie2 ting2 dui4 fang1
cues.en: He swerved and forced the other car to a stop.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超辣豆腐蒸鱼 |简单快速食谱|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 今天跟大家分享的是辣的豆腐蒸鱼
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 la4 de5 dou4 fu3 zheng1 yu2
cues.en: Today I'm sharing spicy tofu steamed fish with you.

cues.zh: 首先我们来做酱汁我们会需要四瓣蒜
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 jiang4 zhi1 wo3 men5 hui4 xu1 yao4 si4 ban4 suan4
cues.en: First let's make the sauce — we'll need four cloves of garlic

cues.zh: 五片姜两根葱
cues.pinyin: wu3 pian4 jiang1 liang3 gen1 cong1
cues.en: five slices of ginger, two scallions

cues.zh: 四分之一杯酱油
cues.pinyin: si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 bei1 jiang4 you2
cues.en: a quarter cup of soy sauce

cues.zh: 在这里我们有三块嫩豆腐
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 men5 you3 san1 kuai4 nen4 dou4 fu3
cues.en: Here we have three blocks of soft tofu

cues.zh: 然后在每一个嫩豆腐上面我们放一片鱼
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 mei3 yi2 ge4 nen4 dou4 fu3 shang4 mian4 wo3 men5 fang4 yi1 pian4 yu2
cues.en: Then on top of each piece of soft tofu we put a piece of fish

cues.zh: 再放一汤匙红剁椒半汤匙姜
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 yi1 tang1 chi2 hong2 duo4 jiao1 ban4 tang1 chi2 jiang1
cues.en: Then add a tablespoon of chopped red chili and half a tablespoon of ginger

cues.zh: 接下来在我们的蒸锅里放进来水
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 zheng1 guo1 li3 fang4 jin4 lai2 shui3
cues.en: Next, pour water into our steamer

cues.zh: 然后给它加热
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 jia1 re4
cues.en: Then heat it up

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超辣豆腐蒸鱼 |简单快速食谱|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 一直煮到开了之后
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 zhu3 dao4 kai1 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it comes to a boil

cues.zh: 把我们的这个盘子放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 men5 de5 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: put our plate in

cues.zh: 给它蒸五分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zheng1 wu3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Steam it for five minutes

cues.zh: 一直蒸到全熟
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 zheng1 dao4 quan2 shu2
cues.en: Keep steaming until fully cooked

cues.zh: 那现在因为很烫
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 yin1 wei4 hen3 tang4
cues.en: Now, since it's very hot

cues.zh: 所以要小心
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 xiao3 xin1
cues.en: so be careful

cues.zh: 把它拿出来之后呢
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After taking it out

cues.zh: 去掉盘中的水
cues.pinyin: qu4 diao4 pan2 zhong1 de5 shui3
cues.en: pour out the water on the plate

cues.zh: 在鱼上面再放一汤匙葱花
cues.pinyin: zai4 yu2 shang4 mian4 zai4 fang4 yi1 tang1 chi2 cong1 hua1
cues.en: On top of the fish, add another tablespoon of chopped scallion

cues.zh: 一汤匙蒜末
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 suan4 mo4
cues.en: a tablespoon of minced garlic

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: a pinch of white pepper

cues.zh: 少许芝麻油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 zhi1 ma2 you2
cues.en: a pinch of sesame oil

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超辣豆腐蒸鱼 |简单快速食谱|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 最后把刚刚做好的这个酱汁撒
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ba3 gang1 gang1 zuo4 hao3 de5 zhe4 ge5 jiang4 zhi1 sa1
cues.en: Finally, drizzle on the sauce we just made

cues.zh: 在盘子的周围
cues.pinyin: zai4 pan2 zi5 de5 zhou1 wei2
cues.en: around the plate

cues.zh: 豆腐就像是一张白纸一样
cues.pinyin: dou4 fu3 jiu4 xiang4 shi4 yi1 zhang1 bai2 zhi3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Tofu is like a blank sheet of paper

cues.zh: 你放进去任何味道呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 fang4 jin4 qu4 ren4 he2 wei4 dao4 ne5
cues.en: whatever flavor you add to it

cues.zh: 它都会体现出来像一张画一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 du1 hui4 ti3 xian4 chu1 lai2 xiang4 yi1 zhang1 hua4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: it will show through, like a painting

cues.zh: 一幅画
cues.pinyin: yi1 fu2 hua4
cues.en: a painting

cues.zh: 那我们今天的这幅画呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 zhe4 fu2 hua4 ne5
cues.en: So this painting of ours today

cues.zh: 这道菜呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 cai4 ne5
cues.en: this dish

cues.zh: 它是辣的鲜的香的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 la4 de5 xian1 de5 xiang1 de5
cues.en: it's spicy, savory, and fragrant

cues.zh: 非常的好吃
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 de5 hao3 chi1
cues.en: absolutely delicious

cues.zh: 希望你会喜欢
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ni3 hui4 xi3 huan1
cues.en: I hope you'll like it

cues.zh: 那也别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: na4 ye3 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: And don't forget to subscribe and like

cues.zh: 我们下期见了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 le5
cues.en: See you next time

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 这个女人太绝了坐着婚车来到医院
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nv3 ren2 tai4 jue2 le5 zuo4 zhe5 hun1 che1 lai2 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: This woman is amazing — she arrived at the hospital in her wedding car.

cues.zh: 鲜血染红了她的婚纱
cues.pinyin: xian1 xue4 ran3 hong2 le5 ta1 de5 hun1 sha1
cues.en: Blood had stained her wedding dress red.

cues.zh: 婚礼当天就要被推上手术台
cues.pinyin: hun1 li3 dang4 tian1 jiu4 yao4 bei4 tui1 shang4 shou3 shu4 tai2
cues.en: On her wedding day, she was wheeled straight into the operating room.

cues.zh: 病床上这个女人名叫苏珊
cues.pinyin: bing4 chuang2 shang4 zhe4 ge5 nv3 ren2 ming2 jiao4 su1 shan1
cues.en: The woman on the hospital bed is named Susan.

cues.zh: 今天是她结婚的日子
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 ta1 jie2 hun1 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: Today is her wedding day.

cues.zh: 婚礼上她突然血泵肚痛不止
cues.pinyin: hun1 li3 shang4 ta1 tu1 ran2 xue4 beng4 du4 tong4 bu4 zhi3
cues.en: At the wedding, she suddenly had non-stop abdominal pain.

cues.zh: 萧恩给她做了检查
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gei3 ta1 zuo4 le5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Shaun examined her.

cues.zh: 发现她子宫上长了纤维瘤
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 zi5 gong1 shang4 zhang3 le5 xian1 wei2 liu2
cues.en: He found a fibroid growing on her uterus.

cues.zh: 不过没什么大碍只要切除就好了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 mei2 shen2 me5 da4 ai4 zhi3 yao4 qie1 chu2 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: But it wasn't serious — it just needed to be removed.

cues.zh: 苏珊不担心手术只是担心会不会影响生育
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 bu4 dan1 xin1 shou3 shu4 zhi3 shi4 dan1 xin1 hui4 bu2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 sheng1 yu4
cues.en: Susan wasn't worried about the surgery, only whether it would affect her fertility.

cues.zh: 可她的问题还没说出口
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 de5 wen4 ti2 hai2 mei2 shuo1 chu1 kou3
cues.en: But before she could even ask her question,

cues.zh: 萧恩就已经抢答了放心吧姑娘
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 jiu4 yi3 jing1 qiang3 da2 le5 fang4 xin1 ba5 gu1 niang2
cues.en: Shaun had already jumped in: 'Don't worry, girl.'

cues.zh: 不影响你造娃
cues.pinyin: bu4 ying3 xiang3 ni3 zao4 wa2
cues.en: It won't affect your ability to have kids.

cues.zh: 苏珊这才放了心
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 zhe4 cai2 fang4 le5 xin1
cues.en: Only then did Susan feel relieved.

cues.zh: 很快苏珊被推上手术台
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 su1 shan1 bei4 tui1 shang4 shou3 shu4 tai2
cues.en: Soon, Susan was wheeled into surgery.

cues.zh: 她的腹腔被打开
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fu4 qiang1 bei4 da3 kai1
cues.en: Her abdomen was opened up.

cues.zh: 用牵开器固定将宽韧带露出
cues.pinyin: yong4 qian1 kai1 qi4 gu4 ding4 jiang1 kuan1 ren4 dai4 lu4 chu1
cues.en: A retractor was used to hold things in place and expose the broad ligament.

cues.zh: 所谓宽韧带位于子宫两侧
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 kuan1 ren4 dai4 wei4 yu2 zi5 gong1 liang3 ce4
cues.en: The so-called broad ligament is located on both sides of the uterus.

cues.zh: 对子宫具有保护作用
cues.pinyin: dui4 zi5 gong1 ju4 you3 bao3 hu4 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: It serves to protect the uterus.

cues.zh: 将宽韧带露出
cues.pinyin: jiang1 kuan1 ren4 dai4 lu4 chu1
cues.en: exposing the broad ligament,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 更方便观察肿瘤是否扩散
cues.pinyin: geng4 fang1 bian4 guan1 cha2 zhong3 liu2 shi4 fou3 kuo4 san4
cues.en: making it easier to see whether the tumor had spread.

cues.zh: 本以为就是一个简单的纤维瘤
cues.pinyin: ben3 yi3 wei2 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 jian3 dan1 de5 xian1 wei2 liu2
cues.en: They thought it was just a simple fibroid,

cues.zh: 萧恩却在子宫上面的直肠上发现了病变
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 que4 zai4 zi5 gong1 shang4 mian4 de5 zhi2 chang2 shang4 fa1 xian4 le5 bing4 bian4
cues.en: but Shaun discovered a lesion on the rectum above the uterus.

cues.zh: 也就是说苏珊得了癌症
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 su1 shan1 de2 le5 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: Which meant Susan had cancer.

cues.zh: 肿瘤只是其中的一部分
cues.pinyin: zhong3 liu2 zhi3 shi4 qi2 zhong1 de5 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: The tumor was only part of it.

cues.zh: 根据现在的情况来看
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 xian4 zai4 de5 qing2 kuang4 lai2 kan4
cues.en: Based on the current situation,

cues.zh: 癌细胞已经扩散到各个器官
cues.pinyin: ai2 xi4 bao1 yi3 jing1 kuo4 san4 dao4 ge4 ge4 qi4 guan1
cues.en: the cancer cells had already spread to various organs.

cues.zh: 已经到了无法挽回的地步
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 dao4 le5 wu2 fa3 wan3 hui2 de5 di4 bu4
cues.en: It had reached a point beyond saving.

cues.zh: 于是主刀梅哥让萧恩进行缝合
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhu3 dao1 mei2 ge1 rang4 xiao1 en1 jin4 xing2 feng2 he2
cues.en: So the lead surgeon, Melendez, had Shaun close her up.

cues.zh: 回到办公室后
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 ban4 gong1 shi4 hou4
cues.en: After returning to the office,

cues.zh: 梅哥说了自己的看法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ge1 shuo1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 kan4 fa3
cues.en: Melendez shared his view.

cues.zh: 苏珊已经没救了
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 yi3 jing1 mei2 jiu4 le5
cues.en: Susan couldn't be saved.

cues.zh: 癌细胞已经扩散到一线
cues.pinyin: ai2 xi4 bao1 yi3 jing1 kuo4 san4 dao4 yi1 xian4
cues.en: The cancer cells had already spread everywhere.

cues.zh: 还有很多地方他们观察不到
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 di4 fang1 ta1 men5 guan1 cha2 bu2 dao4
cues.en: There were many places they couldn't observe.

cues.zh: 但不排除那里没有癌细胞的可能
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 pai2 chu2 na4 li3 mei2 you3 ai2 xi4 bao1 de5 ke3 neng2
cues.en: But they couldn't rule out cancer being there too.

cues.zh: 化疗的话希望也不大
cues.pinyin: hua4 liao2 de5 hua4 xi1 wang4 ye3 bu4 da4
cues.en: Chemotherapy wouldn't offer much hope either.

cues.zh: 但萧恩觉得还是要试一下
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 jue2 de5 hai2 shi4 yao4 shi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: But Shaun felt they should still try.

cues.zh: 说不定能找到别的角度
cues.pinyin: shuo1 bu4 ding4 neng2 zhao3 dao4 bie2 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: Maybe they could find another approach

cues.zh: 挽救病人的生命
cues.pinyin: wan3 jiu4 bing4 ren2 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: to save the patient's life.

cues.zh: 但梅哥觉得没必要
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 ge1 jue2 de5 mei2 bi4 yao4
cues.en: But Melendez thought it wasn't necessary.

cues.zh: 现在他需要萧恩做的就是
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 xu1 yao4 xiao1 en1 zuo4 de5 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: What he needed Shaun to do now was

cues.zh: 告诉苏珊她得了癌症
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 su1 shan1 ta1 de2 le5 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: tell Susan that she had cancer,

cues.zh: 快要凉了
cues.pinyin: kuai4 yao4 liang2 le5
cues.en: and that she was about to die.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 因为即使活下来
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ji2 shi3 huo2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Because even if she survived,

cues.zh: 她依然会是男友的累赘
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 ran2 hui4 shi4 nan2 you3 de5 lei2 zhui4
cues.en: she'd still be a burden to her boyfriend.

cues.zh: 但苏珊的男友不这么想
cues.pinyin: dan4 su1 shan1 de5 nan2 you3 bu4 zhe4 me5 xiang3
cues.en: But Susan's boyfriend didn't see it that way.

cues.zh: 两人上午的婚礼还历历在目
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 shang4 wu3 de5 hun1 li3 hai2 li4 li4 zai4 mu4
cues.en: Their wedding that morning was still vivid in his mind.

cues.zh: 婚礼誓词说道
cues.pinyin: hun1 li3 shi4 ci2 shuo1 dao4
cues.en: The wedding vows had said:

cues.zh: 无论痛苦还是疾病
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 tong4 ku3 hai2 shi4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: through pain or illness,

cues.zh: 两人都要在一起
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 dou1 yao4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: the two of them would stay together.

cues.zh: 她是无论如何都不会放弃苏珊的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 wu2 lun4 ru2 he2 dou1 bu2 hui4 fang4 qi4 su1 shan1 de5
cues.en: He would never give up on Susan, no matter what.

cues.zh: 苏珊被打动了
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 bei4 da3 dong4 le5
cues.en: Susan was moved.

cues.zh: 于是她决定要试一下
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jue2 ding4 yao4 shi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: So she decided to give it a try.

cues.zh: 就这样她被推进了手术室
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 yang4 ta1 bei4 tui1 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: And so she was wheeled into the operating room again.

cues.zh: 苏珊的腹腔再次被打开
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 de5 fu4 qiang1 zai4 ci4 bei4 da3 kai1
cues.en: Susan's abdomen was opened up once more.

cues.zh: 不过这次的面积更大些
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 ci4 de5 mian4 ji1 geng4 da4 xie1
cues.en: But this time the incision was larger.

cues.zh: 将病变器官全部摘出
cues.pinyin: jiang1 bing4 bian4 qi4 guan1 quan2 bu4 zhai1 chu1
cues.en: All the diseased organs were removed

cues.zh: 并逐一清理
cues.pinyin: bing4 zhu2 yi1 qing1 li3
cues.en: and cleaned out one by one.

cues.zh: 最后到了小肠
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 dao4 le5 xiao3 chang2
cues.en: Finally, they got to the small intestine,

cues.zh: 也是病变最严重的部位
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 bing4 bian4 zui4 yan2 zhong4 de5 bu4 wei4
cues.en: which was also the most severely affected area.

cues.zh: 小肠的颜色发暗需要大面积切除
cues.pinyin: xiao3 chang2 de5 yan2 se4 fa1 an4 xu1 yao4 da4 mian4 ji1 qie1 chu2
cues.en: The small intestine had darkened and needed a large section removed.

cues.zh: 但这也意味着
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ye3 yi4 wei4 zhe5
cues.en: But this also meant

cues.zh: 苏珊的消化功能大大减弱
cues.pinyin: su1 shan1 de5 xiao1 hua4 gong1 neng2 da4 da4 jian3 ruo4
cues.en: Susan's digestive function would be greatly weakened.

cues.zh: 手术进行得很顺利
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jin4 xing2 de2 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: The surgery went smoothly.

cues.zh: 术后的苏珊很虚弱
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 de5 su1 shan1 hen3 xu1 ruo4
cues.en: After the surgery, Susan was very weak.

cues.zh: 除此之外
cues.pinyin: chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: On top of that,

cues.zh: 她身上还多了一个引流带
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen1 shang4 hai2 duo1 le5 yi2 ge4 yin3 liu2 dai4
cues.en: she now had a drainage tube attached,

cues.zh: 因为她的小肠大部分切除
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 xiao3 chang2 da4 bu4 fen4 qie1 chu2
cues.en: because most of her small intestine had been removed.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 于是拿出了精心准备的小抄
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 na2 chu1 le5 jing1 xin1 zhun3 bei4 de5 xiao3 chao1
cues.en: So he took out a cheat sheet he'd carefully prepared.

cues.zh: 是的
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5
cues.en: Yes,

cues.zh: 你没有听错
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 you3 ting1 cuo4
cues.en: you heard that right.

cues.zh: 聊天还要找脚本
cues.pinyin: liao2 tian1 hai2 yao4 zhao3 jiao3 ben3
cues.en: He needs a script just to make conversation.

cues.zh: 也是头一次听说
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 tou2 yi1 ci4 ting1 shuo1
cues.en: That's a first.

cues.zh: 萧恩单身这么久
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 dan1 shen1 zhe4 me5 jiu3
cues.en: No wonder Shaun's been single so long —

cues.zh: 看来是有原因的
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 shi4 you3 yuan2 yin1 de5
cues.en: turns out there's a reason.

cues.zh: 话音刚落
cues.pinyin: hua4 yin1 gang1 luo4
cues.en: No sooner had that been said

cues.zh: 正餐上来了
cues.pinyin: zheng4 can1 shang4 lai2 le5
cues.en: than the main course arrived.

cues.zh: 一向讨厌酸黄瓜的她
cues.pinyin: yi2 xiang4 tao3 yan4 suan1 huang2 gua1 de5 ta1
cues.en: She, who normally hates pickles,

cues.zh: 看到盘子里的酸黄瓜直接抱走了
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 pan2 zi5 li3 de5 suan1 huang2 gua1 zhi2 jie1 bao4 zou3 le5
cues.en: saw the pickle on her plate and just grabbed it for herself,

cues.zh: 还险些打翻了红酒
cues.pinyin: hai2 xian3 xie1 da3 fan1 le5 hong2 jiu3
cues.en: and nearly knocked over the red wine.

cues.zh: 不过还好他眼疾手快接到了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hai2 hao3 ta1 yan3 ji2 shou3 kuai4 jie1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Luckily, he reacted quickly and caught it.

cues.zh: 也算是逃过一劫
cues.pinyin: ye3 suan4 shi4 tao2 guo4 yi1 jie2
cues.en: A disaster narrowly avoided.

cues.zh: 酒过三逊
cues.pinyin: jiu3 guo4 san1 xun4
cues.en: After a few rounds of drinks,

cues.zh: 美女正对他说着什么
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 zheng4 dui4 ta1 shuo1 zhe5 shen2 me5
cues.en: the woman was saying something to him

cues.zh: 他却突然跟人家讲起了冷笑话
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 tu1 ran2 gen1 ren2 jia1 jiang3 qi3 le5 leng3 xiao4 hua4
cues.en: when he suddenly launched into a corny joke.

cues.zh: 美女尴尬的笑了
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 gan1 ga4 de5 xiao4 le5
cues.en: She laughed awkwardly.

cues.zh: 萧恩却不满意了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 que4 bu4 man3 yi4 le5
cues.en: But Shaun wasn't satisfied.

cues.zh: 我翻了六本笑话书
cues.pinyin: wo3 fan1 le5 liu4 ben3 xiao4 hua4 shu1
cues.en: "I went through six joke books

cues.zh: 才找出这么一个好笑的
cues.pinyin: cai2 zhao3 chu1 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 hao3 xiao4 de5
cues.en: just to find one this funny,

cues.zh: 你居然跟我呵呵
cues.pinyin: ni3 ju1 ran2 gen1 wo3 he1 he1
cues.en: and you just go 'heh' at me?"

cues.zh: 面对美女尴尬的反应
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 mei3 nv3 gan1 ga4 de5 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Faced with her awkward reaction,

cues.zh: 萧恩当机立断
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 dang1 ji1 li4 duan4
cues.en: Shaun made a snap decision:

cues.zh: 这饭不吃了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fan4 bu4 chi1 le5
cues.en: forget dinner.

cues.zh: 直接把美女从座位上拉起来
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 ba3 mei3 nv3 cong2 zuo4 wei4 shang4 la1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: He pulled her straight up from her seat

cues.zh: 向门口走去
cues.pinyin: xiang4 men2 kou3 zou3 qu4
cues.en: and headed for the door.

cues.zh: 由于太生气
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 tai4 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: Because he was so upset,

cues.zh: 他还将一个妇人撞到
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 jiang1 yi2 ge4 fu4 ren2 zhuang4 dao4
cues.en: he even bumped into a woman,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 不幸的是妇人胳膊脱臼了
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing4 de5 shi4 fu4 ren2 ge1 bo2 tuo1 jiu4 le5
cues.en: and unfortunately, the woman's arm got dislocated.

cues.zh: 不过没关系
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: But that was fine —

cues.zh: 谁让萧恩是个平平无奇的一颗小天才呢
cues.pinyin: shui2 rang4 xiao1 en1 shi4 ge4 ping2 ping2 wu2 qi2 de5 yi1 ke1 xiao3 tian1 cai2 ne5
cues.en: after all, Shaun's just your average, run-of-the-mill genius.

cues.zh: 三下两下就治好了妇女的脱臼
cues.pinyin: san1 xia4 liang3 xia4 jiu4 zhi4 hao3 le5 fu4 nv3 de5 tuo1 jiu4
cues.en: In no time, he fixed the woman's dislocated arm,

cues.zh: 化解了尴尬
cues.pinyin: hua4 jie3 le5 gan1 ga4
cues.en: defusing the awkward situation.

cues.zh: 餐厅里也响起了掌声
cues.pinyin: can1 ting1 li3 ye3 xiang3 qi3 le5 zhang3 sheng1
cues.en: Applause broke out in the restaurant.

cues.zh: 离开餐厅
cues.pinyin: li2 kai1 can1 ting1
cues.en: Leaving the restaurant,

cues.zh: 萧恩送美女回了家
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 song4 mei3 nv3 hui2 le5 jia1
cues.en: Shaun walked her home.

cues.zh: 美女临别前还亲了她一下
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 lin2 bie2 qian2 hai2 qin1 le5 ta1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Before they parted, she even gave him a kiss.

cues.zh: 一切都是顺理成章
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 dou1 shi4 shun4 li3 cheng2 zhang1
cues.en: Everything seemed to follow naturally.

cues.zh: 但萧恩觉得这个晚上她并不快乐
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 wan3 shang4 ta1 bing4 bu4 kuai4 le4
cues.en: But Shaun felt that she hadn't been happy that night,

cues.zh: 而且很拘谨
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hen3 ju1 jin3
cues.en: and had been quite tense.

cues.zh: 这样不自在的约会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 bu4 zi4 zai4 de5 yue1 hui4
cues.en: A date this uncomfortable

cues.zh: 对她来说就是一场灾难
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 chang2 zai1 nan4
cues.en: was a disaster for her.

cues.zh: 虽然有些小题大做
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 you3 xie1 xiao3 ti2 da4 zuo4
cues.en: It might seem like overreacting,

cues.zh: 但也不无道理
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye3 bu4 wu2 dao4 li3
cues.en: but it's not without reason.

cues.zh: 跟不合适的人相处
cues.pinyin: gen1 bu4 he2 shi4 de5 ren2 xiang1 chu3
cues.en: Being with the wrong person,

cues.zh: 无论怎么样都不舒服
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 zen3 me5 yang4 dou1 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: no matter what, never feels right.

cues.zh: 两个人在一起
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: Two people being together

cues.zh: 是因为合拍
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 he2 pai1
cues.en: works because they click,

cues.zh: 而不是因为合适
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 he2 shi4
cues.en: not just because they're 'suitable.'

cues.zh: 这个病人究竟有什么特别之处
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 ren2 jiu1 jing4 you3 shen2 me5 te4 bie2 zhi1 chu4
cues.en: What exactly was so special about this patient

cues.zh: 竟让两个医生如此着迷
cues.pinyin: jing4 rang4 liang3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 ru2 ci3 zhao2 mi2
cues.en: that it had two doctors so fascinated?

cues.zh: 是个有肾结石病史的患者
cues.pinyin: shi4 ge4 you3 shen4 jie2 shi2 bing4 shi3 de5 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: He was a patient with a history of kidney stones.

cues.zh: 这几天老是感觉肾上隐隐作痛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji3 tian1 lao3 shi4 gan3 jue2 shen4 shang4 yin3 yin3 zuo4 tong4
cues.en: These past few days he'd kept feeling a dull ache in his kidney,

cues.zh: 于是来医院检查一下
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: so he came in to get checked.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】美女新婚当天被查出绝症！所有人都认为她没救了，还好有神医肖恩在，要不然就悲剧了

cues.zh: 关系大了
cues.pinyin: guan1 xi4 da4 le5
cues.en: Turns out it was a big deal.

cues.zh: 利姆生之帕克摩根肖恩克莱尔
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 sheng1 zhi1 pa4 ke4 mo2 gen1 xiao4 en1 ke4 lai2 er3
cues.en: Park, Morgan, Shaun, and Claire

cues.zh: 不再是实习生
cues.pinyin: bu4 zai4 shi4 shi2 xi2 sheng1
cues.en: were no longer interns

cues.zh: 而是住院医师
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zhu4 yuan4 yi1 shi1
cues.en: but residents now.

cues.zh: 也就是说一些基础的手术他们都可以主导
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 yi1 xie1 ji1 chu3 de5 shou3 shu4 ta1 men5 dou1 ke3 yi3 zhu3 dao3
cues.en: Meaning they could now lead some basic surgeries themselves.

cues.zh: 而刚好哈维的病例简单
cues.pinyin: er2 gang1 hao3 ha1 wei2 de5 bing4 li4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: And Harvey's case happened to be simple,

cues.zh: 如果手术的话也可以操作
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shou3 shu4 de5 hua4 ye3 ke3 yi3 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: so if surgery was needed, they could handle it.

cues.zh: 这是一个一战成名的好机会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 yi1 zhan4 cheng2 ming2 de5 hao3 ji1 hui4
cues.en: It was a great chance to make a name for themselves.

cues.zh: 摩根和帕克自然不会放过
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 he2 pa4 ke4 zi4 ran2 bu2 hui4 fang4 guo4
cues.en: Naturally, Morgan and Park weren't going to pass it up.

cues.zh: 于是刚才被互相推诿的病例变成了炙
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 gang1 cai2 bei4 hu4 xiang1 tui1 wei3 de5 bing4 li4 bian4 cheng2 le5 zhi4
cues.en: So the case they'd just been pushing off on each other suddenly became

cues.zh: 手可热的存在
cues.pinyin: shou3 ke3 re4 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: a hot commodity everyone wanted.

cues.zh: 不过在这之前
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zai4 zhe4 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: But before that,

cues.zh: 他们需要确定哈维是否进行手术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 que4 ding4 ha1 wei2 shi4 fou3 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: they needed to determine whether Harvey would need surgery.

cues.zh: 于是他们对哈维进行了影像检查
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 dui4 ha1 wei2 jin4 xing2 le5 ying3 xiang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: So they ran imaging tests on Harvey.

cues.zh: 结果显示哈维肾上确实有肿瘤
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4 ha1 wei2 shen4 shang4 que4 shi2 you3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: The results showed Harvey did have a tumor on his kidney.

cues.zh: 是孤独型癌细胞
cues.pinyin: shi4 gu1 du2 xing2 ai2 xi4 bao1
cues.en: It was a localized cancer,

cues.zh: 也就是还未扩散的癌细胞
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 hai2 wei4 kuo4 san4 de5 ai2 xi4 bao1
cues.en: meaning cancer cells that hadn't spread yet.

cues.zh: 这样的手术非常适合住院医师
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 shou3 shu4 fei1 chang2 shi4 he2 zhu4 yuan4 yi1 shi1
cues.en: This kind of surgery was perfect for residents,

cues.zh: 操作简便
cues.pinyin: cao1 zuo4 jian3 bian4
cues.en: simple to perform,

cues.zh: 手术成功率高
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 cheng2 gong1 lv4 gao1
cues.en: with a high success rate.

cues.zh: 于是两人开始了一场拉锯战
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 liang3 ren2 kai1 shi3 le5 yi1 chang2 la1 ju4 zhan4
cues.en: So the two of them began a tug-of-war.

cues.zh: 他们是从护士长那里拿到的病例
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi4 cong2 hu4 shi4 zhang3 na4 li3 na2 dao4 de5 bing4 li4
cues.en: They'd gotten the case from the head nurse,

cues.zh: 于是他们找到了护士长
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 le5 hu4 shi4 zhang3
cues.en: so they went to find the head nurse.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 干炒牛河的家庭做法 一学就会【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 哈喽你好今天呢就让我们一起做干炒牛河
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 ni3 hao3 jin1 tian1 ne5 jiu4 rang4 wo3 men5 yi4 qi3 zuo4 gan4 chao3 niu2 he2
cues.en: Hello, today let's make dry-fried beef chow fun together.

cues.zh: 那首先呢在这里我有一磅的切
cues.pinyin: na4 shou3 xian1 ne5 zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 you3 yi1 bang4 de5 qie4
cues.en: First, here I have a pound of sliced

cues.zh: 好了的牛排肉
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 de5 niu2 pai2 rou4
cues.en: steak beef that's already cut.

cues.zh: 然后我们来做腌制的酱料
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 yan1 zhi4 de5 jiang4 liao4
cues.en: Then let's make the marinade.

cues.zh: 这边有半个蛋清一汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 you3 ban4 ge4 dan4 qing1 yi1 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Here we have half an egg white and one tablespoon of soy sauce.

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒一茶匙玉米粉加上两汤匙的水
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1 yi1 cha2 chi2 yu4 mi3 fen3 jia1 shang4 liang3 tang1 chi2 de5 shui3
cues.en: A little white pepper, one teaspoon of cornstarch, plus two tablespoons of water.

cues.zh: 然后把它搅拌均匀倒进牛肉中
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2 dao4 jin4 niu2 rou4 zhong1
cues.en: Then mix it well and pour it into the beef.

cues.zh: 然后这个时候就给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: Now mix it until even.

cues.zh: 像是按摩一样这样子的感觉
cues.pinyin: xiang4 shi4 an4 mo2 yi1 yang4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Kind of like massaging it, that kind of feeling.

cues.zh: 这个时候呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: At this point,

cues.zh: 我们再放进来一汤匙的植物油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: we add in one tablespoon of vegetable oil.

cues.zh: 然后也是一样搅拌好
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4 jiao3 ban4 hao3
cues.en: Then mix it well again the same way.

cues.zh: 最后呢
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: Lastly,

cues.zh: 给它腌制 15 分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 yan1 zhi4 15 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: let it marinate for 15 minutes.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 干炒牛河的家庭做法 一学就会【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 现在我们来制作我们今天的酱料
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 lai2 zhi4 zuo4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 jiang4 liao4
cues.en: Now let's make today's sauce.

cues.zh: 首先加入两汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 jia1 ru4 liang3 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: First add two tablespoons of soy sauce.

cues.zh: 一汤匙老抽
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 lao3 chou1
cues.en: One tablespoon of dark soy sauce.

cues.zh: 一汤匙蚝油
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 hao2 you2
cues.en: One tablespoon of oyster sauce.

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: A little white pepper.

cues.zh: 和一茶匙的糖
cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 cha2 chi2 de5 tang2
cues.en: And one teaspoon of sugar.

cues.zh: 在一个平底锅里
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 ping2 di3 guo1 li3
cues.en: In a frying pan,

cues.zh: 我们加入一汤匙的植物油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia1 ru4 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: we add one tablespoon of vegetable oil.

cues.zh: 那在这里呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zai4 zhe4 li3 ne5
cues.en: Now here,

cues.zh: 我有一袋新鲜的河粉
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 yi1 dai4 xin1 xian1 de5 he2 fen3
cues.en: I have a bag of fresh rice noodles.

cues.zh: 我们把它放到锅子里
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 fang4 dao4 guo1 zi5 li3
cues.en: We put it into the pan.

cues.zh: 用高温呢
cues.pinyin: yong4 gao1 wen1 ne5
cues.en: Using high heat,

cues.zh: 给它煎到香
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 jian1 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: fry it until fragrant.

cues.zh: 大概两分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 liang3 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: For about two minutes.

cues.zh: 拿出来之后放旁边
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 fang4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: Take it out afterward and set it aside.

cues.zh: 同一个锅呢
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi1 ge4 guo1 ne5
cues.en: In the same pan,

cues.zh: 现在我们再倒进来
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 zai4 dao4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: now we pour in

cues.zh: 一汤匙的植物油
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: one tablespoon of vegetable oil.

cues.zh: 然后放进已经腌制好的牛肉
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 jin4 yi3 jing1 yan1 zhi4 hao3 de5 niu2 rou4
cues.en: Then add the beef that's already marinated.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 干炒牛河的家庭做法 一学就会【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 然后也是用高温给它煎一下
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 yong4 gao1 wen1 gei3 ta1 jian1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: And also fry it on high heat.

cues.zh: 直到七分熟
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 qi1 fen1 shu2
cues.en: Until it's about 70% cooked.

cues.zh: 拿出来之后呢
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After taking it out,

cues.zh: 也是先放旁边
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 xian1 fang4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: set it aside too for now.

cues.zh: 这个时候在我们这个美丽的平底锅中
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zai4 wo3 men5 zhe4 ge5 mei3 li4 de5 ping2 di3 guo1 zhong1
cues.en: At this point, in our beautiful frying pan,

cues.zh: 再倒进来一汤匙油
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 jin4 lai2 yi1 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: pour in another tablespoon of oil.

cues.zh: 放入四分之一的这个洋葱
cues.pinyin: fang4 ru4 si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 zhe4 ge5 yang2 cong1
cues.en: Add a quarter of this onion.

cues.zh: 然后炒到香
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 chao3 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: Stir-fry until fragrant.

cues.zh: 再加入一小把的这个葱
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 ru4 yi1 xiao3 ba3 de5 zhe4 ge5 cong1
cues.en: Then add a small handful of green onion,

cues.zh: 然后只是白的那一段
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhi3 shi4 bai2 de5 na4 yi1 duan4
cues.en: just the white part.

cues.zh: 然后也是炒到香
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 chao3 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: Stir-fry that until fragrant too.

cues.zh: 再加入一杯豆芽菜
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 ru4 yi1 bei1 dou4 ya2 cai4
cues.en: Then add a cup of bean sprouts.

cues.zh: 如果你喜欢的话也可以多放一点
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xi3 huan1 de5 hua4 ye3 ke3 yi3 duo1 fang4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: If you like, you can add a bit more.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 干炒牛河的家庭做法 一学就会【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 加入和粉和这个牛肉
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 he2 fen3 he2 zhe4 ge5 niu2 rou4
cues.en: Add the rice noodles and the beef,

cues.zh: 还有酱汁
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: and also the sauce.

cues.zh: 然后用这个高温呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 gao1 wen1 ne5
cues.en: Then using high heat,

cues.zh: 快速地炒给它
cues.pinyin: kuai4 su4 di4 chao3 gei3 ta1
