cues.zh: 搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: and mix it evenly.

cues.zh: 但是让小心
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 rang4 xiao3 xin1
cues.en: But be careful,

cues.zh: 快对快
cues.pinyin: kuai4 dui4 kuai4
cues.en: it's fast, but fast,

cues.zh: 可是不要把这面条都用断了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bu2 yao4 ba3 zhe4 mian4 tiao2 dou1 yong4 duan4 le5
cues.en: don't end up breaking all the noodles.

cues.zh: 最后呢
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: Finally,

cues.zh: 我们还加一些绿葱
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hai2 jia1 yi1 xie1 lv4 cong1
cues.en: we also add some green onion,

cues.zh: 就是绿色的那个皮粉
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 lv4 se4 de5 na4 ge5 pi2 fen3
cues.en: that is, the green part.

cues.zh: 我们今天做的这道
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zuo4 de5 zhe4 dao4
cues.en: This dish we made today,

cues.zh: 家常干炒牛盒做的
cues.pinyin: jia1 chang2 gan4 chao3 niu2 he2 zuo4 de5
cues.en: the homestyle dry-fried beef chow fun,

cues.zh: 真的是非常的美味
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 fei1 chang2 de5 mei3 wei4
cues.en: is really very delicious.

cues.zh: 你也可以看到这个面条呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 kan4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 mian4 tiao2 ne5
cues.en: You can also see that these noodles,

cues.zh: 其实摇起来是有一种
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 yao2 qi3 lai2 shi4 you3 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: when you shake them, actually have a kind of

cues.zh: Q 弹的感觉
cues.pinyin: Q dan4 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: springy, chewy feel.

cues.zh: 很平很滑的那种口感
cues.pinyin: hen3 ping2 hen3 hua2 de5 na4 zhong3 kou3 gan3
cues.en: A very smooth, slippery texture.

cues.zh: 然后牛肉又很嫩很多汁
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 niu2 rou4 you4 hen3 nen4 hen3 duo1 zhi1
cues.en: And the beef is tender and juicy.

cues.zh: 然后一起吃起来的感觉呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yi4 qi3 chi1 qi3 lai2 de5 gan3 jue2 ne5
cues.en: And when you eat it all together, the feeling is

cues.zh: 还有微微的焦香味
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wei1 wei1 de5 jiao1 xiang1 wei4
cues.en: there's also a slight charred aroma.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會

cues.zh: 真的是很美味很好吃
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 mei3 wei4 hen3 hao3 chi1
cues.en: It's really delicious, really tasty.

cues.zh: 好的那我希望你今天也喜欢这个食谱
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 na4 wo3 xi1 wang4 ni3 jin1 tian1 ye3 xi3 huan1 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3
cues.en: Okay, I hope you like this recipe too.

cues.zh: 如果你为十个广东人喜不喜欢吃甘草牛河
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 wei4 shi2 ge4 guang3 dong1 ren2 xi3 bu4 xi3 huan1 chi1 gan1 cao3 niu2 he2
cues.en: If you ask ten Cantonese people whether they like dry-fried beef chow fun,

cues.zh: 我相信九个呢都会告诉你非常的爱
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang1 xin4 jiu3 ge4 ne5 du1 hui4 gao4 su4 ni3 fei1 chang2 de5 ai4
cues.en: I believe nine of them will tell you they love it.

cues.zh: 因为它真的非常的普遍
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zhen1 de5 fei1 chang2 de5 pu3 bian4
cues.en: Because it's really very common —

cues.zh: 从这个阿嬷的餐桌上啊
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 ge5 a1 ma1 de5 can1 zhuo1 shang4 a5
cues.en: from grandma's dining table

cues.zh: 到五星级饭店
cues.pinyin: dao4 wu3 xing1 ji2 fan4 dian4

cues.zh: 到这个路边摊
cues.pinyin: dao4 zhe4 ge5 lu4 bian1 tan1
cues.en: to roadside stalls,

cues.zh: 你都吃得到了它
cues.pinyin: ni3 dou1 chi1 de2 dao4 le5 ta1

cues.zh: 那也请你留言告诉我

cues.pinyin: ni3 xi3 bu4 xi3 huan1 chi1 zhe4 dao4 gan4 chao3 niu2 he2

cues.zh: 别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: Don't forget to subscribe and like.

cues.zh: 我们下期见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 ge1
cues.en: See you next time.

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 做别人不敢做的事，不是更酷吗？

cues.zh: 一望无际对其他人来说比较荒凉
cues.pinyin: yi2 wang4 wu2 ji4 dui4 qi2 ta1 ren2 lai2 shuo1 bi3 jiao4 huang1 liang2
cues.en: For most other people, the endless horizon looks pretty desolate.

cues.zh: 但是对于我来说我就感觉我自己回家了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 yu2 wo3 lai2 shuo1 wo3 jiu4 gan3 jue2 wo3 zi4 ji3 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: But to me, it feels like I've come home.

cues.zh: 一叉会上演试一下就没停下来
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha1 hui4 shang4 yan3 shi4 yi1 xia4 jiu4 mei2 ting2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: It just clicked instantly — once I tried it, I couldn't stop.

cues.zh: 玩到任何人都会赶上朋友的地面
cues.pinyin: wan2 dao4 ren4 he2 ren2 du1 hui4 gan3 shang4 peng2 you3 de5 di4 mian4
cues.en: I played until even my friends couldn't keep up with me.

cues.zh: 在自己的家乡去挥洒这些热血
cues.pinyin: zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 jia1 xiang1 qu4 hui1 sa3 zhe4 xie1 re4 xue4
cues.en: Pouring out this passion right here in my own hometown.

cues.zh: 我用这种方式也可以证明我的梦想
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 ye3 ke3 yi3 zheng4 ming2 wo3 de5 meng4 xiang3
cues.en: This is also how I prove my dream.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 77岁的当代隐士：生命的富足来自于独处 77-year-old Contemporary Hermit: The Richness of Life Origin

cues.zh: 禅是光的诗图诗是追问的千层
cues.pinyin: chan2 shi4 guang1 de5 shi1 tu2 shi1 shi4 zhui1 wen4 de5 qian1 ceng2
cues.en: Zen is a poem of light; poetry is a thousand layers of questioning.

cues.zh: 做小床时候最深的体格我是一条禅
cues.pinyin: zuo4 xiao3 chuang2 shi2 hou4 zui4 shen1 de5 ti3 ge2 wo3 shi4 yi1 tiao2 chan2
cues.en: My deepest realization while making small works: I am a thread of Zen.

cues.zh: 他把这种生命展开的一个过程
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zhe4 zhong3 sheng1 ming4 zhan3 kai1 de5 yi2 ge4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: He takes this unfolding process of life

cues.zh: 带进艺术里面
cues.pinyin: dai4 jin4 yi4 shu4 li3 mian4
cues.en: and brings it into his art.

cues.zh: 艺术总是由一种例外形成的
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 zong3 shi4 you2 yi1 zhong3 li4 wai4 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: Art is always formed by exception.

cues.zh: 有意思的人都是一些很例外的人
cues.pinyin: you3 yi4 si5 de5 ren2 dou1 shi4 yi1 xie1 hen3 li4 wai4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Interesting people are all rather exceptional people.

cues.zh: 我一直以云
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi4 zhi2 yi3 yun2
cues.en: I have always used clouds

cues.zh: 作为我的一个自然系列
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 wo3 de5 yi2 ge4 zi4 ran2 xi4 lie4
cues.en: as one of my nature series —

cues.zh: 创作里面很重要的一个课题
cues.pinyin: chuang4 zuo4 li3 mian4 hen3 zhong4 yao4 de5 yi2 ge4 ke4 ti2
cues.en: an important theme in my creative work.

cues.zh: 这是自然的呼吸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zi4 ran2 de5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: This is the breath of nature,

cues.zh: 是生命的呼吸
cues.pinyin: shi4 sheng1 ming4 de5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: the breath of life.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 77岁的当代隐士：生命的富足来自于独处 77-year-old Contemporary Hermit: The Richness of Life Origin

cues.zh: 这个是有我这么高的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 you3 wo3 zhe4 me5 gao1 de5
cues.en: This piece is about as tall as I am.

cues.zh: 三十年和禅在一起
cues.pinyin: san1 shi2 nian2 he2 chan2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: Thirty years together with Zen,

cues.zh: 就像称禅道士四方镜一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 cheng1 chan2 dao4 shi4 si4 fang1 jing4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: like being called a Zen Taoist, mirrored on every side.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 77岁的当代隐士：生命的富足来自于独处 77-year-old Contemporary Hermit: The Richness of Life Origin

cues.zh: 魔都之子到了天台才成了仙
cues.pinyin: mo2 dou1 zhi1 zi5 dao4 le5 tian1 tai2 cai2 cheng2 le5 xian1
cues.en: A son of Shanghai who only became an immortal after reaching Tiantai.

cues.zh: 他又是一个上海人
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 shi4 yi2 ge4 shang4 hai3 ren2
cues.en: He's also a Shanghainese.

cues.zh: 天台那种隐性的文化
cues.pinyin: tian1 tai2 na4 zhong3 yin3 xing4 de5 wen2 hua4
cues.en: That hidden culture of Tiantai —

cues.zh: 幽深
cues.pinyin: you1 shen1
cues.en: deep and secluded.

cues.zh: 我当时一下子给迷住了
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 yi1 xia4 zi5 gei3 mi2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: I was instantly captivated.

cues.zh: 生命的丰富来自于独处
cues.pinyin: sheng1 ming4 de5 feng1 fu4 lai2 zi4 yu2 du2 chu3
cues.en: The richness of life comes from solitude.

cues.zh: 独处意味著当下
cues.pinyin: du2 chu3 yi4 wei4 zhu4 dang1 xia4
cues.en: Solitude means living in the present moment.

cues.zh: 整个天台山可能都是他的工作室
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 tian1 tai2 shan1 ke3 neng2 dou1 shi4 ta1 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4
cues.en: The whole of Mount Tiantai might as well be his studio.

cues.zh: 二十世纪以后的人类可能面对的
cues.pinyin: er4 shi2 shi4 ji4 yi3 hou4 de5 ren2 lei4 ke3 neng2 mian4 dui4 de5
cues.en: What humanity may face after the 20th century

cues.zh: 都是对自身状
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 dui4 zi4 shen1 zhuang4
cues.en: is all a kind of confusion

cues.zh: 态的一种迷茫
cues.pinyin: tai4 de5 yi1 zhong3 mi2 mang2
cues.en: about its own state.

cues.zh: 于是我们因为这种迷茫会产生一些追问
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 men5 yin1 wei4 zhe4 zhong3 mi2 mang2 hui4 chan3 sheng1 yi1 xie1 zhui1 wen4
cues.en: So this confusion leads us to raise certain questions.

cues.zh: 但梁老师不是因为迷茫
cues.pinyin: dan4 liang2 lao3 shi1 bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 mi2 mang2
cues.en: But Teacher Liang doesn't question out of confusion.

cues.zh: 梁老师是因为笃定和好奇而追问
cues.pinyin: liang2 lao3 shi1 shi4 yin1 wei4 du3 ding4 he2 hao3 qi2 er2 zhui1 wen4
cues.en: Teacher Liang questions out of certainty and curiosity.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 77岁的当代隐士：生命的富足来自于独处 77-year-old Contemporary Hermit: The Richness of Life Origin

cues.zh: 我们知道他的这个数位生存其
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 shu4 wei4 sheng1 cun2 qi2
cues.en: We know that this digital existence of his

cues.zh: 实很难很难的
cues.pinyin: shi2 hen3 nan2 hen3 nan2 de5
cues.en: is actually very, very hard.

cues.zh: 其实产生命很短的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 chan3 sheng1 ming4 hen3 duan3 de5
cues.en: Actually, life is very short,

cues.zh: 但是作品可以保存上千年
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zuo4 pin3 ke3 yi3 bao3 cun2 shang4 qian1 nian2
cues.en: but a work of art can last a thousand years.

cues.zh: 人来到世上就是留下了那么一点蛛丝马迹
cues.pinyin: ren2 lai2 dao4 shi4 shang4 jiu4 shi4 liu2 xia4 le5 na4 me5 yi4 dian3 zhu1 si1 ma3 ji4
cues.en: A person comes into this world only to leave behind a few faint traces.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分7.8分，游轮上的富婆化身时间管理大师，2025重温经典下饭美剧。

cues.zh: 百年黑奴沉船惊献粉毛鬼头
cues.pinyin: bai3 nian2 hei1 nu2 chen2 chuan2 jing1 xian4 fen3 mao2 gui3 tou2
cues.en: A century-old sunken slave ship shockingly reveals a pink-furred 'ghost head'

cues.zh: 专家狂喊外星寄生
cues.pinyin: zhuan1 jia1 kuang2 han3 wai4 xing1 ji4 sheng1
cues.en: Experts frantically shout 'alien parasite!'

cues.zh: 这具本该与黑奴沉船同碎的尸骨
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ju4 ben3 gai1 yu3 hei1 nu2 chen2 chuan2 tong2 sui4 de5 shi1 gu3
cues.en: This corpse, which should have been destroyed along with the slave ship,

cues.zh: 为何会带着属于当代的致命伤痕
cues.pinyin: wei4 he2 hui4 dai4 zhe5 shu3 yu2 dang1 dai4 de5 zhi4 ming4 shang1 hen2
cues.en: why does it carry a fatal wound that belongs to modern times?

cues.zh: 清晨急促敲门声如鼓点
cues.pinyin: qing1 chen2 ji2 cu4 qiao1 men2 sheng1 ru2 gu3 dian3
cues.en: An urgent knock at dawn sounds like drumbeats,

cues.zh: 吵醒熟睡的警员老顾
cues.pinyin: chao3 xing3 shu2 shui4 de5 jing3 yuan2 lao3 gu4
cues.en: waking Officer Lao Gu from a deep sleep.

cues.zh: 他挣扎起身关节发出的咔嚓声
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng1 zha2 qi3 shen1 guan1 jie2 fa1 chu1 de5 ka1 cha1 sheng1
cues.en: He struggles up, joints cracking,

cues.zh: 憨比老旧木门
cues.pinyin: han1 bi3 lao3 jiu4 mu4 men2
cues.en: rivaling the creak of the old wooden door.

cues.zh: 法医小谷催他赶紧找心理学家小甜
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 cui1 ta1 gan3 jin3 zhao3 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2
cues.en: Forensic examiner Xiao Gu urges him to hurry and find psychologist Xiao Tian.

cues.zh: 甜先提点报告
cues.pinyin: tian2 xian1 ti2 dian3 bao4 gao4
cues.en: Tian gives her briefing on the report first.

cues.zh: 老顾嘀咕着夜生活不节制的烦恼
cues.pinyin: lao3 gu4 di2 gu1 zhe5 ye4 sheng1 huo2 bu4 jie2 zhi4 de5 fan2 nao3
cues.en: Lao Gu grumbles about troubles from an undisciplined nightlife,

cues.zh: 却被小谷队分明是到了炮枸杞的年纪
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 xiao3 gu3 dui4 fen1 ming2 shi4 dao4 le5 pao4 gou3 qi3 de5 nian2 ji4
cues.en: but Xiao Gu teases that he's clearly at the 'goji berry tea' age (i.e. getting old).

cues.zh: 然而推开小甜甜办公室门的瞬间
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 tui1 kai1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 ban4 gong1 shi4 men2 de5 shun4 jian1
cues.en: But the moment he pushes open Xiao Tiantian's office door,

cues.zh: 只见对方正和实习生朱莉滚在一起
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 dui4 fang1 zheng4 he2 shi2 xi2 sheng1 zhu1 li4 gun3 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: he finds her tangled up with intern Zhuli.

cues.zh: 画面过于刺激
cues.pinyin: hua4 mian4 guo4 yu2 ci4 ji1
cues.en: The scene is way too much.

cues.zh: 老顾替大家扛下这波视觉暴击
cues.pinyin: lao3 gu4 ti4 da4 jia1 kang2 xia4 zhe4 bo1 shi4 jue2 bao4 ji1
cues.en: Lao Gu takes the visual hit for everyone.

cues.zh: 小甜甜脸红得像煮熟的龙虾
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 lian3 hong2 de2 xiang4 zhu3 shu2 de5 long2 xia1
cues.en: Xiao Tiantian blushes as red as a boiled lobster.

cues.zh: 仙子动作快如闪电
cues.pinyin: xian1 zi5 dong4 zuo4 kuai4 ru2 shan3 dian4
cues.en: The fairy-like girl moves as fast as lightning.

cues.zh: 而步谷组合陶冶式的离开着干大现场
cues.pinyin: er2 bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 tao2 ye3 shi4 de5 li2 kai1 zhe5 gan4 da4 xian4 chang3
cues.en: The Bu-Gu duo quietly slip away from the scene.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分7.8分，游轮上的富婆化身时间管理大师，2025重温经典下饭美剧。

cues.zh: 船上的 20 多具黑奴遗骸堪称贝壳开甲大户
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shang4 de5 20 duo1 ju4 hei1 nu2 yi2 hai2 kan1 cheng1 bei4 ke2 kai1 jia3 da4 hu4
cues.en: The 20-plus slave remains on the ship are basically a shellfish colonization hotspot.

cues.zh: 150 年的时光里
cues.pinyin: 150 nian2 de5 shi2 guang1 li3
cues.en: Over 150 years,

cues.zh: 活变成一堆会呼吸的海洋化石盲盒
cues.pinyin: huo2 bian4 cheng2 yi1 dui1 hui4 hu1 xi1 de5 hai3 yang2 hua4 shi2 mang2 he2
cues.en: they turned into a pile of 'breathing' ocean-fossil mystery boxes.

cues.zh: 好在修复山奇拉根开了跑谷卦时的
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 xiu1 fu4 shan1 qi2 la1 gen1 kai1 le5 pao3 gu3 gua4 shi2 de5
cues.en: Luckily restoration expert Angela got to work,

cues.zh: 硬是扒出遗骸的花名策
cues.pinyin: ying4 shi4 ba1 chu1 yi2 hai2 de5 hua1 ming2 ce4
cues.en: and forcefully dug up a roster of names for the remains.

cues.zh: 当众人感慨白人奴隶主的操作
cues.pinyin: dang1 zhong4 ren2 gan3 kai3 bai2 ren2 nu2 li4 zhu3 de5 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: As everyone lamented the white slave owners' actions,

cues.zh: 比黄连还苦时
cues.pinyin: bi3 huang2 lian2 hai2 ku3 shi2
cues.en: even more bitter than coptis root,

cues.zh: 黑人发疑卡密尔的眉头
cues.pinyin: hei1 ren2 fa1 yi2 ka3 mi4 er3 de5 mei2 tou2
cues.en: Black forensic examiner Camille's brow

cues.zh: 拧得能夹死蚊子
cues.pinyin: ning2 de2 neng2 jia1 si3 wen2 zi5
cues.en: furrowed tight enough to kill a mosquito.

cues.zh: 小谷迅速对骨骼进行扫描
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 xun4 su4 dui4 gu3 ge2 jin4 xing2 sao3 miao2
cues.en: Xiao Gu quickly scans the skeletons

cues.zh: 竟发现最小的苦主才 9 岁
cues.pinyin: jing4 fa1 xian4 zui4 xiao3 de5 ku3 zhu3 cai2 9 sui4
cues.en: and discovers the youngest victim was only 9 years old —

cues.zh: 哥现在还在跟作业本较劲
cues.pinyin: ge1 xian4 zai4 hai2 zai4 gen1 zuo4 ye4 ben3 jiao4 jin4
cues.en: a kid who'd nowadays still be struggling with homework —

cues.zh: 最年长都快 80 了
cues.pinyin: zui4 nian2 zhang3 dou1 kuai4 80 le5
cues.en: while the oldest was nearly 80.

cues.zh: 更魔幻的是里头混着白黑混血
cues.pinyin: geng4 mo2 huan4 de5 shi4 li3 tou5 hun4 zhe5 bai2 hei1 hun4 xue4
cues.en: Even more bizarre, mixed Black-and-white individuals were among them.

cues.zh: 这血缘混搭的活象历史随手搅了板乱顿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xue4 yuan2 hun4 da1 de5 huo2 xiang4 li4 shi3 sui2 shou3 jiao3 le5 ban3 luan4 dun4
cues.en: This mix of bloodlines looked just like history had been randomly stirred into chaos.

cues.zh: 每一块骨头缝里都藏着没说出口的酸楚
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 kuai4 gu3 tou5 feng4 li3 dou1 cang2 zhe5 mei2 shuo1 chu1 kou3 de5 suan1 chu3
cues.en: Every crevice of bone held unspoken sorrow.

cues.zh: 这些被贝壳咽入味的骨头割了一个半世纪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 bei4 bei4 ke2 yan4 ru4 wei4 de5 gu3 tou5 ge1 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 shi4 ji4
cues.en: These bones, swallowed up by shells, had been hidden away for a century and a half.

cues.zh: 然而就在这时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just then,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分7.8分，游轮上的富婆化身时间管理大师，2025重温经典下饭美剧。

cues.zh: 这不妥妥的年轻款受害者
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 tuo3 tuo3 de5 nian2 qing1 kuan3 shou4 hai4 zhe3
cues.en: this one is clearly a 'young model' victim —

cues.zh: 推测年龄最多 20 岁
cues.pinyin: tui1 ce4 nian2 ling2 zui4 duo1 20 sui4
cues.en: his estimated age was at most 20.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 豪金正对着修复师安琪拉
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 zheng4 dui4 zhe5 xiu1 fu4 shi1 an1 qi2 la1
cues.en: Hodgins is with restoration expert Angela,

cues.zh: 上演宇宙脱口秀
cues.pinyin: shang4 yan3 yu3 zhou4 tuo1 kou3 xiu4
cues.en: putting on a cosmic stand-up show.

cues.zh: 他认为要是破一份猫猫的成分
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 yao4 shi4 po4 yi1 fen4 mao1 mao1 de5 cheng2 fen4
cues.en: He thinks if they can figure out the composition of the find,

cues.zh: 必须组合豪金安琪勒元素赛文名字
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 zu3 he2 hao2 jin1 an1 qi2 lei1 yuan2 su4 sai4 wen2 ming2 zi4
cues.en: they should name it by combining elements of Hodgins and Angela.

cues.zh: 那架势
cues.pinyin: na4 jia4 shi4
cues.en: The way he's going about it,

cues.zh: 活想要把银河系摘下来当定情信物
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang3 yao4 ba3 yin2 he2 xi4 zhai1 xia4 lai2 dang1 ding4 qing2 xin4 wu4
cues.en: it's like he wants to pluck the galaxy down as a token of love.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, on the other side,

cues.zh: 小甜甜正对死因进行推测
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 zheng4 dui4 si3 yin1 jin4 xing2 tui1 ce4
cues.en: Xiao Tiantian is speculating about the cause of death,

cues.zh: 认为指不定是被鱼具勾住的倒霉蛋
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 zhi3 bu4 ding4 shi4 bei4 yu2 ju4 gou1 zhu4 de5 dao3 mei2 dan4
cues.en: thinking maybe it's some unlucky soul who got hooked by fishing gear.

cues.zh: 说着竟叹其感情经
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe5 jing4 tan4 qi2 gan3 qing2 jing1
cues.en: While saying so, she sighs over his romantic history,

cues.zh: 认为他是痴情体质
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 ta1 shi4 chi1 qing2 ti3 zhi4
cues.en: believing he has a hopelessly devoted personality —

cues.zh: 即便和朱莉分手
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 he2 zhu1 li4 fen1 shou3
cues.en: even after breaking up with Zhuli,

cues.zh: 还是被他吸得死死的
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 bei4 ta1 xi1 de2 si3 si3 de5
cues.en: he's still completely hung up on her.

cues.zh: 老布当场进行毒蛇回嘴
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 dang1 chang3 jin4 xing2 du2 she2 hui2 zui3
cues.en: Lao Bu instantly fires back with a venomous retort.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 安琪拉的死者画像新鲜出炉
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 de5 si3 zhe3 hua4 xiang4 xin1 xian1 chu1 lu2
cues.en: Angela's facial reconstruction of the victim comes out fresh.

cues.zh: 老布迅速对失踪人口库开始连连看
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 xun4 su4 dui4 shi1 zong1 ren2 kou3 ku4 kai1 shi3 lian2 lian2 kan4
cues.en: Lao Bu quickly starts matching it against the missing persons database.

cues.zh: 得知死者叫乔治
cues.pinyin: de2 zhi1 si3 zhe3 jiao4 qiao2 zhi4
cues.en: He learns the victim's name is George,

cues.zh: 28 岁已婚低调
cues.pinyin: 28 sui4 yi3 hun1 di1 diao4

cues.zh: 认为死者称死 20 岁

cues.en: concluding the victim was only 20 years old.

cues.zh: 老布认为调查局系统不能撒谎
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 ren4 wei2 diao4 cha2 ju2 xi4 tong3 bu4 neng2 sa1 huang3
cues.en: Lao Bu thinks the bureau's system can't lie.

cues.zh: 小谷显然不可认贼
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 xian3 ran2 bu4 ke3 ren4 zei2
cues.en: Xiao Gu clearly can't be mistaken.

cues.zh: 俩人吵得像菜市场砍价
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 chao3 de2 xiang4 cai4 shi4 chang3 kan3 jia4
cues.en: The two argue like they're haggling at a wet market,

cues.zh: 一路朝乔治家门口
cues.pinyin: yi1 lu4 chao2 qiao2 zhi4 jia1 men2 kou3
cues.en: heading straight for George's front door,

cues.zh: 准备用现实甩对方一脸真相巴掌
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 yong4 xian4 shi2 shuai3 dui4 fang1 yi1 lian3 zhen1 xiang4 ba1 zhang3
cues.en: ready to slap the other with the cold truth of reality.

cues.zh: 门开的瞬间聊着红头发的太太艾莉
cues.pinyin: men2 kai1 de5 shun4 jian1 liao2 zhe5 hong2 tou2 fa1 de5 tai4 tai4 ai4 li4
cues.en: The moment the door opens, it's George's red-haired wife, Ellie,

cues.zh: 听完丈夫死亡通知
cues.pinyin: ting1 wan2 zhang4 fu1 si3 wang2 tong1 zhi1
cues.en: and upon hearing the notice of her husband's death,

cues.zh: 当场把正在擦鱼缸的乔治拎出来
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 ba3 zheng4 zai4 ca1 yu2 gang1 de5 qiao2 zhi4 lin1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: she immediately drags out George — who's busy cleaning the fish tank.

cues.zh: 布谷组合相见会走路的恐龙化石
cues.pinyin: bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 xiang1 jian4 hui4 zou3 lu4 de5 kong3 long2 hua4 shi2
cues.en: The Bu-Gu duo look as stunned as if they'd seen a walking dinosaur fossil.

cues.zh: 审讯室里乔治讲述奇葩遭遇
cues.pinyin: shen3 xun4 shi4 li3 qiao2 zhi4 jiang3 shu4 qi2 pa1 zao1 yu4
cues.en: In the interrogation room, George recounts his bizarre ordeal:

cues.zh: 原来她的身份被图半年
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 de5 shen1 fen4 bei4 tu2 ban4 nian2
cues.en: turns out his identity was stolen for half a year,

cues.zh: 既用卡冻结到连房带都差点断供
cues.pinyin: ji4 yong4 ka3 dong4 jie2 dao4 lian2 fang2 dai4 dou1 cha4 dian3 duan4 gong1
cues.en: his credit cards got frozen to the point he nearly defaulted on his mortgage.

cues.zh: 艾莉也在旁边疯狂附和
cues.pinyin: ai4 li4 ye3 zai4 pang2 bian1 feng1 kuang2 fu4 he4
cues.en: Ellie, standing by, nods along frantically in agreement,

cues.zh: 表示乔治连鸡都不敢杀
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 qiao2 zhi4 lian2 ji1 dou1 bu4 gan3 sha1
cues.en: insisting George wouldn't even dare kill a chicken,

cues.zh: 怎么敢杀人抛尸
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 gan3 sha1 ren2 pao1 shi1
cues.en: let alone murder someone and dump the body.

cues.zh: 但警方甩出的秘密录音让空气瞬间凝固
cues.pinyin: dan4 jing3 fang1 shuai3 chu1 de5 mi4 mi4 lu4 yin1 rang4 kong1 qi4 shun4 jian1 ning2 gu4
cues.en: But the secret recording the police pull out freezes the air instantly:

cues.zh: 乔治曾说要杀死对方的狠话
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 ceng2 shuo1 yao4 sha1 si3 dui4 fang1 de5 hen3 hua4
cues.en: George once uttered the vicious words that he'd kill the other person,

cues.zh: 配着他拥有渔船的线索
cues.pinyin: pei4 zhe5 ta1 yong1 you3 yu2 chuan2 de5 xian4 suo3
cues.en: paired with the clue that he owns a fishing boat.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分7.8分，游轮上的富婆化身时间管理大师，2025重温经典下饭美剧。

cues.zh: 好不容易等到个队友意外
cues.pinyin: hao3 bu4 rong2 yi4 deng3 dao4 ge4 dui4 you3 yi4 wai4
cues.en: Just when they finally caught a break with a partner,

cues.zh: 结果两人因入室抢劫翻车
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 liang3 ren2 yin1 ru4 shi4 qiang3 jie2 fan1 che1
cues.en: it turns out the two of them got busted over a home invasion robbery.

cues.zh: 更戏剧性的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 xi4 ju4 xing4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more dramatic,

cues.zh: 法庭上约翰竟反水指认一万
cues.pinyin: fa3 ting2 shang4 yue1 han4 jing4 fan3 shui3 zhi3 ren4 yi1 wan4
cues.en: in court John unexpectedly turns on Ivan and testifies against him,

cues.zh: 自己美啧啧拿了缓刑
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 mei3 ze2 ze2 na2 le5 huan3 xing2
cues.en: while smugly getting himself a suspended sentence.

cues.zh: 这波被刺操作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bo1 bei4 ci4 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: This backstabbing move

cues.zh: 怕不是给约翰埋了颗定时炸弹
cues.pinyin: pa4 bu2 shi4 gei3 yue1 han4 mai2 le5 ke1 ding4 shi2 zha4 dan4
cues.en: might just be planting a time bomb for John.

cues.zh: 小田街一听这话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 jie1 yi1 ting1 zhe4 hua4
cues.en: The moment Xiao Tiantian hears this,

cues.zh: 小甜甜一听这话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 yi1 ting1 zhe4 hua4
cues.en: she bursts out the door in a hurry.

cues.zh: 与此逢时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 feng2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 事故对前众人正按着身份猜猜
cues.pinyin: shi4 gu4 dui4 qian2 zhong4 ren2 zheng4 an4 zhe5 shen1 fen4 cai1 cai1
cues.en: by the remains, everyone is guessing at identities,

cues.zh: 卡米尔却突然发现
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 que4 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: when Camille suddenly discovers

cues.zh: 某具尸骸大漫上
cues.pinyin: mou3 ju4 shi1 hai2 da4 man4 shang4
cues.en: on the femur of one of the remains,

cues.zh: 竟与曾祖母名则一模一样
cues.pinyin: jing4 yu3 zeng1 zu3 mu3 ming2 ze2 yi1 mu2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: a name identical to her great-grandmother's.

cues.zh: 就在气氛将成冰雕时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 qi4 fen1 jiang1 cheng2 bing1 diao1 shi2
cues.en: Just as the atmosphere was about to freeze into an ice sculpture,

cues.zh: 豪金突然带着线索冲进来
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 tu1 ran2 dai4 zhe5 xian4 suo3 chong1 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Hodgins suddenly bursts in with a clue:

cues.zh: 粉色毛毛竟是鼻涕花如虫
cues.pinyin: fen3 se4 mao2 mao2 jing4 shi4 bi2 ti4 hua1 ru2 chong2
cues.en: the pink fuzz turns out to be slug larvae.

cues.zh: 粉色毛毛竟是鼻涕虫幼虫
cues.pinyin: fen3 se4 mao2 mao2 jing4 shi4 bi2 ti4 chong2 you4 chong2
cues.en: To showcase the bugs' formidable ability,

cues.zh: 当场上演沉浸式模仿秀
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 shang4 yan3 chen2 jin4 shi4 mo2 fang3 xiu4
cues.en: he puts on an immersive impression show on the spot,

cues.zh: 理化虫子钻骨头的架势
cues.pinyin: li3 hua4 chong2 zi5 zuan1 gu3 tou5 de5 jia4 shi4
cues.en: simulating how the bugs burrow into bone,

cues.zh: 还模拟自溜吸骨嘴的音效
cues.pinyin: hai2 mo2 ni3 zi4 liu1 xi1 gu3 zui3 de5 yin1 xiao4
cues.en: and even mimics the sound effects of a bone-sucking mouth.

cues.zh: 这生动表演让在场女士们集体捂住嘴
cues.pinyin: zhe4 sheng1 dong4 biao3 yan3 rang4 zai4 chang3 nv3 shi4 men5 ji2 ti3 wu3 zhu4 zui3
cues.en: This vivid performance makes all the women present clap their hands over their mouths,

cues.zh: 为力翻江倒海的
cues.pinyin: wei4 li4 fan1 jiang1 dao3 hai3 de5
cues.en: their stomachs churning like turning tides,

items.title: 外星人探案

cues.zh: 像刚喝了十瓶碳酸饮料
cues.pinyin: xiang4 gang1 he1 le5 shi2 ping2 tan4 suan1 yin3 liao4
cues.en: as if they'd just downed ten bottles of soda.

cues.zh: 好在豪金早有准备
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 hao2 jin1 zao3 you3 zhun3 bei4
cues.en: Luckily Hodgins came prepared,

cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 dui4 zhe5 gu3 tou5 fang4 shi2 yu2
cues.en: directly releasing flesh-eating fish onto the bones.

cues.zh: 只见粉毛瞬间表演棉花糖浴热
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 fen3 mao2 shun4 jian1 biao3 yan3 mian2 hua1 tang2 yu4 re4
cues.en: The pink fuzz instantly melts away like cotton candy,

cues.zh: 露出白花花的真面目
cues.pinyin: lu4 chu1 bai2 hua1 hua1 de5 zhen1 mian4 mu4
cues.en: revealing its stark white true form.

cues.zh: 然而朱莉突然倒吸一口凉气
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 zhu1 li4 tu1 ran2 dao4 xi1 yi1 kou3 liang2 qi4
cues.en: But then Zhuli suddenly gasps in shock:

cues.zh: 舞面上的花痕密得像搓衣板纹路
cues.pinyin: wu3 mian4 shang4 de5 hua1 hen2 mi4 de2 xiang4 cuo1 yi1 ban3 wen2 lu4
cues.en: the marks on the bone's surface are as dense as the ridges of a washboard,

cues.zh: 骨面上的花痕密得像搓衣板纹路
cues.pinyin: gu3 mian4 shang4 de5 hua1 hen2 mi4 de2 xiang4 cuo1 yi1 ban3 wen2 lu4
cues.en: as if someone had repeatedly ground it against a grinder.

cues.zh: 陶金立即将此消息告知小谷
cues.pinyin: tao2 jin1 li4 ji2 jiang1 ci3 xiao1 xi1 gao4 zhi1 xiao3 gu3
cues.en: Hodgins immediately informs Xiao Gu of this.

cues.zh: 殊不知老布这边极其热闹
cues.pinyin: shu1 bu4 zhi1 lao3 bu4 zhe4 bian1 ji2 qi2 re4 nao4
cues.en: Little did they know, things are quite lively on Lao Bu's end —

cues.zh: 他从监狱事关那儿霸道猛热
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 jian1 yu4 shi4 guan1 na4 er2 ba4 dao4 meng3 re4
cues.en: he's gathering intel from a prison guard:

cues.zh: 一万出狱后竟在绅士游轮当牛郎
cues.pinyin: yi1 wan4 chu1 yu4 hou4 jing4 zai4 shen1 shi4 you2 lun2 dang1 niu2 lang2
cues.en: turns out after Ivan got out of prison, he became a gigolo on a luxury cruise,

cues.zh: 伊万出狱后竟在绅士游轮当牛郎
cues.pinyin: yi1 wan4 chu1 yu4 hou4 jing4 zai4 shen1 shi4 you2 lun2 dang1 niu2 lang2
cues.en: specifically providing young companion services to wealthy women.

cues.zh: 而船老板初见老布时
cues.pinyin: er2 chuan2 lao3 ban3 chu1 jian4 lao3 bu4 shi2
cues.en: When the ship's owner first meets Lao Bu,

cues.zh: 满脸写着生人无尽
cues.pinyin: man3 lian3 xie3 zhe5 sheng1 ren2 wu2 jin4
cues.en: his face is written all over with 'stranger, keep away,'

cues.zh: 直到瞥见旁边的小甜甜
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 pie1 jian4 pang2 bian1 de5 xiao3 tian2 tian2
cues.en: until he glimpses Xiao Tiantian standing next to him,

cues.zh: 眼睛瞬间亮成探照灯
cues.pinyin: yan3 jing1 shun4 jian1 liang4 cheng2 tan4 zhao4 deng1
cues.en: and his eyes instantly light up like searchlights.

cues.zh: 老布瞄懂直接用小甜甜换船票
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 miao2 dong3 zhi2 jie1 yong4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 huan4 chuan2 piao4
cues.en: Lao Bu instantly catches on and basically trades Xiao Tiantian for boarding passes.

cues.zh: 这波鼠师笑翻天
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bo1 shu3 shi1 xiao4 fan1 tian1
cues.en: This move has everyone cracking up.

cues.zh: 我们把葱白的部分给它种在里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 cong1 bai2 de5 bu4 fen4 gei3 ta1 zhong3 zai4 li3 mian4

cues.zh: 每一个葱白之间呢

cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 hui4 zai4 ta1 men5 zhang3 dao4 na4 me5 gao1 zhi1 qian2 ne5
cues.en: So before they grow that tall

cues.zh: 就会收割了

cues.zh: 所以我只留了 1 到 2 英寸的空隙
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 zhi3 liu2 le5 1 dao4 2 ying1 cun4 de5 kong4 xi4

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 前几天日本著名推理作家东野圭吾去世了
cues.pinyin: qian2 ji3 tian1 ri4 ben3 zhu4 ming2 tui1 li3 zuo4 jia1 dong1 ye3 gui1 wu2 qu4 shi4 le5
cues.en: A few days ago, the famous Japanese mystery writer Keigo Higashino passed away.

cues.zh: 死于结肠癌
cues.pinyin: si3 yu2 jie2 chang2 ai2
cues.en: He died of colon cancer.

cues.zh: 在痛心之余有小朋友问我
cues.pinyin: zai4 tong4 xin1 zhi1 yu2 you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3
cues.en: Amid the sadness, a young friend asked me,

cues.zh: 像东野圭吾这么有钱的作家都会死于癌症
cues.pinyin: xiang4 dong1 ye3 gui1 wu2 zhe4 me5 you3 qian2 de5 zuo4 jia1 du1 hui4 si3 yu2 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: "Even a wealthy writer like Higashino Keigo died of cancer,

cues.zh: 我们作为普通人又该如何逃脱
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 wei2 pu3 tong1 ren2 you4 gai1 ru2 he2 tao2 tuo1
cues.en: so how can we ordinary people escape

cues.zh: 癌症的魔爪呢
cues.pinyin: ai2 zheng4 de5 mo2 zhao3 ne5
cues.en: the clutches of cancer?"

cues.zh: 像结肠癌这样的消化道癌症早期
cues.pinyin: xiang4 jie2 chang2 ai2 zhe4 yang4 de5 xiao1 hua4 dao4 ai2 zheng4 zao3 qi1
cues.en: Digestive-tract cancers like colon cancer, in their early stages,

cues.zh: 没有什么症状
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 shen2 me5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: have no obvious symptoms.

cues.zh: 到了晚期很难治疗费用很高
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 wan3 qi1 hen3 nan2 zhi4 liao2 fei4 yong4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: By the late stage they're hard to treat and very costly,

cues.zh: 最后病人的寿命还会大大的缩短
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 bing4 ren2 de5 shou4 ming4 hai2 hui4 da4 da4 de5 suo1 duan3
cues.en: and in the end the patient's life is greatly shortened.

cues.zh: 不过医学发展到今天
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yi1 xue2 fa1 zhan3 dao4 jin1 tian1
cues.en: But with how far medicine has advanced today,

cues.zh: 我们的确有一些方法来对付癌症
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 que4 you3 yi1 xie1 fang1 fa3 lai2 dui4 fu4 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: we do have some ways to deal with cancer.

cues.zh: 今天我们就来聊一聊消化道肿瘤这些事
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 liao2 yi1 liao2 xiao1 hua4 dao4 zhong3 liu2 zhe4 xie1 shi4
cues.en: Today let's talk about digestive tract tumors.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来跟大家谈一谈
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 gen1 da4 jia1 tan2 yi1 tan2
cues.en: First, let's talk with everyone about

cues.zh: 什么是消化系统
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 xiao1 hua4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: what the digestive system is.

cues.zh: 我们是否知道我们要消化一个食物会经
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi4 fou3 zhi1 dao4 wo3 men5 yao4 xiao1 hua4 yi2 ge4 shi2 wu4 hui4 jing1
cues.en: Do we know which organs food passes through

cues.zh: 过哪些器官呢
cues.pinyin: guo4 na3 xie1 qi4 guan1 ne5
cues.en: when we digest it?

cues.zh: 食物在我们身体里边要进行消化和吸收
cues.pinyin: shi2 wu4 zai4 wo3 men5 shen1 ti3 li3 bian1 yao4 jin4 xing2 xiao1 hua4 he2 xi1 shou1
cues.en: Food undergoes digestion and absorption inside our body.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 什么叫消化呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 xiao1 hua4 ne5
cues.en: What is digestion?

cues.zh: 食物块很大我们不能直接进入
cues.pinyin: shi2 wu4 kuai4 hen3 da4 wo3 men5 bu4 neng2 zhi2 jie1 jin4 ru4
cues.en: Food pieces are too big to go directly into

cues.zh: 循环系统对吧
cues.pinyin: xun2 huan2 xi4 tong3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: the circulatory system, right?

cues.zh: 所以首先把大块变小块大分子变小分子
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shou3 xian1 ba3 da4 kuai4 bian4 xiao3 kuai4 da4 fen1 zi5 bian4 xiao3 fen4 zi3
cues.en: So first big pieces become small pieces, big molecules become small molecules —

cues.zh: 这就叫食物的消化过程
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 shi2 wu4 de5 xiao1 hua4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: that's called the process of digesting food.

cues.zh: 这个过程有物理消化也有化学消化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 you3 wu4 li3 xiao1 hua4 ye3 you3 hua4 xue2 xiao1 hua4
cues.en: This process includes both physical and chemical digestion.

cues.zh: 物理消化就比如牙齿嚼碎它是吧
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 xiao1 hua4 jiu4 bi3 ru2 ya2 chi3 jue2 sui4 ta1 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Physical digestion is like teeth chewing it up, right?

cues.zh: 化学消化有一些酶的作用
cues.pinyin: hua4 xue2 xiao1 hua4 you3 yi1 xie1 mei2 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: Chemical digestion involves the action of enzymes,

cues.zh: 把大块给切开变成小块分子
cues.pinyin: ba3 da4 kuai4 gei3 qie4 kai1 bian4 cheng2 xiao3 kuai4 fen4 zi3
cues.en: cutting big pieces into small molecules,

cues.zh: 然后这个小分子再进入人体的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 fen4 zi3 zai4 jin4 ru4 ren2 ti3 de5
cues.en: and then these small molecules enter the body's

cues.zh: 血液循环系统
cues.pinyin: xue4 ye4 xun2 huan2 xi4 tong3
cues.en: blood circulatory system.

cues.zh: 小分子通过小肠上面的小肠绒毛
cues.pinyin: xiao3 fen4 zi3 tong1 guo4 xiao3 chang2 shang4 mian4 de5 xiao3 chang2 rong2 mao2
cues.en: Small molecules pass through the villi on the small intestine

cues.zh: 进入血液循环
cues.pinyin: jin4 ru4 xue4 ye4 xun2 huan2
cues.en: and enter the bloodstream.

cues.zh: 这个过程我们就称之为吸收
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 xi1 shou1
cues.en: We call this process absorption.

cues.zh: 这就是一个消化和一个吸收的一个过程
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao1 hua4 he2 yi2 ge4 xi1 shou1 de5 yi2 ge4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: So that's the process of digestion and then absorption.

cues.zh: 那么食物进来了之后会经过哪些器官呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shi2 wu4 jin4 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4 hui4 jing1 guo4 na3 xie1 qi4 guan1 ne5
cues.en: So which organs does food pass through after entering?

cues.zh: 首先我们知道食物先进到什么地方
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 shi2 wu4 xian1 jin4 dao4 shen2 me5 di4 fang1
cues.en: First, where does food enter?

cues.zh: 先进到嘴也就是口腔对吧
cues.pinyin: xian1 jin4 dao4 zui3 ye3 jiu4 shi4 kou3 qiang1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: It first enters the mouth, the oral cavity, right?

cues.zh: 口腔
cues.pinyin: kou3 qiang1
cues.en: The oral cavity.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 它可以把淀粉消化成麦芽糖
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 ba3 dian4 fen3 xiao1 hua4 cheng2 mai4 ya2 tang2
cues.en: It can digest starch into maltose,

cues.zh: 所以我们就会感觉到好像有点甜味是吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 jiu4 hui4 gan3 jue2 dao4 hao3 xiang4 you3 dian3 tian2 wei4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: so we feel a slightly sweet taste, right?

cues.zh: 好那么这个口腔下来了之后
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 kou3 qiang1 xia4 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Okay, so after leaving the mouth,

cues.zh: 通过淹布然后就进入了食管
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 yan1 bu4 ran2 hou4 jiu4 jin4 ru4 le5 shi2 guan3
cues.en: it passes through the pharynx and enters the esophagus.

cues.zh: 食管既不能进行消化也不能进行吸收
cues.pinyin: shi2 guan3 ji4 bu4 neng2 jin4 xing2 xiao1 hua4 ye3 bu4 neng2 jin4 xing2 xi1 shou1
cues.en: The esophagus can neither digest nor absorb anything,

cues.zh: 但是食管壁它是在上面有强有力的肌肉
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi2 guan3 bi4 ta1 shi4 zai4 shang4 mian4 you3 qiang2 you3 li4 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: but the esophageal wall has powerful muscles on it

cues.zh: 可以把这个食物往下挤挤挤挤
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shi2 wu4 wang3 xia4 ji3 ji3 ji3 ji3
cues.en: that can squeeze the food downward, downward, downward,

cues.zh: 就挤到胃里边去了是吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ji3 dao4 wei4 li3 bian1 qu4 le5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: squeezing it into the stomach, right?

cues.zh: 食管就会进入胃
cues.pinyin: shi2 guan3 jiu4 hui4 jin4 ru4 wei4
cues.en: The esophagus leads into the stomach,

cues.zh: 但是在食管进入胃之前要先通过一个阀门
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 shi2 guan3 jin4 ru4 wei4 zhi1 qian2 yao4 xian1 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 fa2 men2
cues.en: but before the esophagus enters the stomach, it must pass through a valve

cues.zh: 我们称之为奔门
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ben1 men2
cues.en: we call the cardia.

cues.zh: 通过奔门它就进入到了人的胃里边去了
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 ben1 men2 ta1 jiu4 jin4 ru4 dao4 le5 ren2 de5 wei4 li3 bian1 qu4 le5
cues.en: Passing through the cardia, it enters the person's stomach.

cues.zh: 奔门实际上是一个单向阀门
cues.pinyin: ben1 men2 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 dan1 xiang4 fa2 men2
cues.en: The cardia is actually a one-way valve.

cues.zh: 贲门实际上是一个单向阀门
cues.pinyin: ben1 men2 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 dan1 xiang4 fa2 men2
cues.en: It lets food go down into the stomach,

cues.zh: 但是不允许胃部的酸性物质往上反
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 yun3 xu3 wei4 bu4 de5 suan1 xing4 wu4 zhi4 wang3 shang4 fan3
cues.en: but doesn't let the stomach's acidic contents flow back up.

cues.zh: 这就是奔门的作用它是单向阀门
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ben1 men2 de5 zuo4 yong4 ta1 shi4 dan1 xiang4 fa2 men2
cues.en: That's the function of the cardia — it's a one-way valve.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 胃液是酸性的
cues.pinyin: wei4 ye4 shi4 suan1 xing4 de5
cues.en: Gastric juice is acidic.

cues.zh: 一方面来讲这个胃液是酸性的
cues.pinyin: yi4 fang1 mian4 lai2 jiang3 zhe4 ge5 wei4 ye4 shi4 suan1 xing4 de5
cues.en: On one hand, this gastric juice is acidic,

cues.zh: 可以杀死食物中的一些病菌
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 sha1 si3 shi2 wu4 zhong1 de5 yi1 xie1 bing4 jun1
cues.en: which can kill some germs in food.

cues.zh: 另外一方面也为其他的酶提供了一些
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi4 fang1 mian4 ye3 wei4 qi2 ta1 de5 mei2 ti2 gong1 le5 yi1 xie1
cues.en: On the other hand, it also provides other enzymes with

cues.zh: 比较合适的酸碱的环境
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 he2 shi4 de5 suan1 jian3 de5 huan2 jing4
cues.en: a suitably acidic environment.

cues.zh: 在这个胃液里边有一些物质就会被消化掉
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 ye4 li3 bian1 you3 yi1 xie1 wu4 zhi4 jiu4 hui4 bei4 xiao1 hua4 diao4
cues.en: Some substances in this gastric juice get digested,

cues.zh: 比如说蛋白质
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 dan4 bai2 zhi4
cues.en: proteins, for example.

cues.zh: 这个蛋白质在这个胃液的消化作用下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dan4 bai2 zhi4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 ye4 de5 xiao1 hua4 zuo4 yong4 xia4
cues.en: Under the digestive action of this gastric juice,

cues.zh: 它就会变成多态
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 duo1 tai4
cues.en: proteins turn into peptides,

cues.zh: 变成一个小链的这个多态
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 xiao3 lian4 de5 zhe4 ge5 duo1 tai4
cues.en: becoming short peptide chains.

cues.zh: 好吧
cues.pinyin: hao3 ba5
cues.en: Okay.

cues.zh: 好那么食物在胃里边也消化完了
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 shi2 wu4 zai4 wei4 li3 bian1 ye3 xiao1 hua4 wan2 le5
cues.en: Alright, so once food has finished being digested in the stomach,

cues.zh: 继续下面继续往下走
cues.pinyin: ji4 xu4 xia4 mian4 ji4 xu4 wang3 xia4 zou3
cues.en: it continues moving further down.

cues.zh: 它会通过一个叫做幽门的单向阀门
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 you1 men2 de5 dan1 xiang4 fa2 men2
cues.en: It passes through a one-way valve called the pylorus,

cues.zh: 作用跟奔门差不多
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yong4 gen1 ben1 men2 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: whose function is similar to the cardia's.

cues.zh: 不过幽门这地方有个特点
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 you1 men2 zhe4 di4 fang1 you3 ge4 te4 dian3
cues.en: But the pylorus has a special feature:

cues.zh: 就是大部分的病菌不能在胃这种酸
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 da4 bu4 fen4 de5 bing4 jun1 bu4 neng2 zai4 wei4 zhe4 zhong3 suan1
cues.en: most germs can't live in the stomach's

cues.zh: 性环境下生活
cues.pinyin: xing4 huan2 jing4 xia4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: acidic environment.

cues.zh: 但是有一种叫做幽门螺旋杆菌的东西
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 you3 yi1 zhong3 jiao4 zuo4 you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: But there's one called Helicobacter pylori

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 这种细菌它是可以在酸性环境下生活的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 xi4 jun1 ta1 shi4 ke3 yi3 zai4 suan1 xing4 huan2 jing4 xia4 sheng1 huo2 de5
cues.en: that bacterium can live in an acidic environment.

cues.zh: 它就生活在幽门附近
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 sheng1 huo2 zai4 you1 men2 fu4 jin4
cues.en: It lives right near the pylorus.

cues.zh: 而且人们已经证明了
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ren2 men5 yi3 jing1 zheng4 ming2 liao3
cues.en: And it has already been proven

cues.zh: 幽门螺旋感菌是与胃癌直接相
cues.pinyin: you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 shi4 yu3 wei4 ai2 zhi2 jie1 xiang1
cues.en: that H. pylori is directly

cues.zh: 关的一种细菌
cues.pinyin: guan1 de5 yi1 zhong3 xi4 jun1
cues.en: related to stomach cancer,

cues.zh: 所以容易有可能会诱发胃癌
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 rong2 yi4 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 you4 fa1 wei4 ai2
cues.en: so it can easily trigger stomach cancer.

cues.zh: 那于是我们如果有了幽门螺旋感菌感染
cues.pinyin: na4 yu2 shi4 wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 you3 le5 you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 gan3 ran3
cues.en: So if we are infected with H. pylori,

cues.zh: 那我们是不是应该把它杀掉
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 shi4 bu2 shi4 ying1 gai1 ba3 ta1 sha1 diao4
cues.en: should we kill it off?

cues.zh: 问题是中国有多少人幽门螺旋感菌感染呢
cues.pinyin: wen4 ti2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 you3 duo1 shao3 ren2 you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 gan3 ran3 ne5
cues.en: The question is, how many people in China are infected with H. pylori?

cues.zh: 7 亿人
cues.pinyin: 7 yi4 ren2
cues.en: 700 million people.

cues.zh: 问题是中国有多少人幽门螺旋杆菌感染呢
cues.pinyin: wen4 ti2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 you3 duo1 shao3 ren2 you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 gan3 ran3 ne5
cues.en: That means about half the population is infected with H. pylori.

cues.zh: 治疗倒是不麻烦
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liao2 dao3 shi4 bu4 ma2 fan2
cues.en: Treatment isn't actually that troublesome.

cues.zh: 你到医院一吹气发现幽门螺旋感菌感染
cues.pinyin: ni3 dao4 yi1 yuan4 yi1 chui1 qi4 fa1 xian4 you1 men2 luo2 xuan2 gan3 jun1 gan3 ran3
cues.en: You go to the hospital, take a breath test, find you're infected with H. pylori,

cues.zh: 然后就治疗
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: and then you get treated.

cues.zh: 治完了之后就好了不感染了
cues.pinyin: zhi4 wan2 le5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 hao3 le5 bu4 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: After treatment you're cured and no longer infected.

cues.zh: 但问题是你不感染了
cues.pinyin: dan4 wen4 ti2 shi4 ni3 bu4 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: But the problem is, even though you're no longer infected,

cues.zh: 可能你们家里边又感染了对吧
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 ni3 men5 jia1 li3 bian1 you4 gan3 ran3 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: someone in your family might be infected again, right?

cues.zh: 所以你聚餐的时候又被别人重
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 ju4 can1 de5 shi2 hou4 you4 bei4 bie2 ren2 zhong4
cues.en: So when you eat together,

cues.zh: 新二次感染了
cues.pinyin: xin1 er4 ci4 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: you get reinfected by someone else.

cues.zh: 这是个很麻烦的一件事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ge4 hen3 ma2 fan2 de5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: That's quite a troublesome thing.

cues.zh: 所以我们一般是推荐那个胃癌的高危人群
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 yi4 ban1 shi4 tui1 jian4 na4 ge5 wei4 ai2 de5 gao1 wei1 ren2 qun2
cues.en: So we generally recommend that people at high risk of stomach cancer

cues.zh: 做这个幽门路线杆区这个治疗
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zhe4 ge5 you1 men2 lu4 xian4 gan1 qu1 zhe4 ge5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: get this treatment for H. pylori.

cues.zh: 好那么胃通过幽门
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 wei4 tong1 guo4 you1 men2
cues.en: Okay, so after the stomach passes through the pylorus,

cues.zh: 下一步就是谁呢就进入了小肠
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 bu4 jiu4 shi4 shui2 ne5 jiu4 jin4 ru4 le5 xiao3 chang2
cues.en: what's next? It enters the small intestine.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】东野圭吾因结肠癌去世！一个视频教你远离消化道肿瘤

cues.zh: 然后容易跟水基因混合
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rong2 yi4 gen1 shui3 ji1 yin1 hun4 he2
cues.en: Then bile easily mixes with it,

cues.zh: 这就是胆汁的作用
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 dan3 zhi1 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: that's the role of bile.

cues.zh: 好然后还有就是胰腺
cues.pinyin: hao3 ran2 hou4 hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 yi2 xian4
cues.en: And then there's also the pancreas.

cues.zh: 胰腺也是一种消化腺
cues.pinyin: yi2 xian4 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 xiao1 hua4 xian4
cues.en: The pancreas is also a digestive gland.

cues.zh: 胰腺会分泌叫什么叫胰液
cues.pinyin: yi2 xian4 hui4 fen1 mi4 jiao4 shen2 me5 jiao4 yi2 ye4
cues.en: The pancreas secretes something called pancreatic juice.

cues.zh: 胰液这个胰液是一种消化液
cues.pinyin: yi2 ye4 zhe4 ge5 yi2 ye4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 xiao1 hua4 ye4
cues.en: Pancreatic juice is a digestive fluid.

cues.zh: 还有就是小肠腺
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 xiao3 chang2 xian4
cues.en: There's also the intestinal glands.

cues.zh: 小肠腺它可以分泌出肠液
cues.pinyin: xiao3 chang2 xian4 ta1 ke3 yi3 fen1 mi4 chu1 chang2 ye4
cues.en: The intestinal glands can secrete intestinal juice,

cues.zh: 叫肠液肠液也是一种消化液
cues.pinyin: jiao4 chang2 ye4 chang2 ye4 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 xiao1 hua4 ye4
cues.en: called intestinal juice, which is also a digestive fluid.

cues.zh: 那么在这些消化液的作用下
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 zhe4 xie1 xiao1 hua4 ye4 de5 zuo4 yong4 xia4
cues.en: So under the action of these digestive fluids,

cues.zh: 脂肪就可以被消化了
cues.pinyin: zhi1 fang2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 bei4 xiao1 hua4 le5
cues.en: fat can be digested.

cues.zh: 那脂肪变成什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhi1 fang2 bian4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what does fat turn into?

cues.zh: 首先脂肪被肝脏释放的这个胆汁
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhi1 fang2 bei4 gan1 zang4 shi4 fang4 de5 zhe4 ge5 dan3 zhi1
cues.en: First, fat is acted on by bile released by the liver,

cues.zh: 这个变成乳化的脂肪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bian4 cheng2 ru3 hua4 de5 zhi1 fang2
cues.en: turning into emulsified fat.

cues.zh: 然后乳化的脂肪再被这些胰液
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ru3 hua4 de5 zhi1 fang2 zai4 bei4 zhe4 xie1 yi2 ye4
cues.en: Then the emulsified fat is further

cues.zh: 肠液进行消化
cues.pinyin: chang2 ye4 jin4 xing2 xiao1 hua4
cues.en: digested by pancreatic juice and intestinal juice.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 因为议员眼看就要参加初选了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yi4 yuan2 yan3 kan4 jiu4 yao4 can1 jia1 chu1 xuan3 le5
cues.en: Because the senator was about to enter the primary election,

cues.zh: 面部神经却突然出现了问题
cues.pinyin: mian4 bu4 shen2 jing1 que4 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: her facial nerve suddenly started acting up.

cues.zh: 在事业和生命之间
cues.pinyin: zai4 shi4 ye4 he2 sheng1 ming4 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: Between her career and her life,

cues.zh: 她要如何选择她叫小薇
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 ru2 he2 xuan3 ze2 ta1 jiao4 xiao3 wei1
cues.en: how would she choose? Her name was Xiaowei.

cues.zh: 是支持者无数的参议员
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 chi2 zhe3 wu2 shu4 de5 can1 yi4 yuan2
cues.en: She's a senator with countless supporters.

cues.zh: 今早在酒店练习演讲时
cues.pinyin: jin1 zao3 zai4 jiu3 dian4 lian4 xi2 yan3 jiang3 shi2
cues.en: This morning, while practicing her speech at the hotel,

cues.zh: 半边脸突然不听使唤
cues.pinyin: ban4 bian1 lian3 tu1 ran2 bu4 ting1 shi3 huan4
cues.en: half her face suddenly stopped responding.

cues.zh: 疯狂眨眼还发生了抽搐
cues.pinyin: feng1 kuang2 zha3 yan3 hai2 fa1 sheng1 le5 chou1 chu4
cues.en: She blinked uncontrollably and had muscle spasms.

cues.zh: 这已经是第三次了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi3 jing1 shi4 di4 san1 ci4 le5
cues.en: This was already the third time it happened.

cues.zh: 为了避免在演讲时发生变数
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 zai4 yan3 jiang3 shi2 fa1 sheng1 bian4 shu4
cues.en: To avoid any mishap during her speech,

cues.zh: 被对手抓到把柄她来到了医院诊治
cues.pinyin: bei4 dui4 shou3 zhua1 dao4 ba3 bing3 ta1 lai2 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4 zhen3 zhi4
cues.en: and giving her opponent ammunition, she went to the hospital for treatment.

cues.zh: 小薇的这个症状是偏侧面肌痉挛
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 zhe4 ge5 zheng4 zhuang4 shi4 pian1 ce4 mian4 ji1 jing4 luan2
cues.en: Xiaowei's symptom is hemifacial spasm.

cues.zh: 有可能压力太大
cues.pinyin: you3 ke3 neng2 ya1 li4 tai4 da4
cues.en: It could be caused by too much stress,

cues.zh: 情绪消极加上咖啡喝多了引起的
cues.pinyin: qing2 xu4 xiao1 ji2 jia1 shang4 ka1 fei1 he1 duo1 le5 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: negative emotions, and drinking too much coffee.

cues.zh: 毕竟这就是小薇的日常
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 xiao3 wei1 de5 ri4 chang2
cues.en: After all, that's just Xiaowei's daily life.

cues.zh: 只要打肉毒素再吃点药就好了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 da3 rou4 du2 su4 zai4 chi1 dian3 yao4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: Just get some Botox and take medicine, and it'll be fine.

cues.zh: 但如果严重的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 guo3 yan2 zhong4 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if it's serious,

cues.zh: 可能是动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: it could be an aneurysm,

cues.zh: 多发性硬化症或者脑肿瘤
cues.pinyin: duo1 fa1 xing4 ying4 hua4 zheng4 huo4 zhe3 nao3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: multiple sclerosis, or a brain tumor.

cues.zh: 这需要做核磁共振来确定
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4 lai2 que4 ding4
cues.en: An MRI is needed to confirm it.

cues.zh: 既然不确定是哪种原因
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 bu4 que4 ding4 shi4 na3 zhong3 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Since they weren't sure which cause it was,

cues.zh: 那就都来吧
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 dou1 lai2 ba5
cues.en: they decided to test for all of them.

cues.zh: 最担心的那种情况还是出现了
cues.pinyin: zui4 dan1 xin1 de5 na4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 hai2 shi4 chu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: The scenario they feared most ended up happening.

cues.zh: 肉毒素没有用
cues.pinyin: rou4 du2 su4 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: The Botox hadn't worked.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 小薇等待期间又出现了一次症状
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 deng3 dai4 qi1 jian1 you4 chu1 xian4 le5 yi1 ci4 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: While Xiaowei was waiting, the symptom occurred again.

cues.zh: 核磁共振检查
cues.pinyin: he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: The MRI scan

cues.zh: 发现了一股脑动脉正压迫着她的面部神经
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 gu3 nao3 dong4 mai4 zheng4 ya1 po4 zhe5 ta1 de5 mian4 bu4 shen2 jing1
cues.en: revealed a cerebral artery pressing on her facial nerve.

cues.zh: 不幸的是
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Unfortunately,

cues.zh: 她的动脉有段迂回
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 dong4 mai4 you3 duan4 yu1 hui2
cues.en: her artery had a tortuous section,

cues.zh: 要通过手术解决难于登天
cues.pinyin: yao4 tong1 guo4 shou3 shu4 jie3 jue2 nan2 yu2 deng1 tian1
cues.en: making surgical correction extremely difficult.

cues.zh: 但还有个好消息
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 you3 ge4 hao3 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: But there was also good news.

cues.zh: 就是这个情况
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: This condition,

cues.zh: 除了会导致面部肌肉无法控制外
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 hui4 dao3 zhi4 mian4 bu4 ji1 rou4 wu2 fa3 kong4 zhi4 wai4
cues.en: aside from causing loss of control of her facial muscles,

cues.zh: 没有什么其他坏的影响
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 shen2 me5 qi2 ta1 huai4 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: had no other harmful effects.

cues.zh: 也就是说可以不用做手术
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ke3 yi3 bu4 yong4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: In other words, surgery wasn't necessary.

cues.zh: 但小薇将形象看得很重要
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 wei1 jiang1 xing2 xiang4 kan4 de2 hen3 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: But Xiaowei considered her public image extremely important,

cues.zh: 这个问题会影响到他以后的仕途
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 dao4 ta1 yi3 hou4 de5 shi4 tu2
cues.en: and this problem would affect her future political career.

cues.zh: 所以他一定要做
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 yi2 ding4 yao4 zuo4
cues.en: So she insisted on having the surgery.

cues.zh: 摩根不想做
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 bu4 xiang3 zuo4
cues.en: Morgan didn't want to do it,

cues.zh: 但作为小薇超级粉丝的布莱克决定
cues.pinyin: dan4 zuo4 wei2 xiao3 wei1 chao1 ji2 fen3 si1 de5 bu4 lai2 ke4 jue2 ding4
cues.en: but Blake, a huge fan of Xiaowei's, decided to

cues.zh: 尊重他的意愿
cues.pinyin: zun1 zhong4 ta1 de5 yi4 yuan4
cues.en: respect her wishes

cues.zh: 并保证会尽力而为
cues.pinyin: bing4 bao3 zheng4 hui4 jin4 li4 er2 wei2
cues.en: and promised to do everything he could.

cues.zh: 他们最终决定
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zui4 zhong1 jue2 ding4
cues.en: They ultimately decided

cues.zh: 把大脑内导致压力的血管分支提起来
cues.pinyin: ba3 da4 nao3 nei4 dao3 zhi4 ya1 li4 de5 xue4 guan3 fen1 zhi1 ti2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: to lift the blood vessel branch in her brain that was causing the pressure.

cues.zh: 这样风险比较小也比较容易
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 feng1 xian3 bi3 jiao4 xiao3 ye3 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4
cues.en: This way the risk was smaller and the procedure easier.

cues.zh: 顺利的话
cues.pinyin: shun4 li4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If all went smoothly,

cues.zh: 结束之后一两天就可以出院了
cues.pinyin: jie2 shu4 zhi1 hou4 yi1 liang3 tian1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 chu1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: she could be discharged just one or two days after the surgery.

cues.zh: 小薇把他的雇员作为自己的医保代表
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 ba3 ta1 de5 gu4 yuan2 zuo4 wei2 zi4 ji3 de5 yi1 bao3 dai4 biao3
cues.en: Xiaowei had made her employee her medical proxy.

cues.zh: 布莱克不理解
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 ke4 bu4 li3 jie3
cues.en: Blake didn't understand,

cues.zh: 因为大多数人都会把自己的亲
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 da4 duo1 shu4 ren2 du1 hui4 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 qin1
cues.en: since most people would choose their own family member for that.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 十分迷茫的小布莱克
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 mi2 mang2 de5 xiao3 bu4 lai2 ke4
cues.en: Blake, utterly confused,

cues.zh: 巨大的勇气
cues.pinyin: ju4 da4 de5 yong3 qi4
cues.en: it had taken tremendous courage,

cues.zh: 这才使他成为了一个医生
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 shi3 ta1 cheng2 wei2 le5 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: that's what made him become a doctor in the first place.

cues.zh: 谁知道这时
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Who would have known that just then,

cues.zh: 小薇十分诚实的坦白
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 shi2 fen1 cheng2 shi2 de5 tan3 bai2
cues.en: Xiaowei honestly confessed

cues.zh: 这只是一个编造出来的故事而已
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 bian1 zao4 chu1 lai2 de5 gu4 shi4 er2 yi3
cues.en: that it had all just been a made-up story.

cues.zh: 布莱克瞬间陷入了迷茫
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 ke4 shun4 jian1 xian4 ru4 le5 mi2 mang2
cues.en: Blake was instantly thrown into confusion.

cues.zh: 但他没有太多的时间去怀疑人生
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 mei2 you3 tai4 duo1 de5 shi2 jian1 qu4 huai2 yi2 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: But he didn't have much time to question life,

cues.zh: 因为就要手术了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jiu4 yao4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: because the surgery was about to start.

cues.zh: 可意外的是
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi4 wai4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Unexpectedly though,

cues.zh: 手术过后的小薇陷入了昏迷
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 guo4 hou4 de5 xiao3 wei1 xian4 ru4 le5 hun1 mi2
cues.en: after the surgery, Xiaowei fell into a coma.

cues.zh: 医生给小薇做了 CT
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gei3 xiao3 wei1 zuo4 le5 CT
cues.en: The doctors gave Xiaowei a CT scan

cues.zh: 发现脑部肌底动脉肿大了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 nao3 bu4 ji1 di3 dong4 mai4 zhong3 da4 le5
cues.en: and found that her basilar artery had become swollen,

cues.zh: 正在压迫着他的脑干
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 ya1 po4 zhe5 ta1 de5 nao3 gan4
cues.en: and it was pressing on her brainstem.

cues.zh: 布莱克和摩根将这一情况告诉小薇的雇员
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 ke4 he2 mo2 gen1 jiang1 zhe4 yi1 qing2 kuang4 gao4 su4 xiao3 wei1 de5 gu4 yuan2
cues.en: Blake and Morgan told Xiaowei's employee about the situation.

cues.zh: 肌底动脉的肿胀程度很高
cues.pinyin: ji1 di3 dong4 mai4 de5 zhong3 zhang4 cheng2 du4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: The swelling of the basilar artery was severe,

cues.zh: 而且造成了进行性神经功能受损
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zao4 cheng2 le5 jin4 xing2 xing4 shen2 jing1 gong1 neng2 shou4 sun3
cues.en: and it had caused progressive neurological damage.

cues.zh: 只能进行动脉搭桥
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 jin4 xing2 dong4 mai4 da1 qiao2
cues.en: An arterial bypass was the only option left.

cues.zh: 但这个手术风险极大
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 feng1 xian3 ji2 da4
cues.en: But this surgery carried extremely high risk.

cues.zh: 希望雇员能联系一下小薇的丈夫
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 gu4 yuan2 neng2 lian2 xi4 yi1 xia4 xiao3 wei1 de5 zhang4 fu1
cues.en: They hoped the employee could contact Xiaowei's husband.

cues.zh: 但雇员觉得不能这么做
cues.pinyin: dan4 gu4 yuan2 jue2 de5 bu4 neng2 zhe4 me5 zuo4
cues.en: But the employee felt that shouldn't be done,

cues.zh: 因为如果告诉小薇丈夫的话
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ru2 guo3 gao4 su4 xiao3 wei1 zhang4 fu1 de5 hua4
cues.en: because if Xiaowei's husband were told,

cues.zh: 他会立刻赶到
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 li4 ke4 gan3 dao4
cues.en: he would rush over right away,

cues.zh: 这样势必会引起媒体的注意
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 shi4 bi4 hui4 yin3 qi3 mei2 ti3 de5 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: which would inevitably draw media attention.

cues.zh: 到时候小薇的病情就会很难瞒住了
cues.pinyin: dao4 shi2 hou4 xiao3 wei1 de5 bing4 qing2 jiu4 hui4 hen3 nan2 man2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: And then it would become very hard to keep Xiaowei's condition hidden.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 他始终为这个谎言而自豪
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi3 zhong1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 huang3 yan2 er2 zi4 hao2
cues.en: He had always been proud of this lie.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 肖恩和有着几十年经验的老医生对决
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 he2 you3 zhe5 ji3 shi2 nian2 jing1 yan4 de5 lao3 yi1 sheng1 dui4 jue2
cues.en: Shaun went head-to-head with a veteran doctor with decades of experience.

cues.zh: 到底谁输谁赢
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shui2 shu1 shui2 ying2
cues.en: Who would win and who would lose?

cues.zh: 小胖患有轻微心理衰竭
cues.pinyin: xiao3 pang4 huan4 you3 qing1 wei1 xin1 li3 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: Chubby had mild heart failure,

cues.zh: 总是感到很累以及心悸
cues.pinyin: zong3 shi4 gan3 dao4 hen3 lei4 yi3 ji2 xin1 ji4
cues.en: always feeling tired and experiencing heart palpitations.

cues.zh: 一个月前做了一次心脏搭桥
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 qian2 zuo4 le5 yi1 ci4 xin1 zang4 da1 qiao2
cues.en: A month earlier he'd had a heart bypass,

cues.zh: 可今天又突然觉得心脏不舒服
cues.pinyin: ke3 jin1 tian1 you4 tu1 ran2 jue2 de5 xin1 zang4 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: but today his heart suddenly felt uncomfortable again,

cues.zh: 所以赶紧来了最近的圣文德医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 gan3 jin3 lai2 le5 zui4 jin4 de5 sheng4 wen2 de2 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: so he rushed to the nearest hospital, St. Bonaventure.

cues.zh: 这时给他做手术的医生也赶来了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 gei3 ta1 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 yi1 sheng1 ye3 gan3 lai2 le5
cues.en: The doctor who had operated on him also rushed over.

cues.zh: 他叫钟也
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 zhong1 ye3
cues.en: His name was Zhong Ye,

cues.zh: 是个专业的心脏医生
cues.pinyin: shi4 ge4 zhuan1 ye4 de5 xin1 zang4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: a professional cardiac surgeon,

cues.zh: 是曾经还是住院医生的黑哥的外科主任
cues.pinyin: shi4 ceng2 jing1 hai2 shi4 zhu4 yuan4 yi1 sheng1 de5 hei1 ge1 de5 wai4 ke1 zhu3 ren4
cues.en: who had been Hei's surgical director back when Hei was still a resident.

cues.zh: 他给了黑哥不少专业上的帮助
cues.pinyin: ta1 gei3 le5 hei1 ge1 bu4 shao3 zhuan1 ye4 shang4 de5 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: He had given Hei a lot of professional guidance,

cues.zh: 是相当于老师的存在
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 lao3 shi1 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: essentially serving as his mentor.

cues.zh: 他让嫖医生给小胖做一下 12 连导心电图
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 piao2 yi1 sheng1 gei3 xiao3 pang4 zuo4 yi1 xia4 12 lian2 dao3 xin1 dian4 tu2
cues.en: He had Dr. Piao run a 12-lead ECG on Chubby,

cues.zh: 心脏 CT 以及血样检查
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 CT yi3 ji2 xue4 yang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: along with a cardiac CT and blood tests.

cues.zh: 黑哥一开始以为是心脏容量负
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 yi1 kai1 shi3 yi3 wei2 shi4 xin1 zang4 rong2 liang4 fu4
cues.en: At first, Hei thought it was caused by

cues.zh: 荷过度引起的
cues.pinyin: he2 guo4 du4 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: excessive volume overload on the heart.

cues.zh: 但是小胖体内的指标都很正常
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 pang4 ti3 nei4 de5 zhi3 biao1 dou1 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: But all of Chubby's test results were normal,

cues.zh: 而且他的基盖蛋白也正常
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 ji1 gai4 dan4 bai2 ye3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: and his troponin levels were normal too,

cues.zh: 说明也不是术后心肌梗塞
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 ye3 bu2 shi4 shu4 hou4 xin1 ji1 geng3 se4
cues.en: which meant it wasn't a post-op heart attack either.

cues.zh: 黑格和钟也讨论了一下
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge2 he2 zhong1 ye3 tao3 lun4 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Hei and Zhong Ye discussed it,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 可能是钟也之前手术的问题
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 zhong1 ye3 zhi1 qian2 shou3 shu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and thought it might stem from Zhong Ye's earlier surgery.

cues.zh: 小胖心脏过于有力的跳动
cues.pinyin: xiao3 pang4 xin1 zang4 guo4 yu2 you3 li4 de5 tiao4 dong4
cues.en: Chubby's heart was beating too forcefully,

cues.zh: 结果导致心脉承受不住泵压就不行了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 dao3 zhi4 xin1 mai4 cheng2 shou4 bu2 zhu4 beng4 ya1 jiu4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: causing the valve to fail under the pumping pressure.

cues.zh: 钟也决定给小胖做筋脾主动脉瓣致幻术
cues.pinyin: zhong1 ye3 jue2 ding4 gei3 xiao3 pang4 zuo4 jin1 pi2 zhu3 dong4 mai4 ban4 zhi4 huan4 shu4
cues.en: Zhong Ye decided to perform a transcatheter aortic valve replacement on Chubby,

cues.zh: 这样手术窗口最小
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 shou3 shu4 chuang1 kou3 zui4 xiao3
cues.en: which requires the smallest surgical window,

cues.zh: 比较适合刚做完一次手术的小胖
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 shi4 he2 gang1 zuo4 wan2 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4 de5 xiao3 pang4
cues.en: making it suitable for Chubby, who'd just had surgery recently.

cues.zh: 用导线将心的瓣膜通过鼓动脉输送到心脏
cues.pinyin: yong4 dao3 xian4 jiang1 xin1 de5 ban4 mo2 tong1 guo4 gu3 dong4 mai4 shu1 song4 dao4 xin1 zang4
cues.en: A wire would deliver the new valve to the heart through the femoral artery,

cues.zh: 接着让心脉扩张并安装在现有瓣的位置
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 rang4 xin1 mai4 kuo4 zhang1 bing4 an1 zhuang1 zai4 xian4 you3 ban4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: then expand it and install it at the site of the existing valve.

cues.zh: 金在这讨论着手术方案
cues.pinyin: jin1 zai4 zhe4 tao3 lun4 zhuo2 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: While they were discussing the surgical plan,

cues.zh: 病房里的小胖一点也不安省
cues.pinyin: bing4 fang2 li3 de5 xiao3 pang4 yi4 dian3 ye3 bu4 an1 sheng3
cues.en: Chubby in the ward wasn't settling down at all.

cues.zh: 他的袜子找不到了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 wa4 zi5 zhao3 bu2 dao4 le5
cues.en: He couldn't find his socks.

cues.zh: 刚好萧恩从病房外路过
cues.pinyin: gang1 hao3 xiao1 en1 cong2 bing4 fang2 wai4 lu4 guo4
cues.en: Just then Shaun happened to pass by outside the ward,

cues.zh: 就被他拉来当撞钉
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 ta1 la1 lai2 dang1 zhuang4 ding1
cues.en: and got dragged in to help out.

cues.zh: 可是萧恩也找不到他的袜子
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao1 en1 ye3 zhao3 bu2 dao4 ta1 de5 wa4 zi5
cues.en: But Shaun couldn't find his socks either.

cues.zh: 想着要不要从数钱物资区域拿一双过来
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zhe5 yao4 bu4 yao4 cong2 shu4 qian2 wu4 zi1 qu1 yu4 na2 yi1 shuang1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: He wondered whether to grab a pair from the donated-supplies area,

cues.zh: 但小胖嫌弃太劣质了就不想要
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 pang4 xian2 qi4 tai4 lie4 zhi4 le5 jiu4 bu4 xiang3 yao4
cues.en: but Chubby turned them down as too low quality.

cues.zh: 那萧恩也没办法
cues.pinyin: na4 xiao1 en1 ye3 mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: So Shaun had no choice.

cues.zh: 但当他准备离开时
cues.pinyin: dan4 dang1 ta1 zhun3 bei4 li2 kai1 shi2
cues.en: But just as he was about to leave,

cues.zh: 听到小胖抱怨了一句
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 xiao3 pang4 bao4 yuan4 le5 yi1 ju4
cues.en: he heard Chubby complain

cues.zh: 医院的空调温度太低了
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 de5 kong1 tiao2 wen1 du4 tai4 di1 le5
cues.en: that the hospital's air conditioning was set too low,

cues.zh: 脚要冷死了
cues.pinyin: jiao3 yao4 leng3 si3 le5
cues.en: and his feet were freezing.

cues.zh: 果然被萧恩碰上的病人
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 bei4 xiao1 en1 peng4 shang4 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Sure enough, any patient Shaun encountered

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 仅仅为了当官，这个女人连命都不要！好在他遇到了一群天才医生

cues.zh: 捧斩翅的技能
cues.pinyin: peng3 zhan3 chi4 de5 ji4 neng2
cues.en: couldn't escape his sharp diagnostic instincts.

cues.zh: 但萧恩也不知道是真的听不懂
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 shi4 zhen1 de5 ting1 bu4 dong3
cues.en: But it wasn't clear whether Shaun genuinely didn't get the hint,

cues.zh: 还是过于自信
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 guo4 yu2 zi4 xin4
cues.en: or was simply too confident in himself.

cues.zh: 坚持让他们根据自己的判断给小
cues.pinyin: jian1 chi2 rang4 ta1 men5 gen1 ju4 zi4 ji3 de5 pan4 duan4 gei3 xiao3
cues.en: He insisted that, based on his own judgment, they should

cues.zh: 胖做血管噪音
cues.pinyin: pang4 zuo4 xue4 guan3 zao4 yin1
cues.en: check Chubby for a vascular bruit,

cues.zh: 这样就能看到证据了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 neng2 kan4 dao4 zheng4 ju4 le5
cues.en: so they could see the evidence for themselves.

cues.zh: 萧野说他自己没有犯错
cues.pinyin: xiao1 ye3 shuo1 ta1 zi4 ji3 mei2 you3 fan4 cuo4
cues.en: Zhong Ye said he himself hadn't made any mistake,

cues.zh: 萧胖也不需要额外的治疗
cues.pinyin: xiao1 pang4 ye3 bu4 xu1 yao4 e2 wai4 de5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: and that Chubby didn't need any extra treatment.

cues.zh: 但萧恩直接说
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 zhi2 jie1 shuo1
cues.en: But Shaun bluntly said

cues.zh: 研究表明老年人更不喜欢承认错误
cues.pinyin: yan2 jiu1 biao3 ming2 lao3 nian2 ren2 geng4 bu4 xi3 huan1 cheng2 ren4 cuo4 wu4
cues.en: studies show that older people are even less willing to admit their mistakes,

cues.zh: 因为他们往往意识不到自己犯错了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 wang3 wang3 yi4 shi2 bu2 dao4 zi4 ji3 fan4 cuo4 le5
cues.en: because they often don't even realize they've made one.

cues.zh: 好家伙这是真的踩到雷区了
cues.pinyin: hao3 jia1 huo5 zhe4 shi4 zhen1 de5 cai3 dao4 lei2 qu1 le5
cues.en: Well, that really hit a nerve.

cues.zh: 别说中野本人了
cues.pinyin: bie2 shuo1 zhong1 ye3 ben3 ren2 le5
cues.en: Not to mention Zhong Ye himself,

cues.zh: 就连黑格都气得不行
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 hei1 ge2 dou1 qi4 de2 bu4 xing2
cues.en: even Hei got furious.

cues.zh: 直接让他离开
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 rang4 ta1 li2 kai1
cues.en: and told Shaun to leave immediately.

cues.zh: 孝恩也不敢违反上司的要求
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ye3 bu4 gan3 wei2 fan3 shang4 si1 de5 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: Shaun didn't dare defy his superior's order,

cues.zh: 只能离开
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 li2 kai1
cues.en: so he had no choice but to leave.

cues.zh: 但走之前还是笃定的给中野留了句
cues.pinyin: dan4 zou3 zhi1 qian2 hai2 shi4 du3 ding4 de5 gei3 zhong1 ye3 liu2 le5 ju4
cues.en: But before leaving, he firmly told Zhong Ye,

cues.zh: 你会害死他的
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 hai4 si3 ta1 de5
cues.en: "You're going to get him killed."

cues.zh: 如果孝恩是那么容易放弃的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 xiao4 en1 shi4 na4 me5 rong2 yi4 fang4 qi4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If Shaun were the type to give up that easily,

cues.zh: 他就不是孝恩了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu2 shi4 xiao4 en1 le5
cues.en: he wouldn't be Shaun.

cues.zh: 离开之后
cues.pinyin: li2 kai1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After leaving,

cues.zh: 孝恩直接去病房里找到了小胖
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhi2 jie1 qu4 bing4 fang2 li3 zhao3 dao4 le5 xiao3 pang4
cues.en: Shaun went straight to the ward to find Chubby

cues.zh: 把自己的判断告诉了他
cues.pinyin: ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 pan4 duan4 gao4 su4 le5 ta1
cues.en: and told him his own assessment,

cues.zh: 说的要多严重有多严重
cues.pinyin: shuo1 de5 yao4 duo1 yan2 zhong4 you3 duo1 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: making it sound as serious as it could possibly be,

cues.zh: 就差没说你下一刻就嘎嘭死了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 cha4 mei2 shuo1 ni3 xia4 yi1 ke4 jiu4 ga1 peng1 si3 le5
cues.en: all but saying he could drop dead the very next moment.

cues.zh: 小胖听得心惊胆战
cues.pinyin: xiao3 pang4 ting1 de2 xin1 jing1 dan3 zhan4
cues.en: Chubby was scared stiff listening to it.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 嗨我是达达我是小小我们今天要聊什么呢
cues.pinyin: hai1 wo3 shi4 da2 da2 wo3 shi4 xiao3 xiao3 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Hi, I'm Dada, and I'm Xiaoxiao. What are we talking about today?

cues.zh: 我们今天要聊笑话
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 xiao4 hua4
cues.en: Today we're going to talk about jokes.

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你一个问题哦
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 o2
cues.en: Shanshan, let me ask you a question.

cues.zh: 你只能用知道或不知道来回答
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 neng2 yong4 zhi1 dao4 huo4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 lai2 hui2 da2
cues.en: You can only answer with 'I know' or 'I don't know.'

cues.zh: 呃你问吧你知道你自己很笨吗
cues.pinyin: e4 ni3 wen4 ba5 ni3 zhi1 dao4 ni3 zi4 ji3 hen3 ben4 ma5
cues.en: Uh, go ahead. Do you know that you're silly?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 有一天全家人一起去采水果
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 quan2 jia1 ren2 yi4 qi3 qu4 cai3 shui3 guo3
cues.en: One day the whole family went fruit picking together.

cues.zh: 你们待会采到水果要洗干净才可以吃哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 dai4 hui4 cai3 dao4 shui3 guo3 yao4 xi3 gan1 jing4 cai2 ke3 yi3 chi1 o2
cues.en: Once you pick the fruit, you need to wash it before you can eat it.

cues.zh: 爸爸你在洗什么
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 ni3 zai4 xi3 shen2 me5
cues.en: Dad, what are you washing?

cues.zh: 我在洗橘子
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 xi3 ju2 zi5
cues.en: I'm washing an orange.

cues.zh: 因为我踩到橘子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 cai3 dao4 ju2 zi5
cues.en: Because I stepped on an orange.

cues.zh: 姐姐你在洗什么
cues.pinyin: jie3 jie3 ni3 zai4 xi3 shen2 me5
cues.en: Big sister, what are you washing?

cues.zh: 我在洗苹果
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 xi3 ping2 guo3
cues.en: I'm washing an apple.

cues.zh: 因为我踩到苹果
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 cai3 dao4 ping2 guo3
cues.en: Because I stepped on an apple.

cues.zh: 弟弟呢你在洗什么
cues.pinyin: di4 di5 ne5 ni3 zai4 xi3 shen2 me5
cues.en: What about you, little brother? What are you washing?

cues.zh: 我在洗鞋子
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 xi3 xie2 zi5
cues.en: I'm washing my shoes.

cues.zh: 因为我踩到大便
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 cai3 dao4 da4 bian4
cues.en: Because I stepped in poop.

cues.zh: 另一个问题哦
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 o2
cues.en: Here's another question.

cues.zh: 捷运上有五只羊
cues.pinyin: jie2 yun4 shang4 you3 wu3 zhi3 yang2
cues.en: There are five sheep on the MRT.

cues.zh: 后来又上来了一只狼
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 you4 shang4 lai2 le5 yi1 zhi1 lang2
cues.en: Then a wolf got on too.

cues.zh: 请问到站后还有几只羊呢
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 dao4 zhan4 hou4 hai2 you3 ji3 zhi1 yang2 ne5
cues.en: After the train reaches the station, how many sheep are left?

cues.zh: 羊骗我
cues.pinyin: yang2 pian4 wo3
cues.en: Are you tricking me?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 没有饭吃了
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 fan4 chi1 le5
cues.en: There's nothing left to eat.

cues.zh: 因为都被狼吃了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dou1 bei4 lang2 chi1 le5
cues.en: Because the wolf ate them all.

cues.zh: 还有五只羊
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wu3 zhi3 yang2
cues.en: There are still five sheep.

cues.zh: 因为捷运上不能吃东西
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jie2 yun4 shang4 bu4 neng2 chi1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Because you're not allowed to eat on the MRT.

cues.zh: 所以狼也不能吃羊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lang2 ye3 bu4 neng2 chi1 yang2
cues.en: So the wolf can't eat the sheep either.

cues.zh: 您和女友小美
cues.pinyin: nin2 he2 nv3 you3 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: You and your girlfriend Xiaomei

cues.zh: 在街上遇到一位小朋友
cues.pinyin: zai4 jie1 shang4 yu4 dao4 yi1 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3
cues.en: ran into a kid on the street.

cues.zh: 叔叔现在几点了
cues.pinyin: shu1 shu1 xian4 zai4 ji3 dian3 le5
cues.en: Mister, what time is it?

cues.zh: 要叫我哥哥
cues.pinyin: yao4 jiao4 wo3 ge1 ge1
cues.en: You should call me 'big brother.'

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 于是小朋友就说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: So the kid said:

cues.zh: 你看你女友都笑你了
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 ni3 nv3 you3 dou1 xiao4 ni3 le5
cues.en: Look, your girlfriend is laughing at you.

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你哦
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: Chenchen, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 一个人在回家的路上
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 zai4 hui2 jia1 de5 lu4 shang4
cues.en: A person is on the way home

cues.zh: 碰到了五只狮子
cues.pinyin: peng4 dao4 le5 wu3 zhi3 shi1 zi5
cues.en: and runs into five lions.

cues.zh: 请问它会变成什么
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 ta1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 shen2 me5
cues.en: What will he turn into?

cues.zh: 魔法药水之类的
cues.pinyin: mo2 fa3 yao4 shui3 zhi1 lei4 de5
cues.en: Something like a magic potion?

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: Nope.

cues.zh: 答案是
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4
cues.en: The answer is:

cues.zh: 它会变成五堆狮子大便
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 wu3 dui1 shi1 zi5 da4 bian4
cues.en: He'll turn into five piles of lion poop.

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 因为它被狮子吃了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 bei4 shi1 zi5 chi1 le5
cues.en: Because he got eaten by the lions.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 这次数学很难
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 shu4 xue2 hen3 nan2
cues.en: This math test was really hard.

cues.zh: 如果有问题
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: If you have any questions,

cues.zh: 可以私下来问我
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 si1 xia4 lai2 wen4 wo3
cues.en: you can come ask me privately.

cues.zh: 老师
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1
cues.en: Teacher,

cues.zh: 我有很多题都不会
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 hen3 duo1 ti2 dou1 bu2 hui4
cues.en: there are a lot of problems I don't know how to solve.

cues.zh: 你为什么把课本
cues.pinyin: ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 ba3 ke4 ben3
cues.en: Why did you

cues.zh: 撕了一张一张的
cues.pinyin: si1 le5 yi1 zhang1 yi1 zhang1 de5
cues.en: tear the textbook apart page by page?

cues.zh: 老师
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1
cues.en: Teacher,

cues.zh: 你不是要我们私下来问你吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu2 shi4 yao4 wo3 men5 si1 xia4 lai2 wen4 ni3 ma5
cues.en: didn't you say we should come ask you privately, one page at a time?

cues.zh: 医生我昨天跌倒
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 wo3 zuo2 tian1 die1 dao3
cues.en: Doctor, I fell yesterday,

cues.zh: 结果按手会痛按脚会痛按全身都会痛
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 an4 shou3 hui4 tong4 an4 jiao3 hui4 tong4 an4 quan2 shen1 du1 hui4 tong4
cues.en: and now pressing my hand hurts, pressing my foot hurts, pressing anywhere on my body hurts.

cues.zh: 我受伤是不是很严重啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 shou4 shang1 shi4 bu2 shi4 hen3 yan2 zhong4 a5
cues.en: Is my injury serious?

cues.zh: 快帮我做全身检查
cues.pinyin: kuai4 bang1 wo3 zuo4 quan2 shen1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Please give me a full-body checkup.

cues.zh: 哦没事的
cues.pinyin: o2 mei2 shi4 de5
cues.en: Oh, it's nothing.

cues.zh: 你只是食指淤血而已
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 shi4 shi2 zhi3 yu1 xue4 er2 yi3
cues.en: You just have a bruised index finger.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话22｜8个幽默爆笑笑话｜笑一笑~纾解一天的疲惫｜

cues.zh: 晨晨我考你哦
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 kao3 ni3 o2
cues.en: Chenchen, let me test you.

cues.zh: 这边有很多的筷子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 kuai4 zi5
cues.en: There are a bunch of chopsticks here.

cues.zh: 你只能移动一根
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 neng2 yi2 dong4 yi1 gen1
cues.en: You can only move one of them,

cues.zh: 要让它顺序颠倒
cues.pinyin: yao4 rang4 ta1 shun4 xu4 dian1 dao3
cues.en: and you need to reverse their order.

cues.zh: 你知道怎么做吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 zuo4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know how to do it?

cues.zh: 要倒反看吗
cues.pinyin: yao4 dao3 fan3 kan4 ma5
cues.en: Do you mean look at it from the other side?

cues.zh: 倒反看我说要移动一根
cues.pinyin: dao3 fan3 kan4 wo3 shuo1 yao4 yi2 dong4 yi1 gen1
cues.en: Looking at it from the other side — I said to move one.

cues.zh: 大家知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Does everyone know the answer?

cues.zh: 可在下方留言
cues.pinyin: ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2
cues.en: Feel free to leave it in the comments below.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 如果一觉醒来世界上只剩你一个人
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 jiao4 xing3 lai2 shi4 jie4 shang4 zhi3 sheng4 ni3 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: If you woke up one day and found you were the only person left in the world,

cues.zh: 了你会怎么样
cues.pinyin: le5 ni3 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: what would you do?

cues.zh: 这个叫伊什的男人便是如此
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 yi1 shen2 de5 nan2 ren2 bian4 shi4 ru2 ci3
cues.en: This is exactly what happened to a man named Ish.

cues.zh: 睡了一觉醒来他便发现整座城
cues.pinyin: shui4 le5 yi1 jiao4 xing3 lai2 ta1 bian4 fa1 xian4 zheng3 zuo4 cheng2
cues.en: After one night's sleep, he woke up to find the entire city

cues.zh: 市变得空空荡
cues.pinyin: shi4 bian4 de2 kong4 kong1 dang4
cues.en: had become completely empty.

cues.zh: 荡的放眼望去
cues.pinyin: dang4 de5 fang4 yan3 wang4 qu4
cues.en: As far as the eye could see,

cues.zh: 街道上只有已经腐败发臭的尸体
cues.pinyin: jie1 dao4 shang4 zhi3 you3 yi3 jing1 fu3 bai4 fa1 chou4 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: the streets held only rotting, foul-smelling corpses.

cues.zh: 根本没有一个活人
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 yi2 ge4 huo2 ren2
cues.en: There wasn't a single living person.

cues.zh: 那问题来了这个世界到底怎么了
cues.pinyin: na4 wen4 ti2 lai2 le5 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jie4 dao4 di3 zen3 me5 le5
cues.en: So the question is, what on earth happened to this world?

cues.zh: 这座城市又究竟经历了什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 shi4 you4 jiu1 jing4 jing1 li4 le5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: And what exactly did this city go through?

cues.zh: 伊什是个非常优秀的地质学家
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 shi4 ge4 fei1 chang2 you1 xiu4 de5 di4 zhi4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Ish was an excellent geologist.

cues.zh: 为了方便搞地质研究
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 fang1 bian4 gao3 di4 zhi4 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: To make his geological research easier,

cues.zh: 他直接住在了一处深山老林里面
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi2 jie1 zhu4 zai4 le5 yi1 chu4 shen1 shan1 lao3 lin2 li3 mian4
cues.en: he lived deep in the mountains and old forests,

cues.zh: 过住一种与世隔绝的生活
cues.pinyin: guo4 zhu4 yi1 zhong3 yu3 shi4 ge2 jue2 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: leading a life cut off from the world.

cues.zh: 这天他如往常一般
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 ta1 ru2 wang3 chang2 yi4 ban1
cues.en: That day, as usual,

cues.zh: 背着背包跑去踩矿场南面
cues.pinyin: bei4 zhe5 bei1 bao1 pao3 qu4 cai3 kuang4 chang3 nan2 mian4
cues.en: he carried his backpack and went to the south side of the quarry,

cues.zh: 想找到自己心心念念的黄铁矿样本
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zhao3 dao4 zi4 ji3 xin1 xin1 nian4 nian4 de5 huang2 tie3 kuang4 yang4 ben3
cues.en: hoping to find the pyrite sample he'd long been after.

cues.zh: 还很快就有了收获
cues.pinyin: hai2 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 you3 le5 shou1 huo4
cues.en: He soon made a find.

cues.zh: 然而就在伊什暗自感叹自己的好运时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 yi1 shen2 an4 zi4 gan3 tan4 zi4 ji3 de5 hao3 yun4 shi2
cues.en: But just as Ish was secretly marveling at his good luck,

cues.zh: 意外突如其来
cues.pinyin: yi4 wai4 tu1 ru2 qi2 lai2
cues.en: an accident suddenly struck.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 伊什不慎被藏在石头堆里的毒蛇咬了一口
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 bu4 shen4 bei4 cang2 zai4 shi2 tou5 dui1 li3 de5 du2 she2 yao3 le5 yi1 kou3
cues.en: Ish was accidentally bitten by a venomous snake hidden in a pile of rocks.

cues.zh: 他刚想打电话求助
cues.pinyin: ta1 gang1 xiang3 da3 dian4 hua4 qiu2 zhu4
cues.en: Just as he was about to call for help,

cues.zh: 下一秒手机便掉进了石头缝里
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3 shou3 ji1 bian4 diao4 jin4 le5 shi2 tou5 feng4 li3
cues.en: his phone slipped into a crack between the rocks the next second.

cues.zh: 这运气也真是没救了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yun4 qi4 ye3 zhen1 shi4 mei2 jiu4 le5
cues.en: His luck was truly hopeless.

cues.zh: 无奈之下
cues.pinyin: wu2 nai4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: With no other choice,

cues.zh: 伊什只能赶紧想办法自救
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 zhi3 neng2 gan3 jin3 xiang3 ban4 fa3 zi4 jiu4
cues.en: Ish had to quickly find a way to save himself.

cues.zh: 他火速掏出匕首
cues.pinyin: ta1 huo3 su4 tao1 chu1 bi3 shou3
cues.en: He whipped out a knife

cues.zh: 在伤口上划了个十字
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang1 kou3 shang4 hua4 le5 ge4 shi2 zi4
cues.en: and cut a cross-shaped slit over the wound,

cues.zh: 然后又猛吸两口毒血
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you4 meng3 xi1 liang3 kou3 du2 xue4
cues.en: then sucked out some of the venomous blood

cues.zh: 将其吐了出去
cues.pinyin: jiang1 qi2 tu3 le5 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and spat it out.

cues.zh: 然而这只能治标不能治本
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 zhe4 zhi3 neng2 zhi4 biao1 bu4 neng2 zhi4 ben3
cues.en: But this could only ease the symptom, not fix the root cause.

cues.zh: 想要获救
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 huo4 jiu4
cues.en: To be saved,

cues.zh: 伊石必须想回到自己的小屋
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 bi4 xu1 xiang3 hui2 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 xiao3 wu1
cues.en: Ish had to find a way back to his cabin.

cues.zh: 说干就干
cues.pinyin: shuo1 gan4 jiu4 gan4
cues.en: No sooner said than done,

cues.zh: 伊什果断忍着剧痛跑回家里
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 guo3 duan4 ren3 zhe5 ju4 tong4 pao3 hui2 jia1 li3
cues.en: Ish gritted through the agonizing pain and ran back home,

cues.zh: 开始疯狂灌水
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 feng1 kuang2 guan4 shui3
cues.en: and started frantically drinking water.

cues.zh: 可就算如此
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 suan4 ru2 ci3
cues.en: But even so,

cues.zh: 他依旧很快支撑不住
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 jiu4 hen3 kuai4 zhi1 cheng1 bu2 zhu4
cues.en: he quickly started to fail.

cues.zh: 哐当一下就倒在了床上
cues.pinyin: kuang1 dang1 yi1 xia4 jiu4 dao4 zai4 le5 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: He collapsed onto the bed with a thud.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 他当然还是得去医院再检查一下
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 ran2 hai2 shi4 de2 qu4 yi1 yuan4 zai4 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Of course he still needed to go to the hospital for a checkup.

cues.zh: 想到这儿
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 zhe4 er2
cues.en: With that thought,

cues.zh: 他立刻洗漱出门
cues.pinyin: ta1 li4 ke4 xi3 shu4 chu1 men2
cues.en: he quickly washed up and headed out,

cues.zh: 准备进一趟城
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 jin4 yi1 tang4 cheng2
cues.en: planning to drive into town.

cues.zh: 这时
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2
cues.en: At that moment,

cues.zh: 伊什门口的汽车已经积了很厚的一层灰
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 men2 kou3 de5 qi4 che1 yi3 jing1 ji1 le5 hen3 hou4 de5 yi1 ceng2 hui1
cues.en: the car in front of his house was already covered in a thick layer of dust.

cues.zh: 还好油箱还是满的
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 you2 xiang1 hai2 shi4 man3 de5
cues.en: Luckily, the fuel tank was still full,

cues.zh: 发动起来也没什么问题
cues.pinyin: fa1 dong4 qi3 lai2 ye3 mei2 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and it started up fine.

cues.zh: 很快伊什驾驶汽车进到了市区
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 yi1 shen2 jia4 shi3 qi4 che1 jin4 dao4 le5 shi4 qu1
cues.en: Soon Ish drove into the city,

cues.zh: 一路上却没遇到任何车辆以及行人
cues.pinyin: yi1 lu4 shang4 que4 mei2 yu4 dao4 ren4 he2 che1 liang4 yi3 ji2 xing2 ren2
cues.en: but along the way he didn't run into a single vehicle or pedestrian.

cues.zh: 这让他感觉有点不对劲
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 ta1 gan3 jue2 you3 dian3 bu2 dui4 jin4
cues.en: That made him feel something was off.

cues.zh: 却怎么都没有想到
cues.pinyin: que4 zen3 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: But he never could have guessed

cues.zh: 城市广场竟然一片狼藉
cues.pinyin: cheng2 shi4 guang3 chang3 jing4 ran2 yi1 pian4 lang2 ji2
