cues.en: that the city square was in complete chaos.

cues.zh: 大马路上还躺着一具已经腐烂的尸体
cues.pinyin: da4 ma3 lu4 shang4 hai2 tang3 zhe5 yi1 ju4 yi3 jing1 fu3 lan4 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: A rotting corpse lay on the main road.

cues.zh: 这一刻
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ke4
cues.en: At that moment,

cues.zh: 伊什简直不敢相信自己的眼睛
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 jian3 zhi2 bu4 gan3 xiang1 xin4 zi4 ji3 de5 yan3 jing1
cues.en: Ish simply couldn't believe his eyes.

cues.zh: 他尝试探索周边地图
cues.pinyin: ta1 chang2 shi4 tan4 suo3 zhou1 bian1 di4 tu2
cues.en: He tried to explore the area around him,

cues.zh: 但这里的气氛太过诡异
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 li3 de5 qi4 fen1 tai4 guo4 gui3 yi4
cues.en: but the atmosphere here was far too eerie.

cues.zh: 安静得只能听见他的脚步声
cues.pinyin: an1 jing4 de2 zhi3 neng2 ting1 jian4 ta1 de5 jiao3 bu4 sheng1
cues.en: It was so quiet he could only hear his own footsteps

cues.zh: 和一旁气球人被风不断吹倒的声响
cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 pang2 qi4 qiu2 ren2 bei4 feng1 bu4 duan4 chui1 dao4 de5 sheng1 xiang3
cues.en: and the sound of an inflatable figure nearby being knocked over again and again by the wind.

cues.zh: 不过这还不是最要命的
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 hai2 bu2 shi4 zui4 yao4 ming4 de5
cues.en: But that wasn't even the worst part.

cues.zh: 伊什竟然发现
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 jing4 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Ish was shocked to discover

cues.zh: 一旁电子牌上写着
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 dian4 zi5 pai2 shang4 xie3 zhe5
cues.en: that an electronic sign nearby read:

cues.zh: 流行病毒大爆发
cues.pinyin: liu2 xing2 bing4 du2 da4 bao4 fa1
cues.en: "Pandemic outbreak.

cues.zh: 请大家就地避难
cues.pinyin: qing3 da4 jia1 jiu4 di4 bi4 nan4
cues.en: Please shelter in place."

cues.zh: 伊什差点被吓到崩溃
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 cha4 dian3 bei4 xia4 dao4 beng1 kui4
cues.en: Ish nearly broke down in shock.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 伊什爸妈没有半点回应
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 ba4 ma1 mei2 you3 ban4 dian3 hui2 ying4
cues.en: His parents didn't respond at all.

cues.zh: 一旁的餐桌上
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 de5 can1 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: On the dining table nearby,

cues.zh: 还摆着一些来不及收拾的食物
cues.pinyin: hai2 bai3 zhe5 yi1 xie1 lai2 bu4 ji2 shou1 shi2 de5 shi2 wu4
cues.en: there was still food that hadn't been cleared away.

cues.zh: 这让伊什心里有了种非常不祥的预感
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 yi1 shen2 xin1 li3 you3 le5 zhong3 fei1 chang2 bu4 xiang2 de5 yu4 gan3
cues.en: This gave Ish a terrible premonition.

cues.zh: 果不其然
cues.pinyin: guo3 bu4 qi2 ran2
cues.en: Sure enough,

cues.zh: 当他推开卧室房门
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 tui1 kai1 wo4 shi4 fang2 men2
cues.en: when he pushed open the bedroom door,

cues.zh: 一股恶臭扑面而来
cues.pinyin: yi1 gu3 e4 chou4 pu1 mian4 er2 lai2
cues.en: a foul stench hit him in the face.

cues.zh: 他爸倒在床上一动不动
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba4 dao4 zai4 chuang2 shang4 yi1 dong4 bu4 dong4
cues.en: His father lay motionless on the bed.

cues.zh: 伊什忍不住抽泣起来
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 ren3 bu2 zhu4 chou1 qi4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Ish couldn't hold back and started sobbing.

cues.zh: 结果一转身
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 yi1 zhuan3 shen1
cues.en: Then, as he turned around,

cues.zh: 又看见他妈倒在卫生间里
cues.pinyin: you4 kan4 jian4 ta1 ma1 dao4 zai4 wei4 sheng1 jian1 li3
cues.en: he saw his mother lying in the bathroom,

cues.zh: 失去了呼吸
cues.pinyin: shi1 qu4 le5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: no longer breathing.

cues.zh: 这下伊什彻底崩溃了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 yi1 shen2 che4 di3 beng1 kui4 le5
cues.en: This time Ish completely broke down.

cues.zh: 他怎么都没有想到
cues.pinyin: ta1 zen3 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: He never could have imagined

cues.zh: 一觉醒来
cues.pinyin: yi1 jiao4 xing3 lai2
cues.en: that after just one night's sleep,

cues.zh: 世界竟然发生了那么大的变化
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 jing4 ran2 fa1 sheng1 le5 na4 me5 da4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: the world would change so drastically.

cues.zh: 但他并没有悲痛很久
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 bing4 mei2 you3 bei1 tong4 hen3 jiu3
cues.en: But he didn't grieve for long.

cues.zh: 很快便强打精神
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 bian4 qiang2 da3 jing1 shen2
cues.en: He soon pulled himself together

cues.zh: 在自家后院挖了个大坑
cues.pinyin: zai4 zi4 jia1 hou4 yuan4 wa1 le5 ge4 da4 keng1
cues.en: and dug a big pit in his own backyard,

cues.zh: 准备让两位老人入土为安
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 rang4 liang3 wei4 lao3 ren2 ru4 tu3 wei2 an1
cues.en: preparing to lay his parents to rest.

cues.zh: 至于接下来
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 jie1 xia4 lai2
cues.en: As for what came next,

cues.zh: 他该做些什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 gai1 zuo4 xie1 shen2 me5
cues.en: what he should do,

cues.zh: 又能做些什么
cues.pinyin: you4 neng2 zuo4 xie1 shen2 me5
cues.en: and what he even could do,

cues.zh: 他实在不知道
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi2 zai4 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: he really had no idea.

cues.zh: 埋葬掉两位老人后
cues.pinyin: mai2 zang4 diao4 liang3 wei4 lao3 ren2 hou4
cues.en: After burying his parents,

cues.zh: 夜幕很快降临
cues.pinyin: ye4 mu4 hen3 kuai4 jiang4 lin2
cues.en: night fell quickly.

cues.zh: 伊什躺在自己儿时的房间里想了很久
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 tang3 zai4 zi4 ji3 er2 shi2 de5 fang2 jian1 li3 xiang3 le5 hen3 jiu3
cues.en: Ish lay in his childhood bedroom and thought for a long time.

cues.zh: 以前他很喜欢一个人待着
cues.pinyin: yi3 qian2 ta1 hen3 xi3 huan1 yi2 ge4 ren2 dai4 zhe5
cues.en: He used to really enjoy being alone.

cues.zh: 对他来说
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: To him,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 这意味着学习的自由与个人的安静
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 xue2 xi2 de5 zi4 you2 yu3 ge4 ren2 de5 an1 jing4
cues.en: that had meant the freedom to study and the quiet of being by himself.

cues.zh: 可现在
cues.pinyin: ke3 xian4 zai4
cues.en: But now,

cues.zh: 当世界真的只剩下他一个人
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi4 jie4 zhen1 de5 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: with the world truly down to just him,

cues.zh: 他的心情却一下变得非常复杂
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 qing2 que4 yi1 xia4 bian4 de2 fei1 chang2 fu4 za2
cues.en: his feelings suddenly turned very complicated.

cues.zh: 此日
cues.pinyin: ci3 ri4
cues.en: On this day,

cues.zh: 伊什走出家门
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 zou3 chu1 jia1 men2
cues.en: Ish walked out of the house,

cues.zh: 想要找到其他的幸存者
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 zhao3 dao4 qi2 ta1 de5 xing4 cun2 zhe3
cues.en: hoping to find other survivors.

cues.zh: 可是不论是街道上
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bu4 lun4 shi4 jie1 dao4 shang4
cues.en: But whether on the streets

cues.zh: 还是教堂里
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jiao4 tang2 li3
cues.en: or in the church,

cues.zh: 他所到之处
cues.pinyin: ta1 suo3 dao4 zhi1 chu4
cues.en: everywhere he went,

cues.zh: 能够见到的
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 jian4 dao4 de5
cues.en: all he could find

cues.zh: 除了尸体
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: besides corpses

cues.zh: 还是尸体
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 shi1 ti3
cues.en: was more corpses.

cues.zh: 这让伊什几近崩溃
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 yi1 shen2 ji3 jin4 beng1 kui4
cues.en: This nearly drove Ish to a breakdown.

cues.zh: 可就算如此
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 suan4 ru2 ci3
cues.en: But even so,

cues.zh: 伊什依旧没想过放弃
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 yi1 jiu4 mei2 xiang3 guo4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: Ish still never thought about giving up.

cues.zh: 他先跑去超市推了个购物车
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian1 pao3 qu4 chao1 shi4 tui1 le5 ge4 gou4 wu4 che1
cues.en: He first ran to the supermarket and grabbed a shopping cart,

cues.zh: 打算准备好物资
cues.pinyin: da3 suan4 zhun3 bei4 hao3 wu4 zi1
cues.en: planning to stock up on supplies,

cues.zh: 便立刻去更大的城市看看
cues.pinyin: bian4 li4 ke4 qu4 geng4 da4 de5 cheng2 shi4 kan4 kan4
cues.en: then immediately go check out a bigger city.

cues.zh: 或许那里会有幸存者残留呢
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 na4 li3 hui4 you3 xing4 cun2 zhe3 can2 liu2 ne5
cues.en: Maybe there would be survivors left there.

cues.zh: 然而让伊什意想不到的是
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 rang4 yi1 shen2 yi4 xiang3 bu4 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But to Ish's surprise,

cues.zh: 出城的大桥竟然被人给封死了
cues.pinyin: chu1 cheng2 de5 da4 qiao2 jing4 ran2 bei4 ren2 gei3 feng1 si3 le5
cues.en: the bridge out of the city had actually been sealed off.

cues.zh: 面对如此场景
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 ru2 ci3 chang3 jing3
cues.en: Faced with a scene like this,

cues.zh: 一直在竭力保持冷静的伊什
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 zai4 jie2 li4 bao3 chi2 leng3 jing4 de5 yi1 shen2
cues.en: Ish, who had been trying hard to stay calm this whole time,

cues.zh: 心中的委屈
cues.pinyin: xin1 zhong1 de5 wei3 qu1
cues.en: finally couldn't hold back the grievance in his heart,

cues.zh: 愤怒终于忍不住爆发了
cues.pinyin: fen4 nu4 zhong1 yu2 ren3 bu2 zhu4 bao4 fa1 le5
cues.en: and his anger burst out.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2024最新末日灾难美剧《大地永存》！开播30分钟评分就飚到了9.6！一觉醒来世界只剩你一个人

cues.zh: 这让伊什愈发崩溃
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 yi1 shen2 yu4 fa1 beng1 kui4
cues.en: This pushed Ish even closer to breaking down.

cues.zh: 忍不住地想
cues.pinyin: ren3 bu2 zhu4 di4 xiang3
cues.en: He couldn't help but wonder,

cues.zh: 难道这世上真的只剩下他一个人了
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 zhe4 shi4 shang4 zhen1 de5 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2 le5
cues.en: could he really be the only person left in this world?

cues.zh: 伊什不敢往深处想
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 bu4 gan3 wang3 shen1 chu4 xiang3
cues.en: Ish didn't dare think any further.

cues.zh: 在顶楼泡了个澡
cues.pinyin: zai4 ding3 lou2 pao4 le5 ge4 zao3
cues.en: He took a bath on the top floor,

cues.zh: 连毛巾都没擦
cues.pinyin: lian2 mao2 jin1 dou1 mei2 ca1
cues.en: not even bothering to dry off with a towel,

cues.zh: 就跑去吧台找酒喝
cues.pinyin: jiu4 pao3 qu4 ba1 tai2 zhao3 jiu3 he1
cues.en: and went straight to the bar to find a drink.

cues.zh: 伊什想用酒精麻醉一下自己
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 xiang3 yong4 jiu3 jing1 ma2 zui4 yi1 xia4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Ish wanted to numb himself with alcohol.

cues.zh: 至于衣服
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 yi1 fu2
cues.en: As for clothes,

cues.zh: 世上人都死光了
cues.pinyin: shi4 shang4 ren2 dou1 si3 guang1 le5
cues.en: with everyone in the world already dead,

cues.zh: 穿不穿衣服
cues.pinyin: chuan1 bu4 chuan1 yi1 fu2
cues.en: whether he wore any

cues.zh: 伊什也觉得不重要了
cues.pinyin: yi1 shen2 ye3 jue2 de5 bu2 zhong4 yao4 le5
cues.en: no longer seemed to matter to Ish.

cues.zh: 然而谁能想到呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 shui2 neng2 xiang3 dao4 ne5
cues.en: But who could have guessed,

cues.zh: 那酒还没下肚
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu3 hai2 mei2 xia4 du4
cues.en: before the alcohol had even gone down,

cues.zh: 不远处便传来一个女子的声响
cues.pinyin: bu4 yuan3 chu4 bian4 chuan2 lai2 yi2 ge4 nv3 zi3 de5 sheng1 xiang3
cues.en: a woman's voice suddenly rang out nearby.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 流传8000年的古老技艺，在这位80后手中焕发新生

cues.zh: 我一直生活在生机盎然的云南
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi4 zhi2 sheng1 huo2 zai4 sheng1 ji1 ang4 ran2 de5 yun2 nan2
cues.en: I have always lived in Yunnan, a place bursting with vitality.

cues.zh: 植被茂盛富有生命力
cues.pinyin: zhi2 bei4 mao4 sheng4 fu4 you3 sheng1 ming4 li4
cues.en: The vegetation there is lush and full of life.

cues.zh: 在一次偶然中遇见了历经千年依
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi1 ci4 ou3 ran2 zhong1 yu4 jian4 le5 li4 jing1 qian1 nian2 yi1
cues.en: By chance, I encountered something that, after a thousand years,

cues.zh: 然能散发出生
cues.pinyin: ran2 neng2 san4 fa4 chu1 sheng1
cues.en: could still radiate

cues.zh: 命光芒的奇迹
cues.pinyin: ming4 guang1 mang2 de5 qi2 ji4
cues.en: the brilliance of life — a miracle.

cues.zh: 两种生命的质感交融在一起
cues.pinyin: liang3 zhong3 sheng1 ming4 de5 zhi4 gan3 jiao1 rong2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: The textures of two kinds of life blended together.

cues.zh: 在那个当下我决定在这里开始以犀皮为伴
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 ge5 dang1 xia4 wo3 jue2 ding4 zai4 zhe4 li3 kai1 shi3 yi3 xi1 pi2 wei4 ban4
cues.en: In that moment, I decided to start here, accompanying xipi lacquer.

cues.zh: 将自然和犀皮建立连结
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zi4 ran2 he2 xi1 pi2 jian4 li4 lian2 jie2
cues.en: Building a connection between nature and xipi lacquer.

cues.zh: 技艺在中国已经有八千多年的历史
cues.pinyin: ji4 yi4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 yi3 jing1 you3 ba1 qian1 duo1 nian2 de5 li4 shi3
cues.en: This craft has a history of over eight thousand years in China.

cues.zh: 裱布上灰刮灰
cues.pinyin: biao3 bu4 shang4 hui1 gua1 hui1
cues.en: Mounting cloth, applying and scraping the ash ground.

cues.zh: 打磨上漆推光
cues.pinyin: da3 mo2 shang4 qi1 tui1 guang1
cues.en: Polishing, lacquering, and burnishing to a shine.

cues.zh: 数十道工序周而复始
cues.pinyin: shu4 shi2 dao4 gong1 xu4 zhou1 er2 fu4 shi3
cues.en: Dozens of steps repeat over and over again.

cues.zh: 需要经历少则几十道
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 jing1 li4 shao3 ze2 ji3 shi2 dao4
cues.en: It takes at least several dozen steps,

cues.zh: 多则上百道的工序
cues.pinyin: duo1 ze2 shang4 bai3 dao4 de5 gong1 xu4
cues.en: and at most over a hundred steps.

cues.zh: 千百年来
cues.pinyin: qian1 bai3 nian2 lai2
cues.en: For thousands of years,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 流传8000年的古老技艺，在这位80后手中焕发新生

cues.zh: 在初遇苏格兰百富威士忌时
cues.pinyin: zai4 chu1 yu4 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 wei1 shi4 ji4 shi2
cues.en: when I first encountered Balvenie Scotch whisky,

cues.zh: 达夫镇的一代代酿酒师们
cues.pinyin: da2 fu1 zhen4 de5 yi2 dai4 dai4 niang4 jiu3 shi1 men5
cues.en: generation after generation of distillers in Dufftown

cues.zh: 一生只专注于一件事
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 zhi3 zhuan1 zhu4 yu2 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: devoted their whole lives to just one thing.

cues.zh: 种植制麦贩卖
cues.pinyin: zhong4 zhi2 zhi4 mai4 fan4 mai4
cues.en: growing, malting, and selling,

cues.zh: 传统酿造
cues.pinyin: chuan2 tong3 niang4 zao4
cues.en: traditional brewing and distilling.

cues.zh: 他们秉承的天作一半
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bing3 cheng2 de5 tian1 zuo4 yi2 ban4
cues.en: The philosophy they uphold — half made by heaven,

cues.zh: 人作一半的理念打动了我
cues.pinyin: ren2 zuo4 yi2 ban4 de5 li3 nian4 da3 dong4 le5 wo3
cues.en: half made by man — moved me.

cues.zh: 这与我心中的大漆很相似
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yu3 wo3 xin1 zhong1 de5 da4 qi1 hen3 xiang1 si4
cues.en: It closely resembles the great lacquer art in my heart.

cues.zh: 来自漆艺的生漆
cues.pinyin: lai2 zi4 qi1 yi4 de5 sheng1 qi1
cues.en: Raw lacquer, born of this craft.

cues.zh: 在一代代匠人革新技艺的手中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 dai4 dai4 jiang4 ren2 ge2 xin1 ji4 yi4 de5 shou3 zhong1
cues.en: In the hands of generations of craftsmen renewing their craft,

cues.zh: 变化成不朽的作品
cues.pinyin: bian4 hua4 cheng2 bu4 xiu3 de5 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: it transforms into an immortal work.

cues.zh: 创新在威士忌酿造技艺中
cues.pinyin: chuang4 xin1 zai4 wei1 shi4 ji4 niang4 zao4 ji4 yi4 zhong1
cues.en: Innovation in the craft of whisky-making

cues.zh: 同样重要
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: is equally important.

cues.zh: 苏格兰百富传奇酿酒大师
cues.pinyin: su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 chuan2 qi2 niang4 jiu3 da4 shi1
cues.en: Balvenie's legendary Scotch master distiller,

cues.zh: 大卫斯图尔特 60 年来
cues.pinyin: da4 wei4 si1 tu2 er3 te4 60 nian2 lai2
cues.en: David Stewart, for sixty years,

cues.zh: 致力也以过同酿酒记忆
cues.pinyin: zhi4 li4 ye3 yi3 guo4 tong2 niang4 jiu3 ji4 yi4
cues.en: has devoted himself to his own distinctive distilling craft,

cues.zh: 实现苏格兰百富系列
cues.pinyin: shi2 xian4 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 xi4 lie4
cues.en: achieving breakthroughs for the Balvenie range

cues.zh: 在风味上的突破
cues.pinyin: zai4 feng1 wei4 shang4 de5 tu1 po4
cues.en: in flavor,

cues.zh: 与品质的不断攀登
cues.pinyin: yu3 pin3 zhi4 di4 bu4 duan4 pan1 deng1
cues.en: and a continuous rise in quality.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 流传8000年的古老技艺，在这位80后手中焕发新生

cues.zh: 时光沉淀出自然造物的香味
cues.pinyin: shi2 guang1 chen2 dian4 chu1 zi4 ran2 zao4 wu4 de5 xiang1 wei4
cues.en: Time distills the fragrance of nature's creations,

cues.zh: 与匠心的加酿
cues.pinyin: yu3 jiang4 xin1 de5 jia1 niang4
cues.en: together with aging crafted from devotion,

cues.zh: 更给予了我新的灵感
cues.pinyin: geng4 ji3 yu3 le5 wo3 xin1 de5 ling2 gan3
cues.en: giving me fresh inspiration.

cues.zh: 葫芦是人类有历史记载以来
cues.pinyin: hu2 lu2 shi4 ren2 lei4 you3 li4 shi3 ji4 zai3 yi3 lai2
cues.en: The gourd, since the dawn of recorded human history,

cues.zh: 最早被作为酒器的植物之一
cues.pinyin: zui4 zao3 bei4 zuo4 wei2 jiu3 qi4 de5 zhi2 wu4 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: is one of the earliest plants used as a wine vessel,

cues.zh: 也是大自然造物的美妙杰作
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 da4 zi4 ran2 zao4 wu4 de5 mei3 miao4 jie2 zuo4
cues.en: and also a wondrous masterpiece of nature.

cues.zh: 以昆明产的大型葫芦
cues.pinyin: yi3 kun1 ming2 chan3 de5 da4 xing2 hu2 lu2
cues.en: Using large gourds grown in Kunming

cues.zh: 作为七夕的胎体
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 qi1 xi1 de5 tai1 ti3
cues.en: as the body for the lacquer craft,

cues.zh: 用近乎失传的飘漆记忆
cues.pinyin: yong4 jin4 hu1 shi1 chuan2 de5 piao1 qi1 ji4 yi4
cues.en: and the nearly lost technique of "floating lacquer,"

cues.zh: 让如百复威士忌酒院一般流动的色彩
cues.pinyin: rang4 ru2 bai3 fu4 wei1 shi4 ji4 jiu3 yuan4 yi4 ban1 liu2 dong4 de5 se4 cai3
cues.en: colors flow like liquid Balvenie whisky,

cues.zh: 漂流在气温外观上
cues.pinyin: piao1 liu2 zai4 qi4 wen1 wai4 guan1 shang4
cues.en: drifting across the surface of the vessel's form —

cues.zh: 温润的光泽
cues.pinyin: wen1 run4 de5 guang1 ze2
cues.en: a warm, mellow luster,

cues.zh: 流动的自由
cues.pinyin: liu2 dong4 de5 zi4 you2
cues.en: a flowing freedom,

cues.zh: 与气异表面完整保留的植物基礼
cues.pinyin: yu3 qi4 yi4 biao3 mian4 wan2 zheng3 bao3 liu2 de5 zhi2 wu4 ji1 li3
cues.en: together with the plant texture fully preserved on the xipi lacquer surface,

cues.zh: 在时间里一同沉淀
cues.pinyin: zai4 shi2 jian1 li3 yi1 tong2 chen2 dian4
cues.en: settle together over time,

cues.zh: 改变
cues.pinyin: gai3 bian4
cues.en: changing,

cues.zh: 焕然出新的色彩
cues.pinyin: huan4 ran2 chu1 xin1 de5 se4 cai3
cues.en: and emerging anew in radiant color.

cues.zh: 手造的降星与天然的雕琢
cues.pinyin: shou3 zao4 de5 jiang4 xing1 yu3 tian1 ran2 de5 diao1 zhuo2
cues.en: Handcrafted devotion and natural carving

cues.zh: 融合成这款柏树冰桶
cues.pinyin: rong2 he2 cheng2 zhe4 kuan3 bai3 shu4 bing1 tong3
cues.en: blend together into this Balvenie ice bucket.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 流传8000年的古老技艺，在这位80后手中焕发新生

cues.zh: 而苏格兰柏树威士忌的酿造机
cues.pinyin: er2 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 shu4 wei1 shi4 ji4 de5 niang4 zao4 ji1
cues.en: And the craft of brewing Scotch Balvenie whisky,

cues.zh: 与数千年七亿的传承
cues.pinyin: yu3 shu4 qian1 nian2 qi1 yi4 de5 chuan2 cheng2
cues.en: together with thousands of years of lacquer-art heritage,

cues.zh: 也在此有了碰撞融合
cues.pinyin: ye3 zai4 ci3 you3 le5 peng4 zhuang4 rong2 he2
cues.en: collide and fuse here as well.

cues.zh: 在自然胎体七亿冰桶中感受自然
cues.pinyin: zai4 zi4 ran2 tai1 ti3 qi1 yi4 bing1 tong3 zhong1 gan3 shou4 zi4 ran2
cues.en: Feel nature inside this natural-bodied lacquer-art ice bucket,

cues.zh: 冰块融入苏格兰柏树威士忌
cues.pinyin: bing1 kuai4 rong2 ru4 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 shu4 wei1 shi4 ji4
cues.en: as ice melts into Scotch Balvenie whisky,

cues.zh: 带来鲜活的口感
cues.pinyin: dai4 lai2 xian1 huo2 de5 kou3 gan3
cues.en: bringing a lively taste.

cues.zh: 与数十年酿造的生命之水中
cues.pinyin: yu3 shu4 shi2 nian2 niang4 zao4 de5 sheng1 ming4 zhi1 shui3 zhong1
cues.en: And in this water of life, brewed over decades,

cues.zh: 品味蜂蜜香肠
cues.pinyin: pin3 wei4 feng1 mi4 xiang1 chang2
cues.en: taste the honeyed sweetness

cues.zh: 橡默的自然韵味
cues.pinyin: xiang4 mo4 de5 zi4 ran2 yun4 wei4
cues.en: and the natural character of oak.

cues.zh: 让饱满的甜润流淌于纯时间
cues.pinyin: rang4 bao3 man3 de5 tian2 run4 liu2 tang3 yu2 chun2 shi2 jian1
cues.en: letting that full, mellow sweetness flow across the palate.

cues.zh: 在匠心中穿越时光与自然对话
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiang4 xin1 zhong1 chuan1 yue4 shi2 guang1 yu3 zi4 ran2 dui4 hua4
cues.en: In craftsmanship, conversing with nature across time,

cues.zh: 顺应而为
cues.pinyin: shun4 ying4 er2 wei4
cues.en: going with the flow,

cues.zh: 正是人做一半的美好
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 ren2 zuo4 yi2 ban4 de5 mei3 hao3
cues.en: this is exactly the beauty of "half made by man."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季06】天才医生肖恩全力抢救患者，可同事却盯上了患者的心脏，想要移值给自己的病人，肖恩怒了！

cues.zh: 肖恩和朴医生因为一颗心脏差点大打出手
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 he2 pu3 yi1 sheng1 yin1 wei4 yi1 ke1 xin1 zang4 cha4 dian3 da4 da3 chu1 shou3
cues.en: Shaun and Dr. Park nearly came to blows over a heart.

cues.zh: 摩根拿病人做筹码最终得以升职加薪
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 na2 bing4 ren2 zuo4 chou2 ma3 zui4 zhong1 de2 yi3 sheng1 zhi2 jia1 xin1
cues.en: Morgan used a patient as leverage and ended up getting a promotion and a raise.

cues.zh: 大壮户外作业的时候
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 hu4 wai4 zuo4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While Dazhuang was working outdoors,

cues.zh: 从 10 米高的架子上掉了下来
cues.pinyin: cong2 10 mi3 gao1 de5 jia4 zi5 shang4 diao4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: he fell from scaffolding 10 meters high,

cues.zh: 造成头部严重外伤
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 tou2 bu4 yan2 zhong4 wai4 shang1
cues.en: causing severe head trauma.

cues.zh: 身上多处骨折状态很不稳定
cues.pinyin: shen1 shang4 duo1 chu4 gu3 zhe2 zhuang4 tai4 hen3 bu4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: He had multiple fractures and his condition was very unstable.

cues.zh: 能撑到来医院已经很不容易了
cues.pinyin: neng2 cheng1 dao4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 yi3 jing1 hen3 bu4 rong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: It was already a feat that he made it to the hospital alive.

cues.zh: 肖恩一刻不敢耽误
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 yi1 ke4 bu4 gan3 dan1 wu4
cues.en: Shaun didn't dare waste a single moment

cues.zh: 立马检查大壮的情况
cues.pinyin: li4 ma3 jian3 cha2 da4 zhuang4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: and immediately examined Dazhuang's condition.

cues.zh: 内出血严重
cues.pinyin: nei4 chu1 xue4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: He had severe internal bleeding

cues.zh: 失血过多
cues.pinyin: shi1 xue4 guo4 duo1
cues.en: and had lost too much blood.

cues.zh: 腹部积血过多
cues.pinyin: fu4 bu4 ji1 xue4 guo4 duo1
cues.en: Too much blood had pooled in his abdomen,

cues.zh: 无法看清具体状况
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 kan4 qing1 ju4 ti3 zhuang4 kuang4
cues.en: making it impossible to see his exact condition clearly.

cues.zh: 大壮很快发生了呼吸衰竭
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 hen3 kuai4 fa1 sheng1 le5 hu1 xi1 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: Dazhuang quickly went into respiratory failure

cues.zh: 立马就被送去了急救
cues.pinyin: li4 ma3 jiu4 bei4 song4 qu4 le5 ji2 jiu4
cues.en: and was rushed into emergency care.

cues.zh: 可大壮情况实在严重
cues.pinyin: ke3 da4 zhuang4 qing2 kuang4 shi2 zai4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: But Dazhuang's condition was truly dire —

cues.zh: 缺压一直下降
cues.pinyin: que1 ya1 yi4 zhi2 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: his blood pressure kept dropping,

cues.zh: 药量已经用到了极限
cues.pinyin: yao4 liang4 yi3 jing1 yong4 dao4 le5 ji2 xian4
cues.en: and the medication dosage had already hit its limit.

cues.zh: 救回来的几率小之又小
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui2 lai2 de5 ji1 lv4 xiao3 zhi1 you4 xiao3
cues.en: The chance of saving him was slim to none.

cues.zh: 朴医生在一旁围观
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 zai4 yi1 pang2 wei2 guan1
cues.en: Dr. Park watched from the sidelines.

cues.zh: 眼看大壮很可能救不回来了
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 da4 zhuang4 hen3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 bu4 hui2 lai2 le5
cues.en: Seeing that Dazhuang likely couldn't be saved,

cues.zh: 就起了其他心思
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qi3 le5 qi2 ta1 xin1 si1
cues.en: she started having other ideas.

cues.zh: 大壮是阴性 O 型血
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 shi4 yin1 xing4 O xing2 xue4
cues.en: Dazhuang had type O-negative blood,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季06】天才医生肖恩全力抢救患者，可同事却盯上了患者的心脏，想要移值给自己的病人，肖恩怒了！

cues.zh: 也就是我们所说的熊猫血
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 suo3 shuo1 de5 xiong2 mao1 xue4
cues.en: what's known as 'panda blood' — an extremely rare type.

cues.zh: 而她手下有一个同血型的心脏病患者
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 shou3 xia4 you3 yi2 ge4 tong2 xue4 xing2 de5 xin1 zang4 bing4 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: And she had a heart patient under her care with the same blood type,

cues.zh: 急需移植心脏
cues.pinyin: ji2 xu1 yi2 zhi2 xin1 zang4
cues.en: who urgently needed a heart transplant.

cues.zh: 如果大壮生前签署了器官移植协议
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 da4 zhuang4 sheng1 qian2 qian1 shu3 le5 qi4 guan1 yi2 zhi2 xie2 yi4
cues.en: If Dazhuang had signed an organ donation agreement while alive,

cues.zh: 那么她的病人就有所救了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 bing4 ren2 jiu4 you3 suo3 jiu4 le5
cues.en: then her patient would have a chance to be saved.

cues.zh: 可笑音表示
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao4 yin1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But Shaun said

cues.zh: 大壮有没有签协议都无所谓
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 you3 mei2 you3 qian1 xie2 yi4 dou1 wu2 suo3 wei4
cues.en: it didn't matter whether Dazhuang had signed the agreement,

cues.zh: 因为自己一定会救活她
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 yi2 ding4 hui4 jiu4 huo2 ta1
cues.en: because he himself would definitely save him.

cues.zh: 那行吧
cues.pinyin: na4 xing2 ba5
cues.en: Fine then,

cues.zh: 你先救着
cues.pinyin: ni3 xian1 jiu4 zhe5
cues.en: you keep trying to save him for now,

cues.zh: 我去通知我的病人
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 tong1 zhi1 wo3 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: and I'll go tell my patient.

cues.zh: 朴医生的心脏病患者
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 de5 xin1 zang4 bing4 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: Dr. Park's heart patient

cues.zh: 是一个叫小丽的小姑娘
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 jiao4 xiao3 li4 de5 xiao3 gu1 niang2
cues.en: was a little girl named Xiaoli.

cues.zh: 如果再不移植一个新的心脏
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 bu4 yi2 zhi2 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 xin1 zang4
cues.en: If she didn't get a new heart transplanted soon,

cues.zh: 很可能就活不了多久了
cues.pinyin: hen3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 huo2 bu4 liao3 duo1 jiu3 le5
cues.en: she likely wouldn't have much longer to live.

cues.zh: 而她们都知道
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 men5 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: And they both knew

cues.zh: 能和小丽匹配的心脏实在少签
cues.pinyin: neng2 he2 xiao3 li4 pi3 pei4 de5 xin1 zang4 shi2 zai4 shao3 qian1
cues.en: that a heart matching Xiaoli was extremely rare.

cues.zh: 能和小丽匹配的心脏实在少见
cues.pinyin: neng2 he2 xiao3 li4 pi3 pei4 de5 xin1 zang4 shi2 zai4 shao3 jian4
cues.en: Too many previous matching attempts had already failed.

cues.zh: 眼看小丽时日无多
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 xiao3 li4 shi2 ri4 wu2 duo1
cues.en: Seeing that Xiaoli had little time left,

cues.zh: 小丽妈妈就打算带着小丽出去旅行
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 ma1 ma1 jiu4 da3 suan4 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 li4 chu1 qu4 lv3 xing2
cues.en: her mom planned to take her on a trip,

cues.zh: 起码让她活着的时候不留遗憾
cues.pinyin: qi3 ma3 rang4 ta1 huo2 zhe5 de5 shi2 hou4 bu4 liu2 yi2 han4
cues.en: so that at least she'd have no regrets while she was still alive.

cues.zh: 而朴医生一个电话就把他们叫了回来
cues.pinyin: er2 pu3 yi1 sheng1 yi2 ge4 dian4 hua4 jiu4 ba3 ta1 men5 jiao4 le5 hui2 lai2
cues.en: But Dr. Park called them back with a single phone call,

cues.zh: 顺便还做了 CT
cues.pinyin: shun4 bian4 hai2 zuo4 le5 CT
cues.en: and had her get a CT scan while she was there.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季06】天才医生肖恩全力抢救患者，可同事却盯上了患者的心脏，想要移值给自己的病人，肖恩怒了！

cues.zh: 再也没说过话
cues.pinyin: zai4 ye3 mei2 shuo1 guo4 hua4
cues.en: They never spoke to each other again.

cues.zh: 爸爸本来这一周就要和大众打电话
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 ben3 lai2 zhe4 yi1 zhou1 jiu4 yao4 he2 da4 zhong4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Dad had actually planned to call Dazhuang this week

cues.zh: 谈谈两人之间的问题
cues.pinyin: tan2 tan2 liang3 ren2 zhi1 jian1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: to talk through the problems between them.

cues.zh: 可谁知道话还没准备好
cues.pinyin: ke3 shui2 zhi1 dao4 hua4 hai2 mei2 zhun3 bei4 hao3
cues.en: But who knew, before he'd even figured out what to say,

cues.zh: 就出了这种事情
cues.pinyin: jiu4 chu1 le5 zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2
cues.en: this happened.

cues.zh: 小丽的情况不容乐观
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 qing2 kuang4 bu4 rong2 le4 guan1
cues.en: Xiaoli's condition was not looking good —

cues.zh: 随时随地都能撒手霉
cues.pinyin: sui2 shi2 sui2 di4 dou1 neng2 sa1 shou3 mei2
cues.en: she could pass away at any moment.

cues.zh: 朴医生立刻去找了肖恩
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 qu4 zhao3 le5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Dr. Park immediately went to find Shaun.

cues.zh: 此刻肖恩正为大壮的治疗方案焦头烂额
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 xiao4 en1 zheng4 wei4 da4 zhuang4 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 jiao1 tou2 lan4 e2
cues.en: At that moment, Shaun was in a frenzy over Dazhuang's treatment plan.

cues.zh: 大壮的身体承受不了太复杂的手术
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 shen1 ti3 cheng2 shou4 bu4 liao3 tai4 fu4 za2 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Dazhuang's body couldn't withstand too complex a surgery,

cues.zh: 而新的治疗方案又没有成功的剑
cues.pinyin: er2 xin1 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 you4 mei2 you3 cheng2 gong1 de5 jian4
cues.en: and the new treatment plan had no successful precedent

cues.zh: 让他们借鉴
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 men5 jie4 jian4
cues.en: for them to draw on.

cues.zh: 实在是束手无策
cues.pinyin: shi2 zai4 shi4 shu4 shou3 wu2 ce4
cues.en: They were truly at their wits' end.

cues.zh: 现在朴医生又过来问器官移植的事情
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 you4 guo4 lai2 wen4 qi4 guan1 yi2 zhi2 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: Now Dr. Park came again to ask about the organ transplant,

cues.zh: 巴不得她的病人立地成佛
cues.pinyin: ba1 bu4 de2 ta1 de5 bing4 ren2 li4 di4 cheng2 fo2
cues.en: practically wishing her patient could be saved on the spot.

cues.zh: 肖恩立马发飙了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 li4 ma3 fa1 biao1 le5
cues.en: Shaun immediately lost his temper

cues.zh: 警告朴医生
cues.pinyin: jing3 gao4 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: and warned Dr. Park

cues.zh: 如果再不走就举报她
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 bu4 zou3 jiu4 ju3 bao4 ta1
cues.en: that if she didn't leave, he'd report her,

cues.zh: 这样她的病人就会失去移植优先权
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ta1 de5 bing4 ren2 jiu4 hui4 shi1 qu4 yi2 zhi2 you1 xian1 quan2
cues.en: which would cost her patient their transplant priority.

cues.zh: 嫖一声哑口无言
cues.pinyin: piao2 yi1 sheng1 ya3 kou3 wu2 yan2
cues.en: Dr. Park was left speechless

cues.zh: 只能走了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 zou3 le5
cues.en: and could only leave.

cues.zh: 不死心的肖恩
cues.pinyin: bu4 si3 xin1 de5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Unwilling to give up, Shaun

cues.zh: 又想了一个高风险的手术方案
cues.pinyin: you4 xiang3 le5 yi2 ge4 gao1 feng1 xian3 de5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: came up with another high-risk surgical plan,

cues.zh: 其实只有 1 的几率
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhi3 you3 1 de5 ji1 lv4
cues.en: though it really only had a 1% chance of success.

cues.zh: 他还是想要去救大壮
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 xiang3 yao4 qu4 jiu4 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: He still wanted to try to save Dazhuang.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季06】天才医生肖恩全力抢救患者，可同事却盯上了患者的心脏，想要移值给自己的病人，肖恩怒了！

cues.zh: 肖恩的循循善诱
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 de5 xun2 xun2 shan4 you4
cues.en: With Shaun's patient, step-by-step persuasion,

cues.zh: 让小云决定再好好想想
cues.pinyin: rang4 xiao3 yun2 jue2 ding4 zai4 hao3 hao3 xiang3 xiang3
cues.en: Xiaoyun decided to think it over again.

cues.zh: 没多久就完美的完成了那幅刺绣
cues.pinyin: mei2 duo1 jiu3 jiu4 wan2 mei3 de5 wan2 cheng2 le5 na4 fu2 ci4 xiu4
cues.en: Before long, she perfectly finished that embroidery piece.

cues.zh: 刺绣
cues.pinyin: ci4 xiu4
cues.en: Embroidery —

cues.zh: 对就是刺绣
cues.pinyin: dui4 jiu4 shi4 ci4 xiu4
cues.en: yes, embroidery.

cues.zh: 肖恩心里突然就有了办法
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 xin1 li3 tu1 ran2 jiu4 you3 le5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: Shaun suddenly had an idea.

cues.zh: 不过不是救大壮的办法
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 bu2 shi4 jiu4 da4 zhuang4 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: But it wasn't a way to save Dazhuang —

cues.zh: 而救小丽的
cues.pinyin: er2 jiu4 xiao3 li4 de5
cues.en: it was a way to save Xiaoli.

cues.zh: 他们可以将心脏包膜当作血管处理
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 jiang1 xin1 zang4 bao1 mo2 dang4 zuo4 xue4 guan3 chu3 li3
cues.en: They could treat the heart's pericardium as a blood vessel

cues.zh: 用刺绣技术缝合来挽救大壮的心脏
cues.pinyin: yong4 ci4 xiu4 ji4 shu4 feng2 he2 lai2 wan3 jiu4 da4 zhuang4 de5 xin1 zang4
cues.en: and use embroidery-style suturing to repair Dazhuang's heart.

cues.zh: 这个办法在历史上有成功的案例

cues.en: This method had successful precedents in medical history.

cues.zh: 这样虽然不能救活大壮

cues.en: This way, even though it couldn't save Dazhuang's life,

cues.en: it could make his heart meet the standard for transplant,

cues.zh: 来挽救小丽的生命

cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 ba4 ba4 yi1 kai1 shi3 jue2 de5 hen3 cha4 yi4
cues.en: Dazhuang's dad was shocked at first.

cues.zh: 你们火计火了给我说这个办法
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 huo3 ji4 huo3 le5 gei3 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: You're all so frantic telling me about this plan,

cues.zh: 但爸爸也知道现在来不及了

cues.pinyin: ta1 neng2 zuo4 de5 jiu4 shi4 ba3 xiang3 shuo1 de5 hua4 shuo1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: All he could do was say what he'd wanted to say

cues.zh: 爸爸最终接受了现实

cues.en: After he finished telling his son what was in his heart,

cues.zh: 因为大壮

cues.zh: 将这份报告和大壮的照片放在了一起

cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 gong1 si1 zui4 jin4 zheng4 zai4 xun2 zhao3 xin1 de5 yi1 liao2 fu2 wu4 fang1
cues.en: Her company was recently looking for a new medical service provider.

cues.zh: 而巧的是
cues.pinyin: er2 qiao3 de5 shi4
cues.en: And as it happened,

cues.zh: 这个小美最近有点不舒服
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 mei3 zui4 jin4 you3 dian3 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: this Xiaomei had been feeling unwell lately.

cues.zh: 如果摩根能治好她

cues.en: If Morgan could cure her,

cues.zh: 肯定能拿下合同

cues.en: he could definitely land the contract,

cues.zh: 摩根拿这件事做筹码
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 na2 zhe4 jian4 shi4 zuo4 chou2 ma3
cues.en: Morgan used this as leverage.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季06】天才医生肖恩全力抢救患者，可同事却盯上了患者的心脏，想要移值给自己的病人，肖恩怒了！

cues.zh: 小美的视力可以保留 60 左右

cues.zh: 才能百分百拿下合同
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 bai3 fen1 bai3 na2 xia4 he2 tong2
cues.en: could he land the contract for certain.

cues.zh: 摩根很快注意到了一个尚在实
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 hen3 kuai4 zhu4 yi4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 shang4 zai4 shi2

cues.zh: 验阶段的手术

cues.zh: 能够在清除肿瘤的情况下保存小

cues.zh: 美的全部视力

cues.zh: 只是结果成功与否很难确定
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 jie2 guo3 cheng2 gong1 yu3 fou3 hen3 nan2 que4 ding4

cues.en: Morgan went to discuss it with the manager.

cues.en: One option was a safe surgery that could only preserve 60% of her eyesight;

cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shang4 bu4 wan2 shan4 dan4 neng2 bao3 cun2 100 shi4 li4 de5 shou3 shu4

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 你生命中，最重要的是什么？

cues.zh: 我问过很多人关于爱与生命的答案
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 guo4 hen3 duo1 ren2 guan1 yu2 ai4 yu3 sheng1 ming4 de5 da2 an4
cues.en: I've asked many people for answers about love and life.

cues.zh: 但人类的伟大之处就在于
cues.pinyin: dan4 ren2 lei4 de5 wei3 da4 zhi1 chu4 jiu4 zai4 yu2
cues.en: But what makes humanity great is

cues.zh: 认识到每一个人的生命都弥足珍贵
cues.pinyin: ren4 shi2 dao4 mei3 yi2 ge4 ren2 de5 sheng1 ming4 dou1 mi2 zu2 zhen1 gui4
cues.en: recognizing that every single life is precious beyond measure.

cues.zh: 爱人如己保护他人就是勇敢地保护彼此
cues.pinyin: ai4 ren2 ru2 ji3 bao3 hu4 ta1 ren2 jiu4 shi4 yong3 gan3 di4 bao3 hu4 bi3 ci3
cues.en: Loving others as yourself, protecting others, is bravely protecting one another.

cues.zh: 当声音能够重现生命的本真
cues.pinyin: dang1 sheng1 yin1 neng2 gou4 chong2 xian4 sheng1 ming4 de5 ben3 zhen1
cues.en: When sound can faithfully recreate the true essence of life,

cues.zh: 才是独一无二无法重现的音乐
cues.pinyin: cai2 shi4 du2 yi1 wu2 er4 wu2 fa3 chong2 xian4 de5 yin1 yue4
cues.en: that's the one-of-a-kind, irreplaceable music.

cues.zh: 不加修饰而能经得起时间历练
cues.pinyin: bu4 jia1 xiu1 shi4 er2 neng2 jing1 de2 qi3 shi2 jian1 li4 lian4
cues.en: Unembellished, yet able to stand the test of time.

cues.en: The 2025 Singaporean sci-fi comedy "AI Pin Cai Hui Ying" premieres.

cues.pinyin: gai1 pian4 yi3 ren2 gong1 zhi4 neng2 ji1 qi4 ren2 yu3 ren2 lei4 de5 ri4

cues.zh: 又能让你感动流泪
cues.pinyin: you4 neng2 rang4 ni3 gan3 dong4 liu2 lei4
cues.en: and also move you to tears.

cues.zh: 好了话不多说一起进入正题
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 hua4 bu4 duo1 shuo1 yi4 qi3 jin4 ru4 zheng4 ti2
cues.en: Alright, enough talk — let's get into the story.

cues.zh: 话说新加坡政府为了解决用工荒的问题
cues.pinyin: hua4 shuo1 xin1 jia1 po1 zheng4 fu3 wei4 le5 jie3 jue2 yong4 gong1 huang1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The story goes, to solve the labor shortage problem,

cues.pinyin: yan2 zhi4 chu1 yi1 kuan3 AI zhi4 neng2 ji1 qi4 ren2
cues.en: Singapore's government developed an AI smart robot.

cues.zh: 这款机器人拥有人类的思想
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kuan3 ji1 qi4 ren2 yong1 you3 ren2 lei4 de5 si1 xiang3
cues.en: This robot has human-like thinking,

cues.zh: 可以完全代替人类工作
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 wan2 quan2 dai4 ti4 ren2 lei4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: and can completely replace human labor.

cues.zh: 这个爆炸性的新闻引起轩然大波
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bao4 zha4 xing4 de5 xin1 wen2 yin3 qi3 xuan1 ran2 da4 bo1
cues.en: This explosive news caused a huge uproar.

cues.zh: 南叔正在和朋友一起看 AI 机器人的新闻
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 zheng4 zai4 he2 peng2 you3 yi4 qi3 kan4 AI ji1 qi4 ren2 de5 xin1 wen2
cues.en: Uncle Nan was watching the AI robot news with a friend.

cues.zh: 南叔表示有了机器人
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 biao3 shi4 you3 le5 ji1 qi4 ren2
cues.en: Uncle Nan said now that there are robots,

cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 zhe4 yang4 de5 da3 gong1 zai3 ke3 yao4 shi1 ye4 le5
cues.en: working guys like himself are going to lose their jobs.

cues.zh: 第二天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: The next day,

cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 de5 dan1 you1 guo3 ran2 cheng2 zhen1
cues.en: Uncle Nan's worry indeed came true.

cues.zh: 因为机器人的普及
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ji1 qi4 ren2 de5 pu3 ji2

cues.zh: 南叔被通知强制退休
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 bei4 tong1 zhi1 qiang2 zhi4 tui4 xiu1
cues.en: Uncle Nan was notified of forced retirement.

cues.zh: 南叔不服
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 bu4 fu2

cues.zh: 自己为公司抡了 40 年大勺
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 wei4 gong1 si1 lun1 le5 40 nian2 da4 shao2
cues.en: He'd wielded the ladle for the company for 40 years,

cues.zh: 还不如机器人
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu4 ru2 ji1 qi4 ren2
cues.en: yet was still worse off than a robot.

cues.zh: 老板表示机器人不要工资
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 biao3 shi4 ji1 qi4 ren2 bu2 yao4 gong1 zi1
cues.en: The boss said robots don't need wages,

cues.zh: 不用休息
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 xiu1 xi1
cues.en: don't need rest,

cues.zh: 傻子才不用
cues.pinyin: sha3 zi5 cai2 bu4 yong4
cues.en: "Only a fool wouldn't use one."

cues.zh: 南叔提出不当厨子
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 ti2 chu1 bu4 dang4 chu2 zi5
cues.en: Uncle Nan suggested he stop being a cook —

cues.zh: 能不能换个岗位
cues.pinyin: neng2 bu4 neng2 huan4 ge4 gang3 wei4
cues.en: could he switch to a different position?

cues.zh: 老板问南叔
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 wen4 nan2 shu1
cues.en: The boss asked Uncle Nan,

cues.zh: 老板说可以

cues.en: and the boss said sure,

cues.zh: 一张椅子

cues.zh: 果断接受退休

cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 南叔的老婆南嫂正和闺蜜们讨论
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 de5 lao3 po2 nan2 sao3 zheng4 he2 gui1 mi4 men5 tao3 lun4
cues.en: Uncle Nan's wife, Auntie Nan, was discussing with her girlfriends

cues.zh: 一款新出的社交软件探一探
cues.pinyin: yi1 kuan3 xin1 chu1 de5 she4 jiao1 ruan3 jian4 tan4 yi1 tan4
cues.en: a new social app called "Tanyitan."

cues.zh: 据说这个探一探
cues.pinyin: ju4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 tan4 yi1 tan4
cues.en: Apparently this "Tanyitan" app

cues.zh: 上面全是小鲜肉
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 quan2 shi4 xiao3 xian1 rou4
cues.en: was full of hot young guys.

cues.zh: 现在中年大妈都流行玩这个
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhong1 nian2 da4 ma1 dou1 liu2 xing2 wan2 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: Nowadays it's trendy for middle-aged aunties to use it.

cues.zh: 男嫂一阵心动
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 yi1 zhen4 xin1 dong4
cues.en: Auntie Nan's heart skipped a beat.

cues.zh: 赶忙下载了下来准备深入研究
cues.pinyin: gan3 mang2 xia4 zai4 le5 xia4 lai2 zhun3 bei4 shen1 ru4 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: She hurried to download it to study it in depth.

cues.zh: 晚上男叔回到家中
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 nan2 shu1 hui2 dao4 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: That evening Uncle Nan came home.

cues.zh: 今天恰好是他的生日
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 qia4 hao3 shi4 ta1 de5 sheng1 ri4
cues.en: It happened to be his birthday.

cues.zh: 没想到刚进门
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 gang1 jin4 men2
cues.en: Unexpectedly, as soon as he walked in,

cues.zh: 就听到有人在为自己唱生日快乐
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ting1 dao4 you3 ren2 zai4 wei4 zi4 ji3 chang4 sheng1 ri4 kuai4 le4
cues.en: he heard someone singing happy birthday.

cues.zh: 男叔还以为是大家要给自己一个惊喜
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 hai2 yi3 wei2 shi4 da4 jia1 yao4 gei3 zi4 ji3 yi2 ge4 jing1 xi3
cues.en: Uncle Nan thought everyone was giving him a surprise.

cues.zh: 仔细看才发现
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 kan4 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Looking closer, he realized

cues.zh: 他们是在为家里的宠物狗过生日
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi4 zai4 wei4 jia1 li3 de5 chong3 wu4 gou3 guo4 sheng1 ri4
cues.en: they were celebrating the family dog's birthday.

cues.zh: 自己还被安排给大家拍照
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 hai2 bei4 an1 pai2 gei3 da4 jia1 pai1 zhao4
cues.en: He even got assigned to take photos for everyone.

cues.zh: 男叔找到朋友吐槽
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 zhao3 dao4 peng2 you3 tu3 cao2
cues.en: Uncle Nan went to vent to a friend,

cues.zh: 说自己在家的地位还不如一只狗
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zi4 ji3 zai4 jia1 de5 di4 wei4 hai2 bu4 ru2 yi1 zhi1 gou3
cues.en: saying his status at home was lower than a dog's.

cues.zh: 厨房里
cues.pinyin: chu2 fang2 li3
cues.en: In the kitchen,

cues.zh: 南叔仿佛食神下凡
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 fang3 fu2 shi2 shen2 xia4 fan2
cues.en: Uncle Nan seemed like the God of Cookery descended to earth.

cues.zh: 一阵轮勺
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhen4 lun2 shao2
cues.en: With a flurry of ladle work,

cues.zh: 一道道美食就被端上了桌
cues.pinyin: yi1 dao4 dao4 mei3 shi2 jiu4 bei4 duan1 shang4 le5 zhuo1
cues.en: dish after delicious dish was served up.

cues.zh: 南叔的厨艺
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 de5 chu2 yi4
cues.en: Uncle Nan's culinary skill

cues.zh: 点燃了直播间的人气
cues.pinyin: dian3 ran2 le5 zhi2 bo1 jian1 de5 ren2 qi4
cues.en: ignited the livestream's popularity.

cues.zh: 瞬间冲上了热门
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 chong1 shang4 le5 re4 men2
cues.en: It instantly shot to trending.

cues.zh: 大美提出和南叔一起开个餐馆
cues.pinyin: da4 mei3 ti2 chu1 he2 nan2 shu1 yi4 qi3 kai1 ge4 can1 guan3
cues.en: Da Mei suggested opening a restaurant together with Uncle Nan.

cues.zh: 你是认真的
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 ren4 zhen1 de5
cues.en: "Are you serious?"

cues.zh: 我是认真的
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ren4 zhen1 de5
cues.en: "I'm serious."

cues.zh: 我不是开玩笑
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu2 shi4 kai1 wan2 xiao4
cues.en: "I'm not joking."

cues.zh: 南叔当即一拍即合
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 dang1 ji2 yi1 pai1 ji2 he2
cues.en: Uncle Nan agreed on the spot.

cues.zh: 成为大老板这不正是自己的梦想吗
cues.pinyin: cheng2 wei2 da4 lao3 ban3 zhe4 bu4 zheng4 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 meng4 xiang3 ma5
cues.en: Becoming a big boss — wasn't that exactly his dream?

cues.zh: 拿出那笔退休金
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 na4 bi3 tui4 xiu1 jin1
cues.en: He took out that retirement payout,

cues.zh: 餐馆就这样被开起来了
cues.pinyin: can1 guan3 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 bei4 kai1 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: and the restaurant was opened just like that.

cues.zh: 南叔招聘的服务员清一色都是美女
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 zhao1 pin4 de5 fu2 wu4 yuan2 qing1 yi1 se4 dou1 shi4 mei3 nv3
cues.en: Every waitress Uncle Nan hired was a beauty.

cues.zh: 美女美女美女
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 mei3 nv3 mei3 nv3
cues.en: Beauties, beauties, beauties.

cues.zh: 南叔的前同事大牛
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 de5 qian2 tong2 shi4 da4 niu2
cues.en: Uncle Nan's former colleague, Da Niu,

cues.zh: 在网上看到南叔的厨艺惊世骇俗
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 shang4 kan4 dao4 nan2 shu1 de5 chu2 yi4 jing1 shi4 hai4 su2
cues.en: saw online that Uncle Nan's cooking skills were astonishing,

cues.zh: 特意赶来拜师
cues.pinyin: te4 yi4 gan3 lai2 bai4 shi1
cues.en: and came specially to ask to become his disciple.

cues.zh: 为了让男叔收他为徒
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 nan2 shu1 shou1 ta1 wei4 tu2
cues.en: To get Uncle Nan to accept him as a disciple,

cues.zh: 大牛直接下跪
cues.pinyin: da4 niu2 zhi2 jie1 xia4 gui4
cues.en: Da Niu knelt down right there.

cues.zh: 男叔感动到不行
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 gan3 dong4 dao4 bu4 xing2
cues.en: Uncle Nan was moved beyond words,

cues.zh: 当即收他为徒
cues.pinyin: dang1 ji2 shou1 ta1 wei4 tu2
cues.en: and immediately took him on as a disciple.

cues.zh: 餐馆有了男叔的厨艺
cues.pinyin: can1 guan3 you3 le5 nan2 shu1 de5 chu2 yi4
cues.en: With Uncle Nan's cooking skill at the restaurant

cues.zh: 和大美的直播间流量加持
cues.pinyin: he2 da4 mei3 de5 zhi2 bo1 jian1 liu2 liang4 jia1 chi2
cues.en: and the boost from Da Mei's livestream traffic,

cues.zh: 生意一路爆火
cues.pinyin: sheng1 yi4 yi1 lu4 bao4 huo3
cues.en: business boomed.

cues.zh: 男嫂从闺蜜那里
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 cong2 gui1 mi4 na4 li3
cues.en: From her girlfriends, Auntie Nan

cues.zh: 也知道了南叔的餐馆爆火的消息
cues.pinyin: ye3 zhi1 dao4 le5 nan2 shu1 de5 can1 guan3 bao4 huo3 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: also heard the news that Uncle Nan's restaurant had become a huge hit.

items.title_zh: 2025新加坡最新科幻喜剧《AI拼才会赢》！AI机器人竟侵入人类婚姻！还有人利用机器人搞诈骗！全程爆笑！

cues.zh: 这让一向爱出风头的大美感到十分不满
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 yi2 xiang4 ai4 chu1 feng1 tou5 de5 da4 mei3 gan3 dao4 shi2 fen1 bu4 man3
cues.en: This made Da Mei, who always loved the spotlight, very displeased.

cues.zh: 大美提出和男叔分道扬镳
cues.pinyin: da4 mei3 ti2 chu1 he2 nan2 shu1 fen1 dao4 yang2 biao1
cues.en: Da Mei proposed parting ways with Uncle Nan.

cues.zh: 男叔赌气表示同意
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 du3 qi4 biao3 shi4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: Uncle Nan, out of spite, agreed.

cues.zh: 分道扬镳
cues.pinyin: fen1 dao4 yang2 biao1
cues.en: "Parting ways —"

cues.zh: OK 啊
cues.pinyin: OK a5
cues.en: "OK then."

cues.zh: 看你啊
cues.pinyin: kan4 ni3 a5
cues.en: "We'll see..."

cues.zh: 没有我你能够活多久
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 wo3 ni3 neng2 gou4 huo2 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: "...how long can you survive without me?"

cues.zh: 大美把餐馆的房子一分为二
cues.pinyin: da4 mei3 ba3 can1 guan3 de5 fang2 zi5 yi1 fen1 wei2 er4
cues.en: Da Mei split the restaurant premises in two

cues.zh: 在男叔隔壁开了家新餐馆
cues.pinyin: zai4 nan2 shu1 ge2 bi4 kai1 le5 jia1 xin1 can1 guan3
cues.en: and opened a new restaurant right next door to Uncle Nan's.

cues.zh: 南嫂抓住机会
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 zhua1 zhu4 ji1 hui4
cues.en: Auntie Nan seized the chance

cues.zh: 对南叔一阵挖苦
cues.pinyin: dui4 nan2 shu1 yi1 zhen4 wa1 ku3
cues.en: to mock Uncle Nan for a while.

cues.zh: 南叔也不甘示弱
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 ye3 bu4 gan1 shi4 ruo4
cues.en: Uncle Nan wasn't one to back down either,

cues.zh: 两人大吵一架
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 da4 chao3 yi1 jia4
cues.en: and the two had a huge fight.

cues.zh: 南嫂找闺蜜诉苦
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 zhao3 gui1 mi4 su4 ku3
cues.en: Auntie Nan went to vent to her girlfriends,

cues.zh: 说南叔脾气太臭
cues.pinyin: shuo1 nan2 shu1 pi2 qi4 tai4 chou4
cues.en: saying Uncle Nan's temper was awful

cues.zh: 一点都不给自己面子
cues.pinyin: yi4 dian3 dou1 bu4 gei3 zi4 ji3 mian4 zi5
cues.en: and he didn't give her any face at all.

cues.zh: 这时候一群女人又聊起了探一探
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 yi1 qun2 nv3 ren2 you4 liao2 qi3 le5 tan4 yi1 tan4
cues.en: At this point the group of women started talking about Tanyitan again.

cues.zh: 南嫂表示最近一个帅哥加了自己
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 biao3 shi4 zui4 jin4 yi2 ge4 shuai4 ge1 jia1 le5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Auntie Nan said a handsome guy had recently added her.

cues.zh: 正说着话
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shuo1 zhe5 hua4
cues.en: Just as she was speaking,

cues.zh: 帅哥打来了视频通话
cues.pinyin: shuai4 ge1 da3 lai2 le5 shi4 pin2 tong1 hua4
cues.en: the handsome guy called her on video chat.

cues.zh: 看着屏幕里帅哥的风采
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 ping2 mu4 li3 shuai4 ge1 de5 feng1 cai3
cues.en: Watching the handsome guy's charm on screen,

cues.zh: 南嫂顿时把南叔望到九霄云外
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 dun4 shi2 ba3 nan2 shu1 wang4 dao4 jiu3 xiao1 yun2 wai4
cues.en: Auntie Nan instantly tossed Uncle Nan to the back of her mind.

cues.zh: 南叔看到朋友老王
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 kan4 dao4 peng2 you3 lao3 wang2
cues.en: Uncle Nan saw his friend Old Wang

cues.zh: 买了个美女机器人
cues.pinyin: mai3 le5 ge4 mei3 nv3 ji1 qi4 ren2
cues.en: had bought a pretty female robot.

cues.zh: 机器人又漂亮
cues.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ren2 you4 piao4 liang4
cues.en: The robot was both pretty

cues.zh: 又能干活
cues.pinyin: you4 neng2 gan4 huo2
cues.en: and good at working,

cues.zh: 于是赶忙也买了一台
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 gan3 mang2 ye3 mai3 le5 yi1 tai2
cues.en: so he hurried to buy one too.

cues.zh: 南嫂看到机器人那么漂亮
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 kan4 dao4 ji1 qi4 ren2 na4 me5 piao4 liang4
cues.en: Seeing how pretty the robot was,

cues.zh: 害怕南叔和机器人搞外遇
cues.pinyin: hai4 pa4 nan2 shu1 he2 ji1 qi4 ren2 gao3 wai4 yu4
cues.en: Auntie Nan feared Uncle Nan would have an affair with it.

cues.zh: 餐馆经理打来电话
cues.pinyin: can1 guan3 jing1 li3 da3 lai2 dian4 hua4
cues.en: The restaurant manager called.

cues.zh: 餐馆没有了大美的直播间流量
cues.pinyin: can1 guan3 mei2 you3 le5 da4 mei3 de5 zhi2 bo1 jian1 liu2 liang4
cues.en: Without Da Mei's livestream traffic,

cues.zh: 生意急转直下
cues.pinyin: sheng1 yi4 ji2 zhuan3 zhi2 xia4
cues.en: the restaurant's business took a sharp downturn.

cues.zh: 连服务员工资都发不起了
cues.pinyin: lian2 fu2 wu4 yuan2 gong1 zi1 dou1 fa1 bu4 qi3 le5
cues.en: They couldn't even afford to pay the waitstaff's wages.

cues.zh: 南叔向南嫂求救
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 xiang4 nan2 sao3 qiu2 jiu4
cues.en: Uncle Nan turned to Auntie Nan for help,

cues.zh: 让他拿出私房钱拯救餐馆
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 na2 chu1 si1 fang2 qian2 zheng3 jiu4 can1 guan3
cues.en: asking her to use her secret savings to save the restaurant,

cues.zh: 却只得到一顿臭骂
cues.pinyin: que4 zhi3 de2 dao4 yi1 dun4 chou4 ma4
cues.en: but only got a harsh scolding in return.

cues.zh: 更惨的事情还在后面
cues.pinyin: geng4 can3 de5 shi4 qing2 hai2 zai4 hou4 mian4
cues.en: Worse things were still to come.

cues.zh: 大美挖走了南叔的徒弟大牛
cues.pinyin: da4 mei3 wa1 zou3 le5 nan2 shu1 de5 tu2 di4 da4 niu2
cues.en: Da Mei poached Uncle Nan's disciple, Da Niu,

cues.zh: 并且利用直播间的优势
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 li4 yong4 zhi2 bo1 jian1 de5 you1 shi4
cues.en: and using her livestream's advantage,

cues.zh: 大力包装大牛
cues.pinyin: da4 li4 bao1 zhuang1 da4 niu2
cues.en: heavily promoted Da Niu.

cues.zh: 大牛利用从南叔那里学到的技术
cues.pinyin: da4 niu2 li4 yong4 cong2 nan2 shu1 na4 li3 xue2 dao4 de5 ji4 shu4
cues.en: Da Niu used the skills he'd learned from Uncle Nan,

cues.zh: 再经过大美包装
cues.pinyin: zai4 jing1 guo4 da4 mei3 bao1 zhuang1
cues.en: and after being packaged by Da Mei,

cues.zh: 摇身一变成为厨神
cues.pinyin: yao2 shen1 yi1 bian4 cheng2 wei2 chu2 shen2
cues.en: transformed into a culinary god.

items.title_zh: 2025新加坡最新科幻喜剧《AI拼才会赢》！AI机器人竟侵入人类婚姻！还有人利用机器人搞诈骗！全程爆笑！

cues.zh: 南嫂和帅哥的感情也是愈演愈烈
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 he2 shuai4 ge1 de5 gan3 qing2 ye3 shi4 yu4 yan3 yu4 lie4
cues.en: Auntie Nan's relationship with the handsome guy also kept heating up.

cues.zh: 帅哥透露有一个投资项目稳赚
cues.pinyin: shuai4 ge1 tou4 lu4 you3 yi2 ge4 tou2 zi1 xiang4 mu4 wen3 zhuan4
cues.en: The handsome guy revealed an investment project that was guaranteed to profit.

cues.zh: 南嫂为了南叔凑钱拯救餐馆
cues.pinyin: nan2 sao3 wei4 le5 nan2 shu1 cou4 qian2 zheng3 jiu4 can1 guan3
cues.en: To save the restaurant for Uncle Nan's sake, Auntie Nan pooled together money,

cues.zh: 赚取五百试水
cues.pinyin: zhuan4 qu3 wu3 bai3 shi4 shui3
cues.en: investing 500 first to test the waters.

cues.zh: 南叔跟机器人林林诉苦
cues.pinyin: nan2 shu1 gen1 ji1 qi4 ren2 lin2 lin2 su4 ku3
cues.en: Uncle Nan vented to the robot, Lin Lin,

cues.zh: 林林给他一个安慰的抱抱
cues.pinyin: lin2 lin2 gei3 ta1 yi2 ge4 an1 wei4 de5 bao4 bao4
cues.en: and Lin Lin gave him a comforting hug.

cues.zh: 谁知南叔动作太大
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 nan2 shu1 dong4 zuo4 tai4 da4
cues.en: Who knew Uncle Nan's movement was too forceful,

cues.zh: 导致林林直接当机
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 lin2 lin2 zhi2 jie1 dang1 ji1
cues.en: causing Lin Lin to short-circuit on the spot.

cues.zh: 这一幕正好被突然回家的南嫂看到
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi2 mu4 zheng4 hao3 bei4 tu1 ran2 hui2 jia1 de5 nan2 sao3 kan4 dao4
cues.en: This scene was just witnessed by Auntie Nan, who had suddenly come home.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 女人烧伤面目全非
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 shao1 shang1 mian4 mu4 quan2 fei1
cues.en: The woman was burned beyond recognition.

cues.zh: 医生竟然用鱼皮贴在他身上治疗
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jing4 ran2 yong4 yu2 pi2 tie1 zai4 ta1 shen1 shang4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: The doctor actually used fish skin to treat him.

cues.zh: 这究竟是医疗偏锋还是医生的恶作剧呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu1 jing4 shi4 yi1 liao2 pian1 feng1 hai2 shi4 yi1 sheng1 de5 e4 zuo4 ju4 ne5
cues.en: Is this medical innovation or just a doctor's prank?

cues.zh: 本来是一场浪漫的婚礼
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 shi4 yi1 chang2 lang4 man4 de5 hun1 li3
cues.en: It was supposed to be a romantic wedding.

cues.zh: 谁想到竟然成了通往天堂的换乘站
cues.pinyin: shui2 xiang3 dao4 jing4 ran2 cheng2 le5 tong1 wang3 tian1 tang2 de5 huan4 cheng2 zhan4
cues.en: Who knew it would become a transfer station to heaven?

cues.zh: 婚礼车辆出了事故
cues.pinyin: hun1 li3 che1 liang4 chu1 liao3 shi4 gu4
cues.en: The wedding car got into an accident.

cues.zh: 24 名伤者被送到医院救治
cues.pinyin: 24 ming2 shang1 zhe3 bei4 song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 zhi4
cues.en: 24 injured people were rushed to the hospital.

cues.zh: 在来的路上患者们已经被贴上了标签
cues.pinyin: zai4 lai2 de5 lu4 shang4 huan4 zhe3 men5 yi3 jing1 bei4 tie1 shang4 le5 biao1 qian1
cues.en: On the way, the patients had already been tagged.

cues.zh: 萧恩现场解说绿标签的说明伤势较轻
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 xian4 chang3 jie3 shuo1 lv4 biao1 qian1 de5 shuo1 ming2 shang1 shi4 jiao4 qing1
cues.en: Shawn explained on site that a green tag means minor injuries.

cues.zh: 而黄标签说明需要留院观察
cues.pinyin: er2 huang2 biao1 qian1 shuo1 ming2 xu1 yao4 liu2 yuan4 guan1 cha2
cues.en: A yellow tag means the patient needs to stay for observation.

cues.zh: 红标签就是马上抢救
cues.pinyin: hong2 biao1 qian1 jiu4 shi4 ma3 shang4 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: A red tag means immediate resuscitation.

cues.zh: 黑标签就可以集体吃席了
cues.pinyin: hei1 biao1 qian1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ji2 ti3 chi1 xi2 le5
cues.en: A black tag means they could all go straight to the funeral feast.

cues.zh: 很快病人们被送到急诊
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 bing4 ren2 men5 bei4 song4 dao4 ji2 zhen3
cues.en: The patients were quickly sent to the ER.

cues.zh: 按照不同的病情
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 bu4 tong2 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: According to their different conditions,

cues.zh: 医生们认领了自己的病患
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ren4 ling3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 bing4 huan4
cues.en: the doctors claimed their own patients.

cues.zh: 肖恩接受的病人
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jie1 shou4 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: The patient Shawn took on

cues.zh: 是一个腿部受重创的大哥
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 tui3 bu4 shou4 zhong4 chuang1 de5 da4 ge1
cues.en: was a guy with a severe leg injury.

cues.zh: 这大哥血就跟不要钱一样
cues.pinyin: zhe4 da4 ge1 xue4 jiu4 gen1 bu2 yao4 qian2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: This guy's blood was flowing like it was free,

cues.zh: 肆意流淌
cues.pinyin: si4 yi4 liu2 tang3
cues.en: gushing out everywhere.

cues.zh: 放点郫县豆瓣酱
cues.pinyin: fang4 dian3 pi2 xian4 dou4 ban4 jiang4
cues.en: Add some Pixian bean paste,

cues.zh: 就是一盒上好的毛血旺啊
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi1 he2 shang4 hao3 de5 mao2 xue4 wang4 a5
cues.en: and it'd be a perfect bowl of mao xue wang.

cues.zh: 肖恩一看情况不好
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 yi1 kan4 qing2 kuang4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Seeing the situation was bad, Shawn

cues.zh: 赶紧要来了导尿管
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 yao4 lai2 le5 dao3 niao4 guan3
cues.en: quickly asked for a urinary catheter,

cues.zh: 14 号针头
cues.pinyin: 14 hao4 zhen1 tou2
cues.en: a 14-gauge needle,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 动脉导丝
cues.pinyin: dong4 mai4 dao3 si1
cues.en: an arterial guidewire,

cues.zh: 球囊导管
cues.pinyin: qiu2 nang2 dao3 guan3
cues.en: a balloon catheter,

cues.zh: 还有生理盐水
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 sheng1 li3 yan2 shui3
cues.en: and some saline solution.

cues.zh: 其他人一脸懵逼
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 ren2 yi1 lian3 meng3 bi1
cues.en: Everyone else looked totally confused,

cues.zh: 完全猜不透肖恩到底想干啥
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 cai1 bu4 tou4 xiao4 en1 dao4 di3 xiang3 gan4 sha2
cues.en: unable to guess what Shawn was trying to do.

cues.zh: 但是天才要是能随意被猜透
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tian1 cai2 yao4 shi4 neng2 sui2 yi4 bei4 cai1 tou4
cues.en: But if a genius could be figured out that easily,

cues.zh: 还能叫天才嘛
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 jiao4 tian1 cai2 ma5
cues.en: would they even be called a genius?

cues.zh: 肖恩就在众目睽睽之下
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jiu4 zai4 zhong4 mu4 kui2 kui2 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: Right there in front of everyone,

cues.zh: 用这些常见的东西做了一个简
cues.pinyin: yong4 zhe4 xie1 chang2 jian4 de5 dong1 xi1 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 jian3
cues.en: Shawn used these everyday items to make a simplified

cues.zh: 易版的 re po 啊
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban3 de5 re po a5
cues.en: version of REBOA.

cues.zh: 这技术又叫复苏性主动脉球囊阻断术
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji4 shu4 you4 jiao4 fu4 su1 xing4 zhu3 dong4 mai4 qiu2 nang2 zu3 duan4 shu4
cues.en: This technique is also called Resuscitative Endovascular Balloon Occlusion of the Aorta.

cues.zh: 主要是有些病人血流不止
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 you3 xie1 bing4 ren2 xue4 liu2 bu4 zhi3
cues.en: It's mainly used for patients with uncontrollable bleeding

cues.zh: 又不适合压迫止血的时候
cues.pinyin: you4 bu2 shi4 he2 ya1 po4 zhi3 xue4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when compression isn't a suitable way to stop it.

cues.zh: 通过这种技术可以在血管上端形成梗阻
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zhe4 zhong3 ji4 shu4 ke3 yi3 zai4 xue4 guan3 shang4 duan1 xing2 cheng2 geng3 zu3
cues.en: This technique creates a blockage at the upper end of the blood vessel,

cues.zh: 从而阻止大量的血液涌出
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 zu3 zhi3 da4 liang4 de5 xue4 ye4 yong3 chu1
cues.en: preventing a massive amount of blood from gushing out.

cues.zh: 救命的小气球果然止住了病患的血
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ming4 de5 xiao3 qi4 qiu2 guo3 ran2 zhi3 zhu4 le5 bing4 huan4 de5 xue4
cues.en: Sure enough, the lifesaving little balloon stopped the patient's bleeding.

cues.zh: 这个血流不止的大哥就是今天婚礼的新郎
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xue4 liu2 bu4 zhi3 de5 da4 ge1 jiu4 shi4 jin1 tian1 hun1 li3 de5 xin1 lang2
cues.en: This bleeding guy turned out to be today's groom.

cues.zh: 很快新郎的检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 xin1 lang2 de5 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The groom's test results soon came back.

cues.zh: 骨骨粉碎性骨折
cues.pinyin: gu3 gu3 fen3 sui4 xing4 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: A comminuted femur fracture,

cues.zh: 小腿也供血不足
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tui3 ye3 gong1 xue4 bu4 zu2
cues.en: and his lower leg wasn't getting enough blood either.

cues.zh: 新娘十分想治好老公的脚
cues.pinyin: xin1 niang2 shi2 fen1 xiang3 zhi4 hao3 lao3 gong1 de5 jiao3
cues.en: The bride desperately wanted to save her husband's leg,

cues.zh: 但是没医生说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 shuo1
cues.en: but a doctor unexpectedly said

cues.zh: 因为骨头已经碎成渣渣
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 gu3 tou5 yi3 jing1 sui4 cheng2 zha1 zha1
cues.en: that since the bone had shattered into fragments,

cues.zh: 所以基本上只能截肢了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ji1 ben3 shang4 zhi3 neng2 jie2 zhi1 le5
cues.en: amputation was basically the only option.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 但是公公婆婆一口咬定
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 gong1 gong1 po2 po5 yi4 kou3 yao3 ding4
cues.en: But his parents insisted

cues.zh: 你还不是她妻子
cues.pinyin: ni3 hai2 bu2 shi4 ta1 qi1 zi3
cues.en: that she wasn't his wife yet,

cues.zh: 所以没资格替她做任何决定
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 zi1 ge2 ti4 ta1 zuo4 ren4 he2 jue2 ding4
cues.en: so she had no right to make any decisions for him.

cues.zh: 直到医生们把新郎推进手术室了
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 yi1 sheng1 men5 ba3 xin1 lang2 tui1 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4 le5
cues.en: Even after the doctors wheeled the groom into the OR,

cues.zh: 他们还是没争论出一个结果
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 shi4 mei2 zheng1 lun4 chu1 yi2 ge4 jie2 guo3
cues.en: they still hadn't reached a conclusion.

cues.zh: 这时候萧恩发现新郎的脚已经开始变色了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 xiao1 en1 fa1 xian4 xin1 lang2 de5 jiao3 yi3 jing1 kai1 shi3 bian4 se4 le5
cues.en: That's when Shawn noticed the groom's foot had started changing color,

cues.zh: 这就意味着小腿的动脉受损了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 xiao3 tui3 de5 dong4 mai4 shou4 sun3 le5
cues.en: meaning the artery in his lower leg was damaged.

cues.zh: 再不做手术恐怕有性命之忧
cues.pinyin: zai4 bu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 kong3 pa4 you3 xing4 ming4 zhi1 you1
cues.en: If surgery wasn't done soon, his life could be at risk.

cues.zh: 最后医生们脑子都快爆炸了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 sheng1 men5 nao3 zi5 dou1 kuai4 bao4 zha4 le5
cues.en: A group of people wheeled the patient toward the OR

cues.zh: 一边七嘴八舌的继续刚才的争论
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 qi1 zui3 ba1 she2 de5 ji4 xu4 gang1 cai2 de5 zheng1 lun4
cues.en: while still loudly arguing about the same issue.

cues.zh: 最后没医生脑人都快爆炸了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 nao3 ren2 dou1 kuai4 bao4 zha4 le5
cues.en: Finally the doctors' heads were about to explode.

cues.zh: 你们赶紧拿个主意啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 gan3 jin3 na2 ge4 zhu3 yi4 a5
cues.en: "Just make a decision already!"

cues.zh: 七大姑八大姨表示
cues.pinyin: qi1 da4 gu1 ba1 da4 yi2 biao3 shi4
cues.en: The aunties and distant relatives said,

cues.zh: 毕竟新娘才是最了解新郎的人
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 xin1 niang2 cai2 shi4 zui4 liao3 jie3 xin1 lang2 de5 ren2
cues.en: "After all, the bride knows the groom best,

cues.zh: 所以我们听新娘的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ting1 xin1 niang2 de5
cues.en: so let's go with what she says."

cues.zh: 换骨骨
cues.pinyin: huan4 gu3 gu3
cues.en: Replace the bone.

cues.zh: 骨科手术从来都是立即活
cues.pinyin: gu3 ke1 shou3 shu4 cong2 lai2 dou1 shi4 li4 ji2 huo2
cues.en: Orthopedic surgery has always been about acting fast.

cues.zh: 医生们先把新娘碎掉的骨骨清理干净
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 xian1 ba3 xin1 niang2 sui4 diao4 de5 gu3 gu3 qing1 li3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: The doctors first cleaned out the groom's shattered bone fragments,

cues.zh: 然后把钛合筋的骨骨放进去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 tai4 he2 jin1 de5 gu3 gu3 fang4 jin4 qu4
cues.en: then put in a titanium alloy bone.

cues.zh: 手术进行的很顺利
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jin4 xing2 de5 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: The surgery went smoothly.

cues.zh: 萧恩按了一下新郎的脚趾
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 an4 le5 yi1 xia4 xin1 lang2 de5 jiao3 zhi3
cues.en: Shawn pressed on the groom's toe,

cues.zh: 脚趾很快恢复红色
cues.pinyin: jiao3 zhi3 hen3 kuai4 hui1 fu4 hong2 se4
cues.en: and it quickly turned red again,

cues.zh: 说明血流恢复了
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 xue4 liu2 hui1 fu4 le5
cues.en: showing that blood flow had been restored.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 她的心灵更痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 ling2 geng4 tong4
cues.en: Her heart hurt even more,

cues.zh: 尤其是当伴娘看到镜子里的自己
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 dang1 ban4 niang2 kan4 dao4 jing4 zi5 li3 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: especially when the bridesmaid saw herself in the mirror.

cues.zh: 哪个女孩不爱美呢
cues.pinyin: na3 ge5 nv3 hai2 bu4 ai4 mei3 ne5
cues.en: What girl doesn't love being beautiful?

cues.zh: 年纪轻轻就变成探考人
cues.pinyin: nian2 ji4 qing1 qing1 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 tan4 kao3 ren2
cues.en: To become disfigured so young,

cues.zh: 以后还怎么嫁人啊
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 hai2 zen3 me5 jia4 ren2 a5
cues.en: how would she ever get married now?

cues.zh: 她曾经无数次想象自己婚礼是什么样子
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 wu2 shu4 ci4 xiang3 xiang4 zi4 ji3 hun1 li3 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: She had imagined her own wedding countless times,

cues.zh: 甚至连伴娘的礼服都选好了
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 lian2 ban4 niang2 de5 li3 fu2 dou1 xuan3 hao3 le5
cues.en: even picking out the bridesmaid dresses already.

cues.zh: 可是上天竟然跟她开了这么一个玩笑
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shang4 tian1 jing4 ran2 gen1 ta1 kai1 le5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 wan2 xiao4
cues.en: But fate had played such a cruel joke on her.

cues.zh: 伴娘的痛苦实在太有震撼性
cues.pinyin: ban4 niang2 de5 tong4 ku3 shi2 zai4 tai4 you3 zhen4 han4 xing4
cues.en: The bridesmaid's pain was simply overwhelming,

cues.zh: 就连卡路医生都被吓得跑了出来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 ka3 lu4 yi1 sheng1 dou1 bei4 xia4 de2 pao3 le5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: so much that even Dr. Karu was scared off and ran out.

cues.zh: 在走廊里他们遇到了小布
cues.pinyin: zai4 zou3 lang2 li3 ta1 men5 yu4 dao4 le5 xiao3 bu4
cues.en: In the hallway they ran into Xiao Bu.

cues.zh: 小布十分鄙视她这种当逃兵的做法
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 shi2 fen1 bi3 shi4 ta1 zhe4 zhong3 dang1 tao2 bing1 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Xiao Bu deeply despised her for running away like a coward.

cues.zh: 你是医生可以想躲去哪儿就躲去哪儿
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 yi1 sheng1 ke3 yi3 xiang3 duo3 qu4 na3 er2 jiu4 duo3 qu4 na3 er2
cues.en: "You're a doctor, you can go hide wherever you want,

cues.zh: 但是你的病人她也想逃离
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 de5 bing4 ren2 ta1 ye3 xiang3 tao2 li2
cues.en: but your patient — she wants to escape too,

cues.zh: 可是她只能在小小的病床上呻吟
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 zhi3 neng2 zai4 xiao3 xiao3 de5 bing4 chuang2 shang4 shen1 yin2
cues.en: yet she can only lie there moaning on her small hospital bed,

cues.zh: 等待着你给她的救赎
cues.pinyin: deng3 dai4 zhe5 ni3 gei3 ta1 de5 jiu4 shu2
cues.en: waiting for the salvation only you can give her."

cues.zh: 受到教育的卡鲁医生
cues.pinyin: shou4 dao4 jiao4 yu4 de5 ka3 lu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Having been set straight, Dr. Karu

cues.zh: 想到了一个好办法
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 hao3 ban4 fa3
cues.en: came up with a good idea.

cues.zh: 他把平板电脑带进诊室
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 ping2 ban3 dian4 nao3 dai4 jin4 zhen3 shi4
cues.en: He brought a tablet into the exam room

cues.zh: 让伴娘也看看电影
cues.pinyin: rang4 ban4 niang2 ye3 kan4 kan4 dian4 ying3
cues.en: so the bridesmaid could watch a movie too,

cues.zh: 暂时逃离一下残酷的现实吧
cues.pinyin: zan4 shi2 tao2 li2 yi1 xia4 can2 ku4 de5 xian4 shi2 ba5
cues.en: to escape the harsh reality for a little while.

cues.zh: 伴娘都惊呆了
cues.pinyin: ban4 niang2 dou1 jing1 dai1 le5
cues.en: The bridesmaid was stunned.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 这个医生心可真大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi1 sheng1 xin1 ke3 zhen1 da4
cues.en: "This doctor really has nerve,

cues.zh: 难道一个搞笑电影
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 yi2 ge4 gao3 xiao4 dian4 ying3
cues.en: does he really think a comedy movie

cues.zh: 就能让我忘掉苦难吗
cues.pinyin: jiu4 neng2 rang4 wo3 wang4 diao4 ku3 nan4 ma5
cues.en: could make me forget my suffering?"

cues.zh: 为了让伴娘减少苦难
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 ban4 niang2 jian3 shao3 ku3 nan4
cues.en: To help ease the bridesmaid's pain,

cues.zh: 卡鲁医生一直在不停地查找资料
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu3 yi1 sheng1 yi4 zhi2 zai4 bu4 ting2 di4 cha2 zhao3 zi1 liao4
cues.en: Dr. Karu kept searching for information nonstop

cues.zh: 终于让他找到
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 rang4 ta1 zhao3 dao4
cues.en: and finally found it —

cues.zh: 巴西一个医院
cues.pinyin: ba1 xi1 yi2 ge4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: a hospital in Brazil

cues.zh: 居然用罗飞鱼的鱼皮
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 yong4 luo2 fei1 yu2 de5 yu2 pi2
cues.en: that actually used tilapia fish skin

cues.zh: 包裹烧伤部位
cues.pinyin: bao1 guo3 shao1 shang1 bu4 wei4
cues.en: to wrap burn wounds.

cues.zh: 用罗飞鱼皮里的胶原蛋白
cues.pinyin: yong4 luo2 fei1 yu2 pi2 li3 de5 jiao1 yuan2 dan4 bai2
cues.en: Using the collagen inside tilapia fish skin

cues.zh: 促进皮肤再生修复
cues.pinyin: cu4 jin4 pi2 fu1 zai4 sheng1 xiu1 fu4
cues.en: to promote skin regeneration and repair,

cues.zh: 这样就不需要直皮了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 bu4 xu1 yao4 zhi2 pi2 le5
cues.en: meaning she wouldn't need a skin graft.

cues.zh: 老马觉得卡鲁简直是疯了
cues.pinyin: lao3 ma3 jue2 de5 ka3 lu3 jian3 zhi2 shi4 feng1 le5
cues.en: Old Ma thought Karu had completely lost his mind.

cues.zh: 你这个治疗方案先要汇报给委员会审核
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 xian1 yao4 hui4 bao4 gei3 wei3 yuan2 hui4 shen3 he2
cues.en: "This treatment plan has to be approved by the committee first,

cues.zh: 然后再提取医用级别的罗飞鱼皮
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ti2 qu3 yi1 yong4 ji2 bie2 de5 luo2 fei1 yu2 pi2
cues.en: and then you'd still need to get medical-grade tilapia fish skin —

cues.zh: 到时候估计伴娘都凉了
cues.pinyin: dao4 shi2 hou4 gu1 ji4 ban4 niang2 dou1 liang2 le5
cues.en: by then the bridesmaid will probably already be dead."

cues.zh: 不过老马还是愿意陪着卡鲁试一试
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 lao3 ma3 hai2 shi4 yuan4 yi4 pei2 zhe5 ka3 lu3 shi4 yi1 shi4
cues.en: Still, Old Ma was willing to try it with Karu —

cues.zh: 死马当活马医吧
cues.pinyin: si3 ma3 dang1 huo2 ma3 yi1 ba5
cues.en: may as well treat a dying horse as if it could live.

cues.zh: 没想到他们还真的联系上了圣迪
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 ta1 men5 hai2 zhen1 de5 lian2 xi4 shang4 le5 sheng4 di2
cues.en: Unexpectedly, they actually managed to contact

cues.zh: 亚哥社区医院
cues.pinyin: ya4 ge1 she4 qu1 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: San Diego Community Hospital.

cues.zh: 他们听说需要用到罗飞鱼皮
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ting1 shuo1 xu1 yao4 yong4 dao4 luo2 fei1 yu2 pi2
cues.en: As soon as they heard tilapia fish skin was needed,

cues.zh: 立刻派遣直升机送过来
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 pai4 qian3 zhi2 sheng1 ji1 song4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: the hospital immediately sent it over by helicopter,

cues.zh: 一小时后就到了
cues.pinyin: yi1 xiao3 shi2 hou4 jiu4 dao4 le5
cues.en: and it arrived within an hour.

cues.zh: 伴娘终于看到了一丝生的希望
cues.pinyin: ban4 niang2 zhong1 yu2 kan4 dao4 le5 yi1 si1 sheng1 de5 xi1 wang4
cues.en: The bridesmaid finally saw a glimmer of hope.

cues.zh: 终于救命的鱼皮到了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 jiu4 ming4 de5 yu2 pi2 dao4 le5
cues.en: The lifesaving fish skin had finally arrived.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 婚礼现场伴娘被严重烧伤，窝囊医生吓得直接跑路！还好天才医生有妙招，用鱼皮治疗毁容

cues.zh: 小布看了看受伤人员名单
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 kan4 le5 kan4 shou4 shang1 ren2 yuan2 ming2 dan1
cues.en: Xiao Bu checked the list of the injured

cues.zh: 确认没有瘦弱妹的名字
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 mei2 you3 shou4 ruo4 mei4 de5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: and confirmed Skinny Girl's name wasn't on it.

cues.zh: 小布又去后诊室询问
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 you4 qu4 hou4 zhen3 shi4 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Xiao Bu went to ask in the back exam room too,

cues.zh: 那里也没有瘦弱妹的身影
cues.pinyin: na4 li3 ye3 mei2 you3 shou4 ruo4 mei4 de5 shen1 ying3
cues.en: but there was no sign of Skinny Girl there either.

cues.zh: 有人看到她上了车
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 kan4 dao4 ta1 shang4 le5 che1
cues.en: Someone said they'd seen her get into a car,

cues.zh: 但是现在这个人就凭空消失了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xian4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 ping2 kong1 xiao1 shi1 le5
cues.en: but now this person had simply vanished.

cues.zh: 小布这可急坏了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 zhe4 ke3 ji2 huai4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Bu was frantic with worry

cues.zh: 赶紧联系警察
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 lian2 xi4 jing3 cha2
cues.en: and quickly contacted the police,

cues.zh: 再次回到车祸现场去搜查
cues.pinyin: zai4 ci4 hui2 dao4 che1 huo4 xian4 chang3 qu4 sou1 cha2
cues.en: going back to the accident scene to search again.

cues.zh: 果然在距离车祸现场不远处的草丛里
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 zai4 ju4 li2 che1 huo4 xian4 chang3 bu4 yuan3 chu4 de5 cao3 cong2 li3
cues.en: Sure enough, in the grass not far from the crash site,

cues.zh: 找到了被人遗忘的瘦弱妹
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 le5 bei4 ren2 yi2 wang4 de5 shou4 ruo4 mei4
cues.en: they found the forgotten Skinny Girl.

cues.zh: 她是车祸过程中被甩出来的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 che1 huo4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 bei4 shuai3 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: She had been thrown from the car during the crash.

cues.zh: 小布发现她的时候已经严重脑出血了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 shi2 hou4 yi3 jing1 yan2 zhong4 nao3 chu1 xie3 le5
cues.en: By the time Xiao Bu found her, she already had severe brain bleeding.

cues.zh: 她的头部有硬膜下血肿
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tou2 bu4 you3 ying4 mo2 xia4 xue4 zhong3
cues.en: She had a subdural hematoma on her head,

cues.zh: 瞳孔已经开始放大
cues.pinyin: tong2 kong3 yi3 jing1 kai1 shi3 fang4 da4
cues.en: and her pupils had already started to dilate —

cues.zh: 颅内压增高
cues.pinyin: lu2 nei4 ya1 zeng1 gao1
cues.en: her intracranial pressure was rising.

cues.zh: 为了帮她减压
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bang1 ta1 jian3 ya1
cues.en: To relieve the pressure,

cues.zh: 小布竟然用车祸现场的电钻
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 jing4 ran2 yong4 che1 huo4 xian4 chang3 de5 dian4 zuan4
cues.en: Xiao Bu actually used a drill from the accident scene

cues.zh: 钻透了瘦弱骨的头骨
cues.pinyin: zuan1 tou4 le5 shou4 ruo4 gu3 de5 tou2 gu3
cues.en: to bore through Skinny Girl's skull,

cues.zh: 放出了一股血
cues.pinyin: fang4 chu1 le5 yi1 gu3 xue4
cues.en: releasing a gush of blood.

cues.zh: 虽然看着恐怖
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 kan4 zhe5 kong3 bu4
cues.en: It looked terrifying,

cues.zh: 但是命总算暂时保住了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ming4 zong3 suan4 zan4 shi2 bao3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: but her life was at least saved for now.

cues.zh: 小布赶紧给瘦弱妹气管插管
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 gan3 jin3 gei3 shou4 ruo4 mei4 qi4 guan3 cha1 guan3
cues.en: Xiao Bu quickly intubated Skinny Girl

cues.zh: 然后送回医院
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 song4 hui2 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: and sent her back to the hospital.

cues.zh: 回到医院
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Back at the hospital,

cues.zh: 利姆医生皱着眉头
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 yi1 sheng1 zhou4 zhe5 mei2 tou2
cues.en: Dr. Lim frowned.
