cues.zh: 他们还能活着走出医院吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 neng2 huo2 zhe5 zou3 chu1 yi1 yuan4 ma5
cues.en: Can they still walk out of the hospital alive?

cues.zh: 萧恩所在的医院接诊了一家三口
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 suo3 zai4 de5 yi1 yuan4 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi1 jia1 san1 kou3
cues.en: Shaun's hospital admitted a family of three

cues.zh: 因为异常惨烈的车祸爸爸妈妈都受了重伤
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yi4 chang2 can3 lie4 de5 che1 huo4 ba4 ba4 ma1 ma1 dou1 shou4 le5 zhong4 shang1
cues.en: After an unusually brutal car crash, both mom and dad were critically injured

cues.zh: 妈妈虽然还有意识
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 sui1 ran2 hai2 you3 yi4 shi2
cues.en: Mom was still conscious

cues.zh: 可颅内出血严重已经濒临死亡
cues.pinyin: ke3 lu2 nei4 chu1 xue4 yan2 zhong4 yi3 jing1 bin1 lin2 si3 wang2
cues.en: but her intracranial bleeding was severe and she was near death

cues.zh: 爸爸送进医院就没有意识
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 song4 jin4 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 mei2 you3 yi4 shi2
cues.en: Dad was unconscious from the moment he arrived

cues.zh: 他的腿已经保不住了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui3 yi3 jing1 bao3 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: His leg could no longer be saved

cues.zh: 而腹腔内还伴有严重的内出血
cues.pinyin: er2 fu4 qiang1 nei4 hai2 ban4 you3 yan2 zhong4 de5 nei4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: and there was also severe internal bleeding in his abdomen

cues.zh: 爸爸妈妈被推进手术室紧急手术
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 ma1 ma1 bei4 tui1 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4 jin3 ji2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Mom and dad were both rushed into the OR for emergency surgery

cues.zh: 伤势较轻的女儿艾拉肺部被肋骨刺穿
cues.pinyin: shang1 shi4 jiao4 qing1 de5 nv3 er2 ai4 la1 fei4 bu4 bei4 lei4 gu3 ci4 chuan1
cues.en: Their less injured daughter Ella had a lung punctured by a rib

cues.zh: 可她却不哭不闹
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 que4 bu4 ku1 bu4 nao4
cues.en: But she didn't cry or make a fuss

cues.zh: 看着父母的惨状一脸茫然
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 fu4 mu3 de5 can3 zhuang4 yi1 lian3 mang2 ran2
cues.en: She just looked blankly at her parents' terrible state

cues.zh: 爸爸的手术进行得不太顺利
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 de5 shou3 shu4 jin4 xing2 de2 bu4 tai4 shun4 li4
cues.en: Dad's surgery wasn't going smoothly

cues.zh: 腿伤势太重只能截肢
cues.pinyin: tui3 shang1 shi4 tai4 zhong4 zhi3 neng2 jie2 zhi1
cues.en: His leg was too badly damaged and had to be amputated

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】小女孩的小任性竟害得爸爸失去双腿，幸好有神医肖恩在，要不然这一家人就要家破人亡了

cues.zh: 而手部能否保住还是未知数
cues.pinyin: er2 shou3 bu4 neng2 fou3 bao3 zhu4 hai2 shi4 wei4 zhi1 shu4
cues.en: Whether his hand could be saved was still unknown

cues.zh: 估计只能让安德鲁斯医生过来
cues.pinyin: gu1 ji4 zhi3 neng2 rang4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 yi1 sheng1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: They figured they'd have to call in Dr. Andrews

cues.zh: 他的血管重建术是唯一能帮助
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xue4 guan3 chong2 jian4 shu4 shi4 wei2 yi1 neng2 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: His vascular reconstruction technique was the only thing

cues.zh: 患者的机能了
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 de5 ji1 neng2 le5
cues.en: that could help restore the patient's function

cues.zh: 可爸爸的出血量太大了
cues.pinyin: ke3 ba4 ba4 de5 chu1 xie3 liang4 tai4 da4 le5
cues.en: But dad had lost too much blood

cues.zh: 医生们十分怀疑他能不能等到
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 shi2 fen1 huai2 yi2 ta1 neng2 bu4 neng2 deng3 dao4
cues.en: The doctors seriously doubted he could hold on

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯医生
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: until Dr. Andrews arrived

cues.zh: 而妈妈的手术室里迎来了一位十
cues.pinyin: er2 ma1 ma1 de5 shou3 shu4 shi4 li3 ying2 lai2 le5 yi1 wei4 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile, in mom's OR, a very

cues.zh: 分罕见的医生
cues.pinyin: fen1 han3 jian4 de5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: rare kind of doctor had come

cues.zh: 亚伦重新拿起手术刀披挂上阵
cues.pinyin: ya4 lun2 chong2 xin1 na2 qi3 shou3 shu4 dao1 pi1 gua4 shang4 zhen4
cues.en: Aaron picked up the scalpel again and geared up for battle

cues.zh: 人们总是记得她是前院长
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 zong3 shi4 ji4 de5 ta1 shi4 qian2 yuan4 zhang3
cues.en: People always remember her as the former chief of surgery

cues.zh: 却忘记了她其实是最好的神经外科医生
cues.pinyin: que4 wang4 ji4 le5 ta1 qi2 shi2 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 shen2 jing1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: but forget that she's actually the best neurosurgeon

cues.zh: 可现在这位最好的神外医生也一筹莫展
cues.pinyin: ke3 xian4 zai4 zhe4 wei4 zui4 hao3 de5 shen2 wai4 yi1 sheng1 ye3 yi1 chou2 mo4 zhan3
cues.en: Yet even this top neurosurgeon was now at a loss

cues.zh: 妈妈破损的血管明明已经缝合了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 po4 sun3 de5 xue4 guan3 ming2 ming2 yi3 jing1 feng2 he2 le5
cues.en: Mom's damaged blood vessel had clearly already been sutured

cues.zh: 可血压还是不断下降
cues.pinyin: ke3 xue4 ya1 hai2 shi4 bu4 duan4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: but her blood pressure kept dropping

cues.zh: 难道出血点不在脑子里吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 chu1 xie3 dian3 bu4 zai4 nao3 zi5 li3 ma5
cues.en: Could the bleeding point not be in her brain after all?

cues.zh: 亚伦吩咐人赶紧去请社工陪伴小女孩艾拉
cues.pinyin: ya4 lun2 fen1 fu4 ren2 gan3 jin3 qu4 qing3 she4 gong1 pei2 ban4 xiao3 nv3 hai2 ai4 la1
cues.en: Aaron told someone to hurry and get a social worker to stay with little Ella

cues.zh: 因为她很可能同时失去双筋
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 hen3 ke3 neng2 tong2 shi2 shi1 qu4 shuang1 jin1
cues.en: because she might well lose both her parents at the same time

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】小女孩的小任性竟害得爸爸失去双腿，幸好有神医肖恩在，要不然这一家人就要家破人亡了

cues.zh: 面对这么冷静霸气的小姑娘
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 zhe4 me5 leng3 jing4 ba4 qi4 de5 xiao3 gu1 niang2
cues.en: Faced with such a calm, tough little girl,

cues.zh: 萧恩罕见得有点怂了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 han3 jian4 de2 you3 dian3 song3 le5
cues.en: Shaun, rarely, felt a bit intimidated

cues.zh: 爸爸的手术室里
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 de5 shou3 shu4 shi4 li3
cues.en: In dad's operating room,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯终于赶到了
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 zhong1 yu2 gan3 dao4 le5
cues.en: Andrews finally arrived

cues.zh: 他打算打开爸爸的胸腔
cues.pinyin: ta1 da3 suan4 da3 kai1 ba4 ba4 de5 xiong1 qiang1
cues.en: He planned to open dad's chest

cues.zh: 进行尽端血管旁路搭桥树
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 jin3 duan1 xue4 guan3 pang2 lu4 da1 qiao2 shu4
cues.en: and perform a proximal vascular bypass

cues.zh: 可林医生觉得十分冒险
cues.pinyin: ke3 lin2 yi1 sheng1 jue2 de5 shi2 fen1 mao4 xian3
cues.en: But Dr. Lim thought it was far too risky

cues.zh: 现在病人已经失血过多了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bing4 ren2 yi3 jing1 shi1 xue4 guo4 duo1 le5
cues.en: The patient had already lost too much blood

cues.zh: 如果这搭桥树失败
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 da1 qiao2 shu4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: If this bypass failed,

cues.zh: 等待着病人的只有死亡
cues.pinyin: deng3 dai4 zhe5 bing4 ren2 de5 zhi3 you3 si3 wang2
cues.en: only death awaited the patient

cues.zh: 还是节肢比较稳妥
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jie2 zhi1 bi3 jiao4 wen3 tuo3
cues.en: Amputation was still the safer option

cues.zh: 突然有护士来喊人
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 hu4 shi4 lai2 han3 ren2
cues.en: Dr. Lim was about to say more

cues.zh: 突然由护士来喊人
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you2 hu4 shi4 lai2 han3 ren2
cues.en: when suddenly a nurse came calling for help

cues.zh: 说妈妈那边心脏半膜手损严重
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ma1 ma1 na4 bian1 xin1 zang4 ban4 mo2 shou3 sun3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: saying mom's heart valve was severely damaged

cues.zh: 急需外科医生过去帮忙
cues.pinyin: ji2 xu1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 guo4 qu4 bang1 mang2
cues.en: and they urgently needed a surgeon over there

cues.zh: 林医生无奈
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 wu2 nai4
cues.en: Dr. Lim had no choice

cues.zh: 只好跟着护士离开了爸爸的手术台
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 gen1 zhe5 hu4 shi4 li2 kai1 le5 ba4 ba4 de5 shou3 shu4 tai2
cues.en: but to follow the nurse away from dad's operating table

cues.zh: 妈妈的主动脉瓣受损严重
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 de5 zhu3 dong4 mai4 ban4 shou4 sun3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Mom's aortic valve was severely damaged

cues.zh: 林医生刚来到手术室
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 gang1 lai2 dao4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: The moment Dr. Lim arrived in the OR,

cues.zh: 就发现这个患者十分棘手
cues.pinyin: jiu4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 huan4 zhe3 shi2 fen1 ji2 shou3
cues.en: he found this patient extremely tricky

cues.zh: 他必须马上给妈妈做主动脉瓣的修复手术
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi4 xu1 ma3 shang4 gei3 ma1 ma1 zuo4 zhu3 dong4 mai4 ban4 de5 xiu1 fu4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: He had to repair mom's aortic valve immediately

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】小女孩的小任性竟害得爸爸失去双腿，幸好有神医肖恩在，要不然这一家人就要家破人亡了

cues.zh: 他还是认为截肢才是拯救爸爸的最好方法
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 ren4 wei2 jie2 zhi1 cai2 shi4 zheng3 jiu4 ba4 ba4 de5 zui4 hao3 fang1 fa3
cues.en: He still believed amputation was the best way to save dad

cues.zh: 可安德鲁斯觉得人只有四肢
cues.pinyin: ke3 an1 de2 lu3 si1 jue2 de5 ren2 zhi3 you3 si4 zhi1
cues.en: But Andrews felt a person only has so many limbs

cues.zh: 砍掉两只太残忍了
cues.pinyin: kan3 diao4 liang3 zhi3 tai4 can2 ren3 le5
cues.en: and cutting both off was too cruel

cues.zh: 两人话不投机
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 hua4 bu4 tou2 ji1
cues.en: The two of them couldn't see eye to eye

cues.zh: 很快聊崩了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 liao2 beng1 le5
cues.en: and their talk quickly broke down

cues.zh: 妈妈的脑部手术终于坐稳了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 de5 nao3 bu4 shou3 shu4 zhong1 yu2 zuo4 wen3 le5
cues.en: Mom's brain surgery was finally finished

cues.zh: 可是一波未平
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 bo1 wei4 ping2
cues.en: But no sooner had one crisis settled

cues.zh: 一波又起
cues.pinyin: yi1 bo1 you4 qi3
cues.en: than another arose

cues.zh: 她的气管竟然有撕裂
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qi4 guan3 jing4 ran2 you3 si1 lie4
cues.en: Her trachea had actually torn

cues.zh: 她随时都可能失去呼吸道
cues.pinyin: ta1 sui2 shi2 dou1 ke3 neng2 shi1 qu4 hu1 xi1 dao4
cues.en: She could lose her airway at any moment

cues.zh: 亚伦让人叫来了安德鲁斯
cues.pinyin: ya4 lun2 rang4 ren2 jiao4 lai2 le5 an1 de2 lu3 si1
cues.en: Aaron had someone call Andrews over

cues.zh: 大家一起回转
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 hui2 zhuan3
cues.en: so everyone could consult together

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯觉得应该重建气岛
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 jue2 de5 ying1 gai1 chong2 jian4 qi4 dao3
cues.en: Andrews thought they should rebuild the airway

cues.zh: 可亚伦表示
cues.pinyin: ke3 ya4 lun2 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But Aaron pointed out

cues.zh: 如果在妈妈的脖子上用前开气
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 ma1 ma1 de5 bo2 zi5 shang4 yong4 qian2 kai1 qi4
cues.en: that if they cut into mom's neck,

cues.zh: 那么她的脑供血就会不足
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 nao3 gong1 xue4 jiu4 hui4 bu4 zu2
cues.en: her brain's blood supply would become insufficient

cues.zh: 必须给妈妈用肝素
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 gei3 ma1 ma1 yong4 gan1 su4
cues.en: Dr. Lim said that for the heart surgery,

cues.zh: 必须给妈妈用甘素
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 gei3 ma1 ma1 yong4 gan1 su4
cues.en: they had to give mom heparin

cues.zh: 可亚伦还是拒绝
cues.pinyin: ke3 ya4 lun2 hai2 shi4 ju4 jue2
cues.en: but Aaron still refused

cues.zh: 甘肃会影响他对病人脑部的治疗
cues.pinyin: gan1 su4 hui4 ying3 xiang3 ta1 dui4 bing4 ren2 nao3 bu4 de5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: because heparin would interfere with his treatment of her brain

cues.zh: 所以也就是说
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: So essentially,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯代表气管
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 dai4 biao3 qi4 guan3
cues.en: Andrews represented the trachea,

cues.zh: 林医生代表心脏
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 dai4 biao3 xin1 zang4
cues.en: Dr. Lim represented the heart,

cues.zh: 亚伦代表大脑
cues.pinyin: ya4 lun2 dai4 biao3 da4 nao3
cues.en: and Aaron represented the brain

cues.zh: 三人争执不下
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 zheng1 zhi2 bu4 xia4
cues.en: The three of them were deadlocked

cues.zh: 大家都想先治疗自己负责的部分
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 xiang3 xian1 zhi4 liao2 zi4 ji3 fu4 ze2 de5 bu4 fen4
cues.en: Everyone wanted to treat their own area first

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】小女孩的小任性竟害得爸爸失去双腿，幸好有神医肖恩在，要不然这一家人就要家破人亡了

cues.zh: 可谁也不能保证自己这边下手之后
cues.pinyin: ke3 shui2 ye3 bu4 neng2 bao3 zheng4 zi4 ji3 zhe4 bian1 xia4 shou3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: but no one could guarantee that after they operated,

cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 yin3 qi3 ma1 ma1 qi2 ta1 de5 bing4 fa1 zheng4
cues.en: it wouldn't trigger another complication for mom

cues.zh: 而这些病发症都是致命的
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 xie1 bing4 fa1 zheng4 dou1 shi4 zhi4 ming4 de5
cues.en: and these complications could all be fatal

cues.zh: 三人争执不下的时候
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 zheng1 zhi2 bu4 xia4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While the three were still arguing,

cues.zh: 妈妈病情恶化了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 bing4 qing2 e4 hua4 le5
cues.en: mom's condition suddenly worsened

cues.zh: 他的动脉出现了问题
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 dong4 mai4 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Something went wrong with her artery

cues.zh: 三位大佬赶紧披挂上阵
cues.pinyin: san1 wei4 da4 lao3 gan3 jin3 pi1 gua4 shang4 zhen4
cues.en: and she fell into severe organ failure

cues.zh: 三位大佬赶紧披挂上针
cues.pinyin: san1 wei4 da4 lao3 gan3 jin3 pi1 gua4 shang4 zhen1
cues.en: The three top doctors rushed to gear up

cues.zh: 赛斯站在了手术台上
cues.pinyin: sai4 si1 zhan4 zai4 le5 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4
cues.en: Shaun took his place at the operating table

cues.zh: 还好救治及时
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 jiu4 zhi4 ji2 shi2
cues.en: Luckily they treated her in time

cues.zh: 妈妈在此与死神擦肩而过
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zai4 ci3 yu3 si3 shen2 ca1 jian1 er2 guo4
cues.en: and mom narrowly escaped death this time

cues.zh: 而安德鲁斯痛定思痛
cues.pinyin: er2 an1 de2 lu3 si1 tong4 ding4 si1 tong4
cues.en: Andrews, having learned a painful lesson,

cues.zh: 她觉得自己也好
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 ye3 hao3
cues.en: realized that whether it was him,

cues.zh: 亚伦也好
cues.pinyin: ya4 lun2 ye3 hao3
cues.en: Aaron,

cues.zh: 林医生也好
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 ye3 hao3
cues.en: or Dr. Lim,

cues.zh: 出发点都是为了病人的安危
cues.pinyin: chu1 fa1 dian3 dou1 shi4 wei4 le5 bing4 ren2 de5 an1 wei1
cues.en: they were all acting for the patient's safety

cues.zh: 既然这样
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Since that was the case,

cues.zh: 那大家更应该通力合作
cues.pinyin: na4 da4 jia1 geng4 ying1 gai1 tong1 li4 he2 zuo4
cues.en: everyone should cooperate even more fully

cues.zh: 才能将病人成功救活
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 jiang1 bing4 ren2 cheng2 gong1 jiu4 huo2
cues.en: in order to save the patient successfully

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯医生话音未落
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 yi1 sheng1 hua4 yin1 wei4 luo4
cues.en: Before Dr. Andrews even finished speaking,

cues.zh: 手术室里的警报器就响了起来
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi4 li3 de5 jing3 bao4 qi4 jiu4 xiang3 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: the alarm in the operating room went off

cues.zh: 妈妈快不行了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 kuai4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: Mom was slipping away

cues.zh: 她的心动过缓很严重
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 dong4 guo4 huan3 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Her bradycardia had become severe

cues.zh: 可林医生看得很清楚
cues.pinyin: ke3 lin2 yi1 sheng1 kan4 de2 hen3 qing1 chu3
cues.en: But Dr. Lim could see clearly

cues.zh: 妈妈心脏的斑目位置没有什么问题
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 xin1 zang4 de5 ban1 mu4 wei4 zhi4 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that mom's heart valve itself was fine

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】小女孩的小任性竟害得爸爸失去双腿，幸好有神医肖恩在，要不然这一家人就要家破人亡了

cues.zh: 虽然暂时止住血
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zan4 shi2 zhi3 zhu4 xue4
cues.en: Though the bleeding had been stopped for now,

cues.zh: 可随时都有可能再次破裂
cues.pinyin: ke3 sui2 shi2 dou1 you3 ke3 neng2 zai4 ci4 po4 lie4
cues.en: it could rupture again at any moment

cues.zh: 肖恩建议给艾拉开胸手术
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jian4 yi4 gei3 ai4 la1 kai1 xiong1 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Shaun suggested open-chest surgery for Ella

cues.zh: 重建血管
cues.pinyin: chong2 jian4 xue4 guan3
cues.en: to reconstruct her blood vessels

cues.zh: 可艾伦觉得小女孩还年轻
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 lun2 jue2 de5 xiao3 nv3 hai2 hai2 nian2 qing1
cues.en: But Aaron felt the little girl was still so young

cues.zh: 真的要给她做这么大的手术吗
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 yao4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 shou3 shu4 ma5
cues.en: Did she really need such a major surgery?

cues.zh: 就没有别的办法了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 you3 bie2 de5 ban4 fa3 le5
cues.en: Was there really no other way?

cues.zh: 肖恩人形电脑在大脑资料库里搜索了一番
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ren2 xing2 dian4 nao3 zai4 da4 nao3 zi1 liao4 ku4 li3 sou1 suo3 le5 yi1 fan1
cues.en: Shaun, the human computer, searched through his mental database

cues.zh: 确认这也是唯一能治疗艾拉的方法
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 zhe4 ye3 shi4 wei2 yi1 neng2 zhi4 liao2 ai4 la1 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: and confirmed this was the only way to treat Ella

cues.zh: 在打针的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 da3 zhen1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While getting her injection,

cues.zh: 小姑娘一向成熟稳重的脸上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu1 niang2 yi2 xiang4 cheng2 shu2 wen3 zhong4 de5 lian3 shang4
cues.en: the usually mature and composed look on the girl's face

cues.zh: 终于露出了一些恐惧的神情
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 lu4 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 kong3 ju4 de5 shen2 qing2
cues.en: finally showed a hint of fear

cues.zh: 她有点害怕
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 dian3 hai4 pa4
cues.en: She was a little scared

cues.zh: 想牵着萧恩的手
cues.pinyin: xiang3 qian1 zhe5 xiao1 en1 de5 shou3
cues.en: and wanted to hold Shaun's hand

cues.zh: 萧恩也很害怕
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ye3 hen3 hai4 pa4
cues.en: Shaun was also very frightened

cues.zh: 作为一个自闭症患者
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: As someone with autism,

cues.zh: 萧恩拒绝任何不熟悉人的触碰
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ju4 jue2 ren4 he2 bu4 shu2 xi1 ren2 de5 chu4 peng4
cues.en: Shaun normally refuses to be touched by anyone unfamiliar

cues.zh: 可小艾拉的冷静坚强
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 ai4 la1 de5 leng3 jing4 jian1 qiang2
cues.en: but little Ella's calm and strength

cues.zh: 还是感动了萧恩
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 gan3 dong4 le5 xiao1 en1
cues.en: still moved him

cues.zh: 她咬着牙
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao3 zhe5 ya2
cues.en: He gritted his teeth

cues.zh: 她说艾拉的爸爸手术做完了
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ai4 la1 de5 ba4 ba4 shou3 shu4 zuo4 wan2 le5
cues.en: and let Ella hold his hand tightly during the injection

cues.zh: 治疗结束后
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liao2 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the treatment was over,

cues.zh: 艾伦医生感到
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 yi1 sheng1 gan3 dao4
cues.en: Dr. Aaron felt that

cues.zh: 她说艾拉的爸爸下手出台了
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ai4 la1 de5 ba4 ba4 xia4 shou3 chu1 tai2 le5
cues.en: she said Ella's dad's surgery was finished

cues.zh: 她的腿截肢了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui3 jie2 zhi1 le5
cues.en: His leg had been amputated

cues.zh: 守得初步时亮也结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 de2 chu1 bu4 shi2 liang4 ye3 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: and this first round of treatment had also come to a successful close

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天我继续和大家漫谈相对论
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 ji4 xu4 he2 da4 jia1 man4 tan2 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: Today I'll continue our informal chat about relativity.

cues.zh: 我们之前说过
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: As we mentioned before,

cues.zh: 牛顿力学只能处理速度远远低
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 li4 xue2 zhi3 neng2 chu3 li3 su4 du4 yuan3 yuan3 di1
cues.en: Newtonian mechanics can only handle situations where speed is far

cues.zh: 于光速的情况
cues.pinyin: yu2 guang1 su4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: below the speed of light.

cues.zh: 一旦物体的速度足够快
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 wu4 ti3 de5 su4 du4 zu2 gou4 kuai4
cues.en: Once an object's speed is fast enough,

cues.zh: 就应该使用狭义相对论了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi3 yong4 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 le5
cues.en: special relativity should be used instead.

cues.zh: 而狭义相对论只能处理没有物质
cues.pinyin: er2 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhi3 neng2 chu3 li3 mei2 you3 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: But special relativity can only handle cases with no matter,

cues.zh: 空间是平直的情况
cues.pinyin: kong1 jian1 shi4 ping2 zhi2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: where space is flat.

cues.zh: 一旦因为引力造成了空间弯曲
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 yin1 wei4 yin3 li4 zao4 cheng2 le5 kong1 jian1 wan1 qu1
cues.en: Once gravity causes space to curve,

cues.zh: 就要使用广义相对论了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 shi3 yong4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 le5
cues.en: general relativity must be used.

cues.zh: 于是有人说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: So some people say,

cues.zh: 牛顿定律被狭义相对论推翻了
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 bei4 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 tui1 fan1 le5
cues.en: Newton's laws were overturned by special relativity,

cues.zh: 而狭义相对论又被广义相对论推翻了
cues.pinyin: er2 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 you4 bei4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 tui1 fan1 le5
cues.en: and special relativity was in turn overturned by general relativity.

cues.zh: 对于这种观点
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 zhong3 guan1 dian3
cues.en: Regarding this view,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在他写的小册子
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 ta1 xie3 de5 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: in the booklet Einstein wrote,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论浅说中
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1 zhong1
cues.en: 'Relativity: The Special and the General Theory,'

cues.zh: 做了一个比喻
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 bi3 yu4
cues.en: he gave an analogy.

cues.zh: 他说想计算两个电荷之间的作用力
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 xiang3 ji4 suan4 liang3 ge4 dian4 he4 zhi1 jian1 de5 zuo4 yong4 li4
cues.en: He said if you want to calculate the force between two charges,

cues.zh: 可以使用静电学的库仑定律
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 jing4 dian4 xue2 de5 ku4 lun2 ding4 lv4
cues.en: you can use Coulomb's law of electrostatics,

cues.zh: 但是这是在电荷静止不动的情况下
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 shi4 zai4 dian4 he4 jing4 zhi3 bu4 dong4 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: but that's only when the charges are stationary.

cues.zh: 一旦这个电荷运动起来
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 zhe4 ge5 dian4 he4 yun4 dong4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Once the charge starts moving,

cues.zh: 就应该使用麦克斯威方程组和电动
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi3 yong4 mai4 ke4 si1 wei1 fang1 cheng2 zu3 he2 dian4 dong4
cues.en: you should use Maxwell's equations and the theory

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 力学的理论了
cues.pinyin: li4 xue2 de5 li3 lun4 le5
cues.en: of electrodynamics.

cues.zh: 那么我们是不是能说电动力学
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 shi4 bu2 shi4 neng2 shuo1 dian4 dong4 li4 xue2
cues.en: So can we say that electrodynamics

cues.zh: 就推翻了静电学定律呢
cues.pinyin: jiu4 tui1 fan1 le5 jing4 dian4 xue2 ding4 lv4 ne5
cues.en: overturned the laws of electrostatics?

cues.zh: 绝非如此
cues.pinyin: jue2 fei1 ru2 ci3
cues.en: Not at all.

cues.zh: 在电场不随时间变化的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 dian4 chang3 bu4 sui2 shi2 jian1 bian4 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When the electric field doesn't change with time,

cues.zh: 电动力学会得出静电学的结论
cues.pinyin: dian4 dong4 li4 xue2 hui4 de2 chu1 jing4 dian4 xue2 de5 jie2 lun4
cues.en: electrodynamics gives the same conclusions as electrostatics.

cues.zh: 所以静电学是一种特殊或者说极限的情况
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jing4 dian4 xue2 shi4 yi1 zhong3 te4 shu1 huo4 zhe3 shuo1 ji2 xian4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: So electrostatics is a special, or limiting, case,

cues.zh: 在新的理论电动力学中依然是成立的
cues.pinyin: zai4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 dian4 dong4 li4 xue2 zhong1 yi1 ran2 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5
cues.en: that still holds true within the new theory of electrodynamics.

cues.zh: 只是新的理论适用范围更广泛了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 shi4 yong4 fan4 wei2 geng4 guang3 fan4 le5
cues.en: It's just that the new theory has a broader range of applicability.

cues.zh: 所以物理学的发展其实是阶段性的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wu4 li3 xue2 de5 fa1 zhan3 qi2 shi2 shi4 jie1 duan4 xing4 de5
cues.en: So the development of physics actually happens in stages.

cues.zh: 牛顿定律曾经非常精确地阐述了宇
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ceng2 jing1 fei1 chang2 jing1 que4 di4 chan3 shu4 le5 yu3
cues.en: Newton's laws once described the laws governing

cues.zh: 宙运行的规律
cues.pinyin: zhou4 yun4 xing2 de5 gui1 lv4
cues.en: the operation of the universe very precisely.

cues.zh: 可是后来随着人们测量越来越精确
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hou4 lai2 sui2 zhe5 ren2 men5 ce4 liang2 yue4 lai2 yue4 jing1 que4
cues.en: But later, as measurements became more and more precise,

cues.zh: 才发现牛顿定律与事实不相符的地方
cues.pinyin: cai2 fa1 xian4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 yu3 shi4 shi2 bu4 xiang1 fu2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: people found places where Newton's laws didn't match reality,

cues.zh: 才需要新的理论把牛顿定律进行拓展
cues.pinyin: cai2 xu1 yao4 xin1 de5 li3 lun4 ba3 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 jin4 xing2 tuo4 zhan3
cues.en: and new theories were needed to extend Newton's laws.

cues.zh: 狭义和广义相对论并没有推翻牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 he2 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 bing4 mei2 you3 tui1 fan1 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Special and general relativity didn't overturn Newton's laws,

cues.zh: 而是发展了牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 fa1 zhan3 le5 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: they developed them further.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 水星的进冻速度并不快
cues.pinyin: shui3 xing1 de5 jin4 dong4 su4 du4 bing4 bu4 kuai4
cues.en: Mercury's perihelion precession isn't fast,

cues.zh: 可是科学家们认死理
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 ren4 si3 li3
cues.en: but scientists were stubborn about it,

cues.zh: 非要弄清楚这个进冻是从哪里来的
cues.pinyin: fei1 yao4 nong4 qing1 chu3 zhe4 ge5 jin4 dong4 shi4 cong2 na3 li3 lai2 de5
cues.en: insisting on figuring out where this precession came from.

cues.zh: 根据牛顿定律计算
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ji4 suan4
cues.en: Calculating according to Newton's laws,

cues.zh: 考虑各种天体之间的射动影响
cues.pinyin: kao3 lv4 ge4 zhong3 tian1 ti3 zhi1 jian1 de5 she4 dong4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: taking into account the gravitational perturbations between various celestial bodies,

cues.zh: 科学家们可以解释其中的 55 57 秒
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 ke3 yi3 jie3 shi4 qi2 zhong1 de5 55 57 miao3
cues.en: scientists could explain 5557 arcseconds of it,

cues.zh: 但是还有 43 秒的差别是无法解释的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 you3 43 miao3 de5 cha1 bie2 shi4 wu2 fa3 jie3 shi4 de5
cues.en: but the remaining 43 arcseconds couldn't be explained.

cues.zh: 许多科学家提出了一些假说
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ke1 xue2 jia1 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 jia3 shuo1
cues.en: Many scientists proposed hypotheses.

cues.zh: 比如说也许水星轨道附近存在尘埃阻力
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ye3 xu3 shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 fu4 jin4 cun2 zai4 chen2 ai1 zu3 li4
cues.en: For example, maybe there was dust drag near Mercury's orbit,

cues.zh: 太阳是不均匀的
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 shi4 bu4 jun1 yun2 de5
cues.en: or the sun wasn't uniform,

cues.zh: 水星轨道内部还有一颗没有发现的助容星
cues.pinyin: shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 nei4 bu4 hai2 you3 yi1 ke1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 de5 zhu4 rong2 xing1
cues.en: or there was an undiscovered planet, Vulcan, inside Mercury's orbit,

cues.zh: 甚至怀疑牛顿的万有引力定律
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 huai2 yi2 niu2 dun4 de5 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: or they even suspected Newton's law of universal gravitation

cues.zh: 不是严格的平方反比定律
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yan2 ge2 de5 ping2 fang1 fan3 bi3 ding4 lv4
cues.en: wasn't exactly an inverse-square law.

cues.zh: 但是这些理论都无法完美的解释这个差别
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 xie1 li3 lun4 dou1 wu2 fa3 wan2 mei3 de5 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 cha1 bie2
cues.en: But none of these theories could perfectly explain the discrepancy.

cues.zh: 直到爱因斯坦提出广义相对论之后
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ti2 chu1 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Not until Einstein proposed general relativity

cues.zh: 他发现由于水星轨道距离太阳很近
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 you2 yu2 shui3 xing1 gui3 dao4 ju4 li2 tai4 yang2 hen3 jin4
cues.en: did he find that because Mercury's orbit is so close to the sun,

cues.zh: 时空被太阳弯曲的太强烈了
cues.pinyin: shi2 kong1 bei4 tai4 yang2 wan1 qu1 de5 tai4 qiang2 lie4 le5
cues.en: spacetime is curved very strongly by the sun.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 光线也会发生向下的弯折
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 ye3 hui4 fa1 sheng1 xiang4 xia4 de5 wan1 zhe2
cues.en: Light also bends downward because of this.

cues.zh: 引力能够让光发生弯折
cues.pinyin: yin3 li4 neng2 gou4 rang4 guang1 fa1 sheng1 wan1 zhe2
cues.en: Gravity can cause light to bend —

cues.zh: 这就是爱因斯坦的预言
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 de5 yu4 yan2
cues.en: this was Einstein's prediction.

cues.zh: 不过地球的引力还不够大
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 di4 qiu2 de5 yin3 li4 hai2 bu4 gou4 da4
cues.en: But Earth's gravity isn't strong enough.

cues.zh: 如果有一束光在地面上运动 3000 公里
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 yi1 shu4 guang1 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 yun4 dong4 3000 gong1 li3
cues.en: If a beam of light traveled 3000 kilometers on Earth's surface,

cues.zh: 由于引力影响造成的光线偏折也
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 yin3 li4 ying3 xiang3 zao4 cheng2 de5 guang1 xian4 pian1 zhe2 ye3
cues.en: the deflection caused by gravity would be

cues.zh: 只有 0 5 毫米
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 0 5 hao2 mi3
cues.en: only 0.5 millimeters.

cues.zh: 所以爱因斯坦电梯实验没有办法
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 dian4 ti1 shi2 yan4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3
cues.en: So Einstein's elevator thought experiment couldn't be

cues.zh: 在地面上实现
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 shi2 xian4
cues.en: realized on Earth.

cues.zh: 但是太阳的引力远远比地球大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tai4 yang2 de5 yin3 li4 yuan3 yuan3 bi3 di4 qiu2 da4
cues.en: But the sun's gravity is far stronger than Earth's.

cues.zh: 假如光线经过太阳附近
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 guang1 xian4 jing1 guo4 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4
cues.en: If light passes near the sun,

cues.zh: 那么光线的偏折就会达到可以观测的程度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guang1 xian4 de5 pian1 zhe2 jiu4 hui4 da2 dao4 ke3 yi3 guan1 ce4 de5 cheng2 du4
cues.en: the deflection would be large enough to observe.

cues.zh: 其实在爱因斯坦之前就有人根据牛顿定律
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zhi1 qian2 jiu4 you3 ren2 gen1 ju4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Actually, even before Einstein, people had used Newton's laws

cues.zh: 计算出了光线经过太阳附近会发生偏折
cues.pinyin: ji4 suan4 chu1 le5 guang1 xian4 jing1 guo4 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4 hui4 fa1 sheng1 pian1 zhe2
cues.en: to calculate that light passing near the sun would bend.

cues.zh: 只不过用牛顿定律计算出的结果只有爱
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 yong4 niu2 dun4 ding4 lv4 ji4 suan4 chu1 de5 jie2 guo3 zhi3 you3 ai4
cues.en: It's just that the result calculated with Newton's laws was only half

cues.zh: 因斯坦的一半
cues.pinyin: yin1 si1 tan3 de5 yi2 ban4
cues.en: of Einstein's.

cues.zh: 牛顿和爱因斯坦谁对谁错
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 he2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shui2 dui4 shui2 cuo4
cues.en: Who was right, Newton or Einstein —

cues.zh: 必须要通过实验来验证
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 yao4 tong1 guo4 shi2 yan4 lai2 yan4 zheng4
cues.en: it had to be verified by experiment.

cues.zh: 于是历史上两个最伟大的物理学家
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 li4 shi3 shang4 liang3 ge4 zui4 wei3 da4 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: And so the two greatest physicists in history,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 跨越 200 年的 P K 开始了
cues.pinyin: kua4 yue4 200 nian2 de5 P K kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: separated by 200 years, began their showdown.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在 19 16 年写成这本小册子
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 19 16 nian2 xie3 cheng2 zhe4 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: When Einstein finished writing this booklet in 1916,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论潜说的时候
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian2 shuo1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: 'Relativity: The Special and the General Theory,'

cues.zh: 实验还没有人做
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 hai2 mei2 you3 ren2 zuo4
cues.en: no one had done the experiment yet.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦明确地给出了实验的方法
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ming2 que4 di4 gei3 chu1 le5 shi2 yan4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Einstein clearly laid out the experimental method:

cues.zh: 设量两颗恒星光线之间的夹角
cues.pinyin: she4 liang4 liang3 ke1 heng2 xing1 guang1 xian4 zhi1 jian1 de5 jia1 jiao3
cues.en: measure the angle between the light rays of two stars,

cues.zh: 然后随着地球的自转和公转
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 sui2 zhe5 di4 qiu2 de5 zi4 zhuan4 he2 gong1 zhuan4
cues.en: then, as the Earth rotates and orbits,

cues.zh: 找到一个时刻
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 shi2 ke4
cues.en: find a moment

cues.zh: 此时太阳刚好位于两条光线中间
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 tai4 yang2 gang1 hao3 wei4 yu2 liang3 tiao2 guang1 xian4 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: when the sun happens to be right between the two light rays.

cues.zh: 如果太阳的引力真的让光线发生了偏折
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 tai4 yang2 de5 yin3 li4 zhen1 de5 rang4 guang1 xian4 fa1 sheng1 le5 pian1 zhe2
cues.en: If the sun's gravity really does bend the light,

cues.zh: 那么此时两条光线的夹角
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ci3 shi2 liang3 tiao2 guang1 xian4 de5 jia1 jiao3
cues.en: then the angle between the two rays at that moment

cues.zh: 应该与没有太阳的时候是不一样的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 yu3 mei2 you3 tai4 yang2 de5 shi2 hou4 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: should be different from when the sun isn't there.

cues.zh: 由于太阳过于耀眼
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 tai4 yang2 guo4 yu2 yao4 yan3
cues.en: Because the sun is too bright,

cues.zh: 那么这个实验只能在日全时的时候来做
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 zhi3 neng2 zai4 ri4 quan2 shi2 de5 shi2 hou4 lai2 zuo4
cues.en: this experiment can only be done during a total solar eclipse.

cues.pinyin: 19 19 nian2 5 yue4 29 ri4

cues.zh: 英国天文学家爱丁顿率领观测队
cues.pinyin: ying1 guo2 tian1 wen2 xue2 jia1 ai4 ding1 dun4 shuai4 ling3 guan1 ce4 dui4
cues.en: British astronomer Eddington led an observation team

cues.zh: 在西非的普林西壁岛观测了日全时
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 fei1 de5 pu3 lin2 xi1 bi4 dao3 guan1 ce4 le5 ri4 quan2 shi2
cues.en: to observe the total solar eclipse on Príncipe Island in West Africa,

cues.zh: 拍摄日全时时太阳附近的恒星位置
cues.pinyin: pai1 she4 ri4 quan2 shi2 shi2 tai4 yang2 fu4 jin4 de5 heng2 xing1 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: photographing the positions of stars near the sun during the eclipse.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（七）爱因斯坦和牛顿PK谁赢了？广义相对论是否推翻了牛顿定律？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦说
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1
cues.en: Einstein said,

cues.zh: 那我会为上帝感到遗憾
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 hui4 wei4 shang4 di4 gan3 dao4 yi2 han4
cues.en: then I would feel sorry for God —

cues.zh: 不管怎么说
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 zen3 me5 shuo1
cues.en: no matter what,

cues.zh: 理论总还是对的
cues.pinyin: li3 lun4 zong3 hai2 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: the theory is still correct.

cues.zh: 你看爱因斯坦就是这么自信
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 me5 zi4 xin4
cues.en: See, that's how confident Einstein was.

cues.zh: 验证广义相对论的第三个实验
cues.pinyin: yan4 zheng4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 di4 san1 ge4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: The third experiment verifying general relativity

cues.zh: 是引力红移现象
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin3 li4 hong2 yi2 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: was the phenomenon of gravitational redshift.

cues.zh: 广义相对论告诉我们
cues.pinyin: guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 gao4 su4 wo3 men5
cues.en: General relativity tells us

cues.zh: 在引力是低的地方
cues.pinyin: zai4 yin3 li4 shi4 di1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: that in places with low gravitational potential,

cues.zh: 始终会变慢
cues.pinyin: shi3 zhong1 hui4 bian4 man4
cues.en: time runs slower.

cues.zh: 如果大质量的恒星发光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 da4 zhi4 liang4 de5 heng2 xing1 fa1 guang1
cues.en: If a massive star emits light,

cues.zh: 光从引力是很低的星球表面
cues.pinyin: guang1 cong2 yin3 li4 shi4 hen3 di1 de5 xing1 qiu2 biao3 mian4
cues.en: and the light travels from the star's surface, where the gravitational potential is low,

cues.zh: 到达地球的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 da2 di4 qiu2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: to reach Earth,

cues.zh: 频率就会变小
cues.pinyin: pin2 lv4 jiu4 hui4 bian4 xiao3
cues.en: its frequency decreases —

cues.zh: 发生红移
cues.pinyin: fa1 sheng1 hong2 yi2
cues.en: a redshift occurs.

cues.zh: 也就是某种元素
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 mou3 zhong3 yuan2 su4
cues.en: That is, the light emitted by a certain element

cues.zh: 发出光的频率会低于地面上同样元
cues.pinyin: fa1 chu1 guang1 de5 pin2 lv4 hui4 di1 yu2 di4 mian4 shang4 tong2 yang4 yuan2
cues.en: will have a lower frequency than light from the same element

cues.zh: 素发光的频率
cues.pinyin: su4 fa1 guang1 de5 pin2 lv4
cues.en: emitted on Earth.

cues.zh: 反过来说
cues.pinyin: fan3 guo4 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: Conversely,

cues.zh: 如果在地面上向天空发出一道光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 xiang4 tian1 kong1 fa1 chu1 yi1 dao4 guang1
cues.en: if a beam of light is sent from the ground up into the sky,

cues.zh: 在光线远离地球的过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 guang1 xian4 yuan3 li2 di4 qiu2 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: as the light moves away from Earth,

cues.zh: 频率也会变低发生红移
cues.pinyin: pin2 lv4 ye3 hui4 bian4 di1 fa1 sheng1 hong2 yi2
cues.en: its frequency also decreases, causing a redshift.

cues.zh: 或者你也可以理解成
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 li3 jie3 cheng2
cues.en: Or you can think of it this way:

cues.zh: 光线从弯曲的空间中爬出来
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 cong2 wan1 qu1 de5 kong1 jian1 zhong1 pa2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: light climbing out of curved space

cues.zh: 需要消耗一定的能量
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 xiao1 hao4 yi2 ding4 de5 neng2 liang4
cues.en: has to expend some energy,

cues.zh: 所以频率变低了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 pin2 lv4 bian4 di1 le5
cues.en: so its frequency decreases.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】新中国最严重水库溃坝事故：河南“75·8特大洪灾”始末

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近一段时间全国很多地方突降暴雨
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 quan2 guo2 hen3 duo1 di4 fang1 tu1 jiang4 bao4 yu3
cues.en: Recently, many places across the country have had sudden heavy rainstorms.

cues.zh: 有一些地方还出现了洪涝灾害
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 xie1 di4 fang1 hai2 chu1 xian4 le5 hong2 lao4 zai1 hai4
cues.en: Some places have even experienced flood disasters.

cues.zh: 在历史上河南地区也是屡次受到洪
cues.pinyin: zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 he2 nan2 di4 qu1 ye3 shi4 lv3 ci4 shou4 dao4 hong2
cues.en: Historically, Henan has repeatedly suffered from flo-

cues.zh: 涝灾害的侵袭
cues.pinyin: lao4 zai1 hai4 de5 qin1 xi2
cues.en: -oding disasters.

cues.zh: 离我们比较近的是在 19 75 年的 8 月份
cues.pinyin: li2 wo3 men5 bi3 jiao4 jin4 de5 shi4 zai4 19 75 nian2 de5 8 yue4 fen4
cues.en: A relatively recent case was in August 1975.

cues.zh: 由于千年一遇的暴雨
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 qian1 nian2 yi1 yu4 de5 bao4 yu3
cues.en: Due to a once-in-a-millennium rainstorm,

cues.zh: 河南驻马店地区 62 座水库相继溃坝
cues.pinyin: he2 nan2 zhu4 ma3 dian4 di4 qu1 62 zuo4 shui3 ku4 xiang1 ji4 kui4 ba4
cues.en: 62 reservoirs in the Zhumadian area of Henan collapsed one after another.

cues.zh: 2 万平方公里的土地被淹
cues.pinyin: 2 wan4 ping2 fang1 gong1 li3 de5 tu3 di4 bei4 yan1
cues.en: 20,000 square kilometers of land were flooded.

cues.zh: 上千万人成为灾民数万人死亡
cues.pinyin: shang4 qian1 wan4 ren2 cheng2 wei2 zai1 min2 shu4 wan4 ren2 si3 wang2
cues.en: Tens of millions became disaster victims, and tens of thousands died.

cues.zh: 史称 75 8 水灾
cues.pinyin: shi3 cheng1 75 8 shui3 zai1
cues.en: It's known in history as the "75.8" flood.

cues.zh: 但是当我跟小朋友们谈到这个问题的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dang1 wo3 gen1 xiao3 peng2 you3 men5 tan2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when I talk to kids about this topic,

cues.zh: 很多同学并不了解 75 8 水灾
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 tong2 xue2 bing4 bu4 liao3 jie3 75 8 shui3 zai1
cues.en: many students don't know about the "75.8" flood.

cues.zh: 那么今天我们就一起来回忆一下这
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 yi4 qi3 lai2 hui2 yi4 yi1 xia4 zhe4
cues.en: So today let's recall this

cues.zh: 个悲惨的事故
cues.pinyin: ge4 bei1 can3 de5 shi4 gu4
cues.en: tragic incident together.

cues.zh: 我们首先来讲一下河南地区为什
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 jiang3 yi1 xia4 he2 nan2 di4 qu1 wei4 shen2
cues.en: Let's first talk about why Henan

cues.zh: 么会多发水灾
cues.pinyin: me5 hui4 duo1 fa1 shui3 zai1
cues.en: frequently suffers from floods.

cues.zh: 河南水灾的原因是什么
cues.pinyin: he2 nan2 shui3 zai1 de5 yuan2 yin1 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What is the cause of Henan's floods?

cues.zh: 那主要是由于它的气候和地理条件造成的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhu3 yao4 shi4 you2 yu2 ta1 de5 qi4 hou4 he2 di4 li3 tiao2 jian4 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: It's mainly due to its climate and geographic conditions.

cues.zh: 首先河南地区水系非常多
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 he2 nan2 di4 qu1 shui3 xi4 fei1 chang2 duo1
cues.en: First, Henan has a very dense river network.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】新中国最严重水库溃坝事故：河南“75·8特大洪灾”始末

cues.zh: 中国文明是大江大河文明
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 wen2 ming2 shi4 da4 jiang1 da4 he2 wen2 ming2
cues.en: Chinese civilization is a civilization of great rivers.

cues.zh: 我们需要河水江水来进行灌溉
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 he2 shui3 jiang1 shui3 lai2 jin4 xing2 guan4 gai4
cues.en: We need river water for irrigation.

cues.zh: 所以我们在长江和黄河流域产生了文明
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 zai4 chang2 jiang1 he2 huang2 he2 liu2 yu4 chan3 sheng1 le5 wen2 ming2
cues.en: So civilization arose along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins.

cues.zh: 而河南地区就有四条大河
cues.pinyin: er2 he2 nan2 di4 qu1 jiu4 you3 si4 tiao2 da4 he2
cues.en: Henan region has four major rivers.

cues.zh: 分别是黄河还有淮河
cues.pinyin: fen1 bie2 shi4 huang2 he2 hai2 you3 huai2 he2
cues.en: Namely the Yellow River and the Huai River,

cues.zh: 还有长江还有海河
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 chang2 jiang1 hai2 you3 hai3 he2
cues.en: as well as the Yangtze River and the Hai River.

cues.zh: 那么这四条大河都流经了河南境内
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 si4 tiao2 da4 he2 dou1 liu2 jing1 le5 he2 nan2 jing4 nei4
cues.en: These four major rivers all flow through Henan.

cues.zh: 尤其是黄河
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 huang2 he2
cues.en: Especially the Yellow River.

cues.zh: 黄河因为寒沙量子比较大
cues.pinyin: huang2 he2 yin1 wei4 han2 sha1 liang4 zi3 bi3 jiao4 da4
cues.en: The Yellow River has a relatively high sediment content.

cues.zh: 它不是一个特别安分的河
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 te4 bie2 an1 fen4 de5 he2
cues.en: It's not a particularly well-behaved river.

cues.zh: 黄河号称三年一决口百年一改道
cues.pinyin: huang2 he2 hao4 cheng1 san1 nian2 yi1 jue2 kou3 bai3 nian2 yi1 gai3 dao4
cues.en: The Yellow River is known for "a breach every three years, a course change every hundred years."

cues.zh: 在西汉到现在的 2000 多年里外
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 han4 dao4 xian4 zai4 de5 2000 duo1 nian2 li3 wai4
cues.en: From the Western Han to now, over 2,000 years,

cues.zh: 黄河一共绝口了 15 00 次
cues.pinyin: huang2 he2 yi1 gong4 jue2 kou3 le5 15 00 ci4
cues.en: the Yellow River has breached its banks 1,500 times in total.

cues.zh: 其中有 2 3 都是发生在河南境内
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 you3 2 3 dou1 shi4 fa1 sheng1 zai4 he2 nan2 jing4 nei4
cues.en: Two-thirds of those occurred within Henan.

cues.zh: 同时大型的改道有 26 次
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 da4 xing2 de5 gai3 dao4 you3 26 ci4
cues.en: There have also been 26 major course changes.

cues.zh: 有 20 次都是发生在河南境内
cues.pinyin: you3 20 ci4 dou1 shi4 fa1 sheng1 zai4 he2 nan2 jing4 nei4
cues.en: 20 of them occurred within Henan.

cues.zh: 北宋时期又发生了黄河夺淮事件
cues.pinyin: bei3 song4 shi2 qi1 you4 fa1 sheng1 le5 huang2 he2 duo2 huai2 shi4 jian4
cues.en: In the Northern Song era, the Yellow River also diverted into the Huai River's course.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】新中国最严重水库溃坝事故：河南“75·8特大洪灾”始末

cues.zh: 到达了河南地区的话就会被迫抬升
cues.pinyin: dao4 da2 le5 he2 nan2 di4 qu1 de5 hua4 jiu4 hui4 bei4 po4 tai2 sheng1
cues.en: When it reaches Henan, it's forced to rise.

cues.zh: 那一旦抬升遇冷就会形成降雨
cues.pinyin: na4 yi2 dan4 tai2 sheng1 yu4 leng3 jiu4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 jiang4 yu3
cues.en: Once it rises and meets cold air, rain forms.

cues.zh: 形成降雨了之后因为周围都是山
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 jiang4 yu3 le5 zhi1 hou4 yin1 wei4 zhou1 wei2 dou1 shi4 shan1
cues.en: After rain forms, since the surrounding area is all mountains,

cues.zh: 所以这些水就会从山上流下来
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 xie1 shui3 jiu4 hui4 cong2 shan1 shang4 liu2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: this water flows down from the mountains

cues.zh: 然后流到了平原地区
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 liu2 dao4 le5 ping2 yuan2 di4 qu1
cues.en: and then flows into the plains.

cues.zh: 所以平原地区特别容易出现这个内
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ping2 yuan2 di4 qu1 te4 bie2 rong2 yi4 chu1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 nei4
cues.en: So plain areas are especially prone to this kind of

cues.zh: 涂的这种情况
cues.pinyin: tu2 de5 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: waterlogging.

cues.zh: 所以在历史上河南的水灾就特别特别多
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 he2 nan2 de5 shui3 zai1 jiu4 te4 bie2 te4 bie2 duo1
cues.en: So historically, Henan has had an especially large number of floods.

cues.zh: 那 19 31 年的时候河南爆发了一场大水灾
cues.pinyin: na4 19 31 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 he2 nan2 bao4 fa1 le5 yi1 chang2 da4 shui3 zai1
cues.en: In 1931, Henan suffered a major flood disaster.

cues.zh: 2000 万人受灾死了 20 多万人
cues.pinyin: 2000 wan4 ren2 shou4 zai1 si3 le5 20 duo1 wan4 ren2
cues.en: 20 million people were affected, and over 200,000 died.

cues.zh: 1931 年的时候河南爆发了一场大水灾
cues.pinyin: 1931 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 he2 nan2 bao4 fa1 le5 yi1 chang2 da4 shui3 zai1
cues.en: After the founding of New China, the state proposed that we

cues.zh: 要把淮河治好
cues.pinyin: yao4 ba3 huai2 he2 zhi4 hao3
cues.en: must harness the Huai River well.

cues.zh: 在 19 50 年的时候国家提出了这
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 50 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 guo2 jia1 ti2 chu1 le5 zhe4
cues.en: In 1950, the state issued

cues.zh: 样的一份文件
cues.pinyin: yang4 de5 yi1 fen4 wen2 jian4
cues.en: such a document,

cues.zh: 叫做关于治理淮河的决定
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 guan1 yu2 zhi4 li3 huai2 he2 de5 jue2 ding4
cues.en: called "Decision on Harnessing the Huai River."

cues.zh: 关于治理淮河的决定
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 zhi4 li3 huai2 he2 de5 jue2 ding4
cues.en: "Decision on Harnessing the Huai River."

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天我们继续来聊相对论的话题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 ji4 xu4 lai2 liao2 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 hua4 ti2
cues.en: Today we continue talking about relativity.

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦提出狭义相对论之后
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ti2 chu1 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After Einstein proposed special relativity,

cues.zh: 许多科学家都对这种惊世骇俗的世界
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ke1 xue2 jia1 dou1 dui4 zhe4 zhong3 jing1 shi4 hai4 su2 de5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: many scientists had doubts about this shocking

cues.zh: 观产生过质疑
cues.pinyin: guan1 chan3 sheng1 guo4 zhi4 yi2
cues.en: worldview.

cues.zh: 比如说马赫庞加莱洛伦兹等人
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ma3 he4 pang2 jia1 lai2 luo4 lun2 zi1 deng3 ren2
cues.en: For example, Mach, Poincaré, Lorentz, and others —

cues.zh: 他们都是相对论的先驱
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 shi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 xian1 qu1
cues.en: they were all pioneers of relativity,

cues.zh: 但是最初都怀疑相对论的正确性
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zui4 chu1 dou1 huai2 yi2 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 zheng4 que4 xing4
cues.en: but at first they all doubted that relativity was correct.

cues.zh: 不过他们都没有发现狭义相对论真
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 men5 dou1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhen1
cues.en: However, none of them discovered the real

cues.zh: 正的问题所在
cues.pinyin: zheng4 de5 wen4 ti2 suo3 zai4
cues.en: problem with special relativity.

cues.zh: 这个问题是在十年之后的 19 15 年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 shi4 zai4 shi2 nian2 zhi1 hou4 de5 19 15 nian2
cues.en: This problem was found ten years later, in 1915,

cues.zh: 由爱因斯坦本人发现的
cues.pinyin: you2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ben3 ren2 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: by Einstein himself.

cues.zh: 那么狭义相对论究竟有什么问题呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 jiu1 jing4 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: So what exactly is the problem with special relativity?

cues.zh: 狭义相对论中有两条基本原理
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhong1 you3 liang3 tiao2 ji1 ben3 yuan2 li3
cues.en: Special relativity has two basic principles:

cues.zh: 相对性原理和光速不变原理
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 xing4 yuan2 li3 he2 guang1 su4 bu4 bian4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: the principle of relativity and the principle of constant light speed.

cues.zh: 如果非要找一条更基本的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 fei1 yao4 zhao3 yi1 tiao2 geng4 ji1 ben3 de5
cues.en: If we had to pick the more fundamental one,

cues.zh: 我想应该是相对性原理
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 ying1 gai1 shi4 xiang1 dui4 xing4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: I think it would be the principle of relativity:

cues.zh: 在所有惯性参考系中
cues.pinyin: zai4 suo3 you3 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 zhong1
cues.en: in all inertial reference frames,

cues.zh: 物理规律都是相同的
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 dou1 shi4 xiang1 tong2 de5
cues.en: the laws of physics are the same.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（五）惯性参考系真的存在吗？什么是等效原理？

cues.zh: 那么什么是惯性参考系呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shen2 me5 shi4 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 ne5
cues.en: So what is an inertial reference frame?

cues.zh: 我们通常说呀
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong1 chang2 shuo1 ya5
cues.en: We usually say

cues.zh: 惯性参考系就是静止
cues.pinyin: guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 jiu4 shi4 jing4 zhi3
cues.en: an inertial frame is one at rest,

cues.zh: 或者匀速直线运动的参考系
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 yun2 su4 zhi2 xian4 yun4 dong4 de5 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: or one moving at constant velocity in a straight line.

cues.zh: 比如说匀速运动的火车
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 yun2 su4 yun4 dong4 de5 huo3 che1
cues.en: For example, a train moving at constant velocity

cues.zh: 就是一个惯性系
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: is an inertial frame.

cues.zh: 在火车上做任何物理实验都和地
cues.pinyin: zai4 huo3 che1 shang4 zuo4 ren4 he2 wu4 li3 shi2 yan4 dou1 he2 di4
cues.en: Doing any physics experiment on the train is no different from

cues.zh: 面上没有区别
cues.pinyin: mian4 shang4 mei2 you3 qu1 bie2
cues.en: doing it on the ground.

cues.zh: 但是加速运动的火车就不是惯性系了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jia1 su4 yun4 dong4 de5 huo3 che1 jiu4 bu2 shi4 guan4 xing4 xi4 le5
cues.en: But an accelerating train is not an inertial frame.

cues.zh: 如果火车加速
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 huo3 che1 jia1 su4
cues.en: If the train accelerates,

cues.zh: 在车厢里看地板上有一个小球
cues.pinyin: zai4 che1 xiang1 li3 kan4 di4 ban3 shang4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 qiu2
cues.en: suppose there's a ball on the floor of the carriage —

cues.zh: 虽然没有受到水平方向的力
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 mei2 you3 shou4 dao4 shui3 ping2 fang1 xiang4 de5 li4
cues.en: even though it's not subject to any horizontal force,

cues.zh: 但是也会向后滚动
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 hui4 xiang4 hou4 gun3 dong4
cues.en: it will still roll backward.

cues.zh: 但是这种说法存在严重的理论缺陷
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 shuo1 fa3 cun2 zai4 yan2 zhong4 de5 li3 lun4 que1 xian4
cues.en: But this explanation has a serious theoretical flaw:

cues.zh: 静止和运动都是相对的
cues.pinyin: jing4 zhi3 he2 yun4 dong4 dou1 shi4 xiang1 dui4 de5
cues.en: rest and motion are both relative.

cues.zh: 只有相对于惯性参考系静止或匀速直接
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 xiang1 dui4 yu2 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 jing4 zhi3 huo4 yun2 su4 zhi2 jie1
cues.en: Only a frame that is at rest or moving at constant velocity in a straight line

cues.zh: 运动的参考系
cues.pinyin: yun4 dong4 de5 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: relative to an inertial frame

cues.zh: 才是惯性参考系
cues.pinyin: cai2 shi4 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: is itself an inertial frame.

cues.zh: 就比如说你要判断火车是不是惯性系
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 yao4 pan4 duan4 huo3 che1 shi4 bu2 shi4 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: For example, to judge whether a train is an inertial frame,

cues.zh: 不光要看火车有没有在地面上静止或匀速
cues.pinyin: bu4 guang1 yao4 kan4 huo3 che1 you3 mei2 you3 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 jing4 zhi3 huo4 yun2 su4
cues.en: it's not enough to look at whether it's at rest or moving at constant velocity relative to the ground —

cues.en: then that frame would be an inertial frame.

cues.en: not subject to any force at all?

cues.zh: 宏观的作用力主要有电磁力还有万有引力
cues.pinyin: hong2 guan1 de5 zuo4 yong4 li4 zhu3 yao4 you3 dian4 ci2 li4 hai2 you3 wan4 you3 yin3 li4
cues.en: The main macroscopic forces are electromagnetic force and gravity.

cues.zh: 那么电磁力是可以用导体壳来屏蔽的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dian4 ci2 li4 shi4 ke3 yi3 yong4 dao3 ti3 ke2 lai2 ping2 bi4 de5
cues.en: Electromagnetic force can be shielded with a conductive shell,

cues.zh: 不过万有引力不能屏蔽
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 bu4 neng2 ping2 bi4
cues.en: but gravity cannot be shielded.

cues.zh: 比如说飞船里有一个石头
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 fei1 chuan2 li3 you3 yi2 ge4 shi2 tou5
cues.en: For example, suppose there's a rock inside a spaceship

cues.zh: 它相对于飞船正在做匀速直线运动
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang1 dui4 yu2 fei1 chuan2 zheng4 zai4 zuo4 yun2 su4 zhi2 xian4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: moving at constant velocity relative to the spaceship —

cues.zh: 你也不能说飞船就是惯性系
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 bu4 neng2 shuo1 fei1 chuan2 jiu4 shi4 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: you still can't say the spaceship is an inertial frame,

cues.zh: 因为你不知道这块石头
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 kuai4 shi2 tou5
cues.en: because you don't know whether this rock

cues.zh: 是不是受到了飞船或者来自其
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 shou4 dao4 le5 fei1 chuan2 huo4 zhe3 lai2 zi4 qi2
cues.en: is being acted on by the spaceship, or by gravity from

cues.zh: 他星球的引力
cues.pinyin: ta1 xing1 qiu2 de5 yin3 li4
cues.en: other planets.

cues.zh: 如果我们打开中学课本
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 da3 kai1 zhong1 xue2 ke4 ben3
cues.en: If we open a middle school textbook,

cues.zh: 你可能会看到这样的文字
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 hui4 kan4 dao4 zhe4 yang4 de5 wen2 zi4
cues.en: you might see text like this:

cues.zh: 地球接近于一个惯性系
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 jie1 jin4 yu2 yi2 ge4 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: Earth is approximately an inertial frame,

cues.zh: 太阳是比地球更好的惯性系
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 shi4 bi3 di4 qiu2 geng4 hao3 de5 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: the Sun is a better inertial frame than Earth,

cues.zh: 银河系中心又是比太阳更好的惯性系
cues.pinyin: yin2 he2 xi4 zhong1 xin1 you4 shi4 bi3 tai4 yang2 geng4 hao3 de5 guan4 xing4 xi4
cues.en: and the center of the Milky Way is a better inertial frame than the Sun.

cues.zh: 这种说法其实回避了究竟什么是惯性
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shuo1 fa3 qi2 shi2 hui2 bi4 le5 jiu1 jing4 shen2 me5 shi4 guan4 xing4
cues.en: This statement actually dodges the question of what inertia really is.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（五）惯性参考系真的存在吗？什么是等效原理？

cues.zh: 于是爱因斯坦就把狭义的相对性原理
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jiu4 ba3 xia2 yi4 de5 xiang1 dui4 xing4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: So Einstein took the special principle of relativity —

cues.zh: 所有惯性参考系下物理规律相同
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 xiang1 tong2
cues.en: physical laws are the same in all inertial frames —

cues.zh: 修改成广义的相对性原理
cues.pinyin: xiu1 gai3 cheng2 guang3 yi4 de5 xiang1 dui4 xing4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: and modified it into the general principle of relativity:

cues.zh: 所有参考系下物理规律相同了
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 xiang1 tong2 le5
cues.en: physical laws are the same in all reference frames.

cues.zh: 你可能会感觉到奇怪
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 hui4 gan3 jue2 dao4 qi2 guai4
cues.en: You might find this strange.

cues.zh: 那元素运动的火车上
cues.pinyin: na4 yuan2 su4 yun4 dong4 de5 huo3 che1 shang4
cues.en: On a train moving at constant velocity,

cues.zh: 那匀速运动的火车上
cues.pinyin: na4 yun2 su4 yun4 dong4 de5 huo3 che1 shang4
cues.en: a ball falls straight down,

cues.zh: 而加速运动的火车上
cues.pinyin: er2 jia1 su4 yun4 dong4 de5 huo3 che1 shang4
cues.en: while on an accelerating train,

cues.zh: 一个小球松手之后会斜着往下落
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xiao3 qiu2 song1 shou3 zhi1 hou4 hui4 xie2 zhe5 wang3 xia4 luo4
cues.en: a released ball falls at a slant.

cues.zh: 这两个参考系
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: How could these two reference frames

cues.zh: 怎么会有相同的物理规律呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 you3 xiang1 tong2 de5 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 ne5
cues.en: have the same laws of physics?

cues.zh: 这就涉及到第二个问题了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 she4 ji2 dao4 di4 er4 ge4 wen4 ti2 le5
cues.en: This brings us to the second problem:

cues.zh: 引力和加速度的等效性
cues.pinyin: yin3 li4 he2 jia1 su4 du4 de5 deng3 xiao4 xing4
cues.en: the equivalence of gravity and acceleration.

cues.zh: 传说呀
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shuo1 ya5
cues.en: Legend has it

cues.zh: 伽利略在比萨斜塔上
cues.pinyin: jia1 li4 lve4 zai4 bi3 sa4 xie2 ta3 shang4
cues.en: that Galileo, on the Leaning Tower of Pisa,

cues.zh: 扔下了两个铁球
cues.pinyin: reng1 xia4 le5 liang3 ge4 tie3 qiu2
cues.en: dropped two iron balls,

cues.zh: 结果发现
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4
cues.en: and found that

cues.zh: 无论铁球质量大小如何呢
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 tie3 qiu2 zhi4 liang4 da4 xiao3 ru2 he2 ne5
cues.en: no matter the balls' mass,

cues.zh: 它们都是同时落地的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 shi4 tong2 shi2 luo4 di4 de5
cues.en: they landed at the same time.

cues.zh: 虽然这个实验不一定真实的发生过
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 bu4 yi2 ding4 zhen1 shi2 de5 fa1 sheng1 guo4
cues.en: Although this experiment may not have actually happened,

cues.zh: 但是人们对这个现象的重复
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ren2 men5 dui4 zhe4 ge5 xian4 xiang4 de5 chong2 fu4
cues.en: people's testing of this phenomenon

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（五）惯性参考系真的存在吗？什么是等效原理？

cues.zh: 从来就没有停止过
cues.pinyin: cong2 lai2 jiu4 mei2 you3 ting2 zhi3 guo4
cues.en: has never stopped.

cues.zh: 在上中学的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 zhong1 xue2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back in middle school,

cues.zh: 老师会把一个管子中间抽成真空
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 hui4 ba3 yi2 ge4 guan3 zi5 zhong1 jian1 chou1 cheng2 zhen1 kong1
cues.en: teachers would pump the middle of a tube into a vacuum

cues.zh: 让羽毛和硬币同时下落
cues.pinyin: rang4 yu3 mao2 he2 ying4 bi4 tong2 shi2 xia4 luo4
cues.en: and drop a feather and a coin at the same time —

cues.zh: 你会发现它们同时落到管子的另外一端
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 ta1 men5 tong2 shi2 luo4 dao4 guan3 zi5 de5 ling4 wai4 yi1 duan1
cues.en: you'd find they reach the other end of the tube at the same time.

cues.zh: 这叫做毛钱管实验
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 zuo4 mao2 qian2 guan3 shi2 yan4
cues.en: This is called Newton's tube experiment.

cues.pinyin: zai4 19 71 nian2

cues.zh: 阿波罗 15 号的宇航员大卫斯科特
cues.pinyin: a1 bo1 luo2 15 hao4 de5 yu3 hang2 yuan2 da4 wei4 si1 ke1 te4
cues.en: Apollo 15 astronaut David Scott

cues.zh: 在没有空气的月球表面上
cues.pinyin: zai4 mei2 you3 kong4 qi4 de5 yue4 qiu2 biao3 mian4 shang4
cues.en: on the airless surface of the Moon

cues.zh: 同时扔下了一把锤子和一根羽毛
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 reng1 xia4 le5 yi1 ba3 chui2 zi5 he2 yi1 gen1 yu3 mao2
cues.en: dropped a hammer and a feather at the same time,

cues.zh: 在地球上亿万电视观众的面前
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 yi4 wan4 dian4 shi4 guan1 zhong4 de5 mian4 qian2
cues.en: in front of hundreds of millions of TV viewers on Earth.

cues.zh: 锤子和羽毛同时落在月球表面上
cues.pinyin: chui2 zi5 he2 yu3 mao2 tong2 shi2 luo4 zai4 yue4 qiu2 biao3 mian4 shang4
cues.en: The hammer and feather landed on the Moon's surface at the same time.

cues.zh: 安因斯坦也在思考这个问题
cues.pinyin: an1 yin1 si1 tan3 ye3 zai4 si1 kao3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Einstein was also thinking about this problem.

cues.zh: 他说小球下落是因为受到地球的眼力
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 xiao3 qiu2 xia4 luo4 shi4 yin1 wei4 shou4 dao4 di4 qiu2 de5 yan3 li4
cues.en: He said a ball falls because it's acted on by Earth's gravity,

cues.zh: 而眼力的产生是因为地球周围有眼力场
cues.pinyin: er2 yan3 li4 de5 chan3 sheng1 shi4 yin1 wei4 di4 qiu2 zhou1 wei2 you3 yan3 li4 chang3
cues.en: and gravity arises because there's a gravitational field around Earth.

cues.zh: 小球又具有质量
cues.pinyin: xiao3 qiu2 you4 ju4 you3 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: The ball also has mass,

cues.zh: 小球受到的眼力正比于小球的质量
cues.pinyin: xiao3 qiu2 shou4 dao4 de5 yan3 li4 zheng4 bi3 yu2 xiao3 qiu2 de5 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: and the gravitational force on the ball is proportional to its mass.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（五）惯性参考系真的存在吗？什么是等效原理？

cues.zh: 的比是相同的
cues.pinyin: de5 bi3 shi4 xiang1 tong2 de5
cues.en: the ratio is the same.

cues.zh: 如果物体的引力质量和惯性质量
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wu4 ti3 de5 yin3 li4 zhi4 liang4 he2 guan4 xing4 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: If an object's gravitational mass and inertial mass

cues.zh: 的比是相同的
cues.pinyin: de5 bi3 shi4 xiang1 tong2 de5
cues.en: have the same ratio,

cues.zh: 那么通过调整单位
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 tong1 guo4 tiao2 zheng3 dan1 wei4
cues.en: then by adjusting the units,

cues.zh: 我们就可以认为引力质量完全
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ren4 wei2 yin3 li4 zhi4 liang4 wan2 quan2
cues.en: we can consider the gravitational mass as completely

cues.zh: 等于惯性质量
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 guan4 xing4 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: equal to the inertial mass.

cues.zh: 物体的质量可以引起引力
cues.pinyin: wu4 ti3 de5 zhi4 liang4 ke3 yi3 yin3 qi3 yin3 li4
cues.en: An object's mass can give rise to gravity

cues.zh: 又可以产生惯性
cues.pinyin: you4 ke3 yi3 chan3 sheng1 guan4 xing4
cues.en: and can also produce inertia —

cues.zh: 这两个性质并不一样
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 xing4 zhi4 bing4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: these two properties aren't actually the same,

cues.zh: 所以这两个质量也没有理由一定相等
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 zhi4 liang4 ye3 mei2 you3 li3 you2 yi2 ding4 xiang1 deng3
cues.en: so there's no reason these two masses must be equal.

cues.zh: 然而根据实验的结果呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 gen1 ju4 shi2 yan4 de5 jie2 guo3 ne5
cues.en: However, according to experimental results,

cues.zh: 它们又好像确实是相等的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 you4 hao3 xiang4 que4 shi2 shi4 xiang1 deng3 de5
cues.en: they do seem to actually be equal.

cues.zh: 后面我们会看到啊
cues.pinyin: hou4 mian4 wo3 men5 hui4 kan4 dao4 a5
cues.en: Later on we'll see

cues.zh: 引力质量与惯性质量相等
cues.pinyin: yin3 li4 zhi4 liang4 yu3 guan4 xing4 zhi4 liang4 xiang1 deng3
cues.en: that gravitational mass equaling inertial mass

cues.zh: 其实是广义相对性原理的一个结论
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 xing4 yuan2 li3 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 lun4
cues.en: is actually a consequence of the general principle of relativity.

cues.zh: 有一天安耶斯坦坐在办公室里
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 an1 ye2 si1 tan3 zuo4 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 li3
cues.en: One day Einstein was sitting in his office,

cues.zh: 又在思索引力的问题
cues.pinyin: you4 zai4 si1 suo3 yin3 li4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: pondering the problem of gravity again.

cues.zh: 他看看窗外
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 kan4 chuang1 wai4
cues.en: He looked out the window

cues.zh: 猛然想到了一件非常可怕的事
cues.pinyin: meng3 ran2 xiang3 dao4 le5 yi1 jian4 fei1 chang2 ke3 pa4 de5 shi4
cues.en: and suddenly thought of something terrifying:

cues.zh: 如果一个人不慎从楼上跌落
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi2 ge4 ren2 bu4 shen4 cong2 lou2 shang4 die1 luo4
cues.en: if a person accidentally fell off a building,

cues.zh: 他会有什么感觉呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 you3 shen2 me5 gan3 jue2 ne5
cues.en: what would he feel?

cues.zh: 显然相对于地面
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 mian4
cues.en: Clearly, relative to the ground,

cues.zh: 人正在自由落体
cues.pinyin: ren2 zheng4 zai4 zi4 you2 luo4 ti3
cues.en: the person is in free fall.

cues.zh: 有位大老板一天闲来无事
cues.pinyin: you3 wei4 da4 lao3 ban3 yi1 tian1 xian2 lai2 wu2 shi4
cues.en: One day, a big boss had nothing to do,

cues.zh: 就去巡视工厂正好遇到一位工友
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu4 xun2 shi4 gong1 chang3 zheng4 hao3 yu4 dao4 yi1 wei4 gong1 you3
cues.en: so he went to inspect the factory and happened to meet a worker

cues.zh: 在拖地大老板
cues.pinyin: zai4 tuo1 di4 da4 lao3 ban3
cues.en: who was mopping the floor. The big boss

cues.zh: 轻拍工友的肩膀说好好干
cues.pinyin: qing1 pai1 gong1 you3 de5 jian1 bang3 shuo1 hao3 hao3 gan4
cues.en: patted the worker's shoulder and said, "Work hard,

cues.zh: 当初我也是工友出身的
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 wo3 ye3 shi4 gong1 you3 chu1 shen1 de5
cues.en: I also started out as a worker."

cues.zh: 工友抬头看了这位大老板说
cues.pinyin: gong1 you3 tai2 tou2 kan4 le5 zhe4 wei4 da4 lao3 ban3 shuo1
cues.en: The worker looked up at the boss and said,

cues.zh: 你也要好好干
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 yao4 hao3 hao3 gan4
cues.en: "You should work hard too —

cues.zh: 当初我也是老板出身的
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 wo3 ye3 shi4 lao3 ban3 chu1 shen1 de5
cues.en: I also started out as a boss."

items.title_zh: 笑话89｜夭寿算命师｜孟婆喝汤｜突袭细菌｜不和愚蠢的人吵架｜活泼的妇人｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 老公你长得那么帅又有钱
cues.pinyin: lao3 gong1 ni3 zhang3 de2 na4 me5 shuai4 you4 you3 qian2
cues.en: "Honey, you're so handsome and rich,

cues.zh: 当初为什么会娶我啊
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 qu3 wo3 a5
cues.en: why did you marry me back then?"

cues.zh: 因为你很可爱啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 hen3 ke3 ai4 a5
cues.en: "Because you're so cute.

cues.zh: 想当年要不是有个算命师跟我说
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dang1 nian2 yao4 bu2 shi4 you3 ge4 suan4 ming4 shi1 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Actually, if a fortune teller hadn't told me

cues.zh: 若不娶你活不过明年
cues.pinyin: ruo4 bu4 qu3 ni3 huo2 bu4 guo4 ming2 nian2
cues.en: that I wouldn't live past next year unless I married you,

cues.zh: 我怎么可能会娶你
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 ke3 neng2 hui4 qu3 ni3
cues.en: there's no way I would have married you.

cues.zh: 我绝对不会跟你说
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 dui4 bu2 hui4 gen1 ni3 shuo1
cues.en: I'll never tell you

cues.zh: 当年的算命师是我偷偷付钱
cues.pinyin: dang1 nian2 de5 suan4 ming4 shi1 shi4 wo3 tou1 tou1 fu4 qian2
cues.en: that I secretly paid that fortune teller back then

cues.zh: 叫他那样说的
cues.pinyin: jiao4 ta1 na4 yang4 shuo1 de5
cues.en: to say that."

cues.zh: 有一天孟婆在煮孟婆汤
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 meng4 po2 zai4 zhu3 meng4 po2 tang1
cues.en: One day Meng Po was brewing her soup of forgetfulness

cues.zh: 想尝尝看会不会太咸
cues.pinyin: xiang3 chang2 chang2 kan4 hui4 bu2 hui4 tai4 xian2
cues.en: and wanted to taste it to see if it was too salty.

cues.zh: 喝了一口后满意的笑了
cues.pinyin: he1 le5 yi1 kou3 hou4 man3 yi4 de5 xiao4 le5
cues.en: After a sip, she smiled with satisfaction.

cues.zh: 嗯不会太咸

items.title_zh: 笑话89｜夭寿算命师｜孟婆喝汤｜突袭细菌｜不和愚蠢的人吵架｜活泼的妇人｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我叫你中午才吃药
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiao4 ni3 zhong1 wu3 cai2 chi1 yao4
cues.en: "I told you to take the medicine at noon,

cues.zh: 你怎么早上就吃了呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 zao3 shang4 jiu4 chi1 le5 ne5
cues.en: so why did you take it in the morning?"

cues.zh: 因为我想突袭那些细菌
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 xiang3 tu1 xi2 na4 xie1 xi4 jun1
cues.en: "Because I wanted to ambush the germs

cues.zh: 把他们杀个措手不及啊
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 sha1 ge4 cuo4 shou3 bu4 ji2 a5
cues.en: and catch them off guard."

cues.zh: 卖西瓜的老板大声的叫卖
cues.pinyin: mai4 xi1 gua1 de5 lao3 ban3 da4 sheng1 de5 jiao4 mai4
cues.en: A watermelon seller shouted loudly to hawk his melons,

cues.zh: 哎哟来买西瓜不甜不要钱
cues.pinyin: ai1 yo1 lai2 mai3 xi1 gua1 bu4 tian2 bu2 yao4 qian2
cues.en: "Come buy watermelon — if it's not sweet, it's free!"

cues.zh: 入国的客人问
cues.pinyin: ru4 guo2 de5 ke4 ren2 wen4
cues.en: A passing customer asked,

cues.zh: 不甜真的不要钱吗
cues.pinyin: bu4 tian2 zhen1 de5 bu2 yao4 qian2 ma5
cues.en: "If it's not sweet, is it really free?"

cues.zh: 老板当场就用刀把西瓜一分为二
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 dang1 chang3 jiu4 yong4 dao1 ba4 xi1 gua1 yi1 fen1 wei2 er4
cues.en: The seller immediately cut the watermelon in half with a knife

cues.zh: 再从其中切一小块下来
cues.pinyin: zai4 cong2 qi2 zhong1 qie4 yi1 xiao3 kuai4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: and sliced off a small piece from it.

cues.zh: 客人试吃果然很甜
cues.pinyin: ke4 ren2 shi4 chi1 guo3 ran2 hen3 tian2
cues.en: The customer tasted it and it was indeed sweet,

cues.zh: 就把西瓜买回去了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 xi1 gua1 mai3 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: so he bought the watermelon and took it home.

cues.zh: 一整天下来
cues.pinyin: yi1 zheng3 tian1 xia4 lai2
cues.en: By the end of the day,

cues.zh: 老板靠试吃就卖完了全部的西瓜
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 kao4 shi4 chi1 jiu4 mai4 wan2 le5 quan2 bu4 de5 xi1 gua1
cues.en: the seller had sold all his watermelons just by giving out samples.

cues.zh: 可是客人回到家吃时
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ke4 ren2 hui2 dao4 jia1 chi1 shi2
cues.en: But when the customers got home and ate it,

cues.zh: 却发现西瓜似乎没有现场试吃那么甜
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 xi1 gua1 si4 hu1 mei2 you3 xian4 chang3 shi4 chi1 na4 me5 tian2
cues.en: they found the watermelon didn't seem as sweet as the sample tasted.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 珊珊我们来玩一个游戏好不好

cues.pinyin: ta1 shu1 wo3 hao3 ji3 bai3 kuai4 le5
cues.en: He's lost several hundred dollars to me.

cues.pinyin: lai2 wo3 gei3 ni3 jiang3 shen2 me5

cues.en: So over here, I'll twist it into a spiral shape in a moment.

cues.zh: 那你只要猜到这一个呢同心圆的圆点呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi3 yao4 cai1 dao4 zhe4 yi2 ge4 ne5 tong2 xin1 yuan2 de5 yuan2 dian3 ne5
cues.en: As long as you can guess which dot here is the center of the concentric circles.

cues.zh: 我就给你 10 块
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 10 kuai4
cues.en: I'll give you $10.

cues.zh: 啊输了你给我 10 块
cues.pinyin: a5 shu1 le5 ni3 gei3 wo3 10 kuai4
cues.en: Oh, if you lose, you give me $10.

cues.zh: 要玩
cues.pinyin: yao4 wan2
cues.en: Want to play.

cues.zh: 你玩过了你输我了
cues.pinyin: ni3 wan2 guo4 le5 ni3 shu1 wo3 le5
cues.en: You've already played, you lost to me.

cues.zh: 来你看喔我要开始绕了喔你看清楚喔
cues.pinyin: lai2 ni3 kan4 o1 wo3 yao4 kai1 shi3 rao4 le5 o1 ni3 kan4 qing1 chu3 o1
cues.en: Here, watch, I'm about to start winding it, look carefully.

cues.zh: 同心圆喔
cues.pinyin: tong2 xin1 yuan2 o1
cues.en: Concentric circles.

cues.zh: 如果你猜中了我就给你 10 块喔
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 cai1 zhong1 le5 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 10 kuai4 o1
cues.en: If you guess it right, I'll give you $10.

cues.zh: 同心圆的那个圆点喔
cues.pinyin: tong2 xin1 yuan2 de5 na4 ge5 yuan2 dian3 o1
cues.en: That dot of the concentric circles.

cues.zh: 好哪里
cues.pinyin: hao3 na3 li3
cues.en: Okay, where.

cues.zh: 这一个我也要这个
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi2 ge4 wo3 ye3 yao4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: I want this one too.

cues.zh: 嘿嘿嘿
cues.pinyin: hei1 hei1 hei1
cues.en: Hehehe.

cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 yu4 ce4 ta1 de5 zong3 piao4 fang2 hui4 chao1 guo4 1 yi4 yuan2
cues.en: Some predict its total box office will exceed 100 million yuan.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就很奇怪了
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 hen3 qi2 guai4 le5
cues.en: Some kids find this really strange.

cues.zh: 说这么一部奇葩抽象的电影
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 me5 yi1 bu4 qi2 pa1 chou1 xiang4 de5 dian4 ying3
cues.en: They say, such a bizarre, abstract movie,

cues.zh: 就像幼儿园小朋友画的一般
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 you4 er2 yuan2 xiao3 peng2 you3 hua4 de5 yi4 ban1
cues.en: drawn like something a kindergartner scribbled,

cues.zh: 他为什么会有这么多观众追捧呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 guan1 zhong4 zhui1 peng3 ne5
cues.en: why does it have so many fans chasing after it?

cues.zh: 其实之前还有一个热点事件
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhi1 qian2 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 re4 dian3 shi4 jian4
cues.en: Actually, there was another hot topic event before this.

cues.zh: 全网都在疯传一个小玩具逐知了
cues.pinyin: quan2 wang3 dou1 zai4 feng1 chuan2 yi2 ge4 xiao3 wan2 ju4 zhu2 zhi1 liao3
cues.en: The whole internet was going crazy over a little toy called "Zhu Zhi Liao."

cues.zh: 这两件事啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 jian4 shi4 a5
cues.en: These two things,

cues.zh: 它是如何产生现象级传播效果的呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ru2 he2 chan3 sheng1 xian4 xiang4 ji2 chuan2 bo1 xiao4 guo3 de5 ne5
cues.en: how did they produce such a viral, phenomenon-level spread?

cues.zh: 今天我就想从心理学和营销学的角度
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 cong2 xin1 li3 xue2 he2 ying2 xiao1 xue2 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: Today I want to explain this from the perspective of psychology and marketing.

cues.zh: 来解释一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: lai2 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Let me explain this issue.

cues.zh: 带着大家来了解一下
cues.pinyin: dai4 zhe5 da4 jia1 lai2 liao3 jie3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's take everyone through

cues.zh: 禁果效应和抗拒心理
cues.pinyin: jin4 guo3 xiao4 ying4 he2 kang4 ju4 xin1 li3
cues.en: the forbidden fruit effect and psychological reactance.

cues.zh: 首先呢
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ne5
cues.en: First of all,

cues.zh: 我们先来说一说
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1
cues.en: let's start by talking about

cues.zh: 什么是禁果效应
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 jin4 guo3 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: what the forbidden fruit effect is.

cues.zh: 大家知道什么是禁果吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 shen2 me5 shi4 jin4 guo3 ma5
cues.en: Does everyone know what the forbidden fruit is?

cues.zh: 偷吃过禁果吗
cues.pinyin: tou1 chi1 guo4 jin4 guo3 ma5
cues.en: Have you ever "tasted the forbidden fruit"?

cues.zh: 什么叫禁果呀
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 jin4 guo3 ya5
cues.en: What exactly is the forbidden fruit?

cues.zh: 禁果效应指的是啊
cues.pinyin: jin4 guo3 xiao4 ying4 zhi3 de5 shi4 a5
cues.en: The forbidden fruit effect refers to this:

cues.zh: 如果一件事我们越是禁止
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 jian4 shi4 wo3 men5 yue4 shi4 jin4 zhi3
cues.en: the more we forbid something,

cues.zh: 越是禁止
cues.pinyin: yue4 shi4 jin4 zhi3
cues.en: the more we forbid it,

cues.zh: 那么人们呢就越好奇
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 men5 ne5 jiu4 yue4 hao4 qi2
cues.en: the more curious people become,

cues.zh: 就越感觉到非常的奇怪
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yue4 gan3 jue2 dao4 fei1 chang2 de5 qi2 guai4
cues.en: the stranger and more fascinating it feels,

cues.zh: 然后这件事就变得越有吸引力
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 jiu4 bian4 de2 yue4 you3 xi1 yin3 li4
cues.en: and the more attractive that thing becomes.

cues.zh: 那么心理学家呢就发明了一个词
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 ne5 jiu4 fa1 ming2 le5 yi2 ge4 ci2
cues.en: So psychologists coined a term for this,

cues.zh: 叫做禁果效应
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 jin4 guo3 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: called the "forbidden fruit effect."

cues.zh: 禁果这两个字啊
cues.pinyin: jin4 guo3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 zi4 a5
cues.en: As for the words "forbidden fruit,"

cues.zh: 它其实是起源于圣经
cues.pinyin: ta1 qi2 shi2 shi4 qi3 yuan2 yu2 sheng4 jing1
cues.en: they actually originate from the Bible.

cues.zh: 话说宙斯不是生气吗
cues.pinyin: hua4 shuo1 zhou4 si1 bu2 shi4 sheng1 qi4 ma5
cues.en: Speaking of which, wasn't Zeus angry?

cues.zh: 为什么还这么干
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 zhe4 me5 gan4
cues.en: Why did he still do it?

cues.zh: 因为宙斯给了潘多拉一个盒子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhou4 si1 gei3 le5 pan1 duo1 la1 yi2 ge4 he2 zi5
cues.en: Because Zeus gave Pandora a box

cues.zh: 并且告诫潘多拉绝对不可以打开
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 gao4 jie4 pan1 duo1 la1 jue2 dui4 bu4 ke3 yi3 da3 kai1
cues.en: and warned Pandora never to open it under any circumstances.

cues.zh: 这个潘多拉内心就充满了好奇
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 pan1 duo1 la1 nei4 xin1 jiu4 chong1 man3 le5 hao4 qi2
cues.en: Pandora became filled with curiosity.

cues.zh: 这个时时刻刻就想说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 shi2 ke4 ke4 jiu4 xiang3 shuo1
cues.en: She kept thinking about it all the time,

cues.zh: 这盒子里到底装的啥呀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 he2 zi5 li3 dao4 di3 zhuang1 de5 sha2 ya5
cues.en: wondering what exactly was inside that box.

cues.zh: 终于有一天他忍不住了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 ren3 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Finally one day she couldn't resist any longer,

cues.zh: 悄悄打开了盒子
cues.pinyin: qiao1 qiao1 da3 kai1 le5 he2 zi5
cues.en: and secretly opened the box.

cues.zh: 那盒子里装的什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 he2 zi5 li3 zhuang1 de5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what was inside the box?

cues.zh: 盒子里所有的灾祸就都飞出来了
cues.pinyin: he2 zi5 li3 suo3 you3 de5 zai1 huo4 jiu4 dou1 fei1 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: All the disasters inside the box flew out.

cues.zh: 比如说疾病
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ji2 bing4
cues.en: For example, disease,

cues.zh: 这个痛苦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tong4 ku3
cues.en: suffering,

cues.zh: 仇恨
cues.pinyin: chou2 hen4
cues.en: hatred,

cues.zh: 嫉妒
cues.pinyin: ji2 du4
cues.en: jealousy,

cues.zh: 战争
cues.pinyin: zhan4 zheng1
cues.en: war,

cues.zh: 这个饥荒
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ji1 huang1
cues.en: famine,

cues.zh: 还有衰老
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 shuai1 lao3
cues.en: and aging,

cues.zh: 还有罪恶
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zui4 e4
cues.en: and sin —

cues.zh: 这些东西就都飞到了人间
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi1 jiu4 dou1 fei1 dao4 le5 ren2 jian1
cues.en: all these things flew out into the human world.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 那潘多拉被吓坏了
cues.pinyin: na4 pan1 duo1 la1 bei4 xia4 huai4 le5
cues.en: Pandora was terrified,

cues.zh: 赶紧就把这个盒子给关上了
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 he2 zi5 gei3 guan1 shang4 le5
cues.en: and quickly shut the box.

cues.zh: 就还有一样东西没有飞出来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hai2 you3 yi1 yang4 dong1 xi1 mei2 you3 fei1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: But there was still one thing that hadn't flown out.

cues.zh: 大家知道是啥吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 shi4 sha2 ma5
cues.en: Does everyone know what it was?

cues.zh: 叫希望
cues.pinyin: jiao4 xi1 wang4
cues.en: It was called hope.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 这个也告诉大家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ye3 gao4 su4 da4 jia1
cues.en: This also tells everyone,

cues.zh: 就越是不让你干的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yue4 shi4 bu4 rang4 ni3 gan4 de5
cues.en: the more you're forbidden to do something,

cues.zh: 他就偏想干
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 pian1 xiang3 gan4
cues.en: the more you specifically want to do it.

cues.zh: 叫潘多拉效应
cues.pinyin: jiao4 pan1 duo1 la1 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: This is called the Pandora effect.

cues.zh: 还有一个名字啊
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ming2 zi4 a5
cues.en: It has another name too,

cues.zh: 叫罗密欧与朱丽叶效应
cues.pinyin: jiao4 luo2 mi4 ou1 yu3 zhu1 li4 ye4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: called the Romeo and Juliet effect.

cues.zh: 七年战争的时候呢
cues.pinyin: qi1 nian2 zhan4 zheng1 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: During the Seven Years' War,

cues.zh: 被普鲁士给俘虏了
cues.pinyin: bei4 pu3 lu3 shi4 gei3 fu2 lu3 le5
cues.en: he was captured by Prussia.

cues.zh: 然后在军营里边就靠吃土豆活了下来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 jun1 ying2 li3 bian1 jiu4 kao4 chi1 tu3 dou4 huo2 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Then he survived in the military camp by eating potatoes.

cues.zh: 回到法国之后
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 fa3 guo2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After returning to France,

cues.zh: 他就想哎呀
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 xiang3 ai1 ya1
cues.en: he thought, oh,

cues.zh: 这土豆这玩意好啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tu3 dou4 zhe4 wan2 yi4 hao3 a5
cues.en: this potato thing is great!

cues.zh: 是不是
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 他就推广种植土豆
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 tui1 guang3 zhong4 zhi2 tu3 dou4
cues.en: So he promoted the cultivation of potatoes.

cues.zh: 但是当时的法国农民非常排斥土豆
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dang1 shi2 de5 fa3 guo2 nong2 min2 fei1 chang2 pai2 chi4 tu3 dou4
cues.en: But French farmers at the time were very resistant to potatoes.

cues.zh: 说这个土豆是魔鬼的苹果
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 ge5 tu3 dou4 shi4 mo2 gui3 de5 ping2 guo3
cues.en: They said this potato was the devil's apple,

cues.zh: 吃了会得麻风病
cues.pinyin: chi1 le5 hui4 de2 ma2 feng1 bing4
cues.en: and eating it would cause leprosy.

cues.zh: 这个帕芒蒂埃就得到了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 pa4 mang2 di4 ai1 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5
cues.en: This man, Parmentier, then got

cues.zh: 法国国王路易十六的支持
cues.pinyin: fa3 guo2 guo2 wang2 lu4 yi4 shi2 liu4 de5 zhi1 chi2
cues.en: the support of French King Louis XVI.

cues.zh: 就是摸不着头脑那个人
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 mo1 bu4 zhao2 tou2 nao3 na4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: He was the one who was often baffled and clueless.

cues.zh: 他给法王提了一个主意
cues.pinyin: ta1 gei3 fa3 wang2 ti2 le5 yi2 ge4 zhu3 yi4
cues.en: Parmentier gave the French king an idea.

cues.zh: 他说咱们这么着
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zan2 men5 zhe4 me5 zhe5
cues.en: He said, let's do it this way:

cues.zh: 咱们在一块土地上种上土豆
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 zai4 yi1 kuai4 tu3 di4 shang4 zhong3 shang4 tu3 dou4
cues.en: we'll plant potatoes on a piece of land,

cues.zh: 然后咱们白天就派皇家卫队
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zan2 men5 bai2 tian1 jiu4 pai4 huang2 jia1 wei4 dui4
cues.en: and then during the day we'll send the royal guard

cues.zh: 去严密的看守这个土豆田
cues.pinyin: qu4 yan2 mi4 de5 kan1 shou3 zhe4 ge5 tu3 dou4 tian2
cues.en: to closely guard this potato field,

cues.zh: 就制造一个王室专属珍贵作物
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhi4 zao4 yi2 ge4 wang2 shi4 zhuan1 shu3 zhen1 gui4 zuo4 wu4
cues.en: creating the impression that this is

cues.zh: 这么一个印象
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 yin4 xiang4
cues.en: a precious crop exclusive to the royal family.

cues.zh: 到了晚上吧
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 wan3 shang4 ba5
cues.en: Then at night,

cues.zh: 咱们就偷偷把这个守卫给撤走
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 jiu4 tou1 tou1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shou3 wei4 gei3 che4 zou3
cues.en: we'll secretly withdraw the guards

cues.zh: 不加看惯
cues.pinyin: bu4 jia1 kan4 guan4
cues.en: and leave it unguarded.

cues.zh: 这周边农民一看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhou1 bian1 nong2 min2 yi1 kan4
cues.en: When the farmers nearby saw this,

cues.zh: 这什么玩意儿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shen2 me5 wan2 yi4 er2
cues.en: they thought, what is this thing?

cues.zh: 白天有这么多人守着
cues.pinyin: bai2 tian1 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 shou3 zhe5
cues.en: So many people guarding it during the day —

cues.zh: 这肯定是贵重的宝物

cues.zh: 所以在晚上的时候

cues.zh: 带回家自己种
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui2 jia1 zi4 ji3 zhong3
