cues.zh: 慢慢的这个土豆就开始推广开了
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 zhe4 ge5 tu3 dou4 jiu4 kai1 shi3 tui1 guang3 kai1 le5
cues.en: Gradually, potatoes began to spread.

cues.zh: 这农民种植土豆之后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 nong2 min2 zhong4 zhi2 tu3 dou4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After these farmers planted potatoes,

cues.zh: 发现土豆这玩意儿好
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 tu3 dou4 zhe4 wan2 yi4 er2 hao3
cues.en: they discovered potatoes were great —

cues.zh: 又高产又好吃
cues.pinyin: you4 gao1 chan3 you4 hao3 chi1
cues.en: high-yield and delicious,

cues.zh: 还能抗饥荒
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 kang4 ji1 huang1
cues.en: and could even resist famine.

cues.zh: 所以土豆在法国大规模就普及开了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 tu3 dou4 zai4 fa3 guo2 da4 gui1 mo2 jiu4 pu3 ji2 kai1 le5
cues.en: So potatoes became widely popularized in France.

cues.zh: 所以越是被限制
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yue4 shi4 bei4 xian4 zhi4
cues.en: So the more something is restricted,

cues.zh: 被保护
cues.pinyin: bei4 bao3 hu4
cues.en: protected,

cues.zh: 被藏匿的东西
cues.pinyin: bei4 cang2 ni4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: or hidden away,

cues.zh: 越会激发人们的好奇心
cues.pinyin: yue4 hui4 ji1 fa1 ren2 men5 de5 hao4 qi2 xin1
cues.en: the more it stirs up people's curiosity

cues.zh: 还有占有欲
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zhan4 you3 yu4
cues.en: and desire to possess it.

cues.zh: 另外一个典型的案例
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 dian3 xing2 de5 an4 li4
cues.en: Another classic example

cues.zh: 就是什么呢
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: is what, you ask?

cues.zh: 就是禁书
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 jin4 shu1
cues.en: It's banned books.

cues.zh: 就是禁书
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 jin4 shu1
cues.en: It's banned books.

cues.zh: 这个你比如说我上学的时候吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ni3 bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 shang4 xue2 de5 shi2 hou4 ba5
cues.en: For instance, when I was in school,

cues.zh: 我上小学上中学
cues.pinyin: wo3 shang4 xiao3 xue2 shang4 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: in elementary and middle school,

cues.zh: 我们同学都偷看小说
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong2 xue2 dou1 tou1 kan4 xiao3 shuo1
cues.en: my classmates would secretly read novels,

cues.zh: 尤其是偷看金庸古龙的小说
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 tou1 kan4 jin1 yong1 gu3 long2 de5 xiao3 shuo1
cues.en: especially novels by Jin Yong and Gu Long.

cues.zh: 那个时候老师不让我们看小说
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 lao3 shi1 bu4 rang4 wo3 men5 kan4 xiao3 shuo1
cues.en: Back then, teachers wouldn't let us read novels,

cues.zh: 让我们看那些这个鲁迅什么的
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 men5 kan4 na4 xie1 zhe4 ge5 lu3 xun4 shen2 me5 de5
cues.en: and wanted us to read things like Lu Xun's works instead.

cues.zh: 我们偏不看
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 pian1 bu4 kan4
cues.en: But we deliberately refused to.

cues.zh: 这鲁迅的小说我们一概不看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 lu3 xun4 de5 xiao3 shuo1 wo3 men5 yi1 gai4 bu4 kan4
cues.en: We wouldn't read any of Lu Xun's novels at all.

cues.zh: 不仅仅在严厉的禁止中被保留下来
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 jin3 zai4 yan2 li4 de5 jin4 zhi3 zhong1 bei4 bao3 liu2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Not only were they preserved despite strict bans,

cues.zh: 反而被大家认同
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 bei4 da4 jia1 ren4 tong2
cues.en: they were instead embraced by everyone,

cues.zh: 成为了各个学科的经典
cues.pinyin: cheng2 wei2 le5 ge4 ge4 xue2 ke1 de5 jing1 dian3
cues.en: becoming classics in various academic fields.

cues.zh: 直到 19 66 年这一份禁书目录呢
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 19 66 nian2 zhe4 yi1 fen4 jin4 shu1 mu4 lu4 ne5
cues.en: It wasn't until 1966 that this list of banned books

cues.zh: 才被教皇保罗六世废止
cues.pinyin: cai2 bei4 jiao4 huang2 bao3 luo2 liu4 shi4 fei4 zhi3
cues.en: was finally abolished by Pope Paul VI.

cues.zh: 那么除了禁书啊
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 chu2 le5 jin4 shu1 a5
cues.en: So besides banned books,

cues.zh: 另外一个经典的禁果效应的案例
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 jing1 dian3 de5 jin4 guo3 xiao4 ying4 de5 an4 li4
cues.en: another classic example of the forbidden fruit effect

cues.zh: 就是禁酒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 jin4 jiu3
cues.en: is prohibition on alcohol.

cues.zh: 就是禁酒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 jin4 jiu3
cues.en: It's prohibition on alcohol.

cues.zh: 说这个喝酒不是很正常
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 ge5 he1 jiu3 bu2 shi4 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: Drinking alcohol is pretty normal, right?

cues.zh: 但我要告诉大家
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 yao4 gao4 su4 da4 jia1
cues.en: But let me tell you,

cues.zh: 世界两极美国和苏联都搞过禁酒
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 liang3 ji2 mei3 guo2 he2 su1 lian2 dou1 gao3 guo4 jin4 jiu3
cues.en: both superpowers — the US and the Soviet Union — tried prohibition,

cues.zh: 最后无一例外全失败了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wu2 yi1 li4 wai4 quan2 shi1 bai4 le5
cues.en: and in the end, both failed without exception.

cues.zh: 咱们说美国 19 20 到 19 33 年
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 shuo1 mei3 guo2 19 20 dao4 19 33 nian2
cues.en: In the US, from 1920 to 1933,

cues.zh: 美国第 18 宪法修正案
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 di4 18 xian4 fa3 xiu1 zheng4 an4
cues.en: the 18th Amendment to the US Constitution

cues.zh: 禁止在美国境内制造销售运输
cues.pinyin: jin4 zhi3 zai4 mei3 guo2 jing4 nei4 zhi4 zao4 xiao1 shou4 yun4 shu1
cues.en: banned the manufacture, sale, and transport within the US

cues.zh: 酒精类的饮料
cues.pinyin: jiu3 jing1 lei4 de5 yin3 liao4
cues.en: of alcoholic beverages.

cues.zh: 原因就是因为酿酒会消耗大量的粮食
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yin1 jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 niang4 jiu3 hui4 xiao1 hao4 da4 liang4 de5 liang2 shi2
cues.en: The reason was that brewing alcohol consumed large amounts of grain,

cues.zh: 而且酗酒还会造成暴力行为
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 xu4 jiu3 hai2 hui4 zao4 cheng2 bao4 li4 xing2 wei2
cues.en: and alcoholism could lead to violent behavior.

cues.zh: 那一部分学者认为可以通过法
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 bu4 fen4 xue2 zhe3 ren4 wei2 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 fa3
cues.en: Some scholars believed that laws could be used

cues.zh: 律来消除恶习
cues.pinyin: lv4 lai2 xiao1 chu2 e4 xi2
cues.en: to eliminate this bad habit.

cues.zh: 正在玩电脑六岁的子女过来要钱买冰淇
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 wan2 dian4 nao3 liu4 sui4 de5 zi3 nv3 guo4 lai2 yao4 qian2 mai3 bing1 qi2
cues.en: While he was playing on the computer, his six-year-old child came over asking for money to buy ice

cues.zh: 淋我不想给她
cues.pinyin: lin2 wo3 bu4 xiang3 gei3 ta1
cues.en: cream. I didn't want to give it to her.

cues.zh: 哥哥你不给钱我要用遥控器把
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 ni3 bu4 gei3 qian2 wo3 yao4 yong4 yao2 kong4 qi4 ba3
cues.en: "Bro, if you don't give me money, I'm going to use the remote control to"

cues.zh: 电脑给关了哦
cues.pinyin: dian4 nao3 gei3 guan1 le5 o2
cues.en: turn off the computer!

cues.zh: 你要是能用遥控器关电脑我就给你一百块
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 neng2 yong4 yao2 kong4 qi4 guan1 dian4 nao3 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 yi4 bai3 kuai4
cues.en: "If you can turn off the computer with the remote control, I'll give you 100 bucks."

cues.zh: 说完就看见她用遥控器戳电脑的开关
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wan2 jiu4 kan4 jian4 ta1 yong4 yao2 kong4 qi4 chuo1 dian4 nao3 de5 kai1 guan1
cues.en: As soon as I said that, I saw her poke the computer's power button with the remote control.

items.title_zh: 笑话101｜不给钱的后果｜赌性不改｜抓小偷｜霸气的男人｜实习护士｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有一个老婆婆上了冷气公车投了一块钱
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 lao3 po2 po5 shang4 le5 leng3 qi4 gong1 che1 tou2 le5 yi1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: An old lady got on an air-conditioned bus and put in one dollar.

cues.zh: 两块
cues.pinyin: liang3 kuai4
cues.en: "Two dollars."

cues.zh: 是的两块
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5 liang3 kuai4
cues.en: "Yes, two dollars."

cues.zh: 冷气车 2 块
cues.pinyin: leng3 qi4 che1 2 kuai4
cues.en: "The air-conditioned bus is two dollars."

cues.zh: 冷气车是 2 块
cues.pinyin: leng3 qi4 che1 shi4 2 kuai4
cues.en: "The air-conditioned bus is two dollars."

cues.zh: 对啊
cues.pinyin: dui4 a5
cues.en: "That's right."

cues.zh: 头 2 块
cues.pinyin: tou2 2 kuai4
cues.en: "The first two dollars."

cues.zh: 不是头 2 块
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 tou2 2 kuai4
cues.en: "It's not 'the first two dollars.'"

cues.zh: 说完就往后头走
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wan2 jiu4 wang3 hou4 tou5 zou3
cues.en: After saying that, she walked to the back of the bus.

cues.zh: 司机接著说
cues.pinyin: si1 ji1 jie1 zhu4 shuo1
cues.en: The driver then continued,

cues.zh: 我告诉你
cues.pinyin: wo3 gao4 su4 ni3
cues.en: "Let me tell you,"

cues.zh: 我觉得
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5
cues.en: "I think"

cues.zh: 投 2 块
cues.pinyin: tou2 2 kuai4
cues.en: "it should be 'insert two dollars.'"

cues.zh: 我问你喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Let me ask you,"

cues.zh: 我们为什么要走到床上睡觉
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 zou3 dao4 chuang2 shang4 shui4 jiao4
cues.en: "why do we have to walk to the bed to sleep?"

cues.zh: 不然走到
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 zou3 dao4
cues.en: "Instead of walking where?"

cues.zh: 当然要走到床上睡觉
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 yao4 zou3 dao4 chuang2 shang4 shui4 jiao4
cues.en: "Of course you have to walk to the bed to sleep."

cues.zh: 可以用跳的过去啊
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 yong4 tiao4 de5 guo4 qu4 a5
cues.en: "Can't you just jump over there?"

cues.zh: 跳的过去是什么
cues.pinyin: tiao4 de5 guo4 qu4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "What do you mean, jump over there?"

cues.zh: 不是因为床不会自己走过来
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 chuang2 bu2 hui4 zi4 ji3 zou3 guo4 lai2
cues.en: "Isn't it because the bed can't walk over to you by itself?"

items.title_zh: 笑话101｜不给钱的后果｜赌性不改｜抓小偷｜霸气的男人｜实习护士｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 农夫在果园抓到一个偷水果的小孩
cues.pinyin: nong2 fu1 zai4 guo3 yuan2 zhua1 dao4 yi2 ge4 tou1 shui3 guo3 de5 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: A farmer caught a kid stealing fruit in his orchard.

cues.zh: 在送小孩去警察局的路上
cues.pinyin: zai4 song4 xiao3 hai2 qu4 jing3 cha2 ju2 de5 lu4 shang4
cues.en: On the way to take the kid to the police station,

cues.zh: 我把帽子放在果园了
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba3 mao4 zi5 fang4 zai4 guo3 yuan2 le5
cues.en: (the kid said) "I left my hat in the orchard."

cues.zh: 毛包你去哪
cues.pinyin: mao2 bao1 ni3 qu4 na3
cues.en: "Your hat? Go get it, then."

cues.zh: 我在这里等你
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 zhe4 li3 deng3 ni3
cues.en: "I'll wait here for you."

cues.zh: 结果小孩一去就没回来
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xiao3 hai2 yi1 qu4 jiu4 mei2 hui2 lai2
cues.en: As it turned out, once the kid left, he never came back.

cues.zh: 一个礼拜后农夫又抓到同一个小孩
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 li3 bai4 hou4 nong2 fu1 you4 zhua1 dao4 tong2 yi1 ge4 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: A week later, the farmer caught the same kid again.

cues.zh: 这次我一定要抓你去警察局
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 wo3 yi2 ding4 yao4 zhua1 ni3 qu4 jing3 cha2 ju2
cues.en: "This time I'm definitely taking you to the police station."

cues.zh: 等一等
cues.pinyin: deng3 yi1 deng3
cues.en: "Wait a minute,"

cues.zh: 那个我把帽子放在果园了
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 wo3 ba3 mao4 zi5 fang4 zai4 guo3 yuan2 le5
cues.en: "um, I left my hat in the orchard."

cues.zh: 这时农夫兄有成熟的说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 nong2 fu1 xiong1 you3 cheng2 shu2 de5 shuo1
cues.en: This time, the farmer, having learned his lesson, said

cues.zh: 你这次骗不了我
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ci4 pian4 bu4 liao3 wo3
cues.en: "You can't fool me this time."

cues.zh: 你在这里等我
cues.pinyin: ni3 zai4 zhe4 li3 deng3 wo3
cues.en: "You wait here for me,"

cues.zh: 我帮你去哪
cues.pinyin: wo3 bang1 ni3 qu4 na3
cues.en: "I'll go get it for you."

items.title_zh: 笑话101｜不给钱的后果｜赌性不改｜抓小偷｜霸气的男人｜实习护士｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 今天真倒楣
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhen1 dao4 mei2
cues.en: "Today was really unlucky."

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为今天我人不舒服
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jin1 tian1 wo3 ren2 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: "Because I wasn't feeling well today."

cues.zh: 去医院掉点滴
cues.pinyin: qu4 yi1 yuan4 diao4 dian3 di1
cues.en: "I went to the hospital to get an IV drip."

cues.zh: 不是问我怕疼吗
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 wen4 wo3 pa4 teng2 ma5
cues.en: "The nurse asked if I was afraid of pain."

cues.zh: 我勇敢的说不怕
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong3 gan3 de5 shuo1 bu4 pa4
cues.en: "I bravely said I wasn't."

cues.zh: 然后他就给我找了一个实习护士
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 gei3 wo3 zhao3 le5 yi2 ge4 shi2 xi2 hu4 shi4
cues.en: "Then they got me a trainee nurse."

cues.zh: 珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1
cues.en: "Shanshan,"

cues.zh: 我问你哦
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "let me ask you,"

cues.zh: 上帝关了一扇门
cues.pinyin: shang4 di4 guan1 le5 yi1 shan4 men2
cues.en: "when God closes a door,"

cues.zh: 接下来你知道要干嘛吗
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ni3 zhi1 dao4 yao4 gan4 ma2 ma5
cues.en: "do you know what he does next?"

cues.zh: 当然就要给我们开扇窗咯
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 jiu4 yao4 gei3 wo3 men5 kai1 shan4 chuang1 ge1
cues.en: "Of course, he opens a window for us."

cues.zh: 错了
cues.pinyin: cuo4 le5
cues.en: "Wrong."

cues.zh: 答案是要开冷气的
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 yao4 kai1 leng3 qi4 de5
cues.en: "The answer is: he turns on the air conditioner."

cues.zh: 我应该可以算是少数非常霸气的男人
cues.pinyin: wo3 ying1 gai1 ke3 yi3 suan4 shi4 shao3 shu4 fei1 chang2 ba4 qi4 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: "I think I can count as one of the few really commanding men."

cues.zh: 要是我想做的事
cues.pinyin: yao4 shi4 wo3 xiang3 zuo4 de5 shi4
cues.en: "If it's something I want to do,"

cues.zh: 我老婆从不敢说不
cues.pinyin: wo3 lao3 po2 cong2 bu4 gan3 shuo1 bu4
cues.en: "my wife never dares say no."

cues.zh: 真的吗
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 ma5
cues.en: "Really?"

cues.zh: 例如什么
cues.pinyin: li4 ru2 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Like what, for example?"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话101｜不给钱的后果｜赌性不改｜抓小偷｜霸气的男人｜实习护士｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Shanshan, let me ask you,"

cues.zh: 什么是
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4
cues.en: "what is..."

cues.zh: 上课终身想了
cues.pinyin: shang4 ke4 zhong1 shen1 xiang3 le5
cues.en: "the class bell rang,"

cues.zh: 却没有一个同学在教室
cues.pinyin: que4 mei2 you3 yi2 ge4 tong2 xue2 zai4 jiao4 shi4
cues.en: "but not a single classmate was in the classroom."

cues.zh: 你知道为什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: "Do you know why?"

cues.zh: 因为呢
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ne5
cues.en: "Because,"

cues.zh: 同学已经忘记
cues.pinyin: tong2 xue2 yi3 jing1 wang4 ji4
cues.en: "the classmates had already forgotten"

cues.zh: 上课终身了
cues.pinyin: shang4 ke4 zhong1 shen1 le5
cues.en: "that the class bell had rung."

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "Nope, wrong."

cues.zh: 上课钟声响了
cues.pinyin: shang4 ke4 zhong1 sheng1 xiang3 le5
cues.en: "It's because they had PE class,"

cues.zh: 所以他们都在外面
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 dou1 zai4 wai4 mian4
cues.en: "so they were all outside."

cues.zh: 你在不专心上课
cues.pinyin: ni3 zai4 bu4 zhuan1 xin1 shang4 ke4
cues.en: "If you keep not paying attention in class,"

cues.zh: 我就要告诉你爸爸
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 yao4 gao4 su4 ni3 ba4 ba4
cues.en: "I'm going to tell your dad."

cues.zh: 老师其实我对你也不是很满意啊
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 qi2 shi2 wo3 dui4 ni3 ye3 bu2 shi4 hen3 man3 yi4 a5
cues.en: "Teacher, honestly, I'm not very satisfied with you either,"

cues.zh: 可是我都没有跟你爸爸说啊
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 dou1 mei2 you3 gen1 ni3 ba4 ba4 shuo1 a5
cues.en: "but I haven't told your dad about it."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 20 26 年的世界杯正在进行
cues.pinyin: 20 26 nian2 de5 shi4 jie4 bei1 zheng4 zai4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: The 2026 World Cup is currently underway.

cues.zh: 昨天 C 罗上了热搜
cues.pinyin: zuo2 tian1 C luo2 shang4 le5 re4 sou1
cues.en: Yesterday Ronaldo trended on social media.

cues.zh: 因为葡萄牙被刚果金逼平了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 pu2 tao2 ya2 bei4 gang1 guo3 jin1 bi1 ping2 le5
cues.en: Because Portugal was held to a draw by Congo DR.

cues.zh: 核心球员 C 罗表现差强人意
cues.pinyin: he2 xin1 qiu2 yuan2 C luo2 biao3 xian4 cha1 qiang2 ren2 yi4
cues.en: The team's core player Ronaldo had an underwhelming performance.

cues.zh: 很多人感叹岁月不饶人
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 gan3 tan4 sui4 yue4 bu4 rao2 ren2
cues.en: Many people sighed that time spares no one.

cues.zh: 不知大家还是否记得 C 罗的巅峰之战
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 da4 jia1 hai2 shi4 fou3 ji4 de5 C luo2 de5 dian1 feng1 zhi1 zhan4
cues.en: I wonder if everyone still remembers Ronaldo's peak battle.

cues.zh: 2018 年俄罗斯世界杯葡萄牙对阵西班牙
cues.pinyin: 2018 nian2 e2 luo2 si1 shi4 jie4 bei1 pu2 tao2 ya2 dui4 zhen4 xi1 ban1 ya2
cues.en: The 2018 Russia World Cup match between Portugal and Spain.

cues.zh: C 罗上演了帽子戏法
cues.pinyin: C luo2 shang4 yan3 le5 mao4 zi5 xi4 fa3
cues.en: Ronaldo pulled off a hat trick.

cues.zh: 第四分钟 C 罗点球破门
cues.pinyin: di4 si4 fen1 zhong1 C luo2 dian3 qiu2 po4 men2
cues.en: In the 4th minute, Ronaldo scored from a penalty.

cues.zh: 在半场的尾声 C 罗在禁区的弧顶
cues.pinyin: zai4 ban4 chang3 de5 wei3 sheng1 C luo2 zai4 jin4 qu1 de5 hu2 ding3
cues.en: Near the end of the first half, Ronaldo at the top of the arc.

cues.zh: 接队友的回做
cues.pinyin: jie1 dui4 you3 de5 hui2 zuo4
cues.en: Received a lay-off from a teammate.

cues.zh: 左脚低平抽射破门
cues.pinyin: zuo3 jiao3 di1 ping2 chou1 she4 po4 men2
cues.en: And fired a low, flat shot with his left foot into the net.

cues.zh: 在中场之前葡萄牙获得禁区前沿
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 chang3 zhi1 qian2 pu2 tao2 ya2 huo4 de2 jin4 qu1 qian2 yan2
cues.en: Before halftime, Portugal won a free kick just outside the box.

cues.zh: 绝佳的任意球
cues.pinyin: jue2 jia1 de5 ren4 yi4 qiu2
cues.en: A perfect free-kick opportunity.

cues.zh: C 罗独自站在球前调整呼吸
cues.pinyin: C luo2 du2 zi4 zhan4 zai4 qiu2 qian2 tiao2 zheng3 hu1 xi1
cues.en: Ronaldo stood alone before the ball, steadying his breath.

cues.zh: 绷紧肌肉
cues.pinyin: beng1 jin3 ji1 rou4
cues.en: Tensing his muscles.

cues.zh: 助跑后踢出了一道完美的弧线
cues.pinyin: zhu4 pao3 hou4 ti1 chu1 le5 yi1 dao4 wan2 mei3 de5 hu2 xian4
cues.en: After his run-up, he struck a perfect curving shot.

cues.zh: 皮球绕过人墙
cues.pinyin: pi2 qiu2 rao4 guo4 ren2 qiang2
cues.en: The ball curled around the defensive wall.

cues.zh: 直挂球门的右上死角
cues.pinyin: zhi2 gua4 qiu2 men2 de5 you4 shang4 si3 jiao3
cues.en: And flew straight into the top-right corner of the goal.

cues.zh: 进球的瞬间全场沸腾了
cues.pinyin: jin4 qiu2 de5 shun4 jian1 quan2 chang3 fei4 teng2 le5
cues.en: The moment the ball went in, the whole stadium erupted.

cues.zh: C 罗完成了帽子戏法
cues.pinyin: C luo2 wan2 cheng2 le5 mao4 zi5 xi4 fa3
cues.en: Ronaldo had completed his hat trick.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 压哨绝屏墙底
cues.pinyin: ya1 shao4 jue2 ping2 qiang2 di3
cues.en: Sealing it with a stoppage-time strike.

cues.zh: 央视解说朱晓雨留下了经典的台词
cues.pinyin: yang1 shi4 jie3 shuo1 zhu1 xiao3 yu3 liu2 xia4 le5 jing1 dian3 de5 tai2 ci2
cues.en: CCTV commentator Zhu Xiaoyu left behind a classic line.

cues.zh: 翩若惊鸿宛若游龙
cues.pinyin: pian1 ruo4 jing1 hong2 wan3 ruo4 you2 long2
cues.en: "Graceful as a startled swan, swift as a swimming dragon."

cues.zh: 这一记任意球也被球迷称作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ji4 ren4 yi4 qiu2 ye3 bei4 qiu2 mi2 cheng1 zuo4
cues.en: This free kick is also known by fans as...

cues.zh: C 罗在空中写了个 C
cues.pinyin: C luo2 zai4 kong1 zhong1 xie3 le5 ge4 C
cues.en: "Ronaldo writing a C in the air."

cues.zh: 在 8 年以前我专门做过一期视频
cues.pinyin: zai4 8 nian2 yi3 qian2 wo3 zhuan1 men2 zuo4 guo4 yi1 qi1 shi4 pin2
cues.en: Eight years ago, I made a whole video on this.

cues.zh: 从物理角度来拆解 C 罗这一脚
cues.pinyin: cong2 wu4 li3 jiao3 du4 lai2 chai1 jie3 C luo2 zhe4 yi1 jiao3
cues.en: Breaking down this shot of Ronaldo's from a physics perspective.

cues.zh: 标志性的破门
cues.pinyin: biao1 zhi4 xing4 de5 po4 men2
cues.en: That iconic goal.

cues.zh: 讨论它到底是香蕉球落叶球还是电梯球
cues.pinyin: tao3 lun4 ta1 dao4 di3 shi4 xiang1 jiao1 qiu2 luo4 ye4 qiu2 hai2 shi4 dian4 ti1 qiu2
cues.en: Debating whether it was a banana kick, a knuckleball, or an elevator ball.

cues.zh: 今天借着本届世界杯的热点
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jie4 zhe5 ben3 jie4 shi4 jie4 bei1 de5 re4 dian3
cues.en: Today, riding on the buzz of this World Cup.

cues.zh: 让我们回到 8 年以前去重温一下巅峰
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 men5 hui2 dao4 8 nian2 yi3 qian2 qu4 chong2 wen1 yi1 xia4 dian1 feng1
cues.en: Let's go back eight years and revisit the Ronaldo.

cues.zh: 时代的 C 罗吧
cues.pinyin: shi2 dai4 de5 C luo2 ba5
cues.en: Of his prime.

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 很多朋友都看了前几天世界杯小组赛中
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 peng2 you3 dou1 kan4 le5 qian2 ji3 tian1 shi4 jie4 bei1 xiao3 zu3 sai4 zhong1
cues.en: Many friends watched the World Cup group match from a few days ago.

cues.zh: 葡萄牙对战西班牙的那一场比赛
cues.pinyin: pu2 tao2 ya2 dui4 zhan4 xi1 ban1 ya2 de5 na4 yi1 chang2 bi3 sai4
cues.en: The game between Portugal and Spain.

cues.zh: C 罗宝刀未老上演了一出帽子戏法
cues.pinyin: C luo2 bao3 dao1 wei4 lao3 shang4 yan3 le5 yi1 chu1 mao4 zi5 xi4 fa3
cues.en: Ronaldo showed he still had it, pulling off a hat trick.

cues.zh: 尤其是第 88 分钟的那一例进球
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 di4 88 fen1 zhong1 de5 na4 yi1 li4 jin4 qiu2
cues.en: Especially that goal in the 88th minute.

cues.zh: 绝对可以说是教科书式的进球
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 ke3 yi3 shuo1 shi4 jiao4 ke1 shu1 shi4 de5 jin4 qiu2
cues.en: Which can absolutely be called a textbook goal.

cues.zh: 那么对于这个进球有人说它是香蕉球
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dui4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 jin4 qiu2 you3 ren2 shuo1 ta1 shi4 xiang1 jiao1 qiu2
cues.en: As for this goal, some say it was a banana kick.

cues.zh: 有人说是落叶球也有人说是电梯球
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 shi4 luo4 ye4 qiu2 ye3 you3 ren2 shuo1 shi4 dian4 ti1 qiu2
cues.en: Others say it was a knuckleball, and some say an elevator ball.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 那么落叶球是什么意思
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 luo4 ye4 qiu2 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: So what exactly is a knuckleball?

cues.zh: 落叶球的意思跟香蕉球差不多
cues.pinyin: luo4 ye4 qiu2 de5 yi4 si5 gen1 xiang1 jiao1 qiu2 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: A knuckleball works similarly to a banana kick.

cues.zh: 只不过它的旋转是上下方向旋转的
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 ta1 de5 xuan2 zhuan3 shi4 shang4 xia4 fang1 xiang4 xuan2 zhuan3 de5
cues.en: Except its spin is in the vertical direction instead.

cues.zh: 比如说这是一个球门这回我们看示意图了
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 men2 zhe4 hui2 wo3 men5 kan4 shi4 yi4 tu2 le5
cues.en: For example, here's a goal — let's look at a diagram.

cues.zh: 然后这个球在这个位置踢出去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4 ti1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: And the ball is kicked from this spot.

cues.zh: 如果按照抛物线轨迹来说
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 an4 zhao4 pao1 wu4 xian4 gui3 ji4 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: If it followed a normal parabolic trajectory.

cues.zh: 这个球本来应该走到这个位置
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qiu2 ben3 lai2 ying1 gai1 zou3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: The ball should end up here.

cues.zh: 也就是说它会到球门后面去不能进球
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ta1 hui4 dao4 qiu2 men2 hou4 mian4 qu4 bu4 neng2 jin4 qiu2
cues.en: Meaning it would fly over the goal and miss.

cues.zh: 但是因为我们可以让这个球旋转起来
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 rang4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 xuan2 zhuan3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: But because we can make the ball spin.

cues.zh: 这样一来这个球中间就突然之间会变轨迹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 zhong1 jian1 jiu4 tu1 ran2 zhi1 jian1 hui4 bian4 gui3 ji4
cues.en: Its path suddenly changes midway.

cues.zh: 然后走进这个球门就这么一个事
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zou3 jin4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 men2 jiu4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 shi4
cues.en: And it ends up going into the goal — that's the basic idea.

cues.zh: 这个就称之为落叶球它下坠的比较厉害
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 luo4 ye4 qiu2 ta1 xia4 zhui4 de5 bi3 jiao4 li4 hai4
cues.en: This is called a knuckleball — it drops very sharply.

cues.zh: 香蕉球和落叶球它们相同的原理都
cues.pinyin: xiang1 jiao1 qiu2 he2 luo4 ye4 qiu2 ta1 men5 xiang1 tong2 de5 yuan2 li3 dou1
cues.en: The banana kick and the knuckleball share the same underlying principle.

cues.zh: 是伯努力原理
cues.pinyin: shi4 bo2 nu3 li4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: Which is Bernoulli's principle.

cues.zh: 所谓伯努力原理这件事我们之前也讲过
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 bo2 nu3 li4 yuan2 li3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 ye3 jiang3 guo4
cues.en: We've talked about Bernoulli's principle before.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 于是它流速就会变得比较小
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 liu2 su4 jiu4 hui4 bian4 de2 bi3 jiao4 xiao3
cues.en: So the airflow speed becomes relatively slow.

cues.zh: 而压强就会比较大
cues.pinyin: er2 ya1 qiang2 jiu4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 da4
cues.en: And the pressure becomes relatively high.

cues.zh: 底下它们两个没有发生碰撞
cues.pinyin: di3 xia4 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 mei2 you3 fa1 sheng1 peng4 zhuang4
cues.en: On the other side, there's no collision with the air.

cues.zh: 所以流速就会比较大压强就会比较小
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liu2 su4 jiu4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 da4 ya1 qiang2 jiu4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 xiao3
cues.en: So the airflow speed is faster and the pressure is lower.

cues.zh: 这样一来造成了一个压力差
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 zao4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 ya1 li4 cha4
cues.en: This creates a pressure difference.

cues.zh: 这个压力差就把这个球往下边推
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ya1 li4 cha4 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 wang3 xia4 bian1 tui1
cues.en: And that pressure difference pushes the ball downward.

cues.zh: 所以这个球就会急速下坠就这么一个情况
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 jiu4 hui4 ji2 su4 xia4 zhui4 jiu4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: So the ball drops sharply — that's basically what happens.

cues.zh: 但是伯努利原理实际上是对定常流体
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bo2 nu3 li4 yuan2 li3 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 dui4 ding4 chang2 liu2 ti3
cues.en: But Bernoulli's principle is really a theory for steady flow.

cues.zh: 或者说不可压缩流体的一个理论问题
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 bu4 ke3 ya1 suo1 liu2 ti3 de5 yi2 ge4 li3 lun4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Or more precisely, for incompressible fluids.

cues.zh: 那么这个空气实际上它是可以压缩的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 kong1 qi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 ta1 shi4 ke3 yi3 ya1 suo1 de5
cues.en: And air, in reality, is actually compressible.

cues.zh: 所以用伯努利原理只能定性解释而
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yong4 bo2 nu3 li4 yuan2 li3 zhi3 neng2 ding4 xing4 jie3 shi4 er2
cues.en: So Bernoulli's principle can only explain it qualitatively.

cues.zh: 不能定量解释
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 ding4 liang4 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Not quantitatively.

cues.zh: 那么人们为了定量解释这个球的原理
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 men5 wei4 le5 ding4 liang4 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 de5 yuan2 li3
cues.en: So to explain this ball's behavior quantitatively.

cues.zh: 又提出了一个效应
cues.pinyin: you4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: People proposed another effect.

cues.zh: 这叫马格努斯效应
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 ma3 ge2 nu3 si1 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: Called the Magnus effect.

cues.zh: 通过这个马格努斯效应
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 ma3 ge2 nu3 si1 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: Through this Magnus effect.

cues.zh: 我们可以更加精细地研究这个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 geng4 jia1 jing1 xi4 di4 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: We can study this problem more precisely.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 马格努斯效应是说在旋转过程中
cues.pinyin: ma3 ge2 nu3 si1 xiao4 ying4 shi4 shuo1 zai4 xuan2 zhuan3 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: The Magnus effect says that while spinning.

cues.zh: 这个球会受到了一个力的作用
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qiu2 hui4 shou4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 li4 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: The ball experiences a force.

cues.zh: 这个力有多大呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: How big is this force?

cues.zh: 这个力的大小 f 应该等于一个系数 s
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 de5 da4 xiao3 f ying1 gai1 deng3 yu2 yi2 ge4 xi4 shu4 s
cues.en: The magnitude of this force f equals a coefficient S.

cues.zh: 咱们系数就不用管它是什么了
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xi4 shu4 jiu4 bu4 yong4 guan3 ta1 shi4 shen2 me5 le5
cues.en: Let's not worry about what this coefficient actually is.

cues.zh: 跟表面的粘质阻力有关系
cues.pinyin: gen1 biao3 mian4 de5 zhan1 zhi4 zu3 li4 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: It's related to the viscous drag on the surface.

cues.zh: 然后再乘以 x 乘 v
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 x cheng2 v
cues.en: Then multiplied by ω and v.

cues.zh: 有人说完了我看不懂了
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 wan2 le5 wo3 kan4 bu4 dong3 le5
cues.en: Someone might say, "I'm lost now."

cues.zh: 然后再乘以乘 v
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 cheng2 v
cues.en: Actually, it's not that hard.

cues.zh: 是什么呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What is it?

cues.zh: 就是这个球自转的角速度
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 zi4 zhuan4 de5 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: It's the angular velocity of the ball's spin.

cues.zh: 是自转的角速度
cues.pinyin: shi4 zi4 zhuan4 de5 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: The spin's angular velocity.

cues.zh: 这个角速度它是有方向的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao3 su4 du4 ta1 shi4 you3 fang1 xiang4 de5
cues.en: This angular velocity has a direction.

cues.zh: 这个方向是用右手定则判定的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 xiang4 shi4 yong4 you4 shou3 ding4 ze2 pan4 ding4 de5
cues.en: The direction is determined by the right-hand rule.

cues.zh: 你右手的四指顺着球自转的方向
cues.pinyin: ni3 you4 shou3 de5 si4 zhi3 shun4 zhe5 qiu2 zi4 zhuan4 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: Curl your right hand's four fingers in the direction the ball spins.

cues.zh: 则大拇指就是角速度方向
cues.pinyin: ze2 da4 mu3 zhi3 jiu4 shi4 jiao3 su4 du4 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: Then your thumb points in the direction of the angular velocity.

cues.zh: 比如说这个球吧
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 ba5
cues.en: Take this ball, for example.

cues.zh: 我们俯视看这个球是这样转的对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fu3 shi4 kan4 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zhuan3 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Looking from above, it's spinning like this, right?

cues.zh: 所以我们右手四指顺着它的方向
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 you4 shou3 si4 zhi3 shun4 zhe5 ta1 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: So curling our right hand's fingers in that direction.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】廉颇老矣？回看C罗2018世界杯封神任意球，拆解电梯球的物理

cues.zh: 这样一来它的角速度
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 ta1 de5 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: This gives us its angular velocity.

cues.zh: 就是这样朝我们的对吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 chao2 wo3 men5 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Pointing like this, toward us, right?

cues.zh: 然后它的速度 v 是朝左的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 de5 su4 du4 v shi4 chao2 zuo3 de5
cues.en: And its velocity v points to the left.

cues.zh: 这样一来 x v 先让四指指向的方向
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 x v xian1 rang4 si4 zhi3 zhi3 xiang4 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: So for ω × v, first point your fingers in ω's direction.

cues.zh: 再转向 v 的方向大拇指就是受力所
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhuan3 xiang4 v de5 fang1 xiang4 da4 mu3 zhi3 jiu4 shi4 shou4 li4 suo3
cues.en: Then curl toward v's direction — the thumb shows the force.

cues.zh: 以受力就向下
cues.pinyin: yi3 shou4 li4 jiu4 xiang4 xia4
cues.en: So the force points downward.

cues.zh: 我们通过这个受力就可以仔细分析
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 shou4 li4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zi3 xi4 fen1 xi1
cues.en: With this force, we can carefully analyze.

cues.zh: 香蕉球落叶球的一个情况了
cues.pinyin: xiang1 jiao1 qiu2 luo4 ye4 qiu2 de5 yi2 ge4 qing2 kuang4 le5
cues.en: The situation for both the banana kick and the knuckleball.

cues.zh: 那么它们两个的共同特点都是旋转
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 de5 gong4 tong2 te4 dian3 dou1 shi4 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: Their common feature is that both involve spin.

cues.zh: 只不过一个是水平旋转水平偏
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 yi2 ge4 shi4 shui3 ping2 xuan2 zhuan3 shui3 ping2 pian1
cues.en: One spins horizontally, curving sideways.

cues.zh: 一个是竖直旋转所以会急速下坠
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 shu4 zhi2 xuan2 zhuan3 suo3 yi3 hui4 ji2 su4 xia4 zhui4
cues.en: The other spins vertically, causing it to drop sharply.

cues.zh: 那么你为了踢出这样的球
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 wei4 le5 ti1 chu1 zhe4 yang4 de5 qiu2
cues.en: So to kick a ball like this.

cues.zh: 你必须要让它强烈旋转
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi4 xu1 yao4 rang4 ta1 qiang2 lie4 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: You need to make it spin very strongly.

cues.zh: 怎么强烈旋转呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 qiang2 lie4 xuan2 zhuan3 ne5
cues.en: How do you make it spin that strongly?

cues.zh: 就是球速不必太快
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 qiu2 su4 bu4 bi4 tai4 kuai4
cues.en: The ball speed doesn't need to be too fast.

cues.zh: 球速不太快
cues.pinyin: qiu2 su4 bu4 tai4 kuai4
cues.en: The ball speed isn't very fast.

cues.zh: 但是你一定要让它加强烈旋转的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 yi2 ding4 yao4 rang4 ta1 jia1 qiang2 lie4 xuan2 zhuan3 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if you want to make it spin intensely.

cues.zh: 你必须在踢球的时候要增加接触的时间
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi4 xu1 zai4 ti1 qiu2 de5 shi2 hou4 yao4 zeng1 jia1 jie1 chu4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: You must increase the contact time when striking the ball.

items.title_zh: 8个有趣的科学小实验 science experiment #大大小小

cues.zh: 水晶宝宝吸完水之后约 95
cues.pinyin: shui3 jing1 bao3 bao3 xi1 wan2 shui3 zhi1 hou4 yue1 95
cues.en: After the crystal water beads finish absorbing water, about 95%

cues.zh: 都是水因此它的折射率和水很接近
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 shui3 yin1 ci3 ta1 de5 zhe2 she4 lv4 he2 shui3 hen3 jie1 jin4
cues.en: is water, so its refractive index is very close to that of water.

cues.zh: 所以当我们加水后
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dang1 wo3 men5 jia1 shui3 hou4
cues.en: So when we add water,

cues.zh: 它看起来就与水融为一体
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 yu3 shui3 rong2 wei2 yi1 ti3
cues.en: it appears to blend seamlessly with the water.

cues.zh: 因此可以让层层又重新出现了
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 ke3 yi3 rang4 ceng2 ceng2 you4 chong2 xin1 chu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: so the hidden layers reappear.

cues.zh: 光线进入水中后由于折射角度不同
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 jin4 ru4 shui3 zhong1 hou4 you2 yu2 zhe2 she4 jiao3 du4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: After light enters the water, because the refraction angle differs,

cues.zh: 在纸张上的折射角度过大
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhi3 zhang1 shang4 de5 zhe2 she4 jiao3 du4 guo4 da4
cues.en: the refraction angle on the paper becomes too large,

cues.zh: 光线无法反射回眼睛
cues.pinyin: guang1 xian4 wu2 fa3 fan3 she4 hui2 yan3 jing1
cues.en: so the light can't reflect back to the eye,

cues.zh: 所以纸上的颜色就会消失不见了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhi3 shang4 de5 yan2 se4 jiu4 hui4 xiao1 shi1 bu2 jian4 le5
cues.en: so the color on the paper disappears.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 8个有趣的科学小实验 science experiment #大大小小

cues.zh: 酒精比起水来密度较小
cues.pinyin: jiu3 jing1 bi3 qi3 shui3 lai2 mi4 du4 jiao4 xiao3
cues.en: Alcohol has a lower density than water,

cues.zh: 所以加了色素的酒精
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jia1 le5 se4 su4 de5 jiu3 jing1
cues.en: so the alcohol mixed with food coloring

cues.zh: 就会慢慢的往上升
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 man4 man4 de5 wang3 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: slowly rises to the top.

cues.zh: 柠檬酸接触到小苏打粉
cues.pinyin: ning2 meng2 suan1 jie1 chu4 dao4 xiao3 su1 da2 fen3
cues.en: When citric acid touches baking soda powder,

cues.zh: 会产生大量二氧化碳
cues.pinyin: hui4 chan3 sheng1 da4 liang4 er4 yang3 hua4 tan4
cues.en: it produces a large amount of carbon dioxide,

cues.zh: 将粉红色顶升上来
cues.pinyin: jiang1 fen3 hong2 se4 ding3 sheng1 shang4 lai2
cues.en: which pushes the pink liquid upward.

cues.zh: 但油水会分离
cues.pinyin: dan4 you2 shui3 hui4 fen1 li2
cues.en: But oil and water separate,

cues.zh: 这时就会看到一颗颗粉红小球落下来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 jiu4 hui4 kan4 dao4 yi1 ke1 ke1 fen3 hong2 xiao3 qiu2 la4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: so you'll see little pink balls falling down one by one.

cues.zh: 很漂亮吧
cues.pinyin: hen3 piao4 liang4 ba5
cues.en: Pretty, right?

cues.zh: 还没吸饱水的水晶宝宝
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 xi1 bao3 shui3 de5 shui3 jing1 bao3 bao3
cues.en: Crystal water beads that haven't fully absorbed water yet

cues.zh: 在汽水里跳舞
cues.pinyin: zai4 qi4 shui3 li3 tiao4 wu3
cues.en: dance inside the soda.

cues.zh: 是因为二氧化碳气泡
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 er4 yang3 hua4 tan4 qi4 pao4
cues.en: This is because carbon dioxide bubbles

cues.zh: 附在水晶宝宝四周
cues.pinyin: fu4 zai4 shui3 jing1 bao3 bao3 si4 zhou1
cues.en: cling around the crystal beads,

cues.zh: 让它产生浮力
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 chan3 sheng1 fu2 li4
cues.en: giving them buoyancy,

cues.zh: 就会往上浮
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 wang3 shang4 fu2
cues.en: so they float upward.

cues.zh: 等升到水面气泡破了
cues.pinyin: deng3 sheng1 dao4 shui3 mian4 qi4 pao4 po4 le5
cues.en: Once they reach the surface and the bubbles pop,

cues.zh: 水晶宝宝就下沉了喔
cues.pinyin: shui3 jing1 bao3 bao3 jiu4 xia4 chen2 le5 o1
cues.en: the crystal beads sink back down.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 8个有趣的科学小实验 science experiment #大大小小

cues.zh: 水透过毛细现象
cues.pinyin: shui3 tou4 guo4 mao2 xi4 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: Through capillary action, water

cues.zh: 浸润到纸缝隙中
cues.pinyin: jin4 run4 dao4 zhi3 feng4 xi4 zhong1
cues.en: seeps into the gaps in the paper,

cues.zh: 改变纸的张力形状
cues.pinyin: gai3 bian4 zhi3 de5 zhang1 li4 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: changing the paper's tension and shape,

cues.zh: 于是纸卷就开卷了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhi3 juan3 jiu4 kai1 juan4 le5
cues.en: so the paper roll starts to curl open.

cues.zh: 风扇的气流会吹动纸陀螺
cues.pinyin: feng1 shan4 de5 qi4 liu2 hui4 chui1 dong4 zhi3 tuo2 luo2
cues.en: The fan's airflow blows the paper spinner,

cues.zh: 让它旋转起来
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 xuan2 zhuan3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: making it spin.

cues.zh: 风力不可太强
cues.pinyin: feng1 li4 bu4 ke3 tai4 qiang2
cues.en: The wind shouldn't be too strong,

cues.zh: 太强会将纸陀螺吹飞喔
cues.pinyin: tai4 qiang2 hui4 jiang1 zhi3 tuo2 luo2 chui1 fei1 o1
cues.en: too strong and it'll blow the paper spinner away.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 手术过程中突然停电了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 tu1 ran2 ting2 dian4 le5
cues.en: During the surgery, the power suddenly went out.

cues.zh: 天才医生该怎么救人呢
cues.pinyin: tian1 cai2 yi1 sheng1 gai1 zen3 me5 jiu4 ren2 ne5
cues.en: What should the genius doctor do to save the patient?

cues.zh: 今天是他们来到这里第一次开
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 ta1 men5 lai2 dao4 zhe4 li3 di4 yi1 ci4 kai1
cues.en: Today was the first day

cues.zh: 始手术的日子
cues.pinyin: shi3 shou3 shu4 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: they started performing surgery here.

cues.zh: 大家都挺兴奋的
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 ting3 xing1 fen4 de5
cues.en: Everyone was quite excited.

cues.zh: 利姆把所有人分成了三组开展工作
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 ba3 suo3 you3 ren2 fen1 cheng2 le5 san1 zu3 kai1 zhan3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Liam split everyone into three groups to start the work.

cues.zh: 只不过大家刚上手没多久医院就突然停电
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 da4 jia1 gang1 shang4 shou3 mei2 duo1 jiu3 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 tu1 ran2 ting2 dian4
cues.en: But not long after they got started, the hospital suddenly lost power.

cues.zh: 顿时陷入了昏暗之中
cues.pinyin: dun4 shi2 xian4 ru4 le5 hun1 an4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: Everything was plunged into darkness.

cues.zh: 护士大姐过来道歉
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 da4 jie3 guo4 lai2 dao4 qian4
cues.en: The nurse came over to apologize.

cues.zh: 这里地处山上经常停电他们备有发电机
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 di4 chu3 shan1 shang4 jing1 chang2 ting2 dian4 ta1 men5 bei4 you3 fa1 dian4 ji1
cues.en: This place is up in the mountains and often loses power, so they have a generator.

cues.zh: 只不过不幸的是发电机也坏掉了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 bu4 xing4 de5 shi4 fa1 dian4 ji1 ye3 huai4 diao4 le5
cues.en: Unfortunately, the generator was broken too.

cues.zh: 连医院的人也不知道什么时候才来电
cues.pinyin: lian2 yi1 yuan4 de5 ren2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 cai2 lai2 dian4
cues.en: Even the hospital staff didn't know when the power would come back.

cues.zh: 这可怎么办
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: What on earth could they do?

cues.zh: 患者还都敞着肚皮在病床上躺着呢
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 hai2 dou1 chang3 zhe5 du4 pi2 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4 tang3 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: The patients were still lying on their beds with their bellies cut open.

cues.zh: 再过会儿说不定都凉透了
cues.pinyin: zai4 guo4 hui4 er5 shuo1 bu4 ding4 dou1 liang2 tou4 le5
cues.en: In a little while, they might go completely cold.

cues.zh: 对于要求简单的手术
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 yao1 qiu2 jian3 dan1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: For surgeries that didn't require much,

cues.zh: 医生打算趁着窗外的光线凑合凑合
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 da3 suan4 chen4 zhe5 chuang1 wai4 de5 guang1 xian4 cou4 he2 cou4 he2
cues.en: the doctor planned to make do with the light from the window.

cues.zh: 仪器不能用就直接上手感受血管和器官
cues.pinyin: yi2 qi4 bu4 neng2 yong4 jiu4 zhi2 jie1 shang4 shou3 gan3 shou4 xue4 guan3 he2 qi4 guan1
cues.en: If the equipment couldn't be used, they'd just feel the blood vessels and organs by hand.

cues.zh: 而萧恩负责的病人身上长了个肿瘤
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao1 en1 fu4 ze2 de5 bing4 ren2 shen1 shang4 zhang3 le5 ge4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: Meanwhile, the patient Sean was in charge of had a tumor.

cues.zh: 没有超声波也不好切除啊
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 chao1 sheng1 bo1 ye3 bu4 hao3 qie1 chu2 a5
cues.en: Without an ultrasound, it wouldn't be easy to remove either.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 萧恩回想着病人之前的超声波图
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 hui2 xiang3 zhe5 bing4 ren2 zhi1 qian2 de5 chao1 sheng1 bo1 tu2
cues.en: Sean recalled the patient's previous ultrasound images.

cues.zh: 无数影像在他脑中浮现
cues.pinyin: wu2 shu4 ying3 xiang4 zai4 ta1 nao3 zhong1 fu2 xian4
cues.en: Countless images flashed through his mind.

cues.zh: 仔细衡量后
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 heng2 liang2 hou4
cues.en: After carefully weighing it,

cues.zh: 他确定自己可以在没有超声波的情况下
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 ding4 zi4 ji3 ke3 yi3 zai4 mei2 you3 chao1 sheng1 bo1 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: he was confident he could locate the tumor

cues.zh: 确定肿瘤位置
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 zhong3 liu2 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: even without an ultrasound.

cues.zh: 于是萧恩拿起医用剪刀
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao1 en1 na2 qi3 yi1 yong4 jian3 dao1
cues.en: So Sean picked up a pair of surgical scissors

cues.zh: 慢慢伸进病人的腹腔内
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 shen1 jin4 bing4 ren2 de5 fu4 qiang1 nei4
cues.en: and slowly reached into the patient's abdominal cavity.

cues.zh: 他试探着感受到了条索状的东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 tan4 zhe5 gan3 shou4 dao4 le5 tiao2 suo3 zhuang4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Feeling around carefully, he found something cord-like.

cues.zh: 应该就是肿瘤了
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 jiu4 shi4 zhong3 liu2 le5
cues.en: That should be the tumor.

cues.zh: 既然位置确定了
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 wei4 zhi4 que4 ding4 le5
cues.en: Now that its location was confirmed,

cues.zh: 那么他们就可以切除了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 qie1 chu2 le5
cues.en: they could go ahead and remove it.

cues.zh: 工作一天后大家都十分疲惫
cues.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 yi1 tian1 hou4 da4 jia1 dou1 shi2 fen1 pi2 bei4
cues.en: After a full day of work, everyone was exhausted.

cues.zh: 坐在车上都昏昏欲睡
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 che1 shang4 dou1 hun1 hun1 yu4 shui4
cues.en: They were all drowsy in the car.

cues.zh: 利姆和兰登经过昨天的绑架事件后
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 he2 lan2 deng1 jing1 guo4 zuo2 tian1 de5 bang3 jia4 shi4 jian4 hou4
cues.en: After yesterday's kidnapping incident, Liam and Landon's

cues.zh: 关系得到了迅速的转变
cues.pinyin: guan1 xi4 de2 dao4 le5 xun4 su4 de5 zhuan3 bian4
cues.en: relationship changed rapidly.

cues.zh: 回到旅馆后立马滚到床上贪欢
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 lv3 guan3 hou4 li4 ma3 gun3 dao4 chuang2 shang4 tan1 huan1
cues.en: As soon as they got back to the hotel, they rolled straight into bed to indulge themselves.

cues.zh: 兰登是美国人
cues.pinyin: lan2 deng1 shi4 mei3 guo2 ren2
cues.en: Landon is American,

cues.zh: 但是在墨西哥长大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 mo4 xi1 ge1 zhang3 da4
cues.en: but grew up in Mexico.

cues.zh: 还是个混血儿
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ge4 hun4 xue4 er2
cues.en: He's also mixed-race.

cues.zh: 这么多年辗转各个国家和城市
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 zhan3 zhuan3 ge4 ge4 guo2 jia1 he2 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: After drifting between so many countries and cities over the years,

cues.zh: 已经十年没回去了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 shi2 nian2 mei2 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: he hasn't been back in ten years.

cues.zh: 他的履历十分丰富
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 lv3 li4 shi2 fen1 feng1 fu4
cues.en: His résumé is very impressive,

cues.zh: 加上长得不错
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 zhang3 de2 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: and on top of that he's good-looking,

cues.zh: 的确十分吸引人
cues.pinyin: di2 que4 shi2 fen1 xi1 yin3 ren2
cues.en: which really does make him attractive.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 小布的手术也被安排好了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 de5 shou3 shu4 ye3 bei4 an1 pai2 hao3 le5
cues.en: Xiao Bu's surgery was also scheduled.

cues.zh: 手术台上
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4
cues.en: On the operating table,

cues.zh: 黑哥小心翼翼的将肿瘤
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 de5 jiang1 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: Brother Hei carefully removed the tumor

cues.zh: 从小布的鼻旁窦处切除
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 bu4 de5 bi2 pang2 dou4 chu4 qie1 chu2
cues.en: from near Xiao Bu's nasal sinus.

cues.zh: 修复过程比黑哥预料的要艰难的多
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 guo4 cheng2 bi3 hei1 ge1 yu4 liao4 de5 yao4 jian1 nan2 de5 duo1
cues.en: The repair turned out to be much harder than Brother Hei expected.

cues.zh: 一不小心就会伤到小布的眼眶和其他骨头
cues.pinyin: yi2 bu4 xiao3 xin1 jiu4 hui4 shang1 dao4 xiao3 bu4 de5 yan3 kuang4 he2 qi2 ta1 gu3 tou5
cues.en: One careless move could injure Xiao Bu's eye socket or other bones.

cues.zh: 必须得先移开几块骨头
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 de2 xian1 yi2 kai1 ji3 kuai4 gu3 tou5
cues.en: Several bones had to be removed first

cues.zh: 以得到更开阔的手术空间
cues.pinyin: yi3 de2 dao4 geng4 kai1 kuo4 de5 shou3 shu4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: to create more room to operate.

cues.zh: 可是医院里缺少必须的辅助工具
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 yuan4 li3 que1 shao3 bi4 xu1 de5 fu3 zhu4 gong1 ju4
cues.en: But the hospital lacked the necessary supporting tools.

cues.zh: 不得已
cues.pinyin: bu4 de2 yi3
cues.en: With no other choice,

cues.zh: 黑哥只能先终止手术
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 zhi3 neng2 xian1 zhong1 zhi3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Brother Hei had to pause the surgery for now

cues.zh: 和护士小美一起去一家牙科诊所找找工具
cues.pinyin: he2 hu4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 yi4 qi3 qu4 yi1 jia1 ya2 ke1 zhen3 suo3 zhao3 zhao3 gong1 ju4
cues.en: and go with nurse Xiaomei to a dental clinic to look for tools.

cues.zh: 路上黑哥为自己之前跟小美说的调情的话
cues.pinyin: lu4 shang4 hei1 ge1 wei4 zi4 ji3 zhi1 qian2 gen1 xiao3 mei3 shuo1 de5 tiao2 qing2 de5 hua4
cues.en: On the way, Brother Hei felt bad about the flirty things he'd said to Xiaomei before,

cues.zh: 而感到抱歉
cues.pinyin: er2 gan3 dao4 bao4 qian4
cues.en: and felt sorry about it.

cues.zh: 他告诉小美
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: He told Xiaomei

cues.zh: 自己和妻子的感情出现了问题
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 he2 qi1 zi3 de5 gan3 qing2 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that things had gone wrong between him and his wife.

cues.zh: 他和别人在一起了
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 bie2 ren2 zai4 yi4 qi3 le5
cues.en: He'd gotten together with someone else.

cues.zh: 对方前几天前就已经搬出去住了
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 qian2 ji3 tian1 qian2 jiu4 yi3 jing1 ban1 chu1 qu4 zhu4 le5
cues.en: The other woman had already moved out a few days earlier.

cues.zh: 此次出差的人员中本来没有他的
cues.pinyin: ci3 ci4 chu1 chai1 de5 ren2 yuan2 zhong1 ben3 lai2 mei2 you3 ta1 de5
cues.en: He wasn't originally supposed to be on this trip.

cues.zh: 他特地来到这里
cues.pinyin: ta1 te4 di4 lai2 dao4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: He came here specifically

cues.zh: 也是为了好好整理一下思绪
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 wei4 le5 hao3 hao3 zheng3 li3 yi1 xia4 si1 xu4
cues.en: to sort out his thoughts

cues.zh: 想想要不要挽回一下他们的婚姻
cues.pinyin: xiang3 xiang3 yao4 bu2 yao4 wan3 hui2 yi1 xia4 ta1 men5 de5 hun1 yin1
cues.en: and think about whether to try to save their marriage.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 看着布朗的心情好像不是很好的样子
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 bu4 lang3 de5 xin1 qing2 hao3 xiang4 bu2 shi4 hen3 hao3 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Seeing that Brown didn't seem to be in a good mood,

cues.zh: 护士大姐开口安慰他
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 da4 jie3 kai1 kou3 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: the nurse spoke up to comfort him.

cues.zh: 来这里做志愿者的医生有三种
cues.pinyin: lai2 zhe4 li3 zuo4 zhi4 yuan4 zhe3 de5 yi1 sheng1 you3 san1 zhong3
cues.en: There are three kinds of doctors who come here to volunteer.

cues.zh: 一种是太在乎
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 tai4 zai4 hu1
cues.en: One kind cares too much,

cues.zh: 但是他们不可能救下所有人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 bu4 ke3 neng2 jiu4 xia4 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: but they can't possibly save everyone,

cues.zh: 所以自己把自己给压垮了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zi4 ji3 ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 ya1 kua3 le5
cues.en: so they end up crushing themselves under the weight of it.

cues.zh: 一种是太冷漠
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 tai4 leng3 mo4
cues.en: Another kind is too indifferent,

cues.zh: 这种人本身就有问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 ren2 ben3 shen1 jiu4 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and that kind of person has issues of their own.

cues.zh: 还有一种是尽量去疏远自己的感情
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 shi4 jin3 liang4 qu4 shu1 yuan3 zi4 ji3 de5 gan3 qing2
cues.en: And another kind tries to keep their emotions at a distance,

cues.zh: 以便于更好的工作
cues.pinyin: yi3 bian4 yu2 geng4 hao3 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: so they can work better.

cues.zh: 但布朗不一样
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: But Brown is different.

cues.zh: 他在乎并爱护着每一个病人
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 hu1 bing4 ai4 hu4 zhe5 mei3 yi2 ge4 bing4 ren2
cues.en: He cares about and looks after every single patient,

cues.zh: 但他并没有因此垮掉
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 bing4 mei2 you3 yin1 ci3 kua3 diao4
cues.en: yet he hasn't broken down because of it.

cues.zh: 反而从压力中摄取力量
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 cong2 ya1 li4 zhong1 she4 qu3 li4 liang4
cues.en: Instead, he draws strength from the pressure,

cues.zh: 让自己变得更强
cues.pinyin: rang4 zi4 ji3 bian4 de2 geng4 qiang2
cues.en: making himself stronger.

cues.zh: 布朗大受感触
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 da4 shou4 gan3 chu4
cues.en: Brown was deeply moved.

cues.zh: 说了声谢谢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 le5 sheng1 xie4 xie4
cues.en: He said thanks

cues.zh: 自信满满的和他一起走进手术室
cues.pinyin: zi4 xin4 man3 man3 de5 he2 ta1 yi4 qi3 zou3 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: and walked into the operating room with him, full of confidence.

cues.zh: 可是手术并没有那么顺利
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shou3 shu4 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 shun4 li4
cues.en: But the surgery didn't go as smoothly as that.

cues.zh: 小微的肝脏里不只有胆结石
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 gan1 zang4 li3 bu4 zhi3 you3 dan3 jie2 shi2
cues.en: Xiaowei's liver didn't just have gallstones,

cues.zh: 还有肿瘤
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: it also had a tumor,

cues.zh: 而且已经扩散到了肝脏表面
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yi3 jing1 kuo4 san4 dao4 le5 gan1 zang4 biao3 mian4
cues.en: and it had already spread to the surface of the liver.

cues.zh: 他们需要做肝脏部分切除术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 zuo4 gan1 zang4 bu4 fen4 qie1 chu2 shu4
cues.en: The surgery might stretch on for 12 hours.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 但是医院人手短缺
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 yuan4 ren2 shou3 duan3 que1
cues.en: But the hospital was short-staffed,

cues.zh: 他只能自己坚持
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 neng2 zi4 ji3 jian1 chi2
cues.en: so he had to push through on his own.

cues.zh: 他们需要做交叉前颊切除术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 zuo4 jiao1 cha1 qian2 jia2 qie1 chu2 shu4
cues.en: They needed to perform a partial liver resection.

cues.zh: 但布朗只看过
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 zhi3 kan4 guo4
cues.en: But Brown had only ever studied it,

cues.zh: 从没有上手操作过
cues.pinyin: cong2 mei2 you3 shang4 shou3 cao1 zuo4 guo4
cues.en: never actually performed one himself.

cues.zh: 所以他很紧张
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 hen3 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: So he was nervous.

cues.zh: 可布朗的专业性依旧让他有条不紊的
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 lang3 de5 zhuan1 ye4 xing4 yi1 jiu4 rang4 ta1 you3 tiao2 bu4 wen3 de5
cues.en: But Brown's expertise still let him proceed steadily,

cues.zh: 完成一步又一步的操作
cues.pinyin: wan2 cheng2 yi1 bu4 you4 yi1 bu4 de5 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: completing each step one after another.

cues.zh: 可是突然意外发生了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 tu1 ran2 yi4 wai4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: Then suddenly something unexpected happened.

cues.zh: 小微的心率飙升
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 xin1 lv4 biao1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiaowei's heart rate spiked

cues.zh: 血压下降
cues.pinyin: xue4 ya1 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: and her blood pressure dropped.

cues.zh: 马上就要不行了
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: She was about to crash.

cues.zh: 可是他们又找不出原因
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 you4 zhao3 bu4 chu1 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: But they couldn't figure out the cause.

cues.zh: 这下不成功便成仁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 bu4 cheng2 gong1 bian4 cheng2 ren2
cues.en: Brown immediately paused the surgery

cues.zh: 找到理论知识储备非常丰富的肖恩
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 li3 lun4 zhi1 shi2 chu3 bei4 fei1 chang2 feng1 fu4 de5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: and found Sean, who had a wealth of theoretical knowledge,

cues.zh: 向他寻求帮助
cues.pinyin: xiang4 ta1 xun2 qiu2 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: to ask him for help.

cues.zh: 肖恩向他提供了几种思路
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 xiang4 ta1 ti2 gong1 le5 ji3 zhong3 si1 lu4
cues.en: Sean offered him a few possible leads.

cues.zh: 是那个得了腹膜炎的卷毛
cues.pinyin: shi4 na4 ge5 de2 le5 fu4 mo2 yan2 de5 juan3 mao2
cues.en: Brown immediately made up his mind.

cues.zh: 他们不能确定是哪一种可能
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 neng2 que4 ding4 shi4 na3 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: They couldn't be sure which possibility it was,

cues.zh: 只能按照概率最大的来
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 an4 zhao4 gai4 lv4 zui4 da4 de5 lai2
cues.en: so they could only go with the most likely one.

cues.zh: 这下不成功贬成人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 bu4 cheng2 gong1 bian3 cheng2 ren2
cues.en: This time, it was succeed or die trying.

cues.zh: 幸运的是布朗是对的
cues.pinyin: xing4 yun4 de5 shi4 bu4 lang3 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: Luckily, Brown was right.

cues.zh: 手术很快就完成了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 wan2 cheng2 le5
cues.en: The surgery was finished quickly.

cues.zh: 此刻医院又来了一位熟悉的病人
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 yi1 yuan4 you4 lai2 le5 yi1 wei4 shu2 xi1 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Just then, a familiar patient came to the hospital again.

cues.zh: 是那个得了腹膳的卷毛
cues.pinyin: shi4 na4 ge5 de2 le5 fu4 shan4 de5 juan3 mao2
cues.en: It was Curly, the one who had peritonitis.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 手术时竟然停电，病人的肚皮还敞开着呢！天才医生只好把自己当做超声波用

cues.zh: 而且手指关节的疼痛几乎让他
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shou3 zhi3 guan1 jie2 de5 teng2 tong4 ji1 hu1 rang4 ta1
cues.en: And the pain in his finger joints almost

cues.zh: 拿不稳手术剪
cues.pinyin: na2 bu4 wen3 shou3 shu4 jian3
cues.en: made him unable to hold the surgical scissors steady.

cues.zh: 可这已经到了收尾阶段
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 yi3 jing1 dao4 le5 shou1 wei3 jie1 duan4
cues.en: But they'd already reached the final stage,

cues.zh: 他死撑着也要完成
cues.pinyin: ta1 si3 cheng1 zhe5 ye3 yao4 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: so he forced himself to push through and finish.

cues.zh: 此时刚从手术台上下来的朴医生
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 gang1 cong2 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 xia4 lai2 de5 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: At that moment, Dr. Park, who had just come off another operating table,

cues.zh: 立刻赶来剃了摩根的斑
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 gan3 lai2 ti4 le5 mo2 gen1 de5 ban1
cues.en: rushed over to take over Morgan's shift.

cues.zh: 在手术结束后
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the surgery was over,

cues.zh: 一向强势的摩根难得露出了软弱的一面
cues.pinyin: yi2 xiang4 qiang2 shi4 de5 mo2 gen1 nan2 de2 lu4 chu1 le5 ruan3 ruo4 de5 yi2 mian4
cues.en: the usually strong-willed Morgan rarely let his vulnerable side show.

cues.zh: 即使手受伤了
cues.pinyin: ji2 shi3 shou3 shou4 shang1 le5
cues.en: Even though his hand was injured,

cues.zh: 他也从来没有放弃当外科医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 fang4 qi4 dang1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: he had never given up on being a surgeon.

cues.zh: 可手上的伤阻止了他对职业的追求
cues.pinyin: ke3 shou3 shang4 de5 shang1 zu3 zhi3 le5 ta1 dui4 zhi2 ye4 de5 zhui1 qiu2
cues.en: But the injury to his hand stood in the way of pursuing that career.

cues.zh: 他并不是讨厌当内科医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu2 shi4 tao3 yan4 dang1 nei4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: It wasn't that he hated being a physician,

cues.zh: 而是讨厌失败
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 tao3 yan4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: it was that he hated failing.

cues.zh: 但朴医生告诉他
cues.pinyin: dan4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: But Dr. Park told him

cues.zh: 他从来没有失败过
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 shi1 bai4 guo4
cues.en: that he had never once failed.

cues.zh: 他们做了三年的同事
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 le5 san1 nian2 de5 tong2 shi4
cues.en: They'd been colleagues for three years,

cues.zh: 他看着摩根在工作上大放异彩
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 zhe5 mo2 gen1 zai4 gong1 zuo4 shang4 da4 fang4 yi4 cai3
cues.en: and he had watched Morgan shine brilliantly at work.

cues.zh: 不能当外科医生
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 dang1 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Not being able to be a surgeon

cues.zh: 不能成为他的失败
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 cheng2 wei2 ta1 de5 shi1 bai4
cues.en: couldn't be counted as his failure.

cues.zh: 维基一周的出差工作结束了
cues.pinyin: wei2 ji1 yi1 zhou1 de5 chu1 chai1 gong1 zuo4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: The week-long work trip had come to an end.

cues.zh: 病人也陆陆续续康复出院
cues.pinyin: bing4 ren2 ye3 lu4 lu4 xu4 xu4 kang1 fu4 chu1 yuan4
cues.en: The patients gradually recovered and were discharged one by one.

cues.zh: 医生们和这里的每个人告别
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 he2 zhe4 li3 de5 mei3 ge4 ren2 gao4 bie2
cues.en: The doctors said goodbye to everyone there.

cues.zh: 护士病人邻居
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 bing4 ren2 lin2 ju1
cues.en: Nurses, patients, neighbors.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】两辆车60km/h对撞，和一辆车120km/h撞墙，效果一样吗？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近很多小朋友给我发来私信问
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4 wen4
cues.en: Recently many of you have sent me private messages asking,

cues.zh: 说两辆车以 60 公里每小时的速度对撞
cues.pinyin: shuo1 liang3 liang4 che1 yi3 60 gong1 li3 mei3 xiao3 shi2 de5 su4 du4 dui4 zhuang4
cues.en: whether two cars colliding head-on at 60 km/h

cues.zh: 到底相不相当于一辆车
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 xiang1 bu4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 yi1 liang4 che1
cues.en: is really equivalent to one car

cues.zh: 以 120 千米每小时的速度撞墙呢
cues.pinyin: yi3 120 qian1 mi3 mei3 xiao3 shi2 de5 su4 du4 zhuang4 qiang2 ne5
cues.en: hitting a wall at 120 km/h.

cues.zh: 我看了网上一些人的解释既不
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 wang3 shang4 yi1 xie1 ren2 de5 jie3 shi4 ji4 bu4
cues.en: I've seen some explanations online that are neither

cues.zh: 准确也不全面
cues.pinyin: zhun3 que4 ye3 bu4 quan2 mian4
cues.en: accurate nor complete.

cues.zh: 那今天我就想通过一个视频
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: So today I want to use a video

cues.zh: 来把这个问题彻底讲清楚
cues.pinyin: lai2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 che4 di3 jiang3 qing1 chu3
cues.en: to explain this problem thoroughly.

cues.zh: 首先我们先说要想研究这个撞击效果
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 shuo1 yao4 xiang3 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 zhuang4 ji1 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: First, to study the effect of a collision,

cues.zh: 我们得讨论撞击过程中的撞击力
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de2 tao3 lun4 zhuang4 ji1 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 de5 zhuang4 ji1 li4
cues.en: we need to discuss the impact force during the collision.

cues.zh: 我看很多人使用能量动能来计算这个效果
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 hen3 duo1 ren2 shi3 yong4 neng2 liang4 dong4 neng2 lai2 ji4 suan4 zhe4 ge5 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: I've seen many people use energy/kinetic energy to calculate this effect,

cues.zh: 其实这个不准确
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhe4 ge5 bu4 zhun3 que4
cues.en: but that's actually not accurate.

cues.zh: 咱们想象一下
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xiang3 xiang4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's imagine this:

cues.zh: 假如一个人从高处跳下来的话
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 yi2 ge4 ren2 cong2 gao1 chu4 tiao4 xia4 lai2 de5 hua4
cues.en: if a person jumps down from a height,

cues.zh: 那么不管地面是水泥地还是气垫
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 bu4 guan3 di4 mian4 shi4 shui3 ni2 di4 hai2 shi4 qi4 dian4
cues.en: then whether the ground is concrete or an air cushion,

cues.zh: 它的动能其实都一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 dong4 neng2 qi2 shi2 dou1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: the kinetic energy is actually the same.

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 它动能都是一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 dong4 neng2 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: The kinetic energy is the same either way.

cues.zh: 落地的时候速度都是一样的
cues.pinyin: luo4 di4 de5 shi2 hou4 su4 du4 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: The landing speed is also the same.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】两辆车60km/h对撞，和一辆车120km/h撞墙，效果一样吗？

cues.zh: 但是那么为什么撞到水泥地的时候就死了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 na4 me5 wei4 shen2 me5 zhuang4 dao4 shui3 ni2 di4 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 si3 le5
cues.en: So then why does hitting concrete kill you,

cues.zh: 你要是撞到气垫就没事呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 zhuang4 dao4 qi4 dian4 jiu4 mei2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: while hitting an air cushion leaves you fine?

cues.zh: 这个原因是因为它们的撞击力不一样
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yuan2 yin1 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 de5 zhuang4 ji1 li4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: The reason is that the impact forces are different.

cues.zh: 所以我们要讨论撞击效果
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 yao4 tao3 lun4 zhuang4 ji1 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: So when discussing collision effects,

cues.zh: 更应该去从力的角度讨论
cues.pinyin: geng4 ying1 gai1 qu4 cong2 li4 de5 jiao3 du4 tao3 lun4
cues.en: we should really discuss it from the perspective of force,

cues.zh: 而不应该从能的角度讨论
cues.pinyin: er2 bu4 ying1 gai1 cong2 neng2 de5 jiao3 du4 tao3 lun4
cues.en: not from the perspective of energy.

cues.zh: 那么这个撞击力具体有多大呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 zhuang4 ji1 li4 ju4 ti3 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: So exactly how large is this impact force?

cues.zh: 咱们说假设有这么一辆汽车
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 shuo1 jia3 she4 you3 zhe4 me5 yi1 liang4 qi4 che1
cues.en: Let's say we have a car,

cues.zh: 这个汽车它的长度是 L
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qi4 che1 ta1 de5 chang2 du4 shi4 L
cues.en: whose length is L,

cues.zh: 然后它撞击了一个墙
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 zhuang4 ji1 le5 yi2 ge4 qiang2
cues.en: and it crashes into a wall.

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 汽车的质量是 M
cues.pinyin: qi4 che1 de5 zhi4 liang4 shi4 M
cues.en: The car's mass is M,

cues.zh: 速度是 V
cues.pinyin: su4 du4 shi4 V
cues.en: and its speed is V.

cues.zh: 我们想求这个汽车它的撞击力有多大
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xiang3 qiu2 zhe4 ge5 qi4 che1 ta1 de5 zhuang4 ji1 li4 you3 duo1 da4
cues.en: We want to find how large the car's impact force is.

cues.zh: 怎么求呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 qiu2 ne5
cues.en: How do we find it?

cues.zh: 那我们首先得计算一个概念
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 de2 ji4 suan4 yi2 ge4 gai4 nian4
cues.en: First we need to compute a concept

cues.zh: 叫做这个汽车的动量的变化
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 qi4 che1 de5 dong4 liang4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: called the change in the car's momentum.

cues.zh: 这个动量这个概念
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dong4 liang4 zhe4 ge5 gai4 nian4
cues.en: This concept of momentum

cues.zh: 是我们在上高中的时候学的一个概念
cues.pinyin: shi4 wo3 men5 zai4 shang4 gao1 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4 xue2 de5 yi2 ge4 gai4 nian4
cues.en: is something we learned in high school.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】两辆车60km/h对撞，和一辆车120km/h撞墙，效果一样吗？

cues.zh: 它形变的长度或者说吸能的长度就是 L
cues.pinyin: ta1 xing2 bian4 de5 chang2 du4 huo4 zhe3 shuo1 xi1 neng2 de5 chang2 du4 jiu4 shi4 L
cues.en: The length over which it deforms, or absorbs energy, is L.

cues.zh: 这个 L 应该比车长更小一点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 L ying1 gai1 bi3 che1 zhang3 geng4 xiao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: This L should be a bit smaller than the car's length.

cues.zh: 那么它的速度最大值就是 V
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 su4 du4 zui4 da4 zhi2 jiu4 shi4 V
cues.en: The maximum speed is V.

cues.zh: 所以有人说了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you3 ren2 shuo1 le5
cues.en: So some people say,

cues.zh: 那么这个撞击的时间就应该是用 L 除以 V
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 zhuang4 ji1 de5 shi2 jian1 jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi4 yong4 L chu2 yi3 V
cues.en: then the collision time should just be L divided by V.

cues.zh: 这个不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bu2 dui4
cues.en: That's wrong.

cues.zh: 大家想想为啥不对
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 xiang3 xiang3 wei4 sha2 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Think about why it's wrong.

cues.zh: 因为汽车撞强的之前它的速度是 V
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 qi4 che1 zhuang4 qiang2 de5 zhi1 qian2 ta1 de5 su4 du4 shi4 V
cues.en: Because before the car hits the wall, its speed is V,

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 撞完了墙之后速度是 0
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 wan2 le5 qiang2 zhi1 hou4 su4 du4 shi4 0
cues.en: and after hitting the wall, its speed is 0.

cues.zh: 它撞墙的过程中速度是越来越小的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhuang4 qiang2 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 su4 du4 shi4 yue4 lai2 yue4 xiao3 de5
cues.en: During the collision with the wall, the speed keeps decreasing.

cues.zh: 那么如果你用这个吸能的长度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 ni3 yong4 zhe4 ge5 xi1 neng2 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: So if you take this energy-absorbing length

cues.zh: 去除以撞击过程中的最初速度
cues.pinyin: qu4 chu2 yi3 zhuang4 ji1 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 de5 zui4 chu1 su4 du4
cues.en: and divide it by the initial speed of the collision,

cues.zh: 那是不是不合理
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 bu2 shi4 bu4 he2 li3
cues.en: isn't that unreasonable?

cues.zh: 因为它是减速的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 jian3 su4 de5
cues.en: Because it's decelerating.

cues.zh: 你应该除以什么速度
cues.pinyin: ni3 ying1 gai1 chu2 yi3 shen2 me5 su4 du4
cues.en: What speed should you divide by instead?

cues.zh: 你应该除以平均速度
cues.pinyin: ni3 ying1 gai1 chu2 yi3 ping2 jun1 su4 du4
cues.en: You should divide by the average speed.

cues.zh: 那么平均速度是多少
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ping2 jun1 su4 du4 shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: So what's the average speed?

cues.zh: 我们又不好估计
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 bu4 hao3 gu1 ji4
cues.en: That's hard to estimate directly.

cues.zh: 只能采用一种粗略的想法
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 cai3 yong4 yi1 zhong3 cu1 lve4 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: We can only use a rough approach.

cues.zh: 假设这辆车撞强的过程
cues.pinyin: jia3 she4 zhe4 liang4 che1 zhuang4 qiang2 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: Assume that the process of this car hitting the wall

cues.zh: 是均匀减速的
cues.pinyin: shi4 jun1 yun2 jian3 su4 de5
cues.en: is uniform deceleration,

cues.zh: 是匀减速的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yun2 jian3 su4 de5
cues.en: that is, constant deceleration.

cues.zh: 那么你的平均速度从 V 减到 0
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 de5 ping2 jun1 su4 du4 cong2 V jian3 dao4 0
cues.en: Then your speed decreases uniformly from V to 0,

cues.zh: 平均速度就是 2 分之 V
cues.pinyin: ping2 jun1 su4 du4 jiu4 shi4 2 fen1 zhi1 V
cues.en: so the average speed is V divided by 2.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】两辆车60km/h对撞，和一辆车120km/h撞墙，效果一样吗？

cues.zh: 发生变化的时间是 2 l 除以 v
cues.pinyin: fa1 sheng1 bian4 hua4 de5 shi2 jian1 shi4 2 l chu2 yi3 v
cues.en: The time over which this change happens is 2L divided by V.

cues.zh: 我们在分子分母同时乘个 v
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fen4 zi3 fen1 mu3 tong2 shi2 cheng2 ge4 v
cues.en: If we multiply both numerator and denominator by V,

cues.zh: 那么它就等于 M V 方再除以 2 L
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 jiu4 deng3 yu2 M V fang1 zai4 chu2 yi3 2 L
cues.en: then it equals M times V squared, divided by 2L.

cues.zh: 好这个就是我们算出来的撞击力了
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 suan4 chu1 lai2 de5 zhuang4 ji1 li4 le5
cues.en: Okay, that's the impact force we've calculated.

cues.zh: 这个撞击力等于什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhuang4 ji1 li4 deng3 yu2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What does this impact force equal?

cues.zh: 等于汽车的质量再乘以汽车速度的平方
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 qi4 che1 de5 zhi4 liang4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 qi4 che1 su4 du4 de5 ping2 fang1
cues.en: It equals the car's mass times the square of its speed,

cues.zh: 再除以 2 倍的吸能距离
cues.pinyin: zai4 chu2 yi3 2 bei4 de5 xi1 neng2 ju4 li2
cues.en: divided by twice the energy-absorbing distance.

cues.zh: 吸能距离可能比车长小一点
cues.pinyin: xi1 neng2 ju4 li2 ke3 neng2 bi3 che1 zhang3 xiao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: The energy-absorbing distance may be a bit less than the car's length.

cues.zh: 是不是
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 好这个就是力了
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 li4 le5
cues.en: Okay, that's the force.

cues.zh: 那么为什么一辆汽车撞击的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 shen2 me5 yi1 liang4 qi4 che1 zhuang4 ji1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: So why, when a car crashes,

cues.zh: 它那个力量那么大呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 na4 ge5 li4 liang4 na4 me5 da4 ne5
cues.en: is that force so large?

cues.zh: 咱们给算算
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 gei3 suan4 suan4
cues.en: Let's calculate it.

cues.zh: 比如说我们以一辆汽车质量是 1 5 吨为例
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 yi3 yi1 liang4 qi4 che1 zhi4 liang4 shi4 1 5 dun1 wei4 li4
cues.en: For example, let's take a car with a mass of 1.5 tons.

cues.zh: 这个速度是 60 千米每小时
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 su4 du4 shi4 60 qian1 mi3 mei3 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: Its speed is 60 km/h,

cues.zh: 也就大约是 16 7 米每秒
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 da4 yue1 shi4 16 7 mi3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: which is about 16.7 meters per second,

items.title_zh: 她打造100㎡复古老公寓，像活在上世纪的爵士年代 She Decorated a Old Apartment, Living Like the Jazz Age

cues.zh: 我是 L ola 去年夏天我结束了一段十几
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 L ola qu4 nian2 xia4 tian1 wo3 jie2 shu4 le5 yi1 duan4 shi2 ji3
cues.en: I'm Lola. Last summer I ended a dozen-plus

cues.zh: 年的家庭生活
cues.pinyin: nian2 de5 jia1 ting2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: years of married/family life.

cues.zh: 开始了自己的独居生活
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 du2 ju1 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: I started living alone.

cues.zh: 这个房子其实它是 19 29 年建造的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 qi2 shi2 ta1 shi4 19 29 nian2 jian4 zao4 de5
cues.en: This apartment was actually built in 1929.

cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 kan4 dao4 zhe4 tao4 fang2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I first saw this place,

cues.zh: 我就是一见钟情
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 yi1 jian4 zhong1 qing2
cues.en: it was love at first sight.

cues.zh: 大概有一百出头原始就是一室一厅的结构
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 you3 yi4 bai3 chu1 tou2 yuan2 shi3 jiu4 shi4 yi1 shi4 yi1 ting1 de5 jie2 gou4
cues.en: It's a bit over 100 square meters, originally a one-bedroom-one-living-room layout.

cues.zh: 被之前租客改成了那种

cues.en: A previous tenant had changed it into

cues.zh: 有点像德国乡村风格的那种大木条

cues.en: something like a German countryside style with big wooden beams.

cues.zh: 我看了一些之前的老照片
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 yi1 xie1 zhi1 qian2 de5 lao3 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: I looked at some old photos from before

cues.zh: 还原了它的本来的风貌
cues.pinyin: huan2 yuan2 le5 ta1 de5 ben3 lai2 de5 feng1 mao4
cues.en: and restored it to its original look.

cues.zh: 最特别的就是把这个拱门还原
cues.pinyin: zui4 te4 bie2 de5 jiu4 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 gong3 men2 huan2 yuan2
cues.en: The most special part was restoring this archway.

cues.pinyin: fu4 yuan2 le5 ta1 de5 er3 dai4 kou4 de5 xian4 tiao2
cues.en: I restored the molding lines from that era.

cues.zh: 厨房白色的橱柜和石木的桌面
cues.pinyin: chu2 fang2 bai2 se4 de5 chu2 gui4 he2 shi2 mu4 de5 zhuo1 mian4
cues.en: The kitchen's white cabinets and stone-and-wood countertop—
