cues.zh: 终于让政府开始头疼起来
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 rang4 zheng4 fu3 kai1 shi3 tou2 teng2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: This finally started giving the government a headache.

cues.zh: 所以 F BI 也开始关注这个组织
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 F BI ye3 kai1 shi3 guan1 zhu4 zhe4 ge5 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: So the FBI also began paying attention to this organization,

cues.zh: 试图找到他们的老巢
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 zhao3 dao4 ta1 men5 de5 lao3 chao2
cues.en: trying to find their hideout

cues.zh: 将其一网打尽
cues.pinyin: jiang1 qi2 yi1 wang3 da3 jin4
cues.en: and wipe them out completely.

cues.zh: 酒吧里的人们也在窃窃私语
cues.pinyin: jiu3 ba1 li3 de5 ren2 men5 ye3 zai4 qie4 qie4 si1 yu3
cues.en: People in the bar were also whispering,

cues.zh: 聊着新闻里说的事情
cues.pinyin: liao2 zhe5 xin1 wen2 li3 shuo1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: talking about what was on the news.

cues.zh: 突然一个白胡子老头主动来找内侍
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 yi2 ge4 bai2 hu2 zi5 lao3 tou2 zhu3 dong4 lai2 zhao3 nei4 shi4
cues.en: Suddenly, a white-bearded old man approached him.

cues.zh: 想聊聊关于计划组织的事
cues.pinyin: xiang3 liao2 liao2 guan1 yu2 ji4 hua4 zu3 zhi1 de5 shi4
cues.en: He wanted to talk about the organization called 'the Project.'

cues.zh: 内侍好像没听到一样
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 hao3 xiang4 mei2 ting1 dao4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: He acted as if he hadn't heard,

cues.zh: 完全没搭理老头
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 mei2 da1 li3 lao3 tou2
cues.en: completely ignoring the old man.

cues.zh: 可老白直接说出了内侍以前曾经当过兵
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 bai2 zhi2 jie1 shuo1 chu1 le5 nei4 shi4 yi3 qian2 ceng2 jing1 dang1 guo4 bing1
cues.en: But Old Bai bluntly said he knew he used to be a soldier,

cues.zh: 还加入了计划
cues.pinyin: hai2 jia1 ru4 le5 ji4 hua4
cues.en: and had also joined the Project.

cues.zh: 甚至跟首领老黑关系不错
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 gen1 shou3 ling3 lao3 hei1 guan1 xi4 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: He even had a good relationship with the leader, Old Hei.

cues.zh: 内侍震惊了
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 zhen4 jing1 le5
cues.en: He was stunned.

cues.zh: 原来老白是中情局的人
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 lao3 bai2 shi4 zhong1 qing2 ju2 de5 ren2
cues.en: It turned out Old Bai worked for the CIA.

cues.zh: 这次他来找内侍
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 ta1 lai2 zhao3 nei4 shi4
cues.en: This time he came to find him

cues.zh: 就是知道他是从计划里逃出来的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 shi4 cong2 ji4 hua4 li3 tao2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: because he knew he had escaped from the Project.

cues.zh: 希望他能帮助政府消灭这个组织
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ta1 neng2 bang1 zhu4 zheng4 fu3 xiao1 mie4 zhe4 ge5 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: He hoped he could help the government take down the organization.

cues.zh: 那时没同意跟老白合作
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 mei2 tong2 yi4 gen1 lao3 bai2 he2 zuo4
cues.en: He didn't agree to work with Old Bai.

cues.zh: 可晚上回到家
cues.pinyin: ke3 wan3 shang4 hui2 dao4 jia1
cues.en: But that night, back home,

cues.zh: 老白的话勾起了那时不愿回想的过往
cues.pinyin: lao3 bai2 de5 hua4 gou1 qi3 le5 na4 shi2 bu4 yuan4 hui2 xiang3 de5 guo4 wang3
cues.en: Old Bai's words stirred up a past he didn't want to remember.

cues.zh: 他又梦到了那些让他欢乐也让
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 meng4 dao4 le5 na4 xie1 rang4 ta1 huan1 le4 ye3 rang4
cues.en: He dreamed again of the times that had brought him both joy

cues.zh: 他痛苦的曾经
cues.pinyin: ta1 tong4 ku3 de5 ceng2 jing1
cues.en: and pain.

cues.zh: 那时确实加入过计划
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 que4 shi2 jia1 ru4 guo4 ji4 hua4
cues.en: He really had joined the Project.

cues.zh: 计划里的人都尊称老黑为神者
cues.pinyin: ji4 hua4 li3 de5 ren2 dou1 zun1 cheng1 lao3 hei1 wei4 shen2 zhe3
cues.en: Everyone in the Project respectfully called Old Hei 'the Prophet.'

cues.zh: 就好像宗教信徒信奉上帝一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hao3 xiang4 zong1 jiao4 xin4 tu2 xin4 feng4 shang4 di4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Just like religious believers worshipping God.

cues.zh: 这个计划里的人也都十分信赖老黑
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ji4 hua4 li3 de5 ren2 ye3 dou1 shi2 fen1 xin4 lai4 lao3 hei1
cues.en: Everyone in the Project trusted Old Hei completely.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新动作惊悚片！退伍老兵为爱干翻邪恶组织！奥斯卡2大影帝同台飙戏

cues.zh: 为了自己和爱人的幸福
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 zi4 ji3 he2 ai4 ren2 de5 xing4 fu2
cues.en: For his and his love's happiness,

cues.zh: 内侍去找老黑
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 qu4 zhao3 lao3 hei1
cues.en: he went to see Old Hei,

cues.zh: 希望她可以同意自己跟小丽在一起
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ta1 ke3 yi3 tong2 yi4 zi4 ji3 gen1 xiao3 li4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: hoping he'd agree to let him be with Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 可老黑却说内侍身上有伟大的前置
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 hei1 que4 shuo1 nei4 shi4 shen1 shang4 you3 wei3 da4 de5 qian2 zhi4
cues.en: But Old Hei said he had great potential,

cues.zh: 如果只想着老婆孩子热炕头就太可惜了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhi3 xiang3 zhe5 lao3 po2 hai2 zi5 re4 kang4 tou2 jiu4 tai4 ke3 xi1 le5
cues.en: and it would be a waste to just settle down with a wife and kids.

cues.zh: 他要那时加入自己的特别计划
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 na4 shi2 jia1 ru4 zi4 ji3 de5 te4 bie2 ji4 hua4
cues.en: He wanted him to join his special plan.

cues.zh: 只有这样才能让那时实现人生价值
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 zhe4 yang4 cai2 neng2 rang4 na4 shi2 shi2 xian4 ren2 sheng1 jia4 zhi2
cues.en: Only that way, he said, could he realize his true value in life.

cues.zh: 现在老黑给了那时两条路
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 lao3 hei1 gei3 le5 na4 shi2 liang3 tiao2 lu4
cues.en: Now Old Hei gave him two paths:

cues.zh: 恋爱结婚的路很容易
cues.pinyin: lian4 ai4 jie2 hun1 de5 lu4 hen3 rong2 yi4
cues.en: the path of love and marriage was easy,

cues.zh: 但路路无为一生
cues.pinyin: dan4 lu4 lu4 wu2 wei2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: but it meant living an unremarkable life;

cues.zh: 跟自己干大事这条路很艰难
cues.pinyin: gen1 zi4 ji3 gan4 da4 shi4 zhe4 tiao2 lu4 hen3 jian1 nan2
cues.en: the path of doing great things with him was hard,

cues.zh: 但可以功成名就
cues.pinyin: dan4 ke3 yi3 gong1 cheng2 ming2 jiu4
cues.en: but it could bring fame and success.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新动作惊悚片！退伍老兵为爱干翻邪恶组织！奥斯卡2大影帝同台飙戏

cues.zh: 可是那时知道这难度太大
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 shi2 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 nan2 du4 tai4 da4
cues.en: But he knew the difficulty was too great.

cues.zh: 老黑周围有很多对他死忠的手下
cues.pinyin: lao3 hei1 zhou1 wei2 you3 hen3 duo1 dui4 ta1 si3 zhong1 de5 shou3 xia4
cues.en: Old Hei had many die-hard loyal followers around him,

cues.zh: 仅凭两人之力根本无法推翻老黑的统治
cues.pinyin: jin3 ping2 liang3 ren2 zhi1 li4 gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 tui1 fan1 lao3 hei1 de5 tong3 zhi4
cues.en: and the two of them alone could never overthrow his rule.

cues.zh: 最好的做法就是两人一起逃离这里
cues.pinyin: zui4 hao3 de5 zuo4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 liang3 ren2 yi4 qi3 tao2 li2 zhe4 li3
cues.en: The best option was for the two of them to escape together.

cues.zh: 可小丽有点不甘心
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 li4 you3 dian3 bu4 gan1 xin1
cues.en: But Xiao Li was reluctant.

cues.zh: 这里是他们的家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 shi4 ta1 men5 de5 jia1
cues.en: This was their home.

cues.zh: 他离开不就没家了吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 li2 kai1 bu4 jiu4 mei2 jia1 le5 ma5
cues.en: Wouldn't leaving mean losing it?

cues.zh: 于是在一个月黑风高的夜晚
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zai4 yi2 ge4 yue4 hei1 feng1 gao1 de5 ye4 wan3
cues.en: So on a dark, windy night,

cues.zh: 两人开着车敲咪咪地逃了
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 kai1 zhe5 che1 qiao1 mi1 mi1 di4 tao2 le5
cues.en: the two of them quietly drove off and fled.

cues.zh: 一切竟然非常顺利
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 jing4 ran2 fei1 chang2 shun4 li4
cues.en: Everything went surprisingly smoothly.

cues.zh: 没人拦截他们的车子
cues.pinyin: mei2 ren2 lan2 jie2 ta1 men5 de5 che1 zi5
cues.en: No one stopped their car.

cues.zh: 可就在他们觉得安全的时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 zai4 ta1 men5 jue2 de5 an1 quan2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But just when they felt safe,

cues.zh: 突然后面车灯亮起
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 hou4 mian4 che1 deng1 liang4 qi3
cues.en: headlights suddenly lit up behind them.

cues.zh: 追兵追来了
cues.pinyin: zhui1 bing1 zhui1 lai2 le5
cues.en: Pursuers had caught up to them.

cues.zh: 车子最后掉到水里
cues.pinyin: che1 zi5 zui4 hou4 diao4 dao4 shui3 li3
cues.en: In the end, the car plunged into the water.

cues.zh: 内侍昏迷了两天
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 hun1 mi2 le5 liang3 tian1
cues.en: He was unconscious for two days.

cues.zh: 等他醒了以后
cues.pinyin: deng3 ta1 xing3 le5 yi3 hou4
cues.en: When he woke up,

cues.zh: 警察说小丽死了
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 shuo1 xiao3 li4 si3 le5
cues.en: the police told him Xiao Li was dead.

cues.zh: 他们把尸体送回组织了
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ba3 shi1 ti3 song4 hui2 zu3 zhi1 le5
cues.en: They had sent the body back to the organization.

cues.zh: 一夜噩梦
cues.pinyin: yi1 ye4 e4 meng4
cues.en: It was a nightmare come true.

cues.zh: 第二天一早
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 zao3
cues.en: Early the next morning,

cues.zh: 内侍就去找了心理医生
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 jiu4 qu4 zhao3 le5 xin1 li3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: he went to see a therapist.

cues.zh: 医生说内侍在之前的战争里
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 shuo1 nei4 shi4 zai4 zhi1 qian2 de5 zhan4 zheng1 li3
cues.en: The doctor said that during the war before,

cues.zh: 就经历了很多伤害
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jing1 li4 le5 hen3 duo1 shang1 hai4
cues.en: he had already suffered a lot of trauma,

cues.zh: 而妻子的死带给他的伤害更大
cues.pinyin: er2 qi1 zi3 de5 si3 dai4 gei3 ta1 de5 shang1 hai4 geng4 da4
cues.en: and his wife's death had hurt him even more,

cues.zh: 让他的病情更严重了
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 de5 bing4 qing2 geng4 yan2 zhong4 le5
cues.en: making his condition worse,

cues.zh: 所以才会不断做噩梦
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 hui4 bu4 duan4 zuo4 e4 meng4
cues.en: which was why he kept having nightmares.

cues.zh: 刚离开诊所
cues.pinyin: gang1 li2 kai1 zhen3 suo3
cues.en: Just as he left the clinic,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新动作惊悚片！退伍老兵为爱干翻邪恶组织！奥斯卡2大影帝同台飙戏

cues.zh: 女孩还说这信是苏基妈妈让她交给那时的
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 hai2 shuo1 zhe4 xin4 shi4 su1 ji1 ma1 ma1 rang4 ta1 jiao1 gei3 na4 shi2 de5
cues.en: a girl told him that Sukie's mother had asked her to give him this letter.

cues.zh: 难道小丽真的活着
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 xiao3 li4 zhen1 de5 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: Could Xiao Li really still be alive?

cues.zh: 现在唯一的办法就是回组织看看
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wei2 yi1 de5 ban4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 hui2 zu3 zhi1 kan4 kan4
cues.en: Now the only way to know was to go back to the organization and check,

cues.zh: 确认爱人的死活
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 ai4 ren2 de5 si3 huo2
cues.en: to confirm whether his love was alive or dead.

cues.zh: 于是那时找到老白
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 na4 shi2 zhao3 dao4 lao3 bai2
cues.en: So he went to find Old Bai

cues.zh: 同意跟他们合作
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 gen1 ta1 men5 he2 zuo4
cues.en: and agreed to cooperate with them.

cues.zh: 这是她救小丽的唯一机会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ta1 jiu4 xiao3 li4 de5 wei2 yi1 ji1 hui4
cues.en: This was his only chance to save Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 老白为那时找了几个强力队友
cues.pinyin: lao3 bai2 wei4 na4 shi2 zhao3 le5 ji3 ge4 qiang2 li4 dui4 you3
cues.en: Old Bai found him a few powerful teammates

cues.zh: 配合她的行动
cues.pinyin: pei4 he2 ta1 de5 xing2 dong4
cues.en: to support the mission.

cues.zh: F BI 已经集合全部力量准备突
cues.pinyin: F BI yi3 jing1 ji2 he2 quan2 bu4 li4 liang4 zhun3 bei4 tu1
cues.en: The FBI had already gathered all its forces, ready to

cues.zh: 袭组织老巢了
cues.pinyin: xi2 zu3 zhi1 lao3 chao2 le5
cues.en: raid the organization's hideout.

cues.zh: 可老白觉得只要砍掉脑袋那身体就会死去
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 bai2 jue2 de5 zhi3 yao4 kan3 diao4 nao3 dai4 na4 shen1 ti3 jiu4 hui4 si3 qu4
cues.en: But Old Bai believed that cutting off the head would kill the whole body,

cues.zh: 所以他希望内侍可以带着这支突击小队
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xi1 wang4 nei4 shi4 ke3 yi3 dai4 zhe5 zhe4 zhi1 tu1 ji1 xiao3 dui4
cues.en: so he hoped he could lead this strike team

cues.zh: 在 F BI 进攻之前潜入组织内部抓住老黑
cues.pinyin: zai4 F BI jin4 gong1 zhi1 qian2 qian2 ru4 zu3 zhi1 nei4 bu4 zhua1 zhu4 lao3 hei1
cues.en: to sneak in and capture Old Hei before the FBI attacked,

cues.zh: 救出小力
cues.pinyin: jiu4 chu1 xiao3 li4
cues.en: and rescue Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 要不然他们都会落入 F BI 的手里
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 ta1 men5 du1 hui4 luo4 ru4 F BI de5 shou3 li3
cues.en: Otherwise, they'd all end up in the FBI's hands.

cues.zh: 一行人最后在内侍的带领下
cues.pinyin: yi1 xing2 ren2 zui4 hou4 zai4 nei4 shi4 de5 dai4 ling3 xia4
cues.en: In the end, led by him,

cues.zh: 他们只给了内侍一行人 48 小时
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi3 gei3 le5 nei4 shi4 yi1 xing2 ren2 48 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: the group flew by helicopter near the organization's hideout.

cues.zh: 内侍内心十分复杂
cues.pinyin: nei4 shi4 nei4 xin1 shi2 fen1 fu4 za2
cues.en: He felt deeply conflicted inside.

cues.zh: 他原以为自己永远都不会再回来的
cues.pinyin: ta1 yuan2 yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 yong3 yuan3 dou1 bu2 hui4 zai4 hui2 lai2 de5
cues.en: He had thought he'd never come back here again.

cues.zh: 他们先见到了 F BI 的指挥官
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xian1 jian4 dao4 le5 F BI de5 zhi3 hui1 guan1
cues.en: They first met with the FBI commander.

cues.zh: 此时 F BI 已经将这里包围好几天了
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 F BI yi3 jing1 jiang1 zhe4 li3 bao1 wei2 hao3 ji3 tian1 le5
cues.en: By then, the FBI had already surrounded the place for several days.

cues.zh: 看到内侍一行人的到来
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 nei4 shi4 yi1 xing2 ren2 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: Seeing him and his group arrive,

cues.zh: F BI 嗤之以鼻
cues.pinyin: F BI chi1 zhi1 yi3 bi2
cues.en: the FBI scoffed at them.

cues.zh: 他们只给了内侍一行人 48 小时
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi3 gei3 le5 nei4 shi4 yi1 xing2 ren2 48 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: They only gave him and his team 48 hours.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新动作惊悚片！退伍老兵为爱干翻邪恶组织！奥斯卡2大影帝同台飙戏

cues.zh: 可是话刚说一半
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 hua4 gang1 shuo1 yi2 ban4
cues.en: But before he could finish speaking,

cues.zh: 剧烈的震动打断了那时
cues.pinyin: ju4 lie4 de5 zhen4 dong4 da3 duan4 le5 na4 shi2
cues.en: a violent tremor interrupted him.

cues.zh: 那时最终没问出口
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 zui4 zhong1 mei2 wen4 chu1 kou3
cues.en: In the end, he never got to ask.

cues.zh: 只是告诉了母女如何逃出去不被 F BI 发现
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 gao4 su4 le5 mu3 nv3 ru2 he2 tao2 chu1 qu4 bu4 bei4 F BI fa1 xian4
cues.en: He only told the mother and daughter how to escape without being spotted by the FBI.

cues.zh: 原来此时 F BI 已经开始跟计划组织交火了
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ci3 shi2 F BI yi3 jing1 kai1 shi3 gen1 ji4 hua4 zu3 zhi1 jiao1 huo3 le5
cues.en: It turned out the FBI had already opened fire on the Project.

cues.zh: 战火在前门点燃
cues.pinyin: zhan4 huo3 zai4 qian2 men2 dian3 ran2
cues.en: The battle erupted at the front gate.

cues.zh: 基地里警报声响起
cues.pinyin: ji1 di4 li3 jing3 bao4 sheng1 xiang3 qi3
cues.en: Alarms blared throughout the base.

cues.zh: 灯光忽明忽暗
cues.pinyin: deng1 guang1 hu1 ming2 hu1 an4
cues.en: The lights flickered on and off.

cues.zh: 除了必要的守卫
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 bi4 yao4 de5 shou3 wei4
cues.en: Except for essential guards,

cues.zh: 其他人都上了前线
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 ren2 dou1 shang4 le5 qian2 xian4
cues.en: everyone else headed to the front line.

cues.zh: 这时候内侍在走廊里抓到一个老熟人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 nei4 shi4 zai4 zou3 lang2 li3 zhua1 dao4 yi2 ge4 lao3 shu2 ren2
cues.en: At that moment, he ran into an old acquaintance in the hallway,

cues.zh: 是以前在组织里的同僚
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi3 qian2 zai4 zu3 zhi1 li3 de5 tong2 liao2
cues.en: a former colleague from the organization.

cues.zh: 阔别几年
cues.pinyin: kuo4 bie2 ji3 nian2
cues.en: After years apart,

cues.zh: 没想到再次重逢就冰龙相见
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 zai4 ci4 chong2 feng2 jiu4 bing1 long2 xiang1 jian4
cues.en: he never expected their reunion to be as enemies on the battlefield.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从180㎡搬到45㎡，三口之家越住越小，女儿却说现在最好 Moving from 180㎡ to 45㎡,  but The Daughter Loves th

cues.zh: 我们最早住在徐汇滨江 180 平的大房子里
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zui4 zao3 zhu4 zai4 xu2 hui4 bin1 jiang1 180 ping2 de5 da4 fang2 zi5 li3
cues.en: We originally lived in a big 180-square-meter house in Xuhui Riverside.

cues.zh: 东西越来越多
cues.pinyin: dong1 xi1 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: We accumulated more and more stuff.

cues.zh: 收拾起来越来越累
cues.pinyin: shou1 shi2 qi3 lai2 yue4 lai2 yue4 lei4
cues.en: Tidying up got more and more exhausting.

cues.zh: 所以就想住进小一点的房子
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 xiang3 zhu4 jin4 xiao3 yi4 dian3 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: So we wanted to move into a smaller place.

cues.zh: 挑战一下断舍离
cues.pinyin: tiao3 zhan4 yi1 xia4 duan4 she3 li2
cues.en: To give decluttering (minimalism) a try.

cues.zh: 最后选择了现在 45 平的小屋
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 xuan3 ze2 le5 xian4 zai4 45 ping2 de5 xiao3 wu1
cues.en: In the end we chose our current small 45-square-meter home.

cues.zh: 不仅够用而且还很好住
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 gou4 yong4 er2 qie3 hai2 hen3 hao3 zhu4
cues.en: It's not only big enough, it's also very comfortable to live in.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从180㎡搬到45㎡，三口之家越住越小，女儿却说现在最好 Moving from 180㎡ to 45㎡,  but The Daughter Loves th

cues.zh: 我们家是一家三口
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia1 shi4 yi1 jia1 san1 kou3
cues.en: There are three of us in my family.

cues.zh: 之前在上海呢住过挺多板块的
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 zai4 shang4 hai3 ne5 zhu4 guo4 ting3 duo1 ban3 kuai4 de5
cues.en: We'd lived in quite a few different areas of Shanghai before.

cues.zh: 搬过七八次家了
cues.pinyin: ban1 guo4 qi1 ba1 ci4 jia1 le5
cues.en: We'd moved seven or eight times.

cues.zh: 武康路特别是中心的环境
cues.pinyin: wu3 kang1 lu4 te4 bie2 shi4 zhong1 xin1 de5 huan2 jing4
cues.en: Wukang Road, especially its central location, is a great environment.

cues.zh: 住在这个地方也是会比较方便一些
cues.pinyin: zhu4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 ye3 shi4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 fang1 bian4 yi1 xie1
cues.en: Living here is also more convenient.

cues.zh: 去到哪里都很近
cues.pinyin: qu4 dao4 na3 li5 dou1 hen3 jin4
cues.en: Everywhere we need to go is nearby.

cues.zh: 认识甘船也很多年了
cues.pinyin: ren4 shi2 gan1 chuan2 ye3 hen3 duo1 nian2 le5
cues.en: I've known [the designer] for many years.

cues.zh: 希望这间小屋子可以由它来操刀
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 zhe4 jian1 xiao3 wu1 zi5 ke3 yi3 you2 ta1 lai2 cao1 dao1
cues.en: I hoped he could take charge of designing this little home.

cues.zh: 第一次来的时候
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The first time I came here,

cues.zh: 它就是像画了一个烟熏妆
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 xiang4 hua4 le5 yi2 ge4 yan1 xun1 zhuang1
cues.en: it had this dark, smoky look to it.

cues.zh: 特别小
cues.pinyin: te4 bie2 xiao3
cues.en: It was really small,

cues.zh: 非常的昏暗和杂乱
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 de5 hun1 an4 he2 za2 luan4
cues.en: and very dim and cluttered.

cues.zh: 80 年代的老工房
cues.pinyin: 80 nian2 dai4 de5 lao3 gong1 fang2
cues.en: An old 1980s worker-housing apartment.

cues.zh: 并没有经过非常精细化的计算和设计
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 jing1 guo4 fei1 chang2 jing1 xi4 hua4 de5 ji4 suan4 he2 she4 ji4
cues.en: It hadn't gone through very precise calculation or design.

cues.zh: 有很多留白可以给你去发挥的
cues.pinyin: you3 hen3 duo1 liu2 bai2 ke3 yi3 gei3 ni3 qu4 fa1 hui1 de5
cues.en: There was a lot of blank space left for you to work with.

cues.zh: 通过了一个后置玄关
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 le5 yi2 ge4 hou4 zhi4 xuan2 guan1
cues.en: Through a rear entryway,

cues.zh: 进行从入口和厨房区
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 cong2 ru4 kou3 he2 chu2 fang2 qu1
cues.en: moving from the entrance and kitchen area

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从180㎡搬到45㎡，三口之家越住越小，女儿却说现在最好 Moving from 180㎡ to 45㎡,  but The Daughter Loves th

cues.zh: 到客厅的过渡的暗示
cues.pinyin: dao4 ke4 ting1 de5 guo4 du4 de5 an4 shi4
cues.en: there's a hint of transition toward the living room.

cues.zh: 起居玄关的北侧
cues.pinyin: qi3 ju1 xuan2 guan1 de5 bei3 ce4
cues.en: On the north side of the entryway/living area,

cues.zh: 是我们设置的一个榻榻米的盒室
cues.pinyin: shi4 wo3 men5 she4 zhi4 de5 yi2 ge4 ta4 ta4 mi3 de5 he2 shi4
cues.en: we set up a tatami box room.

cues.zh: 女儿特别特别喜欢树屋
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 te4 bie2 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 shu4 wu1
cues.en: Our daughter especially loves treehouses.

cues.zh: 刚好就做了一个阁楼
cues.pinyin: gang1 hao3 jiu4 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 ge2 lou2
cues.en: So we ended up building a loft.

cues.zh: 希望能够融入一些街区的元素
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 neng2 gou4 rong2 ru4 yi1 xie1 jie1 qu1 de5 yuan2 su4
cues.en: We hoped to incorporate some neighborhood elements.

cues.zh: 选择拱拱和柱子表达
cues.pinyin: xuan3 ze2 gong3 gong3 he2 zhu4 zi5 biao3 da2
cues.en: We chose to express that through arches and columns.

cues.zh: 客厅和阳台之间
cues.pinyin: ke4 ting1 he2 yang2 tai2 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: Between the living room and the balcony,

cues.zh: 通过一个拱把这个窗洞给它打开
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 gong3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 chuang1 dong4 gei3 ta1 da3 kai1
cues.en: we used an arch to open up this window opening.

cues.zh: 矮柜高柜非常薄的
cues.pinyin: ai3 gui4 gao1 gui4 fei1 chang2 bao2 de5
cues.en: Low and tall cabinets, very thin,

cues.zh: 贴著墙的柜体
cues.pinyin: tie1 zhu4 qiang2 de5 gui4 ti3
cues.en: cabinets flush against the wall,

cues.zh: 柳安的实木多层板
cues.pinyin: liu3 an1 de5 shi2 mu4 duo1 ceng2 ban3
cues.en: made of lauan solid-wood plywood,

cues.zh: 做大量的家俱
cues.pinyin: zuo4 da4 liang4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: to build a large amount of the furniture,

cues.zh: 塑造空间的同时
cues.pinyin: su4 zao4 kong1 jian1 de5 tong2 shi2
cues.en: while shaping the space,

cues.zh: 去解决收纳的问题
cues.pinyin: qu4 jie3 jue2 shou1 na4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and also solving the storage problem.

cues.zh: 娱乐的功能
cues.pinyin: yu2 le4 de5 gong1 neng2
cues.en: As for the entertainment function,

cues.zh: 可以转移到街区去进行的
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 jie1 qu1 qu4 jin4 xing2 de5
cues.en: it can be shifted out into the neighborhood instead.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从180㎡搬到45㎡，三口之家越住越小，女儿却说现在最好 Moving from 180㎡ to 45㎡,  but The Daughter Loves th

cues.zh: 缓慢的步行和遛弯
cues.pinyin: huan3 man4 de5 bu4 xing2 he2 liu2 wan1
cues.en: Slow walks and strolls,

cues.zh: 15 分钟的 500 米半径
cues.pinyin: 15 fen1 zhong1 de5 500 mi3 ban4 jing4
cues.en: within a 500-meter radius, about 15 minutes on foot,

cues.zh: 你可以发现很多街角绿地
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 fa1 xian4 hen3 duo1 jie1 jiao3 lv4 di4
cues.en: you can find lots of little street-corner green spaces,

cues.zh: 很接地气的街边小店
cues.pinyin: hen3 jie1 di4 qi4 de5 jie1 bian1 xiao3 dian4
cues.en: and very down-to-earth little street shops.

cues.zh: 出行的习惯
cues.pinyin: chu1 xing2 de5 xi2 guan4
cues.en: As for our travel habits,

cues.zh: 渐渐以后开车
cues.pinyin: jian4 jian4 yi3 hou4 kai1 che1
cues.en: gradually, from driving before,

cues.zh: 变成了骑共享单车
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 le5 qi2 gong4 xiang3 dan1 che1
cues.en: it changed to riding shared bikes.

cues.zh: 也会经常去散步
cues.pinyin: ye3 hui4 jing1 chang2 qu4 san4 bu4
cues.en: We also often go out for walks.

cues.zh: 女儿她还发明了一个小游戏
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 ta1 hai2 fa1 ming2 le5 yi2 ge4 xiao3 you2 xi4
cues.en: Our daughter even invented a little game.

cues.zh: 在每一个路口的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 mei3 yi2 ge4 lu4 kou3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: At every intersection,

cues.zh: 她就随意地说向左转或者向右转
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 sui2 yi4 di4 shuo1 xiang4 zuo3 zhuan3 huo4 zhe3 xiang4 you4 zhuan3
cues.en: she randomly says "turn left" or "turn right,"

cues.zh: 来探索这个街区
cues.pinyin: lai2 tan4 suo3 zhe4 ge5 jie1 qu1
cues.en: to explore the neighborhood.

cues.zh: 我平时的工作是做素食的菜品研发
cues.pinyin: wo3 ping2 shi2 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 zuo4 su4 shi2 de5 cai4 pin3 yan2 fa1
cues.en: My regular job is developing vegan dishes.

cues.zh: 需要经常购买一些特种的蔬菜
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 jing1 chang2 gou4 mai3 yi1 xie1 te4 zhong3 de5 shu1 cai4
cues.en: I often need to buy certain special vegetables.

cues.zh: 街区的一些非常小的杂货店里面
cues.pinyin: jie1 qu1 de5 yi1 xie1 fei1 chang2 xiao3 de5 za2 huo4 dian4 li3 mian4
cues.en: In some very small grocery stores around the neighborhood,

cues.zh: 全部都能够看到
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 dou1 neng2 gou4 kan4 dao4
cues.en: I can find everything I need.

cues.zh: 我对烹饪的需求会比较高
cues.pinyin: wo3 dui4 peng1 ren4 de5 xu1 qiu2 hui4 bi3 jiao4 gao1
cues.en: I have fairly high standards for cooking.

cues.zh: 所以厨房要有比较多的空间
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 chu2 fang2 yao4 you3 bi3 jiao4 duo1 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: So the kitchen needs to have a decent amount of space.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从180㎡搬到45㎡，三口之家越住越小，女儿却说现在最好 Moving from 180㎡ to 45㎡,  but The Daughter Loves th

cues.zh: 我选择纯素的生活
cues.pinyin: wo3 xuan3 ze2 chun2 su4 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: I've chosen a vegan lifestyle.

cues.zh: 还是有蛮多不是那么方便的地方
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 you3 man2 duo1 bu2 shi4 na4 me5 fang1 bian4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: There are still quite a few inconveniences.

cues.zh: 小朋友在成长的过程中
cues.pinyin: xiao3 peng2 you3 zai4 cheng2 zhang3 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: As kids grow up,

cues.zh: 一定会想要跟他的朋友一样
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 hui4 xiang3 yao4 gen1 ta1 de5 peng2 you3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: they'll definitely want to be like their friends

cues.zh: 可以吃到同样的东西
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 chi1 dao4 tong2 yang4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: and be able to eat the same things.

cues.zh: 我会尽量在家里面复制出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 jin3 liang4 zai4 jia1 li3 mian4 fu4 zhi4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: I try my best to recreate those dishes at home,

cues.zh: 同样的料理来满足他
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 de5 liao4 li3 lai2 man3 zu2 ta1
cues.en: the same food, to make her happy.

cues.zh: 其实很多朋友住的空间都比较宽敞
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hen3 duo1 peng2 you3 zhu4 de5 kong1 jian1 dou1 bi3 jiao4 kuan1 chang3
cues.en: Actually, a lot of my friends live in fairly spacious places.

cues.zh: 他们来了之后都很喜欢家里的氛围
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4 dou1 hen3 xi3 huan1 jia1 li3 de5 fen1 wei2
cues.en: After they visit, they really like the atmosphere of our home.

cues.zh: 并且很惊讶
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 hen3 jing1 ya4
cues.en: and are quite surprised

cues.zh: 这只是一个 45 坪的房子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 45 ping2 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: that this is only a 45-square-meter house.

cues.zh: 女儿的话呢
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: As for our daughter,

cues.zh: 说这是她住过的最好的一个空间
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 shi4 ta1 zhu4 guo4 de5 zui4 hao3 de5 yi2 ge4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: she says this is the best space she's ever lived in.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 清蒸鱼的家庭做法 | 中国农历新年快乐 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: Hello 你好我是 C issy
cues.pinyin: Hello ni3 hao3 wo3 shi4 C issy
cues.en: Hello, hi, I'm Cissy

cues.zh: 在这里呢我祝你新年快乐万事如意
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 ne5 wo3 zhu4 ni3 xin1 nian2 kuai4 le4 wan4 shi4 ru2 yi4
cues.en: Here I wish you a happy new year and that everything goes well

cues.zh: 今天带给你的是清蒸鱼
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 dai4 gei3 ni3 de5 shi4 qing1 zheng1 yu2
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you steamed fish

cues.zh: 首先我们这里有一磅半的红
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 bang4 ban4 de5 hong2
cues.en: First we have here a pound and a half of red

cues.zh: 鱼我已经给它清理干净然后给它擦干
cues.pinyin: yu2 wo3 yi3 jing1 gei3 ta1 qing1 li3 gan1 jing4 ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 ca1 gan4
cues.en: Snapper — I've already cleaned it and dried it off

cues.zh: 那我们就放少许的盐给它有一点底味
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jiu4 fang4 shao3 xu3 de5 yan2 gei3 ta1 you3 yi4 dian3 di3 wei4
cues.en: Then we add a little salt to give it some base flavor

cues.zh: 我们放三片姜还有一根葱在鱼肚子里
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 san1 pian4 jiang1 hai2 you3 yi1 gen1 cong1 zai4 yu2 du3 zi5 li3
cues.en: We put three slices of ginger and one scallion inside the fish's belly

cues.zh: 我们再放三片姜和一根葱在鱼身上
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 san1 pian4 jiang1 he2 yi1 gen1 cong1 zai4 yu2 shen1 shang4
cues.en: We put three more slices of ginger and one scallion on top of the fish

cues.zh: 接下来我们来做酱汁
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Next let's make the sauce

cues.zh: 那我们今天的食谱呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 shi2 pu3 ne5
cues.en: As for today's recipe

cues.zh: 其实只需要六汤匙的酱油就最多了
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhi3 xu1 yao4 liu4 tang1 chi2 de5 jiang4 you2 jiu4 zui4 duo1 le5
cues.en: Actually you only need at most six tablespoons of soy sauce

cues.zh: 那我多做一点呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 duo1 zuo4 yi4 dian3 ne5
cues.en: So I'll make a bit extra

cues.zh: 之后再使用
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 zai4 shi3 yong4
cues.en: To use later

cues.zh: 然后我们再放进来五片姜
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 wu3 pian4 jiang1
cues.en: Then we add five more slices of ginger

cues.zh: 一根葱
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1 cong1
cues.en: One scallion

cues.zh: 三瓣蒜
cues.pinyin: san1 ban4 suan4
cues.en: Three cloves of garlic

cues.zh: 一小把香菜
cues.pinyin: yi1 xiao3 ba3 xiang1 cai4
cues.en: A small handful of cilantro

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 清蒸鱼的家庭做法 | 中国农历新年快乐 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 然后呢我们最少给它泡制个 20 分钟左右
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 zui4 shao3 gei3 ta1 pao4 zhi4 ge4 20 fen1 zhong1 zuo3 you4
cues.en: Then we let it marinate for at least about 20 minutes

cues.zh: 我们现在呢先把蒸锅里面的水
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ne5 xian1 ba3 zheng1 guo1 li3 mian4 de5 shui3
cues.en: Now let's first take the water in the steamer

cues.zh: 给它煮到沸腾
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zhu3 dao4 fei4 teng2
cues.en: And bring it to a boil

cues.zh: 然后中间呢先放好这个盘子
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhong1 jian1 ne5 xian1 fang4 hao3 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5
cues.en: Then put the plate in the middle first

cues.zh: 如果这个盘子热的话呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5 re4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If this plate is hot

cues.zh: 我们的这个蒸鱼等一下熟的就比较快
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 zhe4 ge5 zheng1 yu2 deng3 yi2 xia4 shu2 de5 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 kuai4
cues.en: Our steamed fish will cook faster later

cues.zh: 好现在我们的水已经沸腾了
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 shui3 yi3 jing1 fei4 teng2 le5
cues.en: Okay, now our water has boiled

cues.zh: 我们把盖子打开
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 gai4 zi5 da3 kai1
cues.en: Let's open the lid

cues.zh: 现在呢我们放进来两根葱
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 gen1 cong1
cues.en: Now we add two scallions

cues.zh: 这样子的话呢把鱼放在上面
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 hua4 ne5 ba3 yu2 fang4 zai4 shang4 mian4
cues.en: This way, when we put the fish on top

cues.zh: 它的那个热度呢会流通的更好
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 na4 ge5 re4 du4 ne5 hui4 liu2 tong1 de5 geng4 hao3
cues.en: The heat will circulate better

cues.zh: 然后那个鱼呢也会吸收到这个
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na4 ge5 yu2 ne5 ye3 hui4 xi1 shou1 dao4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: And the fish will also absorb

cues.zh: 葱的香气更多
cues.pinyin: cong1 de5 xiang1 qi4 geng4 duo1
cues.en: More of the scallion's fragrance

cues.zh: 我们把鱼放进来用大火蒸
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 yu2 fang4 jin4 lai2 yong4 da4 huo3 zheng1
cues.en: We put the fish in and steam it on high heat

cues.zh: 给它蒸个 6 到 10 分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zheng1 ge4 6 dao4 10 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Steam it for 6 to 10 minutes

cues.zh: 那一放半的鱼呢大概 6 分钟就够了
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 fang4 ban4 de5 yu2 ne5 da4 gai4 6 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: For a pound-and-a-half fish, about 6 minutes is enough

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 清蒸鱼的家庭做法 | 中国农历新年快乐 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 我们小心翼翼把这个盘子里面的汤汁呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5 li3 mian4 de5 tang1 zhi1 ne5
cues.en: We carefully take the liquid in the plate

cues.zh: 给它倒掉
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 dao4 diao4
cues.en: And pour it out

cues.zh: 这个汤汁现在已经很腥了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tang1 zhi1 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 hen3 xing1 le5
cues.en: This liquid is now very fishy-smelling

cues.zh: 然后也取出这个姜还有葱
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 qu3 chu1 zhe4 ge5 jiang1 hai2 you3 cong1
cues.en: Then also remove the ginger and scallion

cues.zh: 我们在鱼的身上再放进来一汤匙的姜丝
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 yu2 de5 shen1 shang4 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 jiang1 si1
cues.en: On the fish we add another tablespoon of ginger shreds

cues.zh: 一汤匙葱丝
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 cong1 si1
cues.en: One tablespoon of scallion shreds

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 清蒸鱼的家庭做法 | 中国农历新年快乐 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: A little white pepper

cues.zh: 少许芝麻油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 zhi1 ma2 you2
cues.en: A little sesame oil

cues.zh: 在一个锅子里我们热三汤匙的油
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 zi5 li3 wo3 men5 re4 san1 tang1 chi2 de5 you2
cues.en: In a pan we heat three tablespoons of oil

cues.zh: 给它热到非常的烫
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 re4 dao4 fei1 chang2 de5 tang4
cues.en: Heat it until it's very hot

cues.zh: 然后小心翼的淋到这个鱼的身上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xiao3 xin1 yi4 de5 lin2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 yu2 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Then carefully drizzle it over the fish

cues.zh: 我们也把我们刚刚做好的酱油汁
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ye3 ba3 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 zuo4 hao3 de5 jiang4 you2 zhi1
cues.en: We also take the soy sauce mixture we just made

cues.zh: 淋到鱼的周围
cues.pinyin: lin2 dao4 yu2 de5 zhou1 wei2
cues.en: And drizzle it around the fish

cues.zh: 最好呢是不要直接淋到鱼的身上
cues.pinyin: zui4 hao3 ne5 shi4 bu2 yao4 zhi2 jie1 lin2 dao4 yu2 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: It's best not to pour it directly onto the fish

cues.zh: 否则这个鱼会变得过咸
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 zhe4 ge5 yu2 hui4 bian4 de2 guo4 xian2
cues.en: Otherwise the fish will become too salty

cues.zh: 鱼呢是过年必吃的一道菜
cues.pinyin: yu2 ne5 shi4 guo4 nian2 bi4 chi1 de5 yi1 dao4 cai4
cues.en: Fish is a dish you must eat during Chinese New Year

cues.zh: 其中一个原因当然就是年年有余啦
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 yuan2 yin1 dang1 ran2 jiu4 shi4 nian2 nian2 you3 yu2 la5
cues.en: One reason, of course, is the pun on 'surplus every year'

cues.zh: 那我记得每一年过年的时候呢

cues.zh: 的一本小册子

cues.zh: 在这本小册子的开篇

cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 tan2 dao4 le5 ou1 ji3 li3 de2 ji3 he2 xue2
cues.en: Einstein talked about Euclidean geometry

cues.zh: 公元前 300 年
cues.pinyin: gong1 yuan2 qian2 300 nian2

cues.zh: 古希腊数学家欧几里德写成了一本著作
cues.pinyin: gu3 xi1 la4 shu4 xue2 jia1 ou1 ji3 li3 de2 xie3 cheng2 le5 yi1 ben3 zhu4 zuo4

cues.zh: 几何原本
cues.pinyin: ji3 he2 yuan2 ben3

cues.zh: 在这本书里
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 li3
cues.en: In this book

cues.zh: 欧几里德抽象出了点线面的概念
cues.pinyin: ou1 ji3 li3 de2 chou1 xiang4 chu1 le5 dian3 xian4 mian4 de5 gai4 nian4

cues.zh: 并且提出了五个公设
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 ti2 chu1 le5 wu3 ge4 gong1 she4
cues.en: and proposed five postulates

cues.zh: 所谓公设就是用来当作前提的假设
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 gong1 she4 jiu4 shi4 yong4 lai2 dang4 zuo4 qian2 ti2 de5 jia3 she4
cues.en: A postulate is an assumption used as a premise

cues.zh: 欧几里德的五个公设是
cues.pinyin: ou1 ji3 li3 de2 de5 wu3 ge4 gong1 she4 shi4
cues.en: Euclid's five postulates are

cues.zh: 1 任意两点确定一条直线
cues.pinyin: 1 ren4 yi4 liang3 dian3 que4 ding4 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: 1. Any two points determine a straight line

cues.zh: 2 任意线段能够延长成一条直线
cues.pinyin: 2 ren4 yi4 xian4 duan4 neng2 gou4 yan2 chang2 cheng2 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: 2. Any line segment can be extended into a straight line

cues.zh: 3 以一点为圆心
cues.pinyin: 3 yi3 yi4 dian3 wei4 yuan2 xin1
cues.en: 3. With a point as center

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（二）时间和空间，其实都是牛顿的假设

cues.zh: 一个线段为半径可以做一个圆
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xian4 duan4 wei4 ban4 jing4 ke3 yi3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 yuan2
cues.en: and a segment as radius, a circle can be drawn

cues.zh: 4 所有直角都相等
cues.pinyin: 4 suo3 you3 zhi2 jiao3 dou1 xiang1 deng3
cues.en: 4. All right angles are equal

cues.zh: 5 过直线外一点
cues.pinyin: 5 guo4 zhi2 xian4 wai4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: 5. Given a point not on a line

cues.zh: 有切只有一条直线和一致直线平行
cues.pinyin: you3 qie4 zhi3 you3 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4 he2 yi2 zhi4 zhi2 xian4 ping2 xing2
cues.en: there is exactly one line through it parallel to that line

cues.zh: 从这五个公设出发
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 wu3 ge4 gong1 she4 chu1 fa1
cues.en: Starting from these five postulates

cues.zh: 经过严密的逻辑推理
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yan2 mi4 de5 luo2 ji2 tui1 li3
cues.en: through rigorous logical reasoning

cues.zh: 欧几里德就得到了许许多多的结论
cues.pinyin: ou1 ji3 li3 de2 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 xu3 xu3 duo1 duo1 de5 jie2 lun4
cues.en: Euclid arrived at many, many conclusions

cues.zh: 而这些结论就叫做定理
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 xie1 jie2 lun4 jiu4 jiao4 zuo4 ding4 li3
cues.en: and these conclusions are called theorems

cues.zh: 以公设为基础以定理为框架
cues.pinyin: yi3 gong1 she4 wei4 ji1 chu3 yi3 ding4 li3 wei4 kuang1 jia4
cues.en: With postulates as the foundation and theorems as the framework

cues.zh: 欧几里德构建了一座几何学大厦
cues.pinyin: ou1 ji3 li3 de2 gou4 jian4 le5 yi1 zuo4 ji3 he2 xue2 da4 sha4
cues.en: Euclid built an edifice of geometry

cues.zh: 这就是欧式几何
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ou1 shi4 ji3 he2
cues.en: This is Euclidean geometry

cues.zh: 欧几里德几何是真的吗
cues.pinyin: ou1 ji3 li3 de2 ji3 he2 shi4 zhen1 de5 ma5
cues.en: Is Euclidean geometry true?

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦说这个问题毫无意义
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 hao2 wu2 yi4 yi4
cues.en: Einstein said this question is meaningless

cues.zh: 因为这五个公设你不能证明也不能证伪
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 wu3 ge4 gong1 she4 ni3 bu4 neng2 zheng4 ming2 ye3 bu4 neng2 zheng4 wei3
cues.en: because you can't prove or disprove these five postulates

cues.zh: 根据这五个假设你才能得到后面的结论
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 wu3 ge4 jia3 she4 ni3 cai2 neng2 de2 dao4 hou4 mian4 de5 jie2 lun4
cues.en: You can only derive the later conclusions from these five assumptions

cues.zh: 但是你不能丢弃这些假设
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 bu4 neng2 diu1 qi4 zhe4 xie1 jia3 she4
cues.en: but you can't discard these assumptions

cues.zh: 否则几何学就会变得没有根基
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 ji3 he2 xue2 jiu4 hui4 bian4 de2 mei2 you3 gen1 ji1
cues.en: otherwise geometry would lose its foundation

cues.zh: 可是在不同的时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 bu4 tong2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But at different times

cues.zh: 我们的确需要使用不同的几何
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 que4 xu1 yao4 shi3 yong4 bu4 tong2 de5 ji3 he2
cues.en: we do need to use different geometries

cues.zh: 也就是说在任何惯性参考系中

cues.en: Newton's laws tell us

cues.pinyin: bu4 shou4 li4 de5 wu4 ti3 zong3 bao3 chi2 jing4 zhi3 huo4 yun4 su4 zhi2 xian4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: an object with no force acting on it stays at rest or moves in a straight line at constant speed

cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 que4 bu4 neng2 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 yun4 dong4 de5 su4
cues.en: but they can't tell us how fast

cues.zh: 度究竟有多大
cues.pinyin: du4 jiu1 jing4 you3 duo1 da4
cues.en: that motion actually is

cues.zh: 不过呀
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ya5
cues.en: However

cues.zh: 无论能否找到牛顿都假设绝对
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 neng2 fou3 zhao3 dao4 niu2 dun4 dou1 jia3 she4 jue2 dui4
cues.en: whether or not it could be found, Newton assumed absolute

cues.zh: 时空是存在的
cues.pinyin: shi2 kong1 shi4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: space and time exist

cues.zh: 而且如果一艘飞船相对于绝对空
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ru2 guo3 yi1 sou1 fei1 chuan2 xiang1 dui4 yu2 jue2 dui4 kong1
cues.en: And if a spaceship's speed relative to absolute space

cues.zh: 间的速度是 V
cues.pinyin: jian1 de5 su4 du4 shi4 V
cues.en: is V

cues.zh: 我们在飞船上相对于飞船以速度 U 运动
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fei1 chuan2 shang4 xiang4 dui4 yu2 fei1 chuan2 yi3 su4 du4 U yun4 dong4
cues.en: and we move relative to the spaceship at speed U

cues.zh: 那么我们相对于绝对时空
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 xiang1 dui4 yu2 jue2 dui4 shi2 kong1
cues.en: then relative to absolute space and time

cues.zh: 速度就一定是 V 加 U

cues.en: our speed must be V plus U

cues.zh: 这种简单的速度加减关系叫做伽利略变化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 jian3 dan1 de5 su4 du4 jia1 jian3 guan1 xi4 jiao4 zuo4 jia1 li4 lve4 bian4 hua4

cues.zh: 在牛顿和伽利略看来这是显而易见的
cues.pinyin: zai4 niu2 dun4 he2 jia1 li4 lve4 kan4 lai2 zhe4 shi4 xian3 er2 yi4 jian4 de5

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xun2 zhao3 jue2 dui4 kong1 jian1 de5 wen4 ti2 bian4 de2 shi2 fen1 jin3 po4

cues.pinyin: mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 zu3 fang1 cheng2 zu3

cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 bian4 hua4 de5 dian4 chang3 ke3 yi3 chan3 sheng1 ci2 chang3
cues.en: He told us that a changing electric field can produce a magnetic field

cues.pinyin: bian4 hua4 de5 ci2 chang3 ke3 yi3 chan3 sheng1 dian4 chang3
cues.en: and a changing magnetic field can produce an electric field

cues.zh: 如果电场和磁场相互激发
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dian4 chang3 he2 ci2 chang3 xiang1 hu4 ji1 fa1
cues.en: If electric and magnetic fields excite each other

cues.zh: 就会形成一种波动
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 yi1 zhong3 bo1 dong4
cues.en: they form a kind of wave

cues.zh: 这就是电磁波
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 dian4 ci2 bo1
cues.en: and that is an electromagnetic wave

cues.zh: 而且根据电磁学方程组
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 gen1 ju4 dian4 ci2 xue2 fang1 cheng2 zu3
cues.en: Moreover, based on the equations of electromagnetism

cues.zh: 能够明确计算出
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 ming2 que4 ji4 suan4 chu1
cues.en: one can clearly calculate

cues.zh: 电磁波在真空中的速度
cues.pinyin: dian4 ci2 bo1 zai4 zhen1 kong1 zhong1 de5 su4 du4
cues.en: the speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum

cues.zh: 就是 30 万公里每秒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 30 wan4 gong1 li3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: which is 300,000 kilometers per second

cues.zh: 这正是光速
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zheng4 shi4 guang1 su4
cues.en: and that is exactly the speed of light

cues.zh: 所以麦克斯韦说光就是一种电磁波
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 shuo1 guang1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 dian4 ci2 bo1
cues.en: So Maxwell said light is a kind of electromagnetic wave

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（二）时间和空间，其实都是牛顿的假设

cues.zh: 向宇宙中发出了光
cues.pinyin: xiang4 yu3 zhou4 zhong1 fa1 chu1 le5 guang1
cues.en: The sun sends light out into the universe

cues.zh: 地球在围绕太阳旋转
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 zai4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: while the Earth orbits around it

cues.zh: 光速到底是相对于地球的
cues.pinyin: guang1 su4 dao4 di3 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 qiu2 de5
cues.en: Is the speed of light relative to the Earth

cues.zh: 还是相对于太阳的呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 tai4 yang2 de5 ne5
cues.en: or relative to the Sun?

cues.zh: 无论你给出了哪一个答案
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 ni3 gei3 chu1 le5 na3 yi2 ge4 da2 an4
cues.en: Whichever answer you give

cues.zh: 我们都可以去质疑
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 dou1 ke3 yi3 qu4 zhi4 yi2
cues.en: we can question it

cues.zh: 为什么不是另外一种情况呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bu2 shi4 ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 ne5
cues.en: asking why it isn't the other way instead

cues.zh: 一个比较合理的猜想是
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 he2 li3 de5 cai1 xiang3 shi4
cues.en: A relatively reasonable guess is

cues.zh: 也许光速是相对于光源的
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 guang1 su4 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 guang1 yuan2 de5
cues.en: that the speed of light might be relative to the light source

cues.zh: 如果在地球上的灯塔发出了光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 deng1 ta3 fa1 chu1 le5 guang1
cues.en: If a lighthouse on Earth emits light

cues.zh: 那么光速就是相对于地球的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guang1 su4 jiu4 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 qiu2 de5
cues.en: then the speed of light would be relative to the Earth

cues.zh: 如果太阳发出了光
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 tai4 yang2 fa1 chu1 le5 guang1
cues.en: If the Sun emits light

cues.zh: 那么光速就是相对于太阳的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guang1 su4 jiu4 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 tai4 yang2 de5
cues.en: then the speed of light would be relative to the Sun

cues.zh: 可是这种想法很快就被人们否定了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 xiang3 fa3 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 bei4 ren2 men5 fou3 ding4 le5
cues.en: But this idea was soon refuted

cues.zh: 因为宇宙中有很多的双星
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yu3 zhou4 zhong1 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 shuang1 xing1
cues.en: because there are many binary star systems in the universe

cues.zh: 也就是两颗恒星或者一颗恒星和一颗暗星
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 liang3 ke1 heng2 xing1 huo4 zhe3 yi1 ke1 heng2 xing1 he2 yi1 ke1 an4 xing1
cues.en: that is, two stars, or one star and one dark star

cues.zh: 比如白矮星
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 bai2 ai3 xing1
cues.en: such as a white dwarf

cues.zh: 彼此围绕对方旋转
cues.pinyin: bi3 ci3 wei2 rao4 dui4 fang1 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: orbiting each other

cues.zh: 像我们知道的天狼星就是双星
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 de5 tian1 lang2 xing1 jiu4 shi4 shuang1 xing1
cues.en: For example, Sirius, which we know, is a binary star

cues.zh: 平常我们看到的是天狼星 A
cues.pinyin: ping2 chang2 wo3 men5 kan4 dao4 de5 shi4 tian1 lang2 xing1 A
cues.en: What we usually see is Sirius A

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 辣味鸡丁 | 家庭食谱 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 辣味鸡丁
cues.pinyin: la4 wei4 ji1 ding1
cues.en: Spicy diced chicken

cues.zh: 首先我们来腌制一磅的鸡肉
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 lai2 yan1 zhi4 yi1 bang4 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: First, let's marinate one pound of chicken

cues.zh: 我们放少许的酱油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 shao3 xu3 de5 jiang4 you2
cues.en: We add a little soy sauce

cues.zh: 少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: A little salt

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: A little white pepper

cues.zh: 半个蛋白
cues.pinyin: ban4 ge4 dan4 bai2
cues.en: Half an egg white

cues.zh: 一汤匙玉米粉水
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 yu4 mi3 fen3 shui3
cues.en: A tablespoon of cornstarch slurry

cues.zh: 一汤匙油
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: A tablespoon of oil

cues.zh: 然后呢我们把这个鸡肉给它好
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 gei3 ta1 hao3
cues.en: Then we give the chicken a good

cues.zh: 好的按摩一下
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 an4 mo2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: good massage

cues.zh: 然后再腌制 30 分钟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 yan1 zhi4 30 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Then marinate for another 30 minutes

cues.zh: 接下来我们做酱汁
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 zuo4 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Next we make the sauce

cues.zh: 我们放入一汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 yi1 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: We add a tablespoon of soy sauce

cues.zh: 一汤匙蚝油
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 hao2 you2
cues.en: A tablespoon of oyster sauce

cues.zh: 少许辣椒油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 la4 jiao1 you2
cues.en: A little chili oil

cues.zh: 少许花椒油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 hua1 jiao1 you2
cues.en: A little Sichuan pepper oil

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: A little white pepper

cues.zh: 少许花椒粉
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 hua1 jiao1 fen3
cues.en: A little Sichuan pepper powder

cues.zh: 还有少许的糖
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 shao3 xu3 de5 tang2
cues.en: And a little sugar

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會

cues.zh: 我知道这个食材呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 cai2 ne5
cues.en: I know these ingredients

cues.zh: 听起来真的有那么一点点的多
cues.pinyin: ting1 qi3 lai2 zhen1 de5 you3 na4 me5 yi4 dian3 dian3 de5 duo1
cues.en: Do sound like quite a lot

cues.zh: 不过我保证大家
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 wo3 bao3 zheng4 da4 jia1
cues.en: But I promise you

cues.zh: 等一下吃起来是麻麻辣辣的
cues.pinyin: deng3 yi2 xia4 chi1 qi3 lai2 shi4 ma2 ma2 la4 la4 de5
cues.en: In a bit it'll taste numbing and spicy

cues.zh: 非常的香
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 de5 xiang1
cues.en: And very fragrant

cues.zh: 在一个热的锅子里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 re4 de5 guo1 zi5 li3 mian4
cues.en: In a hot pan

cues.zh: 我们放六汤匙的油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 liu4 tang1 chi2 de5 you2
cues.en: We add six tablespoons of oil

cues.zh: 然后我们把这个鸡肉放进来之后呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 fang4 jin4 lai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: Then after we put the chicken in

cues.zh: 给它炒啊炒啊
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 chao3 a5 chao3 a5
cues.en: We stir-fry it and stir-fry it

cues.zh: 炒到完全熟为止
cues.pinyin: chao3 dao4 wan2 quan2 shu2 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Until it's completely cooked

cues.zh: 拿出来之后呢
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After taking it out

cues.zh: 我们先把它放旁边
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 ba3 ta1 fang4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: We set it aside for now

cues.zh: 用锅子里的余油
cues.pinyin: yong4 guo1 zi5 li3 de5 yu2 you2
cues.en: Using the leftover oil in the pan

cues.zh: 我们炒一个青椒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 chao3 yi2 ge4 qing1 jiao1
cues.en: We stir-fry a green pepper

cues.zh: 大概 30 秒钟
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 30 miao3 zhong1
cues.en: For about 30 seconds

cues.zh: 拿出来
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Take it out

cues.zh: 现在在同一个锅子里面

cues.en: Now in the same pan

cues.zh: 我们放进来三瓣蒜
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 san1 ban4 suan4
cues.en: We add three cloves of garlic

cues.zh: 三个干辣椒
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 gan4 la4 jiao1
cues.en: Three dried chilies

cues.zh: 一汤匙辣豆豉
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 la4 dou4 chi3
cues.en: A tablespoon of spicy fermented black beans

cues.zh: 把刚刚炒好的鸡肉
cues.pinyin: ba3 gang1 gang1 chao3 hao3 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: The chicken we just stir-fried

cues.zh: 青椒
cues.pinyin: qing1 jiao1
cues.en: The green pepper

cues.zh: 还有酱汁
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: And the sauce

cues.zh: 放到锅子里
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 guo1 zi5 li3
cues.en: Put it into the pan

cues.zh: 然后呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: And then

cues.zh: 也是给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Give it a stir as well

cues.zh: 最后呢放进来一汤匙芝麻油
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ne5 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 tang1 chi2 zhi1 ma2 you2
cues.en: Finally, add in a tablespoon of sesame oil

cues.zh: 我相信大家在这个屏幕上已经
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang1 xin4 da4 jia1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 ping2 mu4 shang4 yi3 jing1
cues.en: I believe that through the screen, all of you

cues.zh: 闻到这个又辣

cues.zh: 又香的味道了
cues.pinyin: you4 xiang1 de5 wei4 dao4 le5

cues.zh: 有没有

cues.zh: 有啦

cues.zh: 想要吃辣的吗
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 chi1 la4 de5 ma5
cues.en: Want something spicy?

cues.zh: 那今天这道菜一定很适合你
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 zhe4 dao4 cai4 yi2 ding4 hen3 shi4 he2 ni3
cues.en: Then this dish is perfect for you today

cues.zh: 它又麻又辣又香
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 ma2 you4 la4 you4 xiang1
cues.en: It's numbing, spicy, and fragrant

cues.zh: 昨天晚上我先生在吃它的时候
cues.pinyin: zuo2 tian1 wan3 shang4 wo3 xian1 sheng1 zai4 chi1 ta1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Last night when my husband was eating it

cues.zh: 它就是满头大汗
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 man3 tou2 da4 han2
cues.en: He was sweating all over his head

cues.zh: 然后边吃边说好吃
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 bian1 chi1 bian1 shuo1 hao3 chi1
cues.en: And kept saying it was delicious while eating

cues.zh: 那我就问他说到底是这道菜太辣了
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 wen4 ta1 shuo1 dao4 di3 shi4 zhe4 dao4 cai4 tai4 la4 le5
cues.en: So I asked him whether it was that the dish was too spicy

cues.zh: 还是这个天气太热了
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 zhe4 ge5 tian1 qi4 tai4 re4 le5
cues.en: Or that the weather was too hot

cues.zh: 他们有说话就说好吃
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 you3 shuo1 hua4 jiu4 shuo1 hao3 chi1
cues.en: Whenever he did speak, all he said was "delicious"

cues.zh: 好了那我希望大家呢
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 na4 wo3 xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 ne5
cues.en: Okay, so I hope everyone

cues.zh: 也同样喜欢这道菜
cues.pinyin: ye3 tong2 yang4 xi3 huan1 zhe4 dao4 cai4
cues.en: Likes this dish just as much

cues.zh: 有什么问题随时跟我留言
cues.pinyin: you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 sui2 shi2 gen1 wo3 liu2 yan2
cues.en: If you have any questions, leave me a comment anytime

cues.zh: 别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: And don't forget to subscribe and like

cues.zh: 我们下集见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ji2 jian4 ge1
cues.en: See you in the next episode

cues.zh: 小美你这样又叫又跳的
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ni3 zhe4 yang4 you4 jiao4 you4 tiao4 de5
cues.en: Xiaomei, with all this yelling and jumping,

cues.zh: 真是快要把人吵死了
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 kuai4 yao4 ba3 ren2 chao3 si3 le5
cues.en: you're really driving everyone crazy.

cues.zh: 为什么你不能像哥哥那样安安静静的玩呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ni3 bu4 neng2 xiang4 ge1 ge1 na4 yang4 an1 an1 jing4 jing4 de5 wan2 ne5
cues.en: Why can't you play quietly like your brother does?

cues.zh: 妈妈我们是在玩办家家酒啦
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 wo3 men5 shi4 zai4 wan2 ban4 jia1 jia1 jiu3 la5
cues.en: Mom, we're playing house!

cues.zh: 哥哥扮回来太晚的爸爸我扮你
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 ban4 hui2 lai2 tai4 wan3 de5 ba4 ba4 wo3 ban4 ni3
cues.en: Brother's playing the dad who comes home too late, and I'm playing you.

cues.zh: 我问你哦小美为什么能够一只手就让
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 xiao3 mei3 wei4 shen2 me5 neng2 gou4 yi1 zhi1 shou3 jiu4 rang4
cues.en: Let me ask you, Xiaomei, why can you stop a car with just one hand?

cues.zh: 车子停下来呢
cues.pinyin: che1 zi5 ting2 xia4 lai2 ne5
cues.en: and make the car stop?

cues.zh: 简单因为那是玩具车
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 yin1 wei4 na4 shi4 wan2 ju4 che1
cues.en: Easy, because it's a toy car.

cues.zh: 错的是因为那是计程车车停下来了
cues.pinyin: cuo4 de5 shi4 yin1 wei4 na4 shi4 ji4 cheng2 che1 che1 ting2 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Wrong—it's because that's a taxi, and the car stopped.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话61｜办家家酒｜优秀的老师｜瓦斯怎么叫｜1元变500元｜不咬人的眼镜蛇｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 不是瓦斯要打电话叫
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 wa3 si1 yao4 da3 dian4 hua4 jiao4
cues.en: No, for gas you have to call and order it on the phone.

cues.zh: 嘿嘿嘿嘿
cues.pinyin: hei1 hei1 hei1 hei1
cues.en: Heh heh heh heh.

cues.zh: 这台显微镜可以把原来的东西
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tai2 xian3 wei1 jing4 ke3 yi3 ba3 yuan2 lai2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: This microscope can take an original object

cues.zh: 放到五百倍
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 wu3 bai3 bei4
cues.en: and magnify it 500 times.

cues.zh: 那老师
cues.pinyin: na4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: So, teacher,

cues.zh: 可以借我一下吗
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 jie4 wo3 yi1 xia4 ma5
cues.en: can I borrow it for a moment?

cues.zh: 因为我这里有一元
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 yuan2
cues.en: Because I have one dollar here,

cues.zh: 我想要把它变成五百元
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yao4 ba3 ta1 bian4 cheng2 wu3 bai3 yuan2
cues.en: and I want to turn it into 500 dollars.

cues.zh: 有一只眼镜蛇
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 zhi1 yan3 jing4 she2
cues.en: There's a cobra,

cues.zh: 但是它从来不咬人耶
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 cong2 lai2 bu4 yao3 ren2 ye2
cues.en: but it never bites people.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 因为那只蛇吃素吗
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 na4 zhi3 she2 chi1 su4 ma5
cues.en: Is it because that snake is a vegetarian,

cues.zh: 所以它不吃人
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bu4 chi1 ren2
cues.en: so it doesn't eat people?

cues.zh: 哪有蛇吃素的啊
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 she2 chi1 su4 de5 a5
cues.en: There's no such thing as a vegetarian snake!

cues.zh: 啊它吃别的动物不吃人
cues.pinyin: a5 ta1 chi1 bie2 de5 dong4 wu4 bu4 chi1 ren2
cues.en: Oh, it eats other animals, just not people.

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: No,

cues.zh: 是因为森林里面没有人
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 sen1 lin2 li3 mian4 mei2 you3 ren2
cues.en: it's because there's no one in the forest.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 台湾必吃卤肉饭的做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 哈喽你好今天给你带来的是台湾
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 ni3 hao3 jin1 tian1 gei3 ni3 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 tai2 wan1
cues.en: Hello, today I'm bringing you Taiwan's

cues.zh: 著名的卤肉饭
cues.pinyin: zhu4 ming2 de5 lu3 rou4 fan4
cues.en: famous lu rou fan (braised pork rice)

cues.zh: 首先我们将我们一磅带皮的五花肉切成
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 jiang1 wo3 men5 yi1 bang4 dai4 pi2 de5 wu3 hua1 rou4 qie4 cheng2
cues.en: First, we cut our one pound of skin-on pork belly into

cues.zh: 半英寸宽的片
cues.pinyin: ban4 ying1 cun4 kuan1 de5 pian4
cues.en: half-inch wide slices

cues.zh: 然后呢再把它们切成小块
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5 zai4 ba3 ta1 men5 qie4 cheng2 xiao3 kuai4
cues.en: Then we cut those into small pieces

cues.zh: 像是这个长方形的形状
cues.pinyin: xiang4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 chang2 fang1 xing2 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: like this rectangular shape

cues.zh: 在一个热锅里面我们把我们的五花肉
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 re4 guo1 li3 mian4 wo3 men5 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 wu3 hua1 rou4
cues.en: In a hot pan we put our pork belly

cues.zh: 放进来不放油
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 bu4 fang4 you2
cues.en: in without adding oil

cues.zh: 因为这个五花肉本身呢会出很多的油
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 wu3 hua1 rou4 ben3 shen1 ne5 hui4 chu1 hen3 duo1 de5 you2
cues.en: because the pork belly itself will release a lot of oil

cues.zh: 我们用大火给它炒到金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 da4 huo3 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: We stir-fry it on high heat until golden

cues.zh: 大概炒个五分钟
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 chao3 ge4 wu3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: for about five minutes

cues.zh: 先加入一把葱白
cues.pinyin: xian1 jia1 ru4 yi1 ba3 cong1 bai2
cues.en: First add a handful of scallion whites

cues.zh: 然后也是给它炒到香为止
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 xiang1 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: and also stir-fry those until fragrant

cues.zh: 再放入五瓣蒜末
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 ru4 wu3 ban4 suan4 mo4
cues.en: Then add five cloves of minced garlic

cues.zh: 也是把这个香味给它炒出来
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xiang1 wei4 gei3 ta1 chao3 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and also stir-fry out its fragrance

cues.zh: 放进来一杯油葱酥
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 bei1 you2 cong1 su1
cues.en: Add in a cup of fried shallots

cues.zh: 给它稍微搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 shao1 wei1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and give it a little stir

items.title_zh: 台湾必吃卤肉饭的做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 这时放进来八个切碎了的虾米
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 fang4 jin4 lai2 ba1 ge4 qie4 sui4 le5 de5 xia1 mi3
cues.en: Now add in eight chopped dried shrimp

cues.zh: 六个切碎了的香菇
cues.pinyin: liu4 ge4 qie4 sui4 le5 de5 xiang1 gu1
cues.en: and six chopped dried shiitake mushrooms

cues.zh: 那这个香菇呢我已经泡在水里
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 xiang1 gu1 ne5 wo3 yi3 jing1 pao4 zai4 shui3 li3
cues.en: and these mushrooms I've already soaked in water

cues.zh: 就晚上
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wan3 shang4
cues.en: overnight

cues.zh: 我们再稍微给它炒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 shao1 wei1 gei3 ta1 chao3
cues.en: We stir-fry it a bit more

cues.zh: 大概一分钟左右
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 yi4 fen1 zhong1 zuo3 you4
cues.en: for about one minute

cues.zh: 这时放入三汤匙的糖
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 fang4 ru4 san1 tang1 chi2 de5 tang2
cues.en: Now add in three tablespoons of sugar

cues.zh: 然后也是给它搅拌炒一炒
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 chao3 yi1 chao3
cues.en: and also stir it in and fry it a bit

cues.zh: 那这个糖呢会给我们的五花肉非
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 tang2 ne5 hui4 gei3 wo3 men5 de5 wu3 hua1 rou4 fei1
cues.en: and this sugar will give our pork belly a

cues.zh: 常漂亮的颜色
cues.pinyin: chang2 piao4 liang4 de5 yan2 se4
cues.en: really beautiful color

cues.zh: 这时倒进来 6 汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 dao4 jin4 lai2 6 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Now pour in 6 tablespoons of soy sauce

cues.zh: 3 汤匙米酒
cues.pinyin: 3 tang1 chi2 mi3 jiu3
cues.en: 3 tablespoons of rice wine

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: a little white pepper

cues.zh: 少许五香粉
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 wu3 xiang1 fen3
cues.en: a little five-spice powder

cues.zh: 少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: a little salt

cues.zh: 两杯热水
cues.pinyin: liang3 bei1 re4 shui3
cues.en: two cups of hot water

cues.zh: 两个八角
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ba1 jiao3
cues.en: two star anise

cues.zh: 再加进来 6 颗蛋
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 jin4 lai2 6 ke1 dan4
cues.en: then add in 6 eggs

cues.zh: 我们就是给它稍微的搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ta1 shao1 wei1 de5 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: We just give it a little stir

cues.zh: 然后这个时候呢我们把盖子盖上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 gai4 zi5 gai4 shang4
cues.en: and at this point we put the lid on

cues.zh: 那现在呢就可以给它盛到这个饭上
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 ne5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 gei3 ta1 sheng4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 fan4 shang4
cues.en: and now we can serve it over this rice

cues.zh: 然后放入我们刚刚切好的蛋
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 ru4 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 qie4 hao3 de5 dan4
cues.en: then add in the eggs we just cut up

cues.zh: 还有你喜欢的话也可以放一些绿色的青菜
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ni3 xi3 huan1 de5 hua4 ye3 ke3 yi3 fang4 yi1 xie1 lv4 se4 de5 qing1 cai4
cues.en: and if you like, you can also add some green vegetables

cues.zh: 那我希望你喜欢哦
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 xi1 wang4 ni3 xi3 huan1 o2
cues.en: I hope you enjoy it

cues.zh: 上次去台湾的时候
cues.pinyin: shang4 ci4 qu4 tai2 wan1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The last time I went to Taiwan

cues.zh: 我每天都在吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 tian1 dou1 zai4 chi1
cues.en: I ate it every single day

cues.zh: 时时刻刻的来吃
cues.pinyin: shi2 shi2 ke4 ke4 de5 lai2 chi1
cues.en: I ate it constantly

cues.zh: 看到什么东西呢都想要吃一口
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 shen2 me5 dong1 xi1 ne5 dou1 xiang3 yao4 chi1 yi1 kou3
cues.en: Whatever I saw, I wanted to take a bite

cues.zh: 因为感觉到好美味喔
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 gan3 jue2 dao4 hao3 mei3 wei4 o1
cues.en: because it felt so delicious

cues.zh: 结果我最后给他胖了四五磅这么重
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 wo3 zui4 hou4 gei3 ta1 pang4 le5 si4 wu3 bang4 zhe4 me5 zhong4
cues.en: and in the end I gained about four or five pounds

cues.zh: 其中一样呢
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi1 yang4 ne5
cues.en: One thing in particular

cues.zh: 我记得我最喜欢吃的就是台湾的卤肉饭
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji4 de5 wo3 zui4 xi3 huan1 chi1 de5 jiu4 shi4 tai2 wan1 de5 lu3 rou4 fan4
cues.en: I remember my favorite was Taiwan's lu rou fan

cues.zh: 好美味好好吃喔
cues.pinyin: hao3 mei3 wei4 hao3 hao3 chi1 o1
cues.en: so delicious, so tasty

cues.zh: 后来回到美国呢
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 hui2 dao4 mei3 guo2 ne5
cues.en: Later, after coming back to the US

cues.zh: 可以吃到这种味道这种口感
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 chi1 dao4 zhe4 zhong3 wei4 dao4 zhe4 zhong3 kou3 gan3
cues.en: being able to taste that flavor, that texture

cues.zh: 就几乎非常的少
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ji1 hu1 fei1 chang2 de5 shao3
cues.en: is almost very rare

cues.zh: 好吃的地方也不多
cues.pinyin: hao3 chi1 de5 di4 fang1 ye3 bu4 duo1
cues.en: and there aren't many good places for it either

cues.zh: 所以今天呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 ne5
cues.en: So today

cues.zh: 就跟大家分享的卤肉饭
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 lu3 rou4 fan4
cues.en: I'm sharing with everyone this lu rou fan

cues.zh: 在家里可以如何做
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 li3 ke3 yi3 ru2 he2 zuo4
cues.en: and how you can make it at home

cues.zh: 也可以做的很好吃
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 zuo4 de5 hen3 hao3 chi1
cues.en: and make it taste really good too

cues.zh: 你好各位爱做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 ai4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone, food lovers who love cooking

cues.zh: 非常荣幸地又跟大家见面了我是 C issy
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 di4 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C issy
cues.en: I'm very honored to meet you all again, I'm Cissy

cues.zh: 需要的叉烧呢我又爱做
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 de5 cha1 shao1 ne5 wo3 you4 ai4 zuo4
cues.en: I love making char siu

cues.zh: 我又爱吃真的很好吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 ai4 chi1 zhen1 de5 hen3 hao3 chi1
cues.en: And I love eating it, it's really delicious

cues.zh: 那一般呢我会使用猪肉来做
cues.pinyin: na4 yi4 ban1 ne5 wo3 hui4 shi3 yong4 zhu1 rou4 lai2 zuo4
cues.en: Usually I use pork to make it

cues.zh: 因为它比较肥比较香
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 bi3 jiao4 fei2 bi3 jiao4 xiang1
cues.en: Because it's fattier and more fragrant

cues.zh: 那许多网友呢最近都在问我说
cues.pinyin: na4 xu3 duo1 wang3 you3 ne5 zui4 jin4 dou1 zai4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently many viewers have been asking me

cues.zh: 可不可以用鸡肉来做个看来的叉烧
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 yong4 ji1 rou4 lai2 zuo4 ge4 kan4 lai2 de5 cha1 shao1
cues.en: Whether chicken could be used to make something that looks like char siu

cues.zh: 所以今天要跟大家分享的呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 yao4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 ne5
cues.en: So what I want to share with you today

cues.zh: 就是叉烧鸡的做法
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 cha1 shao1 ji1 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Is how to make char siu chicken

cues.zh: 简单一学一学就会
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 yi1 xue2 yi1 xue2 jiu4 hui4
cues.en: It's simple, you'll learn it in no time

cues.zh: 在一个碗里我们来调制我们的腌料
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 lai2 tiao2 zhi4 wo3 men5 de5 yan1 liao4
cues.en: In a bowl, let's mix our marinade

cues.zh: 首先放入南乳
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 fang4 ru4 nan2 ru3
cues.en: First add nam yu

cues.zh: 也叫红腐乳
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiao4 hong2 fu3 ru3
cues.en: Also called red fermented tofu

cues.zh: 它会给我们的叉烧一个美丽的红色
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 gei3 wo3 men5 de5 cha1 shao1 yi2 ge4 mei3 li4 de5 hong2 se4
cues.en: It gives our char siu a beautiful red color

cues.zh: 再放入酱油
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 ru4 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Then add soy sauce

cues.zh: 老抽
cues.pinyin: lao3 chou1
cues.en: Dark soy sauce

cues.zh: 蚝油
cues.pinyin: hao2 you2
cues.en: Oyster sauce

cues.zh: 海鲜酱

cues.en: Hoisin sauce

cues.zh: 绍兴酒

cues.en: Shaoxing wine

cues.zh: 蜂蜜
cues.pinyin: feng1 mi4
cues.en: Honey

cues.zh: 五香粉
cues.pinyin: wu3 xiang1 fen3
cues.en: Five-spice powder

cues.zh: 白胡椒
cues.pinyin: bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: White pepper

cues.zh: 还有蒜
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 suan4
cues.en: And garlic

cues.zh: 给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Give it a stir

cues.zh: 把我们去骨的鸡腿肉放入一个
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 men5 qu4 gu3 de5 ji1 tui3 rou4 fang4 ru4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Put our boneless chicken thighs into a

cues.zh: 大的厨房袋子
cues.pinyin: da4 de5 chu2 fang2 dai4 zi5
cues.en: Large kitchen bag

cues.zh: 再放入腌料
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 ru4 yan1 liao4
cues.en: Then add the marinade

cues.zh: 把里面的空气尽量的挤出去
cues.pinyin: ba3 li3 mian4 de5 kong1 qi4 jin3 liang4 de5 ji3 chu1 qu4
cues.en: Squeeze out as much air as possible

cues.zh: 把袋子关上
cues.pinyin: ba3 dai4 zi5 guan1 shang4
cues.en: Close the bag

cues.zh: 然后这样子用手把这个腌料还有这个鸡肉
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 yong4 shou3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yan1 liao4 hai2 you3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: Then use your hands to rub the marinade and the chicken

cues.zh: 互相的涂抹一下
cues.pinyin: hu4 xiang1 de5 tu2 mo3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Together so it's evenly coated

cues.zh: 袋子我们放入冰箱给它腌制一个晚上
cues.pinyin: dai4 zi5 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 bing1 xiang1 gei3 ta1 yan1 zhi4 yi2 ge4 wan3 shang4
cues.en: Put the bag in the fridge to marinate overnight

cues.zh: 隔天我们先预热我们的烤箱 400 华氏度
cues.pinyin: ge2 tian1 wo3 men5 xian1 yu4 re4 wo3 men5 de5 kao3 xiang1 400 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: The next day, first preheat our oven to 400°F

cues.zh: 或者是 20 4 摄氏度
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 20 4 she4 shi4 du4
cues.en: Or 204°C

cues.zh: 在烤盘上面放上一个烤架
cues.pinyin: zai4 kao3 pan2 shang4 mian4 fang4 shang4 yi2 ge4 kao3 jia4
cues.en: Place a wire rack on the baking tray

cues.zh: 鸡肉从厨房袋子里面拿出来之后
cues.pinyin: ji1 rou4 cong2 chu2 fang2 dai4 zi5 li3 mian4 na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After taking the chicken out of the kitchen bag

cues.zh: 放在烤架上
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 kao3 jia4 shang4
cues.en: Place it on the rack

cues.zh: 将烤盘转移到烤箱中的中间的架子
cues.pinyin: jiang1 kao3 pan2 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 kao3 xiang1 zhong1 de5 zhong1 jian1 de5 jia4 zi5
cues.en: Move the tray to the middle rack of the oven

cues.zh: 并在 400 华氏度
cues.pinyin: bing4 zai4 400 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: And at 400°F

cues.zh: 也就是 20 4 摄氏度下烤
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 20 4 she4 shi4 du4 xia4 kao3
cues.en: That is, 204°C, bake for

cues.zh: 20 分钟
cues.pinyin: 20 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: 20 minutes

cues.zh: 我们现在来做一点蜂蜜水
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 lai2 zuo4 yi4 dian3 feng1 mi4 shui3
cues.en: Now let's make some honey water

cues.zh: 加入蜂蜜
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 feng1 mi4
cues.en: Add honey

cues.zh: 还有温水
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wen1 shui3
cues.en: And warm water

cues.zh: 给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Give it a stir

cues.zh: 烤盘从烤箱中拿出来之后
cues.pinyin: kao3 pan2 cong2 kao3 xiang1 zhong1 na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After taking the tray out of the oven

cues.zh: 先给鸡肉翻一个面
cues.pinyin: xian1 gei3 ji1 rou4 fan1 yi2 ge4 mian4
cues.en: First flip the chicken over

cues.zh: 在这一面呢先涂上蜂蜜水
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 yi2 mian4 ne5 xian1 tu2 shang4 feng1 mi4 shui3
cues.en: Brush this side with the honey water

cues.zh: 翻一个面
