items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 常言道讳疾忌医不可取有病一定要及时看
cues.pinyin: chang2 yan2 dao4 hui4 ji2 ji4 yi1 bu4 ke3 qu3 you3 bing4 yi2 ding4 yao4 ji2 shi2 kan4
cues.en: As the saying goes, hiding your illness from the doctor is unwise — if you're sick, you must see a doctor promptly.

cues.zh: 否则就会像这个小姑娘一样差
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 jiu4 hui4 xiang4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 gu1 niang2 yi1 yang4 cha4
cues.en: Otherwise you could end up like this little girl,

cues.zh: 点连命都丢了
cues.pinyin: dian3 lian2 ming4 dou1 diu1 le5
cues.en: who nearly lost her life.

cues.zh: 这个女孩叫小美
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nv3 hai2 jiao4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: This girl is named Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 脖子上出了一大片的红斑
cues.pinyin: bo2 zi5 shang4 chu1 le5 yi1 da4 pian4 de5 hong2 ban1
cues.en: A large red rash appeared on her neck.

cues.zh: 这不是她第一次来医院了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu2 shi4 ta1 di4 yi1 ci4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: This wasn't her first visit to the hospital.

cues.zh: 只是当时她才五岁
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 dang1 shi2 ta1 cai2 wu3 sui4
cues.en: But back then she was only five.

cues.zh: 父母又不重视觉得只是普通的扭伤之类的
cues.pinyin: fu4 mu3 you4 bu4 zhong4 shi4 jue2 de5 zhi3 shi4 pu3 tong1 de5 niu3 shang1 zhi1 lei4 de5
cues.en: Her parents didn't take it seriously and assumed it was just an ordinary sprain or something,

cues.zh: 就拒绝了医院手术的提议
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ju4 jue2 le5 yi1 yuan4 shou3 shu4 de5 ti2 yi4
cues.en: so they refused the hospital's proposal for surgery.

cues.zh: 结果过了几年情况越来越严重
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 guo4 le5 ji3 nian2 qing2 kuang4 yue4 lai2 yue4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: A few years later, the condition got worse and worse.

cues.zh: 病症蔓延了半个脖子
cues.pinyin: bing4 zheng4 man4 yan2 le5 ban4 ge4 bo2 zi5
cues.en: The disease had spread over half her neck.

cues.zh: 就算穿高领毛衣也挡不住了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 chuan1 gao1 ling3 mao2 yi1 ye3 dang3 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Even a turtleneck sweater couldn't hide it anymore.

cues.zh: 父母这才不得已带她来了医院做检查
cues.pinyin: fu4 mu3 zhe4 cai2 bu4 de2 yi3 dai4 ta1 lai2 le5 yi1 yuan4 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Only then did her parents reluctantly bring her to the hospital for an exam.

cues.zh: 小美皮肤温度升高
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 pi2 fu1 wen1 du4 sheng1 gao1
cues.en: Xiaomei's skin temperature had risen,

cues.zh: 红斑颜色比上次检查时加深了很多
cues.pinyin: hong2 ban1 yan2 se4 bi3 shang4 ci4 jian3 cha2 shi2 jia1 shen1 le5 hen3 duo1
cues.en: and the rash was much darker than at her last checkup.

cues.zh: 最近一周还开始疼痛
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 yi1 zhou1 hai2 kai1 shi3 teng2 tong4
cues.en: In the past week it had also started to hurt.

cues.zh: 这是动静脉血管畸形
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dong4 jing4 mai4 xue4 guan3 ji1 xing2
cues.en: This is an arteriovenous malformation,

cues.zh: 而且正在增长
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zheng4 zai4 zeng1 zhang3
cues.en: and it's still growing.

cues.zh: 她现在必须得做手术
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 bi4 xu1 de2 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: She has to have surgery now.

cues.zh: 小美父母之前一直给小美服用药物
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 fu4 mu3 zhi1 qian2 yi4 zhi2 gei3 xiao3 mei3 fu2 yong4 yao4 wu4
cues.en: Before this, Xiaomei's parents had kept giving her medication

cues.zh: 和补充营养剂
cues.pinyin: he2 bu3 chong1 ying2 yang3 ji4
cues.en: and nutritional supplements.

cues.zh: 虽然表面上看有抑制的作用
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 biao3 mian4 shang4 kan4 you3 yi4 zhi4 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: Although on the surface it seemed to have a suppressive effect,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 但其实随着小美身体的发育会加
cues.pinyin: dan4 qi2 shi2 sui2 zhe5 xiao3 mei3 shen1 ti3 de5 fa1 yu4 hui4 jia1
cues.en: in fact, as Xiaomei's body developed, it would

cues.zh: 速畸形的发展
cues.pinyin: su4 ji1 xing2 de5 fa1 zhan3
cues.en: accelerate the progression of the malformation,

cues.zh: 加剧她自发性出血的风险
cues.pinyin: jia1 ju4 ta1 zi4 fa1 xing4 chu1 xie3 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: increasing her risk of spontaneous bleeding.

cues.zh: 立刻答应了做手术
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 da1 ying4 le5 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They immediately agreed to the surgery.

cues.zh: 只是这个病发展太久了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 bing4 fa1 zhan3 tai4 jiu3 le5
cues.en: But the disease had been developing for too long,

cues.zh: 动静脉血管畸形已经深入到了肺叶上侧
cues.pinyin: dong4 jing4 mai4 xue4 guan3 ji1 xing2 yi3 jing1 shen1 ru4 dao4 le5 fei4 ye4 shang4 ce4
cues.en: so now the surgery was far harder than it would have been at the start.

cues.zh: 动气脉血管畸形已经深入到了肺液上侧
cues.pinyin: dong4 qi4 mai4 xue4 guan3 ji1 xing2 yi3 jing1 shen1 ru4 dao4 le5 fei4 ye4 shang4 ce4
cues.en: The arteriovenous malformation had already grown deep into the upper lobe of the lung.

cues.zh: 无法用激光消除
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 yong4 ji1 guang1 xiao1 chu2
cues.en: It couldn't be removed with a laser.

cues.zh: 途中小美喉管出血
cues.pinyin: tu2 zhong1 xiao3 mei3 hou2 guan3 chu1 xie3
cues.en: During the procedure, Xiaomei's throat began to bleed,

cues.zh: 丽姆不得不中止手术
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 bu4 de2 bu4 zhong1 zhi3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and Dr. Lim had no choice but to halt the surgery.

cues.zh: 还好没给小美造成什么大的影响
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 mei2 gei3 xiao3 mei3 zao4 cheng2 shen2 me5 da4 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: Fortunately it didn't cause any major harm to Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 她现在情况比较稳定
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 qing2 kuang4 bi3 jiao4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: Her condition is now fairly stable,

cues.zh: 意识清醒
cues.pinyin: yi4 shi2 qing1 xing3
cues.en: and she's conscious.

cues.zh: 只是接下来还必须要做一个手术
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 jie1 xia4 lai2 hai2 bi4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: But she still has to undergo another surgery next.

cues.zh: 他们目前无法确定畸形血管的具体范围
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 mu4 qian2 wu2 fa3 que4 ding4 ji1 xing2 xue4 guan3 de5 ju4 ti3 fan4 wei2
cues.en: They currently can't determine the exact extent of the malformed vessels.

cues.zh: 需要切除小美锁骨来得到操作空间
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 qie1 chu2 xiao3 mei3 suo3 gu3 lai2 de5 dao4 cao1 zuo4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: They need to remove Xiaomei's collarbone to get room to operate,

cues.zh: 将畸形血管切除
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ji1 xing2 xue4 guan3 qie1 chu2
cues.en: remove the malformed vessels,

cues.zh: 然后再把骨头放回去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ba3 gu3 tou5 fang4 hui2 qu4
cues.en: and then put the bone back.

cues.zh: 只是在愈合之前要佩戴支架了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 zai4 yu4 he2 zhi1 qian2 yao4 pei4 dai4 zhi1 jia4 le5
cues.en: But she'll have to wear a brace until it heals.

cues.zh: 小美父母知道后气愤地指责他们
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 fu4 mu3 zhi1 dao4 hou4 qi4 fen4 di4 zhi3 ze2 ta1 men5
cues.en: When Xiaomei's parents found out, they angrily blamed the doctors,

cues.zh: 但被丽姆拒绝了
cues.pinyin: dan4 bei4 li4 mu3 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but Dr. Lim refused to accept the blame.

cues.zh: 因为激光手术引发了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ji1 guang1 shou3 shu4 yin3 fa1 le5
cues.en: Because it was the laser surgery that had caused the complication,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 现在小美也不用切废了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 xiao3 mei3 ye3 bu4 yong4 qie4 fei4 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei doesn't need to lose the limb/bone now.

cues.zh: 他们现在不同意做手术
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xian4 zai4 bu4 tong2 yi4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They still don't agree to the surgery,

cues.zh: 只不过是不想承认自己犯过的错而已
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 shi4 bu4 xiang3 cheng2 ren4 zi4 ji3 fan4 guo4 de5 cuo4 er2 yi3
cues.en: but that's only because they don't want to admit the mistake they made.

cues.zh: 别再自欺欺人了
cues.pinyin: bie2 zai4 zi4 qi1 qi1 ren2 le5
cues.en: Stop deceiving yourselves.

cues.zh: 经过布朗这么一说
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 bu4 lang3 zhe4 me5 yi1 shuo1
cues.en: After Brown put it that way,

cues.zh: 小美的父母总算同意了手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 fu4 mu3 zong3 suan4 tong2 yi4 le5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiaomei's parents finally agreed to the surgery.

cues.zh: 手术重新开始
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 chong2 xin1 kai1 shi3
cues.en: The surgery started again,

cues.zh: 一切顺利
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 shun4 li4
cues.en: and everything went smoothly.

cues.zh: 小美爸妈就守在小美病床前
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ba4 ma1 jiu4 shou3 zai4 xiao3 mei3 bing4 chuang2 qian2
cues.en: Xiaomei's parents stayed by her bedside,

cues.zh: 等她醒后第一句话就是道歉
cues.pinyin: deng3 ta1 xing3 hou4 di4 yi1 ju4 hua4 jiu4 shi4 dao4 qian4
cues.en: and the first thing they said when she woke up was an apology.

cues.zh: 他们为之前的行为感到自责和内疚
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 wei4 zhi1 qian2 de5 xing2 wei2 gan3 dao4 zi4 ze2 he2 nei4 jiu4
cues.en: They felt guilty and ashamed of what they'd done before.

cues.zh: 但索性一切还不算太晚
cues.pinyin: dan4 suo3 xing4 yi1 qie4 hai2 bu4 suan4 tai4 wan3
cues.en: But fortunately it wasn't too late.

cues.zh: 小美告诉他们没关系
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 gao4 su4 ta1 men5 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: Xiaomei told them it was okay,

cues.zh: 她依旧爱他们
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 jiu4 ai4 ta1 men5
cues.en: and that she still loved them.

cues.zh: 布朗看到此情此景有些触动
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 kan4 dao4 ci3 qing2 ci3 jing3 you3 xie1 chu4 dong4
cues.en: Seeing this scene, Brown was a little moved,

cues.zh: 等下班后就去找了自己的父亲
cues.pinyin: deng3 xia4 ban1 hou4 jiu4 qu4 zhao3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: and after his shift he went to see his own father.

cues.zh: 告诉他你是一个糟糕的父亲
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 ni3 shi4 yi2 ge4 zao1 gao1 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: He told him, "You were a terrible father,

cues.zh: 但我原谅你
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 yuan2 liang4 ni3
cues.en: but I forgive you,

cues.zh: 因为我需要你的陪伴
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 xu1 yao4 ni3 de5 pei2 ban4
cues.en: because I need you in my life."

cues.zh: 他们用一个拥抱消除了十几年的隔阂
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yong4 yi2 ge4 yong1 bao4 xiao1 chu2 le5 shi2 ji3 nian2 de5 ge2 he2
cues.en: They cleared away over a decade of estrangement with one hug.

cues.zh: 抑郁症患者小帅
cues.pinyin: yi4 yu4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: A depression patient named Xiaoshuai

cues.zh: 居然服用自己种植的置换蘑菇来抵抗抑郁
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 fu2 yong4 zi4 ji3 zhong4 zhi2 de5 zhi4 huan4 mo2 gu1 lai2 di3 kang4 yi4 yu4
cues.en: was actually taking psychedelic mushrooms he grew himself to fight his depression.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 因为更多的研究表明
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 geng4 duo1 de5 yan2 jiu1 biao3 ming2
cues.en: Because more research shows

cues.zh: 自己用土方法治病的病人
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 yong4 tu3 fang1 fa3 zhi4 bing4 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: that patients who treat themselves with folk remedies

cues.zh: 最后通常会药物上瘾
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 tong1 chang2 hui4 yao4 wu4 shang4 yin3
cues.en: usually end up addicted to drugs,

cues.zh: 甚至死亡
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 si3 wang2
cues.en: or even dead.

cues.zh: 可小帅管不了那么多
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 shuai4 guan3 bu4 liao3 na4 me5 duo1
cues.en: But Xiaoshuai didn't care about any of that,

cues.zh: 因为这是对他唯一有效的治疗
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 shi4 dui4 ta1 wei2 yi1 you3 xiao4 de5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: because this was the only treatment that worked for him.

cues.zh: 他不可能放弃
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 ke3 neng2 fang4 qi4
cues.en: There was no way he'd give it up.

cues.zh: 小帅态度这么坚决
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 tai4 du4 zhe4 me5 jian1 jue2
cues.en: Since Xiaoshuai was so determined,

cues.zh: 摩根一时也不知道怎么劝说
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 yi1 shi2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 quan4 shuo1
cues.en: Morgan didn't know how to talk him out of it for a moment,

cues.zh: 只能给他做更深一步的检查
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 gei3 ta1 zuo4 geng1 shen1 yi1 bu4 de5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: so she could only run a deeper examination on him

cues.zh: 确保没有什么副作用
cues.pinyin: que4 bao3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 fu4 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: to make sure there were no side effects.

cues.zh: 结果检查发现
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jian3 cha2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: As a result, the exam found

cues.zh: 小帅的左肺下野
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 de5 zuo3 fei4 xia4 ye3
cues.en: that in the lower zone of Xiaoshuai's left lung

cues.zh: 出现了大片的真菌感染
cues.pinyin: chu1 xian4 le5 da4 pian4 de5 zhen1 jun1 gan3 ran3
cues.en: there was a large fungal infection.

cues.zh: 他也真是幸运
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 zhen1 shi4 xing4 yun4
cues.en: He was actually really lucky —

cues.zh: 但凡晚来一个星期
cues.pinyin: dan4 fan2 wan3 lai2 yi2 ge4 xing1 qi1
cues.en: if he'd come in even a week later,

cues.zh: 他的肝肺就要和他说白白了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gan1 fei4 jiu4 yao4 he2 ta1 shuo1 bai2 bai2 le5
cues.en: he could have said goodbye to his liver and lungs.

cues.zh: 不过小帅好像并不是很开心
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 shuai4 hao3 xiang4 bing4 bu2 shi4 hen3 kai1 xin1
cues.en: But Xiaoshuai didn't seem very happy about it.

cues.zh: 他关注的是手术后
cues.pinyin: ta1 guan1 zhu4 de5 shi4 shou3 shu4 hou4
cues.en: What he cared about was whether, after the surgery,

cues.zh: 还能不能继续注射置换药物
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 bu4 neng2 ji4 xu4 zhu4 she4 zhi4 huan4 yao4 wu4
cues.en: he could keep injecting the psychedelic drug.

cues.zh: 听到这儿摩根的小脾气就上来了
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 zhe4 er2 mo2 gen1 de5 xiao3 pi2 qi4 jiu4 shang4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Hearing this, Morgan's temper flared up.

cues.zh: 你居然还想着注射能害死你自己的药物
cues.pinyin: ni3 ju1 ran2 hai2 xiang3 zhe5 zhu4 she4 neng2 hai4 si3 ni3 zi4 ji3 de5 yao4 wu4
cues.en: "You're still thinking about injecting a drug that could kill you?

cues.zh: 嫌命太长吗
cues.pinyin: xian2 ming4 tai4 zhang3 ma5
cues.en: Are you tired of living?"

cues.zh: 但小帅也不想啊
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 shuai4 ye3 bu4 xiang3 a5
cues.en: But Xiaoshuai didn't want this either —

cues.zh: 抑郁症让他十分痛苦
cues.pinyin: yi4 yu4 zheng4 rang4 ta1 shi2 fen1 tong4 ku3
cues.en: depression tormented him terribly,

cues.zh: 正规药物对他来说根本没有效果
cues.pinyin: zheng4 gui1 yao4 wu4 dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: and regular medication simply didn't work for him.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 长期的折磨让他几乎崩溃
cues.pinyin: chang2 qi1 de5 zhe2 mo2 rang4 ta1 ji1 hu1 beng1 kui4
cues.en: The prolonged suffering had nearly broken him.

cues.zh: 都这样了
cues.pinyin: dou1 zhe4 yang4 le5
cues.en: Given that things had come to this,

cues.zh: 摩根也不好再说什么
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 ye3 bu4 hao3 zai4 shuo1 shen2 me5
cues.en: Morgan had nothing more to say.

cues.zh: 还是先考虑一下手术的事情吧
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 xian1 kao3 lv4 yi1 xia4 shou3 shu4 de5 shi4 qing2 ba5
cues.en: "Let's focus on the surgery for now."

cues.zh: 摩根考虑开胸和中线腹腔手术
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 kao3 lv4 kai1 xiong1 he2 zhong1 xian4 fu4 qiang1 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Morgan considered open-chest and midline abdominal surgery

cues.zh: 一次性把病灶全部清除
cues.pinyin: yi2 ci4 xing4 ba3 bing4 zao4 quan2 bu4 qing1 chu2
cues.en: to clear out all the lesions at once,

cues.zh: 但朴医生坚持用微创手术来移除
cues.pinyin: dan4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 jian1 chi2 yong4 wei1 chuang4 shou3 shu4 lai2 yi2 chu2
cues.en: but Dr. Park insisted on using minimally invasive surgery to remove

cues.zh: 大的病变组织
cues.pinyin: da4 de5 bing4 bian4 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: the major diseased tissue,

cues.zh: 剩余的部分可以采用抗真菌药物治疗
cues.pinyin: sheng4 yu2 de5 bu4 fen4 ke3 yi3 cai3 yong4 kang4 zhen1 jun1 yao4 wu4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: and treat the rest with antifungal medication.

cues.zh: 这样风险小操作简单
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 feng1 xian3 xiao3 cao1 zuo4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: That way the risk is lower and the procedure is simpler,

cues.zh: 后续恢复也比较容易
cues.pinyin: hou4 xu4 hui1 fu4 ye3 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4
cues.en: and recovery afterward would also be easier.

cues.zh: 而且朴医生现在是高级外科住院医师
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 pu3 yi1 sheng1 xian4 zai4 shi4 gao1 ji2 wai4 ke1 zhu4 yuan4 yi1 shi1
cues.en: Besides, Dr. Park is now a senior surgical resident,

cues.zh: 要怎么做还是要看他的决定
cues.pinyin: yao4 zen3 me5 zuo4 hai2 shi4 yao4 kan4 ta1 de5 jue2 ding4
cues.en: so how to proceed was still his call.

cues.zh: 但是他们在手术时遇到了麻烦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 zai4 shou3 shu4 shi2 yu4 dao4 le5 ma2 fan2
cues.en: But they ran into trouble during the surgery —

cues.zh: 真菌沉寂物造成了太多腹膜斑痕
cues.pinyin: zhen1 jun1 chen2 ji4 wu4 zao4 cheng2 le5 tai4 duo1 fu4 mo2 ban1 hen2
cues.en: the fungal deposits had caused too much peritoneal scarring,

cues.zh: 离总胆管太近了
cues.pinyin: li2 zong3 dan3 guan3 tai4 jin4 le5
cues.en: and it was too close to the common bile duct.

cues.zh: 他们无法切除
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 wu2 fa3 qie1 chu2
cues.en: They couldn't remove it.

cues.zh: 摩根是对的
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: Morgan was right —

cues.zh: 没有办法通过腹腔镜移出所有的病灶
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 tong1 guo4 fu4 qiang1 jing4 yi2 chu1 suo3 you3 de5 bing4 zao4
cues.en: there was no way to remove all the lesions laparoscopically.

cues.zh: 最后他们还是按照了摩根最初的设想
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 men5 hai2 shi4 an4 zhao4 le5 mo2 gen1 zui4 chu1 de5 she4 xiang3
cues.en: In the end they went with Morgan's original plan

cues.zh: 给小帅进行了手术
cues.pinyin: gei3 xiao3 shuai4 jin4 xing2 le5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and performed the surgery on Xiaoshuai.

cues.zh: 术后情况良好
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 qing2 kuang4 liang2 hao3
cues.en: The post-op condition was good,

cues.zh: 不需要多久小帅就会康复
cues.pinyin: bu4 xu1 yao4 duo1 jiu3 xiao3 shuai4 jiu4 hui4 kang1 fu4
cues.en: and it wouldn't be long before Xiaoshuai recovered.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生肖恩竟然面临截肢风险！他让门外汉妻子给他做手术，这也太胆大了吧

cues.zh: 一场雨直接把火给浇灭了
cues.pinyin: yi1 chang2 yu3 zhi2 jie1 ba3 huo3 gei3 jiao1 mie4 le5
cues.en: A rainstorm put out the fire instantly.

cues.zh: 他们只能挫败地收拾收拾东西进帐篷
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi3 neng2 cuo4 bai4 di4 shou1 shi2 shou1 shi2 dong1 xi1 jin4 zhang4 peng2
cues.en: Frustrated, they could only pack up their things and get into the tent.

cues.zh: 什么也不能干就只能盖棉被睡觉了
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 ye3 bu4 neng2 gan4 jiu4 zhi3 neng2 gai4 mian2 bei4 shui4 jiao4 le5
cues.en: Unable to do anything else, they just had to cover up and sleep.

cues.zh: 可偏偏外面下雨的声音接连不断
cues.pinyin: ke3 pian1 pian1 wai4 mian4 xia4 yu3 de5 sheng1 yin1 jie1 lian2 bu4 duan4
cues.en: But the sound of rain outside wouldn't stop,

cues.zh: 俩人根本睡不着
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 gen1 ben3 shui4 bu4 zhe5
cues.en: and the two of them simply couldn't sleep.

cues.zh: 而且他们很快发现帐篷顶漏水了
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 hen3 kuai4 fa1 xian4 zhang4 peng2 ding3 lou4 shui3 le5
cues.en: On top of that, they soon found the tent roof was leaking.

cues.zh: 原本就不想来野营的丽雅爆发了
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ben3 jiu4 bu4 xiang3 lai2 ye3 ying2 de5 li4 ya3 bao4 fa1 le5
cues.en: Léa, who hadn't wanted to go camping in the first place, lost it.

cues.zh: 萧恩不想回家
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 bu4 xiang3 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Shaun didn't want to go home;

cues.zh: 要躺在冰冷潮湿的帐篷里就随她去
cues.pinyin: yao4 tang3 zai4 bing1 leng3 chao2 shi1 de5 zhang4 peng2 li3 jiu4 sui2 ta1 qu4
cues.en: if she wanted to lie in a cold, damp tent, that was her choice.

cues.zh: 丽雅直接抱着衣服跑到了车里
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 zhi2 jie1 bao4 zhe5 yi1 fu2 pao3 dao4 le5 che1 li3
cues.en: Léa grabbed her clothes and ran straight to the car,

cues.zh: 留下萧恩一个人孤独弱小还可怜
cues.pinyin: liu2 xia4 xiao1 en1 yi2 ge4 ren2 gu1 du2 ruo4 xiao3 hai2 ke3 lian2
cues.en: leaving Shaun alone, lonely, weak, and pitiful.

cues.zh: 不过第二天起来时
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 di4 er4 tian1 qi3 lai2 shi2
cues.en: But the next morning, when she woke up

cues.zh: 看见萧恩十分不安的给自己道歉时
cues.pinyin: kan4 jian4 xiao1 en1 shi2 fen1 bu4 an1 de5 gei3 zi4 ji3 dao4 qian4 shi2
cues.en: and saw how uneasy Shaun looked as he apologized to her,

cues.zh: 丽娅就后悔了
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 jiu4 hou4 hui3 le5
cues.en: Léa regretted it,

cues.zh: 表示愿意跟着她按照计划继续爬山去
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 yuan4 yi4 gen1 zhe5 ta1 an4 zhao4 ji4 hua4 ji4 xu4 pa2 shan1 qu4
cues.en: and said she was willing to keep going with him on the planned hike.

cues.zh: 可是他们这次旅行注定不会一帆风顺
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 zhe4 ci4 lv3 xing2 zhu4 ding4 bu2 hui4 yi1 fan1 feng1 shun4
cues.en: But their trip this time was destined not to go smoothly.

cues.zh: 萧恩在拍照时摔伤了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zai4 pai1 zhao4 shi2 shuai1 shang1 le5
cues.en: Shaun got hurt while taking a photo —

cues.zh: 脚踝处骨头错位
cues.pinyin: jiao3 huai2 chu4 gu3 tou5 cuo4 wei4
cues.en: the bones in his ankle were dislocated.

cues.zh: 扭正后她依旧感觉不到自己的脚趾
cues.pinyin: niu3 zheng4 hou4 ta1 yi1 jiu4 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 jiao3 zhi3
cues.en: Even after it was reset, he still couldn't feel his toes.

cues.zh: 看来是禁骨后动脉撕裂了
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 shi4 jin4 gu3 hou4 dong4 mai4 si1 lie4 le5
cues.en: It looked like the posterior tibial artery had been torn.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 女超人天生没有痛觉，十级电流都对她没用！天才医生都惊呆了，这病我不敢治啊！

cues.zh: 天生没有痛觉的人实在是太可怕了
cues.pinyin: tian1 sheng1 mei2 you3 tong4 jue2 de5 ren2 shi2 zai4 shi4 tai4 ke3 pa4 le5
cues.en: People born without the ability to feel pain are truly terrifying.

cues.zh: 小布他们收治了一个女患者开心姐
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 ta1 men5 shou1 zhi4 le5 yi2 ge4 nv3 huan4 zhe3 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: Xiao Bu and the team admitted a female patient, Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 这个患者看上去没什么不好
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 huan4 zhe3 kan4 shang4 qu4 mei2 shen2 me5 bu4 hao3
cues.en: This patient didn't look unwell at all.

cues.zh: 至少一点痛苦的表情都没有
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 yi4 dian3 tong4 ku3 de5 biao3 qing2 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: She didn't even show the slightest hint of pain on her face.

cues.zh: 医生们刚走到她的病床旁边
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gang1 zou3 dao4 ta1 de5 bing4 chuang2 pang2 bian1
cues.en: The doctors had just walked up to her bedside.

cues.zh: 还没来得及开始各项检查
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 lai2 de5 ji2 kai1 shi3 ge4 xiang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Before they could even start any examinations.

cues.zh: 开心姐就坐起来开始剧烈呕吐
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 jiu4 zuo4 qi3 lai2 kai1 shi3 ju4 lie4 ou3 tu4
cues.en: Sister Kaixin sat up and began vomiting violently.

cues.zh: 医生们赶紧把她按在床上做 B 超
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gan3 jin3 ba3 ta1 an4 zai4 chuang2 shang4 zuo4 B chao1
cues.en: The doctors quickly laid her down and did a B-ultrasound.

cues.zh: 不查不知道一查吓一跳
cues.pinyin: bu4 cha2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 yi1 cha2 xia4 yi1 tiao4
cues.en: They had no idea until they checked — and were shocked once they did.

cues.zh: 这开心姐居然阑尾都破裂了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kai1 xin1 jie3 ju1 ran2 lan2 wei3 dou1 po4 lie4 le5
cues.en: It turned out Sister Kaixin's appendix had ruptured.

cues.zh: 一般来说阑尾炎都会让人疼得满地打滚
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 lai2 shuo1 lan2 wei3 yan2 du1 hui4 rang4 ren2 teng2 de2 man3 di4 da3 gun3
cues.en: Normally, appendicitis alone makes people roll on the ground in pain.

cues.zh: 更何况是这大姐直接阑尾破裂
cues.pinyin: geng4 he2 kuang4 shi4 zhe4 da4 jie3 zhi2 jie1 lan2 wei3 po4 lie4
cues.en: Let alone this woman whose appendix had actually ruptured.

cues.zh: 那不疼死才怪了
cues.pinyin: na4 bu4 teng2 si3 cai2 guai4 le5
cues.en: It would be strange if that didn't hurt like hell.

cues.zh: 这大姐究竟是有什么超人的意志力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 da4 jie3 jiu1 jing4 shi4 you3 shen2 me5 chao1 ren2 de5 yi4 zhi4 li4
cues.en: Just what kind of superhuman willpower did this woman have.

cues.zh: 让她撑到现在啊
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 cheng1 dao4 xian4 zai4 a5
cues.en: To let her endure it until now.

cues.zh: 开心姐自己丝毫感觉不到肚子疼啊
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 zi4 ji3 si1 hao2 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 du3 zi5 teng2 a5
cues.en: Sister Kaixin herself felt no stomach pain at all.

cues.zh: 医生们给开心姐做完阑尾手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gei3 kai1 xin1 jie3 zuo4 wan2 lan2 wei3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: After the doctors finished her appendix surgery.

cues.zh: 觉得有必要帮她检查一下
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 you3 bi4 yao4 bang1 ta1 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: They felt it necessary to examine her further.

cues.zh: 感受不到疼痛究竟是什么情况
cues.pinyin: gan3 shou4 bu2 dao4 teng2 tong4 jiu1 jing4 shi4 shen2 me5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: To find out exactly why she couldn't feel pain.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 女超人天生没有痛觉，十级电流都对她没用！天才医生都惊呆了，这病我不敢治啊！

cues.zh: 这个检查就是功能性磁共振
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jian3 cha2 jiu4 shi4 gong1 neng2 xing4 ci2 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: This exam was a functional MRI.

cues.zh: 给开心姐一些刺激来看她大脑的反应
cues.pinyin: gei3 kai1 xin1 jie3 yi1 xie1 ci4 ji1 lai2 kan4 ta1 da4 nao3 de5 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Giving Sister Kaixin some stimuli to see how her brain responded.

cues.zh: 小布和阿雷带着开心姐开始做检查
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 he2 a1 lei2 dai4 zhe5 kai1 xin1 jie3 kai1 shi3 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Xiao Bu and A Lei took Sister Kaixin to begin the test.

cues.zh: 他们先给四级电流刺激
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xian1 gei3 si4 ji2 dian4 liu2 ci4 ji1
cues.en: They first gave her a level-4 electric current.

cues.zh: 发现开心姐毫无反应
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 kai1 xin1 jie3 hao2 wu2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: They found Sister Kaixin had no reaction at all.

cues.zh: 等电流开到五级的时候
cues.pinyin: deng3 dian4 liu2 kai1 dao4 wu3 ji2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When the current was raised to level 5.

cues.zh: 开心姐说可能有点疼
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 shuo1 ke3 neng2 you3 dian3 teng2
cues.en: Sister Kaixin said it might hurt a little.

cues.zh: 可是小布他们在监测画面里
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao3 bu4 ta1 men5 zai4 jian1 ce4 hua4 mian4 li3
cues.en: But on the monitoring screen, Xiao Bu and the others.

cues.zh: 却看不到脑电波有任何变化
cues.pinyin: que4 kan4 bu2 dao4 nao3 dian4 bo1 you3 ren4 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Couldn't see any change in her brain waves at all.

cues.zh: 他们一点点加大刺激
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi4 dian3 dian3 jia1 da4 ci4 ji1
cues.en: They kept increasing the stimulation bit by bit.

cues.zh: 八级九级
cues.pinyin: ba1 ji2 jiu3 ji2
cues.en: Level 8, level 9.

cues.zh: 一般人早就受不了口吐芬芳了
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 ren2 zao3 jiu4 shou4 bu4 liao3 kou3 tu3 fen1 fang1 le5
cues.en: Most people would've already been cursing up a storm by now.

cues.zh: 可是开心姐大脑对疼痛
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 kai1 xin1 jie3 da4 nao3 dui4 teng2 tong4
cues.en: But Sister Kaixin's brain, when it came to pain.

cues.zh: 完全做不出任何反应
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 zuo4 bu4 chu1 ren4 he2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Showed absolutely no reaction whatsoever.

cues.zh: 所以医生们断定
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 sheng1 men5 duan4 ding4
cues.en: So the doctors concluded.

cues.zh: 开心姐这辈子就没疼过
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 zhe4 bei4 zi5 jiu4 mei2 teng2 guo4
cues.en: Sister Kaixin had never felt pain in her entire life.

cues.zh: 她根本不知道
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ben3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: She had no idea at all.

cues.zh: 疼痛是一种什么样的感觉
cues.pinyin: teng2 tong4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: What kind of feeling pain actually was.

cues.zh: 实验结束了
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: The experiment was over.

cues.zh: 小布突然想多问开心姐几个问题
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 tu1 ran2 xiang3 duo1 wen4 kai1 xin1 jie3 ji3 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Xiao Bu suddenly wanted to ask Sister Kaixin a few more questions.

cues.zh: 她提起了开心姐的母亲的事情
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 qi3 le5 kai1 xin1 jie3 de5 mu3 qin1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: She brought up the matter of Sister Kaixin's mother.

cues.zh: 开心姐十分平静地给大家叙述
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 shi2 fen1 ping2 jing4 di4 gei3 da4 jia1 xu4 shu4
cues.en: Sister Kaixin calmly recounted to everyone.

cues.zh: 母亲是如何去世的
cues.pinyin: mu3 qin1 shi4 ru2 he2 qu4 shi4 de5
cues.en: How her mother had passed away.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 女超人天生没有痛觉，十级电流都对她没用！天才医生都惊呆了，这病我不敢治啊！

cues.zh: 但是没有痛觉的开心姐
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 you3 tong4 jue2 de5 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: But Sister Kaixin, who couldn't feel pain.

cues.zh: 完全意识不到问题的严重性
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 yi4 shi2 bu2 dao4 wen4 ti2 de5 yan2 zhong4 xing4
cues.en: Had no idea how serious the problem was.

cues.zh: 痛觉本身就是人类为了保护自己
cues.pinyin: tong4 jue2 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 ren2 lei4 wei4 le5 bao3 hu4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Pain itself is a bodily function that humans have.

cues.zh: 才有的身体机能
cues.pinyin: cai2 you3 de5 shen1 ti3 ji1 neng2
cues.en: In order to protect themselves.

cues.zh: 失去了这种能力
cues.pinyin: shi1 qu4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 neng2 li4
cues.en: Having lost this ability.

cues.zh: 看起来似乎少了很多
cues.pinyin: kan4 qi3 lai2 si4 hu1 shao3 le5 hen3 duo1
cues.en: Might seem like it removes a lot of.

cues.zh: 令人讨厌的麻烦
cues.pinyin: ling4 ren2 tao3 yan4 de5 ma2 fan2
cues.en: Annoying troubles.

cues.zh: 但是你却失去了身体最初
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 que4 shi1 qu4 le5 shen1 ti3 zui4 chu1
cues.en: But in fact, you've lost the body's very first.

cues.zh: 也是最后一道防线了
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 zui4 hou4 yi1 dao4 fang2 xian4 le5
cues.en: And also its very last line of defense.

cues.zh: 医生们将检查结果告诉开心姐
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jiang1 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 gao4 su4 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: The doctors told Sister Kaixin the test results.

cues.zh: 由于她不知道疼
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 ta1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 teng2
cues.en: Because she couldn't feel pain.

cues.zh: 所以右手已经严重感染了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you4 shou3 yi3 jing1 yan2 zhong4 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: Her right hand had already become severely infected.

cues.zh: 开心姐感到十分震惊
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 gan3 dao4 shi2 fen1 zhen4 jing1
cues.en: Sister Kaixin was utterly shocked.

cues.zh: 我能感觉到疼啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 neng2 gan3 jue2 dao4 teng2 a5
cues.en: "But I can feel pain!"

cues.zh: 阿雷问开心姐
cues.pinyin: a1 lei2 wen4 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: A Lei asked Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 你能感觉到我在掐你吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 gan3 jue2 dao4 wo3 zai4 qia1 ni3 ma5
cues.en: "Can you feel me pinching you right now?"

cues.zh: 开心姐说
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 shuo1
cues.en: Sister Kaixin said.

cues.zh: 我知道这就是疼啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 teng2 a5
cues.en: "I know this is pain."

cues.zh: 说我这个手劲掐小步的话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wo3 zhe4 ge5 shou3 jin4 qia1 xiao3 bu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: "If I pinched Xiao Bu this hard."

cues.zh: 她早就疼得跳起来骂娘了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zao3 jiu4 teng2 de2 tiao4 qi3 lai2 ma4 niang2 le5
cues.en: "She'd have jumped up and cursed from the pain long ago."

cues.zh: 你感觉到的是触觉不是痛觉啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 gan3 jue2 dao4 de5 shi4 chu4 jue2 bu2 shi4 tong4 jue2 a5
cues.en: "What you're feeling is touch, not pain."

cues.zh: 开心姐右手的感染太严重
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 you4 shou3 de5 gan3 ran3 tai4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: The infection in Sister Kaixin's right hand was too severe.

cues.zh: 只好截肢了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 jie2 zhi1 le5
cues.en: So it had to be amputated.

cues.zh: 她现在必须时刻关注自己的身体
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 bi4 xu1 shi2 ke4 guan1 zhu4 zi4 ji3 de5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: Now she has to constantly monitor her own body.

cues.zh: 任何一个瘀青
cues.pinyin: ren4 he2 yi2 ge4 yu1 qing1
cues.en: Any bruise.

cues.zh: 红肿都可能是严重的问题
cues.pinyin: hong2 zhong3 dou1 ke3 neng2 shi4 yan2 zhong4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Or swelling and redness could be a serious problem.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 女超人天生没有痛觉，十级电流都对她没用！天才医生都惊呆了，这病我不敢治啊！

cues.zh: 姐夫眼圈通红的问开心姐
cues.pinyin: jie3 fu1 yan3 quan1 tong1 hong2 de5 wen4 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: Her husband, eyes red, asked Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 我要是死了你会伤心吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 shi4 si3 le5 ni3 hui4 shang1 xin1 ma5
cues.en: "If I died, would you be sad?"

cues.zh: 开心姐也有点委屈
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 ye3 you3 dian3 wei3 qu1
cues.en: Sister Kaixin felt a bit wronged too.

cues.zh: 我爱你不想失去你
cues.pinyin: wo3 ai4 ni3 bu4 xiang3 shi1 qu4 ni3
cues.en: "I love you, I don't want to lose you."

cues.zh: 可是爱就必须伴随着痛苦吗
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ai4 jiu4 bi4 xu1 ban4 sui2 zhe5 tong4 ku3 ma5
cues.en: "But does love have to come with pain?"

cues.zh: 文艺中年的姐夫表示
cues.pinyin: wen2 yi4 zhong1 nian2 de5 jie3 fu1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Her sentimental, middle-aged husband replied.

cues.zh: 没有痛苦的爱情
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 tong4 ku3 de5 ai4 qing2
cues.en: "A love without pain."

cues.zh: 如何能让人刻骨铭心呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 he2 neng2 rang4 ren2 ke4 gu3 ming2 xin1 ne5
cues.en: "How could it ever be unforgettable?"

cues.zh: 姐夫十分伤心的离去了
cues.pinyin: jie3 fu1 shi2 fen1 shang1 xin1 de5 li2 qu4 le5
cues.en: Her husband walked away, heartbroken.

cues.zh: 此时此刻
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 ci3 ke4
cues.en: At that moment.

cues.zh: 她想静静
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 jing4 jing4
cues.en: She wanted some quiet time alone.

cues.zh: 看着姐夫离去
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 jie3 fu1 li2 qu4
cues.en: Watching her husband walk away.

cues.zh: 开心姐终于决定服药
cues.pinyin: kai1 xin1 jie3 zhong1 yu2 jue2 ding4 fu2 yao4
cues.en: Sister Kaixin finally decided to take the medication.

cues.zh: 她要治疗自己这种百痛不清的体质
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 zhi4 liao2 zi4 ji3 zhe4 zhong3 bai3 tong4 bu4 qing1 de5 ti3 zhi4
cues.en: She wanted to treat her condition of feeling no pain at all.

cues.zh: 要真切地感受到爱情给人带来的狂喜
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhen1 qie4 di4 gan3 shou4 dao4 ai4 qing2 gei3 ren2 dai4 lai2 de5 kuang2 xi3
cues.en: To truly feel the ecstasy that love brings people.

cues.zh: 和尸骨的痛楚
cues.pinyin: he2 shi1 gu3 de5 tong4 chu3
cues.en: And the heart-wrenching pain that comes with it too.

cues.zh: 因为她是真的不想失去姐夫啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 zhen1 de5 bu4 xiang3 shi1 qu4 jie3 fu1 a5
cues.en: Because she really didn't want to lose her husband.

cues.zh: 可是服药带来的影响
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 fu2 yao4 dai4 lai2 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: But the effects of the medication.

cues.zh: 很快就降临在开心姐身上
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 jiu4 jiang4 lin2 zai4 kai1 xin1 jie3 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Soon came crashing down on Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 她开始不开心了
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 shi3 bu4 kai1 xin1 le5
cues.en: She started to feel unhappy.

cues.zh: 阿雷和小布急匆匆地赶到开心姐的病床前
cues.pinyin: a1 lei2 he2 xiao3 bu4 ji2 cong1 cong1 di4 gan3 dao4 kai1 xin1 jie3 de5 bing4 chuang2 qian2
cues.en: A Lei and Xiao Bu rushed to Sister Kaixin's bedside.

cues.zh: 发现一向乐观
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 yi2 xiang4 le4 guan1
cues.en: And found that the usually optimistic.

cues.zh: 什么都无所谓的开心姐
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 dou1 wu2 suo3 wei4 de5 kai1 xin1 jie3
cues.en: Couldn't-care-less Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 竟然一脸生无可恋
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 yi1 lian3 sheng1 wu2 ke3 lian4
cues.en: Now looked utterly despondent.

cues.zh: 她现在心理落差非常大
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 xin1 li3 luo4 cha4 fei1 chang2 da4
cues.en: She was experiencing a huge psychological shift.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 女超人天生没有痛觉，十级电流都对她没用！天才医生都惊呆了，这病我不敢治啊！

cues.zh: 服药让她能逐渐感受到伤感

cues.zh: 可是这些感觉对于开心姐来说太陌生了

cues.zh: 负面情绪好像洪水猛兽一样向她袭来
cues.pinyin: fu4 mian4 qing2 xu4 hao3 xiang4 hong2 shui3 meng3 shou4 yi1 yang4 xiang4 ta1 xi2 lai2
cues.en: Negative emotions came crashing at her like a flood.

cues.zh: 她还没有完全准备好
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 zhun3 bei4 hao3
cues.en: She wasn't fully prepared for it yet.

cues.zh: 她还完全没有准备好
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 zhun3 bei4 hao3
cues.en: She wasn't prepared for it at all.

cues.zh: 已经快被压得抑郁了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 kuai4 bei4 ya1 de2 yi4 yu4 le5
cues.en: She was nearly crushed into depression.

cues.zh: 姐夫问小布
cues.pinyin: jie3 fu1 wen4 xiao3 bu4
cues.en: Her husband asked Xiao Bu.

cues.zh: 服用这些药物是不是能让开心姐以后
cues.pinyin: fu2 yong4 zhe4 xie1 yao4 wu4 shi4 bu2 shi4 neng2 rang4 kai1 xin1 jie3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: Would taking these medications let Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 生活得更安全
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 de2 geng4 an1 quan2
cues.en: Live more safely in the future.

cues.zh: 阿雷说开心姐服药不是为了自己更安全
cues.pinyin: a1 lei2 shuo1 kai1 xin1 jie3 fu2 yao4 bu2 shi4 wei4 le5 zi4 ji3 geng4 an1 quan2
cues.en: A Lei said Sister Kaixin wasn't taking the medication for her own safety.

cues.zh: 而是不想失去你
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 bu4 xiang3 shi1 qu4 ni3
cues.en: But because she didn't want to lose him.

cues.zh: 你们前半辈子都开开心心的不好吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 qian2 ban4 bei4 zi5 dou1 kai1 kai1 xin1 xin1 de5 bu4 hao3 ma5
cues.en: "Wasn't the first half of your lives together happy enough?"

cues.zh: 非要把生活变成穷瑶剧
cues.pinyin: fei1 yao4 ba3 sheng1 huo2 bian4 cheng2 qiong2 yao2 ju4
cues.en: "Did you really have to turn life into a Qiong Yao drama?"

cues.zh: 天天搞得你死我活

cues.en: "Making it some life-and-death struggle every day."

cues.zh: 悲伤逆流成河才是爱情吗
cues.pinyin: bei1 shang1 ni4 liu2 cheng2 he2 cai2 shi4 ai4 qing2 ma5
cues.en: "Is love only real when sorrow floods through like a river?"

cues.zh: 姐夫再次看到开心姐的时候
cues.pinyin: jie3 fu1 zai4 ci4 kan4 dao4 kai1 xin1 jie3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The next time her husband saw Sister Kaixin.

cues.zh: 她一点也不开心了
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 dian3 ye3 bu4 kai1 xin1 le5

cues.zh: 她手上缠着绷带
cues.pinyin: ta1 shou3 shang4 chan2 zhe5 beng1 dai4

cues.zh: 推着掉屏
cues.pinyin: tui1 zhe5 diao4 ping2
cues.en: She was pushing an IV drip stand.

cues.zh: 一脸伤感
cues.pinyin: yi1 lian3 shang1 gan3
cues.en: Looking sorrowful.

cues.zh: 看到开心姐夫的时候
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 kai1 xin1 jie3 fu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When she saw her husband.

cues.zh: 她扑上去抱着失而复得的丈夫
cues.pinyin: ta1 pu1 shang4 qu4 bao4 zhe5 shi1 er2 fu4 de5 de5 zhang4 fu1
cues.en: She rushed over and hugged the husband she thought she'd lost.

cues.zh: 哭得非常伤心
cues.pinyin: ku1 de2 fei1 chang2 shang1 xin1
cues.en: Crying very hard.

cues.zh: 这是姐夫第一次看到开心姐哭泣
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 jie3 fu1 di4 yi1 ci4 kan4 dao4 kai1 xin1 jie3 ku1 qi4
cues.en: This was the first time her husband had ever seen Sister Kaixin cry.

cues.zh: 各种点评事实

cues.zh: 的那种发言人

cues.zh: 他的肝脏有问题

cues.zh: 来医院进行治疗

cues.zh: 为了保险起见

cues.zh: 把医院医生的祖宗 18 代都调查了个清楚

cues.zh: 在了解了医院医生的背景之后

cues.zh: 明人书十分有品味的

cues.zh: 清点自闭症医生肖恩
cues.pinyin: qing1 dian3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 yi1 sheng1 xiao4 en1

cues.zh: 全权负责他的治疗

cues.zh: 可见这位大叔的口味相当独特
cues.pinyin: ke3 jian4 zhe4 wei4 da4 shu1 de5 kou3 wei4 xiang1 dang1 du2 te4
cues.en: It shows this man's taste is rather unique.

cues.zh: 马医生表示
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi1 sheng1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Dr. Ma said.

cues.zh: 明人书应该好好治疗一下
cues.pinyin: ming2 ren2 shu1 ying1 gai1 hao3 hao3 zhi4 liao2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Mingrenshu should properly treat.

cues.zh: 基因引发的肝损伤
cues.pinyin: ji1 yin1 yin3 fa1 de5 gan1 sun3 shang1
cues.en: The liver damage caused by his genetics.

cues.zh: 但是明人书说自己肝损伤不假

cues.en: But Mingrenshu said his liver damage was real, yes.

cues.zh: 但是自己是被人下毒

cues.zh: 才导致肝损伤的

cues.en: That's what led to the liver damage.

cues.zh: 医生们面面相去
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 mian4 mian4 xiang4 qu4
cues.en: The doctors looked at each other in bewilderment.

cues.zh: 要说别人被下毒可能性不大
cues.pinyin: yao4 shuo1 bie2 ren2 bei4 xia4 du2 ke3 neng2 xing4 bu4 da4
cues.en: It seemed unlikely that someone else would be poisoned.

cues.zh: 人还不知悔改

cues.zh: 天底下恨他的人没有一万也有八千
cues.pinyin: tian1 di3 xia4 hen4 ta1 de5 ren2 mei2 you3 yi1 wan4 ye3 you3 ba1 qian1
cues.en: There's no shortage of people in this world who hate him — easily eight or ten thousand.

cues.zh: 被人下毒的可能性也真不小呢
cues.pinyin: bei4 ren2 xia4 du2 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4 ye3 zhen1 bu4 xiao3 ne5
cues.en: So the chance of him being poisoned really isn't small at all.

cues.zh: 很快明音书的手术完成了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 ming2 yin1 shu1 de5 shou3 shu4 wan2 cheng2 le5
cues.en: Soon, Mingrenshu's surgery was completed.

cues.en: It turned out Xiaomei's little sister was pulling her hair.

cues.zh: 妈妈安慰小美说
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 an1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 shuo1
cues.en: Mom comforted Xiaomei, saying,

cues.zh: 哎不要哭妹妹还小
cues.pinyin: ai1 bu2 yao4 ku1 mei4 mei4 hai2 xiao3
cues.en: "Don't cry, your sister is still little.

cues.zh: 她不知道拉你的头发你会痛啦
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 la1 ni3 de5 tou2 fa4 ni3 hui4 tong4 la5
cues.en: She doesn't know pulling your hair hurts."

cues.zh: 一会儿传来小美妹妹的哭声
cues.pinyin: yi1 hui4 er5 chuan2 lai2 xiao3 mei3 mei4 mei4 de5 ku1 sheng1
cues.en: A while later, crying came from Xiaomei's little sister.

cues.zh: 妈妈问啊那妹妹怎么了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 wen4 a5 na4 mei4 mei4 zen3 me5 le5
cues.en: Mom asked, "What's wrong with your sister?"

cues.zh: 喘喘他知道会痛了
cues.pinyin: chuan3 chuan3 ta1 zhi1 dao4 hui4 tong4 le5
cues.en: "She said now she knows it hurts."

cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 lin1 zhe5 yi1 zhi1 ji1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: In the end, everyone went home carrying a chicken.

cues.zh: 大家都很开心
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 hen3 kai1 xin1
cues.en: Everyone was delighted,

cues.zh: 觉得老板真够意思
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 lao3 ban3 zhen1 gou4 yi4 si5
cues.en: thinking the owner was really generous.

cues.zh: 后来才知道
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 cai2 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Later they found out

cues.zh: 原来老板本来就是养鸡户
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 lao3 ban3 ben3 lai2 jiu4 shi4 yang3 ji1 hu4
cues.en: the owner was actually a chicken farmer.

cues.zh: 鸡养的太多又卖不出去
cues.pinyin: ji1 yang3 de5 tai4 duo1 you4 mai4 bu4 chu1 qu4
cues.en: He had raised too many chickens and couldn't sell them.

cues.zh: 这个钓鱼池根本里面没有放鱼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 diao4 yu2 chi2 gen1 ben3 li3 mian4 mei2 you3 fang4 yu2

cues.zh: 晨晨
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2
cues.en: Chenchen,

cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 龟兔赛跑
cues.pinyin: gui1 tu4 sai4 pao3

cues.zh: 猪当裁判

cues.zh: 谁赢

cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 na4 shi2 hou4 dang1 cai2 pan4 o2
cues.en: "So were you the referee back then?"

cues.zh: 有一天
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1
cues.en: One day,

cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 nan2 you3 da3 dian4 hua4 gei3 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Xiaomei's boyfriend called her,

cues.zh: 不过小美不在家
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 mei3 bu4 zai4 jia1
cues.en: but Xiaomei wasn't home,

cues.zh: 所以小美的妈妈帮她接电话
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 mei3 de5 ma1 ma1 bang1 ta1 jie1 dian4 hua4
cues.en: so Xiaomei's mom answered the phone for her.

cues.zh: 请问小美在家吗
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 xiao3 mei3 zai4 jia1 ma5
cues.en: "Is Xiaomei home?"

cues.zh: 不在
cues.pinyin: bu4 zai4
cues.en: "No."

cues.zh: 请问你贵姓
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 ni3 gui4 xing4
cues.en: "May I ask your surname?"

cues.zh: 我姓魏
cues.pinyin: wo3 xing4 wei4
cues.en: "My surname is Wei."

cues.zh: 魏为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Wei, why?"

cues.zh: 我也不知道啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 a5
cues.en: "I don't know either.

cues.zh: 因为我爸爸姓魏
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 ba4 ba4 xing4 wei4
cues.en: Because my dad's surname is Wei."

cues.zh: 给学生写

cues.zh: 错了

items.title_zh: 知名女网红患上罕见疾病，只有天才医生肖恩能治疗，但为此肖恩惹上大麻烦

cues.zh: 一个母亲误食了女儿的粪便
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 mu3 qin1 wu4 shi2 le5 nv3 er2 de5 fen4 bian4
cues.en: A mother accidentally ate her daughter's feces

cues.zh: 却因此救了女儿这是怎么一回事呢
cues.pinyin: que4 yin1 ci3 jiu4 le5 nv3 er2 zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 yi1 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: but this is what ended up saving her daughter — what happened?

cues.zh: 一大早小美因为严重腹部不适
cues.pinyin: yi1 da4 zao3 xiao3 mei3 yin1 wei4 yan2 zhong4 fu4 bu4 bu4 shi4
cues.en: Early one morning, Xiaomei was sent to the hospital

cues.zh: 被送进了医院
cues.pinyin: bei4 song4 jin4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: because of severe abdominal discomfort

cues.zh: 她还伴随着高热
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 ban4 sui2 zhe5 gao1 re4
cues.en: She also had a high fever,

cues.zh: 心动过速和血压过低等症状
cues.pinyin: xin1 dong4 guo4 su4 he2 xue4 ya1 guo4 di1 deng3 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: tachycardia, and low blood pressure, among other symptoms

cues.zh: 大中和布朗给她检查
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 he2 bu4 lang3 gei3 ta1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Dr. Han and Browne examined her

cues.zh: 腹部触痛伴有肿大而且有脱水现象
cues.pinyin: fu4 bu4 chu4 tong4 ban4 you3 zhong3 da4 er2 qie3 you3 tuo1 shui3 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: Her abdomen was tender and distended, and she showed signs of dehydration

cues.zh: 毛细血管再充盈迟缓小美呼吸频率过快
cues.pinyin: mao2 xi4 xue4 guan3 zai4 chong1 ying2 chi2 huan3 xiao3 mei3 hu1 xi1 pin2 lv4 guo4 kuai4
cues.en: Capillary refill was delayed and Xiaomei's breathing rate was too fast

cues.zh: 皮肤发冷发干她要休克了
cues.pinyin: pi2 fu1 fa1 leng3 fa1 gan4 ta1 yao4 xiu1 ke4 le5
cues.en: Her skin was cold and dry — she was going into shock

cues.zh: 两人立刻给她做急救措施
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 ji2 jiu4 cuo4 shi1
cues.en: The two immediately gave her emergency treatment

cues.zh: 推进广普抗生素
cues.pinyin: tui1 jin4 guang3 pu3 kang4 sheng1 su4
cues.en: administering broad-spectrum antibiotics

cues.zh: 插鼻胃管对腹腔减压
cues.pinyin: cha1 bi2 wei4 guan3 dui4 fu4 qiang1 jian3 ya1
cues.en: and inserting a nasogastric tube to decompress her abdomen

cues.zh: 经过一系列措施
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yi1 xi4 lie4 cuo4 shi1
cues.en: After a series of measures,

cues.zh: 小美的情况终于稳定下来了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4 zhong1 yu2 wen3 ding4 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei's condition finally stabilized

cues.zh: 她此刻躺在病房里
cues.pinyin: ta1 ci3 ke4 tang3 zai4 bing4 fang2 li3
cues.en: She was now lying in her hospital room

cues.zh: 超声波显示她的结肠肿大了
cues.pinyin: chao1 sheng1 bo1 xian3 shi4 ta1 de5 jie2 chang2 zhong3 da4 le5
cues.en: An ultrasound showed her colon was enlarged

cues.zh: 医生放了一根结肠管和鼻胃管释
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 fang4 le5 yi1 gen1 jie2 chang2 guan3 he2 bi2 wei4 guan3 shi4
cues.en: The doctors inserted a colonic tube and a nasogastric tube to

cues.zh: 放里面的压力
cues.pinyin: fang4 li3 mian4 de5 ya1 li4
cues.en: release the pressure inside

cues.zh: 但要对症下药
cues.pinyin: dan4 yao4 dui4 zheng4 xia4 yao4
cues.en: But to treat it properly,

cues.zh: 就必须要找到小美胀气的原因
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi4 xu1 yao4 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 mei3 zhang4 qi4 de5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: they had to find the cause of Xiaomei's bloating

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 知名女网红患上罕见疾病，只有天才医生肖恩能治疗，但为此肖恩惹上大麻烦

cues.zh: 但是小美之前并没有溃疡性结肠
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 zhi1 qian2 bing4 mei2 you3 kui4 yang2 xing4 jie2 chang2
cues.en: But Xiaomei had no prior history of ulcerative

cues.zh: 炎之类的病史
cues.pinyin: yan2 zhi1 lei4 de5 bing4 shi3
cues.en: colitis or anything similar

cues.zh: 暂时找不到病因
cues.pinyin: zan4 shi2 zhao3 bu2 dao4 bing4 yin1
cues.en: They couldn't find the cause for now

cues.zh: 医生就只能先给她注射抗生素
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jiu4 zhi3 neng2 xian1 gei3 ta1 zhu4 she4 kang4 sheng1 su4
cues.en: so the doctors could only give her antibiotics in the meantime

cues.zh: 由于小美是单亲妈妈
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 xiao3 mei3 shi4 dan1 qin1 ma1 ma1
cues.en: Since Xiaomei is a single mother,

cues.zh: 现在没有人能照顾才几岁的女儿
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 mei2 you3 ren2 neng2 zhao4 gu4 cai2 ji3 sui4 de5 nv3 er2
cues.en: there was now no one to look after her young daughter

cues.zh: 于是布朗打算去找个社工
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 bu4 lang3 da3 suan4 qu4 zhao3 ge4 she4 gong1
cues.en: so Browne decided to go find a social worker

cues.zh: 然后就带着小女孩出去了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 nv3 hai2 chu1 qu4 le5
cues.en: and took the little girl outside with him

cues.zh: 在等待社工过来的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 deng3 dai4 she4 gong1 guo4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While waiting for the social worker to arrive,

cues.zh: 小女孩突然说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 tu1 ran2 shuo1
cues.en: the little girl suddenly said,

cues.zh: 可接着她告诉布朗
cues.pinyin: ke3 jie1 zhe5 ta1 gao4 su4 bu4 lang3
cues.en: "I made mommy sick"

cues.zh: 布朗以为是小女孩难过
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 yi3 wei2 shi4 xiao3 nv3 hai2 nan2 guo4
cues.en: Browne assumed the little girl was just upset

cues.zh: 所以才这么说
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 zhe4 me5 shuo1
cues.en: and that's why she said it

cues.zh: 可接着他告诉布朗
cues.pinyin: ke3 jie1 zhe5 ta1 gao4 su4 bu4 lang3
cues.en: But then she told Browne,

cues.zh: 妈妈喝了我的粪便
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 he1 le5 wo3 de5 fen4 bian4
cues.en: "Mommy drank my poop"

cues.zh: 什么
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5
cues.en: "What?"

cues.zh: 布朗和一旁的接待员都惊了
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 he2 yi1 pang2 de5 jie1 dai4 yuan2 dou1 jing1 le5
cues.en: Browne and the receptionist nearby were both stunned

cues.zh: 布朗问了小美这件事
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 wen4 le5 xiao3 mei3 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: Browne asked Xiaomei about it

cues.zh: 这才得知事件的始末
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 de2 zhi1 shi4 jian4 de5 shi3 mo4
cues.en: and that's how he learned the whole story

cues.zh: 原来小美为了治疗自己的尿路感染
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 xiao3 mei3 wei4 le5 zhi4 liao2 zi4 ji3 de5 niao4 lu4 gan3 ran3
cues.en: It turned out that to treat her own urinary tract infection,

cues.zh: 按照网上的视频教程
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 wang3 shang4 de5 shi4 pin2 jiao4 cheng2
cues.en: Xiaomei had followed a video tutorial online

cues.zh: 用女儿的粪便做了家庭粪便移植
cues.pinyin: yong4 nv3 er2 de5 fen4 bian4 zuo4 le5 jia1 ting2 fen4 bian4 yi2 zhi2
cues.en: and used her daughter's feces to do a home fecal transplant

cues.zh: 粪便移植是一种通过重建肠道菌群
cues.pinyin: fen4 bian4 yi2 zhi2 shi4 yi1 zhong3 tong1 guo4 chong2 jian4 chang2 dao4 jun1 qun2
cues.en: A fecal transplant is a method that treats disease

cues.zh: 来治疗疾病的办法
cues.pinyin: lai2 zhi4 liao2 ji2 bing4 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: by rebuilding the gut microbiome

items.title_zh: 知名女网红患上罕见疾病，只有天才医生肖恩能治疗，但为此肖恩惹上大麻烦

cues.zh: 有出血状况
cues.pinyin: you3 chu1 xie3 zhuang4 kuang4
cues.en: There was bleeding

cues.zh: 得做肠切除
cues.pinyin: de2 zuo4 chang2 qie1 chu2

cues.zh: 组织移动时的张力

cues.zh: 造成了皮背膜撕裂

cues.zh: 得做皮切除

cues.zh: 切开连接部分

cues.zh: 此时实验室的小力

cues.zh: 却突然进来了
cues.pinyin: que4 tu1 ran2 jin4 lai2 le5
cues.en: suddenly came in

cues.zh: 化验结果让她等不了手术结束
cues.pinyin: hua4 yan4 jie2 guo3 rang4 ta1 deng3 bu4 liao3 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4

cues.en: The various readings indicated this couldn't possibly be a

cues.zh: 手术结束后
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the surgery ended,

cues.zh: 布朗给小女孩做了个检查
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 gei3 xiao3 nv3 hai2 zuo4 le5 ge4 jian3 cha2

cues.zh: 反而觉得她很酷
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 jue2 de5 ta1 hen3 ku4
cues.en: instead she thought he was really cool

cues.zh: 很可爱
cues.pinyin: hen3 ke3 ai4
cues.en: and really cute

cues.zh: 还给她拍了张照片
cues.pinyin: huan2 gei3 ta1 pai1 le5 zhang1 zhao4 pian1

cues.zh: 小薇的血肠规

cues.en: But Shaun wasn't discouraged

cues.zh: 反而很有斗志
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 hen3 you3 dou4 zhi4

cues.zh: 她对小薇的病症有很多猜想
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 xiao3 wei1 de5 bing4 zheng4 you3 hen3 duo1 cai1 xiang3

cues.zh: 并且打算一一针对检查
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 da3 suan4 yi1 yi1 zhen1 dui4 jian3 cha2

cues.zh: 不过一系列检查下来
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yi1 xi4 lie4 jian3 cha2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: But running the whole series of tests

cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 yao4 hua1 fei4 wu3 wan4

cues.zh: 黑哥显然不会让他这么做
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 xian3 ran2 bu2 hui4 rang4 ta1 zhe4 me5 zuo4

cues.zh: 如果只是个简单的胃酸反流

cues.en: then this wouldn't only be a matter of money

cues.zh: 他让肖恩给小薇开一些止痛药
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 xiao4 en1 gei3 xiao3 wei1 kai1 yi1 xie1 zhi3 tong4 yao4

cues.zh: 然后就让人回家

cues.en: But Xiaowei said it was fine

cues.zh: 他赚了不少钱
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhuan4 le5 bu4 shao3 qian2
cues.en: She'd earned quite a bit of money

cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 yun1 le5

cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 jin3 ji2 zuo4 yi1 xi4 lie4 ying4 dui4

cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 liang3 zhong3 qie1 kou3 fang1 shi4
cues.en: After Shaun brainstormed,

items.title_zh: 知名女网红患上罕见疾病，只有天才医生肖恩能治疗，但为此肖恩惹上大麻烦

cues.zh: 原来小薇是个网红
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 xiao3 wei1 shi4 ge4 wang3 hong2
cues.en: It turned out Xiaowei was an influencer

cues.zh: 她将萧恩就她的视频上传到了网上
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiang1 xiao1 en1 jiu4 ta1 de5 shi4 pin2 shang4 chuan2 dao4 le5 wang3 shang4
cues.en: She had uploaded a video of Shaun treating her online

cues.zh: 萧恩很快就火了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 huo3 le5
cues.en: and Shaun had quickly gone viral

cues.pinyin: gang1 cai2 na4 qun2 ren2 jiu4 shi4 mu4 ming2 er2 lai2 de5
cues.en: The crowd from earlier had come because of his newfound fame

cues.zh: 秉着医生的职责
cues.pinyin: bing3 zhe5 yi1 sheng1 de5 zhi2 ze2
cues.en: Upholding his duty as a doctor,

cues.zh: 萧恩老老实实地告诉了萧薇她的病情
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 lao3 lao3 shi2 shi2 di4 gao4 su4 le5 xiao1 wei1 ta1 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: Shaun honestly told Xiaowei about her condition

cues.zh: 说的过程中萧薇还想拍她
cues.pinyin: shuo1 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 xiao1 wei1 hai2 xiang3 pai1 ta1
cues.en: While he explained, Xiaowei tried to film him again

cues.zh: 但萧恩十分抗拒地捂住自己的脸
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 shi2 fen1 kang4 ju4 di4 wu3 zhu4 zi4 ji3 de5 lian3
cues.en: but Shaun, very reluctant, covered his own face

cues.zh: 黄姐只能接着她的话往下说
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 zhi3 neng2 jie1 zhe5 ta1 de5 hua4 wang3 xia4 shuo1
cues.en: Dr. Huang had to pick up where he left off

cues.zh: 小薇的茎突过长
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 jing1 tu1 guo4 chang2
cues.en: There were two surgical options,

cues.zh: 也就是两种筋口方式
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 liang3 zhong3 jin1 kou3 fang1 shi4
cues.en: that is, two different approaches for the incision

cues.zh: 一个是从嘴巴进入
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 cong2 zui3 ba1 jin4 ru4
cues.en: One was entering through the mouth

cues.zh: 这种是非侵入型的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 fei1 qin1 ru4 xing2 de5
cues.en: This one is non-invasive,

cues.zh: 但手术有挑战性
cues.pinyin: dan4 shou3 shu4 you3 tiao3 zhan4 xing4
cues.en: but the surgery is challenging

cues.zh: 因为不易操作
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 bu4 yi4 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: because it's hard to operate

cues.zh: 而且有视觉障碍
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you3 shi4 jue2 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: and there's limited visibility

cues.zh: 另外一种就是筋弓颈手术
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3 jiu4 shi4 jin1 gong1 jing3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The other option is a transcervical approach,

cues.zh: 脖子上会有一个切口
cues.pinyin: bo2 zi5 shang4 hui4 you3 yi2 ge4 qie1 kou3
cues.en: which leaves an incision on the neck

cues.zh: 疤痕会挺大的
cues.pinyin: ba1 hen2 hui4 ting3 da4 de5
cues.en: and the scar would be fairly large

cues.zh: 几个医生在办公室
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: Several doctors gathered in the office

cues.zh: 讨论小微的手术方案
cues.pinyin: tao3 lun4 xiao3 wei1 de5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: to discuss Xiaowei's surgical plan

cues.zh: 小微的筋突过长
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 jin1 tu1 guo4 chang2
cues.en: Xiaowei's styloid process was too long

cues.zh: 很靠近神经和颈动脉
cues.pinyin: hen3 kao4 jin4 shen2 jing1 he2 jing3 dong4 mai4
cues.en: and sat very close to the nerves and carotid artery

cues.zh: 难点在于接触过长的部分
cues.pinyin: nan2 dian3 zai4 yu2 jie1 chu4 guo4 chang2 de5 bu4 fen4
cues.en: The difficulty lay in removing the overly long section

cues.zh: 还不能损伤局部神经血管结构
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu4 neng2 sun3 shang1 ju2 bu4 shen2 jing1 xue4 guan3 jie2 gou4
cues.en: without damaging the surrounding nerve and blood vessel structures

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 这是史上最敬业的代孕妈妈
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shi3 shang4 zui4 jing4 ye4 de5 dai4 yun4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: This is the most dedicated surrogate mother ever.

cues.zh: 为了帮别人生孩子
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bang1 bie2 ren2 sheng1 hai2 zi5
cues.en: To help someone else have a baby,

cues.zh: 甚至不惜牺牲自己的生命
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 bu4 xi1 xi1 sheng1 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: she was even willing to sacrifice her own life.

cues.zh: 肖恩的医院接诊了一名名叫格雷斯的孕妇
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 de5 yi1 yuan4 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi1 ming2 ming2 jiao4 ge2 lei2 si1 de5 yun4 fu4
cues.en: Shaun's hospital admitted a pregnant woman named Grace.

cues.zh: 她下身出血了
cues.pinyin: ta1 xia4 shen1 chu1 xie3 le5
cues.en: She was bleeding.

cues.zh: 这可是流产的先兆啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 shi4 liu2 chan3 de5 xian1 zhao4 a5
cues.en: That's a sign of a possible miscarriage!

cues.zh: 陪同格雷斯一起来的小美明显有点着急
cues.pinyin: pei2 tong2 ge2 lei2 si1 yi4 qi3 lai2 de5 xiao3 mei3 ming2 xian3 you3 dian3 zhao2 ji2
cues.en: Xiaomei, who came with Grace, was clearly anxious.

cues.zh: 可格雷斯却十分淡定
cues.pinyin: ke3 ge2 lei2 si1 que4 shi2 fen1 dan4 ding4
cues.en: But Grace stayed completely calm.

cues.zh: 她安慰小美说自己生了五个孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 an1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 shuo1 zi4 ji3 sheng1 le5 wu3 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She reassured Xiaomei, saying she'd already given birth to five children,

cues.zh: 都健健康康的
cues.pinyin: dou1 jian4 jian4 kang1 kang1 de5
cues.en: and all of them were perfectly healthy.

cues.zh: 出血这点小阵仗格雷斯从来没放在心上
cues.pinyin: chu1 xie3 zhe4 dian3 xiao3 zhen4 zhang4 ge2 lei2 si1 cong2 lai2 mei2 fang4 zai4 xin1 shang4
cues.en: A little bleeding like this was nothing Grace ever worried about.

cues.zh: 这一番话引起了现场所有医护人员的敬意
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 fan1 hua4 yin3 qi3 le5 xian4 chang3 suo3 you3 yi1 hu4 ren2 yuan2 de5 jing4 yi4
cues.en: Her words earned the respect of every medical staff member on scene.

cues.zh: 这位格雷斯竟然已经生了五个孩子了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 ge2 lei2 si1 jing4 ran2 yi3 jing1 sheng1 le5 wu3 ge4 hai2 zi5 le5
cues.en: This Grace had actually already given birth to five children.

cues.zh: 爱情真是伟大
cues.pinyin: ai4 qing2 zhen1 shi4 wei3 da4
cues.en: Love is truly amazing.

cues.zh: 小美赶紧解释
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 gan3 jin3 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Xiaomei quickly explained,

cues.zh: 他们不是情侣
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu2 shi4 qing2 lv3
cues.en: they weren't a couple.

cues.zh: 格雷斯只是一名专业代孕妈妈
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 zhi3 shi4 yi1 ming2 zhuan1 ye4 dai4 yun4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: Grace was simply a professional surrogate mother.

cues.zh: 这一次她帮小美生孩子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ta1 bang1 xiao3 mei3 sheng1 hai2 zi5
cues.en: This time, she was carrying a baby for Xiaomei.

cues.zh: B 超检查可以看出孩子十分健康
cues.pinyin: B chao1 jian3 cha2 ke3 yi3 kan4 chu1 hai2 zi5 shi2 fen1 jian4 kang1
cues.en: The ultrasound showed the baby was perfectly healthy.

cues.zh: 大家都安心地笑了
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 an1 xin1 di4 xiao4 le5
cues.en: Everyone smiled with relief.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 可下一秒所有人就笑不出来
cues.pinyin: ke3 xia4 yi1 miao3 suo3 you3 ren2 jiu4 xiao4 bu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: But a second later, no one could smile anymore,

cues.zh: 因为格雷斯捂着肚子开始喊疼了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ge2 lei2 si1 wu3 zhe5 du3 zi5 kai1 shi3 han3 teng2 le5
cues.en: because Grace clutched her belly and cried out in pain.

cues.zh: 艾伦赶紧给他安排进一步的检查
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 gan3 jin3 gei3 ta1 an1 pai2 jin4 yi2 bu4 de5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Aaron quickly arranged further tests for her.

cues.zh: 很快检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The results soon came back.

cues.zh: 一切看起来都很正常
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 kan4 qi3 lai2 dou1 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: Everything looked normal.

cues.zh: 没有胎盘植入
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 tai1 pan2 zhi2 ru4
cues.en: No placenta accreta.

cues.zh: 也没有胎盘前置
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 you3 tai1 pan2 qian2 zhi4
cues.en: No placenta previa either.

cues.zh: 按理说不应该有剧烈的疼痛才对啊
cues.pinyin: an4 li3 shuo1 bu4 ying1 gai1 you3 ju4 lie4 de5 teng2 tong4 cai2 dui4 a5
cues.en: By all accounts, there shouldn't have been such intense pain.

cues.zh: 艾伦对这个待遇妈妈格雷斯十分有好感
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 dui4 zhe4 ge5 dai4 yu4 ma1 ma1 ge2 lei2 si1 shi2 fen1 you3 hao3 gan3
cues.en: Aaron had great admiration for Grace, this surrogate mother,

cues.zh: 毕竟她用自己的子宫帮五个家庭圆了梦
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 ta1 yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 zi5 gong1 bang1 wu3 ge4 jia1 ting2 yuan2 le5 meng4
cues.en: after all, she'd used her own womb to make dreams come true for five families.

cues.zh: 可乌尔克医生指出无论什么原因
cues.pinyin: ke3 wu1 er3 ke4 yi1 sheng1 zhi3 chu1 wu2 lun4 shen2 me5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: But Dr. Wolke pointed out that no matter the reason,

cues.zh: 待遇都是违法行为
cues.pinyin: dai4 yu4 dou1 shi4 wei2 fa3 xing2 wei2
cues.en: surrogacy was illegal.

cues.zh: 就在两人争论不休的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 liang3 ren2 zheng1 lun4 bu4 xiu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Just as the two of them kept arguing,

cues.zh: 艾伦突然停了下来
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 tu1 ran2 ting2 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Aaron suddenly stopped.

cues.zh: 他盯着格雷斯的片子发呆
cues.pinyin: ta1 ding1 zhe5 ge2 lei2 si1 de5 pian1 zi5 fa1 dai1
cues.en: He stared blankly at Grace's scans,

cues.zh: 好像发现了什么奇怪的东西
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiang4 fa1 xian4 le5 shen2 me5 qi2 guai4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: as if he'd noticed something strange.

cues.zh: 检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The test results came in.

cues.zh: 格雷斯的子宫附近有一个膀胱肉瘤
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 de5 zi5 gong1 fu4 jin4 you3 yi2 ge4 pang2 guang1 rou4 liu2
cues.en: Grace had a bladder sarcoma near her uterus.

cues.zh: 格雷斯很好奇
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 hen3 hao4 qi2
cues.en: Grace was puzzled,

cues.zh: 自己待遇以前都会做详细检查
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 dai4 yu4 yi3 qian2 du1 hui4 zuo4 xiang2 xi4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: since she always had thorough checkups before every surrogacy,

cues.zh: 那时候都是好好的
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou4 dou1 shi4 hao3 hao3 de5
cues.en: and everything had always been fine back then.

cues.zh: 而安德鲁斯告诉他
cues.pinyin: er2 an1 de2 lu3 si1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Andrews told her

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 切掉肿瘤然后重建他的膀胱
cues.pinyin: qie4 diao4 zhong3 liu2 ran2 hou4 chong2 jian4 ta1 de5 pang2 guang1
cues.en: they needed to remove the tumor and reconstruct her bladder.

cues.zh: 可是格雷斯还是不愿意认命
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ge2 lei2 si1 hai2 shi4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 ren4 ming4
cues.en: But Grace still refused to accept her fate.

cues.zh: 看着格雷斯一脸痛苦
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 ge2 lei2 si1 yi1 lian3 tong4 ku3
cues.en: Seeing Grace in so much pain,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯突然想到了一个比较另
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 tu1 ran2 xiang3 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 ling4
cues.en: Andrews suddenly thought of a rather unconventional

cues.zh: 类的治疗方案
cues.pinyin: lei4 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: treatment option.

cues.zh: 那就是通过一个实验性的膀胱镜
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 shi2 yan4 xing4 de5 pang2 guang1 jing4
cues.en: It involved an experimental cystoscopy

cues.zh: 手术清除肿疗
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 qing1 chu2 zhong3 liao2
cues.en: procedure to remove the tumor.

cues.zh: 可这个手术也有一定几率造成孩子流产
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 ye3 you3 yi2 ding4 ji1 lv4 zao4 cheng2 hai2 zi5 liu2 chan3
cues.en: But the surgery also carried some risk of causing a miscarriage.

cues.zh: 让她终止妊娠乖乖做手术
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zhong1 zhi3 ren4 shen1 guai1 guai1 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiaomei, standing by, couldn't stand to listen anymore.

cues.zh: 就连她都开始劝格雷斯
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 ta1 dou1 kai1 shi3 quan4 ge2 lei2 si1
cues.en: Even she started urging Grace

cues.zh: 让她终止人生乖乖做手术
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zhong1 zhi3 ren2 sheng1 guai1 guai1 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: to terminate the pregnancy and just have the surgery.

cues.zh: 可格雷斯抚摸着肚子
cues.pinyin: ke3 ge2 lei2 si1 fu3 mo1 zhe5 du3 zi5
cues.en: But Grace just stroked her belly,

cues.zh: 感受着里面小家伙的生命力
cues.pinyin: gan3 shou4 zhe5 li3 mian4 xiao3 jia1 huo5 de5 sheng1 ming4 li4
cues.en: feeling the little one's vitality inside.

cues.zh: 她终于做了一个违背现实的决定
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhong1 yu2 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 wei2 bei4 xian4 shi2 de5 jue2 ding4
cues.en: She finally made a decision that defied reality.

cues.zh: 医生们还想再劝
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 hai2 xiang3 zai4 quan4
cues.en: The doctors wanted to persuade her further,

cues.zh: 可是格雷斯心意已决
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ge2 lei2 si1 xin1 yi4 yi3 jue2
cues.en: but Grace's mind was made up.

cues.zh: 她表示只要自己能活到孩子生下
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 shi4 zhi3 yao4 zi4 ji3 neng2 huo2 dao4 hai2 zi5 sheng1 xia4
cues.en: She said as long as she could live until the baby was born,

cues.zh: 那一刻就够了
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 ke4 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: that moment would be enough.

cues.zh: 小美有点受不了了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 you3 dian3 shou4 bu4 liao3 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei couldn't bear it anymore.

cues.zh: 第一次见为了帮别人生孩子而
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 jian4 wei4 le5 bang1 bie2 ren2 sheng1 hai2 zi5 er2
cues.en: It was the first time she'd seen someone

cues.zh: 抛弃性命的人
cues.pinyin: pao1 qi4 xing4 ming4 de5 ren2
cues.en: give up their own life just to help someone else have a baby.

cues.zh: 这是用命赌命啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yong4 ming4 du3 ming4 a5
cues.en: This was gambling one life for another.

cues.zh: 在收拾手术室的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou1 shi2 shou3 shu4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While tidying up the operating room,

cues.zh: 艾伦突然想明白了
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 tu1 ran2 xiang3 ming2 bai2 le5
cues.en: Aaron suddenly understood,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 用自己的命换一个健康孩子的出生
cues.pinyin: yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 ming4 huan4 yi2 ge4 jian4 kang1 hai2 zi5 de5 chu1 sheng1
cues.en: trading her own life for the birth of a healthy child.

cues.zh: 乌尔克听不下去了
cues.pinyin: wu1 er3 ke4 ting1 bu4 xia4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Wolke couldn't take it anymore.

cues.zh: 她打断了格雷斯的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 da3 duan4 le5 ge2 lei2 si1 de5 hua4
cues.en: She cut Grace off.

cues.zh: 你以为自己的举动很伟大吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 de5 ju3 dong4 hen3 wei3 da4 ma5
cues.en: Do you think what you're doing is noble?

cues.zh: 其实你害了小美
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ni3 hai4 le5 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Actually, you're hurting Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 小美真的希望你用自己的命换孩子的命吗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 zhen1 de5 xi1 wang4 ni3 yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 ming4 huan4 hai2 zi5 de5 ming4 ma5
cues.en: Does Xiaomei really want you to trade your life for the baby's?

cues.zh: 如果你为了帮小美生孩子而死
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 wei4 le5 bang1 xiao3 mei3 sheng1 hai2 zi5 er2 si3
cues.en: If you die trying to have this baby for Xiaomei,

cues.zh: 那小美应该如何自处
cues.pinyin: na4 xiao3 mei3 ying1 gai1 ru2 he2 zi4 chu4
cues.en: how is Xiaomei supposed to live with that?

cues.zh: 她应该如何面对那个用一条人
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying1 gai1 ru2 he2 mian4 dui4 na4 ge5 yong4 yi1 tiao2 ren2
cues.en: How is she supposed to face a child

cues.zh: 命换来的孩子
cues.pinyin: ming4 huan4 lai2 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: bought with someone's life?

cues.zh: 格雷斯愣住了
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 leng4 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Grace was stunned.

cues.zh: 显然这些她都没想过
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 zhe4 xie1 ta1 dou1 mei2 xiang3 guo4
cues.en: Clearly, she'd never thought about any of this.

cues.zh: 艾伦建议她选择膀胱镜手术
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 jian4 yi4 ta1 xuan3 ze2 pang2 guang1 jing4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Aaron suggested she go with the cystoscopy surgery,

cues.zh: 毕竟那是唯一一个能去除肿瘤
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 na4 shi4 wei2 yi1 yi2 ge4 neng2 qu4 chu2 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: since it was the only option that could remove the tumor

cues.zh: 又可以大概率保住孩子的方法
cues.pinyin: you4 ke3 yi3 da4 gai4 lv4 bao3 zhu4 hai2 zi5 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: while still giving the baby a good chance of survival.

cues.zh: 格雷斯终于同意了
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 zhong1 yu2 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Grace finally agreed.

cues.zh: 膀胱镜手术开始
cues.pinyin: pang2 guang1 jing4 shou3 shu4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: The cystoscopy surgery began.

cues.zh: 格雷斯的肿瘤比大家想象中还要复杂
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 de5 zhong3 liu2 bi3 da4 jia1 xiang3 xiang4 zhong1 hai2 yao4 fu4 za2
cues.en: Grace's tumor turned out to be more complicated than anyone expected.

cues.zh: 很快书中的出血量就超出预期
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 shu1 zhong1 de5 chu1 xie3 liang4 jiu4 chao1 chu1 yu4 qi1
cues.en: Soon the bleeding during the surgery exceeded expectations.

cues.zh: 格雷斯虚压快速下降
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 xu1 ya1 kuai4 su4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Grace's blood pressure dropped rapidly.

cues.zh: 孩子在子宫内窘迫
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 zai4 zi5 gong1 nei4 jiong3 po4
cues.en: The baby went into fetal distress in the womb.

cues.zh: 随时有窒息的风险
cues.pinyin: sui2 shi2 you3 zhi4 xi1 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: There was a risk of suffocation at any moment.

cues.zh: 医生们赶紧在肿瘤表面用双击烧灼止血
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gan3 jin3 zai4 zhong3 liu2 biao3 mian4 yong4 shuang1 ji1 shao1 zhuo2 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: The doctors rushed to cauterize the tumor's surface with bipolar electrocautery to stop the bleeding,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 却发现根本没用
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 gen1 ben3 mei2 yong4
cues.en: but found it was completely useless.

cues.zh: 再这样下去
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 yang4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: If this continued,

cues.zh: 当然和孩子都保不住了
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 he2 hai2 zi5 dou1 bao3 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: they were afraid neither Grace nor the baby could be saved.

cues.zh: 膀胱进手术宣告失败
cues.pinyin: pang2 guang1 jin4 shou3 shu4 xuan1 gao4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: The cystoscopy surgery was declared a failure.

cues.zh: 医生们只好选择开刀
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 zhi3 hao3 xuan3 ze2 kai1 dao1
cues.en: The doctors had no choice but to switch to open surgery.

cues.zh: 等医生们打开了格雷斯的腹腔才发现
cues.pinyin: deng3 yi1 sheng1 men5 da3 kai1 le5 ge2 lei2 si1 de5 fu4 qiang1 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Once they opened Grace's abdomen, they discovered

cues.zh: 肿瘤已经粘着在子宫壁上了
cues.pinyin: zhong3 liu2 yi3 jing1 zhan1 zhe5 zai4 zi5 gong1 bi4 shang4 le5
cues.en: the tumor had already attached itself to the uterine wall.

cues.zh: 这样必须做紧急子宫切除
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 bi4 xu1 zuo4 jin3 ji2 zi5 gong1 qie1 chu2
cues.en: This meant an emergency hysterectomy was necessary.

cues.zh: 格雷斯不但保不住孩子
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 bu4 dan4 bao3 bu2 zhu4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Not only could Grace not keep the baby,

cues.zh: 连子宫都要失去了
cues.pinyin: lian2 zi5 gong1 dou1 yao4 shi1 qu4 le5
cues.en: she was going to lose her uterus too.

cues.zh: 这是艾伦提出了新的治疗方案
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ai4 lun2 ti2 chu1 le5 xin1 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: At this point, Aaron proposed a new treatment plan:

cues.zh: 从肿瘤的根源止血
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhong3 liu2 de5 gen1 yuan2 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: stop the bleeding at the tumor's source.

cues.zh: 这样对孕妇来说是好事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 dui4 yun4 fu4 lai2 shuo1 shi4 hao3 shi4
cues.en: This would be good for the mother,

cues.zh: 可是对孩子却不太好
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dui4 hai2 zi5 que4 bu4 tai4 hao3
cues.en: but not so good for the baby.

cues.zh: 乌尔克突发奇想
cues.pinyin: wu1 er3 ke4 tu1 fa1 qi2 xiang3
cues.en: Wolke suddenly had an idea.

cues.zh: 要不咱干脆把子宫避缝上
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 zan2 gan1 cui4 ba3 zi5 gong1 bi4 feng4 shang4
cues.en: What if they just stitched the cervix shut,

cues.zh: 让孩子在里面掉不出来怎么样
cues.pinyin: rang4 hai2 zi5 zai4 li3 mian4 diao4 bu4 chu1 lai2 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: so the baby couldn't fall out?

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯十分满意
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 shi2 fen1 man3 yi4
cues.en: Andrews was very pleased with the idea.

cues.zh: 要不咱干脆把子宫颈缝上
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 zan2 gan1 cui4 ba3 zi5 gong1 jing3 feng4 shang4
cues.en: The doctors hurried to remove the tumor.

cues.zh: 最后的结果是令人满意的
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 de5 jie2 guo3 shi4 ling4 ren2 man3 yi4 de5
cues.en: The final result was satisfying.

cues.zh: 手术圆满成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 yuan2 man3 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery was a complete success.

cues.zh: 格雷斯的肿瘤成功解除
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 si1 de5 zhong3 liu2 cheng2 gong1 jie3 chu2
cues.en: Grace's tumor was successfully removed,

cues.zh: 孩子也一气安好
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 ye3 yi1 qi4 an1 hao3
cues.en: and the baby was completely fine too.

cues.zh: 孕妇的问题刚解决
cues.pinyin: yun4 fu4 de5 wen4 ti2 gang1 jie3 jue2
cues.en: No sooner had the pregnant woman's problem been resolved

cues.zh: 小胖哥又被送进医院
cues.pinyin: xiao3 pang4 ge1 you4 bei4 song4 jin4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: than Chubby was rushed to the hospital.

cues.zh: 他是因为跑步的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yin1 wei4 pao3 bu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: He'd been running

cues.zh: 晕倒碰到了头
cues.pinyin: yun1 dao3 peng4 dao4 le5 tou2
cues.en: when he fainted and hit his head.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 这是史上最负责的代孕妈妈，为了帮别人生孩子，命都可以不要！【良医第五季】

cues.zh: 笑音一开始以为小胖哥只是脑炎
cues.pinyin: xiao4 yin1 yi1 kai1 shi3 yi3 wei2 xiao3 pang4 ge1 zhi3 shi4 nao3 yan2
cues.en: At first, Shaun thought Chubby just had encephalitis,

cues.zh: 可仔细看片子却发现
cues.pinyin: ke3 zi3 xi4 kan4 pian1 zi5 que4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: but a close look at the scans showed

cues.zh: 头颅扫描并没有脑炎的病灶
cues.pinyin: tou2 lu2 sao3 miao2 bing4 mei2 you3 nao3 yan2 de5 bing4 zao4
cues.en: the head scan showed no sign of encephalitis.

cues.zh: 头部的片子没问题
cues.pinyin: tou2 bu4 de5 pian1 zi5 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The head scan was fine.

cues.zh: 咽血没问题
cues.pinyin: yan4 xue4 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The blood tests were fine.

cues.zh: 难道是心脏出了问题吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shi4 xin1 zang4 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2 ma5
cues.en: Could it be a heart problem?

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯决定给小胖哥安排摇杆侦测
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 jue2 ding4 gei3 xiao3 pang4 ge1 an1 pai2 yao2 gan1 zhen1 ce4
cues.en: Andrews decided to order a cardiac monitoring test for Chubby

cues.zh: 看看心脏的情况
cues.pinyin: kan4 kan4 xin1 zang4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: to check on his heart.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯这个花影刚落
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 zhe4 ge5 hua1 ying3 gang1 luo4
cues.en: No sooner had Andrews said this

cues.zh: 就对上肖恩那一双满汗的萎缜眼睛
cues.pinyin: jiu4 dui4 shang4 xiao4 en1 na4 yi1 shuang1 man3 han4 de5 wei1 zhen3 yan3 jing1
cues.en: than he met Shaun's bloodshot, exhausted eyes.

items.title_zh: 笑话56｜拉肚子｜新老公｜走到大路｜错误会变强壮｜见一个爱一个｜忘了你是猪｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明有一天肚子痛上公厕第一间有人
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 you3 yi1 tian1 du4 zi5 tong4 shang4 gong1 ce4 di4 yi1 jian1 you3 ren2
cues.en: One day Xiaoming had a stomachache and went to the public restroom — the first stall was occupied.

cues.zh: 于是他就去上了第二间刚要上时
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 qu4 shang4 le5 di4 er4 jian1 gang1 yao4 shang4 shi2
cues.en: So he went into the second stall, and just as he was about to go,

cues.zh: 就听到隔壁的人说嗨怎么样啊你还好吗
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ting1 dao4 ge2 bi4 de5 ren2 shuo1 hai1 zen3 me5 yang4 a5 ni3 hai2 hao3 ma5
cues.en: he heard the person next door say, "Hey, how's it going? You doing okay?"

cues.zh: 小明觉得隔着厕所和陌生人交谈怪怪的
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 jue2 de5 ge2 zhe5 ce4 suo3 he2 mo4 sheng1 ren2 jiao1 tan2 guai4 guai4 de5
cues.en: Xiaoming thought it was weird to chat with a stranger through the stall wall,

cues.zh: 但却又怕失礼还是回答了哦还好啦
cues.pinyin: dan4 que4 you4 pa4 shi1 li3 hai2 shi4 hui2 da2 le5 o2 hai2 hao3 la5
cues.en: but afraid of seeming rude, he still answered, "Oh, I'm fine."

cues.zh: 这时隔壁的人又说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ge2 bi4 de5 ren2 you4 shuo1
cues.en: Then the person next door said again,

cues.zh: 啊你最近都在做什么啊
cues.pinyin: a5 ni3 zui4 jin4 dou1 zai4 zuo4 shen2 me5 a5
cues.en: "So what have you been up to lately?"

cues.zh: 小明虽然还是觉得怪怪的
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 sui1 ran2 hai2 shi4 jue2 de5 guai4 guai4 de5
cues.en: Even though Xiaoming still felt it was strange,

cues.zh: 不过还是回答我正要去
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hai2 shi4 hui2 da2 wo3 zheng4 yao4 qu4
cues.en: he answered anyway, "I'm just about to go..."

cues.zh: 去拜访客户啊
cues.pinyin: qu4 bai4 fang3 ke4 hu4 a5
cues.en: "...visit a client."

cues.zh: 这时听到隔壁的人又说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ting1 dao4 ge2 bi4 de5 ren2 you4 shuo1
cues.en: Then he heard the person next door say,

cues.zh: 欸我等一下再打给你啦
cues.pinyin: ai1 wo3 deng3 yi2 xia4 zai4 da3 gei3 ni3 la5
cues.en: "Hey, I'll call you back later.

cues.zh: 我旁边有一个神经病
cues.pinyin: wo3 pang2 bian1 you3 yi2 ge4 shen2 jing1 bing4
cues.en: There's a lunatic next to me —

cues.zh: 我每次和你说话
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 ci4 he2 ni3 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: every time I talk to you,

cues.zh: 他都抢著回答
cues.pinyin: ta1 dou1 qiang3 zhu4 hui2 da2
cues.en: he keeps jumping in to answer."

cues.zh: 你知道

cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 zhi1 xin1 mai3 de5 gou3 you3 shen2 me5 bu4 tong2 ma5
cues.en: between a new husband and a newly bought dog?

cues.pinyin: xin1 mai3 de5 gou3 yi1 nian2 hou4 kan4 dao4 ni3
cues.en: A year after you buy the dog, when it sees you,

cues.zh: 还是很兴奋
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 hen3 xing1 fen4
cues.en: it's still just as excited.

cues.pinyin: ni3 xiang1 xin4 wo3 neng2 zi4 ji3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zou3 dao4 da4 lu4 ma5
cues.en: Do you believe I can walk to the main road all by myself?

cues.zh: 怎么可能
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 ke3 neng2
cues.en: How could that be possible?

cues.zh: 当然不相信啊
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 bu4 xiang1 xin4 a5
cues.en: Of course I don't believe it.

cues.zh: 我可以啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 ke3 yi3 a5
cues.en: I can do it!

cues.zh: 我从小路就能走到大路了啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 xiao3 lu4 jiu4 neng2 zou3 dao4 da4 lu4 le5 a5
cues.en: I can reach the main road just by taking the side road!

cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 jiu4 shi4 mei3 ping2 fang1 mi3 shang4 jia1 32 niu2 dun4 de5 li4
cues.en: It's roughly adding 32 newtons of force per square meter,

cues.zh: 或者说在 1 平方米上加 3 2 千克的重物
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 zai4 1 ping2 fang1 mi3 shang4 jia1 3 2 qian1 ke4 de5 zhong4 wu4
cues.en: or putting a 32-kilogram weight on every square meter —

cues.zh: 这么大的压力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 da4 de5 ya1 li4
cues.en: that much pressure.

cues.zh: 那这个力其实不算很大对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 li4 qi2 shi2 bu4 suan4 hen3 da4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: That force isn't actually very large, right?

cues.zh: 好这个风比较小
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 feng1 bi3 jiao4 xiao3
cues.en: OK, this wind is relatively weak.

cues.zh: 如果到了七级风这就很可怕了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dao4 le5 qi1 ji2 feng1 zhe4 jiu4 hen3 ke3 pa4 le5
cues.en: If it reaches level 7 wind, that gets scary.

cues.zh: 七级风的风速是 16 米每秒
cues.pinyin: qi1 ji2 feng1 de5 feng1 su4 shi4 16 mi3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: A level 7 wind has a wind speed of 16 meters per second.

cues.zh: 这种风叫什么风呢叫疾风
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 feng1 jiao4 shen2 me5 feng1 ne5 jiao4 ji2 feng1
cues.en: What's this wind called? It's called a "strong breeze."

cues.zh: 急峰的压强有多大大概是 16 5 帕斯卡
cues.pinyin: ji2 feng1 de5 ya1 qiang2 you3 duo1 da4 da4 gai4 shi4 16 5 pa4 si1 ka3
cues.en: A strong breeze has a pressure of roughly 16.5 pascals.

cues.zh: 也就是 1 平方米上加 16 5 千克的重物
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 1 ping2 fang1 mi3 shang4 jia1 16 5 qian1 ke4 de5 zhong4 wu4
cues.en: That is, adding a 16.5-kilogram weight per square meter.

cues.zh: 那么如果这个风力达到 10 级的话
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 feng1 li4 da2 dao4 10 ji2 de5 hua4
cues.en: And if the wind reaches level 10,

cues.zh: 它的风速就是 27 米每秒了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 feng1 su4 jiu4 shi4 27 mi3 mei3 miao3 le5
cues.en: its wind speed becomes 27 meters per second.

cues.zh: 一个男生想找女朋友

cues.en: it's best to go after one who already has a boyfriend."

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 de5 dui4 shou3 zhi3 you3 yi2 ge4 a5
cues.en: "Because then you'd only have one rival."

cues.zh: 超强读心术
cues.pinyin: chao1 qiang2 du2 xin1 shu4
cues.en: Super mind-reading trick.

cues.zh: 现在在脑海里想著你的年龄
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zai4 nao3 hai3 li3 xiang3 zhu4 ni3 de5 nian2 ling2
cues.en: Now think of your age in your head.

cues.zh: 然后加上 5
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jia1 shang4 5
cues.en: Then add 5.

cues.zh: 好了吗
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: Got it?

cues.zh: 再减去 2
cues.pinyin: zai4 jian3 qu4 2
cues.en: Now subtract 2.

cues.zh: 然后再减去你的年龄
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 jian3 qu4 ni3 de5 nian2 ling2
cues.en: Then subtract your age.

cues.zh: 你会得到一个全新的数字
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 de2 dao4 yi2 ge4 quan2 xin1 de5 shu4 zi4
cues.en: You'll get a brand new number.

cues.zh: 为了增加一点难度
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 zeng1 jia1 yi4 dian3 nan2 du4
cues.en: To make it a bit harder,

cues.zh: 现在我把这个数字再加上 3
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shu4 zi4 zai4 jia1 shang4 3
cues.en: I'll now add 3 to that number.

cues.pinyin: zao3 can1 dian4 li3 de5 xiao3 nv3 hai2 yi1 yan3 jiu4 ren4 chu1 ta1
cues.en: A little girl in the shop recognized him at a glance

cues.zh: 是新闻中的人
cues.pinyin: shi4 xin1 wen2 zhong1 de5 ren2
cues.en: as the man from the news

cues.zh: 因为这个原因
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Because of this,

cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 de5 yan3 shen2 yi4 zhi2 hao4 qi2 di4 nian2 zai4 fu2 lan2 ke4 shen1 shang4

cues.zh: 这让弗兰克一下想起了自己的女儿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 fu2 lan2 ke4 yi1 xia4 xiang3 qi3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 nv3 er2

cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhang4 fu1 yi4 zhi2 dao4 chu4 hua1 tian1 jiu3 di4

cues.zh: 他的丈夫一直到处花天酒地
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhang4 fu1 yi4 zhi2 dao4 chu4 hua1 tian1 jiu3 di4

cues.zh: 在他看来死不足惜

cues.zh: 获获多起大案
cues.pinyin: huo4 huo4 duo1 qi3 da4 an4

cues.zh: 但这么杰出的大儿子却在家里
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 me5 jie2 chu1 de5 da4 er2 zi5 que4 zai4 jia1 li3

cues.pinyin: bei4 ren2 dang1 zhe5 zi4 ji3 qi1 zi3 de5 mian4 zhi2 jie1 ge1 hou2 sha1 hai4

cues.zh: 他的二儿子一直以来都是家族中的开心国
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 er4 er2 zi5 yi4 zhi2 yi3 lai2 dou1 shi4 jia1 zu2 zhong1 de5 kai1 xin1 guo2
cues.en: Her second son had always been the family's source of joy

cues.zh: 无论到哪都能带去欢声笑语
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 dao4 na3 dou1 neng2 dai4 qu4 huan1 sheng1 xiao4 yu3

cues.zh: 有自己的家庭

cues.zh: 结果就在自己亲儿子的面前
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 zai4 zi4 ji3 qin1 er2 zi5 de5 mian4 qian2

cues.zh: 当着孩子的面杀害人家的父亲

cues.zh: 在老太太的口中

cues.zh: 可所有人都很清楚

cues.zh: 他那几个儿子
cues.pinyin: ta1 na4 ji3 ge4 er2 zi5

cues.zh: 在老太太眼里或许只是无害又无辜的孩子
cues.pinyin: zai4 lao3 tai4 tai4 yan3 li3 huo4 xu3 zhi3 shi4 wu2 hai4 you4 wu2 gu1 de5 hai2 zi5

cues.zh: 但实际上他们全都是活着
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi2 ji4 shang4 ta1 men5 quan2 dou1 shi4 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: but in reality they were all

cues.zh: 只会给别人带去痛苦的臭蟑螂

cues.zh: 弗兰克并不后悔自己的所作所为
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 bing4 bu4 hou4 hui3 zi4 ji3 de5 suo3 zuo4 suo3 wei2

cues.zh: 那么在外人看来
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 wai4 ren2 kan4 lai2
cues.en: then, as seen by an outside observer,

cues.zh: 靠近黑洞的时钟
cues.pinyin: kao4 jin4 hei1 dong4 de5 shi2 zhong1
cues.en: a clock near the black hole

cues.zh: 时间就会停滞
