items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（六）什么是时空弯曲？爱因斯坦如何解释引力？

cues.zh: 来描述一下平直和弯曲时空的区别呢
cues.pinyin: lai2 miao2 shu4 yi1 xia4 ping2 zhi2 he2 wan1 qu1 shi2 kong1 de5 qu1 bie2 ne5
cues.en: Let's describe the difference between flat and curved spacetime.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在他的
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 ta1 de5
cues.en: Einstein, in his

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论浅说里面
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1 li3 mian4
cues.en: book "Relativity: The Special and General Theory,"

cues.zh: 也通俗地说了这个问题
cues.pinyin: ye3 tong1 su2 di4 shuo1 le5 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: also explained this in plain terms.

cues.zh: 他说假如我们有一个二维的面
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 jia3 ru2 wo3 men5 you3 yi2 ge4 er4 wei2 de5 mian4
cues.en: He said, suppose we have a two-dimensional surface;

cues.zh: 用一对坐标 U 和 V
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi1 dui4 zuo4 biao1 U he2 V
cues.en: with a pair of coordinates U and V

cues.zh: 就能描述出平面上的一个点了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 neng2 miao2 shu4 chu1 ping2 mian4 shang4 de5 yi2 ge4 dian3 le5
cues.en: we can describe a point on the plane.

cues.zh: 那么如果这个平面是平直的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 ping2 mian4 shi4 ping2 zhi2 de5
cues.en: Then if this plane is flat,

cues.zh: 那两个相接近的点
cues.pinyin: na4 liang3 ge4 xiang1 jie1 jin4 de5 dian3
cues.en: for two nearby points,

cues.zh: 距离应该满足勾股定理
cues.pinyin: ju4 li2 ying1 gai1 man3 zu2 gou1 gu3 ding4 li3
cues.en: the distance should satisfy the Pythagorean theorem,

cues.zh: 也就是 ds 的平方等于 du 的平方
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 ds de5 ping2 fang1 deng3 yu2 du de5 ping2 fang1
cues.en: that is, ds squared equals du squared

cues.zh: 加 d v 的平方
cues.pinyin: jia1 d v de5 ping2 fang1
cues.en: plus dv squared.

cues.zh: 狭义相对论描述的其实就是这种情况
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 miao2 shu4 de5 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: What special relativity describes is actually this kind of situation.

cues.zh: 可是如果存在引力的话
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 cun2 zai4 yin3 li4 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if gravity exists,

cues.zh: 那么空间就会被引力弄得弯曲了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 kong1 jian1 jiu4 hui4 bei4 yin3 li4 nong4 de2 wan1 qu1 le5
cues.en: then space gets curved by gravity.

cues.zh: 这个时候再计算两个点之间的间隔
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zai4 ji4 suan4 liang3 ge4 dian3 zhi1 jian1 de5 jian4 ge2
cues.en: At this point, to calculate the interval between two points,

cues.zh: 就需要使用这样的公式
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xu1 yao4 shi3 yong4 zhe4 yang4 de5 gong1 shi4
cues.en: we need to use a formula like this:

cues.zh: ds 的平方等于 g 11 乘以 du 的平方
cues.pinyin: ds de5 ping2 fang1 deng3 yu2 g 11 cheng2 yi3 du de5 ping2 fang1
cues.en: ds squared equals g11 times du squared

cues.zh: 加 g 12 乘以 du d v
cues.pinyin: jia1 g 12 cheng2 yi3 du d v
cues.en: plus g12 times du times dv.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 下饭神剧炸裂剧情，官二代欺负老实人，，冰柜冷藏成生鲜，识骨寻踪。

cues.zh: 老头探险海边跑寻宝梦在脑里烧
cues.pinyin: lao3 tou2 tan4 xian3 hai3 bian1 pao3 xun2 bao3 meng4 zai4 nao3 li3 shao1
cues.en: An old treasure hunter runs to the beach, treasure dreams burning in his mind.

cues.zh: 沙里金光在闪耀口水流得比浪高
cues.pinyin: sha1 li3 jin1 guang1 zai4 shan3 yao4 kou3 shui3 liu2 de2 bi3 lang4 gao1
cues.en: Golden light shines in the sand, and he's drooling more than the waves are cresting.

cues.zh: 伸手一捞吓一跳
cues.pinyin: shen1 shou3 yi1 lao1 xia4 yi1 tiao4
cues.en: He reaches in to scoop it up — and gets a shock.

cues.zh: 腐尸破土咧嘴笑浑身肥虫蹦蹦蹦跳
cues.pinyin: fu3 shi1 po4 tu3 lie3 zui3 xiao4 hun2 shen1 fei2 chong2 beng4 beng4 beng4 tiao4
cues.en: The corpse breaks through the dirt, grinning, fat maggots bouncing all over it.

cues.zh: 房间里警员老布刚和女友汉娜在床上打
cues.pinyin: fang2 jian1 li3 jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 gang1 he2 nv3 you3 han4 na4 zai4 chuang2 shang4 da3
cues.en: In the room, cop Lao Bu is in bed with girlfriend Hannah, finishing—

cues.zh: 完爱情排位赛
cues.pinyin: wan2 ai4 qing2 pai2 wei4 sai4
cues.en: —their 'love ranked match.'

cues.zh: 谁知还没等两人温存片刻
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 hai2 mei2 deng3 liang3 ren2 wen1 cun2 pian4 ke4
cues.en: But before the two can even cuddle for a moment,

cues.zh: 汉娜上次电话就像催命符一样八人薅走
cues.pinyin: han4 na4 shang4 ci4 dian4 hua4 jiu4 xiang4 cui1 ming4 fu2 yi1 yang4 ba1 ren2 hao1 zou3
cues.en: Hannah's phone rings again like a death summons, dragging him away.

cues.zh: 老布正对着空枕头叹气
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zheng4 dui4 zhe5 kong1 zhen3 tou5 tan4 qi4
cues.en: Lao Bu sighs at the empty pillow,

cues.zh: 报警电话又突然炸响
cues.pinyin: bao4 jing3 dian4 hua4 you4 tu1 ran2 zha4 xiang3
cues.en: when the emergency line suddenly blares again.

cues.zh: 等他和法医小谷杀到海边时
cues.pinyin: deng3 ta1 he2 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 sha1 dao4 hai3 bian1 shi2
cues.en: By the time he and medical examiner Xiao Gu rush to the beach,

cues.zh: 朝阳把沙滩染得像草莓酱
cues.pinyin: zhao1 yang2 ba3 sha1 tan1 ran3 de2 xiang4 cao3 mei2 jiang4
cues.en: the morning sun has dyed the sand strawberry-jam red,

cues.zh: 却盖不住尸体旁那群蹦迪的蛆虫
cues.pinyin: que4 gai4 bu2 zhu4 shi1 ti3 pang2 na4 qun2 beng4 di2 de5 qu1 chong2
cues.en: but it can't hide the swarm of maggots partying beside the corpse.

cues.zh: 法医卡米尔蹲在尸袋边直皱眉
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 ka3 mi3 er3 dun1 zai4 shi1 dai4 bian1 zhi2 zhou4 mei2
cues.en: Medical examiner Camille crouches by the body bag, frowning deeply —

cues.zh: 腐败速度快的邪乎像沾染的放
cues.pinyin: fu3 bai4 su4 du4 kuai4 de5 xie2 hu1 xiang4 zhan1 ran3 de5 fang4
cues.en: the decomposition rate is freakishly fast, as if contaminated with

cues.zh: 射性物质一样
cues.pinyin: she4 xing4 wu4 zhi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: radioactive material.

cues.zh: 可检测仪并未在尸体上扫出任何物质
cues.pinyin: ke3 jian3 ce4 yi2 bing4 wei4 zai4 shi1 ti3 shang4 sao3 chu1 ren4 he2 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: But the scanner doesn't detect anything unusual on the body,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 下饭神剧炸裂剧情，官二代欺负老实人，，冰柜冷藏成生鲜，识骨寻踪。

cues.zh: 最后只能归咎于海滩温差魔法
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhi3 neng2 gui1 jiu4 yu2 hai3 tan1 wen1 cha4 mo2 fa3
cues.en: so in the end they can only chalk it up to 'beach temperature-swing magic.'

cues.en: Even more absurd are the maggots inside the corpse —

cues.pinyin: bai2 pang4 de5 xiang4 guo3 tang2 shuang1 de5 tiao4 tiao4 tang2
cues.en: plump and white like sugar-coated popping candy.

cues.zh: 有只还精准蹦到老布皮鞋上
cues.pinyin: you3 zhi3 hai2 jing1 zhun3 beng4 dao4 lao3 bu4 pi2 xie2 shang4
cues.en: One even lands precisely on Lao Bu's leather shoe.

cues.zh: 他刚和汉娜温存被碎一肚子活
cues.pinyin: ta1 gang1 he2 han4 na4 wen1 cun2 bei4 sui4 yi1 du3 zi5 huo2
cues.en: He'd just been interrupted mid-cuddle with Hannah and was already fuming,

cues.zh: 当场就要报幕
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiu4 yao4 bao4 mu4
cues.en: and is about to blow up on the spot

cues.zh: 小谷眼急手快捏起虫子丢进标本庭
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 yan3 ji2 shou3 kuai4 nie1 qi3 chong2 zi5 diu1 jin4 biao1 ben3 ting2
cues.en: when Xiao Gu quickly snatches the bug and drops it into a specimen jar.

cues.zh: 好在死者钱包没丢
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 si3 zhe3 qian2 bao1 mei2 diu1
cues.en: Luckily the victim's wallet wasn't lost —

cues.zh: 身份证量明身份
cues.pinyin: shen1 fen4 zheng4 liang4 ming2 shen1 fen4
cues.en: his ID confirms his identity:

cues.zh: 25 岁约翰
cues.pinyin: 25 sui4 yue1 han4
cues.en: John, 25 years old.

cues.zh: 众人刚把尸体运回实验室
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 gang1 ba3 shi1 ti3 yun4 hui2 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: Just as everyone hauls the body back to the lab,

cues.zh: 果实带经突然上演
cues.pinyin: guo3 shi2 dai4 jing1 tu1 ran2 shang4 yan3
cues.en: the body bag suddenly puts on

cues.zh: 虚虫蹦极秀
cues.pinyin: xu1 chong2 beng4 ji2 xiu4
cues.en: a maggot bungee-jumping show —

cues.zh: 成百条虫子像撞了弹簧一样往外钻
cues.pinyin: cheng2 bai3 tiao2 chong2 zi5 xiang4 zhuang4 le5 tan2 huang2 yi1 yang4 wang3 wai4 zuan1
cues.en: hundreds of maggots spring outward like they've hit trampolines.

cues.zh: 正在和实习生吵架的卡米尔经的目瞪口呆
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 he2 shi2 xi2 sheng1 chao3 jia4 de5 ka3 mi3 er3 jing1 de5 mu4 deng4 kou3 dai1
cues.en: Camille, mid-argument with an intern, freezes in shock.

cues.zh: 只见昆虫学交
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 kun1 chong2 xue2 jiao1
cues.en: Just then an entomologist —

cues.zh: 豪金拿着容器冲过来
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 na2 zhe5 rong2 qi4 chong1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Haojin — comes rushing over with a container,

cues.zh: 活像见了爱度的狂热粉丝
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 jian4 le5 ai4 du4 de5 kuang2 re4 fen3 si1
cues.en: looking exactly like a fan who's spotted their idol.

cues.zh: 活像见了爱豆的狂热粉丝
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 jian4 le5 ai4 dou4 de5 kuang2 re4 fen3 si1
cues.en: He explains to everyone that these are blowfly larvae,

cues.zh: 俗称乃洛船长
cues.pinyin: su2 cheng1 nai3 luo4 chuan2 zhang3
cues.en: nicknamed 'Captain Nilo.'

cues.zh: 他们兴奋时会跳咬屁舞
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xing1 fen4 shi2 hui4 tiao4 yao3 pi4 wu3
cues.en: When excited, they do a wiggling 'butt dance.'

cues.pinyin: shi4 pin2 li3 ta1 zong3 gen1 yi1 wan4 gou1 jian1 da1 pei4

cues.en: a label that, while not exactly a compliment,

cues.pinyin: dang1 de2 zhi1 yue1 han4 de5 si3 xun4 shi2
cues.en: Upon learning of John's death,

cues.zh: 巧克力男激动大吼
cues.pinyin: qiao3 ke4 li4 nan2 ji1 dong4 da4 hou3
cues.en: 'Chocolate Man' shouts emotionally,

cues.zh: 海滩瞬间变成阔烟喇叭
cues.pinyin: hai3 tan1 shun4 jian1 bian4 cheng2 kuo4 yan1 la3 ba1
cues.en: turning the beach instantly into a giant loudspeaker.

cues.zh: 这画面感顿时让老布恼人疼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hua4 mian4 gan3 dun4 shi2 rang4 lao3 bu4 nao3 ren2 teng2
cues.en: The sheer drama of it instantly gives Lao Bu a headache.

cues.zh: 见此布谷组合连忙拽来心理学
cues.pinyin: jian4 ci3 bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 lian2 mang2 zhuai1 lai2 xin1 li3 xue2
cues.en: Seeing this, the Bu-Gu duo hurry to bring in a psychologist —

cues.zh: 家小甜甜探讨
cues.pinyin: jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 tan4 tao3
cues.en: nicknamed 'Little Sweetie' — to talk it through.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 下饭神剧炸裂剧情，官二代欺负老实人，，冰柜冷藏成生鲜，识骨寻踪。

cues.zh: 他表示威多族打架向孔雀开屏
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 shi4 wei1 duo1 zu2 da3 jia4 xiang4 kong3 que4 kai1 ping2
cues.en: She explains that when males fight, it's like a peacock spreading its tail,

cues.zh: 喜欢用暴力表演雄性魅力
cues.pinyin: xi3 huan1 yong4 bao4 li4 biao3 yan3 xiong2 xing4 mei4 li4
cues.en: using violence to show off masculine charm.

cues.zh: 老顾迅速甩出让人演运的聊天记录
cues.pinyin: lao3 gu4 xun4 su4 shuai3 chu1 rang4 ren2 yan3 yun4 de5 liao2 tian1 ji4 lu4
cues.en: Lao Bu quickly whips out some dizzying chat logs,

cues.zh: 满城波浪线配星景符号
cues.pinyin: man3 cheng2 bo1 lang4 xian4 pei4 xing1 jing3 fu2 hao4
cues.en: full of squiggly tildes paired with star emojis.

cues.zh: 小甜甜却像见了亲妈
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 que4 xiang4 jian4 le5 qin1 ma1
cues.en: 'Little Sweetie' reacts like she's seeing her own mother,

cues.zh: 致使他们的兄弟立马
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shi3 ta1 men5 de5 xiong1 di4 li4 ma3
cues.en: which instantly causes their 'bromance' to—

cues.zh: 结束问话的小谷刚回到实验室
cues.pinyin: jie2 shu4 wen4 hua4 de5 xiao3 gu3 gang1 hui2 dao4 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: Just as Xiao Gu finishes the interview and gets back to the lab,

cues.zh: 就被汉娜找上门
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 han4 na4 zhao3 shang4 men2
cues.en: Hannah shows up looking for her.

cues.zh: 原来他出差回来后竟决定要和老顾同居
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 chu1 chai1 hui2 lai2 hou4 jing4 jue2 ding4 yao4 he2 lao3 gu4 tong2 ju1
cues.en: It turns out that after getting back from a business trip, she's decided to move in with Lao Bu,

cues.zh: 不过搬过去之前想送对方一个
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ban1 guo4 qu4 zhi1 qian2 xiang3 song4 dui4 fang1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: but before moving in, she wants to give him a

cues.zh: 小礼物当纪念
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li3 wu4 dang1 ji4 nian4
cues.en: small gift as a keepsake.

cues.zh: 探娜希望小谷这个熟悉老布的人
cues.pinyin: tan4 na4 xi1 wang4 xiao3 gu3 zhe4 ge5 shu2 xi1 lao3 bu4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Hannah hopes Xiao Gu, who knows Lao Bu well,

cues.zh: 能帮忙出主意
cues.pinyin: neng2 bang1 mang2 chu1 zhu3 yi4
cues.en: can help her come up with an idea.

cues.zh: 小谷听后很为两人开心
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 ting1 hou4 hen3 wei4 liang3 ren2 kai1 xin1
cues.en: Hearing this, Xiao Gu is genuinely happy for the two of them

cues.zh: 马上见遗憾的
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 jian4 yi2 han4 de5
cues.en: and immediately suggests

cues.zh: 去买一台老师旋转拨号电话
cues.pinyin: qu4 mai3 yi1 tai2 lao3 shi1 xuan2 zhuan3 bo1 hao4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: buying an old-fashioned rotary dial phone,

cues.zh: 去买一台老式旋转拨号电话
cues.pinyin: qu4 mai3 yi1 tai2 lao3 shi4 xuan2 zhuan3 bo1 hao4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: since Lao Bu's place used to have one,

cues.zh: 坏料后始终没找到合适的
cues.pinyin: huai4 liao4 hou4 shi3 zhong1 mei2 zhao3 dao4 he2 shi4 de5
cues.en: but after it broke, he never found a good replacement.

cues.zh: 对方接受建议后正准备告辞
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 jie1 shou4 jian4 yi4 hou4 zheng4 zhun3 bei4 gao4 ci2
cues.en: After taking the suggestion, Hannah is about to leave,

cues.zh: 小谷却在探尼一开始说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 que4 zai4 tan4 ni2 yi1 kai1 shi3 shuo1
cues.en: when Xiao Gu suddenly starts telling Hannah —

cues.zh: 脑不害己人向警犬咬着不放
cues.pinyin: nao3 bu4 hai4 ji3 ren2 xiang4 jing3 quan3 yao3 zhe5 bu4 fang4
cues.en: as the saying goes, once a police dog bites down, it won't let go —

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 下饭神剧炸裂剧情，官二代欺负老实人，，冰柜冷藏成生鲜，识骨寻踪。

cues.zh: 原来豪金打算搞个怀孕版直播
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 hao2 jin1 da3 suan4 gao3 ge4 huai2 yun4 ban3 zhi2 bo1
cues.en: it turns out Haojin wants to do a 'pregnancy edition' livestream,

cues.zh: 并希望卡米尔保密
cues.pinyin: bing4 xi1 wang4 ka3 mi3 er3 bao3 mi4
cues.en: and hopes Camille will keep it secret.

cues.zh: 正当两人蹦迪时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 dang1 liang3 ren2 beng4 di2 shi2
cues.en: Just as the two are discussing this in private,

cues.zh: 石医生举着报告推门而入
cues.pinyin: shi2 yi1 sheng1 ju3 zhe5 bao4 gao4 tui1 men2 er2 ru4
cues.en: Dr. Shi bursts in holding a report.

cues.zh: 卡米尔秒变严阻脸
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 miao3 bian4 yan2 zu3 lian3
cues.en: Camille's face instantly turns dead serious,

cues.zh: 溜得比尸检报告还快
cues.pinyin: liu1 de2 bi3 shi1 jian3 bao4 gao4 hai2 kuai4
cues.en: and she slips away faster than an autopsy report gets filed,

cues.zh: 留下石医生怀疑人生
cues.pinyin: liu2 xia4 shi2 yi1 sheng1 huai2 yi2 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: leaving Dr. Shi questioning life.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 布谷祖和夜叹会员至酒吧
cues.pinyin: bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 ye4 tan4 hui4 yuan2 zhi4 jiu3 ba1
cues.en: the Bu-Gu duo head to a bar at night to snoop around.

cues.zh: 脚鼓对着保安笔画归多足密码
cues.pinyin: jiao3 gu3 dui4 zhe5 bao3 an1 bi3 hua4 gui1 duo1 zu2 mi4 ma3
cues.en: Lao Bu flashes the bouncer some kind of secret cop hand signal,

cues.zh: 愣是把保安看盟圈放行
cues.pinyin: leng4 shi4 ba3 bao3 an1 kan4 meng2 quan1 fang4 xing2
cues.en: which somehow leaves him utterly baffled but lets them through anyway,

cues.zh: 愣是把保安看懵圈放行
cues.pinyin: leng4 shi4 ba3 bao3 an1 kan4 meng3 quan1 fang4 xing2
cues.en: though Lao Bu still has to flash his badge to get in.

cues.zh: 此时场内正上演冰袋大战
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 chang3 nei4 zheng4 shang4 yan3 bing1 dai4 da4 zhan4
cues.en: Inside, an ice-pack brawl is already in full swing.

cues.zh: 马奇抽起冰袋砸向酒宝
cues.pinyin: ma3 qi2 chou1 qi3 bing1 dai4 za2 xiang4 jiu3 bao3
cues.en: Marcy grabs an ice pack and hurls it at the bartender,

cues.zh: 碎冰茶子见得像香槟塔崩塌
cues.pinyin: sui4 bing1 cha2 zi5 jian4 de2 xiang4 xiang1 bin1 ta3 beng1 ta1
cues.en: shattered ice spraying everywhere like a collapsing champagne tower.

cues.zh: 下一秒就被众人按在地上摩擦
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3 jiu4 bei4 zhong4 ren2 an4 zai4 di4 shang4 mo2 ca1
cues.en: The next second he's pinned to the floor and roughed up by everyone,

cues.zh: 活像块被拍扁的冰棍
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 kuai4 bei4 pai1 bian3 de5 bing1 gun4
cues.en: looking just like a flattened popsicle.

cues.zh: 眼看场面越发混乱
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 chang3 mian4 yue4 fa1 hun4 luan4
cues.en: As the scene spirals into chaos,

cues.zh: 老布直接给他一记大摆锤
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zhi2 jie1 gei3 ta1 yi1 ji4 da4 bai3 chui2
cues.en: Lao Bu lands a massive haymaker on him.

cues.zh: 马奇刚要挥拳
cues.pinyin: ma3 qi2 gang1 yao4 hui1 quan2
cues.en: Just as Marcy is about to swing back,

cues.zh: 小谷突然用他们内部人的劝架
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 tu1 ran2 yong4 ta1 men5 nei4 bu4 ren2 de5 quan4 jia4
cues.en: Xiao Gu suddenly steps in using their 'insider's method' for breaking up fights —

cues.zh: 方式拦截下来
cues.pinyin: fang1 shi4 lan2 jie2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: and stops it cold.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友给我提了一个
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 ti2 le5 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Recently a kid asked me

cues.zh: 很有趣的问题
cues.pinyin: hen3 you3 qu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: a very interesting question.

cues.zh: 他问我外星人能发现地球吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen4 wo3 wai4 xing1 ren2 neng2 fa1 xian4 di4 qiu2 ma5
cues.en: He asked me whether aliens can discover Earth.

cues.zh: 刚好前一段时间诺贝尔物理学奖颁布了
cues.pinyin: gang1 hao3 qian2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 nuo4 bei4 er3 wu4 li3 xue2 jiang3 ban1 bu4 le5
cues.en: Coincidentally, the Nobel Prize in Physics was just announced a while back.

cues.zh: 那么其中有一半的奖金颁发给两位科学家
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 qi2 zhong1 you3 yi2 ban4 de5 jiang3 jin1 ban1 fa1 gei3 liang3 wei4 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Half of the prize money was awarded to two scientists

cues.zh: 以表彰他们在研究太阳系以外行星方
cues.pinyin: yi3 biao3 zhang1 ta1 men5 zai4 yan2 jiu1 tai4 yang2 xi4 yi3 wai4 hang2 xing1 fang1
cues.en: in recognition of their contributions to researching planets

cues.zh: 面做出的贡献
cues.pinyin: mian4 zuo4 chu1 de5 gong4 xian4
cues.en: outside the solar system.

cues.zh: 那我们今天就来讨论一下
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: So today let's discuss

cues.zh: 如果外星人要发现地球
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wai4 xing1 ren2 yao4 fa1 xian4 di4 qiu2
cues.en: if aliens wanted to discover Earth,

cues.zh: 他们将会用什么样的方法呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiang1 hui4 yong4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 fang1 fa3 ne5
cues.en: what methods would they use?

cues.zh: 我们首先来给外星人支个招
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 gei3 wai4 xing1 ren2 zhi1 ge4 zhao1
cues.en: Let's first give the aliens a tip.

cues.zh: 这个方法叫做视向速度法
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 jiao4 zuo4 shi4 xiang4 su4 du4 fa3
cues.en: This method is called the radial velocity method.

cues.zh: 或者叫径向速度法
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 jiao4 jing4 xiang4 su4 du4 fa3
cues.en: It's also called the radial velocity method (a synonym).

cues.zh: 这个方法当然也是我们地球上的科学
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 dang1 ran2 ye3 shi4 wo3 men5 di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 ke1 xue2
cues.en: This method, of course, was also invented by scientists

cues.zh: 家发明出来的
cues.pinyin: jia1 fa1 ming2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: here on Earth.

cues.zh: 如果外星人他们的智慧跟我们一样的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wai4 xing1 ren2 ta1 men5 de5 zhi4 hui4 gen1 wo3 men5 yi1 yang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If aliens had the same level of intelligence as us,

cues.zh: 他们也应该会发现这样的一种方法
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 ying1 gai1 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 zhong3 fang1 fa3
cues.en: they should also be able to discover this kind of method.

cues.zh: 为了研究事项速度法
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 yan2 jiu1 shi4 xiang4 su4 du4 fa3
cues.en: In order to study the radial velocity method,

cues.zh: 我们首先先解释一下双星系统
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4 shuang1 xing1 xi4 tong3
cues.en: let's first explain the binary star system.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 正在上高中的同学们可能对这
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 shang4 gao1 zhong1 de5 tong2 xue2 men5 ke3 neng2 dui4 zhe4
cues.en: Students currently in high school may be

cues.zh: 个问题很熟悉
cues.pinyin: ge4 wen4 ti2 hen3 shu2 xi1
cues.en: quite familiar with this topic.

cues.zh: 什么叫双星呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 shuang1 xing1 ne5
cues.en: What is a binary star?

cues.zh: 就是有两颗星一颗质量是大 m
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 you3 liang3 ke1 xing1 yi1 ke1 zhi4 liang4 shi4 da4 m
cues.en: It's when there are two stars, one with mass M,

cues.zh: 旁边有一颗质量是小 m
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 you3 yi1 ke1 zhi4 liang4 shi4 xiao3 m
cues.en: and next to it one with mass m.

cues.zh: 它们彼此在万有引力的作用下围
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bi3 ci3 zai4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 de5 zuo4 yong4 xia4 wei2
cues.en: Under mutual gravitational attraction, they

cues.zh: 绕着中间在转
cues.pinyin: rao4 zhe5 zhong1 jian1 zai4 zhuan3
cues.en: orbit around a point in the middle.

cues.zh: 我们很多时候认为大 m 是静止不动的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hen3 duo1 shi2 hou4 ren4 wei2 da4 m shi4 jing4 zhi3 bu4 dong4 de5
cues.en: We often assume the large mass M is stationary,

cues.zh: 比如太阳静止不动地球围绕太阳在转
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 tai4 yang2 jing4 zhi3 bu4 dong4 di4 qiu2 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zai4 zhuan3
cues.en: like assuming the Sun is stationary while Earth orbits it.

cues.zh: 但是实际上这个不是很准确
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 zhe4 ge5 bu2 shi4 hen3 zhun3 que4
cues.en: But actually this isn't very accurate.

cues.zh: 它们两个彼此受到万有引力
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 bi3 ci3 shou4 dao4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4
cues.en: The two of them, under mutual gravity,

cues.zh: 其实是在围绕着二者的质心在运动的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 zai4 wei2 rao4 zhe5 er4 zhe3 de5 zhi4 xin1 zai4 yun4 dong4 de5
cues.en: are actually moving around their common center of mass.

cues.zh: 质心叫 C
cues.pinyin: zhi4 xin1 jiao4 C
cues.en: The center of mass is called C.

cues.zh: 大 M 会走出一个圈来
cues.pinyin: da4 M hui4 zou3 chu1 yi2 ge4 quan1 lai2
cues.en: The large mass M traces out a circle,

cues.zh: 小 M 也走出一个圈来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 M ye3 zou3 chu1 yi2 ge4 quan1 lai2
cues.en: and the small mass m also traces out a circle.

cues.zh: 而且每时每刻它们两个的连线都
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 mei3 shi2 mei3 ke4 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 de5 lian2 xian4 dou1
cues.en: And at every moment, the line connecting the two

cues.zh: 会过这个质心
cues.pinyin: hui4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 zhi4 xin1
cues.en: passes through this center of mass.

cues.zh: 比如说大 M 转到这儿了那小 M 就
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 da4 M zhuan3 dao4 zhe4 er2 le5 na4 xiao3 M jiu4
cues.en: For example, if M moves to here, then m

cues.zh: 会跑到这儿来
cues.pinyin: hui4 pao3 dao4 zhe4 er2 lai2
cues.en: will move to here.

cues.zh: 大 M 转到这小 M 跑到这
cues.pinyin: da4 M zhuan3 dao4 zhe4 xiao3 M pao3 dao4 zhe4
cues.en: When M moves here, m moves here,

cues.zh: 大 M 转到这小 M 就跑到这
cues.pinyin: da4 M zhuan3 dao4 zhe4 xiao3 M jiu4 pao3 dao4 zhe4
cues.en: when M moves here, m moves here.

cues.zh: 它们每时每刻连线都会过这个质心
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 mei3 shi2 mei3 ke4 lian2 xian4 du1 hui4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 zhi4 xin1
cues.en: At every moment, the line connecting them passes through this center of mass.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 所以 R 2 会远远大于 R 1
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 R 2 hui4 yuan3 yuan3 da4 yu2 R 1
cues.en: So R2 is much larger than R1.

cues.zh: 也就是说太阳的转动半径会非常小
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 tai4 yang2 de5 zhuan3 dong4 ban4 jing4 hui4 fei1 chang2 xiao3
cues.en: That is, the Sun's orbital radius is very small.

cues.zh: 也正因为如此
cues.pinyin: ye3 zheng4 yin1 wei4 ru2 ci3
cues.en: And precisely because of this,

cues.zh: 我们看起来好像太阳是基本不动的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 kan4 qi3 lai2 hao3 xiang4 tai4 yang2 shi4 ji1 ben3 bu4 dong4 de5
cues.en: it looks to us as if the Sun is basically stationary,

cues.zh: 而地球在围绕太阳在转对吧
cues.pinyin: er2 di4 qiu2 zai4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zai4 zhuan3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: while Earth orbits around the Sun, right?

cues.zh: 好咱们继续说
cues.pinyin: hao3 zan2 men5 ji4 xu4 shuo1
cues.en: Okay, let's continue.

cues.zh: 如果我们把数据带进去
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 ba3 shu4 ju4 dai4 jin4 qu4
cues.en: If we plug in the numbers,

cues.zh: 太阳的质量是 2 10 千克
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 de5 zhi4 liang4 shi4 2 10 qian1 ke4
cues.en: the Sun's mass is 2×10^30 kg,

cues.zh: 地球的质量是 6 10 千克
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 zhi4 liang4 shi4 6 10 qian1 ke4
cues.en: Earth's mass is 6×10^24 kg,

cues.zh: 它们俩之间还有一个距离就是日地距离
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 lia3 zhi1 jian1 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ju4 li2 jiu4 shi4 ri4 di4 ju4 li2
cues.en: and there's also the distance between them, the Earth-Sun distance.

cues.zh: 我们假设这个日地距离
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia3 she4 zhe4 ge5 ri4 di4 ju4 li2
cues.en: Let's assume this Earth-Sun distance

cues.zh: 大约是 1 5 10 这么大
cues.pinyin: da4 yue1 shi4 1 5 10 zhe4 me5 da4
cues.en: is about 1.5×10^11 meters.

cues.zh: 这样一来我们就可以计算出来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ji4 suan4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: This way we can calculate

cues.zh: 太阳的轨道半径 R 1 了
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 de5 gui3 dao4 ban4 jing4 R 1 le5
cues.en: the Sun's orbital radius R1.

cues.zh: 太阳跟地球这个双星系统
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 gen1 di4 qiu2 zhe4 ge5 shuang1 xing1 xi4 tong3
cues.en: For this Sun-Earth binary system,

cues.zh: 它的轨道半径 RE 有多大呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gui3 dao4 ban4 jing4 RE you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: how large is its orbital radius?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 地球的周期不是一年吗
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 zhou1 qi1 bu2 shi4 yi1 nian2 ma5
cues.en: Isn't Earth's period one year?

cues.zh: 所以太阳转一圈也是一年
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 tai4 yang2 zhuan3 yi1 quan1 ye3 shi4 yi1 nian2
cues.en: So the Sun also completes one revolution in a year.

cues.zh: 太阳的速度就会变成 2 R 1
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 de5 su4 du4 jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 2 R 1
cues.en: The Sun's speed would then be 2πR1

cues.zh: 再除以地球的周期
cues.pinyin: zai4 chu2 yi3 di4 qiu2 de5 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: divided by Earth's period.

cues.zh: 我们把数据算出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 shu4 ju4 suan4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Let's calculate the numbers,

cues.zh: 答案是 0 09 米每秒
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 0 09 mi3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: the answer is 0.09 meters per second.

cues.zh: 好我们现在已经明白了
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 ming2 bai2 le5
cues.en: Okay, now we understand.

cues.zh: 如果我们把地球和太阳看作是一个
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 ba3 di4 qiu2 he2 tai4 yang2 kan4 zuo4 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: If we treat Earth and the Sun as a

cues.zh: 双星系统的话
cues.pinyin: shuang1 xing1 xi4 tong3 de5 hua4
cues.en: binary star system,

cues.zh: 那么太阳的速度大概是 9 厘米每秒
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 tai4 yang2 de5 su4 du4 da4 gai4 shi4 9 li2 mi3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: then the Sun's speed is about 9 centimeters per second.

cues.zh: 这个速度不太大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 su4 du4 bu4 tai4 da4
cues.en: This speed isn't very large.

cues.zh: 我们为什么要研究地球和太阳这个系统
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 yan2 jiu1 di4 qiu2 he2 tai4 yang2 zhe4 ge5 xi4 tong3
cues.en: Why do we need to study this Earth-Sun system

cues.zh: 太阳的运动速度呢
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 de5 yun4 dong4 su4 du4 ne5
cues.en: and the Sun's velocity?

cues.zh: 这是因为我们需要使用到第二个方法
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 shi3 yong4 dao4 di4 er4 ge4 fang1 fa3
cues.en: This is because we need to use a second method,

cues.zh: 就是多普勒效应
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 duo1 pu3 le4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: which is the Doppler effect.

cues.zh: 多普勒效应
cues.pinyin: duo1 pu3 le4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: The Doppler effect.

cues.zh: 多普勒效应有很多种
cues.pinyin: duo1 pu3 le4 xiao4 ying4 you3 hen3 duo1 zhong3
cues.en: There are many kinds of Doppler effect.

cues.zh: 比如说有非相对论的多普勒效应
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 fei1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 duo1 pu3 le4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: For example, there's the non-relativistic Doppler effect,

cues.zh: 还有相对论的还有引力造成的多普勒效应
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 hai2 you3 yin3 li4 zao4 cheng2 de5 duo1 pu3 le4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: there's also the relativistic one, and one caused by gravity.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 我们现在只说最简单的一种情况
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 zhi3 shuo1 zui4 jian3 dan1 de5 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Right now we'll only discuss the simplest case,

cues.zh: 非相对论的情况
cues.pinyin: fei1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: the non-relativistic case.

cues.zh: 假如太阳在某个部位发出了光
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 tai4 yang2 zai4 mou3 ge4 bu4 wei4 fa1 chu1 le5 guang1
cues.en: Suppose the Sun emits light from some position,

cues.zh: 太阳在某个部位发出了光
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 zai4 mou3 ge4 bu4 wei4 fa1 chu1 le5 guang1
cues.en: the Sun emits light from some position.

cues.zh: 过了一会儿这个光就会传播出去
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 yi1 hui4 er5 zhe4 ge5 guang1 jiu4 hui4 chuan2 bo1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: After a while, this light propagates outward.

cues.zh: 光是一种波它会传播出去
cues.pinyin: guang1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 bo1 ta1 hui4 chuan2 bo1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: Light is a wave, so it propagates outward.

cues.zh: 但是假如太阳不是静止不动的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jia3 ru2 tai4 yang2 bu2 shi4 jing4 zhi3 bu4 dong4 de5
cues.en: But if the Sun isn't stationary,

cues.zh: 它在往一个方向运动
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wang3 yi2 ge4 fang1 xiang4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: and it's moving in some direction,

cues.zh: 比如说太阳在往右边走
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 tai4 yang2 zai4 wang3 you4 bian1 zou3
cues.en: say the Sun is moving to the right,

cues.zh: 那么下一个时刻它发出的光波
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 xia4 yi2 ge4 shi2 ke4 ta1 fa1 chu1 de5 guang1 bo1
cues.en: then the light wave it emits the next moment,

cues.zh: 它的起点就在这了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qi3 dian3 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 le5
cues.en: its starting point will be here.

cues.zh: 所以新的光波就在这个位置
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xin1 de5 guang1 bo1 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: So the new light wave is at this position.

cues.zh: 如果它还再往前走那发出第三个光波
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 hai2 zai4 wang3 qian2 zou3 na4 fa1 chu1 di4 san1 ge4 guang1 bo1
cues.en: If it keeps moving forward and emits a third light wave,

cues.zh: 它就是这样的一种情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: it looks like this.

cues.zh: 我这画的贴上了其实不应该贴上
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 hua4 de5 tie1 shang4 le5 qi2 shi2 bu4 ying1 gai1 tie1 shang4
cues.en: What I drew here overlaps, which actually shouldn't happen.

cues.zh: 两个相邻的波之间的距离我们管它叫波长
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 xiang1 lin2 de5 bo1 zhi1 jian1 de5 ju4 li2 wo3 men5 guan3 ta1 jiao4 bo1 chang2
cues.en: The distance between two adjacent waves is what we call the wavelength.

cues.zh: 那么对于光波来讲它有一个公式
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dui4 yu2 guang1 bo1 lai2 jiang3 ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: For light waves, there's a formula,

cues.zh: 叫做 c 等于 f
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 c deng3 yu2 f
cues.en: called c equals fλ.

cues.zh: 这个我们以前也讲过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 ye3 jiang3 guo4
cues.en: We've talked about this before.

cues.zh: 这里面的 c 就表示的是光速
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mian4 de5 c jiu4 biao3 shi4 de5 shi4 guang1 su4
cues.en: Here, c represents the speed of light.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人如何发现地球？人类如何发现地外行星？

cues.zh: 但是我们却管它叫蓝移
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 que4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 lan2 yi2
cues.en: But we call this phenomenon blueshift.

cues.zh: 也就是说如果太阳朝着外星人来
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ru2 guo3 tai4 yang2 chao2 zhe5 wai4 xing1 ren2 lai2
cues.en: That is, if the Sun is moving toward the aliens,

cues.zh: 我们假设这外星人叫 O lig
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia3 she4 zhe4 wai4 xing1 ren2 jiao4 O lig
cues.en: let's assume this alien is called Oligei,

cues.zh: O lig 就会发现这个太阳的光发生了蓝移
cues.pinyin: O lig jiu4 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 tai4 yang2 de5 guang1 fa1 sheng1 le5 lan2 yi2
cues.en: Oligei will find that the Sun's light has undergone a blueshift.

cues.zh: 但是如果外星人在太阳的背后呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 wai4 xing1 ren2 zai4 tai4 yang2 de5 bei4 hou4 ne5
cues.en: But what if the alien is behind the Sun?

cues.zh: 在太阳的背后你会发现它这个距离变大了
cues.pinyin: zai4 tai4 yang2 de5 bei4 hou4 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 ta1 zhe4 ge5 ju4 li2 bian4 da4 le5
cues.en: Behind the Sun, you'll find this distance has increased,

cues.zh: 所以它的波长变大了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 de5 bo1 chang2 bian4 da4 le5
cues.en: so its wavelength has increased.

cues.zh: 波长一旦变大了那么频率就会减小
cues.pinyin: bo1 chang2 yi2 dan4 bian4 da4 le5 na4 me5 pin2 lv4 jiu4 hui4 jian3 xiao3
cues.en: Once the wavelength increases, the frequency decreases.

cues.zh: 波长最大频率最小的光是红光
cues.pinyin: bo1 chang2 zui4 da4 pin2 lv4 zui4 xiao3 de5 guang1 shi4 hong2 guang1
cues.en: The light with the longest wavelength and lowest frequency is red light.

cues.zh: 所以这种现象我们称它为红移
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 zhong3 xian4 xiang4 wo3 men5 cheng1 ta1 wei4 hong2 yi2
cues.en: So we call this phenomenon redshift.

cues.zh: 也就是说假如这个光源在离我们远去
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 jia3 ru2 zhe4 ge5 guang1 yuan2 zai4 li2 wo3 men5 yuan3 qu4
cues.en: That is, if the light source is moving away from us,

cues.zh: 我们会看到红移现象
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 kan4 dao4 hong2 yi2 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: we'll observe the redshift phenomenon.

cues.zh: 而且经过一些简单的公式推导
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 jing1 guo4 yi1 xie1 jian3 dan1 de5 gong1 shi4 tui1 dao3
cues.en: And after some simple formula derivation,

cues.zh: 其实我们可以得到这样的一个结论
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 de2 dao4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 lun4
cues.en: we can actually arrive at this conclusion:

cues.zh: 就是这个奥利给星人他会发现
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ao4 li4 gei3 xing1 ren2 ta1 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: that this alien Oligei will find

cues.zh: 太阳的发出的光它的频率变化
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 de5 fa1 chu1 de5 guang1 ta1 de5 pin2 lv4 bian4 hua4
cues.en: that the frequency of the light emitted by the Sun changes...

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 你见过在大马路上给一个肝做手术的吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 jian4 guo4 zai4 da4 ma3 lu4 shang4 gei3 yi2 ge4 gan1 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 ma5
cues.en: Have you ever seen someone operate on a liver in the middle of the street?

cues.zh: 这天一大早克莱尔就接到一个电话
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 yi1 da4 zao3 ke4 lai2 er3 jiu4 jie1 dao4 yi2 ge4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Early that morning, Claire got a phone call.

cues.zh: 电话的内容让他欣喜若狂
cues.pinyin: dian4 hua4 de5 nei4 rong2 rang4 ta1 xin1 xi3 ruo4 kuang2
cues.en: The call filled him with joy.

cues.zh: 对方说找到了和他们医院患者查克相
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shuo1 zhao3 dao4 le5 he2 ta1 men5 yi1 yuan4 huan4 zhe3 cha2 ke4 xiang1
cues.en: The caller said they'd found a liver matching their hospital's patient Chuck

cues.zh: 匹配的肝源了
cues.pinyin: pi3 pei4 de5 gan1 yuan2 le5
cues.en: — a matching liver donor.

cues.zh: 就在旧金山的一个医院
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 jiu4 jin1 shan1 de5 yi2 ge4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: It was at a hospital in San Francisco.

cues.zh: 克莱尔赶紧跑过去告诉了梅医生
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 gan3 jin3 pao3 guo4 qu4 gao4 su4 le5 mei2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Claire rushed over to tell Dr. Melendez.

cues.zh: 只是肝脏从摘取到移植只能存活 8 个小时
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 gan1 zang4 cong2 zhai1 qu3 dao4 yi2 zhi2 zhi3 neng2 cun2 huo2 8 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: But a liver can only survive 8 hours from removal to transplant.

cues.zh: 梅医生立刻派他和萧恩一起去取
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 pai4 ta1 he2 xiao1 en1 yi4 qi3 qu4 qu3
cues.en: Dr. Melendez immediately sent him and Shaun to retrieve it.

cues.zh: 为了抓紧时间医院直接给他们配
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 zhua1 jin3 shi2 jian1 yi1 yuan4 zhi2 jie1 gei3 ta1 men5 pei4
cues.en: To save time, the hospital arranged

cues.zh: 了一架直升机
cues.pinyin: le5 yi1 jia4 zhi2 sheng1 ji1
cues.en: a helicopter for them.

cues.zh: 直升机飞到旧金山只用了十几分钟
cues.pinyin: zhi2 sheng1 ji1 fei1 dao4 jiu4 jin1 shan1 zhi3 yong4 le5 shi2 ji3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: The helicopter took only a little over ten minutes to reach San Francisco.

cues.zh: 可到了医院他们被告知说
cues.pinyin: ke3 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4 ta1 men5 bei4 gao4 zhi1 shuo1
cues.en: But when they got to the hospital, they were told

cues.zh: 有个排名靠前的患者
cues.pinyin: you3 ge4 pai2 ming2 kao4 qian2 de5 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: a patient higher up on the list

cues.zh: 没来得及移植就死了
cues.pinyin: mei2 lai2 de5 ji2 yi2 zhi2 jiu4 si3 le5
cues.en: had died before he could get the transplant.

cues.zh: 而为他们准备的肝脏
cues.pinyin: er2 wei4 ta1 men5 zhun3 bei4 de5 gan1 zang4
cues.en: And the liver that had been prepared for them

cues.zh: 已经取出来三个小时之久
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 qu3 chu1 lai2 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 zhi1 jiu3
cues.en: had already been out of the body for three hours.

cues.zh: 这个就是给查克救命的肝
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 gei3 cha2 ke4 jiu4 ming4 de5 gan1
cues.en: This was the liver meant to save Chuck.

cues.zh: 他们剩余的时间
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 sheng4 yu2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Their remaining time

cues.zh: 生生从七个小时变成了四个小时
cues.pinyin: sheng1 sheng1 cong2 qi1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 bian4 cheng2 le5 si4 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: had shrunk from seven hours down to four.

cues.zh: 但他们也只能接受这个事实
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 men5 ye3 zhi3 neng2 jie1 shou4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 shi2
cues.en: But they had no choice but to accept it.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 肝脏就保存在保温箱里
cues.pinyin: gan1 zang4 jiu4 bao3 cun2 zai4 bao3 wen1 xiang1 li3
cues.en: The liver was kept in a cooler.

cues.zh: 萧恩把肝脏拿出来检查了一下
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ba3 gan1 zang4 na2 chu1 lai2 jian3 cha2 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Shaun took the liver out to examine it.

cues.zh: 确认健康后就签了字带走了
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 jian4 kang1 hou4 jiu4 qian1 le5 zi4 dai4 zou3 le5
cues.en: After confirming it was healthy, he signed for it and took it.

cues.zh: 但不幸的是因为起雾
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 xing4 de5 shi4 yin1 wei4 qi3 wu4
cues.en: But unfortunately, due to fog,

cues.zh: 未来几个小时直升机没法飞行了
cues.pinyin: wei4 lai2 ji3 ge4 xiao3 shi2 zhi2 sheng1 ji1 mei2 fa3 fei1 xing2 le5
cues.en: the helicopter couldn't fly for the next several hours.

cues.zh: 但肝可等不了那么久了
cues.pinyin: dan4 gan1 ke3 deng3 bu4 liao3 na4 me5 jiu3 le5
cues.en: But the liver couldn't wait that long.

cues.zh: 克莱尔向旧金山医院请求一辆救护车
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 xiang4 jiu4 jin1 shan1 yi1 yuan4 qing3 qiu2 yi1 liang4 jiu4 hu4 che1
cues.en: Claire asked the San Francisco hospital for an ambulance.

cues.zh: 但是前台告诉他
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qian2 tai2 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: But the front desk told him

cues.zh: 附近发生了连环车祸
cues.pinyin: fu4 jin4 fa1 sheng1 le5 lian2 huan2 che1 huo4
cues.en: there'd been a multi-car pileup nearby

cues.zh: 没有空闲的车能支给他们
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 kong4 xian2 de5 che1 neng2 zhi1 gei3 ta1 men5
cues.en: and there wasn't a single car free to spare for them.

cues.zh: 没办法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: With no other option,

cues.zh: 他们只能报警请求警察护送
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi3 neng2 bao4 jing3 qing3 qiu2 jing3 cha2 hu4 song4
cues.en: they could only call the police for an escort.

cues.zh: 有警察叔叔的帮忙
cues.pinyin: you3 jing3 cha2 shu1 shu1 de5 bang1 mang2
cues.en: With the officers' help,

cues.zh: 他们还算顺利
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 suan4 shun4 li4
cues.en: things went fairly smoothly.

cues.zh: 只需要 70 分钟就可以回到医院
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xu1 yao4 70 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 hui2 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: It would only take 70 minutes to get back to the hospital.

cues.zh: 但是保存器官的温度不得低于 4 摄氏度
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bao3 cun2 qi4 guan1 de5 wen1 du4 bu4 de2 di1 yu2 4 she4 shi4 du4
cues.en: But the organ's storage temperature must not go below 4°C,

cues.zh: 高于 8 摄氏度
cues.pinyin: gao1 yu2 8 she4 shi4 du4
cues.en: or above 8°C.

cues.zh: 没过多久
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Before long,

cues.zh: 肝脏的温度就开始升高
cues.pinyin: gan1 zang4 de5 wen1 du4 jiu4 kai1 shi3 sheng1 gao1
cues.en: the liver's temperature started rising.

cues.zh: 马上就要超过阀值了
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 chao1 guo4 fa2 zhi2 le5
cues.en: It was about to exceed the threshold.

cues.zh: 必须停下来找到冰来降温
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 ting2 xia4 lai2 zhao3 dao4 bing1 lai2 jiang4 wen1
cues.en: They had to stop and find ice to cool it down.

cues.zh: 他们好不容易找到一个小卖铺
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hao3 bu4 rong2 yi4 zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 mai4 pu4
cues.en: They finally found a small convenience store,

cues.zh: 但店主说冰箱坏了
cues.pinyin: dan4 dian4 zhu3 shuo1 bing1 xiang1 huai4 le5
cues.en: but the owner said the fridge was broken.

cues.zh: 只有五公里外有个超市
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 wu3 gong1 li3 wai4 you3 ge4 chao1 shi4
cues.en: There was a supermarket five kilometers away.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 他告诉萧恩之所以片子上观察不到凝块
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 xiao1 en1 zhi1 suo3 yi3 pian1 zi5 shang4 guan1 cha2 bu2 dao4 ning2 kuai4
cues.en: He told Shaun the reason no clot was visible on the scan

cues.zh: 是因为这是在摘除肝脏之前拍的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 shi4 zai4 zhai1 chu2 gan1 zang4 zhi1 qian2 pai1 de5
cues.en: was that the image had been taken before the liver was removed.

cues.zh: 那时候肝脏还没有被保存液冲洗
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou4 gan1 zang4 hai2 mei2 you3 bei4 bao3 cun2 ye4 chong1 xi3
cues.en: At that point the liver hadn't been flushed with preservation fluid yet.

cues.zh: 为了保存肝脏
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bao3 cun2 gan1 zang4
cues.en: To preserve the liver,

cues.zh: 医生把里面的血液
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 li3 mian4 de5 xue4 ye4
cues.en: the doctors had replaced all the blood inside it

cues.zh: 全部替换为防止肝脏被冻伤的溶液
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 ti4 huan4 wei4 fang2 zhi3 gan1 zang4 bei4 dong4 shang1 de5 rong2 ye4
cues.en: with a solution that prevents the liver from cold damage.

cues.zh: 但里面肯定残留了血液
cues.pinyin: dan4 li3 mian4 ken3 ding4 can2 liu2 le5 xue4 ye4
cues.en: But some blood must have remained inside,

cues.zh: 形成了凝块
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 le5 ning2 kuai4
cues.en: forming a clot.

cues.zh: 离医院还有 30 分钟的路程
cues.pinyin: li2 yi1 yuan4 hai2 you3 30 fen1 zhong1 de5 lu4 cheng2
cues.en: They were still 30 minutes from the hospital,

cues.zh: 但是已经来不及了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi3 jing1 lai2 bu4 ji2 le5
cues.en: but there wasn't enough time.

cues.zh: 肝脏要死了
cues.pinyin: gan1 zang4 yao4 si3 le5
cues.en: The liver was dying.

cues.zh: 必须立刻停车清除凝块
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 li4 ke4 ting2 che1 qing1 chu2 ning2 kuai4
cues.en: They had to stop right away to remove the clot,

cues.zh: 冲洗左肺液
cues.pinyin: chong1 xi3 zuo3 fei4 ye4
cues.en: flush it with preservation fluid,

cues.zh: 防止肝脏冻伤
cues.pinyin: fang2 zhi3 gan1 zang4 dong4 shang1
cues.en: and prevent the liver from cold damage.

cues.zh: 警察立刻停车
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 li4 ke4 ting2 che1
cues.en: The officer stopped the car at once

cues.zh: 在车后放置警告标志
cues.pinyin: zai4 che1 hou4 fang4 zhi4 jing3 gao4 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: and set up warning signs behind it.

cues.zh: 在一片鸣笛中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi1 pian4 ming2 di2 zhong1
cues.en: Amid blaring horns,

cues.zh: 两人不紧不慢地来挽救这块肝脏
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 bu4 jin3 bu4 man4 di4 lai2 wan3 jiu4 zhe4 kuai4 gan1 zang4
cues.en: the two worked calmly to save the liver.

cues.zh: 萧恩将肝脏放在车的后盖上
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 jiang1 gan1 zang4 fang4 zai4 che1 de5 hou4 gai4 shang4
cues.en: Shaun laid the liver on the car's trunk.

cues.zh: 沿着镰状韧带做一个切口
cues.pinyin: yan2 zhe5 lian2 zhuang4 ren4 dai4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 qie1 kou3
cues.en: He pictured the liver's structure in his mind

cues.zh: 沿着连状韧带做一个切口
cues.pinyin: yan2 zhe5 lian2 zhuang4 ren4 dai4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 qie1 kou3
cues.en: and made an incision along the falciform ligament.

cues.zh: 果然从里面找到一个凝块
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 cong2 li3 mian4 zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 ning2 kuai4
cues.en: Sure enough, he found a clot inside.

cues.zh: 清除之后立刻借助吸管
cues.pinyin: qing1 chu2 zhi1 hou4 li4 ke4 jie4 zhu4 xi1 guan3
cues.en: After removing it, he immediately used a tube

cues.zh: 用保存液冲洗
cues.pinyin: yong4 bao3 cun2 ye4 chong1 xi3
cues.en: to flush it with preservation fluid,

cues.zh: 稳定细胞壁
cues.pinyin: wen3 ding4 xi4 bao1 bi4
cues.en: stabilizing the cell membrane.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 卢卡气愤地去找查克对质
cues.pinyin: lu2 ka3 qi4 fen4 di4 qu4 zhao3 cha2 ke4 dui4 zhi4
cues.en: Luca angrily went to confront Chuck.

cues.zh: 面对铁症如山
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 tie3 zheng4 ru2 shan1
cues.en: Faced with ironclad evidence,

cues.zh: 查克只得承认
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 zhi3 de2 cheng2 ren4
cues.en: Chuck had no choice but to admit it.

cues.zh: 在三天前女儿的毕业典礼上
cues.pinyin: zai4 san1 tian1 qian2 nv3 er2 de5 bi4 ye4 dian3 li3 shang4
cues.en: Three days earlier, at his daughter's graduation,

cues.zh: 他喝了一杯香槟
cues.pinyin: ta1 he1 le5 yi1 bei1 xiang1 bin1
cues.en: he'd had a glass of champagne.

cues.zh: 但就一杯
cues.pinyin: dan4 jiu4 yi1 bei1
cues.en: But just one glass.

cues.zh: 难道他因此就不能做移植手术了吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 ta1 yin1 ci3 jiu4 bu4 neng2 zuo4 yi2 zhi2 shou3 shu4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did that really mean he couldn't get the transplant?

cues.zh: 查克是一个很好的人
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 hao3 de5 ren2
cues.en: Chuck was a good man.

cues.zh: 他已经等这个肝源半年了
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi3 jing1 deng3 zhe4 ge5 gan1 yuan2 ban4 nian2 le5
cues.en: He'd been waiting for this liver for half a year.

cues.zh: 虽然卢卡很同情他
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 lu2 ka3 hen3 tong2 qing2 ta1
cues.en: Though Luca sympathized with him,

cues.zh: 但是器官移植登记中心
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qi4 guan1 yi2 zhi2 deng1 ji4 zhong1 xin1
cues.en: the organ transplant registry

cues.zh: 有明文规定
cues.pinyin: you3 ming2 wen2 gui1 ding4
cues.en: had explicit rules,

cues.zh: 他也没办法违背
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 mei2 ban4 fa3 wei2 bei4
cues.en: and he couldn't break them either.

cues.zh: 无奈之下
cues.pinyin: wu2 nai4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: With no other choice,

cues.zh: 卢卡却找了梅医生商量对策
cues.pinyin: lu2 ka3 que4 zhao3 le5 mei2 yi1 sheng1 shang1 liang2 dui4 ce4
cues.en: Luca went to discuss a solution with Dr. Melendez.

cues.zh: 梅医生秀了一通数学能力
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 xiu4 le5 yi2 tong4 shu4 xue2 neng2 li4
cues.en: Dr. Melendez showed off some math skills

cues.zh: 计算出查克没说谎
cues.pinyin: ji4 suan4 chu1 cha2 ke4 mei2 shuo1 huang3
cues.en: and calculated that Chuck wasn't lying —

cues.zh: 确实只喝了一杯
cues.pinyin: que4 shi2 zhi3 he1 le5 yi1 bei1
cues.en: he really had had only one drink.

cues.zh: 事情或许还有转机
cues.pinyin: shi4 qing2 huo4 xu3 hai2 you3 zhuan3 ji1
cues.en: Maybe there was still a chance.

cues.zh: 梅医生去和董事会沟通
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 qu4 he2 dong3 shi4 hui4 gou1 tong1
cues.en: Dr. Melendez went to talk with the board,

cues.zh: 想要让查克移植这个肝脏
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 rang4 cha2 ke4 yi2 zhi2 zhe4 ge5 gan1 zang4
cues.en: hoping to let Chuck get this liver.

cues.zh: 卢卡去安慰查克
cues.pinyin: lu2 ka3 qu4 an1 wei4 cha2 ke4
cues.en: Luca went to comfort Chuck,

cues.zh: 让他放心
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 fang4 xin1
cues.en: telling him not to worry.

cues.zh: 但查克却开始怀疑自己是否值得
cues.pinyin: dan4 cha2 ke4 que4 kai1 shi3 huai2 yi2 zi4 ji3 shi4 fou3 zhi2 de5
cues.en: But Chuck started to doubt whether he deserved it.

cues.zh: 有无数的人在排队等一个肝源
cues.pinyin: you3 wu2 shu4 de5 ren2 zai4 pai2 dui4 deng3 yi2 ge4 gan1 yuan2
cues.en: Countless people were waiting in line for a liver,

cues.zh: 而自己却不珍惜这个机会
cues.pinyin: er2 zi4 ji3 que4 bu4 zhen1 xi1 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: yet he hadn't valued this chance

cues.zh: 违反规定去喝酒
cues.pinyin: wei2 fan3 gui1 ding4 qu4 he1 jiu3
cues.en: and broke the rules to drink.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 他越说越激动
cues.pinyin: ta1 yue4 shuo1 yue4 ji1 dong4
cues.en: He got more and more worked up as he spoke,

cues.zh: 最后直接昏了过去
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhi2 jie1 hun1 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and finally passed out.

cues.zh: 检测器发出了警报
cues.pinyin: jian3 ce4 qi4 fa1 chu1 le5 jing3 bao4
cues.en: The monitor set off an alarm.

cues.zh: 查克静脉曲张出血
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 jing4 mai4 qu3 zhang1 chu1 xie3
cues.en: Chuck's esophageal varices were bleeding.

cues.zh: 血压不断上升
cues.pinyin: xue4 ya1 bu4 duan4 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: His blood pressure kept rising.

cues.zh: 经检查肝衰竭恶化
cues.pinyin: jing1 jian3 cha2 gan1 shuai1 jie2 e4 hua4
cues.en: Tests showed his liver failure had worsened.

cues.zh: 他只剩下不到三个月的寿命了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 bu2 dao4 san1 ge4 yue4 de5 shou4 ming4 le5
cues.en: He had less than three months left to live.

cues.zh: 没有这个肝源
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhe4 ge5 gan1 yuan2
cues.en: Without this liver,

cues.zh: 他必死无疑
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi4 si3 wu2 yi2
cues.en: he would surely die.

cues.zh: 会议上
cues.pinyin: hui4 yi4 shang4
cues.en: At the meeting,

cues.zh: 梅医生竭力帮查克争取这个机会
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 jie2 li4 bang1 cha2 ke4 zheng1 qu3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: Dr. Melendez fought hard to get Chuck this chance.

cues.zh: 查克酒饮没有复发
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 jiu3 yin3 mei2 you3 fu4 fa1
cues.en: Chuck's drinking wasn't a relapse —

cues.zh: 他只喝了一杯香槟而已
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 he1 le5 yi1 bei1 xiang1 bin1 er2 yi3
cues.en: he'd only had one glass of champagne.

cues.zh: 移植登记中心的规定太死板了
cues.pinyin: yi2 zhi2 deng1 ji4 zhong1 xin1 de5 gui1 ding4 tai4 si3 ban3 le5
cues.en: The transplant registry's rules were too rigid.

cues.zh: 他不能因为一杯酒而被剥夺生存的机会
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 neng2 yin1 wei4 yi1 bei1 jiu3 er2 bei4 bo1 duo2 sheng1 cun2 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: He shouldn't lose his chance to live over one drink.

cues.zh: 他们作为医生肩负着拯救患者的责任
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 wei2 yi1 sheng1 jian1 fu4 zhe5 zheng3 jiu4 huan4 zhe3 de5 ze2 ren4
cues.en: As doctors, they bore the responsibility of saving patients.

cues.zh: 不应该完全被规矩所撤走
cues.pinyin: bu4 ying1 gai1 wan2 quan2 bei4 gui1 ju3 suo3 che4 zou3
cues.en: They shouldn't be completely bound by the rules.

cues.zh: 但黑哥不同意他的说法
cues.pinyin: dan4 hei1 ge1 bu4 tong2 yi4 ta1 de5 shuo1 fa3
cues.en: But Dr. Hei disagreed with him.

cues.zh: 规矩制定是有他的理由的
cues.pinyin: gui1 ju3 zhi4 ding4 shi4 you3 ta1 de5 li3 you2 de5
cues.en: The rules were made for a reason.

cues.zh: 而且泉州今天需要这个肝原的有 800 多人
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 quan2 zhou1 jin1 tian1 xu1 yao4 zhe4 ge5 gan1 yuan2 de5 you3 800 duo1 ren2
cues.en: and that day over 800 people statewide needed a liver.

cues.zh: 如果把这个肝脏给了查克
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 gan1 zang4 gei3 le5 cha2 ke4
cues.en: If this liver went to Chuck,

cues.zh: 那对于剩下的严格遵守规定的人
cues.pinyin: na4 dui4 yu2 sheng4 xia4 de5 yan2 ge2 zun1 shou3 gui1 ding4 de5 ren2
cues.en: wouldn't that be unfair

cues.zh: 是不是太不公平了
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 tai4 bu4 gong1 ping2 le5
cues.en: to everyone else who strictly followed the rules?

cues.zh: 查克明知道有这个规定还去违反
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 ming2 zhi1 dao4 you3 zhe4 ge5 gui1 ding4 hai2 qu4 wei2 fan3
cues.en: Chuck knew about the rule and broke it anyway,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 肝脏只能在体外存活八个小时，为了救人，天才医生直接在大马路上给肝做手术！

cues.zh: 移植给其他人
cues.pinyin: yi2 zhi2 gei3 qi2 ta1 ren2
cues.en: so it should go to transplant someone else instead.

cues.zh: 克莱尔又失落又伤心
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 you4 shi1 luo4 you4 shang1 xin1
cues.en: Claire felt both disappointed and heartbroken.

cues.zh: 他努力了这么久
cues.pinyin: ta1 nu3 li4 le5 zhe4 me5 jiu3
cues.en: After all his hard work,

cues.zh: 还是没办法救查克
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 mei2 ban4 fa3 jiu4 cha2 ke4
cues.en: he still couldn't save Chuck.

cues.zh: 但肖恩反而心情很好的样子
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 fan3 er2 xin1 qing2 hen3 hao3 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: But Shaun seemed to be in a great mood.

cues.zh: 他告诉克莱尔
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 ke4 lai2 er3
cues.en: He told Claire,

cues.zh: 真是美好的一天
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 mei3 hao3 de5 yi1 tian1
cues.en: it had really been a wonderful day —

cues.zh: 我们拯救了一个生命
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zheng3 jiu4 le5 yi2 ge4 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: they'd saved a life,

cues.zh: 只不过不是查克的
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 bu2 shi4 cha2 ke4 de5
cues.en: just not Chuck's.

cues.zh: 克莱尔突然就释然了
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 tu1 ran2 jiu4 shi4 ran2 le5
cues.en: Claire suddenly felt at peace.

cues.zh: 查克最后还是出院了
cues.pinyin: cha2 ke4 zui4 hou4 hai2 shi4 chu1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: In the end, Chuck was discharged from the hospital.

cues.zh: 他并没责怪任何人
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 mei2 ze2 guai4 ren4 he2 ren2
cues.en: He didn't blame anyone.

cues.zh: 剩下的生命里他会好好的活
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 sheng1 ming4 li3 ta1 hui4 hao3 hao3 de5 huo2
cues.en: He would live the rest of his life well.

cues.zh: 这个男人脸上开了个洞
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 lian3 shang4 kai1 le5 ge4 dong4
cues.en: This man has a hole in his face —

cues.zh: 喝酒都漏
cues.pinyin: he1 jiu3 dou1 lou4
cues.en: when he drinks, it just leaks right out.

cues.zh: 他叫大腕
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 da4 wan4
cues.en: His name is Big Shot.

cues.zh: 之前因为切除面部的肿瘤
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 yin1 wei4 qie1 chu2 mian4 bu4 de5 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: Because he'd had a facial tumor removed before,

cues.zh: 结果留下了两个口子
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 liu2 xia4 le5 liang3 ge4 kou3 zi5
cues.en: it left behind two openings.

cues.zh: 下午要做器官移植
cues.pinyin: xia4 wu3 yao4 zuo4 qi4 guan1 yi2 zhi2
cues.en: That afternoon he was due for an organ transplant.

cues.zh: 他是医院的 V IP 客户
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi1 yuan4 de5 V IP ke4 hu4
cues.en: He was a VIP client of the hospital,

cues.zh: 也是个政界的大人物
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 ge4 zheng4 jie4 de5 da4 ren2 wu4
cues.en: and also a major political figure,

cues.zh: 掌管医院基金会的税款
cues.pinyin: zhang3 guan3 yi1 yuan4 ji1 jin1 hui4 de5 shui4 kuan3
cues.en: who controlled the hospital foundation's tax funds.

cues.zh: 基金会会长对他做了好长时间的思想工作
cues.pinyin: ji1 jin1 hui4 hui4 zhang3 dui4 ta1 zuo4 le5 hao3 zhang3 shi2 jian1 de5 si1 xiang3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: The foundation chairman had spent a long time working on him,

cues.zh: 才让大腕有给医院减税的想法
cues.pinyin: cai2 rang4 da4 wan4 you3 gei3 yi1 yuan4 jian3 shui4 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: before finally getting Big Shot to consider giving the hospital a tax break.

cues.zh: 所以会长在手术前
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hui4 zhang3 zai4 shou3 shu4 qian2
cues.en: So before the surgery, the chairman

cues.zh: 特地找了大腕的主导医生黑格
cues.pinyin: te4 di4 zhao3 le5 da4 wan4 de5 zhu3 dao3 yi1 sheng1 hei1 ge2
cues.en: specially went to see Big Shot's attending doctor, Dr. Hei.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友跟我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a child told me

cues.zh: 他在网上看到了一个很好玩的东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wang3 shang4 kan4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 hen3 hao3 wan2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: that he saw something really fun online

cues.zh: 叫做鲁伯特之泪

cues.zh: 是一个玻璃做得像蝌蚪一样的东西
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 bo1 li2 zuo4 de2 xiang4 ke1 dou3 yi1 yang4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: It's a piece of glass shaped like a tadpole.

cues.zh: 他的头非常非常坚硬用子弹都打不破
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tou2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 jian1 ying4 yong4 zi3 dan4 dou1 da3 bu4 po4
cues.en: Its head is extremely hard — even a bullet can't break it.

cues.zh: 但他尾巴却特别脆弱一捏他就会爆炸
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 wei3 ba5 que4 te4 bie2 cui4 ruo4 yi1 nie1 ta1 jiu4 hui4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: But its tail is very fragile — pinch it and it explodes.

cues.zh: 这是怎么回事呢咱们先来看一看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5 zan2 men5 xian1 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4
cues.en: How does that work? Let's take a look first

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 为什么这个鲁伯特之泪具有这些
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 ge5 lu3 bo2 te4 zhi1 lei4 ju4 you3 zhe4 xie1
cues.en: at why this Prince Rupert's drop has

cues.zh: 神奇的性质呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 qi2 de5 xing4 zhi4 ne5
cues.en: these magical properties.

cues.zh: 今天就来给大家介绍一下
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Today I'll introduce

cues.zh: 鲁伯特之泪
cues.pinyin: lu3 bo2 te4 zhi1 lei4
cues.en: the Prince Rupert's drop.

cues.zh: 鲁伯特之泪这个名字听着就挺好玩的
cues.pinyin: lu3 bo2 te4 zhi1 lei4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4 ting1 zhe5 jiu4 ting3 hao3 wan2 de5
cues.en: "Prince Rupert's drop" — that name already sounds fun.

cues.zh: 鲁伯特是谁是一个王子
cues.pinyin: lu3 bo2 te4 shi4 shui2 shi4 yi2 ge4 wang2 zi3
cues.en: Who is Rupert? He's a prince.

cues.zh: 这个王子鲁伯特
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wang2 zi3 lu3 bo2 te4
cues.en: This Prince Rupert

cues.zh: 他就喜欢做一些奇奇怪怪的玩意儿
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 xi3 huan1 zuo4 yi1 xie1 qi2 qi2 guai4 guai4 de5 wan2 yi4 er2
cues.en: liked making all sorts of strange things.

cues.zh: 结果就发现我可以干这么一件事
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 fa1 xian4 wo3 ke3 yi3 gan4 zhe4 me5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: He found he could do something like this:

cues.zh: 我把一个玻璃
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba3 yi2 ge4 bo1 li2
cues.en: take a piece of glass,

cues.zh: 我把它玻璃用这个火给它烧烧软了
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba3 ta1 bo1 li2 yong4 zhe4 ge5 huo3 gei3 ta1 shao1 shao1 ruan3 le5
cues.en: heat it with fire until it's soft,

cues.zh: 然后让它滴下来玻璃融化
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rang4 ta1 di1 xia4 lai2 bo1 li2 rong2 hua4
cues.en: then let it drip down as the molten glass melts.

cues.zh: 融化完了之后
cues.pinyin: rong2 hua4 wan2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After it melts,

cues.zh: 我让这个玻璃我滴到了什么呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 rang4 zhe4 ge5 bo1 li2 wo3 di1 dao4 le5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: where did I drip this glass?

cues.zh: 滴到了水中滴到冷水之中
cues.pinyin: di1 dao4 le5 shui3 zhong1 di1 dao4 leng3 shui3 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: Into water — into cold water.

cues.zh: 结果一滴到冷水之中
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 yi1 di1 dao4 leng3 shui3 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: As soon as it dripped into the cold water,

cues.zh: 它不就迅速冷却了吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 jiu4 xun4 su4 leng3 que4 le5 ma5
cues.en: didn't it cool down rapidly?

cues.zh: 然后就形成了一个长得像蝌蚪这么一
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 xing2 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 zhang3 de2 xiang4 ke1 dou3 zhe4 me5 yi1
cues.en: Then it formed a shape

cues.zh: 个形状了对吧
cues.pinyin: ge4 xing2 zhuang4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: like a tadpole, right?

cues.zh: 然后他就发现这玩意很好玩
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 wan2 yi4 hen3 hao3 wan2
cues.en: Then he found this thing was really fun.

cues.zh: 你他头特别硬拿锤子砸砸不碎
cues.pinyin: ni3 ta1 tou2 te4 bie2 ying4 na2 chui2 zi5 za2 za2 bu4 sui4
cues.en: Look, its head is so hard that hitting it with a hammer won't break it.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 最开始你滴到水中的时候玻璃温度很高
cues.pinyin: zui4 kai1 shi3 ni3 di1 dao4 shui3 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4 bo1 li2 wen1 du4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: At first, when it drips into the water, the glass is very hot,

cues.zh: 而水的温度不高
cues.pinyin: er2 shui3 de5 wen1 du4 bu4 gao1
cues.en: while the water isn't.

cues.zh: 所以一旦接触那么它的外层
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi2 dan4 jie1 chu4 na4 me5 ta1 de5 wai4 ceng2
cues.en: So as soon as they touch, the outer layer —

cues.zh: 就这个玻璃的外层遇到冷水
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 ge5 bo1 li2 de5 wai4 ceng2 yu4 dao4 leng3 shui3
cues.en: the outer layer of the glass — meets the cold water,

cues.zh: 结果就快速的干嘛呀就冷却了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 kuai4 su4 de5 gan4 ma2 ya5 jiu4 leng3 que4 le5
cues.en: and as a result it quickly does what? It cools down.

cues.zh: 快速的就冷却了
cues.pinyin: kuai4 su4 de5 jiu4 leng3 que4 le5
cues.en: It cools down rapidly.

cues.zh: 外层快速冷却然后就凝固了呗就硬了对吧
cues.pinyin: wai4 ceng2 kuai4 su4 leng3 que4 ran2 hou4 jiu4 ning2 gu4 le5 bei5 jiu4 ying4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: The outer layer cools quickly and solidifies, becoming hard, right?

cues.zh: 但是外层冷却的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wai4 ceng2 leng3 que4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But while the outer layer is cooling,

cues.zh: 我们如果仔细看你就会发现
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 zi3 xi4 kan4 ni3 jiu4 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: if you look closely, you'll notice

cues.zh: 它的内层其实还没有冷却呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 nei4 ceng2 qi2 shi2 hai2 mei2 you3 leng3 que4 ne5
cues.en: the inner layer actually hasn't cooled yet.

cues.zh: 慢慢的内层也冷却了
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 nei4 ceng2 ye3 leng3 que4 le5
cues.en: Slowly, the inner layer cools too.

cues.zh: 所以内层是一个缓慢的冷却过程
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 nei4 ceng2 shi4 yi2 ge4 huan3 man4 de5 leng3 que4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: So the inner layer goes through a slow cooling process.

cues.zh: 那么内层缓慢冷却又如何呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 nei4 ceng2 huan3 man4 leng3 que4 you4 ru2 he2 ne5
cues.en: So what happens when the inner layer cools slowly?

cues.zh: 你要知道冷却的时候它会怎么样
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 zhi1 dao4 leng3 que4 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: You should know what happens when something cools:

cues.zh: 热胀冷缩对不对
cues.pinyin: re4 zhang4 leng3 suo1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: it expands when hot and contracts when cold, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 因为往里拽拽着拽着就把这个
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wang3 li3 zhuai1 zhuai1 zhe5 zhuai1 zhe5 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: Because it's being pulled inward, pulled and pulled, it

cues.zh: 外层给拽紧了
cues.pinyin: wai4 ceng2 gei3 zhuai1 jin3 le5
cues.en: squeezes the outer layer tight.

cues.zh: 是吧拽紧了这外层就会有压应力了
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 zhuai1 jin3 le5 zhe4 wai4 ceng2 jiu4 hui4 you3 ya1 ying1 li4 le5
cues.en: Right, squeezed tight — so the outer layer ends up under compressive stress.

cues.zh: 而且它里边是收缩的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 li3 bian1 shi4 shou1 suo1 de5
cues.en: And the inside is contracting.

cues.zh: 那里边不是体积小它要收缩吗
cues.pinyin: na4 li3 bian1 bu2 shi4 ti3 ji1 xiao3 ta1 yao4 shou1 suo1 ma5
cues.en: Doesn't the inside shrink in volume as it contracts?

cues.zh: 收着收着
cues.pinyin: shou1 zhe5 shou1 zhe5
cues.en: As it keeps contracting,

cues.zh: 在这个内层的部分它就会出现什么呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 nei4 ceng2 de5 bu4 fen4 ta1 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: what happens in this inner layer?

cues.zh: 就会出现拉硬力
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 la1 ying4 li4
cues.en: Tensile stress appears.

cues.zh: 所以在这个鲁伯特之内的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 lu3 bo2 te4 zhi1 nei4 de5
cues.en: So in this Prince Rupert's drop,

cues.zh: 它外层和内层它不一样是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 wai4 ceng2 he2 nei4 ceng2 ta1 bu4 yi2 yang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: the outer and inner layers are different, right?

cues.zh: 这个外部它是压硬力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wai4 bu4 ta1 shi4 ya1 ying4 li4
cues.en: The outer part is under compressive stress —

cues.zh: 是压硬力
cues.pinyin: shi4 ya1 ying4 li4
cues.en: compressive stress.

cues.zh: 而内部它是拉硬力
cues.pinyin: er2 nei4 bu4 ta1 shi4 la1 ying4 li4
cues.en: while the inner part is under tensile stress —

cues.zh: 拉硬力是吧
cues.pinyin: la1 ying4 li4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: tensile stress, right?

cues.zh: 这个力可以非常大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 ke3 yi3 fei1 chang2 da4
cues.en: This force can be enormous.

cues.zh: 这个压应力可以达到多大呀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ya1 ying1 li4 ke3 yi3 da2 dao4 duo1 da4 ya5
cues.en: I saw some sources saying

cues.zh: 这个压硬力可以达到多大呀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ya1 ying4 li4 ke3 yi3 da2 dao4 duo1 da4 ya5
cues.en: how big can this compressive stress get?

cues.zh: 可以达到 7 000 倍的大气压
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 da2 dao4 7 000 bei4 de5 da4 qi4 ya1
cues.en: It can reach 7,000 times atmospheric pressure.

cues.zh: 7 000 倍的大气压是什么概念呢
cues.pinyin: 7 000 bei4 de5 da4 qi4 ya1 shi4 shen2 me5 gai4 nian4 ne5
cues.en: What does 7,000 times atmospheric pressure even mean?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 那大概就相当于是把 7 吨的物体
cues.pinyin: na4 da4 gai4 jiu4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 shi4 ba3 7 dun1 de5 wu4 ti3
cues.en: It's roughly like pressing a 7-ton object

cues.zh: 压在一平方厘米的
cues.pinyin: ya1 zai4 yi1 ping2 fang1 li2 mi3 de5
cues.en: onto one square centimeter —

cues.zh: 一个大拇指甲盖这么大的面积上
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 da4 mu3 zhi3 jia3 gai4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 mian4 ji1 shang4
cues.en: an area about the size of a thumbnail.

cues.zh: 7 吨的物体压在大拇指甲盖这
cues.pinyin: 7 dun1 de5 wu4 ti3 ya1 zai4 da4 mu3 zhi3 jia3 gai4 zhe4
cues.en: A 7-ton object pressed onto

cues.zh: 么大的面积上
cues.pinyin: me5 da4 de5 mian4 ji1 shang4
cues.en: an area the size of a thumbnail.

cues.zh: 所以可见它这个力有多大
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ke3 jian4 ta1 zhe4 ge5 li4 you3 duo1 da4
cues.en: So you can see just how great this force is.

cues.zh: 它力气非常大是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 li4 qi4 fei1 chang2 da4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: It's an enormous force, right?

cues.zh: 所以当我们有一个比如子弹打过来的时候
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dang1 wo3 men5 you3 yi2 ge4 bi3 ru2 zi3 dan4 da3 guo4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: So when, say, a bullet hits it,

cues.zh: 你首先你要克服这个压阴力
cues.pinyin: ni3 shou3 xian1 ni3 yao4 ke4 fu2 zhe4 ge5 ya1 yin1 li4
cues.en: you first have to overcome this compressive stress.

cues.zh: 你克服不了压阴力你就不能使它破碎
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke4 fu2 bu4 liao3 ya1 yin1 li4 ni3 jiu4 bu4 neng2 shi3 ta1 po4 sui4
cues.en: If you can't overcome the compressive stress, you can't break it.

cues.zh: 是吧所以它就非常非常坚硬
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 jian1 ying4
cues.en: Right, so it ends up extremely hard.

cues.zh: 如果我们打个比方吧
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 da3 ge4 bi3 fang1 ba5
cues.en: Let's use an analogy.

cues.zh: 好比说有这么一个木板
cues.pinyin: hao3 bi3 shuo1 you3 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 mu4 ban3
cues.en: Say there's a wooden board,

cues.zh: 然后一个人他就站在这个木板上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yi2 ge4 ren2 ta1 jiu4 zhan4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 mu4 ban3 shang4
cues.en: and a person stands on this board

cues.zh: 给木板一个立
cues.pinyin: gei3 mu4 ban3 yi2 ge4 li4
cues.en: and applies a force to the board.

cues.zh: 那如果木板内部本身没有压力的话
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 mu4 ban3 nei4 bu4 ben3 shen1 mei2 you3 ya1 li4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If the board itself has no internal stress,

cues.zh: 这个人就比较容易把这个木板
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 mu4 ban3
cues.en: it's relatively easy for this person to bend

cues.zh: 给压弯对不对
cues.pinyin: gei3 ya1 wan1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: the board, right?

cues.zh: 但是如果这个木板它本身它是
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 mu4 ban3 ta1 ben3 shen1 ta1 shi4
cues.en: But if this board itself is

cues.zh: 这样拱起来的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 gong3 qi3 lai2 de5
cues.en: already arched like this,

cues.zh: 像赵州桥一样是吧
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhao4 zhou1 qiao2 yi1 yang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: like the Zhaozhou Bridge,

cues.zh: 它拱在地面上这样拱着的
cues.pinyin: ta1 gong3 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 zhe4 yang4 gong3 zhe5 de5
cues.en: arched over the ground like that,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】神奇的鲁伯特之泪：子弹打不碎，一捏就爆炸！

cues.zh: 它这个压力和拉力的平衡就被破坏了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 ge5 ya1 li4 he2 la1 li4 de5 ping2 heng2 jiu4 bei4 po4 huai4 le5
cues.en: then the balance between compression and tension gets disrupted,

cues.zh: 所以就会以一个很高的速度
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 hui4 yi3 yi2 ge4 hen3 gao1 de5 su4 du4
cues.en: so it will, at very high speed,

cues.zh: 整个的这个水滴就会爆炸
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 de5 zhe4 ge5 shui3 di1 jiu4 hui4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: cause the whole drop to explode.

cues.zh: 那这个速度有多大呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 su4 du4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: So how fast is this speed?

cues.zh: 这国外有很多很有意思的这个 up 主
cues.pinyin: zhe4 guo2 wai4 you3 hen3 duo1 hen3 you3 yi4 si5 de5 zhe4 ge5 up zhu3
cues.en: There are many interesting foreign creators

cues.zh: 他做一些视频去观察
cues.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 yi1 xie1 shi4 pin2 qu4 guan1 cha2
cues.en: who make videos observing it

cues.zh: 高速摄影机去观察它
cues.pinyin: gao1 su4 she4 ying3 ji1 qu4 guan1 cha2 ta1
cues.en: using high-speed cameras to watch it.

cues.zh: 结果发现这个速度可以达到
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 su4 du4 ke3 yi3 da2 dao4
cues.en: They found that the speed can reach

cues.zh: 大概是 16 00 米每秒
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 16 00 mi3 mei3 miao3
cues.en: roughly 1,600 meters per second,

cues.zh: 甚至可以最高达到 19 00 米每秒这个量级
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 ke3 yi3 zui4 gao1 da2 dao4 19 00 mi3 mei3 miao3 zhe4 ge5 liang4 ji2
cues.en: and can even reach as high as 1,900 meters per second.

cues.zh: 就是你这边碎了之后
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 zhe4 bian1 sui4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: That is, after it breaks here,

cues.zh: 它就这么碎了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 zhe4 me5 sui4 le5
cues.en: it just shatters like this.

cues.zh: 那大概速度是 16 00 m s 非常快的一个速度
cues.pinyin: na4 da4 gai4 su4 du4 shi4 16 00 m s fei1 chang2 kuai4 de5 yi2 ge4 su4 du4
cues.en: So the speed is roughly 1,600 m/s — an incredibly fast speed.

cues.zh: 好现在看起来好像这个鲁伯特之类
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 kan4 qi3 lai2 hao3 xiang4 zhe4 ge5 lu3 bo2 te4 zhi1 lei4
cues.en: Okay, so now it seems like this Prince Rupert's drop

cues.zh: 就是一个好玩的东西
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 wan2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: is just a fun thing,

cues.zh: 就像王子一样我拿它去吓人是吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 wang2 zi3 yi1 yang4 wo3 na2 ta1 qu4 xia4 ren2 shi4 ba5
cues.en: like using it to scare people, the way the prince did, right?

cues.zh: 那除了吓人以外还有没有实际的用处呢
cues.pinyin: na4 chu2 le5 xia4 ren2 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 mei2 you3 shi2 ji4 de5 yong4 chu3 ne5
cues.en: But besides scaring people, does it have any practical use?

cues.zh: 其实很有
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hen3 you3
cues.en: Actually, it has plenty.

cues.zh: 这个原理我们现在用在很多很多的地方
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yuan2 li3 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 yong4 zai4 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: We now use this principle in tons of places —

cues.zh: 遍地都是我们家里边都有是吧
cues.pinyin: bian4 di4 dou1 shi4 wo3 men5 jia1 li3 bian1 dou1 you3 shi4 ba5
cues.en: it's everywhere, we all have it at home, right?

cues.zh: 什么东西就是钢化玻璃

cues.en: What is it? It's tempered glass.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】1918西班牙流感始末：一场杀死5000万人的大瘟疫

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 有个小朋友说
cues.pinyin: you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 shuo1
cues.en: A young student asked,

cues.zh: 在 100 年前有一次世界范围的大流感
cues.pinyin: zai4 100 nian2 qian2 you3 yi1 ci4 shi4 jie4 fan4 wei2 de5 da4 liu2 gan3
cues.en: 100 years ago there was a worldwide flu pandemic

cues.zh: 杀死了 5000 万人
cues.pinyin: sha1 si3 le5 5000 wan4 ren2
cues.en: that killed 50 million people.

cues.zh: 这是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: How did this happen?

cues.zh: 今天就给大家介绍一下这个过程
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: Today I'll walk you through this process.

cues.zh: 西班牙流感发生在 100 年前
cues.pinyin: xi1 ban1 ya2 liu2 gan3 fa1 sheng1 zai4 100 nian2 qian2
cues.en: The Spanish flu occurred 100 years ago.

cues.zh: 那么我们要说西班牙流感
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 yao4 shuo1 xi1 ban1 ya2 liu2 gan3
cues.en: So to talk about the Spanish flu,

cues.zh: 首先我们得从 100 年前的那一场战争
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 de2 cong2 100 nian2 qian2 de5 na4 yi1 chang2 zhan4 zheng1
cues.en: we first need to start from the war 100 years ago,

cues.zh: 也就是第一次世界大战说起
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 di4 yi2 ci4 shi4 jie4 da4 zhan4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: that is, World War I.

cues.zh: 第一次世界大战的时间大家还记
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ci4 shi4 jie4 da4 zhan4 de5 shi2 jian1 da4 jia1 hai2 ji4
cues.en: Does everyone remember when World War I

cues.zh: 得是哪一年吗
cues.pinyin: de2 shi4 na3 yi1 nian2 ma5
cues.en: took place?

cues.zh: 是在 19 14 年到 19 18 年是在这段时间里
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 19 14 nian2 dao4 19 18 nian2 shi4 zai4 zhe4 duan4 shi2 jian1 li3
cues.en: It was from 1914 to 1918.

cues.zh: 那么参战的双方主要是同盟国和协约国
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 can1 zhan4 de5 shuang1 fang1 zhu3 yao4 shi4 tong2 meng2 guo2 he2 xie2 yue1 guo2
cues.en: The two warring sides were mainly the Central Powers and the Allied Powers.

cues.zh: 同盟国主要就是德国奥匈帝国这些国家
cues.pinyin: tong2 meng2 guo2 zhu3 yao4 jiu4 shi4 de2 guo2 ao4 xiong1 di4 guo2 zhe4 xie1 guo2 jia1
cues.en: The Central Powers were mainly Germany, Austria-Hungary, and other countries.

cues.zh: 协约国包括英国法国包括俄国
cues.pinyin: xie2 yue1 guo2 bao1 kuo4 ying1 guo2 fa3 guo2 bao1 kuo4 e2 guo2
cues.en: The Allied Powers included Britain, France, and Russia,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】1918西班牙流感始末：一场杀死5000万人的大瘟疫

cues.zh: 以及后来参战的美国这些国家
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 hou4 lai2 can1 zhan4 de5 mei3 guo2 zhe4 xie1 guo2 jia1
cues.en: as well as the United States, which joined later.

cues.zh: 当时的主要战场是在欧洲德国双线作战
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 de5 zhu3 yao4 zhan4 chang3 shi4 zai4 ou1 zhou1 de2 guo2 shuang1 xian4 zuo4 zhan4
cues.en: At the time the main battlefield was in Europe, and Germany fought on two fronts.

cues.zh: 一边跟俄国打一边又跟英法打
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 gen1 e2 guo2 da3 yi1 bian1 you4 gen1 ying1 fa3 da3
cues.en: On one side fighting Russia, on the other fighting Britain and France.

cues.zh: 他觉得力不从心
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 li4 bu4 cong2 xin1
cues.en: He felt overwhelmed.

cues.zh: 而且他还有一个心腹大患就是美国
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 xin1 fu4 da4 huan4 jiu4 shi4 mei3 guo2
cues.en: And he had a major worry: the United States.

cues.zh: 说美国一旦要是参战了的话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 mei3 guo2 yi2 dan4 yao4 shi4 can1 zhan4 le5 de5 hua4
cues.en: He said if the US ever entered the war,

cues.zh: 那战争基本就结束了
cues.pinyin: na4 zhan4 zheng1 ji1 ben3 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: the war would basically be over.

cues.zh: 所以他必须要在美国参战之前打败英法
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bi4 xu1 yao4 zai4 mei3 guo2 can1 zhan4 zhi1 qian2 da3 bai4 ying1 fa3
cues.en: So he had to defeat Britain and France before the US joined.

cues.zh: 或者说想一个办法拖住美国
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 xiang3 yi2 ge4 ban4 fa3 tuo1 zhu4 mei3 guo2
cues.en: Or find a way to tie the US down.

cues.zh: 那怎么拖呢最好在他后门放把火
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 tuo1 ne5 zui4 hao3 zai4 ta1 hou4 men2 fang4 ba3 huo3
cues.en: How to tie it down? Best to start a fire in its backyard.

cues.zh: 他后门是谁呢就是墨西哥
cues.pinyin: ta1 hou4 men2 shi4 shui2 ne5 jiu4 shi4 mo4 xi1 ge1
cues.en: Whose backyard was that? Mexico's.

cues.zh: 于是当时德国的外长在 19 17 年的 1
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 dang1 shi2 de2 guo2 de5 wai4 zhang3 zai4 19 17 nian2 de5 1
cues.en: So at the time, Germany's foreign minister, on January 17,

cues.zh: 月 17 日的时候
cues.pinyin: yue4 17 ri4 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 德国有一个外长名字叫齐默尔曼
cues.pinyin: de2 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 wai4 zhang3 ming2 zi4 jiao4 qi2 mo4 er3 man4
cues.en: Germany had a foreign minister named Zimmermann.

cues.zh: 这个齐默尔曼就给当时的驻墨西哥大使
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qi2 mo4 er3 man4 jiu4 gei3 dang1 shi2 de5 zhu4 mo4 xi1 ge1 da4 shi3
cues.en: This Zimmermann sent the German ambassador in Mexico at the time

cues.zh: 发了一封电报
cues.pinyin: fa1 le5 yi1 feng1 dian4 bao4
cues.en: a telegram.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】1918西班牙流感始末：一场杀死5000万人的大瘟疫

cues.zh: 其实这封电报就已经被美国的情报
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhe4 feng1 dian4 bao4 jiu4 yi3 jing1 bei4 mei3 guo2 de5 qing2 bao4
cues.en: In fact, this telegram had already been intercepted

cues.zh: 机构给截获了
cues.pinyin: ji1 gou4 gei3 jie2 huo4 le5
cues.en: by US intelligence agencies.

cues.zh: 结果呈递到美国总统这儿
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 cheng2 di4 dao4 mei3 guo2 zong3 tong3 zhe4 er2
cues.en: It ended up being handed to the US president.

cues.zh: 美国总统一看帝国主义亡我之心不死
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 zong3 tong3 yi1 kan4 di4 guo2 zhu3 yi4 wang2 wo3 zhi1 xin1 bu4 si3
cues.en: When the US president saw it, he thought: imperialism never gives up on destroying us.

cues.zh: 所以怎么办参战吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zen3 me5 ban4 can1 zhan4 ba5
cues.en: So what to do? Join the war.

cues.zh: 于是就在 19 17 年的 4 月 6 日的时候
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 zai4 19 17 nian2 de5 4 yue4 6 ri4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: So on April 6, 1917,

cues.zh: 美国正式参战是吧美国参战
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 zheng4 shi4 can1 zhan4 shi4 ba5 mei3 guo2 can1 zhan4
cues.en: the United States formally entered the war, right, the US joined the war.

cues.zh: 那么美国虽然说生产力非常的发达
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 mei3 guo2 sui1 ran2 shuo1 sheng1 chan3 li4 fei1 chang2 de5 fa1 da2
cues.en: Although the US had very advanced productivity

cues.zh: 国力非常的雄厚
cues.pinyin: guo2 li4 fei1 chang2 de5 xiong2 hou4
cues.en: and very strong national power,

cues.zh: 但是毕竟战争它不是儿戏
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bi4 jing4 zhan4 zheng1 ta1 bu2 shi4 er2 xi4
cues.en: war is no joke after all.

cues.zh: 不是说你说参战立刻就能把兵派过去的
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 shuo1 ni3 shuo1 can1 zhan4 li4 ke4 jiu4 neng2 ba3 bing1 pai4 guo4 qu4 de5
cues.en: It's not like you declare war and can send troops over instantly.

cues.zh: 你得训练是不是
cues.pinyin: ni3 de2 xun4 lian4 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: You need training, right?

cues.zh: 当时美国有 20 万的军队
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 mei3 guo2 you3 20 wan4 de5 jun1 dui4
cues.en: At the time the US had 200,000 troops.

cues.zh: 那么这 20 万人肯定还是不够
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 20 wan4 ren2 ken3 ding4 hai2 shi4 bu4 gou4
cues.en: 200,000 people clearly wasn't enough.

cues.zh: 于是美国就要怎么样就要训练新兵
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 mei3 guo2 jiu4 yao4 zen3 me5 yang4 jiu4 yao4 xun4 lian4 xin1 bing1
cues.en: So the US needed to train new recruits.

cues.zh: 于是他就在各地建立新兵的兵营
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 zai4 ge4 di4 jian4 li4 xin1 bing1 de5 bing1 ying2
cues.en: So it set up training camps for recruits everywhere.

cues.zh: 就开始训练新兵
cues.pinyin: jiu4 kai1 shi3 xun4 lian4 xin1 bing1
cues.en: and began training the new recruits.

cues.zh: 而我们今天要讲的西班牙大流感
cues.pinyin: er2 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 jiang3 de5 xi1 ban1 ya2 da4 liu2 gan3
cues.en: And what we're going to talk about today, the Spanish flu,

cues.zh: 那么在这个军营里面有一个吹噬员
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 jun1 ying2 li3 mian4 you3 yi2 ge4 chui1 shi4 yuan2
cues.en: there was a cook in one of these camps,

cues.zh: 吹噬兵
cues.pinyin: chui1 shi4 bing1
cues.en: a cook soldier.

cues.zh: 这个吹噬兵它的名字叫盖提撤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 chui1 shi4 bing1 ta1 de5 ming2 zi4 jiao4 gai4 ti2 che4
cues.en: This cook's name was Gitchell.

cues.zh: 这个盖提撤在凌晨的时候就发现
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gai4 ti2 che4 zai4 ling2 chen2 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: This Gitchell discovered in the early morning

cues.zh: 自己好像是感冒了发烧了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 hao3 xiang4 shi4 gan3 mao4 le5 fa1 shao1 le5
cues.en: that he seemed to have a cold and a fever.

cues.zh: 于是就去这个军医那块去看病
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 qu4 zhe4 ge5 jun1 yi1 na4 kuai4 qu4 kan4 bing4
cues.en: So he went to see the army doctor.

cues.zh: 本来只有他一个人
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 zhi3 you3 ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: At first it was just him,

cues.zh: 结果到了那天中午的时候
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 dao4 le5 na4 tian1 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: but by noon that day,

cues.zh: 就已经出现了 100 多个人感染了这种流感
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi3 jing1 chu1 xian4 le5 100 duo1 ge4 ren2 gan3 ran3 le5 zhe4 zhong3 liu2 gan3
cues.en: over 100 people had already caught this flu.

cues.zh: 到了这个一个月之后
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 yi2 ge4 yue4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: A month later,

cues.zh: 就已经有 500 多个人感染了这个流感
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi3 jing1 you3 500 duo1 ge4 ren2 gan3 ran3 le5 zhe4 ge5 liu2 gan3
cues.en: more than 500 people had been infected with this flu.

cues.zh: 最终在这个堪萨斯的这个军营里面
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 kan1 sa4 si1 de5 zhe4 ge5 jun1 ying2 li3 mian4
cues.en: In the end, at this camp in Kansas,

cues.zh: 一共感染了 1 12 7 个人
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 gan3 ran3 le5 1 12 7 ge4 ren2
cues.en: a total of 1,127 people were infected,

cues.zh: 而 46 个人死亡
cues.pinyin: er2 46 ge4 ren2 si3 wang2
cues.en: and 46 people died.

cues.zh: 46 个人死亡
cues.pinyin: 46 ge4 ren2 si3 wang2
cues.en: 46 people died.

cues.zh: 那么按说一场流感居然死了 40 多个人
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 an4 shuo1 yi1 chang2 liu2 gan3 ju1 ran2 si3 le5 40 duo1 ge4 ren2
cues.en: You'd think it strange that a flu killed over 40 people,

cues.zh: 这个看起来其实是不太正常的对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 kan4 qi3 lai2 qi2 shi2 shi4 bu4 tai4 zheng4 chang2 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: that actually seems abnormal, right?

cues.zh: 因为流感的死亡率其实没有那么高
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 liu2 gan3 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 qi2 shi2 mei2 you3 na4 me5 gao1
cues.en: Because the flu's death rate isn't normally that high.

cues.zh: 但是当时是处于一种战争局面
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dang1 shi2 shi4 chu3 yu2 yi1 zhong3 zhan4 zheng1 ju2 mian4
cues.en: But at the time it was wartime,

cues.zh: 也就是说流感死的人跟战场上
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 liu2 gan3 si3 de5 ren2 gen1 zhan4 chang3 shang4
cues.en: meaning compared to the number of people dying

cues.zh: 死的人比起来
cues.pinyin: si3 de5 ren2 bi3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: on the battlefield,

cues.zh: 那还差得太多了
cues.pinyin: na4 hai2 cha4 de2 tai4 duo1 le5
cues.en: this number was far smaller.

cues.zh: 所以这件事情没有引起足够的重视
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 qing2 mei2 you3 yin3 qi3 zu2 gou4 de5 zhong4 shi4
cues.en: So this didn't get enough attention.

cues.zh: 到了 19 18 年
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 19 18 nian2

cues.zh: 到了 19 18 年的 4 月份的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 19 18 nian2 de5 4 yue4 fen4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: by April 1918,

cues.zh: 那么一部分新兵训练好了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 yi1 bu4 fen4 xin1 bing1 xun4 lian4 hao3 le5
cues.en: some of the new recruits had finished training.

cues.zh: 于是这些美国大兵们
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhe4 xie1 mei3 guo2 da4 bing1 men5
cues.en: So these American soldiers,

cues.zh: 美国大兵就怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 da4 bing1 jiu4 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: what did the American soldiers do?

cues.zh: 就乘着船就来到了欧洲
cues.pinyin: jiu4 cheng2 zhe5 chuan2 jiu4 lai2 dao4 le5 ou1 zhou1
cues.en: They took ships to Europe.

cues.zh: 那么来到欧洲的这些美国大兵里面
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 lai2 dao4 ou1 zhou1 de5 zhe4 xie1 mei3 guo2 da4 bing1 li3 mian4
cues.en: Among the American soldiers who came to Europe,

cues.zh: 它除了戴着武器以外
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu2 le5 dai4 zhe5 wu3 qi4 yi3 wai4
cues.en: besides carrying weapons,

cues.zh: 其实还带着另外一种
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hai2 dai4 zhe5 ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: they also carried something else:

cues.zh: 就是这个西班牙流感的这个病毒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 xi1 ban1 ya2 liu2 gan3 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2
cues.en: the Spanish flu virus.

cues.zh: 就带到欧洲去了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 dai4 dao4 ou1 zhou1 qu4 le5
cues.en: They brought it to Europe.

cues.zh: 到了欧洲去之后怎么样
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 ou1 zhou1 qu4 zhi1 hou4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: After arriving in Europe, what happened?

cues.zh: 它很显然它就会互相传染
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 xian3 ran2 ta1 jiu4 hui4 hu4 xiang1 chuan2 ran3
cues.en: Obviously, it would spread from person to person.

cues.zh: 尤其是在军营里面
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 zai4 jun1 ying2 li3 mian4
cues.en: Especially in the military camps.

cues.zh: 我们知道所有的军人都住在一块
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 suo3 you3 de5 jun1 ren2 dou1 zhu4 zai4 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: We know all the soldiers lived together,

cues.zh: 在营房里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 ying2 fang2 li3 mian4
cues.en: in the barracks.

cues.zh: 所以感染的就特别厉害
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 gan3 ran3 de5 jiu4 te4 bie2 li4 hai4
cues.en: So the infection spread especially severely.

cues.zh: 那么最开始是它感染了英国
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zui4 kai1 shi3 shi4 ta1 gan3 ran3 le5 ying1 guo2
cues.en: At first it infected the British,

cues.zh: 还有法国还有德国的军队
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 fa3 guo2 hai2 you3 de2 guo2 de5 jun1 dui4
cues.en: French, and German armies.

cues.zh: 最开始只是感染了军队
cues.pinyin: zui4 kai1 shi3 zhi3 shi4 gan3 ran3 le5 jun1 dui4
cues.en: At first only the military was infected.
