cues.zh: 就是说你对战争不好的这个消息
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ni3 dui4 zhan4 zheng1 bu4 hao3 de5 zhe4 ge5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: Meaning news bad for the war

cues.zh: 你是不能报的
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 bu4 neng2 bao4 de5
cues.en: couldn't be reported.

cues.zh: 那你这个说我们军队里边爆发的流感
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhe4 ge5 shuo1 wo3 men5 jun1 dui4 li3 bian1 bao4 fa1 de5 liu2 gan3
cues.en: So saying our army has an outbreak of flu

cues.zh: 对战争肯定是不好对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhan4 zheng1 ken3 ding4 shi4 bu4 hao3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: would definitely be bad for the war, right?

cues.zh: 所以就不能报都压制
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 bu4 neng2 bao4 dou1 ya1 zhi4
cues.en: So it couldn't be reported, it was all suppressed.

cues.zh: 当时美国特别严厉有反间谍法
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 mei3 guo2 te4 bie2 yan2 li4 you3 fan3 jian4 die2 fa3
cues.en: At the time the US had a particularly strict Anti-Espionage Act.

cues.zh: 你要是说这种话的话就把你抓起来对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 shuo1 zhe4 zhong3 hua4 de5 hua4 jiu4 ba3 ni3 zhua1 qi3 lai2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: If you said things like that, you'd be arrested, right?

cues.zh: 所以很多新闻媒体都不报道
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hen3 duo1 xin1 wen2 mei2 ti3 dou1 bu4 bao4 dao4
cues.en: So many news media didn't report it.

cues.zh: 但是西班牙它是中立国
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xi1 ban1 ya2 ta1 shi4 zhong1 li4 guo2
cues.en: But Spain was a neutral country.

cues.zh: 那中立国就可以随便报道这件事
cues.pinyin: na4 zhong1 li4 guo2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 sui2 bian4 bao4 dao4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: A neutral country could report on this freely.

cues.zh: 西班牙就开始大肆宣传说有一种流感
cues.pinyin: xi1 ban1 ya2 jiu4 kai1 shi3 da4 si4 xuan1 chuan2 shuo1 you3 yi1 zhong3 liu2 gan3
cues.en: Spain started widely publicizing that there was a flu

cues.zh: 那它现在爆发了
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 xian4 zai4 bao4 fa1 le5
cues.en: that had now broken out.

cues.zh: 我们西班牙感染了 800 万人
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xi1 ban1 ya2 gan3 ran3 le5 800 wan4 ren2
cues.en: "Our country, Spain, has had 8 million infections,

cues.zh: 包括我们的国王阿芳索十三世他也感染了
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 wo3 men5 de5 guo2 wang2 a1 fang1 suo3 shi2 san1 shi4 ta1 ye3 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: including our King Alfonso XIII, who was also infected."

cues.zh: 所以大家都是从西班牙的报纸上知道
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 da4 jia1 dou1 shi4 cong2 xi1 ban1 ya2 de5 bao4 zhi3 shang4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: So everyone learned from Spanish newspapers

cues.zh: 现在有一场流感正在爆发
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 you3 yi1 chang2 liu2 gan3 zheng4 zai4 bao4 fa1
cues.en: that a flu outbreak was happening.

cues.zh: 于是久而久之人们就管这个流感叫
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu3 er2 jiu3 zhi1 ren2 men5 jiu4 guan3 zhe4 ge5 liu2 gan3 jiao4
cues.en: So over time, people came to call this flu

cues.zh: 做西班牙流感
cues.pinyin: zuo4 xi1 ban1 ya2 liu2 gan3
cues.en: the Spanish flu.

cues.zh: 但是事实上这个西班牙它既不是感染
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi4 shi2 shang4 zhe4 ge5 xi1 ban1 ya2 ta1 ji4 bu2 shi4 gan3 ran3
cues.en: But in fact, Spain was neither the most severely

cues.zh: 最严重的地区
cues.pinyin: zui4 yan2 zhong4 de5 di4 qu1
cues.en: infected region,

cues.zh: 也不是感染的发源地
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 shi4 gan3 ran3 de5 fa1 yuan2 di4
cues.en: nor the place where it originated.

cues.zh: 所以它叫这个名字其实是挺冤枉的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiao4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4 qi2 shi2 shi4 ting3 yuan1 wang3 de5
cues.en: So calling it that name was actually quite unfair to Spain.

cues.zh: 所以西班牙人自己管这个流感叫什么
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xi1 ban1 ya2 ren2 zi4 ji3 guan3 zhe4 ge5 liu2 gan3 jiao4 shen2 me5
cues.en: So what did the Spaniards themselves call this flu?

cues.zh: 叫法国流感
cues.pinyin: jiao4 fa3 guo2 liu2 gan3
cues.en: They called it the French flu.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 如果你知道有另一个人格在夜晚
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zhi1 dao4 you3 ling4 yi2 ge4 ren2 ge2 zai4 ye4 wan3
cues.en: If you knew that another personality emerges at night

cues.zh: 占据你的身体
cues.pinyin: zhan4 ju4 ni3 de5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: and takes over your body,

cues.zh: 你是会恐惧还是会觉得有趣呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 hui4 kong3 ju4 hai2 shi4 hui4 jue2 de5 you3 qu4 ne5
cues.en: would you be scared, or would you find it fascinating?

cues.zh: 你们会成为敌人还是朋友
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 hui4 cheng2 wei2 di2 ren2 hai2 shi4 peng2 you3
cues.en: Would you become enemies or friends?

cues.zh: 这个男人叫小帅他受了伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 jiao4 xiao3 shuai4 ta1 shou4 le5 shang1
cues.en: This man is named Xiaoshuai, and he was injured.

cues.zh: 带着一身的血来到了急诊室
cues.pinyin: dai4 zhe5 yi1 shen1 de5 xue4 lai2 dao4 le5 ji2 zhen3 shi4
cues.en: He arrived at the ER covered in blood.

cues.zh: 不过说来也奇怪
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 shuo1 lai2 ye3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: Strangely enough,

cues.zh: 他明明不会玩滑板
cues.pinyin: ta1 ming2 ming2 bu2 hui4 wan2 hua2 ban3
cues.en: he clearly doesn't know how to skateboard,

cues.zh: 却在受伤昏迷醒来后发现身侧
cues.pinyin: que4 zai4 shou4 shang1 hun1 mi2 xing3 lai2 hou4 fa1 xian4 shen1 ce4
cues.en: yet when he woke up from being knocked unconscious, he found beside him

cues.zh: 倒着一副滑板
cues.pinyin: dao4 zhe5 yi1 fu4 hua2 ban3
cues.en: a skateboard lying there,

cues.zh: 身上还插着滑板的部件
cues.pinyin: shen1 shang4 hai2 cha1 zhe5 hua2 ban3 de5 bu4 jian4
cues.en: with skateboard parts stuck in his body,

cues.zh: 就像是他玩滑板时玩脱了一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 shi4 ta1 wan2 hua2 ban3 shi2 wan2 tuo1 le5 yi1 yang4
cues.en: as if he'd wiped out while skateboarding.

cues.zh: 但医生以为他是因为喝酒或者其他原
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 sheng1 yi3 wei2 ta1 shi4 yin1 wei4 he1 jiu3 huo4 zhe3 qi2 ta1 yuan2
cues.en: But the doctors assumed it was due to drinking or some other

cues.zh: 因短暂性失忆
cues.pinyin: yin1 duan3 zan4 xing4 shi1 yi4
cues.en: cause, resulting in temporary memory loss,

cues.zh: 就没太注意这件事
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 tai4 zhu4 yi4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: so they didn't pay much attention to it.

cues.zh: 小帅的伤并没有特别严重
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 de5 shang1 bing4 mei2 you3 te4 bie2 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Xiaoshuai's injuries weren't especially severe.

cues.zh: 经过手术治疗后恢复的情况良好
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 shou3 shu4 zhi4 liao2 hou4 hui1 fu4 de5 qing2 kuang4 liang2 hao3
cues.en: After surgery, he recovered well.

cues.zh: 黄姐和布朗来查房时
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 he2 bu4 lang3 lai2 cha2 fang2 shi2
cues.en: When Sister Huang and Brown came on their rounds,

cues.zh: 他还有心思夸赞他们人美心善
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 you3 xin1 si1 kua1 zan4 ta1 men5 ren2 mei3 xin1 shan4
cues.en: he still had the mood to compliment them on being beautiful and kind.

cues.zh: 尽管知道是恭维的话
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 zhi1 dao4 shi4 gong1 wei2 de5 hua4
cues.en: Even though they knew it was just flattery,

cues.zh: 但谁不喜欢呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shui2 bu4 xi3 huan1 ne5
cues.en: who doesn't like hearing that?

cues.zh: 两人就顺着小帅聊了起来
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 jiu4 shun4 zhe5 xiao3 shuai4 liao2 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: The two of them went along and chatted with Xiaoshuai.

cues.zh: 只不过奇怪的是
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But strangely,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 手术前他们明明还和他聊过天
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 qian2 ta1 men5 ming2 ming2 hai2 he2 ta1 liao2 guo4 tian1
cues.en: they had clearly talked with him before the surgery,

cues.zh: 但小帅却说自己是第一次见到他们
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 shuai4 que4 shuo1 zi4 ji3 shi4 di4 yi1 ci4 jian4 dao4 ta1 men5
cues.en: yet Xiaoshuai said this was the first time he'd met them.

cues.zh: 而且很确定自己的记忆力没有问题
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hen3 que4 ding4 zi4 ji3 de5 ji4 yi4 li4 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: And he was quite sure his memory was fine.

cues.zh: 这是怎么回事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: What was going on?

cues.zh: 布朗和黄姐发现他有时会失去意识
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 he2 huang2 jie3 fa1 xian4 ta1 you3 shi2 hui4 shi1 qu4 yi4 shi2
cues.en: Brown and Sister Huang noticed he sometimes lost consciousness,

cues.zh: 而且会经常在不同时间
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hui4 jing1 chang2 zai4 bu4 tong2 shi2 jian1
cues.en: and would often, at different times,

cues.zh: 说一些相反的话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 yi1 xie1 xiang1 fan3 de5 hua4
cues.en: say things that contradicted each other.

cues.zh: 小帅自己也迷了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 zi4 ji3 ye3 mi2 le5
cues.en: Xiaoshuai himself was confused too,

cues.zh: 只能乖乖接受检查
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 guai1 guai1 jie1 shou4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: so he had no choice but to undergo testing.

cues.zh: 晚上正在睡觉的小帅突然醒了
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 zheng4 zai4 shui4 jiao4 de5 xiao3 shuai4 tu1 ran2 xing3 le5
cues.en: That night, Xiaoshuai, who was asleep, suddenly woke up

cues.zh: 还很有兴致地加入聊天
cues.pinyin: hai2 hen3 you3 xing4 zhi4 di4 jia1 ru4 liao2 tian1
cues.en: and eagerly joined in the conversation.

cues.zh: 但布朗却惊讶地发现
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 que4 jing1 ya4 di4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: But Brown was shocked to discover

cues.zh: 仪器上明明显示
cues.pinyin: yi2 qi4 shang4 ming2 ming2 xian3 shi4
cues.en: that the monitor clearly showed

cues.zh: 他应该是处于深度睡眠中才对
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying1 gai1 shi4 chu3 yu2 shen1 du4 shui4 mian2 zhong1 cai2 dui4
cues.en: he should have been in deep sleep.

cues.zh: 如果仪器没有问题
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi2 qi4 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: If the equipment wasn't malfunctioning,

cues.zh: 那就是人的问题了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 ren2 de5 wen4 ti2 le5
cues.en: then the problem was with the person.

cues.zh: 几位医生一起参加讨论
cues.pinyin: ji3 wei4 yi1 sheng1 yi4 qi3 can1 jia1 tao3 lun4
cues.en: Several doctors held a discussion together

cues.zh: 猜测小帅的情况可能是梦游
cues.pinyin: cai1 ce4 xiao3 shuai4 de5 qing2 kuang4 ke3 neng2 shi4 meng4 you2
cues.en: and guessed Xiaoshuai's condition might be sleepwalking.

cues.zh: 而梦游的原因十分广泛
cues.pinyin: er2 meng4 you2 de5 yuan2 yin1 shi2 fen1 guang3 fan4
cues.en: The causes of sleepwalking are quite varied,

cues.zh: 比如多发性硬化症
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 duo1 fa1 xing4 ying4 hua4 zheng4
cues.en: such as multiple sclerosis,

cues.zh: 脑炎或者脑肿瘤
cues.pinyin: nao3 yan2 huo4 zhe3 nao3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: encephalitis, or a brain tumor,

cues.zh: 也可能是常见的酗酒和嗑药
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 chang2 jian4 de5 xu4 jiu3 he2 ke1 yao4
cues.en: or it could be common causes like alcoholism and drug use.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 发现原来是有块肿瘤挤压着他的下丘脑
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 yuan2 lai2 shi4 you3 kuai4 zhong3 liu2 ji3 ya1 zhe5 ta1 de5 xia4 qiu1 nao3
cues.en: They discovered it was actually a tumor pressing on his hypothalamus.

cues.zh: 他们需要把肿囊引流
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 ba3 zhong3 nang2 yin3 liu2
cues.en: They needed to drain the mass.

cues.zh: 知道不处理也没有生命危险后
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 bu4 chu3 li3 ye3 mei2 you3 sheng1 ming4 wei1 xian3 hou4
cues.en: After learning it wouldn't be life-threatening if left untreated,

cues.zh: 小帅拒绝了治疗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 ju4 jue2 le5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: Xiaoshuai refused the treatment.

cues.zh: 他想要留下另一个人格
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 yao4 liu2 xia4 ling4 yi2 ge4 ren2 ge2
cues.en: He wanted to keep his other personality.

cues.zh: 为了方便我们称呼他为小骏
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 fang1 bian4 wo3 men5 cheng1 hu1 ta1 wei4 xiao3 jun4
cues.en: For convenience, let's call him Xiaojun.

cues.zh: 白天的小帅十分客气自律
cues.pinyin: bai2 tian1 de5 xiao3 shuai4 shi2 fen1 ke4 qi4 zi4 lv4
cues.en: During the day, Xiaoshuai was very polite and disciplined,

cues.zh: 但夜晚的小俊却在享受人生
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye4 wan3 de5 xiao3 jun4 que4 zai4 xiang3 shou4 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: but at night, Xiaojun was out enjoying life,

cues.zh: 发泄着所有的压力
cues.pinyin: fa1 xie4 zhe5 suo3 you3 de5 ya1 li4
cues.en: releasing all his pent-up stress.

cues.zh: 或许这才是他内心真正的自己
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 zhe4 cai2 shi4 ta1 nei4 xin1 zhen1 zheng4 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Maybe this was his true inner self.

cues.zh: 医生们去问了小俊的意见
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 qu4 wen4 le5 xiao3 jun4 de5 yi4 jian4
cues.en: The doctors went to ask Xiaojun's opinion.

cues.zh: 把情况全盘拖出
cues.pinyin: ba3 qing2 kuang4 quan2 pan2 tuo1 chu1
cues.en: They laid out the whole situation,

cues.zh: 告诉他如果保留肿囊的话
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 ru2 guo3 bao3 liu2 zhong3 nang2 de5 hua4
cues.en: telling him that if they kept the mass,

cues.zh: 会有得严重神经并发症的风险
cues.pinyin: hui4 you3 de2 yan2 zhong4 shen2 jing1 bing4 fa1 zheng4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: there would be a risk of severe neurological complications,

cues.zh: 可能会失眠
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 hui4 shi1 mian2
cues.en: possibly insomnia,

cues.zh: 激素失衡
cues.pinyin: ji1 su4 shi1 heng2
cues.en: hormonal imbalance,

cues.zh: 抑郁
cues.pinyin: yi4 yu4
cues.en: or depression.

cues.zh: 只是如果要处理掉的话
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 ru2 guo3 yao4 chu3 li3 diao4 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if they removed it,

cues.zh: 他也会不复存在
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 hui4 bu4 fu4 cun2 zai4
cues.en: he would cease to exist.

cues.zh: 小俊很了解小帅
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jun4 hen3 liao3 jie3 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: Xiaojun understood Xiaoshuai well.

cues.zh: 他猜到小帅拒绝了治疗
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai1 dao4 xiao3 shuai4 ju4 jue2 le5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: He guessed that Xiaoshuai had refused treatment,

cues.zh: 也猜到医生想让自己签下同意书
cues.pinyin: ye3 cai1 dao4 yi1 sheng1 xiang3 rang4 zi4 ji3 qian1 xia4 tong2 yi4 shu1
cues.en: and also guessed the doctors wanted him to sign the consent form.

cues.zh: 黄姐对他说
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 dui4 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: Sister Huang said to him—

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 60 岁出头
cues.pinyin: 60 sui4 chu1 tou2
cues.en: She was just over 60 years old.

cues.zh: 被发现时倒在银行道上
cues.pinyin: bei4 fa1 xian4 shi2 dao4 zai4 yin2 hang2 dao4 shang4
cues.en: She was found collapsed on a sidewalk.

cues.zh: 她表现出胸痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 xian4 chu1 xiong1 tong4
cues.en: She was showing chest pain,

cues.zh: 可能是肋骨骨折
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 lei4 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: which could be a rib fracture

cues.zh: 也可能是心脏病发作
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 xin1 zang4 bing4 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: or possibly a heart attack.

cues.zh: 萧恩和大钟急忙帮她做检查
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 he2 da4 zhong1 ji2 mang2 bang1 ta1 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Shawn and Dazhong rushed to examine her

cues.zh: 并例行询问一些问题
cues.pinyin: bing4 li4 xing2 xun2 wen4 yi1 xie1 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and asked some routine questions.

cues.zh: 但大妈意识已经不清晰了
cues.pinyin: dan4 da4 ma1 yi4 shi2 yi3 jing1 bu4 qing1 xi1 le5
cues.en: But the old woman's consciousness was already unclear.

cues.zh: 似乎把肖恩认成了另一个人
cues.pinyin: si4 hu1 ba3 xiao4 en1 ren4 cheng2 le5 ling4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: She seemed to mistake Shawn for someone else,

cues.zh: 不停地对她喊着颗粒这个名字
cues.pinyin: bu4 ting2 di4 dui4 ta1 han3 zhe5 ke1 li4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: repeatedly calling her by the name "Keli."

cues.zh: 大妈的情况不容乐观
cues.pinyin: da4 ma1 de5 qing2 kuang4 bu4 rong2 le4 guan1
cues.en: The woman's condition wasn't looking good.

cues.zh: 她被立刻送进了手术室
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 li4 ke4 song4 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: She was immediately rushed into the operating room.

cues.zh: 大妈主动脉撕裂
cues.pinyin: da4 ma1 zhu3 dong4 mai4 si1 lie4
cues.en: The woman's aorta had torn,

cues.zh: 没医生进行缝合修补
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 jin4 xing2 feng2 he2 xiu1 bu3
cues.en: and the doctors performed a repair surgery on it.

cues.zh: 但是她很快出现了笔拗
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 hen3 kuai4 chu1 xian4 le5 bi3 ao3
cues.en: But she soon developed a complication,

cues.zh: 紧动脉流破裂
cues.pinyin: jin3 dong4 mai4 liu2 po4 lie4
cues.en: a ruptured renal artery aneurysm,

cues.zh: 而且不断的内出血
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 duan4 de5 nei4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: along with continuous internal bleeding.

cues.zh: 他们立刻进行抢救
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 li4 ke4 jin4 xing2 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: They immediately began emergency resuscitation.

cues.zh: 三个医生不敢停下手中的动作
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 yi1 sheng1 bu4 gan3 ting2 xia4 shou3 zhong1 de5 dong4 zuo4
cues.en: The three doctors didn't dare stop what they were doing,

cues.zh: 指令一个接着一个下达
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ling4 yi2 ge4 jie1 zhe5 yi2 ge4 xia4 da2
cues.en: issuing instructions one after another.

cues.zh: 但遗憾的是
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi2 han4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But unfortunately,

cues.zh: 大妈还是抢救无效死亡了
cues.pinyin: da4 ma1 hai2 shi4 qiang3 jiu4 wu2 xiao4 si3 wang2 le5
cues.en: the resuscitation failed, and the woman died.

cues.zh: 医院死人并不稀奇
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 si3 ren2 bing4 bu4 xi1 qi2
cues.en: Death in a hospital isn't unusual.

cues.zh: 确认死亡后
cues.pinyin: que4 ren4 si3 wang2 hou4
cues.en: After death was confirmed,

cues.zh: 医务人员陆续离开
cues.pinyin: yi1 wu4 ren2 yuan2 lu4 xu4 li2 kai1
cues.en: the medical staff left one by one.

cues.zh: 只有萧恩还留在手术室
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 xiao1 en1 hai2 liu2 zai4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Only Shawn stayed behind in the operating room.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 她觉得一定是哪里出现了问题
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 yi2 ding4 shi4 na3 li3 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: She felt something must have gone wrong somewhere.

cues.zh: 大妈不该死的
cues.pinyin: da4 ma1 bu4 gai1 si3 de5
cues.en: The woman shouldn't have died.

cues.zh: 萧恩找到主任
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhao3 dao4 zhu3 ren4
cues.en: Shawn went to find the department head

cues.zh: 要给大妈预约做尸检
cues.pinyin: yao4 gei3 da4 ma1 yu4 yue1 zuo4 shi1 jian3
cues.en: to request an autopsy for the woman.

cues.zh: 但其他医生并没有发现什么疑点
cues.pinyin: dan4 qi2 ta1 yi1 sheng1 bing4 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 shen2 me5 yi2 dian3
cues.en: But the other doctors hadn't found anything suspicious,

cues.zh: 认为她可能只是接受不了病人死亡
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 ta1 ke3 neng2 zhi3 shi4 jie1 shou4 bu4 liao3 bing4 ren2 si3 wang2
cues.en: and thought she might just be unable to accept the patient's death.

cues.zh: 主任并不同意
cues.pinyin: zhu3 ren4 bing4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: The department head didn't agree.

cues.zh: 可萧恩依旧坚持极健
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao1 en1 yi1 jiu4 jian1 chi2 ji2 jian4
cues.en: But Shawn still insisted on her own view.

cues.zh: 她要找到大妈的家人
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 zhao3 dao4 da4 ma1 de5 jia1 ren2
cues.en: She wanted to find the woman's family

cues.zh: 让他们同意尸检
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 men5 tong2 yi4 shi1 jian3
cues.en: to get their consent for an autopsy.

cues.zh: 但是大妈来的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da4 ma1 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when the woman had arrived,

cues.zh: 身上并没有证件
cues.pinyin: shen1 shang4 bing4 mei2 you3 zheng4 jian4
cues.en: she had no ID on her

cues.zh: 也没有手机
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 you3 shou3 ji1
cues.en: and no phone either—

cues.zh: 就是个无名士
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ge4 wu2 ming2 shi4
cues.en: she was a John Doe.

cues.zh: 于是萧恩找到了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao1 en1 zhao3 dao4 le5
cues.en: So Shawn went to find

cues.zh: 从前当警察的大中
cues.pinyin: cong2 qian2 dang1 jing3 cha2 de5 da4 zhong1
cues.en: Dazhong, a former police officer,

cues.zh: 想让她帮自己
cues.pinyin: xiang3 rang4 ta1 bang1 zi4 ji3
cues.en: wanting him to help her.

cues.zh: 大中最终被她说动了
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 zui4 zhong1 bei4 ta1 shuo1 dong4 le5
cues.en: Dazhong was eventually persuaded by her

cues.zh: 同意帮忙
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 bang1 mang2
cues.en: and agreed to help.

cues.zh: 可是唯一的线索就是大妈身上的疯鸟纹身
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wei2 yi1 de5 xian4 suo3 jiu4 shi4 da4 ma1 shen1 shang4 de5 feng1 niao3 wen2 shen1
cues.en: But the only clue was a strange bird tattoo on the woman's body,

cues.zh: 这并不足以让他们找到有关她的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bing4 bu4 zu2 yi3 rang4 ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 you3 guan1 ta1 de5
cues.en: which wasn't enough for them to find

cues.zh: 任何一点信息
cues.pinyin: ren4 he2 yi4 dian3 xin4 xi1
cues.en: any information about her.

cues.zh: 加上梅医生不赞同的态度
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 zan4 tong2 de5 tai4 du4
cues.en: On top of that, Dr. Mei's disapproving attitude

cues.zh: 大钟想要放弃
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 xiang3 yao4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: made Dazhong want to give up.

cues.zh: 可是看到萧恩因为小丽的事情
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 kan4 dao4 xiao1 en1 yin1 wei4 xiao3 li4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: But seeing that Shawn, because of what happened with Xiaoli,

cues.zh: 一直没能放下
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 mei2 neng2 fang4 xia4
cues.en: still couldn't let it go,

cues.zh: 看起来可怜兮兮的
cues.pinyin: kan4 qi3 lai2 ke3 lian2 xi1 xi1 de5
cues.en: and looked so pitiful,

cues.zh: 她又有些不忍
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 you3 xie1 bu4 ren3
cues.en: he couldn't quite bring himself to abandon it.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子拥有双重人格，天才医生为了让他活命，只能杀死另一个人格！

cues.zh: 萧恩就拼命地拍打车门
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 jiu4 pin1 ming4 di4 pai1 da3 che1 men2
cues.en: Shawn desperately pounded on the car door,

cues.zh: 她的表现实在是像个疯子
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 biao3 xian4 shi2 zai4 shi4 xiang4 ge4 feng1 zi5
cues.en: behaving just like a lunatic.

cues.zh: 于是大壮就报警了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 da4 zhuang4 jiu4 bao4 jing3 le5
cues.en: So Dazhuang called the police.

cues.zh: 萧恩被关进了警察局
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 bei4 guan1 jin4 le5 jing3 cha2 ju2
cues.en: Shawn was locked up at the police station.

cues.zh: 最后还是轮输过来接的人
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 hai2 shi4 lun2 shu1 guo4 lai2 jie1 de5 ren2
cues.en: In the end, someone eventually came to pick her up.

cues.zh: 晚上萧恩找到了前女友小丽
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 xiao1 en1 zhao3 dao4 le5 qian2 nv3 you3 xiao3 li4
cues.en: That night, Shawn went to find her ex-girlfriend Xiaoli.

cues.zh: 她认为大妈有多囊性肾脏疾病
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 da4 ma1 you3 duo1 nang2 xing4 shen4 zang4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: She suspected the woman had polycystic kidney disease,

cues.zh: 这和她的动脉膨胀有关
cues.pinyin: zhe4 he2 ta1 de5 dong4 mai4 peng2 zhang4 you3 guan1
cues.en: which was linked to her arterial dilation,

cues.zh: 导致了血管壁脆弱
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 le5 xue4 guan3 bi4 cui4 ruo4
cues.en: causing the blood vessel walls to weaken

cues.zh: 相应地促进了动脉瘤的行程
cues.pinyin: xiang1 ying4 di4 cu4 jin4 le5 dong4 mai4 liu2 de5 xing2 cheng2
cues.en: and in turn promoting the growth of the aneurysm.

cues.zh: 她需要尸检确认
cues.pinyin: ta1 xu1 yao4 shi1 jian3 que4 ren4
cues.en: She needed an autopsy to confirm it,

cues.zh: 于是找上了是病理学部门主任的小丽
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhao3 shang4 le5 shi4 bing4 li3 xue2 bu4 men2 zhu3 ren4 de5 xiao3 li4
cues.en: so she turned to Xiaoli, the head of the pathology department,

cues.zh: 帮忙自己
cues.pinyin: bang1 mang2 zi4 ji3
cues.en: to ask for her help.

cues.zh: 这并不合规
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bing4 bu4 he2 gui1
cues.en: This wasn't exactly by the rules,

cues.zh: 但小丽还是同意了
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 li4 hai2 shi4 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: but Xiaoli agreed anyway.

cues.zh: 实践让肖恩排除了
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian4 rang4 xiao4 en1 pai2 chu2 le5
cues.en: The procedure let Shawn rule out

cues.zh: 多囊性肾脏疾病这一猜想
cues.pinyin: duo1 nang2 xing4 shen4 zang4 ji2 bing4 zhe4 yi1 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: the polycystic kidney disease theory.

cues.zh: 她又不甘心地取出了肝脏
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 bu4 gan1 xin1 di4 qu3 chu1 le5 gan1 zang4
cues.en: Unwilling to give up, she then removed the liver,

cues.zh: 终于找到了问题所在
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zhao3 dao4 le5 wen4 ti2 suo3 zai4
cues.en: and finally found where the problem was.

cues.zh: 肖恩立刻前往大壮家
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 li4 ke4 qian2 wang3 da4 zhuang4 jia1
cues.en: Shawn immediately went to Dazhuang's home.

cues.zh: 她并不在乎大壮糟糕的态度
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu4 zai4 hu1 da4 zhuang4 zao1 gao1 de5 tai4 du4
cues.en: She didn't care about Dazhuang's bad attitude

cues.zh: 自顾自得说自己的
cues.pinyin: zi4 gu4 zi4 de2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 de5
cues.en: and just went ahead saying what she had to say.

cues.zh: 她在大妈的肝动脉里
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 da4 ma1 de5 gan1 dong4 mai4 li3
cues.en: In the woman's hepatic artery

cues.zh: 发现了三个动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 san1 ge4 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: she had found three aneurysms,

cues.zh: 可以推测出
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 tui1 ce4 chu1
cues.en: from which it could be inferred...

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 正当两人尽兴之时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 dang1 liang3 ren2 jin4 xing4 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: Just as the two were having a great time,

cues.zh: 特案组迅速抵达现场
cues.pinyin: te4 an4 zu3 xun4 su4 di3 da2 xian4 chang3
cues.en: The special task force quickly arrived at the scene.

cues.zh: 法医初步勘察死者是一名年轻女性
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 chu1 bu4 kan1 cha2 si3 zhe3 shi4 yi1 ming2 nian2 qing1 nv3 xing4
cues.en: The medical examiner's preliminary examination showed the deceased was a young woman.

cues.zh: 眼内的出血点说明她是溺水身亡
cues.pinyin: yan3 nei4 de5 chu1 xie3 dian3 shuo1 ming2 ta1 shi4 ni4 shui3 shen1 wang2
cues.en: Petechiae in her eyes indicated she died by drowning.

cues.zh: 依据眼角膜浑浊程度推断
cues.pinyin: yi1 ju4 yan3 jiao3 mo2 hun2 zhuo2 cheng2 du4 tui1 duan4
cues.en: Based on the degree of corneal clouding,

cues.zh: 其死亡时间大约在凌晨 4 点
cues.pinyin: qi2 si3 wang2 shi2 jian1 da4 yue1 zai4 ling2 chen2 4 dian3
cues.en: her time of death was estimated at around 4 a.m.

cues.zh: 尽管喷泉冲刷掉了部分痕迹
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 pen1 quan2 chong1 shua1 diao4 le5 bu4 fen4 hen2 ji4
cues.en: Although the fountain had washed away some traces,

cues.zh: 但法医还是在尸体中发现了小蝌蚪和血迹
cues.pinyin: dan4 fa3 yi1 hai2 shi4 zai4 shi1 ti3 zhong1 fa1 xian4 le5 xiao3 ke1 dou3 he2 xue4 ji4
cues.en: the examiner still found small tadpoles and blood on the body.

cues.zh: 由于案发现场并未发现死者的身份证件
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 an4 fa1 xian4 chang3 bing4 wei4 fa1 xian4 si3 zhe3 de5 shen1 fen4 zheng4 jian4
cues.en: Since no identification documents were found at the scene,

cues.zh: 警官泰勒和班森立即进行分析
cues.pinyin: jing3 guan1 tai4 lei1 he2 ban1 sen1 li4 ji2 jin4 xing2 fen1 xi1
cues.en: officers Tyler and Benson immediately began analyzing the case.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 法医突然发现死者而后的一座头
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 si3 zhe3 er2 hou4 de5 yi1 zuo4 tou2
cues.en: the examiner suddenly noticed a tuft of hair behind the victim's ear

cues.zh: 发竟离奇消失
cues.pinyin: fa1 jing4 li2 qi2 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: that had strangely disappeared.

cues.zh: 泰勒推断凶手有收藏头发的特殊癖好
cues.pinyin: tai4 lei1 tui1 duan4 xiong1 shou3 you3 shou1 cang2 tou2 fa4 de5 te4 shu1 pi3 hao4
cues.en: Tyler deduced the killer had an unusual fondness for collecting hair,

cues.zh: 把头发当作个人杰作进行收藏
cues.pinyin: ba3 tou2 fa1 dang4 zuo4 ge4 ren2 jie2 zuo4 jin4 xing2 shou1 cang2
cues.en: treating the hair as a personal masterpiece to collect.

cues.zh: 继而锁定新的受害者
cues.pinyin: ji4 er2 suo3 ding4 xin1 de5 shou4 hai4 zhe3
cues.en: and would go on to target a new victim.

cues.zh: 根据这一重要线索
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 yi1 zhong4 yao4 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Based on this important clue,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 警方迅速比对犯罪数据库
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 xun4 su4 bi3 dui4 fan4 zui4 shu4 ju4 ku4
cues.en: police quickly cross-checked the criminal database

cues.zh: 成功锁定一名专捡女性头发的男子鲍伯
cues.pinyin: cheng2 gong1 suo3 ding4 yi1 ming2 zhuan1 jian3 nv3 xing4 tou2 fa4 de5 nan2 zi5 bao4 bo2
cues.en: and identified a man named Bob who specialized in collecting women's hair.

cues.zh: 对方频繁在公园游荡
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 pin2 fan2 zai4 gong1 yuan2 you2 dang4
cues.en: He frequently loitered in the park,

cues.zh: 当地人称之为变态理发师
cues.pinyin: dang1 di4 ren2 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 bian4 tai4 li3 fa4 shi1
cues.en: where locals called him the "pervert hairdresser."

cues.zh: 班森见状主动请缨
cues.pinyin: ban1 sen1 jian4 zhuang4 zhu3 dong4 qing3 ying1
cues.en: Seeing this, Benson volunteered to act as bait.

cues.zh: 只见他端坐在长椅上拨弄秀发
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 ta1 duan1 zuo4 zai4 zhang3 yi3 shang4 bo1 nong4 xiu4 fa4
cues.en: He sat calmly on a bench, running his fingers through his hair.

cues.zh: 这一举动对于特殊爱好者而言
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ju3 dong4 dui4 yu2 te4 shu1 ai4 hao4 zhe3 er2 yan2
cues.en: For someone with such a particular obsession,

cues.zh: 无疑是巨大诱惑
cues.pinyin: wu2 yi2 shi4 ju4 da4 you4 huo4
cues.en: this was undoubtedly an irresistible temptation.

cues.zh: 按捺不住的鲍伯兴奋的掏出剪刀
cues.pinyin: an4 na4 bu4 zhu4 de5 bao4 bo2 xing1 fen4 de5 tao1 chu1 jian3 dao1
cues.en: Unable to hold back, an excited Bob pulled out a pair of scissors.

cues.zh: 就在这千钧一发之际
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 qian1 jun1 yi1 fa4 zhi1 ji4
cues.en: Right at that critical moment,

cues.zh: 守株待兔的泰勒迅速出击
cues.pinyin: shou3 zhu1 dai4 tu4 de5 tai4 lei1 xun4 su4 chu1 ji1
cues.en: Tyler, who had been lying in wait, struck swiftly

cues.zh: 将鲍伯当场抓获
cues.pinyin: jiang1 bao4 bo2 dang1 chang3 zhua1 huo4
cues.en: and caught Bob red-handed,

cues.zh: 并在他的口袋找到了死者头发
cues.pinyin: bing4 zai4 ta1 de5 kou3 dai4 zhao3 dao4 le5 si3 zhe3 tou2 fa4
cues.en: finding the victim's hair in his pocket.

cues.zh: 然而鲍伯坚决否认杀人行为
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 bao4 bo2 jian1 jue2 fou3 ren4 sha1 ren2 xing2 wei2
cues.en: However, Bob firmly denied killing anyone,

cues.zh: 声称在剪下头发时对方就已离世
cues.pinyin: sheng1 cheng1 zai4 jian3 xia4 tou5 fa1 shi2 dui4 fang1 jiu4 yi3 li2 shi4
cues.en: claiming the victim was already dead when he cut her hair,

cues.zh: 并有完美的不在场证明
cues.pinyin: bing4 you3 wan2 mei3 de5 bu4 zai4 chang3 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: and that he had a perfect alibi.

cues.zh: 声称自己整晚都逗留在一桩匹俱乐部
cues.pinyin: sheng1 cheng1 zi4 ji3 zheng3 wan3 dou1 dou4 liu2 zai4 yi1 zhuang1 pi3 ju4 le4 bu4
cues.en: He claimed he had spent the whole night at a club.

cues.zh: 警方核实后发现
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 he2 shi2 hou4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After verifying with the venue, police found

cues.zh: 鲍伯在凌晨 4 点半被负责人赶出门外
cues.pinyin: bao4 bo2 zai4 ling2 chen2 4 dian3 ban4 bei4 fu4 ze2 ren2 gan3 chu1 men2 wai4
cues.en: Bob had been thrown out by the manager at 4:30 a.m.,

cues.zh: 确实不具备作案时间
cues.pinyin: que4 shi2 bu4 ju4 bei4 zuo4 an4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: meaning he truly didn't have the time to commit the crime.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 还主动将衣服脱掉
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhu3 dong4 jiang1 yi1 fu2 tuo1 diao4
cues.en: He even voluntarily took off his clothes to prove it.

cues.zh: 就在这时匆匆赶来的图图指出
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 cong1 cong1 gan3 lai2 de5 tu2 tu2 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: Just then, Tutu rushed in and pointed out

cues.zh: 艾尔有充足的不在场证明
cues.pinyin: ai4 er3 you3 chong1 zu2 de5 bu4 zai4 chang3 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: that Earl had a solid alibi too.

cues.zh: 他在当晚带着宠物狗在宠物店
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 dang4 wan3 dai4 zhe5 chong3 wu4 gou3 zai4 chong3 wu4 dian4
cues.en: that night he had been at a pet store with his dog

cues.zh: 一直呆到六点
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 dai1 dao4 liu4 dian3
cues.en: and stayed there until 6 o'clock.

cues.zh: 艾尔的嫌疑彻底被洗清
cues.pinyin: ai4 er3 de5 xian2 yi2 che4 di3 bei4 xi3 qing1
cues.en: Earl was completely cleared of suspicion.

cues.zh: 案件再次陷入迷雾
cues.pinyin: an4 jian4 zai4 ci4 xian4 ru4 mi2 wu4
cues.en: The case fell into confusion once again.

cues.zh: 幸运的是
cues.pinyin: xing4 yun4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Fortunately,

cues.zh: 劳拉的随身物品竟在灌木丛被发现
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 de5 sui2 shen1 wu4 pin3 jing4 zai4 guan4 mu4 cong2 bei4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Laura's personal belongings were found in some bushes.

cues.zh: 图图情维迅速前去大捞
cues.pinyin: tu2 tu2 qing2 wei2 xun4 su4 qian2 qu4 da4 lao1
cues.en: Tutu and a colleague quickly went to retrieve them.

cues.zh: 就在这时意外却突然降临
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 yi4 wai4 que4 tu1 ran2 jiang4 lin2
cues.en: Just then, an accident suddenly occurred.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 导致过度肥胖
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 guo4 du4 fei2 pang4
cues.en: It led to severe obesity,

cues.zh: 最终不幸离世
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 bu4 xing4 li2 shi4
cues.en: and she ultimately passed away.

cues.zh: 伤心欲绝的大卫母亲
cues.pinyin: shang1 xin1 yu4 jue2 de5 da4 wei4 mu3 qin1
cues.en: David's grief-stricken mother

cues.zh: 将可乐公司告上法庭
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ke3 le4 gong1 si1 gao4 shang4 fa3 ting2
cues.en: took the cola company to court.

cues.zh: 然而劳拉却突然组织一场儿童减肥活动
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 lao2 la1 que4 tu1 ran2 zu3 zhi1 yi1 chang2 er2 tong2 jian3 fei2 huo2 dong4
cues.en: But Laura had suddenly organized a children's weight-loss event,

cues.zh: 瞬间扭转舆论风向
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 niu3 zhuan3 yu2 lun4 feng1 xiang4
cues.en: instantly turning public opinion around,

cues.zh: 导致官司最终以失败告终
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 guan1 si1 zui4 zhong1 yi3 shi1 bai4 gao4 zhong1
cues.en: causing the lawsuit to ultimately fail.

cues.zh: 而青少年运动的负责人
cues.pinyin: er2 qing1 shao4 nian2 yun4 dong4 de5 fu4 ze2 ren2
cues.en: Meanwhile, the head of a youth sports organization

cues.zh: 也对劳拉赞誉有加
cues.pinyin: ye3 dui4 lao2 la1 zan4 yu4 you3 jia1
cues.en: also praised Laura highly.

cues.zh: 特案组立即展开激烈的讨论
cues.pinyin: te4 an4 zu3 li4 ji2 zhan3 kai1 ji1 lie4 de5 tao3 lun4
cues.en: The special task force immediately began an intense discussion.

cues.zh: 心理专家王博士带来关键信息
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 zhuan1 jia1 wang2 bo2 shi4 dai4 lai2 guan1 jian4 xin4 xi1
cues.en: Psychology expert Dr. Wang brought in key information.

cues.zh: 劳拉体内的食物残渣表明
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 ti3 nei4 de5 shi2 wu4 can2 zha1 biao3 ming2
cues.en: Food residue found in Laura's body showed

cues.zh: 中毒时间大致在晚餐时段
cues.pinyin: zhong4 du2 shi2 jian1 da4 zhi4 zai4 wan3 can1 shi2 duan4
cues.en: the poisoning likely occurred around dinnertime.

cues.zh: 法医随后检测出了四种罕见的南美毒蘑菇
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 sui2 hou4 jian3 ce4 chu1 le5 si4 zhong3 han3 jian4 de5 nan2 mei3 du2 mo2 gu1
cues.en: Examiners then detected four rare South American poisonous mushroom species.

cues.zh: 这些蘑菇在市面上根本无法购得
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 mo2 gu1 zai4 shi4 mian4 shang4 gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 gou4 de2
cues.en: These mushrooms simply cannot be bought on the market,

cues.zh: 并且含有大量毒瘾结
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 han2 you3 da4 liang4 du2 yin3 jie2
cues.en: and they contain large amounts of toxin.

cues.zh: 有毒物质会导致发热和产生幻觉
cues.pinyin: you3 du2 wu4 zhi4 hui4 dao3 zhi4 fa1 re4 he2 chan3 sheng1 huan4 jue2
cues.en: The toxin can cause fever and hallucinations,

cues.zh: 甚至还会导致呼吸衰竭
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hai2 hui4 dao3 zhi4 hu1 xi1 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: and can even lead to respiratory failure.

cues.zh: 这也解释了劳拉为何会丧命水中
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 jie3 shi4 le5 lao2 la1 wei4 he2 hui4 sang4 ming4 shui3 zhong1
cues.en: This also explained why Laura ended up dying in the water.

cues.zh: 劳拉的日程表上显示
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 de5 ri4 cheng2 biao3 shang4 xian3 shi4
cues.en: Laura's schedule showed

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 他当为了捐赠免费儿童攀爬家
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 wei4 le5 juan1 zeng4 mian3 fei4 er2 tong2 pan1 pa2 jia1
cues.en: that night, in order to donate a free children's climbing frame,

cues.zh: 曾在希望时刻筹款机构用餐
cues.pinyin: ceng2 zai4 xi1 wang4 shi2 ke4 chou2 kuan3 ji1 gou4 yong4 can1
cues.en: she had dined at a fundraising organization called "Moment of Hope."

cues.zh: 众人迅速前往筹款机构
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 xun4 su4 qian2 wang3 chou2 kuan3 ji1 gou4
cues.en: Everyone quickly headed to the fundraising organization,

cues.zh: 这是一家资助贫困生的家族企业
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 jia1 zi1 zhu4 pin2 kun4 sheng1 de5 jia1 zu2 qi3 ye4
cues.en: a family business that funds students in poverty.

cues.zh: 负责人艾莎对劳拉致死表示深切哀悼
cues.pinyin: fu4 ze2 ren2 ai4 sha1 dui4 lao2 la1 zhi4 si3 biao3 shi4 shen1 qie4 ai1 dao4
cues.en: The manager, Elsa, expressed deep condolences over Laura's death

cues.zh: 并惊讶地指出
cues.pinyin: bing4 jing1 ya4 di4 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: and surprisingly pointed out

cues.zh: 昨晚菜单中根本没有南美蘑菇
cues.pinyin: zuo2 wan3 cai4 dan1 zhong1 gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 nan2 mei3 mo2 gu1
cues.en: that last night's menu had no South American mushrooms at all.

cues.zh: 随即带领警方来到孙女艾莉的房间
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 dai4 ling3 jing3 fang1 lai2 dao4 sun1 nv3 ai4 li4 de5 fang2 jian1
cues.en: She then led police to her granddaughter Ellie's room.

cues.zh: 艾莉与劳拉是在庇护所中结识的挚友
cues.pinyin: ai4 li4 yu3 lao2 la1 shi4 zai4 bi4 hu4 suo3 zhong1 jie2 shi2 de5 zhi4 you3
cues.en: Ellie and Laura had become close friends at a shelter.

cues.zh: 两人关系极为亲密
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 guan1 xi4 ji2 wei2 qin1 mi4
cues.en: The two were extremely close.

cues.zh: 艾莉立即整理出所有活动的照片
cues.pinyin: ai4 li4 li4 ji2 zheng3 li3 chu1 suo3 you3 huo2 dong4 de5 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: Ellie immediately gathered all the event photos.

cues.zh: 泰勒却注意到
cues.pinyin: tai4 lei1 que4 zhu4 yi4 dao4
cues.en: Tyler, however, noticed

cues.zh: 只有劳拉的餐盘中出现了毒蘑菇
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 lao2 la1 de5 can1 pan2 zhong1 chu1 xian4 le5 du2 mo2 gu1
cues.en: that only Laura's plate had poisonous mushrooms on it,

cues.zh: 并且还有一个面露不悦的神秘男子
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 mian4 lu4 bu2 yue4 de5 shen2 mi4 nan2 zi5
cues.en: and there was also a mysterious man with a displeased expression.

cues.zh: 经过询问得知
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 xun2 wen4 de2 zhi1
cues.en: After questioning, they learned

cues.zh: 该男子晚餐时
cues.pinyin: gai1 nan2 zi5 wan3 can1 shi2
cues.en: that during dinner, the man

cues.zh: 曾对着劳拉破口大骂
cues.pinyin: ceng2 dui4 zhe5 lao2 la1 po4 kou3 da4 ma4
cues.en: had cursed Laura out,

cues.zh: 大喊玻利维亚和水资源相关话语
cues.pinyin: da4 han3 bo1 li4 wei2 ya4 he2 shui3 zi1 yuan2 xiang1 guan1 hua4 yu3
cues.en: shouting things about Bolivia and water resources.

cues.zh: 顺着这条线索
cues.pinyin: shun4 zhe5 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Following this lead,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 女孩为争夺豪门遗产，内心扭曲下毒害死姐姐。突破道德法律底线，简直惨无人道。

cues.zh: 丹尼尔坚决要求查看对方的眼睛
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 jian1 jue2 yao1 qiu2 cha2 kan4 dui4 fang1 de5 yan3 jing1
cues.en: Daniel firmly demanded to see the man's ID.

cues.zh: 直至却被泰勒拦下
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 que4 bei4 tai4 lei1 lan2 xia4
cues.en: However, Tyler stopped him before he could.

cues.zh: 然而下一条
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 xia4 yi1 tiao2
cues.en: But the very next moment,

cues.zh: 泰勒将班森紧急送往医院
cues.pinyin: tai4 lei1 jiang1 ban1 sen1 jin3 ji2 song4 wang3 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Tyler rushed Benson to the hospital,

cues.zh: 由于他在实验室中接触到了致幻菌种
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 ta1 zai4 shi2 yan4 shi4 zhong1 jie1 chu4 dao4 le5 zhi4 huan4 jun1 zhong3
cues.en: because he had been exposed to a hallucinogenic fungus in the lab.

cues.zh: 有毒物质通过水蒸汽侵害了神经系统
cues.pinyin: you3 du2 wu4 zhi4 tong1 guo4 shui3 zheng1 qi4 qin1 hai4 le5 shen2 jing1 xi4 tong3
cues.en: The toxin had attacked his nervous system through water vapor.

cues.zh: 好在发现及时这才没酿成大祸
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 fa1 xian4 ji2 shi2 zhe4 cai2 mei2 niang4 cheng2 da4 huo4
cues.en: Luckily it was caught in time, preventing a disaster.

cues.zh: 丹森调整好状态迅速返回警局
cues.pinyin: dan1 sen1 tiao2 zheng3 hao3 zhuang4 tai4 xun4 su4 fan3 hui2 jing3 ju2
cues.en: Benson got himself together and quickly returned to the station.

cues.zh: 面对劳阿被杀的指控
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 lao2 a1 bei4 sha1 de5 zhi3 kong4
cues.en: Facing accusations of killing Laura,

cues.zh: 丹尼尔坚定地表示自己从未做过此事
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 jian1 ding4 di4 biao3 shi4 zi4 ji3 cong2 wei4 zuo4 guo4 ci3 shi4
cues.en: Daniel firmly insisted he had never done such a thing.

cues.zh: 然而警方还是对丹尼尔提起了诉讼
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jing3 fang1 hai2 shi4 dui4 dan1 ni2 er3 ti2 qi3 le5 su4 song4
cues.en: Nevertheless, police still filed charges against Daniel.

cues.zh: 直至开庭时却发生了意外
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 kai1 ting2 shi2 que4 fa1 sheng1 le5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: But when the trial began, something unexpected happened.

cues.zh: 由于法官对种植玫瑰情有毒众
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 fa3 guan1 dui4 zhong4 zhi2 mei2 gui1 qing2 you3 du2 zhong4
cues.en: Because the judge had a special fondness for growing roses,

cues.zh: 由于法官对种植玫瑰情有独钟
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 fa3 guan1 dui4 zhong4 zhi2 mei2 gui1 qing2 you3 du2 zhong1
cues.en: he determined Daniel would never abandon

cues.zh: 真爱之物潜逃
cues.pinyin: zhen1 ai4 zhi1 wu4 qian2 tao2
cues.en: the thing he truly loved in order to flee.

cues.zh: 竟当场批准了保释请求
cues.pinyin: jing4 dang1 chang3 pi1 zhun3 le5 bao3 shi4 qing3 qiu2
cues.en: He actually approved the bail request on the spot.

cues.zh: 兴奋的丹尼尔面对媒体激动的发表着感言
cues.pinyin: xing1 fen4 de5 dan1 ni2 er3 mian4 dui4 mei2 ti3 ji1 dong4 de5 fa1 biao3 zhe5 gan3 yan2
cues.en: An excited Daniel gave an emotional statement to the media.

cues.zh: 殊不知警局里班塞已经确定
cues.pinyin: shu1 bu4 zhi1 jing3 ju2 li3 ban1 sai1 yi3 jing1 que4 ding4
cues.en: Little did he know, at the police station Benson had already confirmed...

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 他们 10 岁孩子突然找到高僧老家
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 10 sui4 hai2 zi5 tu1 ran2 zhao3 dao4 gao1 seng1 lao3 jia1
cues.en: Their 10-year-old child suddenly shows up at the eminent monk's hometown.

cues.zh: 竟口口声声说高僧是他们父亲
cues.pinyin: jing4 kou3 kou3 sheng1 sheng1 shuo1 gao1 seng1 shi4 ta1 men5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: and keeps insisting that the monk is their father.

cues.zh: 这到底是怎么一回事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 yi1 hui2 shi4
cues.en: What on earth is going on here?

cues.zh: 文汐是韩国著名高僧
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 shi4 han2 guo2 zhu4 ming2 gao1 seng1
cues.en: Wen Xi is a famous eminent monk in Korea.

cues.zh: 每当他宣讲佛法时
cues.pinyin: mei3 dang1 ta1 xuan1 jiang3 fo2 fa3 shi2
cues.en: Whenever he preaches the Buddhist teachings,

cues.zh: 总会有来自全国各地的信徒感
cues.pinyin: zong3 hui4 you3 lai2 zi4 quan2 guo2 ge4 di4 de5 xin4 tu2 gan3
cues.en: believers from all over the country always come,

cues.zh: 只为一听高僧的讲解
cues.pinyin: zhi3 wei4 yi1 ting1 gao1 seng1 de5 jiang3 jie3
cues.en: just to hear the monk's teachings.

cues.zh: 然而他名声越高
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ta1 ming2 sheng1 yue4 gao1
cues.en: But the more famous he became,

cues.zh: 饺子店老板老贤就愈愈了
cues.pinyin: jiao3 zi5 dian4 lao3 ban3 lao3 xian2 jiu4 yu4 yu4 le5
cues.en: the more worried dumpling shop owner Lao Xian grew.

cues.zh: 因为文汐是他唯一的儿子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wen2 xi1 shi4 ta1 wei2 yi1 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: because Wen Xi is his only son.

cues.zh: 老贤老板早已去世
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 lao3 ban3 zao3 yi3 qu4 shi4
cues.en: Lao Xian's wife had already passed away long ago.

cues.zh: 如今文西也没给他留下一而半
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 wen2 xi1 ye3 mei2 gei3 ta1 liu2 xia4 yi1 er2 ban4
cues.en: and now Wen Xi hadn't given him even a single grandchild.

cues.zh: 想到自己身体一天不如一天
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 zi4 ji3 shen1 ti3 yi1 tian1 bu4 ru2 yi1 tian1
cues.en: Thinking about how his health worsened day by day,

cues.zh: 老贤总是惆怅家族的未来
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 zong3 shi4 chou2 chang4 jia1 zu2 de5 wei4 lai2
cues.en: Lao Xian was always anxious about his family's future.

cues.zh: 而每当他看到顾客一家其乐融融的景象
cues.pinyin: er2 mei3 dang1 ta1 kan4 dao4 gu4 ke4 yi1 jia1 qi2 le4 rong2 rong2 de5 jing3 xiang4
cues.en: and whenever he saw customers enjoying happy family moments,

cues.zh: 这种惆怅与落寞就越发强烈了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 chou2 chang4 yu3 luo4 mo4 jiu4 yue4 fa1 qiang2 lie4 le5
cues.en: that anxiety and loneliness grew even stronger.

cues.zh: 这天晚上又到了老贤家族的祭祀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 wan3 shang4 you4 dao4 le5 lao3 xian2 jia1 zu2 de5 ji4 si4
cues.en: That night was once again time for the family's ancestral rites.

cues.zh: 按照父子俩人的约定
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 fu4 zi3 lia3 ren2 de5 yue1 ding4
cues.en: According to the agreement between father and son,

cues.zh: 文西当天必须返回参加祭祀
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 dang4 tian1 bi4 xu1 fan3 hui2 can1 jia1 ji4 si4
cues.en: Wen Xi had to return that day to attend the rites.

cues.zh: 这也是父子俩人少有的见面机会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 fu4 zi3 lia3 ren2 shao3 you3 de5 jian4 mian4 ji1 hui4
cues.en: This was also one of their rare chances to meet.

cues.zh: 老贤总会趁机劝儿子还俗
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 zong3 hui4 chen4 ji1 quan4 er2 zi5 huan2 su2
cues.en: Lao Xian would always use the chance to urge his son to leave the monkhood.

cues.zh: 因此每次见面都非常不愉快
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 mei3 ci4 jian4 mian4 dou1 fei1 chang2 bu4 yu2 kuai4
cues.en: so every meeting ended up unpleasant.

cues.zh: 接近深夜文西终于带着一个小
cues.pinyin: jie1 jin4 shen1 ye4 wen2 xi1 zhong1 yu2 dai4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 xiao3
cues.en: Close to midnight, Wen Xi finally arrived with a little

cues.zh: 沙弥阿星前来
cues.pinyin: sha1 mi2 a1 xing1 qian2 lai2
cues.en: novice monk named Axing.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 他脸上始终保持着一副淡泊
cues.pinyin: ta1 lian3 shang4 shi3 zhong1 bao3 chi2 zhe5 yi1 fu4 dan4 bo2
cues.en: His face always wore a look of detached indifference,

cues.zh: 显然对这个家没有任何回属
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 dui4 zhe4 ge5 jia1 mei2 you3 ren4 he2 hui2 shu3
cues.en: clearly feeling no sense of belonging to this family.

cues.zh: 库子俩人当见面没多久
cues.pinyin: ku4 zi5 lia3 ren2 dang1 jian4 mian4 mei2 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Not long after father and son met,

cues.zh: 便再次开始争执
cues.pinyin: bian4 zai4 ci4 kai1 shi3 zheng1 zhi2
cues.en: they started arguing again.

cues.zh: 最后文西直接带着阿星转身离开
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wen2 xi1 zhi2 jie1 dai4 zhe5 a1 xing1 zhuan3 shen1 li2 kai1
cues.en: In the end, Wen Xi turned and left with Axing.

cues.zh: 老贤被他气得火冒三丈
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 bei4 ta1 qi4 de2 huo3 mao4 san1 zhang4
cues.en: Lao Xian was so furious he nearly exploded.

cues.zh: 下意识端起酒杯一饮而尽
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi4 shi2 duan1 qi3 jiu3 bei1 yi1 yin3 er2 jin3
cues.en: Without thinking, he grabbed a cup of wine and downed it in one gulp,

cues.zh: 紧接着便一头栽倒在地
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 bian4 yi1 tou2 zai1 dao3 zai4 di4
cues.en: then immediately collapsed to the ground.

cues.zh: 助理静香见势不妙
cues.pinyin: zhu4 li3 jing4 xiang1 jian4 shi4 bu4 miao4
cues.en: His assistant Jingxiang saw something was wrong,

cues.zh: 立刻将他送去诊所
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 jiang1 ta1 song4 qu4 zhen3 suo3
cues.en: and rushed him to the clinic.

cues.zh: 主持医生家彦是文西以前的恋
cues.pinyin: zhu3 chi2 yi1 sheng1 jia1 yan4 shi4 wen2 xi1 yi3 qian2 de5 lian4
cues.en: The attending doctor, Jiayan, was Wen Xi's former girlfriend.

cues.zh: 几乎检查确定老贤只是酒精过目
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 jian3 cha2 que4 ding4 lao3 xian2 zhi3 shi4 jiu3 jing1 guo4 mu4
cues.en: The exam confirmed Lao Xian had simply had too much alcohol,

cues.zh: 并没有什么大碍
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 da4 ai4
cues.en: and nothing was seriously wrong.

cues.zh: 通过他和静香的对话可以知道
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 ta1 he2 jing4 xiang1 de5 dui4 hua4 ke3 yi3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: From his conversation with Jingxiang, we learn

cues.zh: 这些年父子俩人关系越来越僵
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 nian2 fu4 zi3 lia3 ren2 guan1 xi4 yue4 lai2 yue4 jiang1
cues.en: that over the years the father-son relationship had grown increasingly strained.

cues.zh: 老贤已经不是第一次被气得送来诊所
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 yi3 jing1 bu2 shi4 di4 yi1 ci4 bei4 qi4 de2 song4 lai2 zhen3 suo3
cues.en: This wasn't the first time Lao Xian had been rushed to the clinic after getting worked up.

cues.zh: 但这是他们的家事
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 shi4 ta1 men5 de5 jia1 shi4
cues.en: But this was their own family matter.

cues.zh: 嘉燕也爱莫能助
cues.pinyin: jia1 yan4 ye3 ai4 mo4 neng2 zhu4
cues.en: Jiayan also felt there was nothing she could do to help.

cues.zh: 静香见嘉燕还没有吃饭
cues.pinyin: jing4 xiang1 jian4 jia1 yan4 hai2 mei2 you3 chi1 fan4
cues.en: Seeing that Jiayan hadn't eaten,

cues.zh: 便给他带来一些饺子
cues.pinyin: bian4 gei3 ta1 dai4 lai2 yi1 xie1 jiao3 zi5
cues.en: Jingxiang brought her some dumplings.

cues.zh: 这是老贤的独门秘籍文宗饺子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 lao3 xian2 de5 du2 men2 mi4 ji2 wen2 zong1 jiao3 zi5
cues.en: These were Lao Xian's secret family-recipe dumplings,

cues.zh: 只制作给家人使用
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zhi4 zuo4 gei3 jia1 ren2 shi3 yong4
cues.en: made only for family,

cues.zh: 从不对外出售
cues.pinyin: cong2 bu4 dui4 wai4 chu1 shou4
cues.en: and never sold to outsiders.

cues.zh: 嘉燕尝后连连夸赞
cues.pinyin: jia1 yan4 chang2 hou4 lian2 lian2 kua1 zan4
cues.en: After tasting them, Jiayan praised them over and over.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just at that moment,

cues.zh: 老贤终于从昏迷中醒来
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 zhong1 yu2 cong2 hun1 mi2 zhong1 xing3 lai2
cues.en: Lao Xian finally woke up.

cues.zh: 他并不缺钱
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu4 que1 qian2
cues.en: He wasn't short of money at all —

cues.zh: 甚至可以说非常富有
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 ke3 yi3 shuo1 fei1 chang2 fu4 you3
cues.en: in fact, he was quite wealthy.

cues.zh: 明显有十几栋楼收租
cues.pinyin: ming2 xian3 you3 shi2 ji3 dong4 lou2 shou1 zu1
cues.en: He clearly owned over a dozen buildings he collected rent from.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 发现这里已经多出无数小塔
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 zhe4 li3 yi3 jing1 duo1 chu1 wu2 shu4 xiao3 ta3
cues.en: He found that countless small pagodas had appeared here.

cues.zh: 那一刻阿星彻底顿悟
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 ke4 a1 xing1 che4 di3 dun4 wu4
cues.en: At that moment Axing became completely enlightened,

cues.zh: 决定削发为僧
cues.pinyin: jue2 ding4 xue1 fa4 wei4 seng1
cues.en: and decided to shave his head and become a monk.

cues.zh: 自那之后又过了几天
cues.pinyin: zi4 na4 zhi1 hou4 you4 guo4 le5 ji3 tian1
cues.en: A few days passed after that.

cues.zh: 他先如同往常一样晶莹的饺子果
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian1 ru2 tong2 wang3 chang2 yi1 yang4 jing1 ying2 de5 jiao3 zi5 guo3
cues.en: He was still making dumplings as usual, just like before.

cues.zh: 这时两个孩子走了进来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 zou3 le5 jin4 lai2
cues.en: At this point two children walked in,

cues.zh: 声称要找父亲文西
cues.pinyin: sheng1 cheng1 yao4 zhao3 fu4 qin1 wen2 xi1
cues.en: claiming they wanted to find their father, Wen Xi.

cues.zh: 听到这一消息老贤无比诧异
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 zhe4 yi1 xiao1 xi1 lao3 xian2 wu2 bi3 cha4 yi4
cues.en: Hearing this, Lao Xian was utterly astonished,

cues.zh: 连忙给儿子打去电话
cues.pinyin: lian2 mang2 gei3 er2 zi5 da3 qu4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: and hurriedly called his son.

cues.zh: 听到消息文西第一反应不是震惊
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 xiao1 xi1 wen2 xi1 di4 yi1 fan3 ying4 bu2 shi4 zhen4 jing1
cues.en: On hearing the news, Wen Xi's first reaction wasn't shock,

cues.zh: 而是无尽的疑惑
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 wu2 jin4 de5 yi2 huo4
cues.en: but endless confusion.

cues.zh: 自己明明已经出家 11 年了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 ming2 ming2 yi3 jing1 chu1 jia1 11 nian2 le5
cues.en: He had clearly become a monk 11 years ago —

cues.zh: 怎么会有 10 岁的孩子来找自己
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 you3 10 sui4 de5 hai2 zi5 lai2 zhao3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: so how could a 10-year-old child come looking for him,

cues.zh: 并且声称是她的亲生骨肉
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 sheng1 cheng1 shi4 ta1 de5 qin1 sheng1 gu3 rou4
cues.en: claiming to be his own flesh and blood?

cues.zh: 文西唯一想到的可能就是初恋家燕
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 wei2 yi1 xiang3 dao4 de5 ke3 neng2 jiu4 shi4 chu1 lian4 jia1 yan4
cues.en: The only person Wen Xi could think of was his first love, Jiayan.

cues.zh: 这也是她唯一谈过的女友
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 ta1 wei2 yi1 tan2 guo4 de5 nv3 you3
cues.en: She was also the only girlfriend he had ever had.

cues.zh: 文西不由猜测
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 bu4 you2 cai1 ce4
cues.en: Wen Xi couldn't help but guess

cues.zh: 会不会是家燕当初偷偷怀孕
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 jia1 yan4 dang1 chu1 tou1 tou1 huai2 yun4
cues.en: that maybe Jiayan had secretly gotten pregnant back then,

cues.zh: 然后留下了孩子
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 liu2 xia4 le5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: and kept the child.

cues.zh: 当她将此事告诉家燕时
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 jiang1 ci3 shi4 gao4 su4 jia1 yan4 shi2
cues.en: When he told Jiayan about this,

cues.zh: 对方同样无比震惊
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 tong2 yang4 wu2 bi3 zhen4 jing1
cues.en: she was equally shocked,

cues.zh: 因为她确实瞒着文西生下了一个女儿
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 que4 shi2 man2 zhe5 wen2 xi1 sheng1 xia4 le5 yi2 ge4 nv3 er2
cues.en: because she had indeed secretly given birth to a daughter without telling Wen Xi.

cues.zh: 但是佳燕从未告诉他亲生父亲身份
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jia1 yan4 cong2 wei4 gao4 su4 ta1 qin1 sheng1 fu4 qin1 shen1 fen4
cues.en: But Jiayan had never told the child who her real father was.

cues.zh: 不明白小夕是从何处探听到了文西身份
cues.pinyin: bu4 ming2 bai2 xiao3 xi1 shi4 cong2 he2 chu4 tan4 ting1 dao4 le5 wen2 xi1 shen1 fen4
cues.en: She had no idea how Xiaoxi had found out Wen Xi's identity.

cues.zh: 不过如今这一切都不重要
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ru2 jin1 zhe4 yi1 qie4 dou1 bu2 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: But by now, none of that mattered anymore.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 最后便将两人扔进保育院
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 bian4 jiang1 liang3 ren2 reng1 jin4 bao3 yu4 yuan4
cues.en: In the end, the two children were sent to an orphanage,

cues.zh: 并结为两人申请了海外收养
cues.pinyin: bing4 jie2 wei4 liang3 ren2 shen1 qing3 le5 hai3 wai4 shou1 yang3
cues.en: and registered for overseas adoption.

cues.zh: 敏国不愿与妹妹分开
cues.pinyin: min3 guo2 bu4 yuan4 yu3 mei4 mei4 fen1 kai1
cues.en: Mingguo didn't want to be separated from his sister,

cues.zh: 便找到当初进行试管婴儿的医院
cues.pinyin: bian4 zhao3 dao4 dang1 chu1 jin4 xing2 shi4 guan3 ying1 er2 de5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: so he found the hospital where their IVF had originally been done,

cues.zh: 想要寻找他们的亲生父亲
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 xun2 zhao3 ta1 men5 de5 qin1 sheng1 fu4 qin1
cues.en: hoping to find their biological father.

cues.zh: 这才找到文希住处
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 zhao3 dao4 wen2 xi1 zhu4 chu4
cues.en: That's how they ended up at Wen Xi's residence.

cues.zh: 文希听后顿时思绪翻飞
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 ting1 hou4 dun4 shi2 si1 xu4 fan1 fei1
cues.en: Hearing this, Wen Xi's thoughts raced.

cues.zh: 他没想到当初的举动
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei2 xiang3 dao4 dang1 chu1 de5 ju3 dong4
cues.en: He never imagined that what he'd done back then

cues.zh: 竟然会带来这种忙
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 hui4 dai4 lai2 zhe4 zhong3 mang2
cues.en: would end up causing this kind of trouble.

cues.zh: 温惜在出家前层的
cues.pinyin: wen1 xi1 zai4 chu1 jia1 qian2 ceng2 de5
cues.en: Before becoming a monk, Wen Xi had once

cues.zh: 嘉燕父亲手下工作
cues.pinyin: jia1 yan4 fu4 qin1 shou3 xia4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: worked under Jiayan's father.

cues.zh: 这位老岳父起初
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 lao3 yue4 fu4 qi3 chu1
cues.en: This soon-to-be father-in-law, at first,

cues.zh: 非常反对两人在一起
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 fan3 dui4 liang3 ren2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: was strongly against the two of them being together.

cues.zh: 直到后来看两人生米煮生熟饭
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 hou4 lai2 kan4 liang3 ren2 sheng1 mi3 zhu3 sheng1 shu2 fan4
cues.en: until later, seeing that the deed was already done,

cues.zh: 不得不捏着鼻子答应
cues.pinyin: bu4 de2 bu4 nie1 zhe5 bi2 zi5 da1 ying4
cues.en: he had no choice but to grudgingly agree.

cues.zh: 但是他提出了一些条件
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: But he set some conditions.

cues.zh: 要求温惜每个星期
cues.pinyin: yao1 qiu2 wen1 xi1 mei3 ge4 xing1 qi1
cues.en: He required Wen Xi, every week,

cues.zh: 去医院进行四次基因捐献
cues.pinyin: qu4 yi1 yuan4 jin4 xing2 si4 ci4 ji1 yin1 juan1 xian4
cues.en: to go to the hospital and donate sperm four times,

cues.zh: 以此帮助那些不孕家庭
cues.pinyin: yi3 ci3 bang1 zhu4 na4 xie1 bu4 yun4 jia1 ting2
cues.en: in order to help infertile families

cues.zh: 怀上保护
cues.pinyin: huai2 shang4 bao3 hu4
cues.en: conceive a child.

cues.zh: 为了能够和嘉燕在一起
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 neng2 gou4 he2 jia1 yan4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: In order to be with Jiayan,

cues.zh: 温惜这种答应下
cues.pinyin: wen1 xi1 zhe4 zhong3 da1 ying4 xia4
cues.en: Wen Xi had no choice but to agree.

cues.zh: 得到儿子的肯定后
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 er2 zi5 de5 ken3 ding4 hou4
cues.en: After getting confirmation from his son,

cues.zh: 父亲老贤差点乐开的话
cues.pinyin: fu4 qin1 lao3 xian2 cha4 dian3 le4 kai1 de5 hua4
cues.en: father Lao Xian was nearly beside himself with joy.

cues.zh: 自从儿子出家后
cues.pinyin: zi4 cong2 er2 zi5 chu1 jia1 hou4
cues.en: Ever since his son became a monk,

cues.zh: 他便整人郁郁寡欢
cues.pinyin: ta1 bian4 zheng3 ren2 yu4 yu4 gua3 huan1
cues.en: he had been gloomy all day long.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 如今看到家族没有绝后
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 kan4 dao4 jia1 zu2 mei2 you3 jue2 hou4
cues.en: Now seeing that his family line wouldn't die out,

cues.zh: 他怎能不欣喜若狂
cues.pinyin: ta1 zen3 neng2 bu4 xin1 xi3 ruo4 kuang2
cues.en: how could he not be overjoyed?

cues.zh: 二话不说就要补偿孙子孙女
cues.pinyin: er4 hua4 bu4 shuo1 jiu4 yao4 bu3 chang2 sun1 zi5 sun1 nv3
cues.en: Without hesitation he wanted to make it up to his grandchildren.

cues.zh: 听到敏赛想要吃烤肉
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 min3 sai4 xiang3 yao4 chi1 kao3 rou4
cues.en: Hearing that Minsai wanted to eat grilled meat,

cues.zh: 老贤直接包场首尔第一烤肉店
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 zhi2 jie1 bao1 chang3 shou3 er3 di4 yi1 kao3 rou4 dian4
cues.en: Lao Xian immediately booked out Seoul's top barbecue restaurant,

cues.zh: 并邀请饺子店所有员工
cues.pinyin: bing4 yao1 qing3 jiao3 zi5 dian4 suo3 you3 yuan2 gong1
cues.en: and invited all the dumpling shop staff

cues.zh: 前去和自己一起庆祝
cues.pinyin: qian2 qu4 he2 zi4 ji3 yi4 qi3 qing4 zhu4
cues.en: to come celebrate together with him.

cues.zh: 他宴会上俩的孩子一边亲切地照着爷爷
cues.pinyin: ta1 yan4 hui4 shang4 lia3 de5 hai2 zi5 yi1 bian1 qin1 qie4 di4 zhao4 zhe5 ye2 ye2
cues.en: At the banquet the two kids affectionately called out "Grandpa"

cues.zh: 一边为他道乡
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 wei4 ta1 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: while pouring wine for him.

cues.zh: 老贤虽然知道自己酒精过努
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 sui1 ran2 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 jiu3 jing1 guo4 nu3
cues.en: Although Lao Xian knew he was allergic to alcohol,

cues.zh: 但是为了不辜负两个孩子的一番心意
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wei4 le5 bu4 gu1 fu4 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 de5 yi1 fan1 xin1 yi4
cues.en: to not disappoint the children's heartfelt gesture,

cues.zh: 他一口气干了两杯
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 kou3 qi4 gan4 le5 liang3 bei1
cues.en: he downed two cups in one go,

cues.zh: 买脸幸福地倒在桌上
cues.pinyin: mai3 lian3 xing4 fu2 di4 dao4 zai4 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: and collapsed onto the table, his face full of happiness.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 本期总感觉事情有些不对
cues.pinyin: ben3 qi1 zong3 gan3 jue2 shi4 qing2 you3 xie1 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Wen Xi kept feeling that something was off.

cues.zh: 于是便找到当初的好友
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 bian4 zhao3 dao4 dang1 chu1 de5 hao3 you3
cues.en: So he went to find an old friend,

cues.zh: 同时也是如今嘉燕的丈夫打算情况
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 ye3 shi4 ru2 jin1 jia1 yan4 de5 zhang4 fu1 da3 suan4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: who was now also Jiayan's husband, to ask about the situation.

cues.zh: 这才得知
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 de2 zhi1
cues.en: and that's when he learned

cues.zh: 当初自己捐献了 500 皮基因
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 zi4 ji3 juan1 xian4 le5 500 pi2 ji1 yin1
cues.en: that he himself had once donated 500 vials of sperm,

cues.zh: 几乎全部成为了
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 quan2 bu4 cheng2 wei2 le5
cues.en: almost all of which ended up resulting

cues.zh: 读期在生物学上
cues.pinyin: du2 qi1 zai4 sheng1 wu4 xue2 shang4
cues.en: — biologically speaking, by now —

cues.zh: 他有 400 多个孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 400 duo1 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: in him having over 400 children.

cues.zh: 这直接把文西听傻了眼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi2 jie1 ba3 wen2 xi1 ting1 sha3 le5 yan3
cues.en: The donor list had been kept safe by Jiayan all along,

cues.zh: 所以两个孩子才能如此快速找到
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 cai2 neng2 ru2 ci3 kuai4 su4 zhao3 dao4
cues.en: which is why the two children were able to find him so quickly.

cues.zh: 这直接将文西听傻眼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi2 jie1 jiang1 wen2 xi1 ting1 sha3 yan3
cues.en: This left Wen Xi completely stunned.

cues.zh: 好友还在他透露
cues.pinyin: hao3 you3 hai2 zai4 ta1 tou4 lu4
cues.en: His friend also revealed to him

cues.zh: 因为自己患有疾病
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 huan4 you3 ji2 bing4
cues.en: that, because he himself had a medical condition,

cues.zh: 他和嘉燕的孩子小西
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 jia1 yan4 de5 hai2 zi5 xiao3 xi1
cues.en: his and Jiayan's child, Xiaoxi,

cues.zh: 也是通过这种方式得来的
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 de2 lai2 de5
cues.en: had also been conceived this same way.

cues.zh: 然而说到这里
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 shuo1 dao4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: However, having said all that,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 韩国爆款伦理喜剧，和尚年轻时偷偷捐精，20年后孩子上门喊「爸」

cues.zh: 想要将两个孩子接回来
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 jiang1 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 jie1 hui2 lai2
cues.en: he wanted to bring the two children back,

cues.zh: 但是如今他们并没有办理说两手续
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 jin1 ta1 men5 bing4 mei2 you3 ban4 li3 shuo1 liang3 shou3 xu4
cues.en: but they hadn't yet completed the adoption paperwork,

cues.zh: 同时也没有能够证明
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 ye3 mei2 you3 neng2 gou4 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: nor did they have any

cues.zh: 他们与两个孩子有关系的证据
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yu3 liang3 ge4 hai2 zi5 you3 guan1 xi4 de5 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: evidence proving their relationship to the children.

cues.zh: 保月院长自然不会放人
cues.pinyin: bao3 yue4 yuan4 zhang3 zi4 ran2 bu2 hui4 fang4 ren2
cues.en: The orphanage director naturally wouldn't let them go.

cues.zh: 老贤因此的对方发生争执
cues.pinyin: lao3 xian2 yin1 ci3 de5 dui4 fang1 fa1 sheng1 zheng1 zhi2
cues.en: Lao Xian got into an argument with him over this,

cues.zh: 最后甚至都惊动了警察
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 shen4 zhi4 dou1 jing1 dong4 le5 jing3 cha2
cues.en: and it even escalated to involving the police.

cues.zh: 文西听到消息立刻赶来阻止父亲
cues.pinyin: wen2 xi1 ting1 dao4 xiao1 xi1 li4 ke4 gan3 lai2 zu3 zhi3 fu4 qin1
cues.en: Hearing the news, Wen Xi rushed over to stop his father.

cues.zh: 在他的说和下
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 de5 shuo1 he2 xia4
cues.en: Thanks to his mediation,

cues.zh: 保月院长终于同意
cues.pinyin: bao3 yue4 yuan4 zhang3 zhong1 yu2 tong2 yi4
cues.en: the orphanage director finally agreed

cues.zh: 小明晚上出门想买一些零食回家吃结账时
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 wan3 shang4 chu1 men2 xiang3 mai3 yi1 xie1 ling2 shi2 hui2 jia1 chi1 jie2 zhang4 shi2
cues.en: Xiao Ming went out one night to buy some snacks, and when he went to pay,

cues.zh: 发现忘了带钱
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 wang4 le5 dai4 qian2
cues.en: he realized he'd forgotten to bring money.

cues.zh: 只好打手机叫家人拿钱过来等待的时候
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 da3 shou3 ji1 jiao4 jia1 ren2 na2 qian2 guo4 lai2 deng3 dai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: He had to call his family to bring some over, and while he waited,

cues.zh: 看到路边有一位老婆婆在烧纸钱
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 lu4 bian1 you3 yi1 wei4 lao3 po2 po5 zai4 shao1 zhi3 qian2
cues.en: he saw an old woman on the roadside burning paper money.

cues.zh: 就走过去跟老婆婆闲聊
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zou3 guo4 qu4 gen1 lao3 po2 po5 xian2 liao2
cues.en: So he walked over and struck up a chat with her.

cues.zh: 老婆婆你在干嘛
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2 po5 ni3 zai4 gan4 ma2
cues.en: "Granny, what are you doing?"

cues.zh: 啊我在烧一些钱给家人能在阴间使用啊
cues.pinyin: a5 wo3 zai4 shao1 yi1 xie1 qian2 gei3 jia1 ren2 neng2 zai4 yin1 jian1 shi3 yong4 a5
cues.en: "Oh, I'm burning some money so my family can use it in the afterlife."

cues.zh: 啊现在这么晚了你在街上干嘛
cues.pinyin: a5 xian4 zai4 zhe4 me5 wan3 le5 ni3 zai4 jie1 shang4 gan4 ma2
cues.en: "Oh, it's so late — what are you doing out on the street?"

cues.zh: 我在等我家人给我钱
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 deng3 wo3 jia1 ren2 gei3 wo3 qian2
cues.en: "I'm waiting for my family to bring me money."

cues.zh: 突然老婆婆脸色大变
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 lao3 po2 po5 lian3 se4 da4 bian4
cues.en: Suddenly the old woman's face went pale.

cues.zh: 很快转身跑走
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 zhuan3 shen1 pao3 zou3
cues.en: She quickly turned and ran off.

cues.zh: 小明心想老婆婆一定是误会了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 xin1 xiang3 lao3 po2 po5 yi2 ding4 shi4 wu4 hui4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Ming thought she must have misunderstood,

cues.zh: 就大叫
cues.pinyin: jiu4 da4 jiao4
cues.en: so he shouted,

cues.zh: 老婆婆不要走那么快
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2 po5 bu2 yao4 zou3 na4 me5 kuai4
cues.en: "Granny, don't run so fast!

cues.zh: 我真的在等家人拿钱给我
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhen1 de5 zai4 deng3 jia1 ren2 na2 qian2 gei3 wo3
cues.en: I really am just waiting for my family to bring me money.

cues.zh: 没有骗你
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 pian4 ni3
cues.en: I'm not lying to you!"

cues.zh: 结果四周的人全跑走了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 si4 zhou1 de5 ren2 quan2 pao3 zou3 le5
cues.en: As a result, everyone else nearby ran off too.

cues.zh: 想住的事情是什么呢
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zhu4 de5 shi4 qing2 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What's the thing it wants to do most?

cues.zh: 冰块喔
cues.pinyin: bing1 kuai4 o1
cues.en: Hmm, an ice cube...

cues.zh: 潜水吗
cues.pinyin: qian2 shui3 ma5
cues.en: Is it diving?

cues.zh: 因为他都浮在水面
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 dou1 fu2 zai4 shui3 mian4
cues.en: Because it's always floating on the water's surface,

cues.zh: 所以想要潜下去
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiang3 yao4 qian2 xia4 qu4
cues.en: so it wants to dive down.

cues.zh: 错当然是退伍
cues.pinyin: cuo4 dang1 ran2 shi4 tui4 wu3
cues.en: Wrong — of course it's getting "discharged."

cues.zh: 因为他当冰当太久了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 dang1 bing1 dang1 tai4 jiu3 le5
cues.en: Because it's been "being ice" (a pun on "being a soldier") for too long.

cues.zh: 精神病院的医生去看一位患者
cues.pinyin: jing1 shen2 bing4 yuan4 de5 yi1 sheng1 qu4 kan4 yi1 wei4 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: A doctor at a psychiatric hospital went to see a patient.

cues.zh: 看到患者蹲著
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 huan4 zhe3 dun1 zhu4
cues.en: He saw the patient squatting down.

cues.zh: 医生就和他一起蹲著
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jiu4 he2 ta1 yi4 qi3 dun1 zhu4
cues.en: So the doctor squatted down with him.

cues.zh: 患者把头转过来问
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 ba3 tou2 zhuan3 guo4 lai2 wen4
cues.en: The patient turned his head and asked,

cues.zh: 你和我一样是香菇吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 he2 wo3 yi1 yang4 shi4 xiang1 gu1 ma5
cues.en: "Are you a mushroom too, like me?"

cues.zh: 小狗一年都不会叫呢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gou3 yi1 nian2 dou1 bu2 hui4 jiao4 ne5
cues.en: The puppy hasn't barked all year.

cues.zh: 为什么就不会叫
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 jiu4 bu2 hui4 jiao4
cues.en: Why would it not bark?

cues.zh: 因为小狗
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 gou3
cues.en: Because it's a puppy.
