cues.zh: 小明和老婆去逛百货公司
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 he2 lao3 po2 qu4 guang4 bai3 huo4 gong1 si1
cues.en: Xiao Ming and his wife went shopping at a department store.

cues.zh: 不小心和老婆走散了
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 he2 lao3 po2 zou3 san4 le5
cues.en: He accidentally got separated from his wife.

cues.zh: 准备去找他老婆
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 qu4 zhao3 ta1 lao3 po2
cues.en: He set off to find her.

cues.zh: 走著走著
cues.pinyin: zou3 zhu4 zou3 zhu4
cues.en: As he walked and walked,

cues.zh: 看到一位美女
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 yi1 wei4 mei3 nv3
cues.en: he saw a beautiful woman.

cues.zh: 就跑去问那美女说
cues.pinyin: jiu4 pao3 qu4 wen4 na4 mei3 nv3 shuo1
cues.en: So he ran over and asked her,

cues.zh: 我和我老婆走散了
cues.pinyin: wo3 he2 wo3 lao3 po2 zou3 san4 le5
cues.en: "I got separated from my wife.

cues.zh: 我可不可以和你聊个几分钟啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 he2 ni3 liao2 ge4 ji3 fen1 zhong1 a5
cues.en: Could I chat with you for a few minutes?"

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为我每次只要跟美女聊天
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 mei3 ci4 zhi3 yao4 gen1 mei3 nv3 liao2 tian1
cues.en: "Because every time I chat with a beautiful woman,

cues.zh: 过没多久
cues.pinyin: guo4 mei2 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: it doesn't take long

cues.zh: 我老婆就会出现了
cues.pinyin: wo3 lao3 po2 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: before my wife shows up."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话36｜烧纸钱｜冰块退伍｜你是香菇吗？｜剥橘子｜7个幽默爆笑笑话｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 桌子上有 A BC 三个空杯子和八颗弹珠
cues.pinyin: zhuo1 zi5 shang4 you3 A BC san1 ge4 kong1 bei1 zi5 he2 ba1 ke1 dan4 zhu1
cues.en: On the table there are three empty cups, A, B, and C, and eight marbles.

cues.zh: 要如何把弹珠平分在杯子里
cues.pinyin: yao4 ru2 he2 ba3 dan4 zhu1 ping2 fen1 zai4 bei1 zi5 li3
cues.en: How do you divide the marbles evenly among the cups?

cues.zh: 不可以切开弹珠哦
cues.pinyin: bu4 ke3 yi3 qie4 kai1 dan4 zhu1 o2
cues.en: You're not allowed to cut a marble open!

cues.zh: 你知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know the answer?

cues.zh: 可在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: Feel free to leave it in the comments below.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to the last episode is here.

cues.zh: 三角形 A 斜边的斜率是 0 3 75
cues.pinyin: san1 jiao3 xing2 A xie2 bian1 de5 xie2 lv4 shi4 0 3 75
cues.en: The slope of the hypotenuse of triangle A is 0.375.

cues.zh: 三角形 A 斜边的斜率是 0.375
cues.pinyin: san1 jiao3 xing2 A xie2 bian1 de5 xie2 lv4 shi4 0.375
cues.en: The slope of the hypotenuse of triangle C is 0.4.

cues.zh: 两个斜率不同
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 xie2 lv4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: The two slopes are different.

cues.zh: V 和 D 也是一样
cues.pinyin: V he2 D ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: B and D are the same way.

cues.zh: 它们的交接处放大看
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 jiao1 jie1 chu4 fang4 da4 kan4
cues.en: If you zoom in on where they meet,

cues.zh: 应该是这样的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: it should look like this.

cues.zh: 所以叉了 1
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cha1 le5 1
cues.en: So there's a slight mismatch.

cues.zh: 你答对了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 da2 dui4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you get it right?

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑汤
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 nv3 shi1 jing4 lan4 cheng2 dou4 fu3 nao3 tang1
cues.en: The virus-infected female corpse actually rotted into tofu pudding.

cues.zh: 病毒甚至趴进法医血管
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 shen4 zhi4 pa1 jin4 fa3 yi1 xue4 guan3
cues.en: The virus even crawled into the coroner's blood vessels.

cues.zh: 更狠的是凶手为搞钱藏的病毒
cues.pinyin: geng4 hen3 de5 shi4 xiong1 shou3 wei4 gao3 qian2 cang2 de5 bing4 du2
cues.en: Even worse, the virus the killer hid just to make money

cues.zh: 竟能让华盛顿瞬间变成丧尸城
cues.pinyin: jing4 neng2 rang4 hua2 sheng4 dun4 shun4 jian1 bian4 cheng2 sang4 shi1 cheng2
cues.en: could instantly turn Washington into a city of zombies.

cues.zh: 这哪是破案分明是凶案危机乱入菜市场
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na3 shi4 po4 an4 fen1 ming2 shi4 xiong1 an4 wei1 ji1 luan4 ru4 cai4 shi4 chang3
cues.en: This wasn't crime-solving — it was a murder crisis crashing straight into the marketplace.

cues.zh: 谁也没想到一具瞧着平平无奇的尸体
cues.pinyin: shui2 ye3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 yi1 ju4 qiao2 zhe5 ping2 ping2 wu2 qi2 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: No one expected that a seemingly ordinary corpse

cues.zh: 竟扯出场跟病毒赛跑的生死剧本
cues.pinyin: jing4 che3 chu1 chang3 gen1 bing4 du2 sai4 pao3 de5 sheng1 si3 ju4 ben3
cues.en: would set off a life-or-death race against the virus.

cues.zh: 早晨法医实验室的生化警报器突然像踩了
cues.pinyin: zao3 chen2 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 de5 sheng1 hua4 jing3 bao4 qi4 tu1 ran2 xiang4 cai3 le5
cues.en: That morning, the biohazard alarm in the forensic lab suddenly

cues.zh: 电门式的狂响
cues.pinyin: dian4 men2 shi4 de5 kuang2 xiang3
cues.en: blared wildly, as if someone had floored the gas pedal.

cues.zh: 而疾控中心那位在土耳其疫情火线上
cues.pinyin: er2 ji2 kong4 zhong1 xin1 na4 wei4 zai4 tu3 er3 qi2 yi4 qing2 huo3 xian4 shang4
cues.en: Meanwhile, the CDC doctor who'd been on the front lines of Turkey's outbreak

cues.zh: 七进七出
cues.pinyin: qi1 jin4 qi1 chu1
cues.en: had fought through it again and again, in and out seven times.

cues.zh: 跟世卫组织掰过专业手腕的博士
cues.pinyin: gen1 shi4 wei4 zu3 zhi1 bai1 guo4 zhuan1 ye4 shou3 wan4 de5 bo2 shi4
cues.en: a doctor who'd gone toe-to-toe with the WHO,

cues.zh: 带着病毒尸体赶到实验室门时
cues.pinyin: dai4 zhe5 bing4 du2 shi1 ti3 gan3 dao4 shi2 yan4 shi4 men2 shi2
cues.en: rushed to the lab door with the virus-infected corpse.

cues.zh: 直呼见鬼了
cues.pinyin: zhi2 hu1 jian4 gui3 le5
cues.en: exclaiming that this was downright ghostly.

cues.zh: 这病毒邪乎的能给科学怪弹血连载
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bing4 du2 xie2 hu1 de5 neng2 gei3 ke1 xue2 guai4 dan4 xue4 lian2 zai3
cues.en: This virus was so bizarre it seemed to belong in some horror-movie serial.

cues.zh: 按常理说
cues.pinyin: an4 chang2 li3 shuo1
cues.en: Under normal circumstances,

cues.zh: 食肉病毒啃肌肉
cues.pinyin: shi2 rou4 bing4 du2 ken3 ji1 rou4
cues.en: a flesh-eating virus gnawing through muscle

cues.zh: 起码也得三到四天
cues.pinyin: qi3 ma3 ye3 de2 san1 dao4 si4 tian1
cues.en: would take at least three to four days.

cues.zh: 可这尸体骨头被啃得像被强酸泡
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 shi1 ti3 gu3 tou5 bei4 ken3 de2 xiang4 bei4 qiang2 suan1 pao4
cues.en: But this corpse's bones had been gnawed down as if soaked in strong acid,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 满打满算才 24 小时
cues.pinyin: man3 da3 man3 suan4 cai2 24 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: and all told, only 24 hours had passed.

cues.zh: 更觉得是病毒跟穿了隐形斗篷一样
cues.pinyin: geng4 jue2 de5 shi4 bing4 du2 gen1 chuan1 le5 yin3 xing2 dou3 peng2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: It felt even more like the virus had thrown on an invisibility cloak,

cues.zh: 竟连传播路子都藏得密不透风
cues.pinyin: jing4 lian2 chuan2 bo1 lu4 zi5 dou1 cang2 de2 mi4 bu4 tou4 feng1
cues.en: hiding its transmission route completely airtight.

cues.zh: 尸体是在一处生化废品厂的垃圾
cues.pinyin: shi1 ti3 shi4 zai4 yi1 chu4 sheng1 hua4 fei4 pin3 chang3 de5 la1 ji1
cues.en: The corpse had turned up in the trash

cues.zh: 堆里跑出来的
cues.pinyin: dui1 li3 pao3 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: of a biohazard waste plant's garbage heap.

cues.zh: 却和动物医疗废料堆成毒垃圾联盟
cues.pinyin: que4 he2 dong4 wu4 yi1 liao2 fei4 liao4 dui1 cheng2 du2 la1 ji1 lian2 meng2
cues.en: yet it was piled together with animal medical waste into one toxic trash alliance.

cues.zh: 博士来验尸
cues.pinyin: bo2 shi4 lai2 yan4 shi1
cues.en: The doctor came to examine the body,

cues.zh: 分明是想扒开病毒的马甲
cues.pinyin: fen1 ming2 shi4 xiang3 ba1 kai1 bing4 du2 de5 ma3 jia3
cues.en: clearly wanting to strip away the virus's disguise,

cues.zh: 顺藤摸瓜
cues.pinyin: shun4 teng2 mo1 gua1
cues.en: following the thread,

cues.zh: 揪出感染源的幕后黑手
cues.pinyin: jiu1 chu1 gan3 ran3 yuan2 de5 mu4 hou4 hei1 shou3
cues.en: to expose the mastermind behind the infection source.

cues.zh: 众人接到通知后
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jie1 dao4 tong1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After everyone got the notice,

cues.zh: 实验室的红色警示灯狂闪
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 de5 hong2 se4 jing3 shi4 deng1 kuang2 shan3
cues.en: the lab's red warning lights flashed wildly,

cues.zh: 警报声能把天花板震起来
cues.pinyin: jing3 bao4 sheng1 neng2 ba3 tian1 hua1 ban3 zhen4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and the alarm was loud enough to shake the ceiling.

cues.zh: 连见惯丧尸袭击现场的法医小谷
cues.pinyin: lian2 jian4 guan4 sang4 shi1 xi2 ji1 xian4 chang3 de5 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3
cues.en: Even forensic examiner Xiao Gu, no stranger to zombie-attack scenes,

cues.zh: 眉头都拧成麻花
cues.pinyin: mei2 tou2 dou1 ning2 cheng2 ma2 hua1
cues.en: furrowed his brow into a knot.

cues.zh: 众人跟装马达一样迅速布置战场
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 gen1 zhuang1 ma3 da2 yi1 yang4 xun4 su4 bu4 zhi4 zhan4 chang3
cues.en: Everyone moved to set up the scene as fast as if they had motors installed.

cues.zh: 整个区域清的鼻炎还干净
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 qu1 yu4 qing1 de5 bi2 yan2 hai2 gan1 jing4
cues.en: The entire area was cleared out, spotless clean.

cues.zh: 三级防护服下的人人像米其林轮胎人
cues.pinyin: san1 ji2 fang2 hu4 fu2 xia4 de5 ren2 ren2 xiang4 mi3 qi2 lin2 lun2 tai1 ren2
cues.en: Everyone in their level-3 protective suits looked like the Michelin Man.

cues.zh: 通风管道也被技术小哥翻来覆去
cues.pinyin: tong1 feng1 guan3 dao4 ye3 bei4 ji4 shu4 xiao3 ge1 fan1 lai2 fu4 qu4
cues.en: The ventilation ducts were also gone over

cues.zh: 查了三遍
cues.pinyin: cha2 le5 san1 bian4
cues.en: and checked three times by the tech guy.

cues.zh: 桌脚全套上塑料软胶套
cues.pinyin: zhuo1 jiao3 quan2 tao4 shang4 su4 liao4 ruan3 jiao1 tao4
cues.en: The table legs were all fitted with soft plastic covers.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 这些小家伙在他眼里
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 xiao3 jia1 huo5 zai4 ta1 yan3 li3
cues.en: In his eyes, these little details

cues.zh: 就是行走的抛尸 G PS
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xing2 zou3 de5 pao1 shi1 G PS
cues.en: were basically a walking GPS pointing to the body-dumping case.

cues.zh: 修复士安琪拉则举着相机收集证据
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 shi4 an1 qi2 la1 ze2 ju3 zhe5 xiang4 ji1 shou1 ji2 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: Meanwhile, technician Angela held up her camera to collect evidence.

cues.zh: 就在这时警员老顾对着生化废品厂的记
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 jing3 yuan2 lao3 gu4 dui4 zhe5 sheng1 hua4 fei4 pin3 chang3 de5 ji4
cues.en: Just then, officer Lao Gu was staring at the biohazard waste plant's

cues.zh: 录系统直挠头
cues.pinyin: lu4 xi4 tong3 zhi2 nao2 tou2
cues.en: record system, scratching his head.

cues.zh: 那数据库乱的堪比打翻的拼图盒
cues.pinyin: na4 shu4 ju4 ku4 luan4 de5 kan1 bi3 da3 fan1 de5 pin1 tu2 he2
cues.en: That database was as chaotic as a spilled jigsaw puzzle box.

cues.zh: 本该分类的生化废料全混成毒垃圾大乱炖
cues.pinyin: ben3 gai1 fen1 lei4 de5 sheng1 hua4 fei4 liao4 quan2 hun4 cheng2 du2 la1 ji1 da4 luan4 dun4
cues.en: Waste that should've been sorted was all mixed into one toxic trash free-for-all.

cues.zh: 更觉得是本该锁进高危舱的死者
cues.pinyin: geng4 jue2 de5 shi4 ben3 gai1 suo3 jin4 gao1 wei1 cang1 de5 si3 zhe3
cues.en: What's more, the deceased — who should've been locked in a high-risk containment unit —

cues.zh: 竟跟兽医诊所的废品塞在同个密封袋
cues.pinyin: jing4 gen1 shou4 yi1 zhen3 suo3 de5 fei4 pin3 sai1 zai4 tong2 ge4 mi4 feng1 dai4
cues.en: had actually been stuffed into the same sealed bag as a vet clinic's waste.

cues.zh: 指纹被腐蚀的比被相机擦过的
cues.pinyin: zhi3 wen2 bei4 fu3 shi2 de5 bi3 bei4 xiang4 ji1 ca1 guo4 de5
cues.en: The fingerprints had been corroded away

cues.zh: 千笔字还干净
cues.pinyin: qian1 bi3 zi4 hai2 gan1 jing4
cues.en: more thoroughly than erased handwriting.

cues.zh: 谁知小谷突然发现死者上下颚的牙齿有
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 xiao3 gu3 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 si3 zhe3 shang4 xia4 e4 de5 ya2 chi3 you3
cues.en: Then Xiao Gu suddenly noticed the deceased's upper and lower jaw teeth had

cues.zh: 被殴打的痕迹
cues.pinyin: bei4 ou1 da3 de5 hen2 ji4
cues.en: marks of having been beaten.

cues.zh: 这哪是病发身亡
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na3 shi4 bing4 fa1 shen1 wang2
cues.en: This wasn't death from illness at all —

cues.zh: 分明是有人精心策划了一场骨头粉碎机
cues.pinyin: fen1 ming2 shi4 you3 ren2 jing1 xin1 ce4 hua4 le5 yi1 chang2 gu3 tou5 fen3 sui4 ji1
cues.en: clearly someone had carefully staged a bone-crushing

cues.zh: 事的死亡剧本
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5 si3 wang2 ju4 ben3
cues.en: death scenario.

cues.zh: 连身份线索都要碾成灰
cues.pinyin: lian2 shen1 fen4 xian4 suo3 dou1 yao4 nian3 cheng2 hui1
cues.en: even the clues to the victim's identity were meant to be ground to dust.

cues.zh: 运里边
cues.pinyin: yun4 li3 bian1
cues.en: In the midst of all this,

cues.zh: 安吉拉仿佛在于时间赛跑
cues.pinyin: an1 ji2 la1 fang3 fu2 zai4 yu2 shi2 jian1 sai4 pao3
cues.en: Angela seemed to be racing against time.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 劳拉这姑娘跟守着国家机密似的
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 zhe4 gu1 niang2 gen1 shou3 zhe5 guo2 jia1 ji1 mi4 shi4 de5
cues.en: This girl Laura was guarding it like a state secret.

cues.zh: 稿子没杀清钱连一万都摸不清她的敌
cues.pinyin: gao3 zi5 mei2 sha1 qing1 qian2 lian2 yi1 wan4 dou1 mo1 bu4 qing1 ta1 de5 di2
cues.en: No matter how they dug, they couldn't even pin down the basics about her.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: At the same time,

cues.zh: 安琪拉利用自己的黑客技术
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 li4 yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 hei1 ke4 ji4 shu4
cues.en: Angela used her hacking skills

cues.zh: 瞬间就给劳拉加密系统
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 jiu4 gei3 lao2 la1 jia1 mi4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: to instantly crack Laura's encryption system.

cues.zh: 来了技术猴衰
cues.pinyin: lai2 le5 ji4 shu4 hou2 shuai1
cues.en: She pulled off an awesomely skilled move,

cues.zh: 深藏的病毒突变文件夹里
cues.pinyin: shen1 cang2 de5 bing4 du2 tu1 bian4 wen2 jian4 jia1 li3
cues.en: diving into a deeply hidden folder of virus mutation files.

cues.zh: 劳拉采访病毒博士安娜的笔记
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 cai3 fang3 bing4 du2 bo2 shi4 an1 na4 de5 bi3 ji4
cues.en: Laura's notes from interviewing virus expert Dr. Anna

cues.zh: 正冒绿光
cues.pinyin: zheng4 mao4 lv4 guang1
cues.en: were glowing an eerie green on screen.

cues.zh: 这位安娜博士可了不得
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 an1 na4 bo2 shi4 ke3 liao3 bu4 de2
cues.en: This Dr. Anna was no ordinary figure.

cues.zh: 既是病毒变异界的炼金术士
cues.pinyin: ji4 shi4 bing4 du2 bian4 yi4 jie4 de5 lian4 jin1 shu4 shi4
cues.en: She was both an alchemist of the virus-mutation world

cues.zh: 又在传染病实验室挂着职
cues.pinyin: you4 zai4 chuan2 ran3 bing4 shi2 yan4 shi4 gua4 zhe5 zhi2
cues.en: and held a post at an infectious disease lab.

cues.zh: 活像恐怖电影里
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 kong3 bu4 dian4 ying3 li3
cues.en: Just like in a horror movie,

cues.zh: 披着白大褂的神秘单 PC
cues.pinyin: pi1 zhe5 bai2 da4 gua4 de5 shen2 mi4 dan1 PC
cues.en: a mysterious NPC in a white coat.

cues.zh: 当心理学家小甜甜对安娜进行审讯
cues.pinyin: dang1 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 dui4 an1 na4 jin4 xing2 shen3 xun4
cues.en: When psychologist Xiao Tiantian interrogated Anna,

cues.zh: 对方光明正大的表示
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 guang1 ming2 zheng4 da4 de5 biao3 shi4
cues.en: she stated plainly and openly

cues.zh: 只跟劳拉见过两面
cues.pinyin: zhi3 gen1 lao2 la1 jian4 guo4 liang3 mian4
cues.en: that she'd only met Laura twice.

cues.zh: 这姑娘老追问瘟疫末日剧本
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu1 niang2 lao3 zhui1 wen4 wen1 yi4 mo4 ri4 ju4 ben3
cues.en: This girl kept pressing her about some pandemic-doomsday script,

cues.zh: 说想给人类学分灭顶之灾使用说明术
cues.pinyin: shuo1 xiang3 gei3 ren2 lei4 xue2 fen1 mie4 ding3 zhi1 zai1 shi3 yong4 shuo1 ming2 shu4
cues.en: saying she wanted to write humanity an instruction manual for total annihilation.

cues.zh: 但当安娜被怀疑实验室是病毒窝点时
cues.pinyin: dan4 dang1 an1 na4 bei4 huai2 yi2 shi2 yan4 shi4 shi4 bing4 du2 wo1 dian3 shi2
cues.en: But when Anna's lab came under suspicion as the virus's source,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 她当场表演白大褂甩锅术
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 chang3 biao3 yan3 bai2 da4 gua4 shuai3 guo1 shu4
cues.en: she instantly pulled off a white-coat blame-shifting act,

cues.zh: 表示研究的病毒温顺的像小奶猫
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 yan2 jiu1 de5 bing4 du2 wen1 shun4 de5 xiang4 xiao3 nai3 mao1
cues.en: claiming the virus she studied was as docile as a kitten

cues.zh: 乙肝病毒都能在培养皿里大瞌睡
cues.pinyin: yi3 gan1 bing4 du2 dou1 neng2 zai4 pei2 yang3 min3 li3 da4 ke1 shui4
cues.en: and that even hepatitis B virus could nap peacefully in her petri dishes.

cues.zh: 绝对不会泄露
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bu2 hui4 xie4 lou4
cues.en: insisting it would never, ever leak.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 小谷确定病毒并不会在空气中传播
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 que4 ding4 bing4 du2 bing4 bu2 hui4 zai4 kong1 qi4 zhong1 chuan2 bo1
cues.en: Xiao Gu confirmed the virus wasn't airborne,

cues.zh: 瞬间让众人长呼一口气
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 rang4 zhong4 ren2 zhang3 hu1 yi4 kou3 qi4
cues.en: which let everyone breathe a huge sigh of relief.

cues.zh: 他们终于可以脱掉沉重的防护服
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhong1 yu2 ke3 yi3 tuo1 diao4 chen2 zhong4 de5 fang2 hu4 fu2
cues.en: They could finally take off their heavy protective suits.

cues.zh: 但博士却说这病毒现在是汗鸭子
cues.pinyin: dan4 bo2 shi4 que4 shuo1 zhe4 bing4 du2 xian4 zai4 shi4 han4 ya1 zi5
cues.en: But the doctor said the virus was just lying low for now.

cues.zh: 但劳拉死法跟被按加速见识的
cues.pinyin: dan4 lao2 la1 si3 fa3 gen1 bei4 an4 jia1 su4 jian4 shi2 de5
cues.en: Yet Laura's condition seemed to hit fast-forward,

cues.zh: 烂得越快越可能变异出尊气泵迪模式
cues.pinyin: lan4 de2 yue4 kuai4 yue4 ke3 neng2 bian4 yi4 chu1 zun1 qi4 beng4 di2 mo2 shi4
cues.en: the faster she decayed, the more likely the virus would mutate into some overpowered new form.

cues.zh: 刚才还像米其林轮胎人的众人
cues.pinyin: gang1 cai2 hai2 xiang4 mi3 qi2 lin2 lun2 tai1 ren2 de5 zhong4 ren2
cues.en: Everyone who, moments ago, looked like Michelin Men

cues.zh: 瞬间将成雕塑
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 jiang1 cheng2 diao1 su4
cues.en: would instantly turn into statues.

cues.zh: 小谷迅速提取劳拉体内的病毒准备
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 xun4 su4 ti2 qu3 lao2 la1 ti3 nei4 de5 bing4 du2 zhun3 bei4
cues.en: Xiao Gu quickly extracted the virus from inside Laura's body, preparing

cues.zh: 进行仔细研究
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 zi3 xi4 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: to study it carefully.

cues.zh: 然而就在准备将尸体密封时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 zhun3 bei4 jiang1 shi1 ti3 mi4 feng1 shi2
cues.en: But just as they were about to seal the body,

cues.zh: 下一秒
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: the very next second,

cues.zh: 夏洛克却突然受伤
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 ke4 que4 tu1 ran2 shou4 shang1
cues.en: Sherlock suddenly got hurt.

cues.zh: 空气瞬间冻成冰坨子
cues.pinyin: kong1 qi4 shun4 jian1 dong4 cheng2 bing1 tuo2 zi5
cues.en: The air instantly froze solid, like a block of ice.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 不看后悔壹辈子的神剧，惊心动魄疫情再次爆发，病毒女尸竟烂成豆腐脑。

cues.zh: 即便卡米尔再怎么不舍得
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 ka3 mi3 er3 zai4 zen3 me5 bu4 she3 de2
cues.en: No matter how reluctant Camille was,

cues.zh: 也只能同意
cues.pinyin: ye3 zhi3 neng2 tong2 yi4
cues.en: she had no choice but to agree.

cues.zh: 众人紧急改造临时隔离舱
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 jin3 ji2 gai3 zao4 lin2 shi2 ge2 li2 cang1
cues.en: Everyone scrambled to convert a makeshift isolation chamber.

cues.zh: 老布得知后
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 de2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After Lao Bu found out,

cues.zh: 撸着袖子要进去帮忙
cues.pinyin: lu1 zhe5 xiu4 zi5 yao4 jin4 qu4 bang1 mang2
cues.en: he rolled up his sleeves to go help,

cues.zh: 却被小谷义正言辞拒绝
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 xiao3 gu3 yi4 zheng4 yan2 ci2 ju4 jue2
cues.en: but was flatly refused by Xiao Gu,

cues.zh: 他认为现在最该干的
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 xian4 zai4 zui4 gai1 gan4 de5
cues.en: who believed the most urgent task right now

cues.zh: 是给这针头做基因测序
cues.pinyin: shi4 gei3 zhe4 zhen1 tou2 zuo4 ji1 yin1 ce4 xu4
cues.en: was to run gene sequencing on this needle

cues.zh: 揪出幕后黑手
cues.pinyin: jiu1 chu1 mu4 hou4 hei1 shou3
cues.en: to expose the mastermind behind it all.

cues.zh: 老布也表示
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 ye3 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Lao Bu also pointed out

cues.zh: 伊万内哥除了网购过一项螺蛳粉
cues.pinyin: yi1 wan4 nei4 ge1 chu2 le5 wang3 gou4 guo4 yi1 xiang4 luo2 si1 fen3
cues.en: that aside from once ordering snail noodles online,

cues.zh: 啥可疑操作都没有
cues.pinyin: sha2 ke3 yi2 cao1 zuo4 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: Ivanko hadn't done anything else suspicious.

cues.zh: 然而就在这时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just at that moment,

cues.zh: 死者的骨髓检测报告终于出结果
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 de5 gu3 sui3 jian3 ce4 bao4 gao4 zhong1 yu2 chu1 jie2 guo3
cues.en: the deceased's bone marrow test results finally came back,

cues.zh: 但情况却比预想的还要糟糕
cues.pinyin: dan4 qing2 kuang4 que4 bi3 yu4 xiang3 de5 hai2 yao4 zao1 gao1
cues.en: and the situation was worse than anyone expected.

cues.zh: 劳拉的巨噬细胞镜像被泼了墨汁般全黑
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 de5 ju4 shi4 xi4 bao1 jing4 xiang4 bei4 po1 le5 mo4 zhi1 ban1 quan2 hei1
cues.en: Laura's macrophage scans looked like they'd been splashed pitch-black with ink,

cues.zh: 关节滑液稠得能当胶水使
cues.pinyin: guan1 jie2 hua2 ye4 chou2 de2 neng2 dang1 jiao1 shui3 shi3
cues.en: and her joint fluid had thickened enough to use as glue.

cues.zh: 这画面瞬间让博士想到
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hua4 mian4 shun4 jian1 rang4 bo2 shi4 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: This scene instantly reminded the doctor of

cues.zh: 非洲内嘎拉的致命蚊子病毒
cues.pinyin: fei1 zhou1 nei4 ga1 la1 de5 zhi4 ming4 wen2 zi5 bing4 du2
cues.en: a deadly mosquito-borne virus from Africa.

cues.zh: 不过这毒株明显被开过挂
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 du2 zhu1 ming2 xian3 bei4 kai1 guo4 gua4
cues.en: But this strain had clearly been artificially juiced up,

cues.zh: 杀伤力跟踩了电门似的暴涨
cues.pinyin: sha1 shang1 li4 gen1 cai3 le5 dian4 men2 shi4 de5 bao4 zhang3
cues.en: its lethality surging as if someone had floored the gas pedal.

cues.zh: 疾控中心倒是囤了一亿多株兔子抗皮
cues.pinyin: ji2 kong4 zhong1 xin1 dao3 shi4 dun4 le5 yi1 yi4 duo1 zhu1 tu4 zi5 kang4 pi2
cues.en: The CDC, meanwhile, had over a hundred million doses of rabbit antibodies stockpiled.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 狠心妈妈竟然杀了自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: hen3 xin1 ma1 ma1 jing4 ran2 sha1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: How could a heartless mother kill her own child?

cues.zh: 她为何如此丧尽天良
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 he2 ru2 ci3 sang4 jin4 tian1 liang2
cues.en: Why was she so utterly without conscience?

cues.zh: 萧恩的医院接诊了一名特殊的孕妇小艾
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 yi1 yuan4 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi1 ming2 te4 shu1 de5 yun4 fu4 xiao3 ai4
cues.en: Shaun's hospital admitted a special pregnant patient, Xiao Ai.

cues.zh: 入院时她大出血胎心过缓
cues.pinyin: ru4 yuan4 shi2 ta1 da4 chu1 xue4 tai1 xin1 guo4 huan3
cues.en: When admitted, she was hemorrhaging heavily and the fetal heart rate was too slow.

cues.zh: 必须马上进行剖腹产
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 ma3 shang4 jin4 xing2 pou1 fu4 chan3
cues.en: She had to undergo an emergency C-section immediately.

cues.zh: 之所以说她特殊是因为陪同她
cues.pinyin: zhi1 suo3 yi3 shuo1 ta1 te4 shu1 shi4 yin1 wei4 pei2 tong2 ta1
cues.en: The reason she was special was because of who accompanied her

cues.zh: 来医院的并不
cues.pinyin: lai2 yi1 yuan4 de5 bing4 bu4
cues.en: to the hospital — it wasn't

cues.zh: 是小艾的丈夫
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiao3 ai4 de5 zhang4 fu1
cues.en: Xiao Ai's husband,

cues.zh: 而是一名狱警
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yi1 ming2 yu4 jing3
cues.en: but a prison guard.

cues.zh: 小艾因为谋杀了自己的第一个孩子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 yin1 wei4 mou2 sha1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 di4 yi2 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Xiao Ai had murdered her first child

cues.zh: 被判处终身监禁
cues.pinyin: bei4 pan4 chu3 zhong1 shen1 jian1 jin4
cues.en: and was sentenced to life in prison.

cues.zh: 手术室里大家还在议论这个深
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi4 li3 da4 jia1 hai2 zai4 yi4 lun4 zhe4 ge5 shen1
cues.en: In the operating room, everyone was still talking about this deeply

cues.zh: 悲无名的孕妇
cues.pinyin: bei1 wu2 ming2 de5 yun4 fu4
cues.en: sorrowful, notorious pregnant woman.

cues.zh: 朴医生说她调查过小艾的事情
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 ta1 diao4 cha2 guo4 xiao3 ai4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: Dr. Park said she had looked into Xiao Ai's case.

cues.zh: 她被指控用防冻剂毒害自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 zhi3 kong4 yong4 fang2 dong4 ji4 du2 hai4 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She had been accused of poisoning her own child with antifreeze.

cues.zh: 但是小艾并不认罪
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 ai4 bing4 bu4 ren4 zui4
cues.en: But Xiao Ai refused to plead guilty

cues.zh: 还在庭审前怀孕了
cues.pinyin: hai2 zai4 ting2 shen3 qian2 huai2 yun4 le5
cues.en: and became pregnant again before the trial.

cues.zh: 在她被判罪以后
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 bei4 pan4 zui4 yi3 hou4
cues.en: After she was convicted,

cues.zh: 家人和朋友全都离她而去
cues.pinyin: jia1 ren2 he2 peng2 you3 quan2 dou1 li2 ta1 er2 qu4
cues.en: her family and friends all abandoned her.

cues.zh: 也算是众叛亲离了
cues.pinyin: ye3 suan4 shi4 zhong4 pan4 qin1 li2 le5
cues.en: It was practically a case of everyone turning their back on her.

cues.zh: 朴医生却觉得
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 que4 jue2 de5
cues.en: Dr. Park, however, felt that

cues.zh: 小艾可能并不是想故意伤害孩子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 ke3 neng2 bing4 bu2 shi4 xiang3 gu4 yi4 shang1 hai4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Xiao Ai might not have intended to harm the child on purpose.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 有可能是患了产后抑郁
cues.pinyin: you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 huan4 le5 chan3 hou4 yi4 yu4
cues.en: She may have been suffering from postpartum depression.

cues.zh: 所以小艾也是受害者
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 ai4 ye3 shi4 shou4 hai4 zhe3
cues.en: So Xiao Ai was a victim too.

cues.zh: 她应该得到治疗而不是监禁
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying1 gai1 de2 dao4 zhi4 liao2 er2 bu2 shi4 jian1 jin4
cues.en: She should receive treatment, not imprisonment.

cues.zh: 可一旁站着的摩根不爱听了
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi1 pang2 zhan4 zhe5 de5 mo2 gen1 bu4 ai4 ting1 le5
cues.en: But Morgan, standing nearby, didn't want to hear it.

cues.zh: 杀人就是杀人
cues.pinyin: sha1 ren2 jiu4 shi4 sha1 ren2
cues.en: Killing is killing.

cues.zh: 别找借口开脱
cues.pinyin: bie2 zhao3 jie4 kou3 kai1 tuo1
cues.en: Don't make excuses to get out of it.

cues.zh: 好在几个医生都十分专业
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 dou1 shi2 fen1 zhuan1 ye4
cues.en: Luckily the doctors were all highly professional.

cues.zh: 就算聊天半嘴
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 liao2 tian1 ban4 zui3
cues.en: Even while chatting away

cues.zh: 也没耽误手底下干活利落
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 dan1 wu4 shou3 di3 xia4 gan4 huo2 li4 luo4
cues.en: it didn't slow down their work at all.

cues.zh: 很快小艾的剖腹产手术结束了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 xiao3 ai4 de5 pou1 fu4 chan3 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: Soon Xiao Ai's C-section was finished.

cues.zh: 小艾苏醒以后
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 su1 xing3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: After Xiao Ai woke up,

cues.zh: 希望可以看看孩子
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ke3 yi3 kan4 kan4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: she hoped to see her baby.

cues.zh: 可是两个医生都没同意
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 liang3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 dou1 mei2 tong2 yi4
cues.en: But neither doctor agreed.

cues.zh: 摩根害怕这个毒妇
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 hai4 pa4 zhe4 ge5 du2 fu4
cues.en: Morgan was afraid this 'poisoner'

cues.zh: 再害了自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: zai4 hai4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: would hurt her own child again.

cues.zh: 而朴医生则是觉得
cues.pinyin: er2 pu3 yi1 sheng1 ze2 shi4 jue2 de5
cues.en: while Dr. Park felt

cues.zh: 应该检查一下小艾
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4 xiao3 ai4
cues.en: they should check Xiao Ai

cues.zh: 是否有产后抑郁症
cues.pinyin: shi4 fou3 you3 chan3 hou4 yi4 yu4 zheng4
cues.en: for postpartum depression.

cues.zh: 朴医生和摩根
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 he2 mo2 gen1
cues.en: Dr. Park and Morgan

cues.zh: 给新生的宝宝做例行检查
cues.pinyin: gei3 xin1 sheng1 de5 bao3 bao3 zuo4 li4 xing2 jian3 cha2
cues.en: did a routine check on the newborn,

cues.zh: 却发现宝宝的肌肉张力很不好
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 bao3 bao3 de5 ji1 rou4 zhang1 li4 hen3 bu4 hao3
cues.en: and found the baby's muscle tone was very poor.

cues.zh: 是婴儿营养不良导致的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ying1 er2 ying2 yang3 bu4 liang2 dao3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: This was caused by infant malnutrition.

cues.zh: 朴医怀疑是因为婴儿肠梗阻
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 huai2 yi2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ying1 er2 chang2 geng3 zu3
cues.en: Dr. Park suspected it was due to infant intestinal obstruction,

cues.zh: 或者是小艾所在监狱的食堂伙食太差
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 xiao3 ai4 suo3 zai4 jian1 yu4 de5 shi2 tang2 huo3 shi2 tai4 cha4
cues.en: or maybe the food at the prison cafeteria where Xiao Ai was held was just too poor.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 小艾在监狱里看管那么严
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 zai4 jian1 yu4 li3 kan1 guan3 na4 me5 yan2
cues.en: Xiao Ai was so closely guarded in prison

cues.zh: 根本接触不到防冻剂
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 jie1 chu4 bu2 dao4 fang2 dong4 ji4
cues.en: that she couldn't possibly get hold of antifreeze.

cues.zh: 她去哪弄的防冻剂给宝宝喝呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 qu4 na3 nong4 de5 fang2 dong4 ji4 gei3 bao3 bao3 he1 ne5
cues.en: So where did she get the antifreeze to give the baby?

cues.zh: 萧恩的检测结果
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 jian3 ce4 jie2 guo3
cues.en: Shaun's test results

cues.zh: 几乎是给了朴医生当头一棒
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 shi4 gei3 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1 dang1 tou2 yi1 bang4
cues.en: hit Dr. Park like a bolt from the blue.

cues.zh: 婴儿的血液里
cues.pinyin: ying1 er2 de5 xue4 ye4 li3
cues.en: In the baby's blood,

cues.zh: 真的发现了防冻剂的痕迹
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 fa1 xian4 le5 fang2 dong4 ji4 de5 hen2 ji4
cues.en: traces of antifreeze were indeed found.

cues.zh: 但是小艾的血液里却干干净净
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 ai4 de5 xue4 ye4 li3 que4 gan1 gan1 jing4 jing4
cues.en: But Xiao Ai's blood was completely clean —

cues.zh: 一点异样都没有
cues.pinyin: yi4 dian3 yi4 yang4 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: not the slightest abnormality.

cues.zh: 朴医生希望是小艾身体原因
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 xi1 wang4 shi4 xiao3 ai4 shen1 ti3 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Dr. Park had hoped it was something in Xiao Ai's own body

cues.zh: 引发孩子中毒的幻想彻底破灭
cues.pinyin: yin3 fa1 hai2 zi5 zhong4 du2 de5 huan4 xiang3 che4 di3 po4 mie4
cues.en: that caused the poisoning, but that theory was now completely dashed.

cues.zh: 小艾不生产防冻剂
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 bu4 sheng1 chan3 fang2 dong4 ji4
cues.en: Xiao Ai didn't produce antifreeze herself —

cues.zh: 她只是防冻剂的搬运工
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 fang2 dong4 ji4 de5 ban1 yun4 gong1
cues.en: she was merely a carrier of the antifreeze.

cues.zh: 当朴医生把宝宝防冻剂中毒的消息
cues.pinyin: dang1 pu3 yi1 sheng1 ba3 bao3 bao3 fang2 dong4 ji4 zhong4 du2 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: When Dr. Park brought the news of the baby's antifreeze poisoning

cues.zh: 告诉小艾的时候
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 xiao3 ai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: to Xiao Ai,

cues.zh: 她脸上十分惊恐
cues.pinyin: ta1 lian3 shang4 shi2 fen1 jing1 kong3
cues.en: her face filled with terror.

cues.zh: 恳求医生救救孩子
cues.pinyin: ken3 qiu2 yi1 sheng1 jiu4 jiu4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She begged the doctors to save the child

cues.zh: 也希望他们不要把事情捅出去
cues.pinyin: ye3 xi1 wang4 ta1 men5 bu2 yao4 ba3 shi4 qing2 tong3 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and also hoped they wouldn't make the matter public.

cues.zh: 话还没说完
cues.pinyin: hua4 hai2 mei2 shuo1 wan2
cues.en: Before she could finish speaking,

cues.zh: 小艾突然痛苦地呻吟起来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 tu1 ran2 tong4 ku3 di4 shen1 yin2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Xiao Ai suddenly began groaning in pain.

cues.zh: 心率血压集体异常
cues.pinyin: xin1 lv4 xue4 ya1 ji2 ti3 yi4 chang2
cues.en: Her heart rate and blood pressure both went haywire.

cues.zh: 经过一番抢救
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yi1 fan1 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: After a round of emergency resuscitation,

cues.zh: 小艾的命保住了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 de5 ming4 bao3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Ai's life was saved.

cues.zh: 她告诉朴医生自己爱孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 zi4 ji3 ai4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She told Dr. Park that she loved her child,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 那丙酸对他来说就是致命毒药
cues.pinyin: na4 bing3 suan1 dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 zhi4 ming4 du2 yao4
cues.en: and that propionic acid was a deadly poison to him.

cues.zh: 有甲基丙二酸血症的人
cues.pinyin: you3 jia3 ji1 bing3 er4 suan1 xue4 zheng4 de5 ren2
cues.en: People with methylmalonic acidemia,

cues.zh: 由于身体里的基因突变
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 shen1 ti3 li3 de5 ji1 yin1 tu1 bian4
cues.en: because of a gene mutation in their bodies,

cues.zh: 使得他们体内的甲基丙二酸无法分解
cues.pinyin: shi3 de5 ta1 men5 ti3 nei4 de5 jia3 ji1 bing3 er4 suan1 wu2 fa3 fen1 jie3
cues.en: can't break down methylmalonic acid.

cues.zh: 这种酸积累多了就会产生酸中毒
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 suan1 ji1 lei3 duo1 le5 jiu4 hui4 chan3 sheng1 suan1 zhong4 du2
cues.en: When this acid builds up too much, it causes acidosis.

cues.zh: 而小艾母乳里的蛋白质会促进酸的产生
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 ai4 mu3 ru3 li3 de5 dan4 bai2 zhi4 hui4 cu4 jin4 suan1 de5 chan3 sheng1
cues.en: And the protein in Xiao Ai's breast milk promoted the production of that acid.

cues.zh: 孩子吃一口奶就等于喝了一口毒
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 chi1 yi1 kou3 nai3 jiu4 deng3 yu2 he1 le5 yi1 kou3 du2
cues.en: One mouthful of milk for the baby was like a mouthful of poison.

cues.zh: 这种病属于染色体遗传
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 bing4 shu3 yu2 ran3 se4 ti3 yi2 chuan2
cues.en: This disease is a chromosomal genetic disorder.

cues.zh: 小艾第一个被毒死的孩子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ai4 di4 yi2 ge4 bei4 du2 si3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Xiao Ai's first child, who was poisoned to death,

cues.zh: 应该也是死于丙酸中毒
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 ye3 shi4 si3 yu2 bing3 suan1 zhong4 du2
cues.en: must have also died from propionic acid poisoning.

cues.zh: 所以小艾是无辜的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 ai4 shi4 wu2 gu1 de5
cues.en: So Xiao Ai was innocent,

cues.zh: 孩子也是无辜的
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 ye3 shi4 wu2 gu1 de5
cues.en: and the child was innocent too.

cues.zh: 都怪他们不做好产前检查
cues.pinyin: dou1 guai4 ta1 men5 bu4 zuo4 hao3 chan3 qian2 jian3 cha2
cues.en: It was all because no one had done proper prenatal screening.

cues.zh: 终于真相大白了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zhen1 xiang4 da4 bai2 le5
cues.en: Finally, the truth came to light.

cues.zh: 无辜的小艾估计很快就能无罪释放
cues.pinyin: wu2 gu1 de5 xiao3 ai4 gu1 ji4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 neng2 wu2 zui4 shi4 fang4
cues.en: The innocent Xiao Ai would likely be acquitted and released soon.

cues.zh: 摩根向小艾道了歉
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 xiang4 xiao3 ai4 dao4 le5 qian4
cues.en: Morgan apologized to Xiao Ai

cues.zh: 因为他的偏见
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 pian1 jian4
cues.en: because her prejudice

cues.zh: 差点就耽误了小宝宝的救治
cues.pinyin: cha4 dian3 jiu4 dan1 wu4 le5 xiao3 bao3 bao3 de5 jiu4 zhi4
cues.en: had nearly delayed the baby's treatment

cues.zh: 也差点让小艾错过了成员得雪的好机会
cues.pinyin: ye3 cha4 dian3 rang4 xiao3 ai4 cuo4 guo4 le5 cheng2 yuan2 de2 xue3 de5 hao3 ji1 hui4
cues.en: and nearly cost Xiao Ai the chance to finally clear her name.

cues.zh: 不过小爱并不在意摩根的态度
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 ai4 bing4 bu4 zai4 yi4 mo2 gen1 de5 tai4 du4
cues.en: But Xiao Ai didn't care about Morgan's attitude —

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 能抱到自己的宝宝才是他梦寐一求的
cues.pinyin: neng2 bao4 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 bao3 bao3 cai2 shi4 ta1 meng4 mei4 yi1 qiu2 de5
cues.en: being able to hold her own baby was all she had ever dreamed of.

cues.zh: 这边刚解决了一个妈妈的无助
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 gang1 jie3 jue2 le5 yi2 ge4 ma1 ma1 de5 wu2 zhu4
cues.en: Just as one mother's helplessness was resolved here,

cues.zh: 那边又来了一个跑步冠军阿玲
cues.pinyin: na4 bian1 you4 lai2 le5 yi2 ge4 pao3 bu4 guan4 jun1 a1 ling2
cues.en: another case arrived: a champion runner named Aling.

cues.zh: 她参加了学校的田径比赛
cues.pinyin: ta1 can1 jia1 le5 xue2 xiao4 de5 tian2 jing4 bi3 sai4
cues.en: She had taken part in her school's track meet,

cues.zh: 以后就投影恶心
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 jiu4 tou2 ying3 e3 xin1
cues.en: and afterward felt dizzy and nauseous.

cues.zh: 做了检查暂时也没有发现有什么问题
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 jian3 cha2 zan4 shi2 ye3 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: An exam found no problems for the time being.

cues.zh: 阿玲也没当回事
cues.pinyin: a1 ling2 ye3 mei2 dang1 hui2 shi4
cues.en: Aling didn't think much of it either,

cues.zh: 觉得自己顶多也就是中暑脱水罢了
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 ding3 duo1 ye3 jiu4 shi4 zhong4 shu3 tuo1 shui3 ba4 le5
cues.en: figuring it was at most heatstroke and dehydration.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯领着阿玲
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 ling3 zhe5 a1 ling2
cues.en: Andrews led Aling

cues.zh: 在一个高级的仪器前站定
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 gao1 ji2 de5 yi2 qi4 qian2 zhan4 ding4
cues.en: to stand in front of an advanced piece of equipment.

cues.zh: 据说这个仪器
cues.pinyin: ju4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 yi2 qi4
cues.en: Supposedly, this machine

cues.zh: 能把你今天早晨偷吃的半块巧克力
cues.pinyin: neng2 ba3 ni3 jin1 tian1 zao3 chen2 tou1 chi1 de5 ban4 kuai4 qiao3 ke4 li4
cues.en: could even find the half a chocolate bar

cues.zh: 都能找出来
cues.pinyin: dou1 neng2 zhao3 chu1 lai2
cues.en: you secretly ate this morning.

cues.zh: 检查的结果证明阿玲十分健康
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 de5 jie2 guo3 zheng4 ming2 a1 ling2 shi2 fen1 jian4 kang1
cues.en: The test results showed Aling was perfectly healthy.

cues.zh: 阿琳正高清的想说点什么
cues.pinyin: a1 lin2 zheng4 gao1 qing1 de5 xiang3 shuo1 dian3 shen2 me5
cues.en: Aling was just happily about to say something

cues.zh: 阿玲正高兴地想说点什么
cues.pinyin: a1 ling2 zheng4 gao1 xing4 di4 xiang3 shuo1 dian3 shen2 me5
cues.en: when she suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood.

cues.zh: 医生们急坏了
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ji2 huai4 le5
cues.en: The doctors were alarmed,

cues.zh: 赶紧清理阿琳的呼吸道
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 qing1 li3 a1 lin2 de5 hu1 xi1 dao4
cues.en: and rushed to clear Aling's airway.

cues.zh: 阿琳醒了过来
cues.pinyin: a1 lin2 xing3 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Aling woke up again.

cues.zh: 这次 CT 检查结果是她的肺部有损伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 CT jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 shi4 ta1 de5 fei4 bu4 you3 sun3 shang1
cues.en: This time the CT scan showed damage to her lungs.

cues.zh: 具体情况要送去活检才能知道
cues.pinyin: ju4 ti3 qing2 kuang4 yao4 song4 qu4 huo2 jian3 cai2 neng2 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: The exact cause could only be known through a biopsy.

cues.zh: 奥斯玛医生让阿琳想一想家里人有没
cues.pinyin: ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 rang4 a1 lin2 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 jia1 li3 ren2 you3 mei2
cues.en: Dr. Osma had Aling think about whether anyone in her family

cues.zh: 有类似的病症
cues.pinyin: you3 lei4 si4 de5 bing4 zheng4
cues.en: had similar symptoms.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 母亲竟杀掉了亲生孩子！要不是天才医生肖恩，这位母亲怕要被冤枉一辈子了！【良医第五季02】

cues.zh: 黑神在一边不停地祈祷
cues.pinyin: hei1 shen2 zai4 yi1 bian1 bu4 ting2 di4 qi2 dao3
cues.en: Hei Shen kept praying off to the side,

cues.zh: 那唧唧叨叨的声音搅乱了阿琳
cues.pinyin: na4 ji1 ji1 dao1 dao1 de5 sheng1 yin1 jiao3 luan4 le5 a1 lin2
cues.en: and the nagging murmuring disturbed Aling's

cues.zh: 本就脆弱的心
cues.pinyin: ben3 jiu4 cui4 ruo4 de5 xin1
cues.en: already fragile heart.

cues.zh: 阿琳一生气就把黑神轰走了
cues.pinyin: a1 lin2 yi1 sheng1 qi4 jiu4 ba3 hei1 shen2 hong1 zou3 le5
cues.en: Annoyed, Aling drove Hei Shen away.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯跟阿琳介绍他的治疗方案
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 gen1 a1 lin2 jie4 shao4 ta1 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: Andrews explained his treatment plan to Aling.

cues.zh: 阿琳有点抗拒治疗
cues.pinyin: a1 lin2 you3 dian3 kang4 ju4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: Aling was a bit resistant to treatment —

cues.zh: 既然早死晚死都是死
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 zao3 si3 wan3 si3 dou1 shi4 si3
cues.en: since dying sooner or later was still dying,

cues.zh: 为什么要苟延残喘
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 gou3 yan2 can2 chuan3
cues.en: why bother clinging to a miserable existence?

cues.zh: 这时候奥斯玛走进来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 ao4 si1 ma3 zou3 jin4 lai2
cues.en: At this point, Dr. Osma walked in

cues.zh: 提出了一种全新的治疗理念
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 zhong3 quan2 xin1 de5 zhi4 liao2 li3 nian4
cues.en: and proposed a brand-new treatment concept:

cues.zh: 国务城替细胞治疗法
cues.pinyin: guo2 wu4 cheng2 ti4 xi4 bao1 zhi4 liao2 fa3
cues.en: engineered T-cell therapy.

cues.zh: 这种方法可以训练人类的免疫细胞
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 fang1 fa3 ke3 yi3 xun4 lian4 ren2 lei4 de5 mian3 yi4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: This method can train a person's immune cells

cues.zh: 国务城替细胞治疗法
cues.pinyin: guo2 wu4 cheng2 ti4 xi4 bao1 zhi4 liao2 fa3
cues.en: to automatically fight cancer,

cues.zh: 让患者的身体最终达到自愈
cues.pinyin: rang4 huan4 zhe3 de5 shen1 ti3 zui4 zhong1 da2 dao4 zi4 yu4
cues.en: letting the patient's body eventually heal itself.

cues.zh: 这种治疗方法让阿琳眼前一亮
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 zhi4 liao2 fang1 fa3 rang4 a1 lin2 yan3 qian2 yi1 liang4
cues.en: This treatment made Aling's eyes light up,

cues.zh: 可安德鲁斯并不赞成使用这种治疗手段
cues.pinyin: ke3 an1 de2 lu3 si1 bing4 bu4 zan4 cheng2 shi3 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 zhi4 liao2 shou3 duan4
cues.en: but Andrews did not approve of using this treatment.

cues.zh: 他直接跟奥斯玛说
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi2 jie1 gen1 ao4 si1 ma3 shuo1
cues.en: He said to Dr. Osma directly,

cues.zh: 这个病人你不要跟了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 ren2 ni3 bu2 yao4 gen1 le5
cues.en: 'You shouldn't take this patient's case.'

cues.zh: 那种工程 T 细胞治疗法药间局都没有批准
cues.pinyin: na4 zhong3 gong1 cheng2 T xi4 bao1 zhi4 liao2 fa3 yao4 jian1 ju2 dou1 mei2 you3 pi1 zhun3
cues.en: That kind of engineered T-cell therapy hasn't even been approved by the drug administration.

cues.zh: 我们在这里私自使用很可能要被处分的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 si1 zi4 shi3 yong4 hen3 ke3 neng2 yao4 bei4 chu3 fen4 de5
cues.en: If we use it here without authorization, we could well be disciplined.

cues.zh: 更何况这种治疗方法仅仅止步于实验室
cues.pinyin: geng4 he2 kuang4 zhe4 zhong3 zhi4 liao2 fang1 fa3 jin3 jin3 zhi3 bu4 yu2 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: Not to mention this treatment is still stuck at the lab stage —

cues.zh: 要么很小
cues.pinyin: yao4 me5 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: the odds of success are slim at best.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 留守武汉的那对跨国夫妻，2年来过得怎么样 The Couple who Stayed in Wuhan, How was Their Life in the P

cues.zh: 我出生在汉口有武汉女生刚的姻缘
cues.pinyin: wo3 chu1 sheng1 zai4 han4 kou3 you3 wu3 han4 nv3 sheng1 gang1 de5 yin1 yuan2
cues.en: I was born in Hankou, and have an inseparable bond with Wuhan.

cues.zh: Fred 就是法国人很爱吐槽
cues.pinyin: Fred jiu4 shi4 fa3 guo2 ren2 hen3 ai4 tu3 cao2
cues.en: Fred is French, and he loves to tease and joke around.

cues.zh: 他的中文名叫福福
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhong1 wen2 ming2 jiao4 fu2 fu2
cues.en: His Chinese name is Fufu.

cues.zh: 在法语里是很可爱的形容
cues.pinyin: zai4 fa3 yu3 li3 shi4 hen3 ke3 ai4 de5 xing2 rong2
cues.en: In French it's a cute way to describe someone.

cues.zh: cra zy crazy 的意思
cues.pinyin: cra zy crazy de5 yi4 si5
cues.en: It means 'crazy crazy.'

cues.zh: 我曾经写了个福字给他
cues.pinyin: wo3 ceng2 jing1 xie3 le5 ge4 fu2 zi4 gei3 ta1
cues.en: I once wrote the character for 'fortune' (fu) for him.

cues.zh: 他裱起来了
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: He had it framed.

cues.zh: 有孩子后
cues.pinyin: you3 hai2 zi5 hou4
cues.en: After we had kids,

cues.zh: 我们把好多艺术品转移到了工作室
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 hao3 duo1 yi4 shu4 pin3 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 le5 gong1 zuo4 shi4
cues.en: we moved a lot of the artwork to the studio,

cues.zh: 留给他更多的空间去玩耍
cues.pinyin: liu2 gei3 ta1 geng4 duo1 de5 kong1 jian1 qu4 wan2 shua3
cues.en: leaving him more space to play.

cues.zh: 我们的家靠近黎黄陂路
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 jia1 kao4 jin4 li2 huang2 pi2 lu4
cues.en: Our home is near Li Huangpi Road.

cues.zh: 在 Fred dy 眼里那是武汉最美的一条街
cues.pinyin: zai4 Fred dy yan3 li3 na4 shi4 wu3 han4 zui4 mei3 de5 yi1 tiao2 jie1
cues.en: In Freddy's eyes, that's the most beautiful street in Wuhan.

cues.zh: 步行区域多车少
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing2 qu1 yu4 duo1 che1 shao3
cues.en: It's a pedestrian area with few cars.

cues.zh: 有树有花空气也好
cues.pinyin: you3 shu4 you3 hua1 kong1 qi4 ye3 hao3
cues.en: There are trees, flowers, and the air is good too.

cues.zh: 每天的生活安排得挺满的
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 de5 sheng1 huo2 an1 pai2 de2 ting3 man3 de5
cues.en: Our daily schedule is pretty packed.

cues.zh: 早起送小朋友上幼儿园
cues.pinyin: zao3 qi3 song4 xiao3 peng2 you3 shang4 you4 er2 yuan2
cues.en: We get up early to take the kids to kindergarten,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 留守武汉的那对跨国夫妻，2年来过得怎么样 The Couple who Stayed in Wuhan, How was Their Life in the P

cues.zh: 然后正式开启工作模式
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zheng4 shi4 kai1 qi3 gong1 zuo4 mo2 shi4
cues.en: then officially switch into work mode.

cues.zh: 五年前我们在这里开了一家咖啡馆
cues.pinyin: wu3 nian2 qian2 wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 kai1 le5 yi1 jia1 ka1 fei1 guan3
cues.en: Five years ago we opened a café here.

cues.zh: 后来做了工作室
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zuo4 le5 gong1 zuo4 shi4
cues.en: Later it became a studio.

cues.zh: 我做音乐
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 yin1 yue4
cues.en: I make music.

cues.zh: 他做服装和设计
cues.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 fu2 zhuang1 he2 she4 ji4
cues.en: He does clothing and design.

cues.zh: 在周末
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhou1 mo4
cues.en: On weekends,

cues.zh: 我会在工作室给学生上钢琴课
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 zai4 gong1 zuo4 shi4 gei3 xue2 sheng1 shang4 gang1 qin2 ke4
cues.en: I give piano lessons to students at the studio.

cues.zh: 这段音乐的时光
cues.pinyin: zhe4 duan4 yin1 yue4 de5 shi2 guang1
cues.en: This time spent on music

cues.zh: 也算是我休息的时间
cues.pinyin: ye3 suan4 shi4 wo3 xiu1 xi1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: is also kind of my time to rest.

cues.zh: 我们不知道明天会怎么样
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ming2 tian1 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: We don't know what tomorrow will bring,

cues.zh: 那就趁着今天好好工作
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 chen4 zhe5 jin1 tian1 hao3 hao3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: so we work hard while we have today,

cues.zh: 尽量多留一点时间给小孩给家人
cues.pinyin: jin3 liang4 duo1 liu2 yi4 dian3 shi2 jian1 gei3 xiao3 hai2 gei3 jia1 ren2
cues.en: and try to save as much time as we can for the kids and family.

cues.zh: 李太太陈太太在王太太家打麻将
cues.pinyin: li3 tai4 tai4 chen2 tai4 tai4 zai4 wang2 tai4 tai4 jia1 da3 ma2 jiang1
cues.en: Mrs. Li and Mrs. Chen are playing mahjong at Mrs. Wang's house.

cues.zh: 王太太的小狗小白躲在桌子下
cues.pinyin: wang2 tai4 tai4 de5 xiao3 gou3 xiao3 bai2 duo3 zai4 zhuo1 zi5 xia4
cues.en: Mrs. Wang's puppy Xiaobai is hiding under the table.

cues.zh: 这时李太太忍不住放了一个屁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 li3 tai4 tai4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 fang4 le5 yi2 ge4 pi4
cues.en: Just then, Mrs. Li couldn't hold it in and let out a fart.

cues.zh: 王太太喊
cues.pinyin: wang2 tai4 tai4 han3
cues.en: Mrs. Wang shouted,

cues.zh: 小白
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2
cues.en: "Xiaobai!"

cues.zh: 李太太心想
cues.pinyin: li3 tai4 tai4 xin1 xiang3
cues.en: Mrs. Li thought to herself,

cues.zh: 还好还好
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 hai2 hao3
cues.en: "Phew, that's a relief."

cues.zh: 别人以为是小白放的屁
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 yi3 wei2 shi4 xiao3 bai2 fang4 de5 pi4
cues.en: Everyone thought it was Xiaobai who farted.

cues.zh: 接着李太太又放屁了
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 li3 tai4 tai4 you4 fang4 pi4 le5
cues.en: Then Mrs. Li farted again.

cues.zh: 王太太又喊
cues.pinyin: wang2 tai4 tai4 you4 han3
cues.en: Mrs. Wang shouted again,

cues.zh: 小白你再不从桌子底下出来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 ni3 zai4 bu4 cong2 zhuo1 zi5 di3 xia4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: "Xiaobai, if you don't come out from under the table right now,

cues.zh: 不怕被李太太的屁熏死吗
cues.pinyin: bu4 pa4 bei4 li3 tai4 tai4 de5 pi4 xun1 si3 ma5
cues.en: aren't you afraid of being smoked to death by Mrs. Li's farts?"

items.title_zh: 笑话34｜虾子作弊｜乖~真乖｜7秒记忆力｜忘了拿伞｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 有一天大鱼对小鱼说
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 da4 yu2 dui4 xiao3 yu2 shuo1
cues.en: One day a big fish said to a little fish,

cues.zh: 你知道鱼的记忆力只有 7 秒吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 yu2 de5 ji4 yi4 li4 zhi3 you3 7 miao3 ma5
cues.en: "Did you know a fish's memory only lasts 7 seconds?"

cues.zh: 是吗真的假的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ma5 zhen1 de5 jia3 de5
cues.en: "Really? Is that true?"

cues.zh: 什么真的假的
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 zhen1 de5 jia3 de5
cues.en: "What? True or false?"

cues.zh: 你不是说鱼的记忆力只有 7 秒
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu2 shi4 shuo1 yu2 de5 ji4 yi4 li4 zhi3 you3 7 miao3
cues.en: "Didn't you just say a fish's memory only lasts 7 seconds?"

cues.zh: 我有说吗真的假的
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 shuo1 ma5 zhen1 de5 jia3 de5
cues.en: "Did I say that? Really?"

cues.zh: 什么真的假的
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 zhen1 de5 jia3 de5
cues.en: "What? Really?"

cues.zh: 大大我问你喔
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Hey, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 小明写给他的女朋友 9 封信
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 xie3 gei3 ta1 de5 nv3 peng2 you3 9 feng1 xin4
cues.en: "Xiaoming wrote 9 letters to his girlfriend."

cues.zh: 为什么他的女朋友只收到一封信呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ta1 de5 nv3 peng2 you3 zhi3 shou1 dao4 yi1 feng1 xin4 ne5
cues.en: "Why did his girlfriend only receive one letter?"

cues.zh: 简单他有 9 个女朋友一人一封啊
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 ta1 you3 9 ge4 nv3 peng2 you3 yi1 ren2 yi1 feng1 a5
cues.en: "Simple—he has 9 girlfriends, one letter each."

cues.zh: 为什么你这么清楚啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ni3 zhe4 me5 qing1 chu3 a5
cues.en: "Why do you know that so well?"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话34｜虾子作弊｜乖~真乖｜7秒记忆力｜忘了拿伞｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 小明机车没油
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ji1 che1 mei2 you2
cues.en: Xiaoming's scooter was out of gas,

cues.zh: 去加油站加油
cues.pinyin: qu4 jia1 you2 zhan4 jia1 you2
cues.en: so he went to a gas station to fill up.

cues.zh: 遇到了新进的员工
cues.pinyin: yu4 dao4 le5 xin1 jin4 de5 yuan2 gong1
cues.en: He ran into a newly hired employee.
"98 octane, fill it up to $100."

cues.zh: 辰辰
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2
cues.en: "Chen Chen,"

cues.zh: 先有你还是先有爸爸
cues.pinyin: xian1 you3 ni3 hai2 shi4 xian1 you3 ba4 ba4
cues.en: "did you come first, or did Dad?"

cues.zh: 当然先有我了
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 xian1 you3 wo3 le5
cues.en: "Of course I came first."

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为妈妈
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: "Because of Mom."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话34｜虾子作弊｜乖~真乖｜7秒记忆力｜忘了拿伞｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 一天小明在搭公车的时候
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 zai4 da1 gong1 che1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: One day while Xiaoming was riding the bus,

cues.zh: 发现一位很漂亮的小姐
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 yi1 wei4 hen3 piao4 liang4 de5 xiao3 jie3
cues.en: he noticed a very pretty young woman.

cues.zh: 在下公车的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 xia4 gong1 che1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When she got off the bus,

cues.zh: 忘了拿自己的雨伞
cues.pinyin: wang4 le5 na2 zi4 ji3 de5 yu3 san3
cues.en: she forgot to take her own umbrella.

cues.zh: 于是小明追了出去
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 ming2 zhui1 le5 chu1 qu4
cues.en: So Xiaoming ran after her.

cues.zh: 欸小姐
cues.pinyin: ai1 xiao3 jie3
cues.en: "Hey, miss!"

cues.zh: 你的雨伞放在公车上忘记拿了
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 yu3 san3 fang4 zai4 gong1 che1 shang4 wang4 ji4 na2 le5
cues.en: "You left your umbrella on the bus."

cues.zh: 啊小哥你真的太贴心了
cues.pinyin: a5 xiao3 ge1 ni3 zhen1 de5 tai4 tie1 xin1 le5
cues.en: "Oh, you're so thoughtful!"

cues.zh: 谢谢你
cues.pinyin: xie4 xie4 ni3
cues.en: "Thank you."

cues.zh: 没有啦这是我的雨伞
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 la5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 de5 yu3 san3
cues.en: "No, no—this is actually my umbrella."

cues.zh: 你的在公车上忘记拿了
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 zai4 gong1 che1 shang4 wang4 ji4 na2 le5
cues.en: "Yours is still on the bus, you forgot it."

cues.zh: 公车已经开走了
cues.pinyin: gong1 che1 yi3 jing1 kai1 zou3 le5
cues.en: "The bus has already left."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话34｜虾子作弊｜乖~真乖｜7秒记忆力｜忘了拿伞｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 六根火柴棒拼成了两个三角形
cues.pinyin: liu4 gen1 huo3 chai2 bang4 pin1 cheng2 le5 liang3 ge4 san1 jiao3 xing2
cues.en: Six matchsticks form two triangles.

cues.zh: 你能移动一根火柴棒
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 yi2 dong4 yi1 gen1 huo3 chai2 bang4
cues.en: Can you move just one matchstick

cues.zh: 让它们变成四个三角形吗
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 men5 bian4 cheng2 si4 ge4 san1 jiao3 xing2 ma5
cues.en: to turn them into four triangles?

cues.zh: 知道答案的可以在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 de5 ke3 yi3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: If you know the answer, leave a comment below to tell everyone.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to the last episode is here.

cues.zh: 一个苹果等于五
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ping2 guo3 deng3 yu2 wu3
cues.en: One apple equals 5.

cues.zh: 一个西瓜
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xi1 gua1
cues.en: One watermelon

cues.zh: 等于 9
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 9
cues.en: equals 9.

cues.zh: 一根香蕉等于 1
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1 xiang1 jiao1 deng3 yu2 1
cues.en: One banana equals 1.

cues.zh: 所以一个苹果加一个西瓜
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi2 ge4 ping2 guo3 jia1 yi2 ge4 xi1 gua1
cues.en: So one apple plus one watermelon

cues.zh: 加一根香蕉就等于 15
cues.pinyin: jia1 yi1 gen1 xiang1 jiao1 jiu4 deng3 yu2 15
cues.en: plus one banana equals 15.

cues.zh: 你答对了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 da2 dui4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you get it right?

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 两年前爆红的乐队，出新歌了：别让世俗淹没激情

cues.zh: 啦啦啦啦你的细腻
cues.pinyin: la5 la5 la5 la5 ni3 de5 xi4 ni4
cues.en: La la la la, your delicate grace

cues.zh: 夏夜里的繁星是你的眼睛
cues.pinyin: xia4 ye4 li3 de5 fan2 xing1 shi4 ni3 de5 yan3 jing1
cues.en: The stars of summer nights are your eyes

cues.zh: 八月里的娇羊是你的外皮爱上你毫不
cues.pinyin: ba1 yue4 li3 de5 jiao1 yang2 shi4 ni3 de5 wai4 pi2 ai4 shang4 ni3 hao2 bu4
cues.en: The scorching August sun is your skin — I fell for you without a moment's hesitation

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 两年前爆红的乐队，出新歌了：别让世俗淹没激情

cues.zh: 你的热烈冬天的热烈
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 re4 lie4 dong1 tian1 de5 re4 lie4
cues.en: Your passion, winter's passion

cues.zh: 这里的白雪是你的成绩
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 bai2 xue3 shi4 ni3 de5 cheng2 ji4
cues.en: The white snow here is your grace

cues.zh: 十二月的寒风是你的脾气
cues.pinyin: shi2 er4 yue4 de5 han2 feng1 shi4 ni3 de5 pi2 qi4
cues.en: December's cold wind is your temper

cues.zh: 天啊我已爱上你华豪无犹豫
cues.pinyin: tian1 a5 wo3 yi3 ai4 shang4 ni3 hua2 hao2 wu2 you2 yu4
cues.en: Oh my, I've already fallen for you, without any hesitation

cues.zh: 路上有我一直陪伴着你
cues.pinyin: lu4 shang4 you3 wo3 yi4 zhi2 pei2 ban4 zhe5 ni3
cues.en: Along the way, I'll always be there with you

cues.zh: 终于说爱风与同情滚滚相见
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 shuo1 ai4 feng1 yu3 tong2 qing2 gun3 gun3 xiang1 jian4
cues.en: Finally confessing our love, braving wind and rain, rolling onward together

cues.zh: 四季相伴年复一年从未改变
cues.pinyin: si4 ji4 xiang1 ban4 nian2 fu4 yi1 nian2 cong2 wei4 gai3 bian4
cues.en: Through all four seasons together, year after year, never changing

cues.zh: 从一所爱风雨同行
cues.pinyin: cong2 yi1 suo3 ai4 feng1 yu3 tong2 hang2
cues.en: From then on, in love, weathering storms side by side

cues.zh: 滚滚向前
cues.pinyin: gun3 gun3 xiang4 qian2
cues.en: Rolling ever forward

cues.zh: 明年从未干净
cues.pinyin: ming2 nian2 cong2 wei4 gan1 jing4
cues.en: Next year will never be interrupted

cues.zh: 今年瓦关联盟可以越办越大
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 wa3 guan1 lian2 meng2 ke3 yi3 yue4 ban4 yue4 da4
cues.en: This year, the Waguan Alliance can grow even bigger

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 两年前爆红的乐队，出新歌了：别让世俗淹没激情

cues.zh: 有更多的人可以和我们一起
cues.pinyin: you3 geng4 duo1 de5 ren2 ke3 yi3 he2 wo3 men5 yi4 qi3
cues.en: More people can join us

cues.zh: 去享受瓦关带来的美好生活
cues.pinyin: qu4 xiang3 shou4 wa3 guan1 dai4 lai2 de5 mei3 hao3 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: And enjoy the wonderful life that Waguan brings

cues.zh: 希望新的一年
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 xin1 de5 yi1 nian2
cues.en: I hope that in the new year

cues.zh: 我们可以有更多的机会
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 you3 geng4 duo1 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: We can have more opportunities

cues.zh: 带上家人带上朋友一起
cues.pinyin: dai4 shang4 jia1 ren2 dai4 shang4 peng2 you3 yi4 qi3
cues.en: To bring our family and friends along

cues.zh: 去享受我们的生活
cues.pinyin: qu4 xiang3 shou4 wo3 men5 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: To enjoy our lives

cues.zh: 亲近大自然
cues.pinyin: qin1 jin4 da4 zi4 ran2
cues.en: Get closer to nature

cues.zh: 不管是学习生活
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 shi4 xue2 xi2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: Whether in study or daily life

cues.zh: 节假日旅行
cues.pinyin: jie2 jia4 ri4 lv3 xing2
cues.en: Holiday travels

cues.zh: 它一直都在我们身边
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 dou1 zai4 wo3 men5 shen1 bian1
cues.en: It's always been by our side

cues.zh: 我希望明年
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 ming2 nian2
cues.en: I hope that next year

cues.zh: 能够有越来越多的朋友们
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 you3 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1 de5 peng2 you3 men5
cues.en: There will be more and more friends

cues.zh: 在瓦关联盟相遇相知
cues.pinyin: zai4 wa3 guan1 lian2 meng2 xiang1 yu4 xiang1 zhi1
cues.en: Who meet and get to know each other in the Waguan Alliance

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 不办婚礼、工作裸辞……现在的年轻人真的很“敢”

cues.zh: 人生第一台后驱车到底该怎么开
cues.pinyin: ren2 sheng1 di4 yi1 tai2 hou4 qu1 che1 dao4 di3 gai1 zen3 me5 kai1
cues.en: How exactly should you drive your first rear-wheel-drive car in life?

cues.zh: 始呢别想太多
cues.pinyin: shi3 ne5 bie2 xiang3 tai4 duo1
cues.en: At the start, don't overthink it.

cues.zh: 开起来就行走起来就行
cues.pinyin: kai1 qi3 lai2 jiu4 xing2 zou3 qi3 lai2 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: Just get it going — once it's moving, you're fine.

cues.zh: 开出去就成成里成气成
cues.pinyin: kai1 chu1 qu4 jiu4 cheng2 cheng2 li3 cheng2 qi4 cheng2
cues.en: Drive it out and you're all set.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 这个男人为了减肥差点连命都没了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 wei2 le5 jian3 fei2 cha4 dian3 lian2 ming4 dou1 mei2 le5
cues.en: This man nearly lost his life trying to lose weight.

cues.zh: 他叫小帅是个运动员
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiao4 xiao3 shuai4 shi4 ge4 yun4 dong4 yuan2
cues.en: His name is Xiao Shuai, and he's an athlete.

cues.zh: 最近一直在为比赛训练
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 yi4 zhi2 zai4 wei4 bi3 sai4 xun4 lian4
cues.en: He's been training for a competition recently.

cues.zh: 但是训练时常常感到膝盖酸痛
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xun4 lian4 shi2 chang2 chang2 gan3 dao4 xi1 gai4 suan1 tong4
cues.en: But during training he often felt knee pain.

cues.zh: 所以来了医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lai2 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: So he came to the hospital.

cues.zh: 他之前做了尿检
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 qian2 zuo4 le5 niao4 jian3
cues.en: He had a urine test done earlier.

cues.zh: 而他大量起泡的尿样成功引起
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 da4 liang4 qi3 pao4 de5 niao4 yang4 cheng2 gong1 yin3 qi3
cues.en: And his heavily foamy urine sample successfully caught

cues.zh: 了肖恩的注意
cues.pinyin: le5 xiao4 en1 de5 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: Shawn's attention.

cues.zh: 所以肖恩和朴医生来到病房一
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao4 en1 he2 pu3 yi1 sheng1 lai2 dao4 bing4 fang2 yi1
cues.en: So Shawn and Dr. Park came to the ward together

cues.zh: 起帮他做检查
cues.pinyin: qi3 bang1 ta1 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: to examine him.

cues.zh: 小帅的关节疼痛
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 de5 guan1 jie2 teng2 tong4
cues.en: Xiao Shuai's joint pain,

cues.zh: 加上他尿样的异常可能是气性膀胱炎
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 ta1 niao4 yang4 de5 yi4 chang2 ke3 neng2 shi4 qi4 xing4 pang2 guang1 yan2
cues.en: combined with the abnormal urine sample, could point to emphysematous cystitis,

cues.zh: 膀胱癌或者肾脏问题
cues.pinyin: pang2 guang1 ai2 huo4 zhe3 shen4 zang4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: bladder cancer, or a kidney problem.

cues.zh: 肖恩的推断听起来很严重
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 de5 tui1 duan4 ting1 qi3 lai2 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Shawn's guess sounded serious.

cues.zh: 小帅忍不住有些担心
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 you3 xie1 dan1 xin1
cues.en: Xiao Shuai couldn't help feeling a bit worried.

cues.zh: 试探着问他们
cues.pinyin: shi4 tan4 zhe5 wen4 ta1 men5
cues.en: He cautiously asked them,

cues.zh: 或许有没有可能是胃旁路手术引起的
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 you3 mei2 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 wei4 pang2 lu4 shou3 shu4 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: "Could it possibly be caused by the gastric bypass surgery?"

cues.zh: 胃旁路手术是指用于治疗肥胖
cues.pinyin: wei4 pang2 lu4 shou3 shu4 shi4 zhi3 yong4 yu2 zhi4 liao2 fei2 pang4
cues.en: Gastric bypass surgery refers to a surgical procedure used to treat

cues.zh: 症的外科手术
cues.pinyin: zheng4 de5 wai4 ke1 shou3 shu4
cues.en: obesity.

cues.zh: 能改变肠道结构
cues.pinyin: neng2 gai3 bian4 chang2 dao4 jie2 gou4
cues.en: It can change the structure of the intestines

cues.zh: 关闭大部分胃功能
cues.pinyin: guan1 bi4 da4 bu4 fen4 wei4 gong1 neng2
cues.en: and shut down most of the stomach's function,

cues.zh: 从而达到减肥的目的
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 da2 dao4 jian3 fei2 de5 mu4 di4
cues.en: thereby achieving weight loss.

cues.zh: 小帅之前是个 17 1 公斤的胖子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 zhi1 qian2 shi4 ge4 17 1 gong1 jin1 de5 pang4 zi5
cues.en: Xiao Shuai used to be a 171 kg heavy man.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 为了减肥因此做了这个手术
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jian3 fei2 yin1 ci3 zuo4 le5 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: He had this surgery in order to lose weight.

cues.zh: 按常理来说
cues.pinyin: an4 chang2 li3 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: Logically speaking,

cues.zh: 这个手术不会引起他现在的这些症状
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 bu2 hui4 yin3 qi3 ta1 xian4 zai4 de5 zhe4 xie1 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: this surgery shouldn't be causing the symptoms he has now.

cues.zh: 但具体原因也要做个膀胱内窥
cues.pinyin: dan4 ju4 ti3 yuan2 yin1 ye3 yao4 zuo4 ge4 pang2 guang1 nei4 kui1
cues.en: But the exact cause would require a cystoscopy

cues.zh: 镜检查才知道
cues.pinyin: jing4 jian3 cha2 cai2 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: to find out for sure.

cues.zh: 窥镜检查显示小帅的尿道很干净
cues.pinyin: kui1 jing4 jian3 cha2 xian3 shi4 xiao3 shuai4 de5 niao4 dao4 hen3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: The cystoscopy showed Xiao Shuai's urethra was clean,

cues.zh: 目前没有病变或者结石
cues.pinyin: mu4 qian2 mei2 you3 bing4 bian4 huo4 zhe3 jie2 shi2
cues.en: with no lesions or stones for now.

cues.zh: 接着他们给他做了膀胱造影
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 ta1 men5 gei3 ta1 zuo4 le5 pang2 guang1 zao4 ying3
cues.en: Next they gave him a cystogram,

cues.zh: 但奇怪的是注入的造影剂很快就消失了
cues.pinyin: dan4 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4 zhu4 ru4 de5 zao4 ying3 ji4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 xiao1 shi1 le5
cues.en: but strangely, the contrast agent injected disappeared very quickly.

cues.zh: 依照这种情况
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhao4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Given this situation,

cues.zh: 肖恩推测小帅可能有瘘管
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 tui1 ce4 xiao3 shuai4 ke3 neng2 you3 lou4 guan3
cues.en: Shawn guessed Xiao Shuai might have a fistula,

cues.zh: 就是他身体上有一个孔洞
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 shen1 ti3 shang4 you3 yi2 ge4 kong3 dong4
cues.en: meaning there was a hole in his body

cues.zh: 接通了他的膀胱和肠道
cues.pinyin: jie1 tong1 le5 ta1 de5 pang2 guang1 he2 chang2 dao4
cues.en: connecting his bladder and intestines.

cues.zh: 因此空气和细菌的移动方向出现了偏差
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 kong1 qi4 he2 xi4 jun1 de5 yi2 dong4 fang1 xiang4 chu1 xian4 le5 pian1 cha1
cues.en: So the direction air and bacteria moved had gotten mixed up,

cues.zh: 导致了他的尿液有泡沫
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 le5 ta1 de5 niao4 ye4 you3 pao4 mo4
cues.en: causing the foam in his urine.

cues.zh: 等小帅醒来后
cues.pinyin: deng3 xiao3 shuai4 xing3 lai2 hou4
cues.en: After Xiao Shuai woke up,

cues.zh: 医生告诉他是克罗恩病导致了他膀胱
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1 shi4 ke4 luo2 en1 bing4 dao3 zhi4 le5 ta1 pang2 guang1
cues.en: the doctors told him Crohn's disease had caused the fistula between his bladder

cues.zh: 和肠道的瘘管
cues.pinyin: he2 chang2 dao4 de5 lou4 guan3
cues.en: and intestines.

cues.zh: 这是一种发炎性肠道疾病
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 fa1 yan2 xing4 chang2 dao4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: It's a type of inflammatory bowel disease.

cues.zh: 而现在他们不得不把他的胃旁路
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 zai4 ta1 men5 bu4 de2 bu4 ba3 ta1 de5 wei4 pang2 lu4
cues.en: And now they had to reverse his gastric bypass

cues.zh: 这个手术复原
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 fu4 yuan2
cues.en: surgery.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 医生们要做术前准备
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 yao4 zuo4 shu4 qian2 zhun3 bei4
cues.en: The doctors needed to do preoperative preparation,

cues.zh: 可这时小帅开始剧烈呕吐
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 shi2 xiao3 shuai4 kai1 shi3 ju4 lie4 ou3 tu4
cues.en: but at that point Xiao Shuai started vomiting violently,

cues.zh: 而且呕吐物混杂着胆汁
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ou3 tu4 wu4 hun4 za2 zhe5 dan3 zhi1
cues.en: and the vomit was mixed with bile.

cues.zh: 这意味着有部分肠梗阻
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 you3 bu4 fen4 chang2 geng3 zu3
cues.en: This meant part of his intestines were obstructed,

cues.zh: 这十分危险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 fen1 wei1 xian3
cues.en: which was very dangerous.

cues.zh: 医生立刻给他插上了鼻胃管
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 cha1 shang4 le5 bi2 wei4 guan3
cues.en: The doctors immediately inserted a nasogastric tube

cues.zh: 做紧急处理
cues.pinyin: zuo4 jin3 ji2 chu3 li3
cues.en: for emergency treatment.

cues.zh: 但大壮觉得不对劲
cues.pinyin: dan4 da4 zhuang4 jue2 de5 bu2 dui4 jin4
cues.en: But Dazhuang felt something was off.

cues.zh: 肠道发炎会引起肠梗阻吗
cues.pinyin: chang2 dao4 fa1 yan2 hui4 yin3 qi3 chang2 geng3 zu3 ma5
cues.en: "Can intestinal inflammation cause an intestinal obstruction?"

cues.zh: 午餐时间
cues.pinyin: wu3 can1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: At lunchtime,

cues.zh: 关心自己丈夫的大壮找到了朴医生
cues.pinyin: guan1 xin1 zi4 ji3 zhang4 fu1 de5 da4 zhuang4 zhao3 dao4 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Dazhuang, worried about her husband, went to find Dr. Park.

cues.zh: 他查了很多资料
cues.pinyin: ta1 cha2 le5 hen3 duo1 zi1 liao4
cues.en: She had looked into a lot of information,

cues.zh: 越查越觉得奇怪
cues.pinyin: yue4 cha2 yue4 jue2 de5 qi2 guai4
cues.en: and the more she researched, the stranger it seemed.

cues.zh: 所以来问问一些细节
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lai2 wen4 wen4 yi1 xie1 xi4 jie2
cues.en: So she came to ask about some details.

cues.zh: 朴医生想要躲着他
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 xiang3 yao4 duo3 zhe5 ta1
cues.en: Dr. Park tried to avoid her,

cues.zh: 但是大壮一步一驱
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da4 zhuang4 yi1 bu4 yi1 qu1
cues.en: but Dazhuang pursued him relentlessly,

cues.zh: 而且准备得十分充分
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhun3 bei4 de2 shi2 fen1 chong1 fen4
cues.en: and had come fully prepared.

cues.zh: 跟念经一样说的人脑子疼
cues.pinyin: gen1 nian4 jing1 yi1 yang4 shuo1 de5 ren2 nao3 zi5 teng2
cues.en: She talked like she was reciting scripture, giving him a headache.

cues.zh: 朴医生见瞒不过去了
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 jian4 man2 bu4 guo4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Seeing he couldn't hide it any longer,

cues.zh: 就把事情告诉了他
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 shi4 qing2 gao4 su4 le5 ta1
cues.en: Dr. Park told her what was going on.

cues.zh: 大壮立刻去找了小帅
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 li4 ke4 qu4 zhao3 le5 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: Dazhuang immediately went to find Xiao Shuai.

cues.zh: 两人在病房里吵了起来
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 zai4 bing4 fang2 li3 chao3 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: The two of them started arguing in the ward.

cues.zh: 但肖恩在一旁还不忘帮小帅检查
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 zai4 yi1 pang2 hai2 bu4 wang4 bang1 xiao3 shuai4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: But Shawn, off to the side, didn't forget to keep examining Xiao Shuai,

cues.zh: 发现他出现了内出血
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 chu1 xian4 le5 nei4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: and discovered he had internal bleeding.

cues.zh: 立刻安排了朴医生和丽母安排手术
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 an1 pai2 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1 he2 li4 mu3 an1 pai2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: He immediately arranged for Dr. Park and another doctor to perform surgery.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 小美是昏厥了之后被送来的
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shi4 hun1 jue2 le5 zhi1 hou4 bei4 song4 lai2 de5
cues.en: Xiaomei was brought in after fainting.

cues.zh: 布朗看到她的时候
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 kan4 dao4 ta1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When Brown saw her,

cues.zh: 很是惊讶了一把
cues.pinyin: hen3 shi4 jing1 ya4 le5 yi1 ba3
cues.en: he was quite shocked —

cues.zh: 瘦得简直就剩下一副骨头架子了
cues.pinyin: shou4 de2 jian3 zhi2 jiu4 sheng4 xia4 yi1 fu4 gu2 tou5 jia4 zi5 le5
cues.en: she was practically just a skeleton, she was so thin.

cues.zh: 但小美昏厥不是因为饿的
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 mei3 hun1 jue2 bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 e4 de5
cues.en: But Xiaomei's fainting wasn't from hunger,

cues.zh: 而是心脏问题
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 xin1 zang4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: it was a heart problem.

cues.zh: 她的心脏正在慢慢衰减
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 zang4 zheng4 zai4 man4 man4 shuai1 jian3
cues.en: Her heart was slowly failing.

cues.zh: 是二尖瓣闭锁不全病症
cues.pinyin: shi4 er4 jian1 ban4 bi4 suo3 bu4 quan2 bing4 zheng4
cues.en: It was mitral valve insufficiency.

cues.zh: 她的一半心脏半膜不能完全闭合
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yi2 ban4 xin1 zang4 ban4 mo2 bu4 neng2 wan2 quan2 bi4 he2
cues.en: Her mitral valve couldn't close completely,

cues.zh: 导致血液一直倒流到心房
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 xue4 ye4 yi4 zhi2 dao4 liu2 dao4 xin1 fang2
cues.en: causing blood to keep flowing back into the atrium,

cues.zh: 造成昏厥
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 hun1 jue2
cues.en: which caused the fainting.

cues.zh: 所以医生现在需要马上修复小美的半膜
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 sheng1 xian4 zai4 xu1 yao4 ma3 shang4 xiu1 fu4 xiao3 mei3 de5 ban4 mo2
cues.en: So the doctors now needed to repair Xiaomei's mitral valve right away.

cues.zh: 二尖瓣问题是长期营养不良的常见并发症
cues.pinyin: er4 jian1 ban4 wen4 ti2 shi4 chang2 qi1 ying2 yang3 bu4 liang2 de5 chang2 jian4 bing4 fa1 zheng4
cues.en: Mitral valve problems are a common complication of long-term malnutrition.

cues.zh: 小美因为一直不吃饭
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 yin1 wei4 yi4 zhi2 bu4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: Since Xiaomei hadn't been eating,

cues.zh: 所以患上也很正常
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 huan4 shang4 ye3 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: it was quite normal for her to develop this.

cues.zh: 这时布朗问小美她的厌食症得了多久了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 bu4 lang3 wen4 xiao3 mei3 ta1 de5 yan4 shi2 zheng4 de2 le5 duo1 jiu3 le5
cues.en: At this point Brown asked Xiaomei how long she'd had her anorexia.

cues.zh: 小美说是从 14 岁起一直断断续续厌食
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shuo1 shi4 cong2 14 sui4 qi3 yi4 zhi2 duan4 duan4 xu4 xu4 yan4 shi2
cues.en: Xiaomei said she'd had intermittent anorexia since she was 14.

cues.zh: 她丈夫接过话说
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhang4 fu1 jie1 guo4 hua4 shuo1
cues.en: Her husband cut in and said

cues.zh: 她大约是从一年前开始
cues.pinyin: ta1 da4 yue1 shi4 cong2 yi1 nian2 qian2 kai1 shi3
cues.en: it was about a year ago

cues.zh: 她就不吃饭了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu4 chi1 fan4 le5
cues.en: that she stopped eating.

cues.zh: 甚至时常骗家里人已经吃过了
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 shi2 chang2 pian4 jia1 li3 ren2 yi3 jing1 chi1 guo4 le5
cues.en: She would even often lie to the family that she'd already eaten,

cues.zh: 而且还过量运动
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 guo4 liang4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: and also exercised excessively.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 他们都担心的不行
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 dan1 xin1 de5 bu4 xing2
cues.en: They were all extremely worried.

cues.zh: 这已经不是单纯的验食了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi3 jing1 bu2 shi4 dan1 chun2 de5 yan4 shi2 le5
cues.en: This was no longer simple anorexia —

cues.zh: 还可能有心理疾病
cues.pinyin: hai2 ke3 neng2 you3 xin1 li3 ji2 bing4
cues.en: there could also be a psychological illness involved.

cues.zh: 医生给小美做了检查
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gei3 xiao3 mei3 zuo4 le5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: The doctors examined Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 她的肝和甲状腺是正常的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gan1 he2 jia3 zhuang4 xian4 shi4 zheng4 chang2 de5
cues.en: Her liver and thyroid were normal,

cues.zh: 但体内的电解质不足
cues.pinyin: dan4 ti3 nei4 de5 dian4 jie3 zhi4 bu4 zu2
cues.en: but her electrolytes were insufficient

cues.zh: 蛋白含量过低
cues.pinyin: dan4 bai2 han2 liang4 guo4 di1
cues.en: and her protein levels were too low —

cues.zh: 严重营养不良
cues.pinyin: yan2 zhong4 ying2 yang3 bu4 liang2
cues.en: severe malnutrition.

cues.zh: 小美要活命就得做手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 yao4 huo2 ming4 jiu4 de2 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: For Xiaomei to survive, she needed surgery,

cues.zh: 但她现在这么虚弱
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 xian4 zai4 zhe4 me5 xu1 ruo4
cues.en: but she was so weak right now

cues.zh: 可能根本撑不过手术
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 gen1 ben3 cheng1 bu4 guo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: she might not even survive the surgery,

cues.zh: 更别说抵抗术后感染了
cues.pinyin: geng4 bie2 shuo1 di3 kang4 shu4 hou4 gan3 ran3 le5
cues.en: let alone fight off a post-op infection.

cues.zh: 为了安全手术
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 an1 quan2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: To make the surgery safe,

cues.zh: 小美得增加热量摄入
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de2 zeng1 jia1 re4 liang4 she4 ru4
cues.en: Xiaomei needed to increase her caloric intake

cues.zh: 优化蛋白质摄入
cues.pinyin: you1 hua4 dan4 bai2 zhi4 she4 ru4
cues.en: and optimize her protein intake.

cues.zh: 比静脉注射更有效的
cues.pinyin: bi3 jing4 mai4 zhu4 she4 geng4 you3 xiao4 de5
cues.en: More effective than an IV drip

cues.zh: 就是直接把营养物质
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhi2 jie1 ba3 ying2 yang3 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: was to send nutrients

cues.zh: 直接送进胃内
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 song4 jin4 wei4 nei4
cues.en: directly into her stomach.

cues.zh: 鉴于小美的情况
cues.pinyin: jian4 yu2 xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Given Xiaomei's situation,

cues.zh: 医生建议给她插入鼻胃管
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jian4 yi4 gei3 ta1 cha1 ru4 bi2 wei4 guan3
cues.en: the doctors suggested inserting a nasogastric tube,

cues.zh: 但小美说她之前试过
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 mei3 shuo1 ta1 zhi1 qian2 shi4 guo4
cues.en: but Xiaomei said she'd tried that before,

cues.zh: 鼻管对她来说依旧没有用
cues.pinyin: bi2 guan3 dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 jiu4 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: and the nasal tube still didn't work for her.

cues.zh: 这下麻烦了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 ma2 fan2 le5
cues.en: Now this was a problem.

cues.zh: 此时布朗突然说
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 bu4 lang3 tu1 ran2 shuo1
cues.en: At this point Brown suddenly said,

cues.zh: 也许不是食物的问题
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 bu2 shi4 shi2 wu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: "Maybe it's not about the food,

cues.zh: 而是因为自我控制
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yin1 wei4 zi4 wo3 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: but about self-control.

cues.zh: 世界上有很多人
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2
cues.en: There are many people in the world

cues.zh: 因为验尸症而死亡
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yan4 shi1 zheng4 er2 si3 wang2
cues.en: who die from anorexia."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】男子为了减肥险些丧命，最后还惨遭男朋友抛弃，实在是惨啊！

cues.zh: 医生们不敢再给她插上了
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 bu4 gan3 zai4 gei3 ta1 cha1 shang4 le5
cues.en: The doctors no longer dared to insert the tube again.

cues.zh: 如果小美还是这样忍住不拔管的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 xiao3 mei3 hai2 shi4 zhe4 yang4 ren3 zhu4 bu4 ba2 guan3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If Xiaomei kept pulling the tube out like this,

cues.zh: 这无异于自残
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wu2 yi4 yu2 zi4 can2
cues.en: that would be no different from self-harm.

cues.zh: 小美的情况让医生们十分为难
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4 rang4 yi1 sheng1 men5 shi2 fen1 wei2 nan2
cues.en: Xiaomei's situation put the doctors in a difficult position.

cues.zh: 这时布朗拿出一份文件交给了梅医生
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 bu4 lang3 na2 chu1 yi1 fen4 wen2 jian4 jiao1 gei3 le5 mei2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: At this point Brown took out a document and handed it to Dr. May.

cues.zh: 里面记载着一个冷门的研究
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 ji4 zai3 zhe5 yi2 ge4 leng3 men2 de5 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: It contained a little-known study

cues.zh: 说是可以通过脑深层刺激术来治疗验尸症
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shi4 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 nao3 shen1 ceng2 ci4 ji1 shu4 lai2 zhi4 liao2 yan4 shi1 zheng4
cues.en: saying deep brain stimulation could treat anorexia.

cues.zh: 可是这个手术仍在试验阶段
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 reng2 zai4 shi4 yan4 jie1 duan4
cues.en: But this surgery was still in the trial stage,

cues.zh: 而且它能导致人格的改变
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 neng2 dao3 zhi4 ren2 ge2 de5 gai3 bian4
cues.en: and it could cause personality changes.

cues.zh: 加上这个实验样本太少
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 yang4 ben3 tai4 shao3
cues.en: Plus the experimental sample size was too small,

cues.zh: 实验数据没有很高的参考价值
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shu4 ju4 mei2 you3 hen3 gao1 de5 can1 kao3 jia4 zhi2
cues.en: so the data wasn't very reliable.

cues.zh: 风险太大
cues.pinyin: feng1 xian3 tai4 da4
cues.en: The risk was too great,

cues.zh: 所以梅医生不同意
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: so Dr. May didn't agree.

cues.zh: 但是布朗还是偷偷把这个手术告
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 lang3 hai2 shi4 tou1 tou1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 gao4
cues.en: But Brown secretly told Xiaomei and her husband

cues.zh: 诉了小美他们
cues.pinyin: su4 le5 xiao3 mei3 ta1 men5
cues.en: about this surgery anyway,

cues.zh: 并告知了所有可能存在的风险
cues.pinyin: bing4 gao4 zhi1 le5 suo3 you3 ke3 neng2 cun2 zai4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: and informed them of all the possible risks.

cues.zh: 在晚上小美的丈夫找到了梅医生
cues.pinyin: zai4 wan3 shang4 xiao3 mei3 de5 zhang4 fu1 zhao3 dao4 le5 mei2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: That night, Xiaomei's husband went to find Dr. May

cues.zh: 同意做这个手术
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and agreed to the surgery.

cues.zh: 梅医生只能再考虑考虑
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zhi3 neng2 zai4 kao3 lv4 kao3 lv4
cues.en: Dr. May said she'd have to think it over more.

cues.zh: 但由于这个研究不是在本国开展的
cues.pinyin: dan4 you2 yu2 zhe4 ge5 yan2 jiu1 bu2 shi4 zai4 ben3 guo2 kai1 zhan3 de5
cues.en: But since this research wasn't being conducted domestically,

cues.zh: 所以医院需要举办听证会来审核
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 yuan4 xu1 yao4 ju3 ban4 ting1 zheng4 hui4 lai2 shen3 he2
cues.en: the hospital needed to hold a hearing to review

cues.zh: 是否同意紧急
cues.pinyin: shi4 fou3 tong2 yi4 jin3 ji2
cues.en: whether to approve the emergency...

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 日式著名亲子丼的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 今天给你带来的是日式亲子丼
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gei3 ni3 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 ri4 shi4 qin1 zi3 jing3
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you Japanese oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl).

cues.zh: 首先在我们的鸡腿肉上放两汤匙清酒
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 tui3 rou4 shang4 fang4 liang3 tang1 chi2 qing1 jiu3
cues.en: First, add two tablespoons of sake to our chicken thigh meat.

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1 shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: A little white pepper and a little salt.

cues.zh: 然后搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Then mix it a bit.

cues.zh: 外面许多食谱都没有这个步骤
cues.pinyin: wai4 mian4 xu3 duo1 shi2 pu3 dou1 mei2 you3 zhe4 ge5 bu4 zhou4
cues.en: Many recipes out there skip this step.

cues.zh: 但你如果做了的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 ni3 ru2 guo3 zuo4 le5 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if you do it,

cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 ni3 de5 ji1 rou4 hui4 you3 duo1 yi1 ceng2 di3 wei4
cues.en: you'll find your chicken has an extra layer of base flavor.

cues.zh: 现在我们来做日式的 d ashi 汤底
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 ri4 shi4 de5 d ashi tang1 di3
cues.en: Now let's make the Japanese dashi broth.

cues.zh: 那首先呢我们这里面有一个干海带
cues.pinyin: na4 shou3 xian1 ne5 wo3 men5 zhe4 li3 mian4 you3 yi2 ge4 gan4 hai3 dai4
cues.en: First, we have a piece of dried kelp here.

cues.zh: 我已经给它泡了两个小时
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi3 jing1 gei3 ta1 pao4 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: I've already soaked it for two hours.

cues.zh: 然后现在放到锅子里面我们把火打开
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xian4 zai4 fang4 dao4 guo1 zi5 li3 mian4 wo3 men5 ba3 huo3 da3 kai1
cues.en: Now put it in the pot and turn on the heat.

cues.zh: 给它煮开
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zhu3 kai1
cues.en: Bring it to a boil.

cues.zh: 然后把这个海带拿出来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 hai3 dai4 na2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Then take the kelp out.

cues.zh: 把火关掉
cues.pinyin: ba3 huo3 guan1 diao4
cues.en: Turn off the heat.

cues.zh: 这个时候我们放进来大概半个 ounce 的柴鱼片
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 da4 gai4 ban4 ge4 ounce de5 chai2 yu2 pian4
cues.en: Now add about half an ounce of bonito flakes.

cues.zh: 现在我们就可以来做酱汁了

cues.pinyin: san1 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Three tablespoons of soy sauce.

cues.zh: 三汤匙清酒
cues.pinyin: san1 tang1 chi2 qing1 jiu3
cues.en: Three tablespoons of sake.

cues.zh: 三汤匙米粒料酒
cues.pinyin: san1 tang1 chi2 mi3 li4 liao4 jiu3
cues.en: Three tablespoons of mirin.

cues.zh: 一汤匙糖
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 tang2
cues.en: One tablespoon of sugar.

cues.zh: 然后搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: Then mix it evenly.

cues.zh: 这里呢我们有四颗蛋
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 ne5 wo3 men5 you3 si4 ke1 dan4
cues.en: Here we have four eggs.

cues.zh: 我们给它稍微的搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 shao1 wei1 de5 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: We'll beat them a little.

cues.zh: 不需要搅拌的特别均匀
cues.pinyin: bu4 xu1 yao4 jiao3 ban4 de5 te4 bie2 jun1 yun2
cues.en: No need to beat them too evenly.

cues.zh: 好现在在热锅里面我们放进来三汤匙油
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 zai4 re4 guo1 li3 mian4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 san1 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: Okay, now in a hot pan we add three tablespoons of oil.

cues.zh: 两个洋葱
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 yang2 cong1
cues.en: Two onions.

cues.zh: 然后给它炒到这个味道出来很香
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 dao4 chu1 lai2 hen3 xiang1
cues.en: Then fry it until the aroma comes out really nicely.

cues.zh: 了之后就好了
cues.pinyin: le5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: Once that's done, it's ready.

cues.zh: 放进来我们刚刚做好的酱汁
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 zuo4 hao3 de5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Add in the sauce we just made.

cues.zh: 这个一直惨遭丈夫抱怨的女人名叫秀段

cues.en: This woman, constantly scolded by her husband, is named Xiu Duan.

cues.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 gen1 bu4 shang4 zi4 ji3 zhang4 fu1 de5 bu4 fa2
cues.en: She always lags behind her husband's pace.

cues.zh: 丈夫也总是不会回头等她
cues.pinyin: zhang4 fu1 ye3 zong3 shi4 bu2 hui4 hui2 tou2 deng3 ta1

cues.zh: 但这次她终于走到了自己丈夫
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ci4 ta1 zhong1 yu2 zou3 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 zhang4 fu1
cues.en: But this time, she finally caught up right behind her husband.

cues.zh: 清福的前面这天
cues.pinyin: qing1 fu2 de5 qian2 mian4 zhe4 tian1
cues.en: — right in front of Qingfu. That day,

cues.zh: 家里的水管又爆了清福修了半天没修好
cues.pinyin: jia1 li3 de5 shui3 guan3 you4 bao4 le5 qing1 fu2 xiu1 le5 ban4 tian1 mei2 xiu1 hao3
cues.en: the water pipe at home burst again, and Qingfu spent half the day failing to fix it,

cues.zh: 最后不得不出门一趟
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 bu4 de2 bu4 chu1 men2 yi1 tang4
cues.en: so in the end he had to go out.

cues.zh: 而这也就意味着
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ye3 jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5
cues.en: And that meant

cues.zh: 跛脚的他必须走过一组很长的台阶
cues.pinyin: bo3 jiao3 de5 ta1 bi4 xu1 zou3 guo4 yi1 zu3 hen3 zhang3 de5 tai2 jie1
cues.en: the limping Qingfu had to climb a long flight of stairs,

cues.zh: 然后坐车穿过一片很绿的山林
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zuo4 che1 chuan1 guo4 yi1 pian4 hen3 lv4 de5 shan1 lin2
cues.en: then take a bus through a lush green forest.

cues.zh: 这无疑是在为难他

cues.en: This was clearly hard on him.

cues.zh: 这不仅是因为他的身体
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 jin3 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: Not just because of his body,

cues.zh: 途中有人上车
