cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 hui4 rang4 jing3 chui2 yong3 yuan3 chu3 yu2 bu4 wen3 ding4 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: But this would leave the cervical spine permanently unstable

cues.zh: 而且还可能造成中风
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 ke3 neng2 zao4 cheng2 zhong4 feng1
cues.en: and could also cause a stroke.

cues.zh: 布朗一直没想到能规避或者减少这两
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 yi4 zhi2 mei2 xiang3 dao4 neng2 gui1 bi4 huo4 zhe3 jian3 shao3 zhe4 liang3
cues.en: Brown still couldn't figure out how to avoid or reduce these two

cues.zh: 个风险的办法
cues.pinyin: ge4 feng1 xian3 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: risks.

cues.zh: 一直在休息室待到很晚
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 zai4 xiu1 xi1 shi4 dai4 dao4 hen3 wan3
cues.en: He stayed in the break room until very late.

cues.zh: 没办法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: With no other option,

cues.zh: 梅医生只能让他先回家了
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zhi3 neng2 rang4 ta1 xian1 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: Dr. Mei finally sent him home.

cues.zh: 但是梅医生却从布朗的草稿纸中想
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 que4 cong2 bu4 lang3 de5 cao3 gao3 zhi3 zhong1 xiang3
cues.en: But Dr. Mei, looking through Brown's draft notes,

cues.zh: 到了一个办法
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 fa3
cues.en: came up with an idea:

cues.zh: 可以从后面经过脑硬膜进去
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 cong2 hou4 mian4 jing1 guo4 nao3 ying4 mo2 jin4 qu4
cues.en: they could go in from the back, through the dura mater,

cues.zh: 小心地把骨髓移开
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xin1 di4 ba3 gu3 sui3 yi2 kai1
cues.en: carefully move the spinal cord aside,

cues.zh: 这样就可以钻开变形的第二脊椎
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zuan1 kai1 bian4 xing2 de5 di4 er4 ji3 zhui1
cues.en: so they could drill open the deformed second vertebra.

cues.zh: 这样有瘫痪的风险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 you3 tan1 huan4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: This carried a risk of paralysis,

cues.zh: 但是医院也会持续监视大壮的脊椎功能
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 yuan4 ye3 hui4 chi2 xu4 jian1 shi4 da4 zhuang4 de5 ji3 zhui1 gong1 neng2
cues.en: but the hospital would keep continuously monitoring Dazhuang's spinal function

cues.zh: 从而帮助避免神经损伤
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 bang1 zhu4 bi4 mian3 shen2 jing1 sun3 shang1
cues.en: to help prevent nerve damage.

cues.zh: 大壮同意了这个方案
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 tong2 yi4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 an4
cues.en: Dazhuang agreed to the plan.

cues.zh: 但萧恩却说
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao1 en1 que4 shuo1
cues.en: But Shawn said

cues.zh: 她是目光短浅且愚蠢的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 mu4 guang1 duan3 qian3 qie3 yu2 chun3 de5
cues.en: she was shortsighted and foolish.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 倒霉小伙平抵抗后背竟压个巴斯尸体
cues.pinyin: dao3 mei2 xiao3 huo3 ping2 di3 kang4 hou4 bei4 jing4 ya1 ge4 ba1 si1 shi1 ti3
cues.en: The unlucky guy struggles, only to find a corpse pressed against his back.

cues.zh: 法医赶紧来救场
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 gan3 jin3 lai2 jiu4 chang3
cues.en: The forensic examiner rushes in to save the day.

cues.zh: 却发现尸体屠杀巨型烤肉签
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 shi1 ti3 tu2 sha1 ju4 xing2 kao3 rou4 qian1
cues.en: Only to discover the body has a giant barbecue skewer stuck through it.

cues.zh: 而这恶心的场面还得从头顶的广告牌说起
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 e3 xin1 de5 chang3 mian4 hai2 de2 cong2 tou2 ding3 de5 guang3 gao4 pai2 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: And this gross scene actually starts with the billboard overhead.

cues.zh: 案发当晚小伙正踩着折叠梯工作
cues.pinyin: an4 fa1 dang4 wan3 xiao3 huo3 zheng4 cai3 zhe5 zhe2 die2 ti1 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: On the night of the incident, the guy was working while standing on a folding ladder.

cues.zh: 谁知脚下的工业强力胶突然长腿跑路
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 jiao3 xia4 de5 gong1 ye4 qiang2 li4 jiao1 tu1 ran2 zhang3 tui3 pao3 lu4
cues.en: When suddenly the industrial-strength glue under his feet mysteriously disappeared.

cues.zh: 心慌的小伙直接站在狭窄广告
cues.pinyin: xin1 huang1 de5 xiao3 huo3 zhi2 jie1 zhan4 zai4 xia2 zhai3 guang3 gao4
cues.en: The panicked guy just kept standing on the narrow billboard

cues.zh: 牌下继续操作
cues.pinyin: pai2 xia4 ji4 xu4 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: ledge below and kept working.

cues.zh: 然而就在下一秒
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: But in the very next second,

cues.zh: 小伙瞬间摔成脑震荡
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 shun4 jian1 shuai1 cheng2 nao3 zhen4 dang4
cues.en: the guy instantly fell and got a concussion.

cues.zh: 小编再次提醒大家
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bian1 zai4 ci4 ti2 xing3 da4 jia1
cues.en: The editor reminds everyone again:

cues.zh: 小短腿别做
cues.pinyin: xiao3 duan3 tui3 bie2 zuo4
cues.en: if you've got short legs, don't attempt this,

cues.zh: 大长腿也别浪
cues.pinyin: da4 zhang3 tui3 ye3 bie2 lang4
cues.en: and even long legs shouldn't get reckless.

cues.zh: 当法医实验室接警迅速赶到时
cues.pinyin: dang1 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 jie1 jing3 xun4 su4 gan3 dao4 shi2
cues.en: When the forensics team got the call and rushed to the scene,

cues.zh: 小伙子已经悠悠转醒
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 zi5 yi3 jing1 you1 you1 zhuan3 xing3
cues.en: the guy had already slowly come around.

cues.zh: 检查后并未发现对方有任何外伤
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 hou4 bing4 wei4 fa1 xian4 dui4 fang1 you3 ren4 he2 wai4 shang1
cues.en: After examination, no external injuries were found on him.

cues.zh: 小伙因为自己排面足够大
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 pai2 mian4 zu2 gou4 da4
cues.en: The guy, feeling pretty proud of the scene he'd caused,

cues.zh: 刚想摆谱就突然被抬上担架
cues.pinyin: gang1 xiang3 bai3 pu3 jiu4 tu1 ran2 bei4 tai2 shang4 dan1 jia4
cues.en: was just about to show off when he was suddenly carried off on a stretcher.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 显然众人的关注点是小货身下的尸体
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 zhong4 ren2 de5 guan1 zhu4 dian3 shi4 xiao3 huo4 shen1 xia4 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: Clearly, everyone's attention was on the corpse underneath him.

cues.zh: 法医小谷发现
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Forensic examiner Gu discovers

cues.zh: 死者的头颅竟被弓箭穿透
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 de5 tou2 lu2 jing4 bei4 gong1 jian4 chuan1 tou4
cues.en: the victim's skull had actually been pierced by an arrow.

cues.zh: 这肯定是场谋杀案
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ken3 ding4 shi4 chang3 mou2 sha1 an4
cues.en: This has to be a murder case.

cues.zh: 被鼠虫啃咬只剩一副骨架的尸体
cues.pinyin: bei4 shu3 chong2 ken3 yao3 zhi3 sheng4 yi1 fu4 gu3 jia4 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: The body, gnawed by rodents and bugs, is now just a bare skeleton,

cues.zh: 其死亡时间也成了谜
cues.pinyin: qi2 si3 wang2 shi2 jian1 ye3 cheng2 le5 mi2
cues.en: and the time of death has become a mystery too.

cues.zh: 由于小伙与尸体被强力胶粘成背对背拥抱
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 xiao3 huo3 yu3 shi1 ti3 bei4 qiang2 li4 jiao1 zhan1 cheng2 bei4 dui4 bei4 yong1 bao4
cues.en: Since the guy and the corpse were glued together back-to-back by the strong adhesive,

cues.zh: 一人一尸竟直接锁死身上
cues.pinyin: yi1 ren2 yi1 shi1 jing4 zhi2 jie1 suo3 si3 shen1 shang4
cues.en: the living man and the corpse were literally locked together.

cues.zh: 众人只好将小伙抬回实验室清理
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 zhi3 hao3 jiang1 xiao3 huo3 tai2 hui2 shi2 yan4 shi4 qing1 li3
cues.en: Everyone had no choice but to carry the guy back to the lab to clean him up.

cues.zh: 直至上一秒还鬼哭狼嚎的小伙
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 shang4 yi1 miao3 hai2 gui3 ku1 lang2 hao2 de5 xiao3 huo3
cues.en: The guy, who was wailing like a banshee just a second ago,

cues.zh: 现在正优雅的躺上扫描台
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zheng4 you1 ya3 de5 tang3 shang4 sao3 miao2 tai2
cues.en: is now lying elegantly on the scanning table,

cues.zh: 活脱脱一尊米开朗基罗雕塑
cues.pinyin: huo2 tuo1 tuo1 yi1 zun1 mi3 kai1 lang3 ji1 luo2 diao1 su4
cues.en: looking just like a Michelangelo sculpture.

cues.zh: 法医扫描尸体后发现
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 sao3 miao2 shi1 ti3 hou4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After scanning the body, the forensic team discovers

cues.zh: 死者粗糙的骨盆显然是 0 30 岁左
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 cu1 cao1 de5 gu3 pen2 xian3 ran2 shi4 0 30 sui4 zuo3
cues.en: the victim's coarse pelvis suggests he's around 30 years old,

cues.zh: 右的白人男性
cues.pinyin: you4 de5 bai2 ren2 nan2 xing4
cues.en: a Caucasian male.

cues.zh: 对方脊柱上大型手术的疤痕
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 ji2 zhu4 shang4 da4 xing2 shou3 shu4 de5 ba1 hen2
cues.en: A large surgical scar on his spine

cues.zh: 在人群中堪称稀有特征
cues.pinyin: zai4 ren2 qun2 zhong1 kan1 cheng1 xi1 you3 te4 zheng1
cues.en: is a pretty rare identifying feature,

cues.zh: 简直给法医递了张医院挂号条
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 gei3 fa3 yi1 di4 le5 zhang1 yi1 yuan4 gua4 hao4 tiao2
cues.en: practically handing the forensic team a hospital registration slip.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 对方因镇定剂已经进入幻境
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 yin1 zhen4 ding4 ji4 yi3 jing1 jin4 ru4 huan4 jing4
cues.en: Having been sedated, the guy has already drifted into a dreamlike state.

cues.zh: 然而就在此时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 ci3 shi2
cues.en: But right at this moment,

cues.zh: 安琪拉突然留意到小伙的画作
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 tu1 ran2 liu2 yi4 dao4 xiao3 huo3 de5 hua4 zuo4
cues.en: Angela suddenly notices the guy's artwork

cues.zh: 意识到对方正是她尤为钟爱的神秘作家
cues.pinyin: yi4 shi2 dao4 dui4 fang1 zheng4 shi4 ta1 you2 wei4 zhong1 ai4 de5 shen2 mi4 zuo4 jia1
cues.en: and realizes he's actually the mysterious author she's especially fond of.

cues.zh: 已婚的安琪拉
cues.pinyin: yi3 hun1 de5 an1 qi2 la1
cues.en: The married Angela

cues.zh: 竟直接上演突袭亲吻
cues.pinyin: jing4 zhi2 jie1 shang4 yan3 tu1 xi2 qin1 wen3
cues.en: goes ahead and ambushes him with a surprise kiss.

cues.zh: 下一秒
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: The next second,

cues.zh: 这波操作直接将小伙的 C PU 干收
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bo1 cao1 zuo4 zhi2 jie1 jiang1 xiao3 huo3 de5 C PU gan4 shou1
cues.en: this move basically fries the guy's CPU —

cues.zh: 体温急速飙升
cues.pinyin: ti3 wen1 ji2 su4 biao1 sheng1
cues.en: his body temperature spikes rapidly,

cues.zh: 瞬间将强力胶融化
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 jiang1 qiang2 li4 jiao1 rong2 hua4
cues.en: instantly melting the strong glue.

cues.zh: 一旁的法医瞅准时机
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 de5 fa3 yi1 chou3 zhun3 shi2 ji1
cues.en: The forensic examiner nearby seizes the moment,

cues.zh: 轻轻扳开死者头骨
cues.pinyin: qing1 qing1 ban1 kai1 si3 zhe3 tou2 gu3
cues.en: gently pries open the victim's skull,

cues.zh: 只见颅骨凹陷得如同被雷神之
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 lu2 gu3 ao1 xian4 de2 ru2 tong2 bei4 lei2 shen2 zhi1
cues.en: only to see the skull dented like a potato chip

cues.zh: 锤砸过的薯片
cues.pinyin: chui2 za2 guo4 de5 shu3 pian4
cues.en: smashed by Thor's hammer,

cues.zh: 表面不满盾气遭出的陨石坑
cues.pinyin: biao3 mian4 bu4 man3 dun4 qi4 zao1 chu1 de5 yun3 shi2 keng1
cues.en: its surface covered in crater-like dents.

cues.zh: 然而就在法医卡米尔近距离观察时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 fa3 yi1 ka3 mi3 er3 jin4 ju4 li2 guan1 cha2 shi2
cues.en: But just as the forensic examiner Cam leans in for a closer look,

cues.zh: 颅骨缝隙中突然飞出成群结队的飞蛾
cues.pinyin: lu2 gu3 feng4 xi4 zhong1 tu1 ran2 fei1 chu1 cheng2 qun2 jie2 dui4 de5 fei1 e2
cues.en: swarms of moths suddenly burst out of the cracks in the skull.

cues.zh: 豪金根据虫蜕推测
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 gen1 ju4 chong2 tui4 tui1 ce4
cues.en: Based on the molted shells, Hodgins deduces

cues.zh: 这些虫子竟在死者脑壳里开了 5000 派对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 chong2 zi5 jing4 zai4 si3 zhe3 nao3 ke2 li3 kai1 le5 5000 pai4 dui4
cues.en: that these bugs threw a party of 5,000 inside the victim's skull.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 小伙突然一头栽到地上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 tu1 ran2 yi1 tou2 zai1 dao4 di4 shang4
cues.en: the guy suddenly collapses face-first onto the floor.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 上司赶紧将安娜的地址全部说出
cues.pinyin: shang4 si1 gan3 jin3 jiang1 an1 na4 de5 di4 zhi3 quan2 bu4 shuo1 chu1
cues.en: His boss quickly blurts out Anna's address.

cues.zh: 根据这条线索
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Following this lead,

cues.zh: 小谷和老布迅速找到安娜
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 he2 lao3 bu4 xun4 su4 zhao3 dao4 an1 na4
cues.en: Gu and Booth quickly find Anna,

cues.zh: 却发现她还有个亲弟弟丹尼尔
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 ta1 hai2 you3 ge4 qin1 di4 di5 dan1 ni2 er3
cues.en: but discover she also has a younger brother, Daniel.

cues.zh: 然而两人听闻约翰死去时竟疯狂大笑
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 liang3 ren2 ting1 wen2 yue1 han4 si3 qu4 shi2 jing4 feng1 kuang2 da4 xiao4
cues.en: Yet when the two hear that John has died, they burst into crazy laughter,

cues.zh: 表示这一定是对方的恶作剧
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 zhe4 yi2 ding4 shi4 dui4 fang1 de5 e4 zuo4 ju4
cues.en: claiming it must be one of his pranks.

cues.zh: 直到安娜被老布带到警局
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 an1 na4 bei4 lao3 bu4 dai4 dao4 jing3 ju2
cues.en: Not until Anna is taken to the police station by Booth

cues.zh: 她这才意识到这是来真的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 cai2 yi4 shi2 dao4 zhe4 shi4 lai2 zhen1 de5
cues.en: does she realize this is for real.

cues.zh: 面对心理学家小甜甜的灵魂拷问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 de5 ling2 hun2 kao3 wen4
cues.en: Facing the psychologist Sweets's probing questions,

cues.zh: 安娜爆料约翰竟是名喜剧演员
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 bao4 liao4 yue1 han4 jing4 shi4 ming2 xi3 ju4 yan3 yuan2
cues.en: Anna reveals that John was actually a comedian,

cues.zh: 电话销售纯属副业
cues.pinyin: dian4 hua4 xiao1 shou4 chun2 shu3 fu4 ye4
cues.en: telemarketing was just his side gig.

cues.zh: 约翰招风引爹的本事和讲笑话一样溜
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 zhao1 feng1 yin3 die1 de5 ben3 shi4 he2 jiang3 xiao4 hua4 yi1 yang4 liu1
cues.en: John was as skilled at drawing attention as he was at cracking jokes.

cues.zh: 安娜表示约翰虽爱拿笑话当饭吃
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 biao3 shi4 yue1 han4 sui1 ai4 na2 xiao4 hua4 dang1 fan4 chi1
cues.en: Anna says that although John loved making a living off jokes,

cues.zh: 但绝不会将弓箭插脑壳上
cues.pinyin: dan4 jue2 bu2 hui4 jiang1 gong1 jian4 cha1 nao3 ke2 shang4
cues.en: he would never stick an arrow through someone's skull —

cues.zh: 因为他最烦这种骚操作
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zui4 fan2 zhe4 zhong3 sao1 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: because he hated that kind of over-the-top stunt.

cues.zh: 为自证清白
cues.pinyin: wei4 zi4 zheng4 qing1 bai2
cues.en: To prove her innocence,

cues.zh: 安娜称丹尼尔手中有约翰生前的演出录像
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 cheng1 dan1 ni2 er3 shou3 zhong1 you3 yue1 han4 sheng1 qian2 de5 yan3 chu1 lu4 xiang4
cues.en: Anna says Daniel has recordings of John's shows before he died.

cues.zh: 审讯室里丹尼尔堪称追星界天花板
cues.pinyin: shen3 xun4 shi4 li3 dan1 ni2 er3 kan1 cheng1 zhui1 xing1 jie4 tian1 hua1 ban3
cues.en: In the interrogation room, Daniel turns out to be the ultimate super-fan,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 路约翰演出竟比狗仔跟拍还惊艳
cues.pinyin: lu4 yue1 han4 yan3 chu1 jing4 bi3 gou3 zai3 gen1 pai1 hai2 jing1 yan4
cues.en: his recordings of John's shows more impressive than paparazzi footage.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 老布突然从视频中发现
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 tu1 ran2 cong2 shi4 pin2 zhong1 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Booth suddenly notices in the video

cues.zh: 每场演出总有个冒昧的家伙在
cues.pinyin: mei3 chang3 yan3 chu1 zong3 you3 ge4 mao4 mei4 de5 jia1 huo5 zai4
cues.en: that every show has one bold guy

cues.zh: 台下疯狂拆台
cues.pinyin: tai2 xia4 feng1 kuang2 chai1 tai2
cues.en: heckling wildly from the audience.

cues.zh: 丹尼尔告诉老布
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 gao4 su4 lao3 bu4
cues.en: Daniel tells Booth

cues.zh: 对方叫比尔也是一龄地下喜剧演员
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 jiao4 bi3 er3 ye3 shi4 yi1 ling2 di4 xia4 xi3 ju4 yan3 yuan2
cues.en: the guy's name is Bill, also an underground comedian,

cues.zh: 一直都和约翰水火不容
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 dou1 he2 yue1 han4 shui3 huo3 bu4 rong2
cues.en: who's always been at odds with John.

cues.zh: 小甜甜在表示
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 zai4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Sweets points out again

cues.zh: 往约翰头上插弓箭这一行为
cues.pinyin: wang3 yue1 han4 tou2 shang4 cha1 gong1 jian4 zhe4 yi1 xing2 wei4
cues.en: that sticking an arrow in John's head

cues.zh: 凶手绝对是故意羞辱这波操作
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 jue2 dui4 shi4 gu4 yi4 xiu1 ru3 zhe4 bo1 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: is clearly a deliberate act of humiliation by the killer,

cues.zh: 直接将比尔汗死在嫌疑人 C 位
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 jiang1 bi3 er3 han4 si3 zai4 xian2 yi2 ren2 C wei4
cues.en: which pins Bill firmly as the prime suspect.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 小谷咽尸时突然发现大量骨头碎片
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 yan4 shi1 shi2 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 da4 liang4 gu3 tou5 sui4 pian4
cues.en: while examining the body, Gu suddenly finds a large amount of bone fragments,

cues.zh: 很显然是凶手对约翰进行疯狂击打所致
cues.pinyin: hen3 xian3 ran2 shi4 xiong1 shou3 dui4 yue1 han4 jin4 xing2 feng1 kuang2 ji1 da3 suo3 zhi4
cues.en: clearly caused by the killer beating John furiously.

cues.zh: 小谷迅速将这条线索告知检验科
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 xun4 su4 jiang1 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3 gao4 zhi1 jian3 yan4 ke1
cues.en: Gu quickly reports this clue to the lab.

cues.zh: 直至安琪拉刚准备开工
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 an1 qi2 la1 gang1 zhun3 bei4 kai1 gong1
cues.en: Just as Angela is about to get to work,

cues.zh: 竟发现海报小伙待在自己的办公室
cues.pinyin: jing4 fa1 xian4 hai3 bao4 xiao3 huo3 dai4 zai4 zi4 ji3 de5 ban4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: she's surprised to find the billboard guy waiting in her office.

cues.zh: 对方对着安琪拉的话做一顿彩虹屁
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 dui4 zhe5 an1 qi2 la1 de5 hua4 zuo4 yi1 dun4 cai3 hong2 pi4
cues.en: He showers Angela with over-the-top compliments,

cues.zh: 接着便开启人生感悟小课堂
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 bian4 kai1 qi3 ren2 sheng1 gan3 wu4 xiao3 ke4 tang2
cues.en: then launches into a little life-lesson lecture.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 经典高分悬疑美剧《寻骨失踪》，壹集壹个小故事，逗逼组合屡破奇案，幽默之间揭露人性！

cues.zh: 自从约翰死后他就迅速上位
cues.pinyin: zi4 cong2 yue1 han4 si3 hou4 ta1 jiu4 xun4 su4 shang4 wei4
cues.en: Ever since John died, he's quickly risen to take his place.

cues.zh: 当布谷两人找到对方时
cues.pinyin: dang1 bu4 gu3 liang3 ren2 zhao3 dao4 dui4 fang1 shi2
cues.en: When Booth and Gu go to find him,

cues.zh: 发现赛文正在表演轮打锤
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 sai4 wen2 zheng4 zai4 biao3 yan3 lun2 da3 chui2
cues.en: they find Sevin performing a hammer-juggling act.

cues.zh: 面对警方的询问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 jing3 fang1 de5 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Facing the police's questioning,

cues.zh: 赛文表示弓箭道具早在前几天就被盗揍
cues.pinyin: sai4 wen2 biao3 shi4 gong1 jian4 dao4 ju4 zao3 zai4 qian2 ji3 tian1 jiu4 bei4 dao4 zou4
cues.en: Sevin says the arrow prop was stolen days earlier.

cues.zh: 对于约翰的死
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 yue1 han4 de5 si3
cues.en: Regarding John's death,

cues.zh: 赛文表示纯属活该
cues.pinyin: sai4 wen2 biao3 shi4 chun2 shu3 huo2 gai1
cues.en: Sevin says he simply had it coming.

cues.zh: 毕竟约翰热衷偷段子
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 yue1 han4 re4 zhong1 tou1 duan4 zi5
cues.en: After all, John was notorious for stealing jokes,

cues.zh: 销创意在圈子里堪称人形招黑剂
cues.pinyin: xiao1 chuang4 yi4 zai4 quan1 zi5 li3 kan1 cheng1 ren2 xing2 zhao1 hei1 ji4
cues.en: stealing ideas too — basically a magnet for hate in the scene.

cues.zh: 趁赛伦不注意
cues.pinyin: chen4 sai4 lun2 bu4 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: While Sevin isn't looking,

cues.zh: 小谷立即提取锤子上的液体进行检验
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 li4 ji2 ti2 qu3 chui2 zi5 shang4 de5 ye4 ti3 jin4 xing2 jian3 yan4
cues.en: Gu immediately takes a liquid sample from the hammer for testing.

cues.zh: 发现世界结果却呈阳性
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 shi4 jie4 jie2 guo3 que4 cheng2 yang2 xing4
cues.en: The test result comes back positive,

cues.zh: 直接让赛文洗洗颈具油
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 rang4 sai4 wen2 xi3 xi3 jing3 ju4 you2
cues.en: practically telling Sevin to get ready for trouble.

cues.zh: 而实验室里
cues.pinyin: er2 shi2 yan4 shi4 li3
cues.en: Meanwhile, back at the lab,

cues.zh: 豪金竟一盆冷水泼下
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 jing4 yi1 pen2 leng3 shui3 po1 xia4
cues.en: Hodgins throws cold water on the theory,

cues.zh: 液体呈现阳性
cues.pinyin: ye4 ti3 cheng2 xian4 yang2 xing4
cues.en: saying the liquid tested positive

cues.zh: 是因为玉金香叶造成的假阳性乌龙
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 ye4 zao4 cheng2 de5 jia3 yang2 xing4 wu1 long2
cues.en: only because of a false positive caused by tulip leaves.

cues.zh: 瞬间让赛文咬遍无辜路人
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 rang4 sai4 wen2 yao3 bian4 wu2 gu1 lu4 ren2
cues.en: That instantly clears Sevin, who'd nearly implicated an innocent bystander.

cues.zh: 实习生也扔出重磅炸弹
cues.pinyin: shi2 xi2 sheng1 ye3 reng1 chu1 zhong4 bang4 zha4 dan4
cues.en: The intern then drops a bombshell too:

cues.zh: 约翰卫里竟发现陶瓷碎片
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 wei4 li3 jing4 fa1 xian4 tao2 ci2 sui4 pian4
cues.en: ceramic fragments were found in John's stomach.

cues.zh: 难不成吞陶瓷
cues.pinyin: nan2 bu4 cheng2 tun1 tao2 ci2
cues.en: Don't tell me he swallowed ceramic?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 李永乐老师您是怎么考上北大的
cues.pinyin: li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1 nin2 shi4 zen3 me5 kao3 shang4 bei3 da4 de5
cues.en: Teacher Li Yongle, how did you get into Peking University?

cues.zh: 其实我是保送到北大的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 shi4 bao3 song4 dao4 bei3 da4 de5
cues.en: Actually, I was admitted to Peking University through recommendation, without the exam.

cues.zh: 我保送到北大的时候还有一件特
cues.pinyin: wo3 bao3 song4 dao4 bei3 da4 de5 shi2 hou4 hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 te4
cues.en: When I was recommended to Peking University, there was also a particularly

cues.zh: 别有意思的事
cues.pinyin: bie2 you3 yi4 si5 de5 shi4
cues.en: interesting thing that happened.

cues.zh: 那天早上起来也不知道为什么那么倒霉
cues.pinyin: na4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 na4 me5 dao3 mei2
cues.en: That morning when I got up, I don't know why, but I was so unlucky.

cues.zh: 我早上起来一骑自行车
cues.pinyin: wo3 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 yi1 qi2 zi4 xing2 che1
cues.en: When I got up that morning and rode my bike,

cues.zh: 发现自行车闸线断了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 zi4 xing2 che1 zha2 xian4 duan4 le5
cues.en: I found that the bike's brake cable was broken.

cues.zh: 然后我就推着车赶紧来到修车师傅面前
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 tui1 zhe5 che1 gan3 jin3 lai2 dao4 xiu1 che1 shi1 fu4 mian4 qian2
cues.en: So I pushed the bike and hurried over to a bike repairman.

cues.zh: 我说你帮我把这个闸修一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 ni3 bang1 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xiu1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: I said, please help me fix this brake.

cues.zh: 结果师傅看了一眼然后拿了一把钳子出来
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 shi1 fu4 kan4 le5 yi1 yan3 ran2 hou4 na2 le5 yi1 ba3 qian2 zi5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: The repairman took one look, then pulled out a pair of pliers,

cues.zh: 就把我这个闸线给剪断了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 wo3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 gei3 jian3 duan4 le5
cues.en: and cut my brake cable.

cues.zh: 我说我这个闸线断了你给我修好
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 duan4 le5 ni3 gei3 wo3 xiu1 hao3
cues.en: I said, my brake cable is broken, I need you to fix it.

cues.zh: 他就说了一句让我震惊的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 le5 yi1 ju4 rang4 wo3 zhen4 jing1 de5 hua4
cues.en: He said something that shocked me.

cues.zh: 他说如果我不给你这个闸线剪断
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ru2 guo3 wo3 bu4 gei3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jian3 duan4
cues.en: He said if he hadn't cut this brake cable for me,

cues.zh: 你这个闸线就会缠到轮子里就会有危险
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jiu4 hui4 chan2 dao4 lun2 zi5 li3 jiu4 hui4 you3 wei1 xian3
cues.en: the cable would get tangled in the wheel, which would be dangerous.

cues.zh: 现在我把你这个闸线剪断了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 ba3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 zha2 xian4 jian3 duan4 le5
cues.en: Now that he'd cut my brake cable,

cues.zh: 它就不会缠到轮子里了交钱吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 chan2 dao4 lun2 zi5 li3 le5 jiao1 qian2 ba5
cues.en: it wouldn't get tangled in the wheel anymore — now pay up.

cues.zh: 我当时年轻气盛我就跟这个修车
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 nian2 qing1 qi4 sheng4 wo3 jiu4 gen1 zhe4 ge5 xiu1 che1
cues.en: I was young and hot-tempered back then, so I

cues.zh: 师傅吵了一下
cues.pinyin: shi1 fu4 chao3 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: argued with the repairman for a bit.

cues.zh: 吵完之后等我赶到学校
cues.pinyin: chao3 wan2 zhi1 hou4 deng3 wo3 gan3 dao4 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: After arguing, by the time I rushed to school,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 已经迟到了半个小时了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 chi2 dao4 le5 ban4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 le5
cues.en: I was already half an hour late.

cues.zh: 那一次是全国物理竞赛的初赛
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 ci4 shi4 quan2 guo2 wu4 li3 jing4 sai4 de5 chu1 sai4
cues.en: That time was the preliminary round of the National Physics Competition.

cues.zh: 如果我要是通不过这个初赛
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 yao4 shi4 tong1 bu4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 chu1 sai4
cues.en: If I failed to pass this preliminary round,

cues.zh: 我就不能参加复赛不能参加决赛
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 bu4 neng2 can1 jia1 fu4 sai4 bu4 neng2 can1 jia1 jue2 sai4
cues.en: I wouldn't be able to take part in the semifinal or the final.

cues.zh: 但是我当时准备物理竞赛已经
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 zhun3 bei4 wu4 li3 jing4 sai4 yi3 jing1
cues.en: But at that time I had already been preparing for the physics competition

cues.zh: 准备了一年了
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 le5 yi1 nian2 le5
cues.en: for a whole year.

cues.zh: 我想难道就因为一个自行车
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 nan2 dao4 jiu4 yin1 wei4 yi2 ge4 zi4 xing2 che1
cues.en: I thought, could it really be that because of a bicycle,

cues.zh: 我最后就失去了这个机会吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 hou4 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4 ma5
cues.en: I would end up losing this opportunity?

cues.zh: 绝对不行
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bu4 xing2
cues.en: Absolutely not.

cues.zh: 所以我当时坐在考场上
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 dang1 shi2 zuo4 zai4 kao3 chang3 shang4
cues.en: So I sat there in the exam room,

cues.zh: 深吸一口气
cues.pinyin: shen1 xi1 yi4 kou3 qi4
cues.en: took a deep breath,

cues.zh: 稳了稳情绪开始打卷
cues.pinyin: wen3 le5 wen3 qing2 xu4 kai1 shi3 da3 juan3
cues.en: calmed myself down, and started answering the paper.

cues.zh: 没想到就越打越顺
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 jiu4 yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: Unexpectedly, the more I wrote, the smoother it went.

cues.zh: 越打越顺
cues.pinyin: yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: Smoother and smoother.

cues.zh: 最后反而还提前打完了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 fan3 er2 hai2 ti2 qian2 da3 wan2 le5
cues.en: In the end, I actually finished early.

cues.zh: 然后我又通过了负载决赛
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 you4 tong1 guo4 le5 fu4 zai4 jue2 sai4
cues.en: Then I also passed the semifinal and the final.

cues.zh: 就荣幸的被北京大学物理系给录取了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 rong2 xing4 de5 bei4 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 wu4 li3 xi4 gei3 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: and was honored to be admitted to Peking University's Physics Department.

cues.zh: 所以我有时候在想
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 you3 shi2 hou4 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: So sometimes I think,

cues.zh: 一个人在考试之中
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 zai4 kao3 shi4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: when a person is taking an exam,

cues.zh: 可能一定会遇到一些意外
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 yi2 ding4 hui4 yu4 dao4 yi1 xie1 yi4 wai4
cues.en: they'll probably run into some unexpected accidents.

cues.zh: 但是只要你有实力
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhi3 yao4 ni3 you3 shi2 li4
cues.en: But as long as you have real ability,

cues.zh: 你就会无惧意外
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 hui4 wu2 ju4 yi4 wai4
cues.en: you won't fear those accidents.

cues.zh: 那您后来又上了清华
cues.pinyin: na4 nin2 hou4 lai2 you4 shang4 le5 qing1 hua2
cues.en: So you later went on to Tsinghua University.

cues.zh: 在这个过程中有什么趣事吗
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 you3 shen2 me5 qu4 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Were there any interesting stories in that process?

cues.zh: 我本科毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ben3 ke1 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I graduated with my bachelor's degree,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 这个老师让我保研
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 shi1 rang4 wo3 bao3 yan2
cues.en: my teacher wanted me to get recommended for grad school without an exam.

cues.zh: 当时想让我保到这个北京大学技术物理系
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 xiang3 rang4 wo3 bao3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 ji4 shu4 wu4 li3 xi4
cues.en: At the time they wanted to place me into Peking University's Department of Technical Physics,

cues.zh: 去搞原子弹是吧
cues.pinyin: qu4 gao3 yuan2 zi3 dan4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: to work on atomic bombs, you know.

cues.zh: 但是我当时已经想要去考研了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 yi3 jing1 xiang3 yao4 qu4 kao3 yan2 le5
cues.en: But by then I had already decided to take the graduate entrance exam.

cues.zh: 我之所以想要考研
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xiang3 yao4 kao3 yan2
cues.en: The reason I wanted to take the grad exam

cues.zh: 就是因为我想通过一个机会来证明自己
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3 xiang3 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 ji1 hui4 lai2 zheng4 ming2 zi4 ji3
cues.en: was because I wanted a chance to prove myself,

cues.zh: 看看我到底还有没有能力去学习
cues.pinyin: kan4 kan4 wo3 dao4 di3 hai2 you3 mei2 you3 neng2 li4 qu4 xue2 xi2
cues.en: to see whether I still had the ability to study.

cues.zh: 而且要考就考最难考的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yao4 kao3 jiu4 kao3 zui4 nan2 kao3 de5
cues.en: And if I was going to take an exam, I'd take the hardest one there was.

cues.zh: 我就选了个清华电子系
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xuan3 le5 ge4 qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4
cues.en: So I chose Tsinghua's Electronics Department.

cues.zh: 清华电子系当年特别难考
cues.pinyin: qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4 dang1 nian2 te4 bie2 nan2 kao3
cues.en: Back then, Tsinghua's Electronics Department was extremely hard to get into.

cues.zh: 有点类似于现在的计算机
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 lei4 si4 yu2 xian4 zai4 de5 ji4 suan4 ji1
cues.en: It was a bit like computer science is today.

cues.zh: 然后我当时在准备考研的时候
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 dang1 shi2 zai4 zhun3 bei4 kao3 yan2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Then while I was preparing for the grad exam,

cues.zh: 还有一件趣事就是有一个这个同学
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 jian4 qu4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 zhe4 ge5 tong2 xue2
cues.en: there was another funny thing — a classmate of mine

cues.zh: 他这个端着一个盘子走到我面前就跟我说
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 ge5 duan1 zhe5 yi2 ge4 pan2 zi5 zou3 dao4 wo3 mian4 qian2 jiu4 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: carried a tray over to me and said,

cues.zh: 说这个听说你想考清华电子系
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ting1 shuo1 ni3 xiang3 kao3 qing1 hua2 dian4 zi5 xi4
cues.en: 'I heard you want to take the exam for Tsinghua's Electronics Department.

cues.zh: 你能考上吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 kao3 shang4 ma5
cues.en: Can you actually get in?'

cues.zh: 我说考不上也没事再考一年就行了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 kao3 bu4 shang4 ye3 mei2 shi4 zai4 kao3 yi1 nian2 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: I said, if I don't get in, it's fine, I'll just try again next year.

cues.zh: 他就说你现在就为你考不上找借口
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 ni3 xian4 zai4 jiu4 wei4 ni3 kao3 bu4 shang4 zhao3 jie4 kou3
cues.en: He said, 'You're already making excuses for failing before you even try.'

cues.zh: 哎呀给我气的是吧
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 gei3 wo3 qi4 de5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Ugh, that made me so angry.

cues.zh: 虽然我当时非常生气
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 wo3 dang1 shi2 fei1 chang2 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: Although I was very angry at the time,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 但是我什么话都没说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 shen2 me5 hua4 dou1 mei2 shuo1
cues.en: I didn't say a word.

cues.zh: 我这个后来我复习的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 ge5 hou4 lai2 wo3 fu4 xi2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Later on, when I was reviewing,

cues.zh: 每当我复习不下去
cues.pinyin: mei3 dang1 wo3 fu4 xi2 bu4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: whenever I felt like I couldn't keep studying,

cues.zh: 我就想起这个人奚落我的这种表情
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xiang3 qi3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 xi1 luo4 wo3 de5 zhe4 zhong3 biao3 qing2
cues.en: I'd remember the mocking look on his face,

cues.zh: 哎呀结果我就满血复活了
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 jie2 guo3 wo3 jiu4 man3 xue4 fu4 huo2 le5
cues.en: and that would instantly reenergize me.

cues.zh: 没想到后来经过这个 8 个月的紧张复习
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 hou4 lai2 jing1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 8 ge4 yue4 de5 jin3 zhang1 fu4 xi2
cues.en: Then, after 8 months of intense review,

cues.zh: 我就走入了这个考场
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zou3 ru4 le5 zhe4 ge5 kao3 chang3
cues.en: I walked into the exam room.

cues.zh: 那我记得我当时走入清华这个考场的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 ji4 de5 wo3 dang1 shi2 zou3 ru4 qing1 hua2 zhe4 ge5 kao3 chang3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: I remember when I walked into that Tsinghua exam room,

cues.zh: 也发生了一些意外
cues.pinyin: ye3 fa1 sheng1 le5 yi1 xie1 yi4 wai4
cues.en: some unexpected things happened too.

cues.zh: 什么意外呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 wai4 ne5
cues.en: What kind of accident?

cues.zh: 就是我在头一天晚上的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 zai4 tou2 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The night before,

cues.zh: 不知道吃什么吃坏肚子了
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 chi1 shen2 me5 chi1 huai4 du3 zi5 le5
cues.en: I ate something that upset my stomach, I don't know what.

cues.zh: 那一天晚上基本就没睡
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4 ji1 ben3 jiu4 mei2 shui4
cues.en: That night I basically didn't sleep at all.

cues.zh: 就是连续上厕所上了七八次
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 lian2 xu4 shang4 ce4 suo3 shang4 le5 qi1 ba1 ci4
cues.en: I went to the bathroom seven or eight times in a row.

cues.zh: 第二天早上起来就快虚脱了
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 kuai4 xu1 tuo1 le5
cues.en: The next morning I woke up nearly drained.

cues.zh: 整个人就懵了
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 ren2 jiu4 meng3 le5
cues.en: I was completely dazed.

cues.zh: 而且第二天早上起来
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: And on top of that, the next morning,

cues.zh: 我也不知道怎么想
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 xiang3
cues.en: I don't know what I was thinking,

cues.zh: 我还喝了一碗豆浆
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 he1 le5 yi1 wan3 dou4 jiang1
cues.en: but I still drank a bowl of soy milk.

cues.zh: 结果进了考场之后我就想上厕所
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jin4 le5 kao3 chang3 zhi1 hou4 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 shang4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: As a result, once I got into the exam room, I needed to use the bathroom.

cues.zh: 然后我又不知道能不能让我上厕所
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 you4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 neng2 bu4 neng2 rang4 wo3 shang4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: And I wasn't sure if I'd even be allowed to go.

cues.zh: 于是我就憋着
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 jiu4 bie1 zhe5
cues.en: So I held it in.

cues.zh: 我就开始憋憋憋
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 kai1 shi3 bie1 bie1 bie1
cues.en: I just kept holding it in, and holding it in.

cues.zh: 憋了一个半小时
cues.pinyin: bie1 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: I held it for an hour and a half.

cues.zh: 我实在是憋不住了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi2 zai4 shi4 bie1 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: I really couldn't hold it any longer.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 最后我就提前交卷去上厕所去了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 jiu4 ti2 qian2 jiao1 juan4 qu4 shang4 ce4 suo3 qu4 le5
cues.en: In the end, I turned in my test early just to go to the bathroom.

cues.zh: 这样一来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2
cues.en: Because of that,

cues.zh: 我第一课考政治就考得非常非常差
cues.pinyin: wo3 di4 yi1 ke4 kao3 zheng4 zhi4 jiu4 kao3 de2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 cha4
cues.en: I did really, really badly on the first exam, Politics.

cues.zh: 但是我那天中午的时候就在想
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 na4 tian1 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: But that noon, I found myself thinking,

cues.zh: 难道说我复习了这么长时间
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shuo1 wo3 fu4 xi2 le5 zhe4 me5 zhang3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: could it really be that after reviewing for so long,

cues.zh: 就因为我吃坏了肚子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 wo3 chi1 huai4 le5 du3 zi5
cues.en: just because I had an upset stomach,

cues.zh: 就因为我喝了一碗豆浆
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 wo3 he1 le5 yi1 wan3 dou4 jiang1
cues.en: just because I drank a bowl of soy milk,

cues.zh: 最后我就失去了这个机会吗
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ji1 hui4 ma5
cues.en: I would end up losing this opportunity?

cues.zh: 不行
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing2
cues.en: No way.

cues.zh: 我一定要抓紧后面的这些内容
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 ding4 yao4 zhua1 jin3 hou4 mian4 de5 zhe4 xie1 nei4 rong2
cues.en: I had to make sure to focus hard on what was left.

cues.zh: 然后那天中午
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na4 tian1 zhong1 wu3
cues.en: So that noon,

cues.zh: 我觉得宿舍里边好好的睡了一觉
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 su4 she4 li3 bian1 hao3 hao3 de5 shui4 le5 yi1 jiao4
cues.en: I went back to the dorm and had a really good sleep.

cues.zh: 睡得特别香
cues.pinyin: shui4 de2 te4 bie2 xiang1
cues.en: I slept really soundly.

cues.zh: 到了下午在考试的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 xia4 wu3 zai4 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: By the time the afternoon exam came around,

cues.zh: 我就感觉到顺风顺水
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gan3 jue2 dao4 shun4 feng1 shun4 shui3
cues.en: I felt like everything was going smoothly.

cues.zh: 就感觉越来越打越顺
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gan3 jue2 yue4 lai2 yue4 da3 yue4 shun4
cues.en: I felt like the more I answered, the smoother it went.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: You know.

cues.zh: 再往后到专业课的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 hou4 dao4 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Then later, when it came to the specialized subject exam,

cues.zh: 就觉得哇
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jue2 de5 wa5
cues.en: I thought, wow,

cues.zh: 这个专业课怎么这么简单呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 zen3 me5 zhe4 me5 jian3 dan1 ne5
cues.en: how is this specialized exam so easy?

cues.zh: 跟我复习的非常对路
cues.pinyin: gen1 wo3 fu4 xi2 de5 fei1 chang2 dui4 lu4
cues.en: It matched exactly what I had reviewed.

cues.zh: 结果我的专业课就考了 14 6 分
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 wo3 de5 zhuan1 ye4 ke4 jiu4 kao3 le5 14 6 fen1
cues.en: As a result, I scored 146 on the specialized subject.

cues.zh: 我只扣了 4 分
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 kou4 le5 4 fen1
cues.en: I only lost 4 points.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: You know.

cues.zh: 后来我就考了 4 20 多分
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 jiu4 kao3 le5 4 20 duo1 fen1
cues.en: In the end, I scored over 420 points total.

cues.zh: 最后就荣幸的被清华大学录取了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 jiu4 rong2 xing4 de5 bei4 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: and I was honored to be admitted to Tsinghua University.

cues.zh: 所以这件事又再次的给了我一个印证
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 you4 zai4 ci4 de5 gei3 le5 wo3 yi2 ge4 yin4 zheng4
cues.en: So this experience once again confirmed something for me.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我是怎么考上北大清华的？

cues.zh: 就是当你真的是对一件事
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dang1 ni3 zhen1 de5 shi4 dui4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: That is, when you've truly

cues.zh: 付出了足够的努力的时候
cues.pinyin: fu4 chu1 le5 zu2 gou4 de5 nu3 li4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: put in enough effort toward something,

cues.zh: 即便是你遇到了很多的意外
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 shi4 ni3 yu4 dao4 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: even if you run into a lot of unexpected setbacks,

cues.zh: 你也可以无惧这个意外
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 wu2 ju4 zhe4 ge5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: you can face them without fear.

cues.zh: 我想跟各位参加高考的考生说
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 gen1 ge4 wei4 can1 jia1 gao1 kao3 de5 kao3 sheng1 shuo1
cues.en: I want to tell all of you taking the college entrance exam

cues.zh: 这么一个故事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 gu4 shi4
cues.en: a story.

cues.zh: 这个故事是我小的时候看的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi4 shi4 wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 kan4 de5
cues.en: I read this story when I was young.

cues.zh: 就是有一个新兵
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 xin1 bing1
cues.en: There was a new recruit.

cues.zh: 他呢在第一次跳伞之前
cues.pinyin: ta1 ne5 zai4 di4 yi1 ci4 tiao4 san3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Before his first parachute jump,

cues.zh: 去问自己的教官
cues.pinyin: qu4 wen4 zi4 ji3 de5 jiao4 guan1
cues.en: he went to ask his instructor,

cues.zh: 说如果说我跳下去之后
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ru2 guo3 shuo1 wo3 tiao4 xia4 qu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: 'If, after I jump,

cues.zh: 发现我的伞包打不开了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 wo3 de5 san3 bao1 da3 bu4 kai1 le5
cues.en: I find that my main parachute won't open,

cues.zh: 我的备用伞包也打不开了
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 bei4 yong4 san3 bao1 ye3 da3 bu4 kai1 le5
cues.en: and my backup parachute won't open either,

cues.zh: 那我该怎么办呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 gai1 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5
cues.en: what should I do then?'

cues.zh: 这个时候这个教官就跟他说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 jiao4 guan1 jiu4 gen1 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: At that point, the instructor said to him,

cues.zh: 说呀当我当新兵的时候
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ya5 dang1 wo3 dang1 xin1 bing1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: 'When I was a new recruit,

cues.zh: 我也问过我的教官同样的问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 wen4 guo4 wo3 de5 jiao4 guan1 tong2 yang4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I asked my instructor that very same question.

cues.zh: 你知道教官是怎么回答我的吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 jiao4 guan1 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 wo3 de5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know how he answered me?

cues.zh: 教官跟我说
cues.pinyin: jiao4 guan1 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: My instructor told me,

cues.zh: 在一个成功者的眼中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 cheng2 gong1 zhe3 de5 yan3 zhong1
cues.en: "In the eyes of someone who succeeds,

cues.zh: 是没有那么多万一的
cues.pinyin: shi4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 duo1 wan4 yi1 de5
cues.en: there's no room for so many 'what ifs.'

cues.zh: 只有一万个信心
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yi1 wan4 ge4 xin4 xin1
cues.en: There's only absolute confidence."'

cues.zh: 然后就把我一脚踢了下去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 ba3 wo3 yi1 jiao3 ti1 le5 xia4 qu4
cues.en: Then he just kicked me right out of the plane.

cues.zh: 希望我们今年参加高考的考生中
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 wo3 men5 jin1 nian2 can1 jia1 gao1 kao3 de5 kao3 sheng1 zhong1
cues.en: I hope that among this year's college entrance exam candidates,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近一段时间我大 A 股又开启了一轮下跌
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 wo3 da4 A gu3 you4 kai1 qi3 le5 yi1 lun2 xia4 die1
cues.en: Recently our "Big A-shares" started another decline.

cues.zh: 我的股票和基金账户也跟各位小朋友一样
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 gu3 piao4 he2 ji1 jin1 zhang4 hu4 ye3 gen1 ge4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: My stock and fund accounts, just like all of yours,

cues.zh: 经历了一轮快速的缩水
cues.pinyin: jing1 li4 le5 yi1 lun2 kuai4 su4 de5 suo1 shui3
cues.en: went through a rapid shrinkage.

cues.zh: 有小朋友看到美国的道琼斯指
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 kan4 dao4 mei3 guo2 de5 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3
cues.en: Some of you saw that the US Dow Jones Index

cues.zh: 数从 2020 年最低
cues.pinyin: shu4 cong2 2020 nian2 zui4 di1
cues.en: from its lowest point in 2020

cues.zh: 点大约 18 000 点
cues.pinyin: dian3 da4 yue1 18 000 dian3
cues.en: was around 18,000 points,

cues.zh: 到现在已经到了 53 000 点左右增长了 200
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 dao4 le5 53 000 dian3 zuo3 you4 zeng1 zhang3 le5 200
cues.en: has now risen to about 53,000 points, an increase of 200%.

cues.zh: 可是 A 股的上证指数却跌跌不休
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 A gu3 de5 shang4 zheng4 zhi3 shu4 que4 die1 die1 bu4 xiu1
cues.en: But China's Shanghai Composite Index just keeps falling.

cues.zh: 瞬间就绷不住了
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 jiu4 beng1 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: and I instantly couldn't hold it together.

cues.zh: 即便是前一段时间
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 shi4 qian2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Even a while back,

cues.zh: 上证指数创出 10 年新高的时候
cues.pinyin: shang4 zheng4 zhi3 shu4 chuang4 chu1 10 nian2 xin1 gao1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when the Shanghai Composite hit a 10-year high,

cues.zh: 很多人的账户依然是亏损的
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 de5 zhang4 hu4 yi1 ran2 shi4 kui1 sun3 de5
cues.en: many people's accounts were still in the red.

cues.zh: 我当时还发了一条微博
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 hai2 fa1 le5 yi1 tiao2 wei1 bo2
cues.en: At the time I even posted on Weibo

cues.zh: 说上证指数创十年新高
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shang4 zheng4 zhi3 shu4 chuang4 shi2 nian2 xin1 gao1
cues.en: saying the Shanghai Composite hit a 10-year high,

cues.zh: 我的基金是五年内买的
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 ji1 jin1 shi4 wu3 nian2 nei4 mai3 de5
cues.en: but the fund I bought within the last five years

cues.zh: 但是还是没有回本
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 shi4 mei2 you3 hui2 ben3
cues.en: still hadn't broken even.

cues.zh: 结果就上了热搜
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 shang4 le5 re4 sou1
cues.en: As a result it became a trending topic.

cues.zh: 那你知道股票指数到底是什么吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 gu3 piao4 zhi3 shu4 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: So do you actually know what a stock index is?

cues.zh: 今天呢咱们就暂且不看账户
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ne5 zan2 men5 jiu4 zan4 qie3 bu4 kan4 zhang4 hu4
cues.en: Today let's set our accounts aside for now

cues.zh: 来讲一讲到底什么是股票指数
cues.pinyin: lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 dao4 di3 shen2 me5 shi4 gu3 piao4 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: and talk about what a stock index really is.

cues.zh: 在等待股市筑底的过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 deng3 dai4 gu3 shi4 zhu4 di3 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: While we wait for the market to bottom out,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 相互抚慰一下受伤的心灵
cues.pinyin: xiang1 hu4 fu3 wei4 yi1 xia4 shou4 shang1 de5 xin1 ling2
cues.en: let's comfort each other's wounded hearts.

cues.zh: 我们就从历史上最悠久的股票指数
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 cong2 li4 shi3 shang4 zui4 you1 jiu3 de5 gu3 piao4 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: Let's start with the oldest stock index in history,

cues.zh: 道琼斯指数开始吧
cues.pinyin: dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 kai1 shi3 ba5
cues.en: the Dow Jones Index.

cues.zh: 道琼斯指数
cues.pinyin: dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: The Dow Jones Index.

cues.zh: 道和琼斯是两个人
cues.pinyin: dao4 he2 qiong2 si1 shi4 liang3 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Dow and Jones were two people.

cues.zh: 那这个指数为什么以他们命名呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 zhi3 shu4 wei4 shen2 me5 yi3 ta1 men5 ming4 ming2 ne5
cues.en: So why is the index named after them?

cues.zh: 咱们来说一下
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's talk about it.

cues.zh: 世界上最早的股票和证券交易所是在荷兰
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 zao3 de5 gu3 piao4 he2 zheng4 quan4 jiao1 yi4 suo3 shi4 zai4 he2 lan2
cues.en: The world's earliest stock and securities exchange was in the Netherlands.

cues.zh: 荷兰呢为了出海
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 ne5 wei4 le5 chu1 hai3
cues.en: The Dutch, in order to sail overseas,

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 所以就发行股票
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 fa1 xing2 gu3 piao4
cues.en: issued stocks.

cues.zh: 大家一起凑钱
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 cou4 qian2
cues.en: Everyone pooled money together,

cues.zh: 然后出海了之后有了钱了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 chu1 hai3 le5 zhi1 hou4 you3 le5 qian2 le5
cues.en: and after sailing out and making money,

cues.zh: 咱们再进行分红
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 zai4 jin4 xing2 fen1 hong2
cues.en: they would then distribute dividends.

cues.zh: 后来美国建立了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 mei3 guo2 jian4 li4 le5
cues.en: Later, the United States was established.

cues.zh: 美国人说那我们也要搞股票啊
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 ren2 shuo1 na4 wo3 men5 ye3 yao4 gao3 gu3 piao4 a5
cues.en: Americans said, well, we should do stocks too,

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 所以美国人呢就在费城搞了一个交易所
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei3 guo2 ren2 ne5 jiu4 zai4 fei4 cheng2 gao3 le5 yi2 ge4 jiao1 yi4 suo3
cues.en: So Americans set up an exchange in Philadelphia.

cues.zh: 这就是美国最早的交易所
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 mei3 guo2 zui4 zao3 de5 jiao1 yi4 suo3
cues.en: This was America's earliest exchange.

cues.zh: 在 17 90 年的费城
cues.pinyin: zai4 17 90 nian2 de5 fei4 cheng2
cues.en: In Philadelphia in 1790,

cues.zh: 叫做费城证券交易所
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 fei4 cheng2 zheng4 quan4 jiao1 yi4 suo3
cues.en: called the Philadelphia Stock Exchange.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 第一件事就是交易员必须得有资质
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 jiao1 yi4 yuan2 bi4 xu1 de2 you3 zi1 zhi4
cues.en: The first thing was that traders had to be qualified.

cues.zh: 所有的交易员咱们都必须签订梧桐树协议
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 jiao1 yi4 yuan2 zan2 men5 dou1 bi4 xu1 qian1 ding4 wu2 tong2 shu4 xie2 yi4
cues.en: All traders had to sign the Buttonwood Agreement.

cues.zh: 你必须遵守我们的规则才能是交易员
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi4 xu1 zun1 shou3 wo3 men5 de5 gui1 ze2 cai2 neng2 shi4 jiao1 yi4 yuan2
cues.en: You had to follow our rules to be a trader.

cues.zh: 如果你要是不遵守规则
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 yao4 shi4 bu4 zun1 shou3 gui1 ze2
cues.en: If you didn't follow the rules

cues.zh: 不签协议的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 qian1 xie2 yi4 de5 hua4
cues.en: and didn't sign the agreement,

cues.zh: 其他交易员是不能跟你进行交易的
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 jiao1 yi4 yuan2 shi4 bu4 neng2 gen1 ni3 jin4 xing2 jiao1 yi4 de5
cues.en: other traders wouldn't be allowed to trade with you.

cues.zh: 另外呢
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 ne5
cues.en: Also,

cues.zh: 我们在交易的过程之中
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 jiao1 yi4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: during the trading process,

cues.zh: 怎么样啊
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 yang4 a5
cues.en: how should it be?

cues.zh: 我们要保证啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 bao3 zheng4 a5
cues.en: We had to guarantee

cues.zh: 这个佣金不能低于 0 25
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yong4 jin1 bu4 neng2 di1 yu2 0 25
cues.en: that the commission couldn't be lower than 0.25.

cues.zh: 交易员的工作
cues.pinyin: jiao1 yi4 yuan2 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: A trader's job

cues.zh: 就是带客户去买卖股票
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dai4 ke4 hu4 qu4 mai3 mai4 gu3 piao4
cues.en: was to help clients buy and sell stocks.

cues.zh: 他们签了这么一个协议之后呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 qian1 le5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 xie2 yi4 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After they signed this agreement,

cues.zh: 逐渐就形成了一种行业的一个规则
cues.pinyin: zhu2 jian4 jiu4 xing2 cheng2 le5 yi1 zhong3 hang2 ye4 de5 yi2 ge4 gui1 ze2
cues.en: it gradually became an industry rule.

cues.zh: 这个华尔街呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hua2 er3 jie1 ne5
cues.en: And so Wall Street

cues.zh: 就成为了美国的这种证券的交易中心
cues.pinyin: jiu4 cheng2 wei2 le5 mei3 guo2 de5 zhe4 zhong3 zheng4 quan4 de5 jiao1 yi4 zhong1 xin1
cues.en: became America's center for securities trading.

cues.zh: 那么到了 18 63 年
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dao4 le5 18 63 nian2
cues.en: Then by 1863,

cues.zh: 18 63 年的时候
cues.pinyin: 18 63 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 就以华尔街为核心
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi3 hua2 er3 jie1 wei4 he2 xin1
cues.en: with Wall Street at its core,

cues.zh: 成立了什么呀
cues.pinyin: cheng2 li4 le5 shen2 me5 ya5
cues.en: what was established?

cues.zh: 成立了纽约证券交易所
cues.pinyin: cheng2 li4 le5 niu3 yue1 zheng4 quan4 jiao1 yi4 suo3
cues.en: The New York Stock Exchange was established.

cues.zh: 也就是纽交所
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 niu3 jiao1 suo3
cues.en: That is, the NYSE.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 名字叫做查尔斯道
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 cha2 er3 si1 dao4
cues.en: His name was Charles Dow.

cues.zh: 查尔斯道
cues.pinyin: cha2 er3 si1 dao4
cues.en: Charles Dow.

cues.zh: 这个查尔斯道啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cha2 er3 si1 dao4 a5
cues.en: This Charles Dow

cues.zh: 其实他连初中都没毕业
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ta1 lian2 chu1 zhong1 dou1 mei2 bi4 ye4
cues.en: actually never even finished middle school.

cues.zh: 但是他很聪明啊
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 hen3 cong1 ming2 a5
cues.en: But he was very smart.

cues.zh: 还有一个人叫爱德华琼斯
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 jiao4 ai4 de2 hua2 qiong2 si1
cues.en: There was also a man named Edward Jones.

cues.zh: 爱德华琼斯
cues.pinyin: ai4 de2 hua2 qiong2 si1
cues.en: Edward Jones.

cues.zh: 这两个人他们就创立了一家公司
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 ren2 ta1 men5 jiu4 chuang4 li4 le5 yi1 jia1 gong1 si1
cues.en: The two of them founded a company together.

cues.zh: 这家公司就叫道琼斯公司
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jia1 gong1 si1 jiu4 jiao4 dao4 qiong2 si1 gong1 si1
cues.en: This company was called Dow Jones & Company.

cues.zh: 那他们的工作是什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 men5 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what was their job?

cues.zh: 其实就是给客户打电话
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ke4 hu4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: It was basically calling clients

cues.zh: 告诉他们今天的股票价格是多少
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 gu3 piao4 jia4 ge2 shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: to tell them what today's stock prices were.

cues.zh: 那后来他们就想
cues.pinyin: na4 hou4 lai2 ta1 men5 jiu4 xiang3
cues.en: Later they thought,

cues.zh: 我们怎么样快速的用一个数
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zen3 me5 yang4 kuai4 su4 de5 yong4 yi2 ge4 shu4
cues.en: how could we quickly use a single number

cues.zh: 来告诉客户们整体的股市情况呢
cues.pinyin: lai2 gao4 su4 ke4 hu4 men5 zheng3 ti3 de5 gu3 shi4 qing2 kuang4 ne5
cues.en: to tell clients the overall state of the market?

cues.zh: 于是他们就编了一个指数
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 jiu4 bian1 le5 yi2 ge4 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: So they created an index,

cues.zh: 就是所谓的道琼斯指数
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 suo3 wei4 de5 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: the so-called Dow Jones Index.

cues.zh: 这个道琼斯指数叫 D JI
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 jiao4 D JI
cues.en: This Dow Jones Index is called DJI.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 这个道琼斯指数怎么做的呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 zen3 me5 zuo4 de5 ne5
cues.en: How was this Dow Jones Index made?

cues.zh: 就他们当时选举了 12 只最重要的工业股
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ta1 men5 dang1 shi2 xuan3 ju3 le5 12 zhi3 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 gong1 ye4 gu3
cues.en: They selected the 12 most important industrial stocks at the time.

cues.zh: 因为当时的美国工业正在大发展
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dang1 shi2 de5 mei3 guo2 gong1 ye4 zheng4 zai4 da4 fa1 zhan3
cues.en: Because American industry was booming at the time,

cues.zh: 工业代表了未来
cues.pinyin: gong1 ye4 dai4 biao3 le5 wei4 lai2
cues.en: industry represented the future.

cues.zh: 什么工业股呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 gong1 ye4 gu3 ne5
cues.en: What kind of industrial stocks?

cues.zh: 比如造棉花的造烟草的
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zao4 mian2 hua1 de5 zao4 yan1 cao3 de5
cues.en: Things like cotton makers and tobacco makers,

cues.zh: 还有造电器的像通用电器
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zao4 dian4 qi4 de5 xiang4 tong1 yong4 dian4 qi4
cues.en: and electrical appliance makers, like General Electric.

cues.zh: 他把这些个工业股
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zhe4 xie1 ge4 gong1 ye4 gu3
cues.en: He took these industrial stocks

cues.zh: 他们的股票价格取得一个平均
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 gu3 piao4 jia4 ge2 qu3 de2 yi2 ge4 ping2 jun1
cues.en: and took an average of their stock prices.

cues.zh: 第一个股票价格是 P 1
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 gu3 piao4 jia4 ge2 shi4 P 1
cues.en: The first stock's price was P1,

cues.zh: 第二个股票价格是 P 2
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 gu3 piao4 jia4 ge2 shi4 P 2
cues.en: the second stock's price was P2,

cues.zh: 一直到最后一只股票
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 dao4 zui4 hou4 yi1 zhi1 gu3 piao4
cues.en: all the way to the last stock,

cues.zh: 它价格是 P 12
cues.pinyin: ta1 jia4 ge2 shi4 P 12
cues.en: whose price was P12.

cues.zh: 然后把它呢再除以 12
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 ne5 zai4 chu2 yi3 12
cues.en: Then they divided that by 12

cues.zh: 就得到了一个指数
cues.pinyin: jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 zhi3 shu4
cues.en: and got an index.

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 那么如果说
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 shuo1
cues.en: So if, say,

cues.zh: 有一支工业股价格上涨
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 zhi1 gong1 ye4 gu3 jia4 ge2 shang4 zhang3
cues.en: one industrial stock's price went up

cues.zh: 其他工业股价格都不变
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 gong1 ye4 gu3 jia4 ge2 dou1 bu4 bian4
cues.en: while the others stayed the same,

cues.zh: 那我们就说
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: then we'd say

cues.zh: 这个道琼斯指数就会上涨
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 jiu4 hui4 shang4 zhang3
cues.en: the Dow Jones Index would rise.

cues.zh: 如果一支下跌其他不变
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 zhi1 xia4 die1 qi2 ta1 bu4 bian4
cues.en: If one fell while the others stayed the same,

cues.zh: 整体指数就下跌
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ti3 zhi3 shu4 jiu4 xia4 die1
cues.en: the overall index would fall.

cues.zh: 如果有涨有跌呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 zhang3 you3 die1 ne5
cues.en: If some rose and some fell,

cues.zh: 那就看是涨的多
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 kan4 shi4 zhang3 de5 duo1
cues.en: then it depended on whether the gains

cues.zh: 还是跌的多就行了
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 die1 de5 duo1 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: outweighed the losses, or vice versa.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中美股市哪个更赚钱？为什么道指屡创新高，上证指数永远3000点？

cues.zh: 好道琼斯指数呢
cues.pinyin: hao3 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 ne5
cues.en: Okay, the Dow Jones Index

cues.zh: 其实也经历了一些变化
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ye3 jing1 li4 le5 yi1 xie1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: actually went through some changes too.

cues.zh: 举个例子来说
cues.pinyin: ju3 ge4 li4 zi5 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: For example,

cues.zh: 我们说美国的股市啊有上万只股
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shuo1 mei3 guo2 de5 gu3 shi4 a5 you3 shang4 wan4 zhi3 gu3
cues.en: the US stock market has tens of thousands of stocks,

cues.zh: 结果你道琼斯指数只有 12 只
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ni3 dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 zhi3 you3 12 zhi3
cues.en: yet the Dow Jones Index only had 12.

cues.zh: 所以在 1928 年的时候啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 1928 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 a5
cues.en: Isn't that too few?

cues.zh: 所以在 19 28 年的时候啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 19 28 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 a5
cues.en: So in 1928,

cues.zh: 它是经历了一次扩容
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 jing1 li4 le5 yi1 ci4 kuo4 rong2
cues.en: it underwent an expansion.

cues.zh: 19 28 年的时候啊
cues.pinyin: 19 28 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 a5

cues.zh: 道琼斯指数的这个成分股啊
cues.pinyin: dao4 qiong2 si1 zhi3 shu4 de5 zhe4 ge5 cheng2 fen4 gu3 a5
cues.en: the Dow Jones Index's component stocks

cues.zh: 从 12 只
cues.pinyin: cong2 12 zhi3
cues.en: went from 12

cues.zh: 12 只扩容到了 30 只
cues.pinyin: 12 zhi3 kuo4 rong2 dao4 le5 30 zhi3
cues.en: 12 expanded to 30.

cues.zh: 扩容到了 30 只
cues.pinyin: kuo4 rong2 dao4 le5 30 zhi3
cues.en: expanded to 30.

cues.zh: 而且呢 19 28 年 10 月 1 号的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ne5 19 28 nian2 10 yue4 1 hao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: And on October 1, 1928,

cues.zh: 10 月 1 号的时候
cues.pinyin: 10 yue4 1 hao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: on October 1,

cues.zh: 这股票指数正好是 100 点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu3 piao4 zhi3 shu4 zheng4 hao3 shi4 100 dian3
cues.en: the index was exactly 100 points.

cues.zh: 一般以 1928 年 10 月 1 号为基准
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 yi3 1928 nian2 10 yue4 1 hao4 wei4 ji1 zhun3
cues.en: So later, when people calculated it,

cues.zh: 一般以 19 28 年 10 月 1 号为基准
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 yi3 19 28 nian2 10 yue4 1 hao4 wei4 ji1 zhun3
cues.en: they generally used October 1, 1928 as the baseline,

cues.zh: 因为此时呢它刚好就是 100 点
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ci3 shi2 ne5 ta1 gang1 hao3 jiu4 shi4 100 dian3
cues.en: because at that point it was exactly 100.

cues.zh: 而且我们说这个成分股
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 wo3 men5 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 cheng2 fen4 gu3
cues.en: And we should note that these component stocks

cues.zh: 它也不是一成不变的
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 bu2 shi4 yi1 cheng2 bu4 bian4 de5
cues.en: aren't fixed forever either.

cues.zh: 如果说呢你这个股票啊
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shuo1 ne5 ni3 zhe4 ge5 gu3 piao4 a5
cues.en: If a stock

cues.zh: 这个越来越差
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yue4 lai2 yue4 cha4
cues.en: kept getting worse,

cues.zh: 行业没落了
cues.pinyin: hang2 ye4 mo4 luo4 le5
cues.en: the industry declined,

cues.zh: 或者你公司经营不善
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 ni3 gong1 si1 jing1 ying2 bu4 shan4
cues.en: or the company was poorly managed,

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话精华集12｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 大大我问你哦什么东西大家都不喜欢吃呢
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 shen2 me5 dong1 xi1 da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 xi3 huan1 chi1 ne5
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you — what does everyone dislike eating?

cues.zh: 大家都不喜欢吃
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 bu4 xi3 huan1 chi1
cues.en: Everyone dislikes eating it?

cues.zh: 吃药我不喜欢吃药吃药也是可以
cues.pinyin: chi1 yao4 wo3 bu4 xi3 huan1 chi1 yao4 chi1 yao4 ye3 shi4 ke3 yi3
cues.en: Medicine — I don't like taking medicine, but 'medicine' could work too.

cues.zh: 但是答案不是这个
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da2 an4 bu2 shi4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: But that's not the answer.

cues.zh: 饭是什么是吃亏
cues.pinyin: fan4 shi4 shen2 me5 shi4 chi1 kui1
cues.en: The answer is 'chikui' — taking a loss.

cues.zh: 大大我问你哦什么车寸步难行
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 shen2 me5 che1 cun4 bu4 nan2 xing2
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you — what vehicle can't move even an inch?

cues.zh: 这个太简单了啦坏掉的车啦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tai4 jian3 dan1 le5 la5 huai4 diao4 de5 che1 la5
cues.en: That's too easy — a broken-down car.

cues.zh: 对不对坏掉的车可以走吗
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4 huai4 diao4 de5 che1 ke3 yi3 zou3 ma5
cues.en: Right? Can a broken car move?

cues.zh: 有时候可以推啊也是可以走啊哦
cues.pinyin: you3 shi2 hou4 ke3 yi3 tui1 a5 ye3 shi4 ke3 yi3 zou3 a5 o2
cues.en: Sometimes you can push it, so it can still move.

cues.zh: 那答案是什么是风车不能走的
cues.pinyin: na4 da2 an4 shi4 shen2 me5 shi4 feng1 che1 bu4 neng2 zou3 de5
cues.en: So what's the answer? A windmill — it can't move without wind.

cues.zh: 为什么你最近都那么晚下班啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ni3 zui4 jin4 dou1 na4 me5 wan3 xia4 ban1 a5
cues.en: Why have you been getting off work so late lately?

cues.zh: 哦因为我想加薪啊
cues.pinyin: o2 yin1 wei4 wo3 xiang3 jia1 xin1 a5
cues.en: Oh, because I want... 'Jiaxin'.

cues.zh: 加薪是谁
cues.pinyin: jia1 xin1 shi4 shui2
cues.en: Who's Jiaxin?

cues.zh: 说加薪是谁
cues.pinyin: shuo1 jia1 xin1 shi4 shui2
cues.en: Tell me, who is Jiaxin?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话精华集12｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你喔
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Chenchen, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 一口咬掉牛尾巴差一个字
cues.pinyin: yi1 kou3 yao3 diao4 niu2 wei3 ba5 cha4 yi2 ge4 zi4
cues.en: Bite a cow's tail off in one bite — guess the phrase, one character off.

cues.zh: 嗯为什么每次你考试
cues.pinyin: n2 wei4 shen2 me5 mei3 ci4 ni3 kao3 shi4
cues.en: Hmm, why is it that every time you take a test,

cues.zh: 钱都要把鼻通力的笔都数一遍啊
cues.pinyin: qian2 dou1 yao4 ba3 bi2 tong1 li4 de5 bi3 dou1 shu4 yi1 bian4 a5
cues.en: you have to count all the pens in your pencil case?

cues.zh: 你不知道吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ma5
cues.en: Didn't you know?

cues.zh: 只要是笔百战百胜啊
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 shi4 bi3 bai3 zhan4 bai3 sheng4 a5
cues.en: As long as it's a pen, it's undefeated in battle!

cues.zh: 为了学好英文
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 xue2 hao3 ying1 wen2
cues.en: To learn English well,

cues.zh: 上个月我跟我朋友约好
cues.pinyin: shang4 ge4 yue4 wo3 gen1 wo3 peng2 you3 yue1 hao3
cues.en: last month my friend and I agreed

cues.zh: 以后聊天都只能
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 liao2 tian1 dou1 zhi3 neng2
cues.en: that from then on we'd only chat

cues.zh: 我们讲英文
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiang3 ying1 wen2
cues.en: in English.

cues.zh: 那结果咧
cues.pinyin: na4 jie2 guo3 lie3
cues.en: So how did it turn out?

cues.zh: 结果我们都先学会了手语
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 wo3 men5 dou1 xian1 xue2 hui4 le5 shou3 yu3
cues.en: Turns out we both learned sign language first.

cues.zh: 已经长得像什么呢
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 zhang3 de2 xiang4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What does it look like now?

cues.zh: 呃我想一想喔
cues.pinyin: e4 wo3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 o1
cues.en: Uh, let me think...

cues.zh: 像黑心的心
cues.pinyin: xiang4 hei1 xin1 de5 xin1
cues.en: Like a black heart.

cues.zh: 老公我想要去学游泳
cues.pinyin: lao3 gong1 wo3 xiang3 yao4 qu4 xue2 you2 yong3
cues.en: Honey, I want to learn how to swim.

cues.zh: 因为游泳可以瘦身减肥
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 you2 yong3 ke3 yi3 shou4 shen1 jian3 fei2
cues.en: Because swimming can help me slim down.

cues.zh: 别傻了啦
cues.pinyin: bie2 sha3 le5 la5
cues.en: Don't be silly.

cues.zh: 你看那个鲸鱼 24 小时都在游泳
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 na4 ge5 jing1 yu2 24 xiao3 shi2 dou1 zai4 you2 yong3
cues.en: Look at whales — they swim 24 hours a day.

cues.zh: 牠有瘦过吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 shou4 guo4 ma5
cues.en: Have they ever lost weight?

cues.zh: 那为什么后来把牠放掉了呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wei4 shen2 me5 hou4 lai2 ba3 ta1 fang4 diao4 le5 ne5
cues.en: So why did they let it go afterward?

cues.zh: 呃因为牠们已经吃饱了
cues.pinyin: e4 yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 yi3 jing1 chi1 bao3 le5
cues.en: Uh, because it had already eaten its fill?

cues.zh: 错因为他太
cues.pinyin: cuo4 yin1 wei4 ta1 tai4
cues.en: Wrong — because it was too fat.

cues.zh: 做人不要总是想要跟别人比较
cues.pinyin: zuo4 ren2 bu2 yao4 zong3 shi4 xiang3 yao4 gen1 bie2 ren2 bi3 jiao4
cues.en: In life, you shouldn't always compare yourself to others.

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why not?

cues.zh: 因为一直输很累
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yi4 zhi2 shu1 hen3 lei4
cues.en: Because always losing is exhausting.

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Shanshan, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 有一天啊有一个人走在路上
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 a5 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zou3 zai4 lu4 shang4
cues.en: One day, a man was walking down the street,

cues.zh: 结果放屁很大声耶
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fang4 pi4 hen3 da4 sheng1 ye2
cues.en: and he let out a really loud fart.

cues.zh: 为什么知不知道
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhi1 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Why? Do you know?

cues.zh: 会不会是因为他吃太多烤万薯了
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 chi1 tai4 duo1 kao3 wan4 shu3 le5
cues.en: Could it be because he ate too many roasted sweet potatoes?

cues.zh: 不是答案是因为他穿喇叭裤
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 da2 an4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 chuan1 la3 ba1 ku4
cues.en: No — the answer is because he was wearing bell-bottoms.

cues.zh: 动动脑时间
cues.pinyin: dong4 dong4 nao3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Brain-teaser time!

cues.zh: 跑步比赛中
cues.pinyin: pao3 bu4 bi3 sai4 zhong1
cues.en: In a running race,

cues.zh: 你超过了第二名
cues.pinyin: ni3 chao1 guo4 le5 di4 er4 ming2
cues.en: you overtake the person in second place.

cues.zh: 那你是第几名呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 shi4 di4 ji3 ming2 ne5
cues.en: What place are you in now?

cues.zh: 知道答案的
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 de5
cues.en: If you know the answer,

cues.zh: 可在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: leave a comment below and tell everyone!

cues.zh: 你怎么哭了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 ku1 le5
cues.en: Why are you crying?

cues.zh: 刚刚我在路上遇到一个乞丐跟我要钱
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 wo3 zai4 lu4 shang4 yu4 dao4 yi2 ge4 qi3 gai4 gen1 wo3 yao4 qian2
cues.en: I just ran into a beggar on the road who asked me for money.

cues.zh: 我看他心里就难过了起来
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 ta1 xin1 li3 jiu4 nan2 guo4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Seeing him made me feel sad.

cues.zh: 你真善良耶有恻隐之心别难过了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhen1 shan4 liang2 ye2 you3 ce4 yin3 zhi1 xin1 bie2 nan2 guo4 le5
cues.en: You're so kind, you have such compassion, don't be sad.

cues.zh: 我是看他碗里的钱比我还多
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 kan4 ta1 wan3 li3 de5 qian2 bi3 wo3 hai2 duo1
cues.en: It's because I saw his bowl had more money in it than I do

cues.zh: 我才难过起来的
cues.pinyin: wo3 cai2 nan2 guo4 qi3 lai2 de5
cues.en: that I got sad.

cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 shen2 me5 ne5

cues.zh: 不对

cues.zh: 穷凶极恶的男在杀妻子之后入狱
cues.pinyin: qiong2 xiong1 ji2 e4 de5 nan2 zai4 sha1 qi1 zi3 zhi1 hou4 ru4 yu4
cues.en: A vicious man goes to prison after killing his wife.

cues.zh: 令人震惊的是
cues.pinyin: ling4 ren2 zhen4 jing1 de5 shi4
cues.en: Shockingly,

cues.zh: 他只被判了三年缓刑出狱
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 bei4 pan4 le5 san1 nian2 huan3 xing2 chu1 yu4
cues.en: he's only sentenced to three years' probation and is released.

cues.zh: 回到家里他对着女儿痛哭流涕
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 jia1 li3 ta1 dui4 zhe5 nv3 er2 tong4 ku1 liu2 ti4
cues.en: Back home, he weeps bitterly in front of his daughter.

cues.zh: 女儿原本在水杯里下了老鼠药
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 yuan2 ben3 zai4 shui3 bei1 li3 xia4 le5 lao3 shu3 yao4
cues.en: The daughter had earlier put rat poison in a glass of water,

cues.zh: 想要先发制人
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 xian1 fa1 zhi4 ren2
cues.en: wanting to strike first.

cues.zh: 但是他一见父亲居然向自己忏悔
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 yi1 jian4 fu4 qin1 ju1 ran2 xiang4 zi4 ji3 chan4 hui3
cues.en: But when she saw her father actually confessing to her,

cues.zh: 女儿顿时心软了
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 dun4 shi2 xin1 ruan3 le5
cues.en: she softened.

cues.zh: 他赶紧拿起水杯想要去换一杯水
cues.pinyin: ta1 gan3 jin3 na2 qi3 shui3 bei1 xiang3 yao4 qu4 huan4 yi1 bei1 shui3
cues.en: She quickly grabbed the glass to go get a fresh one.

cues.zh: 没想到父亲在他起身之后
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 fu4 qin1 zai4 ta1 qi3 shen1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: She never expected that after he stood up,

cues.zh: 露出了本来面目
cues.pinyin: lu4 chu1 le5 ben3 lai2 mian4 mu4
cues.en: her father showed his true colors.

cues.zh: 他从背后对女儿展开了袭击
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 bei4 hou4 dui4 nv3 er2 zhan3 kai1 le5 xi2 ji1
cues.en: He attacked his daughter from behind.

cues.zh: 原来他根本不后悔自己做的事
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 gen1 ben3 bu4 hou4 hui3 zi4 ji3 zuo4 de5 shi4
cues.en: It turned out he never regretted what he'd done at all—

cues.zh: 只后悔当初还留下了女儿这个活口
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hou4 hui3 dang1 chu1 hai2 liu2 xia4 le5 nv3 er2 zhe4 ge5 huo2 kou3
cues.en: he only regretted leaving his daughter alive as a witness.

cues.zh: 眼见小女孩命悬一线
cues.pinyin: yan3 jian4 xiao3 nv3 hai2 ming4 xuan2 yi1 xian4
cues.en: Just as the girl's life hung by a thread,

cues.zh: 突然一发子弹穿过了她家的窗户
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 yi1 fa1 zi3 dan4 chuan1 guo4 le5 ta1 jia1 de5 chuang1 hu4
cues.en: a bullet suddenly shot through the window of her house,

cues.zh: 将男人当场放倒
cues.pinyin: jiang1 nan2 ren2 dang1 chang3 fang4 dao3
cues.en: dropping the man on the spot.

cues.zh: 小女孩十分惊愕
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 shi2 fen1 jing1 e4
cues.en: The girl was utterly stunned.

cues.zh: 她顺着枪声传来的方向一路找了过去
cues.pinyin: ta1 shun4 zhe5 qiang1 sheng1 chuan2 lai2 de5 fang1 xiang4 yi1 lu4 zhao3 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: She followed the direction the gunshot came from,

cues.zh: 最后在一处楼顶上发现了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zai4 yi1 chu4 lou2 ding3 shang4 fa1 xian4 le5
cues.en: and finally, on a rooftop,

cues.zh: 杀手写在雪地上的圣诞快乐
cues.pinyin: sha1 shou3 xie3 zai4 xue3 di4 shang4 de5 sheng4 dan4 kuai4 le4
cues.en: found 'Merry Christmas' written in the snow by the killer.

cues.zh: 原来今天是圣诞节
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 jin1 tian1 shi4 sheng4 dan4 jie2
cues.en: It turned out today was Christmas.

cues.zh: 不久之前
cues.pinyin: bu4 jiu3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Not long before,

cues.zh: 小女孩一个人站在圣诞树下
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 yi2 ge4 ren2 zhan4 zai4 sheng4 dan4 shu4 xia4
cues.en: the little girl had stood alone under a Christmas tree,

cues.zh: 看着那些琳琅满目的礼物掉眼泪
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 na4 xie1 lin2 lang2 man3 mu4 di4 li3 wu4 diao4 yan3 lei4
cues.en: crying as she looked at all the dazzling gifts.

cues.zh: 当时一个女人安慰她
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 yi2 ge4 nv3 ren2 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: At the time, a woman comforted her.

cues.zh: 对方让她回到家里之后
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 rang4 ta1 hui2 dao4 jia1 li3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: The woman told her that once she got home,

cues.zh: 打开窗户说不定会收到圣诞礼物
cues.pinyin: da3 kai1 chuang1 hu4 shuo1 bu4 ding4 hui4 shou1 dao4 sheng4 dan4 li3 wu4
cues.en: if she opened the window, she might receive a Christmas present.

cues.zh: 小女孩照做了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 zhao4 zuo4 le5
cues.en: The girl did as she was told.

cues.zh: 结果父亲的死亡就是他的圣诞礼物
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fu4 qin1 de5 si3 wang2 jiu4 shi4 ta1 de5 sheng4 dan4 li3 wu4
cues.en: In the end, her father's death turned out to be her Christmas present.

cues.zh: 而这位杀手便是大名鼎鼎的翠鸟
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 wei4 sha1 shou3 bian4 shi4 da4 ming2 ding3 ding3 de5 cui4 niao3
cues.en: And this killer was none other than the famous Kingfisher.

cues.zh: 翠鸟这个代号人尽皆知
cues.pinyin: cui4 niao3 zhe4 ge5 dai4 hao4 ren2 jin3 jie1 zhi1
cues.en: Everyone knew the codename 'Kingfisher.'

cues.zh: 只因为这种鸟速度极快
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yin1 wei4 zhe4 zhong3 niao3 su4 du4 ji2 kuai4
cues.en: It was because this bird is extremely fast—

cues.zh: 一旦发现目标便会射入水中
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 fa1 xian4 mu4 biao1 bian4 hui4 she4 ru4 shui3 zhong1
cues.en: once it spots its target, it dives straight into the water.

cues.zh: 普通人连羽毛都难以看清
cues.pinyin: pu3 tong1 ren2 lian2 yu3 mao2 dou1 nan2 yi3 kan4 qing1
cues.en: Ordinary people can't even make out its feathers.

cues.zh: 但藏在代号之下的其实只是一
cues.pinyin: dan4 cang2 zai4 dai4 hao4 zhi1 xia4 de5 qi2 shi2 zhi3 shi4 yi1
cues.en: But hidden behind that codename was really just

cues.zh: 个普通的母亲
cues.pinyin: ge4 pu3 tong1 de5 mu3 qin1
cues.en: an ordinary mother.

cues.zh: 她的真名是刘宝娜
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhen1 ming2 shi4 liu2 bao3 na4
cues.en: Her real name was Liu Bao-na.

cues.zh: 几年后的今天
cues.pinyin: ji3 nian2 hou4 de5 jin1 tian1
cues.en: Years later, today,

cues.zh: 刘宝娜今天却忍不住笑了笑
cues.pinyin: liu2 bao3 na4 jin1 tian1 que4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 xiao4 le5 xiao4
cues.en: Liu Bao-na couldn't help but smile.

cues.zh: 她要回到阔别已久的职场
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 hui2 dao4 kuo4 bie2 yi3 jiu3 de5 zhi2 chang3
cues.en: She was about to return to the workplace she'd been away from for so long.

cues.zh: 这场产假她已经休了三年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 chan3 jia4 ta1 yi3 jing1 xiu1 le5 san1 nian2
cues.en: She had taken three years of maternity leave.

cues.zh: 但全职妈妈要回归职场
cues.pinyin: dan4 quan2 zhi2 ma1 ma1 yao4 hui2 gui1 zhi2 chang3
cues.en: But for a stay-at-home mom returning to work,

cues.zh: 第一个面临的压力就是婆婆的不满
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 mian4 lin2 de5 ya1 li4 jiu4 shi4 po2 po5 de5 bu4 man3
cues.en: the first pressure she faced was her mother-in-law's disapproval.

cues.zh: 婆婆经营着一家炸鸡店
cues.pinyin: po2 po5 jing1 ying2 zhe5 yi1 jia1 zha4 ji1 dian4
cues.en: Her mother-in-law ran a fried chicken shop.

cues.zh: 她对刘宝娜怎么看都不顺眼
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 liu2 bao3 na4 zen3 me5 kan4 dou1 bu4 shun4 yan3
cues.en: No matter how she looked at Liu Bao-na, she didn't like her,

cues.zh: 因为她觉得刘宝娜还不够贤惠
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 jue2 de5 liu2 bao3 na4 hai2 bu4 gou4 xian2 hui4
cues.en: because she felt Liu Bao-na wasn't virtuous enough.

cues.zh: 接着主管往前走了几步
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 zhu3 guan3 wang3 qian2 zou3 le5 ji3 bu4
cues.en: Then the manager took a few steps forward

cues.zh: 又被突然掉落的豆子绊了一跤
cues.pinyin: you4 bei4 tu1 ran2 diao4 luo4 de5 dou4 zi5 ban4 le5 yi1 jiao1
cues.en: and was tripped again by beans that suddenly fell.

cues.zh: 最后她刚爬起来
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 gang1 pa2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Just as she got back up,

cues.zh: 刘宝娜又再次扔出一个土豆
cues.pinyin: liu2 bao3 na4 you4 zai4 ci4 reng1 chu1 yi2 ge4 tu3 dou4
cues.en: Liu Bao-na threw another potato,

cues.zh: 精准命中额头
cues.pinyin: jing1 zhun3 ming4 zhong4 e2 tou2
cues.en: hitting her square on the forehead.

cues.zh: 随着超市的广播优惠声音响起
cues.pinyin: sui2 zhe5 chao1 shi4 de5 guang3 bo1 you1 hui4 sheng1 yin1 xiang3 qi3
cues.en: As the supermarket's discount announcement sounded,

cues.zh: 所有的妈妈都一直冲向优惠区
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 ma1 ma1 dou1 yi4 zhi2 chong1 xiang4 you1 hui4 qu1
cues.en: all the moms rushed straight toward the discount section.

cues.zh: 刘宝纳混在人群中完全没有被察觉
cues.pinyin: liu2 bao3 na4 hun4 zai4 ren2 qun2 zhong1 wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 bei4 cha2 jue2
cues.en: Liu Bao-na blended into the crowd completely unnoticed.

cues.zh: 刘宝纳的丈夫全泰成是一个记者
cues.pinyin: liu2 bao3 na4 de5 zhang4 fu1 quan2 tai4 cheng2 shi4 yi2 ge4 ji4 zhe3
cues.en: Liu Bao-na's husband, Jeon Tae-seong, was a reporter.

cues.zh: 这天她去酒吧根据线人提供的线索
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 ta1 qu4 jiu3 ba1 gen1 ju4 xian4 ren2 ti2 gong1 de5 xian4 suo3
cues.en: That day, based on a tip from an informant, she went to a bar,

cues.zh: 试图找到毒品分销网络的下线
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 zhao3 dao4 du2 pin3 fen1 xiao1 wang3 luo4 de5 xia4 xian4
cues.en: trying to find the downstream link in a drug distribution network.

cues.zh: 当晚她瞄准目标
cues.pinyin: dang4 wan3 ta1 miao2 zhun3 mu4 biao1
cues.en: That night she locked onto her target

cues.zh: 跟踪对方来到偏僻的山路
cues.pinyin: gen1 zong1 dui4 fang1 lai2 dao4 pian1 pi4 de5 shan1 lu4
cues.en: and tracked him to a remote mountain road.

cues.zh: 没想到毒贩的车辆突然发生爆炸
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 du2 fan4 de5 che1 liang4 tu1 ran2 fa1 sheng1 bao4 zha4
cues.en: She never expected the drug dealer's car to suddenly explode.

cues.zh: 不远处的黑暗中
cues.pinyin: bu4 yuan3 chu4 de5 hei1 an4 zhong1
cues.en: Not far off in the darkness,

cues.zh: 一个神秘人对此十分满意
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shen2 mi4 ren2 dui4 ci3 shi2 fen1 man3 yi4
cues.en: a mysterious figure looked quite satisfied with this.
