items.title_zh: 2026韩国最新收视冠军！漂亮妈妈竟是职业杀手，专杀人渣和败类！壹口气看完《杀手妈咪》1-2集

cues.zh: 但这么强的刘宝那下班之后
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 me5 qiang2 de5 liu2 bao3 na4 xia4 ban1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: But even as formidable as she was, after work Liu Bao-na

cues.zh: 还是要去接孩子
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 yao4 qu4 jie1 hai2 zi5
cues.en: still had to go pick up her kids.

cues.zh: 丈夫全泰成则为了追查毒贩的车祸
cues.pinyin: zhang4 fu1 quan2 tai4 cheng2 ze2 wei4 le5 zhui1 cha2 du2 fan4 de5 che1 huo4
cues.en: Meanwhile her husband Jeon Tae-seong, chasing the drug dealer's car crash case,

cues.zh: 案件奔波两天
cues.pinyin: an4 jian4 ben1 bo1 liang3 tian1
cues.en: had been running around on it for two days.

cues.zh: 他亲眼目睹爆炸发生
cues.pinyin: ta1 qin1 yan3 mu4 du3 bao4 zha4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: He had personally witnessed the explosion happen

cues.zh: 更清楚这个毒贩的身份非常不简单
cues.pinyin: geng4 qing1 chu3 zhe4 ge5 du2 fan4 de5 shen1 fen4 fei1 chang2 bu4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: and knew all too well that this drug dealer's identity was no simple matter.

cues.zh: 对方手握半个韩国的毒品流通网络
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shou3 wo4 ban4 ge4 han2 guo2 de5 du2 pin3 liu2 tong1 wang3 luo4
cues.en: The man controlled half of Korea's drug distribution network.

cues.zh: 这样的人居然莫名其妙死于车祸爆炸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 ren2 ju1 ran2 mo4 ming2 qi2 miao4 si3 yu2 che1 huo4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: For someone like that to die so inexplicably in a car explosion—

cues.zh: 全泰成不相信是意外
cues.pinyin: quan2 tai4 cheng2 bu4 xiang1 xin4 shi4 yi4 wai4
cues.en: Jeon Tae-seong didn't believe it was an accident.

cues.zh: 他认定这是一起踏杀案件
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 ding4 zhe4 shi4 yi4 qi3 ta4 sha1 an4 jian4
cues.en: He was convinced it was a hit.

cues.zh: 可警方却不愿意将此事闹大
cues.pinyin: ke3 jing3 fang1 que4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 jiang1 ci3 shi4 nao4 da4
cues.en: But the police didn't want to make a big deal of it.

cues.zh: 他们仔细调查现场之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zi3 xi4 diao4 cha2 xian4 chang3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After carefully investigating the scene,

cues.zh: 得出结论没有任何一点
cues.pinyin: de2 chu1 jie2 lun4 mei2 you3 ren4 he2 yi4 dian3
cues.en: they concluded there was nothing suspicious at all—

cues.zh: 这只是正常车祸意外
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi3 shi4 zheng4 chang2 che1 huo4 yi4 wai4
cues.en: this was just a normal car accident.

cues.zh: 全泰成一面为案件苦恼
cues.pinyin: quan2 tai4 cheng2 yi2 mian4 wei4 an4 jian4 ku3 nao3
cues.en: While Jeon Tae-seong was troubled by the case,

cues.zh: 一面还要思考怎么跟老婆交代
cues.pinyin: yi2 mian4 hai2 yao4 si1 kao3 zen3 me5 gen1 lao3 po2 jiao1 dai4
cues.en: he also had to think about how to explain things to his wife.

cues.zh: 晚上他一进门就道歉
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 ta1 yi1 jin4 men2 jiu4 dao4 qian4
cues.en: That night, he apologized the moment he walked in the door.

cues.zh: 刘宝纳并没有责怪丈夫的彻夜不归
cues.pinyin: liu2 bao3 na4 bing4 mei2 you3 ze2 guai4 zhang4 fu1 de5 che4 ye4 bu4 gui1
cues.en: Liu Bao-na didn't blame her husband for staying out all night.

cues.zh: 他温柔地包容着这个家里的所有人
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen1 rou2 di4 bao1 rong2 zhe5 zhe4 ge5 jia1 li3 de5 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: He gently embraced everyone in this family,

cues.zh: 因为他心里始终都没有安全感
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 xin1 li3 shi3 zhong1 dou1 mei2 you3 an1 quan2 gan3
cues.en: because deep down he never felt secure.

cues.zh: 朋友告诉他除菊的花语是秘密的爱
cues.pinyin: peng2 you3 gao4 su4 ta1 chu2 ju2 de5 hua1 yu3 shi4 mi4 mi4 de5 ai4
cues.en: A friend told him the chrysanthemum's flower language means 'secret love.'

cues.zh: 但朋友不理解
cues.pinyin: dan4 peng2 you3 bu4 li3 jie3
cues.en: But his friend didn't understand—

cues.zh: 既然是爱
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 shi4 ai4
cues.en: if it's love,

cues.zh: 怎么还会有秘密
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hai2 hui4 you3 mi4 mi4
cues.en: how could there be a secret?

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026韩国最新收视冠军！漂亮妈妈竟是职业杀手，专杀人渣和败类！壹口气看完《杀手妈咪》1-2集

cues.zh: 男人的死亡很快被人发现
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 de5 si3 wang2 hen3 kuai4 bei4 ren2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: The man's death was soon discovered.

cues.zh: 警察来到现场进行勘察
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 lai2 dao4 xian4 chang3 jin4 xing2 kan1 cha2
cues.en: Police came to the scene to investigate.

cues.zh: 他们先对死者的情况进行了一个摸排
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xian1 dui4 si3 zhe3 de5 qing2 kuang4 jin4 xing2 le5 yi2 ge4 mo1 pai2
cues.en: They first did a background check on the deceased's situation,

cues.zh: 结果发现这个死者的情况也很复杂
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 si3 zhe3 de5 qing2 kuang4 ye3 hen3 fu4 za2
cues.en: and found that the deceased's circumstances were quite complicated.

cues.zh: 对方三年前开车带着怀孕的妻子发生车祸
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 san1 nian2 qian2 kai1 che1 dai4 zhe5 huai2 yun4 de5 qi1 zi3 fa1 sheng1 che1 huo4
cues.en: Three years earlier, he had been driving with his pregnant wife when they had a car crash.

cues.zh: 而在事前
cues.pinyin: er2 zai4 shi4 qian2
cues.en: And before that,

cues.zh: 这个男人已经为妻子投下巨额保险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 yi3 jing1 wei4 qi1 zi3 tou2 xia4 ju4 e2 bao3 xian3
cues.en: this man had already taken out a massive insurance policy on his wife.

cues.zh: 因为很难认定车祸发生是否是
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 hen3 nan2 ren4 ding4 che1 huo4 fa1 sheng1 shi4 fou3 shi4
cues.en: Because it was hard to determine whether the crash

cues.zh: 男人主观故意
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhu3 guan1 gu4 yi4
cues.en: was intentional on the man's part,

cues.zh: 所以他被判得很轻
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bei4 pan4 de2 hen3 qing1
cues.en: he received a very light sentence.

cues.zh: 在妻子死亡之后
cues.pinyin: zai4 qi1 zi3 si3 wang2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After his wife's death,

cues.zh: 他获得了一大笔赔偿金
cues.pinyin: ta1 huo4 de2 le5 yi1 da4 bi3 pei2 chang2 jin1
cues.en: he received a huge settlement.

cues.zh: 男人坐牢不到五年便成功出狱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zuo4 lao2 bu2 dao4 wu3 nian2 bian4 cheng2 gong1 chu1 yu4
cues.en: The man served less than five years before being successfully released.

cues.zh: 这起案件引发舆论轩然大波
cues.pinyin: zhe4 qi3 an4 jian4 yin3 fa1 yu2 lun4 xuan1 ran2 da4 bo1
cues.en: This case sparked a huge public outcry.

cues.zh: 无数人怒骂男人杀气骗保
cues.pinyin: wu2 shu4 ren2 nu4 ma4 nan2 ren2 sha1 qi4 pian4 bao3
cues.en: Countless people cursed the man for killing his wife for the insurance money—

cues.zh: 丧心病狂
cues.pinyin: sang4 xin1 bing4 kuang2
cues.en: it was utterly deranged.

cues.zh: 为了有一个新的人生
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 you3 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: Wanting a fresh start in life,

cues.zh: 男人拿着这笔钱准备离开韩国
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 na2 zhe5 zhe4 bi3 qian2 zhun3 bei4 li2 kai1 han2 guo2
cues.en: the man took the money and prepared to leave Korea.

cues.zh: 他买的机票在 12 小时后
cues.pinyin: ta1 mai3 de5 ji1 piao4 zai4 12 xiao3 shi2 hou4
cues.en: His flight was in 12 hours.

cues.zh: 可就在离开韩国的前一天
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 zai4 li2 kai1 han2 guo2 de5 qian2 yi1 tian1
cues.en: But the day before he was set to leave Korea,

cues.zh: 他被人杀死在公寓
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 ren2 sha1 si3 zai4 gong1 yu4
cues.en: he was murdered in his apartment.

cues.zh: 更离奇的是他的死亡非常干净利落
cues.pinyin: geng4 li2 qi2 de5 shi4 ta1 de5 si3 wang2 fei1 chang2 gan1 jing4 li4 luo4
cues.en: What's even stranger is that his death was extremely clean and precise—

cues.zh: 枪手势超远距离一枪毙命
cues.pinyin: qiang1 shou3 shi4 chao1 yuan3 ju4 li2 yi1 qiang1 bi4 ming4
cues.en: the shooter killed him with a single shot from an extremely long distance.

cues.zh: 警察来到弹道轨迹推测出的开枪地点
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 lai2 dao4 dan4 dao4 gui3 ji4 tui1 ce4 chu1 de5 kai1 qiang1 di4 dian3
cues.en: Police traced the trajectory to figure out where the shot came from—

cues.zh: 教堂楼顶
cues.pinyin: jiao4 tang2 lou2 ding3
cues.en: the rooftop of a church.

cues.zh: 新人警察顿时震惊了
cues.pinyin: xin1 ren2 jing3 cha2 dun4 shi2 zhen4 jing1 le5
cues.en: The rookie officer was stunned.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 90后男生创新传统手艺，到成都郊野用花草展现生命的激情

cues.zh: 解读一座城市得从人开始
cues.pinyin: jie3 du2 yi1 zuo4 cheng2 shi4 de2 cong2 ren2 kai1 shi3
cues.en: To interpret a city, you have to start with its people.

cues.zh: 成都人悠闲而包容时髦和市井
cues.pinyin: cheng2 du1 ren2 you1 xian2 er2 bao1 rong2 shi2 mao2 he2 shi4 jing3
cues.en: Chengdu people are laid-back yet tolerant, fashionable and down-to-earth.

cues.zh: 追求创新却尊崇传统
cues.pinyin: zhui1 qiu2 chuang4 xin1 que4 zun1 chong2 chuan2 tong3
cues.en: They pursue innovation yet revere tradition.

cues.zh: 在这里都不再是反义词
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 dou1 bu4 zai4 shi4 fan3 yi4 ci2
cues.en: Here, those are no longer opposites.

cues.zh: 于是我来到成都生活
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 lai2 dao4 cheng2 du1 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: So I came to live in Chengdu.

cues.zh: 在创作中细胶这里蕴藏的生命有力
cues.pinyin: zai4 chuang4 zuo4 zhong1 xi4 jiao1 zhe4 li3 yun4 cang2 de5 sheng1 ming4 you3 li4
cues.en: In my creative work, I savor the vitality hidden here.

cues.zh: 作为花艺师我希望在一花一叶
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 hua1 yi4 shi1 wo3 xi1 wang4 zai4 yi1 hua1 yi1 ye4
cues.en: As a florist, I hope that in every flower and leaf,

cues.zh: 里感受我与表
cues.pinyin: li3 gan3 shou4 wo3 yu3 biao3
cues.en: I can feel my own connection with

cues.zh: 现生命的意义
cues.pinyin: xian4 sheng1 ming4 de5 yi4 yi4
cues.en: expressing the meaning of life.

cues.zh: 所以每一个作品我都会去花式探寻
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei3 yi2 ge4 zuo4 pin3 wo3 du1 hui4 qu4 hua1 shi4 tan4 xun2
cues.en: So for every piece I make, I search for it in all sorts of ways.

cues.zh: 在山野里找寻花材
cues.pinyin: zai4 shan1 ye3 li3 zhao3 xun2 hua1 cai2
cues.en: Searching for floral materials out in the wild hills,

cues.zh: 亲手感知生命力
cues.pinyin: qin1 shou3 gan3 zhi1 sheng1 ming4 li4
cues.en: feeling the life force with my own hands,

cues.zh: 也激发出新的思考
cues.pinyin: ye3 ji1 fa1 chu1 xin1 de5 si1 kao3
cues.en: and sparking new reflections.

cues.zh: 第一次见到苏格兰百富的那支红玫瑰
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 jian4 dao4 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 de5 na4 zhi1 hong2 mei2 gui1
cues.en: The first time I saw The Balvenie's red rose,

cues.zh: 我就感受到了同频的默契
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gan3 shou4 dao4 le5 tong2 pin2 de5 mo4 qi4
cues.en: I felt an instant, unspoken resonance —

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 90后男生创新传统手艺，到成都郊野用花草展现生命的激情

cues.zh: 和成都很相似
cues.pinyin: he2 cheng2 du1 hen3 xiang1 si4
cues.en: much like Chengdu itself.

cues.zh: 酿造苏格兰百富威士忌的达夫镇
cues.pinyin: niang4 zao4 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 wei1 shi4 ji4 de5 da2 fu1 zhen4
cues.en: Dufftown, where The Balvenie Scotch whisky is distilled,

cues.zh: 保留着 12 9 年前传统苏格兰手工技艺
cues.pinyin: bao3 liu2 zhe5 12 9 nian2 qian2 chuan2 tong3 su1 ge2 lan2 shou3 gong1 ji4 yi4
cues.en: still preserves traditional Scottish craftsmanship from 129 years ago,

cues.zh: 而这份匠心可以追溯更早以前
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 fen4 jiang4 xin1 ke3 yi3 zhui1 su4 geng4 zao3 yi3 qian2
cues.en: and this devotion to craft traces back even further.

cues.zh: 酒厂前身苏格兰百富古堡的主人
cues.pinyin: jiu3 chang3 qian2 shen1 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 gu3 bao3 de5 zhu3 ren2
cues.en: The owner of Balvenie Castle, predecessor of the distillery,

cues.zh: 道格拉斯女士
cues.pinyin: dao4 ge2 la1 si1 nv3 shi4
cues.en: Lady Douglas,

cues.zh: 在新鲜培育的玫瑰园中
cues.pinyin: zai4 xin1 xian1 pei2 yu4 de5 mei2 gui1 yuan2 zhong1
cues.en: would go into a freshly tended rose garden

cues.zh: 选取最好的那支玫瑰
cues.pinyin: xuan3 qu3 zui4 hao3 de5 na4 zhi1 mei2 gui1
cues.en: and pick the finest rose,

cues.zh: 以城堡租金上交给国王
cues.pinyin: yi3 cheng2 bao3 zu1 jin1 shang4 jiao1 gei3 guo2 wang2
cues.en: paying it to the king as the castle's rent.

cues.zh: 这份对传统的郑重与传承
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fen4 dui4 chuan2 tong3 de5 zheng4 zhong4 yu3 chuan2 cheng2
cues.en: This solemn reverence for tradition, and its legacy,

cues.zh: 在今天被重现
cues.pinyin: zai4 jin1 tian1 bei4 chong2 xian4
cues.en: is recreated today.

cues.zh: 万中选一的珍贵玫瑰
cues.pinyin: wan4 zhong1 xuan3 yi1 de5 zhen1 gui4 mei2 gui1
cues.en: A rose chosen as one in ten thousand

cues.zh: 化作了历经二十一年时光沉淀
cues.pinyin: hua4 zuo4 le5 li4 jing1 er4 shi2 yi1 nian2 shi2 guang1 chen2 dian4
cues.en: has become, after twenty-one years of time's slow distillation,

cues.zh: 今已透着玫瑰色的珍贵家酿
cues.pinyin: jin1 yi3 tou4 zhe5 mei2 gui1 se4 de5 zhen1 gui4 jia1 niang4
cues.en: a precious reserve whisky now tinged rose-gold.

cues.zh: 大麦
cues.pinyin: da4 mai4
cues.en: Barley.

cues.zh: 取自酿造威士忌的原料
cues.pinyin: qu3 zi4 niang4 zao4 wei1 shi4 ji4 de5 yuan2 liao4
cues.en: Taken from the raw grain used to brew whisky,

cues.zh: 在层层包裹中
cues.pinyin: zai4 ceng2 ceng2 bao1 guo3 zhong1
cues.en: wrapped layer upon layer,

cues.zh: 仿佛一颗蕴藏新生的种子
cues.pinyin: fang3 fu2 yi1 ke1 yun4 cang2 xin1 sheng1 de5 zhong3 zi5
cues.en: like a seed holding new life within,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 90后男生创新传统手艺，到成都郊野用花草展现生命的激情

cues.zh: 在四季更迭里开始它的生命旅程
cues.pinyin: zai4 si4 ji4 geng1 die2 li3 kai1 shi3 ta1 de5 sheng1 ming4 lv3 cheng2
cues.en: it begins its life's journey through the turning seasons.

cues.zh: 它是一颗大麦种子
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi1 ke1 da4 mai4 zhong3 zi5
cues.en: It is a barley seed,

cues.zh: 历练光阴洗礼
cues.pinyin: li4 lian4 guang1 yin1 xi3 li3
cues.en: tempered by the trials of time,

cues.zh: 交汇在一朵永生玫瑰上
cues.pinyin: jiao1 hui4 zai4 yi1 duo3 yong3 sheng1 mei2 gui1 shang4
cues.en: converging with an everlasting rose.

cues.zh: 在大地的滋养下
cues.pinyin: zai4 da4 di4 de5 zi1 yang3 xia4
cues.en: Nourished by the earth,

cues.zh: 承托着生命的重量
cues.pinyin: cheng2 tuo1 zhe5 sheng1 ming4 de5 zhong4 liang4
cues.en: it bears the weight of life,

cues.zh: 永不凋零
cues.pinyin: yong3 bu4 diao1 ling2
cues.en: never withering.

cues.zh: 完成不是一段旅程的终点
cues.pinyin: wan2 cheng2 bu2 shi4 yi1 duan4 lv3 cheng2 de5 zhong1 dian3
cues.en: Completion isn't the end of a journey,

cues.zh: 而是思考与感受的记录
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 si1 kao3 yu3 gan3 shou4 de5 ji4 lu4
cues.en: but a record of thought and feeling,

cues.zh: 让它开始自己的生命历程
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 kai1 shi3 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 ming4 li4 cheng2
cues.en: letting it begin its own life's journey.

cues.zh: 自下而上
cues.pinyin: zi4 xia4 er2 shang4
cues.en: From the bottom up,

cues.zh: 沉淀时间和期待
cues.pinyin: chen2 dian4 shi2 jian1 he2 qi1 dai4
cues.en: distilling time and anticipation;

cues.zh: 由上而下
cues.pinyin: you2 shang4 er2 xia4
cues.en: from the top down,

cues.zh: 淬炼出一段传奇的心声
cues.pinyin: cui4 lian4 chu1 yi1 duan4 chuan2 qi2 de5 xin1 sheng1
cues.en: forging the voice of a legend.

cues.zh: 就如同苏格兰百富那支红玫瑰
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ru2 tong2 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 na4 zhi1 hong2 mei2 gui1
cues.en: Just like The Balvenie's red rose,

cues.zh: 带来口感上的浓郁果香
cues.pinyin: dai4 lai2 kou3 gan3 shang4 de5 nong2 yu4 guo3 xiang1
cues.en: which brings a rich, fruity aroma to the palate,

cues.zh: 与背后蕴藏故事的感动一样
cues.pinyin: yu3 bei4 hou4 yun4 cang2 gu4 shi4 de5 gan3 dong4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: just as moving as the story hidden behind it.

cues.zh: 在一个个生命的细节里
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 ge4 sheng1 ming4 de5 xi4 jie2 li3
cues.en: In every small detail of life,

cues.zh: 只会用最细微的方式
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hui4 yong4 zui4 xi4 wei1 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: it speaks only in the subtlest of ways,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 90后男生创新传统手艺，到成都郊野用花草展现生命的激情

cues.zh: 向我们传递着美感和力量
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 men5 chuan2 di4 zhe5 mei3 gan3 he2 li4 liang4
cues.en: conveying beauty and strength to us.

cues.zh: 拿它柔美如玫瑰
cues.pinyin: na2 ta1 rou2 mei3 ru2 mei2 gui1
cues.en: Even though it's as soft and beautiful as a rose,

cues.zh: 都会有它强大的力量
cues.pinyin: du1 hui4 you3 ta1 qiang2 da4 de5 li4 liang4
cues.en: it still holds powerful strength within.

cues.zh: 降星至于花艺
cues.pinyin: jiang4 xing1 zhi4 yu2 hua1 yi4
cues.en: Brought down to the art of floristry,

cues.zh: 是时刻保持初心
cues.pinyin: shi4 shi2 ke4 bao3 chi2 chu1 xin1
cues.en: that means always holding onto your original intent —

cues.zh: 如同苏格兰百富威士忌
cues.pinyin: ru2 tong2 su1 ge2 lan2 bai3 fu4 wei1 shi4 ji4
cues.en: just like The Balvenie whisky's

cues.zh: 传奇酿酒大师
cues.pinyin: chuan2 qi2 niang4 jiu3 da4 shi1
cues.en: legendary master distiller,

cues.zh: 大卫斯图尔特一样
cues.pinyin: da4 wei4 si1 tu2 er3 te4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: David Stewart.

cues.zh: 拥有则一世
cues.pinyin: yong1 you3 ze2 yi1 shi4
cues.en: What he has is a lifetime,

cues.zh: 终一生的不懈专注
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yi1 sheng1 de5 bu4 xie4 zhuan1 zhu4
cues.en: a whole life's worth of unwavering dedication,

cues.zh: 也是时刻回溯自我
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 shi2 ke4 hui2 su4 zi4 wo3
cues.en: but also one of constantly looking back at himself

cues.zh: 不断尝试多元艺术的勇敢
cues.pinyin: bu4 duan4 chang2 shi4 duo1 yuan2 yi4 shu4 de5 yong3 gan3
cues.en: and the courage to keep trying diverse forms of art.

cues.zh: 这是师承自然的收获
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shi1 cheng2 zi4 ran2 de5 shou1 huo4
cues.en: This is the harvest of learning from nature,

cues.zh: 一生作为一个
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4
cues.en: and the happiness, for a lifetime, of being

cues.zh: 匠人的幸福所在
cues.pinyin: jiang4 ren2 de5 xing4 fu2 suo3 zai4
cues.en: a craftsman — that's where the happiness lies.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁叉烧排骨做法～外焦香里软嫩～这样做最好吃！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 你好各位做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello to all you home cooks

cues.zh: 非常荣幸的又跟大家见面了我是 S iss i
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 de5 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 S iss i
cues.en: I'm very honored to be with you again — I'm Cissy

cues.zh: 今天要问大家分享的是叉烧排骨的做法
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 wen4 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 cha1 shao1 pai2 gu3 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Today I'd like to share with you how to make char siu pork ribs

cues.zh: 首先呢我们先将它炖一下
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ne5 wo3 men5 xian1 jiang1 ta1 dun4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: First, let's braise it for a bit

cues.zh: 所以里面是软嫩的多汁的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 li3 mian4 shi4 ruan3 nen4 de5 duo1 zhi1 de5
cues.en: That way the inside turns out tender and juicy

cues.zh: 我们再将它放入这个烤箱总烤一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 jiang1 ta1 fang4 ru4 zhe4 ge5 kao3 xiang1 zong3 kao3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Then we put it in the oven to roast

cues.zh: 所以外面会有一种非常迷人的焦香味
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wai4 mian4 hui4 you3 yi1 zhong3 fei1 chang2 mi2 ren2 de5 jiao1 xiang1 wei4
cues.en: So the outside gets a really tempting charred aroma

cues.zh: 我们赶快来看一看这个做法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gan3 kuai4 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4 zhe4 ge5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Let's quickly take a look at how it's made

cues.zh: 首先这个碗里我们来调制我们的酱料
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhe4 ge5 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 lai2 tiao2 zhi4 wo3 men5 de5 jiang4 liao4
cues.en: First, in this bowl we'll mix our sauce

cues.zh: 加入南乳
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 nan2 ru3
cues.en: Add fermented red tofu (nam yu)

cues.zh: 还有南乳的酱汁
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 nan2 ru3 de5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: And the sauce from the fermented red tofu

cues.zh: 蚝油
cues.pinyin: hao2 you2
cues.en: Oyster sauce

cues.zh: 海鲜酱
cues.pinyin: hai3 xian1 jiang4
cues.en: Hoisin sauce

cues.zh: 老抽
cues.pinyin: lao3 chou1
cues.en: Dark soy sauce

cues.zh: 玫瑰露酒
cues.pinyin: mei2 gui1 lu4 jiu3
cues.en: Rose wine

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁叉烧排骨做法～外焦香里软嫩～这样做最好吃！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 在一个锅里使用大火
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 li3 shi3 yong4 da4 huo3
cues.en: In a pot, use high heat

cues.zh: 放入清淡橄榄油
cues.pinyin: fang4 ru4 qing1 dan4 gan3 lan3 you2
cues.en: Add light olive oil

cues.zh: 放入排骨
cues.pinyin: fang4 ru4 pai2 gu3
cues.en: Add the ribs

cues.zh: 煎到排骨有微微的金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: jian1 dao4 pai2 gu3 you3 wei1 wei1 de5 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Fry until the ribs are lightly golden

cues.zh: 大概是 8 分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 8 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: About 8 minutes

cues.zh: 在这里我没有事先煎我们的排骨
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 mei2 you3 shi4 xian1 jian1 wo3 men5 de5 pai2 gu3
cues.en: Here I didn't pre-fry our ribs

cues.zh: 因为在炖的过程中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 dun4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: Because during the braising process

cues.zh: 这个排骨就会变得非常的入味
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 pai2 gu3 jiu4 hui4 bian4 de2 fei1 chang2 de5 ru4 wei4
cues.en: The ribs will become very flavorful

cues.zh: 加入大蒜
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 da4 suan4
cues.en: Add garlic

cues.zh: 八角
cues.pinyin: ba1 jiao3
cues.en: Star anise

cues.zh: 和桂皮
cues.pinyin: he2 gui4 pi2
cues.en: And cinnamon bark

cues.zh: 给它爆香一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 bao4 xiang1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Stir-fry them to release the aroma

cues.zh: 大概是 30 秒钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 30 miao3 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: About 30 seconds

cues.zh: 再倒入酱汁
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 ru4 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Then pour in the sauce

cues.zh: 冰糖
cues.pinyin: bing1 tang2
cues.en: Rock sugar

cues.zh: 给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Give it a stir

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁叉烧排骨做法～外焦香里软嫩～这样做最好吃！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 给它盖上盖子
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 gai4 shang4 gai4 zi5
cues.en: Put the lid on

cues.zh: 转中小火
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 zhong1 xiao3 huo3
cues.en: Turn to medium-low heat

cues.zh: 炖 15 分钟
cues.pinyin: dun4 15 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Braise for 15 minutes

cues.zh: 时不时的可以给排骨翻一个面
cues.pinyin: shi2 bu4 shi2 de5 ke3 yi3 gei3 pai2 gu3 fan1 yi2 ge4 mian4
cues.en: You can flip the ribs over from time to time

cues.zh: 把盖子打开
cues.pinyin: ba3 gai4 zi5 da3 kai1
cues.en: Take the lid off

cues.zh: 收汁 10 分钟
cues.pinyin: shou1 zhi1 10 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Reduce the sauce for 10 minutes

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁叉烧排骨做法～外焦香里软嫩～这样做最好吃！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 在烤盘上加一个烤架
cues.pinyin: zai4 kao3 pan2 shang4 jia1 yi2 ge4 kao3 jia4
cues.en: Place a rack on the baking tray

cues.zh: 再将排骨转移到烤架上
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiang1 pai2 gu3 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 kao3 jia4 shang4
cues.en: Then move the ribs onto the rack

cues.zh: 在一个预热的烤箱中
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 yu4 re4 de5 kao3 xiang1 zhong1
cues.en: In a preheated oven

cues.zh: 将我们的烤锅转移到烤箱的中间架子上
cues.pinyin: jiang1 wo3 men5 de5 kao3 guo1 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 kao3 xiang1 de5 zhong1 jian1 jia4 zi5 shang4
cues.en: Move our roasting pan to the middle rack of the oven

cues.zh: 在 400 华氏度或 20 4 摄氏度下面烤 10 分钟
cues.pinyin: zai4 400 hua2 shi4 du4 huo4 20 4 she4 shi4 du4 xia4 mian4 kao3 10 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Roast at 400°F or 204°C for 10 minutes

cues.zh: 现在我们来制作蜂蜜水
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 lai2 zhi4 zuo4 feng1 mi4 shui3
cues.en: Now let's make the honey water

cues.zh: 在一个碗里加入蜂蜜和温水
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 wan3 li3 jia1 ru4 feng1 mi4 he2 wen1 shui3
cues.en: In a bowl, add honey and warm water

cues.zh: 搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Give it a stir

cues.zh: 从烤箱中取出烤锅

cues.en: Take the roasting pan out of the oven

cues.en: Brush on the honey water

cues.zh: 再将烤锅放回烤箱的中间架子上
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiang1 kao3 guo1 fang4 hui2 kao3 xiang1 de5 zhong1 jian1 jia4 zi5 shang4
cues.en: Put the roasting pan back on the middle rack of the oven

cues.zh: 在 400 华氏度或 20 4 摄氏度下烤 10 分钟

cues.en: Roast at 400°F or 204°C for 10 minutes

cues.zh: 我们这个叉烧排骨做的要不要
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 ge5 cha1 shao1 pai2 gu3 zuo4 de5 yao4 bu4 yao4
cues.en: So, are these char siu pork ribs we made good or not?

cues.zh: 啊这么好吃啊
cues.pinyin: a5 zhe4 me5 hao3 chi1 a5
cues.en: Oh, they're so delicious

cues.zh: 它真的是里面是软嫩的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhen1 de5 shi4 li3 mian4 shi4 ruan3 nen4 de5
cues.en: The inside really is tender and juicy

cues.zh: 然后外面有焦香味
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wai4 mian4 you3 jiao1 xiang1 wei4
cues.en: And the outside has that charred aroma

cues.zh: 哇好棒好棒
cues.pinyin: wa5 hao3 bang4 hao3 bang4
cues.en: Wow, great, great!

cues.zh: 而且它最赞的这一点就是
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 zui4 zan4 de5 zhe4 yi4 dian3 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: And the best part about it is

cues.zh: 它又容易又简单
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 rong2 yi4 you4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: It's both easy and simple

cues.zh: 这样子的做法绝对没有失败率
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 zuo4 fa3 jue2 dui4 mei2 you3 shi1 bai4 lv4
cues.en: Made this way, it definitely won't fail

cues.zh: 那我以前也做过不同的叉烧食谱
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 yi3 qian2 ye3 zuo4 guo4 bu4 tong2 de5 cha1 shao1 shi2 pu3
cues.en: I've made different char siu recipes before too

cues.zh: 如果你对它们感兴趣的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 dui4 ta1 men5 gan3 xing4 qu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If you're interested in those

cues.zh: 你可以在我的网站上面找到这些影片
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 zai4 wo3 de5 wang3 zhan4 shang4 mian4 zhao3 dao4 zhe4 xie1 ying3 pian4
cues.en: You can find those videos on my website

cues.zh: 好的那今天就这样子了
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 na4 jin1 tian1 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 le5
cues.en: Okay, that's it for today

cues.zh: 我希望大家喜欢今天的影片
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 xi3 huan1 jin1 tian1 de5 ying3 pian4
cues.en: I hope you all enjoyed today's video

cues.zh: 我们下周见了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 zhou1 jian4 le5
cues.en: See you next week

cues.zh: 祝大家有一个美好的周末
cues.pinyin: zhu4 da4 jia1 you3 yi2 ge4 mei3 hao3 de5 zhou1 mo4
cues.en: Wishing everyone a wonderful weekend

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye-bye

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 现女友给前女友做手术
cues.pinyin: xian4 nv3 you3 gei3 qian2 nv3 you3 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: His current girlfriend has to operate on his ex-girlfriend.

cues.zh: 手术室差点变成修罗场
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi4 cha4 dian3 bian4 cheng2 xiu1 luo2 chang3
cues.en: The operating room nearly turned into a battlefield.

cues.zh: 小美患有急性肾衰竭
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 huan4 you3 ji2 xing4 shen4 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: Xiaomei has acute kidney failure.

cues.zh: 三年前因肾动脉狭窄而接受过治疗
cues.pinyin: san1 nian2 qian2 yin1 shen4 dong4 mai4 xia2 zhai3 er2 jie1 shou4 guo4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: Three years ago she was treated for renal artery stenosis.

cues.zh: 但如今植入的支架不行了
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 jin1 zhi2 ru4 de5 zhi1 jia4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: But the stent implanted back then has now failed.

cues.zh: 需要立即进行绕道手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 li4 ji2 jin4 xing2 rao4 dao4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: She needs an emergency bypass surgery.

cues.zh: 手术没什么大问题
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 mei2 shen2 me5 da4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The surgery itself isn't a big problem.

cues.zh: 但主要是这个人
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhu3 yao4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: But the real issue is the people involved.

cues.zh: 林医生接触起来多多少少有点心理障碍
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 jie1 chu4 qi3 lai2 duo1 duo1 shao3 shao3 you3 dian3 xin1 li3 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: Dr. Lin feels somewhat uneasy about treating her.

cues.zh: 因为小美是自己的男友的前任不仅如此
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 nan2 you3 de5 qian2 ren4 bu4 jin3 ru2 ci3
cues.en: Because Xiaomei is her boyfriend's ex — and not only that,

cues.zh: 她还是自己男友推荐过来做手术的
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 zi4 ji3 nan2 you3 tui1 jian4 guo4 lai2 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5
cues.en: it was her own boyfriend who recommended Xiaomei for the surgery.

cues.zh: 因为小美所在的地方医院没有做手
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 suo3 zai4 de5 di4 fang1 yi1 yuan4 mei2 you3 zuo4 shou3
cues.en: Because the hospital in Xiaomei's hometown doesn't have

cues.zh: 术的相关仪器
cues.pinyin: shu4 de5 xiang1 guan1 yi2 qi4
cues.en: the equipment needed for the operation.

cues.zh: 不过作为一个医生
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: But as a doctor,

cues.zh: 林医生对患者一视同仁
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 dui4 huan4 zhe3 yi1 shi4 tong2 ren2
cues.en: Dr. Lin treats every patient the same.

cues.zh: 并没有趁机打击报复什么的
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 chen4 ji1 da3 ji1 bao4 fu4 shen2 me5 de5
cues.en: She doesn't use the chance to settle any personal scores.

cues.zh: 医生旋转小美那次的所有器官
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 xuan2 zhuan3 xiao3 mei3 na4 ci4 de5 suo3 you3 qi4 guan1
cues.en: The doctor carefully moves aside Xiaomei's organs,

cues.zh: 将肾血管暴露出来
cues.pinyin: jiang1 shen4 xue4 guan3 bao4 lu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: exposing the renal blood vessels.

cues.zh: 但接着就发现有一个巨大的动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: dan4 jie1 zhe5 jiu4 fa1 xian4 you3 yi2 ge4 ju4 da4 de5 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: But then they find a huge aneurysm

cues.zh: 阻断了血液流动
cues.pinyin: zu3 duan4 le5 xue4 ye4 liu2 dong4
cues.en: blocking the blood flow.

cues.zh: 这就表明无法进行血管重建
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 biao3 ming2 wu2 fa3 jin4 xing2 xue4 guan3 chong2 jian4
cues.en: This means vascular reconstruction isn't possible.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 林医生建议可以从主动脉
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 jian4 yi4 ke3 yi3 cong2 zhu3 dong4 mai4
cues.en: Dr. Lin suggests they could bypass from the aorta

cues.zh: 或者下动脉处做旁路手术
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 xia4 dong4 mai4 chu4 zuo4 pang2 lu4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: or from the lower artery instead.

cues.zh: 但腹部主动脉周围有好几个动脉流断
cues.pinyin: dan4 fu4 bu4 zhu3 dong4 mai4 zhou1 wei2 you3 hao3 ji3 ge4 dong4 mai4 liu2 duan4
cues.en: But there are several aneurysms around the abdominal aorta,

cues.zh: 是一个方案不可行
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 fang1 an4 bu4 ke3 xing2
cues.en: so this plan isn't feasible either.

cues.zh: 最后医生用一根血管绕过了肾动脉
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 sheng1 yong4 yi1 gen1 xue4 guan3 rao4 guo4 le5 shen4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: In the end, the doctor uses a vessel graft to bypass the renal artery,

cues.zh: 解决了肾衰竭问题
cues.pinyin: jie3 jue2 le5 shen4 shuai1 jie2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: solving the kidney failure problem.

cues.zh: 但同时发现小美患有纤维肌肉发育不良症
cues.pinyin: dan4 tong2 shi2 fa1 xian4 xiao3 mei3 huan4 you3 xian1 wei2 ji1 rou4 fa1 yu4 bu4 liang2 zheng4
cues.en: But they also discover Xiaomei has fibromuscular dysplasia,

cues.zh: 这会导致心脏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 dao3 zhi4 xin1 zang4
cues.en: which can cause the heart,

cues.zh: 大脑和其他主要血管出现动脉流氧
cues.pinyin: da4 nao3 he2 qi2 ta1 zhu3 yao4 xue4 guan3 chu1 xian4 dong4 mai4 liu2 yang3
cues.en: brain, and other major blood vessels to develop aneurysms,

cues.zh: 狭窄危及生命
cues.pinyin: xia2 zhai3 wei1 ji2 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: narrowing that endangers her life.

cues.zh: 医生可以给大家进行药物治疗
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ke3 yi3 gei3 da4 jia1 jin4 xing2 yao4 wu4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: The doctor could treat her with medication

cues.zh: 控制潜在风险
cues.pinyin: kong4 zhi4 qian2 zai4 feng1 xian3
cues.en: to control the underlying risk,

cues.zh: 并且再做一次手术
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 zai4 zuo4 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and then perform another surgery

cues.zh: 修复每个动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 mei3 ge4 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: to repair each aneurysm.

cues.zh: 但手术有中风和大出血的风险
cues.pinyin: dan4 shou3 shu4 you3 zhong4 feng1 he2 da4 chu1 xue4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: But that surgery carries a risk of stroke and major bleeding.

cues.zh: 可不做手术的话
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: On the other hand, if they don't operate,

cues.zh: 动脉瘤破裂只是时间的问题
cues.pinyin: dong4 mai4 liu2 po4 lie4 zhi3 shi4 shi2 jian1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: the aneurysm rupturing is only a matter of time —

cues.zh: 到时候肯定是死路一条
cues.pinyin: dao4 shi2 hou4 ken3 ding4 shi4 si3 lu4 yi1 tiao2
cues.en: and when it does, death is certain.

cues.zh: 小美选择进行手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 xuan3 ze2 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiaomei chooses to go through with the surgery.

cues.zh: 但如果出事了的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 guo3 chu1 shi4 le5 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if something goes wrong,

cues.zh: 希望能让前男友
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 neng2 rang4 qian2 nan2 you3
cues.en: she hopes her ex-boyfriend —

cues.zh: 也就是林医生的现男友告诉自己的父母
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 lin2 yi1 sheng1 de5 xian4 nan2 you3 gao4 su4 zi4 ji3 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: that is, Dr. Lin's current boyfriend — will tell her parents,

cues.zh: 因为他不想爸妈从陌生人口中得
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 bu4 xiang3 ba4 ma1 cong2 mo4 sheng1 ren2 kou3 zhong1 de2
cues.en: because she doesn't want her parents to learn

cues.zh: 知自己的死讯
cues.pinyin: zhi1 zi4 ji3 de5 si3 xun4
cues.en: of her death from a stranger.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 林医生都不能放弃小美
cues.pinyin: lin2 yi1 sheng1 dou1 bu4 neng2 fang4 qi4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Dr. Lin refuses to give up on Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 但把人救回来是不可能了
cues.pinyin: dan4 ba3 ren2 jiu4 hui2 lai2 shi4 bu4 ke3 neng2 le5
cues.en: But saving her there turns out to be impossible,

cues.zh: 所以林医生直接赶到了县医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lin2 yi1 sheng1 zhi2 jie1 gan3 dao4 le5 xian4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: so Dr. Lin rushes straight to the county hospital

cues.zh: 给小美做手术
cues.pinyin: gei3 xiao3 mei3 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: to operate on Xiaomei herself.

cues.zh: 她修复了小美所有的动脉瘤
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiu1 fu4 le5 xiao3 mei3 suo3 you3 de5 dong4 mai4 liu2
cues.en: She repairs all of Xiaomei's aneurysms.

cues.zh: 不出一周
cues.pinyin: bu4 chu1 yi1 zhou1
cues.en: Within a week,

cues.zh: 小美就能回家了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 jiu4 neng2 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei is able to go home.

cues.zh: 两个前提最终握手言和
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 qian2 ti2 zui4 zhong1 wo4 shou3 yan2 he2
cues.en: The two of them finally make peace,

cues.zh: 将狗男人抛至脑后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 gou3 nan2 ren2 pao1 zhi4 nao3 hou4
cues.en: putting the cheating ex behind her.

cues.zh: 话说肖恩又自闭了
cues.pinyin: hua4 shuo1 xiao4 en1 you4 zi4 bi4 le5
cues.en: Meanwhile, Shaun withdraws into himself again.

cues.zh: 医院搞了个患者评价
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 gao3 le5 ge4 huan4 zhe3 ping2 jia4
cues.en: The hospital has set up a patient review

cues.zh: 对医生打分的系统
cues.pinyin: dui4 yi1 sheng1 da3 fen1 de5 xi4 tong3
cues.en: system for rating doctors.

cues.zh: 结果在一个周期末统计时
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zai4 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 mo4 tong3 ji4 shi2
cues.en: When the results are tallied at the end of one cycle,

cues.zh: 肖恩名字排到了最后
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ming2 zi4 pai2 dao4 le5 zui4 hou4
cues.en: Shaun's name comes in last,

cues.zh: 偏分低到没眼看
cues.pinyin: pian1 fen1 di1 dao4 mei2 yan3 kan4
cues.en: with a score too low to look at.

cues.zh: 网上对肖恩的评价
cues.pinyin: wang3 shang4 dui4 xiao4 en1 de5 ping2 jia4
cues.en: Online comments about Shaun

cues.zh: 都是不尊重别人
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 bu4 zun1 zhong4 bie2 ren2
cues.en: all say things like "disrespectful,"

cues.zh: 给我压迫感
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 ya1 po4 gan3
cues.en: "makes me feel pressured,"

cues.zh: 这个医生有点怪之类的评价
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi1 sheng1 you3 dian3 guai4 zhi1 lei4 de5 ping2 jia4
cues.en: and "this doctor is kind of weird."

cues.zh: 肖恩这下老伤情了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 xia4 lao3 shang1 qing2 le5
cues.en: Shaun is really hurt by this.

cues.zh: 发誓要提高自己的分数
cues.pinyin: fa1 shi4 yao4 ti2 gao1 zi4 ji3 de5 fen1 shu4
cues.en: He vows to raise his score.

cues.zh: 老壮是一家五金店的老板
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 shi4 yi1 jia1 wu3 jin1 dian4 de5 lao3 ban3
cues.en: Lao Zhuang owns a hardware store.

cues.zh: 这天点被碰上一群小混混
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 dian3 bei4 peng4 shang4 yi1 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4
cues.en: One day he runs into a group of thugs.

cues.zh: 推丧之下
cues.pinyin: tui1 sang4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: In the scuffle,

cues.zh: 这天碰上了一群小混混
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 peng4 shang4 le5 yi1 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4
cues.en: he's slammed into the car's side mirror.

cues.zh: 一整个脸外嘴斜
cues.pinyin: yi1 zheng3 ge4 lian3 wai4 zui3 xie2
cues.en: His whole face ends up twisted.

cues.zh: 进医院检查才发现
cues.pinyin: jin4 yi1 yuan4 jian3 cha2 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Only at the hospital exam do they discover

cues.zh: 腹林八管的骨折导致了舌下出血
cues.pinyin: fu4 lin2 ba1 guan3 de5 gu3 zhe2 dao3 zhi4 le5 she2 xia4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: a jaw fracture has caused bleeding under his tongue,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 下摆骨折了
cues.pinyin: xia4 bai3 gu3 zhe2 le5
cues.en: his jaw is broken.

cues.zh: 女儿认为那群小混混是故意的
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 ren4 wei2 na4 qun2 xiao3 hun4 hun4 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: His daughter believes the thugs did it on purpose.

cues.zh: 这种事情也不是一天两天了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2 ye3 bu2 shi4 yi1 tian1 liang3 tian1 le5
cues.en: This isn't the first time something like this has happened,

cues.zh: 想要报警
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: and she wants to report it to the police.

cues.zh: 但老壮觉得多一事不如少一事
cues.pinyin: dan4 lao3 zhuang4 jue2 de5 duo1 yi1 shi4 bu4 ru2 shao3 yi1 shi4
cues.en: But Lao Zhuang feels it's better not to make a fuss,

cues.zh: 想大事化小小事化两
cues.pinyin: xiang3 da4 shi4 hua4 xiao3 xiao3 shi4 hua4 liang3
cues.en: wanting to downplay the whole thing.

cues.zh: 正说着呢
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shuo1 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: Just as they're talking about it,

cues.zh: 老壮突然变得呼吸困难
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 tu1 ran2 bian4 de2 hu1 xi1 kun4 nan2
cues.en: Lao Zhuang suddenly can't breathe.

cues.zh: 一看才发现
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: On checking, they discover

cues.zh: 骨折的骨头和舌头向后滑动
cues.pinyin: gu3 zhe2 de5 gu3 tou5 he2 she2 tou5 xiang4 hou4 hua2 dong4
cues.en: the broken bone and his tongue have slid backward,

cues.zh: 阻塞了他的口液
cues.pinyin: zu3 se4 le5 ta1 de5 kou3 ye4
cues.en: blocking his airway.

cues.zh: 医生立刻给他推进了手术室
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 tui1 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: The doctors rush him into the operating room.

cues.zh: 医生将老壮的骨折碎片复位
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jiang1 lao3 zhuang4 de5 gu3 zhe2 sui4 pian4 fu4 wei4
cues.en: They reposition the fractured bone fragments.

cues.zh: 科手术图中
cues.pinyin: ke1 shou3 shu4 tu2 zhong1
cues.en: During the surgery,

cues.zh: 老壮心率减缓
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 xin1 lv4 jian3 huan3
cues.en: Lao Zhuang's heart rate slows,

cues.zh: 心跳和碎牙皱降
cues.pinyin: xin1 tiao4 he2 sui4 ya2 zhou4 jiang4
cues.en: and his heart rate and blood pressure suddenly crash.

cues.zh: 黑哥猜测老壮可能会有心脏问题
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 cai1 ce4 lao3 zhuang4 ke3 neng2 hui4 you3 xin1 zang4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Dr. Park suspects Lao Zhuang might have a heart condition

cues.zh: 导致了对麻醉剂的不良反应
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 le5 dui4 ma2 zui4 ji4 de5 bu4 liang2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: causing a bad reaction to the anesthetic.

cues.zh: 但做了超声波和心电图后
cues.pinyin: dan4 zuo4 le5 chao1 sheng1 bo1 he2 xin1 dian4 tu2 hou4
cues.en: But after an ultrasound and an ECG,

cues.zh: 并没有发现什么问题
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: they find nothing wrong.

cues.zh: 而手术中的不良反应
cues.pinyin: er2 shou3 shu4 zhong1 de5 bu4 liang2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: So the reaction during surgery

cues.zh: 大概只是轻微的麻药反应
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhi3 shi4 qing1 wei1 de5 ma2 yao4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: was probably just a mild anesthesia response,

cues.zh: 属于正常范围
cues.pinyin: shu3 yu2 zheng4 chang2 fan4 wei2
cues.en: within the normal range.

cues.zh: 但事情似乎并没有那么简单
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qing2 si4 hu1 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But things turn out not to be so simple.

cues.zh: 术后老壮又发生了一次心率降低
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 lao3 zhuang4 you4 fa1 sheng1 le5 yi1 ci4 xin1 lv4 jiang4 di1
cues.en: After the surgery, Lao Zhuang's heart rate drops again,

cues.zh: 还伴随着窒息危险
cues.pinyin: hai2 ban4 sui2 zhe5 zhi4 xi1 wei1 xian3
cues.en: along with a risk of suffocation.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 感到的不止是伤心
cues.pinyin: gan3 dao4 de5 bu4 zhi3 shi4 shang1 xin1
cues.en: What his daughter feels isn't just sadness,

cues.zh: 还要委屈
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 wei3 qu1
cues.en: but also resentment.

cues.zh: 老壮怎么这样
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 zen3 me5 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Why is her father like this —

cues.zh: 小心翼翼地活着
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 di4 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: living so carefully,

cues.zh: 不愿意冒一点风险
cues.pinyin: bu4 yuan4 yi4 mao4 yi4 dian3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: unwilling to take even a small risk,

cues.zh: 就算被小混混袭击
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 bei4 xiao3 hun4 hun4 xi2 ji1
cues.en: not even thinking to call the police

cues.zh: 也不想着报警
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xiang3 zhe5 bao4 jing3
cues.en: when he's attacked by thugs,

cues.zh: 吃下这个哑巴亏
cues.pinyin: chi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 ya3 ba5 kui1
cues.en: just swallowing the injustice

cues.zh: 继续软弱下去
cues.pinyin: ji4 xu4 ruan3 ruo4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: and staying weak.

cues.zh: 出了这么大的事情
cues.pinyin: chu1 le5 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: Something this serious happened,

cues.zh: 也不告诉自己
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 gao4 su4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: and he still won't even tell his daughter.

cues.zh: 是想自己欺人下去吗
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiang3 zi4 ji3 qi1 ren2 xia4 qu4 ma5
cues.en: Is he trying to keep deceiving himself?

cues.zh: 但朴医生告诉他
cues.pinyin: dan4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: But Dr. Park tells her

cues.zh: 老壮至此也会这样
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 zhi4 ci3 ye3 hui4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: the reason Lao Zhuang is like this

cues.zh: 是为了保护女儿
cues.pinyin: shi4 wei4 le5 bao3 hu4 nv3 er2
cues.en: is to protect his daughter.

cues.zh: 她想独自面对这个世界的恶意
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 du2 zi4 mian4 dui4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jie4 de5 e4 yi4
cues.en: He wants to face the world's malice alone,

cues.zh: 就像当初来到一厢白手起家
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 dang1 chu1 lai2 dao4 yi1 xiang1 bai2 shou3 qi3 jia1
cues.en: just like back when he built the business from nothing by himself,

cues.zh: 护着她长大一样
cues.pinyin: hu4 zhe5 ta1 zhang3 da4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: shielding her as she grew up.

cues.zh: 是生活逼着她在坚强
cues.pinyin: shi4 sheng1 huo2 bi1 zhe5 ta1 zai4 jian1 qiang2
cues.en: It's life that forced him to be strong.

cues.zh: 在朴医生的劝说之下
cues.pinyin: zai4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 de5 quan4 shuo1 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: Persuaded by Dr. Park,

cues.zh: 女儿决定和爸爸谈一谈
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 jue2 ding4 he2 ba4 ba4 tan2 yi1 tan2
cues.en: the daughter decides to talk with her father.

cues.zh: 虽然女儿也不想随着爸爸
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 nv3 er2 ye3 bu4 xiang3 sui2 zhe5 ba4 ba4
cues.en: Though she doesn't want to simply go along with him,

cues.zh: 可她最终还是决定尊重老壮的意愿
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 zui4 zhong1 hai2 shi4 jue2 ding4 zun1 zhong4 lao3 zhuang4 de5 yi4 yuan4
cues.en: she ultimately decides to respect Lao Zhuang's wishes.

cues.zh: 但这违背了朴医生和萧音的初衷
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 wei2 bei4 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1 he2 xiao1 yin1 de5 chu1 zhong1
cues.en: But this goes against what Dr. Park and Shaun intended.

cues.zh: 他们是想和修复女儿和老壮的关系
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi4 xiang3 he2 xiu1 fu4 nv3 er2 he2 lao3 zhuang4 de5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: They had wanted to repair the father-daughter relationship

cues.zh: 然后让女儿劝说老壮做手术
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rang4 nv3 er2 quan4 shuo1 lao3 zhuang4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and have the daughter convince Lao Zhuang to have the surgery.

cues.zh: 可没想到过头了
cues.pinyin: ke3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 guo4 tou2 le5
cues.en: Instead, it backfires completely.

cues.zh: 妇女俩站在了同一站前
cues.pinyin: fu4 nv3 lia3 zhan4 zai4 le5 tong2 yi1 zhan4 qian2
cues.en: Father and daughter end up standing on the same side.

cues.zh: 肖音急得腾腾转
cues.pinyin: xiao4 yin1 ji2 de2 teng2 teng2 zhuan3
cues.en: Shaun is so anxious he can't sit still,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 良医最新剧情：天才医生肖恩为了五星好评直接开挂！老人的性命得以拯救！

cues.zh: 不仅是因为老壮不同意手术
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 shi4 yin1 wei4 lao3 zhuang4 bu4 tong2 yi4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: not only because Lao Zhuang refuses the surgery,

cues.zh: 还有朴医生劝说成功的对比
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 pu3 yi1 sheng1 quan4 shuo1 cheng2 gong1 de5 dui4 bi3
cues.en: but also because, next to Dr. Park's successful persuasion,

cues.zh: 显得自己十分不会交流
cues.pinyin: xian3 de5 zi4 ji3 shi2 fen1 bu2 hui4 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: he looks terrible at communicating

cues.zh: 还不讨喜
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu4 tao3 xi3
cues.en: and unlikeable besides.

cues.zh: 丽雅告诉她
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Lea tells him

cues.zh: 是这种打分机制困扰了她
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhe4 zhong3 da3 fen1 ji1 zhi4 kun4 rao3 le5 ta1
cues.en: it's this rating system that's been troubling him —

cues.zh: 纠结于别人的想法
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jie2 yu2 bie2 ren2 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: dwelling on what other people think

cues.zh: 这会让自己陷入疯狂的漩涡
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 rang4 zi4 ji3 xian4 ru4 feng1 kuang2 de5 xuan2 wo1
cues.en: will only drag him into a maddening spiral.

cues.zh: 你是一个好医生
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: "You're a good doctor.

cues.zh: 这就够了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: That's enough."

cues.zh: 没过多久
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Not long after,

cues.zh: 老壮突发了癫痫
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 tu1 fa1 le5 dian1 xian2
cues.en: Lao Zhuang suddenly has a seizure.

cues.zh: 尽管很快稳定住了
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 hen3 kuai4 wen3 ding4 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Though he's quickly stabilized,

cues.zh: 但情况依旧不容乐观
cues.pinyin: dan4 qing2 kuang4 yi1 jiu4 bu4 rong2 le4 guan1
cues.en: the outlook remains grim.

cues.zh: 医生告诉女儿
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 nv3 er2
cues.en: The doctors tell his daughter

cues.zh: 随着肿瘤的生长
cues.pinyin: sui2 zhe5 zhong3 liu2 de5 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: that as the tumor keeps growing,

cues.zh: 老壮癫痫和脑伤的情况
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 dian1 xian2 he2 nao3 shang1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Lao Zhuang's seizures and brain damage

cues.zh: 只会越来越重
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hui4 yue4 lai2 yue4 zhong4
cues.en: will only get worse.

cues.zh: 现在只能用药物使她陷入昏迷
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhi3 neng2 yong4 yao4 wu4 shi3 ta1 xian4 ru4 hun1 mi2
cues.en: Now they can only use medication to keep him sedated

cues.zh: 直到肿瘤夺走她的生命
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhong3 liu2 duo2 zou3 ta1 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: until the tumor takes his life.

cues.zh: 可能女儿还是很纠结
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 nv3 er2 hai2 shi4 hen3 jiu1 jie2
cues.en: His daughter is probably still torn.

cues.zh: 爸爸说得很清楚了
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 shuo1 de2 hen3 qing1 chu3 le5
cues.en: Her father has made it very clear:

cues.zh: 不想后半生在病床上果眼残喘
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiang3 hou4 ban4 sheng1 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4 guo3 yan3 can2 chuan3
cues.en: he doesn't want to spend his final days lingering in a hospital bed.

cues.zh: 如果自己坚持做手术的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zi4 ji3 jian1 chi2 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If she insists on the surgery anyway,

cues.zh: 她可能会恨自己
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 neng2 hui4 hen4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: he might end up resenting her.

cues.zh: 但肖恩直言
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 zhi2 yan2
cues.en: But Shaun says bluntly

cues.zh: 这是一个不理智的选择
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 bu4 li3 zhi4 de5 xuan3 ze2
cues.en: that this is an irrational choice —

cues.zh: 老壮恨不恨你并不重要
cues.pinyin: lao3 zhuang4 hen4 bu4 hen4 ni3 bing4 bu2 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: whether Lao Zhuang resents her or not isn't the point.

cues.zh: 纠结于此
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jie2 yu2 ci3
cues.en: Dwelling on it

cues.zh: 这会让你陷入疯狂的漩涡
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 rang4 ni3 xian4 ru4 feng1 kuang2 de5 xuan2 wo1
cues.en: will only drag her into a maddening spiral.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 每到夏季我们经常听到台风这个词
cues.pinyin: mei3 dao4 xia4 ji4 wo3 men5 jing1 chang2 ting1 dao4 tai2 feng1 zhe4 ge5 ci2
cues.en: Every summer we often hear the word "typhoon."

cues.zh: 台风一来就会造成大范围的降雨
cues.pinyin: tai2 feng1 yi1 lai2 jiu4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 da4 fan4 wei2 de5 jiang4 yu3
cues.en: Once a typhoon arrives, it causes widespread rainfall.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说台风是怎么形成的
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 tai2 feng1 shi4 zen3 me5 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: A kid asked me how typhoons form.

cues.zh: 为什么台风会有台风眼呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 tai2 feng1 hui4 you3 tai2 feng1 yan3 ne5
cues.en: Why do typhoons have an eye?

cues.zh: 台风为什么是涡旋形状的
cues.pinyin: tai2 feng1 wei4 shen2 me5 shi4 wo1 xuan2 xing2 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: Why are typhoons shaped like vortices?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来研究一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's look into this question.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说一下台风的条件
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 tai2 feng1 de5 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: First, let's talk about the conditions for a typhoon.

cues.zh: 人们对于台风其实研究的还不是那么清楚
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 dui4 yu2 tai2 feng1 qi2 shi2 yan2 jiu1 de5 hai2 bu2 shi4 na4 me5 qing1 chu3
cues.en: Actually, people haven't studied typhoons that clearly yet.

cues.zh: 但是人们大体上认同台风的条件有两个
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ren2 men5 da4 ti3 shang4 ren4 tong2 tai2 feng1 de5 tiao2 jian4 you3 liang3 ge4
cues.en: But people generally agree there are two conditions for a typhoon.

cues.zh: 一个就是要有大量的水汽
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 jiu4 shi4 yao4 you3 da4 liang4 de5 shui3 qi4
cues.en: One is that there must be a large amount of water vapor.

cues.zh: 什么地方有大量水气呢就是海洋上
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 di4 fang1 you3 da4 liang4 shui3 qi4 ne5 jiu4 shi4 hai3 yang2 shang4
cues.en: Where is there a lot of water vapor? Over the ocean.

cues.zh: 第二就是要有什么呀要有这个大量的热量
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jiu4 shi4 yao4 you3 shen2 me5 ya5 yao4 you3 zhe4 ge5 da4 liang4 de5 re4 liang4
cues.en: Second, what's needed? A large amount of heat.

cues.zh: 那这就必须在夏季太阳光强烈照射的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 jiu4 bi4 xu1 zai4 xia4 ji4 tai4 yang2 guang1 qiang2 lie4 zhao4 she4 de5
cues.en: That can only happen in summer when sunlight shines

cues.zh: 时候才会发生
cues.pinyin: shi2 hou4 cai2 hui4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: strongly enough.

cues.zh: 台风具体怎么回事
cues.pinyin: tai2 feng1 ju4 ti3 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: How exactly does a typhoon happen?

cues.zh: 大概就是这是一个大海
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 da4 hai3
cues.en: Let's say this is an ocean.

cues.zh: 大海
cues.pinyin: da4 hai3
cues.en: An ocean.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 然后在阳光强烈照射下的时候怎么样
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 yang2 guang1 qiang2 lie4 zhao4 she4 xia4 de5 shi2 hou4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: Then when strong sunlight shines on it, what happens?

cues.zh: 水蒸气这个海水就会变成水蒸气
cues.pinyin: shui3 zheng1 qi4 zhe4 ge5 hai3 shui3 jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 shui3 zheng1 qi4
cues.en: The seawater turns into water vapor.

cues.zh: 同时会上升
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hui4 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: At the same time it rises.

cues.zh: 因为它膨胀了所以就上升
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 peng2 zhang4 le5 suo3 yi3 jiu4 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: Because it expands, it rises.

cues.zh: 这就是第一个条件
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 di4 yi2 ge4 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: This is the first condition.

cues.zh: 就是阳光照射阳光照射
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yang2 guang1 zhao4 she4 yang2 guang1 zhao4 she4
cues.en: That is, sunlight — sunlight.

cues.zh: 所以海水就会蒸发
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hai3 shui3 jiu4 hui4 zheng1 fa1
cues.en: So the seawater evaporates.

cues.zh: 除了海水蒸发以外
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 hai3 shui3 zheng1 fa1 yi3 wai4
cues.en: Besides the seawater evaporating,

cues.zh: 水蒸气还要上升这是第一个
cues.pinyin: shui3 zheng1 qi4 hai2 yao4 shang4 sheng1 zhe4 shi4 di4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: the water vapor also needs to rise — that's the first part.

cues.zh: 那么水蒸气上升了之后会怎么样
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shui3 zheng1 qi4 shang4 sheng1 le5 zhi1 hou4 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: So what happens after the water vapor rises?

cues.zh: 大海的温度稍微高一些
cues.pinyin: da4 hai3 de5 wen1 du4 shao1 wei1 gao1 yi1 xie1
cues.en: The ocean's temperature is a bit higher.

cues.zh: 到了高空的温度还没有那么高
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 gao1 kong1 de5 wen1 du4 hai2 mei2 you3 na4 me5 gao1
cues.en: At high altitude the temperature isn't as high.

cues.zh: 所以上升气流就会怎么样
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shang4 sheng1 qi4 liu2 jiu4 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: So what happens to the rising air current?

cues.zh: 上升的气流里面有水蒸气就会出现液化
cues.pinyin: shang4 sheng1 de5 qi4 liu2 li3 mian4 you3 shui3 zheng1 qi4 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 ye4 hua4
cues.en: The water vapor in the rising air current will condense.

cues.zh: 水气就会液化
cues.pinyin: shui3 qi4 jiu4 hui4 ye4 hua4
cues.en: The water vapor will condense.

cues.zh: 那么水气一旦要液化了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shui3 qi4 yi2 dan4 yao4 ye4 hua4 le5
cues.en: Once the water vapor condenses,

cues.zh: 它就会怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: what happens then?

cues.zh: 它就会成云有可能就会降雨
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 cheng2 yun2 you3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 hui4 jiang4 yu3
cues.en: Clouds form, and it may rain.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 上升到上面成云降雨周围的空气补充过来
cues.pinyin: shang4 sheng1 dao4 shang4 mian4 cheng2 yun2 jiang4 yu3 zhou1 wei2 de5 kong1 qi4 bu3 chong1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: It rises up, forms clouds and rains, and the surrounding air rushes in to fill the gap.

cues.zh: 这就是台风的简单道理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 tai2 feng1 de5 jian3 dan1 dao4 li3
cues.en: That's the basic idea of a typhoon.

cues.zh: 但是这个道理还没有说明为什
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 dao4 li3 hai2 mei2 you3 shuo1 ming2 wei4 shen2
cues.en: But this explanation still hasn't shown why

cues.zh: 么会有台风眼
cues.pinyin: me5 hui4 you3 tai2 feng1 yan3
cues.en: there's a typhoon eye.

cues.zh: 以及台风的涡旋形状是如何形成的
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 tai2 feng1 de5 wo1 xuan2 xing2 zhuang4 shi4 ru2 he2 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: or how the typhoon's vortex shape forms.

cues.zh: 下面咱们来研究一下台风的这个旋转
cues.pinyin: xia4 mian4 zan2 men5 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 tai2 feng1 de5 zhe4 ge5 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: Next, let's look into this rotation of the typhoon.

cues.zh: 这个涡旋到底是怎么形成的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo1 xuan2 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: How exactly does this vortex form?

cues.zh: 台风的涡旋是如何形成的
cues.pinyin: tai2 feng1 de5 wo1 xuan2 shi4 ru2 he2 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: How does the typhoon's vortex form?

cues.zh: 大家知道不知道北半球的台风涡旋
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 bei3 ban4 qiu2 de5 tai2 feng1 wo1 xuan2
cues.en: Does everyone know whether a typhoon's vortex in the Northern Hemisphere

cues.zh: 是顺势针还是逆势针的
cues.pinyin: shi4 shun4 shi4 zhen1 hai2 shi4 ni4 shi4 zhen1 de5
cues.en: spins clockwise or counterclockwise?

cues.zh: 应该是逆势针的而南半球是顺势针的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 ni4 shi4 zhen1 de5 er2 nan2 ban4 qiu2 shi4 shun4 shi4 zhen1 de5
cues.en: It should be counterclockwise, while in the Southern Hemisphere it's clockwise.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 为了解释这件事我们首先得说一下
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 de2 shuo1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: To explain this, we first need to talk about

cues.zh: 有一个物理学原理叫科里奥利利
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 wu4 li3 xue2 yuan2 li3 jiao4 ke1 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: a principle in physics called the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 科里奥利利
cues.pinyin: ke1 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: The Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 有同学在学地理的时候老师可能提到过叫
cues.pinyin: you3 tong2 xue2 zai4 xue2 di4 li3 de5 shi2 hou4 lao3 shi1 ke3 neng2 ti2 dao4 guo4 jiao4
cues.en: When studying geography, your teacher may have mentioned

cues.zh: 做地转偏向力
cues.pinyin: zuo4 di4 zhuan3 pian1 xiang4 li4
cues.en: the "geostrophic deflection force."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 于是人感觉好像有一个力在拽着他一样
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ren2 gan3 jue2 hao3 xiang4 you3 yi2 ge4 li4 zai4 zhuai1 zhe5 ta1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: So people feel as if some force is pulling them.

cues.zh: 这个力给他起个名字叫科里奥利利
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 gei3 ta1 qi3 ge4 ming2 zi4 jiao4 ke1 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: This force was given a name: the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 事实上科里奥利利是不存在的
cues.pinyin: shi4 shi2 shang4 ke1 li3 ao4 li4 li4 shi4 bu4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: In fact, the Coriolis force doesn't really exist.

cues.zh: 它只是一种惯性力就是因为参考
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 guan4 xing4 li4 jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 can1 kao3
cues.en: It's just an inertial force caused by a change

cues.zh: 系变换造成的
cues.pinyin: xi4 bian4 huan4 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: of reference frame.

cues.zh: 那么克里奥利利大小有多大呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 da4 xiao3 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: So how big is the Coriolis force?

cues.zh: 这个大小这么算
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 xiao3 zhe4 me5 suan4
cues.en: Here's how it's calculated.

cues.zh: 克里奥利利的大小等于 2 m v x
cues.pinyin: ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 de5 da4 xiao3 deng3 yu2 2 m v x
cues.en: The magnitude of the Coriolis force equals 2mv×ω.

cues.zh: 所以这什么意思 2 m 就是 2 倍的物体质量
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 2 m jiu4 shi4 2 bei4 de5 wu4 ti3 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: So what does that mean? 2m is twice the object's mass.

cues.zh: v 是这个物体相对于参考系
cues.pinyin: v shi4 zhe4 ge5 wu4 ti3 xiang1 dui4 yu2 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: v is the velocity of the object relative to

cues.zh: 转动参考系的速度
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 dong4 can1 kao3 xi4 de5 su4 du4
cues.en: the rotating reference frame.

cues.zh: 比如这个人相右的速度叫 v
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zhe4 ge5 ren2 xiang1 you4 de5 su4 du4 jiao4 v
cues.en: For example, the speed this person is walking is called v.

cues.zh: 同时还有一个是这个盘子旋转的角速度
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5 xuan2 zhuan3 de5 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: There's also the angular velocity of the rotating disk.

cues.zh: 角速度也有方向
cues.pinyin: jiao3 su4 du4 ye3 you3 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: Angular velocity also has a direction.

cues.zh: 就是我们右手四指顺着这个盘
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 you4 shou3 si4 zhi3 shun4 zhe5 zhe4 ge5 pan2
cues.en: If we curl the fingers of our right hand in the direction

cues.zh: 子转动的方向
cues.pinyin: zi5 zhuan3 dong4 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: the disk is rotating,

cues.zh: 则大拇指就是角速度方向
cues.pinyin: ze2 da4 mu3 zhi3 jiu4 shi4 jiao3 su4 du4 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: then the thumb points in the direction of the angular velocity.

cues.zh: 所以这个盘子角速度方向是向上的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 pan2 zi5 jiao3 su4 du4 fang1 xiang4 shi4 xiang4 shang4 de5
cues.en: So the disk's angular velocity points upward.

cues.zh: 这个时候克里奥利利是朝我们的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 shi4 chao2 wo3 men5 de5
cues.en: At this point the Coriolis force points toward us.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 所以大概是这个方向朝这个方向
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 fang1 xiang4 chao2 zhe4 ge5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: So roughly it points in this direction.

cues.zh: 这叫克里奥利利
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: This is called the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 它的方向也满足右手定则
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fang1 xiang4 ye3 man3 zu2 you4 shou3 ding4 ze2
cues.en: Its direction also follows the right-hand rule.

cues.zh: 就是我右手四指先指向 V 的方向
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 you4 shou3 si4 zhi3 xian1 zhi3 xiang4 V de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: That is, point the fingers of your right hand toward the direction of V,

cues.zh: 再转向的方向咱们看
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhuan3 xiang4 de5 fang1 xiang4 zan2 men5 kan4
cues.en: then curl them toward the direction of — let's see.

cues.zh: 右手四指先指向 V 的方向
cues.pinyin: you4 shou3 si4 zhi3 xian1 zhi3 xiang4 V de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: point the fingers of your right hand toward the direction of V first,

cues.zh: 再转向角速度的方向
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhuan3 xiang4 jiao3 su4 du4 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: then curl toward the direction of angular velocity.

cues.zh: 大拇指的方向就是克里奥利利的方向
cues.pinyin: da4 mu3 zhi3 de5 fang1 xiang4 jiu4 shi4 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: The direction the thumb points is the direction of the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 而且我们会发现这样一件事
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 wo3 men5 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 yang4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: And we'll also notice something else:

cues.zh: 就是说这个人在盘子上边走的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ren2 zai4 pan2 zi5 shang4 bian1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when this person walks on the spinning disk,

cues.zh: 他受到的力总是向右的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shou4 dao4 de5 li4 zong3 shi4 xiang4 you4 de5
cues.en: the force they feel is always to the right.

cues.zh: 你往这边走他受力向右
cues.pinyin: ni3 wang3 zhe4 bian1 zou3 ta1 shou4 li4 xiang4 you4
cues.en: If you walk this way, the force pushes you to the right.

cues.zh: 你往左走他受力向里边
cues.pinyin: ni3 wang3 zuo3 zou3 ta1 shou4 li4 xiang4 li3 bian1
cues.en: If you walk to the left, the force pushes you inward.

cues.zh: 向里边其实还是向右
cues.pinyin: xiang4 li3 bian1 qi2 shi2 hai2 shi4 xiang4 you4
cues.en: Inward is actually still to the right.

cues.zh: 所以克里奥利利在这个情况下
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: So in this situation, the Coriolis force

cues.zh: 他总是向右的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zong3 shi4 xiang4 you4 de5
cues.en: always points to the right.

cues.zh: 那么在地球上其实也差不太多
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 qi2 shi2 ye3 cha4 bu4 tai4 duo1
cues.en: On Earth it's actually not too different.

cues.zh: 比如说地球
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 di4 qiu2
cues.en: Take Earth, for example.

cues.zh: 我们知道地球也是绕地轴在旋转的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 ye3 shi4 rao4 di4 zhou2 zai4 xuan2 zhuan3 de5
cues.en: We know Earth also rotates around its axis.

cues.zh: 有一个角速度对吧旋转的
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 jiao3 su4 du4 dui4 ba5 xuan2 zhuan3 de5
cues.en: It has an angular velocity too, right?

cues.zh: 那么假如有一个人他在北半球运动
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jia3 ru2 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 ta1 zai4 bei3 ban4 qiu2 yun4 dong4
cues.en: So suppose a person is moving in the Northern Hemisphere.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频说清台风的成因

cues.zh: 这个分量就是使这个人向右偏的分量
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fen4 liang4 jiu4 shi4 shi3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 xiang4 you4 pian1 de5 fen4 liang4
cues.en: This component is the part that deflects the person to the right.

cues.zh: 所以我们有一种说法
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 you3 yi1 zhong3 shuo1 fa3
cues.en: So there's a saying

cues.zh: 就是北半球河流会怎么样会向右方侵蚀
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bei3 ban4 qiu2 he2 liu2 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4 hui4 xiang4 you4 fang1 qin1 shi2
cues.en: that in the Northern Hemisphere, rivers erode toward the right bank.

cues.zh: 这就是因为克里奥利利的作用造成的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 de5 zuo4 yong4 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: This is caused by the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 北半球物体在运动的过程中受力会向右
cues.pinyin: bei3 ban4 qiu2 wu4 ti3 zai4 yun4 dong4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 shou4 li4 hui4 xiang4 you4
cues.en: In the Northern Hemisphere, a moving object's force deflects to the right.

cues.zh: 受力会向右原因就是地转偏向力或者
cues.pinyin: shou4 li4 hui4 xiang4 you4 yuan2 yin1 jiu4 shi4 di4 zhuan3 pian1 xiang4 li4 huo4 zhe3
cues.en: The reason the force deflects right is the geostrophic deflection force, or

cues.zh: 说克里奥利利
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: in other words, the Coriolis force.

cues.zh: 那么如果这个人在赤道上往里走
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 zai4 chi4 dao4 shang4 wang3 li3 zou3
cues.en: So if this person walks toward the center while on the equator,

cues.zh: 赤道上往里走实际上是向东往里走
cues.pinyin: chi4 dao4 shang4 wang3 li3 zou3 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 xiang4 dong1 wang3 li3 zou3
cues.en: walking toward the center on the equator actually means walking eastward.

cues.zh: 在这个时候他受到的克里奥利
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ta1 shou4 dao4 de5 ke4 li3 ao4 li4
cues.en: At this point, the Coriolis force

cues.zh: 利还是向右的
cues.pinyin: li4 hai2 shi4 xiang4 you4 de5
cues.en: they experience still points to the right.

cues.zh: 我们会发现这个克里奥利利不会
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 bu2 hui4
cues.en: But we'll find that this Coriolis force doesn't

cues.zh: 说科里奥利力
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ke1 li3 ao4 li4 li4
cues.en: produce any sideways

cues.zh: 的影响对不对
cues.pinyin: de5 ying3 xiang3 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: effect on them, right?

cues.zh: 所以赤道上是没有克里奥利利的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 chi4 dao4 shang4 shi4 mei2 you3 ke4 li3 ao4 li4 li4 de5
cues.en: So there's no Coriolis force at the equator.

cues.zh: 在赤道上是没有力的
cues.pinyin: zai4 chi4 dao4 shang4 shi4 mei2 you3 li4 de5
cues.en: There's no such force at the equator.

cues.zh: 有一天孙子跟爷爷说
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 sun1 zi5 gen1 ye2 ye2 shuo1
cues.en: One day, a grandson said to his grandfather,

cues.zh: 我朋友家养的猫好厉害喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 peng2 you3 jia1 yang3 de5 mao1 hao3 li4 hai4 o1
cues.en: "My friend's cat at home is so amazing!"

cues.zh: 他竟然会讲中文耶
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing4 ran2 hui4 jiang3 zhong1 wen2 ye2
cues.en: "It can actually speak Chinese!"

cues.zh: 每次我问他去哪里拜拜的时候他就说喵喵
cues.pinyin: mei3 ci4 wo3 wen4 ta1 qu4 na3 li3 bai4 bai4 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 shuo1 miao1 miao1
cues.en: "Every time I ask where it goes to pray, it just says 'meow meow'."

cues.zh: 哎哟那不算什么啦
cues.pinyin: ai1 yo1 na4 bu4 suan4 shen2 me5 la5
cues.en: "Oh, that's nothing."

cues.zh: 我之前养的羊还会说英文耶
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 qian2 yang3 de5 yang2 hai2 hui4 shuo1 ying1 wen2 ye2
cues.en: "The sheep I used to raise could even speak English."

cues.zh: 每次我问他五月的英文怎么讲他都说喵喵
cues.pinyin: mei3 ci4 wo3 wen4 ta1 wu3 yue4 de5 ying1 wen2 zen3 me5 jiang3 ta1 dou1 shuo1 miao1 miao1
cues.en: "Every time I asked it how to say 'May' in English, it just bleated 'Meh~' (which sounds like 'May')."

cues.zh: 我问你喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 有一个人的名字叫老王
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 de5 ming2 zi4 jiao4 lao3 wang2
cues.en: "There's a man named Lao Wang."

cues.zh: 那他姓什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 xing4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: "So what's his surname?"

cues.zh: 姓什么喔
cues.pinyin: xing4 shen2 me5 o1
cues.en: "What's his surname?"

cues.zh: 姓陈吗
cues.pinyin: xing4 chen2 ma5
cues.en: "Is it Chen?"

cues.zh: 还是姓隔壁的
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 xing4 ge2 bi4 de5
cues.en: "Or is it 'Next Door's'?"

cues.zh: 隔壁的老王
cues.pinyin: ge2 bi4 de5 lao3 wang2
cues.en: "Next door's Lao Wang."

cues.zh: 要不然是什么
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "If not that, then what?"

cues.zh: 答案是王
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 wang2

cues.zh: 有一天小明去搭巴士时
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 qu4 da1 ba1 shi4 shi2
cues.en: One day, Xiao Ming was taking the bus,

cues.zh: 不小心撞到了一位女士
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 zhuang4 dao4 le5 yi1 wei4 nv3 shi4
cues.en: and accidentally bumped into a lady.

cues.zh: 那位女士不耐烦的说

cues.zh: 你神经病啦

cues.zh: 你会治吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 zhi4 ma5

cues.zh: 珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1
cues.en: Shanshan,

cues.zh: 我问你
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】2026高考志愿填报必看！中国高校录取规则“平行志愿”全解析

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 现在 20 26 年的高考成绩已经出来了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 20 26 nian2 de5 gao1 kao3 cheng2 ji4 yi3 jing1 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The 2026 college entrance exam scores have already come out.

cues.zh: 各个省份都已经陆续开始了
cues.pinyin: ge4 ge4 sheng3 fen4 dou1 yi3 jing1 lu4 xu4 kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: Every province has already started

cues.zh: 高考院校的报名和录取工作
cues.pinyin: gao1 kao3 yuan4 xiao4 de5 bao4 ming2 he2 lu4 qu3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: the application and admission process for universities.

cues.zh: 于是高考报什么专业成了一个热门话题
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 gao1 kao3 bao4 shen2 me5 zhuan1 ye4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 re4 men2 hua4 ti2
cues.en: So what major to apply for has become a hot topic.

cues.zh: 但是无论你报什么专业什么院校
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wu2 lun4 ni3 bao4 shen2 me5 zhuan1 ye4 shen2 me5 yuan4 xiao4
cues.en: But no matter what major or school you apply to,

cues.zh: 都必须对高考投档和录取的规则
cues.pinyin: dou1 bi4 xu1 dui4 gao1 kao3 tou2 dang4 he2 lu4 qu3 de5 gui1 ze2
cues.en: you must have a certain understanding

cues.zh: 有一定的了解
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ding4 de5 liao3 jie3
cues.en: of the rules for score submission and admission.

cues.zh: 有个小朋友就跟我说
cues.pinyin: you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A young viewer told me

cues.zh: 他对现在的平行志愿制度还不是非常清楚
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 xian4 zai4 de5 ping2 xing2 zhi4 yuan4 zhi4 du4 hai2 bu2 shi4 fei1 chang2 qing1 chu3
cues.en: he's still not very clear on the current parallel-preference system.

cues.zh: 这和以前的录取方法有什么样的区别呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 he2 yi3 qian2 de5 lu4 qu3 fang1 fa3 you3 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 qu1 bie2 ne5
cues.en: How is it different from the old admission method?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来仔细地解释一下平行志愿
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 zi3 xi4 di4 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4 ping2 xing2 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: Today let's carefully explain parallel preferences.

cues.zh: 为了解释平行志愿
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 ping2 xing2 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: To explain parallel preferences,

cues.zh: 咱们先来说一说二十年前的高考录取制度
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 er4 shi2 nian2 qian2 de5 gao1 kao3 lu4 qu3 zhi4 du4
cues.en: let's first talk about the admission system from twenty years ago.

cues.zh: 那个叫做顺序志愿
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 jiao4 zuo4 shun4 xu4 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: It was called sequential preferences.

cues.zh: 在我考大学的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 wo3 kao3 da4 xue2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I took the college entrance exam,

cues.zh: 使用的就是顺序志愿的方法
cues.pinyin: shi3 yong4 de5 jiu4 shi4 shun4 xu4 zhi4 yuan4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: sequential preferences was the method used.

cues.zh: 顺序志愿总结来说就是四个字
cues.pinyin: shun4 xu4 zhi4 yuan4 zong3 jie2 lai2 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 si4 ge4 zi4
cues.en: Sequential preferences can be summed up in four words:

cues.zh: 那就是志愿优先
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 zhi4 yuan4 you1 xian1
cues.en: 'preference comes first.'

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】2026高考志愿填报必看！中国高校录取规则“平行志愿”全解析

cues.zh: 志愿优先
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yuan4 you1 xian1
cues.en: Preference comes first.

cues.zh: 我是第一志愿你是第二志愿
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 di4 yi1 zhi4 yuan4 ni3 shi4 di4 er4 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: If I'm your first choice and you're my second choice,

cues.zh: 那我就比你占太多的优势了
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 bi3 ni3 zhan4 tai4 duo1 de5 you1 shi4 le5
cues.en: then I have way more of an advantage than you.

cues.zh: 具体是怎么回事咱们打个比方
cues.pinyin: ju4 ti3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 zan2 men5 da3 ge4 bi3 fang1
cues.en: Let's use an analogy to explain how this actually works.

cues.zh: 比如说有三所学校
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 san1 suo3 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: Say there are three schools.

cues.zh: 每个学校就像一辆公交车
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 xue2 xiao4 jiu4 xiang4 yi1 liang4 gong1 jiao1 che1
cues.en: Each school is like a bus.

cues.zh: 比如说有一个公交车叫北大
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 gong1 jiao1 che1 jiao4 bei3 da4
cues.en: For example, there's a bus called Peking University.

cues.zh: 北大今年在这个省份我招三个人
cues.pinyin: bei3 da4 jin1 nian2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 sheng3 fen4 wo3 zhao1 san1 ge4 ren2
cues.en: This year Peking University is recruiting three people from this province.

cues.zh: 第二个公交车叫清华
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 gong1 jiao1 che1 jiao4 qing1 hua2
cues.en: The second bus is called Tsinghua University.

cues.zh: 清华在这个省份我们招两个人
cues.pinyin: qing1 hua2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 sheng3 fen4 wo3 men5 zhao1 liang3 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Tsinghua is recruiting two people from this province.

cues.zh: 就好像公交车上只有两个座位一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hao3 xiang4 gong1 jiao1 che1 shang4 zhi3 you3 liang3 ge4 zuo4 wei4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: It's like the bus only has two seats.

cues.zh: 坐满了就不能再坐了
cues.pinyin: zuo4 man3 le5 jiu4 bu4 neng2 zai4 zuo4 le5
cues.en: Once they're filled, no one else can get on.

cues.zh: 第三个公交车叫人大
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ge4 gong1 jiao1 che1 jiao4 ren2 da4
cues.en: The third bus is called Renmin University.

cues.zh: 人大在这个省份我们也招三个人
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 sheng3 fen4 wo3 men5 ye3 zhao1 san1 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Renmin University is also recruiting three people from this province.

cues.zh: 然后你进行报名的时候
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 jin4 xing2 bao4 ming2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Then when you submit your application,

cues.zh: 每个人要填报志愿
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 yao4 tian2 bao4 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: everyone has to fill in their preferences.

cues.zh: 我们每壹个人的第一志愿是最重要的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 mei3 yi1 ge4 ren2 de5 di4 yi1 zhi4 yuan4 shi4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5
cues.en: Each person's first choice is the most important,

cues.zh: 所以咱们只列出第一志愿
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zan2 men5 zhi3 lie4 chu1 di4 yi1 zhi4 yuan4
cues.en: so let's just look at the first choices.

cues.zh: 比如说报北大的这些人
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 bao4 bei3 da4 de5 zhe4 xie1 ren2
cues.en: Take the people who put Peking University as their first choice.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】2026高考志愿填报必看！中国高校录取规则“平行志愿”全解析

cues.zh: 那我们就从高分往第一分去捋嘛
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jiu4 cong2 gao1 fen1 wang3 di4 yi1 fen1 qu4 lv3 ma5
cues.en: We rank them from the highest score down.

cues.zh: 咱们看报北大的一共有这么多人
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 kan4 bao4 bei3 da4 de5 yi1 gong4 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2
cues.en: Say this many people chose Peking University as first choice.

cues.zh: 那么其中北大只录取三个人
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 qi2 zhong1 bei3 da4 zhi3 lu4 qu3 san1 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Peking University only admits three people.

cues.zh: 所以第一个人最高分录了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 di4 yi2 ge4 ren2 zui4 gao1 fen1 lu4 le5
cues.en: So the person with the highest score gets admitted,

cues.zh: 第二个人录了
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 ren2 lu4 le5
cues.en: the second person gets admitted,

cues.zh: 第三个人录了
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ge4 ren2 lu4 le5
cues.en: the third person gets admitted,

cues.zh: 往后就不录了这卡个线
cues.pinyin: wang3 hou4 jiu4 bu4 lu4 le5 zhe4 ka3 ge4 xian4
cues.en: and after that no one else gets in — that's the cutoff.

cues.zh: 所以北大的分数线就是最后一名
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bei3 da4 de5 fen1 shu4 xian4 jiu4 shi4 zui4 hou4 yi1 ming2
cues.en: So Peking University's cutoff score is the score of

cues.zh: 的分数 67 1 分
cues.pinyin: de5 fen1 shu4 67 1 fen1
cues.en: the last admitted person: 671.

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 清华录两个人第一个录了第二个录了
cues.pinyin: qing1 hua2 lu4 liang3 ge4 ren2 di4 yi2 ge4 lu4 le5 di4 er4 ge4 lu4 le5
cues.en: Tsinghua admits two people — the first and second get in,

cues.zh: 来往后就不再录了
cues.pinyin: lai2 wang3 hou4 jiu4 bu4 zai4 lu4 le5
cues.en: and after that no one else is admitted.

cues.zh: 所以清华的分数线 6 92 分
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qing1 hua2 de5 fen1 shu4 xian4 6 92 fen1
cues.en: So Tsinghua's cutoff score is 692.

cues.zh: 人大录三个人第一个录了
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 lu4 san1 ge4 ren2 di4 yi2 ge4 lu4 le5
cues.en: Renmin University admits three — the first gets in,

cues.zh: 第二个录了第三个也录了
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 lu4 le5 di4 san1 ge4 ye3 lu4 le5
cues.en: the second gets in, the third also gets in,

cues.zh: 所以恰好到这儿人大的分数线 653 分
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qia4 hao3 dao4 zhe4 er2 ren2 da4 de5 fen1 shu4 xian4 653 fen1
cues.en: so Renmin University's cutoff score ends up being 653.

cues.zh: 这就是传统的录取模式叫做志愿优先
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 chuan2 tong3 de5 lu4 qu3 mo2 shi4 jiao4 zuo4 zhi4 yuan4 you1 xian1
cues.en: This is the traditional admission model called 'preference comes first.'

cues.zh: 那我们来看第一志愿录完了之后
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 di4 yi1 zhi4 yuan4 lu4 wan2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Now let's look at what happens after the first choices are filled.

cues.zh: 那么有的同学比如说这个报清华的这
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 you3 de5 tong2 xue2 bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 bao4 qing1 hua2 de5 zhe4
cues.en: Some students, like this fourth-place student who applied to Tsinghua,

cues.zh: 个第四名同学
cues.pinyin: ge4 di4 si4 ming2 tong2 xue2
cues.en: this person,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】2026高考志愿填报必看！中国高校录取规则“平行志愿”全解析

cues.zh: 这个最高的那个学校
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zui4 gao1 de5 na4 ge5 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: even though their score was the highest of that group,

cues.zh: 有一些学校像北京的首都经贸大学
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 xie1 xue2 xiao4 xiang4 bei3 jing1 de5 shou3 du1 jing1 mao4 da4 xue2
cues.en: some schools, like Capital University of Economics and Business in Beijing,

cues.zh: 像这个吉林的吉林大学
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhe4 ge5 ji2 lin2 de5 ji2 lin2 da4 xue2
cues.en: or Jilin University,

cues.zh: 它会接那个北大清华高分落榜
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 jie1 na4 ge5 bei3 da4 qing1 hua2 gao1 fen1 luo4 bang3
cues.en: will take in students who scored high but were rejected by Peking University or Tsinghua.

cues.zh: 的这些同学的
cues.pinyin: de5 zhe4 xie1 tong2 xue2 de5
cues.en: those students.

cues.zh: 我记得当年我们在高考的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji4 de5 dang1 nian2 wo3 men5 zai4 gao1 kao3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: I remember back when we took the exam,

cues.zh: 我们班有 9 个报了清华北大的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ban1 you3 9 ge4 bao4 le5 qing1 hua2 bei3 da4 de5
cues.en: nine people in my class applied to Tsinghua or Peking University.

cues.zh: 最后考试分出来有 6 个没考上
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 kao3 shi4 fen1 chu1 lai2 you3 6 ge4 mei2 kao3 shang4
cues.en: In the end, six of them didn't get in.

cues.zh: 只有 3 个考上的
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 3 ge4 kao3 shang4 de5
cues.en: Only three got admitted.

cues.zh: 我们班有 9 个人分数超过了清华北大的线
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ban1 you3 9 ge4 ren2 fen1 shu4 chao1 guo4 le5 qing1 hua2 bei3 da4 de5 xian4
cues.en: Nine people in our class scored above the Tsinghua/Peking University cutoff,

cues.zh: 但是只有 3 个人报了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhi3 you3 3 ge4 ren2 bao4 le5
cues.en: but only three of them had actually put those as their choice.

cues.zh: 还有 6 个人是没有报的
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 6 ge4 ren2 shi4 mei2 you3 bao4 de5
cues.en: The other six hadn't listed them as their choice.

cues.zh: 所以就在这个顺序志愿的情况下
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shun4 xu4 zhi4 yuan4 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: So under this sequential-preference system,

cues.zh: 非常容易出现两个情况

cues.en: The first sentence is 'score comes first.'

cues.zh: 都在一个停车场这

cues.zh: 而这个停车场怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 ting2 che1 chang3 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: And how is this parking lot set up?

cues.zh: 只有一个入口
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yi2 ge4 ru4 kou3
cues.en: There's only one entrance.

cues.zh: 只有一个入口
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yi2 ge4 ru4 kou3

cues.zh: 北大也好清华也好人大也好是吧

cues.en: Whether it's Peking University, Tsinghua, or Renmin University,
