items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】上帝的骰子：电子双缝干涉实验！一个视频了解神奇的量子世界！

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 总有小朋友问我
cues.pinyin: zong3 you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3
cues.en: Students often ask me,

cues.zh: 电子的双缝干涉实验有什么神奇的地方
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 de5 shuang1 feng4 gan1 she4 shi2 yan4 you3 shen2 me5 shen2 qi2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: what's so amazing about the electron double-slit interference experiment?

cues.zh: 那今天我们再讨论一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zai4 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: So today let's discuss this question again.

cues.zh: 为了讨论电子的双缝干涉实验
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tao3 lun4 dian4 zi5 de5 shuang1 feng4 gan1 she4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: To discuss the electron double-slit interference experiment,

cues.zh: 我们必须从薛定谔方程说起
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 bi4 xu1 cong2 xue1 ding4 e4 fang1 cheng2 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: we have to start with the Schrödinger equation.

cues.zh: 我们要研究一下什么是波函数
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 shen2 me5 shi4 bo1 han2 shu4
cues.en: We need to study what a wave function is.

cues.zh: 什么是波函数呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 bo1 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: What is a wave function?

cues.zh: 这个问题最早是在 19 13 年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 zui4 zao3 shi4 zai4 19 13 nian2
cues.en: This question first arose in 1913,

cues.zh: 玻尔为了研究氢原子的光谱的时候发现的
cues.pinyin: bo1 er3 wei4 le5 yan2 jiu1 qing1 yuan2 zi5 de5 guang1 pu3 de5 shi2 hou4 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: when Bohr discovered it while studying the hydrogen atom's spectrum.

cues.zh: 玻尔发现说这个氢可以发出光
cues.pinyin: bo1 er3 fa1 xian4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 qing1 ke3 yi3 fa1 chu1 guang1
cues.en: Bohr found that hydrogen can emit light.

cues.zh: 氢的光谱我们用分光计把它分开
cues.pinyin: qing1 de5 guang1 pu3 wo3 men5 yong4 fen1 guang1 ji4 ba3 ta1 fen1 kai1
cues.en: If we split hydrogen's spectrum with a spectrometer,

cues.zh: 你会发现氢发出的光只有一些特定的波长
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 qing1 fa1 chu1 de5 guang1 zhi3 you3 yi1 xie1 te4 ding4 de5 bo1 chang2
cues.en: you'll find the light hydrogen emits only has certain specific wavelengths.

cues.zh: 其他的波长是没有的
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 bo1 chang2 shi4 mei2 you3 de5
cues.en: Other wavelengths don't appear.

cues.zh: 这个玻尔就说那为什么出现这种效果呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bo1 er3 jiu4 shuo1 na4 wei4 shen2 me5 chu1 xian4 zhe4 zhong3 xiao4 guo3 ne5
cues.en: Bohr then asked, why does this effect occur?

cues.zh: 他提出了一种假设
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 zhong3 jia3 she4
cues.en: He proposed a hypothesis.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】上帝的骰子：电子双缝干涉实验！一个视频了解神奇的量子世界！

cues.zh: 就叫氢原子的能量量子化假设
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jiao4 qing1 yuan2 zi5 de5 neng2 liang4 liang4 zi3 hua4 jia3 she4
cues.en: It's called the energy quantization hypothesis of the hydrogen atom.

cues.zh: 氢原子量子化假设
cues.pinyin: qing1 yuan2 zi5 liang4 zi3 hua4 jia3 she4
cues.en: The hydrogen atom quantization hypothesis.

cues.zh: 这个量子化假设是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 liang4 zi3 hua4 jia3 she4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does this quantization hypothesis mean?

cues.zh: 他说这个氢原子之所以发出这种波
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 qing1 yuan2 zi5 zhi1 suo3 yi3 fa1 chu1 zhe4 zhong3 bo1
cues.en: He said the reason the hydrogen atom emits this kind of wave

cues.zh: 是因为氢是由一个原子核和电子构成的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 qing1 shi4 you2 yi2 ge4 yuan2 zi3 he2 he2 dian4 zi5 gou4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: is because hydrogen is made of a nucleus and an electron.

cues.zh: 这电子只有一个
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dian4 zi5 zhi3 you3 yi2 ge4
cues.en: There's only one electron.

cues.zh: 电子有很多种轨道
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 you3 hen3 duo1 zhong3 gui3 dao4
cues.en: The electron has many possible orbits.

cues.zh: 电子可以在这个轨道跑
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 ke3 yi3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 gui3 dao4 pao3
cues.en: The electron can run in this orbit,

cues.zh: 也可以跑到更高层的轨道去
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 pao3 dao4 geng4 gao1 ceng2 de5 gui3 dao4 qu4
cues.en: or it can jump to a higher-level orbit.

cues.zh: 如果外界射入了一个光进来
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wai4 jie4 she4 ru4 le5 yi2 ge4 guang1 jin4 lai2
cues.en: If light comes in from outside,

cues.zh: 那电子就会向上跃迁
cues.pinyin: na4 dian4 zi5 jiu4 hui4 xiang4 shang4 yue4 qian1
cues.en: the electron will jump up,

cues.zh: 跑到上面那轨道去了
cues.pinyin: pao3 dao4 shang4 mian4 na4 gui3 dao4 qu4 le5
cues.en: moving to the orbit above.

cues.zh: 那转着转着有可能
cues.pinyin: na4 zhuan3 zhe5 zhuan3 zhe5 you3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: Then as it keeps going, it's possible that

cues.zh: 它又从高层轨道又跑回到低层轨道
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 cong2 gao1 ceng2 gui3 dao4 you4 pao3 hui2 dao4 di1 ceng2 gui3 dao4
cues.en: it falls back from the higher orbit to a lower one.

cues.zh: 这样它就会发光对吧就会发光
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ta1 jiu4 hui4 fa1 guang1 dui4 ba5 jiu4 hui4 fa1 guang1
cues.en: In doing so it emits light, right? It emits light.

cues.zh: 所以它发的光的能量
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 fa1 de5 guang1 de5 neng2 liang4
cues.en: So the energy of the light it emits

cues.zh: 其实正好就是这两个轨道能量之差
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zheng4 hao3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 gui3 dao4 neng2 liang4 zhi1 cha4
cues.en: is exactly the energy difference between these two orbits.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】上帝的骰子：电子双缝干涉实验！一个视频了解神奇的量子世界！

cues.zh: 比如说有一个人名字叫德布罗意
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 ming2 zi4 jiao4 de2 bu4 luo2 yi4
cues.en: For example, there was a person named de Broglie.

cues.zh: 德布罗裔在 19 24 年的时候
cues.pinyin: de2 bu4 luo2 yi4 zai4 19 24 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: In 1924, de Broglie

cues.zh: 19 24 年的时候提出了物质波假说
cues.pinyin: 19 24 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 ti2 chu1 le5 wu4 zhi4 bo1 jia3 shuo1
cues.en: in 1924, proposed the matter wave hypothesis.

cues.zh: 物质波他说我们以前一直认为电子是一
cues.pinyin: wu4 zhi4 bo1 ta1 shuo1 wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 yi4 zhi2 ren4 wei2 dian4 zi5 shi4 yi1
cues.en: Matter waves—he said we used to always think electrons were a

cues.zh: 种粒子对不对
cues.pinyin: zhong3 li4 zi5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: kind of particle, right?

cues.zh: 但是电子它是有波动性的电子有波动性
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dian4 zi5 ta1 shi4 you3 bo1 dong4 xing4 de5 dian4 zi5 you3 bo1 dong4 xing4
cues.en: But electrons also have wave properties, electrons have wave properties.

cues.zh: 电子实际上很有可能是一团波
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 shi2 ji4 shang4 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 yi1 tuan2 bo1
cues.en: In fact, the electron is quite possibly a wave packet.

cues.zh: 只不过这团波特别稠密你看起来好像
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 zhe4 tuan2 bo1 te4 bie2 chou2 mi4 ni3 kan4 qi3 lai2 hao3 xiang4
cues.en: It's just that this wave packet is so dense that it looks

cues.zh: 是个颗粒一样
cues.pinyin: shi4 ge4 ke1 li4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: like a particle.

cues.zh: 那这一团波在这个外边运动的过程之中
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 yi1 tuan2 bo1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wai4 bian1 yun4 dong4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: As this wave packet moves around outside,

cues.zh: 它必须形成驻波也就是首尾得相接
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi4 xu1 xing2 cheng2 zhu4 bo1 ye3 jiu4 shi4 shou3 wei3 de2 xiang1 jie1
cues.en: it must form a standing wave, meaning head and tail connect.

cues.zh: 那么我们根据驻波一计算就正好满
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 gen1 ju4 zhu4 bo1 yi1 ji4 suan4 jiu4 zheng4 hao3 man3
cues.en: And if we calculate based on the standing wave, it exactly

cues.zh: 足你这个结果
cues.pinyin: zu2 ni3 zhe4 ge5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: satisfies this result.

cues.zh: 德布罗伊提出电子是有波动性的
cues.pinyin: de2 bu4 luo2 yi1 ti2 chu1 dian4 zi5 shi4 you3 bo1 dong4 xing4 de5
cues.en: De Broglie proposed that electrons have wave properties.

cues.zh: 那么电子有波动性
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dian4 zi5 you3 bo1 dong4 xing4

cues.zh: 经过对比

cues.en: Before she was killed,

cues.zh: 应该已经陷入了昏迷
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 yi3 jing1 xian4 ru4 le5 hun1 mi2
cues.en: she must have already been unconscious.

cues.zh: 这也就解释了为什么尸体上没
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 jiu4 jie3 shi4 le5 wei4 shen2 me5 shi1 ti3 shang4 mei2
cues.en: That would explain why there were no

cues.zh: 有打度的痕迹

cues.zh: 由于行为过激

cues.pinyin: shang4 le5 xiao3 gu3 qian1 shou4 hui4 de5 hei1 ming2 dan1

cues.zh: 已经有过一段时间没出来蹦打了

cues.zh: 但这已足以证明

cues.zh: 很有犯罪的嫌疑

cues.zh: 布斯合理怀疑

cues.pinyin: ta1 yi3 jing1 bu4 man3 zu2 he2 ren2 ou3 yi4 qi3 wan2

cues.zh: 而将目标转到了人身上
cues.pinyin: er2 jiang1 mu4 biao1 zhuan3 dao4 le5 ren2 shen1 shang4
cues.en: and had shifted his focus to real people.

cues.zh: 欧文说自己没杀人

cues.en: Owen insisted he hadn't killed anyone,

cues.zh: 但言语之中

cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 dou1 shi4 fan4 zui4 xiao3 shuo1 de5 shu1 mi2

cues.zh: 说着说着

cues.zh: 到现在还没回来

cues.zh: 助理在神心时懊悔的一笔

cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ming2 si3 zhe3 shi4 cong2 hou4 jing3 xi2 ji1

cues.zh: 还是近距离射击
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jin4 ju4 li2 she4 ji1
cues.en: shot at close range.

cues.zh: 三者之间毫无规律
cues.pinyin: san1 zhe3 zhi1 jian1 hao2 wu2 gui1 lv4
cues.en: There was no pattern linking the three.

cues.zh: 小谷认为有三个凶手
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 ren4 wei2 you3 san1 ge4 xiong1 shou3
cues.en: Xiaogu believed there were three killers.

cues.zh: 杰克发现第一个死者身上的胶带上
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 fa1 xian4 di4 yi2 ge4 si3 zhe3 shen1 shang4 de5 jiao1 dai4 shang4
cues.en: Jack found that the tape on the first victim

cues.zh: 沾有一些人工沙粒
cues.pinyin: zhan1 you3 yi1 xie1 ren2 gong1 sha1 li4
cues.en: had traces of artificial sand on it,

cues.zh: 出自某个公司
cues.pinyin: chu1 zi4 mou3 ge4 gong1 si1
cues.en: coming from a specific company

cues.zh: 只供给几个高尔夫球场
cues.pinyin: zhi3 gong1 ji3 ji3 ge4 gao1 er3 fu1 qiu2 chang3
cues.en: that only supplied a handful of golf courses.

cues.zh: 而布斯也突然想到
cues.pinyin: er2 bu4 si1 ye3 tu1 ran2 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: And that's when Booth suddenly thought of something.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有一个新闻说内蒙古有两名患者
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 yi2 ge4 xin1 wen2 shuo1 nei4 meng2 gu3 you3 liang3 ming2 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: Recently there was news that two patients in Inner Mongolia

cues.zh: 到北京来看病
cues.pinyin: dao4 bei3 jing1 lai2 kan4 bing4
cues.en: came to Beijing for medical treatment

cues.zh: 被确诊为肺鼠疫
cues.pinyin: bei4 que4 zhen3 wei4 fei4 shu3 yi4
cues.en: and were diagnosed with pneumonic plague.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说这个鼠疫到底
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 shu3 yi4 dao4 di3
cues.en: A young student asked me what exactly plague

cues.zh: 是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: actually is.

cues.zh: 它是如何传播的呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ru2 he2 chuan2 bo1 de5 ne5
cues.en: How is it transmitted?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来谈一谈鼠疫的问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 tan2 yi1 tan2 shu3 yi4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's talk about the issue of plague.

cues.zh: 首先我们来介绍一下鼠疫到底是由于什
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 lai2 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 shu3 yi4 dao4 di3 shi4 you2 yu2 shen2
cues.en: First, let's introduce what exactly

cues.zh: 么原因引起的
cues.pinyin: me5 yuan2 yin1 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: causes the plague.

cues.zh: 鼠疫一听这名字就知道
cues.pinyin: shu3 yi4 yi1 ting1 zhe4 ming2 zi4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: As soon as you hear the name "plague" (鼠疫, "rat epidemic"),

cues.zh: 肯定跟老鼠有关系对吧
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 gen1 lao3 shu3 you3 guan1 xi4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: you know it must be related to rats, right?

cues.zh: 这个老鼠它身上会带一种病菌
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 shu3 ta1 shen1 shang4 hui4 dai4 yi1 zhong3 bing4 jun1
cues.en: These rats carry a type of bacteria.

cues.zh: 带一种病菌
cues.pinyin: dai4 yi1 zhong3 bing4 jun1
cues.en: They carry a bacterium.

cues.zh: 这种病菌我们现在称之为耶尔森菌
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 bing4 jun1 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ye2 er3 sen1 jun1
cues.en: This bacterium is now called Yersinia.

cues.zh: 或者叫耶尔森氏菌
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 jiao4 ye2 er3 sen1 shi4 jun1
cues.en: Or it's called Yersinia bacillus.

cues.zh: 因为它是耶尔森发现的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 ye2 er3 sen1 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: because it was discovered by Yersin.

cues.zh: 那么这个老鼠身上带这个病菌之后
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 lao3 shu3 shen1 shang4 dai4 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: So once the rat carries this bacterium,

cues.zh: 老鼠也会生病
cues.pinyin: lao3 shu3 ye3 hui4 sheng1 bing4
cues.en: the rat also gets sick.

cues.zh: 但是并不是老鼠直接把这个病菌传给人的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bing4 bu2 shi4 lao3 shu3 zhi2 jie1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 chuan2 gei3 ren2 de5
cues.en: But it's not the rat that directly transmits the bacterium to humans.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 而是通过一个昆虫什么昆虫就是跳蚤
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 kun1 chong2 shen2 me5 kun1 chong2 jiu4 shi4 tiao4 zao3
cues.en: It's transmitted through an insect — which insect? The flea.

cues.zh: 这个跳蚤它会吸老鼠的血
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tiao4 zao3 ta1 hui4 xi1 lao3 shu3 de5 xue4
cues.en: This flea sucks the rat's blood.

cues.zh: 对吧它会吸老鼠的血
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 ta1 hui4 xi1 lao3 shu3 de5 xue4
cues.en: Right, it sucks the rat's blood.

cues.zh: 吸老鼠的血之后
cues.pinyin: xi1 lao3 shu3 de5 xue4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After sucking the rat's blood,

cues.zh: 这个病菌就吸到这个跳蚤的体内了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 jiu4 xi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 tiao4 zao3 de5 ti3 nei4 le5
cues.en: the bacterium gets sucked into the flea's body.

cues.zh: 到了跳蚤体内之后
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 tiao4 zao3 ti3 nei4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once inside the flea,

cues.zh: 这个病菌会繁殖繁殖越来越多
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 hui4 fan2 zhi2 fan2 zhi2 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: the bacterium multiplies, more and more.

cues.zh: 最后就会把这个跳蚤的胃给堵住
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 jiu4 hui4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 tiao4 zao3 de5 wei4 gei3 du3 zhu4
cues.en: Eventually it blocks the flea's stomach.

cues.zh: 跳蚤堵住了胃之后
cues.pinyin: tiao4 zao3 du3 zhu4 le5 wei4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the flea's stomach is blocked,

cues.zh: 就没有办法把血吸到胃里边去消化了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 ba3 xue4 xi1 dao4 wei4 li3 bian1 qu4 xiao1 hua4 le5
cues.en: it can't get the blood it sucks into its stomach to digest.

cues.zh: 所以跳蚤感觉到很饿
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 tiao4 zao3 gan3 jue2 dao4 hen3 e4
cues.en: So the flea feels very hungry.

cues.zh: 很饿等它吸老鼠老鼠死了怎么办
cues.pinyin: hen3 e4 deng3 ta1 xi1 lao3 shu3 lao3 shu3 si3 le5 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: Very hungry — and when the rat it feeds on dies, what then?

cues.zh: 它就会去吸谁吸人
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 qu4 xi1 shui2 xi1 ren2
cues.en: It goes to suck someone else's blood — a human's.

cues.zh: 那么在跳蚤吸人的血的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 tiao4 zao3 xi1 ren2 de5 xue4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: So when the flea sucks a human's blood,

cues.zh: 因为它的胃已经被堵住了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 wei4 yi3 jing1 bei4 du3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: because its stomach is already blocked,

cues.zh: 所以它吸的这个血没有办法进到胃里边去
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xi1 de5 zhe4 ge5 xue4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 jin4 dao4 wei4 li3 bian1 qu4
cues.en: the blood it sucks can't get into its stomach.

cues.zh: 吸到一半它就吐了
cues.pinyin: xi1 dao4 yi2 ban4 ta1 jiu4 tu3 le5
cues.en: Halfway through sucking, it vomits.

cues.zh: 它一吐就把这个病菌
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 tu3 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1
cues.en: As soon as it vomits, it brings up the bacterium

cues.zh: 连同这个血液一起吐回到人体里边
cues.pinyin: lian2 tong2 zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 yi4 qi3 tu3 hui2 dao4 ren2 ti3 li3 bian1
cues.en: along with the blood, back into the person's body.

cues.zh: 结果这个人体就生病了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 ti3 jiu4 sheng1 bing4 le5
cues.en: As a result, the person gets sick.

cues.zh: 那么这种鼠疫就是最常见的一种鼠疫
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 zhong3 shu3 yi4 jiu4 shi4 zui4 chang2 jian4 de5 yi1 zhong3 shu3 yi4
cues.en: This type of plague is the most common form of plague.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 继发性肺鼠疫就是先得了腺鼠疫
cues.pinyin: ji4 fa1 xing4 fei4 shu3 yi4 jiu4 shi4 xian1 de2 le5 xian4 shu3 yi4
cues.en: Secondary pneumonic plague means first getting bubonic plague,

cues.zh: 得了腺鼠疫之后
cues.pinyin: de2 le5 xian4 shu3 yi4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: after getting bubonic plague,

cues.zh: 慢慢的这个病菌就侵入到肺部
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 jiu4 qin1 ru4 dao4 fei4 bu4
cues.en: the bacterium gradually invades the lungs,

cues.zh: 结果就造成了这个肺鼠疫
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 zao4 cheng2 le5 zhe4 ge5 fei4 shu3 yi4
cues.en: resulting in pneumonic plague.

cues.zh: 还有就是这个得了肺鼠疫的人他会咳嗽
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 de2 le5 fei4 shu3 yi4 de5 ren2 ta1 hui4 ke2 sou4
cues.en: Also, a person with pneumonic plague will cough.

cues.zh: 这个人会咳嗽咳血
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 hui4 ke2 sou4 ke2 xie3
cues.en: This person will cough, coughing up blood.

cues.zh: 于是就会有肺磨
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 hui4 you3 fei4 mo2
cues.en: This produces respiratory droplets.

cues.zh: 这个肺磨里面是带有很多的鼠疫病菌的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fei4 mo2 li3 mian4 shi4 dai4 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 shu3 yi4 bing4 jun1 de5
cues.en: These droplets carry a lot of plague bacteria.

cues.zh: 结果这个肺磨直接传播给人了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 fei4 mo2 zhi2 jie1 chuan2 bo1 gei3 ren2 le5
cues.en: As a result, these droplets spread it directly to other people.

cues.zh: 这种我们就称之为原发性的肺鼠疫
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 yuan2 fa1 xing4 de5 fei4 shu3 yi4
cues.en: This is what we call primary pneumonic plague.

cues.zh: 所以鼠疫是可以从人通过肺磨传播给人的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shu3 yi4 shi4 ke3 yi3 cong2 ren2 tong1 guo4 fei4 mo2 chuan2 bo1 gei3 ren2 de5
cues.en: So plague can spread from person to person through droplets.

cues.zh: 因此肺鼠疫比这个腺鼠疫更加厉害
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 fei4 shu3 yi4 bi3 zhe4 ge5 xian4 shu3 yi4 geng4 jia1 li4 hai4
cues.en: Therefore pneumonic plague is more severe than bubonic plague.

cues.zh: 因为肺鼠疫是可以人传人的更加可怕
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 fei4 shu3 yi4 shi4 ke3 yi3 ren2 chuan2 ren2 de5 geng4 jia1 ke3 pa4
cues.en: Because pneumonic plague can spread person to person, it's more frightening.

cues.zh: 还有一种叫做败血型鼠疫
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 jiao4 zuo4 bai4 xue4 xing2 shu3 yi4
cues.en: There's also a type called septicemic plague.

cues.zh: 败血型鼠疫
cues.pinyin: bai4 xue4 xing2 shu3 yi4
cues.en: Septicemic plague.

cues.zh: 败血型鼠疫的意思就是说
cues.pinyin: bai4 xue4 xing2 shu3 yi4 de5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: Septicemic plague means

cues.zh: 这个鼠疫的病菌进入到人的血液里边了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu3 yi4 de5 bing4 jun1 jin4 ru4 dao4 ren2 de5 xue4 ye4 li3 bian1 le5
cues.en: the plague bacterium enters a person's bloodstream,

cues.zh: 造成了这个血液的感染
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 le5 zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 de5 gan3 ran3
cues.en: causing an infection of the blood.

cues.zh: 在血液里边繁殖
cues.pinyin: zai4 xue4 ye4 li3 bian1 fan2 zhi2
cues.en: It multiplies in the blood.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 最快一天就死
cues.pinyin: zui4 kuai4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 si3
cues.en: At its fastest, death can occur within a day.

cues.zh: 也就是说上午感染的鼠疫下午就死
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 shang4 wu3 gan3 ran3 de5 shu3 yi4 xia4 wu3 jiu4 si3
cues.en: That is, someone infected in the morning could be dead by the afternoon.

cues.zh: 还有这种传说说有一个小偷
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 zhe4 zhong3 chuan2 shuo1 shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 tou1
cues.en: There's also a legend about a thief

cues.zh: 到这个有一个得鼠疫的人家里边偷东西
cues.pinyin: dao4 zhe4 ge5 you3 yi2 ge4 de2 shu3 yi4 de5 ren2 jia1 li3 bian1 tou1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: who went to steal from the home of someone with plague.

cues.zh: 结果刚一进去在偷东西的时候
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 gang1 yi1 jin4 qu4 zai4 tou1 dong1 xi1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: As soon as he went in and was stealing things,

cues.zh: 给他同伙递东西的时候就死掉了
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 tong2 huo3 di4 dong1 xi1 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 si3 diao4 le5
cues.en: while handing something to his accomplice, he dropped dead.

cues.zh: 就这么快发病特别快
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 me5 kuai4 fa1 bing4 te4 bie2 kuai4
cues.en: That's how fast — the onset was extremely quick.

cues.zh: 所以很多人就得了鼠疫之后死了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hen3 duo1 ren2 jiu4 de2 le5 shu3 yi4 zhi1 hou4 si3 le5
cues.en: So many people got plague and died.

cues.zh: 别人以为是被下毒了
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 yi3 wei2 shi4 bei4 xia4 du2 le5
cues.en: Others thought they had been poisoned.

cues.zh: 因为他死状特别恐怖而且时间太短了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 si3 zhuang4 te4 bie2 kong3 bu4 er2 qie3 shi2 jian1 tai4 duan3 le5
cues.en: Because the way they died was terrifying and it happened so fast,

cues.zh: 所以以为是被下毒了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi3 wei2 shi4 bei4 xia4 du2 le5
cues.en: people assumed poison was involved.

cues.zh: 还有就是鼠疫的死亡率特别高死亡率很高
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 shu3 yi4 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 te4 bie2 gao1 si3 wang2 lv4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: Also, plague's mortality rate is extremely high.

cues.zh: 那死亡率有多高
cues.pinyin: na4 si3 wang2 lv4 you3 duo1 gao1
cues.en: So how high is the mortality rate?

cues.zh: 像这个腺鼠疫如果没有经过治疗的话
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhe4 ge5 xian4 shu3 yi4 ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 jing1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 de5 hua4
cues.en: For bubonic plague, if untreated,

cues.zh: 它的死亡率在 50 以上
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 zai4 50 yi3 shang4
cues.en: its mortality rate is above 50%.

cues.zh: 50 60 这样的一个比例
cues.pinyin: 50 60 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 bi3 li4
cues.en: Around 50 to 60 percent.

cues.zh: 而败血型鼠疫和肺鼠疫就更可怕了
cues.pinyin: er2 bai4 xue4 xing2 shu3 yi4 he2 fei4 shu3 yi4 jiu4 geng4 ke3 pa4 le5
cues.en: Septicemic and pneumonic plague are even more terrifying.

cues.zh: 如果不经治疗这两种鼠疫基本上是 100 死亡
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bu4 jing1 zhi4 liao2 zhe4 liang3 zhong3 shu3 yi4 ji1 ben3 shang4 shi4 100 si3 wang2
cues.en: If untreated, these two types are essentially 100% fatal.

cues.zh: 就是没有人能存活下来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 mei2 you3 ren2 neng2 cun2 huo2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: meaning no one survives.

cues.zh: 这是在不经治疗的情况下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zai4 bu4 jing1 zhi4 liao2 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: This is in the case of no treatment.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 因为鼠疫死亡率这么高而且传染性又很强
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shu3 yi4 si3 wang2 lv4 zhe4 me5 gao1 er2 qie3 chuan2 ran3 xing4 you4 hen3 qiang2
cues.en: Because plague's mortality rate is so high and it's highly contagious,

cues.zh: 所以它是我国的甲基传染病
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 shi4 wo3 guo2 de5 jia3 ji1 chuan2 ran3 bing4
cues.en: it's classified as a Class A infectious disease in our country.

cues.zh: 也被称为一号病
cues.pinyin: ye3 bei4 cheng1 wei2 yi1 hao4 bing4
cues.en: Also known as "Disease No. 1."

cues.zh: 同为甲基传染病的还有一个二号病叫霍乱
cues.pinyin: tong2 wei4 jia3 ji1 chuan2 ran3 bing4 de5 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 er4 hao4 bing4 jiao4 huo4 luan4
cues.en: Another Class A disease is "Disease No. 2," cholera.

cues.zh: 那么霍乱的死亡率有多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 huo4 luan4 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 you3 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: So what is cholera's mortality rate?

cues.zh: 不经治疗的时候
cues.pinyin: bu4 jing1 zhi4 liao2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When untreated,

cues.zh: 霍乱的死亡率一般是在 5 左右
cues.pinyin: huo4 luan4 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 yi4 ban1 shi4 zai4 5 zuo3 you4
cues.en: cholera's mortality rate is generally around 5%.

cues.zh: 那么还有一种叫三号病
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 jiao4 san1 hao4 bing4
cues.en: There's also one called "Disease No. 3."

cues.zh: 三号病就是我们已经消灭的天花
cues.pinyin: san1 hao4 bing4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 yi3 jing1 xiao1 mie4 de5 tian1 hua1
cues.en: Disease No. 3 is smallpox, which we have already eradicated.

cues.zh: 天花是非常可怕的
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 shi4 fei1 chang2 ke3 pa4 de5
cues.en: Smallpox is extremely terrifying.

cues.zh: 但是天花不经治疗的死亡率也只有 30
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tian1 hua1 bu4 jing1 zhi4 liao2 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 ye3 zhi3 you3 30
cues.en: But even smallpox's untreated mortality rate is only 30%.

cues.zh: 所以从这一看
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cong2 zhe4 yi1 kan4
cues.en: So looking at this,

cues.zh: 这个鼠疫这是无愧于一号病的这个称号
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu3 yi4 zhe4 shi4 wu2 kui4 yu2 yi1 hao4 bing4 de5 zhe4 ge5 cheng1 hao4
cues.en: plague truly lives up to its title as "Disease No. 1."

cues.zh: 它的死亡率太高了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 tai4 gao1 le5
cues.en: Its mortality rate is just too high.

cues.zh: 应该说是人类历史上最可怕的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shuo1 shi4 ren2 lei4 li4 shi3 shang4 zui4 ke3 pa4 de5
cues.en: It should be said to be one of the most terrifying

cues.zh: 传染病之一了
cues.pinyin: chuan2 ran3 bing4 zhi1 yi1 liao3
cues.en: infectious diseases in human history.

cues.zh: 那么有人可能会想这个鼠疫这么可怕
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 you3 ren2 ke3 neng2 hui4 xiang3 zhe4 ge5 shu3 yi4 zhe4 me5 ke3 pa4
cues.en: Someone might think, since plague is this terrifying,

cues.zh: 但是我们科学更发达
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 ke1 xue2 geng4 fa1 da2
cues.en: but our science is more advanced now,

cues.zh: 那我们不能消灭鼠疫吗
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 bu4 neng2 xiao1 mie4 shu3 yi4 ma5
cues.en: can't we eliminate plague?

cues.zh: 天花不就被我们消灭了吗
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 bu4 jiu4 bei4 wo3 men5 xiao1 mie4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Didn't we already eradicate smallpox?

cues.zh: 是的但是鼠疫可能在很长一段时间内
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5 dan4 shi4 shu3 yi4 ke3 neng2 zai4 hen3 zhang3 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 nei4
cues.en: Yes, but plague, for a long time to come,

cues.zh: 人类都无法消灭
cues.pinyin: ren2 lei4 dou1 wu2 fa3 xiao1 mie4
cues.en: humans may not be able to eliminate.

cues.zh: 人们必须学会跟鼠疫共存
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 bi4 xu1 xue2 hui4 gen1 shu3 yi4 gong4 cun2
cues.en: People must learn to coexist with plague.

cues.zh: 为什么呢因为鼠疫有一个特点
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5 yin1 wei4 shu3 yi4 you3 yi2 ge4 te4 dian3
cues.en: Why? Because plague has one characteristic.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】鼠疫是如何传染的？黑死病从未远离人类！

cues.zh: 鼠疫在老鼠中一直存在
cues.pinyin: shu3 yi4 zai4 lao3 shu3 zhong1 yi4 zhi2 cun2 zai4
cues.en: Plague persists continuously among rats.

cues.zh: 隔三差五的它就会传染给人类
cues.pinyin: ge2 san1 cha4 wu3 de5 ta1 jiu4 hui4 chuan2 ran3 gei3 ren2 lei4
cues.en: Every so often, it spreads to humans.

cues.zh: 因此在很长一段时间里
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 zai4 hen3 zhang3 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 li3
cues.en: So for a long time,

cues.zh: 可能人们必须学会如何跟鼠疫进行共存
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 ren2 men5 bi4 xu1 xue2 hui4 ru2 he2 gen1 shu3 yi4 jin4 xing2 gong4 cun2
cues.en: people will likely have to learn to coexist with plague.

cues.zh: 那么在历史上鼠疫一共有三次大流行
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 shu3 yi4 yi1 gong4 you3 san1 ci4 da4 liu2 xing2
cues.en: Historically, there have been three major plague pandemics.

cues.zh: 每一次大流行都给人类带来的深重的灾难
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ci4 da4 liu2 xing2 dou1 gei3 ren2 lei4 dai4 lai2 de5 shen1 zhong4 de5 zai1 nan4
cues.en: Each pandemic brought profound disaster to humanity

cues.zh: 而且严重的影响了历史的进场
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yan2 zhong4 de5 ying3 xiang3 le5 li4 shi3 de5 jin4 chang3
cues.en: and seriously affected the course of history.

cues.zh: 所以咱们说到蜀裔
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zan2 men5 shuo1 dao4 shu3 yi4
cues.en: So since we're talking about plague,

cues.zh: 不妨就把这几次大流行给大家介绍一下
cues.pinyin: bu4 fang2 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ji3 ci4 da4 liu2 xing2 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: let's go ahead and introduce these pandemics.

cues.zh: 第二蜀裔的三次大流行
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 shu3 yi4 de5 san1 ci4 da4 liu2 xing2
cues.en: Next, the three major pandemics of plague.

cues.zh: 蜀裔的第一次大流行是在公元六
cues.pinyin: shu3 yi4 de5 di4 yi1 ci4 da4 liu2 xing2 shi4 zai4 gong1 yuan2 liu4
cues.en: The first plague pandemic was in the 6th century AD,

cues.zh: 世纪这个时候
cues.pinyin: shi4 ji4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: around that time.

cues.zh: 时间比较久远了
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 bi3 jiao4 jiu3 yuan3 le5
cues.en: It was quite a long time ago.

cues.zh: 它是从非洲开始的非洲出现了蜀裔
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 cong2 fei1 zhou1 kai1 shi3 de5 fei1 zhou1 chu1 xian4 le5 shu3 yi4
cues.en: It started in Africa, where plague first appeared,

cues.zh: 然后非洲就传给了欧洲
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fei1 zhou1 jiu4 chuan2 gei3 le5 ou1 zhou1
cues.en: then spread from Africa to Europe.

cues.zh: 欧洲的这个败战庭帝国
cues.pinyin: ou1 zhou1 de5 zhe4 ge5 bai4 zhan4 ting2 di4 guo2
cues.en: The Byzantine Empire in Europe

cues.zh: 因为这次蜀裔死了三分之一的人
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ci4 shu3 yi4 si3 le5 san1 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 ren2
cues.en: lost a third of its population to this plague.

cues.zh: 当然同时他也传给了亚洲
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 tong2 shi2 ta1 ye3 chuan2 gei3 le5 ya4 zhou1
cues.en: Of course, at the same time, it also spread to Asia.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 执习声只因背后吐槽老板竟直
cues.pinyin: zhi2 xi2 sheng1 zhi3 yin1 bei4 hou4 tu3 cao2 lao3 ban3 jing4 zhi2
cues.en: An intern badmouthed the boss behind his back and was immediately

cues.zh: 接被扔到桥底
cues.pinyin: jie1 bei4 reng1 dao4 qiao2 di3
cues.en: thrown off a bridge for it.

cues.zh: 检察官甚至为恶魔老板站台
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 guan1 shen4 zhi4 wei4 e4 mo2 lao3 ban3 zhan4 tai2
cues.en: A prosecutor even vouched for the devilish boss.

cues.zh: 职场霸凌成为新型企业文化
cues.pinyin: zhi2 chang3 ba4 ling2 cheng2 wei2 xin1 xing2 qi3 ye4 wen2 hua4
cues.en: Workplace bullying has become a twisted new corporate culture.

cues.zh: 这故事得从那家科技公司说起
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu4 shi4 de2 cong2 na4 jia1 ke1 ji4 gong1 si1 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: This story starts with that tech company.

cues.zh: 表面上看着像个正经企业
cues.pinyin: biao3 mian4 shang4 kan4 zhe5 xiang4 ge4 zheng4 jing1 qi3 ye4
cues.en: On the surface it looks like a legitimate business,

cues.zh: 实际上背地里竟是些乱七八糟的龌龊事
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 bei4 di4 li3 jing4 shi4 xie1 luan4 qi1 ba1 zao1 de5 wo4 chuo4 shi4
cues.en: but behind the scenes it's full of filthy, messed-up dealings.

cues.zh: 简直就是个大型职场的活地狱
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 jiu4 shi4 ge4 da4 xing2 zhi2 chang3 de5 huo2 di4 yu4
cues.en: It's basically a living hell disguised as a big corporation.

cues.zh: 老板朴会长纯纯似的披着羊皮的大恶魔
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 pu3 hui4 zhang3 chun2 chun2 shi4 de5 pi1 zhe5 yang2 pi2 de5 da4 e4 mo2
cues.en: The boss, Chairman Park, is a devil in sheep's clothing.

cues.zh: 别看平时嘻嘻哈哈的
cues.pinyin: bie2 kan4 ping2 shi2 xi1 xi1 ha1 ha1 de5
cues.en: Don't be fooled by how jovial he usually seems —

cues.zh: 眼神里却带着股狠劲儿
cues.pinyin: yan3 shen2 li3 que4 dai4 zhe5 gu3 hen3 jin4 er2
cues.en: there's a ruthless glint in his eyes.

cues.zh: 在公司里他就是个说一不二的土皇帝
cues.pinyin: zai4 gong1 si1 li3 ta1 jiu4 shi4 ge4 shuo1 yi1 bu4 er4 de5 tu3 huang2 di4
cues.en: In the company he's a petty tyrant whose word is law.

cues.zh: 早上开早会
cues.pinyin: zao3 shang4 kai1 zao3 hui4
cues.en: At the morning meeting,

cues.zh: 小职员打了个瞌睡
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi2 yuan2 da3 le5 ge4 ke1 shui4
cues.en: a junior employee dozed off

cues.zh: 正好被逮着了
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hao3 bei4 dai3 zhe5 le5
cues.en: and got caught red-handed.

cues.zh: 老板手下郑理事立马炸毛
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 shou3 xia4 zheng4 li3 shi4 li4 ma3 zha4 mao2
cues.en: Director Zheng, the boss's underling, immediately flew into a rage,

cues.zh: 嚷嚷着要赶人走
cues.pinyin: rang1 rang5 zhe5 yao4 gan3 ren2 zou3
cues.en: shouting that the employee should be fired on the spot.

cues.zh: 朴会长赶紧过来打圆场
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 gan3 jin3 guo4 lai2 da3 yuan2 chang3
cues.en: Chairman Park hurried over to smooth things over.

cues.zh: 可郑理事一看见他腿肚子都打颤
cues.pinyin: ke3 zheng4 li3 shi4 yi1 kan4 jian4 ta1 tui3 du4 zi5 dou1 da3 zhan4
cues.en: But the moment Director Zheng saw him, his legs started shaking.

cues.zh: 新来的徐一鸣还嘀咕
cues.pinyin: xin1 lai2 de5 xu2 yi1 ming2 hai2 di2 gu1
cues.en: The new hire, Xu Yiming, muttered to himself,

cues.zh: 这老板看着挺随和的呀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 lao3 ban3 kan4 zhe5 ting3 sui2 he2 de5 ya5
cues.en: "This boss seems pretty easygoing."

cues.zh: 结果当晚的迎新会就开眼了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 dang4 wan3 de5 ying2 xin1 hui4 jiu4 kai1 yan3 le5
cues.en: But that very night's welcome party gave him an eye-opener.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 朴会长喝嗨了正在唱歌
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 he1 hai1 le5 zheng4 zai4 chang4 ge1
cues.en: Chairman Park, tipsy, was singing karaoke

cues.zh: 瞅见个女员工偷偷吐了酒段
cues.pinyin: chou3 jian4 ge4 nv3 yuan2 gong1 tou1 tou1 tu3 le5 jiu3 duan4
cues.en: when he spotted a female employee secretly throwing up from drinking.

cues.zh: 是火帽三丈
cues.pinyin: shi4 huo3 mao4 san1 zhang4
cues.en: He flew into a rage.

cues.zh: 他不乏人家吸人
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 fa2 ren2 jia1 xi1 ren2
cues.en: He didn't punish the person who had forced her to drink,

cues.zh: 反倒嫌招人的理事没交好规矩
cues.pinyin: fan3 dao4 xian2 zhao1 ren2 de5 li3 shi4 mei2 jiao1 hao3 gui1 ju3
cues.en: but instead blamed the director who recruited her for not teaching her manners.

cues.zh: 还让叫来的徐一鸣
cues.pinyin: hai2 rang4 jiao4 lai2 de5 xu2 yi1 ming2
cues.en: He even had Xu Yiming, who'd been called over,

cues.zh: 过去扇了她一耳光
cues.pinyin: guo4 qu4 shan4 le5 ta1 yi1 er3 guang1
cues.en: go slap the woman across the face.

cues.zh: 把人吓得一动不敢动
cues.pinyin: ba3 ren2 xia4 de2 yi1 dong4 bu4 gan3 dong4
cues.en: scaring her so badly she didn't dare move.

cues.zh: 朴会长嫌太犹豫
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 xian2 tai4 you2 yu4
cues.en: Chairman Park, annoyed that Xu hesitated too much,

cues.zh: 当场就示范了一把
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiu4 shi4 fan4 le5 yi1 ba3
cues.en: demonstrated the slap himself on the spot.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 在家突然刷到了投诉乔会长的新闻
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 tu1 ran2 shua1 dao4 le5 tou2 su4 qiao2 hui4 zhang3 de5 xin1 wen2
cues.en: At home, Xu Yiming happened to come across news about a complaint against Chairman Park.

cues.zh: 忍不住评论吐槽几句又赶紧删了
cues.pinyin: ren3 bu2 zhu4 ping2 lun4 tu3 cao2 ji3 ju4 you4 gan3 jin3 shan1 le5
cues.en: He couldn't resist leaving a few critical comments, then quickly deleted them.

cues.zh: 可公司的监控网络到处都是
cues.pinyin: ke3 gong1 si1 de5 jian1 kong4 wang3 luo4 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4
cues.en: But the company's surveillance network was everywhere.

cues.zh: 这群人渣直接根据地址把徐一鸣绑走了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 qun2 ren2 zha1 zhi2 jie1 gen1 ju4 di4 zhi3 ba3 xu2 yi1 ming2 bang3 zou3 le5
cues.en: These scumbags tracked his address and kidnapped Xu Yiming.

cues.zh: 朴会长出了个损招
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 chu1 le5 ge4 sun3 zhao1
cues.en: Chairman Park came up with a vicious scheme:

cues.zh: 写一个字挨三棍
cues.pinyin: xie3 yi2 ge4 zi4 ai1 san1 gun4
cues.en: for every character he'd written, he'd take three beatings.

cues.zh: 徐一鸣一共挨了四十五下
cues.pinyin: xu2 yi1 ming2 yi1 gong4 ai1 le5 si4 shi2 wu3 xia4
cues.en: In total, Xu Yiming took forty-five blows.

cues.zh: 被轮到再厉害不够
cues.pinyin: bei4 lun2 dao4 zai4 li4 hai4 bu4 gou4
cues.en: No matter how brutally he was beaten, it still wasn't enough for them.

cues.zh: 徐一鸣又被绑在柱子上扇耳光踹肚子
cues.pinyin: xu2 yi1 ming2 you4 bei4 bang3 zai4 zhu4 zi5 shang4 shan4 er3 guang1 chuai4 du3 zi5
cues.en: Xu Yiming was then tied to a post, slapped, and kicked in the stomach.

cues.zh: 小弟们全上了手
cues.pinyin: xiao3 di4 men5 quan2 shang4 le5 shou3
cues.en: All the underlings joined in on the beating.

cues.zh: 最后直接把人打得昏死过去
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhi2 jie1 ba3 ren2 da3 de2 hun1 si3 guo4 qu4
cues.en: In the end they beat him until he passed out.

cues.zh: 徐一鸣早就去过检察厅报过案
cues.pinyin: xu2 yi1 ming2 zao3 jiu4 qu4 guo4 jian3 cha2 ting1 bao4 guo4 an4
cues.en: Xu Yiming had already gone to the prosecutor's office to file a report before.

cues.zh: 江河娜检察官气坏了
cues.pinyin: jiang1 he2 na4 jian3 cha2 guan1 qi4 huai4 le5
cues.en: Prosecutor Jiang Hena was furious,

cues.zh: 可还没等为受害者讨回功等
cues.pinyin: ke3 hai2 mei2 deng3 wei4 shou4 hai4 zhe3 tao3 hui2 gong1 deng3
cues.en: but before she could get justice for the victim,

cues.zh: 上司就过来求她
cues.pinyin: shang4 si1 jiu4 guo4 lai2 qiu2 ta1
cues.en: her superior came to plead with her,

cues.zh: 说他师父现在是朴会长的法律顾问
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 shi1 fu4 xian4 zai4 shi4 pu3 hui4 zhang3 de5 fa3 lv4 gu4 wen4
cues.en: saying his mentor was now Chairman Park's legal advisor.

cues.zh: 明知是拿恩情逼他们撤案
cues.pinyin: ming2 zhi1 shi4 na2 en1 qing2 bi1 ta1 men5 che4 an4
cues.en: Clearly leveraging that favor to pressure them into dropping the case,

cues.zh: 非说是徐一鸣主动要和解的
cues.pinyin: fei1 shuo1 shi4 xu2 yi1 ming2 zhu3 dong4 yao4 he2 jie3 de5
cues.en: he insisted Xu Yiming had wanted to settle voluntarily.

cues.zh: 江河娜哪忍得了这脾气
cues.pinyin: jiang1 he2 na4 na3 ren3 de2 le5 zhe4 pi2 qi4
cues.en: Jiang Hena couldn't hold back her temper

cues.zh: 当场骂上司臭不要脸
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 ma4 shang4 si1 chou4 bu2 yao4 lian3
cues.en: and cursed her superior out on the spot for being shameless,

cues.zh: 竟帮坏人说话
cues.pinyin: jing4 bang1 huai4 ren2 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: for siding with the villain.

cues.zh: 转头就想调查朴会长的黑料
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 tou2 jiu4 xiang3 diao4 cha2 pu3 hui4 zhang3 de5 hei1 liao4
cues.en: She then turned to dig up dirt on Chairman Park.

cues.zh: 上司气得把资料撕了个稀碎
cues.pinyin: shang4 si1 qi4 de2 ba3 zi1 liao4 si1 le5 ge4 xi1 sui4
cues.en: Her furious superior tore the file to shreds.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 他在医院看到徐一鸣的惨样
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 yi1 yuan4 kan4 dao4 xu2 yi1 ming2 de5 can3 yang4
cues.en: When he saw Xu Yiming's wretched state at the hospital,

cues.zh: 没打扰就走了
cues.pinyin: mei2 da3 rao3 jiu4 zou3 le5
cues.en: he left without disturbing him.

cues.zh: 而江河纳也赶到了医院
cues.pinyin: er2 jiang1 he2 na4 ye3 gan3 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Jiang Hena also rushed to the hospital.

cues.zh: 家属说徐一鸣肯定是被报复的
cues.pinyin: jia1 shu3 shuo1 xu2 yi1 ming2 ken3 ding4 shi4 bei4 bao4 fu4 de5
cues.en: His family said Xu Yiming must have been attacked in retaliation,

cues.zh: 警方却认定是喝酒自寻短见
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 que4 ren4 ding4 shi4 he1 jiu3 zi4 xun2 duan3 jian4
cues.en: but police ruled it a drunken suicide attempt.

cues.zh: 他老婆赶紧说
cues.pinyin: ta1 lao3 po2 gan3 jin3 shuo1
cues.en: His wife quickly spoke up,

cues.zh: 徐一鸣还说过要跟恶人斗到底
cues.pinyin: xu2 yi1 ming2 hai2 shuo1 guo4 yao4 gen1 e4 ren2 dou4 dao4 di3
cues.en: saying Xu Yiming had vowed to fight the villains to the end —

cues.zh: 怎会寻短见
cues.pinyin: zen3 hui4 xun2 duan3 jian4
cues.en: how could he possibly try to take his own life?

cues.zh: 就连和解书都是被递才签的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 he2 jie3 shu1 dou1 shi4 bei4 di4 cai2 qian1 de5
cues.en: Even the settlement document had only been signed under coercion.

cues.zh: 江河纳为了讨公道
cues.pinyin: jiang1 he2 na4 wei4 le5 tao3 gong1 dao4
cues.en: To seek justice,

cues.zh: 原夜发案后发现叫上酒的职员
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ye4 fa1 an4 hou4 fa1 xian4 jiao4 shang4 jiu3 de5 zhi2 yuan2
cues.en: Jiang Hena found out the employee who had invited him to drink that night

cues.zh: 有类似的经历
cues.pinyin: you3 lei4 si4 de5 jing1 li4
cues.en: had gone through a similar ordeal himself.

cues.zh: 结果出事后就到了一座小岛避难
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 chu1 shi4 hou4 jiu4 dao4 le5 yi1 zuo4 xiao3 dao3 bi4 nan4
cues.en: After the incident he'd fled to a small island to hide.

cues.zh: 当江河纳和眼镜哥找到上酒时
cues.pinyin: dang1 jiang1 he2 na4 he2 yan3 jing4 ge1 zhao3 dao4 shang4 jiu3 shi2
cues.en: When Jiang Hena and "Glasses Bro" tracked down the man who'd invited Xu to drink,

cues.zh: 对方一惊
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 yi1 jing1
cues.en: the man was startled.

cues.zh: 他是检察官直接吓跑了
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 jian3 cha2 guan1 zhi2 jie1 xia4 pao3 le5
cues.en: Realizing she was a prosecutor, he immediately ran off.

cues.zh: 江河纳决定偷渡插票会长
cues.pinyin: jiang1 he2 na4 jue2 ding4 tou1 du4 cha1 piao4 hui4 zhang3
cues.en: Jiang Hena decided to secretly investigate Chairman Park,

cues.zh: 却发现公司安保特别严指令有猫腻
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 gong1 si1 an1 bao3 te4 bie2 yan2 zhi3 ling4 you3 mao1 ni4
cues.en: but found the company's security unusually tight, hinting something was off.

cues.zh: 他直接冲到公司
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi2 jie1 chong1 dao4 gong1 si1
cues.en: She went straight to the company,

cues.zh: 却被洗剪吹组合
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 xi3 jian3 chui1 zu3 he2
cues.en: but was stopped by the "wash-cut-blow" trio,

cues.zh: 已没有预约婉拒了
cues.pinyin: yi3 mei2 you3 yu4 yue1 wan3 ju4 le5
cues.en: who turned her away for having no appointment.

cues.zh: 转头刺撞进金道琪在这上班
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 tou2 ci4 zhuang4 jin4 jin1 dao4 qi2 zai4 zhe4 shang4 ban1
cues.en: She then happened to run into Jin Daoqi, who worked there.

cues.zh: 原来他曾去过出事的河边
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 ceng2 qu4 guo4 chu1 shi4 de5 he2 bian1
cues.en: It turned out he'd once visited the riverbank where the incident happened,

cues.zh: 觉得特别蹊跷
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 te4 bie2 qi1 qiao1
cues.en: finding it very suspicious.

cues.zh: 徐一鸣伤那么重
cues.pinyin: xu2 yi1 ming2 shang1 na4 me5 zhong4
cues.en: Xu Yiming's injuries were so severe,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 哪有力解词寻短见
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 li4 jie3 ci2 xun2 duan3 jian4
cues.en: how could he possibly have had the strength to attempt suicide?

cues.zh: 金道琪找到复仇小分队说出了坏衣
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 qi2 zhao3 dao4 fu4 chou2 xiao3 fen1 dui4 shuo1 chu1 le5 huai4 yi1
cues.en: Jin Daoqi found the revenge squad and voiced his suspicions.

cues.zh: 技术人高恩突然想起出事的桥上
cues.pinyin: ji4 shu4 ren2 gao1 en1 tu1 ran2 xiang3 qi3 chu1 shi4 de5 qiao2 shang4
cues.en: Tech expert Gao En suddenly remembered that on the bridge where it happened,

cues.zh: 梅庄监视器
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhuang1 jian1 shi4 qi4
cues.en: there was no surveillance camera installed.

cues.zh: 陶会长的公司监控也没联系
cues.pinyin: tao2 hui4 zhang3 de5 gong1 si1 jian1 kong4 ye3 mei2 lian2 xi4
cues.en: They also couldn't get access to Chairman Park's company cameras.

cues.zh: 他虽然是黑客
cues.pinyin: ta1 sui1 ran2 shi4 hei1 ke4
cues.en: Although he was a hacker,

cues.zh: 但这种情况也没辙
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 ye3 mei2 zhe2
cues.en: even he had no way around this one.

cues.zh: 几人打起了坏主意
cues.pinyin: ji3 ren2 da3 qi3 le5 huai4 zhu3 yi4
cues.en: The group hatched a scheme:

cues.zh: 想让金道奇混进去
cues.pinyin: xiang3 rang4 jin1 dao4 qi2 hun4 jin4 qu4
cues.en: they'd have Jin Daoqi infiltrate the company.

cues.zh: 这倒霉蛋就这么一职人的身份进了公司
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao3 mei2 dan4 jiu4 zhe4 me5 yi1 zhi2 ren2 de5 shen1 fen4 jin4 le5 gong1 si1
cues.en: The unlucky guy went in posing as a regular employee.

cues.zh: 复仇小队还给他安排了夸张人设
cues.pinyin: fu4 chou2 xiao3 dui4 huan2 gei3 ta1 an1 pai2 le5 kua1 zhang1 ren2 she4
cues.en: The revenge squad gave him an exaggerated cover story.

cues.zh: 保持被席剑吹三人组追问
cues.pinyin: bao3 chi2 bei4 xi2 jian4 chui1 san1 ren2 zu3 zhui1 wen4
cues.en: As a result, he got grilled by the "wash-cut-blow" trio,

cues.zh: 金道奇靠拍马屁成功蒙混过关
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 qi2 kao4 pai1 ma3 pi4 cheng2 gong1 meng2 hun4 guo4 guan1
cues.en: but Jin Daoqi flattered his way through and got away with it.

cues.zh: 还当上了科长
cues.pinyin: hai2 dang1 shang4 le5 ke1 zhang3
cues.en: He even got promoted to section chief.

cues.zh: 而江河纳也怀疑金道奇不对劲
cues.pinyin: er2 jiang1 he2 na4 ye3 huai2 yi2 jin1 dao4 qi2 bu2 dui4 jin4
cues.en: Meanwhile, Jiang Hena also found Jin Daoqi suspicious,

cues.zh: 但他却说被张代者开除了
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 que4 shuo1 bei4 zhang1 dai4 zhe3 kai1 chu2 le5
cues.en: but he claimed he'd been fired from his previous company.

cues.zh: 江河纳觉得他在撒谎
cues.pinyin: jiang1 he2 na4 jue2 de5 ta1 zai4 sa1 huang3
cues.en: Jiang Hena felt he was lying.

cues.zh: 而金道奇刚混进敌营
cues.pinyin: er2 jin1 dao4 qi2 gang1 hun4 jin4 di2 ying2
cues.en: Meanwhile, having just infiltrated enemy territory,

cues.zh: 当场惊得说不出话
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jing1 de2 shuo1 bu4 chu1 hua4
cues.en: Jin Daoqi was stunned speechless on the spot.

cues.zh: 这拿枪正经大企业
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na2 qiang1 zheng4 jing1 da4 qi3 ye4
cues.en: This place was nothing like a legitimate big corporation —

cues.zh: 简直就是诈骗组织的洗脑会
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 jiu4 shi4 zha4 pian4 zu3 zhi1 de5 xi3 nao3 hui4
cues.en: it was basically a brainwashing session for a scam ring.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb评分8.0，有前科才有资格进会社高层，李帝勋主演刑侦复仇神剧，《模范出租车》。

cues.zh: 金道奇赶紧去监控室
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 qi2 gan3 jin3 qu4 jian1 kong4 shi4
cues.en: Jin Daoqi hurried to the surveillance room

cues.zh: 唯独企划部是个死角
cues.pinyin: wei2 du2 qi3 hua4 bu4 shi4 ge4 si3 jiao3
cues.en: and had Gao En help hack into the system.

cues.zh: 发现公司到处是监控
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 gong1 si1 dao4 chu4 shi4 jian1 kong4
cues.en: He found cameras everywhere in the company,

cues.zh: 唯独企划不是个死角
cues.pinyin: wei2 du2 qi3 hua4 bu2 shi4 ge4 si3 jiao3
cues.en: except that the planning department was a blind spot.

cues.zh: 这指定有毛利
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi3 ding4 you3 mao2 li4
cues.en: That definitely meant something shady was going on.

cues.zh: 金道奇让高温帮他提升知名度好混进去
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 qi2 rang4 gao1 wen1 bang1 ta1 ti2 sheng1 zhi1 ming2 du4 hao3 hun4 jin4 qu4
cues.en: Jin Daoqi had Gao En boost his profile so he could transfer in.

cues.zh: 而崔主任和朴主任也伪装成擦
cues.pinyin: er2 cui1 zhu3 ren4 he2 pu3 zhu3 ren4 ye3 wei3 zhuang1 cheng2 ca1
cues.en: Meanwhile, Director Cui and Director Park disguised themselves as

cues.zh: 鞋工在外支援
cues.pinyin: xie2 gong1 zai4 wai4 zhi1 yuan2
cues.en: shoeshiners supporting from outside.

cues.zh: 没想到两人技术太好招了一堆客人
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 liang3 ren2 ji4 shu4 tai4 hao3 zhao1 le5 yi1 dui1 ke4 ren2
cues.en: Unexpectedly, the two were so skilled they drew a crowd of customers,

cues.zh: 这可把崔主任气个够呛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 ba3 cui1 zhu3 ren4 qi4 ge4 gou4 qiang4
cues.en: which left Director Cui thoroughly exasperated.

cues.zh: 高温也让病毒入侵了公司的电脑
cues.pinyin: gao1 wen1 ye3 rang4 bing4 du2 ru4 qin1 le5 gong1 si1 de5 dian4 nao3
cues.en: Gao En also had a virus infiltrate the company's computers,

cues.zh: 系统当场崩了
cues.pinyin: xi4 tong3 dang1 chang3 beng1 le5
cues.en: and the system crashed on the spot.

cues.zh: 朴会长听说要休一周气的骂劫
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 ting1 shuo1 yao4 xiu1 yi1 zhou1 qi4 de5 ma4 jie2
cues.en: Hearing it would take a week to fix, Chairman Park cursed furiously.

cues.zh: 金道奇赶紧说自己十分钟就能搞定
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 qi2 gan3 jin3 shuo1 zi4 ji3 shi2 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 neng2 gao3 ding4
cues.en: Jin Daoqi quickly claimed he could fix it in ten minutes.

cues.zh: 他假装操作其实是高温在远程控制
cues.pinyin: ta1 jia3 zhuang1 cao1 zuo4 qi2 shi2 shi4 gao1 wen1 zai4 yuan3 cheng2 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: He pretended to work on it while Gao En actually controlled it remotely,

cues.zh: 真就弄好了
cues.pinyin: zhen1 jiu4 nong4 hao3 le5
cues.en: and it really got fixed.

cues.zh: 这下公司上下都记住了他
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 gong1 si1 shang4 xia4 dou1 ji4 zhu4 le5 ta1
cues.en: This made the whole company take notice of him.

cues.zh: 朴会长决定给他发很多的奖金
cues.pinyin: pu3 hui4 zhang3 jue2 ding4 gei3 ta1 fa1 hen3 duo1 de5 jiang3 jin1
cues.en: Chairman Park decided to give him a hefty bonus.

cues.zh: 金道基也趁机说想进企划部多赚钱
cues.pinyin: jin1 dao4 ji1 ye3 chen4 ji1 shuo1 xiang3 jin4 qi3 hua4 bu4 duo1 zhuan4 qian2
cues.en: Jin Daoqi seized the chance to say he wanted to transfer into the planning department to earn more,

cues.zh: 却被疑心中的朴会长直接拒绝了
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 yi2 xin1 zhong1 de5 pu3 hui4 zhang3 zhi2 jie1 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but the suspicious Chairman Park flatly refused.

cues.zh: 他和高恩都很纳闷
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 gao1 en1 dou1 hen3 na4 men4
cues.en: Both he and Gao En were puzzled.

items.title_zh: 动动脑时间3｜8个人8天用几桶水呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: 两个人两天用几桶水
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 liang3 tian1 yong4 ji3 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Two people, two days — how many buckets of water do they use?

cues.zh: 那么八个人八天用几桶水呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ba1 ge4 ren2 ba1 tian1 yong4 ji3 tong3 shui3 ne5
cues.en: So eight people, eight days — how many buckets of water do they use?

cues.zh: 你知道答案吗可在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5 ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: Do you know the answer? Leave a comment below and tell everyone.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to the last episode is here.

cues.zh: C D 完全看不见所以就不考虑了
cues.pinyin: C D wan2 quan2 kan4 bu2 jian4 suo3 yi3 jiu4 bu4 kao3 lv4 le5
cues.en: C and D can't see anything at all, so they're not considered.

cues.zh: A 无法判断自己的颜色所以也不说话
cues.pinyin: A wu2 fa3 pan4 duan4 zi4 ji3 de5 yan2 se4 suo3 yi3 ye3 bu4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: A can't determine their own color, so A doesn't speak either.

cues.zh: B 看 A 没回答就知道自己跟 C 颜色不同
cues.pinyin: B kan4 A mei2 hui2 da2 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 gen1 C yan2 se4 bu4 tong2
cues.en: Seeing that A didn't answer, B knows their color is different from C's.

cues.zh: B 就能猜出自己的颜色是黄色
cues.pinyin: B jiu4 neng2 cai1 chu1 zi4 ji3 de5 yan2 se4 shi4 huang2 se4
cues.en: So B can figure out that their own color is yellow.

cues.zh: 你答对了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 da2 dui4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you get it right?

cues.zh: 有一天老师问小明
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 lao3 shi1 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: One day, the teacher asked Xiaoming

cues.zh: 你回去问你妈咪用什么打蚊子
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui2 qu4 wen4 ni3 ma1 mi1 yong4 shen2 me5 da3 wen2 zi5
cues.en: "Go home and ask your mom what she uses to kill mosquitoes"

cues.zh: 问爸爸上战场用什么武器
cues.pinyin: wen4 ba4 ba4 shang4 zhan4 chang3 yong4 shen2 me5 wu3 qi4
cues.en: "Ask your dad what weapon he uses on the battlefield"

cues.zh: 问姐姐洗澡洗多久问哥哥想再活多久
cues.pinyin: wen4 jie3 jie3 xi3 zao3 xi3 duo1 jiu3 wen4 ge1 ge1 xiang3 zai4 huo2 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: "Ask your sister how long she showers, and ask your brother how much longer he wants to live"

cues.zh: 我明天会问你
cues.pinyin: wo3 ming2 tian1 hui4 wen4 ni3
cues.en: "I'll ask you tomorrow"

cues.zh: 回家后小明就去问妈妈妈妈回答用电蚊拍
cues.pinyin: hui2 jia1 hou4 xiao3 ming2 jiu4 qu4 wen4 ma1 ma1 ma1 ma1 hui2 da2 yong4 dian4 wen2 pai1
cues.en: After going home, Xiaoming went to ask his mom — mom answered, "An electric mosquito swatter"

cues.zh: 去问爸爸爸爸回答战车
cues.pinyin: qu4 wen4 ba4 ba4 ba4 ba4 hui2 da2 zhan4 che1
cues.en: He asked his dad — dad answered, "A tank"

cues.zh: 去问姐姐姐姐回答十分钟
cues.pinyin: qu4 wen4 jie3 jie3 jie3 jie3 hui2 da2 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: He asked his sister — she answered, "Ten minutes"

cues.zh: 去问哥哥哥哥回答八十年隔天老师问小明
cues.pinyin: qu4 wen4 ge1 ge1 ge1 ge1 hui2 da2 ba1 shi2 nian2 ge2 tian1 lao3 shi1 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: He asked his brother — he answered, "Eighty years." The next day, the teacher asked Xiaoming

cues.zh: 我妈妈说她用战车打蚊子
cues.pinyin: wo3 ma1 ma1 shuo1 ta1 yong4 zhan4 che1 da3 wen2 zi5
cues.en: "My mom said she kills mosquitoes with a tank"

cues.zh: 爸爸上战场用电蚊拍
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 shang4 zhan4 chang3 yong4 dian4 wen2 pai1
cues.en: "Dad uses an electric mosquito swatter on the battlefield"

cues.zh: 姐姐洗澡洗八十年
cues.pinyin: jie3 jie3 xi3 zao3 xi3 ba1 shi2 nian2
cues.en: "My sister showers for eighty years"

cues.zh: 哥哥想再活十分钟
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 xiang3 zai4 huo2 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: "My brother wants to live ten more minutes"

cues.zh: 山山我问你哦
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Shanshan, let me ask you something"

cues.zh: 寿司师傅啊
cues.pinyin: shou4 si1 shi1 fu4 a5
cues.en: "About the sushi chef"

cues.zh: 大学都念什么科系呢
cues.pinyin: da4 xue2 dou1 nian4 shen2 me5 ke1 xi4 ne5
cues.en: "What did he study in college?"

cues.zh: 参景系啊
cues.pinyin: can1 jing3 xi4 a5
cues.en: "The landscaping department"

cues.zh: 原来她要做寿司
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 yao4 zuo4 shou4 si1
cues.en: "I thought he'd end up making garden displays"

cues.zh: 不是哦
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 o2

cues.zh: 是美术系哦
cues.pinyin: shi4 mei3 shu4 xi4 o2
cues.en: "It's actually the fine arts department"

cues.zh: 为什么

cues.zh: 因为美苏系
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei3 su1 xi4

cues.zh: 我回家的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "When I got home"

cues.zh: 之后看到一只蟑螂跑进我们家
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 kan4 dao4 yi1 zhi1 zhang1 lang2 pao3 jin4 wo3 men5 jia1
cues.en: "I saw a cockroach run into our house"

cues.zh: 那你有没有把牠打死
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 you3 mei2 you3 ba3 ta1 da3 si3
cues.en: "So did you kill it?"

cues.zh: 没有啊
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 a5
cues.en: "No"

cues.zh: 因为蟑螂在你脚下啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhang1 lang2 zai4 ni3 jiao3 xia4 a5
cues.en: "Because the cockroach is under your foot"

cues.zh: 哪一只会先死
cues.pinyin: na3 yi1 zhi1 hui4 xian1 si3
cues.en: "Which one will die first?"

cues.zh: 两只都会一起死啊
cues.pinyin: liang3 zhi3 du1 hui4 yi4 qi3 si3 a5
cues.en: "They'll both die together"

cues.zh: 错答案是鸡
cues.pinyin: cuo4 da2 an4 shi4 ji1
cues.en: "Wrong — the answer is: chicken"

cues.zh: 因为那只耳是企鹅
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 na4 zhi3 er3 shi4 qi3 e2
cues.en: "Because the other one is a penguin"

cues.zh: 晨晨
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2
cues.en: Chenchen

cues.zh: 我考你吼
cues.pinyin: wo3 kao3 ni3 hou3
cues.en: "Let me quiz you, okay?"

cues.zh: 好不然我再考你一个好了

cues.pinyin: xin1 keng1 fa1 xian4 le5 xiao3 tong2 ren2

cues.zh: 撞脸了奥特曼的那个头型
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 lian3 le5 ao4 te4 man4 de5 na4 ge5 tou2 xing2

cues.zh: 它也是分为三个部分
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shi4 fen1 wei2 san1 ge4 bu4 fen4
cues.en: It's also divided into three parts.

cues.pinyin: di3 zuo4 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 fang1 fang1 zheng4 zheng4 de5

cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 si4 mian4 lou4 kong1 de5 ji1 tai2

cues.en: There are 13 figures, each with a different role and task.

cues.zh: 当时在参与一场非常隆重的祭祀活动

cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 tai2 de5 shi4 ge4 shen2 shou4
cues.en: What they're carrying is a divine beast.
