cues.pinyin: ta1 chu1 tu3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 bei4 cheng1 wei2 qi1 hao4 keng1 de5 zheng4 keng1 zhi1 bao3
cues.en: When it was unearthed, it was called the prized treasure of Pit No. 7.

cues.zh: 这件玉器是和青铜器组合在一起的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 yu4 qi4 shi4 he2 qing1 tong2 qi4 zu3 he2 zai4 yi4 qi3 de5
cues.en: This jade piece is combined together with a bronze vessel.

cues.zh: 它是一块椭圆形的玉石器
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi1 kuai4 tuo3 yuan2 xing2 de5 yu4 shi2 qi4
cues.en: It's an oval-shaped piece of jade.

cues.zh: 外层两面用格状的青铜器牢牢
cues.pinyin: wai4 ceng2 liang3 mian4 yong4 ge2 zhuang4 de5 qing1 tong2 qi4 lao2 lao2
cues.en: On the outside, a latticed bronze piece tightly...

cues.zh: 锁住前所未见
cues.pinyin: suo3 zhu4 qian2 suo3 wei4 jian4
cues.en: ...locks it in place — something never seen before.

cues.zh: 新坑出土的文物
cues.pinyin: xin1 keng1 chu1 tu3 de5 wen2 wu4
cues.en: Artifacts unearthed from the new pit.

cues.zh: 神兽驮人顶尊铜像
cues.pinyin: shen2 shou4 tuo2 ren2 ding3 zun1 tong2 xiang4
cues.en: A bronze statue of a divine beast carrying a figure holding up a zun vessel.

cues.zh: 跨坑拼接在一起的
cues.pinyin: kua4 keng1 pin1 jie1 zai4 yi4 qi3 de5
cues.en: ...pieced together across different pits.

cues.zh: 三号坑的顶尊人像顶尊一件大口尊
cues.pinyin: san1 hao4 keng1 de5 ding3 zun1 ren2 xiang4 ding3 zun1 yi1 jian4 da4 kou3 zun1
cues.en: The figure holding up a zun from Pit No. 3 is holding a large-mouthed zun vessel.

cues.zh: 而且尊的边缘处还有龙形的这种装饰
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zun1 de5 bian1 yuan2 chu4 hai2 you3 long2 xing2 de5 zhe4 zhong3 zhuang1 shi4
cues.en: And around the rim of the zun there are dragon-shaped decorations.

cues.zh: 在 8 号祭祀坑
cues.pinyin: zai4 8 hao4 ji4 si4 keng1
cues.en: In sacrificial Pit No. 8,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 【文物篇】花费14亿！四川最新地标来了，一票难求 Cost 1.4 billion! Sichuan's newest landmark whose ticke

cues.zh: 我们又发现了三星堆迄今为止最
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 fa1 xian4 le5 san1 xing1 dui1 qi4 jin1 wei2 zhi3 zui4
cues.en: we discovered the largest—

cues.zh: 大的一个神兽
cues.pinyin: da4 de5 yi2 ge4 shen2 shou4
cues.en: —divine beast found at Sanxingdui so far.

cues.zh: 我们知道尊是具有中原风格特色的礼器
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 zun1 shi4 ju4 you3 zhong1 yuan2 feng1 ge2 te4 se4 de5 li3 qi4
cues.en: We know the zun is a ritual vessel with the stylistic features of the Central Plains.

cues.zh: 它和三星堆的人像组合在一起
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 san1 xing1 dui1 de5 ren2 xiang4 zu3 he2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: It's combined together with a Sanxingdui figure.

cues.zh: 反映了蜀文化和中原文化之间的交流
cues.pinyin: fan3 ying4 le5 shu3 wen2 hua4 he2 zhong1 yuan2 wen2 hua4 zhi1 jian1 de5 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: This reflects the cultural exchange between Shu culture and Central Plains culture.

cues.zh: 创新
cues.pinyin: chuang4 xin1
cues.en: — innovation.

cues.zh: 镇馆之宝
cues.pinyin: zhen4 guan3 zhi1 bao3
cues.en: The museum's prized treasure.

cues.zh: 通天神树
cues.pinyin: tong1 tian1 shen2 shu4
cues.en: The sky-reaching sacred tree.

cues.zh: 通高达到了 3 96 米
cues.pinyin: tong1 gao1 da2 dao4 le5 3 96 mi3
cues.en: Its total height reaches 3.96 meters.

cues.zh: 分为三层
cues.pinyin: fen1 wei2 san1 ceng2
cues.en: It's divided into three tiers.

cues.zh: 树上有小鸟
cues.pinyin: shu4 shang4 you3 xiao3 niao3
cues.en: There are small birds on the tree.

cues.zh: 有果实
cues.pinyin: you3 guo3 shi2
cues.en: There are fruits.

cues.zh: 有龙的造型
cues.pinyin: you3 long2 de5 zao4 xing2
cues.en: There are dragon shapes.

cues.zh: 全世界同时期发现最高最大的
cues.pinyin: quan2 shi4 jie4 tong2 shi2 qi1 fa1 xian4 zui4 gao1 zui4 da4 de5
cues.en: The tallest and largest single bronze artifact ever found from the same period, worldwide—

cues.zh: 青铜单件文物
cues.pinyin: qing1 tong2 dan1 jian4 wen2 wu4
cues.en: —a single bronze artifact.

cues.zh: 青铜大立人
cues.pinyin: qing1 tong2 da4 li4 ren2
cues.en: The large standing bronze figure.

cues.zh: 通高达到 2 米 62
cues.pinyin: tong1 gao1 da2 dao4 2 mi3 62
cues.en: Its total height reaches 2.62 meters.

cues.zh: 大家也把它称为东方巨人
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ye3 ba3 ta1 cheng1 wei2 dong1 fang1 ju4 ren2
cues.en: People also call it the 'Eastern Giant.'

cues.zh: 它是迄今为止
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 qi4 jin1 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: It is, to this day,

cues.zh: 三星堆所有青铜人物雕像当中体
cues.pinyin: san1 xing1 dui1 suo3 you3 qing1 tong2 ren2 wu4 diao1 xiang4 dang1 zhong1 ti3
cues.en: the tallest among all the bronze figure statues at Sanxingdui.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 当爱人生了病患有自闭症的肖恩还会一
cues.pinyin: dang1 ai4 ren2 sheng1 le5 bing4 huan4 you3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 xiao4 en1 hai2 hui4 yi1
cues.en: When his girlfriend falls ill, will Shaun, who has autism, still

cues.zh: 如既往地保持
cues.pinyin: ru2 ji4 wang3 di4 bao3 chi2
cues.en: keep up his usual

cues.zh: 绝对的冷静吗
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 de5 leng3 jing4 ma5
cues.en: absolute calm?

cues.zh: 丽娅和肖恩正在亚马路时
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 he2 xiao4 en1 zheng4 zai4 ya4 ma3 lu4 shi2
cues.en: While Lea and Shaun were walking on the road,

cues.zh: 丽娅突然腹痛男人倒在了地上
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 tu1 ran2 fu4 tong4 nan2 ren2 dao4 zai4 le5 di4 shang4
cues.en: Lea suddenly had abdominal pain and collapsed to the ground

cues.zh: 她的妇科医生说是发育期疼痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fu4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 shi4 fa1 yu4 qi1 teng2 tong4
cues.en: Her gynecologist said it was just growing pains

cues.zh: 但不放心的肖恩还是带着丽娅来到了
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 fang4 xin1 de5 xiao4 en1 hai2 shi4 dai4 zhe5 li4 ya4 lai2 dao4 le5
cues.en: But Shaun, feeling uneasy, still brought Lea to

cues.zh: 自己所在的医
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 suo3 zai4 de5 yi1
cues.en: the hospital where he

cues.zh: 院再检查一遍
cues.pinyin: yuan4 zai4 jian3 cha2 yi1 bian4
cues.en: worked for another check-up

cues.zh: 不过克莱尔检查过后发现孩子的心率
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ke4 lai2 er3 jian3 cha2 guo4 hou4 fa1 xian4 hai2 zi5 de5 xin1 lv4
cues.en: But after examining her, Claire found the baby's heart rate

cues.zh: 和活动都很正
cues.pinyin: he2 huo2 dong4 dou1 hen3 zheng4
cues.en: and activity were both

cues.zh: 常血压也正常
cues.pinyin: chang2 xue4 ya1 ye3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: normal, and the blood pressure was normal too

cues.zh: 看来妇科医生说的没错但肖恩还是担心
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 fu4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 de5 mei2 cuo4 dan4 xiao4 en1 hai2 shi4 dan1 xin1
cues.en: It seemed the gynecologist was right, but Shaun was still worried

cues.zh: 觉得妇科医生下的结论太草率了
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 fu4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 xia4 de5 jie2 lun4 tai4 cao3 shuai4 le5
cues.en: feeling the gynecologist's conclusion had been too hasty

cues.zh: 他自己列了一些需要的检查项目
cues.pinyin: ta1 zi4 ji3 lie4 le5 yi1 xie1 xu1 yao4 de5 jian3 cha2 xiang4 mu4
cues.en: He drew up a list of tests he thought were needed

cues.zh: 让克雷尔帮忙给丽雅检查一下
cues.pinyin: rang4 ke4 lei2 er3 bang1 mang2 gei3 li4 ya3 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and had Claire check on Lea

cues.zh: 大有不做就赖着不走的架势
cues.pinyin: da4 you3 bu4 zuo4 jiu4 lai4 zhe5 bu4 zou3 de5 jia4 shi4
cues.en: with the air of someone who wouldn't leave until it was done

cues.zh: 克雷尔看着这样洋洋洒洒的几大张的单子
cues.pinyin: ke4 lei2 er3 kan4 zhe5 zhe4 yang4 yang2 yang2 sa3 sa3 de5 ji3 da4 zhang1 de5 dan1 zi5
cues.en: Claire looked at the long list covering several pages

cues.zh: 又酸又无语
cues.pinyin: you4 suan1 you4 wu2 yu3
cues.en: feeling both exasperated and speechless

cues.zh: 但保证病人的健康是医生的职责
cues.pinyin: dan4 bao3 zheng4 bing4 ren2 de5 jian4 kang1 shi4 yi1 sheng1 de5 zhi2 ze2
cues.en: But ensuring a patient's health is a doctor's duty

cues.zh: 何况这还是萧恩的女友
cues.pinyin: he2 kuang4 zhe4 hai2 shi4 xiao1 en1 de5 nv3 you3
cues.en: especially since this patient was Shaun's girlfriend

cues.zh: 所以克雷尔就照做了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ke4 lei2 er3 jiu4 zhao4 zuo4 le5
cues.en: so Claire went ahead and did it

cues.zh: 一套检查下来并没有发现什么
cues.pinyin: yi1 tao4 jian3 cha2 xia4 lai2 bing4 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4 shen2 me5
cues.en: After the full round of tests, nothing was found

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 一切都很正常
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 dou1 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: Everything was completely normal

cues.zh: 但丽雅为了稳妥还是决定在医院住下来
cues.pinyin: dan4 li4 ya3 wei4 le5 wen3 tuo3 hai2 shi4 jue2 ding4 zai4 yi1 yuan4 zhu4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: But to be safe, Lea still decided to stay in the hospital

cues.zh: 起码出事了抓给医生过来就行
cues.pinyin: qi3 ma3 chu1 shi4 le5 zhua1 gei3 yi1 sheng1 guo4 lai2 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: at least if something happened, a doctor could be called right away

cues.zh: 看着电子监护仪上的数据
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 dian4 zi5 jian1 hu4 yi2 shang4 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: Watching the data on the monitor,

cues.zh: 克莱尔慢慢地觉察出了不对劲来
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 man4 man4 di4 jue2 cha2 chu1 le5 bu2 dui4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Claire gradually sensed something was wrong

cues.zh: 婴儿的心率出现了轻度过缓
cues.pinyin: ying1 er2 de5 xin1 lv4 chu1 xian4 le5 qing1 du4 guo4 huan3
cues.en: The baby's heart rate showed mild bradycardia

cues.zh: 于是他立刻给丽雅做了超声检查
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 li4 ke4 gei3 li4 ya3 zuo4 le5 chao1 sheng1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: so she immediately gave Lea an ultrasound

cues.zh: 结果出来了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The results came back

cues.zh: 丽雅患有二型前置血管
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 huan4 you3 er4 xing2 qian2 zhi4 xue4 guan3
cues.en: Lea had type II vasa previa

cues.zh: 这是一种十分罕见的妇科疾病
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 shi2 fen1 han3 jian4 de5 fu4 ke1 ji2 bing4
cues.en: a very rare obstetric condition

cues.zh: 对母体没有什么伤害
cues.pinyin: dui4 mu3 ti3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 shang1 hai4
cues.en: harmless to the mother

cues.zh: 但是胎儿的血管穿过了子宫禁时
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tai1 er2 de5 xue4 guan3 chuan1 guo4 le5 zi5 gong1 jin4 shi2
cues.en: but when the fetal blood vessels pass through the cervix

cues.zh: 就会变得非常脆弱
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 bian4 de2 fei1 chang2 cui4 ruo4
cues.en: they become extremely fragile

cues.zh: 随时可能会破裂
cues.pinyin: sui2 shi2 ke3 neng2 hui4 po4 lie4
cues.en: and could rupture at any moment

cues.zh: 就算一直顽强地维持正常状态
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 yi4 zhi2 wan2 qiang2 di4 wei2 chi2 zheng4 chang2 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: Even if things stubbornly stayed normal,

cues.zh: 到了羊水破的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 yang2 shui3 po4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: once the water broke,

cues.zh: 血管也会破裂的
cues.pinyin: xue4 guan3 ye3 hui4 po4 lie4 de5
cues.en: the vessels would rupture anyway

cues.zh: 丽雅听不懂
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 ting1 bu4 dong3
cues.en: Lea didn't understand the medical details

cues.zh: 但克莱尔的表情和语气
cues.pinyin: dan4 ke4 lai2 er3 de5 biao3 qing2 he2 yu3 qi4
cues.en: but Claire's expression and tone

cues.zh: 已经告诉她这不是一般的情况
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 gao4 su4 ta1 zhe4 bu2 shi4 yi4 ban1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: already told her this was no ordinary situation

cues.zh: 萧恩告诉他
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Shaun told her

cues.zh: 他们可能会失去这个孩子了
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 neng2 hui4 shi1 qu4 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 le5
cues.en: they might lose the baby

cues.zh: 而且胎儿只有 22 周大
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 tai1 er2 zhi3 you3 22 zhou1 da4
cues.en: and since the fetus was only 22 weeks old,

cues.zh: 根本不能抛妇产
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 bu4 neng2 pao1 fu4 chan3
cues.en: a C-section was out of the question

cues.zh: 为了救助丽雅
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jiu4 zhu4 li4 ya3
cues.en: To try to save Lea,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 肯定会尽全力而为
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 hui4 jin4 quan2 li4 er2 wei4
cues.en: they would definitely do everything they could

cues.zh: 但肖恩依旧不放弃
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 yi1 jiu4 bu4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: But Shaun still wouldn't give up

cues.zh: 在丽姆这吃扁了
cues.pinyin: zai4 li4 mu3 zhe4 chi1 bian3 le5
cues.en: Having gotten nowhere there,

cues.zh: 就去找身为院长的伦叔
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu4 zhao3 shen1 wei4 yuan4 zhang3 de5 lun2 shu1
cues.en: he went to find Uncle Lun, the hospital director,

cues.zh: 希望他能给自己走个后门
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ta1 neng2 gei3 zi4 ji3 zou3 ge4 hou4 men2
cues.en: hoping he'd pull some strings for him

cues.zh: 但伦叔也拒绝了他
cues.pinyin: dan4 lun2 shu1 ye3 ju4 jue2 le5 ta1
cues.en: But Uncle Lun refused him too

cues.zh: 萧恩现在的行为
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 xian4 zai4 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: Shaun's behavior right now

cues.zh: 很明显就是在情绪化
cues.pinyin: hen3 ming2 xian3 jiu4 shi4 zai4 qing2 xu4 hua4
cues.en: was clearly just him being emotional

cues.zh: 他不可能让萧恩参加的
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 ke3 neng2 rang4 xiao1 en1 can1 jia1 de5
cues.en: there was no way he could let Shaun take part

cues.zh: 没办法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: There was nothing to be done

cues.zh: 萧恩只能站在二楼围观
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhi3 neng2 zhan4 zai4 er4 lou2 wei2 guan1
cues.en: Shaun could only watch from the second floor

cues.zh: 在他焦急的等待中
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 jiao1 ji2 de5 deng3 dai4 zhong1
cues.en: While he waited anxiously,

cues.zh: 手术顺利结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shun4 li4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: the surgery finished successfully

cues.zh: 现在需要的就是等待
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 xu1 yao4 de5 jiu4 shi4 deng3 dai4
cues.en: Now all that was left was to wait

cues.zh: 胎儿需要肋骨唇
cues.pinyin: tai1 er2 xu1 yao4 lei4 gu3 chun2
cues.en: The fetus needed steroids

cues.zh: 来加速肺部发育
cues.pinyin: lai2 jia1 su4 fei4 bu4 fa1 yu4
cues.en: to speed up lung development

cues.zh: 两天后会做必超复查
cues.pinyin: liang3 tian1 hou4 hui4 zuo4 bi4 chao1 fu4 cha2
cues.en: Two days later they'd do a follow-up ultrasound

cues.zh: 如果药物起作用
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yao4 wu4 qi3 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: if the medication worked,

cues.zh: 那就没什么问题了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 mei2 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 le5
cues.en: then there wouldn't be a problem

cues.zh: 丽雅选择工作
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 xuan3 ze2 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Lea chose to keep working

cues.zh: 来分散注意力
cues.pinyin: lai2 fen1 san4 zhu4 yi4 li4
cues.en: to distract herself

cues.zh: 好熬过这漫长的两天
cues.pinyin: hao3 ao2 guo4 zhe4 man4 chang2 de5 liang3 tian1
cues.en: and get through those two long days

cues.zh: 萧恩则去做手术
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ze2 qu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Shaun, meanwhile, went to perform surgery

cues.zh: 第二天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: The next day,

cues.zh: 肖恩正在给丽娅汇报体征情况时
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zheng4 zai4 gei3 li4 ya4 hui4 bao4 ti3 zheng1 qing2 kuang4 shi2
cues.en: while Shaun was reporting her vitals to Lea,

cues.zh: 丽娅突然感到呼吸困难
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 tu1 ran2 gan3 dao4 hu1 xi1 kun4 nan2
cues.en: Lea suddenly found it hard to breathe

cues.zh: 肖恩慌了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 huang1 le5
cues.en: Shaun panicked

cues.zh: 两秒后立刻掀去她身上的毯子
cues.pinyin: liang3 miao3 hou4 li4 ke4 xian1 qu4 ta1 shen1 shang4 de5 tan3 zi5
cues.en: two seconds later he yanked the blanket off her

cues.zh: 丽娅的腿已经肿起来了
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 de5 tui3 yi3 jing1 zhong3 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: Lea's legs had already swollen up

cues.zh: 下肢肿胀
cues.pinyin: xia4 zhi1 zhong3 zhang4
cues.en: with lower-limb swelling

cues.zh: 呼吸短促
cues.pinyin: hu1 xi1 duan3 cu4
cues.en: and shortness of breath

cues.zh: 这是肺栓色的症状
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 fei4 shuan1 se4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: these were symptoms of a pulmonary embolism

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 还有一个卡在了歧动脉里
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ka3 zai4 le5 qi2 dong4 mai4 li3
cues.en: with another clot lodged in a limb artery

cues.zh: 布莱尔真的希望自己判断错了
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 er3 zhen1 de5 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 pan4 duan4 cuo4 le5
cues.en: Claire genuinely hoped she was wrong

cues.zh: 所以想让一直以来都很优秀的肖
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiang3 rang4 yi4 zhi2 yi3 lai2 dou1 hen3 you1 xiu4 de5 xiao4
cues.en: so she wanted Shaun, who had always been excellent,

cues.zh: 恩再诊断一下
cues.pinyin: en1 zai4 zhen3 duan4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: to make the diagnosis again

cues.zh: 但肖恩告诉他没错
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 gao4 su4 ta1 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: but Shaun told her she wasn't wrong

cues.zh: 他看到了羊水的测试结果
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 le5 yang2 shui3 de5 ce4 shi4 jie2 guo3
cues.en: He'd seen the amniotic fluid test results

cues.zh: 肋固醇没有用
cues.pinyin: le1 gu4 chun2 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: the steroids hadn't worked

cues.zh: 也就是说婴儿无法存活
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ying1 er2 wu2 fa3 cun2 huo2
cues.en: meaning the baby couldn't survive

cues.zh: 可是他现在还不敢去告诉丽雅
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 xian4 zai4 hai2 bu4 gan3 qu4 gao4 su4 li4 ya3
cues.en: But he still didn't dare tell Lea yet

cues.zh: 布莱克看着肖恩这么难过
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 ke4 kan4 zhe5 xiao4 en1 zhe4 me5 nan2 guo4
cues.en: Seeing Shaun so devastated,

cues.zh: 想着要不自己去说
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zhe5 yao4 bu4 zi4 ji3 qu4 shuo1
cues.en: Claire thought about telling her herself instead

cues.zh: 但肖恩拒绝了他
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 ju4 jue2 le5 ta1
cues.en: but Shaun refused to let her

cues.zh: 起身独自去了丽雅的病房
cues.pinyin: qi3 shen1 du2 zi4 qu4 le5 li4 ya3 de5 bing4 fang2
cues.en: and got up to go to Lea's room alone

cues.zh: 不知情的丽雅还在工作
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 qing2 de5 li4 ya3 hai2 zai4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Unaware, Lea was still working

cues.zh: 可他看到肖恩的表情后就懂了一切
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 kan4 dao4 xiao4 en1 de5 biao3 qing2 hou4 jiu4 dong3 le5 yi1 qie4
cues.en: but the moment she saw Shaun's expression, she understood everything

cues.zh: 抱着他失声痛哭
cues.pinyin: bao4 zhe5 ta1 shi1 sheng1 tong4 ku1
cues.en: She threw her arms around him and broke down sobbing

cues.zh: 最后肖恩陪着丽雅做了引流手术
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 xiao4 en1 pei2 zhe5 li4 ya3 zuo4 le5 yin3 liu2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: In the end, Shaun stayed by Lea's side through the drainage procedure

cues.zh: 她眼中含泪和自己未出生的孩子告别
cues.pinyin: ta1 yan3 zhong1 han2 lei4 he2 zi4 ji3 wei4 chu1 sheng1 de5 hai2 zi5 gao4 bie2
cues.en: With tears in her eyes, she said goodbye to her unborn child

cues.zh: 一个如此热爱生活的人
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ru2 ci3 re4 ai4 sheng1 huo2 de5 ren2
cues.en: Someone who loved life so much

cues.zh: 为什么会一心求死呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 yi1 xin1 qiu2 si3 ne5
cues.en: why would she be so set on dying?

cues.zh: 80 多岁的马太太在募捐会上昏
cues.pinyin: 80 duo1 sui4 de5 ma3 tai4 tai4 zai4 mu4 juan1 hui4 shang4 hun1
cues.en: Mrs. Ma, in her 80s, collapsed

cues.zh: 倒在了五指里
cues.pinyin: dao4 zai4 le5 wu3 zhi3 li3
cues.en: on the dance floor at a fundraiser

cues.zh: 被救助人员送到医院时
cues.pinyin: bei4 jiu4 zhu4 ren2 yuan2 song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 shi2
cues.en: By the time rescuers got her to the hospital,

cues.zh: 呼吸急促
cues.pinyin: hu1 xi1 ji2 cu4
cues.en: her breathing was rapid,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 脉搏和呼吸频率都在下降
cues.pinyin: mai4 bo2 he2 hu1 xi1 pin2 lv4 dou1 zai4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: her pulse and breathing rate were both dropping

cues.zh: 没过多时便发生了致命性的心脏骤停
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 shi2 bian4 fa1 sheng1 le5 zhi4 ming4 xing4 de5 xin1 zang4 zhou4 ting2
cues.en: and before long she suffered a fatal cardiac arrest

cues.zh: 沃克立刻准备急救
cues.pinyin: wo4 ke4 li4 ke4 zhun3 bei4 ji2 jiu4
cues.en: Walker immediately prepared to resuscitate her

cues.zh: 却被嫖医生叫停了
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 piao2 yi1 sheng1 jiao4 ting2 le5
cues.en: but was stopped by Dr. Park

cues.zh: 因为马太太的手上带着一个医用手环
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ma3 tai4 tai4 de5 shou3 shang4 dai4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 yi1 yong4 shou3 huan2
cues.en: because Mrs. Ma was wearing a medical bracelet

cues.zh: 说明她签了不抢救协议
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 ta1 qian1 le5 bu4 qiang3 jiu4 xie2 yi4
cues.en: showing she'd signed a do-not-resuscitate agreement

cues.zh: 他们救她是违反规定的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiu4 ta1 shi4 wei2 fan3 gui1 ding4 de5
cues.en: Saving her would mean breaking the rules

cues.zh: 那怎么办
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: So what were they supposed to do?

cues.zh: 眼睁睁地看着她停止心跳吗
cues.pinyin: yan3 zheng1 zheng1 di4 kan4 zhe5 ta1 ting2 zhi3 xin1 tiao4 ma5
cues.en: just watch helplessly as her heart stopped?

cues.zh: 年轻的沃克还想要再挣扎一下
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 de5 wo4 ke4 hai2 xiang3 yao4 zai4 zheng1 zha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: The young Walker still wanted to try something

cues.zh: 他们也许可以用一些比较温和的治疗
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 xu3 ke3 yi3 yong4 yi1 xie1 bi3 jiao4 wen1 he2 de5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: maybe they could use some gentler treatment

cues.zh: 但还是被朴医生强硬的驳回了
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 shi4 bei4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 qiang2 ying4 de5 bo2 hui2 le5
cues.en: but Dr. Park firmly rejected that too

cues.zh: 说话间
cues.pinyin: shuo1 hua4 jian1
cues.en: Even as they spoke,

cues.zh: 心电图逐渐变成了一条直线
cues.pinyin: xin1 dian4 tu2 zhu2 jian4 bian4 cheng2 le5 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: the EKG gradually flattened into a straight line

cues.zh: 没有机会了
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ji1 hui4 le5
cues.en: There was no chance left

cues.zh: 可万万没想到的是
cues.pinyin: ke3 wan4 wan4 mei2 xiang3 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But what no one expected was,

cues.zh: 就在朴医生准备宣布死亡时间时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 pu3 yi1 sheng1 zhun3 bei4 xuan1 bu4 si3 wang2 shi2 jian1 shi2
cues.en: just as Dr. Park was about to call the time of death,

cues.zh: 马太太的血压居然逐渐恢复了
cues.pinyin: ma3 tai4 tai4 de5 xue4 ya1 ju1 ran2 zhu2 jian4 hui1 fu4 le5
cues.en: Mrs. Ma's blood pressure actually started to recover

cues.zh: 血氧饱和度也恢复了正常水平
cues.pinyin: xue4 yang3 bao3 he2 du4 ye3 hui1 fu4 le5 zheng4 chang2 shui3 ping2
cues.en: and her blood oxygen saturation returned to normal too

cues.zh: 这是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: What was going on?

cues.zh: 难道马太太有起死回生这种不科学的能力
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 ma3 tai4 tai4 you3 qi3 si3 hui2 sheng1 zhe4 zhong3 bu4 ke1 xue2 de5 neng2 li4
cues.en: Could Mrs. Ma really have some unscientific power to come back from the dead,

cues.zh: 还是机器出现了问题
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ji1 qi4 chu1 xian4 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: or was something wrong with the machines?

cues.zh: 机器肯定是没问题的
cues.pinyin: ji1 qi4 ken3 ding4 shi4 mei2 wen4 ti2 de5
cues.en: The machines definitely weren't the problem

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 因为活够了，老奶奶执意要死！天才医生想救都不能救！肖恩的孩子没了

cues.zh: 决定用机器辅助手术
cues.pinyin: jue2 ding4 yong4 ji1 qi4 fu3 zhu4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They decided to do machine-assisted surgery

cues.zh: 在她心脏还在跳动的时候取出装置
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 xin1 zang4 hai2 zai4 tiao4 dong4 de5 shi2 hou4 qu3 chu1 zhuang1 zhi4
cues.en: to remove the device while her heart was still beating

cues.zh: 俩人商量的起劲
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 shang1 liang2 de5 qi3 jin4
cues.en: The two of them discussed it eagerly

cues.zh: 沃克依旧在一旁茫然
cues.pinyin: wo4 ke4 yi1 jiu4 zai4 yi1 pang2 mang2 ran2
cues.en: while Walker stood by, still confused

cues.zh: 马太太比她所见的任何病人都要有生机
cues.pinyin: ma3 tai4 tai4 bi3 ta1 suo3 jian4 de5 ren4 he2 bing4 ren2 dou1 yao4 you3 sheng1 ji1
cues.en: Mrs. Ma had more vitality than any patient she'd ever seen

cues.zh: 为何她会选择取出装置
cues.pinyin: wei4 he2 ta1 hui4 xuan3 ze2 qu3 chu1 zhuang1 zhi4
cues.en: so why would she choose to have the device removed

cues.zh: 加速自己的死亡呢
cues.pinyin: jia1 su4 zi4 ji3 de5 si3 wang2 ne5
cues.en: and hasten her own death?

cues.zh: 为了说服马太太改缘主意
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 shuo1 fu2 ma3 tai4 tai4 gai3 yuan2 zhu3 yi4
cues.en: To persuade Mrs. Ma to change her mind,

cues.zh: 沃克特地和她套近乎
cues.pinyin: wo4 ke4 te4 di4 he2 ta1 tao4 jin4 hu1
cues.en: Walker made a point of getting close to her

cues.zh: 还提到了自己已经去世的祖母
cues.pinyin: hai2 ti2 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 yi3 jing1 qu4 shi4 de5 zu3 mu3
cues.en: even bringing up her own late grandmother,

cues.zh: 试图引起对方的共鸣
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 yin3 qi3 dui4 fang1 de5 gong4 ming2
cues.en: trying to strike an emotional chord

cues.zh: 但马太太早就看出了她内心的小九九
cues.pinyin: dan4 ma3 tai4 tai4 zao3 jiu4 kan4 chu1 le5 ta1 nei4 xin1 de5 xiao3 jiu3 jiu3
cues.en: But Mrs. Ma had already seen through her little scheme

cues.zh: 一点也不知她的套路
cues.pinyin: yi4 dian3 ye3 bu4 zhi1 ta1 de5 tao4 lu4
cues.en: and wasn't fooled by her tactics at all

cues.zh: 没办法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: With no other option,

cues.zh: 沃克决定打直球
cues.pinyin: wo4 ke4 jue2 ding4 da3 zhi2 qiu2
cues.en: Walker decided to just ask it straight

cues.zh: 问她真的想死吗
cues.pinyin: wen4 ta1 zhen1 de5 xiang3 si3 ma5
cues.en: whether she really wanted to die

cues.zh: 马太太说
cues.pinyin: ma3 tai4 tai4 shuo1
cues.en: Mrs. Ma said

cues.zh: 选择自己怎么死是一个很幸运的事
cues.pinyin: xuan3 ze2 zi4 ji3 zen3 me5 si3 shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 xing4 yun4 de5 shi4
cues.en: that getting to choose how you die is a very lucky thing

cues.zh: 她原本想死在舞池里的
cues.pinyin: ta1 yuan2 ben3 xiang3 si3 zai4 wu3 chi2 li3 de5
cues.en: She'd originally wanted to die on the dance floor,

cues.zh: 心中有歌手中有酒
cues.pinyin: xin1 zhong1 you3 ge1 shou3 zhong1 you3 jiu3
cues.en: with a song in her heart and wine in hand

cues.zh: 可谁知又活了过来
cues.pinyin: ke3 shui2 zhi1 you4 huo2 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: but who knew she'd come back to life

cues.zh: 而沃克现在居然还想劝说她选
cues.pinyin: er2 wo4 ke4 xian4 zai4 ju1 ran2 hai2 xiang3 quan4 shuo1 ta1 xuan3
cues.en: and now Walker actually wanted to talk her into

cues.zh: 择再活几个月
cues.pinyin: ze2 zai4 huo2 ji3 ge4 yue4
cues.en: living a few more months

cues.zh: 那时候她只能痛苦地死去了
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 hou4 ta1 zhi3 neng2 tong4 ku3 di4 si3 qu4 le5
cues.en: by which point she'd only end up dying in agony

cues.zh: 她选择了拒绝
cues.pinyin: ta1 xuan3 ze2 le5 ju4 jue2
cues.en: She chose to refuse

cues.zh: 最终马太太还是做了手术
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 ma3 tai4 tai4 hai2 shi4 zuo4 le5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: In the end, Mrs. Ma went ahead with the surgery anyway

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻在家中造悬空泳池，不需要空调，获年度大奖 The couple built a hanging pool at home, did not need air

cues.zh: 宽度只有 6 米的小住宅
cues.pinyin: kuan1 du4 zhi3 you3 6 mi3 de5 xiao3 zhu4 zhai2
cues.en: A small house only 6 meters wide

cues.zh: 为什么可以获得新加坡建筑设
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ke3 yi3 huo4 de2 xin1 jia1 po1 jian4 zhu4 she4
cues.en: Why could it win Singapore's architecture design award's

cues.zh: 计奖的最高荣
cues.pinyin: ji4 jiang3 de5 zui4 gao1 rong2
cues.en: highest honor,

cues.zh: 誉年度建筑奖
cues.pinyin: yu4 nian2 du4 jian4 zhu4 jiang3
cues.en: the Building of the Year award

cues.zh: 这是一对建筑师夫妻耗时 20 个月为
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 dui4 jian4 zhu4 shi1 fu1 qi1 hao4 shi2 20 ge4 yue4 wei4
cues.en: This is a home a couple of architects spent 20 months

cues.zh: 自己打造的家
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 da3 zao4 de5 jia1
cues.en: building for themselves

cues.zh: 它的位置很受限夹在一排屋子中间
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 wei4 zhi4 hen3 shou4 xian4 jia1 zai4 yi1 pai2 wu1 zi5 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: Its location is very restricted, sandwiched between a row of houses

cues.zh: 只有东西两个方向的采光
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 dong1 xi1 liang3 ge4 fang1 xiang4 de5 cai3 guang1
cues.en: It only gets light from the east and west sides

cues.zh: 然而在西晒严重
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 zai4 xi1 shai4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: However, the west-facing sun exposure is severe

cues.zh: 常年 25 至 35 度的热带几乎从来不用开空调
cues.pinyin: chang2 nian2 25 zhi4 35 du4 de5 re4 dai4 ji1 hu1 cong2 lai2 bu4 yong4 kai1 kong1 tiao2
cues.en: In the tropics, with year-round temperatures of 25 to 35 degrees, they almost never need to turn on the AC

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻在家中造悬空泳池，不需要空调，获年度大奖 The couple built a hanging pool at home, did not need air

cues.zh: 泳池在二楼最西边
cues.pinyin: yong3 chi2 zai4 er4 lou2 zui4 xi1 bian1
cues.en: The pool is on the second floor, at the westernmost end

cues.zh: 外立面完全是通透的
cues.pinyin: wai4 li4 mian4 wan2 quan2 shi4 tong1 tou4 de5
cues.en: The facade is completely open and see-through

cues.zh: 风是从前面来
cues.pinyin: feng1 shi4 cong2 qian2 mian4 lai2
cues.en: The wind comes from the front

cues.zh: 然后吹过泳池之后
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 chui1 guo4 yong3 chi2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: and then after it blows across the pool,

cues.zh: 把空气给凉快化
cues.pinyin: ba3 kong1 qi4 gei3 liang2 kuai4 hua4
cues.en: it cools the air down

cues.zh: 主要的区域的高度
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 de5 qu1 yu4 de5 gao1 du4
cues.en: The height of the main areas

cues.zh: 稍微高一点
cues.pinyin: shao1 wei1 gao1 yi4 dian3
cues.en: is a bit taller

cues.zh: 让自然风去带到
cues.pinyin: rang4 zi4 ran2 feng1 qu4 dai4 dao4
cues.en: to let the natural breeze flow through

cues.zh: 可以舒缓整体的一个
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 shu1 huan3 zheng3 ti3 de5 yi2 ge4
cues.en: which can help cool the whole space

cues.zh: 最外面的一个大门
cues.pinyin: zui4 wai4 mian4 de5 yi2 ge4 da4 men2
cues.en: The outermost front gate

cues.zh: 它其实是一个
cues.pinyin: ta1 qi2 shi2 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: is actually

cues.zh: 六寸厚两层的石木
cues.pinyin: liu4 cun4 hou4 liang3 ceng2 de5 shi2 mu4
cues.en: a six-inch-thick, two-layer stone-and-wood door

cues.zh: 有夹空保温的一个效果
cues.pinyin: you3 jia1 kong1 bao3 wen1 de5 yi2 ge4 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: which has an insulating effect from the air gap inside

cues.zh: 主卧整体六米宽的景观是给卧室了
cues.pinyin: zhu3 wo4 zheng3 ti3 liu4 mi3 kuan1 de5 jing3 guan1 shi4 gei3 wo4 shi4 le5
cues.en: The master bedroom's whole 6-meter-wide view was given to the bedroom

cues.zh: 卧室跟泳池之间都是一个很 open 的感觉
cues.pinyin: wo4 shi4 gen1 yong3 chi2 zhi1 jian1 dou1 shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 open de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Between the bedroom and the pool, it all feels very open

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻在家中造悬空泳池，不需要空调，获年度大奖 The couple built a hanging pool at home, did not need air

cues.zh: 这个屋子它是四层嘛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wu1 zi5 ta1 shi4 si4 ceng2 ma5
cues.en: This house has four floors

cues.zh: 除了我家婆跟我妈妈之外呢
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 wo3 jia1 po2 gen1 wo3 ma1 ma1 zhi1 wai4 ne5
cues.en: Besides my mother-in-law and my mother,

cues.zh: 还有我 13 岁的儿子
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wo3 13 sui4 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: there's also my 13-year-old son

cues.zh: 三代是一回事哦
cues.pinyin: san1 dai4 shi4 yi1 hui2 shi4 o2
cues.en: Three generations under one roof is a whole different matter

cues.zh: 妈妈跟岳母在一起
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 gen1 yue4 mu3 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: My mom and my mother-in-law together

cues.zh: 是一个很危险的一个考虑
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 wei1 xian3 de5 yi2 ge4 kao3 lv4
cues.en: is a very risky consideration

cues.zh: 其实主要的元素就是让每一层都有属于他
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhu3 yao4 de5 yuan2 su4 jiu4 shi4 rang4 mei3 yi1 ceng2 dou1 you3 shu3 yu2 ta1
cues.en: Actually, the main idea is to let each floor have

cues.zh: 们自己的空间
cues.pinyin: men5 zi4 ji3 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: its own space

cues.zh: 种植的空间
cues.pinyin: zhong4 zhi2 de5 kong1 jian1

cues.en: Just then, the news reports that a female celebrity was beaten black and blue by a rich businessman.

cues.pinyin: ai1 zhe4 nv3 ming2 xing1 piao1 piao1 liang4 liang4 de5
cues.en: "Oh, this actress is so pretty,

cues.zh: 被打成这样真是可怜
cues.pinyin: bei4 da3 cheng2 zhe4 yang4 zhen1 shi4 ke3 lian2
cues.en: and she got beaten like this — how pitiful."

cues.zh: 哥哥突然语重心长的跟妹妹说
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 tu1 ran2 yu3 zhong4 xin1 chang2 de5 gen1 mei4 mei4 shuo1
cues.en: The older brother suddenly says earnestly to his little sister,

cues.pinyin: mei4 mei4 ni3 yi3 hou4 yao4 jia4 jue2 dui4 bu2 yao4 jia4 gei3 fu4 shang1
cues.en: "Sister, when you get married one day, never marry a rich businessman."

cues.zh: 妹妹心想记得小时候我们常吵架
cues.pinyin: mei4 mei4 xin1 xiang3 ji4 de5 xiao3 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 chang2 chao3 jia4
cues.en: The sister thinks, remembering how they used to fight as kids,

cues.zh: 没想到哥哥竟然这么关心我想保护我
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 ge1 ge1 jing4 ran2 zhe4 me5 guan1 xin1 wo3 xiang3 bao3 hu4 wo3
cues.en: "I never expected my brother to care about me and want to protect me like this."

cues.zh: 哥哥接下去说
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 jie1 xia4 qu4 shuo1
cues.en: The brother continues,

cues.zh: 人家长得那么漂亮
cues.pinyin: ren2 jia1 zhang3 de2 na4 me5 piao4 liang4
cues.en: "Someone that pretty

cues.zh: 都被打得鼻青脸肿
cues.pinyin: dou1 bei4 da3 de2 bi2 qing1 lian3 zhong3
cues.en: still got beaten black and blue.

cues.zh: 你长成这样

cues.zh: 一定会被打死的
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 hui4 bei4 da3 si3 de5

cues.zh: 小小我问你哦
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Little one, let me ask you,

cues.zh: 你知道母鸡的腿为什么这么短吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 mu3 ji1 de5 tui3 wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 duan3 ma5
cues.en: do you know why hens have such short legs?"

cues.zh: 这么短
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duan3
cues.en: "So short?"

cues.zh: 因为母鸡它要下蛋的时候很胖啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mu3 ji1 ta1 yao4 xia4 dan4 de5 shi2 hou4 hen3 pang4 a5
cues.en: "Because hens get really fat when they're about to lay an egg,

cues.zh: 所以短腿会比较稳一点
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 duan3 tui3 hui4 bi3 jiao4 wen3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: so short legs are more stable."

cues.zh: 哦不是耶
cues.pinyin: o2 bu2 shi4 ye2
cues.en: "Oh, that's not it.

cues.zh: 是要是母鸡的腿很长的话
cues.pinyin: shi4 yao4 shi4 mu3 ji1 de5 tui3 hen3 zhang3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If a hen's legs were long,

cues.zh: 下蛋的时候
cues.pinyin: xia4 dan4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when she lays an egg,

cues.zh: 那不就把蛋摔破了吗
cues.pinyin: na4 bu4 jiu4 ba3 dan4 shuai1 po4 le5 ma5
cues.en: wouldn't the egg just break when it drops?"

cues.zh: 上课时老师问小明
cues.pinyin: shang4 ke4 shi2 lao3 shi1 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: In class, the teacher asks Xiaoming,

cues.zh: 小明你家现在一共有几个人啊
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ni3 jia1 xian4 zai4 yi1 gong4 you3 ji3 ge4 ren2 a5
cues.en: "Xiaoming, how many people are in your family right now?"

cues.zh: 有两个爸爸和妈妈
cues.pinyin: you3 liang3 ge4 ba4 ba4 he2 ma1 ma1
cues.en: "There are two — dad and mom."

cues.zh: 加上你不是三个吗
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 ni3 bu2 shi4 san1 ge4 ma5
cues.en: "Adding you, isn't that three?"

cues.zh: 我现在不在家啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian4 zai4 bu4 zai4 jia1 a5
cues.en: "I'm not home right now."

cues.zh: 莎莎我问你喔
cues.pinyin: sha1 sha1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Shasha, let me ask you,

cues.zh: 怎么花力气最大
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hua1 li4 qi4 zui4 da4
cues.en: which flower has the greatest strength?"

cues.zh: 当然是玛莉欧里的那个食人花
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 shi4 ma3 li4 ou1 li3 de5 na4 ge5 shi2 ren2 hua1
cues.en: "Of course it's the man-eating plant from Mario,

cues.zh: 好那我再问你喔

cues.zh: 那怎么花力气最小呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 hua1 li4 qi4 zui4 xiao3 ne5

cues.en: "Oh, that's a good answer too,

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: but no,

cues.zh: 答案是茉莉花
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 mo4 li4 hua1
cues.en: the answer is jasmine."

cues.zh: 为什么

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】GPT-6取得重大数学突破！孪生素数猜想和张益唐的故事

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近数学圈有一个大新闻
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 shu4 xue2 quan1 you3 yi2 ge4 da4 xin1 wen2
cues.en: There's been big news in the math world recently.

cues.zh: Open AI 的大模型 G PD 6
cues.pinyin: Open AI de5 da4 mo2 xing2 G PD 6
cues.en: OpenAI's large language model GPT-6

cues.zh: 在孪生素数猜想方面取得了重大突破
cues.pinyin: zai4 luan2 sheng1 su4 shu4 cai1 xiang3 fang1 mian4 qu3 de2 le5 zhong4 da4 tu1 po4
cues.en: has made a major breakthrough on the twin prime conjecture.

cues.zh: 证明了存在无穷多个相邻素数对
cues.pinyin: zheng4 ming2 liao3 cun2 zai4 wu2 qiong2 duo1 ge4 xiang1 lin2 su4 shu4 dui4
cues.en: It proved that there exist infinitely many pairs of adjacent primes

cues.zh: 他们的间隔不超过 18 6
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 jian4 ge2 bu4 chao1 guo4 18 6
cues.en: whose gap doesn't exceed 186.

cues.zh: 结果一出满座皆惊
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 yi1 chu1 man3 zuo4 jie1 jing1
cues.en: When the result came out, everyone was stunned.

cues.zh: 要知道孪生素数猜想是数论中的重要猜想
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4 luan2 sheng1 su4 shu4 cai1 xiang3 shi4 shu4 lun4 zhong1 de5 zhong4 yao4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: You should know, the twin prime conjecture is an important conjecture in number theory.

cues.zh: 在这里做出重要突破的人是华人
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 zuo4 chu1 zhong4 yao4 tu1 po4 de5 ren2 shi4 hua2 ren2
cues.en: The person who made this key breakthrough is Chinese—

cues.zh: 数学家张益唐
cues.pinyin: shu4 xue2 jia1 zhang1 yi4 tang2
cues.en: mathematician Zhang Yitang.

cues.zh: 他证明了间隔不超过 7 000 万
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng4 ming2 liao3 jian4 ge2 bu4 chao1 guo4 7 000 wan4
cues.en: He proved the gap doesn't exceed 70 million.

cues.zh: 此后由著名数学家陶哲轩领先的团队
cues.pinyin: ci3 hou4 you2 zhu4 ming2 shu4 xue2 jia1 tao2 zhe2 xuan1 ling3 xian1 de5 tuan2 dui4
cues.en: After that, a team led by the famous mathematician Terence Tao

cues.zh: 经过多年的努力把这个间隔上限
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 duo1 nian2 de5 nu3 li4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 jian4 ge2 shang4 xian4
cues.en: spent many years of effort narrowing this gap's upper bound,

cues.zh: 压缩到 24 6
cues.pinyin: ya1 suo1 dao4 24 6
cues.en: compressing it down to 246.

cues.zh: 这一结果保持了很多年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 jie2 guo3 bao3 chi2 le5 hen3 duo1 nian2
cues.en: This result held for many years,

cues.zh: 直到今年的 8 月 31 日
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 jin1 nian2 de5 8 yue4 31 ri4
cues.en: until August 31 of this year,

cues.zh: 28 岁的年轻女数学家施泰德尔曼
cues.pinyin: 28 sui4 de5 nian2 qing1 nv3 shu4 xue2 jia1 shi1 tai4 de2 er3 man4

items.title_zh: 天才医生竟犯下致命失误，孕妇当场死亡！真是太可惜了

cues.zh: 孕妇有生命危险是保大还是保小
cues.pinyin: yun4 fu4 you3 sheng1 ming4 wei1 xian3 shi4 bao3 da4 hai2 shi4 bao3 xiao3
cues.en: When a pregnant woman's life is at risk, do you save the mother or the baby?

cues.zh: 医生的自信却让准妈妈失去生命
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 de5 zi4 xin4 que4 rang4 zhun3 ma1 ma1 shi1 qu4 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: The doctor's overconfidence cost the expectant mother her life.

cues.zh: 医院里来了一对十分恩爱的夫妻
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 li3 lai2 le5 yi1 dui4 shi2 fen1 en1 ai4 de5 fu1 qi1
cues.en: A very loving couple came to the hospital.

cues.zh: 他们即将迎来他们第一个孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ji2 jiang1 ying2 lai2 ta1 men5 di4 yi2 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: They were about to welcome their first child.

cues.zh: 可是准妈妈帕蒂却在产检的时候不
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhun3 ma1 ma1 pa4 di4 que4 zai4 chan3 jian3 de5 shi2 hou4 bu4
cues.en: But during a prenatal checkup, expectant mother Patty unfortunately

cues.zh: 幸发现了肿瘤
cues.pinyin: xing4 fa1 xian4 le5 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: discovered a tumor.

cues.zh: 梅医生接待了他们
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 jie1 dai4 le5 ta1 men5
cues.en: Dr. Mei was the one who saw them.

cues.zh: 这个肿瘤距离子宫的距离太近了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhong3 liu2 ju4 li2 zi5 gong1 de5 ju4 li2 tai4 jin4 le5
cues.en: The tumor was too close to the uterus.

cues.zh: 这对于一个孕妇来说非常危险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dui4 yu2 yi2 ge4 yun4 fu4 lai2 shuo1 fei1 chang2 wei1 xian3
cues.en: This was extremely dangerous for a pregnant woman.

cues.zh: 不过梅医生却信心十足
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 que4 xin4 xin1 shi2 zu2
cues.en: But Dr. Mei was full of confidence.

cues.zh: 他说只要开刀把肿瘤切除
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhi3 yao4 kai1 dao1 ba4 zhong3 liu2 qie1 chu2
cues.en: He said as long as they operated to remove the tumor,

cues.zh: 对孩子毫无影响
cues.pinyin: dui4 hai2 zi5 hao2 wu2 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: it would have no effect on the baby at all.

cues.zh: 顶多三个星期的康复时间
cues.pinyin: ding3 duo1 san1 ge4 xing1 qi1 de5 kang1 fu4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Recovery would take three weeks at most.

cues.zh: 帕蒂又能活蹦乱跳地
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 you4 neng2 huo2 beng4 luan4 tiao4 di4
cues.en: Patty would be back on her feet,

cues.zh: 准备女儿的婴儿房了
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 nv3 er2 de5 ying1 er2 fang2 le5
cues.en: getting the baby girl's nursery ready.

cues.zh: 帕蒂的手术正在进行着
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 de5 shou3 shu4 zheng4 zai4 jin4 xing2 zhe5
cues.en: Patty's surgery was underway.

cues.zh: 医生们打开帕蒂腹腔
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 da3 kai1 pa4 di4 fu4 qiang1
cues.en: The doctors opened up Patty's abdomen.

cues.zh: 首先把肿块和下面的子宫肌层分开
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ba3 zhong3 kuai4 he2 xia4 mian4 de5 zi5 gong1 ji1 ceng2 fen1 kai1
cues.en: First they separated the mass from the uterine muscle layer beneath it.

cues.zh: 可是在手术过程中
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: But during the operation,

cues.zh: 突然发现了一个十分严重的问题
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 le5 yi2 ge4 shi2 fen1 yan2 zhong4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: they suddenly discovered a very serious problem.

cues.zh: 肿瘤不断渗血
cues.pinyin: zhong3 liu2 bu4 duan4 shen4 xue4
cues.en: The tumor kept bleeding.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生竟犯下致命失误，孕妇当场死亡！真是太可惜了

cues.zh: 而且肿瘤把子宫动脉全都包围起来了
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhong3 liu2 ba3 zi5 gong1 dong4 mai4 quan2 dou1 bao1 wei2 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: And it had completely surrounded the uterine artery.

cues.zh: 这样很难在不伤害孩子的前提下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 hen3 nan2 zai4 bu4 shang1 hai4 hai2 zi5 de5 qian2 ti2 xia4
cues.en: This made it very hard to remove the tumor

cues.zh: 切除肿块
cues.pinyin: qie1 chu2 zhong3 kuai4
cues.en: without hurting the baby.

cues.zh: 于是医生们决定先给帕蒂做血管内栓塞术
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 yi1 sheng1 men5 jue2 ding4 xian1 gei3 pa4 di4 zuo4 xue4 guan3 nei4 shuan1 se4 shu4
cues.en: So the doctors decided to first perform an intravascular embolization on Patty

cues.zh: 先把他的内出血止住
cues.pinyin: xian1 ba3 ta1 de5 nei4 chu1 xue4 zhi3 zhu4
cues.en: to stop her internal bleeding,

cues.zh: 然后把肿块切下来做活检
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zhong3 kuai4 qie4 xia4 lai2 zuo4 huo2 jian3
cues.en: then cut out the mass for a biopsy,

cues.zh: 再把腹腔缝合
cues.pinyin: zai4 ba3 fu4 qiang1 feng2 he2
cues.en: and close up the abdomen,

cues.zh: 让胎儿再长两个月
cues.pinyin: rang4 tai1 er2 zai4 zhang3 liang3 ge4 yue4
cues.en: letting the fetus grow for another two months,

cues.zh: 等胎儿可以体外存活以后再一次进行手术
cues.pinyin: deng3 tai1 er2 ke3 yi3 ti3 wai4 cun2 huo2 yi3 hou4 zai4 yi2 ci4 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: until it could survive outside the womb before operating again.

cues.zh: 这个时候就可以把胎儿和肿瘤一起取出来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ba3 tai1 er2 he2 zhong3 liu2 yi4 qi3 qu3 chu1 lai2
cues.en: At that point, they could remove the fetus and the tumor together,

cues.zh: 才能保证手术的成功
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 bao3 zheng4 shou3 shu4 de5 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: which would ensure the surgery's success.

cues.zh: 理想很丰满
cues.pinyin: li3 xiang3 hen3 feng1 man3
cues.en: The ideal plan sounded great,

cues.zh: 现实很骨感
cues.pinyin: xian4 shi2 hen3 gu3 gan3
cues.en: but reality was harsh.

cues.zh: 本来帕蒂的肿瘤活检证明是良性的
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 pa4 di4 de5 zhong3 liu2 huo2 jian3 zheng4 ming2 shi4 liang2 xing4 de5
cues.en: Patty's tumor biopsy actually turned out to be benign,

cues.zh: 并不需要紧急手术
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 xu1 yao4 jin3 ji2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: so emergency surgery wasn't necessary.

cues.zh: 原则上是可以等两个月以后再进行切除的
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ze2 shang4 shi4 ke3 yi3 deng3 liang3 ge4 yue4 yi3 hou4 zai4 jin4 xing2 qie1 chu2 de5
cues.en: In principle, the removal could wait another two months.

cues.zh: 但是当医生老朴跟帕蒂夫妻俩汇
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dang1 yi1 sheng1 lao3 pu3 gen1 pa4 di4 fu1 qi1 lia3 hui4
cues.en: But when Dr. Park was reporting

cues.zh: 报病情的时候
cues.pinyin: bao4 bing4 qing2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: the condition to Patty and her husband,

cues.zh: 帕蒂却突然觉得眼前模糊
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 que4 tu1 ran2 jue2 de5 yan3 qian2 mo2 hu2
cues.en: Patty suddenly felt her vision blur,

cues.zh: 十分难过
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 nan2 guo4
cues.en: and felt very unwell.

cues.zh: 医疗测试仪器也开始报警
cues.pinyin: yi1 liao2 ce4 shi4 yi2 qi4 ye3 kai1 shi3 bao4 jing3
cues.en: The medical monitors also started alarming.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生竟犯下致命失误，孕妇当场死亡！真是太可惜了

cues.zh: 也能更好地控制出血
cues.pinyin: ye3 neng2 geng4 hao3 di4 kong4 zhi4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: It could also control bleeding better.

cues.zh: 这个高级的亚气凝血器
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gao1 ji2 de5 ya4 qi4 ning2 xue4 qi4
cues.en: This advanced argon coagulator

cues.zh: 是利用对人体无害的亚气进行手术
cues.pinyin: shi4 li4 yong4 dui4 ren2 ti3 wu2 hai4 de5 ya4 qi4 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: uses argon gas, which is harmless to the body, during surgery

cues.zh: 降低创免温度
cues.pinyin: jiang4 di1 chuang4 mian3 wen1 du4
cues.en: to lower the temperature of the wound surface.

cues.zh: 比起一般手术的电刀
cues.pinyin: bi3 qi3 yi4 ban1 shou3 shu4 de5 dian4 dao1
cues.en: Compared to the electric scalpel used in ordinary surgery,

cues.zh: 亚气凝血气手术直血更快
cues.pinyin: ya4 qi4 ning2 xue4 qi4 shou3 shu4 zhi2 xue4 geng4 kuai4
cues.en: the argon coagulator stops bleeding faster,

cues.zh: 患者失血更少
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 shi1 xue4 geng4 shao3
cues.en: and patients lose less blood.

cues.zh: 摩根提出的这种手术方案十分大胆
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 ti2 chu1 de5 zhe4 zhong3 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 shi2 fen1 da4 dan3
cues.en: The surgical plan Morgan proposed was very bold.

cues.zh: 老朴觉得很冒险
cues.pinyin: lao3 pu3 jue2 de5 hen3 mao4 xian3
cues.en: Dr. Park thought it was too risky.

cues.zh: 万一大初学止不住了
cues.pinyin: wan4 yi1 da4 chu1 xue2 zhi3 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: If the massive bleeding couldn't be stopped,

cues.zh: 那就是一尸两命啊
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 shi1 liang3 ming4 a5
cues.en: it would mean losing two lives at once.

cues.zh: 可摩根觉得万一成功了
cues.pinyin: ke3 mo2 gen1 jue2 de5 wan4 yi1 cheng2 gong1 le5
cues.en: But Morgan thought that if it succeeded,

cues.zh: 孩子就可以足月生产
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zu2 yue4 sheng1 chan3
cues.en: the baby could be carried to full term,

cues.zh: 帕地的家庭也会因为天使的降
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 de5 jia1 ting2 ye3 hui4 yin1 wei4 tian1 shi3 de5 jiang4
cues.en: and Patty's family would be overjoyed

cues.zh: 临而非常幸福
cues.pinyin: lin2 er2 fei1 chang2 xing4 fu2
cues.en: at the arrival of their little angel.

cues.zh: 梅医生觉得摩根说的对
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 jue2 de5 mo2 gen1 shuo1 de5 dui4
cues.en: Dr. Mei thought Morgan was right.

cues.zh: 这个方法可以试一试
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 ke3 yi3 shi4 yi1 shi4
cues.en: This method was worth trying.

cues.zh: 但是林主任表示这种手术方法太冒险了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 lin2 zhu3 ren4 biao3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 shou3 shu4 fang1 fa3 tai4 mao4 xian3 le5
cues.en: But Dr. Lin said this surgical method was too risky.

cues.zh: 如果是她
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 ta1
cues.en: If it were her,

cues.zh: 她肯定会让帕蒂提前终止认真
cues.pinyin: ta1 ken3 ding4 hui4 rang4 pa4 di4 ti2 qian2 zhong1 zhi3 ren4 zhen1
cues.en: she would definitely have Patty terminate the pregnancy early.

cues.zh: 毕竟孩子没了还能再生一个
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 hai2 zi5 mei2 le5 hai2 neng2 zai4 sheng1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: After all, if the baby is lost, they can have another,

cues.zh: 但是帕蒂没了就什么都没了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 pa4 di4 mei2 le5 jiu4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 le5
cues.en: but if Patty is lost, everything is lost.

cues.zh: 可是梅医生对自己很自信
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 dui4 zi4 ji3 hen3 zi4 xin4
cues.en: But Dr. Mei was very confident in herself.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生竟犯下致命失误，孕妇当场死亡！真是太可惜了

cues.zh: 帕蒂含泪望着梅医生
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 han2 lei4 wang4 zhe5 mei2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Patty looked at Dr. Mei with tears in her eyes.

cues.zh: 她希望梅医生可以挽救他们母女的生命
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 ke3 yi3 wan3 jiu4 ta1 men5 mu3 nv3 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: She hoped Dr. Mei could save both her and her daughter's lives.

cues.zh: 终于到了帕迪上手术台的日子
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 dao4 le5 pa4 di2 shang4 shou3 shu4 tai2 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: Finally the day came for Patty to go into surgery.

cues.zh: 梅医生小心地绕过血管
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 xiao3 xin1 di4 rao4 guo4 xue4 guan3
cues.en: Dr. Mei carefully worked around the blood vessels,

cues.zh: 试图剥离肿瘤
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 bo1 li2 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: trying to separate the tumor.

cues.zh: 可是无论她如何小心
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wu2 lun4 ta1 ru2 he2 xiao3 xin1
cues.en: But no matter how careful she was,

cues.zh: 还是切破了一条血管
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 qie4 po4 le5 yi1 tiao2 xue4 guan3
cues.en: she still cut into a blood vessel.

cues.zh: 那是子宫肚脉血管
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 zi5 gong1 du4 mai4 xue4 guan3
cues.en: It was the uterine artery.

cues.zh: 一时间血流如柱
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 jian1 xue4 liu2 ru2 zhu4
cues.en: In an instant, blood gushed out like a pillar,

cues.zh: 鲜血如喷泉一样地喷出体内
cues.pinyin: xian1 xue4 ru2 pen1 quan2 yi1 yang4 di4 pen1 chu1 ti3 nei4
cues.en: spraying out of her body like a fountain.

cues.zh: 就算紧急输血
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 jin3 ji2 shu1 xue4
cues.en: Even with emergency blood transfusions,

cues.zh: 依然无法挽救帕迪的生命
cues.pinyin: yi1 ran2 wu2 fa3 wan3 jiu4 pa4 di2 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: Patty's life could not be saved.

cues.zh: 大量的出血让帕迪的心脏出现失颤
cues.pinyin: da4 liang4 de5 chu1 xie3 rang4 pa4 di2 de5 xin1 zang4 chu1 xian4 shi1 chan4
cues.en: The massive blood loss caused Patty's heart to go into fibrillation.

cues.zh: 梅医生赶紧准备除颤
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 gan3 jin3 zhun3 bei4 chu2 chan4
cues.en: Dr. Mei quickly prepared to defibrillate.

cues.zh: 一次失败
cues.pinyin: yi1 ci4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: The first attempt failed.

cues.zh: 肾上腺素进退
cues.pinyin: shen4 shang4 xian4 su4 jin4 tui4
cues.en: Epinephrine was administered,

cues.zh: 第二次除颤又失败
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ci4 chu2 chan4 you4 shi1 bai4
cues.en: and the second defibrillation also failed.

cues.zh: 依然无法挽救帕蒂的生命
cues.pinyin: yi1 ran2 wu2 fa3 wan3 jiu4 pa4 di4 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: Patty's heart had already stopped.

cues.zh: 心电图变成一条直线
cues.pinyin: xin1 dian4 tu2 bian4 cheng2 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: The EKG went flat.

cues.zh: 每一生此刻已经无力回天
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 sheng1 ci3 ke4 yi3 jing1 wu2 li4 hui2 tian1
cues.en: At this point, Dr. Mei was powerless to save her.

cues.zh: 尽管他一次次的用电机除颤仪
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 ta1 yi1 ci4 ci4 de5 yong4 dian4 ji1 chu2 chan4 yi2
cues.en: Even though she kept trying to shock her heart with the defibrillator again and again,

cues.zh: 希望可以让帕迪的心脏重新起搏
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ke3 yi3 rang4 pa4 di2 de5 xin1 zang4 chong2 xin1 qi3 bo2
cues.en: hoping to restart Patty's heartbeat,

cues.zh: 肾上腺素跟进
cues.pinyin: shen4 shang4 xian4 su4 gen1 jin4
cues.en: heaven didn't cooperate.

cues.zh: 心电图还是毫无变化
cues.pinyin: xin1 dian4 tu2 hai2 shi4 hao2 wu2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: The EKG showed no change at all.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生竟犯下致命失误，孕妇当场死亡！真是太可惜了

cues.zh: 帕蒂的心脏已经停止工作
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 de5 xin1 zang4 yi3 jing1 ting2 zhi3 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Patty could never be brought back to life.

cues.zh: 不过还好大家发现婴儿的心跳暂时还正常
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hai2 hao3 da4 jia1 fa1 xian4 ying1 er2 de5 xin1 tiao4 zan4 shi2 hai2 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: Fortunately, though, they found the baby's heartbeat was still normal for now,

cues.zh: 便赶紧将婴儿取出
cues.pinyin: bian4 gan3 jin3 jiang1 ying1 er2 qu3 chu1
cues.en: so they quickly delivered the baby

cues.zh: 送到新生儿科
cues.pinyin: song4 dao4 xin1 sheng1 er2 ke1
cues.en: and sent her to the neonatal unit —

cues.zh: 或许还有一丝希望
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 hai2 you3 yi1 si1 xi1 wang4
cues.en: there might still be a glimmer of hope.

cues.zh: 帕迪丈夫得知了妻子的死讯
cues.pinyin: pa4 di2 zhang4 fu1 de2 zhi1 le5 qi1 zi3 de5 si3 xun4
cues.en: Patty's husband learned of his wife's death

cues.zh: 悲痛欲绝
cues.pinyin: bei1 tong4 yu4 jue2
cues.en: and was devastated.

cues.zh: 当她穿着无菌服进入了新生儿重症监护科
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 chuan1 zhe5 wu2 jun1 fu2 jin4 ru4 le5 xin1 sheng1 er2 zhong4 zheng4 jian1 hu4 ke1
cues.en: When he put on sterile scrubs and entered the neonatal ICU

cues.zh: 看着那个幼小的生命
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 na4 ge5 you4 xiao3 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: and looked at that tiny little life,

cues.zh: 一时间百感交集
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 jian1 bai3 gan3 jiao1 ji2
cues.en: he was overwhelmed with mixed emotions.

cues.zh: 这是妻子用生命换来的孩子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 qi1 zi3 yong4 sheng1 ming4 huan4 lai2 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: This was the child his wife had given her life for.

cues.zh: 怕地的死其实本来可以避免的
cues.pinyin: pa4 di4 de5 si3 qi2 shi2 ben3 lai2 ke3 yi3 bi4 mian3 de5
cues.en: Patty's death actually could have been avoided.

cues.zh: 如果早点终止认证
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zao3 dian3 zhong1 zhi3 ren4 zheng4
cues.en: If they had terminated the pregnancy earlier

cues.zh: 将孩子和肿瘤一起取出
cues.pinyin: jiang1 hai2 zi5 he2 zhong3 liu2 yi4 qi3 qu3 chu1
cues.en: and removed the baby along with the tumor,

cues.zh: 她以后还有做母亲的机会
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi3 hou4 hai2 you3 zuo4 mu3 qin1 de5 ji1 hui4

cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 xia1 fang4 jin4 lai2 zhi2 dao4 zha4 dao4 jin1 huang2 se4
cues.en: We add the shrimp in until fried golden

cues.zh: 然后你可以看到这个虾仁的颜
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 ke3 yi3 kan4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 xia1 ren2 de5 yan2
cues.en: Then you can see the shrimp's color

cues.zh: 色呢是这种发
cues.pinyin: se4 ne5 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 fa1
cues.en: turning

cues.zh: 红发橘的颜色
cues.pinyin: hong2 fa1 ju2 de5 yan2 se4
cues.en: a reddish-orange color

cues.zh: 好拿出来之后呢我们把这个虾的油沥干
cues.pinyin: hao3 na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xia1 de5 you2 li4 gan4
cues.en: OK, after taking them out, drain the oil from the shrimp

cues.zh: 把虾仁呢放到一个大的搅拌碗里
cues.pinyin: ba3 xia1 ren2 ne5 fang4 dao4 yi2 ge4 da4 de5 jiao3 ban4 wan3 li3
cues.en: Put the shrimp into a large mixing bowl

cues.zh: 然后我们把我们的酱汁放进来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 jiang4 zhi1 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Then we add our sauce in

cues.zh: 然后也是给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: and mix it well too

cues.zh: 那好啦
cues.pinyin: na4 hao3 la5
cues.en: Alright

cues.zh: 现在我们的核桃虾就基本做完了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 he2 tao2 xia1 jiu4 ji1 ben3 zuo4 wan2 le5
cues.en: Now our walnut shrimp is basically done

cues.zh: 把它摆盘
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 bai3 pan2
cues.en: Plate it up

cues.zh: 真的是超美味的感觉啊
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 chao1 mei3 wei4 de5 gan3 jue2 a5
cues.en: It really feels super delicious

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超赞核桃虾的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 我觉得核桃虾是一道让人吃了会开心的菜
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 he2 tao2 xia1 shi4 yi1 dao4 rang4 ren2 chi1 le5 hui4 kai1 xin1 de5 cai4
cues.en: I think walnut shrimp is a dish that makes people happy when they eat it

cues.zh: 我觉得有一次啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 you3 yi1 ci4 a5
cues.en: I remember once

cues.zh: 我就觉得有点郁闷
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 jue2 de5 you3 dian3 yu4 men4
cues.en: I was feeling a bit down

cues.zh: 然后那一天呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na4 yi1 tian1 ne5
cues.en: And that day

cues.zh: 后来我就跟我朋友去吃饭
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 jiu4 gen1 wo3 peng2 you3 qu4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: I later went out to eat with a friend

cues.zh: 然后我点了一个核桃虾
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 dian3 le5 yi2 ge4 he2 tao2 xia1
cues.en: and I ordered walnut shrimp

cues.zh: 还有干炒牛河
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 gan4 chao3 niu2 he2
cues.en: and also dry-fried beef chow fun

cues.zh: 我朋友点了一些菜
cues.pinyin: wo3 peng2 you3 dian3 le5 yi1 xie1 cai4
cues.en: My friend ordered some dishes

cues.zh: 吃完之后呢
cues.pinyin: chi1 wan2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After eating

cues.zh: 我整个就开心起来了
cues.pinyin: wo3 zheng3 ge4 jiu4 kai1 xin1 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: I became happy overall

cues.zh: 那也请你在下面留言告诉我说
cues.pinyin: na4 ye3 qing3 ni3 zai4 xia4 mian4 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: So please leave a comment below telling me

cues.zh: 有哪一些菜是你吃了会开心的
cues.pinyin: you3 na3 yi1 xie1 cai4 shi4 ni3 chi1 le5 hui4 kai1 xin1 de5
cues.en: which dishes make you happy when you eat them

cues.zh: 那说不定下一次我郁闷起来的时候呢
cues.pinyin: na4 shuo1 bu4 ding4 xia4 yi1 ci4 wo3 yu4 men4 qi3 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: So maybe next time when I'm feeling down

cues.zh: 也可以去尝尝那些菜
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 qu4 chang2 chang2 na4 xie1 cai4
cues.en: I can go try those dishes too

cues.zh: 那别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: na4 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: Don't forget to subscribe and like

cues.zh: 我们下期见哦
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 o2
cues.en: See you next time

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一代传奇女强人：为家人在市中心建楼，8年收藏数量惊人 Legendary Taiwan Female Developer Builds a House in D

cues.zh: 我是台湾少数从事建筑行业的女性
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 tai2 wan1 shao3 shu4 cong2 shi4 jian4 zhu4 hang2 ye4 de5 nv3 xing4
cues.en: I'm one of the few women in Taiwan who work in architecture.

cues.zh: 也是艺术收藏家
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 yi4 shu4 shou1 cang2 jia1
cues.en: I'm also an art collector.

cues.zh: 我出生于台北高中的时候在美国东岸念书
cues.pinyin: wo3 chu1 sheng1 yu2 tai2 bei3 gao1 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 mei3 guo2 dong1 an4 nian4 shu1
cues.en: I was born in Taipei, and during high school I studied on the East Coast of the US.

cues.zh: 19 97 年的时候回来台湾
cues.pinyin: 19 97 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 hui2 lai2 tai2 wan1
cues.en: I came back to Taiwan in 1997.

cues.zh: 跟着父亲从事建筑的行业
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhe5 fu4 qin1 cong2 shi4 jian4 zhu4 de5 hang2 ye4
cues.en: I went into architecture, following my father.

cues.zh: 我成长在一个非常传统的大家庭
cues.pinyin: wo3 cheng2 zhang3 zai4 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 chuan2 tong3 de5 da4 jia1 ting2
cues.en: I grew up in a very traditional extended family.

cues.zh: 我奶奶生了十个孩子
cues.pinyin: wo3 nai3 nai3 sheng1 le5 shi2 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: My grandmother had ten children.

cues.zh: 是非常富贵人家的独生女
cues.pinyin: shi4 fei1 chang2 fu4 gui4 ren2 jia1 de5 du2 sheng1 nv3
cues.en: She was the only daughter of a very wealthy family.

cues.zh: 所以从小我们家所有的东西都是很讲究的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cong2 xiao3 wo3 men5 jia1 suo3 you3 de5 dong1 xi1 dou1 shi4 hen3 jiang3 jiu1 de5
cues.en: So since childhood, everything in our family was done with great care and refinement.

cues.zh: 我们甚至会请人家来家里面唱戏
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shen4 zhi4 hui4 qing3 ren2 jia1 lai2 jia1 li3 mian4 chang4 xi4
cues.en: We'd even have people come to the house to perform opera.

cues.zh: 艺术跟生活一直对我们来讲是息息相关的
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 gen1 sheng1 huo2 yi4 zhi2 dui4 wo3 men5 lai2 jiang3 shi4 xi1 xi1 xiang1 guan1 de5
cues.en: Art and life have always been closely connected for us.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一代传奇女强人：为家人在市中心建楼，8年收藏数量惊人 Legendary Taiwan Female Developer Builds a House in D

cues.zh: 我大学的时候特别喜欢在纽约中央公
cues.pinyin: wo3 da4 xue2 de5 shi2 hou4 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 zai4 niu3 yue1 zhong1 yang1 gong1
cues.en: In college, I especially loved the townhouses near Central Park

cues.zh: 园东岸的房子
cues.pinyin: yuan2 dong1 an4 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: on the East Side in New York.

cues.zh: 第二次世界大战之后的高楼建筑的形式
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ci4 shi4 jie4 da4 zhan4 zhi1 hou4 de5 gao1 lou2 jian4 zhu4 de5 xing2 shi4
cues.en: the style of high-rise buildings after World War II.

cues.zh: 所以我特别商请了耶鲁大学建筑系
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 te4 bie2 shang1 qing3 le5 ye2 lu3 da4 xue2 jian4 zhu4 xi4
cues.en: So I specially invited the Yale School of Architecture's

cues.zh: 的学院的院长
cues.pinyin: de5 xue2 yuan4 de5 yuan4 zhang3
cues.en: dean to help us.

cues.zh: Rob in Stern 来帮我们做这个设计
cues.pinyin: Rob in Stern lai2 bang1 wo3 men5 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 she4 ji4
cues.en: Robert Stern came to help us with the design.

cues.zh: 从规划设计庭院大厅
cues.pinyin: cong2 gui1 hua4 she4 ji4 ting2 yuan4 da4 ting1
cues.en: From planning and designing the courtyard and the hall,

cues.zh: 都是由他亲自为我们设计完成
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 you2 ta1 qin1 zi4 wei4 wo3 men5 she4 ji4 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: everything was personally designed by him for us.

cues.zh: 这个房子有三层楼
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 you3 san1 ceng2 lou2
cues.en: This house has three floors.

cues.zh: 一楼就是公共空间
cues.pinyin: yi1 lou2 jiu4 shi4 gong1 gong4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: The first floor is the shared/common space —

cues.zh: 爸爸妈妈的起居室
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 ma1 ma1 de5 qi3 ju1 shi4
cues.en: my parents' living room,

cues.zh: 餐厅厨房
cues.pinyin: can1 ting1 chu2 fang2
cues.en: the dining room and kitchen.

cues.zh: 二楼是我跟我三个孩子的空间
cues.pinyin: er4 lou2 shi4 wo3 gen1 wo3 san1 ge4 hai2 zi5 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: The second floor is the space for me and my three children.

cues.zh: 三楼是我们的佛堂
cues.pinyin: san1 lou2 shi4 wo3 men5 de5 fo2 tang2
cues.en: The third floor is our Buddhist shrine room,

cues.zh: 书房跟客房
cues.pinyin: shu1 fang2 gen1 ke4 fang2
cues.en: the study, and the guest room.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一代传奇女强人：为家人在市中心建楼，8年收藏数量惊人 Legendary Taiwan Female Developer Builds a House in D

cues.zh: 实际 2015 年的时候
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 2015 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Actually, it was in 2015

cues.zh: 才正式开始收藏的
cues.pinyin: cai2 zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3 shou1 cang2 de5
cues.en: that I formally started collecting art.

cues.zh: 收的速度很快
cues.pinyin: shou1 de5 su4 du4 hen3 kuai4
cues.en: I collected very quickly.

cues.zh: 我不太敢跟你说
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 tai4 gan3 gen1 ni3 shuo1
cues.en: I'm almost embarrassed to tell you.

cues.zh: 你进门会看到鱼籍的食肉
cues.pinyin: ni3 jin4 men2 hui4 kan4 dao4 yu2 ji2 de5 shi2 rou4
cues.en: When you walk in the door, you'll see a fleshy-looking piece.

cues.zh: 看到它
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 ta1
cues.en: When you look at it,

cues.zh: 我联想到女性的身体
cues.pinyin: wo3 lian2 xiang3 dao4 nv3 xing4 de5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: it makes me think of a woman's body.

cues.zh: 右手边
cues.pinyin: you4 shou3 bian1
cues.en: On the right-hand side,

cues.zh: 我们看到了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 kan4 dao4 le5
cues.en: we see

cues.zh: An ne Veronica Young son 的
cues.pinyin: An ne Veronica Young son de5
cues.en: a work by Anne Veronica Janssens —

cues.zh: 金色的京都的竹帘
cues.pinyin: jin1 se4 de5 jing1 du1 de5 zhu2 lian2
cues.en: a golden bamboo curtain from Kyoto.

cues.zh: 在地上的这个是
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 shang4 de5 zhe4 ge5 shi4
cues.en: The one on the floor is

cues.zh: P ier re Hugh 的毛型雕塑
cues.pinyin: P ier re Hugh de5 mao2 xing2 diao1 su4
cues.en: Pierre Huyghe's fur-textured sculpture.

cues.zh: 墙壁上有两幅比较巨幅的
cues.pinyin: qiang2 bi4 shang4 you3 liang3 fu2 bi3 jiao4 ju4 fu2 de5
cues.en: On the wall there are two fairly large pieces.

cues.zh: 电梯进不来
cues.pinyin: dian4 ti1 jin4 bu4 lai2
cues.en: The elevator couldn't fit them,

cues.zh: 要从阳台掉进来
cues.pinyin: yao4 cong2 yang2 tai2 diao4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: so they had to be lowered in through the balcony.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一代传奇女强人：为家人在市中心建楼，8年收藏数量惊人 Legendary Taiwan Female Developer Builds a House in D

cues.zh: 美国的艺术家 Ron nie Hong 来台湾做歌展
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 de5 yi4 shu4 jia1 Ron nie Hong lai2 tai2 wan1 zuo4 ge1 zhan3
cues.en: The American artist Roni Horn came to Taiwan for a solo show.

cues.zh: 他亲自来选件
cues.pinyin: ta1 qin1 zi4 lai2 xuan3 jian4
cues.en: He personally chose the pieces,

cues.zh: 摆设
cues.pinyin: bai3 she4
cues.en: arranged them,

cues.zh: 然后放置
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 zhi4
cues.en: then placed them,

cues.zh: 甚至打光
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 da3 guang1
cues.en: and even did the lighting himself.

cues.zh: 我跟他整整相处了一个礼拜的时间
cues.pinyin: wo3 gen1 ta1 zheng3 zheng3 xiang1 chu3 le5 yi2 ge4 li3 bai4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: I spent an entire week with him.

cues.zh: 他带了一件从来没有展出过的玻璃雕塑
cues.pinyin: ta1 dai4 le5 yi1 jian4 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 zhan3 chu1 guo4 de5 bo1 li2 diao1 su4
cues.en: He brought a glass sculpture that had never been exhibited before.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 如果你只剩下 6 个月可活你会去做什么
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 6 ge4 yue4 ke3 huo2 ni3 hui4 qu4 zuo4 shen2 me5
cues.en: If you had only six months left to live, what would you do?

cues.zh: 安心待在医院忍受病痛折磨接受治疗
cues.pinyin: an1 xin1 dai4 zai4 yi1 yuan4 ren3 shou4 bing4 tong4 zhe2 mo2 jie1 shou4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: Calmly stay in the hospital, endure the suffering, and get treatment

cues.zh: 还是去放纵去狂欢
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 qu4 fang4 zong4 qu4 kuang2 huan1
cues.en: Or go wild and indulge yourself

cues.zh: 哪怕随时面对可能把死期提前的意外
cues.pinyin: na3 pa4 sui2 shi2 mian4 dui4 ke3 neng2 ba3 si3 qi1 ti2 qian2 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: Even if it means risking accidents that could hasten your death

cues.zh: 成功和小丽完成生命大和谐的萧
cues.pinyin: cheng2 gong1 he2 xiao3 li4 wan2 cheng2 sheng1 ming4 da4 he2 xie2 de5 xiao1
cues.en: Shaun, who had successfully reached 'life's great harmony' with Lea,

cues.zh: 恩这天心情舒
cues.pinyin: en1 zhe4 tian1 xin1 qing2 shu1
cues.en: was in a great mood that day

cues.zh: 畅的来上班了
cues.pinyin: chang4 de5 lai2 shang4 ban1 le5
cues.en: and came to work feeling cheerful

cues.zh: 今天的病人是位老大爷
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 bing4 ren2 shi4 wei4 lao3 da4 ye2
cues.en: Today's patient was an elderly man

cues.zh: 这个大爷患了癌症
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 ye2 huan4 le5 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: The old man had cancer

cues.zh: 恶性周围神经鞘肿瘤
cues.pinyin: e4 xing4 zhou1 wei2 shen2 jing1 qiao4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

cues.zh: 现在比较好的治疗方案就是给他接入永
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bi3 jiao4 hao3 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ta1 jie1 ru4 yong3
cues.en: The best treatment option now was to give him a

cues.zh: 久性人工血管
cues.pinyin: jiu3 xing4 ren2 gong1 xue4 guan3
cues.en: permanent artificial vascular port

cues.zh: 可以简化他的化疗流程
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 jian3 hua4 ta1 de5 hua4 liao2 liu2 cheng2
cues.en: to simplify his chemotherapy process

cues.zh: 不需要每次都找静脉
cues.pinyin: bu4 xu1 yao4 mei3 ci4 dou1 zhao3 jing4 mai4
cues.en: so they wouldn't need to find a vein every time

cues.zh: 但这个大爷并不积极
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ge5 da4 ye2 bing4 bu4 ji1 ji2
cues.en: But the old man wasn't keen on it

cues.zh: 长期的病痛折磨让他十分疲惫
cues.pinyin: chang2 qi1 de5 bing4 tong4 zhe2 mo2 rang4 ta1 shi2 fen1 pi2 bei4
cues.en: Long-term suffering had left him exhausted

cues.zh: 这个提议仅仅只能让他
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ti2 yi4 jin3 jin3 zhi3 neng2 rang4 ta1
cues.en: This proposal would only spare him

cues.zh: 免于注射药物时被针扎的那一下而已
cues.pinyin: mian3 yu2 zhu4 she4 yao4 wu4 shi2 bei4 zhen1 zha1 de5 na4 yi1 xia4 er2 yi3
cues.en: from the needle prick when getting injections

cues.zh: 他拒绝了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: He refused

cues.zh: 不仅如此他也不想继续化疗了
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 ru2 ci3 ta1 ye3 bu4 xiang3 ji4 xu4 hua4 liao2 le5
cues.en: Moreover, he no longer wanted to continue chemotherapy

cues.zh: 妻子没能劝住他
cues.pinyin: qi1 zi3 mei2 neng2 quan4 zhu4 ta1
cues.en: His wife couldn't talk him out of it

cues.zh: 丈夫糟糕的情况让他也十分难过
cues.pinyin: zhang4 fu1 zao1 gao1 de5 qing2 kuang4 rang4 ta1 ye3 shi2 fen1 nan2 guo4
cues.en: Her husband's dire condition upset her deeply too

cues.zh: 所以两人出院了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liang3 ren2 chu1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: So the two of them left the hospital

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 这个大爷没过多久就又回来了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 ye2 mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3 jiu4 you4 hui2 lai2 le5
cues.en: Not long after, the old man came back

cues.zh: 不过不是改变主意了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 bu2 shi4 gai3 bian4 zhu3 yi4 le5
cues.en: But not because he'd changed his mind

cues.zh: 而是他在跳伞时摔了一下
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 ta1 zai4 tiao4 san3 shi2 shuai1 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: it was because he'd taken a fall while skydiving

cues.zh: 显然这位知道自己活不过半年的老大爷
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 zhe4 wei4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 huo2 bu4 guo4 ban4 nian2 de5 lao3 da4 ye2
cues.en: Clearly, this old man, who knew he had less than six months to live,

cues.zh: 却放飞自我了
cues.pinyin: que4 fang4 fei1 zi4 wo3 le5
cues.en: had decided to let loose

cues.zh: 只是第一次做极限运动
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 di4 yi1 ci4 zuo4 ji2 xian4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: It was just his first time doing an extreme sport

cues.zh: 技术不太行
cues.pinyin: ji4 shu4 bu4 tai4 xing2
cues.en: and his skills weren't quite there

cues.zh: 不过还好摔得不严重
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hai2 hao3 shuai1 de2 bu4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Luckily the fall wasn't serious

cues.zh: 只需要晚上冰敷一下
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xu1 yao4 wan3 shang4 bing1 fu1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: he just needed to ice it that night

cues.zh: 然后再休息几天就好了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 xiu1 xi1 ji3 tian1 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: and rest for a few days to recover

cues.zh: 大爷一点也不想遵守医嘱
cues.pinyin: da4 ye2 yi4 dian3 ye3 bu4 xiang3 zun1 shou3 yi1 zhu3
cues.en: The old man had no intention of following doctor's orders

cues.zh: 他还有很多事情要做
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 shi4 qing2 yao4 zuo4
cues.en: He still had a lot to do

cues.zh: 还让医生给自己接种了热带病疫苗
cues.pinyin: hai2 rang4 yi1 sheng1 gei3 zi4 ji3 jie1 zhong3 le5 re4 dai4 bing4 yi4 miao2
cues.en: He even had the doctor give him tropical disease vaccines

cues.zh: 他想搬到天气好的地方去
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 ban1 dao4 tian1 qi4 hao3 de5 di4 fang1 qu4
cues.en: He wanted to move somewhere with good weather

cues.zh: 比如哥斯达利家
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ge1 si1 da2 li4 jia1
cues.en: like Costa Rica

cues.zh: 好好享受自己剩下的时光
cues.pinyin: hao3 hao3 xiang3 shou4 zi4 ji3 sheng4 xia4 de5 shi2 guang1
cues.en: to fully enjoy the time he had left

cues.zh: 第三次了大爷又来了
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ci4 le5 da4 ye2 you4 lai2 le5
cues.en: For the third time, the old man was back

cues.zh: 他穿了一身亮黄色的西装
cues.pinyin: ta1 chuan1 le5 yi1 shen1 liang4 huang2 se4 de5 xi1 zhuang1
cues.en: He was wearing a bright yellow suit

cues.zh: 看起来不伦不类
cues.pinyin: kan4 qi3 lai2 bu4 lun2 bu4 lei4
cues.en: which looked rather out of place

cues.zh: 更重要的是脑袋上还带着伤
cues.pinyin: geng4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4 nao3 dai4 shang4 hai2 dai4 zhe5 shang1
cues.en: More importantly, he had an injury on his head

cues.zh: 依旧是妻子陪在他身边
cues.pinyin: yi1 jiu4 shi4 qi1 zi3 pei2 zai4 ta1 shen1 bian1
cues.en: His wife was still by his side

cues.zh: 大爷取出了银行账户上所有的钱
cues.pinyin: da4 ye2 qu3 chu1 le5 yin2 hang2 zhang4 hu4 shang4 suo3 you3 de5 qian2
cues.en: The old man withdrew all the money from his bank account

cues.zh: 买了一辆新车开出门
cues.pinyin: mai3 le5 yi1 liang4 xin1 che1 kai1 chu1 men2
cues.en: bought a new car, and drove off

cues.zh: 回来时觉得头晕眼花胃不舒服
cues.pinyin: hui2 lai2 shi2 jue2 de5 tou2 yun1 yan3 hua1 wei4 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: On the way back he felt dizzy and nauseous

cues.zh: 然后就晕了过去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 yun1 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and then passed out

cues.zh: 撞伤了自己的头
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 shang1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 tou2
cues.en: hitting and injuring his head

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 治疗过程很痛苦
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liao2 guo4 cheng2 hen3 tong4 ku3
cues.en: The treatment process was painful

cues.zh: 但是操作起来十分简单
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 cao1 zuo4 qi3 lai2 shi2 fen1 jian3 dan1
cues.en: but quite simple to perform

cues.zh: 聊天过程中
cues.pinyin: liao2 tian1 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: During the conversation

cues.zh: 大中意外发现
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 yi4 wai4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Dr. Park unexpectedly noticed

cues.zh: 大爷的脖子活动度看起来很好
cues.pinyin: da4 ye2 de5 bo2 zi5 huo2 dong4 du4 kan4 qi3 lai2 hen3 hao3
cues.en: that the old man's neck mobility looked quite good

cues.zh: 但是之前因为癌症
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhi1 qian2 yin1 wei4 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: But hadn't his cancer before

cues.zh: 他不是一直肌肉就有问题吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 shi4 yi4 zhi2 ji1 rou4 jiu4 you3 wen4 ti2 ma5
cues.en: been causing him muscle problems all along?

cues.zh: 大钟把这点记下来
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 ba3 zhe4 dian3 ji4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Dr. Park made a note of this

cues.zh: 还得继续做检查
cues.pinyin: hai2 de2 ji4 xu4 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: and said more tests were needed

cues.zh: 另有所有人惊喜的是
cues.pinyin: ling4 you3 suo3 you3 ren2 jing1 xi3 de5 shi4
cues.en: To everyone's surprise,

cues.zh: 最近凭着大爷不懈努力
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 ping2 zhe5 da4 ye2 bu4 xie4 nu3 li4
cues.en: thanks to the old man's relentless efforts recently,

cues.zh: 霍霍自己耳朵的感染侵入了肿瘤
cues.pinyin: huo4 huo4 zi4 ji3 er3 duo3 de5 gan3 ran3 qin1 ru4 le5 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: an ear infection of his had spread into the tumor

cues.zh: 然后被他的免疫系统发现了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 bei4 ta1 de5 mian3 yi4 xi4 tong3 fa1 xian4 le5
cues.en: and his immune system had detected it

cues.zh: 这意味着他也许不用死了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 ta1 ye3 xu3 bu4 yong4 si3 le5
cues.en: which meant he might not have to die after all

cues.zh: 因为肿瘤严重的点
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhong3 liu2 yan2 zhong4 de5 dian3
cues.en: Because the dangerous thing about the tumor

cues.zh: 就在于他能避开免疫系统
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 yu2 ta1 neng2 bi4 kai1 mian3 yi4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: was that it could evade the immune system

cues.zh: 但是现在情况已经改变了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xian4 zai4 qing2 kuang4 yi3 jing1 gai3 bian4 le5
cues.en: But now the situation had changed

cues.zh: 他的肿瘤已经缩小到可以手术切除了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhong3 liu2 yi3 jing1 suo1 xiao3 dao4 ke3 yi3 shou3 shu4 qie1 chu2 le5
cues.en: His tumor had shrunk enough to be surgically removed

cues.zh: 一旦感染在他体内完全清除
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 gan3 ran3 zai4 ta1 ti3 nei4 wan2 quan2 qing1 chu2
cues.en: Once the infection was fully cleared from his body

cues.zh: 就可以预定手术了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 yu4 ding4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: surgery could be scheduled

cues.zh: 感染并不严重
cues.pinyin: gan3 ran3 bing4 bu4 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: The infection wasn't serious

cues.zh: 大爷现在可以回家了
cues.pinyin: da4 ye2 xian4 zai4 ke3 yi3 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: so the old man could go home now

cues.zh: 这个消息让大爷有些懵
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao1 xi1 rang4 da4 ye2 you3 xie1 meng3
cues.en: The news left the old man a bit stunned

cues.zh: 自己竟然可以活下去了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 jing4 ran2 ke3 yi3 huo2 xia4 qu4 le5
cues.en: that he could actually go on living after all

cues.zh: 可是出了医院
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 chu1 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: But once outside the hospital

cues.zh: 坐在门口的站牌下
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 men2 kou3 de5 zhan4 pai2 xia4
cues.en: sitting under the bus sign by the entrance

cues.zh: 他却有些茫然
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 you3 xie1 mang2 ran2
cues.en: he felt a bit lost

cues.zh: 他的妻子离开了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qi1 zi3 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: His wife had left him

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 所以他现在这样也很快乐
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xian4 zai4 zhe4 yang4 ye3 hen3 kuai4 le4
cues.en: so even with his life saved, he wasn't happy now

cues.zh: 不过这个病人比他想象中的还要偏执
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 bing4 ren2 bi3 ta1 xiang3 xiang4 zhong1 de5 hai2 yao4 pian1 zhi2
cues.en: But this patient was even more stubborn than he'd expected

cues.zh: 迎客死亡也不愿意放弃创作
cues.pinyin: ying2 ke4 si3 wang2 ye3 bu4 yuan4 yi4 fang4 qi4 chuang4 zuo4
cues.en: She'd rather die than give up creating art

cues.zh: 病人出了轮输的办公室后
cues.pinyin: bing4 ren2 chu1 le5 lun2 shu1 de5 ban4 gong1 shi4 hou4
cues.en: After the patient left the consultation room

cues.zh: 遇到了黄姐和布朗
cues.pinyin: yu4 dao4 le5 huang2 jie3 he2 bu4 lang3
cues.en: she ran into Dr. Huang and Browne

cues.zh: 她很惊喜地和黄姐拥抱
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 jing1 xi3 di4 he2 huang2 jie3 yong1 bao4
cues.en: and happily hugged Dr. Huang

cues.zh: 但是黄姐好像并没有多开心
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 huang2 jie3 hao3 xiang4 bing4 mei2 you3 duo1 kai1 xin1
cues.en: but Dr. Huang didn't seem too pleased

cues.zh: 宁愿死亡也不愿意放弃创作
cues.pinyin: ning4 yuan4 si3 wang2 ye3 bu4 yuan4 yi4 fang4 qi4 chuang4 zuo4
cues.en: It turned out the patient was Dr. Huang's mother

cues.zh: 只是两个人关系一直不好
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 liang3 ge4 ren2 guan1 xi4 yi4 zhi2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: the two of them just had a long history of a poor relationship

cues.zh: 妈妈是著名的绘画家
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 hui4 hua4 jia1
cues.en: Her mother was a famous painter

cues.zh: 哥哥是雕塑家
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 shi4 diao1 su4 jia1
cues.en: her brother was a sculptor

cues.zh: 弟弟是作曲家
cues.pinyin: di4 di5 shi4 zuo4 qu3 jia1
cues.en: and her younger brother was a composer

cues.zh: 从小到大
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 dao4 da4
cues.en: Growing up

cues.zh: 亲人的光环在影响着她
cues.pinyin: qin1 ren2 de5 guang1 huan2 zai4 ying3 xiang3 zhe5 ta1
cues.en: she'd always lived in her family's shadow

cues.zh: 在艺术方面没有天赋
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi4 shu4 fang1 mian4 mei2 you3 tian1 fu4
cues.en: having no talent in art herself

cues.zh: 长大后成为医生的黄姐
cues.pinyin: zhang3 da4 hou4 cheng2 wei2 yi1 sheng1 de5 huang2 jie3
cues.en: Dr. Huang, who became a doctor as an adult,

cues.zh: 在这个家格格不入
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 jia1 ge2 ge2 bu4 ru4
cues.en: never quite fit into this family

cues.zh: 加上她单方面的厌情情趣
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 ta1 dan1 fang1 mian4 de5 yan4 qing2 qing2 qu4
cues.en: and on top of that, her own one-sided resentment toward it

cues.zh: 所以她和家人的关系一直不好
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 he2 jia1 ren2 de5 guan1 xi4 yi4 zhi2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: so her relationship with her family had always been poor

cues.zh: 妈妈和布朗聊着正性
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 he2 bu4 lang3 liao2 zhe5 zheng4 xing4
cues.en: While her mother was chatting with Browne about her condition,

cues.zh: 却突然倒在地上
cues.pinyin: que4 tu1 ran2 dao3 zai4 di4 shang4
cues.en: she suddenly collapsed

cues.zh: 她被推进了手术室
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 tui1 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: and was rushed into the operating room

cues.zh: 黄妈妈脑中出血
cues.pinyin: huang2 ma1 ma1 nao3 zhong1 chu1 xie3
cues.en: Mrs. Huang had bleeding in her brain

cues.zh: 医生把她吸抽病情里凝块枪
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 ta1 xi1 chou1 bing4 qing2 li3 ning2 kuai4 qiang1
cues.en: Doctors used suction to remove the blood clots from her brain

cues.zh: 不过她脑中到处都是海绵状
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 nao3 zhong1 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 hai3 mian2 zhuang4
cues.en: But her brain was riddled with cavernous

cues.zh: 血管激情
cues.pinyin: xue4 guan3 ji1 qing2
cues.en: vascular malformations

cues.zh: 妈妈和布朗聊着病情
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 he2 bu4 lang3 liao2 zhe5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: and she faced the risk of massive bleeding at any moment

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 黄姐这时才知道妈妈的病情
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 zhe4 shi2 cai2 zhi1 dao4 ma1 ma1 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: Only then did Dr. Huang learn of her mother's condition

cues.zh: 她在病房陪同时一直出言讽刺
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 bing4 fang2 pei2 tong2 shi2 yi4 zhi2 chu1 yan2 feng3 ci4
cues.en: While keeping her company in the ward, she kept making snide remarks

cues.zh: 但妈妈好像丝毫不介意
cues.pinyin: dan4 ma1 ma1 hao3 xiang4 si1 hao2 bu4 jie4 yi4
cues.en: but her mother didn't seem to mind at all

cues.zh: 只是没过多久
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: But not long after

cues.zh: 妈妈就自己出院了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 jiu4 zi4 ji3 chu1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: her mother discharged herself from the hospital

cues.zh: 并没有告诉黄姐
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 gao4 su4 huang2 jie3
cues.en: without telling Dr. Huang

cues.zh: 生气又担心的黄姐找到了妈妈的住处
cues.pinyin: sheng1 qi4 you4 dan1 xin1 de5 huang2 jie3 zhao3 dao4 le5 ma1 ma1 de5 zhu4 chu4
cues.en: Angry and worried, Dr. Huang went to find her mother's place

cues.zh: 想和她聊聊病情
cues.pinyin: xiang3 he2 ta1 liao2 liao2 bing4 qing2
cues.en: wanting to talk to her about her condition

cues.zh: 但被拒绝了
cues.pinyin: dan4 bei4 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but was turned away

cues.zh: 这时黄姐的哥哥从楼上下来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 huang2 jie3 di1 ge1 ge1 cong2 lou2 shang4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Just then, Dr. Huang's brother came down from upstairs

cues.zh: 两人言语针锋相对
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 yan2 yu3 zhen1 feng1 xiang1 dui4
cues.en: and the two of them exchanged sharp words

cues.zh: 黄姐很生气
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 hen3 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: Dr. Huang was furious

cues.zh: 她没有告诉自己妈妈病情的事情
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 gao4 su4 zi4 ji3 ma1 ma1 bing4 qing2 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: that he hadn't told her about their mother's condition

cues.zh: 哥哥也不喜欢这个对自己家没有
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 ye3 bu4 xi3 huan1 zhe4 ge5 dui4 zi4 ji3 jia1 mei2 you3
cues.en: Her brother, in turn, didn't like this sister who had no

cues.zh: 归属感的妹妹
cues.pinyin: gui1 shu3 gan3 de5 mei4 mei4
cues.en: sense of belonging to the family

cues.zh: 他们正扯着
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zheng4 che3 zhe5
cues.en: As they were arguing

cues.zh: 突然听到嘶嘶一声
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 ting1 dao4 si1 si1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: they suddenly heard a hissing sound

cues.zh: 哥哥脸上溅满了血滴
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 lian3 shang4 jian4 man3 le5 xue4 di1
cues.en: and the brother's face was splattered with blood

cues.zh: 转头看去
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 tou2 kan4 qu4
cues.en: Turning around

cues.zh: 妈妈呆呆地站在原地
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 dai1 dai1 di4 zhan4 zai4 yuan2 di4
cues.en: their mother stood frozen in place

cues.zh: 他突然发作了综合性局部癫痫
cues.pinyin: ta1 tu1 ran2 fa1 zuo4 le5 zong1 he2 xing4 ju2 bu4 dian1 xian2
cues.en: She'd suddenly had a complex partial seizure

cues.zh: 电动料理刀把手指都切断了
cues.pinyin: dian4 dong4 liao4 li3 dao1 ba4 shou3 zhi3 dou1 qie1 duan4 le5
cues.en: and the electric kitchen knife had cut off her fingers

cues.zh: 兄妹俩立刻把妈妈送到医院
cues.pinyin: xiong1 mei4 lia3 li4 ke4 ba3 ma1 ma1 song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: The siblings immediately rushed their mother to the hospital

cues.zh: 并带上她的断指给她做了手术
cues.pinyin: bing4 dai4 shang4 ta1 de5 duan4 zhi3 gei3 ta1 zuo4 le5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: bringing her severed fingers along for surgery

cues.zh: 协助手术的香恩突发习想
cues.pinyin: xie2 zhu4 shou3 shu4 de5 xiang1 en1 tu1 fa1 xi2 xiang3
cues.en: Shaun, who was assisting with the surgery, suddenly had an idea

cues.zh: 如果癫痫并不是海绵状血管进行引起的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dian1 xian2 bing4 bu2 shi4 hai3 mian2 zhuang4 xue4 guan3 jin4 xing2 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: What if the seizures weren't caused by the cavernous malformation

cues.zh: 而是出血呢
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 chu1 xie3 ne5
cues.en: but by bleeding instead?

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】生命只剩下六个月，老人选择不断放纵自己，妻子都离开了他，然而结果病却全好了！

cues.zh: 只需要切掉一块脑组织就可以了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xu1 yao4 qie4 diao4 yi1 kuai4 nao3 zu3 zhi1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: Then they'd only need to remove a small piece of brain tissue

cues.zh: 直接定向到畸形位置
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 ding4 xiang4 dao4 ji1 xing2 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: targeting the malformation directly

cues.zh: 这样不会影响妈妈的创作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 bu2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 ma1 ma1 de5 chuang4 zuo4
cues.en: This way it wouldn't affect their mother's ability to paint

cues.zh: 但是伦书否定了这个方案
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 lun2 shu1 fou3 ding4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 an4
cues.en: But Dr. Lun rejected the plan

cues.zh: 从来没有人用这个技术治疗过脑海
cues.pinyin: cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 ren2 yong4 zhe4 ge5 ji4 shu4 zhi4 liao2 guo4 nao3 hai3
cues.en: No one had ever used this technique to treat cerebral

cues.zh: 绵状血管畸形
cues.pinyin: mian2 zhuang4 xue4 guan3 ji1 xing2
cues.en: cavernous malformations

cues.zh: 而且操作起来十分严格
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 cao1 zuo4 qi3 lai2 shi2 fen1 yan2 ge2
cues.en: and the procedure required extreme precision

cues.zh: 只要一处基因没有精准定位
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 yi1 chu4 ji1 yin1 mei2 you3 jing1 zhun3 ding4 wei4
cues.en: If even one spot wasn't precisely located
