items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有一则新闻刷爆了互联网
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 yi1 ze2 xin1 wen2 shua1 bao4 le5 hu4 lian2 wang3
cues.en: Recently a piece of news went viral on the internet.

cues.zh: 说是加拿大的科学家发现了快速射电暴 FRB
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shi4 jia1 na2 da4 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 fa1 xian4 le5 kuai4 su4 she4 dian4 bao4 FRB
cues.en: It said Canadian scientists discovered a Fast Radio Burst (FRB)

cues.zh: B 的重复信号
cues.pinyin: B de5 chong2 fu4 xin4 hao4
cues.en: with a repeating signal.

cues.zh: 有人就说这就是外星人向我们招手
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 jiu4 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 wai4 xing1 ren2 xiang4 wo3 men5 zhao1 shou3
cues.en: Some people said this is aliens waving to us.

cues.zh: 有小朋友问我说外星人到底存在不存在呢
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 wai4 xing1 ren2 dao4 di3 cun2 zai4 bu4 cun2 zai4 ne5
cues.en: A kid asked me whether aliens actually exist.

cues.zh: 今天我们就来讨论一个有关外星人的话题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi2 ge4 you3 guan1 wai4 xing1 ren2 de5 hua4 ti2
cues.en: Today we're going to discuss a topic about aliens

cues.zh: 叫做费米悖论
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 fei4 mi3 bei4 lun4
cues.en: called the Fermi Paradox.

cues.zh: 为了讨论费米悖论
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tao3 lun4 fei4 mi3 bei4 lun4
cues.en: In order to discuss the Fermi Paradox,

cues.zh: 我们首先先来介绍一下费米这个人
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 fei4 mi3 zhe4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: let's first introduce the man, Fermi.

cues.zh: 费米是一个意大利的物理学家
cues.pinyin: fei4 mi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 yi4 da4 li4 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Fermi was an Italian physicist,

cues.zh: 而且绝对是 20 世纪物理学家中
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 jue2 dui4 shi4 20 shi4 ji4 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: and definitely one of the

cues.zh: 扛把子的角色
cues.pinyin: kang2 ba3 zi5 de5 jue2 se4
cues.en: top dogs among 20th-century physicists.

cues.zh: 费米他提出了很多的理论
cues.pinyin: fei4 mi3 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: Fermi proposed many theories,

cues.zh: 比如说像费米狄拉克统计
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 xiang4 fei4 mi3 di2 la1 ke4 tong3 ji4
cues.en: such as Fermi-Dirac statistics,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 还有他提出了中微子的模型
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 zhong1 wei1 zi5 de5 mo2 xing2
cues.en: and he also proposed the neutrino model.

cues.zh: 再比如说他提出若相互作用的理论
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 ti2 chu1 ruo4 xiang1 hu4 zuo4 yong4 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: He also proposed the theory of the weak interaction,

cues.zh: 若相互作用的理论
cues.pinyin: ruo4 xiang1 hu4 zuo4 yong4 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: the weak interaction theory,

cues.zh: 等等一些理论
cues.pinyin: deng3 deng3 yi1 xie1 li3 lun4
cues.en: and so on.

cues.zh: 都为未来的物理学发展铺平了道路
cues.pinyin: dou1 wei4 wei4 lai2 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 fa1 zhan3 pu1 ping2 le5 dao4 lu4
cues.en: All of these paved the way for the future development of physics.

cues.zh: 他还参加了美国的这个原子弹计划
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 can1 jia1 le5 mei3 guo2 de5 zhe4 ge5 yuan2 zi3 dan4 ji4 hua4
cues.en: He also took part in America's atomic bomb program,

cues.zh: 就是曼哈顿计划
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 man4 ha1 dun4 ji4 hua4
cues.en: the Manhattan Project.

cues.zh: 他跟奥本海默并称为原子弹之父
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ao4 ben3 hai3 mo4 bing4 cheng1 wei4 yuan2 zi3 dan4 zhi1 fu4
cues.en: He and Oppenheimer are jointly called the fathers of the atomic bomb.

cues.zh: 另外他还培养了很多优秀的学生
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 ta1 hai2 pei2 yang3 le5 hen3 duo1 you1 xiu4 de5 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: He also trained many outstanding students.

cues.zh: 他的学生里边得诺贝尔奖的就有六个
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xue2 sheng1 li3 bian1 de2 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3 de5 jiu4 you3 liu4 ge4
cues.en: Six of his students went on to win the Nobel Prize,

cues.zh: 包括我们熟知的李正道和杨振宁
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 wo3 men5 shu2 zhi1 de5 li3 zheng4 dao4 he2 yang2 zhen4 ning2
cues.en: including the famous Tsung-Dao Lee and Chen-Ning Yang,

cues.zh: 都是这个费米的学生
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 zhe4 ge5 fei4 mi3 de5 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: who were both students of Fermi.

cues.zh: 所以费米是跟爱因斯坦一个级
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 fei4 mi3 shi4 gen1 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 yi2 ge4 ji2
cues.en: So Fermi is on the same level

cues.zh: 别的物理学家
cues.pinyin: bie2 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: as Einstein among physicists.

cues.zh: 那么费米他特别有意思的一点是在于
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 fei4 mi3 ta1 te4 bie2 you3 yi4 si5 de5 yi4 dian3 shi4 zai4 yu2
cues.en: What's especially interesting about Fermi is

cues.zh: 他特别喜欢用一些快速的估算方法
cues.pinyin: ta1 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 yong4 yi1 xie1 kuai4 su4 de5 gu1 suan4 fang1 fa3
cues.en: he really liked using quick estimation methods

cues.zh: 来计算一些复杂的问题
cues.pinyin: lai2 ji4 suan4 yi1 xie1 fu4 za2 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: to calculate complicated problems.

cues.zh: 比如说在 19 50 年有一次
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zai4 19 50 nian2 you3 yi1 ci4
cues.en: For example, once in 1950

cues.zh: 他跟几个科学家一起吃饭
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ji3 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1 yi4 qi3 chi1 fan4
cues.en: he was having a meal with a few scientists,

cues.zh: 吃完了午饭之后讨论外星人的问题
cues.pinyin: chi1 wan2 le5 wu3 fan4 zhi1 hou4 tao3 lun4 wai4 xing1 ren2 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and after lunch they discussed the question of aliens.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 这 1000 亿个星系每一个星系都像银
cues.pinyin: zhe4 1000 yi4 ge4 xing1 xi4 mei3 yi2 ge4 xing1 xi4 dou1 xiang4 yin2
cues.en: There are 100 billion galaxies, and if every galaxy is like

cues.zh: 河系那样是吧
cues.pinyin: he2 xi4 na4 yang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: the Milky Way, right,

cues.zh: 那么每一个星系里边有多少个恒星呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 mei3 yi2 ge4 xing1 xi4 li3 bian1 you3 duo1 shao3 ge4 heng2 xing1 ne5
cues.en: then how many stars are there in each galaxy?

cues.zh: 就估计有 1000 亿到 1 万亿个
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gu1 ji4 you3 1000 yi4 dao4 1 wan4 yi4 ge4
cues.en: Estimated to be 100 billion to 1 trillion.

cues.zh: 咱们保守估计每一个星系里边
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 bao3 shou3 gu1 ji4 mei3 yi2 ge4 xing1 xi4 li3 bian1
cues.en: Let's conservatively estimate that in each galaxy

cues.zh: 有 1000 亿个恒星
cues.pinyin: you3 1000 yi4 ge4 heng2 xing1
cues.en: there are 100 billion stars.

cues.zh: 有 1000 亿个恒星
cues.pinyin: you3 1000 yi4 ge4 heng2 xing1
cues.en: 100 billion stars.

cues.zh: 但是这些恒星不都像太阳一样
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 xie1 heng2 xing1 bu4 dou1 xiang4 tai4 yang2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: But not all these stars are like the sun.

cues.zh: 如果这个恒星质量太大的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 heng2 xing1 zhi4 liang4 tai4 da4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If a star's mass is too large,

cues.zh: 那么它的寿命就比较短不足以产生生命
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 shou4 ming4 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 duan3 bu4 zu2 yi3 chan3 sheng1 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: then its lifespan is too short to produce life.

cues.zh: 如果这个恒星质量太小
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 heng2 xing1 zhi4 liang4 tai4 xiao3
cues.en: If a star's mass is too small,

cues.zh: 发的光又比较弱而且不稳定
cues.pinyin: fa1 de5 guang1 you4 bi3 jiao4 ruo4 er2 qie3 bu4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: the light it emits is too weak and unstable.

cues.zh: 所以只有像太阳那么大差不多的恒星
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhi3 you3 xiang4 tai4 yang2 na4 me5 da4 cha4 bu5 duo1 de5 heng2 xing1
cues.en: So only stars about the size of the sun

cues.zh: 才能够产生生命
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 gou4 chan3 sheng1 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: can produce life.

cues.zh: 那这样的话比例有多少
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4 bi3 li4 you3 duo1 shao3
cues.en: So what's that proportion?

cues.zh: 咱们再保守估计壹点
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 zai4 bao3 shou3 gu1 ji4 yi1 dian3
cues.en: Let's be conservative again a bit.

cues.zh: 科学家估计是 5 到 20
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 jia1 gu1 ji4 shi4 5 dao4 20
cues.en: Scientists estimate it's 5 to 20 percent.

cues.zh: 咱们估计个 1
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 gu1 ji4 ge4 1
cues.en: Let's just estimate 1 percent.

cues.zh: 这 1 是像太阳壹样的恒星
cues.pinyin: zhe4 1 shi4 xiang4 tai4 yang2 yi1 yang4 de5 heng2 xing1
cues.en: That 1 percent are stars like the sun.

cues.zh: 每壹个像太阳壹样的恒星都会
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 ge4 xiang4 tai4 yang2 yi1 yang4 de5 heng2 xing1 du1 hui4
cues.en: Every sun-like star will

cues.zh: 有壹个小星系
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 ge4 xiao3 xing1 xi4
cues.en: have a small planetary system.

cues.zh: 而这个小星系里边就会有一些
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 xing1 xi4 li3 bian1 jiu4 hui4 you3 yi1 xie1
cues.en: And in that small system there will be

cues.zh: 行星围绕它转
cues.pinyin: xing2 xing1 wei2 rao4 ta1 zhuan3
cues.en: planets orbiting it.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 这个就是能够产生高文明生命的这个数量
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 neng2 gou4 chan3 sheng1 gao1 wen2 ming2 sheng1 ming4 de5 zhe4 ge5 shu4 liang4
cues.en: This is the number that can produce advanced civilizations.

cues.zh: 把它们都乘起来大概有多少呢
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 dou1 cheng2 qi3 lai2 da4 gai4 you3 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: If we multiply all these together, how many is that?

cues.zh: 大概有十的十四次方个
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 you3 shi2 de5 shi2 si4 ci4 fang1 ge4
cues.en: About 10 to the 14th power,

cues.zh: 也就是一百万亿个
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 yi4 bai3 wan4 yi4 ge4
cues.en: which is 100 trillion.

cues.zh: 也就是说理论上讲外星人在全宇宙中
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 li3 lun4 shang4 jiang3 wai4 xing1 ren2 zai4 quan2 yu3 zhou4 zhong1
cues.en: In other words, theoretically, among aliens in the entire universe

cues.zh: 应该有 100 万亿个文明
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 you3 100 wan4 yi4 ge4 wen2 ming2
cues.en: there should be 100 trillion civilizations,

cues.zh: 至少应该有这么多对不对
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 ying1 gai1 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: there should be at least that many, right?

cues.zh: 那有同学可能会说那这些文明也许真的有
cues.pinyin: na4 you3 tong2 xue2 ke3 neng2 hui4 shuo1 na4 zhe4 xie1 wen2 ming2 ye3 xu3 zhen1 de5 you3
cues.en: Some students might say maybe these civilizations really exist,

cues.zh: 但是因为宇宙太大了我们没接触上对吧
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 yu3 zhou4 tai4 da4 le5 wo3 men5 mei2 jie1 chu4 shang4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: but because the universe is too big, we haven't made contact, right?

cues.zh: 这个也不行为什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ye3 bu4 xing2 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: That doesn't work either, why?

cues.zh: 因为我们哪怕就考虑银河系
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 na3 pa4 jiu4 kao3 lv4 yin2 he2 xi4
cues.en: Because even just considering the Milky Way,

cues.zh: 我们知道有 1000 亿个像银河系这样的星系
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 you3 1000 yi4 ge4 xiang4 yin2 he2 xi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 xing1 xi4
cues.en: we know there are 100 billion galaxies like the Milky Way.

cues.zh: 如果我们把这个文明数量除以 1000 亿
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 wen2 ming2 shu4 liang4 chu2 yi3 1000 yi4
cues.en: If we divide the number of civilizations by 100 billion,

cues.zh: 那就是在银河系里边应该有多
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 zai4 yin2 he2 xi4 li3 bian1 ying1 gai1 you3 duo1
cues.en: that gives how many civilizations

cues.zh: 少个文明对吧
cues.pinyin: shao3 ge4 wen2 ming2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: there should be in the Milky Way, right?

cues.zh: 我们估算也会有 1000 个以上的高等文明对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gu1 suan4 ye3 hui4 you3 1000 ge4 yi3 shang4 de5 gao1 deng3 wen2 ming2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: We estimate there would be more than 1000 advanced civilizations, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 甚至美国有一个绿岸天文台
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 mei3 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 lv4 an4 tian1 wen2 tai2
cues.en: There's even an observatory in America called the Green Bank Observatory,

cues.zh: 美国国家射箭天文台绿岸天文台
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 guo2 jia1 she4 jian4 tian1 wen2 tai2 lv4 an4 tian1 wen2 tai2
cues.en: the US National Radio Astronomy Observatory's Green Bank Observatory.

cues.zh: 它也是三体里边那个红岸天文台的原型
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shi4 san1 ti3 li3 bian1 na4 ge5 hong2 an4 tian1 wen2 tai2 de5 yuan2 xing2
cues.en: It's also the prototype of the Red Coast Observatory in "The Three-Body Problem."

cues.zh: 这个绿岸天文台有一个科学家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lv4 an4 tian1 wen2 tai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: At this Green Bank Observatory there's a scientist

cues.zh: 名字叫德雷克
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 de2 lei2 ke4
cues.en: named Drake.

cues.zh: 德雷克说你刚才用的那个公式
cues.pinyin: de2 lei2 ke4 shuo1 ni3 gang1 cai2 yong4 de5 na4 ge5 gong1 shi4
cues.en: Drake said, the formula you just used

cues.zh: 这个估计方法太简单了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu1 ji4 fang1 fa3 tai4 jian3 dan1 le5
cues.en: — that estimation method is too simple.

cues.zh: 我给你提出一个复杂的方法
cues.pinyin: wo3 gei3 ni3 ti2 chu1 yi2 ge4 fu4 za2 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Let me give you a more complex method

cues.zh: 那比较精确地估算一下这个文
cues.pinyin: na4 bi3 jiao4 jing1 que4 di4 gu1 suan4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen2
cues.en: to more precisely estimate this

cues.zh: 明的存在数量
cues.pinyin: ming2 de5 cun2 zai4 shu4 liang4
cues.en: civilization's existing number.

cues.zh: 结果他提出了德雷克公式
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 de2 lei2 ke4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: As a result he proposed the Drake Equation.

cues.zh: 那在这个德雷克公式里边去计算
cues.pinyin: na4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 de2 lei2 ke4 gong1 shi4 li3 bian1 qu4 ji4 suan4
cues.en: And if you calculate using the Drake Equation,

cues.zh: 外星文明还是非常非常多
cues.pinyin: wai4 xing1 wen2 ming2 hai2 shi4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 duo1
cues.en: the number of alien civilizations is still extremely large,

cues.zh: 比我们估计的这个还要高很多对吧
cues.pinyin: bi3 wo3 men5 gu1 ji4 de5 zhe4 ge5 hai2 yao4 gao1 hen3 duo1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: much higher than what we estimated, right?

cues.zh: 那么就奇怪了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jiu4 qi2 guai4 le5
cues.en: So that's strange.

cues.zh: 说既然有这么多外星文明
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ji4 ran2 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 wai4 xing1 wen2 ming2
cues.en: Since there are so many alien civilizations,

cues.zh: 为什么我们都没有看得见呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 men5 dou1 mei2 you3 kan4 de2 jian4 ne5
cues.en: why haven't we seen any of them?

cues.zh: 那第二句话就应该是
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 er4 ju4 hua4 jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi4
cues.en: The second sentence should be,

cues.zh: 外星文明如果存在的话
cues.pinyin: wai4 xing1 wen2 ming2 ru2 guo3 cun2 zai4 de5 hua4
cues.en: if alien civilizations exist,

cues.zh: 外星人应该被发现
cues.pinyin: wai4 xing1 ren2 ying1 gai1 bei4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: aliens should be discoverable.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】外星人存在吗？我们为什么看不到外星文明？（费米悖论）

cues.zh: 方瓦特这么多
cues.pinyin: fang1 wa3 te4 zhe4 me5 duo1
cues.en: ...watts, that much.

cues.zh: 那么这个文明我们就称之为一类文明
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 wen2 ming2 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 yi1 lei4 wen2 ming2
cues.en: So we call this civilization a Type I civilization.

cues.zh: 假如有一个文明
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 you3 yi2 ge4 wen2 ming2
cues.en: Suppose there's a civilization

cues.zh: 它可以利用它所在的恒星的全部能量
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 li4 yong4 ta1 suo3 zai4 de5 heng2 xing1 de5 quan2 bu4 neng2 liang4
cues.en: that can harness all the energy of the star it's around,

cues.zh: 它可以利用恒星的能量了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 li4 yong4 heng2 xing1 de5 neng2 liang4 le5
cues.en: it can harness the star's energy,

cues.zh: 这个大概是 10 的 26 次方瓦特这么大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 gai4 shi4 10 de5 26 ci4 fang1 wa3 te4 zhe4 me5 da4
cues.en: that's roughly 10 to the 26th power watts.

cues.zh: 那么我们就称之为二星文明
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 er4 xing1 wen2 ming2
cues.en: We call this a Type II civilization.

cues.zh: 假如有一个文明你可以利用整个星系
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 you3 yi2 ge4 wen2 ming2 ni3 ke3 yi3 li4 yong4 zheng3 ge4 xing1 xi4
cues.en: Suppose there's a civilization that can harness an entire galaxy,

cues.zh: 比如说对我们来讲就是银河系
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 dui4 wo3 men5 lai2 jiang3 jiu4 shi4 yin2 he2 xi4
cues.en: for us that would be the Milky Way,

cues.zh: 可以利用整个星系的能量了
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 li4 yong4 zheng3 ge4 xing1 xi4 de5 neng2 liang4 le5
cues.en: harnessing the energy of an entire galaxy,

cues.zh: 那么大概要功率是 10 的 36 次方瓦特
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 da4 gai4 yao4 gong1 lv4 shi4 10 de5 36 ci4 fang1 wa3 te4
cues.en: that would require roughly 10 to the 36th power watts.

cues.zh: 这种文明我们就称之为第三级文明
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 wen2 ming2 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 di4 san1 ji2 wen2 ming2
cues.en: We call this kind of civilization a Type III civilization.

cues.zh: 那地球现在出于哪一级文明呢
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 qiu2 xian4 zai4 chu1 yu2 na3 yi1 ji2 wen2 ming2 ne5
cues.en: So which stage is Earth at right now?

cues.zh: 很遗憾地球还没到第一级文明呢
cues.pinyin: hen3 yi2 han4 di4 qiu2 hai2 mei2 dao4 di4 yi1 ji2 wen2 ming2 ne5
cues.en: Unfortunately, Earth hasn't even reached Type I civilization yet.

cues.zh: 我们整个地球上的能源还没有被开发出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zheng3 ge4 di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 neng2 yuan2 hai2 mei2 you3 bei4 kai1 fa1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: The energy resources on our whole planet haven't even been fully developed.

cues.zh: 地球大概在这个位置
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 da4 gai4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: Earth is roughly at this position.

cues.zh: 地球大概在这个位置
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 da4 gai4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: Earth is roughly at this position.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 扦插种植罗勒九层塔，无需种子，一年四季都可以！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 几分钟内学会扦插种植罗勒的方法
cues.pinyin: ji3 fen1 zhong1 nei4 xue2 hui4 qian1 cha1 zhong4 zhi2 luo2 le4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Learn how to propagate basil by cuttings in just a few minutes.

cues.zh: 你好各位美食家我们又见面了我是 S issy
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 mei3 shi2 jia1 wo3 men5 you4 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 S issy
cues.en: Hello everyone, foodies, we meet again, I'm Sissy.

cues.zh: 那如果你最近有看我的影片的话呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 zui4 jin4 you3 kan4 wo3 de5 ying3 pian4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If you've watched my videos recently,

cues.zh: 你已经知道了
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi3 jing1 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: you already know.

cues.zh: 我在这个室外啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 wai4 a5
cues.en: that outdoors,

cues.zh: 还有室内都种植了许多这个蔬菜还有香料
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 shi4 nei4 dou1 zhong4 zhi2 le5 xu3 duo1 zhe4 ge5 shu1 cai4 hai2 you3 xiang1 liao4
cues.en: and indoors too, I grow a lot of vegetables and herbs.

cues.zh: 今天想要跟你分享的是
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 xiang3 yao4 gen1 ni3 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4
cues.en: What I want to share with you today is

cues.zh: 用一个很简单的办法
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi2 ge4 hen3 jian3 dan1 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: a very simple method

cues.zh: 简单的方法来种植许多这个漂亮的罗勒
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 de5 fang1 fa3 lai2 zhong4 zhi2 xu3 duo1 zhe4 ge5 piao4 liang4 de5 luo2 le4
cues.en: a simple way to grow lots of this beautiful basil.

cues.zh: 赶快来看一看一学就会
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4 yi1 xue2 jiu4 hui4
cues.en: Come take a look, you'll learn it instantly.

cues.zh: 首先把我们的罗勒给它剪成 3 到
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 luo2 le4 gei3 ta1 jian3 cheng2 3 dao4
cues.en: First, cut our basil down to 3 to

cues.zh: 4 英寸这么高
cues.pinyin: 4 ying1 cun4 zhe4 me5 gao1
cues.en: 4 inches tall.

cues.zh: 下面的多余的叶子呢给它灸掉
cues.pinyin: xia4 mian4 de5 duo1 yu2 de5 ye4 zi5 ne5 gei3 ta1 jiu3 diao4
cues.en: Pluck off the extra leaves at the bottom.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 扦插种植罗勒九层塔，无需种子，一年四季都可以！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 剩下的罗勒也是同样的做法
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 luo2 le4 ye3 shi4 tong2 yang4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Do the same for the rest of the basil.

cues.zh: 在一个杯子或者是瓶子里呢加入一杯水
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 bei1 zi5 huo4 zhe3 shi4 ping2 zi5 li3 ne5 jia1 ru4 yi1 bei1 shui3
cues.en: Add a cup of water to a cup or bottle.

cues.zh: 将几根已经剪好的罗勒枝给它放到里面来
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ji3 gen1 yi3 jing1 jian3 hao3 de5 luo2 le4 zhi1 gei3 ta1 fang4 dao4 li3 mian4 lai2
cues.en: Put several of the trimmed basil cuttings into it.

cues.zh: 将这几个瓶子呢放到窗户旁边
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zhe4 ji3 ge4 ping2 zi5 ne5 fang4 dao4 chuang1 hu4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: Place these bottles by the window.

cues.zh: 因为这个罗勒喜欢阳光
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 luo2 le4 xi3 huan1 yang2 guang1
cues.en: Because basil loves sunlight.

cues.zh: 所以它最好是一天可以接受到六
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 zui4 hao3 shi4 yi1 tian1 ke3 yi3 jie1 shou4 dao4 liu4
cues.en: So it's best if it gets six

cues.zh: 个小时的阳光
cues.pinyin: ge4 xiao3 shi2 de5 yang2 guang1
cues.en: hours of sunlight a day.

cues.zh: 它呢也喜欢暖的天气
cues.pinyin: ta1 ne5 ye3 xi3 huan1 nuan3 de5 tian1 qi4
cues.en: It also likes warm weather.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 扦插种植罗勒九层塔，无需种子，一年四季都可以！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 最适合它的温度是 75 到 90 华氏度
cues.pinyin: zui4 shi4 he2 ta1 de5 wen1 du4 shi4 75 dao4 90 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: The ideal temperature for it is 75 to 90 degrees Fahrenheit.

cues.zh: 那这个水呢我们也每两天给它换一次
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 shui3 ne5 wo3 men5 ye3 mei3 liang3 tian1 gei3 ta1 huan4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: We also change the water every two days

cues.zh: 给它保持新鲜
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 bao3 chi2 xin1 xian1

items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】周期函数如何展开成一系列的三角函数？《火柴人vs数学》深度解析（二）泰勒展开

cues.zh: 都会幻化成一堆数字
cues.pinyin: du1 hui4 huan4 hua4 cheng2 yi1 dui1 shu4 zi4
cues.en: it turns into a bunch of numbers.

cues.zh: 这又是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what's going on here?

cues.zh: 为了解释这个问题
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: To explain this,

cues.zh: 我们首先必须解释什么是泰勒展开
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 bi4 xu1 jie3 shi4 shen2 me5 shi4 tai4 lei1 zhan3 kai1
cues.en: we first need to explain what a Taylor expansion is.

cues.zh: 泰勒展开其实很简单
cues.pinyin: tai4 lei1 zhan3 kai1 qi2 shi2 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: The Taylor expansion is actually quite simple.

cues.zh: 就是一句话
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi1 ju4 hua4
cues.en: It can be summed up in one sentence:

cues.zh: 用幂函数的和去逼近某一个函数
cues.pinyin: yong4 mi4 han2 shu4 de5 he2 qu4 bi1 jin4 mou3 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4
cues.en: use a sum of power functions to approximate a given function.

cues.zh: 幂函数就是像 x 的 1 次方
cues.pinyin: mi4 han2 shu4 jiu4 shi4 xiang4 x de5 1 ci4 fang1
cues.en: A power function is something like x to the 1st power,

cues.zh: x 的 2 次方
cues.pinyin: x de5 2 ci4 fang1
cues.en: x to the 2nd power,

cues.zh: x 的 3 次方这样的函数
cues.pinyin: x de5 3 ci4 fang1 zhe4 yang4 de5 han2 shu4
cues.en: x to the 3rd power, and so on.

cues.zh: 这种函数具有非常好的性质
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 han2 shu4 ju4 you3 fei1 chang2 hao3 de5 xing4 zhi4
cues.en: These functions have very nice properties.

cues.zh: 因为即使不使用计算器
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ji2 shi3 bu4 shi3 yong4 ji4 suan4 qi4
cues.en: Because even without a calculator,

cues.zh: 也能比较方便的计算出函数值
cues.pinyin: ye3 neng2 bi3 jiao4 fang1 bian4 de5 ji4 suan4 chu1 han2 shu4 zhi2
cues.en: you can easily compute their values.

cues.zh: 可是其他函数
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 qi2 ta1 han2 shu4
cues.en: But other functions,

cues.zh: 比如说指数函数
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhi3 shu4 han2 shu4
cues.en: like exponential functions,

cues.zh: 对数函数
cues.pinyin: dui4 shu4 han2 shu4
cues.en: logarithmic functions,

cues.zh: 三角函数
cues.pinyin: san1 jiao3 han2 shu4
cues.en: and trigonometric functions,

cues.zh: 如果不用计算器而用手算的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bu4 yong4 ji4 suan4 qi4 er2 yong4 shou3 suan4 de5 hua4
cues.en: if calculated by hand instead of with a calculator,

cues.zh: 难度就大得多了
cues.pinyin: nan2 du4 jiu4 da4 de2 duo1 le5
cues.en: are much harder.

cues.zh: 于是有人就想
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 jiu4 xiang3
cues.en: So someone thought,

cues.zh: 能不能把一个函数表示成一大堆幂函数
cues.pinyin: neng2 bu4 neng2 ba3 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4 biao3 shi4 cheng2 yi1 da4 dui1 mi4 han2 shu4
cues.en: could we express a function as a sum of a bunch of power functions

cues.zh: 相加的形式呢
cues.pinyin: xiang1 jia1 de5 xing2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: added together?

items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】周期函数如何展开成一系列的三角函数？《火柴人vs数学》深度解析（二）泰勒展开

cues.zh: 你会发现这个函数越来越接近 sin x
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 yue4 lai2 yue4 jie1 jin4 sin x
cues.en: You'll find this function gets closer and closer to sin x.

cues.zh: 可以证明如果我们按照一定的规则
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zheng4 ming2 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 an4 zhao4 yi2 ding4 de5 gui1 ze2
cues.en: It can be proven that if we follow certain rules

cues.zh: 不停地添加幂函数
cues.pinyin: bu4 ting2 di4 tian1 jia1 mi4 han2 shu4
cues.en: and keep adding power-function terms,

cues.zh: 就能够严格逼近 sin x 了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 neng2 gou4 yan2 ge2 bi1 jin4 sin x le5
cues.en: we can approximate sin x exactly.

cues.zh: 所以我们说用幂函数逼近 sin 函数是可能的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 shuo1 yong4 mi4 han2 shu4 bi1 jin4 sin han2 shu4 shi4 ke3 neng2 de5
cues.en: So we can say it's possible to approximate the sin function using power functions.

cues.zh: 它的形式就是这个样子
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xing2 shi4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: It looks like this.

cues.zh: 等号右侧的幂函数项数越多
cues.pinyin: deng3 hao4 you4 ce4 de5 mi4 han2 shu4 xiang4 shu4 yue4 duo1
cues.en: The more power-function terms there are on the right side of the equation,

cues.zh: 整个函数就越来越接近 sin x
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 han2 shu4 jiu4 yue4 lai2 yue4 jie1 jin4 sin x
cues.en: the closer the whole function gets to sin x.

cues.zh: 如果幂函数的项数有无穷多
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mi4 han2 shu4 de5 xiang4 shu4 you3 wu2 qiong2 duo1
cues.en: If there are infinitely many power-function terms,

cues.zh: 那么整个函数的和就严格等于 sin x 了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zheng3 ge4 han2 shu4 de5 he2 jiu4 yan2 ge2 deng3 yu2 sin x le5
cues.en: then the sum equals sin x exactly.

cues.zh: 这就是 sin x 的幂级数展开
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 sin x de5 mi4 ji2 shu4 zhan3 kai1
cues.en: This is the power series expansion of sin x,

cues.zh: 或者叫做泰勒展开
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 jiao4 zuo4 tai4 lei1 zhan3 kai1
cues.en: also called the Taylor expansion.

cues.zh: 我们再来仔细解释一下这个公式吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 lai2 zi3 xi4 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 gong1 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Let's take a closer look at this formula.

cues.zh: 首先叹号叫阶乘
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 tan4 hao2 jiao4 jie1 cheng2
cues.en: First, the exclamation mark denotes a factorial.

cues.zh: 它表示从 1 乘到这个数
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 shi4 cong2 1 cheng2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 shu4
cues.en: It means multiplying from 1 up to that number.

cues.zh: 比如说 3 的阶乘就是 1 乘 2 乘 3 等于 6
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 3 de5 jie1 cheng2 jiu4 shi4 1 cheng2 2 cheng2 3 deng3 yu2 6
cues.en: For example, 3 factorial is 1×2×3 = 6.

items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】周期函数如何展开成一系列的三角函数？《火柴人vs数学》深度解析（二）泰勒展开

cues.zh: 5 的阶乘就是 1 乘 2 乘 3 乘 4
cues.pinyin: 5 de5 jie1 cheng2 jiu4 shi4 1 cheng2 2 cheng2 3 cheng2 4
cues.en: 5 factorial is 1×2×3×4

cues.zh: 乘 5 等 120 等等
cues.pinyin: cheng2 5 deng3 120 deng3 deng3
cues.en: ×5 = 120, and so on.

cues.zh: 每一项 x 的密次分别是 13 57
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 xiang4 x de5 mi4 ci4 fen1 bie2 shi4 13 57
cues.en: The power of x in each term is 1, 3, 5, 7,

cues.zh: 我们可以把它写作 x 的 2 n 加 1 次米
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 xie3 zuo4 x de5 2 n jia1 1 ci4 mi3
cues.en: and we can write it as x to the (2n+1) power,

cues.zh: 其中 n 等于 0 12 3
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 n deng3 yu2 0 12 3

cues.zh: 阶乘和幂次相同
cues.pinyin: jie1 cheng2 he2 mi4 ci4 xiang1 tong2
cues.en: the factorial matches the power,

cues.zh: 也可以写成 2 n 加 1 的阶层
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 xie3 cheng2 2 n jia1 1 de5 jie1 ceng2
cues.en: so it can also be written as (2n+1) factorial.

cues.zh: 最后再看正符号
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zai4 kan4 zheng4 fu2 hao4
cues.en: Finally, look at the sign.

cues.zh: x 的项是正的
cues.pinyin: x de5 xiang4 shi4 zheng4 de5
cues.en: The x term is positive,

cues.zh: x 三次方项是负的
cues.pinyin: x san1 ci4 fang1 xiang4 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: the x-cubed term is negative,

cues.zh: x 五次方项是正的
cues.pinyin: x wu3 ci4 fang1 xiang4 shi4 zheng4 de5
cues.en: the x-to-the-5th term is positive,

cues.zh: x 七次方项是负的
cues.pinyin: x qi1 ci4 fang1 xiang4 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: the x-to-the-7th term is negative,

cues.zh: 所以符号可以写成负 1 的 n 次幂
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 fu2 hao4 ke3 yi3 xie3 cheng2 fu4 1 de5 n ci4 mi4
cues.en: so the sign can be written as (-1) to the n-th power.

cues.zh: 这样一来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2
cues.en: With that,

cues.zh: sin x 函数的泰勒展开
cues.pinyin: sin x han2 shu4 de5 tai4 lei1 zhan3 kai1
cues.en: the Taylor expansion of sin x

cues.zh: 又可以写成一个比较集中的形式
cues.pinyin: you4 ke3 yi3 xie3 cheng2 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 ji2 zhong1 de5 xing2 shi4
cues.en: can be written in a more compact form.

cues.zh: 这里的表示加和
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 de5 biao3 shi4 jia1 he2
cues.en: Here, this symbol denotes a summation,

cues.zh: 而下方的 n 等于 0 和上方的 n 等于无穷
cues.pinyin: er2 xia4 fang1 de5 n deng3 yu2 0 he2 shang4 fang1 de5 n deng3 yu2 wu2 qiong2
cues.en: and the n=0 below and n=∞ above

cues.zh: 表示后方向中 n 要从 0 开始一直到无穷多
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 hou4 fang1 xiang4 zhong1 n yao4 cong2 0 kai1 shi3 yi4 zhi2 dao4 wu2 qiong2 duo1
cues.en: mean that in the expression after it, n runs from 0 all the way to infinity.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】周期函数如何展开成一系列的三角函数？《火柴人vs数学》深度解析（二）泰勒展开

cues.zh: 为什么是这样
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 为什么一个函数可以展开成幂级数的和呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4 ke3 yi3 zhan3 kai1 cheng2 mi4 ji2 shu4 de5 he2 ne5
cues.en: Why can a function be expanded into a sum of a power series?

cues.zh: 或者说如果我们想展开一个函数
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 xiang3 zhan3 kai1 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4
cues.en: Or put another way, if we want to expand a function,

cues.zh: 具体应该怎么做呢
cues.pinyin: ju4 ti3 ying1 gai1 zen3 me5 zuo4 ne5
cues.en: how exactly should we do it?

cues.zh: 我们大概可以这样理解
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 da4 gai4 ke3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 li3 jie3
cues.en: We can understand it roughly like this.

cues.zh: 如果你要画一个人
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 yao4 hua4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: If you want to draw a person,

cues.zh: 首先要画一个轮廓
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 yao4 hua4 yi2 ge4 lun2 kuo4
cues.en: you first draw an outline,

cues.zh: 然后再增加一些细节
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 zeng1 jia1 yi1 xie1 xi4 jie2
cues.en: then add some details,

cues.zh: 再画上一些更细的细节
cues.pinyin: zai4 hua4 shang4 yi1 xie1 geng4 xi4 de5 xi4 jie2
cues.en: then add even finer details,

cues.zh: 最终完成这幅画
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 wan2 cheng2 zhe4 fu2 hua4
cues.en: and finally complete the drawing.

cues.zh: 同样用一系列的幂函数
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 yong4 yi1 xi4 lie4 de5 mi4 han2 shu4
cues.en: Similarly, using a series of power functions

cues.zh: 去逼近一个函数
cues.pinyin: qu4 bi1 jin4 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4
cues.en: to approximate a function,

cues.zh: 第一项就相当于轮廓
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 xiang4 jiu4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 lun2 kuo4
cues.en: the first term is like the outline,

cues.zh: 第二项就相当于一些粗的细节
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 xiang4 jiu4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 yi1 xie1 cu1 de5 xi4 jie2
cues.en: the second term is like some rough details,

cues.zh: 第三项就相当于一些更细的细节
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 xiang4 jiu4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 yi1 xie1 geng4 xi4 de5 xi4 jie2
cues.en: the third term is like finer details,

cues.zh: 如此当项数足够多的时候
cues.pinyin: ru2 ci3 dang1 xiang4 shu4 zu2 gou4 duo1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: and so when there are enough terms,

cues.zh: 就能够足够接近我们想要的函数了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 neng2 gou4 zu2 gou4 jie1 jin4 wo3 men5 xiang3 yao4 de5 han2 shu4 le5
cues.en: the result gets close enough to the function we want.

cues.zh: 那么每一项具体应该是多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 mei3 yi1 xiang4 ju4 ti3 ying1 gai1 shi4 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: So what exactly should each term be?

cues.zh: 我们可以这样计算
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 ji4 suan4
cues.en: We can calculate it like this.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】周期函数如何展开成一系列的三角函数？《火柴人vs数学》深度解析（二）泰勒展开

cues.zh: 首先假设函数 f x 可以展开成幂级数的和
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 jia3 she4 han2 shu4 f x ke3 yi3 zhan3 kai1 cheng2 mi4 ji2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: First, assume that f(x) can be expanded into a sum of a power series,

cues.zh: 样子是这样的
cues.pinyin: yang4 zi5 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: like this.

cues.zh: 现在我们的任务是求出每一项的系数
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 ren4 wu4 shi4 qiu2 chu1 mei3 yi1 xiang4 de5 xi4 shu4
cues.en: Now our task is to find the coefficient of each term.

cues.zh: 方法其实很简单
cues.pinyin: fang1 fa3 qi2 shi2 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: The method is actually quite simple.

cues.zh: 首先让等号两边的 x 都取 0
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 rang4 deng3 hao4 liang3 bian1 de5 x dou1 qu3 0
cues.en: First, let x = 0 on both sides of the equation.

cues.zh: 这样就有 f x 等于 a 0 加 a 1 乘以 0
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 you3 f x deng3 yu2 a 0 jia1 a 1 cheng2 yi3 0
cues.en: This gives f(0) = a0 + a1×0

cues.zh: 加 a 2 乘以 0 方加 a 3 乘以 0 的立方等等
cues.pinyin: jia1 a 2 cheng2 yi3 0 fang1 jia1 a 3 cheng2 yi3 0 de5 li4 fang1 deng3 deng3
cues.en: + a2×0² + a3×0³, and so on.

cues.zh: 你会发现等号的右边除了第一项
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 deng3 hao4 de5 you4 bian1 chu2 le5 di4 yi1 xiang4
cues.en: You'll notice that on the right side, except for the first term,

cues.zh: 其他都是 0
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 dou1 shi4 0
cues.en: everything else is 0.

cues.zh: 所以 A 0 就等于 F 0 了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 A 0 jiu4 deng3 yu2 F 0 le5
cues.en: So A0 equals F(0).

cues.zh: 这样我们就求出了第一个系数
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 wo3 men5 jiu4 qiu2 chu1 le5 di4 yi2 ge4 xi4 shu4
cues.en: This way we've found the first coefficient.

cues.zh: 然后我们对刚刚的式子两边同时求导数
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 dui4 gang1 gang1 de5 shi4 zi5 liang3 bian1 tong2 shi2 qiu2 dao3 shu4
cues.en: Next, we take the derivative of both sides of the equation.

cues.zh: 这样就得到了 F
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 F
cues.en: This gives us F'(x)

cues.zh: x 等于 0 加 A 1 加 2 A 2 x
cues.pinyin: x deng3 yu2 0 jia1 A 1 jia1 2 A 2 x

cues.zh: 加 3A3x 的平方加 4A4x 的立方等等
cues.pinyin: jia1 3A3x de5 ping2 fang1 jia1 4A4x de5 li4 fang1 deng3 deng3
cues.en: + 3A3x² + 4A4x³, and so on.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 男子骑自行车居然骑出了三场手术
cues.pinyin: nan2 zi5 qi2 zi4 xing2 che1 ju1 ran2 qi2 chu1 le5 san1 chang3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: A man riding a bike ended up needing three surgeries.

cues.zh: 到底是他自己太倒霉
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 ta1 zi4 ji3 tai4 dao3 mei2
cues.en: Was it just that he was terribly unlucky,

cues.zh: 还是医生圈钱太黑心呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 yi1 sheng1 quan1 qian2 tai4 hei1 xin1 ne5
cues.en: or that doctors are just too money-hungry and heartless?

cues.zh: 萧恩的医院接诊了一个伤势十分严
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 yi1 yuan4 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi2 ge4 shang1 shi4 shi2 fen1 yan2
cues.en: Shaun's hospital admitted a patient with very severe

cues.zh: 重的病患飞哥
cues.pinyin: zhong4 de5 bing4 huan4 fei1 ge1
cues.en: injuries — Brother Fei.

cues.zh: 飞哥入院时有严重的头部创伤
cues.pinyin: fei1 ge1 ru4 yuan4 shi2 you3 yan2 zhong4 de5 tou2 bu4 chuang1 shang1
cues.en: When Fei was admitted he had severe head trauma,

cues.zh: 已经休克眼看人就要不行了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 xiu1 ke4 yan3 kan4 ren2 jiu4 yao4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: he was already in shock and looked like he might not make it.

cues.zh: 医生们都以为他是出了车祸
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 dou1 yi3 wei2 ta1 shi4 chu1 le5 che1 huo4
cues.en: The doctors all assumed he'd been in a car accident.

cues.zh: 可是也想不到飞哥竟然是自己
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ye3 xiang3 bu2 dao4 fei1 ge1 jing4 ran2 shi4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: But who would've guessed Fei had actually

cues.zh: 骑自行车甩的
cues.pinyin: qi2 zi4 xing2 che1 shuai3 de5
cues.en: thrown himself off his own bicycle.

cues.zh: 他自行车前轮卡在下排水口里
cues.pinyin: ta1 zi4 xing2 che1 qian2 lun2 ka3 zai4 xia4 pai2 shui3 kou3 li3
cues.en: His front wheel got stuck in a drain grate,

cues.zh: 然后整个人飞出去脸先着地
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zheng3 ge4 ren2 fei1 chu1 qu4 lian3 xian1 zhe5 di4
cues.en: and he flew off, hitting the ground face-first.

cues.zh: 现在飞哥满嘴都是血
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 fei1 ge1 man3 zui3 dou1 shi4 xue4
cues.en: Now Fei's mouth was full of blood.

cues.zh: 医生们赶紧帮他清理气道
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gan3 jin3 bang1 ta1 qing1 li3 qi4 dao4
cues.en: The doctors rushed to clear his airway.

cues.zh: 肖恩站在旁边也没闲着
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhan4 zai4 pang2 bian1 ye3 mei2 xian2 zhe5
cues.en: Shaun, standing nearby, wasn't idle either —

cues.zh: 用他的人体 X 光超能力把飞哥扫描了一遍
cues.pinyin: yong4 ta1 de5 ren2 ti3 X guang1 chao1 neng2 li4 ba3 fei1 ge1 sao3 miao2 le5 yi1 bian4
cues.en: he used his human-X-ray superpower to scan Fei,

cues.zh: 心里已经清楚了
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 yi3 jing1 qing1 chu3 le5
cues.en: and already knew in his mind

cues.zh: 飞哥需要做三个手术
cues.pinyin: fei1 ge1 xu1 yao4 zuo4 san1 ge4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: that Fei would need three surgeries

cues.zh: 才能修复他摔的稀烂的面部骨骼
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 xiu1 fu4 ta1 shuai1 de5 xi1 lan4 de5 mian4 bu4 gu3 ge2
cues.en: to fix his shattered facial bones.

cues.zh: 肖恩的敏锐
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 de5 min3 rui4
cues.en: Shaun's sharp insight

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 把旁边青创的沃尔科医生看得一脸崇拜
cues.pinyin: ba3 pang2 bian1 qing1 chuang4 de5 wo4 er3 ke1 yi1 sheng1 kan4 de2 yi1 lian3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: left the junior doctor Volker nearby looking at him in awe.

cues.zh: 肖恩给大家详细介绍飞哥的手术
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 gei3 da4 jia1 xiang2 xi4 jie4 shao4 fei1 ge1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Shaun explained Fei's surgeries to everyone in detail.

cues.zh: 第一个手术创作额下气刀
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 shou3 shu4 chuang4 zuo4 e2 xia4 qi4 dao1
cues.en: The first surgery would create a submandibular airway.

cues.zh: 第二个手术修复鼻子附近的颅骨骨折
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 shou3 shu4 xiu1 fu4 bi2 zi5 fu4 jin4 de5 lu2 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The second surgery would repair the skull fracture near the nose.

cues.zh: 第三个手术是修复眼眶附近的颅骨骨折
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ge4 shou3 shu4 shi4 xiu1 fu4 yan3 kuang4 fu4 jin4 de5 lu2 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The third surgery would repair the skull fracture near the eye socket.

cues.zh: 三个手术听起来是有点多
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 shou3 shu4 ting1 qi3 lai2 shi4 you3 dian3 duo1
cues.en: Three surgeries sounded like a lot.

cues.zh: 沃尔克对肖恩很崇拜
cues.pinyin: wo4 er3 ke4 dui4 xiao4 en1 hen3 chong2 bai4
cues.en: Volker admired Shaun greatly

cues.zh: 没有质疑肖恩的方案
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhi4 yi2 xiao4 en1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: and didn't question his plan at all.

cues.zh: 可艾伦却对肖恩的手术方案不知可否
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 lun2 que4 dui4 xiao4 en1 de5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 bu4 zhi1 ke3 fou3
cues.en: But Ellen was noncommittal about Shaun's surgical plan.

cues.zh: 在手术中
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 zhong1
cues.en: During the surgery,

cues.zh: 艾伦果然提出了一个新的方案
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 guo3 ran2 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: Ellen indeed proposed a new plan.

cues.zh: 飞哥或许不需要做三次手术
cues.pinyin: fei1 ge1 huo4 xu3 bu4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 san1 ci4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Fei might not need three surgeries after all.

cues.zh: 按照艾伦的方案
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 ai4 lun2 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: According to Ellen's plan,

cues.zh: 两次手术就能搞定
cues.pinyin: liang3 ci4 shou3 shu4 jiu4 neng2 gao3 ding4
cues.en: two surgeries could get the job done.

cues.zh: 在修复下恶骨的同时修复眼眶
cues.pinyin: zai4 xiu1 fu4 xia4 e4 gu3 de5 tong2 shi2 xiu1 fu4 yan3 kuang4
cues.en: Fixing the jawbone and the eye socket at the same time

cues.zh: 这样飞哥也能早点出现不适
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 fei1 ge1 ye3 neng2 zao3 dian3 chu1 xian4 bu4 shi4
cues.en: would let Fei be discharged sooner too.

cues.zh: 可肖恩觉得这样做风险太大
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 feng1 xian3 tai4 da4
cues.en: But Shaun felt this approach was too risky.

cues.zh: 可艾伦直接指出这样做更能省钱
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 lun2 zhi2 jie1 zhi3 chu1 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 geng4 neng2 sheng3 qian2
cues.en: Ellen pointed out directly that it would also save money.

cues.zh: 肖恩一时间也不知道还能说啥
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 yi1 shi2 jian1 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 hai2 neng2 shuo1 sha2
cues.en: For a moment Shaun didn't know what else to say.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 可也就在这时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 ye3 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But right at that moment,

cues.zh: 她的脑子空前活跃
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 nao3 zi5 kong1 qian2 huo2 yue4
cues.en: her mind became unusually active,

cues.zh: 似乎想到了更好的治疗方案
cues.pinyin: si4 hu1 xiang3 dao4 le5 geng4 hao3 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: as if she'd thought of an even better treatment plan.

cues.zh: 但就在这方案即将成型
cues.pinyin: dan4 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 fang1 an4 ji2 jiang1 cheng2 xing2
cues.en: But just as this plan was about to take shape,

cues.zh: 还没成型的时候
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 cheng2 xing2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: before it had fully formed,

cues.zh: 一阵干手气的风鸣打断了萧恩的思考
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhen4 gan4 shou3 qi4 de5 feng1 ming2 da3 duan4 le5 xiao1 en1 de5 si1 kao3
cues.en: a burst of whirring from a hand dryer interrupted Shaun's train of thought.

cues.zh: 这要是普通人也就不当回事了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yao4 shi4 pu3 tong1 ren2 ye3 jiu4 bu4 dang4 hui2 shi4 le5
cues.en: For an ordinary person this wouldn't have been a big deal,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩现在处于极度敏感期
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 xian4 zai4 chu3 yu2 ji2 du4 min3 gan3 qi1
cues.en: but Shaun was currently in an extremely sensitive phase.

cues.zh: 那干手机的声音在肖恩耳朵里
cues.pinyin: na4 gan4 shou3 ji1 de5 sheng1 yin1 zai4 xiao4 en1 er3 duo3 li3
cues.en: That hand dryer noise, to Shaun's ears,

cues.zh: 就跟天打雷 P 一样无法很受
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gen1 tian1 da3 lei2 P yi1 yang4 wu2 fa3 hen3 shou4
cues.en: was as unbearable as a thunderclap.

cues.zh: 肖恩把气撒到了萨伦身上
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ba3 qi4 sa1 dao4 le5 sa4 lun2 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Shaun took his frustration out on Salen,

cues.zh: 他把一堆投诉书丢给了萨伦
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 yi1 dui1 tou2 su4 shu1 diu1 gei3 le5 sa4 lun2
cues.en: dumping a stack of complaint forms on her.

cues.zh: 他投诉干手机
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou2 su4 gan4 shou3 ji1
cues.en: He complained about the hand dryer,

cues.zh: 要投诉洗手液
cues.pinyin: yao4 tou2 su4 xi3 shou3 ye4
cues.en: wanted to complain about the hand soap,

cues.zh: 要投诉手术服
cues.pinyin: yao4 tou2 su4 shou3 shu4 fu2
cues.en: and wanted to complain about the surgical gowns.

cues.zh: 萨伦一脸懵逼的看着肖恩
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 yi1 lian3 meng3 bi1 de5 kan4 zhe5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Salen stared at Shaun completely baffled.

cues.zh: 他知道此时不能跟肖恩对着干
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 ci3 shi2 bu4 neng2 gen1 xiao4 en1 dui4 zhe5 gan4
cues.en: She knew she couldn't clash with Shaun right now,

cues.zh: 要不然肖恩敢把全员的干手机都砸了
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 xiao4 en1 gan3 ba3 quan2 yuan2 de5 gan4 shou3 ji1 dou1 za2 le5
cues.en: or he might just smash all the hand dryers in the building.

cues.zh: 萨伦安抚肖恩
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 an1 fu3 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Salen tried to soothe Shaun:

cues.zh: 你说的没错
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 de5 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: "You're not wrong,

cues.zh: 我做的也没错
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 de5 ye3 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: and what I did isn't wrong either —

cues.zh: 咱俩都没错
cues.pinyin: zan2 lia3 dou1 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: neither of us is wrong.

cues.zh: 所以肖恩你要乖
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao4 en1 ni3 yao4 guai1
cues.en: So Shaun, be good.

cues.zh: 你可以不用洗手液
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 bu4 yong4 xi3 shou3 ye4
cues.en: You don't have to use the hand soap,

cues.zh: 不用干手机
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 gan4 shou3 ji1
cues.en: you don't have to use the hand dryer,

cues.zh: 也可以穿你喜欢的手术服
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 chuan1 ni3 xi3 huan1 de5 shou3 shu4 fu2
cues.en: and you can wear whichever surgical gown you like.

cues.zh: 你要乖哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 guai1 o2
cues.en: Just be good, okay?"

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 让每个人的心里的不快都少了不少
cues.pinyin: rang4 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 xin1 li3 de5 bu4 kuai4 dou1 shao3 le5 bu4 shao3
cues.en: This eased the frustration in everyone's hearts quite a bit.

cues.zh: 艾伦和乌尔克也互相道歉兵士前行了
cues.pinyin: ai4 lun2 he2 wu1 er3 ke4 ye3 hu4 xiang1 dao4 qian4 bing1 shi4 qian2 xing2 le5
cues.en: Ellen and Volker also apologized to each other and moved on together.

cues.zh: 这也要感谢飞科给他们创造了和好的机会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 yao4 gan3 xie4 fei1 ke1 gei3 ta1 men5 chuang4 zao4 le5 he2 hao3 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: For that, they had Brother Fei to thank for giving them a chance to make up.

cues.zh: 肖恩这边的难题刚结束
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 bian1 de5 nan2 ti2 gang1 jie2 shu4
cues.en: Just as Shaun's dilemma wrapped up,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯那边的难题又来了
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 na4 bian1 de5 nan2 ti2 you4 lai2 le5
cues.en: another dilemma arose over on Andrews' side.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯接诊了一个十分奇怪的病人
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi2 ge4 shi2 fen1 qi2 guai4 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Andrews took on a very strange patient —

cues.zh: 他是私生癫痫患者梅姐
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 si1 sheng1 dian1 xian2 huan4 zhe3 mei2 jie3
cues.en: an epilepsy patient named Sister Mei.

cues.zh: 梅姐虽然有癫痫
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 sui1 ran2 you3 dian1 xian2
cues.en: Although Sister Mei has epilepsy,

cues.zh: 但是却能跟正常人一样带人接物
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 que4 neng2 gen1 zheng4 chang2 ren2 yi1 yang4 dai4 ren2 jie1 wu4
cues.en: she can still interact with people just like anyone else,

cues.zh: 这都归功于两年前
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dou1 gui1 gong1 yu2 liang3 nian2 qian2
cues.en: and can even drive and cook normally.

cues.zh: 他不说你都不知道他有病
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 shuo1 ni3 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 you3 bing4
cues.en: If she didn't tell you, you'd never know she was sick.

cues.zh: 这调归功于两年前
cues.pinyin: zhe4 diao4 gui1 gong1 yu2 liang3 nian2 qian2
cues.en: That's all thanks to two years ago,

cues.zh: 他脑袋里被植入了一个植入物
cues.pinyin: ta1 nao3 dai4 li3 bei4 zhi2 ru4 le5 yi2 ge4 zhi2 ru4 wu4
cues.en: when an implant was placed in her brain.

cues.zh: 这个植入物有效地抑制了他癫痫发作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhi2 ru4 wu4 you3 xiao4 di4 yi4 zhi4 le5 ta1 dian1 xian2 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: This implant effectively suppressed her seizures.

cues.zh: 但是梅姐这次来医院却主动要把
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 jie3 zhe4 ci4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 que4 zhu3 dong4 yao4 ba3
cues.en: But this time, Sister Mei came to the hospital wanting

cues.zh: 要关门大吉了
cues.pinyin: yao4 guan1 men2 da4 ji2 le5
cues.en: to have the implant removed.

cues.zh: 这因为植入物的研发公司赚不到钱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yin1 wei4 zhi2 ru4 wu4 de5 yan2 fa1 gong1 si1 zhuan4 bu2 dao4 qian2
cues.en: That's because the company that developed the implant couldn't turn a profit

cues.zh: 要关门大姐了
cues.pinyin: yao4 guan1 men2 da4 jie3 le5
cues.en: and was about to go out of business.

cues.zh: 公司都关门了
cues.pinyin: gong1 si1 dou1 guan1 men2 le5
cues.en: Now that the company had closed down,

cues.zh: 植入物自然也就没法采用
cues.pinyin: zhi2 ru4 wu4 zi4 ran2 ye3 jiu4 mei2 fa3 cai3 yong4
cues.en: the implant naturally couldn't be supported anymore.

cues.zh: 所以梅姐很无奈啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 jie3 hen3 wu2 nai4 a5
cues.en: So Sister Mei was left with no good options.

cues.zh: 几个医生聚在办公室里替梅姐的前途发愁
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1 ju4 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 li3 ti4 mei2 jie3 de5 qian2 tu2 fa1 chou2
cues.en: Several doctors gathered in the office worrying about Sister Mei's future.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 取出植物物以后
cues.pinyin: qu3 chu1 zhi2 wu4 wu4 yi3 hou4
cues.en: Once the implant was removed,

cues.zh: 梅姐又要回到每天吃药控制病情的日子
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 you4 yao4 hui2 dao4 mei3 tian1 chi1 yao4 kong4 zhi4 bing4 qing2 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: Sister Mei would go back to controlling her condition with daily medication.

cues.zh: 可是只用药物也不一定能控制
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhi3 yong4 yao4 wu4 ye3 bu4 yi2 ding4 neng2 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: But medication alone might not necessarily be able to

cues.zh: 住梅姐的病情
cues.pinyin: zhu4 mei2 jie3 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: keep Sister Mei's condition under control.

cues.zh: 她一天至少癫痫 50 次呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 tian1 zhi4 shao3 dian1 xian2 50 ci4 ne5
cues.en: She has seizures at least 50 times a day.

cues.zh: 奥斯玛医生提出
cues.pinyin: ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 ti2 chu1
cues.en: Dr. Osma suggested

cues.zh: 不如把她的癫痫病灶直接吸了一劳永逸
cues.pinyin: bu4 ru2 ba3 ta1 de5 dian1 xian2 bing4 zao4 zhi2 jie1 xi1 le5 yi4 lao2 yong3 yi4
cues.en: that they might as well remove her seizure focus directly, once and for all.

cues.zh: 朴一生说这想法太疯狂了
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 zhe4 xiang3 fa3 tai4 feng1 kuang2 le5
cues.en: Dr. Park said that idea was too crazy —

cues.zh: 稍微差一点点梅姐就偏瘫了
cues.pinyin: shao1 wei1 cha4 yi4 dian3 dian3 mei2 jie3 jiu4 pian1 tan1 le5
cues.en: the slightest slip and Sister Mei would end up paralyzed.

cues.zh: 可奥斯玛医生表示
cues.pinyin: ke3 ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But Dr. Osma said

cues.zh: 自己充分相信安德鲁斯的医术
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 chong1 fen4 xiang1 xin4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 de5 yi1 shu4
cues.en: she fully trusted Andrews' surgical skill.

cues.zh: 别人开刀有几率偏瘫
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 kai1 dao1 you3 ji1 lv4 pian1 tan1
cues.en: Other surgeons' patients might have a chance of paralysis,

cues.zh: 咱领导的医术绝对没问题
cues.pinyin: zan2 ling3 dao3 de5 yi1 shu4 jue2 dui4 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: but their boss's skill was absolutely not in question.

cues.zh: 这一码皮拍的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ma3 pi2 pai1 de5
cues.en: That bit of flattery

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯十分舒爽
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 shi2 fen1 shu1 shuang3
cues.en: left Andrews feeling quite pleased,

cues.zh: 而且奥斯玛这个夜线确实让他更勤动
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ao4 si1 ma3 zhe4 ge5 ye4 xian4 que4 shi2 rang4 ta1 geng4 qin2 dong4
cues.en: and Osma's little provocation really did make her more tempted.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯打算大胆试一试
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 da3 suan4 da4 dan3 shi4 yi1 shi4
cues.en: Andrews decided to boldly give it a try.

cues.zh: 就算几个医生
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 ji3 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Just as the doctors

cues.zh: 值得意义满地想给美姐受疏的时候
cues.pinyin: zhi2 de5 yi4 yi4 man3 di4 xiang3 gei3 mei3 jie3 shou4 shu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: were full of fighting spirit and about to operate on Sister Mei,

cues.zh: 收到了来自老板萨伦的质疑
cues.pinyin: shou1 dao4 le5 lai2 zi4 lao3 ban3 sa4 lun2 de5 zhi4 yi2
cues.en: they received pushback from their boss, Salen.

cues.zh: 萨伦说
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shuo1
cues.en: Salen said,

cues.zh: 你们这套手术方案太冒险了
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 zhe4 tao4 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 tai4 mao4 xian3 le5
cues.en: "This surgical plan of yours is too risky.

cues.zh: 一旦失误患者没准又要投诉
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 shi1 wu4 huan4 zhe3 mei2 zhun3 you4 yao4 tou2 su4
cues.en: If there's a mistake, the patient might file a complaint again,

cues.zh: 法欧部还得忙着打官司
cues.pinyin: fa3 ou1 bu4 hai2 de2 mang2 zhe5 da3 guan1 si1
cues.en: and legal will be stuck dealing with lawsuits."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季】美女患有癫痫，一天不正常起码50次！还好天才医生有妙招

cues.zh: 可是谁能说服萨伦呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 shui2 neng2 shuo1 fu2 sa4 lun2 ne5
cues.en: But who could possibly talk Salen out of it?

cues.zh: 那家伙可是钻到前眼子里了
cues.pinyin: na4 jia1 huo5 ke3 shi4 zuan1 dao4 qian2 yan3 zi5 li3 le5
cues.en: That woman was obsessed with money through and through —

cues.zh: 心里眼里只有规避风险
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 yan3 li3 zhi3 you3 gui1 bi4 feng1 xian3
cues.en: all she cared about was avoiding risk

cues.zh: 少有麻烦
cues.pinyin: shao3 you3 ma2 fan2
cues.en: and minimizing trouble.

cues.zh: 于是安德鲁斯把主意打到了亚
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 ba3 zhu3 yi4 da3 dao4 le5 ya4
cues.en: So Andrews set her sights on

cues.zh: 伦院长的身上
cues.pinyin: lun2 yuan4 zhang3 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: Director Yalun instead.

cues.zh: 可是亚伦院长已经人老成精了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ya4 lun2 yuan4 zhang3 yi3 jing1 ren2 lao3 cheng2 jing1 le5
cues.en: But Director Yalun was already an old fox,

cues.zh: 才不会掺和到他们这些事中呢
cues.pinyin: cai2 bu2 hui4 chan1 huo5 dao4 ta1 men5 zhe4 xie1 shi4 zhong1 ne5
cues.en: and wasn't about to get mixed up in their business.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯实在没办法了
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 shi2 zai4 mei2 ban4 fa3 le5
cues.en: With no other options left,

cues.zh: 她只好硬着头皮去找萨伦
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 hao3 ying4 zhe5 tou2 pi2 qu4 zhao3 sa4 lun2
cues.en: Andrews had to swallow her pride and go find Salen.

cues.zh: 萨伦是一个杀人思路
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shi4 yi2 ge4 sha1 ren2 si1 lu4
cues.en: Salen was someone with a businessman's mindset,

cues.zh: 会衡量每一次手术的性价比
cues.pinyin: hui4 heng2 liang2 mei3 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4 de5 xing4 jia4 bi3
cues.en: who weighed the cost-effectiveness of every single surgery.

cues.zh: 或许帮梅姐做手术的性价比不高
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 bang1 mei2 jie3 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 xing4 jia4 bi3 bu4 gao1
cues.en: Operating on Sister Mei might not be very cost-effective,

cues.zh: 但是安德鲁斯打引卖身给她
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 da3 yin3 mai4 shen1 gei3 ta1
cues.en: but Andrews offered to indenture herself to her —

cues.zh: 帮她做牛做马
cues.pinyin: bang1 ta1 zuo4 niu2 zuo4 ma3
cues.en: to work tirelessly for her —

cues.zh: 做一次性价比低的手术
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ci4 xing4 jia4 bi3 di1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: doing one low-value surgery

cues.zh: 再做两次性价比高的手术如何
cues.pinyin: zai4 zuo4 liang3 ci4 xing4 jia4 bi3 gao1 de5 shou3 shu4 ru2 he2
cues.en: in exchange for doing two highly cost-effective ones. How about that?

cues.zh: 萨伦十分的开心同意了
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shi2 fen1 de5 kai1 xin1 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Salen was delighted and agreed.

cues.zh: 梅姐终于躺在手术台上了
cues.pinyin: mei2 jie3 zhong1 yu2 tang3 zai4 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 le5
cues.en: Sister Mei was finally lying on the operating table.

cues.zh: 医生们打开她的头盖骨
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 da3 kai1 ta1 de5 tou2 gai4 gu3
cues.en: The doctors opened up her skull.

cues.zh: 为了预防手术中出现偏差
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 yu4 fang2 shou3 shu4 zhong1 chu1 xian4 pian1 cha1
cues.en: To prevent any deviation during the surgery,

cues.zh: 朴医生他们特意用机器绘图
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 ta1 men5 te4 yi4 yong4 ji1 qi4 hui4 tu2
cues.en: Dr. Park and the others specially used machine mapping

cues.zh: 来识别运动性语言中枢皮层的边界
cues.pinyin: lai2 shi2 bie2 yun4 dong4 xing4 yu3 yan2 zhong1 shu1 pi2 ceng2 de5 bian1 jie4
cues.en: to identify the boundaries of the motor speech center cortex.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 全职妈妈有房不住，20年不断租房搬家：重新装修很上瘾 Stay-at-Home Mom Kept Moving for Two Decades: Redecor

cues.zh: 从小到大跟着爸爸妈妈习惯这种搬迁
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 dao4 da4 gen1 zhe5 ba4 ba4 ma1 ma1 xi2 guan4 zhe4 zhong3 ban1 qian1
cues.en: Growing up, I got used to moving around with my parents.

cues.zh: 我先生他是做石油行业的
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian1 sheng1 ta1 shi4 zuo4 shi2 you2 hang2 ye4 de5
cues.en: My husband works in the oil industry.

cues.zh: 一年就要换一个国家
cues.pinyin: yi1 nian2 jiu4 yao4 huan4 yi2 ge4 guo2 jia1
cues.en: We'd change countries almost every year.

cues.zh: 原来不得不搬之后就觉得上瘾了一样
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 bu4 de2 bu4 ban1 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 jue2 de5 shang4 yin3 le5 yi1 yang4
cues.en: At first we had no choice but to move, but later it felt almost addictive.

cues.zh: 从决定到搬家他都是一点没有参与的
cues.pinyin: cong2 jue2 ding4 dao4 ban1 jia1 ta1 dou1 shi4 yi4 dian3 mei2 you3 can1 yu4 de5
cues.en: From the decision to the actual move, he's never been involved at all.

cues.zh: 他是在国外待了好几个月
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 zai4 guo2 wai4 dai4 le5 hao3 ji3 ge4 yue4
cues.en: He'd be abroad for months at a time.

cues.zh: 他也搞不清楚到底哪是哪
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 gao3 bu4 qing1 chu3 dao4 di3 na3 shi4 na3
cues.en: He can't even tell which place is which.

cues.zh: 下飞机的时候我再给他发地址
cues.pinyin: xia4 fei1 ji1 de5 shi2 hou4 wo3 zai4 gei3 ta1 fa1 di4 zhi3
cues.en: I just send him the address after he lands.

cues.zh: 他就觉得他像进了一个新的 H ot el 一样的
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 jue2 de5 ta1 xiang4 jin4 le5 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 H ot el yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: He feels like he's just checking into a new hotel.

cues.zh: 特别开心
cues.pinyin: te4 bie2 kai1 xin1
cues.en: He's really happy about it.

cues.zh: 租到顶层公寓
cues.pinyin: zu1 dao4 ding3 ceng2 gong1 yu4
cues.en: We rented a penthouse apartment.

cues.zh: 我的日常生活基本上都是周边一公里解决
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 ri4 chang2 sheng1 huo2 ji1 ben3 shang4 dou1 shi4 zhou1 bian1 yi1 gong1 li3 jie3 jue2
cues.en: My daily life is basically handled within a one-kilometer radius.

cues.zh: 150 几坪
cues.pinyin: 150 ji3 ping2
cues.en: It's over 150 ping in size.

cues.zh: 4 个房间因为艺术品比较多
cues.pinyin: 4 ge4 fang2 jian1 yin1 wei4 yi4 shu4 pin3 bi3 jiao4 duo1
cues.en: Four bedrooms, since I have quite a lot of artworks.

cues.zh: 在找一个家的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhao3 yi2 ge4 jia1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I'm looking for a home,

cues.zh: 我会看有没有足够的墙面能够让我画画
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 kan4 you3 mei2 you3 zu2 gou4 de5 qiang2 mian4 neng2 gou4 rang4 wo3 hua4 hua4
cues.en: I check whether there's enough wall space for me to paint.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 全职妈妈有房不住，20年不断租房搬家：重新装修很上瘾 Stay-at-Home Mom Kept Moving for Two Decades: Redecor

cues.zh: 一进来首先看到了一面墙
cues.pinyin: yi1 jin4 lai2 shou3 xian1 kan4 dao4 le5 yi2 mian4 qiang2
cues.en: The moment I walk in, the first thing I see is a wall.

cues.zh: 想到我有一幅丁乙的作品
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 wo3 you3 yi1 fu2 ding1 yi3 de5 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: I thought of a piece I have by Ding Yi.

cues.zh: 基调是黑白
cues.pinyin: ji1 diao4 shi4 hei1 bai2
cues.en: The overall tone is black and white.

cues.zh: 沙发一定是白色的
cues.pinyin: sha1 fa1 yi2 ding4 shi4 bai2 se4 de5
cues.en: The sofa had to be white.

cues.zh: 黑色的茶几
cues.pinyin: hei1 se4 de5 cha2 ji1
cues.en: A black coffee table.

cues.zh: 找工厂订制的一个古董柜
cues.pinyin: zhao3 gong1 chang3 ding4 zhi4 de5 yi2 ge4 gu3 dong3 gui4
cues.en: I had a factory custom-make an antique-style cabinet.

cues.zh: 墙的颜色调整
cues.pinyin: qiang2 de5 yan2 se4 diao4 zheng3
cues.en: Adjusted the wall color.

cues.zh: 灯重新布置了一下
cues.pinyin: deng1 chong2 xin1 bu4 zhi4 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Rearranged the lighting a bit.

cues.zh: 年轻的时候工作真的很忙
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 gong1 zuo4 zhen1 de5 hen3 mang2
cues.en: When I was young, I was really busy with work.

cues.zh: 过了 30 之后决定生孩子了吧
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 30 zhi1 hou4 jue2 ding4 sheng1 hai2 zi5 le5 ba5
cues.en: After turning 30, I decided to have a kid.

cues.zh: 刚开始停下来的时候
cues.pinyin: gang1 kai1 shi3 ting2 xia4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I first stopped working,

cues.zh: 别人问你做什么
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 wen4 ni3 zuo4 shen2 me5
cues.en: when people asked what I did,

cues.zh: 在家带孩子就觉得
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 dai4 hai2 zi5 jiu4 jue2 de5
cues.en: saying 'I stay home with the kids' made me feel

cues.zh: 有点不好意思
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 bu4 hao3 yi4 si1
cues.en: a bit embarrassed.

cues.zh: 在那个时间节点开始
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 ge5 shi2 jian1 jie2 dian3 kai1 shi3
cues.en: Starting around that point in time,

cues.zh: 当代艺术收藏的
cues.pinyin: dang1 dai4 yi4 shu4 shou1 cang2 de5
cues.en: I began collecting contemporary art.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 全职妈妈有房不住，20年不断租房搬家：重新装修很上瘾 Stay-at-Home Mom Kept Moving for Two Decades: Redecor

cues.zh: 艺术给我带来了更深层次的自信和安全感
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 gei3 wo3 dai4 lai2 le5 geng1 shen1 ceng2 ci4 de5 zi4 xin4 he2 an1 quan2 gan3
cues.en: Art has given me a deeper sense of confidence and security.

cues.pinyin: 200 8 nian2

cues.zh: 我刚生完儿子
cues.pinyin: wo3 gang1 sheng1 wan2 er2 zi5
cues.en: I had just given birth to my son.

cues.zh: 想给家里面放两幅很漂亮的画
cues.pinyin: xiang3 gei3 jia1 li3 mian4 fang4 liang3 fu2 hen3 piao4 liang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: I wanted to put a couple of beautiful paintings in the house.

cues.zh: 第一幅作品我买的应该是张丽的
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 fu2 zuo4 pin3 wo3 mai3 de5 ying1 gai1 shi4 zhang1 li4 de5
cues.en: The first piece I bought was by Zhang Li, I think.

cues.zh: 第一次去了香格纳
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 qu4 le5 xiang1 ge2 na4
cues.en: The first time I went to ShanghART,

cues.zh: 看到它的展览说不清的感动
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 ta1 de5 zhan3 lan3 shuo1 bu4 qing1 de5 gan3 dong4
cues.en: seeing their exhibition moved me in a way I can't quite describe.

cues.zh: 收藏也就从那个时候开始了
cues.pinyin: shou1 cang2 ye3 jiu4 cong2 na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: That's when my collecting really began.

cues.zh: 到现在差不多有一百多件
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 cha4 bu5 duo1 you3 yi4 bai3 duo1 jian4
cues.en: By now I have over a hundred pieces.

cues.zh: 绘画为主
cues.pinyin: hui4 hua4 wei2 zhu3
cues.en: Mostly paintings.

cues.zh: 大概这个房子有二十几个作品
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 you3 er4 shi2 ji3 ge4 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: This house alone has around twenty-some pieces.

cues.zh: 父母家也挂了很多
cues.pinyin: fu4 mu3 jia1 ye3 gua4 le5 hen3 duo1
cues.en: My parents' place has a lot hanging too.

cues.zh: 剩下的都在仓库里面
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 dou1 zai4 cang1 ku4 li3 mian4
cues.en: The rest are all in storage.

cues.zh: 我先生过生日
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian1 sheng1 guo4 sheng1 ri4
cues.en: For my husband's birthday,

cues.zh: 想买一个作品送给我先生
cues.pinyin: xiang3 mai3 yi2 ge4 zuo4 pin3 song4 gei3 wo3 xian1 sheng1
cues.en: I wanted to buy a piece as a gift for him.

cues.zh: 觉得嗯长得有点像
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 n2 zhang3 de2 you3 dian3 xiang4
cues.en: I thought, well, it kind of looks like him.

cues.zh: 每一个来的客人都喜欢客厅里的这一幅
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 lai2 de5 ke4 ren2 dou1 xi3 huan1 ke4 ting1 li3 de5 zhe4 yi1 fu2
cues.en: Every guest who visits loves this piece in the living room.

cues.zh: 女儿房间玫红色的爱的礼物
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 fang2 jian1 mei2 hong2 se4 de5 ai4 de5 li3 wu4
cues.en: In my daughter's room is the rose-red piece 'Gift of Love.'

cues.zh: 一根一根的刺
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1 yi1 gen1 de5 ci4
cues.en: Made up of spike after spike.

cues.zh: 爱有的时候就是这样嘛
cues.pinyin: ai4 you3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 ma5
cues.en: That's just what love is like sometimes.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 全职妈妈有房不住，20年不断租房搬家：重新装修很上瘾 Stay-at-Home Mom Kept Moving for Two Decades: Redecor

cues.zh: 有甜蜜有艰辛
cues.pinyin: you3 tian2 mi4 you3 jian1 xin1
cues.en: There's sweetness, and there's hardship.

cues.zh: 我们两个虽然是国际家庭
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 liang3 ge4 sui1 ran2 shi4 guo2 ji4 jia1 ting2
cues.en: Even though we're an international family,

cues.zh: 都还是蛮传统的
cues.pinyin: dou1 hai2 shi4 man2 chuan2 tong3 de5
cues.en: we're both still pretty traditional.

cues.zh: 经济是不分的
cues.pinyin: jing1 ji4 shi4 bu4 fen1 de5
cues.en: We don't separate our finances.

cues.zh: 大笔的支出会做商量
cues.pinyin: da4 bi3 de5 zhi1 chu1 hui4 zuo4 shang1 liang2
cues.en: For big expenses, we discuss it together.

cues.zh: 买作品量力而行
cues.pinyin: mai3 zuo4 pin3 liang4 li4 er2 xing2
cues.en: When buying art, I go by what I can afford.

cues.zh: 完全是因为喜欢
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 shi4 yin1 wei4 xi3 huan1
cues.en: It's purely because I love it.

cues.zh: 只收当代艺术作品
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shou1 dang1 dai4 yi4 shu4 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: I only collect contemporary art.

cues.zh: 因为我活在当下
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 huo2 zai4 dang1 xia4
cues.en: Because I live in the present.

cues.zh: 对艺术家都是一种支持
cues.pinyin: dui4 yi4 shu4 jia1 dou1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 zhi1 chi2
cues.en: And it's also a way of supporting the artists.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026美国最新灾难大片《深水》！ 2大奥斯卡影帝领衔主演，真实还原飞机空难全过程

cues.zh: 这绝对是 20 26 年最精彩的一部空难生存片
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jue2 dui4 shi4 20 26 nian2 zui4 jing1 cai3 de5 yi1 bu4 kong1 nan4 sheng1 cun2 pian4
cues.en: This is definitely the most thrilling plane-crash survival movie of 2026.

cues.zh: 讲述了不同国家
cues.pinyin: jiang3 shu4 le5 bu4 tong2 guo2 jia1
cues.en: It tells the story of a group of people from different countries,

cues.zh: 背景各异的一群人在灾难来临的生死关头
cues.pinyin: bei4 jing3 ge4 yi4 de5 yi1 qun2 ren2 zai4 zai1 nan4 lai2 lin2 de5 sheng1 si3 guan1 tou2
cues.en: with vastly different backgrounds, who face a life-and-death disaster,

cues.zh: 最终不计前嫌死里逃生的故事
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 bu4 ji4 qian2 xian2 si3 li3 tao2 sheng1 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: and ultimately set aside their grudges to survive.

cues.zh: 在传统空难片的基础上
cues.pinyin: zai4 chuan2 tong3 kong1 nan4 pian4 de5 ji1 chu3 shang4
cues.en: Building on traditional disaster films,

cues.zh: 将人性中团结互助
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ren2 xing4 zhong1 tuan2 jie2 hu4 zhu4
cues.en: it amplifies the shining qualities of human unity and mutual aid,

cues.zh: 有爱包容的闪光点放大
cues.pinyin: you3 ai4 bao1 rong2 de5 shan3 guang1 dian3 fang4 da4
cues.en: as well as love and tolerance,

cues.zh: 书写了一群可歌可泣的动人故事影片开始
cues.pinyin: shu1 xie3 le5 yi1 qun2 ke3 ge1 ke3 qi4 de5 dong4 ren2 gu4 shi4 ying3 pian4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: writing a moving, unforgettable story. The film begins

cues.zh: 为了给患癌的儿子治病筹钱
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 gei3 huan4 ai2 de5 er2 zi5 zhi4 bing4 chou2 qian2
cues.en: with a copilot trying to raise money to treat his son's cancer.

cues.zh: 经验老道的副机长本选择多加一次班
cues.pinyin: jing1 yan4 lao3 dao4 de5 fu4 ji1 zhang3 ben3 xuan3 ze2 duo1 jia1 yi1 ci4 ban1
cues.en: The experienced copilot, Ben, chooses to take an extra shift,

cues.zh: 从洛杉矶飞往上海
cues.pinyin: cong2 luo4 shan1 ji1 fei1 wang3 shang4 hai3
cues.en: flying from Los Angeles to Shanghai.

cues.zh: 坐这趟飞机的乘客有很多
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zhe4 tang4 fei1 ji1 de5 cheng2 ke4 you3 hen3 duo1
cues.en: There are many passengers on this flight.

cues.zh: 他们来自不同地方
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 lai2 zi4 bu4 tong2 di4 fang1
cues.en: They come from different places.

cues.zh: 有刚在美国参加完比赛的哈奇和
cues.pinyin: you3 gang1 zai4 mei3 guo2 can1 jia1 wan2 bi3 sai4 de5 ha1 qi2 he2
cues.en: There's Hatch, who just finished a competition in the US,

cues.zh: 他的队友教练
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 dui4 you3 jiao4 lian4
cues.en: along with his teammate and coach,

cues.zh: 以及他们的中国对手青年李和女朋友丽莎
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 ta1 men5 de5 zhong1 guo2 dui4 shou3 qing1 nian2 li3 he2 nv3 peng2 you3 li4 sha1
cues.en: as well as their Chinese rival, young Li, and his girlfriend Lisa.

cues.zh: 还有一位幽默风趣的卷毛大叔
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 wei4 you1 mo4 feng1 qu4 de5 juan3 mao2 da4 shu1
cues.en: There's also a humorous uncle with curly hair,

cues.zh: 一家刚组建不久的二婚家庭
cues.pinyin: yi1 jia1 gang1 zu3 jian4 bu4 jiu3 de5 er4 hun1 jia1 ting2
cues.en: and a newly blended family from a second marriage.

cues.zh: 上飞机前
cues.pinyin: shang4 fei1 ji1 qian2
cues.en: Before boarding the plane,

cues.zh: 副机长本还亲切的
cues.pinyin: fu4 ji1 zhang3 ben3 hai2 qin1 qie4 de5
cues.en: copilot Ben warmly

cues.zh: 和二婚家庭中的小女儿柯拉有过一面之缘
cues.pinyin: he2 er4 hun1 jia1 ting2 zhong1 de5 xiao3 nv3 er2 ke1 la1 you3 guo4 yi2 mian4 zhi1 yuan2
cues.en: had a brief encounter with Cora, the little girl from the blended family.

cues.zh: 可爱的小女孩对本很是好奇
cues.pinyin: ke3 ai4 de5 xiao3 nv3 hai2 dui4 ben3 hen3 shi4 hao4 qi2
cues.en: The cute little girl was very curious about Ben,

cues.zh: 为何本年纪看起来如此之大
cues.pinyin: wei4 he2 ben3 nian2 ji4 kan4 qi3 lai2 ru2 ci3 zhi1 da4
cues.en: wondering why he looked so old.
