cues.zh: 更有意思的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 you3 yi4 si5 de5 shi4
cues.en: What's even more interesting is,

cues.zh: 本次航班的机长也是一位年逾古稀
cues.pinyin: ben3 ci4 hang2 ban1 de5 ji1 zhang3 ye3 shi4 yi1 wei4 nian2 yu2 gu3 xi1
cues.en: the captain of this flight is also an elderly man

cues.zh: 的老头理查德
cues.pinyin: de5 lao3 tou2 li3 cha2 de2
cues.en: in his seventies, named Richard.

cues.zh: 或许看到年迈的机长
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 kan4 dao4 nian2 mai4 de5 ji1 zhang3
cues.en: Perhaps if she'd seen the elderly captain first,

cues.zh: 科拉就不会问出如此没礼貌的问题了
cues.pinyin: ke1 la1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 wen4 chu1 ru2 ci3 mei2 li3 mao4 de5 wen4 ti2 le5
cues.en: Cora wouldn't have asked such a rude question.

cues.zh: 一切准备就绪
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 zhun3 bei4 jiu4 xu4
cues.en: Everything is ready.

cues.zh: 飞机如一道细细的光刺破广阔的苍穹
cues.pinyin: fei1 ji1 ru2 yi1 dao4 xi4 xi4 de5 guang1 ci4 po4 guang3 kuo4 de5 cang1 qiong2
cues.en: The plane, like a thin beam of light, pierces the vast sky.

cues.zh: 突然一阵气流冲击过来
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 yi1 zhen4 qi4 liu2 chong1 ji1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Suddenly a gust of turbulence hits,

cues.zh: 导致飞机剧烈震颤了一下
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 fei1 ji1 ju4 lie4 zhen4 chan4 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: causing the plane to shake violently.

cues.zh: 一位胡子大叔忙向身旁的美女开启了玩笑
cues.pinyin: yi1 wei4 hu2 zi5 da4 shu1 mang2 xiang4 shen1 pang2 de5 mei3 nv3 kai1 qi3 le5 wan2 xiao4
cues.en: A bearded uncle hurries to joke with the pretty woman beside him.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026美国最新灾难大片《深水》！ 2大奥斯卡影帝领衔主演，真实还原飞机空难全过程

cues.zh: 源于前货舱的一个箱子
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yu2 qian2 huo4 cang1 de5 yi2 ge4 xiang1 zi5
cues.en: It stems from a box in the forward cargo hold,

cues.zh: 里面装着一大块锂电池
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 zhuang1 zhe5 yi1 da4 kuai4 li3 dian4 chi2
cues.en: which contains a large lithium battery.

cues.zh: 在长时间的运送途中
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhang3 shi2 jian1 de5 yun4 song4 tu2 zhong1
cues.en: During the long transport,

cues.zh: 耐受不住高温的锂电池突然燃烧了起来
cues.pinyin: nai4 shou4 bu2 zhu4 gao1 wen1 de5 li3 dian4 chi2 tu1 ran2 ran2 shao1 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: the lithium battery, unable to withstand the heat, suddenly catches fire.

cues.zh: 前货舱起火
cues.pinyin: qian2 huo4 cang1 qi3 huo3
cues.en: The forward cargo hold catches fire.

cues.zh: 这突如其来的消息瞬间让机长副
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tu1 ru2 qi2 lai2 de5 xiao1 xi1 shun4 jian1 rang4 ji1 zhang3 fu4
cues.en: This sudden news instantly leaves the captain and

cues.zh: 机长都惊呆了
cues.pinyin: ji1 zhang3 dou1 jing1 dai1 le5
cues.en: copilot stunned.

cues.zh: 他们不敢懈怠
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 gan3 xie4 dai4
cues.en: They dare not slack off,

cues.zh: 忙释放灭火器
cues.pinyin: mang2 shi4 fang4 mie4 huo3 qi4
cues.en: and rush to grab the fire extinguishers,

cues.zh: 命令机组人员去消灭火情
cues.pinyin: ming4 ling4 ji1 zu3 ren2 yuan2 qu4 xiao1 mie4 huo3 qing2
cues.en: ordering the crew to put out the fire.

cues.zh: 几个全副武装的安保人员拿起灭火器
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 quan2 fu4 wu3 zhuang1 de5 an1 bao3 ren2 yuan2 na2 qi3 mie4 huo3 qi4
cues.en: Several fully armed security personnel grab fire extinguishers

cues.zh: 吓到货舱
cues.pinyin: xia4 dao4 huo4 cang1
cues.en: and rush to the cargo hold.

cues.zh: 果然看见货舱里的锂电池箱冒着熊熊烈火
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 kan4 jian4 huo4 cang1 li3 de5 li3 dian4 chi2 xiang1 mao4 zhe5 xiong2 xiong2 lie4 huo3
cues.en: Sure enough, they see the lithium battery case blazing with fierce fire.

cues.zh: 原以为火情能得到控制
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yi3 wei2 huo3 qing2 neng2 de2 dao4 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: They thought the fire could be brought under control,

cues.zh: 可突然货架上的锂电池箱由于气流的
cues.pinyin: ke3 tu1 ran2 huo4 jia4 shang4 de5 li3 dian4 chi2 xiang1 you2 yu2 qi4 liu2 de5
cues.en: but suddenly, due to the airflow,

cues.zh: 原因固定不稳
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yin1 gu4 ding4 bu4 wen3
cues.en: the lithium battery case on the rack becomes unstable

cues.zh: 朝旧声援这边滑来
cues.pinyin: chao2 jiu4 sheng1 yuan2 zhe4 bian1 hua2 lai2
cues.en: and slides toward the side nearby.

cues.zh: 而滑行的过程中
cues.pinyin: er2 hua2 xing2 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: During the slide,

cues.zh: 锂电池更是发生了爆炸
cues.pinyin: li3 dian4 chi2 geng4 shi4 fa1 sheng1 le5 bao4 zha4
cues.en: the lithium battery actually explodes,

cues.zh: 在飞机上直接撕开了一道口子
cues.pinyin: zai4 fei1 ji1 shang4 zhi2 jie1 si1 kai1 le5 yi1 dao4 kou3 zi5
cues.en: tearing a hole directly through the plane.

cues.zh: 强大的对冲气流迅速冲进了机舱
cues.pinyin: qiang2 da4 de5 dui4 chong1 qi4 liu2 xun4 su4 chong1 jin4 le5 ji1 cang1
cues.en: A powerful counter-airflow rushes into the cabin,

cues.zh: 到处都是人们的尖叫声
cues.pinyin: dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 ren2 men5 de5 jian1 jiao4 sheng1
cues.en: and screams fill the air everywhere.

cues.zh: 交集寻找妈妈的小女孩克拉也
cues.pinyin: jiao1 ji2 xun2 zhao3 ma1 ma1 de5 xiao3 nv3 hai2 ke4 la1 ye3
cues.en: The little girl Cora, anxiously searching for her mom,

cues.zh: 因强大的冲击
cues.pinyin: yin1 qiang2 da4 de5 chong1 ji1
cues.en: is knocked to the ground

cues.zh: 力摔倒在地上
cues.pinyin: li4 shuai1 dao3 zai4 di4 shang4
cues.en: by the powerful impact.

cues.zh: 幸亏女学生丽莎将其及时拉住
cues.pinyin: xing4 kui1 nv3 xue2 sheng1 li4 sha1 jiang1 qi2 ji2 shi2 la1 zhu4
cues.en: Luckily, the student Lisa grabs her in time.

cues.zh: 在厕所里放飞自我的小情侣头
cues.pinyin: zai4 ce4 suo3 li3 fang4 fei1 zi4 wo3 de5 xiao3 qing2 lv3 tou2
cues.en: In the bathroom, a young couple lost in the moment have their heads

cues.zh: 直接撞碎玻璃
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 zhuang4 sui4 bo1 li2
cues.en: smash straight through the glass.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026美国最新灾难大片《深水》！ 2大奥斯卡影帝领衔主演，真实还原飞机空难全过程

cues.zh: 正意味着飞机将要在一片茫茫的大
cues.pinyin: zheng4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 fei1 ji1 jiang1 yao4 zai4 yi1 pian4 mang2 mang2 de5 da4
cues.en: This means the plane is about to make an emergency landing

cues.zh: 海中进行迫降
cues.pinyin: hai3 zhong1 jin4 xing2 po4 jiang4
cues.en: in the vast, empty ocean.

cues.zh: 终于由于涡轮长时间的着火
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 you2 yu2 wo1 lun2 zhang3 shi2 jian1 de5 zhao2 huo3
cues.en: Finally, because the turbine has been on fire for so long,

cues.zh: 渐渐整架飞机失去了动力
cues.pinyin: jian4 jian4 zheng3 jia4 fei1 ji1 shi1 qu4 le5 dong4 li4
cues.en: the entire plane gradually loses power.

cues.zh: 理查德和本只得挑选海面进行迫降
cues.pinyin: li3 cha2 de2 he2 ben3 zhi3 de2 tiao1 xuan3 hai3 mian4 jin4 xing2 po4 jiang4
cues.en: Richard and Ben have no choice but to pick the sea surface for the landing.

cues.zh: 他们冷静地在驾驶舱内发布指令
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 leng3 jing4 di4 zai4 jia4 shi3 cang1 nei4 fa1 bu4 zhi3 ling4
cues.en: They calmly give orders inside the cockpit.

cues.zh: 即便到了可能是生命的最后一刻
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 dao4 le5 ke3 neng2 shi4 sheng1 ming4 de5 zui4 hou4 yi2 ke4
cues.en: Even as they reach what may be the final moment of their lives,

cues.zh: 二人还是尽职尽责地完成了迫降任务
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 hai2 shi4 jin4 zhi2 jin4 ze2 di4 wan2 cheng2 le5 po4 jiang4 ren4 wu4
cues.en: the two of them still dutifully complete the emergency landing.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026美国最新灾难大片《深水》！ 2大奥斯卡影帝领衔主演，真实还原飞机空难全过程

cues.zh: 最后飞机的机翼划过海面
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 fei1 ji1 de5 ji1 yi4 hua2 guo4 hai3 mian4
cues.en: In the end, the plane's wing skims across the sea surface,

cues.zh: 原本波澜不惊的海面激起阵阵浪花
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ben3 bo1 lan2 bu4 jing1 de5 hai3 mian4 ji1 qi3 zhen4 zhen4 lang4 hua1
cues.en: and the once-calm ocean kicks up waves.

cues.zh: 大量海水开始沿着缝隙向飞机里
cues.pinyin: da4 liang4 hai3 shui3 kai1 shi3 yan2 zhe5 feng4 xi4 xiang4 fei1 ji1 li3
cues.en: A huge amount of seawater starts seeping into the plane through the cracks,

cues.zh: 蔓延渗透进来
cues.pinyin: man4 yan2 shen4 tou4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: spreading and flooding in.

cues.zh: 水与火开始互相交融
cues.pinyin: shui3 yu3 huo3 kai1 shi3 hu4 xiang1 jiao1 rong2
cues.en: Water and fire begin to merge,

cues.zh: 将这群天选的受难者彻底置于
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zhe4 qun2 tian1 xuan3 de5 shou4 nan4 zhe3 che4 di3 zhi4 yu2
cues.en: putting this group of chosen victims completely

cues.zh: 水深火热之中
cues.pinyin: shui3 shen1 huo3 re4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: into deep water and raging fire.

cues.zh: 飞机也不堪重负开始锻炼
cues.pinyin: fei1 ji1 ye3 bu4 kan1 zhong4 fu4 kai1 shi3 duan4 lian4
cues.en: The plane, unable to bear the strain, begins to break apart,

cues.zh: 大量的海水漫灌进了飞机里
cues.pinyin: da4 liang4 de5 hai3 shui3 man4 guan4 jin4 le5 fei1 ji1 li3
cues.en: as massive amounts of seawater flood into it.

cues.zh: 无数鲜活的生命葬送在了茫茫大海上
cues.pinyin: wu2 shu4 xian1 huo2 de5 sheng1 ming4 zang4 song4 zai4 le5 mang2 mang2 da4 hai3 shang4
cues.en: Countless vibrant lives are lost in the vast ocean.

cues.zh: 驾驶舱内本上处在清醒状态
cues.pinyin: jia4 shi3 cang1 nei4 ben3 shang4 chu4 zai4 qing1 xing3 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: Inside the cockpit, Ben is still conscious,

cues.zh: 然而机长理查德却倒伏在仪表盘上
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ji1 zhang3 li3 cha2 de2 que4 dao3 fu2 zai4 yi2 biao3 pan2 shang4
cues.en: but Captain Richard lies slumped over the instrument panel,

cues.zh: 昏迷不醒
cues.pinyin: hun1 mi2 bu4 xing3
cues.en: unconscious.

cues.zh: 本急忙同身旁的黑妹一同帮助理查德
cues.pinyin: ben3 ji2 mang2 tong2 shen1 pang2 de5 hei1 mei4 yi1 tong2 bang1 zhu4 li3 cha2 de2
cues.en: Ben hurries to help Richard along with the flight attendant, Sister Hei,

cues.zh: 解脱出驾驶位
cues.pinyin: jie3 tuo1 chu1 jia4 shi3 wei4
cues.en: to free him from the pilot's seat.

cues.zh: 可飞机突出的零部件正好压住
cues.pinyin: ke3 fei1 ji1 tu1 chu1 de5 ling2 bu4 jian4 zheng4 hao3 ya1 zhu4
cues.en: But a protruding piece of the plane's wreckage pins down

cues.zh: 理查德的大腿
cues.pinyin: li3 cha2 de2 de5 da4 tui3
cues.en: Richard's leg,

cues.zh: 令他难以动弹
cues.pinyin: ling4 ta1 nan2 yi3 dong4 tan2
cues.en: making it impossible for him to move.

cues.zh: 这是理查德被剧烈的疼痛唤醒
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 li3 cha2 de2 bei4 ju4 lie4 de5 teng2 tong4 huan4 xing3
cues.en: At that moment, Richard is jolted awake by intense pain.

cues.zh: 正当三人想办法如何解脱时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 dang1 san1 ren2 xiang3 ban4 fa3 ru2 he2 jie3 tuo1 shi2
cues.en: Just as the three of them are trying to figure out how to free him,

cues.zh: 受到压力开始破裂的玻璃窗却提醒三
cues.pinyin: shou4 dao4 ya1 li4 kai1 shi3 po4 lie4 de5 bo1 li2 chuang1 que4 ti2 xing3 san1
cues.en: the glass window, cracking under pressure, reminds the three of them

cues.zh: 人时间不多了
cues.pinyin: ren2 shi2 jian1 bu4 duo1 le5
cues.en: that time is running out.

cues.zh: 理查德只好劝他们赶快离开
cues.pinyin: li3 cha2 de2 zhi3 hao3 quan4 ta1 men5 gan3 kuai4 li2 kai1
cues.en: Richard urges them to leave quickly.

cues.zh: 外面还有很多的人要求
cues.pinyin: wai4 mian4 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 ren2 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: There are still many people outside who need help,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2026美国最新灾难大片《深水》！ 2大奥斯卡影帝领衔主演，真实还原飞机空难全过程

cues.zh: 亲自前往机身中部
cues.pinyin: qin1 zi4 qian2 wang3 ji1 shen1 zhong1 bu4
cues.en: requesting someone go in person to the mid-fuselage section,

cues.zh: 那里会有更多的幸存者
cues.pinyin: na4 li3 hui4 you3 geng4 duo1 de5 xing4 cun2 zhe3
cues.en: where there would be more survivors.

cues.zh: 然而空姐黑妹却自告奋勇承担
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 kong1 jie3 hei1 mei4 que4 zi4 gao4 fen4 yong3 cheng2 dan1
cues.en: However, the flight attendant Sister Hei volunteers to take on

cues.zh: 起了这个重任
cues.pinyin: qi3 le5 zhe4 ge5 zhong4 ren4
cues.en: this important task.

cues.zh: 他还不需要救生法
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 bu4 xu1 yao4 jiu4 sheng1 fa3
cues.en: She doesn't even need a life raft;

cues.zh: 想凭借游泳水瓶完成任务
cues.pinyin: xiang3 ping2 jie4 you2 yong3 shui3 ping2 wan2 cheng2 ren4 wu4
cues.en: she wants to complete the mission relying on her swimming skills.

cues.zh: 本答应了他
cues.pinyin: ben3 da1 ying4 le5 ta1
cues.en: Ben agrees to let her.

cues.zh: 于是空姐一个猛子扎进水里
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 kong1 jie3 yi2 ge4 meng3 zi5 zha1 jin4 shui3 li3
cues.en: So the flight attendant dives straight into the water,

cues.zh: 施展灵活且娴熟的自由泳向远方游去
cues.pinyin: shi1 zhan3 ling2 huo2 qie3 xian2 shu2 de5 zi4 you2 yong3 xiang4 yuan3 fang1 you2 qu4
cues.en: swimming off into the distance with a flexible, skilled freestyle stroke.

cues.zh: 谁知道刚游到一半
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dao4 gang1 you2 dao4 yi2 ban4
cues.en: But who knew, just halfway there,

cues.zh: 机舱上的本和女孩科拉就发现
cues.pinyin: ji1 cang1 shang4 de5 ben3 he2 nv3 hai2 ke1 la1 jiu4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Ben and the girl Cora, up in the cabin, spot

cues.zh: 了一条大鲨鱼
cues.pinyin: le5 yi1 tiao2 da4 sha1 yu2
cues.en: a large shark.

cues.zh: 本和科拉迅速打开救生阀
cues.pinyin: ben3 he2 ke1 la1 xun4 su4 da3 kai1 jiu4 sheng1 fa2
cues.en: Ben and Cora quickly open the life raft

cues.zh: 向黑妹追去
cues.pinyin: xiang4 hei1 mei4 zhui1 qu4
cues.en: and chase after Sister Hei.

cues.zh: 黑妹意识到了危险
cues.pinyin: hei1 mei4 yi4 shi2 dao4 le5 wei1 xian3
cues.en: Sister Hei realizes the danger

cues.zh: 正惊慌失措向救生阀游去时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 jing1 huang1 shi1 cuo4 xiang4 jiu4 sheng1 fa2 you2 qu4 shi2
cues.en: and panics, swimming toward the life raft,

cues.zh: 大腿却被鲨鱼死死咬住
cues.pinyin: da4 tui3 que4 bei4 sha1 yu2 si3 si3 yao3 zhu4
cues.en: but the shark clamps down hard on her leg.

cues.zh: 最终黑妹被鲨鱼吞噬
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 hei1 mei4 bei4 sha1 yu2 tun1 shi4
cues.en: In the end, Sister Hei is devoured by the shark,

cues.zh: 水面上只留下一滩红色的鲜血
cues.pinyin: shui3 mian4 shang4 zhi3 liu2 xia4 yi1 tan1 hong2 se4 de5 xian1 xue4
cues.en: leaving only a pool of red blood on the water's surface.

cues.zh: 此时鲨鱼还想吃掉救生阀上剩下的两人
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 sha1 yu2 hai2 xiang3 chi1 diao4 jiu4 sheng1 fa2 shang4 sheng4 xia4 de5 liang3 ren2
cues.en: At this moment, the shark still wants to eat the two people left on the raft.

cues.zh: 本拼命拿奖砸向他的头
cues.pinyin: ben3 pin1 ming4 na2 jiang3 za2 xiang4 ta1 de5 tou2
cues.en: Ben desperately smashes an oar against its head,

cues.zh: 才将他逼退
cues.pinyin: cai2 jiang1 ta1 bi1 tui4
cues.en: finally forcing it to retreat.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 在中部机舱
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 bu4 ji1 cang1
cues.en: in the mid-section of the cabin,

cues.zh: 巨大的压力使机舱边的那块甲板再也
cues.pinyin: ju4 da4 de5 ya1 li4 shi3 ji1 cang1 bian1 de5 na4 kuai4 jia3 ban3 zai4 ye3
cues.en: the enormous pressure makes the deck panel by the cabin wall

cues.zh: 承受不住压力
cues.pinyin: cheng2 shou4 bu2 zhu4 ya1 li4
cues.en: unable to withstand the strain any longer,

cues.zh: 最后猛然断裂
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 meng3 ran2 duan4 lie4
cues.en: and it suddenly breaks apart.

cues.zh: 长发女子不慎落入水中
cues.pinyin: chang2 fa4 nv3 zi3 bu4 shen4 luo4 ru4 shui3 zhong1
cues.en: A long-haired woman accidentally falls into the water,

cues.zh: 幸好周边人拼命救援
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 zhou1 bian1 ren2 pin1 ming4 jiu4 yuan2
cues.en: but luckily the people nearby rush to save her.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友跟我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a young student told me

cues.zh: 他每天睡觉都会做梦
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei3 tian1 shui4 jiao4 du1 hui4 zuo4 meng4
cues.en: that he dreams every night when he sleeps.

cues.zh: 有的时候梦见自己找不到厕所
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 meng4 jian4 zi4 ji3 zhao3 bu2 dao4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: Sometimes he dreams he can't find a bathroom,

cues.zh: 或者厕所非常脏非常拥挤
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 ce4 suo3 fei1 chang2 zang4 fei1 chang2 yong1 ji3
cues.en: or that the bathroom is extremely dirty and crowded.

cues.zh: 有的时候梦见自己只穿了上衣
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 meng4 jian4 zi4 ji3 zhi3 chuan1 le5 shang4 yi1
cues.en: Sometimes he dreams he's only wearing a top,

cues.zh: 没穿裤子非常尴尬
cues.pinyin: mei2 chuan1 ku4 zi5 fei1 chang2 gan1 ga4
cues.en: with no pants on, which is very embarrassing.

cues.zh: 有的时候梦见自己的父亲或者
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 meng4 jian4 zi4 ji3 de5 fu4 qin1 huo4 zhe3
cues.en: Sometimes he dreams that his father or

cues.zh: 母亲去世哭醒
cues.pinyin: mu3 qin1 qu4 shi4 ku1 xing3
cues.en: mother has died, and he wakes up crying.

cues.zh: 有的时候梦见自己考试什么都不会
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 meng4 jian4 zi4 ji3 kao3 shi4 shen2 me5 dou1 bu2 hui4
cues.en: Sometimes he dreams he's taking an exam and doesn't know any of the answers,

cues.zh: 急得满头大汗
cues.pinyin: ji2 de2 man3 tou2 da4 han2
cues.en: sweating with anxiety.

cues.zh: 可是自己明明已经大学毕业好多年了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zi4 ji3 ming2 ming2 yi3 jing1 da4 xue2 bi4 ye4 hao3 duo1 nian2 le5
cues.en: But he clearly graduated from college years ago.

cues.zh: 他想问我这些梦有什么特殊的含义吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wen4 wo3 zhe4 xie1 meng4 you3 shen2 me5 te4 shu1 de5 han2 yi4 ma5
cues.en: He wanted to ask me if these dreams have any special meaning,

cues.zh: 为什么会反复出现呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 fan3 fu4 chu1 xian4 ne5
cues.en: and why they keep recurring.

cues.zh: 最近我看了一本很著名的书
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 wo3 kan4 le5 yi1 ben3 hen3 zhu4 ming2 de5 shu1
cues.en: Recently I read a very famous book,

cues.zh: 奥地利心理学家西格蒙德
cues.pinyin: ao4 di4 li4 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xi1 ge2 meng2 de2
cues.en: by the Austrian psychologist Sigmund

cues.zh: 弗洛伊德的梦的解析
cues.pinyin: fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 de5 meng4 de5 jie3 xi1
cues.en: Freud — 'The Interpretation of Dreams.'

cues.zh: 这一回我就跟大家一起分享一下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 hui2 wo3 jiu4 gen1 da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 fen1 xiang3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: This time I'll share with everyone

cues.zh: 我的读书心得
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 du2 shu1 xin1 de2
cues.en: my thoughts on reading it.

cues.zh: 没准能解答你的疑问
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhun3 neng2 jie3 da2 ni3 de5 yi2 wen4
cues.en: Maybe it can answer your questions.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来简单介绍一下这本书的
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 jian3 dan1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 de5
cues.en: First, let's briefly introduce this book's

cues.zh: 作者弗洛伊德
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zhe3 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2
cues.en: author, Freud.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 弗洛伊德奥地利的心理学家
cues.pinyin: fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 ao4 di4 li4 de5 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Freud was an Austrian psychologist.

cues.zh: 他出生于 18 56 年出生于奥匈帝国
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu1 sheng1 yu2 18 56 nian2 chu1 sheng1 yu2 ao4 xiong1 di4 guo2
cues.en: He was born in 1856 in the Austro-Hungarian Empire.

cues.zh: 那么他是一个犹太人
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 you2 tai4 ren2
cues.en: He was Jewish.

cues.zh: 他出生在一个犹太的商人家庭犹太人
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu1 sheng1 zai4 yi2 ge4 you2 tai4 de5 shang1 ren2 jia1 ting2 you2 tai4 ren2
cues.en: He was born into a Jewish merchant family.

cues.zh: 他的父亲比他的母亲大了 20 岁
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fu4 qin1 bi3 ta1 de5 mu3 qin1 da4 le5 20 sui4
cues.en: His father was 20 years older than his mother.

cues.zh: 所以他有的时候觉得父亲好像像爷爷一样
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 you3 de5 shi2 hou4 jue2 de5 fu4 qin1 hao3 xiang4 xiang4 ye2 ye2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: So sometimes he felt his father seemed more like a grandfather,

cues.zh: 他的哥哥倒像是父亲一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 di1 ge1 ge1 dao4 xiang4 shi4 fu4 qin1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: while his older brother seemed more like a father.

cues.zh: 那么他是精神分析法的创始人
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 shi4 jing1 shen2 fen1 xi1 fa3 de5 chuang4 shi3 ren2
cues.en: He was the founder of psychoanalysis.

cues.zh: 他开创了精神分析的这样的一种方法
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 chuang4 le5 jing1 shen2 fen1 xi1 de5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi1 zhong3 fang1 fa3
cues.en: He pioneered this method of psychoanalysis,

cues.zh: 精神分析的方法
cues.pinyin: jing1 shen2 fen1 xi1 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: the psychoanalytic method.

cues.zh: 所以他有很多的推崇者
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 tui1 chong2 zhe3
cues.en: So he had many admirers.

cues.zh: 他推崇者认为
cues.pinyin: ta1 tui1 chong2 zhe3 ren4 wei2
cues.en: His admirers believed

cues.zh: 普洛伊德是世界上三个最伟大
cues.pinyin: pu3 luo4 yi1 de2 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 san1 ge4 zui4 wei3 da4
cues.en: that Freud was one of the three greatest

cues.zh: 的犹太人之一
cues.pinyin: de5 you2 tai4 ren2 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: Jewish people in the world.

cues.zh: 那么另外两个是爱因斯坦和马克思
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ling4 wai4 liang3 ge4 shi4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 he2 ma3 ke4 si1
cues.en: The other two were Einstein and Marx.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 抑郑病也叫歇斯底里症
cues.pinyin: yi4 zheng4 bing4 ye3 jiao4 xie1 si1 di3 li3 zheng4
cues.en: Hysteria is also called the 'yì zhèng' disorder.

cues.zh: 那么当时对于抑郑的治疗方法有这么几种
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dang1 shi2 dui4 yu2 yi4 zheng4 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 fa3 you3 zhe4 me5 ji3 zhong3
cues.en: At the time, there were several treatments for hysteria,

cues.zh: 比如说像电击
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 xiang4 dian4 ji1
cues.en: such as electric shock,

cues.zh: 像水浴把人头按水里
cues.pinyin: xiang4 shui3 yu4 ba3 ren2 tou2 an4 shui3 li3
cues.en: or water therapy where the person's head was pushed into water,

cues.zh: 是不是按摩肯定也不会特别舒服
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 an4 mo2 ken3 ding4 ye3 bu2 hui4 te4 bie2 shu1 fu2
cues.en: or massage — none of which could have been very pleasant.

cues.zh: 反正这些方法对抑郁可能效果也不大
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zhe4 xie1 fang1 fa3 dui4 yi4 yu4 ke3 neng2 xiao4 guo3 ye3 bu4 da4
cues.en: Anyway, none of these methods were very effective for hysteria.

cues.zh: 反正这些方法对癔症可能效果也不大
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zhe4 xie1 fang1 fa3 dui4 yi4 zheng4 ke3 neng2 xiao4 guo3 ye3 bu4 da4
cues.en: He later discovered that if you could guide the patient

cues.zh: 把他心里面的这些话说出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 xin1 li3 mian4 de5 zhe4 xie1 hua4 shuo1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: to say out loud what was on their mind,

cues.zh: 他的这个病症就好很多
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 zheng4 jiu4 hao3 hen3 duo1
cues.en: their symptoms would improve a lot.

cues.zh: 而很多的这个患者在说的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 hen3 duo1 de5 zhe4 ge5 huan4 zhe3 zai4 shuo1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: And when many patients were talking,

cues.zh: 都会谈到自己做的梦
cues.pinyin: du1 hui4 tan2 dao4 zi4 ji3 zuo4 de5 meng4
cues.en: they would often bring up dreams they'd had.

cues.zh: 所以他就开始觉得
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 jue2 de5
cues.en: So he began to think

cues.zh: 这个梦好像跟人的意识是有一定的关系的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 meng4 hao3 xiang4 gen1 ren2 de5 yi4 shi2 shi4 you3 yi2 ding4 de5 guan1 xi4 de5
cues.en: that dreams seemed to be related to human consciousness in some way.

cues.zh: 他就开始研究梦
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 yan2 jiu1 meng4
cues.en: So he started studying dreams.

cues.zh: 后来他就提出了自己的理论
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 jiu4 ti2 chu1 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: Later he proposed his own theory.

cues.zh: 比如说他在这个梦的解析里边的核心内容
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 meng4 de5 jie3 xi1 li3 bian1 de5 he2 xin1 nei4 rong2
cues.en: For example, the core content in The Interpretation of Dreams

cues.zh: 潜意识理论
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi4 shi2 li3 lun4
cues.en: includes the theory of the unconscious,

cues.zh: 前意识我们一会儿会具体的讲
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi4 shi2 wo3 men5 yi1 hui4 er5 hui4 ju4 ti3 de5 jiang3
cues.en: and the preconscious — we'll talk about that in detail later,

cues.zh: 什么叫前意识
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 qian2 yi4 shi2
cues.en: what the preconscious is.

cues.zh: 再比如说俄迪姆斯情节
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 e2 di2 mu3 si1 qing2 jie2
cues.en: Another example is the Oedipus complex.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 就是通过梦
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 meng4
cues.en: That is, through dreams,

cues.zh: 神可以告诉我们一些未来可以发生的事
cues.pinyin: shen2 ke3 yi3 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 yi1 xie1 wei4 lai2 ke3 yi3 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: gods could tell us things that would happen in the future.

cues.zh: 比较典型的一个是埃及法老的一个梦
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 dian3 xing2 de5 yi2 ge4 shi4 ai1 ji2 fa3 lao3 de5 yi2 ge4 meng4
cues.en: A classic example is a dream of an Egyptian pharaoh.

cues.zh: 在旧约上记载说埃及法老做了一个梦
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiu4 yue1 shang4 ji4 zai3 shuo1 ai1 ji2 fa3 lao3 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 meng4
cues.en: The Old Testament records that the Egyptian pharaoh had a dream

cues.zh: 梦见七只肥的母牛还有七只兽的母牛
cues.pinyin: meng4 jian4 qi1 zhi3 fei2 de5 mu3 niu2 hai2 you3 qi1 zhi3 shou4 de5 mu3 niu2
cues.en: in which he saw seven fat cows and seven thin cows.

cues.zh: 后来这七只兽的母牛
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zhe4 qi1 zhi3 shou4 de5 mu3 niu2
cues.en: Then the seven thin cows

cues.zh: 把七只肥的母牛给吃了
cues.pinyin: ba3 qi1 zhi3 fei2 de5 mu3 niu2 gei3 chi1 le5
cues.en: ate the seven fat cows,

cues.zh: 然后七只兽的母牛依然很瘦
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 qi1 zhi3 shou4 de5 mu3 niu2 yi1 ran2 hen3 shou4
cues.en: yet the seven thin cows remained just as thin.

cues.zh: 这个时候约瑟就跟这个法老解释这个梦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 yue1 se4 jiu4 gen1 zhe4 ge5 fa3 lao3 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 meng4
cues.en: At that point, Joseph explained the dream to the pharaoh,

cues.zh: 说这意思是我们将会遇到七个丰年
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 yi4 si5 shi4 wo3 men5 jiang1 hui4 yu4 dao4 qi1 ge4 feng1 nian2
cues.en: saying it meant they would have seven years of abundance,

cues.zh: 然后又会遇到七个灾年
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you4 hui4 yu4 dao4 qi1 ge4 zai1 nian2
cues.en: followed by seven years of famine,

cues.zh: 而七个灾年会消耗掉七个丰年所有的粮食
cues.pinyin: er2 qi1 ge4 zai1 nian2 hui4 xiao1 hao4 diao4 qi1 ge4 feng1 nian2 suo3 you3 de5 liang2 shi2
cues.en: and the seven years of famine would consume all the grain from the seven years of abundance.

cues.zh: 这就说明梦是神对我们的启示
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shuo1 ming2 meng4 shi4 shen2 dui4 wo3 men5 de5 qi3 shi4
cues.en: This suggests that dreams are revelations from the gods.

cues.zh: 再后来人们又想出了一些方法
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 you4 xiang3 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Later on, people came up with other methods

cues.zh: 把梦里边梦到的东西和现实的一
cues.pinyin: ba3 meng4 li3 bian1 meng4 dao4 de5 dong1 xi1 he2 xian4 shi2 de5 yi1
cues.en: to match things seen in dreams

cues.zh: 些事对应起来
cues.pinyin: xie1 shi4 dui4 ying4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: with events in reality.

cues.zh: 比如说如果你梦到了信
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ru2 guo3 ni3 meng4 dao4 le5 xin4
cues.en: For example, if you dreamed of a letter,

cues.zh: 就意味着你遇到要遇到麻烦了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 ni3 yu4 dao4 yao4 yu4 dao4 ma2 fan2 le5
cues.en: it meant you were about to run into trouble.

cues.zh: 你梦到了葬礼
cues.pinyin: ni3 meng4 dao4 le5 zang4 li3
cues.en: If you dreamed of a funeral,

cues.zh: 也就意味着你可能要订婚了对吧等等
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 ni3 ke3 neng2 yao4 ding4 hun1 le5 dui4 ba5 deng3 deng3
cues.en: it might mean you were about to get engaged, and so on, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 那显然意见这些说法都没有什
cues.pinyin: na4 xian3 ran2 yi4 jian4 zhe4 xie1 shuo1 fa3 dou1 mei2 you3 shen2
cues.en: Obviously, none of these claims

cues.zh: 么科学的道理
cues.pinyin: me5 ke1 xue2 de5 dao4 li3
cues.en: have any scientific basis.

cues.zh: 那直到古希腊的智者亚里士多德
cues.pinyin: na4 zhi2 dao4 gu3 xi1 la4 de5 zhi4 zhe3 ya4 li3 shi4 duo1 de2
cues.en: It wasn't until the ancient Greek sage Aristotle

cues.zh: 他提出了一个理论
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 li3 lun4
cues.en: proposed a theory

cues.zh: 他说这个梦不是神对我们的一个启示
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 meng4 bu2 shi4 shen2 dui4 wo3 men5 de5 yi2 ge4 qi3 shi4
cues.en: that he said dreams are not a revelation from the gods,

cues.zh: 而是什么呢
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: but rather what?

cues.zh: 是人的精神活动
cues.pinyin: shi4 ren2 de5 jing1 shen2 huo2 dong4
cues.en: They are a form of human mental activity.

cues.zh: 是人的精神活动
cues.pinyin: shi4 ren2 de5 jing1 shen2 huo2 dong4
cues.en: They are a form of human mental activity.

cues.zh: 那我们中国的说法就是日有所思夜有所梦
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 zhong1 guo2 de5 shuo1 fa3 jiu4 shi4 ri4 you3 suo3 si1 ye4 you3 suo3 meng4
cues.en: In Chinese we'd say, 'what you think of by day, you dream of by night.'

cues.zh: 它只是现实的一个反应
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 xian4 shi2 de5 yi2 ge4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: It's just a reflection of reality.

cues.zh: 它跟你的这个神没有什么关系是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ni3 de5 zhe4 ge5 shen2 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 guan1 xi4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: It has nothing to do with the gods, right?

cues.zh: 后来的人们也逐渐的延续了亚里士
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 de5 ren2 men5 ye3 zhu2 jian4 de5 yan2 xu4 le5 ya4 li3 shi4
cues.en: Later people gradually continued

cues.zh: 多的这个观点
cues.pinyin: duo1 de5 zhe4 ge5 guan1 dian3
cues.en: Aristotle's view.

cues.zh: 比如说你口渴了你就会梦见水对吧
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 kou3 ke3 le5 ni3 jiu4 hui4 meng4 jian4 shui3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: For example, if you're thirsty, you'll dream of water, right?

cues.zh: 你肚子憋尿你就想上厕所梦见厕所是不是
cues.pinyin: ni3 du3 zi5 bie1 niao4 ni3 jiu4 xiang3 shang4 ce4 suo3 meng4 jian4 ce4 suo3 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: If you need to pee, you'll want to use the bathroom and dream of a bathroom, right?

cues.zh: 你要是这个热了
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 re4 le5
cues.en: If you're hot,

cues.zh: 你就会梦见你自己处于一团火之中
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 hui4 meng4 jian4 ni3 zi4 ji3 chu3 yu2 yi1 tuan2 huo3 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: you'll dream that you're surrounded by fire.

cues.zh: 所以说梦其实就是对内外刺激的一个反应
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 meng4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 dui4 nei4 wai4 ci4 ji1 de5 yi2 ge4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: So dreams are actually just a response to internal and external stimuli.

cues.zh: 因此梦就没有什么含义
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 meng4 jiu4 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 han2 yi4
cues.en: Therefore, dreams have no particular meaning.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】梦见裸体、考试、亲人死亡…咋回事？详解弗洛伊德《梦的解析》

cues.zh: 那就是他有一个女的病人
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 nv3 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Then there's the case of a female patient he had.

cues.zh: 这个女的病人叫做伊尔玛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nv3 de5 bing4 ren2 jiao4 zuo4 yi1 er3 ma3
cues.en: This female patient was called Irma.

cues.zh: 这伊尔玛跟弗洛伊德的他们家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 er3 ma3 gen1 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 de5 ta1 men5 jia1
cues.en: Irma and Freud's family

cues.zh: 的关系特别好
cues.pinyin: de5 guan1 xi4 te4 bie2 hao3
cues.en: were on very good terms.

cues.zh: 然后伊尔玛患了一些心理疾病
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yi1 er3 ma3 huan4 le5 yi1 xie1 xin1 li3 ji2 bing4
cues.en: Irma suffered from some psychological illness

cues.zh: 找弗洛伊德治病
cues.pinyin: zhao3 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 zhi4 bing4
cues.en: and went to Freud for treatment.

cues.zh: 弗洛伊德治了一段时间之后发现伊
cues.pinyin: fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 zhi4 le5 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 zhi1 hou4 fa1 xian4 yi1
cues.en: After treating her for a while, Freud found that Irma

cues.zh: 尔玛没有痊愈
cues.pinyin: er3 ma3 mei2 you3 quan2 yu4
cues.en: hadn't fully recovered.

cues.zh: 于是准备换一种治疗的方法
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhun3 bei4 huan4 yi1 zhong3 zhi4 liao2 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: So he planned to switch to a different treatment method,

cues.zh: 结果这个伊尔玛就拒绝了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 yi1 er3 ma3 jiu4 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but Irma refused.

cues.zh: 那他就不愿意再让这个弗洛伊德治病了
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 jiu4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 zai4 rang4 zhe4 ge5 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 zhi4 bing4 le5
cues.en: She didn't want Freud to keep treating her anymore.

cues.zh: 后来这个有一个医生名字叫做奥特
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zhe4 ge5 you3 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 ao4 te4
cues.en: Later, there was a doctor named Otto

cues.zh: 这个奥特医生就来看弗洛伊德
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ao4 te4 yi1 sheng1 jiu4 lai2 kan4 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2
cues.en: who came to visit Freud.

cues.zh: 然后他们就谈到了这个伊尔玛
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 men5 jiu4 tan2 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 yi1 er3 ma3
cues.en: Then they talked about Irma.

cues.zh: 弗洛伊德就问说伊尔玛的病好了吗
cues.pinyin: fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 jiu4 wen4 shuo1 yi1 er3 ma3 de5 bing4 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: Freud asked if Irma's condition had improved.

cues.zh: 奥特医生说它好了一些可是没有完全好
cues.pinyin: ao4 te4 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 ta1 hao3 le5 yi1 xie1 ke3 shi4 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 hao3
cues.en: Dr. Otto said she'd improved somewhat, but not completely.

cues.zh: 就这么一个事
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 shi4
cues.en: That was basically the situation.

cues.zh: 结果这个弗洛伊德晚上就做梦了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 fu2 luo4 yi1 de2 wan3 shang4 jiu4 zuo4 meng4 le5
cues.en: As a result, Freud had a dream that night.

cues.zh: 他就梦见在一个宴会上伊尔玛出席了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 meng4 jian4 zai4 yi2 ge4 yan4 hui4 shang4 yi1 er3 ma3 chu1 xi2 le5
cues.en: He dreamed that Irma was present at a banquet.

cues.zh: 然后他就跟伊尔玛说说你病没有好
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 gen1 yi1 er3 ma3 shuo1 shuo1 ni3 bing4 mei2 you3 hao3
cues.en: Then he said to Irma, 'The reason you haven't recovered

cues.zh: 是因为你拒绝接受我的治疗法
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ni3 ju4 jue2 jie1 shou4 wo3 de5 zhi4 liao2 fa3
cues.en: is because you refused to accept my treatment.'

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 豉油皇炒面做法～简单易学太美味了！【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 你好各位爱做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 ai4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone who loves cooking,

cues.zh: 很荣幸的又跟大家见面了我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: hen3 rong2 xing4 de5 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: I'm happy to meet you all again, I'm Cissy.

cues.zh: 今天要跟大家分享的是一道往
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 yi1 dao4 wang3
cues.en: Today I'm going to share with you a

cues.zh: 式炒面的做法
cues.pinyin: shi4 chao3 mian4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Cantonese-style fried noodles recipe.

cues.zh: 说到这个炒面呢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 chao3 mian4 ne5
cues.en: Speaking of this fried noodles dish,

cues.zh: 其实你放任何食材在里面都可以
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ni3 fang4 ren4 he2 shi2 cai2 zai4 li3 mian4 dou1 ke3 yi3
cues.en: actually you can put any ingredients you like in it.

cues.zh: 那我们今天要使用的食材呢有这个韭菜
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 shi3 yong4 de5 shi2 cai2 ne5 you3 zhe4 ge5 jiu3 cai4
cues.en: The ingredients we're using today are these chives,

cues.zh: 豆芽还有韭黄
cues.pinyin: dou4 ya2 hai2 you3 jiu3 huang2
cues.en: bean sprouts, and yellow chives.

cues.zh: 我们马上来看看豉油皇炒面的做法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ma3 shang4 lai2 kan4 kan4 shi4 you2 huang2 chao3 mian4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Let's take a look at how to make soy sauce fried noodles,

cues.zh: 一雪就会哦
cues.pinyin: yi1 xue3 jiu4 hui4 o2
cues.en: it's super easy to learn.

cues.zh: 把韭菜给它切成 2 英寸的长度
cues.pinyin: ba3 jiu3 cai4 gei3 ta1 qie4 cheng2 2 ying1 cun4 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: Cut the chives into 2-inch lengths.

cues.zh: 酒黄我们也给它切成两英寸的长度
cues.pinyin: jiu3 huang2 wo3 men5 ye3 gei3 ta1 qie4 cheng2 liang3 ying1 cun4 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: We also cut the yellow chives into 2-inch lengths.

cues.zh: 蒜切成蒜末

cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 chi3 zi5 yue4 xiao3 jie2 guo3 jiu4 yue4 da4
cues.en: So the smaller the ruler, the bigger the result.

cues.zh: 那如果是个细菌去走呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 shi4 ge4 xi4 jun1 qu4 zou3 ne5
cues.en: What if it were a bacterium walking it?

cues.zh: 它走的路径就更加的崎岖
cues.pinyin: ta1 zou3 de5 lu4 jing4 jiu4 geng4 jia1 de5 qi2 qu1
cues.en: Its path would be even more jagged.

cues.zh: 所以如果尺子无限小会有什么结果
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ru2 guo3 chi3 zi5 wu2 xian4 xiao3 hui4 you3 shen2 me5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: So what happens if the ruler becomes infinitely small?

cues.zh: 如果尺子无限小
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 chi3 zi5 wu2 xian4 xiao3
cues.en: If the ruler is infinitely small,

cues.zh: 那么这个尺寸就会结果怎么样
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 chi3 cun4 jiu4 hui4 jie2 guo3 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: what would the result turn out to be?

cues.zh: 结果就会无限大
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 hui4 wu2 xian4 da4
cues.en: The result would be infinite.

cues.zh: 那么综上所述英国的海岸线有多长呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zong1 shang4 suo3 shu4 ying1 guo2 de5 hai3 an4 xian4 you3 duo1 zhang3 ne5
cues.en: So, in summary, how long is Britain's coastline?

cues.zh: 是不可以估计的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu4 ke3 yi3 gu1 ji4 de5
cues.en: It can't be estimated.

cues.zh: 这件事取决于你的尺子的尺寸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 qu3 jue2 yu2 ni3 de5 chi3 zi5 de5 chi3 cun4
cues.en: It depends on the size of your ruler.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】雪花周长和地球直径哪个大？一个视频带你了解分形几何

cues.zh: 一个三角形
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 san1 jiao3 xing2
cues.en: Take a triangle.

cues.zh: 然后我们把三角形的每一个边
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 ba3 san1 jiao3 xing2 de5 mei3 yi2 ge4 bian1
cues.en: Then we divide each side of the triangle

cues.zh: 都等分为三份
cues.pinyin: dou1 deng3 fen1 wei4 san1 fen4
cues.en: into three equal parts.

cues.zh: 等分为三份
cues.pinyin: deng3 fen1 wei4 san1 fen4
cues.en: Divide it into three equal parts.

cues.zh: 然后把其中的一份边擦掉
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 qi2 zhong1 de5 yi1 fen4 bian1 ca1 diao4
cues.en: Then erase one of those segments.

cues.zh: 变成一个两个相等的边组成的一个角
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 liang3 ge4 xiang1 deng3 de5 bian1 zu3 cheng2 de5 yi2 ge4 jiao3
cues.en: It becomes an angle made of two equal sides.

cues.zh: 组成的一个这样的角
cues.pinyin: zu3 cheng2 de5 yi2 ge4 zhe4 yang4 de5 jiao3
cues.en: forming an angle like this.

cues.zh: 同样道理我把这个边也擦掉
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bian1 ye3 ca1 diao4
cues.en: Likewise, I erase this edge too.

cues.zh: 然后我用一个拱起来的两个相等的边
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 yong4 yi2 ge4 gong3 qi3 lai2 de5 liang3 ge4 xiang1 deng3 de5 bian1
cues.en: Then I use two equal sides that bulge outward.

cues.zh: 这个边我也擦掉让它拱起来相等的边
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bian1 wo3 ye3 ca1 diao4 rang4 ta1 gong3 qi3 lai2 xiang1 deng3 de5 bian1
cues.en: I erase this edge too and make it bulge out with equal sides.

cues.zh: 好这样我就做了一次迭代
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 yang4 wo3 jiu4 zuo4 le5 yi1 ci4 die2 dai4
cues.en: Okay, so now I've done one iteration.

cues.zh: 然后我再把这里面的每一个小边
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 zai4 ba3 zhe4 li3 mian4 de5 mei3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 bian1
cues.en: Then I take each small edge within this

cues.zh: 再等分成三份
cues.pinyin: zai4 deng3 fen1 cheng2 san1 fen4
cues.en: and divide it into three equal parts again.

cues.zh: 然后擦掉中间这一份
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ca1 diao4 zhong1 jian1 zhe4 yi1 fen4
cues.en: Then erase the middle part.

cues.zh: 这样一来我又可以擦掉很多个边对不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 wo3 you4 ke3 yi3 ca1 diao4 hen3 duo1 ge4 bian1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: This way I can erase many more edges, right?

cues.zh: 擦掉很多个边
cues.pinyin: ca1 diao4 hen3 duo1 ge4 bian1
cues.en: Erase many edges.

cues.zh: 擦完了这些边之后干什么
cues.pinyin: ca1 wan2 le5 zhe4 xie1 bian1 zhi1 hou4 gan4 shen2 me5
cues.en: After erasing these edges, what do I do?

cues.zh: 我再把它拱起来
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ba3 ta1 gong3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: I make it bulge out again.

cues.zh: 我再把它这样拱起来
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ba3 ta1 zhe4 yang4 gong3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: I bulge it out like this again.

cues.zh: 这样我就做了二次迭代
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 wo3 jiu4 zuo4 le5 er4 ci4 die2 dai4
cues.en: This way I've done a second iteration.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】雪花周长和地球直径哪个大？一个视频带你了解分形几何

cues.zh: 如此反复
cues.pinyin: ru2 ci3 fan3 fu4
cues.en: And so on, repeating this.

cues.zh: 我们可以折腾很多很多次折腾无限次
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zhe1 teng5 hen3 duo1 hen3 duo1 ci4 zhe1 teng5 wu2 xian4 ci4
cues.en: We can repeat this many, many times — infinitely many times.

cues.zh: 那么这样就构成了一个类似于雪花的形状
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 yang4 jiu4 gou4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 lei4 si4 yu2 xue3 hua1 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: This forms a shape similar to a snowflake.

cues.zh: 而这个形状我们就称之为科赫雪花
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 xing2 zhuang4 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ke1 he4 xue3 hua1
cues.en: And we call this shape the Koch snowflake.

cues.zh: 咱们可以研究一下这科赫雪花
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ke3 yi3 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ke1 he4 xue3 hua1
cues.en: Let's study this Koch snowflake's

cues.zh: 的周长有多大
cues.pinyin: de5 zhou1 chang2 you3 duo1 da4
cues.en: perimeter, how big is it?

cues.zh: 先说周长
cues.pinyin: xian1 shuo1 zhou1 chang2
cues.en: Let's talk about the perimeter first.

cues.zh: 假设我们原来的科赫雪花每个边长都是 1
cues.pinyin: jia3 she4 wo3 men5 yuan2 lai2 de5 ke1 he4 xue3 hua1 mei3 ge4 bian1 zhang3 dou1 shi4 1
cues.en: Suppose each side of our original Koch snowflake has length 1.

cues.zh: 但是你每做一次迭代都会擦掉三分之一
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 mei3 zuo4 yi1 ci4 die2 dai4 du1 hui4 ca1 diao4 san1 fen1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: But each iteration erases one third

cues.zh: 取而代之的是三分之二
cues.pinyin: qu3 er2 dai4 zhi1 de5 shi4 san1 fen1 zhi1 er4
cues.en: and replaces it with two-thirds (two segments of length 1/3 each).

cues.zh: 所以实际上周长变成三分之四倍了对吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shi2 ji4 shang4 zhou1 chang2 bian4 cheng2 san1 fen1 zhi1 si4 bei4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: So the perimeter actually becomes 4/3 times as much, right?

cues.zh: 所以周长大小应该是什么呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhou1 chang2 da4 xiao3 ying1 gai1 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what should the size of the perimeter be?

cues.zh: 应该是本来是三对吧
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 ben3 lai2 shi4 san1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: It should start at 3, right?

cues.zh: 然后再乘以迭代一次乘个三分之四
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 die2 dai4 yi1 ci4 cheng2 ge4 san1 fen1 zhi1 si4
cues.en: Then multiply by 4/3 for the first iteration.

cues.zh: 迭代两次再乘个三分之四
cues.pinyin: die2 dai4 liang3 ci4 zai4 cheng2 ge4 san1 fen1 zhi1 si4
cues.en: Multiply by 4/3 again for the second iteration.

cues.zh: 一直往下乘乘无限多次
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 wang3 xia4 sheng4 cheng2 wu2 xian4 duo1 ci4
cues.en: Keep multiplying like this, infinitely many times.

cues.zh: 那么大家想一想最后这个结果会怎么样
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 da4 jia1 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 zui4 hou4 zhe4 ge5 jie2 guo3 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: So think about it, what would the final result be?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】雪花周长和地球直径哪个大？一个视频带你了解分形几何

cues.zh: 我们称之为谢尔宾斯基地毯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 xie4 er3 bin1 si1 ji1 di4 tan3
cues.en: We call this the Sierpinski carpet.

cues.zh: 谢尔宾斯基地毯
cues.pinyin: xie4 er3 bin1 si1 ji1 di4 tan3
cues.en: The Sierpinski carpet.

cues.zh: 谢尔宾斯基地毯是什么样子的呢
cues.pinyin: xie4 er3 bin1 si1 ji1 di4 tan3 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 de5 ne5
cues.en: What does the Sierpinski carpet look like?

cues.zh: 我们看一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 kan4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's take a look.

cues.zh: 谢尔宾斯基提出了这样的一个构造
cues.pinyin: xie4 er3 bin1 si1 ji1 ti2 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 gou4 zao4
cues.en: Sierpinski proposed a construction like this.

cues.zh: 他说你看这有一张地毯
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 kan4 zhe4 you3 yi1 zhang1 di4 tan3
cues.en: He said, look, here's a carpet.

cues.zh: 这些地毯太单调了不好看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 di4 tan3 tai4 dan1 diao4 le5 bu4 hao3 kan4
cues.en: This carpet is too plain and not nice-looking.

cues.zh: 所以怎么着
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zen3 me5 zhe5
cues.en: So what do we do?

cues.zh: 我中间挖一个洞这就叫迭代一次
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhong1 jian1 wa1 yi2 ge4 dong4 zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 die2 dai4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: I cut a hole in the middle — that's called one iteration.

cues.zh: 中间挖一个洞我把这个用白色的笔表示
cues.pinyin: zhong1 jian1 wa1 yi2 ge4 dong4 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yong4 bai2 se4 de5 bi3 biao3 shi4
cues.en: I cut a hole in the middle, and I mark it with a white pen

cues.zh: 你挖掉的部分
cues.pinyin: ni3 wa1 diao4 de5 bu4 fen4
cues.en: the part that's been cut out.

cues.zh: 然后你其实是把这个地毯分成了 9 个格
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 qi2 shi2 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 di4 tan3 fen1 cheng2 le5 9 ge4 ge2
cues.en: Then you've actually divided the carpet into 9 squares.

cues.zh: 其中有一个格被你给挖掉
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 you3 yi2 ge4 ge2 bei4 ni3 gei3 wa1 diao4
cues.en: One of these squares gets cut out.

cues.zh: 然后我再在其中的 1 9 分之 1 个格
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 zai4 zai4 qi2 zhong1 de5 1 9 fen1 zhi1 1 ge4 ge2
cues.en: Then, in one of those 1/9 squares,

cues.zh: 我再做这件事
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 zuo4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: I do the same thing again.

cues.zh: 什么事我再挖一个洞
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 wo3 zai4 wa1 yi2 ge4 dong4
cues.en: What thing? I cut another hole.

cues.zh: 同样道理这个格子我也要挖一个洞
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 zhe4 ge5 ge2 zi5 wo3 ye3 yao4 wa1 yi2 ge4 dong4
cues.en: Likewise, I cut a hole in this square too.

cues.zh: 好吃的

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 zhou1 wei2 dou1 shi4 fei1 chang2 sheng1 ji1 ang4 ran2 de5

items.title_zh: 【良医第五季07】手术过程中药品竟然过期！肖恩只好用伟哥来救命，然而结果依然不太乐观

cues.zh: 伟哥既然能救命不愧是天才一生肖恩
cues.pinyin: wei3 ge1 ji4 ran2 neng2 jiu4 ming4 bu4 kui4 shi4 tian1 cai2 yi1 sheng1 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Since Viagra can save a life, Shaun really is a genius.

cues.zh: 伦叔自从媳妇跑路后就一直郁郁寡欢
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 zi4 cong2 xi2 fu4 pao3 lu4 hou4 jiu4 yi4 zhi2 yu4 yu4 gua3 huan1
cues.en: Uncle Lun has been depressed ever since his wife left him.

cues.zh: 终于下定决心想要离开这个伤心地
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 xia4 ding4 jue2 xin1 xiang3 yao4 li2 kai1 zhe4 ge5 shang1 xin1 di4
cues.en: He finally decided to leave this place full of heartbreak.

cues.zh: 联系了中介准备把房子卖掉
cues.pinyin: lian2 xi4 le5 zhong1 jie4 zhun3 bei4 ba3 fang2 zi5 mai4 diao4
cues.en: He contacted an agent to sell the house.

cues.zh: 谁知刚商量好前妻就突然上门了
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 gang1 shang1 liang2 hao3 qian2 qi1 jiu4 tu1 ran2 shang4 men2 le5
cues.en: But just as that was settled, his ex-wife suddenly showed up.

cues.zh: 前妻并非想和他旧情复燃
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 bing4 fei1 xiang3 he2 ta1 jiu4 qing2 fu4 ran2
cues.en: The ex-wife hadn't come to rekindle their romance.

cues.zh: 毕竟人家已经有了一个恩爱的丈夫大壮
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 ren2 jia1 yi3 jing1 you3 le5 yi2 ge4 en1 ai4 de5 zhang4 fu1 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: After all, she already has a loving husband, Dazhuang.

cues.zh: 她此次前来也正是为了大壮
cues.pinyin: ta1 ci3 ci4 qian2 lai2 ye3 zheng4 shi4 wei4 le5 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: This time she'd come specifically because of Dazhuang.

cues.zh: 大壮患上了路易体痴呆
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 huan4 shang4 le5 lu4 yi4 ti3 chi1 dai1
cues.en: Dazhuang has been diagnosed with Lewy body dementia.

cues.zh: 路易体痴呆是继阿尔兹海默症
cues.pinyin: lu4 yi4 ti3 chi1 dai1 shi4 ji4 a1 er3 zi1 hai3 mo4 zheng4
cues.en: Lewy body dementia is, after Alzheimer's,

cues.zh: 之后第二常见
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 di4 er4 chang2 jian4
cues.en: the second most common

cues.zh: 的进行性痴呆
cues.pinyin: de5 jin4 xing2 xing4 chi1 dai1
cues.en: type of progressive dementia.

cues.zh: 是一种叫路易体的蛋白质沉积在
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 zhong3 jiao4 lu4 yi4 ti3 de5 dan4 bai2 zhi4 chen2 ji1 zai4
cues.en: It's caused by a protein called Lewy bodies building up

cues.zh: 大脑中与思考
cues.pinyin: da4 nao3 zhong1 yu3 si1 kao3
cues.en: in brain regions linked to thinking,

cues.zh: 记忆和运动有关的区域所导致的
cues.pinyin: ji4 yi4 he2 yun4 dong4 you3 guan1 de5 qu1 yu4 suo3 dao3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: memory, and movement.

cues.zh: 大壮出现症状已经两年了
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 chu1 xian4 zheng4 zhuang4 yi3 jing1 liang3 nian2 le5
cues.en: Dazhuang's symptoms have been going on for two years.

cues.zh: 一开始失眠
cues.pinyin: yi1 kai1 shi3 shi1 mian2
cues.en: At first it was insomnia,

cues.zh: 其无力躁动不安
cues.pinyin: qi2 wu2 li4 zao4 dong4 bu4 an1
cues.en: then weakness and restlessness,

items.title_zh: 【良医第五季07】手术过程中药品竟然过期！肖恩只好用伟哥来救命，然而结果依然不太乐观

cues.zh: 现在已经有些糊涂了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 you3 xie1 hu2 tu2 le5
cues.en: and now he's become somewhat confused.

cues.zh: 他们听说有个实验疗法
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ting1 shuo1 you3 ge4 shi2 yan4 liao2 fa3
cues.en: They'd heard about an experimental treatment —

cues.zh: 是通过进行深部脑部刺激减缓认知衰退
cues.pinyin: shi4 tong1 guo4 jin4 xing2 shen1 bu4 nao3 bu4 ci4 ji1 jian3 huan3 ren4 zhi1 shuai1 tui4
cues.en: deep brain stimulation to slow cognitive decline —

cues.zh: 所以想向伦叔这个脑部专家咨询一下
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiang3 xiang4 lun2 shu1 zhe4 ge5 nao3 bu4 zhuan1 jia1 zi1 xun2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: so they wanted to ask Uncle Lun, a brain specialist, about it,

cues.zh: 看这个疗法是否值得一试
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe4 ge5 liao2 fa3 shi4 fou3 zhi2 de5 yi1 shi4
cues.en: to see if the treatment was worth trying.

cues.zh: 如果可以的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ke3 yi3 de5 hua4
cues.en: And if possible,

cues.zh: 最好顺带把手术也给做了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hao3 shun4 dai4 ba3 shou3 shu4 ye3 gei3 zuo4 le5
cues.en: they'd like him to go ahead and do the surgery too.

cues.zh: 伦叔把大壮带到了医院
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 ba3 da4 zhuang4 dai4 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Uncle Lun brought Dazhuang to the hospital

cues.zh: 自己做他的主治医生
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 zuo4 ta1 de5 zhu3 zhi4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: and became his attending physician himself.

cues.zh: 先给他安排了几项检查
cues.pinyin: xian1 gei3 ta1 an1 pai2 le5 ji3 xiang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: He first arranged several tests for him

cues.zh: 来测试他的认知情况
cues.pinyin: lai2 ce4 shi4 ta1 de5 ren4 zhi1 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: to check his cognitive state,

cues.zh: 再让他做个核磁共振
cues.pinyin: zai4 rang4 ta1 zuo4 ge4 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: then had him get an MRI

cues.zh: 看他的身体状况是否适合做那个治疗
cues.pinyin: kan4 ta1 de5 shen1 ti3 zhuang4 kuang4 shi4 fou3 shi4 he2 zuo4 na4 ge5 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: to see if his body could handle the treatment.

cues.zh: 大壮表示没有问题
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 biao3 shi4 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Dazhuang said there was no problem.

cues.zh: 正说着呢
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shuo1 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: But just as he was saying this,

cues.zh: 突然表情一变
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 biao3 qing2 yi1 bian4
cues.en: his expression suddenly changed.

cues.zh: 问伦叔你是谁
cues.pinyin: wen4 lun2 shu1 ni3 shi4 shui2
cues.en: He asked Uncle Lun, "Who are you?"

cues.zh: 看来是突然发病了
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 shi4 tu1 ran2 fa1 bing4 le5
cues.en: It seemed he'd suddenly had an episode.

cues.zh: 前期联盟拿出他们一家的合照
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 lian2 meng2 na2 chu1 ta1 men5 yi1 jia1 de5 he2 zhao4
cues.en: The ex-wife quickly took out a family photo

cues.zh: 让大壮看
cues.pinyin: rang4 da4 zhuang4 kan4
cues.en: and showed it to Dazhuang

cues.zh: 稳定他的情绪
cues.pinyin: wen3 ding4 ta1 de5 qing2 xu4
cues.en: to calm his emotions.

cues.zh: 这病来的快去的也快
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bing4 lai2 de5 kuai4 qu4 de5 ye3 kuai4
cues.en: This disease comes on fast and passes just as fast.

cues.zh: 大壮很快就缓过来了
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 huan3 guo4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Dazhuang recovered quickly.

cues.zh: 这样起码能夺活几年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 qi3 ma3 neng2 duo2 huo2 ji3 nian2
cues.en: This way he could at least live a few more years.

cues.zh: 虽然大壮很伤心
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 da4 zhuang4 hen3 shang1 xin1
cues.en: Although Dazhuang was heartbroken,

cues.zh: 却还是接受了这个现实
cues.pinyin: que4 hai2 shi4 jie1 shou4 le5 zhe4 ge5 xian4 shi2
cues.en: he still accepted this reality.

cues.zh: 可前妻并没有轻易放弃
cues.pinyin: ke3 qian2 qi1 bing4 mei2 you3 qing1 yi4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: But the ex-wife didn't give up easily.

cues.zh: 私下找了伦书
cues.pinyin: si1 xia4 zhao3 le5 lun2 shu1
cues.en: She went to find Uncle Lun privately.

cues.zh: 她很清楚伦书的本质
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 qing1 chu3 lun2 shu1 de5 ben3 zhi4
cues.en: She understood Uncle Lun's true nature well.

cues.zh: 只有在研究那些无解的方案时
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 zai4 yan2 jiu1 na4 xie1 wu2 jie3 de5 fang1 an4 shi2
cues.en: Only when working on an unsolvable case,

cues.zh: 只有在做手术时
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 zai4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 shi2
cues.en: only while performing surgery,

cues.zh: 前妻恳请伦叔再帮她一次
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 ken3 qing3 lun2 shu1 zai4 bang1 ta1 yi1 ci4
cues.en: only while working as a doctor

cues.zh: 她才算真正的活着
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai2 suan4 zhen1 zheng4 de5 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: did he feel truly alive.

cues.zh: 而现在她失去了承担失败的勇气
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 zai4 ta1 shi1 qu4 le5 cheng2 dan1 shi1 bai4 de5 yong3 qi4
cues.en: And now he'd lost the courage to face failure.

cues.zh: 前妻恳请伦书再帮她一次
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 ken3 qing3 lun2 shu1 zai4 bang1 ta1 yi1 ci4
cues.en: The ex-wife begged Uncle Lun to help her once more,

cues.zh: 给大壮做手术
cues.pinyin: gei3 da4 zhuang4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: to operate on Dazhuang.

cues.zh: 伦书拒绝了
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: Uncle Lun refused.

cues.zh: 而这时大壮突然病发了
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 shi2 da4 zhuang4 tu1 ran2 bing4 fa1 le5
cues.en: Right then, Dazhuang suddenly had another episode.

cues.zh: 变得六亲不认
cues.pinyin: bian4 de2 liu4 qin1 bu4 ren4
cues.en: He stopped recognizing anyone, even family,

cues.zh: 在病房跟医护人员大吵大闹
cues.pinyin: zai4 bing4 fang2 gen1 yi1 hu4 ren2 yuan2 da4 chao3 da4 nao4
cues.en: and caused a huge scene with the medical staff in the ward,

cues.zh: 甚至不认识自己的妻子
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 bu4 ren4 shi2 zi4 ji3 de5 qi1 zi3
cues.en: not even recognizing his own wife.

cues.zh: 最后还是靠一直镇定剂
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 hai2 shi4 kao4 yi4 zhi2 zhen4 ding4 ji4
cues.en: In the end it took a shot of sedative

cues.zh: 才让大壮安静下来
cues.pinyin: cai2 rang4 da4 zhuang4 an1 jing4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: to finally calm Dazhuang down.

cues.zh: 伦叔和前妻又谈了一次
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 he2 qian2 qi1 you4 tan2 le5 yi1 ci4
cues.en: Uncle Lun and the ex-wife talked again.

cues.zh: 前妻为自己之前的话感到抱歉
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 wei4 zi4 ji3 zhi1 qian2 de5 hua4 gan3 dao4 bao4 qian4
cues.en: The ex-wife apologized for what she'd said before.

cues.zh: 伦叔的苛责
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 de5 ke1 ze2
cues.en: Uncle Lun's harshness

cues.zh: 间接导致他们的女儿死亡
cues.pinyin: jian4 jie1 dao3 zhi4 ta1 men5 de5 nv3 er2 si3 wang2
cues.en: had indirectly caused their daughter's death.

cues.zh: 所以两人在离婚
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liang3 ren2 zai4 li2 hun1
cues.en: That's why the two of them had divorced.

cues.zh: 和大壮即为夫妻
cues.pinyin: he2 da4 zhuang4 ji2 wei4 fu1 qi1
cues.en: She later married Dazhuang.

items.title_zh: 【良医第五季07】手术过程中药品竟然过期！肖恩只好用伟哥来救命，然而结果依然不太乐观

cues.zh: 只是暂时不能运动
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 zan4 shi2 bu4 neng2 yun4 dong4
cues.en: It's just that he can't exercise for now.

cues.zh: 前妻十分感谢他
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 shi2 fen1 gan3 xie4 ta1
cues.en: The ex-wife was deeply grateful to him.

cues.zh: 临走之前劝她不要搬家了
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 zhi1 qian2 quan4 ta1 bu2 yao4 ban1 jia1 le5
cues.en: Before leaving, she urged him not to move away after all.

cues.zh: 她需要肖恩
cues.pinyin: ta1 xu1 yao4 xiao4 en1
cues.en: He needed her.

cues.zh: 有她陪着
cues.pinyin: you3 ta1 pei2 zhe5
cues.en: With her by his side,

cues.zh: 轮述会好一点
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu4 hui4 hao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Uncle Lun would feel a little better.

cues.zh: 此时肖恩正和丽娅在看教堂
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 xiao4 en1 zheng4 he2 li4 ya4 zai4 kan4 jiao4 tang2
cues.en: Meanwhile, Shaun and Lea were looking at a church.

cues.zh: 两人婚礼在即
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 hun1 li3 zai4 ji2
cues.en: Their wedding was coming up soon.

cues.zh: 但由于肖恩的龟毛脾气
cues.pinyin: dan4 you2 yu2 xiao4 en1 de5 gui1 mao2 pi2 qi4
cues.en: But because of Shaun's fussy, exacting nature,

cues.zh: 他们一直没能确定好最后方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi4 zhi2 mei2 neng2 que4 ding4 hao3 zui4 hou4 fang1 an4
cues.en: they still hadn't settled on a final plan.

cues.zh: 找到一个符合肖恩设想的完美教堂
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 fu2 he2 xiao4 en1 she4 xiang3 de5 wan2 mei3 jiao4 tang2
cues.en: Finding a church that perfectly matched Shaun's vision

cues.zh: 并让她自闭症自动痊愈还难
cues.pinyin: bing4 rang4 ta1 zi4 bi4 zheng4 zi4 dong4 quan2 yu4 hai2 nan2
cues.en: seemed even harder than curing his autism on its own.

cues.zh: 今天两人联系了一家教堂去现场踩点
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 liang3 ren2 lian2 xi4 le5 yi1 jia1 jiao4 tang2 qu4 xian4 chang3 cai3 dian3
cues.en: Today the two of them contacted a church to scout it in person.

cues.zh: 回来的时候正巧碰上了一场车祸
cues.pinyin: hui2 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 zheng4 qiao3 peng4 shang4 le5 yi1 chang2 che1 huo4
cues.en: On the way back, they happened upon a car accident.

cues.zh: 其中一个事故受害者
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 shi4 gu4 shou4 hai4 zhe3
cues.en: One of the accident victims

cues.zh: 是一名叫小美的孕妇
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 ming2 jiao4 xiao3 mei3 de5 yun4 fu4
cues.en: was a pregnant woman named Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 小美的腿被变形的车子卡住了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 tui3 bei4 bian4 xing2 de5 che1 zi5 ka3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei's leg was trapped by the mangled car.

cues.zh: 暂时靠人力拉不出来
cues.pinyin: zan4 shi2 kao4 ren2 li4 la1 bu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: It couldn't be freed by manpower alone for now.

cues.zh: 事故造成了她心脏损伤
cues.pinyin: shi4 gu4 zao4 cheng2 le5 ta1 xin1 zang4 sun3 shang1
cues.en: The accident had damaged her heart,

cues.zh: 导致心动过速呼吸困难
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 xin1 dong4 guo4 su4 hu1 xi1 kun4 nan2
cues.en: causing rapid heartbeat and trouble breathing,

cues.zh: 紧禁脉肿胀
cues.pinyin: jin3 jin4 mai4 zhong3 zhang4
cues.en: along with jugular vein swelling.

cues.zh: 如果不立刻消肿
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bu4 li4 ke4 xiao1 zhong3
cues.en: If the swelling wasn't relieved right away,

cues.zh: 等救护车来
cues.pinyin: deng3 jiu4 hu4 che1 lai2
cues.en: by the time the ambulance arrived,

cues.zh: 就可以直接给她拉到太平江了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhi2 jie1 gei3 ta1 la1 dao4 tai4 ping2 jiang1 le5
cues.en: she could be headed straight for the morgue.

cues.zh: 现场简陋的环境更没有难倒小恩

cues.zh: 她立刻用胶带和软管制作了一
cues.pinyin: ta1 li4 ke4 yong4 jiao1 dai4 he2 ruan3 guan3 zhi4 zuo4 le5 yi1

cues.zh: 个缩操的工具
