cues.en: a device for draining the pressure.

cues.zh: 当场给小美的心脏做了个穿刺
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 gei3 xiao3 mei3 de5 xin1 zang4 zuo4 le5 ge4 chuan1 ci4
cues.en: On the spot, he performed a puncture on Xiaomei's heart,

cues.zh: 缓解了她的症状
cues.pinyin: huan3 jie3 le5 ta1 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: relieving her symptoms.

cues.zh: 就是小美本人内出血过多
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 ben3 ren2 nei4 chu1 xue4 guo4 duo1
cues.en: By the time the ambulance arrived and took her away,

cues.zh: 小美的孩子没什么问题
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 hai2 zi5 mei2 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Xiaomei's baby was fine.

cues.zh: 胎心正常也无压迫
cues.pinyin: tai1 xin1 zheng4 chang2 ye3 wu2 ya1 po4
cues.en: The fetal heartbeat was normal, with no compression.

cues.zh: 就是小美本人内出血过多
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 ben3 ren2 nei4 chu1 xue4 guo4 duo1
cues.en: It was Xiaomei herself who had lost too much blood internally.

cues.zh: 继续做手术
cues.pinyin: ji4 xu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: She needed to go into surgery right away.

cues.zh: 医生缝合了小美心事撕裂
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 feng2 he2 le5 xiao3 mei3 xin1 shi4 si1 lie4
cues.en: Doctors stitched up the tear in Xiaomei's heart.

cues.zh: 幸运的是她没有出现动脉或者大出血
cues.pinyin: xing4 yun4 de5 shi4 ta1 mei2 you3 chu1 xian4 dong4 mai4 huo4 zhe3 da4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: Luckily she had no arterial or major bleeding.

cues.zh: 后续不会有太大的问题
cues.pinyin: hou4 xu4 bu2 hui4 you3 tai4 da4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: There shouldn't be any serious problems going forward.

cues.zh: 只是小美骨折有点严重
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 xiao3 mei3 gu3 zhe2 you3 dian3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: It's just that Xiaomei's fracture was fairly severe.

cues.zh: 需要用金属支架固定骨折的骨头
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 yong4 jin1 shu3 zhi1 jia4 gu4 ding4 gu3 zhe2 de5 gu3 tou5
cues.en: It needed a metal frame to stabilize the broken bone.

cues.zh: 外部固定是目前来说最好的选择
cues.pinyin: wai4 bu4 gu4 ding4 shi4 mu4 qian2 lai2 shuo1 zui4 hao3 de5 xuan3 ze2
cues.en: External fixation was currently the best option.

cues.zh: 但小美之后很可能会换上关节炎
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 mei3 zhi1 hou4 hen3 ke3 neng2 hui4 huan4 shang4 guan1 jie2 yan2
cues.en: But afterward Xiaomei would likely develop arthritis,

cues.zh: 极有可能会影响她的行动力
cues.pinyin: ji2 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 ta1 de5 xing2 dong4 li4
cues.en: which could very well affect her mobility.

cues.zh: 当然她也可以选择抛腹斩
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 ta1 ye3 ke3 yi3 xuan3 ze2 pao1 fu4 zhan3
cues.en: Of course, she could also choose a cesarean section instead.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季07】手术过程中药品竟然过期！肖恩只好用伟哥来救命，然而结果依然不太乐观

cues.zh: 医院发生了很多变化
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 fa1 sheng1 le5 hen3 duo1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: The hospital had changed a lot.

cues.zh: 她知道肖恩无法适应
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 dao4 xiao4 en1 wu2 fa3 shi4 ying4
cues.en: Lea knew Shaun couldn't adapt to it,

cues.zh: 尤其是那个评分机制
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 na4 ge5 ping2 fen1 ji1 zhi4
cues.en: especially to that rating system.

cues.zh: 所以为了帮肖恩改变心态
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wei2 le5 bang1 xiao4 en1 gai3 bian4 xin1 tai4
cues.en: So to help change Shaun's mindset,

cues.zh: 就借用之前
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jie4 yong4 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: she used her past access

cues.zh: 把给肖恩的负面评论提出了一部分
cues.pinyin: ba3 gei3 xiao4 en1 de5 fu4 mian4 ping2 lun4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: to remove some of the negative reviews about Shaun,

cues.zh: 提升了她的分数
cues.pinyin: ti2 sheng1 le5 ta1 de5 fen1 shu4
cues.en: raising his score.

cues.zh: 而这个方法确实也有效果
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 que4 shi2 ye3 you3 xiao4 guo3
cues.en: And this method really did work.

cues.zh: 只是一种自我欺骗而已
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 zi4 wo3 qi1 pian4 er2 yi3
cues.en: Shaun's mood became much more positive.

cues.zh: 可丽娅知道这是欺骗
cues.pinyin: ke3 li4 ya4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 qi1 pian4
cues.en: But Lea knew it was a deception —

cues.zh: 只是一二到零而已
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yi1 er4 dao4 ling2 er2 yi3
cues.en: just a temporary fix, nothing more.

cues.zh: 萧恩沉默了一会儿
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 chen2 mo4 le5 yi1 hui4 er5
cues.en: Shaun fell silent for a moment,

cues.zh: 指责丽娅这是不对的
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ze2 li4 ya4 zhe4 shi4 bu2 dui4 de5
cues.en: then told Lea this was wrong,

cues.zh: 并且拒绝了她的道歉
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 ju4 jue2 le5 ta1 de5 dao4 qian4
cues.en: and he refused her apology.

cues.zh: 两人不欢而散
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 bu4 huan1 er2 san4
cues.en: The two parted on bad terms.

cues.zh: 萧美最终决定采取外部固定
cues.pinyin: xiao1 mei3 zui4 zhong1 jue2 ding4 cai3 qu3 wai4 bu4 gu4 ding4
cues.en: Xiaomei finally decided to go with external fixation.

cues.zh: 她要保护自己的孩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 bao3 hu4 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: She wanted to protect her baby.

cues.zh: 但事情已经由不得她了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qing2 yi3 jing1 you2 bu4 de2 ta1 le5
cues.en: But things were no longer up to her.

cues.zh: 萧美胎盘早播引起了死宫出血
cues.pinyin: xiao1 mei3 tai1 pan2 zao3 bo1 yin3 qi3 le5 si3 gong1 chu1 xie3
cues.en: Xiaomei's placental abruption caused uterine bleeding —

cues.zh: 这是对车祸撞击引起的延迟反应
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dui4 che1 huo4 zhuang4 ji1 yin3 qi3 de5 yan2 chi2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: a delayed reaction to the impact of the car crash.

cues.zh: 萧美立刻被推进手术室
cues.pinyin: xiao1 mei3 li4 ke4 bei4 tui1 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Xiaomei was immediately rushed into the operating room

cues.zh: 进行了紧急破腹产手术
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 le5 jin3 ji2 po4 fu4 chan3 shou3 shu4
cues.en: for an emergency cesarean section.

cues.zh: 婴儿被取出后
cues.pinyin: ying1 er2 bei4 qu3 chu1 hou4
cues.en: After the baby was delivered,

cues.zh: 立刻植入罗丁进行了固定
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 zhi2 ru4 luo2 ding1 jin4 xing2 le5 gu4 ding4
cues.en: metal screws were immediately put in to stabilize the fracture.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 韩版逃学威龙震撼来袭
cues.pinyin: han2 ban3 tao2 xue2 wei1 long2 zhen4 han4 lai2 xi2
cues.en: A stunning Korean version of "Fight Back to School" has arrived!

cues.zh: 故事的主角郑海诚是一个国情院特工
cues.pinyin: gu4 shi4 de5 zhu3 jue2 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 shi4 yi2 ge4 guo2 qing2 yuan4 te4 gong1
cues.en: The story's protagonist, Zheng Haicheng, is an NIS agent.

cues.zh: 他接到任务需要去阻止韩国的文物贩子
cues.pinyin: ta1 jie1 dao4 ren4 wu4 xu1 yao4 qu4 zu3 zhi3 han2 guo2 de5 wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5
cues.en: He's assigned a mission to stop a Korean artifact smuggler

cues.zh: 偷走金佛转卖
cues.pinyin: tou1 zou3 jin1 fu2 zhuan3 mai4
cues.en: who stole a golden Buddha statue to resell it.

cues.zh: 文物贩子一见他就傻了
cues.pinyin: wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5 yi1 jian4 ta1 jiu4 sha3 le5
cues.en: The moment the smuggler sees him, he's stunned.

cues.zh: 不是哥们我就偷个文物
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 ge1 men5 wo3 jiu4 tou1 ge4 wen2 wu4
cues.en: "Come on, man, I just stole an artifact,"

cues.zh: 又不是杀人放火
cues.pinyin: you4 bu2 shi4 sha1 ren2 fang4 huo3
cues.en: "it's not like I killed or burned anything,"

cues.zh: 至于派特工来抓人吗
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 pai4 te4 gong1 lai2 zhua1 ren2 ma5
cues.en: "did they really need to send an agent to catch me?"

cues.zh: 郑海诚管你那么多直接掏出了枪
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 guan3 ni3 na4 me5 duo1 zhi2 jie1 tao1 chu1 le5 qiang1
cues.en: Zheng Haicheng doesn't care and just pulls out his gun.

cues.zh: 文物贩子正在犹豫要不要放下手里的金佛
cues.pinyin: wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5 zheng4 zai4 you2 yu4 yao4 bu4 yao4 fang4 xia4 shou3 li3 de5 jin1 fu2
cues.en: The smuggler hesitates over whether to put down the golden Buddha.

cues.zh: 突然有一个同伙袭击了郑海诚
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 yi2 ge4 tong2 huo3 xi2 ji1 le5 zheng4 hai3 cheng2
cues.en: Suddenly an accomplice attacks Zheng Haicheng.

cues.zh: 这么一拖延文物贩子如蒙大赦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi1 tuo1 yan2 wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5 ru2 meng2 da4 she4
cues.en: With the delay, the smuggler feels like he's been granted a reprieve.

cues.zh: 赶紧上车就想跑路
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 shang4 che1 jiu4 xiang3 pao3 lu4
cues.en: He rushes into the car, trying to flee.

cues.zh: 郑海诚哪能让他就这么跑啊
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 na3 neng2 rang4 ta1 jiu4 zhe4 me5 pao3 a5
cues.en: There's no way Zheng Haicheng will let him get away like that.

cues.zh: 他硬是骑着摩托
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying4 shi4 qi2 zhe5 mo2 tuo1
cues.en: He insists on chasing by motorcycle,

cues.zh: 摩托车追上去跳到车顶
cues.pinyin: mo2 tuo1 che1 zhui1 shang4 qu4 tiao4 dao4 che1 ding3
cues.en: catches up and jumps onto the roof of the car.

cues.zh: 硬生生用摩托车头盔将车顶砸开跳进车里
cues.pinyin: ying4 sheng1 sheng1 yong4 mo2 tuo1 che1 tou2 kui1 jiang1 che1 ding3 za2 kai1 tiao4 jin4 che1 li3
cues.en: He smashes open the roof with his motorcycle helmet and jumps inside.

cues.zh: 从文物贩子手里抢佛
cues.pinyin: cong2 wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5 shou3 li3 qiang3 fu2
cues.en: He wrestles the golden Buddha away from the smuggler.

cues.zh: 双方打得火热
cues.pinyin: shuang1 fang1 da3 de2 huo3 re4
cues.en: The two of them fight fiercely.

cues.zh: 前面的司机也是受到了波及
cues.pinyin: qian2 mian4 de5 si1 ji1 ye3 shi4 shou4 dao4 le5 bo1 ji2
cues.en: The driver up front gets caught up in it too.

cues.zh: 车歪歪扭扭撞上了障碍物
cues.pinyin: che1 wai1 wai1 niu3 niu3 zhuang4 shang4 le5 zhang4 ai4 wu4
cues.en: The car swerves wildly and crashes into an obstacle,

cues.zh: 直接引发了爆炸
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 yin3 fa1 le5 bao4 zha4
cues.en: triggering an explosion.

cues.zh: 同事们都以为郑海诚这一次死了
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi4 men5 dou1 yi3 wei2 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 zhe4 yi1 ci4 si3 le5
cues.en: His colleagues all think Zheng Haicheng has died this time.

cues.zh: 没想到下一秒
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: But unexpectedly, the next second,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 郑海诚居然抱着文物贩子和金佛从大
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 ju1 ran2 bao4 zhe5 wen2 wu4 fan4 zi5 he2 jin1 fu2 cong2 da4
cues.en: Zheng Haicheng walks out of the flames carrying the smuggler and the golden Buddha,

cues.zh: 火里走了出来
cues.pinyin: huo3 li3 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: having come out of the fire.

cues.zh: 可是悲剧很快就来了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bei1 ju4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 lai2 le5
cues.en: But tragedy strikes soon after.

cues.zh: 他们的确是抢回了金佛
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 que4 shi4 qiang3 hui2 le5 jin1 fu2
cues.en: They did manage to recover the golden Buddha,

cues.zh: 但是郑海诚那一子弹竟然将金佛的手
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 na4 yi1 zi3 dan4 jing4 ran2 jiang1 jin1 fu2 de5 shou3
cues.en: but one of Zheng Haicheng's bullets

cues.zh: 臂打掉了一只
cues.pinyin: bi4 da3 diao4 le5 yi1 zhi1
cues.en: ends up blowing off one of the Buddha's arms.

cues.zh: 上级气坏了
cues.pinyin: shang4 ji2 qi4 huai4 le5
cues.en: His superior is furious.

cues.zh: 组长拼命求情才保住了郑海诚的工作
cues.pinyin: zu3 zhang3 pin1 ming4 qiu2 qing2 cai2 bao3 zhu4 le5 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: The team leader pleads desperately to save Zheng Haicheng's job.

cues.zh: 但是上级给了他们一个更艰难的任务
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shang4 ji2 gei3 le5 ta1 men5 yi2 ge4 geng4 jian1 nan2 de5 ren4 wu4
cues.en: But the superior assigns them an even harder mission:

cues.zh: 要他们找回曾经朝鲜末代皇帝
cues.pinyin: yao4 ta1 men5 zhao3 hui2 ceng2 jing1 chao2 xian1 mo4 dai4 huang2 di4
cues.en: recover the gold bars that the last Korean emperor

cues.zh: 交给自己亲信大臣的八千亿金条
cues.pinyin: jiao1 gei3 zi4 ji3 qin1 xin4 da4 chen2 de5 ba1 qian1 yi4 jin1 tiao2
cues.en: once entrusted — 800 billion worth — to his most trusted minister.

cues.zh: 这些金条原本说是要作为朝鲜的建设
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jin1 tiao2 yuan2 ben3 shuo1 shi4 yao4 zuo4 wei2 chao2 xian1 de5 jian4 she4
cues.en: The gold bars were supposedly meant to fund

cues.zh: 和发展的资金
cues.pinyin: he2 fa1 zhan3 de5 zi1 jin1
cues.en: the nation's construction and development.

cues.zh: 但亲信大臣全部自己一个人吞了
cues.pinyin: dan4 qin1 xin4 da4 chen2 quan2 bu4 zi4 ji3 yi2 ge4 ren2 tun1 le5
cues.en: But the minister kept every bit of it for himself.

cues.zh: 后来据说韩国建国他怕钱太多惹眼就将
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ju4 shuo1 han2 guo2 jian4 guo2 ta1 pa4 qian2 tai4 duo1 re3 yan3 jiu4 jiang1
cues.en: Later, when Korea was founded, fearing the huge sum would draw attention, he

cues.zh: 金条藏了起来
cues.pinyin: jin1 tiao2 cang2 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: hid the gold bars away.

cues.zh: 现在韩国国情院得到情报说
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 han2 guo2 guo2 qing2 yuan4 de2 dao4 qing2 bao4 shuo1
cues.en: Now, Korea's NIS has received intelligence saying

cues.zh: 这些金条很可能就藏在这个大臣后人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jin1 tiao2 hen3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 cang2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 da4 chen2 hou4 ren2
cues.en: the gold is likely hidden at a high school run by a conglomerate

cues.zh: 所建立的财团下属高中里
cues.pinyin: suo3 jian4 li4 de5 cai2 tuan2 xia4 shu3 gao1 zhong1 li3
cues.en: founded by the minister's descendants.

cues.zh: 为了达成任务就要委屈一下郑海诚了
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 da2 cheng2 ren4 wu4 jiu4 yao4 wei3 qu1 yi1 xia4 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 le5
cues.en: To complete the mission, Zheng Haicheng has to make a sacrifice.

cues.zh: 他必须伪装成高中生进入其中卧底
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi4 xu1 wei3 zhuang1 cheng2 gao1 zhong1 sheng1 jin4 ru4 qi2 zhong1 wo4 di3
cues.en: He has to disguise himself as a high schooler and go undercover.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 可是她没想到自己第二天
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 mei2 xiang3 dao4 zi4 ji3 di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: But she never expected that the very next day,

cues.zh: 就在学校见到了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 xue2 xiao4 jian4 dao4 le5
cues.en: she would run into, right at school,

cues.zh: 令自己怦然心动的这个男人
cues.pinyin: ling4 zi4 ji3 peng1 ran2 xin1 dong4 de5 zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: the man who had made her heart skip a beat.

cues.zh: 对方的身份居然是一个未成年转学生
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 de5 shen1 fen4 ju1 ran2 shi4 yi2 ge4 wei4 cheng2 nian2 zhuan3 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: It turns out he's actually a minor — a transfer student.

cues.zh: 女老师化羞涩为愤怒
cues.pinyin: nv3 lao3 shi1 hua4 xiu1 se4 wei4 fen4 nu4
cues.en: The female teacher's embarrassment turns to anger.

cues.zh: 狠狠地责骂了郑海诚一顿
cues.pinyin: hen3 hen3 di4 ze2 ma4 le5 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 yi1 dun4
cues.en: She gives Zheng Haicheng a fierce scolding,

cues.zh: 指责他不应该未成年跑去酒馆喝酒还打架
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ze2 ta1 bu4 ying1 gai1 wei4 cheng2 nian2 pao3 qu4 jiu3 guan3 he1 jiu3 hai2 da3 jia4
cues.en: criticizing him for being underage yet drinking and fighting at a bar.

cues.zh: 而郑海诚觉得他这个维员师表的
cues.pinyin: er2 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 jue2 de5 ta1 zhe4 ge5 wei2 yuan2 shi1 biao3 de5
cues.en: Zheng Haicheng thinks that she, supposedly a model teacher,

cues.zh: 当时也动了手
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 ye3 dong4 le5 shou3
cues.en: also threw punches back then,

cues.zh: 和自己半斤八两
cues.pinyin: he2 zi4 ji3 ban4 jin1 ba1 liang3
cues.en: making her just as guilty as him.

cues.zh: 但看在这个女老师是自己班主任的份上
cues.pinyin: dan4 kan4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 nv3 lao3 shi1 shi4 zi4 ji3 ban1 zhu3 ren4 de5 fen4 shang4
cues.en: But out of respect for the fact she's his homeroom teacher,

cues.zh: 他还是低了头
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 di1 le5 tou2
cues.en: he still backs down.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 她使劲将郑海诚弄醒
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi3 jin4 jiang1 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 nong4 xing3
cues.en: The teacher obviously isn't satisfied with that.

cues.zh: 他使劲将郑海诚弄醒
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi3 jin4 jiang1 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 nong4 xing3
cues.en: She forcibly shakes Zheng Haicheng awake.

cues.zh: 没想到郑海诚醒过来本能反应差点打他
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 xing3 guo4 lai2 ben3 neng2 fan3 ying4 cha4 dian3 da3 ta1
cues.en: Unexpectedly, the moment he wakes, instinct almost makes him hit her.

cues.zh: 幸好他清醒的快在最后一刻停住了手
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 ta1 qing1 xing3 de5 kuai4 zai4 zui4 hou4 yi2 ke4 ting2 zhu4 le5 shou3
cues.en: Luckily he comes to his senses fast and stops himself at the last second.

cues.zh: 要不然上课第一天就得因为暴打
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 shang4 ke4 di4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 de2 yin1 wei4 bao4 da3
cues.en: Otherwise he'd have been expelled on his very first day

cues.zh: 女老师被开除
cues.pinyin: nv3 lao3 shi1 bei4 kai1 chu2
cues.en: for beating up a teacher.

cues.zh: 下课女生们围着郑海诚要逆针
cues.pinyin: xia4 ke4 nv3 sheng1 men5 wei2 zhe5 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 yao4 ni4 zhen1
cues.en: During break, girls crowd around Zheng Haicheng wanting to exchange contacts.

cues.zh: 他完全听不懂什么叫逆针
cues.pinyin: ta1 wan2 quan2 ting1 bu4 dong3 shen2 me5 jiao4 ni4 zhen1
cues.en: He has no idea what they even mean.

cues.zh: 完了难道他真的变成老古董吗
cues.pinyin: wan2 le5 nan2 dao4 ta1 zhen1 de5 bian4 cheng2 lao3 gu3 dong3 ma5
cues.en: Great, has he really turned into an old fogey?

cues.zh: 算了这些都不重要
cues.pinyin: suan4 le5 zhe4 xie1 dou1 bu2 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: Never mind, none of that matters.

cues.zh: 还是任务最重要
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ren4 wu4 zui4 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: The mission is what matters most.

cues.zh: 他在学校四处寻找藏金条的地方
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 xue2 xiao4 si4 chu4 xun2 zhao3 cang2 jin1 tiao2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: He searches all over the school for where the gold might be hidden,

cues.zh: 然后发现学校里面有一座非常古旧的老龙
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fa1 xian4 xue2 xiao4 li3 mian4 you3 yi1 zuo4 fei1 chang2 gu3 jiu4 de5 lao3 long2
cues.en: and discovers a very old, run-down building on campus.

cues.zh: 这边正转着圈看老龙呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 zheng4 zhuan3 zhe5 quan1 kan4 lao3 long2 ne5
cues.en: While he's circling around checking out the old building,

cues.zh: 没想到正好撞上霸凌现场
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 zheng4 hao3 zhuang4 shang4 ba4 ling2 xian4 chang3
cues.en: he unexpectedly stumbles right into a bullying incident.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 而郑海诚并不知道学校有关的教育成像
cues.pinyin: er2 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 bing4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 xue2 xiao4 you3 guan1 de5 jiao4 yu4 cheng2 xiang4
cues.en: Zheng Haicheng has no idea there's surveillance footage of this at the school,

cues.zh: 他一门心思都是进入那栋旧楼
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 men2 xin1 si1 dou1 shi4 jin4 ru4 na4 dong4 jiu4 lou2
cues.en: his mind is set only on getting into that old building

cues.zh: 查看有没有金条
cues.pinyin: cha2 kan4 you3 mei2 you3 jin1 tiao2
cues.en: to check whether the gold bars are there.

cues.zh: 这栋楼十分老旧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dong4 lou2 shi2 fen1 lao3 jiu4
cues.en: The building is extremely run-down,

cues.zh: 完全不符合这所学校豪奢的贵族高中设定
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 bu4 fu2 he2 zhe4 suo3 xue2 xiao4 hao2 she1 de5 gui4 zu2 gao1 zhong1 she4 ding4
cues.en: completely at odds with the school's image as a lavish elite academy.

cues.zh: 而且平日里大门紧锁
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ping2 ri4 li3 da4 men2 jin3 suo3
cues.en: Its doors are normally kept locked,

cues.zh: 还密布监控
cues.pinyin: hai2 mi4 bu4 jian1 kong4
cues.en: and it's covered with surveillance cameras.

cues.zh: 明明没有在使用
cues.pinyin: ming2 ming2 mei2 you3 zai4 shi3 yong4
cues.en: Even though it's clearly not in use,

cues.zh: 但是里面的电力却是正常的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 li3 mian4 de5 dian4 li4 que4 shi4 zheng4 chang2 de5
cues.en: the power inside is still running normally,

cues.zh: 甚至还有设备维持一定的适度
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hai2 you3 she4 bei4 wei2 chi2 yi2 ding4 de5 shi4 du4
cues.en: and there's even equipment maintaining a certain humidity level.

cues.zh: 种种线索来看
cues.pinyin: zhong3 zhong3 xian4 suo3 lai2 kan4
cues.en: Judging by all these clues,

cues.zh: 金条大概率就在这栋老楼里
cues.pinyin: jin1 tiao2 da4 gai4 lv4 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 dong4 lao3 lou2 li3
cues.en: the gold is most likely hidden inside this old building.

cues.zh: 当天晚上郑海诚便潜入了这座老楼
cues.pinyin: dang4 tian1 wan3 shang4 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 bian4 qian2 ru4 le5 zhe4 zuo4 lao3 lou2
cues.en: That night, Zheng Haicheng sneaks into the old building.

cues.zh: 没想到刚到转角被人拿枪指着
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 gang1 dao4 zhuan3 jiao3 bei4 ren2 na2 qiang1 zhi3 zhe5
cues.en: Right at the corner, he's unexpectedly held at gunpoint.

cues.zh: 原来是巡逻的女老师发现了他
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 shi4 xun2 luo2 de5 nv3 lao3 shi1 fa1 xian4 le5 ta1
cues.en: It turns out it's the patrolling female teacher who's found him.

cues.zh: 幸好郑海诚戴着口罩
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 dai4 zhe5 kou3 zhao4
cues.en: Luckily, Zheng Haicheng is wearing a mask,

cues.zh: 女老师一下并没有认出来
cues.pinyin: nv3 lao3 shi1 yi1 xia4 bing4 mei2 you3 ren4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: so the teacher doesn't recognize him right away.

cues.zh: 他拿手电腿慌了一下女老师
cues.pinyin: ta1 na2 shou3 dian4 tui3 huang1 le5 yi1 xia4 nv3 lao3 shi1
cues.en: He flashes his flashlight at her once,

cues.zh: 趁着女老师眼花的瞬间夺门而出
cues.pinyin: chen4 zhe5 nv3 lao3 shi1 yan3 hua1 de5 shun4 jian1 duo2 men2 er2 chu1
cues.en: and while her eyes are dazzled, he bolts out the door.

cues.zh: 这件事引起了学校的警觉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 yin3 qi3 le5 xue2 xiao4 de5 jing3 jue2
cues.en: The incident puts the school on alert.

cues.zh: 郑海诚第二天还是照常去上学
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 di4 er4 tian1 hai2 shi4 zhao4 chang2 qu4 shang4 xue2
cues.en: The next day, Zheng Haicheng still goes to school as usual.

cues.zh: 他现在最大的麻烦就是霸凌小
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 zui4 da4 de5 ma2 fan2 jiu4 shi4 ba4 ling2 xiao3
cues.en: His biggest problem now is that a bullying gang

cues.zh: 团伙盯上了他
cues.pinyin: tuan2 huo3 ding1 shang4 le5 ta1
cues.en: has set its sights on him.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新高能韩剧《卧底高中》！顶级特工假扮高中生寻找8000亿金条！途中竟还被校园霸凌了！

cues.zh: 郑海诚回到教室
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 hui2 dao4 jiao4 shi4
cues.en: When Zheng Haicheng returns to the classroom,

cues.zh: 突然发现自己的同桌跟他一起被霸凌
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 de5 tong2 zhuo1 gen1 ta1 yi4 qi3 bei4 ba4 ling2
cues.en: he suddenly notices that his deskmate,

cues.zh: 的东民不见了
cues.pinyin: de5 dong1 min2 bu2 jian4 le5
cues.en: Dongmin, who was also bullied with him, is missing.

cues.zh: 霸凌他们的班长声称说东民不舒服回家了
cues.pinyin: ba4 ling2 ta1 men5 de5 ban1 zhang3 sheng1 cheng1 shuo1 dong1 min2 bu4 shu1 fu2 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: The class monitor who bullies them claims Dongmin went home sick.

cues.zh: 但郑海诚总觉得事情没有那么简单
cues.pinyin: dan4 zheng4 hai3 cheng2 zong3 jue2 de5 shi4 qing2 mei2 you3 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But Zheng Haicheng feels it can't be that simple.

cues.zh: 又是课间
cues.pinyin: you4 shi4 ke4 jian1
cues.en: During another break,

cues.zh: 他偷偷躲起来替班长打游戏
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou1 tou1 duo3 qi3 lai2 ti4 ban1 zhang3 da3 you2 xi4
cues.en: he secretly hides away to play games for the class monitor,

cues.zh: 意外发现校长进入老楼
cues.pinyin: yi4 wai4 fa1 xian4 xiao4 zhang3 jin4 ru4 lao3 lou2
cues.en: and happens to spot the principal entering the old building.

cues.zh: 他赶紧偷偷跟了上去
cues.pinyin: ta1 gan3 jin3 tou1 tou1 gen1 le5 shang4 qu4
cues.en: He quickly sneaks after him,

cues.zh: 发现校长进入地下室
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 xiao4 zhang3 jin4 ru4 di4 xia4 shi4
cues.en: and sees the principal go down into the basement.

cues.zh: 但这时保安也发现了他
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 shi2 bao3 an1 ye3 fa1 xian4 le5 ta1
cues.en: But at that moment, security spots him too.

cues.zh: 郑海诚更加确定了地下室的确有问题
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hai3 cheng2 geng4 jia1 que4 ding4 le5 di4 xia4 shi4 di2 que4 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Zheng Haicheng is now even more certain something's wrong with the basement.

cues.zh: 他正在思索的时候忽然发现旁边的垃圾箱
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng4 zai4 si1 suo3 de5 shi2 hou4 hu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 pang2 bian1 de5 la1 ji1 xiang1
cues.en: While he's thinking it over, he notices the trash bin next to him

cues.zh: 有点不太对劲
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 bu4 tai4 dui4 jin4
cues.en: seems a bit off.

cues.zh: 他打开垃圾箱一看
cues.pinyin: ta1 da3 kai1 la1 ji1 xiang1 yi1 kan4
cues.en: He opens the bin to look,

cues.zh: 自己的同桌竟然在里面
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 de5 tong2 zhuo1 jing4 ran2 zai4 li3 mian4
cues.en: and finds his deskmate inside.

cues.zh: 不用说
cues.pinyin: bu2 yong4 shuo1
cues.en: Needless to say,

cues.zh: 这肯定又是国会议员儿子太秀干的好事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ken3 ding4 you4 shi4 guo2 hui4 yi4 yuan2 er2 zi5 tai4 xiu4 gan4 de5 hao3 shi4
cues.en: this must be the handiwork of Taesoo, the congressman's son, again.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 小学生如何写作文🤔🤔~~一点就通👍👍

cues.zh: 珊珊快升国中了她国小作文还不错
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 kuai4 sheng1 guo2 zhong1 le5 ta1 guo2 xiao3 zuo4 wen2 hai2 bu2 cuo4
cues.en: Shanshan is about to start middle school; her essays were already pretty good in elementary school.

cues.zh: 语文竞赛市赛第一
cues.pinyin: yu3 wen2 jing4 sai4 shi4 sai4 di4 yi1
cues.en: She placed first in the Chinese writing competition at the city level.

cues.zh: 代表高雄市比全国赛也得到优等
cues.pinyin: dai4 biao3 gao1 xiong2 shi4 bi3 quan2 guo2 sai4 ye3 de2 dao4 you1 deng3
cues.en: Representing Kaohsiung City, she also won an award of excellence at the national competition.

cues.zh: 今天就来问问她是怎么写作文的
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 wen4 wen4 ta1 shi4 zen3 me5 xie3 zuo4 wen2 de5
cues.en: Today we're going to ask her how she writes her essays.

cues.zh: 珊珊你都是怎么写作文的啊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 ni3 dou1 shi4 zen3 me5 xie3 zuo4 wen2 de5 a5
cues.en: Shanshan, how do you go about writing an essay?

cues.zh: 看到题目后要先审题
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 ti2 mu4 hou4 yao4 xian1 shen3 ti2
cues.en: After seeing the topic, you first need to analyze it carefully.

cues.zh: 把架构组织好大纲要先在头脑中拟好
cues.pinyin: ba3 jia4 gou4 zu3 zhi1 hao3 da4 gang1 yao4 xian1 zai4 tou2 nao3 zhong1 ni3 hao3
cues.en: You should organize the structure and work out the outline in your head first.

cues.zh: 要不然的话下一段就不知道要写什么了
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 de5 hua4 xia4 yi1 duan4 jiu4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 yao4 xie3 shen2 me5 le5
cues.en: Otherwise you won't know what to write in the next paragraph.

cues.zh: 每段都不要超出设定的范围
cues.pinyin: mei3 duan4 dou1 bu2 yao4 chao1 chu1 she4 ding4 de5 fan4 wei2
cues.en: Each paragraph shouldn't go beyond its intended scope.

cues.zh: 这就是所谓的起承转合
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 suo3 wei4 de5 qi3 cheng2 zhuan3 he2
cues.en: This is what's called the 'introduction, elaboration, transition, conclusion' structure.

cues.zh: 第一段就是要先破题解释题目
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 duan4 jiu4 shi4 yao4 xian1 po4 ti2 jie3 shi4 ti2 mu4
cues.en: The first paragraph should open by explaining the topic.

cues.zh: 要是离题了后面的楼就歪了
cues.pinyin: yao4 shi4 li2 ti2 le5 hou4 mian4 de5 lou2 jiu4 wai1 le5
cues.en: If you go off-topic, everything built on it after that goes crooked.

cues.zh: 像我最难忘的一件事
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 zui4 nan2 wang4 de5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: Like 'The Most Unforgettable Thing'

cues.zh: 和我最快乐的一件事
cues.pinyin: he2 wo3 zui4 kuai4 le4 de5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: and 'The Happiest Thing'

cues.zh: 这两个题目的意思就是不一样的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 ti2 mu4 di4 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: these two topics actually mean different things.

cues.zh: 第二段的话
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 duan4 de5 hua4
cues.en: As for the second paragraph,

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 小学生如何写作文🤔🤔~~一点就通👍👍

cues.zh: 你可以先把题目当作是一个问题
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 xian1 ba3 ti2 mu4 dang4 zuo4 shi4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: you can first treat the topic as a question

cues.zh: 回答题目
cues.pinyin: hui2 da2 ti2 mu4
cues.en: and answer that question.

cues.zh: 把题目延伸下去就成了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ti2 mu4 yan2 shen1 xia4 qu4 jiu4 cheng2 le5
cues.en: Extending from the topic like that is enough.

cues.zh: 第三段就是如果没有做到会如何
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 duan4 jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 zuo4 dao4 hui4 ru2 he2
cues.en: The third paragraph covers what would happen if you failed to achieve it.

cues.zh: 最后一段的话就是先做个总结
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 duan4 de5 hua4 jiu4 shi4 xian1 zuo4 ge4 zong3 jie2
cues.en: The last paragraph is where you give a summary.

cues.zh: 总而言之言而总之等等的
cues.pinyin: zong3 er2 yan2 zhi1 yan2 er2 zong3 zhi1 deng3 deng3 de5
cues.en: Phrases like 'in summary' or 'to sum it up' and so on.

cues.zh: 最后一段呢要记得扬升
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 duan4 ne5 yao4 ji4 de5 yang2 sheng1
cues.en: And for the last paragraph, remember to end on an uplifting note.

cues.zh: 不要说一些比较负面一点的话
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 shuo1 yi1 xie1 bi3 jiao4 fu4 mian4 yi4 dian3 de5 hua4
cues.en: Don't say anything too negative.

cues.zh: 例如说我再也不要参加运动会了
cues.pinyin: li4 ru2 shuo1 wo3 zai4 ye3 bu2 yao4 can1 jia1 yun4 dong4 hui4 le5
cues.en: For example, 'I never want to join sports day again.'

cues.zh: 或是我从此再也没信心的这些的
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 wo3 cong2 ci3 zai4 ye3 mei2 xin4 xin1 de5 zhe4 xie1 de5
cues.en: Or 'I'll never have confidence again' — things like that.

cues.zh: 好那还有什么作文小技巧吗
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 zuo4 wen2 xiao3 ji4 qiao3 ma5
cues.en: Okay, are there any other essay-writing tips?

cues.zh: 如果是比赛的话写一篇一千个字的文章
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 bi3 sai4 de5 hua4 xie3 yi1 pian1 yi1 qian1 ge4 zi4 de5 wen2 zhang1
cues.en: If it's for a competition, you write about a 1,000-character essay.

cues.zh: 只分几段的话太少了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 fen1 ji3 duan4 de5 hua4 tai4 shao3 le5
cues.en: If you only split it into a few paragraphs, that's too few.

cues.zh: 每段的字数太多
cues.pinyin: mei3 duan4 de5 zi4 shu4 tai4 duo1
cues.en: Each paragraph would have too many characters.

cues.zh: 平时也看得会很吃力
cues.pinyin: ping2 shi2 ye3 kan4 de2 hui4 hen3 chi1 li4
cues.en: It would also be tiring to read normally.

cues.zh: 所以呢我会把它分成 6 到 7 段
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ne5 wo3 hui4 ba3 ta1 fen1 cheng2 6 dao4 7 duan4
cues.en: So I divide it into 6 to 7 paragraphs.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 小学生如何写作文🤔🤔~~一点就通👍👍

cues.zh: 第一段的话会先放一些佳句
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 duan4 de5 hua4 hui4 xian1 fang4 yi1 xie1 jia1 ju4
cues.en: In the first paragraph I'll put in some nice quotes.

cues.zh: 让评审眼睛一亮
cues.pinyin: rang4 ping2 shen3 yan3 jing1 yi1 liang4
cues.en: To make the judges' eyes light up.

cues.zh: 佳句多备一些万用的
cues.pinyin: jia1 ju4 duo1 bei4 yi1 xie1 wan4 yong4 de5
cues.en: Prepare extra all-purpose quotes in advance.

cues.zh: 这集以前的文章用过了也没有关系
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji2 yi3 qian2 de5 wen2 zhang1 yong4 guo4 le5 ye3 mei2 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: It's fine even if you've used it in a previous essay.

cues.zh: 因为评审可能只看你这一次
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ping2 shen3 ke3 neng2 zhi3 kan4 ni3 zhe4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: Because the judges will probably only read this one essay of yours.

cues.zh: 如果忘了这句佳句的来源
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wang4 le5 zhe4 ju4 jia1 ju4 de5 lai2 yuan2
cues.en: If you forget where a quote came from,

cues.zh: 你可以说有位名人互说
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 shuo1 you3 wei4 ming2 ren2 hu4 shuo1
cues.en: you can just say 'a famous person once said...'

cues.zh: 或是有句话说这样就可以了
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 you3 ju4 hua4 shuo1 zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: or 'there's a saying that goes...' — that works too.

cues.zh: 文章中间要举一个长故事
cues.pinyin: wen2 zhang1 zhong1 jian1 yao4 ju3 yi2 ge4 zhang3 gu4 shi4
cues.en: In the middle of the essay, bring in a longer story.

cues.zh: 自己的例子最好
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 de5 li4 zi5 zui4 hao3
cues.en: Your own example is best.

cues.zh: 名人的也没有关系
cues.pinyin: ming2 ren2 de5 ye3 mei2 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: A celebrity's example is fine too.

cues.zh: 最后一段要说自己的期许

cues.zh: 他就一直追着我
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 yi4 zhi2 zhui1 zhe5 wo3
cues.en: So he just kept chasing me.

cues.en: remember to subscribe and like,

cues.en: and share this video.

cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 xi1 wang4 ke3 yi3 gen1 da4 jia1 zai4
cues.en: I also hope to stay in touch with everyone

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 经常有小朋友问我说他的亲戚朋友给他介
cues.pinyin: jing1 chang2 you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 ta1 de5 qin1 qi1 peng2 you3 gei3 ta1 jie4
cues.en: Kids often ask me that their relatives or friends introduced

cues.zh: 绍了一个工程
cues.pinyin: shao4 le5 yi2 ge4 gong1 cheng2
cues.en: them to a 'project.'

cues.zh: 只要交一定份额的钱
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 jiao1 yi2 ding4 fen4 e2 de5 qian2
cues.en: As long as you pay a certain amount of money,

cues.zh: 然后就可以在几个月之后拿回一笔巨款
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zai4 ji3 ge4 yue4 zhi1 hou4 na2 hui2 yi1 bi3 ju4 kuan3
cues.en: you can get back a huge sum a few months later.

cues.zh: 他问我这事到底靠不靠谱呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen4 wo3 zhe4 shi4 dao4 di3 kao4 bu4 kao4 pu3 ne5
cues.en: They ask me whether this is actually legit.

cues.zh: 或者说直白一点他知道传销是非法的
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 zhi2 bai2 yi4 dian3 ta1 zhi1 dao4 chuan2 xiao1 shi4 fei1 fa3 de5
cues.en: Or to put it bluntly, they know pyramid schemes are illegal,

cues.zh: 但是到底能不能挣到钱呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dao4 di3 neng2 bu4 neng2 zheng1 dao4 qian2 ne5
cues.en: but can you actually make money from it?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来研究一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's look into this question.

cues.zh: 我们首先从一个古老的骗局庞氏骗局说起
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 cong2 yi2 ge4 gu3 lao3 de5 pian4 ju2 pang2 shi4 pian4 ju2 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: Let's start with an old scam: the Ponzi scheme.

cues.zh: 庞氏骗局这个名字是从一个意
cues.pinyin: pang2 shi4 pian4 ju2 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4 shi4 cong2 yi2 ge4 yi4
cues.en: The name 'Ponzi scheme' comes from an

cues.zh: 大利人开始的
cues.pinyin: da4 li4 ren2 kai1 shi3 de5
cues.en: Italian man.

cues.zh: 这个意大利人名字叫做查尔斯庞兹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi4 da4 li4 ren2 ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 cha2 er3 si1 pang2 zi1
cues.en: This Italian's name was Charles Ponzi.

cues.zh: 查尔斯庞兹出生于意大利
cues.pinyin: cha2 er3 si1 pang2 zi1 chu1 sheng1 yu2 yi4 da4 li4
cues.en: Charles Ponzi was born in Italy,

cues.zh: 但是他后来主要的活动都是在美国
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 hou4 lai2 zhu3 yao4 de5 huo2 dong4 dou1 shi4 zai4 mei3 guo2
cues.en: but his main activities later were in the US.

cues.zh: 在 19 03 年的时候查尔斯
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 03 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 cha2 er3 si1
cues.en: In 1903, Charles

cues.zh: 庞兹坐着船到了美国
cues.pinyin: pang2 zi1 zuo4 zhe5 chuan2 dao4 le5 mei3 guo2
cues.en: Ponzi arrived in the US by boat.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 到了美国的时候他身上只有 2
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 mei3 guo2 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 shen1 shang4 zhi3 you3 2
cues.en: When he arrived in the US, he only had

cues.zh: 块 5 毛钱美元
cues.pinyin: kuai4 5 mao2 qian2 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: $2.50 on him.

cues.zh: 但是他说自己有一个 100 万美元的梦想
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 you3 yi2 ge4 100 wan4 mei3 yuan2 de5 meng4 xiang3
cues.en: But he said he had a dream of making a million dollars.

cues.zh: 100 万美元大概相当于我们今天
cues.pinyin: 100 wan4 mei3 yuan2 da4 gai4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1
cues.en: A million dollars back then is roughly like

cues.zh: 的一个小目标
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 ge4 xiao3 mu4 biao1
cues.en: a 'small goal' today.

cues.zh: 在 19 03 年到了美国之后他的命运就没
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 03 nian2 dao4 le5 mei3 guo2 zhi1 hou4 ta1 de5 ming4 yun4 jiu4 mei2
cues.en: After arriving in the US in 1903, his luck

cues.zh: 有那么顺利了
cues.pinyin: you3 na4 me5 shun4 li4 le5
cues.en: wasn't so great.

cues.zh: 19 03 年的时候在餐厅做服务员
cues.pinyin: 19 03 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 can1 ting1 zuo4 fu2 wu4 yuan2
cues.en: In 1903 he worked as a waiter in a restaurant,

cues.zh: 结果偷东西盗窃
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 tou1 dong1 xi1 dao4 qie4
cues.en: but ended up stealing,

cues.zh: 盗窃了之后就被餐厅开除了
cues.pinyin: dao4 qie4 le5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 bei4 can1 ting1 kai1 chu2 le5
cues.en: and after stealing he was fired.

cues.zh: 后来在 19 07 年的时候
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zai4 19 07 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Later, in 1907,

cues.zh: 他跑到了加拿大的蒙特利尔
cues.pinyin: ta1 pao3 dao4 le5 jia1 na2 da4 de5 meng2 te4 li4 er3
cues.en: he went to Montreal, Canada.

cues.zh: 在蒙特利尔的一家银行里边当一个职员
cues.pinyin: zai4 meng2 te4 li4 er3 de5 yi1 jia1 yin2 hang2 li3 bian1 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhi2 yuan2
cues.en: He worked as a clerk at a bank in Montreal.

cues.zh: 后来他发现这家银行每年给出储
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 fa1 xian4 zhe4 jia1 yin2 hang2 mei3 nian2 gei3 chu1 chu3
cues.en: He later discovered that this bank's annual interest

cues.zh: 户的利息是 6
cues.pinyin: hu4 de5 li4 xi1 shi4 6
cues.en: rate for depositors was 6%,

cues.zh: 比其他银行都高一倍
cues.pinyin: bi3 qi2 ta1 yin2 hang2 dou1 gao1 yi2 bei4
cues.en: twice as high as other banks.

cues.zh: 这是为什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why was that?

cues.zh: 后来他发现原来这家银行不过在做一种
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 fa1 xian4 yuan2 lai2 zhe4 jia1 yin2 hang2 bu4 guo4 zai4 zuo4 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: He later found out the bank was just doing something like

cues.zh: 拆东墙补西墙的行为
cues.pinyin: chai1 dong1 qiang2 bu3 xi1 qiang2 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: robbing Peter to pay Paul.

cues.zh: 也就是说新的储户进来之后
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 xin1 de5 chu3 hu4 jin4 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: That is, when new depositors came in,

cues.zh: 把新储户的钱去补贴给那些原来的储户
cues.pinyin: ba3 xin1 chu3 hu4 de5 qian2 qu4 bu3 tie1 gei3 na4 xie1 yuan2 lai2 de5 chu3 hu4
cues.en: their money was used to pay the old depositors.

cues.zh: 这个事给了庞兹很大的启发
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 gei3 le5 pang2 zi1 hen3 da4 de5 qi3 fa1
cues.en: This gave Ponzi a lot of inspiration.

cues.zh: 这个事当然玩不下去
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 dang1 ran2 wan2 bu4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: Of course, this couldn't go on forever.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 这个国际回信邮票券是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo2 ji4 hui2 xin4 you2 piao4 quan4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what was this 'International Reply Coupon'?

cues.zh: 就说当时庞兹从监狱里边出来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shuo1 dang1 shi2 pang2 zi1 cong2 jian1 yu4 li3 bian1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: At that time, Ponzi had just gotten out of prison,

cues.zh: 面对自己房租都快要付不起的情况
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 zi4 ji3 fang2 zu1 dou1 kuai4 yao4 fu4 bu4 qi3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: facing a situation where he could barely pay rent.

cues.zh: 想怎么发财呢
cues.pinyin: xiang3 zen3 me5 fa1 cai2 ne5
cues.en: How could he get rich?

cues.zh: 他作为一个连续创业者
cues.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 lian2 xu4 chuang4 ye4 zhe3
cues.en: As a serial entrepreneur,

cues.zh: 就又想出一个点子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 you4 xiang3 chu1 yi2 ge4 dian3 zi5
cues.en: he came up with another idea.

cues.zh: 说我给企业做广告
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wo3 gei3 qi3 ye4 zuo4 guang3 gao4
cues.en: He said, I'll make ads for businesses.

cues.zh: 做出一个叫做国际企业名录的书
cues.pinyin: zuo4 chu1 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 guo2 ji4 qi3 ye4 ming2 lu4 de5 shu1
cues.en: He made a book called the International Business Directory.

cues.zh: 我去分发
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 fen1 fa1
cues.en: I'll distribute it.

cues.zh: 这样一来别人可以定据这本书就挣了钱了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 bie2 ren2 ke3 yi3 ding4 ju4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 jiu4 zheng1 le5 qian2 le5
cues.en: This way, others could place ads through the book and he'd make money.

cues.zh: 结果做了这本书之后
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zuo4 le5 zhe4 ben3 shu1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After he actually made the book,

cues.zh: 发现没有多少企业回应他
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 mei2 you3 duo1 shao3 qi3 ye4 hui2 ying4 ta1
cues.en: he found that few businesses responded.

cues.zh: 不过远在西班牙的一个企业
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yuan3 zai4 xi1 ban1 ya2 de5 yi2 ge4 qi3 ye4
cues.en: But a company far away in Spain

cues.zh: 反而给他寄了一封信
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 gei3 ta1 ji4 le5 yi1 feng1 xin4
cues.en: actually sent him a letter.

cues.zh: 这封信里面除了一些正常内容以外
cues.pinyin: zhe4 feng1 xin4 li3 mian4 chu2 le5 yi1 xie1 zheng4 chang2 nei4 rong2 yi3 wai4
cues.en: Besides the usual content,

cues.zh: 还附了一张券
cues.pinyin: hai2 fu4 le5 yi1 zhang1 quan4
cues.en: the letter also had a coupon attached.

cues.zh: 就是这个国际回信邮票券
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 guo2 ji4 hui2 xin4 you2 piao4 quan4
cues.en: This was the International Reply Coupon.

cues.zh: 什么意思
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: What does that mean?

cues.zh: 就是西班牙有一个企业
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xi1 ban1 ya2 you3 yi2 ge4 qi3 ye4
cues.en: There was a company in Spain

cues.zh: 他对庞兹的这个名录感兴趣
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 pang2 zi1 de5 zhe4 ge5 ming2 lu4 gan3 xing4 qu4
cues.en: that was interested in Ponzi's directory.

cues.zh: 于是他就给这个庞兹寄了一封信
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 gei3 zhe4 ge5 pang2 zi1 ji4 le5 yi1 feng1 xin4
cues.en: So it sent Ponzi a letter.

cues.zh: 这封信你要寄过来你得贴邮票对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 feng1 xin4 ni3 yao4 ji4 guo4 lai2 ni3 de2 tie1 you2 piao4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: To send that letter, you need to put a stamp on it, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 而这个国际回信邮票券是这个万国邮
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 guo2 ji4 hui2 xin4 you2 piao4 quan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 wan4 guo2 you2
cues.en: And this International Reply Coupon was issued by the Universal

cues.zh: 政联盟主办的
cues.pinyin: zheng4 lian2 meng2 zhu3 ban4 de5
cues.en: Postal Union.

cues.zh: 所有的加盟国他都是要承认这个
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 jia1 meng2 guo2 ta1 dou1 shi4 yao4 cheng2 ren4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: All member countries had to recognize this

cues.zh: 邮票券的对吧
cues.pinyin: you2 piao4 quan4 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: coupon.

cues.zh: 好那么这么一个东西庞兹发现
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 dong1 xi1 pang2 zi1 fa1 xian4
cues.en: So with this thing, what business opportunity

cues.zh: 了什么商机呢
cues.pinyin: le5 shen2 me5 shang1 ji1 ne5
cues.en: did Ponzi spot?

cues.zh: 他发现这个邮票券在西班牙卖的
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 you2 piao4 quan4 zai4 xi1 ban1 ya2 mai4 de5
cues.en: He found that in Spain, this coupon

cues.zh: 它是卖 30 分这是西班牙的货币
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 mai4 30 fen1 zhe4 shi4 xi1 ban1 ya2 de5 huo4 bi4
cues.en: sold for 30 cents, in Spanish currency.

cues.zh: 需要用西班牙货币 30 分来买这个邮票券
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 yong4 xi1 ban1 ya2 huo4 bi4 30 fen1 lai2 mai3 zhe4 ge5 you2 piao4 quan4
cues.en: You needed 30 Spanish cents to buy this coupon.

cues.zh: 但是到了美国这个邮局
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dao4 le5 mei3 guo2 zhe4 ge5 you2 ju2
cues.en: But at the US post office,

cues.zh: 你换回来这张邮票它是 5 分钱
cues.pinyin: ni3 huan4 hui2 lai2 zhe4 zhang1 you2 piao4 ta1 shi4 5 fen1 qian2
cues.en: you could exchange it for a 5-cent US stamp.

cues.zh: 这是美国的这个价格
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 mei3 guo2 de5 zhe4 ge5 jia4 ge2
cues.en: That was the US price.

cues.zh: 他就发现那么按照这个国际回信邮票
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 fa1 xian4 na4 me5 an4 zhao4 zhe4 ge5 guo2 ji4 hui2 xin4 you2 piao4
cues.en: So he figured, based on this International Reply Coupon,

cues.zh: 券的这个比例
cues.pinyin: quan4 de5 zhe4 ge5 bi3 li4
cues.en: ratio,

cues.zh: 西班牙和美国的货币它们之间的关
cues.pinyin: xi1 ban1 ya2 he2 mei3 guo2 de5 huo4 bi4 ta1 men5 zhi1 jian1 de5 guan1
cues.en: what should the exchange relationship

cues.zh: 系应该是什么
cues.pinyin: xi4 ying1 gai1 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: between Spanish and US currency be?

cues.zh: 应该是 6 比 1 的关系对吧
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 6 bi3 1 de5 guan1 xi4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: It should be 6 to 1, right?

cues.zh: 这个汇率应该是 6 比 1 的这么一个关系
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hui4 lv4 ying1 gai1 shi4 6 bi3 1 de5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 guan1 xi4
cues.en: The exchange rate should be about 6 to 1.

cues.zh: 但是他又查阅了当时的报纸
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 you4 cha2 yue4 liao3 dang4 shi2 de5 bao4 zhi3
cues.en: But when he checked the newspapers at the time,

cues.zh: 他发现真正的市场上的汇率是多少
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 zhen1 zheng4 de5 shi4 chang3 shang4 de5 hui4 lv4 shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: he found what the actual market exchange rate was.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 市场上西班牙货币对美国货币的比
cues.pinyin: shi4 chang3 shang4 xi1 ban1 ya2 huo4 bi4 dui4 mei3 guo2 huo4 bi4 de5 bi3
cues.en: In the market, the ratio of Spanish currency to US currency

cues.zh: 例是 6 6 比 1
cues.pinyin: li4 shi4 6 6 bi3 1
cues.en: was 6.6 to 1.

cues.zh: 因为当时欧洲不太行欧洲刚打完一战
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dang1 shi2 ou1 zhou1 bu4 tai4 xing2 ou1 zhou1 gang1 da3 wan2 yi1 zhan4
cues.en: Because Europe wasn't doing well then — it had just finished WWI,

cues.zh: 所以那时候经济很差
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 na4 shi2 hou4 jing1 ji4 hen3 cha4
cues.en: so the economy was very bad,

cues.zh: 所以这个很多货币都在贬值
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 hen3 duo1 huo4 bi4 dou1 zai4 bian3 zhi2
cues.en: and many currencies were depreciating.

cues.zh: 他就发现这里面汇率不一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 li3 mian4 hui4 lv4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: He noticed the exchange rates didn't match.

cues.zh: 于是呢于是就有套利的空间
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ne5 yu2 shi4 jiu4 you3 tao4 li4 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: So there was room for arbitrage.

cues.zh: 怎么套利呢其实也很简单
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 tao4 li4 ne5 qi2 shi2 ye3 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: How to arbitrage? It's actually simple.

cues.zh: 就是你在西班牙花 6 块钱买邮票券
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 zai4 xi1 ban1 ya2 hua1 6 kuai4 qian2 mai3 you2 piao4 quan4
cues.en: You spend 6 pesetas in Spain to buy the coupons,

cues.zh: 到了美国之后
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 mei3 guo2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: then once in the US,

cues.zh: 你就可以换成这个 1 块钱美元的等值邮票
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 huan4 cheng2 zhe4 ge5 1 kuai4 qian2 mei3 yuan2 de5 deng3 zhi2 you2 piao4
cues.en: you exchange them for $1 worth of stamps.

cues.zh: 然后你再通过某些方法
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 zai4 tong1 guo4 mou3 xie1 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Then, through some method,

cues.zh: 把这 1 块钱的等值邮票换成美元
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 1 kuai4 qian2 de5 deng3 zhi2 you2 piao4 huan4 cheng2 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: convert that $1 worth of stamps into cash dollars.

cues.zh: 然后再用这个美元在汇率市场上换回成西
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 mei3 yuan2 zai4 hui4 lv4 shi4 chang3 shang4 huan4 hui2 cheng2 xi1
cues.en: Then use that dollar in the currency market to convert back into

cues.zh: 班牙的这个钱
cues.pinyin: ban1 ya2 de5 zhe4 ge5 qian2
cues.en: Spanish money.

cues.zh: 那就能换 6 块 6 了吧对不对
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 neng2 huan4 6 kuai4 6 le5 ba5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Then you'd get 6.6 pesetas back, right?

cues.zh: 然后你再拿这 6 块 6 去买邮票
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 zai4 na2 zhe4 6 kuai4 6 qu4 mai3 you2 piao4
cues.en: Then you use that 6.6 to buy coupons again.

cues.zh: 这样做一个循环
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 xun2 huan2
cues.en: That's one full cycle.

cues.zh: 做一个循环能挣多少钱能挣 10 对不对
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ge4 xun2 huan2 neng2 zheng1 duo1 shao3 qian2 neng2 zheng1 10 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: How much do you earn per cycle? About 10%, right?

cues.zh: 能挣 10
cues.pinyin: neng2 zheng1 10
cues.en: You earn about 10%.

cues.zh: 所以这样就存在套利的可能
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 jiu4 cun2 zai4 tao4 li4 de5 ke3 neng2
cues.en: So there was a real possibility for arbitrage.

cues.zh: 然后庞兹亲自的去试了一下
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 pang2 zi1 qin1 zi4 de5 qu4 shi4 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Then Ponzi tried it himself.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞氏骗局是什么？如何识别传销诈骗？（经济泡沫系列之三）

cues.zh: 那 90 天你的资产可就翻倍了
cues.pinyin: na4 90 tian1 ni3 de5 zi1 chan3 ke3 jiu4 fan1 bei4 le5
cues.en: In 90 days, your assets would double.

cues.zh: 所以它这个广告是非常吸引人的对不对
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 zhe4 ge5 guang3 gao4 shi4 fei1 chang2 xi1 yin3 ren2 de5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: So this pitch was very attractive, right?

cues.zh: 然后到了 19 20 年的 2 月
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 dao4 le5 19 20 nian2 de5 2 yue4
cues.en: Then, in February 1920,

cues.zh: 庞兹的这个公司正式开始市运营
cues.pinyin: pang2 zi1 de5 zhe4 ge5 gong1 si1 zheng4 shi4 kai1 shi3 shi4 yun4 ying2
cues.en: Ponzi's company officially started operating.

cues.zh: 第一个月它就筹集了 5000 美元
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 yue4 ta1 jiu4 chou2 ji2 le5 5000 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: In the first month, it raised $5,000.

cues.zh: 5000 美元已经不少了
cues.pinyin: 5000 mei3 yuan2 yi3 jing1 bu4 shao3 le5
cues.en: $5,000 was already quite a lot.

cues.zh: 没想到后来人就越来越多
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 hou4 lai2 ren2 jiu4 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: Unexpectedly, more and more people joined.

cues.zh: 到了 7 月的时候
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 7 yue4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: By July,

cues.zh: 这个数字已经达到了 100 万美元
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu4 zi4 yi3 jing1 da2 dao4 le5 100 wan4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: the amount had reached $1 million.

cues.zh: 最疯狂的时候
cues.pinyin: zui4 feng1 kuang2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: At the craziest point,

cues.zh: 人们拥挤在庞兹的大厦周围
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 yong1 ji3 zai4 pang2 zi1 de5 da4 sha4 zhou1 wei2
cues.en: people crowded around Ponzi's building,

cues.zh: 就是向庞兹疯狂的高呼
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xiang4 pang2 zi1 feng1 kuang2 de5 gao1 hu1
cues.en: shouting wildly at Ponzi,

cues.zh: 说庞兹给他们提供了一个发财的梦想
cues.pinyin: shuo1 pang2 zi1 gei3 ta1 men5 ti2 gong1 le5 yi2 ge4 fa1 cai2 de5 meng4 xiang3
cues.en: saying Ponzi had given them a dream of getting rich.

cues.zh: 那么巅峰时刻这个庞兹一共有
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dian1 feng1 shi2 ke4 zhe4 ge5 pang2 zi1 yi1 gong4 you3
cues.en: At its peak, Ponzi had a total of

cues.zh: 4 万名投资者
cues.pinyin: 4 wan4 ming2 tou2 zi1 zhe3
cues.en: 40,000 investors.

cues.zh: 这 4 万名投资者大概有 15 00 万美
cues.pinyin: zhe4 4 wan4 ming2 tou2 zi1 zhe3 da4 gai4 you3 15 00 wan4 mei3
cues.en: These 40,000 investors had put in about $15 million

cues.zh: 元的这个投资
cues.pinyin: yuan2 de5 zhe4 ge5 tou2 zi1
cues.en: in investments.

cues.zh: 庞兹拿到这些钱之后大量的购置
cues.pinyin: pang2 zi1 na2 dao4 zhe4 xie1 qian2 zhi1 hou4 da4 liang4 de5 gou4 zhi4
cues.en: After getting this money, Ponzi bought a huge amount of

cues.zh: 豪宅豪车手表
cues.pinyin: hao2 zhai2 hao2 che1 shou3 biao3
cues.en: mansions, luxury cars, and watches.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 男人别墅找女友却撞见女尸满脸真恐动
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 bie2 shu4 zhao3 nv3 you3 que4 zhuang4 jian4 nv3 shi1 man3 lian3 zhen1 kong3 dong4
cues.en: A man goes to his girlfriend's villa but stumbles upon a woman's corpse, his face full of shock.

cues.zh: 幕后黑手你永远猜不到
cues.pinyin: mu4 hou4 hei1 shou3 ni3 yong3 yuan3 cai1 bu2 dao4
cues.en: You'll never guess who's behind it.

cues.zh: 建议密集恐惧症者慎入
cues.pinyin: jian4 yi4 mi4 ji2 kong3 ju4 zheng4 zhe3 shen4 ru4
cues.en: Warning: those with trypophobia should proceed with caution.

cues.zh: 接到报警后法医实验室迅速赶往现场
cues.pinyin: jie1 dao4 bao4 jing3 hou4 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 xun4 su4 gan3 wang3 xian4 chang3
cues.en: After getting the call, the forensic lab team rushed to the scene.

cues.zh: 而警探老布没直奔现场
cues.pinyin: er2 jing3 tan4 lao3 bu4 mei2 zhi2 ben1 xian4 chang3
cues.en: But detective Lao Bu didn't head straight there.

cues.zh: 却一头扎进健身房找心理学专家小甜甜
cues.pinyin: que4 yi1 tou2 zha1 jin4 jian4 shen1 fang2 zhao3 xin1 li3 xue2 zhuan1 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2
cues.en: Instead he dove into the gym to find psychologist Xiao Tiantian.

cues.zh: 原来法医小谷前段时间刚和他表白
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 qian2 duan4 shi2 jian1 gang1 he2 ta1 biao3 bai2
cues.en: Turns out forensic examiner Xiao Gu had confessed her feelings to him a while back.

cues.zh: 可眼下他正和新女友打得火热
cues.pinyin: ke3 yan3 xia4 ta1 zheng4 he2 xin1 nv3 you3 da3 de2 huo3 re4
cues.en: But right now he's head over heels with his new girlfriend.

cues.zh: 更魔幻的是小谷和现女友居然成了闺蜜
cues.pinyin: geng4 mo2 huan4 de5 shi4 xiao3 gu3 he2 xian4 nv3 you3 ju1 ran2 cheng2 le5 gui1 mi4
cues.en: Even more bizarre, Xiao Gu and his current girlfriend have become best friends.

cues.zh: 老布急得像被踩尾巴的猫
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 ji2 de2 xiang4 bei4 cai3 wei3 ba5 de5 mao1
cues.en: Lao Bu is as anxious as a cat whose tail just got stepped on.

cues.zh: 结果小甜甜摘下耳机一针见血
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xiao3 tian2 tian2 zhai1 xia4 er3 ji1 yi1 zhen1 jian4 xie3
cues.en: Xiao Tiantian took off her headphones and cut straight to the point.

cues.zh: 说老布是典型的情感暧昧选手
cues.pinyin: shuo1 lao3 bu4 shi4 dian3 xing2 de5 qing2 gan3 ai4 mei4 xuan3 shou3
cues.en: She said Lao Bu is a classic case of leading women on.

cues.zh: 吃着碗里的表白盯着锅里的心宽
cues.pinyin: chi1 zhe5 wan3 li3 de5 biao3 bai2 ding1 zhe5 guo1 li3 de5 xin1 kuan1
cues.en: Having one in the bowl while eyeing the new catch in the pot.

cues.zh: 气得老布直接把小甜甜的跑步
cues.pinyin: qi4 de2 lao3 bu4 zhi2 jie1 ba3 xiao3 tian2 tian2 de5 pao3 bu4
cues.en: Furious, Lao Bu cranked Xiao Tiantian's treadmill

cues.zh: 机调到最高速
cues.pinyin: ji1 diao4 dao4 zui4 gao1 su4
cues.en: all the way up to max speed.

cues.zh: 骂骂咧咧冲向案发现场
cues.pinyin: ma4 ma4 lie1 lie1 chong1 xiang4 an4 fa1 xian4 chang3
cues.en: Cursing under his breath, he rushed to the crime scene.

cues.zh: 公寓里眼前的场景让老布差点把早
cues.pinyin: gong1 yu4 li3 yan3 qian2 de5 chang3 jing3 rang4 lao3 bu4 cha4 dian3 ba3 zao3
cues.en: The scene in the apartment nearly made Lao Bu throw up his breakfast—

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 餐吐回健身房
cues.pinyin: can1 tu3 hui2 jian4 shen1 fang2
cues.en: —right back at the gym.

cues.zh: 尸体竟被高温热水冲刷三天
cues.pinyin: shi1 ti3 jing4 bei4 gao1 wen1 re4 shui3 chong1 shua1 san1 tian1
cues.en: The body had been scalded by high-temperature hot water for three days.

cues.zh: 像块被开水煮烂的蜂窝煤
cues.pinyin: xiang4 kuai4 bei4 kai1 shui3 zhu3 lan4 de5 feng1 wo1 mei2
cues.en: Like a honeycomb briquette boiled to mush.

cues.zh: 小谷发现尸体破洞全是高压水枪的杰作
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 fa1 xian4 shi1 ti3 po4 dong4 quan2 shi4 gao1 ya1 shui3 qiang1 de5 jie2 zuo4
cues.en: Xiao Gu found the holes in the body were all the work of a high-pressure water gun.

cues.zh: 根据尸骨判断
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 shi1 gu3 pan4 duan4
cues.en: Based on the remains...

cues.zh: 死者是名女性 20 到 25 岁
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 shi4 ming2 nv3 xing4 20 dao4 25 sui4
cues.en: ...the victim is a woman aged 20 to 25.

cues.zh: 而老布也从邻居口中套出换
cues.pinyin: er2 lao3 bu4 ye3 cong2 lin2 ju1 kou3 zhong1 tao4 chu1 huan4
cues.en: Meanwhile, Lao Bu got the neighbors to reveal the—

cues.zh: 房主叫安娜
cues.pinyin: fang2 zhu3 jiao4 an1 na4
cues.en: —resident's name: Anna.

cues.zh: 年龄 23 岁
cues.pinyin: nian2 ling2 23 sui4
cues.en: Age 23.

cues.zh: 一名妙龄女子
cues.pinyin: yi1 ming2 miao4 ling2 nv3 zi3
cues.en: A young woman in her prime.

cues.zh: 独住高级公寓
cues.pinyin: du2 zhu4 gao1 ji2 gong1 yu4
cues.en: Living alone in a luxury apartment.

cues.zh: 懂得都懂
cues.pinyin: dong3 de5 dou1 dong3
cues.en: Those who know, know.

cues.zh: 可惜死者连骨早已碎成渣
cues.pinyin: ke3 xi1 si3 zhe3 lian2 gu3 zao3 yi3 sui4 cheng2 zha1
cues.en: Sadly, the victim's bones had already been crushed to bits.

cues.zh: 肌肉组织全部冲进下水道
cues.pinyin: ji1 rou4 zu3 zhi1 quan2 bu4 chong1 jin4 xia4 shui3 dao4
cues.en: The muscle tissue had all been flushed down the drain.

cues.zh: 要想进行面部复原
cues.pinyin: yao4 xiang3 jin4 xing2 mian4 bu4 fu4 yuan2
cues.en: To reconstruct her face...

cues.zh: 就必须得先捞骨头
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi4 xu1 de2 xian1 lao1 gu3 tou5
cues.en: ...they'd first have to fish out the bones.

cues.zh: 然而昆虫学家豪金
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 kun1 chong2 xue2 jia1 hao2 jin1
cues.en: Meanwhile, entomologist Hao Jin...

cues.zh: 早已扛着设备到达屋顶通风口
cues.pinyin: zao3 yi3 kang2 zhe5 she4 bei4 dao4 da2 wu1 ding3 tong1 feng1 kou3
cues.en: ...had already hauled his gear up to the rooftop vent.

cues.zh: 只见他对着对讲机
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 ta1 dui4 zhe5 dui4 jiang3 ji1
cues.en: Just as he was on the walkie-talkie...

cues.zh: 向几人描述下水道的惨状
cues.pinyin: xiang4 ji3 ren2 miao2 shu4 xia4 shui3 dao4 de5 can3 zhuang4
cues.en: ...describing the horrific state of the sewer to the others.

cues.zh: 老布青的胃里瞬间翻降倒海
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 qing1 de5 wei4 li3 shun4 jian1 fan1 jiang4 dao4 hai3
cues.en: Lao Bu's stomach instantly churned.

cues.zh: 竟直接关掉对讲机
cues.pinyin: jing4 zhi2 jie1 guan1 diao4 dui4 jiang3 ji1
cues.en: ...so he just switched off the walkie-talkie outright.

cues.zh: 别承想
cues.pinyin: bie2 cheng2 xiang3
cues.en: Who would've guessed—

cues.zh: 豪金在屋顶按下压力机时
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 zai4 wu1 ding3 an4 xia4 ya1 li4 ji1 shi2
cues.en: —just as Hao Jin pressed the pressure machine on the roof...

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 所以导致自己现在闷得像块化石
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dao3 zhi4 zi4 ji3 xian4 zai4 men4 de2 xiang4 kuai4 hua4 shi2
cues.en: ...he ended up stuck there, bored stiff as a fossil.

cues.zh: 他的前女友也说克拉克很没劲
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qian2 nv3 you3 ye3 shuo1 ke4 la1 ke4 hen3 mei2 jin4
cues.en: His ex-girlfriend also said Clark is really boring.

cues.zh: 哈米尔生怕他抖出更惊悚的情单石
cues.pinyin: ha1 mi3 er3 sheng1 pa4 ta1 dou3 chu1 geng4 jing1 song3 de5 qing2 dan1 shi2
cues.en: Hamir was afraid he'd blurt out even more shocking info.

cues.zh: 赶紧让他去把骨头和肉拆明白
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 rang4 ta1 qu4 ba3 gu3 tou5 he2 rou4 chai1 ming2 bai2
cues.en: ...so he quickly had him go sort out the bones from the flesh.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile—

cues.zh: 豪金也在管道里奋力干活
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 ye3 zai4 guan3 dao4 li3 fen4 li4 gan4 huo2
cues.en: —Hao Jin was also working hard inside the pipes.

cues.zh: 原来上次手滑搞出尸骨回流
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 shang4 ci4 shou3 hua2 gao3 chu1 shi1 gu3 hui2 liu2
cues.en: Turns out last time a slip of the hand sent the bones washing back.

cues.zh: 现在只得重新打捞碎骨
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhi3 de2 chong2 xin1 da3 lao1 sui4 gu3
cues.en: Now he had no choice but to dredge up the fragments again.

cues.zh: 谁知修复是安琪拉整拎着午餐盒来投胃
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 xiu1 fu4 shi4 an1 qi2 la1 zheng3 lin1 zhe5 wu3 can1 he2 lai2 tou2 wei4
cues.en: Who knew, just then Angela came by with a lunch box to feed him.

cues.zh: 谁知打开只剩面包边
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 da3 kai1 zhi3 sheng4 mian4 bao1 bian1
cues.en: But opening it, there were only bread crusts left.

cues.zh: 不用看就知道哪个小蝉猫干的
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 kan4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 na3 ge5 xiao3 chan2 mao1 gan4 de5
cues.en: No need to look to know which little glutton did that.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then—

cues.zh: 豪金突然从水管里拽出一团头发
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 tu1 ran2 cong2 shui3 guan3 li3 zhuai1 chu1 yi1 tuan2 tou2 fa4
cues.en: —Hao Jin suddenly pulled a clump of hair out of the pipe.

cues.zh: 竟还有带血色的纸片
cues.pinyin: jing4 hai2 you3 dai4 xue4 se4 de5 zhi3 pian4
cues.en: There was even a blood-stained scrap of paper.

cues.zh: 安琪拉立即回到实验室对其修复
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 li4 ji2 hui2 dao4 shi2 yan4 shi4 dui4 qi2 xiu1 fu4
cues.en: Angela immediately took it back to the lab to reconstruct it.

cues.zh: 然而克拉克这边更魔幻
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ke4 la1 ke4 zhe4 bian1 geng4 mo2 huan4
cues.en: Meanwhile, things got even more bizarre on Clark's end.

cues.zh: 安娜驾照明明写着一米六二
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 jia4 zhao4 ming2 ming2 xie3 zhe5 yi1 mi3 liu4 er4
cues.en: Anna's driver's license clearly lists her as 162 cm.

cues.zh: 尸骨身高虽然对上
cues.pinyin: shi1 gu3 shen1 gao1 sui1 ran2 dui4 shang4
cues.en: The skeletal height matched, though...

cues.zh: 但骨骼比例却像被按了异常缩放键
cues.pinyin: dan4 gu3 ge2 bi3 li4 que4 xiang4 bei4 an4 le5 yi4 chang2 suo1 fang4 jian4
cues.en: ...the bone proportions looked like someone hit a weird scaling button.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 老布正对着安娜的消费账单直犯迷糊
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zheng4 dui4 zhe5 an1 na4 de5 xiao1 fei4 zhang4 dan1 zhi2 fan4 mi2 hu1
cues.en: Lao Bu was utterly baffled staring at Anna's spending statement.

cues.zh: 那数字长得能绕警局走廊三圈
cues.pinyin: na4 shu4 zi4 zhang3 de2 neng2 rao4 jing3 ju2 zou3 lang2 san1 quan1
cues.en: The numbers were so long they could wrap around the station hallway three times.

cues.zh: 信用卡流水
cues.pinyin: xin4 yong4 ka3 liu2 shui3
cues.en: Credit card transactions—

cues.zh: 活像用印炒机洗走
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 yong4 yin4 chao3 ji1 xi3 zou3
cues.en: —looked like they'd been churned out by a money printer.

cues.zh: 根本分不清这案子是钱窟窿惹的祸
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 fen4 bu4 qing1 zhe4 an4 zi5 shi4 qian2 ku1 long2 re3 de5 huo4
cues.en: No way to tell if the case was caused by a money pit...

cues.zh: 还是自裂惹的
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 zi4 lie4 re3 de5
cues.en: ...or something else entirely.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then—

cues.zh: 小甜甜却在安娜的博客里挖料
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 que4 zai4 an1 na4 de5 bo2 ke4 li3 wa1 liao4
cues.en: —Xiao Tiantian was digging for clues in Anna's blog.

cues.zh: 满屏自拍配文
cues.pinyin: man3 ping2 zi4 pai1 pei4 wen2
cues.en: A screen full of selfies with captions.

cues.zh: 全世界都是我的聚光灯
cues.pinyin: quan2 shi4 jie4 dou1 shi4 wo3 de5 ju4 guang1 deng1
cues.en: 'The whole world is my spotlight.'

cues.zh: 典型的混乱自恋人格
cues.pinyin: dian3 xing2 de5 hun4 luan4 zi4 lian4 ren2 ge2
cues.en: A textbook case of a chaotic narcissistic personality.

cues.zh: 更魔幻的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 mo2 huan4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more bizarre—

cues.zh: 这姑娘看似众星捧月
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu1 niang2 kan4 shi4 zhong4 xing1 peng3 yue4
cues.en: —this girl seemed adored by everyone, a star among the crowd.

cues.zh: 却只跟一名叫可莉的女孩聊得火热
cues.pinyin: que4 zhi3 gen1 yi1 ming2 jiao4 ke3 li4 de5 nv3 hai2 liao2 de2 huo3 re4
cues.en: Yet she only chatted intensely with one girl named Keli.

cues.zh: 两名愿天天互吹彩虹屁
cues.pinyin: liang3 ming2 yuan4 tian1 tian1 hu4 chui1 cai3 hong2 pi4
cues.en: The two of them showered each other with compliments every day.

cues.zh: 然而四天前可莉突然化身键盘侠
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 si4 tian1 qian2 ke3 li4 tu1 ran2 hua4 shen1 jian4 pan2 xia2
cues.en: But four days ago, Keli suddenly turned into a keyboard warrior.

cues.zh: 留言开骂安娜后
cues.pinyin: liu2 yan2 kai1 ma4 an1 na4 hou4
cues.en: After leaving comments cursing out Anna—

cues.zh: 有拉黑
cues.pinyin: you3 la1 hei1
cues.en: —she then blocked her.

cues.zh: 塑料姐妹情直接碎成渣
cues.pinyin: su4 liao4 jie3 mei4 qing2 zhi2 jie1 sui4 cheng2 zha1
cues.en: Their fake friendship shattered to pieces.

cues.zh: 直至可莉被带进警局时却表示
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 ke3 li4 bei4 dai4 jin4 jing3 ju2 shi2 que4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: When Keli was finally brought to the station, she claimed—

cues.zh: 两人的决裂却是因为一个包包
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 de5 jue2 lie4 que4 shi4 yin1 wei4 yi2 ge4 bao1 bao1
cues.en: —their falling-out was actually over a handbag.

cues.zh: 可莉拿着安娜送她的名牌包去专柜换款
cues.pinyin: ke3 li4 na2 zhe5 an1 na4 song4 ta1 de5 ming2 pai2 bao1 qu4 zhuan1 gui4 huan4 kuan3
cues.en: Keli took the designer bag Anna gave her to the brand counter to exchange it.

cues.zh: 竟被柜员指出
cues.pinyin: jing4 bei4 gui4 yuan2 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: —only to be told by the staff—

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 这是
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4
cues.en: 'This is—'

cues.zh: 假货对方当场把可莉当骗子
cues.pinyin: jia3 huo4 dui4 fang1 dang1 chang3 ba3 ke3 li4 dang1 pian4 zi5
cues.en: —a fake, and they treated Keli like a scammer on the spot.

cues.zh: 最后更是直接到警局录口供
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 geng4 shi4 zhi2 jie1 dao4 jing3 ju2 lu4 kou3 gong4
cues.en: In the end, she went straight to the station to give a statement.

cues.zh: 这姑娘就差拍着桌子发誓
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu1 niang2 jiu4 cha4 pai1 zhe5 zhuo1 zi5 fa1 shi4
cues.en: The girl was all but pounding the table, swearing—

cues.zh: 即便自己再暴躁
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 zi4 ji3 zai4 bao4 zao4
cues.en: —that no matter how short-tempered she was—

cues.zh: 也不至于为个假包杀人
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 zhi4 yu2 wei4 ge4 jia3 bao1 sha1 ren2
cues.en: —she wouldn't kill someone over a fake bag.

cues.zh: 顶多想把包塞安娜嘴里让她尝尝味
cues.pinyin: ding3 duo1 xiang3 ba3 bao1 sai1 an1 na4 zui3 li3 rang4 ta1 chang2 chang2 wei4
cues.en: At most, she wanted to stuff the bag in Anna's mouth and make her taste it.

cues.zh: 眼看案件陷入死局
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 an4 jian4 xian4 ru4 si3 ju2
cues.en: Just as the case seemed to hit a dead end—

cues.zh: 布谷组合转头杀进中药店
cues.pinyin: bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 zhuan3 tou2 sha1 jin4 zhong1 yao4 dian4
cues.en: —the Bu-Gu duo stormed into a Chinese medicine shop.

cues.zh: 然而当亚裔老板乔治看见照片时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 dang1 ya4 yi4 lao3 ban3 qiao2 zhi4 kan4 jian4 zhao4 pian1 shi2
cues.en: But when the shop owner, Asian-American George, saw the photo—

cues.zh: 竟瞬间破防
cues.pinyin: jing4 shun4 jian1 po4 fang2
cues.en: —he instantly broke down.

cues.zh: 原来劳拉不仅是他的病人
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 lao2 la1 bu4 jin3 shi4 ta1 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: Turns out Laura wasn't just his patient—

cues.zh: 更是乔治的未婚妻
cues.pinyin: geng4 shi4 qiao2 zhi4 de5 wei4 hun1 qi1
cues.en: —she was also George's fiancée.

cues.zh: 两人一周前刚大吵一架
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 yi1 zhou1 qian2 gang1 da4 chao3 yi1 jia4
cues.en: The two had a huge fight just a week ago.

cues.zh: 原因是劳拉太崇洋媚外
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yin1 shi4 lao2 la1 tai4 chong2 yang2 mei4 wai4
cues.en: The reason: Laura was too obsessed with foreign things.

cues.zh: 乔治觉得她背叛了两人的信仰
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 jue2 de5 ta1 bei4 pan4 le5 liang3 ren2 de5 xin4 yang3
cues.en: George felt she'd betrayed their shared beliefs.

cues.zh: 随即竟向布谷报出猛料
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 jing4 xiang4 bu4 gu3 bao4 chu1 meng3 liao4
cues.en: He then dropped a bombshell to the Bu-Gu duo.

cues.zh: 原来劳拉是安娜的铁杆粉丝
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 lao2 la1 shi4 an1 na4 de5 tie3 gan3 fen3 si1
cues.en: Turns out Laura was Anna's diehard fan.

cues.zh: 她平时在对面中餐馆给刘妈妈打工
cues.pinyin: ta1 ping2 shi2 zai4 dui4 mian4 zhong1 can1 guan3 gei3 liu2 ma1 ma1 da3 gong1
cues.en: She usually worked part-time at Mama Liu's Chinese restaurant across the street.

cues.zh: 乔治觉得凶手肯定是刘妈妈那个假包贩子
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 jue2 de5 xiong1 shou3 ken3 ding4 shi4 liu2 ma1 ma1 na4 ge5 jia3 bao1 fan4 zi5
cues.en: George was sure the killer had to be Mama Liu, that fake-bag dealer.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超炸裂！探员卖假包睡线人，女友欲实名举报，浴室里被烫熟了。

cues.zh: 况且他疼劳拉跟疼自家闺女似的
cues.pinyin: kuang4 qie3 ta1 teng2 lao2 la1 gen1 teng2 zi4 jia1 gui1 nv3 shi4 de5
cues.en: Besides, he doted on Laura like she was his own daughter.

cues.zh: 结果话锋一转直接开启爆料模式
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 hua4 feng1 yi1 zhuan3 zhi2 jie1 kai1 qi3 bao4 liao4 mo2 shi4
cues.en: Then he suddenly switched gears into exposé mode.

cues.zh: 把安娜拖欠两千美刀包包费的事
cues.pinyin: ba3 an1 na4 tuo1 qian4 liang3 qian1 mei3 dao1 bao1 bao1 fei4 de5 shi4
cues.en: He spilled that Anna owed two thousand dollars in bag fees—

cues.zh: 抖得干干净净
cues.pinyin: dou3 de2 gan1 gan1 jing4 jing4
cues.en: —laying it all out completely.

cues.zh: 还疯狂暗示警方
cues.pinyin: hai2 feng1 kuang2 an4 shi4 jing3 fang1
cues.en: He even frantically hinted to the police—

cues.zh: 不如赶紧去抓那个欠账不还的
cues.pinyin: bu4 ru2 gan3 jin3 qu4 zhua1 na4 ge5 qian4 zhang4 bu4 hai2 de5
cues.en: —that they should hurry and arrest the one who wouldn't pay her debts.

cues.zh: 这边刘妈妈刚嘴硬完
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 liu2 ma1 ma1 gang1 zui3 ying4 wan2
cues.en: Just as Mama Liu finished running her mouth—

cues.zh: 丹尼尔就带着证据来大配合
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 jiu4 dai4 zhe5 zheng4 ju4 lai2 da4 pei4 he2
cues.en: —Daniel showed up with evidence to confront her.

cues.zh: 直接甩出刘妈妈在纽约清点假货的铁证
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 shuai3 chu1 liu2 ma1 ma1 zai4 niu3 yue1 qing1 dian3 jia3 huo4 de5 tie3 zheng4
cues.en: He laid out ironclad proof of Mama Liu counting fakes in New York.

cues.zh: 小甜甜在社交平台扒料
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 zai4 she4 jiao1 ping2 tai2 ba1 liao4
cues.en: Xiao Tiantian was digging for info on social media.

cues.zh: 却发现劳拉当初给安娜发好友申请
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 lao2 la1 dang1 chu1 gei3 an1 na4 fa1 hao3 you3 shen1 qing3
cues.en: She found that Laura had once sent Anna a friend request.

cues.zh: 结果竟被对方拒绝
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jing4 bei4 dui4 fang1 ju4 jue2
cues.en: But it had been rejected.

cues.zh: 正当他和老布还在梳理线索时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 dang1 ta1 he2 lao3 bu4 hai2 zai4 shu1 li3 xian4 suo3 shi2
cues.en: Just as she and Lao Bu were still sorting through the clues—

cues.zh: 对方却对着安娜的宠物老鼠发愣
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 que4 dui4 zhe5 an1 na4 de5 chong3 wu4 lao3 shu3 fa1 leng4
cues.en: —he was staring blankly at Anna's pet rat.

cues.zh: 仔细一瞧好家伙
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 yi1 qiao2 hao3 jia1 huo5
cues.en: Looking closely—get this—

cues.zh: 原来盯上了老鼠脖子上的定位项圈
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ding1 shang4 le5 lao3 shu3 bo2 zi5 shang4 de5 ding4 wei4 xiang4 quan1
cues.en: —he'd spotted the tracking collar on the rat's neck.

cues.zh: 实验室里
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 li3
cues.en: Back in the lab—

cues.zh: 豪金正和尸体死磕
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 zheng4 he2 shi1 ti3 si3 ke1
cues.en: —Hao Jin was locked in a battle with the corpse.

cues.zh: 克拉克却在旁边开启话痨模式
cues.pinyin: ke4 la1 ke4 que4 zai4 pang2 bian1 kai1 qi3 hua4 lao2 mo2 shi4
cues.en: Clark, meanwhile, switched into chatterbox mode next to him.

cues.zh: 小嘴巴巴的跟机关枪一样
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zui3 ba1 ba1 de5 gen1 ji1 guan1 qiang1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: His mouth going like a machine gun.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle

cues.zh: 最近一位小朋友跟我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 yi1 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a young friend told me

cues.zh: 他特别喜欢数学
cues.pinyin: ta1 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 shu4 xue2
cues.en: that he especially loves math

cues.zh: 立志要成为一个伟大的数学家
cues.pinyin: li4 zhi4 yao4 cheng2 wei2 yi2 ge4 wei3 da4 de5 shu4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: and aspires to become a great mathematician

cues.zh: 攻克数学难题
cues.pinyin: gong1 ke4 shu4 xue2 nan2 ti2
cues.en: and conquer difficult math problems

cues.zh: 他听说七个千禧年难题中
cues.pinyin: ta1 ting1 shuo1 qi1 ge4 qian1 xi3 nian2 nan2 ti2 zhong1
cues.en: He heard that among the seven Millennium Problems

cues.zh: 只有一个被攻克的就是庞加莱猜想
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 yi2 ge4 bei4 gong1 ke4 de5 jiu4 shi4 pang2 jia1 lai2 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: only one has been solved, the Poincaré Conjecture

cues.zh: 这个猜想好像和宇宙的形状有关系
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cai1 xiang3 hao3 xiang4 he2 yu3 zhou4 de5 xing2 zhuang4 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: This conjecture seems related to the shape of the universe

cues.zh: 他想问我这是一个怎样的猜想呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wen4 wo3 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 zen3 yang4 de5 cai1 xiang3 ne5
cues.en: He wanted to ask me what kind of conjecture this is

cues.zh: 又是如何被攻克的呢
cues.pinyin: you4 shi4 ru2 he2 bei4 gong1 ke4 de5 ne5
cues.en: and how it was solved

cues.zh: 那今天我们就来讲一讲庞加莱猜想
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 pang2 jia1 lai2 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: So today let's talk about the Poincaré Conjecture

cues.zh: 为了讲庞加莱猜想
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jiang3 pang2 jia1 lai2 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: To explain the Poincaré Conjecture

cues.zh: 我们首先从一个大家都知道的问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 cong2 yi2 ge4 da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: let's first start with a question everyone knows

cues.zh: 地球的形状说起
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 xing2 zhuang4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: the shape of the Earth

cues.zh: 地球的形状
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: The shape of the Earth

cues.zh: 地球是什么形状的呢
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shi4 shen2 me5 xing2 zhuang4 de5 ne5
cues.en: What shape is the Earth?

cues.zh: 我们知道地球是一个球体
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: We know the Earth is a sphere

cues.zh: 原因是我们可以派一个宇宙飞
cues.pinyin: yuan2 yin1 shi4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 pai4 yi2 ge4 yu3 zhou4 fei1
cues.en: The reason is we can send a spaceship

cues.zh: 船到太空中去
cues.pinyin: chuan2 dao4 tai4 kong1 zhong1 qu4
cues.en: into outer space

cues.zh: 回头拍一张照片就知道地球是球体了
cues.pinyin: hui2 tou2 pai1 yi1 zhang1 zhao4 pian1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 shi4 qiu2 ti3 le5
cues.en: and take a photo looking back to know the Earth is a sphere

cues.zh: 但是在我们没有上太空之前
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 wo3 men5 mei2 you3 shang4 tai4 kong1 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: But before we went to space

cues.zh: 我们是如何知道地球是球体的呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi4 ru2 he2 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 shi4 qiu2 ti3 de5 ne5
cues.en: how did we know the Earth was a sphere?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 可能有同学会说
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 you3 tong2 xue2 hui4 shuo1
cues.en: Some students might say

cues.zh: 那我们可以把地球上每一个地点的地
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 di4 qiu2 shang4 mei3 yi2 ge4 di4 dian3 de5 di4
cues.en: we could map every location on Earth

cues.zh: 图都绘制下来
cues.pinyin: tu2 dou1 hui4 zhi4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: and draw all the maps

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 把它们组成一个球体那就行了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 zu3 cheng2 yi2 ge4 qiu2 ti3 na4 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: and piece them together into a sphere, and that would work

cues.zh: 或者说我们可以环球旅行
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2
cues.en: Or we could say we can travel around the world

cues.zh: 我们就可以知道地球是球体了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 shi4 qiu2 ti3 le5
cues.en: and then we'd know the Earth is a sphere

cues.zh: 其实如果我们环球旅行的话
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2 de5 hua4
cues.en: Actually, if we travel around the world

cues.zh: 并不一定能证明地球就是球体
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 yi2 ding4 neng2 zheng4 ming2 di4 qiu2 jiu4 shi4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: that doesn't necessarily prove the Earth is a sphere

cues.zh: 只能证明地球是一个什么样的物体呢
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 zheng4 ming2 di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 wu4 ti3 ne5
cues.en: It can only prove the Earth is what kind of object?

cues.zh: 地球是一个单连通的
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 dan1 lian2 tong1 de5
cues.en: The Earth is simply connected

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 比如说这是一个球体
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: For example, here's a sphere

cues.zh: 我们在上面做环球旅行
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 shang4 mian4 zuo4 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2
cues.en: we travel around it

cues.zh: 我们做环球旅行
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2
cues.en: we go on a journey around it

cues.zh: 套了一个圈
cues.pinyin: tao4 le5 yi2 ge4 quan1
cues.en: with a loop around it

cues.zh: 然后我们让这个圈缩缩缩
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 rang4 zhe4 ge5 quan1 suo1 suo1 suo1
cues.en: then we let this loop shrink, shrink, shrink

cues.zh: 在最后可以缩成一个点对不对
cues.pinyin: zai4 zui4 hou4 ke3 yi3 suo1 cheng2 yi2 ge4 dian3 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: and in the end it can shrink to a point, right?

cues.zh: 可以是一个球体
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: It could be a sphere

cues.zh: 但也不一定是个球体
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye3 bu4 yi2 ding4 shi4 ge4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: but it's not necessarily a sphere

cues.zh: 你只是从单联通这个事
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 shi4 cong2 dan1 lian2 tong1 zhe4 ge5 shi4
cues.en: You've only shown it's simply connected

cues.zh: 它也不一定是个球体
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 bu4 yi2 ding4 shi4 ge4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: it's still not necessarily a sphere

cues.zh: 你比如说它如果是一个心形
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 ru2 guo3 shi4 yi2 ge4 xin1 xing2
cues.en: For example, if it were heart-shaped

cues.zh: 是不是也可以对不对
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 ye3 ke3 yi3 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: couldn't that also work, right?

cues.zh: 你做一个环球旅行
cues.pinyin: ni3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2
cues.en: You travel around it

cues.zh: 然后你这根绳子缩缩缩
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 zhe4 gen1 sheng2 zi5 suo1 suo1 suo1
cues.en: and then this rope shrinks, shrinks, shrinks

cues.zh: 你不也能缩成一个点吗是不是
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 ye3 neng2 suo1 cheng2 yi2 ge4 dian3 ma5 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: can't it also shrink to a point?

cues.zh: 所以单联通不一定是球体
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dan1 lian2 tong1 bu4 yi2 ding4 shi4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: So simply connected doesn't mean it's a sphere

cues.zh: 但是有一些形状肯定不是单连通的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 you3 yi1 xie1 xing2 zhuang4 ken3 ding4 bu2 shi4 dan1 lian2 tong1 de5
cues.en: But some shapes are definitely not simply connected

cues.zh: 比如说地球如果是一个甜甜圈的形状
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 di4 qiu2 ru2 guo3 shi4 yi2 ge4 tian2 tian2 quan1 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: For example, if the Earth were shaped like a donut

cues.zh: 或者说是一个游泳圈一样的形状
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 shi4 yi2 ge4 you2 yong3 quan1 yi1 yang4 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: or shaped like a swimming ring

cues.zh: 那么这个时候你能不能做环球旅行
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ni3 neng2 bu4 neng2 zuo4 huan2 qiu2 lv3 xing2
cues.en: then in that case, could you travel around it?

cues.zh: 你当然可以了
cues.pinyin: ni3 dang1 ran2 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: Of course you could

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 我们就叫做多连同的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 jiao4 zuo4 duo1 lian2 tong2 de5
cues.en: We call that multiply connected

cues.zh: 地球是一个单连同的
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 dan1 lian2 tong2 de5
cues.en: The Earth is simply connected

cues.zh: 我们不需真正的去牵一根绳子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 xu1 zhen1 zheng4 de5 qu4 qian1 yi1 gen1 sheng2 zi5
cues.en: We don't actually need to pull a real rope

cues.zh: 只要利用数学的方法就可以证明这一点了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 li4 yong4 shu4 xue2 de5 fang1 fa3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zheng4 ming2 zhe4 yi4 dian3 le5
cues.en: we can just use mathematical methods to prove this

cues.zh: 同时地球是紧致的
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 di4 qiu2 shi4 jin3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: At the same time, the Earth is compact

cues.zh: 什么是紧致呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 jin3 zhi4 ne5
cues.en: What does compact mean?

cues.zh: 就是地球是一个有限大小的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 you3 xian4 da4 xiao3 de5
cues.en: It means the Earth has a finite size

cues.zh: 我们可以用一张一张的地图
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 yi1 zhang1 yi1 zhang1 de5 di4 tu2
cues.en: We can use maps, one by one

cues.zh: 把整个地球给覆盖住
cues.pinyin: ba3 zheng3 ge4 di4 qiu2 gei3 fu4 gai4 zhu4
cues.en: to cover the entire Earth

cues.zh: 这就叫做紧致的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 zuo4 jin3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: that's what's called compact

cues.zh: 地球又是无界的
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 you4 shi4 wu2 jie4 de5
cues.en: The Earth is also unbounded

cues.zh: 你不可能说我躺在一个边缘
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 ke3 neng2 shuo1 wo3 tang3 zai4 yi2 ge4 bian1 yuan2
cues.en: You can't say you're lying at an edge

cues.zh: 往那边一伸手
cues.pinyin: wang3 na4 bian1 yi1 shen1 shou3
cues.en: and reach your hand out that way

cues.zh: 我就这个手我就伸出了地球
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 wo3 jiu4 shen1 chu1 le5 di4 qiu2
cues.en: and your hand would stick out past the Earth

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 没有这个边界
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 zhe4 ge5 bian1 jie4
cues.en: There is no such boundary

cues.zh: 如果你往东走
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 wang3 dong1 zou3
cues.en: If you walk east

cues.zh: 走走走很长时间之后
cues.pinyin: zou3 zou3 zou3 hen3 zhang3 shi2 jian1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: and keep walking for a long time

cues.zh: 你会回到出发点
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 hui2 dao4 chu1 fa1 dian3
cues.en: you'll come back to your starting point

cues.zh: 你从北极开始走你会走到南极
cues.pinyin: ni3 cong2 bei3 ji2 kai1 shi3 zou3 ni3 hui4 zou3 dao4 nan2 ji2
cues.en: If you start walking from the North Pole, you'll reach the South Pole

cues.zh: 你知道你再往前走的话你又会回到北极
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 ni3 zai4 wang3 qian2 zou3 de5 hua4 ni3 you4 hui4 hui2 dao4 bei3 ji2
cues.en: and you know if you keep walking you'll come back to the North Pole

cues.zh: 你永远都走不到地球的边界这就叫无界的
cues.pinyin: ni3 yong3 yuan3 dou1 zou3 bu2 dao4 di4 qiu2 de5 bian1 jie4 zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 wu2 jie4 de5
cues.en: You can never reach the edge of the Earth, that's what's called unbounded

cues.zh: 所以我们说地球是一个什么
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 shuo1 di4 qiu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5
cues.en: So what do we say the Earth is?

cues.zh: 是一个单联通紧致无界的二维流行
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 dan1 lian2 tong1 jin3 zhi4 wu2 jie4 de5 er4 wei2 liu2 xing2
cues.en: It's a simply connected, compact, unbounded two-dimensional manifold

cues.zh: 二维流行就是一个二维曲面的意思
cues.pinyin: er4 wei2 liu2 xing2 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 er4 wei2 qu1 mian4 de5 yi4 si5
cues.en: A two-dimensional manifold just means a two-dimensional surface

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 所以说我们在地球上面
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 wo3 men5 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 mian4
cues.en: So on Earth

cues.zh: 其实我们没有办法知道地球是不是球体
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 men5 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 zhi1 dao4 di4 qiu2 shi4 bu2 shi4 qiu2 ti3
cues.en: we actually have no way of knowing whether the Earth is a sphere

cues.zh: 除非我们跳到地球外面去看才能看得清楚
cues.pinyin: chu2 fei1 wo3 men5 tiao4 dao4 di4 qiu2 wai4 mian4 qu4 kan4 cai2 neng2 kan4 de5 qing1 chu3
cues.en: unless we jump outside the Earth to look, only then can we see clearly

cues.zh: 不过在托普学家眼中
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zai4 tuo1 pu3 xue2 jia1 yan3 zhong1
cues.en: But in the eyes of topologists

cues.zh: 地球是不是球体不重要
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shi4 bu2 shi4 qiu2 ti3 bu2 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: whether the Earth is a sphere or not doesn't matter

cues.zh: 因为什么呢
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 因为托普学有一个概念叫做同胚
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 tuo1 pu3 xue2 you3 yi2 ge4 gai4 nian4 jiao4 zuo4 tong2 pei1
cues.en: Because topology has a concept called homeomorphism

cues.zh: 同胚
cues.pinyin: tong2 pei1
cues.en: Homeomorphism

cues.zh: 同胚的意思就是这两个形状
cues.pinyin: tong2 pei1 de5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: Homeomorphism means these two shapes

cues.zh: 简单来说就是它们的点是一一对应的
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 lai2 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 ta1 men5 de5 dian3 shi4 yi1 yi1 dui4 ying4 de5
cues.en: simply put, their points correspond one to one

cues.zh: 点的位置关系是一一对应的
cues.pinyin: dian3 de5 wei4 zhi4 guan1 xi4 shi4 yi1 yi1 dui4 ying4 de5
cues.en: the positional relationships of the points correspond one to one

cues.zh: 最典型的同胚例子就是地铁的线路图
cues.pinyin: zui4 dian3 xing2 de5 tong2 pei1 li4 zi5 jiu4 shi4 di4 tie3 de5 xian4 lu4 tu2
cues.en: The most typical example of homeomorphism is a subway map

cues.zh: 地铁线路图我们画的时候
cues.pinyin: di4 tie3 xian4 lu4 tu2 wo3 men5 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When we draw a subway map

cues.zh: 你会发现它经常长得
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 ta1 jing1 chang2 zhang3 de2
cues.en: you'll find it often looks

cues.zh: 跟实际地铁的样子是不一样的对不对
cues.pinyin: gen1 shi2 ji4 di4 tie3 de5 yang4 zi5 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: quite different from the actual subway system, right?

cues.zh: 但是它是同胚的是吧
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 shi4 tong2 pei1 de5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: But it's homeomorphic, right?

cues.zh: 两个站之间的关系是完全一致的
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 zhan4 zhi1 jian1 de5 guan1 xi4 shi4 wan2 quan2 yi2 zhi4 de5
cues.en: the relationships between two stations are exactly the same

cues.zh: 你看这个同胚图
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 zhe4 ge5 tong2 pei1 tu2
cues.en: Looking at this homeomorphic diagram

cues.zh: 你就可以知道实际的地铁线路图
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhi1 dao4 shi2 ji4 de5 di4 tie3 xian4 lu4 tu2
cues.en: you can know what the actual subway route

cues.zh: 是什么样子的
cues.pinyin: shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: looks like
