items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】庞加莱猜想为何价值100万美元？宇宙是什么形状？

cues.zh: 你知道一个茶壶跟谁同胚吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 yi2 ge4 cha2 hu2 gen1 shui2 tong2 pei1 ma5
cues.en: Do you know what a teapot is homeomorphic to?

cues.zh: 一个茶壶
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 cha2 hu2
cues.en: A teapot

cues.zh: 茶壶有两个洞
cues.pinyin: cha2 hu2 you3 liang3 ge4 dong4
cues.en: A teapot has two holes

cues.zh: 有一个洞是这个把手这个地方
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 dong4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ba3 shou3 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1
cues.en: one hole is where the handle is

cues.zh: 还有一个洞是从壶嘴进来
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 dong4 shi4 cong2 hu2 zui3 jin4 lai2
cues.en: and another hole is where you pour in from the spout

cues.zh: 然后从壶中间出去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 cong2 hu2 zhong1 jian1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and it comes out through the middle of the pot

cues.zh: 所以它有两个洞因此它和谁同胚
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 you3 liang3 ge4 dong4 yin1 ci3 ta1 he2 shui2 tong2 pei1
cues.en: So it has two holes, so what is it homeomorphic to?

cues.zh: 它和那个两个洞的这种甜甜圈是同胚的
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 na4 ge5 liang3 ge4 dong4 de5 zhe4 zhong3 tian2 tian2 quan1 shi4 tong2 pei1 de5
cues.en: It's homeomorphic to that donut shape with two holes

cues.zh: 当然还有三个洞四个洞
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 hai2 you3 san1 ge4 dong4 si4 ge4 dong4
cues.en: Of course there are also ones with three holes, four holes

cues.zh: 所以对于托普学家来讲
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dui4 yu2 tuo1 pu3 xue2 jia1 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: So for topologists

cues.zh: 你是一个碗的形状还是一个球的形状
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 yi2 ge4 wan3 de5 xing2 zhuang4 hai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: whether you're shaped like a bowl or shaped like a sphere

cues.zh: 这没有区别它们是同胚的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 mei2 you3 qu1 bie2 ta1 men5 shi4 tong2 pei1 de5
cues.en: there's no difference, they're homeomorphic

cues.zh: 同样你说我已经知道
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 ni3 shuo1 wo3 yi3 jing1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Likewise, you might say I already know

cues.zh: 地球是单连通紧致无界的一个二维流行了
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 shi4 dan1 lian2 tong1 jin3 zhi4 wu2 jie4 de5 yi2 ge4 er4 wei2 liu2 xing2 le5
cues.en: the Earth is a simply connected, compact, unbounded two-dimensional manifold

cues.zh: 那么你到底是一个心形的还是一个球形的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 dao4 di3 shi4 yi2 ge4 xin1 xing2 de5 hai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 xing2 de5
cues.en: so whether it's heart-shaped or sphere-shaped

cues.zh: 这就不重要了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 bu2 zhong4 yao4 le5
cues.en: that doesn't matter anymore

cues.zh: 因为它们二者是同胚的对吧
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 er4 zhe3 shi4 tong2 pei1 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: because the two are homeomorphic, right?

cues.zh: 在托普学上我们可以证明一件事
cues.pinyin: zai4 tuo1 pu3 xue2 shang4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zheng4 ming2 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: In topology we can prove one thing

cues.en: But if you look from another angle,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（四）什么是闵可夫斯基四维时空？

cues.zh: 杨桃好像一个五角星
cues.pinyin: yang2 tao2 hao3 xiang4 yi2 ge4 wu3 jiao3 xing1
cues.en: the star fruit looks like a five-pointed star.

cues.zh: 杨桃本身其实并没有发生任何变化
cues.pinyin: yang2 tao2 ben3 shen1 qi2 shi2 bing4 mei2 you3 fa1 sheng1 ren4 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: The star fruit itself hasn't actually changed at all.

cues.zh: 只是因为我们观察的角度变了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 guan1 cha2 de5 jiao3 du4 bian4 le5
cues.en: It's just that our viewing angle has changed.

cues.zh: 杨桃在我们观察方向的投影就发生了变化
cues.pinyin: yang2 tao2 zai4 wo3 men5 guan1 cha2 fang1 xiang4 de5 tou2 ying3 jiu4 fa1 sheng1 le5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: The star fruit's projection in our line of sight has changed.

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦之前
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Before Einstein,

cues.zh: 人们认为空间尺寸和时间长度都
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 ren4 wei2 kong1 jian1 chi3 cun4 he2 shi2 jian1 chang2 du4 dou1
cues.en: people believed that spatial size and the length of time were both

cues.zh: 是绝对不变的
cues.pinyin: shi4 jue2 dui4 bu4 bian4 de5
cues.en: absolutely unchanging.

cues.zh: 相对论提出之后
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 lun4 ti2 chu1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After relativity was proposed,

cues.zh: 人们才发现真正不变的是四维时空
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 cai2 fa1 xian4 zhen1 zheng4 bu4 bian4 de5 shi4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1
cues.en: people discovered that what's truly invariant is the spacetime interval

cues.zh: 中的时空间隔
cues.pinyin: zhong1 de5 shi2 kong1 jian4 ge2
cues.en: in four-dimensional spacetime.

cues.zh: 而在不同的参考系下
cues.pinyin: er2 zai4 bu4 tong2 de5 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4
cues.en: And under different reference frames,

cues.zh: 时间长度和空间间隔其实都会发生变化
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 chang2 du4 he2 kong1 jian1 jian4 ge2 qi2 shi2 du1 hui4 fa1 sheng1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: the length of time and the spatial interval will actually both change.

cues.zh: 时间和空间不过是一个四维时空间隔的
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 bu4 guo4 shi4 yi2 ge4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 jian4 ge2 de5
cues.en: Time and space are merely two

cues.zh: 两种投影而已
cues.pinyin: liang3 zhong3 tou2 ying3 er2 yi3
cues.en: projections of a single four-dimensional spacetime interval.

cues.zh: 我们一旦运动起来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi2 dan4 yun4 dong4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Once we start moving,

cues.zh: 实际上是改变了自己观察世界的角度
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 gai3 bian4 le5 zi4 ji3 guan1 cha2 shi4 jie4 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: we're actually changing the angle from which we observe the world,

cues.zh: 自然就会发现时间和空间都变了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ran2 jiu4 hui4 fa1 xian4 shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 dou1 bian4 le5
cues.en: so naturally we'll find that both time and space have changed.

cues.zh: 为了解释清楚这件事
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 qing1 chu3 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: To explain this clearly,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（四）什么是闵可夫斯基四维时空？

cues.zh: 这里诞生了七桥问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 dan4 sheng1 le5 qi1 qiao2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: this is where the Seven Bridges Problem was born,

cues.zh: 也诞生了数学家希尔伯特和哲学家康德
cues.pinyin: ye3 dan4 sheng1 le5 shu4 xue2 jia1 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 he2 zhe2 xue2 jia1 kang1 de2
cues.en: and also where mathematician Hilbert and philosopher Kant were born.

cues.zh: 康德被认为是苏格拉底波拉图
cues.pinyin: kang1 de2 bei4 ren4 wei2 shi4 su1 ge2 la1 di3 bo1 la1 tu2
cues.en: Kant is considered, after Socrates, Plato,

cues.zh: 亚里士多德之后
cues.pinyin: ya4 li3 shi4 duo1 de2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: and Aristotle,

cues.zh: 最有影响力的西方思想家
cues.pinyin: zui4 you3 ying3 xiang3 li4 de5 xi1 fang1 si1 xiang3 jia1
cues.en: the most influential Western thinker.

cues.zh: 而希尔伯特则是 20 世纪初最伟大的数学家
cues.pinyin: er2 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 ze2 shi4 20 shi4 ji4 chu1 zui4 wei3 da4 de5 shu4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: And Hilbert was the greatest mathematician of the early 20th century.

cues.zh: 明可夫斯基三兄弟都非常优秀
cues.pinyin: ming2 ke3 fu1 si1 ji1 san1 xiong1 di4 dou1 fei1 chang2 you1 xiu4
cues.en: All three Minkowski brothers were exceptionally talented.

cues.zh: 大哥子成副业成了优秀的商人
cues.pinyin: da4 ge1 zi5 cheng2 fu4 ye4 cheng2 le5 you1 xiu4 de5 shang1 ren2
cues.en: The eldest brother, Max, went into business and became an excellent merchant.

cues.zh: 二哥就是发现胰岛素和糖尿病关系
cues.pinyin: er4 ge1 jiu4 shi4 fa1 xian4 yi2 dao3 su4 he2 tang2 niao4 bing4 guan1 xi4
cues.en: The second brother is the one who discovered the link between insulin and diabetes,

cues.zh: 的胰岛素之父
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 dao3 su4 zhi1 fu4
cues.en: the father of insulin research,

cues.zh: 奥斯卡明可夫斯基
cues.pinyin: ao4 si1 ka3 ming2 ke3 fu1 si1 ji1
cues.en: Oskar Minkowski.

cues.zh: 而赫尔曼在很小的时候就表现出极
cues.pinyin: er2 he4 er3 man4 zai4 hen3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 biao3 xian4 chu1 ji2
cues.en: And Hermann showed extremely

cues.zh: 高的数学天赋
cues.pinyin: gao1 de5 shu4 xue2 tian1 fu4
cues.en: high mathematical talent from a very young age,

cues.zh: 被誉为神童
cues.pinyin: bei4 yu4 wei2 shen2 tong2
cues.en: and was hailed as a child prodigy.

cues.zh: 所以三兄弟在当地都十分有名
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 san1 xiong1 di4 zai4 dang1 di4 dou1 shi2 fen1 you3 ming2
cues.en: So all three brothers were quite famous locally.

cues.zh: 18 96 年明可夫斯基来到瑞士的苏黎市
cues.pinyin: 18 96 nian2 ming2 ke3 fu1 si1 ji1 lai2 dao4 rui4 shi4 de5 su1 li2 shi4
cues.en: In 1896, Minkowski came to Zurich, Switzerland to work at the

cues.zh: 理工学院工作
cues.pinyin: li3 gong1 xue2 yuan4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Polytechnic Institute.

cues.zh: 在这里他遇到了后来
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 ta1 yu4 dao4 le5 hou4 lai2
cues.en: Here he met the man who would later become

cues.zh: 享誉世界的物理学泰斗
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yu4 shi4 jie4 de5 wu4 li3 xue2 tai4 dou3
cues.en: a world-renowned giant of physics,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: Einstein.

cues.zh: 只不过在那个时候
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 zai4 na4 ge5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Although at that time,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（四）什么是闵可夫斯基四维时空？

cues.zh: 但是这条轨迹没有办法告诉我们
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 tiao2 gui3 ji4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 gao4 su4 wo3 men5
cues.en: But this trajectory can't tell us

cues.zh: 在某一个时刻原子到底在什么位置
cues.pinyin: zai4 mou3 yi2 ge4 shi2 ke4 yuan2 zi5 dao4 di3 zai4 shen2 me5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: exactly where the atom was at any given moment.

cues.zh: 如果我们在空间坐标系中
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 zai4 kong1 jian1 zuo4 biao1 xi4 zhong1
cues.en: If, in our spatial coordinate system,

cues.zh: 再增加一个时间维度
cues.pinyin: zai4 zeng1 jia1 yi2 ge4 shi2 jian1 wei2 du4
cues.en: we add one more dimension of time

cues.zh: 把这个原子每个时刻的位置画出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 yuan2 zi5 mei3 ge4 shi2 ke4 de5 wei4 zhi4 hua4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and plot this atom's position at every moment,

cues.zh: 我们就得到了一条包含时间和空
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 yi1 tiao2 bao1 han2 shi2 jian1 he2 kong1
cues.en: we get a trajectory that includes both time and

cues.zh: 间的原子轨迹
cues.pinyin: jian1 de5 yuan2 zi5 gui3 ji4
cues.en: space — the atom's trajectory.

cues.zh: 那么这条轨迹就叫做世界线
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 tiao2 gui3 ji4 jiu4 jiao4 zuo4 shi4 jie4 xian4
cues.en: This trajectory is called a worldline.

cues.zh: 当然了物体如果不是原子而是一根杆
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 le5 wu4 ti3 ru2 guo3 bu2 shi4 yuan2 zi5 er2 shi4 yi1 gen1 gan1
cues.en: Of course, if the object isn't an atom but a rod,

cues.zh: 它一边在空间中运动
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 bian1 zai4 kong1 jian1 zhong1 yun4 dong4
cues.en: as it moves through space

cues.zh: 一边感受时间的流逝
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 gan3 shou4 shi2 jian1 de5 liu2 shi4
cues.en: while also experiencing the passage of time,

cues.zh: 那么杆上的每一个原子的世界线组合起来
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 gan1 shang4 de5 mei3 yi2 ge4 yuan2 zi5 de5 shi4 jie4 xian4 zu3 he2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: then the worldlines of every atom on the rod combined

cues.zh: 在四维时空中就会变成一个面
cues.pinyin: zai4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 zhong1 jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 mian4
cues.en: become a surface in four-dimensional spacetime.

cues.zh: 这叫做世界面
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 zuo4 shi4 jie4 mian4
cues.en: This is called a world sheet.

cues.zh: 如果物体是一个薄膜
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wu4 ti3 shi4 yi2 ge4 bao2 mo2
cues.en: If the object is a thin membrane,

cues.zh: 那么每一个点的世界线组合起来
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 mei3 yi2 ge4 dian3 de5 shi4 jie4 xian4 zu3 he2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: then the worldlines of every point combined

cues.zh: 在四维时空中的轨迹就是一个立体
cues.pinyin: zai4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 zhong1 de5 gui3 ji4 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 li4 ti3
cues.en: trace out a solid volume in four-dimensional spacetime.

cues.zh: 这叫做世界体
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 zuo4 shi4 jie4 ti3
cues.en: This is called a world volume.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（四）什么是闵可夫斯基四维时空？

cues.zh: 当然了实际的物体都是三维的
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 le5 shi2 ji4 de5 wu4 ti3 dou1 shi4 san1 wei2 de5
cues.en: Of course, real objects are all three-dimensional,

cues.zh: 在四维时空中会留下一个四维的轨迹
cues.pinyin: zai4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 zhong1 hui4 liu2 xia4 yi2 ge4 si4 wei2 de5 gui3 ji4
cues.en: so they leave behind a four-dimensional trajectory in four-dimensional spacetime.

cues.zh: 世界面世界体或者是四维轨迹
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 mian4 shi4 jie4 ti3 huo4 zhe3 shi4 si4 wei2 gui3 ji4
cues.en: World sheets, world volumes, or four-dimensional trajectories —

cues.zh: 其实都是由世界线组成的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 dou1 shi4 you2 shi4 jie4 xian4 zu3 cheng2 de5
cues.en: these are actually all made up of worldlines.

cues.zh: 我们就统称它为世界树吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 tong3 cheng1 ta1 wei4 shi4 jie4 shu4 ba5
cues.en: Let's just collectively call them worldlines.

cues.zh: 一个人从出生到死亡
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 cong2 chu1 sheng1 dao4 si3 wang2
cues.en: From birth to death,

cues.zh: 空间位置和时间都在不停的变化
cues.pinyin: kong1 jian1 wei4 zhi4 he2 shi2 jian1 dou1 zai4 bu4 ting2 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: a person's spatial position and time are constantly changing.

cues.zh: 所以每一个人的生命
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei3 yi2 ge4 ren2 de5 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: So every person's life

cues.zh: 其实都是在四维时空中画出了世界术
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 dou1 shi4 zai4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 zhong1 hua4 chu1 le5 shi4 jie4 shu4
cues.en: actually traces out a worldline in four-dimensional spacetime.

cues.zh: 而且由于我们会不停地接纳一
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you2 yu2 wo3 men5 hui4 bu4 ting2 di4 jie1 na4 yi1
cues.en: And because we're constantly taking in

cues.zh: 些外界的原子
cues.pinyin: xie1 wai4 jie4 de5 yuan2 zi5
cues.en: atoms from the outside world —

cues.zh: 比如水空气食物
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shui3 kong1 qi4 shi2 wu4
cues.en: like water, air, and food —

cues.zh: 也会不停地排出一些原子
cues.pinyin: ye3 hui4 bu4 ting2 di4 pai2 chu1 yi1 xie1 yuan2 zi5
cues.en: we're also constantly expelling some atoms,

cues.zh: 比如粪便头发指甲
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 fen4 bian4 tou2 fa4 zhi3 jia3
cues.en: like feces, hair, and nail clippings,

cues.zh: 那你会发现许多周围原子的世界线
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 xu3 duo1 zhou1 wei2 yuan2 zi5 de5 shi4 jie4 xian4
cues.en: you'll find that the worldlines of many surrounding atoms

cues.zh: 一会儿和我们重合
cues.pinyin: yi1 hui4 er5 he2 wo3 men5 chong2 he2
cues.en: sometimes coincide with ours

cues.zh: 一会儿又离我们而去
cues.pinyin: yi1 hui4 er5 you4 li2 wo3 men5 er2 qu4
cues.en: and sometimes drift away from us.

cues.zh: 等到我们死后
cues.pinyin: deng3 dao4 wo3 men5 si3 hou4
cues.en: By the time we die,

cues.zh: 尸体燃烧或者腐烂
cues.pinyin: shi1 ti3 ran2 shao1 huo4 zhe3 fu3 lan4
cues.en: the body burns or decays,

cues.zh: 所有的原子除了后人为了纪念我们
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 yuan2 zi5 chu2 le5 hou4 ren2 wei2 le5 ji4 nian4 wo3 men5
cues.en: and all the atoms, except for those kept by descendants to remember us,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（四）什么是闵可夫斯基四维时空？

cues.zh: 所以地球的世界线是沿着时间轴
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 di4 qiu2 de5 shi4 jie4 xian4 shi4 yan2 zhe5 shi2 jian1 zhou2
cues.en: so the Earth's worldline is a helix

cues.zh: 盘旋的螺旋线
cues.pinyin: pan2 xuan2 de5 luo2 xuan2 xian4
cues.en: spiraling along the time axis.

cues.zh: 我们可以使用明可普斯基思维时空
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 ming2 ke3 pu3 si1 ji1 si1 wei2 shi2 kong1
cues.en: We can use Minkowski's four-dimensional spacetime

cues.zh: 来说明一下时空的变化
cues.pinyin: lai2 shuo1 ming2 yi1 xia4 shi2 kong1 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: to illustrate how spacetime changes.

cues.zh: 比如在加莫夫的从一到无数大
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zai4 jia1 mo4 fu1 de5 cong2 yi1 dao4 wu2 shu4 da4
cues.en: For example, in Gamow's "One Two Three... Infinity,"

cues.zh: 中有一个例子
cues.pinyin: zhong1 you3 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: there's an example:

cues.zh: 上午 9 点 21 分
cues.pinyin: shang4 wu3 9 dian3 21 fen1
cues.en: At 9:21 AM,

cues.zh: 银行距离我们有 10 个街口
cues.pinyin: yin2 hang2 ju4 li2 wo3 men5 you3 10 ge4 jie1 kou3
cues.en: a bank in New York was robbed.

cues.zh: 9 点 36 分
cues.pinyin: 9 dian3 36 fen1

cues.zh: 一架飞机撞上了帝国大厦
cues.pinyin: yi1 jia4 fei1 ji1 zhuang4 shang4 le5 di4 guo2 da4 sha4
cues.en: a plane crashed into the Empire State Building.

cues.zh: 为了方便起见
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 fang1 bian4 qi3 jian4
cues.en: For convenience,

cues.zh: 我们假设它们发生在同一条马路上
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia3 she4 ta1 men5 fa1 sheng1 zai4 tong2 yi1 tiao2 ma3 lu4 shang4
cues.en: let's assume both happened on the same street.

cues.zh: 银行距离我们有 10 个接口
cues.pinyin: yin2 hang2 ju4 li2 wo3 men5 you3 10 ge4 jie1 kou3
cues.en: The bank is 10 blocks away from us,

cues.zh: 而帝国大厦距离我们有 20 个接口
cues.pinyin: er2 di4 guo2 da4 sha4 ju4 li2 wo3 men5 you3 20 ge4 jie1 kou3
cues.en: and the Empire State Building is 20 blocks away from us.

cues.zh: 这样在我们看来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zai4 wo3 men5 kan4 lai2
cues.en: So, as we see it,

cues.zh: 两件事的空间间隔就是 10 个接口
cues.pinyin: liang3 jian4 shi4 de5 kong1 jian1 jian4 ge2 jiu4 shi4 10 ge4 jie1 kou3
cues.en: the spatial interval between the two events is 10 blocks,

cues.zh: 而时间间隔是 15 分钟
cues.pinyin: er2 shi2 jian1 jian4 ge2 shi4 15 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and the time interval is 15 minutes.

cues.zh: 我们可以画出一个四维时空图
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 hua4 chu1 yi2 ge4 si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 tu2
cues.en: We can draw a four-dimensional spacetime diagram,

cues.zh: 两个事件可以表示成
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 shi4 jian4 ke3 yi3 biao3 shi4 cheng2
cues.en: and the two events can be represented as

cues.zh: 四维时空图上的两个点
cues.pinyin: si4 wei2 shi2 kong1 tu2 shang4 de5 liang3 ge4 dian3
cues.en: two points on the four-dimensional spacetime diagram.

cues.zh: 两个点分别向时间轴和空间轴做投影
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 dian3 fen1 bie2 xiang4 shi2 jian1 zhou2 he2 kong1 jian1 zhou2 zuo4 tou2 ying3
cues.en: The two points are each projected onto the time axis and the space axis.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 不用社交软件，他专注画画30年 He’s Been Focusing on Painting for over Three Decades, Needing N

cues.zh: 我是张恩丽做艺术到现在应该是三十几年
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zhang1 en1 li4 zuo4 yi4 shu4 dao4 xian4 zai4 ying1 gai1 shi4 san1 shi2 ji3 nian2
cues.en: I'm Zhang Enli, and I've been doing art for over thirty years now.

cues.zh: 和这次主题叫肖像
cues.pinyin: he2 zhe4 ci4 zhu3 ti2 jiao4 xiao4 xiang4
cues.en: This time the theme is called 'Portrait.'

cues.zh: 但没有一个直接的人在里面
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 you3 yi2 ge4 zhi2 jie1 de5 ren2 zai4 li3 mian4
cues.en: But there's no direct person in it.

cues.zh: 主要是物体到比较抽象的这些绘画
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 wu4 ti3 dao4 bi3 jiao4 chou1 xiang4 de5 zhe4 xie1 hui4 hua4
cues.en: It's mainly objects, leading into fairly abstract paintings.

cues.zh: 物体对我来讲它也是肖像
cues.pinyin: wu4 ti3 dui4 wo3 lai2 jiang3 ta1 ye3 shi4 xiao4 xiang4
cues.en: For me, objects are also portraits.

cues.zh: 是一个生活的一面镜子
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 sheng1 huo2 de5 yi2 mian4 jing4 zi5
cues.en: It's a mirror of life.

cues.zh: 反映了这个时代所有人跟这些物
cues.pinyin: fan3 ying4 le5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 dai4 suo3 you3 ren2 gen1 zhe4 xie1 wu4
cues.en: It reflects the relationship everyone in this era has with these objects

cues.zh: 体的一个关系
cues.pinyin: ti3 de5 yi2 ge4 guan1 xi4
cues.en: — that relationship with objects.

cues.zh: 一个很简单的一个桌子
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 hen3 jian3 dan1 de5 yi2 ge4 zhuo1 zi5
cues.en: A very simple table.

cues.zh: 就是一个水桶变成一张画的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 shui3 tong3 bian4 cheng2 yi1 zhang1 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When a bucket turns into a painting,

cues.zh: 有一种既熟悉又陌生的一种反应
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 zhong3 ji4 shu2 xi1 you4 mo4 sheng1 de5 yi1 zhong3 fan3 ying4
cues.en: there's a reaction that's both familiar and strange.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 不用社交软件，他专注画画30年 He’s Been Focusing on Painting for over Three Decades, Needing N

cues.zh: 当你画一把椅子的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ni3 hua4 yi1 ba3 yi3 zi5 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When you paint a chair,

cues.zh: 它还是很具体
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 hen3 ju4 ti3
cues.en: it's still very concrete.

cues.zh: 后期布的本身
cues.pinyin: hou4 qi1 bu4 de5 ben3 shen1
cues.en: Later on, the canvas itself —

cues.zh: 它这个外延就扩大了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 ge5 wai4 yan2 jiu4 kuo4 da4 le5
cues.en: its scope just expanded.

cues.zh: 找到今天这个纯粹抽象的画面
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 chun2 cui4 chou1 xiang4 de5 hua4 mian4
cues.en: I arrived at today's purely abstract imagery.

cues.zh: 我希望它是有更多东西在里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 ta1 shi4 you3 geng4 duo1 dong1 xi1 zai4 li3 mian4
cues.en: I hope there's more contained within it.

cues.zh: 每个观众都会有自己的感受
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 guan1 zhong4 du1 hui4 you3 zi4 ji3 de5 gan3 shou4
cues.en: Every viewer will have their own feelings.

cues.zh: 有几个作品是专门针对和这个空间作
cues.pinyin: you3 ji3 ge4 zuo4 pin3 shi4 zhuan1 men2 zhen1 dui4 he2 zhe4 ge5 kong1 jian1 zuo4
cues.en: A few works are made specifically for this space,

cues.zh: 三个立体的东西
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 li4 ti3 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: three three-dimensional pieces.

cues.zh: 和的美术馆基本上是以曲线和圆形为主
cues.pinyin: he2 de5 mei3 shu4 guan3 ji1 ben3 shang4 shi4 yi3 qu1 xian4 he2 yuan2 xing2 wei2 zhu3
cues.en: He Art Museum is mainly built around curves and circles.

cues.zh: 我做了两个立方体方的东西在里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 le5 liang3 ge4 li4 fang1 ti3 fang1 de5 dong1 xi1 zai4 li3 mian4
cues.en: I put two cube-shaped, square things inside it,

cues.zh: 把这个空间把它破一下
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 kong1 jian1 ba3 ta1 po4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: to break up that space a bit.

cues.zh: 我希望我的那个状态一直很好
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 de5 na4 ge5 zhuang4 tai4 yi4 zhi2 hen3 hao3
cues.en: I hope that state of mine stays good forever.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 眼前这个人竟然和自己死去的哥哥
cues.pinyin: yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 ren2 jing4 ran2 he2 zi4 ji3 si3 qu4 di1 ge1 ge1
cues.en: The person in front of him turned out to look exactly like his dead brother

cues.zh: 长得一模一样
cues.pinyin: zhang3 de2 yi1 mu2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: They looked exactly alike

cues.zh: 天才医生肖恩都惊呆了
cues.pinyin: tian1 cai2 yi1 sheng1 xiao4 en1 dou1 jing1 dai1 le5
cues.en: Even genius doctor Shaun was stunned

cues.zh: 今早肖恩刚到医院
cues.pinyin: jin1 zao3 xiao4 en1 gang1 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: This morning, right when Shaun arrived at the hospital

cues.zh: 就注意到了一个独自看病的小男孩
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhu4 yi4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 du2 zi4 kan4 bing4 de5 xiao3 nan2 hai2
cues.en: he noticed a little boy seeing a doctor all by himself

cues.zh: 长得几乎和哥哥一模一样
cues.pinyin: zhang3 de2 ji1 hu1 he2 ge1 ge1 yi1 mu2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: who looked almost exactly like his brother

cues.zh: 他立刻撇下了当前的工作
cues.pinyin: ta1 li4 ke4 pie1 xia4 liao3 dang4 qian2 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: He immediately dropped what he was doing

cues.zh: 主动帮男孩诊治
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dong4 bang1 nan2 hai2 zhen3 zhi4
cues.en: and volunteered to treat the boy

cues.zh: 男孩叫小文他原本在参加学校举
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 jiao4 xiao3 wen2 ta1 yuan2 ben3 zai4 can1 jia1 xue2 xiao4 ju3
cues.en: The boy's name was Xiaowen; he had originally been on a school-organized

cues.zh: 行的野外考察
cues.pinyin: xing2 de5 ye3 wai4 kao3 cha2
cues.en: field trip

cues.zh: 结果自己把自己给绊倒然后胳膊就骨折了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zi4 ji3 ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 ban4 dao3 ran2 hou4 ge1 bo2 jiu4 gu3 zhe2 le5
cues.en: but ended up tripping over himself and breaking his arm

cues.zh: 不过肖恩觉得虽然骨折很严重
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 sui1 ran2 gu3 zhe2 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Shaun felt that although the fracture was serious

cues.zh: 但不需要打钢钉
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 xu1 yao4 da3 gang1 ding1
cues.en: it didn't need surgical pins

cues.zh: 年轻人的愈合能力是很强的
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 ren2 de5 yu4 he2 neng2 li4 shi4 hen3 qiang2 de5
cues.en: young people heal very well

cues.zh: 小文的父母工作地点离这里很远
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 de5 fu4 mu3 gong1 zuo4 di4 dian3 li2 zhe4 li3 hen3 yuan3
cues.en: Xiaowen's parents worked far from here

cues.zh: 此刻还在赶来的路上
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 hai2 zai4 gan3 lai2 de5 lu4 shang4
cues.en: and were still on their way

cues.zh: 小文说他总是笨手笨脚
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 shuo1 ta1 zong3 shi4 ben4 shou3 ben4 jiao3
cues.en: Xiaowen said he was always clumsy

cues.zh: 经常把自己给绊倒
cues.pinyin: jing1 chang2 ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 ban4 dao3
cues.en: and often tripped over himself

cues.zh: 肖恩就给他做了个简单的测试
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jiu4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 le5 ge4 jian3 dan1 de5 ce4 shi4
cues.en: So Shaun gave him a simple test

cues.zh: 他有点眼球震颤和不自主运动
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 dian3 yan3 qiu2 zhen4 chan4 he2 bu4 zi4 zhu3 yun4 dong4
cues.en: He had some nystagmus and involuntary movements

cues.zh: 可能是神经系统的问题
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 shen2 jing1 xi4 tong3 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: which could point to a nervous system problem

cues.zh: 小文说他摔倒的时候没有撞到头
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 shuo1 ta1 shuai1 dao3 de5 shi2 hou4 mei2 you3 zhuang4 dao4 tou2
cues.en: Xiaowen said he hadn't hit his head when he fell

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 但肖恩还是给他预约了脑部 CT
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 hai2 shi4 gei3 ta1 yu4 yue1 le5 nao3 bu4 CT
cues.en: but Shaun still scheduled a brain CT for him

cues.zh: 此时伦叔恰好路过
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 lun2 shu1 qia4 hao3 lu4 guo4
cues.en: At that moment Uncle Lun happened to pass by

cues.zh: 他看到了小文
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 le5 xiao3 wen2
cues.en: He saw Xiaowen

cues.zh: 一时震惊得无以复加
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 zhen4 jing1 de2 wu2 yi3 fu4 jia1
cues.en: and was shocked beyond words

cues.zh: 甚至怀疑他和肖恩是不是有什么血缘关系
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 huai2 yi2 ta1 he2 xiao4 en1 shi4 bu2 shi4 you3 shen2 me5 xue4 yuan2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: He even wondered if he and Shaun were related by blood

cues.zh: 不然怎么和肖恩的哥哥长得那么像
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 zen3 me5 he2 xiao4 en1 di1 ge1 ge1 zhang3 de2 na4 me5 xiang4
cues.en: otherwise why would he look so much like Shaun's brother

cues.zh: 肖恩告诉他
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Shaun told him

cues.zh: 俩人姓不一样
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 xing4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: the two of them had different surnames

cues.zh: 应该就纯属巧合
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 jiu4 chun2 shu3 qiao3 he2
cues.en: so it should just be a coincidence

cues.zh: 而且俩人也不完全一样
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 lia3 ren2 ye3 bu4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Besides, the two of them weren't completely identical

cues.zh: 小文的头发短一点
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 de5 tou2 fa4 duan3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Xiaowen's hair was a bit shorter

cues.zh: 伦叔无语凝噎
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 wu2 yu3 ning2 ye1
cues.en: Uncle Lun was left speechless

cues.zh: 肖恩要是玩我们一起来找茬的游戏
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 yao4 shi4 wan2 wo3 men5 yi4 qi3 lai2 zhao3 cha2 de5 you2 xi4
cues.en: If Shaun ever played our 'spot the difference' game with us

cues.zh: 一定很厉害吧
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 hen3 li4 hai4 ba5
cues.en: he'd probably be really good at it

cues.zh: 伦叔安慰他
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: Uncle Lun comforted him

cues.zh: 你要是被吓到了可以和我说
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 bei4 xia4 dao4 le5 ke3 yi3 he2 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: saying he could tell him if he'd been scared

cues.zh: 但肖恩坚持说自己没有
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 jian1 chi2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 mei2 you3
cues.en: But Shaun insisted he hadn't been

cues.zh: 他很清楚的知道哥哥已经死了
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 qing1 chu3 de5 zhi1 dao4 ge1 ge1 yi3 jing1 si3 le5
cues.en: He knew very clearly that his brother was already dead

cues.zh: 伦叔不知道该说些什么
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 shuo1 xie1 shen2 me5
cues.en: Uncle Lun didn't know what to say

cues.zh: 但他明显感觉到萧恩的情绪不对
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 ming2 xian3 gan3 jue2 dao4 xiao1 en1 de5 qing2 xu4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: but he could clearly tell something was off with Shaun

cues.zh: 萧恩很快离开了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 hen3 kuai4 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: Shaun left in a hurry

cues.zh: 带着萧文去做检测
cues.pinyin: dai4 zhe5 xiao1 wen2 qu4 zuo4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: taking Xiaowen for testing

cues.zh: CT 图显示
cues.pinyin: CT tu2 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The CT scan showed

cues.zh: 小文内耳附近有脑肿瘤
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 nei4 er3 fu4 jin4 you3 nao3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: there was a brain tumor near Xiaowen's inner ear

cues.zh: 小文的爸妈也过来了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 de5 ba4 ma1 ye3 guo4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Xiaowen's parents arrived as well

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 小文是他爸妈的儿子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 shi4 ta1 ba4 ma1 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: Xiaowen was their son

cues.zh: 他们才有权利决定是否告诉病情
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 cai2 you3 quan2 li4 jue2 ding4 shi4 fou3 gao4 su4 bing4 qing2
cues.en: so only they had the right to decide whether to tell him about his condition

cues.zh: 午餐过后
cues.pinyin: wu3 can1 guo4 hou4
cues.en: After lunch

cues.zh: 肖恩找到布莱尔
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhao3 dao4 bu4 lai2 er3
cues.en: Shaun went to find Blair

cues.zh: 希望他替自己撒谎
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ta1 ti4 zi4 ji3 sa1 huang3
cues.en: hoping Blair would lie on his behalf

cues.zh: 布莱尔跟他回了病房
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 er3 gen1 ta1 hui2 le5 bing4 fang2
cues.en: Blair went back to the ward with him

cues.zh: 替他给小文说明情况
cues.pinyin: ti4 ta1 gei3 xiao3 wen2 shuo1 ming2 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: to explain the situation to Xiaowen in his place

cues.zh: 他对小文说
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 xiao3 wen2 shuo1
cues.en: He said to Xiaowen

cues.zh: 考虑到骨折的严重程度
cues.pinyin: kao3 lv4 dao4 gu3 zhe2 de5 yan2 zhong4 cheng2 du4
cues.en: considering how serious the fracture was

cues.zh: 我们认为对骨折进行彻底有效的修复
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ren4 wei2 dui4 gu3 zhe2 jin4 xing2 che4 di3 you3 xiao4 de5 xiu1 fu4
cues.en: they believed a thorough and effective repair of the fracture

cues.zh: 才是比较慎重周全的治疗办法
cues.pinyin: cai2 shi4 bi3 jiao4 shen4 zhong4 zhou1 quan2 de5 zhi4 liao2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: was the more careful and comprehensive treatment option

cues.zh: 小文问那还能打棒球吗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 wen4 na4 hai2 neng2 da3 bang4 qiu2 ma5
cues.en: Xiaowen asked if he could still play baseball

cues.zh: 布莱尔说当然可以
cues.pinyin: bu4 lai2 er3 shuo1 dang1 ran2 ke3 yi3
cues.en: Blair said of course he could

cues.zh: 只要经过理疗等骨折痊愈就可以
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 jing1 guo4 li3 liao2 deng3 gu3 zhe2 quan2 yu4 jiu4 ke3 yi3
cues.en: as long as he did physical therapy and let the fracture heal

cues.zh: 其他人陆续离开
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 ren2 lu4 xu4 li2 kai1
cues.en: The others left one by one

cues.zh: 病房里只剩下肖恩和小文
cues.pinyin: bing4 fang2 li3 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 xiao4 en1 he2 xiao3 wen2
cues.en: leaving only Shaun and Xiaowen in the ward

cues.zh: 小文早就看破了肖恩的谎言
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 zao3 jiu4 kan4 po4 le5 xiao4 en1 de5 huang3 yan2
cues.en: Xiaowen had already seen through Shaun's lie

cues.zh: 肖恩也实在是瞒不下去了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ye3 shi2 zai4 shi4 man2 bu4 xia4 qu4 le5
cues.en: and Shaun really couldn't keep it up anymore

cues.zh: 肖恩说了他患有癌症
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 shuo1 le5 ta1 huan4 you3 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: Shaun told him he had cancer

cues.zh: 谁知道小文比他爸妈还淡定
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dao4 xiao3 wen2 bi3 ta1 ba4 ma1 hai2 dan4 ding4
cues.en: Who knew Xiaowen would be even calmer than his parents

cues.zh: 他说他知道
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ta1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: He said he already knew

cues.zh: 之前他腿疼
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 ta1 tui3 teng2
cues.en: Earlier, his leg had been hurting

cues.zh: 爸妈就带他去了医院
cues.pinyin: ba4 ma1 jiu4 dai4 ta1 qu4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: and his parents had taken him to the hospital

cues.zh: 做了很多检查
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 hen3 duo1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: where they ran a lot of tests

cues.zh: 结果爸妈只告诉他没事
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ba4 ma1 zhi3 gao4 su4 ta1 mei2 shi4
cues.en: but his parents only told him it was nothing

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 但是小文曾经做了两次活体组织检查
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 wen2 ceng2 jing1 zuo4 le5 liang3 ci4 huo2 ti3 zu3 zhi1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Yet Xiaowen had actually had two biopsies

cues.zh: 病理报告都说他患有肉骨瘤
cues.pinyin: bing4 li3 bao4 gao4 dou1 shuo1 ta1 huan4 you3 rou4 gu3 liu2
cues.en: and both pathology reports said he had osteosarcoma

cues.zh: 小文猜测成立的几率不足 0 3
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 cai1 ce4 cheng2 li4 de5 ji1 lv4 bu4 zu2 0 3
cues.en: Xiaowen guessed the odds of it being true were under 0.3

cues.zh: 所以梅医生不同意她去做骨髓穿刺
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 tong2 yi4 ta1 qu4 zuo4 gu3 sui3 chuan1 ci4
cues.en: so Dr. Mei disagreed with her going through a bone marrow aspiration

cues.zh: 这相当于让溺死孩童的父母
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 rang4 ni4 si3 hai2 tong2 de5 fu4 mu3
cues.en: That would be like asking the parents of a drowned child

cues.zh: 去盼望一件根本不可能的事情
cues.pinyin: qu4 pan4 wang4 yi1 jian4 gen1 ben3 bu4 ke3 neng2 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: to hope for something that was fundamentally impossible

cues.zh: 萧恩只能向院长请求帮助
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhi3 neng2 xiang4 yuan4 zhang3 qing3 qiu2 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: Shaun had no choice but to ask the director for help

cues.zh: 面对她的坚持
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 ta1 de5 jian1 chi2
cues.en: Faced with her insistence

cues.zh: 轮述让她直接去做检测
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu4 rang4 ta1 zhi2 jie1 qu4 zuo4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: Uncle Lun told her to just go get tested

cues.zh: 不要告诉任何人
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 gao4 su4 ren4 he2 ren2
cues.en: without telling anyone

cues.zh: 如果有人问起
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 ren2 wen4 qi3
cues.en: and if anyone asked

cues.zh: 就说病人红血球数较低
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shuo1 bing4 ren2 hong2 xue4 qiu2 shu4 jiao4 di1
cues.en: to just say the patient's red blood cell count was a bit low

cues.zh: 肖恩立刻就去了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 li4 ke4 jiu4 qu4 le5
cues.en: and this was a routine check

cues.zh: 萧恩立刻就去了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 li4 ke4 jiu4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Shaun went right away

cues.zh: 可她逐烈的谎言没能瞒过萧恩
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 zhu2 lie4 de5 huang3 yan2 mei2 neng2 man2 guo4 xiao1 en1
cues.en: but her clumsy lie couldn't fool Shaun

cues.zh: 不过萧恩很乐意让她做检测
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao1 en1 hen3 le4 yi4 rang4 ta1 zuo4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: Still, Shaun was happy to let her get tested

cues.zh: 毕竟虽然她不怕死
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 sui1 ran2 ta1 bu4 pa4 si3
cues.en: because even though she wasn't afraid of dying

cues.zh: 但不代表不想活
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 dai4 biao3 bu4 xiang3 huo2
cues.en: that didn't mean she didn't want to live

cues.zh: 可谁知道
cues.pinyin: ke3 shui2 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: But who would have guessed

cues.zh: 萧恩刚准备扎针
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gang1 zhun3 bei4 zha1 zhen1
cues.en: just as Shaun was about to insert the needle

cues.zh: 小文的爸妈就回来了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 de5 ba4 ma1 jiu4 hui2 lai2 le5
cues.en: Xiaowen's parents came back

cues.zh: 他们十分愤怒
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi2 fen1 fen4 nu4
cues.en: They were furious

cues.zh: 以为是肖恩告诉了小文
cues.pinyin: yi3 wei2 shi4 xiao4 en1 gao4 su4 le5 xiao3 wen2
cues.en: thinking Shaun had told Xiaowen

cues.zh: 他得癌症的事情
cues.pinyin: ta1 de2 ai2 zheng4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: about him having cancer

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 推脏着要将他赶出去
cues.pinyin: tui1 zang4 zhe5 yao4 jiang1 ta1 gan3 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and shoved him, trying to throw him out

cues.zh: 这时小文突然咳出鲜血
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 wen2 tu1 ran2 ke2 chu1 xian1 xue4
cues.en: At that moment Xiaowen suddenly coughed up blood

cues.zh: 肖恩立刻给他做急救
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 ji2 jiu4
cues.en: Shaun immediately gave him emergency treatment

cues.zh: 检查后发现
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 hou4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After the examination they found

cues.zh: 小文体内有栓色
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wen2 ti3 nei4 you3 shuan1 se4
cues.en: Xiaowen had an embolism in his body

cues.zh: 可能是从骨折出来的
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 cong2 gu3 zhe2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: possibly from the fracture

cues.zh: 处于肺动脉分叉处
cues.pinyin: chu3 yu2 fei4 dong4 mai4 fen1 cha4 chu4
cues.en: lodged at the pulmonary artery bifurcation

cues.zh: 他快要出现血管塌陷了
cues.pinyin: ta1 kuai4 yao4 chu1 xian4 xue4 guan3 ta1 xian4 le5
cues.en: He was about to go into vascular collapse

cues.zh: 这很严重
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: This was very serious

cues.zh: 梅医生给小文做了手术
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 gei3 xiao3 wen2 zuo4 le5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Dr. Mei operated on Xiaowen

cues.zh: 取出栓色
cues.pinyin: qu3 chu1 shuan1 se4
cues.en: to remove the embolism

cues.zh: 只是手术过程中发现
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 fa1 xian4
cues.en: but during the surgery they discovered

cues.zh: 小帅肋骨有损伤
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 lei4 gu3 you3 sun3 shang1
cues.en: Xiaowen's rib was damaged

cues.zh: 这是肉骨瘤的确凿证据
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 rou4 gu3 liu2 di2 que4 zao2 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: which was solid evidence of osteosarcoma

cues.zh: 而且已经转移到了胸墙
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yi3 jing1 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 le5 xiong1 qiang2
cues.en: and that it had already spread to the chest wall

cues.zh: 萧恩是错的
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 shi4 cuo4 de5
cues.en: Shaun had been wrong

cues.zh: 小布醒来后告诉爸妈
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 xing3 lai2 hou4 gao4 su4 ba4 ma1
cues.en: After Xiaowen woke up he told his parents

cues.zh: 他早就知道了自己患有肿瘤
cues.pinyin: ta1 zao3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 huan4 you3 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: that he had already known he had a tumor

cues.zh: 而且还安慰他们没关系的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 an1 wei4 ta1 men5 mei2 guan1 xi4 de5
cues.en: and he even comforted them, saying it was okay

cues.zh: 他不会孤单
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 hui4 gu1 dan1
cues.en: he wouldn't be alone

cues.zh: 至少还能见到死去的奶奶
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 hai2 neng2 jian4 dao4 si3 qu4 de5 nai3 nai3
cues.en: since he'd at least get to see his late grandmother again

cues.zh: 晚上小布的爸妈离开的时候
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 xiao3 bu4 de5 ba4 ma1 li2 kai1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: That night, when Xiaowen's parents left

cues.zh: 萧恩去了病房
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 qu4 le5 bing4 fang2
cues.en: Shaun went to the ward

cues.zh: 小布对他说了谢谢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 dui4 ta1 shuo1 le5 xie4 xie4
cues.en: Xiaowen thanked him

cues.zh: 经过他的同意后
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 ta1 de5 tong2 yi4 hou4
cues.en: and with his permission

cues.zh: 萧恩拿出了一本书
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 na2 chu1 le5 yi1 ben3 shu1
cues.en: Shaun took out a book

cues.zh: 缓缓地读了起来
cues.pinyin: huan3 huan3 di4 du2 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and slowly started reading it aloud

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 病人竟然和自己死去的哥哥一模一样，天才医生肖恩立马给予特殊照顾！然而结局却有点伤感

cues.zh: 此刻大壮正在病床上嚎着呢
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 da4 zhuang4 zheng4 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4 hao2 zhe5 ne5
cues.en: Meanwhile, Dazhuang was groaning on his hospital bed

cues.zh: 检查显示
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 xian3 shi4
cues.en: Tests showed

cues.zh: 脂肪酶淀粉酶和胰蛋白的含量都增高了
cues.pinyin: zhi1 fang2 mei2 dian4 fen3 mei2 he2 yi2 dan4 bai2 de5 han2 liang4 dou1 zeng1 gao1 le5
cues.en: his lipase, amylase, and trypsin levels were all elevated

cues.zh: 胰腺增大
cues.pinyin: yi2 xian4 zeng1 da4
cues.en: and his pancreas was enlarged

cues.zh: 小帅还说早上俩人见面的时候
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 hai2 shuo1 zao3 shang4 lia3 ren2 jian4 mian4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Xiaoshuai also mentioned that when the two of them met that morning

cues.zh: 从大壮身上闻到了酒气
cues.pinyin: cong2 da4 zhuang4 shen1 shang4 wen2 dao4 le5 jiu3 qi4
cues.en: he'd smelled alcohol on Dazhuang

cues.zh: 可能是酒精诱发了胰腺炎
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 jiu3 jing1 you4 fa1 le5 yi2 xian4 yan2
cues.en: so alcohol might have triggered the pancreatitis

cues.zh: 过敏性反应是胰腺炎诱发的症状
cues.pinyin: guo4 min3 xing4 fan3 ying4 shi4 yi2 xian4 yan2 you4 fa1 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: An allergic reaction was listed as a symptom of the pancreatitis

cues.zh: 但梅医生不太认通
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 tai4 ren4 tong1
cues.en: but Dr. Mei wasn't quite convinced

cues.zh: 他指着平板上的图给布莱尔和卢卡看
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 zhe5 ping2 ban3 shang4 de5 tu2 gei3 bu4 lai2 er3 he2 lu2 ka3 kan4
cues.en: He pointed at the image on the tablet to show Blair and Luca

cues.zh: 由于肠道气体的覆盖
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 chang2 dao4 qi4 ti3 de5 fu4 gai4
cues.en: that because of the gas covering the intestines

cues.zh: 上面看不到完整的一线
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 kan4 bu2 dao4 wan2 zheng3 de5 yi1 xian4
cues.en: a complete outline couldn't be seen on it

cues.zh: 他让两人给大壮预约腹部 CT
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 liang3 ren2 gei3 da4 zhuang4 yu4 yue1 fu4 bu4 CT
cues.en: so he had the two of them schedule an abdominal CT for Dazhuang

cues.zh: 好好看清楚再下结论
cues.pinyin: hao3 hao3 kan4 qing1 chu3 zai4 xia4 jie2 lun4
cues.en: to get a clear look before drawing any conclusions

cues.zh: 小帅在病房陪着大壮
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 zai4 bing4 fang2 pei2 zhe5 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: Xiaoshuai stayed in the ward with Dazhuang

cues.zh: 解释说自己之所以没参加妈妈的葬礼
cues.pinyin: jie3 shi4 shuo1 zi4 ji3 zhi1 suo3 yi3 mei2 can1 jia1 ma1 ma1 de5 zang4 li3
cues.en: and explained that the reason he hadn't gone to his mother's funeral

cues.zh: 是因为自己恋爱了
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 lian4 ai4 le5
cues.en: was that he had fallen in love

cues.zh: 对方是个泰国女人
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shi4 ge4 tai4 guo2 nv3 ren2
cues.en: The other person was a Thai woman

cues.zh: 是一个学校的老师
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 xue2 xiao4 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: who worked as a teacher at a school

cues.zh: 她患有先天性心脏缺损
cues.pinyin: ta1 huan4 you3 xian1 tian1 xing4 xin1 zang4 que1 sun3
cues.en: She had a congenital heart defect

cues.zh: 那段时间病得很重
cues.pinyin: na4 duan4 shi2 jian1 bing4 de2 hen3 zhong4
cues.en: and had been very ill around that time

cues.zh: 自己忙着照顾她所以才没回来
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 mang2 zhe5 zhao4 gu4 ta1 suo3 yi3 cai2 mei2 hui2 lai2
cues.en: so he'd been busy taking care of her and couldn't go back

items.title_zh: 笑话87｜谐音梗图猜谜大挑战｜孟婆想投胎了｜清廷被青蛙吃了｜大门不见了｜最忠心和最不忠心｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 孟婆在地府工作了几百年之后
cues.pinyin: meng4 po2 zai4 di4 fu3 gong1 zuo4 le5 ji3 bai3 nian2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After Meng Po had worked in the underworld for hundreds of years,

cues.zh: 想要离职去投胎了
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 li2 zhi2 qu4 tou2 tai1 le5
cues.en: she wanted to quit and be reincarnated.

cues.zh: 阎王啊我在这里工作了几百年
cues.pinyin: yan2 wang2 a5 wo3 zai4 zhe4 li3 gong1 zuo4 le5 ji3 bai3 nian2
cues.en: Yama, I've worked here for hundreds of years,

cues.zh: 我想要投胎了
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yao4 tou2 tai1 le5
cues.en: I want to be reincarnated.

cues.zh: 哦好啊那你先喝一口孟婆汤再去
cues.pinyin: o2 hao3 a5 na4 ni3 xian1 he1 yi1 kou3 meng4 po2 tang1 zai4 qu4
cues.en: Oh, sure — but drink a bowl of Meng Po soup first.

cues.zh: 孟婆喝了一口
cues.pinyin: meng4 po2 he1 le5 yi1 kou3
cues.en: Meng Po took a sip.

cues.zh: 你怎么会在这里
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 hui4 zai4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: Why are you here?

cues.zh: 哦你刚来因为你在世的时候做了很多好事
cues.pinyin: o2 ni3 gang1 lai2 yin1 wei4 ni3 zai4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 zuo4 le5 hen3 duo1 hao3 shi4
cues.en: Oh, you just arrived — since you did so many good deeds in life,

cues.zh: 我决定帮你升官
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 ding4 bang1 ni3 sheng1 guan1
cues.en: I've decided to promote you.

cues.zh: 在这里煮孟婆汤哦
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 zhu3 meng4 po2 tang1 o2
cues.en: You'll brew Meng Po soup here.

cues.zh: 耶太好了谢谢阴王
cues.pinyin: ye2 tai4 hao3 le5 xie4 xie4 yin1 wang2
cues.en: Yay, great, thank you, Yama!

cues.zh: 于是孟婆又继续在这里煮汤
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 meng4 po2 you4 ji4 xu4 zai4 zhe4 li3 zhu3 tang1
cues.en: So Meng Po kept brewing soup here, just like before.

cues.zh: 晨晨你知道清朝为什么会灭亡吗
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 ni3 zhi1 dao4 qing1 chao2 wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 mie4 wang2 ma5
cues.en: Chenchen, do you know why the Qing dynasty fell?

cues.zh: 我知道啊被青蛙吃掉
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 a5 bei4 qing1 wa1 chi1 diao4
cues.en: I know — it got eaten by a frog!

cues.zh: 历史老师叫我抄一百遍
cues.pinyin: li4 shi3 lao3 shi1 jiao4 wo3 chao1 yi4 bai3 bian4
cues.en: My history teacher made me copy that out a hundred times.

cues.zh: 三三三三我问你哦
cues.pinyin: san1 san1 san1 san1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: San-san-san-san, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 如果我有一颗苹果
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 you3 yi1 ke1 ping2 guo3
cues.en: If I have an apple

cues.zh: 分你一半你知道这叫什么吗
cues.pinyin: fen1 ni3 yi2 ban4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 jiao4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: and give you half, do you know what that's called?

cues.zh: 不知道耶
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ye2
cues.en: I don't know.

cues.zh: 这叫友情
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 you3 qing2
cues.en: That's called friendship.

cues.zh: 那如果我只是不要
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 wo3 zhi3 shi4 bu2 yao4
cues.en: What if I just don't want it,

cues.zh: 剩下的都给你呢
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 dou1 gei3 ni3 ne5
cues.en: and give you all the rest?

cues.zh: 我知道这叫亲情
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 jiao4 qin1 qing2
cues.en: I know — that's called family love.

cues.zh: 不对
cues.pinyin: bu2 dui4
cues.en: Wrong.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话87｜谐音梗图猜谜大挑战｜孟婆想投胎了｜清廷被青蛙吃了｜大门不见了｜最忠心和最不忠心｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 你是做什么的啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 zuo4 shen2 me5 de5 a5
cues.en: What do you do for work?

cues.zh: 安门的啊
cues.pinyin: an1 men2 de5 a5
cues.en: I install doors.

cues.zh: 那你喜不喜欢这个工作啊
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 xi3 bu4 xi3 huan1 zhe4 ge5 gong1 zuo4 a5
cues.en: Do you like the job?

cues.zh: 还蛮喜欢的
cues.pinyin: hai2 man2 xi3 huan1 de5
cues.en: I like it quite a lot,

cues.zh: 不过后来被开除了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hou4 lai2 bei4 kai1 chu2 le5
cues.en: but I got fired later.

cues.zh: 为什么啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 a5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 因为大门丢了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 da4 men2 diu1 le5
cues.en: Because the front door went missing.

cues.zh: 大大大大大
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 da4 da4 da4
cues.en: Da-da-da-da-da,

cues.zh: 我问你哦
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 你知道世界上最中心的是什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 zhong1 xin1 de5 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know what's the most 'central' thing in the world?

cues.zh: 是小狗啊
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiao3 gou3 a5
cues.en: Is it a puppy?

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: No.

cues.zh: 是脂肪
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhi1 fang2
cues.en: It's fat.

cues.zh: 他怎么甩也甩不掉
cues.pinyin: ta1 zen3 me5 shuai3 ye3 shuai3 bu4 diao4
cues.en: No matter how you shake it, it won't come off.

cues.zh: 那我也问你哦
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 ye3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: Then let me ask you too —

cues.zh: 世界上最不中心的是什么
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 bu4 zhong1 xin1 de5 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: what's the least 'central' thing in the world?

cues.zh: 就是你啊
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 a5
cues.en: It's you.

cues.zh: 不是啦
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 la5
cues.en: Nope.

cues.zh: 是钱
cues.pinyin: shi4 qian2
cues.en: It's money.

cues.zh: 说好的一起出门
cues.pinyin: shuo1 hao3 de5 yi4 qi3 chu1 men2
cues.en: You agree to go out together,

cues.zh: 然后就不跟你回家了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 bu4 gen1 ni3 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: and then it doesn't come home with you.

items.title_zh: 笑话87｜谐音梗图猜谜大挑战｜孟婆想投胎了｜清廷被青蛙吃了｜大门不见了｜最忠心和最不忠心｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 辰辰辰辰辰
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 chen2 chen2 chen2
cues.en: Chen-chen-chen-chen-chen,

cues.zh: 什么事
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4
cues.en: What is it?

cues.zh: 我出一个谜题给你猜哦
cues.pinyin: wo3 chu1 yi2 ge4 mi2 ti2 gei3 ni3 cai1 o2
cues.en: I've got a riddle for you to guess.

cues.zh: 你一定会答错
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi2 ding4 hui4 da2 cuo4
cues.en: You're bound to get it wrong.

cues.zh: 不可能的
cues.pinyin: bu4 ke3 neng2 de5
cues.en: No way.

cues.zh: 我都会答对的
cues.pinyin: wo3 du1 hui4 da2 dui4 de5
cues.en: I always get it right.

cues.zh: 我很会猜谜啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 hui4 cai1 mi2 a5
cues.en: I'm really good at guessing riddles.

cues.zh: 好你听清楚啰
cues.pinyin: hao3 ni3 ting1 qing1 chu3 luo1
cues.en: Okay, listen carefully.

cues.zh: 就是左边一个金
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zuo3 bian1 yi2 ge4 jin1
cues.en: On the left there's a 金 (gold),

cues.zh: 右边一个席
cues.pinyin: you4 bian1 yi2 ge4 xi2
cues.en: on the right there's a 席 (mat).

cues.zh: 差一个字
cues.pinyin: cha4 yi2 ge4 zi4
cues.en: Missing one character.

items.title_zh: 笑话100｜做什么事能最快成为亿万富翁💰｜算命｜胆小鬼｜找手机｜感情不顺｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 算命大师我真的放不下他
cues.pinyin: suan4 ming4 da4 shi1 wo3 zhen1 de5 fang4 bu4 xia4 ta1
cues.en: Fortune teller, I really can't let go of him.

cues.zh: 我好难过喔离开他我真的活不下去了
cues.pinyin: wo3 hao3 nan2 guo4 o1 li2 kai1 ta1 wo3 zhen1 de5 huo2 bu4 xia4 qu4 le5
cues.en: I'm so sad, I really can't live without him.

cues.zh: 我该怎么办呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 gai1 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5
cues.en: What should I do?

cues.zh: 他会影响你的财运喔这样啊
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ying3 xiang3 ni3 de5 cai2 yun4 o1 zhe4 yang4 a5
cues.en: "He'll affect your financial luck." "Oh, I see."

cues.zh: 喔那没事了我突然放下了
cues.pinyin: o1 na4 mei2 shi4 le5 wo3 tu1 ran2 fang4 xia4 le5
cues.en: Oh, then never mind, I suddenly let go.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话100｜做什么事能最快成为亿万富翁💰｜算命｜胆小鬼｜找手机｜感情不顺｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 一个夜黑风高的夜晚小明遇到一只鬼
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ye4 hei1 feng1 gao1 de5 ye4 wan3 xiao3 ming2 yu4 dao4 yi1 zhi1 gui3
cues.en: On a dark, windy night, Xiao Ming ran into a ghost.

cues.zh: 但是那只鬼就落荒而逃了为什么呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 na4 zhi3 gui3 jiu4 luo4 huang1 er2 tao2 le5 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: But the ghost fled in terror — why was that?

cues.zh: 他小明是神啦
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiao3 ming2 shi4 shen2 la5
cues.en: Because Xiao Ming is a god.

cues.zh: 哪有神叫做小明的啊
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 shen2 jiao4 zuo4 xiao3 ming2 de5 a5
cues.en: Since when is there a god named Xiao Ming?

cues.zh: 当然是因为那只鬼是单潇
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 shi4 yin1 wei4 na4 zhi3 gui3 shi4 dan1 xiao1
cues.en: Of course it's because the ghost is a coward.

cues.zh: 老婆
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2
cues.en: Honey,

cues.zh: 我昨天晚上
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo2 tian1 wan3 shang4
cues.en: last night I

cues.zh: 打开手机的手电筒
cues.pinyin: da3 kai1 shou3 ji1 de5 shou3 dian4 tong3
cues.en: turned on my phone's flashlight

cues.zh: 在找手机耶
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhao3 shou3 ji1 ye2
cues.en: to look for my phone.

cues.zh: 你看我的脑袋是不是出问题了
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 wo3 de5 nao3 dai4 shi4 bu2 shi4 chu1 wen4 ti2 le5
cues.en: See, is there something wrong with my head?

cues.zh: 你不是刚买的

cues.zh: 怎么会弄丢的

cues.zh: 后来又找到了吗

cues.en: Did you end up finding it?

cues.zh: 老婆
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2
cues.en: Honey,

cues.zh: 我们会在一起不是没有原因的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 zai4 yi4 qi3 bu2 shi4 mei2 you3 yuan2 yin1 de5
cues.en: there's a reason we're together.

cues.zh: 什么意思啊

cues.zh: 你说什么意思啊

cues.zh: 我问你喔

cues.en: your dad is actually a billionaire.

cues.zh: 可是不想让你们成为败家子
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bu4 xiang3 rang4 ni3 men5 cheng2 wei2 bai4 jia1 zi3
cues.en: But he didn't want you two to become spoiled brats,

cues.zh: 所以没有跟你们说过
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 you3 gen1 ni3 men5 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: so he never told you.

cues.zh: 这哪是坏消息
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na3 shi4 huai4 xiao1 xi1

cues.zh: 这个是超级好的消息
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 chao1 ji2 hao3 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: That's amazing news!

cues.zh: 好消息是
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiao1 xi1 shi4
cues.en: The good news is,

cues.zh: 你是路边捡的
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 lu4 bian1 jian3 de5
cues.en: you were picked up by the roadside.

cues.zh: 所以跟你爸爸的身家没关系
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 gen1 ni3 ba4 ba4 de5 shen1 jia1 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: So it has nothing to do with your dad's fortune.

cues.zh: 不用想着怎么跟你弟弟抢

cues.en: No need to worry about competing with your brother for it.

cues.zh: 我两次婚姻都失败了

cues.en: Both of my marriages failed.

cues.zh: 怎么说

cues.zh: 第一个老婆

cues.en: My first wife...

cues.zh: 好了

cues.en: that's enough.

cues.zh: 那第二个呢
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 er4 ge4 ne5
cues.en: What about the second one?
