items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 当自闭症患者遇上自闭症的医生会擦
cues.pinyin: dang1 zi4 bi4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3 yu4 shang4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 yi1 sheng1 hui4 ca1
cues.en: When an autistic patient meets an autistic doctor, what

cues.zh: 出什么火花呢
cues.pinyin: chu1 shen2 me5 huo3 hua1 ni2
cues.en: sparks will fly, I wonder?

cues.zh: 医院里来了一个很奇怪的病人小金
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 li3 lai2 le5 yi2 ge4 hen3 qi2 guai4 de5 bing4 ren2 xiao3 jin1
cues.en: A strange patient named Xiao Jin came to the hospital.

cues.zh: 本来就是头部有点创伤
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 jiu4 shi4 tou2 bu4 you3 dian3 chuang1 shang1
cues.en: It was originally just a minor head injury.

cues.zh: 亲个创包扎一下就完了
cues.pinyin: qin1 ge4 chuang4 bao1 za1 yi1 xia4 jiu4 wan2 le5
cues.en: Clean and bandage the wound, and it'd be done.

cues.zh: 可是小金被一群人按在床上
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao3 jin1 bei4 yi1 qun2 ren2 an4 zai4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: But Xiao Jin was held down on the bed by a group of people.

cues.zh: 就跟待宰的羔羊一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gen1 dai4 zai3 de5 gao1 yang2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: just like a lamb about to be slaughtered.

cues.zh: 拼了命的挣扎
cues.pinyin: pin1 le5 ming4 de5 zheng1 zha2
cues.en: struggling with all his might.

cues.zh: 知道的这是在医院里准备包扎伤口
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 de5 zhe4 shi4 zai4 yi1 yuan4 li3 zhun3 bei4 bao1 za1 shang1 kou3
cues.en: Those who knew understood it was just the hospital preparing to bandage his wound.

cues.zh: 不知道的还以为马上就要把小金
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 hai2 yi3 wei2 ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 ba3 xiao3 jin1
cues.en: Those who didn't know might think Xiao Jin was about to be

cues.zh: 给扔下油锅呢
cues.pinyin: gei3 reng1 xia4 you2 guo1 ne5
cues.en: thrown into a vat of boiling oil.

cues.zh: 萧恩远远地看过去人们越压制小金
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 yuan3 yuan3 di4 kan4 guo4 qu4 ren2 men5 yue4 ya1 zhi4 xiao3 jin1
cues.en: Shaun watched from a distance — the more people restrained Xiao Jin,

cues.zh: 她挣扎的就越厉害她胸有成竹地走过去
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng1 zha2 de5 jiu4 yue4 li4 hai4 ta1 xiong1 you3 cheng2 zhu2 di4 zou3 guo4 qu4
cues.en: the harder she struggled. She walked over confidently,

cues.zh: 对小金的父母表示
cues.pinyin: dui4 xiao3 jin1 de5 fu4 mu3 biao3 shi4
cues.en: and told Xiao Jin's parents,

cues.zh: 你们吓到她了
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 xia4 dao4 ta1 le5
cues.en: You're scaring her.

cues.zh: 果然人群散开了
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 ren2 qun2 san4 kai1 le5
cues.en: Sure enough, the crowd dispersed.

cues.zh: 小金的状态好了很多
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 de5 zhuang4 tai4 hao3 le5 hen3 duo1
cues.en: Xiao Jin's condition improved a lot.

cues.zh: 萧恩顺利的帮她包扎了伤口
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 shun4 li4 de5 bang1 ta1 bao1 za1 le5 shang1 kou3
cues.en: Shaun successfully bandaged her wound.

cues.zh: 萧恩的父母也知道
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 fu4 mu3 ye3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Shaun's parents also knew

cues.zh: 儿子不太对劲
cues.pinyin: er2 zi5 bu4 tai4 dui4 jin4
cues.en: something was off with their son.

cues.zh: 所以一直想赶紧带她回家
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi4 zhi2 xiang3 gan3 jin3 dai4 ta1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: so they kept wanting to hurry and take him home.

cues.zh: 医院的灯光太亮了
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 de5 deng1 guang1 tai4 liang4 le5
cues.en: The hospital lights were too bright.

cues.zh: 小金十分的紧张
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 shi2 fen1 de5 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: Xiao Jin was extremely nervous.

cues.zh: 但是经过萧恩的 X 光的眼睛检查
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jing1 guo4 xiao1 en1 de5 X guang1 de5 yan3 jing1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: But after an examination with Shaun's X-ray-like eyes,

cues.zh: 小金可不仅仅是摔伤这么简单
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 ke3 bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 shuai1 shang1 zhe4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: Xiao Jin's case wasn't as simple as just a fall injury.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 这孩子还有荒胆
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hai2 zi5 hai2 you3 huang1 dan3
cues.en: This child also had jaundice.

cues.zh: 搞不好其他器官也有病变
cues.pinyin: gao3 bu4 hao3 qi2 ta1 qi4 guan1 ye3 you3 bing4 bian4
cues.en: Other organs might also have lesions.

cues.zh: 所以萧恩让她留院观察
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao1 en1 rang4 ta1 liu2 yuan4 guan1 cha2
cues.en: So Shaun had her stay for observation.

cues.zh: 检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The test results came back.

cues.zh: 萧恩的透视眼果然没看错
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 tou4 shi4 yan3 guo3 ran2 mei2 kan4 cuo4
cues.en: Shaun's 'X-ray vision' indeed hadn't been wrong.

cues.zh: 超声波显示
cues.pinyin: chao1 sheng1 bo1 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The ultrasound showed

cues.zh: 小金的胆管肿大
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 de5 dan3 guan3 zhong3 da4
cues.en: Xiao Jin's bile duct was enlarged.

cues.zh: 这种情况比较麻烦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 bi3 jiao4 ma2 fan2
cues.en: This situation was rather tricky.

cues.zh: 轻则是不良饮食导致的
cues.pinyin: qing1 ze2 shi4 bu4 liang2 yin3 shi2 dao3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: At best, it was caused by poor diet.

cues.zh: 重则呢
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ze2 ne5
cues.en: At worst,

cues.zh: 也可能是癌症肿瘤引发的
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 ai2 zheng4 zhong3 liu2 yin3 fa1 de5
cues.en: it could be caused by a cancerous tumor.

cues.zh: 小恩决定给小金做进一步的检查
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 jue2 ding4 gei3 xiao3 jin1 zuo4 jin4 yi2 bu4 de5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Shaun decided to run further tests on Xiao Jin,

cues.zh: 也就是做经内镜逆行性胰胆管造影
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 zuo4 jing1 nei4 jing4 ni4 xing2 xing4 yi2 dan3 guan3 zao4 ying3
cues.en: namely an ERCP (endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography).

cues.zh: 小恩找来小布
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 zhao3 lai2 xiao3 bu4
cues.en: Shaun brought in Xiao Bu,

cues.zh: 两人一起给小金做检查
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 yi4 qi3 gei3 xiao3 jin1 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: and the two of them examined Xiao Jin together.

cues.zh: 检查过程中小金又犯病了
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 xiao3 jin1 you4 fan4 bing4 le5
cues.en: During the exam, Xiao Jin had another episode,

cues.zh: 不断乱动还念叨着
cues.pinyin: bu4 duan4 luan4 dong4 hai2 nian4 dao1 zhe5
cues.en: moving around restlessly and muttering

cues.zh: 32 8 32 8 这几个数字
cues.pinyin: 32 8 32 8 zhe4 ji3 ge4 shu4 zi4
cues.en: the numbers 32, 8, 32, 8.

cues.zh: 小布都有点心动了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 dou1 you3 dian3 xin1 dong4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Bu even got a little excited,

cues.zh: 这孩子是不是有特异功能啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hai2 zi5 shi4 bu2 shi4 you3 te4 yi4 gong1 neng2 a5
cues.en: wondering if this kid had some special ability—

cues.zh: 能看到六合彩的中甲号码啊
cues.pinyin: neng2 kan4 dao4 liu4 he2 cai3 de5 zhong1 jia3 hao4 ma3 a5
cues.en: could he see the winning lottery numbers?

cues.zh: 小恩说你想多了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 shuo1 ni3 xiang3 duo1 le5
cues.en: Shaun said he was overthinking it.

cues.zh: 他就是在说
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 zai4 shuo1
cues.en: Xiao Jin was just saying

cues.zh: 这屋子里有 32 个橱窗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wu1 zi5 li3 you3 32 ge4 chu2 chuang1
cues.en: there were 32 cabinets in the room

cues.zh: 8 个把手
cues.pinyin: 8 ge4 ba3 shou3
cues.en: and 8 handles.

cues.zh: 这观察力有什么了不起的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 guan1 cha2 li4 you3 shen2 me5 liao3 bu4 qi3 de5
cues.en: What's so amazing about that observation?

cues.zh: 好像谁没得过自闭症一样
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiang4 shui2 mei2 de2 guo4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: It's not like no one else has had autism.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 小金勉强配合不动
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 mian3 qiang3 pei4 he2 bu4 dong4
cues.en: Xiao Jin reluctantly cooperated and stayed still.

cues.zh: 可是随着时间越来越长
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 sui2 zhe5 shi2 jian1 yue4 lai2 yue4 zhang3
cues.en: But as time went on,

cues.zh: 小金也越来越害怕
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 ye3 yue4 lai2 yue4 hai4 pa4
cues.en: Xiao Jin grew more and more frightened.

cues.zh: 她已经无法控制自己
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi3 jing1 wu2 fa3 kong4 zhi4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: He could no longer control himself

cues.zh: 开始用头撞机器
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 yong4 tou2 zhuang4 ji1 qi4
cues.en: and started banging his head against the machine.

cues.zh: 检查只好中断
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 zhi3 hao3 zhong1 duan4
cues.en: The exam had to be stopped.

cues.zh: 在病房里小金已经完全无法控制
cues.pinyin: zai4 bing4 fang2 li3 xiao3 jin1 yi3 jing1 wan2 quan2 wu2 fa3 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: In the ward, Xiao Jin had completely lost control of

cues.zh: 自己的情绪了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 de5 qing2 xu4 le5
cues.en: his emotions.

cues.zh: 他崩溃的挣扎要回家
cues.pinyin: ta1 beng1 kui4 de5 zheng1 zha2 yao4 hui2 jia1
cues.en: He broke down, struggling to go home.

cues.zh: 只有萧恩才能让他安静下来
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 xiao1 en1 cai2 neng2 rang4 ta1 an1 jing4 xia4 lai2
cues.en: Only Shaun could calm him down.

cues.zh: 萧恩终于发现了小金的病根
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhong1 yu2 fa1 xian4 le5 xiao3 jin1 de5 bing4 gen1
cues.en: Shaun finally found the root of Xiao Jin's illness:

cues.zh: 那就是免疫系统冲突引起的一系列并发症
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 mian3 yi4 xi4 tong3 chong1 tu1 yin3 qi3 de5 yi1 xi4 lie4 bing4 fa1 zheng4
cues.en: a series of complications caused by an immune system conflict.

cues.zh: 梅医生跟小金的父母说了治疗方案
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 gen1 xiao3 jin1 de5 fu4 mu3 shuo1 le5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: Dr. Mei told Xiao Jin's parents the treatment plan.

cues.zh: 手术虽然有风险
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 sui1 ran2 you3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: Although the surgery carried risks,

cues.zh: 但是他们别无选择
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 bie2 wu2 xuan3 ze2
cues.en: they had no other choice.

cues.zh: 小金的父母同意为儿子做手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 de5 fu4 mu3 tong2 yi4 wei4 er2 zi5 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiao Jin's parents agreed to let their son have the surgery.

cues.zh: 他们也看到了萧恩对儿子所做的一切努力
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 kan4 dao4 le5 xiao1 en1 dui4 er2 zi5 suo3 zuo4 de5 yi1 qie4 nu3 li4
cues.en: They had also seen all the effort Shaun put in for their son,

cues.zh: 他们对萧恩表示了感谢
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dui4 xiao1 en1 biao3 shi4 le5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: so they thanked Shaun,

cues.zh: 然后拒绝了萧恩为儿子做手术
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ju4 jue2 le5 xiao1 en1 wei4 er2 zi5 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: but then refused to let Shaun perform the surgery on their son.

cues.zh: 自逼症最了解自逼症
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi1 zheng4 zui4 liao3 jie3 zi4 bi1 zheng4
cues.en: Someone with autism understands autism best,

cues.zh: 自闭症的父母也同样害怕
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 fu4 mu3 ye3 tong2 yang4 hai4 pa4
cues.en: but parents of an autistic child were equally afraid.

cues.zh: 自闭症最了解自闭症
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi4 zheng4 zui4 liao3 jie3 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: An autistic doctor—

cues.zh: 怎么能给儿子做手术呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 neng2 gei3 er2 zi5 zuo4 shou3 shu4 ne5
cues.en: how could he operate on their son?

cues.zh: 这不是拿命开玩笑吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu2 shi4 na2 ming4 kai1 wan2 xiao4 ma5
cues.en: Wasn't that gambling with his life?

cues.zh: 好在医院的医生们都挺肖恩
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 yi1 yuan4 de5 yi1 sheng1 men5 dou1 ting3 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Luckily, the hospital's doctors all backed Shaun.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 但是很顺利
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: And it went very smoothly.

cues.zh: 小金的父母激动的抱着肖恩
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 de5 fu4 mu3 ji1 dong4 de5 bao4 zhe5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Xiao Jin's parents excitedly hugged Shaun,

cues.zh: 这是发自肺腑的感谢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 fa1 zi4 fei4 fu3 de5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: a thank-you straight from the heart.

cues.zh: 从对身为医生
cues.pinyin: cong2 dui4 shen1 wei4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: From their distrust of Shaun as both a doctor

cues.zh: 也是同为病患的肖恩的不信任
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 tong2 wei4 bing4 huan4 de5 xiao4 en1 de5 bu4 xin4 ren4
cues.en: and a fellow patient,

cues.zh: 到将自己儿子
cues.pinyin: dao4 jiang1 zi4 ji3 er2 zi5
cues.en: to entrusting their own son

cues.zh: 交在他手上的忐忑
cues.pinyin: jiao1 zai4 ta1 shou3 shang4 de5 tan3 te4
cues.en: into his hands with anxious uncertainty,

cues.zh: 再到现在的感谢
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 xian4 zai4 de5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: to now feeling grateful—

cues.zh: 小金的父母的情感
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 de5 fu4 mu3 de5 qing2 gan3
cues.en: Xiao Jin's parents' emotions

cues.zh: 几乎大起大落
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 da4 qi3 da4 luo4
cues.en: went through a huge rollercoaster,

cues.zh: 一时有点难以自知了
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 you3 dian3 nan2 yi3 zi4 zhi1 le5
cues.en: and for a moment they could hardly hold themselves together.

cues.zh: 肖恩说其实不用谢他
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 shuo1 qi2 shi2 bu4 yong4 xie4 ta1
cues.en: Shaun said there was really no need to thank him.

cues.zh: 小金能活下来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 neng2 huo2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: The reason Xiao Jin survived

cues.zh: 全靠父母对他不抛弃
cues.pinyin: quan2 kao4 fu4 mu3 dui4 ta1 bu4 pao1 qi4
cues.en: was entirely because his parents never abandoned him

cues.zh: 不放弃
cues.pinyin: bu4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: and never gave up.

cues.zh: 是你们救了你们的儿子
cues.pinyin: shi4 ni3 men5 jiu4 le5 ni3 men5 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: You are the ones who saved your son.

cues.zh: 小金苏醒过来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 su1 xing3 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Xiao Jin woke up.

cues.zh: 他的状态很好
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhuang4 tai4 hen3 hao3
cues.en: He was in good condition,

cues.zh: 比起刚入院的时候
cues.pinyin: bi3 qi3 gang1 ru4 yuan4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: compared to when he was first admitted,

cues.zh: 镇定了不少
cues.pinyin: zhen4 ding4 le5 bu4 shao3
cues.en: he was much calmer.

cues.zh: 连灯光也不害怕了
cues.pinyin: lian2 deng1 guang1 ye3 bu4 hai4 pa4 le5
cues.en: He wasn't even afraid of the lights anymore.

cues.zh: 或许自闭症呢
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 ne5
cues.en: Maybe autism,

cues.zh: 本来也没有那么可怕
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 ye3 mei2 you3 na4 me5 ke3 pa4
cues.en: wasn't really that scary after all.

cues.zh: 这些来自星星的孩子终究有回到
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 lai2 zi4 xing1 xing1 de5 hai2 zi5 zhong1 jiu1 you3 hui2 dao4
cues.en: These children from the stars will eventually

cues.zh: 人间的一天啊
cues.pinyin: ren2 jian1 de5 yi1 tian1 a5
cues.en: have their day of returning to the human world.

cues.zh: 急诊科送来了一个白发老人
cues.pinyin: ji2 zhen3 ke1 song4 lai2 le5 yi2 ge4 bai2 fa4 lao3 ren2
cues.en: The ER brought in a white-haired old man.

cues.zh: 他的心脏起搏器坏了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 zang4 qi3 bo2 qi4 huai4 le5
cues.en: His pacemaker was broken.

cues.zh: 心脏附近的几条血管都堵塞了
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 fu4 jin4 de5 ji3 tiao2 xue4 guan3 dou1 du3 se4 le5
cues.en: Several blood vessels near his heart were blocked.

cues.zh: 心脏几乎都不能泵血了
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 ji1 hu1 dou1 bu4 neng2 beng4 xue4 le5
cues.en: His heart could barely pump blood anymore.

cues.zh: 梅医生诊断他是心脏衰竭末期
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zhen3 duan4 ta1 shi4 xin1 zang4 shuai1 jie2 mo4 qi1
cues.en: Dr. Mei diagnosed him with end-stage heart failure.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 而且心脏也是无法修复的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 xin1 zang4 ye3 shi4 wu2 fa3 xiu1 fu4 de5
cues.en: and his heart could not be repaired.

cues.zh: 老人已经 73 岁了
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 yi3 jing1 73 sui4 le5
cues.en: The old man was already 73.

cues.zh: 不具备换心术的条件
cues.pinyin: bu4 ju4 bei4 huan4 xin1 shu4 de5 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: He didn't meet the conditions for a heart transplant.

cues.zh: 连肖恩都说这老头就要死了
cues.pinyin: lian2 xiao4 en1 dou1 shuo1 zhe4 lao3 tou2 jiu4 yao4 si3 le5
cues.en: Even Shaun said the old man was going to die.

cues.zh: 可是卡鲁不想放弃
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ka3 lu3 bu4 xiang3 fang4 qi4
cues.en: But Dr. Kalu didn't want to give up.

cues.zh: 他建议给老人用心脏同步治疗
cues.pinyin: ta1 jian4 yi4 gei3 lao3 ren2 yong4 xin1 zang4 tong2 bu4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: He suggested cardiac resynchronization therapy for the old man,

cues.zh: 用双心式起搏器
cues.pinyin: yong4 shuang1 xin1 shi4 qi3 bo2 qi4
cues.en: using a biventricular pacemaker.

cues.zh: 虽然不能治愈他的病
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu4 neng2 zhi4 yu4 ta1 de5 bing4
cues.en: Although it couldn't cure his disease,

cues.zh: 但是最起码能在他剩下的几个月生命里
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zui4 qi3 ma3 neng2 zai4 ta1 sheng4 xia4 de5 ji3 ge4 yue4 sheng1 ming4 li3
cues.en: at least in the remaining months of his life,

cues.zh: 过得更舒服一点
cues.pinyin: guo4 de2 geng4 shu1 fu2 yi4 dian3
cues.en: he could live a bit more comfortably.

cues.zh: 就在医生们讨论治疗方案的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 yi1 sheng1 men5 tao3 lun4 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Just as the doctors were discussing the treatment plan,

cues.zh: 老人的监护仪器再次报警
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 de5 jian1 hu4 yi2 qi4 zai4 ci4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: the old man's monitor alarmed again.

cues.zh: 这心脏真是已经烂糟到
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xin1 zang4 zhen1 shi4 yi3 jing1 lan4 zao1 dao4
cues.en: His heart had really deteriorated to the point

cues.zh: 随时随地都有罢工的可能了
cues.pinyin: sui2 shi2 sui2 di4 dou1 you3 ba4 gong1 de5 ke3 neng2 le5
cues.en: it could give out at any moment.

cues.zh: 每医生让小布切开静脉放置起搏器
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 sheng1 rang4 xiao3 bu4 qie4 kai1 jing4 mai4 fang4 zhi4 qi3 bo2 qi4
cues.en: Dr. Mei had Xiao Bu cut open a vein to place the pacemaker,

cues.zh: 但小布拿着刀的手有些哆嗦
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 bu4 na2 zhe5 dao1 de5 shou3 you3 xie1 duo1 suo5
cues.en: but Xiao Bu's hand holding the scalpel trembled a bit.

cues.zh: 他还沉浸在之前插管插死病患的
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 chen2 jin4 zai4 zhi1 qian2 cha1 guan3 cha1 si3 bing4 huan4 de5
cues.en: He was still shaken from an earlier incident where he'd accidentally killed a patient while inserting a tube,

cues.zh: 医疗事故的余韵当中
cues.pinyin: yi1 liao2 shi4 gu4 de5 yu2 yun4 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: still haunted by that medical accident,

cues.zh: 无法自拔
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 zi4 ba2
cues.en: unable to shake it off.

cues.zh: 好在他是一个专业的医生
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhuan1 ye4 de5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Luckily, he was a professional doctor,

cues.zh: 很快就调整好情绪进入状态
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 jiu4 tiao2 zheng3 hao3 qing2 xu4 jin4 ru4 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: and quickly steadied his emotions and got into the zone.

cues.zh: 老人从昏迷中醒来
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 cong2 hun1 mi2 zhong1 xing3 lai2
cues.en: The old man woke up from unconsciousness.

cues.zh: 第一反应不是感谢上苍我还活着
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 fan3 ying4 bu2 shi4 gan3 xie4 shang4 cang1 wo3 hai2 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: His first reaction wasn't to thank heaven for still being alive,

cues.zh: 而是很生气的问卡鲁医生
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 hen3 sheng1 qi4 de5 wen4 ka3 lu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: but to angrily ask Dr. Kalu something.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 自闭症患者无法使用高科技仪器，天才医生们集体犯难，这集肖恩大显身手！

cues.zh: 卡路打算赶紧把老人扛上楼
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu4 da3 suan4 gan3 jin3 ba3 lao3 ren2 kang2 shang4 lou2
cues.en: Dr. Kalu planned to quickly take the old man upstairs

cues.zh: 换一个新的起泊器
cues.pinyin: huan4 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 qi3 po1 qi4
cues.en: to replace the pacemaker with a new one,

cues.zh: 要不然他就随时有性命之忧
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 ta1 jiu4 sui2 shi2 you3 xing4 ming4 zhi1 you1
cues.en: otherwise his life would be in danger at any moment.

cues.zh: 但是老人拒绝了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 lao3 ren2 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: But the old man refused.

cues.zh: 他承认起波器就是自己弄坏的
cues.pinyin: ta1 cheng2 ren4 qi3 bo1 qi4 jiu4 shi4 zi4 ji3 nong4 huai4 de5
cues.en: He admitted he had broken the pacemaker himself.

cues.zh: 他就是想死啊
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 xiang3 si3 a5
cues.en: He simply wanted to die.

cues.zh: 老人知道自己的病情
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: The old man knew his condition—

cues.zh: 无论安装什么都只是勉强让他多活几天
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 an1 zhuang1 shen2 me5 dou1 zhi3 shi4 mian3 qiang3 rang4 ta1 duo1 huo2 ji3 tian1
cues.en: no matter what device was installed, it would only barely keep him alive a few more days,

cues.zh: 根本无法根治
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 gen1 zhi4
cues.en: it could never cure him.

cues.zh: 等死的过程比死亡本身更加痛苦
cues.pinyin: deng3 si3 de5 guo4 cheng2 bi3 si3 wang2 ben3 shen1 geng4 jia1 tong4 ku3
cues.en: Waiting to die was more painful than death itself,

cues.zh: 所以还不如来个干脆的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 huan2 bu4 ru2 lai2 ge4 gan1 cui4 de5
cues.en: so he'd rather just end it quickly.

cues.zh: 卡鲁希望他能跟亲人谈谈
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu3 xi1 wang4 ta1 neng2 gen1 qin1 ren2 tan2 tan2
cues.en: Dr. Kalu hoped he could talk to his family,

cues.zh: 也许就能找到一些求生的意志
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 jiu4 neng2 zhao3 dao4 yi1 xie1 qiu2 sheng1 de5 yi4 zhi4
cues.en: hoping he might find some will to live.

cues.zh: 可是老人说自己兄弟死了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lao3 ren2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 xiong1 di4 si3 le5
cues.en: But the old man said his brother had died,

cues.zh: 也没有妻子
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 you3 qi1 zi3
cues.en: and he had no wife.

cues.zh: 标准的孤家寡人
cues.pinyin: biao1 zhun3 de5 gu1 jia1 gua3 ren2
cues.en: A textbook case of being all alone.

cues.zh: 卡鲁说这边有专业的心理咨询师
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu3 shuo1 zhe4 bian1 you3 zhuan1 ye4 de5 xin1 li3 zi1 xun2 shi1
cues.en: Dr. Kalu said there were professional counselors here,

cues.zh: 或许可以给老人做一下话聊
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 ke3 yi3 gei3 lao3 ren2 zuo4 yi1 xia4 hua4 liao2
cues.en: who could maybe talk with the old man,

cues.zh: 嗯谈话治疗
cues.pinyin: n2 tan2 hua4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: um, talk therapy.

cues.zh: 可是老人依然拒绝
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lao3 ren2 yi1 ran2 ju4 jue2
cues.en: But the old man still refused.

cues.zh: 卡鲁索性在他旁边坐下了
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu3 suo3 xing4 zai4 ta1 pang2 bian1 zuo4 xia4 le5
cues.en: So Dr. Kalu just sat down next to him.

cues.zh: 他在默默等待
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 mo4 mo4 deng3 dai4
cues.en: He waited silently.

cues.zh: 老人好奇问他等啥呢
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 hao4 qi2 wen4 ta1 deng3 sha2 ne5
cues.en: The old man curiously asked what he was waiting for.

cues.zh: 卡鲁说等你晕倒啊
cues.pinyin: ka3 lu3 shuo1 deng3 ni3 yun1 dao3 a5
cues.en: Dr. Kalu said, 'Waiting for you to pass out—

cues.zh: 在你死之前
cues.pinyin: zai4 ni3 si3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: before you die.'

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 你知道世界上最贵的汽车是多少钱吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 gui4 de5 qi4 che1 shi4 duo1 shao3 qian2 ma5
cues.en: Do you know how much the most expensive car in the world costs?

cues.zh: 是 19 07 年生产的劳斯莱斯银魅
cues.pinyin: shi4 19 07 nian2 sheng1 chan3 de5 lao2 si1 lai2 si1 yin2 mei4
cues.en: It's the Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost, produced in 1907.

cues.zh: 一共生产了 7 87 4 辆
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 sheng1 chan3 le5 7 87 4 liang4
cues.en: A total of 7,874 were produced.

cues.zh: 据估计现在一辆银魅的收藏价值已
cues.pinyin: ju4 gu1 ji4 xian4 zai4 yi1 liang4 yin2 mei4 de5 shou1 cang2 jia4 zhi2 yi3
cues.en: It's estimated that a Silver Ghost's collector value has already

cues.zh: 经超过了 15 亿
cues.pinyin: jing1 chao1 guo4 le5 15 yi4
cues.en: exceeded 1.5 billion.

cues.zh: 银魅生产于 100 多年前
cues.pinyin: yin2 mei4 sheng1 chan3 yu2 100 duo1 nian2 qian2
cues.en: The Silver Ghost was made over 100 years ago.

cues.zh: 它搭载了 7 升排量的发动机
cues.pinyin: ta1 da1 zai4 le5 7 sheng1 pai2 liang4 de5 fa1 dong4 ji1
cues.en: It had a 7-liter displacement engine.

cues.zh: 看起来动力很强大吧
cues.pinyin: kan4 qi3 lai2 dong4 li4 hen3 qiang2 da4 ba5
cues.en: Sounds powerful, right?

cues.zh: 但实际上它的输出功率只有 36 千瓦
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi2 ji4 shang4 ta1 de5 shu1 chu1 gong1 lv4 zhi3 you3 36 qian1 wa3
cues.en: But actually its output power was only 36 kilowatts.

cues.zh: 现在我们的家用汽车排量不到银
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 jia1 yong4 qi4 che1 pai2 liang4 bu2 dao4 yin2
cues.en: Nowadays our family cars have less than

cues.zh: 魅的四分之一
cues.pinyin: mei4 de5 si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: a quarter of the Silver Ghost's displacement.

cues.zh: 但是输出功率却是银魅的三倍多
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shu1 chu1 gong1 lv4 que4 shi4 yin2 mei4 de5 san1 bei4 duo1
cues.en: But their output power is more than three times that of the Silver Ghost.

cues.zh: 你知道这是为什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know why?

cues.zh: 在汽车行业里有很多专业术语
cues.pinyin: zai4 qi4 che1 hang2 ye4 li3 you3 hen3 duo1 zhuan1 ye4 shu4 yu3
cues.en: There are many technical terms in the auto industry.

cues.zh: 比如说气缸数排量扭矩功率
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 qi4 gang1 shu4 pai2 liang4 niu3 ju3 gong1 lv4
cues.en: Like number of cylinders, displacement, torque, power.

cues.zh: 这些到底是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What do these actually mean?

cues.zh: 有些汽车采用了涡轮增压发动机
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 qi4 che1 cai3 yong4 le5 wo1 lun2 zeng1 ya1 fa1 dong4 ji1
cues.en: Some cars use turbocharged engines.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 这又有什么好处呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you4 you3 shen2 me5 hao3 chu4 ne5
cues.en: What are the benefits of that?

cues.zh: 为什么混动汽车比普通的燃油车更省油呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hun4 dong4 qi4 che1 bi3 pu3 tong1 de5 ran2 you2 che1 geng4 sheng3 you2 ne5
cues.en: Why are hybrid cars more fuel-efficient than regular gas cars?

cues.zh: 我想即使你是一个 20 年的老司机
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 ji2 shi3 ni3 shi4 yi2 ge4 20 nian2 de5 lao3 si1 ji1
cues.en: I bet even if you're a driver with 20 years of experience,

cues.zh: 以上的问题也不见得都能说得清楚
cues.pinyin: yi3 shang4 de5 wen4 ti2 ye3 bu2 jian4 de5 dou1 neng2 shuo1 de2 qing1 chu3
cues.en: you might not be able to clearly answer all these questions.

cues.zh: 花点时间看完这个小视频你就都知道了
cues.pinyin: hua1 dian3 shi2 jian1 kan4 wan2 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 shi4 pin2 ni3 jiu4 dou1 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Spend a little time watching this video and you'll understand it all.

cues.zh: 准备好了吗我们发车吧
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 hao3 le5 ma5 wo3 men5 fa1 che1 ba5
cues.en: Ready? Let's get going.

cues.zh: 先说说燃油发动机的气缸吧
cues.pinyin: xian1 shuo1 shuo1 ran2 you2 fa1 dong4 ji1 de5 qi4 gang1 ba5
cues.en: Let's first talk about the cylinders of a fuel engine.

cues.zh: 燃油发动机里有一个容纳油气混合物的腔
cues.pinyin: ran2 you2 fa1 dong4 ji1 li3 you3 yi2 ge4 rong2 na4 you2 qi4 hun4 he2 wu4 de5 qiang1
cues.en: Inside a fuel engine there's a chamber that holds the fuel-air mixture,

cues.zh: 叫做气缸
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 qi4 gang1
cues.en: called the cylinder.

cues.zh: 汽油就是在气缸里燃烧的
cues.pinyin: qi4 you2 jiu4 shi4 zai4 qi4 gang1 li3 ran2 shao1 de5
cues.en: Gasoline burns inside the cylinder.

cues.zh: 气缸的上方有一个进气口和一个排气口
cues.pinyin: qi4 gang1 de5 shang4 fang1 you3 yi2 ge4 jin4 qi4 kou3 he2 yi2 ge4 pai2 qi4 kou3
cues.en: At the top of the cylinder there's an intake port and an exhaust port.

cues.zh: 下方有活塞
cues.pinyin: xia4 fang1 you3 huo2 sai1
cues.en: Below is the piston.

cues.zh: 活塞下面连着连杆和曲轴
cues.pinyin: huo2 sai1 xia4 mian4 lian2 zhe5 lian2 gan3 he2 qu1 zhou2
cues.en: Under the piston are the connecting rod and crankshaft.

cues.zh: 发动机的工作可以分为四个阶段
cues.pinyin: fa1 dong4 ji1 de5 gong1 zuo4 ke3 yi3 fen1 wei2 si4 ge4 jie1 duan4
cues.en: The engine's operation can be divided into four stages.

cues.zh: 首先是吸气进气口打开活塞向下运动
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 shi4 xi1 qi4 jin4 qi4 kou3 da3 kai1 huo2 sai1 xiang4 xia4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: First is intake: the intake port opens and the piston moves down,

cues.zh: 把油气混合物吸进气缸里
cues.pinyin: ba3 you2 qi4 hun4 he2 wu4 xi1 jin4 qi4 gang1 li3
cues.en: drawing the fuel-air mixture into the cylinder.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 只有半圈会获得动力
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 ban4 quan1 hui4 huo4 de2 dong4 li4
cues.en: Only half a revolution produces power.

cues.zh: 汽车的运行不够平稳
cues.pinyin: qi4 che1 de5 yun4 xing2 bu4 gou4 ping2 wen3
cues.en: The car wouldn't run smoothly.

cues.zh: 动力也不够强
cues.pinyin: dong4 li4 ye3 bu4 gou4 qiang2
cues.en: and the power wouldn't be strong enough.

cues.zh: 所以我们可以用四个气缸
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 si4 ge4 qi4 gang1
cues.en: So we can use four cylinders

cues.zh: 让它们交替运行
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 men5 jiao1 ti4 yun4 xing2
cues.en: and have them run alternately,

cues.zh: 轮流做工
cues.pinyin: lun2 liu2 zuo4 gong1
cues.en: taking turns doing work.

cues.zh: 这时整个发动机的动力输出
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 zheng3 ge4 fa1 dong4 ji1 de5 dong4 li4 shu1 chu1
cues.en: This way the engine's overall power output

cues.zh: 就又大又平稳了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 you4 da4 you4 ping2 wen3 le5
cues.en: becomes both strong and smooth.

cues.zh: 当然了如果你有钱
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 le5 ru2 guo3 ni3 you3 qian2
cues.en: Of course, if you have the money,

cues.zh: 还可以买 6 缸或者 8 缸的发动机
cues.pinyin: hai2 ke3 yi3 mai3 6 gang1 huo4 zhe3 8 gang1 de5 fa1 dong4 ji1
cues.en: you could also buy a 6- or 8-cylinder engine.

cues.zh: 一些豪华车比如说阿斯顿马丁
cues.pinyin: yi1 xie1 hao2 hua2 che1 bi3 ru2 shuo1 a1 si1 dun4 ma3 ding1
cues.en: Some luxury cars, like Aston Martin,

cues.zh: 还有 12 缸的发动机
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 12 gang1 de5 fa1 dong4 ji1
cues.en: even have 12-cylinder engines.

cues.zh: 气缸越多排量越大
cues.pinyin: qi4 gang1 yue4 duo1 pai2 liang4 yue4 da4
cues.en: The more cylinders, the greater the displacement,

cues.zh: 一般来讲动力也就越强劲
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 lai2 jiang3 dong4 li4 ye3 jiu4 yue4 qiang2 jing4
cues.en: and generally the more powerful it is,

cues.zh: 油耗也会越多
cues.pinyin: you2 hao4 ye3 hui4 yue4 duo1
cues.en: though fuel consumption also increases.

cues.zh: 谈到汽车的动力一般有两个指标
cues.pinyin: tan2 dao4 qi4 che1 de5 dong4 li4 yi4 ban1 you3 liang3 ge4 zhi3 biao1
cues.en: When it comes to a car's power, there are usually two metrics:

cues.zh: 功率和扭矩
cues.pinyin: gong1 lv4 he2 niu3 ju3
cues.en: power and torque.

cues.zh: 买车的时候销售一般都会给我们介绍
cues.pinyin: mai3 che1 de5 shi2 hou4 xiao1 shou4 yi4 ban1 du1 hui4 gei3 wo3 men5 jie4 shao4
cues.en: When buying a car, the salesperson usually tells us

cues.zh: 这个车的最大功率是多少多少
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 che1 de5 zui4 da4 gong1 lv4 shi4 duo1 shao3 duo1 shao3
cues.en: what the car's maximum power is,

cues.zh: 峰值扭矩又是多少多少
cues.pinyin: feng1 zhi2 niu3 ju3 you4 shi4 duo1 shao3 duo1 shao3
cues.en: and what its peak torque is.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 那么功率又是啥意思呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 gong1 lv4 you4 shi4 sha2 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: So what does power actually mean?

cues.zh: 功率代表了发动机做工的快慢
cues.pinyin: gong1 lv4 dai4 biao3 le5 fa1 dong4 ji1 zuo4 gong1 de5 kuai4 man4
cues.en: Power represents how fast the engine does work.

cues.zh: 初中物理学过一个公式
cues.pinyin: chu1 zhong1 wu4 li3 xue2 guo4 yi2 ge4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: We learned a formula in middle school physics:

cues.zh: 功率等于驱动力乘以速度
cues.pinyin: gong1 lv4 deng3 yu2 qu1 dong4 li4 cheng2 yi3 su4 du4
cues.en: power equals driving force times velocity.

cues.zh: 对于同样的驱动力
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 tong2 yang4 de5 qu1 dong4 li4
cues.en: For the same driving force,

cues.zh: 最大功率越大
cues.pinyin: zui4 da4 gong1 lv4 yue4 da4
cues.en: the greater the maximum power,

cues.zh: 就意味着能够达到的最大速度越大
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 neng2 gou4 da2 dao4 de5 zui4 da4 su4 du4 yue4 da4
cues.en: the greater the maximum speed it can reach.

cues.zh: 所以我们通常说最大功率决定了汽
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 tong1 chang2 shuo1 zui4 da4 gong1 lv4 jue2 ding4 le5 qi4
cues.en: So we usually say maximum power determines

cues.zh: 车的最高时速
cues.pinyin: che1 de5 zui4 gao1 shi2 su4
cues.en: the car's top speed.

cues.zh: 总结一下笼统来讲
cues.pinyin: zong3 jie2 yi1 xia4 long3 tong3 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: To sum up, broadly speaking,

cues.zh: 扭矩决定了汽车的顺时加速能力
cues.pinyin: niu3 ju3 jue2 ding4 le5 qi4 che1 de5 shun4 shi2 jia1 su4 neng2 li4
cues.en: torque determines a car's instantaneous acceleration ability.

cues.zh: 而功率决定了汽车的最高时速
cues.pinyin: er2 gong1 lv4 jue2 ding4 le5 qi4 che1 de5 zui4 gao1 shi2 su4
cues.en: while power determines the car's top speed.

cues.zh: 但实际上扭矩和功率之间是有关系的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi2 ji4 shang4 niu3 ju3 he2 gong1 lv4 zhi1 jian1 shi4 you3 guan1 xi4 de5
cues.en: But actually torque and power are related.

cues.zh: 汽车的功率就等于发动机的转速乘以扭矩
cues.pinyin: qi4 che1 de5 gong1 lv4 jiu4 deng3 yu2 fa1 dong4 ji1 de5 zhuan4 su4 cheng2 yi3 niu3 ju3
cues.en: A car's power equals the engine's RPM times torque.

cues.zh: 转速就是发动机曲轴在一分钟内转的圈数
cues.pinyin: zhuan4 su4 jiu4 shi4 fa1 dong4 ji1 qu1 zhou2 zai4 yi4 fen1 zhong1 nei4 zhuan3 de5 quan1 shu4
cues.en: RPM is the number of revolutions the crankshaft makes per minute.

cues.zh: 也就是说功率一定的时候
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 gong1 lv4 yi2 ding4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: That is, when power is fixed,

cues.zh: 如果发动机在低速转动
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 fa1 dong4 ji1 zai4 di1 su4 zhuan3 dong4
cues.en: if the engine is running at low speed,

cues.zh: 那么扭矩就比较大
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 niu3 ju3 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 da4
cues.en: then the torque is relatively large,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 而高速转动的时候扭矩就会比较小
cues.pinyin: er2 gao1 su4 zhuan3 dong4 de5 shi2 hou4 niu3 ju3 jiu4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 xiao3
cues.en: and when running at high speed, torque will be relatively small.

cues.zh: 在功率一定的情况下
cues.pinyin: zai4 gong1 lv4 yi2 ding4 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: With power held constant,

cues.zh: 有些车需要降低转速增大扭矩
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 che1 xu1 yao4 jiang4 di1 zhuan4 su4 zeng1 da4 niu3 ju3
cues.en: some vehicles need to lower RPM and increase torque.

cues.zh: 比如拖拉机负载比较重
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 tuo1 la1 ji1 fu4 zai4 bi3 jiao4 zhong4
cues.en: For example, a tractor carries a heavy load

cues.zh: 但是对速度要求没有那么高
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 su4 du4 yao1 qiu2 mei2 you3 na4 me5 gao1
cues.en: but doesn't require high speed,

cues.zh: 所以会调到低转速大扭矩的状态
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hui4 diao4 dao4 di1 zhuan4 su4 da4 niu3 ju3 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: so it's tuned to a low-RPM, high-torque state.

cues.zh: 而轻型的小汽车高速运行的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 qing1 xing2 de5 xiao3 qi4 che1 gao1 su4 yun4 xing2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Whereas light cars running at high speed

cues.zh: 一般都处于高转速低扭矩的状态
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 dou1 chu3 yu2 gao1 zhuan4 su4 di1 niu3 ju3 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: are generally in a high-RPM, low-torque state,

cues.zh: 跑起来比较轻快
cues.pinyin: pao3 qi3 lai2 bi3 jiao4 qing1 kuai4
cues.en: which makes them run more nimbly.

cues.zh: 说到这儿我们讲了汽车发动机
cues.pinyin: shuo1 dao4 zhe4 er2 wo3 men5 jiang3 le5 qi4 che1 fa1 dong4 ji1
cues.en: At this point, we've covered the car engine's

cues.zh: 的气缸和排量
cues.pinyin: de5 qi4 gang1 he2 pai2 liang4
cues.en: cylinders and displacement.

cues.zh: 一般来讲排量越大汽车动力越强
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 lai2 jiang3 pai2 liang4 yue4 da4 qi4 che1 dong4 li4 yue4 qiang2
cues.en: Generally, the greater the displacement, the stronger the power,

cues.zh: 消耗的燃油越多
cues.pinyin: xiao1 hao4 de5 ran2 you2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: and the more fuel it consumes.

cues.zh: 而汽车的动力又可以用功率和扭矩来衡量
cues.pinyin: er2 qi4 che1 de5 dong4 li4 you4 ke3 yi3 yong4 gong1 lv4 he2 niu3 ju3 lai2 heng2 liang2
cues.en: A car's power can in turn be measured by power and torque.

cues.zh: 功率代表汽车最高时速
cues.pinyin: gong1 lv4 dai4 biao3 qi4 che1 zui4 gao1 shi2 su4
cues.en: Power represents the car's top speed,

cues.zh: 扭矩代表顺时加速性
cues.pinyin: niu3 ju3 dai4 biao3 shun4 shi2 jia1 su4 xing4
cues.en: torque represents instantaneous acceleration.

cues.zh: 下次去 4 S 店选车的时候
cues.pinyin: xia4 ci4 qu4 4 S dian4 xuan3 che1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Next time you go to a dealership to pick a car,

cues.zh: 是不是会显得更专业了
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 hui4 xian3 de5 geng4 zhuan1 ye4 le5
cues.en: won't you seem more knowledgeable?

cues.zh: 那么是不是排量越大的汽车
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shi4 bu2 shi4 pai2 liang4 yue4 da4 de5 qi4 che1
cues.en: So does that mean the bigger a car's displacement,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】增程式汽车真的省油吗？气缸排量、扭矩功率、涡轮增压都是啥意思？

cues.zh: 然后再吸进气缸燃烧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 xi1 jin4 qi4 gang1 ran2 shao1
cues.en: and then it's drawn into the cylinder to burn.

cues.zh: 而汽车在地面上跑空气充足
cues.pinyin: er2 qi4 che1 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 pao3 kong1 qi4 chong1 zu2
cues.en: And since a car runs on the ground where air is abundant,

cues.zh: 采用自然吸气依靠大气压
cues.pinyin: cai3 yong4 zi4 ran2 xi1 qi4 yi1 kao4 da4 qi4 ya1
cues.en: using natural intake relies on atmospheric pressure

cues.zh: 把油气混合物压进气缸就够了
cues.pinyin: ba3 you2 qi4 hun4 he2 wu4 ya1 jin4 qi4 gang1 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: to push the fuel-air mixture into the cylinder, which is enough.

cues.zh: 可是这种方式的弊端在于进入气
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 de5 bi4 duan1 zai4 yu2 jin4 ru4 qi4
cues.en: But the drawback of this method is that the air entering the

cues.zh: 缸的空气有限
cues.pinyin: gang1 de5 kong1 qi4 you3 xian4
cues.en: cylinder is limited.

cues.zh: 而燃烧后排出的气体温度依然很高
cues.pinyin: er2 ran2 shao1 hou4 pai2 chu1 de5 qi4 ti3 wen1 du4 yi1 ran2 hen3 gao1
cues.en: And the exhaust gas after combustion is still at a high temperature,

cues.zh: 就当作废气排出了浪费了很多能量
cues.pinyin: jiu4 dang4 zuo4 fei4 qi4 pai2 chu1 le5 lang4 fei4 le5 hen3 duo1 neng2 liang4
cues.en: it's just vented as waste, wasting a lot of energy.

cues.zh: 于是人们想了一个办法
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ren2 men5 xiang3 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 fa3
cues.en: So people came up with a solution:

cues.zh: 让从排气口出来的高温废气进入一个涡轮
cues.pinyin: rang4 cong2 pai2 qi4 kou3 chu1 lai2 de5 gao1 wen1 fei4 qi4 jin4 ru4 yi2 ge4 wo1 lun2
cues.en: let the high-temperature exhaust gas from the exhaust port enter a turbine,

cues.zh: 依靠废气的力量推动主动涡轮叶片
cues.pinyin: yi1 kao4 fei4 qi4 de5 li4 liang4 tui1 dong4 zhu3 dong4 wo1 lun2 ye4 pian4
cues.en: using the force of the exhaust gas to drive the driving turbine blades,

cues.zh: 然后再把废气排出
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ba3 fei4 qi4 pai2 chu1
cues.en: and then vent the exhaust gas.

cues.zh: 相当于把废气的一部分能量交还给涡轮了
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dang1 yu2 ba3 fei4 qi4 de5 yi1 bu4 fen4 neng2 liang4 jiao1 huan2 gei3 wo1 lun2 le5
cues.en: This is equivalent to returning part of the exhaust gas's energy to the turbine.

cues.zh: 主动涡轮叶片转动之后

cues.zh: 让整体的空间看上去更通透一些
cues.pinyin: rang4 zheng3 ti3 de5 kong1 jian1 kan4 shang4 qu4 geng4 tong1 tou4 yi1 xie1
cues.en: It makes the whole space feel more open.

cues.zh: 木地板也重新都换过了
cues.pinyin: mu4 di4 ban3 ye3 chong2 xin1 dou1 huan4 guo4 le5
cues.en: The wood flooring was also completely replaced.

cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 lao3 fang2 zi5 li3 mian4 fang4 yi1 xie1 you3 nian2 dai4 gan3 de5 jia1 ju4

cues.zh: 都是选择木制的

cues.zh: 可能它的气质更符合
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 ta1 de5 qi4 zhi4 geng4 fu2 he2
cues.en: Maybe their character suits it better.

cues.pinyin: yi2 ban4 shi2 jian1 hui4 dai4 zai4 fang2 zi5 li3 mian4
cues.en: I spend about half my time at home.

cues.pinyin: ban1 lai2 zhe4 li3 zhi1 hou4 wo3 bu4 xing2 shi2 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 dao4 gong1 si1

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是朗道-西格尔零点猜想？传奇数学家张益唐的又一突破！

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 在上一回我们讲了让张益唐教授
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 yi1 hui2 wo3 men5 jiang3 le5 rang4 zhang1 yi4 tang2 jiao4 shou4

cues.pinyin: yi1 ju3 cheng2 ming2 de5 luan2 sheng1 su4 shu4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: who became famous overnight for the twin prime conjecture.

cues.zh: 张益唐并没有证明或者证伪孪生素数猜想
cues.pinyin: zhang1 yi4 tang2 bing4 mei2 you3 zheng4 ming2 huo4 zhe3 zheng4 wei3 luan2 sheng1 su4 shu4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: Zhang Yitang didn't actually prove or disprove the twin prime conjecture,

cues.zh: 但是他为这个问题的解决开辟了一条道路
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 de5 jie3 jue2 kai1 pi4 le5 yi1 tiao2 dao4 lu4
cues.en: but he opened up a path toward solving the problem.

cues.zh: 没看过的小伙伴可以点进我的
cues.pinyin: mei2 kan4 guo4 de5 xiao3 huo3 ban4 ke3 yi3 dian3 jin4 wo3 de5
cues.en: If you haven't seen that video, you can click into my

cues.zh: 主页了解一下
cues.pinyin: zhu3 ye4 liao3 jie3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: channel homepage to check it out.

cues.pinyin: zai4 20 22 nian2 11 yue4 7 ri4
cues.en: On November 7, 2022,

cues.zh: 张益唐教授再次震惊了数学圈
cues.pinyin: zhang1 yi4 tang2 jiao4 shou4 zai4 ci4 zhen4 jing1 le5 shu4 xue2 quan1
cues.en: Professor Zhang Yitang shocked the math world once again

cues.zh: 用一篇 11 1 页的论文
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi1 pian1 11 1 ye4 de5 lun4 wen2
cues.en: with a 111-page paper

cues.zh: 阐述了自己对于朗道西格尔零点问
cues.pinyin: chan3 shu4 le5 zi4 ji3 dui4 yu2 lang3 dao4 xi1 ge2 er3 ling2 dian3 wen4
cues.en: laying out his research results on the Landau-Siegel zero

cues.zh: 题的研究成果
cues.pinyin: ti2 de5 yan2 jiu1 cheng2 guo3
cues.en: problem.

cues.zh: 而这个问题和黎曼猜想又有着密切的联系
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 he2 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 you4 you3 zhe5 mi4 qie4 de5 lian2 xi4
cues.en: And this problem is closely connected to the Riemann Hypothesis.

cues.zh: 许多小朋友给我发来私信说
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4 shuo1
cues.en: Many viewers sent me private messages asking,

cues.zh: 这个朗道西格尔零点问题到底是什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lang3 dao4 xi1 ge2 er3 ling2 dian3 wen4 ti2 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: "What exactly is this Landau-Siegel zero problem?"

cues.zh: 张益唐到底有没有解决这个问题呢
cues.pinyin: zhang1 yi4 tang2 dao4 di3 you3 mei2 you3 jie3 jue2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: "Did Zhang Yitang actually solve this problem?"

cues.zh: 如果张益唐的论文是对的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhang1 yi4 tang2 de5 lun4 wen2 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: "If Zhang Yitang's paper is correct,

cues.zh: 那么它是否已经证明了黎曼猜想呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 shi4 fou3 yi3 jing1 zheng4 ming2 liao3 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 ne5
cues.en: has he already proven the Riemann Hypothesis?"

cues.zh: 今天我们就想来介绍一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 xiang3 lai2 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today we want to introduce this problem.

cues.zh: 这个问题比较庞大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 bi3 jiao4 pang2 da4
cues.en: It's a fairly large topic,

cues.zh: 我们首先要介绍黎曼猜想
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 yao4 jie4 shao4 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: so first we'll introduce the Riemann Hypothesis,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是朗道-西格尔零点猜想？传奇数学家张益唐的又一突破！

cues.zh: 然后介绍广义黎曼猜想
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jie4 shao4 guang3 yi4 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: then the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis,

cues.zh: 最后来到朗道西格尔零点问题
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 lai2 dao4 lang3 dao4 xi1 ge2 er3 ling2 dian3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and finally arrive at the Landau-Siegel zero problem.

cues.zh: 那么关于黎曼猜想
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guan1 yu2 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: As for the Riemann Hypothesis,

cues.zh: 我在几年以前做过三期节目
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ji3 nian2 yi3 qian2 zuo4 guo4 san1 qi1 jie2 mu4
cues.en: I made a three-part series on it a few years ago

cues.zh: 详细讨论的这个问题
cues.pinyin: xiang2 xi4 tao3 lun4 de5 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: discussing this problem in detail.

cues.zh: 我们首先再做一个简要的复习
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 zai4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 jian3 yao4 de5 fu4 xi2
cues.en: Let's start with a brief review.

cues.zh: 黎曼猜想首先是基于一个函数
cues.pinyin: li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 shou3 xian1 shi4 ji1 yu2 yi2 ge4 han2 shu4
cues.en: The Riemann Hypothesis is based on a function

cues.zh: 叫做黎曼函数
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 li2 man4 han2 shu4
cues.en: called the Riemann zeta function.

cues.zh: 而要讲这个黎曼函数
cues.pinyin: er2 yao4 jiang3 zhe4 ge5 li2 man4 han2 shu4
cues.en: And to talk about this Riemann zeta function,

cues.zh: 我们又得从大数学家欧拉说起
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 de2 cong2 da4 shu4 xue2 jia1 ou1 la1 shuo1 qi3

cues.zh: 欧拉曾经研究过一个级数的和
cues.pinyin: ou1 la1 ceng2 jing1 yan2 jiu1 guo4 yi2 ge4 ji2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: Euler once studied the sum of a certain series,

cues.zh: 这个级数的和就是
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ji2 shu4 de5 he2 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: and that sum was

cues.zh: 自然数 n 它的 s 取加和
cues.pinyin: zi4 ran2 shu4 n ta1 de5 s qu3 jia1 he2
cues.en: the sum over natural numbers n of n to the power negative s,

cues.zh: n 从 1 开始一直到正无穷
cues.pinyin: n cong2 1 kai1 shi3 yi4 zhi2 dao4 zheng4 wu2 qiong2
cues.en: with n running from 1 to positive infinity.

cues.zh: 我把它展开的话
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba3 ta1 zhan3 kai1 de5 hua4
cues.en: If I write it out,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是朗道-西格尔零点猜想？传奇数学家张益唐的又一突破！

cues.zh: 这个玩意上加起来得多少
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wan2 yi4 shang4 jia1 qi3 lai2 de5 duo1 shao3
cues.en: how much does this thing add up to?

cues.zh: 等于 6 分之方
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 6 fen1 zhi1 fang1
cues.en: It equals π squared over 6.

cues.zh: 这就是欧拉的研究成果
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ou1 la1 de5 yan2 jiu1 cheng2 guo3
cues.en: That was Euler's result,

cues.zh: 也就是著名的巴塞尔问题
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 ba1 sai1 er3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: known as the famous Basel problem.

cues.zh: 那么关于它为什么等于 6 分之方
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 guan1 yu2 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 deng3 yu2 6 fen1 zhi1 fang1
cues.en: As for why it equals π squared over 6,

cues.zh: 还是挺有意思的
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ting3 you3 yi4 si5 de5
cues.en: that's actually quite interesting.

cues.zh: 以后我们找个时间好好讲一讲
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 wo3 men5 zhao3 ge4 shi2 jian1 hao3 hao3 jiang3 yi1 jiang3
cues.en: We'll find time to go over it properly another day.

cues.zh: 那么除此之外
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: Beyond that,

cues.zh: 比如说欧拉还发现这个极数的核
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ou1 la1 hai2 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 ji2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: for example, Euler also discovered that this series

cues.zh: 和全体的素数也就是质数是有关系的
cues.pinyin: he2 quan2 ti3 de5 su4 shu4 ye3 jiu4 shi4 zhi4 shu4 shi4 you3 guan1 xi4 de5
cues.en: is related to all the prime numbers.

cues.zh: 也就是 s 它又等于什么呢
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 s ta1 you4 deng3 yu2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: In other words, what else does it equal?

cues.zh: 它又等于 1 2 的 s 分之 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 deng3 yu2 1 2 de5 s fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: It also equals 1 over (1 minus 2 to the negative s),

cues.zh: 再乘以 1 3 的 s 分之 1
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 yi3 1 3 de5 s fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: times 1 over (1 minus 3 to the negative s),

cues.zh: 再乘以 1 5 的 s 分之 1
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 yi3 1 5 de5 s fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: times 1 over (1 minus 5 to the negative s),

cues.zh: 这么一直乘下去
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi4 zhi2 cheng2 xia4 qu4
cues.en: and so on, multiplying indefinitely.

cues.zh: 它这个分母里面的每一项都是一个素数
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 ge5 fen1 mu3 li3 mian4 de5 mei3 yi1 xiang4 dou1 shi4 yi2 ge4 su4 shu4
cues.en: Every term in these denominators is a prime number.

cues.zh: 你把所有的素数带到这个表达式里面去
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba3 suo3 you3 de5 su4 shu4 dai4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 biao3 da2 shi4 li3 mian4 qu4
cues.en: If you plug all the primes into this expression

cues.zh: 把它乘到一块最后的结果就是欧
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 cheng2 dao4 yi1 kuai4 zui4 hou4 de5 jie2 guo3 jiu4 shi4 ou1
cues.en: and multiply them all together, the final result is Euler's

cues.zh: 拉的这个极数
cues.pinyin: la1 de5 zhe4 ge5 ji2 shu4
cues.en: series.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是朗道-西格尔零点猜想？传奇数学家张益唐的又一突破！

cues.zh: 并且我还可以延长到整个的这个
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 wo3 hai2 ke3 yi3 yan2 chang2 dao4 zheng3 ge4 de5 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: And moreover, this can be extended across the entire

cues.zh: 复数的平面里
cues.pinyin: fu4 shu4 de5 ping2 mian4 li3
cues.en: complex plane.

cues.zh: 所以这个黎曼进行解析延拓之后
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 li2 man4 jin4 xing2 jie3 xi1 yan2 tuo4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: So after Riemann performed this analytic continuation,

cues.zh: 得到了一个新的函数
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 xin1 de5 han2 shu4
cues.en: he obtained a new function,

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xin1 de5 han2 shu4 jiu4 shi4 li2 man4 c de5 han2 shu4
cues.en: and this new function is the Riemann zeta function.

cues.en: so I won't write it out here — there are many forms of it, right?

cues.zh: 但是解析研究之后
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jie3 xi1 yan2 jiu1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: But after this analytic study,

cues.en: You can imagine that Euler's original series

cues.zh: 它只能是在一个实数轴

cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shi4 zai4 da4 yu2 1 de5 fan4 wei2 nei4 cai2 you3 ding4 yi4
cues.en: and only for values greater than 1.

cues.zh: 而这个黎曼 z 的函数
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 li2 man4 z de5 han2 shu4

cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 tuo4 zhan3 dao4 zheng3 ge4 fu4 ping2 mian4

cues.zh: 只要你 s 不等于 1 就可以了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 s bu4 deng3 yu2 1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: as long as s isn't equal to 1.

cues.zh: 那么黎曼 z 的函数有什么性质呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 li2 man4 z de5 han2 shu4 you3 shen2 me5 xing4 zhi4 ne5
cues.en: So what properties does the Riemann zeta function have?

cues.zh: 黎曼经过研究就发现
cues.pinyin: li2 man4 jing1 guo4 yan2 jiu1 jiu4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Through his research, Riemann found

cues.zh: 这个黎曼茨的函数有一些平凡零点

cues.zh: 就是当它的自变量等于 2

cues.en: It means when its input variable equals -2,

cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 4 huo4 zhe3 6 deng3 deng3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: or -4, or -6, and so on,

cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 ping2 fan2 ling2 dian3 shi4 ba5

cues.zh: 这叫平凡零点

cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 zhe4 xie1 ge4 ling2 dian3 jiu4 jiao4 fei1 fan2 ling2 dian3

cues.zh: 经过研究黎曼就发现
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yan2 jiu1 li2 man4 jiu4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Through his research, Riemann discovered

cues.pinyin: fei1 fan2 ling2 dian3 shi4 you3 yi1 xie1 te4 zheng1 de5

cues.zh: 什么特征呢

cues.zh: 而是一定有虚部的
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yi2 ding4 you3 xu1 bu4 de5
cues.en: It definitely has an imaginary part.

cues.zh: 这是第一个特征
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 di4 yi2 ge4 te4 zheng1
cues.en: That's the first characteristic.

cues.zh: 第二个特征就是它的实部
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 te4 zheng1 jiu4 shi4 ta1 de5 shi2 bu4
cues.en: The second characteristic is about its real part —

cues.zh: 肯定不在这个轴上

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 妻子怀孕不想夫妻生活，天才医生肖恩都抑郁了！克莱尔终于原谅了自己的父亲

cues.zh: 这个男人身患癌症
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 shen1 huan4 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: This man has cancer.

cues.zh: 好在医生们对于治好他的病很有信心
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 yi1 sheng1 men5 dui4 yu2 zhi4 hao3 ta1 de5 bing4 hen3 you3 xin4 xin1
cues.en: Luckily, the doctors are confident they can cure his illness.

cues.zh: 但是他却拒绝治疗
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 que4 ju4 jue2 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: But he refuses treatment.

cues.zh: 男人的女儿就是优秀的克莱尔医生
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 de5 nv3 er2 jiu4 shi4 you1 xiu4 de5 ke4 lai2 er3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: The man's daughter is the excellent Dr. Claire.

cues.zh: 可克莱尔却对父亲的病不管不顾
cues.pinyin: ke3 ke4 lai2 er3 que4 dui4 fu4 qin1 de5 bing4 bu4 guan3 bu4 gu4
cues.en: Yet Claire ignores her father's illness completely.

cues.zh: 这背后到底有什么隐情
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bei4 hou4 dao4 di3 you3 shen2 me5 yin3 qing2
cues.en: What's the hidden reason behind this?

cues.zh: 这天清晨一个高大的男人敲开了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 qing1 chen2 yi2 ge4 gao1 da4 de5 nan2 ren2 qiao1 kai1 le5
cues.en: Early this morning, a tall man knocked on

cues.zh: 克莱尔的家门
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 de5 jia1 men2
cues.en: Claire's door.

cues.zh: 他是克莱尔的父亲麦尔斯
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ke4 lai2 er3 de5 fu4 qin1 mai4 er3 si1
cues.en: He is Claire's father, Miles.

cues.zh: 麦尔斯在克莱尔很小的时候就离开了他
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 zai4 ke4 lai2 er3 hen3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 li2 kai1 le5 ta1
cues.en: Miles left him when Claire was very young.

cues.zh: 所以克莱尔的童年很孤单
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ke4 lai2 er3 de5 tong2 nian2 hen3 gu1 dan1
cues.en: So Claire's childhood was very lonely.

cues.zh: 克莱尔想到自己小时候的艰难处境
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 xiang3 dao4 zi4 ji3 xiao3 shi2 hou4 de5 jian1 nan2 chu3 jing4
cues.en: Claire thought of the hardships of her own childhood.

cues.zh: 他自然没办法接受眼前这个男人
cues.pinyin: ta1 zi4 ran2 mei2 ban4 fa3 jie1 shou4 yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: Naturally, he couldn't accept the man in front of him.

cues.zh: 麦尔斯的情绪变得很激动
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 de5 qing2 xu4 bian4 de2 hen3 ji1 dong4
cues.en: Miles became very emotional.

cues.zh: 很显然他很内疚和自责
cues.pinyin: hen3 xian3 ran2 ta1 hen3 nei4 jiu4 he2 zi4 ze2
cues.en: Clearly he felt guilty and remorseful.

cues.zh: 他现在想弥补对克莱尔的爱
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 xiang3 mi2 bu3 dui4 ke4 lai2 er3 de5 ai4
cues.en: Now he wants to make up for the love he owes Claire.

cues.zh: 突然麦尔斯的身体开始不受控制
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 mai4 er3 si1 de5 shen1 ti3 kai1 shi3 bu4 shou4 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: Suddenly Miles's body began to lose control.

cues.zh: 克莱尔见状赶紧对麦尔斯做了简单的测试
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 jian4 zhuang4 gan3 jin3 dui4 mai4 er3 si1 zuo4 le5 jian3 dan1 de5 ce4 shi4
cues.en: Seeing this, Claire quickly did a simple test on Miles.

cues.zh: 他认为麦尔斯是中风发作
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 mai4 er3 si1 shi4 zhong4 feng1 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: He believed Miles was having a stroke.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 妻子怀孕不想夫妻生活，天才医生肖恩都抑郁了！克莱尔终于原谅了自己的父亲

cues.zh: 于是赶紧拨打了急救电话
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 gan3 jin3 bo1 da3 le5 ji2 jiu4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: So he quickly called for emergency help.

cues.zh: 他认为不管自己多么恨麦尔斯
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 bu4 guan3 zi4 ji3 duo1 me5 hen4 mai4 er3 si1
cues.en: He felt that no matter how much he hated Miles,

cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xian4 zai4 bi4 xu1 jiang1 mai4 er3 si1 song4 qu4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: he now had to get Miles to the hospital.

cues.zh: 不一会儿后
cues.pinyin: bu4 yi1 hui4 er5 hou4
cues.en: Not long after,

cues.zh: 麦尔斯被送到了克莱尔工作的医院
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 bei4 song4 dao4 le5 ke4 lai2 er3 gong1 zuo4 de5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Miles was taken to the hospital where Claire worked.

cues.zh: 麦尔斯的主要症状就是头痛
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 de5 zhu3 yao4 zheng4 zhuang4 jiu4 shi4 tou2 tong4
cues.en: Miles's main symptom was a headache.

cues.zh: 对于这个病症
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 bing4 zheng4
cues.en: As for this condition,

cues.zh: 麦尔斯很不在意
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 hen3 bu4 zai4 yi4
cues.en: Miles didn't take it seriously.

cues.zh: 他表示
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: He said

cues.zh: 头痛是因为自己压力过大造成的
cues.pinyin: tou2 tong4 shi4 yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 ya1 li4 guo4 da4 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: the headache was caused by his own excessive stress.

cues.zh: 此刻的麦尔斯特别想找个机会
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 de5 mai4 er3 si1 te4 bie2 xiang3 zhao3 ge4 ji1 hui4
cues.en: At this moment, Miles really wanted a chance

cues.zh: 好好的向女儿诚恳的表达心中的歉意
cues.pinyin: hao3 hao3 de5 xiang4 nv3 er2 cheng2 ken3 de5 biao3 da2 xin1 zhong1 de5 qian4 yi4
cues.en: to sincerely apologize to his daughter.

cues.zh: 但克莱尔对麦尔斯满是恨意
cues.pinyin: dan4 ke4 lai2 er3 dui4 mai4 er3 si1 man3 shi4 hen4 yi4
cues.en: But Claire was full of hatred toward Miles.

cues.zh: 不过他仍然尽着一个医生的职责
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 reng2 ran2 jin4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1 de5 zhi2 ze2
cues.en: Still, he kept fulfilling his duty as a doctor.

cues.zh: 他将麦尔斯的身体状况详细的告诉了对方
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiang1 mai4 er3 si1 de5 shen1 ti3 zhuang4 kuang4 xiang2 xi4 de5 gao4 su4 le5 dui4 fang1
cues.en: He explained Miles's condition to him in detail.

cues.zh: 麦尔斯刚才是因为神经性功能障碍
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 gang1 cai2 shi4 yin1 wei4 shen2 jing1 xing4 gong1 neng2 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: Miles's headache had just been caused by a neurological dysfunction,

cues.zh: 所以才会剧烈头痛
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 hui4 ju4 lie4 tou2 tong4
cues.en: which was why it was so severe.

cues.zh: 要确定具体的病因
cues.pinyin: yao4 que4 ding4 ju4 ti3 de5 bing4 yin1
cues.en: To determine the exact cause,

cues.zh: 还要对他进行 CT 检查
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 dui4 ta1 jin4 xing2 CT jian3 cha2
cues.en: he also needed a CT scan.

cues.zh: 麦尔斯接受检查时
cues.pinyin: mai4 er3 si1 jie1 shou4 jian3 cha2 shi2
cues.en: While Miles was being examined,

cues.zh: 他对女儿克莱尔说出了实情
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 nv3 er2 ke4 lai2 er3 shuo1 chu1 le5 shi2 qing2
cues.en: he told his daughter Claire the truth.

cues.zh: 其实他根本不是头疼
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ta1 gen1 ben3 bu2 shi4 tou2 teng2
cues.en: Actually, it wasn't a headache at all.

cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 wang4 de5 xiang3 chu1 yuan4
cues.en: He desperately wanted to leave the hospital.

cues.zh: 当时是她的朋友李奥将她送到了医院
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 shi4 ta1 de5 peng2 you3 li3 ao4 jiang1 ta1 song4 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4

cues.zh: 两个人的关系很是亲密
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 guan1 xi4 hen3 shi4 qin1 mi4
cues.en: The two were very close.

cues.zh: 玛雅认为自己受的伤不严重

cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fu4 mo2 hou4 qiang1 chu1 xie3
cues.en: She had bleeding in her retroperitoneal space.

cues.zh: 所以必须要尽快对她进行手术
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bi4 xu1 yao4 jin3 kuai4 dui4 ta1 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: So she needed surgery as soon as possible.

cues.zh: 很快玛雅躺到了手术台上
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 ma3 ya3 tang3 dao4 le5 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4

cues.zh: 手术时
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi2

cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 de5 xue4 ya1 yi4 zhi2 zai4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Maya's blood pressure kept dropping.

cues.zh: 她的血液也不进行凝结
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xue4 ye4 ye3 bu4 jin4 xing2 ning2 jie2
cues.en: Her blood also wasn't clotting.

cues.zh: 所以医生们不得不给她进行输血
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 sheng1 men5 bu4 de2 bu4 gei3 ta1 jin4 xing2 shu1 xue4
cues.en: So the doctors had to give her a blood transfusion.

cues.zh: 经过不懈的努力
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 bu4 xie4 de5 nu3 li4
cues.en: After tireless efforts,

cues.zh: 玛雅的血压终于开始回升
cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 de5 xue4 ya1 zhong1 yu2 kai1 shi3 hui2 sheng1
cues.en: Maya's blood pressure finally began to rise.

cues.zh: 大夫们心里明白
cues.pinyin: da4 fu1 men5 xin1 li3 ming2 bai2
cues.en: The doctors understood in their hearts

cues.zh: 她的腿部疼痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui3 bu4 teng2 tong4
cues.en: that the pain in her leg

cues.en: and now the bleeding had already eroded the bone.

cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 de5 tui3 bu4 you3 liang3 zhong3 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: There were two treatment options for Maya's leg.

cues.zh: 一种是骨骨头致患手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 gu3 gu3 tou5 zhi4 huan4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: One was limb-salvage surgery.

cues.zh: 这个方案风险高
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 an4 feng1 xian3 gao1
cues.en: This option was high-risk,

cues.zh: 另一种方案则是截肢
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 zhong3 fang1 an4 ze2 shi4 jie2 zhi1
cues.en: and could even cause Maya's death.

cues.zh: 但是一旦成功的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi2 dan4 cheng2 gong1 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if it succeeded,

cues.zh: 就可以保住玛雅的腿
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 bao3 zhu4 ma3 ya3 de5 tui3
cues.en: Maya's leg could be saved,

cues.zh: 从而让玛雅继续跳舞
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 rang4 ma3 ya3 ji4 xu4 tiao4 wu3
cues.en: letting Maya keep dancing.

cues.zh: 另一种方案则是节制
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 zhong3 fang1 an4 ze2 shi4 jie2 zhi4
cues.en: The other option was amputation.

cues.zh: 这种方案风险很小
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 fang1 an4 feng1 xian3 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: This option had very low risk.

cues.zh: 玛雅很爱跳舞
cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 hen3 ai4 tiao4 wu3
cues.en: Maya loved dancing very much.

cues.zh: 她认为必须保住自己的腿
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 bi4 xu1 bao3 zhu4 zi4 ji3 de5 tui3
cues.en: She felt she had to save her leg.

cues.zh: 所以她选择了骨骨头致患手术
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xuan3 ze2 le5 gu3 gu3 tou5 zhi4 huan4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: So she chose the limb-salvage surgery.

cues.zh: 想到自己的遭遇
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 zao1 yu4
cues.en: Thinking of what had happened to her,

cues.zh: 玛雅和李奥忍不住地在病房里跳了起来
cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 he2 li3 ao4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 di4 zai4 bing4 fang2 li3 tiao4 le5 qi3 lai2

cues.zh: 亚瑟认为李奥是同性恋
cues.pinyin: ya4 se4 ren4 wei2 li3 ao4 shi4 tong2 xing4 lian4
cues.en: Arthur thought Leo was gay.

cues.zh: 不过她在玛雅和李奥的互动中
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 zai4 ma3 ya3 he2 li3 ao4 de5 hu4 dong4 zhong1

cues.zh: 明显地感到玛雅已经爱上了李奥
cues.pinyin: ming2 xian3 di4 gan3 dao4 ma3 ya3 yi3 jing1 ai4 shang4 le5 li3 ao4
cues.en: she clearly sensed that Maya had fallen for Leo.

cues.zh: 玛雅是为了李奥才愿意接受手术的
cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 shi4 wei4 le5 li3 ao4 cai2 yuan4 yi4 jie1 shou4 shou3 shu4 de5
cues.en: Maya was only willing to have the surgery because of Leo.

cues.zh: 玛雅对此进行了否认
cues.pinyin: ma3 ya3 dui4 ci3 jin4 xing2 le5 fou3 ren4

cues.zh: 她认为自己和李奥只是好朋友
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 zi4 ji3 he2 li3 ao4 zhi3 shi4 hao3 peng2 you3
cues.en: She felt she and Leo were just good friends

cues.zh: 在生活的各个方面
cues.pinyin: zai4 sheng1 huo2 de5 ge4 ge4 fang1 mian4
cues.en: in every aspect of life.

cues.zh: 比如说这个黄洋葱呢
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 huang2 yang2 cong1 ne5
cues.en: For example, this yellow onion,

cues.zh: 它是店里面买来的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 dian4 li3 mian4 mai3 lai2 de5
cues.en: which was bought from a store,

cues.zh: 它的皮呢就非常的厚
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 pi2 ne5 jiu4 fei1 chang2 de5 hou4
cues.en: its skin is very thick.

cues.zh: 你摸一摸就知道了

cues.zh: 水分呢也非常的大

cues.zh: 有一个对称的量

cues.zh: 它的意思是说
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yi4 si5 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: What it means is

cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zuo4 de5 wu4 li3 shi2 yan4 de2 chu1 de5 gui1 lv4
cues.en: that the laws we get from a physics experiment done today

cues.pinyin: he2 ming2 tian1 zuo4 de5 wu4 li3 shi2 yan4 de2 chu1 de5 gui1 lv4

cues.zh: 这事要从一个著名的谜团叫之谜说起
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yao4 cong2 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 de5 mi2 tuan2 jiao4 zhi1 mi2 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: This story starts with a famous mystery called the theta-tau puzzle.

cues.zh: 这两个都是一个粒子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 ge4 dou1 shi4 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: These two seemed to be the same particle.

cues.zh: 这个粒子和粒子

cues.en: This theta particle and tau particle,

cues.zh: 粒子它和粒子长得非常像
cues.pinyin: li4 zi5 ta1 he2 li4 zi5 zhang3 de2 fei1 chang2 xiang4
cues.en: the theta particle and tau particle look extremely alike.

cues.zh: 就是它们从质量和电荷上来看
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 men5 cong2 zhi4 liang4 he2 dian4 he4 shang4 lai2 kan4
cues.en: That is, in terms of mass and charge,

cues.zh: 它们应该是完全一样的相同的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ying1 gai1 shi4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4 de5 xiang1 tong2 de5
cues.en: they should be completely identical, the same.

cues.zh: 质量也相同电荷也相同
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liang4 ye3 xiang1 tong2 dian4 he4 ye3 xiang1 tong2
cues.en: Same mass, same charge too,

cues.zh: 反正你看什么性质它都一样
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 ni3 kan4 shen2 me5 xing4 zhi4 ta1 dou1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: no matter what property you look at, they're the same.

cues.zh: 那既然这样的话它就应该是一个粒子
cues.pinyin: na4 ji4 ran2 zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4 ta1 jiu4 ying1 gai1 shi4 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Given that, it should just be one particle.

cues.zh: 但问题是和它的衰变产物是不一样的
cues.pinyin: dan4 wen4 ti2 shi4 he2 ta1 de5 shuai1 bian4 chan3 wu4 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: But the problem is their decay products are different.

cues.zh: 粒子它衰变了之后是一个加介子
cues.pinyin: li4 zi5 ta1 shuai1 bian4 le5 zhi1 hou4 shi4 yi2 ge4 jia1 jie4 zi5
cues.en: After the theta particle decays, you get one pi-plus meson

cues.zh: 还有一个 0 介子
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 0 jie4 zi5
cues.en: and one pi-zero meson.

cues.zh: 这个粒子它衰变之后是两个加介子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 zi5 ta1 shuai1 bian4 zhi1 hou4 shi4 liang3 ge4 jia1 jie4 zi5
cues.en: After this tau particle decays, you get two pi-plus mesons

cues.zh: 还有一个介子
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 jie4 zi5
cues.en: and one pi-minus meson.

cues.zh: 说衰变产物不一样
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shuai1 bian4 chan3 wu4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: So the decay products are different.

cues.pinyin: yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 zheng4 zai4 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 shang4 yan3
cues.en: This man is about to put on a show in the forensics lab—

cues.zh: 大型翻车现场
cues.pinyin: da4 xing2 fan1 che1 xian4 chang3
cues.en: a massive fiasco.

cues.zh: 从蚊香石石到鸟睡大师
cues.pinyin: cong2 wen2 xiang1 shi2 shi2 dao4 niao3 shui4 da4 shi1
cues.en: From mosquito coil to master of dozing off,

cues.zh: 他竟将二氧化碳吸成了安眠药
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing4 jiang1 er4 yang3 hua4 tan4 xi1 cheng2 le5 an1 mian2 yao4
cues.en: he actually turned carbon dioxide into a sleeping pill by inhaling it.

cues.zh: 至于他为何要做出这种迷惑行为
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 ta1 wei4 he2 yao4 zuo4 chu1 zhe4 zhong3 mi2 huo4 xing2 wei2
cues.en: As for why he did something so baffling,

cues.zh: 这还要从几天前的海边说起
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hai2 yao4 cong2 ji3 tian1 qian2 de5 hai3 bian1 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: we have to go back to the beach a few days earlier.
