cues.pinyin: yi1 chang2 heng2 chong1 zhi2 zhuang4 de5 ju4 feng1 zai4 hai3 mian4 sa1 ye3
cues.en: A reckless hurricane was running wild over the sea,

cues.zh: 将一艘垃圾船拍成了海上披萨
cues.pinyin: jiang1 yi1 sou1 la1 ji1 chuan2 pai1 cheng2 le5 hai3 shang4 pi1 sa4
cues.en: smashing a garbage barge flat like a pizza.

cues.zh: 就在警方准备清理这片海鲜大
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 jing3 fang1 zhun3 bei4 qing1 li3 zhe4 pian4 hai3 xian1 da4
cues.en: Just as police were about to clean up this seafood medley—

cues.zh: 杂烩时下一秒
cues.pinyin: za2 hui4 shi2 xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: in the very next second,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 沙滩惊现人体灌汤包，剧情翻转18湾，贪婪是人性的坟墓。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 这简直是法医科小谷的舒适区
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian3 zhi2 shi4 fa3 yi1 ke1 xiao3 gu3 de5 shu1 shi4 qu1
cues.en: this turned out to be forensic specialist Xiao Gu's comfort zone.

cues.zh: 根据一切检测
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 yi1 qie4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: Based on a series of tests,

cues.zh: 这块巨型琥珀硬堂中竟装着一位男性尸体
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kuai4 ju4 xing2 hu3 po4 ying4 tang2 zhong1 jing4 zhuang1 zhe5 yi1 wei4 nan2 xing4 shi1 ti3
cues.en: this giant chunk of amber candy actually had a man's corpse inside it.

cues.zh: 且从做谷节节磨损度来看
cues.pinyin: qie3 cong2 zuo4 gu3 jie2 jie2 mo2 sun3 du4 lai2 kan4
cues.en: And judging from the wear on his hip joint,

cues.zh: 其平时没少坐办公室
cues.pinyin: qi2 ping2 shi2 mei2 shao3 zuo4 ban4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: he must have spent a lot of time sitting at a desk job.

cues.zh: 法医豪金冷不丁的开了个玩笑
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 hao2 jin1 leng3 bu4 ding1 de5 kai1 le5 ge4 wan2 xiao4
cues.en: Forensic examiner Hodgins suddenly cracked a joke,

cues.zh: 骑着警察老伯差点赏他一个爆炒例子
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhe5 jing3 cha2 lao3 bo2 cha4 dian3 shang3 ta1 yi2 ge4 bao4 chao3 li4 zi5
cues.en: which nearly got him a knuckle-rap from the furious old detective.

cues.zh: 法医卡米尔正和法医夏洛克打情骂俏
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 ka3 mi3 er3 zheng4 he2 fa3 yi1 xia4 luo4 ke4 da3 qing2 ma4 qiao4
cues.en: Forensic examiners Camille and Sherlock were flirting with each other,

cues.zh: 谁知检验科安琪拉却突然出现
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 jian3 yan4 ke1 an1 qi2 la1 que4 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4
cues.en: when Angela from the lab suddenly showed up,

cues.zh: 八卦询问两人之间的关系
cues.pinyin: ba1 gua4 xun2 wen4 liang3 ren2 zhi1 jian1 de5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: gossiping and prying into the relationship between the two.

cues.zh: 只见卡米尔一脸羞涩
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 ka3 mi3 er3 yi1 lian3 xiu1 se4
cues.en: Camille looked completely bashful,

cues.zh: 眼看这边其乐融融
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 zhe4 bian1 qi2 le4 rong2 rong2
cues.en: and just as everything seemed warm and cozy here,

cues.zh: 然而另一边的实验室却发生意外
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ling4 yi1 bian1 de5 shi2 yan4 shi4 que4 fa1 sheng1 yi4 wai4
cues.en: an accident happened in the lab on the other side.

cues.zh: 为了将尸体从巨型琥珀糖中取出
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jiang1 shi1 ti3 cong2 ju4 xing2 hu3 po4 tang2 zhong1 qu3 chu1
cues.en: In order to get the body out of the giant amber candy,

cues.zh: 夏洛克和豪金立即用激光对尸体外层的胶
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 ke4 he2 hao2 jin1 li4 ji2 yong4 ji1 guang1 dui4 shi1 ti3 wai4 ceng2 de5 jiao1
cues.en: Sherlock and Hodgins immediately used a laser on the gelatinous

cues.zh: 状物进行切割
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 wu4 jin4 xing2 qie1 ge1
cues.en: layer coating the body's surface to cut it open.

cues.zh: 发现表面似乎是一种塑料物质
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 biao3 mian4 si4 hu1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 su4 liao4 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: They found the surface seemed to be some kind of plastic material.

cues.zh: 下一秒
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3
cues.en: The next second—

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 沙滩惊现人体灌汤包，剧情翻转18湾，贪婪是人性的坟墓。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 自豪的豪金渴望获得对方的赞赏
cues.pinyin: zi4 hao2 de5 hao2 jin1 ke3 wang4 huo4 de2 dui4 fang1 de5 zan4 shang3
cues.en: a proud Hodgins was eager for some praise,

cues.zh: 直至紧随其后赶来的卡米尔却频
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 jin3 sui2 qi2 hou4 gan3 lai2 de5 ka3 mi3 er3 que4 pin2
cues.en: but Camille, who rushed in right after,

cues.zh: 频称赞夏洛克
cues.pinyin: pin2 cheng1 zan4 xia4 luo4 ke4
cues.en: kept praising Sherlock instead,

cues.zh: 对豪金视若无睹
cues.pinyin: dui4 hao2 jin1 shi4 ruo4 wu2 du3
cues.en: while completely ignoring Hodgins.

cues.zh: 这态度简直是双标
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tai4 du4 jian3 zhi2 shi4 shuang1 biao1
cues.en: Talk about a double standard.

cues.zh: 豪金只好将视线重新聚焦于尸体
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 zhi3 hao3 jiang1 shi4 xian4 chong2 xin1 ju4 jiao1 yu2 shi1 ti3
cues.en: Hodgins had no choice but to refocus on the body.

cues.zh: 他根据液体中木屑上的色斑推测
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ju4 ye4 ti3 zhong1 mu4 xie4 shang4 de5 se4 ban1 tui1 ce4
cues.en: Based on the stains on wood shavings found in the fluid, he guessed

cues.zh: 这些痕迹极有可能是墨水印刷字体
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 hen2 ji4 ji2 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 mo4 shui3 yin4 shua1 zi4 ti3
cues.en: these marks were most likely an ink-printed typeface.

cues.zh: 卡米尔在进行技术还原后
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 zai4 jin4 xing2 ji4 shu4 huan2 yuan2 hou4
cues.en: After Camille did a technical reconstruction,

cues.zh: 发现这是当地家木材公司的标志
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 zhe4 shi4 dang1 di4 jia1 mu4 cai2 gong1 si1 de5 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: she found it was the logo of a local lumber company.

cues.zh: 根据这条线索
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Following this lead,

cues.zh: 脑部和小鼓励即进行走法
cues.pinyin: nao3 bu4 he2 xiao3 gu3 li4 ji2 jin4 xing2 zou3 fa3
cues.en: Booth and Bones immediately went to pay a visit.

cues.zh: 只知道木材店销售员看到死者画像时
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zhi1 dao4 mu4 cai2 dian4 xiao1 shou4 yuan2 kan4 dao4 si3 zhe3 hua4 xiang4 shi2
cues.en: Who knew, when the lumber store's salesman saw the victim's portrait,

cues.zh: 掌门竟比预风警报还强
cues.pinyin: zhang3 men2 jing4 bi3 yu4 feng1 jing3 bao4 hai2 qiang2
cues.en: his reaction was even more intense than a storm warning.

cues.zh: 从他口中得知死者名叫约翰
cues.pinyin: cong2 ta1 kou3 zhong1 de2 zhi1 si3 zhe3 ming2 jiao4 yue1 han4
cues.en: From him they learned the victim's name was John,

cues.zh: 是一名犯罪现场清理师
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 ming2 fan4 zui4 xian4 chang3 qing1 li3 shi1
cues.en: a crime scene cleaner.

cues.zh: 看着销售员如此激动
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 xiao1 shou4 yuan2 ru2 ci3 ji1 dong4
cues.en: Seeing the salesman so worked up,

cues.zh: 两人瞬间起了疑心
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 shun4 jian1 qi3 le5 yi2 xin1
cues.en: the two instantly grew suspicious.

cues.zh: 几番盘问下
cues.pinyin: ji3 fan1 pan2 wen4 xia4
cues.en: After several rounds of questioning,

cues.zh: 销售员最终承认自己是对方的地下情人
cues.pinyin: xiao1 shou4 yuan2 zui4 zhong1 cheng2 ren4 zi4 ji3 shi4 dui4 fang1 de5 di4 xia4 qing2 ren2
cues.en: the salesman finally admitted he was John's secret lover.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 沙滩惊现人体灌汤包，剧情翻转18湾，贪婪是人性的坟墓。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 安吉拉通过伤口数据进行检测后发现
cues.pinyin: an1 ji2 la1 tong1 guo4 shang1 kou3 shu4 ju4 jin4 xing2 jian3 ce4 hou4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After Angela examined the wound data, she discovered

cues.zh: 胸器已经是一把羊角锤
cues.pinyin: xiong1 qi4 yi3 jing1 shi4 yi1 ba3 yang2 jiao3 chui2
cues.en: the weapon had actually been a claw hammer—

cues.zh: 这是清洁人清洗地板的一种常用工具
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 qing1 jie2 ren2 qing1 xi3 di4 ban3 de5 yi1 zhong3 chang2 yong4 gong1 ju4
cues.en: a common tool cleaners use for scrubbing floors.

cues.zh: 巧合的是
cues.pinyin: qiao3 he2 de5 shi4
cues.en: Coincidentally,

cues.zh: 销售员所在的木材公司正好有寿
cues.pinyin: xiao1 shou4 yuan2 suo3 zai4 de5 mu4 cai2 gong1 si1 zheng4 hao3 you3 shou4
cues.en: the lumber company the salesman worked at happened to sell that very kind of hammer.

cues.zh: 检验室内正发生一件有趣的事
cues.pinyin: jian3 yan4 shi4 nei4 zheng4 fa1 sheng1 yi1 jian4 you3 qu4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Meanwhile, something interesting was happening back in the lab.

cues.zh: 原来夏洛克曾是一位追求自由的诗人
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 xia4 luo4 ke4 ceng2 shi4 yi1 wei4 zhui1 qiu2 zi4 you2 de5 shi1 ren2
cues.en: It turned out Sherlock had once been a freedom-chasing poet,

cues.zh: 甚至在军校就读过
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 zai4 jun1 xiao4 jiu4 du2 guo4
cues.en: who had even studied at a military academy.

cues.zh: 年轻气盛的他创作了许多不合时宜的史作
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 qi4 sheng4 de5 ta1 chuang4 zuo4 le5 xu3 duo1 bu4 he2 shi2 yi2 de5 shi3 zuo4
cues.en: In his brash youth he'd written plenty of ill-timed poems,

cues.zh: 因此得罪不少人
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 de2 zui4 bu4 shao3 ren2
cues.en: which had offended quite a few people

cues.zh: 甚至险些被当地政府逮捕
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 xian3 xie1 bei4 dang1 di4 zheng4 fu3 dai4 bu3
cues.en: and even nearly gotten him arrested by the local government.

cues.zh: 眼看豪金兴奋的还想继续询问
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 hao2 jin1 xing1 fen4 de5 hai2 xiang3 ji4 xu4 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Just as an excited Hodgins wanted to keep asking about it,

cues.zh: 夏洛克赶紧向他询问案件的进展
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 ke4 gan3 jin3 xiang4 ta1 xun2 wen4 an4 jian4 de5 jin4 zhan3
cues.en: Sherlock quickly steered him back to the case's progress.

cues.zh: 豪金表示
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Hodgins explained that

cues.zh: 通过检测尸体的腐烂速度发现
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 jian3 ce4 shi1 ti3 de5 fu3 lan4 su4 du4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: by testing the body's decomposition rate, they found

cues.zh: 他曾被生物分解煤清洁剂浸泡过
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 bei4 sheng1 wu4 fen1 jie3 mei2 qing1 jie2 ji4 jin4 pao4 guo4
cues.en: it had been soaked in a bio-decomposing enzyme cleaner.

cues.zh: 这种清洁剂具有极强的分解能力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing1 jie2 ji4 ju4 you3 ji2 qiang2 de5 fen1 jie3 neng2 li4
cues.en: This cleaner has an extremely powerful breakdown ability—

cues.zh: 效果比外卖平台催好平还厉害
cues.pinyin: xiao4 guo3 bi3 wai4 mai4 ping2 tai2 cui1 hao3 ping2 hai2 li4 hai4
cues.en: even stronger than a food delivery app pushing you for five-star reviews.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 沙滩惊现人体灌汤包，剧情翻转18湾，贪婪是人性的坟墓。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 鉴于凶手娴熟的手法
cues.pinyin: jian4 yu2 xiong1 shou3 xian2 shu2 de5 shou3 fa3
cues.en: Given the killer's polished technique,

cues.zh: 豪金推测对方很有可能是约翰熟悉之人
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 tui1 ce4 dui4 fang1 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 yue1 han4 shu2 xi1 zhi1 ren2
cues.en: Hodgins guessed the culprit was very likely someone close to John.

cues.zh: 警方瞬间怀疑乔治就是凶手
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 shun4 jian1 huai2 yi2 qiao2 zhi4 jiu4 shi4 xiong1 shou3
cues.en: The police instantly suspected George was the killer.

cues.zh: 要说这杀人动机
cues.pinyin: yao4 shuo1 zhe4 sha1 ren2 dong4 ji1
cues.en: As for the motive,

cues.zh: 十有八九
cues.pinyin: shi2 you3 ba1 jiu3
cues.en: nine times out of ten

cues.zh: 只乔治看不惯继父
cues.pinyin: zhi3 qiao2 zhi4 kan4 bu4 guan4 ji4 fu4
cues.en: it was simply that George couldn't stand his stepfather.

cues.zh: 明明有家庭
cues.pinyin: ming2 ming2 you3 jia1 ting2
cues.en: Despite clearly having a family,

cues.zh: 只因乔治看不惯继父
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yin1 qiao2 zhi4 kan4 bu4 guan4 ji4 fu4
cues.en: the stepfather still insisted on playing the field everywhere.

cues.zh: 然而面对心理学家小甜甜的怀疑
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 mian4 dui4 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 de5 huai2 yi2
cues.en: But faced with suspicion from psychologist Sweets,

cues.zh: 乔治却干脆利落的摊拍
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 que4 gan1 cui4 li4 luo4 de5 tan1 pai1
cues.en: George came clean without hesitation.

cues.zh: 原来他早就知道继父的后供团阵容豪华
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 zao3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 ji4 fu4 de5 hou4 gong1 tuan2 zhen4 rong2 hao2 hua2
cues.en: It turned out he'd long known his stepfather kept quite the harem,

cues.zh: 乔治却干脆利落的摊牌
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 que4 gan1 cui4 li4 luo4 de5 tan1 pai2
cues.en: and John never bothered hiding it,

cues.zh: 总是用男人有点小外号
cues.pinyin: zong3 shi4 yong4 nan2 ren2 you3 dian3 xiao3 wai4 hao4
cues.en: always brushing it off with 'that's just how men are,'

cues.zh: 而且约翰从不藏着掖着
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yue1 han4 cong2 bu4 cang2 zhe5 ye1 zhe5
cues.en: treating it as a totally normal excuse to hide behind.

cues.zh: 虽然乔治对他的这种行为很是气憎
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 qiao2 zhi4 dui4 ta1 de5 zhe4 zhong3 xing2 wei2 hen3 shi4 qi4 zeng1
cues.en: Though George was furious about this behavior,

cues.zh: 但想到继父对他们娘俩确实掏心掏肺
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiang3 dao4 ji4 fu4 dui4 ta1 men5 niang2 lia3 que4 shi2 tao1 xin1 tao1 fei4
cues.en: thinking of how his stepfather truly gave his all for him and his mom,

cues.zh: 虽然乔治对他的这种行为很是气愤
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 qiao2 zhi4 dui4 ta1 de5 zhe4 zhong3 xing2 wei2 hen3 shi4 qi4 fen4
cues.en: he ended up forcing down all that rage, turning it into quiet inner hurt.

cues.zh: 另外小田田提供了一条关键信息
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 ti2 gong1 le5 yi1 tiao2 guan1 jian4 xin4 xi1
cues.en: Separately, Sweets provided a key piece of information:

cues.zh: 乔治表示
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: George said

cues.zh: 另外小甜甜提供了一条关键信息
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 ti2 gong1 le5 yi1 tiao2 guan1 jian4 xin4 xi1
cues.en: Daniel, the lumber company's owner, was the biggest suspect,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 沙滩惊现人体灌汤包，剧情翻转18湾，贪婪是人性的坟墓。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 指出乔治因企图私吞约翰的财产嫌疑重大
cues.pinyin: zhi3 chu1 qiao2 zhi4 yin1 qi3 tu2 si1 tun1 yue1 han4 de5 cai2 chan3 xian2 yi2 zhong4 da4
cues.en: pointing out that George himself was highly suspicious for allegedly trying to seize John's assets.

cues.zh: 丹尼尔希望小甜甜能仔细检查
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 xi1 wang4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 neng2 zi3 xi4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Daniel hoped Sweets would carefully search

cues.zh: 乔治的工具箱
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 de5 gong1 ju4 xiang1
cues.en: George's toolbox

cues.zh: 从中发现关键证据
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhong1 fa1 xian4 guan1 jian4 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: to find key evidence inside.

cues.zh: 眼看着嫌疑人如俄罗斯套娃般
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 zhe5 xian2 yi2 ren2 ru2 e2 luo2 si1 tao4 wa2 ban1
cues.en: Watching the suspects pile up like Russian nesting dolls,

cues.zh: 一层接一层的不断涌现
cues.pinyin: yi1 ceng2 jie1 yi1 ceng2 de5 bu4 duan4 yong3 xian4
cues.en: emerging layer after layer,

cues.zh: 法医只好将两人的作案工具
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 zhi3 hao3 jiang1 liang3 ren2 de5 zuo4 an4 gong1 ju4
cues.en: the forensic team had no choice but to haul both men's alleged murder tools

cues.zh: 全部带回实验室
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 dai4 hui2 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: back to the lab entirely.

cues.zh: 然而就在这时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just at that moment,

cues.zh: 夏洛科学发现了重大猫腻
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 ke1 xue2 fa1 xian4 le5 zhong4 da4 mao1 ni4
cues.en: Sherlock discovered something seriously fishy:

cues.zh: 丹尼尔的工具箱遍布血字
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 de5 gong1 ju4 xiang1 bian4 bu4 xue4 zi4
cues.en: Daniel's toolbox was covered in bloodstains,

cues.zh: 反观乔治的工具箱却极其干净
cues.pinyin: fan3 guan1 qiao2 zhi4 de5 gong1 ju4 xiang1 que4 ji2 qi2 gan1 jing4
cues.en: while George's toolbox, by contrast, was spotlessly clean.

cues.zh: 难道这小子杀完人后
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 zhe4 xiao3 zi5 sha1 wan2 ren2 hou4
cues.en: Could it be that after killing someone,

cues.zh: 还给凶器来了套深度清洁按摩
cues.pinyin: huan2 gei3 xiong1 qi4 lai2 le5 tao4 shen1 du4 qing1 jie2 an4 mo2
cues.en: this guy even gave the murder weapon a deep-cleaning spa treatment?

cues.zh: 而豪金检测后更是发现
cues.pinyin: er2 hao2 jin1 jian3 ce4 hou4 geng4 shi4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: And after testing, Hodgins discovered something more:

cues.zh: 裹着尸体的塑料膜
cues.pinyin: guo3 zhe5 shi1 ti3 de5 su4 liao4 mo2
cues.en: the plastic film wrapping the body

cues.zh: 竟是约翰公社的砖工款
cues.pinyin: jing4 shi4 yue1 han4 gong1 she4 de5 zhuan1 gong1 kuan3
cues.en: was actually a proprietary type used by John's own company.

cues.zh: 这说明第一案发现场就在死者自
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shuo1 ming2 di4 yi1 an4 fa1 xian4 chang3 jiu4 zai4 si3 zhe3 zi4
cues.en: This showed the first crime scene was right on the victim's

cues.zh: 家的工作地盘
cues.pinyin: jia1 de5 gong1 zuo4 di4 pan2
cues.en: own home turf.

cues.zh: 麻烦的是这俩人全都是清理现场的老油条
cues.pinyin: ma2 fan2 de5 shi4 zhe4 lia3 ren2 quan2 dou1 shi4 qing1 li3 xian4 chang3 de5 lao3 you2 tiao2
cues.en: The trouble is, both of these men were seasoned old hands at cleaning up crime scenes,

cues.zh: 想要寻找线索
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 xun2 zhao3 xian4 suo3
cues.en: making it that much harder to find any clues.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 泰式著名打抛猪肉 |一生必吃|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 猪肉九成塔是我最爱的泰国菜之一
cues.pinyin: zhu1 rou4 jiu3 cheng2 ta3 shi4 wo3 zui4 ai4 de5 tai4 guo2 cai4 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: Pork pad kra pao is one of my favorite Thai dishes

cues.zh: 首先在一个热锅里加三汤匙的油
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zai4 yi2 ge4 re4 guo1 li3 jia1 san1 tang1 chi2 de5 you2
cues.en: First, add three tablespoons of oil to a hot pan

cues.zh: 接下来加一个红辣椒和一个绿辣椒
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 jia1 yi2 ge4 hong2 la4 jiao1 he2 yi2 ge4 lv4 la4 jiao1
cues.en: Next, add one red chili and one green chili

cues.zh: 在这里我们应该要使用泰式的辣椒
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 men5 ying1 gai1 yao4 shi3 yong4 tai4 shi4 de5 la4 jiao1
cues.en: Here we should use Thai chilies

cues.zh: 可是我家附近的超市真的是没有
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 jia1 fu4 jin4 de5 chao1 shi4 zhen1 de5 shi4 mei2 you3
cues.en: But my local supermarket really doesn't have any

cues.zh: 所以我就使用了别的种类的辣椒来做代替
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 jiu4 shi3 yong4 le5 bie2 de5 zhong3 lei4 de5 la4 jiao1 lai2 zuo4 dai4 ti4
cues.en: So I used a different kind of chili instead

cues.zh: 再加入五粒蒜
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 ru4 wu3 li4 suan4
cues.en: Then add five cloves of garlic

cues.zh: 把它们炒到这个空气里面都是辣喷喷香
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 chao3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 kong1 qi4 li3 mian4 dou1 shi4 la4 pen1 pen4 xiang1
cues.en: Stir-fry them until the air is filled with a spicy aroma

cues.zh: 喷喷的就好了
cues.pinyin: pen1 pen1 de5 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: and it smells fragrant, then it's ready

cues.zh: 这个时候放进来一磅的猪肉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 bang4 de5 zhu1 rou4
cues.en: Now add in one pound of pork

cues.zh: 用大火炒到八成熟
cues.pinyin: yong4 da4 huo3 chao3 dao4 ba1 cheng2 shu2
cues.en: Stir-fry on high heat until it's about 80% cooked

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 泰式著名打抛猪肉 |一生必吃|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 这时我们的猪肉就已经熟了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 wo3 men5 de5 zhu1 rou4 jiu4 yi3 jing1 shu2 le5
cues.en: At this point our pork is already cooked

cues.zh: 最后我们放进来一把九层塔
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 ba3 jiu3 ceng2 ta3
cues.en: Finally, we add in a handful of holy basil

cues.zh: 那当然这个九层塔呢
cues.pinyin: na4 dang1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 jiu3 ceng2 ta3 ne5
cues.en: And of course, this holy basil

cues.zh: 应该是要使用泰式的九层塔
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 yao4 shi3 yong4 tai4 shi4 de5 jiu3 ceng2 ta3
cues.en: should ideally be Thai holy basil

cues.zh: 可是呢我真的是找不到
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ne5 wo3 zhen1 de5 shi4 zhao3 bu2 dao4
cues.en: But I really couldn't find any

cues.zh: 我家原本呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 jia1 yuan2 ben3 ne5
cues.en: Near my house originally

cues.zh: 这附近还有一家中国超市
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fu4 jin4 hai2 you3 yi1 jia1 zhong1 guo2 chao1 shi4
cues.en: there was also a Chinese supermarket nearby

cues.zh: 可以卖到各式各样亚洲的食品
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 mai4 dao4 ge4 shi4 ge4 yang4 ya4 zhou1 de5 shi2 pin3
cues.en: that sold all kinds of Asian food products

cues.zh: 可是你知道怎么了吗
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 zen3 me5 le5 ma5
cues.en: But you know what happened?

cues.zh: 它关了
cues.pinyin: ta1 guan1 le5
cues.en: It closed down

cues.zh: 所以呢如果你要是这个超市的老板
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ne5 ru2 guo3 ni3 yao4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 chao1 shi4 de5 lao3 ban3
cues.en: So if you happen to be a supermarket owner

cues.zh: 然后卖亚洲食物的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 mai4 ya4 zhou1 shi2 wu4 de5
cues.en: who sells Asian food

cues.zh: 在我们家附近赶快开一家吧
cues.pinyin: zai4 wo3 men5 jia1 fu4 jin4 gan3 kuai4 kai1 yi1 jia1 ba5
cues.en: please hurry up and open one near us!

cues.zh: 在另外一个锅里呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 li3 ne5
cues.en: In another pan

cues.zh: 我们加进来半杯油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia1 jin4 lai2 ban4 bei1 you2
cues.en: we add in half a cup of oil

cues.zh: 然后把它烧热
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 shao1 re4
cues.en: and heat it up

cues.zh: 放进来一粒蛋
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 li4 dan4
cues.en: Add in one egg

cues.zh: 给它炸到下面和旁边都变成金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zha4 dao4 xia4 mian4 he2 pang2 bian1 dou1 bian4 cheng2 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: and fry it until the bottom and edges turn golden brown

cues.zh: 一道菜呢可以带给人许多的美好童年回忆
cues.pinyin: yi1 dao4 cai4 ne5 ke3 yi3 dai4 gei3 ren2 xu3 duo1 de5 mei3 hao3 tong2 nian2 hui2 yi4
cues.en: A dish can bring people many wonderful childhood memories

cues.zh: 那这道猪肉九层塔呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 dao4 zhu1 rou4 jiu3 ceng2 ta3 ne5
cues.en: And this pork holy basil dish

cues.zh: 就带给我了许多美好在泰国时候的回忆
cues.pinyin: jiu4 dai4 gei3 wo3 le5 xu3 duo1 mei3 hao3 zai4 tai4 guo2 shi2 hou4 de5 hui2 yi4
cues.en: brought me many wonderful memories of my time in Thailand

cues.zh: 今天这时候放学啊肚子饿了
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhe4 shi2 hou4 fang4 xue2 a5 du4 zi5 e4 le5
cues.en: Back then, after school when I was hungry

cues.zh: 最想吃的就是这道路边摊卖的猪肉九层塔
cues.pinyin: zui4 xiang3 chi1 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 dao4 lu4 bian1 tan1 mai4 de5 zhu1 rou4 jiu3 ceng2 ta3
cues.en: what I wanted to eat most was this pork holy basil sold at the roadside stall

cues.zh: 然后上面放一个炸鸡蛋
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 shang4 mian4 fang4 yi2 ge4 zha2 ji1 dan4
cues.en: with a fried egg on top

cues.zh: 真的很好吃美味无穷
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 hen3 hao3 chi1 mei3 wei4 wu2 qiong2
cues.en: It was truly delicious, endlessly tasty

cues.zh: 所以我希望大家能喜欢这个食谱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 neng2 xi3 huan1 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3
cues.en: So I hope everyone will like this recipe

cues.zh: 那别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: na4 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: and don't forget to subscribe and like

cues.zh: 我们下期见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 ge1
cues.en: See you next time

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 上一回咱们讲了病毒是如何感
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 hui2 zan2 men5 jiang3 le5 bing4 du2 shi4 ru2 he2 gan3
cues.en: Last time, we talked about how a virus infects

cues.zh: 染一个细胞的
cues.pinyin: ran3 yi2 ge4 xi4 bao1 de5
cues.en: a cell.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A young friend asked me,

cues.zh: 他最近在看一部剧名字叫做血液
cues.pinyin: ta1 zui4 jin4 zai4 kan4 yi1 bu4 ju4 ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 xue4 ye4
cues.en: he's recently been watching a show called "Blood

cues.zh: 里面讲到一种病毒叫做埃博拉病毒
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 jiang3 dao4 yi1 zhong3 bing4 du2 jiao4 zuo4 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2
cues.en: It mentions a virus called Ebola virus.

cues.zh: 埃博拉病毒真的有这么可怕吗
cues.pinyin: ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2 zhen1 de5 you3 zhe4 me5 ke3 pa4 ma5
cues.en: Is Ebola virus really that terrifying?

cues.zh: 人们有没有办法去对付它呢
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 you3 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 qu4 dui4 fu4 ta1 ne5
cues.en: Is there any way for people to deal with it?

cues.zh: 今天咱们就来讲一讲埃博拉病毒
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zan2 men5 jiu4 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2
cues.en: Today let's talk about Ebola virus.

cues.zh: 我们首先先来说一说埃博拉病毒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2
cues.en: First, let's talk about Ebola virus's

cues.zh: 在历史上的几次比较大的流行
cues.pinyin: zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 de5 ji3 ci4 bi3 jiao4 da4 de5 liu2 xing2
cues.en: several major outbreaks in history —

cues.zh: 埃博拉的流行
cues.pinyin: ai1 bo2 la1 de5 liu2 xing2
cues.en: Ebola outbreaks.

cues.zh: 最早埃博拉是在 19 76 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zui4 zao3 ai1 bo2 la1 shi4 zai4 19 76 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Ebola was first discovered in 1976

cues.zh: 在扎伊尔发现的
cues.pinyin: zai4 zha1 yi1 er3 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: in Zaire.

cues.zh: 扎伊尔就是现在的刚果金
cues.pinyin: zha1 yi1 er3 jiu4 shi4 xian4 zai4 de5 gang1 guo3 jin1
cues.en: Zaire is now the Democratic Republic of Congo.

cues.zh: 在扎伊尔有一个小村子
cues.pinyin: zai4 zha1 yi1 er3 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 cun1 zi5
cues.en: There was a small village in Zaire

cues.zh: 名字叫雅布库
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 ya3 bu4 ku4
cues.en: called Yambuku.

cues.zh: 这个雅布库这个村子里面有一个学校
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ya3 bu4 ku4 zhe4 ge5 cun1 zi5 li3 mian4 you3 yi2 ge4 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: In this village of Yambuku there was a school.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 这学校有个校长
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xue2 xiao4 you3 ge4 xiao4 zhang3
cues.en: The school had a principal.

cues.zh: 有一天校长到扎伊尔的北部去旅游
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao4 zhang3 dao4 zha1 yi1 er3 de5 bei3 bu4 qu4 lv3 you2
cues.en: One day the principal traveled to northern Zaire.

cues.zh: 然后回来的时候就发现自己好像是发烧了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hui2 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 hao3 xiang4 shi4 fa1 shao1 le5
cues.en: When he came back, he found he seemed to have a fever.

cues.zh: 这校长在 8 月 26 号的时候
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiao4 zhang3 zai4 8 yue4 26 hao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: On August 26th,

cues.zh: 他发现自己发烧了发烧了之后就去医院吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 fa1 shao1 le5 fa1 shao1 le5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 qu4 yi1 yuan4 ba5
cues.en: he realized he had a fever, and afterward he went to the hospital.

cues.zh: 医院也看不出来是什么毛病
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 ye3 kan4 bu4 chu1 lai2 shi4 shen2 me5 mao2 bing4
cues.en: The hospital couldn't figure out what was wrong.

cues.zh: 就觉得这个人可能是得了疟疾
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 ke3 neng2 shi4 de2 le5 nve4 ji2
cues.en: They thought he might have malaria.

cues.zh: 于是就给他开了一些奎宁让他回家去养着
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 gei3 ta1 kai1 le5 yi1 xie1 kui2 ning2 rang4 ta1 hui2 jia1 qu4 yang3 zhe5
cues.en: So they prescribed him some quinine and sent him home to recover.

cues.zh: 回去之后过了两天发现不行然后住院
cues.pinyin: hui2 qu4 zhi1 hou4 guo4 le5 liang3 tian1 fa1 xian4 bu4 xing2 ran2 hou4 zhu4 yuan4
cues.en: After going home, two days later he got worse and was hospitalized.

cues.zh: 9 月 5 号的时候他到了一个教会医
cues.pinyin: 9 yue4 5 hao4 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 jiao4 hui4 yi1
cues.en: On September 5th he went to a mission hos-

cues.zh: 院里面去住院
cues.pinyin: yuan4 li3 mian4 qu4 zhu4 yuan4
cues.en: -pital to be admitted.

cues.zh: 结果住了一段时间
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhu4 le5 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: After staying there for a while,

cues.zh: 到了 9 月 8 号的时候就死亡了
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 9 yue4 8 hao4 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 si3 wang2 le5
cues.en: he died on September 8th.

cues.zh: 而且死状还非常的恐怖
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 si3 zhuang4 hai2 fei1 chang2 de5 kong3 bu4
cues.en: And the way he died was extremely horrifying.

cues.zh: 那么他死了之后那些照顾他的那些修女
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 si3 le5 zhi1 hou4 na4 xie1 zhao4 gu4 ta1 de5 na4 xie1 xiu1 nv3
cues.en: After he died, the nuns who had cared for him,

cues.zh: 还有他的一些亲戚们也陆续患病
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ta1 de5 yi1 xie1 qin1 qi1 men5 ye3 lu4 xu4 huan4 bing4
cues.en: as well as some of his relatives, also became sick one after another.

cues.zh: 然后很快的有大面积的人死亡
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hen3 kuai4 de5 you3 da4 mian4 ji1 de5 ren2 si3 wang2
cues.en: Then very quickly a large number of people died.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 当时有一个修女去世了之后
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 you3 yi2 ge4 xiu1 nv3 qu4 shi4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: At that time, after a nun passed away,

cues.zh: 有一个医生他把这个修女的血
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1 ta1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xiu1 nv3 de5 xue4
cues.en: a doctor preserved this nun's blood

cues.zh: 液给保存下来
cues.pinyin: ye4 gei3 bao3 cun2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: sample.

cues.zh: 然后送到了这个比利时
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 song4 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 bi3 li4 shi2
cues.en: Then it was sent to Belgium.

cues.zh: 当时在比利时有一个病毒研究所
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 zai4 bi3 li4 shi2 you3 yi2 ge4 bing4 du2 yan2 jiu1 suo3
cues.en: At that time there was a virus research institute in Belgium.

cues.zh: 这个比利时这个病毒研究所里面
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bi3 li4 shi2 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2 yan2 jiu1 suo3 li3 mian4
cues.en: In this Belgian virus research institute

cues.zh: 有一个很年轻的一个科学家
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 hen3 nian2 qing1 de5 yi2 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: there was a very young scientist.

cues.zh: 这个科学家名字叫做皮奥特
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ke1 xue2 jia1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 pi2 ao4 te4
cues.en: This scientist's name was Piot.

cues.zh: 那么皮奥特现在已经是世卫组织里面
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 pi2 ao4 te4 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 shi4 shi4 wei4 zu3 zhi1 li3 mian4
cues.en: Piot is now at the WHO,

cues.zh: 研究艾滋病的这样的一个科学家了
cues.pinyin: yan2 jiu1 ai4 zi1 bing4 de5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1 le5
cues.en: a scientist who researches AIDS.

cues.zh: 这个皮奥特当时只有 27 岁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 pi2 ao4 te4 dang1 shi2 zhi3 you3 27 sui4
cues.en: Piot was only 27 years old at the time.

cues.zh: 他拿到了这个样本之后就观察
cues.pinyin: ta1 na2 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 yang4 ben3 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 guan1 cha2
cues.en: After he got the sample, he observed it,

cues.zh: 结果发现了一种丝状病毒
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 zhong3 si1 zhuang4 bing4 du2
cues.en: and found a filamentous virus.

cues.zh: 这个丝状病毒和我们以前看到的病
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 si1 zhuang4 bing4 du2 he2 wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 kan4 dao4 de5 bing4
cues.en: This filamentous virus was different from the vi-

cues.zh: 毒都不太一样
cues.pinyin: du2 dou1 bu4 tai4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: -ruses we had seen before.

cues.zh: 所以他认定说这是一种新的病毒
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 ren4 ding4 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 xin1 de5 bing4 du2
cues.en: So he concluded it was a new virus.

cues.zh: 紧跟着皮奥特就来到了扎伊尔
cues.pinyin: jin3 gen1 zhe5 pi2 ao4 te4 jiu4 lai2 dao4 le5 zha1 yi1 er3
cues.en: Right after that, Piot went to Zaire.

cues.zh: 到扎伊尔之后去研究这个病是怎么传播的
cues.pinyin: dao4 zha1 yi1 er3 zhi1 hou4 qu4 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 bing4 shi4 zen3 me5 chuan2 bo1 de5
cues.en: After arriving in Zaire, he studied how the disease spread.

cues.zh: 结果发现很多死的人
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 hen3 duo1 si3 de5 ren2
cues.en: He found that many people had died.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 最后这一场瘟疫一共在扎伊尔造成了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhe4 yi1 chang2 wen1 yi4 yi1 gong4 zai4 zha1 yi1 er3 zao4 cheng2 le5
cues.en: In the end, this epidemic caused in Zaire

cues.zh: 3 18 人的感染
cues.pinyin: 3 18 ren2 de5 gan3 ran3
cues.en: 318 infections.

cues.zh: 3 18 人的感染
cues.pinyin: 3 18 ren2 de5 gan3 ran3
cues.en: 318 infections,

cues.zh: 然后死了 2 80 个人
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 si3 le5 2 80 ge4 ren2
cues.en: and then 280 deaths.

cues.zh: 死亡率接近 90
cues.pinyin: si3 wang2 lv4 jie1 jin4 90
cues.en: The mortality rate was nearly 90%.

cues.zh: 这个死亡率真是太高了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 si3 wang2 lv4 zhen1 shi4 tai4 gao1 le5
cues.en: This mortality rate is really too high.

cues.zh: 我们知道这个狂犬病
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 kuang2 quan3 bing4
cues.en: We know that rabies,

cues.zh: 在没有疫苗的情况下
cues.pinyin: zai4 mei2 you3 yi4 miao2 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: without a vaccine,

cues.zh: 一旦发病致死率 100
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 fa1 bing4 zhi4 si3 lv4 100
cues.en: once symptoms appear, has a 100% fatality rate.

cues.zh: 但是我们有疫苗
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 you3 yi4 miao2
cues.en: But we have a vaccine.

cues.zh: 可以在被狗咬了之后去打疫苗
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 bei4 gou3 yao3 le5 zhi1 hou4 qu4 da3 yi4 miao2
cues.en: We can get vaccinated after being bitten by a dog,

cues.zh: 我们就不会发病了对不对
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 bu2 hui4 fa1 bing4 le5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: and then we won't get sick, right?

cues.zh: 所以我们没有那么害怕
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 mei2 you3 na4 me5 hai4 pa4
cues.en: So we're not that afraid of it.

cues.zh: 但是面对这种新的病毒
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mian4 dui4 zhe4 zhong3 xin1 de5 bing4 du2
cues.en: But when facing this new virus,

cues.zh: 完全没有疫苗
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 yi4 miao2
cues.en: there was no vaccine at all.

cues.zh: 一旦感染了之后
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 gan3 ran3 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once infected,

cues.zh: 90 的死亡率人人都非常害怕
cues.pinyin: 90 de5 si3 wang2 lv4 ren2 ren2 dou1 fei1 chang2 hai4 pa4
cues.en: a 90% mortality rate made everyone extremely afraid.

cues.zh: 而且那在几十年的时间里面
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 na4 zai4 ji3 shi2 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1 li3 mian4
cues.en: And over the following decades,

cues.zh: 非洲大地每隔一段时间
cues.pinyin: fei1 zhou1 da4 di4 mei3 ge2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: every so often on the African continent

cues.zh: 就会冒出来一次
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 mao4 chu1 lai2 yi1 ci4
cues.en: there would be another outbreak

cues.zh: 这个埃博拉病毒的流行是吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2 de5 liu2 xing2 shi4 ba5
cues.en: of this Ebola virus epidemic.

cues.zh: 所以费州真是多灾作难
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 fei4 zhou1 zhen1 shi4 duo1 zai1 zuo4 nan2
cues.en: So Africa has really suffered one disaster after another.

cues.zh: 那么当时皮奥特做完了这个隔离之后
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dang1 shi2 pi2 ao4 te4 zuo4 wan2 le5 zhe4 ge5 ge2 li2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: At that time, after Piot finished the quarantine work,

cues.zh: 做完了这次处理之后他就回到了比利时
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wan2 le5 zhe4 ci4 chu3 li3 zhi1 hou4 ta1 jiu4 hui2 dao4 le5 bi3 li4 shi2
cues.en: after completing this response, he returned to Belgium.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 他在这个扎伊尔做的最后一件事
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 zha1 yi1 er3 zuo4 de5 zui4 hou4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: The last thing he did in Zaire

cues.zh: 就是给这个病毒命名
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 gei3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2 ming4 ming2
cues.en: was to name this virus.

cues.zh: 当然这个病毒是发生在雅伯库这个小村子
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2 shi4 fa1 sheng1 zai4 ya3 bo2 ku4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 cun1 zi5
cues.en: Of course, this virus occurred in the small village of Yambuku,

cues.zh: 所以按说应该叫雅伯库病毒对吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 an4 shuo1 ying1 gai1 jiao4 ya3 bo2 ku4 bing4 du2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: so logically it should be called "Yambuku virus," right?

cues.zh: 不过他不想让这个村子背负骂名
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 bu4 xiang3 rang4 zhe4 ge5 cun1 zi5 bei1 fu4 ma4 ming2
cues.en: But he didn't want the village to bear a bad reputation.

cues.zh: 在这个村子旁边有一条河流叫埃博拉河
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 cun1 zi5 pang2 bian1 you3 yi1 tiao2 he2 liu2 jiao4 ai1 bo2 la1 he2
cues.en: Next to this village there was a river called the Ebola River,

cues.zh: 于是就以这条河的名字来命名这种病毒
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 yi3 zhe4 tiao2 he2 de5 ming2 zi4 lai2 ming4 ming2 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 du2
cues.en: so he named the virus after this river.

cues.zh: 我们就叫它埃博拉病毒了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 jiao4 ta1 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2 le5
cues.en: That's why we call it the Ebola virus.

cues.zh: 埃博拉病毒到现在为止
cues.pinyin: ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2 dao4 xian4 zai4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Up until now, the Ebola virus

cues.zh: 出现的时间已经不短了
cues.pinyin: chu1 xian4 de5 shi2 jian1 yi3 jing1 bu4 duan3 le5
cues.en: has existed for quite a long time.

cues.zh: 不过很长时间以来
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hen3 zhang3 shi2 jian1 yi3 lai2
cues.en: But for a long time,

cues.zh: 西方世界对它都没有什么重视
cues.pinyin: xi1 fang1 shi4 jie4 dui4 ta1 dou1 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 zhong4 shi4
cues.en: the Western world didn't pay much attention to it.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 因为这种病毒它就只在非洲流行
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 du2 ta1 jiu4 zhi3 zai4 fei1 zhou1 liu2 xing2
cues.en: Because this virus only spread in Africa.

cues.zh: 在非洲以外的国家从来就没有人感染
cues.pinyin: zai4 fei1 zhou1 yi3 wai4 de5 guo2 jia1 cong2 lai2 jiu4 mei2 you3 ren2 gan3 ran3
cues.en: Outside of Africa, no one had ever been infected.

cues.zh: 所以西方的科学家们宁可把钱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xi1 fang1 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 ning4 ke3 ba3 qian2
cues.en: So Western scientists would rather put their money

cues.zh: 投向流感病毒
cues.pinyin: tou2 xiang4 liu2 gan3 bing4 du2
cues.en: into influenza virus research

cues.zh: 投向一些西方人常见的病毒
cues.pinyin: tou2 xiang4 yi1 xie1 xi1 fang1 ren2 chang2 jian4 de5 bing4 du2
cues.en: and into viruses common among Westerners,

cues.zh: 他不会去投这个埃博拉病毒
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 hui4 qu4 tou2 zhe4 ge5 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2
cues.en: rather than invest in Ebola virus research.

cues.zh: 而且埃博拉病毒到现在为止
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ai1 bo2 la1 bing4 du2 dao4 xian4 zai4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: And up until now, the Ebola virus

cues.zh: 死的人数并不多
cues.pinyin: si3 de5 ren2 shu4 bing4 bu4 duo1
cues.en: hadn't caused that many deaths.

cues.zh: 属于一种所谓的罕见病
cues.pinyin: shu3 yu2 yi1 zhong3 suo3 wei4 de5 han3 jian4 bing4
cues.en: It's considered a so-called "rare disease."

cues.zh: 那么为罕见病投入研发的这个经费的话
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 han3 jian4 bing4 tou2 ru4 yan2 fa1 de5 zhe4 ge5 jing1 fei4 de5 hua4
cues.en: As for the research funding invested in rare diseases,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频了解埃博拉病毒的前世今生

cues.zh: 结果去世了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 qu4 shi4 le5
cues.en: ...he ended up passing away.

cues.zh: 他去世了之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 qu4 shi4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After he passed away,

cues.zh: 他的姐姐以及他们的家人首先发生了感染
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 jie3 jie3 yi3 ji2 ta1 men5 de5 jia1 ren2 shou3 xian1 fa1 sheng1 le5 gan3 ran3
cues.en: his sister and their family were the first to get infected,

cues.zh: 然后也去世了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 qu4 shi4 le5
cues.en: and they also passed away.

cues.zh: 很多村子里的人来参加他们村子
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 cun1 zi5 li3 de5 ren2 lai2 can1 jia1 ta1 men5 cun1 zi5
cues.en: Many people from the village came to attend their village's

cues.zh: 里的人的葬礼
cues.pinyin: li3 de5 ren2 de5 zang4 li3
cues.en: funeral for those who had died.

cues.zh: 结果把这些病毒就扩散开来了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ba3 zhe4 xie1 bing4 du2 jiu4 kuo4 san4 kai1 lai2 le5
cues.en: As a result, the virus spread.

cues.zh: 而且他这个村子所在的位置
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 zhe4 ge5 cun1 zi5 suo3 zai4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: And the location of this village

cues.zh: 正好是在几内亚利比利亚和塞拉利昂
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hao3 shi4 zai4 ji3 nei4 ya4 li4 bi3 li4 ya4 he2 sai1 la1 li4 ang2
cues.en: happened to be right at the border of Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone,

cues.zh: 三个国家交界的那个位置上
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 guo2 jia1 jiao1 jie4 de5 na4 ge5 wei4 zhi4 shang4
cues.en: where the three countries meet.

cues.zh: 所以这三个国家同时爆发了爱博拉流行
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 san1 ge4 guo2 jia1 tong2 shi2 bao4 fa1 le5 ai4 bo2 la1 liu2 xing2
cues.en: So Ebola outbreaks erupted in all three countries at the same time.

cues.zh: 这三个国家的首都纷纷沦陷
cues.pinyin: zhe4 san1 ge4 guo2 jia1 de5 shou3 du1 fen1 fen1 lun2 xian4
cues.en: The capitals of these three countries fell one after another.

cues.zh: 总统们纷纷宣布说自己的国家
cues.pinyin: zong3 tong3 men5 fen1 fen1 xuan1 bu4 shuo1 zi4 ji3 de5 guo2 jia1
cues.en: The presidents each declared that their countries

cues.zh: 处于紧急状态
cues.pinyin: chu3 yu2 jin3 ji2 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: were in a state of emergency.

cues.zh: 但是也没有用
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: But it didn't help.

cues.zh: 为了控制疾病流行
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 kong4 zhi4 ji2 bing4 liu2 xing2
cues.en: In order to control the spread of the disease,

cues.zh: 这非洲国家的政府采取了很多的措施
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fei1 zhou1 guo2 jia1 de5 zheng4 fu3 cai3 qu3 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 cuo4 shi1
cues.en: these African governments took many measures.

cues.zh: 但是我们知道这个非洲的民众
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 fei1 zhou1 de5 min2 zhong4
cues.en: But we know that the African public,

cues.zh: 很多他不开话
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ta1 bu4 kai1 hua4
cues.en: many of them wouldn't listen,

cues.zh: 他不相信政府不信政府
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang1 xin4 zheng4 fu3 bu4 xin4 zheng4 fu3
cues.en: they didn't trust the government, didn't believe the government.

cues.zh: 他觉得政府这种措施是不对的
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 zheng4 fu3 zhe4 zhong3 cuo4 shi1 shi4 bu2 dui4 de5
cues.en: They felt these government measures were wrong.

cues.zh: 所以不信
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bu4 xin4
cues.en: So they didn't believe it.

cues.zh: 因此政府让他们上医院他们也不去
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 zheng4 fu3 rang4 ta1 men5 shang4 yi1 yuan4 ta1 men5 ye3 bu4 qu4
cues.en: So even when the government told them to go to the hospital, they wouldn't go.

cues.zh: 为什么不去呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 qu4 ne5
cues.en: Why wouldn't they go?

cues.zh: 他们觉得这个人送到医院之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: They felt that once someone was sent to the hospital,

cues.zh: 就没见着活着出来的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 jian4 zhe5 huo2 zhe5 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: they never saw anyone come out alive.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 冰钓老爹带崽整活
cues.pinyin: bing1 diao4 lao3 die1 dai4 zai3 zheng3 huo2
cues.en: An ice-fishing dad and his kid are at it again.

cues.zh: 钻头下去竟被冰面开个血盆大口
cues.pinyin: zuan4 tou2 xia4 qu4 jing4 bei4 bing1 mian4 kai1 ge4 xue4 pen2 da4 kou3
cues.en: The drill broke through, and the ice split open into a huge bloody mouth.

cues.zh: 合着湖底在搞冬日限定血旺火锅局
cues.pinyin: he2 zhe5 hu2 di3 zai4 gao3 dong1 ri4 xian4 ding4 xue4 wang4 huo3 guo1 ju2
cues.en: Turns out the lake bottom was running a winter-only blood-tofu hotpot special.

cues.zh: 然而下一秒却上演冰雪奇缘惊魂版
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 xia4 yi1 miao3 que4 shang4 yan3 bing1 xue3 qi2 yuan2 jing1 hun2 ban3
cues.en: But what happened next played out like a horror version of Frozen.

cues.zh: 而这一切的背后竟和一桩恩怨有关
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 yi1 qie4 de5 bei4 hou4 jing4 he2 yi1 zhuang1 en1 yuan4 you3 guan1
cues.en: And behind it all was actually a long-standing grudge.

cues.zh: 在案件发生前警员老布正全身心投入
cues.pinyin: zai4 an4 jian4 fa1 sheng1 qian2 jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 zheng4 quan2 shen1 xin1 tou2 ru4
cues.en: Before the case began, officer Lao Bu was fully absorbed

cues.zh: 到一场激烈的
cues.pinyin: dao4 yi1 chang2 ji1 lie4 de5
cues.en: in an intense

cues.zh: 冰球比赛状况
cues.pinyin: bing1 qiu2 bi3 sai4 zhuang4 kuang4
cues.en: ice hockey match.

cues.zh: 老布在冰球场上活向头被点燃的灰熊球杆
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zai4 bing1 qiu2 chang3 shang4 huo2 xiang4 tou2 bei4 dian3 ran2 de5 hui1 xiong2 qiu2 gan1
cues.en: On the rink, Lao Bu looked like a grizzly bear on fire, his stick

cues.zh: 挥得像风火轮
cues.pinyin: hui1 de2 xiang4 feng1 huo3 lun2
cues.en: swinging like a wheel of flame.

cues.zh: 谁知队友突然被敌方球员约翰一记扫
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dui4 you3 tu1 ran2 bei4 di2 fang1 qiu2 yuan2 yue1 han4 yi1 ji4 sao3
cues.en: Then a teammate suddenly got swept

cues.zh: 堂腿掀翻在地
cues.pinyin: tang2 tui3 xian1 fan1 zai4 di4
cues.en: off his feet by a leg sweep from rival player John,

cues.zh: 活像被推倒的多米诺骨牌
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 bei4 tui1 dao4 de5 duo1 mi3 nuo4 gu3 pai2
cues.en: toppling like a knocked-over domino.

cues.zh: 老布当场扎毛跟约翰发生激烈冲突
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 dang1 chang3 zha1 mao2 gen1 yue1 han4 fa1 sheng1 ji1 lie4 chong1 tu1
cues.en: On the spot, Lao Bu lost it and clashed with John head-on.

cues.zh: 周围球员全都围在一起看好戏
cues.pinyin: zhou1 wei2 qiu2 yuan2 quan2 dou1 wei2 zai4 yi4 qi3 kan4 hao3 xi4
cues.en: All the players around them gathered to watch the show.

cues.zh: 谁知裁判却吹哨说老布犯规
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 cai2 pan4 que4 chui1 shao4 shuo1 lao3 bu4 fan4 gui1
cues.en: But then the referee blew the whistle, calling it on Lao Bu.

cues.zh: 黑哨直接将他罚进小黑屋
cues.pinyin: hei1 shao4 zhi2 jie1 jiang1 ta1 fa2 jin4 xiao3 hei1 wu1
cues.en: The biased ref sent him straight to the penalty box.

cues.zh: 而约翰还在继续使坏
cues.pinyin: er2 yue1 han4 hai2 zai4 ji4 xu4 shi3 huai4
cues.en: Meanwhile John kept stirring up trouble,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 故意把另一个队友撞倒在地
cues.pinyin: gu4 yi4 ba3 ling4 yi2 ge4 dui4 you3 zhuang4 dao4 zai4 di4
cues.en: deliberately knocking another teammate to the ground

cues.zh: 还冲老布挑衅
cues.pinyin: hai2 chong1 lao3 bu4 tiao3 xin4
cues.en: and taunting Lao Bu on top of it.

cues.zh: 老布这暴脾气哪忍得住
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zhe4 bao4 pi2 qi4 na3 ren3 de2 zhu4
cues.en: With that temper, how could Lao Bu hold back?

cues.zh: 直接冲出罚球区
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 chong1 chu1 fa2 qiu2 qu1
cues.en: He stormed straight out of the penalty box

cues.zh: 将约翰打成了孙子
cues.pinyin: jiang1 yue1 han4 da3 cheng2 le5 sun1 zi5
cues.en: and beat John into submission.

cues.zh: 赛后法一小谷急匆匆闯进南庚一室
cues.pinyin: sai4 hou4 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 ji2 cong1 cong1 chuang3 jin4 nan2 geng1 yi1 shi4
cues.en: After the game, forensic examiner Xiao Gu rushed into the locker room,

cues.zh: 老布却以男女授受不亲为由
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 que4 yi3 nan2 nv3 shou4 shou4 bu4 qin1 wei4 you2
cues.en: but Lao Bu, citing "men and women shouldn't touch,"

cues.zh: 赶紧把人往外推
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 ba3 ren2 wang3 wai4 tui1
cues.en: hurried to push her out,

cues.zh: 活像在赶偷鱼的猫
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 zai4 gan3 tou1 yu2 de5 mao1
cues.en: like a cat chasing off a fish thief.

cues.zh: 然而谁都没想到
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 shei2 dou1 mei2 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: Yet no one could have guessed

cues.zh: 冰球场上那场火星四溅的冲突
cues.pinyin: bing1 qiu2 chang3 shang4 na4 chang3 huo3 xing1 si4 jian4 de5 chong1 tu1
cues.en: that the sparks-flying clash on the rink

cues.zh: 竟成了打开悬疑局的钥匙
cues.pinyin: jing4 cheng2 le5 da3 kai1 xuan2 yi2 ju2 de5 yao4 shi5
cues.en: would become the key that unlocked the whole mystery.

cues.zh: 接到父子俩的报警时
cues.pinyin: jie1 dao4 fu4 zi3 lia3 de5 bao4 jing3 shi2
cues.en: When the call about the father and son came in,

cues.zh: 老布正往伤口贴创可贴
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zheng4 wang3 shang1 kou3 tie1 chuang4 ke3 tie1
cues.en: Lao Bu was putting a band-aid on his wound —

cues.zh: 那是和约翰互殴时蹭的皮外伤
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 he2 yue1 han4 hu4 ou1 shi2 ceng4 de5 pi2 wai4 shang1
cues.en: just a scrape from brawling with John.

cues.zh: 现在却像提前盖好了嫌疑人印章
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 que4 xiang4 ti2 qian2 gai4 hao3 le5 xian2 yi2 ren2 yin4 zhang1
cues.en: Now it looked like a pre-stamped seal marking him as a suspect.

cues.zh: 小谷根据尸体判断
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 gen1 ju4 shi1 ti3 pan4 duan4
cues.en: Based on the body, Xiao Gu determined

cues.zh: 这人在湖面结冰前就成了水下住户
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ren2 zai4 hu2 mian4 jie2 bing1 qian2 jiu4 cheng2 le5 shui3 xia4 zhu4 hu4
cues.en: the man had already been underwater before the lake froze over.

cues.zh: 等湖水冻成玻璃盖子
cues.pinyin: deng3 hu2 shui3 dong4 cheng2 bo1 li2 gai4 zi5
cues.en: Once the lake water froze into a glass lid,

cues.zh: 尸体像浮冰奶茶里的珍珠一样飘上来
cues.pinyin: shi1 ti3 xiang4 fu2 bing1 nai3 cha2 li3 de5 zhen1 zhu1 yi1 yang4 piao1 shang4 lai2
cues.en: the body floated up like a pearl in iced bubble tea.

cues.zh: 而死者脸上的冰印
cues.pinyin: er2 si3 zhe3 lian3 shang4 de5 bing1 yin4
cues.en: And there was an ice imprint on the victim's face.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 约翰死亡时间在湖面结冰前五天
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 si3 wang2 shi2 jian1 zai4 hu2 mian4 jie2 bing1 qian2 wu3 tian1
cues.en: John died five days before the lake froze.

cues.zh: 和老布揍人的档期精准撞上
cues.pinyin: he2 lao3 bu4 zou4 ren2 de5 dang4 qi1 jing1 zhun3 zhuang4 shang4
cues.en: That window lines up exactly with when Lao Bu beat him up.

cues.zh: 昆虫学家豪金连忙说道
cues.pinyin: kun1 chong2 xue2 jia1 hao2 jin1 lian2 mang2 shuo1 dao4
cues.en: The entomologist, Hawkins, quickly spoke up:

cues.zh: 胃里除了蚊子幼虫
cues.pinyin: wei4 li3 chu2 le5 wen2 zi5 you4 chong2
cues.en: "Besides mosquito larvae in his stomach,

cues.zh: 还有半消化的热狗
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ban4 xiao1 hua4 de5 re4 gou3
cues.en: there's also a half-digested hot dog."

cues.zh: 凶手怕不是请他吃完宵夜
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 pa4 bu2 shi4 qing3 ta1 chi1 wan2 xiao1 ye4
cues.en: "The killer probably treated him to a midnight snack first,

cues.zh: 再送份湖面豪华抛尸套餐
cues.pinyin: zai4 song4 fen4 hu2 mian4 hao2 hua2 pao1 shi1 tao4 can1
cues.en: then served up a deluxe lake-dumping combo."

cues.zh: 远毛突然表示
cues.pinyin: yuan3 mao2 tu1 ran2 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Yuan Mao suddenly chimed in,

cues.zh: 这上等我被约翰扫堂腿撂倒时的瘀青
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shang4 deng3 wo3 bei4 yue1 han4 sao3 tang2 tui3 liao4 dao4 shi2 de5 yu1 qing1
cues.en: "This is the bruise from when John swept me off my feet —

cues.zh: 简直暴力美学双胞胎
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 bao4 li4 mei3 xue2 shuang1 bao1 tai1
cues.en: we're practically violence-aesthetics twins."

cues.zh: 卡米尔立刻泼冷水
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 li4 ke4 po1 leng3 shui3
cues.en: Camille immediately threw cold water on that:

cues.zh: 你妈拿鸡毛胆子盯着你养伤
cues.pinyin: ni3 ma1 na2 ji1 mao2 dan3 zi5 ding1 zhe5 ni3 yang3 shang1
cues.en: "That's just you playing up a trivial excuse to cover your recovery."

cues.zh: 不在场证明比溜冰场冰面还光滑
cues.pinyin: bu4 zai4 chang3 zheng4 ming2 bi3 liu1 bing1 chang3 bing1 mian4 hai2 guang1 hua2
cues.en: "Your alibi is smoother than a skating rink."

cues.zh: 卡米尔就唱拿放大镜对着死者左眼
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 jiu4 chang4 na2 fang4 da4 jing4 dui4 zhe5 si3 zhe3 zuo3 yan3
cues.en: Camille then held a magnifying glass right up to the victim's left eye.

cues.zh: 而约翰的真正死因竟是泪线穿孔
cues.pinyin: er2 yue1 han4 de5 zhen1 zheng4 si3 yin1 jing4 shi4 lei4 xian4 chuan1 kong3
cues.en: John's real cause of death turned out to be a punctured tear duct.

cues.zh: 这凶器得锋利到能玩人体绣花针才行
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiong1 qi4 de2 feng1 li4 dao4 neng2 wan2 ren2 ti3 xiu4 hua1 zhen1 cai2 xing2
cues.en: The weapon had to be sharp enough to do embroidery on a human body.

cues.zh: 老布那大老粗可干不出这手艺
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 na4 da4 lao3 cu1 ke3 gan4 bu4 chu1 zhe4 shou3 yi4
cues.en: There's no way ham-fisted Lao Bu could pull off that kind of skill.

cues.zh: 眼看案件陷入僵局
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 an4 jian4 xian4 ru4 jiang1 ju2
cues.en: Just as the case hit a dead end,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 艾琳这才大大出手
cues.pinyin: ai4 lin2 zhe4 cai2 da4 da4 chu1 shou3
cues.en: Erin finally decided to step in big time.

cues.zh: 谁知话没说完突然抿嘴笑
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 hua4 mei2 shuo1 wan2 tu1 ran2 min3 zui3 xiao4
cues.en: But before she could finish talking, she suddenly smirked.

cues.zh: 艾琳突然发现
cues.pinyin: ai4 lin2 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Erin suddenly realized

cues.zh: 但凡提到小谷
cues.pinyin: dan4 fan2 ti2 dao4 xiao3 gu3
cues.en: that whenever Xiao Gu came up,

cues.zh: 连夜带她去医院爆炸
cues.pinyin: lian2 ye4 dai4 ta1 qu4 yi1 yuan4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: Lao Bu's urge to rush her to the hospital overnight nearly exploded.

cues.zh: 老布眼角皱纹
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 yan3 jiao3 zhou4 wen2
cues.en: The wrinkles at the corners of Lao Bu's eyes

cues.zh: 都快笑成冰球花纹了
cues.pinyin: dou1 kuai4 xiao4 cheng2 bing1 qiu2 hua1 wen2 le5
cues.en: had practically crinkled into hockey-puck patterns from smiling.

cues.zh: 然而艾琳却突然吐槽老布的酒鬼父亲
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ai4 lin2 que4 tu1 ran2 tu3 cao2 lao3 bu4 de5 jiu3 gui3 fu4 qin1
cues.en: But then Erin suddenly roasted Lao Bu's drunkard father,

cues.zh: 他家的酗酒室能追溯到冰河世纪
cues.pinyin: ta1 jia1 de5 xu4 jiu3 shi4 neng2 zhui1 su4 dao4 bing1 he2 shi4 ji4
cues.en: saying his family's history of boozing traced back to the Ice Age.

cues.zh: 这暴脾气怕不是刻在 D NA 里的祖传技能
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bao4 pi2 qi4 pa4 bu2 shi4 ke4 zai4 D NA li3 de5 zu3 chuan2 ji4 neng2
cues.en: "That temper of yours is probably a hereditary skill baked right into your DNA."

cues.zh: 这话瞬间戳中脑部的暴怒神经
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hua4 shun4 jian1 chuo1 zhong1 nao3 bu4 de5 bao4 nu4 shen2 jing1
cues.en: That line instantly struck his rage nerve.

cues.zh: 只见他竟突然冲进心理学家小甜甜办公室
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 ta1 jing4 tu1 ran2 chong1 jin4 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 ban4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: Next thing you know, he stormed into psychologist Xiao Tiantian's office,

cues.zh: 质问他为何将自己的私事告知探员
cues.pinyin: zhi4 wen4 ta1 wei4 he2 jiang1 zi4 ji3 de5 si1 shi4 gao4 zhi1 tan4 yuan2
cues.en: demanding to know why he'd told the detective about his private business.

cues.zh: 小甜甜却表示要按流程提交心理评估
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 que4 biao3 shi4 yao4 an4 liu2 cheng2 ti2 jiao1 xin1 li3 ping2 gu1
cues.en: Xiao Tiantian just said he had to file the psych evaluation per protocol.

cues.zh: 老部随即冷笑
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 sui2 ji2 leng3 xiao4
cues.en: Lao Bu sneered right back:

cues.zh: 我要真有暴力倾向
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 zhen1 you3 bao4 li4 qing1 xiang4
cues.en: "If I really had violent tendencies,

cues.zh: 你现在该跟木乃伊一样
cues.pinyin: ni3 xian4 zai4 gai1 gen1 mu4 nai3 yi1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: you'd be lying there right now like a mummy —

cues.zh: 唐姐破台拼尸块了
cues.pinyin: tang2 jie3 po4 tai2 pin1 shi1 kuai4 le5
cues.en: on the autopsy table getting pieced back together."

cues.zh: 吓得小甜甜差点隔屁
cues.pinyin: xia4 de2 xiao3 tian2 tian2 cha4 dian3 ge2 pi4
cues.en: That scared Xiao Tiantian half to death.

cues.zh: 老部接着杀气腾腾杀回陈俊世
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 jie1 zhe5 sha1 qi4 teng2 teng2 sha1 hui2 chen2 jun4 shi4
cues.en: Lao Bu then stormed back to the interrogation room, murder in his eyes,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 没想到艾琳突然称赞她胳膊上的肌肉线条
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 ai4 lin2 tu1 ran2 cheng1 zan4 ta1 ge1 bo2 shang4 de5 ji1 rou4 xian4 tiao2
cues.en: only for Erin to suddenly compliment the suspect's arm muscle lines.

cues.zh: 两人从健身器材聊到蛋白质摄入
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 cong2 jian4 shen1 qi4 cai2 liao2 dao4 dan4 bai2 zhi4 she4 ru4
cues.en: The two went from talking workout gear to protein intake,

cues.zh: 活活把审讯室变成硬汉健身方分厅
cues.pinyin: huo2 huo2 ba3 shen3 xun4 shi4 bian4 cheng2 ying4 han4 jian4 shen1 fang1 fen1 ting1
cues.en: turning the interrogation room into a meathead's gym hangout.

cues.zh: 和这探员跟嫌疑人是来开健身
cues.pinyin: he2 zhe4 tan4 yuan2 gen1 xian2 yi2 ren2 shi4 lai2 kai1 jian4 shen1
cues.en: Were the detective and the suspect here to hold

cues.zh: 经验交流会的
cues.pinyin: jing1 yan4 jiao1 liu2 hui4 de5
cues.en: a fitness-tips exchange meeting or something?

cues.zh: 经得门外的小甜甜一阵头疼
cues.pinyin: jing1 de2 men2 wai4 de5 xiao3 tian2 tian2 yi1 zhen4 tou2 teng2
cues.en: It gave Xiao Tiantian, waiting outside the door, a splitting headache.

cues.zh: 眼看线索断得比冰球干还干脆
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 xian4 suo3 duan4 de2 bi3 bing1 qiu2 gan4 hai2 gan1 cui4
cues.en: Just as the leads seemed to snap clean like a broken hockey stick,

cues.zh: 步步组合直接拽着艾琳杀进约翰公寓
cues.pinyin: bu4 bu4 zu3 he2 zhi2 jie1 zhuai1 zhe5 ai4 lin2 sha1 jin4 yue1 han4 gong1 yu4
cues.en: Lao Bu went ahead and dragged Erin straight into John's apartment.

cues.zh: 开门的女友听完死讯
cues.pinyin: kai1 men2 de5 nv3 you3 ting1 wan2 si3 xun4
cues.en: The girlfriend who opened the door, on hearing he was dead,

cues.zh: 突然透露一条重要线索
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 tou4 lu4 yi1 tiao2 zhong4 yao4 xian4 suo3
cues.en: suddenly revealed an important clue:

cues.zh: 约翰竟是一名志愿消防员
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 jing4 shi4 yi1 ming2 zhi4 yuan4 xiao1 fang2 yuan2
cues.en: John had actually been a volunteer firefighter,

cues.zh: 且在失踪前轮胎曾被人化成渔网
cues.pinyin: qie3 zai4 shi1 zong1 qian2 lun2 tai1 ceng2 bei4 ren2 hua4 cheng2 yu2 wang3
cues.en: and before he disappeared, someone had slashed his tires into a net of holes.

cues.zh: 这一女又为何不报警
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 nv3 you4 wei4 he2 bu4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: So why hadn't she reported it?

cues.zh: 她因为约翰跟哪个辣妹玩汽车躲债
cues.pinyin: ta1 yin1 wei4 yue1 han4 gen1 na3 ge5 la4 mei4 wan2 qi4 che1 duo3 zhai4
cues.en: She said it was because John was dodging debt from a car-loan deal.

cues.zh: 然而就在这时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just then,

cues.zh: 艾琳突然翻出约翰的一叠账单
cues.pinyin: ai4 lin2 tu1 ran2 fan1 chu1 yue1 han4 de5 yi1 die2 zhang4 dan1
cues.en: Erin pulled out a stack of John's bills,

cues.zh: 现款数字长得跟冰球场围栏似的
cues.pinyin: xian4 kuan3 shu4 zi4 zhang3 de2 gen1 bing1 qiu2 chang3 wei2 lan2 shi4 de5
cues.en: the debt figures stretching as long as a hockey rink's boards.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 当碎骨开口说话：法医与 FBI 的追凶狂欢，每具尸体都藏著颠覆认知的真相。

cues.zh: 你冰球杆还能戳人肥管子
cues.pinyin: ni3 bing1 qiu2 gan1 hai2 neng2 chuo1 ren2 fei2 guan3 zi5
cues.en: "Your hockey stick could poke clean through someone's windpipe."

cues.zh: 但两人并未做出过分的事
cues.pinyin: dan4 liang3 ren2 bing4 wei4 zuo4 chu1 guo4 fen4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But the two of them hadn't actually gone that far.

cues.zh: 随后球员向几人抛出一条重要线索
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 qiu2 yuan2 xiang4 ji3 ren2 pao1 chu1 yi1 tiao2 zhong4 yao4 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Afterward, a player tossed them an important lead,

cues.zh: 穿夺他们去找冰球宝贝安娜打听
cues.pinyin: chuan1 duo2 ta1 men5 qu4 zhao3 bing1 qiu2 bao3 bei4 an1 na4 da3 ting1
cues.en: urging them to go ask hockey belle Anna about it.

cues.zh: 这姑娘跟半支球队组过恋爱临时工
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu1 niang2 gen1 ban4 zhi1 qiu2 dui4 zu3 guo4 lian4 ai4 lin2 shi2 gong1
cues.en: This girl had basically dated half the team as temp boyfriends,

cues.zh: 先天被约翰甩得最难看
cues.pinyin: xian1 tian1 bei4 yue1 han4 shuai3 de2 zui4 nan2 kan4
cues.en: and was clearly the one John had dumped the worst.

cues.zh: 面对询问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Facing their questions,

cues.zh: 安娜表示跟约翰是开放式关系体验卡
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 biao3 shi4 gen1 yue1 han4 shi4 kai1 fang4 shi4 guan1 xi4 ti3 yan4 ka3
cues.en: Anna said she and John had an "open relationship" trial run,

cues.zh: 显然被约翰甩得最难看
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 bei4 yue1 han4 shuai3 de2 zui4 nan2 kan4
cues.en: and firmly believed he'd never truly committed to anyone else.

cues.zh: 谁知老顾却故意指出
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 lao3 gu4 que4 gu4 yi4 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: Little did she know, Lao Bu deliberately pointed out

cues.zh: 对方有其他女人安娜当场扎毛
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 you3 qi2 ta1 nv3 ren2 an1 na4 dang1 chang3 zha1 mao2
cues.en: that John had other women — and Anna instantly bristled.

cues.zh: 爱琳趁机怀疑对方是凶手
cues.pinyin: ai4 lin2 chen4 ji1 huai2 yi2 dui4 fang1 shi4 xiong1 shou3
cues.en: Erin seized the moment to suspect her as the killer.

cues.zh: 对此安娜当场侥幸
cues.pinyin: dui4 ci3 an1 na4 dang1 chang3 jiao3 xing4
cues.en: At that, Anna broke down on the spot:

cues.zh: 约翰劈腿竟被她抓爆
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 pi1 tui3 jing4 bei4 ta1 zhua1 bao4
cues.en: she admitted she'd caught John cheating red-handed.

cues.zh: 安娜愤怒之下
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 fen4 nu4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: In her fury,

cues.zh: 便将约翰轮胎化成刘苏勋
cues.pinyin: bian4 jiang1 yue1 han4 lun2 tai1 hua4 cheng2 liu2 su1 xun1
cues.en: she'd slashed John's tires into a net of holes.

cues.zh: 当被问及分答是谁时
cues.pinyin: dang1 bei4 wen4 ji2 fen1 da2 shi4 shui2 shi2
cues.en: When asked who the real culprit was,

cues.zh: 安娜说
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 shuo1
cues.en: Anna said

cues.zh: 对方是一个经营扑克捉的人
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shi4 yi2 ge4 jing1 ying2 pu1 ke4 zhuo1 de5 ren2
cues.en: it was someone who ran a poker game.

cues.zh: 根据这一线索
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 yi1 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Based on this lead,

cues.zh: 两人迅速前往扑克室
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 xun4 su4 qian2 wang3 pu1 ke4 shi4
cues.en: the two of them headed straight for the poker room.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 极限，不就是用来突破的吗？

cues.zh: 我将小轮车全国赛事冠军保持了 11 年
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiang1 xiao3 lun2 che1 quan2 guo2 sai4 shi4 guan4 jun1 bao3 chi2 le5 11 nian2
cues.en: I held the national BMX championship title for 11 years

cues.zh: 一个动作反复做 10 遍 20 遍
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 dong4 zuo4 fan3 fu4 zuo4 10 bian4 20 bian4
cues.en: Doing one move over and over, 10 times, 20 times

cues.zh: 累到筋疲力尽为止
cues.pinyin: lei4 dao4 jin1 pi2 li4 jin4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Until I was completely exhausted

cues.zh: 挑战极限这件事从来没有停过
cues.pinyin: tiao3 zhan4 ji2 xian4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 ting2 guo4
cues.en: Pushing the limits is something I've never stopped doing

cues.zh: 赛车也是我在小轮车上面的一个延续
cues.pinyin: sai4 che1 ye3 shi4 wo3 zai4 xiao3 lun2 che1 shang4 mian4 de5 yi2 ge4 yan2 xu4
cues.en: Racing cars is also an extension of my BMX riding

cues.zh: 在赛道里飞驰的那一刻
cues.pinyin: zai4 sai4 dao4 li3 fei1 chi2 de5 na4 yi1 ke4
cues.en: The moment I'm speeding down the track

cues.zh: 整个人是焕然一新了
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 ren2 shi4 huan4 ran2 yi4 xin1 le5
cues.en: I feel like a completely new person

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话72｜女朋友的条件｜四脚朝天变阿呆｜没做过的事｜？不知？｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我想要交女朋友条件有什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 yao4 jiao1 nv3 peng2 you3 tiao2 jian4 you3 shen2 me5
cues.en: What are the conditions for me to get a girlfriend?

cues.zh: 是不是眼睛要大大的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 yan3 jing1 yao4 da4 da4 de5
cues.en: Should her eyes be big?

cues.zh: 对对对睫毛长长的
cues.pinyin: dui4 dui4 dui4 jie2 mao2 chang2 chang2 de5
cues.en: Right, right, right, and long eyelashes.

cues.zh: 对哦脚细细的对对对走路轻轻的
cues.pinyin: dui4 o2 jiao3 xi4 xi4 de5 dui4 dui4 dui4 zou3 lu4 qing1 qing1 de5
cues.en: Right, slender feet — right, right, right — and walks lightly.

cues.zh: 对对对对那路途怎么样啊
cues.pinyin: dui4 dui4 dui4 dui4 na4 lu4 tu2 zen3 me5 yang4 a5
cues.en: Right right right right, and what about her gait?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话72｜女朋友的条件｜四脚朝天变阿呆｜没做过的事｜？不知？｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你哦好
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 hao3
cues.en: Chenchen, let me ask you something, okay?

cues.zh: 阿信走路跌倒了摔得四脚朝天会变成什么
cues.pinyin: a1 xin4 zou3 lu4 die1 dao3 le5 shuai1 de2 si4 jiao3 chao2 tian1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 shen2 me5
cues.en: If A-Xin trips while walking and lands flat on his back, what does he turn into?

cues.zh: 变成颠倒的乌龟
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 dian1 dao3 de5 wu1 gui1
cues.en: He turns into an upside-down turtle.

cues.zh: 颠倒的乌龟
cues.pinyin: dian1 dao3 de5 wu1 gui1
cues.en: An upside-down turtle.

cues.zh: 翻不回去了是不是
cues.pinyin: fan1 bu4 hui2 qu4 le5 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: It can't flip itself back over, right?

cues.zh: 答案是变成阿呆
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 bian4 cheng2 a1 dai1
cues.en: The answer is he becomes 'A-Dai' (a fool).

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 因为信把它翻过来就变成呆了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xin4 ba3 ta1 fan1 guo4 lai2 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 dai1 le5
cues.en: Because flipping the character 信 (Xin) over turns it into 呆 (dumb).
