items.title_zh: 笑话72｜女朋友的条件｜四脚朝天变阿呆｜没做过的事｜？不知？｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有一天小明问妈妈
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 wen4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: One day Xiaoming asked his mom,

cues.zh: 妈妈
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1
cues.en: 'Mom,'

cues.zh: 我会不会因为自己没做过的事
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 bu2 hui4 yin1 wei4 zi4 ji3 mei2 zuo4 guo4 de5 shi4
cues.en: 'will I be punished for something'

cues.zh: 而受到惩罚
cues.pinyin: er2 shou4 dao4 cheng2 fa2
cues.en: 'that I haven't done?'

cues.zh: 不会啊
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 a5
cues.en: 'No,'

cues.zh: 没做过的事
cues.pinyin: mei2 zuo4 guo4 de5 shi4
cues.en: 'something you haven't done'

cues.zh: 当然不会挨罚
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 bu2 hui4 ai1 fa2
cues.en: 'of course won't get you punished.'

cues.zh: 那挨骂呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ai2 ma4 ne5
cues.en: 'What about getting scolded?'

cues.zh: 也不会挨骂
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 hui4 ai2 ma4
cues.en: 'Won't get scolded either.'

cues.zh: 小明高兴地说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 gao1 xing4 di4 shuo1
cues.en: Xiaoming happily said,

cues.zh: 谢天谢地
cues.pinyin: xie4 tian1 xie4 di4
cues.en: 'Thank goodness,'

cues.zh: 我今天没有做功课
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 tian1 mei2 you3 zuo4 gong1 ke4
cues.en: 'I didn't do my homework today!'

cues.zh: 屋子谁玩游戏一定会被淘汰
cues.pinyin: wu1 zi5 shui2 wan2 you2 xi4 yi2 ding4 hui4 bei4 tao2 tai4
cues.en: At the zoo, who will definitely be eliminated playing the game?

cues.zh: 谁一定会被淘汰
cues.pinyin: shui2 yi2 ding4 hui4 bei4 tao2 tai4
cues.en: Who will definitely be eliminated?

cues.zh: 可能是老虎喔
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 lao3 hu3 o1
cues.en: Maybe the tiger.

cues.zh: 因为我每次在动物园
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 mei3 ci4 zai4 dong4 wu4 yuan2
cues.en: Because every time I'm at the zoo,

cues.zh: 看到老虎都在睡觉
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 lao3 hu3 dou1 zai4 shui4 jiao4
cues.en: I see the tiger sleeping.

cues.zh: 牠比较懒惰
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi3 jiao4 lan3 duo4
cues.en: It's rather lazy,

cues.zh: 所以牠玩游戏一定会先被淘汰
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 wan2 you2 xi4 yi2 ding4 hui4 xian1 bei4 tao2 tai4
cues.en: so it'll definitely be the first one eliminated in the game.

cues.zh: 答案是
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4
cues.en: The answer is—

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话72｜女朋友的条件｜四脚朝天变阿呆｜没做过的事｜？不知？｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小生
cues.pinyin: xiao3 sheng1
cues.en: Xiao Sheng.

cues.zh: 这个是几根手指头
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 ji3 gen1 shou3 zhi3 tou5
cues.en: How many fingers is this?

cues.zh: 一根
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1
cues.en: One.

cues.zh: 这样呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ne5
cues.en: What about like this?

cues.zh: 两根
cues.pinyin: liang3 gen1
cues.en: Two.

cues.zh: 六根
cues.pinyin: liu4 gen1
cues.en: Six.

cues.zh: 错这样子是两根
cues.pinyin: cuo4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 shi4 liang3 gen1
cues.en: Wrong, this way is two.

cues.zh: 两根手指头
cues.pinyin: liang3 gen1 shou3 zhi3 tou5
cues.en: Two fingers.

cues.zh: 上国语课老师教大家
cues.pinyin: shang4 guo2 yu3 ke4 lao3 shi1 jiao4 da4 jia1
cues.en: In Mandarin class, the teacher taught everyone:

cues.zh: 在不知的前后
cues.pinyin: zai4 bu4 zhi1 de5 qian2 hou4
cues.en: before and after '不知' (don't know),

cues.zh: 各加上一个字
cues.pinyin: ge4 jia1 shang4 yi2 ge4 zi4
cues.en: add one character each

cues.zh: 变成一个成语
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 cheng2 yu3
cues.en: to make it into an idiom.

cues.zh: 老师我知道
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 wo3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: 'Teacher, I know!'

cues.zh: 食不知味
cues.pinyin: shi2 bu4 zhi1 wei4
cues.en: '食不知味' — eating without tasting the food.

cues.zh: 小美呢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ne5
cues.en: What about Xiaomei?

cues.zh: 恬不知耻
cues.pinyin: tian2 bu4 zhi1 chi3
cues.en: '恬不知耻' — shameless.

cues.zh: 小明呢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ne5
cues.en: What about Xiaoming?

cues.zh: 我不知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: 'I don't know.'

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 肖美是一个小提琴手
cues.pinyin: xiao4 mei3 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 ti2 qin2 shou3
cues.en: Xiao Mei is a violinist.

cues.zh: 却因为做了一个美甲导致截肢
cues.pinyin: que4 yin1 wei4 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 mei3 jia3 dao3 zhi4 jie2 zhi1
cues.en: But getting a manicure ended up causing an amputation.

cues.zh: 直接毁了她的职业生涯
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 hui3 le5 ta1 de5 zhi2 ye4 sheng1 ya2
cues.en: It completely ruined her career.

cues.zh: 时间退回两天前
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 tui4 hui2 liang3 tian1 qian2
cues.en: Let's go back two days.

cues.zh: 肖美周末在大剧场有小提琴演出活动
cues.pinyin: xiao4 mei3 zhou1 mo4 zai4 da4 ju4 chang3 you3 xiao3 ti2 qin2 yan3 chu1 huo2 dong4
cues.en: Xiao Mei had a violin performance at the big theater that weekend.

cues.zh: 为了视觉效果更好就去做了个美甲
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 shi4 jue2 xiao4 guo3 geng4 hao3 jiu4 qu4 zuo4 le5 ge4 mei3 jia3
cues.en: To look better on stage, she went and got a manicure.

cues.zh: 几乎第二天手指头就肿了
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 di4 er4 tian1 shou3 zhi3 tou5 jiu4 zhong3 le5
cues.en: Almost the very next day, her finger swelled up.

cues.zh: 所以来了医院做检查等到时间
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lai2 le5 yi1 yuan4 zuo4 jian3 cha2 deng3 dao4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: So she came to the hospital for a checkup and waited for her turn.

cues.zh: 还不忘对着谱子练习
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu4 wang4 dui4 zhe5 pu3 zi5 lian4 xi2
cues.en: She still didn't forget to practice while looking at the sheet music.

cues.zh: 医生来了之后告诉她不用担心
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4 gao4 su4 ta1 bu4 yong4 dan1 xin1
cues.en: After the doctor arrived, he told her not to worry.

cues.zh: 这是甲沟炎是常见的细菌引起的脓肿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 jia3 gou1 yan2 shi4 chang2 jian4 de5 xi4 jun1 yin3 qi3 de5 nong2 zhong3
cues.en: This is paronychia, an abscess commonly caused by bacteria.

cues.zh: 等把脓肿挑破排出来就能回家
cues.pinyin: deng3 ba3 nong2 zhong3 tiao1 po4 pai2 chu1 lai2 jiu4 neng2 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Once the abscess is lanced and drained, she can go home.

cues.zh: 三天后疼痛和肿胀都会消失
cues.pinyin: san1 tian1 hou4 teng2 tong4 he2 zhong3 zhang4 du1 hui4 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: In three days the pain and swelling will go away.

cues.zh: 然后她就可以继续拉小提琴了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ji4 xu4 la1 xiao3 ti2 qin2 le5
cues.en: Then she can go back to playing the violin.

cues.zh: 可是当肖恩帮小美清除脓肿的时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dang1 xiao4 en1 bang1 xiao3 mei3 qing1 chu2 nong2 zhong3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when Shaun was draining Xiao Mei's abscess,

cues.zh: 她疼得忍不住叫了一声
cues.pinyin: ta1 teng2 de2 ren3 bu2 zhu4 jiao4 le5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: she couldn't help but cry out in pain.

cues.zh: 肖恩觉得不对劲啊
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 bu2 dui4 jin4 a5
cues.en: Shaun felt something was off.

cues.zh: 明明给她做了局部麻醉
cues.pinyin: ming2 ming2 gei3 ta1 zuo4 liao3 ju2 bu4 ma2 zui4
cues.en: She had clearly been given a local anesthetic,

cues.zh: 应该感觉不到疼痛的才对
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 teng2 tong4 de5 cai2 dui4
cues.en: so she shouldn't have been able to feel pain.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 原来是小美长期拉小提琴
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 shi4 xiao3 mei3 chang2 qi1 la1 xiao3 ti2 qin2
cues.en: It turned out that from playing the violin for so long,

cues.zh: 患上了关节疼痛
cues.pinyin: huan4 shang4 le5 guan1 jie2 teng2 tong4
cues.en: Xiao Mei had developed joint pain.

cues.zh: 是刚才清理的动作牵扯到了手指关节
cues.pinyin: shi4 gang1 cai2 qing1 li3 de5 dong4 zuo4 qian1 che3 dao4 le5 shou3 zhi3 guan1 jie2
cues.en: The motion from the cleaning just now had tugged on her finger joint.

cues.zh: 可肖恩觉得没那么简单
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao4 en1 jue2 de5 mei2 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But Shaun didn't think it was that simple.

cues.zh: 这有可能是食肉菌感染
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 shi2 rou4 jun1 gan3 ran3
cues.en: This could be a flesh-eating bacteria infection.

cues.zh: 这样的话就得截掉她的手指了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4 jiu4 de2 jie2 diao4 ta1 de5 shou3 zhi3 le5
cues.en: If so, her finger would have to be amputated.

cues.zh: 食肉菌又称为
cues.pinyin: shi2 rou4 jun1 you4 cheng1 wei2
cues.en: Flesh-eating bacteria are also known as

cues.zh: 食肉菌
cues.pinyin: shi2 rou4 jun1
cues.en: flesh-eating bacteria.

cues.zh: 是一系列菌类的总称
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 xi4 lie4 jun1 lei4 de5 zong3 cheng1
cues.en: It's a general term for a group of bacteria

cues.zh: 能引发坏死性筋膜炎
cues.pinyin: neng2 yin3 fa1 huai4 si3 xing4 jin1 mo2 yan2
cues.en: that can cause necrotizing fasciitis.

cues.zh: 因为临床病症快速而严重
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 lin2 chuang2 bing4 zheng4 kuai4 su4 er2 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: Because the clinical symptoms progress quickly and severely,

cues.zh: 死亡率很高
cues.pinyin: si3 wang2 lv4 hen3 gao1
cues.en: the mortality rate is very high.

cues.zh: 所以才被冠上食人菌的名称
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 bei4 guan1 shang4 shi2 ren2 jun1 de5 ming2 cheng1
cues.en: That's why it's been given the name "man-eating bacteria."

cues.zh: 听到要截掉手指
cues.pinyin: ting1 dao4 yao4 jie2 diao4 shou3 zhi3
cues.en: Upon hearing her finger might be amputated,

cues.zh: 小美惊了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 jing1 le5
cues.en: Xiao Mei was shocked.

cues.zh: 不就是个假钩炎吗
cues.pinyin: bu4 jiu4 shi4 ge4 jia3 gou1 yan2 ma5
cues.en: Isn't it just paronychia?

cues.zh: 怎么会这么严重
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 zhe4 me5 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: How could it be this serious?

cues.zh: 摩根也觉得是小狠小题大做了
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 ye3 jue2 de5 shi4 xiao3 hen3 xiao3 ti2 da4 zuo4 le5
cues.en: Morgan also thought Shaun was overreacting.

cues.zh: 拒绝了她
cues.pinyin: ju4 jue2 le5 ta1
cues.en: She turned down

cues.zh: 要在小美手指伸出做一个切口
cues.pinyin: yao4 zai4 xiao3 mei3 shou3 zhi3 shen1 chu1 zuo4 yi2 ge4 qie1 kou3
cues.en: the proposal to make an incision on Xiao Mei's finger

cues.zh: 取样做检查的提议
cues.pinyin: qu3 yang4 zuo4 jian3 cha2 de5 ti2 yi4
cues.en: and take a sample for testing.

cues.zh: 因为如果这样的话
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ru2 guo3 zhe4 yang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Because if they did that,

cues.zh: 会对小美的手指造成永久性伤害
cues.pinyin: hui4 dui4 xiao3 mei3 de5 shou3 zhi3 zao4 cheng2 yong3 jiu3 xing4 shang1 hai4
cues.en: it would cause permanent damage to Xiao Mei's finger.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 而就在俩人争执的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 jiu4 zai4 lia3 ren2 zheng1 zhi2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But just as the two of them were arguing,

cues.zh: 小美的体温上升到了 39 度
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 ti3 wen1 shang4 sheng1 dao4 le5 39 du4
cues.en: Xiao Mei's temperature rose to 39 degrees Celsius.

cues.zh: 就连摩根也不得不重视起来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 mo2 gen1 ye3 bu4 de2 bu4 zhong4 shi4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Even Morgan had to take it seriously then.

cues.zh: 同意给她做检测
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: She agreed to run the test.

cues.zh: 结果显示肖恩是对的
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4 xiao4 en1 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: The results showed Shaun was right.

cues.zh: 小美受伤的手指组织已经死亡
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shou4 shang1 de5 shou3 zhi3 zu3 zhi1 yi3 jing1 si3 wang2
cues.en: The tissue in Xiao Mei's injured finger had already died.

cues.zh: 而且她的皮下脂肪和筋膜也开始坏死
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 pi2 xia4 zhi1 fang2 he2 jin1 mo2 ye3 kai1 shi3 huai4 si3
cues.en: And her subcutaneous fat and fascia had also started to necrotize.

cues.zh: 现在她们能做的就是给她安排手术
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 men5 neng2 zuo4 de5 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ta1 an1 pai2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Now all they could do was schedule her for surgery

cues.zh: 尽力挽救她的手
cues.pinyin: jin4 li4 wan3 jiu4 ta1 de5 shou3
cues.en: and try their best to save her hand.

cues.zh: 小美被送进来手术室情况不太好
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 bei4 song4 jin4 lai2 shou3 shu4 shi4 qing2 kuang4 bu4 tai4 hao3
cues.en: Xiao Mei was wheeled into the OR in bad condition.

cues.zh: 她的肌肉无力
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 ji1 rou4 wu2 li4
cues.en: Her muscles were weak.

cues.zh: 手术前根本夹不紧
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 qian2 gen1 ben3 jia1 bu4 jin3
cues.en: She couldn't even clench her hand tight before the surgery.

cues.zh: 而且她的组织产生了异味
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 zu3 zhi1 chan3 sheng1 le5 yi4 wei4
cues.en: And her tissue had developed a foul smell,

cues.zh: 就像是臭鸡蛋一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 shi4 chou4 ji1 dan4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: just like rotten eggs.

cues.zh: 如果仔细地为她的手清创
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zi3 xi4 di4 wei4 ta1 de5 shou3 qing1 chuang4
cues.en: But so far they'd only found tissue damage.

cues.zh: 如果仔细地为她的手清闯
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zi3 xi4 di4 wei4 ta1 de5 shou3 qing1 chuang3
cues.en: If they carefully debrided her hand,

cues.zh: 手的活动功能和灵敏度还能保住一部分
cues.pinyin: shou3 de5 huo2 dong4 gong1 neng2 he2 ling2 min3 du4 hai2 neng2 bao3 zhu4 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: some of its mobility and sensitivity could still be preserved.

cues.zh: 可是当手术结束当晚
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dang1 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 dang4 wan3
cues.en: But the night after the surgery ended,

cues.zh: 小美的血压突然下降
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 xue4 ya1 tu1 ran2 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Xiao Mei's blood pressure suddenly dropped

cues.zh: 心率激增
cues.pinyin: xin1 lv4 ji1 zeng1
cues.en: and her heart rate spiked.

cues.zh: 留守的肖文和摩根
cues.pinyin: liu2 shou3 de5 xiao4 wen2 he2 mo2 gen1
cues.en: Shaun and Morgan, who stayed behind,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 他们谁都不能出去
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shei2 dou1 bu4 neng2 chu1 qu4
cues.en: neither of them could leave.

cues.zh: 摩根表面冷静
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 biao3 mian4 leng3 jing4
cues.en: Morgan looked calm on the surface,

cues.zh: 但却悄悄转过头
cues.pinyin: dan4 que4 qiao1 qiao1 zhuan3 guo4 tou2
cues.en: but she quietly turned her head away

cues.zh: 眼泪落了下来
cues.pinyin: yan3 lei4 la4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: as tears fell.

cues.zh: 她当初为小美考虑的举动
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 chu1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 kao3 lv4 de5 ju3 dong4
cues.en: The decision she'd made for Xiao Mei's sake back then —

cues.zh: 真的错了吗
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 cuo4 le5 ma5
cues.en: was it really wrong?

cues.zh: 难道她要学着消痕那样
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 ta1 yao4 xue2 zhe5 xiao1 hen2 na4 yang4
cues.en: Does she really have to learn to be like Shaun,

cues.zh: 李知道近乎冷血吗
cues.pinyin: li3 zhi1 dao4 jin4 hu1 leng3 xue4 ma5
cues.en: becoming almost cold-blooded?

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 小薇因为流了一个小时的鼻血
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 yin1 wei4 liu2 le5 yi2 ge4 xiao3 shi2 de5 bi2 xue4
cues.en: Xiao Wei was sent to the hospital

cues.zh: 而被送进了医院
cues.pinyin: er2 bei4 song4 jin4 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: after her nose bled for a whole hour.

cues.zh: 救护车上
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hu4 che1 shang4
cues.en: In the ambulance,

cues.zh: 救助人员已经进行了堵塞
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhu4 ren2 yuan2 yi3 jing1 jin4 xing2 le5 du3 se4
cues.en: the paramedics had already packed her nose,

cues.zh: 却依旧没用
cues.pinyin: que4 yi1 jiu4 mei2 yong4
cues.en: but it still didn't help.

cues.zh: 丽姆立刻让人给她用上轻孔仪
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 li4 ke4 rang4 ren2 gei3 ta1 yong4 shang4 qing1 kong3 yi2
cues.en: Rheme immediately had someone use a device on her

cues.zh: 擦拭本身上腺素溶液
cues.pinyin: ca1 shi4 ben3 shen1 shang4 xian4 su4 rong2 ye4
cues.en: and apply epinephrine solution

cues.zh: 增加外周血管阻力
cues.pinyin: zeng1 jia1 wai4 zhou1 xue4 guan3 zu3 li4
cues.en: to increase peripheral vascular resistance

cues.zh: 升高血压
cues.pinyin: sheng1 gao1 xue4 ya1
cues.en: and raise her blood pressure,

cues.zh: 然后进行灼伤止血
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 zhuo2 shang1 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: then cauterize it to stop the bleeding.

cues.zh: 做了处理之后
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 chu3 li3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After they treated her,

cues.zh: 小薇的爸妈找到朴医生
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 ba4 ma1 zhao3 dao4 pu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiao Wei's parents went to find Dr. Park.

cues.zh: 说他们觉得女儿是装病
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 men5 jue2 de5 nv3 er2 shi4 zhuang1 bing4
cues.en: They said they thought their daughter was faking it,

cues.zh: 这次鼻血应该是故意的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 bi2 xue4 ying1 gai1 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: and that this nosebleed was probably intentional.

cues.zh: 因为自从他们离婚之后
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zi4 cong2 ta1 men5 li2 hun1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Because ever since their divorce,

cues.zh: 小薇经常出现失眠
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 jing1 chang2 chu1 xian4 shi1 mian2
cues.en: Xiao Wei had often had insomnia,

cues.zh: 呼吸脚痛
cues.pinyin: hu1 xi1 jiao3 tong4
cues.en: rapid breathing, abdominal pain,

cues.zh: 等症状
cues.pinyin: deng3 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: and other symptoms.

cues.zh: 但是去做检查
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qu4 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: But when they ran tests,

cues.zh: 却什么都没有发现
cues.pinyin: que4 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 you3 fa1 xian4
cues.en: they couldn't find anything.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 后来心理医生告诉他们
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 xin1 li3 yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: Later, a psychiatrist told them

cues.zh: 试图挽救破碎的家庭
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 wan3 jiu4 po4 sui4 de5 jia1 ting2
cues.en: it might be that Xiao Wei was subconsciously

cues.zh: 试图挽救破罪的家庭
cues.pinyin: shi4 tu2 wan3 jiu4 po4 zui4 de5 jia1 ting2
cues.en: trying to save their broken family,

cues.zh: 所以才出现这些反应
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 chu1 xian4 zhe4 xie1 fan3 ying4
cues.en: which is why she was having these reactions.

cues.zh: 姚医生也接受了这个说法
cues.pinyin: yao2 yi1 sheng1 ye3 jie1 shou4 le5 zhe4 ge5 shuo1 fa3
cues.en: Dr. Yao accepted this explanation too.

cues.zh: 并且小薇还小
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 xiao3 wei1 hai2 xiao3
cues.en: Also, Xiao Wei was still young,

cues.zh: 肯定难以接受父母的离异
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 nan2 yi3 jie1 shou4 fu4 mu3 de5 li2 yi4
cues.en: so she must be finding it hard to accept her parents' divorce.

cues.zh: 再人回来之后
cues.pinyin: zai4 ren2 hui2 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the family members came back,

cues.zh: 布朗告诉他们
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: Brown told them

cues.zh: 小薇的鼻孔黏膜非常的薄
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 bi2 kong3 nian2 mo2 fei1 chang2 de5 bao2
cues.en: that the mucous membrane in Xiao Wei's nostril was very thin,

cues.zh: 最好留意一下
cues.pinyin: zui4 hao3 liu2 yi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: so they should keep an eye on it,

cues.zh: 未来可能复发
cues.pinyin: wei4 lai2 ke3 neng2 fu4 fa1
cues.en: since it might happen again in the future.

cues.zh: 询问得知是小薇最近
cues.pinyin: xun2 wen4 de2 zhi1 shi4 xiao3 wei1 zui4 jin4
cues.en: After asking around, they learned that Xiao Wei had recently

cues.zh: 在吸入一些药物
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 ru4 yi1 xie1 yao4 wu4
cues.en: been inhaling some kind of medication,

cues.zh: 因为她一直感到咳嗽和鼻塞
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yi4 zhi2 gan3 dao4 ke2 sou4 he2 bi2 se4
cues.en: because she'd been feeling coughs and nasal congestion all along,

cues.zh: 爸妈又不怎么管她
cues.pinyin: ba4 ma1 you4 bu4 zen3 me5 guan3 ta1
cues.en: and since her parents barely looked after her,

cues.zh: 所以才自己查了资料买药汁
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 zi4 ji3 cha2 le5 zi1 liao4 mai3 yao4 zhi1
cues.en: she had looked things up herself and bought the medicine.

cues.zh: 那就得了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 de2 le5
cues.en: That is,

cues.zh: 滥用某种喷雾类药物
cues.pinyin: lan4 yong4 mou3 zhong3 pen1 wu4 lei4 yao4 wu4
cues.en: misuse of a certain kind of nasal spray

cues.zh: 确实会使鼻黏膜病薄
cues.pinyin: que4 shi2 hui4 shi3 bi2 nian2 mo2 bing4 bao2
cues.en: really can make the nasal mucosa thin,

cues.zh: 导致严重流鼻血
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 yan2 zhong4 liu2 bi2 xue4
cues.en: leading to severe nosebleeds.

cues.zh: 只要停了就好
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ting2 le5 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: As long as she stopped using it, she'd be fine.

cues.zh: 这时小薇的父母又因为这次事情吵了起来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 wei1 de5 fu4 mu3 you4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 ci4 shi4 qing2 chao3 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: At this point, Xiao Wei's parents started arguing again over this,

cues.zh: 根本不顾小薇的感受
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 bu4 gu4 xiao3 wei1 de5 gan3 shou4
cues.en: completely ignoring how Xiao Wei felt.

cues.zh: 小薇不想听他们争吵
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 bu4 xiang3 ting1 ta1 men5 zheng1 chao3
cues.en: Xiao Wei didn't want to listen to them fighting

cues.zh: 想要离开
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 li2 kai1
cues.en: and wanted to leave,

cues.zh: 却在起床的时候
cues.pinyin: que4 zai4 qi3 chuang2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: but just as she got up —

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅做了一次美甲，竟然就导致截肢！如果她能听肖恩的话就好了

cues.zh: 可是他们没在肺组织里找到异常之处
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 men5 mei2 zai4 fei4 zu3 zhi1 li3 zhao3 dao4 yi4 chang2 zhi1 chu4
cues.en: But they didn't find anything abnormal in the lung tissue,

cues.zh: 而且遮气管看起来也很健康
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe1 qi4 guan3 kan4 qi3 lai2 ye3 hen3 jian4 kang1
cues.en: and the trachea looked healthy too.

cues.zh: 这时医生们翻动组织的动作直接切断了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 yi1 sheng1 men5 fan1 dong4 zu3 zhi1 de5 dong4 zuo4 zhi2 jie1 qie1 duan4 le5
cues.en: At that point, the doctors' handling of the tissue accidentally severed

cues.zh: 一处肺液动脉
cues.pinyin: yi1 chu4 fei4 ye4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: a pulmonary artery.

cues.zh: 小微立刻心理趋增陷入危险
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 li4 ke4 xin1 li3 qu1 zeng1 xian4 ru4 wei1 xian3
cues.en: Xiao Wei's heart rate suddenly spiked and she was in danger.

cues.zh: 为了应对
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 ying4 dui4
cues.en: To deal with it,

cues.zh: 医生立刻给小微开胸进行动脉管止血
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 li4 ke4 gei3 xiao3 wei1 kai1 xiong1 jin4 xing2 dong4 mai4 guan3 zhi3 xue4
cues.en: the doctors immediately opened her chest to stop the arterial bleeding.

cues.zh: 她的情况这才渐渐稳定
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 qing2 kuang4 zhe4 cai2 jian4 jian4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: Her condition then gradually stabilized.

cues.zh: 丽姆突然摇摇头
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 tu1 ran2 yao2 yao2 tou2
cues.en: Rheme suddenly shook her head.

cues.zh: 这是不对的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 bu2 dui4 de5
cues.en: This isn't right.

cues.zh: 小微的动脉密不应该这么脆弱
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 dong4 mai4 mi4 bu4 ying1 gai1 zhe4 me5 cui4 ruo4
cues.en: Xiao Wei's artery wall shouldn't be this fragile.

cues.zh: 肯定有什么原因让他的动脉壁变薄了
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 you3 shen2 me5 yuan2 yin1 rang4 ta1 de5 dong4 mai4 bi4 bian4 bao2 le5
cues.en: There must be some reason her artery wall had thinned.

cues.zh: 针对这个猜测
cues.pinyin: zhen1 dui4 zhe4 ge5 cai1 ce4
cues.en: Based on this suspicion,

cues.zh: 医生们继续翻找
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ji4 xu4 fan1 zhao3
cues.en: the doctors kept searching.

cues.zh: 最终在右肺下液
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 zai4 you4 fei4 xia4 ye4
cues.en: Finally, in the lower lobe of the right lung,

cues.zh: 发现了一个局部肉芽种
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 yi2 ge4 ju2 bu4 rou4 ya2 zhong3
cues.en: they found a localized granuloma.

cues.zh: 但这不是肿瘤
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 bu2 shi4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: But this wasn't a tumor.

cues.zh: 当他们把肺液拉开
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 men5 ba3 fei4 ye4 la1 kai1
cues.en: When they pulled the lung lobe open,

cues.zh: 医生把肋骨碎片小心地取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 lei4 gu3 sui4 pian4 xiao3 xin1 di4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: they found a piece of rib bone underneath.

cues.zh: 终于找到原因了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zhao3 dao4 yuan2 yin1 le5
cues.en: They had finally found the cause.

cues.zh: 医生把肋膏小心地取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ba3 le1 gao1 xiao3 xin1 di4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: The doctor carefully removed the rib fragment

cues.zh: 然后进行了缝合
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 le5 feng2 he2
cues.en: and then stitched her up.

cues.zh: 等到小微醒后
cues.pinyin: deng3 dao4 xiao3 wei1 xing3 hou4
cues.en: After Xiao Wei woke up,

cues.zh: 丽姆把这块肋膏交给了他
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 ba3 zhe4 kuai4 le1 gao1 jiao1 gei3 le5 ta1
cues.en: Rheme handed her the piece of rib bone.

cues.zh: 小明长得很矮大家就叫他矮子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 zhang3 de2 hen3 ai3 da4 jia1 jiu4 jiao4 ta1 ai3 zi5
cues.en: Xiao Ming was very short, so everyone called him "Shorty."

cues.zh: 于是他想长高一点
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 xiang3 zhang3 gao1 yi4 dian3
cues.en: So he wanted to grow a bit taller

cues.zh: 摆脱矮子这个外号
cues.pinyin: bai3 tuo1 ai3 zi5 zhe4 ge5 wai4 hao4
cues.en: to get rid of the nickname "Shorty."

cues.zh: 于是他每餐都吃很多
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 mei3 can1 dou1 chi1 hen3 duo1
cues.en: So he ate a lot at every meal.

cues.zh: 果然一年后没人再叫他矮子了
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 yi1 nian2 hou4 mei2 ren2 zai4 jiao4 ta1 ai3 zi5 le5
cues.en: Sure enough, a year later no one called him "Shorty" anymore.

cues.zh: 大家都叫他胖子
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 jiao4 ta1 pang4 zi5
cues.en: Everyone called him "Fatty" instead.

cues.zh: 我问你呢猴子每分钟都能扒一个玉米
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 ne5 hou2 zi5 mei3 fen1 zhong1 dou1 neng2 ba1 yi2 ge4 yu4 mi3
cues.en: Let me ask you: a monkey can husk one ear of corn a minute.

cues.zh: 那在果园里一只猴子 5 分钟能扒
cues.pinyin: na4 zai4 guo3 yuan2 li3 yi1 zhi1 hou2 zi5 5 fen1 zhong1 neng2 ba1
cues.en: So in an orchard, how many ears of corn can a monkey husk

cues.zh: 下几个玉米呢
cues.pinyin: xia4 ji3 ge4 yu4 mi3 ne5
cues.en: in 5 minutes?

cues.zh: 5 分钟就 5 个啊
cues.pinyin: 5 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 5 ge4 a5
cues.en: Five minutes, so 5 ears, right?

cues.zh: 错当然是零个
cues.pinyin: cuo4 dang1 ran2 shi4 ling2 ge4
cues.en: Wrong — of course it's zero.

cues.zh: 因为果园里没有玉米
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 guo3 yuan2 li3 mei2 you3 yu4 mi3
cues.en: Because there's no corn in an orchard.

cues.zh: 有一位老婆婆因贫血去看医生
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 wei4 lao3 po2 po5 yin1 pin2 xue4 qu4 kan4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: An old woman went to see a doctor because of anemia.

cues.zh: 医生建议她要多吃高铁的食物
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jian4 yi4 ta1 yao4 duo1 chi1 gao1 tie3 de5 shi2 wu4
cues.en: The doctor told her to eat more iron-rich food.

cues.zh: 一个月之后老婆婆回诊
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 zhi1 hou4 lao3 po2 po5 hui2 zhen3
cues.en: A month later, the old woman came back for a follow-up.

cues.zh: 医生很奇怪地发现
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 hen3 qi2 guai4 di4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: The doctor was puzzled to find

cues.zh: 老婆婆贫血的症状
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2 po5 pin2 xue4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: that the old woman's anemia symptoms

cues.zh: 并没有任何的改善
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 ren4 he2 de5 gai3 shan4
cues.en: hadn't improved at all.

cues.zh: 她就问老婆婆说
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 wen4 lao3 po2 po5 shuo1
cues.en: So she asked the old woman,

cues.zh: 你有听我的话
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 ting1 wo3 de5 hua4
cues.en: "Did you do what I told you

cues.zh: 多吃高铁的食物吗
cues.pinyin: duo1 chi1 gao1 tie3 de5 shi2 wu4 ma5
cues.en: and eat more iron-rich food?"

cues.zh: 老婆婆说
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2 po5 shuo1
cues.en: The old woman said,

cues.zh: 有啊我很听医生的话
cues.pinyin: you3 a5 wo3 hen3 ting1 yi1 sheng1 de5 hua4
cues.en: "Yes, I listened to the doctor very carefully.

cues.zh: 我每天都去高铁买便当来吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 tian1 dou1 qu4 gao1 tie3 mai3 bian4 dang1 lai2 chi1
cues.en: I go to the high-speed rail station every day to buy a boxed meal to eat."

cues.zh: 三三
cues.pinyin: san1 san1
cues.en: San San,

cues.zh: 我们来玩一个游戏喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 wan2 yi2 ge4 you2 xi4 o1
cues.en: let's play a game.

cues.zh: 这个游戏叫做学我讲话
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 you2 xi4 jiao4 zuo4 xue2 wo3 jiang3 hua4
cues.en: This game is called 'Copy What I Say.'

cues.zh: 准备好了吗
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: Are you ready?

cues.zh: 好了
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5
cues.en: Ready.

cues.zh: 错了
cues.pinyin: cuo4 le5
cues.en: Wrong!

items.title_zh: 笑话76｜你这个矮子｜猴子掰玉米｜阿婆看病｜学我讲话｜遵守交通号志｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 你要跟我说一样的喔
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 gen1 wo3 shuo1 yi1 yang4 de5 o1
cues.en: You have to say exactly what I say.

cues.zh: 要说准备好了我们再一次喔
cues.pinyin: yao4 shuo1 zhun3 bei4 hao3 le5 wo3 men5 zai4 yi2 ci4 o1
cues.en: You should say 'Ready' — let's try again.

cues.zh: 准备好了吗
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: Are you ready?

cues.zh: 乘 2
cues.pinyin: cheng2 2
cues.en: 2 times

cues.zh: 等于几
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 ji3
cues.en: equals what?

cues.zh: 错了
cues.pinyin: cuo4 le5
cues.en: Wrong!

cues.zh: 你要跟我讲一样的啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 gen1 wo3 jiang3 yi1 yang4 de5 a5
cues.en: You have to say exactly what I say.

cues.zh: 我们再一次喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 yi2 ci4 o1
cues.en: Let's try again.

cues.zh: 乘 2
cues.pinyin: cheng2 2
cues.en: 2 times

cues.zh: 等于几
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 ji3
cues.en: equals what?

cues.zh: 等于四
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 si4
cues.en: equals 4.

cues.zh: 你又错了
cues.pinyin: ni3 you4 cuo4 le5
cues.en: You're wrong again!

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 你要学我讲话你这次错了
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 xue2 wo3 jiang3 hua4 ni3 zhe4 ci4 cuo4 le5
cues.en: You're supposed to copy what I say — you got it wrong this time.

cues.zh: 你要说你又错了啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shuo1 ni3 you4 cuo4 le5 a5
cues.en: You should have said 'You're wrong again.'

cues.zh: 我怎么还知道一直我错
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 hai2 zhi1 dao4 yi4 zhi2 wo3 cuo4
cues.en: Then how am I supposed to know I have to keep saying I'm wrong?

cues.zh: 所以你还是错了啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 hai2 shi4 cuo4 le5 a5
cues.en: So you're still wrong!

cues.zh: 有一天老师问小明
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 lao3 shi1 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: One day the teacher asked Xiao Ming,

cues.zh: 你今天为什么迟到
cues.pinyin: ni3 jin1 tian1 wei4 shen2 me5 chi2 dao4
cues.en: "Why are you late today?"

cues.zh: 老师
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1
cues.en: "Teacher,"

cues.zh: 因为我不过只是遵守
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 bu4 guo4 zhi3 shi4 zun1 shou3
cues.en: "it's only because I was obeying

cues.zh: 交通标志的规定啊
cues.pinyin: jiao1 tong1 biao1 zhi4 de5 gui1 ding4 a5
cues.en: the traffic sign rules."

cues.zh: 什么标志
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: "Which sign?"

items.title_zh: 动动脑时间4｜为什么两人卖苹果的钱会不够分呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: 小明和小华各带 30 颗苹果到市场卖
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 he2 xiao3 hua2 ge4 dai4 30 ke1 ping2 guo3 dao4 shi4 chang3 mai4
cues.en: Xiaoming and Xiaohua each brought 30 apples to sell at the market.

cues.zh: 小明要卖 3 颗 100 元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 yao4 mai4 3 ke1 100 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaoming wanted to sell 3 for 100 yuan.

cues.zh: 小华要卖 2 颗 100 元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 hua2 yao4 mai4 2 ke1 100 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaohua wanted to sell 2 for 100 yuan.

cues.zh: 他们正准备摆摊的时候想到两个人分开卖
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zheng4 zhun3 bei4 bai3 tan1 de5 shi2 hou4 xiang3 dao4 liang3 ge4 ren2 fen1 kai1 mai4
cues.en: Just as they were about to set up their stall, they thought that selling separately

cues.zh: 会互相抢生意
cues.pinyin: hui4 hu4 xiang1 qiang3 sheng1 yi4
cues.en: would mean they'd steal business from each other.

cues.zh: 所以就改把两个人的苹果一起卖
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 gai3 ba3 liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 ping2 guo3 yi4 qi3 mai4
cues.en: So they decided to sell both of their apples together instead.

cues.zh: 他们都想用自己原本的价格卖
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 xiang3 yong4 zi4 ji3 yuan2 ben3 de5 jia4 ge2 mai4
cues.en: They both still wanted to sell at their own original price.

cues.zh: 3 颗 100 元跟 2 颗 100 元合起来就是 5 颗 200 元
cues.pinyin: 3 ke1 100 yuan2 gen1 2 ke1 100 yuan2 he2 qi3 lai2 jiu4 shi4 5 ke1 200 yuan2
cues.en: 3 for 100 yuan plus 2 for 100 yuan combined makes 5 for 200 yuan.

cues.zh: 就这样把 60 颗苹果都卖光了卖得 24 00 元
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 yang4 ba3 60 ke1 ping2 guo3 dou1 mai4 guang1 le5 mai4 de2 24 00 yuan2
cues.en: That's how they sold all 60 apples and made 2400 yuan.

cues.zh: 但是等他们回家的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 deng3 ta1 men5 hui2 jia1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But when they got home,

cues.zh: 小明要分一千元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 yao4 fen1 yi1 qian1 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaoming was supposed to get 1000 yuan,

cues.zh: 小华要分一千五百元
cues.pinyin: xiao3 hua2 yao4 fen1 yi1 qian1 wu3 bai3 yuan2
cues.en: and Xiaohua was supposed to get 1500 yuan.

cues.zh: 但钱不够分
cues.pinyin: dan4 qian2 bu4 gou4 fen1
cues.en: But there wasn't enough money to split that way.

cues.zh: 到底是哪里出了问题呢
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 na3 li3 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: So where exactly did it go wrong?

cues.zh: 你知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know the answer?

cues.zh: 欢迎在下方留言告诉大家喔
cues.pinyin: huan1 ying2 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o1
cues.en: Feel free to leave a comment below and tell everyone.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这喔
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o1
cues.en: The answer to the last episode's riddle is here.

cues.zh: 两个人在两天用两桶水
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 zai4 liang3 tian1 yong4 liang3 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Two people use two buckets of water in two days.

cues.zh: 那么两人一天就是用一桶水
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 liang3 ren2 yi1 tian1 jiu4 shi4 yong4 yi1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: So one person uses one bucket of water in one day.

cues.zh: 八个人一天就是用四桶水
cues.pinyin: ba1 ge4 ren2 yi1 tian1 jiu4 shi4 yong4 si4 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Eight people use four buckets of water in one day.

cues.zh: 八个人八天也就是用了三十二桶水
cues.pinyin: ba1 ge4 ren2 ba1 tian1 ye3 jiu4 shi4 yong4 le5 san1 shi2 er4 tong3 shui3
cues.en: Eight people over eight days use thirty-two buckets of water.

cues.zh: 另外还有一个脑筋急转弯的答案
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 nao3 jin1 ji2 zhuan3 wan1 de5 da2 an4
cues.en: There's also another answer to this brain teaser.

cues.zh: 两个人每个人都用了一天的水
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 yong4 le5 yi1 tian1 de5 shui3
cues.en: Each of the two people used one day's worth of water,

cues.zh: 总共用了两桶水
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 yong4 le5 liang3 tong3 shui3
cues.en: for a total of two buckets of water.

cues.zh: 总共花的时间
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 hua1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: As for the total time spent,

cues.zh: 一天加一天等于两天
cues.pinyin: yi1 tian1 jia1 yi1 tian1 deng3 yu2 liang3 tian1
cues.en: one day plus one day equals two days.

cues.zh: 也就是一人一天用一桶水
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ren2 yi1 tian1 yong4 yi1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: That means one person uses one bucket of water per day.

cues.zh: 那么八个人每个人用一天的水
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ba1 ge4 ren2 mei3 ge4 ren2 yong4 yi1 tian1 de5 shui3
cues.en: So for eight people, each using one day's worth of water,

cues.zh: 总共花了八天的时间
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 hua1 le5 ba1 tian1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: it took a total of eight days.

cues.zh: 所以答案就是八桶水
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 da2 an4 jiu4 shi4 ba1 tong3 shui3
cues.en: So the answer is eight buckets of water.

cues.zh: 你喜欢哪一个答案呢

cues.en: Which answer do you like better?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】杨振宁为何反对中国建设大型粒子对撞机？粒子加速器有什么用？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 著名科学家杨振宁先生在生前曾反
cues.pinyin: zhu4 ming2 ke1 xue2 jia1 yang2 zhen4 ning2 xian1 sheng1 zai4 sheng1 qian2 ceng2 fan3
cues.en: The famous scientist Mr. Yang Zhenning, before he passed away, once opposed

cues.zh: 对中国建设大
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhong1 guo2 jian4 she4 da4
cues.en: China building a large

cues.zh: 型粒子对撞机
cues.pinyin: xing2 li4 zi5 dui4 zhuang4 ji1
cues.en: particle collider.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说粒子对撞机到
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 li4 zi5 dui4 zhuang4 ji1 dao4
cues.en: A kid once asked me what a particle collider

cues.zh: 底是干嘛的呢
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 gan4 ma2 de5 ne5
cues.en: actually does,

cues.zh: 它的原理是怎样的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yuan2 li3 shi4 zen3 yang4 de5
cues.en: and how its principle works.

cues.zh: 今天就来给大家介绍一下这方面的知识
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 fang1 mian4 de5 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: Today I'll explain this knowledge to everyone.

cues.zh: 首先我们从对撞机的原理说起
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 cong2 dui4 zhuang4 ji1 de5 yuan2 li3 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: Let's start with the principle of the collider.

cues.zh: 对撞机是用来加速并且使基本粒
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhuang4 ji1 shi4 yong4 lai2 jia1 su4 bing4 qie3 shi3 ji1 ben3 li4
cues.en: A collider is used to accelerate and make fundamental particles

cues.zh: 子发生碰撞的
cues.pinyin: zi5 fa1 sheng1 peng4 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: collide with each other.

cues.zh: 我们首先说一下这个基本粒子发生碰撞它
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 shuo1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 ji1 ben3 li4 zi5 fa1 sheng1 peng4 zhuang4 ta1
cues.en: Let's first talk about what colliding fundamental particles

cues.zh: 的作用是什么
cues.pinyin: de5 zuo4 yong4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: is actually for.

cues.zh: 比如说我们想研究一下核桃的内部结构
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 xiang3 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 he2 tao2 de5 nei4 bu4 jie2 gou4
cues.en: For example, say we want to study the internal structure of a walnut.

cues.zh: 我们怎么研究我们要把核桃敲碎对不对
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zen3 me5 yan2 jiu1 wo3 men5 yao4 ba3 he2 tao2 qiao1 sui4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: How do we study it? We need to crack the walnut open, right?

cues.zh: 在宏观世界里我们可以用锤子去敲核桃
cues.pinyin: zai4 hong2 guan1 shi4 jie4 li3 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 chui2 zi5 qu4 qiao1 he2 tao2
cues.en: In the macroscopic world we can use a hammer to crack a walnut.

cues.zh: 但是微观世界里这个核桃非常非常的小
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wei1 guan1 shi4 jie4 li3 zhe4 ge5 he2 tao2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 xiao3
cues.en: But in the microscopic world, this "walnut" is extremely tiny.

cues.zh: 你没办法用锤子敲
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 ban4 fa3 yong4 chui2 zi5 qiao1
cues.en: You can't use a hammer to crack it.

cues.zh: 你只能用两个核桃对撞是吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 neng2 yong4 liang3 ge4 he2 tao2 dui4 zhuang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: You can only smash two walnuts together, right?

cues.zh: 就是使两个基本粒子发生碰撞
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shi3 liang3 ge4 ji1 ben3 li4 zi5 fa1 sheng1 peng4 zhuang4
cues.en: That is, making two fundamental particles collide.

cues.en: it might emit light, or various other

cues.zh: 七八糟的东西
cues.pinyin: qi1 ba1 zao1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: miscellaneous things.

cues.zh: 我们现在对于微观世界的认识
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 dui4 yu2 wei1 guan1 shi4 jie4 de5 ren4 shi2
cues.en: Our current understanding of the microscopic world

cues.zh: 很多都是靠这个加速器和粒子对状产生的
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 dou1 shi4 kao4 zhe4 ge5 jia1 su4 qi4 he2 li4 zi5 dui4 zhuang4 chan3 sheng1 de5
cues.en: relies heavily on accelerators and particle collisions.

cues.zh: 比如说我们知道物质有什么构成
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 wu4 zhi4 you3 shen2 me5 gou4 cheng2
cues.en: For example, we know what matter is made of—

cues.zh: 由原子构成对吧
cues.pinyin: you2 yuan2 zi5 gou4 cheng2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: it's made of atoms, right?

cues.zh: 而原子由原子和核外电子构成
cues.pinyin: er2 yuan2 zi5 you2 yuan2 zi5 he2 he2 wai4 dian4 zi5 gou4 cheng2
cues.en: And atoms are made of a nucleus and electrons outside it.

cues.zh: 这咱们是怎么知道的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zan2 men5 shi4 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 de5
cues.en: How did we come to know this?

cues.zh: 其实就是靠粒子对状实现的
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 kao4 li4 zi5 dui4 zhuang4 shi2 xian4 de5
cues.en: Actually, it was discovered through particle collisions.

cues.zh: 比如卢瑟福
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 lu2 se4 fu2
cues.en: For example, Rutherford.

cues.zh: 卢瑟福是二十世纪初英国著名
cues.pinyin: lu2 se4 fu2 shi4 er4 shi2 shi4 ji4 chu1 ying1 guo2 zhu4 ming2
cues.en: Rutherford was a famous British

cues.zh: 的核物理学家
cues.pinyin: de5 he2 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: nuclear physicist in the early 20th century.

cues.zh: 这个卢瑟福他利用粒子对状做
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lu2 se4 fu2 ta1 li4 yong4 li4 zi5 dui4 zhuang4 zuo4
cues.en: This Rutherford used particle collisions to do

cues.zh: 了很多的实验
cues.pinyin: le5 hen3 duo1 de5 shi2 yan4
cues.en: a lot of experiments.

cues.zh: 比如有一个著名实验叫粒子散射实验
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 you3 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 shi2 yan4 jiao4 li4 zi5 san3 she4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: For instance, there's a famous one called the particle scattering experiment.

cues.zh: 粒子就是氦原子核
cues.pinyin: li4 zi5 jiu4 shi4 hai4 yuan2 zi3 he2
cues.en: The particles were helium nuclei (alpha particles),

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】杨振宁为何反对中国建设大型粒子对撞机？粒子加速器有什么用？

cues.zh: 轰出来氧 17 是氧的一种同位素
cues.pinyin: hong1 chu1 lai2 yang3 17 shi4 yang3 de5 yi1 zhong3 tong2 wei4 su4
cues.en: blasted out to produce oxygen-17, an isotope of oxygen,

cues.zh: 以及一个质子
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 yi2 ge4 zhi4 zi5
cues.en: as well as a proton.

cues.zh: 结果他发现有这么一个玩意儿
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ta1 fa1 xian4 you3 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 wan2 yi4 er2
cues.en: As a result he found there was this thing—

cues.zh: 这个玩意儿它的质量数和那核都是 1
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wan2 yi4 er2 ta1 de5 zhi4 liang4 shu4 he2 na4 he2 dou1 shi4 1
cues.en: its mass number, like that of a hydrogen nucleus, was 1.

cues.zh: 它是原子核的组成部分
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yuan2 zi3 he2 de5 zu3 cheng2 bu4 fen4
cues.en: It's a component of the atomic nucleus.

cues.zh: 于是他就发现了质子
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 fa1 xian4 le5 zhi4 zi5
cues.en: So he discovered the proton.

cues.zh: 是吧你看卢瑟福是很厉害的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 ni3 kan4 lu2 se4 fu2 shi4 hen3 li4 hai4 de5
cues.en: See, Rutherford was really remarkable.

cues.zh: 但最后卢瑟福居然得了个诺贝尔
cues.pinyin: dan4 zui4 hou4 lu2 se4 fu2 ju1 ran2 de2 le5 ge4 nuo4 bei4 er3
cues.en: But in the end, Rutherford actually won the Nobel Prize

cues.zh: 化学奖很奇怪
cues.pinyin: hua4 xue2 jiang3 hen3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: in Chemistry, which is pretty strange.

cues.zh: 卢瑟福有一个学生名字叫查德维克
cues.pinyin: lu2 se4 fu2 you3 yi2 ge4 xue2 sheng1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 cha2 de2 wei2 ke4
cues.en: Rutherford had a student named Chadwick.

cues.zh: 这个查德维克在跟著卢瑟福做实验的时候
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cha2 de2 wei2 ke4 zai4 gen1 zhu4 lu2 se4 fu2 zuo4 shi2 yan4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While this Chadwick was doing experiments with Rutherford,

cues.zh: 也就有了一些感受是吧
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 you3 le5 yi1 xie1 gan3 shou4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: he picked up some insights too.

cues.zh: 所以查德维克也开始用
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cha2 de2 wei2 ke4 ye3 kai1 shi3 yong4
cues.en: So Chadwick also started using

cues.zh: 粒子轰击乱七八糟的东西
cues.pinyin: li4 zi5 hong1 ji1 luan4 qi1 ba1 zao1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: particles to bombard all sorts of things.

cues.zh: 比如有一次查德维克就用粒子去轰击鹏
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 you3 yi1 ci4 cha2 de2 wei2 ke4 jiu4 yong4 li4 zi5 qu4 hong1 ji1 peng2
cues.en: For example, once Chadwick used particles to bombard beryllium.

cues.zh: 结果轰击出来什么呢
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 hong1 ji1 chu1 lai2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What came out of the bombardment?

cues.zh: 轰击出来氮十三和一个不带电的粒子
cues.pinyin: hong1 ji1 chu1 lai2 dan4 shi2 san1 he2 yi2 ge4 bu4 dai4 dian4 de5 li4 zi5
cues.en: It produced nitrogen-13 and an uncharged particle.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】杨振宁为何反对中国建设大型粒子对撞机？粒子加速器有什么用？

cues.zh: 19 28 年挪威的一个科学家叫维德罗
cues.pinyin: 19 28 nian2 nuo2 wei1 de5 yi2 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1 jiao4 wei2 de2 luo2
cues.en: In 1928, a Norwegian scientist named Widerøe

cues.zh: 这个维德罗他设计主持建造了第一
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wei2 de2 luo2 ta1 she4 ji4 zhu3 chi2 jian4 zao4 le5 di4 yi1
cues.en: designed and led the construction of the first

cues.zh: 台直线加速器
cues.pinyin: tai2 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4
cues.en: linear accelerator.

cues.zh: 这个直线加速器的基本结构也非常简单
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4 de5 ji1 ben3 jie2 gou4 ye3 fei1 chang2 jian3 dan1
cues.en: The basic structure of this linear accelerator is actually very simple.

cues.zh: 如果我们用现在通俗的语言来讲的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 yong4 xian4 zai4 tong1 su2 de5 yu3 yan2 lai2 jiang3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If we describe it in today's everyday language,

cues.zh: 大概是这个样子
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: it's roughly like this.

cues.zh: 说有一个电源电源旁边有个灯丝
cues.pinyin: shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 dian4 yuan2 dian4 yuan2 pang2 bian1 you3 ge4 deng1 si1
cues.en: Say there's a power source, and next to it a filament.

cues.zh: 所以灯丝一于热就可以发射电子
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 deng1 si1 yi1 yu2 re4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 fa1 she4 dian4 zi5
cues.en: Once the filament heats up, it can emit electrons.

cues.zh: 电子出来之后速度很低
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 su4 du4 hen3 di1
cues.en: When the electrons come out, their speed is very low.

cues.zh: 那我们能不能把它加速呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 neng2 bu4 neng2 ba3 ta1 jia1 su4 ne5
cues.en: So can we accelerate them?

cues.zh: 可以我们怎么办
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 wo3 men5 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: Yes, how do we do it?

cues.zh: 我们再加一个加速电场
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 jia1 yi2 ge4 jia1 su4 dian4 chang3
cues.en: We add an accelerating electric field.

cues.zh: 这个加速电场有一个阳极
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jia1 su4 dian4 chang3 you3 yi2 ge4 yang2 ji2
cues.en: This accelerating field has an anode.

cues.zh: 这一边构成它的阴极
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 bian1 gou4 cheng2 ta1 de5 yin1 ji2
cues.en: This side forms its cathode.

cues.zh: 然后在加速电场中形成了向左的电场
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 jia1 su4 dian4 chang3 zhong1 xing2 cheng2 le5 xiang4 zuo3 de5 dian4 chang3
cues.en: Then in the accelerating field a leftward electric field forms.

cues.zh: 那么电子它带负电盒
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dian4 zi5 ta1 dai4 fu4 dian4 he2
cues.en: Now, the electron carries negative charge,

cues.zh: 所以在一个向左的电场中
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 yi2 ge4 xiang4 zuo3 de5 dian4 chang3 zhong1
cues.en: so in a leftward-pointing electric field,

cues.zh: 电子会有一个向右的受力
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 hui4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiang4 you4 de5 shou4 li4
cues.en: the electron experiences a force to the right.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】杨振宁为何反对中国建设大型粒子对撞机？粒子加速器有什么用？

cues.zh: 所以这个受力就会使得电子往这边飞了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 shou4 li4 jiu4 hui4 shi3 de5 dian4 zi5 wang3 zhe4 bian1 fei1 le5
cues.en: So this force makes the electron fly in that direction.

cues.zh: 这就是所谓的直线加速器
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 suo3 wei4 de5 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4
cues.en: This is the so-called linear accelerator.

cues.zh: 我们以前老式的那个显像管电视机原理
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 lao3 shi4 de5 na4 ge5 xian3 xiang4 guan3 dian4 shi4 ji1 yuan2 li3
cues.en: The old-style cathode-ray tube TVs we used to have

cues.zh: 就是这个样子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: worked exactly on this principle.

cues.zh: 电子枪发出电子来之后经过加速器加速
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 qiang1 fa1 chu1 dian4 zi5 lai2 zhi1 hou4 jing1 guo4 jia1 su4 qi4 jia1 su4
cues.en: The electron gun emits electrons, which get accelerated by the accelerator,

cues.zh: 然后打到屏幕上面我们看掉图像
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 da3 dao4 ping2 mu4 shang4 mian4 wo3 men5 kan4 diao4 tu2 xiang4
cues.en: then hit the screen, and that's how we see the image.

cues.zh: 那么后来人们就想说
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 jiu4 xiang3 shuo1
cues.en: Later on, people thought,

cues.zh: 如果我们想提高这个电子的速度怎么办
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 xiang3 ti2 gao1 zhe4 ge5 dian4 zi5 de5 su4 du4 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: what if we want to increase the electron's speed?

cues.zh: 我就需要让电压变得更大一些
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xu1 yao4 rang4 dian4 ya1 bian4 de2 geng4 da4 yi1 xie1
cues.en: We'd need to make the voltage even higher.

cues.zh: 但是电压我又没办法变得特别大怎么整呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dian4 ya1 wo3 you4 mei2 ban4 fa3 bian4 de2 te4 bie2 da4 zen3 me5 zheng3 ne5
cues.en: But we have no way to make the voltage extremely large, so what do we do?

cues.zh: 咱们又发明了这个多级直线加速器
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 you4 fa1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 duo1 ji2 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4
cues.en: We invented the multi-stage linear accelerator.

cues.zh: 多级直线加速器原理上其实也差不太多
cues.pinyin: duo1 ji2 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4 yuan2 li3 shang4 qi2 shi2 ye3 cha4 bu4 tai4 duo1
cues.en: The multi-stage linear accelerator is actually not that different in principle.

cues.zh: 原理上其实也差不太多
cues.pinyin: yuan2 li3 shang4 qi2 shi2 ye3 cha4 bu4 tai4 duo1
cues.en: It's not that different in principle.

cues.zh: 那大概的意思是这样
cues.pinyin: na4 da4 gai4 de5 yi4 si5 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Roughly, the idea is like this.

cues.zh: 它也有这个加速的这个环状的结构
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 you3 zhe4 ge5 jia1 su4 de5 zhe4 ge5 huan2 zhuang4 de5 jie2 gou4
cues.en: It also has this accelerating ring-shaped structure,

cues.zh: 环状的结构
cues.pinyin: huan2 zhuang4 de5 jie2 gou4
cues.en: a ring-shaped structure.

cues.zh: 然后它接的是一个交流点
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jie1 de5 shi4 yi2 ge4 jiao1 liu2 dian3
cues.en: and it's connected to an alternating current.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】杨振宁为何反对中国建设大型粒子对撞机？粒子加速器有什么用？

cues.zh: 这就是所谓的多极直线加速器的原理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 suo3 wei4 de5 duo1 ji2 zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4 de5 yuan2 li3
cues.en: This is the principle of the so-called multi-stage linear accelerator.

cues.zh: 那么我们知道如果你加速的速度越来越快
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ru2 guo3 ni3 jia1 su4 de5 su4 du4 yue4 lai2 yue4 kuai4
cues.en: Now, we know that if the acceleration gets faster and faster,

cues.zh: AB 的这个交流电周期不变的话
cues.pinyin: AB de5 zhe4 ge5 jiao1 liu2 dian4 zhou1 qi1 bu4 bian4 de5 hua4
cues.en: and the period of the AC between A and B stays the same,

cues.zh: 你这个距离必须越来越大
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 ju4 li2 bi4 xu1 yue4 lai2 yue4 da4
cues.en: then this distance has to keep getting larger.

cues.zh: 越往右边就距离越大
cues.pinyin: yue4 wang3 you4 bian1 jiu4 ju4 li2 yue4 da4
cues.en: The farther to the right, the greater the distance.

cues.zh: 直线加速器有一个优点
cues.pinyin: zhi2 xian4 jia1 su4 qi4 you3 yi2 ge4 you1 dian3
cues.en: The linear accelerator has one advantage:

cues.zh: 就是它结构简单
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 jie2 gou4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: its structure is simple,

cues.zh: 而且比较高效
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bi3 jiao4 gao1 xiao4
cues.en: and it's quite efficient.

cues.zh: 它一直在加速对吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 zai4 jia1 su4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: It's accelerating the whole time, right?

cues.zh: 但它有一个缺点
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 que1 dian3
cues.en: But it also has a drawback:

cues.zh: 缺点就是你要想加速到很高的速度
cues.pinyin: que1 dian3 jiu4 shi4 ni3 yao4 xiang3 jia1 su4 dao4 hen3 gao1 de5 su4 du4
cues.en: the drawback is, if you want to accelerate to very high speeds,

cues.zh: 你就需要特别特别长对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 xu1 yao4 te4 bie2 te4 bie2 zhang3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: you need it to be extremely, extremely long, right?

cues.zh: 这个对于这个实验设备的建造
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dui4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 she4 bei4 de5 jian4 zao4
cues.en: For building this kind of experimental equipment,

cues.zh: 是非常不利的
cues.pinyin: shi4 fei1 chang2 bu4 li4 de5
cues.en: that's very disadvantageous.

cues.zh: 你搞一个很长很长的这样一个管道
cues.pinyin: ni3 gao3 yi2 ge4 hen3 zhang3 hen3 zhang3 de5 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 guan3 dao4
cues.en: You'd need to build an extremely long tube,

cues.zh: 上百公里的管道
cues.pinyin: shang4 bai3 gong1 li3 de5 guan3 dao4
cues.en: a tube hundreds of kilometers long.

cues.zh: 那你想一想这个难度是很大的对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 zhe4 ge5 nan2 du4 shi4 hen3 da4 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Just think about it, that's really difficult, right?

cues.zh: 后来人们又想我们能不能改一改呢
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 you4 xiang3 wo3 men5 neng2 bu4 neng2 gai3 yi1 gai3 ne5
cues.en: Later, people thought, could we change this?

cues.zh: 我们让它体积小一点
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 rang4 ta1 ti3 ji1 xiao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Could we make it smaller in size?

cues.zh: 于是有一个人就发明了回旋加速器
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 jiu4 fa1 ming2 le5 hui2 xuan2 jia1 su4 qi4
cues.en: So someone invented the cyclotron.

cues.zh: 回旋加速器的发明者
cues.pinyin: hui2 xuan2 jia1 su4 qi4 de5 fa1 ming2 zhe3
cues.en: The inventor of the cyclotron—

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: “时差恋人”保持新鲜感的秘诀是……？

cues.zh: 我是建筑师金山周平 18 年前我和中国结缘
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jian4 zhu4 shi1 jin1 shan1 zhou1 ping2 18 nian2 qian2 wo3 he2 zhong1 guo2 jie2 yuan2
cues.en: I'm architect Kanayama Shuhei. 18 years ago, I became connected to China.

cues.zh: 我被这片土地上生活的人深深打动
cues.pinyin: wo3 bei4 zhe4 pian4 tu3 di4 shang4 sheng1 huo2 de5 ren2 shen1 shen1 da3 dong4
cues.en: I was deeply moved by the people living on this land.

cues.zh: 便开始关注起了这里的人们
cues.pinyin: bian4 kai1 shi3 guan1 zhu4 qi3 le5 zhe4 li3 de5 ren2 men5
cues.en: So I started paying attention to the people here.

cues.zh: 用空间换效率的居住改造
cues.pinyin: yong4 kong1 jian1 huan4 xiao4 lv4 de5 ju1 zhu4 gai3 zao4
cues.en: A home renovation that trades space for efficiency.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: “时差恋人”保持新鲜感的秘诀是……？

cues.zh: 你好清掌老师你好
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 qing1 zhang3 lao3 shi1 ni3 hao3
cues.en: Hello, Teacher Qingzhang — hello!

cues.zh: 邀请来进行空间改造
cues.pinyin: yao1 qing3 lai2 jin4 xing2 kong1 jian1 gai3 zao4
cues.en: Invited to carry out a space renovation.

cues.zh: 希望带给地方一间洗
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 dai4 gei3 di4 fang1 yi1 jian1 xi3
cues.en: Hoping to bring this place something fresh.

cues.zh: 那你们平时会做饭吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 ping2 shi2 hui4 zuo4 fan4 ma5
cues.en: So, do you two usually cook?

cues.zh: 我们呢其实会喜欢平常做一些好吃的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ne5 qi2 shi2 hui4 xi3 huan1 ping2 chang2 zuo4 yi1 xie1 hao3 chi1 de5
cues.en: Actually, we like to make something delicious sometimes.

cues.zh: 然后也是像我们生活中的一些仪式感
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 xiang4 wo3 men5 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 de5 yi1 xie1 yi2 shi4 gan3
cues.en: It's also a bit of ritual in our life.

cues.zh: 平常呢因为工作
cues.pinyin: ping2 chang2 ne5 yin1 wei4 gong1 zuo4

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: “时差恋人”保持新鲜感的秘诀是……？

cues.zh: 爱不能被时间辜负
cues.pinyin: ai4 bu4 neng2 bei4 shi2 jian1 gu1 fu4
cues.en: Love shouldn't be failed by time,

cues.zh: 更不能被空间辜负
cues.pinyin: geng4 bu4 neng2 bei4 kong1 jian1 gu1 fu4
cues.en: nor should it be failed by space.

cues.zh: 生活的美好在空间的边界下
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 de5 mei3 hao3 zai4 kong1 jian1 de5 bian1 jie4 xia4
cues.en: The beauty of life, within the boundaries of space,

cues.zh: 延展出生活的各种可能
cues.pinyin: yan2 zhan3 chu1 sheng1 huo2 de5 ge4 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: extends out into all of life's possibilities.

cues.zh: 同样大小的空间
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 da4 xiao3 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: The same size of space,

cues.zh: 却能装下多一半的新鲜
cues.pinyin: que4 neng2 zhuang1 xia4 duo1 yi2 ban4 de5 xin1 xian1
cues.en: but it can hold half again as much freshness.

cues.zh: 百变吃鲜
cues.pinyin: bai3 bian4 chi1 xian1
cues.en: A hundred ways to keep it fresh.

cues.zh: 每样食材都能找到适合它的温度
cues.pinyin: mei3 yang4 shi2 cai2 dou1 neng2 zhao3 dao4 shi4 he2 ta1 de5 wen1 du4
cues.en: Every ingredient can find the temperature that suits it best.

cues.zh: 抗菌锁鲜不串味
cues.pinyin: kang4 jun1 suo3 xian1 bu4 chuan4 wei4
cues.en: Antibacterial, freshness-locking, no mixing of odors,

cues.zh: 更能帮你锁住它的味道
cues.pinyin: geng4 neng2 bang1 ni3 suo3 zhu4 ta1 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: it also helps you lock in the flavor even better.

cues.zh: 不再为旧的担忧
cues.pinyin: bu4 zai4 wei4 jiu4 de5 dan1 you1
cues.en: No more worrying about things going stale.

cues.zh: 打破新鲜的时差
cues.pinyin: da3 po4 xin1 xian1 de5 shi2 cha4
cues.en: Breaking the time lag of freshness.

cues.zh: 美好的一切
cues.pinyin: mei3 hao3 de5 yi1 qie4
cues.en: All the good things in life

cues.zh: 应当拥有更长的保鲜期限
cues.pinyin: ying1 dang1 yong1 you3 geng4 zhang3 de5 bao3 xian1 qi1 xian4
cues.en: deserve a longer shelf life.

cues.zh: 生活不将就
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 bu4 jiang1 jiu4
cues.en: Life doesn't have to settle,

cues.zh: 新鲜更长久
cues.pinyin: xin1 xian1 geng4 chang2 jiu3
cues.en: freshness lasts longer.

cues.zh: 番茄牛肉 8 oz 的牛肉

cues.zh: 煎一煎

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】阴谋还是必需品？告诉你关于牛奶的一切

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友问我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a child asked me

cues.zh: 他看到周围的同学每天都喝牛奶
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 zhou1 wei2 de5 tong2 xue2 mei3 tian1 dou1 he1 niu2 nai3
cues.en: He saw classmates around him drinking milk every day

cues.zh: 但是他一喝牛奶就肚子疼
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 yi1 he1 niu2 nai3 jiu4 du3 zi5 teng2
cues.en: But whenever he drinks milk, his stomach hurts

cues.zh: 他问我这是为什么呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen4 wo3 zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: He asked me why that is

cues.zh: 牛奶是不是每个人都应该喝呢
cues.pinyin: niu2 nai3 shi4 bu2 shi4 mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 ying1 gai1 he1 ne5
cues.en: Should everyone drink milk?

cues.zh: 还有有些牛奶保质期是 7 天
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 you3 xie1 niu2 nai3 bao3 zhi4 qi1 shi4 7 tian1
cues.en: Also, some milk has a shelf life of 7 days

cues.zh: 有些牛奶保质期是半年
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 niu2 nai3 bao3 zhi4 qi1 shi4 ban4 nian2
cues.en: Some milk has a shelf life of half a year

cues.zh: 为什么会差别这么大是不是添
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 cha1 bie2 zhe4 me5 da4 shi4 bu2 shi4 tian1
cues.en: Why is the difference so big — is it because

cues.zh: 加了防腐剂呢
cues.pinyin: jia1 le5 fang2 fu3 ji4 ne5
cues.en: preservatives were added?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来讨论一下关于牛奶的话题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 guan1 yu2 niu2 nai3 de5 hua4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's discuss the topic of milk

cues.zh: 为了讨论牛奶的话题
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tao3 lun4 niu2 nai3 de5 hua4 ti2
cues.en: To discuss the topic of milk

cues.zh: 我们还是从人体需要的一种元素钙说起
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hai2 shi4 cong2 ren2 ti3 xu1 yao4 de5 yi1 zhong3 yuan2 su4 gai4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: Let's start with an element the human body needs: calcium

cues.zh: 钙这种元素是人体所需要的第五大元素
cues.pinyin: gai4 zhe4 zhong3 yuan2 su4 shi4 ren2 ti3 suo3 xu1 yao4 de5 di4 wu3 da4 yuan2 su4
cues.en: Calcium is the fifth most abundant element needed by the human body

cues.zh: 我们知道人体之中含量最多的元素
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ren2 ti3 zhi1 zhong1 han2 liang4 zui4 duo1 de5 yuan2 su4
cues.en: We know the elements with the highest content in the human body

cues.zh: 有碳氢氧氮
cues.pinyin: you3 tan4 qing1 yang3 dan4
cues.en: are carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, and nitrogen

cues.zh: 那第五个就是钙
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 wu3 ge4 jiu4 shi4 gai4
cues.en: The fifth one is calcium

cues.zh: 钙这种元素人的含量特别高
cues.pinyin: gai4 zhe4 zhong3 yuan2 su4 ren2 de5 han2 liang4 te4 bie2 gao1
cues.en: The content of calcium in the human body is especially high

cues.zh: 有 1 5 到 2 是钙
cues.pinyin: you3 1 5 dao4 2 shi4 gai4
cues.en: About 1.5% to 2% of the body is calcium

cues.zh: 也就是一个人 150 斤
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 ren2 150 jin1

cues.zh: 可是洗了半天小明的衣服还是
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xi3 le5 ban4 tian1 xiao3 ming2 de5 yi1 fu2 hai2 shi4
cues.en: But after washing for a long time, Xiao Ming's clothes are still

cues.zh: 脏的为什么呢
cues.pinyin: zang4 de5 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: dirty, why is that?

cues.zh: 会不会是小明的衣服实在太脏了
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 xiao3 ming2 de5 yi1 fu2 shi2 zai4 tai4 zang1 le5
cues.en: Could it be that Xiao Ming's clothes were just too dirty

cues.zh: 然后洗了才变成一点点干净而已
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xi3 le5 cai2 bian4 cheng2 yi4 dian3 dian3 gan1 jing4 er2 yi3
cues.en: so after washing they only got a tiny bit cleaner?

cues.zh: 错答案是因为妈妈洗的是别人的衣服
cues.pinyin: cuo4 da2 an4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ma1 ma1 xi3 de5 shi4 bie2 ren2 de5 yi1 fu2
cues.en: Wrong! The answer is because mom was washing someone else's clothes.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话66｜好孩子｜弟弟摔倒｜说曹操曹操到｜A.C比身高｜变聋了｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 老实说地球整天不停的转动
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi2 shuo1 di4 qiu2 zheng3 tian1 bu4 ting2 de5 zhuan3 dong4
cues.en: Honestly, the earth keeps spinning all day without stopping,

cues.zh: 怪不得我弟弟一天到晚都摔倒
cues.pinyin: guai4 bu4 de2 wo3 di4 di5 yi1 tian1 dao4 wan3 dou1 shuai1 dao3
cues.en: no wonder my little brother falls down all day long.

cues.zh: 在历史上谁跑得最快呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 shui2 pao3 de2 zui4 kuai4 ne5
cues.en: In history, who ran the fastest?

cues.zh: 关公因为他骑赤兔马
cues.pinyin: guan1 gong1 yin1 wei4 ta1 qi2 chi4 tu4 ma3
cues.en: Guan Gong, because he rode the Red Hare horse.

cues.zh: 不是喔是曹操
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 o1 shi4 cao2 cao1
cues.en: No wait, it's Cao Cao.

cues.zh: 因为有一句成语说
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 you3 yi1 ju4 cheng2 yu3 shuo1
cues.en: Because there's a saying that goes,

cues.zh: 说超超超超超大
cues.pinyin: shuo1 chao1 chao1 chao1 chao1 chao1 da4
cues.en: 'speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives.'

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话66｜好孩子｜弟弟摔倒｜说曹操曹操到｜A.C比身高｜变聋了｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1
cues.en: Shanshan.

cues.zh: 干嘛
cues.pinyin: gan4 ma2
cues.en: What?

cues.zh: 现在社会要流行多说好话
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 she4 hui4 yao4 liu2 xing2 duo1 shuo1 hao3 hua4
cues.en: These days society is all about saying nicer things to each other.

cues.zh: 我们现在呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ne5
cues.en: So right now, let's

cues.zh: 妳夸我一句
cues.pinyin: ni3 kua1 wo3 yi1 ju4
cues.en: you compliment me once,

cues.zh: 我夸妳一句怎么样
cues.pinyin: wo3 kua1 ni3 yi1 ju4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: and I'll compliment you once, how about that?

cues.zh: 蛤那我先了喔
cues.pinyin: ha2 na4 wo3 xian1 le5 o1
cues.en: Huh, okay, I'll go first then.

cues.zh: 妳眼光真好
cues.pinyin: ni3 yan3 guang1 zhen1 hao3
cues.en: You have great taste.

items.title_zh: 笑话66｜好孩子｜弟弟摔倒｜说曹操曹操到｜A.C比身高｜变聋了｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 是不是所有虚构的故事
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 suo3 you3 xu1 gou4 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: Isn't it true that all fictional stories

cues.zh: 开头都会说
cues.pinyin: kai1 tou2 du1 hui4 shuo1
cues.en: always begin by saying,

cues.zh: 很久很久以前
cues.pinyin: hen3 jiu3 hen3 jiu3 yi3 qian2
cues.en: 'once upon a time',

cues.zh: 这样子呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 ne5
cues.en: something like that?

cues.zh: 不是的
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 de5
cues.en: No.

cues.zh: 那个像有时候会用
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 xiang4 you3 shi2 hou4 hui4 yong4
cues.en: Sometimes they instead use

cues.zh: 亲爱的
cues.pinyin: qin1 ai4 de5
cues.en: 'Dear,

cues.zh: 今天公司加班
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gong1 si1 jia1 ban1
cues.en: I have to work overtime at the office today,

cues.zh: 我会晚一点回来
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 wan3 yi4 dian3 hui2 lai2
cues.en: I'll be back a bit late.'

cues.zh: 像这一些
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhe4 yi1 xie1
cues.en: Things like that.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 中国最受冷落的大师，被这个山东80后发掘了 China's Most Neglected Master, Discovered by This Shandong

cues.zh: 懂画的人都喜欢关良
cues.pinyin: dong3 hua4 de5 ren2 dou1 xi3 huan1 guan1 liang2
cues.en: People who understand painting all like Guan Liang.

cues.zh: 近代艺术三座高峰
cues.pinyin: jin4 dai4 yi4 shu4 san1 zuo4 gao1 feng1
cues.en: Three peaks of modern Chinese art.

cues.zh: 山水是黄宾虹花鸟是齐白石
cues.pinyin: shan1 shui3 shi4 huang2 bin1 hong2 hua1 niao3 shi4 qi2 bai2 shi2
cues.en: Landscape painting: Huang Binhong. Bird-and-flower painting: Qi Baishi.

cues.zh: 人物肯定是关良
cues.pinyin: ren2 wu4 ken3 ding4 shi4 guan1 liang2
cues.en: Figure painting: it has to be Guan Liang.

cues.zh: 来自山东的林玉柱先生是关良作品最大
cues.pinyin: lai2 zi4 shan1 dong1 de5 lin2 yu4 zhu4 xian1 sheng1 shi4 guan1 liang2 zuo4 pin3 zui4 da4
cues.en: Mr. Lin Yuzhu from Shandong is the collector who holds

cues.zh: 体量的收藏家
cues.pinyin: ti3 liang4 de5 shou1 cang2 jia1
cues.en: the largest collection of Guan Liang's works.

cues.zh: 他出过关良画册办关良展览
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu1 guo4 guan1 liang2 hua4 ce4 ban4 guan1 liang2 zhan3 lan3
cues.en: He has published Guan Liang art books and held Guan Liang exhibitions.

cues.zh: 同时他自己也是一位画家
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 ta1 zi4 ji3 ye3 shi4 yi1 wei4 hua4 jia1
cues.en: At the same time, he himself is also a painter.

cues.zh: 从事美术教育行业
cues.pinyin: cong2 shi4 mei3 shu4 jiao4 yu4 hang2 ye4
cues.en: He works in the field of art education.

cues.zh: 今年初我们来到他在山东日照
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 chu1 wo3 men5 lai2 dao4 ta1 zai4 shan1 dong1 ri4 zhao4
cues.en: Early this year we came to his home in Rizhao, Shandong,

cues.zh: 的家拜访了他
cues.pinyin: de5 jia1 bai4 fang3 le5 ta1
cues.en: to visit him.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 中国最受冷落的大师，被这个山东80后发掘了 China's Most Neglected Master, Discovered by This Shandong

cues.zh: 这片海是生我养我的海
cues.pinyin: zhe4 pian4 hai3 shi4 sheng1 wo3 yang3 wo3 de5 hai3
cues.en: This sea is the sea that gave me life and raised me.

cues.zh: 小时候都在这个海边长大
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 hou4 dou1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 hai3 bian1 zhang3 da4
cues.en: As a child I grew up on this beach.

cues.zh: 从小就抱着一个
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 jiu4 bao4 zhe5 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Since I was young I held onto

cues.zh: 当艺术家的梦想
cues.pinyin: dang1 yi4 shu4 jia1 de5 meng4 xiang3
cues.en: a dream of becoming an artist.

cues.zh: 去学画画
cues.pinyin: qu4 xue2 hua4 hua4
cues.en: and went to study painting.

cues.zh: 我要做美术教育
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 zuo4 mei3 shu4 jiao4 yu4
cues.en: I wanted to work in art education.

cues.zh: 我自己也写书法
cues.pinyin: wo3 zi4 ji3 ye3 xie3 shu1 fa3
cues.en: I also practice calligraphy myself.

cues.zh: 自己亲历亲密地去实践
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 qin1 li4 qin1 mi4 di4 qu4 shi2 jian4
cues.en: Personally experiencing and practicing it up close —

cues.zh: 那还是不一样
cues.pinyin: na4 hai2 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: that's still different from just observing.

cues.zh: 可能看着会更深更透
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 kan4 zhe5 hui4 geng1 shen1 geng4 tou4
cues.en: It probably lets you see things more deeply and clearly.

cues.zh: 买的过程中
cues.pinyin: mai3 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: In the process of collecting his works,

cues.zh: 识别奠定
cues.pinyin: shi2 bie2 dian4 ding4
cues.en: identifying and studying them laid a foundation,

cues.zh: 对我自身的专业
cues.pinyin: dui4 wo3 zi4 shen1 de5 zhuan1 ye4
cues.en: for my own professional growth,

cues.zh: 它又是一个滋养
cues.pinyin: ta1 you4 shi4 yi2 ge4 zi1 yang3
cues.en: it has also been a source of nourishment.

cues.zh: 我做过几个大的展览
cues.pinyin: wo3 zuo4 guo4 ji3 ge4 da4 de5 zhan3 lan3
cues.en: I've organized several major exhibitions.

cues.zh: 我买关良
cues.pinyin: wo3 mai3 guan1 liang2
cues.en: I collect Guan Liang's works,

cues.zh: 认识的好多当代艺术家
cues.pinyin: ren4 shi2 de5 hao3 duo1 dang1 dai4 yi4 shu4 jia1
cues.en: and I know many contemporary artists,

cues.zh: 或者是那种搞学术的老师们
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 na4 zhong3 gao3 xue2 shu4 de5 lao3 shi1 men5
cues.en: or teachers who do academic art work.

cues.zh: 他们的书房里或家里都会挂一张关良
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 shu1 fang2 li3 huo4 jia1 li3 du1 hui4 gua4 yi1 zhang1 guan1 liang2
cues.en: They all hang a Guan Liang painting in their study or home.

cues.zh: 初看关良的画的人可能都觉得
cues.pinyin: chu1 kan4 guan1 liang2 de5 hua4 de5 ren2 ke3 neng2 dou1 jue2 de5
cues.en: People seeing Guan Liang's paintings for the first time probably think,

cues.zh: 这是什么呀这是小孩画的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 ya5 zhe4 shi4 xiao3 hai2 hua4 de5
cues.en: 'What is this? This looks like a child drew it.'

cues.zh: 这就是推过境界
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 tui1 guo4 jing4 jie4
cues.en: But that's actually the state of returning to innocence.

cues.zh: 毕加索有一句话叫
cues.pinyin: bi4 jia1 suo3 you3 yi1 ju4 hua4 jiao4
cues.en: Picasso once said,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 中国最受冷落的大师，被这个山东80后发掘了 China's Most Neglected Master, Discovered by This Shandong

cues.zh: 我用一辈子的时间去画得像孩子一样
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 yi1 bei4 zi5 de5 shi2 jian1 qu4 hua4 de2 xiang4 hai2 zi5 yi1 yang4
cues.en: 'I spent my whole life learning to paint like a child.'

cues.zh: 关良是广州番禺人
cues.pinyin: guan1 liang2 shi4 guang3 zhou1 pan1 yu2 ren2
cues.en: Guan Liang was from Panyu, Guangzhou.

cues.zh: 11 岁他在英国圣公会中学学习
cues.pinyin: 11 sui4 ta1 zai4 ying1 guo2 sheng4 gong1 hui4 zhong1 xue2 xue2 xi2
cues.en: At 11 he studied at an Anglican Church middle school.

cues.zh: 19 23 年从日本留学归来
cues.pinyin: 19 23 nian2 cong2 ri4 ben3 liu2 xue2 gui1 lai2
cues.en: In 1923 he returned from studying in Japan,

cues.zh: 在上海美术专科学校任教
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 hai3 mei3 shu4 zhuan1 ke1 xue2 xiao4 ren4 jiao4
cues.en: and taught at the Shanghai Academy of Fine Arts.

cues.zh: 他开始创作戏剧人物就始于这个时期
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 shi3 chuang4 zuo4 xi4 ju4 ren2 wu4 jiu4 shi3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 shi2 qi1
cues.en: His creation of opera-themed figure paintings began in this period.

cues.zh: 小的时候母亲是禁止他看戏的
cues.pinyin: xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 mu3 qin1 shi4 jin4 zhi3 ta1 kan4 xi4 de5
cues.en: As a child, his mother forbade him from watching opera,

cues.zh: 但看戏是他一生中戒不掉的嗜好
cues.pinyin: dan4 kan4 xi4 shi4 ta1 yi1 sheng1 zhong1 jie4 bu4 diao4 de5 shi4 hao4
cues.en: but watching opera was a habit he could never give up his whole life.

cues.zh: 关良不仅看戏
cues.pinyin: guan1 liang2 bu4 jin3 kan4 xi4
cues.en: Guan Liang didn't just watch opera —

cues.zh: 自己还会吊嗓子
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 hai2 hui4 diao4 sang3 zi5
cues.en: he also practiced vocal techniques himself,

cues.zh: 熟悉各种唱腔
cues.pinyin: shu2 xi1 ge4 zhong3 chang4 qiang1
cues.en: and was familiar with all kinds of opera singing styles.

cues.zh: 一直到晚年都乐此不疲
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 dao4 wan3 nian2 dou1 le4 ci3 bu4 pi2
cues.en: He kept enjoying this right into his old age.

cues.zh: 因此在京剧中
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 zai4 jing1 ju4 zhong1
cues.en: So, in Peking opera,

cues.zh: 不同行当的表演技巧
cues.pinyin: bu4 tong2 hang2 dang1 de5 biao3 yan3 ji4 qiao3
cues.en: the performance techniques of different role types,

cues.zh: 人物的个性心理
cues.pinyin: ren2 wu4 de5 ge4 xing4 xin1 li3
cues.en: and characters' personalities and psychology —

cues.zh: 他拿捏得十分到位
cues.pinyin: ta1 na2 nie1 de2 shi2 fen1 dao4 wei4
cues.en: he captured them very precisely.

cues.zh: 潘金莲王熙凤孙悟空
cues.pinyin: pan1 jin1 lian2 wang2 xi1 feng4 sun1 wu4 kong1
cues.en: Pan Jinlian, Wang Xifeng, Sun Wukong,

cues.zh: 李逵张飞等人物
cues.pinyin: li3 kui2 zhang1 fei1 deng3 ren2 wu4
cues.en: Li Kui, Zhang Fei, and other characters

cues.zh: 在他的笔下也是栩栩如生
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 de5 bi3 xia4 ye3 shi4 xu3 xu3 ru2 sheng1
cues.en: all came to life vividly under his brush.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 中国最受冷落的大师，被这个山东80后发掘了 China's Most Neglected Master, Discovered by This Shandong

cues.zh: 这个是孙悟空系列的一个题材
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 sun1 wu4 kong1 xi4 lie4 de5 yi2 ge4 ti2 cai2
cues.en: This is one subject from the Sun Wukong series.

cues.zh: 这个题材它画得比较少
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ti2 cai2 ta1 hua4 de2 bi3 jiao4 shao3
cues.en: He painted this subject relatively rarely.

cues.zh: 这张算是
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhang1 suan4 shi4
cues.en: This piece is

cues.zh: 这个题材里边非常精彩的一张
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ti2 cai2 li3 bian1 fei1 chang2 jing1 cai3 de5 yi1 zhang1
cues.en: one of the most outstanding works on this subject.

cues.zh: 传统绘画里边的笔墨
cues.pinyin: chuan2 tong3 hui4 hua4 li3 bian1 de5 bi3 mo4
cues.en: The brush-and-ink technique from traditional painting,

cues.zh: 虚实构成
cues.pinyin: xu1 shi2 gou4 cheng2
cues.en: and the composition of empty and solid space,

cues.zh: 表现得淋漓尽致
cues.pinyin: biao3 xian4 de2 lin2 li2 jin4 zhi4
cues.en: are expressed to the fullest here.

cues.zh: 对颜色的用意用也特别好
cues.pinyin: dui4 yan2 se4 de5 yong4 yi4 yong4 ye3 te4 bie2 hao3
cues.en: The intent and use of color are also especially good.

cues.zh: 这一张实际上就完全可以
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 zhang1 shi2 ji4 shang4 jiu4 wan2 quan2 ke3 yi3
cues.en: This piece, in fact, can fully

cues.zh: 把官僚的水平看得比较透彻
cues.pinyin: ba3 guan1 liao2 de5 shui3 ping2 kan4 de2 bi3 jiao4 tou4 che4
cues.en: reveal Guan Liang's level of skill quite clearly.

cues.zh: 这张很特殊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhang1 hen3 te4 shu1
cues.en: This piece is very special.

cues.zh: 在香港外面也是
cues.pinyin: zai4 xiang1 gang3 wai4 mian4 ye3 shi4
cues.en: It was also acquired outside Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 那个时候面貌和后来 70 年代
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 mian4 mao4 he2 hou4 lai2 70 nian2 dai4
cues.en: The style at that time, compared to the 1970s later,

cues.zh: 就完全不一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wan2 quan2 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: was completely different.

cues.zh: 画的笔墨比较温厚
cues.pinyin: hua4 de5 bi3 mo4 bi3 jiao4 wen1 hou4
cues.en: The brushwork is more gentle and warm,

cues.zh: 色彩比较清雅
cues.pinyin: se4 cai3 bi3 jiao4 qing1 ya3
cues.en: and the colors are more elegant and subdued.

cues.zh: 两个人物的交谈
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 wu4 de5 jiao1 tan2
cues.en: The conversation between the two figures —

cues.zh: 手有动作眼神有动作
cues.pinyin: shou3 you3 dong4 zuo4 yan3 shen2 you3 dong4 zuo4
cues.en: their hands have gestures, their eyes have expression.

cues.zh: 阿清嫂的神情
cues.pinyin: a1 qing1 sao3 de5 shen2 qing2
cues.en: Sister Aqing's expression

cues.zh: 和他俩的神情就不一样
cues.pinyin: he2 ta1 lia3 de5 shen2 qing2 jiu4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: is different from the other two's expressions.

cues.zh: 外面平花系列
cues.pinyin: wai4 mian4 ping2 hua1 xi4 lie4
cues.en: The 'Outdoor Flowers' series.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 日本帅哥改造上海老公寓：愿意把花销用到房子上面International Couple Transforms Old Apartment in Shanghai

cues.zh: 哈喽欢迎来我家
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 huan1 ying2 lai2 wo3 jia1
cues.en: Hi, welcome to my home.

cues.zh: 我叫尼诺天 20 10 年从日本来中国生活
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiao4 ni2 nuo4 tian1 20 10 nian2 cong2 ri4 ben3 lai2 zhong1 guo2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: My name is Nino. I came to China from Japan in 2010 to live here.

cues.zh: 这个公寓是老的公寓
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gong1 yu4 shi4 lao3 de5 gong1 yu4
cues.en: This apartment is an old one.

cues.zh: 四周湖旁边面积 100 平左右
cues.pinyin: si4 zhou1 hu2 pang2 bian1 mian4 ji1 100 ping2 zuo3 you4
cues.en: It's right next to Suzhou Creek, about 100 square meters.

cues.zh: 是西班牙的建筑师设计的
cues.pinyin: shi4 xi1 ban1 ya2 de5 jian4 zhu4 shi1 she4 ji4 de5
cues.en: It was designed by a Spanish architect.

cues.zh: 直接露出来的水泥的柱子
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 lu4 chu1 lai2 de5 shui3 ni2 de5 zhu4 zi5
cues.en: The exposed concrete pillars.

cues.zh: 还有一点点工业风
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi4 dian3 dian3 gong1 ye4 feng1
cues.en: There's also a bit of an industrial feel.

cues.zh: 但是保留了历史的原来的样子
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bao3 liu2 le5 li4 shi3 de5 yuan2 lai2 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: But it kept its original historical look.

cues.zh: 在疫情之前的话我们每个月都出国玩
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi4 qing2 zhi1 qian2 de5 hua4 wo3 men5 mei3 ge4 yue4 dou1 chu1 guo2 wan2
cues.en: Before the pandemic, we traveled abroad every month.

cues.zh: 现在不能去旅游
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bu4 neng2 qu4 lv3 you2
cues.en: Now we can't travel.

cues.zh: 所以在这边稍微贵一点
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 zhe4 bian1 shao1 wei1 gui4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: So we spend a little more on this place instead.

cues.zh: 我们就可以调整花钱的比例
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 tiao2 zheng3 hua1 qian2 de5 bi3 li4
cues.en: We can adjust the ratio of how we spend our money.

cues.zh: 花费的差不多 50 左右
cues.pinyin: hua1 fei4 de5 cha4 bu5 duo1 50 zuo3 you4
cues.en: The spending ratio is about 50/50.

cues.zh: 挺有压力的
cues.pinyin: ting3 you3 ya1 li4 de5
cues.en: It's quite stressful.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 日本帅哥改造上海老公寓：愿意把花销用到房子上面International Couple Transforms Old Apartment in Shanghai

cues.zh: 我来上海之前在北京的广州已
cues.pinyin: wo3 lai2 shang4 hai3 zhi1 qian2 zai4 bei3 jing1 de5 guang3 zhou1 yi3
cues.en: Before coming to Shanghai, I lived in Beijing and Guangzhou.

cues.zh: 经待过 10 年了
cues.pinyin: jing1 dai4 guo4 10 nian2 le5
cues.en: I had already been there for 10 years.

cues.zh: 我一直以来租房子
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi4 zhi2 yi3 lai2 zu1 fang2 zi5
cues.en: I've always rented.

cues.zh: 然后这个房子是目前来说最喜欢的一个
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 shi4 mu4 qian2 lai2 shuo1 zui4 xi3 huan1 de5 yi2 ge4
cues.en: And this apartment is my favorite one so far.

cues.zh: 那个榻榻米的屋子真的是挺亲切的
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 ta4 ta4 mi3 de5 wu1 zi5 zhen1 de5 shi4 ting3 qin1 qie4 de5
cues.en: That tatami room really feels cozy.

cues.zh: 天气好的时候那边躺一下看个书
cues.pinyin: tian1 qi4 hao3 de5 shi2 hou4 na4 bian1 tang3 yi1 xia4 kan4 ge4 shu1
cues.en: When the weather's nice, I lie down there and read a book.

cues.zh: 喝个咖啡小妈咪游玩
cues.pinyin: he1 ge4 ka1 fei1 xiao3 ma1 mi1 you2 wan2
cues.en: Have some coffee, play with the cat a bit.

cues.zh: 家具都是我们搬进来的东西
cues.pinyin: jia1 ju4 dou1 shi4 wo3 men5 ban1 jin4 lai2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: All the furniture is stuff we brought in ourselves.

cues.zh: 我最喜欢的是这个
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 xi3 huan1 de5 shi4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: My favorite thing is this.

cues.zh: 我现在做的有件像椅
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian4 zai4 zuo4 de5 you3 jian4 xiang4 yi3
cues.en: What I have now is a set of chairs.

cues.zh: 金属的面表面每一件椅子都不一样的
cues.pinyin: jin1 shu3 de5 mian4 biao3 mian4 mei3 yi1 jian4 yi3 zi5 dou1 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: The metal surface - every chair is different.

cues.zh: 又优雅又干净
cues.pinyin: you4 you1 ya3 you4 gan1 jing4
cues.en: It's elegant and clean.

cues.zh: 但是也有很力量的那种感觉
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 you3 hen3 li4 liang4 de5 na4 zhong3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: But it also has a sense of strength to it.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 日本帅哥改造上海老公寓：愿意把花销用到房子上面International Couple Transforms Old Apartment in Shanghai

cues.zh: 潘顿的 Heart Cone Chair 是我女朋友特别喜欢的
cues.pinyin: pan1 dun4 de5 Heart Cone Chair shi4 wo3 nv3 peng2 you3 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 de5
cues.en: My girlfriend especially loves Panton's Heart Cone Chair.

cues.zh: 所以买的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mai3 de5
cues.en: So we bought it.

cues.zh: 我主要做的是平面设计
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhu3 yao4 zuo4 de5 shi4 ping2 mian4 she4 ji4
cues.en: What I mainly do is graphic design.

cues.zh: 在家里工作的情况比较多
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 li3 gong1 zuo4 de5 qing2 kuang4 bi3 jiao4 duo1
cues.en: I work from home a lot.

cues.zh: 在家的时间听唱片是最多的
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 de5 shi2 jian1 ting1 chang4 pian4 shi4 zui4 duo1 de5
cues.en: At home, I spend most of my time listening to records.

cues.zh: 然后弹吉他
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 dan4 ji2 ta1
cues.en: And playing guitar.

cues.zh: 做饭也差不多天天做
cues.pinyin: zuo4 fan4 ye3 cha4 bu5 duo1 tian1 tian1 zuo4
cues.en: I cook almost every day too.

cues.zh: 日本菜比较多
cues.pinyin: ri4 ben3 cai4 bi3 jiao4 duo1
cues.en: Mostly Japanese food.

cues.zh: 还会做西餐
cues.pinyin: hai2 hui4 zuo4 xi1 can1
cues.en: I also make Western food.

cues.zh: 然后调酒喝
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 diao4 jiu3 he1
cues.en: And mix drinks.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 日本帅哥改造上海老公寓：愿意把花销用到房子上面International Couple Transforms Old Apartment in Shanghai

cues.zh: 周末的时候在谷北的澳咖啡会放放歌的
cues.pinyin: zhou1 mo4 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 gu3 bei3 de5 ao4 ka1 fei1 hui4 fang4 fang4 ge1 de5
cues.en: On weekends I DJ a bit at a café on Julu Road.

cues.zh: 现在打开窗户的话
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 da3 kai1 chuang1 hu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Now if I open the window,

cues.zh: 闻到的那种秋天的味道是跟我家那
cues.pinyin: wen2 dao4 de5 na4 zhong3 qiu1 tian1 de5 wei4 dao4 shi4 gen1 wo3 jia1 na4
cues.en: the smell of autumn I catch is just like the smell back home,

cues.zh: 边的味道很像
cues.pinyin: bian1 de5 wei4 dao4 hen3 xiang4
cues.en: it's really similar.

cues.zh: 家是最放松的地方
cues.pinyin: jia1 shi4 zui4 fang4 song1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: Home is the most relaxing place.

cues.zh: 给我一个挖掘自己的力量
cues.pinyin: gei3 wo3 yi2 ge4 wa1 jue2 zi4 ji3 de5 li4 liang4
cues.en: It gives me the strength to discover myself.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 女孩在森林里发现一个神秘洞穴
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 zai4 sen1 lin2 li3 fa1 xian4 yi2 ge4 shen2 mi4 dong4 xue2
cues.en: The girl discovers a mysterious cave in the forest.

cues.zh: 她缓缓靠近突然
cues.pinyin: ta1 huan3 huan3 kao4 jin4 tu1 ran2
cues.en: She slowly approaches it, and suddenly—

cues.zh: 女孩没有退缩她试图用长树枝制住小怪物
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 mei2 you3 tui4 suo1 ta1 shi4 tu2 yong4 zhang3 shu4 zhi1 zhi4 zhu4 xiao3 guai4 wu4
cues.en: The girl doesn't back down; she tries to pin down the little monster with a long branch.

cues.zh: 不料小怪物十分积极
cues.pinyin: bu4 liao4 xiao3 guai4 wu4 shi2 fen1 ji1 ji2
cues.en: Unexpectedly, the little monster puts up quite a fight.

cues.zh: 从树枝下挣脱
cues.pinyin: cong2 shu4 zhi1 xia4 zheng4 tuo1
cues.en: It breaks free from under the branch.

cues.zh: 拖着一条腿拼命向前爬
cues.pinyin: tuo1 zhe5 yi1 tiao2 tui3 pin1 ming4 xiang4 qian2 pa2
cues.en: Dragging one leg, it crawls forward desperately.

cues.zh: 腿上已经鲜血淋漓了爬了一段
cues.pinyin: tui3 shang4 yi3 jing1 xian1 xue4 lin2 li2 le5 pa2 le5 yi1 duan4
cues.en: Its leg is already covered in blood; it crawls on for a while.

cues.zh: 小怪物发现女孩没有追过来她回头
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 wu4 fa1 xian4 nv3 hai2 mei2 you3 zhui1 guo4 lai2 ta1 hui2 tou2
cues.en: The little monster notices the girl isn't chasing it and turns its head back.

cues.zh: 一双眼睛冲着女孩眨眨显得可爱又可怜
cues.pinyin: yi1 shuang1 yan3 jing1 chong1 zhe5 nv3 hai2 zha3 zha3 xian3 de5 ke3 ai4 you4 ke3 lian2
cues.en: Its eyes blink at her, looking cute yet pitiful.

cues.zh: 女孩把小怪物放进背包里
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 ba3 xiao3 guai4 wu4 fang4 jin4 bei1 bao1 li3
cues.en: The girl puts the little monster into her backpack.

cues.zh: 悄悄带回了家为了不让父亲发现
cues.pinyin: qiao1 qiao1 dai4 hui2 le5 jia1 wei4 le5 bu4 rang4 fu4 qin1 fa1 xian4
cues.en: She quietly brings it home, careful not to let her father find out.

cues.zh: 女孩没敢从正门进屋
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 mei2 gan3 cong2 zheng4 men2 jin4 wu1
cues.en: The girl doesn't dare go in through the front door.

cues.zh: 而是爬墙回到自己的房间
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 pa2 qiang2 hui2 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 fang2 jian1
cues.en: Instead she climbs the wall back up to her own room.

cues.zh: 她拿出药品和纱布想为小
cues.pinyin: ta1 na2 chu1 yao4 pin3 he2 sha1 bu4 xiang3 wei4 xiao3
cues.en: She takes out medicine and bandages to treat the little—

cues.zh: 小怪物包扎伤口
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 wu4 bao1 za1 shang1 kou3
cues.en: —monster's wound.

cues.zh: 可小怪物胆子小
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 guai4 wu4 dan3 zi5 xiao3
cues.en: But the little monster is timid.

cues.zh: 对陌生人的触碰十分排斥
cues.pinyin: dui4 mo4 sheng1 ren2 de5 chu4 peng4 shi2 fen1 pai2 chi4
cues.en: It strongly resists being touched by a stranger.

cues.zh: 女孩于是灵机一动
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 yu2 shi4 ling2 ji1 yi1 dong4
cues.en: So the girl has a sudden idea.

cues.zh: 拿出万圣节的吸血鬼假牙按在嘴里
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 wan4 sheng4 jie2 de5 xi1 xue4 gui3 jia3 ya2 an4 zai4 zui3 li3
cues.en: She takes out her Halloween vampire fake teeth and puts them in her mouth.

cues.zh: 冲着小怪兽发出威胁的咆哮
cues.pinyin: chong1 zhe5 xiao3 guai4 shou4 fa1 chu1 wei1 xie2 de5 pao2 xiao1
cues.en: and lets out a threatening growl at the little monster.

cues.zh: 一番较量过后
cues.pinyin: yi1 fan1 jiao4 liang4 guo4 hou4
cues.en: After a bit of a standoff,

cues.zh: 小怪兽败下阵来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 shou4 bai4 xia4 zhen4 lai2
cues.en: the little monster loses the fight.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 终于老老实实地伸出爪子让女孩为他包扎
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 lao3 lao3 shi2 shi2 di4 shen1 chu1 zhua3 zi5 rang4 nv3 hai2 wei4 ta1 bao1 za1
cues.en: It finally obediently holds out its claw for her to bandage.

cues.zh: 包好了伤口
cues.pinyin: bao1 hao3 le5 shang1 kou3
cues.en: Once the wound is bandaged,

cues.zh: 小怪兽还是小孩子星星
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 shou4 hai2 shi4 xiao3 hai2 zi5 xing1 xing1
cues.en: the little monster still has a childlike nature,

cues.zh: 开始探索女孩的房间
cues.pinyin: kai1 shi3 tan4 suo3 nv3 hai2 de5 fang2 jian1
cues.en: and starts exploring the girl's room.

cues.zh: 发现一个雨林缸里有一只蓝色毛毛虫
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 yi2 ge4 yu3 lin2 gang1 li3 you3 yi1 zhi1 lan2 se4 mao2 mao2 chong2
cues.en: It finds a blue caterpillar in a rainforest tank.

cues.zh: 眼看就要爬出来了
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 jiu4 yao4 pa2 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: It's just about to crawl out.

cues.zh: 小怪兽扑向毛毛虫
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 shou4 pu1 xiang4 mao2 mao2 chong2
cues.en: The little monster pounces at the caterpillar,

cues.zh: 却被女孩立声制止
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 nv3 hai2 li4 sheng1 zhi4 zhi3
cues.en: but the girl sharply stops it.

cues.zh: 这可是女孩最真爱的一色毛毛虫
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 shi4 nv3 hai2 zui4 zhen1 ai4 de5 yi1 se4 mao2 mao2 chong2
