cues.en: This is the girl's most beloved caterpillar,

cues.zh: 花了好久时间才搞到的
cues.pinyin: hua1 le5 hao3 jiu3 shi2 jian1 cai2 gao3 dao4 de5
cues.en: which took her ages to get.

cues.zh: 小怪兽仿佛听得懂女孩的话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 shou4 fang3 fu2 ting1 de5 dong3 nv3 hai2 de5 hua4
cues.en: The little monster seems to understand her words,

cues.zh: 真的停下了动作
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 ting2 xia4 le5 dong4 zuo4
cues.en: and really does stop moving.

cues.zh: 女孩随后把毛毛虫放到小怪物手上
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 sui2 hou4 ba3 mao2 mao2 chong2 fang4 dao4 xiao3 guai4 wu4 shou3 shang4
cues.en: The girl then places the caterpillar in the little monster's hand.

cues.zh: 小怪物又乖乖地把虫子放回了雨林缸里
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guai4 wu4 you4 guai1 guai1 di4 ba3 chong2 zi5 fang4 hui2 le5 yu3 lin2 gang1 li3
cues.en: The little monster obediently puts the bug back into the tank.

cues.zh: 女孩十分诧异
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 shi2 fen1 cha4 yi4
cues.en: The girl is quite surprised.

cues.zh: 这小女孩名叫尤里
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiao3 nv3 hai2 ming2 jiao4 you2 li3
cues.en: This little girl is named Yuli.

cues.zh: 眼前这个小怪物她认识
cues.pinyin: yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 guai4 wu4 ta1 ren4 shi2
cues.en: She recognizes the little monster in front of her.

cues.zh: 大人们都称其为傲奇
cues.pinyin: da4 ren2 men5 dou1 cheng1 qi2 wei4 ao4 qi2
cues.en: Adults all call it an Orgi.

cues.zh: 据说是十分凶猛的怪兽
cues.pinyin: ju4 shuo1 shi4 shi2 fen1 xiong1 meng3 de5 guai4 shou4
cues.en: It's said to be an extremely fierce monster,

cues.zh: 凶残暴虐
cues.pinyin: xiong1 can2 bao4 nve4
cues.en: cruel and vicious,

cues.zh: 杀人无数
cues.pinyin: sha1 ren2 wu2 shu4
cues.en: having killed countless people.

cues.zh: 他们总是成群结队地在森林里活动
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zong3 shi4 cheng2 qun2 jie2 dui4 di4 zai4 sen1 lin2 li3 huo2 dong4
cues.en: They always move through the forest in packs.

cues.zh: 所以在尤里所住的小山村里
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 you2 li3 suo3 zhu4 de5 xiao3 shan1 cun1 li3
cues.en: So in the small mountain village where Yuli lives,

cues.zh: 每个孩子都严格遵守着一个规定
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 hai2 zi5 dou1 yan2 ge2 zun1 shou3 zhe5 yi2 ge4 gui1 ding4
cues.en: every child strictly follows one rule:

cues.zh: 天黑之后绝对不外出
cues.pinyin: tian1 hei1 zhi1 hou4 jue2 dui4 bu4 wai4 chu1
cues.en: never go outside after dark.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 抬头发现一只毛茸茸的小奥琪
cues.pinyin: tai2 tou2 fa1 xian4 yi1 zhi1 mao2 rong2 rong2 de5 xiao3 ao4 qi2
cues.en: Looking up, she spots a furry little Orgi,

cues.zh: 正无助地挂在树上惊恐地大叫
cues.pinyin: zheng4 wu2 zhu4 di4 gua4 zai4 shu4 shang4 jing1 kong3 di4 da4 jiao4
cues.en: helplessly hanging from a tree, screaming in terror.

cues.zh: 奥琪妈妈很想过去
cues.pinyin: ao4 qi2 ma1 ma1 hen3 xiang3 guo4 qu4
cues.en: Its mother desperately wants to go to it,

cues.zh: 可孩子们正在往树上开枪
cues.pinyin: ke3 hai2 zi5 men5 zheng4 zai4 wang3 shu4 shang4 kai1 qiang1
cues.en: but the villagers are shooting up at the tree,

cues.zh: 她根本过不去
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 ben3 guo4 bu4 qu4
cues.en: so she simply can't get through.

cues.zh: 远处其他傲奇大叫着
cues.pinyin: yuan3 chu4 qi2 ta1 ao4 qi2 da4 jiao4 zhe5
cues.en: In the distance, the other Orgis are crying out,

cues.zh: 妈妈终究还是跟着族群一起离开了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zhong1 jiu1 hai2 shi4 gen1 zhe5 zu2 qun2 yi4 qi3 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: and in the end the mother leaves with the group,

cues.zh: 只留下小傲奇孤零零地挂在树上
cues.pinyin: zhi3 liu2 xia4 xiao3 ao4 qi2 gu1 ling2 ling2 di4 gua4 zai4 shu4 shang4
cues.en: leaving the little Orgi hanging there alone.

cues.zh: 第二天尤里心里一直想着昨天那只小傲奇
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 you2 li3 xin1 li3 yi4 zhi2 xiang3 zhe5 zuo2 tian1 na4 zhi3 xiao3 ao4 qi2
cues.en: The next day, Yuli can't stop thinking about yesterday's little Orgi.

cues.zh: 被妈妈抛下的孩子一定很可怜
cues.pinyin: bei4 ma1 ma1 pao1 xia4 de5 hai2 zi5 yi2 ding4 hen3 ke3 lian2
cues.en: A child abandoned by its mother must feel so wretched.

cues.zh: 因为她自己就是生活在单亲家庭中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zi4 ji3 jiu4 shi4 sheng1 huo2 zai4 dan1 qing4 jia5 ting2 zhong1
cues.en: Because she herself lives in a single-parent family.

cues.zh: 看到别人家妈妈温柔牵着孩子的手
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 bie2 ren2 jia1 ma1 ma1 wen1 rou2 qian1 zhe5 hai2 zi5 de5 shou3
cues.en: Seeing other mothers gently holding their children's hands,

cues.zh: 尤里总觉得心里难受
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 zong3 jue2 de5 xin1 li3 nan2 shou4
cues.en: Yuli always feels a pang of sadness.

cues.zh: 可每次当她提出想去看妈妈
cues.pinyin: ke3 mei3 ci4 dang1 ta1 ti2 chu1 xiang3 qu4 kan4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: But every time she brings up wanting to see her mother,

cues.zh: 总会遭到爸爸的斥责
cues.pinyin: zong3 hui4 zao1 dao4 ba4 ba4 de5 chi4 ze2
cues.en: she's always scolded by her father.

cues.zh: 尤里心里很难受
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 xin1 li3 hen3 nan2 shou4
cues.en: Yuli feels very hurt inside.

cues.zh: 她觉得被妈妈抛弃的小傲奇心
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 bei4 ma1 ma1 pao1 qi4 de5 xiao3 ao4 qi2 xin1
cues.en: She thinks the little Orgi, abandoned by its mother,

cues.zh: 里会一样难受
cues.pinyin: li3 hui4 yi1 yang4 nan2 shou4
cues.en: must feel just as much pain.

cues.zh: 于是饭后他背上大书包进入森林深处
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 fan4 hou4 ta1 bei4 shang4 da4 shu1 bao1 jin4 ru4 sen1 lin2 shen1 chu4
cues.en: So after dinner she straps on a big backpack and heads deep into the forest,

cues.zh: 来到昨天他们战斗过的地方
cues.pinyin: lai2 dao4 zuo2 tian1 ta1 men5 zhan4 dou4 guo4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: arriving at the place where they fought yesterday.

cues.zh: 小奥奇已经没了踪影
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 qi2 yi3 jing1 mei2 le5 zong1 ying3
cues.en: The little Orgi is nowhere to be seen.

cues.zh: 地上陷阱被动过
cues.pinyin: di4 shang4 xian4 jing3 bei4 dong4 guo4
cues.en: The trap on the ground has been disturbed,

cues.zh: 上面还沾着血
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 hai2 zhan1 zhe5 xue4
cues.en: with blood still on it.

cues.zh: 尤里在往深处走
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 zai4 wang3 shen1 chu4 zou3
cues.en: Yuli keeps walking deeper in,

cues.zh: 终于在一个小洞里发现了小奥奇
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zai4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 dong4 li3 fa1 xian4 le5 xiao3 ao4 qi2
cues.en: and finally finds the little Orgi in a small hole.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 说吧尤里翻窗而出
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ba5 you2 li3 fan1 chuang1 er2 chu1
cues.en: With that, Yuli climbs out through the window.

cues.zh: 哥哥什么都没说
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 shuo1
cues.en: Her brother says nothing,

cues.zh: 没阻拦尤里
cues.pinyin: mei2 zu3 lan2 you2 li3
cues.en: doesn't stop her,

cues.zh: 也没去告诉爸爸
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 qu4 gao4 su4 ba4 ba4
cues.en: and doesn't tell their father either.

cues.zh: 第二天一早
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 zao3
cues.en: Early the next morning,

cues.zh: 爸爸吃早饭的时候
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 chi1 zao3 fan4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: while their father is eating breakfast,

cues.zh: 发现尤里没有下楼
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 you2 li3 mei2 you3 xia4 lou2
cues.en: he notices Yuli hasn't come down.

cues.zh: 于是来到尤里的房间叫女儿下来吃饭
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 lai2 dao4 you2 li3 de5 fang2 jian1 jiao4 nv3 er2 xia4 lai2 chi1 fan4
cues.en: So he goes to her room to call his daughter down to eat.

cues.zh: 结果他打开门就发现屋里空无一人
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ta1 da3 kai1 men2 jiu4 fa1 xian4 wu1 li3 kong1 wu2 yi4 ren2
cues.en: He opens the door only to find the room completely empty.

cues.zh: 在地上有一滩尚未干涸的血
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 shang4 you3 yi1 tan1 shang4 wei4 gan1 he2 de5 xue4
cues.en: There's a pool of blood on the floor that hasn't dried yet,

cues.zh: 还有不少黄毛
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 bu4 shao3 huang2 mao2
cues.en: along with quite a bit of yellow fur.

cues.zh: 一看这黄毛爸爸就知道了
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 zhe4 huang2 mao2 ba4 ba4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: The moment he sees the yellow fur, the father knows—

cues.zh: 这就是奥奇的毛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ao4 qi2 de5 mao2
cues.en: it's Orgi's fur.

cues.zh: 难道尤里被奥奇抓走了
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 you2 li3 bei4 ao4 qi2 zhua1 zou3 le5
cues.en: Could Yuli have been taken by Orgi?

cues.zh: 奥奇是在报复吗
cues.pinyin: ao4 qi2 shi4 zai4 bao4 fu4 ma5
cues.en: Is Orgi taking revenge?

cues.zh: 村子里的人立即紧张起来
cues.pinyin: cun1 zi5 li3 de5 ren2 li4 ji2 jin3 zhang1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: The villagers immediately grow tense.

cues.zh: 在尤里爸的带领下
cues.pinyin: zai4 you2 li3 ba4 de5 dai4 ling3 xia4
cues.en: Led by Yuli's father,

cues.zh: 他们拿着武器和诱饵就上了车
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 na2 zhe5 wu3 qi4 he2 you4 er3 jiu4 shang4 le5 che1
cues.en: they grab weapons and bait and pile into the car,

cues.zh: 进森林去围猎奥奇
cues.pinyin: jin4 sen1 lin2 qu4 wei2 lie4 ao4 qi2
cues.en: heading into the forest to hunt down Orgi.

cues.zh: 谁也想不到
cues.pinyin: shui2 ye3 xiang3 bu2 dao4
cues.en: No one could have guessed,

cues.zh: 尤里带着小奥奇离开家后
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 ao4 qi2 li2 kai1 jia1 hou4
cues.en: that after Yuli left home with the little Orgi,

cues.zh: 并没有第一时间去森林里
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 di4 yi1 shi2 jian1 qu4 sen1 lin2 li3
cues.en: she didn't head to the forest right away.

cues.zh: 而是来到了超市
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 lai2 dao4 le5 chao1 shi4
cues.en: Instead she went to the supermarket,

cues.zh: 这里是爸爸从来不让他踏足的地方
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 shi4 ba4 ba4 cong2 lai2 bu4 rang4 ta1 ta4 zu2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: a place her father had never let her set foot in.

cues.zh: 有这么多好吃的
cues.pinyin: you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 hao3 chi1 de5
cues.en: With so many delicious things around,

cues.zh: 他一定要吃个痛快
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ding4 yao4 chi1 ge4 tong4 kuai4
cues.en: she was determined to eat to her heart's content.

cues.zh: 小奥奇也没来过超市
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 qi2 ye3 mei2 lai2 guo4 chao1 shi4
cues.en: The little Orgi had never been to a supermarket either.

cues.zh: 他好奇地探出头
cues.pinyin: ta1 hao4 qi2 di4 tan4 chu1 tou2
cues.en: It curiously pokes its head out,

cues.zh: 伸手抓了一个鸡蛋
cues.pinyin: shen1 shou3 zhua1 le5 yi2 ge4 ji1 dan4
cues.en: and reaches out to grab an egg.

cues.zh: 这下小奥奇藏不住了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 xiao3 ao4 qi2 cang2 bu2 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Now the little Orgi can't stay hidden any longer.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 店员拿起猎枪走向小奥奇
cues.pinyin: dian4 yuan2 na2 qi3 lie4 qiang1 zou3 xiang4 xiao3 ao4 qi2
cues.en: A store clerk picks up a hunting rifle and walks toward it.

cues.zh: 尤里吓坏了
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 xia4 huai4 le5
cues.en: Yuli is terrified,

cues.zh: 赶紧躲进冷柜
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 duo3 jin4 leng3 gui4
cues.en: and quickly hides in a freezer.

cues.zh: 狠狠捂住小奥奇的嘴让他别叫了
cues.pinyin: hen3 hen3 wu3 zhu4 xiao3 ao4 qi2 de5 zui3 rang4 ta1 bie2 jiao4 le5
cues.en: She clamps her hand tightly over the little Orgi's mouth to keep it from crying out.

cues.zh: 可小奥奇不屈服
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 ao4 qi2 bu4 qu1 fu2
cues.en: But the little Orgi won't give in,

cues.zh: 一口咬在尤里手上
cues.pinyin: yi1 kou3 yao3 zai4 you2 li3 shou3 shang4
cues.en: and bites down hard on Yuli's hand.

cues.zh: 这下好了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 hao3 le5
cues.en: Great, now—

cues.zh: 换成尤里尖叫了
cues.pinyin: huan4 cheng2 you2 li3 jian1 jiao4 le5
cues.en: it's Yuli's turn to scream.

cues.zh: 他最后带着小奥奇连滚带爬的逃出冷柜
cues.pinyin: ta1 zui4 hou4 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 ao4 qi2 lian2 gun3 dai4 pa2 de5 tao2 chu1 leng3 gui4
cues.en: In the end she scrambles out of the freezer, dragging the little Orgi with her,

cues.zh: 然后随便抢了一辆车开着就走
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 sui2 bian4 qiang3 le5 yi1 liang4 che1 kai1 zhe5 jiu4 zou3
cues.en: then just grabs some car and drives off.

cues.zh: 可是这辆车子很快就没有汽油了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 liang4 che1 zi5 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 mei2 you3 qi4 you2 le5
cues.en: But the car soon runs out of gas,

cues.zh: 而偏偏这时尤里手上伤口开始红肿发自
cues.pinyin: er2 pian1 pian1 zhe4 shi2 you2 li3 shou3 shang4 shang1 kou3 kai1 shi3 hong2 zhong3 fa1 zi4
cues.en: and right at that moment the wound on Yuli's hand starts swelling and turning purple.

cues.zh: 明显是中毒了
cues.pinyin: ming2 xian3 shi4 zhong4 du2 le5
cues.en: She's clearly been poisoned.

cues.zh: 小傲奇愧疚地看着尤里
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 qi2 kui4 jiu4 di4 kan4 zhe5 you2 li3
cues.en: The little Orgi looks at her guiltily,

cues.zh: 但尤里并不怪他
cues.pinyin: dan4 you2 li3 bing4 bu4 guai4 ta1
cues.en: but Yuli doesn't blame it.

cues.zh: 尤里的车子用尽汽油撞在路边无法动弹
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 de5 che1 zi5 yong4 jin3 qi4 you2 zhuang4 zai4 lu4 bian1 wu2 fa3 dong4 tan2
cues.en: Yuli's car runs dry and crashes at the roadside, unable to move,

cues.zh: 他不得不带着小傲奇步行进入森林
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 de2 bu4 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 ao4 qi2 bu4 xing2 jin4 ru4 sen1 lin2
cues.en: so she has no choice but to continue on foot into the forest with the little Orgi.

cues.zh: 尤里找了一处脏水洼
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 zhao3 le5 yi1 chu4 zang4 shui3 wa1
cues.en: Yuli finds a filthy puddle,

cues.zh: 将胳膊伸到水里
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ge1 bo2 shen1 dao4 shui3 li3
cues.en: and sticks her arm into the water,

cues.zh: 让水质趴在胳膊上损兴浓血
cues.pinyin: rang4 shui3 zhi4 pa1 zai4 ge1 bo2 shang4 sun3 xing1 nong2 xue4
cues.en: letting a leech attach to her arm to draw out the infected blood.

cues.zh: 他希望用这种古老的方法治疗伤口
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 gu3 lao3 de5 fang1 fa3 zhi4 liao2 shang1 kou3
cues.en: She hopes this old remedy will heal the wound,

cues.zh: 可显然不管用
cues.pinyin: ke3 xian3 ran2 bu4 guan3 yong4
cues.en: but it clearly doesn't work.

cues.zh: 结果小奥琪抓了一只甲虫递给尤里
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xiao3 ao4 qi2 zhua1 le5 yi1 zhi1 jia3 chong2 di4 gei3 you2 li3
cues.en: The little Orgi then catches a beetle and hands it to her,

cues.zh: 好像要给他吃
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiang4 yao4 gei3 ta1 chi1
cues.en: as if offering it for her to eat.

cues.zh: 尤里十分厌恶
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 shi2 fen1 yan4 wu4
cues.en: Yuli is thoroughly disgusted.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025美国最新奇幻电影！少女把食人魔当宠物，人类的无耻简直让人惊叹

cues.zh: 尤里乐极生悲
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 le4 ji2 sheng1 bei1
cues.en: Yuli's joy turns to disaster —

cues.zh: 脚下一滑
cues.pinyin: jiao3 xia4 yi1 hua2
cues.en: her foot slips,

cues.zh: 掉进了猎人设置的陷阱里
cues.pinyin: diao4 jin4 le5 lie4 ren2 she4 zhi4 de5 xian4 jing3 li3
cues.en: and she falls into a trap set by hunters.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 尤里爸带着搜索队沿路搜寻的时候
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 ba4 dai4 zhe5 sou1 suo3 dui4 yan2 lu4 sou1 xun2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: as Yuli's father leads the search team along the trail,

cues.zh: 正好看到了被尤里遗弃的车子就扔在一边
cues.pinyin: zheng4 hao3 kan4 dao4 le5 bei4 you2 li3 yi2 qi4 de5 che1 zi5 jiu4 reng1 zai4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: they spot the car Yuli abandoned, left by the roadside.

cues.zh: 车里搜出尤里最爱的假牙
cues.pinyin: che1 li3 sou1 chu1 you2 li3 zui4 ai4 de5 jia3 ya2
cues.en: They search the car and find Yuli's favorite fake teeth,

cues.zh: 显然这车尤里开过
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 zhe4 che1 you2 li3 kai1 guo4
cues.en: so clearly she had driven it.

cues.zh: 他们在车子附近发现了尤里的脚印
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 che1 zi5 fu4 jin4 fa1 xian4 le5 you2 li3 de5 jiao3 yin4
cues.en: They find her footprints near the car,

cues.zh: 就沿着脚印一路搜索
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yan2 zhe5 jiao3 yin4 yi1 lu4 sou1 suo3
cues.en: and follow them all the way,

cues.zh: 来到一片沼泽边缘
cues.pinyin: lai2 dao4 yi1 pian4 zhao3 ze2 bian1 yuan2
cues.en: arriving at the edge of a swamp.

cues.zh: 天快黑了
cues.pinyin: tian1 kuai4 hei1 le5
cues.en: It's almost dark,

cues.zh: 他们不敢进入沼泽
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bu4 gan3 jin4 ru4 zhao3 ze2
cues.en: and they don't dare go into the swamp.

cues.zh: 而此时尤里正躺在陷阱里昏昏沉沉
cues.pinyin: er2 ci3 shi2 you2 li3 zheng4 tang3 zai4 xian4 jing3 li3 hun1 hun1 chen2 chen2
cues.en: Meanwhile Yuli lies in the trap, drifting in and out of consciousness.

cues.zh: 恍惚间好像看到了一个人打开
cues.pinyin: huang3 hu1 jian1 hao3 xiang4 kan4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ren2 da3 kai1
cues.en: In her hazy state, she seems to see someone open—

cues.zh: 了陷阱的盖子
cues.pinyin: le5 xian4 jing3 de5 gai4 zi5
cues.en: —the lid of the trap,

cues.zh: 然后把自己救了出去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zi4 ji3 jiu4 le5 chu1 qu4
cues.en: and then pull her out.

cues.zh: 那是一个十分苍老的女人
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 yi2 ge4 shi2 fen1 cang1 lao3 de5 nv3 ren2
cues.en: It's a very old woman.

cues.zh: 女人把尤里扛到自己住的小屋
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 ba3 you2 li3 kang2 dao4 zi4 ji3 zhu4 de5 xiao3 wu1
cues.en: The woman carries Yuli to her own cabin,

cues.zh: 将她安置在床上
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ta1 an1 zhi4 zai4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: and lays her down on the bed.

cues.zh: 尤里看着那张熟悉又陌生的脸
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 kan4 zhe5 na4 zhang1 shu2 xi1 you4 mo4 sheng1 de5 lian3
cues.en: Yuli looks at that face, both familiar and strange.

cues.zh: 这女人就是她的母亲
cues.pinyin: zhe4 nv3 ren2 jiu4 shi4 ta1 de5 mu3 qin1
cues.en: This woman is her mother,

cues.zh: 只是许久未见了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 xu3 jiu3 wei4 jian4 le5
cues.en: only it's been so long since they've seen each other

cues.zh: 她一时没认出来
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 shi2 mei2 ren4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: that for a moment she doesn't recognize her.

cues.zh: 尤里妈来到羊圈
cues.pinyin: you2 li3 ma1 lai2 dao4 yang2 juan4
cues.en: Yuli's mother goes to the sheep pen,

cues.zh: 从一头眼睛赤红的羊身上抓到一只蝙蝠
cues.pinyin: cong2 yi1 tou2 yan3 jing1 chi4 hong2 de5 yang2 shen1 shang4 zhua1 dao4 yi1 zhi1 bian1 fu2
cues.en: and catches a bat off a sheep with blood-red eyes,

cues.zh: 拿回去给女儿熬药
cues.pinyin: na2 hui2 qu4 gei3 nv3 er2 ao2 yao4
cues.en: then takes it back to brew medicine for her daughter.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 大半夜的韩国这座果川到底有多乱
cues.pinyin: da4 ban4 ye4 de5 han2 guo2 zhe4 zuo4 guo3 chuan1 dao4 di3 you3 duo1 luan4
cues.en: How chaotic can this city of Gwacheon, Korea get in the dead of night?

cues.zh: 单身女性晚上千万不要一个人出门
cues.pinyin: dan1 shen1 nv3 xing4 wan3 shang4 qian1 wan4 bu2 yao4 yi2 ge4 ren2 chu1 men2
cues.en: Single women should never go out alone at night.

cues.zh: 更不要一个人上公共厕所
cues.pinyin: geng4 bu2 yao4 yi2 ge4 ren2 shang4 gong1 gong4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: Especially never use a public restroom alone.

cues.zh: 眼前这个女人就是去两里地开
cues.pinyin: yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 nv3 ren2 jiu4 shi4 qu4 liang3 li3 di4 kai1
cues.en: The woman we're watching went to a public restroom

cues.zh: 外的公厕方便
cues.pinyin: wai4 de5 gong1 ce4 fang1 bian4
cues.en: about a kilometer away to relieve herself.

cues.zh: 刚解决完大事准备离开
cues.pinyin: gang1 jie3 jue2 wan2 da4 shi4 zhun3 bei4 li2 kai1
cues.en: Having just finished her business, she was about to leave,

cues.zh: 突然看到一个黑影在卫生间门口徘徊
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 kan4 dao4 yi2 ge4 hei1 ying3 zai4 wei4 sheng1 jian1 men2 kou3 pai2 huai2
cues.en: when she suddenly saw a dark figure lingering outside the restroom door.

cues.zh: 女人紧张的屏住呼吸
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 jin3 zhang1 de5 bing3 zhu4 hu1 xi1
cues.en: The woman nervously held her breath.

cues.zh: 好在黑影在几秒后就离开了
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 hei1 ying3 zai4 ji3 miao3 hou4 jiu4 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: Luckily, the figure left after a few seconds.

cues.zh: 然而就在女人开门出去的一瞬间
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 nv3 ren2 kai1 men2 chu1 qu4 de5 yi1 shun4 jian1
cues.en: But the instant the woman opened the door to leave—

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 下一秒女人从床上醒来
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3 nv3 ren2 cong2 chuang2 shang4 xing3 lai2
cues.en: —the next second, she woke up in bed.

cues.zh: 幸好刚刚只是做了个梦
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 gang1 gang1 zhi3 shi4 zuo4 le5 ge4 meng4
cues.en: Luckily, it had only been a dream.

cues.zh: 然而果川的真实环境可比梦可怕多了
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 guo3 chuan1 de5 zhen1 shi2 huan2 jing4 ke3 bi3 meng4 ke3 pa4 duo1 le5
cues.en: But the real Gwacheon is far scarier than any dream.

cues.zh: 可女人不知道的是
cues.pinyin: ke3 nv3 ren2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: What the woman didn't know, though,

cues.zh: 她早已经被恶魔盯上
cues.pinyin: ta1 zao3 yi3 jing1 bei4 e4 mo2 ding1 shang4
cues.en: was that she had already caught a predator's eye.

cues.zh: 而这一切的起因只是因为一次停车
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 yi1 qie4 de5 qi3 yin1 zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 yi1 ci4 ting2 che1
cues.en: And it all started because of a parking spot.

cues.zh: 女人名叫颜希
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 ming2 jiao4 yan2 xi1
cues.en: The woman's name was Yeonhee,

cues.zh: 是一名再平凡不过的上班族
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 ming2 zai4 ping2 fan2 bu4 guo4 de5 shang4 ban1 zu2
cues.en: an utterly ordinary office worker.

cues.zh: 前不久离婚后
cues.pinyin: qian2 bu4 jiu3 li2 hun1 hou4
cues.en: Having recently divorced,

cues.zh: 租下了一套带停车位的房子
cues.pinyin: zu1 xia4 le5 yi1 tao4 dai4 ting2 che1 wei4 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: she had rented an apartment with a parking space.

cues.zh: 却不曾想
cues.pinyin: que4 bu4 ceng2 xiang3
cues.en: She never imagined

cues.zh: 正是这个停车位引发了一系列的惨案
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ting2 che1 wei4 yin3 fa1 le5 yi1 xi4 lie4 de5 can3 an4
cues.en: that this very parking spot would set off a string of disasters.

cues.zh: 颜希刚回到久违的职场
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 gang1 hui2 dao4 jiu3 wei2 de5 zhi2 chang3
cues.en: Yeonhee had just returned to work after a long break,

cues.zh: 工作起来还是有些生疏
cues.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 qi3 lai2 hai2 shi4 you3 xie1 sheng1 shu1
cues.en: and was still a bit rusty at her job.

cues.zh: 而她的上司金部长一直鼓励安慰她
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 de5 shang4 si1 jin1 bu4 zhang3 yi4 zhi2 gu3 li4 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: Her boss, Section Chief Kim, kept encouraging and comforting her,

cues.zh: 并表示可以解决颜希转正的问题
cues.pinyin: bing4 biao3 shi4 ke3 yi3 jie3 jue2 yan2 xi1 zhuan3 zheng4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: saying he could help get her made a permanent employee,

cues.zh: 还帮她准备了迎新会
cues.pinyin: hai2 bang1 ta1 zhun3 bei4 le5 ying2 xin1 hui4
cues.en: and even helped organize a welcome party for her.

cues.zh: 延熙对此很是感激
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 dui4 ci3 hen3 shi4 gan3 ji1
cues.en: Yeonhee was very grateful for this.

cues.zh: 却不知这个金部长表面一本正经
cues.pinyin: que4 bu4 zhi1 zhe4 ge5 jin1 bu4 zhang3 biao3 mian4 yi1 ben3 zheng4 jing1
cues.en: Little did she know that beneath his proper exterior,

cues.zh: 背地里却经常骚扰公司的女同事
cues.pinyin: bei4 di4 li3 que4 jing1 chang2 sao1 rao3 gong1 si1 de5 nv3 tong2 shi4
cues.en: Section Chief Kim often harassed female coworkers behind the scenes.

cues.zh: 当天晚上
cues.pinyin: dang4 tian1 wan3 shang4
cues.en: That night,

cues.zh: 延熙在迎新会上喝了点酒
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 zai4 ying2 xin1 hui4 shang4 he1 le5 dian3 jiu3
cues.en: Yeonhee had a bit to drink at the welcome party.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 女邻居竟走到车前警告她酒后驾车
cues.pinyin: nv3 lin2 ju1 jing4 zou3 dao4 che1 qian2 jing3 gao4 ta1 jiu3 hou4 jia4 che1
cues.en: Her female neighbor actually walked up to her car to warn her against drunk driving.

cues.zh: 严夕对此很是无语
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 dui4 ci3 hen3 shi4 wu2 yu3
cues.en: Yeonhee was quite annoyed by this.

cues.zh: 第二天正在工作的严夕突然被同事问到
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zheng4 zai4 gong1 zuo4 de5 yan2 xi1 tu1 ran2 bei4 tong2 shi4 wen4 dao4
cues.en: The next day at work, a coworker suddenly asked Yeonhee

cues.zh: 她居住的果川怎么样
cues.pinyin: ta1 ju1 zhu4 de5 guo3 chuan1 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: what it was like living in Gwacheon.

cues.zh: 原来同事觉得果川的房子比较便宜
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 tong2 shi4 jue2 de5 guo3 chuan1 de5 fang2 zi5 bi3 jiao4 pian2 yi5
cues.en: It turned out the coworker thought housing there was cheap

cues.zh: 想搬过去再特意来打听情况
cues.pinyin: xiang3 ban1 guo4 qu4 zai4 te4 yi4 lai2 da3 ting1 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: and wanted to move, so had come to ask about it.

cues.zh: 严夕表示果川确实比较安静
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 biao3 shi4 guo3 chuan1 que4 shi2 bi3 jiao4 an1 jing4
cues.en: Yeonhee said Gwacheon was indeed quiet,

cues.zh: 但上下班通勤时间长
cues.pinyin: dan4 shang4 xia4 ban1 tong1 qin2 shi2 jian1 zhang3
cues.en: but the commute was long,

cues.zh: 而且停车是个严重问题
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ting2 che1 shi4 ge4 yan2 zhong4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and parking was a serious problem.

cues.zh: 同事说最近因为停车问题吵架的确实很多
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi4 shuo1 zui4 jin4 yin1 wei4 ting2 che1 wen4 ti2 chao3 jia4 di2 que4 shi2 hen3 duo1
cues.en: The coworker said there'd been a lot of fights over parking lately.

cues.zh: 严夕建议她以后租房一定要选有车位的
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 jian4 yi4 ta1 yi3 hou4 zu1 fang2 yi2 ding4 yao4 xuan3 you3 che1 wei4 de5
cues.en: Yeonhee suggested she make sure to rent a place with a parking spot.

cues.zh: 晚上下班后
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 xia4 ban1 hou4
cues.en: After work that evening,

cues.zh: 严席开车回到楼下
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi2 kai1 che1 hui2 dao4 lou2 xia4
cues.en: Yeonhee drove back to her building.

cues.zh: 今天还算幸运
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hai2 suan4 xing4 yun4
cues.en: Today she was in luck—

cues.zh: 邻居的车没有挡到他的车位
cues.pinyin: lin2 ju1 de5 che1 mei2 you3 dang3 dao4 ta1 de5 che1 wei4
cues.en: her neighbor's car wasn't blocking her spot.

cues.zh: 顺利停好车后
cues.pinyin: shun4 li4 ting2 hao3 che1 hou4
cues.en: After parking smoothly,

cues.zh: 他准备回家时
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhun3 bei4 hui2 jia1 shi2
cues.en: as she was about to head inside,

cues.zh: 意外看到昨晚的女邻居正在打电话
cues.pinyin: yi4 wai4 kan4 dao4 zuo2 wan3 de5 nv3 lin2 ju1 zheng4 zai4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: she unexpectedly saw last night's female neighbor on the phone,

cues.zh: 听起来像是在和谁吵架
cues.pinyin: ting1 qi3 lai2 xiang4 shi4 zai4 he2 shui2 chao3 jia4
cues.en: sounding like she was arguing with someone.

cues.zh: 严席转身便回到楼上
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi2 zhuan3 shen1 bian4 hui2 dao4 lou2 shang4
cues.en: Yeonhee turned and went back upstairs.

cues.zh: 洗漱完毕准备睡觉时
cues.pinyin: xi3 shu4 wan2 bi4 zhun3 bei4 shui4 jiao4 shi2
cues.en: After washing up and getting ready for bed,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 金部长却表示
cues.pinyin: jin1 bu4 zhang3 que4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Section Chief Kim messaged her, saying

cues.zh: 之前给过很多暗示
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 gei3 guo4 hen3 duo1 an4 shi4
cues.en: he'd given plenty of hints before,

cues.zh: 见你没拒绝
cues.pinyin: jian4 ni3 mei2 ju4 jue2
cues.en: and since she hadn't refused,

cues.zh: 还以为你同意了
cues.pinyin: hai2 yi3 wei2 ni3 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: he thought she'd agreed.

cues.zh: 今日他喋喋不休
cues.pinyin: jin1 ri4 ta1 die2 die2 bu4 xiu1
cues.en: He wouldn't stop texting that day.

cues.zh: 严夕不想纠缠
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 bu4 xiang3 jiu1 chan2
cues.en: Not wanting to get tangled up in it,

cues.zh: 发动车子离开了
cues.pinyin: fa1 dong4 che1 zi5 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: Yeonhee started her car and left.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 昨晚的男人再次来到严夕楼下
cues.pinyin: zuo2 wan3 de5 nan2 ren2 zai4 ci4 lai2 dao4 yan2 xi1 lou2 xia4
cues.en: the man from the night before showed up again at Yeonhee's building—

cues.zh: 可他的目标竟是女邻居
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 de5 mu4 biao1 jing4 shi4 nv3 lin2 ju1
cues.en: but his target was actually the female neighbor.

cues.zh: 他从包里拿出扳手
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 bao1 li3 na2 chu1 ban1 shou3
cues.en: He took a wrench out of his bag

cues.zh: 按响了女邻居的门铃
cues.pinyin: an4 xiang3 le5 nv3 lin2 ju1 de5 men2 ling2
cues.en: and rang the neighbor's doorbell.

cues.zh: 就在女邻居打开门缝观察时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 nv3 lin2 ju1 da3 kai1 men2 feng4 guan1 cha2 shi2
cues.en: Just as she opened the door a crack to look,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 看着突然出现了男人
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 le5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: the man suddenly appeared before her.

cues.zh: 女邻居很惊恐
cues.pinyin: nv3 lin2 ju1 hen3 jing1 kong3
cues.en: The neighbor was terrified.

cues.zh: 在门关上的一瞬间
cues.pinyin: zai4 men2 guan1 shang4 de5 yi1 shun4 jian1
cues.en: The instant the door closed,

cues.zh: 屋内顺时传来女人惊恐的尖叫声
cues.pinyin: wu1 nei4 shun4 shi2 chuan2 lai2 nv3 ren2 jing1 kong3 de5 jian1 jiao4 sheng1
cues.en: a woman's terrified scream rang out from inside at once.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 刚摆脱金部长的延熙开车回到楼下
cues.pinyin: gang1 bai3 tuo1 jin1 bu4 zhang3 de5 yan2 xi1 kai1 che1 hui2 dao4 lou2 xia4
cues.en: having just gotten away from Section Chief Kim, Yeonhee drove home,

cues.zh: 愤怒的发现女邻居的车又堵住了车位
cues.pinyin: fen4 nu4 de5 fa1 xian4 nv3 lin2 ju1 de5 che1 you4 du3 zhu4 le5 che1 wei4
cues.en: only to find, furious, that the neighbor's car was blocking her spot again.

cues.zh: 她给女邻居打电话时
cues.pinyin: ta1 gei3 nv3 lin2 ju1 da3 dian4 hua4 shi2
cues.en: When she called the neighbor to complain,

cues.zh: 殊不证女邻居正被手脚捆绑
cues.pinyin: shu1 bu4 zheng4 nv3 lin2 ju1 zheng4 bei4 shou3 jiao3 kun3 bang3
cues.en: she had no idea the woman was bound hand and foot,

cues.zh: 额头流血
cues.pinyin: e2 tou2 liu2 xie3
cues.en: forehead bleeding,

cues.zh: 嘴巴被胶带粘住
cues.pinyin: zui3 ba1 bei4 jiao1 dai4 zhan1 zhu4
cues.en: mouth taped shut,

cues.zh: 恐惧的看着眼前的男人
cues.pinyin: kong3 ju4 de5 kan4 zhuo2 yan3 qian2 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: staring in terror at the man in front of her.

cues.zh: 男人拿起女人的手机询文密码
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 na2 qi3 nv3 ren2 de5 shou3 ji1 xun2 wen2 mi4 ma3
cues.en: The man picked up her phone and demanded the password.

cues.zh: 见她不配合
cues.pinyin: jian4 ta1 bu4 pei4 he2
cues.en: When she wouldn't cooperate,

cues.zh: 正准备用指纹解锁示
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zhun3 bei4 yong4 zhi3 wen2 jie3 suo3 shi4
cues.en: he was about to unlock it with her fingerprint instead,

cues.zh: 正准备用指纹解锁时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zhun3 bei4 yong4 zhi3 wen2 jie3 suo3 shi2
cues.en: when Yeonhee's call happened to come in.

cues.zh: 男人直接挂灯
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhi2 jie1 gua4 deng1
cues.en: The man hung up right away.

cues.zh: 可延熙的电话接二连三打来
cues.pinyin: ke3 yan2 xi1 de5 dian4 hua4 jie1 er4 lian2 san1 da3 lai2
cues.en: But Yeonhee's calls kept coming, one after another.

cues.zh: 男人只能捂住女邻居的嘴巴
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhi3 neng2 wu3 zhu4 nv3 lin2 ju1 de5 zui3 ba1
cues.en: The man had no choice but to cover the neighbor's mouth

cues.zh: 装作是他的男朋友借起电话
cues.pinyin: zhuang1 zuo4 shi4 ta1 de5 nan2 peng2 you3 jie4 qi3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: and pretend to be her boyfriend as he answered.

cues.zh: 为了避免严夕起疑心
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 yan2 xi1 qi3 yi2 xin1
cues.en: To keep Yeonhee from getting suspicious,

cues.zh: 男人只能按要求下楼
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhi3 neng2 an4 yao1 qiu2 xia4 lou2
cues.en: the man had to go downstairs as she'd asked.

cues.zh: 在得知严夕这么晚只是让他挪车时
cues.pinyin: zai4 de2 zhi1 yan2 xi1 zhe4 me5 wan3 zhi3 shi4 rang4 ta1 nuo2 che1 shi2
cues.en: Realizing she'd only called him down so late to move his car,

cues.zh: 男人愤怒的质问
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 fen4 nu4 de5 zhi4 wen4
cues.en: the man angrily confronted her.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 7.5高分韩国犯罪悬疑电影，上映后首周登顶韩国票房榜冠军，影片悬疑感爆棚，剧情紧张刺激直到最后壹秒。

cues.zh: 直到最近才找到他的位置
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zui4 jin4 cai2 zhao3 dao4 ta1 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: It wasn't until just now that she'd found where it was.

cues.zh: 第二天延熙工作时
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yan2 xi1 gong1 zuo4 shi2
cues.en: The next day, while Yeonhee was at work,

cues.zh: 回想起昨晚金部长的举动
cues.pinyin: hui2 xiang3 qi3 zuo2 wan3 jin1 bu4 zhang3 de5 ju3 dong4
cues.en: she kept thinking about Section Chief Kim's behavior the night before,

cues.zh: 对他更是避之不及
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 geng4 shi4 bi4 zhi1 bu4 ji2
cues.en: and avoided him even more than usual.

cues.zh: 晚上不出意料收到金部长的消息
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 bu4 chu1 yi4 liao4 shou1 dao4 jin1 bu4 zhang3 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: That evening, as expected, a message came from Section Chief Kim,

cues.zh: 对方询问他今晚是否能送自己回家
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 xun2 wen4 ta1 jin1 wan3 shi4 fou3 neng2 song4 zi4 ji3 hui2 jia1
cues.en: asking if she could give him a ride home that night.

cues.zh: 有了前车之鉴
cues.pinyin: you3 le5 qian2 che1 zhi1 jian4
cues.en: Having learned her lesson from before,

cues.zh: 延熙直接招借库推脱
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 zhi2 jie1 zhao1 jie4 ku4 tui1 tuo1
cues.en: Yeonhee made up an excuse to turn him down.

cues.zh: 当晚延熙开车回家时
cues.pinyin: dang4 wan3 yan2 xi1 kai1 che1 hui2 jia1 shi2
cues.en: That night, as Yeonhee drove home,

cues.zh: 本庆幸女邻居车没有挡路
cues.pinyin: ben3 qing4 xing4 nv3 lin2 ju1 che1 mei2 you3 dang3 lu4
cues.en: she was at first relieved the neighbor's car wasn't in the way,

cues.zh: 因为对方终于听紧去告借
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dui4 fang1 zhong1 yu2 ting1 jin3 qu4 gao4 jie4
cues.en: assuming the woman had finally taken her advice and moved it.

cues.zh: 却不曾想女邻居早已经参死驾众
cues.pinyin: que4 bu4 ceng2 xiang3 nv3 lin2 ju1 zao3 yi3 jing1 can1 si3 jia4 zhong4
cues.en: She never imagined the neighbor had already been brutally murdered.

cues.zh: 就在延熙钢琴号车时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 yan2 xi1 gang1 qin2 hao4 che1 shi2
cues.en: Just as Yeonhee finished parking,

cues.zh: 遇到了早已等候多时的号剧
cues.pinyin: yu4 dao4 le5 zao3 yi3 deng3 hou4 duo1 shi2 de5 hao4 ju4
cues.en: she ran into the killer, who had been lying in wait for some time.

cues.zh: 男人说想让他为昨晚的无礼道歉
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shuo1 xiang3 rang4 ta1 wei4 zuo2 wan3 de5 wu2 li3 dao4 qian4
cues.en: The man said he wanted her to apologize for being rude the night before.

cues.zh: 严夕却不觉得自己的话有问题
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 que4 bu4 jue2 de2 zi4 ji3 de5 hua4 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Yeonhee, though, didn't think there was anything wrong with what she'd said,

cues.zh: 认为该道歉的是对方
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 gai1 dao4 qian4 de5 shi4 dui4 fang1
cues.en: and felt it was he who owed the apology.

cues.zh: 如果你们把车停好
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 men5 ba3 che1 ting2 hao3
cues.en: "If you'd all just parked properly,"

cues.zh: 又怎么会有后面的问题
cues.pinyin: you4 zen3 me5 hui4 you3 hou4 mian4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: "none of this would have happened in the first place."

cues.zh: 严夕不知道的是
cues.pinyin: yan2 xi1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: What Yeonhee didn't know

cues.zh: 在她走后
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 zou3 hou4
cues.en: was that after she walked away,

cues.zh: 号军拍下了车里的号码
cues.pinyin: hao4 jun1 pai1 xia4 le5 che1 li3 de5 hao4 ma3
cues.en: the man took a photo of her car's license plate.

cues.zh: 回到家的严夕接到母亲打来的电话
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 jia1 de5 yan2 xi1 jie1 dao4 mu3 qin1 da3 lai2 de5 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Back home, Yeonhee got a call from her mother.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话65｜应酬｜拔腿就跑｜近视很深｜偷猪｜补摇一下｜吃鱼｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 丈夫打电话给妻子
cues.pinyin: zhang4 fu1 da3 dian4 hua4 gei3 qi1 zi3
cues.en: Husband calls his wife.

cues.zh: 说晚上有应酬无法回家吃晚餐儿子问妈妈
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wan3 shang4 you3 ying4 chou2 wu2 fa3 hui2 jia1 chi1 wan3 can1 er2 zi5 wen4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: He says he has a work obligation tonight and can't come home for dinner; the son asks his mom,

cues.zh: 应酬是什么啊妈妈告诉她
cues.pinyin: ying4 chou2 shi4 shen2 me5 a5 ma1 ma1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: "What's an 'obligation'?" Mom tells him,

cues.zh: 啊不喜欢去却又不得不去的这就叫应酬啊
cues.pinyin: a5 bu4 xi3 huan1 qu4 que4 you4 bu4 de2 bu4 qu4 de5 zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 ying4 chou2 a5
cues.en: "Going somewhere you don't want to but have no choice — that's called an obligation."

cues.zh: 隔天早上儿子上学之前对妈妈说
cues.pinyin: ge2 tian1 zao3 shang4 er2 zi5 shang4 xue2 zhi1 qian2 dui4 ma1 ma1 shuo1
cues.en: The next morning, before school, the son says to his mom,

cues.zh: 妈妈我要去应酬了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 wo3 yao4 qu4 ying4 chou2 le5
cues.en: "Mom, I'm off to my obligation."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话65｜应酬｜拔腿就跑｜近视很深｜偷猪｜补摇一下｜吃鱼｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我问你你知道为什么海是蓝色的吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 ni3 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 hai3 shi4 lan2 se4 de5 ma5
cues.en: "Let me ask you, do you know why the sea is blue?"

cues.zh: 是因为照到天空吗
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zhao4 dao4 tian1 kong1 ma5
cues.en: "Is it because it reflects the sky?"

cues.zh: 错当然是因为海里有鱼
cues.pinyin: cuo4 dang1 ran2 shi4 yin1 wei4 hai3 li3 you3 yu2
cues.en: "Wrong — it's because there are fish in the sea."

cues.zh: 为什么海里有鱼会变成蓝色的呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hai3 li3 you3 yu2 hui4 bian4 cheng2 lan2 se4 de5 ne5
cues.en: "Why would fish make the sea turn blue?"

cues.zh: 因为鱼会吐泡泡然后就会发出
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 yu2 hui4 tu3 pao4 pao4 ran2 hou4 jiu4 hui4 fa1 chu1
cues.en: "Because fish blow bubbles, and that makes the sound"

cues.zh: b lu b lu 的声音呢
cues.pinyin: b lu b lu de5 sheng1 yin1 ne5
cues.en: "'blu blu.'" (a pun on "blue")

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话65｜应酬｜拔腿就跑｜近视很深｜偷猪｜补摇一下｜吃鱼｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你喔
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Chenchen, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 有一名警察看到了小偷
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 ming2 jing3 cha2 kan4 dao4 le5 xiao3 tou1
cues.en: "A police officer saw a thief."

cues.zh: 为什么他拔腿就跑呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ta1 ba2 tui3 jiu4 pao3 ne5
cues.en: "Why did he take off running?"

cues.zh: 会不会小偷有武器比警察还要强
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 xiao3 tou1 you3 wu3 qi4 bi3 jing3 cha2 hai2 yao4 qiang2
cues.en: "Could the thief have had a weapon stronger than the police?"

cues.zh: 警察很怕小偷就对了是不是
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 hen3 pa4 xiao3 tou1 jiu4 dui4 le5 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: "The police were scared of the thief, right?"

cues.zh: 不是他拔腿就跑
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 ta1 ba2 tui3 jiu4 pao3
cues.en: "No — he took off running"

cues.zh: 因为他要去追小偷
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yao4 qu4 zhui1 xiao3 tou1
cues.en: "because he was going to chase the thief."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话65｜应酬｜拔腿就跑｜近视很深｜偷猪｜补摇一下｜吃鱼｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 贾明
cues.pinyin: jia3 ming2
cues.en: Jiaming,

cues.zh: 你为什么要跳个不停啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 tiao4 ge4 bu4 ting2 a5
cues.en: "why do you keep jumping nonstop?"

cues.zh: 我刚刚喝了药水
cues.pinyin: wo3 gang1 gang1 he1 le5 yao4 shui3
cues.en: "I just drank some medicine."

cues.zh: 瓶子上写
cues.pinyin: ping2 zi5 shang4 xie3
cues.en: "The bottle said,"

cues.zh: 不用钱请摇一摇
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 qian2 qing3 yao2 yi1 yao2
cues.en: "free of charge, please shake."

cues.zh: 我忘了摇了
cues.pinyin: wo3 wang4 le5 yao2 le5
cues.en: "I forgot to shake it,"

cues.zh: 所以现在补摇一下
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xian4 zai4 bu3 yao2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: "so now I'm making up for it by shaking."

cues.zh: 不约什么人
cues.pinyin: bu4 yue1 shen2 me5 ren2
cues.en: "Who wouldn't you ask out?"

cues.zh: 不约什么人
cues.pinyin: bu4 yue1 shen2 me5 ren2
cues.en: "Who wouldn't you ask out?"

cues.zh: 就是如果是不合适的人
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 shi4 bu4 he2 shi4 de5 ren2
cues.en: "Well, someone who isn't a good fit,"

cues.zh: 或是不喜欢的人都不会约
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 bu4 xi3 huan1 de5 ren2 dou1 bu2 hui4 yue1
cues.en: "or someone you don't like — you wouldn't ask them out."

cues.zh: 不是是儿童
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 shi4 er2 tong2
cues.en: "No — it's children."

cues.zh: 因为不约儿童
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 bu4 yue1 er2 tong2
cues.en: "Because you don't ask out children."

cues.zh: 妈妈问小美
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 wen4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Mom asks Xiaomei,

cues.zh: 你知道吃鱼的好处吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 chi1 yu2 de5 hao3 chu4 ma5
cues.en: "do you know the benefits of eating fish?"

cues.zh: 吃鱼可以预防近视
cues.pinyin: chi1 yu2 ke3 yi3 yu4 fang2 jin4 shi4
cues.en: "Eating fish can prevent nearsightedness."

cues.zh: 怎么说呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 shuo1 ne5
cues.en: "How so?"

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天由我继续为大家导读爱因
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 you2 wo3 ji4 xu4 wei4 da4 jia1 dao3 du2 ai4 yin1
cues.en: Today I'll continue guiding you through Einstein's

cues.zh: 斯坦的小册子
cues.pinyin: si1 tan3 de5 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: booklet,

cues.zh: 狭义与广义相对论浅说
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1
cues.en: "Relativity: The Special and General Theory, A Popular Exposition."

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦年轻的时候特别喜欢读书
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 te4 bie2 xi3 huan1 du2 shu1
cues.en: When Einstein was young he especially loved reading.

cues.zh: 比如他阅读了很多庞加莱的著作
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ta1 yue4 du2 le5 hen3 duo1 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 zhu4 zuo4
cues.en: For example, he read many works by Poincaré.

cues.zh: 庞加莱是继高斯和黎曼之后世界上最伟大
cues.pinyin: pang2 jia1 lai2 shi4 ji4 gao1 si1 he2 li2 man4 zhi1 hou4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 wei3 da4
cues.en: Poincaré was, after Gauss and Riemann, one of the greatest

cues.zh: 的数学家之一
cues.pinyin: de5 shu4 xue2 jia1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: mathematicians in the world.

cues.zh: 他的许多工作对相对论的提出产
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xu3 duo1 gong1 zuo4 dui4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 ti2 chu1 chan3
cues.en: Many of his works had an important

cues.zh: 生了重要影响
cues.pinyin: sheng1 le5 zhong4 yao4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: influence on the development of relativity.

cues.zh: 甚至一度有人认为庞加莱才是相
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 yi2 du4 you3 ren2 ren4 wei2 pang2 jia1 lai2 cai2 shi4 xiang1
cues.en: Some even once thought Poincaré was actually the

cues.zh: 对论的提出者
cues.pinyin: dui4 lun4 de5 ti2 chu1 zhe3
cues.en: one who first proposed relativity.

cues.zh: 同时庞加莱也是一名科学哲学家
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 pang2 jia1 lai2 ye3 shi4 yi1 ming2 ke1 xue2 zhe2 xue2 jia1
cues.en: At the same time, Poincaré was also a philosopher of science.

cues.zh: 他曾经写过一本小册子科学与假设
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 xie3 guo4 yi1 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5 ke1 xue2 yu3 jia3 she4
cues.en: He once wrote a booklet called "Science and Hypothesis."

cues.zh: 在这本书中庞加莱提出
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 zhong1 pang2 jia1 lai2 ti2 chu1
cues.en: In this book, Poincaré proposed that

cues.zh: 想把两个不在一起的时钟对齐
cues.pinyin: xiang3 ba3 liang3 ge4 bu4 zai4 yi4 qi3 de5 shi2 zhong1 dui4 qi2
cues.en: trying to synchronize two clocks that aren't together

cues.zh: 并不是一件容易的事
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu2 shi4 yi1 jian4 rong2 yi4 de5 shi4
cues.en: is not an easy thing to do.

cues.zh: 比如在北京有一个钟表
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zai4 bei3 jing1 you3 yi2 ge4 zhong1 biao3
cues.en: For example, there's a clock in Beijing,

cues.zh: 在上海有另外一个钟表
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 hai3 you3 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 biao3
cues.en: and another clock in Shanghai.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 我们通过什么方法能够把两个钟表对准呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong1 guo4 shen2 me5 fang1 fa3 neng2 gou4 ba3 liang3 ge4 zhong1 biao3 dui4 zhun3 ne5
cues.en: What method can we use to synchronize the two clocks?

cues.zh: 大家注意
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: Pay attention, everyone.

cues.zh: 你不能回答我说
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 neng2 hui2 da2 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: You can't answer by saying,

cues.zh: 打开电脑查询标准北京时间
cues.pinyin: da3 kai1 dian4 nao3 cha2 xun2 biao1 zhun3 bei3 jing1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: "Just check the standard Beijing time on a computer."

cues.zh: 因为能够用电脑查询标准北京
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 neng2 gou4 yong4 dian4 nao3 cha2 xun2 biao1 zhun3 bei3 jing1
cues.en: Because the premise for being able to check standard Beijing

cues.zh: 时间的前提是
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 de5 qian2 ti2 shi4
cues.en: time on a computer

cues.zh: 我们的确有方法对齐不同地点的时钟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 que4 you3 fang1 fa3 dui4 qi2 bu4 tong2 di4 dian3 de5 shi2 zhong1
cues.en: is that we already have a way to synchronize clocks in different places.

cues.zh: 我们所问的就是这种对中的方法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 suo3 wen4 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 dui4 zhong1 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: What we're asking is exactly what this method of

cues.zh: 究竟是什么
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jing4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: synchronization actually is.

cues.zh: 你可能会想到
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 hui4 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: You might think of this:

cues.zh: 我们先在北京对好两个时钟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 zai4 bei3 jing1 dui4 hao3 liang3 ge4 shi2 zhong1
cues.en: first synchronize the two clocks in Beijing,

cues.zh: 然后再把其中一个拿到上海去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ba3 qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 na2 dao4 shang4 hai3 qu4
cues.en: then take one of them to Shanghai.

cues.zh: 这个不行吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bu4 xing2 ma5
cues.en: Wouldn't that work?

cues.zh: 可是在移动的过程之中
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 yi2 dong4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: But during the process of moving,

cues.zh: 谁也不能保证时钟的走时
cues.pinyin: shui2 ye3 bu4 neng2 bao3 zheng4 shi2 zhong1 de5 zou3 shi2
cues.en: no one can guarantee that the clock's timekeeping

cues.zh: 不发生任何变化
cues.pinyin: bu4 fa1 sheng1 ren4 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: won't change at all.

cues.zh: 当它移动到上海的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 yi2 dong4 dao4 shang4 hai3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: By the time it's moved to Shanghai,

cues.zh: 未必能和北京的时钟保持同步
cues.pinyin: wei4 bi4 neng2 he2 bei3 jing1 de5 shi2 zhong1 bao3 chi2 tong2 bu4
cues.en: it might not stay in sync with the clock in Beijing.

cues.zh: 对于这个问题
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Regarding this problem,

cues.zh: 庞家来提出过一种猜想
cues.pinyin: pang2 jia1 lai2 ti2 chu1 guo4 yi1 zhong3 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: Poincaré proposed a conjecture.

cues.zh: 他认为应该通过一种约定
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 ying1 gai1 tong1 guo4 yi1 zhong3 yue1 ding4
cues.en: He thought it should be resolved through a convention

cues.zh: 来解决时钟的对齐问题
cues.pinyin: lai2 jie3 jue2 shi2 zhong1 de5 dui4 qi2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: to solve the problem of synchronizing clocks.

cues.zh: 最简单的约定
cues.pinyin: zui4 jian3 dan1 de5 yue1 ding4
cues.en: The simplest convention—

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦发展了庞加莱的理论
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 fa1 zhan3 le5 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: Einstein developed Poincaré's theory.

cues.zh: 他说光速在任何惯性参考系中都保持不变
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 guang1 su4 zai4 ren4 he2 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 zhong1 du1 bao3 chi2 bu4 bian4
cues.en: He said the speed of light stays constant in every inertial reference frame.

cues.zh: 这就是光速不变假设
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 guang1 su4 bu4 bian4 jia3 she4
cues.en: This is the postulate of the constancy of the speed of light.

cues.zh: 根据这个假设
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 ge5 jia3 she4
cues.en: Based on this postulate,

cues.zh: 绝对的时间是不存在的
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 de5 shi2 jian1 shi4 bu4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: absolute time does not exist.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦在本书中
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 ben3 shu1 zhong1
cues.en: In this book, Einstein

cues.zh: 用一个闪电劈火车的例子说明了这个道理
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi2 ge4 shan3 dian4 pi1 huo3 che1 de5 li4 zi5 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 dao4 li3
cues.en: used an example of lightning striking a train to explain this principle.

cues.zh: 我们把这个例子修改一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 li4 zi5 xiu1 gai3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's modify this example a bit

cues.zh: 让它更加方便理解
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 geng4 jia1 fang1 bian4 li3 jie3
cues.en: to make it easier to understand.

cues.zh: 有一辆急迟的高铁中有一节餐车
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 liang4 ji2 chi2 de5 gao1 tie3 zhong1 you3 yi1 jie2 can1 che1
cues.en: A speeding high-speed train has a dining car.

cues.zh: 在餐车的头部和尾部各有一个
cues.pinyin: zai4 can1 che1 de5 tou2 bu4 he2 wei3 bu4 ge4 you3 yi2 ge4
cues.en: At the front and back of the dining car there is each

cues.zh: 乘客准备用餐
cues.pinyin: cheng2 ke4 zhun3 bei4 yong4 can1
cues.en: a passenger preparing to eat.

cues.zh: 逝者站在车厢正中央点亮了一盏灯
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhe3 zhan4 zai4 che1 xiang1 zheng4 zhong1 yang1 dian3 liang4 le5 yi1 zhan3 deng1
cues.en: The attendant stands right in the middle of the car and turns on a light.

cues.zh: 这盏灯会向前方和后方发出光线
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhan3 deng1 hui4 xiang4 qian2 fang1 he2 hou4 fang1 fa1 chu1 guang1 xian4
cues.en: This light sends out beams both forward and backward.

cues.zh: 这就是说火车上的侍者认为同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 huo3 che1 shang4 de5 shi4 zhe3 ren4 wei2 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: When the two passengers see the light, they start eating.

cues.zh: 因为两名乘客到逝者的距离是一样的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 liang3 ming2 cheng2 ke4 dao4 shi4 zhe3 de5 ju4 li2 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: Because the distance from each passenger to the attendant is the same,

cues.zh: 而光的传播速度也是一样的
cues.pinyin: er2 guang1 de5 chuan2 bo1 su4 du4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: and the speed of light is also the same,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 这就是说火车上的逝者认为同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 huo3 che1 shang4 de5 shi4 zhe3 ren4 wei2 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: this means the attendant on the train thinks the two events happen at the same time,

cues.zh: 地面上的倒叉工却认为是一先一后发生的
cues.pinyin: di4 mian4 shang4 de5 dao4 cha1 gong1 que4 ren4 wei2 shi4 yi1 xian1 yi1 hou4 fa1 sheng1 de5
cues.en: but a switchman on the ground thinks they happen one after the other.

cues.zh: 同时是具有相对性的
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 shi4 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4 de5
cues.en: Simultaneity is relative.

cues.zh: 在一个参考系下同时发生
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Events simultaneous in one reference frame

cues.zh: 换一个参考系就会一先一后
cues.pinyin: huan4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 jiu4 hui4 yi1 xian1 yi1 hou4
cues.en: become sequential in a different reference frame.

cues.zh: 所以宇宙中不存在一个统一的时间
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yu3 zhou4 zhong1 bu4 cun2 zai4 yi2 ge4 tong3 yi1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: So there's no single unified time in the universe

cues.zh: 永恒不变的流逝
cues.pinyin: yong3 heng2 bu4 bian4 de5 liu2 shi4
cues.en: flowing forever unchanged.

cues.zh: 紧跟着爱因斯坦指出
cues.pinyin: jin3 gen1 zhe5 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zhi3 chu1
cues.en: Right after this, Einstein points out

cues.zh: 既然时间具有相对性
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 shi2 jian1 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4
cues.en: that since time is relative,

cues.zh: 那么空间尺寸也会具有相对性
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 kong1 jian1 chi3 cun4 ye3 hui4 ju4 you3 xiang1 dui4 xing4
cues.en: spatial dimensions must also be relative.

cues.zh: 像欧吉里德几何中那种刚性的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 ou1 ji2 li3 de2 ji3 he2 zhong1 na4 zhong3 gang1 xing4 de5
cues.en: A rigid, absolutely unchanging length like the kind in

cues.zh: 绝对不变的长度是不存在的
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bu4 bian4 de5 chang2 du4 shi4 bu4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: Euclidean geometry does not exist.

cues.zh: 你看啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 a5
cues.en: Look at it this way:

cues.zh: 如果你想测量一列火车的长度
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 ce4 liang2 yi1 lie4 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: if you want to measure the length of a train,

cues.zh: 你就需要一把尺子放在火车的旁边
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 xu1 yao4 yi1 ba3 chi3 zi5 fang4 zai4 huo3 che1 de5 pang2 bian1
cues.en: you need to place a ruler next to the train

cues.zh: 同时读出火车头部和尾部对齐的刻度
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 du2 chu1 huo3 che1 tou2 bu4 he2 wei3 bu4 dui4 qi2 de5 ke4 du4
cues.en: and simultaneously read the markings aligned with the train's front and back.

cues.zh: 然后把它们做差就得到了火车的长度
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 men5 zuo4 cha4 jiu4 de2 dao4 le5 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4
cues.en: Then subtract them to get the train's length.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 但是除非这把尺子跟火车相对静止
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 chu2 fei1 zhe4 ba3 chi3 zi5 gen1 huo3 che1 xiang1 dui4 jing4 zhi3
cues.en: But unless this ruler is at rest relative to the train,

cues.zh: 你读首尾两个刻度的时间才可以不一样
cues.pinyin: ni3 du2 shou3 wei3 liang3 ge4 ke4 du4 de5 shi2 jian1 cai2 ke3 yi3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: the times at which you read the two end marks don't need to match.

cues.zh: 否则假如火车在地面上飞奔
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 jia3 ru2 huo3 che1 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 fei1 ben1
cues.en: Otherwise, if the train is speeding along the ground,

cues.zh: 你必须同时读出两个刻度
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi4 xu1 tong2 shi2 du2 chu1 liang3 ge4 ke4 du4
cues.en: you must read the two marks at the same time

cues.zh: 才能准确测出火车长度
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 zhun3 que4 ce4 chu1 huo3 che1 chang2 du4
cues.en: in order to accurately measure the train's length.

cues.zh: 可是我们知道同时是跟参考系有关的
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 tong2 shi2 shi4 gen1 can1 kao3 xi4 you3 guan1 de5
cues.en: But we know that simultaneity depends on the reference frame.

cues.zh: 在某个参考系上同时发生的事
cues.pinyin: zai4 mou3 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 shang4 tong2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: Events that happen simultaneously in one reference frame

cues.zh: 换一个参考系就不是同时了
cues.pinyin: huan4 yi2 ge4 can1 kao3 xi4 jiu4 bu2 shi4 tong2 shi2 le5
cues.en: are no longer simultaneous in a different reference frame.

cues.zh: 这样一来火车的长度也就跟参考系有关了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 huo3 che1 de5 chang2 du4 ye3 jiu4 gen1 can1 kao3 xi4 you3 guan1 le5
cues.en: As a result, the train's length also depends on the reference frame.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦说麦克斯韦方程组计算出的
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1 mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 fang1 cheng2 zu3 ji4 suan4 chu1 de5
cues.en: Einstein said the speed of light calculated from Maxwell's equations

cues.zh: 光速是恒定的
cues.pinyin: guang1 su4 shi4 heng2 ding4 de5
cues.en: is constant.

cues.zh: 我们又假设光速在所有参考系
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you4 jia3 she4 guang1 su4 zai4 suo3 you3 can1 kao3 xi4
cues.en: We also assume the speed of light is the same

cues.zh: 下都是一样的
cues.pinyin: xia4 dou1 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: in every reference frame.

cues.zh: 所以我们当然应该认为麦克斯韦方程组
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 dang1 ran2 ying1 gai1 ren4 wei2 mai4 ke4 si1 wei2 fang1 cheng2 zu3
cues.en: So we should of course believe that Maxwell's equations

cues.zh: 在所有惯性参考系下都是成立的了
cues.pinyin: zai4 suo3 you3 guan4 xing4 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4 dou1 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5 le5
cues.en: hold true in every inertial reference frame.

cues.zh: 而伽利略早就告诉我们力学规律
cues.pinyin: er2 jia1 li4 lve4 zao3 jiu4 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 li4 xue2 gui1 lv4
cues.en: And Galileo had already told us the laws of mechanics (hold the same way).

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（三）光速为何恒定不变？时间和空间为什么是相对的？

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦导出了不同参考系下
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 dao3 chu1 le5 bu4 tong2 can1 kao3 xi4 xia4
cues.en: Einstein derived the laws governing how time and space

cues.zh: 时间和空间的变化规律
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 de5 bian4 hua4 gui1 lv4
cues.en: change across different reference frames.

cues.zh: 这就是著名的洛伦兹变换
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 luo4 lun2 zi1 bian4 huan4
cues.en: This is the famous Lorentz transformation.

cues.zh: 之所以叫洛伦兹变换
cues.pinyin: zhi1 suo3 yi3 jiao4 luo4 lun2 zi1 bian4 huan4
cues.en: The reason it's called the Lorentz transformation

cues.zh: 是因为这个规律最早是洛伦兹提出的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4 zui4 zao3 shi4 luo4 lun2 zi1 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: is because this law was first proposed by Lorentz.

cues.zh: 他为了解释迈克尔索莫雷实验
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 mai4 ke4 er3 suo3 mo4 lei2 shi2 yan4
cues.en: In order to explain the Michelson–Morley experiment,

cues.zh: 提出了物体在运动的方向上长度会收缩
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 wu4 ti3 zai4 yun4 dong4 de5 fang1 xiang4 shang4 chang2 du4 hui4 shou1 suo1
cues.en: he proposed that an object's length contracts in its direction of motion,

cues.zh: 而且还得出了正确的公式
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 de2 chu1 le5 zheng4 que4 de5 gong1 shi4
cues.en: and he even derived the correct formula.

cues.zh: 只可惜洛伦兹认为的收缩
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ke3 xi1 luo4 lun2 zi1 ren4 wei2 de5 shou1 suo1
cues.en: It's just a shame that the contraction Lorentz imagined

cues.zh: 是物体在绝对空间中的实际收缩
cues.pinyin: shi4 wu4 ti3 zai4 jue2 dui4 kong1 jian1 zhong1 de5 shi2 ji4 shou1 suo1
cues.en: was an object's actual contraction in absolute space.

cues.zh: 他甚至还带着学生研究
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen4 zhi4 hai2 dai4 zhe5 xue2 sheng1 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: He even worked with students to study

cues.zh: 在收缩过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou1 suo1 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: during the contraction process,

cues.zh: 电荷密度的变化会造成什么影响
cues.pinyin: dian4 he4 mi4 du4 de5 bian4 hua4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: what effect the change in charge density would cause.

cues.zh: 但是我们之后就会看到
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 hui4 kan4 dao4
cues.en: But as we'll see later,

cues.zh: 这种收缩并不是物体在时空中的收缩
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shou1 suo1 bing4 bu2 shi4 wu4 ti3 zai4 shi2 kong1 zhong1 de5 shou1 suo1
cues.en: this contraction isn't actually an object's contraction in spacetime,

cues.zh: 而只是因为观察者所在的时空
cues.pinyin: er2 zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 guan1 cha2 zhe3 suo3 zai4 de5 shi2 kong1
cues.en: it's just that the observer's spacetime

cues.zh: 角度不一样了
cues.pinyin: jiao3 du4 bu4 yi2 yang4 le5
cues.en: angle, or perspective, is different.

cues.zh: 如果我们总结一下
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 zong3 jie2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: To sum it up,

cues.zh: 牛顿时空观的问题究竟在哪里呢
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 shi2 kong1 guan1 de5 wen4 ti2 jiu1 jing4 zai4 na3 li3 ne5
cues.en: where exactly is the problem with Newton's view of space and time?

cues.zh: 它在于
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 yu2
cues.en: It lies in...

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 最大胆的高中校园 The Chinese High School with the Most Bolding Design

cues.zh: 课间短短 10 分钟
cues.pinyin: ke4 jian1 duan3 duan3 10 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Recess is only a short ten minutes.

cues.zh: 学生是来不及跑到楼下去活动的
cues.pinyin: xue2 sheng1 shi4 lai2 bu4 ji2 pao3 dao4 lou2 xia4 qu4 huo2 dong4 de5
cues.en: Students don't have time to run downstairs to be active.

cues.zh: 我们把教学楼面向超长的地方
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 jiao4 xue2 lou2 mian4 xiang4 chao1 chang2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: We took the extra-long side of the teaching building

cues.zh: 设计成了一个巨大的空中森林
cues.pinyin: she4 ji4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 ju4 da4 de5 kong1 zhong1 sen1 lin2
cues.en: and designed it into a huge aerial forest.

cues.zh: 一下课快速可以进入到这片柔软的空间
cues.pinyin: yi1 xia4 ke4 kuai4 su4 ke3 yi3 jin4 ru4 dao4 zhe4 pian4 rou2 ruan3 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: Right after class, you can quickly enter this soft, gentle space.

cues.zh: 在教育无比内卷的今天
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiao4 yu4 wu2 bi3 nei4 juan3 de5 jin1 tian1
cues.en: In today's era of intense educational competition,

cues.zh: 我们希望创造一个可以认真浪
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xi1 wang4 chuang4 zao4 yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 ren4 zhen1 lang4
cues.en: we wanted to create a high school where you could

cues.zh: 费时间的高中
cues.pinyin: fei4 shi2 jian1 de5 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: seriously "waste" some time —

cues.zh: 让学校不那么的让人讨厌
cues.pinyin: rang4 xue2 xiao4 bu4 na4 me5 de5 rang4 ren2 tao3 yan4
cues.en: so that school feels less unlikeable.

cues.zh: 惠贞高级中学是一所 30 班规模的寄宿
cues.pinyin: hui4 zhen1 gao1 ji2 zhong1 xue2 shi4 yi1 suo3 30 ban1 gui1 mo2 de5 ji4 su4
cues.en: Huizhen Senior High School is a regular high school with 30 classes,

cues.zh: 制的普通高中
cues.pinyin: zhi4 de5 pu3 tong1 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: run as a boarding school.

cues.zh: 当学生处于屋面的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 xue2 sheng1 chu3 yu2 wu1 mian4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When students are up on the roof,

cues.zh: 整个学校都已经从视线中消失了
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 xue2 xiao4 dou1 yi3 jing1 cong2 shi4 xian4 zhong1 xiao1 shi1 le5
cues.en: the whole school disappears from view.

cues.zh: 他能看到的只有广袤的城市
cues.pinyin: ta1 neng2 kan4 dao4 de5 zhi3 you3 guang3 mao4 de5 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: All they can see is the sprawling city

cues.zh: 还有无垠的天空
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wu2 yin2 de5 tian1 kong1
cues.en: and the boundless sky.

cues.zh: 有时间的话我会去天台上散步
cues.pinyin: you3 shi2 jian1 de5 hua4 wo3 hui4 qu4 tian1 tai2 shang4 san4 bu4
cues.en: When I have time, I go for a walk on the rooftop terrace.

cues.zh: 跟天空离得非常近
cues.pinyin: gen1 tian1 kong1 li2 de2 fei1 chang2 jin4
cues.en: It feels very close to the sky.

cues.zh: 感觉有一种自由的感觉
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 you3 yi1 zhong3 zi4 you2 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: There's a real sense of freedom.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 最大胆的高中校园 The Chinese High School with the Most Bolding Design

cues.zh: 正常在一个学校里面
cues.pinyin: zheng4 chang2 zai4 yi2 ge4 xue2 xiao4 li3 mian4
cues.en: Normally, in a school,

cues.zh: 所有的空间都是被监视著的
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 kong1 jian1 dou1 shi4 bei4 jian1 shi4 zhu4 de5
cues.en: every space is under surveillance.

cues.zh: 通过这样一个充满乡野气息的
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 chong1 man3 xiang1 ye3 qi4 xi1 de5
cues.en: Through this layout full of rural, countryside atmosphere

cues.zh: 立体交织的游廊中
cues.pinyin: li4 ti3 jiao1 zhi1 de5 you2 lang2 zhong1
cues.en: and a three-dimensional, interwoven corridor,

cues.zh: 它就会有一个隐蔽的小空间
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 you3 yi2 ge4 yin3 bi4 de5 xiao3 kong1 jian1
cues.en: there's a hidden little space

cues.zh: 可以把他们的作业带到这里来完成
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 men5 de5 zuo4 ye4 dai4 dao4 zhe4 li3 lai2 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: where students can bring their homework to finish,

cues.zh: 或者是谈一些悄悄话
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 tan2 yi1 xie1 qiao1 qiao1 hua4
cues.en: or share some private whispers,

cues.zh: 而不会觉得被哪个老师正注视著
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 hui4 jue2 de5 bei4 na3 ge5 lao3 shi1 zheng4 zhu4 shi4 zhu4
cues.en: without feeling watched by any teacher.

cues.zh: 我们联系宁波教育局
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lian2 xi4 ning2 bo1 jiao4 yu4 ju2
cues.en: We contacted the Ningbo Education Bureau.

cues.zh: 当这个完全不像学校的一个森林
cues.pinyin: dang1 zhe4 ge5 wan2 quan2 bu4 xiang4 xue2 xiao4 de5 yi2 ge4 sen1 lin2
cues.en: When this forest, which looks nothing like a school,

cues.zh: 摆在他们面前的时候
cues.pinyin: bai3 zai4 ta1 men5 mian4 qian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: was put in front of them,

cues.zh: 他们也是很吃惊的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 shi4 hen3 chi1 jing1 de5
cues.en: they were quite surprised too.

cues.zh: 宁波市教育局还是很有魄力的
cues.pinyin: ning2 bo1 shi4 jiao4 yu4 ju2 hai2 shi4 hen3 you3 po4 li4 de5
cues.en: The Ningbo Education Bureau turned out to be very bold.

cues.zh: 他们就决定了这个方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiu4 jue2 ding4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 an4
cues.en: They went ahead and approved this plan.

cues.zh: 整个教学楼是以高校浓缩的方式
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 jiao4 xue2 lou2 shi4 yi3 gao1 xiao4 nong2 suo1 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: The whole teaching building, in a highly condensed way,

cues.zh: 形成一个物质型的布局
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 yi2 ge4 wu4 zhi4 xing2 de5 bu4 ju2
cues.en: forms a fishbone-shaped layout.

cues.zh: 永远形成一个连续起伏的
cues.pinyin: yong3 yuan3 xing2 cheng2 yi2 ge4 lian2 xu4 qi3 fu2 de5
cues.en: Then it forms a continuously undulating,

cues.zh: 超尺度的屋顶公园
cues.pinyin: chao1 chi3 du4 de5 wu1 ding3 gong1 yuan2
cues.en: oversized rooftop park.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 最大胆的高中校园 The Chinese High School with the Most Bolding Design

cues.zh: 所有的教室走廊都设计成最经
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 jiao4 shi4 zou3 lang2 dou1 she4 ji4 cheng2 zui4 jing1
cues.en: All the classroom corridors are designed to the most

cues.zh: 济的一个尺寸
cues.pinyin: ji4 de5 yi2 ge4 chi3 cun4
cues.en: economical size.

cues.zh: 把这个空间全部都给节省出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 kong1 jian1 quan2 bu4 dou1 gei3 jie2 sheng3 chu1 lai2
cues.en: All that saved space

cues.zh: 放到所谓的园里面去
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 suo3 wei4 de5 yuan2 li3 mian4 qu4
cues.en: goes into the so-called "garden."

cues.zh: 我们的设计就是让这边森林可以覆盖
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 she4 ji4 jiu4 shi4 rang4 zhe4 bian1 sen1 lin2 ke3 yi3 fu4 gai4
cues.en: Our design lets this forest cover

cues.zh: 每一栋教学楼
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 dong4 jiao4 xue2 lou2
cues.en: every teaching building,

cues.zh: 的每一个楼层
cues.pinyin: de5 mei3 yi2 ge4 lou2 ceng2
cues.en: every single floor of it.

cues.zh: 森林里的小路都是被设计成蜿
cues.pinyin: sen1 lin2 li3 de5 xiao3 lu4 dou1 shi4 bei4 she4 ji4 cheng2 wan1
cues.en: The paths in the forest are all designed to be

cues.zh: 蜒起伏的状态
cues.pinyin: yan2 qi3 fu2 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: winding and undulating.

cues.zh: 立柱都散落在森林的空间里头
cues.pinyin: li4 zhu4 dou1 san4 luo4 zai4 sen1 lin2 de5 kong1 jian1 li3 tou5
cues.en: The columns are scattered throughout the forest space.

cues.zh: 空中的游廊树冠之间交织缠绕
cues.pinyin: kong1 zhong1 de5 you2 lang2 shu4 guan1 zhi1 jian1 jiao1 zhi1 chan2 rao4
cues.en: The aerial walkways weave between the tree canopies.

cues.zh: 它们似乎都有自己喜好的一条流线
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 si4 hu1 dou1 you3 zi4 ji3 xi3 hao4 de5 yi1 tiao2 liu2 xian4
cues.en: Each one seems to have its own favorite route.

cues.zh: 当他们两条不同高度的游郎交会的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ta1 men5 liang3 tiao2 bu4 tong2 gao1 du4 de5 you2 lang2 jiao1 hui4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When two walkways of different heights cross paths,

cues.zh: 他们也会相互之间看一眼打个招呼
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 hui4 xiang1 hu4 zhi1 jian1 kan4 yi1 yan3 da3 ge4 zhao1 hu1
cues.en: people on them will glance at each other and say hi.

cues.zh: 还涉及了很多高高低低的小书屋
cues.pinyin: hai2 she4 ji2 le5 hen3 duo1 gao1 gao1 di1 di1 de5 xiao3 shu1 wu1
cues.en: There are also many little reading nooks at different heights.

cues.zh: 让课堂也可以在森林中发生
cues.pinyin: rang4 ke4 tang2 ye3 ke3 yi3 zai4 sen1 lin2 zhong1 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: This lets classes happen in the forest too.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 最大胆的高中校园 The Chinese High School with the Most Bolding Design

cues.zh: 我们会带领学生到生物园里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 dai4 ling3 xue2 sheng1 dao4 sheng1 wu4 yuan2 li3 mian4
cues.en: Last year we launched an elective called "Into the Plants."

cues.zh: 我们会带领学生到生物院里面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 dai4 ling3 xue2 sheng1 dao4 sheng1 wu4 yuan4 li3 mian4
cues.en: We take students to the biology garden

cues.zh: 对植物进行一些水培
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhi2 wu4 jin4 xing2 yi1 xie1 shui3 pei2
cues.en: to do some hydroponic planting

cues.zh: 去制作森林的植物地图
cues.pinyin: qu4 zhi4 zuo4 sen1 lin2 de5 zhi2 wu4 di4 tu2
cues.en: and make maps of the forest's plants.

cues.zh: 我们是把教学楼抬离地面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi4 ba3 jiao4 xue2 lou2 tai2 li2 di4 mian4
cues.en: We lifted the teaching buildings off the ground

cues.zh: 把地面也弹了出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 di4 mian4 ye3 dan4 le5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and freed up the ground level too,

cues.zh: 变成一个可以连续漫步的公园和街道
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 lian2 xu4 man4 bu4 de5 gong1 yuan2 he2 jie1 dao4
cues.en: turning it into a park and street you can stroll through continuously.

cues.zh: 剧院图书馆体育馆食堂
cues.pinyin: ju4 yuan4 tu2 shu1 guan3 ti3 yu4 guan3 shi2 tang2
cues.en: Theater, library, gym, cafeteria —

cues.zh: 就像一个小店铺一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 dian4 pu4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: they're like little shops

cues.zh: 站落在街道两旁
cues.pinyin: zhan4 luo4 zai4 jie1 dao4 liang3 pang2
cues.en: lining both sides of the street.

cues.zh: 学生进入这些公共空间就像逛街一样
cues.pinyin: xue2 sheng1 jin4 ru4 zhe4 xie1 gong1 gong4 kong1 jian1 jiu4 xiang4 guang4 jie1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Students entering these public spaces feels like going shopping.

cues.zh: 我曾经去杭州所里一次分享
cues.pinyin: wo3 ceng2 jing1 qu4 hang2 zhou1 suo3 li3 yi1 ci4 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: I once gave a talk in Hangzhou.

cues.zh: 当我最后说这是一个
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 zui4 hou4 shuo1 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: When I finally said this

cues.zh: 隶属于宁波教育局的公办高中
cues.pinyin: li4 shu3 yu2 ning2 bo1 jiao4 yu4 ju2 de5 gong1 ban4 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: was a public high school under the Ningbo Education Bureau,

cues.zh: 所有的人都静呆了
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 ren2 dou1 jing4 dai1 le5
cues.en: everyone was stunned.

cues.zh: 原来宁波市教育局的接触度这么高
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ning2 bo1 shi4 jiao4 yu4 ju2 de5 jie1 chu4 du4 zhe4 me5 gao1
cues.en: "The Ningbo Education Bureau is this open-minded?"

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 最大胆的高中校园 The Chinese High School with the Most Bolding Design

cues.zh: 所有的学生都承载着巨大的学业压力
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 xue2 sheng1 dou1 cheng2 zai4 zhe5 ju4 da4 de5 xue2 ye4 ya1 li4
cues.en: All students carry a huge amount of academic pressure.

cues.zh: 但是作为一所技术制中学
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zuo4 wei2 yi1 suo3 ji4 shu4 zhi4 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: But as a boarding school,

cues.zh: 校园几乎是一个孩子全部青春
cues.pinyin: xiao4 yuan2 ji1 hu1 shi4 yi2 ge4 hai2 zi5 quan2 bu4 qing1 chun1
cues.en: the campus is almost a child's entire

cues.zh: 期的成长空间
cues.pinyin: qi1 de5 cheng2 zhang3 kong1 jian1
cues.en: formative teenage years.

cues.zh: 不是只有学习
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 zhi3 you3 xue2 xi2
cues.en: It's not just about studying,

cues.zh: 不是只有效率
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 zhi3 you3 xiao4 lv4
cues.en: not just about efficiency —

cues.zh: 还有可以让学生发现青春的美
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ke3 yi3 rang4 xue2 sheng1 fa4 xian4 qing1 chun1 de5 mei3
cues.en: there should also be spaces that let students discover

cues.zh: 好的一些空间
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 yi1 xie1 kong1 jian1
cues.en: the beauty of youth.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】你敢相信一个人可以拥有2个心脏吗？梅医生他就做到了

cues.zh: 拥有两个心脏的人你听说过吗
cues.pinyin: yong1 you3 liang3 ge4 xin1 zang4 de5 ren2 ni3 ting1 shuo1 guo4 ma5
cues.en: Have you ever heard of someone having two hearts?

cues.zh: 真是世界之大无奇不有
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 shi4 jie4 zhi1 da4 wu2 qi2 bu4 you3
cues.en: Truly, the world is full of wonders.

cues.zh: 这个老妇人心脏不太好
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 fu4 ren2 xin1 zang4 bu4 tai4 hao3
cues.en: This old woman's heart wasn't in good shape.

cues.zh: 除此之外她还患有肺动脉高压
cues.pinyin: chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4 ta1 hai2 huan4 you3 fei4 dong4 mai4 gao1 ya1
cues.en: On top of that, she also had pulmonary hypertension.

cues.zh: 单靠药物降压效果并不明显
cues.pinyin: dan1 kao4 yao4 wu4 jiang4 ya1 xiao4 guo3 bing4 bu4 ming2 xian3
cues.en: Medication alone wasn't very effective at lowering it.

cues.zh: 她的心脏因为劳累过度出现了衰竭的情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 zang4 yin1 wei4 lao2 lei4 guo4 du4 chu1 xian4 le5 shuai1 jie2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Her heart had gone into failure from overexertion.

cues.zh: 所以心脏移植是必然操作
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xin1 zang4 yi2 zhi2 shi4 bi4 ran2 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: So a heart transplant was inevitable.

cues.zh: 但主治医生梅格的治疗方案有
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhu3 zhi4 yi1 sheng1 mei2 ge2 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4 you3
cues.en: But the attending physician, Dr. Meg, had a treatment plan that

cues.zh: 点不走寻常路
cues.pinyin: dian3 bu4 zou3 xun2 chang2 lu4
cues.en: was a bit unconventional.

cues.zh: 他认为患者的心脏虽然功能衰竭
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 huan4 zhe3 de5 xin1 zang4 sui1 ran2 gong1 neng2 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: He believed that although the patient's heart had failed functionally,

cues.zh: 但机体还是健康的
cues.pinyin: dan4 ji1 ti3 hai2 shi4 jian4 kang1 de5
cues.en: her body was otherwise still healthy.

cues.zh: 所以他想保留原来的心脏
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xiang3 bao3 liu2 yuan2 lai2 de5 xin1 zang4
cues.en: So he wanted to preserve her original heart.

cues.zh: 在不影响机能的情况下
cues.pinyin: zai4 bu4 ying3 xiang3 ji1 neng2 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: Without compromising function,

cues.zh: 将新的心脏植入胸腔
cues.pinyin: jiang1 xin1 de5 xin1 zang4 zhi2 ru4 xiong1 qiang1
cues.en: implant a new heart into the chest cavity.

cues.zh: 这就是传说中的异位式心脏移植
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 chuan2 shuo1 zhong1 de5 yi4 wei4 shi4 xin1 zang4 yi2 zhi2
cues.en: This was the legendary heterotopic heart transplant.

cues.zh: 虽然听起来很不可思议
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ting1 qi3 lai2 hen3 bu4 ke3 si1 yi4
cues.en: Although it sounded unbelievable,

cues.zh: 但却能让老夫人的寿命延长十年
cues.pinyin: dan4 que4 neng2 rang4 lao3 fu1 ren2 de5 shou4 ming4 yan2 chang2 shi2 nian2
cues.en: it could extend the old woman's life by ten years.

cues.zh: 老夫人的儿子听完手术方案后
cues.pinyin: lao3 fu1 ren2 de5 er2 zi5 ting1 wan2 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 hou4
cues.en: After hearing the surgical plan, the old woman's son

cues.zh: 有些后怕
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 hou4 pa4
cues.en: felt a bit uneasy about it.

cues.zh: 他希望采取更稳妥的方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 cai3 qu3 geng4 wen3 tuo3 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: He wanted a safer approach.

cues.zh: 但这时老夫人打断了他
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 shi2 lao3 fu1 ren2 da3 duan4 le5 ta1
cues.en: But at this moment the old woman cut him off.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】你敢相信一个人可以拥有2个心脏吗？梅医生他就做到了

cues.zh: 她相信手术会成功
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang1 xin4 shou3 shu4 hui4 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: She believed the surgery would succeed.

cues.zh: 因为梅哥是医院里外科手术的扛把子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei2 ge1 shi4 yi1 yuan4 li3 wai4 ke1 shou3 shu4 de5 kang2 ba3 zi5
cues.en: because Dr. Mei was the hospital's top surgeon.

cues.zh: 虽然是褒奖
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 shi4 bao1 jiang3
cues.en: Although it was meant as a compliment,

cues.zh: 但对于梅哥来说
cues.pinyin: dan4 dui4 yu2 mei2 ge1 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: for Dr. Mei

cues.zh: 却有些沉重
cues.pinyin: que4 you3 xie1 chen2 zhong4
cues.en: it felt like a heavy burden.

cues.zh: 因为这个手术风险很大
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 feng1 xian3 hen3 da4
cues.en: because this surgery carried huge risk.

cues.zh: 如果失误
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi1 wu4
cues.en: If anything went wrong,

cues.zh: 就会造成无法挽回的局面
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 wu2 fa3 wan3 hui2 de5 ju2 mian4
cues.en: it would lead to an irreversible outcome.

cues.zh: 他决定全力以赴
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 ding4 quan2 li4 yi3 fu4
cues.en: He decided to give it everything he had.

cues.zh: 然而这时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: However, at this point,

cues.zh: 他却听说了另外一件事
cues.pinyin: ta1 que4 ting1 shuo1 le5 ling4 wai4 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: he heard about something else.

cues.zh: 新上任的院长马库斯
cues.pinyin: xin1 shang4 ren4 de5 yuan4 zhang3 ma3 ku4 si1
cues.en: The newly appointed director, Marcus,

cues.zh: 准备在这次手术后
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 zai4 zhe4 ci4 shou3 shu4 hou4
cues.en: was planning, after this surgery,

cues.zh: 开一个记者发布会
cues.pinyin: kai1 yi2 ge4 ji4 zhe3 fa1 bu4 hui4
cues.en: to hold a press conference,

cues.zh: 想要借此
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 jie4 ci3
cues.en: hoping to use it

cues.zh: 给医院创造一些热点话题
cues.pinyin: gei3 yi1 yuan4 chuang4 zao4 yi1 xie1 re4 dian3 hua4 ti2
cues.en: to generate some buzz for the hospital.

cues.zh: 手术还没开始
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hai2 mei2 kai1 shi3
cues.en: The surgery hadn't even started yet,

cues.zh: 马库斯就制造这么大的噱头
cues.pinyin: ma3 ku4 si1 jiu4 zhi4 zao4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 xue2 tou5
cues.en: and Marcus was already hyping it up this much.

cues.zh: 这让梅根很不能接受
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 mei2 gen1 hen3 bu4 neng2 jie1 shou4
cues.en: This was hard for Megan to accept.

cues.zh: 但马库斯觉得
cues.pinyin: dan4 ma3 ku4 si1 jue2 de5
cues.en: But Marcus felt

cues.zh: 自己这么做没有什么问题
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 zhe4 me5 zuo4 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: there was nothing wrong with what he was doing.

cues.zh: 新官上任三把火嘛
cues.pinyin: xin1 guan1 shang4 ren4 san1 ba3 huo3 ma5
cues.en: A new chief always starts with a show of force,

cues.zh: 只是碰巧烧到了梅哥这儿
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 peng4 qiao3 shao1 dao4 le5 mei2 ge1 zhe4 er2
cues.en: it just happened to land on Dr. Mei this time.

cues.zh: 有什么大惊小怪的
cues.pinyin: you3 shen2 me5 da4 jing1 xiao3 guai4 de5
cues.en: What's there to make a fuss about?

cues.zh: 这场手术给梅哥的压力已经很大了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 shou3 shu4 gei3 mei2 ge1 de5 ya1 li4 yi3 jing1 hen3 da4 le5
cues.en: This surgery already put enormous pressure on Dr. Mei.

cues.zh: 马库斯居然还搞起了营销
cues.pinyin: ma3 ku4 si1 ju1 ran2 hai2 gao3 qi3 le5 ying2 xiao1
cues.en: and now Marcus was even turning it into marketing.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】你敢相信一个人可以拥有2个心脏吗？梅医生他就做到了

cues.zh: 是一种制造人造血管的材料
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 zhong3 zhi4 zao4 ren2 zao4 xue4 guan3 de5 cai2 liao4
cues.en: It's a material used to make artificial blood vessels,

cues.zh: 常被用于心脏搭桥手术
cues.pinyin: chang2 bei4 yong4 yu2 xin1 zang4 da1 qiao2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: often used in heart bypass surgery.

cues.zh: 成分安全
cues.pinyin: cheng2 fen4 an1 quan2
cues.en: Its composition is safe,

cues.zh: 与机体的相容性高
cues.pinyin: yu3 ji1 ti3 de5 xiang1 rong2 xing4 gao1
cues.en: and it's highly compatible with the body.

cues.zh: 用它来代替主动脉
cues.pinyin: yong4 ta1 lai2 dai4 ti4 zhu3 dong4 mai4
cues.en: Using it to replace the aorta

cues.zh: 虽然有些冒险
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 you3 xie1 mao4 xian3
cues.en: was somewhat risky,

cues.zh: 但不失是一种好的方法
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 shi1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hao3 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: but it was still a good method.

cues.zh: 随后他们找到了梅哥
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 ta1 men5 zhao3 dao4 le5 mei2 ge1
cues.en: Afterward they went to find Dr. Mei.

cues.zh: 此时梅哥正在被马库斯约谈
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 mei2 ge1 zheng4 zai4 bei4 ma3 ku4 si1 yue1 tan2
cues.en: At that moment, Dr. Mei was being called in by Marcus for a talk.

cues.zh: 两人对手术的事尚未达成一致
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 dui4 shou3 shu4 de5 shi4 shang4 wei4 da2 cheng2 yi2 zhi4
cues.en: The two hadn't yet reached agreement on the surgery,

cues.zh: 而梅哥也刚好说到了主动脉瘤的事
cues.pinyin: er2 mei2 ge1 ye3 gang1 hao3 shuo1 dao4 le5 zhu3 dong4 mai4 liu2 de5 shi4
cues.en: and Dr. Mei happened to be discussing the aortic aneurysm issue.

cues.zh: 摩根将手术方案告诉了梅哥
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 jiang1 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 gao4 su4 le5 mei2 ge1
cues.en: Morgan explained the surgical plan to Dr. Mei.

cues.zh: 马库斯觉得可行
cues.pinyin: ma3 ku4 si1 jue2 de5 ke3 xing2
cues.en: Marcus thought it was feasible.

cues.zh: 但梅哥反对
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 ge1 fan3 dui4
cues.en: But Dr. Mei objected,

cues.zh: 因为正有可能在缝合时破裂
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zheng4 you3 ke3 neng2 zai4 feng2 he2 shi2 po4 lie4
cues.en: because it could rupture during suturing,

cues.zh: 造成血崩
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 xue4 beng1
cues.en: causing massive bleeding.

cues.zh: 这时马库斯问方案是谁出的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ma3 ku4 si1 wen4 fang1 an4 shi4 shui2 chu1 de5
cues.en: At this point Marcus asked who had come up with the plan.

cues.zh: 克莱尔说是大家聊天的时候想到的
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 shuo1 shi4 da4 jia1 liao2 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4 xiang3 dao4 de5
cues.en: Claire said it came up while everyone was chatting.

cues.zh: 但摩根赶紧反驳道
cues.pinyin: dan4 mo2 gen1 gan3 jin3 fan3 bo2 dao4
cues.en: But Morgan quickly cut in and said,

cues.zh: 是克莱尔提出来的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ke4 lai2 er3 ti2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: "It was Claire who proposed it,

cues.zh: 跟其他人没关系
cues.pinyin: gen1 qi2 ta1 ren2 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: it has nothing to do with anyone else."

cues.zh: 克莱尔一脸尴尬
cues.pinyin: ke4 lai2 er3 yi1 lian3 gan1 ga4
cues.en: Claire looked embarrassed.

cues.zh: 摩根这个小臂齿
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 bi4 chi3
cues.en: This scheming Morgan—

cues.zh: 关键时候就知道帅哥
cues.pinyin: guan1 jian4 shi2 hou4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 shuai4 ge1
cues.en: only knows how to show off when it counts.

cues.zh: 真是没劲透了
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 mei2 jin4 tou4 le5
cues.en: Truly so lame.

cues.zh: 马库斯意味深长地看了克莱尔一眼
cues.pinyin: ma3 ku4 si1 yi4 wei4 shen1 chang2 di4 kan4 le5 ke4 lai2 er3 yi1 yan3
cues.en: Marcus gave Claire a meaningful look.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】你敢相信一个人可以拥有2个心脏吗？梅医生他就做到了

cues.zh: 手术前期很顺利
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 qian2 qi1 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: The early part of the surgery went smoothly,

cues.zh: 并变得主动脉被切除
cues.pinyin: bing4 bian4 de2 zhu3 dong4 mai4 bei4 qie1 chu2
cues.en: and the aorta was removed

cues.zh: 由人造血管代替
cues.pinyin: you2 ren2 zao4 xue4 guan3 dai4 ti4
cues.en: and replaced with the artificial blood vessel.

cues.zh: 接下来就要移植心脏了
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 jiu4 yao4 yi2 zhi2 xin1 zang1 le5
cues.en: Next came the heart transplant.

cues.zh: 但新的问题出现了
cues.pinyin: dan4 xin1 de5 wen4 ti2 chu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: But a new problem came up.

cues.zh: 患者年事已高
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 nian2 shi4 yi3 gao1
cues.en: The patient was already elderly,

cues.zh: 主动脉壁很薄
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dong4 mai4 bi4 hen3 bao2
cues.en: and her aortic wall was very thin,

cues.zh: 如同卫生纸一般
cues.pinyin: ru2 tong2 wei4 sheng1 zhi3 yi4 ban1
cues.en: like tissue paper,

cues.zh: 根本无法承受新心脏的重量
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 cheng2 shou4 xin1 xin1 zang4 de5 zhong4 liang4
cues.en: unable to bear the weight of the new heart at all.

cues.zh: 可能出现断裂的风险
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 chu1 xian4 duan4 lie4 de5 feng1 xian3
cues.en: There was a risk it could tear.

cues.zh: 于是梅哥做了一个大胆决定
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 mei2 ge1 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 da4 dan3 jue2 ding4
cues.en: So Dr. Mei made a bold decision:

cues.zh: 将整条主动脉替换
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zheng3 tiao2 zhu3 dong4 mai4 ti4 huan4
cues.en: replace the entire aorta

cues.zh: 之后再移植心脏
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 zai4 yi2 zhi2 xin1 zang4
cues.en: and then transplant the heart afterward.

cues.zh: 手术后期在有条不稳中度过
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hou4 qi1 zai4 you3 tiao2 bu4 wen3 zhong1 du4 guo4
cues.en: The later part of the surgery proceeded in an orderly fashion.

cues.zh: 心脏被放入胸腔
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 bei4 fang4 ru4 xiong1 qiang1
cues.en: The heart was placed into the chest cavity.

cues.zh: 没过多久
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Before long,

cues.zh: 两颗心脏一起跳动起来
cues.pinyin: liang3 ke1 xin1 zang4 yi4 qi3 tiao4 dong4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: the two hearts began beating together.

cues.zh: 到最终的缝合环节
cues.pinyin: dao4 zui4 zhong1 de5 feng2 he2 huan2 jie2
cues.en: At the final suturing stage,

cues.zh: 手术后期在有条不紊中度过

cues.zh: 我学会飞了而且飞得很好哦

cues.zh: 我的寿命还有多久

cues.zh: 四三二
cues.pinyin: si4 san1 er4

cues.zh: 跳水运动员

cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 you3 yi1 tian1 ta1 zhan4 zai4 tiao4 tai2 shang4
