cues.zh: 小明对计程车司机抱怨
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 dui4 ji4 cheng2 che1 si1 ji1 bao4 yuan4
cues.en: Xiaoming complained to the taxi driver

cues.zh: 搭你的车好无聊
cues.pinyin: da1 ni3 de5 che1 hao3 wu2 liao2
cues.en: "Riding in your car is so boring"

cues.zh: 都没有音乐
cues.pinyin: dou1 mei2 you3 yin1 yue4
cues.en: "There's no music at all"

cues.zh: 那我建议你搭垃圾车
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jian4 yi4 ni3 da1 la1 ji1 che1
cues.en: "Then I suggest you take the garbage truck"

cues.zh: 小的地方是哪里
cues.pinyin: xiao3 de5 di4 fang1 shi4 na3 li3
cues.en: Where is a place that can be "small"?

cues.zh: 哪有这种地方啊
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 zhe4 zhong4 di4 fang1 a5
cues.en: "Is there really such a place?"

cues.zh: 还有地方可以大可以小
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 di4 fang1 ke3 yi3 da4 ke3 yi3 xiao3
cues.en: "There's a place that can be big or small"

cues.zh: 不知道呢
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ne5
cues.en: "I don't know"

cues.zh: 是厕所
cues.pinyin: shi4 ce4 suo3
cues.en: "It's the bathroom"

cues.zh: 可以在厕所里大便或小便
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 ce4 suo3 li3 da4 bian4 huo4 xiao3 bian4
cues.en: "You can go number two or number one in the bathroom"

cues.zh: 小朋友
cues.pinyin: xiao3 peng2 you3
cues.en: "Kids"

cues.zh: 你们家里都养什么宠物啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 jia1 li3 dou1 yang3 shen2 me5 chong3 wu4 a5
cues.en: "What pets does your family keep?"

cues.zh: 我爸爸养的宠物最厉害
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba4 yang3 de5 chong3 wu4 zui4 li4 hai4
cues.en: "My dad's pet is the most amazing"

cues.zh: 你爸爸养什么宠物啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba4 ba4 yang3 shen2 me5 chong3 wu4 a5
cues.en: "What pet does your dad keep?"

cues.zh: 听我妈妈说
cues.pinyin: ting1 wo3 ma1 ma1 shuo1
cues.en: "I heard from my mom"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话40｜飞得很好了｜掰咖超人｜搭垃圾车｜不只一只｜头〝圆〞的｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我爸爸在外面养了一只狐狸精
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba4 zai4 wai4 mian4 yang3 le5 yi1 zhi1 hu2 li2 jing1
cues.en: "My dad keeps a fox spirit outside"

cues.zh: 我还没见过呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 mei2 jian4 guo4 ne5
cues.en: "I've never seen it"

cues.zh: 我还发现我爸打电话的时候总是说
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 fa1 xian4 wo3 ba4 da3 dian4 hua4 de5 shi2 hou4 zong3 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: "I also noticed that whenever my dad's on the phone, he always says"

cues.zh: 我家里有一只毛毛虎
cues.pinyin: wo3 jia1 li3 you3 yi1 zhi1 mao2 mao2 hu3
cues.en: "I have a fuzzy tiger at home"

cues.zh: 但我总是找不到
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 zong3 shi4 zhao3 bu2 dao4
cues.en: "but I can never find it"

cues.zh: 我去问爷爷
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 wen4 ye2 ye2
cues.en: "I went and asked grandpa"

cues.zh: 他只是叹了一口气说
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 tan4 le5 yi4 kou3 qi4 shuo1
cues.en: "He just sighed and said"

cues.zh: 不止一只
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi3 yi1 zhi1
cues.en: "There's more than one."

cues.zh: 问你哦
cues.pinyin: wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Let me ask you"

cues.zh: 你知道太平洋的中间是什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 tai4 ping2 yang2 de5 zhong1 jian1 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: "Do you know what's in the middle of the Pacific Ocean?"

cues.zh: 海啊
cues.pinyin: hai3 a5
cues.en: "The sea?"

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: "Right?"

cues.zh: 不对是平
cues.pinyin: bu2 dui4 shi4 ping2
cues.en: "Wrong, it's 'ping' (peaceful)"

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为太平洋三个字
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 tai4 ping2 yang2 san1 ge4 zi4
cues.en: "Because the three characters '太平洋' (Pacific) literally mean 'very peaceful ocean'"

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 30年前中国小朋友珍贵旧照，像极了当年的自己 Precious Photos of Chinese Children from 30 Years Ago, Ju

cues.zh: 19 83 年摄影集你好小朋友出版
cues.pinyin: 19 83 nian2 she4 ying3 ji2 ni3 hao3 xiao3 peng2 you3 chu1 ban3
cues.en: In 1983, the photo collection "Hello Little Friends" was published.

cues.zh: 当时国内大多数都是黑白照片
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 guo2 nei4 da4 duo1 shu4 dou1 shi4 hei1 bai2 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: At the time, most photos in China were still black and white.

cues.zh: 日本摄影师秋山亮二记录下了 80
cues.pinyin: ri4 ben3 she4 ying3 shi1 qiu1 shan1 liang4 er4 ji4 lu4 xia4 le5 80
cues.en: Japanese photographer Akiyama Ryoji captured the colorful

cues.zh: 年代中国小朋
cues.pinyin: nian2 dai4 zhong1 guo2 xiao3 peng2
cues.en: childhood of Chinese children in the

cues.zh: 友的多彩童年
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 duo1 cai3 tong2 nian2

cues.zh: 做眼保健操的喝橘子汽水的跳远的女孩子
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yan3 bao3 jian4 cao1 de5 he1 ju2 zi5 qi4 shui3 de5 tiao4 yuan3 de5 nv3 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Kids doing eye exercises, drinking orange soda, a girl long-jumping—

cues.zh: 是不是都像极
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 dou1 xiang4 ji2
cues.en: don't they all look just

cues.zh: 了当年的自己
cues.pinyin: liao3 dang4 nian2 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: like our childhood selves?

cues.zh: 这本摄影集被复刻出版又连出续片
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ben3 she4 ying3 ji2 bei4 fu4 ke4 chu1 ban3 you4 lian2 chu1 xu4 pian4
cues.en: This photo collection was reprinted and got several sequels,

cues.zh: 几乎每一次都会在国内引发一波回忆潮
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 mei3 yi1 ci4 du1 hui4 zai4 guo2 nei4 yin3 fa1 yi1 bo1 hui2 yi4 chao2
cues.en: and almost every time it sparked a wave of nostalgia in China.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 30年前中国小朋友珍贵旧照，像极了当年的自己 Precious Photos of Chinese Children from 30 Years Ago, Ju

cues.zh: 这几年
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji3 nian2
cues.en: In recent years,

cues.zh: 出版社青草堂一直在寻找这些小朋友
cues.pinyin: chu1 ban3 she4 qing1 cao3 tang2 yi4 zhi2 zai4 xun2 zhao3 zhe4 xie1 xiao3 peng2 you3
cues.en: the publisher Qingcaotang has been searching for these children.

cues.zh: 到现在为止
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: So far,

cues.zh: 已经有 11 位小朋友被找到
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 you3 11 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 bei4 zhao3 dao4
cues.en: 11 of them have been found.

cues.zh: 其中这位在王府井补衣铺门前
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 zhe4 wei4 zai4 wang2 fu3 jing3 bu3 yi1 pu4 men2 qian2
cues.en: One of them is the girl in red standing in front of

cues.zh: 的红衣小女孩
cues.pinyin: de5 hong2 yi1 xiao3 nv3 hai2
cues.en: a clothing repair shop in Wangfujing.

cues.zh: 2019 年看到一条报道秋山亮二的视频后
cues.pinyin: 2019 nian2 kan4 dao4 yi1 tiao2 bao4 dao4 qiu1 shan1 liang4 er4 de5 shi4 pin2 hou4
cues.en: After seeing a report about Akiyama Ryoji's video in 2019,

cues.zh: 专程去日本拜访了他
cues.pinyin: zhuan1 cheng2 qu4 ri4 ben3 bai4 fang3 le5 ta1
cues.en: she traveled to Japan specially to visit him.

cues.zh: 她对秋山亮 2 说
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 qiu1 shan1 liang4 2 shuo1
cues.en: She told Akiyama Ryoji

cues.zh: 那是她童年的唯一一张彩色照片
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 ta1 tong2 nian2 de5 wei2 yi1 yi1 zhang1 cai3 se4 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: that it was the only color photo from her childhood.

cues.zh: 而无论他之后搬过多少次家
cues.pinyin: er2 wu2 lun4 ta1 zhi1 hou4 ban1 guo4 duo1 shao3 ci4 jia1
cues.en: And no matter how many times he moved afterward,

cues.zh: 这本影集他都永远放在餐桌边上
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ben3 ying3 ji2 ta1 dou1 yong3 yuan3 fang4 zai4 can1 zhuo1 bian1 shang4
cues.en: he always kept this photo collection by his dining table,

cues.zh: 随手翻看
cues.pinyin: sui2 shou3 fan1 kan4
cues.en: flipping through it from time to time.

cues.zh: 从去年的 6 月 1 日起
cues.pinyin: cong2 qu4 nian2 de5 6 yue4 1 ri4 qi3
cues.en: Starting from June 1st last year,

cues.zh: 青草堂就开始筹备
cues.pinyin: qing1 cao3 tang2 jiu4 kai1 shi3 chou2 bei4
cues.en: Qingcaotang began preparing

cues.zh: 将最具代表性的五张照片
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zui4 ju4 dai4 biao3 xing4 de5 wu3 zhang1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: to turn the five most representative photos

cues.zh: 还原成一个个小雕塑
cues.pinyin: huan2 yuan2 cheng2 yi2 ge4 ge4 xiao3 diao1 su4
cues.en: into small sculptures.

cues.zh: 这是由国内顶尖雕塑工作室
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 you2 guo2 nei4 ding3 jian1 diao1 su4 gong1 zuo4 shi4
cues.en: This was designed and made by a top domestic

cues.zh: 回向工作室设计制作的
cues.pinyin: hui2 xiang4 gong1 zuo4 shi4 she4 ji4 zhi4 zuo4 de5
cues.en: sculpture studio, Huixiang Studio.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 30年前中国小朋友珍贵旧照，像极了当年的自己 Precious Photos of Chinese Children from 30 Years Ago, Ju

cues.zh: 从平面到立体的过程并不简单
cues.pinyin: cong2 ping2 mian4 dao4 li4 ti3 de5 guo4 cheng2 bing4 bu4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: Going from flat photos to 3D sculptures wasn't simple.

cues.zh: 有些照片只拍了上半身
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 zhao4 pian1 zhi3 pai1 le5 shang4 ban4 shen1
cues.en: Some photos only showed the upper body,

cues.zh: 设计师既要发挥想象力
cues.pinyin: she4 ji4 shi1 ji4 yao4 fa1 hui1 xiang3 xiang4 li4
cues.en: so the designers had to use their imagination

cues.zh: 又要符合年代感地
cues.pinyin: you4 yao4 fu2 he2 nian2 dai4 gan3 di4
cues.en: while staying true to the era

cues.zh: 还原整个身体的姿态
cues.pinyin: huan2 yuan2 zheng3 ge4 shen1 ti3 de5 zi1 tai4
cues.en: to recreate the pose of the whole body.

cues.zh: 今年的六月儿童节
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 de5 liu4 yue4 er2 tong2 jie2
cues.en: This June, on Children's Day,

cues.zh: 五个雕塑被手工木框装表
cues.pinyin: wu3 ge4 diao1 su4 bei4 shou3 gong1 mu4 kuang1 zhuang1 biao3
cues.en: the five sculptures were framed in handcrafted wooden frames,

cues.zh: 配以摄影作品
cues.pinyin: pei4 yi3 she4 ying3 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: displayed together with the photographs

cues.zh: 还有秋山先生的签名
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 qiu1 shan1 xian1 sheng1 de5 qian1 ming2
cues.en: and Mr. Akiyama's signature.

cues.zh: 在一条独家首发
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi1 tiao2 du2 jia1 shou3 fa1
cues.en: Exclusively premiered on Yit,

cues.zh: 将作为一份送给
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zuo4 wei2 yi1 fen4 song4 gei3
cues.en: it will serve as a gift

cues.zh: 中国 80 90 后的专属礼物
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 80 90 hou4 de5 zhuan1 shu3 li3 wu4
cues.en: made especially for China's post-80s and post-90s generations.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一条创始人徐沪生：家是我的宇宙中心，也是我的私人小艺术馆

cues.zh: 我们一条拍视频也拍了十年了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi1 tiao2 pai1 shi4 pin2 ye3 pai1 le5 shi2 nian2 le5
cues.en: We at Yitiao have been making videos for ten years now.

cues.zh: 每天一条视频拍了四五千条
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 yi1 tiao2 shi4 pin2 pai1 le5 si4 wu3 qian1 tiao2
cues.en: We put out one video a day — over the years we've made four or five thousand.

cues.zh: 今天有一个趋势很明显的
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 you3 yi2 ge4 qu1 shi4 hen3 ming2 xian3 de5
cues.en: Today there's a very clear trend.

cues.zh: 艺术家的家艺术收藏家的家就特别受欢迎
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 jia1 de5 jia1 yi4 shu4 shou1 cang2 jia1 de5 jia1 jiu4 te4 bie2 shou4 huan1 ying2
cues.en: Homes of artists and art collectors are especially popular.

cues.zh: 这些家里面有艺术品
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jia1 li3 mian4 you3 yi4 shu4 pin3
cues.en: These homes have artworks in them.

cues.zh: 有非常多的好看的家具
cues.pinyin: you3 fei1 chang2 duo1 de5 hao3 kan4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: And a lot of beautiful furniture.

cues.zh: 这些家就更像一个小型的私人的美术馆
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jia1 jiu4 geng4 xiang4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 xing2 de5 si1 ren2 de5 mei3 shu4 guan3
cues.en: These homes feel more like small private art museums.

cues.zh: 我这个房子因为其实是个老房
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 yin1 wei4 qi2 shi2 shi4 ge4 lao3 fang2
cues.en: This house of mine is actually an old building,

cues.zh: 子单价也不贵
cues.pinyin: zi5 dan1 jia4 ye3 bu4 gui4
cues.en: and the price per square meter wasn't expensive either.

cues.zh: 它有三百零米
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 san1 bai3 ling2 mi3
cues.en: It's a bit over three hundred square meters.

cues.zh: 我当时是在找那种带院子或者
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 shi4 zai4 zhao3 na4 zhong3 dai4 yuan4 zi5 huo4 zhe3
cues.en: At the time I was looking for a place with a courtyard, or

cues.zh: 带露台的房子
cues.pinyin: dai4 lu4 tai2 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: one with a terrace.

cues.zh: 所以看到这个房子的第一反应
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 kan4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 de5 di4 yi1 fan3 ying4
cues.en: So my first reaction on seeing this house was —

cues.zh: 其实是我可以隔出几十平米来做院子
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 wo3 ke3 yi3 ge2 chu1 ji3 shi2 ping2 mi3 lai2 zuo4 yuan4 zi5
cues.en: that I could actually carve out tens of square meters to make a courtyard.

cues.zh: 除了大的空间设计方案之外
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 da4 de5 kong1 jian1 she4 ji4 fang1 an4 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: Besides the overall spatial design plan,

cues.zh: 最重要的就是选家具
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 jiu4 shi4 xuan3 jia1 ju4
cues.en: the most important thing was choosing the furniture.

cues.zh: 当下有一些打破常规形态的家具
cues.pinyin: dang1 xia4 you3 yi1 xie1 da3 po4 chang2 gui1 xing2 tai4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: Nowadays there's furniture that breaks conventional forms.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一条创始人徐沪生：家是我的宇宙中心，也是我的私人小艺术馆

cues.zh: 它们本身就是一件具备实用功能的艺术品
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 jian4 ju4 bei4 shi2 yong4 gong1 neng2 de5 yi4 shu4 pin3
cues.en: They're themselves functional artworks.

cues.zh: 后来我就选了很多大牌的家具
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 jiu4 xuan3 le5 hen3 duo1 da4 pai2 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: Later on I chose a lot of brand-name furniture.

cues.zh: 它的艺术属性特别高
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yi4 shu4 shu3 xing4 te4 bie2 gao1
cues.en: Its artistic quality is especially high.

cues.zh: 甚至雕塑感都很强
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 diao1 su4 gan3 dou1 hen3 qiang2
cues.en: Even its sculptural quality is strong.

cues.zh: 它不是那种很标准化的造型
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 shi4 na4 zhong3 hen3 biao1 zhun3 hua4 de5 zao4 xing2
cues.en: It's not that standardized kind of shape.

cues.zh: 就是说这些家具很独立
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zhe4 xie1 jia1 ju4 hen3 du2 li4
cues.en: These pieces of furniture are very distinctive.

cues.zh: 我在意的不仅仅是它的实用功能
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 yi4 de5 bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 ta1 de5 shi2 yong4 gong1 neng2
cues.en: What I care about isn't just its practical function.

cues.zh: 我在家里待的时间
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 jia1 li3 dai4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: The amount of time I spend at home

cues.zh: 大概比 90 甚至 95 的创业者可能还要多
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 bi3 90 shen4 zhi4 95 de5 chuang4 ye4 zhe3 ke3 neng2 hai2 yao4 duo1
cues.en: is probably more than even most post-90s or post-95s entrepreneurs.

cues.zh: 因为我几乎是零应酬的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 ji1 hu1 shi4 ling2 ying4 chou2 de5
cues.en: Because I have almost zero social obligations.

cues.zh: 一个月大概是有 28 天是在家里吃晚饭的
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 da4 gai4 shi4 you3 28 tian1 shi4 zai4 jia1 li3 chi1 wan3 fan4 de5
cues.en: In a month I probably eat dinner at home about 28 days.

cues.zh: 我爸在的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba4 zai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When my dad was still alive,

cues.zh: 我几乎每天要回家陪他吃晚饭
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji1 hu1 mei3 tian1 yao4 hui2 jia1 pei2 ta1 chi1 wan3 fan4
cues.en: I went home almost every day to have dinner with him.

cues.zh: 喝个两三杯的小白酒也不多
cues.pinyin: he1 ge4 liang3 san1 bei1 de5 xiao3 bai2 jiu3 ye3 bu4 duo1
cues.en: Having two or three cups of baijiu isn't much.

cues.zh: 所以这个事情就对我来讲
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 shi4 qing2 jiu4 dui4 wo3 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: So for me, this

cues.zh: 是一天当中非常非常重要的一个事情
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 tian1 dang1 zhong1 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 zhong4 yao4 de5 yi2 ge4 shi4 qing2
cues.en: is one of the most important things in a day.

cues.zh: 像我们这样的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 men5 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: For families like ours —

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一条创始人徐沪生：家是我的宇宙中心，也是我的私人小艺术馆

cues.zh: 就是中国传统家庭来讲
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 chuan2 tong3 jia1 ting2 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: traditional Chinese families, that is —

cues.zh: 家庭成员之间的语言交流是不多的
cues.pinyin: jia1 ting2 cheng2 yuan2 zhi1 jian1 de5 yu3 yan2 jiao1 liu2 shi4 bu4 duo1 de5
cues.en: there isn't much verbal communication between family members.

cues.zh: 像是餐桌大概是一天里面最重要的
cues.pinyin: xiang4 shi4 can1 zhuo1 da4 gai4 shi4 yi1 tian1 li3 mian4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5
cues.en: The dining table is probably the most important place in the day,

cues.zh: 大家能够坐下来吃吃饭聊聊天的地方
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 neng2 gou4 zuo4 xia4 lai2 chi1 chi1 fan4 liao2 liao2 tian1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: where everyone can sit down, eat, and chat.

cues.zh: 但是餐桌也不算特别大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 can1 zhuo1 ye3 bu4 suan4 te4 bie2 da4
cues.en: But the dining table isn't especially big either.

cues.zh: 能够跟餐椅之间是很紧凑的
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 gen1 can1 yi3 zhi1 jian1 shi4 hen3 jin3 cou4 de5
cues.en: It's very compact between the table and the chairs.

cues.zh: 餐椅也是让人坐得非常非常的舒服
cues.pinyin: can1 yi3 ye3 shi4 rang4 ren2 zuo4 de2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 shu1 fu2
cues.en: The chairs also let people sit very comfortably.

cues.zh: 就是一家人要在餐桌上面坐得舒服
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi1 jia1 ren2 yao4 zai4 can1 zhuo1 shang4 mian4 zuo4 de2 shu1 fu2
cues.en: It's about the whole family sitting comfortably at the table,

cues.zh: 坐得久
cues.pinyin: zuo4 de2 jiu3
cues.en: sitting for a long time,

cues.zh: 而且靠得近
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 kao4 de2 jin4
cues.en: and sitting close together.

cues.zh: 我就像外国人那样给大家坐得很开
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xiang4 wai4 guo2 ren2 na4 yang4 gei3 da4 jia1 zuo4 de2 hen3 kai1
cues.en: Not like foreigners, who spread everyone out far apart.

cues.zh: 我觉得这个不是中国家庭的方式
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 bu2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 jia1 ting2 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: I don't think that's the Chinese family way.

cues.zh: 刚进来的时候
cues.pinyin: gang1 jin4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I first walked in,

cues.zh: 我以为我会在院子里待很长时间
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi3 wei2 wo3 hui4 zai4 yuan4 zi5 li3 dai4 hen3 zhang3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: I thought I'd spend a lot of time in the courtyard.

cues.zh: 最后发现不是的
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 fa1 xian4 bu2 shi4 de5
cues.en: In the end it turned out not to be the case.

cues.zh: 就是沙发才是我的舒适区
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 sha1 fa1 cai2 shi4 wo3 de5 shu1 shi4 qu1
cues.en: The sofa is actually my comfort zone.

cues.zh: 因为我每年大概看电影跟剧集
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 mei3 nian2 da4 gai4 kan4 dian4 ying3 gen1 ju4 ji2
cues.en: Because every year I watch

cues.zh: 看了一百部以上
cues.pinyin: kan4 le5 yi4 bai3 bu4 yi3 shang4
cues.en: over a hundred movies and shows.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一条创始人徐沪生：家是我的宇宙中心，也是我的私人小艺术馆

cues.zh: 躺在沙发上看那些艺术大师的电影
cues.pinyin: tang3 zai4 sha1 fa1 shang4 kan4 na4 xie1 yi4 shu4 da4 shi1 de5 dian4 ying3
cues.en: Lying on the sofa watching films by great masters,

cues.zh: 我觉得这是我人生大概最大的享受之一
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 zhe4 shi4 wo3 ren2 sheng1 da4 gai4 zui4 da4 de5 xiang3 shou4 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: I think that's one of the biggest pleasures of my life.

cues.zh: 我看了就是中外的家
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 le5 jiu4 shi4 zhong1 wai4 de5 jia1
cues.en: I've seen quite a few homes, Chinese and foreign,

cues.zh: 案例也算是非常非常的多了
cues.pinyin: an4 li4 ye3 suan4 shi4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 duo1 le5
cues.en: the cases are really quite numerous.

cues.zh: 最直观的最外在的一个区别就是
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhi2 guan1 de5 zui4 wai4 zai4 de5 yi2 ge4 qu1 bie2 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: The most direct, most outward difference is —

cues.zh: 外国人哪怕是一个中学老师
cues.pinyin: wai4 guo2 ren2 na3 pa4 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1
cues.en: even a foreigner who's just a middle school teacher,

cues.zh: 一般来讲他家里都会挂个十几张画
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 lai2 jiang3 ta1 jia1 li3 du1 hui4 gua4 ge4 shi2 ji3 zhang1 hua4
cues.en: generally has a dozen or so paintings hanging at home.

cues.zh: 有几件或者十几十来件
cues.pinyin: you3 ji3 jian4 huo4 zhe3 shi2 ji3 shi2 lai2 jian4
cues.en: and has a few, or a dozen or so, pieces

cues.zh: 独特的很好看的家具
cues.pinyin: du2 te4 de5 hen3 hao3 kan4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: of distinctive, good-looking furniture,

cues.zh: 蛮个性的家具
cues.pinyin: man2 ge4 xing4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: furniture with a lot of personality,

cues.zh: 而不是空空荡荡
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 kong1 kong1 dang4 dang4
cues.en: rather than an empty, bare space,

cues.zh: 或者只有一些蛮标准化的家具
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 zhi3 you3 yi1 xie1 man2 biao1 zhun3 hua4 de5 jia1 ju4
cues.en: or just some very standardized furniture.

cues.zh: 不一定说我要花很多的钱
cues.pinyin: bu4 yi2 ding4 shuo1 wo3 yao4 hua1 hen3 duo1 de5 qian2
cues.en: It doesn't necessarily mean spending a lot of money.

cues.zh: 我们就曾经报导过一个日本的工薪阶层
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ceng2 jing1 bao4 dao3 guo4 yi2 ge4 ri4 ben3 de5 gong1 xin1 jie1 ceng2
cues.en: We once did a story about a Japanese salaried worker

cues.zh: 它就是用工资做收藏
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi4 yong4 gong1 zi1 zuo4 shou1 cang2
cues.en: who built a collection with his salary.

cues.zh: 最后成了一个收藏大奖
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 shou1 cang2 da4 jiang3
cues.en: In the end it became an award-winning collection,

cues.zh: 非常有影响力
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 you3 ying3 xiang3 li4
cues.en: very influential.

cues.zh: 我觉得在未来
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 zai4 wei4 lai2
cues.en: I think in the future,

cues.zh: 家的艺术含量会越来越高
cues.pinyin: jia1 de5 yi4 shu4 han2 liang4 hui4 yue4 lai2 yue4 gao1
cues.en: the artistic content of homes will only keep increasing.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁鸡翅膀做法～祝福母亲节快乐！【家乐鲜露 & 美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 你好各位爱做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 ai4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone who loves to cook

cues.zh: 非常荣幸地又跟大家见面了我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 di4 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: I'm very honored to meet with you all again, I'm Cissy

cues.zh: 母亲节马上就要到了
cues.pinyin: mu3 qin1 jie2 ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 dao4 le5
cues.en: Mother's Day is coming soon

cues.zh: 在这里我祝大家母亲节快乐
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 zhu4 da4 jia1 mu3 qin1 jie2 kuai4 le4
cues.en: Here I wish everyone a Happy Mother's Day

cues.zh: 为了庆祝这特别的日子
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 qing4 zhu4 zhe4 te4 bie2 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: To celebrate this special day

cues.zh: 今天我跟家乐鲜露合作
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 gen1 jia1 le4 xian1 lu4 he2 zuo4
cues.en: Today I'm collaborating with Knorr Liquid Seasoning

cues.zh: 它让所有的美食更美味更好吃
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 suo3 you3 de5 mei3 shi2 geng4 mei3 wei4 geng4 hao3 chi1
cues.en: It makes all dishes more delicious

cues.zh: 那今天给大家带来的是这个很好吃很美
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 gei3 da4 jia1 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 zhe4 ge5 hen3 hao3 chi1 hen3 mei3
cues.en: So today I'm bringing you this very tasty and

cues.zh: 味的蜜汁鸡翅
cues.pinyin: wei4 de5 mi4 zhi1 ji1 chi4
cues.en: delicious honey glazed chicken wings

cues.zh: 今天的食谱我们只会需要鸡翅中间的部分
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 shi2 pu3 wo3 men5 zhi3 hui4 xu1 yao4 ji1 chi4 zhong1 jian1 de5 bu4 fen4
cues.en: For today's recipe we'll only need the middle part of the chicken wings

cues.zh: 其他的部分我们可以留着
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 bu4 fen4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 liu2 zhe5
cues.en: We can save the other parts

cues.zh: 下次再做其他的菜肴
cues.pinyin: xia4 ci4 zai4 zuo4 qi2 ta1 de5 cai4 yao2
cues.en: To make other dishes next time

cues.zh: 在鸡翅上面撒上盐
cues.pinyin: zai4 ji1 chi4 shang4 mian4 sa1 shang4 yan2
cues.en: Sprinkle salt on the chicken wings

cues.zh: 还有黑胡椒
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 hei1 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: And black pepper too

cues.zh: 那你可能在想
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 ke3 neng2 zai4 xiang3
cues.en: You might be wondering

cues.zh: 母亲节为什么要做蜜汁鸡翅呢
cues.pinyin: mu3 qin1 jie2 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 zuo4 mi4 zhi1 ji1 chi4 ne5
cues.en: Why make honey chicken wings for Mother's Day

cues.zh: 其实有两个原因
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 you3 liang3 ge4 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Actually there are two reasons

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁鸡翅膀做法～祝福母亲节快乐！【家乐鲜露 & 美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 在一个碗里我们来做我们的酱汁
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 wo3 men5 de5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: In a bowl, let's make our sauce

cues.zh: 我们放入家乐鲜露
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 jia1 le4 xian1 lu4
cues.en: We add Knorr Liquid Seasoning

cues.zh: 家乐鲜露会给我们的食物带出鲜味
cues.pinyin: jia1 le4 xian1 lu4 hui4 gei3 wo3 men5 de5 shi2 wu4 dai4 chu1 xian1 wei4
cues.en: Knorr Liquid Seasoning brings out the umami flavor of our food

cues.zh: 它是厨房中的完美伴侣
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 chu2 fang2 zhong1 de5 wan2 mei3 ban4 lv3
cues.en: It's the perfect companion in the kitchen

cues.zh: 你可以用它来烹饪腌制调味
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 yong4 ta1 lai2 peng1 ren4 yan1 zhi4 tiao2 wei4
cues.en: You can use it for cooking, marinating, and seasoning

cues.zh: 也可以拿来做蘸酱
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 na2 lai2 zuo4 zhan4 jiang4
cues.en: You can also use it to make dipping sauce

cues.zh: 它会马上成为你最喜欢的调味料
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ma3 shang4 cheng2 wei2 ni3 zui4 xi3 huan1 de5 tiao2 wei4 liao4
cues.en: It will instantly become your favorite seasoning

cues.zh: 再加入米醋
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 ru4 mi3 cu4
cues.en: Then add rice vinegar

cues.zh: 米酒
cues.pinyin: mi3 jiu3
cues.en: Rice wine

cues.zh: 蜂蜜
cues.pinyin: feng1 mi4
cues.en: Honey

cues.zh: 大蒜
cues.pinyin: da4 suan4
cues.en: Garlic

cues.zh: 还有姜
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiang1
cues.en: And ginger

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁鸡翅膀做法～祝福母亲节快乐！【家乐鲜露 & 美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 在一个平底锅中使用大火
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 ping2 di3 guo1 zhong1 shi3 yong4 da4 huo3
cues.en: In a pan, using high heat

cues.zh: 我们放入清淡橄榄油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 qing1 dan4 gan3 lan3 you2
cues.en: We add light olive oil

cues.zh: 再放入我们的鸡翅
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 ru4 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 chi4
cues.en: Then add our chicken wings

cues.zh: 每一面呢都给它煎到金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 mian4 ne5 dou1 gei3 ta1 jian1 dao4 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Fry each side until golden brown

cues.zh: 每一面需要大概两分钟
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 mian4 xu1 yao4 da4 gai4 liang3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Each side takes about two minutes

cues.zh: 今天这个食谱的好处呢
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3 de5 hao3 chu4 ne5
cues.en: The great thing about today's recipe is

cues.zh: 就是其实你可以用任何蛋白质来代替
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 qi2 shi2 ni3 ke3 yi3 yong4 ren4 he2 dan4 bai2 zhi4 lai2 dai4 ti4
cues.en: that you can actually substitute any protein

cues.zh: 看你自己喜欢吃什么
cues.pinyin: kan4 ni3 zi4 ji3 xi3 huan1 chi1 shen2 me5
cues.en: depending on what you like to eat

cues.zh: 牛肉猪肉虾海鲜
cues.pinyin: niu2 rou4 zhu1 rou4 xia1 hai3 xian1
cues.en: beef, pork, shrimp, seafood

cues.zh: 甚至豆腐也可以
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 dou4 fu3 ye3 ke3 yi3
cues.en: even tofu works too

cues.zh: 那另外一个原因呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 yuan2 yin1 ne5
cues.en: Now the other reason is

cues.zh: 就是我的两个女儿也都很爱吃甜食
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 de5 liang3 ge4 nv3 er2 ye3 dou1 hen3 ai4 chi1 tian2 shi2
cues.en: that my two daughters both love sweets

cues.zh: 嗯没错就跟我一样
cues.pinyin: n2 mei2 cuo4 jiu4 gen1 wo3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: yeah, just like me

cues.zh: 我每一次煮蜜汁鸡翅的时候呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 yi1 ci4 zhu3 mi4 zhi1 ji1 chi4 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: Every time I make honey chicken wings

cues.zh: 他们都非常的高兴
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 fei1 chang2 de5 gao1 xing4
cues.en: they get so happy

cues.zh: 现在我们放入酱汁
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Now we add the sauce

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 蜜汁鸡翅膀做法～祝福母亲节快乐！【家乐鲜露 & 美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 盖上盖子
cues.pinyin: gai4 shang4 gai4 zi5

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 前一段时间我去理发店理发的时候
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 wo3 qu4 li3 fa4 dian4 li3 fa4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: A while back when I went to a barbershop for a haircut,

cues.zh: 被理发师用剪刀剪到了耳朵
cues.pinyin: bei4 li3 fa4 shi1 yong4 jian3 dao1 jian3 dao4 le5 er3 duo3
cues.en: I got cut on the ear by the barber's scissors.

cues.zh: 剪下了一条 2 厘米长的肉
cues.pinyin: jian3 xia4 le5 yi1 tiao2 2 li2 mi3 zhang3 de5 rou4
cues.en: A 2-centimeter piece of flesh was cut off.

cues.zh: 去医院里缝了 4 针
cues.pinyin: qu4 yi1 yuan4 li3 feng4 le5 4 zhen1
cues.en: I went to the hospital and got 4 stitches.

cues.zh: 店家承担了医疗费然后拒绝做出其他赔偿
cues.pinyin: dian4 jia1 cheng2 dan1 le5 yi1 liao2 fei4 ran2 hou4 ju4 jue2 zuo4 chu1 qi2 ta1 pei2 chang2
cues.en: The shop covered the medical costs but refused any further compensation.

cues.zh: 跟我说让我去法院告他们
cues.pinyin: gen1 wo3 shuo1 rang4 wo3 qu4 fa3 yuan4 gao4 ta1 men5
cues.en: They told me to go sue them in court.

cues.zh: 真是让人非常的生气
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 rang4 ren2 fei1 chang2 de5 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: It was really infuriating.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Some kids asked me,

cues.zh: 这么倒霉的事你为什么摊上了呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 dao3 mei2 de5 shi4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 tan1 shang4 le5 ne5
cues.en: "Why did such bad luck happen to you?"

cues.zh: 这是一个小概率事件
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gai4 lv4 shi4 jian4
cues.en: This is a low-probability event.

cues.zh: 小概率的倒霉事也会摊上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gai4 lv4 de5 dao3 mei2 shi4 ye3 hui4 tan1 shang4
cues.en: Even low-probability bad luck can happen to you.

cues.zh: 这实际上是叫做墨菲定律
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 jiao4 zuo4 mo4 fei1 ding4 lv4
cues.en: This is actually what's called Murphy's Law.

cues.zh: 今天就想给大家介绍一下什么是摩菲定律
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 xiang3 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 shen2 me5 shi4 mo2 fei1 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Today I want to introduce what Murphy's Law is.

cues.zh: 墨菲定律是由一个美国人墨菲提出的
cues.pinyin: mo4 fei1 ding4 lv4 shi4 you2 yi2 ge4 mei3 guo2 ren2 mo4 fei1 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: Murphy's Law was proposed by an American named Murphy.

cues.zh: 这个定律是怎么提出的呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ding4 lv4 shi4 zen3 me5 ti2 chu1 de5 ne5
cues.en: How was this law proposed?

cues.zh: 它的故事背景是这样的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gu4 shi4 bei4 jing3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: Here's the background story.

cues.zh: 在 19 49 年的时候美国的空军做一个实验
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 49 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 mei3 guo2 de5 kong1 jun1 zuo4 yi2 ge4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: In 1949, the US Air Force conducted an experiment.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 因为当时要研究这个飞行器研究飞机
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dang1 shi2 yao4 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 fei1 xing2 qi4 yan2 jiu1 fei1 ji1
cues.en: Because at the time they needed to study aircraft,

cues.zh: 研究这个宇宙飞船
cues.pinyin: yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 yu3 zhou4 fei1 chuan2
cues.en: and study spacecraft.

cues.zh: 那么就要研究人到底能承受多大的加速度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jiu4 yao4 yan2 jiu1 ren2 dao4 di3 neng2 cheng2 shou4 duo1 da4 de5 jia1 su4 du4
cues.en: They needed to find out how much acceleration a person could withstand.

cues.zh: 所以他们就做了这样的一个装置
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 jiu4 zuo4 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 zhuang1 zhi4
cues.en: So they built a device like this.

cues.zh: 这是一个轨道
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 gui3 dao4
cues.en: This is a track.

cues.zh: 然后有一辆小车这个小车在轨道上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you3 yi1 liang4 xiao3 che1 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 che1 zai4 gui3 dao4 shang4
cues.en: There's a cart on the track.

cues.zh: 这个小车可以以很大的加速度往前冲
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 che1 ke3 yi3 yi3 hen3 da4 de5 jia1 su4 du4 wang3 qian2 chong1
cues.en: This cart could accelerate forward very rapidly.

cues.zh: 再以很大的加速度停止
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi3 hen3 da4 de5 jia1 su4 du4 ting2 zhi3
cues.en: And then stop with very high deceleration.

cues.zh: 把人绑在这个车上
cues.pinyin: ba3 ren2 bang3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 che1 shang4
cues.en: They strapped a person onto this cart.

cues.zh: 然后就看这个人能不能承受得住
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 kan4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 neng2 bu4 neng2 cheng2 shou4 de2 zhu4
cues.en: Then they'd see if the person could withstand it.

cues.zh: 大家还记得吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hai2 ji4 de5 ma5
cues.en: Do you all remember?

cues.zh: 咱们在以前的一个节目
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 zai4 yi3 qian2 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 mu4
cues.en: In one of our earlier episodes,

cues.zh: 千万不要高空跳水里谈到过这个实验
cues.pinyin: qian1 wan4 bu2 yao4 gao1 kong1 tiao4 shui3 li3 tan2 dao4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4
cues.en: we talked about this experiment in "Never Dive from Great Heights."

cues.zh: 这个被绑在椅子上的人叫什么
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bei4 bang3 zai4 yi3 zi5 shang4 de5 ren2 jiao4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What was the name of the person strapped to the chair?

cues.zh: 叫保罗斯塔普
cues.pinyin: jiao4 bao3 luo2 si1 ta3 pu3
cues.en: He was called Paul Stapp.

cues.zh: 就是这个项目的主导者就是他
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 xiang4 mu4 di4 zhu3 dao3 zhe3 jiu4 shi4 ta1
cues.en: He was the one leading this project.

cues.zh: 那么你为了测量这个加速度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 wei4 le5 ce4 liang2 zhe4 ge5 jia1 su4 du4
cues.en: To measure this acceleration,

cues.zh: 你就需要一个装置就叫加速度计
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 xu1 yao4 yi2 ge4 zhuang1 zhi4 jiu4 jiao4 jia1 su4 du4 ji4
cues.en: you need a device called an accelerometer.

cues.zh: 就是用来测量这个车到底有多大的加速度
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yong4 lai2 ce4 liang2 zhe4 ge5 che1 dao4 di3 you3 duo1 da4 de5 jia1 su4 du4
cues.en: It's used to measure exactly how much acceleration the cart has.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 无论发生的可能性有多小
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 fa1 sheng1 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4 you3 duo1 xiao3
cues.en: No matter how small the probability of it happening,

cues.zh: 那么哪怕这是一个小概率的坏事
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 na3 pa4 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gai4 lv4 de5 huai4 shi4
cues.en: even if it's a low-probability bad event,

cues.zh: 也怎么样也一定会发生
cues.pinyin: ye3 zen3 me5 yang4 ye3 yi2 ding4 hui4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: it will definitely happen anyway.

cues.zh: 也一定会发生
cues.pinyin: ye3 yi2 ding4 hui4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: It will definitely happen.

cues.zh: 简单来讲就是如果一件事可能出错
cues.pinyin: jian3 dan1 lai2 jiang3 jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 yi1 jian4 shi4 ke3 neng2 chu1 cuo4
cues.en: Simply put, if something can go wrong,

cues.zh: 就一定会出错
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi2 ding4 hui4 chu1 cuo4
cues.en: it definitely will.

cues.zh: 这件事就被称为墨菲定律
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jian4 shi4 jiu4 bei4 cheng1 wei2 mo4 fei1 ding4 lv4
cues.en: This is called Murphy's Law.

cues.zh: 经过几十年的时间
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 ji3 shi2 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: After several decades,

cues.zh: 人们每次遇到倒霉事都会想到墨菲
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 mei3 ci4 yu4 dao4 dao3 mei2 shi4 du1 hui4 xiang3 dao4 mo4 fei1
cues.en: whenever people run into bad luck, they think of Murphy.

cues.zh: 所以墨菲定律这个名字就越传越响
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mo4 fei1 ding4 lv4 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4 jiu4 yue4 chuan2 yue4 xiang3
cues.en: So the name Murphy's Law became more and more well-known.

cues.zh: 我们来举几个例子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 ju3 ji3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let's look at a few examples.

cues.zh: 最典型的一个例子就是我们都熟知的
cues.pinyin: zui4 dian3 xing2 de5 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 dou1 shu2 zhi1 de5
cues.en: The most classic example is one we're all familiar with.

cues.zh: 叫黄油面包黄油面包
cues.pinyin: jiao4 huang2 you2 mian4 bao1 huang2 you2 mian4 bao1
cues.en: It's called "buttered bread."

cues.zh: 什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does it mean?

cues.zh: 假如说这个面包掉到地上了
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 mian4 bao1 diao4 dao4 di4 shang4 le5
cues.en: Suppose this bread falls on the floor.

cues.zh: 那么两面都有可能会着地
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 liang3 mian4 dou1 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 zhe5 di4
cues.en: Either side could land facing down.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 但是一年也不出事故
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 nian2 ye3 bu4 chu1 shi4 gu4
cues.en: But for a year nothing goes wrong,

cues.zh: 两年也不出事故
cues.pinyin: liang3 nian2 ye3 bu4 chu1 shi4 gu4
cues.en: for two years nothing goes wrong,

cues.zh: 三年也不出事故
cues.pinyin: san1 nian2 ye3 bu4 chu1 shi4 gu4
cues.en: for three years nothing goes wrong,

cues.zh: 到第四年我们说不买了
cues.pinyin: dao4 di4 si4 nian2 wo3 men5 shuo1 bu4 mai3 le5
cues.en: In the fourth year we say, "let's not buy butter anymore."

cues.zh: 结果第四年就出事故对吧
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 di4 si4 nian2 jiu4 chu1 shi4 gu4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: And then in the fourth year, it happens, right?

cues.zh: 再比如说下雨洗车
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 xia4 yu3 xi3 che1
cues.en: Another example: washing your car and it rains.

cues.zh: 我们平时不洗车它也不下雨
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ping2 shi2 bu4 xi3 che1 ta1 ye3 bu4 xia4 yu3
cues.en: Normally when we don't wash the car, it doesn't rain.

cues.zh: 只要我们一洗车它就下雨
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 wo3 men5 yi1 xi3 che1 ta1 jiu4 xia4 yu3
cues.en: But as soon as we wash the car, it rains.

cues.zh: 这也是一个小概率事件对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gai4 lv4 shi4 jian4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: This is also a low-probability event, right?

cues.zh: 但是它就总发生
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 jiu4 zong3 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: But it keeps happening.

cues.zh: 再比如说我们再举个例子
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 zai4 ju3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let's give another example.

cues.zh: 就是上大学的时候我们都逃过课对不对
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shang4 da4 xue2 de5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 dou1 tao2 guo4 ke4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: When we were in college, we all skipped class, right?

cues.zh: 平时不逃课的时候老师也不点名
cues.pinyin: ping2 shi2 bu4 tao2 ke4 de5 shi2 hou4 lao3 shi1 ye3 bu4 dian3 ming2
cues.en: Usually when we don't skip, the teacher doesn't take attendance.

cues.zh: 但是我们只要一逃课他就点名
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhi3 yao4 yi1 tao2 ke4 ta1 jiu4 dian3 ming2
cues.en: But the moment we skip, they take attendance.

cues.zh: 这是个倒霉事对吧也一定发生
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ge4 dao3 mei2 shi4 dui4 ba5 ye3 yi2 ding4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: That's bad luck, right, and it's bound to happen.

cues.zh: 还有就是我们这一次说这个理发
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhe4 yi1 ci4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 li3 fa4
cues.en: And then there's this haircut incident we're talking about this time.

cues.zh: 说理发这是个多简单的一个工作呀
cues.pinyin: shuo1 li3 fa1 zhe4 shi4 ge4 duo1 jian3 dan1 de5 yi2 ge4 gong1 zuo4 ya5
cues.en: Getting a haircut is such a simple thing.

cues.zh: 居然能被剪到耳朵这就让人生气
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 neng2 bei4 jian3 dao4 er3 duo3 zhe4 jiu4 rang4 ren2 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: Yet somehow my ear got cut, which is infuriating.

cues.zh: 理发受伤这也是一个小概率事件
cues.pinyin: li3 fa4 shou4 shang1 zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gai4 lv4 shi4 jian4
cues.en: Getting hurt during a haircut is also a low-probability event.

cues.zh: 但是总有人发生肯定不只有我一个对不对
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zong3 you3 ren2 fa1 sheng1 ken3 ding4 bu4 zhi3 you3 wo3 yi2 ge4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: But it always happens to someone — definitely not just me, right?

cues.zh: 对那么这些事就是都可以认为是摩菲定
cues.pinyin: dui4 na4 me5 zhe4 xie1 shi4 jiu4 shi4 dou1 ke3 yi3 ren4 wei2 shi4 mo2 fei1 ding4
cues.en: Right, so all these things can be considered Murphy's

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 律发生作用了
cues.pinyin: lv4 fa1 sheng1 zuo4 yong4 le5
cues.en: law at work.

cues.zh: 可能有人去想那摩菲定律到底是为什么呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 you3 ren2 qu4 xiang3 na4 mo2 fei1 ding4 lv4 dao4 di3 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Some might wonder, why does Murphy's Law happen at all?

cues.zh: 有人就从心理学角度去解释它
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 jiu4 cong2 xin1 li3 xue2 jiao3 du4 qu4 jie3 shi4 ta1
cues.en: Some explain it from a psychological perspective.

cues.zh: 所以这个墨菲定律看似是成立的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 mo4 fei1 ding4 lv4 kan4 shi4 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5
cues.en: They say the reason Murphy's Law seems to happen to you

cues.zh: 是因为每当你遇到岛没事你就会想起它来
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 mei3 dang1 ni3 yu4 dao4 dao3 mei2 shi4 ni3 jiu4 hui4 xiang3 qi3 ta1 lai2
cues.en: is that every time you hit bad luck, you remember it.

cues.zh: 所以这个摩菲定律看似是成立的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 mo2 fei1 ding4 lv4 kan4 shi4 shi4 cheng2 li4 de5
cues.en: So Murphy's Law seems to hold true.

cues.zh: 有人从物理学去解释它
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 cong2 wu4 li3 xue2 qu4 jie3 shi4 ta1
cues.en: Some explain it from a physics perspective.

cues.zh: 比如说你黄油涂了面包黄油那边种
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 huang2 you2 tu2 le5 mian4 bao1 huang2 you2 na4 bian1 zhong3
cues.en: For example, the side of the bread with butter on it is heavier,

cues.zh: 它就更容易着地等等
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 geng4 rong2 yi4 zhe5 di4 deng3 deng3
cues.en: so it's more likely to land facing down, and so on.

cues.zh: 不过今天我想从数学角度来解释一下
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 jin1 tian1 wo3 xiang3 cong2 shu4 xue2 jiao3 du4 lai2 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: But today I want to explain it from a mathematical angle,

cues.zh: 为什么会发生摩菲定律
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 fa1 sheng1 mo2 fei1 ding4 lv4
cues.en: why Murphy's Law happens.

cues.zh: 我们来对它做一下数学的解释
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 dui4 ta1 zuo4 yi1 xia4 shu4 xue2 de5 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Let's give it a mathematical explanation.

cues.zh: 数学的解释
cues.pinyin: shu4 xue2 de5 jie3 shi4
cues.en: A mathematical explanation.

cues.zh: 我觉得这个定律可以从这样的两
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 ding4 lv4 ke3 yi3 cong2 zhe4 yang4 de5 liang3
cues.en: I think this law can be understood from two

cues.zh: 个角度来理解
cues.pinyin: ge4 jiao3 du4 lai2 li3 jie3
cues.en: angles like this.

cues.zh: 那么第一个角度就是如果一件事
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 di4 yi2 ge4 jiao3 du4 jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: The first angle is: if something,

cues.zh: 它的发生的次数
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fa1 sheng1 de5 ci4 shu4
cues.en: the number of times it happens,

cues.zh: 发生的次数或者是发生的样本
cues.pinyin: fa1 sheng1 de5 ci4 shu4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 fa1 sheng1 de5 yang4 ben3
cues.en: the number of occurrences, or the sample size,

cues.zh: 比如说你去理发的次数或者是理发的人数
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 qu4 li3 fa4 de5 ci4 shu4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 li3 fa4 de5 ren2 shu4
cues.en: for example, how many times you get a haircut, or how many people get haircuts,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】理发为啥会被剪到耳朵？你一定要知道的墨菲定律

cues.zh: 它发生空难的可能性非常低
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 sheng1 kong1 nan4 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4 fei1 chang2 di1
cues.en: the probability of a plane crash is very low.

cues.zh: 但是每一年都有空难对不对
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei3 yi1 nian2 dou1 you3 kong4 nan2 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: But there's a plane crash every year, right?

cues.zh: 你找不出一年说这一年一点空难都没有
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhao3 bu4 chu1 yi1 nian2 shuo1 zhe4 yi1 nian2 yi4 dian3 kong1 nan4 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: You can't find a single year with zero plane crashes.

cues.zh: 除非没有发生飞机的时候
cues.pinyin: chu2 fei1 mei2 you3 fa1 sheng1 fei1 ji1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Except maybe before airplanes existed.

cues.zh: 为什么会出现这种情况呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 chu1 xian4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 ne5
cues.en: Why does this happen?

cues.zh: 我们来看一下假如说空难它概率很低
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 yi1 xia4 jia3 ru2 shuo1 kong1 nan4 ta1 gai4 lv4 hen3 di1
cues.en: Let's look at it: suppose the probability of a plane crash is very low.

cues.zh: 我们根据最近几年空难的数据
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gen1 ju4 zui4 jin4 ji3 nian2 kong1 nan4 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: Based on data on plane crashes in recent years,

cues.zh: 空难的概率大概是 1 200 万分之 1
cues.pinyin: kong1 nan4 de5 gai4 lv4 da4 gai4 shi4 1 200 wan4 fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: the probability of a crash is about 1 in 2 million.

cues.zh: 就是飞机飞 200 万次它才会有一次空难
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 fei1 ji1 fei1 200 wan4 ci4 ta1 cai2 hui4 you3 yi1 ci4 kong1 nan4
cues.en: That means a plane has to fly 2 million times for one crash to occur.

cues.zh: 那两百万分之一大概是多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 liang3 bai3 wan4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 da4 gai4 shi4 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: So roughly how much is 1 in 2 million?

cues.zh: 是 5 乘以 10 的 7 四方这么大
cues.pinyin: shi4 5 cheng2 yi3 10 de5 7 si4 fang1 zhe4 me5 da4
cues.en: It's about 5 times 10 to the negative 7th power.

cues.zh: 所以这个概率是很小的对吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 shi4 hen3 xiao3 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: So this probability is very small, right?

cues.zh: 那么如果你不发生空难呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 ni3 bu4 fa1 sheng1 kong1 nan4 ne5
cues.en: So what if a crash doesn't happen?

cues.zh: 就是正常的概率
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zheng4 chang2 de5 gai4 lv4
cues.en: That's the normal (complementary) probability.

cues.zh: 坐飞机没有发生任何空难
cues.pinyin: zuo4 fei1 ji1 mei2 you3 fa1 sheng1 ren4 he2 kong1 nan4
cues.en: Flying without any crash happening,

cues.zh: 这个概率有多大呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: how big is that probability?

cues.zh: 那自然而然就用 1 减曲这个 Pa 就
cues.pinyin: na4 zi4 ran2 er2 ran2 jiu4 yong4 1 jian3 qu1 zhe4 ge5 Pa jiu4
cues.en: Naturally, you just use 1 minus this P,

cues.zh: 行了吧对不对
cues.pinyin: xing2 le5 ba5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: and that's it, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 相信很多同学都看过刘慈欣的小说三体
cues.pinyin: xiang1 xin4 hen3 duo1 tong2 xue2 dou1 kan4 guo4 liu2 ci2 xin1 de5 xiao3 shuo1 san1 ti3
cues.en: I believe many of you have read Liu Cixin's novel "The Three-Body Problem."

cues.zh: 前一段时间三体的动画版上映了
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 san1 ti3 de5 dong4 hua4 ban3 shang4 ying4 le5
cues.en: The animated version of Three-Body was released a while ago.

cues.zh: 又引发了一次热潮
cues.pinyin: you4 yin3 fa1 le5 yi1 ci4 re4 chao2
cues.en: It sparked another wave of popularity.

cues.zh: 三体的背景是三体人生活在半人马座星
cues.pinyin: san1 ti3 de5 bei4 jing3 shi4 san1 ti3 ren2 sheng1 huo2 zai4 ban4 ren2 ma3 zuo4 xing1
cues.en: The story's setting is that the Trisolarans live on a planet in the Alpha Centauri system.

cues.zh: 有三颗恒星
cues.pinyin: you3 san1 ke1 heng2 xing1
cues.en: There are three stars.

cues.zh: 三颗恒星无法稳定的存在
cues.pinyin: san1 ke1 heng2 xing1 wu2 fa3 wen3 ding4 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: The three stars cannot exist stably.

cues.zh: 造成了恒纪元和乱纪元的交替
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 le5 heng2 ji4 yuan2 he2 luan4 ji4 yuan2 de5 jiao1 ti4
cues.en: This causes the Stable Era and Chaotic Era to alternate.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A young student asked me.

cues.zh: 为什么说三体问题没有稳定的运动呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 shuo1 san1 ti3 wen4 ti2 mei2 you3 wen3 ding4 de5 yun4 dong4 ne5
cues.en: Why is it said that the three-body problem has no stable motion?

cues.zh: 我们的太阳系虽然只有一颗恒星
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 tai4 yang2 xi4 sui1 ran2 zhi3 you3 yi1 ke1 heng2 xing1
cues.en: Although our solar system has only one star.

cues.zh: 但是行星和小行星的个数也不少
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xing2 xing1 he2 xiao3 xing2 xing1 de5 ge4 shu4 ye3 bu4 shao3
cues.en: There are still quite a few planets and asteroids.

cues.zh: 太阳系会一直稳定下去吗
cues.pinyin: tai4 yang2 xi4 hui4 yi4 zhi2 wen3 ding4 xia4 qu4 ma5
cues.en: Will the solar system remain stable forever?

cues.zh: 其实三体问题是一个非常复杂的问题
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 san1 ti3 wen4 ti2 shi4 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 fu4 za2 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Actually, the three-body problem is a very complex problem.

cues.zh: 直到今天也没有完全解决
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 jin1 tian1 ye3 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 jie3 jue2
cues.en: It still hasn't been fully solved even today.

cues.zh: 今天我们就花一点时间
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 hua1 yi4 dian3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Today let's take a moment.

cues.zh: 来带着大家简单了解一下三体问题
cues.pinyin: lai2 dai4 zhe5 da4 jia1 jian3 dan1 liao3 jie3 yi1 xia4 san1 ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: To give everyone a simple introduction to the three-body problem.

cues.zh: 我们先来完整叙述一遍
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 wan2 zheng3 xu4 shu4 yi1 bian4
cues.en: Let's first give a complete explanation.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 到底什么是 N 体问题
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shen2 me5 shi4 N ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Of what exactly the N-body problem is.

cues.zh: 什么是 N 体问题呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 N ti3 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: What is the N-body problem?

cues.zh: 它最早是牛顿提出来的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zui4 zao3 shi4 niu2 dun4 ti2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: It was first proposed by Newton.

cues.zh: 因为牛顿发现了万有引力定律
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 niu2 dun4 fa1 xian4 le5 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Because Newton discovered the law of universal gravitation.

cues.zh: N 体问题就是说有 N 个质点
cues.pinyin: N ti3 wen4 ti2 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 you3 N ge4 zhi4 dian3
cues.en: The N-body problem refers to having N point masses.

cues.zh: N 个质点
cues.pinyin: N ge4 zhi4 dian3
cues.en: N point masses.

cues.zh: 这 N 个质点仅在万有引力的作用下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 N ge4 zhi4 dian3 jin3 zai4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 de5 zuo4 yong4 xia4
cues.en: These N point masses, acted on only by gravity.

cues.zh: 仅在万有引力作用下
cues.pinyin: jin3 zai4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 zuo4 yong4 xia4
cues.en: Acted on only by gravity.

cues.zh: 它的运动的规律是什么样子的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yun4 dong4 de5 gui1 lv4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: What is the pattern of their motion?

cues.zh: 它的运动是什么样的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 yun4 dong4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5
cues.en: What does their motion look like?

cues.zh: 这个问题就称之为 N 体问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 N ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: This problem is called the N-body problem.

cues.zh: N 等于 2 就是 2 体问题
cues.pinyin: N deng3 yu2 2 jiu4 shi4 2 ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: When N equals 2, it's the two-body problem.

cues.zh: N 等于 3 就是 3 体问题
cues.pinyin: N deng3 yu2 3 jiu4 shi4 3 ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: When N equals 3, it's the three-body problem.

cues.zh: 也有 4 体 5 体 6 体问题
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 4 ti3 5 ti3 6 ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: There are also four-body, five-body, six-body problems.

cues.zh: 这个问题怎么解决呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 zen3 me5 jie3 jue2 ne5
cues.en: How can this problem be solved?

cues.zh: 其实牛顿就给出了方法
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 niu2 dun4 jiu4 gei3 chu1 le5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Actually, Newton gave a method.

cues.zh: 你看假如说我们有三个物体
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 jia3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 you3 san1 ge4 wu4 ti3
cues.en: Suppose we have three objects.

cues.zh: 这三个物体之间彼此之间会产生一个力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 san1 ge4 wu4 ti3 zhi1 jian1 bi3 ci3 zhi1 jian1 hui4 chan3 sheng1 yi2 ge4 li4
cues.en: These three objects exert a force on each other.

cues.zh: 这个力就是万有引力对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 jiu4 shi4 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: That force is gravity, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 速度变化又会造成位置的变化
cues.pinyin: su4 du4 bian4 hua4 you4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 wei4 zhi4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: A change in velocity in turn causes a change in position.

cues.zh: R 比 T
cues.pinyin: R bi3 T
cues.en: R over T.

cues.zh: 速度造成位置的变化
cues.pinyin: su4 du4 zao4 cheng2 wei4 zhi4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Velocity causes a change in position.

cues.zh: 最后位置又反过头来
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wei4 zhi4 you4 fan3 guo4 tou2 lai2
cues.en: Finally, the position in turn.

cues.zh: 影响了牛顿的这个万有引力
cues.pinyin: ying3 xiang3 le5 niu2 dun4 de5 zhe4 ge5 wan4 you3 yin3 li4
cues.en: Affects this gravitational force from Newton.

cues.zh: 也就是说你因为受到力的作用
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ni3 yin1 wei4 shou4 dao4 li4 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: That is to say, because you're acted on by a force.

cues.zh: 而产生加速度
cues.pinyin: er2 chan3 sheng1 jia1 su4 du4
cues.en: You produce acceleration.

cues.zh: 因为加速度而产生速度变化
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jia1 su4 du4 er2 chan3 sheng1 su4 du4 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Because of acceleration, velocity changes.

cues.zh: 因为速度的变化而产生了位置的变化
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 su4 du4 de5 bian4 hua4 er2 chan3 sheng1 le5 wei4 zhi4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Because velocity changes, position changes.

cues.zh: 因为位置的变化又影响了你的受力
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wei4 zhi4 de5 bian4 hua4 you4 ying3 xiang3 le5 ni3 de5 shou4 li4
cues.en: Because position changes, it in turn affects the force you experience.

cues.zh: 这样一次又一次的循环
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 ci4 you4 yi1 ci4 de5 xun2 huan2
cues.en: This cycle repeats over and over.

cues.zh: 那我问你你的运动规律是什么样子的
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 wen4 ni3 ni3 de5 yun4 dong4 gui1 lv4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: So I ask you, what is your pattern of motion?

cues.zh: 这个问题称之为 N 体问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 N ti3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: This problem is called the N-body problem.

cues.zh: 当然这个问题牛顿解决了一部分
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 niu2 dun4 jie3 jue2 le5 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: Of course, Newton solved part of this problem.

cues.zh: 解决了哪一部分呢
cues.pinyin: jie3 jue2 le5 na3 yi1 bu4 fen4 ne5
cues.en: Which part did he solve?

cues.zh: 就是二体问题中的一部分
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 er4 ti3 wen4 ti2 zhong1 de5 yi1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: Part of the two-body problem.

cues.zh: 在牛顿那个时代
cues.pinyin: zai4 niu2 dun4 na4 ge5 shi2 dai4
cues.en: In Newton's time.

cues.zh: 开普勒通过天文观测
cues.pinyin: kai1 pu3 lei1 tong1 guo4 tian1 wen2 guan1 ce4
cues.en: Kepler, through astronomical observation.

cues.zh: 发现行星围绕太阳运动是椭圆
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 xing2 xing1 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 yun4 dong4 shi4 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: Discovered that planets orbit the sun in ellipses.

cues.zh: 这个事很神奇
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 hen3 shen2 qi2
cues.en: This is quite amazing.

cues.zh: 如果开普勒再详细地观测一下
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 kai1 pu3 lei1 zai4 xiang2 xi4 di4 guan1 ce4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: If Kepler had observed more carefully.

cues.zh: 他会发现行星运动不是椭圆
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 fa1 xian4 xing2 xing1 yun4 dong4 bu2 shi4 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: He would have found that planetary motion isn't actually an ellipse.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 但是完整的二体问题的解决
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wan2 zheng3 de5 er4 ti3 wen4 ti2 de5 jie3 jue2
cues.en: But the complete solution to the two-body problem.

cues.zh: 归功于另外一个人叫做约翰伯努利
cues.pinyin: gui1 gong1 yu2 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 ren2 jiao4 zuo4 yue1 han4 bo2 nu3 li4
cues.en: Is credited to another person named Johann Bernoulli.

cues.zh: 比牛顿稍微年轻一点
cues.pinyin: bi3 niu2 dun4 shao1 wei1 nian2 qing1 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Slightly younger than Newton.

cues.zh: 咱们以前讲过约翰伯努利的故事
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 yi3 qian2 jiang3 guo4 yue1 han4 bo2 nu3 li4 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: We've told the story of Johann Bernoulli before.

cues.zh: 他是丹尼尔伯努力的父亲
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 dan1 ni2 er3 bo2 nu3 li4 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: He was the father of Daniel Bernoulli.

cues.zh: 是雅各布伯努力的弟弟是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ya3 ge4 bu4 bo2 nu3 li4 de5 di4 di5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: And the younger brother of Jacob Bernoulli, right?

cues.zh: 是三大伯努力之一
cues.pinyin: shi4 san1 da4 bo2 nu3 li4 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: He was one of the three great Bernoullis.

cues.zh: 那这个伯努力还向牛顿发起过挑战
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 bo2 nu3 li4 hai2 xiang4 niu2 dun4 fa1 qi3 guo4 tiao3 zhan4
cues.en: This Bernoulli even challenged Newton.

cues.zh: 但是被牛顿的轻松战胜了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bei4 niu2 dun4 de5 qing1 song1 zhan4 sheng4 le5
cues.en: But was easily defeated by Newton.

cues.zh: 这个约翰伯努力
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yue1 han4 bo2 nu3 li4
cues.en: This Johann Bernoulli.

cues.zh: 他求解出二体问题的普遍解
cues.pinyin: ta1 qiu2 jie3 chu1 er4 ti3 wen4 ti2 de5 pu3 bian4 jie3
cues.en: He solved the general solution of the two-body problem.

cues.zh: 应该是圆锥曲线
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 yuan2 zhui1 qu1 xian4
cues.en: It should be a conic section.

cues.zh: 它不一定是椭圆
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 yi2 ding4 shi4 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: It's not necessarily an ellipse.

cues.zh: 它实际上是圆锥曲线
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yuan2 zhui1 qu1 xian4
cues.en: It's actually a conic section.

cues.zh: 实际上也是圆锥曲线
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 ye3 shi4 yuan2 zhui1 qu1 xian4
cues.en: It's actually also a conic section.

cues.zh: 什么叫圆锥曲线呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 yuan2 zhui1 qu1 xian4 ne5
cues.en: What is a conic section?

cues.zh: 就是我们画一个圆锥
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 hua4 yi2 ge4 yuan2 zhui1
cues.en: Let's draw a cone.

cues.zh: 这个圆锥是两个圆锥顶到一起的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yuan2 zhui1 shi4 liang3 ge4 yuan2 zhui1 ding3 dao4 yi4 qi3 de5
cues.en: This cone is two cones joined tip to tip.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 然后我用一个平面去切这个圆锥
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 yong4 yi2 ge4 ping2 mian4 qu4 qie4 zhe4 ge5 yuan2 zhui1
cues.en: Then I cut this cone with a plane.

cues.zh: 咱们想象一下
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xiang3 xiang4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's imagine this.

cues.zh: 如果我平面是水平切圆锥的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 ping2 mian4 shi4 shui3 ping2 qie4 yuan2 zhui1 de5
cues.en: If my plane cuts the cone horizontally.

cues.zh: 那么圆锥就会切出一个圆来对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 yuan2 zhui1 jiu4 hui4 qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4 yuan2 lai2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then the cone produces a circle, right?

cues.zh: 如果我这个平面稍微斜一点
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 zhe4 ge5 ping2 mian4 shao1 wei1 xie2 yi4 dian3
cues.en: If I tilt the plane a little.

cues.zh: 我就会切出一个椭圆来
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 hui4 qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4 tuo3 yuan2 lai2
cues.en: I'll cut out an ellipse.

cues.zh: 如果我斜的足够厉害
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 xie2 de5 zu2 gou4 li4 hai4
cues.en: If I tilt it enough.

cues.zh: 我会切出一个抛物线来
cues.pinyin: wo3 hui4 qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4 pao1 wu4 xian4 lai2
cues.en: I'll cut out a parabola.

cues.zh: 如果我再斜的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 zai4 xie2 de5 hua4
cues.en: If I tilt it even more.

cues.zh: 我就会下边切出一个
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 hui4 xia4 bian1 qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: I'll cut one piece at the bottom.

cues.zh: 上边切出一个
cues.pinyin: shang4 bian1 qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: And one piece at the top.

cues.zh: 切出一个双曲线来对吧
cues.pinyin: qie4 chu1 yi2 ge4 shuang1 qu1 xian4 lai2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Producing a hyperbola, right?

cues.zh: 约翰普总理就说
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 pu3 zong3 li3 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: Johann Bernoulli said.

cues.zh: 天体的运动轨道实际上是圆锥曲线
cues.pinyin: tian1 ti3 de5 yun4 dong4 gui3 dao4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yuan2 zhui1 qu1 xian4
cues.en: The orbits of celestial bodies are actually conic sections.

cues.zh: 如果你速度正合适
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 su4 du4 zheng4 he2 shi4
cues.en: If your speed is just right.

cues.zh: 我在这儿花
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 zhe4 er2 hua1
cues.en: Let me draw it here.

cues.zh: 假如这是一个太阳
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 tai4 yang2
cues.en: Suppose this is the sun.

cues.zh: 那么如果你速度正合适
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 ni3 su4 du4 zheng4 he2 shi4
cues.en: Then if your speed is just right.

cues.zh: 那你就围绕太阳做圆轨道运动
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zuo4 yuan2 gui3 dao4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: You'll orbit the sun in a circular path.

cues.zh: 假如你速度稍微大一点
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 ni3 su4 du4 shao1 wei1 da4 yi1 dian3
cues.en: If your speed is a bit faster.

cues.zh: 那么你就围绕太阳做一个椭圆轨道运动
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 jiu4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zuo4 yi2 ge4 tuo3 yuan2 gui3 dao4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: Then you'll orbit the sun in an elliptical path.

cues.zh: 如果你速度再大一点
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 su4 du4 zai4 da4 yi1 dian3
cues.en: If your speed is even faster.

cues.zh: 你就围绕太阳做了一个抛物线
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 pao1 wu4 xian4
cues.en: You'll trace out a parabola around the sun.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】三体问题究竟是什么？为什么说科学的尽头是神学？

cues.zh: 那么我的轨道也只有一点点变化
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 de5 gui3 dao4 ye3 zhi3 you3 yi4 dian3 dian3 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Then my orbit only changes by a tiny bit.

cues.zh: 你比如说你开始是个椭圆
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 kai1 shi3 shi4 ge4 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: For example, suppose you start with an ellipse.

cues.zh: 然后你稍微加一点速
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 shao1 wei1 jia1 yi4 dian3 su4
cues.en: Then you speed up just a little.

cues.zh: 那我就变成了一个更大的椭圆
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 geng4 da4 de5 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: Then I become a slightly bigger ellipse.

cues.zh: 你再加一点速
cues.pinyin: ni3 zai4 jia1 yi4 dian3 su4
cues.en: You speed up a bit more.

cues.zh: 就会变成一个更大的椭圆
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 geng4 da4 de5 tuo3 yuan2
cues.en: It becomes an even bigger ellipse.

cues.zh: 你一直加一直加
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi4 zhi2 jia1 yi4 zhi2 jia1
cues.en: You keep speeding up, again and again.

cues.zh: 我这个椭圆就会越来越大
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 ge5 tuo3 yuan2 jiu4 hui4 yue4 lai2 yue4 da4
cues.en: This ellipse keeps getting bigger and bigger.

cues.zh: 大到无穷大实
cues.pinyin: da4 dao4 wu2 qiong2 da4 shi2
cues.en: When it grows large enough to be infinite.

cues.zh: 它就变成抛肤线了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 pao1 fu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: It turns into a parabola.

cues.zh: 所以只要你给我一个很小的初始的变化
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhi3 yao4 ni3 gei3 wo3 yi2 ge4 hen3 xiao3 de5 chu1 shi3 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: So as long as you give me a very small initial change.

cues.zh: 我最后的结局也只有很小的变化
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 hou4 de5 jie2 ju2 ye3 zhi3 you3 hen3 xiao3 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: My final outcome will also only change slightly.

cues.zh: 这就叫稳定是吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 wen3 ding4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: This is called stability, right?

cues.zh: 二体问题是解析的而且是稳定的
cues.pinyin: er4 ti3 wen4 ti2 shi4 jie3 xi1 de5 er2 qie3 shi4 wen3 ding4 de5
cues.en: The two-body problem is analytically solvable and stable.

cues.zh: 好那么我们自然想到
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 wo3 men5 zi4 ran2 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: Well then, naturally we think.

cues.zh: 三体问题我们是不是也可以这样解决呢
cues.pinyin: san1 ti3 wen4 ti2 wo3 men5 shi4 bu2 shi4 ye3 ke3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 jie3 jue2 ne5
cues.en: Can we solve the three-body problem the same way?

cues.zh: 人们也用了这个方法去尝试
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 ye3 yong4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 qu4 chang2 shi4
cues.en: People also tried this method.

cues.zh: 最早尝试的是牛顿
cues.pinyin: zui4 zao3 chang2 shi4 de5 shi4 niu2 dun4
cues.en: The first to try was Newton.

cues.zh: 牛顿就在思考说太阳系有这么多的天体
cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 jiu4 zai4 si1 kao3 shuo1 tai4 yang2 xi4 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 de5 tian1 ti3
cues.en: Newton was thinking that the solar system has so many celestial bodies.

cues.zh: 对吧它们彼此之间有相互的作用
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 ta1 men5 bi3 ci3 zhi1 jian1 you3 xiang1 hu4 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: Right, they all interact with each other.

cues.zh: 那么你说太阳系它是不是一个
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 shuo1 tai4 yang2 xi4 ta1 shi4 bu2 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: So is the solar system.

cues.zh: 稳定的结构呢
cues.pinyin: wen3 ding4 de5 jie2 gou4 ne5
cues.en: A stable structure?

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 疫情下广州情侣97㎡的家，久宅不腻！ 97-m2 Home of a Guangzhou Couple during the COVID-19 Pandemic

cues.zh: 年轻人在外地的压力其实还是挺大的
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 ren2 zai4 wai4 di4 de5 ya1 li4 qi2 shi2 hai2 shi4 ting3 da4 de5
cues.en: The pressure on young people living away from home is actually quite intense.

cues.zh: 这样一个地方既可以办公又可以居家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 di4 fang1 ji4 ke3 yi3 ban4 gong1 you4 ke3 yi3 ju1 jia1
cues.en: A place like this can serve as both an office and a home.

cues.zh: 半夜打拼到两点
cues.pinyin: ban4 ye4 da3 pin1 dao4 liang3 dian3
cues.en: Working hard until two in the morning.

cues.zh: 看到一盏暖色的灯灰味里亮着
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 yi1 zhan3 nuan3 se4 de5 deng1 hui1 wei4 li3 liang4 zhe5
cues.en: I'd see a warm-colored lamp glowing in the night.

cues.zh: 就像一个孔明灯
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 yi2 ge4 kong3 ming2 deng1
cues.en: Just like a Kongming sky lantern.

cues.zh: 就是我们努力的那一份动力吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 nu3 li4 de5 na4 yi1 fen4 dong4 li4 ba5
cues.en: That's the motivation behind all our hard work, I guess.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 疫情下广州情侣97㎡的家，久宅不腻！ 97-m2 Home of a Guangzhou Couple during the COVID-19 Pandemic

cues.zh: 这栋楼前面 C B D
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dong4 lou2 qian2 mian4 C B D
cues.en: In front of this building is the CBD.

cues.zh: 后面就是一大片的城中村
cues.pinyin: hou4 mian4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 da4 pian4 de5 cheng2 zhong1 cun1
cues.en: Behind it is a large urban village.

cues.zh: 我和我男朋友毕业实习的时候就来到广州
cues.pinyin: wo3 he2 wo3 nan2 peng2 you3 bi4 ye4 shi2 xi2 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 lai2 dao4 guang3 zhou1
cues.en: My boyfriend and I came to Guangzhou during our graduation internship.

cues.zh: 第一个落脚点就是这边的城中村
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 luo4 jiao3 dian3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 bian1 de5 cheng2 zhong1 cun1
cues.en: Our first place to stay was this urban village.

cues.zh: 刚开始有想过去租一个写字楼
cues.pinyin: gang1 kai1 shi3 you3 xiang3 guo4 qu4 zu1 yi2 ge4 xie3 zi4 lou2
cues.en: At first we thought about renting an office space.

cues.zh: 办公跟生活去分开
cues.pinyin: ban4 gong1 gen1 sheng1 huo2 qu4 fen1 kai1
cues.en: To keep work and life separate.

cues.zh: 但是前期压力太大
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qian2 qi1 ya1 li4 tai4 da4
cues.en: But the pressure in the early stage was too much.

cues.zh: 只租一套
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zu1 yi1 tao4
cues.en: So we just rented one unit instead.

cues.zh: 有自己的生活
cues.pinyin: you3 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: Have our own life,

cues.zh: 还能自由地办公
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 zi4 you2 di4 ban4 gong1
cues.en: and still be able to work freely.

cues.zh: 在 19 年中下旬开始租
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 nian2 zhong1 xia4 xun2 kai1 shi3 zu1
cues.en: We started renting it in mid-to-late 2019.

cues.zh: 整个装修 30 多万
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 zhuang1 xiu1 30 duo1 wan4
cues.en: The whole renovation cost over 300,000 yuan.

cues.zh: 全部所有墙壁都可以打透
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 suo3 you3 qiang2 bi4 dou1 ke3 yi3 da3 tou4
cues.en: Every single wall could be knocked through.

cues.zh: 入户是有一个玄关
cues.pinyin: ru4 hu4 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 xuan2 guan1
cues.en: There's an entryway right when you walk in.

cues.zh: 有一点点暗调
cues.pinyin: you3 yi4 dian3 dian3 an4 diao4
cues.en: It has a slightly dark tone.

cues.zh: 烧烤的那种锡箔纸
cues.pinyin: shao1 kao3 de5 na4 zhong3 xi1 bo2 zhi3
cues.en: The kind of aluminum foil used for barbecues.

cues.zh: 它很薄
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 bao2
cues.en: It's very thin.

cues.zh: 我们可以随意创造纹理
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 sui2 yi4 chuang4 zao4 wen2 li3
cues.en: We can create textures on it however we like.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 疫情下广州情侣97㎡的家，久宅不腻！ 97-m2 Home of a Guangzhou Couple during the COVID-19 Pandemic

cues.zh: 能在一定程度上反光
cues.pinyin: neng2 zai4 yi2 ding4 cheng2 du4 shang4 fan3 guang1
cues.en: It can reflect light to a certain degree.

cues.zh: 做一个茶宫间
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ge4 cha2 gong1 jian1
cues.en: We made a little tea space.

cues.zh: 使用的一个材料就是障子纸
cues.pinyin: shi3 yong4 de5 yi2 ge4 cai2 liao4 jiu4 shi4 zhang4 zi5 zhi3
cues.en: The material we used is shoji paper.

cues.zh: 它既可以透光
cues.pinyin: ta1 ji4 ke3 yi3 tou4 guang1
cues.en: It lets light through,

cues.zh: 然后又有一定程度的隐私
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you4 you3 yi2 ding4 cheng2 du4 de5 yin3 si1
cues.en: while still giving a certain degree of privacy.

cues.zh: 这个胭脂色的地板
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yan1 zhi1 se4 de5 di4 ban3
cues.en: This rouge-colored flooring,

cues.zh: 故宫的那种东方红
cues.pinyin: gu4 gong1 de5 na4 zhong3 dong1 fang1 hong2
cues.en: the kind of 'Oriental Red' used in the Forbidden City,

cues.zh: 是用植物染色去做的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yong4 zhi2 wu4 ran3 se4 qu4 zuo4 de5
cues.en: is made using plant dye.

cues.zh: 比较环保
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 huan2 bao3
cues.en: It's relatively eco-friendly.

cues.zh: 经过光照会有一个渐变的一个过程
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 guang1 zhao4 hui4 you3 yi2 ge4 jian4 bian4 de5 yi2 ge4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: Exposed to light, it goes through a gradual color change.

cues.zh: 我们割舍掉了厨房
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ge1 she3 diao4 le5 chu2 fang2
cues.en: We gave up having a kitchen.

cues.zh: 因为使用频次特别少
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shi3 yong4 pin2 ci4 te4 bie2 shao3
cues.en: Because we use it so rarely.

cues.zh: 大家都知道的是是在广州
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 zhi1 dao4 de5 shi4 shi4 zai4 guang3 zhou1
cues.en: Everyone knows that, being in Guangzhou,

cues.zh: 外卖又特别便利
cues.pinyin: wai4 mai4 you4 te4 bie2 bian4 li4
cues.en: takeout delivery is especially convenient.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 疫情下广州情侣97㎡的家，久宅不腻！ 97-m2 Home of a Guangzhou Couple during the COVID-19 Pandemic

cues.zh: 疫情之后居家办公成为年轻人生活方式
cues.pinyin: yi4 qing2 zhi1 hou4 ju1 jia1 ban4 gong1 cheng2 wei2 nian2 qing1 ren2 sheng1 huo2 fang1 shi4
cues.en: After the pandemic, working from home became a lifestyle for young people.

cues.zh: 工作占据了我们大部分的世界
cues.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 zhan4 ju4 le5 wo3 men5 da4 bu4 fen4 de5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: Work takes up most of our world.

cues.zh: 睡眠放在了一个极小的空间里
cues.pinyin: shui4 mian2 fang4 zai4 le5 yi2 ge4 ji2 xiao3 de5 kong1 jian1 li3
cues.en: Sleep got squeezed into a tiny little space.

cues.zh: 应该六平左右吧
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 liu4 ping2 zuo3 you4 ba5
cues.en: Should be about six square meters, I guess.

cues.zh: 每天可能几个小时
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 ke3 neng2 ji3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: Maybe just a few hours a day.

cues.zh: 所需要的可能就是一个很狭小
cues.pinyin: suo3 xu1 yao4 de5 ke3 neng2 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 xia2 xiao3
cues.en: What you really need is just somewhere small and cozy,

cues.zh: 很安全的空间
cues.pinyin: hen3 an1 quan2 de5 kong1 jian1
cues.en: a very safe little space.

cues.zh: 我们在 27 层茶室做了一个超大的玻璃
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 27 ceng2 cha2 shi4 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 chao1 da4 de5 bo1 li2
cues.en: On the 27th floor, in the tea room, we put in a huge pane of glass.

cues.zh: 就像 IM A X 电影一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 IM A X dian4 ying3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Just like watching an IMAX movie.

cues.zh: 最浪漫的是
cues.pinyin: zui4 lang4 man4 de5 shi4
cues.en: The most romantic thing is,

cues.zh: 两个人在一起
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: the two of us together,

cues.zh: 看下雨
cues.pinyin: kan4 xia4 yu3
cues.en: watching the rain fall,

cues.zh: 看日出日落
cues.pinyin: kan4 ri4 chu1 ri4 luo4
cues.en: watching the sunrise and sunset,

cues.zh: 给人一种时间的力量感
cues.pinyin: gei3 ren2 yi1 zhong3 shi2 jian1 de5 li4 liang4 gan3
cues.en: it gives you a real sense of the weight of time.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 我们知道今天中国的股市又暴跌了一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 jin1 tian1 zhong1 guo2 de5 gu3 shi4 you4 bao4 die1 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: As we know, China's stock market crashed again today.

cues.zh: 这么多年以来无论国际形势如何变化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 yi3 lai2 wu2 lun4 guo2 ji4 xing2 shi4 ru2 he2 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Over all these years, no matter how the international situation has changed,

cues.zh: 中国的股民总是不忘初心
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 de5 gu3 min2 zong3 shi4 bu4 wang4 chu1 xin1
cues.en: Chinese retail investors always stay true to their original intention,

cues.zh: 被祖国提供的有动静
cues.pinyin: bei4 zu3 guo2 ti2 gong1 de5 you3 dong4 jing4
cues.en: staying unwavering even while trapped in losses.

cues.zh: 关于炒股赔钱这件事
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 chao3 gu3 pei2 qian2 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: When it comes to losing money in stocks,

cues.zh: 每个人都有不同的想法
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: everyone has a different take on it.

cues.zh: 有的人想可能是我智商不够
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 ren2 xiang3 ke3 neng2 shi4 wo3 zhi4 shang1 bu4 gou4
cues.en: Some think maybe their IQ just isn't high enough.

cues.zh: 也有人想可能就是我运气不好
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 ren2 xiang3 ke3 neng2 jiu4 shi4 wo3 yun4 qi4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Others think maybe they just have bad luck,

cues.zh: 总是踩不上点
cues.pinyin: zong3 shi4 cai3 bu4 shang4 dian3
cues.en: always missing the right timing.

cues.zh: 但是大家会发现大部分股民都是赔钱的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da4 jia1 hui4 fa1 xian4 da4 bu4 fen4 gu3 min2 dou1 shi4 pei2 qian2 de5
cues.en: But you'll notice most retail investors end up losing money.

cues.zh: 那么这里有没有什么深刻的数学内涵呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 li3 you3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 shen1 ke4 de5 shu4 xue2 nei4 han2 ne5
cues.en: So is there some deep mathematical reason behind this?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来给大家举一个例子
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 ju3 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Today let's look at an example.

cues.zh: 这个例子称之为美女与男人的游戏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li4 zi5 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 mei3 nv3 yu3 nan2 ren2 de5 you2 xi4
cues.en: This example is called the game between a beautiful woman and a man—

cues.zh: 游戏
cues.pinyin: you2 xi4
cues.en: the game.

cues.zh: 最后一个男人他都在酒吧里独自喝酒
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 nan2 ren2 ta1 dou1 zai4 jiu3 ba1 li3 du2 zi4 he1 jiu3
cues.en: Say, a man is drinking alone at a bar.

cues.zh: 这个时候走过来一个美女
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zou3 guo4 lai2 yi2 ge4 mei3 nv3
cues.en: At this moment a beautiful woman walks up to him.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 这个美女跟他说咱们玩一个游戏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 mei3 nv3 gen1 ta1 shuo1 zan2 men5 wan2 yi2 ge4 you2 xi4
cues.en: She says, let's play a game.

cues.zh: 男人说怎么玩
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shuo1 zen3 me5 wan2
cues.en: The man asks, how do we play?

cues.zh: 美女说这样
cues.pinyin: mei3 nv3 shuo1 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: She says, like this:

cues.zh: 咱们每个人拿一个硬币
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 mei3 ge4 ren2 na2 yi2 ge4 ying4 bi4
cues.en: Each of us takes a coin.

cues.zh: 咱们两个人把硬币出一面
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ren2 ba3 ying4 bi4 chu1 yi2 mian4
cues.en: The two of us each show one side of our coin.

cues.zh: 你出一面我出一面
cues.pinyin: ni3 chu1 yi2 mian4 wo3 chu1 yi2 mian4
cues.en: You show one side, I show one side.

cues.zh: 咱们看一看
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 kan4 yi1 kan4
cues.en: Let's see what happens.

cues.zh: 如果这两个硬币都是正面的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 liang3 ge4 ying4 bi4 dou1 shi4 zheng4 mian4 de5
cues.en: If both coins come up heads,

cues.zh: 那我就给你三块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 san1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then I'll give you three dollars.

cues.zh: 男人的收益就三块钱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 de5 shou1 yi4 jiu4 san1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: The man's payoff is three dollars.

cues.zh: 如果都是反面的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dou1 shi4 fan3 mian4 de5
cues.en: If both are tails,

cues.zh: 那我就给你一块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 gei3 ni3 yi1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then I'll give you one dollar.

cues.zh: 男人收益就一块钱
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 shou1 yi4 jiu4 yi1 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: The man's payoff is one dollar.

cues.zh: 但是如果咱们两个硬币一正一反
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ying4 bi4 yi1 zheng4 yi1 fan3
cues.en: But if our two coins are one heads and one tails,

cues.zh: 你随便出
cues.pinyin: ni3 sui2 bian4 chu1
cues.en: you can show whichever you like—

cues.zh: 你出正也可以反也可以
cues.pinyin: ni3 chu1 zheng4 ye3 ke3 yi3 fan3 ye3 ke3 yi3
cues.en: heads or tails, either is fine.

cues.zh: 我也是
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 shi4
cues.en: Same for me.

cues.zh: 咱们两个如果一正一反的话
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 liang3 ge4 ru2 guo3 yi1 zheng4 yi1 fan3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If between the two of us it's one heads and one tails,

cues.zh: 那你就给我两块钱
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 gei3 wo3 liang3 kuai4 qian2
cues.en: then you give me two dollars.

cues.zh: 所以就输了两块
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 shu1 le5 liang3 kuai4
cues.en: So he loses two dollars.

cues.zh: 这样男人的收益就是这样的

cues.zh: 它都是在 0 和 1 之间的一个数

items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】炒股为啥会赔钱？散户为啥无法对抗庄家？通过美女和男人的博弈故事，你可能会获得答案

cues.zh: 它要小于 3 x 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 xiao3 yu2 3 x 1
cues.en: It needs to be less than 3x - 1.

cues.zh: 我们在初中学习不等式的时候知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 chu1 zhong1 xue2 xi2 bu4 deng3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: We learned in middle school when studying inequalities,

cues.zh: 不等式的这一根要除过去
cues.pinyin: bu4 deng3 shi4 de5 zhe4 yi1 gen1 yao4 chu2 guo4 qu4
cues.en: that when you divide this term over to the other side,

cues.zh: 必须要考虑是正的还是负的问题
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 yao4 kao3 lv4 shi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 shi4 fu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: you must consider whether it's positive or negative.

cues.zh: 也就是 x 大于 8 分之 3
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 x da4 yu2 8 fen1 zhi1 3
cues.en: If 8x - 3 is greater than 0,

cues.zh: 也就是 x 大于 3 8 分之 3
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 x da4 yu2 3 8 fen1 zhi1 3
cues.en: that is, x > 3/8,

cues.zh: 在这种情况下这个数是正的
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 xia4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 shi4 zheng4 de5
cues.en: in this case this number is positive,

cues.zh: 我们摸过去不变号
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 mo1 guo4 qu4 bu4 bian4 hao4
cues.en: and dividing it over doesn't flip the inequality sign.

cues.zh: y 就要小于 3 x 1 除以 8 x 3
cues.pinyin: y jiu4 yao4 xiao3 yu2 3 x 1 chu2 yi3 8 x 3
cues.en: y must be less than (3x - 1)/(8x - 3).

cues.zh: 也就是说女人的这个 y
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 nv3 ren2 de5 zhe4 ge5 y
cues.en: In other words, the woman's y

cues.zh: 她只要能够小于这个数
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yao4 neng2 gou4 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 shu4
cues.en: just needs to be less than this value,

cues.zh: 就可以保证男人的期望是负的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 bao3 zheng4 nan2 ren2 de5 qi1 wang4 shi4 fu4 de5
cues.en: and she can guarantee the man's expectation is negative.

cues.zh: 那么这个函数是一个什么函数呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: So what kind of function is this?

cues.zh: 如果我画出图像就知道了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 hua4 chu1 tu2 xiang4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: If I plot its graph, we'll see.

cues.zh: 它是一个减函数
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 jian3 han2 shu4
cues.en: It's a decreasing function.

cues.zh: 所谓减函数的意思就是 x 越大这个值越小
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 jian3 han2 shu4 de5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 x yue4 da4 zhe4 ge5 zhi2 yue4 xiao3
cues.en: A decreasing function means the larger x is, the smaller this value becomes.

cues.zh: 那我要是让 y 一直小于这个函数的话
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 yao4 shi4 rang4 y yi4 zhi2 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: So if I want y to always be less than this function,

cues.zh: 就要小于这个函数的最小值
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 xiao3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 de5 zui4 xiao3 zhi2
cues.en: it needs to be less than the minimum value of this function.
