cues.zh: 一切都非常顺利
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 dou1 fei1 chang2 shun4 li4
cues.en: everything was going very smoothly.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 2025最新惊悚大片！妙龄美女被杀人魔盯上数月！最后绝境求生！根据真实事件改编

cues.zh: 可让人意外的是
cues.pinyin: ke3 rang4 ren2 yi4 wai4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But surprisingly,

cues.zh: 安妮刚和那个男孩道别
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 gang1 he2 na4 ge5 nan2 hai2 dao4 bie2
cues.en: right after Annie said goodbye to the boy,

cues.zh: 准备和闺蜜一起回家
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 he2 gui1 mi4 yi4 qi3 hui2 jia1
cues.en: and was about to head home with her best friend,

cues.zh: 他们便再次和那辆白色面包车相遇了
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 bian4 zai4 ci4 he2 na4 liang4 bai2 se4 mian4 bao1 che1 xiang1 yu4 le5
cues.en: they ran into that white van again.

cues.zh: 二人被吓得够呛
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 bei4 xia4 de2 gou4 qiang4
cues.en: The two of them were scared stiff.

cues.zh: 回过神来
cues.pinyin: hui2 guo4 shen2 lai2
cues.en: Once they came to their senses,

cues.zh: 便立刻想骑马逃离这里
cues.pinyin: bian4 li4 ke4 xiang3 qi2 ma3 tao2 li2 zhe4 li3
cues.en: they immediately wanted to ride off and escape.

cues.zh: 安全起见
cues.pinyin: an1 quan2 qi3 jian4
cues.en: For safety,

cues.zh: 安妮准备跟闺蜜兵分两路
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 zhun3 bei4 gen1 gui1 mi4 bing1 fen1 liang3 lu4
cues.en: Annie decided to split up with her best friend,

cues.zh: 各自出逃
cues.pinyin: ge4 zi4 chu1 tao2
cues.en: each fleeing separately.

cues.zh: 毕竟他们有两个人
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 ta1 men5 you3 liang3 ge4 ren2
cues.en: After all, there were two of them,

cues.zh: 而面包车只有一辆
cues.pinyin: er2 mian4 bao1 che1 zhi3 you3 yi1 liang4
cues.en: but only one van.

cues.zh: 只可戏跑到一半
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ke3 xi4 pao3 dao4 yi2 ban4
cues.en: But unfortunately, halfway through running,

cues.zh: 安妮就因为昏暗的环境
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 jiu4 yin1 wei4 hun1 an4 de5 huan2 jing4
cues.en: Annie, because of the dim surroundings,

cues.zh: 把自己给绊倒了
cues.pinyin: ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 ban4 dao3 le5
cues.en: tripped herself and fell.

cues.zh: 等安妮从地上坐起来
cues.pinyin: deng3 an1 ni1 cong2 di4 shang4 zuo4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: By the time Annie sat up from the ground,

cues.zh: 那辆白色面包车已经来到了她的面前
cues.pinyin: na4 liang4 bai2 se4 mian4 bao1 che1 yi3 jing1 lai2 dao4 le5 ta1 de5 mian4 qian2
cues.en: that white van had already pulled up right in front of her.

cues.zh: 这也太吓人了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 tai4 xia4 ren2 le5
cues.en: This was just too terrifying.

cues.zh: 安妮连重新上马的时间都没有
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 lian2 chong2 xin1 shang4 ma3 de5 shi2 jian1 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: Annie didn't even have time to get back on her horse.

cues.zh: 立刻跑路
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 pao3 lu4
cues.en: and immediately ran for it.

cues.zh: 但两条腿怎么跑得过四个轮子呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 liang3 tiao2 tui3 zen3 me5 pao3 de2 guo4 si4 ge4 lun2 zi5 ne5
cues.en: But how could two legs outrun four wheels?

cues.zh: 安妮眼瞅着
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 yan3 chou3 zhe5
cues.en: Annie watched helplessly

cues.zh: 马上就要被面包车给追上了
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 bei4 mian4 bao1 che1 gei3 zhui1 shang4 le5
cues.en: as the van was about to catch up to her.

cues.zh: 好在危急时刻
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 wei1 ji2 shi2 ke4
cues.en: Luckily, in that critical moment,

cues.zh: 安妮的脑子转得飞快
cues.pinyin: an1 ni1 de5 nao3 zi5 zhuan3 de2 fei1 kuai4
cues.en: Annie's mind raced quickly,

cues.zh: 直接冲进了一旁的小树林
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 chong1 jin4 le5 yi1 pang2 de5 xiao3 shu4 lin2
cues.en: and she dashed straight into a small patch of woods nearby.

cues.zh: 毕竟在那儿
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 zai4 na4 er2
cues.en: After all, there,

cues.zh: 面包车根本无路可走
cues.pinyin: mian4 bao1 che1 gen1 ben3 wu2 lu4 ke3 zou3
cues.en: the van had nowhere to go.

cues.zh: 没啥用武之地
cues.pinyin: mei2 sha2 yong4 wu3 zhi1 di4
cues.en: and was useless.

cues.zh: 很快安妮摆脱那辆面包车
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 an1 ni1 bai3 tuo1 na4 liang4 mian4 bao1 che1
cues.en: Soon Annie had shaken off the van.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 所谓寻宝人其实就是一种玩家
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 xun2 bao3 ren2 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 wan2 jia1
cues.en: So-called treasure hunters are actually a type of player.

cues.zh: 首先一个名为江泰公的发起者
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 yi2 ge4 ming2 wei4 jiang1 tai4 gong1 de5 fa1 qi3 zhe3
cues.en: First, an organizer named Jiang Taigong starts it off.

cues.zh: 会在城里的某个角落藏的东西
cues.pinyin: hui4 zai4 cheng2 li3 de5 mou3 ge4 jiao3 luo4 cang2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: He'll hide something in some corner of the city.

cues.zh: 然后在网上发点宝物线索
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 wang3 shang4 fa1 dian3 bao3 wu4 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Then he posts treasure clues online.

cues.zh: 大家比赛谁先找到就算赢
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 bi3 sai4 shui2 xian1 zhao3 dao4 jiu4 suan4 ying2
cues.en: Everyone competes, and whoever finds it first wins.

cues.zh: 技术人员顺着线索查监控追 IP
cues.pinyin: ji4 shu4 ren2 yuan2 shun4 zhe5 xian4 suo3 cha2 jian1 kong4 zhui1 IP
cues.en: Technicians follow the clues, check surveillance footage, and trace the IP.

cues.zh: 但发布者非常鸡贼
cues.pinyin: dan4 fa1 bu4 zhe3 fei1 chang2 ji1 zei2
cues.en: But the poster is extremely sly.

cues.zh: 得自己打码不说
cues.pinyin: de2 zi4 ji3 da3 ma3 bu4 shuo1
cues.en: He blurs his face and says nothing.

cues.zh: 每次追踪还都会跳到新地址
cues.pinyin: mei3 ci4 zhui1 zong1 hai2 du1 hui4 tiao4 dao4 xin1 di4 zhi3
cues.en: Every time they track him, it jumps to a new address.

cues.zh: 最后总算发现
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zong3 suan4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Finally they discovered

cues.zh: 这网站更新用的是同一个无线网
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wang3 zhan4 geng1 xin1 yong4 de5 shi4 tong2 yi1 ge4 wu2 xian4 wang3
cues.en: the site's updates all came from the same wireless network.

cues.zh: 地点是一家名叫制服仓库的折扣店
cues.pinyin: di4 dian3 shi4 yi1 jia1 ming2 jiao4 zhi4 fu2 cang1 ku4 de5 zhe2 kou4 dian4
cues.en: The location was a discount store called Uniform Warehouse.

cues.zh: 警员班森和泰勒立刻杀到店里
cues.pinyin: jing3 yuan2 ban1 sen1 he2 tai4 lei1 li4 ke4 sha1 dao4 dian4 li3
cues.en: Officers Benson and Taylor rushed straight to the store.

cues.zh: 结果负责人直摇头
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fu4 ze2 ren2 zhi2 yao2 tou2
cues.en: But the manager just shook his head,

cues.zh: 表示店里有上百个员工呢
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 dian4 li3 you3 shang4 bai3 ge4 yuan2 gong1 ne5
cues.en: saying the store had over a hundred employees,

cues.zh: 根本没法精准锁定目标
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 mei2 fa3 jing1 zhun3 suo3 ding4 mu4 biao1
cues.en: so there was no way to pinpoint the target precisely.

cues.zh: 没办法泰勒直接放大招
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3 tai4 lei1 zhi2 jie1 fang4 da4 zhao1
cues.en: With no other choice, Taylor pulled out a big move.

cues.zh: 抄起麦克风就问江泰公在哪里
cues.pinyin: chao1 qi3 mai4 ke4 feng1 jiu4 wen4 jiang1 tai4 gong1 zai4 na3 li3
cues.en: He grabbed the microphone and asked where Jiang Taigong was,

cues.zh: 然后盯着员工们的反应看
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ding1 zhe5 yuan2 gong1 men5 de5 fan3 ying4 kan4
cues.en: then watched everyone's reactions closely.

cues.zh: 还真看见一个姑娘
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhen1 kan4 jian4 yi2 ge4 gu1 niang2
cues.en: Sure enough, he spotted a girl

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 眼神躲躲闪闪慌里慌张的
cues.pinyin: yan3 shen2 duo3 duo3 shan3 shan3 huang1 li3 huang1 zhang1 de5
cues.en: whose eyes were shifty and nervous.

cues.zh: 经过一番追问
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 yi1 fan1 zhui1 wen4
cues.en: After some persistent questioning,

cues.zh: 对方终于扛不住压力
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 zhong1 yu2 kang2 bu2 zhu4 ya1 li4
cues.en: she finally couldn't withstand the pressure

cues.zh: 承认视频是他发的
cues.pinyin: cheng2 ren4 shi4 pin2 shi4 ta1 fa1 de5
cues.en: and admitted she was the one who posted the video.

cues.zh: 但接着就发誓说
cues.pinyin: dan4 jie1 zhe5 jiu4 fa1 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: But then she swore

cues.zh: 在隧道里压根没见过尸体
cues.pinyin: zai4 sui4 dao4 li3 ya1 gen1 mei2 jian4 guo4 shi1 ti3
cues.en: she had never seen a body in the tunnel.

cues.zh: 警方反复扒拉她拍的视频
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 fan3 fu4 ba1 la1 ta1 pai1 de5 shi4 pin2
cues.en: The police went over the video she filmed again and again

cues.zh: 冷不丁发现行李箱是从火车上扔下来的
cues.pinyin: leng3 bu4 ding1 fa1 xian4 xing2 li3 xiang1 shi4 cong2 huo3 che1 shang4 reng1 xia4 lai2 de5
cues.en: and suddenly noticed the suitcase had been thrown off a train.

cues.zh: 放大画面看清车号和相对位置后
cues.pinyin: fang4 da4 hua4 mian4 kan4 qing1 che1 hao4 he2 xiang1 dui4 wei4 zhi4 hou4
cues.en: After zooming in to clearly see the car number and its position,

cues.zh: 警方开始着手检查列车的信用卡购票记录
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 kai1 shi3 zhuo2 shou3 jian3 cha2 lie4 che1 de5 xin4 yong4 ka3 gou4 piao4 ji4 lu4
cues.en: the police began checking the train's credit card ticket records.

cues.zh: 终于死者身份浮出水面
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 si3 zhe3 shen1 fen4 fu2 chu1 shui3 mian4
cues.en: Finally the victim's identity came to light:

cues.zh: 是 20 岁的艾米丽
cues.pinyin: shi4 20 sui4 de5 ai4 mi3 li4
cues.en: it was 20-year-old Emily.

cues.zh: 这不巧了吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 qiao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: Wasn't that quite a coincidence?

cues.zh: 说明她很可能是在旅行路上遭人害的
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 ta1 hen3 ke3 neng2 shi4 zai4 lv3 xing2 lu4 shang4 zao1 ren2 hai4 de5
cues.en: It suggested she was likely attacked while traveling

cues.zh: 然后半道被装进行李箱扔下火车
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ban4 dao4 bei4 zhuang1 jin4 xing2 li3 xiang1 reng1 xia4 huo3 che1
cues.en: and then stuffed into a suitcase and thrown off the train partway through.

cues.zh: 紧接着班森和泰勒找到艾米丽的爸妈
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 ban1 sen1 he2 tai4 lei1 zhao3 dao4 ai4 mi3 li4 de5 ba4 ma1
cues.en: Right after, Benson and Taylor found Emily's parents.

cues.zh: 他爸爸哭得那叫一个惨
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba4 ba4 ku1 de2 na4 jiao4 yi2 ge4 can3
cues.en: Her father cried so pitifully,

cues.zh: 只摇头说不可能是我闺女
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao2 tou2 shuo1 bu4 ke3 neng2 shi4 wo3 gui1 nv3
cues.en: just shaking his head and saying it couldn't be his daughter,

cues.zh: 因为艾米丽出门必定带着她的宝贝狗
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ai4 mi3 li4 chu1 men2 bi4 ding4 dai4 zhe5 ta1 de5 bao3 bei4 gou3
cues.en: because Emily never left home without her beloved dog.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 他们在欧文翻船的甲板底下
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 ou1 wen2 fan1 chuan2 de5 jia3 ban3 di3 xia4
cues.en: Under the deck of Owen's capsized boat,

cues.zh: 搜出十几公斤面粉
cues.pinyin: sou1 chu1 shi2 ji3 gong1 jin1 mian4 fen3
cues.en: they found over a dozen kilograms of flour.

cues.zh: 欧文一看自己
cues.pinyin: ou1 wen2 yi1 kan4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: The moment Owen realized

cues.zh: 卷进了杀人抛尸的恶性案件里
cues.pinyin: juan3 jin4 le5 sha1 ren2 pao1 shi1 de5 e4 xing4 an4 jian4 li3
cues.en: he'd been dragged into a brutal murder and body-dumping case,

cues.zh: 当场就认了自己贩卖面粉的事
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiu4 ren4 le5 zi4 ji3 fan4 mai4 mian4 fen3 de5 shi4
cues.en: he immediately confessed to dealing in flour.

cues.zh: 还说早在几个月前就跟艾米利分手了
cues.pinyin: hai2 shuo1 zao3 zai4 ji3 ge4 yue4 qian2 jiu4 gen1 ai4 mi3 li4 fen1 shou3 le5
cues.en: He also said he'd broken up with Emily months earlier,

cues.zh: 因为对方老觉得住在船上投于恶心
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dui4 fang1 lao3 jue2 de5 zhu4 zai4 chuan2 shang4 tou2 yu2 e3 xin1
cues.en: because she always thought living on the boat was disgusting.

cues.zh: 所以谈了一个周
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 tan2 le5 yi2 ge4 zhou1
cues.en: So they'd only dated for a week

cues.zh: 艾米丽就搬到公寓去了
cues.pinyin: ai4 mi3 li4 jiu4 ban1 dao4 gong1 yu4 qu4 le5
cues.en: before Emily moved out to an apartment.

cues.zh: 得到了这条线索
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 le5 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: With this lead in hand,

cues.zh: 班森和泰勒赶紧杀到那间公寓
cues.pinyin: ban1 sen1 he2 tai4 lei1 gan3 jin3 sha1 dao4 na4 jian1 gong1 yu4
cues.en: Benson and Taylor rushed to that apartment.

cues.zh: 一进门就瞧见艾米丽的宠物狗缩在角落
cues.pinyin: yi1 jin4 men2 jiu4 qiao2 jian4 ai4 mi3 li4 de5 chong3 wu4 gou3 suo1 zai4 jiao3 luo4
cues.en: As soon as they walked in, they saw Emily's pet dog curled up in a corner,

cues.zh: 桌上随意堆着一堆高档首饰
cues.pinyin: zhuo1 shang4 sui2 yi4 dui1 zhe5 yi1 dui1 gao1 dang4 shou3 shi4
cues.en: with a pile of high-end jewelry casually heaped on the table.

cues.zh: 就连旁边的花瓶都标着一千美金的价钱
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 pang2 bian1 de5 hua1 ping2 dou1 biao1 zhe5 yi1 qian1 mei3 jin1 de5 jia4 qian2
cues.en: Even the vase beside it was tagged at a thousand dollars.

cues.zh: 但翻看账单才发现
cues.pinyin: dan4 fan1 kan4 zhang4 dan1 cai2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: But checking the bills, they discovered

cues.zh: 她明明只是个在美甲沙龙打工的普通女孩
cues.pinyin: ta1 ming2 ming2 zhi3 shi4 ge4 zai4 mei3 jia3 sha1 long2 da3 gong1 de5 pu3 tong1 nv3 hai2
cues.en: she was clearly just an ordinary girl working at a nail salon.

cues.zh: 哪能负担得起这么奢侈的话笑
cues.pinyin: na3 neng2 fu4 dan1 de2 qi3 zhe4 me5 she1 chi3 de5 hua4 xiao4
cues.en: How could she possibly afford such a luxurious lifestyle?

cues.zh: 翻查她的电脑时
cues.pinyin: fan1 cha2 ta1 de5 dian4 nao3 shi2
cues.en: While going through her computer,

cues.zh: 两人发现艾米丽经常在蜜糖网
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 fa1 xian4 ai4 mi3 li4 jing1 chang2 zai4 mi4 tang2 wang3
cues.en: the two found Emily was often on a site called Honey Net,

cues.zh: 发布交友信息
cues.pinyin: fa1 bu4 jiao1 you3 xin4 xi1
cues.en: posting dating profiles,

cues.zh: 言语间满是诱惑
cues.pinyin: yan2 yu3 jian1 man3 shi4 you4 huo4
cues.en: her words dripping with allure.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 保不齐凶手就是在这盯上的他
cues.pinyin: bao3 bu4 qi2 xiong1 shou3 jiu4 shi4 zai4 zhe4 ding1 shang4 de5 ta1
cues.en: It was quite possible the killer had targeted her right there.

cues.zh: 班森和泰勒立马去查了网站的运营公司
cues.pinyin: ban1 sen1 he2 tai4 lei1 li4 ma3 qu4 cha2 le5 wang3 zhan4 de5 yun4 ying2 gong1 si1
cues.en: Benson and Taylor immediately went to check the website's parent company.

cues.zh: 与运输透露
cues.pinyin: yu3 yun4 shu1 tou4 lu4
cues.en: The other party revealed

cues.zh: 这是家广告联盟旗下有十多家类似
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 jia1 guang3 gao4 lian2 meng2 qi2 xia4 you3 shi2 duo1 jia1 lei4 si4
cues.en: it was an ad network that owned over a dozen sites similar to

cues.zh: 蜜糖网的网站
cues.pinyin: mi4 tang2 wang3 de5 wang3 zhan4
cues.en: Honey Net.

cues.zh: 创始人文思特别会笼络员工
cues.pinyin: chuang4 shi3 ren2 wen2 si1 te4 bie2 hui4 long3 luo4 yuan2 gong1
cues.en: The founder, Vince, was especially good at winning over his staff.

cues.zh: 只要在这上班就能享受免费干洗服务
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 zai4 zhe4 shang4 ban1 jiu4 neng2 xiang3 shou4 mian3 fei4 gan1 xi3 fu2 wu4
cues.en: Just working there got you free dry-cleaning service,

cues.zh: 一日三餐供应
cues.pinyin: yi1 ri4 san1 can1 gong1 ying4
cues.en: three meals a day,

cues.zh: 还有悬面的健康保险
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 xuan2 mian4 de5 jian4 kang1 bao3 xian3
cues.en: and comprehensive health insurance,

cues.zh: 甚至包括免费的整形手术
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 bao1 kuo4 mian3 fei4 de5 zheng3 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: even including free plastic surgery.

cues.zh: 他整天挂在嘴边的宗旨
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng3 tian1 gua4 zai4 zui3 bian1 de5 zong1 zhi3
cues.en: The motto he always kept on his lips

cues.zh: 就是要让所有员工在快乐中工作
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yao4 rang4 suo3 you3 yuan2 gong1 zai4 kuai4 le4 zhong1 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: was that every employee should work happily.

cues.zh: 还当问到艾米利时
cues.pinyin: hai2 dang1 wen4 dao4 ai4 mi3 li4 shi2
cues.en: But when asked about Emily,

cues.zh: 文思却装出一副完全不认识的样子
cues.pinyin: wen2 si1 que4 zhuang1 chu1 yi1 fu4 wan2 quan2 bu4 ren4 shi2 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Vince acted like he didn't know her at all,

cues.zh: 还拿保密协议当挡箭拍
cues.pinyin: hai2 na2 bao3 mi4 xie2 yi4 dang1 dang3 jian4 pai1
cues.en: hiding behind the NDA as his shield,

cues.zh: 说什么也不肯向警方提供任何信息
cues.pinyin: shuo1 shen2 me5 ye3 bu4 ken3 xiang4 jing3 fang1 ti2 gong1 ren4 he2 xin4 xi1
cues.en: refusing to give the police any information no matter what,

cues.zh: 包括客户的约会邮件或聊天记录
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 ke4 hu4 de5 yue1 hui4 you2 jian4 huo4 liao2 tian1 ji4 lu4
cues.en: including clients' dating emails or chat logs.

cues.zh: 没办法
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: With no other option,

cues.zh: 警方只能再次从网站上寻找线索
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 zhi3 neng2 zai4 ci4 cong2 wang3 zhan4 shang4 xun2 zhao3 xian4 suo3
cues.en: the police had to search for clues on the website again,

cues.zh: 结果发现公司已经把艾米利的信
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 gong1 si1 yi3 jing1 ba3 ai4 mi3 li4 de5 xin4
cues.en: and found the company had already wiped Emily's messages.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 泰勒又问她的未婚夫
cues.pinyin: tai4 lei1 you4 wen4 ta1 de5 wei4 hun1 fu1
cues.en: Taylor then asked her fiancé

cues.zh: 知不知道她做这个
cues.pinyin: zhi1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 zuo4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: whether he knew what Emily did for a living.

cues.zh: 帕梅娜说知道
cues.pinyin: pa4 mei2 na4 shuo1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Pamela said yes, she knew,

cues.zh: 还让她放心就行
cues.pinyin: hai2 rang4 ta1 fang4 xin1 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: and had told Emily not to worry about it.

cues.zh: 好在泰勒没忘记初衷
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 tai4 lei1 mei2 wang4 ji4 chu1 zhong1
cues.en: Luckily Taylor hadn't forgotten the real goal,

cues.zh: 很快把话题引到了艾米丽身上
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 ba3 hua4 ti2 yin3 dao4 le5 ai4 mi3 li4 shen1 shang4
cues.en: and quickly steered the conversation back to Emily.

cues.zh: 这才得知艾米丽最近交往了一个非
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 de2 zhi1 ai4 mi3 li4 zui4 jin4 jiao1 wang3 le5 yi2 ge4 fei1
cues.en: That's how they learned Emily had recently been dating an extremely

cues.zh: 常有钱的男友
cues.pinyin: chang2 you3 qian2 de5 nan2 you3
cues.en: wealthy boyfriend.

cues.zh: 虽然帕梅娜不知道对方姓名
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 pa4 mei2 na4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 dui4 fang1 xing4 ming2
cues.en: Although Pamela didn't know his name,

cues.zh: 但在上一次私人约会时
cues.pinyin: dan4 zai4 shang4 yi1 ci4 si1 ren2 yue1 hui4 shi2
cues.en: during their last private date

cues.zh: 她偷偷拍下了很多照片
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou1 tou1 pai1 xia4 le5 hen3 duo1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: she had secretly taken a lot of photos.

cues.zh: 而令泰勒无论如何也想不到的是
cues.pinyin: er2 ling4 tai4 lei1 wu2 lun4 ru2 he2 ye3 xiang3 bu2 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: What Taylor never expected

cues.zh: 照片里的男人竟然就是蜜糖网的老板文斯
cues.pinyin: zhao4 pian1 li3 de5 nan2 ren2 jing4 ran2 jiu4 shi4 mi4 tang2 wang3 de5 lao3 ban3 wen2 si1
cues.en: was that the man in those photos was none other than Vince, the boss of Honey Net.

cues.zh: 很显然这家伙之前对着警方撒
cues.pinyin: hen3 xian3 ran2 zhe4 jia1 huo5 zhi1 qian2 dui4 zhe5 jing3 fang1 sa1
cues.en: Clearly this guy had already told the police

cues.zh: 了个弥天大谎
cues.pinyin: le5 ge4 mi2 tian1 da4 huang3
cues.en: a huge lie.

cues.zh: 于是文斯被传唤到了警局
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wen2 si1 bei4 chuan2 huan4 dao4 le5 jing3 ju2
cues.en: So Vince was summoned to the police station,

cues.zh: 一看证据摆在面前立马松了口
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 zheng4 ju4 bai3 zai4 mian4 qian2 li4 ma3 song1 le5 kou3
cues.en: and the moment he saw the evidence laid out, he cracked immediately.

cues.zh: 但又开始哭惨卖乖
cues.pinyin: dan4 you4 kai1 shi3 ku1 can3 mai4 guai1
cues.en: But then he started crying and playing the victim,

cues.zh: 直呼他是上市公司老总
cues.pinyin: zhi2 hu1 ta1 shi4 shang4 shi4 gong1 si1 lao3 zong3
cues.en: insisting he was the head of a publicly listed company—

cues.zh: 难道不要面子呀
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 bu2 yao4 mian4 zi5 ya5
cues.en: didn't he have a reputation to protect?

cues.zh: 而且他闺女都 17 岁了
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 gui1 nv3 dou1 17 sui4 le5
cues.en: Besides, his daughter was already 17,

cues.zh: 前妻要是知道他跟小姑娘谈恋
cues.pinyin: qian2 qi1 yao4 shi4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 gen1 xiao3 gu1 niang2 tan2 lian4
cues.en: and if his ex-wife found out he was dating a young girl,

cues.zh: 爱肯定闹上天
cues.pinyin: ai4 ken3 ding4 nao4 shang4 tian1
cues.en: it would cause an uproar.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 隧道惊现裸尸，女孩警局弑父，牵出富豪糜烂私生活。

cues.zh: 再说他是真把艾米丽当闺女疼
cues.pinyin: zai4 shuo1 ta1 shi4 zhen1 ba3 ai4 mi3 li4 dang1 gui1 nv3 teng2
cues.en: Besides, he really did treat Emily like a daughter,

cues.zh: 带她逛博物馆鼓励她考大学
cues.pinyin: dai4 ta1 guang4 bo2 wu4 guan3 gu3 li4 ta1 kao3 da4 xue2
cues.en: taking her to museums and encouraging her to apply to college—

cues.zh: 怎么可能下死手
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 ke3 neng2 xia4 si3 shou3
cues.en: how could he possibly have killed her?

cues.zh: 她挠着头堵呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 nao2 zhe5 tou2 du3 ne5
cues.en: He scratched his head and said

cues.zh: 可能是因为艾米丽和女儿年龄相仿
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ai4 mi3 li4 he2 nv3 er2 nian2 ling2 xiang1 fang3
cues.en: it was probably because Emily was close in age to his own daughter.

cues.zh: 自己平时忙得脚不沾地
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 ping2 shi2 mang2 de2 jiao3 bu4 zhan1 di4
cues.en: He himself was always so busy he barely had a moment to rest,

cues.zh: 总觉得亏欠闺女
cues.pinyin: zong3 jue2 de5 kui1 qian4 gui1 nv3
cues.en: and always felt he owed his daughter something,

cues.zh: 才把这段感情处成了畸形补偿
cues.pinyin: cai2 ba3 zhe4 duan4 gan3 qing2 chu4 cheng2 le5 ji1 xing2 bu3 chang2
cues.en: so this relationship turned into a twisted form of compensation.

cues.zh: 当班森问其案发当天行程
cues.pinyin: dang1 ban1 sen1 wen4 qi2 an4 fa1 dang4 tian1 xing2 cheng2
cues.en: When Benson asked about his schedule on the day of the murder,

cues.zh: 文斯拍着胸脯打包票
cues.pinyin: wen2 si1 pai1 zhe5 xiong1 pu2 da3 bao1 piao4
cues.en: Vince confidently swore, hand on his chest,

cues.zh: 艾米丽下午三点来公寓
cues.pinyin: ai4 mi3 li4 xia4 wu3 san1 dian3 lai2 gong1 yu4
cues.en: that Emily came to the apartment at 3pm.

cues.zh: 两人因为感情的事吵了两句
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 yin1 wei4 gan3 qing2 de5 shi4 chao3 le5 liang3 ju4
cues.en: The two argued briefly over their relationship,

cues.zh: 他三点四十五分就拖着行李走了
cues.pinyin: ta1 san1 dian3 si4 shi2 wu3 fen1 jiu4 tuo1 zhe5 xing2 li3 zou3 le5
cues.en: and she left dragging her luggage at 3:45.

cues.zh: 而文斯四点准时去学校看闺女替足球赛
cues.pinyin: er2 wen2 si1 si4 dian3 zhun3 shi2 qu4 xue2 xiao4 kan4 gui1 nv3 ti4 zu2 qiu2 sai4
cues.en: Vince then went to the school right at 4 to watch his daughter's soccer match.

cues.zh: 为了戳穿他的鬼话
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 chuo1 chuan1 ta1 de5 gui3 hua4
cues.en: To expose his lies,

cues.zh: 班森和泰勒找到他女儿夏洛特
cues.pinyin: ban1 sen1 he2 tai4 lei1 zhao3 dao4 ta1 nv3 er2 xia4 luo4 te4
cues.en: Benson and Taylor went to find his daughter, Charlotte.

cues.zh: 一开始夏洛特支支吾吾说
cues.pinyin: yi1 kai1 shi3 xia4 luo4 te4 zhi1 zhi1 wu2 wu2 shuo1
cues.en: At first Charlotte stammered and said

cues.zh: 爸爸确实来看比赛了
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 que4 shi2 lai2 kan4 bi3 sai4 le5
cues.en: her dad really had come to watch the match.

cues.zh: 结果亲妈当场拆台
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 qin1 ma1 dang1 chang3 chai1 tai2
cues.en: But her mother blew his story apart on the spot,

cues.zh: 表示当天闺女是哭着回家的
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 dang4 tian1 gui1 nv3 shi4 ku1 zhe5 hui2 jia1 de5
cues.en: saying that day their daughter had come home crying

cues.zh: 还埋怨父亲又放鸽子
cues.pinyin: hai2 man2 yuan4 fu4 qin1 you4 fang4 ge1 zi5
cues.en: and complained that her father had stood her up again.

cues.zh: 在班森的追问下
cues.pinyin: zai4 ban1 sen1 de5 zhui1 wen4 xia4
cues.en: Under Benson's continued questioning,

items.title_zh: 笑话38｜会上火的椰子｜小心〝肝〞｜头皮发〝毛〞｜记忆力｜刺青会变矮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明出国玩买椰子喝
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 chu1 guo2 wan2 mai3 ye1 zi5 he1
cues.en: Xiaoming went abroad and bought a coconut to drink.

cues.zh: 到了商店看到招牌写
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 shang1 dian4 kan4 dao4 zhao1 pai2 xie3
cues.en: When he got to the store, he saw the sign.

cues.zh: 椰子一个 30 元小明心想
cues.pinyin: ye1 zi5 yi2 ge4 30 yuan2 xiao3 ming2 xin1 xiang3
cues.en: "Coconuts are 30 yuan each," Xiaoming thought,

cues.zh: 太便宜了就买了两个这时导游说
cues.pinyin: tai4 pian2 yi5 le5 jiu4 mai3 le5 liang3 ge4 zhe4 shi2 dao3 you2 shui4
cues.en: "That's so cheap!" and bought two. At that point the tour guide said,

cues.zh: 少喝一点啊当心椰子越喝
cues.pinyin: shao3 he1 yi4 dian3 a5 dang1 xin1 ye1 zi5 yue4 he1
cues.en: "Drink less — careful, the more coconut you drink,

cues.zh: 火气越大小明心想
cues.pinyin: huo3 qi4 yue4 da4 xiao3 ming2 xin1 xiang3
cues.en: the more your body heat rises," Xiaoming thought,

cues.zh: 听你在胡说八道椰子应该越喝越退火吧
cues.pinyin: ting1 ni3 zai4 hu2 shuo1 ba1 dao4 ye1 zi5 ying1 gai1 yue4 he1 yue4 tui4 huo3 ba5
cues.en: "Nonsense, coconut should cool you down the more you drink, right?"

cues.zh: 小明继续沿着商店街往前走
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ji4 xu4 yan2 zhe5 shang1 dian4 jie1 wang3 qian2 zou3
cues.en: Xiaoming kept walking along the shopping street.

cues.zh: 第二家招牌写
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jia1 zhao1 pai2 xie3
cues.en: The second shop's sign read,

cues.zh: 椰子一个 20 元
cues.pinyin: ye1 zi5 yi2 ge4 20 yuan2
cues.en: "Coconuts, 20 yuan each."

cues.zh: 第三家招牌写椰子一个 20 元
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 jia1 zhao1 pai2 xie3 ye1 zi5 yi2 ge4 20 yuan2
cues.en: The third shop's sign read: coconuts, 20 yuan each,

cues.zh: 1 个 10 元
cues.pinyin: 1 ge4 10 yuan2
cues.en: "1 for 10 yuan."

cues.zh: 第四家招牌写
cues.pinyin: di4 si4 jia1 zhao1 pai2 xie3
cues.en: The fourth shop's sign read,

cues.zh: 也是 1 个 10 元
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 1 ge4 10 yuan2
cues.en: "Also 1 for 10 yuan,

cues.zh: 买 1 送 1
cues.pinyin: mai3 1 song4 1
cues.en: buy one get one free."

items.title_zh: 笑话38｜会上火的椰子｜小心〝肝〞｜头皮发〝毛〞｜记忆力｜刺青会变矮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 在桌子上
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhuo1 zi5 shang4
cues.en: On the table,

cues.zh: 要怎么样才能知道它后面是什么呢
cues.pinyin: yao4 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 neng2 zhi1 dao4 ta1 hou4 mian4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: how can you tell what's on the other side?

cues.zh: 嗯用一个时光机
cues.pinyin: n2 yong4 yi2 ge4 shi2 guang1 ji1
cues.en: "Hmm, use a time machine?"

cues.zh: 当然是翻过来看就可以了
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 shi4 fan1 guo4 lai2 kan4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: "Of course not — just flip it over and look!"

items.title_zh: 笑话38｜会上火的椰子｜小心〝肝〞｜头皮发〝毛〞｜记忆力｜刺青会变矮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 护士看到病人在病房喝酒
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 kan4 dao4 bing4 ren2 zai4 bing4 fang2 he1 jiu3
cues.en: A nurse saw a patient drinking in his hospital room,

cues.zh: 就走过去小声的叮咛说
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zou3 guo4 qu4 xiao3 sheng1 de5 ding1 ning2 shuo1
cues.en: so she walked over and quietly warned him, saying,

cues.zh: 小金刚
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jin1 gang1
cues.en: "My dear" (literally: liver of my heart),

cues.zh: 小宝贝
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bao3 bei4
cues.en: "my little treasure,

cues.zh: 长头发呢
cues.pinyin: zhang3 tou2 fa4 ne5
cues.en: do you want to grow your hair?"

cues.zh: 不头长头发就去看医生啊
cues.pinyin: bu4 tou2 zhang3 tou2 fa4 jiu4 qu4 kan4 yi1 sheng1 a5
cues.en: "If you want to grow hair, go see a doctor,"

cues.zh: 错去看鬼片
cues.pinyin: cuo4 qu4 kan4 gui3 pian4
cues.en: "Wrong — go watch a horror movie,

cues.zh: 因为看鬼片会头皮发毛
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 kan4 gui3 pian4 hui4 tou2 pi2 fa1 mao2
cues.en: because watching horror movies gives you goosebumps (literally makes your scalp 'grow hair')."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话38｜会上火的椰子｜小心〝肝〞｜头皮发〝毛〞｜记忆力｜刺青会变矮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 一位计程车司机
cues.pinyin: yi1 wei4 ji4 cheng2 che1 si1 ji1
cues.en: A taxi driver,

cues.zh: 在晚上载了一名提着一袋苹果的富人
cues.pinyin: zai4 wan3 shang4 zai4 le5 yi1 ming2 ti2 zhe5 yi1 dai4 ping2 guo3 de5 fu4 ren2
cues.en: one night picked up a rich man carrying a bag of apples.

cues.zh: 富人上车边吃苹果边说
cues.pinyin: fu4 ren2 shang4 che1 bian1 chi1 ping2 guo3 bian1 shuo1
cues.en: The rich man got in and said while eating an apple,

cues.zh: 我生前最喜欢吃苹果了
cues.pinyin: wo3 sheng1 qian2 zui4 xi3 huan1 chi1 ping2 guo3 le5
cues.en: "I loved eating apples most when I was alive."

cues.zh: 司机听了吓得发抖
cues.pinyin: si1 ji1 ting1 le5 xia4 de2 fa1 dou3
cues.en: The driver was so scared he started shaking,

cues.zh: 以为自己遇上阿飘了
cues.pinyin: yi3 wei2 zi4 ji3 yu4 shang4 a1 piao1 le5
cues.en: thinking he'd run into a ghost.

cues.zh: 接着富人又说
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 fu4 ren2 you4 shuo1
cues.en: Then the rich man said again,

cues.zh: 但是生完之后就没那么喜欢吃了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 sheng1 wan2 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 mei2 na4 me5 xi3 huan1 chi1 le5
cues.en: "But after I gave birth, I didn't like them as much anymore."

cues.zh: 好啊
cues.pinyin: hao3 a5
cues.en: "Alright,

cues.zh: 你的记忆力好不好
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 ji4 yi4 li4 hao3 bu4 hao3
cues.en: is your memory good?"

cues.zh: 当然好啊
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 hao3 a5
cues.en: "Of course it is."

cues.zh: 那你昨天吃了什么
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zuo2 tian1 chi1 le5 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Then what did you eat yesterday?"

cues.zh: 最简单
cues.pinyin: zui4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: "Easy —

cues.zh: 我吃了面包
cues.pinyin: wo3 chi1 le5 mian4 bao1
cues.en: I ate bread,

cues.zh: 鸡蛋
cues.pinyin: ji1 dan4
cues.en: eggs,

cues.zh: 米粉
cues.pinyin: mi3 fen3
cues.en: rice noodles,

cues.zh: 炒饭
cues.pinyin: chao3 fan4
cues.en: and fried rice."

cues.zh: 那我刚刚问你的第一个问题是什么
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 gang1 gang1 wen4 ni3 de5 di4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "So what was the first question I just asked you?"

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 2亿中国人得了这个小病，不害命，但闹心！

cues.zh: 沙漠种树人要做的是植下树种
cues.pinyin: sha1 mo4 zhong4 shu4 ren2 yao4 zuo4 de5 shi4 zhi2 xia4 shu4 zhong3
cues.en: What desert tree-planters need to do is plant the seeds

cues.zh: 让植物根系牢牢抓住沙粒
cues.pinyin: rang4 zhi2 wu4 gen1 xi4 lao2 lao2 zhua1 zhu4 sha1 li4
cues.en: So that the plants' roots can grip the sand firmly

cues.zh: 让沙漠不再侵蚀绿洲
cues.pinyin: rang4 sha1 mo4 bu4 zai4 qin1 shi2 lv4 zhou1
cues.en: Stopping the desert from encroaching on the oasis any further

cues.zh: 腐术粮携手百万森林公益
cues.pinyin: fu3 shu4 liang2 xie2 shou3 bai3 wan4 sen1 lin2 gong1 yi4
cues.en: They've teamed up with the Million Forests charity project

cues.zh: 在阿拉善沙漠边缘种下一片绿意
cues.pinyin: zai4 a1 la1 shan4 sha1 mo4 bian1 yuan2 zhong4 xia4 yi1 pian4 lv4 yi4
cues.en: Planting a stretch of green at the edge of the Alxa Desert

cues.zh: 让绿色沙沙生长
cues.pinyin: rang4 lv4 se4 sha1 sha1 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: Letting that green grow, spreading further and further

cues.zh: 将健康呼吸还给地球
cues.pinyin: jiang1 jian4 kang1 hu1 xi1 huan2 gei3 di4 qiu2
cues.en: Giving the earth back its healthy breath

cues.zh: 和生活在其中的人们
cues.pinyin: he2 sheng1 huo2 zai4 qi2 zhong1 de5 ren2 men5
cues.en: Along with the people who live there

items.title_zh: 笑话82｜心脏病发作｜孟母雕像价值？｜〝虫〞前有一只狗｜帅不能吃冰｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 老婆我心脏病发作的快去叫医生快
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2 wo3 xin1 zang4 bing4 fa1 zuo4 de5 kuai4 qu4 jiao4 yi1 sheng1 kuai4
cues.en: Honey, I'm having a heart attack, hurry and call a doctor, hurry!

cues.zh: 好那我手机没电了我用你手机打
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 wo3 shou3 ji1 mei2 dian4 le5 wo3 yong4 ni3 shou3 ji1 da3
cues.en: Okay, but my phone's out of battery, I'll use yours to call.

cues.zh: 你手机密码赶快给我啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 shou3 ji1 mi4 ma3 gan3 kuai4 gei3 wo3 a5
cues.en: Give me your phone password, quick!

cues.zh: 我打电话给医院叫救护车
cues.pinyin: wo3 da3 dian4 hua4 gei3 yi1 yuan4 jiao4 jiu4 hu4 che1
cues.en: I'm calling the hospital for an ambulance.

cues.zh: 那我觉得我现在好多了
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 xian4 zai4 hao3 duo1 le5
cues.en: Actually, I feel a lot better now.

cues.zh: 已经不需要打电话了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 bu4 xu1 yao4 da3 dian4 hua4 le5
cues.en: No need to call anymore.

cues.zh: 我问你哦如果有一座纪念孟子妈妈的雕像
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 ru2 guo3 you3 yi1 zuo4 ji4 nian4 meng4 zi5 ma1 ma1 de5 diao1 xiang4
cues.en: Let me ask you, if there were a statue commemorating Mencius's mother,

cues.zh: 那它的价值会是多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 de5 jia4 zhi2 hui4 shi4 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: how much would it be worth?

cues.zh: 纪念孟子妈妈的雕像
cues.pinyin: ji4 nian4 meng4 zi5 ma1 ma1 de5 diao1 xiang4
cues.en: A statue commemorating Mencius's mother...

cues.zh: 那要看它是什么材质做的
cues.pinyin: na4 yao4 kan4 ta1 shi4 shen2 me5 cai2 zhi4 zuo4 de5
cues.en: That depends on what material it's made of.

cues.zh: 如果是黄金就很多钱
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 huang2 jin1 jiu4 hen3 duo1 qian2
cues.en: If it's gold, it'd be worth a lot.

cues.zh: 如果是石头就便宜一点
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 shi2 tou5 jiu4 bian4 yi2 yi4 dian3
cues.en: If it's stone, it'd be cheaper.

cues.zh: 错答案是三千元
cues.pinyin: cuo4 da2 an4 shi4 san1 qian1 yuan2
cues.en: Wrong, the answer is three thousand dollars.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话82｜心脏病发作｜孟母雕像价值？｜〝虫〞前有一只狗｜帅不能吃冰｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 为什么别人的男朋友
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 bie2 ren2 de5 nan2 peng2 you3
cues.en: Why do other people's boyfriends

cues.zh: 都会 po 自己女朋友的照片
cues.pinyin: du1 hui4 po zi4 ji3 nv3 peng2 you3 de5 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: always post photos of their girlfriends,

cues.zh: 你从来不 po 呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 cong2 lai2 bu4 po ne5
cues.en: but you never post any?

cues.zh: 我有长得很难看吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 zhang3 de2 hen3 nan2 kan4 ma5
cues.en: Am I really that ugly?

cues.zh: 还是你有其他的女朋友
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ni3 you3 qi2 ta1 de5 nv3 peng2 you3
cues.en: Or do you have another girlfriend?

cues.zh: 你仔细想想
cues.pinyin: ni3 zi3 xi4 xiang3 xiang3
cues.en: Think about it carefully.

cues.zh: 如果你在路上捡到 50 元
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zai4 lu4 shang4 jian3 dao4 50 yuan2
cues.en: If you found 50 dollars on the street,

cues.zh: 你会 PO 上网炫耀吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 PO shang4 wang3 xuan4 yao4 ma5
cues.en: would you post it online to show off?

cues.zh: 会呀
cues.pinyin: hui4 ya5
cues.en: Yeah, I would.

cues.zh: 我一定会和我家人炫耀
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 ding4 hui4 he2 wo3 jia1 ren2 xuan4 yao4
cues.en: I'd definitely brag about it to my family.

cues.zh: 那如果你今天捡到 50 万元呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 jin1 tian1 jian3 dao4 50 wan4 yuan2 ne5
cues.en: What if you found 500,000 dollars today?

cues.zh: 哦那我懂了
cues.pinyin: o2 na4 wo3 dong3 le5
cues.en: Oh, now I get it.

cues.zh: 我不应该怀疑你的
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 ying1 gai1 huai2 yi2 ni3 de5
cues.en: I shouldn't have doubted you.

cues.zh: 从前有一只狗
cues.pinyin: cong2 qian2 you3 yi1 zhi1 gou3
cues.en: Once upon a time there was a dog.

cues.zh: 它在前面是猫
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 qian2 mian4 shi4 mao1
cues.en: In front of it was a cat.

cues.zh: 猫在前面是一只老鼠
cues.pinyin: mao1 zai4 qian2 mian4 shi4 yi1 zhi1 lao3 shu3
cues.en: In front of the cat was a mouse.

cues.zh: 那狗的后面是什么
cues.pinyin: na4 gou3 de5 hou4 mian4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: So what's behind the dog?

cues.zh: 狗的后面
cues.pinyin: gou3 de5 hou4 mian4
cues.en: Behind the dog...

cues.zh: 狗的后面是狗尾巴
cues.pinyin: gou3 de5 hou4 mian4 shi4 gou3 wei3 ba5
cues.en: Behind the dog is the dog's tail.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 龙虾伊面的家庭做法【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 新年快乐我真的不敢相信
cues.pinyin: xin1 nian2 kuai4 le4 wo3 zhen1 de5 bu4 gan3 xiang1 xin4
cues.en: Happy New Year, I really can't believe it.

cues.zh: 2018 年马上就要到了
cues.pinyin: 2018 nian2 ma3 shang4 jiu4 yao4 dao4 le5
cues.en: 2018 is almost here.

cues.zh: 那今天给大家带来的是这个龙虾伊面
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 gei3 da4 jia1 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 yi1 mian4
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you this lobster e-fu noodles.

cues.zh: 因为这个面条象征着好运还有长寿
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 mian4 tiao2 xiang4 zheng1 zhe5 hao3 yun4 hai2 you3 chang2 shou4
cues.en: Because the noodles symbolize good luck and longevity.

cues.zh: 所以我希望大家在新的一年里呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 zai4 xin1 de5 yi1 nian2 li3 ne5
cues.en: So I hope that in the new year everyone will have

cues.zh: 都有着许许多多的好运
cues.pinyin: dou1 you3 zhe5 xu3 xu3 duo1 duo1 de5 hao3 yun4
cues.en: lots and lots of good luck.

cues.zh: 万事如意长命百岁
cues.pinyin: wan4 shi4 ru2 yi4 chang2 ming4 bai3 sui4
cues.en: May everything go your way and may you live a long life.

cues.zh: 赶快让我们开始吧
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 rang4 wo3 men5 kai1 shi3 ba5
cues.en: Let's hurry and get started.

cues.zh: 首先这个龙虾洗干净
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 xi3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: First, wash the lobster clean.

cues.zh: 然后擦干之后呢我们可以用我们的刀背
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ca1 gan4 zhi1 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 wo3 men5 de5 dao1 bei4
cues.en: Then after drying it, we can use the back of our knife

cues.zh: 把这个龙虾的爪子这边呢给它敲破
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 de5 zhua3 zi5 zhe4 bian1 ne5 gei3 ta1 qiao1 po4
cues.en: to crack open the lobster's claws on this side.

cues.zh: 这样子等下吃的时候就比较容易
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 deng3 xia4 chi1 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4
cues.en: This way it'll be easier to eat later.

cues.zh: 然后用一个汤匙呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 yi2 ge4 tang1 chi2 ne5
cues.en: Then, using a spoon,

cues.zh: 把这个龙虾里面
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 li3 mian4
cues.en: from inside the lobster

cues.zh: 黑色的这个内脏给它挖出来
cues.pinyin: hei1 se4 de5 zhe4 ge5 nei4 zang4 gei3 ta1 wa1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: scoop out the black innards.

cues.zh: 接下来我们在这个滚热的热水里面呢
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 gun3 re4 de5 re4 shui3 li3 mian4 ne5
cues.en: Next, in this boiling hot water,

cues.zh: 放进来 6 oz 的伊面
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 6 oz de5 yi1 mian4
cues.en: add in 6 oz of noodles.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 龙虾伊面的家庭做法【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 然后给它煮大概 30 秒钟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 zhu3 da4 gai4 30 miao3 zhong1
cues.en: Then cook it for about 30 seconds.

cues.zh: 煮到软就可以了
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dao4 ruan3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: Cook until soft, that's enough.

cues.zh: 接下来我们把它拿出来
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 na2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Next we take it out,

cues.zh: 先放到一边
cues.pinyin: xian1 fang4 dao4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: and set it aside first.

cues.zh: 在一个热锅里呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 re4 guo1 li3 ne5
cues.en: In a hot pan,

cues.zh: 我们放进来两汤匙油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: we add in two tablespoons of oil,

cues.zh: 两瓣蒜
cues.pinyin: liang3 ban4 suan4
cues.en: two cloves of garlic,

cues.zh: 然后把这个蒜给炒香
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 suan4 gei3 chao3 xiang1
cues.en: then sauté the garlic until fragrant.

cues.zh: 那现在呢我们放入刚刚的伊面
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 gang1 gang1 de5 yi1 mian4
cues.en: Now we add in the noodles from before,

cues.zh: 然后给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: and mix them evenly,

cues.zh: 直到这个面呢有这个大蒜的香气
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 mian4 ne5 you3 zhe4 ge5 da4 suan4 de5 xiang1 qi4
cues.en: until the noodles have that garlic aroma.

cues.zh: 把面条呢先放到这个盘上
cues.pinyin: ba3 mian4 tiao2 ne5 xian1 fang4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 pan2 shang4
cues.en: Put the noodles on this plate first.

cues.zh: 在这个锅子里我们再放入五汤匙油
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo1 zi5 li3 wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 ru4 wu3 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: In this pan we add another five tablespoons of oil,

cues.zh: 五片姜
cues.pinyin: wu3 pian4 jiang1
cues.en: five slices of ginger,

cues.zh: 三瓣蒜
cues.pinyin: san1 ban4 suan4
cues.en: three cloves of garlic,

cues.zh: 两根葱
cues.pinyin: liang3 gen1 cong1
cues.en: two scallions,

cues.zh: 葱白的地方
cues.pinyin: cong1 bai2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: the white part of the scallion.

cues.zh: 然后也是把这个食材的这个香
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shi2 cai2 de5 zhe4 ge5 xiang1
cues.en: Then we also sauté these ingredients

cues.zh: 气炒出来之后
cues.pinyin: qi4 chao3 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: until their fragrance comes out, and then

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 龙虾伊面的家庭做法【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 接下来放进来两汤匙蚝油
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 tang1 chi2 hao2 you2
cues.en: next we add in two tablespoons of oyster sauce,

cues.zh: 两汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: liang3 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: two tablespoons of soy sauce,

cues.zh: 两汤匙烧薰酒
cues.pinyin: liang3 tang1 chi2 shao1 xun1 jiu3
cues.en: two tablespoons of Shaoxing wine,

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: a little white pepper,

cues.zh: 少许鱼
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yu2
cues.en: a little fish sauce,

cues.zh: 少许香油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 xiang1 you2
cues.en: a little sesame oil,

cues.zh: 一个半杯的鸡汤
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ban4 bei1 de5 ji1 tang1
cues.en: one and a half cups of chicken stock.

cues.zh: 然后我们把这个锅盖盖上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 guo1 gai4 gai4 shang4
cues.en: Then we put the lid on the pot.

cues.zh: 然后我们让这个龙虾在锅里面
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 rang4 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 zai4 guo1 li3 mian4
cues.en: Then we let the lobster

cues.zh: 慢慢的煮一下
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 zhu3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: simmer slowly in the pot

cues.zh: 大概 5 分钟
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 5 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: for about 5 minutes,

cues.zh: 直到这个龙虾呢全部变红为止
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 ne5 quan2 bu4 bian4 hong2 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: until the lobster has turned completely red.

cues.zh: 那我们打开盖子之后呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 da3 kai1 gai4 zi5 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After we open the lid,

cues.zh: 我们发现其实有一些龙虾的地方呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fa1 xian4 qi2 shi2 you3 yi1 xie1 long2 xia1 de5 di4 fang1 ne5
cues.en: we find that actually some parts of the lobster

cues.zh: 还没有完全变红
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 bian4 hong2
cues.en: haven't turned completely red yet,

cues.zh: 那我们就再继续的给它煮
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jiu4 zai4 ji4 xu4 de5 gei3 ta1 zhu3
cues.en: so we continue cooking it,

cues.zh: 确保说让我们的龙虾都熟了为止
cues.pinyin: que4 bao3 shuo1 rang4 wo3 men5 de5 long2 xia1 dou1 shu2 le5 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: to make sure our lobster is fully cooked through.

cues.zh: 接下来我们放进来一些玉米粉水
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 xie1 yu4 mi3 fen3 shui3
cues.en: Next we add in some cornstarch slurry

cues.zh: 把这个汤汁变得浓稠一些
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 tang1 zhi1 bian4 de2 nong2 chou2 yi1 xie1
cues.en: to thicken the sauce a bit.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 龙虾伊面的家庭做法【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 那我这里有一汤匙的玉米粉
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 yu4 mi3 fen3
cues.en: Here I have one tablespoon of cornstarch,

cues.zh: 加上两汤匙的水
cues.pinyin: jia1 shang4 liang3 tang1 chi2 de5 shui3
cues.en: plus two tablespoons of water,

cues.zh: 然后我们就给它放进来搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 jiu4 gei3 ta1 fang4 jin4 lai2 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: and we add it in and mix it evenly.

cues.zh: 这里呢我还有两根葱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 ne5 wo3 hai2 you3 liang3 gen1 cong1
cues.en: Here I also have two scallions,

cues.zh: 就是葱绿的地方
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 cong1 lv4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: the green part of the scallion.

cues.zh: 然后我们给它放进来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Then we add it in,

cues.zh: 然后再放进来一小把香菜
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 xiao3 ba3 xiang1 cai4
cues.en: and then add in a small handful of cilantro.

cues.zh: 我个人非常喜欢香菜的这个香气
cues.pinyin: wo3 ge4 ren2 fei1 chang2 xi3 huan1 xiang1 cai4 de5 zhe4 ge5 xiang1 qi4
cues.en: I personally really love the fragrance of cilantro.

cues.zh: 然后好我们就给它搅拌
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hao3 wo3 men5 jiu4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4
cues.en: Then, okay, we mix it together.

cues.zh: 那现在呢我们就可以把我们的这个龙虾
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1
cues.en: Now we can take our lobster

cues.zh: 放到刚刚我们煮好的面上面
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 gang1 gang1 wo3 men5 zhu3 hao3 de5 mian4 shang4 mian4
cues.en: and place it on top of the noodles we just cooked,

cues.zh: 然后也慢慢的把这个汤汁浇上来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 man4 man4 de5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 tang1 zhi1 jiao1 shang4 lai2
cues.en: and then slowly pour the sauce over it.

cues.zh: 哇多么美好的这个龙虾意面啊
cues.pinyin: wa5 duo1 me5 mei3 hao3 de5 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 yi4 mian4 a5
cues.en: Wow, what a wonderful lobster e-fu noodle dish!

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 龙虾伊面的家庭做法【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 我们今天这个龙虾呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 long2 xia1 ne5
cues.en: Today our lobster

cues.zh: 实在是非常的美味
cues.pinyin: shi2 zai4 shi4 fei1 chang2 de5 mei3 wei4
cues.en: is really, really delicious.

cues.zh: 这个意面完全的吸收了龙虾的鲜甜
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi4 mian4 wan2 quan2 de5 xi1 shou1 le5 long2 xia1 de5 xian1 tian2
cues.en: The noodles have completely absorbed the sweet freshness of the lobster,

cues.zh: 然后这个面条咬上去很有弹性
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 mian4 tiao2 yao3 shang4 qu4 hen3 you3 tan2 xing4
cues.en: and the noodles have a nice bite to them,

cues.zh: 很有 Q Q 的感觉
cues.pinyin: hen3 you3 Q Q de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: that nice chewy 'QQ' texture.

cues.zh: 然后颜色看上去也是很漂亮
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yan2 se4 kan4 shang4 qu4 ye3 shi4 hen3 piao4 liang4
cues.en: And the color looks really pretty too,

cues.zh: 有红色有绿色
cues.pinyin: you3 hong2 se4 you3 lv4 se4
cues.en: there's red and there's green,

cues.zh: 看上去很有这个节日的气氛

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频告诉你关于赌球的一切...

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 20 26 年世界杯正在如火如荼的进行
cues.pinyin: 20 26 nian2 shi4 jie4 bei1 zheng4 zai4 ru2 huo3 ru2 tu2 de5 jin4 xing2
cues.en: The 2026 World Cup is in full swing.

cues.zh: 有很多小朋友问我
cues.pinyin: you3 hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3
cues.en: Many people have asked me,

cues.zh: 这个体育彩票怎么买才能挣钱呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ti3 yu4 cai3 piao4 zen3 me5 mai3 cai2 neng2 zheng4 qian2 ne5
cues.en: "How should I buy sports lottery tickets to make money?"

cues.zh: 博彩公司会不会操纵比赛踢假球
cues.pinyin: bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 hui4 bu2 hui4 cao1 zong4 bi3 sai4 ti1 jia3 qiu2
cues.en: Will betting companies manipulate matches through match-fixing

cues.zh: 让我们输钱呢
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 men5 shu1 qian2 ne5
cues.en: to make us lose money?

cues.zh: 其实在 4 年以前我曾经讨论过这个问题
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zai4 4 nian2 yi3 qian2 wo3 ceng2 jing1 tao3 lun4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Actually, I discussed this question four years ago,

cues.zh: 那那个时候讲的不够深入
cues.pinyin: na4 na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 jiang3 de5 bu4 gou4 shen1 ru4
cues.en: but back then I didn't go deep enough,

cues.zh: 还把无风险套利和对冲给搞混了
cues.pinyin: hai2 ba3 wu2 feng1 xian3 tao4 li4 he2 dui4 chong1 gei3 gao3 hun4 le5
cues.en: and I even mixed up risk-free arbitrage with hedging.

cues.zh: 那今天我就想把这个问题再深
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 zai4 shen1
cues.en: So today I want to explore this question in more

cues.zh: 入的探讨一下
cues.pinyin: ru4 de5 tan4 tao3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: depth.

cues.zh: 我们首先来研究一个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Let's first look at a question:

cues.zh: 那就是博彩公司到底是怎么挣钱的
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 zheng4 qian2 de5
cues.en: how exactly do betting companies make money?

cues.zh: 我们来研究一下博彩公司的套路
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 de5 tao4 lu4
cues.en: Let's examine the tricks betting companies use

cues.zh: 怎么挣钱呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 zheng4 qian2 ne5
cues.en: to make money.

cues.zh: 经常有人说踢假球对吧
cues.pinyin: jing1 chang2 you3 ren2 shuo1 ti1 jia3 qiu2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: People often say match-fixing, right —

cues.zh: 让某一个队赢
cues.pinyin: rang4 mou3 yi2 ge4 dui4 ying2
cues.en: letting a certain team win,

cues.zh: 所以他就可以挣钱我们就赔钱了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zheng4 qian2 wo3 men5 jiu4 pei2 qian2 le5
cues.en: so they profit while we lose money.

cues.zh: 其实如果你了解博彩公司设计赔率的方法
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ru2 guo3 ni3 liao3 jie3 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 she4 ji4 pei2 lv4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Actually, if you understand how betting companies design their odds,

items.title: 李永乐老师

cues.zh: 你就会知道他根本不需要踢假球
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 hui4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 gen1 ben3 bu4 xu1 yao4 ti1 jia3 qiu2
cues.en: you'll realize they don't even need to fix matches —

cues.zh: 他照样可以百分百挣你的钱
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhao4 yang4 ke3 yi3 bai3 fen1 bai3 zheng1 ni3 de5 qian2
cues.en: they can still guarantee 100% profit from you.

cues.zh: 我们就以上届世界杯的决赛为例
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 yi3 shang4 jie4 shi4 jie4 bei1 de5 jue2 sai4 wei4 li4
cues.en: Let's use the previous World Cup final as an example

cues.zh: 来进行说明吧
cues.pinyin: lai2 jin4 xing2 shuo1 ming2 ba5
cues.en: to illustrate this.

cues.zh: 上届世界杯的决赛在阿根廷和
cues.pinyin: shang4 jie4 shi4 jie4 bei1 de5 jue2 sai4 zai4 a1 gen1 ting2 he2
cues.en: The previous World Cup final was between Argentina

cues.zh: 法国之间进行
cues.pinyin: fa3 guo2 zhi1 jian1 jin4 xing2
cues.en: and France.

cues.zh: 那么有的博彩公司就开出了赔率
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 you3 de5 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 jiu4 kai1 chu1 le5 pei2 lv4
cues.en: Some betting companies offered these odds:

cues.zh: 阿根廷获胜 1 赔 2 89
cues.pinyin: a1 gen1 ting2 huo4 sheng4 1 pei2 2 89
cues.en: Argentina to win: 1 pays 2.89.

cues.zh: 也就是你花 1 块钱买彩票
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 ni3 hua1 1 kuai4 qian2 mai3 cai3 piao4
cues.en: That means if you spend 1 yuan on a ticket

cues.zh: 他最后阿根廷胜了之后赔你 2 89
cues.pinyin: ta1 zui4 hou4 a1 gen1 ting2 sheng4 le5 zhi1 hou4 pei2 ni3 2 89
cues.en: and Argentina wins in the end, they pay you 2.89.

cues.zh: 平是 1 赔 3 08
cues.pinyin: ping2 shi4 1 pei2 3 08
cues.en: Draw: 1 pays 3.08.

cues.zh: 法国获胜 1 赔 2 81
cues.pinyin: fa3 guo2 huo4 sheng4 1 pei2 2 81
cues.en: France to win: 1 pays 2.81.

cues.zh: 比赛结果是不确定的
cues.pinyin: bi3 sai4 jie2 guo3 shi4 bu4 que4 ding4 de5
cues.en: The match result is uncertain,

cues.zh: 但是博彩公司怎么能稳赚不赔呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 zen3 me5 neng2 wen3 zhuan4 bu4 pei2 ne5
cues.en: so how can betting companies guarantee a profit no matter what?

cues.zh: 其实很简单
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: Actually it's simple.

cues.zh: 他只要保证
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yao4 bao3 zheng4
cues.en: They just need to make sure

cues.zh: 无论比赛出什么结果
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 bi3 sai4 chu1 shen2 me5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: that no matter the result,

cues.zh: 博彩公司付出的彩金都是固定的就行了
cues.pinyin: bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 fu4 chu1 de5 cai3 jin1 dou1 shi4 gu4 ding4 de5 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: the amount they pay out stays fixed.

cues.zh: 比如说不管是谁赢
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 bu4 guan3 shi4 shui2 ying2
cues.en: For example, no matter who wins,

cues.zh: 我只要赔付你
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 yao4 pei2 fu4 ni3
cues.en: as long as I pay out to you

cues.zh: 只要我保证还给彩民的彩金都是 100 元
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 wo3 bao3 zheng4 huan2 gei3 cai3 min2 de5 cai3 jin1 dou1 shi4 100 yuan2
cues.en: such that the total paid to bettors is always 100 yuan,

cues.zh: 那我再保证我收的钱比 100 元多
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 zai4 bao3 zheng4 wo3 shou1 de5 qian2 bi3 100 yuan2 duo1
cues.en: then I just need to make sure I collect more than 100 yuan.

cues.zh: 是不是 100 除以 3 08

cues.zh: 销售彩票的话
cues.pinyin: xiao1 shou4 cai3 piao4 de5 hua4
cues.en: according to this ratio,

cues.zh: 那么最后不管是哪个结果
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zui4 hou4 bu4 guan3 shi4 na3 ge5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: then no matter the final result,

cues.zh: 那你收了多少钱呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 shou1 le5 duo1 shao3 qian2 ne5
cues.en: So how much money did you collect?

cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 san1 ge4 jia1 qi3 lai2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Add the three amounts together, right?

cues.en: Notice that in total you can collect 102.66 yuan.

cues.zh: 这种情况是不会出现的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 shi4 bu2 hui4 chu1 xian4 de5
cues.en: But this situation won't actually happen.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 因为赔率是动态调整的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 pei2 lv4 shi4 dong4 tai4 tiao2 zheng3 de5
cues.en: Because the odds are adjusted dynamically.

cues.zh: 如果买阿根廷队的采民多
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mai3 a1 gen1 ting2 dui4 de5 cai3 min2 duo1
cues.en: If more bettors bet on Argentina,

cues.zh: 那么博彩公司的精算师
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 de5 jing1 suan4 shi1
cues.en: then the betting company's actuaries

cues.zh: 就会降低阿根廷获胜的赔率
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 jiang4 di1 a1 gen1 ting2 huo4 sheng4 de5 pei2 lv4
cues.en: will lower the odds for Argentina winning

cues.zh: 提高平局和法国获胜的赔率
cues.pinyin: ti2 gao1 ping2 ju2 he2 fa3 guo2 huo4 sheng4 de5 pei2 lv4
cues.en: and raise the odds for a draw and for France winning.

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 让更多的人去购买平局和法国获胜
cues.pinyin: rang4 geng4 duo1 de5 ren2 qu4 gou4 mai3 ping2 ju2 he2 fa3 guo2 huo4 sheng4
cues.en: This pushes more people to bet on a draw or France winning,

cues.zh: 更少的人买阿根廷获胜
cues.pinyin: geng4 shao3 de5 ren2 mai3 a1 gen1 ting2 huo4 sheng4
cues.en: and fewer people to bet on Argentina.

cues.zh: 他通过这种动态调整赔率
cues.pinyin: ta1 tong1 guo4 zhe4 zhong3 dong4 tai4 tiao2 zheng3 pei2 lv4
cues.en: Through this dynamic odds adjustment,

cues.zh: 就总能够保证他付出的彩金是固定的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zong3 neng2 gou4 bao3 zheng4 ta1 fu4 chu1 de5 cai3 jin1 shi4 gu4 ding4 de5
cues.en: they can always ensure their payout stays fixed,

cues.zh: 而他的收入又比付出的彩金要多
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 de5 shou1 ru4 you4 bi3 fu4 chu1 de5 cai3 jin1 yao4 duo1
cues.en: while their revenue is always higher than that payout.

cues.zh: 所以彩票是稳赚不赔的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai3 piao4 shi4 wen3 zhuan4 bu4 pei2 de5
cues.en: So betting is guaranteed to be profitable.

cues.zh: 当然这是对博彩公司而言
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 zhe4 shi4 dui4 bo2 cai3 gong1 si1 er2 yan2
cues.en: Of course, that's from the betting company's perspective.

cues.zh: 那么对于彩民而言
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dui4 yu2 cai3 min2 er2 yan2
cues.en: So from the bettor's perspective,

cues.zh: 有没有什么好的方法呢
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 hao3 de5 fang1 fa3 ne5
cues.en: is there a good strategy?

cues.zh: 我们来讨论一个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Let's discuss a concept

cues.zh: 叫做价值投注
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 jia4 zhi2 tou2 zhu4
cues.en: called "value betting."

cues.zh: 什么叫价值投注
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 jia4 zhi2 tou2 zhu4
cues.en: What is value betting?

cues.zh: 大家听说过价值投资吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ting1 shuo1 guo4 jia4 zhi2 tou2 zi1 ma5
cues.en: Have you heard of "value investing"?

cues.zh: 买股票的时候
cues.pinyin: mai3 gu3 piao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When buying stocks,

cues.zh: 买那些被低估的股价比较低
cues.pinyin: mai3 na4 xie1 bei4 di1 gu1 de5 gu3 jia4 bi3 jiao4 di1
cues.en: you buy undervalued stocks with relatively low prices

cues.zh: 而且又比较优质的股票
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you4 bi3 jiao4 you1 zhi4 di4 gu3 piao4
cues.en: that are also high quality.

cues.zh: 等它价格涨起来之后

cues.en: After the price rises,

cues.zh: 就叫价格投注

cues.zh: 我们也举一个例子

cues.en: Germany to win: 1 pays 1.462.

cues.zh: 平局 1 赔 4 8

cues.en: Draw: 1 pays 4.8.

cues.zh: 日本获胜 1 赔 7 3
cues.pinyin: ri4 ben3 huo4 sheng4 1 pei2 7 3
cues.en: Japan to win: 1 pays 7.3.

cues.zh: 那么按照我们刚才的说法
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 an4 zhao4 wo3 men5 gang1 cai2 de5 shuo1 fa3
cues.en: So, following what we just said,

cues.en: the betting company says,

cues.zh: 因为它是被浸熟的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 bei4 jin4 shu2 de5
cues.en: Because it's cooked by gentle poaching,

cues.zh: 所以它的肉质呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 de5 rou4 zhi4 ne5
cues.en: the texture of the meat

cues.zh: 真的是非常的软嫩
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 fei1 chang2 de5 ruan3 nen4
cues.en: is truly very soft and tender,

cues.zh: 滑多汁
cues.pinyin: hua2 duo1 zhi1
cues.en: smooth and juicy.

cues.zh: 而且鸡皮还有这个鸡肉中间呢
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ji1 pi2 hai2 you3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 zhong1 jian1 ne5
cues.en: And between the skin and the chicken meat,

cues.zh: 还有一层胶脂
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 ceng2 jiao1 zhi1
cues.en: there's also a layer of gelatin.

cues.zh: 哦真的太美味了
cues.pinyin: o2 zhen1 de5 tai4 mei3 wei4 le5
cues.en: Oh, it's truly delicious!

cues.zh: 那不晓得你觉得
cues.pinyin: na4 bu4 xiao3 de5 ni3 jue2 de5
cues.en: So I'm curious what you think —

cues.zh: 今天这个师傅做的怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 shi1 fu4 zuo4 de5 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: how do you feel about the way this chef made it today?

cues.zh: 你会给他尝试吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 gei3 ta1 chang2 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Would you give it a try?

cues.zh: 还是你觉得
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 ni3 jue2 de5
cues.en: Or do you think,

cues.zh: 嗯算了吧
cues.pinyin: n2 suan4 le5 ba5
cues.en: "eh, never mind"?

cues.zh: 请在下面留言告诉我你的看法
cues.pinyin: qing3 zai4 xia4 mian4 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 wo3 ni3 de5 kan4 fa3
cues.en: Please leave a comment below telling me your thoughts.

cues.zh: 那今天就这样子了
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 le5
cues.en: Well, that's it for today.

cues.zh: 我们下周见
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 zhou1 jian4
cues.en: See you next week.

cues.zh: 祝大家有一个美好的周末
cues.pinyin: zhu4 da4 jia1 you3 yi2 ge4 mei3 hao3 de5 zhou1 mo4
cues.en: Wishing everyone a wonderful weekend.

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye!
