items.title_zh: 国中资优班考试~一次搞懂｜该如何报名？如何准备？｜语文资优班｜数理资优班

cues.zh: 珊珊和澄澄国小都是读资优班的
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 he2 cheng2 cheng2 guo2 xiao3 dou1 shi4 du2 zi1 you1 ban1 de5
cues.en: Both Shanshan and Chengcheng were in the gifted program in elementary school.

cues.zh: 珊珊最近也去考国中的资优鉴定
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 zui4 jin4 ye3 qu4 kao3 guo2 zhong1 de5 zi1 you1 jian4 ding4
cues.en: Shanshan recently also took the gifted program assessment for junior high.

cues.zh: 许多人对资优鉴定并不太清楚
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ren2 dui4 zi1 you1 jian4 ding4 bing4 bu4 tai4 qing1 chu3
cues.en: Many people aren't very clear on what the gifted assessment involves.

cues.zh: 我们来问问她是如何考国中资优班的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 wen4 wen4 ta1 shi4 ru2 he2 kao3 guo2 zhong1 zi1 you1 ban1 de5
cues.en: Let's ask her how she tested into the junior high gifted program.

cues.zh: 珊珊你是如何考国中资优班的
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 ni3 shi4 ru2 he2 kao3 guo2 zhong1 zi1 you1 ban1 de5
cues.en: Shanshan, how did you test into the junior high gifted program?

cues.zh: 可不可以跟大家说一下
cues.pinyin: ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 gen1 da4 jia1 shuo1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Could you tell everyone about it?

cues.zh: 其实呢大家只要想考的话就可以考了
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ne5 da4 jia1 zhi3 yao4 xiang3 kao3 de5 hua4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 kao3 le5
cues.en: Actually, anyone who wants to take the test can just sign up.

cues.zh: 它可以是老师推荐也可以是家长推荐
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 shi4 lao3 shi1 tui1 jian4 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi4 jia1 zhang3 tui1 jian4
cues.en: It can be through a teacher's recommendation or a parent's recommendation.

cues.zh: 国小的考试时间是在二年级或是
cues.pinyin: guo2 xiao3 de5 kao3 shi4 shi2 jian1 shi4 zai4 er4 nian2 ji2 huo4 shi4
cues.en: For elementary school, the test is given in second grade or

cues.zh: 四年级的时候
cues.pinyin: si4 nian2 ji2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: in fourth grade.

cues.zh: 我们的第一部影片
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 di4 yi1 bu4 ying3 pian4
cues.en: Our first video

cues.zh: 有介绍国小的资优考试
cues.pinyin: you3 jie4 shao4 guo2 xiao3 de5 zi1 you1 kao3 shi4
cues.en: introduced the elementary school gifted program test.

cues.zh: 我想考的同学可以去看看
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 kao3 de5 tong2 xue2 ke3 yi3 qu4 kan4 kan4
cues.en: If you're thinking of taking it, you can go check that out.

cues.zh: 连结我会放在影片的最后哦
cues.pinyin: lian2 jie2 wo3 hui4 fang4 zai4 ying3 pian4 de5 zui4 hou4 o2
cues.en: I'll put the link at the end of this video.

cues.zh: 国中的话呢
cues.pinyin: guo2 zhong1 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: As for junior high,

cues.zh: 就只有国小六年级这一次的考试
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhi3 you3 guo2 xiao3 liu4 nian2 ji2 zhe4 yi1 ci4 de5 kao3 shi4
cues.en: there's only one chance to test, in sixth grade.

cues.zh: 然后呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: And also,

cues.zh: 有资优鉴定的学校
cues.pinyin: you3 zi1 you1 jian4 ding4 de5 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: schools that offer the gifted assessment

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 国中资优班考试~一次搞懂｜该如何报名？如何准备？｜语文资优班｜数理资优班

cues.zh: 并不用受学区的限制
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 yong4 shou4 xue2 qu1 de5 xian4 zhi4
cues.en: aren't restricted by school district boundaries,

cues.zh: 就可以报考了哦
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 bao4 kao3 le5 o2
cues.en: so you can just sign up to take it.

cues.zh: 那要怎么报名呢
cues.pinyin: na4 yao4 zen3 me5 bao4 ming2 ne5
cues.en: So how do you register?

cues.zh: 国中的资优班考试
cues.pinyin: guo2 zhong1 de5 zi1 you1 ban1 kao3 shi4
cues.en: The junior high gifted program exam

cues.zh: 可以分为语文和数理两种
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 fen1 wei2 yu3 wen2 he2 shu4 li3 liang3 zhong3
cues.en: is divided into two types: humanities and math/science.

cues.zh: 你词对国语
cues.pinyin: ni3 ci2 dui4 guo2 yu3
cues.en: If you're interested in Chinese

cues.zh: 英文有兴趣的话
cues.pinyin: ying1 wen2 you3 xing4 qu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: and English,

cues.zh: 你就可以去报考语文的
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 qu4 bao4 kao3 yu3 wen2 de5
cues.en: you can apply for the humanities track.

cues.zh: 然后如果你是对数学自然有兴趣的话
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ru2 guo3 ni3 shi4 dui4 shu4 xue2 zi4 ran2 you3 xing4 qu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: And if you're interested in math and science instead,

cues.zh: 你就可以去报考数理资优
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 qu4 bao4 kao3 shu4 li3 zi1 you1
cues.en: you can apply for the math/science gifted track.

cues.zh: 还有另外一种管道
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3 guan3 dao4
cues.en: There's also another route:

cues.zh: 就是透过书面审查
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 tou4 guo4 shu1 mian4 shen3 cha2
cues.en: going through document review,

cues.zh: 就不用去考试了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bu4 yong4 qu4 kao3 shi4 le5
cues.en: so you don't have to take the test.

cues.zh: 但是它有一定的资格限制
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 you3 yi2 ding4 de5 zi1 ge2 xian4 zhi4
cues.en: But it does have certain eligibility requirements.

cues.zh: 就是你必须要通过全国语文竞赛
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 bi4 xu1 yao4 tong1 guo4 quan2 guo2 yu3 wen2 jing4 sai4
cues.en: You have to have placed in the National Chinese Language Competition,

cues.zh: 或是全国科展
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 quan2 guo2 ke1 zhan3
cues.en: or the National Science Fair,

cues.zh: 还有一些国际发明等奖项
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 guo2 ji4 fa1 ming2 deng3 jiang3 xiang4
cues.en: or won certain international invention awards, etc.

cues.zh: 就可以众神看看
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhong4 shen2 kan4 kan4
cues.en: then you can look into applying through that route.

cues.zh: 像我这次就是通过参加全国语文竞赛
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 zhe4 ci4 jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 can1 jia1 quan2 guo2 yu3 wen2 jing4 sai4
cues.en: For me, I qualified by taking part in the National Chinese Language Competition,

cues.zh: 所以就书面录取啦
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 shu1 mian4 lu4 qu3 la5
cues.en: so I was admitted through document review.

cues.zh: 那要如何准备资优考试呢
cues.pinyin: na4 yao4 ru2 he2 zhun3 bei4 zi1 you1 kao3 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So how do you prepare for the gifted program exam?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 国中资优班考试~一次搞懂｜该如何报名？如何准备？｜语文资优班｜数理资优班

cues.zh: 因为我已经书面审查通过了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 yi3 jing1 shu1 mian4 shen3 cha2 tong1 guo4 le5
cues.en: Since I already passed the document review,

cues.zh: 所以基本上就没有什么压力
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ji1 ben3 shang4 jiu4 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 ya1 li4
cues.en: I basically didn't have much pressure.

cues.zh: 但是要有英文成绩
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yao4 you3 ying1 wen2 cheng2 ji4
cues.en: But you do need an English score,

cues.zh: 这样国中上英文课时
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 guo2 zhong1 shang4 ying1 wen2 ke4 shi2
cues.en: so that when taking English class in junior high,

cues.zh: 才可以抽离加速
cues.pinyin: cai2 ke3 yi3 chou1 li2 jia1 su4
cues.en: you can be pulled out for accelerated classes.

cues.zh: 所以我才去参加资优鉴定考试
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 cai2 qu4 can1 jia1 zi1 you1 jian4 ding4 kao3 shi4
cues.en: That's why I went and took the gifted assessment test.

cues.zh: 而且我也有去书店买一些资优
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 wo3 ye3 you3 qu4 shu1 dian4 mai3 yi1 xie1 zi1 you1
cues.en: I also went to a bookstore and bought some gifted program

cues.zh: 考试的书来看
cues.pinyin: kao3 shi4 de5 shu1 lai2 kan4
cues.en: test prep books to study.

cues.zh: 题型是差不多
cues.pinyin: ti2 xing2 shi4 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: The question types are pretty similar,

cues.zh: 但是题目的有可能会不一样
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ti2 mu4 di4 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: but the actual questions might be different,

cues.zh: 所以基本上还是要看题型
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ji1 ben3 shang4 hai2 shi4 yao4 kan4 ti2 xing2
cues.en: so basically you still need to get familiar with the question types.

cues.zh: 那你们考试大概是怎样的情况啊
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 kao3 shi4 da4 gai4 shi4 zen3 yang4 de5 qing2 kuang4 a5
cues.en: So what's the test actually like?

cues.zh: 我们有分性向测验
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 you3 fen1 xing4 xiang4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: There's an aptitude test

cues.zh: 然后还有成就测验两种
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hai2 you3 cheng2 jiu4 ce4 yan4 liang3 zhong3
cues.en: and an achievement test — two types.

cues.zh: 像我这次考的语文资优
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 zhe4 ci4 kao3 de5 yu3 wen2 zi1 you1
cues.en: For me, since I took the humanities gifted exam,

cues.zh: 就分国文性向测验
cues.pinyin: jiu4 fen1 guo2 wen2 xing4 xiang4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: it was split into a Chinese aptitude test

cues.zh: 和英文性向测验
cues.pinyin: he2 ying1 wen2 xing4 xiang4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: and an English aptitude test,

cues.zh: 国文成就测验
cues.pinyin: guo2 wen2 cheng2 jiu4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: plus a Chinese achievement test

cues.zh: 和英文成就测验
cues.pinyin: he2 ying1 wen2 cheng2 jiu4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: and an English achievement test.

cues.zh: 总共有四科
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 you3 si4 ke1
cues.en: So there are four subjects in total,

cues.zh: 只要有一科过就可以录取了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 you3 yi1 ke1 guo4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: and passing just one of them is enough to be admitted.

cues.zh: 数理资优的话
cues.pinyin: shu4 li3 zi1 you1 de5 hua4
cues.en: For the math/science gifted track,

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 国中资优班考试~一次搞懂｜该如何报名？如何准备？｜语文资优班｜数理资优班

cues.zh: 也有数学和自然的
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 shu4 xue2 he2 zi4 ran2 de5
cues.en: there are also math and science

cues.zh: 性向和成就测验
cues.pinyin: xing4 xiang4 he2 cheng2 jiu4 ce4 yan4
cues.en: aptitude and achievement tests.

cues.zh: 同样的也是过一科就可以录取了
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 de5 ye3 shi4 guo4 yi1 ke1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 lu4 qu3 le5
cues.en: Same as before — passing just one subject gets you in.

cues.zh: 那大概都考些什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 da4 gai4 dou1 kao3 xie1 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what kind of things do they actually test?

cues.zh: 性向测验的话是没办法准备的
cues.pinyin: xing4 xiang4 ce4 yan4 de5 hua4 shi4 mei2 ban4 fa3 zhun3 bei4 de5
cues.en: You can't really prepare for the aptitude test,

cues.zh: 因为他考的都是一些观念
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 kao3 de5 dou1 shi4 yi1 xie1 guan1 nian4
cues.en: because it tests general concepts and reasoning.

cues.zh: 成就测验的话就比较像是我们学校的考试
cues.pinyin: cheng2 jiu4 ce4 yan4 de5 hua4 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 xiang4 shi4 wo3 men5 xue2 xiao4 de5 kao3 shi4
cues.en: The achievement test is more like our regular school exams,

cues.zh: 但是难度就比较高一点
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 nan2 du4 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 gao1 yi4 dian3
cues.en: but it's a bit harder.

cues.zh: 那还有什么要注意的吗
cues.pinyin: na4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 yao4 zhu4 yi4 de5 ma5
cues.en: Is there anything else to watch out for?

cues.zh: 考试时会有说明的时间
cues.pinyin: kao3 shi4 shi2 hui4 you3 shuo1 ming2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: During the test there's a time for instructions,

cues.zh: 结束时收卷的时间
cues.pinyin: jie2 shu4 shi2 shou1 juan3 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: and a time when papers are collected at the end.

cues.zh: 要依照监考老师的为准
cues.pinyin: yao4 yi1 zhao4 jian1 kao3 lao3 shi1 de5 wei4 zhun3
cues.en: You should go by whatever the proctor says,

cues.zh: 和准考证上的时间可能不太一样
cues.pinyin: he2 zhun3 kao3 zheng4 shang4 de5 shi2 jian1 ke3 neng2 bu4 tai4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: since it might differ from the time printed on your admission ticket.

cues.zh: 所以要仔细听老师的说明
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 zi3 xi4 ting1 lao3 shi1 de5 shuo1 ming2
cues.en: So listen carefully to the proctor's instructions.

cues.zh: 还有考试的时候是用电脑的答案卡作答
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 shi4 yong4 dian4 nao3 de5 da2 an4 ka3 zuo4 da2
cues.en: Also, the test uses a computer-scored answer sheet,

cues.zh: 用画圈或是画长条的方式
cues.pinyin: yong4 hua4 quan1 huo4 shi4 hua4 chang2 tiao2 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: where you fill in circles or bars.

cues.zh: 所以要带 2 B 铅笔
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 dai4 2 B qian1 bi3
cues.en: So you need to bring a 2B pencil.

cues.zh: 没画过的人可以先练习看看
cues.pinyin: mei2 hua4 guo4 de5 ren2 ke3 yi3 xian1 lian4 xi2 kan4 kan4
cues.en: If you've never filled one out before, practice beforehand.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 国中资优班考试~一次搞懂｜该如何报名？如何准备？｜语文资优班｜数理资优班

cues.zh: 接下来就是要带一般的指针手表
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 jiu4 shi4 yao4 dai4 yi4 ban1 de5 zhi3 zhen1 shou3 biao3
cues.en: Next, you should bring a regular analog watch.

cues.zh: 可以带智慧型手表
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 dai4 zhi4 hui4 xing2 shou3 biao3
cues.en: You're not allowed to bring a smartwatch.

cues.zh: 其实资优班的课程非常的有趣
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zi1 you1 ban1 de5 ke4 cheng2 fei1 chang2 de5 you3 qu4
cues.en: Actually, the gifted program's curriculum is really interesting.

cues.zh: 我国小的时候就很喜欢上
cues.pinyin: wo3 guo2 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 jiu4 hen3 xi3 huan1 shang4
cues.en: I loved attending it back in elementary school.

cues.zh: 所以我国中的画材是可以自己去考
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 guo2 zhong1 de5 hua4 cai2 shi4 ke3 yi3 zi4 ji3 qu4 kao3
cues.en: So for junior high, you can choose to test in on your own.

cues.zh: 大家也可以去考考看
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ye3 ke3 yi3 qu4 kao3 kao3 kan4
cues.en: Everyone can give it a try too.

cues.zh: 希望透过这次的分享
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 tou4 guo4 zhe4 ci4 de5 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: I hope that through sharing this today,

cues.zh: 能对国中想考资优班的同学有一些帮助
cues.pinyin: neng2 dui4 guo2 zhong1 xiang3 kao3 zi1 you1 ban1 de5 tong2 xue2 you3 yi1 xie1 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: it can help students who want to test into the junior high gifted program.

cues.zh: 也可以直接询问
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 zhi2 jie1 xun2 wen4
cues.en: You can also just directly ask

cues.zh: 你想报考的那所国中
cues.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 bao4 kao3 de5 na4 suo3 guo2 zhong1
cues.en: the junior high school you want to apply to.

cues.zh: 相信老师会很乐意的
cues.pinyin: xiang1 xin4 lao3 shi1 hui4 hen3 le4 yi4 de5
cues.en: I'm sure the teachers there will be happy

cues.zh: 回答你所有的问题的
cues.pinyin: hui2 da2 ni3 suo3 you3 de5 wen4 ti2 de5
cues.en: to answer all your questions.

cues.zh: 那我们今天就分享到这里
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 jiu4 fen1 xiang3 dao4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: That's all we're sharing for today.

cues.zh: 我们就拜拜咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 bai4 bai4 ge1
cues.en: So, bye bye!

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 吓得他差点当场翻阻跳霹雳舞
cues.pinyin: xia4 de2 ta1 cha4 dian3 dang1 chang3 fan1 zu3 tiao4 pi1 li4 wu3
cues.en: Scared him so badly he almost did a flip and started breakdancing on the spot

cues.zh: 接到报警后
cues.pinyin: jie1 dao4 bao4 jing3 hou4
cues.en: After receiving the emergency call

cues.zh: 调查局和法医实验室
cues.pinyin: diao4 cha2 ju2 he2 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: The investigation bureau and the forensic lab

cues.zh: 火速杀到现场
cues.pinyin: huo3 su4 sha1 dao4 xian4 chang3
cues.en: Rushed to the scene at lightning speed

cues.zh: 警员老布和法医小谷这对活宝
cues.pinyin: jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 he2 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 zhe4 dui4 huo2 bao3
cues.en: Officer Booth and forensic anthropologist Bones, this comedic duo

cues.zh: 边戴手套
cues.pinyin: bian1 dai4 shou3 tao4
cues.en: Were putting on gloves

cues.zh: 边聊火星移民
cues.pinyin: bian1 liao2 huo3 xing1 yi2 min2
cues.en: While chatting about Mars colonization

cues.zh: 老布自信表示
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zi4 xin4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Booth confidently stated

cues.zh: 地球资源即将见底
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 zi1 yuan2 ji2 jiang1 jian4 di3
cues.en: That Earth's resources would soon run dry

cues.zh: 人类早晚得巡猎霸搞宇宙扩张
cues.pinyin: ren2 lei4 zao3 wan3 de2 xun2 lie4 ba4 gao3 yu3 zhou4 kuo4 zhang1
cues.en: And humanity would sooner or later need to push into space expansion

cues.zh: 小谷白眼翻到后脑勺
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 bai2 yan3 fan1 dao4 hou4 nao3 shao2
cues.en: Bones rolled her eyes so hard they nearly reached the back of her skull

cues.zh: 只有差拿解剖刀给老布开开撬
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 cha4 na2 jie3 pou1 dao1 gei3 lao3 bu4 kai1 kai1 qiao4
cues.en: She was just short of grabbing a scalpel to knock some sense into Booth

cues.zh: 而法医卡米尔从报案人口中得知
cues.pinyin: er2 fa3 yi1 ka3 mi3 er3 cong2 bao4 an4 ren2 kou3 zhong1 de2 zhi1
cues.en: Meanwhile forensic examiner Cam learned from the caller

cues.zh: 要不是大哼心血来潮搞私人农场
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu2 shi4 da4 heng1 xin1 xue4 lai2 chao2 gao3 si1 ren2 nong2 chang3
cues.en: That if not for Daheng's sudden whim to start a private farm

cues.zh: 这具尸体怕是要烂在地里
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ju4 shi1 ti3 pa4 shi4 yao4 lan4 zai4 di4 li3
cues.en: This body would've rotted away in the ground

cues.zh: 当有机肥料
cues.pinyin: dang1 you3 ji1 fei2 liao4
cues.en: And become organic fertilizer

cues.zh: 昆虫学家豪金根据腐尸上的蛆虫掐指一算
cues.pinyin: kun1 chong2 xue2 jia1 hao2 jin1 gen1 ju4 fu3 shi1 shang4 de5 qu1 chong2 qia1 zhi3 yi1 suan4
cues.en: Entomologist Hodgins did some quick math based on the maggots on the corpse

cues.zh: 死者死亡事件为五千
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 si3 wang2 shi4 jian4 wei4 wu3 qian1
cues.en: The time of death was five days ago

cues.zh: 诡异的是死者头骨竟离奇消失
cues.pinyin: gui3 yi4 de5 shi4 si3 zhe3 tou2 gu3 jing4 li2 qi2 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: Strangely, the victim's skull had bizarrely vanished

cues.zh: 小骨根据尸体上密密麻麻的三
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 gen1 ju4 shi1 ti3 shang4 mi4 mi4 ma2 ma2 de5 san1
cues.en: Based on the dense triangular bite marks on the body, Bones

cues.zh: 角形咬痕判断
cues.pinyin: jiao3 xing2 yao3 hen2 pan4 duan4
cues.en: determined that

cues.zh: 一次被野生囊牙棒暴揍过
cues.pinyin: yi1 ci4 bei4 ye3 sheng1 nang2 ya2 bang4 bao4 zou4 guo4
cues.en: the victim had once been savagely attacked by a wild animal

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 众人准备将尸体运回实验室
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 zhun3 bei4 jiang1 shi1 ti3 yun4 hui2 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: Everyone prepared to transport the body back to the lab

cues.zh: 布骨两人正在餐厅等着运尸车
cues.pinyin: bu4 gu3 liang3 ren2 zheng4 zai4 can1 ting1 deng3 zhe5 yun4 shi1 che1
cues.en: Booth and Bones were at a restaurant waiting for the body van

cues.zh: 谁知老布继续对着小骨嘴炮
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 lao3 bu4 ji4 xu4 dui4 zhe5 xiao3 gu3 zui3 pao4
cues.en: When Booth kept running his mouth at Bones

cues.zh: 话题还在围着火星移民打转
cues.pinyin: hua4 ti2 hai2 zai4 wei2 zhao2 huo3 xing1 yi2 min2 da3 zhuan4
cues.en: Still circling around the topic of Mars colonization

cues.zh: 甚至盯上老婆钱包
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 ding1 shang4 lao3 po2 qian2 bao1
cues.en: He even eyed his wife's wallet

cues.zh: 想让他买上巨额太空股票
cues.pinyin: xiang3 rang4 ta1 mai3 shang4 ju4 e2 tai4 kong1 gu3 piao4
cues.en: Wanting her to buy a huge amount of space stock

cues.zh: 就在小谷准备让他知道家里谁说话算时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 xiao3 gu3 zhun3 bei4 rang4 ta1 zhi1 dao4 jia1 li3 shui2 shuo1 hua4 suan4 shi2
cues.en: Just as Bones was about to show him who wears the pants at home

cues.zh: 一个血糊拉碴的小伙儿突然冲向两人
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xue4 hu2 la1 cha2 de5 xiao3 huo3 er2 tu1 ran2 chong1 xiang4 liang3 ren2
cues.en: A young man covered in blood suddenly rushed at the two of them

cues.zh: 对方甚至知道布骨两人的真实身份
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shen4 zhi4 zhi1 dao4 bu4 gu3 liang3 ren2 de5 zhen1 shi2 shen1 fen4
cues.en: The guy even knew Booth and Bones' real identities

cues.zh: 就在老布条件反射掏枪时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 lao3 bu4 tiao2 jian4 fan3 she4 tao1 qiang1 shi2
cues.en: Just as Booth reflexively drew his gun

cues.zh: 小伙儿竟从包里掏出颗人脑袋
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 er2 jing4 cong2 bao1 li3 tao1 chu1 ke1 ren2 nao3 dai4
cues.en: The young man pulled a human head out of his bag

cues.zh: 小伙儿也从卡米尔口中得知
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 er2 ye3 cong2 ka3 mi3 er3 kou3 zhong1 de2 zhi1
cues.en: The young man also learned from Cam

cues.zh: 小伙儿名叫威尔
cues.pinyin: xiao3 huo3 er2 ming2 jiao4 wei1 er3
cues.en: That the guy's name was Wendell

cues.zh: 是一名精通各领域的全能实习生
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 ming2 jing1 tong1 ge4 ling3 yu4 de5 quan2 neng2 shi2 xi2 sheng1
cues.en: An all-around intern skilled in every field

cues.zh: 感情这个叫威尔的全能实习生
cues.pinyin: gan3 qing2 zhe4 ge5 jiao4 wei1 er3 de5 quan2 neng2 shi2 xi2 sheng1
cues.en: Turns out this all-around intern named Wendell

cues.zh: 单枪匹马闯进狼窝
cues.pinyin: dan1 qiang1 pi3 ma3 chuang3 jin4 lang2 wo1
cues.en: Had single-handedly charged into the wolf's den

cues.zh: 仅仅一个半小时就将死者脑袋包邮带回
cues.pinyin: jin3 jin3 yi2 ge4 ban4 xiao3 shi2 jiu4 jiang1 si3 zhe3 nao3 dai4 bao1 you2 dai4 hui2
cues.en: And in just an hour and a half brought the victim's head back, free shipping included

cues.zh: 威尔巴拉着脑袋瞅半天
cues.pinyin: wei1 er3 ba1 la1 zhe5 nao3 dai4 chou3 ban4 tian1
cues.en: Wendell held up the head and stared at it for ages

cues.zh: 发现头颅表面没剩
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 tou2 lu2 biao3 mian4 mei2 sheng4
cues.en: Finding barely any soft tissue left on the skull's surface

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 当负责人丹尼尔看到弟弟画像时
cues.pinyin: dang1 fu4 ze2 ren2 dan1 ni2 er3 kan4 dao4 di4 di5 hua4 xiang4 shi2
cues.en: When the man in charge, Daniel, saw the sketch of his brother

cues.zh: 瞬间哇的哭出声
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 wa5 de5 ku1 chu1 sheng1
cues.en: He instantly burst into tears

cues.zh: 死者正是他优秀的弟弟约翰
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 zheng4 shi4 ta1 you1 xiu4 de5 di4 di5 yue1 han4
cues.en: The victim was indeed his outstanding younger brother, John

cues.zh: 据丹尼尔回忆
cues.pinyin: ju4 dan1 ni2 er3 hui2 yi4
cues.en: According to Daniel's recollection

cues.zh: 因其中考试临近
cues.pinyin: yin1 qi2 zhong1 kao3 shi4 lin2 jin4
cues.en: Since midterms were approaching

cues.zh: 他特意给弟弟放个长假
cues.pinyin: ta1 te4 yi4 gei3 di4 di5 fang4 ge4 chang2 jia4
cues.en: He had specially given his brother a long break

cues.zh: 由于父母早已离世
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 fu4 mu3 zao3 yi3 li2 shi4
cues.en: Since their parents had long since passed away

cues.zh: 弟弟便是自己唯一的亲人
cues.pinyin: di4 di5 bian4 shi4 zi4 ji3 wei2 yi1 de5 qin1 ren2
cues.en: His brother was his only family

cues.zh: 谁知这下自己彻底成为孤寡老哥
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 zhe4 xia4 zi4 ji3 che4 di3 cheng2 wei2 gu1 gua3 lao3 ge1
cues.en: Who knew he'd now become a completely solitary old guy

cues.zh: 而就在这时
cues.pinyin: er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: And right at that moment

cues.zh: 修理工伊万突然哐当甩出大瓜
cues.pinyin: xiu1 li3 gong1 yi1 wan4 tu1 ran2 kuang1 dang1 shuai3 chu1 da4 gua1
cues.en: Mechanic Ivan suddenly dropped a huge piece of gossip

cues.zh: 直言肯定有人嫉妒约翰
cues.pinyin: zhi2 yan2 ken3 ding4 you3 ren2 ji2 du4 yue1 han4
cues.en: Claiming outright that someone must have been jealous of John

cues.zh: 毕竟他拥有一辆超酷改装的雪佛兰古董车
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 ta1 yong1 you3 yi1 liang4 chao1 ku4 gai3 zhuang1 de5 xue3 fu2 lan2 gu3 dong3 che1
cues.en: After all, he owned a super cool modified vintage Chevrolet

cues.zh: 这才吓狠手
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 xia4 hen3 shou3
cues.en: That's probably why someone went to such ruthless lengths

cues.zh: 还甩锅给约翰前女友安娜
cues.pinyin: hai2 shuai3 guo1 gei3 yue1 han4 qian2 nv3 you3 an1 na4
cues.en: And he also tried to pin the blame on John's ex-girlfriend, Anna

cues.zh: 一急到车
cues.pinyin: yi1 ji2 dao4 che1
cues.en: The moment the car was mentioned

cues.zh: 安娜就像开闸的水龙头
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 jiu4 xiang4 kai1 zha2 de5 shui3 long2 tou2
cues.en: Anna turned into a faucet with the valve wide open

cues.zh: 疯狂吐槽
cues.pinyin: feng1 kuang2 tu3 cao2
cues.en: Ranting furiously

cues.zh: 说以前和约翰感情好的年糊
cues.pinyin: shuo1 yi3 qian2 he2 yue1 han4 gan3 qing2 hao3 de5 nian2 hu2
cues.en: Saying that back when things were good between her and John

cues.zh: 可自从他捣鼓那辆破铜烂铁
cues.pinyin: ke3 zi4 cong2 ta1 dao3 gu3 na4 liang4 po4 tong2 lan4 tie3
cues.en: Ever since he started tinkering with that piece of junk

cues.zh: 就将自己晾在一边
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jiang1 zi4 ji3 liang4 zai4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: He left her out to dry

cues.zh: 连他慢料身材都不瞧一眼
cues.pinyin: lian2 ta1 man4 liao4 shen1 cai2 dou1 bu4 qiao2 yi1 yan3
cues.en: Not even glancing at her killer figure

cues.zh: 不过安娜傲娇表示
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 an1 na4 ao4 jiao1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: However Anna said, putting on airs

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 毕竟约翰是研究时空穿梭的科学家
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 yue1 han4 shi4 yan2 jiu1 shi2 kong1 chuan1 suo1 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: After all, John was a scientist researching time travel

cues.zh: 这身份可比破车高大上
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shen1 fen4 ke3 bi3 po4 che1 gao1 da4 shang4
cues.en: That identity was way cooler than some old car

cues.zh: 直至小甜甜一经时空穿梭
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 yi1 jing1 shi2 kong1 chuan1 suo1
cues.en: Until the moment Hodgins heard about the time travel

cues.zh: 瞬间两眼放光
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 liang3 yan3 fang4 guang1
cues.en: His eyes instantly lit up

cues.zh: 恨不得立刻来到宇宙科普脱口秀
cues.pinyin: hen4 bu4 de2 li4 ke4 lai2 dao4 yu3 zhou4 ke1 pu3 tuo1 kou3 xiu4
cues.en: He could hardly wait to host a cosmic science talk show on the spot

cues.zh: 安娜越说越上头
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 yue4 shuo1 yue4 shang4 tou5
cues.en: The more Anna talked, the more worked up she got

cues.zh: 直接开启骂男模式
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 kai1 qi3 ma4 nan2 mo2 shi4
cues.en: And switched straight into man-bashing mode

cues.zh: 吓得小甜甜和老布秒变安纯
cues.pinyin: xia4 de2 xiao3 tian2 tian2 he2 lao3 bu4 miao3 bian4 an1 chun2
cues.en: Scaring Hodgins and Booth into instantly behaving themselves

cues.zh: 他俩认为安娜绝对有间歇性狂躁症
cues.pinyin: ta1 lia3 ren4 wei2 an1 na4 jue2 dui4 you3 jian4 xie1 xing4 kuang2 zao4 zheng4
cues.en: The two of them figured Anna definitely had intermittent explosive disorder

cues.zh: 虽然她这愚蠢模样不太像凶手
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 zhe4 yu2 chun3 mu2 yang4 bu4 tai4 xiang4 xiong1 shou3
cues.en: Although her silly behavior didn't seem much like a killer's

cues.zh: 但情绪失控或许有失手的可能性
cues.pinyin: dan4 qing2 xu4 shi1 kong4 huo4 xu3 you3 shi1 shou3 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4
cues.en: Losing control of her emotions might still mean she could've snapped

cues.zh: 实验室里朝金正指挥着她的虫子大军
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 li3 chao2 jin1 zheng4 zhi3 hui1 zhe5 ta1 de5 chong2 zi5 da4 jun1
cues.en: Back in the lab, Hodgins was commanding his army of bugs

cues.zh: 让这群小宝贝啃食死者骨头上的腐肉
cues.pinyin: rang4 zhe4 qun2 xiao3 bao3 bei4 ken3 shi2 si3 zhe3 gu3 tou5 shang4 de5 fu3 rou4
cues.en: Having the little darlings gnaw the rotting flesh off the victim's bones

cues.zh: 威尔突然开启中二化楼模式
cues.pinyin: wei1 er3 tu1 ran2 kai1 qi3 zhong1 er4 hua4 lou2 mo2 shi4
cues.en: Wendell suddenly switched into full cringe roast mode

cues.zh: 直接将射牛属性拉满的豪金都
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 jiang1 she4 niu2 shu3 xing4 la1 man3 de5 hao2 jin1 dou1
cues.en: Directly leaving even trash-talk-maxed Hodgins

cues.zh: 搞得一脸猛圈
cues.pinyin: gao3 de2 yi1 lian3 meng3 quan1
cues.en: Looking utterly dumbfounded

cues.zh: 谁让威尔不仅发一致使张口就来
cues.pinyin: shui2 rang4 wei1 er3 bu4 jin3 fa1 yi2 zhi4 shi3 zhang1 kou3 jiu4 lai2
cues.en: Because Wendell wasn't just a walking encyclopedia who could rattle off facts

cues.zh: 居然还精准扒出豪金小时候的囚事
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 hai2 jing1 zhun3 ba1 chu1 hao2 jin1 xiao3 shi2 hou4 de5 qiu2 shi4
cues.en: He even precisely dug up embarrassing stories from Hodgins' childhood

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 这也说明尸体很可能被转移过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shuo1 ming2 shi1 ti3 hen3 ke3 neng2 bei4 zhuan3 yi2 guo4
cues.en: This also suggested the body had likely been moved

cues.zh: 修复施安琪拉跑来爆料
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 shi1 an1 qi2 la1 pao3 lai2 bao4 liao4
cues.en: Forensic reconstruction artist Angela ran over with a scoop

cues.zh: 案发时安娜这门酒吧新结石的黄毛丸头子
cues.pinyin: an4 fa1 shi2 an1 na4 zhe4 men2 jiu3 ba1 xin1 jie2 shi2 de5 huang2 mao2 wan2 tou2 zi5
cues.en: At the time of the crime, Anna was with a bleached-blond guy she'd just met at a bar

cues.zh: 拥有不在场证明
cues.pinyin: yong1 you3 bu4 zai4 chang3 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: And she had an alibi

cues.zh: 而且约翰的电脑中全是石碰穿梭论能
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yue1 han4 de5 dian4 nao3 zhong1 quan2 shi4 shi2 peng4 chuan1 suo1 lun4 neng2
cues.en: Moreover, John's computer was full of time-travel theory notes

cues.zh: 别人研究穿越多想冲向未来
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 yan2 jiu1 chuan1 yue4 duo1 xiang3 chong1 xiang4 wei4 lai2
cues.en: While others researching time travel mostly wanted to rush toward the future

cues.zh: 他竟一头扎进回过去的死胡同
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing4 yi1 tou2 zha1 jin4 hui2 guo4 qu4 de5 si3 hu2 tong4
cues.en: He dove headfirst into the dead end of going back to the past

cues.zh: 这思路简直太与众不同了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 si1 lu4 jian3 zhi2 tai4 yu3 zhong4 bu4 tong2 le5
cues.en: This mindset was just way too unconventional

cues.zh: 而是只豪基一听穿越话题
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zhi3 hao2 ji1 yi1 ting1 chuan1 yue4 hua4 ti2
cues.en: And as soon as Hodgins heard the topic of time travel

cues.zh: 瞬间打了鸡血
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 da3 le5 ji1 xue4
cues.en: He instantly got pumped up

cues.zh: 对着安琪拉就是一句土味情话
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhe5 an1 qi2 la1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ju4 tu3 wei4 qing2 hua4
cues.en: And hit Angela with a cheesy pickup line

cues.zh: 结果安琪拉毫不留情泼冷水
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 an1 qi2 la1 hao2 bu4 liu2 qing2 po1 leng3 shui3
cues.en: But Angela mercilessly poured cold water on it

cues.zh: 是精心准备着情花炮弹
cues.pinyin: shi4 jing1 xin1 zhun3 bei4 zhe5 qing2 hua1 pao4 dan4
cues.en: He had carefully prepared a barrage of sweet talk

cues.zh: 瞬间被砸得吸碎
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 bei4 za2 de2 xi1 sui4
cues.en: Which instantly got shattered to pieces

cues.zh: 可豪金哪肯罢休还想继续纠缠
cues.pinyin: ke3 hao2 jin1 na3 ken3 ba4 xiu1 hai2 xiang3 ji4 xu4 jiu1 chan2
cues.en: But Hodgins wouldn't give up and wanted to keep pestering her

cues.zh: 安琪拉却敷衍地将其打发
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 que4 fu1 yan3 di4 jiang1 qi2 da3 fa1
cues.en: So Angela just half-heartedly brushed him off

cues.zh: 然而更诡异的是
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 geng4 gui3 yi4 de5 shi4
cues.en: However, even stranger was that

cues.zh: 约翰根本不是名校学生
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 gen1 ben3 bu2 shi4 ming2 xiao4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: John wasn't even a student at a prestigious school

cues.zh: 却能用物理学博士账号发表论文
cues.pinyin: que4 neng2 yong4 wu4 li3 xue2 bo2 shi4 zhang4 hao4 fa1 biao3 lun4 wen2
cues.en: Yet he managed to publish papers using a physics PhD's account

cues.zh: 这操作处处透着怪异
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cao1 zuo4 chu4 chu4 tou4 zhe5 guai4 yi4
cues.en: This whole move reeked of strangeness

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 狼窝里抢出头颅，亲哥壹枪崩了俩，死者爹死了又死，这背后的事比地狱还乱？

cues.zh: 豪金怀疑他和博士一起搞时空研究
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 huai2 yi2 ta1 he2 bo2 shi4 yi4 qi3 gao3 shi2 kong1 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: Hodgins suspected he and the PhD were secretly doing time-travel research together

cues.zh: 老姑顺着线索一插
cues.pinyin: lao3 gu1 shun4 zhe5 xian4 suo3 yi1 cha1
cues.en: Booth followed the lead and dug further

cues.zh: 发现兄弟两人的父亲
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 xiong1 di4 liang3 ren2 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: And discovered that the two brothers' father

cues.zh: 竟在约翰六岁时离奇失踪
cues.pinyin: jing4 zai4 yue1 han4 liu4 sui4 shi2 li2 qi2 shi1 zong1
cues.en: Had mysteriously disappeared when John was six

cues.zh: 只留下一张和雪佛兰的合影
cues.pinyin: zhi3 liu2 xia4 yi1 zhang1 he2 xue3 fu2 lan2 de5 he2 ying3
cues.en: Leaving behind only a photo with the Chevrolet

cues.zh: 小甜甜分析约翰或许想要再次回到过去
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 fen1 xi1 yue1 han4 huo4 xu3 xiang3 yao4 zai4 ci4 hui2 dao4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: Hodgins analyzed that John might have wanted to go back to the past again

cues.zh: 阻止家庭破裂
cues.pinyin: zu3 zhi3 jia1 ting2 po4 lie4
cues.en: To stop his family from falling apart

cues.zh: 所以想穿越时空
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiang3 chuan1 yue4 shi2 kong1
cues.en: That's why he wanted to time travel

cues.zh: 这一分析也触动小甜甜美心身处的心弦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 fen1 xi1 ye3 chu4 dong4 xiao3 tian2 tian2 mei3 xin1 shen1 chu4 de5 xin1 xian2
cues.en: This analysis also struck a chord deep inside Hodgins

cues.zh: 他也想回到过去
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 xiang3 hui2 dao4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: He too wanted to go back to the past

cues.zh: 想收养自己的养父母表达一声真挚感谢
cues.pinyin: xiang3 shou1 yang3 zi4 ji3 de5 yang3 fu4 mu3 biao3 da2 yi1 sheng1 zhen1 zhi4 gan3 xie4
cues.en: To express his sincere thanks to the adoptive parents who raised him

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Right at that moment

cues.zh: 博士的黑历史也浮出水面
cues.pinyin: bo2 shi4 de5 hei1 li4 shi3 ye3 fu2 chu1 shui3 mian4
cues.en: The PhD's dark history also surfaced

cues.zh: 两年前其主导的电磁实验
cues.pinyin: liang3 nian2 qian2 qi2 zhu3 dao3 de5 dian4 ci2 shi2 yan4
cues.en: Two years earlier, an electromagnetic experiment he had led

cues.zh: 竟导致学生触电身亡
cues.pinyin: jing4 dao3 zhi4 xue2 sheng1 chu4 dian4 shen1 wang2
cues.en: Actually caused a student to be electrocuted to death

cues.zh: 最终博士被学校开除
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 bo2 shi4 bei4 xue2 xiao4 kai1 chu2
cues.en: In the end, the PhD was expelled from the school

cues.zh: 小和的事案发当晚
cues.pinyin: xiao3 he2 de5 shi4 an4 fa1 dang4 wan3
cues.en: Upon investigation, on the night of the crime

cues.zh: 他曾与约翰约好见面
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 yu3 yue1 han4 yue1 hao3 jian4 mian4
cues.en: He had arranged to meet up with John

cues.zh: 实验室里
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 li3
cues.en: Back in the lab

cues.zh: 却发现多根肋骨出现细密裂纹
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 duo1 gen1 lei4 gu3 chu1 xian4 xi4 mi4 lie4 wen2
cues.en: Wendell and Bones were examining the body

cues.zh: 却发现多株肋骨出现细密裂纹
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 duo1 zhu1 lei4 gu3 chu1 xian4 xi4 mi4 lie4 wen2
cues.en: When they discovered several ribs had fine, hairline cracks

cues.zh: 小明算完命吼
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 suan4 wan2 ming4 hou3
cues.en: After Xiaoming had his fortune told,

cues.zh: 诶诶诶你这个人怎么不给钱就走了
cues.pinyin: ei2 ei2 ei2 ni3 zhe4 ge5 ren2 zen3 me5 bu4 gei3 qian2 jiu4 zou3 le5
cues.en: Hey, hey, hey! Why are you leaving without paying?

cues.zh: 难道你算不出来我口袋没钱吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 ni3 suan4 bu4 chu1 lai2 wo3 kou3 dai4 mei2 qian2 ma5
cues.en: Couldn't you tell I have no money in my pocket?

cues.zh: 小明一天刮了十次的胡子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 yi1 tian1 gua1 le5 shi2 ci4 de5 hu2 zi5
cues.en: Xiaoming shaves his beard ten times a day.

cues.zh: 为什么身上还有胡子呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 shen1 shang4 hai2 you3 hu2 zi5 ne5
cues.en: Why does he still have stubble then?

cues.zh: 因为他是大胡子他胡子长得超级快
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 da4 hu2 zi5 ta1 hu2 zi5 zhang3 de2 chao1 ji2 kuai4
cues.en: Because he has a heavy beard that grows super fast.

cues.zh: 不是哦是因为他是理发师
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 o2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 li3 fa4 shi1
cues.en: No, it's because he's a barber.

cues.zh: 哦他刮别人的胡子
cues.pinyin: o2 ta1 gua1 bie2 ren2 de5 hu2 zi5
cues.en: Oh, he's shaving other people's beards.

cues.zh: 学校要考试
cues.pinyin: xue2 xiao4 yao4 kao3 shi4
cues.en: School is having an exam.

cues.zh: 待会我听你一下椅子
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui4 wo3 ting1 ni3 yi1 xia4 yi3 zi5
cues.en: Let me lean against your chair for a bit during the exam.

cues.zh: 你就给我瞄一下吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 gei3 wo3 miao2 yi1 xia4 ba5
cues.en: Then just let me take a peek, okay?

cues.zh: 好啊
cues.pinyin: hao3 a5
cues.en: Sure.

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你喔
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Chenchen, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 什么动物没生病
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 dong4 wu4 mei2 sheng1 bing4
cues.en: What animal never gets sick,

cues.zh: 人还买药给他吃呢
cues.pinyin: ren2 hai2 mai3 yao4 gei3 ta1 chi1 ne5
cues.en: yet people still buy medicine for it to eat?

cues.zh: 答案是老鼠
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 lao3 shu3
cues.en: The answer is a mouse.

cues.zh: 买老鼠药给他吃
cues.pinyin: mai3 lao3 shu3 yao4 gei3 ta1 chi1
cues.en: People buy rat poison for it to eat.

cues.zh: 晨晨
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2
cues.en: Chenchen,

cues.zh: 十年前你十岁
cues.pinyin: shi2 nian2 qian2 ni3 shi2 sui4
cues.en: Ten years ago you were ten years old.

cues.zh: 十年后你几岁
cues.pinyin: shi2 nian2 hou4 ni3 ji3 sui4
cues.en: Ten years later, how old will you be?

cues.zh: 对了

cues.zh: 要去向父亲炫耀

cues.zh: 你好各位做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone, fellow food lovers

cues.zh: 非常荣幸又跟大家见面了我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: It's such an honor to see you all again, I'm Cissi

cues.zh: 今天要跟大家分享的是一种炸
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 yi1 zhong3 zha4
cues.en: Today I'm going to share with you a fried

cues.zh: 五花肉的做法
cues.pinyin: wu3 hua1 rou4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: pork belly recipe

cues.zh: 因为它是炸的所以许多的猪油在炸的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 zha4 de5 suo3 yi3 xu3 duo1 de5 zhu1 you2 zai4 zha4 de5
cues.en: Because it's fried, a lot of the pork fat

cues.zh: 时候都会出来
cues.pinyin: shi2 hou4 du1 hui4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: comes out during frying

cues.zh: 反倒变得不油腻
cues.pinyin: fan3 dao4 bian4 de2 bu4 you2 ni4
cues.en: so it actually ends up not greasy at all

cues.zh: 外面是酥脆的里面是滑嫩多汁的
cues.pinyin: wai4 mian4 shi4 su1 cui4 de5 li3 mian4 shi4 hua2 nen4 duo1 zhi1 de5
cues.en: Crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside

cues.zh: 我们赶快来看一看它的做法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gan3 kuai4 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4 ta1 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Let's take a quick look at how it's made

cues.zh: 前一天晚上使用一个叉子
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4 shi3 yong4 yi2 ge4 cha1 zi5
cues.en: The night before, use a fork

cues.zh: 在五花肉身上到处扎扎扎扎扎扎扎扎
cues.pinyin: zai4 wu3 hua1 rou4 shen1 shang4 dao4 chu4 zha1 zha1 zha1 zha1 zha1 zha1 zha1 zha1
cues.en: and poke it all over the pork belly

cues.zh: 这样子的做法不仅仅有软化五花肉的作用
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 zuo4 fa3 bu4 jin3 jin3 you3 ruan3 hua4 wu3 hua1 rou4 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: This not only helps soften the pork belly

cues.zh: 而且在炸的时候它比较容易熟
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zai4 zha4 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 shu2
cues.en: but also makes it cook faster when frying

cues.zh: 现在我们来做腌料
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 yan1 liao4
cues.en: Now let's make the marinade

cues.zh: 在一个碗里我们放入酱油
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 jiang4 you2
cues.en: In a bowl, add soy sauce

cues.zh: 蚝油
cues.pinyin: hao2 you2

cues.zh: 绍兴酒
cues.pinyin: shao4 xing1 jiu3
cues.en: Shaoxing wine

cues.zh: 蜂蜜
cues.pinyin: feng1 mi4
cues.en: honey

cues.zh: 五香粉
cues.pinyin: wu3 xiang1 fen3
cues.en: five-spice powder

cues.zh: 和白胡椒
cues.pinyin: he2 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: and white pepper

cues.zh: 搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and mix it together

cues.zh: 在一个大的厨房袋子里呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 de5 chu2 fang2 dai4 zi5 li3 ne5
cues.en: In a large kitchen bag

cues.zh: 我们放入我们的五花肉
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 wo3 men5 de5 wu3 hua1 rou4
cues.en: put in our pork belly

cues.zh: 再倒入腌料
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 ru4 yan1 liao4
cues.en: then pour in the marinade

cues.zh: 把袋子关起来
cues.pinyin: ba3 dai4 zi5 guan1 qi3 lai2

cues.zh: 然后这样子给它揉搓
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 gei3 ta1 rou2 cuo1
cues.en: and massage it like this

cues.zh: 让五花肉上面到处都有这个腌料
cues.pinyin: rang4 wu3 hua1 rou4 shang4 mian4 dao4 chu4 dou1 you3 zhe4 ge5 yan1 liao4
cues.en: so the marinade coats the pork belly all over

cues.zh: 五花肉放入冰箱冷藏一个晚上
cues.pinyin: wu3 hua1 rou4 fang4 ru4 bing1 xiang1 leng3 cang2 yi2 ge4 wan3 shang4
cues.en: Refrigerate the pork belly overnight

cues.zh: 大概一半的时候呢

cues.en: About halfway through

cues.zh: 再给它翻一个面
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 ta1 fan1 yi2 ge4 mian4
cues.en: flip it over once

cues.zh: 第二天的时候在一个大碗里
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 wan3 li3
cues.en: The next day, in a large bowl

cues.zh: 我们放入地瓜粉
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 di4 gua1 fen3
cues.en: add sweet potato starch

cues.zh: 这个地瓜粉我使用的是粗的地瓜粉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 di4 gua1 fen3 wo3 shi3 yong4 de5 shi4 cu1 de5 di4 gua1 fen3

cues.zh: 也可以使用玉米淀粉来代替

cues.en: you can also use cornstarch instead

cues.zh: 将五花肉放入滴瓜粉里
cues.pinyin: jiang1 wu3 hua1 rou4 fang4 ru4 di1 gua1 fen3 li3
cues.en: Put the pork belly into the sweet potato starch

cues.zh: 然后让它上面都沾满滴瓜粉
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rang4 ta1 shang4 mian4 dou1 zhan1 man3 di1 gua1 fen3
cues.en: and make sure it's fully coated

cues.zh: 放到一个盘子上
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 yi2 ge4 pan2 zi5 shang4
cues.en: Place it on a plate

cues.zh: 让它休息 5 分钟
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 xiu1 xi1 5 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and let it rest for 5 minutes

cues.zh: 5 分钟后再来沾一次滴瓜粉
cues.pinyin: 5 fen1 zhong1 hou4 zai4 lai2 zhan1 yi1 ci4 di1 gua1 fen3
cues.en: After 5 minutes, coat it with starch again

cues.zh: 放到盘子上先让它们休息一下
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 pan2 zi5 shang4 xian1 rang4 ta1 men5 xiu1 xi1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Put it back on the plate and let it rest a bit

cues.zh: 在一个大锅里放入芥花籽油
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 guo1 li3 fang4 ru4 jie4 hua1 zi3 you2
cues.en: Heat canola oil in a large pot

cues.zh: 你也可以使用其他高冒烟点的食用油
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 qi2 ta1 gao1 mao4 yan1 dian3 de5 shi2 yong4 you2
cues.en: you can also use another high-smoke-point cooking oil

cues.zh: 我们使用中火就好
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi3 yong4 zhong1 huo3 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: We'll use medium heat

cues.zh: 然后给它热到 3 25 华氏度
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 re4 dao4 3 25 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: and heat it to 325°F

cues.zh: 也就是 16 3 摄氏度
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 16 3 she4 shi4 du4
cues.en: which is 163°C

cues.zh: 小心翼翼地将我们的五花肉放到油锅里

cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 zha4 de5 shi2 hou4 xu3 duo1 de5 zhe4 ge5 you2

cues.zh: 有一个探险家在非洲
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 tan4 xian3 jia1 zai4 fei1 zhou1
cues.en: There was an explorer in Africa.

cues.zh: 不小心碰到了食人族
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 peng4 dao4 le5 shi2 ren2 zu2
cues.en: He accidentally ran into a tribe of cannibals.

cues.zh: 探险家被食人族包围了
cues.pinyin: tan4 xian3 jia1 bei4 shi2 ren2 zu2 bao1 wei2 le5
cues.en: The explorer was surrounded by the cannibals.

cues.zh: 他对天空大喊上帝啊快帮帮我吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 tian1 kong1 da4 han3 shang4 di4 a5 kuai4 bang1 bang1 wo3 ba5
cues.en: He shouted to the sky, "God, please help me!"

cues.zh: 这样下去我就死定了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 xia4 qu4 wo3 jiu4 si3 ding4 le5
cues.en: "If this keeps going, I'm done for!"

cues.zh: 这时候天空传来一个声音爷吉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 tian1 kong1 chuan2 lai2 yi2 ge4 sheng1 yin1 ye2 ji2
cues.en: At that moment, a voice came from the sky.

cues.zh: 你现在还不一定会死
cues.pinyin: ni3 xian4 zai4 hai2 bu4 yi2 ding4 hui4 si3
cues.en: "You might not die just yet."

cues.zh: 赶快拿石头丢那个酋长
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 na2 shi2 tou5 diu1 na4 ge5 qiu2 zhang3
cues.en: "Quick, grab a rock and throw it at the chief."

cues.zh: 探险家按照老天的指示
cues.pinyin: tan4 xian3 jia1 an4 zhao4 lao3 tian1 de5 zhi3 shi4
cues.en: The explorer followed the voice's instructions.

cues.zh: 拿了一块大石头
cues.pinyin: na2 le5 yi1 kuai4 da4 shi2 tou5
cues.en: He picked up a big rock.

cues.zh: 朝酋长用力丢过去
cues.pinyin: chao2 qiu2 zhang3 yong4 li4 diu1 guo4 qu4
cues.en: And hurled it hard at the chief.

cues.zh: 酋长就被砸死了
cues.pinyin: qiu2 zhang3 jiu4 bei4 za2 si3 le5
cues.en: The chief was struck dead.

cues.zh: 其他的食人族
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 shi2 ren2 zu2
cues.en: The rest of the cannibals

cues.zh: 先是错愕
cues.pinyin: xian1 shi4 cuo4 e4
cues.en: were stunned at first,

cues.zh: 然后开始对探险家怒目相视
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 kai1 shi3 dui4 tan4 xian3 jia1 nu4 mu4 xiang1 shi4
cues.en: then started glaring furiously at the explorer.

cues.zh: 这时候天上又传来声音
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 tian1 shang4 you4 chuan2 lai2 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: At that moment, the voice from the sky spoke again:

cues.zh: 这下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4
cues.en: "Now

cues.zh: 你才是真的死定了
cues.pinyin: ni3 cai2 shi4 zhen1 de5 si3 ding4 le5
cues.en: you're really done for."

cues.zh: 老鼠姓米

cues.zh: 因为他吃米

cues.zh: 那为什么糖好压姓糖

cues.en: "Then why is candy's surname Tang (sugar)?"

cues.zh: 因为他吃死
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 chi1 si3

cues.zh: 有一天晚上
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wan3 shang4
cues.en: One night,

cues.zh: 阿兵哥捡到了一只小狗
cues.pinyin: a1 bing1 ge1 jian3 dao4 le5 yi1 zhi1 xiao3 gou3
cues.en: a soldier found a puppy.

cues.zh: 并把他带回军营
cues.pinyin: bing4 ba3 ta1 dai4 hui2 jun1 ying2
cues.en: and brought it back to the barracks.

cues.zh: 军营里的人都很喜欢他
cues.pinyin: jun1 ying2 li3 de5 ren2 dou1 hen3 xi3 huan1 ta1
cues.en: Everyone in the barracks loved it.

cues.zh: 过了不知道多久
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 bu4 zhi1 dao4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: After some unknown amount of time,

cues.zh: 这只小狗开始帮忙工作
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhi3 xiao3 gou3 kai1 shi3 bang1 mang2 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: the puppy started helping out with chores.

cues.zh: 一位军人出门拿东西
cues.pinyin: yi1 wei4 jun1 ren2 chu1 men2 na2 dong1 xi1
cues.en: One soldier went out to get something

cues.zh: 不小心看到小狗在说话
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 kan4 dao4 xiao3 gou3 zai4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: and accidentally saw the puppy talking.

cues.zh: 他吓了一跳
cues.pinyin: ta1 xia4 le5 yi1 tiao4
cues.en: He was startled.

cues.zh: 小狗对他说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gou3 dui4 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: The puppy said to him,

cues.zh: 求求你
cues.pinyin: qiu2 qiu2 ni3
cues.en: "Please,

cues.zh: 不要把我会说话的事说出去
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 ba3 wo3 hui4 shuo1 hua4 de5 shi4 shuo1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: don't tell anyone that I can talk."

cues.zh: 不然他们连电话都要叫我接了
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 ta1 men5 lian2 dian4 hua4 dou1 yao4 jiao4 wo3 jie1 le5
cues.en: "Otherwise they'll even make me answer the phone."

cues.zh: 大大我问你哦
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 有壳的叫乌龟
cues.pinyin: you3 ke2 de5 jiao4 wu1 gui1
cues.en: The one with a shell is called a turtle.

cues.zh: 没壳的叫什么龟
cues.pinyin: mei2 ke2 de5 jiao4 shen2 me5 gui1
cues.en: What's the one without a shell called?

cues.zh: 没壳的叫什么龟
cues.pinyin: mei2 ke2 de5 jiao4 shen2 me5 gui1
cues.en: What's the one without a shell called?

cues.zh: 没壳的是壁虎
cues.pinyin: mei2 ke2 de5 shi4 bi4 hu3
cues.en: "The shell-less one is a gecko."

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "Nope."

cues.zh: 壁虎龟
cues.pinyin: bi4 hu3 gui1
cues.en: "A gecko-turtle?"

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "Nope."

cues.zh: 是无家可归
cues.pinyin: shi4 wu2 jia1 ke3 gui1
cues.en: "It's 'homeless' (a pun on 'shell-less turtle')."

cues.zh: 天小明的老师
cues.pinyin: tian1 xiao3 ming2 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: One day, Xiaoming's teacher

cues.zh: 打电话给小明的妈妈
cues.pinyin: da3 dian4 hua4 gei3 xiao3 ming2 de5 ma1 ma1
cues.en: called Xiaoming's mom.

cues.zh: 喂小明的妈妈
cues.pinyin: wei4 xiao3 ming2 de5 ma1 ma1
cues.en: "Hello, Xiaoming's mom,

cues.zh: 小明在考试的时候作弊
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 zai4 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 zuo4 bi4
cues.en: Xiaoming cheated on his exam."

cues.zh: 麻烦你教训他哦
cues.pinyin: ma2 fan2 ni3 jiao4 xun4 ta1 o2
cues.en: "Please give him a talking-to."

cues.zh: 哦这样子哦
cues.pinyin: o2 zhe4 yang4 zi5 o2
cues.en: "Oh, I see."

cues.zh: 好的
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5
cues.en: "Okay."

cues.zh: 小明回家后妈妈便问小明
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 hui2 jia1 hou4 ma1 ma1 bian4 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: After Xiaoming got home, his mom asked him,

cues.zh: 你是不是在考试的时候抄同学的答案啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 bu2 shi4 zai4 kao3 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 chao1 tong2 xue2 de5 da2 an4 a5
cues.en: "Did you copy a classmate's answers during the exam?"

cues.zh: 是啊但是我没有抄完
cues.pinyin: shi4 a5 dan4 shi4 wo3 mei2 you3 chao1 wan2
cues.en: "Yeah, but I didn't finish copying."

cues.zh: 那你哪一个不是抄的
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 na3 yi2 ge4 bu2 shi4 chao1 de5
cues.en: "So which one didn't you copy?"

cues.zh: 名字
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4
cues.en: "The name."

cues.zh: 欸如果射到好人那一出电影就演完了啊
cues.pinyin: ai1 ru2 guo3 she4 dao4 hao3 ren2 na4 yi1 chu1 dian4 ying3 jiu4 yan3 wan2 le5 a5
cues.en: "If the bullet hit the good guy, the movie would be over right there."

cues.zh: 所以当然射不到好人
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dang1 ran2 she4 bu2 dao4 hao3 ren2
cues.en: "So of course it can't hit the good guy."

cues.zh: 错答案是因为它是二视力
cues.pinyin: cuo4 da2 an4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 er4 shi4 li4
cues.en: "Wrong, the real answer is because he's nearsighted."

cues.zh: 正方形的面积是 8 乘以 8 等于 64
cues.pinyin: zheng4 fang1 xing2 de5 mian4 ji1 shi4 8 cheng2 yi3 8 deng3 yu2 64
cues.en: The area of the square is 8 times 8, which equals 64.

cues.zh: 切开后重新排列
cues.pinyin: qie4 kai1 hou4 chong2 xin1 pai2 lie4
cues.en: After cutting it up and rearranging the pieces,

cues.zh: 变成 5 乘以 13 等于 65
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 5 cheng2 yi3 13 deng3 yu2 65
cues.en: it becomes 5 times 13, which equals 65.

cues.zh: 为什么 64 会等于 65 呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 64 hui4 deng3 yu2 65 ne5
cues.en: Why would 64 equal 65?

cues.zh: 你知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Do you know the answer?

cues.zh: 可在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: Feel free to leave a comment below and tell everyone.

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer from last episode is here.

cues.zh: 只要把这根火柴棒往下移
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ba3 zhe4 gen1 huo3 chai2 bang4 wang3 xia4 yi2
cues.en: Just move this matchstick down,

cues.zh: 就变成 4 个三角形了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bian4 cheng2 4 ge4 san1 jiao3 xing2 le5
cues.en: and it becomes 4 triangles.

cues.zh: 你答对了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 da2 dui4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you get it right?
