cues.zh: 嗨大家好我是大大
cues.pinyin: hai1 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 da4 da4
cues.en: Hi everyone, I'm Dada.

cues.zh: 今天我要聊的趣事是
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 yao4 liao2 de5 qu4 shi4 shi4
cues.en: The funny story I want to talk about today is

cues.zh: 我读书在外地住宿时发生的故事
cues.pinyin: wo3 du2 shu1 zai4 wai4 di4 zhu4 su4 shi2 fa1 sheng1 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: something that happened when I was living away from home for school.

cues.zh: 鱿鱼丝的秘密那时因在外地念书
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 si1 de5 mi4 mi4 na4 shi2 yin1 zai4 wai4 di4 nian4 shu1
cues.en: The secret of the squid snack — that was when I was studying away from home,

cues.zh: 所以在学校附近租房子有一回
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 xue2 xiao4 fu4 jin4 zu1 fang2 zi5 you3 yi1 hui2
cues.en: so I rented a place near school. One time,

cues.zh: 一位认识的学长阿华
cues.pinyin: yi1 wei4 ren4 shi2 de5 xue2 zhang3 a1 hua2
cues.en: a senior I knew, Ah Hua,

cues.zh: 当兵放假回来
cues.pinyin: dang1 bing1 fang4 jia4 hui2 lai2
cues.en: came back on leave from military service

cues.zh: 到我住屋处来找我聊天
cues.pinyin: dao4 wo3 zhu4 wu1 chu4 lai2 zhao3 wo3 liao2 tian1
cues.en: and came to my place to chat.

cues.zh: 我的房间是合租的要脱鞋
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 fang2 jian1 shi4 he2 zu1 de5 yao4 tuo1 xie2
cues.en: My room was a shared rental, so you had to take your shoes off.

cues.zh: 我们坐在地上一边喝饮料
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 zai4 di4 shang4 yi1 bian1 he1 yin3 liao4
cues.en: We sat on the floor drinking drinks

cues.zh: 一边聊着往事
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 liao2 zhe5 wang3 shi4
cues.en: while chatting about old times.

cues.zh: 聊得很开心
cues.pinyin: liao2 de2 hen3 kai1 xin1
cues.en: We were having a great time.

cues.zh: 但他突然开始一边聊天
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 tu1 ran2 kai1 shi3 yi1 bian1 liao2 tian1
cues.en: But suddenly, while chatting,

cues.zh: 一边剥起脚皮
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 bo1 qi3 jiao3 pi2
cues.en: he started peeling the skin off his feet.

cues.zh: 哦好痒哦
cues.pinyin: o2 hao3 yang3 o2
cues.en: "Ugh, it's so itchy,"

cues.zh: 去当兵得到香港脚
cues.pinyin: qu4 dang1 bing1 de2 dao4 xiang1 gang3 jiao3
cues.en: "I got athlete's foot during military service."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事2｜笑话｜鱿鱼丝的秘密｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 你看脚都脱皮
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 jiao3 dou1 tuo1 pi2
cues.en: "Look, my feet are peeling."

cues.zh: 好痒哦
cues.pinyin: hao3 yang3 o2
cues.en: "So itchy!"

cues.zh: 哎很恶心耶
cues.pinyin: ai1 hen3 e3 xin1 ye2
cues.en: "Ugh, that's so gross,"

cues.zh: 你可不可以不要再剥了
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 bu4 ke3 yi3 bu2 yao4 zai4 bo1 le5
cues.en: "can you stop peeling it?"

cues.zh: 我的房间是合租的
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 fang2 jian1 shi4 he2 zu1 de5
cues.en: My room was a shared rental —

cues.zh: 我都直接躺下去睡觉呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 dou1 zhi2 jie1 tang3 xia4 qu4 shui4 jiao4 ne5
cues.en: I'd just lie straight down on the floor to sleep.

cues.zh: 哦好啦
cues.pinyin: o2 hao3 la5
cues.en: "Oh, alright,"

cues.zh: 那我就把剥下来的脚皮先放在桌上
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 ba3 bo1 xia4 lai2 de5 jiao3 pi2 xian1 fang4 zai4 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: so I put the peeled foot skin on the table for now,

cues.zh: 待会儿我再一起拿去丢
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui4 er5 wo3 zai4 yi4 qi3 na2 qu4 diu1
cues.en: planning to throw it away together later.

cues.zh: 我们聊了一会儿
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 liao2 le5 yi1 hui4 er5
cues.en: We chatted for a while longer,

cues.zh: 不知不觉中桌上也出现了一座脚皮小山
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 zhong1 zhuo1 shang4 ye3 chu1 xian4 le5 yi1 zuo4 jiao3 pi2 xiao3 shan1
cues.en: and before we knew it, there was a little mountain of foot skin on the table.

cues.zh: 后来阿华学长约我一起去外面
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 a1 hua2 xue2 zhang3 yue1 wo3 yi4 qi3 qu4 wai4 mian4
cues.en: Later, senior Ah Hua invited me to go out

cues.zh: 吃饭继续聊天
cues.pinyin: chi1 fan4 ji4 xu4 liao2 tian1
cues.en: to eat and keep chatting.

cues.zh: 但走的时候他忘了把他的脚皮
cues.pinyin: dan4 zou3 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 wang4 le5 ba3 ta1 de5 jiao3 pi2
cues.en: But when he left, he forgot to throw away

cues.zh: 小山拿去丢掉
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shan1 na2 qu4 diu1 diao4
cues.en: his little mountain of foot skin.

cues.zh: 后来在外面吃完饭阿华学长就回去了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zai4 wai4 mian4 chi1 wan2 fan4 a1 hua2 xue2 zhang3 jiu4 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: After we finished eating out, senior Ah Hua went home,

cues.zh: 我也返回住屋处
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 fan3 hui2 zhu4 wu1 chu4
cues.en: and I went back to my place too.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事2｜笑话｜鱿鱼丝的秘密｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 我打开门的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 da3 kai1 men2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I opened the door,

cues.zh: 发现我的同居室友
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 wo3 de5 tong2 ju1 shi4 you3
cues.en: I found my roommate,

cues.zh: 阿达已经在里面了
cues.pinyin: a1 da2 yi3 jing1 zai4 li3 mian4 le5
cues.en: Ah Da, was already inside.

cues.zh: 哦你真是太浪费了
cues.pinyin: o2 ni3 zhen1 shi4 tai4 lang4 fei4 le5
cues.en: "Wow, what a waste,"

cues.zh: 吃鱿鱼丝
cues.pinyin: chi1 you2 yu2 si1
cues.en: "eating squid snack"

cues.zh: 血血掉了这么多在桌上
cues.pinyin: xue4 xue4 diao4 le5 zhe4 me5 duo1 zai4 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: "and dropping so many crumbs on the table."

cues.zh: 哦那个是
cues.pinyin: o2 na4 ge5 shi4
cues.en: "Oh, that's..."

cues.zh: 刚刚学长来找我聊天
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 xue2 zhang3 lai2 zhao3 wo3 liao2 tian1
cues.en: "my senior came by to chat earlier."

cues.zh: 诶诶
cues.pinyin: ei2 ei2
cues.en: "Huh?"

cues.zh: 我看到阿达一边闻
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 a1 da2 yi1 bian1 wen2
cues.en: I watched Ah Da sniffing it

cues.zh: 一边在捏起来吃
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 zai4 nie1 qi3 lai2 chi1
cues.en: and then picking it up to eat.

cues.zh: 一时间
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: For a moment,

cues.zh: 我觉得很好笑
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 hen3 hao3 xiao4
cues.en: I found it hilarious,

cues.zh: 但我不知道
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: but I had no idea

cues.zh: 该跟他说什么好
cues.pinyin: gai1 gen1 ta1 shuo1 shen2 me5 hao3
cues.en: what to say to him.

cues.zh: 噢你刚刚要说什么啊
cues.pinyin: o1 ni3 gang1 gang1 yao4 shuo1 shen2 me5 a5
cues.en: "Oh, what were you about to say?"

cues.zh: 欸你这个鱿鱼丝绝绝
cues.pinyin: ai1 ni3 zhe4 ge5 you2 yu2 si1 jue2 jue2
cues.en: "Hey, this squid snack,"

cues.zh: 味道比较怪是不是放过期了啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 dao4 bi3 jiao4 guai4 shi4 bu2 shi4 fang4 guo4 qi1 le5 a5
cues.en: "it tastes kind of weird — is it expired?"

cues.zh: 噢那没什么
cues.pinyin: o1 na4 mei2 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Oh, it's nothing,"

cues.zh: 比较怪你就不要再吃了
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 guai4 ni3 jiu4 bu2 yao4 zai4 chi1 le5
cues.en: "if it tastes off, just stop eating it."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事2｜笑话｜鱿鱼丝的秘密｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 学生时期大家都比较节省
cues.pinyin: xue2 sheng1 shi2 qi1 da4 jia1 dou1 bi3 jiao4 jie2 sheng3
cues.en: Back in our student days, everyone was pretty frugal,

cues.zh: 阿达最后还是把他吃完了
cues.pinyin: a1 da2 zui4 hou4 hai2 shi4 ba3 ta1 chi1 wan2 le5
cues.en: so Ah Da ended up finishing it anyway.

cues.zh: 直到现在阿达依旧是我最好的朋友
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 xian4 zai4 a1 da2 yi1 jiu4 shi4 wo3 zui4 hao3 de5 peng2 you3
cues.en: To this day, Ah Da is still my best friend.

cues.zh: 我们一直都保持联络
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi4 zhi2 dou1 bao3 chi2 lian2 luo4
cues.en: We've stayed in touch all this time,

cues.zh: 但我还是不知道该不该跟他讲当年
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 hai2 shi4 bu4 zhi1 dao4 gai1 bu4 gai1 gen1 ta1 jiang3 dang1 nian2
cues.en: but I still don't know whether I should tell him about

cues.zh: 鱿鱼丝的秘密
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 si1 de5 mi4 mi4
cues.en: the secret of that squid snack from back then.

cues.zh: 也因这件事
cues.pinyin: ye3 yin1 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: Because of this,

cues.zh: 我到现在都不再喜欢吃鱿鱼丝了
cues.pinyin: wo3 dao4 xian4 zai4 dou1 bu4 zai4 xi3 huan1 chi1 you2 yu2 si1 le5
cues.en: I haven't enjoyed eating squid snack ever since.

cues.zh: 喜欢今天的影片吗
cues.pinyin: xi3 huan1 jin1 tian1 de5 ying3 pian4 ma5
cues.en: Did you like today's video?

cues.zh: 喜欢的话请帮我们按赞订阅加分享哦
cues.pinyin: xi3 huan1 de5 hua4 qing3 bang1 wo3 men5 an4 zan4 ding4 yue4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 o2
cues.en: If you did, please like, subscribe, and share — thanks!

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 1000万人参与这支纪录片，在路上找答案

cues.zh: 你敢去抛弃一些东西去做你想做的事吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 gan3 qu4 pao1 qi4 yi1 xie1 dong1 xi1 qu4 zuo4 ni3 xiang3 zuo4 de5 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Do you dare give up certain things to do what you really want to do?

cues.zh: 没有想过放弃不想被别人看别人
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 xiang3 guo4 fang4 qi4 bu4 xiang3 bei4 bie2 ren2 kan4 bie2 ren2
cues.en: I never thought about giving up — I didn't want to be looked down on by others.

cues.zh: 我用这种方式也可以成为我的方向
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 ye3 ke3 yi3 cheng2 wei2 wo3 de5 fang1 xiang4
cues.en: This way, I can also become my own direction.

cues.zh: 就是需要很大的勇气
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xu1 yao4 hen3 da4 de5 yong3 qi4
cues.en: It just takes a lot of courage.

cues.zh: 走出来了以后懂得了应该怎么
cues.pinyin: zou3 chu1 lai2 le5 yi3 hou4 dong3 de5 le5 ying1 gai1 zen3 me5
cues.en: After I came out of it, I understood how

cues.zh: 样去热爱生活
cues.pinyin: yang4 qu4 re4 ai4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: to love life.

cues.zh: 热爱一定有在家
cues.pinyin: re4 ai4 yi2 ding4 you3 zai4 jia1
cues.en: Loving life definitely isn't just about staying home.

cues.zh: 对别人可能一文不值
cues.pinyin: dui4 bie2 ren2 ke3 neng2 yi1 wen2 bu4 zhi2
cues.en: To others it might be worthless,

cues.zh: 但是对你来说这就是全部
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 ni3 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 quan2 bu4
cues.en: but to you, this is everything.

cues.zh: 感觉干聊天呆你真的还在继续干
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 gan4 liao2 tian1 dai1 ni3 zhen1 de5 hai2 zai4 ji4 xu4 gan4
cues.en: It feels like after doing this for so many years, are you really still going to keep doing it?

cues.zh: 永远永远热泪一样
cues.pinyin: yong3 yuan3 yong3 yuan3 re4 lei4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Forever and ever, loving it just the same.

cues.zh: 你无法不得去做
cues.pinyin: ni3 wu2 fa3 bu4 de2 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: You can't help but do it.

cues.zh: 方向在路上
cues.pinyin: fang1 xiang4 zai4 lu4 shang4
cues.en: The direction is out there on the road.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 中国每年有 55 万的心源性猝死病例
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 mei3 nian2 you3 55 wan4 de5 xin1 yuan2 xing4 cu4 si3 bing4 li4
cues.en: China has 550,000 cases of sudden cardiac death every year.

cues.zh: 他们之中有很多普通人
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi1 zhong1 you3 hen3 duo1 pu3 tong1 ren2
cues.en: Many of them are ordinary people.

cues.zh: 也有像高以翔这样的社会名流
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 xiang4 gao1 yi3 xiang2 zhe4 yang4 de5 she4 hui4 ming2 liu2
cues.en: There are also celebrities like Godfrey Gao (高以翔).

cues.zh: 抢救过来的比例乐观估计也只有 1 到 2
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jiu4 guo4 lai2 de5 bi3 li4 le4 guan1 gu1 ji4 ye3 zhi3 you3 1 dao4 2
cues.en: Even by an optimistic estimate, the survival rate is only 1 to 2 percent.

cues.zh: 因为心源性猝死一旦发生
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xin1 yuan2 xing4 cu4 si3 yi2 dan4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Because once sudden cardiac death happens,

cues.zh: 黄金抢救时间只有几分钟
cues.pinyin: huang2 jin1 qiang3 jiu4 shi2 jian1 zhi3 you3 ji3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: the golden window for rescue is only a few minutes.

cues.zh: 10 分钟以后大脑就会因为缺氧
cues.pinyin: 10 fen1 zhong1 yi3 hou4 da4 nao3 jiu4 hui4 yin1 wei4 que1 yang3
cues.en: After 10 minutes, the brain, due to lack of oxygen,

cues.zh: 而面临不可逆的损害
cues.pinyin: er2 mian4 lin2 bu4 ke3 ni4 de5 sun3 hai4
cues.en: will suffer irreversible damage,

cues.zh: 并让患者最终死亡
cues.pinyin: bing4 rang4 huan4 zhe3 zui4 zhong1 si3 wang2
cues.en: which ultimately leads to the patient's death.

cues.zh: 心源性猝死到底是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: xin1 yuan2 xing4 cu4 si3 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what exactly is sudden cardiac death?

cues.zh: 心肺复苏 C PR 和体外除颤 A ED
cues.pinyin: xin1 fei4 fu4 su1 C PR he2 ti3 wai4 chu2 chan4 A ED
cues.en: CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) and AED (automated external defibrillation) —

cues.zh: 又应该如何使用呢
cues.pinyin: you4 ying1 gai1 ru2 he2 shi3 yong4 ne5
cues.en: how should they be used?

cues.zh: 今天我们就带着大家来讨论一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 dai4 zhe5 da4 jia1 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today we'll discuss this question with everyone.

cues.zh: 我们首先要讨论一下心脏的功能
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 yao4 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 xin1 zang4 de5 gong1 neng2
cues.en: First, let's talk about the function of the heart.

cues.zh: 因为我们要了解为什么要进行急救
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 yao4 liao3 jie3 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 jin4 xing2 ji2 jiu4
cues.en: Because we need to understand why emergency treatment is needed,

cues.zh: 我们得知道心脏到底是出了什么样的问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de2 zhi1 dao4 xin1 zang4 dao4 di3 shi4 chu1 le5 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: we have to know exactly what's going wrong with the heart.

cues.zh: 我先画一个心脏
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian1 hua4 yi2 ge4 xin1 zang4
cues.en: Let me draw a heart first.

cues.zh: 好我们画完了一个心脏的示意图
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 men5 hua4 wan2 le5 yi2 ge4 xin1 zang4 de5 shi4 yi4 tu2
cues.en: Okay, we've finished drawing a diagram of the heart.

cues.zh: 心脏是两室两厅是吧
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 shi4 liang3 shi4 liang3 ting1 shi4 ba5
cues.en: The heart is like a "two-bedroom, two-living-room" apartment, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 有两个心房和两个心室
cues.pinyin: you3 liang3 ge4 xin1 fang2 he2 liang3 ge4 xin1 shi4
cues.en: It has two atria and two ventricles.

cues.zh: 这个我们就称之为右心房
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 you4 xin1 fang2
cues.en: Let's call this one the right atrium.

cues.zh: 这个我们就称之为左心房
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 zuo3 xin1 fang2
cues.en: Let's call this one the left atrium.

cues.zh: 上面是心房
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 shi4 xin1 fang2
cues.en: The top part is the atria,

cues.zh: 底下是心室
cues.pinyin: di3 xia4 shi4 xin1 shi4
cues.en: and the bottom part is the ventricles.

cues.zh: 这个叫右心室
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 you4 xin1 shi4
cues.en: This one is called the right ventricle.

cues.zh: 底下的这个叫左心室
cues.pinyin: di3 xia4 de5 zhe4 ge5 jiao4 zuo3 xin1 shi4
cues.en: And the one below is called the left ventricle.

cues.zh: 左心室
cues.pinyin: zuo3 xin1 shi4
cues.en: The left ventricle.

cues.zh: 有人说你这个左右是不是反了
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 ni3 zhe4 ge5 zuo3 you4 shi4 bu2 shi4 fan3 le5
cues.en: Someone might say, "Isn't your left and right reversed?"

cues.zh: 其实没反
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 mei2 fan3
cues.en: Actually, it's not reversed.

cues.zh: 因为我这是这样的一个人
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 zhe4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Because this is a person drawn facing us,

cues.zh: 这边就是他的右边
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 jiu4 shi4 ta1 de5 you4 bian1
cues.en: so this side is their right,

cues.zh: 这边就是他的左边
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 jiu4 shi4 ta1 de5 zuo3 bian1
cues.en: and this side is their left.

cues.zh: 所以是右心房右心室
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shi4 you4 xin1 fang2 you4 xin1 shi4
cues.en: So it's the right atrium and right ventricle,

cues.zh: 左心房左心室
cues.pinyin: zuo3 xin1 fang2 zuo3 xin1 shi4
cues.en: the left atrium and left ventricle.

cues.zh: 而且整个心脏的位置
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zheng3 ge4 xin1 zang4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: Also, the position of the whole heart

cues.zh: 大概在我们两乳中间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zai4 wo3 men5 liang3 ru3 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: is roughly between our two nipples,

cues.zh: 中间这个位置稍稍偏左
cues.pinyin: zhong1 jian1 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4 shao1 shao1 pian1 zuo3
cues.en: slightly to the left of that midpoint.

cues.zh: 没有像电视里演的那样
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 xiang4 dian4 shi4 li3 yan3 de5 na4 yang4
cues.en: It's not like what's shown on TV,

cues.zh: 说心脏在这个位置
cues.pinyin: shuo1 xin1 zang4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: where they say the heart is at this spot,

cues.zh: 打这就死了
cues.pinyin: da3 zhe4 jiu4 si3 le5
cues.en: and shooting here kills you instantly.

cues.zh: 不是这地方是左肺
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 zhe4 di4 fang1 shi4 zuo3 fei4
cues.en: No, that spot is actually the left lung.

cues.zh: 心脏是中间偏左一点点的位置
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 shi4 zhong1 jian1 pian1 zuo3 yi4 dian3 dian3 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: The heart is located slightly to the left of center.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 主静脉就是我们身体那些这个
cues.pinyin: zhu3 jing4 mai4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 shen1 ti3 na4 xie1 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: The main veins are those in our body that... um,

cues.zh: 静脉汇到一块
cues.pinyin: jing4 mai4 hui4 dao4 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: all the veins converge together,

cues.zh: 主静脉流回到这个右心房里边去
cues.pinyin: zhu3 jing4 mai4 liu2 hui2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 you4 xin1 fang2 li3 bian1 qu4
cues.en: and the main vein flows back into the right atrium.

cues.zh: 然后这个血流回到右心房里边之后
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 xue4 liu2 hui2 dao4 you4 xin1 fang2 li3 bian1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Then after this blood flows back into the right atrium,

cues.zh: 再通过心房和心室之间的这个瓣膜
cues.pinyin: zai4 tong1 guo4 xin1 fang2 he2 xin1 shi4 zhi1 jian1 de5 zhe4 ge5 ban4 mo2
cues.en: it passes through the valve between the atrium and ventricle,

cues.zh: 叫三肩瓣流到这个右心室里边去
cues.pinyin: jiao4 san1 jian1 ban4 liu2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 you4 xin1 shi4 li3 bian1 qu4
cues.en: called the tricuspid valve, and flows into the right ventricle.

cues.zh: 然后这个右心室一收缩一挤
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 you4 xin1 shi4 yi1 shou1 suo1 yi1 ji3
cues.en: Then the right ventricle contracts and squeezes,

cues.zh: 就把这个血液又挤上去了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 you4 ji3 shang4 qu4 le5
cues.en: pushing this blood up again,

cues.zh: 通过上面的这根管道挤上去了
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 shang4 mian4 de5 zhe4 gen1 guan3 dao4 ji3 shang4 qu4 le5
cues.en: squeezing it up through this pipe above.

cues.zh: 这根管道叫什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gen1 guan3 dao4 jiao4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What is this pipe called?

cues.zh: 这根管道叫肺动脉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gen1 guan3 dao4 jiao4 fei4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: This pipe is called the pulmonary artery.

cues.zh: 肺动脉
cues.pinyin: fei4 dong4 mai4
cues.en: The pulmonary artery.

cues.zh: 那你可以想象
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 ke3 yi3 xiang3 xiang4
cues.en: So you can imagine,

cues.zh: 这个血液经过肺动脉之后流哪去了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 jing1 guo4 fei4 dong4 mai4 zhi1 hou4 liu2 na3 qu4 le5
cues.en: where does this blood go after passing through the pulmonary artery?

cues.zh: 是不是流到肺里边去了
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 liu2 dao4 fei4 li3 bian1 qu4 le5
cues.en: Doesn't it flow into the lungs?

cues.zh: 所以这个血液就会流到肺中去
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 jiu4 hui4 liu2 dao4 fei4 zhong1 qu4
cues.en: So this blood will flow into the lungs.

cues.zh: 那么肺里面可以进行气体交换
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 fei4 li3 mian4 ke3 yi3 jin4 xing2 qi4 ti3 jiao1 huan4
cues.en: And in the lungs, gas exchange can take place.

cues.zh: 也就是说肺会把血液中的二氧化碳释放走
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 fei4 hui4 ba3 xue4 ye4 zhong1 de5 er4 yang3 hua4 tan4 shi4 fang4 zou3
cues.en: That is, the lungs release the carbon dioxide from the blood,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 就会流到身体的各个部分
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 liu2 dao4 shen1 ti3 de5 ge4 ge4 bu4 fen4
cues.en: and then it flows to all parts of the body,

cues.zh: 包括大脑向上流大脑上
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 da4 nao3 xiang4 shang4 liu2 da4 nao3 shang4
cues.en: including up to the brain,

cues.zh: 向下流到这个全身各处
cues.pinyin: xiang4 xia4 liu2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 quan2 shen1 ge4 chu4
cues.en: and down to the rest of the body.

cues.zh: 所以就会经过身体
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 hui4 jing1 guo4 shen1 ti3
cues.en: So it passes through the body,

cues.zh: 经过身体之后
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 shen1 ti3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: and after passing through the body,

cues.zh: 它就会释放出很多氧气
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 shi4 fang4 chu1 hen3 duo1 yang3 qi4
cues.en: it releases a lot of oxygen.

cues.zh: 所以这个血液变成了什么呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 bian4 cheng2 le5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what does this blood become?

cues.zh: 就变成了静脉血
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bian4 cheng2 le5 jing4 mai4 xue4
cues.en: It becomes venous blood.

cues.zh: 静脉血又会通过这个大静脉
cues.pinyin: jing4 mai4 xue4 you4 hui4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 da4 jing4 mai4
cues.en: The venous blood then flows back through the large vein

cues.zh: 流回到右心房里面去
cues.pinyin: liu2 hui2 dao4 you4 xin1 fang2 li3 mian4 qu4
cues.en: into the right atrium.

cues.zh: 所以这个就是整个的一个心脏血
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 zheng3 ge4 de5 yi2 ge4 xin1 zang4 xue4
cues.en: So this is the whole process of the heart's blood

cues.zh: 液循环的过程
cues.pinyin: ye4 xun2 huan2 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: circulation.

cues.zh: 就是血液先流到右心房里去
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xue4 ye4 xian1 liu2 dao4 you4 xin1 fang2 li3 qu4
cues.en: That is, blood first flows into the right atrium,

cues.zh: 流到右心室里去
cues.pinyin: liu2 dao4 you4 xin1 shi4 li3 qu4
cues.en: then into the right ventricle,

cues.zh: 一蹦蹦到了这个肺里去
cues.pinyin: yi1 beng4 beng4 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fei4 li3 qu4
cues.en: then with one pump it jumps into the lungs.

cues.zh: 然后肺中的血回来之后
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fei4 zhong1 de5 xue4 hui2 lai2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Then after the blood from the lungs comes back,

cues.zh: 流到左心房左心室
cues.pinyin: liu2 dao4 zuo3 xin1 fang2 zuo3 xin1 shi4
cues.en: it flows into the left atrium and left ventricle,

cues.zh: 然后再一蹦就蹦到了身体各个地方
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 yi1 beng4 jiu4 beng4 dao4 le5 shen1 ti3 ge4 ge4 di4 fang1
cues.en: and then with another pump it jumps out to all parts of the body.

cues.zh: 然后就这样一次又一次的循环
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 yi1 ci4 you4 yi1 ci4 de5 xun2 huan2
cues.en: And this cycle repeats over and over.

cues.zh: 它可以把肺里边的这个氧气
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 ba3 fei4 li3 bian1 de5 zhe4 ge5 yang3 qi4
cues.en: It carries the oxygen from the lungs

cues.zh: 带到身体的各个部位对吧
cues.pinyin: dai4 dao4 shen1 ti3 de5 ge4 ge4 bu4 wei4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: to every part of the body, right?

cues.zh: 那么这里面功能最重要的是哪一个呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 li3 mian4 gong1 neng2 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4 na3 yi2 ge4 ne5
cues.en: So which part has the most important function here?

cues.zh: 是这个左心室
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhe4 ge5 zuo3 xin1 shi4
cues.en: It's the left ventricle.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 因为左心室的功能是把动脉血
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zuo3 xin1 shi4 de5 gong1 neng2 shi4 ba3 dong4 mai4 xue4
cues.en: Because the left ventricle's job is to pump arterial blood

cues.zh: 蹦到全身各处
cues.pinyin: beng4 dao4 quan2 shen1 ge4 chu4
cues.en: out to the entire body.

cues.zh: 如果你左心室不工作了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zuo3 xin1 shi4 bu4 gong1 zuo4 le5
cues.en: If your left ventricle stops working,

cues.zh: 或者工作能力很差的话
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 gong1 zuo4 neng2 li4 hen3 cha4 de5 hua4
cues.en: or its function becomes very poor,

cues.zh: 这个血液就没有办法蹦到全身各处了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xue4 ye4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 beng4 dao4 quan2 shen1 ge4 chu4 le5
cues.en: then the blood has no way to reach the whole body.

cues.zh: 它如果不能蹦到全身各处的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 ru2 guo3 bu4 neng2 beng4 dao4 quan2 shen1 ge4 chu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If it can't reach the whole body,

cues.zh: 那么身体的细胞就会缺血而死亡
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shen1 ti3 de5 xi4 bao1 jiu4 hui4 que1 xue4 er2 si3 wang2
cues.en: then the body's cells will die from lack of blood.

cues.zh: 最主要的就是大脑
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhu3 yao4 de5 jiu4 shi4 da4 nao3
cues.en: Most importantly, the brain.

cues.zh: 大脑一旦缺血了
cues.pinyin: da4 nao3 yi2 dan4 que1 xue4 le5
cues.en: Once the brain lacks blood,

cues.zh: 这个人就会不可逆的受损对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 hui4 bu4 ke3 ni4 de5 shou4 sun3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: the person suffers irreversible damage, right?

cues.zh: 最后就死亡了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 jiu4 si3 wang2 le5
cues.en: And in the end, they die.

cues.zh: 所以左心室是绝对不能够出问题的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zuo3 xin1 shi4 shi4 jue2 dui4 bu4 neng2 gou4 chu1 wen4 ti2 de5
cues.en: So the left ventricle absolutely cannot have any problems.

cues.zh: 心房出问题倒还问题不大是吧
cues.pinyin: xin1 fang2 chu1 wen4 ti2 dao4 hai2 wen4 ti2 bu4 da4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: If the atria have a problem, it's not as serious, right?

cues.zh: 因为心房主要是接受回流血
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xin1 fang2 zhu3 yao4 shi4 jie1 shou4 hui2 liu2 xie3
cues.en: Because the atria mainly receive returning blood.

cues.zh: 所以有些人心房出现了房颤
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you3 xie1 ren2 xin1 fang2 chu1 xian4 le5 fang2 chan4
cues.en: So some people develop atrial fibrillation,

cues.zh: 或者是这个有人天生没有心房
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 you3 ren2 tian1 sheng1 mei2 you3 xin1 fang2
cues.en: or some people are born without an atrium,

cues.zh: 但他还可以活
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 hai2 ke3 yi3 huo2
cues.en: but they can still live.

cues.zh: 但心室如果出了问题
cues.pinyin: dan4 xin1 shi4 ru2 guo3 chu1 le5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: But if the ventricle has a problem,

cues.zh: 那这人就一定会死是吧
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ren2 jiu4 yi2 ding4 hui4 si3 shi4 ba5
cues.en: then that person will definitely die, right?

cues.zh: 就是因为它的作用是把血蹦出去
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 zuo4 yong4 shi4 ba3 xue4 beng4 chu1 qu4
cues.en: Because its job is to pump blood out.

cues.zh: 它的作用非常大
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 yong4 fei1 chang2 da4
cues.en: Its role is extremely important.

cues.zh: 那么为什么心脏可以有规律的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 shen2 me5 xin1 zang4 ke3 yi3 you3 gui1 lv4 de5
cues.en: So why can the heart beat

cues.zh: 一次一次蹦呢
cues.pinyin: yi1 ci4 yi1 ci4 beng4 ne5
cues.en: regularly, over and over?

cues.zh: 我们来讨论一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's discuss this.

cues.zh: 心脏的节律是如何产生的
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 de5 jie2 lv4 shi4 ru2 he2 chan3 sheng1 de5
cues.en: How is the heart's rhythm generated?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】什么是心源性猝死？不可不知的急救常识：心肺复苏CPR和体外除颤AED

cues.zh: 所以就是痘和房中间的一个结叫痘房结
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 shi4 dou4 he2 fang2 zhong1 jian1 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 jiao4 dou4 fang2 jie2
cues.en: So there's a node between the sinus and the atrium called the sinoatrial node.

cues.zh: 这个痘房结有什么特点呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dou4 fang2 jie2 you3 shen2 me5 te4 dian3 ne5
cues.en: What's special about this sinoatrial node?

cues.zh: 就是它可以有规律的释放出电信号
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 ke3 yi3 you3 gui1 lv4 de5 shi4 fang4 chu1 dian4 xin4 hao4
cues.en: It can release electrical signals regularly.

cues.zh: 它的这个电信号其实就是指挥整
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 dian4 xin4 hao4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 zhi3 hui1 zheng3
cues.en: This electrical signal is actually what commands

cues.zh: 个心脏跳动的
cues.pinyin: ge4 xin1 zang4 tiao4 dong4 de5
cues.en: the whole heart to beat.

cues.zh: 所以它就是司令部是吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 shi4 si1 ling4 bu4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: So it's like the headquarters, right?

cues.zh: 它可以释放电信号
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 shi4 fang4 dian4 xin4 hao4
cues.en: It can release electrical signals.

cues.zh: 这个电信号首先会释放到心房这
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dian4 xin4 hao4 shou3 xian1 hui4 shi4 fang4 dao4 xin1 fang2 zhe4
cues.en: This electrical signal first gets released to the atria,

cues.zh: 释放到心房这个部位
cues.pinyin: shi4 fang4 dao4 xin1 fang2 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4
cues.en: released to this part, the atria,

cues.zh: 释放到心房这个部位
cues.pinyin: shi4 fang4 dao4 xin1 fang2 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4
cues.en: released to this part, the atria,

cues.zh: 也让新房出现收缩的情况
cues.pinyin: ye3 rang4 xin1 fang2 chu1 xian4 shou1 suo1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: causing the atria to contract.

cues.zh: 但是除了这个主司令
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 chu2 le5 zhe4 ge5 zhu3 si1 ling4
cues.en: But besides this main commander,

cues.zh: 它可以有个率的跳动
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 you3 ge4 lv4 de5 tiao4 dong4
cues.en: it can beat regularly,

cues.zh: 而且这个周期是 0 86 秒
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 ge5 zhou1 qi1 shi4 0 86 miao3
cues.en: and this cycle is 0.86 seconds.

cues.zh: 周期大约是 0 86 秒
cues.pinyin: zhou1 qi1 da4 yue1 shi4 0 86 miao3
cues.en: The cycle is about 0.86 seconds.

cues.zh: 所以你可以算出来一分钟
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 ke3 yi3 suan4 chu1 lai2 yi4 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: So you can calculate

cues.zh: 你应该心跳多少次
cues.pinyin: ni3 ying1 gai1 xin1 tiao4 duo1 shao3 ci4
cues.en: how many times your heart should beat per minute.

cues.zh: 那么除了这个主司令以外
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 chu2 le5 zhe4 ge5 zhu3 si1 ling4 yi3 wai4
cues.en: So besides this main commander,

cues.zh: 其实还有一个负司令
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 fu4 si1 ling4
cues.en: there's actually also a secondary commander.

cues.zh: 就是在这个新房和新室中间
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 xin1 fang2 he2 xin1 shi4 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: It's located between the atrium and the ventricle,

cues.zh: 这个地方还有一个结
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 jie2
cues.en: there's another node here.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 一个苹果引起了两起血案这是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ping2 guo3 yin3 qi3 le5 liang3 qi3 xue4 an4 zhe4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: An apple caused two bloody incidents — how did that happen?

cues.zh: 一月在急诊室来了一辆救护车
cues.pinyin: yi2 yue4 zai4 ji2 zhen3 shi4 lai2 le5 yi1 liang4 jiu4 hu4 che1
cues.en: One day in January, an ambulance arrived at the ER.

cues.zh: 从车上抬下来两个病患
cues.pinyin: cong2 che1 shang4 tai2 xia4 lai2 liang3 ge4 bing4 huan4
cues.en: Two patients were carried off the vehicle.

cues.zh: 一个是有枪伤的女孩小丽
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 you3 qiang1 shang1 de5 nv3 hai2 xiao3 li4
cues.en: One was a girl with a gunshot wound, Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 另一个是脖子被钝器所伤的男子
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi2 ge4 shi4 bo2 zi5 bei4 dun4 qi4 suo3 shang1 de5 nan2 zi5
cues.en: The other was a man whose neck was injured by a blunt object.

cues.zh: 他是一个抢劫犯
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiang3 jie2 fan4
cues.en: He was a robber.

cues.zh: 就是他开枪射击小丽的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 kai1 qiang1 she4 ji1 xiao3 li4 de5
cues.en: He was the one who shot Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 肖恩居然也在这辆救护车上
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ju1 ran2 ye3 zai4 zhe4 liang4 jiu4 hu4 che1 shang4
cues.en: Shaun happened to be on this same ambulance.

cues.zh: 就在他急匆匆地往急诊大厅走的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 ta1 ji2 cong1 cong1 di4 wang3 ji2 zhen3 da4 ting1 zou3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Just as he was hurrying toward the ER lobby,

cues.zh: 旁边突然出现一个男孩
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 yi2 ge4 nan2 hai2
cues.en: a boy suddenly appeared beside him,

cues.zh: 指着肖恩说一切都怪你
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zhe5 xiao4 en1 shuo1 yi1 qie4 dou1 guai4 ni3
cues.en: pointed at Shaun and said it was all his fault,

cues.zh: 是你害得小丽受伤的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ni3 hai4 de2 xiao3 li4 shou4 shang1 de5
cues.en: that he was the one who got Xiao Li hurt.

cues.zh: 这几句话让肖恩收获了急诊室里所
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji3 ju4 hua4 rang4 xiao4 en1 shou1 huo4 le5 ji2 zhen3 shi4 li3 suo3
cues.en: These words earned Shaun the stares of

cues.zh: 有人的注目礼
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 de5 zhu4 mu4 li3
cues.en: everyone in the ER.

cues.zh: 小丽的状况十分危急
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 zhuang4 kuang4 shi2 fen1 wei1 ji2
cues.en: Xiao Li's condition was extremely critical.

cues.zh: 必须马上控制住她的大出血
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 ma3 shang4 kong4 zhi4 zhu4 ta1 de5 da4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: Her massive bleeding had to be controlled immediately.

cues.zh: 而抢劫犯则是气管受伤严重
cues.pinyin: er2 qiang3 jie2 fan4 ze2 shi4 qi4 guan3 shou4 shang1 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: The robber, meanwhile, had a badly injured trachea.

cues.zh: 再有五分钟不通气就要挠死亡了
cues.pinyin: zai4 you3 wu3 fen1 zhong1 bu4 tong1 qi4 jiu4 yao4 nao2 si3 wang2 le5
cues.en: Five more minutes without airflow and he'd be dead.

cues.zh: 小丽和抢劫犯都被推进了手术室
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 he2 qiang3 jie2 fan4 dou1 bei4 tui1 jin4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Both Xiao Li and the robber were wheeled into the OR

cues.zh: 接受紧急抢救
cues.pinyin: jie1 shou4 jin3 ji2 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: to receive emergency treatment.

cues.zh: 小丽的手术台上就好像屠宰现场一样惨烈
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 jiu4 hao3 xiang4 tu2 zai3 xian4 chang3 yi1 yang4 can3 lie4
cues.en: Xiao Li's operating table looked as gruesome as a slaughterhouse.

cues.zh: 到处都是沾满鲜血的纱布
cues.pinyin: dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 zhan1 man3 xian1 xue4 de5 sha1 bu4
cues.en: Blood-soaked gauze lay everywhere.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 医生们刚处理完上一个的伤口
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gang1 chu3 li3 wan2 shang4 yi2 ge4 de5 shang1 kou3
cues.en: The doctors had just finished one wound,

cues.zh: 一转身另一边又开始大出血
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhuan3 shen1 ling4 yi1 bian1 you4 kai1 shi3 da4 chu1 xue4
cues.en: and turned around to find heavy bleeding on the other side again.

cues.zh: 一气不断的报警
cues.pinyin: yi1 qi4 bu4 duan4 de5 bao4 jing3
cues.en: The machines kept alarming nonstop.

cues.zh: 想缝合这个姑娘的脾脏
cues.pinyin: xiang3 feng2 he2 zhe4 ge5 gu1 niang2 de5 pi2 zang4
cues.en: They tried to suture the girl's spleen,

cues.zh: 就好像把碎牛肉拼成牛排一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hao3 xiang4 ba3 sui4 niu2 rou4 pin1 cheng2 niu2 pai2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: but it was like trying to piece ground beef back into a steak —

cues.zh: 稍微一用力就全变成了碎肉块
cues.pinyin: shao1 wei1 yi1 yong4 li4 jiu4 quan2 bian4 cheng2 le5 sui4 rou4 kuai4
cues.en: the slightest pressure turned it into mush.

cues.zh: 看来只有把脾脏摘除才能保平安了
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 zhi3 you3 ba3 pi2 zang4 zhai1 chu2 cai2 neng2 bao3 ping2 an1 le5
cues.en: It seemed removing the spleen was the only way to keep her safe.

cues.zh: 手术终于结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 zhong1 yu2 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: The surgery finally ended.

cues.zh: 小丽的大出血暂时止住了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 da4 chu1 xue4 zan4 shi2 zhi3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Li's severe bleeding was temporarily stopped.

cues.zh: 小丽的伤不能说跟肖恩毫无关系
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 shang1 bu4 neng2 shuo1 gen1 xiao4 en1 hao2 wu2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: Xiao Li's injury can't be said to have nothing to do with Shaun.

cues.zh: 这一切的起源还是因为一个苹果
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 qie4 de5 qi3 yuan2 hai2 shi4 yin1 wei4 yi2 ge4 ping2 guo3
cues.en: All of this started because of an apple.

cues.zh: 早晨肖恩去超市买苹果
cues.pinyin: zao3 chen2 xiao4 en1 qu4 chao1 shi4 mai3 ping2 guo3
cues.en: That morning, Shaun went to the supermarket to buy apples

cues.zh: 遇到了一个抢劫犯
cues.pinyin: yu4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 qiang3 jie2 fan4
cues.en: and ran into a robber.

cues.zh: 她用枪指着肖恩让她把钱包拿出来
cues.pinyin: ta1 yong4 qiang1 zhi3 zhe5 xiao4 en1 rang4 ta1 ba3 qian2 bao1 na2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: He pointed a gun at Shaun, telling him to hand over his wallet,

cues.zh: 但她不理解肖恩是一个自闭症患者啊
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 bu4 li3 jie3 xiao4 en1 shi4 yi2 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3 a5
cues.en: but he didn't realize Shaun has autism.

cues.zh: 面对生命危险的肖恩没有想着如何逃命
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 sheng1 ming4 wei1 xian3 de5 xiao4 en1 mei2 you3 xiang3 zhe5 ru2 he2 tao2 ming4
cues.en: Facing a life-threatening situation, Shaun wasn't thinking about escaping;

cues.zh: 而是在那跟驴拉末一样走来走去
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zai4 na4 gen1 lv2 la1 mo4 yi1 yang4 zou3 lai2 zou3 qu4
cues.en: instead he paced back and forth like a donkey turning a mill,

cues.zh: 口中还念念有词
cues.pinyin: kou3 zhong1 hai2 nian4 nian4 you3 ci2
cues.en: muttering to himself the whole time.

cues.zh: 抢劫犯本来就紧张
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 ben3 lai2 jiu4 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: The robber was already on edge,

cues.zh: 一看肖恩这种神神叨叨的样子
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 xiao4 en1 zhe4 zhong3 shen2 shen2 dao1 dao1 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: and seeing Shaun acting so strange,

cues.zh: 还以为他倾神上身呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 yi3 wei2 ta1 qing1 shen2 shang4 shen1 ne5
cues.en: he thought Shaun was possessed by spirits.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 但是小丽没带身份证没法去
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 li4 mei2 dai4 shen1 fen4 zheng4 mei2 fa3 qu4
cues.en: But Xiao Li had no ID, so nothing could proceed.

cues.zh: 梅医生只好让社工去找小丽的家人
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zhi3 hao3 rang4 she4 gong1 qu4 zhao3 xiao3 li4 de5 jia1 ren2
cues.en: Dr. Mei had the social worker go find Xiao Li's family.

cues.zh: 肖恩去小丽的病房查看她的情况
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 qu4 xiao3 li4 de5 bing4 fang2 cha2 kan4 ta1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Shaun went to check on Xiao Li in her room.

cues.zh: 小丽的男友也在
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 nan2 you3 ye3 zai4
cues.en: Her boyfriend was there too.

cues.zh: 她说一切都是因为肖恩
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 yi1 qie4 dou1 shi4 yin1 wei4 xiao4 en1
cues.en: He said it was all because Shaun

cues.zh: 没有把钱包给劫匪
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ba3 qian2 bao1 gei3 jie2 fei3
cues.en: hadn't handed the wallet to the robber —

cues.zh: 一切都怪肖恩
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 dou1 guai4 xiao4 en1
cues.en: it was all Shaun's fault.

cues.zh: 可是肖恩作为天才
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao4 en1 zuo4 wei2 tian1 cai2
cues.en: But Shaun, being a genius,

cues.zh: 她的注意力都在小丽的尿上
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhu4 yi4 li4 dou1 zai4 xiao3 li4 de5 niao4 shang4
cues.en: had no interest in comparing wits with an ordinary person.

cues.zh: 她的注意力都在小丽的尿上
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhu4 yi4 li4 dou1 zai4 xiao3 li4 de5 niao4 shang4
cues.en: His attention was fixed on Xiao Li's urine.

cues.zh: 为什么这么少呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 shao3 ne5
cues.en: Why was there so little of it?

cues.zh: 肖恩把小丽身上的被子全部掀开
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ba3 xiao3 li4 shen1 shang4 de5 bei4 zi5 quan2 bu4 xian1 kai1
cues.en: Shaun pulled back all of Xiao Li's blankets

cues.zh: 发现她身上已经浮肿得很厉害了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 shen1 shang4 yi3 jing1 fu2 zhong3 de2 hen3 li4 hai4 le5
cues.en: and found her body already badly swollen.

cues.zh: 这是严重肾衰的标志
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yan2 zhong4 shen4 shuai1 de5 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: This was a sign of severe kidney failure.

cues.zh: 在给小丽做透析的过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 xiao3 li4 zuo4 tou4 xi1 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: While performing dialysis on Xiao Li,

cues.zh: 发现她的胸腔有大量的肌液
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 xiong1 qiang1 you3 da4 liang4 de5 ji1 ye4
cues.en: they found a large buildup of fluid in her chest cavity,

cues.zh: 肺部也开始衰竭
cues.pinyin: fei4 bu4 ye3 kai1 shi3 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: and her lungs were starting to fail too.

cues.zh: 两人给小丽做穿刺引流
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 gei3 xiao3 li4 zuo4 chuan1 ci4 yin3 liu2
cues.en: The two of them did a drainage puncture on Xiao Li,

cues.zh: 终于稳定了她的呼吸
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 wen3 ding4 le5 ta1 de5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: finally stabilizing her breathing.

cues.zh: 梅医生说这一切只是开始
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 shuo1 zhe4 yi1 qie4 zhi3 shi4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: Dr. Mei said this was only the beginning —

cues.zh: 人多器官同时衰竭的最后一步
cues.pinyin: ren2 duo1 qi4 guan1 tong2 shi2 shuai1 jie2 de5 zui4 hou4 yi1 bu4
cues.en: the final stage of multi-organ failure

cues.zh: 就是心脏衰竭
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xin1 zang4 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: is heart failure.

cues.zh: 所以现在必须时刻关注小丽的呼吸
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xian4 zai4 bi4 xu1 shi2 ke4 guan1 zhu4 xiao3 li4 de5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: So now they had to watch Xiao Li's breathing constantly.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 也许这姑娘不是心脏衰竭
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 zhe4 gu1 niang2 bu2 shi4 xin1 zang4 shuai1 jie2
cues.en: Maybe this girl's problem isn't heart failure at all,

cues.zh: 而是身体里还有其他地方大量出血呢
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 shen1 ti3 li3 hai2 you3 qi2 ta1 di4 fang1 da4 liang4 chu1 xie3 ne5
cues.en: but massive bleeding somewhere else in her body.

cues.zh: 但是这次判断必须准确
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ci4 pan4 duan4 bi4 xu1 zhun3 que4
cues.en: But this time the diagnosis had to be exact,

cues.zh: 因为小莉已经无法经受手术了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 li4 yi3 jing1 wu2 fa3 jing1 shou4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: because Xiao Li couldn't survive another surgery.

cues.zh: 机器的报警声音越来越大
cues.pinyin: ji1 qi4 de5 bao4 jing3 sheng1 yin1 yue4 lai2 yue4 da4
cues.en: The machine's alarm grew louder and louder.

cues.zh: 小丽已经不行了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 yi3 jing1 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: Xiao Li was slipping away.

cues.zh: 再不做决定就可以躺板般睡管管
cues.pinyin: zai4 bu4 zuo4 jue2 ding4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 tang3 ban3 ban1 shui4 guan3 guan3
cues.en: If they didn't decide now, she'd be done for,

cues.zh: 然后埋山山了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 mai2 shan1 shan1 le5
cues.en: and then she'd be buried.

cues.zh: 梅医生当机立断给小丽做手术
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 dang1 ji1 li4 duan4 gei3 xiao3 li4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Dr. Mei decisively went ahead with surgery on Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 在手术室果然发现小丽是有地方大量出血
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 shi4 guo3 ran2 fa1 xian4 xiao3 li4 shi4 you3 di4 fang1 da4 liang4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: In the OR, they confirmed Xiao Li did have heavy bleeding somewhere,

cues.zh: 但是这个出血点却一直找不到
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 chu1 xie3 dian3 que4 yi4 zhi2 zhao3 bu2 dao4
cues.en: but the bleeding point simply couldn't be found.

cues.zh: 这时候肖恩的天才大脑开始启动
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 xiao4 en1 de5 tian1 cai2 da4 nao3 kai1 shi3 qi3 dong4
cues.en: That's when Shaun's genius brain kicked into gear.

cues.zh: 直接通过小丽子弹进入身体的角度
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 tong1 guo4 xiao3 li4 zi3 dan4 jin4 ru4 shen1 ti3 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: Using the angle at which the bullet entered Xiao Li's body,

cues.zh: 判断出了出血点在哪
cues.pinyin: pan4 duan4 chu1 le5 chu1 xie3 dian3 zai4 na3
cues.en: he worked out where the bleeding point was.

cues.zh: 他让梅医生从给小丽左面第二根和第
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 mei2 yi1 sheng1 cong2 gei3 xiao3 li4 zuo3 mian4 di4 er4 gen1 he2 di4
cues.en: He told Dr. Mei to cut in between Xiao Li's left second and

cues.zh: 三根肋骨下刀
cues.pinyin: san1 gen1 lei4 gu3 xia4 dao1
cues.en: third ribs.

cues.zh: 直接通过小丽子弹进入身体的角度
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 tong1 guo4 xiao3 li4 zi3 dan4 jin4 ru4 shen1 ti3 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: The bullet must have nicked the supreme intercostal artery.

cues.zh: 梅医生按照萧恩说的方法
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 an4 zhao4 xiao1 en1 shuo1 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Dr. Mei followed Shaun's instructions

cues.zh: 果然找到了出血点
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 zhao3 dao4 le5 chu1 xie3 dian3
cues.en: and indeed found the bleeding point.

cues.zh: 当出血止住以后
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 xie3 zhi3 zhu4 yi3 hou4
cues.en: Once the bleeding was stopped,

cues.zh: 警报暂时消除了
cues.pinyin: jing3 bao4 zan4 shi2 xiao1 chu2 le5
cues.en: the alarm finally stopped going off.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 当小丽父母赶到医院后
cues.pinyin: dang1 xiao3 li4 fu4 mu3 gan3 dao4 yi1 yuan4 hou4
cues.en: After Xiao Li's parents arrived at the hospital,

cues.zh: 她终于在昏迷中醒了过来
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhong1 yu2 zai4 hun1 mi2 zhong1 xing3 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: she finally woke up from unconsciousness.

cues.zh: 她对男友表示道歉
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 nan2 you3 biao3 shi4 dao4 qian4
cues.en: She apologized to her boyfriend.

cues.zh: 她之前一直以为男友要甩掉她
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 qian2 yi4 zhi2 yi3 wei2 nan2 you3 yao4 shuai3 diao4 ta1
cues.en: She had always assumed he wanted to break up with her,

cues.zh: 才各种找理由
cues.pinyin: cai2 ge4 zhong3 zhao3 li3 you2
cues.en: which is why she kept making excuses.

cues.zh: 现在看到男友不离不弃的
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 kan4 dao4 nan2 you3 bu4 li2 bu4 qi4 de5
cues.en: Now, seeing him stick by her side

cues.zh: 一直陪在她身边
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 pei2 zai4 ta1 shen1 bian1
cues.en: through it all,

cues.zh: 心里真的十分高兴
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 zhen1 de5 shi2 fen1 gao1 xing4
cues.en: she was genuinely overjoyed.

cues.zh: 经历了这次生离死别
cues.pinyin: jing1 li4 le5 zhe4 ci4 sheng1 li2 si3 bie2
cues.en: After going through this brush with death,

cues.zh: 男友突然觉得苍白的小丽是那么可爱
cues.pinyin: nan2 you3 tu1 ran2 jue2 de5 cang1 bai2 de5 xiao3 li4 shi4 na4 me5 ke3 ai4
cues.en: her boyfriend suddenly found pale, weakened Xiao Li so endearing.

cues.zh: 她真心希望小丽身体好以后
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhen1 xin1 xi1 wang4 xiao3 li4 shen1 ti3 hao3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: He genuinely hoped that once Xiao Li recovered,

cues.zh: 可以再次约会
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 ci4 yue1 hui4
cues.en: they could go on another date.

cues.zh: 抢劫犯那边的抢救也是十分的不顺利
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 na4 bian1 de5 qiang3 jiu4 ye3 shi4 shi2 fen1 de5 bu4 shun4 li4
cues.en: On the robber's side, the rescue wasn't going smoothly either.

cues.zh: 小布参与了这个人的抢救过程
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 can1 yu4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 de5 qiang3 jiu4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: Xiao Bu was part of the team treating him.

cues.zh: 在当时撕开衣服的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 dang1 shi2 si1 kai1 yi1 fu2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While tearing his clothes open,

cues.zh: 他看到抢劫犯胸口纹了一个万字
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 qiang3 jie2 fan4 xiong1 kou3 wen2 le5 yi2 ge4 wan4 zi4
cues.en: she saw a swastika tattooed on the robber's chest —

cues.zh: 这是纳粹的标志
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 na4 cui4 de5 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: a Nazi symbol.

cues.zh: 小布对这个人的印象就非常的差
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 dui4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 de5 yin4 xiang4 jiu4 fei1 chang2 de5 cha4
cues.en: Xiao Bu's impression of him immediately turned very negative.

cues.zh: 抢劫犯是一个种族歧视主义者
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhong3 zu2 qi2 shi4 zhu3 yi4 zhe3
cues.en: The robber was a racist,

cues.zh: 而小布恰好就是那个
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 bu4 qia4 hao3 jiu4 shi4 na4 ge5
cues.en: and Xiao Bu happened to be exactly

cues.zh: 最容易被人歧视的黑人妹子
cues.pinyin: zui4 rong2 yi4 bei4 ren2 qi2 shi4 de5 hei1 ren2 mei4 zi5
cues.en: the kind of Black woman most likely to face his discrimination.

cues.zh: 小布本来不打算参与这场抢救
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 ben3 lai2 bu4 da3 suan4 can1 yu4 zhe4 chang3 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: Xiao Bu hadn't originally planned to join this rescue;

cues.zh: 想和萧恩一起去救治小莉的
cues.pinyin: xiang3 he2 xiao1 en1 yi4 qi3 qu4 jiu4 zhi4 xiao3 li4 de5
cues.en: she wanted to go treat Xiao Li together with Shaun instead.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生被人用枪挟持，结果竟导致2人重伤，自己却跟没事人一样！这简直神奇

cues.zh: 利母医生让小布去照顾抢劫犯
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 yi1 sheng1 rang4 xiao3 bu4 qu4 zhao4 gu4 qiang3 jie2 fan4
cues.en: Dr. Lim assigned Xiao Bu to look after the robber.

cues.zh: 小布十分崩溃
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 shi2 fen1 beng1 kui4
cues.en: Xiao Bu was furious.

cues.zh: 她真心希望小丽身体好以后
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhen1 xin1 xi1 wang4 xiao3 li4 shen1 ti3 hao3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: "Dr. Lim, aren't you abusing your authority for personal reasons?"

cues.zh: 今天明明不是我值班啊
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ming2 ming2 bu2 shi4 wo3 zhi2 ban1 a5
cues.en: "It's clearly not my shift today."

cues.zh: 利母医生表示
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 yi1 sheng1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: Dr. Lim replied,

cues.zh: 我就是假公祭司
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 jia3 gong1 ji4 si1
cues.en: "Yes, I am abusing my authority.

cues.zh: 你又能奈我何呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 you4 neng2 nai4 wo3 he2 ne5
cues.en: What are you going to do about it?

cues.zh: 我是领导我牛叉呀
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ling3 dao3 wo3 niu2 cha1 ya5
cues.en: I'm the boss, I can do what I want."

cues.zh: 抢劫犯已经醒了过来
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 yi3 jing1 xing3 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: The robber had woken up.

cues.zh: 他觉得自己很疼
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 hen3 teng2
cues.en: He felt like he was in a lot of pain.

cues.zh: 小布发现这人还有注射毒品的习惯
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ren2 hai2 you3 zhu4 she4 du2 pin3 de5 xi2 guan4
cues.en: Xiao Bu discovered he also had a habit of injecting drugs,

cues.zh: 难怪对止痛药已经产生抗药性了
cues.pinyin: nan2 guai4 dui4 zhi3 tong4 yao4 yi3 jing1 chan3 sheng1 kang4 yao4 xing4 le5
cues.en: which explained his resistance to painkillers.

cues.zh: 这就是自作孽不可活
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 zi4 zuo4 nie4 bu4 ke3 huo2
cues.en: This was a case of reaping what you sow.

cues.zh: 抢劫犯要注射大剂量针痛剂
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 yao4 zhu4 she4 da4 ji4 liang4 zhen1 tong4 ji4
cues.en: The robber wanted a large dose of painkillers injected.

cues.zh: 小布不同意
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: Xiao Bu refused.

cues.zh: 抢劫犯对自己的认识倒是十分透彻
cues.pinyin: qiang3 jie2 fan4 dui4 zi4 ji3 de5 ren4 shi2 dao3 shi4 shi2 fen1 tou4 che4
cues.en: The robber actually had a very clear picture of himself —

cues.zh: 他怀疑小布是看不上他
cues.pinyin: ta1 huai2 yi2 xiao3 bu4 shi4 kan4 bu4 shang4 ta1
cues.en: he suspected Xiao Bu looked down on him

cues.zh: 才用这种方式惩罚他
cues.pinyin: cai2 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 cheng2 fa2 ta1
cues.en: and was punishing him this way.

cues.zh: 还发怒把东西摔在小布的身上
cues.pinyin: hai2 fa1 nu4 ba3 dong1 xi1 shuai1 zai4 xiao3 bu4 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: He got angry and flung things at Xiao Bu.

cues.zh: 晚上小布留在医院值班
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 xiao3 bu4 liu2 zai4 yi1 yuan4 zhi2 ban1
cues.en: That night, Xiao Bu stayed on duty at the hospital.

cues.zh: 我就是假公祭司
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 jia3 gong1 ji4 si1
cues.en: He even said to Shaun,

cues.zh: 要不咱俩换个病人吧
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 zan2 lia3 huan4 ge4 bing4 ren2 ba5
cues.en: "How about we swap patients?"

cues.zh: 他实在不愿意面对那个抢劫犯
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi2 zai4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 mian4 dui4 na4 ge5 qiang3 jie2 fan4
cues.en: He really didn't want to deal with that robber,

cues.zh: 当然也不想面对给自己穿小鞋的
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 ye3 bu4 xiang3 mian4 dui4 gei3 zi4 ji3 chuan1 xiao3 xie2 de5
cues.en: and of course he didn't want to deal with

cues.zh: 领导利姆医生
cues.pinyin: ling3 dao3 li4 mu3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: the boss who kept making life hard for him — Dr. Lim.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 眼前这个比神婆还神的男人
cues.pinyin: yan3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 bi3 shen2 po2 hai2 shen2 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: This man in front of us is more mystical than the shaman herself,

cues.zh: 却是首尔街头令人闻风丧胆的黑
cues.pinyin: que4 shi4 shou3 er3 jie1 tou2 ling4 ren2 wen2 feng1 sang4 dan3 de5 hei1
cues.en: yet he is actually the gang leader on the streets of Seoul who makes people tremble just hearing his name —

cues.zh: 帮头目乔光浩
cues.pinyin: bang1 tou2 mu4 qiao2 guang1 hao4
cues.en: the gang boss Cho Guang-ho.

cues.zh: 做事雷厉风行说一般
cues.pinyin: zuo4 shi4 lei2 li4 feng1 xing2 shuo1 yi4 ban1
cues.en: He gets things done decisively, like a true go-getter.

cues.zh: 可谁能想到一场离奇的遭遇
cues.pinyin: ke3 shui2 neng2 xiang3 dao4 yi1 chang2 li2 qi2 de5 zao1 yu4
cues.en: But who could have imagined that a bizarre encounter

cues.zh: 竟让他被迫转行成了神婆
cues.pinyin: jing4 rang4 ta1 bei4 po4 zhuan3 hang2 cheng2 le5 shen2 po2
cues.en: would force him to switch careers and become a shaman.

cues.zh: 从此开启了一边混黑道一边跳大
cues.pinyin: cong2 ci3 kai1 qi3 le5 yi1 bian1 hun4 hei1 dao4 yi1 bian1 tiao4 da4
cues.en: From then on he began a double life — mixed up in the underworld while also performing shamanic rituals,

cues.zh: 神的双重人生
cues.pinyin: shen2 de5 shuang1 chong2 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: a dual existence.

cues.zh: 这天光浩与同为二当家的泰珠一
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 guang1 hao4 yu3 tong2 wei4 er4 dang1 jia1 de5 tai4 zhu1 yi1
cues.en: One day, Guanghao and Taizhu, who was also second-in-command,

cues.zh: 起去追捕另一
cues.pinyin: qi3 qu4 zhui1 bu3 ling4 yi1
cues.en: went together to hunt down

cues.zh: 个帮派的老大
cues.pinyin: ge4 bang1 pai4 de5 lao3 da4
cues.en: the boss of another gang.

cues.zh: 平日下手狠辣
cues.pinyin: ping2 ri4 xia4 shou3 hen3 la4
cues.en: He was usually ruthless when he made his move.

cues.zh: 光浩成功抢回了对方帮派的机密文件
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 cheng2 gong1 qiang3 hui2 le5 dui4 fang1 bang1 pai4 de5 ji1 mi4 wen2 jian4
cues.en: Guanghao succeeded in snatching back the rival gang's confidential documents.

cues.zh: 可泰珠却想独吞功劳
cues.pinyin: ke3 tai4 zhu1 que4 xiang3 du2 tun1 gong1 lao2
cues.en: But Taizhu wanted to claim all the credit for himself,

cues.zh: 想让光浩不备泰珠用刀捅向光浩
cues.pinyin: xiang3 rang4 guang1 hao4 bu4 bei4 tai4 zhu1 yong4 dao1 tong3 xiang4 guang1 hao4
cues.en: so wanting to catch Guanghao off guard, he stabbed a knife toward him.

cues.zh: 幸好光浩反应过快
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 guang1 hao4 fan3 ying4 guo4 kuai4
cues.en: Luckily, Guanghao reacted too fast,

cues.zh: 及时用手握住了刀剑
cues.pinyin: ji2 shi2 yong4 shou3 wo4 zhu4 le5 dao1 jian4
cues.en: and grabbed the blade with his bare hand in time,

cues.zh: 这才没造成致命伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 mei2 zao4 cheng2 zhi4 ming4 shang1
cues.en: so it didn't end up being a fatal wound.

cues.zh: 之后他直奔医院准备处理伤口
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 ta1 zhi2 ben1 yi1 yuan4 zhun3 bei4 chu3 li3 shang1 kou3
cues.en: Afterward, he rushed straight to the hospital to get the wound treated.

cues.zh: 可帮派老大却一个劲打电话
cues.pinyin: ke3 bang1 pai4 lao3 da4 que4 yi2 ge4 jin4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: But the gang boss kept calling nonstop,

cues.zh: 催光浩回去汇报工作
cues.pinyin: cui1 guang1 hao4 hui2 qu4 hui4 bao4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: pressing Guanghao to come back and report on the job.

cues.zh: 为了节省时间
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie2 sheng3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: To save time,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 光浩连麻药都没打
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 lian2 ma2 yao4 dou1 mei2 da3
cues.en: Guanghao didn't even get anesthesia,

cues.zh: 让医生直接缝针
cues.pinyin: rang4 yi1 sheng1 zhi2 jie1 feng4 zhen1
cues.en: and had the doctor stitch him up directly.

cues.zh: 面对暗恋的女神
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 an4 lian4 de5 nv3 shen2
cues.en: In front of the goddess he secretly had a crush on,

cues.zh: 尽管光浩疼得呲牙咧嘴
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 guang1 hao4 teng2 de2 zi1 ya2 lie3 zui3
cues.en: even though Guanghao was grimacing from the pain,

cues.zh: 他硬是咬着牙撑到了最后
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying4 shi4 yao3 zhe5 ya2 cheng1 dao4 le5 zui4 hou4
cues.en: he gritted his teeth and held on till the end.

cues.zh: 回到总部
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 zong3 bu4
cues.en: Back at headquarters,

cues.zh: 大哥将泰珠骂了一顿
cues.pinyin: da4 ge1 jiang1 tai4 zhu1 ma4 le5 yi1 dun4
cues.en: the boss scolded Taizhu severely,

cues.zh: 将新的项目交给了光浩负责
cues.pinyin: jiang1 xin1 de5 xiang4 mu4 jiao1 gei3 le5 guang1 hao4 fu4 ze2
cues.en: and handed the new project over to Guanghao,

cues.zh: 并让所有人配合他的工作
cues.pinyin: bing4 rang4 suo3 you3 ren2 pei4 he2 ta1 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: ordering everyone to cooperate with him.

cues.zh: 二当家虽有不忿
cues.pinyin: er4 dang1 jia1 sui1 you3 bu4 fen4
cues.en: Although the second-in-command was seething with resentment,

cues.zh: 但也不敢当面发作
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye3 bu4 gan3 dang1 mian4 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: he didn't dare act up to his face.

cues.zh: 晚上光浩做了一个诡异的梦
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 guang1 hao4 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 gui3 yi4 de5 meng4
cues.en: That night, Guanghao had a bizarre dream.

cues.zh: 更离谱的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 li2 pu3 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more absurd,

cues.zh: 他一睡就是整整三天
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 shui4 jiu4 shi4 zheng3 zheng3 san1 tian1
cues.en: he slept for three days straight.

cues.zh: 然而怪事才刚刚开始
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 guai4 shi4 cai2 gang1 gang1 kai1 shi3
cues.en: But the strange events had only just begun.

cues.zh: 这天光浩带着小弟去菜市场收保护费
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 guang1 hao4 dai4 zhe5 xiao3 di4 qu4 cai4 shi4 chang3 shou1 bao3 hu4 fei4
cues.en: That day, Guanghao took his underlings to the market to collect protection money.

cues.zh: 没成想
cues.pinyin: mei2 cheng2 xiang3
cues.en: Unexpectedly,

cues.zh: 他居然看见卖鱼大婶的屁股后面
cues.pinyin: ta1 ju1 ran2 kan4 jian4 mai4 yu2 da4 shen3 de5 pi4 gu3 hou4 mian4
cues.en: he actually saw that behind the auntie selling fish

cues.zh: 拖着一条鱼尾
cues.pinyin: tuo1 zhe5 yi1 tiao2 yu2 wei3
cues.en: was a fish tail trailing along.

cues.zh: 在好奇心的驱使下
cues.pinyin: zai4 hao4 qi2 xin1 de5 qu1 shi3 xia4
cues.en: Driven by curiosity,

cues.zh: 他忍不住凑过去
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren3 bu2 zhu4 cou4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: he couldn't help going over,

cues.zh: 想掀开围裙看个究竟
cues.pinyin: xiang3 xian1 kai1 wei2 qun2 kan4 ge4 jiu1 jing4
cues.en: wanting to lift her apron to see what was really going on.

cues.zh: 结果大婶以为他是想占便宜的臭流氓
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 da4 shen3 yi3 wei2 ta1 shi4 xiang3 zhan4 pian2 yi2 de5 chou4 liu2 mang2
cues.en: As a result, the auntie thought he was a pervert trying to take advantage of her,

cues.zh: 让他想找女人就回家找老婆去
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 xiang3 zhao3 nv3 ren2 jiu4 hui2 jia1 zhao3 lao3 po2 qu4
cues.en: and told him if he wanted a woman he should go home to his wife.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 看着光浩点头
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 guang1 hao4 dian3 tou2
cues.en: Seeing Guanghao nod,

cues.zh: 神婆顿时就明白了
cues.pinyin: shen2 po2 dun4 shi2 jiu4 ming2 bai2 le5
cues.en: the shaman immediately understood

cues.zh: 光浩这是被东西附身了
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 zhe4 shi4 bei4 dong1 xi1 fu4 shen1 le5
cues.en: that Guanghao had been possessed by something,

cues.zh: 想要解决这事
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 jie3 jue2 zhe4 shi4
cues.en: and to resolve the matter,

cues.zh: 唯一的办法就是让他当萨满
cues.pinyin: wei2 yi1 de5 ban4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 rang4 ta1 dang1 sa4 man3
cues.en: the only way was for him to become a shaman himself.

cues.zh: 光浩根本不信这一套
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 gen1 ben3 bu4 xin4 zhe4 yi1 tao4
cues.en: Guanghao didn't believe any of this at all,

cues.zh: 觉得这是神婆骗钱的胡话
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 zhe4 shi4 shen2 po2 pian4 qian2 de5 hu2 hua4
cues.en: thinking it was just nonsense the shaman used to swindle money.

cues.zh: 可他刚走出神婆家
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 gang1 zou3 chu1 shen2 po2 jia1
cues.en: But just as he walked out of the shaman's house,

cues.zh: 就在楼梯口碰到个老奶奶
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 lou2 ti1 kou3 peng4 dao4 ge4 lao3 nai3 nai3
cues.en: he ran into an old grandmother at the stairway.

cues.zh: 老奶奶盯着他嘟囔了几句
cues.pinyin: lao3 nai3 nai3 ding1 zhe5 ta1 du1 nang1 le5 ji3 ju4
cues.en: The grandmother stared at him and muttered a few words,

cues.zh: 光浩就又晕了过去
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 jiu4 you4 yun1 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and Guanghao passed out again.

cues.zh: 送到医院检查时
cues.pinyin: song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 jian3 cha2 shi2
cues.en: When he was taken to the hospital for a checkup,

cues.zh: 伟叔一脸严肃
cues.pinyin: wei3 shu1 yi1 lian3 yan2 su4
cues.en: Uncle Wei had an extremely serious expression,

cues.zh: 看得光浩心里直发毛
cues.pinyin: kan4 de2 guang1 hao4 xin1 li3 zhi2 fa1 mao2
cues.en: which made Guanghao's hair stand on end.

cues.zh: 伟叔告诉他
cues.pinyin: wei3 shu1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Uncle Wei told him

cues.zh: 这病比绝症还严重
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bing4 bi3 jue2 zheng4 hai2 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: that this illness was worse than a terminal disease,

cues.zh: 可能睡着睡着就再也醒不过来了
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shui4 zhao2 shui4 zhao2 jiu4 zai4 ye3 xing3 bu4 guo4 lai2 le5
cues.en: and that he might fall asleep and never wake up again.

cues.zh: 光浩一听
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 yi1 ting1
cues.en: Upon hearing this, Guanghao

cues.zh: 直接拉住伟叔的手
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 la1 zhu4 wei3 shu1 de5 shou3
cues.en: immediately grabbed Uncle Wei's hand,

cues.zh: 反正命悬一现
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 ming4 xuan2 yi1 xian4
cues.en: thinking that since his life was hanging by a thread anyway,

cues.zh: 不如现在就跟他表白
cues.pinyin: bu4 ru2 xian4 zai4 jiu4 gen1 ta1 biao3 bai2
cues.en: he might as well confess his feelings to him right now.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just at that moment,

cues.zh: 护士送来了报告
cues.pinyin: hu4 shi4 song4 lai2 le5 bao4 gao4
cues.en: the nurse brought in the report,

cues.zh: 原来美叔说的是老板的检查结果
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 mei3 shu1 shuo1 de5 shi4 lao3 ban3 de5 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3
cues.en: and it turned out what Uncle Wei had been talking about was actually the boss's test results —

cues.zh: 光浩自己的身体杀是没有
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 zi4 ji3 de5 shen1 ti3 sha1 shi4 mei2 you3
cues.en: Guanghao's own body was completely fine.

cues.zh: 既然医院查不出原因
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 yi1 yuan4 cha2 bu4 chu1 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Since the hospital couldn't find a cause,

cues.zh: 光浩只能再去找神婆
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 zhi3 neng2 zai4 qu4 zhao3 shen2 po2
cues.en: Guanghao had no choice but to go see the shaman again.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 路上他不小心撞到一个小女孩
cues.pinyin: lu4 shang4 ta1 bu4 xiao3 xin1 zhuang4 dao4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 nv3 hai2
cues.en: On the way, he accidentally hit a little girl with his car.

cues.zh: 下车一看
cues.pinyin: xia4 che1 yi1 kan4
cues.en: Getting out to check,

cues.zh: 小女孩竟然毫发无伤
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 jing4 ran2 hao2 fa1 wu2 shang1
cues.en: the girl turned out to be completely unharmed.

cues.zh: 光浩坚持要送他去医院
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 jian1 chi2 yao4 song4 ta1 qu4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Guanghao insisted on taking her to the hospital,

cues.zh: 可小女孩拒绝了
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 nv3 hai2 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but the girl refused,

cues.zh: 只拿走了他的名片
cues.pinyin: zhi3 na2 zou3 le5 ta1 de5 ming2 pian4
cues.en: and only took his business card.

cues.zh: 随后光浩找到神婆
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 guang1 hao4 zhao3 dao4 shen2 po2
cues.en: Afterward, Guanghao went to find the shaman,

cues.zh: 想让他帮忙驱邪
cues.pinyin: xiang3 rang4 ta1 bang1 mang2 qu1 xie2
cues.en: wanting her help to drive out the evil spirit,

cues.zh: 但明确表示不想当萨满
cues.pinyin: dan4 ming2 que4 biao3 shi4 bu4 xiang3 dang1 sa4 man3
cues.en: but made it clear he didn't want to become a shaman.

cues.zh: 神婆看了他的手相
cues.pinyin: shen2 po2 kan4 le5 ta1 de5 shou3 xiang4
cues.en: The shaman looked at his palm

cues.zh: 说他本来早该没命的
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 ben3 lai2 zao3 gai1 mei2 ming4 de5
cues.en: and said he should have died long ago —

cues.zh: 不知道是谁出手干预
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 shi4 shui2 chu1 shou3 gan1 yu4
cues.en: she didn't know who had intervened

cues.zh: 才让他活了下来
cues.pinyin: cai2 rang4 ta1 huo2 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: to let him survive.

cues.zh: 现在除非他成为萨满
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 chu2 fei1 ta1 cheng2 wei2 sa4 man3
cues.en: Now, unless he became a shaman,

cues.zh: 否则随时可能丢命
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 sui2 shi2 ke3 neng2 diu1 ming4
cues.en: he could lose his life at any moment.

cues.zh: 光浩一惊
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 yi1 jing1
cues.en: Guanghao was startled,

cues.zh: 拿起钱转身就要走
cues.pinyin: na2 qi3 qian2 zhuan3 shen1 jiu4 yao4 zou3
cues.en: grabbed his money, and turned to leave.

cues.zh: 开玩笑
cues.pinyin: kai1 wan2 xiao4
cues.en: No way —

cues.zh: 他可是黑帮二当家
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 shi4 hei1 bang1 er4 dang1 jia1
cues.en: he was the second-in-command of a major gang,

cues.zh: 缝针都不用麻药的硬汉
cues.pinyin: feng4 zhen1 dou1 bu4 yong4 ma2 yao4 de5 ying4 han4
cues.en: a tough guy who didn't even need anesthesia for stitches.

cues.zh: 怎么可能去跳大神
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 ke3 neng2 qu4 tiao4 da4 shen2
cues.en: How could he possibly go do shamanic rituals?

cues.zh: 可接下来发生的事
cues.pinyin: ke3 jie1 xia4 lai2 fa1 sheng1 de5 shi4
cues.en: But what happened next

cues.zh: 直接让他彻底改变了想法
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 rang4 ta1 che4 di3 gai3 bian4 le5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: completely changed his mind.

cues.zh: 光浩开车离开神婆家后
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 kai1 che1 li2 kai1 shen2 po2 jia1 hou4
cues.en: After Guanghao drove away from the shaman's house,

cues.zh: 车子突然坏在了铁轨上
cues.pinyin: che1 zi5 tu1 ran2 huai4 zai4 le5 tie3 gui3 shang4
cues.en: his car suddenly broke down right on the train tracks.

cues.zh: 启动箭失灵
cues.pinyin: qi3 dong4 jian4 shi1 ling2
cues.en: The ignition failed,

cues.zh: 车门也打不开
cues.pinyin: che1 men2 ye3 da3 bu4 kai1
cues.en: and the doors wouldn't open either.

cues.zh: 眼看着火车越来越近
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 zhao2 huo3 che1 yue4 lai2 yue4 jin4
cues.en: Watching the train get closer and closer,

cues.zh: 光浩彻底慌了
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 che4 di3 huang1 le5
cues.en: Guanghao completely panicked.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 明年放的正是他经常梦见的铃铛
cues.pinyin: ming2 nian2 fang4 de5 zheng4 shi4 ta1 jing1 chang2 meng4 jian4 de5 ling2 dang1
cues.en: The sound ringing out right then was exactly the bell he often dreamed about.

cues.zh: 就这样光浩从韩国最大黑帮的二当家
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 yang4 guang1 hao4 cong2 han2 guo2 zui4 da4 hei1 bang1 de5 er4 dang1 jia1
cues.en: And just like that, Guanghao went from being the second-in-command of Korea's biggest gang

cues.zh: 变成了一个浓妆艳抹给人算命的萨满
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 nong2 zhuang1 yan4 mo3 gei3 ren2 suan4 ming4 de5 sa4 man3
cues.en: to a heavily made-up shaman telling people's fortunes.

cues.zh: 今天是光浩第一次正式接单
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 guang1 hao4 di4 yi1 ci4 zheng4 shi4 jie1 dan1
cues.en: Today was Guanghao's first official day taking clients.

cues.zh: 没想到第一个客人竟是同行
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 di4 yi2 ge4 ke4 ren2 jing4 shi4 tong2 hang2
cues.en: He never expected his very first customer to be a fellow shaman,

cues.zh: 还想趁机打压他
cues.pinyin: hai2 xiang3 chen4 ji1 da3 ya1 ta1
cues.en: who wanted to use the chance to put him down.

cues.zh: 那人指着光浩就骂他是骗子
cues.pinyin: na4 ren2 zhi3 zhe5 guang1 hao4 jiu4 ma4 ta1 shi4 pian4 zi5
cues.en: That person pointed at Guanghao and called him a fraud,

cues.zh: 让大家别信
cues.pinyin: rang4 da4 jia1 bie2 xin4
cues.en: telling everyone not to believe him.

cues.zh: 这时现场又起了一阵怪风
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xian4 chang3 you4 qi3 le5 yi1 zhen4 guai4 feng1
cues.en: At that moment, a strange wind swept through the scene again,

cues.zh: 铃铛叮当作响
cues.pinyin: ling2 dang1 ding1 dang1 zuo4 xiang3
cues.en: and the bell jingled.

cues.zh: 光浩像被附身一样
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 xiang4 bei4 fu4 shen1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: As if possessed,

cues.zh: 把对方的人生经历说得一清二楚
cues.pinyin: ba3 dui4 fang1 de5 ren2 sheng1 jing1 li4 shuo1 de2 yi4 qing1 er4 chu3
cues.en: Guanghao laid out the other person's entire life story in perfect detail.

cues.zh: 同行当场吓软了
cues.pinyin: tong2 hang2 dang1 chang3 xia4 ruan3 le5
cues.en: The rival shaman was scared stiff on the spot,

cues.zh: 坐在地上就开始哭
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 di4 shang4 jiu4 kai1 shi3 ku1
cues.en: and sat down on the ground crying.

cues.zh: 这事之后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After this incident,

cues.zh: 光浩名声大噪
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 ming2 sheng1 da4 zao4
cues.en: Guanghao's reputation skyrocketed.

cues.zh: 每天都有人排队找他算命
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 dou1 you3 ren2 pai2 dui4 zhao3 ta1 suan4 ming4
cues.en: Every day people lined up to have their fortunes told,

cues.zh: 连电视台都跑来采访
cues.pinyin: lian2 dian4 shi4 tai2 dou1 pao3 lai2 cai3 fang3
cues.en: and even TV stations came to interview him.

cues.zh: 神婆也趁机赚得盘满钵满
cues.pinyin: shen2 po2 ye3 chen4 ji1 zuan4 de5 pan2 man3 bo1 man3
cues.en: The shaman also took the chance to rake in a fortune.

cues.zh: 现在光浩天天忙的脚不沾地
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 guang1 hao4 tian1 tian1 mang2 de5 jiao3 bu4 zhan1 di4
cues.en: Now Guanghao was so busy every day he barely touched the ground,

cues.zh: 就连老板出院的日子都差点忘了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 lao3 ban3 chu1 yuan4 de5 ri4 zi5 dou1 cha4 dian3 wang4 le5
cues.en: and almost forgot the day his boss was discharged from the hospital.

cues.zh: 直到小弟打了电话
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 xiao3 di4 da3 le5 dian4 hua4
cues.en: Not until his underling called

cues.zh: 他才赶去医院
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai2 gan3 qu4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: did he rush over to the hospital.

cues.zh: 结果因为没卸完妆
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 yin1 wei4 mei2 xie4 wan2 zhuang1
cues.en: As a result, because he hadn't finished removing his makeup,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 超10万人评分7.1，韩国年度最佳喜剧犯罪电影，影片斩获国际各大核心奖项，堪称 “韩国电影史上不可错过的黑色喜剧经典”。

cues.zh: 差点被小弟发现
cues.pinyin: cha4 dian3 bei4 xiao3 di4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: he nearly got caught by his underling.

cues.zh: 最近老板被黄警官盯得很紧
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 lao3 ban3 bei4 huang2 jing3 guan1 ding1 de2 hen3 jin3
cues.en: Recently the boss had been closely watched by Officer Huang.

cues.zh: 为了帮老板解决麻烦
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bang1 lao3 ban3 jie3 jue2 ma2 fan2
cues.en: To help the boss get out of trouble,

cues.zh: 光浩决定去会黄警官
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 jue2 ding4 qu4 hui4 huang2 jing3 guan1
cues.en: Guanghao decided to go meet Officer Huang,

cues.zh: 可无论他来软的还是硬的
cues.pinyin: ke3 wu2 lun4 ta1 lai2 ruan3 de5 hai2 shi4 ying4 de5
cues.en: but no matter whether he tried being gentle or tough,

cues.zh: 黄警官都不吃这一套
cues.pinyin: huang2 jing3 guan1 dou1 bu4 chi1 zhe4 yi1 tao4
cues.en: Officer Huang wasn't buying any of it.

cues.zh: 最后两人不欢而散
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 liang3 ren2 bu4 huan1 er2 san4
cues.en: In the end, the two parted on bad terms.

cues.zh: 不知道是不是吵得太凶了
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 shi4 bu2 shi4 chao3 de2 tai4 xiong1 le5
cues.en: Not sure if it was because they'd argued too fiercely,

cues.zh: 旁边有个女人突然哭了起来
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 you3 ge4 nv3 ren2 tu1 ran2 ku1 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: but a woman nearby suddenly burst into tears.

cues.zh: 光浩看了一眼也没太在意就回家了
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 kan4 le5 yi1 yan3 ye3 mei2 tai4 zai4 yi4 jiu4 hui2 jia1 le5
cues.en: Guanghao glanced over but didn't think much of it, and went home.

cues.zh: 洗澡时光浩总觉得有人在掐他后背
cues.pinyin: xi3 zao3 shi2 guang1 hao4 zong3 jue2 de5 you3 ren2 zai4 qia1 ta1 hou4 bei4
cues.en: While showering, Guanghao kept feeling like someone was pinching his back.

cues.zh: 等他出去查看
cues.pinyin: deng3 ta1 chu1 qu4 cha2 kan4
cues.en: When he went out to check,

cues.zh: 结果发现小吃店的那个女人竟然
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 xiao3 chi1 dian4 de5 na4 ge5 nv3 ren2 jing4 ran2
cues.en: he discovered that the woman from the snack shop had actually

cues.zh: 跟着他回了家
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhe5 ta1 hui2 le5 jia1
cues.en: followed him home.

cues.zh: 可这个女人比他还震惊
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 ge5 nv3 ren2 bi3 ta1 hai2 zhen4 jing1
cues.en: But the woman was even more shocked than he was,

cues.zh: 因为这是第一次有人能看见他
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 shi4 di4 yi1 ci4 you3 ren2 neng2 kan4 jian4 ta1
cues.en: because this was the first time anyone had ever been able to see her.

cues.zh: 光浩这才注意到
cues.pinyin: guang1 hao4 zhe4 cai2 zhu4 yi4 dao4
cues.en: Only then did Guanghao notice

cues.zh: 这女人没有影子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 nv3 ren2 mei2 you3 ying3 zi5
cues.en: that the woman had no shadow.

cues.zh: 此时光浩吓得魂都快飞了
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 guang1 hao4 xia4 de2 hun2 dou1 kuai4 fei1 le5
cues.en: At this point Guanghao was scared out of his wits.

cues.zh: 女人希望光浩能帮她给丈夫带句话
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 xi1 wang4 guang1 hao4 neng2 bang1 ta1 gei3 zhang4 fu1 dai4 ju4 hua4
cues.en: The woman hoped Guanghao could pass a message to her husband,

cues.zh: 传完就不再缠着她了
cues.pinyin: chuan2 wan2 jiu4 bu4 zai4 chan2 zhe5 ta1 le5
cues.en: and once it was delivered, she would stop haunting him —

cues.zh: 否则就会一直跟着
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 jiu4 hui4 yi4 zhi2 gen1 zhe5
cues.en: otherwise she would keep following him forever.

cues.zh: 没办法光浩只能答应
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3 guang1 hao4 zhi3 neng2 da1 ying4
cues.en: With no other choice, Guanghao had to agree.

items.title_zh: 笑话83｜熊剪指甲会变什么？｜隐形富二代｜飞离开｜一毛不拔｜8头身｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 吃饭的时候妈妈突然对小明说家里有快递
cues.pinyin: chi1 fan4 de5 shi2 hou4 ma1 ma1 tu1 ran2 dui4 xiao3 ming2 shuo1 jia1 li3 you3 kuai4 di4
cues.en: While they were eating, Mom suddenly told Xiaoming there was a package for the family.

cues.zh: 是你的名字小明心想哦
cues.pinyin: shi4 ni3 de5 ming2 zi4 xiao3 ming2 xin1 xiang3 o2
cues.en: "It has your name on it," she said. Xiaoming thought to himself, "Oh..."

cues.zh: 原来我是隐形的富二代
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 wo3 shi4 yin3 xing2 de5 fu4 er4 dai4
cues.en: "So I'm secretly a rich second-generation heir after all."

cues.zh: 之前的贫困日志都是为了磨练我
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 de5 pin2 kun4 ri4 zhi4 dou1 shi4 wei4 le5 mo2 lian4 wo3
cues.en: "All those years of pretending to be poor were just to toughen me up."

cues.zh: 现在时机终于成熟了我要发了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 shi2 ji1 zhong1 yu2 cheng2 shu2 le5 wo3 yao4 fa1 le5
cues.en: "Now the time has finally come — I'm about to strike it rich."

cues.zh: 小明强忍内心的激动
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 qiang2 ren3 nei4 xin1 de5 ji1 dong4
cues.en: Xiaoming held back his inner excitement.

cues.zh: 尽量用平和又不经意的语气回答
cues.pinyin: jin3 liang4 yong4 ping2 he2 you4 bu4 jing1 yi4 de5 yu3 qi4 hui2 da2
cues.en: He tried his best to answer in a calm, casual tone.

cues.zh: 哦在哪里在桌上过运季来的快递
cues.pinyin: o2 zai4 na3 li3 zai4 zhuo1 shang4 guo4 yun4 ji4 lai2 de5 kuai4 di4
cues.en: "Oh, where is it? On the table — the package that arrived a few days ago."

cues.zh: 我早上帮你签收了
cues.pinyin: wo3 zao3 shang4 bang1 ni3 qian1 shou1 le5
cues.en: "I signed for it on your behalf this morning."

items.title_zh: 笑话83｜熊剪指甲会变什么？｜隐形富二代｜飞离开｜一毛不拔｜8头身｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Shanshan, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 如果啊打不开瓶盖的时候
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 a5 da3 bu4 kai1 ping2 gai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "If you can't get a bottle cap open,"

cues.zh: 应该要请谁来开瓶呢
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 yao4 qing3 shui2 lai2 kai1 ping2 ne5
cues.en: "who should you ask to open it?"

cues.zh: 呃不用啊
cues.pinyin: e4 bu4 yong4 a5
cues.en: "Uh, no need."

cues.zh: 不用请谁啊
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 qing3 shui2 a5
cues.en: "No need to ask anyone."

cues.zh: 因为这样冷说
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 yang4 leng3 shuo1
cues.en: "Because when it's cold like this,"

cues.zh: 所以就冲热水就比较容易打开了啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 chong1 re4 shui3 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 da3 kai1 le5 a5
cues.en: "you just run it under hot water and it opens more easily."

cues.zh: 不是要请孔雀
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yao4 qing3 kong3 que4
cues.en: "No, you should ask a peacock."

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 哦因为孔雀开瓶对吗
cues.pinyin: o2 yin1 wei4 kong3 que4 kai1 ping2 dui4 ma5
cues.en: "Oh, because a peacock is great at 'opening bottles' — a pun on a peacock 'spreading its tail,' right?"

cues.zh: 小美有天遇到了神仙
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 you3 tian1 yu4 dao4 le5 shen2 xian1
cues.en: One day, Xiaomei met an immortal.

cues.zh: 我可以达成你的愿望
cues.pinyin: wo3 ke3 yi3 da2 cheng2 ni3 de5 yuan4 wang4
cues.en: "I can grant you a wish."

cues.zh: 啊我希望我脸小尖下巴大眼睛手脚都很细
cues.pinyin: a5 wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 lian3 xiao3 jian1 xia4 ba1 da4 yan3 jing1 shou3 jiao3 dou1 hen3 xi4
cues.en: "I want a small face, a pointed chin, big eyes, and slender hands and feet."

cues.zh: 还有八头身的比例
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ba1 tou2 shen1 de5 bi3 li4
cues.en: "And an eight-heads-tall body proportion."

cues.zh: 肚子不要太多啰
cues.pinyin: du3 zi5 bu2 yao4 tai4 duo1 luo1
cues.en: "And don't give me too much belly, okay?"

cues.zh: 好的没问题
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: "Sure, no problem."

items.title_zh: 笑话83｜熊剪指甲会变什么？｜隐形富二代｜飞离开｜一毛不拔｜8头身｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有一天小华在学校制作餐厅吃饭
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 hua2 zai4 xue2 xiao4 zhi4 zuo4 can1 ting1 chi1 fan4
cues.en: One day, Xiaohua was eating at the school cafeteria.

cues.zh: 小明拿著他的盘子坐在小华的隔壁
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 na2 zhu4 ta1 de5 pan2 zi5 zuo4 zai4 xiao3 hua2 de5 ge2 bi4
cues.en: Xiaoming took his tray and sat down right next to Xiaohua.

cues.zh: 你不知道
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: "Don't you know,"

cues.zh: 一头猪和一只鸟
cues.pinyin: yi1 tou2 zhu1 he2 yi1 zhi1 niao3
cues.en: "a pig and a bird"

cues.zh: 是不会坐在一起吃东西的吗
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 hui4 zuo4 zai4 yi4 qi3 chi1 dong1 xi1 de5 ma5
cues.en: "aren't supposed to sit together to eat?"

cues.zh: 我知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: "I know."

cues.zh: 你不用担心
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 yong4 dan1 xin1
cues.en: "You don't need to worry."

cues.zh: 我将会
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiang1 hui4
cues.en: "I will"

cues.zh: 飞离开
cues.pinyin: fei1 li2 kai1
cues.en: "fly away."

cues.zh: 接著
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhu4
cues.en: Then,

cues.zh: 小明就坐到另外一张桌子去
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 jiu4 zuo4 dao4 ling4 wai4 yi1 zhang1 zhuo1 zi5 qu4
cues.en: Xiaoming got up and moved to another table.
