items.title_zh: 笑话83｜熊剪指甲会变什么？｜隐形富二代｜飞离开｜一毛不拔｜8头身｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你哦
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: "Chenchen, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 一头牛卖一万元
cues.pinyin: yi1 tou2 niu2 mai4 yi1 wan4 yuan2
cues.en: "One cow sells for 10,000 yuan."

cues.zh: 为什么两头牛卖十万元呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 liang3 tou2 niu2 mai4 shi2 wan4 yuan2 ne5
cues.en: "Why do two cows sell for 100,000 yuan?"

cues.zh: 不知道耶
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ye2
cues.en: "I don't know."

cues.zh: 因为两个头的牛很少啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 liang3 ge4 tou2 de5 niu2 hen3 shao3 a5
cues.en: "Because two-headed cows are rare."

cues.zh: 所以要卖贵一点啊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 mai4 gui4 yi4 dian3 a5
cues.en: "So they sell for a lot more."

cues.zh: 请人节快到了
cues.pinyin: qing3 ren2 jie2 kuai4 dao4 le5
cues.en: Valentine's Day is almost here.

cues.zh: 公鸡找母鸡说
cues.pinyin: gong1 ji1 zhao3 mu3 ji1 shuo1
cues.en: The rooster said to the hen,

cues.zh: 我们一起过情人节吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi4 qi3 guo4 qing2 ren2 jie2 ba5
cues.en: "Let's celebrate Valentine's Day together."

cues.zh: 好啊
cues.pinyin: hao3 a5
cues.en: "Sure."

cues.zh: 你的羽毛好漂亮
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 yu3 mao2 hao3 piao4 liang4
cues.en: "Your feathers are so pretty."

cues.zh: 把几根给我吧
cues.pinyin: ba3 ji3 gen1 gei3 wo3 ba5
cues.en: "Give me a few of them."

cues.zh: 公鸡一听生气说
cues.pinyin: gong1 ji1 yi1 ting1 sheng1 qi4 shuo1
cues.en: On hearing that, the rooster got angry and said,

cues.zh: 怎么过个情人节还得拔毛哦
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 guo4 ge4 qing2 ren2 jie2 hai2 de2 ba2 mao2 o2
cues.en: "How come celebrating Valentine's Day means I have to pluck my own feathers?"

cues.zh: 你一毛不拔还想过情人节
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi1 mao2 bu4 ba2 hai2 xiang3 guo4 qing2 ren2 jie2
cues.en: "You won't give up a single feather, and yet you still want to celebrate Valentine's Day?"

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 当时我绝对没有想到我会一做视
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 wo3 jue2 dui4 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4 wo3 hui4 yi1 zuo4 shi4
cues.en: At the time, I never imagined that I'd keep making videos

cues.zh: 频做这么多年
cues.pinyin: pin2 zuo4 zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2
cues.en: for so many years.

cues.zh: 我也没有想到我会因为做视频获得
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4 wo3 hui4 yin1 wei4 zuo4 shi4 pin2 huo4 de2
cues.en: I also never imagined that making videos would bring me

cues.zh: 这么多的关注
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 de5 guan1 zhu4
cues.en: so much attention.

cues.zh: 我没有想到我会因为做视频额
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4 wo3 hui4 yin1 wei4 zuo4 shi4 pin2 e2
cues.en: I never imagined that making videos would

cues.zh: 外的获得收入
cues.pinyin: wai4 de5 huo4 de2 shou1 ru4
cues.en: earn me extra income.

cues.zh: 我没有想到我会因为做视频获得
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4 wo3 hui4 yin1 wei4 zuo4 shi4 pin2 huo4 de2
cues.en: I never imagined that making videos would bring me

cues.zh: 这么多的麻烦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 de5 ma2 fan2
cues.en: so much trouble.

cues.zh: 这一切我都没有想到
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 qie4 wo3 dou1 mei2 you3 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: I never anticipated any of this.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 从播号网络上流传的 fl ash 动画
cues.pinyin: cong2 bo1 hao4 wang3 luo4 shang4 liu2 chuan2 de5 fl ash dong4 hua4
cues.en: From Flash animations spreading over dial-up networks

cues.zh: 到光纤和 5 G 传输的 4 K 直播
cues.pinyin: dao4 guang1 xian1 he2 5 G chuan2 shu1 de5 4 K zhi2 bo1
cues.en: to 4K livestreams over fiber optics and 5G.

cues.zh: 比特的洪流冲刷过每块屏幕
cues.pinyin: bi3 te4 de5 hong2 liu2 chong1 shua1 guo4 mei3 kuai4 ping2 mu4
cues.en: A flood of bits washes over every screen.

cues.zh: 直接进去
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 jin4 qu4
cues.en: Just go right in.

cues.zh: 闪烁的像素构建出大千世界
cues.pinyin: shan3 shuo4 de5 xiang4 su4 gou4 jian4 chu1 da4 qian1 shi4 jie4
cues.en: Flickering pixels build an entire universe.

cues.pinyin: 20 nian2
cues.en: 20 years.

cues.zh: 时代的打开方式已被彻底改变
cues.pinyin: shi2 dai4 de5 da3 kai1 fang1 shi4 yi3 bei4 che4 di3 gai3 bian4
cues.en: The way we access this era has completely changed.

cues.zh: 可以利用互联网实现价值公平
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 li4 yong4 hu4 lian2 wang3 shi2 xian4 jia4 zhi2 gong1 ping2
cues.en: The internet can be used to achieve fairness in value.

cues.zh: 观众太压抑了
cues.pinyin: guan1 zhong4 tai4 ya1 yi4 le5
cues.en: The audience was too repressed.

cues.zh: 充当他们的嘴替
cues.pinyin: chong1 dang1 ta1 men5 de5 zui3 ti4
cues.en: Acting as their mouthpiece.

cues.zh: 网络就把不认识的人变成亲人的那种
cues.pinyin: wang3 luo4 jiu4 ba3 bu4 ren4 shi2 de5 ren2 bian4 cheng2 qin1 ren2 de5 na4 zhong3
cues.en: The internet turns strangers into something like family.

cues.zh: 曾经电视机前的观众
cues.pinyin: ceng2 jing1 dian4 shi4 ji1 qian2 de5 guan1 zhong4
cues.en: The audience that once sat in front of the TV

cues.zh: 成为了自己生活的导演
cues.pinyin: cheng2 wei2 le5 zi4 ji3 sheng1 huo2 de5 dao3 yan3
cues.en: became the director of their own lives.

cues.zh: 数亿块屏幕上
cues.pinyin: shu4 yi4 kuai4 ping2 mu4 shang4
cues.en: Across hundreds of millions of screens,

cues.zh: 跃动着数亿个灵魂
cues.pinyin: yue4 dong4 zhao1 shu4 yi4 ge4 ling2 hun2
cues.en: hundreds of millions of souls flicker to life.

cues.zh: 每个人都可以闪耀五秒
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 ke3 yi3 shan3 yao4 wu3 miao3
cues.en: Everyone can shine for five seconds —

cues.zh: 也可能只有五秒
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 zhi3 you3 wu3 miao3
cues.en: or maybe only five seconds.

cues.zh: 感觉前面这路有点乱
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 qian2 mian4 zhe4 lu4 you3 dian3 luan4
cues.en: The road ahead feels a bit chaotic.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 大概这个访谈多少时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhe4 ge5 fang3 tan2 duo1 shao3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: About how long will this interview be?

cues.zh: 两到三个小时
cues.pinyin: liang3 dao4 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: Two to three hours.

cues.zh: 这么长时间
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 zhang3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: That long?

cues.zh: OK 吗
cues.pinyin: OK ma5
cues.en: Is that okay?

cues.zh: 作为一名北京中学物理老师的我
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 yi1 ming2 bei3 jing1 zhong1 xue2 wu4 li3 lao3 shi1 de5 wo3
cues.en: As a physics teacher at a Beijing middle school,

cues.zh: 带出过上千名毕业生
cues.pinyin: dai4 chu1 guo4 shang4 qian1 ming2 bi4 ye4 sheng1
cues.en: I've taught over a thousand graduates.

cues.zh: 而作为在互联网上拥有两千万粉丝的我
cues.pinyin: er2 zuo4 wei2 zai4 hu4 lian2 wang3 shang4 yong1 you3 liang3 qian1 wan4 fen3 si1 de5 wo3
cues.en: And as someone with 20 million followers online,

cues.zh: 用知识影响着上千万人
cues.pinyin: yong4 zhi1 shi2 ying3 xiang3 zhe5 shang4 qian1 wan4 ren2
cues.en: I influence tens of millions of people with knowledge.

cues.zh: 知识应该公平地抵达每一个渴望他的人
cues.pinyin: zhi1 shi2 ying1 gai1 gong1 ping2 di4 di3 da2 mei3 yi2 ge4 ke3 wang4 ta1 de5 ren2
cues.en: Knowledge should fairly reach everyone who desires it.

cues.zh: 在刚刚那个视频里提到
cues.pinyin: zai4 gang1 gang1 na4 ge5 shi4 pin2 li3 ti2 dao4
cues.en: In the video just now, it was mentioned that

cues.zh: 知识应该公平地抵达每一个渴望他的人
cues.pinyin: zhi1 shi2 ying1 gai1 gong1 ping2 di4 di3 da2 mei3 yi2 ge4 ke3 wang4 ta1 de5 ren2
cues.en: knowledge should fairly reach everyone who desires it.

cues.zh: 那你是为什么会有这种想法
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 you3 zhe4 zhong3 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: So why do you think that way?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 我记得我有一次去四川梁山
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji4 de5 wo3 you3 yi1 ci4 qu4 si4 chuan1 liang2 shan1
cues.en: I remember once going to Liangshan, Sichuan.

cues.zh: 中央电视台呢
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yang1 dian4 shi4 tai2 ne5
cues.en: CCTV

cues.zh: 请我去给梁山的学生和老师们
cues.pinyin: qing3 wo3 qu4 gei3 liang2 shan1 de5 xue2 sheng1 he2 lao3 shi1 men5
cues.en: invited me to give the students and teachers in Liangshan

cues.zh: 做一些讲座
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi1 xie1 jiang3 zuo4
cues.en: some lectures.

cues.zh: 我今天非常的开心啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 tian1 fei1 chang2 de5 kai1 xin1 a5
cues.en: I'm very happy today.

cues.zh: 来到了我们梁山州喜德县的瓦尔学校
cues.pinyin: lai2 dao4 le5 wo3 men5 liang2 shan1 zhou1 xi3 de2 xian4 de5 wa3 er3 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: to come to Wa'er School in Xide County, Liangshan Prefecture,

cues.zh: 见到了这么多可爱的遗族孩子
cues.pinyin: jian4 dao4 le5 zhe4 me5 duo1 ke3 ai4 de5 yi2 zu2 hai2 zi5
cues.en: and meet so many adorable Yi children.

cues.zh: 那么我们今天呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 ne5
cues.en: So today,

cues.zh: 就想来谈一谈古希腊的这些哲人们
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang3 lai2 tan2 yi1 tan2 gu3 xi1 la4 de5 zhe4 xie1 zhe2 ren2 men5
cues.en: I'd like to talk about these ancient Greek philosophers.

cues.zh: 大家看这三个人大家都认识吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 zhe4 san1 ge4 ren2 da4 jia1 dou1 ren4 shi2 ma5
cues.en: Does everyone recognize these three people?

cues.zh: 雕像不认识
cues.pinyin: diao1 xiang4 bu4 ren4 shi2
cues.en: I don't recognize the statues.

cues.zh: 但是如果告诉你
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 gao4 su4 ni3
cues.en: But if I told you

cues.zh: 叫古希腊三贤的话
cues.pinyin: jiao4 gu3 xi1 la4 san1 xian2 de5 hua4
cues.en: they're called the 'Three Sages of Ancient Greece,'

cues.zh: 你知道他们是谁吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 ta1 men5 shi4 shui2 ma5
cues.en: would you know who they are?

cues.zh: 也不知道
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Still don't know.

cues.zh: 那好
cues.pinyin: na4 hao3
cues.en: Alright then.

cues.zh: 我告诉你啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 gao4 su4 ni3 a5
cues.en: I'll tell you.

cues.zh: 古希腊三贤的第一位
cues.pinyin: gu3 xi1 la4 san1 xian2 de5 di4 yi1 wei4
cues.en: The first of the Three Sages of Ancient Greece

cues.zh: 那就是左边这个
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 zuo3 bian1 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: is the one on the left.

cues.zh: 他的名字叫什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 ming2 zi4 jiao4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What's his name?

cues.zh: 叫苏格拉底
cues.pinyin: jiao4 su1 ge2 la1 di3
cues.en: Socrates.

cues.zh: 我看到一个小孩
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: I saw a kid.

cues.zh: 这个小孩个子特别小
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 hai2 ge4 zi5 te4 bie2 xiao3
cues.en: This kid was really small.

cues.zh: 我看的样子
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: From how he looked,

cues.zh: 也就是一二年级
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 yi1 er4 nian2 ji2
cues.en: he seemed like a first or second grader.

cues.zh: 然后我就问他说
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 wen4 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: So I asked him,

cues.zh: 你几年级了
cues.pinyin: ni3 ji3 nian2 ji2 le5
cues.en: What grade are you in?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 他说我五年级
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 wu3 nian2 ji2
cues.en: He said, 'I'm in fifth grade.'

cues.zh: 然后我就说
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: So I said,

cues.zh: 那五年级
cues.pinyin: na4 wu3 nian2 ji2
cues.en: If you're in fifth grade,

cues.zh: 为什么个子这么小
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ge4 zi5 zhe4 me5 xiao3
cues.en: why are you so short?

cues.zh: 你是不是不好好吃饭
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 bu2 shi4 bu4 hao3 hao3 chi1 fan4
cues.en: Don't you eat properly?

cues.zh: 然后他就说了一句话
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 shuo1 le5 yi1 ju4 hua4
cues.en: Then he said something.

cues.zh: 他说这不取决于我
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 bu4 qu3 jue2 yu2 wo3
cues.en: He said, 'That's not up to me.'

cues.zh: 然后我当时就觉得
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 dang1 shi2 jiu4 jue2 de5
cues.en: And right then I thought,

cues.zh: 这个孩子怎么说话这么深刻呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 zen3 me5 shuo1 hua4 zhe4 me5 shen1 ke4 ne5
cues.en: how does this kid speak so profoundly?

cues.zh: 当时我就说
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 wo3 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: At the time I said,

cues.zh: 我跟我老婆说
cues.pinyin: wo3 gen1 wo3 lao3 po2 shuo1
cues.en: I told my wife,

cues.zh: 我说我应该为穷人的教育做点什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 ying1 gai1 wei4 qiong2 ren2 de5 jiao4 yu4 zuo4 dian3 shen2 me5
cues.en: I said I should do something for the education of the poor.

cues.zh: 然后当时我老婆还说
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 dang1 shi2 wo3 lao3 po2 hai2 shuo1
cues.en: And then my wife said,

cues.zh: 你还为穷人的教育做点什么
cues.pinyin: ni3 hai2 wei4 qiong2 ren2 de5 jiao4 yu4 zuo4 dian3 shen2 me5
cues.en: 'You want to do something for the education of the poor?'

cues.zh: 你自己就是穷人
cues.pinyin: ni3 zi4 ji3 jiu4 shi4 qiong2 ren2
cues.en: You're poor yourself.

cues.zh: 我是希望能够用互联网平台
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 xi1 wang4 neng2 gou4 yong4 hu4 lian2 wang3 ping2 tai2
cues.en: I hope to use internet platforms

cues.zh: 把教育公平这件事
cues.pinyin: ba3 jiao4 yu4 gong1 ping2 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: to keep pushing forward

cues.zh: 能够继续坚持下去
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 ji4 xu4 jian1 chi2 xia4 qu4
cues.en: the cause of educational fairness.

cues.zh: 所以有一次我记得我在演讲当中说
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you3 yi1 ci4 wo3 ji4 de5 wo3 zai4 yan3 jiang3 dang1 zhong1 shuo1
cues.en: So I remember once in a speech I said,

cues.zh: 做一个网红和做一个优秀教师
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ge4 wang3 hong2 he2 zuo4 yi2 ge4 you1 xiu4 jiao4 shi1
cues.en: being an internet celebrity and being an excellent teacher

cues.zh: 并不矛盾
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 mao2 dun4
cues.en: aren't contradictory.

cues.zh: 互联网和课堂也不矛盾
cues.pinyin: hu4 lian2 wang3 he2 ke4 tang2 ye3 bu4 mao2 dun4
cues.en: The internet and the classroom aren't contradictory either.

cues.zh: 因为在我小的时候
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Because when I was young,

cues.zh: 虽然家里面有贫富的差距
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 jia1 li3 mian4 you3 pin2 fu4 de5 cha1 ju4
cues.en: although there was a gap between rich and poor families,

cues.zh: 但是基本上来讲
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ji1 ben3 shang4 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: but basically speaking,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】做网红，不是我的人生主线

cues.zh: 我们那时候上清华的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 na4 shi2 hou4 shang4 qing1 hua2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: back when we were at Tsinghua,

cues.zh: 就知道有一个叫校内网的网站
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhi1 dao4 you3 yi2 ge4 jiao4 xiao4 nei4 wang3 de5 wang3 zhan4
cues.en: we knew of a website called Xiaonei (Renren).

cues.zh: 这个校内网就是最开始是王兴办的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao4 nei4 wang3 jiu4 shi4 zui4 kai1 shi3 shi4 wang2 xing1 ban4 de5
cues.en: Xiaonei was originally started by Wang Xing.

cues.zh: 然后还在厕所里面贴广告
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hai2 zai4 ce4 suo3 li3 mian4 tie1 guang3 gao4
cues.en: He even put up ads in the bathrooms.

cues.zh: 大家都去上
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 dou1 qu4 shang4
cues.en: Everyone went on it.

cues.zh: 很多人找对象都是在校内网上找到
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 zhao3 dui4 xiang4 dou1 shi4 zai4 xiao4 nei4 wang3 shang4 zhao3 dao4
cues.en: Many people found their partners on Xiaonei.

cues.zh: 然后后来王兴又把这个算论网卖了之后
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hou4 lai2 wang2 xing1 you4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 suan4 lun4 wang3 mai4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Then later, after Wang Xing sold Xiaonei,

cues.zh: 又去搞了一个什么什么什么贩佛啊
cues.pinyin: you4 qu4 gao3 le5 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 shen2 me5 shen2 me5 fan4 fu2 a5
cues.en: he went and started something called Fanfou,

cues.zh: 什么什么美团啊什么的
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shen2 me5 mei3 tuan2 a5 shen2 me5 de5
cues.en: and things like Meituan.

cues.zh: 但是我挺佩服这些国内的创业者的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 ting3 pei4 fu2 zhe4 xie1 guo2 nei4 de5 chuang4 ye4 zhe3 de5
cues.en: But I really admire these domestic entrepreneurs.

cues.zh: 因为我觉得我就不具备这个能力
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 jiu4 bu4 ju4 bei4 zhe4 ge5 neng2 li4
cues.en: Because I feel I just don't have that ability.

cues.zh: 你要是让我编个程序或者解决一个问题
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 shi4 rang4 wo3 bian1 ge4 cheng2 xu4 huo4 zhe3 jie3 jue2 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: If you asked me to write code or solve a problem,

cues.zh: 我觉得我还是可以的
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 hai2 shi4 ke3 yi3 de5
cues.en: I think I could manage.

cues.zh: 但是让我管理好这么多人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 rang4 wo3 guan3 li3 hao3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2
cues.en: But to manage so many people well,

cues.zh: 我觉得我就做不到
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 jiu4 zuo4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: I don't think I could do that.

cues.zh: 但是像这些创业者
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiang4 zhe4 xie1 chuang4 ye4 zhe3
cues.en: But entrepreneurs like these —

cues.zh: 什么张一鸣啊
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 zhang1 yi1 ming2 a5
cues.en: people like Zhang Yiming,

cues.zh: 王兴啊
cues.pinyin: wang2 xing1 a5
cues.en: Wang Xing,

cues.zh: 什么雷军呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 lei2 jun1 ne5
cues.en: Lei Jun,

cues.zh: 他们自己不光可以编程序
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zi4 ji3 bu4 guang1 ke3 yi3 bian1 cheng2 xu4
cues.en: they can not only write code themselves

cues.zh: 居然还可以管理好这么多人
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 hai2 ke3 yi3 guan3 li3 hao3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2
cues.en: but somehow also manage so many people well.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 你能想象吗一个连阎王爷见了都得躲着
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 xiang3 xiang4 ma5 yi2 ge4 lian2 yan2 wang2 ye2 jian4 le5 dou1 de2 duo3 zhe5
cues.en: Can you imagine — a top hitman so feared

cues.zh: 走的顶级杀手
cues.pinyin: zou3 de5 ding3 ji2 sha1 shou3
cues.en: that even the God of Death would avoid him

cues.zh: 就因为老婆一句话
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yin1 wei4 lao3 po2 yi1 ju4 hua4
cues.en: just because of one thing his wife said

cues.zh: 居然乖乖去给一个 17 岁的小姑
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 guai1 guai1 qu4 gei3 yi2 ge4 17 sui4 de5 xiao3 gu1
cues.en: he obediently agreed to be a bodyguard for a 17-year-old girl

cues.zh: 娘当起了保镖
cues.pinyin: niang2 dang1 qi3 le5 bao3 biao1
cues.en: and took on the job of protecting her

cues.zh: 他谁也没想到这场看起来挺简单的活儿
cues.pinyin: ta1 shui2 ye3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 zhe4 chang3 kan4 qi3 lai2 ting3 jian3 dan1 de5 huo2 er5
cues.en: He never expected that this seemingly simple job

cues.zh: 竟然牵扯出了一桩非法交易的黑幕
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 qian1 che3 chu1 le5 yi1 zhuang1 fei1 fa3 jiao1 yi4 de5 hei1 mu4
cues.en: would actually expose a dark illegal trafficking scheme

cues.zh: 把他又重新拉回了那种刀光剑影的江湖里
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 you4 chong2 xin1 la1 hui2 le5 na4 zhong3 dao1 guang1 jian4 ying3 de5 jiang1 hu2 li3
cues.en: dragging him right back into that world of blades and bloodshed

cues.zh: 今天要说的就是这部韩国犯罪
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 shuo1 de5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 bu4 han2 guo2 fan4 zui4
cues.en: Today we're talking about this Korean crime

cues.zh: 爽片悲传杀手
cues.pinyin: shuang3 pian4 bei1 chuan2 sha1 shou3
cues.en: action thriller, a hitman's tale

cues.zh: 深夜的大酒店里
cues.pinyin: shen1 ye4 de5 da4 jiu3 dian4 li3
cues.en: Late at night in a large hotel

cues.zh: 杀手阿江轻巧地躲过了迎面飞来的斧头
cues.pinyin: sha1 shou3 a1 jiang1 qing1 qiao3 di4 duo3 guo4 le5 ying2 mian4 fei1 lai2 de5 fu3 tou2
cues.en: hitman A Jiang nimbly dodges an axe flying straight at him

cues.zh: 紧接着就和一群大伴的花里胡哨的
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 jiu4 he2 yi1 qun2 da4 ban4 de5 hua1 li3 hu2 shao4 de5
cues.en: and immediately starts fighting a flashily dressed group

cues.zh: 混混干了起来
cues.pinyin: hun4 hun4 gan4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: of thugs

cues.zh: 对面的混混不仅没伤着阿江
cues.pinyin: dui4 mian4 de5 hun4 hun4 bu4 jin3 mei2 shang1 zhe5 a1 jiang1
cues.en: The thugs not only fail to land a hit on A Jiang

cues.zh: 反倒被阿江一斧头给解决了
cues.pinyin: fan3 dao4 bei4 a1 jiang1 yi1 fu3 tou2 gei3 jie3 jue2 le5
cues.en: but instead get taken out by his own axe

cues.zh: 剩下的混混想跑
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 hun4 hun4 xiang3 pao3
cues.en: The remaining thug tries to run

cues.zh: 却被阿江一脚踩住
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 a1 jiang1 yi1 jiao3 cai3 zhu4
cues.en: but A Jiang pins him down with one foot

cues.zh: 动弹不得
cues.pinyin: dong4 tan2 bu4 de2
cues.en: unable to move

cues.zh: 这时电梯到了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 dian4 ti1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Just then the elevator arrives

cues.zh: 里面的混混看着满地狼藉
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 de5 hun4 hun4 kan4 zhe5 man3 di4 lang2 ji2
cues.en: The thugs inside see the wreckage everywhere

cues.zh: 全都吓得缩成一团
cues.pinyin: quan2 dou1 xia4 de2 suo1 cheng2 yi1 tuan2
cues.en: and all cower in fear

cues.zh: 大气都不敢出
cues.pinyin: da4 qi4 dou1 bu4 gan3 chu1
cues.en: not daring to even breathe loudly

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 就在这时候阿江的电话响了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 hou4 a1 jiang1 de5 dian4 hua4 xiang3 le5
cues.en: Right then, A Jiang's phone rings

cues.zh: 是老婆发来的短信
cues.pinyin: shi4 lao3 po2 fa1 lai2 de5 duan3 xin4
cues.en: It's a text from his wife

cues.zh: 问他照看的孩子有没有事
cues.pinyin: wen4 ta1 zhao4 kan4 de5 hai2 zi5 you3 mei2 you3 shi4
cues.en: asking if the kid he's watching is okay

cues.zh: 看到短信
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 duan3 xin4
cues.en: Seeing the message

cues.zh: 阿江脸上满是无奈
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 lian3 shang4 man3 shi4 wu2 nai4
cues.en: A Jiang's face fills with exasperation

cues.zh: 原来不久前
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 bu4 jiu3 qian2
cues.en: It turns out that not long ago

cues.zh: 阿江的老婆和他的好友白夫人去旅行
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 de5 lao3 po2 he2 ta1 de5 hao3 you3 bai2 fu1 ren2 qu4 lv3 xing2
cues.en: A Jiang's wife went traveling with her friend, Mrs. Bai

cues.zh: 临走前特意叮嘱阿江
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 qian2 te4 yi4 ding1 zhu3 a1 jiang1
cues.en: Before leaving, she specifically told A Jiang

cues.zh: 让他照看好白夫人 17 岁的女儿
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zhao4 kan4 hao3 bai2 fu1 ren2 17 sui4 de5 nv3 er2
cues.en: to take good care of Mrs. Bai's 17-year-old daughter

cues.zh: 那小姑娘还在上高中
cues.pinyin: na4 xiao3 gu1 niang2 hai2 zai4 shang4 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: The girl is still in high school

cues.zh: 虽然阿江不喜欢看孩子
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 a1 jiang1 bu4 xi3 huan1 kan4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Although A Jiang hates babysitting

cues.zh: 可他是出了名的怕老婆
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 shi4 chu1 le5 ming2 de5 pa4 lao3 po2
cues.en: he's famously terrified of his wife

cues.zh: 把老婆送到机场后
cues.pinyin: ba3 lao3 po2 song4 dao4 ji1 chang3 hou4
cues.en: After dropping his wife off at the airport

cues.zh: 就去女孩辅导班楼下等着了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu4 nv3 hai2 fu3 dao3 ban1 lou2 xia4 deng3 zhe5 le5
cues.en: he went to wait outside the girl's cram school

cues.zh: 阿江在车里打盹
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zai4 che1 li3 da3 dun3
cues.en: A Jiang dozes off in the car

cues.zh: 突然有人敲车窗
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 ren2 qiao1 che1 chuang1
cues.en: Suddenly someone knocks on the window

cues.zh: 阿江一看是个漂亮的女孩
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 yi1 kan4 shi4 ge4 piao4 liang4 de5 nv3 hai2
cues.en: He looks up to see a pretty girl

cues.zh: 见女孩喊出了他的名字
cues.pinyin: jian4 nv3 hai2 han3 chu1 le5 ta1 de5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: She calls out his name

cues.zh: 还说出了街头暗号
cues.pinyin: hai2 shuo1 chu1 le5 jie1 tou2 an4 hao4
cues.en: and even gives the street code phrase

cues.zh: 阿江摆了摆手让她上车
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 bai3 le5 bai3 shou3 rang4 ta1 shang4 che1
cues.en: A Jiang waves her into the car

cues.zh: 女孩自报家门说叫小芝
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 zi4 bao4 jia1 men2 shuo1 jiao4 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: The girl introduces herself as Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 阿江没耐心听她多说
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 mei2 nai4 xin1 ting1 ta1 duo1 shuo1
cues.en: A Jiang has no patience to hear more

cues.zh: 正想打断
cues.pinyin: zheng4 xiang3 da3 duan4
cues.en: and is about to cut her off

cues.zh: 却发现小芝还带了个闺蜜上车
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 xiao3 zhi1 hai2 dai4 le5 ge4 gui1 mi4 shang4 che1
cues.en: when he notices Xiaozhi brought a friend along too

cues.zh: 没办法阿江只能先送她闺蜜回家
cues.pinyin: mei2 ban4 fa3 a1 jiang1 zhi3 neng2 xian1 song4 ta1 gui1 mi4 hui2 jia1
cues.en: With no choice, A Jiang drives the friend home first

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 有事打电话
cues.pinyin: you3 shi4 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: telling them to call if anything comes up

cues.zh: 刚想立让眼接着睡
cues.pinyin: gang1 xiang3 li4 rang4 yan3 jie1 zhe5 shui4
cues.en: He's about to go right back to sleep

cues.zh: 又想起老婆临走时的叮嘱
cues.pinyin: you4 xiang3 qi3 lao3 po2 lin2 zou3 shi2 de5 ding1 zhu3
cues.en: when he remembers his wife's instructions

cues.zh: 他穿好衣服
cues.pinyin: ta1 chuan1 hao3 yi1 fu2
cues.en: He gets dressed

cues.zh: 开车到了小芝说的地方
cues.pinyin: kai1 che1 dao4 le5 xiao3 zhi1 shuo1 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: and drives to the place Xiaozhi mentioned

cues.zh: 发现是间餐厅
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 shi4 jian1 can1 ting1
cues.en: only to find it's a restaurant

cues.zh: 而腰壳肚子疼的小芝
cues.pinyin: er2 yao1 ke2 du3 zi5 teng2 de5 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: and Xiaozhi, who'd claimed to have a stomachache

cues.zh: 竟然在和一个男生约会
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 zai4 he2 yi2 ge4 nan2 sheng1 yue1 hui4
cues.en: is actually on a date with a boy

cues.zh: 见状阿姜的火气不打一出来
cues.pinyin: jian4 zhuang4 a1 jiang1 de5 huo3 qi4 bu4 da3 yi1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Seeing this, A Jiang's temper flares instantly

cues.zh: 更过分的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 guo4 fen4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more outrageous

cues.zh: 小芝还让他将送男生回家
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 hai2 rang4 ta1 jiang1 song4 nan2 sheng1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Xiaozhi asks him to drive the boy home too

cues.zh: 还好男孩察觉到了阿姜身上的怨气
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 nan2 hai2 cha2 jue2 dao4 le5 a1 jiang1 shen1 shang4 de5 yuan4 qi4
cues.en: Luckily the boy senses A Jiang's hostility

cues.zh: 忙说自己大车走
cues.pinyin: mang2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 da4 che1 zou3
cues.en: and quickly says he'll just grab a taxi

cues.zh: 阿江问小芝怎么回事
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 wen4 xiao3 zhi1 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: then slinks away

cues.zh: 阿姜问小芝怎么回事
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 wen4 xiao3 zhi1 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: A Jiang asks Xiaozhi what's going on

cues.zh: 小芝不说话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 bu4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: Xiaozhi says nothing

cues.zh: 低着头自不玩着手机
cues.pinyin: di1 zhe5 tou2 zi4 bu4 wan2 zhuo2 shou3 ji1
cues.en: just keeps her head down, playing on her phone

cues.zh: 随后对阿姜说用不到他的
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 dui4 a1 jiang1 shuo1 yong4 bu2 dao4 ta1 de5
cues.en: then tells A Jiang she doesn't need him

cues.zh: 阿姜都气笑了
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 dou1 qi4 xiao4 le5
cues.en: A Jiang almost laughs out of anger

cues.zh: 大半夜叫他过来
cues.pinyin: da4 ban4 ye4 jiao4 ta1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Calling him over in the middle of the night

cues.zh: 转头又赶人
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 tou2 you4 gan3 ren2
cues.en: then immediately trying to get rid of him

cues.zh: 顶级杀手就不要面子吗
cues.pinyin: ding3 ji2 sha1 shou3 jiu4 bu2 yao4 mian4 zi5 ma5
cues.en: Does a top hitman have no pride at all?

cues.zh: 再三确认小芝不需要帮助后
cues.pinyin: zai4 san1 que4 ren4 xiao3 zhi1 bu4 xu1 yao4 bang1 zhu4 hou4
cues.en: After repeatedly confirming Xiaozhi doesn't need help

cues.zh: 他牛头就走
cues.pinyin: ta1 niu2 tou2 jiu4 zou3
cues.en: he turns and leaves

cues.zh: 从后视镜里看到小芝上了一辆摩托车
cues.pinyin: cong2 hou4 shi4 jing4 li3 kan4 dao4 xiao3 zhi1 shang4 le5 yi1 liang4 mo2 tuo1 che1
cues.en: In the rearview mirror he sees Xiaozhi get on a motorcycle

cues.zh: 跟着一群看着不三不色的人走了
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhe5 yi1 qun2 kan4 zhe5 bu4 san1 bu4 se4 de5 ren2 zou3 le5
cues.en: and ride off with a shady-looking group

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 第二天一早
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 yi1 zao3
cues.en: Early the next morning

cues.zh: 阿江便被小智缠着聊天
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 bian4 bei4 xiao3 zhi4 chan2 zhe5 liao2 tian1
cues.en: Xiaozhi keeps pestering A Jiang to chat

cues.zh: 无奈之下出去玩了一天
cues.pinyin: wu2 nai4 zhi1 xia4 chu1 qu4 wan2 le5 yi1 tian1
cues.en: Left with no choice, he spends the whole day out with her

cues.zh: 晚上回家途中
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 hui2 jia1 tu2 zhong1
cues.en: On the way home that evening

cues.zh: 经过花冰场才知道出了人命
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 hua1 bing1 chang3 cai2 zhi1 dao4 chu1 le5 ren2 ming4
cues.en: passing by a skating rink, he learns someone has died

cues.zh: 面对刑警老李的询问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 xing2 jing3 lao3 li3 de5 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Facing questioning from detective Old Li

cues.zh: 小芝神色略显慌张
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhi1 shen2 se4 lve4 xian3 huang1 zhang1
cues.en: Xiaozhi looks noticeably nervous

cues.zh: 然而第二天早晨
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 di4 er4 tian1 zao3 chen2
cues.en: But the next morning

cues.zh: 老李便来到阿姜家中
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 bian4 lai2 dao4 a1 jiang1 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: Old Li shows up at A Jiang's home

cues.zh: 便拿出手机播放了一段视频
cues.pinyin: bian4 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 bo1 fang4 le5 yi1 duan4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: and pulls out his phone to play a video

cues.zh: 老李质疑命案与阿姜有关
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 zhi4 yi2 ming4 an4 yu3 a1 jiang1 you3 guan1
cues.en: Old Li suspects A Jiang is connected to the murder

cues.zh: 而一番交谈下来
cues.pinyin: er2 yi1 fan1 jiao1 tan2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: But after questioning him

cues.zh: 并没有得到任何线索
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 de2 dao4 ren4 he2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: he gets no useful leads at all

cues.zh: 还被阿姜奚落一顿
cues.pinyin: hai2 bei4 a1 jiang1 xi1 luo4 yi1 dun4
cues.en: and even gets mocked by A Jiang

cues.zh: 只得兴兴离开
cues.pinyin: zhi3 de2 xing1 xing1 li2 kai1
cues.en: leaving in frustration

cues.zh: 庞间内
cues.pinyin: pang2 jian1 nei4
cues.en: Back in the room

cues.zh: 阿姜正想安抚一下受伤的小芝
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zheng4 xiang3 an1 fu3 yi1 xia4 shou4 shang1 de5 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: A Jiang is about to comfort the hurt Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 一通电话的到来
cues.pinyin: yi2 tong4 dian4 hua4 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: when a phone call comes in

cues.zh: 将整个事件推向了高潮
cues.pinyin: jiang1 zheng3 ge4 shi4 jian4 tui1 xiang4 le5 gao1 chao2
cues.en: pushing the whole situation to a climax

cues.zh: 电话那头是之前的小太妹
cues.pinyin: dian4 hua4 na4 tou2 shi4 zhi1 qian2 de5 xiao3 tai4 mei4
cues.en: On the line is the delinquent girl from before

cues.zh: 原来她在阿姜走后
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 zai4 a1 jiang1 zou3 hou4
cues.en: It turns out that after A Jiang left

cues.zh: 用带有阿姜指纹的匕首
cues.pinyin: yong4 dai4 you3 a1 jiang1 zhi3 wen2 de5 bi3 shou3
cues.en: she used a dagger with A Jiang's fingerprints on it

cues.zh: 将几个男生杀害
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ji3 ge4 nan2 sheng1 sha1 hai4
cues.en: to kill several boys

cues.zh: 此刻他正用这事威胁阿将取他指定的地址
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 ta1 zheng4 yong4 zhe4 shi4 wei1 xie2 a1 jiang1 qu3 ta1 zhi3 ding4 de5 di4 zhi3
cues.en: and now she's using it to blackmail A Jiang into coming to a place she names

cues.zh: 临走前弟弟小致一个定位手环
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 qian2 di4 di5 xiao3 zhi4 yi2 ge4 ding4 wei4 shou3 huan2
cues.en: Before leaving she'd given Xiaozhi a tracking bracelet

cues.zh: 随后来到指定地边
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 lai2 dao4 zhi3 ding4 di4 bian1
cues.en: A Jiang then heads to the designated location

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 眼见阿将手段如此残忍
cues.pinyin: yan3 jian4 a1 jiang1 shou3 duan4 ru2 ci3 can2 ren3
cues.en: Seeing how ruthless A Jiang is

cues.zh: 吓破胆的大哥急忙将匕首扔下阿将
cues.pinyin: xia4 po4 dan3 de5 da4 ge1 ji2 mang2 jiang1 bi3 shou3 reng1 xia4 a1 jiang1
cues.en: the terrified gang leader hastily drops the dagger in front of him

cues.zh: 随后却又掏枪指向阿将
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 que4 you4 tao1 qiang1 zhi3 xiang4 a1 jiang1
cues.en: then pulls out a gun and points it at A Jiang instead

cues.zh: 只是觉得真理在熟
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 jue2 de5 zhen1 li3 zai4 shu2
cues.en: clearly thinking he has the upper hand

cues.zh: 天下窝友的男人低估了阿江的实力
cues.pinyin: tian1 xia4 wo1 you3 de5 nan2 ren2 di1 gu1 le5 a1 jiang1 de5 shi2 li4
cues.en: little does he know he's underestimated A Jiang's skill

cues.zh: 只能在慌乱中从后门逃跑了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 zai4 huang1 luan4 zhong1 cong2 hou4 men2 tao2 pao3 le5
cues.en: and ends up fleeing out the back door in a panic

cues.zh: 阿江追着男人走进一条长廊
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhui1 zhe5 nan2 ren2 zou3 jin4 yi1 tiao2 chang2 lang2
cues.en: A Jiang chases him into a corridor

cues.zh: 停着职业的警觉性
cues.pinyin: ting2 zhe5 zhi2 ye4 de5 jing3 jue2 xing4
cues.en: Relying on his professional instincts

cues.zh: 随即与这个突然出现的黄毛
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 yu3 zhe4 ge5 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 de5 huang2 mao2
cues.en: he dodges several steel nails fired from the shadows

cues.zh: 随即与这个突然出现的荒毛
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 yu3 zhe4 ge5 tu1 ran2 chu1 xian4 de5 huang1 mao2
cues.en: then immediately clashes with this suddenly appearing yellow-haired thug

cues.zh: 交起手来
cues.pinyin: jiao1 qi3 shou3 lai2
cues.en: trading blows

cues.zh: 阿江找了个机会推出战斗折回家中
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhao3 le5 ge4 ji1 hui4 tui1 chu1 zhan4 dou4 zhe2 hui2 jia1 zhong1
cues.en: A Jiang finds a chance to break off the fight and head back home

cues.zh: 望着家中凌乱的脚印与血迹
cues.pinyin: wang4 zhe5 jia1 zhong1 ling2 luan4 de5 jiao3 yin4 yu3 xue4 ji4
cues.en: Looking at the messy footprints and bloodstains in the house

cues.zh: 猜测小只应该被人趁机绑架了
cues.pinyin: cai1 ce4 xiao3 zhi3 ying1 gai1 bei4 ren2 chen4 ji1 bang3 jia4 le5
cues.en: he guesses Xiaozhi must have been kidnapped in the chaos

cues.zh: 追着手环的位置
cues.pinyin: zhui1 zhuo2 shou3 huan2 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: Tracking the bracelet's location

cues.zh: 阿江来到一片破旧的居民楼下
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 lai2 dao4 yi1 pian4 po4 jiu4 de5 ju1 min2 lou2 xia4
cues.en: A Jiang arrives at a run-down residential building

cues.zh: 闯门进去发现被欺负的并不是小只
cues.pinyin: chuang3 men2 jin4 qu4 fa1 xian4 bei4 qi1 fu4 de5 bing4 bu2 shi4 xiao3 zhi3
cues.en: He breaks in and finds that the one being hurt isn't Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 而小太妹发现阿江的到来
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 tai4 mei4 fa1 xian4 a1 jiang1 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: but the friend she'd brought along earlier

cues.zh: 而小太妹发现阿姜的到来
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 tai4 mei4 fa1 xian4 a1 jiang1 de5 dao4 lai2
cues.en: When the delinquent girl notices A Jiang has arrived

cues.zh: 慌不择路的逃产中
cues.pinyin: huang1 bu4 ze2 lu4 de5 tao2 chan3 zhong1
cues.en: she flees in a blind panic

cues.zh: 随即嘲笑阿江中计了
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 chao2 xiao4 a1 jiang1 zhong4 ji4 le5
cues.en: but A Jiang pins her to the ground

cues.zh: 随即嘲笑阿姜中计了
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji2 chao2 xiao4 a1 jiang1 zhong4 ji4 le5
cues.en: She mocks him, saying he's fallen for her trap

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 真男人必看！豆瓣评分8.4，投资千万票房破百亿，韩国动作犯罪题材新标杆，票房口碑双丰收。

cues.zh: 得到地址的阿姜立即前往女孩口中的酒店
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 di4 zhi3 de5 a1 jiang1 li4 ji2 qian2 wang3 nv3 hai2 kou3 zhong1 de5 jiu3 dian4
cues.en: Having gotten the address, A Jiang heads straight to the hotel the girl mentioned

cues.zh: 刚转身
cues.pinyin: gang1 zhuan3 shen1
cues.en: The moment he turns around

cues.zh: 达到一楼的小怪兽
cues.pinyin: da2 dao4 yi1 lou2 de5 xiao3 guai4 shou4
cues.en: he takes down the thugs on the first floor

cues.zh: 阿江直接来到顶楼
cues.pinyin: a1 jiang1 zhi2 jie1 lai2 dao4 ding3 lou2
cues.en: then goes straight up to the top floor

cues.zh: 插手的极致就是一击之命
cues.pinyin: cha1 shou3 de5 ji2 zhi4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ji1 zhi1 ming4
cues.en: For a hitman, the ultimate skill is a one-hit kill

cues.zh: 每人一颗花生米
cues.pinyin: mei3 ren2 yi1 ke1 hua1 sheng1 mi3
cues.en: one bullet for each man

cues.zh: 不到一分钟便解决了所有人
cues.pinyin: bu2 dao4 yi4 fen1 zhong1 bian4 jie3 jue2 le5 suo3 you3 ren2
cues.en: taking out everyone in under a minute

cues.zh: 这时之前的黄毛慢悠悠走了出来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 zhi1 qian2 de5 huang2 mao2 man4 you1 you1 zou3 le5 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Just then, the yellow-haired thug from before strolls out

cues.zh: 话不投机半句多
cues.pinyin: hua4 bu4 tou2 ji1 ban4 ju4 duo1
cues.en: With nothing worth saying between them

cues.zh: 两人也没有惺惺相惜
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 ye3 mei2 you3 xing1 xing1 xiang1 xi1
cues.en: there's no mutual respect here

cues.zh: 直接战斗在一起
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 zhan4 dou4 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: they go straight into a fight

cues.zh: 然而阿江的首要目标
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 a1 jiang1 de5 shou3 yao4 mu4 biao1
cues.en: But A Jiang's main priority

cues.zh: 还是找到小芝
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 zhi1
cues.en: is still finding Xiaozhi

cues.zh: 将黄毛缠住后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 huang2 mao2 chan2 zhu4 hou4
cues.en: After tying up the yellow-haired thug

cues.zh: 直接破窗跳了下来
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 po4 chuang1 tiao4 le5 xia4 lai2
cues.en: he smashes through a window and jumps down

cues.zh: 结果被赶来的警察老李抓个正着
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 bei4 gan3 lai2 de5 jing3 cha2 lao3 li3 zhua1 ge4 zheng4 zhe5
cues.en: only to get caught red-handed by detective Old Li, who's just arrived

cues.zh: 将千里松人头的老李靠着后
cues.pinyin: jiang1 qian1 li3 song1 ren2 tou2 de5 lao3 li3 kao4 zhe5 hou4
cues.en: After explaining everything to Old Li

cues.zh: 二人来到码头
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 lai2 dao4 ma3 tou2
cues.en: the two of them head to the docks

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 这两天美国总统特朗普来到了北京
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 tian1 mei3 guo2 zong3 tong3 te4 lang3 pu3 lai2 dao4 le5 bei3 jing1
cues.en: These past two days, US President Trump came to Beijing.

cues.zh: 身边还带着整个地球上最挣钱的超豪
cues.pinyin: shen1 bian1 hai2 dai4 zhe5 zheng3 ge4 di4 qiu2 shang4 zui4 zheng4 qian2 de5 chao1 hao2
cues.en: bringing along the richest, most luxurious

cues.zh: 华企业家团队
cues.pinyin: hua2 qi3 ye4 jia1 tuan2 dui4
cues.en: team of entrepreneurs on the planet.

cues.zh: 比如说世界首富埃隆马斯克
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 shi4 jie4 shou3 fu4 ai1 long2 ma3 si1 ke4
cues.en: For example, the world's richest man, Elon Musk,

cues.zh: 目前身价是 8 400 亿美元
cues.pinyin: mu4 qian2 shen1 jia4 shi4 8 400 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: is currently worth $840 billion.

cues.zh: 英伟达的黄仁勋身价 15 00 亿美元
cues.pinyin: ying1 wei3 da2 de5 huang2 ren2 xun1 shen1 jia4 15 00 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is worth $150 billion.

cues.zh: 黑石集团的史蒂芬
cues.pinyin: hei1 shi2 ji2 tuan2 de5 shi3 di4 fen1
cues.en: Blackstone's Stephen

cues.zh: 施瓦茨曼身价是 400 亿美元
cues.pinyin: shi1 wa3 ci2 man4 shen1 jia4 shi4 400 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: Schwarzman is worth $40 billion.

cues.zh: 此外还有苹果的 CE O 库克
cues.pinyin: ci3 wai4 hai2 you3 ping2 guo3 de5 CE O ku4 ke4
cues.en: Besides, there's also Apple's CEO Cook,

cues.zh: 波音公司的 CE O 凯利
cues.pinyin: bo1 yin1 gong1 si1 de5 CE O kai3 li4
cues.en: Boeing's CEO Kelly,

cues.zh: 花旗集团的 CE O 减弗雷泽
cues.pinyin: hua1 qi2 ji2 tuan2 de5 CE O jian3 fu2 lei2 ze2
cues.en: Citigroup's CEO Jane Fraser,

cues.zh: 高盛集团的 CE O 戴维等等等等
cues.pinyin: gao1 sheng4 ji2 tuan2 de5 CE O dai4 wei2 deng3 deng3 deng3 deng3
cues.en: Goldman Sachs's CEO David [Solomon], and so on.

cues.zh: 这些人总身价超过了 1 万亿美元
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 ren2 zong3 shen1 jia4 chao1 guo4 le5 1 wan4 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: These people's combined net worth exceeds $1 trillion,

cues.zh: 而他们能够直接或者间接影响的财富
cues.pinyin: er2 ta1 men5 neng2 gou4 zhi2 jie1 huo4 zhe3 jian4 jie1 ying3 xiang3 de5 cai2 fu4
cues.en: and the wealth they can directly or indirectly influence

cues.zh: 更是超过了 100 万亿美元
cues.pinyin: geng4 shi4 chao1 guo4 le5 100 wan4 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: actually exceeds $100 trillion,

cues.zh: 至少占到全球可投资资产的三分之一
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 zhan4 dao4 quan2 qiu2 ke3 tou2 zi1 zi1 chan3 de5 san1 fen1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: accounting for at least a third of the world's investable assets.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就跟我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A kid once said to me,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 我这辈子怎么样才能赚到这么多钱呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 bei4 zi5 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 neng2 zhuan4 dao4 zhe4 me5 duo1 qian2 ne5
cues.en: 'How can I make this much money in my lifetime?'

cues.zh: 我想告诉大家的是
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 de5 shi4
cues.en: What I want to tell everyone is,

cues.zh: 这其实也没有那么难
cues.pinyin: zhe4 qi2 shi2 ye3 mei2 you3 na4 me5 nan2
cues.en: it's actually not that hard.

cues.zh: 你只要找到 33 只猴子就行
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 yao4 zhao3 dao4 33 zhi3 hou2 zi5 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: You just need to find 33 monkeys.

cues.zh: 今天我们就来讲一讲这个无限猴子的问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 zhe4 ge5 wu2 xian4 hou2 zi5 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's talk about this infinite monkey problem.

cues.zh: 什么叫无限猴子呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 wu2 xian4 hou2 zi5 ne5
cues.en: What is the 'infinite monkey'?

cues.zh: 这个事儿其实是在 19 13 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 er2 qi2 shi2 shi4 zai4 19 13 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: This actually happened back in 1913.

cues.zh: 有一个法国的学者
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 fa3 guo2 de5 xue2 zhe3
cues.en: There was a French scholar

cues.zh: 这个法国的学者名字叫伯雷尔
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fa3 guo2 de5 xue2 zhe3 ming2 zi4 jiao4 bo2 lei2 er3
cues.en: and this French scholar's name was Borel.

cues.zh: 他提出的这么一个思想实验
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 chu1 de5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 si1 xiang3 shi2 yan4
cues.en: He proposed this thought experiment.

cues.zh: 他说有一只猴子
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 you3 yi1 zhi1 hou2 zi5
cues.en: He said: imagine a monkey

cues.zh: 这个猴子他既不懂英文也不懂汉语
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hou2 zi5 ta1 ji4 bu4 dong3 ying1 wen2 ye3 bu4 dong3 han4 yu3
cues.en: that understands neither English nor Chinese.

cues.zh: 但是如果你能给这个猴子提供一个
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 ni3 neng2 gei3 zhe4 ge5 hou2 zi5 ti2 gong1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: But if you give this monkey

cues.zh: 永远不卡纸永远不缺末的打字机
cues.pinyin: yong3 yuan3 bu4 ka3 zhi3 yong3 yuan3 bu4 que1 mo4 de5 da3 zi4 ji1
cues.en: a typewriter that never jams and never runs out of ink,

cues.zh: 让他在上面随便乱敲
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zai4 shang4 mian4 sui2 bian4 luan4 qiao1
cues.en: and let it bang on the keys randomly,

cues.zh: 只要你给他足够长的时间
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 gei3 ta1 zu2 gou4 zhang3 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: as long as you give it enough time...

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 打对三个字母概率还是 1
cues.pinyin: da3 dui4 san1 ge4 zi4 mu3 gai4 lv4 hai2 shi4 1
cues.en: the probability of typing one letter correctly is still 1 in 26.

cues.zh: 所以它连续对八次就能打出我的名字了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 lian2 xu4 dui4 ba1 ci4 jiu4 neng2 da3 chu1 wo3 de5 ming2 zi4 le5
cues.en: So if it gets it right eight times in a row, it can type my name.

cues.zh: 那这个概率有多大呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: So how big is that probability?

cues.zh: 那应该是 26 分之 1 的 8 次方
cues.pinyin: na4 ying1 gai1 shi4 26 fen1 zhi1 1 de5 8 ci4 fang1
cues.en: It should be (1/26) to the 8th power.

cues.zh: 这个数其实很小
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu4 qi2 shi2 hen3 xiao3
cues.en: This number is actually very small.

cues.zh: 我们用计算器把它算出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 ji4 suan4 qi4 ba3 ta1 suan4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Let's work it out with a calculator.

cues.zh: 结果是大约 5 乘 10 的 12 次方
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 shi4 da4 yue1 5 cheng2 10 de5 12 ci4 fang1
cues.en: The result is about 5 times 10 to the negative 12th power.

cues.zh: 这个大家没概念是吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 jia1 mei2 gai4 nian4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: You probably have no feel for that, right?

cues.zh: 咱写成小数
cues.pinyin: zan2 xie3 cheng2 xiao3 shu4
cues.en: Let's write it as a decimal.

cues.zh: 它应该是 0 00 一大堆 0
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying1 gai1 shi4 0 00 yi1 da4 dui1 0
cues.en: It should be 0.00 followed by a bunch of zeros

cues.zh: 最后带一个 5
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 dai4 yi2 ge4 5
cues.en: and ending with a 5.

cues.zh: 有多少个 0 呢
cues.pinyin: you3 duo1 shao3 ge4 0 ne5
cues.en: How many zeros are there?

cues.zh: 有 11 个 0
cues.pinyin: you3 11 ge4 0
cues.en: There are 11 zeros.

cues.zh: 就这么小
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 me5 xiao3
cues.en: That's how small it is.

cues.zh: 这个概率非常非常小
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 xiao3
cues.en: This probability is extremely, extremely small,

cues.zh: 但是也是有可能的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 shi4 you3 ke3 neng2 de5
cues.en: but it is still possible.

cues.zh: 我们怎么样才能让这个猴子打
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 neng2 rang4 zhe4 ge5 hou2 zi5 da3
cues.en: So how can we get this monkey to type

cues.zh: 出我的名字呢
cues.pinyin: chu1 wo3 de5 ming2 zi4 ne5
cues.en: out my name?

cues.zh: 咱们要说
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 yao4 shuo1
cues.en: We can say:

cues.zh: 只要你猴子足够多就行
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 hou2 zi5 zu2 gou4 duo1 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: as long as you have enough monkeys, it works.

cues.zh: 好比说你这个猴子
cues.pinyin: hao3 bi3 shuo1 ni3 zhe4 ge5 hou2 zi5
cues.en: For example, say for your monkey

cues.zh: 打出我名字的概率是二分之一
cues.pinyin: da3 chu1 wo3 ming2 zi4 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 er4 fen1 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: the chance of typing my name is one in two.

cues.zh: 那我两只猴子来打
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 liang3 zhi3 hou2 zi5 lai2 da3
cues.en: Then I use two monkeys to type it,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 没关系
cues.pinyin: mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: no problem.

cues.zh: 你让一只猴子打印两千亿次
cues.pinyin: ni3 rang4 yi1 zhi1 hou2 zi5 da3 yin4 liang3 qian1 yi4 ci4
cues.en: You have one monkey type two hundred billion times,

cues.zh: 也是可以的
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 ke3 yi3 de5
cues.en: that also works.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 你让他打 2000 亿次
cues.pinyin: ni3 rang4 ta1 da3 2000 yi4 ci4
cues.en: Eight letters counts as one attempt.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 一般都会说打哈姆雷特
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 du1 hui4 shuo1 da3 ha1 mu3 lei2 te4
cues.en: People usually talk about typing out Hamlet.

cues.zh: 我们知道英国有一个文豪莎士比亚
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ying1 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 wen2 hao2 sha1 shi4 bi3 ya4
cues.en: We know England had a literary giant, Shakespeare,

cues.zh: 他写了一个名著叫哈姆雷特
cues.pinyin: ta1 xie3 le5 yi2 ge4 ming2 zhu4 jiao4 ha1 mu3 lei2 te4
cues.en: who wrote a famous work called Hamlet.

cues.zh: 那我就想问了
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 wen4 le5
cues.en: So I want to ask:

cues.zh: 如果有一个猴子
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 yi2 ge4 hou2 zi5
cues.en: if there's a monkey

cues.zh: 让他打出哈姆雷特来
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 da3 chu1 ha1 mu3 lei2 te4 lai2
cues.en: and you have it type out Hamlet,

cues.zh: 这个概率又有多大呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 you4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: how big would that probability be?

cues.zh: 咱们可以算一算
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ke3 yi3 suan4 yi1 suan4
cues.en: Let's work it out.

cues.zh: 哈姆雷特呀
cues.pinyin: ha1 mu3 lei2 te4 ya5
cues.en: Hamlet

cues.zh: 一共大约有 13 万个字母
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 da4 yue1 you3 13 wan4 ge4 zi4 mu3
cues.en: has about 130,000 letters in total.

cues.zh: 咱们不算空格之类的
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 bu4 suan4 kong4 ge2 zhi1 lei4 de5
cues.en: Let's not count spaces and the like.

cues.zh: 咱们假设每个字母都是 26 个字母之一
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 jia3 she4 mei3 ge4 zi4 mu3 dou1 shi4 26 ge4 zi4 mu3 zhi1 yi1
cues.en: Let's assume every letter is one of the 26 letters.

cues.zh: 是不是一共有 13 万个字母
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 yi1 gong4 you3 13 wan4 ge4 zi4 mu3
cues.en: So that's a total of 130,000 letters, right?

cues.zh: 那么你每个字母都打对
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 mei3 ge4 zi4 mu3 dou1 da3 dui4
cues.en: So for every single letter to be typed correctly,

cues.zh: 按照我们的算法
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 wo3 men5 de5 suan4 fa3
cues.en: according to our calculation,

cues.zh: 这个概率是 26 分之一的 13 万次方
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gai4 lv4 shi4 26 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 13 wan4 ci4 fang1
cues.en: the probability is (1/26) to the 130,000th power.

cues.zh: 26 分之一的 13 万次方有多大呢
cues.pinyin: 26 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 13 wan4 ci4 fang1 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: How big is (1/26) to the 130,000th power?

cues.zh: 大约是 0 00 一大堆零
cues.pinyin: da4 yue1 shi4 0 00 yi1 da4 dui1 ling2
cues.en: It's about 0.00 followed by a huge bunch of zeros,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你的财富和马斯克这些人，只差33只猴子...

cues.zh: 我们算出来大概是 3 乘以 10 的 18 39 46 次方
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 suan4 chu1 lai2 da4 gai4 shi4 3 cheng2 yi3 10 de5 18 39 46 ci4 fang1
cues.en: we calculated it comes out to about 3 times 10 to the negative 183,946th power.

cues.zh: 这么多
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1
cues.en: That's how many zeros there are.

cues.zh: 那如果我们要把这个数读出来的话
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shu4 du2 chu1 lai2 de5 hua4
cues.en: If we tried to actually read this number aloud,

cues.zh: 都非常费劲
cues.pinyin: dou1 fei1 chang2 fei4 jin4
cues.en: it would be extremely laborious.

cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 3 11 11 11
cues.en: It should be read as 3, then 1, 1, 1, 1...

cues.zh: 一直读一
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 du2 yi1
cues.en: just reading '1' over and over,

cues.zh: 读多少个一呢
cues.pinyin: du2 duo1 shao3 ge4 yi1 ne5
cues.en: for how many '1's?

cues.pinyin: du2 23 000 ge4 yi1
cues.en: You'd read '1' 23,000 times.

cues.zh: 因为我们知道八个零是一亿
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 ba1 ge4 ling2 shi4 yi1 yi4
cues.en: Because we know eight zeros make a 'yi' (hundred million),

cues.zh: 它现在有 18 39 46 个零
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian4 zai4 you3 18 39 46 ge4 ling2
cues.en: and this number now has 183,946 zeros,

cues.zh: 你按八个零算以一个零来算
cues.pinyin: ni3 an4 ba1 ge4 ling2 suan4 yi3 yi2 ge4 ling2 lai2 suan4
cues.en: if you count every eight zeros as one unit,

cues.zh: 那你得读 2 3 万个零字
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 de2 du2 2 3 wan4 ge4 ling2 zi4
cues.en: then you'd have to read about 23,000 of those zero-groups.

cues.zh: 就是 3 11 1 一直读 2 3 万次
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 3 11 1 yi4 zhi2 du2 2 3 wan4 ci4
cues.en: That is, '3, 1, 1, 1...' reading '1' 23,000 times in a row.

cues.zh: 你需要这么多只猴子同时去打
cues.pinyin: ni3 xu1 yao4 zhe4 me5 duo1 zhi3 hou2 zi5 tong2 shi2 qu4 da3
cues.en: You'd need that many monkeys typing all at once

cues.zh: 才会有平均一只猴子打出一部哈姆雷特
cues.pinyin: cai2 hui4 you3 ping2 jun1 yi1 zhi1 hou2 zi5 da3 chu1 yi1 bu4 ha1 mu3 lei2 te4
cues.en: for, on average, one monkey to produce a full copy of Hamlet.

cues.zh: 可见这个哈姆雷特猴是非常非常稀有的
cues.pinyin: ke3 jian4 zhe4 ge5 ha1 mu3 lei2 te4 hou2 shi4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 xi1 you3 de5
cues.en: You can see this 'Hamlet monkey' is extremely, extremely rare.

cues.zh: 我们说无线猴子是存在理论可能
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shuo1 wu2 xian4 hou2 zi5 shi4 cun2 zai4 li3 lun4 ke3 neng2
cues.en: We say the infinite monkey theorem exists as a theoretical possibility.
