cues.pinyin: zhong3 tai2 wan1 de5 xiao3 chi1
cues.en: these Taiwanese snacks.

cues.zh: 当然最难忘的还是这个台湾的咸酥鸡
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 zui4 nan2 wang4 de5 hai2 shi4 zhe4 ge5 tai2 wan1 de5 xian2 su1 ji1
cues.en: But of course the most memorable was this Taiwanese salt-and-pepper chicken.

cues.zh: 你要准备炸鸡肉的时候呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 zhun3 bei4 zha4 ji1 rou4 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When you're about to fry the chicken,

cues.zh: 你可以用你的筷子测试一下
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 yong4 ni3 de5 kuai4 zi5 ce4 shi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: you can test it with your chopsticks.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 咸酥鸡 | 如何在家里做得酥酥脆脆|【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 如果你把筷子放下去的时候
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 ba3 kuai4 zi5 fang4 xia4 qu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: If you put the chopsticks in

cues.zh: 你看到旁边有许多小气泡
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 dao4 pang2 bian1 you3 xu3 duo1 xiao3 qi4 pao4
cues.en: and you see lots of tiny bubbles around them,

cues.zh: 就是这样子的气泡
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 qi4 pao4
cues.en: bubbles just like this,

cues.zh: 你就知道呢这个油呢可以拿来炸鸡肉了
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 ne5 zhe4 ge5 you2 ne5 ke3 yi3 na2 lai2 zha4 ji1 rou4 le5
cues.en: then you know the oil is ready to fry the chicken.

cues.zh: 那么这个咸酥鸡的创始人到底是谁呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 xian2 su1 ji1 de5 chuang4 shi3 ren2 dao4 di3 shi4 shui2 ne5
cues.en: So who was the actual founder of this salt-and-pepper chicken?

cues.zh: 根据苹果预报报道
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 ping2 guo3 yu4 bao4 bao4 dao4
cues.en: According to a report from Apple Daily,

cues.zh: 是在 19 75 年由陈挺智创立的
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 19 75 nian2 you2 chen2 ting3 zhi4 chuang4 li4 de5
cues.en: it was founded in 1975 by Chen Ting-chih.

cues.zh: 它在西门町开了第一家咸酥鸡店
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 xi1 men2 ting1 kai1 le5 di4 yi1 jia1 xian2 su1 ji1 dian4
cues.en: He opened the first salt-and-pepper chicken shop in Ximending.

cues.zh: 首先是把鸡肉先炸到金黄色
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 shi4 ba3 ji1 rou4 xian1 zha4 dao4 jin1 huang2 se4
cues.en: First, the chicken is fried until golden brown,

cues.zh: 非常的美丽之后
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 de5 mei3 li4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: looking really beautiful,

cues.zh: 然后撒上一种特别的调味料
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 sa1 shang4 yi1 zhong3 te4 bie2 de5 tiao2 wei4 liao4
cues.en: then a special seasoning is sprinkled on top.

cues.zh: 因为它越来越受欢迎
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yue4 lai2 yue4 shou4 huan1 ying2
cues.en: Because it became more and more popular,

cues.zh: 许多店家就开始跟它学
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 dian4 jia1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 gen1 ta1 xue2
cues.en: many shops started to copy it.

cues.zh: 店家开的多了
cues.pinyin: dian4 jia1 kai1 de5 duo1 le5
cues.en: As more shops opened,

cues.zh: 咸酥鸡也就越变越红
cues.pinyin: xian2 su1 ji1 ye3 jiu4 yue4 bian4 yue4 hong2
cues.en: salt-and-pepper chicken also became more and more popular.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 咸酥鸡 | 如何在家里做得酥酥脆脆|【美食天堂 】家常料理食谱

cues.zh: 我们今天这个咸酥鸡呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 xian2 su1 ji1 ne5
cues.en: The salt-and-pepper chicken we have today

cues.zh: 味道真的是很棒
cues.pinyin: wei4 dao4 zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 bang4
cues.en: really tastes great.

cues.zh: 非常的酥脆
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 de5 su1 cui4
cues.en: Very crispy.

cues.zh: 可以比得上这个
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 bi3 de2 shang4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: It can compare to

cues.zh: 我在台湾吃到的这个咸酥鸡
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 tai2 wan1 chi1 dao4 de5 zhe4 ge5 xian2 su1 ji1
cues.en: the salt-and-pepper chicken I ate in Taiwan.

cues.zh: 我咬的时候呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao3 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When I bite into it,

cues.zh: 很酥脆
cues.pinyin: hen3 su1 cui4
cues.en: it's very crispy.

cues.zh: 我自己可以听得到那个声音
cues.pinyin: wo3 zi4 ji3 ke3 yi3 ting1 de5 dao4 na4 ge5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: I can hear the sound myself.

cues.zh: 而且不油腻
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 you2 ni4
cues.en: And it's not greasy.

cues.zh: 在家里做的呢又比较健康
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 li3 zuo4 de5 ne5 you4 bi3 jiao4 jian4 kang1
cues.en: Making it at home is also healthier.

cues.zh: 它有很多种的这个味道
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 hen3 duo1 zhong3 de5 zhe4 ge5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: It has many layers of flavor.

cues.zh: 很多层次
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ceng2 ci4
cues.en: Lots of layers.

cues.zh: 有咸味
cues.pinyin: you3 xian2 wei4
cues.en: There's a salty taste,

cues.zh: 蒜味
cues.pinyin: suan4 wei4
cues.en: a garlicky taste,

cues.zh: 然后有微微的辣味
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you3 wei1 wei1 de5 la4 wei4
cues.en: and then a slight spiciness.

cues.zh: 真的是很美味
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 mei3 wei4
cues.en: It's really delicious.

cues.zh: 需要这个炸鸡呢真的是有各式各样
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 zhe4 ge5 zha4 ji1 ne5 zhen1 de5 shi4 you3 ge4 shi4 ge4 yang4
cues.en: Fried chicken really comes in all kinds.

cues.zh: 每个国家都有不同的种类
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 guo2 jia1 dou1 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 zhong3 lei4
cues.en: Every country has different types.

cues.zh: 那也请你在下面留言告诉我
cues.pinyin: na4 ye3 qing3 ni3 zai4 xia4 mian4 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 wo3
cues.en: So please leave a comment below and tell me

cues.zh: 你最喜欢的这个炸鸡是哪一种
cues.pinyin: ni3 zui4 xi3 huan1 de5 zhe4 ge5 zha4 ji1 shi4 na3 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: which fried chicken is your favorite.

cues.zh: 也别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: ye3 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: And don't forget to subscribe and like.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 亲爱的各位老师们大家好我是李永乐
cues.pinyin: qin1 ai4 de5 ge4 wei4 lao3 shi1 men5 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4
cues.en: Dear teachers, hello everyone, I'm Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 来自北京的中国人民大学附属中学
cues.pinyin: lai2 zi4 bei3 jing1 de5 zhong1 guo2 ren2 min2 da4 xue2 fu4 shu3 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: I'm from the High School Affiliated with Renmin University of China in Beijing.

cues.zh: 今天很荣幸受到刘鹏之校长的邀请
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 hen3 rong2 xing4 shou4 dao4 liu2 peng2 zhi1 xiao4 zhang3 de5 yao1 qing3
cues.en: Today I'm honored to be invited by Principal Liu Pengzhi.

cues.zh: 来给我们普林斯顿国际数理学校的老师
cues.pinyin: lai2 gei3 wo3 men5 pu3 lin2 si1 dun4 guo2 ji4 shu4 li3 xue2 xiao4 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: to share with the teachers of our Princeton International School of Mathematics and Science.

cues.zh: 分享一下我的故事
cues.pinyin: fen1 xiang3 yi1 xia4 wo3 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: a bit of my story.

cues.zh: 我从 200 9 年加入人大附中工作了 16 年
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 200 9 nian2 jia1 ru4 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 gong1 zuo4 le5 16 nian2
cues.en: I joined RDFZ in 2009 and have worked there for 16 years.

cues.zh: 一直从事高中物理教学
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 cong2 shi4 gao1 zhong1 wu4 li3 jiao4 xue2
cues.en: I've always taught high school physics.

cues.zh: 还有物理竞赛的培训工作
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wu4 li3 jing4 sai4 de5 pei2 xun4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: as well as training students for physics competitions.

cues.zh: 也取得了一定的成绩
cues.pinyin: ye3 qu3 de2 le5 yi2 ding4 de5 cheng2 ji4
cues.en: and achieved some results.

cues.zh: 比如说 20 13 年我的学生张延征
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 20 13 nian2 wo3 de5 xue2 sheng1 zhang1 yan2 zheng1
cues.en: For example, in 2013 my student Zhang Yanzheng.

cues.zh: 获得了北京市高考的第一名
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 le5 bei3 jing1 shi4 gao1 kao3 de5 di4 yi4 ming2
cues.en: won first place in Beijing's college entrance exam.

cues.zh: 2019 年我的学生孙向凯
cues.pinyin: 2019 nian2 wo3 de5 xue2 sheng1 sun1 xiang4 kai3
cues.en: In 2019 my student Sun Xiangkai.

cues.zh: 获得了第 50 届国际物理奥林匹克竞赛
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 le5 di4 50 jie4 guo2 ji4 wu4 li3 ao4 lin2 pi3 ke4 jing4 sai4
cues.en: won first place and gold medal.

cues.zh: 金牌第一名
cues.pinyin: jin1 pai2 di4 yi4 ming2
cues.en: at the 50th International Physics Olympiad.

cues.zh: 张哲伦获得亚洲物理奥赛的金牌
cues.pinyin: zhang1 zhe2 lun2 huo4 de2 ya4 zhou1 wu4 li3 ao4 sai4 de5 jin1 pai2
cues.en: Zhang Zhelun won the gold medal at the Asian Physics Olympiad.

cues.zh: 最近几年呢
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 ji3 nian2 ne5
cues.en: In recent years.

cues.zh: 我又在互联网上上传了许多的科普课
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 zai4 hu4 lian2 wang3 shang4 shang4 chuan2 le5 xu3 duo1 de5 ke1 pu3 ke4
cues.en: I've also uploaded many science outreach lessons online.

cues.zh: 程和教学课程
cues.pinyin: cheng2 he2 jiao4 xue2 ke4 cheng2
cues.en: and teaching courses.

cues.zh: 突然获得了很大的观看量
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 huo4 de2 le5 hen3 da4 de5 guan1 kan4 liang4
cues.en: and suddenly got a huge number of views.

cues.zh: 让我受宠若惊
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 shou4 chong3 ruo4 jing1
cues.en: which left me overwhelmed with the attention.

cues.zh: 我现在呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian4 zai4 ne5
cues.en: Right now.

cues.zh: 在互联网上有 3000 多万的粉丝
cues.pinyin: zai4 hu4 lian2 wang3 shang4 you3 3000 duo1 wan4 de5 fen3 si1
cues.en: I have over 30 million followers online.

cues.zh: 那我的视频呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 de5 shi4 pin2 ne5
cues.en: And my videos.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 总共的播放量有几十亿次
cues.pinyin: zong3 gong4 de5 bo1 fang4 liang4 you3 ji3 shi2 yi4 ci4
cues.en: have been watched billions of times in total.

cues.zh: 您应该抓到过我的视频
cues.pinyin: nin2 ying1 gai1 zhua1 dao4 guo4 wo3 de5 shi4 pin2
cues.en: You've probably come across one of my videos.

cues.zh: 如果说你不认识我
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shuo1 ni3 bu4 ren4 shi2 wo3
cues.en: If you don't recognize me.

cues.zh: 那只能说明啊
cues.pinyin: na4 zhi3 neng2 shuo1 ming2 a5
cues.en: that can only mean.

cues.zh: 我现在胖得太厉害了
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian4 zai4 pang4 de2 tai4 li4 hai4 le5
cues.en: I've gotten way too fat now.

cues.zh: 很多人可能会好奇
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 ke3 neng2 hui4 hao4 qi2
cues.en: Many people might be curious.

cues.zh: 十几年前青花北大的毕业生
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji3 nian2 qian2 qing1 hua1 bei3 da4 de5 bi4 ye4 sheng1
cues.en: why, as a Peking University graduate over a decade ago.

cues.zh: 为什么要当一个中学老师呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1 ne5
cues.en: I chose to become a middle/high school teacher.

cues.zh: 既然当中学老师给学生上课
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 dang1 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1 gei3 xue2 sheng1 shang4 ke4
cues.en: Since being a teacher means teaching regular classes.

cues.zh: 还要上竞赛课工作量不饱和吗
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 shang4 jing4 sai4 ke4 gong1 zuo4 liang4 bu4 bao3 he2 ma5
cues.en: plus competition classes — isn't the workload already full?

cues.zh: 为什么还有时间在网上做视频呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 you3 shi2 jian1 zai4 wang3 shang4 zuo4 shi4 pin2 ne5
cues.en: why would I still have time to make videos online?

cues.zh: 今天我就想和大家分享一下我的成长经历
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 xiang3 he2 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 yi1 xia4 wo3 de5 cheng2 zhang3 jing1 li4
cues.en: Today I'd like to share my growth story with everyone.

cues.zh: 1 小学和中学
cues.pinyin: 1 xiao3 xue2 he2 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: Part 1: Elementary and Middle School.

cues.zh: 我出生在东北的一座小城市吉林市
cues.pinyin: wo3 chu1 sheng1 zai4 dong1 bei3 de5 yi1 zuo4 xiao3 cheng2 shi4 ji2 lin2 shi4
cues.en: I was born in a small city in the northeast, Jilin City.

cues.zh: 吉林市地处东北老工业基地
cues.pinyin: ji2 lin2 shi4 di4 chu3 dong1 bei3 lao3 gong1 ye4 ji1 di4
cues.en: Jilin City is located in the old industrial base of the northeast.

cues.zh: 产业结构也比较传统
cues.pinyin: chan3 ye4 jie2 gou4 ye3 bi3 jiao4 chuan2 tong3
cues.en: and its industrial structure is also relatively traditional.

cues.zh: 我小的时候家里很多人都是当老师的
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 jia1 li3 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 shi4 dang1 lao3 shi1 de5
cues.en: When I was young, many people in my family were teachers.

cues.zh: 我读的小学是吉林市第一实验小学
cues.pinyin: wo3 du2 de5 xiao3 xue2 shi4 ji2 lin2 shi4 di4 yi1 shi2 yan4 xiao3 xue2
cues.en: The elementary school I attended was Jilin City First Experimental Elementary School.

cues.zh: 虽然是在 30 多年前
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 shi4 zai4 30 duo1 nian2 qian2
cues.en: Even though it was more than 30 years ago.

cues.zh: 但是一实验的理念非常先进
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 shi2 yan4 de5 li3 nian4 fei1 chang2 xian1 jin4
cues.en: the educational philosophy at First Experimental was very advanced.

cues.zh: 每天下午三点半之后
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 xia4 wu3 san1 dian3 ban4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Every day after 3:30 in the afternoon.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 于是就找了一个大帅哥崔眼做替身
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 zhao3 le5 yi2 ge4 da4 shuai4 ge1 cui1 yan3 zuo4 ti4 shen1
cues.en: so they found a handsome guy, Cui Yan, to be his stand-in.

cues.zh: 自己拿了一把刀假扮侍卫
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 na2 le5 yi1 ba3 dao1 jia3 ban4 shi4 wei4
cues.en: and he himself took a sword and disguised himself as a guard.

cues.zh: 站在崔眼的身边
cues.pinyin: zhan4 zai4 cui1 yan3 de5 shen1 bian1
cues.en: standing beside Cui Yan.

cues.zh: 下朝之后
cues.pinyin: xia4 chao2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the court session ended.

cues.zh: 曹操不知道自己的计谋成功不成功
cues.pinyin: cao2 cao1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 ji4 mou2 cheng2 gong1 bu4 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: Cao Cao didn't know whether his scheme had worked.

cues.zh: 就派人去问使者
cues.pinyin: jiu4 pai4 ren2 qu4 wen4 shi3 zhe3
cues.en: so he sent someone to ask the envoy.

cues.zh: 你觉得魏王怎么样啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 jue2 de5 wei4 wang2 zen3 me5 yang4 a5
cues.en: "What did you think of the King of Wei?"

cues.zh: 使者说魏王威武非常
cues.pinyin: shi3 zhe3 shuo1 wei4 wang2 wei1 wu3 fei1 chang2
cues.en: The envoy said the King of Wei was extremely impressive.

cues.zh: 但是他身旁那个持刀而立的人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 shen1 pang2 na4 ge5 chi2 dao1 er2 li4 de5 ren2
cues.en: but the man standing beside him holding the sword.

cues.zh: 才是一个真正的英雄
cues.pinyin: cai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhen1 zheng4 de5 ying1 xiong2
cues.en: was the true hero.

cues.zh: 看到这里我不禁浮想连篇
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 zhe4 li3 wo3 bu4 jin1 fu2 xiang3 lian2 pian1
cues.en: Reading this, I couldn't help but let my imagination run wild.

cues.zh: 真的希望自己能像曹操一样
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 neng2 xiang4 cao2 cao1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: I truly wished I could be like Cao Cao.

cues.zh: 虽然深矮行漏
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 shen1 ai3 xing2 lou4
cues.en: even though short and plain-looking.

cues.zh: 却能够持刀而立
cues.pinyin: que4 neng2 gou4 chi2 dao1 er2 li4
cues.en: could still stand holding a sword.

cues.zh: 做一个真正的英雄
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yi2 ge4 zhen1 zheng4 de5 ying1 xiong2
cues.en: and be a true hero.

cues.zh: 可是这把刀到底是什么呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 ba3 dao1 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: But what exactly was this "sword"?

cues.zh: 后来我上了中学
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 shang4 le5 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: Later I went to middle school.

cues.zh: 来到了吉林市第五中学
cues.pinyin: lai2 dao4 le5 ji2 lin2 shi4 di4 wu3 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: and came to Jilin City No. 5 Middle School.

cues.zh: 相比来讲
cues.pinyin: xiang1 bi3 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: By comparison.

cues.zh: 吉林五中的教学更加偏向于应试
cues.pinyin: ji2 lin2 wu3 zhong1 de5 jiao4 xue2 geng4 jia1 pian1 xiang4 yu2 ying4 shi4
cues.en: Jilin No. 5 Middle School's teaching leaned more toward exam prep.

cues.zh: 学生人数多
cues.pinyin: xue2 sheng1 ren2 shu4 duo1
cues.en: There were more students.

cues.zh: 学习更加紧张
cues.pinyin: xue2 xi2 geng4 jia1 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: and studying was more intense.

cues.zh: 但是我庆幸在这里遇到了许多认
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 qing4 xing4 zai4 zhe4 li3 yu4 dao4 le5 xu3 duo1 ren4
cues.en: But I was fortunate to meet many conscientious.

cues.zh: 真负责的老师
cues.pinyin: zhen1 fu4 ze2 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: and responsible teachers there.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 吉林市实行了严格的管控制度
cues.pinyin: ji2 lin2 shi4 shi2 xing2 le5 yan2 ge2 de5 guan3 kong4 zhi4 du4
cues.en: Jilin City implemented strict lockdown controls.

cues.zh: 几乎所有的人都必须留在家里不能外出
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 suo3 you3 de5 ren2 dou1 bi4 xu1 liu2 zai4 jia1 li3 bu4 neng2 wai4 chu1
cues.en: Almost everyone had to stay home and couldn't go out.

cues.zh: 也出现了一定的物资困难
cues.pinyin: ye3 chu1 xian4 le5 yi2 ding4 de5 wu4 zi1 kun4 nan2
cues.en: There were also certain shortages of supplies.

cues.zh: 我们同学也一直关注着刘老师家里的情况
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong2 xue2 ye3 yi4 zhi2 guan1 zhu4 zhe5 liu2 lao3 shi1 jia1 li3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: We classmates kept paying attention to Teacher Liu's family situation.

cues.zh: 有一天我们突然获知
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wo3 men5 tu1 ran2 huo4 zhi1
cues.en: One day we suddenly learned.

cues.zh: 刘老师所在的小区社区的工作人
cues.pinyin: liu2 lao3 shi1 suo3 zai4 de5 xiao3 qu1 she4 qu1 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2
cues.en: that a staff member.

cues.zh: 员出现了阳性
cues.pinyin: yuan2 chu1 xian4 le5 yang2 xing4
cues.en: at Teacher Liu's residential community had tested positive.

cues.zh: 所有社区工作人员都被拉走隔离
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 she4 qu1 gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 dou1 bei4 la1 zou3 ge2 li2
cues.en: All the community staff were taken away for quarantine.

cues.zh: 造成了社区的停摆
cues.pinyin: zao4 cheng2 le5 she4 qu1 de5 ting2 bai3
cues.en: which brought the community to a standstill.

cues.zh: 物资转运更加的困难
cues.pinyin: wu4 zi1 zhuan3 yun4 geng4 jia1 de5 kun4 nan2
cues.en: making it even harder to deliver supplies.

cues.zh: 所有的同学立刻在微信群里活动了起来
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 tong2 xue2 li4 ke4 zai4 wei1 xin4 qun2 li3 huo2 dong4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: All the classmates immediately sprang into action in our WeChat group.

cues.zh: 70 人一起为刘老师买了米面油和蔬菜水果
cues.pinyin: 70 ren2 yi4 qi3 wei4 liu2 lao3 shi1 mai3 le5 mi3 mian4 you2 he2 shu1 cai4 shui3 guo3
cues.en: 70 of us together bought rice, flour, oil, vegetables and fruit for Teacher Liu.

cues.zh: 委托留在当地参与防疫志愿工作的同学
cues.pinyin: wei3 tuo1 liu2 zai4 dang1 di4 can1 yu4 fang2 yi4 zhi4 yuan4 gong1 zuo4 de5 tong2 xue2
cues.en: We asked a classmate who stayed locally doing pandemic-prevention volunteer work.

cues.zh: 在方便的时候给刘老师送去
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang1 bian4 de5 shi2 hou4 gei3 liu2 lao3 shi1 song4 qu4
cues.en: to deliver it to Teacher Liu when convenient.

cues.zh: 前前后后只用了一天
cues.pinyin: qian2 qian2 hou4 hou4 zhi3 yong4 le5 yi1 tian1
cues.en: From start to finish it only took one day.

cues.zh: 如果说什么是最成功的老师
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shuo1 shen2 me5 shi4 zui4 cheng2 gong1 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: If you ask what makes the most successful teacher.

cues.zh: 我想刘老师就是最成功的老师
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 liu2 lao3 shi1 jiu4 shi4 zui4 cheng2 gong1 de5 lao3 shi1
cues.en: I think Teacher Liu is the most successful teacher.

cues.zh: 虽然毕业了 20 多年
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bi4 ye4 le5 20 duo1 nian2
cues.en: Even though we graduated more than 20 years ago.

cues.zh: 但是集体还在
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ji2 ti3 hai2 zai4
cues.en: the class spirit is still there.

cues.zh: 师生情还在
cues.pinyin: shi1 sheng1 qing2 hai2 zai4
cues.en: and the bond between teacher and students is still there.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 再后来我上了高中
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 wo3 shang4 le5 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: Later still, I went to high school.

cues.zh: 就读于吉林市第一中学
cues.pinyin: jiu4 du2 yu2 ji2 lin2 shi4 di4 yi1 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: and attended Jilin City No. 1 Middle School.

cues.zh: 还考上了奥林匹克班
cues.pinyin: hai2 kao3 shang4 le5 ao4 lin2 pi3 ke4 ban1
cues.en: and even got into the Olympiad class.

cues.zh: 我记得在刚进入高中的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 ji4 de5 zai4 gang1 jin4 ru4 gao1 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: I remember when I first entered high school.

cues.zh: 老师让每一个人做一个演讲
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 rang4 mei3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 yi2 ge4 yan3 jiang3
cues.en: the teacher had everyone give a speech.

cues.zh: 介绍自己
cues.pinyin: jie4 shao4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: to introduce themselves.

cues.zh: 刚刚认识
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 ren4 shi2
cues.en: Having just met.

cues.zh: 难免要相互吹嘘
cues.pinyin: nan2 mian3 yao4 xiang1 hu4 chui1 xu1
cues.en: we inevitably bragged about ourselves a bit to each other.

cues.zh: 再自迁一番
cues.pinyin: zai4 zi4 qian1 yi1 fan1
cues.en: and talked ourselves up.

cues.zh: 有些人说
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: Some people said.

cues.zh: 红花还要绿叶配
cues.pinyin: hong2 hua1 hai2 yao4 lv4 ye4 pei4
cues.en: "a red flower needs green leaves to set it off.

cues.zh: 大家做红花
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zuo4 hong2 hua1
cues.en: everyone else can be the red flower.

cues.zh: 我就做绿叶
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zuo4 lv4 ye4
cues.en: I'll be the green leaf."

cues.zh: 还有人说
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: Someone else said.

cues.zh: 那你们做红花和绿叶
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 men5 zuo4 hong2 hua1 he2 lv4 ye4
cues.en: "you all can be the red flower and the green leaves.

cues.zh: 我来做枝
cues.pinyin: wo3 lai2 zuo4 zhi1
cues.en: I'll be the branch.

cues.zh: 再往后就是做泥土
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 hou4 jiu4 shi4 zuo4 ni2 tu3
cues.en: and after that, be the soil.

cues.zh: 做肥料等等
cues.pinyin: zuo4 fei2 liao4 deng3 deng3
cues.en: be the fertilizer, and so on."

cues.zh: 我演讲的时候说呀
cues.pinyin: wo3 yan3 jiang3 de5 shi2 hou4 shuo1 ya5
cues.en: When I gave my speech, I said.

cues.zh: 我想成为中国的教育部长
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 cheng2 wei2 zhong1 guo2 de5 jiao4 yu4 bu4 zhang3
cues.en: "I want to become China's Minister of Education."

cues.zh: 2002 年我来到了北京大学物理系读书
cues.pinyin: 2002 nian2 wo3 lai2 dao4 le5 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 wu4 li3 xi4 du2 shu1
cues.en: Many classmates, including the teacher, found it a bit strange.

cues.zh: 怎么刚上中学就想着当官呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 gang1 shang4 zhong1 xue2 jiu4 xiang3 zhe5 dang1 guan1 ne5
cues.en: "Why would you be thinking about becoming an official right when you start school?

cues.zh: 劳动者不光荣吗
cues.pinyin: lao2 dong4 zhe3 bu4 guang1 rong2 ma5
cues.en: Isn't being a laborer honorable?"

cues.zh: 其实 15 岁的我对当官没有什么概念
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 15 sui4 de5 wo3 dui4 dang1 guan1 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 gai4 nian4
cues.en: Actually, at 15, I had no real concept of "being an official."

cues.zh: 我心里只是单纯的对科学知识
cues.pinyin: wo3 xin1 li3 zhi3 shi4 dan1 chun2 de5 dui4 ke1 xue2 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: In my heart I simply had a kind of blind faith.

cues.zh: 对教育有一种迷信
cues.pinyin: dui4 jiao4 yu4 you3 yi1 zhong3 mi2 xin4
cues.en: in scientific knowledge and in education.

cues.zh: 我懵懂的认为
cues.pinyin: wo3 meng3 dong3 de5 ren4 wei2
cues.en: I naively believed.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我一个中学老师，怎么就成网红了？

cues.zh: 我的心中就埋下了当年当老师的种子
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 xin1 zhong1 jiu4 mai2 xia4 liao3 dang4 nian2 dang1 lao3 shi1 de5 zhong3 zi5
cues.en: and that's when the seed of wanting to be a teacher was planted in my heart.

cues.zh: 200 2 年我来到了北京大学物理系读书
cues.pinyin: 200 2 nian2 wo3 lai2 dao4 le5 bei3 jing1 da4 xue2 wu4 li3 xi4 du2 shu1
cues.en: In 2002 I came to Peking University to study physics.

cues.zh: 到现在已经 24 年了
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 yi3 jing1 24 nian2 le5
cues.en: and it's now been 24 years.

cues.zh: 回想起来在北大的日子
cues.pinyin: hui2 xiang3 qi3 lai2 zai4 bei3 da4 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: Looking back on my days at Peking University.

cues.zh: 真是我一生中最快乐
cues.pinyin: zhen1 shi4 wo3 yi1 sheng1 zhong1 zui4 kuai4 le4
cues.en: they were truly the happiest.

cues.zh: 最无忧无虑的一段时光
cues.pinyin: zui4 wu2 you1 wu2 lv4 de5 yi1 duan4 shi2 guang1
cues.en: and most carefree time of my life.

cues.zh: 感谢北大物理系所有老师对我的教诲
cues.pinyin: gan3 xie4 bei3 da4 wu4 li3 xi4 suo3 you3 lao3 shi1 dui4 wo3 de5 jiao4 hui4
cues.en: I'm grateful to all the teachers in Peking University's physics department for their guidance.

cues.zh: 虽然我没有能够成为一名学霸毕业生
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 wo3 mei2 you3 neng2 gou4 cheng2 wei2 yi1 ming2 xue2 ba4 bi4 ye4 sheng1
cues.en: Although I didn't manage to graduate as a top student.

cues.zh: 但是我永远以北大为荣
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 yong3 yuan3 yi3 bei3 da4 wei4 rong2
cues.en: I will always be proud to be a Peking University alumnus.

cues.zh: 200 4 年大二暑假
cues.pinyin: 200 4 nian2 da4 er4 shu3 jia4
cues.en: In the summer of 2004, my sophomore year.

cues.zh: 我组织了几位同学去甘肃省惠宁县
cues.pinyin: wo3 zu3 zhi1 le5 ji3 wei4 tong2 xue2 qu4 gan1 su4 sheng3 hui4 ning2 xian4
cues.en: I organized a few classmates to go to Huining County, Gansu Province.

cues.zh: 进行了社会实践考察
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 le5 she4 hui4 shi2 jian4 kao3 cha2
cues.en: to carry out a social practice field study.

cues.zh: 惠宁县是红军三军会师的纪念地
cues.pinyin: hui4 ning2 xian4 shi4 hong2 jun1 san1 jun1 hui4 shi1 de5 ji4 nian4 di4
cues.en: Huining County is the memorial site where the Red Army's three armies joined forces.

cues.zh: 也是远近文明的状元县
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 yuan3 jin4 wen2 ming2 de5 zhuang4 yuan2 xian4
cues.en: and it's also a county well known far and wide for producing top scholars.

cues.zh: 我们到了那儿才发现当地非常的贫困
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 dao4 le5 na4 er2 cai2 fa1 xian4 dang1 di4 fei1 chang2 de5 pin2 kun4
cues.en: When we got there we discovered how extremely poor the area was.

cues.zh: 缺水
cues.pinyin: que1 shui3
cues.en: and short of water.

cues.zh: 虽然到了 21 世纪
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 dao4 le5 21 shi4 ji4
cues.en: Even though it was already the 21st century.

cues.zh: 很多家庭还住在窑洞里
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 jia1 ting2 hai2 zhu4 zai4 yao2 dong4 li3
cues.en: many families still lived in cave dwellings.

cues.zh: 用门前挖的大坑储存雨水度日
cues.pinyin: yong4 men2 qian2 wa1 de5 da4 keng1 chu3 cun2 yu3 shui3 du4 ri4
cues.en: using big pits dug in front of their doors to store rainwater to get through the days.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 前两天王虹和邓煜一起获得了数学
cues.pinyin: qian2 liang3 tian1 wang2 hong2 he2 deng4 yu4 yi4 qi3 huo4 de2 le5 shu4 xue2
cues.en: A couple of days ago, Wang Hong and Deng Yu together won

cues.zh: 界的最高奖之
cues.pinyin: jie4 de5 zui4 gao1 jiang3 zhi1
cues.en: the top prize in mathematics —

cues.zh: 一的菲尔兹奖
cues.pinyin: yi1 de5 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3
cues.en: the Fields Medal.

cues.zh: 我在一年以前就做了一个视频
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 yi1 nian2 yi3 qian2 jiu4 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: A year ago I made a video

cues.zh: 讲解了王虹研究的挂骨猜想到
cues.pinyin: jiang3 jie3 le5 wang2 hong2 yan2 jiu1 de5 gua4 gu3 cai1 xiang3 dao4
cues.en: explaining what Wang Hong's research on the conjecture

cues.zh: 底是怎么回事
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: was actually about,

cues.zh: 并且预祝王虹获得菲尔兹奖
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 yu4 zhu4 wang2 hong2 huo4 de2 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3
cues.en: and I wished Wang Hong well in winning the Fields Medal.

cues.zh: 最近很多小朋友就催我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 cui1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a lot of you kids have been pushing me, saying

cues.zh: 王虹的研究讲完了
cues.pinyin: wang2 hong2 de5 yan2 jiu1 jiang3 wan2 le5
cues.en: "You've finished covering Wang Hong's research,

cues.zh: 那你赶紧讲一讲邓煜的研究工作吧
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 gan3 jin3 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 deng4 yu4 de5 yan2 jiu1 gong1 zuo4 ba5
cues.en: so hurry up and talk about Deng Yu's research too!"

cues.zh: 他到底是因为什么获得了菲尔兹奖呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 dao4 di3 shi4 yin1 wei4 shen2 me5 huo4 de2 le5 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3 ne5
cues.en: What exactly did he win the Fields Medal for?

cues.zh: 邓煜研究的是著名的希尔伯特第六问题
cues.pinyin: deng4 yu4 yan2 jiu1 de5 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 di4 liu4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Deng Yu's research is on the famous Hilbert's sixth problem.

cues.zh: 今天我就通过一个视频跟大家来聊一聊
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 shi4 pin2 gen1 da4 jia1 lai2 liao2 yi1 liao2
cues.en: Today I'll use one video to talk with you about

cues.zh: 什么是希尔伯特第六问题
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 di4 liu4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: what Hilbert's sixth problem is,

cues.zh: 以及这一个问题对科学研究到底有
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 zhe4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 dui4 ke1 xue2 yan2 jiu1 dao4 di3 you3
cues.en: and what significance this problem actually has

cues.zh: 什么样的意义
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yang4 de5 yi4 yi4
cues.en: for scientific research.

cues.zh: 希尔伯特第六问题是希尔伯特提出的
cues.pinyin: xi1 er3 bo2 te4 di4 liu4 wen4 ti2 shi4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: Hilbert's sixth problem was proposed by Hilbert,

cues.zh: 关于物理公理化的问题
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 wu4 li3 gong1 li3 hua4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: and it's about the axiomatization of physics —

cues.zh: 物理公理化
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gong1 li3 hua4
cues.en: the axiomatization of physics.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does that mean?

cues.zh: 咱们来回顾一下历史
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 lai2 hui2 gu4 yi1 xia4 li4 shi3
cues.en: Let's look back at history.

cues.zh: 就在 19 00 年的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 19 00 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back in the year 1900,

cues.zh: 19 00 年数学家们开了第二届的 IC M 大会
cues.pinyin: 19 00 nian2 shu4 xue2 jia1 men5 kai1 le5 di4 er4 jie4 de5 IC M da4 hui4
cues.en: in 1900 mathematicians held the second International Congress of Mathematicians,

cues.zh: 国际数学家大会
cues.pinyin: guo2 ji4 shu4 xue2 jia1 da4 hui4
cues.en: the International Congress of Mathematicians.

cues.zh: 第二届 IC M
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jie4 IC M
cues.en: the second ICM.

cues.zh: 现在呢王虹他们获奖这一届是第三届
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ne5 wang2 hong2 ta1 men5 huo4 jiang3 zhe4 yi1 jie4 shi4 di4 san1 jie4
cues.en: Now, the congress where Wang Hong and the others won is said to be the third one.

cues.zh: 是吧就一届一届传下来的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 jiu4 yi1 jie4 yi1 jie4 chuan2 xia4 lai2 de5
cues.en: Right, each one carries on from the last, one after another.

cues.zh: 第二届 IC M 大会上有一个著名的数学家
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jie4 IC M da4 hui4 shang4 you3 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 de5 shu4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: At the second ICM, there was a famous mathematician

cues.zh: 名字叫希尔伯特
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4
cues.en: named Hilbert.

cues.zh: 这希尔伯特呀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 ya5
cues.en: This Hilbert —

cues.zh: 人家邀请他发表一个演讲
cues.pinyin: ren2 jia1 yao1 qing3 ta1 fa1 biao3 yi2 ge4 yan3 jiang3
cues.en: people invited him to give a talk,

cues.zh: 他就发表了一个演讲
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 fa1 biao3 le5 yi2 ge4 yan3 jiang3
cues.en: and he gave a talk.

cues.zh: 这题目呢叫数学问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ti2 mu4 ne5 jiao4 shu4 xue2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The title was "Mathematical Problems."

cues.zh: 在这个著名的演讲之中
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 zhu4 ming2 de5 yan3 jiang3 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: In this famous lecture,

cues.zh: 希尔伯特没有回顾前 100 年
cues.pinyin: xi1 er3 bo2 te4 mei2 you3 hui2 gu4 qian2 100 nian2
cues.en: Hilbert didn't look back at the previous hundred years

cues.zh: 数学史上有什么成就
cues.pinyin: shu4 xue2 shi3 shang4 you3 shen2 me5 cheng2 jiu4
cues.en: of achievements in the history of mathematics.

cues.zh: 他反而向后展望
cues.pinyin: ta1 fan3 er2 xiang4 hou4 zhan3 wang4
cues.en: Instead, he looked forward.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 数学公理化
cues.pinyin: shu4 xue2 gong1 li3 hua4
cues.en: The axiomatization of mathematics.

cues.zh: 什么是数学公理化呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 shu4 xue2 gong1 li3 hua4 ne5
cues.en: What is the axiomatization of mathematics?

cues.zh: 咱们学过初中几何的小朋友都知道
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xue2 guo4 chu1 zhong1 ji3 he2 de5 xiao3 peng2 you3 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Kids who've studied middle-school geometry all know

cues.zh: 这个我们的初中几何
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 de5 chu1 zhong1 ji3 he2
cues.en: that our middle-school geometry

cues.zh: 是从欧几里德的几何原本出发的
cues.pinyin: shi4 cong2 ou1 ji3 li3 de2 de5 ji3 he2 yuan2 ben3 chu1 fa1 de5
cues.en: starts from Euclid's "Elements."

cues.zh: 几何原本怎么做呀
cues.pinyin: ji3 he2 yuan2 ben3 zen3 me5 zuo4 ya5
cues.en: How does the "Elements" do it?

cues.zh: 首先呢提出一些基本概念
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ne5 ti2 chu1 yi1 xie1 ji1 ben3 gai4 nian4
cues.en: First, it introduces some basic concepts,

cues.zh: 比如说点线面
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 dian3 xian4 mian4
cues.en: like points, lines, and planes.

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 它对应着生活中的一些个物体的抽象
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 ying4 zhe5 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 de5 yi1 xie1 ge4 wu4 ti3 de5 chou1 xiang4
cues.en: These correspond to abstractions of objects in everyday life.

cues.zh: 然后呢又提出了一些公设
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5 you4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 xie1 gong1 she4
cues.en: Then it introduces some postulates,

cues.zh: 比如说这个以某一个点为原形
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 yi3 mou3 yi2 ge4 dian3 wei4 yuan2 xing2
cues.en: for example, with a point as the center

cues.zh: 某一个长度为半径
cues.pinyin: mou3 yi2 ge4 chang2 du4 wei4 ban4 jing4
cues.en: and a certain length as the radius,

cues.zh: 可以做一个圆
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 yuan2
cues.en: you can draw a circle.

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 所有直角都相等
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 zhi2 jiao3 dou1 xiang1 deng3
cues.en: All right angles are equal.

cues.zh: 过直线外一点
cues.pinyin: guo4 zhi2 xian4 wai4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Through a point outside a line,

cues.zh: 有些只有一条直线
cues.pinyin: you3 xie1 zhi3 you3 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: there is exactly one line

cues.zh: 合一直线平行等等
cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 zhi2 xian4 ping2 xing2 deng3 deng3
cues.en: parallel to that line, and so on.

cues.zh: 那么通过这些个概念
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 tong1 guo4 zhe4 xie1 ge4 gai4 nian4
cues.en: So, through these concepts,

cues.zh: 公设公理就推出了一大堆定理
cues.pinyin: gong1 she4 gong1 li3 jiu4 tui1 chu1 le5 yi1 da4 dui1 ding4 li3
cues.en: postulates and axioms lead to a whole bunch of theorems.

cues.zh: 是不是
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 这就是几何原本理的内容
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ji3 he2 yuan2 ben3 li3 de5 nei4 rong2
cues.en: That's the content of the "Elements."

cues.zh: 很多小朋友可能会觉得
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 jue2 de5
cues.en: A lot of kids might think

cues.zh: 这就是公理化的数学
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 gong1 li3 hua4 de5 shu4 xue2
cues.en: that this is already axiomatized mathematics.

cues.zh: 实际上啊
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 a5
cues.en: But actually,

cues.zh: 这种公理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 gong1 li3
cues.en: this kind of axiom —

cues.zh: 我们叫它什么呀
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiao4 ta1 shen2 me5 ya5
cues.en: what do we call it?

cues.zh: 我们叫它实质公理化
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiao4 ta1 shi2 zhi4 gong1 li3 hua4
cues.en: We call it "material axiomatization."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 啥意思呢
cues.pinyin: sha2 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does that mean?

cues.zh: 就比如说吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ba5
cues.en: For example,

cues.zh: 这个几何原本里边说点就是点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ji3 he2 yuan2 ben3 li3 bian1 shuo1 dian3 jiu4 shi4 dian3
cues.en: in the "Elements," a point is a point,

cues.zh: 线就是线
cues.pinyin: xian4 jiu4 shi4 xian4
cues.en: a line is a line.

cues.zh: 他绝对不能把这个点变成线
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 dui4 bu4 neng2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 dian3 bian4 cheng2 xian4
cues.en: You absolutely cannot turn a point into a line,

cues.zh: 或者把线变成点
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 ba3 xian4 bian4 cheng2 dian3
cues.en: or a line into a point.

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 但是呢在这个希尔伯特看来就不是这样的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ne5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 kan4 lai2 jiu4 bu2 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: But in Hilbert's view, that's not how it is.

cues.zh: 他说了他说点线面呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 le5 ta1 shuo1 dian3 xian4 mian4 ne5
cues.en: He said points, lines, and planes —

cues.zh: 咱们完全可以用桌子椅子和啤酒杯代替
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 wan2 quan2 ke3 yi3 yong4 zhuo1 zi5 yi3 zi5 he2 pi2 jiu3 bei1 dai4 ti4
cues.en: we could completely replace them with a table, a chair, and a beer mug.

cues.zh: 是吧你说的是什么都行
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 ni3 shuo1 de5 shi4 shen2 me5 dou1 xing2
cues.en: In other words, you can call it whatever you want.

cues.zh: 你最开始说一个概念的时候
cues.pinyin: ni3 zui4 kai1 shi3 shuo1 yi2 ge4 gai4 nian4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When you first state a concept,

cues.zh: 你不一定非要把它跟现实生活中的某些
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 yi2 ding4 fei1 yao4 ba3 ta1 gen1 xian4 shi2 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 de5 mou3 xie1
cues.en: you don't necessarily have to tie it

cues.zh: 东西对应起来
cues.pinyin: dong1 xi1 dui4 ying4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: to something in real life.

cues.zh: 它只是个概念是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 ge4 gai4 nian4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: It's just a concept, right?

cues.zh: 第二个公理是什么
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 gong1 li3 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What's the second axiom?

cues.zh: 公理啊它只是一个对应的规则
cues.pinyin: gong1 li3 a5 ta1 zhi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 dui4 ying4 de5 gui1 ze2
cues.en: An axiom is just a rule of correspondence.

cues.zh: 公理是规则
cues.pinyin: gong1 li3 shi4 gui1 ze2
cues.en: Axioms are rules.

cues.zh: 比如说吧
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ba5
cues.en: For example,

cues.zh: 说两点之间有一条直线
cues.pinyin: shuo1 liang3 dian3 zhi1 jian1 you3 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: "there's a line between two points" —

cues.zh: 那你完全可以把它对应成
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 wan2 quan2 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 dui4 ying4 cheng2
cues.en: you could just as well map that to

cues.zh: 两个桌子之间有一把椅子
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 zhuo1 zi5 zhi1 jian1 you3 yi1 ba3 yi3 zi5
cues.en: "there's a chair between two tables."

cues.zh: 是吧
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 就是你公理只是一种规则
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 gong1 li3 zhi3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 gui1 ze2
cues.en: An axiom is just a kind of rule;

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 它不一定要和现实中的某些东西对应起来
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 yi2 ding4 yao4 he2 xian4 shi2 zhong1 de5 mou3 xie1 dong1 xi1 dui4 ying4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: it doesn't have to correspond to something real.

cues.zh: 第三呢
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ne5
cues.en: Third,

cues.zh: 就是这些个公理之间要相容
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 xie1 ge4 gong1 li3 zhi1 jian1 yao4 xiang1 rong2
cues.en: these axioms have to be consistent with each other.

cues.zh: 什么叫相容呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 xiang1 rong2 ne5
cues.en: What does "consistent" mean?

cues.zh: 意思就是说
cues.pinyin: yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: It means

cues.zh: 你不能两个公理发生矛盾
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 neng2 liang3 ge4 gong1 li3 fa4 sheng1 mao2 dun4
cues.en: two axioms can't contradict each other.

cues.zh: 对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 第二呢叫独立
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ne5 jiao4 du2 li4
cues.en: Second is called "independence."

cues.zh: 意思就是说呢
cues.pinyin: yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ne5
cues.en: That means

cues.zh: 你不能说这个有一个公理
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 neng2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 you3 yi2 ge4 gong1 li3
cues.en: you can't have an axiom

cues.zh: 可以从其他公理推出来
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 cong2 qi2 ta1 gong1 li3 tui1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: that can be derived from the other axioms.

cues.zh: 第三呢就是要完备
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ne5 jiu4 shi4 yao4 wan2 bei4
cues.en: Third is "completeness."

cues.zh: 什么叫完备呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 wan2 bei4 ne5
cues.en: What does "completeness" mean?

cues.zh: 在希尔伯特当时的想法来看
cues.pinyin: zai4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 dang1 shi2 de5 xiang3 fa3 lai2 kan4
cues.en: In Hilbert's thinking at the time,

cues.zh: 他认为啊
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 a5
cues.en: he believed that

cues.zh: 就是我建立了一套公理体系之后
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 jian4 li4 le5 yi1 tao4 gong1 li3 ti3 xi4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: once you've built a system of axioms,

cues.zh: 任何一个命题
cues.pinyin: ren4 he2 yi2 ge4 ming4 ti2
cues.en: for any proposition,

cues.zh: 要么能够证明
cues.pinyin: yao4 me5 neng2 gou4 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: you should either be able to prove it

cues.zh: 要么能够证伪
cues.pinyin: yao4 me5 neng2 gou4 zheng4 wei3
cues.en: or disprove it.

cues.zh: 是被谁公理化的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bei4 shui2 gong1 li3 hua4 de5
cues.en: There shouldn't be a proposition

cues.zh: 既不能证明也不能证伪
cues.pinyin: ji4 bu4 neng2 zheng4 ming2 ye3 bu4 neng2 zheng4 wei3
cues.en: that can neither be proved nor disproved.

cues.zh: 好那希尔伯特认为啊
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 ren4 wei2 a5
cues.en: Now, Hilbert believed

cues.zh: 满足这样的数学理论
cues.pinyin: man3 zu2 zhe4 yang4 de5 shu4 xue2 li3 lun4
cues.en: that for a mathematical theory satisfying this,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清楚邓煜研究的“希尔伯特第六问题”

cues.zh: 我也可以造出一套自然性的系统来
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 ke3 yi3 zao4 chu1 yi1 tao4 zi4 ran2 xing4 de5 xi4 tong3 lai2
cues.en: I can also build a similarly axiomatic system.

cues.zh: 再比如说实数
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 shi2 shu4
cues.en: Take real numbers, for example —

cues.zh: 是被谁公里化的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bei4 shui2 gong1 li3 hua4 de5
cues.en: who axiomatized them?

cues.zh: 是被以前我们讲过的一个人
cues.pinyin: shi4 bei4 yi3 qian2 wo3 men5 jiang3 guo4 de5 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: It was someone we've talked about before,

cues.zh: 叫戴德金
cues.pinyin: jiao4 dai4 de2 jin1
cues.en: named Dedekind.

cues.zh: 戴德金
cues.pinyin: dai4 de2 jin1
cues.en: Dedekind.

cues.zh: 戴德金呢
cues.pinyin: dai4 de2 jin1 ne5
cues.en: Dedekind —

cues.zh: 他采用了一种什么戴德金分割呀等等
cues.pinyin: ta1 cai3 yong4 le5 yi1 zhong3 shen2 me5 dai4 de2 jin1 fen1 ge1 ya5 deng3 deng3
cues.en: he used something called a "Dedekind cut," and so on,

cues.zh: 他把这个实数给公里化了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shi2 shu4 gei3 gong1 li3 hua4 le5
cues.en: and he axiomatized the real numbers with it.

cues.zh: 那我们现在也管他叫
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ye3 guan3 ta1 jiao4
cues.en: So now we also call that

cues.zh: 这个分析的一个公里化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fen1 xi1 de5 yi2 ge4 gong1 li3 hua4
cues.en: the axiomatization of analysis —

cues.zh: 实数分析
cues.pinyin: shi2 shu4 fen1 xi1
cues.en: real analysis,

cues.zh: 就是公里化了等等吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 gong1 li3 hua4 le5 deng3 deng3 ba5
cues.en: that's axiomatization, and so on.

cues.zh: 反正在一系列数学家的努力下呢
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zai4 yi1 xi4 lie4 shu4 xue2 jia1 de5 nu3 li4 xia4 ne5
cues.en: Anyway, through the efforts of a whole line of mathematicians,

cues.zh: 很多数学问题就都被公理化了
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 shu4 xue2 wen4 ti2 jiu4 dou1 bei4 gong1 li3 hua4 le5
cues.en: many mathematical problems got axiomatized.

cues.zh: 于是希尔伯特呢就信心膨胀了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 ne5 jiu4 xin4 xin1 peng2 zhang4 le5
cues.en: So Hilbert's confidence swelled.

cues.zh: 他说你看啊
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 kan4 a5
cues.en: He said, "Look,

cues.zh: 既然数学可以公理化
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 shu4 xue2 ke3 yi3 gong1 li3 hua4
cues.en: since mathematics can be axiomatized,

cues.zh: 那物理能不能也公理化呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wu4 li3 neng2 bu4 neng2 ye3 gong1 li3 hua4 ne5
cues.en: can physics be axiomatized too?"

cues.zh: 也造出一个纯逻辑的物理理论
cues.pinyin: ye3 zao4 chu1 yi2 ge4 chun2 luo2 ji2 de5 wu4 li3 li3 lun4
cues.en: Build a purely logical physical theory

cues.zh: 它可以不对应现实中的一些问题
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 bu2 dui4 ying1 xian4 shi2 zhong1 de5 yi1 xie1 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that doesn't have to correspond to anything real.

cues.zh: 有人说你物理本身就是研究现实生活的
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 ni3 wu4 li3 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 yan2 jiu1 xian4 shi2 sheng1 huo2 de5
cues.en: Someone said, "But physics itself is the study of real life."

cues.zh: 能够跟家人相处

cues.en: to spend time with my family

cues.zh: 同时间还能做到我想要做的运动
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 jian1 hai2 neng2 zuo4 dao4 wo3 xiang3 yao4 zuo4 de5 yun4 dong4
cues.en: while also getting in the exercise I want to do—

cues.zh: 的一个蛮好的一个解决方案吧
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 ge4 man2 hao3 de5 yi2 ge4 jie3 jue2 fang1 an4 ba5
cues.en: a pretty good solution, I think.

cues.zh: 在过去这么多年的工作生活里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 guo4 qu4 zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 de5 gong1 zuo4 sheng1 huo2 li3 mian4
cues.en: Over all these years of work and life,

cues.zh: 有的时候其实不太记得
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 qi2 shi2 bu4 tai4 ji4 de5
cues.en: sometimes I honestly can't quite remember

cues.zh: 我有给自己的时间吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 gei3 zi4 ji3 de5 shi2 jian1 ba5
cues.en: whether I've given myself any time.

cues.zh: 我是妈妈
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: I'm a mom,

cues.zh: 我又是公司里面的老板
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 shi4 gong1 si1 li3 mian4 de5 lao3 ban3
cues.en: I'm also the boss at my company,

cues.zh: 我又是人家老婆
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 shi4 ren2 jia1 lao3 po2
cues.en: I'm also somebody's wife,

cues.zh: 我是人家女儿
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ren2 jia1 nv3 er2
cues.en: and I'm somebody's daughter.

cues.zh: 这么多的身份
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 duo1 de5 shen1 fen4
cues.en: So many identities,

cues.zh: 在一个人的身上
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 ren2 de5 shen1 shang4
cues.en: all carried by one person.

cues.zh: 很多时候没有时间去想自己
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 shi2 hou4 mei2 you3 shi2 jian1 qu4 xiang3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: A lot of the time there's no time left to think about myself.

cues.zh: 其实就在几个月前
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 zai4 ji3 ge4 yue4 qian2
cues.en: Actually, just a few months ago,

cues.zh: 我跟朋友一起去聊天的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 gen1 peng2 you3 yi4 qi3 qu4 liao2 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when I was out chatting with a friend,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 职场妈妈的「寻我启事」：我要把弄丢的自己找回来

cues.zh: 聊到了一些过去我很喜欢的一些乐团吧
cues.pinyin: liao2 dao4 le5 yi1 xie1 guo4 qu4 wo3 hen3 xi3 huan1 de5 yi1 xie1 yue4 tuan2 ba5
cues.en: we talked about some bands I used to really love.

cues.zh: 那个晚上我其实聊得非常非常开心
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 wan3 shang4 wo3 qi2 shi2 liao2 de2 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 kai1 xin1
cues.en: That night I had such a good time talking,

cues.zh: 然后开心到我对她有点陌生
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 kai1 xin1 dao4 wo3 dui4 ta1 you3 dian3 mo4 sheng1
cues.en: I was so happy that I almost felt like I didn't recognize myself.

cues.zh: 那个晚上其实我觉得特别特别难过
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 wan3 shang4 qi2 shi2 wo3 jue2 de5 te4 bie2 te4 bie2 nan2 guo4
cues.en: That night, actually, I also felt incredibly sad,

cues.zh: 然后大哭了一场
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 da4 ku1 le5 yi1 chang2
cues.en: and I ended up crying my eyes out.

cues.zh: 其实我很想念以前的那个 M ia
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 hen3 xiang3 nian4 yi3 qian2 de5 na4 ge5 M ia
cues.en: Honestly, I really miss the old Mia,

cues.zh: 但是我不知道她去哪里了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 qu4 na3 li3 le5
cues.en: but I don't know where she's gone.

cues.zh: 运动给我的感觉就是一种自我疗愈的过程
cues.pinyin: yun4 dong4 gei3 wo3 de5 gan3 jue2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 zi4 wo3 liao2 yu4 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: Exercise, to me, feels like a process of self-healing.

cues.zh: 在那个过程里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 li3 mian4
cues.en: In that process,

cues.zh: 它会让我所有的不开心压力沮丧
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 rang4 wo3 suo3 you3 de5 bu4 kai1 xin1 ya1 li4 ju3 sang4
cues.en: it lets all my unhappiness, stress, and frustration

cues.zh: 会跟著我的身体上的律动
cues.pinyin: hui4 gen1 zhu4 wo3 de5 shen1 ti3 shang4 de5 lv4 dong4
cues.en: move along with the rhythm of my body,

cues.zh: 或是汗水蒸发掉那种感觉
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 han4 shui3 zheng1 fa1 diao4 na4 zhong3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: or evaporate away with my sweat—that kind of feeling.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 职场妈妈的「寻我启事」：我要把弄丢的自己找回来

cues.zh: 如果每个人都能够很清楚地认识到自己
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei3 ge4 ren2 dou1 neng2 gou4 hen3 qing1 chu3 di4 ren4 shi2 dao4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: If everyone could clearly recognize

cues.zh: 最需要的空间跟时间
cues.pinyin: zui4 xu1 yao4 de5 kong1 jian1 gen1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: the space and time they need most,

cues.zh: 跟什么样的状态是让自己最舒服的
cues.pinyin: gen1 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 zhuang4 tai4 shi4 rang4 zi4 ji3 zui4 shu1 fu2 de5
cues.en: and what state makes them feel most comfortable,

cues.zh: 那我就会觉得这段 Be Time
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 hui4 jue2 de5 zhe4 duan4 Be Time
cues.en: then I'd feel that this 'me time'

cues.zh: 对每个人来说都非常非常重要
cues.pinyin: dui4 mei3 ge4 ren2 lai2 shuo1 dou1 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: is extremely, extremely important for everyone.

cues.zh: 一定要找到一个能够跟你自主的方式
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 yao4 zhao3 dao4 yi2 ge4 neng2 gou4 gen1 ni3 zi4 zhu3 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: You have to find a way that lets you take ownership of yourself,

cues.zh: 然后这个自主的方式
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 zi4 zhu3 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: and this way of taking ownership

cues.zh: 是让你自己最舒服的一个状态
cues.pinyin: shi4 rang4 ni3 zi4 ji3 zui4 shu1 fu2 de5 yi2 ge4 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: is the state that feels most comfortable to you.

cues.zh: 我还是很相信
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 shi4 hen3 xiang1 xin4
cues.en: I still firmly believe

cues.zh: 就是当你是一个最佳状态的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dang1 ni3 shi4 yi2 ge4 zui4 jia1 zhuang4 tai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that when you're in your best state,

cues.zh: 在他出来的光
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 chu1 lai2 de5 guang1
cues.en: the light you radiate

cues.zh: 是会输出到你身边的工作
cues.pinyin: shi4 hui4 shu1 chu1 dao4 ni3 shen1 bian1 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: will carry over into the work and people around you.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 泰式炒河粉做法 (Pad See Ew) 吃了都说赞！真的太好吃了！ 【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 你好各位美食家很荣幸又跟大家见面
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 mei3 shi2 jia1 hen3 rong2 xing4 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4
cues.en: Hello everyone, fellow food lovers, it's my pleasure to be with you again

cues.zh: 了我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: le5 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: I'm Cassie.

cues.zh: 小的时候呢我住在泰国许多年
cues.pinyin: xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5 wo3 zhu4 zai4 tai4 guo2 xu3 duo1 nian2
cues.en: When I was young, I lived in Thailand for many years

cues.zh: 所以脑子里呢常常有许多对泰
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 nao3 zi5 li3 ne5 chang2 chang2 you3 xu3 duo1 dui4 tai4
cues.en: So I often have a lot of memories about Thai

cues.zh: 国美食的回忆
cues.pinyin: guo2 mei3 shi2 de5 hui2 yi4
cues.en: food in my mind.

cues.zh: 今天要跟你分享的是泰式炒河粉 Pad See Ew
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 yao4 gen1 ni3 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 tai4 shi4 chao3 he2 fen3 Pad See Ew
cues.en: Today I'll share with you Thai stir-fried rice noodles, Pad See Ew

cues.zh: Pad See Ew 呢它是一道非常受欢迎的泰式美食
cues.pinyin: Pad See Ew ne5 ta1 shi4 yi1 dao4 fei1 chang2 shou4 huan1 ying2 de5 tai4 shi4 mei3 shi2
cues.en: Pad See Ew is a very popular Thai dish

cues.zh: 在泰国的大街小巷里都看得到它的踪影
cues.pinyin: zai4 tai4 guo2 de5 da4 jie1 xiao3 xiang4 li3 dou1 kan4 de2 dao4 ta1 de5 zong1 ying3
cues.en: You can find it everywhere on the streets of Thailand

cues.zh: 我们来看一看它的做法
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 yi1 kan4 ta1 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Let's take a look at how to make it

cues.zh: 首先呢我们来腌我们的鸡肉
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ne5 wo3 men5 lai2 yan1 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: First, let's marinate our chicken

cues.zh: 在这个鸡肉里面呢我们放入
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 li3 mian4 ne5 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4
cues.en: Into the chicken, we add

cues.zh: 鸡山鲜酱油精
cues.pinyin: ji1 shan1 xian1 jiang4 you2 jing1
cues.en: chicken bouillon powder and light soy sauce

cues.zh: 老抽
cues.pinyin: lao3 chou1
cues.en: dark soy sauce

cues.zh: 蛋白
cues.pinyin: dan4 bai2
cues.en: egg white

cues.zh: 玉米粉浆
cues.pinyin: yu4 mi3 fen3 jiang1
cues.en: cornstarch slurry

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 泰式炒河粉做法 (Pad See Ew) 吃了都说赞！真的太好吃了！ 【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 蛋白还有我们的玉米粉浆呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 bai2 hai2 you3 wo3 men5 de5 yu4 mi3 fen3 jiang1 ne5
cues.en: The egg white and our cornstarch slurry

cues.zh: 会使我们的鸡肉更滑嫩
cues.pinyin: hui4 shi3 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 rou4 geng4 hua2 nen4
cues.en: will make our chicken more tender and smooth

cues.zh: 好我们给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Okay, let's mix it a bit

cues.zh: 我们再放入清淡橄榄油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 ru4 qing1 dan4 gan3 lan3 you2
cues.en: Then we add some light olive oil

cues.zh: 你也可以使用其他的食用油
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 qi2 ta1 de5 shi2 yong4 you2
cues.en: You can also use other cooking oils

cues.zh: 油的作用呢是可以防止鸡肉
cues.pinyin: you2 de5 zuo4 yong4 ne5 shi4 ke3 yi3 fang2 zhi3 ji1 rou4
cues.en: The oil's purpose is to prevent the chicken

cues.zh: 等下再炒的时候不粘在一起
cues.pinyin: deng3 xia4 zai4 chao3 de5 shi2 hou4 bu4 zhan1 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: from sticking together later when we stir-fry it

cues.zh: 腌制 20 分钟
cues.pinyin: yan1 zhi4 20 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Marinate for 20 minutes

cues.zh: 我们今天买到的这个河粉呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 mai3 dao4 de5 zhe4 ge5 he2 fen3 ne5
cues.en: The rice noodles we bought today

cues.zh: 是有冷藏过
cues.pinyin: shi4 you3 leng3 cang2 guo4
cues.en: have been refrigerated

cues.zh: 所以比较硬
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bi3 jiao4 ying4
cues.en: so they're a bit stiff

cues.zh: 要把它分开呢
cues.pinyin: yao4 ba3 ta1 fen1 kai1 ne5
cues.en: To separate them

cues.zh: 首先需要先软化它
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 xu1 yao4 xian1 ruan3 hua4 ta1
cues.en: we first need to soften them

cues.zh: 那做法就是可以放在微波炉里
cues.pinyin: na4 zuo4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 ke3 yi3 fang4 zai4 wei1 bo1 lu2 li3
cues.en: The way to do that is to put them in the microwave

cues.zh: 给它热 3 分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 re4 3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: and heat them for 3 minutes

cues.zh: 软化了之后呢
cues.pinyin: ruan3 hua4 le5 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After they've softened

cues.zh: 它就很容易打开了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hen3 rong2 yi4 da3 kai1 le5
cues.en: they'll be very easy to separate

cues.zh: 这个时候呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: At this point

cues.zh: 我们再给它切成 1 英寸的大小
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 gei3 ta1 qie4 cheng2 1 ying1 cun4 de5 da4 xiao3
cues.en: we cut them into 1-inch pieces

cues.zh: 每一个河粉呢
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 he2 fen3 ne5
cues.en: Each piece of rice noodle

cues.zh: 给它用手分开
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 yong4 shou3 fen1 kai1
cues.en: we separate by hand

cues.zh: 老抽
cues.pinyin: lao3 chou1
cues.en: dark soy sauce

cues.zh: 蚝油
cues.pinyin: hao2 you2
cues.en: oyster sauce

cues.zh: 鱼露
cues.pinyin: yu2 lu4
cues.en: fish sauce

cues.zh: 还有糖
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 tang2
cues.en: and sugar

cues.zh: 给它搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: mix it together

cues.zh: 在一个铁锅里我们开大火
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 tie3 guo1 li3 wo3 men5 kai1 da4 huo3
cues.en: In a wok, we turn the heat to high

cues.zh: 然后给它烧到冒烟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 shao1 dao4 mao4 yan1
cues.en: and heat it until it smokes

cues.zh: 加入两汤匙清淡橄榄油
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 liang3 tang1 chi2 qing1 dan4 gan3 lan3 you2
cues.en: add two tablespoons of light olive oil

cues.zh: 铁锅想要不粘锅的话呢
cues.pinyin: tie3 guo1 xiang3 yao4 bu4 nian2 guo1 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If you want the wok to not stick

cues.zh: 要用热锅凉油
cues.pinyin: yao4 yong4 re4 guo1 liang2 you2
cues.en: you should use the "hot pan, cold oil" technique

cues.zh: 也叫做猛火煸油
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiao4 zuo4 meng3 huo3 bian1 you2
cues.en: also called high-heat quick oil searing

cues.zh: 我们把鸡肉给它炒到熟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ji1 rou4 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 shu2
cues.en: We stir-fry the chicken until cooked

cues.zh: 大概是三分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 san1 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: about 3 minutes

cues.zh: 拿出来之后先给它放旁边
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 xian1 gei3 ta1 fang4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: Take it out and set it aside

cues.zh: 同一个锅里继续开大火
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi1 ge4 guo1 li3 ji4 xu4 kai1 da4 huo3
cues.en: In the same pan, keep the heat on high

cues.zh: 然后给它烧到冒烟
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 shao1 dao4 mao4 yan1
cues.en: and heat it until it smokes

cues.zh: 加入两汤匙清淡橄榄油
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 liang3 tang1 chi2 qing1 dan4 gan3 lan3 you2
cues.en: add two tablespoons of light olive oil

cues.zh: 你也可以使用其他高烟点的食用油
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 qi2 ta1 gao1 yan1 dian3 de5 shi2 yong4 you2
cues.en: You can also use other high smoke-point cooking oils

cues.zh: 这个时候我们放进来两颗蛋
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 ke1 dan4
cues.en: At this point we add two eggs

cues.zh: 给它炒到熟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 shu2
cues.en: and stir-fry until cooked

cues.zh: 然后给它放到旁边去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 fang4 dao4 pang2 bian1 qu4
cues.en: then set it aside

cues.zh: 我们再放入蒜
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 ru4 suan4
cues.en: We then add garlic

cues.zh: 给它爆香一下
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 bao4 xiang1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and sauté until fragrant

cues.zh: 20 秒钟
cues.pinyin: 20 miao3 zhong1
cues.en: for 20 seconds

cues.zh: 这时候呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: At this point

cues.zh: 我们再放入芥兰
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 ru4 jie4 lan2
cues.en: we add Chinese broccoli (kai-lan)

cues.zh: 再给它炒到香
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: and stir-fry until fragrant

cues.zh: 大概是 30 秒钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 30 miao3 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: for about 30 seconds

items.title_zh: 泰式炒河粉做法 (Pad See Ew) 吃了都说赞！真的太好吃了！ 【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 我们放入我们的和粉
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 wo3 men5 de5 he2 fen3
cues.en: We add our rice noodles

cues.zh: 再放回我们的鸡肉
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 hui2 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: then put the chicken back in

cues.zh: 放入我们刚刚调好的酱汁
cues.pinyin: fang4 ru4 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 diao4 hao3 de5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: add the sauce we just mixed

cues.zh: 然后给它炒啊炒啊
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 chao3 a5 chao3 a5
cues.en: and keep stir-frying

cues.zh: 直到炒到香
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 chao3 dao4 xiang1
cues.en: until it's fragrant

cues.zh: 大概是 2 到 3 分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 2 dao4 3 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: about 2 to 3 minutes

cues.zh: 十分怀念这个味道
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 huai2 nian4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: I really miss this flavor

cues.zh: 非常的道理

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】中国数学家王虹、邓煜获得菲尔兹奖！一个视频告诉你王虹研究的挂谷猜想是什么

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Li Yongle laoshi.

cues.zh: 在刚刚开幕的 20 26 国际数学家大会上
cues.pinyin: zai4 gang1 gang1 kai1 mu4 de5 20 26 guo2 ji4 shu4 xue2 jia1 da4 hui4 shang4
cues.en: At the International Congress of Mathematicians that just opened in 2026,

cues.zh: 数学界的最高奖菲尔兹奖终于揭晓了
cues.pinyin: shu4 xue2 jie4 de5 zui4 gao1 jiang3 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3 zhong1 yu2 jie1 xiao3 le5
cues.en: the Fields Medal, math's highest honor, has finally been announced.

cues.zh: 北大毕业的青年数学家王虹和
cues.pinyin: bei3 da4 bi4 ye4 de5 qing1 nian2 shu4 xue2 jia1 wang2 hong2 he2
cues.en: Young mathematician Wang Hong, a Peking University graduate, and

cues.zh: 邓煜双双获奖
cues.pinyin: deng4 yu4 shuang1 shuang1 huo4 jiang3
cues.en: Deng Yu both won the award.

cues.zh: 这是中国数学家在菲尔兹奖上零的突破
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 shu4 xue2 jia1 zai4 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3 shang4 ling2 de5 tu1 po4
cues.en: This marks China's first-ever Fields Medal breakthrough.

cues.zh: 要知道菲尔兹奖每四年颁发一次
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3 mei3 si4 nian2 ban1 fa1 yi1 ci4
cues.en: You should know the Fields Medal is only awarded once every four years,

cues.zh: 而且只颁发给 40 岁以下的青年数学家
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhi3 ban1 fa1 gei3 40 sui4 yi3 xia4 de5 qing1 nian2 shu4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: and only to mathematicians under the age of 40.

cues.zh: 证明费马大定理的英国数学家怀尔斯
cues.pinyin: zheng4 ming2 fei4 ma3 da4 ding4 li3 de5 ying1 guo2 shu4 xue2 jia1 huai2 er3 si1
cues.en: Andrew Wiles, the British mathematician who proved Fermat's Last Theorem,

cues.zh: 因为年龄超了一岁都没有得到正
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 nian2 ling2 chao1 le5 yi1 sui4 dou1 mei2 you3 de2 dao4 zheng4
cues.en: missed out on an official Fields Medal just because he was one year too old—

cues.zh: 式的菲尔兹奖
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5 fei1 er3 zi1 jiang3
cues.en: an official Fields Medal.

cues.zh: 王虹研究的是挂谷猜想
cues.pinyin: wang2 hong2 yan2 jiu1 de5 shi4 gua4 gu3 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: Wang Hong's research is on the Kakeya conjecture,

cues.zh: 邓煜研究的是希尔伯特第六问题
cues.pinyin: deng4 yu4 yan2 jiu1 de5 shi4 xi1 er3 bo2 te4 di4 liu4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: while Deng Yu's research is on Hilbert's sixth problem.

cues.zh: 许多小朋友给我发来私信问
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4 wen4
cues.en: Many young viewers have sent me messages asking,

cues.zh: 挂谷猜想到底是什么呢
cues.pinyin: gua4 gu3 cai1 xiang3 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: what exactly is the Kakeya conjecture?

cues.zh: 这个问题理解起来比较复杂
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 li3 jie3 qi3 lai2 bi3 jiao4 fu4 za2
cues.en: This question is fairly complex to understand,

cues.zh: 让我们从挂谷问题说起吧
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 men5 cong2 gua4 gu3 wen4 ti2 shuo1 qi3 ba5
cues.en: so let's start with the Kakeya problem.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来说一说什么是挂谷问题
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 shen2 me5 shi4 gua4 gu3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: First, let's talk about what the Kakeya problem is.

cues.zh: 挂谷问题
cues.pinyin: gua4 gu3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: The Kakeya problem.

cues.zh: 什么是一个好的数学问题呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 de5 shu4 xue2 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: What makes a good math problem?

cues.zh: 一个好的数学问题应该吸引很多人去研究
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 hao3 de5 shu4 xue2 wen4 ti2 ying1 gai1 xi1 yin3 hen3 duo1 ren2 qu4 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: A good math problem should attract many people to study it,

cues.zh: 从而创造出新的方法新的理论
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 chuang4 zao4 chu1 xin1 de5 fang1 fa3 xin1 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: thereby creating new methods and new theories,

cues.zh: 甚至能够开拓出全新的领域
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 neng2 gou4 kai1 tuo4 chu1 quan2 xin1 de5 ling3 yu4
cues.en: and even open up entirely new fields.

cues.zh: 而且这个问题最好是描述起来非
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 zui4 hao3 shi4 miao2 shu4 qi3 lai2 fei1
cues.en: Also, ideally the problem should be described

cues.zh: 常非常的简单
cues.pinyin: chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: very, very simply,

cues.zh: 但是解决起来却异常的困难
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jie3 jue2 qi3 lai2 que4 yi4 chang2 de5 kun4 nan2
cues.en: yet be extraordinarily difficult to solve.

cues.zh: 比如说费马大定理就是一个好的数学问题

cues.en: For example, Fermat's Last Theorem is a good math problem,

cues.pinyin: er2 gua4 gu3 wen4 ti2 shi4 he2 fei4 ma3 da4 ding4 li3 fei1
cues.en: and the Kakeya problem is very, very

cues.zh: 常非常类似的
cues.pinyin: chang2 fei1 chang2 lei4 si4 de5
cues.en: similar to Fermat's Last Theorem.

cues.zh: 这个问题是 1917 年日本数学家挂谷
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 shi4 1917 nian2 ri4 ben3 shu4 xue2 jia1 gua4 gu3
cues.en: This problem was proposed in 1917 by the Japanese mathematician Kakeya

cues.zh: 谷宗一提出的
cues.pinyin: gu3 zong1 yi1 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: Sōichi.

cues.zh: 他说有一位武士在上厕所的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 you3 yi1 wei4 wu3 shi4 zai4 shang4 ce4 suo3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: He said there was a samurai who, while using the outhouse,

cues.en: was attacked by enemies raining down sword strikes.

cues.zh: 而他只有一根短棒

cues.en: But he only had a short stick.

cues.en: To block the attacks,

cues.zh: 他需要将这根棒旋转一周
cues.pinyin: ta1 xu1 yao4 jiang1 zhe4 gen1 bang4 xuan2 zhuan3 yi1 zhou1
cues.en: he needed to rotate the stick through a full turn,

cues.en: But the outhouse was very small,

cues.zh: 因此在转动短棒的时候
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 zai4 zhuan3 dong4 duan3 bang4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: so while rotating the stick,

cues.zh: 你的面积就是这个半圆的面积
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 mian4 ji1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ban4 yuan2 de5 mian4 ji1

cues.zh: 半圆面积是 1 2 r
cues.pinyin: ban4 yuan2 mian4 ji1 shi4 1 2 r
cues.en: The semicircle's area is (1/2)πr².

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 r jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 duan3 bang4 de5 chang2 du4

cues.pinyin: ni3 xian1 rang4 zhe4 ge5 bang4 shun4 zhe5 AB de5 fang1 xiang4 fang4

cues.zh: 可能是 19 20 年左右
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 19 20 nian2 zuo3 you4
cues.en: It was probably around 2019 or 2020.

cues.zh: 我看到很多杀猪盘的新闻
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 hen3 duo1 sha1 zhu1 pan2 de5 xin1 wen2
cues.en: I saw a lot of news about 'pig-butchering' scams.

cues.zh: 挑一个
cues.pinyin: tiao1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Pick one.

cues.zh: 下面有很多的评论
cues.pinyin: xia4 mian4 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 ping2 lun4
cues.en: There were a lot of comments underneath.

cues.zh: 说这些被骗的女性一定是很愚蠢的
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 xie1 bei4 pian4 de5 nv3 xing4 yi2 ding4 shi4 hen3 yu2 chun3 de5
cues.en: Saying that these women who got scammed must be really stupid.

cues.zh: 恋爱脑
cues.pinyin: lian4 ai4 nao3
cues.en: Being 'blinded by love.'

cues.zh: 好笑
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiao4
cues.en: Funny.

cues.zh: 其实对人有一种非常羞辱性的打击
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 dui4 ren2 you3 yi1 zhong3 fei1 chang2 xiu1 ru3 xing4 de5 da3 ji1
cues.en: But it's actually a deeply humiliating blow to a person.

cues.zh: 我就希望拍一个电影
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xi1 wang4 pai1 yi2 ge4 dian4 ying3
cues.en: So I wanted to make a film.

cues.zh: 不是为了给女性上一课
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 wei4 le5 gei3 nv3 xing4 shang4 yi1 ke4
cues.en: Not to lecture women,

cues.zh: 只是展示了一个女性的遭遇
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 zhan3 shi4 le5 yi2 ge4 nv3 xing4 de5 zao1 yu4
cues.en: but just to show what a woman went through,

cues.zh: 以及她重建自己的过程
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 ta1 chong2 jian4 zi4 ji3 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: and the process of her rebuilding herself.

cues.zh: 那个人一天没有为自己的所作
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 yi1 tian1 mei2 you3 wei4 zi4 ji3 de5 suo3 zuo4
cues.en: As long as that person hasn't

cues.zh: 所为付出代价
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 fu4 chu1 dai4 jia4
cues.en: paid for what he did,

cues.zh: 我就一天睡不好觉了
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 yi1 tian1 shui4 bu4 hao3 jue2 le5
cues.en: I won't sleep well for a single day.

cues.zh: 我不找临时工
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhao3 lin2 shi2 gong1
cues.en: I don't hire temp workers for this.

cues.zh: 我欠了一笔钱
cues.pinyin: wo3 qian4 le5 yi1 bi3 qian2
cues.en: I owe a debt.

cues.zh: 不一定你最快乐的时候给你一刀
cues.pinyin: bu4 yi2 ding4 ni3 zui4 kuai4 le4 de5 shi2 hou4 gei3 ni3 yi1 dao1
cues.en: Maybe I'll stab you right when you're happiest.

cues.zh: 你跑不了了
cues.pinyin: ni3 pao3 bu4 liao3 le5
cues.en: You can't run away now.

cues.zh: 邓宇是一个看起来瘦瘦的女孩
cues.pinyin: deng4 yu3 shi4 yi2 ge4 kan4 qi3 lai2 shou4 shou4 de5 nv3 hai2
cues.en: Deng Yu looks like a thin, slight girl.

cues.zh: 但是她非常有力量很锋利
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 fei1 chang2 you3 li4 liang4 hen3 feng1 li4
cues.en: But she's incredibly strong and sharp.

cues.zh: 张瑜老师我们对她的造型的定义
cues.pinyin: zhang1 yu2 lao3 shi1 wo3 men5 dui4 ta1 de5 zao4 xing2 de5 ding4 yi4
cues.en: Teacher Zhang Yu — the way we defined her look

cues.zh: 就是斯文败类
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 si1 wen2 bai4 lei4
cues.en: was 'a wolf in sheep's clothing.'

cues.zh: 他之前的角色很多是比较内敛的猛撞的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 qian2 de5 jue2 se4 hen3 duo1 shi4 bi3 jiao4 nei4 lian3 de5 meng3 zhuang4 de5
cues.en: Many of his previous roles were more restrained and brash.

cues.zh: 但林志光是一个非常善于应用语言去操
cues.pinyin: dan4 lin2 zhi4 guang1 shi4 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 shan4 yu2 ying4 yong4 yu3 yan2 qu4 cao1
cues.en: But Lin Zhiguang plays a character very skilled at using language to

cues.zh: 纵别人的角色
cues.pinyin: zong4 bie2 ren2 de5 jue2 se4
cues.en: manipulate other people.

cues.zh: 这个声音就能让你有很多的想像
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 sheng1 yin1 jiu4 neng2 rang4 ni3 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 xiang3 xiang4
cues.en: Just that voice alone gives you so much to imagine.

cues.zh: 宝贝我爱你
cues.pinyin: bao3 bei4 wo3 ai4 ni3
cues.en: Baby, I love you.

cues.zh: 我们是具体在一个叫东山的地方拍的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi4 ju4 ti3 zai4 yi2 ge4 jiao4 dong1 shan1 de5 di4 fang1 pai1 de5
cues.en: We actually filmed it in a place called Dongshan.

cues.zh: 经常有很多雾
cues.pinyin: jing1 chang2 you3 hen3 duo1 wu4
cues.en: It's often very foggy there.

cues.zh: 尤其是上山下海的这些戏得到身边
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 shang4 shan1 xia4 hai3 de5 zhe4 xie1 xi4 de2 dao4 shen1 bian1
cues.en: Especially for the scenes climbing mountains and diving into the sea, we got

cues.zh: 很多人的帮助
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 de5 bang1 zhu4
cues.en: a lot of people's help.

cues.zh: 我在拍摄的过程中至少有两次
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 pai1 she4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 zhi4 shao3 you3 liang3 ci4
cues.en: During filming, there were at least two times

cues.zh: 我觉得我今天有可能会死在这个地方
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 jin1 tian1 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 si3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1
cues.en: when I thought I might actually die there that day.

cues.zh: 因为你旁边就是悬崖嘛
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 pang2 bian1 jiu4 shi4 xuan2 ya2 ma5
cues.en: Because right beside you was a cliff.

cues.zh: 当然我的制片主做了非常好的工作
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 wo3 de5 zhi4 pian4 zhu3 zuo4 le5 fei1 chang2 hao3 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: Of course, our producer did an excellent job.

cues.zh: 他们确保我不会掉下去
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 que4 bao3 wo3 bu2 hui4 diao4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: They made sure I wouldn't fall.

cues.zh: 但是我觉得拍电影的人都是有点疯的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 jue2 de5 pai1 dian4 ying3 de5 ren2 dou1 shi4 you3 dian3 feng1 de5
cues.en: But I think everyone who makes films is a little crazy.

cues.zh: 你到了那个情境下
cues.pinyin: ni3 dao4 le5 na4 ge5 qing2 jing4 xia4
cues.en: Once you're in that situation,

cues.zh: 你没有什么别的想法
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 bie2 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: you don't have any other thoughts,

cues.zh: 你就是觉得我要去我要拍
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 shi4 jue2 de5 wo3 yao4 qu4 wo3 yao4 pai1
cues.en: you just feel like I have to go, I have to shoot this.

cues.zh: 我今天在这里
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 tian1 zai4 zhe4 li3
cues.en: Being here today

cues.zh: 至少是一个可能性
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 shi4 yi2 ge4 ke3 neng2 xing4
cues.en: is at least one possibility —

cues.zh: 行动上不变的人
cues.pinyin: xing2 dong4 shang4 bu4 bian4 de5 ren2
cues.en: a person who stays consistent in action

cues.zh: 你有可能可以做到一些事情
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 ke3 neng2 ke3 yi3 zuo4 dao4 yi1 xie1 shi4 qing2
cues.en: might actually be able to accomplish something.

cues.zh: 大家都会想要问我一个问题
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 du1 hui4 xiang3 yao4 wen4 wo3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Everyone always wants to ask me one question.

cues.zh: 就是被害者有什么共性
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bei4 hai4 zhe3 you3 shen2 me5 gong4 xing4
cues.en: What do victims have in common?

cues.zh: 我认为恰恰是没有
cues.pinyin: wo3 ren4 wei2 qia4 qia4 shi4 mei2 you3
cues.en: I think the answer is: nothing.

cues.zh: 任何人男性女性
cues.pinyin: ren4 he2 ren2 nan2 xing4 nv3 xing4
cues.en: Anyone — man or woman —

cues.zh: 他只要在人生低谷的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yao4 zai4 ren2 sheng1 di1 gu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: as long as they're at a low point in life,

cues.zh: 都是容易被骗的时候

cues.en: Today, information leaks are extremely serious.

cues.en: They already know a lot about your situation

cues.zh: 有非常深入的了解了
cues.pinyin: you3 fei1 chang2 shen1 ru4 de5 liao3 jie3 le5
cues.en: in great depth.

cues.zh: 他们还会有不同的角色之间的配合
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 hui4 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 jue2 se4 zhi1 jian1 de5 pei4 he2
cues.en: They also coordinate between different roles/personas.

cues.zh: 在情感诈骗当中
cues.pinyin: zai4 qing2 gan3 zha4 pian4 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: In romance scams,

cues.zh: 女性受害者是比较高的
cues.pinyin: nv3 xing4 shou4 hai4 zhe3 shi4 bi3 jiao4 gao1 de5
cues.en: the proportion of female victims is relatively high.

cues.zh: 我也认为女性更珍视情感这件事情
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 ren4 wei2 nv3 xing4 geng4 zhen1 shi4 qing2 gan3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 qing2
cues.en: I also think women value emotional connection more,

cues.zh: 或者更愿意付出信任这个事情
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 geng4 yuan4 yi4 fu4 chu1 xin4 ren4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: or are more willing to give their trust —

cues.zh: 是没有错的
cues.pinyin: shi4 mei2 you3 cuo4 de5
cues.en: and that's not wrong.

cues.zh: 错的是利用情感
cues.pinyin: cuo4 de5 shi4 li4 yong4 qing2 gan3
cues.en: What's wrong is the person who exploits emotion

cues.zh: 利用信任去磨取利益的人
cues.pinyin: li4 yong4 xin4 ren4 qu4 mo2 qu3 li4 yi4 de5 ren2
cues.en: and uses trust to extract benefit from others.

cues.zh: 哈喽你好各位美食家

cues.zh: 各位爱做饭的人们

cues.en: Come into my kitchen,

cues.zh: 跟我一起探索亚洲家庭菜的无穷美味

cues.en: Explore the endless deliciousness of Asian home cooking with me,

cues.zh: 赶快一起动手做
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 yi4 qi3 dong4 shou3 zuo4
cues.en: And let's get cooking right away!

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 「入口即化」的日式叉烧 |【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 日式叉烧是拉面的一种配料
cues.pinyin: ri4 shi4 cha1 shao1 shi4 la1 mian4 de5 yi1 zhong3 pei4 liao4
cues.en: Japanese chashu is a topping for ramen.

cues.zh: 首先将五花肉卷起来
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 jiang1 wu3 hua1 rou4 juan3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: First, roll up the pork belly.

cues.zh: 然后慢慢的炖到入口即化
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 man4 man4 de5 dun4 dao4 ru4 kou3 ji2 hua4
cues.en: Then slowly braise it until it melts in your mouth.

cues.zh: 十分的多汁而入味
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 de5 duo1 zhi1 er2 ru4 wei4
cues.en: It's very juicy and flavorful.

cues.zh: 日式叉烧是我最喜欢拉面上面的配料
cues.pinyin: ri4 shi4 cha1 shao1 shi4 wo3 zui4 xi3 huan1 la1 mian4 shang4 mian4 de5 pei4 liao4
cues.en: Japanese chashu is my favorite ramen topping.

cues.zh: 可是每次去外面吃它都只给你一两片
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei3 ci4 qu4 wai4 mian4 chi1 ta1 dou1 zhi3 gei3 ni3 yi1 liang3 pian4
cues.en: But whenever I eat it out, they only give you one or two slices.

cues.zh: 我怎么吃都吃得不过瘾
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 chi1 dou1 chi1 de2 bu4 guo4 yin3
cues.en: No matter how much I eat, it's never enough to satisfy me.

cues.zh: 所以今天呢自己在家里动手做
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 ne5 zi4 ji3 zai4 jia1 li3 dong4 shou3 zuo4
cues.en: So today I'm making it myself at home.

cues.zh: 想吃多少就吃多少
cues.pinyin: xiang3 chi1 duo1 shao3 jiu4 chi1 duo1 shao3
cues.en: Eat as much as you want.

cues.zh: 我们将五花肉卷成一个圆柱形皮朝外
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiang1 wu3 hua1 rou4 juan3 cheng2 yi2 ge4 yuan2 zhu4 xing2 pi2 chao2 wai4
cues.en: We roll the pork belly into a cylinder shape with the skin facing out.

cues.zh: 接下来我们用麻线把这个五花肉绑起来
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 yong4 ma2 xian4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 wu3 hua1 rou4 bang3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Next we tie up the pork belly with kitchen twine.

cues.zh: 先绑中间
cues.pinyin: xian1 bang3 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: First tie the middle.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 「入口即化」的日式叉烧 |【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 然后再绑到另外一个边
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 bang3 dao4 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 bian1
cues.en: Then tie it to the other side.

cues.zh: 然后再回到中间
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 hui2 dao4 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: Then come back to the middle.

cues.zh: 再打一个结
cues.pinyin: zai4 da3 yi2 ge4 jie2
cues.en: Then tie another knot.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 「入口即化」的日式叉烧 |【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 绑的时候呢
cues.pinyin: bang3 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When tying it,

cues.zh: 确保它要很扎实就好
cues.pinyin: que4 bao3 ta1 yao4 hen3 zha1 shi2 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: just make sure it's nice and firm.

cues.zh: 好现在在一个煎锅里呢
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 zai4 yi2 ge4 jian1 guo1 li3 ne5
cues.en: Okay, now in a frying pan,

cues.zh: 我们放进来两汤匙植物油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 tang1 chi2 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: we add two tablespoons of vegetable oil.

cues.zh: 放进五花肉
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 wu3 hua1 rou4
cues.en: Put in the pork belly.

cues.zh: 每一个边呢我们都用中火给它煎
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 bian1 ne5 wo3 men5 dou1 yong4 zhong1 huo3 gei3 ta1 jian1
cues.en: We fry each side over medium heat

cues.zh: 到金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: dao4 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: until golden brown.

cues.zh: 大概两分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 liang3 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: About two minutes.

cues.zh: 然后转然后继续煎
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhuan3 ran2 hou4 ji4 xu4 jian1
cues.en: Then turn it and keep frying.

cues.zh: 全部的煎的时间呢大概是 12 分钟
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 de5 jian1 de5 shi2 jian1 ne5 da4 gai4 shi4 12 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: The total frying time is about 12 minutes.

cues.zh: 好现在我们准备一下这个铝箔纸下盖
cues.pinyin: hao3 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 zhun3 bei4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 lv3 bo2 zhi3 xia4 gai4
cues.en: Okay, now let's prepare this foil drop-lid.
