cues.zh: 首先这是铝箔纸先拿一张
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhe4 shi4 lv3 bo2 zhi3 xian1 na2 yi1 zhang1
cues.en: First, here's the aluminum foil, take one sheet.

cues.zh: 可以盖住你的锅子的大小的这样子一块
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 gai4 zhu4 ni3 de5 guo1 zi5 de5 da4 xiao3 de5 zhe4 yang4 zi5 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: A piece big enough to cover your pot.

cues.zh: 把旁边的这个周围呢
cues.pinyin: ba3 pang2 bian1 de5 zhe4 ge5 zhou1 wei2 ne5
cues.en: Then around the edges,

cues.zh: 都折叠成圆形
cues.pinyin: dou1 zhe2 die2 cheng2 yuan2 xing2
cues.en: fold it into a circle.

cues.zh: 就是圆的这样子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yuan2 de5 zhe4 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Just like this, round.

cues.zh: 然后拿一双
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na2 yi1 shuang1
cues.en: Then take a pair...

cues.zh: 拿一只筷子就好
cues.pinyin: na2 yi1 zhi1 kuai4 zi5 jiu4 hao3
cues.en: just take one chopstick.

cues.zh: 在中间呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhong1 jian1 ne5
cues.en: In the middle,

cues.zh: 给它这样子搓搓搓
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 zhe4 yang4 zi5 cuo1 cuo1 cuo1
cues.en: poke it through like this, poke, poke, poke.

cues.zh: 搓大概五个孔
cues.pinyin: cuo1 da4 gai4 wu3 ge4 kong3
cues.en: Poke about five holes.

cues.zh: 如果稍微戳破一点也没有关系啦
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shao1 wei1 chuo1 po4 yi4 dian3 ye3 mei2 you3 guan1 xi4 la5
cues.en: If you accidentally poke it a bit too much, that's fine too.

cues.zh: 在一个锅中呢
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 zhong1 ne5
cues.en: In a pot,

cues.zh: 我们倒进来水
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 dao4 jin4 lai2 shui3
cues.en: we pour in water.

cues.zh: 酱油
cues.pinyin: jiang4 you2
cues.en: Soy sauce.

cues.zh: 味醂
cues.pinyin: wei4 lan3
cues.en: Mirin.

cues.zh: 清酒
cues.pinyin: qing1 jiu3
cues.en: Sake.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 「入口即化」的日式叉烧 |【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 然后把五花肉也放进来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 wu3 hua1 rou4 ye3 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Then add the pork belly in too.

cues.zh: 也是给它煮到滚
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 zhu3 dao4 gun3
cues.en: Bring it to a boil as well.

cues.zh: 然后放进我们刚刚做好的铝箔纸下盖
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 jin4 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 zuo4 hao3 de5 lv3 bo2 zhi3 xia4 gai4
cues.en: Then put in the foil drop-lid we just made.

cues.zh: 这个可以帮助防止蒸气出来的太快
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ke3 yi3 bang1 zhu4 fang2 zhi3 zheng1 qi4 chu1 lai2 de5 tai4 kuai4
cues.en: This helps prevent the steam from escaping too quickly.

cues.zh: 并且可以让这个热气平均的分布
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 ke3 yi3 rang4 zhe4 ge5 re4 qi4 ping2 jun1 de5 fen1 bu4
cues.en: And it helps distribute the heat evenly.

cues.zh: 再盖上盖子
cues.pinyin: zai4 gai4 shang4 gai4 zi5
cues.en: Then put the lid on.

cues.zh: 用小火煮两个小时
cues.pinyin: yong4 xiao3 huo3 zhu3 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: Simmer on low heat for two hours.

cues.zh: 那每 20 分钟呢我们都要给它翻转一次
cues.pinyin: na4 mei3 20 fen1 zhong1 ne5 wo3 men5 dou1 yao4 gei3 ta1 fan1 zhuan3 yi1 ci4
cues.en: Every 20 minutes, we flip it over once.

cues.zh: 直到煮完
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zhu3 wan2
cues.en: Until it's done cooking.

cues.zh: 两个小时过后呢我们把火关掉
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2 guo4 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 huo3 guan1 diao4
cues.en: After two hours, we turn off the heat.

cues.zh: 然后我们等到它完全冷却了之后
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 deng3 dao4 ta1 wan2 quan2 leng3 que4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Then we wait until it has completely cooled down.

cues.zh: 再来切这个五花肉这个叉烧
cues.pinyin: zai4 lai2 qie4 zhe4 ge5 wu3 hua1 rou4 zhe4 ge5 cha1 shao1
cues.en: Then we slice this pork belly chashu.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 「入口即化」的日式叉烧 |【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 这个五花肉煮好了之后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wu3 hua1 rou4 zhu3 hao3 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the pork belly is cooked,

cues.zh: 你可以把它继续放在锅子里
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 ji4 xu4 fang4 zai4 guo1 zi5 li3
cues.en: you can leave it in the pot,

cues.zh: 然后放进冰箱
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 jin4 bing1 xiang1
cues.en: then put it in the fridge.

cues.zh: 隔天拿出来的时候呢它会非常的入味
cues.pinyin: ge2 tian1 na2 chu1 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5 ta1 hui4 fei1 chang2 de5 ru4 wei4
cues.en: When you take it out the next day, it will be very flavorful.

cues.zh: 好的现在我们把这个麻线剪掉
cues.pinyin: hao3 de5 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ma2 xian4 jian3 diao4
cues.en: Okay, now let's cut off the kitchen twine.

cues.zh: 然后拿掉它
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na2 diao4 ta1
cues.en: And remove it.

cues.zh: 那这个日式叉烧呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 ri4 shi4 cha1 shao1 ne5
cues.en: As for this Japanese chashu,

cues.zh: 想要切薄切厚都可以
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 qie4 bao2 qie4 hou4 dou1 ke3 yi3
cues.en: you can slice it thin or thick, whichever you like.

cues.zh: 放到冰箱冷却之后呢
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 bing1 xiang1 leng3 que4 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After it's chilled in the fridge,

cues.zh: 其实可以切到非常薄的一片一片
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ke3 yi3 qie4 dao4 fei1 chang2 bao2 de5 yi1 pian4 yi1 pian4
cues.en: you can actually slice it into very thin pieces.

cues.zh: 那我就是喜欢这种很大块的
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 shi4 xi3 huan1 zhe4 zhong3 hen3 da4 kuai4 de5
cues.en: As for me, I like it in big chunks.

cues.zh: 所以我就这样子切了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 qie4 le5
cues.en: So that's how I sliced it.

cues.zh: 那你可以把它放在拉面上
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 fang4 zai4 la1 mian4 shang4
cues.en: You can put it on ramen.

cues.zh: 放在米饭上
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 mi3 fan4 shang4
cues.en: Put it on rice.

cues.zh: 或者是就这样子享用也是可以的
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 xiang3 yong4 ye3 shi4 ke3 yi3 de5
cues.en: Or just enjoy it as is, that's fine too.

cues.zh: 哇看上去实在是太好吃了
cues.pinyin: wa5 kan4 shang4 qu4 shi2 zai4 shi4 tai4 hao3 chi1 le5
cues.en: Wow, it looks absolutely delicious.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻修400㎡养老房，全屋毛坯风，拒绝一切智能家电 Chongqing Couple’s 400-m2 Minimalist Villa with No Sma

cues.zh: 以前的话是住在江边
cues.pinyin: yi3 qian2 de5 hua4 shi4 zhu4 zai4 jiang1 bian1
cues.en: Before, we lived by the river.

cues.zh: 重庆有一个网红的打卡点
cues.pinyin: chong2 qing4 you3 yi2 ge4 wang3 hong2 de5 da3 ka3 dian3
cues.en: Chongqing has a popular check-in spot.

cues.zh: 叫青鬼穿洞
cues.pinyin: jiao4 qing1 gui3 chuan1 dong4
cues.en: It's called the Green Ghost Cave-through.

cues.zh: 那个就在我家阳台的对面
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 jiu4 zai4 wo3 jia1 yang2 tai2 de5 dui4 mian4
cues.en: That's right across from my balcony.

cues.zh: 就天天看在那儿穿过去穿过来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 tian1 tian1 kan4 zai4 na4 er2 chuan1 guo4 qu4 chuan1 guo4 lai2
cues.en: I watched people walk back and forth through it every day.

cues.zh: 身处繁华但是忍受这种嘈杂
cues.pinyin: shen1 chu4 fan2 hua2 dan4 shi4 ren3 shou4 zhe4 zhong3 cao2 za2
cues.en: Living amid the bustle, but having to put up with the noise.

cues.zh: 南山就有点像重庆的一个后花园
cues.pinyin: nan2 shan1 jiu4 you3 dian3 xiang4 chong2 qing4 de5 yi2 ge4 hou4 hua1 yuan2
cues.en: Nanshan is kind of like Chongqing's backyard garden.

cues.zh: 解放碑二三十分钟的一个车程
cues.pinyin: jie3 fang4 bei1 er4 san1 shi2 fen1 zhong1 de5 yi2 ge4 che1 cheng2
cues.en: It's about a twenty- to thirty-minute drive from Jiefangbei.

cues.zh: 第一次过来的时候
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 guo4 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The first time I came here,

cues.zh: 当时天下着萌萌的那种小雨
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 tian1 xia4 zhe5 meng2 meng2 de5 na4 zhong3 xiao3 yu3
cues.en: it was drizzling, the kind of cute little rain.

cues.zh: 当天就决定了买了一套房子
cues.pinyin: dang4 tian1 jiu4 jue2 ding4 le5 mai3 le5 yi1 tao4 fang2 zi5
cues.en: That very day I decided to buy a house.

cues.zh: 放很久
cues.pinyin: fang4 hen3 jiu3
cues.en: I let it sit unused for a long time.

cues.zh: 我又找到我喜欢的风格
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 zhao3 dao4 wo3 xi3 huan1 de5 feng1 ge2
cues.en: And then I found the style I liked.

cues.zh: 很偶然的一个机会联系上这个设计师
cues.pinyin: hen3 ou3 ran2 de5 yi2 ge4 ji1 hui4 lian2 xi4 shang4 zhe4 ge5 she4 ji4 shi1
cues.en: By a chance encounter, I got in touch with this designer.

cues.zh: 重庆这个城市它本身就是山城
cues.pinyin: chong2 qing4 zhe4 ge5 cheng2 shi4 ta1 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 shan1 cheng2
cues.en: Chongqing itself is a mountain city.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻修400㎡养老房，全屋毛坯风，拒绝一切智能家电 Chongqing Couple’s 400-m2 Minimalist Villa with No Sma

cues.zh: 走出去之后
cues.pinyin: zou3 chu1 qu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After you step outside,

cues.zh: 其实是一个非常开阔的花园
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 kai1 kuo4 de5 hua1 yuan2
cues.en: it's actually a very open, spacious garden.

cues.zh: 更像是一个露台
cues.pinyin: geng4 xiang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 lu4 tai2
cues.en: It's more like a terrace.

cues.zh: 可以在这里烧烤
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 zhe4 li3 shao1 kao3
cues.en: You can barbecue here,

cues.zh: 甚至吃火锅
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 chi1 huo3 guo1
cues.en: and even eat hotpot.

cues.zh: 一楼是一个起居室
cues.pinyin: yi1 lou2 shi4 yi2 ge4 qi3 ju1 shi4
cues.en: The first floor is a living room.

cues.zh: 主人房套房的这种设计
cues.pinyin: zhu3 ren2 fang2 tao4 fang2 de5 zhe4 zhong3 she4 ji4
cues.en: This kind of master bedroom suite design,

cues.zh: 它能够满足它日常生活的所有的功能
cues.pinyin: ta1 neng2 gou4 man3 zu2 ta1 ri4 chang2 sheng1 huo2 de5 suo3 you3 de5 gong1 neng2
cues.en: it can cover all the functions needed for daily life,

cues.zh: 并且不被打扰
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 bu4 bei4 da3 rao3
cues.en: without being disturbed.

cues.zh: 楼梯作为整个空间的视觉核心
cues.pinyin: lou2 ti1 zuo4 wei2 zheng3 ge4 kong1 jian1 de5 shi4 jue2 he2 xin1
cues.en: The staircase serves as the visual core of the whole space.

cues.zh: 做了一个弧形的处理
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 hu2 xing2 de5 chu3 li3
cues.en: It was given a curved treatment.

cues.zh: 铺屋顶做了一个穹顶
cues.pinyin: pu4 wu1 ding3 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 qiong2 ding3
cues.en: For the roof, we made a dome.

cues.zh: 像一个海螺包裹住了整个空间
cues.pinyin: xiang4 yi2 ge4 hai3 luo2 bao1 guo3 zhu4 le5 zheng3 ge4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: Like a conch shell, it wraps around the whole space.

cues.zh: 重庆本地它原始的建筑就是以土坯房
cues.pinyin: chong2 qing4 ben3 di4 ta1 yuan2 shi3 de5 jian4 zhu4 jiu4 shi4 yi3 tu3 pi1 fang2
cues.en: Chongqing's original local buildings were mainly adobe houses.

cues.zh: 最普通的这种灰泥的样子
cues.pinyin: zui4 pu3 tong1 de5 zhe4 zhong3 hui1 ni2 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: the most common kind of gray-plaster look.

cues.zh: 杏黄咖啡色的做了一个叠加
cues.pinyin: xing4 huang2 ka1 fei1 se4 de5 zuo4 le5 yi2 ge4 die2 jia1
cues.en: We layered apricot-yellow and coffee-brown tones together.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 夫妻修400㎡养老房，全屋毛坯风，拒绝一切智能家电 Chongqing Couple’s 400-m2 Minimalist Villa with No Sma

cues.zh: 这样是节约了 50 的一个成本投入
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 shi4 jie2 yue1 le5 50 de5 yi2 ge4 cheng2 ben3 tou2 ru4
cues.en: This way we saved about 50% on cost.

cues.zh: 我们家里的电器是很少的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jia1 li3 de5 dian4 qi4 shi4 hen3 shao3 de5
cues.en: We have very few appliances in our home.

cues.zh: 也没有电视机
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 you3 dian4 shi4 ji1
cues.en: There's no TV either.

cues.zh: 放弃了全屋智能
cues.pinyin: fang4 qi4 le5 quan2 wu1 zhi4 neng2
cues.en: We gave up having a fully smart home.

cues.zh: 适当的一个动手
cues.pinyin: shi4 dang4 de5 yi2 ge4 dong4 shou3
cues.en: A bit of hands-on effort, where appropriate.

cues.zh: 享受生活本身的一些东西
cues.pinyin: xiang3 shou4 sheng1 huo2 ben3 shen1 de5 yi1 xie1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Enjoying things about life itself.

cues.zh: 公区用的是地暖
cues.pinyin: gong1 qu1 yong4 de5 shi4 di4 nuan3
cues.en: The common areas use underfloor heating.

cues.zh: 卧室还有书房用的电暖片
cues.pinyin: wo4 shi4 hai2 you3 shu1 fang2 yong4 de5 dian4 nuan3 pian4
cues.en: The bedroom and study use electric heating panels.

cues.zh: 成本也会有增加审美也会有一些欠缺
cues.pinyin: cheng2 ben3 ye3 hui4 you3 zeng1 jia1 shen3 mei3 ye3 hui4 you3 yi1 xie1 qian4 que1
cues.en: The cost would go up a bit, and the aesthetics would fall short a bit too.

cues.zh: 但是艰难
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jian1 nan2
cues.en: But it's difficult.

cues.zh: 为什么我会想到我要做更环保
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 hui4 xiang3 dao4 wo3 yao4 zuo4 geng4 huan2 bao3
cues.en: Why did I think I should make it more eco-friendly?

cues.zh: 重庆以前因为工业化城市
cues.pinyin: chong2 qing4 yi3 qian2 yin1 wei4 gong1 ye4 hua4 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: Chongqing used to be an industrialized city,

cues.zh: 它的雾特别大
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 wu4 te4 bie2 da4
cues.en: and its smog was really heavy.

cues.zh: 现在的话这里的空气也挺好的
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 de5 hua4 zhe4 li3 de5 kong1 qi4 ye3 ting3 hao3 de5
cues.en: Now, the air here is actually pretty good.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 过年了给大家道一声新春快乐
cues.pinyin: guo4 nian2 le5 gei3 da4 jia1 dao4 yi1 sheng1 xin1 chun1 kuai4 le4
cues.en: It's New Year, so let me wish you all a happy Spring Festival.

cues.zh: 祝大家在新的一年里心想事成万事如意
cues.pinyin: zhu4 da4 jia1 zai4 xin1 de5 yi1 nian2 li3 xin1 xiang3 shi4 cheng2 wan4 shi4 ru2 yi4
cues.en: May everything go as you wish and all your wishes come true in the new year.

cues.zh: 不过今年春节可能很多人高兴不起来
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 jin1 nian2 chun1 jie2 ke3 neng2 hen3 duo1 ren2 gao1 xing4 bu4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: But this Spring Festival, many people probably can't feel happy.

cues.zh: 因为突如其来的新型肺炎病毒
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 tu1 ru2 qi2 lai2 de5 xin1 xing2 fei4 yan2 bing4 du2
cues.en: Because of the sudden outbreak of the new coronavirus pneumonia.

cues.zh: 包括我在内的很多人都取消了
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 wo3 zai4 nei4 de5 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 qu3 xiao1 le5
cues.en: Many people, including myself, have canceled

cues.zh: 行程窝在家里
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 wo1 zai4 jia1 li3
cues.en: travel plans and are staying cooped up at home.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说这个新型肺炎病毒到底
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 xin1 xing2 fei4 yan2 bing4 du2 dao4 di3
cues.en: A kid asked me what exactly this new coronavirus pneumonia

cues.zh: 是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: is all about.

cues.zh: 反正现在哪儿也去不了
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 xian4 zai4 na3 er2 ye3 qu4 bu4 liao3
cues.en: Since there's nowhere to go right now anyway,

cues.zh: 不如我们慢慢讲这个问题先从细菌说起
cues.pinyin: bu4 ru2 wo3 men5 man4 man4 jiang3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 xian1 cong2 xi4 jun1 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: let's slowly talk through this topic, starting with bacteria.

cues.zh: 我们首先先来说一说细菌有什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 xi4 jun1 you3 shen2 me5
cues.en: First, let's talk about what kind of structure

cues.zh: 样的一个结构
cues.pinyin: yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 gou4
cues.en: bacteria have.

cues.zh: 它有哪些种类
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 na3 xie1 zhong3 lei4
cues.en: What types there are.

cues.zh: 它对我们的生活到底有什么样的影响
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 wo3 men5 de5 sheng1 huo2 dao4 di3 you3 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: And what kind of impact they actually have on our lives.

cues.zh: 最近的发现其实是最近几百年的事
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 de5 fa1 xian4 qi2 shi2 shi4 zui4 jin4 ji3 bai3 nian2 de5 shi4
cues.en: The discovery of bacteria is actually only a matter of the last few hundred years.

cues.zh: 在 17 世纪的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 17 shi4 ji4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back in the 17th century,

cues.zh: 有一个荷兰的看门人名字叫列文虎克
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 he2 lan2 de5 kan1 men2 ren2 ming2 zi4 jiao4 lie4 wen2 hu3 ke4
cues.en: there was a Dutch doorman named Leeuwenhoek.

cues.zh: 我们之前讲过列文虎克这个人
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 jiang3 guo4 lie4 wen2 hu3 ke4 zhe4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: We've talked about Leeuwenhoek before.

cues.zh: 列文虎克因为看门所以没事干
cues.pinyin: lie4 wen2 hu3 ke4 yin1 wei4 kan1 men2 suo3 yi3 mei2 shi4 gan4
cues.en: Because Leeuwenhoek was a doorman, he had nothing to do,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 于是自己磨镜片做显微镜
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zi4 ji3 mo2 jing4 pian4 zuo4 xian3 wei1 jing4
cues.en: so he ground his own lenses to make microscopes.

cues.zh: 他就做了可以放大两三百倍的显微镜
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 zuo4 le5 ke3 yi3 fang4 da4 liang3 san1 bai3 bei4 de5 xian3 wei1 jing4
cues.en: He made microscopes that could magnify two to three hundred times.

cues.zh: 然后用这个显微镜去观察各种各样千
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 xian3 wei1 jing4 qu4 guan1 cha2 ge4 zhong3 ge4 yang4 qian1
cues.en: Then he used this microscope to observe all sorts of

cues.zh: 奇百怪的东西
cues.pinyin: qi2 bai3 guai4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: strange and bizarre things.

cues.zh: 比如说他观察一个不刷牙的老人的牙垢
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 guan1 cha2 yi2 ge4 bu4 shua1 ya2 de5 lao3 ren2 de5 ya2 gou4
cues.en: For example, he looked at the plaque on the teeth of an old man who didn't brush his teeth.

cues.zh: 结果就在牙垢中发现了许许多多的小动物
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 zai4 ya2 gou4 zhong1 fa1 xian4 le5 xu3 xu3 duo1 duo1 de5 xiao3 dong4 wu4
cues.en: As a result, he found many tiny little animals in the plaque.

cues.zh: 然后把它画出来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 ta1 hua4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Then he drew them,

cues.zh: 寄给这个英国的皇家学会去发表
cues.pinyin: ji4 gei3 zhe4 ge5 ying1 guo2 de5 huang2 jia1 xue2 hui4 qu4 fa1 biao3
cues.en: and sent the drawings to the Royal Society in England to be published.

cues.zh: 那么他管它叫小动物
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 guan3 ta1 jiao4 xiao3 dong4 wu4
cues.en: He called them "little animals."

cues.zh: 后来我们就知道了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 men5 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Later we came to know

cues.zh: 这实际上是微生物也就是细菌
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 wei1 sheng1 wu4 ye3 jiu4 shi4 xi4 jun1
cues.en: that these were actually microorganisms, that is, bacteria.

cues.zh: 那么人们现在知道了地球上的所有细菌
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 men5 xian4 zai4 zhi1 dao4 le5 di4 qiu2 shang4 de5 suo3 you3 xi4 jun1
cues.en: So now people know that all the bacteria on Earth

cues.zh: 估计有 5 乘以 10 的 30 次王格这么多
cues.pinyin: gu1 ji4 you3 5 cheng2 yi3 10 de5 30 ci4 wang2 ge2 zhe4 me5 duo1
cues.en: are estimated to number about 5 times 10 to the 30th power.

cues.zh: 那这个数量大概有多少
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 liang4 da4 gai4 you3 duo1 shao3
cues.en: So roughly how large is this number?

cues.zh: 就是比世界上所有除了细菌之外
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bi3 shi4 jie4 shang4 suo3 you3 chu2 le5 xi4 jun1 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: It's more than the total of all the cells

cues.zh: 其他的生物的细胞加起来还要多
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 sheng1 wu4 de5 xi4 bao1 jia1 qi3 lai2 hai2 yao4 duo1
cues.en: of every other living thing on Earth besides bacteria, combined.

cues.zh: 如果我们在 1000 克的土壤中
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 zai4 1000 ke4 de5 tu3 rang3 zhong1
cues.en: If we take 1000 grams of soil,

cues.zh: 1000 克的土中就会有 4 000 万个细菌
cues.pinyin: 1000 ke4 de5 tu3 zhong1 jiu4 hui4 you3 4 000 wan4 ge4 xi4 jun1
cues.en: in that 1000 grams of soil there would be about 40 million bacteria.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 巴斯德用一个瓶子
cues.pinyin: ba1 si1 de2 yong4 yi2 ge4 ping2 zi5
cues.en: Pasteur used a flask,

cues.zh: 然后把这个瓶子的口变成是这
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ping2 zi5 de5 kou3 bian4 cheng2 shi4 zhe4
cues.en: and he shaped the neck of the flask

cues.zh: 样的一个结构
cues.pinyin: yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 jie2 gou4
cues.en: into a certain structure,

cues.zh: 像俄的脖子一样
cues.pinyin: xiang4 e2 de5 bo2 zi5 yi1 yang4
cues.en: like the neck of a goose.

cues.zh: 所以叫鹅浸瓶
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiao4 e2 jin4 ping2
cues.en: So it's called a "swan-neck flask."

cues.zh: 然后在瓶子里边装一些肉汤
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ping2 zi5 li3 bian1 zhuang1 yi1 xie1 rou4 tang1
cues.en: Then he put some broth into the flask.

cues.zh: 他先把肉汤装进去
cues.pinyin: ta1 xian1 ba3 rou4 tang1 zhuang1 jin4 qu4
cues.en: He first put the broth in,

cues.zh: 再把这个瓶口变成这个样子
cues.pinyin: zai4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ping2 kou3 bian4 cheng2 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: then shaped the flask's neck into that curved form.

cues.zh: 变成这个样子之后
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it was shaped that way,

cues.zh: 这个肉汤用火去加热
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 rou4 tang1 yong4 huo3 qu4 jia1 re4
cues.en: he heated the broth with fire.

cues.zh: 加热之后就可以把它里面的细菌给杀死
cues.pinyin: jia1 re4 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 li3 mian4 de5 xi4 jun1 gei3 sha1 si3
cues.en: After heating, it would kill any bacteria inside it.

cues.zh: 然后就把这个瓶子静置
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ping2 zi5 jing4 zhi4
cues.en: Then he let the flask sit undisturbed.

cues.zh: 静置了一年的时间
cues.pinyin: jing4 zhi4 le5 yi1 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: He let it sit for a whole year.

cues.zh: 然后你会发现说这个瓶子里面的肉
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ping2 zi5 li3 mian4 de5 rou4
cues.en: Then you'd think that the meat broth in the flask,

cues.zh: 已经放了一年了肯定要烂掉
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 fang4 le5 yi1 nian2 le5 ken3 ding4 yao4 lan4 diao4
cues.en: having sat there for a year, must surely have gone bad.

cues.zh: 所以这个水就要浑浊
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 shui3 jiu4 yao4 hun2 zhuo2
cues.en: So the liquid should turn cloudy,

cues.zh: 这汤就要浑浊对不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tang1 jiu4 yao4 hun2 zhuo2 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: the broth should turn cloudy, right?

cues.zh: 但是事实上一年之后什么结果
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi4 shi2 shang4 yi1 nian2 zhi1 hou4 shen2 me5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: But in fact, after a year, what was the result?

cues.zh: 这个汤依然是澄清的状态
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tang1 yi1 ran2 shi4 cheng2 qing1 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: The broth was still clear.

cues.zh: 依然是澄清的状态
cues.pinyin: yi1 ran2 shi4 cheng2 qing1 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: Still in a clear state,

cues.zh: 没有浑浊
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 hun2 zhuo2
cues.en: not cloudy at all.

cues.zh: 没有浑浊就说明什么
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 hun2 zhuo2 jiu4 shuo1 ming2 shen2 me5
cues.en: Not being cloudy — what does that tell us?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 然后它有可能会进到这个口里
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 jin4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 kou3 li3
cues.en: Then it might get in through that neck opening.

cues.zh: 进到这个口里之后
cues.pinyin: jin4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 kou3 li3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it got into that opening,

cues.zh: 因为细菌比空气密度大所以它往下沉
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xi4 jun1 bi3 kong1 qi4 mi4 du4 da4 suo3 yi3 ta1 wang3 xia4 chen2
cues.en: because bacteria are denser than air, they sink downward.

cues.zh: 于是它就会沉到这个部位在这攒着
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 hui4 chen2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4 zai4 zhe4 zan3 zhe5
cues.en: So they would sink down and collect right at that bend.

cues.zh: 但是它上不去除非你往里吹气它就上去了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 shang4 bu4 qu4 chu2 fei1 ni3 wang3 li3 chui1 qi4 ta1 jiu4 shang4 qu4 le5
cues.en: But they can't get further up unless you blow air into it, which would push them up.

cues.zh: 但是你只要不吹气静置它它上不去
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 zhi3 yao4 bu4 chui1 qi4 jing4 zhi4 ta1 ta1 shang4 bu4 qu4
cues.en: But as long as you don't blow into it and just leave it still, they can't get up.

cues.zh: 所以攒了很长时间细菌也都一
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zan3 le5 hen3 zhang3 shi2 jian1 xi4 jun1 ye3 dou1 yi1
cues.en: So even after sitting there a long time, the bacteria all stayed

cues.zh: 直在这个部位
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4
cues.en: right in that spot.

cues.zh: 它进不到这个肉汤里边去繁殖
cues.pinyin: ta1 jin4 bu2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 rou4 tang1 li3 bian1 qu4 fan2 zhi2
cues.en: They couldn't get into the broth itself to multiply.

cues.zh: 所以肉汤就一直是澄清的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 rou4 tang1 jiu4 yi4 zhi2 shi4 cheng2 qing1 de5
cues.en: So the broth stayed clear the whole time.

cues.zh: 但是如果你把这个口拿掉
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 ni3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 kou3 na2 diao4
cues.en: But if you remove that curved neck,

cues.zh: 那细菌就可以直接掉进去了
cues.pinyin: na4 xi4 jun1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhi2 jie1 diao4 jin4 qu4 le5
cues.en: then bacteria can fall straight in.

cues.zh: 掉进去了之后在这里边繁殖
cues.pinyin: diao4 jin4 qu4 le5 zhi1 hou4 zai4 zhe4 li3 bian1 fan2 zhi2
cues.en: Once they fall in, they multiply there,

cues.zh: 于是这个肉就烂了
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zhe4 ge5 rou4 jiu4 lan4 le5
cues.en: and so the meat goes bad.

cues.zh: 这个汤就浑浊了就是这么一个道理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tang1 jiu4 hun2 zhuo2 le5 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 dao4 li3
cues.en: And the broth turns cloudy — that's the whole principle.

cues.zh: 所以它证明了细菌并不是无中生有的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 zheng4 ming2 liao3 xi4 jun1 bing4 bu2 shi4 wu2 zhong1 sheng1 you3 de5
cues.en: So this proved that bacteria don't just appear out of nothing.

cues.zh: 而是空气中水中都有细菌
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 kong1 qi4 zhong1 shui3 zhong1 du1 you3 xi4 jun1
cues.en: Rather, there are bacteria in both the air and in water.

cues.zh: 那细菌可以在肉汤里边繁殖才会使肉烂掉
cues.pinyin: na4 xi4 jun1 ke3 yi3 zai4 rou4 tang1 li3 bian1 fan2 zhi2 cai2 hui4 shi3 rou4 lan4 diao4
cues.en: And bacteria multiplying in the broth is what makes the meat go bad.

cues.zh: 当然巴斯德的贡献不仅仅是这个
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 ba1 si1 de2 de5 gong4 xian4 bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: Of course, Pasteur's contributions weren't limited to this.

cues.zh: 巴斯德还有很多其他的贡献
cues.pinyin: ba1 si1 de2 hai2 you3 hen3 duo1 qi2 ta1 de5 gong4 xian4
cues.en: Pasteur made many other contributions too.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 比如说巴斯德发明了这个狂犬病疫苗
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ba1 si1 de2 fa1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 kuang2 quan3 bing4 yi4 miao2
cues.en: For example, Pasteur invented the rabies vaccine.

cues.zh: 狂犬病一旦发病了致死率百分之百
cues.pinyin: kuang2 quan3 bing4 yi2 dan4 fa1 bing4 le5 zhi4 si3 lv4 bai3 fen1 zhi1 bai3
cues.en: Once rabies develops symptoms, the fatality rate is 100%.

cues.zh: 那么用狂犬病疫苗就可以在发病之前注射
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 yong4 kuang2 quan3 bing4 yi4 miao2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zai4 fa1 bing4 zhi1 qian2 zhu4 she4
cues.en: So the rabies vaccine can be injected before the disease develops,

cues.zh: 这个人就好了对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 jiu4 hao3 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: and the person would be fine, right?

cues.zh: 炭疽也是一种很可怕的这个病菌炭疽疫苗
cues.pinyin: tan4 ju1 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hen3 ke3 pa4 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 tan4 ju1 yi4 miao2
cues.en: Using the rabies vaccine, he saved a person named Yersin.

cues.zh: 而这个年轻的伊尔森后来在香港发
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 nian2 qing1 de5 yi1 er3 sen1 hou4 lai2 zai4 xiang1 gang3 fa1
cues.en: And this young Yersin later, in Hong Kong,

cues.zh: 现了鼠疫病菌
cues.pinyin: xian4 le5 shu3 yi4 bing4 jun1
cues.en: discovered the plague bacterium.

cues.zh: 这事咱们以前也说过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zan2 men5 yi3 qian2 ye3 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: We've talked about this before too.

cues.zh: 除此之外它还发明了这个碳菊碳菊疫苗
cues.pinyin: chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4 ta1 hai2 fa1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 tan4 ju2 tan4 ju2 yi4 miao2
cues.en: Besides that, he also invented the anthrax vaccine.

cues.zh: 碳菊也是一种很可怕的这个病菌碳菊疫苗
cues.pinyin: tan4 ju2 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hen3 ke3 pa4 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 jun1 tan4 ju2 yi4 miao2
cues.en: Anthrax is also a very frightening disease; the anthrax vaccine

cues.zh: 它用这种疫苗也可以救人
cues.pinyin: ta1 yong4 zhe4 zhong3 yi4 miao2 ye3 ke3 yi3 jiu4 ren2
cues.en: can also save people using this vaccine.

cues.zh: 还有就是我们每天都会接触到的
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 mei3 tian1 du1 hui4 jie1 chu4 dao4 de5
cues.en: And there's also something we come into contact with every day:

cues.zh: 就是巴氏杀菌法这也是它发明的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ba1 shi4 sha1 jun1 fa3 zhe4 ye3 shi4 ta1 fa1 ming2 de5
cues.en: pasteurization, which he also invented.

cues.zh: 巴氏杀菌法
cues.pinyin: ba1 shi4 sha1 jun1 fa3
cues.en: Pasteurization.

cues.zh: 巴氏杀菌法就是说在不到 100 度的温度下
cues.pinyin: ba1 shi4 sha1 jun1 fa3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zai4 bu2 dao4 100 du4 de5 wen1 du4 xia4
cues.en: Pasteurization means heating food

cues.zh: 对这个食物进行加热
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 wu4 jin4 xing2 jia1 re4
cues.en: at a temperature below 100 degrees Celsius.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】细菌到底是什么？人类是如何发现细菌的？

cues.zh: 第一个类型就是球菌
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 lei4 xing2 jiu4 shi4 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: The first type is cocci.

cues.zh: 就是长的样子是一个球
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhang3 de5 yang4 zi5 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2
cues.en: Meaning they're shaped like a ball.

cues.zh: 比较典型的这个球菌
cues.pinyin: bi3 jiao4 dian3 xing2 de5 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: A fairly typical example of cocci,

cues.zh: 比如说像肺炎双球菌
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 xiang4 fei4 yan2 shuang1 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: for instance, is pneumococcus (diplococcus pneumoniae).

cues.zh: 肺炎双球菌它是可以引发肺炎的
cues.pinyin: fei4 yan2 shuang1 qiu2 jun1 ta1 shi4 ke3 yi3 yin3 fa1 fei4 yan2 de5
cues.en: Pneumococcus can cause pneumonia.

cues.zh: 它是两个细菌每个细菌都是一个球
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 liang3 ge4 xi4 jun1 mei3 ge4 xi4 jun1 dou1 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2
cues.en: It consists of two bacteria, each one a sphere,

cues.zh: 然后能合到一块叫肺炎双球菌这样的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 neng2 he2 dao4 yi1 kuai4 jiao4 fei4 yan2 shuang1 qiu2 jun1 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: that join together, which is why it's called "double-sphere pneumonia bacteria."

cues.zh: 此外还有像葡萄球菌
cues.pinyin: ci3 wai4 hai2 you3 xiang4 pu2 tao2 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: Besides cocci, there's also staphylococcus.

cues.zh: 葡萄球菌就是一大堆的这个球菌
cues.pinyin: pu2 tao2 qiu2 jun1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 da4 dui1 de5 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: Staphylococcus is a cluster of these round bacteria

cues.zh: 组成一个像葡萄的样子球菌
cues.pinyin: zu3 cheng2 yi2 ge4 xiang4 pu2 tao2 de5 yang4 zi5 qiu2 jun1
cues.en: forming a shape like a bunch of grapes.

cues.zh: 除了球菌以外还有什么呢
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 qiu2 jun1 yi3 wai4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Besides cocci, what else is there?

cues.zh: 还有杆菌
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 gan3 jun1
cues.en: There's also bacilli.

cues.zh: 杆菌顾名思义就是长得像杆一样
cues.pinyin: gan3 jun1 gu4 ming2 si1 yi4 jiu4 shi4 zhang3 de2 xiang4 gan1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: As the name suggests, bacilli are shaped like rods.

cues.zh: 最典型的就是大肠杆菌
cues.pinyin: zui4 dian3 xing2 de5 jiu4 shi4 da4 chang2 gan3 jun1
cues.en: The most typical example is E. coli.

cues.zh: 大肠杆菌
cues.pinyin: da4 chang2 gan3 jun1
cues.en: E. coli.

cues.zh: 那除了球菌和杆菌
cues.pinyin: na4 chu2 le5 qiu2 jun1 he2 gan3 jun1
cues.en: Besides cocci and bacilli,

cues.zh: 还有一种就是螺旋菌
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 jiu4 shi4 luo2 xuan2 jun1
cues.en: there's also spirilla.

cues.zh: 螺旋菌就是弯的
cues.pinyin: luo2 xuan2 jun1 jiu4 shi4 wan1 de5
cues.en: Spirilla are curved/spiral-shaped.

cues.zh: 螺旋菌里面可能还分为好几个种类
cues.pinyin: luo2 xuan2 jun1 li3 mian4 ke3 neng2 hai2 fen1 wei2 hao3 ji3 ge4 zhong3 lei4
cues.en: Spirilla can be further divided into several types.

cues.zh: 那么螺旋菌它就是弯的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 luo2 xuan2 jun1 ta1 jiu4 shi4 wan1 de5
cues.en: So spirilla are curved in shape.

cues.zh: 有一天乌龟生病了
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 wu1 gui1 sheng1 bing4 le5
cues.en: One day a turtle got sick

cues.zh: 请他的好朋友蜗牛去帮他买药
cues.pinyin: qing3 ta1 de5 hao3 peng2 you3 wo1 niu2 qu4 bang1 ta1 mai3 yao4
cues.en: He asked his good friend snail to go buy medicine for him

cues.zh: 过了好几个小时蜗牛还是没有回来
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 hao3 ji3 ge4 xiao3 shi2 wo1 niu2 hai2 shi4 mei2 you3 hui2 lai2
cues.en: Several hours passed and the snail still hadn't come back

cues.zh: 于是乌龟就破口大骂说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wu1 gui1 jiu4 po4 kou3 da4 ma4 shuo1
cues.en: So the turtle started cursing, saying

cues.zh: 蜗牛再不回来我就要跟他断交
cues.pinyin: wo1 niu2 zai4 bu4 hui2 lai2 wo3 jiu4 yao4 gen1 ta1 duan4 jiao1
cues.en: If the snail doesn't come back soon, I'm ending our friendship

cues.zh: 这时候从门口传来蜗牛的声音说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 cong2 men2 kou3 chuan2 lai2 wo1 niu2 de5 sheng1 yin1 shuo1
cues.en: At that moment, the snail's voice came from the doorway, saying

cues.zh: 你在骂我
cues.pinyin: ni3 zai4 ma4 wo3
cues.en: You're cursing me?

cues.zh: 我就不去了
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 bu4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Then I'm not going

cues.zh: 有一天小明和小美出去玩看到一只蜘蛛
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 he2 xiao3 mei3 chu1 qu4 wan2 kan4 dao4 yi1 zhi1 zhi1 zhu1
cues.en: One day, Xiaoming and Xiaomei were out and saw a spider.

cues.zh: 啊这是什么
cues.pinyin: a5 zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Huh, what's this?

cues.zh: 啊准备的
cues.pinyin: a5 zhun3 bei4 de5
cues.en: Oh, that's something I prepared.

cues.zh: 你说谁失败的你才失败的咧
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 shui2 shi1 bai4 de5 ni3 cai2 shi1 bai4 de5 lie3
cues.en: Who are you calling a failure? You're the failure!

cues.zh: 蜘蛛最怕什么
cues.pinyin: zhi1 zhu1 zui4 pa4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What is a spider most afraid of?

cues.zh: 怕剪刀剪他
cues.pinyin: pa4 jian3 dao1 jian3 ta1
cues.en: Afraid of scissors cutting it.

cues.zh: 错但是不怕一万只怕万一
cues.pinyin: cuo4 dan4 shi4 bu4 pa4 yi1 wan4 zhi3 pa4 wan4 yi1
cues.en: Wrong — it's not afraid of ten thousand, only afraid of the one-in-ten-thousand chance.

cues.zh: 昨天去买东西出来
cues.pinyin: zuo2 tian1 qu4 mai3 dong1 xi1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Yesterday I went out to buy something, and when I came out,

cues.zh: 看到警察在开罚单
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 jing3 cha2 zai4 kai1 fa2 dan1
cues.en: I saw a police officer writing a ticket.

cues.zh: 于是我就走过去说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 jiu4 zou3 guo4 qu4 shuo1
cues.en: So I walked up and said,

cues.zh: 断了啦只是聆听一下
cues.pinyin: duan4 le5 la5 zhi3 shi4 ling2 ting1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: No, no — I was just parked for a second!

cues.zh: 那警察怎么说
cues.pinyin: na4 jing3 cha2 zen3 me5 shuo1
cues.en: What did the officer say?

cues.zh: 那警察完全不理我继续开罚单
cues.pinyin: na4 jing3 cha2 wan2 quan2 bu4 li3 wo3 ji4 xu4 kai1 fa2 dan1
cues.en: The officer completely ignored me and kept writing the ticket.

cues.zh: 我就骂他那么爱钱
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 ma4 ta1 na4 me5 ai4 qian2
cues.en: So I cursed him for loving money so much.

cues.zh: 有什么比打女人更可耻的事吗
cues.pinyin: you3 shen2 me5 bi3 da3 nv3 ren2 geng4 ke3 chi3 de5 shi4 ma5
cues.en: Is there anything more shameful than hitting a woman?

cues.zh: 有啊
cues.pinyin: you3 a5
cues.en: Yes, there is.

cues.zh: 是什么
cues.pinyin: shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What is it?

cues.zh: 打不过他啊
cues.pinyin: da3 bu4 guo4 ta1 a5
cues.en: Not being able to beat her!

cues.zh: 登山我问你喔
cues.pinyin: deng1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Wait, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 这个是什么
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What is this?

cues.zh: 不是这个是我的手指头
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 wo3 de5 shou3 zhi3 tou5
cues.en: No, this is my finger.

cues.zh: 那你知道为什么贝多芬不用这根手
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 bei4 duo1 fen1 bu4 yong4 zhe4 gen1 shou3
cues.en: Then do you know why Beethoven doesn't use this finger

cues.zh: 指头弹钢琴吗
cues.pinyin: zhi3 tou5 tan2 gang1 qin2 ma5
cues.en: to play the piano?

cues.zh: 因为他这只手指头断掉了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zhe4 zhi3 shou3 zhi3 tou5 duan4 diao4 le5
cues.en: Because this finger of his is broken.

cues.zh: 不是因为这根手指头是我的
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 gen1 shou3 zhi3 tou5 shi4 wo3 de5
cues.en: No — it's because this finger is mine!

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 富婆日光浴，结果被做成东北杀人菜。真相奇葩至极。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 豪宅女佣推门闻到糊味攻击
cues.pinyin: hao2 zhai2 nv3 yong1 tui1 men2 wen2 dao4 hu2 wei4 gong1 ji1
cues.en: The mansion's maid opened the door and was hit by a wave of burnt smell.

cues.zh: 还以为霍太佑在搞黑暗料理直播
cues.pinyin: hai2 yi3 wei2 huo4 tai4 you4 zai4 gao3 hei1 an4 liao4 li3 zhi2 bo1
cues.en: At first she thought the host was livestreaming some 'dark cuisine' show.

cues.zh: 谁知竟烤成人形酱香饼
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 jing4 kao3 cheng2 ren2 xing2 jiang4 xiang1 bing3
cues.en: Turns out it was a person roasted into a human-shaped sauce-glazed flatbread.

cues.zh: 这哪是日光浴床
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na3 shi4 ri4 guang1 yu4 chuang2
cues.en: This was no tanning bed at all.

cues.zh: 建议商家改名叫美黑火葬场豪华版
cues.pinyin: jian4 yi4 shang1 jia1 gai3 ming2 jiao4 mei3 hei1 huo3 zang4 chang3 hao2 hua2 ban3
cues.en: Someone suggested the salon rebrand as 'Deluxe Tanning Crematorium.'

cues.zh: 毕竟能把人烤成七分熟酱牛肉
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 neng2 ba3 ren2 kao3 cheng2 qi1 fen1 shu2 jiang4 niu2 rou4
cues.en: After all, it can roast a person into medium-well braised beef.

cues.zh: 现在也就这床能卷成美容界刑具
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ye3 jiu4 zhe4 chuang2 neng2 juan3 cheng2 mei3 rong2 jie4 xing2 ju4
cues.en: These days this bed is basically a torture device for the beauty industry.

cues.zh: 接到报警后法医实验室小骨和昆虫学家
cues.pinyin: jie1 dao4 bao4 jing3 hou4 fa3 yi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 xiao3 gu3 he2 kun1 chong2 xue2 jia1
cues.en: After the call came in, the lab's Bones and the entomologist

cues.zh: 豪金迅速赶到
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 xun4 su4 gan3 dao4
cues.en: and Hodgins rushed to the scene.

cues.zh: 经两人初步检测
cues.pinyin: jing1 liang3 ren2 chu1 bu4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: After a preliminary exam by the two,

cues.zh: 确定死者是位 40 岁左右的女性
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 si3 zhe3 shi4 wei4 40 sui4 zuo3 you4 de5 nv3 xing4
cues.en: they determined the victim was a woman around 40.

cues.zh: 小谷随即科普美黑旅游来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 sui2 ji2 ke1 pu3 mei3 hei1 lv3 you2 lai2
cues.en: Bones then gave a quick lecture on 'tanning tourism.'

cues.zh: 豪金则在一旁暗示
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 ze2 zai4 yi1 pang2 an4 shi4
cues.en: while Hodgins hinted on the side

cues.zh: 法医卡米尔今晚约了人行荷尔蒙
cues.pinyin: fa3 yi1 ka3 mi3 er3 jin1 wan3 yue1 le5 ren2 xing2 he2 er3 meng2
cues.en: that forensic examiner Cam had a date tonight, hormones running wild.

cues.zh: 话没说完就被小骨打断
cues.pinyin: hua4 mei2 shuo1 wan2 jiu4 bei4 xiao3 gu3 da3 duan4
cues.en: Before she could finish, Bones cut her off,

cues.zh: 只听对方说
cues.pinyin: zhi3 ting1 dui4 fang1 shuo1
cues.en: only to hear her say:

cues.zh: 情人节起源于被斩首的基督徒
cues.pinyin: qing2 ren2 jie2 qi3 yuan2 yu2 bei4 zhan3 shou3 de5 ji1 du1 tu2
cues.en: Valentine's Day originated from a beheaded Christian saint.

cues.zh: 浪漫氛围瞬间变成恐怖片开场
cues.pinyin: lang4 man4 fen1 wei2 shun4 jian1 bian4 cheng2 kong3 bu4 pian4 kai1 chang3
cues.en: The romantic mood instantly turned into a horror movie opening.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 富婆日光浴，结果被做成东北杀人菜。真相奇葩至极。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 好在警员老布也迅速赶到现场
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 ye3 xun4 su4 gan3 dao4 xian4 chang3
cues.en: Luckily, officer Booth also arrived at the scene quickly.

cues.zh: 经调查
cues.pinyin: jing1 diao4 cha2
cues.en: Upon investigation,

cues.zh: 死者名叫劳拉是婚礼策划界的浪漫包公头
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 ming2 jiao4 lao2 la1 shi4 hun1 li3 ce4 hua4 jie4 de5 lang4 man4 bao1 gong1 tou2
cues.en: the victim, Laura, turned out to be a top wedding planner known for romance.

cues.zh: 满屋子设计主旨比婚纱店样册还密集
cues.pinyin: man3 wu1 zi5 she4 ji4 zhu3 zhi3 bi3 hun1 sha1 dian4 yang4 ce4 hai2 mi4 ji2
cues.en: The room was packed with design mockups denser than a bridal shop's catalog.

cues.zh: 讽刺的是
cues.pinyin: feng3 ci4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Ironically,

cues.zh: 这姑娘对别人搭爱情舞台
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gu1 niang2 dui4 bie2 ren2 da1 ai4 qing2 wu3 tai2
cues.en: this woman built romantic stages for everyone else,

cues.zh: 自己却在情人节里和饭
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 que4 zai4 qing2 ren2 jie2 li3 he2 fan4
cues.en: yet spent Valentine's Day eating alone herself.

cues.zh: 谁知老顾听到情人节三个字
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 lao3 gu4 ting1 dao4 qing2 ren2 jie2 san1 ge4 zi4
cues.en: But when old Gu heard the words 'Valentine's Day,'

cues.zh: 差点当场发作
cues.pinyin: cha4 dian3 dang1 chang3 fa1 zuo4
cues.en: he nearly lost it on the spot.

cues.zh: 这刚分手的单身狗暴击
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gang1 fen1 shou3 de5 dan1 shen1 gou3 bao4 ji1
cues.en: This freshly single guy took a gut punch,

cues.zh: 简直比尸体味儿还上头
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 bi3 shi1 ti3 wei4 er2 hai2 shang4 tou5
cues.en: hitting him harder than even the smell of the corpse.

cues.zh: 鉴于屋内没有撬锁痕迹
cues.pinyin: jian4 yu2 wu1 nei4 mei2 you3 qiao4 suo3 hen2 ji4
cues.en: Given there were no signs of forced entry,

cues.zh: 众人推测
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 tui1 ce4
cues.en: everyone speculated:

cues.zh: 难道劳拉将美黑灯当太阳
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 lao2 la1 jiang1 mei3 hei1 deng1 dang1 tai4 yang2
cues.en: did Laura use the tanning lamp as if it were the sun,

cues.zh: 把自己烤成了人形红薯干
cues.pinyin: ba3 zi4 ji3 kao3 cheng2 le5 ren2 xing2 hong2 shu3 gan4
cues.en: and roast herself into a human-shaped dried sweet potato?

cues.zh: 更惊悚的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 jing1 song3 de5 shi4
cues.en: Even more unsettling,

cues.zh: 劳拉眼球突然在眼眶里转圈圈
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 yan3 qiu2 tu1 ran2 zai4 yan3 kuang4 li3 zhuan4 quan1 quan1
cues.en: Laura's eyeballs suddenly started rolling around in their sockets,

cues.zh: 吓得老顾差点当场暴走
cues.pinyin: xia4 de2 lao3 gu4 cha4 dian3 dang1 chang3 bao4 zou3
cues.en: startling Gu so badly he nearly freaked out on the spot.

cues.zh: 十日市里小谷根据日光预传推算
cues.pinyin: shi2 ri4 shi4 li3 xiao3 gu3 gen1 ju4 ri4 guang1 yu4 chuan2 tui1 suan4
cues.en: Afterward, Bones used the tanning bed's heat to calculate

cues.zh: 死亡时间大概在 32 到 38 小时
cues.pinyin: si3 wang2 shi2 jian1 da4 gai4 zai4 32 dao4 38 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: the time of death at roughly 32 to 38 hours prior.

cues.zh: 卡伊克拉克突然发现
cues.pinyin: ka3 yi1 ke4 la1 ke4 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: Cam suddenly discovered

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 富婆日光浴，结果被做成东北杀人菜。真相奇葩至极。《识骨寻踪》。

cues.zh: 劳拉身上的刺伤竟和心脏就隔层胸膜
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 shen1 shang4 de5 ci4 shang1 jing4 he2 xin1 zang4 jiu4 ge2 ceng2 xiong1 mo2
cues.en: that the stab wound on Laura's body was separated from her heart by just a layer of pleura.

cues.zh: 谋杀实锤了
cues.pinyin: mou2 sha1 shi2 chui2 le5
cues.en: Murder confirmed.

cues.zh: 卡米尔瞬间生无可恋
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 shun4 jian1 sheng1 wu2 ke3 lian4
cues.en: Cam instantly lost all will to live.

cues.zh: 眼看烛光晚餐要改成尸体冷餐会
cues.pinyin: yan3 kan4 zhu2 guang1 wan3 can1 yao4 gai3 cheng2 shi1 ti3 leng3 can1 hui4
cues.en: Just as her candlelit dinner was about to turn into a corpse buffet,

cues.zh: 嘴上抱怨着却突然设置破案倒计时
cues.pinyin: zui3 shang4 bao4 yuan4 zhe5 que4 tu1 ran2 she4 zhi4 po4 an4 dao4 ji4 shi2
cues.en: she complained aloud while suddenly setting a countdown to crack the case.

cues.zh: 这几要在爱情与死亡的 P K 赛里扳回一局
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ji3 yao4 zai4 ai4 qing2 yu3 si3 wang2 de5 P K sai4 li3 ban1 hui2 yi1 ju2
cues.en: She was determined to win a round in the PK battle between love and death.

cues.zh: 豪金在旁边吐槽
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 zai4 pang2 bian1 tu3 cao2
cues.en: Hodgins snarked from the side,

cues.zh: 结果被老婆安琪拉一脑瓜崩敲得直喊
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 bei4 lao3 po2 an1 qi2 la1 yi1 nao3 gua1 beng1 qiao1 de2 zhi2 han3
cues.en: only to get bonked on the head by his wife Angela and blurt the truth.

cues.zh: 谁知豪金突然来劲
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 hao2 jin1 tu1 ran2 lai2 jin4
cues.en: Who knew Hodgins suddenly got fired up —

cues.zh: 虽说和安琪拉早过了天逆期
cues.pinyin: sui1 shuo1 he2 an1 qi2 la1 zao3 guo4 le5 tian1 ni4 qi1
cues.en: though he and Angela were long past the honeymoon phase,

cues.zh: 但老婆那句情人节早过够了
cues.pinyin: dan4 lao3 po2 na4 ju4 qing2 ren2 jie2 zao3 guo4 gou4 le5
cues.en: his wife's line 'I'm sick of Valentine's Day already'

cues.zh: 听着比昆虫标本还扎心
cues.pinyin: ting1 zhe5 bi3 kun1 chong2 biao1 ben3 hai2 zha1 xin1
cues.en: stung worse than an insect specimen pin.

cues.zh: 她正琢磨送啥惊喜
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng4 zhuo2 mo2 song4 sha2 jing1 xi3
cues.en: While she was pondering what surprise to give,

cues.zh: 安琪拉就复原了劳拉画像
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 jiu4 fu4 yuan2 le5 lao2 la1 hua4 xiang4
cues.en: Angela had already reconstructed Laura's face.

cues.zh: 豪金突然揪着卡米尔追问
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 tu1 ran2 jiu1 zhe5 ka3 mi3 er3 zhui1 wen4
cues.en: Hodgins suddenly grabbed Cam and pressed her:

cues.zh: 孕妇到底要杀浪漫
cues.pinyin: yun4 fu4 dao4 di3 yao4 sha1 lang4 man4
cues.en: 'does being pregnant really kill the romance?'

cues.zh: 卡米尔却说
cues.pinyin: ka3 mi3 er3 que4 shuo1
cues.en: Cam just said,

cues.zh: 直至对方刚接完电话

items.title: 外星人探案

cues.zh: 对方却强装弹地

cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 zi4 ji3 hao3 de5 hen3

cues.zh: 鉴于老布和小谷之间有情况
cues.pinyin: jian4 yu2 lao3 bu4 he2 xiao3 gu3 zhi1 jian1 you3 qing2 kuang4

cues.zh: 安琪拉小脑怪一动
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 xiao3 nao3 guai4 yi1 dong4

cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 an4 shi4 xiao3 gu3 qing2 ren2 jie2 xu1 yao4 ren2 pei2
cues.en: and she quickly hinted that Bones needed company on Valentine's Day.

cues.zh: 老布当然知道安琪拉打的什么算摊
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 dang1 ran2 zhi1 dao4 an1 qi2 la1 da3 di1 shen2 me5 suan4 tan1

cues.zh: 不过并未做出反应
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 bing4 wei4 zuo4 chu1 fan3 ying4
cues.en: but didn't react to it.

cues.zh: 谁知电脑解锁后
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dian4 nao3 jie3 suo3 hou4
cues.en: But once the computer was unlocked,

cues.zh: 却跳出了命名鬼才的文件夹

cues.zh: 黑文狠的向黑帮警告

cues.zh: 面对家暴嫌疑

cues.zh: 丹尼尔赶紧喊冤

cues.zh: 两人之所以分居

cues.zh: 老布瞬间激动
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 shun4 jian1 ji1 dong4

cues.zh: 吓了小谷对着电话
cues.pinyin: xia4 le5 xiao3 gu3 dui4 zhe5 dian4 hua4

cues.zh: 光速甩锅

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】傅立叶变换啥原理？美颜和变声软件是怎么工作的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有小朋友问我为什么不同的人说话的
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 tong2 de5 ren2 shuo1 hua4 de5
cues.en: Recently a student asked me why different people's voices

cues.zh: 声音不一样呢
cues.pinyin: sheng1 yin1 bu4 yi2 yang4 ne5
cues.en: sound different.

cues.zh: 人们是怎么把不同的人说话声
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 shi4 zen3 me5 ba3 bu4 tong2 de5 ren2 shuo1 hua4 sheng1
cues.en: How do people distinguish different people's voices

cues.zh: 音区分开的呢
cues.pinyin: yin1 qu1 fen1 kai1 de5 ne5
cues.en: from one another?

cues.zh: 还有小朋友问我说这个美颜软件磨皮的原
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 mei3 yan2 ruan3 jian4 mo2 pi2 de5 yuan2
cues.en: Another student asked me what the principle behind

cues.zh: 理到底是什么
cues.pinyin: li3 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: skin-smoothing in beauty filter apps actually is.

cues.zh: 这里面其实都涉及到一个重要的数学概
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mian4 qi2 shi2 dou1 she4 ji2 dao4 yi2 ge4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shu4 xue2 gai4
cues.en: Both of these actually involve an important mathematical

cues.zh: 念傅里叶变换
cues.pinyin: nian4 fu4 li3 ye4 bian4 huan4
cues.en: concept: the Fourier transform.

cues.zh: 今天就想介绍一下这方面的知识
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 xiang3 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 fang1 mian4 de5 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: Today I want to introduce this topic.

cues.zh: 为了说傅里叶变换我们首先从一个简
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 shuo1 fu4 li3 ye4 bian4 huan4 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 cong2 yi2 ge4 jian3
cues.en: To explain the Fourier transform, let's first start with a simple

cues.zh: 单的变换说起
cues.pinyin: dan1 de5 bian4 huan4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: transformation.

cues.zh: 变换是数学里非常常见的一个概念
cues.pinyin: bian4 huan4 shi4 shu4 xue2 li3 fei1 chang2 chang2 jian4 de5 yi2 ge4 gai4 nian4
cues.en: Transformation is a very common concept in mathematics.

cues.zh: 比如说我们画一个平面直角坐标系
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 hua4 yi2 ge4 ping2 mian4 zhi2 jiao3 zuo4 biao1 xi4
cues.en: For example, let's draw a Cartesian coordinate plane.

cues.zh: 在平面直角坐标系上有一个向量 A
cues.pinyin: zai4 ping2 mian4 zhi2 jiao3 zuo4 biao1 xi4 shang4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiang4 liang4 A
cues.en: On this plane there's a vector A.

cues.zh: 这个 A 向量现在看起来是一个图对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 A xiang4 liang4 xian4 zai4 kan4 qi3 lai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 tu2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: This vector A currently looks like a picture, right?

cues.zh: 但是我们可以把它变成是一个数
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 bian4 cheng2 shi4 yi2 ge4 shu4
cues.en: But we can turn it into a number.

cues.zh: 怎么变成一个数呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 shu4 ne5
cues.en: How do we turn it into a number?

cues.zh: 首先我们来看 A 的横坐标
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 A de5 heng2 zuo4 biao1
cues.en: First let's look at A's x-coordinate.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】傅立叶变换啥原理？美颜和变声软件是怎么工作的？

cues.zh: A 的横坐标可能是 2 对吧
cues.pinyin: A de5 heng2 zuo4 biao1 ke3 neng2 shi4 2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: A's x-coordinate might be 2, right?

cues.zh: A 的纵坐标可能是 1
cues.pinyin: A de5 zong4 zuo4 biao1 ke3 neng2 shi4 1
cues.en: A's y-coordinate might be 1.

cues.zh: 所以我们就可以做变化了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zuo4 bian4 hua4 le5
cues.en: So now we can do the transformation.

cues.zh: 我们说这个 A 我们可以把它写作什么呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 A wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 xie3 zuo4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: We can say A can be written as what?

cues.zh: 写作横坐标为 2
cues.pinyin: xie3 zuo4 heng2 zuo4 biao1 wei4 2
cues.en: Written as the pair with x-coordinate 2

cues.zh: 纵坐标为 1 的这么一个数对不对
cues.pinyin: zong4 zuo4 biao1 wei4 1 de5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 shu4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: and y-coordinate 1 — right?

cues.zh: 同样我还可以再画一个向量 B
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 wo3 hai2 ke3 yi3 zai4 hua4 yi2 ge4 xiang4 liang4 B
cues.en: Similarly, I can draw another vector B.

cues.zh: 这个向量 B 向量 B 它的横坐标是 1
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiang4 liang4 B xiang4 liang4 B ta1 de5 heng2 zuo4 biao1 shi4 1
cues.en: This vector B has an x-coordinate of 1.

cues.zh: 它的纵坐标是 2 对吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zong4 zuo4 biao1 shi4 2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Its y-coordinate is 2, right?

cues.zh: 那我可以说 B 就是横坐标是 1 纵坐标是 2
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 ke3 yi3 shuo1 B jiu4 shi4 heng2 zuo4 biao1 shi4 1 zong4 zuo4 biao1 shi4 2
cues.en: So I can say B is the pair with x-coordinate 1, y-coordinate 2.

cues.zh: 从这一点上看 A 和 B 这两个图就都
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 yi4 dian3 shang4 kan4 A he2 B zhe4 liang3 ge4 tu2 jiu4 dou1
cues.en: From this point on, both pictures A and B

cues.zh: 变成了一组数
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 le5 yi1 zu3 shu4
cues.en: have become pairs of numbers.

cues.zh: 这实际上就是什么就是一组变换
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ji4 shang4 jiu4 shi4 shen2 me5 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zu3 bian4 huan4
cues.en: This is actually what we call a transformation.

cues.zh: 而反过来说这组数我们也可以对
cues.pinyin: er2 fan3 guo4 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 zu3 shu4 wo3 men5 ye3 ke3 yi3 dui4
cues.en: Conversely, this pair of numbers can also

cues.zh: 应到这个图上
cues.pinyin: ying1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 tu2 shang4
cues.en: correspond back to the picture.

cues.zh: 这就叫逆变换那它们两个是一一对应的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 jiao4 ni4 bian4 huan4 na4 ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 shi4 yi1 yi1 dui4 ying4 de5
cues.en: This is called the inverse transform — the two correspond one-to-one.

cues.zh: 说你变换的又能怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ni3 bian4 huan4 de5 you4 neng2 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: So what's the point of transforming it?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】傅立叶变换啥原理？美颜和变声软件是怎么工作的？

cues.zh: 其实是代表了你在 x 的方向上有
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 dai4 biao3 le5 ni3 zai4 x de5 fang1 xiang4 shang4 you3
cues.en: It actually represents how many units

cues.zh: 几个单位长度
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 dan1 wei4 chang2 du4
cues.en: you have in the x direction.

cues.zh: 每一个单位长度我可以写作一
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 dan1 wei4 chang2 du4 wo3 ke3 yi3 xie3 zuo4 yi1
cues.en: Each unit length I can write as

cues.zh: 个叫 ex 的向量
cues.pinyin: ge4 jiao4 ex de5 xiang4 liang4
cues.en: a vector called ex.

cues.zh: 那么你在 y 方向上有几个单位长度
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 zai4 y fang1 xiang4 shang4 you3 ji3 ge4 dan1 wei4 chang2 du4
cues.en: And how many units you have in the y direction

cues.zh: 每一个单位长度我们可以写作
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 dan1 wei4 chang2 du4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 xie3 zuo4
cues.en: each unit length we can write as

cues.zh: 一个 ey 的向量
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ey de5 xiang4 liang4
cues.en: a vector called ey.

cues.zh: ex 和 ey 有什么特点呢
cues.pinyin: ex he2 ey you3 shen2 me5 te4 dian3 ne5
cues.en: What properties do ex and ey have?

cues.zh: 我们看首先 E x 和 E y 的长度都是 1
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 kan4 shou3 xian1 E x he2 E y de5 chang2 du4 dou1 shi4 1
cues.en: First, the lengths of both ex and ey are 1.

cues.zh: 从数学上讲 E x E x 这叫内积对吧
cues.pinyin: cong2 shu4 xue2 shang4 jiang3 E x E x zhe4 jiao4 nei4 ji1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Mathematically, ex dot ex is called the dot product, right?

cues.zh: 它应该等于 E y E y E y 它也应该等于 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 ying1 gai1 deng3 yu2 E y E y E y ta1 ye3 ying1 gai1 deng3 yu2 1
cues.en: It should equal 1, and ey dot ey should also equal 1.

cues.zh: 也就是说它的长度是 1 内积是 1
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ta1 de5 chang2 du4 shi4 1 nei4 ji1 shi4 1
cues.en: That is, their length is 1 and their dot product with themselves is 1.

cues.zh: 而 E y E y 是多少
cues.pinyin: er2 E y E y shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: And what is ex dot ey?

cues.zh: 只要我们学过高中的数学就都知道
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 wo3 men5 xue2 guo4 gao1 zhong1 de5 shu4 xue2 jiu4 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: As long as we've learned high school math, we know

cues.zh: 如果两个向量是互相垂直的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 liang3 ge4 xiang4 liang4 shi4 hu4 xiang1 chui2 zhi2 de5
cues.en: that if two vectors are perpendicular to each other,

cues.zh: 它们做内积的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zuo4 nei4 ji1 de5 hua4
cues.en: when you take their dot product,

cues.zh: 实际上是两个向量的长度再乘以 cos 一夹角
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 liang3 ge4 xiang4 liang4 de5 chang2 du4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 cos yi1 jia1 jiao3
cues.en: it's actually the product of their lengths times the cosine of the angle between them.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】傅立叶变换啥原理？美颜和变声软件是怎么工作的？

cues.zh: 咱们首先来说一下傅里叶级数
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 fu4 li3 ye4 ji2 shu4
cues.en: Let's first talk about the Fourier series.

cues.zh: 负利液极数是在 180 7 年的时候
cues.pinyin: fu4 li4 ye4 ji2 shu4 shi4 zai4 180 7 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: The Fourier series was first proposed in 1807

cues.zh: 由这个法国的学者傅里叶最早提出的
cues.pinyin: you2 zhe4 ge5 fa3 guo2 de5 xue2 zhe3 fu4 li3 ye4 zui4 zao3 ti2 chu1 de5
cues.en: by the French scholar Fourier.

cues.zh: 他说什么呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What did he say?

cues.zh: 负利液就说说任何一个周期性的函数
cues.pinyin: fu4 li4 ye4 jiu4 shuo1 shuo1 ren4 he2 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 xing4 de5 han2 shu4
cues.en: Fourier said that any periodic function

cues.zh: 这个函数它是周期性的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 ta1 shi4 zhou1 qi1 xing4 de5
cues.en: a function that is periodic

cues.zh: 这个周期性的函数 FT
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhou1 qi1 xing4 de5 han2 shu4 FT
cues.en: this periodic function f(t)

cues.zh: T 是横坐标
cues.pinyin: T shi4 heng2 zuo4 biao1
cues.en: where t is the x-axis variable

cues.zh: 这个 FT 表示一个周期性函数
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 FT biao3 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 xing4 han2 shu4
cues.en: this f(t) represents a periodic function

cues.zh: 它都可以进行变换
cues.pinyin: ta1 dou1 ke3 yi3 jin4 xing2 bian4 huan4
cues.en: can always be transformed.

cues.zh: 变换成什么呢
cues.pinyin: bian4 huan4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Transformed into what?

cues.zh: 变换成一系列正余弦函数的和
cues.pinyin: bian4 huan4 cheng2 yi1 xi4 lie4 zheng4 yu2 xian2 han2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: Transformed into the sum of a series of sine and cosine functions.

cues.zh: 一系列的正余弦函数的和
cues.pinyin: yi1 xi4 lie4 de5 zheng4 yu2 xian2 han2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: A sum of a series of sine and cosine functions.

cues.zh: 我们可以把这个函数写成一大
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 han2 shu4 xie3 cheng2 yi1 da4
cues.en: We can write this function as a huge

cues.zh: 堆的正弦或者
cues.pinyin: dui1 de5 zheng4 xian2 huo4 zhe3
cues.en: pile of sine functions, or

cues.zh: 余弦函数的和
cues.pinyin: yu2 xian2 han2 shu4 de5 he2
cues.en: a sum of cosine functions.

cues.zh: 这个正余弦函数是什么
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zheng4 yu2 xian2 han2 shu4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What are these sine and cosine functions?

cues.zh: 其实就是我们刚才所谓的这个 EX 和 E Y
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 gang1 cai2 suo3 wei4 de5 zhe4 ge5 EX he2 E Y
cues.en: They're actually the ex and ey we just mentioned.

cues.zh: 对吧就是一组正交机
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zu3 zheng4 jiao1 ji1
cues.en: Right, they're an orthogonal basis.

cues.zh: 为什么这个式子是成立的呢

cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 ni4 bian4 huan4 shi4 xian3 er2 yi4 jian4 de5
cues.en: Its inverse transform is obvious.

cues.zh: 就是如果我把一大堆正于弦给加起来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 wo3 ba3 yi1 da4 dui1 zheng4 yu2 xian2 gei3 jia1 qi3 lai2

cues.en: let's see what it necessarily becomes after adding them up.

cues.zh: 变成周期性函数
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 zhou1 qi1 xing4 han2 shu4
cues.en: It becomes a periodic function.

cues.zh: 但是反过来是不是所有的周期性函数都能
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 fan3 guo4 lai2 shi4 bu2 shi4 suo3 you3 de5 zhou1 qi1 xing4 han2 shu4 dou1 neng2
cues.en: But conversely, can every periodic function

cues.zh: 变成正于弦呢
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 zheng4 yu2 xian2 ne5
cues.en: be turned into sines and cosines?

cues.zh: 傅利叶其实就提出了这样的一个观点
cues.pinyin: fu4 li4 ye4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 ti2 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 guan1 dian3

cues.zh: 事实上我们经过数学证明
cues.pinyin: shi4 shi2 shang4 wo3 men5 jing1 guo4 shu4 xue2 zheng4 ming2
cues.en: In fact, after mathematical proof,

cues.zh: 傅利叶说的是对的
cues.pinyin: fu4 li4 ye4 shuo1 de5 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: what Fourier said is correct.

cues.zh: 确实是可以这个样子的
cues.pinyin: que4 shi2 shi4 ke3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: It can indeed be done this way.

cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 hua4 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 xing4 han2 shu4
cues.en: For example, let's draw a periodic function.

cues.zh: 横坐标是时间 t
cues.pinyin: heng2 zuo4 biao1 shi4 shi2 jian1 t
cues.en: The x-axis is time t.

cues.zh: 纵坐标是 ft
cues.pinyin: zong4 zuo4 biao1 shi4 ft
cues.en: The y-axis is f(t).

cues.zh: 这个周期性函数长得比较奇怪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhou1 qi1 xing4 han2 shu4 zhang3 de2 bi3 jiao4 qi2 guai4
cues.en: This periodic function looks rather strange.

cues.zh: 比如说是这个样子的
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: For example, it looks like this.

cues.zh: 这个样子的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: Like this.

cues.zh: 好它是一个周期性的对吧
cues.pinyin: hao3 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 xing4 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: OK, it's periodic, right?

cues.zh: 好那么我们现在把它可以分解成一系列
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ba3 ta1 ke3 yi3 fen1 jie3 cheng2 yi1 xi4 lie4
cues.en: OK, so now we can decompose it into a series

cues.zh: 的正余线函数
cues.pinyin: de5 zheng4 yu2 xian4 han2 shu4

cues.zh: 那么怎么进行分解呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zen3 me5 jin4 xing2 fen1 jie3 ne5
cues.en: So how do we do the decomposition?

cues.zh: 首先可能这个正余线函数有频率比较低的
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ke3 neng2 zhe4 ge5 zheng4 yu2 xian4 han2 shu4 you3 pin2 lv4 bi3 jiao4 di1 de5

cues.zh: 在这个方向上就是它的频率频率对吧

cues.en: But if we look from this side,

cues.en: looking from this side, you'll find

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】黎曼猜想（三）世界上最难赚的100万美元

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 经过前两期的学习我们已经知道了黎
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 qian2 liang3 qi1 de5 xue2 xi2 wo3 men5 yi3 jing1 zhi1 dao4 le5 li2
cues.en: After the last two episodes, we already know what the Rie-

cues.zh: 曼函数是什么
cues.pinyin: man4 han2 shu4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: -mann function is.

cues.zh: 我们也知道了黎曼猜想与素数
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ye3 zhi1 dao4 le5 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 yu3 su4 shu4
cues.en: We also know that the Riemann Hypothesis has

cues.zh: 有很强的关系
cues.pinyin: you3 hen3 qiang2 de5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: a strong relationship with prime numbers.

cues.zh: 那么今天我们终于要讲一讲黎曼猜想
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 zhong1 yu2 yao4 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: So today we're finally going to talk about what the Riemann Hypothesis

cues.zh: 到底是什么了
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 le5
cues.en: actually is.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说一下黎曼猜想的提出
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 de5 ti2 chu1
cues.en: Let's first talk about how the Riemann Hypothesis was proposed.

cues.zh: 黎曼猜想自然是黎曼提出来的
cues.pinyin: li2 man4 cai1 xiang3 zi4 ran2 shi4 li2 man4 ti2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: The Riemann Hypothesis was naturally proposed by Riemann himself.

cues.zh: 它是在 18 59 年的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 zai4 18 59 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: It was in the year 1859

cues.zh: 德国的数学家黎曼当选为柏林的科
cues.pinyin: de2 guo2 de5 shu4 xue2 jia1 li2 man4 dang1 xuan3 wei4 bo2 lin2 de5 ke1
cues.en: that the German mathematician Riemann was elected as a corresponding

cues.zh: 学院通讯院士
cues.pinyin: xue2 yuan4 tong1 xun4 yuan4 shi4
cues.en: member of the Berlin Academy of Sciences.

cues.zh: 那么为了回应它这个荣誉就写了一篇
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 le5 hui2 ying4 ta1 zhe4 ge5 rong2 yu4 jiu4 xie3 le5 yi1 pian1
cues.en: In response to this honor, he wrote

cues.zh: 八页纸的论文
cues.pinyin: ba1 ye4 zhi3 de5 lun4 wen2
cues.en: an eight-page paper.

cues.zh: 这个论文叫论小于某值的素数个数
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lun4 wen2 jiao4 lun4 xiao3 yu2 mou3 zhi2 de5 su4 shu4 ge4 shu4
cues.en: This paper is called "On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude."

cues.zh: 小于某值的素数个数素数就是质数
cues.pinyin: xiao3 yu2 mou3 zhi2 de5 su4 shu4 ge4 shu4 su4 shu4 jiu4 shi4 zhi4 shu4
cues.en: "The number of primes less than a given value" — primes means prime numbers.

items.title: 李永乐老师

cues.zh: 就是问小于一个值它的质数有几个
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wen4 xiao3 yu2 yi2 ge4 zhi2 ta1 de5 zhi4 shu4 you3 ji3 ge4
cues.en: That is, it asks how many primes there are below a given value.

cues.zh: 这个问题欧拉和高斯都研究过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 ou1 la1 he2 gao1 si1 dou1 yan2 jiu1 guo4
cues.en: Both Euler and Gauss had studied this problem.

cues.zh: 欧拉当时提出了一个观点
cues.pinyin: ou1 la1 dang1 shi2 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 guan1 dian3
cues.en: Euler proposed a view at the time.

cues.zh: 他说这个素数个数 x 约等于 x 除以 lnx
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 su4 shu4 ge4 shu4 x yue1 deng3 yu2 x chu2 yi3 lnx
cues.en: He said the number of primes, x, is approximately equal to x divided by ln x.

cues.zh: 大概是这么个数
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 me5 ge4 shu4
cues.en: That's roughly the number.

cues.zh: 但是差多少呢欧拉也没有太搞清楚
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 cha4 duo1 shao3 ne5 ou1 la1 ye3 mei2 you3 tai4 gao3 qing1 chu3
cues.en: But how much the difference was, even Euler never quite figured out.

cues.zh: 然后是高斯这个高斯他提出了素数猜想
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 shi4 gao1 si1 zhe4 ge5 gao1 si1 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 su4 shu4 cai1 xiang3
cues.en: Then there was Gauss, who proposed the prime number conjecture,

cues.zh: 后来被证实为素数定理
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 bei4 zheng4 shi2 wei4 su4 shu4 ding4 li3
cues.en: which was later proven and became the Prime Number Theorem.

cues.zh: 他说这个 x 等于一个积分从 0 积分到 x
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 x deng3 yu2 yi2 ge4 ji1 fen1 cong2 0 ji1 fen1 dao4 x
cues.en: He said this x equals an integral from 0 to x

cues.zh: d t 除以 l n t 再加一个余向 c
cues.pinyin: d t chu2 yi3 l n t zai4 jia1 yi2 ge4 yu2 xiang4 c
cues.en: of dt over ln t, plus a remainder term C.

cues.zh: 但是这两个人的研究其实还没有完全搞清
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 yan2 jiu1 qi2 shi2 hai2 mei2 you3 wan2 quan2 gao3 qing1
cues.en: But these two men's research hadn't fully worked out

cues.zh: 楚素数的分布
cues.pinyin: chu3 su4 shu4 de5 fen1 bu4
cues.en: the distribution of primes.

cues.zh: 黎曼就想顺着他们的研究继续
cues.pinyin: li2 man4 jiu4 xiang3 shun4 zhe5 ta1 men5 de5 yan2 jiu1 ji4 xu4
cues.en: Riemann wanted to follow their research and push it

cues.zh: 往下深入一步
cues.pinyin: wang3 xia4 shen1 ru4 yi1 bu4
cues.en: a step further.

cues.zh: 他是从当时欧拉提出的欧拉连程
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 cong2 dang1 shi2 ou1 la1 ti2 chu1 de5 ou1 la1 lian2 cheng2
cues.en: He derived it from Euler's product formula,

cues.zh: 定理得出来的
cues.pinyin: ding4 li3 de2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: which Euler had proposed at the time.

cues.zh: 黎曼把当时欧拉已经研究过的
cues.pinyin: li2 man4 ba3 dang1 shi2 ou1 la1 yi3 jing1 yan2 jiu1 guo4 de5
cues.en: Riemann took what Euler had already studied

cues.zh: 而且一个屎然后旁边一个围

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】为什么十五的月亮十六圆？你之前的理解可能都错了

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 中秋节到了值此佳节
cues.pinyin: zhong1 qiu1 jie2 dao4 le5 zhi2 ci3 jia1 jie2
cues.en: Mid-Autumn Festival has arrived, and on this festive occasion,

cues.zh: 祝各位小朋友人随月安好岁岁常团圆
cues.pinyin: zhu4 ge4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 ren2 sui2 yue4 an1 hao3 sui4 sui4 chang2 tuan2 yuan2
cues.en: I wish all the children peace like the moon, and reunion every year.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友跟我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a child asked me something.

cues.zh: 他经常听说一句话 15 的月亮 16 圆
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing1 chang2 ting1 shuo1 yi1 ju4 hua4 15 de5 yue4 liang4 16 yuan2
cues.en: He often hears the saying "the moon on the 15th, round on the 16th."

cues.zh: 他想问我这句话到底是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wen4 wo3 zhe4 ju4 hua4 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: He wanted to ask me what this saying actually means.

cues.zh: 是不是说 16 的月亮比 15 更圆呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 bu2 shi4 shuo1 16 de5 yue4 liang4 bi3 15 geng4 yuan2 ne5
cues.en: Does it mean the moon on the 16th is rounder than on the 15th?

cues.zh: 还有月有阴晴圆缺
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yue4 you3 yin1 qing2 yuan2 que1
cues.en: Also, the moon waxes and wanes.

cues.zh: 这个变化跟日子到底是什么关系
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bian4 hua4 gen1 ri4 zi5 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: What's the real relationship between this change and the date?

cues.zh: 我们能不能看月亮就快速确定
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 neng2 bu4 neng2 kan4 yue4 liang4 jiu4 kuai4 su4 que4 ding4
cues.en: Can we quickly determine

cues.zh: 农历的日子呢
cues.pinyin: nong2 li4 de5 ri4 zi5 ne5
cues.en: the lunar calendar date just by looking at the moon?

cues.zh: 今天我们就跟大家聊一聊月相的问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 gen1 da4 jia1 liao2 yi1 liao2 yue4 xiang4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's talk about the phases of the moon.

cues.zh: 认真听十几分钟
cues.pinyin: ren4 zhen1 ting1 shi2 ji3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Listen carefully for just over ten minutes,

cues.zh: 你不光能够根据月亮快速地算出农历日子
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 guang1 neng2 gou4 gen1 ju4 yue4 liang4 kuai4 su4 di4 suan4 chu1 nong2 li4 ri4 zi5
cues.en: and you'll not only be able to quickly figure out the lunar date from the moon,

cues.zh: 还能够弄明白 15 的月亮 16 圆到
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 gou4 nong4 ming2 bai2 15 de5 yue4 liang4 16 yuan2 dao4
cues.en: but also understand what "the moon on the 15th, round on the 16th"

cues.zh: 底是什么意思
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: really means.

cues.zh: 我们首先先来说一下农历月
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 nong2 li4 yue4
cues.en: First, let's talk about the lunar month.

cues.zh: 我们知道农历是阴阳合历
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 nong2 li4 shi4 yin1 yang2 he2 li4
cues.en: We know the lunar calendar is a lunisolar calendar.

cues.zh: 一个农历月其实就是月亮阴晴圆缺变
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 nong2 li4 yue4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 yue4 liang4 yin1 qing2 yuan2 que1 bian4
cues.en: A lunar month is actually the cycle of the moon's

cues.zh: 化的一个周期
cues.pinyin: hua4 de5 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: waxing and waning.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】为什么十五的月亮十六圆？你之前的理解可能都错了

cues.zh: 那么这个周期有多长呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 zhou1 qi1 you3 duo1 zhang3 ne5
cues.en: So how long is this cycle?

cues.zh: 我们看假如这是太阳
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 kan4 jia3 ru2 zhe4 shi4 tai4 yang2
cues.en: Let's see — suppose this is the sun,

cues.zh: 然后太阳旁边是地球
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 tai4 yang2 pang2 bian1 shi4 di4 qiu2
cues.en: and next to the sun is the Earth,

cues.zh: 在地球旁边是月亮
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 qiu2 pang2 bian1 shi4 yue4 liang4
cues.en: and next to the Earth is the moon.

cues.zh: 月亮围绕地球旋转
cues.pinyin: yue4 liang4 wei2 rao4 di4 qiu2 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: The moon revolves around the Earth.

cues.zh: 月亮围绕地球旋转
cues.pinyin: yue4 liang4 wei2 rao4 di4 qiu2 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: The moon revolves around the Earth.

cues.zh: 转一圈多长时间呢
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yi1 quan1 duo1 zhang3 shi2 jian1 ne5
cues.en: How long does one revolution take?

cues.zh: 如果你在恒星参考系上看
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zai4 heng2 xing1 can1 kao3 xi4 shang4 kan4
cues.en: If you look at it from the reference frame of the stars,

cues.zh: 月亮转了 360 度
cues.pinyin: yue4 liang4 zhuan3 le5 360 du4
cues.en: the moon turns 360 degrees.

cues.zh: 这个我们就称之为恒星月
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 heng2 xing1 yue4
cues.en: We call this the sidereal month —

cues.zh: 是以恒星参考系来看月亮转 360 度的时间
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi3 heng2 xing1 can1 kao3 xi4 lai2 kan4 yue4 liang4 zhuan3 360 du4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: the time for the moon to turn 360 degrees as seen from the stellar reference frame.

cues.zh: 这个时间是 27 3 天
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 jian1 shi4 27 3 tian1
cues.en: This time is 27.3 days.

cues.zh: 但是大家注意
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 da4 jia1 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: But notice this:

cues.zh: 这个时间并不是月亮阴晴圆缺变化的周期
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 jian1 bing4 bu2 shi4 yue4 liang4 yin1 qing2 yuan2 que1 bian4 hua4 de5 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: this is not actually the cycle of the moon's phases.

cues.zh: 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 因为在这段时间内怎么样
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 zhe4 duan4 shi2 jian1 nei4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: Because during this period,

cues.zh: 地球也在围绕太阳转
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 ye3 zai4 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 zhuan3
cues.en: the Earth is also revolving around the sun.

cues.zh: 地球可能转到这个位置去了
cues.pinyin: di4 qiu2 ke3 neng2 zhuan3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4 qu4 le5
cues.en: The Earth may have moved to this position.

items.title: 李永乐老师

cues.zh: 就是在地球上看这个月向的一个完整周期
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zai4 di4 qiu2 shang4 kan4 zhe4 ge5 yue4 xiang4 de5 yi2 ge4 wan2 zheng3 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: So the full cycle of the moon's phase as seen from Earth

cues.zh: 硕望月
cues.pinyin: shuo4 wang4 yue4
cues.en: is called the synodic month.

cues.zh: 硕望月比恒星月长一点是 29 5 天
cues.pinyin: shuo4 wang4 yue4 bi3 heng2 xing1 yue4 zhang3 yi4 dian3 shi4 29 5 tian1
cues.en: The synodic month is a bit longer than the sidereal month — 29.5 days.

cues.zh: 对吧就是因为地球还在绕着太阳旋转
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 di4 qiu2 hai2 zai4 rao4 zhe5 tai4 yang2 xuan2 zhuan3
cues.en: Right, because the Earth is still orbiting the sun.

cues.zh: 那么为了跟硕望月相匹配
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 le5 gen1 shuo4 wang4 yue4 xiang4 pi3 pei4
cues.en: So to match the synodic month,

cues.zh: 我们农历就把大月定为 30 天
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 nong2 li4 jiu4 ba3 da4 yue4 ding4 wei4 30 tian1
cues.en: our lunar calendar sets a "big month" as 30 days,

cues.zh: 而小月就定为 29 天
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 yue4 jiu4 ding4 wei4 29 tian1
cues.en: and a "small month" as 29 days.

cues.zh: 这样一来平均来讲
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 ping2 jun1 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: This way, on average,

cues.zh: 一个月 29 5 天就和硕望月相匹配了
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 29 5 tian1 jiu4 he2 shuo4 wang4 yue4 xiang4 pi3 pei4 le5
cues.en: a month of 29.5 days matches the synodic month.

cues.zh: 而硕望月就是月亮阴晴圆缺变
cues.pinyin: er2 shuo4 wang4 yue4 jiu4 shi4 yue4 liang4 yin1 qing2 yuan2 que1 bian4
cues.en: And the synodic month is the cycle of the moon's

cues.zh: 转一圈的时间
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yi1 quan1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: waxing and waning —

cues.zh: 它是相对于太阳地球这个参考器
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 xiang1 dui4 yu2 tai4 yang2 di4 qiu2 zhe4 ge5 can1 kao3 qi4
cues.en: it's the time for one revolution relative to

cues.zh: 转一圈的实践
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yi1 quan1 de5 shi2 jian4
cues.en: the sun-Earth reference frame.

cues.zh: 好那么我们下面就要讨论一下月向了
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 wo3 men5 xia4 mian4 jiu4 yao4 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 yue4 xiang4 le5
cues.en: Now let's discuss the moon's phases.

cues.zh: 月向它的变化是什么样的一个规律呢
cues.pinyin: yue4 xiang4 ta1 de5 bian4 hua4 shi4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 gui1 lv4 ne5
cues.en: What pattern does the change in the moon's phase follow?

cues.zh: 第二个月向
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 yue4 xiang4
cues.en: The second position,

cues.zh: 这个延长线上叫 E
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yan2 chang2 xian4 shang4 jiao4 E
cues.en: this point on the extended line is called E,

cues.zh: 这个位置 F G 还有 H
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wei4 zhi4 F G hai2 you3 H
cues.en: this position, F, G, and H,

cues.zh: 然后又回到了 A 点是吧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you4 hui2 dao4 le5 A dian3 shi4 ba5
cues.en: and then it comes back to point A, right?

cues.zh: 月亮可能处于不同的位置
cues.pinyin: yue4 liang4 ke3 neng2 chu3 yu2 bu4 tong2 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: The moon can be at different positions.

cues.zh: 那么我们把月亮围绕地球转一转的时间
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 ba3 yue4 liang4 wei2 rao4 di4 qiu2 zhuan3 yi1 zhuan3 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: So we define the time for the moon to go around the Earth once

cues.zh: 就定为一个农历月
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ding4 wei4 yi2 ge4 nong2 li4 yue4
cues.en: as one lunar month.

cues.zh: 大家要明白
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 yao4 ming2 bai2
cues.en: Everyone should understand this:

cues.zh: 因为太阳光从左侧照射过来
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 tai4 yang2 guang1 cong2 zuo3 ce4 zhao4 she4 guo4 lai2
