cues.zh: 噢他们把你吵醒了
cues.pinyin: o1 ta1 men5 ba3 ni3 chao3 xing3 le5
cues.en: "Oh, so they woke you up?"

cues.zh: 没有幸好当时我一直在练习打鼓
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 xing4 hao3 dang1 shi2 wo3 yi4 zhi2 zai4 lian4 xi2 da3 gu3
cues.en: "No, luckily I was practicing drums at the time"

cues.zh: 还没有睡觉
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 you3 shui4 jiao4
cues.en: "and hadn't gone to sleep yet."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话48｜刮到宾士｜吹风鸡｜胖娃娃｜罚老王｜发言权｜加油｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 珊珊我考你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 kao3 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Shanshan, let me quiz you."

cues.zh: 有一只鸡它很喜欢吹风为什么
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 zhi1 ji1 ta1 hen3 xi3 huan1 chui1 feng1 wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "There's a chicken that loves blowing in the wind — why?"

cues.zh: 因为是吹风鸡
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shi4 chui1 feng1 ji1
cues.en: "Because it's a 'wind-blowing chicken' (a pun on 'hair dryer')."

cues.zh: 答对了叮咚叮咚
cues.pinyin: da2 dui4 le5 ding1 dong1 ding1 dong1
cues.en: "Correct! Ding dong, ding dong!"

cues.zh: 神啊为什么我无论怎么减肥
cues.pinyin: shen2 a5 wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 wu2 lun4 zen3 me5 jian3 fei2
cues.en: "God, why is it that no matter how I diet,"

cues.zh: 都还是那么胖
cues.pinyin: dou1 hai2 shi4 na4 me5 pang4
cues.en: "I'm still just as fat?"

cues.zh: 噢那是因为你出生的时候
cues.pinyin: o1 na4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ni3 chu1 sheng1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "Oh, that's because when you were born,"

cues.zh: 你的爸妈给我吃给他们一个健康的胖娃娃
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 ba4 ma1 gei3 wo3 chi1 gei3 ta1 men5 yi2 ge4 jian4 kang1 de5 pang4 wa2 wa2
cues.en: "your parents asked me for a healthy chubby baby."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话48｜刮到宾士｜吹风鸡｜胖娃娃｜罚老王｜发言权｜加油｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 大大我问你喔
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Dada, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 有一天啊
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 a5
cues.en: "One day,"

cues.zh: 小明开车载老王去埃及
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 kai1 che1 zai4 lao3 wang2 qu4 ai1 ji2
cues.en: "Xiaoming drove Old Wang to Egypt."

cues.zh: 在路上他闯红灯
cues.pinyin: zai4 lu4 shang4 ta1 chuang3 hong2 deng1
cues.en: "On the way, he ran a red light"

cues.zh: 被警察拦下来
cues.pinyin: bei4 jing3 cha2 lan2 xia4 lai2
cues.en: "and got pulled over by the police."

cues.zh: 你猜警察会罚小明还是老王
cues.pinyin: ni3 cai1 jing3 cha2 hui4 fa2 xiao3 ming2 hai2 shi4 lao3 wang2
cues.en: "Guess who the police fined — Xiaoming or Old Wang?"

cues.zh: 当然是罚小明啊
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 shi4 fa2 xiao3 ming2 a5
cues.en: "Of course it's Xiaoming."

cues.zh: 因为小明开车的啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 ming2 kai1 che1 de5 a5
cues.en: "Because Xiaoming was the one driving."

cues.zh: 不是哦
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 o2
cues.en: "Nope."

cues.zh: 是罚老王哦
cues.pinyin: shi4 fa2 lao3 wang2 o2
cues.en: "It was Old Wang who got fined."

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Why?"

cues.zh: 因为埃及罚老王
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ai1 ji2 fa2 lao3 wang2
cues.en: "Because in Egypt, it's the Pharaoh (a pun on 'fine Old Wang')."

cues.zh: 老公啊
cues.pinyin: lao3 gong1 a5
cues.en: "Honey,"

cues.zh: 你最近老是说梦话
cues.pinyin: ni3 zui4 jin4 lao3 shi4 shuo1 meng4 hua4
cues.en: "you've been talking in your sleep a lot lately."

cues.zh: 要不要我陪你去医院检查一下身体啊
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 yao4 wo3 pei2 ni3 qu4 yi1 yuan4 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4 shen1 ti3 a5
cues.en: "Should I go with you to the hospital for a checkup?"

cues.zh: 不用不用如果医生给我治好这个毛病的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 bu4 yong4 ru2 guo3 yi1 sheng1 gei3 wo3 zhi4 hao3 zhe4 ge5 mao2 bing4 de5 hua4
cues.en: "No need, no need — if the doctor cured this problem of mine,"

cues.zh: 那么我在家里这一点点的发炎权都没有了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 zai4 jia1 li3 zhe4 yi4 dian3 dian3 de5 fa1 yan2 quan2 dou1 mei2 you3 le5
cues.en: "I wouldn't even have this tiny bit of right to speak at home."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话48｜刮到宾士｜吹风鸡｜胖娃娃｜罚老王｜发言权｜加油｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 晨晨哪一种水果会说话
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 na3 yi1 zhong3 shui3 guo3 hui4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: "Chenchen, which fruit can talk?"

cues.zh: 嗯应该是西瓜吧以为它会乖乖叫
cues.pinyin: n2 ying1 gai1 shi4 xi1 gua1 ba5 yi3 wei2 ta1 hui4 guai1 guai1 jiao4
cues.en: "Um, maybe watermelon? I figured it would just whine like a baby."

cues.zh: 葡萄佑因为它是葡萄它会喊佑
cues.pinyin: pu2 tao2 you4 yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 pu2 tao2 ta1 hui4 han3 you4
cues.en: "Grapefruit — because it's a grape, and it shouts 'you!'"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话48｜刮到宾士｜吹风鸡｜胖娃娃｜罚老王｜发言权｜加油｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有一天小明早上要去上班
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 zao3 shang4 yao4 qu4 shang4 ban1
cues.en: One day Xiaoming was about to leave for work in the morning.

cues.zh: 一打开车门就看到老婆写的小纸条
cues.pinyin: yi1 da3 kai1 che1 men2 jiu4 kan4 dao4 lao3 po2 xie3 de5 xiao3 zhi3 tiao2
cues.en: As soon as he opened the car door, he saw a little note his wife had written.

cues.zh: 一定要加油
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 yao4 jia1 you2
cues.en: "Be sure to fill up on gas" (a pun meaning both 'refuel' and 'keep working hard').

cues.zh: 当时小米觉得很感动
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 xiao3 mi3 jue2 de5 hen3 gan3 dong4
cues.en: At the time, Xiaoming felt really touched.

cues.zh: 心里想
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 xiang3
cues.en: He thought to himself,

cues.zh: 老婆
cues.pinyin: lao3 po2
cues.en: "Honey,

cues.zh: 我一定会努力赚钱
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 ding4 hui4 nu3 li4 zhuan4 qian2
cues.en: I'll definitely work hard to earn money

cues.zh: 让你过上好日子的
cues.pinyin: rang4 ni3 guo4 shang4 hao3 ri4 zi5 de5
cues.en: and give you a good life."

cues.zh: 十分钟后
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 zhong1 hou4
cues.en: Ten minutes later,

cues.zh: 小米的车子
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mi3 de5 che1 zi5
cues.en: Xiaoming's car,

cues.zh: 在高速公路上
cues.pinyin: zai4 gao1 su4 gong1 lu4 shang4
cues.en: on the highway,

cues.zh: 没有被拖掉车
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 bei4 tuo1 diao4 che1
cues.en: didn't break down —

cues.zh: 拖到了加油站
cues.pinyin: tuo1 dao4 le5 jia1 you2 zhan4
cues.en: it just got towed to a gas station.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 神秘包裹炸穿老实人胸膛
cues.pinyin: shen2 mi4 bao1 guo3 zha4 chuan1 lao3 shi2 ren2 xiong1 tang2
cues.en: A mysterious package blasted a hole clean through an honest man's chest.

cues.zh: 玩具店老板突然对着凶手扑通跪下
cues.pinyin: wan2 ju4 dian4 lao3 ban3 tu1 ran2 dui4 zhe5 xiong1 shou3 pu1 tong1 gui4 xia4
cues.en: The toy store owner suddenly dropped to his knees in front of the killer.

cues.zh: 案发现场频繁出现的变形金刚
cues.pinyin: an4 fa1 xian4 chang3 pin2 fan2 chu1 xian4 de5 bian4 xing2 jin1 gang1
cues.en: The Transformers toys that kept turning up at the crime scenes—

cues.zh: 竟是在为当年的坠崖案讨还血债
cues.pinyin: jing4 shi4 zai4 wei4 dang1 nian2 de5 zhui4 ya2 an4 tao3 huan2 xue4 zhai4
cues.en: —turned out to be revenge for a blood debt from an old cliff-fall case.

cues.zh: 一个下着瓢泼大雨的晚上值班室里
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xia4 zhe5 piao2 po1 da4 yu3 de5 wan3 shang4 zhi2 ban1 shi4 li3
cues.en: One night during a torrential downpour, in the duty room—

cues.zh: 把伞借给工友的车间工人王新军正窝在椅
cues.pinyin: ba3 san3 jie4 gei3 gong1 you3 de5 che1 jian1 gong1 ren2 wang2 xin1 jun1 zheng4 wo1 zai4 yi3
cues.en: —workshop worker Wang Xinjun, who'd lent his umbrella to a coworker, was curled up in his chair,

cues.zh: 子上美景搭菜
cues.pinyin: zi5 shang4 mei3 jing3 da1 cai4
cues.en: happily nibbling on a little snack,

cues.zh: 的心里吃迪雾
cues.pinyin: de5 xin1 li3 chi1 di2 wu4
cues.en: muttering to himself,

cues.zh: 这鬼天气真遭罪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gui3 tian1 qi4 zhen1 zao1 zui4
cues.en: "This damn weather is brutal."

cues.zh: 一阵急促的敲门声
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhen4 ji2 cu4 de5 qiao1 men2 sheng1
cues.en: Then came a sudden, urgent knock at the door.

cues.zh: 瞬间把寂静砸破了王新军抬头一看
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 ba3 ji4 jing4 za2 po4 le5 wang2 xin1 jun1 tai2 tou2 yi1 kan4
cues.en: It shattered the silence in an instant. Wang Xinjun looked up,

cues.zh: 一个穿雨衣的男人突然递过来一个包裹
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 chuan1 yu3 yi1 de5 nan2 ren2 tu1 ran2 di4 guo4 lai2 yi2 ge4 bao1 guo3
cues.en: and a man in a raincoat suddenly held out a package to him,

cues.zh: 然后转身就走
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhuan3 shen1 jiu4 zou3
cues.en: then turned and walked away.

cues.zh: 王新军纳闷的想自己最近哪买东西了
cues.pinyin: wang2 xin1 jun1 na4 men4 de5 xiang3 zi4 ji3 zui4 jin4 na3 mai3 dong1 xi1 le5
cues.en: Wang Xinjun wondered, puzzled—when had he ordered anything lately?

cues.zh: 漫天火光晃得人眼睛发疼
cues.pinyin: man4 tian1 huo3 guang1 huang3 de2 ren2 yan3 jing1 fa1 teng2
cues.en: The sky lit up with flames so bright it made people's eyes ache.

cues.zh: 凶手倒好慢悠悠点上烟
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 dao4 hao3 man4 you1 you1 dian3 shang4 yan1
cues.en: The killer, meanwhile, calmly lit up a cigarette

cues.zh: 跟逛菜市场似的淡定离开了
cues.pinyin: gen1 guang4 cai4 shi4 chang3 shi4 de5 dan4 ding4 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: and strolled off as leisurely as if he'd just been browsing a market.

cues.zh: 报警电话刚挂
cues.pinyin: bao4 jing3 dian4 hua4 gang1 gua4
cues.en: The emergency call had barely been hung up

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 北江刑侦大队嗖嗖的赶到现场
cues.pinyin: bei3 jiang1 xing2 zhen1 da4 dui4 sou1 sou1 de5 gan3 dao4 xian4 chang3
cues.en: when the Beijiang Criminal Investigation Squad raced to the scene.

cues.zh: 扒证据
cues.pinyin: ba1 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: Digging for evidence,

cues.zh: 屋里乱的像被推土机碾过
cues.pinyin: wu1 li3 luan4 de5 xiang4 bei4 tui1 tu3 ji1 nian3 guo4
cues.en: the room was as wrecked as if a bulldozer had rolled through it.

cues.zh: 值班是乍不成样的
cues.pinyin: zhi2 ban1 shi4 zha4 bu4 cheng2 yang4 de5
cues.en: The duty room was blown to pieces.

cues.zh: 萧嫣卫能呛死的人
cues.pinyin: xiao1 yan1 wei4 neng2 qiang1 si3 de5 ren2
cues.en: The smell of gunpowder smoke was choking.

cues.zh: 队长杜城扫一眼就心里门清
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhang3 du4 cheng2 sao3 yi1 yan3 jiu4 xin1 li3 men2 qing1
cues.en: Captain Du Cheng took one look and immediately understood what had happened.

cues.zh: 桌子就是爆炸的窝点
cues.pinyin: zhuo1 zi5 jiu4 shi4 bao4 zha4 de5 wo1 dian3
cues.en: The table was where the bomb had gone off.

cues.zh: 这案子发生在 8 月 29 号晚上
cues.pinyin: zhe4 an4 zi5 fa1 sheng1 zai4 8 yue4 29 hao4 wan3 shang4
cues.en: This case happened on the night of August 29th,

cues.zh: 地点在城郊的金属加工厂
cues.pinyin: di4 dian3 zai4 cheng2 jiao1 de5 jin1 shu3 jia1 gong1 chang3
cues.en: at a metal processing plant on the outskirts of town.

cues.zh: 可惜王新军当场被炸成重伤
cues.pinyin: ke3 xi1 wang2 xin1 jun1 dang1 chang3 bei4 zha4 cheng2 zhong4 shang1
cues.en: Unfortunately, Wang Xinjun was severely injured in the blast on the spot,

cues.zh: 送医院的路上没撑住还是走了
cues.pinyin: song4 yi1 yuan4 de5 lu4 shang4 mei2 cheng1 zhu4 hai2 shi4 zou3 le5
cues.en: and didn't make it—he passed away on the way to the hospital.

cues.zh: 好在案发时间晚
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 an4 fa1 shi2 jian1 wan3
cues.en: Luckily, since it happened so late at night,

cues.zh: 工人早就下班回家歇着了
cues.pinyin: gong1 ren2 zao3 jiu4 xia4 ban1 hui2 jia1 xie1 zhe5 le5
cues.en: the other workers had already gone home for the day.

cues.zh: 王新军的同事陈勇刚好去解决内急
cues.pinyin: wang2 xin1 jun1 de5 tong2 shi4 chen2 yong3 gang1 hao3 qu4 jie3 jue2 nei4 ji2
cues.en: Wang Xinjun's coworker Chen Yong happened to be off using the restroom

cues.zh: 躲过了这一劫
cues.pinyin: duo3 guo4 le5 zhe4 yi1 jie2
cues.en: and so narrowly escaped the disaster.

cues.zh: 杜城从现场的快递碎渣和玩具碎渣来看
cues.pinyin: du4 cheng2 cong2 xian4 chang3 de5 kuai4 di4 sui4 zha1 he2 wan2 ju4 sui4 zha1 lai2 kan4
cues.en: Judging from the shredded packaging and toy fragments at the scene, Du Cheng determined

cues.zh: 炸弹明显是装在快递里送进来的
cues.pinyin: zha4 dan4 ming2 xian3 shi4 zhuang1 zai4 kuai4 di4 li3 song4 jin4 lai2 de5
cues.en: the bomb had clearly been smuggled in inside a delivery package.

cues.zh: 不知怎么回事就砰的炸的
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 jiu4 peng1 de5 zha4 de5
cues.en: No one knew quite how, but it just went off with a bang.

cues.zh: 但是稀巴烂的快递和啥信息都瞅不清
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xi1 ba1 lan4 de5 kuai4 di4 he2 sha2 xin4 xi1 dou1 chou3 bu4 qing1
cues.en: But the package was blown to bits, with no clear information left on it.

cues.zh: 张局听完汇报气得吹胡子瞪眼呢
cues.pinyin: zhang1 ju2 ting1 wan2 hui4 bao4 qi4 de2 chui1 hu2 zi5 deng4 yan3 ne5
cues.en: After hearing the report, Director Zhang was so furious he was practically fuming.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 赶紧告诉了杜城
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 gao4 su4 le5 du4 cheng2
cues.en: He quickly passed the news on to Du Cheng:

cues.zh: 那起案子发生在丽江南区的单身公寓
cues.pinyin: na4 qi3 an4 zi5 fa1 sheng1 zai4 li4 jiang1 nan2 qu1 de5 dan1 shen1 gong1 yu4
cues.en: that case had happened in a bachelor apartment in the Lijiang South District.

cues.zh: 受害人赵建宇当场被炸的嗷嗷叫
cues.pinyin: shou4 hai4 ren2 zhao4 jian4 yu3 dang1 chang3 bei4 zha4 de5 ao2 ao2 jiao4
cues.en: The victim, Zhao Jianyu, had screamed in pain from the blast,

cues.zh: 到现在还在医院昏迷呢
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 hai2 zai4 yi1 yuan4 hun1 mi2 ne5
cues.en: and was still unconscious in the hospital.

cues.zh: 这两起爆炸案的手法简直是一个
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 qi3 bao4 zha4 an4 de5 shou3 fa3 jian3 zhi2 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: The methods used in these two bombings were practically

cues.zh: 模子刻出来的
cues.pinyin: mu2 zi5 ke4 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: cut from the same mold.

cues.zh: 凶手先把炸弹塞玩具里
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 xian1 ba3 zha4 dan4 sai1 wan2 ju4 li3
cues.en: The killer first hid the bomb inside a toy,

cues.zh: 再装成快递给受害者送过去
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhuang1 cheng2 kuai4 di4 gei3 shou4 hai4 zhe3 song4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: then disguised it as a delivery and sent it to the victim.

cues.zh: 这么一看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi1 kan4
cues.en: Looking at it this way—

cues.zh: 这不连环爆炸案吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 lian2 huan2 bao4 zha4 an4 ma5
cues.en: wasn't this a serial bombing case?

cues.zh: 明白这凶手还得接着下手
cues.pinyin: ming2 bai2 zhe4 xiong1 shou3 hai2 de2 jie1 zhe5 xia4 shou3
cues.en: And the two cases were only three weeks apart.

cues.zh: 明白这凶手还得接着索腰
cues.pinyin: ming2 bai2 zhe4 xiong1 shou3 hai2 de2 jie1 zhe5 suo3 yao1
cues.en: Clearly, this killer meant to strike again.

cues.zh: 可警方现在对他是哪路神仙
cues.pinyin: ke3 jing3 fang1 xian4 zai4 dui4 ta1 shi4 na3 lu4 shen2 xian1
cues.en: But the police had no idea what kind of person they were dealing with,

cues.zh: 为啥干着缺德事
cues.pinyin: wei4 sha2 gan4 zhe5 que1 de2 shi4
cues.en: why he was doing such rotten things,

cues.zh: 还完全窝不着头脑
cues.pinyin: hai2 wan2 quan2 wo1 bu4 zhe5 tou2 nao3
cues.en: and were completely stumped.

cues.zh: 张局一点不憨糊
cues.pinyin: zhang1 ju2 yi4 dian3 bu4 han1 hu2
cues.en: Director Zhang wasted no time.

cues.zh: 当场就向上级申请病案调查
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiu4 xiang4 shang4 ji2 shen1 qing3 bing4 an4 diao4 cha2
cues.en: He immediately requested that the two cases be merged into one investigation,

cues.zh: 还一个劲的催大家
cues.pinyin: hai2 yi2 ge4 jin4 de5 cui1 da4 jia1
cues.en: and kept pushing everyone

cues.zh: 着俩受害者之间的关联
cues.pinyin: zhe5 lia3 shou4 hai4 zhe3 zhi1 jian1 de5 guan1 lian2
cues.en: to dig up the connection between the two victims,

cues.zh: 争取快点把这案子给拿下
cues.pinyin: zheng1 qu3 kuai4 dian3 ba3 zhe4 an4 zi5 gei3 na2 xia4
cues.en: trying to crack the case as fast as possible.

cues.zh: 都城说连环爆炸案一半就两种
cues.pinyin: du1 cheng2 shuo1 lian2 huan2 bao4 zha4 an4 yi2 ban4 jiu4 liang3 zhong3
cues.en: Du Cheng said serial bombings generally come in two types.

cues.zh: 一种是有目标的报复
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 shi4 you3 mu4 biao1 de5 bao4 fu4
cues.en: One is targeted revenge.

cues.zh: 最吓人的就是没头没脑的搞恐怖袭击
cues.pinyin: zui4 xia4 ren2 de5 jiu4 shi4 mei2 tou2 mei2 nao3 de5 gao3 kong3 bu4 xi2 ji1
cues.en: The scariest kind is a random, senseless terror attack.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 只要一打开
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 yi1 da3 kai1
cues.en: As soon as it's opened,

cues.zh: 盒子砰的一下就炸的
cues.pinyin: he2 zi5 peng1 de5 yi1 xia4 jiu4 zha4 de5
cues.en: the box goes off with a bang.

cues.zh: 但嫌闻的是
cues.pinyin: dan4 xian2 wen2 de5 shi4
cues.en: But what's even more worrying is

cues.zh: 凶手的技术还在偷偷升级
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 de5 ji4 shu4 hai2 zai4 tou1 tou1 sheng1 ji2
cues.en: the killer's skills were quietly improving.

cues.zh: 跟第一枚炸弹比起来
cues.pinyin: gen1 di4 yi1 mei2 zha4 dan4 bi3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Compared with the first bomb,

cues.zh: 第二颗里居然颤的鳞
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ke1 li3 ju1 ran2 chan4 de5 lin2
cues.en: the second one actually had steel ball bearings packed inside.

cues.zh: 所以这次的威力和破坏性都大了不少
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ci4 de5 wei1 li4 he2 po4 huai4 xing4 dou1 da4 le5 bu4 shao3
cues.en: So its power and destructive force were considerably greater.

cues.zh: 这要是真出了第三起爆炸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yao4 shi4 zhen1 chu1 le5 di4 san1 qi3 bao4 zha4
cues.en: If a third bombing really happened,

cues.zh: 后果咋样
cues.pinyin: hou4 guo3 za3 yang4
cues.en: what would the consequences be?

cues.zh: 大伙儿用脚趾头想都知道
cues.pinyin: da4 huo3 er2 yong4 jiao3 zhi3 tou2 xiang3 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: Anyone could guess, without even trying hard.

cues.zh: 杜成一看事闹大了
cues.pinyin: du4 cheng2 yi1 kan4 shi4 nao4 da4 le5
cues.en: Once Du Cheng saw how serious things had gotten,

cues.zh: 立马分工干活
cues.pinyin: li4 ma3 fen1 gong1 gan4 huo2
cues.en: he immediately divided up the work.

cues.zh: 有人去查爆炸附近所有的监控录像
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 qu4 cha2 bao4 zha4 fu4 jin4 suo3 you3 de5 jian1 kong4 lu4 xiang4
cues.en: Some went to check all the surveillance footage near the blast sites,

cues.zh: 一部分人去追玩具的来源
cues.pinyin: yi1 bu4 fen4 ren2 qu4 zhui1 wan2 ju4 de5 lai2 yuan2
cues.en: some went to trace where the toys had come from,

cues.zh: 技术队去现场再找新线索
cues.pinyin: ji4 shu4 dui4 qu4 xian4 chang3 zai4 zhao3 xin1 xian4 suo3
cues.en: the forensics team went to the scene to look for fresh leads,

cues.zh: 剩下的去挨家挨户问周围居民
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 de5 qu4 ai1 jia1 ai1 hu4 wen4 zhou1 wei2 ju1 min2
cues.en: and the rest went door to door questioning nearby residents.

cues.zh: 杜成临走前还没忘记沈亿派魂
cues.pinyin: du4 cheng2 lin2 zou3 qian2 hai2 mei2 wang4 ji4 shen3 yi4 pai4 hun2
cues.en: Before he left, Du Cheng remembered to give Shen Yi an assignment too,

cues.zh: 让他对着监控
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 dui4 zhe5 jian1 kong4
cues.en: having him go through the surveillance footage

cues.zh: 把凶手的模样画出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 xiong1 shou3 de5 mu2 yang4 hua4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and sketch out what the killer looked like.

cues.zh: 可这次的案子真是邪门了
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 ci4 de5 an4 zi5 zhen1 shi4 xie2 men2 le5
cues.en: But this case turned out to be truly bizarre.

cues.zh: 一点线索都没摸着
cues.pinyin: yi4 dian3 xian4 suo3 dou1 mei2 mo1 zhe5
cues.en: Not a single clue could be found.

cues.zh: 小弟蒋锋刨断推大厅
cues.pinyin: xiao3 di4 jiang3 feng1 pao2 duan4 tui1 da4 ting1
cues.en: Junior officer Jiang Feng ran himself ragged

cues.zh: 发现快递站压根没这两弹的出库记录
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 kuai4 di4 zhan4 ya1 gen1 mei2 zhe4 liang3 dan4 de5 chu1 ku4 ji4 lu4
cues.en: and discovered the delivery station had no outgoing record for either package at all.

cues.zh: 也就是说凶手竟然装成怪力员亲
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 xiong1 shou3 jing4 ran2 zhuang1 cheng2 guai4 li4 yuan2 qin1
cues.en: In other words, the killer had disguised himself as a courier

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 自送炸弹上门
cues.pinyin: zi4 song4 zha4 dan4 shang4 men2
cues.en: and delivered the bombs to the doors personally.

cues.zh: 这胆儿也太肥了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dan3 er2 ye3 tai4 fei2 le5
cues.en: Talk about nerve.

cues.zh: 这线索严瞅着又断了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xian4 suo3 yan2 chou3 zhe5 you4 duan4 le5
cues.en: And just like that, the trail went cold again.

cues.zh: 更糟的是第一起爆炸案小区的监控
cues.pinyin: geng4 zao1 de5 shi4 di4 yi4 qi3 bao4 zha4 an4 xiao3 qu1 de5 jian1 kong4
cues.en: Worse still, the surveillance in the first bombing's neighborhood

cues.zh: 还在用老系统
cues.pinyin: hai2 zai4 yong4 lao3 xi4 tong3
cues.en: was still running on an old system,

cues.zh: 人像拍的模模糊糊根本看不清
cues.pinyin: ren2 xiang4 pai1 de5 mo2 mo2 hu2 hu2 gen1 ben3 kan4 bu4 qing1
cues.en: and the footage of people was too blurry to make out.

cues.zh: 金属加工厂的监控刚修好没多久
cues.pinyin: jin1 shu3 jia1 gong1 chang3 de5 jian1 kong4 gang1 xiu1 hao3 mei2 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: The metal plant's surveillance had only just been fixed;

cues.zh: 虽说换了新系统
cues.pinyin: sui1 shuo1 huan4 le5 xin1 xi4 tong3
cues.en: though it had a new system now,

cues.zh: 但拆换的时候好多时段都没录上
cues.pinyin: dan4 chai1 huan4 de5 shi2 hou4 hao3 duo1 shi2 duan4 dou1 mei2 lu4 shang4
cues.en: a lot of time slots went unrecorded during the changeover.

cues.zh: 关键是不管新系统还是老系统愣是没拍
cues.pinyin: guan1 jian4 shi4 bu4 guan3 xin1 xi4 tong3 hai2 shi4 lao3 xi4 tong3 leng4 shi4 mei2 pai1
cues.en: The key problem: neither the new system nor the old one managed to catch

cues.zh: 到凶手的影子
cues.pinyin: dao4 xiong1 shou3 de5 ying3 zi5
cues.en: so much as a glimpse of the killer.

cues.zh: 这家伙反侦察意识贼强
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jia1 huo5 fan3 zhen1 cha2 yi4 shi2 zei2 qiang2
cues.en: This guy had an extremely sharp sense for evading surveillance.

cues.zh: 摆明了故意躲开所有监控
cues.pinyin: bai3 ming2 liao3 gu4 yi4 duo3 kai1 suo3 you3 jian1 kong4
cues.en: He'd clearly dodged every camera on purpose.

cues.zh: 案子这下更难办了
cues.pinyin: an4 zi5 zhe4 xia4 geng4 nan2 ban4 le5
cues.en: The case had just gotten even harder to crack.

cues.zh: 为了捋一捋案情
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 lv3 yi1 lv3 an4 qing2
cues.en: Everyone was frowning,

cues.zh: 唯一块段案情呢
cues.pinyin: wei2 yi1 kuai4 duan4 an4 qing2 ne5
cues.en: and to try to sort out the details of the case,

cues.zh: 蒋锋先开了口
cues.pinyin: jiang3 feng1 xian1 kai1 le5 kou3
cues.en: Jiang Feng was the first to speak up.

cues.zh: 把俩受害者的情况扒了扒
cues.pinyin: ba3 lia3 shou4 hai4 zhe3 de5 qing2 kuang4 ba1 le5 ba1
cues.en: He'd dug into the backgrounds of both victims.

cues.zh: 第一个受害者赵建瑜是本地人
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 shou4 hai4 zhe3 zhao4 jian4 yu2 shi4 ben3 di4 ren2
cues.en: The first victim, Wang Xinjun, was a local.

cues.zh: 从这的中学毕业后就去澳大利亚念书了
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 de5 zhong1 xue2 bi4 ye4 hou4 jiu4 qu4 ao4 da4 li4 ya4 nian4 shu1 le5
cues.en: After graduating from middle school here, he'd gone to study in Australia,

cues.zh: 读完书才回国
cues.pinyin: du2 wan2 shu1 cai2 hui2 guo2
cues.en: and only came back after finishing his degree.

cues.zh: 回来后租了房子
cues.pinyin: hui2 lai2 hou4 zu1 le5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: After returning, he'd rented an apartment

cues.zh: 在金属加工厂当生产经理
cues.pinyin: zai4 jin1 shu3 jia1 gong1 chang3 dang1 sheng1 chan3 jing1 li3
cues.en: and worked as a production manager at the metal processing plant.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 老婆在家也要看的悬疑神剧，连环爆炸案，剧情反转再反转，当年豆瓣评分7.8.

cues.zh: 他的媳妇哭得上气不接下气
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xi2 fu4 ku1 de2 shang4 qi4 bu4 jie1 xia4 qi4
cues.en: His wife was crying so hard she could barely catch her breath,

cues.zh: 一个劲的求警方给王新军讨个公道
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 jin4 de5 qiu2 jing3 fang1 gei3 wang2 xin1 jun1 tao3 ge4 gong1 dao4
cues.en: begging the police over and over to get justice for Wang Xinjun.

cues.zh: 小两口刚结婚没几天就出了这事
cues.pinyin: xiao3 liang3 kou3 gang1 jie2 hun1 mei2 ji3 tian1 jiu4 chu1 le5 zhe4 shi4
cues.en: The young couple had only been married a few days when this happened.

cues.zh: 换谁能不委屈的慌
cues.pinyin: huan4 shui2 neng2 bu4 wei3 qu1 de5 huang1
cues.en: Anyone in that position would feel wronged.

cues.zh: 从他说的话里能听出来
cues.pinyin: cong2 ta1 shuo1 de5 hua4 li3 neng2 ting1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: From the way he talked, you could tell

cues.zh: 王新军对媳妇内脚一个疼
cues.pinyin: wang2 xin1 jun1 dui4 xi2 fu4 nei4 jiao3 yi2 ge4 teng2
cues.en: Wang Xinjun cherished his wife down to the bone.

cues.zh: 家里到处都是过日子的温信家
cues.pinyin: jia1 li3 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 guo4 ri4 zi5 de5 wen1 xin4 jia1
cues.en: Their home was full of the warmth of a life carefully built together.

cues.zh: 这么个老实本分的男人能得罪谁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 ge4 lao3 shi2 ben3 fen4 de5 nan2 ren2 neng2 de2 zui4 shui2
cues.en: Who could such an honest, decent man have possibly wronged?

cues.zh: 说出来真没人信
cues.pinyin: shuo1 chu1 lai2 zhen1 mei2 ren2 xin4
cues.en: You wouldn't believe it even if someone told you.

cues.zh: 沈亿心里也直提人难受
cues.pinyin: shen3 yi4 xin1 li3 ye3 zhi2 ti2 ren2 nan2 shou4
cues.en: Shen Yi, too, felt for him.

cues.zh: 再看赵建宇家
cues.pinyin: zai4 kan4 zhao4 jian4 yu3 jia1
cues.en: Now, looking at Zhao Jianyu's home—

cues.zh: 那场面简直没法看
cues.pinyin: na4 chang3 mian4 jian3 zhi2 mei2 fa3 kan4
cues.en: the scene was unbearable to look at.

cues.zh: 满地都是家具碎片和灰
cues.pinyin: man3 di4 dou1 shi4 jia1 ju4 sui4 pian4 he2 hui1
cues.en: Furniture debris and dust covered the floor everywhere,

cues.zh: 跟被炮轰过似的
cues.pinyin: gen1 bei4 pao4 hong1 guo4 shi4 de5
cues.en: as if it had taken a direct artillery hit.

cues.zh: 但按理说
cues.pinyin: dan4 an4 li3 shuo1
cues.en: But logically speaking,

cues.zh: 头一回爆炸威力不该这么大呀
cues.pinyin: tou2 yi1 hui2 bao4 zha4 wei1 li4 bu4 gai1 zhe4 me5 da4 ya5
cues.en: the initial blast shouldn't have been this powerful.

cues.zh: 后来才弄明白
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 cai2 nong4 ming2 bai2
cues.en: It later became clear

cues.zh: 原来赵建宇收到那玩意儿的时候
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 zhao4 jian4 yu3 shou1 dao4 na4 wan2 yi4 er2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that when Zhao Jianyu received the package,

cues.zh: 厨房里正开着火做饭呢
cues.pinyin: chu2 fang2 li3 zheng4 kai1 zhao2 huo3 zuo4 fan4 ne5
cues.en: the stove in his kitchen was on, cooking,

cues.zh: 这才引起了二次爆炸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 yin3 qi3 le5 er4 ci4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: which triggered a secondary explosion.

cues.zh: 赵建宇这人社交却也简单
cues.pinyin: zhao4 jian4 yu3 zhe4 ren2 she4 jiao1 que4 ye3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: Zhao Jianyu's social circle was actually quite simple;

cues.zh: 除了上班打交道的
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 shang4 ban1 da3 jiao1 dao4 de5
cues.en: aside from people he dealt with at work,

cues.zh: 压根没什么仇人
cues.pinyin: ya1 gen1 mei2 shen2 me5 chou2 ren2
cues.en: he had virtually no enemies.

cues.zh: 他爹妈接到信就往医院上
cues.pinyin: ta1 die1 ma1 jie1 dao4 xin4 jiu4 wang3 yi1 yuan4 shang4
cues.en: His parents rushed to the hospital the moment they got the news.

cues.zh: 到现在赵建宇还没醒
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 zhao4 jian4 yu3 hai2 mei2 xing3
cues.en: Zhao Jianyu still hadn't woken up.

cues.zh: 浑身大面积烧伤手都废了
cues.pinyin: hun2 shen1 da4 mian4 ji1 shao1 shang1 shou3 dou1 fei4 le5
cues.en: He had severe burns over much of his body, and his hands were ruined.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话43｜梗图笑话｜最特别的｜买花送女朋友｜十全八美｜探监｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 爸爸我长大了要当一名北极探险家
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 wo3 zhang3 da4 le5 yao4 dang1 yi1 ming2 bei3 ji2 tan4 xian3 jia1
cues.en: Dad, when I grow up I want to be an Arctic explorer.

cues.zh: 哇这是个很好的梦想啊
cues.pinyin: wa5 zhe4 shi4 ge4 hen3 hao3 de5 meng4 xiang3 a5
cues.en: Wow, that's a wonderful dream!

cues.zh: 可是我想要立刻开始训练自己耶
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 xiang3 yao4 li4 ke4 kai1 shi3 xun4 lian4 zi4 ji3 ye2
cues.en: But I want to start training myself right away.

cues.zh: 哦要怎么训练呢
cues.pinyin: o2 yao4 zen3 me5 xun4 lian4 ne5
cues.en: Oh, how will you train?

cues.zh: 我每天要吃冰淇淋
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei3 tian1 yao4 chi1 bing1 qi2 lin2
cues.en: I'll eat ice cream every day.

cues.zh: 这样我就能适应寒冷的天气了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 wo3 jiu4 neng2 shi4 ying4 han2 leng3 de5 tian1 qi4 le5
cues.en: That way I'll get used to the cold weather.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话43｜梗图笑话｜最特别的｜买花送女朋友｜十全八美｜探监｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明去上英文课
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 qu4 shang4 ying1 wen2 ke4
cues.en: Xiaoming went to English class.

cues.zh: 看到教室墙角有很多蚂蚁
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 jiao4 shi4 qiang2 jiao3 you3 hen3 duo1 ma3 yi3
cues.en: He saw lots of ants in the corner of the classroom.

cues.zh: 就大叫
cues.pinyin: jiu4 da4 jiao4
cues.en: So he shouted.

cues.zh: 这里有好多蚂蚁哦
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 hao3 duo1 ma3 yi3 o2
cues.en: There are so many ants here!

cues.zh: 老师突然想
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 tu1 ran2 xiang3
cues.en: The teacher suddenly had an idea.

cues.zh: 可以考考小明
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 kao3 kao3 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: She could quiz Xiaoming.

cues.zh: 蚂蚁的英文怎么说
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi3 de5 ying1 wen2 zen3 me5 shuo1
cues.en: How do you say 'ant' in English?

cues.zh: 就问小明
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wen4 xiao3 ming2
cues.en: So she asked Xiaoming.

cues.zh: 小明
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2
cues.en: Xiaoming,

cues.zh: 蚂蚁怎么说啊
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi3 zen3 me5 shuo1 a5
cues.en: how do you say 'ant'?

cues.zh: 蚂蚁
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi3
cues.en: Ant.

cues.zh: 蚂蚁怎么也没说啊
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi3 zen3 me5 ye3 mei2 shuo1 a5
cues.en: You don't even know how to say 'ant' in English?

cues.zh: 爸爸妈妈有事出门
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 ma1 ma1 you3 shi4 chu1 men2
cues.en: Mom and Dad went out to run some errands.

cues.zh: 只剩小明跟妹妹在家
cues.pinyin: zhi3 sheng4 xiao3 ming2 gen1 mei4 mei4 zai4 jia1
cues.en: Only Xiaoming and his little sister were left at home.

cues.zh: 晚上吃饭时间
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 chi1 fan4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: At dinner time that evening,

cues.zh: 小明拿出两个面包说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 na2 chu1 liang3 ge4 mian4 bao1 shuo1
cues.en: Xiaoming took out two pieces of bread and said,

cues.zh: 妈妈有留两个面包给我嘛
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 you3 liu2 liang3 ge4 mian4 bao1 gei3 wo3 ma5
cues.en: Mom left two pieces of bread for me.

cues.zh: 全部都给你
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 dou1 gei3 ni3
cues.en: I'll give them all to you.

cues.zh: 我不饿
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 e4
cues.en: I'm not hungry.

cues.zh: 妹妹超感动的
cues.pinyin: mei4 mei4 chao1 gan3 dong4 de5
cues.en: His little sister was so touched.

cues.zh: 把两个面包吃完
cues.pinyin: ba3 liang3 ge4 mian4 bao1 chi1 wan2
cues.en: She ate both pieces of bread.

cues.zh: 小明这时拿出一桶炸鸡说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 zhe4 shi2 na2 chu1 yi1 tong3 zha4 ji1 shuo1
cues.en: Then Xiaoming took out a bucket of fried chicken and said,

cues.zh: 爸爸还有留这一桶炸鸡
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 hai2 you3 liu2 zhe4 yi1 tong3 zha4 ji1
cues.en: Dad also left this bucket of fried chicken.

cues.zh: 你还饿吗

cues.en: You failed every subject — doesn't that make you sad?

cues.zh: 我倒没觉得什么啦难过的是我爸爸
cues.pinyin: wo3 dao4 mei2 jue2 de5 shen2 me5 la5 nan2 guo4 de5 shi4 wo3 ba4 ba4
cues.en: I don't really feel that way; the one who's sad is my dad.

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔 12 3 是什么字呢
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1 12 3 shi4 shen2 me5 zi4 ne5
cues.en: Shanshan, let me ask you — what word is "123"?

cues.pinyin: 12 3 6 yue1 1 jia1 2 jia1 3 deng3 6
cues.en: 1, 2, 3... well, 1 plus 2 plus 3 equals 6.

cues.zh: 不对喔答案是数字
cues.pinyin: bu2 dui4 o1 da2 an4 shi4 shu4 zi4
cues.en: Nope, the answer is "number."

cues.zh: 这次考试我得了第四名给我零用钱吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 kao3 shi4 wo3 de2 le5 di4 si4 ming2 gei3 wo3 ling2 yong4 qian2 ba5
cues.en: I got 4th place this time, give me my allowance!

cues.zh: 哦好孩子进步真快
cues.pinyin: o2 hao3 hai2 zi5 jin4 bu4 zhen1 kuai4
cues.en: Oh, good kid, you're improving fast.

cues.zh: 妈妈待会就拿零用钱给你
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 dai4 hui4 jiu4 na2 ling2 yong4 qian2 gei3 ni3
cues.en: Mom will give you your allowance later.

cues.zh: 谢谢妈妈
cues.pinyin: xie4 xie4 ma1 ma1
cues.en: Thanks, Mom.

cues.zh: 那这次考试一共几个人考啊
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ci4 kao3 shi4 yi1 gong4 ji3 ge4 ren2 kao3 a5
cues.en: So how many people took this exam in total?

cues.zh: 十个人啊
cues.pinyin: shi2 ge4 ren2 a5
cues.en: Ten people.

cues.zh: 小明你计算好这题了吗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ni3 ji4 suan4 hao3 zhe4 ti2 le5 ma5
cues.en: Xiao Ming, have you finished working out this problem?

cues.zh: 已经算好了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 suan4 hao3 le5
cues.en: I've already worked it out.

cues.zh: 而且算了十次
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 suan4 le5 shi2 ci4
cues.en: And I worked it out ten times.

cues.zh: 哦你学得真好
cues.pinyin: o2 ni3 xue2 de2 zhen1 hao3
cues.en: Wow, you're studying really well.

cues.zh: 但是我得到十个不同的答案
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 de2 dao4 shi2 ge4 bu4 tong2 de5 da2 an4
cues.en: But I got ten different answers.

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你哦
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: Chenchen, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 小明是个诚实的人
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 shi4 ge4 cheng2 shi2 de5 ren2
cues.en: Xiao Ming is an honest person.

cues.zh: 为什么他捡到钱包却没有交给警察呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 ta1 jian3 dao4 qian2 bao1 que4 mei2 you3 jiao1 gei3 jing3 cha2 ne5
cues.en: Why didn't he hand in the wallet he found to the police?

cues.zh: 没有交给警察
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 jiao1 gei3 jing3 cha2
cues.en: He didn't hand it in to the police.

cues.zh: 会不会是钱包是他的啊
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 qian2 bao1 shi4 ta1 de5 a5
cues.en: Could it be that the wallet was actually his?

cues.zh: 答对了
cues.pinyin: da2 dui4 le5
cues.en: That's right!

items.title_zh: 笑话94｜超好玩的〝照样照句〞你会吗？｜123是什么字呢？｜考场上没人可以合作｜难过的是我爸爸｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小孩子不应该撒谎喔
cues.pinyin: xiao3 hai2 zi5 bu4 ying1 gai1 sa1 huang3 o1
cues.en: Kids shouldn't lie.

cues.zh: 我像你这么大的时候从来没有撒过谎
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang4 ni3 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 shi2 hou4 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 sa1 guo4 huang3
cues.en: When I was your age, I never lied once.

cues.zh: 那你是多大的时候开始撒谎的呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 shi4 duo1 da4 de5 shi2 hou4 kai1 shi3 sa1 huang3 de5 ne5
cues.en: So at what age did you start lying?

cues.zh: 知道我们不是去看医生而是医生在看我
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 wo3 men5 bu2 shi4 qu4 kan4 yi1 sheng1 er2 shi4 yi1 sheng1 zai4 kan4 wo3
cues.en: I realized we weren't going to see the doctor — the doctor was examining me.

cues.zh: 那我觉得我们不是去打针而是我被针打
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 men5 bu2 shi4 qu4 da3 zhen1 er2 shi4 wo3 bei4 zhen1 da3
cues.en: I think we're not "getting a shot," but rather "being hit by a needle."

cues.zh: 我觉得我们不是病好了
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 men5 bu2 shi4 bing4 hao3 le5
cues.en: I don't think it's that the illness got better.

cues.zh: 而是我好了
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 wo3 hao3 le5
cues.en: It's that I got better.

cues.zh: 我觉得我们不是去打赌壁球
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 wo3 men5 bu2 shi4 qu4 da3 du3 bi4 qiu2
cues.en: I don't think we're going to play squash.

cues.zh: 而是我被赌壁球打
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 wo3 bei4 du3 bi4 qiu2 da3
cues.en: It's that I'm the one getting hit by the squash ball.

cues.zh: 照样照句
cues.pinyin: zhao4 yang4 zhao4 ju4
cues.en: "Sentence Pattern Imitation"

cues.zh: 大家还有别的类似的句子吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hai2 you3 bie2 de5 lei4 si4 de5 ju4 zi5 ma5
cues.en: Does anyone have other similar sentences?

cues.zh: 可在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: Feel free to leave a comment below and share with everyone.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 前两天诺贝尔化学奖授予给两位科学家
cues.pinyin: qian2 liang3 tian1 nuo4 bei4 er3 hua4 xue2 jiang3 shou4 yu3 gei3 liang3 wei4 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: A few days ago, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to two scientists.

cues.zh: 法国科学家亨利
cues.pinyin: fa3 guo2 ke1 xue2 jia1 heng1 li4
cues.en: French scientist Henri

cues.zh: 卡根和日本科学家霞和献三
cues.pinyin: ka3 gen1 he2 ri4 ben3 ke1 xue2 jia1 xia2 he2 xian4 san1
cues.en: Cargin, and Japanese scientist Xia Hexianshan

cues.zh: 以表彰他们在小分子不对称有机催化方
cues.pinyin: yi3 biao3 zhang1 ta1 men5 zai4 xiao3 fen4 zi3 bu2 dui4 cheng1 you3 ji1 cui1 hua4 fang1
cues.en: in recognition of the contributions they made

cues.zh: 面做出的贡献
cues.pinyin: mian4 zuo4 chu1 de5 gong4 xian4
cues.en: to small-molecule asymmetric organocatalysis.

cues.zh: 催化剂就是一种特殊的物质
cues.pinyin: cui1 hua4 ji4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 te4 shu1 de5 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: A catalyst is a special kind of substance.

cues.zh: 它可以让化学反应更加快速的进行
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 rang4 hua4 xue2 fan3 ying4 geng4 jia1 kuai4 su4 de5 jin4 xing2
cues.en: It can make chemical reactions happen faster.

cues.zh: 比如说我们生活中常见的塑料
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 chang2 jian4 de5 su4 liao4
cues.en: For example, the plastic we commonly see in daily life

cues.zh: 就是通过催化作用制造的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 cui1 hua4 zuo4 yong4 zhi4 zao4 de5
cues.en: is made through catalysis.

cues.zh: 再比如说生物体内的各种化学反应
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 sheng1 wu4 ti3 nei4 de5 ge4 zhong3 hua4 xue2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Another example: the various chemical reactions inside living organisms

cues.zh: 比如说光合作用呼吸作用
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 guang1 he2 zuo4 yong4 hu1 xi1 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: such as photosynthesis and respiration

cues.zh: 也要通过催化剂煤的作用进行
cues.pinyin: ye3 yao4 tong1 guo4 cui1 hua4 ji4 mei2 de5 zuo4 yong4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: also rely on the action of catalysts to take place.

cues.zh: 可以说没有催化剂
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 shuo1 mei2 you3 cui1 hua4 ji4
cues.en: It can be said that without catalysts,

cues.zh: 就没有我们的现代生活
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 you3 wo3 men5 de5 xian4 dai4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: there would be no modern life as we know it,

cues.zh: 也没有生命本身
cues.pinyin: ye3 mei2 you3 sheng1 ming4 ben3 shen1
cues.en: and no life itself.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: A young viewer once asked me,

cues.zh: 历史上还有哪些诺贝尔奖
cues.pinyin: li4 shi3 shang4 hai2 you3 na3 xie1 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: what other Nobel Prizes in history

cues.zh: 是授予给催化剂方面的研究呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 shou4 yu3 gei3 cui1 hua4 ji4 fang1 mian4 de5 yan2 jiu1 ne5
cues.en: have been awarded for research on catalysts?

cues.zh: 那么今天我们就带大家了解一下
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 dai4 da4 jia1 liao3 jie3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: So today, let's take a look together at

cues.zh: 历史上最富争议的诺贝尔奖
cues.pinyin: li4 shi3 shang4 zui4 fu4 zheng1 yi4 de5 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: one of the most controversial Nobel Prizes in history.

cues.zh: 19 18 年诺贝尔化学奖授予给弗里茨哈伯
cues.pinyin: 19 18 nian2 nuo4 bei4 er3 hua4 xue2 jiang3 shou4 yu3 gei3 fu2 li3 ci2 ha1 bo2
cues.en: In 1918, the Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Fritz Haber,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 以表彰他在人工合成氨气方面的贡献
cues.pinyin: yi3 biao3 zhang1 ta1 zai4 ren2 gong1 he2 cheng2 an1 qi4 fang1 mian4 de5 gong4 xian4
cues.en: in recognition of his contribution to the artificial synthesis of ammonia.

cues.zh: 有人说哈勃的这项贡
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 ha1 bo2 de5 zhe4 xiang4 gong4
cues.en: Some say this contribution of Haber's

cues.zh: 可以比肩普罗米修斯
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 bi3 jian1 pu3 luo2 mi3 xiu1 si1
cues.en: can be compared to that of Prometheus.

cues.zh: 他是人间天使
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ren2 jian1 tian1 shi3
cues.en: He is an angel on earth.

cues.zh: 但是也有人说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 you3 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: But others say

cues.zh: 哈勃是一个双手沾满鲜血的恶魔
cues.pinyin: ha1 bo2 shi4 yi2 ge4 shuang1 shou3 zhan1 man3 xian1 xue4 de5 e4 mo2
cues.en: Haber is a devil with blood on both hands.

cues.zh: 这到底是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what is actually going on here?

cues.zh: 今天就来讲一讲哈勃的故事
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 ha1 bo2 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: Today, let's talk about Haber's story.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来说一说
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1
cues.en: First, let's talk about

cues.zh: 为什么有人叫哈勃是人间天使
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 you3 ren2 jiao4 ha1 bo2 shi4 ren2 jian1 tian1 shi3
cues.en: why some people call Haber an angel on earth.

cues.zh: 在 18 98 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 18 98 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back in 1898,

cues.zh: 有一个科学家曾经做出过预测
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 ke1 xue2 jia1 ceng2 jing1 zuo4 chu1 guo4 yu4 ce4
cues.en: a scientist once made a prediction.

cues.zh: 他说在 19 30 年的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zai4 19 30 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: He said that by the 1930s,

cues.zh: 人口的增长就会超出地球上耕地所
cues.pinyin: ren2 kou3 de5 zeng1 zhang3 jiu4 hui4 chao1 chu1 di4 qiu2 shang4 geng1 di4 suo3
cues.en: population growth would exceed what the farmland on Earth

cues.zh: 能产出的粮食
cues.pinyin: neng2 chan3 chu1 de5 liang2 shi2
cues.en: could produce in food.

cues.zh: 所以到了那个时候人类一定会出现大饥荒
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dao4 le5 na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ren2 lei4 yi2 ding4 hui4 chu1 xian4 da4 ji1 huang1
cues.en: So by that time, humanity would surely face a great famine.

cues.zh: 但事实上在 19 30 年代人类没有出现大饥荒
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi2 shang4 zai4 19 30 nian2 dai4 ren2 lei4 mei2 you3 chu1 xian4 da4 ji1 huang1
cues.en: But in fact, no great famine occurred in the 1930s.

cues.zh: 这是为什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Why was that?

cues.zh: 就要归功于哈勃的贡献
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 gui1 gong1 yu2 ha1 bo2 de5 gong4 xian4
cues.en: It's thanks to Haber's contribution.

cues.zh: 我们知道生物体
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 sheng1 wu4 ti3
cues.en: We know that living organisms —

cues.zh: 无论是动物和植物它其实都需要氮氮元素
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 dong4 wu4 he2 zhi2 wu4 ta1 qi2 shi2 dou1 xu1 yao4 dan4 dan4 yuan2 su4
cues.en: whether animals or plants — actually need nitrogen.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 无论是动物和植物它其实都需要氮元素
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 dong4 wu4 he2 zhi2 wu4 ta1 qi2 shi2 dou1 xu1 yao4 dan4 yuan2 su4
cues.en: These bacteria can, through certain biochemical reactions,

cues.zh: 把这个氮变成溶于水的物质
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 dan4 bian4 cheng2 rong2 yu2 shui3 de5 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: convert nitrogen into substances that dissolve in water.

cues.zh: 比如说氨气 N H 3
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 an1 qi4 N H 3
cues.en: For example, ammonia, NH3.

cues.zh: 这叫氨气
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiao4 an1 qi4
cues.en: This is called ammonia.

cues.zh: 它变成氨气了之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 bian4 cheng2 an1 qi4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it becomes ammonia,

cues.zh: 这氨气溶于水又形成了一些氨根的离子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 an1 qi4 rong2 yu2 shui3 you4 xing2 cheng2 le5 yi1 xie1 an1 gen1 de5 li2 zi5
cues.en: dissolving in water forms ammonium ions.

cues.zh: 然后这些氨根的离子就可以被植物吸收了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 xie1 an1 gen1 de5 li2 zi5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 bei4 zhi2 wu4 xi1 shou1 le5
cues.en: Then these ammonium ions can be absorbed by plants.

cues.zh: 那么当然除了这种生物作用以外
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dang1 ran2 chu2 le5 zhe4 zhong3 sheng1 wu4 zuo4 yong4 yi3 wai4
cues.en: Of course, besides this biological process,

cues.zh: 还有一种就是闪电
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 jiu4 shi4 shan3 dian4
cues.en: there's also lightning.

cues.zh: 在发生闪电的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 fa1 sheng1 shan3 dian4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When lightning occurs,

cues.zh: 闪电也可以使空气中的这个氮溶于水
cues.pinyin: shan3 dian4 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi3 kong1 qi4 zhong1 de5 zhe4 ge5 dan4 rong2 yu2 shui3
cues.en: it can also cause nitrogen in the air to dissolve in water,

cues.zh: 变成了什么呢
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 le5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: turning into what?

cues.zh: 变成了硝酸根离子 NO 3
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 le5 xiao1 suan1 gen1 li2 zi5 NO 3
cues.en: It turns into nitrate ions, NO3-.

cues.zh: 就一个氮原子三个氧原子这个样子的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi2 ge4 dan4 yuan2 zi5 san1 ge4 yang3 yuan2 zi5 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: That is, one nitrogen atom and three oxygen atoms.

cues.zh: 然后这个硝酸根离子溶于水
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 xiao1 suan1 gen1 li2 zi5 rong2 yu2 shui3
cues.en: Then these nitrate ions dissolve in water,

cues.zh: 最后也能够被植物吸收
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ye3 neng2 gou4 bei4 zhi2 wu4 xi1 shou1
cues.en: and can ultimately be absorbed by plants too.

cues.zh: 反正总之我们如果想获得氮元素
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zong3 zhi1 wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 xiang3 huo4 de2 dan4 yuan2 su4
cues.en: In any case, if we want to obtain nitrogen,

cues.zh: 就这么两个方式
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 me5 liang3 ge4 fang1 shi4
cues.en: there are just these two ways.

cues.zh: 就是空气中的氮气通过细菌的作
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 kong1 qi4 zhong1 de5 dan4 qi4 tong1 guo4 xi4 jun1 de5 zuo4
cues.en: That is, nitrogen gas in the air is converted by bacteria

cues.zh: 用变成了氨气
cues.pinyin: yong4 bian4 cheng2 le5 an1 qi4
cues.en: into ammonia.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 这个也是在我们中学的化学课本里
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ye3 shi4 zai4 wo3 men5 zhong1 xue2 de5 hua4 xue2 ke4 ben3 li3
cues.en: This is also someone featured in our middle school chemistry textbook —

cues.zh: 面的一个人物
cues.pinyin: mian4 de5 yi2 ge4 ren2 wu4
cues.en: a figure in it

cues.zh: 提出了著名的勒沙特列原理
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 zhu4 ming2 de5 lei1 sha1 te4 lie4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: who proposed the famous Le Chatelier's principle.

cues.zh: 他说其实我们想合成氨气并没有那么难
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 qi2 shi2 wo3 men5 xiang3 he2 cheng2 an1 qi4 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 nan2
cues.en: He said that synthesizing ammonia actually isn't that hard.

cues.zh: 氨气是怎么形成的
cues.pinyin: an1 qi4 shi4 zen3 me5 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: How is ammonia formed?

cues.zh: 不就是壹个氮原子和三个氢原子吗
cues.pinyin: bu4 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ge4 dan4 yuan2 zi5 he2 san1 ge4 qing1 yuan2 zi5 ma5
cues.en: Isn't it just one nitrogen atom and three hydrogen atoms?

cues.zh: 那既然如此
cues.pinyin: na4 ji4 ran2 ru2 ci3
cues.en: So if that's the case,

cues.zh: 我们用氮气和氢气进行反应不就行了吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 dan4 qi4 he2 qing1 qi4 jin4 xing2 fan3 ying4 bu4 jiu4 xing2 le5 ma5
cues.en: can't we just react nitrogen gas with hydrogen gas?

cues.zh: 我们用氮气加上三个氢气对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 dan4 qi4 jia1 shang4 san1 ge4 qing1 qi4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: We use nitrogen plus three hydrogens, right?

cues.zh: 然后我反应
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 fan3 ying4
cues.en: And then they react,

cues.zh: 反应的时候我就会形成什么呢
cues.pinyin: fan3 ying4 de5 shi2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: and during the reaction, what forms?

cues.zh: 形成两分子的氨气对吧
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 liang3 fen4 zi3 de5 an1 qi4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Two molecules of ammonia form, right?

cues.zh: 他希望这个反应能够发生
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 neng2 gou4 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: He hoped this reaction could happen,

cues.zh: 然后就想尽的壹切办法
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 xiang3 jin3 de5 yi1 qie4 ban4 fa3
cues.en: so he tried every possible method

cues.zh: 去促进这个氨气分子的生成
cues.pinyin: qu4 cu4 jin4 zhe4 ge5 an1 qi4 fen4 zi3 de5 sheng1 cheng2
cues.en: to promote the formation of ammonia molecules.

cues.zh: 但是这个反应它是一个可逆反应
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 ke3 ni4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: But this reaction is a reversible reaction.

cues.zh: 什么叫可逆反应呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 ke3 ni4 fan3 ying4 ne5
cues.en: What is a reversible reaction?

cues.zh: 就是氮气和氢气不停地变成氨气
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dan4 qi4 he2 qing1 qi4 bu4 ting2 di4 bian4 cheng2 an1 qi4
cues.en: It means nitrogen and hydrogen keep turning into ammonia,

cues.zh: 然后氨气也不停地变回成氮气和氢气
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 an1 qi4 ye3 bu4 ting2 di4 bian4 hui2 cheng2 dan4 qi4 he2 qing1 qi4
cues.en: while ammonia also keeps turning back into nitrogen and hydrogen.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 它们会达成一种平衡
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hui4 da2 cheng2 yi1 zhong3 ping2 heng2
cues.en: They reach a kind of equilibrium.

cues.zh: 这就称之为可逆反应
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ke3 ni4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: This is called a reversible reaction.

cues.zh: 那么我们怎么样才能促进可逆反应
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 zen3 me5 yang4 cai2 neng2 cu4 jin4 ke3 ni4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: So how can we push a reversible reaction

cues.zh: 往右边进行呢
cues.pinyin: wang3 you4 bian1 jin4 xing2 ne5
cues.en: to proceed to the right?

cues.zh: 这就需要用到勒沙特列原理了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 xu1 yao4 yong4 dao4 lei1 sha1 te4 lie4 yuan2 li3 le5
cues.en: This is where Le Chatelier's principle comes in.

cues.zh: 勒沙特列原理是说
cues.pinyin: lei1 sha1 te4 lie4 yuan2 li3 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: Le Chatelier's principle states that

cues.zh: 如果我们改变了某一个条件
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 gai3 bian4 le5 mou3 yi2 ge4 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: if we change a certain condition,

cues.zh: 那么这个反应会像减弱这种改
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 hui4 xiang4 jian3 ruo4 zhe4 zhong3 gai3
cues.en: the reaction will shift in the direction that weakens

cues.zh: 变的方向发展
cues.pinyin: bian4 de5 fang1 xiang4 fa1 zhan3
cues.en: that change.

cues.zh: 这什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does this mean?

cues.zh: 不太好理解
cues.pinyin: bu4 tai4 hao3 li3 jie3
cues.en: It's not easy to understand.

cues.zh: 你看反映的左侧一共有 4 个分子
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 fan3 ying4 de5 zuo3 ce4 yi1 gong4 you3 4 ge4 fen4 zi3
cues.en: Look, on the left side of the reaction there are 4 molecules total —

cues.zh: 1 个加 3 个是 4 个
cues.pinyin: 1 ge4 jia1 3 ge4 shi4 4 ge4
cues.en: 1 plus 3 is 4.

cues.zh: 反映的右侧是 2 个分子
cues.pinyin: fan3 ying4 de5 you4 ce4 shi4 2 ge4 fen4 zi3
cues.en: The right side of the reaction has 2 molecules.

cues.zh: 所以我们如果要是加大压强会有什么结果
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 yao4 shi4 jia1 da4 ya1 qiang2 hui4 you3 shen2 me5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: So what happens if we increase the pressure?

cues.zh: 这个反映就会向右侧进行
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 jiu4 hui4 xiang4 you4 ce4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: The reaction will shift toward the right side.

cues.zh: 这其实就是那些特技原理告诉我们的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 na4 xie1 te4 ji4 yuan2 li3 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 de5
cues.en: This is exactly what Le Chatelier's principle tells us.

cues.zh: 所以他想了一些办法
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 xiang3 le5 yi1 xie1 ban4 fa3
cues.en: So he came up with some methods.

cues.zh: 比如说我们把这个压强增大
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ya1 qiang2 zeng1 da4
cues.en: For example, we increase the pressure.

cues.zh: 这个压强我可以增大到 200 个 AT M
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ya1 qiang2 wo3 ke3 yi3 zeng1 da4 dao4 200 ge4 AT M
cues.en: We can raise the pressure to 200 atm,

cues.zh: 也就是 200 倍的大气压
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 200 bei4 de5 da4 qi4 ya1
cues.en: that is, 200 times atmospheric pressure.

cues.zh: 那非常高了对不对
cues.pinyin: na4 fei1 chang2 gao1 le5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: That's extremely high, isn't it?

cues.zh: 加的这么高
cues.pinyin: jia1 de5 zhe4 me5 gao1
cues.en: Raised that high,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】最具争议诺贝尔奖得主——弗里茨.哈伯：天使还是恶魔？

cues.zh: 但是温度高的时候这个反应的速度快
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wen1 du4 gao1 de5 shi2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 de5 su4 du4 kuai4
cues.en: but when the temperature is high, the reaction speed is fast.

cues.zh: 虽然反应更容易往左侧发展
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 fan3 ying4 geng4 rong2 yi4 wang3 zuo3 ce4 fa1 zhan3
cues.en: Although the reaction tends to shift more toward the left,

cues.zh: 但它速度快
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 su4 du4 kuai4
cues.en: it is fast.

cues.zh: 如果你温度特别低
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 wen1 du4 te4 bie2 di1
cues.en: If the temperature is very low,

cues.zh: 它反应速度特别慢那也不行
cues.pinyin: ta1 fan3 ying4 su4 du4 te4 bie2 man4 na4 ye3 bu4 xing2
cues.en: the reaction rate is too slow, and that doesn't work either.

cues.zh: 反正总而言之通过这样的方法
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zong3 er2 yan2 zhi1 tong1 guo4 zhe4 yang4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Anyway, in short, through methods like these,

cues.zh: 勒沙特列就获得了一种制造氨气的方式
cues.pinyin: lei1 sha1 te4 lie4 jiu4 huo4 de2 le5 yi1 zhong3 zhi4 zao4 an1 qi4 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: Le Chatelier arrived at a way to produce ammonia.

cues.zh: 但是就在它即将要成功的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jiu4 zai4 ta1 ji2 jiang1 yao4 cheng2 gong1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But just as he was about to succeed,

cues.zh: 突然之间它实验室发生了爆炸
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 zhi1 jian1 ta1 shi2 yan4 shi4 fa1 sheng1 le5 bao4 zha4
cues.en: an explosion suddenly occurred in his lab.

cues.zh: 爆炸之后勒沙特列还死了一个助手
cues.pinyin: bao4 zha4 zhi1 hou4 lei1 sha1 te4 lie4 hai2 si3 le5 yi2 ge4 zhu4 shou3
cues.en: After the explosion, one of Le Chatelier's assistants died.

cues.zh: 所以这件事就停滞了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 jiu4 ting2 zhi4 le5
cues.en: So the work came to a halt.

cues.zh: 后来勒扫特列回忆的时候也说
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 lei1 sao3 te4 lie4 hui2 yi4 de5 shi2 hou4 ye3 shuo1
cues.en: Later, when Le Chatelier looked back, he also said

cues.zh: 说一生中最大的遗憾
cues.pinyin: shuo1 yi1 sheng1 zhong1 zui4 da4 de5 yi2 han4
cues.en: that his greatest regret in life

cues.zh: 就是让人工合成胺这件事从我手边溜走了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 rang4 ren2 gong1 he2 cheng2 an4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 cong2 wo3 shou3 bian1 liu1 zou3 le5
cues.en: was letting the chance to artificially synthesize ammonia slip through his fingers.

cues.zh: 因为他基本上已经找到了人工
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 ji1 ben3 shang4 yi3 jing1 zhao3 dao4 le5 ren2 gong1
cues.en: Because he had basically already found the method

cues.zh: 合成胺的方法
cues.pinyin: he2 cheng2 an4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: for synthesizing ammonia artificially.

cues.zh: 但是很遗憾因为死了一个人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hen3 yi2 han4 yin1 wei4 si3 le5 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: But unfortunately, because someone had died,

cues.zh: 所以这项研究就停滞了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 xiang4 yan2 jiu1 jiu4 ting2 zhi4 le5
cues.en: this research came to a stop.

cues.zh: 他停滞了之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 ting2 zhi4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After he stopped,

cues.zh: 另外一个人就登上了历史的舞台
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 ren2 jiu4 deng1 shang4 le5 li4 shi3 de5 wu3 tai2
cues.en: another person stepped onto the stage of history.

cues.zh: 那就是我们今天的主角
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 zhu3 jue2
cues.en: And that is today's main character.

cues.zh: 19 09 年的时候
cues.pinyin: 19 09 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 德国有一个著名的化学家
cues.pinyin: de2 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 de5 hua4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: there was a famous chemist in Germany.

cues.zh: 达达我问你喔怎么会出席的人特别少呢
cues.pinyin: da2 da2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1 zen3 me5 hui4 chu1 xi2 de5 ren2 te4 bie2 shao3 ne5
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you — why were there so few people there?

cues.zh: 怎么会你要给我借钱的聚会我就不去了
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 ni3 yao4 gei3 wo3 jie4 qian2 de5 ju4 hui4 wo3 jiu4 bu4 qu4 le5
cues.en: What do you mean? If it's a gathering where you're going to ask me for money, I'm not going.

cues.zh: 不是是约会只有两个人
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 shi4 yue1 hui4 zhi3 you3 liang3 ge4 ren2
cues.en: No, it's a date — there are only two people.

cues.zh: 睡觉的时候
cues.pinyin: shui4 jiao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While sleeping,

cues.zh: 妻子喋喋不休的讲他的过去
cues.pinyin: qi1 zi3 die2 die2 bu4 xiu1 de5 jiang3 ta1 de5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: his wife wouldn't stop babbling on about his past.

cues.zh: 突然用手按了电灯开关
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 yong4 shou3 an4 le5 dian4 deng1 kai1 guan1
cues.en: Suddenly she reached over and flipped the light switch.

cues.zh: 亲爱的
cues.pinyin: qin1 ai4 de5
cues.en: Honey,

cues.zh: 所有的门窗都有关好了吗
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 men2 chuang1 dou1 you3 guan1 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: did you lock all the doors and windows?

cues.zh: 亲爱的
cues.pinyin: qin1 ai4 de5
cues.en: Honey,

cues.zh: 除了你的话匣子以外
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 ni3 de5 hua4 xia2 zi5 yi3 wai4
cues.en: except for your mouth,

cues.zh: 该关的都关了
cues.pinyin: gai1 guan1 de5 dou1 guan1 le5
cues.en: everything that needed closing is closed.

cues.zh: 晨晨
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2
cues.en: Chenchen,

cues.zh: 我问你啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 a5
cues.en: let me ask you something,

cues.zh: 蛤什么
cues.pinyin: ha2 shen2 me5
cues.en: Huh? What?

cues.zh: 钉子被人打头打了两下
cues.pinyin: ding1 zi5 bei4 ren2 da3 tou2 da3 le5 liang3 xia4
cues.en: A nail had its head struck twice.

cues.zh: 你知道会变成什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know what it turns into?

cues.zh: 答案是变成
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 bian4 cheng2
cues.en: The answer is, it becomes—

cues.zh: 磕磕
cues.pinyin: ke1 ke1
cues.en: a stutterer.

cues.zh: 为什么
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 因为他的钉被打到都变弯了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 ding1 bei4 da3 dao4 dou1 bian4 wan1 le5
cues.en: Because its head got hit so much it bent.

items.title_zh: 笑话71｜跪在床边｜话匣子没关｜天堂的规矩｜肥而不腻｜高高在上｜鸡蛋摔倒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有三姐妹来到了天堂
cues.pinyin: you3 san1 jie3 mei4 lai2 dao4 le5 tian1 tang2
cues.en: Three sisters arrived in heaven.

cues.zh: 地上全是小花
cues.pinyin: di4 shang4 quan2 shi4 xiao3 hua1
cues.en: The ground was covered with little flowers.

cues.zh: 神仙说天堂有个规矩
cues.pinyin: shen2 xian1 shuo1 tian1 tang2 you3 ge4 gui1 ju3
cues.en: An immortal said heaven had a rule:

cues.zh: 不可以踩到小花
cues.pinyin: bu4 ke3 yi3 cai3 dao4 xiao3 hua1
cues.en: you must not step on the flowers.

cues.zh: 踩到会被处罚
cues.pinyin: cai3 dao4 hui4 bei4 chu3 fa2
cues.en: Stepping on one means punishment.

cues.zh: 三姐妹于是每天都小心翼翼的走着
cues.pinyin: san1 jie3 mei4 yu2 shi4 mei3 tian1 dou1 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 de5 zou3 zhe5
cues.en: So the three sisters walked very carefully every day.

cues.zh: 大姐不小心踩到了小花
cues.pinyin: da4 jie3 bu4 xiao3 xin1 cai3 dao4 le5 xiao3 hua1
cues.en: The eldest sister accidentally stepped on a flower.

cues.zh: 承仙就带来一个非常丑的男人
cues.pinyin: cheng2 xian1 jiu4 dai4 lai2 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 chou3 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: The immortal brought a very ugly man,

cues.zh: 用铁链和他锁在一起
cues.pinyin: yong4 tie3 lian4 he2 ta1 suo3 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: and chained her to him.

cues.zh: 二姐和小妹都非常害怕
cues.pinyin: er4 jie3 he2 xiao3 mei4 dou1 fei1 chang2 hai4 pa4
cues.en: The second sister and the youngest were both terrified.

cues.zh: 于是每天都更小心
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 mei3 tian1 dou1 geng4 xiao3 xin1
cues.en: So they were even more careful every day.

cues.zh: 没想到二姐又踩到了小花
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 er4 jie3 you4 cai3 dao4 le5 xiao3 hua1
cues.en: But unexpectedly, the second sister also stepped on a flower.

cues.zh: 神仙带了一个非常丑的男人
cues.pinyin: shen2 xian1 dai4 le5 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 chou3 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: The immortal brought another very ugly man,

cues.zh: 用铁链和他锁在一起
cues.pinyin: yong4 tie3 lian4 he2 ta1 suo3 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: and chained her to him too.

cues.zh: 从此三妹更害怕了
cues.pinyin: cong2 ci3 san1 mei4 geng4 hai4 pa4 le5
cues.en: From then on, the youngest sister was even more scared.

cues.zh: 非常小心都没有踩到小花
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 xiao3 xin1 dou1 mei2 you3 cai3 dao4 xiao3 hua1
cues.en: She was extremely careful and never stepped on a flower.

cues.zh: 过了一年
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 yi1 nian2
cues.en: A year passed.

cues.zh: 有一天天使带着一个非常帅的男人
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 tian1 shi3 dai4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 shuai4 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: One day an angel brought a very handsome man.

items.title_zh: 笑话71｜跪在床边｜话匣子没关｜天堂的规矩｜肥而不腻｜高高在上｜鸡蛋摔倒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 善善
cues.pinyin: shan4 shan4
cues.en: Shanshan,

cues.zh: 我怎么看你都看不腻呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 zen3 me5 kan4 ni3 dou1 kan4 bu4 ni4 ne5
cues.en: no matter how much I look at you, I never get tired of it.

cues.zh: 你知道为什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know why?

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: No, I don't know.

cues.zh: 因为你肥而不腻
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 fei2 er2 bu4 ni4
cues.en: Because you're 'fat but not greasy.'

cues.zh: 什么意思啊
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 si5 a5
cues.en: What does that mean?

cues.zh: 你不懂喔
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 dong3 o1
cues.en: You don't get it, huh?

cues.zh: 说你很肥啦
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ni3 hen3 fei2 la5
cues.en: It means you're fat,

cues.zh: 肥而不腻啦
cues.pinyin: fei2 er2 bu4 ni4 la5
cues.en: fat but not greasy.

cues.zh: 听不懂
cues.pinyin: ting1 bu4 dong3
cues.en: I still don't get it.

cues.zh: 我是 L inda 去年在上海借了这个房子
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 L inda qu4 nian2 zai4 shang4 hai3 jie4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5

cues.zh: 大概是 120 个平方
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 120 ge4 ping2 fang1
cues.en: It's about 120 square meters.

cues.zh: 它是建于上世纪 20 年代一个都
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 jian4 yu2 shang4 shi4 ji4 20 nian2 dai4 yi2 ge4 dou1
cues.en: It was built in the 1920s, an

cues.zh: 德风格的公寓

cues.zh: 是一个木砖混的结构
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 mu4 zhuan1 hun4 de5 jie2 gou4
cues.en: It has a wood-and-brick mixed structure.

cues.pinyin: nei4 zou3 dao4 shi4 yuan2 zhi1 yuan2 wei4 di4 bao3 liu2 le5 shui3 mo2 shi2

cues.zh: 和一些马赛克
cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 xie1 ma3 sai4 ke4
cues.en: and some mosaic

cues.zh: 的工艺的做法
cues.pinyin: de5 gong1 yi4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: craftsmanship.

cues.zh: 拿到房子进来的时候只有前厅有一些光线

cues.en: When I first got the place, only the front hall had any light.

cues.zh: 那其他地方是暗的
cues.pinyin: na4 qi2 ta1 di4 fang1 shi4 an4 de5
cues.en: Everywhere else was dark.

cues.zh: 客厅的这个墙面我用了一个苔绿色
cues.pinyin: ke4 ting1 de5 zhe4 ge5 qiang2 mian4 wo3 yong4 le5 yi2 ge4 tai2 lv4 se4
cues.en: For the living room wall I used a moss green,

cues.pinyin: qian2 ting1 de5 zhe4 yi1 kuai4 yong4 le5 yi2 ge4 guo3 lv4 se4
cues.en: and for this part of the front hall I used a grass green.

cues.zh: 它跟苔绿色稍微有一个过渡
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 tai2 lv4 se4 shao1 wei1 you3 yi2 ge4 guo4 du4
cues.en: It transitions gently from the moss green.

cues.zh: 让前厅就更加地亮堂
cues.pinyin: rang4 qian2 ting1 jiu4 geng4 jia1 di4 liang4 tang2
cues.en: That makes the front hall feel even brighter.

cues.zh: 房子里面的每一件物品
cues.pinyin: fang2 zi5 li3 mian4 de5 mei3 yi1 jian4 wu4 pin3
cues.en: Every single item in the house

cues.zh: 它都来自不同的地方
cues.pinyin: ta1 dou1 lai2 zi4 bu4 tong2 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: comes from a different place.

cues.zh: 收桃子的话

cues.pinyin: wo3 geng4 qing1 xiang4 yu2 nian2 qing1 ren2
cues.en: I lean more towards younger makers.

cues.en: This one is also hand-pinched.

cues.zh: 捏的桃
cues.pinyin: nie1 de5 tao2

cues.zh: 有一些化妆土

cues.zh: 然后在窑里面形成了一个气氛
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 yao2 li3 mian4 xing2 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 qi4 fen1
cues.en: and then in the kiln it took on a certain effect.

cues.zh: 这些肌理都非常自然
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 ji1 li3 dou1 fei1 chang2 zi4 ran2
cues.en: These textures are all very natural.

cues.zh: 这个茶壶
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 cha2 hu2
cues.en: This teapot—

cues.zh: 它当时做的时候是有一块木板
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 shi2 zuo4 de5 shi2 hou4 shi4 you3 yi1 kuai4 mu4 ban3
cues.en: when it was made, there was a wooden board involved.

cues.zh: 它是长年累月在上面画了很多东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 chang2 nian2 lei3 yue4 zai4 shang4 mian4 hua4 le5 hen3 duo1 dong1 xi1

cues.zh: 然后它硬配硬上去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 ying4 pei4 ying4 shang4 qu4
cues.en: and then that pattern was pressed onto the clay.

cues.zh: 形成了一个自然的一个肌理
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 zi4 ran2 de5 yi2 ge4 ji1 li3
cues.en: It formed a natural texture.

cues.zh: 我心想真好笑
cues.pinyin: wo3 xin1 xiang3 zhen1 hao3 xiao4
cues.en: I thought to myself, that's hilarious

cues.zh: 到底是谁这么大了还偷大便
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 shui2 zhe4 me5 da4 le5 hai2 tou1 da4 bian4
cues.en: Who's so grown up and still secretly poops?

cues.zh: 诶不对哦
cues.pinyin: ei2 bu2 dui4 o2
cues.en: Wait, hold on

cues.zh: 我也有闻到
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 you3 wen2 dao4
cues.en: I smell it too

cues.zh: 不会是我踩到大便了吧
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 shi4 wo3 cai3 dao4 da4 bian4 le5 ba5
cues.en: Could it be that I stepped on poop?

cues.zh: 赶快看了一下自己的鞋底
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 kan4 le5 yi1 xia4 zi4 ji3 de5 xie2 di3
cues.en: I quickly checked the sole of my shoe

cues.zh: 还好我没踩到
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 wo3 mei2 cai3 dao4
cues.en: Luckily I hadn't stepped on it

cues.zh: 但这时瞄了一眼
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 shi2 miao2 le5 yi1 yan3
cues.en: But then I glanced over

cues.zh: 坐在我旁边的阿明
cues.pinyin: zuo4 zai4 wo3 pang2 bian1 de5 a1 ming2
cues.en: at A-Ming sitting next to me

cues.zh: 我发现阿明的鞋子旁边
cues.pinyin: wo3 fa1 xian4 a1 ming2 de5 xie2 zi5 pang2 bian1
cues.en: and I noticed beside A-Ming's shoe

cues.zh: 有溢出一些黄色黏土状的东西
cues.pinyin: you3 yi4 chu1 yi1 xie1 huang2 se4 nian2 tu3 zhuang4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: there was some yellow, clay-like stuff oozing out

cues.zh: 当时我就知道发生什么事了
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 wo3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 fa1 sheng1 shen2 me5 shi4 le5
cues.en: At that moment I knew exactly what had happened

cues.zh: 我偷偷的跟阿明说
cues.pinyin: wo3 tou1 tou1 de5 gen1 a1 ming2 shuo1

cues.zh: 欸你踩到大便了
cues.pinyin: ai1 ni3 cai3 dao4 da4 bian4 le5

cues.zh: 接下来阿民就不动声色地走到后阳台
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 a1 min2 jiu4 bu4 dong4 sheng1 se4 di4 zou3 dao4 hou4 yang2 tai2
cues.en: Then A-Ming calmly walked to the back balcony

cues.zh: 把教室的门再关好
cues.pinyin: ba3 jiao4 shi4 de5 men2 zai4 guan1 hao3
cues.en: and closed the classroom door behind him

cues.zh: 隔了好久直到我们上课了才回来
cues.pinyin: ge2 le5 hao3 jiu3 zhi2 dao4 wo3 men5 shang4 ke4 le5 cai2 hui2 lai2
cues.en: He didn't come back until a long time later, when class had already started

cues.zh: 欸你处理好了吗
cues.pinyin: ai1 ni3 chu3 li3 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: 'Hey, did you take care of it?'

cues.zh: 嗯但以后阳台上第二个水龙头
cues.pinyin: n2 dan4 yi3 hou4 yang2 tai2 shang4 di4 er4 ge4 shui3 long2 tou2
cues.en: 'Yeah, but from now on, the second faucet on the balcony

cues.zh: 都不要再用了
cues.pinyin: dou1 bu2 yao4 zai4 yong4 le5
cues.en: don't use it anymore'

cues.zh: 我疑惑地看着他
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 huo4 di4 kan4 zhe5 ta1
cues.en: I looked at him in confusion

cues.zh: 下课时间他才告诉我
cues.pinyin: xia4 ke4 shi2 jian1 ta1 cai2 gao4 su4 wo3
cues.en: At break time he finally told me

cues.zh: 原来是他把鞋子脱下来放在水龙头下猛冲
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 shi4 ta1 ba3 xie2 zi5 tuo1 xia4 lai2 fang4 zai4 shui3 long2 tou2 xia4 meng3 chong1
cues.en: He'd taken off his shoe and blasted it with water under the faucet

cues.zh: 但还是很多大便都黏在鞋底
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 shi4 hen3 duo1 da4 bian4 dou1 nian2 zai4 xie2 di3
cues.en: But a lot of the poop was still stuck to the sole

cues.zh: 他一时间找不到工具去挖干净
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 shi2 jian1 zhao3 bu2 dao4 gong1 ju4 qu4 wa1 gan1 jing4
cues.en: He couldn't find a tool to scrape it clean

cues.zh: 又不敢用手去弄
cues.pinyin: you4 bu4 gan3 yong4 shou3 qu4 nong4
cues.en: and didn't dare use his hands

cues.zh: 于是就一边冲水
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 yi1 bian1 chong1 shui3
cues.en: So while running the water

cues.zh: 一边用水龙头把鞋底刮干净
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 yong4 shui3 long2 tou2 ba3 xie2 di3 gua1 gan1 jing4
cues.en: he used the faucet itself to scrape the sole clean

cues.zh: 然后再若无其事地回去座位做好上课
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 ruo4 wu2 qi2 shi4 di4 hui2 qu4 zuo4 wei4 zuo4 hao3 shang4 ke4
cues.en: then went back to his seat like nothing happened and sat through class

cues.zh: 虽然他说他有把水龙头洗干净
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 shuo1 ta1 you3 ba3 shui3 long2 tou2 xi3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: Even though he said he'd washed the faucet clean

cues.zh: 到了中午大家吃完了便当
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 zhong1 wu3 da4 jia1 chi1 wan2 le5 bian4 dang1
cues.en: At noon, after everyone finished their lunch boxes

cues.zh: 看到同学到阳台的水龙头洗手
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 tong2 xue2 dao4 yang2 tai2 de5 shui3 long2 tou2 xi3 shou3
cues.en: seeing classmates go wash their hands at the balcony faucet

cues.zh: 还是觉得恶心
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jue2 de5 e3 xin1
cues.en: still made me feel grossed out

cues.zh: 但怕阿明被大家指责
cues.pinyin: dan4 pa4 a1 ming2 bei4 da4 jia1 zhi3 ze2
cues.en: But I was afraid A-Ming would get blamed by everyone

cues.zh: 最后我还是选择没跟大家说
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 hai2 shi4 xuan3 ze2 mei2 gen1 da4 jia1 shuo1
cues.en: so in the end I chose not to tell anyone

cues.zh: 等大家进教室后
cues.pinyin: deng3 da4 jia1 jin4 jiao4 shi4 hou4
cues.en: After everyone went back into the classroom

cues.zh: 我就告诫阿明
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 gao4 jie4 a1 ming2
cues.en: I warned A-Ming

cues.zh: 下次如果再这样没公德心就绝交
cues.pinyin: xia4 ci4 ru2 guo3 zai4 zhe4 yang4 mei2 gong1 de2 xin1 jiu4 jue2 jiao1
cues.en: 'If you do something this inconsiderate again, we're done being friends'

cues.zh: 他也说当时太慌张了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shuo1 dang1 shi2 tai4 huang1 zhang1 le5
cues.en: He said he'd just panicked in the moment

cues.zh: 其实事后他也很后悔
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 hou4 ta1 ye3 hen3 hou4 hui3
cues.en: and actually felt really guilty about it afterward

cues.zh: 于是我们用洗碗精又彻底的把水龙
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 men5 yong4 xi3 wan3 jing1 you4 che4 di3 de5 ba3 shui3 long2
cues.en: So we used dish soap to thoroughly

cues.zh: 头再清洗一次
cues.pinyin: tou2 zai4 qing1 xi3 yi1 ci4
cues.en: wash the faucet again

cues.zh: 直到水龙头闪闪发亮
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 shui3 long2 tou2 shan3 shan3 fa1 liang4
cues.en: until it was shining clean
