items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 做体育运动的时候受伤很常见
cues.pinyin: zuo4 ti3 yu4 yun4 dong4 de5 shi2 hou4 shou4 shang1 hen3 chang2 jian4
cues.en: Getting hurt during sports is common.

cues.zh: 但举重举到差点瘫痪的你见过吗
cues.pinyin: dan4 ju3 zhong4 ju3 dao4 cha4 dian3 tan1 huan4 de5 ni3 jian4 guo4 ma5
cues.en: But have you ever seen someone almost paralyzed from weightlifting?

cues.zh: 大壮是个橄榄球运动员为了增强臂力
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 shi4 ge4 gan3 lan3 qiu2 yun4 dong4 yuan2 wei4 le5 zeng1 qiang2 bi4 li4
cues.en: Dazhuang is a football player, and to build arm strength,

cues.zh: 他今天来到健身王练习举重
cues.pinyin: ta1 jin1 tian1 lai2 dao4 jian4 shen1 wang2 lian4 xi2 ju3 zhong4
cues.en: he came to Fitness King today to practice weightlifting.

cues.zh: 同在健身王锻炼的布朗在一旁看呆了
cues.pinyin: tong2 zai4 jian4 shen1 wang2 duan4 lian4 de5 bu4 lang3 zai4 yi1 pang2 kan4 dai1 le5
cues.en: Brown, who was also working out at Fitness King, watched in shock.

cues.zh: 因为他举的杠铃足足有 300 多斤
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 ju3 de5 gang4 ling2 zu2 zu2 you3 300 duo1 jin1
cues.en: because the barbell he was lifting weighed over 300 jin.

cues.zh: 这力气也太大了吧不怕出什么问题吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li4 qi4 ye3 tai4 da4 le5 ba5 bu4 pa4 chu1 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 ma5
cues.en: That's so much weight—aren't you afraid something will go wrong?

cues.zh: 没过多久布朗担心的事情就发生了
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3 bu4 lang3 dan1 xin1 de5 shi4 qing2 jiu4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: Not long after, what Brown feared happened.

cues.zh: 大壮突然脱力倒在地上
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 tu1 ran2 tuo1 li4 dao3 zai4 di4 shang4
cues.en: Dazhuang suddenly lost strength and collapsed.

cues.zh: 他和梅主管赶紧跑过去查看情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 mei2 zhu3 guan3 gan3 jin3 pao3 guo4 qu4 cha2 kan4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: He and Supervisor Mei rushed over to check on him.

cues.zh: 大壮一个劲的说自己的腿没知觉了
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 yi2 ge4 jin4 de5 shuo1 zi4 ji3 de5 tui3 mei2 zhi1 jue2 le5
cues.en: Dazhuang kept saying he couldn't feel his legs.

cues.zh: 梅主管让他别乱动
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhu3 guan3 rang4 ta1 bie2 luan4 dong4
cues.en: Supervisor Mei told him not to move.

cues.zh: 然后布朗立刻打了 9 11
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 bu4 lang3 li4 ke4 da3 le5 9 11
cues.en: Then Brown immediately called 911.

cues.zh: 大壮到医院后就做了核磁共振
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 hou4 jiu4 zuo4 le5 he2 ci2 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: After Dazhuang got to the hospital, he had an MRI.

cues.zh: 可结果并不乐观
cues.pinyin: ke3 jie2 guo3 bing4 bu4 le4 guan1
cues.en: But the results weren't good.

cues.zh: 他脊椎破裂
cues.pinyin: ta1 ji3 zhui1 po4 lie4
cues.en: His spine was fractured.

cues.zh: 小关节骨折
cues.pinyin: xiao3 guan1 jie2 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: The small joints were broken.

cues.zh: 而且后移的骨骼碎片进入了椎管
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hou4 yi2 de5 gu3 ge2 sui4 pian4 jin4 ru4 le5 chui2 guan3
cues.en: And bone fragments that shifted backward had entered the spinal canal.

cues.zh: 但脊椎里面并没有横贯性的瘀伤
cues.pinyin: dan4 ji3 zhui1 li3 mian4 bing4 mei2 you3 heng2 guan4 xing4 de5 yu1 shang1
cues.en: But there was no transverse bruising inside the spine.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 医生们决定把骨折稳定住
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jue2 ding4 ba3 gu3 zhe2 wen3 ding4 zhu4
cues.en: The doctors decided to stabilize the fracture

cues.zh: 减轻脊椎的压力
cues.pinyin: jian3 qing1 ji3 zhui1 de5 ya1 li4
cues.en: to relieve pressure on the spine.

cues.zh: 这样大概率可以治好大壮的麻痹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 da4 gai4 lv4 ke3 yi3 zhi4 hao3 da4 zhuang4 de5 ma2 bi4
cues.en: This would likely cure Dazhuang's paralysis.

cues.zh: 梅主管把这个想法告诉大壮的父亲后
cues.pinyin: mei2 zhu3 guan3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xiang3 fa3 gao4 su4 da4 zhuang4 de5 fu4 qin1 hou4
cues.en: After Supervisor Mei told Dazhuang's father this plan,

cues.zh: 却遭到了反对
cues.pinyin: que4 zao1 dao4 le5 fan3 dui4
cues.en: he objected.

cues.zh: 大壮的父亲要求使用治疗肌萎缩
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 fu4 qin1 yao1 qiu2 shi3 yong4 zhi4 liao2 ji1 wei1 suo1
cues.en: Dazhuang's father demanded they use medication for treating

cues.zh: 厕所硬化的药物
cues.pinyin: ce4 suo3 ying4 hua4 de5 yao4 wu4
cues.en: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) instead.

cues.zh: 这种药物能减少运动神经的损伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 yao4 wu4 neng2 jian3 shao3 yun4 dong4 shen2 jing1 de5 sun3 shang1
cues.en: This medication can reduce damage to motor neurons,

cues.zh: 但是不能逆转已经对运动神经
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 neng2 ni4 zhuan3 yi3 jing1 dui4 yun4 dong4 shen2 jing1
cues.en: but it can't reverse damage

cues.zh: 元造成的损害
cues.pinyin: yuan2 zao4 cheng2 de5 sun3 hai4
cues.en: already done to the motor neurons.

cues.zh: 黄姐立刻拒绝
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 li4 ke4 ju4 jue2
cues.en: Dr. Huang immediately refused.

cues.zh: 提议有一种实验性的低体温疗法
cues.pinyin: ti2 yi4 you3 yi1 zhong3 shi2 yan4 xing4 de5 di1 ti3 wen1 liao2 fa3
cues.en: She proposed an experimental hypothermia therapy

cues.zh: 在术前可以减少脊髓水肿和细胞死亡
cues.pinyin: zai4 shu4 qian2 ke3 yi3 jian3 shao3 ji2 sui3 shui3 zhong3 he2 xi4 bao1 si3 wang2
cues.en: that could reduce spinal cord swelling and cell death before surgery.

cues.zh: 但是这个方法会造成心动过缓心率不齐
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 fang1 fa3 hui4 zao4 cheng2 xin1 dong4 guo4 huan3 xin1 lv4 bu4 qi2
cues.en: But this method also carries a high risk of bradycardia

cues.zh: 的几率也很高
cues.pinyin: de5 ji1 lv4 ye3 hen3 gao1
cues.en: and irregular heartbeat.

cues.zh: 两方都是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: liang3 fang1 dou1 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What did the two sides actually mean?

cues.zh: 其实就是父亲希望在不危及大壮
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 fu4 qin1 xi1 wang4 zai4 bu4 wei1 ji2 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: In fact, the father hoped that, without endangering

cues.zh: 生命的前期下
cues.pinyin: sheng1 ming4 de5 qian2 qi1 xia4
cues.en: Dazhuang's life,

cues.zh: 要确定手术方法不会对他今后的
cues.pinyin: yao4 que4 ding4 shou3 shu4 fang1 fa3 bu2 hui4 dui4 ta1 jin1 hou4 de5
cues.en: they would choose a surgical method that wouldn't affect

cues.zh: 事业造成影响
cues.pinyin: shi4 ye4 zao4 cheng2 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: his future career.

cues.zh: 但医生要做的是尽大可能修复大壮的损伤
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 sheng1 yao4 zuo4 de5 shi4 jin3 da4 ke3 neng2 xiu1 fu4 da4 zhuang4 de5 sun3 shang1
cues.en: But what the doctors wanted to do was repair Dazhuang's injury as fully as possible.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 围观的父亲松了口气
cues.pinyin: wei2 guan1 de5 fu4 qin1 song1 le5 kou3 qi4
cues.en: The father, who was present, let out a sigh of relief.

cues.zh: 情况稳定后
cues.pinyin: qing2 kuang4 wen3 ding4 hou4
cues.en: After his condition stabilized,

cues.zh: 这个小手术就结束了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 shou3 shu4 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: this minor surgery was over.

cues.zh: 但医生们还要检查一下大壮的情况
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 sheng1 men5 hai2 yao4 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4 da4 zhuang4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: But the doctors still needed to check on Dazhuang's condition

cues.zh: 保证明天的正式手术顺利开展
cues.pinyin: bao3 zheng4 ming2 tian1 de5 zheng4 shi4 shou3 shu4 shun4 li4 kai1 zhan3
cues.en: to make sure tomorrow's main surgery would go smoothly.

cues.zh: 手术开始前
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 kai1 shi3 qian2
cues.en: Before the surgery began,

cues.zh: 黄姐安慰大壮
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 an1 wei4 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: Dr. Huang comforted Dazhuang,

cues.zh: 以后也许还有机会重回赛场
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 ye3 xu3 hai2 you3 ji1 hui4 zhong4 hui2 sai4 chang3
cues.en: saying he might still have a chance to return to the field someday.

cues.zh: 听此大壮忍不住坦白
cues.pinyin: ting1 ci3 da4 zhuang4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 tan3 bai2
cues.en: Hearing this, Dazhuang couldn't help but confess.

cues.zh: 他之所以选择医生的方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xuan3 ze2 yi1 sheng1 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: The reason he chose the doctors' plan

cues.zh: 是因为他一直很讨厌橄榄球
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 yi4 zhi2 hen3 tao3 yan4 gan3 lan3 qiu2
cues.en: was that he had always hated football.

cues.zh: 中学是因为身材的优势被选上球队
cues.pinyin: zhong1 xue2 shi4 yin1 wei4 shen1 cai2 de5 you1 shi4 bei4 xuan3 shang4 qiu2 dui4
cues.en: In middle school he was picked for the team because of his build,

cues.zh: 但并没有人问过他的意见
cues.pinyin: dan4 bing4 mei2 you3 ren2 wen4 guo4 ta1 de5 yi4 jian4
cues.en: but no one ever asked for his opinion.

cues.zh: 从第一次训练开始
cues.pinyin: cong2 di4 yi1 ci4 xun4 lian4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: From the very first practice,

cues.zh: 他就失去了自我
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shi1 qu4 le5 zi4 wo3
cues.en: he lost himself.

cues.zh: 大壮想过放弃
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 xiang3 guo4 fang4 qi4
cues.en: Dazhuang had thought about quitting,

cues.zh: 但是面对全家人以及亲戚朋友的期盼
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mian4 dui4 quan2 jia1 ren2 yi3 ji2 qin1 qi1 peng2 you3 de5 qi1 pan4
cues.en: but faced with the whole family's and relatives' expectations,

cues.zh: 他只能继续坚持
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 neng2 ji4 xu4 jian1 chi2
cues.en: he could only keep pushing through.

cues.zh: 他一直希望自己受伤
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 zhi2 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 shou4 shang1
cues.en: He had always wished he'd get injured.

cues.zh: 就连去举重房也是故意的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 qu4 ju3 zhong4 fang2 ye3 shi4 gu4 yi4 de5
cues.en: Even going to the weight room was intentional—

cues.zh: 想要弄破膝盖
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 nong4 po4 xi1 gai4
cues.en: he wanted to hurt his knee.

cues.zh: 但没想到出了这样的意外
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 xiang3 dao4 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: But he never expected this kind of accident.

cues.zh: 不管怎样手术很顺利
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 zen3 yang4 shou3 shu4 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: Regardless, the surgery went smoothly.

cues.zh: 医生连接上大壮断裂的脊椎
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 lian2 jie1 shang4 da4 zhuang4 duan4 lie4 de5 ji3 zhui1
cues.en: The doctors reconnected Dazhuang's broken spine.

cues.zh: 大壮想来后不朗去找他
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 xiang3 lai2 hou4 bu4 lang3 qu4 zhao3 ta1
cues.en: After Dazhuang woke up, Brown went to see him.

cues.zh: 告诉大壮
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: He told Dazhuang

cues.zh: 他得把自己的想法告诉父母
cues.pinyin: ta1 de2 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 xiang3 fa3 gao4 su4 fu4 mu3
cues.en: that he had to tell his parents how he really felt.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 但是要求必须带上室友
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yao1 qiu2 bi4 xu1 dai4 shang4 shi4 you3
cues.en: But he asked that they bring along his roommate

cues.zh: 兼好友丽雅
cues.pinyin: jian1 hao3 you3 li4 ya3
cues.en: and good friend, Liya.

cues.zh: 虽然伦叔觉得不太合适
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 lun2 shu1 jue2 de5 bu4 tai4 he2 shi4
cues.en: Although Uncle Lun felt it wasn't quite appropriate,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩好不容易同意了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 hao3 bu4 rong2 yi4 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Shaun had finally agreed,

cues.zh: 就没有要求那么多
cues.pinyin: jiu4 mei2 you3 yao1 qiu2 na4 me5 duo1
cues.en: so he didn't ask for anything more.

cues.zh: 他们要前往另一个城市
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yao4 qian2 wang3 ling4 yi2 ge4 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: They were going to head to another city.

cues.zh: 收拾东西后
cues.pinyin: shou1 shi2 dong1 xi1 hou4
cues.en: After packing their things,

cues.zh: 尽快坐上了飞机
cues.pinyin: jin3 kuai4 zuo4 shang4 le5 fei1 ji1
cues.en: they got on a plane as soon as possible.

cues.zh: 下飞机后三人驱车去了萧恩家
cues.pinyin: xia4 fei1 ji1 hou4 san1 ren2 qu1 che1 qu4 le5 xiao1 en1 jia1
cues.en: After landing, the three drove to Shaun's house.

cues.zh: 到达后萧恩突然却反悔了
cues.pinyin: dao4 da2 hou4 xiao1 en1 tu1 ran2 que4 fan3 hui3 le5
cues.en: But once they arrived, Shaun suddenly changed his mind.

cues.zh: 此时萧恩妈妈看到有人来
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 xiao1 en1 ma1 ma1 kan4 dao4 you3 ren2 lai2
cues.en: At that moment, Shaun's mother saw someone had come

cues.zh: 便出门查看
cues.pinyin: bian4 chu1 men2 cha2 kan4
cues.en: and went out to check.

cues.zh: 看到了伦叔和萧恩
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 le5 lun2 shu1 he2 xiao1 en1
cues.en: She saw Uncle Lun and Shaun,

cues.zh: 但又不敢直接上前
cues.pinyin: dan4 you4 bu4 gan3 zhi2 jie1 shang4 qian2
cues.en: but didn't dare approach directly.

cues.zh: 只能小心翼翼的往车边挪
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 xiao3 xin1 yi4 yi4 de5 wang3 che1 bian1 nuo2
cues.en: She could only inch carefully toward the car.

cues.zh: 萧恩这时突然情绪失控
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 zhe4 shi2 tu1 ran2 qing2 xu4 shi1 kong4
cues.en: Shaun suddenly lost control of his emotions,

cues.zh: 大叫着让伦叔开车离开
cues.pinyin: da4 jiao4 zhe5 rang4 lun2 shu1 kai1 che1 li2 kai1
cues.en: shouting at Uncle Lun to drive away.

cues.zh: 不断强调自己想走
cues.pinyin: bu4 duan4 qiang2 diao4 zi4 ji3 xiang3 zou3
cues.en: He kept insisting he wanted to leave.

cues.zh: 伦叔不敢再刺激他
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 bu4 gan3 zai4 ci4 ji1 ta1
cues.en: Uncle Lun didn't dare upset him further.

cues.zh: 匆忙和萧恩妈妈打了个招呼
cues.pinyin: cong1 mang2 he2 xiao1 en1 ma1 ma1 da3 le5 ge4 zhao1 hu1
cues.en: He hurriedly greeted Shaun's mother

cues.zh: 就驱车离开
cues.pinyin: jiu4 qu1 che1 li2 kai1
cues.en: and then drove off.

cues.zh: 三人在一所旅馆住下
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 zai4 yi1 suo3 lv3 guan3 zhu4 xia4
cues.en: The three of them checked into an inn.

cues.zh: 萧恩一个人坐在屋里
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zuo4 zai4 wu1 li3
cues.en: Shaun sat alone in his room.

cues.zh: 丽雅过来安慰他
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 guo4 lai2 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: Liya came to comfort him,

cues.zh: 告诉他没事的
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 mei2 shi4 de5
cues.en: telling him it would be okay.

cues.zh: 虽然父亲快死了
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 fu4 qin1 kuai4 si3 le5
cues.en: Even though his father was dying,

cues.zh: 但肖恩没有必要
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 mei2 you3 bi4 yao4
cues.en: Shaun didn't have to

cues.zh: 因此就原谅他的所作所为
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 jiu4 yuan2 liang4 ta1 de5 suo3 zuo4 suo3 wei2
cues.en: forgive him for everything he'd done just because of that.

cues.zh: 肖恩终于说话了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhong1 yu2 shuo1 hua4 le5
cues.en: Shaun finally spoke.

cues.zh: 他要去看望哥哥
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 qu4 kan4 wang4 ge1 ge1
cues.en: He said he wanted to visit his brother.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 两人和伦叔一起来到肖恩哥哥的墓地
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 he2 lun2 shu1 yi4 qi3 lai2 dao4 xiao4 en1 ge1 ge1 de5 mu4 di4
cues.en: The two of them, with Uncle Lun, went to Shaun's brother's grave.

cues.zh: 当初哥哥下葬时
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 ge1 ge1 xia4 zang4 shi2
cues.en: Back when his brother was buried,

cues.zh: 父亲亲戚还有伦叔都在场
cues.pinyin: fu4 qin1 qin1 qi1 hai2 you3 lun2 shu1 dou1 zai4 chang3
cues.en: his father, relatives, and Uncle Lun had all been there.

cues.zh: 肖恩当众拒绝随同父亲回去
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 dang1 zhong4 ju4 jue2 sui2 tong2 fu4 qin1 hui2 qu4
cues.en: Shaun had refused in front of everyone to go back with his father.

cues.zh: 两人无法达成和解
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 wu2 fa3 da2 cheng2 he2 jie3
cues.en: The two of them had never reconciled,

cues.zh: 直到今日
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 jin1 ri4
cues.en: right up until today.

cues.zh: 伦叔看出肖恩的难过
cues.pinyin: lun2 shu1 kan4 chu1 xiao4 en1 de5 nan2 guo4
cues.en: Uncle Lun saw how sad Shaun was

cues.zh: 努力安慰他
cues.pinyin: nu3 li4 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: and tried hard to comfort him,

cues.zh: 但还是不忘让他回去看看父亲
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 shi4 bu4 wang4 rang4 ta1 hui2 qu4 kan4 kan4 fu4 qin1
cues.en: but still didn't forget to urge him to go see his father.

cues.zh: 丽雅告诉他
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Liya told him

cues.zh: 如果是勉强的
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 shi4 mian3 qiang3 de5
cues.en: that if he was just forcing himself,

cues.zh: 那就不干是你做的
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 bu4 gan4 shi4 ni3 zuo4 de5
cues.en: then it wasn't something he truly wanted to do.

cues.zh: 肖恩最终还是回去了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zui4 zhong1 hai2 shi4 hui2 qu4 le5
cues.en: In the end, Shaun went back anyway.

cues.zh: 安静的坐在床前听父亲讲话
cues.pinyin: an1 jing4 de5 zuo4 zai4 chuang2 qian2 ting1 fu4 qin1 jiang3 hua4
cues.en: He sat quietly by the bed listening to his father speak,

cues.zh: 并不去看他
cues.pinyin: bing4 bu4 qu4 kan4 ta1
cues.en: without looking at him.

cues.zh: 小恩对不起
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 dui4 bu4 qi3
cues.en: "Xiao En, I'm sorry.

cues.zh: 只是我一直想要个儿子
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 wo3 yi4 zhi2 xiang3 yao4 ge4 er2 zi5
cues.en: It's just that I always wanted a son—

cues.zh: 我是说一个我能教他打猎钓鱼的孩子
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shuo1 yi2 ge4 wo3 neng2 jiao4 ta1 da3 lie4 diao4 yu2 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: I mean, a kid I could teach to hunt and fish,

cues.zh: 能一起捉迷藏
cues.pinyin: neng2 yi4 qi3 zhuo1 mi2 cang2
cues.en: someone to play hide-and-seek with,

cues.zh: 一起喝啤酒
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 he1 pi2 jiu3
cues.en: to drink beer with,

cues.zh: 一个可以扛在肩上的小孩
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 kang2 zai4 jian1 shang4 de5 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: a kid I could carry on my shoulders.

cues.zh: 我很愤怒
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 fen4 nu4
cues.en: I was angry,

cues.zh: 不是对你
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 dui4 ni3
cues.en: not at you,

cues.zh: 而是对我自己
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 dui4 wo3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: but at myself.

cues.zh: 我对自己很恼火
cues.pinyin: wo3 dui4 zi4 ji3 hen3 nao3 huo3
cues.en: I was furious at myself

cues.zh: 因为我帮不了我的儿子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 bang1 bu4 liao3 wo3 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: because I couldn't help my son.

cues.zh: 不管多么努力
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 duo1 me5 nu3 li4
cues.en: No matter how hard I tried,

cues.zh: 我总是失败了
cues.pinyin: wo3 zong3 shi4 shi1 bai4 le5
cues.en: I always failed.

cues.zh: 但你是个好孩子
cues.pinyin: dan4 ni3 shi4 ge4 hao3 hai2 zi5
cues.en: But you're a good kid."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】运动员想要故意弄伤自己，但结果却差点造成瘫痪！肖恩的父亲去世了

cues.zh: 长时间没上来
cues.pinyin: zhang3 shi2 jian1 mei2 shang4 lai2
cues.en: She hadn't come back up for a long time.

cues.zh: 肖恩有些慌
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 you3 xie1 huang1
cues.en: Shaun started to panic.

cues.zh: 脱了鞋袜想去看看
cues.pinyin: tuo1 le5 xie2 wa4 xiang3 qu4 kan4 kan4
cues.en: He took off his shoes and socks to go look.

cues.zh: 但丽雅又突然浮上来了
cues.pinyin: dan4 li4 ya3 you4 tu1 ran2 fu2 shang4 lai2 le5
cues.en: But Liya suddenly resurfaced.

cues.zh: 肖恩感觉自己被欺骗了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 gan3 jue2 zi4 ji3 bei4 qi1 pian4 le5
cues.en: Shaun felt like he'd been tricked.

cues.zh: 生气的离开
cues.pinyin: sheng1 qi4 de5 li2 kai1
cues.en: He left angrily.

cues.zh: 肖恩回到旅馆
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 hui2 dao4 lv3 guan3
cues.en: Shaun went back to the inn,

cues.zh: 坐到床上
cues.pinyin: zuo4 dao4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: sat down on the bed,

cues.zh: 看着自己沾满泥的脚
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 zi4 ji3 zhan1 man3 ni2 de5 jiao3
cues.en: and looked at his own mud-covered feet.

cues.zh: 记忆一下拉回小时候
cues.pinyin: ji4 yi4 yi1 xia4 la1 hui2 xiao3 shi2 hou4
cues.en: His memory suddenly pulled him back to his childhood.

cues.zh: 当时她和哥哥父亲一起去爬山
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 ta1 he2 ge1 ge1 fu4 qin1 yi4 qi3 qu4 pa2 shan1
cues.en: Back then, he, his brother, and his father went hiking together,

cues.zh: 要蹚过一条小河
cues.pinyin: yao4 tang1 guo4 yi1 tiao2 xiao3 he2
cues.en: and had to wade across a small stream.

cues.zh: 但肖恩不想沾上泥
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao4 en1 bu4 xiang3 zhan1 shang4 ni2
cues.en: But Shaun didn't want to get muddy

cues.zh: 也不愿让爸爸背过去
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 yuan4 rang4 ba4 ba4 bei4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and refused to let his dad carry him across.

cues.zh: 僵持之下
cues.pinyin: jiang1 chi2 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: In the standoff,

cues.zh: 爸爸趁他不注意
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 chen4 ta1 bu4 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: his dad caught him off guard

cues.zh: 把他强制的抱过去了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 qiang2 zhi4 de5 bao4 guo4 qu4 le5
cues.en: and forcibly carried him across.

cues.zh: 肖恩挣扎中
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zheng1 zha2 zhong1
cues.en: As Shaun struggled,

cues.zh: 把爸爸的脸抓烂了
cues.pinyin: ba3 ba4 ba4 de5 lian3 zhua1 lan4 le5
cues.en: he scratched up his dad's face,

cues.zh: 但是他没怪自己
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 mei2 guai4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: but his dad never blamed him for it.

cues.zh: 第二天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: The next day,

cues.zh: 肖恩他们正在吃饭
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ta1 men5 zheng4 zai4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: while Shaun and the others were eating,

cues.zh: 妈妈主动来找肖恩
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zhu3 dong4 lai2 zhao3 xiao4 en1
cues.en: his mother came to find him on her own,

cues.zh: 近乎哀求的请求他
cues.pinyin: jin4 hu1 ai1 qiu2 de5 qing3 qiu2 ta1
cues.en: almost begging him

cues.zh: 能再去看看爸爸
cues.pinyin: neng2 zai4 qu4 kan4 kan4 ba4 ba4
cues.en: to go see his dad again.

cues.zh: 妈妈真情流露
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 zhen1 qing2 liu2 lu4
cues.en: Seeing his mother's genuine emotion

cues.zh: 或许让肖恩有一些动容
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 rang4 xiao4 en1 you3 yi1 xie1 dong4 rong2
cues.en: may have moved Shaun a little.

cues.zh: 在他想要抱住自己时
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 xiang3 yao4 bao4 zhu4 zi4 ji3 shi2
cues.en: When she tried to hug him,

cues.zh: 还主动站了起来
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhu3 dong4 zhan4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: he even stood up on his own.

cues.zh: 他决定再和父亲好好谈一谈
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 ding4 zai4 he2 fu4 qin1 hao3 hao3 tan2 yi1 tan2
cues.en: He decided to have a real talk with his father again.

cues.zh: 可这次父亲和上一次判诺了两人
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 ci4 fu4 qin1 he2 shang4 yi1 ci4 pan4 nuo4 le5 liang3 ren2
cues.en: But this time, his father seemed like a completely different person compared to before.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话86｜不然我掏吧！｜小学生造句｜是1个人😡😤｜学霸｜火腿的相反｜在一块喔｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 情人节快到了老板叫秘书去买花
cues.pinyin: qing2 ren2 jie2 kuai4 dao4 le5 lao3 ban3 jiao4 mi4 shu1 qu4 mai3 hua1
cues.en: Valentine's Day is coming, so the boss told the secretary to go buy flowers.

cues.zh: 要送情人秘书问老板老板
cues.pinyin: yao4 song4 qing2 ren2 mi4 shu1 wen4 lao3 ban3 lao3 ban3
cues.en: To give to his lover. The secretary asked the boss, "Boss,

cues.zh: 你有几个情人啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 ji3 ge4 qing2 ren2 a5
cues.en: how many lovers do you have?"

cues.zh: 是一个人
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: "It's one person."

cues.zh: 十一个人哦
cues.pinyin: shi2 yi2 ge4 ren2 o2
cues.en: "Eleven people, huh?"

cues.zh: 不是十一个人而是一个人
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 shi2 yi2 ge4 ren2 er2 shi4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: "Not eleven — just one person."

cues.zh: 二十一个人哇哦
cues.pinyin: er4 shi2 yi2 ge4 ren2 wa5 o2
cues.en: "Twenty-one people, whoa!"

cues.zh: 你听错了七十一个人
cues.pinyin: ni3 ting1 cuo4 le5 qi1 shi2 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: "You heard wrong — seventy-one people."

cues.zh: 七十一个人太吓人了吧
cues.pinyin: qi1 shi2 yi2 ge4 ren2 tai4 xia4 ren2 le5 ba5
cues.en: "Seventy-one people is way too scary!"

cues.zh: 老板生气的说就是一个人
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 sheng1 qi4 de5 shuo1 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: The boss angrily said, "It's just one person!"

cues.zh: 9 11 个人不可能吧
cues.pinyin: 9 11 ge4 ren2 bu4 ke3 neng2 ba5
cues.en: "911 people? No way!"

cues.zh: 老板忍不住骂人了
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 ren3 bu2 zhu4 ma4 ren2 le5
cues.en: The boss couldn't help but start cursing.

cues.zh: 15 4 一个人啊
cues.pinyin: 15 4 yi2 ge4 ren2 a5
cues.en: "154 people?"

cues.zh: 25 1 个人天啊
cues.pinyin: 25 1 ge4 ren2 tian1 a5
cues.en: "251 people, good grief!"

cues.zh: 隔天老板就把秘书开除了
cues.pinyin: ge2 tian1 lao3 ban3 jiu4 ba3 mi4 shu1 kai1 chu2 le5
cues.en: The next day, the boss fired the secretary.

items.title_zh: 笑话86｜不然我掏吧！｜小学生造句｜是1个人😡😤｜学霸｜火腿的相反｜在一块喔｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小小我问你喔
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Xiaoxiao, let me ask you,"

cues.zh: 妳知道火腿的相反是什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 huo3 tui3 de5 xiang1 fan3 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: "do you know what the opposite of ham is?"

cues.zh: 火腿的相反就是推火啊
cues.pinyin: huo3 tui3 de5 xiang1 fan3 jiu4 shi4 tui1 huo3 a5
cues.en: "The opposite of ham is push-fire!"

cues.zh: 不是答案是水手
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 da2 an4 shi4 shui3 shou3
cues.en: "No, the answer is 'sailor.'"

cues.zh: 很好笑吧
cues.pinyin: hen3 hao3 xiao4 ba5
cues.en: "Pretty funny, right?"

cues.zh: 欸欸欸欸欸欸欸
cues.pinyin: ai1 ai1 ai1 ai1 ai1 ai1 ai1
cues.en: "Hey hey hey hey hey hey hey—"

cues.zh: 干嘛这样
cues.pinyin: gan4 ma2 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: "Why are you like this?"

cues.zh: 朋友说要请客去吃饭
cues.pinyin: peng2 you3 shuo1 yao4 qing3 ke4 qu4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: A friend said he'd treat everyone to dinner.

cues.zh: 吃完付钱的时候
cues.pinyin: chi1 wan2 fu4 qian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When it came time to pay after eating,

cues.zh: 小明看他掏钱掏得很慢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 kan4 ta1 tao1 qian2 tao1 de2 hen3 man4
cues.en: Xiaoming saw him fumbling for his money really slowly,

cues.zh: 忽然
cues.pinyin: hu1 ran2
cues.en: and suddenly—

cues.zh: 我掏吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 tao1 ba5
cues.en: "Let me get it."

cues.zh: 喔那怎么好意思
cues.pinyin: o1 na4 zen3 me5 hao3 yi4 si5
cues.en: "Oh, how could I let you do that—"

cues.zh: 于是小明就把手伸进他朋友的口袋里掏钱
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xiao3 ming2 jiu4 ba3 shou3 shen1 jin4 ta1 peng2 you3 de5 kou3 dai4 li3 tao1 qian2
cues.en: So Xiaoming reached straight into his friend's pocket and dug out the money.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话86｜不然我掏吧！｜小学生造句｜是1个人😡😤｜学霸｜火腿的相反｜在一块喔｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 陈陈陈陈陈
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 chen2 chen2 chen2
cues.en: "Chen, Chen, Chen, Chen, Chen—"

cues.zh: 什么事
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi4
cues.en: "What's up?"

cues.zh: 我跟你说喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 gen1 ni3 shuo1 o1
cues.en: "Let me tell you,"

cues.zh: 我们班有一个很厉害的学霸
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ban1 you3 yi2 ge4 hen3 li4 hai4 de5 xue2 ba4
cues.en: "there's a really amazing top student in our class."

cues.zh: 他上课一般都是闭目养神
cues.pinyin: ta1 shang4 ke4 yi4 ban1 dou1 shi4 bi4 mu4 yang3 shen2
cues.en: "He usually just closes his eyes and rests during class,"

cues.zh: 但是当他睁开眼睛的那一刻
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dang1 ta1 zheng1 kai1 yan3 jing1 de5 na4 yi1 ke4
cues.en: "but the moment he opens his eyes,"

cues.zh: 老师就知道自己哪里肯定讲错了
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 na3 li3 ken3 ding4 jiang3 cuo4 le5
cues.en: "the teacher knows she must have said something wrong."

cues.zh: 那有什么了不起
cues.pinyin: na4 you3 shen2 me5 liao3 bu4 qi3
cues.en: "What's so great about that?"

cues.zh: 我也跟那个学霸一样啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 gen1 na4 ge5 xue2 ba4 yi1 yang4 a5
cues.en: "I'm just like that top student too!"

cues.zh: 只要我一睁开眼睛
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 wo3 yi1 zheng1 kai1 yan3 jing1
cues.en: "The moment I open my eyes,"

cues.zh: 老师就知道要下课了
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 yao4 xia4 ke4 le5
cues.en: "the teacher knows it's time for class to end."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 大学生惨死诡异树林，凶手竟是几百年前的鬼魂吗！《识骨寻踪》p10—2

cues.zh: 大学生惨死诡异树林
cues.pinyin: da4 xue2 sheng1 can3 si3 gui3 yi4 shu4 lin2
cues.en: A college student dies gruesomely in a mysterious forest.

cues.zh: 到底是冤魂索命还是变态杀手所为
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 yuan1 hun2 suo3 ming4 hai2 shi4 bian4 tai4 sha1 shou3 suo3 wei4
cues.en: Is it a vengeful ghost claiming his life, or the work of a psychotic killer?

cues.zh: 这是一片被诅咒笼罩的树林
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 pian4 bei4 zu3 zhou4 long3 zhao4 de5 shu4 lin2
cues.en: This is a forest shrouded in a curse.

cues.zh: 传说有人在这里见到了死去的马吉
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shuo1 you3 ren2 zai4 zhe4 li3 jian4 dao4 le5 si3 qu4 de5 ma3 ji2
cues.en: Legend says someone here saw the ghost of Magi, who died long ago.

cues.zh: 他曾经是这里的一个住客
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 shi4 zhe4 li3 de5 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ke4
cues.en: He once lived here as a resident.

cues.zh: 但在 17 80 年就死了
cues.pinyin: dan4 zai4 17 80 nian2 jiu4 si3 le5
cues.en: But he died in 1780.

cues.zh: 这附近的居民认为他是女巫
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fu4 jin4 de5 ju1 min2 ren4 wei2 ta1 shi4 nv3 wu1
cues.en: Nearby residents believed he was a witch.

cues.zh: 所以就把他给斩首了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 ba3 ta1 gei3 zhan3 shou3 le5
cues.en: So they beheaded him.

cues.zh: 相传他的灵魂还在林中飘荡
cues.pinyin: xiang1 chuan2 ta1 de5 ling2 hun2 hai2 zai4 lin2 zhong1 piao1 dang4
cues.en: It's said his spirit still wanders the forest.

cues.zh: 寻找他被砍下的头颅
cues.pinyin: xun2 zhao3 ta1 bei4 kan3 xia4 de5 tou2 lu2
cues.en: Searching for the head that was cut off.

cues.zh: 这个树林里经常发生奇怪的事情
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu4 lin2 li3 jing1 chang2 fa1 sheng1 qi2 guai4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: Strange things often happen in this forest.

cues.zh: 比如树枝挂着许多类似眼睛的鸟骨
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shu4 zhi1 gua4 zhe5 xu3 duo1 lei4 si4 yan3 jing1 de5 niao3 gu3
cues.en: For example, bird bones that look like eyes hang from the branches.

cues.zh: 上面还有血迹
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 hai2 you3 xue4 ji4
cues.en: There are also traces of blood on them.

cues.zh: 而来这里查案的小谷和布斯
cues.pinyin: er2 lai2 zhe4 li3 cha2 an4 de5 xiao3 gu3 he2 bu4 si1
cues.en: Xiaogu and Booth, who came here to investigate,

cues.zh: 也见到了许多个这种鸟谷
cues.pinyin: ye3 jian4 dao4 le5 xu3 duo1 ge4 zhe4 zhong3 niao3 gu3
cues.en: also saw many of these bird bones.

cues.zh: 就像一只一只的眼睛
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 yi1 zhi1 yi1 zhi1 de5 yan3 jing1
cues.en: They looked just like eyes, one after another.

cues.zh: 在监视着来来往往的人
cues.pinyin: zai4 jian1 shi4 zhe5 lai2 lai2 wang3 wang3 de5 ren2
cues.en: Watching over everyone who passed by.

cues.zh: 一个游客在这个树林里探险
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 you2 ke4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 lin2 li3 tan4 xian3
cues.en: A tourist was exploring this forest.

cues.zh: 结果不小心掉进了一个树叶眼藏陷阱
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 bu4 xiao3 xin1 diao4 jin4 le5 yi2 ge4 shu4 ye4 yan3 cang2 xian4 jing3
cues.en: and accidentally fell into a trap hidden under leaves.

cues.zh: 直接和里面一具死相层中的尸体
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 he2 li3 mian4 yi1 ju4 si3 xiang1 ceng2 zhong1 de5 shi1 ti3
cues.en: He ended up making direct, intimate contact

cues.zh: 来了个亲密接触
cues.pinyin: lai2 le5 ge4 qin1 mi4 jie1 chu4
cues.en: with a badly decomposed corpse inside.

cues.zh: 魂都要吓飞了
cues.pinyin: hun2 dou1 yao4 xia4 fei1 le5
cues.en: He was scared out of his wits.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 大学生惨死诡异树林，凶手竟是几百年前的鬼魂吗！《识骨寻踪》p10—2

cues.zh: 带两人来的管理员告诉他们
cues.pinyin: dai4 liang3 ren2 lai2 de5 guan3 li3 yuan2 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: The ranger who brought the two of them told them:

cues.zh: 马吉曾经说过
cues.pinyin: ma3 ji2 ceng2 jing1 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: Magi once said

cues.zh: 谁要来找他
cues.pinyin: shui2 yao4 lai2 zhao3 ta1
cues.en: that whoever came looking for him,

cues.zh: 他一定会杀了那个人
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ding4 hui4 sha1 le5 na4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: he would definitely kill that person.

cues.zh: 而受害者死亡的方式
cues.pinyin: er2 shou4 hai4 zhe3 si3 wang2 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: And the way the victim died

cues.zh: 也如同传说里马吉杀人的方式一样
cues.pinyin: ye3 ru2 tong2 chuan2 shuo1 li3 ma3 ji2 sha1 ren2 de5 fang1 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: matched exactly how legend says Magi killed people —

cues.zh: 被砍下了头颅
cues.pinyin: bei4 kan3 xia4 le5 tou2 lu2
cues.en: his head had been cut off.

cues.zh: 死者是一名男性
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 shi4 yi1 ming2 nan2 xing4
cues.en: The deceased was male,

cues.zh: 年龄在 18 到 25 岁之间
cues.pinyin: nian2 ling2 zai4 18 dao4 25 sui4 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: between 18 and 25 years old.

cues.zh: 怀里还有一个摄像机
cues.pinyin: huai2 li3 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 she4 xiang4 ji1
cues.en: He still had a camera in his arms,

cues.zh: 但头却不翼而飞了
cues.pinyin: dan4 tou2 que4 bu4 yi4 er2 fei1 le5
cues.en: but his head had vanished without a trace.

cues.zh: 小谷才不相信什么鬼神的传说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 gu3 cai2 bu4 xiang1 xin4 shen2 me5 gui3 shen2 de5 chuan2 shuo1
cues.en: Xiaogu didn't believe any ghost stories at all.

cues.zh: 他相信一定能从尸体上找到凶手的线索
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang1 xin4 yi2 ding4 neng2 cong2 shi1 ti3 shang4 zhao3 dao4 xiong1 shou3 de5 xian4 suo3
cues.en: He believed he could find clues to the killer from the body.

cues.zh: 杰克经过鉴定尸体上的昆虫
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 jing1 guo4 jian4 ding4 shi1 ti3 shang4 de5 kun1 chong2
cues.en: Jack identified the insects on the body

cues.zh: 确定了死者的死亡时间
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 le5 si3 zhe3 de5 si3 wang2 shi2 jian1
cues.en: and determined the time of death.

cues.zh: 是在去年的 11 月份
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 qu4 nian2 de5 11 yue4 fen4
cues.en: It was last November.

cues.zh: 尸体上找到的木屑属于一种画木
cues.pinyin: shi1 ti3 shang4 zhao3 dao4 de5 mu4 xie4 shu3 yu2 yi1 zhong3 hua4 mu4
cues.en: Wood splinters found on the body belonged to a type of wood called "huamu."

cues.zh: 而这种画木近在 18 00 年就已经绝种了
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 zhong3 hua4 mu4 jin4 zai4 18 00 nian2 jiu4 yi3 jing1 jue2 zhong3 le5
cues.en: And that wood had already gone extinct as early as 1800.

cues.zh: 传说马基用来杀人的凶器
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shuo1 ma3 ji1 yong4 lai2 sha1 ren2 de5 xiong1 qi4
cues.en: According to legend, the weapon Magi used to kill

cues.zh: 是 17 83 年把他缠属的那把斧头
cues.pinyin: shi4 17 83 nian2 ba3 ta1 chan2 shu3 de5 na4 ba3 fu3 tou2
cues.en: was the axe that beheaded him in 1783.

cues.zh: 这段画信息量太大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 duan4 hua4 xin4 xi1 liang4 tai4 da4
cues.en: This bit of dialogue carried a lot of information.

cues.zh: 让人起了一层鸡皮疙瘩
cues.pinyin: rang4 ren2 qi3 le5 yi1 ceng2 ji1 pi2 ge1 da5
cues.en: It gave people goosebumps.

cues.zh: 难不成真的有鬼魂吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 bu4 cheng2 zhen1 de5 you3 gui3 hun2 ma5
cues.en: Could there really be a ghost?

cues.zh: 布斯查了失踪人口
cues.pinyin: bu4 si1 cha2 le5 shi1 zong1 ren2 kou3
cues.en: Booth looked into missing persons reports.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 大学生惨死诡异树林，凶手竟是几百年前的鬼魂吗！《识骨寻踪》p10—2

cues.zh: 显示他在死之前曾努力地保护头部
cues.pinyin: xian3 shi4 ta1 zai4 si3 zhi1 qian2 ceng2 nu3 li4 di4 bao3 hu4 tou2 bu4
cues.en: It showed he had tried hard to protect his head before dying.

cues.zh: 前臂那次的齿骨曾经有过粉碎性骨折
cues.pinyin: qian2 bi4 na4 ci4 de5 chi3 gu3 ceng2 jing1 you3 guo4 fen3 sui4 xing4 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: His forearm's ulna had once suffered a comminuted fracture.

cues.zh: 肌骨专件很专业
cues.pinyin: ji1 gu3 zhuan1 jian4 hen3 zhuan1 ye4
cues.en: The bone-setting surgery had been done very professionally.

cues.zh: 恢复得不错
cues.pinyin: hui1 fu4 de2 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: It had healed well.

cues.zh: 从结巴情况来看
cues.pinyin: cong2 jie1 ba5 qing2 kuang4 lai2 kan4
cues.en: Judging from the callus,

cues.zh: 应该是童年时期造成的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 tong2 nian2 shi2 qi1 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: it was likely caused during childhood.

cues.zh: 葛雷的父母在他 13 岁时意外身亡
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 de5 fu4 mu3 zai4 ta1 13 sui4 shi2 yi4 wai4 shen1 wang2
cues.en: This also confirmed the victim's identity as Gray.

cues.zh: 葛雷的父母在大 13 岁时意外身亡
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 de5 fu4 mu3 zai4 da4 13 sui4 shi2 yi4 wai4 shen1 wang2
cues.en: Gray's parents died unexpectedly when he was 13.

cues.zh: 只和一个哥哥相依为命
cues.pinyin: zhi3 he2 yi2 ge4 ge1 ge1 xiang1 yi1 wei2 ming4
cues.en: He had only his older brother to rely on.

cues.zh: 当时两人都小
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 liang3 ren2 dou1 xiao3
cues.en: Both of them were young at the time.

cues.zh: 哥哥退学进了消防队养活两个人
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 tui4 xue2 jin4 le5 xiao1 fang2 dui4 yang3 huo2 liang3 ge4 ren2
cues.en: His brother dropped out of school and joined the fire department to support them both.

cues.zh: 从哥哥那里得知
cues.pinyin: cong2 ge1 ge1 na4 li3 de2 zhi1
cues.en: From the brother, they learned

cues.zh: 葛雷失踪那天
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 shi1 zong1 na4 tian1
cues.en: that on the day Gray disappeared,

cues.zh: 和同校的两个电影系学生在一起
cues.pinyin: he2 tong2 xiao4 de5 liang3 ge4 dian4 ying3 xi4 xue2 sheng1 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: he was with two film students from the same school,

cues.zh: 一个男孩一个女孩
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 nan2 hai2 yi2 ge4 nv3 hai2
cues.en: a boy and a girl —

cues.zh: 正是录像里的另外两人
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shi4 lu4 xiang4 li3 de5 ling4 wai4 liang3 ren2
cues.en: the same two people seen in the video,

cues.zh: 小恩和小丽
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 he2 xiao3 li4
cues.en: Xiao En and Xiao Li.

cues.zh: 哥哥曾想让小恩带自己进树林里找葛雷
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 ceng2 xiang3 rang4 xiao3 en1 dai4 zi4 ji3 jin4 shu4 lin2 li3 zhao3 ge2 lei2
cues.en: The brother once asked Xiao En to take him into the forest to find Gray,

cues.zh: 但小恩吓坏了
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 en1 xia4 huai4 le5
cues.en: but Xiao En was terrified

cues.zh: 死活不肯回去
cues.pinyin: si3 huo2 bu4 ken3 hui2 qu4
cues.en: and absolutely refused to go back.

cues.zh: 她作为消防员
cues.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 wei2 xiao1 fang2 yuan2
cues.en: As a firefighter,

cues.zh: 曾经组织多次救援
cues.pinyin: ceng2 jing1 zu3 zhi1 duo1 ci4 jiu4 yuan2
cues.en: she had organized multiple rescue efforts,

cues.zh: 可都一无所获
cues.pinyin: ke3 dou1 yi1 wu2 suo3 huo4
cues.en: but all came up empty.

cues.zh: 格雷本来有一份奖学金
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 ben3 lai2 you3 yi1 fen4 jiang3 xue2 jin1
cues.en: Gray originally had a scholarship,

cues.zh: 每年三万美元
cues.pinyin: mei3 nian2 san1 wan4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: worth $30,000 a year.

cues.zh: 而小恩也申请了这份奖学金
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 en1 ye3 shen1 qing3 le5 zhe4 fen4 jiang3 xue2 jin1
cues.en: Xiao En had also applied for that same scholarship,

cues.zh: 可最终输给了格雷
cues.pinyin: ke3 zui4 zhong1 shu1 gei3 le5 ge2 lei2
cues.en: but ultimately lost to Gray.

cues.zh: 如果格雷出事了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ge2 lei2 chu1 shi4 le5
cues.en: If something happened to Gray,

cues.zh: 钱就是小恩的了
cues.pinyin: qian2 jiu4 shi4 xiao3 en1 de5 le5
cues.en: the money would go to Xiao En.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 大学生惨死诡异树林，凶手竟是几百年前的鬼魂吗！《识骨寻踪》p10—2

cues.zh: 小白通过尸体上的伤痕
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 tong1 guo4 shi1 ti3 shang4 de5 shang1 hen2
cues.en: From the wounds on the body, Xiaogu

cues.zh: 推断格雷死后曾被拖拽过
cues.pinyin: tui1 duan4 ge2 lei2 si3 hou4 ceng2 bei4 tuo1 zhuai1 guo4
cues.en: deduced that Gray's body had been dragged after death,

cues.zh: 导致了比往拖旧
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 le5 bi3 wang3 tuo1 jiu4
cues.en: causing abrasions on the skin.

cues.zh: 但拖拽的距离并不远

cues.zh: 显示这个人做过环具术
cues.pinyin: xian3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 zuo4 guo4 huan2 ju4 shu4
cues.en: showing this person had undergone trepanation.

cues.zh: 这是一种古老的手术
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 gu3 lao3 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: This was an ancient surgical procedure

cues.zh: 被用来治疗头疼
cues.pinyin: bei4 yong4 lai2 zhi4 liao2 tou2 teng2
cues.en: used to treat headaches,

cues.zh: 在 17 世纪也存用在女巫身上
cues.pinyin: zai4 17 shi4 ji4 ye3 cun2 yong4 zai4 nv3 wu1 shen1 shang4
cues.en: and in the 17th century it was also performed on accused witches.

cues.zh: 但相当于老古董的斧头和头骨怎么会出
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 lao3 gu3 dong3 de5 fu3 tou2 he2 tou2 gu3 zen3 me5 hui4 chu1
cues.en: But how could an axe and skull, practically antiques,

cues.zh: 现在树林里呢
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 shu4 lin2 li3 ne5
cues.en: end up in this forest?

cues.zh: 唯一科学的解释就是有人偷了这两样东西
cues.pinyin: wei2 yi1 ke1 xue2 de5 jie3 shi4 jiu4 shi4 you3 ren2 tou1 le5 zhe4 liang3 yang4 dong1 xi1
cues.en: The only scientific explanation was that someone had stolen both items

cues.zh: 故意造成马吉杀人的假象
cues.pinyin: gu4 yi4 zao4 cheng2 ma3 ji2 sha1 ren2 de5 jia3 xiang4
cues.en: to deliberately stage it as a Magi-style murder.

cues.zh: 格雷背包里有一本剧本是关于马吉的
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 bei1 bao1 li3 you3 yi1 ben3 ju4 ben3 shi4 guan1 yu2 ma3 ji2 de5
cues.en: In Gray's backpack was a script about Magi,

cues.zh: 而布斯发现
cues.pinyin: er2 bu4 si1 fa1 xian4
cues.en: and Booth discovered

cues.zh: 小恩最近在筹备的一个电影也是
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 zui4 jin4 zai4 chou2 bei4 de5 yi2 ge4 dian4 ying3 ye3 shi4
cues.en: that the movie Xiao En was recently preparing

cues.zh: 关于这个故事
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: was also about this very story.

cues.zh: 他们还查出
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 cha2 chu1
cues.en: They also found out

cues.zh: 格雷曾经把这个剧本电子版发给了小恩
cues.pinyin: ge2 lei2 ceng2 jing1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ju4 ben3 dian4 zi5 ban3 fa1 gei3 le5 xiao3 en1
cues.en: that Gray had once sent an electronic copy of the script to Xiao En,

cues.zh: 想问问他的意见
cues.pinyin: xiang3 wen4 wen4 ta1 de5 yi4 jian4
cues.en: wanting his opinion on it.

cues.zh: 会不会是小恩想剖泄故事
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 xiao3 en1 xiang3 pou1 xie4 gu4 shi4
cues.en: Could Xiao En have wanted to plagiarize the story,

cues.zh: 于是借马吉的传说杀了格雷
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jie4 ma3 ji2 de5 chuan2 shuo1 sha1 le5 ge2 lei2
cues.en: and used the Magi legend to kill Gray?

cues.zh: 面对布斯的质疑
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 bu4 si1 de5 zhi4 yi2
cues.en: Faced with Booth's suspicion,

cues.zh: 小恩只能承认自己是嫉妒格雷
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 zhi3 neng2 cheng2 ren4 zi4 ji3 shi4 ji2 du4 ge2 lei2
cues.en: Xiao En could only admit he was jealous of Gray,

cues.zh: 但是他没杀人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 mei2 sha1 ren2
cues.en: but insisted he hadn't killed anyone.

cues.zh: 只是在格雷失踪
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 zai4 ge2 lei2 shi1 zong1
cues.en: It was just that once Gray went missing,

cues.zh: 而且大概率不会回来后
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 da4 gai4 lv4 bu2 hui4 hui2 lai2 hou4
cues.en: and most likely wasn't coming back,

cues.zh: 李戴桃将获得了一个剧本的注作权
cues.pinyin: li3 dai4 tao2 jiang1 huo4 de2 le5 yi2 ge4 ju4 ben3 de5 zhu4 zuo4 quan2
cues.en: he would naturally end up with the script's authorship rights.

cues.zh: 他还说
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shuo1
cues.en: He also said

cues.zh: 他找到小丽的时候
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 li4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that when he found Xiao Li,

cues.zh: 他浑身是血
cues.pinyin: ta1 hun2 shen1 shi4 xue4
cues.en: she was covered in blood,

cues.zh: 但不是小丽自己的
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu2 shi4 xiao3 li4 zi4 ji3 de5
cues.en: but it wasn't her own.

cues.zh: 小丽精神错乱
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 jing1 shen2 cuo4 luan4

cues.zh: 但这也太小了吧

cues.zh: 但不符合格雷

cues.pinyin: sui1 ken3 ding4 bu2 shi4 ma3 ji4

cues.zh: 看来格雷的死

cues.zh: 确实是一场谋杀

cues.zh: 而非灵异事件
cues.pinyin: er2 fei1 ling2 yi4 shi4 jian4
cues.en: not a supernatural event.

cues.zh: 而这个神秘人
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 shen2 mi4 ren2
cues.en: And this mysterious person

cues.zh: 应该就是凶手了
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 jiu4 shi4 xiong1 shou3 le5
cues.en: must be the killer.

cues.zh: 经过进一步检测
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 jin4 yi2 bu4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: After further testing,

cues.zh: 浮头上又分离出了
cues.pinyin: fu2 tou2 shang4 you4 fen1 li2 chu1 le5

cues.zh: 被格雷伤到留下的

cues.zh: 猪肉虾仁馄饨

cues.zh: 在这个大碗里面我们有 8 个 oz 的猪肉

cues.zh: 接下来加 2 汤匙酱油

cues.en: Next add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce

cues.zh: 2 汤匙绍兴酒
cues.pinyin: 2 tang1 chi2 shao4 xing1 jiu3
cues.en: 2 tablespoons of Shaoxing wine

cues.zh: 少许糖
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 tang2
cues.en: A little sugar

cues.zh: 1 茶匙盐
cues.pinyin: 1 cha2 chi2 yan2
cues.en: 1 teaspoon of salt

cues.zh: 1 茶匙白胡椒
cues.pinyin: 1 cha2 chi2 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: 1 teaspoon of white pepper

cues.zh: 1 汤匙芝麻油
cues.pinyin: 1 tang1 chi2 zhi1 ma2 you2
cues.en: 1 tablespoon of sesame oil

cues.zh: 2 汤匙玉米粉水
cues.pinyin: 2 tang1 chi2 yu4 mi3 fen3 shui3
cues.en: 2 tablespoons of cornstarch water

cues.zh: 还有一个鸡蛋
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 ji1 dan4

cues.zh: 接下来呢我们把它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2

cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 xiang3 yao4 xian2 yi4 dian3 de5 jiu4 duo1 fang4 yi4 dian3 jiang4 you2 a5

cues.zh: 都放一点盐
cues.pinyin: dou1 fang4 yi4 dian3 yan2
cues.en: Add a little salt as well

cues.zh: 再放进来四个 l 剁碎的虾仁
cues.pinyin: zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 si4 ge4 l duo4 sui4 de5 xia1 ren2

cues.zh: 三汤匙蘑菇
cues.pinyin: san1 tang1 chi2 mo2 gu1
cues.en: 3 tablespoons of mushrooms

cues.en: Actually, I really do quite like making wontons

cues.zh: 因为可以全家人一起做
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ke3 yi3 quan2 jia1 ren2 yi4 qi3 zuo4
cues.en: Because the whole family can make them together

cues.zh: 包著包著很有趣
cues.pinyin: bao1 zhu4 bao1 zhu4 hen3 you3 qu4
cues.en: Wrapping them is really fun

cues.zh: 你也可以教你自己的孩子怎么样做馄饨啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 jiao4 ni3 zi4 ji3 de5 hai2 zi5 zen3 me5 yang4 zuo4 hun2 tun2 a5
cues.en: You can also teach your own kids how to make wontons

cues.zh: 可是当你的小孩子做完馄饨之后呢
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dang1 ni3 de5 xiao3 hai2 zi5 zuo4 wan2 hun2 tun2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: But after your kids finish making the wontons

cues.zh: 你就这样子看了一下
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 kan4 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: You just take a look like this

cues.zh: 姐姐你是我看过最干净的人
cues.pinyin: jie3 jie3 ni3 shi4 wo3 kan4 guo4 zui4 gan1 jing4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Sis, you're the cleanest person I've ever seen.

cues.zh: 真的吗你是从哪里看出来的
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 ma5 ni3 shi4 cong2 na3 li3 kan4 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: Really? How can you tell?

cues.zh: 不管什么事你都推得一干二净
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 shen2 me5 shi4 ni3 dou1 tui1 de2 yi1 gan1 er4 jing4
cues.en: No matter what happens, you always wipe your hands clean of it.

cues.zh: 珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1
cues.en: Shanshan.

cues.zh: 你知道熊为什么冬眠那么久吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 xiong2 wei4 shen2 me5 dong1 mian2 na4 me5 jiu3 ma5
cues.en: Do you know why bears hibernate for so long?

cues.zh: 因为没有人敢吵醒他
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei2 you3 ren2 gan3 chao3 xing3 ta1
cues.en: Because no one dares to wake him up.

cues.zh: 答对了
cues.pinyin: da2 dui4 le5
cues.en: Correct!

cues.zh: 因为没有人敢叫他起床
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei2 you3 ren2 gan3 jiao4 ta1 qi3 chuang2
cues.en: Because no one dares to wake him up to get out of bed.

items.title_zh: 笑话85｜我家养的猪｜最干净的人｜偏财运｜一个人吗？｜看不到我的钱｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我老婆偏财运很强
cues.pinyin: wo3 lao3 po2 pian1 cai2 yun4 hen3 qiang2
cues.en: My wife has really strong windfall luck.

cues.zh: 她买股票股票就涨
cues.pinyin: ta1 mai3 gu3 piao4 gu3 piao4 jiu4 zhang3
cues.en: Whenever she buys stocks, the stock price goes up.

cues.zh: 买房子房价就涨
cues.pinyin: mai3 fang2 zi5 fang2 jia4 jiu4 zhang3
cues.en: When she buys a house, the house price goes up.

cues.zh: 那很好啊
cues.pinyin: na4 hen3 hao3 a5
cues.en: That's great!

cues.zh: 你为什么这么不开心
cues.pinyin: ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 bu4 kai1 xin1
cues.en: Why are you so unhappy, then?

cues.zh: 因为她刚刚买了我的保险
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 gang1 gang1 mai3 le5 wo3 de5 bao3 xian3
cues.en: Because she just bought life insurance on me.

cues.zh: 小明没事呢
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 mei2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: Is Xiaoming okay?

cues.zh: 小明没事
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 mei2 shi4
cues.en: Xiaoming is fine.

cues.zh: 小明有穿全身的护具
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 you3 chuan1 quan2 shen1 de5 hu4 ju4
cues.en: Xiaoming was wearing full-body protective gear.

cues.zh: 他开赛车
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 sai4 che1
cues.en: He drives race cars.

cues.zh: 错当然是因为他没在车上
cues.pinyin: cuo4 dang1 ran2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 mei2 zai4 che1 shang4
cues.en: Wrong — it's because he wasn't in the car.

cues.zh: 世界上有两件事很难
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 shang4 you3 liang3 jian4 shi4 hen3 nan2
cues.en: There are two things in this world that are very hard.

cues.zh: 一是把自己的思想装进别人的脑袋
cues.pinyin: yi1 shi4 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 si1 xiang3 zhuang1 jin4 bie2 ren2 de5 nao3 dai4
cues.en: One is putting your own thoughts into someone else's head.

cues.zh: 二是把别人的钱装进自己的口袋
cues.pinyin: er4 shi4 ba3 bie2 ren2 de5 qian2 zhuang1 jin4 zi4 ji3 de5 kou3 dai4
cues.en: The other is putting someone else's money into your own pocket.

cues.zh: 前者成功的叫老师
cues.pinyin: qian2 zhe3 cheng2 gong1 de5 jiao4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Whoever succeeds at the former is called a teacher.

cues.zh: 后者成功的叫老板
cues.pinyin: hou4 zhe3 cheng2 gong1 de5 jiao4 lao3 ban3
cues.en: Whoever succeeds at the latter is called a boss.

cues.zh: 两者都成功的叫老婆
cues.pinyin: liang3 zhe3 dou1 cheng2 gong1 de5 jiao4 lao3 po2
cues.en: Whoever succeeds at both is called a wife.

cues.zh: 小小我问你
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3
cues.en: Xiaoxiao, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 桌上有十根蜡烛
cues.pinyin: zhuo1 shang4 you3 shi2 gen1 la4 zhu2
cues.en: There are ten candles on the table.

cues.zh: 一阵风吹来灭掉了三根
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhen4 feng1 chui1 lai2 mie4 diao4 le5 san1 gen1
cues.en: A gust of wind blew and put out three of them.

cues.zh: 后来弟弟又来吹灭了两根
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 di4 di5 you4 lai2 chui1 mie4 le5 liang3 gen1
cues.en: Then my little brother came and blew out two more.

cues.zh: 请问桌上还有几根蜡烛
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 zhuo1 shang4 hai2 you3 ji3 gen1 la4 zhu2
cues.en: So how many candles are left on the table?

cues.zh: 还有十根是不是
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 shi2 gen1 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Still ten, right?

cues.zh: 对答对了
cues.pinyin: dui4 da2 dui4 le5
cues.en: Yes, correct!

cues.zh: 刚刚我去吃饭
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 wo3 qu4 chi1 fan4
cues.en: I just went out to eat.

cues.zh: 突然有个美女走到我旁边问我
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 ge4 mei3 nv3 zou3 dao4 wo3 pang2 bian1 wen4 wo3
cues.en: Suddenly a pretty woman walked up next to me and asked,

cues.zh: 大哥一个人吗
cues.pinyin: da4 ge1 yi2 ge4 ren2 ma5
cues.en: 'Are you here alone, handsome?'

cues.zh: 对啊我是一个人
cues.pinyin: dui4 a5 wo3 shi4 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: Yeah, I'm alone.

cues.zh: 然后他就把我旁边的椅子给拿走了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 ba3 wo3 pang2 bian1 de5 yi3 zi5 gei3 na2 zou3 le5
cues.en: Then she took the chair next to me and walked off with it.

items.title_zh: 笑话85｜我家养的猪｜最干净的人｜偏财运｜一个人吗？｜看不到我的钱｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小小我问你
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3
cues.en: Xiaoxiao, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 如果孔子还在世的时候
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 kong3 zi5 hai2 zai4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: If Confucius were still alive today,

cues.zh: 世界会变成怎么样
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: what would the world be like?

cues.zh: 世界会变怎么样
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 hui4 bian4 zen3 me5 yang4
cues.en: What would the world be like?

cues.zh: 教育会改革吗
cues.pinyin: jiao4 yu4 hui4 gai3 ge2 ma5
cues.en: Would education be reformed?

cues.zh: 可是答案一定不是这个那么简单的
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 da2 an4 yi2 ding4 bu2 shi4 zhe4 ge5 na4 me5 jian3 dan1 de5
cues.en: But the answer definitely isn't something that simple.

cues.zh: 答案是世界会多了一个人
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 shi4 jie4 hui4 duo1 le5 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: The answer is: there'd just be one more person in the world.

cues.zh: 以后只要是我朋友
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 zhi3 yao4 shi4 wo3 peng2 you3
cues.en: From now on, as long as you're my friend,

cues.zh: 谁没钱了尽管跟我说一声
cues.pinyin: shui2 mei2 qian2 le5 jin3 guan3 gen1 wo3 shuo1 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: if anyone's ever broke, just come tell me.

cues.zh: 哇你真大方耶
cues.pinyin: wa5 ni3 zhen1 da4 fang1 ye2
cues.en: Wow, you're so generous!

cues.zh: 我是说我可以跟她讲讲
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shuo1 wo3 ke3 yi3 gen1 ta1 jiang3 jiang3
cues.en: I mean I can tell them all about

cues.zh: 我没钱的日子是怎么度过的
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 qian2 de5 ri4 zi5 shi4 zen3 me5 du4 guo4 de5
cues.en: how I get through my days without money.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有一个小朋友给我发来私信说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a young viewer sent me a private message saying

cues.zh: 他在网上贷了几千块钱买了一
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wang3 shang4 dai4 le5 ji3 qian1 kuai4 qian2 mai3 le5 yi1
cues.en: that he borrowed a few thousand yuan online to buy a

cues.zh: 个高端的手机
cues.pinyin: ge4 gao1 duan1 de5 shou3 ji1
cues.en: high-end phone.

cues.zh: 然后利滚利变成几万块钱了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 li4 gun3 li4 bian4 cheng2 ji3 wan4 kuai4 qian2 le5
cues.en: Then with compounding interest it grew to tens of thousands of yuan.

cues.zh: 他也还不起也不敢跟家里说
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 hai2 bu4 qi3 ye3 bu4 gan3 gen1 jia1 li3 shuo1
cues.en: He couldn't repay it and didn't dare tell his family.

cues.zh: 他说自己当初真不知道为什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 dang1 chu1 zhen1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: He said he himself didn't know why

cues.zh: 会买这个东西
cues.pinyin: hui4 mai3 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: he bought that thing in the first place.

cues.zh: 其实很多穷人都对奢侈品有一种偏爱
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 hen3 duo1 qiong2 ren2 dou1 dui4 she1 chi3 pin3 you3 yi1 zhong3 pian1 ai4
cues.en: Actually, many poor people have a special fondness for luxury goods.

cues.zh: 比如说攒很多的钱买一个 L V 的包
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zan3 hen3 duo1 de5 qian2 mai3 yi2 ge4 L V de5 bao1
cues.en: For example, saving up a lot of money to buy an LV bag,

cues.zh: 买一件貂皮大衣或者办一次豪
cues.pinyin: mai3 yi1 jian4 diao1 pi2 da4 yi1 huo4 zhe3 ban4 yi1 ci4 hao2
cues.en: buying a mink fur coat, or holding a lavish

cues.zh: 华的婚礼等等
cues.pinyin: hua2 de5 hun1 li3 deng3 deng3
cues.en: wedding, and so on.

cues.zh: 为什么穷人会对奢侈品情有独钟呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 qiong2 ren2 hui4 dui4 she1 chi3 pin3 qing2 you3 du2 zhong1 ne5
cues.en: Why do poor people have such a strong attachment to luxury goods?

cues.zh: 前一段时间诺贝尔经济学奖颁发给了
cues.pinyin: qian2 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1 nuo4 bei4 er3 jing1 ji4 xue2 jiang3 ban1 fa1 gei3 le5
cues.en: A while back the Nobel Prize in Economics was awarded to

cues.zh: 麻省理工学院的巴纳吉和迪弗洛夫妇
cues.pinyin: ma2 sheng3 li3 gong1 xue2 yuan4 de5 ba1 na4 ji2 he2 di2 fu2 luo4 fu1 fu4
cues.en: MIT's Banerjee and Duflo, a married couple,

cues.zh: 以及哈佛大学的克里默
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 ha1 fu2 da4 xue2 de5 ke4 li3 mo4
cues.en: as well as Harvard's Kremer,

cues.zh: 以表彰他们在对抗贫困方面所做出的研究
cues.pinyin: yi3 biao3 zhang1 ta1 men5 zai4 dui4 kang4 pin2 kun4 fang1 mian4 suo3 zuo4 chu1 de5 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: in recognition of their research on fighting poverty.

cues.zh: 那么我今天想给大家介绍一下他
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 jin1 tian1 xiang3 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 ta1
cues.en: So today I want to introduce

cues.zh: 们的研究成果
cues.pinyin: men5 de5 yan2 jiu1 cheng2 guo3
cues.en: their research findings to everyone.

cues.zh: 看一看通过他们的研究成果
cues.pinyin: kan4 yi1 kan4 tong1 guo4 ta1 men5 de5 yan2 jiu1 cheng2 guo3
cues.en: Let's take a look at their research findings

cues.zh: 我们是不是可以对贫穷有更深刻的认识
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shi4 bu2 shi4 ke3 yi3 dui4 pin2 qiong2 you3 geng1 shen1 ke4 de5 ren4 shi2
cues.en: and see if we can gain a deeper understanding of poverty.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来讲一讲
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3
cues.en: First, let's talk about

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 针对贫穷有一个争论
cues.pinyin: zhen1 dui4 pin2 qiong2 you3 yi2 ge4 zheng1 lun4
cues.en: a debate concerning poverty.

cues.zh: 这个争论就是我们针对于穷人的援助
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zheng1 lun4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 zhen1 dui4 yu2 qiong2 ren2 de5 yuan2 zhu4
cues.en: This debate is about whether aid to the poor

cues.zh: 到底是有没有用的
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 you3 mei2 you3 yong4 de5
cues.en: actually works or not.

cues.zh: 援助有用吗
cues.pinyin: yuan2 zhu4 you3 yong4 ma5
cues.en: Does aid work?

cues.zh: 有人可能会说这不是废话吗
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 ke3 neng2 hui4 shuo1 zhe4 bu2 shi4 fei4 hua4 ma5
cues.en: Some people might say, isn't that an obvious question?

cues.zh: 援助当然有用了
cues.pinyin: yuan2 zhu4 dang1 ran2 you3 yong4 le5
cues.en: Of course aid works.

cues.zh: 你不援助难道看着穷人饿死吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 yuan2 zhu4 nan2 dao4 kan4 zhe5 qiong2 ren2 e4 si3 ma5
cues.en: If you don't give aid, would you just watch the poor starve to death?

cues.zh: 但是从数据上看好像并不支持这个结论
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 cong2 shu4 ju4 shang4 kan4 hao3 xiang4 bing4 bu4 zhi1 chi2 zhe4 ge5 jie2 lun4
cues.en: But the data doesn't seem to support that conclusion.

cues.zh: 那么在最近几十年
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 zui4 jin4 ji3 shi2 nian2
cues.en: Over the past few decades,

cues.zh: 世界对于非洲的援助是很多的
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 dui4 yu2 fei1 zhou1 de5 yuan2 zhu4 shi4 hen3 duo1 de5
cues.en: the world has given a lot of aid to Africa.

cues.zh: 因为撒哈拉以南的非洲是非常贫穷的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 sa1 ha1 la1 yi3 nan2 de5 fei1 zhou1 shi4 fei1 chang2 pin2 qiong2 de5
cues.en: Because sub-Saharan Africa is extremely poor.

cues.zh: 所以我们可以画一个图
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 hua4 yi2 ge4 tu2
cues.en: So we can draw a graph.

cues.zh: 随着时间的推移
cues.pinyin: sui2 zhe5 shi2 jian1 de5 tui1 yi2
cues.en: As time goes on,

cues.zh: 整个对撒哈拉以南的非洲的援助总金额
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 dui4 sa1 ha1 la1 yi3 nan2 de5 fei1 zhou1 de5 yuan2 zhu4 zong3 jin1 e2
cues.en: the total amount of aid to sub-Saharan Africa

cues.zh: 它是越来越多的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1 de5
cues.en: has kept increasing.

cues.zh: 非常非常多越来越多
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 duo1 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: A lot, a lot, more and more.

cues.zh: 那么在这段时间里面
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 zhe4 duan4 shi2 jian1 li3 mian4
cues.en: So during this period,

cues.zh: 非洲的 G DP 到底有什么变化呢
cues.pinyin: fei1 zhou1 de5 G DP dao4 di3 you3 shen2 me5 bian4 hua4 ne5
cues.en: what happened to Africa's GDP?

cues.zh: 我们如果把非洲的 G DP 画出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 ba3 fei1 zhou1 de5 G DP hua4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: If we plot Africa's GDP,

cues.zh: 什么样子
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: what does it look like?

cues.zh: 大概是这样的
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: It's roughly like this.

cues.zh: 大概是这样的
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: It's roughly like this.

cues.zh: 这个就是 G DP
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 G DP
cues.en: This is the GDP.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 非洲人民自力更生越来越厉害了对不对
cues.pinyin: fei1 zhou1 ren2 min2 zi4 li4 geng1 sheng1 yue4 lai2 yue4 li4 hai4 le5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Did African people become more and more self-reliant? Right?

cues.zh: 这是一种可能
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: That's one possibility.

cues.zh: 但是还有一种可能
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 you3 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: But there's another possibility too.

cues.zh: 那就是如果你停止援助的话
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 ni3 ting2 zhi3 yuan2 zhu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Which is that if you stop giving aid,

cues.zh: 非洲就会遍地都是饥荒失衡遍野
cues.pinyin: fei1 zhou1 jiu4 hui4 bian4 di4 dou1 shi4 ji1 huang1 shi1 heng2 bian4 ye3
cues.en: Africa would be covered in famine, with corpses everywhere.

cues.zh: 这也是一种可能
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2
cues.en: That's also a possibility.

cues.zh: 那么如果我们真的停止对非洲的援助
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 zhen1 de5 ting2 zhi3 dui4 fei1 zhou1 de5 yuan2 zhu4
cues.en: So if we really stopped aiding Africa,

cues.zh: 究竟会发生哪一种可能呢
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jing4 hui4 fa1 sheng1 na3 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2 ne5
cues.en: which of these would actually happen?

cues.zh: 就好像在中世纪的时候有人生病了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hao3 xiang4 zai4 zhong1 shi4 ji4 de5 shi2 hou4 you3 ren2 sheng1 bing4 le5
cues.en: It's like in the Middle Ages, when someone got sick,

cues.zh: 生病了他就去拜神求佛对吧
cues.pinyin: sheng1 bing4 le5 ta1 jiu4 qu4 bai4 shen2 qiu2 fu2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: once sick, they'd go pray to gods and worship Buddha, right?

cues.zh: 还有一些人生病了之后他去寻医问药
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 ren2 sheng1 bing4 le5 zhi1 hou4 ta1 qu4 xun2 yi1 wen4 yao4
cues.en: And some other sick people would go see doctors and take medicine.

cues.zh: 那么到底是寻医问药有用
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dao4 di3 shi4 xun2 yi1 wen4 yao4 you3 yong4
cues.en: So was it seeing doctors and taking medicine that worked,

cues.zh: 还是拜神求佛有用人们不知道
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 bai4 shen2 qiu2 fu2 you3 yong4 ren2 men5 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: or was it praying to gods that worked? People didn't know.

cues.zh: 这个时候该怎么办
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 gai1 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: What should be done in this situation?

cues.zh: 现代医学已经告诉我了
cues.pinyin: xian4 dai4 yi1 xue2 yi3 jing1 gao4 su4 wo3 le5
cues.en: Modern medicine has already told us.

cues.zh: 我们可以做实验做什么实验
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zuo4 shi2 yan4 zuo4 shen2 me5 shi2 yan4
cues.en: We can run an experiment. What kind of experiment?

cues.zh: 做随机对比实验
cues.pinyin: zuo4 sui2 ji1 dui4 bi3 shi2 yan4
cues.en: Run a randomized controlled experiment.

cues.zh: 就是把人生病都差不多的分成三组
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ba3 ren2 sheng1 bing4 dou1 cha4 bu5 duo1 de5 fen1 cheng2 san1 zu3
cues.en: That is, divide people with similar illnesses into three groups.

cues.zh: 第一组人去求医问药
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 zu3 ren2 qu4 qiu2 yi1 wen4 yao4
cues.en: The first group goes to see doctors and take medicine.

cues.zh: 第二组人求神拜佛
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 zu3 ren2 qiu2 shen2 bai4 fo2
cues.en: The second group prays to gods and worships Buddha.

cues.zh: 第三组人作为对照组什么都不干
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 zu3 ren2 zuo4 wei2 dui4 zhao4 zu3 shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 gan4
cues.en: The third group, as the control group, does nothing.

cues.zh: 然后来比较他们三个人的病好了没有对吧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 lai2 bi3 jiao4 ta1 men5 san1 ge4 ren2 de5 bing4 hao3 le5 mei2 you3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then compare whether the illness in these three groups got better, right?

cues.zh: 通过这种方式我们就知道了
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 wo3 men5 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: Through this method, we would find out.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 所以他们的医疗状况是非常差的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 de5 yi1 liao2 zhuang4 kuang4 shi4 fei1 chang2 cha4 de5
cues.en: So their medical conditions are very poor.

cues.zh: 每年有 900 万人
cues.pinyin: mei3 nian2 you3 900 wan4 ren2
cues.en: Every year, nine million people,

cues.zh: 900 万人会在 5 岁之前夭折
cues.pinyin: 900 wan4 ren2 hui4 zai4 5 sui4 zhi1 qian2 yao1 zhe2
cues.en: nine million people die before the age of five.

cues.zh: 5 岁之前就夭折了
cues.pinyin: 5 sui4 zhi1 qian2 jiu4 yao1 zhe2 le5
cues.en: They die before reaching five years old.

cues.zh: 而且这些人绝大多数都是在撒哈
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 xie1 ren2 jue2 da4 duo1 shu4 dou1 shi4 zai4 sa1 ha1
cues.en: And the vast majority of these people are in sub-

cues.zh: 拉以南的非洲
cues.pinyin: la1 yi3 nan2 de5 fei1 zhou1
cues.en: Saharan Africa.

cues.zh: 那么如果一个人健康状况不好
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 yi2 ge4 ren2 jian4 kang1 zhuang4 kuang4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: So if a person's health is poor,

cues.zh: 他就没有办法干活
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 gan4 huo2
cues.en: they can't work.

cues.zh: 干不了活自然挣不了钱
cues.pinyin: gan4 bu4 liao3 huo2 zi4 ran2 zheng1 bu4 liao3 qian2
cues.en: If they can't work, naturally they can't earn money.

cues.zh: 他就没有办法摆脱贫困
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 bai3 tuo1 pin2 kun4
cues.en: They have no way to escape poverty.

cues.zh: 所以要摆脱贫困
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 bai3 tuo1 pin2 kun4
cues.en: So to escape poverty,

cues.zh: 首先要解决穷人的健康问题
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 yao4 jie3 jue2 qiong2 ren2 de5 jian4 kang1 wen4 ti2
cues.en: first you must solve the poor's health problems.

cues.zh: 于是他就提到两件事
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 ti2 dao4 liang3 jian4 shi4
cues.en: So he brought up two things.

cues.zh: 第一件事就是疫苗
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 yi4 miao2
cues.en: The first thing is vaccines.

cues.zh: 很多疾病其实是可以通过疫苗控制的
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ji2 bing4 qi2 shi2 shi4 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 yi4 miao2 kong4 zhi4 de5
cues.en: Many diseases can actually be controlled through vaccines.

cues.zh: 我们现在有非常成熟的技术对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 you3 fei1 chang2 cheng2 shu2 de5 ji4 shu4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: We now have very mature technology, right?

cues.zh: 所以我们可以对这些穷人免费发放疫苗
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 dui4 zhe4 xie1 qiong2 ren2 mian3 fei4 fa1 fang4 yi4 miao2
cues.en: So we can distribute free vaccines to these poor people.

cues.zh: 但是实际上全球每年有 25 00 万的儿童
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 quan2 qiu2 mei3 nian2 you3 25 00 wan4 de5 er2 tong2
cues.en: But in reality, every year 25 million children worldwide

cues.zh: 这 25 00 万的儿童没有接受疫苗的注射
cues.pinyin: zhe4 25 00 wan4 de5 er2 tong2 mei2 you3 jie1 shou4 yi4 miao2 de5 zhu4 she4
cues.en: these 25 million children don't receive vaccine shots.

cues.zh: 也就是说他们的疫苗缺失了
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ta1 men5 de5 yi4 miao2 que1 shi1 le5
cues.en: That is to say, they're missing their vaccinations.

cues.zh: 他们没有抵御能力
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 mei2 you3 di3 yu4 neng2 li4
cues.en: They have no immune defense.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 所以遇到一点什么传染病他们就死了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yu4 dao4 yi4 dian3 shen2 me5 chuan2 ran3 bing4 ta1 men5 jiu4 si3 le5
cues.en: So when they encounter any infectious disease, they die.

cues.zh: 那我们为什么有了技术却没有
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 you3 le5 ji4 shu4 que4 mei2 you3
cues.en: So why is it that despite having the technology, there's still no

cues.zh: 办法打疫苗呢
cues.pinyin: ban4 fa3 da3 yi4 miao2 ne5
cues.en: way to get vaccines administered?

cues.zh: 到底是因为资金不够
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 yin1 wei4 zi1 jin1 bu4 gou4
cues.en: Is it because of insufficient funding,

cues.zh: 还是因为意识问题认为打疫苗是不好的呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 yin1 wei4 yi4 shi2 wen4 ti2 ren4 wei2 da3 yi4 miao2 shi4 bu4 hao3 de5 ne5
cues.en: or is it an awareness issue, thinking vaccination is bad?

cues.zh: 他们决定去调查
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jue2 ding4 qu4 diao4 cha2
cues.en: They decided to investigate.

cues.zh: 于是他们就来到了印度
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 jiu4 lai2 dao4 le5 yin4 du4
cues.en: So they went to India.

cues.zh: 这个巴纳吉的老家就是印度
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ba1 na4 ji2 de5 lao3 jia1 jiu4 shi4 yin4 du4
cues.en: This Banerjee's hometown is India.

cues.zh: 在印度有一个地方叫乌代布尔地区
cues.pinyin: zai4 yin4 du4 you3 yi2 ge4 di4 fang1 jiao4 wu1 dai4 bu4 er3 di4 qu1
cues.en: In India there's a place called the Udaipur region.

cues.zh: 他们在这个乌代布尔地区做了很多的调查
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 wu1 dai4 bu4 er3 di4 qu1 zuo4 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 diao4 cha2
cues.en: They did a lot of investigation in this Udaipur region.

cues.zh: 他们发现乌代布尔地区又分布
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 fa1 xian4 wu1 dai4 bu4 er3 di4 qu1 you4 fen1 bu4
cues.en: They found that the Udaipur region has

cues.zh: 着很多的村子
cues.pinyin: zhe5 hen3 duo1 de5 cun1 zi5
cues.en: many villages scattered throughout it.

cues.zh: 这里有很多的村子分布的大山里边
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 cun1 zi5 fen1 bu4 de5 da4 shan1 li3 bian1
cues.en: There are many villages scattered in the mountains here.

cues.zh: 而这个地区他们的疫苗免疫率
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 di4 qu1 ta1 men5 de5 yi4 miao2 mian3 yi4 lv4
cues.en: And in this region, their vaccine immunization rate

cues.zh: 大概只有多少
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhi3 you3 duo1 shao3
cues.en: was only about how much?

cues.zh: 大概只有 1
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhi3 you3 1
cues.en: Only about 1.

cues.zh: 只有 1 完成了所有的疫苗
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 1 wan2 cheng2 le5 suo3 you3 de5 yi4 miao2
cues.en: Only 1 percent completed all the vaccinations.

cues.zh: 剩下那些人都没有完成
cues.pinyin: sheng4 xia4 na4 xie1 ren2 dou1 mei2 you3 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: The rest of the people didn't complete them.

cues.zh: 说他为什么不完成呢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 wan2 cheng2 ne5
cues.en: Why didn't they complete it, you ask?

cues.zh: 第一个是不是技术不够
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 shi4 bu2 shi4 ji4 shu4 bu4 gou4
cues.en: First, was it because the technology wasn't sufficient?

cues.zh: 但是他们发现技术是 OK 的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 men5 fa1 xian4 ji4 shu4 shi4 OK de5
cues.en: But they found the technology was fine.

cues.zh: 印度政府为他们提供了这个疫苗注射点
cues.pinyin: yin4 du4 zheng4 fu3 wei4 ta1 men5 ti2 gong1 le5 zhe4 ge5 yi4 miao2 zhu4 she4 dian3
cues.en: The Indian government provided vaccination stations for them.

cues.zh: 只要他们到疫苗注射点
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ta1 men5 dao4 yi4 miao2 zhu4 she4 dian3
cues.en: As long as they got to the vaccination station—

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何才能摆脱贫穷？穷人和富人有什么差别？

cues.zh: 那你可能翻山越岭要花一天的时间
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 ke3 neng2 fan1 shan1 yue4 ling3 yao4 hua1 yi1 tian1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: well, you might have to trek over mountains for a whole day,

cues.zh: 结果到了之后发现这个护士非常不负责
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 dao4 le5 zhi1 hou4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 hu4 shi4 fei1 chang2 bu4 fu4 ze2
cues.en: and when you finally arrive, you find the nurse is very irresponsible.

cues.zh: 今天他歇班了他没来
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ta1 xie1 ban1 le5 ta1 mei2 lai2
cues.en: Today she's off work, she didn't come.

cues.zh: 那你还得翻山越岭回去
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 hai2 de2 fan1 shan1 yue4 ling3 hui2 qu4
cues.en: So you have to trek back over the mountains again.

cues.zh: 结果你这一天的工作是不是就损失了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ni3 zhe4 yi1 tian1 de5 gong1 zuo4 shi4 bu2 shi4 jiu4 sun3 shi1 le5
cues.en: As a result, you've lost a whole day's work, haven't you?

cues.zh: 损失一天工作对于一个富人来讲没有
cues.pinyin: sun3 shi1 yi1 tian1 gong1 zuo4 dui4 yu2 yi2 ge4 fu4 ren2 lai2 jiang3 mei2 you3
cues.en: Losing a day of work for a rich person isn't

cues.zh: 什么大不了的
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 da4 bu4 liao3 de5
cues.en: that big a deal.

cues.zh: 但是对于一个穷人来讲
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 yu2 yi2 ge4 qiong2 ren2 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: But for a poor person,

cues.zh: 损失一天的工作可能第二天就没有饭吃了
cues.pinyin: sun3 shi1 yi1 tian1 de5 gong1 zuo4 ke3 neng2 di4 er4 tian1 jiu4 mei2 you3 fan4 chi1 le5
cues.en: losing a day of work might mean no food the next day.

cues.zh: 所以他们为了避免这种情况出现
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 wei4 le5 bi4 mian3 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 chu1 xian4
cues.en: So in order to avoid this situation,

cues.zh: 最后他们就不打疫苗了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 men5 jiu4 bu4 da3 yi4 miao2 le5
cues.en: in the end they just stopped getting vaccinated.

cues.zh: 那这个猜想到底对还是不对
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 cai1 xiang3 dao4 di3 dui4 hai2 shi4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: So was this guess right or wrong?

cues.zh: 他们就要去做实验
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiu4 yao4 qu4 zuo4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: They had to go run an experiment.

cues.zh: 怎么去做实验呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 qu4 zuo4 shi2 yan4 ne5
cues.en: How would they run the experiment?

cues.zh: 首先他们先在这些村子里面随机
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 ta1 men5 xian1 zai4 zhe4 xie1 cun1 zi5 li3 mian4 sui2 ji1
cues.en: First, they randomly selected

cues.zh: 选了一些村子
cues.pinyin: xuan3 le5 yi1 xie1 cun1 zi5
cues.en: some of these villages.

cues.zh: 随机选的
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji1 xuan3 de5
cues.en: Randomly selected.

cues.zh: 随机选了一些村子
cues.pinyin: sui2 ji1 xuan3 le5 yi1 xie1 cun1 zi5
cues.en: Randomly selected some villages.

cues.zh: 那么这些村子它作为对照组
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 xie1 cun1 zi5 ta1 zuo4 wei2 dui4 zhao4 zu3
cues.en: So these villages served as the control group.

cues.zh: 它什么都不做
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 zuo4
cues.en: They did nothing at all.

cues.zh: 什么都不做
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 dou1 bu4 zuo4
cues.en: Nothing at all.

cues.zh: 只是进去调查一下
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 jin4 qu4 diao4 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Just went in to do a survey,

cues.zh: 到底你有没有打疫苗
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 ni3 you3 mei2 you3 da3 yi4 miao2
cues.en: asking whether you'd gotten vaccinated or not.

cues.zh: 就是这么一些村子
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 me5 yi1 xie1 cun1 zi5
cues.en: That's one set of villages.

cues.zh: 那么第二他选了一些村子
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 di4 er4 ta1 xuan3 le5 yi1 xie1 cun1 zi5
cues.en: Then second, they selected some other villages.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 90后妈妈在外买25㎡公寓独居：每周逃离家庭一天Post-90s Mom Buys 25㎡ Apartment Living Alone: Escaping F

cues.zh: 这个房子的面积是 25 平米
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 de5 mian4 ji1 shi4 25 ping2 mi3
cues.en: This apartment is 25 square meters.

cues.zh: 要是只有我一个人有
cues.pinyin: yao4 shi4 zhi3 you3 wo3 yi2 ge4 ren2 you3
cues.en: If it's just me living here,

cues.zh: 老公和孩子的话
cues.pinyin: lao3 gong1 he2 hai2 zi5 de5 hua4
cues.en: even with a husband and kids,

cues.zh: 也是被邀请才能到这边来的
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 bei4 yao1 qing3 cai2 neng2 dao4 zhe4 bian1 lai2 de5
cues.en: they'd still need an invitation to come over.

cues.zh: 无拘无束的一个人的独居生活
cues.pinyin: wu2 ju1 wu2 shu4 de5 yi2 ge4 ren2 de5 du2 ju1 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: A free and unrestrained life living alone.

cues.zh: 这套公寓买下来大概在 50 万左右
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tao4 gong1 yu4 mai3 xia4 lai2 da4 gai4 zai4 50 wan4 zuo3 you4
cues.en: This apartment cost around 500,000 yuan.

cues.zh: 硬装 20 万左右
cues.pinyin: ying4 zhuang1 20 wan4 zuo3 you4
cues.en: The basic renovation cost about 200,000 yuan.

cues.zh: 是我自己一个人出资买的
cues.pinyin: shi4 wo3 zi4 ji3 yi2 ge4 ren2 chu1 zi1 mai3 de5
cues.en: I paid for it myself, on my own.

cues.zh: 我们之前一家五口人
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 yi1 jia1 wu3 kou3 ren2
cues.en: Before, there were five of us in my family.

cues.zh: 是住在 130 几平的房子里面
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhu4 zai4 130 ji3 ping2 de5 fang2 zi5 li3 mian4
cues.en: We lived in a place of over 130 square meters.

cues.zh: 跟他们在一起的话我是妻子儿媳妇
cues.pinyin: gen1 ta1 men5 zai4 yi4 qi3 de5 hua4 wo3 shi4 qi1 zi3 er2 xi2 fu4
cues.en: Being with them, I'm a wife and daughter-in-law,

cues.zh: 还有就是妈妈的身份
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 ma1 ma1 de5 shen1 fen4
cues.en: and also a mother.

cues.zh: 但是在这边的话我就只想做我自己
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 zhe4 bian1 de5 hua4 wo3 jiu4 zhi3 xiang3 zuo4 wo3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: But here, I just want to be myself.

cues.zh: 从日常的生活中抽离出来
cues.pinyin: cong2 ri4 chang2 de5 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 chou1 li2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Stepping away from everyday life.

cues.zh: 到这边的话可以单独待这么一两天
cues.pinyin: dao4 zhe4 bian1 de5 hua4 ke3 yi3 dan1 du2 dai4 zhe4 me5 yi1 liang3 tian1
cues.en: Here I can stay alone for a day or two.

cues.zh: 偶尔的话会邀约朋友过来喝喝茶
cues.pinyin: ou3 er3 de5 hua4 hui4 yao1 yue1 peng2 you3 guo4 lai2 he1 he1 cha2
cues.en: Sometimes I'll invite friends over for tea.

cues.zh: 所以家里人还是蛮支持的

cues.zh: 现在女性想要从第一居所的社会身份
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 nv3 xing4 xiang3 yao4 cong2 di4 yi1 ju1 suo3 de5 she4 hui4 shen1 fen4

cues.zh: 安全感非常重要

cues.zh: 从地板到天花全部都是由一个木桶包裹

cues.zh: 从暗的到亮的过渡

cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 wo3 jiu4 bu4 guo4 duo1 di4 jie4 shao4 le5

cues.zh: 不管在生活还是工作中都是完全独立的
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 zai4 sheng1 huo2 hai2 shi4 gong1 zuo4 zhong1 du1 shi4 wan2 quan2 du2 li4 de5
cues.en: I'm completely independent, both in life and at work.

cues.zh: 毕业我就自己开了母婴店
cues.pinyin: bi4 ye4 wo3 jiu4 zi4 ji3 kai1 le5 mu3 ying1 dian4
cues.en: After graduating, I opened my own baby products store.

cues.zh: 后来我就改行了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 jiu4 gai3 hang2 le5
cues.en: Later I switched careers.

cues.zh: 开了一家财务公司
cues.pinyin: kai1 le5 yi1 jia1 cai2 wu4 gong1 si1
cues.en: I started a finance company.

cues.zh: 为什么我买这套房子不用去遵循
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 mai3 zhe4 tao4 fang2 zi5 bu4 yong4 qu4 zun1 xun2
cues.en: Why do I not need to follow

cues.zh: 任何人的意见
cues.pinyin: ren4 he2 ren2 de5 yi4 jian4
cues.en: anyone else's opinion when buying this apartment?

cues.zh: 因为只有独立了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhi3 you3 du2 li4 le5
cues.en: Because only once you're independent

cues.zh: 你有这个能力去拿到自己想要的东西
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 zhe4 ge5 neng2 li4 qu4 na2 dao4 zi4 ji3 xiang3 yao4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: do you have the ability to get what you want.

cues.zh: 生完宝宝之后
cues.pinyin: sheng1 wan2 bao3 bao3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After I had my baby,

cues.zh: 就出去游了有两三个月租了一辆车
cues.pinyin: jiu4 chu1 qu4 you2 le5 you3 liang3 san1 ge4 yue4 zu1 le5 yi1 liang4 che1
cues.en: I went out traveling for two or three months, renting a car.

cues.zh: 女人一定要自己手扶方向盘
cues.pinyin: nv3 ren2 yi2 ding4 yao4 zi4 ji3 shou3 fu2 fang1 xiang4 pan2
cues.en: A woman must hold the steering wheel herself.

cues.zh: 这样我想去拿就去拿
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 wo3 xiang3 qu4 na2 jiu4 qu4 na2
cues.en: That way, I can take whatever I want, whenever I want.

cues.zh: 如果咱们有能力必须要买
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zan2 men5 you3 neng2 li4 bi4 xu1 yao4 mai3
cues.en: If we have the means, we must buy.

cues.zh: 那完全根据我自己真实的想法的房子
cues.pinyin: na4 wan2 quan2 gen1 ju4 wo3 zi4 ji3 zhen1 shi2 de5 xiang3 fa3 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: A house that's based entirely on what I truly want.

cues.zh: 如果咱们还是还没有能力买房
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zan2 men5 hai2 shi4 hai2 mei2 you3 neng2 li4 mai3 fang2
cues.en: If we don't yet have the means to buy a house,

cues.zh: 那咱们就先把车给买了
cues.pinyin: na4 zan2 men5 jiu4 xian1 ba3 che1 gei3 mai3 le5
cues.en: then let's buy a car first.

cues.zh: 不管是豪车还是普通的车
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 shi4 hao2 che1 hai2 shi4 pu3 tong1 de5 che1
cues.en: Whether it's a luxury car or an ordinary one,

cues.zh: 它只要是四个轮的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yao4 shi4 si4 ge4 lun2 de5
cues.en: as long as it has four wheels

cues.zh: 咱能把小孩和行李拖走的
cues.pinyin: zan2 neng2 ba3 xiao3 hai2 he2 xing2 li3 tuo1 zou3 de5
cues.en: and can carry the kids and the luggage,

cues.zh: 咱就买
cues.pinyin: zan2 jiu4 mai3
cues.en: we'll buy it.

cues.zh: 我比较尊重的小朋友跟朋友一样的
cues.pinyin: wo3 bi3 jiao4 zun1 zhong4 de5 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 peng2 you3 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: I respect my child and treat them like a friend.

cues.zh: 顾不了家庭

cues.zh: 谁也看不到我

cues.zh: 律师的狗没绑好跑到肉店偷了一块肉
cues.pinyin: lv4 shi1 de5 gou3 mei2 bang3 hao3 pao3 dao4 rou4 dian4 tou1 le5 yi1 kuai4 rou4
cues.en: The lawyer's dog got loose and ran to the butcher shop, where it stole a piece of meat.

cues.zh: 肉店主人走进律师办公室问
cues.pinyin: rou4 dian4 zhu3 ren2 zou3 jin4 lv4 shi1 ban4 gong1 shi4 wen4
cues.en: The butcher shop owner walked into the lawyer's office and asked,

cues.zh: 如果一条没绑好的狗从我店里偷走一块肉
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi1 tiao2 mei2 bang3 hao3 de5 gou3 cong2 wo3 dian4 li3 tou1 zou3 yi1 kuai4 rou4
cues.en: "If a dog that wasn't tied up steals a piece of meat from my shop,

cues.zh: 我是否有权要求狗主人赔偿啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 fou3 you3 quan2 yao1 qiu2 gou3 zhu3 ren2 pei2 chang2 a5
cues.en: do I have the right to ask the dog's owner for compensation?"

cues.zh: 律师回答当然有啊
cues.pinyin: lv4 shi1 hui2 da2 dang1 ran2 you3 a5
cues.en: The lawyer replied, "Of course you do.

cues.zh: 那你欠我一百元
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 qian4 wo3 yi4 bai3 yuan2
cues.en: So you owe me 100 dollars.

cues.zh: 今天你的狗没绑好偷走了我店里的肉
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ni3 de5 gou3 mei2 bang3 hao3 tou1 zou3 le5 wo3 dian4 li3 de5 rou4
cues.en: Today your dog got loose and stole meat from my shop."

cues.zh: 律师不发一言给了他一百元
cues.pinyin: lv4 shi1 bu4 fa1 yi1 yan2 gei3 le5 ta1 yi4 bai3 yuan2
cues.en: The lawyer said nothing and handed him 100 dollars.

cues.zh: 几天后肉店收到一封律师信上面写着
cues.pinyin: ji3 tian1 hou4 rou4 dian4 shou1 dao4 yi1 feng1 lv4 shi1 xin4 shang4 mian4 xie3 zhe5
cues.en: A few days later, the butcher shop received a lawyer's letter that read:

cues.zh: 律师咨询费一千元
cues.pinyin: lv4 shi1 zi1 xun2 fei4 yi1 qian1 yuan2
cues.en: "Legal consultation fee: 1,000 dollars."

cues.zh: 大大我问你喔
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Dada, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 什么东西啊看不到
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 dong1 xi1 a5 kan4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: What's something you can't see,

cues.zh: 但是摸得到喔
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mo1 de2 dao4 o1
cues.en: but you can touch it?

cues.zh: 那一旦摸不到了之后
cues.pinyin: na4 yi2 dan4 mo1 bu2 dao4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: And once you can't touch it anymore,

cues.zh: 就会很害怕
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 hen3 hai4 pa4
cues.en: you get really scared.

cues.zh: 哪有这个东西啊
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 a5
cues.en: Is there even such a thing?

cues.zh: 鬼鬼鬼看不到摸得到
cues.pinyin: gui3 gui3 gui3 kan4 bu2 dao4 mo1 de2 dao4
cues.en: A ghost! A ghost — you can't see it but you can touch it?

cues.zh: 鬼哪摸得到啊
cues.pinyin: gui3 na3 mo1 de2 dao4 a5
cues.en: How can you touch a ghost?

cues.zh: 要不然是什么
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu4 ran2 shi4 shen2 me5

cues.zh: 圣诞节马上就要到了

cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 dai4 gei3 ni3 de5 shi4 kao3 quan2 ji1

cues.zh: 然后可以稍微的放一点小苏打粉给它
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ke3 yi3 shao1 wei1 de5 fang4 yi4 dian3 xiao3 su1 da2 fen3 gei3 ta1
cues.en: then we can add a little baking soda to it

cues.zh: 这样子搓一下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 cuo1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and rub it like this

cues.zh: 然后给它洗干净
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 xi3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: and then wash it clean

cues.zh: 这样子的做法呢可以去除鸡皮表
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 zuo4 fa3 ne5 ke3 yi3 qu4 chu2 ji1 pi2 biao3
cues.en: this method can remove the surface of the chicken skin's

cues.zh: 层的一层脂肪
cues.pinyin: ceng2 de5 yi1 ceng2 zhi1 fang2
cues.en: layer of fat

cues.zh: 接下来呢我们可以用一张纸巾把
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ne5 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 jin1 ba3
cues.en: Next we can use a paper towel to

cues.zh: 这个鸡皮擦干
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ji1 pi2 ca1 gan4
cues.en: dry this chicken skin

cues.zh: 这样子做的好处呢还可以去除鸡毛
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 de5 hao3 chu4 ne5 hai2 ke3 yi3 qu4 chu2 ji1 mao2
cues.en: the benefit of doing this is it can also remove chicken feathers

cues.zh: 还有鸡皮上表层的一层脂肪
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ji1 pi2 shang4 biao3 ceng2 de5 yi1 ceng2 zhi1 fang2
cues.en: and the layer of fat on the surface of the chicken skin

cues.zh: 接下来我们把这个一整只鸡呢
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yi1 zheng3 zhi3 ji1 ne5
cues.en: Next we take this whole chicken

cues.zh: 放到一个大的 zip lock 袋子里面
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 yi2 ge4 da4 de5 zip lock dai4 zi5 li3 mian4
cues.en: and put it into a large ziplock bag

cues.zh: 我们现在呢来做这个腌料
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian4 zai4 ne5 lai2 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 yan1 liao4
cues.en: Now let's make the marinade

cues.zh: 这里有半杯酱油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 ban4 bei1 jiang4 you2
cues.en: here's half a cup of soy sauce

cues.zh: 三汤匙蚝油

cues.en: During this time

cues.en: After we take the chicken out

cues.zh: 然后要给它晾干大概 4 个小时在室温下
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yao4 gei3 ta1 liang4 gan1 da4 gai4 4 ge4 xiao3 shi2 zai4 shi4 wen1 xia4
cues.en: let it air dry for about 4 hours at room temperature

cues.zh: 那或者有另外一个办法就是拿
cues.pinyin: na4 huo4 zhe3 you3 ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 ban4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 na2
cues.en: Or another method is to take

cues.zh: 一个吹风机呢

cues.zh: 可以这样子给它吹

cues.zh: 那记得要使用这个凉风
cues.pinyin: na4 ji4 de5 yao4 shi3 yong4 zhe4 ge5 liang2 feng1
cues.en: remember to use the cool setting

cues.zh: 对然后就这样子吹

cues.en: or 204°C

cues.zh: 那现在我们用一条线
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 yong4 yi1 tiao2 xian4
cues.en: Now we take a piece of string

cues.zh: 把这个鸡腿下面的底部呢
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 tui3 xia4 mian4 de5 di3 bu4 ne5
cues.en: under the bottom of the chicken legs

cues.zh: 给它绑上
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 bang3 shang4

cues.zh: 然后接下来在这个铝箔纸上面
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jie1 xia4 lai2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 lv3 bo2 zhi3 shang4 mian4
cues.en: Then next, on this aluminum foil

cues.zh: 稍微刷一点油
cues.pinyin: shao1 wei1 shua1 yi4 dian3 you2

cues.zh: 然后盖住我们鸡腿底部的这个地方
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gai4 zhu4 wo3 men5 ji1 tui3 di3 bu4 de5 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1
cues.en: then cover the bottom part of our chicken legs

cues.zh: 因为这个地方呢比较容易烧焦
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 ne5 bi3 jiao4 rong2 yi4 shao1 jiao1
cues.en: because this spot tends to burn easily

cues.zh: 那就这个鸡翅的做法呢也是同样
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 zhe4 ge5 ji1 chi4 de5 zuo4 fa3 ne5 ye3 shi4 tong2 yang4

cues.zh: 刷一点油然后盖上
cues.pinyin: shua1 yi4 dian3 you2 ran2 hou4 gai4 shang4
cues.en: brush a little oil then cover it

cues.zh: 我们也可以稍微在这个烤箱上涂一点油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ye3 ke3 yi3 shao1 wei1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 kao3 xiang1 shang4 tu2 yi4 dian3 you2
cues.en: We can also brush a little oil on the oven rack

cues.zh: 这样子呢可以防止我们把烤鸡
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 ne5 ke3 yi3 fang2 zhi3 wo3 men5 ba3 kao3 ji1

cues.zh: 烤好的时候呢

cues.zh: 这个皮不会给用破
