items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币交易如何防伪？私钥、公钥、地址啥意思？（二）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 在上一回咱们讲了比特币和区块
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 yi1 hui2 zan2 men5 jiang3 le5 bi3 te4 bi4 he2 qu1 kuai4
cues.en: Last time we talked about the basic principles of Bitcoin and the block

cues.zh: 链的基本原理
cues.pinyin: lian4 de5 ji1 ben3 yuan2 li3
cues.en: chain.

cues.zh: 知道了比特币是一种电子记账系统
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 le5 bi3 te4 bi4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 dian4 zi5 ji4 zhang4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: We learned that Bitcoin is a type of electronic ledger system.

cues.zh: 但是它的所有记录都是公开而且匿名的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 de5 suo3 you3 ji4 lu4 dou1 shi4 gong1 kai1 er2 qie3 ni4 ming2 de5
cues.en: But all of its records are public and anonymous.

cues.zh: 这样比特币就面临几个问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 bi3 te4 bi4 jiu4 mian4 lin2 ji3 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: This means Bitcoin faces several problems.

cues.zh: 它如何去解决伪造记录
cues.pinyin: ta1 ru2 he2 qu4 jie3 jue2 wei3 zao4 ji4 lu4
cues.en: How does it solve the problem of forging records,

cues.zh: 篡改记录或者是双重支付的问题
cues.pinyin: cuan4 gai3 ji4 lu4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 shuang1 chong2 zhi1 fu4 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: tampering with records, or double spending?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来研究一下这几个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ji3 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today we're going to look into these problems.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说一下如何保证比特币的交易
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 ru2 he2 bao3 zheng4 bi3 te4 bi4 de5 jiao1 yi4
cues.en: Let's first talk about how to ensure that Bitcoin transaction

cues.zh: 记录是真实的
cues.pinyin: ji4 lu4 shi4 zhen1 shi2 de5
cues.en: records are genuine.

cues.zh: 也就是如何进行身份认证
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 ru2 he2 jin4 xing2 shen1 fen4 ren4 zheng4
cues.en: In other words, how to do identity authentication.

cues.zh: 我们必须保证每一条记录都是由比特币持
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 bi4 xu1 bao3 zheng4 mei3 yi1 tiao2 ji4 lu4 dou1 shi4 you2 bi3 te4 bi4 chi2
cues.en: We must ensure that every record was sent by the Bitcoin

cues.zh: 有者所发出的
cues.pinyin: you3 zhe3 suo3 fa1 chu1 de5
cues.en: holder themselves,

cues.zh: 而不是由其他人伪造的
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 you2 qi2 ta1 ren2 wei3 zao4 de5
cues.en: and not forged by someone else.

cues.zh: 那么传统的记录证证方式有哪些呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 chuan2 tong3 de5 ji4 lu4 zheng4 zheng4 fang1 shi4 you3 na3 xie1 ne5
cues.en: So what are the traditional methods of identity authentication?

cues.zh: 传统的方式比如说可以刷脸对吧人脸识别
cues.pinyin: chuan2 tong3 de5 fang1 shi4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ke3 yi3 shua1 lian3 dui4 ba5 ren2 lian3 shi2 bie2
cues.en: Traditional methods include, for example, facial recognition, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币交易如何防伪？私钥、公钥、地址啥意思？（二）

cues.zh: 我们去银行办业务
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 qu4 yin2 hang2 ban4 ye4 wu4
cues.en: When we go to the bank to do business,

cues.zh: 银行要求我们必须本人去
cues.pinyin: yin2 hang2 yao1 qiu2 wo3 men5 bi4 xu1 ben3 ren2 qu4
cues.en: the bank requires us to go in person.

cues.zh: 为什么因为他要刷脸对吧
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yin1 wei4 ta1 yao4 shua1 lian3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Why? Because they need to scan your face, right?

cues.zh: 第二个就是签名
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ge4 jiu4 shi4 qian1 ming2
cues.en: The second one is a signature.

cues.zh: 我们可以在某个文件上签字表示我们认
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zai4 mou3 ge4 wen2 jian4 shang4 qian1 zi4 biao3 shi4 wo3 men5 ren4
cues.en: We can sign a document to show that we

cues.zh: 可这份文件了
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 fen4 wen2 jian4 le5
cues.en: approve of it.

cues.zh: 或者再狠一点我们搞指纹
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 zai4 hen3 yi4 dian3 wo3 men5 gao3 zhi3 wen2
cues.en: Or, going further, we use fingerprints.

cues.zh: 每个人的指纹不一样你按了手印就
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 zhi3 wen2 bu4 yi2 yang4 ni3 an4 le5 shou3 yin4 jiu4
cues.en: Everyone's fingerprint is different; once you press your fingerprint, it

cues.zh: 表示这个事是
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 shi4
cues.en: shows that this matter is

cues.zh: 你认可的对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 ren4 ke3 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: something you've approved, right?

cues.zh: 但是这些方式在电子支付系统上都不能
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 xie1 fang1 shi4 zai4 dian4 zi5 zhi1 fu4 xi4 tong3 shang4 dou1 bu4 neng2
cues.en: But these methods can't be implemented in an electronic

cues.zh: 实现为什么呢
cues.pinyin: shi2 xian4 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: payment system. Why?

cues.zh: 因为无论是人脸签名还是指纹我用计算机
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wu2 lun4 shi4 ren2 lian3 qian1 ming2 hai2 shi4 zhi3 wen2 wo3 yong4 ji4 suan4 ji1
cues.en: Because whether it's a face, a signature, or a fingerprint, using a computer

cues.zh: 系统我都可以
cues.pinyin: xi4 tong3 wo3 dou1 ke3 yi3
cues.en: system I can

cues.zh: 进行拷贝对吧
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 kao3 bei4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: copy it, right?

cues.zh: 我可以拷贝下来你的签名
cues.pinyin: wo3 ke3 yi3 kao3 bei4 xia4 lai2 ni3 de5 qian1 ming2
cues.en: I can copy your signature,

cues.zh: 然后添加到我伪造的基督上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 tian1 jia1 dao4 wo3 wei3 zao4 de5 ji1 du1 shang4
cues.en: and then attach it to my forged record.

cues.zh: 这不就行了吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 jiu4 xing2 le5 ma5
cues.en: Wouldn't that work?

cues.zh: 所以我们必须对这种传统的身份认证
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 bi4 xu1 dui4 zhe4 zhong3 chuan2 tong3 de5 shen1 fen4 ren4 zheng4
cues.en: So we must change this kind of traditional identity authentication

cues.zh: 方式进行更改
cues.pinyin: fang1 shi4 jin4 xing2 geng1 gai3
cues.en: method.

cues.zh: 怎么改呢就叫电子签名
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 gai3 ne5 jiu4 jiao4 dian4 zi5 qian1 ming2
cues.en: How do we change it? It's called a digital signature.

cues.zh: 电子接名系统咱们在之前已经讲过了
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 jie1 ming2 xi4 tong3 zan2 men5 zai4 zhi1 qian2 yi3 jing1 jiang3 guo4 le5
cues.en: We've already talked about digital signature systems before.

cues.zh: 就是我们讲这个生日碰撞和哈希
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 jiang3 zhe4 ge5 sheng1 ri4 peng4 zhuang4 he2 ha1 xi1
cues.en: That is, we talked about the birthday paradox and hashing.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币交易如何防伪？私钥、公钥、地址啥意思？（二）

cues.zh: 所以有些人把私钥放在一个不联
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you3 xie1 ren2 ba3 si1 yao4 fang4 zai4 yi2 ge4 bu4 lian2
cues.en: So some people store their private key on a computer that's not connected

cues.zh: 网的电脑里面
cues.pinyin: wang3 de5 dian4 nao3 li3 mian4
cues.en: to the internet.

cues.zh: 也有一些人把它背下来接到脑子里
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 yi1 xie1 ren2 ba3 ta1 bei4 xia4 lai2 jie1 dao4 nao3 zi5 li3
cues.en: Some people also memorize it and keep it in their head.

cues.zh: 但是这个私钥不能丢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 si1 yao4 bu4 neng2 diu1
cues.en: But this private key must not be lost.

cues.zh: 而公钥和地址都是公开的
cues.pinyin: er2 gong1 yao4 he2 di4 zhi3 dou1 shi4 gong1 kai1 de5
cues.en: The public key and the address, on the other hand, are both public.

cues.zh: 如果你想让别人给你钱的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 rang4 bie2 ren2 gei3 ni3 qian2 de5 hua4
cues.en: If you want someone to send you money,

cues.zh: 你就把你的地址告诉他就可以了
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 ba3 ni3 de5 di4 zhi3 gao4 su4 ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: you just tell them your address.

cues.zh: 如果你想给别人钱的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 gei3 bie2 ren2 qian2 de5 hua4
cues.en: If you want to send someone money,

cues.zh: 你要把你的公钥和地址一起发送过去
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 ba3 ni3 de5 gong1 yao4 he2 di4 zhi3 yi4 qi3 fa1 song4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: you need to send your public key and address together.

cues.zh: 但是这两个都是公开的没有关系
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 dou1 shi4 gong1 kai1 de5 mei2 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: But it's fine that both of these are public.

cues.zh: 而且通过公钥也反算不出来私钥
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 tong1 guo4 gong1 yao4 ye3 fan3 suan4 bu4 chu1 lai2 si1 yao4
cues.en: Moreover, you can't work backwards from the public key to get the private key.

cues.zh: 咱们上次说过你像刹 25 6 算法
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 shang4 ci4 shuo1 guo4 ni3 xiang4 sha1 25 6 suan4 fa3
cues.en: As we mentioned before, with the SHA256 algorithm,

cues.zh: 你只能正正的算反正算不出来
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 neng2 zheng4 zheng4 de5 suan4 fan3 zheng4 suan4 bu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: you can only compute it forward, not backward.

cues.zh: 同样的私钥到公钥可以算
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 de5 si1 yao4 dao4 gong1 yao4 ke3 yi3 suan4
cues.en: Similarly, you can compute the public key from the private key,

cues.zh: 但是反过来公钥到私钥是算不出来的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 fan3 guo4 lai2 gong1 yao4 dao4 si1 yao4 shi4 suan4 bu4 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: but you can't compute the private key from the public key.

cues.zh: 这也是一种加密手段
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 jia1 mi4 shou3 duan4
cues.en: This is also a form of encryption.

cues.zh: 好了那么私钥和公钥有什么作用呢
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 na4 me5 si1 yao4 he2 gong1 yao4 you3 shen2 me5 zuo4 yong4 ne5
cues.en: Okay, so what are the private key and public key used for?

cues.zh: 私钥可以对一串字符进行加密
cues.pinyin: si1 yao4 ke3 yi3 dui4 yi1 chuan4 zi4 fu2 jin4 xing2 jia1 mi4
cues.en: The private key can encrypt a string of characters.

cues.zh: 可以对一串字符进行加密
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 dui4 yi1 chuan4 zi4 fu2 jin4 xing2 jia1 mi4
cues.en: It can encrypt a string of characters.

cues.zh: 而公钥可以把这个私钥加密之后的这个
cues.pinyin: er2 gong1 yao4 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 si1 yao4 jia1 mi4 zhi1 hou4 de5 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: And the public key can decrypt the data that was

cues.zh: 数据进行解密
cues.pinyin: shu4 ju4 jin4 xing2 jie3 mi4
cues.en: encrypted with that private key.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】比特币交易如何防伪？私钥、公钥、地址啥意思？（二）

cues.zh: 这个摘要就出来了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhai1 yao4 jiu4 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: And then this digest comes out.

cues.zh: 其实就是通过这个 S HA 25 6 算法
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 S HA 25 6 suan4 fa3
cues.en: It's actually a digest calculated through the SHA256 algorithm.

cues.zh: 算出来的摘要
cues.pinyin: suan4 chu1 lai2 de5 zhai1 yao4
cues.en: ...digest calculated this way.

cues.zh: 好这个摘要算完了之后
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 zhai1 yao4 suan4 wan2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Okay, once this digest is calculated,

cues.zh: 它再通过自己的这个私钥进行
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 tong1 guo4 zi4 ji3 de5 zhe4 ge5 si1 yao4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: it then uses its own private key to

cues.zh: 干嘛进行加密
cues.pinyin: gan4 ma2 jin4 xing2 jia1 mi4
cues.en: do what? To encrypt it.

cues.zh: 加密完了之后它就会产生一个密码对吧
cues.pinyin: jia1 mi4 wan2 le5 zhi1 hou4 ta1 jiu4 hui4 chan3 sheng1 yi2 ge4 mi4 ma3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: After encrypting it, it produces a signature, right?

cues.zh: 产生一个密码好这是 A 要干的事
cues.pinyin: chan3 sheng1 yi2 ge4 mi4 ma3 hao3 zhe4 shi4 A yao4 gan4 de5 shi4
cues.en: It produces a signature. Okay, this is what A needs to do.

cues.zh: 然后它进行广播它对前网进行广播
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jin4 xing2 guang3 bo1 ta1 dui4 qian2 wang3 jin4 xing2 guang3 bo1
cues.en: Then it broadcasts — it broadcasts to the whole network.

cues.zh: 它广播什么呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 guang3 bo1 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What does it broadcast?

cues.zh: 它首先把 A 给 B 10 个比特币这件事
cues.pinyin: ta1 shou3 xian1 ba3 A gei3 B 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: First, it broadcasts the fact that A gave B 10 bitcoins —

cues.zh: 它要进行广播
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 jin4 xing2 guang3 bo1
cues.en: it broadcasts this.

cues.zh: 告诉别人说我给了 B 10 个比特币了对吧
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 bie2 ren2 shuo1 wo3 gei3 le5 B 10 ge4 bi3 te4 bi4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: telling others that "I gave B 10 bitcoins," right?

cues.zh: 然后他同时还要把自己的公钥广播出去
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 tong2 shi2 hai2 yao4 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 gong1 yao4 guang3 bo1 chu1 qu4
cues.en: Then it also broadcasts its own public key at the same time.

cues.zh: 他要告诉别人我的公钥是什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 gao4 su4 bie2 ren2 wo3 de5 gong1 yao4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: It tells others what its public key is.

cues.zh: 同时他还要把这个密码

cues.zh: 就刚才他经过加密之后的这个密

cues.zh: 这条信息对吧

cues.zh: 利用公钥和密码进行解密
cues.pinyin: li4 yong4 gong1 yao4 he2 mi4 ma3 jin4 xing2 jie3 mi4
cues.en: They use the public key and the signature to decrypt it.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 肖恩又接收了一位奇葩病人莉莉
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 you4 jie1 shou1 le5 yi1 wei4 qi2 pa1 bing4 ren2 li4 li4
cues.en: Shaun took on another eccentric patient, Lily.

cues.zh: 莉莉是一位歌星
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 shi4 yi1 wei4 ge1 xing1
cues.en: Lily is a singer.

cues.zh: 曾经和自己的姐姐组成了双人
cues.pinyin: ceng2 jing1 he2 zi4 ji3 de5 jie3 jie3 zu3 cheng2 le5 shuang1 ren2
cues.en: She once formed a duo with her older sister

cues.zh: 组合轰动一时
cues.pinyin: zu3 he2 hong1 dong4 yi1 shi2
cues.en: that was a huge sensation for a while.

cues.zh: 就连黑妹都是她的粉丝
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 hei1 mei4 dou1 shi4 ta1 de5 fen3 si1
cues.en: Even Heimei is one of her fans.

cues.zh: 但是她现在只能这样说话
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 xian4 zai4 zhi3 neng2 zhe4 yang4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: But now she can only speak like this.

cues.zh: 她因为气管受损现在只能靠着电子喉发声
cues.pinyin: ta1 yin1 wei4 qi4 guan3 shou4 sun3 xian4 zai4 zhi3 neng2 kao4 zhe5 dian4 zi5 hou2 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Because her trachea is damaged, she can only speak through an electronic larynx.

cues.zh: 莉莉为了恢复自己的声音
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 wei4 le5 hui1 fu4 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: In order to get her voice back, Lily

cues.zh: 想要做气管移植手术
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 zuo4 qi4 guan3 yi2 zhi2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: wants to undergo a tracheal transplant.

cues.zh: 她为了等一个合适的供体已经等了五年
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 le5 deng3 yi2 ge4 he2 shi4 de5 gong1 ti3 yi3 jing1 deng3 le5 wu3 nian2
cues.en: She's been waiting five years for a suitable donor.

cues.zh: 但是肖恩只是将手指在她颈侧轻
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 zhi3 shi4 jiang1 shou3 zhi3 zai4 ta1 jing3 ce4 qing1
cues.en: But Shaun just lightly pressed his fingers against the side of her neck

cues.zh: 轻按压就发现
cues.pinyin: qing1 an4 ya1 jiu4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: and pressed gently, when he discovered

cues.zh: 她的左颈动脉出现了震颤
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo3 jing3 dong4 mai4 chu1 xian4 le5 zhen4 chan4
cues.en: there was a tremor in her left carotid artery.

cues.zh: 这可能是动脉阻塞
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 neng2 shi4 dong4 mai4 zu3 se4
cues.en: This could be an arterial blockage.

cues.zh: 如果供体气管没有足够的血液供应
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 gong1 ti3 qi4 guan3 mei2 you3 zu2 gou4 de5 xue4 ye4 gong1 ying4
cues.en: If the donor trachea doesn't get enough blood supply,

cues.zh: 情况将会非常危险
cues.pinyin: qing2 kuang4 jiang1 hui4 fei1 chang2 wei1 xian3
cues.en: the situation would be extremely dangerous.

cues.zh: 所以他觉得这个手术不能做
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 bu4 neng2 zuo4
cues.en: So he thinks the surgery shouldn't be done.

cues.zh: 可是安德鲁斯认为没有关系
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 ren4 wei2 mei2 you3 guan1 xi4
cues.en: But Andrews thinks it's fine.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 坚持让他先去做血管噪音
cues.pinyin: jian1 chi2 rang4 ta1 xian1 qu4 zuo4 xue4 guan3 zao4 yin1
cues.en: She insisted Lily first get a vascular bruit test.

cues.zh: 检查结果显示
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The test results showed

cues.zh: 莉莉的左侧颈外动脉狭窄
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 de5 zuo3 ce4 jing3 wai4 dong4 mai4 xia2 zhai3
cues.en: that Lily's left external carotid artery is narrowed.

cues.zh: 肖恩的判断是对的
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 de5 pan4 duan4 shi4 dui4 de5
cues.en: Shaun's judgment was correct.

cues.zh: 这种情况下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: In this situation,

cues.zh: 颈动脉血流不畅可能导致移植器官坏死
cues.pinyin: jing3 dong4 mai4 xue4 liu2 bu4 chang4 ke3 neng2 dao3 zhi4 yi2 zhi2 qi4 guan1 huai4 si3
cues.en: poor carotid blood flow could cause the transplanted organ to die off,

cues.zh: 出现败血症甚至是死亡
cues.pinyin: chu1 xian4 bai4 xue4 zheng4 shen4 zhi4 shi4 si3 wang2
cues.en: leading to sepsis or even death.

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 莉莉的姐姐赶来了医院
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 de5 jie3 jie3 gan3 lai2 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: Lily's older sister rushed to the hospital.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯把莉莉的情况如实相告
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 ba3 li4 li4 de5 qing2 kuang4 ru2 shi2 xiang4 gao4
cues.en: Andrews told her the truth about Lily's condition.

cues.zh: 她认为现在虽然手术的风险很大
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 xian4 zai4 sui1 ran2 shou3 shu4 de5 feng1 xian3 hen3 da4
cues.en: She believes that although the surgery is very risky right now,

cues.zh: 但患者如果坚持还是可以尝试的
cues.pinyin: dan4 huan4 zhe3 ru2 guo3 jian1 chi2 hai2 shi4 ke3 yi3 chang2 shi4 de5
cues.en: it can still be attempted if the patient insists.

cues.zh: 肖恩却认为
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 que4 ren4 wei2
cues.en: But Shaun thinks

cues.zh: 莉莉没必要为了正常发声就难命去赌
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 mei2 bi4 yao4 wei4 le5 zheng4 chang2 fa1 sheng1 jiu4 nan2 ming4 qu4 du3
cues.en: Lily shouldn't bet her life just to speak normally.

cues.zh: 就算恢复了声音也和以前无法一样
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 hui1 fu4 le5 sheng1 yin1 ye3 he2 yi3 qian2 wu2 fa3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Even if her voice is restored, it won't be the same as before.

cues.zh: 但是莉莉还是坚持要找回属于自己的声音
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 li4 li4 hai2 shi4 jian1 chi2 yao4 zhao3 hui2 shu3 yu2 zi4 ji3 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: But Lily still insists on getting her own voice back.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯也决定给她做这台手术
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 ye3 jue2 ding4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 zhe4 tai2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Andrews also decided to go ahead with the surgery for her.

cues.zh: 而安德鲁斯之所以想要冒这个险
cues.pinyin: er2 an1 de2 lu3 si1 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xiang3 yao4 mao4 zhe4 ge5 xian3
cues.en: The reason Andrews is willing to take this risk

cues.zh: 是因为金姐刚刚将她提拔为了外科主任
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 jin1 jie3 gang1 gang1 jiang1 ta1 ti2 ba2 wei4 le5 wai4 ke1 zhu3 ren4
cues.en: is that Jin just promoted her to chief of surgery.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 肖恩发现莉莉的血管壁太僵硬了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 fa1 xian4 li4 li4 de5 xue4 guan3 bi4 tai4 jiang1 ying4 le5
cues.en: Shaun discovered Lily's vessel walls are too stiff.

cues.zh: 她没办法保持管腔通畅
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei2 ban4 fa3 bao3 chi2 guan3 qiang1 tong1 chang4
cues.en: She couldn't keep the lumen open.

cues.zh: 就在肖恩失败了把死之后
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 xiao4 en1 shi1 bai4 le5 ba3 si3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Right after Shaun's attempt failed,

cues.zh: 她终于撂挑子不干了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhong1 yu2 liao4 tiao1 zi5 bu4 gan4 le5
cues.en: she finally gave up and refused to continue.

cues.zh: 这种事情根本就不是多练几次就能成功的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2 gen1 ben3 jiu4 bu2 shi4 duo1 lian4 ji3 ci4 jiu4 neng2 cheng2 gong1 de5
cues.en: This isn't something that can succeed just by practicing more.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯却认为
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 que4 ren4 wei2
cues.en: But Andrews thinks

cues.zh: 萧恩的态度这么消极
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 de5 tai4 du4 zhe4 me5 xiao1 ji2
cues.en: Shaun's attitude is so negative

cues.zh: 是因为最近和丽娅吵架了
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zui4 jin4 he2 li4 ya4 chao3 jia4 le5
cues.en: because he recently had a fight with Lea.

cues.zh: 萧恩立马怼了回去
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 li4 ma3 dui4 le5 hui2 qu4
cues.en: Shaun immediately snapped back,

cues.zh: 那你现在在和金姐约会
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 xian4 zai4 zai4 he2 jin1 jie3 yue1 hui4
cues.en: "So are you dating Jin right now —

cues.zh: 你的情绪影响了你的决定吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 qing2 xu4 ying3 xiang3 le5 ni3 de5 jue2 ding4 ma5
cues.en: is your mood affecting your decisions?"

cues.zh: 一旁的黑妹赶紧踢了萧恩一脚让她闭嘴
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 de5 hei1 mei4 gan3 jin3 ti1 le5 xiao1 en1 yi1 jiao3 rang4 ta1 bi4 zui3
cues.en: Heimei quickly kicked Shaun to make him shut up.

cues.zh: 这种事情心里知道就好了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2 xin1 li3 zhi1 dao4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: Some things are better kept to yourself,

cues.zh: 不要说出来嘛
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 shuo1 chu1 lai2 ma5
cues.en: not said out loud.

cues.zh: 然后他们又开始了第九次尝试
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 men5 you4 kai1 shi3 le5 di4 jiu3 ci4 chang2 shi4
cues.en: Then they began their ninth attempt.

cues.zh: 但是就在此时
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jiu4 zai4 ci3 shi2
cues.en: But just at that moment,

cues.zh: 病床上的丽丽快要不行了
cues.pinyin: bing4 chuang2 shang4 de5 li4 li4 kuai4 yao4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: Lily on the operating table was about to crash.

cues.zh: 萧恩立马敢随为她注射了身上腺素
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 li4 ma3 gan3 sui2 wei4 ta1 zhu4 she4 le5 shen1 shang4 xian4 su4
cues.en: Shaun immediately rushed to give her epinephrine

cues.zh: 还安排了中央插管
cues.pinyin: hai2 an1 pai2 le5 zhong1 yang1 cha1 guan3
cues.en: and also arranged for a central line.

cues.zh: 莉莉对于免疫医治疗法的反应不好
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 dui4 yu2 mian3 yi4 yi1 zhi4 liao2 fa3 de5 fan3 ying4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Lily wasn't responding well to the immunosuppressive therapy.

cues.zh: 现在必须叫停手术
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 bi4 xu1 jiao4 ting2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The surgery had to be stopped now.

cues.zh: 但安德鲁斯还是坚持自己的想法
cues.pinyin: dan4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 hai2 shi4 jian1 chi2 zi4 ji3 de5 xiang3 fa3
cues.en: But Andrews still insisted on her own plan.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 而姐姐收到的则是美妆文具
cues.pinyin: er2 jie3 jie3 shou1 dao4 de5 ze2 shi4 mei3 zhuang1 wen2 ju4
cues.en: Meanwhile, what the older sister received was makeup and stationery.

cues.zh: 因为在妹妹看来姐姐是最漂亮的那一个
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 mei4 mei4 kan4 lai2 jie3 jie3 shi4 zui4 piao4 liang4 de5 na4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Because in the younger sister's eyes, her sister is the prettiest one.

cues.zh: 但其实姐姐更羡慕的是妹妹的才华
cues.pinyin: dan4 qi2 shi2 jie3 jie3 geng4 xian4 mu4 de5 shi4 mei4 mei4 de5 cai2 hua2
cues.en: But actually, the older sister envies the younger sister's talent more.

cues.zh: 姐妹两把话说开
cues.pinyin: jie3 mei4 liang3 ba3 hua4 shuo1 kai1
cues.en: The two sisters talked things through

cues.zh: 终于冰释前嫌
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 bing1 shi4 qian2 xian2
cues.en: and finally let go of their old grudge.

cues.zh: 还想要未来一起重返歌坛
cues.pinyin: hai2 xiang3 yao4 wei4 lai2 yi4 qi3 chong2 fan3 ge1 tan2
cues.en: They even want to return to the music scene together someday.

cues.zh: 小恩也被这对姐妹之间的感情
cues.pinyin: xiao3 en1 ye3 bei4 zhe4 dui4 jie3 mei4 zhi1 jian1 de5 gan3 qing2
cues.en: Shaun was also moved by the bond

cues.zh: 和坦诚所打动
cues.pinyin: he2 tan3 cheng2 suo3 da3 dong4
cues.en: and honesty between the two sisters.

cues.zh: 主动去和丽娅说出了自己小时候
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dong4 qu4 he2 li4 ya4 shuo1 chu1 le5 zi4 ji3 xiao3 shi2 hou4
cues.en: He opened up to Lea about his own childhood,

cues.zh: 被欺负的经历
cues.pinyin: bei4 qi1 fu4 de5 jing1 li4
cues.en: about being bullied.

cues.zh: 丽娅也认识到自己私自改了她
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 ye3 ren4 shi2 dao4 zi4 ji3 si1 zi4 gai3 le5 ta1
cues.en: Lea also realized that secretly changing her

cues.zh: 分数这一行为
cues.pinyin: fen1 shu4 zhe4 yi1 xing2 wei4
cues.en: grade

cues.zh: 其实也是在否定她的能力
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ye3 shi4 zai4 fou3 ding4 ta1 de5 neng2 li4
cues.en: was really a way of denying her ability.

cues.zh: 这两位也终于不再吵架
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang3 wei4 ye3 zhong1 yu2 bu4 zai4 chao3 jia4
cues.en: The two of them finally stopped fighting,

cues.zh: 觉得彼此就是最相配的
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 bi3 ci3 jiu4 shi4 zui4 xiang1 pei4 de5
cues.en: feeling that they are truly meant for each other.

cues.zh: 哪怕以后还会有很多次争吵
cues.pinyin: na3 pa4 yi3 hou4 hai2 hui4 you3 hen3 duo1 ci4 zheng1 chao3
cues.en: Even if there will be many more arguments ahead,

cues.zh: 两人也会一起努力磨合
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 ye3 hui4 yi4 qi3 nu3 li4 mo2 he2
cues.en: the two of them will work through it together

cues.zh: 不会再随便分手了
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 zai4 sui2 bian4 fen1 shou3 le5
cues.en: and won't break up over nothing again.

cues.zh: 在手术台上
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4
cues.en: On the operating table,

cues.zh: 小云发现莉莉的远端器官内被有广
cues.pinyin: xiao3 yun2 fa1 xian4 li4 li4 de5 yuan3 duan1 qi4 guan1 nei4 bei4 you3 guang3
cues.en: Shaun found extensive scarring

cues.zh: 泛的箱内斑痕
cues.pinyin: fan4 de5 xiang1 nei4 ban1 hen2
cues.en: inside Lily's distal trachea.

cues.zh: 于是她切除了后三分之一的环球转骨来
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 qie1 chu2 le5 hou4 san1 fen1 zhi1 yi1 de5 huan2 qiu2 zhuan3 gu3 lai2
cues.en: So she removed the back third of the cricoid cartilage

cues.zh: 解决这个问题
cues.pinyin: jie3 jue2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: to fix the problem,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 并且被莉莉放入了新的器官内导管
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 bei4 li4 li4 fang4 ru4 le5 xin1 de5 qi4 guan1 nei4 dao3 guan3
cues.en: and placed a new endotracheal tube for Lily.

cues.zh: 并且为莉莉放入了新的气管内导管
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 wei4 li4 li4 fang4 ru4 le5 xin1 de5 qi4 guan3 nei4 dao3 guan3
cues.en: But Lily's carotid artery suddenly started bleeding.

cues.zh: 一气显示血压骤降
cues.pinyin: yi1 qi4 xian3 shi4 xue4 ya1 zhou4 jiang4
cues.en: The monitor showed her blood pressure crashing.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯立刻要求注射加压
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 li4 ke4 yao1 qiu2 zhu4 she4 jia1 ya1
cues.en: Andrews immediately called for a pressor injection.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯立刻要求注射升压药
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 li4 ke4 yao1 qiu2 zhu4 she4 sheng1 ya1 yao4
cues.en: They gave her four units of B-negative blood,

cues.zh: 可是效果并不明显
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao4 guo3 bing4 bu4 ming2 xian3
cues.en: but it didn't help much.

cues.zh: 莉莉现在血压已经掉到了高压 40 D 28
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 xian4 zai4 xue4 ya1 yi3 jing1 diao4 dao4 le5 gao1 ya1 40 D 28
cues.en: Lily's blood pressure had now dropped to 40 over 28.

cues.zh: 小云马上为她注射了身上腺素
cues.pinyin: xiao3 yun2 ma3 shang4 wei4 ta1 zhu4 she4 le5 shen1 shang4 xian4 su4
cues.en: Shaun immediately gave her epinephrine.

cues.zh: 就算安德鲁斯在疯狂为患者进行心肺复苏
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 an1 de2 lu3 si1 zai4 feng1 kuang2 wei2 huan4 zhe3 jin4 xing2 xin1 fei4 fu4 su1
cues.en: Even as Andrews frantically performed CPR on her,

cues.zh: 莉莉的生命体积还是在逐渐消失
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 de5 sheng1 ming4 ti3 ji1 hai2 shi4 zai4 zhu2 jian4 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: Lily's vital signs kept fading.

cues.zh: 到了最后她的心电图都落成了一条直线
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 zui4 hou4 ta1 de5 xin1 dian4 tu2 dou1 luo4 cheng2 le5 yi1 tiao2 zhi2 xian4
cues.en: In the end, her EKG flatlined.

cues.zh: 难道说莉莉要就这样死在手术台上了吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shuo1 li4 li4 yao4 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 si3 zai4 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Could Lily really die on the operating table like this?

cues.zh: 不设计也没那么简单
cues.pinyin: bu4 she4 ji4 ye3 mei2 na4 me5 jian3 dan1
cues.en: But it's not that simple.

cues.zh: 就在大家准备放弃治疗的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 da4 jia1 zhun3 bei4 fang4 qi4 zhi4 liao2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Just as everyone was about to give up,

cues.zh: 莉莉的生命体积竟然又奇迹般
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 de5 sheng1 ming4 ti3 ji1 jing4 ran2 you4 qi2 ji4 ban1
cues.en: Lily's vital signs miraculously

cues.zh: 地恢复了正常
cues.pinyin: di4 hui1 fu4 le5 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: returned to normal.

cues.zh: 血止住了器官灌注改善了
cues.pinyin: xue4 zhi3 zhu4 le5 qi4 guan1 guan4 zhu4 gai3 shan4 le5
cues.en: The bleeding stopped and organ perfusion improved —

cues.zh: 她竟然起死回生了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jing4 ran2 qi3 si3 hui2 sheng1 le5
cues.en: she had actually come back from the dead.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季09】知名歌手手术台上停止心跳，神医肖恩都以为没救了！没想到她却自己起死回生了！

cues.zh: 同时另一边
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 雷斯和朴一生收拾了一位老人叫做老乔
cues.pinyin: lei2 si1 he2 pu3 yi1 sheng1 shou1 shi2 le5 yi1 wei4 lao3 ren2 jiao4 zuo4 lao3 qiao2
cues.en: Reyes and Park together admitted an elderly man named Old Joe.

cues.zh: 他本来是要帮犯了地血糖的大胖儿
cues.pinyin: ta1 ben3 lai2 shi4 yao4 bang1 fan4 le5 di4 xue4 tang2 de5 da4 pang4 er2
cues.en: He'd been trying to help his overweight son, who was having a low-blood-sugar episode,

cues.zh: 子抱进轮椅里
cues.pinyin: zi5 bao4 jin4 lun2 yi3 li3
cues.en: into his wheelchair,

cues.zh: 结果把自己给摔坏了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ba3 zi4 ji3 gei3 shuai1 huai4 le5
cues.en: and ended up injuring himself in the process.

cues.zh: 他的儿子科迪患有歌舞剂综合症
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 er2 zi5 ke1 di2 huan4 you3 ge1 wu3 ji4 zong1 he2 zheng4
cues.en: His son Cody has Kabuki syndrome,

cues.zh: 这种病是以肌肉长力低
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 bing4 shi4 yi3 ji1 rou4 zhang3 li4 di1
cues.en: a genetic disorder characterized by low muscle tone,

cues.zh: 心脏缺陷和治理障碍为特征的遗传性疾病
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 que1 xian4 he2 zhi4 li3 zhang4 ai4 wei4 te4 zheng1 de5 yi2 chuan2 xing4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: heart defects, and intellectual disability.

cues.zh: 儿子的情况目前看来倒是不算危急
cues.pinyin: er2 zi5 de5 qing2 kuang4 mu4 qian2 kan4 lai2 dao3 shi4 bu4 suan4 wei1 ji2
cues.en: The son's condition doesn't look critical for now,

cues.zh: 但老乔有三组锁骨骨折
cues.pinyin: dan4 lao3 qiao2 you3 san1 zu3 suo3 gu3 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: but Old Joe has collarbone fractures in three places

cues.zh: 还有肩关节脱位
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jian1 guan1 jie2 tuo1 wei4
cues.en: and a dislocated shoulder.

cues.zh: 而且还感觉不到痛
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 tong4
cues.en: On top of that, he can't feel any pain,

cues.zh: 急需要进行治疗
cues.pinyin: ji2 xu1 yao4 jin4 xing2 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: so he urgently needs treatment.

cues.zh: 庄医生打算先给老乔把锁骨用钢板固
cues.pinyin: zhuang1 yi1 sheng1 da3 suan4 xian1 gei3 lao3 qiao2 ba3 suo3 gu3 yong4 gang1 ban3 gu4
cues.en: Dr. Park plans to first fix Old Joe's collarbone with a plate

cues.zh: 定再做个检查
cues.pinyin: ding4 zai4 zuo4 ge4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: and then run some tests

cues.zh: 确定一下他为什么感觉不到痛
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 yi1 xia4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 tong4
cues.en: to figure out why he can't feel pain.

cues.zh: 在把人推进手术室之前
cues.pinyin: zai4 ba3 ren2 tui1 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: Before wheeling him into the OR,

cues.zh: 科迪也很担心自己爸爸的情况
cues.pinyin: ke1 di2 ye3 hen3 dan1 xin1 zi4 ji3 ba4 ba4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Cody was very worried about his father's condition.

cues.zh: 老乔说
cues.pinyin: lao3 qiao2 shuo1
cues.en: Old Joe said

cues.zh: 过去的几年里都是他们父子俩相依为命
cues.pinyin: guo4 qu4 de5 ji3 nian2 li3 dou1 shi4 ta1 men5 fu4 zi3 lia3 xiang1 yi1 wei2 ming4
cues.en: that for the past few years, it's just been the two of them getting by together,

cues.zh: 他们俩是个最棒的团队
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 lia3 shi4 ge4 zui4 bang4 de5 tuan2 dui4
cues.en: and they're the best team there is.

cues.zh: 说着还和儿子碰了个拳
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe5 hai2 he2 er2 zi5 peng4 le5 ge4 quan2
cues.en: As he said it, he gave his son a fist bump.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】为什么说杨振宁是当代最伟大的物理学家？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今天是 20 25 年 10 月 18 日
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 shi4 20 25 nian2 10 yue4 18 ri4
cues.en: Today is October 18, 2025.

cues.zh: 一颗照亮现代物理学天空的巨星归于星海
cues.pinyin: yi1 ke1 zhao4 liang4 xian4 dai4 wu4 li3 xue2 tian1 kong1 de5 ju4 xing1 gui1 yu2 xing1 hai3
cues.en: A giant star that lit up the sky of modern physics has returned to the sea of stars.

cues.zh: 杨振宁先生在北京逝世享年 10 3 岁
cues.pinyin: yang2 zhen4 ning2 xian1 sheng1 zai4 bei3 jing1 shi4 shi4 xiang3 nian2 10 3 sui4
cues.en: Mr. Yang Chen-Ning passed away in Beijing at the age of 103.

cues.zh: 这位跨越了一个世纪的科学巨匠
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 kua4 yue4 le5 yi2 ge4 shi4 ji4 de5 ke1 xue2 ju4 jiang4
cues.en: This scientific giant who spanned a century,

cues.zh: 用宇称不守恒的革命性发现
cues.pinyin: yong4 yu3 cheng1 bu4 shou3 heng2 de5 ge2 ming4 xing4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: with his revolutionary discovery that parity is not conserved,

cues.zh: 打破了物理学界的认知谜局
cues.pinyin: da3 po4 le5 wu4 li3 xue2 jie4 de5 ren4 zhi1 mi2 ju2
cues.en: broke open a puzzle in the physics world,

cues.zh: 用杨米尔斯场论为现代粒子物理搭
cues.pinyin: yong4 yang2 mi3 er3 si1 chang3 lun4 wei4 xian4 dai4 li4 zi5 wu4 li3 da1
cues.en: and with Yang-Mills theory built,

cues.zh: 建了根基框架
cues.pinyin: jian4 le5 gen1 ji1 kuang1 jia4
cues.en: the foundational framework for modern particle physics.

cues.zh: 杨振宁先生是当今中国乃至世
cues.pinyin: yang2 zhen4 ning2 xian1 sheng1 shi4 dang1 jin1 zhong1 guo2 nai3 zhi4 shi4
cues.en: Mr. Yang Chen-Ning is, in China and even

cues.zh: 界上首屈一指
cues.pinyin: jie4 shang4 shou3 qu1 yi1 zhi3
cues.en: the world, one of the very foremost

cues.zh: 的物理学泰斗
cues.pinyin: de5 wu4 li3 xue2 tai4 dou3
cues.en: giants of physics.

cues.zh: 大部分网友熟悉杨先生还是因为 19 57 年
cues.pinyin: da4 bu4 fen4 wang3 you3 shu2 xi1 yang2 xian1 sheng1 huan2 shi4 yin1 wei4 19 57 nian2
cues.en: Most people online know Mr. Yang mainly because in 1957,

cues.zh: 杨振宁先生和李政道先生共同提出了
cues.pinyin: yang2 zhen4 ning2 xian1 sheng1 he2 li3 zheng4 dao4 xian1 sheng1 gong4 tong2 ti2 chu1 le5
cues.en: Mr. Yang Chen-Ning and Mr. Lee Tsung-Dao jointly proposed

cues.zh: 弱相互作用下宇称不守恒
cues.pinyin: ruo4 xiang1 hu4 zuo4 yong4 xia4 yu3 cheng1 bu4 shou3 heng2
cues.en: that parity is not conserved under the weak interaction,

cues.zh: 获得了诺贝尔物理学奖

cues.en: for which they won the Nobel Prize in Physics.

cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 di4 yi1 ci4 huo4 de2 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: This was the first time a Chinese person won a Nobel Prize.

cues.zh: 今天就让我们一起回顾这一伟大成就
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 rang4 wo3 men5 yi4 qi3 hui2 gu4 zhe4 yi1 wei3 da4 cheng2 jiu4
cues.en: Today let's look back at this great achievement together,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】为什么说杨振宁是当代最伟大的物理学家？

cues.zh: 用以缅怀杨振宁先生和先他一步去世
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi3 mian3 huai2 yang2 zhen4 ning2 xian1 sheng1 he2 xian1 ta1 yi1 bu4 qu4 shi4
cues.en: to commemorate Mr. Yang Chen-Ning and

cues.zh: 的李正道先生
cues.pinyin: de5 li3 zheng4 dao4 xian1 sheng1
cues.en: Mr. Lee Tsung-Dao, who passed away before him.

cues.zh: 首先我们要讨论一下物理学中对称
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 yao4 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 wu4 li3 xue2 zhong1 dui4 chen4
cues.en: First, let's discuss the relationship between symmetry

cues.zh: 和守恒的关系
cues.pinyin: he2 shou3 heng2 de5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: and conservation in physics.

cues.zh: 在 20 世纪初
cues.pinyin: zai4 20 shi4 ji4 chu1
cues.en: In the early 20th century,

cues.zh: 德国著名的女性数学家艾米诺特提
cues.pinyin: de2 guo2 zhu4 ming2 de5 nv3 xing4 shu4 xue2 jia1 ai4 mi3 nuo4 te4 ti2
cues.en: the famous German female mathematician Emmy Noether

cues.zh: 出了诺特定理
cues.pinyin: chu1 le5 nuo4 te4 ding4 li3
cues.en: proposed Noether's theorem.

cues.zh: 她说系统中每一个连续的对称性
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 xi4 tong3 zhong1 mei3 yi2 ge4 lian2 xu4 de5 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: She said that every continuous symmetry in a system

cues.zh: 都会对应着一个守恒量
cues.pinyin: du1 hui4 dui4 ying4 zhe5 yi2 ge4 shou3 heng2 liang4
cues.en: corresponds to a conserved quantity.

cues.zh: 比如说物理规律都满足时间平移对称性
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 dou1 man3 zu2 shi2 jian1 ping2 yi2 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: For example, physical laws all satisfy time-translation symmetry,

cues.zh: 意思是说今天的物理规律
cues.pinyin: yi4 si5 shi4 shuo1 jin1 tian1 de5 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4
cues.en: meaning that today's physical laws

cues.zh: 和明天的物理规律是完全一样的
cues.pinyin: he2 ming2 tian1 de5 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 shi4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: are exactly the same as tomorrow's.

cues.zh: 物理规律不会随着时间而发生变化
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 bu2 hui4 sui2 zhe5 shi2 jian1 er2 fa1 sheng1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: Physical laws don't change over time.

cues.zh: 根据诺特定理
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 nuo4 te4 ding4 li3
cues.en: According to Noether's theorem,

cues.zh: 这种对称性一定对应了物理学中
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 dui4 chen4 xing4 yi2 ding4 dui4 ying4 le5 wu4 li3 xue2 zhong1
cues.en: this symmetry must correspond to

cues.zh: 的一个守恒量
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 ge4 shou3 heng2 liang4
cues.en: a conserved quantity in physics,

cues.zh: 这个守恒量就是能量
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shou3 heng2 liang4 jiu4 shi4 neng2 liang4
cues.en: and that conserved quantity is energy.

cues.zh: 为什么这么说呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 shuo1 ne5
cues.en: Why do we say that?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】为什么说杨振宁是当代最伟大的物理学家？

cues.zh: 就必然会得出万有引力常数不随时间变化
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi4 ran2 hui4 de2 chu1 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 chang2 shu4 bu4 sui2 shi2 jian1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: It follows that the gravitational constant doesn't change over time.

cues.zh: 这就是时间平移对称性
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 shi2 jian1 ping2 yi2 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: This is what time-translation symmetry means.

cues.zh: 物理规律除了满足时间平移对称性以外
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 chu2 le5 man3 zu2 shi2 jian1 ping2 yi2 dui4 chen4 xing4 yi3 wai4
cues.en: Besides time-translation symmetry,

cues.zh: 还要满足空间平移对称性
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 man3 zu2 kong1 jian1 ping2 yi2 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: physical laws must also satisfy spatial-translation symmetry.

cues.zh: 一个物理实验在中国做还是美国做
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 wu4 li3 shi2 yan4 zai4 zhong1 guo2 zuo4 hai2 shi4 mei3 guo2 zuo4
cues.en: Whether a physics experiment is done in China or in the US,

cues.zh: 得出的规律是一样的
cues.pinyin: de2 chu1 de5 gui1 lv4 shi4 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: the law you get is the same.

cues.zh: 就算我们拿到火星上去做
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 wo3 men5 na2 dao4 huo3 xing1 shang4 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: Even if we did it on Mars,

cues.zh: 结果也是如此
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ye3 shi4 ru2 ci3
cues.en: the result would still be the same.

cues.zh: 空间平移对称性对应了物理学
cues.pinyin: kong1 jian1 ping2 yi2 dui4 chen4 xing4 dui4 ying4 le5 wu4 li3 xue2
cues.en: Spatial-translation symmetry corresponds to

cues.zh: 中的动量守恒
cues.pinyin: zhong1 de5 dong4 liang4 shou3 heng2
cues.en: conservation of momentum in physics.

cues.zh: 此外物理规律还要满足空间旋转对称性
cues.pinyin: ci3 wai4 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 hai2 yao4 man3 zu2 kong1 jian1 xuan2 zhuan3 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: Besides that, physical laws must also satisfy spatial-rotation symmetry.

cues.zh: 向东扔一个篮球和向南扔一个篮球
cues.pinyin: xiang4 dong1 reng1 yi2 ge4 lan2 qiu2 he2 xiang4 nan2 reng1 yi2 ge4 lan2 qiu2
cues.en: Throwing a basketball eastward and throwing one southward

cues.zh: 得到的物理规律是相同的
cues.pinyin: de2 dao4 de5 wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 shi4 xiang1 tong2 de5
cues.en: give you the same physical laws.

cues.zh: 空间旋转对称性对应了物理学中
cues.pinyin: kong1 jian1 xuan2 zhuan3 dui4 chen4 xing4 dui4 ying4 le5 wu4 li3 xue2 zhong1
cues.en: Spatial-rotation symmetry corresponds to

cues.zh: 的角动量守行
cues.pinyin: de5 jiao3 dong4 liang4 shou3 xing2
cues.en: conservation of angular momentum in physics.

cues.zh: 最初诺特认为对称量应该是连续可微的
cues.pinyin: zui4 chu1 nuo4 te4 ren4 wei2 dui4 chen4 liang4 ying1 gai1 shi4 lian2 xu4 ke3 wei1 de5
cues.en: At first Noether believed symmetries had to be continuous and differentiable,

cues.zh: 也就是说可以一点一点的变化
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ke3 yi3 yi4 dian3 yi4 dian3 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: meaning they change little by little.

cues.zh: 比如说时间的平移空间的平移
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 shi2 jian1 de5 ping2 yi2 kong1 jian1 de5 ping2 yi2
cues.en: For example, time translation, spatial translation,

cues.zh: 还有空间的旋转都是连续可微的
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 kong4 jian1 de5 xuan2 zhuan3 dou1 shi4 lian2 xu4 ke3 wei1 de5
cues.en: and spatial rotation are all continuous and differentiable.

cues.zh: 但是后来人们又发现了一种不
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 you4 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 zhong3 bu4
cues.en: But later, people discovered another kind of

cues.zh: 连续的对称性
cues.pinyin: lian2 xu4 de5 dui4 chen4 xing4
cues.en: symmetry that isn't continuous:

cues.zh: 镜像对称
cues.pinyin: jing4 xiang4 dui4 chen4

cues.zh: 物理规律也普遍的满足镜像对称
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 ye3 pu3 bian4 de5 man3 zu2 jing4 xiang4 dui4 chen4
cues.en: Physical laws generally also satisfy mirror symmetry.

cues.zh: 例如我扔出一个篮球

cues.en: For example, if I throw a basketball,

cues.pinyin: na4 me5 lan2 qiu2 hui4 jing1 guo4 yi1 tiao2 pao1 wu4 xian4 gui3 ji4

cues.zh: 如果在我的对面有一个镜子
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zai4 wo3 de5 dui4 mian4 you3 yi2 ge4 jing4 zi5
cues.en: If there's a mirror facing me,

cues.zh: 镜子里边的篮球也会经过一个抛物线轨迹
cues.pinyin: jing4 zi5 li3 bian1 de5 lan2 qiu2 ye3 hui4 jing1 guo4 yi2 ge4 pao1 wu4 xian4 gui3 ji4
cues.en: the basketball in the mirror will also follow a parabolic trajectory.

cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 bu4 lun4 shi4 jing4 zi5 wai4 mian4 de5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: You'll find that whether in the world outside the mirror

cues.zh: 还是镜子里面的世界
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jing4 zi5 li3 mian4 de5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: or the world inside the mirror,

cues.zh: 物理规律也是完全一样的
cues.pinyin: wu4 li3 gui1 lv4 ye3 shi4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: the physical laws are exactly the same.

cues.zh: 如果你只看篮球经过了一个抛物线
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zhi3 kan4 lan2 qiu2 jing1 guo4 le5 yi2 ge4 pao1 wu4 xian4
cues.en: If you only look at the basketball tracing out a parabola...

cues.zh: 而函数 Y 等于 X 三次方叫做 G 函数
cues.pinyin: er2 han2 shu4 Y deng3 yu2 X san1 ci4 fang1 jiao4 zuo4 G han2 shu4
cues.en: the function y = x cubed is called an odd function.

cues.en: We need a wave function

cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 bo1 han2 shu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 ou3 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: So if this wave function is an even function,

cues.zh: 我们就叫它偶语称
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 jiao4 ta1 ou3 yu3 cheng1

cues.zh: 如果波函数是积函数呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bo1 han2 shu4 shi4 ji1 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: If the wave function is an odd function,

cues.zh: 我们就叫它偶宇称
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 jiao4 ta1 ou3 yu3 cheng1

cues.zh: 如果波函数是奇函数呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 bo1 han2 shu4 shi4 ji1 han2 shu4 ne5
cues.en: The mirror symmetry of physical laws

cues.zh: 我们就叫它奇宇称
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 jiao4 ta1 qi2 yu3 cheng1

cues.zh: 也就是说
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1

cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5 de5 bo1 han2 shu4 zui4 chu1 shi4 ou3 han2 shu4
cues.en: if a particle's wave function starts out as an even function,

cues.zh: 那么它将会一直是偶函数
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 jiang1 hui4 yi4 zhi2 shi4 ou3 han2 shu4

cues.zh: 如果它最初是积函数
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 zui4 chu1 shi4 ji1 han2 shu4
cues.en: If it starts out as an odd function,

cues.zh: 那么它将一直是积函数
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 jiang1 yi4 zhi2 shi4 ji1 han2 shu4
cues.en: it will always remain an odd function.

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1

cues.zh: 最近有一个小朋友给我发来私信
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4
cues.en: Recently a kid sent me a private message.

cues.zh: 说他们最近学了一篇课文叫做皇帝的新装
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ta1 men5 zui4 jin4 xue2 le5 yi1 pian1 ke4 wen2 jiao4 zuo4 huang2 di4 de5 xin1 zhuang1
cues.en: Saying they recently studied a text called "The Emperor's New Clothes."

cues.zh: 是安徒生的一篇童话
cues.pinyin: shi4 an1 tu2 sheng1 de5 yi1 pian1 tong2 hua4
cues.en: It's a fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen.

cues.zh: 老师让他们写读后感
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 rang4 ta1 men5 xie3 du2 hou4 gan3
cues.en: The teacher had them write a reading response.

cues.zh: 他想问我说这篇课文除了讽刺皇
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 pian1 ke4 wen2 chu2 le5 feng3 ci4 huang2
cues.en: He wanted to ask me, besides mocking the emperor's

cues.zh: 帝的愚蠢之外
cues.pinyin: di4 de5 yu2 chun3 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: ...stupidity,

cues.zh: 有没有更加深刻的社会含义呢
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 geng4 jia1 shen1 ke4 de5 she4 hui4 han2 yi4 ne5
cues.en: does this text have a deeper social meaning?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来讨论一下这件事
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: Today let's discuss this.

cues.zh: 为了讨论这件事
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tao3 lun4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: To discuss this,

cues.zh: 首先跟大家讲一个有意思的数学逻辑题
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 gen1 da4 jia1 jiang3 yi2 ge4 you3 yi4 si5 de5 shu4 xue2 luo2 ji2 ti2
cues.en: first let me tell you an interesting math logic puzzle.

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 luo2 ji2 ti2 jiao4 zuo4 hong2 yan3 jing1 he2 lan2 yan3 jing1
cues.en: This logic puzzle is called "Red Eyes and Blue Eyes."

cues.zh: 红眼睛与蓝眼睛
cues.pinyin: hong2 yan3 jing1 yu3 lan2 yan3 jing1
cues.en: Red Eyes and Blue Eyes.

cues.zh: 这个数学题是一个华人数学家陶哲轩
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu4 xue2 ti2 shi4 yi2 ge4 hua2 ren2 shu4 xue2 jia1 tao2 zhe2 xuan1
cues.en: This math problem was first posted online by Chinese mathematician Terence Tao

cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 wang3 shang4 zui4 zao3 tie1 chu1 lai2 de5 gong1 da4 jia1 qu4 tao3 lun4
cues.en: for everyone to discuss.

cues.zh: 这个问题是这样的说有一个村子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 cun1 zi5
cues.en: The problem goes like this: there's a village.

items.title: 李永乐老师

cues.en: Of these 100 people, 95

cues.en: But the villagers don't know there are 95 blue-eyed

cues.zh: 他们不知道这事

cues.en: you can see what color other people's eyes are, that's fine,

cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 bu4 yun3 xu3 ba3 zhe4 jian4 shi4 shuo1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: but you're not allowed to say it out loud.

cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 yu3 bie2 ren2 tao3 lun4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: or discuss this topic with others.

cues.zh: 一旦是因为某些原因
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 mou3 xie1 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: If, for some reason,

cues.zh: 比如你照镜子或者是因为什么原因
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ni3 zhao4 jing4 zi5 huo4 zhe3 shi4 yin1 wei4 shen2 me5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: like looking in a mirror, or whatever the reason,

cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 yan3 jing1 yan2 se4
cues.en: you find out your own eye color,

cues.zh: 你就必须到第二天的中午在广场上自杀
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 bi4 xu1 dao4 di4 er4 tian1 de5 zhong1 wu3 zai4 guang3 chang3 shang4 zi4 sha1

cues.pinyin: rang4 suo3 you3 ren2 dou1 kan4 dao4 ni3 si3 le5
cues.en: so everyone sees you die.

cues.zh: 它就有一个这么奇特的规矩
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 you3 yi2 ge4 zhe4 me5 qi2 te4 de5 gui1 ju3
cues.en: That's the strange rule it has.

cues.zh: 所以所有人都不知道自己眼睛是什么颜色
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 suo3 you3 ren2 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 yan3 jing1 shi4 shen2 me5 yan2 se4
cues.en: So nobody knows their own eye color.
