cues.en: will kill themselves together.

cues.zh: 就是这样一个结果
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 jie2 guo3
cues.en: That's the result.

cues.zh: 有人可能还问那这五个红眼睛
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 ke3 neng2 hai2 wen4 na4 zhe4 wu3 ge4 hong2 yan3 jing1
cues.en: Some might also ask, after these five red-eyed

cues.zh: 的人自杀之后
cues.pinyin: de5 ren2 zi4 sha1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: people kill themselves,

cues.zh: 蓝眼睛的人会不会也自杀呢不
cues.pinyin: lan2 yan3 jing1 de5 ren2 hui4 bu2 hui4 ye3 zi4 sha1 ne5 bu4
cues.en: will the blue-eyed people also kill themselves? No,

cues.zh: 会的为什么呢
cues.pinyin: hui4 de5 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: they won't. Why?

cues.zh: 因为蓝眼睛的人不知道自己眼睛什么颜色
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 lan2 yan3 jing1 de5 ren2 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 yan3 jing1 shen2 me5 yan2 se4
cues.en: Because the blue-eyed people don't know their own eye color.

cues.zh: 每一个人都觉得自己可能是蓝色的
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 ren2 dou1 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 ke3 neng2 shi4 lan2 se4 de5
cues.en: Everyone thinks they might be blue-eyed,

cues.zh: 也可能是绿色的对不对
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 lv4 se4 de5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: or maybe green-eyed, right?

cues.zh: 所以他们是没有事的就这红眼睛的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 shi4 mei2 you3 shi4 de5 jiu4 zhe4 hong2 yan3 jing1 de5
cues.en: So they're fine; it's only the red-eyed

cues.zh: 人全都自杀了
cues.pinyin: ren2 quan2 dou1 zi4 sha1 le5
cues.en: people who all killed themselves.

cues.zh: 不过这件事实际上是一个悖论
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 bei4 lun4
cues.en: But actually, this whole thing is a paradox.

cues.zh: 为什么说是悖论
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 shuo1 shi4 bei4 lun4
cues.en: Why is it called a paradox?

cues.zh: 你想这些人不管是眼睛蓝色的还是红色的
cues.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 zhe4 xie1 ren2 bu4 guan3 shi4 yan3 jing1 lan2 se4 de5 hai2 shi4 hong2 se4 de5
cues.en: Think about it: these people, whether blue-eyed or red-eyed,

cues.zh: 他们本来就知道村子里是有红眼睛的人的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ben3 lai2 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 cun1 zi5 li3 shi4 you3 hong2 yan3 jing1 de5 ren2 de5
cues.en: already knew there were red-eyed people in the village.

cues.zh: 那么这个外乡人也确实没有说出什
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 wai4 xiang1 ren2 ye3 que4 shi2 mei2 you3 shuo1 chu1 shen2
cues.en: So the outsider really didn't say

cues.zh: 么新的花样来
cues.pinyin: me5 xin1 de5 hua1 yang4 lai2
cues.en: anything new.

cues.zh: 他只是告诉你村子里有红眼睛的人
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 gao4 su4 ni3 cun1 zi5 li3 you3 hong2 yan3 jing1 de5 ren2
cues.en: He just told you there are red-eyed people in the village.

cues.zh: 为什么这句话的杀伤力这么大呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 ju4 hua4 de5 sha1 shang1 li4 zhe4 me5 da4 ne5
cues.en: So why does that sentence have such power?

cues.zh: 为了研究这个问题我们还要对知识
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 wo3 men5 hai2 yao4 dui4 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: To study this problem, we need to

cues.zh: 进行一下分类
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 yi1 xia4 fen1 lei4
cues.en: classify knowledge.

cues.zh: 我们可以把知识分为两类
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhi1 shi2 fen1 wei2 liang3 lei4
cues.en: We can divide knowledge into two types.

cues.zh: 第一类叫共有知识
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 lei4 jiao4 gong4 you3 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: The first type is called "common knowledge."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】《皇帝的新装》到底在告诉我们什么？呐喊有多大的力量？

cues.zh: 要满足这一条
cues.pinyin: yao4 man3 zu2 zhe4 yi1 tiao2
cues.en: It must satisfy this condition.

cues.zh: 我举个例子
cues.pinyin: wo3 ju3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let me give an example.

cues.zh: 比如说有两个人一个男孩和一个女孩
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 liang3 ge4 ren2 yi2 ge4 nan2 hai2 he2 yi2 ge4 nv3 hai2
cues.en: Say there are two people, a boy and a girl.

cues.zh: 这个男孩和这个女孩两个人互相暗恋
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 hai2 he2 zhe4 ge5 nv3 hai2 liang3 ge4 ren2 hu4 xiang1 an4 lian4
cues.en: This boy and this girl secretly like each other.

cues.zh: 他们没有表白互相暗恋
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 mei2 you3 biao3 bai2 hu4 xiang1 an4 lian4
cues.en: They secretly like each other but haven't confessed.

cues.zh: 这个男孩和女孩没有表白的时候
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 hai2 he2 nv3 hai2 mei2 you3 biao3 bai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When this boy and girl haven't confessed,

cues.zh: 会有什么特点
cues.pinyin: hui4 you3 shen2 me5 te4 dian3
cues.en: what characteristic would there be?

cues.zh: 如果未表白在这个时候
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wei4 biao3 bai2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: If, before confessing, at this point,

cues.zh: 他们之间相爱这件事可能他们也都知道
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 zhi1 jian1 xiang1 ai4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 ke3 neng2 ta1 men5 ye3 dou1 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: they might both actually know that they love each other.

cues.zh: 男孩知道自己肯定是爱女孩的
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 ken3 ding4 shi4 ai4 nv3 hai2 de5
cues.en: The boy knows for sure he loves the girl.

cues.zh: 而且通过这个女孩的这个行为
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 nv3 hai2 de5 zhe4 ge5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: And from the girl's behavior,

cues.zh: 他也感觉到这个女孩也应该是爱自己的
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 gan3 jue2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 nv3 hai2 ye3 ying1 gai1 shi4 ai4 zi4 ji3 de5
cues.en: he also senses that the girl must love him too.

cues.zh: 所以未表白的时候双方都知道这件事
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wei4 biao3 bai2 de5 shi2 hou4 shuang1 fang1 dou1 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: So even before confessing, both sides know this.

cues.zh: 这个知识就是共有知识
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhi1 shi2 jiu4 shi4 gong4 you3 zhi1 shi2
cues.en: This knowledge is "common knowledge."

cues.zh: 但是男孩并不清楚
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 nan2 hai2 bing4 bu4 qing1 chu3
cues.en: But the boy isn't sure

cues.zh: 自己知道相爱这件事女孩知道不知道
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 zhi1 dao4 xiang1 ai4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 nv3 hai2 zhi1 dao4 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: whether the girl knows that he knows they love each other.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 你能想象吗一个人居然在自己肚子里
cues.pinyin: ni3 neng2 xiang3 xiang4 ma5 yi2 ge4 ren2 ju1 ran2 zai4 zi4 ji3 du3 zi5 li3
cues.en: Can you imagine — someone actually hid

cues.zh: 藏了小半盆的
cues.pinyin: cang2 le5 xiao3 ban4 pen2 de5
cues.en: nearly half a basin of

cues.zh: 毒品差点死掉
cues.pinyin: du2 pin3 cha4 dian3 si3 diao4
cues.en: drugs in their own stomach, and almost died,

cues.zh: 最终还狡猾地逃脱了警察的追捕
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 hai2 jiao3 hua2 di4 tao2 tuo1 le5 jing3 cha2 de5 zhui1 bu3
cues.en: and in the end cleverly escaped the police.

cues.zh: 布朗和大钟负责一个病人小白
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 he2 da4 zhong1 fu4 ze2 yi2 ge4 bing4 ren2 xiao3 bai2
cues.en: Brown and Da Zhong are in charge of a patient, Xiaobai.

cues.zh: 他肚子肿胀一触即痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 du3 zi5 zhong3 zhang4 yi1 chu4 ji2 tong4
cues.en: His stomach is swollen and hurts sharply at the slightest touch.

cues.zh: 布朗要安排他住院拍 X 光
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 yao4 an1 pai2 ta1 zhu4 yuan4 pai1 X guang1
cues.en: Brown wants to arrange an X-ray and hospitalize him.

cues.zh: 可小白说自己只需要一些泄药就好了
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 bai2 shuo1 zi4 ji3 zhi3 xu1 yao4 yi1 xie1 xie4 yao4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: But Xiaobai says he just needs some laxatives.

cues.zh: 自己没有工作也没有保险付不起费用
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 mei2 you3 gong1 zuo4 ye3 mei2 you3 bao3 xian3 fu4 bu4 qi3 fei4 yong4
cues.en: He has no job or insurance and can't afford the cost.

cues.zh: 可是如果不治疗的话长梗组可能会致命
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 bu4 zhi4 liao2 de5 hua4 zhang3 geng3 zu3 ke3 neng2 hui4 zhi4 ming4
cues.en: But if untreated, intestinal obstruction could be fatal.

cues.zh: 布朗和他商量可以不拍 X 光
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 he2 ta1 shang1 liang2 ke3 yi3 bu4 pai1 X guang1
cues.en: Brown discusses with him skipping the X-ray.

cues.zh: 医生会给他开药但是小白必须住院
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 hui4 gei3 ta1 kai1 yao4 dan4 shi4 xiao3 bai2 bi4 xu1 zhu4 yuan4
cues.en: The doctor will prescribe medicine, but Xiaobai must stay in the hospital

cues.zh: 直到排便为止
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 pai2 bian4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: until he has a bowel movement.

cues.zh: 双方达成共识
cues.pinyin: shuang1 fang1 da2 cheng2 gong4 shi2
cues.en: Both sides reached an agreement.

cues.zh: 但布朗没想到的是
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu4 lang3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But what Brown didn't expect was

cues.zh: 小白拿到歇药后就立刻离开了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 na2 dao4 xie1 yao4 hou4 jiu4 li4 ke4 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: as soon as Xiaobai got the laxative, he left immediately.

cues.zh: 但是走到医院门口就开始狂吐
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zou3 dao4 yi1 yuan4 men2 kou3 jiu4 kai1 shi3 kuang2 tu3
cues.en: But at the hospital entrance he started vomiting violently.

cues.zh: 这位护士发现了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wei4 hu4 shi4 fa1 xian4 le5
cues.en: A nurse noticed.

cues.zh: 他和大钟去查看情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 he2 da4 zhong1 qu4 cha2 kan4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: He and Da Zhong went to check on him.

cues.zh: 大钟好像看出了什么
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 hao3 xiang4 kan4 chu1 le5 shen2 me5
cues.en: Da Zhong seemed to realize something.

cues.zh: 问他是在运送什么
cues.pinyin: wen4 ta1 shi4 zai4 yun4 song4 shen2 me5
cues.en: He asked what he was transporting.

cues.zh: 便秘精神紧张
cues.pinyin: bian4 mi4 jing1 shen2 jin3 zhang1
cues.en: Constipation, nervous and tense —

cues.zh: 拒绝 CT 扫描
cues.pinyin: ju4 jue2 CT sao3 miao2
cues.en: he refused a CT scan.

cues.zh: 装毒品的球囊
cues.pinyin: zhuang1 du2 pin3 de5 qiu2 nang2
cues.en: Balloons packed with drugs —

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 要么造成了肠道完全阻塞
cues.pinyin: yao4 me5 zao4 cheng2 le5 chang2 dao4 wan2 quan2 zu3 se4
cues.en: either they caused a complete intestinal blockage,

cues.zh: 要么其中一个已经破了
cues.pinyin: yao4 me5 qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 yi3 jing1 po4 le5
cues.en: or one of them had already burst.

cues.zh: 小白现在的情况很危急
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 xian4 zai4 de5 qing2 kuang4 hen3 wei1 ji2
cues.en: Xiaobai's condition is now critical.

cues.zh: 布朗保证不会报警
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 bao3 zheng4 bu2 hui4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: Brown promises not to call the police,

cues.zh: 让他留下来检查
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 liu2 xia4 lai2 jian3 cha2
cues.en: to get him to stay for examination.

cues.zh: 小白妥协了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 tuo3 xie2 le5
cues.en: Xiaobai gave in.

cues.zh: 检查结果显示
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The exam results showed

cues.zh: 小白的回盲场闸门处
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 de5 hui2 mang2 chang3 zha2 men2 chu4
cues.en: that at Xiaobai's ileocecal valve

cues.zh: 卡住了 50 多个球囊
cues.pinyin: ka3 zhu4 le5 50 duo1 ge4 qiu2 nang2
cues.en: more than 50 balloons were stuck.

cues.zh: 这必须要做手术
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bi4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: This requires surgery.

cues.zh: 梅医生知道后要通知缉毒部门
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zhi1 dao4 hou4 yao4 tong1 zhi1 ji1 du2 bu4 men2
cues.en: Once Dr. Mei found out, she wanted to notify the narcotics unit.

cues.zh: 毕竟不报警是布朗保证的
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 bu4 bao4 jing3 shi4 bu4 lang3 bao3 zheng4 de5
cues.en: After all, it was Brown who promised not to call the police,

cues.zh: 而不是他
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 ta1
cues.en: not her.

cues.zh: 小白知道他们想要报警
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 zhi1 dao4 ta1 men5 xiang3 yao4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: Xiaobai found out they wanted to call the police,

cues.zh: 就立刻要求出院
cues.pinyin: jiu4 li4 ke4 yao1 qiu2 chu1 yuan4
cues.en: and immediately demanded to be discharged.

cues.zh: 大中告诉他
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Da Zhong told him

cues.zh: 如果球囊破裂的严重后果
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 qiu2 nang2 po4 lie4 de5 yan2 zhong4 hou4 guo3
cues.en: the serious consequences if the balloons ruptured,

cues.zh: 但依旧没能挽留他
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi1 jiu4 mei2 neng2 wan3 liu2 ta1
cues.en: but still couldn't get him to stay.

cues.zh: 最后是布朗单独和他谈话
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 shi4 bu4 lang3 dan1 du2 he2 ta1 tan2 hua4
cues.en: In the end, Brown talked to him alone,

cues.zh: 用自己的小时候并不美好的童年
cues.pinyin: yong4 zi4 ji3 de5 xiao3 shi2 hou4 bing4 bu4 mei3 hao3 de5 tong2 nian2
cues.en: using his own unhappy childhood

cues.zh: 获取他的同情心
cues.pinyin: huo4 qu3 ta1 de5 tong2 qing2 xin1
cues.en: to win his sympathy,

cues.zh: 并保证一定会找到
cues.pinyin: bing4 bao3 zheng4 yi2 ding4 hui4 zhao3 dao4
cues.en: and promised he would definitely find

cues.zh: 让他不坐牢而离开这里的办法
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 bu4 zuo4 lao2 er2 li2 kai1 zhe4 li3 de5 ban4 fa3
cues.en: a way for him to leave without going to jail.

cues.zh: 小白选择相信他
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 xuan3 ze2 xiang1 xin4 ta1
cues.en: Xiaobai chose to trust him.

cues.zh: 布朗的做法让大中觉得有些荒唐
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 de5 zuo4 fa3 rang4 da4 zhong1 jue2 de5 you3 xie1 huang1 tang2
cues.en: Brown's approach struck Da Zhong as somewhat absurd.

cues.zh: 布朗同情穷途没落的小白
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 tong2 qing2 qiong2 tu2 mo4 luo4 de5 xiao3 bai2
cues.en: Brown sympathized with down-and-out Xiaobai,

cues.zh: 但大众更加理性
cues.pinyin: dan4 da4 zhong4 geng4 jia1 li3 xing4
cues.en: but Da Zhong was more rational,

cues.zh: 何况他从前就是一个警察
cues.pinyin: he2 kuang4 ta1 cong2 qian2 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 jing3 cha2
cues.en: especially since he used to be a police officer himself.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 布朗是第一个让他感觉自己被重视的人
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 shi4 di4 yi2 ge4 rang4 ta1 gan3 jue2 zi4 ji3 bei4 zhong4 shi4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Brown was the first person who made him feel valued.

cues.zh: 可是没想到还是出意外了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 mei2 xiang3 dao4 hai2 shi4 chu1 yi4 wai4 le5
cues.en: But unexpectedly, something still went wrong.

cues.zh: 他们下班后的时间
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xia4 ban1 hou4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: During their off-duty hours,

cues.zh: 有员工看到有一个人装作发病
cues.pinyin: you3 yuan2 gong1 kan4 dao4 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 zhuang1 zuo4 fa1 bing4
cues.en: a staff member saw someone fake a medical episode,

cues.zh: 另一个人趁机打开了储藏室的门
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi2 ge4 ren2 chen4 ji1 da3 kai1 le5 chu3 cang2 shi4 de5 men2
cues.en: while another person seized the chance to open the storage room door

cues.zh: 拿走了要化验的球囊
cues.pinyin: na2 zou3 le5 yao4 hua4 yan4 de5 qiu2 nang2
cues.en: and take the balloons that were to be tested.

cues.zh: 可能是小白干的
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 xiao3 bai2 gan4 de5
cues.en: It might have been Xiaobai who did it.

cues.zh: 此时警察已经来到医院了
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 jing3 cha2 yi3 jing1 lai2 dao4 yi1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: By now the police had already arrived at the hospital

cues.zh: 正在查监控
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 cha2 jian1 kong4
cues.en: and were checking the surveillance footage.

cues.zh: 但小白已经出院了
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 bai2 yi3 jing1 chu1 yuan4 le5
cues.en: But Xiaobai had already been discharged,

cues.zh: 而且留下的名字是假的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 liu2 xia4 de5 ming2 zi4 shi4 jia3 de5
cues.en: and the name he'd left behind was fake.

cues.zh: 警察注定查不出什么
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 zhu4 ding4 cha2 bu4 chu1 shen2 me5
cues.en: The police were bound to find nothing.

cues.zh: 布朗感觉自己被欺骗了
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 gan3 jue2 zi4 ji3 bei4 qi1 pian4 le5
cues.en: Brown felt he'd been deceived.

cues.zh: 小白就是个卑鄙的毒贩
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bai2 jiu4 shi4 ge4 bei1 bi3 de5 du2 fan4
cues.en: Xiaobai was just a vile drug dealer

cues.zh: 利用他的同情心转移毒品
cues.pinyin: li4 yong4 ta1 de5 tong2 qing2 xin1 zhuan3 yi2 du2 pin3
cues.en: who used his sympathy to smuggle out the drugs.

cues.zh: 他一个人站在连郎上吹风
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ge4 ren2 zhan4 zai4 lian2 lang2 shang4 chui1 feng1
cues.en: He stood alone in the hallway, letting the wind blow on him.

cues.zh: 没一声走过来告诉他
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 zou3 guo4 lai2 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: Da Zhong walked over and said to him,

cues.zh: 如果你是个好人
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 shi4 ge4 hao3 ren2
cues.en: "If you're a good person,

cues.zh: 偶然会觉得自己像个傻瓜
cues.pinyin: ou3 ran2 hui4 jue2 de5 zi4 ji3 xiang4 ge4 sha3 gua1
cues.en: you'll sometimes feel like a fool.

cues.zh: 今天你错了
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ni3 cuo4 le5
cues.en: You were wrong today,

cues.zh: 但我仍感激能和你共事
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 reng2 gan3 ji1 neng2 he2 ni3 gong4 shi4
cues.en: but I'm still grateful to have worked with you."

cues.zh: 这些许安慰到布朗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 xu3 an1 wei4 dao4 bu4 lang3
cues.en: These words gave Brown a little comfort.

cues.zh: 我们回到香安那边
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui2 dao4 xiang1 an1 na4 bian1
cues.en: Let's go back to Shawn's side.

cues.zh: 我们回到肖恩那边
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui2 dao4 xiao4 en1 na4 bian1
cues.en: To comfort Shawn, Liya

cues.zh: 在她房间里睡了一晚
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 fang2 jian1 li3 shui4 le5 yi1 wan3
cues.en: spent a night in her room.

cues.zh: 早上起来后对肖恩说
cues.pinyin: zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 hou4 dui4 xiao4 en1 shuo1
cues.en: The next morning, after waking up, she said to Shawn,

cues.zh: 不要把这些事情告诉别人
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 ba3 zhe4 xie1 shi4 qing2 gao4 su4 bie2 ren2
cues.en: "Don't tell anyone about this."

cues.zh: 肖恩当时答应的很痛快
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 dang1 shi2 da1 ying4 de5 hen3 tong4 kuai4
cues.en: Shawn agreed readily at the time.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 定一根钢针穿过水管
cues.pinyin: ding4 yi1 gen1 gang1 zhen1 chuan1 guo4 shui3 guan3
cues.en: They'd drive a steel pin through the marrow canal

cues.zh: 钉一根钢针穿过骨髓腔
cues.pinyin: ding1 yi1 gen1 gang1 zhen1 chuan1 guo4 gu3 sui3 qiang1
cues.en: to join the two ends of the fracture together.

cues.zh: 小美好像有些害怕手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 hao3 xiang4 you3 xie1 hai4 pa4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Xiaomei seemed somewhat afraid of the surgery.

cues.zh: 难道打个石膏还不够吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 da3 ge4 shi2 gao1 hai2 bu4 gou4 ma5
cues.en: "Isn't putting on a cast enough?"

cues.zh: 黄姐安慰她
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 an1 wei4 ta1
cues.en: Sister Huang comforted her —

cues.zh: 手术过程她会睡一觉
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 ta1 hui4 shui4 yi1 jiao4
cues.en: during the surgery she'd be asleep

cues.zh: 感觉不到痛苦
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 bu2 dao4 tong4 ku3
cues.en: and wouldn't feel any pain.

cues.zh: 小美又难为的开口
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 you4 nan2 wei2 de5 kai1 kou3
cues.en: Xiaomei spoke up again, embarrassed:

cues.zh: 其实我撒谎了
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 wo3 sa1 huang3 le5
cues.en: "Actually, I lied."

cues.zh: 原来小美是一个类鸦片瘾君子
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 xiao3 mei3 shi4 yi2 ge4 lei4 ya1 pian4 yin3 jun1 zi3
cues.en: It turned out Xiaomei was a former opioid addict,

cues.zh: 而小帅并不知道
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 shuai4 bing4 bu4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: something Xiaoshuai didn't know.

cues.zh: 她虽然已经戒掉十年了
cues.pinyin: ta1 sui1 ran2 yi3 jing1 jie4 diao4 shi2 nian2 le5
cues.en: Although she'd been clean for ten years,

cues.zh: 但只要一剂
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhi3 yao4 yi1 ji4
cues.en: just a single dose

cues.zh: 就能可以让她重新上瘾
cues.pinyin: jiu4 neng2 ke3 yi3 rang4 ta1 chong2 xin1 shang4 yin3
cues.en: could make her addicted all over again.

cues.zh: 所以她不能用止疼药和麻醉剂
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bu4 neng2 yong4 zhi3 teng2 yao4 he2 ma2 zui4 ji4
cues.en: So she couldn't be given painkillers or anesthetics.

cues.zh: 小美请求医生
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 qing3 qiu2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiaomei asked the doctors

cues.zh: 尽他们所能治好自己的腿
cues.pinyin: jin3 ta1 men5 suo3 neng2 zhi4 hao3 zi4 ji3 de5 tui3
cues.en: to do everything they could to fix her leg,

cues.zh: 但不要使用任何麻醉剂
cues.pinyin: dan4 bu2 yao4 shi3 yong4 ren4 he2 ma2 zui4 ji4
cues.en: but not to use any anesthesia at all.

cues.zh: 这个问题让医生们很难办
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 rang4 yi1 sheng1 men5 hen3 nan2 ban4
cues.en: This put the doctors in a tough spot.

cues.zh: 就连黑哥也十分烦恼
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 hei1 ge1 ye3 shi2 fen1 fan2 nao3
cues.en: Even Brother Hei was quite troubled.

cues.zh: 和他们讨论看能不能有什么可以用的
cues.pinyin: he2 ta1 men5 tao3 lun4 kan4 neng2 bu4 neng2 you3 shen2 me5 ke3 yi3 yong4 de5
cues.en: He discussed with them whether there was anything usable —

cues.zh: 阵痛麻醉药剂
cues.pinyin: zhen4 tong4 ma2 zui4 yao4 ji4
cues.en: a pain-relief anesthetic.

cues.zh: 然而一个又一个提案被否决
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 yi2 ge4 you4 yi2 ge4 ti2 an4 bei4 fou3 jue2
cues.en: But proposal after proposal was rejected.

cues.zh: 最后黑哥决定给小美换一个手术方案
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 hei1 ge1 jue2 ding4 gei3 xiao3 mei3 huan4 yi2 ge4 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: Finally Brother Hei decided to switch Xiaomei to a different surgical plan:

cues.zh: 用别的方法把她的腿接上
cues.pinyin: yong4 bie2 de5 fang1 fa3 ba3 ta1 de5 tui3 jie1 shang4
cues.en: fixing her leg by other means.

cues.zh: 比如外部固定
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 wai4 bu4 gu4 ding4
cues.en: For instance, external fixation.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 他们计划在小美腿部用钢钉固定金属框架
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ji4 hua4 zai4 xiao3 mei3 tui3 bu4 yong4 gang1 ding1 gu4 ding4 jin1 shu3 kuang1 jia4
cues.en: They planned to attach a metal frame to Xiaomei's leg with steel pins,

cues.zh: 这样能固定骨折
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 neng2 gu4 ding4 gu3 zhe2
cues.en: which could stabilize the fracture

cues.zh: 而且不用阵痛性麻醉
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 yong4 zhen4 tong4 xing4 ma2 zui4
cues.en: without needing pain-blocking anesthesia.

cues.zh: 但是这样后果可能会导致发炎
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 hou4 guo3 ke3 neng2 hui4 dao3 zhi4 fa1 yan2
cues.en: But this could risk causing inflammation,

cues.zh: 但是痛苦会小很多
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 tong4 ku3 hui4 xiao3 hen3 duo1
cues.en: though the pain would be much less.

cues.zh: 黄姐和肖恩把手术方案告诉了小美夫妻
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 he2 xiao4 en1 ba3 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 gao4 su4 le5 xiao3 mei3 fu1 qi1
cues.en: Sister Huang and Shawn explained the surgical plan to Xiaomei and her husband,

cues.zh: 并没有提到过她的吸毒史
cues.pinyin: bing4 mei2 you3 ti2 dao4 guo4 ta1 de5 xi1 du2 shi3
cues.en: without ever mentioning her history of drug use.

cues.zh: 小帅尽管很担心
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 jin3 guan3 hen3 dan1 xin1
cues.en: Although Xiaoshuai was very worried,

cues.zh: 但是也没有其他办法
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ye3 mei2 you3 qi2 ta1 ban4 fa3
cues.en: there was no other option,

cues.zh: 他们同意了
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: so they agreed.

cues.zh: 手术开始了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: The surgery began.

cues.zh: 医生在小美腿上打入钢钉
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 zai4 xiao3 mei3 tui3 shang4 da3 ru4 gang1 ding1
cues.en: The doctor drove steel pins into Xiaomei's leg.

cues.zh: 整个过程十分痛苦
cues.pinyin: zheng3 ge4 guo4 cheng2 shi2 fen1 tong4 ku3
cues.en: The whole process was extremely painful.

cues.zh: 小美疼得大寒淋漓
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 teng2 de2 da4 han2 lin2 li2
cues.en: Xiaomei was drenched in sweat from the pain.

cues.zh: 期间她的血压一度增高
cues.pinyin: qi1 jian1 ta1 de5 xue4 ya1 yi2 du4 zeng1 gao1
cues.en: During it, her blood pressure spiked at one point,

cues.zh: 医生只能在她静脉推注
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 zhi3 neng2 zai4 ta1 jing4 mai4 tui1 zhu4
cues.en: so the doctor could only give her an IV push of

cues.zh: b eta 受体阻断药
cues.pinyin: b eta shou4 ti3 zu3 duan4 yao4
cues.en: beta-blocker medication.

cues.zh: 终于最后一个钢钉固定好
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 gang1 ding1 gu4 ding4 hao3
cues.en: Finally the last steel pin was secured,

cues.zh: 手术结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: and the surgery was over.

cues.zh: 晚上黑哥看萧恩守夜班
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 hei1 ge1 kan4 xiao1 en1 shou3 ye4 ban1
cues.en: That night, Brother Hei saw Shawn on the night shift

cues.zh: 祝福她好好休息
cues.pinyin: zhu4 fu2 ta1 hao3 hao3 xiu1 xi1
cues.en: and wished her a good rest —

cues.zh: 黄姐会守着小美的情况
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 hui4 shou3 zhe5 xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Sister Huang would keep watch over Xiaomei's condition.

cues.zh: 萧恩已经忙了一个星期了
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 yi3 jing1 mang2 le5 yi2 ge4 xing1 qi1 le5
cues.en: Shawn had already been working nonstop for a week,

cues.zh: 但是萧恩拒绝了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao1 en1 ju4 jue2 le5
cues.en: but Shawn refused.

cues.zh: 她问黑哥
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen4 hei1 ge1
cues.en: She asked Brother Hei

cues.zh: 怎么才能确定你的妻子
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 cai2 neng2 que4 ding4 ni3 de5 qi1 zi3
cues.en: how he could be sure your wife

cues.zh: 就是那个队的人
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 na4 ge5 dui4 de5 ren2
cues.en: was one of that team's people.

cues.zh: 黑哥回答
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 hui2 da2
cues.en: Brother Hei answered,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良恩】美女为了不让男友知道自己有毒瘾，坚持不肯打麻醉剂，结果险些丧命

cues.zh: 然后用内部钢钉替换外部支架
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 nei4 bu4 gang1 ding1 ti4 huan4 wai4 bu4 zhi1 jia4
cues.en: then they'd replace the external fixator with internal pins.

cues.zh: 如果现在不及时处理
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 xian4 zai4 bu4 ji2 shi2 chu3 li3
cues.en: If it's not dealt with promptly now,

cues.zh: 她可能会面临节肢的危险
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 neng2 hui4 mian4 lin2 jie2 zhi1 de5 wei1 xian3
cues.en: she might face the risk of amputation,

cues.zh: 因为之前手术过程中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhi1 qian2 shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: because during the earlier surgery,

cues.zh: 小美有过血压上升的情况
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 you3 guo4 xue4 ya1 shang4 sheng1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Xiaomei had already had an episode of rising blood pressure.

cues.zh: 不打麻醉的话
cues.pinyin: bu4 da3 ma2 zui4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Without anesthesia,

cues.zh: 她可能出现高压危险
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 neng2 chu1 xian4 gao1 ya1 wei1 xian3
cues.en: she could face a hypertensive crisis,

cues.zh: 有中风或者心脏病发作的危险
cues.pinyin: you3 zhong4 feng1 huo4 zhe3 xin1 zang4 bing4 fa1 zuo4 de5 wei1 xian3
cues.en: with risk of stroke or heart attack.

cues.zh: 术后他们可以帮小美控制剂量
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 bang1 xiao3 mei3 kong4 zhi4 ji4 liang4
cues.en: After surgery they can help Xiaomei control her dosage,

cues.zh: 如果毒瘾复发
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 du2 yin3 fu4 fa1
cues.en: and if the addiction relapses,

cues.zh: 还会有顾问帮忙
cues.pinyin: hai2 hui4 you3 gu4 wen4 bang1 mang2
cues.en: there will be counselors to help too.

cues.zh: 但是小美依旧拒绝
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 yi1 jiu4 ju4 jue2
cues.en: But Xiaomei still refused.

cues.zh: 她不想再体会一次毒瘾的痛苦了
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang3 zai4 ti3 hui4 yi1 ci4 du2 yin3 de5 tong4 ku3 le5
cues.en: She didn't want to go through the agony of addiction again —

cues.zh: 那是生理和心理的双重压力
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 sheng1 li3 he2 xin1 li3 de5 shuang1 chong2 ya1 li4
cues.en: that dual physical and psychological pressure.

cues.zh: 三人几次劝说无故
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 ji3 ci4 quan4 shuo1 wu2 gu4
cues.en: The three of them tried persuading her several times, without success.

cues.zh: 在办公室商量对策
cues.pinyin: zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 shang1 liang2 dui4 ce4
cues.en: They discussed what to do in the office.

cues.zh: 黄姐提议告诉小帅
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 ti2 yi4 gao4 su4 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: Sister Huang proposed telling Xiaoshuai,

cues.zh: 让作为丈夫来劝小美
cues.pinyin: rang4 zuo4 wei2 zhang4 fu1 lai2 quan4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: so that, as her husband, he could persuade Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 但是医护案间有保密协议
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 hu4 an4 jian1 you3 bao3 mi4 xie2 yi4
cues.en: But there's a confidentiality agreement among medical staff,

cues.zh: 这样做显然是违规的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zuo4 xian3 ran2 shi4 wei2 gui1 de5
cues.en: so doing so would clearly be a violation.

cues.zh: 不过虽然不能直接向小帅说明情况
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 sui1 ran2 bu4 neng2 zhi2 jie1 xiang4 xiao3 shuai4 shuo1 ming2 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Still, although they couldn't directly explain the situation to Xiaoshuai,

cues.zh: 但是可以采用迂回方案
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ke3 yi3 cai3 yong4 yu1 hui2 fang1 an4
cues.en: they could take a roundabout approach.

cues.zh: 黑哥找到小帅
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: Brother Hei found Xiaoshuai

cues.zh: 告诉小美出现了一些并发症
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 xiao3 mei3 chu1 xian4 le5 yi1 xie1 bing4 fa1 zheng4
cues.en: and told him Xiaomei had developed some complications

cues.zh: 需要再一次手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 zai4 yi2 ci4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and needed another surgery.

cues.zh: 小帅问
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 wen4
cues.en: Xiaoshuai asked,

cues.zh: 做什么手术
cues.pinyin: zuo4 shen2 me5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: "What kind of surgery?"

cues.zh: 黑哥十分淡定的说
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 shi2 fen1 dan4 ding4 de5 shuo1
cues.en: Brother Hei said, very calmly—

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话42｜梗图笑话｜老样子｜厚脸皮含羞草｜缩小腹｜喝尿解毒｜没有大脑｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明在学校每次上完厕所都有洗手
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 zai4 xue2 xiao4 mei3 ci4 shang4 wan2 ce4 suo3 dou1 you3 xi3 shou3
cues.en: Every time Xiao Ming used the bathroom at school, he washed his hands.

cues.zh: 老师觉得很棒
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jue2 de5 hen3 bang4
cues.en: The teacher thought this was great.

cues.zh: 明天要在全班表扬一下
cues.pinyin: ming2 tian1 yao4 zai4 quan2 ban1 biao3 yang2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: She planned to praise him in front of the whole class tomorrow.

cues.zh: 可是到了明天小明上完厕所却没有洗手
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dao4 le5 ming2 tian1 xiao3 ming2 shang4 wan2 ce4 suo3 que4 mei2 you3 xi3 shou3
cues.en: But the next day, after using the bathroom, Xiao Ming didn't wash his hands.

cues.zh: 老师觉得很奇怪
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jue2 de5 hen3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: The teacher thought this was strange.

cues.zh: 就问小明小明你今天上完厕所为
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wen4 xiao3 ming2 xiao3 ming2 ni3 jin1 tian1 shang4 wan2 ce4 suo3 wei4
cues.en: So she asked, "Xiao Ming, why didn't you wash your hands

cues.zh: 什么没洗手呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 mei2 xi3 shou3 ne5
cues.en: after using the bathroom today?"

cues.zh: 老师今天我有带卫生纸啊
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 jin1 tian1 wo3 you3 dai4 wei4 sheng1 zhi3 a5
cues.en: "Teacher, I brought tissue paper today!"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话42｜梗图笑话｜老样子｜厚脸皮含羞草｜缩小腹｜喝尿解毒｜没有大脑｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明洗完澡
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 xi3 wan2 zao3
cues.en: After Xiao Ming finished showering,

cues.zh: 踏上体重计
cues.pinyin: ta4 shang4 ti3 zhong4 ji4
cues.en: he stepped on the scale.

cues.zh: 还用力的缩起小腹
cues.pinyin: hai2 yong4 li4 de5 suo1 qi3 xiao3 fu4
cues.en: and forcefully sucked in his belly.

cues.zh: 一旁的老婆说
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 de5 lao3 po2 shuo1
cues.en: His wife standing nearby said,

cues.zh: 你以为你缩了小腹
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi3 wei2 ni3 suo1 le5 xiao3 fu4
cues.en: "You think sucking in your belly

cues.zh: 体重就会变轻吗
cues.pinyin: ti3 zhong4 jiu4 hui4 bian4 qing1 ma5
cues.en: will make your weight lighter?"

cues.zh: 我当然知道这样做不会变轻了
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 ran2 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 bu2 hui4 bian4 qing1 le5
cues.en: "Of course I know that won't make it lighter."

cues.zh: 那你为什么还要缩小腹呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 yao4 suo1 xiao3 fu4 ne5
cues.en: "Then why do you keep sucking it in?"

cues.zh: 因为如果不缩小腹
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ru2 guo3 bu4 suo1 xiao3 fu4
cues.en: "Because if I don't suck in my belly,

cues.zh: 我就看不到萤幕上显示多少公斤了
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 kan4 bu2 dao4 ying2 mu4 shang4 xian3 shi4 duo1 shao3 gong1 jin1 le5
cues.en: I can't see how many kilograms show on the screen!"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话42｜梗图笑话｜老样子｜厚脸皮含羞草｜缩小腹｜喝尿解毒｜没有大脑｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明去花店买花
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 qu4 hua1 dian4 mai3 hua1
cues.en: Xiao Ming went to a flower shop to buy flowers.

cues.zh: 他看到一盆含羞草
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 yi1 pen2 han2 xiu1 cao3
cues.en: He saw a pot of a mimosa (sensitive plant).

cues.zh: 用手碰了它
cues.pinyin: yong4 shou3 peng4 le5 ta1
cues.en: He touched it with his hand.

cues.zh: 发现它竟然不动
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 jing4 ran2 bu4 dong4
cues.en: He found it didn't move at all.

cues.zh: 就问老板
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wen4 lao3 ban3
cues.en: So he asked the owner,

cues.zh: 老板
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3
cues.en: "Sir,

cues.zh: 为什么这颗含羞草没有反应呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 ke1 han2 xiu1 cao3 mei2 you3 fan3 ying4 ne5
cues.en: why doesn't this mimosa react?"

cues.zh: 可能是这一颗脸皮比较厚吧
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 zhe4 yi1 ke1 lian3 pi2 bi3 jiao4 hou4 ba5
cues.en: "Maybe this one's just thick-skinned."

cues.zh: 小美你能看得到神吗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ni3 neng2 kan4 de2 dao4 shen2 ma5
cues.en: "Xiao Mei, can you see God?"

cues.zh: 不能耶
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 ye2
cues.en: "No, I can't."

cues.zh: 那你能摸得到神吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 neng2 mo1 de2 dao4 shen2 ma5
cues.en: "Then can you touch God?"

cues.zh: 也不能耶
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 neng2 ye2
cues.en: "No, I can't do that either."

cues.zh: 那就说明世界上并没有神啊
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shuo1 ming2 shi4 jie4 shang4 bing4 mei2 you3 shen2 a5
cues.en: "That proves there's no God in this world."

cues.zh: 哦那你能看得到你的大脑吗
cues.pinyin: o2 na4 ni3 neng2 kan4 de2 dao4 ni3 de5 da4 nao3 ma5
cues.en: "Oh, then can you see your own brain?"

cues.zh: 呃不行啊
cues.pinyin: e4 bu4 xing2 a5
cues.en: "Uh, no, I can't."

cues.zh: 那你能摸得到你的大脑吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 neng2 mo1 de2 dao4 ni3 de5 da4 nao3 ma5
cues.en: "Then can you touch your own brain?"

cues.zh: 也不行啊
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xing2 a5
cues.en: "No, I can't do that either."

cues.zh: 哦那就证明你没大脑
cues.pinyin: o2 na4 jiu4 zheng4 ming2 ni3 mei2 da4 nao3
cues.en: "Oh, then that proves you have no brain."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话42｜梗图笑话｜老样子｜厚脸皮含羞草｜缩小腹｜喝尿解毒｜没有大脑｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小美在山上摘了一些野生香菇回家
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 zai4 shan1 shang4 zhai1 le5 yi1 xie1 ye3 sheng1 xiang1 gu1 hui2 jia1
cues.en: Xiao Mei picked some wild mushrooms in the mountains and took them home,

cues.zh: 和朋友一块吃
cues.pinyin: he2 peng2 you3 yi1 kuai4 chi1
cues.en: to eat with her friends.

cues.zh: 但又怕香菇有毒
cues.pinyin: dan4 you4 pa4 xiang1 gu1 you3 du2
cues.en: But she was afraid the mushrooms might be poisonous.

cues.zh: 于是先煮了一些拿给狗吃看看
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 xian1 zhu3 le5 yi1 xie1 na2 gei3 gou3 chi1 kan4 kan4
cues.en: So she cooked some first and fed it to the dog to test it.

cues.zh: 发现狗没死
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 gou3 mei2 si3
cues.en: Seeing that the dog didn't die,

cues.zh: 到就放心把野生香菇都吃光了
cues.pinyin: dao4 jiu4 fang4 xin1 ba3 ye3 sheng1 xiang1 gu1 dou1 chi1 guang1 le5
cues.en: everyone felt reassured and ate all the wild mushrooms.

cues.zh: 突然儿子从外面跑进来大喊
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 er2 zi5 cong2 wai4 mian4 pao3 jin4 lai2 da4 han3
cues.en: Suddenly the son ran in from outside shouting,

cues.zh: 爸爸狗狗死掉了
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 gou3 gou3 si3 diao4 le5
cues.en: "Dad, the dog died!"

cues.zh: 大家惊慌失措
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 jing1 huang1 shi1 cuo4
cues.en: Everyone panicked.

cues.zh: 其中一人突然想到尿能解毒
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi1 ren2 tu1 ran2 xiang3 dao4 niao4 neng2 jie3 du2
cues.en: Someone suddenly remembered that urine can detoxify poison.

cues.zh: 为了活命
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 huo2 ming4
cues.en: To save their lives,

cues.zh: 每个人立刻尿了一杯
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 ren2 li4 ke4 niao4 le5 yi1 bei1
cues.en: everyone immediately peed into a cup

cues.zh: 一饮而进
cues.pinyin: yi1 yin3 er2 jin4
cues.en: and drank it all down in one go.

cues.zh: 接下来小米问儿子
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 xiao3 mi3 wen4 er2 zi5
cues.en: Then Xiao Mei asked her son,

cues.zh: 是被一辆车子撞死的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bei4 yi1 liang4 che1 zi5 zhuang4 si3 de5
cues.en: "How did you see the dog die?"

cues.zh: 是被一辆车子钻死的
cues.pinyin: shi4 bei4 yi1 liang4 che1 zi5 zuan1 si3 de5
cues.en: "It got run over and killed by a car."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话42｜梗图笑话｜老样子｜厚脸皮含羞草｜缩小腹｜喝尿解毒｜没有大脑｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 妈妈我给你买扫地机器人吧
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 wo3 gei3 ni3 mai3 sao3 di4 ji1 qi4 ren2 ba5
cues.en: "Mom, let me buy you a robot vacuum."

cues.zh: 那你就不用扫地了
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 bu4 yong4 sao3 di4 le5
cues.en: "Then you won't have to sweep anymore."

cues.zh: 啊不要浪费钱啊
cues.pinyin: a5 bu2 yao4 lang4 fei4 qian2 a5
cues.en: "Oh, don't waste money."

cues.zh: 那我给你买洗碗机
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 gei3 ni3 mai3 xi3 wan3 ji1
cues.en: "Then I'll buy you a dishwasher."

cues.zh: 那这样子你就不用洗碗了
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 ni3 jiu4 bu4 yong4 xi3 wan3 le5
cues.en: "That way you won't have to wash dishes."

cues.zh: 啊买啦不要浪费钱啦
cues.pinyin: a5 mai3 la5 bu2 yao4 lang4 fei4 qian2 la5
cues.en: "Oh don't buy it, don't waste money."

cues.zh: 那你想要什么
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 xiang3 yao4 shen2 me5
cues.en: "Then what do you want?"

cues.zh: 啊什么都不要
cues.pinyin: a5 shen2 me5 dou1 bu2 yao4
cues.en: "Oh, I don't want anything."

cues.zh: 这些事你爸都能做啊
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shi4 ni3 ba4 dou1 neng2 zuo4 a5
cues.en: "Your dad can already do all these things anyway."

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 女孩儿街头举枪爆射警察
cues.pinyin: nv3 hai2 er2 jie1 tou2 ju3 qiang1 bao4 she4 jing3 cha2
cues.en: A girl raises a gun in the street and opens fire on police.

cues.zh: 转眼公园惊献探员俯视
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yan3 gong1 yuan2 jing1 xian4 tan4 yuan2 fu3 shi4
cues.en: Moments later, in a park, agents are found looking down at a shocking scene.

cues.zh: 这哪是杀人分明是疯批舔狗爱而不得
cues.pinyin: zhe4 na3 shi4 sha1 ren2 fen1 ming2 shi4 feng1 pi1 tian3 gou3 ai4 er2 bu4 de2
cues.en: This isn't just murder—it's clearly an obsessive simp lashing out over unrequited love.

cues.zh: 竟拿人命搞血色求案一事
cues.pinyin: jing4 na2 ren2 ming4 gao3 xue4 se4 qiu2 an4 yi1 shi4
cues.en: He actually turned it into a bloody pursuit of love, using human lives.

cues.zh: 而这一切还要从一起案件说起
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 yi1 qie4 hai2 yao4 cong2 yi4 qi3 an4 jian4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: And it all begins with a single case.

cues.zh: 杰克探员街头领核犯的消息刚传来
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 tan4 yuan2 jie1 tou2 ling3 he2 fan4 de5 xiao1 xi1 gang1 chuan2 lai2
cues.en: News had just come in that Agent Jack intercepted a suspect on the street.

cues.zh: 警队就瞬间杀到现场
cues.pinyin: jing3 dui4 jiu4 shun4 jian1 sha1 dao4 xian4 chang3
cues.en: The police squad rushed to the scene in an instant.

cues.zh: 警员老布差点登场倒吸凉气昔日的脑战油
cues.pinyin: jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 cha4 dian3 deng1 chang2 dao4 xi1 liang2 qi4 xi1 ri4 de5 nao3 zhan4 you2
cues.en: Officer Booth nearly gasped out loud the moment he arrived.

cues.zh: 死者脸糊得像被揉烂的草莓酱皮
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 lian3 hu2 de2 xiang4 bei4 rou2 lan4 de5 cao3 mei2 jiang4 pi2
cues.en: The victim's face was smashed into a mess, like crushed strawberry jam.

cues.zh: 死状相当惨烈
cues.pinyin: si3 zhuang4 xiang1 dang1 can3 lie4
cues.en: The state of the body was horrifically gruesome.

cues.zh: 估计警犬都忍不住呜咽两声
cues.pinyin: gu1 ji4 jing3 quan3 dou1 ren3 bu2 zhu4 wu1 ye4 liang3 sheng1
cues.en: Even the police dog probably couldn't help whimpering.

cues.zh: 而现场唯一的幸存证人叫艾丽
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 chang3 wei2 yi1 de5 xing4 cun2 zheng4 ren2 jiao4 ai4 li4
cues.en: The only witness at the scene was a woman named Ellie.

cues.zh: 在被凶手击倒后
cues.pinyin: zai4 bei4 xiong1 shou3 ji1 dao4 hou4
cues.en: After being knocked down by the killer,

cues.zh: 也刚从昏迷套餐里醒过的张嘴
cues.pinyin: ye3 gang1 cong2 hun1 mi2 tao4 can1 li3 xing3 guo4 de5 zhang1 zui3
cues.en: she had just regained consciousness and opened her mouth to speak,

cues.zh: 就是关键行器
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 guan1 jian4 xing2 qi4
cues.en: and what came out was the key clue.

cues.zh: 他曾看到凶手戴一顶滑雪帽
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 kan4 dao4 xiong1 shou3 dai4 yi1 ding3 hua2 xue3 mao4
cues.en: She recalled seeing the killer wearing a ski mask,

cues.zh: 胳膊上还纹着菜刀图案
cues.pinyin: ge1 bo2 shang4 hai2 wen2 zhe5 cai4 dao1 tu2 an4
cues.en: with a cleaver tattoo on his arm.

cues.zh: 但脑瓜子被敲得像粘了胶的她
cues.pinyin: dan4 nao3 gua1 zi5 bei4 qiao1 de2 xiang4 zhan1 le5 jiao1 de5 ta1
cues.en: But having been hit so hard her head felt glued shut,

cues.zh: 根本记不清凶手的样貌特征
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 ji4 bu4 qing1 xiong1 shou3 de5 yang4 mao4 te4 zheng1
cues.en: she couldn't clearly recall the killer's facial features.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 老布见状只好将自己的名片塞给她
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 jian4 zhuang4 zhi3 hao3 jiang1 zi4 ji3 de5 ming2 pian4 sai1 gei3 ta1
cues.en: Seeing this, Booth could only hand her his business card.

cues.zh: 谁知旁边探员跟淘宝似的
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 pang2 bian1 tan4 yuan2 gen1 tao2 bao3 shi4 de5
cues.en: Who knew the agent nearby, acting like he was shopping online,

cues.zh: 竟从垃圾桶里拎出顶滑雪帽
cues.pinyin: jing4 cong2 la1 ji1 tong3 li3 lin1 chu1 ding3 hua2 xue3 mao4
cues.en: actually pulled a ski mask out of a trash can.

cues.zh: 然而就在老布准备前去仔细观察时
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 jiu4 zai4 lao3 bu4 zhun3 bei4 qian2 qu4 zi3 xi4 guan1 cha2 shi2
cues.en: But just as Booth was about to go examine it closely,

cues.zh: 电门式的狂响
cues.pinyin: dian4 men2 shi4 de5 kuang2 xiang3
cues.en: his phone suddenly rang wildly.

cues.zh: 听筒里飘出阴森森的声音
cues.pinyin: ting1 tong3 li3 piao1 chu1 yin1 sen1 sen1 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: An eerie voice drifted out of the receiver.

cues.zh: 上来就自曝身份
cues.pinyin: shang4 lai2 jiu4 zi4 pu4 shen1 fen4
cues.en: It immediately revealed its own identity—

cues.zh: 又是前几集把警队耍成陀螺的连
cues.pinyin: you4 shi4 qian2 ji3 ji2 ba3 jing3 dui4 shua3 cheng2 tuo2 luo2 de5 lian2
cues.en: it was the same one who, in earlier episodes, spun the police around like a top—

cues.zh: 环杀手丹尼尔
cues.pinyin: huan2 sha1 shou3 dan1 ni2 er3
cues.en: the serial killer Daniel.

cues.zh: 这个更觉得是张嘴就爆出老顾的及时坐标
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 geng4 jue2 de5 shi4 zhang1 zui3 jiu4 bao4 chu1 lao3 gu4 de5 ji2 shi2 zuo4 biao1
cues.en: This guy bluntly blurted out Booth's real-time location the moment he opened his mouth.

cues.zh: 老顾蒙地抬头看监控当场误
cues.pinyin: lao3 gu4 meng2 di4 tai2 tou2 kan4 jian1 kong4 dang1 chang3 wu4
cues.en: Booth, stunned, looked up at the surveillance camera and froze on the spot.

cues.zh: 这货竟把全程摄像头黑成自家追剧弹幕
cues.pinyin: zhe4 huo4 jing4 ba3 quan2 cheng2 she4 xiang4 tou2 hei1 cheng2 zi4 jia1 zhui1 ju4 dan4 mu4
cues.en: This guy had actually hacked every camera into his own personal commentary feed,

cues.zh: 警队每步操作都被他当成真人秀围观
cues.pinyin: jing3 dui4 mei3 bu4 cao1 zuo4 dou1 bei4 ta1 dang4 cheng2 zhen1 ren2 xiu4 wei2 guan1
cues.en: watching the police's every move like it was a reality show.

cues.zh: 丹尼尔突然切换悲情频道
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 tu1 ran2 qie4 huan4 bei1 qing2 pin2 dao4
cues.en: Daniel suddenly switched to a tragic tone,

cues.zh: 跟念复仇宣言似的
cues.pinyin: gen1 nian4 fu4 chou2 xuan1 yan2 shi4 de5
cues.en: as if reciting a vow of revenge.

cues.zh: 原来之前老顾开枪肿伤他
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 zhi1 qian2 lao3 gu4 kai1 qiang1 zhong3 shang1 ta1
cues.en: It turned out Booth had shot and wounded him before.

cues.zh: 但丹尼尔非常守规矩
cues.pinyin: dan4 dan1 ni2 er3 fei1 chang2 shou3 gui1 ju3
cues.en: But Daniel claimed to stick strictly to his own rules—

cues.zh: 从未伤害过众人
cues.pinyin: cong2 wei4 shang1 hai4 guo4 zhong4 ren2
cues.en: he'd never harmed innocent people.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 肖谷则发现死者伤恶骨糊涂是白人标配
cues.pinyin: xiao4 gu3 ze2 fa1 xian4 si3 zhe3 shang1 e4 gu3 hu2 tu2 shi4 bai2 ren2 biao1 pei4
cues.en: Meanwhile, Brennan found that the victim's wounds and bone structure matched a typical Caucasian build.

cues.zh: 牙齿磨损度像 50 年的老电锯
cues.pinyin: ya2 chi3 mo2 sun3 du4 xiang4 50 nian2 de5 lao3 dian4 ju4
cues.en: The teeth were worn down like a 50-year-old chainsaw.

cues.zh: 沿上估计挨了好几发加特林套餐
cues.pinyin: yan2 shang4 gu1 ji4 ai1 le5 hao3 ji3 fa1 jia1 te4 lin2 tao4 can1
cues.en: Along the way, he'd apparently taken several rounds from a Gatling gun.

cues.zh: 根据野餐桌上的干涸血字推断
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 ye3 can1 zhuo1 shang4 de5 gan1 he2 xue4 zi4 tui1 duan4
cues.en: Based on the dried bloody writing on the picnic table, they deduced

cues.zh: 第一案发现场没跑了
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 an4 fa1 xian4 chang3 mei2 pao3 le5
cues.en: that this had to be the primary crime scene.

cues.zh: 凶手在这开枪
cues.pinyin: xiong1 shou3 zai4 zhe4 kai1 qiang1
cues.en: The killer opened fire here,

cues.zh: 死者像玩跑酷一样疯狂往林子里窜
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 xiang4 wan2 pao3 ku4 yi1 yang4 feng1 kuang2 wang3 lin2 zi5 li3 cuan4
cues.en: and the victim bolted into the woods like he was doing parkour.

cues.zh: 结果还是被追成一栋靶子
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 hai2 shi4 bei4 zhui1 cheng2 yi1 dong4 ba3 zi5
cues.en: In the end, he was still chased down and turned into a living target.

cues.zh: 尸骨被送回实验室后
cues.pinyin: shi1 gu3 bei4 song4 hui2 shi2 yan4 shi4 hou4
cues.en: After the remains were sent back to the lab,

cues.zh: 团队随即展开详细调查
cues.pinyin: tuan2 dui4 sui2 ji2 zhan3 kai1 xiang2 xi4 diao4 cha2
cues.en: the team immediately launched a detailed investigation.

cues.zh: 然而小谷却突然发现
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 xiao3 gu3 que4 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: But then Brennan suddenly discovered something.

cues.zh: 这死者怕不是跟凶手签了十年售后协议
cues.pinyin: zhe4 si3 zhe3 pa4 bu2 shi4 gen1 xiong1 shou3 qian1 le5 shi2 nian2 shou4 hou4 xie2 yi4
cues.en: It was as if the victim had signed a ten-year "aftercare" contract with the killer—

cues.zh: 十二处新鲜伤就算了
cues.pinyin: shi2 er4 chu4 xin1 xian1 shang1 jiu4 suan4 le5
cues.en: twelve fresh wounds were one thing,

cues.zh: 内骨凤梨竟还塞着十年前的老弹剑
cues.pinyin: nei4 gu3 feng4 li2 jing4 hai2 sai1 zhe5 shi2 nian2 qian2 de5 lao3 dan4 jian4
cues.en: but embedded in the bone was an old piece of shrapnel from ten years earlier.

cues.zh: 直至今检测凶器还是美国专利 9 毫米手枪
cues.pinyin: zhi2 zhi4 jin1 jian3 ce4 xiong1 qi4 hai2 shi4 mei3 guo2 zhuan1 li4 9 hao2 mi3 shou3 qiang1
cues.en: Ballistics confirmed the weapon was a US-patented 9mm pistol,

cues.zh: 职业杀手的从业资格证同款
cues.pinyin: zhi2 ye4 sha1 shou3 de5 cong2 ye4 zi1 ge2 zheng4 tong2 kuan3
cues.en: the kind favored by professional hitmen.

cues.zh: 昆虫学家小甜甜对此展开推理
cues.pinyin: kun1 chong2 xue2 jia1 xiao3 tian2 tian2 dui4 ci3 zhan3 kai1 tui1 li3
cues.en: Entomologist Caroline then began analyzing the case.

cues.zh: 怀疑死者蠢蠢是被钓鱼链接骗来案发现场
cues.pinyin: huai2 yi2 si3 zhe3 chun3 chun3 shi4 bei4 diao4 yu2 lian4 jie1 pian4 lai2 an4 fa1 xian4 chang3
cues.en: She suspected the victim had actually been lured to the scene by a phishing link,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 更觉得是凶手把尸体扔在新开的登山道上
cues.pinyin: geng4 jue2 de5 shi4 xiong1 shou3 ba3 shi1 ti3 reng1 zai4 xin1 kai1 de5 deng1 shan1 dao4 shang4
cues.en: and believed the killer had dumped the body on a newly opened hiking trail.

cues.zh: 这操作竟和小甜甜某篇压箱底的病态自
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cao1 zuo4 jing4 he2 xiao3 tian2 tian2 mou3 pian1 ya1 xiang1 di3 de5 bing4 tai4 zi4
cues.en: This method eerily matched a long-shelved paper of Caroline's own on pathological narcissism—

cues.zh: 恋研究神撞车
cues.pinyin: lian4 yan2 jiu1 shen2 zhuang4 che1
cues.en: an uncanny overlap with her research.

cues.zh: 那么问题来了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wen4 ti2 lai2 le5
cues.en: So here's the question:

cues.zh: 没发朋友圈的论文如何被凶手偷了电子版
cues.pinyin: mei2 fa1 peng2 you3 quan1 de5 lun4 wen2 ru2 he2 bei4 xiong1 shou3 tou1 le5 dian4 zi5 ban3
cues.en: how did the killer get an electronic copy of a paper she'd never even posted online?

cues.zh: 老布当场怀疑准是丹尼尔那货干的
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 dang1 chang3 huai2 yi2 zhun3 shi4 dan1 ni2 er3 na4 huo4 gan4 de5
cues.en: Booth immediately suspected it had to be Daniel's doing,

cues.zh: 毕竟这货之前黑进全程监控
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 zhe4 huo4 zhi1 qian2 hei1 jin4 quan2 cheng2 jian1 kong4
cues.en: since the guy had already hacked every camera in the area before.

cues.zh: 所以顺着小甜甜的论文草稿
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shun4 zhe5 xiao3 tian2 tian2 de5 lun4 wen2 cao3 gao3
cues.en: So, following the trail from Caroline's draft paper,

cues.zh: 像逛超市一样简单
cues.pinyin: xiang4 guang4 chao1 shi4 yi1 yang4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: stealing it would've been as easy as browsing a supermarket.

cues.zh: 再说他早一暗恋小谷跟实验室结下梁子
cues.pinyin: zai4 shuo1 ta1 zao3 yi1 an4 lian4 xiao3 gu3 gen1 shi2 yan4 shi4 jie2 xia4 liang2 zi5
cues.en: Besides, he'd long had a secret crush on Brennan and a grudge against the lab,

cues.zh: 如今用专业知识挑衅警方
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 yong4 zhuan1 ye4 zhi1 shi2 tiao3 xin4 jing3 fang1
cues.en: and now he was using professional know-how to taunt the police,

cues.zh: 活想在玩犯罪界米其林挑战赛
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang3 zai4 wan2 fan4 zui4 jie4 mi3 qi2 lin2 tiao3 zhan4 sai4
cues.en: like he was running some kind of "Michelin Guide" challenge for crime.

cues.zh: 然而更糟糕的是
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 geng4 zao1 gao1 de5 shi4
cues.en: But things got even worse.

cues.zh: 修复施安奇拉透露的消息
cues.pinyin: xiu1 fu4 shi1 an1 qi2 la1 tou4 lu4 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: News revealed by forensic artist Angela

cues.zh: 让众人集体倒吸凉气
cues.pinyin: rang4 zhong4 ren2 ji2 ti3 dao4 xi1 liang2 qi4
cues.en: left everyone gasping.

cues.zh: 死者竟是刚退休的联邦探员约翰
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 jing4 shi4 gang1 tui4 xiu1 de5 lian2 bang1 tan4 yuan2 yue1 han4
cues.en: The victim turned out to be John, a federal agent who'd just retired,

cues.zh: 还是老布的昔日搭档
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 lao3 bu4 de5 xi1 ri4 da1 dang4
cues.en: and none other than Booth's former partner.

cues.zh: 如今约翰却成了停尸台上的一副骸骨
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 yue1 han4 que4 cheng2 le5 ting2 shi1 tai2 shang4 de5 yi1 fu4 hai2 gu3
cues.en: Now John was just a skeleton lying on the morgue table.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 是十年前的狗咬老兵本
cues.pinyin: shi4 shi2 nian2 qian2 de5 gou3 yao3 lao3 bing1 ben3
cues.en: He was a veteran of that mission ten years ago—

cues.zh: 然而翻遍约翰的病历本
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 fan1 bian4 yue1 han4 de5 bing4 li4 ben3
cues.en: yet after going through all of John's medical records,

cues.zh: 别说狗咬记录
cues.pinyin: bie2 shuo1 gou3 yao3 ji4 lu4
cues.en: there wasn't even a record of a dog bite,

cues.zh: 竟连十年前中枪的事都被磨除
cues.pinyin: jing4 lian2 shi2 nian2 qian2 zhong1 qiang1 de5 shi4 dou1 bei4 mo2 chu2
cues.en: let alone any trace of the gunshot wound from ten years before—it had all been erased.

cues.zh: 老布却突然透露一条重要线索
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 que4 tu1 ran2 tou4 lu4 yi1 tiao2 zhong4 yao4 xian4 suo3
cues.en: But then Booth suddenly revealed a crucial clue:

cues.zh: 这是和十年前那场水晶吸行动有关
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 he2 shi2 nian2 qian2 na4 chang3 shui3 jing1 xi1 xing2 dong4 you3 guan1
cues.en: this was connected to a mission from ten years ago codenamed "Crystal."

cues.zh: 约翰杰克和老布
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 jie2 ke4 he2 lao3 bu4
cues.en: John, Jack, and Booth

cues.zh: 当时被基地的看门狗
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 bei4 ji1 di4 de5 kan1 men2 gou3
cues.en: had back then been attacked by guard dogs at a base

cues.zh: 坠成三条丧家犬
cues.pinyin: zhui4 cheng2 san1 tiao2 sang4 jia1 quan3
cues.en: and were reduced to three cornered, hunted men.

cues.zh: 每人腿上都留下狗牙勋章
cues.pinyin: mei3 ren2 tui3 shang4 dou1 liu2 xia4 gou3 ya2 xun1 zhang1
cues.en: Each of them bore dog-bite scars on their legs like badges.

cues.zh: 但这行动敏感到能炸穿臭氧层
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 xing2 dong4 min3 gan3 dao4 neng2 zha4 chuan1 chou4 yang3 ceng2
cues.en: But the mission was so sensitive it could've blasted through the ozone layer,

cues.zh: 所有医疗记录
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 yi1 liao2 ji4 lu4
cues.en: so all medical records

cues.zh: 早被官方绞成芝麻线
cues.pinyin: zao3 bei4 guan1 fang1 jiao3 cheng2 zhi1 ma2 xian4
cues.en: had long since been officially shredded to nothing.

cues.zh: 就在暗将卡成 PP D 时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 an4 jiang1 ka3 cheng2 PP D shi2
cues.en: Just as the case was stuck at a complete standstill,

cues.zh: 小甜甜突然甩出猛料
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 tu1 ran2 shuai3 chu1 meng3 liao4
cues.en: Caroline suddenly dropped a bombshell:

cues.zh: 认为丹尼尔压根没亲自动手
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 dan1 ni2 er3 ya1 gen1 mei2 qin1 zi4 dong4 shou3
cues.en: she believed Daniel hadn't acted alone at all.

cues.zh: 对照他写的论文
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhao4 ta1 xie3 de5 lun4 wen2
cues.en: Comparing it with the paper she'd written,

cues.zh: 小田田怀疑十年前水晶系行动力
cues.pinyin: xiao3 tian2 tian2 huai2 yi2 shi2 nian2 qian2 shui3 jing1 xi4 xing2 dong4 li4
cues.en: Caroline suspected that during the "Crystal" mission ten years ago,

cues.zh: 不少孩子目睹家人挂掉
cues.pinyin: bu4 shao3 hai2 zi5 mu4 du3 jia1 ren2 gua4 diao4
cues.en: many children had witnessed family members die,

cues.zh: 心理创伤跟马蜂窝似的
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 chuang1 shang1 gen1 ma3 feng1 wo1 shi4 de5
cues.en: leaving psychological trauma as tangled as a wasp's nest.

cues.zh: 丹尼尔极有可能利用洗脑战术
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 er3 ji2 you3 ke3 neng2 li4 yong4 xi3 nao3 zhan4 shu4
cues.en: Daniel had quite possibly used brainwashing tactics

cues.zh: 将他们寻成杀人手柄
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ta1 men5 xun2 cheng2 sha1 ren2 shou3 bing3
cues.en: to train them into tools for murder.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: IMDb:评分9.4，2025重温经典犯罪悬疑美剧，连环凶手黑进全网，制造混乱为所欲为。

cues.zh: 实验室里
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 li3
cues.en: Back in the lab,

cues.zh: 安琪拉突然找到豪金
cues.pinyin: an1 qi2 la1 tu1 ran2 zhao3 dao4 hao2 jin1
cues.en: Angela suddenly came to find Hodgins

cues.zh: 说出一条糟糕的消息
cues.pinyin: shuo1 chu1 yi1 tiao2 zao1 gao1 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: with some bad news.

cues.zh: 他突然发现犯罪现场的监控录像
cues.pinyin: ta1 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 fan4 zui4 xian4 chang3 de5 jian1 kong4 lu4 xiang4
cues.en: She'd discovered that the crime scene's surveillance footage

cues.zh: 竟删得比前男友的联系方式还干净
cues.pinyin: jing4 shan1 de2 bi3 qian2 nan2 you3 de5 lian2 xi4 fang1 shi4 hai2 gan1 jing4
cues.en: had been wiped cleaner than an ex-boyfriend's contact info.

cues.zh: 只见中央服务器里空空如也
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 zhong1 yang1 fu2 wu4 qi4 li3 kong1 kong1 ru2 ye3
cues.en: The central server was left completely empty.

cues.zh: 豪金瞬间开始自责
cues.pinyin: hao2 jin1 shun4 jian1 kai1 shi3 zi4 ze2
cues.en: Hodgins immediately began blaming himself,

cues.zh: 认为早知道当初该学灭霸打个响指
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 zao3 zhi1 dao4 dang1 chu1 gai1 xue2 mie4 ba4 da3 ge4 xiang3 zhi3
cues.en: thinking he should've just snapped his fingers like Thanos from the start

cues.zh: 直接把丹尼尔从地球上抹掉
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 ba3 dan1 ni2 er3 cong2 di4 qiu2 shang4 mo3 diao4
cues.en: and erased Daniel from the planet entirely.

cues.zh: 就不会有这么多人枉死
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bu2 hui4 you3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 wang3 si3
cues.en: Then so many people wouldn't have died for nothing.

cues.zh: 而现在对方彻底把城市变成楚门的世界
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 zai4 dui4 fang1 che4 di3 ba3 cheng2 shi4 bian4 cheng2 chu3 men2 de5 shi4 jie4
cues.en: And now Daniel had turned the whole city into his own version of "The Truman Show."

cues.zh: 好在豪金重振旗鼓
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 hao2 jin1 chong2 zhen4 qi2 gu3
cues.en: Luckily, Hodgins pulled himself back together

cues.zh: 对着政务带猛烹放大镜
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhe5 zheng4 wu4 dai4 meng3 peng1 fang4 da4 jing4
cues.en: and grabbed a magnifying glass to go over the evidence bag.

cues.zh: 竟在死者帽子上
cues.pinyin: jing4 zai4 si3 zhe3 mao4 zi5 shang4
cues.en: On the victim's hat,

cues.zh: 找到了北美鹅掌丘的花坟
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 le5 bei3 mei3 e2 zhang3 qiu1 de5 hua1 fen2
cues.en: he found pollen from the North American tulip tree.

cues.zh: 这玩意儿跟挑食傲娇鬼似的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wan2 yi4 er2 gen1 tiao1 shi2 ao4 jiao1 gui3 shi4 de5
cues.en: This plant is as picky as a fussy little diva—

cues.zh: 只在兰岭山外晃悠
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zai4 lan2 ling3 shan1 wai4 huang4 you1
cues.en: it only grows around the Blue Ridge Mountains.

cues.zh: 可那地方大得能装下三个纽约州
cues.pinyin: ke3 na4 di4 fang1 da4 de2 neng2 zhuang1 xia4 san1 ge4 niu3 yue1 zhou1
cues.en: But that area is big enough to fit three New York states inside it,

cues.zh: 想要找凶手和在太平洋里
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 zhao3 xiong1 shou3 he2 zai4 tai4 ping2 yang2 li3
cues.en: so trying to find the killer there was like

cues.zh: 露针没啥去别
cues.pinyin: lu4 zhen1 mei2 sha2 qu4 bie2
cues.en: no different from fishing for a needle in the ocean.

cues.zh: 众人顿时陷入失望中
cues.pinyin: zhong4 ren2 dun4 shi2 xian4 ru4 shi1 wang4 zhong1
cues.en: Everyone instantly sank into disappointment.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile...

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下
cues.pinyin: jin3 jin3 bei4 xian1 ren2 zhang3 zha1 le5 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Just one prick from a cactus

cues.zh: 竟然就面临生命危险
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 jiu4 mian4 lin2 sheng1 ming4 wei1 xian3
cues.en: nearly cost him his life.

cues.zh: 这个男人叫大壮今年 49 岁
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 nan2 ren2 jiao4 da4 zhuang4 jin1 nian2 49 sui4
cues.en: This man is named Dazhuang, 49 years old.

cues.zh: 四天前他的右上臂被仙人掌扎破
cues.pinyin: si4 tian1 qian2 ta1 de5 you4 shang4 bi4 bei4 xian1 ren2 zhang3 zha1 po4
cues.en: Four days ago, a cactus punctured his upper right arm.

cues.zh: 被送到医院时伤口严重感染
cues.pinyin: bei4 song4 dao4 yi1 yuan4 shi2 shang1 kou3 yan2 zhong4 gan3 ran3
cues.en: By the time he reached the hospital, the wound was severely infected.

cues.zh: 体温已经达到 39 1 了
cues.pinyin: ti3 wen1 yi3 jing1 da2 dao4 39 1 le5
cues.en: His temperature had already reached 39.1°C.

cues.zh: 之所以现在才来是因为大壮是一个野
cues.pinyin: zhi1 suo3 yi3 xian4 zai4 cai2 lai2 shi4 yin1 wei4 da4 zhuang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 ye3
cues.en: The reason he only came now is that Dazhuang is

cues.zh: 营旅行的领队
cues.pinyin: ying2 lv3 xing2 de5 ling3 dui4
cues.en: the leader of a wilderness camping trip.

cues.zh: 他不能把自己的队员留在山上
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 neng2 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 dui4 yuan2 liu2 zai4 shan1 shang4
cues.en: He couldn't leave his team members on the mountain,

cues.zh: 所以才一直耽误到现在
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 yi4 zhi2 dan1 wu4 dao4 xian4 zai4
cues.en: so he kept putting it off until now.

cues.zh: 血压 89 51 心动过速
cues.pinyin: xue4 ya1 89 51 xin1 dong4 guo4 su4
cues.en: Blood pressure 89/51, with tachycardia,

cues.zh: 呼吸急促且微弱是败血症的症状
cues.pinyin: hu1 xi1 ji2 cu4 qie3 wei1 ruo4 shi4 bai4 xue4 zheng4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: rapid, shallow breathing — symptoms of sepsis.

cues.zh: 医生必须立即给他的伤口
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 bi4 xu1 li4 ji2 gei3 ta1 de5 shang1 kou3
cues.en: The doctors had to immediately

cues.zh: 做清创
cues.pinyin: zuo4 qing1 chuang4
cues.en: debride his wound.

cues.zh: 但是处理过之后
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 chu3 li3 guo4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: But after the treatment,

cues.zh: 情况并没有好转
cues.pinyin: qing2 kuang4 bing4 mei2 you3 hao3 zhuan3
cues.en: his condition didn't improve.

cues.zh: 大壮的血压下降
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 xue4 ya1 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Dazhuang's blood pressure dropped,

cues.zh: 心脏有杂音
cues.pinyin: xin1 zang4 you3 za2 yin1
cues.en: his heart had a murmur,

cues.zh: 感染扩散了
cues.pinyin: gan3 ran3 kuo4 san4 le5
cues.en: the infection had spread,

cues.zh: 而且伤到了主动脉瓣
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shang1 dao4 le5 zhu3 dong4 mai4 ban4
cues.en: and it had damaged the aortic valve.

cues.zh: 大壮需要紧急手术
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 xu1 yao4 jin3 ji2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Dazhuang needed emergency surgery.

cues.zh: 感染形成了围管
cues.pinyin: gan3 ran3 xing2 cheng2 le5 wei2 guan3
cues.en: The infection had formed a pocket of pus.

cues.zh: 医生切除了大壮心脏上
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 qie1 chu2 le5 da4 zhuang4 xin1 zang4 shang4
cues.en: The doctors cut away

cues.zh: 环形缺损周围的坏死组织
cues.pinyin: huan2 xing2 que1 sun3 zhou1 wei2 de5 huai4 si3 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: the dead tissue around the ring-shaped defect on his heart,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 从心包上裁剪补片进行修复
cues.pinyin: cong2 xin1 bao1 shang4 cai2 jian3 bu3 pian4 jin4 xing2 xiu1 fu4
cues.en: and repaired it with a patch cut from the pericardium.

cues.zh: 这会形成永久的心脏损伤
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 yong3 jiu3 de5 xin1 zang4 sun3 shang1
cues.en: This would leave permanent heart damage,

cues.zh: 但也没有其他办法
cues.pinyin: dan4 ye3 mei2 you3 qi2 ta1 ban4 fa3
cues.en: but there was no other way.

cues.zh: 随同大壮一起来的
cues.pinyin: sui2 tong2 da4 zhuang4 yi4 qi3 lai2 de5
cues.en: Those who came with Dazhuang

cues.zh: 还有他们旅行团的队员
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ta1 men5 lv3 xing2 tuan2 de5 dui4 yuan2
cues.en: also included the members of their travel group.

cues.zh: 那些队员都是孩子
cues.pinyin: na4 xie1 dui4 yuan2 dou1 shi4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Those members were all children,

cues.zh: 也只是大壮在照顾
cues.pinyin: ye3 zhi3 shi4 da4 zhuang4 zai4 zhao4 gu4
cues.en: and Dazhuang alone had been looking after them.

cues.zh: 都十分叛逆
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi2 fen1 pan4 ni4
cues.en: They were all very rebellious

cues.zh: 而且有点反社会
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you3 dian3 fan3 she4 hui4
cues.en: and a bit antisocial.

cues.zh: 好几年都没见过父母了
cues.pinyin: hao3 ji3 nian2 dou1 mei2 jian4 guo4 fu4 mu3 le5
cues.en: They hadn't seen their parents in years

cues.zh: 现在无处可去
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wu2 chu3 ke3 qu4
cues.en: and now had nowhere to go,

cues.zh: 所以一直待在医院等他治疗
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi4 zhi2 dai4 zai4 yi1 yuan4 deng3 ta1 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: so they stayed at the hospital waiting for his treatment.

cues.zh: 可是等大壮手术醒来
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 deng3 da4 zhuang4 shou3 shu4 xing3 lai2
cues.en: But when Dazhuang woke up from surgery,

cues.zh: 却被告知
cues.pinyin: que4 bei4 gao4 zhi1
cues.en: he was told

cues.zh: 其中一个孩子小帅
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 hai2 zi5 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: that one of the kids, Xiao Shuai,

cues.zh: 用电子烟抽大麻
cues.pinyin: yong4 dian4 zi5 yan1 chou1 da4 ma2
cues.en: had been found in the hospital

cues.zh: 用电子盐抽打麻
cues.pinyin: yong4 dian4 zi5 yan2 chou1 da3 ma2
cues.en: vaping marijuana with an e-cigarette.

cues.zh: 幸好主任没有报警
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 zhu3 ren4 mei2 you3 bao4 jing3
cues.en: Luckily the director hadn't called the police,

cues.zh: 不然大壮现在就得去警察局
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 da4 zhuang4 xian4 zai4 jiu4 de2 qu4 jing3 cha2 ju2
cues.en: or Dazhuang would have had to go to the police station

cues.zh: 捞他了
cues.pinyin: lao1 ta1 le5
cues.en: to bail him out.

cues.zh: 大壮生气地让他道歉
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 sheng1 qi4 di4 rang4 ta1 dao4 qian4
cues.en: Dazhuang angrily made him apologize.

cues.zh: 可是这时
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just then,

cues.zh: 黄姐突然发现他的手肿了
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 tu1 ran2 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 shou3 zhong3 le5
cues.en: Sister Huang suddenly noticed his hand was swollen.

cues.zh: 不只是手
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi3 shi4 shou3
cues.en: Not just the hand —

cues.zh: 还有脚上也是
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiao3 shang4 ye3 shi4
cues.en: his feet were too.

cues.zh: 而且他的尿量明显减少
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 de5 niao4 liang4 ming2 xian3 jian3 shao3
cues.en: And his urine output had clearly dropped.

cues.zh: 经过检查发现
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 jian3 cha2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: After an examination, they found

cues.zh: 大壮的心脏损伤
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 de5 xin1 zang4 sun3 shang1
cues.en: that Dazhuang's heart damage

cues.zh: 暂时阻断了血液流向肾脏
cues.pinyin: zan4 shi2 zu3 duan4 le5 xue4 ye4 liu2 xiang4 shen4 zang4
cues.en: had temporarily cut off blood flow to the kidneys.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 要还找不到肾源
cues.pinyin: yao4 hai2 zhao3 bu2 dao4 shen4 yuan2
cues.en: If a kidney source still couldn't be found,

cues.zh: 就该准备后事了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gai1 zhun3 bei4 hou4 shi4 le5
cues.en: they'd need to prepare for the worst.

cues.zh: 没想到的是
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Unexpectedly,

cues.zh: 那群孩子们知道这件事后
cues.pinyin: na4 qun2 hai2 zi5 men5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 hou4
cues.en: once the group of kids learned of this,

cues.zh: 都去做了培行
cues.pinyin: dou1 qu4 zuo4 le5 pei2 xing2
cues.en: they all went to get tissue-matched,

cues.zh: 最终结果只有小帅的符合
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 jie2 guo3 zhi3 you3 xiao3 shuai4 de5 fu2 he2
cues.en: and in the end only Xiao Shuai's matched.

cues.zh: 所以他找到了照顾大壮的黄姐
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 zhao3 dao4 le5 zhao4 gu4 da4 zhuang4 de5 huang2 jie3
cues.en: So he went to find Sister Huang, who was caring for Dazhuang,

cues.zh: 想要把肾移植给大壮
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 ba3 shen4 yi2 zhi2 gei3 da4 zhuang4
cues.en: wanting to donate his kidney to Dazhuang.

cues.zh: 医生们经过商讨后拒绝了他
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jing1 guo4 shang1 tao3 hou4 ju4 jue2 le5 ta1
cues.en: After discussing it, the doctors refused him,

cues.zh: 因为小帅才 16 岁
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 shuai4 cai2 16 sui4
cues.en: because Xiao Shuai was only 16,

cues.zh: 活体捐赠者必须要满 18 周岁
cues.pinyin: huo2 ti3 juan1 zeng4 zhe3 bi4 xu1 yao4 man3 18 zhou1 sui4
cues.en: and living donors must be at least 18.

cues.zh: 尽管他没有监护人的束缚
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 ta1 mei2 you3 jian1 hu4 ren2 de5 shu4 fu4
cues.en: Even though he had no guardian to stop him,

cues.zh: 但是否要做手术
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 fou3 yao4 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: whether the surgery would happen

cues.zh: 还是要医院决定
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 yao4 yi1 yuan4 jue2 ding4
cues.en: was still the hospital's decision.

cues.zh: 医生告诉他
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 ta1
cues.en: The doctor told him

cues.zh: 如果没有大壮保他出狱
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 da4 zhuang4 bao3 ta1 chu1 yu4
cues.en: there would be many complications after a transplant.

cues.zh: 这很可怕
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hen3 ke3 pa4
cues.en: That was frightening —

cues.zh: 他未来的生活将会很艰难
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 lai2 de5 sheng1 huo2 jiang1 hui4 hen3 jian1 nan2
cues.en: his future life would be very hard.

cues.zh: 但小帅表示
cues.pinyin: dan4 xiao3 shuai4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But Xiao Shuai said

cues.zh: 如果没有大壮保持自己出狱
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 da4 zhuang4 bao3 chi2 zi4 ji3 chu1 yu4
cues.en: if Dazhuang hadn't bailed him out of jail

cues.zh: 没有他的照顾
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ta1 de5 zhao4 gu4
cues.en: and hadn't taken care of him,

cues.zh: 他就不会有今天的生活
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu2 hui4 you3 jin1 tian1 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: he wouldn't have the life he has today.

cues.zh: 也许现在还在先雨惶惶度日
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 xian4 zai4 hai2 zai4 xian1 yu3 huang2 huang2 du4 ri4
cues.en: He might still be living in fear and uncertainty.

cues.zh: 如果有一天
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 yi1 tian1
cues.en: "If one day

cues.zh: 我能勉强成为一个好父亲
cues.pinyin: wo3 neng2 mian3 qiang3 cheng2 wei2 yi2 ge4 hao3 fu4 qin1
cues.en: I can manage to become a good father,

cues.zh: 如果我没有坠入深渊
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 mei2 you3 zhui4 ru4 shen1 yuan1
cues.en: if I never fell into the abyss,

cues.zh: 那都是因为他从未放弃过我
cues.pinyin: na4 dou1 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 cong2 wei4 fang4 qi4 guo4 wo3
cues.en: it'll all be because he never gave up on me."

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 面对专业的医生
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 zhuan1 ye4 de5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Faced with the doctor's expertise,

cues.zh: 小帅根本没有反驳的余地
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 gen1 ben3 mei2 you3 fan3 bo2 de5 yu2 di4
cues.en: Xiao Shuai had no room to argue.

cues.zh: 他相信了
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang1 xin4 le5
cues.en: He believed it,

cues.zh: 却也很自责
cues.pinyin: que4 ye3 hen3 zi4 ze2
cues.en: but he also blamed himself deeply,

cues.zh: 自己什么也做不好
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 shen2 me5 ye3 zuo4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: feeling he couldn't do anything right.

cues.zh: 你尽了一切努力
cues.pinyin: ni3 jin3 le5 yi1 qie4 nu3 li4
cues.en: "You've tried everything you could.

cues.zh: 他为你骄傲
cues.pinyin: ta1 wei4 ni3 jiao1 ao4
cues.en: He's proud of you."

cues.zh: 尽管主任这么安慰
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 zhu3 ren4 zhe4 me5 an1 wei4
cues.en: Even with the director comforting him like that,

cues.zh: 小帅却还是忍不住痛苦哭泣
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 que4 hai2 shi4 ren3 bu2 zhu4 tong4 ku3 ku1 qi4
cues.en: Xiao Shuai still couldn't hold back his tears.

cues.zh: 晚上孩子们围在大壮床前
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 hai2 zi5 men5 wei2 zai4 da4 zhuang4 chuang2 qian2
cues.en: That night, the kids gathered around Dazhuang's bed.

cues.zh: 大壮在教他们怎么辨认星星
cues.pinyin: da4 zhuang4 zai4 jiao4 ta1 men5 zen3 me5 bian4 ren4 xing1 xing1
cues.en: Dazhuang was teaching them how to find the stars.

cues.zh: 北极星在正北方
cues.pinyin: bei3 ji2 xing1 zai4 zheng4 bei3 fang1
cues.en: "The North Star sits due north.

cues.zh: 您一直看着她
cues.pinyin: nin2 yi4 zhi2 kan4 zhe5 ta1
cues.en: Keep watching it,

cues.zh: 不管陷入什么困境都能找到出路
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 xian4 ru4 shen2 me5 kun4 jing4 dou1 neng2 zhao3 dao4 chu1 lu4
cues.en: and no matter what trouble you're in, you'll find your way out."

cues.zh: 这也许是她能为这群孩子做的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 xu3 shi4 ta1 neng2 wei4 zhe4 qun2 hai2 zi5 zuo4 de5
cues.en: This might be the last thing

cues.zh: 最后一件事了
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 yi1 jian4 shi4 le5
cues.en: he could do for these kids.

cues.zh: 至少今夜他们是彼此相依的
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 jin1 ye4 ta1 men5 shi4 bi3 ci3 xiang1 yi1 de5
cues.en: At least tonight, they had each other.

cues.zh: 而医院另一边
cues.pinyin: er2 yi1 yuan4 ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, on the other side of the hospital,

cues.zh: 患者小美正十分从容地躺在病床上
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 xiao3 mei3 zheng4 shi2 fen1 cong2 rong2 di4 tang3 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: patient Xiao Mei lay calmly on her hospital bed,

cues.zh: 和医生探讨自己的病情
cues.pinyin: he2 yi1 sheng1 tan4 tao3 zi4 ji3 de5 bing4 qing2
cues.en: discussing her condition with the doctor.

cues.zh: 她走两步就要摔倒
cues.pinyin: ta1 zou3 liang3 bu4 jiu4 yao4 shuai1 dao3
cues.en: She'd nearly fall after just two steps,

cues.zh: 不能保持平衡也十分虚弱
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 bao3 chi2 ping2 heng2 ye3 shi2 fen1 xu1 ruo4
cues.en: couldn't keep her balance, and was very weak.

cues.zh: 还出现疲惫
cues.pinyin: hai2 chu1 xian4 pi2 bei4
cues.en: She also had fatigue,

cues.zh: 眩晕头疼等症状
cues.pinyin: xuan4 yun1 tou2 teng2 deng3 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: dizziness, headaches, and other symptoms,

cues.zh: 偶尔还会恶心
cues.pinyin: ou3 er3 hai2 hui4 e3 xin1
cues.en: and occasionally felt nauseous.

cues.zh: 站立时血压会下降
cues.pinyin: zhan4 li4 shi2 xue4 ya1 hui4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Her blood pressure dropped when she stood up.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 小美用词严谨准确
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 yong4 ci2 yan2 jin3 zhun3 que4
cues.en: Xiao Mei's wording was precise and exact,

cues.zh: 毫不输经验老练的医生
cues.pinyin: hao2 bu4 shu1 jing1 yan4 lao3 lian4 de5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: every bit the match of a seasoned doctor.

cues.zh: 但是她并不是一位医术专家
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 bing4 bu2 shi4 yi1 wei4 yi1 shu4 zhuan1 jia1
cues.en: But she wasn't a medical expert at all —

cues.zh: 之所以表现得这么专业
cues.pinyin: zhi1 suo3 yi3 biao3 xian4 de2 zhe4 me5 zhuan1 ye4
cues.en: the reason she sounded so professional

cues.zh: 只是因为她已经被病状困扰了五年
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 yi3 jing1 bei4 bing4 zhuang4 kun4 rao3 le5 wu3 nian2
cues.en: was simply that she'd been plagued by this condition for five years,

cues.zh: 从女儿出生就开始了
cues.pinyin: cong2 nv3 er2 chu1 sheng1 jiu4 kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: ever since her daughter was born.

cues.zh: 期间问诊过十八次
cues.pinyin: qi1 jian1 wen4 zhen3 guo4 shi2 ba1 ci4
cues.en: In that time, she'd seen doctors eighteen times,

cues.zh: 一次又一次听到重复的症状
cues.pinyin: yi1 ci4 you4 yi1 ci4 ting1 dao4 chong2 fu4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: and after hearing the same symptoms described over and over,

cues.zh: 她早就倒背如流了
cues.pinyin: ta1 zao3 jiu4 dao4 bei4 ru2 liu2 le5
cues.en: she could recite them from memory.

cues.zh: 可是至今也没人能确诊她
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhi4 jin1 ye3 mei2 ren2 neng2 que4 zhen3 ta1
cues.en: Yet to this day, no one had been able to diagnose her.

cues.zh: 这么一说小安就来兴趣了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 yi1 shuo1 xiao3 an1 jiu4 lai2 xing4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Hearing this, Dr. Shawn got interested —

cues.zh: 她就喜欢疑难杂症
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 xi3 huan1 yi2 nan2 za2 zheng4
cues.en: she loved tricky, hard-to-diagnose cases.

cues.zh: 肖安要给她做一系列检查
cues.pinyin: xiao4 an1 yao4 gei3 ta1 zuo4 yi1 xi4 lie4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Dr. Shawn wanted to run a full set of tests on her,

cues.zh: 他觉得她一切都是无用功
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 ta1 yi1 qie4 dou1 shi4 wu2 yong4 gong1
cues.en: but Xiao Mei said there was no need for the trouble.

cues.zh: 接着掏出了存有自己五年间
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 tao1 chu1 le5 cun2 you3 zi4 ji3 wu3 nian2 jian1
cues.en: She then pulled out a drive holding

cues.zh: 所有检查结果的存储盘给她
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 de5 cun2 chu3 pan2 gei3 ta1
cues.en: all her test results from the past five years and handed it over.

cues.zh: 行吧
cues.pinyin: xing2 ba5
cues.en: "All right then,

cues.zh: 这也省得麻烦了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 sheng3 de5 ma2 fan2 le5
cues.en: that saves us some trouble."

cues.zh: 医生们在办公室对着一大堆资料
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 dui4 zhe5 yi1 da4 dui1 zi1 liao4
cues.en: The doctors sat in the office facing a huge stack of files,

cues.zh: 分析小美的病因
cues.pinyin: fen1 xi1 xiao3 mei3 de5 bing4 yin1
cues.en: analyzing the cause of Xiao Mei's illness.

cues.zh: 果然是坚持就医了五年的人
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 shi4 jian1 chi2 jiu4 yi1 le5 wu3 nian2 de5 ren2
cues.en: No wonder — she'd stuck with seeing doctors for five straight years.

cues.zh: 布朗看资料看得头都大了
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 kan4 zi1 liao4 kan4 de2 tou2 dou1 da4 le5
cues.en: Brown's head was spinning just from reading the files,

cues.zh: 排除了一个又一个可能
cues.pinyin: pai2 chu2 le5 yi2 ge4 you4 yi2 ge4 ke3 neng2
cues.en: ruling out one possibility after another.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】仅仅被仙人掌扎了一下，这位大叔就面临生命危险，小男孩想要救他，医生却直接拒绝

cues.zh: 这时小美的丈夫和女儿来了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 mei3 de5 zhang4 fu1 he2 nv3 er2 lai2 le5
cues.en: Just then, Xiao Mei's husband and daughter arrived.

cues.zh: 丈夫是来接小美回家的
cues.pinyin: zhang4 fu1 shi4 lai2 jie1 xiao3 mei3 hui2 jia1 de5
cues.en: The husband had come to take Xiao Mei home.

cues.zh: 她本来就不同意小美再来医院
cues.pinyin: ta1 ben3 lai2 jiu4 bu4 tong2 yi4 xiao3 mei3 zai4 lai2 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: He'd never agreed with Xiao Mei coming back to the hospital —

cues.zh: 她觉得你一切都是无用功
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 ni3 yi1 qie4 dou1 shi4 wu2 yong4 gong1
cues.en: he thought everything she was doing was pointless,

cues.zh: 何况小汉刚才的诊断
cues.pinyin: he2 kuang4 xiao3 han4 gang1 cai2 de5 zhen3 duan4
cues.en: especially since Dr. Shawn's diagnosis just now

cues.zh: 差点杀了她
cues.pinyin: cha4 dian3 sha1 le5 ta1
cues.en: had nearly killed her.

cues.zh: 两人在病房里小吵了一架
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 zai4 bing4 fang2 li3 xiao3 chao3 le5 yi1 jia4
cues.en: The two of them had a small argument in the hospital room.

cues.zh: 小美想要治好不能长时间站立的毛病
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 xiang3 yao4 zhi4 hao3 bu4 neng2 zhang3 shi2 jian1 zhan4 li4 de5 mao2 bing4
cues.en: Xiao Mei wanted to cure her inability to stand for long periods.

cues.zh: 她想做一个能和女儿一起玩
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 neng2 he2 nv3 er2 yi4 qi3 wan2
cues.en: She wanted to be a mother who could play

cues.zh: 一起闹的正常母亲
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 nao4 de5 zheng4 chang2 mu3 qin1
cues.en: and be silly with her daughter,

cues.zh: 而不是一直躺在病床上
cues.pinyin: er2 bu2 shi4 yi4 zhi2 tang3 zai4 bing4 chuang2 shang4
cues.en: instead of always lying in a hospital bed

cues.zh: 自怨自哀
cues.pinyin: zi4 yuan4 zi4 ai1
cues.en: feeling sorry for herself.

cues.zh: 这时小汉却突然问她
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 han4 que4 tu1 ran2 wen4 ta1
cues.en: At this point, Dr. Shawn suddenly asked her,

cues.zh: 你热吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 re4 ma5
cues.en: "Are you hot?"

cues.zh: 因为小美在冒汗
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 mei3 zai4 mao4 han4
cues.en: because Xiao Mei was sweating.

cues.zh: 可是她既不热
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 ji4 bu4 re4
cues.en: But she wasn't hot,

cues.zh: 也不觉得害怕
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 jue2 de2 hai4 pa4
cues.en: and she wasn't scared either —

cues.zh: 没有理由会出汗
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 li3 you2 hui4 chu1 han4
cues.en: there was no reason for her to be sweating.

cues.zh: 肖恩看着仪器
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 kan4 zhe5 yi2 qi4
cues.en: Dr. Shawn looked at the monitor;

cues.zh: 屏幕上显示她的体温正常
cues.pinyin: ping2 mu4 shang4 xian3 shi4 ta1 de5 ti3 wen1 zheng4 chang2
