cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 kai1 ye4 san1 tian1 jiu4 bei4 cha2 chu1 le5 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: But three days after opening, he was diagnosed with cancer

cues.zh: 他希望遇到肖恩那一刻起
cues.pinyin: ta1 xi1 wang4 yu4 dao4 xiao4 en1 na4 yi1 ke4 qi3
cues.en: He hoped that from the moment he met Shaun

cues.zh: 自己可以交到好运
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 ke3 yi3 jiao1 dao4 hao3 yun4
cues.en: his luck would change for the better

cues.zh: 肖恩邪魅一笑
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 xie2 mei4 yi1 xiao4
cues.en: Shaun smiled a sly smile

cues.zh: 把手术的各种可能风险娓娓道来
cues.pinyin: ba3 shou3 shu4 de5 ge4 zhong3 ke3 neng2 feng1 xian3 wei3 wei3 dao4 lai2
cues.en: and went through all the possible risks of the surgery in detail

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子的身体竟然能自动酿酒，这辈子都无法开车！天才医生们这次竟全都判断失误

cues.zh: 说的贝斯都已经怀疑人生了
cues.pinyin: shuo1 de5 bei4 si1 dou1 yi3 jing1 huai2 yi2 ren2 sheng1 le5
cues.en: until Beth started questioning his whole life

cues.zh: 还好他足够乐观
cues.pinyin: hai2 hao3 ta1 zu2 gou4 le4 guan1
cues.en: Luckily, he was optimistic enough

cues.zh: 这才是林主任帮肖恩选择他的最重要特质
cues.pinyin: zhe4 cai2 shi4 lin2 zhu3 ren4 bang1 xiao4 en1 xuan3 ze2 ta1 de5 zui4 zhong4 yao4 te4 zhi4
cues.en: This was exactly the trait that made Dr. Lin choose him for Shaun

cues.zh: 要知道
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: You should know

cues.zh: 肖恩这家伙就好像是一台精密的医学机器
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 jia1 huo5 jiu4 hao3 xiang4 shi4 yi1 tai2 jing1 mi4 de5 yi1 xue2 ji1 qi4
cues.en: Shaun is like a precision medical machine

cues.zh: 技术方面绝对没问题
cues.pinyin: ji4 shu4 fang1 mian4 jue2 dui4 mei2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: His skills are absolutely not in question

cues.zh: 但是为人处事和跟患者沟通起来
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wei2 ren2 chu3 shi4 he2 gen1 huan4 zhe3 gou1 tong1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: but when it comes to people skills and talking with patients

cues.zh: 简直让人头疼
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 rang4 ren2 tou2 teng2
cues.en: he's simply a headache

cues.zh: 所以林主任才为他挑了这么一个
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 lin2 zhu3 ren4 cai2 wei4 ta1 tiao1 le5 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4
cues.en: That's why Dr. Lin picked him

cues.zh: 乐观开朗好沟通的病患
cues.pinyin: le4 guan1 kai1 lang3 hao3 gou1 tong1 de5 bing4 huan4
cues.en: an optimistic, cheerful, easy-to-talk-to patient

cues.zh: 希望肖恩可以来个开门红
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 xiao4 en1 ke3 yi3 lai2 ge4 kai1 men2 hong2
cues.en: hoping Shaun could get off to a great start

cues.zh: 让他变得自信起来
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 bian4 de2 zi4 xin4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and build up his confidence

cues.zh: 肖恩认真的做着术前准备
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ren4 zhen1 de5 zuo4 zhe5 shu4 qian2 zhun3 bei4
cues.en: Shaun seriously prepared for the surgery

cues.zh: 仔细的检查患者的每一个化验单和 CT 片
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 de5 jian3 cha2 huan4 zhe3 de5 mei3 yi2 ge4 hua4 yan4 dan1 he2 CT pian4
cues.en: carefully checking every lab report and CT scan of the patient

cues.zh: 确定了病灶部位
cues.pinyin: que4 ding4 le5 bing4 zao4 bu4 wei4
cues.en: He confirmed the location of the lesion

cues.zh: 发现了他的胃已经与前腹壁粘连了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 ta1 de5 wei4 yi3 jing1 yu3 qian2 fu4 bi4 zhan1 lian2 le5
cues.en: and found that the stomach had already adhered to the anterior abdominal wall

cues.zh: 这就意味着他不能再吃饭了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 ta1 bu4 neng2 zai4 chi1 fan4 le5
cues.en: which meant he could never eat again

cues.zh: 萧恩十分沮丧
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 shi2 fen1 ju3 sang4
cues.en: Shaun was very upset

cues.zh: 本来他告诉过贝斯不需要插胃管的
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 ta1 gao4 su4 guo4 bei4 si1 bu4 xu1 yao4 cha1 wei4 guan3 de5
cues.en: He had told Beth earlier that a feeding tube wouldn't be needed

cues.zh: 可是这下自己要食言了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 xia4 zi4 ji3 yao4 shi2 yan2 le5
cues.en: but now he had to break his promise

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子的身体竟然能自动酿酒，这辈子都无法开车！天才医生们这次竟全都判断失误

cues.zh: 你这辈子都不能再吃东西了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 bei4 zi5 dou1 bu4 neng2 zai4 chi1 dong1 xi1 le5
cues.en: "You can never eat solid food again for the rest of your life"

cues.zh: 胃管要终身插了
cues.pinyin: wei4 guan3 yao4 zhong1 shen1 cha1 le5
cues.en: "You'll need a feeding tube for life"

cues.zh: 这对于一个未来的大厨简直是毁灭的打击
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dui4 yu2 yi2 ge4 wei4 lai2 de5 da4 chu2 jian3 zhi2 shi4 hui3 mie4 de5 da3 ji1
cues.en: For a future head chef, this was simply a devastating blow

cues.zh: 咖啡店的梦想破碎了
cues.pinyin: ka1 fei1 dian4 de5 meng4 xiang3 po4 sui4 le5
cues.en: His dream of the coffee shop was shattered

cues.zh: 最可怕的事情还是发生了
cues.pinyin: zui4 ke3 pa4 de5 shi4 qing2 hai2 shi4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: Then the most terrifying thing happened

cues.zh: 贝斯拒绝肖恩帮他主刀
cues.pinyin: bei4 si1 ju4 jue2 xiao4 en1 bang1 ta1 zhu3 dao1
cues.en: Beth refused to let Shaun perform the surgery

cues.zh: 这小子看起来非常不靠谱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiao3 zi5 kan4 qi3 lai2 fei1 chang2 bu4 kao4 pu3
cues.en: "This kid seems completely unreliable"

cues.zh: 本来自己前半生就挺悲惨了
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 zi4 ji3 qian2 ban4 sheng1 jiu4 ting3 bei1 can3 le5
cues.en: "My life was already miserable enough"

cues.zh: 遇到肖恩会不会这辈子就此终结了
cues.pinyin: yu4 dao4 xiao4 en1 hui4 bu2 hui4 zhe4 bei4 zi5 jiu4 ci3 zhong1 jie2 le5
cues.en: "Will meeting Shaun be the end of it?"

cues.zh: 这可苦了林主任
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 ku3 le5 lin2 zhu3 ren4
cues.en: This put Dr. Lin in a tough spot

cues.zh: 一边哄肖恩一边安慰贝斯
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 hong3 xiao4 en1 yi1 bian1 an1 wei4 bei4 si1
cues.en: coaxing Shaun on one side and comforting Beth on the other

cues.zh: 贝斯其实就是觉得肖恩出尔反尔
cues.pinyin: bei4 si1 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 jue2 de5 xiao4 en1 chu1 er3 fan3 er3
cues.en: Beth actually just felt that Shaun had gone back on his word

cues.zh: 说好了不插胃管的
cues.pinyin: shuo1 hao3 le5 bu4 cha1 wei4 guan3 de5
cues.en: He'd said there'd be no feeding tube

cues.zh: 为什么突然又插了
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 tu1 ran2 you4 cha1 le5
cues.en: so why was there suddenly one needed

cues.zh: 你是忽悠我不懂是吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 hu1 you1 wo3 bu4 dong3 shi4 ma5
cues.en: "Are you trying to fool me because you think I don't understand?"

cues.zh: 林主任表示这种情况谁也不想看到
cues.pinyin: lin2 zhu3 ren4 biao3 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 shui2 ye3 bu4 xiang3 kan4 dao4
cues.en: Dr. Lin said no one wanted this situation either

cues.zh: 但是病情就是这样
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bing4 qing2 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: but that's just how the illness was

cues.zh: 他也没忽悠你
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 mei2 hu1 you1 ni3
cues.en: He wasn't trying to trick you

cues.zh: 所以如果你觉得不希望肖恩主刀
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ru2 guo3 ni3 jue2 de5 bu4 xi1 wang4 xiao4 en1 zhu3 dao1
cues.en: So if you don't want Shaun to lead the surgery

cues.zh: 那你就去别家医院吧
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 qu4 bie2 jia1 yi1 yuan4 ba5
cues.en: you can go to another hospital

cues.zh: 看着肖恩期待的小表情
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 xiao4 en1 qi1 dai4 de5 xiao3 biao3 qing2
cues.en: Seeing Shaun's hopeful little expression

cues.zh: 贝斯终于同意了继续由肖恩担任
cues.pinyin: bei4 si1 zhong1 yu2 tong2 yi4 le5 ji4 xu4 you2 xiao4 en1 dan1 ren4
cues.en: Beth finally agreed to let Shaun continue as the lead surgeon

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子的身体竟然能自动酿酒，这辈子都无法开车！天才医生们这次竟全都判断失误

cues.zh: 他站在手术台上歇斯底里的大喊
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhan4 zai4 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4 xie1 si1 di3 li3 de5 da4 han3
cues.en: He stood at the operating table, shouting hysterically

cues.zh: 然后居然摘掉眼镜和口罩夺门而出
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ju1 ran2 zhai1 diao4 yan3 jing4 he2 kou3 zhao4 duo2 men2 er2 chu1
cues.en: then suddenly tore off his glasses and mask and ran out the door

cues.zh: 手术进行一半主刀医生跑了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jin4 xing2 yi2 ban4 zhu3 dao1 yi1 sheng1 pao3 le5
cues.en: Halfway through the surgery, the lead surgeon had run off

cues.zh: 贝斯的下半辈子还真是有够倒霉的
cues.pinyin: bei4 si1 de5 xia4 ban4 bei4 zi5 hai2 zhen1 shi4 you3 gou4 dao3 mei2 de5
cues.en: Beth's second half of life was really unlucky

cues.zh: 医生们赶紧把林主任叫来
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 gan3 jin3 ba3 lin2 zhu3 ren4 jiao4 lai2
cues.en: The doctors quickly called Dr. Lin over

cues.zh: 这时候肖恩还是无法控制自己的情绪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 xiao4 en1 hai2 shi4 wu2 fa3 kong4 zhi4 zi4 ji3 de5 qing2 xu4
cues.en: At that moment Shaun still couldn't control his emotions

cues.zh: 林主任让老朴火线救急
cues.pinyin: lin2 zhu3 ren4 rang4 lao3 pu3 huo3 xian4 jiu4 ji2
cues.en: Dr. Lin had Dr. Park step in urgently

cues.zh: 赶紧去把手术搞定
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 qu4 ba3 shou3 shu4 gao3 ding4
cues.en: to hurry and finish the surgery

cues.zh: 但是老朴却说肖恩不是一个没责任心的人
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 lao3 pu3 que4 shuo1 xiao4 en1 bu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 mei2 ze2 ren4 xin1 de5 ren2
cues.en: But Dr. Park said Shaun wasn't an irresponsible person

cues.zh: 我们还是听听看他到底遇到了什么问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hai2 shi4 ting1 ting1 kan4 ta1 dao4 di3 yu4 dao4 le5 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: "Let's hear what problem he actually ran into"

cues.zh: 恍惚中肖恩看到了自己的弟弟站在面前
cues.pinyin: huang3 hu1 zhong1 xiao4 en1 kan4 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 di4 di5 zhan4 zai4 mian4 qian2
cues.en: In a daze, Shaun saw his own younger brother standing in front of him

cues.zh: 他跟随弟弟的节奏深呼吸
cues.pinyin: ta1 gen1 sui2 di4 di5 de5 jie2 zou4 shen1 hu1 xi1
cues.en: He followed his brother's rhythm and took deep breaths

cues.zh: 终于勉强平复了情绪
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 mian3 qiang3 ping2 fu4 le5 qing2 xu4
cues.en: and finally managed to calm down

cues.zh: 原来肖恩在检查癌变部位上端的时候
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 xiao4 en1 zai4 jian3 cha2 ai2 bian4 bu4 wei4 shang4 duan1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: It turned out that while Shaun was examining the upper end of the cancerous area

cues.zh: 发现了很长一段食管是没有长肿瘤的
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 le5 hen3 zhang3 yi1 duan4 shi2 guan3 shi4 mei2 you3 zhang3 zhong3 liu2 de5
cues.en: he found a long section of the esophagus that had no tumor growth

cues.zh: 这段组织足够做游离空肠再见手术了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 duan4 zu3 zhi1 zu2 gou4 zuo4 you2 li2 kong1 chang2 zai4 jian4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: and that tissue was enough to do a free jejunum reconstruction surgery

cues.zh: 如果这样做了的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 le5 de5 hua4
cues.en: If they did this

cues.zh: 贝斯就不用插管了
cues.pinyin: bei4 si1 jiu4 bu4 yong4 cha1 guan3 le5
cues.en: Beth wouldn't need a feeding tube

items.title: 先锋影视

cues.zh: 而且也会让他的手术愈后更好
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ye3 hui4 rang4 ta1 de5 shou3 shu4 yu4 hou4 geng4 hao3

cues.zh: 可是这个手术十分困难

cues.zh: 萧恩根本完成不了

cues.zh: 所以萧恩很崩溃

cues.en: So Shaun was devastated

cues.zh: 一方面是自己的第一次主刀手术

cues.zh: 另一方面是患者的生命质量
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi4 fang1 mian4 shi4 huan4 zhe3 de5 sheng1 ming4 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: On the other was the patient's quality of life

cues.zh: 最后萧恩还是选择了后者
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 xiao1 en1 hai2 shi4 xuan3 ze2 le5 hou4 zhe3

cues.zh: 最后决定由马医生代替萧恩主刀

cues.zh: 但是马医生也没做过这样的手术
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ma3 yi1 sheng1 ye3 mei2 zuo4 guo4 zhe4 yang4 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: But Dr. Ma had never done this kind of surgery either

cues.zh: 好在肖恩学习过
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 xiao4 en1 xue2 xi2 guo4
cues.en: Luckily, Shaun had studied it

cues.zh: 所以最后肖恩负责提供手术方案和指导
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zui4 hou4 xiao4 en1 fu4 ze2 ti2 gong1 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4 he2 zhi3 dao3
cues.en: So in the end Shaun was in charge of providing the surgical plan and guidance

cues.zh: 马医生主导操作
cues.pinyin: ma3 yi1 sheng1 zhu3 dao3 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: while Dr. Ma performed the operation

cues.zh: 手术再次开始了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 zai4 ci4 kai1 shi3 le5
cues.en: The surgery began again

cues.zh: 这次完成得十分顺利
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ci4 wan2 cheng2 de2 shi2 fen1 shun4 li4
cues.en: This time it went very smoothly

cues.zh: 在最后缝合的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 zui4 hou4 feng2 he2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: During the final suturing

cues.zh: 肖恩缝上了最后一针
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 feng4 shang4 le5 zui4 hou4 yi1 zhen1
cues.en: Shaun put in the last stitch

cues.zh: 由他开始再由他结束
cues.pinyin: you2 ta1 kai1 shi3 zai4 you2 ta1 jie2 shu4
cues.en: He started it, and he ended it

cues.zh: 一切由始由终
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 you2 shi3 you2 zhong1
cues.en: Everything had a beginning and an end, by him

cues.zh: 虽然这次不是肖恩真正意义上
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 ci4 bu2 shi4 xiao4 en1 zhen1 zheng4 yi4 yi4 shang4
cues.en: Although this wasn't truly, in the full sense,

cues.zh: 的第一次主导
cues.pinyin: de5 di4 yi1 ci4 zhu3 dao3
cues.en: his first time leading a surgery

cues.zh: 但是他战胜了自己
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 zhan4 sheng4 le5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: he had overcome himself

cues.zh: 他提出了优秀的手术方案
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 you1 xiu4 de5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: He had come up with an excellent surgical plan

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 男子的身体竟然能自动酿酒，这辈子都无法开车！天才医生们这次竟全都判断失误

cues.zh: 可是检验数据不会骗人
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jian3 yan4 shu4 ju4 bu2 hui4 pian4 ren2
cues.en: But test results don't lie

cues.zh: 他血管里的酒精不是自己喝的
cues.pinyin: ta1 xue4 guan3 li3 de5 jiu3 jing1 bu2 shi4 zi4 ji3 he1 de5

cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shi4 wai4 xing1 ren2 gei3 ta1 guan1 jin4 qu4 de5 ma5
cues.en: Could aliens have poured it into him?

cues.zh: 在给九哥做手术的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 jiu3 ge1 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While operating on Brother Nine

cues.zh: 小布感觉到他的心脏有问题
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 gan3 jue2 dao4 ta1 de5 xin1 zang4 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Dr. Bu sensed something wrong with his heart

cues.zh: 应该是酗酒造成的

cues.zh: 这些应该告诉他妻子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 ying1 gai1 gao4 su4 ta1 qi1 zi3
cues.en: This should be told to his wife

cues.zh: 可是他妻子明显拒绝相信事实
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ta1 qi1 zi3 ming2 xian3 ju4 jue2 xiang1 xin4 shi4 shi2

cues.zh: 说了也没用
cues.pinyin: shuo1 le5 ye3 mei2 yong4
cues.en: Telling her wouldn't help

cues.zh: 手术后小布和雷雷为九哥检查心脏
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hou4 xiao3 bu4 he2 lei2 lei2 wei4 jiu3 ge1 jian3 cha2 xin1 zang4
cues.en: After the surgery, Dr. Bu and Dr. Lei checked Brother Nine's heart

cues.zh: 九哥现在的情况怎么检查
cues.pinyin: jiu3 ge1 xian4 zai4 de5 qing2 kuang4 zen3 me5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: No matter how they examined Brother Nine's current condition

cues.zh: 都是一个酗酒人的状态
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 yi2 ge4 xu4 jiu3 ren2 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: it all looked like the state of an alcoholic

cues.zh: 医生们无法相信他真的是在戒酒阶段
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 wu2 fa3 xiang4 xin4 ta1 zhen1 de5 shi4 zai4 jie4 jiu3 jie1 duan4
cues.en: The doctors couldn't believe he was really in the process of quitting drinking

cues.zh: 他的心率失常和心脏疾病
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 lv4 shi1 chang2 he2 xin1 zang4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: His irregular heartbeat and heart disease

cues.zh: 都是因为喝酒造成的
cues.pinyin: dou1 shi4 yin1 wei4 he1 jiu3 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: were all caused by drinking

cues.zh: 小布和雷雷去跟九嫂谈
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 he2 lei2 lei2 qu4 gen1 jiu3 sao3 tan2
cues.en: Dr. Bu and Dr. Lei went to talk to Sister-in-law Nine

cues.zh: 九嫂说他跟九哥是青梅竹马
cues.pinyin: jiu3 sao3 shuo1 ta1 gen1 jiu3 ge1 shi4 qing1 mei2 zhu2 ma3
cues.en: She said she and Brother Nine were childhood sweethearts

cues.zh: 很早就认识了
cues.pinyin: hen3 zao3 jiu4 ren4 shi2 le5
cues.en: who had known each other since they were very young

cues.zh: 九哥母亲去世后他开始酗酒
cues.pinyin: jiu3 ge1 mu3 qin1 qu4 shi4 hou4 ta1 kai1 shi3 xu4 jiu3
cues.en: After Brother Nine's mother passed away, he started drinking heavily

cues.zh: 九嫂说如果他再这样糟蹋自己
cues.pinyin: jiu3 sao3 shuo1 ru2 guo3 ta1 zai4 zhe4 yang4 zao1 ta4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Sister-in-law Nine said if he kept ruining himself like this

cues.zh: 就跟他分手
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gen1 ta1 fen1 shou3
cues.en: she would break up with him

cues.zh: 九哥害怕了
cues.pinyin: jiu3 ge1 hai4 pa4 le5
cues.en: Brother Nine got scared

cues.zh: 于是在九哥戒酒之后
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 zai4 jiu3 ge1 jie4 jiu3 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: So after Brother Nine quit drinking

cues.zh: 他就跟九哥结婚了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 gen1 jiu3 ge1 jie2 hun1 le5
cues.en: she married him

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 在娱乐圈生存却不争不抢，她说：总有一束光是为我而打

cues.zh: 我是春夏今天想和你一起找一找那
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 chun1 xia4 jin1 tian1 xiang3 he2 ni3 yi4 qi3 zhao3 yi1 zhao3 na4
cues.en: I'm Chunxia. Today I want to search with you for

cues.zh: 个真实的自己
cues.pinyin: ge4 zhen1 shi2 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: that real self.

cues.zh: 我长得普普通通
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhang3 de2 pu3 pu3 tong1 tong1
cues.en: I look very ordinary.

cues.zh: 要跟随大众的审美改变自己吗
cues.pinyin: yao4 gen1 sui2 da4 zhong4 de5 shen3 mei3 gai3 bian4 zi4 ji3 ma5
cues.en: Should I change myself to follow the crowd's aesthetic standards?

cues.zh: 我的高低眉乱乱的头发四处飞
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 gao1 di1 mei2 luan4 luan4 de5 tou2 fa4 si4 chu4 fei1
cues.en: My uneven eyebrows, my messy hair flying everywhere,

cues.zh: 舞根本不听话
cues.pinyin: wu3 gen1 ben3 bu4 ting1 hua4
cues.en: it simply won't behave.

cues.zh: 还有我肉肉的鼻子和黑眼圈
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 wo3 rou4 rou4 de5 bi2 zi5 he2 hei1 yan3 quan1
cues.en: and my chubby nose and dark circles.

cues.zh: 忘了那些别人的标准吧
cues.pinyin: wang4 le5 na4 xie1 bie2 ren2 de5 biao1 zhun3 ba5
cues.en: Forget other people's standards.

cues.zh: 真正的美
cues.pinyin: zhen1 zheng4 de5 mei3
cues.en: True beauty

cues.zh: 不取决于精心装扮
cues.pinyin: bu4 qu3 jue2 yu2 jing1 xin1 zhuang1 ban4
cues.en: doesn't depend on careful adornment.

cues.zh: 美一个属于你的瞬间
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 shu3 yu2 ni3 de5 shun4 jian1
cues.en: Make beautiful a moment that belongs only to you.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 在娱乐圈生存却不争不抢，她说：总有一束光是为我而打

cues.zh: 为什么排除万难也要做自己
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 pai2 chu2 wan4 nan2 ye3 yao4 zuo4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: Why insist on being yourself despite overcoming every difficulty?

cues.zh: 我有一天在拍戏时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 yi1 tian1 zai4 pai1 xi4 shi2 hou4
cues.en: One day while I was filming,

cues.zh: 站在那等
cues.pinyin: zhan4 zai4 na4 deng3
cues.en: I stood there waiting.

cues.zh: 突然有树光打到我了
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 you3 shu4 guang1 da3 dao4 wo3 le5
cues.en: Suddenly a beam of light hit me.

cues.zh: 我当时眼泪就要流下来了
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 yan3 lei4 jiu4 yao4 liu2 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: My tears were about to fall.

cues.zh: 那一刻感觉自己被点燃了
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 ke4 gan3 jue2 zi4 ji3 bei4 dian3 ran2 le5
cues.en: In that moment I felt ignited.

cues.zh: 是的
cues.pinyin: shi4 de5
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 这世上总有一束光是为我打的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shang4 zong3 you3 yi1 shu4 guang1 shi4 wei4 wo3 da3 di1
cues.en: In this world there's always a beam of light meant for me.

cues.zh: 有一个舞台是为我亮的
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 wu3 tai2 shi4 wei4 wo3 liang4 de5
cues.en: There's a stage lit up just for me.

cues.zh: 是为这个特别的我而来的
cues.pinyin: shi4 wei4 zhe4 ge5 te4 bie2 de5 wo3 er2 lai2 de5
cues.en: It comes for this special me.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 在娱乐圈生存却不争不抢，她说：总有一束光是为我而打

cues.zh: 身边的人都不如了家庭
cues.pinyin: shen1 bian1 de5 ren2 dou1 bu4 ru2 le5 jia1 ting2
cues.en: Everyone around me already has a family.

cues.zh: 但我不想妥协
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 bu4 xiang3 tuo3 xie2
cues.en: But I don't want to compromise.

cues.zh: 有点累也有点孤独
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 lei4 ye3 you3 dian3 gu1 du2
cues.en: A little tired, a little lonely.

cues.zh: 相信我
cues.pinyin: xiang1 xin4 wo3
cues.en: Trust me,

cues.zh: 你并不孤单
cues.pinyin: ni3 bing4 bu4 gu1 dan1
cues.en: you are not alone.

cues.zh: 我写了首诗分享给你们
cues.pinyin: wo3 xie3 le5 shou3 shi1 fen1 xiang3 gei3 ni3 men5
cues.en: I wrote a poem to share with you.

cues.zh: 我睁眼时
cues.pinyin: wo3 zheng1 yan3 shi2
cues.en: When I open my eyes,

cues.zh: 就置身在这无边际的黑暗里
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhi4 shen1 zai4 zhe4 wu2 bian1 ji4 de5 hei1 an4 li3
cues.en: I find myself in this boundless darkness.

cues.zh: 我只是宇宙微末的尘埃
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi3 shi4 yu3 zhou4 wei1 mo4 de5 chen2 ai1
cues.en: I'm just an insignificant speck of cosmic dust,

cues.zh: 还是没来得及发光的星辰点点
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 mei2 lai2 de5 ji2 fa1 guang1 de5 xing1 chen2 dian3 dian3
cues.en: or a scattering of stars that haven't had the chance to shine yet.

cues.zh: 我看不到我
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 bu2 dao4 wo3
cues.en: I can't see myself.

cues.zh: 我大声地呼喊
cues.pinyin: wo3 da4 sheng1 di4 hu1 han3
cues.en: I shout loudly.

cues.zh: 我努力地晃动
cues.pinyin: wo3 nu3 li4 di4 huang4 dong4
cues.en: I struggle to move.

cues.zh: 谁也看不到我
cues.pinyin: shui2 ye3 kan4 bu2 dao4 wo3
cues.en: No one can see me either.

cues.zh: 我对着目不可及的坐标分离
cues.pinyin: wo3 dui4 zhe5 mu4 bu4 ke3 ji2 de5 zuo4 biao1 fen1 li2
cues.en: I drift apart toward coordinates I can never reach.

cues.zh: 我向着一切未知的存在
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang4 zhe5 yi1 qie4 wei4 zhi1 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: I turn toward every unknown existence,

cues.zh: 讨要异议
cues.pinyin: tao3 yao4 yi4 yi4
cues.en: demanding an answer.

cues.zh: 我没看到有第二个
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 kan4 dao4 you3 di4 er4 ge4
cues.en: I see no one else like me.

cues.zh: 我朝着我来
cues.pinyin: wo3 chao2 zhe5 wo3 lai2
cues.en: I walk toward myself,

cues.zh: 但我等待无数个你
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 deng3 dai4 wu2 shu4 ge4 ni3
cues.en: but I wait for countless versions of you.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 《繁花》之后，胡歌又出王炸Hu Ge's New Highly-praised Work after Blossoms Shanghai

cues.zh: 我们通常讲我们自己有五千年的文明史
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 tong1 chang2 jiang3 wo3 men5 zi4 ji3 you3 wu3 qian1 nian2 de5 wen2 ming2 shi3
cues.en: We usually say we have five thousand years of civilization.

cues.zh: 但世界是不是这么看的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jie4 shi4 bu2 shi4 zhe4 me5 kan4 de5
cues.en: But does the world see it that way?

cues.zh: 通过这一百年一代一代的考古人来去证实
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 zhe4 yi4 bai3 nian2 yi2 dai4 yi2 dai4 de5 kao3 gu3 ren2 lai2 qu4 zheng4 shi2
cues.en: It's verified by generation after generation of archaeologists over the past hundred years.

cues.zh: 人们从洞穴居住一步一步
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 cong2 dong4 xue2 ju1 zhu4 yi2 bu4 yi2 bu4
cues.en: People, step by step, went from living in caves

cues.zh: 怎么到秦汉的这个时代
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 dao4 qin2 han4 de5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 dai4
cues.en: to how they reached the Qin and Han era,

cues.zh: 又怎么连接到我们今天
cues.pinyin: you4 zen3 me5 lian2 jie1 dao4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1
cues.en: and how that connects to us today.

cues.zh: 既然是以考古为准绳
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 shi4 yi3 kao3 gu3 wei4 zhun3 sheng2
cues.en: Since archaeology is the standard we go by,

cues.zh: 考古人是老老实实做学问的
cues.pinyin: kao3 gu3 ren2 shi4 lao3 lao3 shi2 shi2 zuo4 xue2 wen4 de5
cues.en: archaeologists do scholarship honestly,

cues.zh: 我们就老老实实做片子绝对不去偷任何懒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 lao3 lao3 shi2 shi2 zuo4 pian1 zi5 jue2 dui4 bu4 qu4 tou1 ren4 he2 lan3
cues.en: so we make the film honestly too, without ever cutting corners.

cues.zh: 出现在我们片子最早的文物
cues.pinyin: chu1 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 pian1 zi5 zui4 zao3 de5 wen2 wu4
cues.en: The earliest artifact to appear in our film

cues.zh: 应该是四万年的田园洞人的遗骨
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 si4 wan4 nian2 de5 tian2 yuan2 dong4 ren2 de5 yi2 gu3
cues.en: should be the 40,000-year-old remains of the Tianyuandong people.

cues.zh: 富豪墓
cues.pinyin: fu4 hao2 mu4
cues.en: A wealthy man's tomb,

cues.zh: 亚长的遗骨
cues.pinyin: ya4 zhang3 de5 yi2 gu3
cues.en: the remains of Ya Zhang,

cues.zh: 良渚遗址
cues.pinyin: liang2 zhu3 yi2 zhi3
cues.en: the Liangzhu site,

cues.zh: 它的宫殿
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gong1 dian4
cues.en: its palace,

cues.zh: 宫城的这些遗址
cues.pinyin: gong1 cheng2 de5 zhe4 xie1 yi2 zhi3
cues.en: these ruins of the palace city.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 《繁花》之后，胡歌又出王炸Hu Ge's New Highly-praised Work after Blossoms Shanghai

cues.zh: 我们何以中国去了全国的博物馆
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 he2 yi3 zhong1 guo2 qu4 le5 quan2 guo2 de5 bo2 wu4 guan3
cues.en: For 'Why China,' we went to museums all over the country,

cues.zh: 考古遗址
cues.pinyin: kao3 gu3 yi2 zhi3
cues.en: archaeological sites —

cues.zh: 加起来大概 2 30 个点位
cues.pinyin: jia1 qi3 lai2 da4 gai4 2 30 ge4 dian3 wei4
cues.en: altogether about twenty to thirty locations,

cues.zh: 在那个大山之间
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 ge5 da4 shan1 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: among those great mountains,

cues.zh: 沟壑纵横之间
cues.pinyin: gou1 he4 zong4 heng2 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: amid crisscrossing ravines.

cues.zh: 真正的历史恐怕是那些普通人
cues.pinyin: zhen1 zheng4 de5 li4 shi3 kong3 pa4 shi4 na4 xie1 pu3 tong1 ren2
cues.en: The real history is probably that of ordinary people,

cues.zh: 像第一集秦汉当中
cues.pinyin: xiang4 di4 yi1 ji2 qin2 han4 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: like in the first episode on the Qin and Han,

cues.zh: 很多这些不见于文献典籍
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zhe4 xie1 bu2 jian4 yu2 wen2 xian4 dian3 ji2
cues.en: many of these are not found in historical texts and classics —

cues.zh: 记载的这些人物故事
cues.pinyin: ji4 zai3 de5 zhe4 xie1 ren2 wu4 gu4 shi4
cues.en: the stories of these people.

cues.zh: 2000 年前的人
cues.pinyin: 2000 nian2 qian2 de5 ren2
cues.en: People from 2,000 years ago,

cues.zh: 轻笔一笔一画写下来的东西
cues.pinyin: qing1 bi3 yi1 bi3 yi1 hua4 xie3 xia4 lai2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: things written stroke by stroke in their own hand —

cues.zh: 所以就尤为打动人
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 you2 wei4 da3 dong4 ren2
cues.en: that's what makes it especially moving.

cues.zh: 我希望我们是一个档案
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 men5 shi4 yi2 ge4 dang4 an4
cues.en: I hope we can be like an archive.

cues.zh: 光道具大概就 3000 多件
cues.pinyin: guang1 dao4 ju4 da4 gai4 jiu4 3000 duo1 jian4
cues.en: Just the props alone number over 3,000 pieces,

cues.zh: 根据出土的文物来复原的
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 chu1 tu3 de5 wen2 wu4 lai2 fu4 yuan2 de5
cues.en: recreated based on unearthed artifacts.

cues.zh: 光演员可能就大概 4 000 人
cues.pinyin: guang1 yan3 yuan2 ke3 neng2 jiu4 da4 gai4 4 000 ren2
cues.en: Just the actors alone number around 4,000 people.

cues.zh: 胡歌的造型
cues.pinyin: hu2 ge1 de5 zao4 xing2
cues.en: Hu Ge's look —

cues.zh: 他头上戴着这个红金
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou2 shang4 dai4 zhe5 zhe4 ge5 hong2 jin1
cues.en: he wears this red headscarf on his head,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 《繁花》之后，胡歌又出王炸Hu Ge's New Highly-praised Work after Blossoms Shanghai

cues.zh: 是根据汉代出土的画像石上的形象来的
cues.pinyin: shi4 gen1 ju4 han4 dai4 chu1 tu3 de5 hua4 xiang4 shi2 shang4 de5 xing2 xiang4 lai2 de5
cues.en: based on the imagery on stone reliefs unearthed from the Han dynasty.

cues.zh: 解忧身上的服装浴室
cues.pinyin: jie3 you1 shen1 shang4 de5 fu2 zhuang1 yu4 shi4
cues.en: Jieyou's costume design,

cues.zh: 他头上戴着这个红巾
cues.pinyin: ta1 tou2 shang4 dai4 zhe5 zhe4 ge5 hong2 jin1
cues.en: a Wusun architectural space —

cues.zh: 其实是四组专家在给我们来提供
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 si4 zu3 zhuan1 jia1 zai4 gei3 wo3 men5 lai2 ti2 gong1
cues.en: these were actually provided by four teams of experts for us.

cues.zh: 我们这次片尾字幕的工作人员的名单
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 ci4 pian4 wei3 zi4 mu4 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 de5 ming2 dan1
cues.en: The staff credits list at the end of our film this time

cues.zh: 是一万两千字
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 wan4 liang3 qian1 zi4
cues.en: is 12,000 characters long.

cues.zh: A 4 是二十四眼
cues.pinyin: A 4 shi4 er4 shi2 si4 yan3
cues.en: On A4 paper, that's twenty-four pages.

cues.zh: 考古学家专家团大概就有一百多人
cues.pinyin: kao3 gu3 xue2 jia1 zhuan1 jia1 tuan2 da4 gai4 jiu4 you3 yi4 bai3 duo1 ren2
cues.en: The team of archaeology experts alone numbers over a hundred people.

cues.zh: 把中国最好的那些老师们都聚集在这
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhong1 guo2 zui4 hao3 de5 na4 xie1 lao3 shi1 men5 dou1 ju4 ji2 zai4 zhe4
cues.en: We've gathered the best scholars in China

cues.zh: A4 是二十四页
cues.pinyin: A4 shi4 er4 shi2 si4 ye4
cues.en: around this program.

cues.zh: 像我们一些考古学家
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 men5 yi1 xie1 kao3 gu3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Like some of our archaeologists,

cues.zh: 他去挖这些人骨
cues.pinyin: ta1 qu4 wa1 zhe4 xie1 ren2 gu3
cues.en: when they go dig up these human bones,

cues.zh: 晚上得睡在山洞里
cues.pinyin: wan3 shang4 de2 shui4 zai4 shan1 dong4 li3
cues.en: they have to sleep in caves at night.

cues.zh: 有老鼠自己也睡不着
cues.pinyin: you3 lao3 shu3 zi4 ji3 ye3 shui4 bu4 zhe5
cues.en: With rats around, they can't sleep either,

cues.zh: 就坐到那个洞口
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zuo4 dao4 na4 ge5 dong4 kou3
cues.en: so they just sit at the cave entrance.

cues.zh: 我们在这个遗址当中
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 yi2 zhi3 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: At this site of ours,

cues.zh: 也曾是一群人的家
cues.pinyin: ye3 ceng2 shi4 yi1 qun2 ren2 de5 jia1
cues.en: it was also once home to a group of people.

cues.zh: 通过好好去研究这些
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 hao3 hao3 qu4 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 xie1
cues.en: By carefully studying these

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 《繁花》之后，胡歌又出王炸Hu Ge's New Highly-praised Work after Blossoms Shanghai

cues.zh: 器物墓葬村落
cues.pinyin: qi4 wu4 mu4 zang4 cun1 luo4
cues.en: artifacts, tombs, and villages,

cues.zh: 你就完全能够去走进
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 wan2 quan2 neng2 gou4 qu4 zou3 jin4
cues.en: you can completely step into

cues.zh: 那一段人的生活
cues.pinyin: na4 yi1 duan4 ren2 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: that stretch of people's lives.

cues.zh: 梁祖遗址的王宁元老师
cues.pinyin: liang2 zu3 yi2 zhi3 de5 wang2 ning2 yuan2 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Teacher Wang Ningyuan from the Liangzhu site

cues.zh: 他觉得我们在做
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 wo3 men5 zai4 zuo4
cues.en: felt that what we were doing

cues.zh: 考古人应该做的一件事
cues.pinyin: kao3 gu3 ren2 ying1 gai1 zuo4 de5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: was something archaeologists should do,

cues.zh: 叫实验考古
cues.pinyin: jiao4 shi2 yan4 kao3 gu3
cues.en: called experimental archaeology.

cues.zh: 我们拍他那边的梁祖碳化米

cues.en: wasn't nearly enough for the parents to raise the ransom money.

cues.pinyin: na4 wei4 shen2 me5 dang1 chu1 bang3 fei3 gei3 le5 jia1 shu3 24 xiao3 shi2 de5 qi1 xian4
cues.en: So why did the kidnapper give the family a 24-hour deadline back then?

cues.zh: 虽然这个绑匪十分可恶
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 bang3 fei3 shi2 fen1 ke3 wu4
cues.en: Although this kidnapper was utterly despicable,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 高智商女主被埋在地底，看她如何绝地逃生

cues.zh: 把两人一起绑走了
cues.pinyin: ba3 liang3 ren2 yi4 qi3 bang3 zou3 le5
cues.en: he had kidnapped the two of them together.

cues.zh: 随后布斯又收到了绑匪的消息
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 bu4 si1 you4 shou1 dao4 le5 bang3 fei3 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: Afterward, Booth received another message from the kidnapper,

cues.zh: 威胁他汇 800 万到银行账户上
cues.pinyin: wei1 xie2 ta1 hui4 800 wan4 dao4 yin2 hang2 zhang4 hu4 shang4
cues.en: threatening to make him transfer 8 million into a bank account,

cues.zh: 不然杰克和小谷就会窒息而死
cues.pinyin: bu4 ran2 jie2 ke4 he2 xiao3 gu3 jiu4 hui4 zhi4 xi1 er2 si3
cues.en: or else Jack and Xiaogu would suffocate to death.

cues.zh: 这和当初兄弟俩的案件如出一辙
cues.pinyin: zhe4 he2 dang1 chu1 xiong1 di4 lia3 de5 an4 jian4 ru2 chu1 yi1 zhe2
cues.en: This matched the brothers' case exactly.

cues.zh: 只不过凶手从中吸取了教训
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 xiong1 shou3 cong2 zhong1 xi1 qu3 le5 jiao4 xun4
cues.en: Except the killer had learned a lesson from it

cues.zh: 把期限缩小到了 12 小时
cues.pinyin: ba3 qi1 xian4 suo1 xiao3 dao4 le5 12 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: and shortened the deadline to 12 hours.

cues.zh: 被绑架的小谷和杰克也不是坐以待毙的人
cues.pinyin: bei4 bang3 jia4 de5 xiao3 gu3 he2 jie2 ke4 ye3 bu2 shi4 zuo4 yi3 dai4 bi4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Xiaogu and Jack, now kidnapped, weren't the type to just wait for death.

cues.zh: 因为小谷准备去空手倒班
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 xiao3 gu3 zhun3 bei4 qu4 kong1 shou3 dao3 ban1
cues.en: Because Xiaogu had been getting ready to work a shift out in the field,

cues.zh: 所以车上准备了许多水
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 che1 shang4 zhun3 bei4 le5 xu3 duo1 shui3
cues.en: there was a lot of water prepared in the car.

cues.zh: 然后就给杰克清理并包扎了伤口
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 gei3 jie2 ke4 qing1 li3 bing4 bao1 za1 le5 shang1 kou3
cues.en: So she cleaned and bandaged Jack's wound.

cues.zh: 掘坟杀手每次行动都相同
cues.pinyin: jue2 fen2 sha1 shou3 mei3 ci4 xing2 dong4 dou1 xiang1 tong2
cues.en: The Grave Killer's method was the same every time.

cues.zh: 所以小谷推断两人只能生活 12 个小时
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 gu3 tui1 duan4 liang3 ren2 zhi3 neng2 sheng1 huo2 12 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: So Xiaogu figured the two of them could only survive 12 hours.

cues.zh: 如果没有人交付赎金
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 ren2 jiao1 fu4 shu2 jin1
cues.en: If no one paid the ransom,

cues.zh: 两人就永远也见不到第二天的太阳了
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 jiu4 yong3 yuan3 ye3 jian4 bu2 dao4 di4 er4 tian1 de5 tai4 yang2 le5
cues.en: the two of them would never see the next day's sun.

cues.zh: 两人昏迷了两个小时
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 hun1 mi2 le5 liang3 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: The two of them were unconscious for two hours.

cues.zh: 现在只剩下十个小时的自救时间了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhi3 sheng4 xia4 shi2 ge4 xiao3 shi2 de5 zi4 jiu4 shi2 jian1 le5
cues.en: Now only ten hours of time to save themselves remained.

cues.zh: 杰克的伤造成了骨筋膜室综合症
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 de5 shang1 zao4 cheng2 le5 gu3 jin1 mo2 shi4 zong1 he2 zheng4
cues.en: Jack's injury had caused compartment syndrome,

cues.zh: 会非常痛苦
cues.pinyin: hui4 fei1 chang2 tong4 ku3
cues.en: which would be extremely painful

cues.zh: 然后造成休克直至死亡
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zao4 cheng2 xiu1 ke4 zhi2 zhi4 si3 wang2
cues.en: and then lead to shock and eventually death.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 高智商女主被埋在地底，看她如何绝地逃生

cues.zh: 必须做手术
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Surgery had to be done

cues.zh: 切开筋膜
cues.pinyin: qie4 kai1 jin1 mo2
cues.en: to cut open the fascia

cues.zh: 释放压力
cues.pinyin: shi4 fang4 ya1 li4
cues.en: and release the pressure.

cues.zh: 他们手边只有一把小刀
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shou3 bian1 zhi3 you3 yi1 ba3 xiao3 dao1
cues.en: All they had on hand was a small knife.

cues.zh: 条件十分简陋
cues.pinyin: tiao2 jian4 shi2 fen1 jian3 lou4
cues.en: The conditions were extremely crude.

cues.zh: 不过还好小谷的技术不错
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 hai2 hao3 xiao3 gu3 de5 ji4 shu4 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: But fortunately, Xiaogu's skill was quite good,

cues.zh: 过程十分顺利
cues.pinyin: guo4 cheng2 shi2 fen1 shun4 li4
cues.en: and the process went very smoothly.

cues.zh: 杰克暂时捡回了自己的小命
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 zan4 shi2 jian3 hui2 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 xiao3 ming4
cues.en: Jack got his life back, for now.

cues.zh: 实验室众人十分焦急
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 zhong4 ren2 shi2 fen1 jiao1 ji2
cues.en: Everyone at the lab was extremely anxious,

cues.zh: 马不停蹄地寻找线索好找到两人
cues.pinyin: ma3 bu4 ting2 ti2 di4 xun2 zhao3 xian4 suo3 hao3 zhao3 dao4 liang3 ren2
cues.en: racing nonstop to find clues to locate the two of them.

cues.zh: 探员小美发现了一本杰克的笔记
cues.pinyin: tan4 yuan2 xiao3 mei3 fa1 xian4 le5 yi1 ben3 jie2 ke4 de5 bi3 ji4
cues.en: Agent Xiaomei found one of Jack's notebooks,

cues.zh: 只不过里面的内容全部是特殊的密码组成
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 li3 mian4 de5 nei4 rong2 quan2 bu4 shi4 te4 shu1 de5 mi4 ma3 zu3 cheng2
cues.en: except its contents were entirely made up of special codes.

cues.zh: 好在安琪和杰克关系密切
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 an1 qi2 he2 jie2 ke4 guan1 xi4 mi4 qie4
cues.en: Luckily, Angie was close with Jack

cues.zh: 能够看得懂这些东西
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 kan4 de5 dong3 zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: and was able to understand this stuff.

cues.zh: 上面说杰克在受害者衣服上发现的微量旅
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 shuo1 jie2 ke4 zai4 shou4 hai4 zhe3 yi1 fu2 shang4 fa1 xian4 de5 wei1 liang4 lv3
cues.en: It said the trace substance Jack found on the victim's clothes

cues.zh: 肯定来自于决分杀手的车
cues.pinyin: ken3 ding4 lai2 zi4 yu2 jue2 fen1 sha1 shou3 de5 che1
cues.en: definitely came from the Grave Killer's vehicle,

cues.zh: 比如卡车或者货车的后备箱
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ka3 che1 huo4 zhe3 huo4 che1 de5 hou4 bei4 xiang1
cues.en: something like the trunk of a truck or a van.

cues.zh: 可是看多也没什么用
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 kan4 duo1 ye3 mei2 shen2 me5 yong4
cues.en: But understanding it wasn't much use.

cues.zh: 他们现在紧急需要的不是找到凶手的证据
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xian4 zai4 jin3 ji2 xu1 yao4 de5 bu2 shi4 zhao3 dao4 xiong1 shou3 de5 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: What they urgently needed right now wasn't evidence to find the killer,

cues.zh: 而是发百万
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 fa1 bai3 wan4
cues.en: but to find the two of them.

cues.zh: 杰克是某个财团的唯一级证人
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 shi4 mou3 ge4 cai2 tuan2 de5 wei2 yi1 ji2 zheng4 ren2
cues.en: Jack was the sole witness for a certain consortium.

cues.zh: 当然这个集团有一条规定
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 ji2 tuan2 you3 yi1 tiao2 gui1 ding4
cues.en: Of course, this consortium had a rule:

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 高智商女主被埋在地底，看她如何绝地逃生

cues.zh: 还需要利用化学反应进一步确认
cues.pinyin: hai2 xu1 yao4 li4 yong4 hua4 xue2 fan3 ying4 jin4 yi2 bu4 que4 ren4
cues.en: they still needed a chemical reaction to confirm it further.

cues.zh: 他们需要二本甲铜
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 er4 ben3 jia3 tong2
cues.en: They needed benzophenone,

cues.zh: 一般化妆品里都含有
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 hua4 zhuang1 pin3 li3 dou1 han2 you3
cues.en: which is generally found in cosmetics.

cues.zh: 可惜小谷过得比较糙
cues.pinyin: ke3 xi1 xiao3 gu3 guo4 de2 bi3 jiao4 cao1
cues.en: Unfortunately, Xiaogu lived a rather rough, no-frills life,

cues.zh: 车上没什么化妆品
cues.pinyin: che1 shang4 mei2 shen2 me5 hua4 zhuang1 pin3
cues.en: and there wasn't much cosmetics in the car.

cues.zh: 最后他盯上了杰克给安琪买的香水
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 ding1 shang4 le5 jie2 ke4 gei3 an1 qi2 mai3 de5 xiang1 shui3
cues.en: In the end, he set his sights on the perfume Jack had bought for Angie,

cues.zh: 一瓶三千美元
cues.pinyin: yi1 ping2 san1 qian1 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: a bottle worth three thousand dollars.

cues.zh: 不过杰克可是个富二代
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 jie2 ke4 ke3 shi4 ge4 fu4 er4 dai4
cues.en: But Jack was a rich second-generation heir,

cues.zh: 这点小鲜他还不至于舍不得
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dian3 xiao3 xian1 ta1 hai2 bu4 zhi4 yu2 she3 bu4 de2
cues.en: so this small amount of money wasn't something he'd be stingy about.

cues.zh: 杰克将相睡突然混合
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 jiang4 xiang4 shui4 tu1 ran2 hun4 he2
cues.en: Jack suddenly mixed in the perfume,

cues.zh: 从而产生的一系列反应中
cues.pinyin: cong2 er2 chan3 sheng1 de5 yi1 xi4 lie4 fan3 ying4 zhong1
cues.en: and from the resulting series of reactions,

cues.zh: 一刻分析出了他们所在的位置
cues.pinyin: yi1 ke4 fen1 xi1 chu1 le5 ta1 men5 suo3 zai4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: they immediately worked out where they were located.

cues.zh: 可他们只有四五秒的时间能发消息
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 men5 zhi3 you3 si4 wu3 miao3 de5 shi2 jian1 neng2 fa1 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: But they only had four or five seconds to send a message.

cues.zh: 杰克用他的聪明材质
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 yong4 ta1 de5 cong1 ming2 cai2 zhi4
cues.en: Jack used his intelligence

cues.zh: 将位置信息转换成一串极短的密码
cues.pinyin: jiang1 wei4 zhi4 xin4 xi1 zhuan3 huan4 cheng2 yi1 chuan4 ji2 duan3 de5 mi4 ma3
cues.en: to convert the location info into an extremely short code,

cues.zh: 将信息发到了布斯的手机上
cues.pinyin: jiang1 xin4 xi1 fa1 dao4 le5 bu4 si1 de5 shou3 ji1 shang4
cues.en: and sent the message to Booth's phone.

cues.zh: 布斯收到这一串填文数字
cues.pinyin: bu4 si1 shou1 dao4 zhe4 yi1 chuan4 tian2 wen2 shu4 zi4
cues.en: Booth received this string of jumbled numbers,

cues.zh: 又激动又迷茫
cues.pinyin: you4 ji1 dong4 you4 mi2 mang2
cues.en: both excited and confused.

cues.zh: 实验室的其他人也一时没能从这条消息中
cues.pinyin: shi2 yan4 shi4 de5 qi2 ta1 ren2 ye3 yi1 shi2 mei2 neng2 cong2 zhe4 tiao2 xiao1 xi1 zhong1
cues.en: The others at the lab also, for a moment, couldn't

cues.zh: 获得什么有用的线索
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 shen2 me5 you3 yong4 de5 xian4 suo3
cues.en: get any useful clues out of this message,

cues.zh: 而且时间已经过了 12 个小时
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shi2 jian1 yi3 jing1 guo4 le5 12 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: and on top of that, 12 hours had already passed.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 逃离城市，绝美川西露营之旅

cues.zh: 有多久没离开过城市真正地走进自然
cues.pinyin: you3 duo1 jiu3 mei2 li2 kai1 guo4 cheng2 shi4 zhen1 zheng4 di4 zou3 jin4 zi4 ran2
cues.en: How long has it been since I truly left the city and stepped into nature?

cues.zh: 去不被光污染的星空之下
cues.pinyin: qu4 bu4 bei4 guang1 wu1 ran3 de5 xing1 kong1 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: To stand beneath a starry sky untouched by light pollution

cues.zh: 去深入海拔三千五百米树的海洋我们
cues.pinyin: qu4 shen1 ru4 hai3 ba2 san1 qian1 wu3 bai3 mi3 shu4 de5 hai3 yang2 wo3 men5
cues.en: To venture deep into a sea of trees at 3,500 meters elevation, we

cues.zh: 一路向西畅想晴朗与探途
cues.pinyin: yi1 lu4 xiang4 xi1 chang4 xiang3 qing2 lang3 yu3 tan4 tu2
cues.en: headed west, imagining clear skies and the journey ahead

cues.zh: 去穿过浓雾和冰雹在夜幕中抵达这里
cues.pinyin: qu4 chuan1 guo4 nong2 wu4 he2 bing1 bao2 zai4 ye4 mu4 zhong1 di3 da2 zhe4 li3
cues.en: passed through thick fog and hail, arriving here as night fell

cues.zh: 当山雨突袭
cues.pinyin: dang1 shan1 yu3 tu1 xi2
cues.en: When a mountain storm suddenly struck

cues.zh: 无法看到期待的漫天星辰
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 kan4 dao4 qi1 dai4 de5 man4 tian1 xing1 chen2
cues.en: we couldn't see the sky full of stars we'd hoped for

cues.zh: 我们就在营地点亮自己的星光
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 zai4 ying2 di4 dian3 liang4 zi4 ji3 de5 xing1 guang1
cues.en: so we lit up our own starlight at the campsite instead

cues.zh: 在天幕下彼此分享
cues.pinyin: zai4 tian1 mu4 xia4 bi3 ci3 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: sharing with each other under the open sky

cues.zh: 成为新的人生之友
cues.pinyin: cheng2 wei2 xin1 de5 ren2 sheng1 zhi1 you3
cues.en: becoming new friends for life

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 逃离城市，绝美川西露营之旅

cues.zh: 我知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: I know

cues.zh: 我终将回到城市
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhong1 jiang1 hui2 dao4 cheng2 shi4
cues.en: I will eventually return to the city

cues.zh: 回到喧嚣和人海里

cues.en: the sound of insects chirping and the stream here

cues.zh: 如同山野在我的心中

cues.en: as if the mountains and wilderness live on in my heart

cues.zh: 自由无数

cues.zh: 尽情奔赴
