items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 今年的 3 月 20 日是农历 2 月 2
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 de5 3 yue4 20 ri4 shi4 nong2 li4 2 yue4 2
cues.en: This year, March 20th falls on the 2nd day of the 2nd lunar month.

cues.zh: 俗话说 2 月 2 龙抬头
cues.pinyin: su2 hua4 shuo1 2 yue4 2 long2 tai2 tou2
cues.en: As the saying goes, "On the 2nd day of the 2nd month, the dragon raises its head."

cues.zh: 这一天又恰好是 24 节气里面的春分
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 you4 qia4 hao3 shi4 24 jie2 qi4 li3 mian4 de5 chun1 fen1
cues.en: This day also happens to be the Spring Equinox, one of the 24 solar terms.

cues.zh: 这样的日子叫做龙头春是难得的大吉日
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 ri4 zi5 jiao4 zuo4 long2 tou2 chun1 shi4 nan2 de2 de5 da4 ji2 ri4
cues.en: A day like this is called a "Dragon Head Spring," a rare and highly auspicious day.

cues.zh: 俗话说春分遇龙头五谷满屯楼
cues.pinyin: su2 hua4 shuo1 chun1 fen1 yu4 long2 tou2 wu3 gu3 man3 tun2 lou2
cues.en: As the saying goes, "When Spring Equinox meets the dragon's head, the grain fills the barns."

cues.zh: 下次再遇到这样的日子
cues.pinyin: xia4 ci4 zai4 yu4 dao4 zhe4 yang4 de5 ri4 zi5
cues.en: The next time such a day occurs

cues.zh: 就要等到 19 年之后的 20 45 年了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 deng3 dao4 19 nian2 zhi1 hou4 de5 20 45 nian2 le5
cues.en: won't be until 19 years later, in the year 2045.

cues.zh: 还有一个小朋友们很关心的事
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 men5 hen3 guan1 xin1 de5 shi4
cues.en: There's also something the kids are very concerned about.

cues.zh: 今年的春季学期是最近 20 年来有据可
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 de5 chun1 ji4 xue2 qi1 shi4 zui4 jin4 20 nian2 lai2 you3 ju4 ke3
cues.en: This year's spring semester is, as far as records show, the shortest

cues.zh: 查的最短学期
cues.pinyin: cha2 de5 zui4 duan3 xue2 qi1
cues.en: in the past 20 years.

cues.zh: 以北京市义务教育阶段为例
cues.pinyin: yi3 bei3 jing1 shi4 yi4 wu4 jiao4 yu4 jie1 duan4 wei4 li4
cues.en: Take Beijing's compulsory education stage as an example.

cues.zh: 从 3 月 2 日开学到 7 月 7 日放假
cues.pinyin: cong2 3 yue4 2 ri4 kai1 xue2 dao4 7 yue4 7 ri4 fang4 jia4
cues.en: School starts on March 2nd and summer break begins on July 7th.

cues.zh: 一共 12 8 天
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 12 8 tian1
cues.en: That's 128 days total.

cues.zh: 去掉周末清明五一端午和中高考放假
cues.pinyin: qu4 diao4 zhou1 mo4 qing1 ming2 wu3 yi1 duan1 wu3 he2 zhong1 gao1 kao3 fang4 jia4
cues.en: Subtract weekends, Qingming Festival, Labor Day, Dragon Boat Festival, and days off for the high school and college entrance exams,

cues.zh: 实际的在校时间恐怕只有 85 天左右
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 de5 zai4 xiao4 shi2 jian1 kong3 pa4 zhi3 you3 85 tian1 zuo3 you4
cues.en: and the actual time in school is probably only around 85 days.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 如果按照每天在校 8 小时计算
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 an4 zhao4 mei3 tian1 zai4 xiao4 8 xiao3 shi2 ji4 suan4
cues.en: If we calculate based on 8 hours in school per day,

cues.zh: 一共只有 6 80 小时
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 zhi3 you3 6 80 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: that's only 680 hours total.

cues.zh: 按照每天 24 小时算
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 mei3 tian1 24 xiao3 shi2 suan4
cues.en: Calculated as 24 hours a day,

cues.zh: 相当于 28 天
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dang1 yu2 28 tian1
cues.en: that's equivalent to about 28 days,

cues.zh: 也就是 4 周
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 4 zhou1
cues.en: or 4 weeks.

cues.zh: 现在开学已经三周了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 kai1 xue2 yi3 jing1 san1 zhou1 le5
cues.en: School has already been in session for three weeks now.

cues.zh: 一周之后大家就能放假了
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhou1 zhi1 hou4 da4 jia1 jiu4 neng2 fang4 jia4 le5
cues.en: After one more week, everyone gets to go on break.

cues.zh: 想一想还有点小激动
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yi1 xiang3 hai2 you3 dian3 xiao3 ji1 dong4
cues.en: Just thinking about it is a little exciting.

cues.zh: 大家有没有想过
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 you3 mei2 you3 xiang3 guo4
cues.en: Has everyone ever wondered

cues.zh: 为什么春分遇到龙抬头的日子很少见呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 chun1 fen1 yu4 dao4 long2 tai2 tou2 de5 ri4 zi5 hen3 shao3 jian4 ne5
cues.en: why it's so rare for the Spring Equinox to coincide with the "Dragon Raises Its Head" day?

cues.zh: 为什么今年的春季学期这么短呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 jin1 nian2 de5 chun1 ji4 xue2 qi1 zhe4 me5 duan3 ne5
cues.en: Or why this year's spring semester is so short?

cues.zh: 这一切都来源于两个字
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 qie4 dou1 lai2 yuan2 yu2 liang3 ge4 zi4
cues.en: It all comes down to two words:

cues.zh: 历法
cues.pinyin: li4 fa3
cues.en: "the calendar."

cues.zh: 一阳历与阴历
cues.pinyin: yi1 yang2 li4 yu3 yin1 li4
cues.en: First, the solar calendar and the lunar calendar.

cues.zh: 我小的时候家里老人把功历叫做阳历
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiao3 de5 shi2 hou4 jia1 li3 lao3 ren2 ba3 gong1 li4 jiao4 zuo4 yang2 li4
cues.en: When I was little, the elders at home called the Gregorian calendar the "solar calendar,"

cues.zh: 把农历叫做阴历
cues.pinyin: ba3 nong2 li4 jiao4 zuo4 yin1 li4
cues.en: and called the traditional Chinese calendar the "lunar calendar."

cues.zh: 这种说法只对了一半
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shuo1 fa3 zhi3 dui4 le5 yi2 ban4
cues.en: But that's only half right.

cues.zh: 阳历又叫太阳历
cues.pinyin: yang2 li4 you4 jiao4 tai4 yang2 li4
cues.en: The solar calendar is also called the "sun calendar."

cues.zh: 它把地球围绕太阳公转一圈的时间
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 di4 qiu2 wei2 rao4 tai4 yang2 gong1 zhuan4 yi1 quan1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: It defines the time it takes Earth to orbit the sun once

cues.zh: 规定为一年
cues.pinyin: gui1 ding4 wei4 yi1 nian2
cues.en: as one year.

cues.zh: 比如说 1900 年就不是闰年
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 1900 nian2 jiu4 bu2 shi4 run4 nian2
cues.en: The Gregorian calendar used worldwide today

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 比如说 19 00 年就不是润年
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 19 00 nian2 jiu4 bu2 shi4 run4 nian2
cues.en: for example, the year 1900 was not a leap year.

cues.zh: 如果年份能被四百整出
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 nian2 fen4 neng2 bei4 si4 bai3 zheng3 chu1
cues.en: if a year is evenly divisible by 400,

cues.zh: 那就又是润年
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 you4 shi4 run4 nian2
cues.en: then it is a leap year after all.

cues.zh: 比如说 2000 年就是润年
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 2000 nian2 jiu4 shi4 run4 nian2
cues.en: For example, the year 2000 was a leap year.

cues.zh: 大家知道为什么要这样做吗
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 zhe4 yang4 zuo4 ma5
cues.en: Does anyone know why it's done this way?

cues.zh: 你可以来算一算
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 lai2 suan4 yi1 suan4
cues.en: You can try calculating it yourself.

cues.zh: 按照这个规则
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 zhe4 ge5 gui1 ze2
cues.en: Following this rule,

cues.zh: 从公元一年到公元一万年
cues.pinyin: cong2 gong1 yuan2 yi1 nian2 dao4 gong1 yuan2 yi1 wan4 nian2
cues.en: from year 1 to year 10,000 AD,

cues.zh: 四的倍数有 25 00 个
cues.pinyin: si4 de5 bei4 shu4 you3 25 00 ge4
cues.en: there are 2,500 multiples of 4.

cues.zh: 100 的倍数有 100 个
cues.pinyin: 100 de5 bei4 shu4 you3 100 ge4
cues.en: There are 100 multiples of 100.

cues.zh: 400 的倍数有 25 个
cues.pinyin: 400 de5 bei4 shu4 you3 25 ge4
cues.en: There are 25 multiples of 400.

cues.zh: 所以一共有 25 100 加 25
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yi1 gong4 you3 25 100 jia1 25
cues.en: So in total there are 2,500 minus 100 plus 25,

cues.zh: 等于 24 25 个润日
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 24 25 ge4 run4 ri4
cues.en: which equals 2,425 leap days.

cues.zh: 平均到每年就是 36 5 24 25 天
cues.pinyin: ping2 jun1 dao4 mei3 nian2 jiu4 shi4 36 5 24 25 tian1
cues.en: Averaged per year, that's 365.2425 days.

cues.zh: 这和地球公转的周期 36 5
cues.pinyin: zhe4 he2 di4 qiu2 gong1 zhuan4 de5 zhou1 qi1 36 5
cues.en: and this is very close to Earth's orbital period

cues.zh: 24 22 天是非常接近的
cues.pinyin: 24 22 tian1 shi4 fei1 chang2 jie1 jin4 de5
cues.en: of 365.2422 days.

cues.zh: 说完了阳历
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wan2 le5 yang2 li4
cues.en: Now that we've covered the solar calendar,

cues.zh: 咱们再来说说阴历
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 zai4 lai2 shuo1 shuo1 yin1 li4
cues.en: let's talk about the lunar calendar.

cues.zh: 阴历就是以月相变化作为历法依据的
cues.pinyin: yin1 li4 jiu4 shi4 yi3 yue4 xiang4 bian4 hua4 zuo4 wei2 li4 fa3 yi1 ju4 de5
cues.en: The lunar calendar is based on the changing phases of the moon.

cues.zh: 人们很早以前就会通过观察月亮的
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 hen3 zao3 yi3 qian2 jiu4 hui4 tong1 guo4 guan1 cha2 yue4 liang4 de5
cues.en: People long ago learned to track time by observing the moon—

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 例如伊斯兰历法就是这样
cues.pinyin: li4 ru2 yi1 si1 lan2 li4 fa3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: the Islamic calendar, for instance, works this way.

cues.zh: 它的每一年与公历的时间大约相差 11 天
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 mei3 yi1 nian2 yu3 gong1 li4 de5 shi2 jian1 da4 yue1 xiang1 cha4 11 tian1
cues.en: Each of its years is about 11 days shorter than a Gregorian year.

cues.zh: 总结来说
cues.pinyin: zong3 jie2 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: To sum up,

cues.zh: 阳历每一年的时间和地球公转的时间一致
cues.pinyin: yang2 li4 mei3 yi1 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1 he2 di4 qiu2 gong1 zhuan4 de5 shi2 jian1 yi2 zhi4
cues.en: the solar calendar's year length matches Earth's orbital period,

cues.zh: 对于判断天气的变化
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 pan4 duan4 tian1 qi4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: which is very important for judging seasonal weather changes

cues.zh: 进行农业的生产非常的重要
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 nong2 ye4 de5 sheng1 chan3 fei1 chang2 de5 zhong4 yao4
cues.en: and for carrying out agricultural production.

cues.zh: 可是如果没有日历
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 mei2 you3 ri4 li4
cues.en: But without a calendar on hand,

cues.zh: 杨历的日子不是很好推算
cues.pinyin: yang2 li4 de5 ri4 zi5 bu2 shi4 hen3 hao3 tui1 suan4
cues.en: the days of the solar calendar aren't easy to calculate in your head.

cues.zh: 而且杨历中每个月有多少天是规定好的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 yang2 li4 zhong1 mei3 ge4 yue4 you3 duo1 shao3 tian1 shi4 gui1 ding4 hao3 de5
cues.en: Also, in the solar calendar the number of days in each month is fixed by rule

cues.zh: 不能适配月象的变化
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 shi4 pei4 yue4 xiang4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: and can't adapt to the changing phases of the moon.

cues.zh: 而阴历则刚好相反
cues.pinyin: er2 yin1 li4 ze2 gang1 hao3 xiang1 fan3
cues.en: The lunar calendar is just the opposite.

cues.zh: 每个月的时间都是和月象匹配的
cues.pinyin: mei3 ge4 yue4 de5 shi2 jian1 dou1 shi4 he2 yue4 xiang4 pi3 pei4 de5
cues.en: Each month's length matches the phase of the moon.

cues.zh: 是初一还是十五
cues.pinyin: shi4 chu1 yi1 hai2 shi4 shi2 wu3
cues.en: Whether it's the 1st or the 15th of the month,

cues.zh: 抬头看看月亮就知道了
cues.pinyin: tai2 tou2 kan4 kan4 yue4 liang4 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: you can tell just by looking up at the moon.

cues.zh: 对于不以农耕为主
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 bu4 yi3 nong2 geng1 wei2 zhu3
cues.en: For people who don't rely mainly on farming

cues.zh: 而是以游牧商业为主的阿拉伯民
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yi3 you2 mu4 shang1 ye4 wei2 zhu3 de5 a1 la1 bo2 min2
cues.en: but instead on nomadic herding and trade—

cues.zh: 族更加的实用
cues.pinyin: zu2 geng4 jia1 de5 shi2 yong4
cues.en: like Arab peoples—it's even more practical.

cues.zh: 但是阴历没有办法和地球的公转周期匹配
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 li4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 he2 di4 qiu2 de5 gong1 zhuan4 zhou1 qi1 pi3 pei4
cues.en: But the lunar calendar can't match Earth's orbital period.

cues.zh: 比如说穆斯林的开斋节
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 mu4 si1 lin2 de5 kai1 zhai1 jie2
cues.en: For example, the Islamic holiday of Eid al-Fitr

cues.zh: 有的时候在冬天
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 dong1 tian1
cues.en: is sometimes in winter

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 有的时候在夏天
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 zai4 xia4 tian1
cues.en: and sometimes in summer.

cues.zh: 那么中国的传统历法
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhong1 guo2 de5 chuan2 tong3 li4 fa3
cues.en: So what about China's traditional calendar—

cues.zh: 农历到底是阴历还是阳历呢
cues.pinyin: nong2 li4 dao4 di3 shi4 yin1 li4 hai2 shi4 yang2 li4 ne5
cues.en: is the Chinese calendar actually a lunar or a solar calendar?

cues.zh: 二农历
cues.pinyin: er4 nong2 li4
cues.en: Second, the Chinese calendar.

cues.zh: 实际上中国的农历既不是阴历
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 zhong1 guo2 de5 nong2 li4 ji4 bu2 shi4 yin1 li4
cues.en: In fact, China's traditional calendar is neither purely lunar

cues.zh: 也不是阳历
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu2 shi4 yang2 li4
cues.en: nor purely solar,

cues.zh: 而是阴阳和历
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yin1 yang2 he2 li4
cues.en: but a lunisolar calendar.

cues.zh: 中国自古就有阴阳调和的思想
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 zi4 gu3 jiu4 you3 yin1 yang2 tiao2 he2 de5 si1 xiang3
cues.en: China has had the idea of balancing yin and yang since ancient times.

cues.zh: 既要看太阳进行农业生产
cues.pinyin: ji4 yao4 kan4 tai4 yang2 jin4 xing2 nong2 ye4 sheng1 chan3
cues.en: You need the sun for farming,

cues.zh: 又要看月亮算日子
cues.pinyin: you4 yao4 kan4 yue4 liang4 suan4 ri4 zi5
cues.en: and the moon for counting days,

cues.zh: 赶集和祭祀
cues.pinyin: gan3 ji2 he2 ji4 si4
cues.en: for market days and ritual ceremonies.

cues.zh: 所以中国古人采用了一种
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhong1 guo2 gu3 ren2 cai3 yong4 le5 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: So the ancient Chinese adopted

cues.zh: 特别聪明的方法
cues.pinyin: te4 bie2 cong1 ming2 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: a particularly clever method:

cues.zh: 设置润月来调和地球公转周期
cues.pinyin: she4 zhi4 run4 yue4 lai2 tiao2 he2 di4 qiu2 gong1 zhuan4 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: inserting leap months to reconcile Earth's orbital period

cues.zh: 和月亮绕地球运动的周期
cues.pinyin: he2 yue4 liang4 rao4 di4 qiu2 yun4 dong4 de5 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: with the moon's orbital period around Earth.

cues.zh: 具体来讲
cues.pinyin: ju4 ti3 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: Specifically,

cues.zh: 农历把朔月出现的日子规定为初一
cues.pinyin: nong2 li4 ba3 shuo4 yue4 chu1 xian4 de5 ri4 zi5 gui1 ding4 wei4 chu1 yi1
cues.en: the Chinese calendar sets the day a new moon appears as the 1st of the month.

cues.zh: 两个朔月之间成为一个月
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 shuo4 yue4 zhi1 jian1 cheng2 wei2 yi2 ge4 yue4
cues.en: The time between two new moons is called one month.

cues.zh: 一个月的时间是 29 天或 30 天
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 de5 shi2 jian1 shi4 29 tian1 huo4 30 tian1
cues.en: Each month lasts either 29 or 30 days.

cues.zh: 每年的 12 个月有 35 4 到 35 5 天
cues.pinyin: mei3 nian2 de5 12 ge4 yue4 you3 35 4 dao4 35 5 tian1
cues.en: Each year's 12 months add up to 354 to 355 days.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】19年一遇！春分碰上“龙抬头”！一个视频弄清农历和二十四节气

cues.zh: 既能看月亮感激又能看太阳波肘
cues.pinyin: ji4 neng2 kan4 yue4 liang4 gan3 ji1 you4 neng2 kan4 tai4 yang2 bo1 zhou3
cues.en: so it can track time by the moon while also keeping pace with the sun.

cues.zh: 也正是因为 19 年期润的法则
cues.pinyin: ye3 zheng4 shi4 yin1 wei4 19 nian2 qi1 run4 de5 fa3 ze2
cues.en: And it's precisely because of the 19-year leap-month rule

cues.zh: 农历的日期和公历的日期
cues.pinyin: nong2 li4 de5 ri4 qi1 he2 gong1 li4 de5 ri4 qi1
cues.en: that the dates of the Chinese lunar calendar and the Gregorian calendar

cues.zh: 大约每 19 年重合一次
cues.pinyin: da4 yue1 mei3 19 nian2 chong2 he2 yi1 ci4
cues.en: coincide roughly once every 19 years.

cues.zh: 比如说你在 19 岁 38 岁 57 岁 76 岁 95 岁的时候
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ni3 zai4 19 sui4 38 sui4 57 sui4 76 sui4 95 sui4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: For example, when you turn 19, 38, 57, 76, or 95,

cues.zh: 农历的生日和公历的生日大概
cues.pinyin: nong2 li4 de5 sheng1 ri4 he2 gong1 li4 de5 sheng1 ri4 da4 gai4
cues.en: your lunar birthday and your Gregorian birthday

cues.zh: 率会在同一天
cues.pinyin: lv4 hui4 zai4 tong2 yi1 tian1
cues.en: will most likely fall on the same day.

cues.zh: 现在我们就可以解释
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Now we can explain

cues.zh: 为什么 20 26 年的春季学期这么短了
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 20 26 nian2 de5 chun1 ji4 xue2 qi1 zhe4 me5 duan3 le5
cues.en: why the 2026 spring semester is so short.

cues.zh: 如果某一年是农历的平年
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mou3 yi1 nian2 shi4 nong2 li4 de5 ping2 nian2
cues.en: If a given year is a "common year" in the lunar calendar,

cues.zh: 就会比公历年少 10 到 11 天
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 bi3 gong1 li4 nian2 shao4 10 dao4 11 tian1
cues.en: it will be 10 to 11 days shorter than a Gregorian year,

cues.zh: 第二年的农历新年就会提前 10 到 11 天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 nian2 de5 nong2 li4 xin1 nian2 jiu4 hui4 ti2 qian2 10 dao4 11 tian1
cues.en: so the next lunar new year will arrive 10 to 11 days earlier.

cues.zh: 反之如果某一年是农历闰年
cues.pinyin: fan3 zhi1 ru2 guo3 mou3 yi1 nian2 shi4 nong2 li4 run4 nian2
cues.en: Conversely, if a given year is a leap year in the lunar calendar,

cues.zh: 就会多一个闰月
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 duo1 yi2 ge4 run4 yue4
cues.en: it will have an extra leap month,

cues.zh: 比公历年多 18 到 19 天
cues.pinyin: bi3 gong1 li4 nian2 duo1 18 dao4 19 tian1
cues.en: making it 18 to 19 days longer than a Gregorian year,

cues.zh: 那么第二年的农历新年
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 di4 er4 nian2 de5 nong2 li4 xin1 nian2
cues.en: so the next year's lunar new year—

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 注意寻宝小伙捞起睁眼女尸竟
cues.pinyin: zhu4 yi4 xun2 bao3 xiao3 huo3 lao1 qi3 zheng1 yan3 nv3 shi1 jing4
cues.en: Watch out — the treasure hunter who fished up the open-eyed corpse actually

cues.zh: 发现喉咙卡着
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 hou2 long2 ka3 zhe5
cues.en: discovered something stuck in her throat:

cues.zh: 藏宝图和断指
cues.pinyin: cang2 bao3 tu2 he2 duan4 zhi3
cues.en: a treasure map and a severed finger.

cues.zh: 而沼泽断头男的眼球正紧紧盯着鱼群
cues.pinyin: er2 zhao3 ze2 duan4 tou2 nan2 de5 yan3 qiu2 zheng4 jin3 jin3 ding1 zhe5 yu2 qun2
cues.en: And the eyeball of the headless man in the swamp was staring intently at a school of fish.

cues.zh: 这血色沙岸的背后竟和一座圣母雕像有关
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xue4 se4 sha1 an4 de5 bei4 hou4 jing4 he2 yi1 zuo4 sheng4 mu3 diao1 xiang4 you3 guan1
cues.en: This blood-red shore turns out to be connected to a statue of the Virgin Mary.

cues.zh: 事情得从几天前的沼泽惊魂说起
cues.pinyin: shi4 qing2 de2 cong2 ji3 tian1 qian2 de5 zhao3 ze2 jing1 hun2 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: The story begins a few days ago with a scare in the swamp.

cues.zh: 警员老布和法医小谷接到匿名报案时正坐
cues.pinyin: jing3 yuan2 lao3 bu4 he2 fa3 yi1 xiao3 gu3 jie1 dao4 ni4 ming2 bao4 an4 shi2 zheng4 zuo4
cues.en: When officer Lao Bu and forensic examiner Xiao Gu got the anonymous tip, they were sitting

cues.zh: 着汽艇在那泥
cues.pinyin: zhe5 qi4 ting3 zai4 na4 ni2
cues.en: in a motorboat out in that mud pond,

cues.zh: 塘里批拨斩了
cues.pinyin: tang2 li3 pi1 bo1 zhan3 le5
cues.en: paddling along,

cues.zh: 只见沼泽中央飘着具高度腐烂的尸骸
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian4 zhao3 ze2 zhong1 yang1 piao1 zhe5 ju4 gao1 du4 fu3 lan4 de5 shi1 hai2
cues.en: when they spotted a highly decomposed corpse floating in the middle of the swamp.

cues.zh: 30 岁左右的男性尸体被野兽啃得只剩骨架
cues.pinyin: 30 sui4 zuo3 you4 de5 nan2 xing4 shi1 ti3 bei4 ye3 shou4 ken3 de2 zhi3 sheng4 gu3 jia4
cues.en: The male body, around 30 years old, had been gnawed by animals down to just a skeleton.

cues.zh: 身上连块破布都没剩
cues.pinyin: shen1 shang4 lian2 kuai4 po4 bu4 dou1 mei2 sheng4
cues.en: Not even a scrap of cloth was left on it.

cues.zh: 妥妥的抛尸现场
cues.pinyin: tuo3 tuo3 de5 pao1 shi1 xian4 chang3
cues.en: Clearly a body-dumping scene.

cues.zh: 好在小谷眼尖
cues.pinyin: hao3 zai4 xiao3 gu3 yan3 jian1
cues.en: Luckily, Xiao Gu had sharp eyes

cues.zh: 发现死者一只眼睛竟是假眼
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 si3 zhe3 yi1 zhi1 yan3 jing1 jing4 shi4 jia3 yan3
cues.en: and noticed one of the victim's eyes was actually a glass eye.

cues.zh: 老布赶紧顺着假体序列号一查
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 gan3 jin3 shun4 zhe5 jia3 ti3 xu4 lie4 hao4 yi1 cha2
cues.en: Lao Bu quickly traced the prosthetic eye's serial number,

cues.zh: 死者竟是当地海运古董博物馆的保安约翰
cues.pinyin: si3 zhe3 jing4 shi4 dang1 di4 hai3 yun4 gu3 dong3 bo2 wu4 guan3 de5 bao3 an1 yue1 han4
cues.en: and the victim turned out to be John, a security guard at the local maritime antiques museum.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 馆长丹尼尔听说员工被谋杀
cues.pinyin: guan3 zhang3 dan1 ni2 er3 ting1 shuo1 yuan2 gong1 bei4 mou2 sha1
cues.en: When curator Daniel heard his employee had been murdered,

cues.zh: 当场抖出猛料
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 dou3 chu1 meng3 liao4
cues.en: he immediately dropped a bombshell:

cues.zh: 这小子十天前就旷工
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiao3 zi5 shi2 tian1 qian2 jiu4 kuang4 gong1
cues.en: this guy had already been a no-show at work for ten days.

cues.zh: 起初以为他家里出事
cues.pinyin: qi3 chu1 yi3 wei2 ta1 jia1 li3 chu1 shi4
cues.en: At first they figured something had happened at his home,

cues.zh: 然而调监控却发现
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 diao4 jian1 kong4 que4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: but checking the surveillance footage, they found

cues.zh: 约翰最后一次上班时
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 zui4 hou4 yi1 ci4 shang4 ban1 shi2
cues.en: that the last time John showed up for work,

cues.zh: 竟从仓库鬼鬼祟祟顺
cues.pinyin: jing4 cong2 cang1 ku4 gui3 gui3 sui4 sui4 shun4
cues.en: he sneakily

cues.zh: 顺走张藏宝图
cues.pinyin: shun4 zou3 zhang1 cang2 bao3 tu2
cues.en: swiped a treasure map from the warehouse.

cues.zh: 图上标着西班牙运宝船的沉没地点
cues.pinyin: tu2 shang4 biao1 zhe5 xi1 ban1 ya2 yun4 bao3 chuan2 de5 chen2 mo4 di4 dian3
cues.en: The map marked the sinking location of a Spanish treasure ship.

cues.zh: 但丹尼尔直挠头
cues.pinyin: dan4 dan1 ni2 er3 zhi2 nao2 tou2
cues.en: But Daniel just scratched his head —

cues.zh: 博物馆曾收过一箱这种破地图
cues.pinyin: bo2 wu4 guan3 ceng2 shou1 guo4 yi1 xiang1 zhe4 zhong3 po4 di4 tu2
cues.en: the museum had once taken in a whole box of these junk maps,

cues.zh: 全是废纸
cues.pinyin: quan2 shi4 fei4 zhi3
cues.en: all worthless scrap paper.

cues.zh: 可约翰的死明显和这图脱不了干系
cues.pinyin: ke3 yue1 han4 de5 si3 ming2 xian3 he2 zhe4 tu2 tuo1 bu4 liao3 gan1 xi4
cues.en: Still, John's death was clearly tied to this map somehow.

cues.zh: 总不能是被纸扎死的吧
cues.pinyin: zong3 bu4 neng2 shi4 bei4 zhi3 zha1 si3 de5 ba5
cues.en: Surely he wasn't stabbed to death by a piece of paper?

cues.zh: 为了揪出真凶
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jiu1 chu1 zhen1 xiong1
cues.en: To root out the real killer,

cues.zh: 老布拽着小谷去见个狠角色
cues.pinyin: lao3 bu4 zhuai1 zhe5 xiao3 gu3 qu4 jian4 ge4 hen3 jue2 se4
cues.en: Lao Bu dragged Xiao Gu to meet a real tough character:

cues.zh: 他的退伍战友乔治
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tui4 wu3 zhan4 you3 qiao2 zhi4
cues.en: his discharged army buddy, George.

cues.zh: 这哥们自从受伤退伍后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge1 men5 zi4 cong2 shou4 shang1 tui4 wu3 hou4
cues.en: Ever since this guy got injured and left the service,

cues.zh: 竟觉醒人形金属探测器天赋
cues.pinyin: jing4 jue2 xing3 ren2 xing2 jin1 shu3 tan4 ce4 qi4 tian1 fu4
cues.en: he'd somehow awakened the talent of a human metal detector.

cues.zh: 此刻正翘着二郎腿在酒馆聊哲学
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 zheng4 qiao4 zhe5 er4 lang2 tui3 zai4 jiu3 guan3 liao2 zhe2 xue2
cues.en: Right now he's sitting with his legs crossed in a bar, chatting about philosophy.

cues.zh: 跟小谷搭话的安娜是情报贩子
cues.pinyin: gen1 xiao3 gu3 da1 hua4 de5 an1 na4 shi4 qing2 bao4 fan4 zi5
cues.en: Anna, who struck up a conversation with Xiao Gu, is an information broker.

cues.zh: 旁边坐着的黑人大叔赛文
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 zuo4 zhe5 de5 hei1 ren2 da4 shu1 sai4 wen2
cues.en: Sitting next to her is a Black guy named Seven.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 当乔治听到藏宝涂撒刺时
cues.pinyin: dang1 qiao2 zhi4 ting1 dao4 cang2 bao3 tu2 sa1 ci4 shi2
cues.en: When George heard about the treasure map,

cues.zh: 眼睛亮的能当电灯泡
cues.pinyin: yan3 jing1 liang4 de5 neng2 dang1 dian4 deng1 pao4
cues.en: his eyes lit up bright enough to work as a lightbulb.

cues.zh: 安娜却突然泼冷水
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 que4 tu1 ran2 po1 leng3 shui3
cues.en: But Anna suddenly threw cold water on it,

cues.zh: 显然不想让他过多参与
cues.pinyin: xian3 ran2 bu4 xiang3 rang4 ta1 guo4 duo1 can1 yu4
cues.en: clearly not wanting him to get too involved.

cues.zh: 但乔治拍着胸脯谈条件
cues.pinyin: dan4 qiao2 zhi4 pai1 zhe5 xiong1 pu2 tan2 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: But George, beating his chest, laid out his terms:

cues.zh: 让布谷组合负责破案写报告
cues.pinyin: rang4 bu4 gu3 zu3 he2 fu4 ze2 po4 an4 xie3 bao4 gao4
cues.en: the Bu-Gu duo would handle solving the case and writing the report,

cues.zh: 自己则负责挖宝藏
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 ze2 fu4 ze2 wa1 bao3 zang4
cues.en: while he himself would handle digging up the treasure.

cues.zh: 三人当场组成汉堡联盟
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 dang1 chang3 zu3 cheng2 han4 bao3 lian2 meng2
cues.en: The three of them formed the "Burger Alliance" on the spot.

cues.zh: 临走时
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 shi2
cues.en: As they were about to leave,

cues.zh: 乔治嘴欠来了句
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 zui3 qian4 lai2 le5 ju4
cues.en: George, being a smart mouth, couldn't help saying

cues.zh: 乔治神神秘秘的样子
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 shen2 shen2 mi4 mi4 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: — looking at how mysterious George was acting,

cues.zh: 怕不是天桥底下摆摊算卦的吧
cues.pinyin: pa4 bu2 shi4 tian1 qiao2 di3 xia4 bai3 tan1 suan4 gua4 de5 ba5
cues.en: he was probably just a fortune-teller running a stall under the overpass, right?

cues.zh: 对方瞬间被戳中软肋
cues.pinyin: dui4 fang1 shun4 jian1 bei4 chuo1 zhong1 ruan3 lei4
cues.en: That remark instantly hit a nerve.

cues.zh: 联盟让乔治考试
cues.pinyin: lian2 meng2 rang4 qiao2 zhi4 kao3 shi4
cues.en: The alliance decided to put George to the test.

cues.zh: 乔治丝毫不客气
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 si1 hao2 bu2 ke4 qi4
cues.en: George showed zero mercy,

cues.zh: 让他找到自己高一时丢的科学竞赛金牌
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 zhao3 dao4 zi4 ji3 gao1 yi1 shi2 diu1 de5 ke1 xue2 jing4 sai4 jin1 pai2
cues.en: having him find the gold medal he'd lost in a science competition back in tenth grade.

cues.zh: 结果乔治却甩下句快递马上到就迅速开溜
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 qiao2 zhi4 que4 shuai3 xia4 ju4 kuai4 di4 ma3 shang4 dao4 jiu4 xun4 su4 kai1 liu1
cues.en: As a result, George just said "my delivery's arriving any second" and bolted.

cues.zh: 没过多久
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Not long after,

cues.zh: 乔治小队杀到约翰家
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 xiao3 dui4 sha1 dao4 yue1 han4 jia1
cues.en: George's team showed up at John's place.

cues.zh: 安娜扫一眼屋里的破沙发和小区环境
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 sao3 yi1 yan3 wu1 li3 de5 po4 sha1 fa1 he2 xiao3 qu1 huan2 jing4
cues.en: Anna took a glance at the shabby sofa inside and the state of the neighborhood,

cues.zh: 判断约翰穷的叮当响
cues.pinyin: pan4 duan4 yue1 han4 qiong2 de5 ding1 dang1 xiang3
cues.en: and concluded John had been dirt poor.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 偷地图肯定是被人当枪使
cues.pinyin: tou1 di4 tu2 ken3 ding4 shi4 bei4 ren2 dang1 qiang1 shi3
cues.en: Stealing the map must mean someone had used him as a pawn.

cues.zh: 乔治见没有备用钥匙
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 jian4 mei2 you3 bei4 yong4 yao4 shi5
cues.en: Seeing there was no spare key, George

cues.zh: 突然像忍者一样从管道钻进房间
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 xiang4 ren3 zhe3 yi1 yang4 cong2 guan3 dao4 zuan1 jin4 fang2 jian1
cues.en: suddenly, ninja-style, squeezed in through a pipe into the room.

cues.zh: 安娜转头和赛文吐槽
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 zhuan3 tou2 he2 sai4 wen2 tu3 cao2
cues.en: Anna turned to Seven and griped,

cues.zh: 认为乔治迟早被当成变态抓进局子
cues.pinyin: ren4 wei2 qiao2 zhi4 chi2 zao3 bei4 dang4 cheng2 bian4 tai4 zhua1 jin4 ju2 zi5
cues.en: saying George would sooner or later get mistaken for a pervert and hauled off to jail.

cues.zh: 赛文却认为这没啥
cues.pinyin: sai4 wen2 que4 ren4 wei2 zhe4 mei2 sha2
cues.en: But Seven thought that was no big deal.

cues.zh: 两人随即闹得不欢而散
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 sui2 ji2 nao4 de2 bu4 huan1 er2 san4
cues.en: The two of them ended up arguing and splitting up on bad terms.

cues.zh: 房间里乔治活用他的人体定位系统
cues.pinyin: fang2 jian1 li3 qiao2 zhi4 huo2 yong4 ta1 de5 ren2 ti3 ding4 wei4 xi4 tong3
cues.en: Inside the room, George put his human GPS talent to use,

cues.zh: 在约翰家上演沉浸式死者剧本杀
cues.pinyin: zai4 yue1 han4 jia1 shang4 yan3 chen2 jin4 shi4 si3 zhe3 ju4 ben3 sha1
cues.en: staging an immersive murder-mystery reenactment in John's house.

cues.zh: 从压抑的环境判断
cues.pinyin: cong2 ya1 yi4 de5 huan2 jing4 pan4 duan4
cues.en: Judging from the depressing atmosphere,

cues.zh: 约翰估计患有抑郁症
cues.pinyin: yue1 han4 gu1 ji4 huan4 you3 yi4 yu4 zheng4
cues.en: John had probably suffered from depression.

cues.zh: 乔治扒拉着侦探小说直摇头
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 ba1 la1 zhe5 zhen1 tan4 xiao3 shuo1 zhi2 yao2 tou2
cues.en: Flipping through the detective novels, George shook his head —

cues.zh: 这个妥妥孤僻硬核玩家
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tuo3 tuo3 gu1 pi4 ying4 he2 wan2 jia1
cues.en: this guy was clearly a total reclusive hardcore fan,

cues.zh: 没对象没酒友
cues.pinyin: mei2 dui4 xiang4 mei2 jiu3 you3
cues.en: no partner, no drinking buddies,

cues.zh: 竟把硬汉小说当精神食粮
cues.pinyin: jing4 ba3 ying4 han4 xiao3 shuo1 dang1 jing1 shen2 shi2 liang2
cues.en: who treated hard-boiled crime novels as his spiritual nourishment.

cues.zh: 最近还卖了家里所有东西
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 hai2 mai4 le5 jia1 li3 suo3 you3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: He'd recently even sold off everything in his house,

cues.zh: 独独留着几百本破案书
cues.pinyin: du2 du2 liu2 zhe5 ji3 bai3 ben3 po4 an4 shu1
cues.en: keeping only a few hundred crime novels.

cues.zh: 乔治反差萌
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 fan3 cha4 meng2
cues.en: George found the contrast kind of endearing —

cues.zh: 怕不是看小说看魔愣
cues.pinyin: pa4 bu2 shi4 kan4 xiao3 shuo1 kan4 mo2 leng4
cues.en: guessing the guy had gotten obsessed from reading too many novels,

cues.zh: 把自己幻想成硬汉派的侦探
cues.pinyin: ba3 zi4 ji3 huan4 xiang3 cheng2 ying4 han4 pai4 de5 zhen1 tan4
cues.en: fantasizing himself as a hard-boiled detective,

cues.zh: 揣着地图就去闯江湖
cues.pinyin: chuai1 zhe5 di4 tu2 jiu4 qu4 chuang3 jiang1 hu2
cues.en: heading out into the world with the map tucked under his arm.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 这里竟还有另一拨人在蹲点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 jing4 hai2 you3 ling4 yi1 bo1 ren2 zai4 dun1 dian3
cues.en: Turns out another group was staking out this very spot.

cues.zh: 怕不是同行
cues.pinyin: pa4 bu2 shi4 tong2 hang2
cues.en: Probably rivals in the same line of work.

cues.zh: 三人组赶紧冲进当铺
cues.pinyin: san1 ren2 zu3 gan3 jin3 chong1 jin4 dang4 pu4
cues.en: The trio rushed straight into the pawn shop.

cues.zh: 面对询问
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Facing their questions,

cues.zh: 老板娘竟拿不是本人当挡箭牌
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 niang2 jing4 na2 bu2 shi4 ben3 ren2 dang1 dang3 jian4 pai2
cues.en: the shop owner used "it wasn't me" as her shield,

cues.zh: 甚至还对着俩大男人进行调戏
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hai2 dui4 zhe5 lia3 da4 nan2 ren2 jin4 xing2 tiao2 xi4
cues.en: and even started flirting with the two grown men.

cues.zh: 狠人话不多的安娜直接放大招
cues.pinyin: hen3 ren2 hua4 bu4 duo1 de5 an1 na4 zhi2 jie1 fang4 da4 zhao1
cues.en: Anna, a tough woman of few words, went straight for her big move:

cues.zh: 监管局刚查过你的卫生环境
cues.pinyin: jian1 guan3 ju2 gang1 cha2 guo4 ni3 de5 wei4 sheng1 huan2 jing4
cues.en: "The regulators just inspected your hygiene conditions —

cues.zh: 下水到堵的跟你唠嗑一样
cues.pinyin: xia4 shui3 dao4 du3 de5 gen1 ni3 lao4 ke1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: and next time, it'll be even worse, trust me."

cues.zh: 甚至还在当铺安装证据手机监控
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hai2 zai4 dang4 pu4 an1 zhuang1 zheng4 ju4 shou3 ji1 jian1 kong4
cues.en: She even claimed to have installed evidence-grade camera surveillance in the pawn shop.

cues.zh: 老板娘听完了认怂
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 niang2 ting1 wan2 le5 ren4 song3
cues.en: Hearing that, the owner backed down,

cues.zh: 迅速逃出把破优克里米
cues.pinyin: xun4 su4 tao2 chu1 ba3 po4 you1 ke4 li3 mi3
cues.en: quickly digging out some stuff and handing it over,

cues.zh: 表示前几天有个胸口纹
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 qian2 ji3 tian1 you3 ge4 xiong1 kou3 wen2
cues.en: saying that a few days earlier, a girl with a chest tattoo

cues.zh: 无可救药的姑娘前来点档
cues.pinyin: wu2 ke3 jiu4 yao4 de5 gu1 niang2 qian2 lai2 dian3 dang4
cues.en: who was clearly a hopeless case had come in to pawn something,

cues.zh: 甚至从中取走一张纸条
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 cong2 zhong1 qu3 zou3 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 tiao2
cues.en: and had even taken a slip of paper from among the pawned items.

cues.zh: 根据这条线索
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 zhe4 tiao2 xian4 suo3
cues.en: Based on this clue,

cues.zh: 几人迅速杀到纹身店
cues.pinyin: ji3 ren2 xun4 su4 sha1 dao4 wen2 shen1 dian4
cues.en: the group rushed straight to the tattoo shop.

cues.zh: 乔治靠纹身小哥兄弟情
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 kao4 wen2 shen1 xiao3 ge1 xiong1 di4 qing2
cues.en: Relying on bro-code with the tattoo guy, George

cues.zh: 立即找到给女孩纹身的大块头
cues.pinyin: li4 ji2 zhao3 dao4 gei3 nv3 hai2 wen2 shen1 de5 da4 kuai4 tou2
cues.en: immediately found the big burly guy who'd done the girl's tattoo.

cues.zh: 谁知乔治却嘴见家戏
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 qiao2 zhi4 que4 zui3 jian4 jia1 xi4
cues.en: Who knew George just couldn't help running his mouth,

cues.zh: 非要揭穿大块头
cues.pinyin: fei1 yao4 jie1 chuan1 da4 kuai4 tou2
cues.en: insisting on exposing the big guy's

cues.zh: 曾经搞液体快乐水生意的事情
cues.pinyin: ceng2 jing1 gao3 ye4 ti3 kuai4 le4 shui3 sheng1 yi4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: past dealings in the "happy water" (drug) business.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 番茄新鲜度90%，犯罪悬疑美剧尺度炸裂，剧情反转再反转。

cues.zh: 旁边的门神男
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 de5 men2 shen2 nan2
cues.en: The bouncer-looking guy standing nearby

cues.zh: 惊得下巴差点砸到脚趾头
cues.pinyin: jing1 de2 xia4 ba1 cha4 dian3 za2 dao4 jiao3 zhi3 tou2
cues.en: was so shocked his jaw nearly hit his own toes.

cues.zh: 等赛文和大块头友好交流完
cues.pinyin: deng3 sai4 wen2 he2 da4 kuai4 tou2 you3 hao3 jiao1 liu2 wan2
cues.en: After Seven and the big guy finished their "friendly" chat,

cues.zh: 终于扒出女孩叫劳娜
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 ba1 chu1 nv3 hai2 jiao4 lao2 na4
cues.en: they finally got out of him that the girl's name was Laura.

cues.zh: 终于扒出女孩叫劳拉
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 ba1 chu1 nv3 hai2 jiao4 lao2 la1
cues.en: When the group turned and rushed over to the bar,

cues.zh: 安娜正在分析人群热力图
cues.pinyin: an1 na4 zheng4 zai4 fen1 xi1 ren2 qun2 re4 li4 tu2
cues.en: Anna was busy analyzing the crowd heat map.

cues.zh: 乔治突然甩给她个史诗任务
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 tu1 ran2 shuai3 gei3 ta1 ge4 shi3 shi1 ren4 wu4
cues.en: George suddenly tossed her an epic quest:

cues.zh: 由于劳拉是拉了
cues.pinyin: you2 yu2 lao2 la1 shi4 la1 le5
cues.en: since Laura turned out to be a lesbian,

cues.zh: 便让她去色诱套话
cues.pinyin: bian4 rang4 ta1 qu4 se4 you4 tao4 hua4
cues.en: they had Anna go play honeypot and pump her for info.

cues.zh: 十只钢铁侄女安娜差点当场干五
cues.pinyin: shi2 zhi3 gang1 tie3 zhi2 nv3 an1 na4 cha4 dian3 dang1 chang3 gan4 wu3
cues.en: Anna, a through-and-through straight woman, nearly lost it on the spot —

cues.zh: 扎我跟人亲嘴
cues.pinyin: zha1 wo3 gen1 ren2 qin1 zui3
cues.en: "You want me to kiss someone?

cues.zh: 这是要我跟人亲嘴
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yao4 wo3 gen1 ren2 qin1 zui3
cues.en: I'd rather go grope alligators in the swamp!"

cues.zh: 正吵着
cues.pinyin: zheng4 chao3 zhe5
cues.en: Right as they were arguing about it,

cues.zh: 乔治却突然瞅见劳娜和鸡肉男
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 que4 tu1 ran2 chou3 jian4 lao2 na4 he2 ji1 rou4 nan2
cues.en: George suddenly spotted Laura and the guy they'd nicknamed "Chicken"

cues.zh: 亲得难舍难分
cues.pinyin: qin1 de2 nan2 she3 nan2 fen1
cues.en: locked in a kiss, inseparable.

cues.zh: 他立刻决定亲自上场
cues.pinyin: ta1 li4 ke4 jue2 ding4 qin1 zi4 shang4 chang3
cues.en: He immediately decided to step in personally,

cues.zh: 并让安娜趁机搜劳拉的车
cues.pinyin: bing4 rang4 an1 na4 chen4 ji1 sou1 lao2 la1 de5 che1
cues.en: and had Anna search Laura's car in the meantime.

cues.zh: 然而他刚摆出妖娆姿劳拉就嫌弃的直皱眉
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 ta1 gang1 bai3 chu1 yao1 rao2 zi1 lao2 la1 jiu4 xian2 qi4 de5 zhi2 zhou4 mei2
cues.en: But the moment he struck a seductive pose, Laura just scowled in disgust,

cues.zh: 活像看见沼子里飘来的臭袜子
cues.pinyin: huo2 xiang4 kan4 jian4 zhao3 zi5 li3 piao1 lai2 de5 chou4 wa4 zi5
cues.en: like she'd just seen a stinky sock floating up out of the swamp.

cues.zh: 乔治只好化身牛皮糖从酒吧跟到码头
cues.pinyin: qiao2 zhi4 zhi3 hao3 hua4 shen1 niu2 pi2 tang2 cong2 jiu3 ba1 gen1 dao4 ma3 tou2
cues.en: George had no choice but to turn into sticky toffee, tailing her from the bar all the way to the docks,

cues.zh: 劳拉一路骂骂咧咧相装了自动对人程序
cues.pinyin: lao2 la1 yi1 lu4 ma4 ma4 lie1 lie1 xiang1 zhuang1 le5 zi4 dong4 dui4 ren2 cheng2 xu4
cues.en: while Laura cursed him out the whole way, like she had an auto-retort program installed.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 2019 年的双十一当天天猫的销售额
cues.pinyin: 2019 nian2 de5 shuang1 shi2 yi1 dang4 tian1 tian1 mao1 de5 xiao1 shou4 e2
cues.en: On Double Eleven Day in 2019, Tmall's sales revenue

cues.zh: 就达到 26 84 亿
cues.pinyin: jiu4 da2 dao4 26 84 yi4
cues.en: reached 268.4 billion yuan.

cues.zh: 不过网络上有很多人质疑天猫的
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 wang3 luo4 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 ren2 zhi4 yi2 tian1 mao1 de5
cues.en: But many people online questioned whether Tmall's

cues.zh: 数据是造假的
cues.pinyin: shu4 ju4 shi4 zao4 jia3 de5
cues.en: data was fabricated.

cues.zh: 面对质疑阿里巴巴高层纷纷回应
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 zhi4 yi2 a1 li3 ba1 ba1 gao1 ceng2 fen1 fen1 hui2 ying4
cues.en: Facing the doubts, Alibaba's executives responded one after another:

cues.zh: 我们绝对没有也毫无必要造假
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jue2 dui4 mei2 you3 ye3 hao2 wu2 bi4 yao4 zao4 jia3
cues.en: "We absolutely did not, nor had any need to, falsify data."

cues.zh: 在生活中我们经常要接触各种各样的数据
cues.pinyin: zai4 sheng1 huo2 zhong1 wo3 men5 jing1 chang2 yao4 jie1 chu4 ge4 zhong3 ge4 yang4 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: In daily life we often come across all kinds of data.

cues.zh: 有没有一种方法可以方便的检验数据
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 yi1 zhong3 fang1 fa3 ke3 yi3 fang1 bian4 de5 jian3 yan4 shu4 ju4
cues.en: Is there a convenient way to test whether data

cues.zh: 到底是真实的
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 shi4 zhen1 shi2 de5
cues.en: is genuinely real,

cues.zh: 还是经过人为篡改呢
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 jing1 guo4 ren2 wei2 cuan4 gai3 ne5
cues.en: or has been artificially tampered with?

cues.zh: 这回再给大家介绍一个有趣的定律叫
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui2 zai4 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi2 ge4 you3 qu4 de5 ding4 lv4 jiao4
cues.en: This time I'll introduce an interesting law called

cues.zh: 做本福特定律
cues.pinyin: zuo4 ben3 fu2 te4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: Benford's Law.

cues.zh: 我们没准可以通过这个本福特定律
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 mei2 zhun3 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 ben3 fu2 te4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: We might be able to use this Benford's Law

cues.zh: 来判断天猫这个数据有没有作假
cues.pinyin: lai2 pan4 duan4 tian1 mao1 zhe4 ge5 shu4 ju4 you3 mei2 you3 zuo4 jia3
cues.en: to judge whether Tmall's data was faked.

cues.zh: 本福特定律讲的是什么呢
cues.pinyin: ben3 fu2 te4 ding4 lv4 jiang3 de5 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What does Benford's Law say?

cues.zh: 首先我问大家这样一个问题
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 wen4 da4 jia1 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: First let me ask you all a question.

cues.zh: 说有一些数据这些数据是自然的数据
cues.pinyin: shuo1 you3 yi1 xie1 shu4 ju4 zhe4 xie1 shu4 ju4 shi4 zi4 ran2 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: Suppose there's some data that is "natural" data.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 比如说一个国家的人口 G DP 国土面积
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 yi2 ge4 guo2 jia1 de5 ren2 kou3 G DP guo2 tu3 mian4 ji1
cues.en: For example, a country's population, GDP, land area —

cues.zh: 这样的自然数据
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 zi4 ran2 shu4 ju4
cues.en: that kind of natural data.

cues.zh: 没有经过人为的修改的数据
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 jing1 guo4 ren2 wei2 de5 xiu1 gai3 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: Data that hasn't been manually altered,

cues.zh: 而且它是杂乱无章的
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 shi4 za2 luan4 wu2 zhang1 de5
cues.en: and that is disorderly/random.

cues.zh: 很多国家的 G DP 那肯定没什么关系
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 guo2 jia1 de5 G DP na4 ken3 ding4 mei2 shen2 me5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: The GDPs of many countries certainly have no particular relation to each other —

cues.zh: 是杂乱无章的
cues.pinyin: shi4 za2 luan4 wu2 zhang1 de5
cues.en: they're disorderly/random.

cues.zh: 那么这些自然的杂乱无章的数据
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 xie1 zi4 ran2 de5 za2 luan4 wu2 zhang1 de5 shu4 ju4
cues.en: So for this kind of natural, random data,

cues.zh: 那么它有一个首数或者说首位
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 shou3 shu4 huo4 zhe3 shuo1 shou3 wei4
cues.en: it has a leading digit, or first digit.

cues.zh: 首位可能是 1
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 ke3 neng2 shi4 1
cues.en: The first digit could be 1.

cues.zh: 比如说 1000 亿它首位就是 1
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 1000 yi4 ta1 shou3 wei4 jiu4 shi4 1
cues.en: For example, for 100 billion, the first digit is 1.

cues.zh: 20 那首位就是 2
cues.pinyin: 20 na4 shou3 wei4 jiu4 shi4 2
cues.en: For 20, the first digit is 2.

cues.zh: 35 首位就是 3
cues.pinyin: 35 shou3 wei4 jiu4 shi4 3
cues.en: For 35, the first digit is 3.

cues.zh: 那手位为 1 手位为 1 的概率有多大
cues.pinyin: na4 shou3 wei4 wei4 1 shou3 wei4 wei4 1 de5 gai4 lv4 you3 duo1 da4
cues.en: So what's the probability that the first digit is 1?

cues.zh: 想问大家这么一个问题
cues.pinyin: xiang3 wen4 da4 jia1 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I want to ask you all this question.

cues.zh: 那么可能很多同学会想
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ke3 neng2 hen3 duo1 tong2 xue2 hui4 xiang3
cues.en: Many of you might think

cues.zh: 首位为 1 的概率那很简单
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 wei4 1 de5 gai4 lv4 na4 hen3 jian3 dan1
cues.en: the probability of the first digit being 1 is simple:

cues.zh: 1 9 分之 1 为什么呢
cues.pinyin: 1 9 fen1 zhi1 1 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5

cues.zh: 因为首位可以是 12 3 45 67 89
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shou3 wei4 ke3 yi3 shi4 12 3 45 67 89
cues.en: Because the first digit can be 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9,

cues.zh: 每一种可能都是相等的
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 zhong3 ke3 neng2 dou1 shi4 xiang1 deng3 de5
cues.en: and every possibility is equally likely.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 首位是 1 的概率远远超过 1 9 大概有 30
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 shi4 1 de5 gai4 lv4 yuan3 yuan3 chao1 guo4 1 9 da4 gai4 you3 30
cues.en: But the probability of the first digit being 1 far exceeds 1/9 — it's about 30%.

cues.zh: 那么这个规律是谁发现的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4 shi4 shui2 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: So who discovered this pattern?

cues.zh: 就是有两位科学家
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 you3 liang3 wei4 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: There were two scientists.

cues.zh: 一个是在 18 81 年的时候
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 zai4 18 81 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: One was in 1881,

cues.zh: 有一位天文学家名字叫纽康
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 wei4 tian1 wen2 xue2 jia1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 niu3 kang1
cues.en: an astronomer named Newcomb.

cues.zh: 我们以前谈到过这个人
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi3 qian2 tan2 dao4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: We've talked about him before.

cues.zh: 还有就是在 19 38 年的时候
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 jiu4 shi4 zai4 19 38 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: And then in 1938,

cues.zh: 有一个物理学家名字叫本福特
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 ben3 fu2 te4
cues.en: there was a physicist named Benford.

cues.zh: 他们两个人各自独立的发现了这个规律
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 liang3 ge4 ren2 ge4 zi4 du2 li4 de5 fa1 xian4 le5 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4
cues.en: The two of them independently discovered this pattern.

cues.zh: 就是首位是 1 的这样的数字
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shou3 wei4 shi4 1 de5 zhe4 yang4 de5 shu4 zi4
cues.en: Namely, numbers whose first digit is 1

cues.zh: 概率远远超过其他的数字
cues.pinyin: gai4 lv4 yuan3 yuan3 chao1 guo4 qi2 ta1 de5 shu4 zi4
cues.en: occur far more often than other numbers.

cues.zh: 传说是他们在查找对数表的时候
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shuo1 shi4 ta1 men5 zai4 cha2 zhao3 dui4 shu4 biao3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Legend has it that while they were looking things up in logarithm tables,

cues.zh: 发现对数表前几页总是被翻得很烂
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 dui4 shu4 biao3 qian2 ji3 ye4 zong3 shi4 bei4 fan1 de2 hen3 lan4
cues.en: they noticed the first few pages of the tables were always worn out from use.

cues.zh: 他就说原来首位是 1 的数字特别多
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 yuan2 lai2 shou3 wei4 shi4 1 de5 shu4 zi4 te4 bie2 duo1
cues.en: They realized that numbers starting with 1 were especially common,

cues.zh: 所以人们总去查这个前面的这对数表
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ren2 men5 zong3 qu4 cha2 zhe4 ge5 qian2 mian4 de5 zhe4 dui4 shu4 biao3
cues.en: so people kept looking up those early pages of the log tables,

cues.zh: 所以前面这几节就翻烂了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qian2 mian4 zhe4 ji3 jie2 jiu4 fan1 lan4 le5
cues.en: which is why those front sections got worn out.

cues.zh: 而且他们得出了这样的一个规律
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 de2 chu1 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 gui1 lv4
cues.en: And they arrived at a pattern like this:

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 所以就是 2 2 也就是 log 2
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 shi4 2 2 ye3 jiu4 shi4 log 2
cues.en: the probability for first digit 1 is log 2.

cues.zh: log 2 等于几
cues.pinyin: log 2 deng3 yu2 ji3
cues.en: What does log 2 equal?

cues.zh: 等于 30 1
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 30 1
cues.en: It equals 0.301.

cues.zh: 所以说在自然界中
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 zai4 zi4 ran2 jie4 zhong1
cues.en: So in nature,

cues.zh: 首位是 1 的数字大概占了 30
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 shi4 1 de5 shu4 zi4 da4 gai4 zhan4 le5 30
cues.en: numbers starting with 1 make up about 30%.

cues.zh: 那么首位是 2 的就等于 log 3 分之 2
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 shou3 wei4 shi4 2 de5 jiu4 deng3 yu2 log 3 fen1 zhi1 2
cues.en: And for first digit 2, it equals log(3/2),

cues.zh: 这个数大概是 17 6
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shu4 da4 gai4 shi4 17 6
cues.en: which is about 17.6%.

cues.zh: 就要小很多了对吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 xiao3 hen3 duo1 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: That's quite a bit smaller, right?

cues.zh: 一直到首位是 9 的这个数字就特别少
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 dao4 shou3 wei4 shi4 9 de5 zhe4 ge5 shu4 zi4 jiu4 te4 bie2 shao3
cues.en: Going all the way to first digit 9, where it's especially small.

cues.zh: 它是 log 10 分之 9 的对数
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 log 10 fen1 zhi1 9 de5 dui4 shu4
cues.en: It's log(10/9),

cues.zh: 它等于多少呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 deng3 yu2 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: which equals what?

cues.zh: 大概是 4 6
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 4 6
cues.en: About 4.6%.

cues.zh: 如果我们要是画出一个图像的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 yao4 shi4 hua4 chu1 yi2 ge4 tu2 xiang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If we were to plot this as a graph,

cues.zh: 按照本福特定律的预测
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 ben3 fu2 te4 ding4 lv4 de5 yu4 ce4
cues.en: according to Benford's Law's prediction,

cues.zh: 应该是这个样子的
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: it should look like this.

cues.zh: 首位出现的概率以及首位数
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 chu1 xian4 de5 gai4 lv4 yi3 ji2 shou3 wei4 shu4
cues.en: The probability of each first digit, versus the first digit itself —

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 首位数当然可以是 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 shu4 dang1 ran2 ke3 yi3 shi4 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9
cues.en: the first digit can of course be 1 through 9,

cues.zh: 首位数可以是这么多种
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 shu4 ke3 yi3 shi4 zhe4 me5 duo1 zhong3
cues.en: that many possible values.

cues.zh: 相应的概率它就是这样的一个列表
cues.pinyin: xiang1 ying4 de5 gai4 lv4 ta1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 lie4 biao3
cues.en: The corresponding probabilities form a list like this.

cues.zh: 我们把它画成一个曲线
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 hua4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 qu1 xian4
cues.en: If we plot it as a curve,

cues.zh: 大概是这个样子的
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: it looks roughly like this.

cues.zh: 大概是这个样子的
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5
cues.en: Roughly like this.

cues.zh: 在首位是 1 的这个地方概率特别大
cues.pinyin: zai4 shou3 wei4 shi4 1 de5 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 gai4 lv4 te4 bie2 da4
cues.en: At first digit 1, the probability is especially high,

cues.zh: 大概有 30 1
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 you3 30 1
cues.en: about 30.1%.

cues.zh: 首位是 9 的概率特别小
cues.pinyin: shou3 wei4 shi4 9 de5 gai4 lv4 te4 bie2 xiao3
cues.en: At first digit 9, the probability is especially small,

cues.zh: 大概是 4 6
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 shi4 4 6
cues.en: about 4.6%.

cues.zh: 这就是本负特定律了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ben3 fu4 te4 ding4 lv4 le5
cues.en: This is Benford's Law.

cues.zh: 说那这个规律到底对不对
cues.pinyin: shuo1 na4 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4 dao4 di3 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: So, is this pattern actually correct?

cues.zh: 我们得拿数据去验证
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de2 na2 shu4 ju4 qu4 yan4 zheng4
cues.en: We have to test it with real data.

cues.zh: 比如说我们随便拿一个数据
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 sui2 bian4 na2 yi2 ge4 shu4 ju4
cues.en: For example, let's just take some data at random,

cues.zh: 好比说是这个国家的美国国家的人口

cues.en: Then we can draw a bar chart, right? A bar chart.

cues.en: If we look at this bar chart, we find

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】如何识别数据造假？神奇的本福特定律

cues.zh: 所谓跨度大就是你得跨越几个量级
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 kua4 du4 da4 jiu4 shi4 ni3 de2 kua4 yue4 ji3 ge4 liang4 ji2
cues.en: that "large span" means the data needs to cross several orders of magnitude.

cues.zh: 你比如说
cues.pinyin: ni3 bi3 ru2 shuo1
cues.en: For example,

cues.zh: 你说人的身高满不满足本福特定律
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 ren2 de5 shen1 gao1 man3 bu4 man3 zu2 ben3 fu2 te4 ding4 lv4
cues.en: does human height satisfy Benford's Law?

cues.zh: 那它也不满足为什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 ye3 bu4 man3 zu2 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: No, it doesn't — why?

cues.zh: 因为人的身高都一米多对吧
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ren2 de5 shen1 gao1 dou1 yi1 mi3 duo1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Because people's heights are all around one meter something, right?

cues.zh: 你低于一米的或者高于两米的这个很少
cues.pinyin: ni3 di1 yu2 yi1 mi3 de5 huo4 zhe3 gao1 yu2 liang3 mi3 de5 zhe4 ge5 hen3 shao3
cues.en: Very few people are under one meter or over two meters,

cues.zh: 它跨度太小所以也不行
cues.pinyin: ta1 kua4 du4 tai4 xiao3 suo3 yi3 ye3 bu4 xing2
cues.en: so its span is too small, which also doesn't work.

cues.zh: 我们得跨越几个数量级的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de2 kua4 yue4 ji3 ge4 shu4 liang4 ji2 de5
cues.en: We need data that spans several orders of magnitude.

cues.zh: 那我就找了几个数据
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 zhao3 le5 ji3 ge4 shu4 ju4
cues.en: So I found a few data sets.

cues.zh: 比如说我找了什么数据呢
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 zhao3 le5 shen2 me5 shu4 ju4 ne5
cues.en: What data did I find, for example?

cues.zh: 第一个就是我的视频播放量
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 de5 shi4 pin2 bo1 fang4 liang4
cues.en: The first one is my video view counts.

cues.zh: 我的视频播放量是什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 shi4 pin2 bo1 fang4 liang4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What do I mean by my video view counts?

cues.zh: 我经常在网上放一些视频
cues.pinyin: wo3 jing1 chang2 zai4 wang3 shang4 fang4 yi1 xie1 shi4 pin2
cues.en: I often post videos online.

cues.zh: 这些视频有的可能制作好一点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shi4 pin2 you3 de5 ke3 neng2 zhi4 zuo4 hao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Some of these videos might be made a bit better,

cues.zh: 所以播放量就大
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bo1 fang4 liang4 jiu4 da4
cues.en: so they get more views.

cues.zh: 有的制作不太好播放量就小
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 zhi4 zuo4 bu4 tai4 hao3 bo1 fang4 liang4 jiu4 xiao3
cues.en: Some aren't made as well, so they get fewer views.

cues.zh: 所以这播放量数据变化很大
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 bo1 fang4 liang4 shu4 ju4 bian4 hua4 hen3 da4
cues.en: So the view-count data varies a lot.

cues.zh: 我在一个平台里面上传了 26 6 个视频
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 yi2 ge4 ping2 tai2 li3 mian4 shang4 chuan2 le5 26 6 ge4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: I uploaded 266 videos on one platform.

cues.zh: 这 26 6 个视频最少的播放量是 2 万
cues.pinyin: zhe4 26 6 ge4 shi4 pin2 zui4 shao3 de5 bo1 fang4 liang4 shi4 2 wan4
cues.en: Of these 266 videos, the lowest view count was 20,000.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 家常红烧肉的做法 |赞不绝口|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 红烧肉首先我们给猪皮先去毛
cues.pinyin: hong2 shao1 rou4 shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 gei3 zhu1 pi2 xian1 qu4 mao2
cues.en: For red-braised pork, first we remove the hair from the pork skin.

cues.zh: 接下来用冷水煮五花肉
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 yong4 leng3 shui3 zhu3 wu3 hua1 rou4
cues.en: Next, boil the pork belly in cold water.

cues.zh: 煮到开了之后呢再煮一分钟
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dao4 kai1 le5 zhi1 hou4 ne5 zai4 zhu3 yi4 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Once it boils, cook for one more minute.

cues.zh: 现在我们可以把这个五花肉切
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 wu3 hua1 rou4 qie4
cues.en: Now we can cut the pork belly

cues.zh: 成四方的小块
cues.pinyin: cheng2 si4 fang1 de5 xiao3 kuai4
cues.en: into small square chunks.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 家常红烧肉的做法 |赞不绝口|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 在这个锅子里我们加三汤匙的油 8 拌蒜
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo1 zi5 li3 wo3 men5 jia1 san1 tang1 chi2 de5 you2 8 ban4 suan4
cues.en: In this pot, we add three tablespoons of oil and sauté the garlic.

cues.zh: 然后这个蒜呢一直给它炒到金黄色为止
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 suan4 ne5 yi4 zhi2 gei3 ta1 chao3 dao4 jin1 huang2 se4 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Then keep frying the garlic until it turns golden.

cues.zh: 把蒜拿出来之后先放在旁边
cues.pinyin: ba3 suan4 na2 chu1 lai2 zhi1 hou4 xian1 fang4 zai4 pang2 bian1
cues.en: Take the garlic out and set it aside for now.

cues.zh: 这时在锅子里我们加三片姜
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 zai4 guo1 zi5 li3 wo3 men5 jia1 san1 pian4 jiang1
cues.en: Now add three slices of ginger to the pot.

cues.zh: 把我们刚刚切好的五花肉放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 men5 gang1 gang1 qie4 hao3 de5 wu3 hua1 rou4 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Add the pork belly we just cut.

cues.zh: 然后也是给它上色
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 shang4 se4
cues.en: Then sear it to give it some color too.

cues.zh: 这样子的味道会比较香
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 wei4 dao4 hui4 bi3 jiao4 xiang1
cues.en: This way the flavor will be more fragrant.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 家常红烧肉的做法 |赞不绝口|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 放四杯的水
cues.pinyin: fang4 si4 bei1 de5 shui3
cues.en: Add four cups of water.

cues.zh: 三个八角
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 ba1 jiao3
cues.en: Three star anise.

cues.zh: 四分之一个陈皮
cues.pinyin: si4 fen1 zhi1 yi2 ge4 chen2 pi2
cues.en: A quarter piece of dried tangerine peel.

cues.zh: 五汤匙酱油
cues.pinyin: wu3 tang1 chi2 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Five tablespoons of soy sauce.

cues.zh: 一汤匙老抽
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 lao3 chou1
cues.en: One tablespoon of dark soy sauce.

cues.zh: 少许的盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 de5 yan2
cues.en: A little salt.

cues.zh: 一杯绍兴酒
cues.pinyin: yi1 bei1 shao4 xing1 jiu3
cues.en: One cup of Shaoxing wine.

cues.zh: 现在呢我们把它盖一盖
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 gai4 yi1 gai4
cues.en: Now let's cover it with a lid.

cues.zh: 用大火煮十分钟
cues.pinyin: yong4 da4 huo3 zhu3 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Cook on high heat for ten minutes.

cues.zh: 在一个小锅里我们加两汤匙的水
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 guo1 li3 wo3 men5 jia1 liang3 tang1 chi2 de5 shui3
cues.en: In a small pot, add two tablespoons of water.

cues.zh: 2 汤匙的黄冰糖
cues.pinyin: 2 tang1 chi2 de5 huang2 bing1 tang2
cues.en: Two tablespoons of yellow rock sugar.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 家常红烧肉的做法 |赞不绝口|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 这个时候再加 2 汤匙的油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 zai4 jia1 2 tang1 chi2 de5 you2
cues.en: At this point, add two more tablespoons of oil.

cues.zh: 这个糖浆会让我们的红烧肉看起来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tang2 jiang1 hui4 rang4 wo3 men5 de5 hong2 shao1 rou4 kan4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: This syrup will make our red-braised pork look

cues.zh: 颜色非常的亮丽红润
cues.pinyin: yan2 se4 fei1 chang2 de5 liang4 li4 hong2 run4
cues.en: very glossy and rosy in color.

cues.zh: 把糖浆倒入刚刚的锅里
cues.pinyin: ba3 tang2 jiang1 dao4 ru4 gang1 gang1 de5 guo1 li3
cues.en: Pour the syrup into the pot from before.

cues.zh: 用小火继续煮
cues.pinyin: yong4 xiao3 huo3 ji4 xu4 zhu3
cues.en: Continue cooking on low heat.

cues.zh: 煮 50 分钟
cues.pinyin: zhu3 50 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Cook for 50 minutes.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 家常红烧肉的做法 |赞不绝口|【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 今天这个红烧肉真的是非常的好吃
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 hong2 shao1 rou4 zhen1 de5 shi4 fei1 chang2 de5 hao3 chi1
cues.en: This red-braised pork today is really delicious.

cues.zh: 肥而不腻
cues.pinyin: fei2 er2 bu4 ni4
cues.en: Fatty but not greasy.

cues.zh: 吃起来反倒有一种爽口的感觉
cues.pinyin: chi1 qi3 lai2 fan3 dao4 you3 yi1 zhong3 shuang3 kou3 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: In fact, it feels refreshing when you eat it.

cues.zh: 就连是这种不敢吃肥肉的人
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 bu4 gan3 chi1 fei2 rou4 de5 ren2
cues.en: Even people who are afraid to eat fatty meat

cues.zh: 吃了之后都会赞不绝口
cues.pinyin: chi1 le5 zhi1 hou4 du1 hui4 zan4 bu4 jue2 kou3
cues.en: will be full of praise after trying it.

cues.zh: 他的秘密武器其实就是这个陈皮
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 mi4 mi4 wu3 qi4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 chen2 pi2
cues.en: Its secret weapon is actually this dried tangerine peel.

cues.zh: 只需要放一点点
cues.pinyin: zhi3 xu1 yao4 fang4 yi4 dian3 dian3
cues.en: You only need to add a tiny bit.

cues.zh: 味道就非常的清爽非常的好吃
cues.pinyin: wei4 dao4 jiu4 fei1 chang2 de5 qing1 shuang3 fei1 chang2 de5 hao3 chi1
cues.en: It makes the flavor very refreshing and delicious.

cues.zh: 可是如果放多了之后
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ru2 guo3 fang4 duo1 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: But if you add too much,

cues.zh: 反倒有一种酸苦的味道
cues.pinyin: fan3 dao4 you3 yi1 zhong3 suan1 ku3 de5 wei4 dao4
cues.en: it instead gets a sour, bitter taste.

cues.zh: 所以不要这样子做
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bu2 yao4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4
cues.en: So don't do that.

cues.zh: 那这个食谱其实是罗师傅给我的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3 qi2 shi2 shi4 luo2 shi1 fu4 gei3 wo3 de5
cues.en: This recipe was actually given to me by Chef Luo.

cues.zh: 当时是我们要一起来做
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 shi4 wo3 men5 yao4 yi4 qi3 lai2 zuo4
cues.en: Back then we were supposed to make it together.

cues.zh: 在我怀孕的时候一起做
cues.pinyin: zai4 wo3 huai2 yun4 de5 shi2 hou4 yi4 qi3 zuo4
cues.en: Make it together while I was pregnant.

cues.zh: 那后来真的是有点来不及了
cues.pinyin: na4 hou4 lai2 zhen1 de5 shi4 you3 dian3 lai2 bu4 ji2 le5
cues.en: But later there just wasn't enough time.

cues.zh: 所以现在我决定自己做这个食谱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xian4 zai4 wo3 jue2 ding4 zi4 ji3 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3
cues.en: So now I've decided to make this recipe myself.

cues.zh: 那罗师傅现在的新唐人电视台
cues.pinyin: na4 luo2 shi1 fu4 xian4 zai4 de5 xin1 tang2 ren2 dian4 shi4 tai2
cues.en: Chef Luo is now at New Tang Dynasty Television

cues.zh: 也有做一些自己的食谱
cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 zuo4 yi1 xie1 zi4 ji3 de5 shi2 pu3
cues.en: also making some of his own recipes

cues.zh: 自己的节目
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 de5 jie2 mu4
cues.en: his own show.

cues.zh: 希望大家也可以去关注一下
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 ye3 ke3 yi3 qu4 guan1 zhu4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: I hope everyone can go check it out too.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一位讲佛学的大学教授火了：为什么寺庙六成香客是年轻人？A university professor who lectured on Buddhism goes

cues.zh: 社会大变动之下
cues.pinyin: she4 hui4 da4 bian4 dong4 zhi1 xia4
cues.en: Amid great social upheaval,

cues.zh: 年轻一代就面临未来极大的不确定性
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 yi2 dai4 jiu4 mian4 lin2 wei4 lai2 ji2 da4 de5 bu4 que4 ding4 xing4
cues.en: the younger generation faces enormous uncertainty about the future.

cues.zh: 寺庙作为我们过去认为是充满玄
cues.pinyin: si4 miao4 zuo4 wei2 wo3 men5 guo4 qu4 ren4 wei2 shi4 chong1 man3 xuan2
cues.en: Temples, which we used to think of as a space filled with mysticism and the metaphysical —

cues.zh: 学的一个空间
cues.pinyin: xue2 de5 yi2 ge4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: that kind of space —

cues.zh: 提供了一种冥冥的安慰感
cues.pinyin: ti2 gong1 le5 yi1 zhong3 ming2 ming2 de5 an1 wei4 gan3
cues.en: offer a mysterious sense of comfort.

cues.zh: 过去我们的父母总是告诉你你考了酒吧
cues.pinyin: guo4 qu4 wo3 men5 de5 fu4 mu3 zong3 shi4 gao4 su4 ni3 ni3 kao3 le5 jiu3 ba1
cues.en: In the past, our parents always told you: as long as you get into a good university —

cues.zh: 我考了北大清华
cues.pinyin: wo3 kao3 le5 bei3 da4 qing1 hua2
cues.en: say, I got into Peking University or Tsinghua —

cues.zh: 他会认为你稳了但怎么可能
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ren4 wei2 ni3 wen3 le5 dan4 zen3 me5 ke3 neng2
cues.en: they'd think you've got it made — but how could that really be the case?

cues.zh: 你看在日本终身雇佣也在崩溃
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 zai4 ri4 ben3 zhong1 shen1 gu4 yong1 ye3 zai4 beng1 kui4
cues.en: Look at Japan — even lifetime employment is collapsing there.

cues.zh: 其实失业最大的冲击是师尊心受
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi1 ye4 zui4 da4 de5 chong1 ji1 shi4 shi1 zun1 xin1 shou4
cues.en: Actually, the biggest blow from unemployment is that your self-esteem

cues.zh: 到很大的垂折
cues.pinyin: dao4 hen3 da4 de5 chui2 zhe2
cues.en: takes a huge hit.

cues.zh: 他从一个大厂去开滴滴落差很大
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 yi2 ge4 da4 chang3 qu4 kai1 di1 di1 luo4 cha4 hen3 da4
cues.en: He goes from working at a big tech company to driving for Didi — the contrast is huge.

cues.zh: 没钱他可以降低生活标准
cues.pinyin: mei2 qian2 ta1 ke3 yi3 jiang4 di1 sheng1 huo2 biao1 zhun3
cues.en: If you have no money, you can lower your standard of living.

cues.zh: 他不能接受的是降低生活标准以后
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 neng2 jie1 shou4 de5 shi4 jiang4 di1 sheng1 huo2 biao1 zhun3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: What he can't accept is that after lowering his standard of living,

cues.zh: 对自己的否定
cues.pinyin: dui4 zi4 ji3 de5 fou3 ding4
cues.en: comes a kind of self-denial.

cues.zh: 从佛学的角度来说
cues.pinyin: cong2 fo2 xue2 de5 jiao3 du4 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: From a Buddhist perspective,

cues.zh: 无常的思想
cues.pinyin: wu2 chang2 de5 si1 xiang3
cues.en: the concept of impermanence —

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一位讲佛学的大学教授火了：为什么寺庙六成香客是年轻人？A university professor who lectured on Buddhism goes

cues.zh: 所谓的躺平就是卷而不得
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 de5 tang3 ping2 jiu4 shi4 juan3 er2 bu4 de2
cues.en: so-called 'lying flat' is really just grinding hard and getting nowhere.

cues.zh: 看到别人过上那么幸福的生活
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 bie2 ren2 guo4 shang4 na4 me5 xing4 fu2 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: Seeing others living such happy lives,

cues.zh: 你发觉你竞争无望
cues.pinyin: ni3 fa1 jue2 ni3 jing4 zheng1 wu2 wang4
cues.en: you realize you have no hope of competing,

cues.zh: 然后你就觉得那人生没有意义
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 jiu4 jue2 de5 na4 ren2 sheng1 mei2 you3 yi4 yi4
cues.en: and then you feel life has no meaning —

cues.zh: 干脆我也不干了
cues.pinyin: gan1 cui4 wo3 ye3 bu4 gan4 le5
cues.en: so you just give up altogether.

cues.zh: 无非就是这种求不得苦的一种现
cues.pinyin: wu2 fei1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 zhong3 qiu2 bu4 de2 ku3 de5 yi1 zhong3 xian4
cues.en: it's really just a modern version of this kind of

cues.zh: 代的翻版而已
cues.pinyin: dai4 de5 fan1 ban3 er2 yi3
cues.en: 'suffering of not getting what you want.'

cues.zh: 我们其实可以换一种心态
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 qi2 shi2 ke3 yi3 huan4 yi1 zhong3 xin1 tai4
cues.en: We can actually adopt a different mindset.

cues.zh: 我在观察我能做什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 guan1 cha2 wo3 neng2 zuo4 shen2 me5
cues.en: I observe what I'm able to do,

cues.zh: 我就做好那件事情
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zuo4 hao3 na4 jian4 shi4 qing2
cues.en: and I just focus on doing that one thing well.

cues.zh: 因为你的生命你如果不去自己实践

cues.zh: 佛学它非常强调一个要摄心

cues.en: Using methods like meditation and Chan practice,

cues.en: So when facing society,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】牛顿炒股为何赔了几十年工资？史上最有钱的公司是哪个？（经济泡沫系列二）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有一个小朋友问我说世界
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 shi4 jie4
cues.en: Recently a young student asked me, in the world

cues.zh: 上最有钱的公
cues.pinyin: shang4 zui4 you3 qian2 de5 gong1
cues.en: the richest company

cues.zh: 司是哪一个呢

cues.en: which one is it?

cues.zh: 你可能会想到微软苹果谷歌亚马逊
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 hui4 xiang3 dao4 wei1 ruan3 ping2 guo3 gu3 ge1 ya4 ma3 xun4
cues.en: You might think of Microsoft, Apple, Google, Amazon

cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hai2 you3 tong2 xue2 hui4 xiang3 dao4 200 7 nian2 de5 zhong1 guo2 shi2 you2
cues.en: or even China National Petroleum back in 2007

cues.zh: 不过这些公司在历史上连前五名都达不到
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 xie1 gong1 si1 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 lian2 qian2 wu3 ming2 dou1 da2 bu2 dao4
cues.en: But none of these companies even make the top five in history

cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 jiu4 xiang3 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 li4 shi3 shang4 shi4 zhi2 zui4
cues.en: Today we want to talk about the companies with the largest

cues.zh: 大的几个公司
cues.pinyin: da4 de5 ji3 ge4 gong1 si1
cues.en: market value in history

cues.zh: 同时还要填一下三个月前挖的坑
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hai2 yao4 tian2 yi1 xia4 san1 ge4 yue4 qian2 wa1 de5 keng1
cues.en: and also fill in a hole we dug three months ago

cues.pinyin: niu2 dun4 shi4 ru2 he2 chao3 gu3 pei2 diao4 ji3 shi2 nian2 gong1 zi1 de5
cues.en: how Newton lost decades of salary trading stocks

cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 400 nian2 qian2 he2 lan2 de5 yi2 ge4 gong1 si1
cues.en: Let's first talk about a Dutch company from 400 years ago

cues.zh: 这个公司叫做荷兰东印度公司
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gong1 si1 jiao4 zuo4 he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: This company is called the Dutch East India Company

cues.zh: 荷兰东印度公司
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: The Dutch East India Company

cues.zh: 荷兰东印度公司是如何产生的呢
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 shi4 ru2 he2 chan3 sheng1 de5 ne5
cues.en: How did the Dutch East India Company come about?

cues.zh: 它最早是经营香料贸易的
cues.pinyin: ta1 zui4 zao3 shi4 jing1 ying2 xiang1 liao4 mao4 yi4 de5
cues.en: It originally dealt in the spice trade

items.title: 李永乐老师

cues.zh: 西方人特别需要东方的香料
cues.pinyin: xi1 fang1 ren2 te4 bie2 xu1 yao4 dong1 fang1 de5 xiang1 liao4
cues.en: Westerners badly needed spices from the East

cues.zh: 比如说肉桂胡椒这些东西
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 rou4 gui4 hu2 jiao1 zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi1
cues.en: things like cinnamon and pepper

cues.zh: 因为这些东西可以让他们的食
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi1 ke3 yi3 rang4 ta1 men5 de5 shi2
cues.en: because these things could make their food

cues.zh: 物保存得更久
cues.pinyin: wu4 bao3 cun2 de2 geng4 jiu3
cues.en: last longer

cues.zh: 那么香料贸易在最开始
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 xiang1 liao4 mao4 yi4 zai4 zui4 kai1 shi3
cues.en: So in the spice trade, at the very beginning

cues.pinyin: dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 chu1 xian4 zhi1 qian2 shi4 zen3 me5 mao4 yi4 de5 ne5
cues.en: before the East India Company appeared, how was trade done?

cues.zh: 有两条路
cues.pinyin: you3 liang3 tiao2 lu4
cues.en: There were two routes

cues.zh: 第一条路就是陆地
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 tiao2 lu4 jiu4 shi4 lu4 di4
cues.en: The first route was by land

cues.zh: 你可以从陆地把这个香料从东南亚
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 cong2 lu4 di4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xiang1 liao4 cong2 dong1 nan2 ya4
cues.en: You could transport spices overland from Southeast Asia

cues.zh: 贩运到西欧去
cues.pinyin: fan4 yun4 dao4 xi1 ou1 qu4
cues.en: to Western Europe

cues.zh: 那么陆地的话你就要经过奥斯
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 lu4 di4 de5 hua4 ni3 jiu4 yao4 jing1 guo4 ao4 si1
cues.en: For the land route, you had to pass through the Ottoman

cues.zh: 曼土耳其帝国
cues.pinyin: man4 tu3 er3 qi2 di4 guo2
cues.en: Turkish Empire

cues.zh: 同时还要经过比如说威尼斯
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hai2 yao4 jing1 guo4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 wei1 ni2 si1
cues.en: and also pass through, say, Venice

cues.zh: 那威尼斯的这个商人他非常的苛刻对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 wei1 ni2 si1 de5 zhe4 ge5 shang1 ren2 ta1 fei1 chang2 de5 ke1 ke4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: and those Venetian merchants were very harsh, right?

cues.zh: 所以他会扣你很多的钱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 hui4 kou4 ni3 hen3 duo1 de5 qian2
cues.en: so they'd charge you a lot of money

cues.zh: 西欧的人拿到这个香料价格非常贵
cues.pinyin: xi1 ou1 de5 ren2 na2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 xiang1 liao4 jia4 ge2 fei1 chang2 gui4
cues.en: Europeans who got the spice paid a very high price

cues.zh: 那于是有人就想我们能不能从海洋上
cues.pinyin: na4 yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 jiu4 xiang3 wo3 men5 neng2 bu4 neng2 cong2 hai3 yang2 shang4
cues.en: So someone thought, could we open up

cues.zh: 开辟出第二条贸易通道呢
cues.pinyin: kai1 pi4 chu1 di4 er4 tiao2 mao4 yi4 tong1 dao4 ne5
cues.en: a second trade route by sea?

cues.zh: 这个主要的人就是西班牙和葡萄牙人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhu3 yao4 de5 ren2 jiu4 shi4 xi1 ban1 ya2 he2 pu2 tao2 ya2 ren2
cues.en: The main people behind this were the Spanish and Portuguese

cues.zh: 那么在 16 世纪 17 世纪的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 16 shi4 ji4 17 shi4 ji4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: In the 16th and 17th centuries

cues.en: Now everyone pay attention

cues.zh: 东印度公司这个名字在历史上有很多个
cues.pinyin: dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 zhe4 ge5 ming2 zi4 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 you3 hen3 duo1 ge4
cues.en: There have been many companies named 'East India Company' in history

cues.zh: 英国也有法国也有
cues.pinyin: ying1 guo2 ye3 you3 fa3 guo2 ye3 you3
cues.en: Britain had one, France had one too

cues.zh: 而我们今天所谈的这个是荷兰
cues.pinyin: er2 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 suo3 tan2 de5 zhe4 ge5 shi4 he2 lan2
cues.en: and the one we're talking about today is the Dutch

cues.zh: 的东印度公司
cues.pinyin: de5 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: East India Company

cues.zh: 荷兰东印度公司在历史上是一个非
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 shi4 yi2 ge4 fei1
cues.en: The Dutch East India Company holds a very

cues.zh: 常重要的存在
cues.pinyin: chang2 zhong4 yao4 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: important place in history

cues.zh: 因为它是历史上第一家什么公司
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 li4 shi3 shang4 di4 yi1 jia1 shen2 me5 gong1 si1
cues.en: because it was the first what kind of company?

cues.zh: 第一家股份公司
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 jia1 gu3 fen4 gong1 si1
cues.en: the first joint-stock company

cues.zh: 股份公司什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: gu3 fen4 gong1 si1 shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does joint-stock company mean?

cues.zh: 就是说当时他们组建这个公司的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 dang1 shi2 ta1 men5 zu3 jian4 zhe4 ge5 gong1 si1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: It means when they set up this company

cues.zh: 得有投资者对吧
cues.pinyin: de2 you3 tou2 zi1 zhe3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: they needed investors, right?

cues.zh: 这 14 家公司的老板出钱
cues.pinyin: zhe4 14 jia1 gong1 si1 de5 lao3 ban3 chu1 qian2
cues.en: The bosses of these 14 companies put in money

cues.zh: 但是还是不够怎么办
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 shi4 bu4 gou4 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: but it still wasn't enough, what to do?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】牛顿炒股为何赔了几十年工资？史上最有钱的公司是哪个？（经济泡沫系列二）

cues.zh: 荷兰政府通过一定的优惠政策算是出钱了
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 zheng4 fu3 tong1 guo4 yi2 ding4 de5 you1 hui4 zheng4 ce4 suan4 shi4 chu1 qian2 le5
cues.en: the Dutch government chipped in through certain favorable policies

cues.zh: 但是还不够怎么办
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 bu4 gou4 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: but it still wasn't enough, what to do?

cues.zh: 有人想了个办法这样
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 xiang3 le5 ge4 ban4 fa3 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Someone thought of a solution

cues.zh: 咱们把这个公司发行一些股票
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 gong1 si1 fa1 xing2 yi1 xie1 gu3 piao4
cues.en: let's issue some shares for this company

cues.zh: 这些股票可以卖给这个荷兰的普通的市民
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 gu3 piao4 ke3 yi3 mai4 gei3 zhe4 ge5 he2 lan2 de5 pu3 tong1 de5 shi4 min2
cues.en: these shares could be sold to ordinary Dutch citizens

cues.zh: 这个普通市民买了这个股票之后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 pu3 tong1 shi4 min2 mai3 le5 zhe4 ge5 gu3 piao4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: after ordinary citizens bought these shares

cues.zh: 每年就可以有什么
cues.pinyin: mei3 nian2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 you3 shen2 me5
cues.en: every year they could get what?

cues.zh: 可以有分红可以有股息对吧
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 you3 fen1 hong2 ke3 yi3 you3 gu3 xi1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: they could get dividends, right?

cues.zh: 所以股息也是他发明的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 gu3 xi1 ye3 shi4 ta1 fa1 ming2 de5
cues.en: so dividends were also invented by them

cues.zh: 那么有很多的人都是公司的股
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 ren2 dou1 shi4 gong1 si1 de5 gu3
cues.en: Now there were many people who were shareholders of the company

cues.zh: 东谁来管理他
cues.pinyin: dong1 shui2 lai2 guan3 li3 ta1
cues.en: who would manage it?

cues.zh: 于是他们就选出了一个 17 个人代表
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 jiu4 xuan3 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 17 ge4 ren2 dai4 biao3
cues.en: so they elected a 17-person

cues.zh: 的一个董事会
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 ge4 dong3 shi4 hui4
cues.en: board of directors

cues.zh: 所以董事会也是最早由荷兰东印
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dong3 shi4 hui4 ye3 shi4 zui4 zao3 you2 he2 lan2 dong1 yin4
cues.en: so the board of directors was also first invented by the Dutch East

cues.zh: 度公司发明的
cues.pinyin: du4 gong1 si1 fa1 ming2 de5
cues.en: India Company

cues.zh: 同时还有一些投资者他买了这
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 tou2 zi1 zhe3 ta1 mai3 le5 zhe4
cues.en: At the same time, some investors who bought

cues.zh: 个股票之后说
cues.pinyin: ge4 gu3 piao4 zhi1 hou4 shuo1
cues.en: these shares later said

cues.zh: 不行我家里几用钱我必须把这个股退了
cues.pinyin: bu4 xing2 wo3 jia1 li3 ji3 yong4 qian2 wo3 bi4 xu1 ba3 zhe4 ge5 gu3 tui4 le5
cues.en: 'No, I urgently need money at home, I have to withdraw my shares'

cues.zh: 这个董事会就说了退股是不可能了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 dong3 shi4 hui4 jiu4 shuo1 le5 tui4 gu3 shi4 bu4 ke3 neng2 le5
cues.en: the board said

cues.zh: 但是你可以把这个股干嘛呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 gu3 gan4 ma2 ne5
cues.en: withdrawing shares isn't possible, but you can do what with them?

cues.zh: 你可以卖给其他投资者
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 mai4 gei3 qi2 ta1 tou2 zi1 zhe3
cues.en: you can sell them to other investors

cues.zh: 这样你就把钱拿回来了对不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ni3 jiu4 ba3 qian2 na2 hui2 lai2 le5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: that way you get your money back, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】牛顿炒股为何赔了几十年工资？史上最有钱的公司是哪个？（经济泡沫系列二）

cues.zh: 所以把很多的国家职能都赋予了这
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ba3 hen3 duo1 de5 guo2 jia1 zhi2 neng2 dou1 fu4 yu3 le5 zhe4
cues.en: so many state-like functions were granted to this

cues.zh: 个东印度公司
cues.pinyin: ge4 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: East India Company

cues.zh: 所以说这个荷兰东印度公司
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: So this Dutch East India Company

cues.zh: 在东南亚建立了很多的据点
cues.pinyin: zai4 dong1 nan2 ya4 jian4 li4 le5 hen3 duo1 de5 ju4 dian3
cues.en: set up many trading posts in Southeast Asia

cues.zh: 比如爪哇马六甲等等这些地方
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zhao3 wa1 ma3 liu4 jia3 deng3 deng3 zhe4 xie1 di4 fang1
cues.en: like Java, Malacca, and other places

cues.zh: 还在中国台湾
cues.pinyin: hai2 zai4 zhong1 guo2 tai2 wan1
cues.en: and also in Taiwan, China

cues.zh: 当时的清朝的台湾建立了一个据点
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 de5 qing1 chao2 de5 tai2 wan1 jian4 li4 le5 yi2 ge4 ju4 dian3
cues.en: they set up a trading post in the Qing-dynasty Taiwan of that era

cues.zh: 后来当然被这个郑成功给打跑了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 dang1 ran2 bei4 zhe4 ge5 zheng4 cheng2 gong1 gei3 da3 pao3 le5
cues.en: which was later driven out by Zheng Chenggong

cues.zh: 打跑的其实就是这个荷兰东印度公司的人
cues.pinyin: da3 pao3 de5 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 de5 ren2
cues.en: the ones driven out were actually people from the Dutch East India Company

cues.zh: 再后来这个东印度公司也不仅仅卖香料了
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 zhe4 ge5 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 ye3 bu4 jin3 jin3 mai4 xiang1 liao4 le5
cues.en: Later on, the East India Company didn't just sell spices anymore

cues.zh: 因为他发现中国还有瓷器和丝绸对吧
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 fa1 xian4 zhong1 guo2 hai2 you3 ci2 qi4 he2 si1 chou2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: because they discovered China also had porcelain and silk

cues.zh: 要把这些东西卖到了西欧去
cues.pinyin: yao4 ba3 zhe4 xie1 dong1 xi1 mai4 dao4 le5 xi1 ou1 qu4
cues.en: and sold these things to Western Europe

cues.zh: 所以赚了很多钱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhuan4 le5 hen3 duo1 qian2
cues.en: so they made a lot of money

cues.zh: 东印度公司在历史上持续了将
cues.pinyin: dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1 zai4 li4 shi3 shang4 chi2 xu4 le5 jiang1
cues.en: The East India Company lasted for nearly

cues.zh: 近 200 年的时间
cues.pinyin: jin4 200 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: 200 years in history

cues.zh: 它的股价翻了 100 倍左右
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 gu3 jia4 fan1 le5 100 bei4 zuo3 you4
cues.en: Its stock price rose about 100-fold

cues.zh: 所以当时的投资者都获得了丰厚的回报
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dang1 shi2 de5 tou2 zi1 zhe3 dou1 huo4 de2 le5 feng1 hou4 de5 hui2 bao4
cues.en: so investors at the time all got generous returns

cues.zh: 不仅仅是股价翻倍
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 gu3 jia4 fan1 bei4
cues.en: not just the stock price doubling

cues.zh: 它每年的分红据说有 40
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei3 nian2 de5 fen1 hong2 ju4 shuo1 you3 40
cues.en: its annual dividend was reportedly 40%

cues.zh: 而且在最高峰的时候
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zai4 zui4 gao1 feng1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: and at its peak

cues.zh: 东晋度公司的市值达到了 7 9 万亿
cues.pinyin: dong1 jin4 du4 gong1 si1 de5 shi4 zhi2 da2 dao4 le5 7 9 wan4 yi4
cues.en: the East India Company's market value reached 7.9 trillion

cues.zh: 小明去买早餐老板有没有
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 qu4 mai3 zao3 can1 lao3 ban3 you3 mei2 you3
cues.en: Xiao Ming goes to buy breakfast: 'Boss, do you have—'

cues.zh: 烧饼油条
cues.pinyin: shao1 bing3 you2 tiao2
cues.en: '—shaobing and youtiao (fried dough sticks)?'

cues.zh: 烧饼油条卖光了只有圣诞饼
cues.pinyin: shao1 bing3 you2 tiao2 mai4 guang1 le5 zhi3 you3 sheng4 dan4 bing3
cues.en: 'Shaobing and youtiao are sold out, we only have egg pancakes.'

cues.zh: 圣诞节又还没有到就开始卖
cues.pinyin: sheng4 dan4 jie2 you4 hai2 mei2 you3 dao4 jiu4 kai1 shi3 mai4
cues.en: 'Christmas hasn't even arrived and you're already selling Christmas cakes?'

cues.zh: 圣诞饼
cues.pinyin: sheng4 dan4 bing3
cues.en: 'Christmas cakes?'

cues.zh: 不是圣诞饼只有圣诞饼
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 sheng4 dan4 bing3 zhi3 you3 sheng4 dan4 bing3
cues.en: 'It's not Christmas cake — we only have egg pancakes.'

cues.zh: 只有蛋饼那就蛋饼吧
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 dan4 bing3 na4 jiu4 dan4 bing3 ba5
cues.en: 'Oh, just egg pancakes? Then I'll have an egg pancake.'

cues.zh: 有没有冰豆浆
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 bing1 dou4 jiang1
cues.en: 'Do you have iced soy milk?'

cues.zh: 冰豆浆也卖完了温热的好不好
cues.pinyin: bing1 dou4 jiang1 ye3 mai4 wan2 le5 wen1 re4 de5 hao3 bu4 hao3
cues.en: 'Iced soy milk is sold out too — how about warm?'

cues.zh: 豆浆还有温热的豆浆吗
cues.pinyin: dou4 jiang1 hai2 you3 wen1 re4 de5 dou4 jiang1 ma5
cues.en: 'Is there such a thing as warm soy milk?'

cues.zh: 我是说温热的好不好
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shuo1 wen1 re4 de5 hao3 bu4 hao3
cues.en: 'I said, how about warm, is that okay?'

cues.zh: 热的就热的
cues.pinyin: re4 de5 jiu4 re4 de5
cues.en: 'Fine, hot it is then.'

cues.zh: 阿我们的豆浆是会基因的喔
cues.pinyin: a1 wo3 men5 de5 dou4 jiang1 shi4 hui4 ji1 yin1 de5 o1
cues.en: 'Oh — our soy milk is genetic, you know.'

cues.zh: 老板
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3
cues.en: 'Boss—'

cues.zh: 为什么喝你们的豆浆会基因的啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 he1 ni3 men5 de5 dou4 jiang1 hui4 ji1 yin1 de5 a5
cues.en: 'Why would drinking your soy milk be genetic?'

cues.zh: 我是说吼
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 shuo1 hou3
cues.en: 'I mean—'

cues.zh: 我们的豆浆是会基因的喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 dou4 jiang1 shi4 hui4 ji1 yin1 de5 o1
cues.en: 'Our soy milk is genetic, okay?'

cues.zh: 我的国语有那么差吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 guo2 yu3 you3 na4 me5 cha4 ma5
cues.en: 'Is my Mandarin really that bad?'

cues.zh: 大象的妈妈还是大象
cues.pinyin: da4 xiang4 de5 ma1 ma1 hai2 shi4 da4 xiang4
cues.en: 'A baby elephant's mother is still an elephant.'

cues.zh: 错了是猩猩
cues.pinyin: cuo4 le5 shi4 xing1 xing1
cues.en: 'Wrong — it's an orangutan.'

cues.zh: 怎么可能大象的妈妈会是猩猩啊
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 ke3 neng2 da4 xiang4 de5 ma1 ma1 hui4 shi4 xing1 xing1 a5
cues.en: 'How could an elephant's mother be an orangutan?'

cues.zh: 因为像有猩猩

cues.en: 'Because 'resemble' already has 'orangutan' in it.'

cues.zh: 有一天妈妈带著小美到牙医诊所拔牙
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 ma1 ma1 dai4 zhu4 xiao3 mei3 dao4 ya2 yi1 zhen3 suo3 ba2 ya2
cues.en: One day, Mom took Xiaomei to the dentist to get a tooth pulled.

cues.zh: 牙医检查了小美的牙齿说
cues.pinyin: ya2 yi1 jian3 cha2 le5 xiao3 mei3 de5 ya2 chi3 shuo1
cues.en: The dentist examined Xiaomei's teeth and said,

cues.zh: 你有一颗蛀牙需要拔掉喔
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 yi1 ke1 zhu4 ya2 xu1 yao4 ba2 diao4 o1
cues.en: 'You have a cavity that needs to come out.'

cues.zh: 别怕别怕
cues.pinyin: bie2 pa4 bie2 pa4
cues.en: 'Don't be scared, don't be scared.'

cues.zh: 阿嬷最真就不疼了
cues.pinyin: a1 ma1 zui4 zhen1 jiu4 bu4 teng2 le5
cues.en: 'Once we numb it, it won't hurt.'

cues.zh: 大大我问你喔
cues.pinyin: da4 da4 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: 'Dada, let me ask you something.'

cues.zh: 喝五杯牛奶跟喝五杯高粱酒有什么差别
cues.pinyin: he1 wu3 bei1 niu2 nai3 gen1 he1 wu3 bei1 gao1 liang2 jiu3 you3 shen2 me5 cha1 bie2
cues.en: 'What's the difference between drinking five glasses of milk and five cups of sorghum liquor?'

cues.zh: 喝五杯牛奶去推墙壁墙壁不会动啊
cues.pinyin: he1 wu3 bei1 niu2 nai3 qu4 tui1 qiang2 bi4 qiang2 bi4 bu2 hui4 dong4 a5
cues.en: 'Drink five glasses of milk, go push a wall — the wall won't budge.'

cues.zh: 但是喝了五杯高粱酒不用你推墙
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 he1 le5 wu3 bei1 gao1 liang2 jiu3 bu4 yong4 ni3 tui1 qiang2
cues.en: 'But after five cups of sorghum liquor, you don't even need to push the wall—'

cues.zh: 壁会自己走耶
cues.pinyin: bi4 hui4 zi4 ji3 zou3 ye2
cues.en: '—the wall moves by itself.'

items.title_zh: 笑话37｜找不同🤔｜豆浆〝会积阴德〞｜5杯高粱酒｜〝魏芷婷〞是谁？｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 你们最佩服你们爸爸的什么啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 zui4 pei4 fu2 ni3 men5 ba4 ba4 de5 shen2 me5 a5
cues.en: 'What do you admire most about your dad?'

cues.zh: 我最佩服我爸爸的长相
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 pei4 fu2 wo3 ba4 ba4 de5 zhang3 xiang4
cues.en: 'I admire my dad's looks the most.'

cues.zh: 我最佩服我爸爸的自信
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 pei4 fu2 wo3 ba4 ba4 de5 zi4 xin4
cues.en: 'I admire my dad's confidence the most.'

cues.zh: 我最佩服我爸爸的儿子
cues.pinyin: wo3 zui4 pei4 fu2 wo3 ba4 ba4 de5 er2 zi5
cues.en: 'I admire my dad's son the most.'

cues.zh: 晨晨我问你哦
cues.pinyin: chen2 chen2 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2
cues.en: 'Chen Chen, let me ask you something.'

cues.zh: 你知道为什么我的刮胡刀不利的吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 de5 gua1 hu2 dao1 bu4 li4 de5 ma5
cues.en: 'Do you know why my razor isn't sharp?'
