items.title_zh: 笑话37｜找不同🤔｜豆浆〝会积阴德〞｜5杯高粱酒｜〝魏芷婷〞是谁？｜大大小小笑话｜

cues.zh: 一对夫妻在高级餐厅吃饭
cues.pinyin: yi1 dui4 fu1 qi1 zai4 gao1 ji2 can1 ting1 chi1 fan4
cues.en: A couple is dining at a fancy restaurant.

cues.zh: 上完菜之后丈夫说
cues.pinyin: shang4 wan2 cai4 zhi1 hou4 zhang4 fu1 shuo1
cues.en: After the food arrived, the husband said,

cues.zh: 看起来都很好吃赶快吃吧
cues.pinyin: kan4 qi3 lai2 dou1 hen3 hao3 chi1 gan3 kuai4 chi1 ba5
cues.en: 'Everything looks delicious, let's eat.'

cues.zh: 亲爱的你在家吃饭前不是都要先祷告吗
cues.pinyin: qin1 ai4 de5 ni3 zai4 jia1 chi1 fan4 qian2 bu2 shi4 dou1 yao4 xian1 dao3 gao4 ma5
cues.en: 'Honey, don't you always pray before eating at home?'

cues.zh: 那是因为在家
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 yin1 wei4 zai4 jia1
cues.en: 'That's because at home—'

cues.en: '—here, the chef should know how to cook, right?'

cues.zh: 这两张图有五个不一样的地方

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 从今天开始我想为大家导读爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: cong2 jin1 tian1 kai1 shi3 wo3 xiang3 wei4 da4 jia1 dao3 du2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: Starting today, I want to guide everyone through Einstein's

cues.zh: 的一本小册子
cues.pinyin: de5 yi1 ben3 xiao3 ce4 zi5
cues.en: booklet

cues.zh: 侠义与广义相对论浅说
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 yu3 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qian3 shuo1
cues.en: "Relativity: The Special and the General Theory"

cues.zh: 和大家一起聊一聊相对论
cues.pinyin: he2 da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 liao2 yi1 liao2 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: and discuss relativity together with you.

cues.zh: 相对论的书很多
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 shu1 hen3 duo1
cues.en: There are many books about relativity.

cues.zh: 为什么我要选择这一本书呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 yao4 xuan3 ze2 zhe4 yi1 ben3 shu1 ne5
cues.en: Why did I choose this particular book?

cues.zh: 因为在这本书的前沿之中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 zhe4 ben3 shu1 de5 qian2 yan2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: Because in the preface of this book,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦写道
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 xie3 dao4
cues.en: Einstein wrote:

cues.zh: 本书只在让那些对相对论感兴趣
cues.pinyin: ben3 shu1 zhi3 zai4 rang4 na4 xie1 dui4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 gan3 xing4 qu4
cues.en: this book is meant only to let those interested in relativity

cues.zh: 但是理论物理和数学又不太好的读者
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 li3 lun4 wu4 li3 he2 shu4 xue2 you4 bu4 tai4 hao3 de5 du2 zhe3
cues.en: but not so good at theoretical physics and math

cues.zh: 能够尽可能准确地理解相对论
cues.pinyin: neng2 gou4 jin3 ke3 neng2 zhun3 que4 di4 li3 jie3 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: understand relativity as accurately as possible.

cues.zh: 那我想这本书刚好适合我的知识水平
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 xiang3 zhe4 ben3 shu1 gang1 hao3 shi4 he2 wo3 de5 zhi1 shi2 shui3 ping2
cues.en: So I thought this book just suits my level of knowledge.

cues.zh: 我想无论你是中学生还是大学生
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wu2 lun4 ni3 shi4 zhong1 xue2 sheng1 huan2 shi4 da4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: I think whether you're a middle school student or a college student,

cues.zh: 无论是文科生还是理科生
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 wen2 ke1 sheng1 huan2 shi4 li3 ke1 sheng1
cues.en: whether you're in humanities or sciences,

cues.zh: 都一定听说过相对论这三个字吧
cues.pinyin: dou1 yi2 ding4 ting1 shuo1 guo4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhe4 san1 ge4 zi4 ba5
cues.en: you must have heard the term "theory of relativity," right?

cues.zh: 可是对于大多数人来说
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 dui4 yu2 da4 duo1 shu4 ren2 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: But for most people,

cues.zh: 相对论又实在太难了
cues.pinyin: xiang1 dui4 lun4 you4 shi2 zai4 tai4 nan2 le5
cues.en: relativity is really too difficult.

cues.zh: 这里还有一个小故事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 gu4 shi4
cues.en: There's also a little story here.

cues.zh: 全世界只有两个人懂相对论
cues.pinyin: quan2 shi4 jie4 zhi3 you3 liang3 ge4 ren2 dong3 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: Only two people in the world understood relativity.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 这个故事具体是这样的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gu4 shi4 ju4 ti3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: The story goes like this:

cues.zh: 在 19 19 年英国皇家学会的会议上
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 19 nian2 ying1 guo2 huang2 jia1 xue2 hui4 de5 hui4 yi4 shang4
cues.en: At a 1919 meeting of the Royal Society in Britain,

cues.zh: 爱丁顿爵士宣布了他测量的星光偏角
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 jue2 shi4 xuan1 bu4 le5 ta1 ce4 liang2 de5 xing1 guang1 pian1 jiao3
cues.en: Sir Eddington announced the deflection angle of starlight he had measured,

cues.zh: 与爱因斯坦在 19 15 年广义相对论
cues.pinyin: yu3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zai4 19 15 nian2 guang3 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: which matched Einstein's 1915 general relativity

cues.zh: 的预测相符合
cues.pinyin: de5 yu4 ce4 xiang1 fu2 he2
cues.en: prediction.

cues.zh: 那么会后自认为是相对论专家的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hui4 hou4 zi4 ren4 wei2 shi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 zhuan1 jia1 de5
cues.en: After the meeting, an American physicist who considered himself a relativity expert,

cues.zh: 美国物理学家希尔伯斯坦
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1 xi1 er3 bo2 si1 tan3
cues.en: Silberstein,

cues.zh: 与他闲聊的时候说
cues.pinyin: yu3 ta1 xian2 liao2 de5 shi2 hou4 shuo1
cues.en: chatted with him and said,

cues.zh: 爱丁顿教授
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 jiao4 shou4
cues.en: "Professor Eddington,

cues.zh: 您应该是世界上最了解相对论的
cues.pinyin: nin2 ying1 gai1 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 liao3 jie3 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5
cues.en: you must be one of the three people in the world

cues.zh: 三个人之一了
cues.pinyin: san1 ge4 ren2 zhi1 yi1 liao3
cues.en: who understand relativity best."

cues.zh: 当爱丁顿还在迟疑该如何回答的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 ai4 ding1 dun4 hai2 zai4 chi2 yi2 gai1 ru2 he2 hui2 da2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: While Eddington was still hesitating how to respond,

cues.zh: 希尔伯斯坦接着说
cues.pinyin: xi1 er3 bo2 si1 tan3 jie1 zhe5 shuo1
cues.en: Silberstein went on to say,

cues.zh: 不要太谦虚了
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 tai4 qian1 xu1 le5
cues.en: "Don't be so modest."

cues.zh: 爱丁顿终于回答说
cues.pinyin: ai4 ding1 dun4 zhong1 yu2 hui2 da2 shuo1
cues.en: Eddington finally replied,

cues.zh: 哦不
cues.pinyin: o2 bu4
cues.en: "Oh no,

cues.zh: 我是在想第三个人可能是谁
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zai4 xiang3 di4 san1 ge4 ren2 ke3 neng2 shi4 shui2
cues.en: I was just wondering who the third person might be."

cues.zh: 的确
cues.pinyin: di2 que4
cues.en: Indeed,

cues.zh: 在爱因斯坦刚刚提出相对论的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 gang1 gang1 ti2 chu1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when Einstein first proposed relativity,

cues.zh: 科学界一片哗然
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 jie4 yi1 pian4 hua2 ran2
cues.en: the scientific community was in uproar.

cues.zh: 许多科学家既没有弄懂
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 ke1 xue2 jia1 ji4 mei2 you3 nong4 dong3
cues.en: Many scientists neither understood it

cues.zh: 也不相信爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xiang1 xin4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: nor believed Einstein.

cues.zh: 而且爱因斯坦获得诺贝尔奖
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 huo4 de2 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: And Einstein won the Nobel Prize

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 不过在德国读书的时候
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zai4 de2 guo2 du2 shu1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: However, while studying in Germany,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦并没有表现出自己的天才
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 bing4 mei2 you3 biao3 xian4 chu1 zi4 ji3 de5 tian1 cai2
cues.en: Einstein didn't show any sign of being a genius.

cues.zh: 甚至因为德国的教育的严格
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 yin1 wei4 de2 guo2 de5 jiao4 yu4 de5 yan2 ge2
cues.en: In fact, the strictness of German education

cues.zh: 让爱因斯坦非常不舒服
cues.pinyin: rang4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 fei1 chang2 bu4 shu1 fu2
cues.en: made Einstein very uncomfortable.

cues.zh: 在 18 95 年爱因斯坦来到了瑞士
cues.pinyin: zai4 18 95 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 lai2 dao4 le5 rui4 shi4
cues.en: In 1895, Einstein came to Switzerland

cues.zh: 参加了瑞士的高考
cues.pinyin: can1 jia1 le5 rui4 shi4 de5 gao1 kao3
cues.en: and took Switzerland's college entrance exam.

cues.zh: 但是因为文科部分考得不好
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yin1 wei4 wen2 ke1 bu4 fen4 kao3 de2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: But because he did poorly on the humanities section,

cues.zh: 没有考上
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 kao3 shang4
cues.en: he didn't get in.

cues.zh: 于是就在瑞士的阿劳中学复读了一年
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 zai4 rui4 shi4 de5 a1 lao2 zhong1 xue2 fu4 du2 le5 yi1 nian2
cues.en: So he repeated a year at Aarau Cantonal School in Switzerland.

cues.zh: 阿劳中学宽松的学风
cues.pinyin: a1 lao2 zhong1 xue2 kuan1 song1 de5 xue2 feng1
cues.en: The relaxed academic atmosphere at Aarau

cues.zh: 给了爱因斯坦很多独立思考的机会
cues.pinyin: gei3 le5 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 hen3 duo1 du2 li4 si1 kao3 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: gave Einstein many opportunities for independent thinking.

cues.zh: 比如他曾经想过这样一个问题
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ta1 ceng2 jing1 xiang3 guo4 zhe4 yang4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: For example, he once pondered a question like this:

cues.zh: 如果一个人跑得跟光一样快
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 yi2 ge4 ren2 pao3 de2 gen1 guang1 yi1 yang4 kuai4
cues.en: if a person ran as fast as light,

cues.zh: 他会看到什么情景呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 kan4 dao4 shen2 me5 qing2 jing3 ne5
cues.en: what would he see?

cues.zh: 直到十年之后
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 shi2 nian2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: It wasn't until ten years later

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦自己回答了自己的问题
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 zi4 ji3 hui2 da2 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: that Einstein answered his own question.

cues.zh: 在第二年爱因斯坦高中毕业
cues.pinyin: zai4 di4 er4 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 gao1 zhong1 bi4 ye4
cues.en: The following year, Einstein graduated from high school.

cues.zh: 他的数学和物理考试都得了六分
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 shu4 xue2 he2 wu4 li3 kao3 shi4 dou1 de2 le5 liu4 fen1
cues.en: He scored a 6 in both math and physics.

cues.zh: 有人据此说爱因斯坦学习不好
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 ju4 ci3 shuo1 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 xue2 xi2 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Some people use this to claim Einstein wasn't good at school.

cues.zh: 我还考了 60 分
cues.pinyin: wo3 hai2 kao3 le5 60 fen1
cues.en: "I even scored 60."

cues.zh: 要知道瑞士高中毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4 rui4 shi4 gao1 zhong1 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: You should know that when graduating from Swiss high school,

cues.zh: 6 分就是满分了
cues.pinyin: 6 fen1 jiu4 shi4 man3 fen1 le5
cues.en: a 6 was a perfect score.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 从 19 00 年到 19 05 年爱因斯坦没有博士学位
cues.pinyin: cong2 19 00 nian2 dao4 19 05 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 mei2 you3 bo2 shi4 xue2 wei4
cues.en: From 1900 to 1905, Einstein had no doctoral degree.

cues.zh: 最初几年也没有工作狼狈至极
cues.pinyin: zui4 chu1 ji3 nian2 ye3 mei2 you3 gong1 zuo4 lang2 bei4 zhi4 ji2
cues.en: In the early years he had no job either, living in dire straits.

cues.zh: 后来在他的同学格罗斯曼的父亲的帮助下
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zai4 ta1 de5 tong2 xue2 ge2 luo2 si1 man4 de5 fu4 qin1 de5 bang1 zhu4 xia4
cues.en: Later, with the help of his classmate Grossmann's father,

cues.zh: 在博尔尼瑞士专利局当了一名小职员
cues.pinyin: zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 rui4 shi4 zhuan1 li4 ju2 dang1 le5 yi1 ming2 xiao3 zhi2 yuan2
cues.en: he became a minor clerk at the Swiss Patent Office in Bern.

cues.zh: 为了贴补家用
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 tie1 bu3 jia1 yong4
cues.en: To help support the family,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦还在当地的报纸
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 hai2 zai4 dang1 di4 de5 bao4 zhi3
cues.en: Einstein even placed an ad in the local newspaper,

cues.zh: 博尔尼市公告报上刊登广告
cues.pinyin: bo2 er3 ni2 shi4 gong1 gao4 bao4 shang4 kan1 deng1 guang3 gao4
cues.en: the Bern City Gazette:

cues.zh: 阿尔伯特爱因斯坦
cues.pinyin: a1 er3 bo2 te4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3
cues.en: "Albert Einstein

cues.zh: 愿意私人为大学生或者中学生
cues.pinyin: yuan4 yi4 si1 ren2 wei2 da4 xue2 sheng1 huo4 zhe3 zhong1 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: is willing to privately teach college or high school students

cues.zh: 彻底讲授数学和物理学
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 jiang3 shou4 shu4 xue2 he2 wu4 li3 xue2
cues.en: mathematics and physics thoroughly.

cues.zh: 本人持有苏黎世联邦工学院的
cues.pinyin: ben3 ren2 chi2 you3 su1 li2 shi4 lian2 bang1 gong1 xue2 yuan4 de5
cues.en: I hold a teaching qualification certificate from

cues.zh: 教师资格证书
cues.pinyin: jiao4 shi1 zi1 ge2 zheng4 shu1
cues.en: the Swiss Federal Polytechnic in Zurich.

cues.zh: 驻正义街 32 号一楼
cues.pinyin: zhu4 zheng4 yi4 jie1 32 hao4 yi1 lou2
cues.en: Located at No. 32 Justice Street, first floor.

cues.zh: 试听免费
cues.pinyin: shi4 ting1 mian3 fei4
cues.en: Trial lesson free."

cues.zh: 广告还真的招来了几个学生
cues.pinyin: guang3 gao4 hai2 zhen1 de5 zhao1 lai2 le5 ji3 ge4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: The ad really did attract a few students.

cues.pinyin: zai4 19 02 nian2

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦有了第一个学生索洛文
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 you3 le5 di4 yi2 ge4 xue2 sheng1 suo3 luo4 wen2
cues.en: Einstein got his first student, Solovine,

cues.zh: 当时正在博尔尼大学学习物理和哲学
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 zheng4 zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 da4 xue2 xue2 xi2 wu4 li3 he2 zhe2 xue2
cues.en: who was studying physics and philosophy at the University of Bern at the time.

cues.zh: 他觉得课堂内容太简单了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 ke4 tang2 nei4 rong2 tai4 jian3 dan1 le5
cues.en: He found the classroom content too simple,

cues.zh: 就来听爱因斯坦的课
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lai2 ting1 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 de5 ke4
cues.en: so he came to attend Einstein's lessons.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 收费课程结束之后
cues.pinyin: shou1 fei4 ke4 cheng2 jie2 shu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the paid lessons ended,

cues.zh: 二人又开始随心所欲地讨论物理和哲学
cues.pinyin: er4 ren2 you4 kai1 shi3 sui2 xin1 suo3 yu4 di4 tao3 lun4 wu4 li3 he2 zhe2 xue2
cues.en: the two of them started discussing physics and philosophy freely, as they pleased.

cues.zh: 后来又加入了在博尔尼大学学习数
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 you4 jia1 ru4 le5 zai4 bo2 er3 ni2 da4 xue2 xue2 xi2 shu4
cues.en: Later, Habicht, who was studying mathematics

cues.zh: 学的哈比克特
cues.pinyin: xue2 de5 ha1 bi3 ke4 te4
cues.en: at the University of Bern, also joined them.

cues.zh: 再后来邮电局的雇员沙旺
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 you2 dian4 ju2 de5 gu4 yuan2 sha1 wang4
cues.en: Then later, a postal-service clerk named Shawang also joined,

cues.zh: 专利局的同事贝索也加入了进来
cues.pinyin: zhuan1 li4 ju2 de5 tong2 shi4 bei4 suo3 ye3 jia1 ru4 le5 jin4 lai2
cues.en: and Besso, a colleague from the patent office, joined in too.

cues.zh: 很快收费的课程变成了次要的
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 shou1 fei4 de5 ke4 cheng2 bian4 cheng2 le5 ci4 yao4 de5
cues.en: Soon the paid lessons became secondary;

cues.zh: 热烈的课后讨论才是他们想要的
cues.pinyin: re4 lie4 de5 ke4 hou4 tao3 lun4 cai2 shi4 ta1 men5 xiang3 yao4 de5
cues.en: the heated after-class discussions were what they really wanted.

cues.zh: 因为在家里影响了妻子米列娃的休息
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 jia1 li3 ying3 xiang3 le5 qi1 zi3 mi3 lie4 wa2 de5 xiu1 xi1
cues.en: Because it disturbed his wife Mileva's rest at home,

cues.zh: 几个人转移到了一个叫做奥林匹
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 ren2 zhuan3 yi2 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 ao4 lin2 pi3
cues.en: the group moved to a café called

cues.zh: 亚的咖啡馆里
cues.pinyin: ya4 de5 ka1 fei1 guan3 li3
cues.en: "Olympia."

cues.zh: 几个年轻人还给这个小团体起了个名字
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 nian2 qing1 ren2 huan2 gei3 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 tuan2 ti3 qi3 le5 ge4 ming2 zi4
cues.en: The young men even gave this little group a name:

cues.zh: 奥林匹亚科学院
cues.pinyin: ao4 lin2 pi3 ya4 ke1 xue2 yuan4
cues.en: the "Olympia Academy."

cues.zh: 他们会先吃一点东西
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hui4 xian1 chi1 yi4 dian3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: They would first eat a little something,

cues.zh: 然后阅读一些与数学物理哲学有关的书
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yue4 du2 yi1 xie1 yu3 shu4 xue2 wu4 li3 zhe2 xue2 you3 guan1 de5 shu1
cues.en: then read some books related to math, physics, and philosophy,

cues.zh: 然后进行讨论
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jin4 xing2 tao3 lun4
cues.en: and then discuss them.

cues.zh: 他们读过休默柏拉图
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 du2 guo4 xiu1 mo4 bo2 la1 tu2
cues.en: They read classic works by Hume, Plato,

cues.zh: 莱布尼茨庞加莱的经典著作
cues.pinyin: lai2 bu4 ni2 ci2 pang2 jia1 lai2 de5 jing1 dian3 zhu4 zuo4
cues.en: Leibniz, and Poincaré.

cues.zh: 提出了光的波粒二象性学说
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 guang1 de5 bo1 li4 er4 xiang4 xing4 xue2 shuo1
cues.en: They'd read a page and then start discussing.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】漫谈相对论（一）高考只得6分，爱因斯坦是如何成为伟大科学家的？

cues.zh: 几乎没有什么参考文献
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 mei2 you3 shen2 me5 can1 kao3 wen2 xian4
cues.en: They had almost no reference materials,

cues.zh: 却唯独对贝索表示了感谢
cues.pinyin: que4 wei2 du2 dui4 bei4 suo3 biao3 shi4 le5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: yet they specifically expressed gratitude to Besso alone.

cues.zh: 贝索激动地对爱因斯坦说
cues.pinyin: bei4 suo3 ji1 dong4 di4 dui4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 shuo1
cues.en: Besso excitedly said to Einstein,

cues.zh: 阿尔伯特你把我拉进了历史
cues.pinyin: a1 er3 bo2 te4 ni3 ba3 wo3 la1 jin4 le5 li4 shi3
cues.en: "Albert, you've pulled me into history."

cues.zh: 在那一年爱因斯坦宛如被雅典娜附体
cues.pinyin: zai4 na4 yi1 nian2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 wan3 ru2 bei4 ya3 dian3 na4 fu4 ti3
cues.en: That year, Einstein seemed possessed by Athena.

cues.zh: 一年之内连续发表了数篇论文
cues.pinyin: yi1 nian2 zhi1 nei4 lian2 xu4 fa1 biao3 le5 shu4 pian1 lun4 wen2
cues.en: Within a single year he published several papers in a row,

cues.zh: 每一篇论文都是诺贝尔奖的水平
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 pian1 lun4 wen2 dou1 shi4 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3 de5 shui3 ping2
cues.en: each one of Nobel Prize caliber.

cues.zh: 比如爱因斯坦解释了光电效应
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jie3 shi4 le5 guang1 dian4 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: For instance, Einstein explained the photoelectric effect,

cues.zh: 提出了光的玻璃二象性学说
cues.pinyin: ti2 chu1 le5 guang1 de5 bo1 li2 er4 xiang4 xing4 xue2 shuo1
cues.en: and proposed the theory of wave-particle duality of light.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦通过对布朗运动的解释
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 tong1 guo4 dui4 bu4 lang3 yun4 dong4 de5 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Through his explanation of Brownian motion,

cues.zh: 证实了原子的存在
cues.pinyin: zheng4 shi2 le5 yuan2 zi5 de5 cun2 zai4
cues.en: he confirmed the existence of atoms.

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦提出了时间和空间的新的看法
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 ti2 chu1 le5 shi2 jian1 he2 kong1 jian1 de5 xin1 de5 kan4 fa3
cues.en: Einstein proposed a new view of time and space,

cues.zh: 并且提出智能方程
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 ti2 chu1 zhi4 neng2 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: and put forward the mass-energy equation.

cues.zh: 19 05 年被称之为爱因斯坦奇迹年
cues.pinyin: 19 05 nian2 bei4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 qi2 ji4 nian2
cues.en: 1905 is known as Einstein's "miracle year."

cues.zh: 人们难以想象一个 26 岁的年轻人
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 nan2 yi3 xiang3 xiang4 yi2 ge4 26 sui4 de5 nian2 qing1 ren2
cues.en: People find it hard to imagine how a 26-year-old young man

cues.zh: 是如何获得这么多成果的
cues.pinyin: shi4 ru2 he2 huo4 de2 zhe4 me5 duo1 cheng2 guo3 de5
cues.en: achieved so many results,

cues.zh: 就像人们不明白
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 ren2 men5 bu4 ming2 bai2
cues.en: just as people can't understand

cues.zh: 在 16 66 年那个 23 岁的年轻人
cues.pinyin: zai4 16 66 nian2 na4 ge5 23 sui4 de5 nian2 qing1 ren2
cues.en: that 23-year-old young man back in 1666...

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 她在北京市中心188㎡的家：用24k黄金打造天花板 Her 188㎡ home in the heart of Beijing: ceiling made of

cues.zh: 我是江西南昌人
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jiang1 xi1 nan2 chang1 ren2
cues.en: I'm from Nanchang, Jiangxi.

cues.zh: 这个房子在朝阳区东三环
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang2 zi5 zai4 chao2 yang2 qu1 dong1 san1 huan2
cues.en: This house is in the East Third Ring area of Chaoyang District.

cues.zh: 室内的面积是 18 8 平
cues.pinyin: shi4 nei4 de5 mian4 ji1 shi4 18 8 ping2
cues.en: The indoor area is 188 square meters.

cues.zh: 花园的面积是 30 平
cues.pinyin: hua1 yuan2 de5 mian4 ji1 shi4 30 ping2
cues.en: The garden area is 30 square meters.

cues.zh: 生活中有太多的柴米油盐
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 zhong1 you3 tai4 duo1 de5 chai2 mi3 you2 yan2
cues.en: There are so many mundane necessities in daily life.

cues.zh: 各种琐碎的事情
cues.pinyin: ge4 zhong3 suo3 sui4 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: All sorts of trivial, everyday matters.

cues.zh: 已经足够接地气
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 zu2 gou4 jie1 di4 qi4
cues.en: That's already down-to-earth enough.

cues.zh: 我就希望我的家是脱离这种人间烟火气
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 xi1 wang4 wo3 de5 jia1 shi4 tuo1 li2 zhe4 zhong3 ren2 jian1 yan1 huo3 qi4
cues.en: I wanted my home to feel removed from that worldly, everyday atmosphere.

cues.zh: 每一个空间都是不一样的颜色
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi2 ge4 kong1 jian1 dou1 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5 yan2 se4
cues.en: Every space has a different color.

cues.zh: 在一开始没有想过要做不同的主题
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi1 kai1 shi3 mei2 you3 xiang3 guo4 yao4 zuo4 bu4 tong2 de5 zhu3 ti2
cues.en: At first I hadn't thought about giving each room a different theme.

cues.zh: 因为我喜欢红楼梦
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 xi3 huan1 hong2 lou2 meng4
cues.en: Because I love Dream of the Red Chamber.

cues.zh: 就希望自己是能够有一个观四季的观感
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xi1 wang4 zi4 ji3 shi4 neng2 gou4 you3 yi2 ge4 guan1 si4 ji4 de5 guan1 gan3
cues.en: I just wanted the feeling of watching the four seasons pass.

cues.zh: 它是有一个主题的叫观园
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 you3 yi2 ge4 zhu3 ti2 de5 jiao4 guan1 yuan2
cues.en: It has a theme called 'Viewing Garden.'

cues.zh: 客厅就有一种很春天的感觉
cues.pinyin: ke4 ting1 jiu4 you3 yi1 zhong3 hen3 chun1 tian1 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: The living room has a very spring-like feel.

cues.zh: 第一鉴定的家具就是百宝间的屏风
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 jian4 ding4 de5 jia1 ju4 jiu4 shi4 bai3 bao3 jian1 de5 ping2 feng1
cues.en: The first custom-made piece of furniture was the inlaid screen.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 她在北京市中心188㎡的家：用24k黄金打造天花板 Her 188㎡ home in the heart of Beijing: ceiling made of

cues.zh: 查记是他爸妈当年去比利时度明月的
cues.pinyin: cha2 ji4 shi4 ta1 ba4 ma1 dang1 nian2 qu4 bi3 li4 shi2 du4 ming2 yue4 de5
cues.en: This piece was a gift his parents bought when they honeymooned in Belgium back then.

cues.zh: 时候买的礼物
cues.pinyin: shi2 hou4 mai3 de5 li3 wu4
cues.en: —bought as a gift during that trip.

cues.zh: 餐厨区的粉色比较夏天
cues.pinyin: can1 chu2 qu1 de5 fen3 se4 bi3 jiao4 xia4 tian1
cues.en: The pink of the dining area feels more like summer.

cues.zh: 就真的没有女生会不爱它
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhen1 de5 mei2 you3 nv3 sheng1 hui4 bu4 ai4 ta1
cues.en: There's really no woman who wouldn't love it.

cues.zh: 可以为了美牺牲掉不必要的所有
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 wei4 le5 mei3 xi1 sheng1 diao4 bu4 bi4 yao4 de5 suo3 you3
cues.en: You can sacrifice anything unnecessary for the sake of beauty.

cues.zh: 功能性的东西
cues.pinyin: gong1 neng2 xing4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Anything purely functional.

cues.zh: 鸢尾花灯
cues.pinyin: yuan1 wei3 hua1 deng1
cues.en: The iris flower lamp.

cues.zh: 它是从意大利的专门产玻璃制品的那个岛
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 cong2 yi4 da4 li4 de5 zhuan1 men2 chan3 bo1 li2 zhi4 pin3 de5 na4 ge5 dao3
cues.en: It was made on an island in Italy that specializes in glassware.

cues.zh: 上面订制来的
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 ding4 zhi4 lai2 de5
cues.en: —custom-ordered and made there.

cues.zh: 花跟叶子是一个个插上去
cues.pinyin: hua1 gen1 ye4 zi5 shi4 yi2 ge4 ge4 cha1 shang4 qu4
cues.en: The flowers and leaves were inserted in one by one.

cues.zh: 旁边的那一面墙的话就是把我数年收藏的
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 de5 na4 yi2 mian4 qiang2 de5 hua4 jiu4 shi4 ba3 wo3 shu4 nian2 shou1 cang2 de5
cues.en: As for the wall next to it, I hung years of my collection on it.

cues.zh: 一些大画小画
cues.pinyin: yi1 xie1 da4 hua4 xiao3 hua4
cues.en: Some large and small paintings.

cues.zh: 老瓷盘给排布在上面了
cues.pinyin: lao3 ci2 pan2 gei3 pai2 bu4 zai4 shang4 mian4 le5
cues.en: And old porcelain plates arranged on it.

cues.zh: 只要是自己真正认可然后喜欢的东西
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 shi4 zi4 ji3 zhen1 zheng4 ren4 ke3 ran2 hou4 xi3 huan1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: As long as it's something I truly recognize and love.

cues.zh: 放在一起又有一种和谐感
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 yi4 qi3 you4 you3 yi1 zhong3 he2 xie2 gan3
cues.en: Putting them together creates a sense of harmony.

cues.zh: 衣帽间也挺夏天的
cues.pinyin: yi1 mao4 jian1 ye3 ting3 xia4 tian1 de5
cues.en: The walk-in closet also feels quite summery.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 她在北京市中心188㎡的家：用24k黄金打造天花板 Her 188㎡ home in the heart of Beijing: ceiling made of

cues.zh: 中式的配色有点孔雀蓝
cues.pinyin: zhong1 shi4 de5 pei4 se4 you3 dian3 kong3 que4 lan2
cues.en: The Chinese-style color scheme has a touch of peacock blue.

cues.zh: 柜门上面用到的竹编
cues.pinyin: gui4 men2 shang4 mian4 yong4 dao4 de5 zhu2 bian1
cues.en: The bamboo weave used on the cabinet doors.

cues.zh: 然后加上那个海棠的形状
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jia1 shang4 na4 ge5 hai3 tang2 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: Plus that begonia shape.

cues.zh: 卧室它就是很秋天
cues.pinyin: wo4 shi4 ta1 jiu4 shi4 hen3 qiu1 tian1
cues.en: The bedroom feels very autumn.

cues.zh: 这个壁纸一个松林图
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bi4 zhi3 yi2 ge4 song1 lin2 tu2
cues.en: This wallpaper is a pine forest scene.

cues.zh: 像在山林里面
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zai4 shan1 lin2 li3 mian4
cues.en: Like being in a mountain forest.

cues.zh: 我刚才一进来就被这个金色的
cues.pinyin: wo3 gang1 cai2 yi1 jin4 lai2 jiu4 bei4 zhe4 ge5 jin1 se4 de5
cues.en: As soon as I walked in, I was drawn to this golden—

cues.zh: 天花板吸引了
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 ban3 xi1 yin3 le5
cues.en: —ceiling.

cues.zh: 金补需要师傅用那个鹅毛一张一张贴
cues.pinyin: jin1 bu3 xu1 yao4 shi1 fu4 yong4 na4 ge5 e2 mao2 yi1 zhang1 yi1 zhang1 tie1
cues.en: The gold leaf has to be applied sheet by sheet by a craftsman using a goose feather.

cues.zh: 每天醒来的时候是一个金顶
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 xing3 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 shi4 yi2 ge4 jin1 ding3
cues.en: Every morning I wake up under a golden ceiling.

cues.zh: 黄金这个东西吧年轻的时候喜欢
cues.pinyin: huang2 jin1 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 ba5 nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 xi3 huan1
cues.en: As for gold, when I was young I liked it.

cues.zh: 但我现在真的是很爱
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 xian4 zai4 zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 ai4
cues.en: But now I truly love it.

cues.zh: 主位一走进去
cues.pinyin: zhu3 wei4 yi1 zou3 jin4 qu4
cues.en: As soon as you walk into the master bedroom.

cues.zh: 像在北海道泡温泉的时候看到
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zai4 bei3 hai3 dao4 pao4 wen1 quan2 de5 shi2 hou4 kan4 dao4
cues.en: It's like what you see soaking in a hot spring in Hokkaido.

cues.zh: 的那个星空顶
cues.pinyin: de5 na4 ge5 xing1 kong1 ding3
cues.en: —that starry-sky ceiling.

cues.zh: 很自然地有一个冬天的感觉
cues.pinyin: hen3 zi4 ran2 di4 you3 yi2 ge4 dong1 tian1 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: It naturally gives off a feeling of winter.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 她在北京市中心188㎡的家：用24k黄金打造天花板 Her 188㎡ home in the heart of Beijing: ceiling made of

cues.zh: 我爸妈一年来这边住一个月的时间
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ma1 yi1 nian2 lai2 zhe4 bian1 zhu4 yi2 ge4 yue4 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: My parents come live here for a month every year.

cues.zh: 也是蛮适应的
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 man2 shi4 ying4 de5
cues.en: And they adapt to it quite well.

cues.zh: 大家看到我家是个极凡的家
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 dao4 wo3 jia1 shi4 ge4 ji2 fan2 de5 jia1
cues.en: Everyone sees my home as a minimalist home.

cues.zh: 因为我有很多喜欢的东西
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 you3 hen3 duo1 xi3 huan1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Because I have a lot of things I love.

cues.zh: 旅行过程中一些有纪念意义的东西
cues.pinyin: lv3 xing2 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 yi1 xie1 you3 ji4 nian4 yi4 yi4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Items with sentimental meaning from my travels.

cues.zh: 你没有必要把它们藏起来
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 you3 bi4 yao4 ba3 ta1 men5 cang2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: There's no need to hide them away.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 她在北京市中心188㎡的家：用24k黄金打造天花板 Her 188㎡ home in the heart of Beijing: ceiling made of

cues.zh: 10 年前开始创业
cues.pinyin: 10 nian2 qian2 kai1 shi3 chuang4 ye4
cues.en: I started my own business 10 years ago.

cues.zh: 纪念年初退出管理
cues.pinyin: ji4 nian4 nian2 chu1 tui4 chu1 guan3 li3
cues.en: Early this year I stepped back from management.

cues.zh: 我其实就是退休也是在做事情的
cues.pinyin: wo3 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 tui4 xiu1 ye3 shi4 zai4 zuo4 shi4 qing2 de5
cues.en: Honestly, even in retirement I'm still doing things.

cues.zh: 在做的工作其实是和美去打交道的工作
cues.pinyin: zai4 zuo4 de5 gong1 zuo4 qi2 shi2 shi4 he2 mei3 qu4 da3 jiao1 dao4 de5 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: The work I do deals with beauty.

cues.zh: 钱这个东西对所有人来说都没有上限
cues.pinyin: qian2 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 dui4 suo3 you3 ren2 lai2 shuo1 dou1 mei2 you3 shang4 xian4
cues.en: When it comes to money, there's no upper limit for anyone.

cues.zh: 你可以去选择任何一种生活
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 qu4 xuan3 ze2 ren4 he2 yi1 zhong3 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: You can choose to live any kind of life.

cues.zh: 但是其中要承受的这种代价
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qi2 zhong1 yao4 cheng2 shou4 de5 zhe4 zhong3 dai4 jia4
cues.en: But the price you have to pay for it.

cues.zh: 你自己是要去清除的
cues.pinyin: ni3 zi4 ji3 shi4 yao4 qu4 qing1 chu2 de5
cues.en: You need to be clear about that yourself.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle

cues.zh: 这个十一你出门旅游了吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 yi1 ni3 chu1 men2 lv3 you2 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you travel during this National Day holiday?

cues.zh: 到处都是人山人海
cues.pinyin: dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4 ren2 shan1 ren2 hai3
cues.en: Everywhere was packed with crowds of people

cues.zh: 许多小朋友给我发来私信问
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 gei3 wo3 fa1 lai2 si1 xin4 wen4
cues.en: Many young students sent me private messages asking

cues.zh: 既然明明知道五一出游会人多
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 ming2 ming2 zhi1 dao4 wu3 yi1 chu1 you2 hui4 ren2 duo1
cues.en: Since you clearly know the May Day holiday will be crowded

cues.zh: 大家为什么还要拼命的出去旅游呢
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 yao4 pin1 ming4 de5 chu1 qu4 lv3 you2 ne5
cues.en: Why do people still insist on traveling anyway?

cues.zh: 这个问题我想用马斯洛的需求层次理论
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 wo3 xiang3 yong4 ma3 si1 luo4 de5 xu1 qiu2 ceng2 ci4 li3 lun4
cues.en: I'd like to use Maslow's hierarchy of needs theory

cues.zh: 和大家一起分析一下
cues.pinyin: he2 da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 fen1 xi1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: to analyze this question together with you

cues.zh: 如果你听懂了这个理论
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 ting1 dong3 le5 zhe4 ge5 li3 lun4
cues.en: If you understand this theory

cues.zh: 那么你会发现
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: then you'll find that

cues.zh: 无论是在工作当中还是在子女教育当中
cues.pinyin: wu2 lun4 shi4 zai4 gong1 zuo4 dang1 zhong1 hai2 shi4 zai4 zi3 nv3 jiao4 yu4 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: whether at work or in raising children

cues.zh: 这个理论都是很有用的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li3 lun4 dou1 shi4 hen3 you3 yong4 de5
cues.en: this theory is very useful

cues.zh: 我们来讲一讲马斯洛的需求层次理论
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 ma3 si1 luo4 de5 xu1 qiu2 ceng2 ci4 li3 lun4
cues.en: Let's talk about Maslow's hierarchy of needs theory

cues.zh: 马斯洛美国心理学家
cues.pinyin: ma3 si1 luo4 mei3 guo2 xin1 li3 xue2 jia1
cues.en: Maslow was an American psychologist

cues.zh: 当过美国心理学会的会长
cues.pinyin: dang1 guo4 mei3 guo2 xin1 li3 xue2 hui4 de5 hui4 zhang3
cues.en: He served as president of the American Psychological Association

cues.zh: 他是人本主义的代表人物
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 ren2 ben3 zhu3 yi4 de5 dai4 biao3 ren2 wu4
cues.en: He is a representative figure of humanistic psychology

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 他在 19 43 年的时候提出了需求层次的理论
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 19 43 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 ti2 chu1 le5 xu1 qiu2 ceng2 ci4 de5 li3 lun4
cues.en: In 1943 he proposed the hierarchy of needs theory

cues.zh: 这个理论有三个基本的观点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 li3 lun4 you3 san1 ge4 ji1 ben3 de5 guan1 dian3
cues.en: This theory has three basic premises

cues.zh: 第一个观点人会有不同的行为
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 guan1 dian3 ren2 hui4 you3 bu4 tong2 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: First premise: people exhibit different behaviors

cues.zh: 行为是怎么产生的呢
cues.pinyin: xing2 wei2 shi4 zen3 me5 chan3 sheng1 de5 ne5
cues.en: How does behavior arise?

cues.zh: 是因为人有动机所以才产生了行为
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ren2 you3 dong4 ji1 suo3 yi3 cai2 chan3 sheng1 le5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: Behavior arises because people have motives

cues.zh: 那么人为什么会有这样的动机呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 wei2 shen2 me5 hui4 you3 zhe4 yang4 de5 dong4 ji1 ne5
cues.en: So why do people have these motives?

cues.zh: 这是因为人有需求
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ren2 you3 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: It's because people have needs

cues.zh: 不同的需求就会产生不同的动机
cues.pinyin: bu4 tong2 de5 xu1 qiu2 jiu4 hui4 chan3 sheng1 bu4 tong2 de5 dong4 ji1
cues.en: Different needs produce different motives

cues.zh: 而不同的动机又会产生不同的行为
cues.pinyin: er2 bu4 tong2 de5 dong4 ji1 you4 hui4 chan3 sheng1 bu4 tong2 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: and different motives in turn produce different behaviors

cues.zh: 人的需求是分层次的从低到高
cues.pinyin: ren2 de5 xu1 qiu2 shi4 fen1 ceng2 ci4 de5 cong2 di1 dao4 gao1
cues.en: Human needs are arranged in levels, from low to high

cues.zh: 最初他提出了五个需求的层次
cues.pinyin: zui4 chu1 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 wu3 ge4 xu1 qiu2 de5 ceng2 ci4
cues.en: Initially he proposed five levels of needs

cues.zh: 我们来说一下人的需求层次
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 ren2 de5 xu1 qiu2 ceng2 ci4
cues.en: Let's talk about the levels of human needs

cues.zh: 需求层次
cues.pinyin: xu1 qiu2 ceng2 ci4
cues.en: Hierarchy of needs

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 那么就有可能会出现大规模的抢劫的行为
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jiu4 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 chu1 xian4 da4 gui1 mo2 de5 qiang3 jie2 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: then large-scale robbery behavior could occur

cues.zh: 那么比生理需求高一层次的是安全的需求
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 bi3 sheng1 li3 xu1 qiu2 gao1 yi1 ceng2 ci4 de5 shi4 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: One level above physiological needs is the need for safety

cues.zh: 人有安全的需求
cues.pinyin: ren2 you3 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: People have a need for safety

cues.zh: 这个安全需求包括身体的安全
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 an1 quan2 xu1 qiu2 bao1 kuo4 shen1 ti3 de5 an1 quan2
cues.en: This safety need includes physical safety

cues.zh: 包括财产的安全
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 cai2 chan3 de5 an1 quan2
cues.en: including financial safety

cues.zh: 包括事业的安全等等
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 shi4 ye4 de5 an1 quan2 deng3 deng3
cues.en: including career safety, and so on

cues.zh: 就比如说我们为什么要体检呢
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 ti3 jian3 ne5
cues.en: For example, why do we get physical checkups?

cues.zh: 因为我们害怕身体出毛病
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 men5 hai4 pa4 shen1 ti3 chu1 mao2 bing4
cues.en: Because we're afraid something will go wrong with our bodies

cues.zh: 这是对于身体安全的需求
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dui4 yu2 shen1 ti3 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: This is the need for physical safety

cues.zh: 我们需要买养老保险买汽车保险
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 mai3 yang3 lao3 bao3 xian3 mai3 qi4 che1 bao3 xian3
cues.en: We need to buy retirement insurance and car insurance

cues.zh: 这是对于我们的事业
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dui4 yu2 wo3 men5 de5 shi4 ye4
cues.en: This is for the sake of our careers

cues.zh: 对于我们的财产安全的需求
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 wo3 men5 de5 cai2 chan3 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: and for the safety of our assets

cues.zh: 如果安全的需求出现匮乏
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2 chu1 xian4 kui4 fa2
cues.en: If the need for safety is left unmet

cues.zh: 那么人就会变得恐惧和焦虑
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 jiu4 hui4 bian4 de2 kong3 ju4 he2 jiao1 lv4
cues.en: then people become fearful and anxious

cues.zh: 恐惧源于未知
cues.pinyin: kong3 ju4 yuan2 yu2 wei4 zhi1
cues.en: Fear comes from the unknown

cues.zh: 比如一个孩子
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 yi2 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: For example, a child

cues.zh: 他处于一个不可预测的环境之中
cues.pinyin: ta1 chu3 yu2 yi2 ge4 bu4 ke3 yu4 ce4 de5 huan2 jing4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: who lives in an unpredictable environment

cues.zh: 每天回到家都不知道他爸爸会不会揍他
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 hui2 dao4 jia1 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 ta1 ba4 ba4 hui4 bu2 hui4 zou4 ta1
cues.en: never knowing each day whether his father will beat him when he gets home

cues.zh: 那这个孩子往往就会处于一种恐
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 wang3 wang3 jiu4 hui4 chu3 yu2 yi1 zhong3 kong3
cues.en: that child will often be in a state of

cues.zh: 惧和焦虑之中
cues.pinyin: ju4 he2 jiao1 lv4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: fear and anxiety

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 像宗教起到的作用也是给人一种归属感
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zong1 jiao4 qi3 dao4 de5 zuo4 yong4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ren2 yi1 zhong3 gui1 shu3 gan3
cues.en: Religion also serves to give people a sense of belonging

cues.zh: 第四个层次叫尊重的需求
cues.pinyin: di4 si4 ge4 ceng2 ci4 jiao4 zun1 zhong4 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: The fourth level is called the need for esteem

cues.zh: 尊重
cues.pinyin: zun1 zhong4
cues.en: Esteem

cues.zh: 尊重又分为两个方面
cues.pinyin: zun1 zhong4 you4 fen1 wei2 liang3 ge4 fang1 mian4
cues.en: Esteem is divided into two aspects

cues.zh: 一个是自我尊重也就是自信
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 zi4 wo3 zun1 zhong4 ye3 jiu4 shi4 zi4 xin4
cues.en: One is self-esteem, that is, self-confidence

cues.zh: 另外一个是其他人的尊重
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi2 ge4 shi4 qi2 ta1 ren2 de5 zun1 zhong4
cues.en: the other is the esteem of others

cues.zh: 收获其他人的尊重
cues.pinyin: shou1 huo4 qi2 ta1 ren2 de5 zun1 zhong4
cues.en: earning the respect of others

cues.zh: 这也是我们的一个需求
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 wo3 men5 de5 yi2 ge4 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: this is also one of our needs

cues.zh: 那么人如果缺乏了这种需求
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 ru2 guo3 que1 fa2 le5 zhe4 zhong3 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: So when a person lacks this need

cues.zh: 他往往表现就是自卑
cues.pinyin: ta1 wang3 wang3 biao3 xian4 jiu4 shi4 zi4 bei1
cues.en: they often show signs of inferiority

cues.zh: 自卑的行为有很多种
cues.pinyin: zi4 bei1 de5 xing2 wei2 you3 hen3 duo1 zhong3
cues.en: There are many kinds of inferior behavior

cues.zh: 比如说爱慕虚荣是吧
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ai4 mu4 xu1 rong2 shi4 ba5
cues.en: For example, vanity, right?

cues.zh: 明明没有钱反正就很自卑
cues.pinyin: ming2 ming2 mei2 you3 qian2 fan3 zheng4 jiu4 hen3 zi4 bei1
cues.en: Clearly having no money but still feeling inferior

cues.zh: 他非要买一个 L V 的包
cues.pinyin: ta1 fei1 yao4 mai3 yi2 ge4 L V de5 bao1
cues.en: they insist on buying an LV bag

cues.zh: 爱马仕的包对吧
cues.pinyin: ai4 ma3 shi4 de5 bao1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: or a Hermès bag, right

cues.zh: 以显示自己好像生活很富足
cues.pinyin: yi3 xian3 shi4 zi4 ji3 hao3 xiang4 sheng1 huo2 hen3 fu4 zu2
cues.en: to show that their life seems abundant

cues.zh: 再比如说明明他学习成绩不是很好
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 ming2 ming2 ta1 xue2 xi2 cheng2 ji4 bu2 shi4 hen3 hao3
cues.en: Another example: when a student's grades aren't very good

cues.zh: 但是每到老师提问的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei3 dao4 lao3 shi1 ti2 wen4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: but whenever the teacher asks a question

cues.zh: 他一定要抢着回答
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ding4 yao4 qiang3 zhe5 hui2 da2
cues.en: they insist on being the first to answer

cues.zh: 让别人感觉好像自己是很会的
cues.pinyin: rang4 bie2 ren2 gan3 jue2 hao3 xiang4 zi4 ji3 shi4 hen3 hui4 de5
cues.en: to make others feel like they really know it

cues.zh: 这种自我表现的行为
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 zi4 wo3 biao3 xian4 de5 xing2 wei2
cues.en: This kind of self-display behavior

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 往往是因为缺乏自信
cues.pinyin: wang3 wang3 shi4 yin1 wei4 que1 fa2 zi4 xin4
cues.en: is often because of a lack of confidence

cues.zh: 渴望通过这种方式来收获其他人的尊重
cues.pinyin: ke3 wang4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 zhong3 fang1 shi4 lai2 shou1 huo4 qi2 ta1 ren2 de5 zun1 zhong4
cues.en: and a desire to earn others' respect this way

cues.zh: 更高层次的需求叫做自我实现
cues.pinyin: geng4 gao1 ceng2 ci4 de5 xu1 qiu2 jiao4 zuo4 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4
cues.en: A higher level of need is called self-actualization

cues.zh: 当我们之前的需求都满足得差不多了
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 men5 zhi1 qian2 de5 xu1 qiu2 dou1 man3 zu2 de2 cha4 bu5 duo1 le5
cues.en: Once our previous needs are mostly satisfied

cues.zh: 那么人就有一种自我实现的需求了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ren2 jiu4 you3 yi1 zhong3 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4 de5 xu1 qiu2 le5
cues.en: then people develop a need for self-actualization

cues.zh: 自我实现的需求就是要实现个人
cues.pinyin: zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4 de5 xu1 qiu2 jiu4 shi4 yao4 shi2 xian4 ge4 ren2
cues.en: The need for self-actualization is about realizing one's personal

cues.zh: 的理想与报复
cues.pinyin: de5 li3 xiang3 yu3 bao4 fu4
cues.en: ideals and ambitions

cues.zh: 个人的理想与报复是一种高级的需求
cues.pinyin: ge4 ren2 de5 li3 xiang3 yu3 bao4 fu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 gao1 ji2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: Personal ideals and ambitions are a high-level need

cues.zh: 最高层次的需求
cues.pinyin: zui4 gao1 ceng2 ci4 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: the highest level of need

cues.zh: 人如果缺乏了自我实现的需求
cues.pinyin: ren2 ru2 guo3 que1 fa2 le5 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: If a person lacks the need for self-actualization

cues.zh: 就会感觉到空虚
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 gan3 jue2 dao4 kong1 xu1
cues.en: they will feel a sense of emptiness

cues.zh: 有一些大老板他前四个需求都达到了
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 xie1 da4 lao3 ban3 ta1 qian2 si4 ge4 xu1 qiu2 dou1 da2 dao4 le5
cues.en: Some big bosses have achieved the first four levels of needs

cues.zh: 非常有钱受到人的尊敬
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 you3 qian2 shou4 dao4 ren2 de5 zun1 jing4
cues.en: they're very wealthy and respected by others

cues.zh: 结果抑郁了为什么呢
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 yi4 yu4 le5 wei4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: but end up depressed — why?

cues.zh: 因为他没有达到自我实现
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 mei2 you3 da2 dao4 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4
cues.en: Because they haven't achieved self-actualization

cues.zh: 后来他找到了一种自我实现的方法
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 zhao3 dao4 le5 yi1 zhong3 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4 de5 fang1 fa3
cues.en: Later they found a way to achieve self-actualization

cues.zh: 那抑郁不就好了吗
cues.pinyin: na4 yi4 yu4 bu4 jiu4 hao3 le5 ma5
cues.en: and then the depression went away, didn't it?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】假期你会出门旅游吗？这其实说明了你的需求层次

cues.zh: 第二层次的安全需求
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 ceng2 ci4 de5 an1 quan2 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: The second level, the need for safety

cues.zh: 第三层次爱与归属
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 ceng2 ci4 ai4 yu3 gui1 shu3
cues.en: The third level, love and belonging

cues.zh: 第四层次的尊重
cues.pinyin: di4 si4 ceng2 ci4 de5 zun1 zhong4
cues.en: The fourth level, esteem

cues.zh: 和第五层次的自我实现
cues.pinyin: he2 di4 wu3 ceng2 ci4 de5 zi4 wo3 shi2 xian4
cues.en: and the fifth level, self-actualization

cues.zh: 我们不妨打个比方
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 bu4 fang2 da3 ge4 bi3 fang1
cues.en: Let's use an analogy

cues.zh: 我们就以西游记为例
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 yi3 xi1 you2 ji4 wei4 li4
cues.en: Let's take Journey to the West as an example

cues.zh: 西游记唐僧师徒其实一共是 5 个人对吧
cues.pinyin: xi1 you2 ji4 tang2 seng1 shi1 tu2 qi2 shi2 yi1 gong4 shi4 5 ge4 ren2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: In Journey to the West, Tang Monk and his disciples are actually five people total, right?

cues.zh: 4 个人再加一个白龙马
cues.pinyin: 4 ge4 ren2 zai4 jia1 yi2 ge4 bai2 long2 ma3
cues.en: Four people plus one White Dragon Horse

cues.zh: 一共是 5 个人
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 shi4 5 ge4 ren2
cues.en: that's five in total

cues.zh: 这 5 个人他们的需求其实就是不一样的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 5 ge4 ren2 ta1 men5 de5 xu1 qiu2 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4 de5
cues.en: These five people actually have different needs

cues.zh: 比如说猪八戒它是什么需求
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhu1 ba1 jie4 ta1 shi4 shen2 me5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: For example, what need does Pigsy have?

cues.zh: 猪八戒的需求那很显然它就是生理需求
cues.pinyin: zhu1 ba1 jie4 de5 xu1 qiu2 na4 hen3 xian3 ran2 ta1 jiu4 shi4 sheng1 li3 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: Pigsy's need is obviously the physiological need

cues.zh: 每天就只想吃馒头对吧
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 jiu4 zhi3 xiang3 chi1 man2 tou5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: He only wants to eat steamed buns every day, right?

cues.zh: 还有一个就是想着高老庄的高小姐对吧
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 jiu4 shi4 xiang3 zhe5 gao1 lao3 zhuang1 de5 gao1 xiao3 jie3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: And he's also thinking about Miss Gao from Gao Village, right?

cues.zh: 所以他的基本需求就是生理需求
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 de5 ji1 ben3 xu1 qiu2 jiu4 shi4 sheng1 li3 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: So his basic need is the physiological need

cues.zh: 那白龙马呢
cues.pinyin: na4 bai2 long2 ma3 ne5
cues.en: What about the White Dragon Horse?

cues.zh: 白龙马的需求就不再是生理需求了
cues.pinyin: bai2 long2 ma3 de5 xu1 qiu2 jiu4 bu4 zai4 shi4 sheng1 li3 xu1 qiu2 le5
cues.en: The White Dragon Horse's need is no longer a physiological need

cues.zh: 白龙马的需求主要是安全的需求
cues.pinyin: bai2 long2 ma3 de5 xu1 qiu2 zhu3 yao4 shi4 an1 quan2 de5 xu1 qiu2
cues.en: The White Dragon Horse's need is mainly the need for safety

cues.zh: 白龙马因为受罚
cues.pinyin: bai2 long2 ma3 yin1 wei4 shou4 fa2
cues.en: Because the White Dragon Horse is being punished

cues.zh: 每过 7 天就会有天剑来穿他的
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo4 7 tian1 jiu4 hui4 you3 tian1 jian4 lai2 chuan1 ta1 de5
cues.en: every seven days a heavenly sword comes to pierce him

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 功夫高手分享秘笈：越是动如雷霆，越要静如平湖

cues.zh: 而静的秘诀就在脚下平衡
cues.pinyin: er2 jing4 de5 mi4 jue2 jiu4 zai4 jiao3 xia4 ping2 heng2

cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 ta1 yi1 wu2 suo3 you3 hui2 dao4 jia1 xiang1 shi2

cues.zh: 却发现自己误打误撞
cues.pinyin: que4 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 wu4 da3 wu4 zhuang4

cues.en: He had actually become a winner in life

cues.zh: 20 25 年印度最新喜剧体育俱乐部震撼上映
cues.pinyin: 20 25 nian2 yin4 du4 zui4 xin1 xi3 ju4 ti3 yu4 ju4 le4 bu4 zhen4 han4 shang4 ying4
cues.en: The newest 2025 Indian sports comedy hits theaters with a bang

cues.zh: 小帅是印度乡下的一个穷青年
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 shi4 yin4 du4 xiang1 xia4 de5 yi2 ge4 qiong2 qing1 nian2
cues.en: Xiao Shuai is a poor young man from rural India

cues.zh: 今天跟几个好基友正在查询高考成绩
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gen1 ji3 ge4 hao3 ji1 you3 zheng4 zai4 cha2 xun2 gao1 kao3 cheng2 ji4
cues.en: Today he and his buddies are checking their college entrance exam scores

cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 zhe4 ci4 huo2 dong4 hai2 cong2 jia1 li3 tou1 le5 yi1 guan4 mi3 jiu3
cues.en: For the occasion, he even stole a jar of rice wine from home

cues.zh: 闻着米酒的香气小帅露出了幸福的微笑
cues.pinyin: wen2 zhe5 mi3 jiu3 de5 xiang1 qi4 xiao3 shuai4 lu4 chu1 le5 xing4 fu2 de5 wei1 xiao4
cues.en: Smelling the rice wine's aroma, Xiao Shuai breaks into a happy smile

cues.zh: 首先查分的是胡子哥
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 cha2 fen1 de5 shi4 hu2 zi5 ge1
cues.en: The first to check his score is Beard Bro

cues.zh: 结果十门只有一门及格
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 shi2 men2 zhi3 you3 yi1 men2 ji2 ge2
cues.en: Out of ten subjects, he only passed one

cues.zh: 紧接着是一脸淡定的白毛
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 shi4 yi1 lian3 dan4 ding4 de5 bai2 mao2
cues.en: Next is the ever-composed Whitey

cues.zh: 离录取分数线还差 500 分
cues.pinyin: li2 lu4 qu3 fen1 shu4 xian4 hai2 cha4 500 fen1
cues.en: He's 500 points short of the cutoff score

cues.zh: 然后是戴着眼镜的小黑
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 shi4 dai4 zhuo2 yan3 jing4 de5 xiao3 hei1
cues.en: Then comes bespectacled Xiao Hei

cues.zh: 高考时跑错了考场成绩直接作废
cues.pinyin: gao1 kao3 shi2 pao3 cuo4 le5 kao3 chang3 cheng2 ji4 zhi2 jie1 zuo4 fei4
cues.en: He went to the wrong exam hall, so his score was voided

cues.zh: 接下来是满脸自信的小帅
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 shi4 man3 lian3 zi4 xin4 de5 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: Next up is the confident Xiao Shuai

cues.zh: 他的总分居然是个位数
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zong3 fen1 ju1 ran2 shi4 ge4 wei4 shu4
cues.en: His total score turns out to be a single digit

cues.zh: 最后是穿着花衬衫的学霸
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 shi4 chuan1 zhe5 hua1 chen4 shan1 de5 xue2 ba4
cues.en: Finally there's the top student in the flowery shirt

cues.zh: 他一脸淡定地告诉众人自己考上了大学
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi1 lian3 dan4 ding4 di4 gao4 su4 zhong4 ren2 zi4 ji3 kao3 shang4 le5 da4 xue2
cues.en: He calmly announces he got into college

cues.zh: 学霸嫌弃地推开酒杯
cues.pinyin: xue2 ba4 xian2 qi4 di4 tui1 kai1 jiu3 bei1
cues.en: The top student pushes his wine cup away in disgust

items.title: 先锋影视

cues.en: That night the top student goes to mooch a meal at Xiao Shuai's house

cues.en: Xiao Shuai's mom sighs on hearing the top student got into college

cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 qi4 hong1 hong1 nian3 zou3 le5 xue2 ba4
cues.en: Xiao Shuai furiously chases the top student out

cues.zh: 这小子一点义气都不讲
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xiao3 zi5 yi4 dian3 yi4 qi4 dou1 bu4 jiang3
cues.en: "This guy has no sense of loyalty at all"

cues.zh: 居然偷偷考取了大学
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 tou1 tou1 kao3 qu3 le5 da4 xue2
cues.en: "Getting into college behind our backs"

cues.zh: 学霸吐槽一声小气转身就走

cues.en: The top student scoffs "how petty" and walks off

cues.zh: 他提醒小帅以后虽然阶级不同了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ti2 xing3 xiao3 shuai4 yi3 hou4 sui1 ran2 jie1 ji2 bu4 tong2 le5
cues.en: He reminds Xiao Shuai that even though their status differs now

cues.zh: 但是还是朋友
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 shi4 peng2 you3
cues.en: they're still friends

cues.zh: 第二天小帅和学霸坐着船去赶集
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 xiao3 shuai4 he2 xue2 ba4 zuo4 zhe5 chuan2 qu4 gan3 ji2

cues.pinyin: chuan2 tou2 yi2 ge4 gu1 niang2 rang4 ta1 chun1 xin1 dang4 yang4
cues.en: A girl at the bow of the boat makes his heart flutter

cues.zh: 小帅赶忙上去搭讪

cues.pinyin: gu1 niang2 kan4 zhe5 ta1 zhi3 shi4 xiao4 er2 bu4 yu3
cues.en: The girl just smiles at him without saying a word

cues.en: Xiao Shuai quickly asks for the girl's name

cues.pinyin: yi1 zhen4 la1 che3 cai2 zhi1 dao4 gu1 niang2 ming2 jiao4 da4 mei3

cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 da4 mei3 zhi3 xi3 huan1 neng2 da3 de2 guo4 ta1 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: Turns out Da Mei only likes men who can beat her in a fight

cues.zh: 小帅只恨自己拳头太软只能放弃
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 zhi3 hen4 zi4 ji3 quan2 tou5 tai4 ruan3 zhi3 neng2 fang4 qi4
cues.en: Cursing his own weak fists, Xiao Shuai has to give up

cues.zh: 下了船又和一个卷发妹勾搭在一起
cues.pinyin: xia4 le5 chuan2 you4 he2 yi2 ge4 juan3 fa4 mei4 gou1 da1 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: After getting off the boat, he hooks up with a curly-haired girl

cues.zh: 卷发妹一直暗恋着小帅
cues.pinyin: juan3 fa4 mei4 yi4 zhi2 an4 lian4 zhe5 xiao3 shuai4
cues.en: The curly-haired girl has secretly had a crush on Xiao Shuai all along

cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 ta1 kou3 cai2 hen3 hao3 you4 zhang3 de2 hen3 shuai4
cues.en: She thinks he's eloquent and handsome

cues.zh: 小帅和学霸去白毛家的牛肉店
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 he2 xue2 ba4 qu4 bai2 mao2 jia1 de5 niu2 rou4 dian4

cues.en: But sometimes, inside our body,

cues.pinyin: bao1 hui4 fa1 sheng1 bing4 bian4
cues.en: cells undergo mutation.

cues.zh: 比如说癌细胞
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ai2 xi4 bao1
cues.en: For example, cancer cells.

cues.zh: 癌细胞是正常细胞突变出现的
cues.pinyin: ai2 xi4 bao1 shi4 zheng4 chang2 xi4 bao1 tu1 bian4 chu1 xian4 de5
cues.en: Cancer cells arise from mutated normal cells.

cues.zh: 这个细胞个头太大跟这个巨噬细胞差不多
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xi4 bao1 ge4 tou2 tai4 da4 gen1 zhe4 ge5 ju4 shi4 xi4 bao1 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: This cell is too big, about the same size as a macrophage,

cues.zh: 所以巨噬细胞没有办法吃掉这个癌细胞
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ju4 shi4 xi4 bao1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 chi1 diao4 zhe4 ge5 ai2 xi4 bao1
cues.en: so a macrophage can't eat this cancer cell.

cues.zh: 那这时候怎么办呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 shi2 hou4 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5
cues.en: So what do we do then?

cues.zh: 另外一种非特异性的免疫细胞
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3 fei1 te4 yi4 xing4 de5 mian3 yi4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: Another type of non-specific immune cell

cues.zh: 叫做自然杀手细胞就出现了
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 zi4 ran2 sha1 shou3 xi4 bao1 jiu4 chu1 xian4 le5
cues.en: called the natural killer cell comes into play.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】CAR-T免疫疗法：120万一针的抗癌神药

cues.zh: 好这是第二道防线叫做非特异性免疫
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 shi4 di4 er4 dao4 fang2 xian4 jiao4 zuo4 fei1 te4 yi4 xing4 mian3 yi4
cues.en: This is the second line of defense, called non-specific immunity.

cues.zh: 那么还有第三道防线
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hai2 you3 di4 san1 dao4 fang2 xian4
cues.en: Then there's a third line of defense,

cues.zh: 第三道防线就称之为特异性免疫
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 dao4 fang2 xian4 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 te4 yi4 xing4 mian3 yi4
cues.en: the third line of defense is called specific immunity.

cues.zh: 这个特异性免疫实际上是在人出生之后
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 te4 yi4 xing4 mian3 yi4 shi2 ji4 shang4 shi4 zai4 ren2 chu1 sheng1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: This specific immunity actually develops after a person is born,

cues.zh: 经过了很长时间跟环境的接触
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 le5 hen3 zhang3 shi2 jian1 gen1 huan2 jing4 de5 jie1 chu4
cues.en: through long-term contact with the environment,

cues.zh: 反复的生病获得了一种免疫能力
cues.pinyin: fan3 fu4 de5 sheng1 bing4 huo4 de2 le5 yi1 zhong3 mian3 yi4 neng2 li4
cues.en: gaining immune ability through repeated illness.

cues.zh: 这个具体怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ju4 ti3 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: How exactly does this work?

cues.zh: 比如说这个巨噬细胞
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 ju4 shi4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: For example, this macrophage

cues.zh: 它可以吃掉一些细菌病毒
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 chi1 diao4 yi1 xie1 xi4 jun1 bing4 du2
cues.en: can eat some bacteria and viruses,

cues.zh: 或者是一些病变细胞的碎片
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 yi1 xie1 bing4 bian4 xi4 bao1 de5 sui4 pian4
cues.en: or fragments of mutated cells.

cues.zh: 吃掉了之后
cues.pinyin: chi1 diao4 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After eating them,

cues.zh: 它并没有把这个东西就随意丢弃
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 mei2 you3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 jiu4 sui2 yi4 diu1 qi4
cues.en: it doesn't just discard them randomly.

cues.zh: 它会把一部分碎片
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ba3 yi1 bu4 fen4 sui4 pian4
cues.en: It takes some of the fragments

cues.zh: 承递到自己的表面上
cues.pinyin: cheng2 di4 dao4 zi4 ji3 de5 biao3 mian4 shang4
cues.en: and presents them on its own surface.

cues.zh: 这个过程叫做抗原承递过程
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 jiao4 zuo4 kang4 yuan2 cheng2 di4 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: This process is called antigen presentation.

cues.zh: 那么承递给谁呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 cheng2 di4 gei3 shui2 ne5
cues.en: So who does it present them to?

cues.zh: 承递给一个叫做辅助替细胞的东西
cues.pinyin: cheng2 di4 gei3 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 fu3 zhu4 ti4 xi4 bao1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: It presents them to something called a helper T cell.

cues.zh: 辅助 T 细胞就是一种特异性免疫细
cues.pinyin: fu3 zhu4 T xi4 bao1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 te4 yi4 xing4 mian3 yi4 xi4
cues.en: Helper T cells are a type of specific immune cell —

cues.zh: 胞就是 T 细胞
cues.pinyin: bao1 jiu4 shi4 T xi4 bao1
cues.en: that is, T cells.

cues.zh: 那么除了 T 细胞以外
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 chu2 le5 T xi4 bao1 yi3 wai4
cues.en: Besides T cells,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】CAR-T免疫疗法：120万一针的抗癌神药

cues.zh: 还有另外一种特异性免疫细胞叫 B 细胞
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ling4 wai4 yi1 zhong3 te4 yi4 xing4 mian3 yi4 xi4 bao1 jiao4 B xi4 bao1
cues.en: there's another type of specific immune cell called B cells.

cues.zh: 主要是这样的两种淋巴细胞
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5 liang3 zhong3 lin2 ba1 xi4 bao1
cues.en: These are mainly the two kinds of lymphocytes.

cues.zh: 那么这个辅助 T 细胞可以干什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 fu3 zhu4 T xi4 bao1 ke3 yi3 gan4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what can this helper T cell do?

cues.zh: 它表面有一些受体有各种各样的受体
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 mian4 you3 yi1 xie1 shou4 ti3 you3 ge4 zhong3 ge4 yang4 de5 shou4 ti3
cues.en: On its surface it has various receptors,

cues.zh: 有的受体长得长方形有的受体长得三角形
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shou4 ti3 zhang3 de2 chang2 fang1 xing2 you3 de5 shou4 ti3 zhang3 de2 san1 jiao3 xing2
cues.en: some shaped like rectangles, some like triangles.

cues.zh: 结果巨石细胞送过来一个长方形的
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 ju4 shi2 xi4 bao1 song4 guo4 lai2 yi2 ge4 chang2 fang1 xing2 de5
cues.en: Suppose a macrophage delivers a rectangular

cues.zh: 一个这个病原体的碎片
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 zhe4 ge5 bing4 yuan2 ti3 de5 sui4 pian4
cues.en: fragment of a pathogen,

cues.zh: 然后带有长方形受体的辅助细胞就会过来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 dai4 you3 chang2 fang1 xing2 shou4 ti3 de5 fu3 zhu4 xi4 bao1 jiu4 hui4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: then the helper cell with a rectangular receptor comes over

cues.zh: 就会抓住这个碎片
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 zhua1 zhu4 zhe4 ge5 sui4 pian4
cues.en: and grabs this fragment.

cues.zh: 然后他就进行分析说这个碎片表明
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 jin4 xing2 fen1 xi1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 sui4 pian4 biao3 ming2
cues.en: Then it analyzes and concludes this fragment shows

cues.zh: 有一些具有这种特征的坏分子
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 xie1 ju4 you3 zhe4 zhong3 te4 zheng1 de5 huai4 fen4 zi3
cues.en: that some bad actors with this characteristic

cues.zh: 已经混进来了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 hun4 jin4 lai2 le5
cues.en: have already infiltrated.

cues.zh: 那怎么办呢我就要动员起来对不对
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5 wo3 jiu4 yao4 dong4 yuan2 qi3 lai2 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: So what do we do? We need to mobilize, right?

cues.zh: 它就会分泌一种物质叫做细胞激素
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 fen1 mi4 yi1 zhong3 wu4 zhi4 jiao4 zuo4 xi4 bao1 ji1 su4
cues.en: It secretes a substance called cytokines.

cues.zh: 而细胞激素一方面可以活化自身
cues.pinyin: er2 xi4 bao1 ji1 su4 yi4 fang1 mian4 ke3 yi3 huo2 hua4 zi4 shen1
cues.en: Cytokines can, on one hand, activate itself —

cues.zh: 就是活化这个辅助 T 细胞产生更
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 huo2 hua4 zhe4 ge5 fu3 zhu4 T xi4 bao1 chan3 sheng1 geng4
cues.en: that is, activate this helper T cell to produce more

cues.zh: 多的细胞激素
cues.pinyin: duo1 de5 xi4 bao1 ji1 su4
cues.en: cytokines.

cues.zh: 而另外一方面它可以造出很多其
cues.pinyin: er2 ling4 wai4 yi4 fang1 mian4 ta1 ke3 yi3 zao4 chu1 hen3 duo1 qi2
cues.en: On the other hand, it can produce many other

cues.zh: 他的免疫细胞
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 mian3 yi4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: immune cells.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】CAR-T免疫疗法：120万一针的抗癌神药

cues.zh: 也就是说你只有经过辅助 T 细胞的动员
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ni3 zhi3 you3 jing1 guo4 fu3 zhu4 T xi4 bao1 de5 dong4 yuan2
cues.en: In other words, only after being mobilized by the helper T cell

cues.zh: 然后你告诉我这个坏分子长什么样
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ni3 gao4 su4 wo3 zhe4 ge5 huai4 fen4 zi3 zhang3 shen2 me5 yang4
cues.en: and told what this bad actor looks like

cues.zh: 我才会去找它对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 cai2 hui4 qu4 zhao3 ta1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: will I go after it, right?

cues.zh: 其他的坏分子我不抓
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 huai4 fen4 zi3 wo3 bu4 zhua1
cues.en: I won't catch other bad actors;

cues.zh: 我就抓带有这个长方块的这个
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zhua1 dai4 you3 zhe4 ge5 chang2 fang1 kuai4 de5 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: I'll only catch the ones with this rectangular shape,

cues.zh: 坏分子是不是
cues.pinyin: huai4 fen4 zi3 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 好这个就是特异性的这个免疫细胞
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 te4 yi4 xing4 de5 zhe4 ge5 mian3 yi4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: This is the specific immune cell.

cues.zh: 同时辅助 T 细胞动员还可以动员僵细胞
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 fu3 zhu4 T xi4 bao1 dong4 yuan2 hai2 ke3 yi3 dong4 yuan2 jiang1 xi4 bao1
cues.en: At the same time, helper T cell mobilization can also mobilize plasma cells.

cues.zh: 这个僵细胞是由 B 细胞分化而形成的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiang1 xi4 bao1 shi4 you2 B xi4 bao1 fen1 hua4 er2 xing2 cheng2 de5
cues.en: These plasma cells are formed by B cells differentiating.

cues.zh: 僵细胞可以干什么呢
cues.pinyin: jiang1 xi4 bao1 ke3 yi3 gan4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What can plasma cells do?

cues.zh: 僵细胞可以分泌出很多的抗体
cues.pinyin: jiang1 xi4 bao1 ke3 yi3 fen1 mi4 chu1 hen3 duo1 de5 kang4 ti3
cues.en: Plasma cells can secrete lots of antibodies.

cues.zh: 这个抗体长的样子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 kang4 ti3 zhang3 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: What do these antibodies look like?

cues.zh: 也和它刚才这个 T 细胞的受体一样
cues.pinyin: ye3 he2 ta1 gang1 cai2 zhe4 ge5 T xi4 bao1 de5 shou4 ti3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: They're just like the T cell's receptor —

cues.zh: 它也是专门去寻找病毒表面的这些特征
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shi4 zhuan1 men2 qu4 xun2 zhao3 bing4 du2 biao3 mian4 de5 zhe4 xie1 te4 zheng1
cues.en: they're specifically designed to find features on the virus's surface.

cues.zh: 那么它来了之后
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 lai2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it arrives,

cues.zh: 抗体本身它是不带有这个杀伤能力的
cues.pinyin: kang4 ti3 ben3 shen1 ta1 shi4 bu4 dai4 you3 zhe4 ge5 sha1 shang1 neng2 li4 de5
cues.en: the antibody itself doesn't have killing power,

cues.zh: 但是它可以把这个病原体包住
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 yuan2 ti3 bao1 zhu4
cues.en: but it can wrap around the pathogen.

cues.zh: 你这个病原体表面不是有这个肠
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 yuan2 ti3 biao3 mian4 bu2 shi4 you3 zhe4 ge5 chang2
cues.en: Doesn't this pathogen's surface have this unique

cues.zh: 黄罐的特征吗
cues.pinyin: huang2 guan4 de5 te4 zheng1 ma5
cues.en: feature?

cues.zh: 特征吗
cues.pinyin: te4 zheng1 ma5
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 好你有这个特征我就把你包住
cues.pinyin: hao3 ni3 you3 zhe4 ge5 te4 zheng1 wo3 jiu4 ba3 ni3 bao1 zhu4
cues.en: Well, since you have that feature, I'll wrap you up.

cues.en: We meet again, I'm Cissy

cues.zh: 那外面的天气呢越变越暖了

cues.en: The weather outside is getting warmer and warmer

cues.zh: 然后太阳越变越大

cues.en: And the sun is getting stronger

cues.zh: 天气真的是十分的漂亮
cues.pinyin: tian1 qi4 zhen1 de5 shi4 shi2 fen1 de5 piao4 liang4

cues.zh: 然后这个叶子呢又变绿了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhe4 ge5 ye4 zi5 ne5 you4 bian4 lv4 le5
cues.en: And the leaves have turned green again

cues.zh: 那今天想要跟大家分享的是我
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 xiang3 yao4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 wo3
cues.en: So today I want to share with you

cues.zh: 个人的私房菜
cues.pinyin: ge4 ren2 de5 si1 fang2 cai4
cues.en: my personal secret home recipe

cues.zh: 我是这么做的
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zhe4 me5 zuo4 de5
cues.en: This is how I make it

cues.zh: 那我知道大家每家呢每户呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 zhi1 dao4 da4 jia1 mei3 jia1 ne5 mei3 hu4 ne5
cues.en: I know every household

cues.zh: 都有自己的这样的食谱
cues.pinyin: dou1 you3 zi4 ji3 de5 zhe4 yang4 de5 shi2 pu3

cues.zh: 清爽的这个凉拌小黄瓜

cues.en: this refreshing cold cucumber salad

cues.zh: 我是这么做的赶快来看一看

cues.zh: 我们用刀给这个黄瓜稍微的拍一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 dao1 gei3 zhe4 ge5 huang2 gua1 shao1 wei1 de5 pai1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Use a knife to lightly smash the cucumber

cues.zh: 这样子做黄瓜等下搅拌的时候会更入味
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 huang2 gua1 deng3 xia4 jiao3 ban4 de5 shi2 hou4 hui4 geng4 ru4 wei4
cues.en: This way the cucumber absorbs the flavor better when mixed later

cues.zh: 再给它切成半英寸这样子的小块
cues.pinyin: zai4 gei3 ta1 qie4 cheng2 ban4 ying1 cun4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 xiao3 kuai4
cues.en: Then cut it into small pieces about half an inch

cues.zh: 那如果你想要切大一点也没有问题
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 yao4 qie4 da4 yi1 dian3 ye3 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: If you want to cut them bigger, that's fine too

cues.zh: 我是方便家里的小孩子吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 fang1 bian4 jia1 li3 de5 xiao3 hai2 zi5 chi1
cues.en: I cut them small so it's easier for the kids at home to eat

cues.zh: 所以切小一点
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qie4 xiao3 yi4 dian3
cues.en: So I cut them smaller

cues.zh: 另外一半黄瓜呢也是同样的做法
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 yi2 ban4 huang2 gua1 ne5 ye3 shi4 tong2 yang4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: Do the same with the other half of the cucumber

cues.zh: 这个时候我们来做我们的蒜油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 wo3 men5 de5 suan4 you2
cues.en: Now let's make our garlic oil

cues.zh: 在一个小锅里呢放入植物油
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 xiao3 guo1 li3 ne5 fang4 ru4 zhi2 wu4 you2
cues.en: Put vegetable oil in a small pot

cues.zh: 然后蒜
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 suan4
cues.en: Then add garlic

cues.zh: 用小火呢给它炒大概是一分钟的时间
cues.pinyin: yong4 xiao3 huo3 ne5 gei3 ta1 chao3 da4 gai4 shi4 yi4 fen1 zhong1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Fry it on low heat for about a minute

cues.zh: 荞麦面酱油露
cues.pinyin: qiao2 mai4 mian4 jiang4 you2 lu4
cues.en: Soy sauce dressing

cues.zh: 我很喜欢这种酱油露
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 xi3 huan1 zhe4 zhong3 jiang4 you2 lu4
cues.en: I really like this type of soy sauce dressing

cues.zh: 因为它可以增加鲜味
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 ke3 yi3 zeng1 jia1 xian1 wei4
cues.en: Because it adds umami flavor

cues.zh: 那如果你没有的话呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 mei2 you3 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If you don't have it

cues.zh: 也可以用酱油代替

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 你敢信这个健壮的男人黑子竟然被
cues.pinyin: ni3 gan3 xin4 zhe4 ge5 jian4 zhuang4 de5 nan2 ren2 hei1 zi5 jing4 ran2 bei4
cues.en: Can you believe this muscular man actually got

cues.zh: 确诊为乳腺癌
cues.pinyin: que4 zhen3 wei4 ru3 xian4 ai2
cues.en: diagnosed with breast cancer?

cues.zh: 是医生们搞错了还是这其中另有隐情
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi1 sheng1 men5 gao3 cuo4 le5 hai2 shi4 zhe4 qi2 zhong1 ling4 you3 yin3 qing2
cues.en: Did the doctors make a mistake, or is there something else going on?

cues.zh: 医院收治了一名普通的挫伤病人
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 shou1 zhi4 le5 yi1 ming2 pu3 tong1 de5 cuo4 shang1 bing4 ren2
cues.en: The hospital admitted an ordinary patient with a contusion.

cues.zh: 亚瑟对此特别兴奋
cues.pinyin: ya4 se4 dui4 ci3 te4 bie2 xing1 fen4
cues.en: Arthur was especially excited about this.

cues.zh: 摩根则对亚瑟的表现感到惊讶
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 ze2 dui4 ya4 se4 de5 biao3 xian4 gan3 dao4 jing1 ya4
cues.en: Morgan, however, was surprised by Arthur's reaction.

cues.zh: 有啥好激动的啊
cues.pinyin: you3 sha2 hao3 ji1 dong4 de5 a5
cues.en: What's there to be so excited about?

cues.zh: 见到病人后摩根明白了其中的原因
cues.pinyin: jian4 dao4 bing4 ren2 hou4 mo2 gen1 ming2 bai2 le5 qi2 zhong1 de5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: After seeing the patient, Morgan understood the reason.

cues.zh: 那个男人叫做布拉德利
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 nan2 ren2 jiao4 zuo4 bu4 la1 de2 li4
cues.en: That man was named Bradley.

cues.zh: 他是美国的格斗明星
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 mei3 guo2 de5 ge2 dou4 ming2 xing1
cues.en: He was an American fighting star.

cues.zh: 布拉德利打拳的时候
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 da3 quan2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When Bradley was fighting,

cues.zh: 对手的回旋腿正好踢中他的胸口
cues.pinyin: dui4 shou3 de5 hui2 xuan2 tui3 zheng4 hao3 ti1 zhong1 ta1 de5 xiong1 kou3
cues.en: his opponent's spinning kick landed right on his chest.

cues.zh: 这让他的伤口看起来伤得很严重
cues.pinyin: zhe4 rang4 ta1 de5 shang1 kou3 kan4 qi3 lai2 shang1 de2 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: This made his wound look very serious.

cues.zh: 亚瑟之所以很兴奋
cues.pinyin: ya4 se4 zhi1 suo3 yi3 hen3 xing1 fen4
cues.en: The reason Arthur was so excited

cues.zh: 是因为他见到了心中的明星
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 jian4 dao4 le5 xin1 zhong1 de5 ming2 xing1
cues.en: was that he got to see the star he admired.

cues.zh: 摩根很快对布拉德利的伤情做出了判断
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 hen3 kuai4 dui4 bu4 la1 de2 li4 de5 shang1 qing2 zuo4 chu1 le5 pan4 duan4
cues.en: Morgan quickly made a judgment about Bradley's injury.

cues.zh: 血块很严重
cues.pinyin: xue4 kuai4 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: The blood clot was severe.

cues.zh: 所以需要立刻排液
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xu1 yao4 li4 ke4 pai2 ye4
cues.en: so it needed to be drained right away.

cues.zh: 布拉德利提出了一个特殊的要求
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 te4 shu1 de5 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: Bradley made a special request.

cues.zh: 排液可以
cues.pinyin: pai2 ye4 ke3 yi3
cues.en: Draining it was fine,

cues.zh: 但是不能在大庭广众之下进行
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bu4 neng2 zai4 da4 ting2 guang3 zhong4 zhi1 xia4 jin4 xing2
cues.en: but it couldn't be done in public.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 因为这会让他的粉丝们知道他受伤的事

cues.en: because that would let his fans know he was injured.

cues.zh: 布拉德利为了让自己看起来更强壮
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 wei4 le5 rang4 zi4 ji3 kan4 qi3 lai2 geng4 qiang2 zhuang4
cues.en: In order to look stronger,

cues.en: he had once gotten implants.

cues.zh: 检查结果显示
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The examination results showed

cues.pinyin: ta1 guo4 qu4 zhi2 ru4 de5 jia3 ti3 wan2 hao3 wu2 sun3

cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 de5 jian3 cha2 shi4 zai4 dan1 du2 de5 fang2 jian1 jin4 xing2 de5
cues.en: Bradley's examination was done in a private room.

cues.zh: 对于这样的照顾
cues.pinyin: dui4 yu2 zhe4 yang4 de5 zhao4 gu4
cues.en: For this kind of consideration,

cues.zh: 布拉德利对医生很是感激
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 dui4 yi1 sheng1 hen3 shi4 gan3 ji1
cues.en: Bradley was very grateful to the doctors.

cues.zh: 他心里明白
cues.pinyin: ta1 xin1 li3 ming2 bai2
cues.en: He knew in his heart

cues.zh: 如果粉丝们发现他植入了假体
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 fen3 si1 men5 fa1 xian4 ta1 zhi2 ru4 le5 jia3 ti3
cues.en: that if his fans found out he had implants,

cues.zh: 那他的职业生涯也就结束了
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 de5 zhi2 ye4 sheng1 ya2 ye3 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: his career would be over.

cues.zh: 布拉德利说出了他的过去
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 shuo1 chu1 le5 ta1 de5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: Bradley told them about his past.

cues.zh: 在他还是个大男孩的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 hai2 shi4 ge4 da4 nan2 hai2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When he was just a boy,

cues.en: His mother really wanted him to be able to protect himself,

cues.zh: 于是便把他送去练柔道

cues.zh: 可是练习柔道让他身体的脂肪快速消失
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lian4 xi2 rou2 dao4 rang4 ta1 shen1 ti3 de5 zhi1 fang2 kuai4 su4 xiao1 shi1
cues.en: But practicing judo made the fat on his body disappear quickly.

cues.zh: 后来他为了让自己看起来更加强壮
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 wei4 le5 rang4 zi4 ji3 kan4 qi3 lai2 geng4 jia1 qiang2 zhuang4
cues.en: Later, in order to look even stronger,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 影像可见的范围
cues.pinyin: ying3 xiang4 ke3 jian4 de5 fan4 wei2
cues.en: that the visible range of the imaging

cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 bei4 zhi2 ru4 de5 xin1 zang4 dao3 guan3 ye3 bei4 dang3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: the implanted cardiac catheter was also blocked.

cues.zh: 医生们不得不暂停手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 bu4 de2 bu4 zan4 ting2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The doctors had to pause the surgery.

cues.zh: 因为肿瘤很大
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhong3 liu2 hen3 da4
cues.en: Because the tumor was large,

cues.zh: 他们需要将布拉德利叫醒
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xu1 yao4 jiang1 bu4 la1 de2 li4 jiao4 xing3
cues.en: they needed to wake Bradley up

cues.zh: 然后让他同意做全乳切除手术
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rang4 ta1 tong2 yi4 zuo4 quan2 ru3 qie1 chu2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and get his consent for a full mastectomy.

cues.zh: 朴医生找到布拉德利
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 zhao3 dao4 bu4 la1 de2 li4
cues.en: Dr. Park went to see Bradley.

cues.zh: 他说出了布拉德利的真实病情
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 chu1 le5 bu4 la1 de2 li4 de5 zhen1 shi2 bing4 qing2
cues.en: He told Bradley his real condition.

cues.zh: 布拉德利必须要做全乳切除手术
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 bi4 xu1 yao4 zuo4 quan2 ru3 qie1 chu2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Bradley had to undergo a full mastectomy.

cues.zh: 虽然这会切除他的胸部假体
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 hui4 qie1 chu2 ta1 de5 xiong1 bu4 jia3 ti3
cues.en: Although this would remove his chest implant,

cues.zh: 但这会让他恢复健康
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 hui4 rang4 ta1 hui1 fu4 jian4 kang1
cues.en: it would restore his health.

cues.zh: 手术应该会很顺利
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 ying1 gai1 hui4 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: The surgery should go smoothly.

cues.zh: 再加上后期的锻炼
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 hou4 qi1 de5 duan4 lian4
cues.en: Combined with rehab exercise afterward,

cues.zh: 布拉德利的力量完全可以恢复
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 de5 li4 liang4 wan2 quan2 ke3 yi3 hui1 fu4
cues.en: Bradley's strength could fully recover.

cues.zh: 布拉德利不同意
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: Bradley refused.

cues.zh: 他担心如果那样的话
cues.pinyin: ta1 dan1 xin1 ru2 guo3 na4 yang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: He worried that if that happened,

cues.zh: 他的胸部看起来就像凹进去一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xiong1 bu4 kan4 qi3 lai2 jiu4 xiang4 ao1 jin4 qu4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: his chest would look sunken in.

cues.zh: 那时他会失去所有的赞助
cues.pinyin: na4 shi2 ta1 hui4 shi1 qu4 suo3 you3 de5 zan4 zhu4
cues.en: Then he'd lose all his sponsorships.

cues.zh: 布拉德利选择了化疗
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 xuan3 ze2 le5 hua4 liao2
cues.en: Bradley chose chemotherapy.

cues.zh: 他想只通过化疗来治好自己的病
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 zhi3 tong1 guo4 hua4 liao2 lai2 zhi4 hao3 zi4 ji3 de5 bing4
cues.en: He wanted to cure his illness with chemo alone.

cues.zh: 朴医生解释说
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 jie3 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: Dr. Park explained

cues.zh: 单独化疗的话不一定能够治好他的乳腺癌
cues.pinyin: dan1 du2 hua4 liao2 de5 hua4 bu4 yi2 ding4 neng2 gou4 zhi4 hao3 ta1 de5 ru3 xian4 ai2
cues.en: that chemo alone might not necessarily cure his breast cancer.

cues.zh: 布拉德利则认为有希望就行
cues.pinyin: bu4 la1 de2 li4 ze2 ren4 wei2 you3 xi1 wang4 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: Bradley figured having hope was enough,

cues.zh: 只要不切除假体
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 bu4 qie1 chu2 jia3 ti3
cues.en: as long as the implant wasn't removed.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 小珍就要做手术了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 jiu4 yao4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: Xiaozhen was about to have surgery.

cues.zh: 相关检查结果显示
cues.pinyin: xiang1 guan1 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The relevant test results showed

cues.zh: 小珍术前的各项指标都很正常
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 shu4 qian2 de5 ge4 xiang4 zhi3 biao1 dou1 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: that all of Xiaozhen's pre-op indicators were normal.

cues.zh: 所以可以立刻给她进行髋关节致幻术
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ke3 yi3 li4 ke4 gei3 ta1 jin4 xing2 kuan1 guan1 jie2 zhi4 huan4 shu4
cues.en: so she could go ahead with hip replacement surgery right away.

cues.zh: 大家憧憬着小珍手术后的美好样子
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 chong1 jing3 zhe5 xiao3 zhen1 shou3 shu4 hou4 de5 mei3 hao3 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Everyone pictured how great Xiaozhen would look after the surgery.

cues.zh: 手术四小时后她就可以走路
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 si4 xiao3 shi2 hou4 ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zou3 lu4
cues.en: Four hours after surgery, she'd be able to walk.

cues.zh: 十至十二周之后
cues.pinyin: shi2 zhi4 shi2 er4 zhou1 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After ten to twelve weeks,

cues.zh: 她就能像正常人一样了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 neng2 xiang4 zheng4 chang2 ren2 yi1 yang4 le5
cues.en: she'd be back to normal.

cues.zh: 不过小珍期望自己
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 zhen1 qi1 wang4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: But Xiaozhen hoped

cues.zh: 九周后就能像正常人一样
cues.pinyin: jiu3 zhou1 hou4 jiu4 neng2 xiang4 zheng4 chang2 ren2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: to be back to normal after just nine weeks.

cues.zh: 肖恩非常耐心地对她解释说
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 fei1 chang2 nai4 xin1 di4 dui4 ta1 jie3 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: Shaun patiently explained to her

cues.zh: 这种事情不能操之过急
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 shi4 qing2 bu4 neng2 cao1 zhi1 guo4 ji2
cues.en: that this kind of thing couldn't be rushed.

cues.zh: 小珍对于手术很有信心
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 dui4 yu2 shou3 shu4 hen3 you3 xin4 xin1
cues.en: Xiaozhen was very confident about the surgery.

cues.zh: 她认为做完手术之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 zuo4 wan2 shou3 shu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: She believed that once it was done,

cues.zh: 自己就再无病痛了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 jiu4 zai4 wu2 bing4 tong4 le5
cues.en: she'd never have any more pain.

cues.zh: 再也不用吃药
cues.pinyin: zai4 ye3 bu4 yong4 chi1 yao4
cues.en: She'd never need to take medicine again.

cues.zh: 用不了多久
cues.pinyin: yong4 bu4 liao3 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: Before long,

cues.zh: 她就能够重新回到驾驶舱
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 neng2 gou4 chong2 xin1 hui2 dao4 jia4 shi3 cang1
cues.en: she'd be back in the cockpit,

cues.zh: 驾驶飞机了
cues.pinyin: jia4 shi3 fei1 ji1 le5
cues.en: flying planes again.

cues.zh: 医生开始给小珍做手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 kai1 shi3 gei3 xiao3 zhen1 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The doctors began operating on Xiaozhen.

cues.zh: 最开始时一切进行的都很顺利
cues.pinyin: zui4 kai1 shi3 shi2 yi1 qie4 jin4 xing2 de5 dou1 hen3 shun4 li4
cues.en: At first, everything went smoothly.

cues.zh: 突然小珍的血压开始骤降
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 xiao3 zhen1 de5 xue4 ya1 kai1 shi3 zhou4 jiang4
cues.en: Suddenly Xiaozhen's blood pressure began to crash.

cues.zh: 高压降到了 64
cues.pinyin: gao1 ya1 jiang4 dao4 le5 64
cues.en: Her systolic pressure dropped to 64.

cues.zh: 低压降到了 38
cues.pinyin: di1 ya1 jiang4 dao4 le5 38
cues.en: Her diastolic pressure dropped to 38.

cues.zh: 医生健壮立刻推出液体
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jian4 zhuang4 li4 ke4 tui1 chu1 ye4 ti3
cues.en: The doctors immediately pushed fluids.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 并且启动生压器
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 qi3 dong4 sheng1 ya1 qi4
cues.en: and started vasopressors.

cues.zh: 这时大家忽然发现
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 da4 jia1 hu1 ran2 fa1 xian4
cues.en: At that moment everyone suddenly noticed

cues.zh: 小珍的心率只有 42
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 de5 xin1 lv4 zhi3 you3 42
cues.en: that Xiaozhen's heart rate was only 42.

cues.zh: 她的逗性心动过缓
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 dou4 xing4 xin1 dong4 guo4 huan3
cues.en: She had sinus bradycardia.

cues.zh: 肖恩对此感到不理解
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 dui4 ci3 gan3 dao4 bu4 li3 jie3
cues.en: Shaun couldn't make sense of it.

cues.zh: 因为在手术前
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zai4 shou3 shu4 qian2
cues.en: Because before the surgery,

cues.zh: 小珍的各项检查指标都很正常
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 de5 ge4 xiang4 jian3 cha2 zhi3 biao1 dou1 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: all of Xiaozhen's test results had been normal.

cues.zh: 小珍没有心脏病史
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 mei2 you3 xin1 zang4 bing4 shi3
cues.en: Xiaozhen had no history of heart disease.

cues.zh: 如果有血栓的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 you3 xue4 shuan1 de5 hua4
cues.en: If there were a blood clot,

cues.zh: 她的心率应该很快
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xin1 lv4 ying1 gai1 hen3 kuai4
cues.en: her heart rate should be fast.

cues.zh: 这时小珍的血压突然又正常了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 xiao3 zhen1 de5 xue4 ya1 tu1 ran2 you4 zheng4 chang2 le5
cues.en: At this point Xiaozhen's blood pressure suddenly went back to normal.

cues.zh: 医生们见状立即赶紧继续对她进行手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jian4 zhuang4 li4 ji2 gan3 jin3 ji4 xu4 dui4 ta1 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Seeing this, the doctors quickly pressed on with the surgery.

cues.zh: 大家心里明白等手术结束后
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 xin1 li3 ming2 bai2 deng3 shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: Everyone knew that once the surgery was over,

cues.zh: 必须弄清楚小珍血压突然下降的原因
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 nong4 qing1 chu3 xiao3 zhen1 xue4 ya1 tu1 ran2 xia4 jiang4 de5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: they'd have to figure out why Xiaozhen's blood pressure had suddenly dropped.

cues.zh: 做完手术后的小珍她的状态非常好
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wan2 shou3 shu4 hou4 de5 xiao3 zhen1 ta1 de5 zhuang4 tai4 fei1 chang2 hao3
cues.en: After surgery, Xiaozhen was doing very well.

cues.zh: 她很积极乐观地面对着一切
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 ji1 ji2 le4 guan1 di4 mian4 dui4 zhe5 yi1 qie4
cues.en: She faced everything with positivity and optimism.

cues.zh: 同时也努力地配合着医生做康复锻炼
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 ye3 nu3 li4 di4 pei4 he2 zhe5 yi1 sheng1 zuo4 kang1 fu4 duan4 lian4
cues.en: She also worked hard with the doctors on rehab exercises.

cues.zh: 小珍的心脏没有任何问题
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 de5 xin1 zang4 mei2 you3 ren4 he2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: There was nothing wrong with Xiaozhen's heart.

cues.zh: 她做手术师之所以血压下降
cues.pinyin: ta1 zuo4 shou3 shu4 shi1 zhi1 suo3 yi3 xue4 ya1 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: The reason her blood pressure dropped during surgery

cues.zh: 那是她对麻醉剂的反应所导致的
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 ta1 dui4 ma2 zui4 ji4 de5 fan3 ying4 suo3 dao3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: was due to her reaction to the anesthetic.

cues.zh: 小珍走下床她开始扶着架子练习走路
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 zou3 xia4 chuang2 ta1 kai1 shi3 fu2 zhe5 jia4 zi5 lian4 xi2 zou3 lu4
cues.en: Xiaozhen got out of bed and started practicing walking holding a frame.

cues.zh: 突然她晕倒在了地上
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 ta1 yun1 dao3 zai4 le5 di4 shang4
cues.en: Suddenly she collapsed on the floor.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 格斗明星为了让自己更强壮，竟私自改造身体！结果竟患上了乳腺癌，还好他碰到了一群天才医生！

cues.zh: 是否出现过直隆隆的盯着某处看的情况
cues.pinyin: shi4 fou3 chu1 xian4 guo4 zhi2 long2 long2 de5 ding1 zhe5 mou3 chu4 kan4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Had there been times when she just stared blankly at one spot?

cues.zh: 小珍的女儿托莉回想到了这样的情况
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 de5 nv3 er2 tuo1 li4 hui2 xiang3 dao4 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Xiaozhen's daughter Tori recalled a situation like that.

cues.zh: 她的父亲去世之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 fu4 qin1 qu4 shi4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After her father passed away,

cues.zh: 有一次小珍看电视看到很晚
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 xiao3 zhen1 kan4 dian4 shi4 kan4 dao4 hen3 wan3
cues.en: once Xiaozhen stayed up late watching TV,

cues.zh: 然后不知不觉就睡着了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 bu4 zhi1 bu4 jue2 jiu4 shui4 zhao2 le5
cues.en: then fell asleep without realizing it.

cues.zh: 不一会后小珍起来上厕所时突然头晕
cues.pinyin: bu4 yi1 hui4 hou4 xiao3 zhen1 qi3 lai2 shang4 ce4 suo3 shi2 tu1 ran2 tou2 yun1
cues.en: A little while later, when she got up to use the bathroom, she suddenly felt dizzy.

cues.zh: 那次还差点晕倒
cues.pinyin: na4 ci4 hai2 cha4 dian3 yun1 dao3
cues.en: That time she almost fainted.

cues.zh: 小珍听完女儿的话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 ting1 wan2 nv3 er2 de5 hua4
cues.en: After hearing her daughter's account,

cues.zh: 她认为对于那次头晕不用太介意
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 wei2 dui4 yu2 na4 ci4 tou2 yun1 bu4 yong4 tai4 jie4 yi4
cues.en: Xiaozhen felt that spell of dizziness wasn't worth worrying about.

cues.zh: 那是因为她太累造成的
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 tai4 lei4 zao4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: She thought it was just because she'd been too tired.

cues.zh: 其实这种情况在这几年出现过好几次
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 zai4 zhe4 ji3 nian2 chu1 xian4 guo4 hao3 ji3 ci4
cues.en: Actually, this had happened several times over the past few years.

cues.zh: 小珍曾经和内科医生反映过这个问题
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 ceng2 jing1 he2 nei4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 fan3 ying4 guo4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Xiaozhen had mentioned this to her internist before.

cues.zh: 不过医生当时认为这是更年期的正常状况
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 yi1 sheng1 dang1 shi2 ren4 wei2 zhe4 shi4 geng1 nian2 qi1 de5 zheng4 chang2 zhuang4 kuang4
cues.en: but at the time the doctor thought it was just normal menopause.

cues.zh: 肖恩立刻找到小珍当年的主治医生
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 li4 ke4 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 zhen1 dang1 nian2 de5 zhu3 zhi4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Shaun immediately tracked down Xiaozhen's attending doctor from back then.

cues.zh: 她迫不及待地将小珍的状况告诉了对方
cues.pinyin: ta1 po4 bu4 ji2 dai4 di4 jiang1 xiao3 zhen1 de5 zhuang4 kuang4 gao4 su4 le5 dui4 fang1
cues.en: She couldn't wait to tell him about Xiaozhen's condition.

cues.zh: 小珍的很多症状都没有写到病历中
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zhen1 de5 hen3 duo1 zheng4 zhuang4 dou1 mei2 you3 xie3 dao4 bing4 li4 zhong1
cues.en: Many of Xiaozhen's symptoms had never been written into her medical record.

cues.zh: 便秘失眠热潮性欲减退
cues.pinyin: bian4 mi4 shi1 mian2 re4 chao2 xing4 yu4 jian3 tui4
cues.en: Constipation, insomnia, hot flashes, decreased libido.

cues.zh: 这些绝对不是更年期的问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 jue2 dui4 bu2 shi4 geng1 nian2 qi1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: These were definitely not menopause issues.

cues.zh: 因为更年期问题不会影响到血压
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 geng1 nian2 qi1 wen4 ti2 bu2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 dao4 xue4 ya1
