items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】摩天大楼会被台风吹倒吗？定楼神器风阻尼器原理

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近台风频繁袭扰我国
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 tai2 feng1 pin2 fan2 xi2 rao3 wo3 guo2
cues.en: Typhoons have been frequently hitting our country recently.

cues.zh: 在上海地区有许多的摩天大楼
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang4 hai3 di4 qu1 you3 xu3 duo1 de5 mo2 tian1 da4 lou2
cues.en: There are many skyscrapers in the Shanghai area.

cues.zh: 这些摩天大楼在台风中依然巍然不动
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 mo2 tian1 da4 lou2 zai4 tai2 feng1 zhong1 yi1 ran2 wei1 ran2 bu4 dong4
cues.en: These skyscrapers remain standing firm in typhoons.

cues.zh: 这是因为大楼上安装了一种叫做风
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yin1 wei4 da4 lou2 shang4 an1 zhuang1 le5 yi1 zhong3 jiao4 zuo4 feng1
cues.en: This is because a device called a wind

cues.zh: 阻尼器的东西
cues.pinyin: zu3 ni2 qi4 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: damper is installed on the building.

cues.zh: 有许多小朋友就问我说这个风阻尼器到底
cues.pinyin: you3 xu3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 feng1 zu3 ni2 qi4 dao4 di3
cues.en: Many kids have asked me what exactly this wind damper

cues.zh: 是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: is all about.

cues.zh: 今天我们就来研究一下这种定楼神器
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 zhong3 ding4 lou2 shen2 qi4
cues.en: Today let's look into this building-stabilizing device.

cues.zh: 为了了解风阻尼器的原理
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 liao3 jie3 feng1 zu3 ni2 qi4 de5 yuan2 li3
cues.en: To understand the principle behind the wind damper,

cues.zh: 我们首先先来讲一下物体振动的一种形式
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 jiang3 yi1 xia4 wu4 ti3 zhen4 dong4 de5 yi1 zhong3 xing2 shi4
cues.en: let's first talk about a type of object vibration

cues.zh: 叫做受迫振动
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 shou4 po4 zhen4 dong4
cues.en: called forced vibration.

cues.zh: 所谓受迫振动就是物体在一定的驱动力
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 shou4 po4 zhen4 dong4 jiu4 shi4 wu4 ti3 zai4 yi2 ding4 de5 qu1 dong4 li4
cues.en: So-called forced vibration is when an object, under a certain driving force,

cues.zh: 作用下的振动
cues.pinyin: zuo4 yong4 xia4 de5 zhen4 dong4
cues.en: vibrates under that force.

cues.zh: 我们先来举一个例子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 ju3 yi2 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let's start with an example.

cues.zh: 说这里有一个天花板
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 li3 you3 yi2 ge4 tian1 hua1 ban3
cues.en: Say there's a ceiling here,

cues.zh: 天花板下面用弹簧吊著一个物体
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 ban3 xia4 mian4 yong4 tan2 huang2 diao4 zhu4 yi2 ge4 wu4 ti3
cues.en: and an object is hung from the ceiling by a spring.

cues.zh: 弹簧有劲度系数 k 物体有质量 m
cues.pinyin: tan2 huang2 you3 jin4 du4 xi4 shu4 k wu4 ti3 you3 zhi4 liang4 m
cues.en: The spring has a stiffness coefficient k, and the object has mass m.

cues.zh: 如果我往下拉一下这个物体的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 wang3 xia4 la1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wu4 ti3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If I pull this object down a bit,

cues.zh: 那物体就会上下的振动
cues.pinyin: na4 wu4 ti3 jiu4 hui4 shang4 xia4 de5 zhen4 dong4
cues.en: the object will vibrate up and down.

cues.zh: 这种振动叫做自由振动
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 zhen4 dong4 jiao4 zuo4 zi4 you2 zhen4 dong4
cues.en: This type of vibration is called free vibration.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】摩天大楼会被台风吹倒吗？定楼神器风阻尼器原理

cues.zh: 它有一个周期和频率
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 zhou1 qi1 he2 pin2 lv4
cues.en: It has a period and a frequency,

cues.zh: 我们称之为固有周期或固有频率
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 gu4 you3 zhou1 qi1 huo4 gu4 you3 pin2 lv4
cues.en: which we call the natural period or natural frequency.

cues.zh: 像这种弹簧振子它的固有周期
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhe4 zhong3 tan2 huang2 zhen4 zi5 ta1 de5 gu4 you3 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: For a spring oscillator like this, its natural period

cues.zh: 是这样计算的
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhe4 yang4 ji4 suan4 de5
cues.en: is calculated like this:

cues.zh: 2 的根号下 m 除以 k
cues.pinyin: 2 de5 gen1 hao4 xia4 m chu2 yi3 k

cues.zh: 这个 m 是物体的质量
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 m shi4 wu4 ti3 de5 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: where m is the mass of the object,

cues.zh: 这个 k 是它的劲度系数
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 k shi4 ta1 de5 jin4 du4 xi4 shu4
cues.en: and k is its stiffness coefficient.

cues.zh: 跟它类似的还有比如说单摆
cues.pinyin: gen1 ta1 lei4 si4 de5 hai2 you3 bi3 ru2 shuo1 dan1 bai3
cues.en: Something similar is, for example, the simple pendulum.

cues.zh: 天花板下面吊了一个球
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 ban3 xia4 mian4 diao4 le5 yi2 ge4 qiu2
cues.en: A ball hangs from the ceiling,

cues.zh: 球在左右的摆动构成了一个单摆
cues.pinyin: qiu2 zai4 zuo3 you4 de5 bai3 dong4 gou4 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 dan1 bai3
cues.en: and the ball swinging left and right forms a simple pendulum.

cues.zh: 单摆在运动过程中也有一个固有周期
cues.pinyin: dan1 bai3 zai4 yun4 dong4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 ye3 you3 yi2 ge4 gu4 you3 zhou1 qi1
cues.en: The pendulum also has a natural period during its motion,

cues.zh: 固有周期叫 2 的根号下 L 比 G
cues.pinyin: gu4 you3 zhou1 qi1 jiao4 2 de5 gen1 hao4 xia4 L bi3 G
cues.en: the natural period is T = 2π√(L/g),

cues.zh: 这里面的 L 是摆长摆长
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mian4 de5 L shi4 bai3 zhang3 bai3 zhang3
cues.en: where L is the pendulum's length,

cues.zh: 而 G 是重力加速度
cues.pinyin: er2 G shi4 zhong4 li4 jia1 su4 du4
cues.en: and g is the acceleration due to gravity.

cues.zh: 也就是说物体在不受外力的时候

cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 du1 hui4 jing1 xin1 da3 li3 tou2 fa4
cues.en: Carefully does her hair every day.

cues.zh: 她说
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1
cues.en: She said,

cues.zh: 头发精神
cues.pinyin: tou2 fa4 jing1 shen2
cues.en: "When your hair looks lively,

cues.zh: 人也精神
cues.pinyin: ren2 ye3 jing1 shen2
cues.en: you look lively too."

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 台上的魔术师按下手中的按钮
cues.pinyin: tai2 shang4 de5 mo2 shu4 shi1 an4 xia4 shou3 zhong1 de5 an4 niu3
cues.en: The magician on stage presses the button in his hand.

cues.zh: 穿梭记里的法国佬竟然一秒钟
cues.pinyin: chuan1 suo1 ji4 li3 de5 fa3 guo2 lao3 jing4 ran2 yi1 miao3 zhong1
cues.en: In the blink of an eye, the French guy from the teleport

cues.zh: 穿越到地球另一边的巴黎
cues.pinyin: chuan1 yue4 dao4 di4 qiu2 ling4 yi1 bian1 de5 ba1 li2
cues.en: crosses to Paris, on the other side of the globe,

cues.zh: 并且降落到一个银行的金库中
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 jiang4 luo4 dao4 yi2 ge4 yin2 hang2 de5 jin1 ku4 zhong1
cues.en: and lands inside a bank's vault.

cues.zh: 面前最少有 300 万欧元的现金
cues.pinyin: mian4 qian2 zui4 shao3 you3 300 wan4 ou1 yuan2 de5 xian4 jin1
cues.en: In front of him sits at least 3 million euros in cash.

cues.zh: 这场魔术的终极目标竟是抢银行
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 mo2 shu4 de5 zhong1 ji2 mu4 biao1 jing4 shi4 qiang3 yin2 hang2
cues.en: The ultimate goal of this magic trick turns out to be robbing the bank.

cues.zh: 但他们并不是要据为己有
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 men5 bing4 bu2 shi4 yao4 ju4 wei2 ji3 you3
cues.en: But they don't intend to keep it for themselves.

cues.zh: 随着通风系统启动
cues.pinyin: sui2 zhe5 tong1 feng1 xi4 tong3 qi3 dong4
cues.en: As the ventilation system kicks in,

cues.zh: 300 万欧元全都撒跌了在场的观众们
cues.pinyin: 300 wan4 ou1 yuan2 quan2 dou1 sa1 die1 le5 zai4 chang3 de5 guan1 zhong4 men5
cues.en: all 3 million euros rain down onto the audience in the crowd.

cues.zh: 场上的 4 位魔术师被称为天奇色骑士
cues.pinyin: chang3 shang4 de5 4 wei4 mo2 shu4 shi1 bei4 cheng1 wei2 tian1 qi2 se4 qi2 shi4
cues.en: The four magicians on stage are known as the Four Horsemen.

cues.zh: 然而一年前他们还都是寂寂无
cues.pinyin: ran2 er2 yi1 nian2 qian2 ta1 men5 hai2 dou1 shi4 ji4 ji4 wu2
cues.en: Yet a year earlier they were all unknown

cues.zh: 名的街头骗子
cues.pinyin: ming2 de5 jie1 tou2 pian4 zi5
cues.en: street con artists.

cues.zh: 直到遇到了魔术界的最高荣誉组织
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 yu4 dao4 le5 mo2 shu4 jie4 de5 zui4 gao1 rong2 yu4 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: Until they encountered the magic world's most prestigious organization.

cues.zh: 传说魔术世界中有一个究极神秘组织
cues.pinyin: chuan2 shuo1 mo2 shu4 shi4 jie4 zhong1 you3 yi2 ge4 jiu1 ji2 shen2 mi4 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: Legend has it there's an ultimate secret society in the world of magic,

cues.zh: 名叫魔眼
cues.pinyin: ming2 jiao4 mo2 yan3
cues.en: called the Eye.

cues.zh: 从古埃及时就已经存在了
cues.pinyin: cong2 gu3 ai1 ji2 shi2 jiu4 yi3 jing1 cun2 zai4 le5
cues.en: It has existed since ancient Egypt.

cues.zh: 当年他们凭着一手绝活从法老那偷来食物
cues.pinyin: dang1 nian2 ta1 men5 ping2 zhe5 yi1 shou3 jue2 huo2 cong2 fa3 lao3 na4 tou1 lai2 shi2 wu4
cues.en: Back then, using their skills, they stole food from the pharaoh

cues.zh: 分给受苦的奴隶们
cues.pinyin: fen1 gei3 shou4 ku3 de5 nu2 li4 men5
cues.en: and gave it to the suffering slaves.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 摩岩就一个心思用戏法和幻象
cues.pinyin: mo2 yan2 jiu4 yi2 ge4 xin1 si1 yong4 xi4 fa3 he2 huan4 xiang4
cues.en: The Eye was single-mindedly devoted to using tricks and illusions

cues.zh: 把坏了的天秤给搬正了
cues.pinyin: ba3 huai4 le5 de5 tian1 cheng4 gei3 ban1 zheng4 le5
cues.en: to set the broken scales of justice right again.

cues.zh: 传到现在这组织还在延续香火
cues.pinyin: chuan2 dao4 xian4 zai4 zhe4 zu3 zhi1 hai2 zai4 yan2 xu4 xiang1 huo3
cues.en: Passed down to today, the organization still carries on its legacy.

cues.zh: 每年都会挑选两次传人就这样延续下去
cues.pinyin: mei3 nian2 du1 hui4 tiao1 xuan3 liang3 ci4 chuan2 ren2 jiu4 zhe4 yang4 yan2 xu4 xia4 qu4
cues.en: Every year they pick successors twice, and so it continues on.

cues.zh: 这回芝加哥的街头
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui2 zhi1 jia1 ge1 de5 jie1 tou2
cues.en: This time, on the streets of Chicago,

cues.zh: 丹妮正哗哗地翻着手里的牌
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 zheng4 hua1 hua1 di4 fan1 zhuo2 shou3 li3 de5 pai2
cues.en: Danny is riffling through a deck of cards in her hands.

cues.zh: 让嘉宾去记住其中一张牌
cues.pinyin: rang4 jia1 bin1 qu4 ji4 zhu4 qi2 zhong1 yi1 zhang1 pai2
cues.en: She has a guest memorize one of the cards.

cues.zh: 旁边姑娘攥着项链
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 gu1 niang2 zuan4 zhe5 xiang4 lian4
cues.en: The girl next to her clutches her necklace,

cues.zh: 眼都不眨的盯着
cues.pinyin: yan3 dou1 bu4 zha3 de5 ding1 zhe5
cues.en: staring without blinking.

cues.zh: 接着丹妮把牌铺开
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 dan1 ni1 ba3 pai2 pu4 kai1
cues.en: Then Danny fans the cards out.

cues.zh: 姑娘看了半天
cues.pinyin: gu1 niang2 kan4 le5 ban4 tian1
cues.en: The girl looks for a long while

cues.zh: 没发现自己选的那张
cues.pinyin: mei2 fa1 xian4 zi4 ji3 xuan3 de5 na4 zhang1
cues.en: but can't find the card she picked.

cues.zh: 丹妮猫要猛的把牌往牵上一扬
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 mao1 yao4 meng3 de5 ba3 pai2 wang3 qian1 shang4 yi1 yang2
cues.en: Danny suddenly flings the deck up into the air.

cues.zh: 下一秒旁边大厦的灯刷的亮起
cues.pinyin: xia4 yi1 miao3 pang2 bian1 da4 sha4 de5 deng1 shua1 de5 liang4 qi3
cues.en: The next second, the lights on the building nearby flash on,

cues.zh: 拼出那张牌的模样
cues.pinyin: pin1 chu1 na4 zhang1 pai2 de5 mu2 yang4
cues.en: forming the shape of that very card.

cues.zh: 姑娘嗷一嗓子叫出来
cues.pinyin: gu1 niang2 ao2 yi1 sang3 zi5 jiao4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: The girl lets out a shriek.

cues.zh: 围观的人惊得张大嘴
cues.pinyin: wei2 guan1 de5 ren2 jing1 de2 zhang1 da4 zui3
cues.en: The onlookers gasp, mouths wide open.

cues.zh: 而在人群的外围有一个神秘人
cues.pinyin: er2 zai4 ren2 qun2 de5 wai4 wei2 you3 yi2 ge4 shen2 mi4 ren2
cues.en: And at the edge of the crowd stands a mysterious figure.

cues.zh: 原来他波澜不惊想是习惯了
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 ta1 bo1 lan2 bu4 jing1 xiang3 shi4 xi2 guan4 le5
cues.en: He seems completely unfazed, as if he's used to this.

cues.zh: 镜头一转
cues.pinyin: jing4 tou2 yi1 zhuan3
cues.en: The scene cuts.

cues.zh: 新二良的咖啡经理
cues.pinyin: xin1 er4 liang2 de5 ka1 fei1 jing1 li3
cues.en: A coffee shop manager,

cues.zh: 李特一把勾住别人老婆的腰
cues.pinyin: li3 te4 yi1 ba3 gou1 zhu4 bie2 ren2 lao3 po2 de5 yao1
cues.en: Merritt suddenly hooks his arm around another man's wife's waist,

cues.zh: 然后秒后打了个响指
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 miao3 hou4 da3 le5 ge4 xiang3 zhi3
cues.en: then a few seconds later snaps his fingers,

cues.zh: 掏出钱来说
cues.pinyin: tao1 chu1 qian2 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: pulls out money, and says something.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 凑过来一把掏走杰克屁狗和袖口的外衣
cues.pinyin: cou4 guo4 lai2 yi1 ba3 tao1 zou3 jie2 ke4 pi4 gou3 he2 xiu4 kou3 de5 wai4 yi1
cues.en: He comes over and swipes Jack's wallet and the cash from his cuff.

cues.zh: 杰克被戳穿摸出一百块交给对方
cues.pinyin: jie2 ke4 bei4 chuo1 chuan1 mo1 chu1 yi4 bai3 kuai4 jiao1 gei3 dui4 fang1
cues.en: Caught in the act, Jack pulls out a hundred bucks and hands it over.

cues.zh: 接着往加板下走
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 wang3 jia1 ban3 xia4 zou3
cues.en: Then he walks on ahead.

cues.zh: 刚跟那神秘人擦身而过
cues.pinyin: gang1 gen1 na4 shen2 mi4 ren2 ca1 shen1 er2 guo4
cues.en: He's just brushed past that mysterious figure.

cues.zh: 眼镜哥突然摸动
cues.pinyin: yan3 jing4 ge1 tu1 ran2 mo1 dong4
cues.en: The guy in glasses suddenly pats his pocket

cues.zh: 发现钱包手表全没了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 qian2 bao1 shou3 biao3 quan2 mei2 le5
cues.en: and finds his wallet and watch are both gone.

cues.zh: 他扯着嗓子喊杰克
cues.pinyin: ta1 che3 zhe5 sang3 zi5 han3 jie2 ke4
cues.en: He shouts at the top of his lungs for Jack,

cues.zh: 可人家早混进人队
cues.pinyin: ke3 ren2 jia1 zao3 hun4 jin4 ren2 dui4
cues.en: but the guy's already vanished into the crowd.

cues.zh: 没赢了
cues.pinyin: mei2 ying2 le5
cues.en: Gone without a trace.

cues.zh: 开坦洛杉矶大厦顶楼
cues.pinyin: kai1 tan3 luo4 shan1 ji1 da4 sha4 ding3 lou2
cues.en: The scene cuts to the rooftop of a Los Angeles building.

cues.zh: 亨利三步并坐两步趴上铁架
cues.pinyin: heng1 li4 san1 bu4 bing4 zuo4 liang3 bu4 pa1 shang4 tie3 jia4
cues.en: Henry hurries, climbing onto the iron frame two steps at a time.

cues.zh: 要沿水下缺索逃生
cues.pinyin: yao4 yan2 shui3 xia4 que1 suo3 tao2 sheng1
cues.en: He's going to escape along an underwater cable.

cues.zh: 一分钟之内
cues.pinyin: yi4 fen1 zhong1 zhi1 nei4
cues.en: Within one minute,

cues.zh: 如果没逃出来
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 mei2 tao2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: if he fails to escape,

cues.zh: 头顶那箱湿人鱼
cues.pinyin: tou2 ding3 na4 xiang1 shi1 ren2 yu2
cues.en: the tank of piranhas above him

cues.zh: 头顶那箱食人鱼
cues.pinyin: tou2 ding3 na4 xiang1 shi2 ren2 yu2
cues.en: will make him their dinner.

cues.zh: 工作人员给亨利
cues.pinyin: gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 gei3 heng1 li4
cues.en: The staff put

cues.zh: 掏上手铐脚镣
cues.pinyin: tao1 shang4 shou3 kao4 jiao3 liao4
cues.en: handcuffs and shackles on Henry.

cues.zh: 然后小伙兴奋的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xiao3 huo3 xing1 fen4 de5
cues.en: Then, excitedly, the young assistant

cues.zh: 扯烂他的喇叭裤
cues.pinyin: che3 lan4 ta1 de5 la3 ba1 ku4
cues.en: rips his bell-bottom pants.

cues.zh: 底下观众瞬间
cues.pinyin: di3 xia4 guan1 zhong4 shun4 jian1
cues.en: The audience below instantly

cues.zh: 扎得过嗷嗷叫
cues.pinyin: zha1 de2 guo4 ao2 ao2 jiao4
cues.en: erupts, roaring with excitement.

cues.zh: 炸了锅嗷嗷叫
cues.pinyin: zha4 le5 guo1 ao2 ao2 jiao4
cues.en: Then with a splash,

cues.zh: 亨利在泥水里
cues.pinyin: heng1 li4 zai4 ni2 shui3 li3
cues.en: Henry drops into the murky water.

cues.zh: 还不到 10 秒他就睁开手上的镣铐
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu2 dao4 10 miao3 ta1 jiu4 zheng1 kai1 shou3 shang4 de5 liao4 kao4
cues.en: In under 10 seconds he's already broken free of the shackles on his wrists.

cues.zh: 往下一沉使劲拽铁链
cues.pinyin: wang3 xia4 yi1 chen2 shi3 jin4 zhuai1 tie3 lian4
cues.en: He sinks down and yanks hard on the chain,

cues.zh: 可链子卡住了
cues.pinyin: ke3 lian4 zi5 ka3 zhu4 le5
cues.en: but the chain is stuck.

cues.zh: 他急的敲玻璃求救
cues.pinyin: ta1 ji2 de5 qiao1 bo1 li2 qiu2 jiu4
cues.en: Panicking, he bangs on the glass for help.

cues.zh: 观众们抄起铁棍猛砸
cues.pinyin: guan1 zhong4 men5 chao1 qi3 tie3 gun4 meng3 za2
cues.en: The audience grabs iron rods and smashes at the tank,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 同时李特也收到了
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 li3 te4 ye3 shou1 dao4 le5
cues.en: and at the same time Merritt also receives...

cues.zh: 还有亨利洗完脸盯着鱼缸
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 heng1 li4 xi3 wan2 lian3 ding1 zhe5 yu2 gang1
cues.en: And afterward, Henry, having washed his face, stares at the fish tank —

cues.zh: 一张魔眼卡片正飘在水里
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhang1 mo2 yan3 ka3 pian4 zheng4 piao1 zai4 shui3 li3
cues.en: an Eye card is floating in the water.

cues.zh: 慢牛又大转
cues.pinyin: man4 niu2 you4 da4 zhuan3
cues.en: The scene cuts again.

cues.zh: 3 月 29 日
cues.pinyin: 3 yue4 29 ri4
cues.en: March 29th.

cues.zh: 四个人在纽约齐聚
cues.pinyin: si4 ge4 ren2 zai4 niu3 yue1 qi2 ju4
cues.en: The four of them gather in New York,

cues.zh: 钻进卡片上写的房间
cues.pinyin: zuan1 jin4 ka3 pian4 shang4 xie3 de5 fang2 jian1
cues.en: and sneak into the room written on the card.

cues.zh: 丹妮捡起地上的纸条
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 jian3 qi3 di4 shang4 de5 zhi3 tiao2
cues.en: Danny picks up a note off the floor.

cues.zh: 上面就一行字
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 jiu4 yi1 xing2 zi4
cues.en: On it is just one line:

cues.zh: 现在你什么都看不到
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ni3 shen2 me5 dou1 kan4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: "Now you see nothing."

cues.zh: 横利弯腰捡起地上的白玫瑰
cues.pinyin: heng2 li4 wan1 yao1 jian3 qi3 di4 shang4 de5 bai2 mei2 gui1
cues.en: Henry bends down and picks up a white rose off the floor,

cues.zh: 随手扔进旁边的花盆
cues.pinyin: sui2 shou3 reng1 jin4 pang2 bian1 de5 hua1 pen2
cues.en: then casually tosses it into the flowerpot nearby.

cues.zh: 盆里的水刷的漫出来
cues.pinyin: pen2 li3 de5 shui3 shua1 de5 man4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: The water in the pot suddenly overflows,

cues.zh: 顺着地面的凹槽流的到处都是
cues.pinyin: shun4 zhe5 di4 mian4 de5 ao1 cao2 liu2 de5 dao4 chu4 dou1 shi4
cues.en: flowing everywhere along the grooves in the floor.

cues.zh: 丹妮腾的冒起白雾
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 teng2 de5 mao4 qi3 bai2 wu4
cues.en: White mist suddenly billows up from Danny,

cues.zh: 转眼就把屋子地板覆盖打扮
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yan3 jiu4 ba3 wu1 zi5 di4 ban3 fu4 gai4 da3 ban4
cues.en: and in an instant covers the whole floor of the room.

cues.zh: 丹妮走到墙边打开灯
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 zou3 dao4 qiang2 bian1 da3 kai1 deng1
cues.en: Danny walks to the wall and switches on the light.

cues.zh: 米特抬手轻轻碰了碰灯泡
cues.pinyin: mi3 te4 tai2 shou3 qing1 qing1 peng4 le5 peng4 deng1 pao4
cues.en: Merritt reaches up and gently touches the light bulb.

cues.zh: 门上的摄像头突然闪起蓝光
cues.pinyin: men2 shang4 de5 she4 xiang4 tou2 tu1 ran2 shan3 qi3 lan2 guang1
cues.en: The camera on the door suddenly flashes blue,

cues.zh: 一道亮斑落在房间中央
cues.pinyin: yi1 dao4 liang4 ban1 luo4 zai4 fang2 jian1 zhong1 yang1
cues.en: and a spot of light lands in the center of the room —

cues.zh: 魔法设计图就这么显现出来
cues.pinyin: mo2 fa3 she4 ji4 tu2 jiu4 zhe4 me5 xian3 xian4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: a magic blueprint appears just like that.

cues.zh: 根据提示
cues.pinyin: gen1 ju4 ti2 shi4
cues.en: Following the clue,

cues.zh: 天解色解释正式成立
cues.pinyin: tian1 jie3 se4 jie3 shi4 zheng4 shi4 cheng2 li4
cues.en: the Four Horsemen are officially formed.

cues.zh: 时间来到一年之后
cues.pinyin: shi2 jian1 lai2 dao4 yi1 nian2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Time jumps forward a year.

cues.zh: 四骑士将要举行一场魔术盛宴
cues.pinyin: si4 qi2 shi4 jiang1 yao4 ju3 xing2 yi1 chang2 mo2 shu4 sheng4 yan4
cues.en: The Four Horsemen are about to put on a magic extravaganza,

cues.zh: 并且在舞台上宣布
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 zai4 wu3 tai2 shang4 xuan1 bu4
cues.en: and announce on stage

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 今晚上的节目是要抢银行
cues.pinyin: jin1 wan3 shang4 de5 jie2 mu4 shi4 yao4 qiang3 yin2 hang2
cues.en: that tonight's show is to rob a bank —

cues.zh: 而且是随机选一名观众
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 shi4 sui2 ji1 xuan3 yi1 ming2 guan1 zhong4
cues.en: and that they'll randomly pick an audience member

cues.zh: 说出要抢的银行
cues.pinyin: shuo1 chu1 yao4 qiang3 de5 yin2 hang2
cues.en: to name the bank to be robbed.

cues.zh: 这话一出口
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hua4 yi1 chu1 kou3
cues.en: The moment these words leave their mouths,

cues.zh: 全场更炸的锅死他
cues.pinyin: quan2 chang3 geng4 zha4 de5 guo1 si3 ta1
cues.en: the whole venue erupts.

cues.zh: 胳膊举的比旗杆还高
cues.pinyin: ge1 bo2 ju3 de5 bi3 qi2 gan1 hai2 gao1
cues.en: Arms shoot up higher than flagpoles,

cues.zh: 都盼着被选中
cues.pinyin: dou1 pan4 zhe5 bei4 xuan3 zhong1
cues.en: everyone hoping to be chosen.

cues.zh: 很快四骑士搬来装满乒乓球的玻璃碗
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 si4 qi2 shi4 ban1 lai2 zhuang1 man3 ping1 pang1 qiu2 de5 bo1 li2 wan3
cues.en: Soon the Four Horsemen bring out a glass bowl full of ping-pong balls

cues.zh: 让三个观众各抽一个
cues.pinyin: rang4 san1 ge4 guan1 zhong4 ge4 chou1 yi2 ge4
cues.en: and have three audience members each draw one,

cues.zh: 爆出上面的座位号
cues.pinyin: bao4 chu1 shang4 mian4 de5 zuo4 wei4 hao4
cues.en: revealing the seat number written on it.

cues.zh: 而此时观众席上的布莱德
cues.pinyin: er2 ci3 shi2 guan1 zhong4 xi2 shang4 de5 bu4 lai2 de2
cues.en: Meanwhile, Bradley in the audience

cues.zh: 正在偷偷录下
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zai4 tou1 tou1 lu4 xia4
cues.en: is secretly filming it all.

cues.zh: 坦快几人已经分别抽完
cues.pinyin: tan3 kuai4 ji3 ren2 yi3 jing1 fen1 bie2 chou1 wan2
cues.en: Soon the people have each finished drawing,

cues.zh: B G 5 拍 13 号
cues.pinyin: B G 5 pai1 13 hao4
cues.en: seat BG5, row 13.

cues.zh: 丹尼迂速飞快
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 yu1 su4 fei1 kuai4
cues.en: Danny moves fast,

cues.zh: 聚光灯刷的大过去
cues.pinyin: ju4 guang1 deng1 shua1 de5 da4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and the spotlight sweeps across the room,

cues.zh: 锁定了一个中年男人
cues.pinyin: suo3 ding4 le5 yi2 ge4 zhong1 nian2 nan2 ren2
cues.en: locking onto a middle-aged man.

cues.zh: 丹尼提醒他报下他和银行的名字
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni2 ti2 xing3 ta1 bao4 xia4 ta1 he2 yin2 hang2 de5 ming2 zi4
cues.en: Danny asks him to state his name and the name of his bank.

cues.zh: 男人叫希尔
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 jiao4 xi1 er3
cues.en: The man's name is Hill.

cues.zh: 最常去的是巴黎共和信贷银行
cues.pinyin: zui4 chang2 qu4 de5 shi4 ba1 li2 gong4 he2 xin4 dai4 yin2 hang2
cues.en: The bank he frequents most is the Paris Republic Credit Bank.

cues.zh: 男人站起来一脸蒙
cues.pinyin: nan2 ren2 zhan4 qi3 lai2 yi1 lian3 meng2
cues.en: The man stands up, looking utterly confused.

cues.zh: 亨利抬手示意希尔先生来台上
cues.pinyin: heng1 li4 tai2 shou3 shi4 yi4 xi1 er3 xian1 sheng1 lai2 tai2 shang4
cues.en: Henry gestures for Mr. Hill to come up on stage.

cues.zh: 希尔刚走到台中央
cues.pinyin: xi1 er3 gang1 zou3 dao4 tai2 zhong1 yang1
cues.en: The moment Hill reaches center stage,

cues.zh: 李特就攥住他的手
cues.pinyin: li3 te4 jiu4 zuan4 zhu4 ta1 de5 shou3
cues.en: Merritt grabs his hand,

cues.zh: 往胸口猛敲了两下
cues.pinyin: wang3 xiong1 kou3 meng3 qiao1 le5 liang3 xia4
cues.en: pounds it against his own chest twice,

cues.zh: 跟着打了个响指
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhe5 da3 le5 ge4 xiang3 zhi3
cues.en: then snaps his fingers.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 好莱坞倾情打造最会玩魔术的犯罪片，堪称 “烧脑爽片” 典范！

cues.zh: 丹妮又让她掏出欠了名的牌
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 you4 rang4 ta1 tao1 chu1 qian4 le5 ming2 de5 pai2
cues.en: Danny then has him pull out the signed card,

cues.zh: 再加上千万的票根一起放在钱队正中间
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 qian1 wan4 de5 piao4 gen1 yi4 qi3 fang4 zai4 qian2 dui4 zheng4 zhong1 jian1
cues.en: and place it together with the signed ticket stub right in the middle of the pile of cash.

cues.zh: 丹妮在台上喊希尔手忙脚乱照做
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 zai4 tai2 shang4 han3 xi1 er3 shou3 mang2 jiao3 luan4 zhao4 zuo4
cues.en: Danny shouts instructions on stage, and Hill fumblingly complies.

cues.zh: 丹妮又说
cues.pinyin: dan1 ni1 you4 shuo1
cues.en: Danny then says,

cues.zh: 头盔上有按钮
cues.pinyin: tou2 kui1 shang4 you3 an4 niu3
cues.en: "There's a button on the helmet.

cues.zh: 按一下通风管道能通到拉斯维加斯
cues.pinyin: an4 yi1 xia4 tong1 feng1 guan3 dao4 neng2 tong1 dao4 la1 si1 wei2 jia1 si1
cues.en: Press it once and the ventilation duct will connect straight to Las Vegas."

cues.zh: 谢尔刚按下按钮
cues.pinyin: xie4 er3 gang1 an4 xia4 an4 niu3
cues.en: The moment Hill presses the button,

cues.zh: 那 300 万欧元直接被吸了过去
cues.pinyin: na4 300 wan4 ou1 yuan2 zhi2 jie1 bei4 xi1 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: the 3 million euros are instantly sucked away.

cues.zh: 他在保险库里激动的嗷嗷叫
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 bao3 xian3 ku4 li3 ji1 dong4 de5 ao2 ao2 jiao4
cues.en: He shouts with excitement inside the vault.

cues.zh: 巴黎银行的人工刚打开保险库门
cues.pinyin: ba1 li2 yin2 hang2 de5 ren2 gong1 gang1 da3 kai1 bao3 xian3 ku4 men2
cues.en: The moment a staff member at the Paris bank opens the vault door,

cues.zh: 巴黎银行的员工刚打开保险库门
cues.pinyin: ba1 li2 yin2 hang2 de5 yuan2 gong1 gang1 da3 kai1 bao3 xian3 ku4 men2
cues.en: all that's left inside is a single card and that ticket stub.

cues.zh: 而拉斯维加斯的会场上空
cues.pinyin: er2 la1 si1 wei2 jia1 si1 de5 hui4 chang3 shang4 kong1
cues.en: And meanwhile, high above the venue in Las Vegas,

cues.zh: 300 万欧元跟鹅毛大雪式的飘下来
cues.pinyin: 300 wan4 ou1 yuan2 gen1 e2 mao2 da4 xue3 shi4 de5 piao1 xia4 lai2
cues.en: the 3 million euros drift down like giant snowflakes.

cues.zh: 观众疯得似的往怀里捡
cues.pinyin: guan1 zhong4 feng1 de2 shi4 de5 wang3 huai2 li3 jian3
cues.en: The audience scrambles like mad to scoop it into their arms.

cues.zh: 角落里的布莱德看完全场
cues.pinyin: jiao3 luo4 li3 de5 bu4 lai2 de2 kan4 wan2 quan2 chang3
cues.en: Bradley, watching from the corner, having seen the whole thing,

cues.zh: 半天说不出话
cues.pinyin: ban4 tian1 shuo1 bu4 chu1 hua4
cues.en: is speechless for a long while.

cues.zh: 四骑士的投资人亚瑟定日这幕
cues.pinyin: si4 qi2 shi4 de5 tou2 zi1 ren2 ya4 se4 ding4 ri4 zhe4 mu4
cues.en: Arthur, the Four Horsemen's investor, stares at this scene,

cues.zh: 围头皱成个疙瘩
cues.pinyin: wei2 tou2 zhou4 cheng2 ge4 ge1 da5
cues.en: his brow furrowing into a knot.

cues.zh: 四人快步上前
cues.pinyin: si4 ren2 kuai4 bu4 shang4 qian2
cues.en: The four of them step forward briskly

cues.zh: 拘了一宫
cues.pinyin: ju1 le5 yi1 gong1
cues.en: and take a bow,

cues.zh: 鞠了一躬
cues.pinyin: ju1 le5 yi1 gong1
cues.en: then take their curtain call and exit the stage.

cues.zh: 很快罗兹接到报警
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 luo2 zi1 jie1 dao4 bao4 jing3
cues.en: Soon after, Rhodes receives the police report.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會

cues.zh: 现在这个步骤就蛮好玩的
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 bu4 zhou4 jiu4 man2 hao3 wan2 de5
cues.en: Now this step is quite fun.

cues.zh: 有点像是丢球一样
cues.pinyin: you3 dian3 xiang4 shi4 diu1 qiu2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: It's a bit like throwing a ball.

cues.zh: 我们把这个虾呢用成一个圆圆的形状
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 xia1 ne5 yong4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 yuan2 yuan2 de5 xing2 zhuang4
cues.en: We shape the shrimp into a round shape.

cues.zh: 然后就是这样子的丢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 diu1
cues.en: And then we throw it like this.

cues.zh: 然后丢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 diu1
cues.en: Then throw it.

cues.zh: 那这样子做的好处呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 de5 hao3 chu4 ne5
cues.en: The benefit of doing it this way is

cues.zh: 就是我们的这个虾底下会有
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 de5 zhe4 ge5 xia1 di3 xia4 hui4 you3
cues.en: that the bottom of our shrimp will have

cues.zh: 很有弹性的口感
cues.pinyin: hen3 you3 tan2 xing4 de5 kou3 gan3
cues.en: a very springy texture.

cues.zh: 然后很好吃
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hen3 hao3 chi1
cues.en: And it's very delicious.

cues.zh: 我们在我们的虾里面呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 wo3 men5 de5 xia1 li3 mian4 ne5
cues.en: Into our shrimp mixture,

cues.zh: 加入半茶匙的盐
cues.pinyin: jia1 ru4 ban4 cha2 chi2 de5 yan2
cues.en: we add half a teaspoon of salt,

cues.zh: 半茶匙白胡椒
cues.pinyin: ban4 cha2 chi2 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: half a teaspoon of white pepper,

cues.zh: 少许糖
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 tang2
cues.en: a little sugar,

cues.zh: 一汤匙芝麻油
cues.pinyin: yi1 tang1 chi2 zhi1 ma2 you2
cues.en: one tablespoon of sesame oil,

cues.zh: 一茶匙玉米粉
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha2 chi2 yu4 mi3 fen3
cues.en: one teaspoon of cornstarch,

cues.zh: 一个蛋白
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 dan4 bai2
cues.en: one egg white,

cues.zh: 一茶匙姜末
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha2 chi2 jiang1 mo4
cues.en: one teaspoon of minced ginger,

cues.zh: 两汤匙香菜梗
cues.pinyin: liang3 tang1 chi2 xiang1 cai4 geng3
cues.en: two tablespoons of cilantro stems,

cues.zh: 两汤匙胡萝卜
cues.pinyin: liang3 tang1 chi2 hu2 luo2 bo5
cues.en: two tablespoons of carrot.

cues.zh: 然后搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: Then mix it evenly.

cues.zh: 现在我们需要把这个蛋黄涂在吐司的两边
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 dan4 huang2 tu2 zai4 tu3 si1 de5 liang3 bian1
cues.en: Now we need to brush the egg yolk on both sides of the toast,

cues.zh: 然后放上这个面包屑
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 fang4 shang4 zhe4 ge5 mian4 bao1 xie4
cues.en: then add the breadcrumbs.

cues.zh: 现在我们在一个热的锅子里面放进来
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 zai4 yi2 ge4 re4 de5 guo1 zi5 li3 mian4 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: Now we pour into a hot pan

cues.zh: 大概一英寸高的油
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 yi1 ying1 cun4 gao1 de5 you2
cues.en: about an inch of oil,

cues.zh: 然后给它烧热
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 shao1 re4
cues.en: and heat it up.

cues.zh: 那我们怎么知道这个油好了没有呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 you2 hao3 le5 mei2 you3 ne5
cues.en: So how do we know when the oil is ready?

cues.zh: 我们可以放进来一双筷子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 shuang1 kuai4 zi5
cues.en: We can put in a pair of chopsticks,

cues.zh: 那如果这筷子旁边啊
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 zhe4 kuai4 zi5 pang2 bian1 a5
cues.en: and if around these chopsticks

cues.zh: 具有这个一小粒一小粒的这个泡泡
cues.pinyin: ju4 you3 zhe4 ge5 yi1 xiao3 li4 yi1 xiao3 li4 de5 zhe4 ge5 pao4 pao4
cues.en: there are tiny little bubbles forming,

cues.zh: 你就知道说这个油已经好了
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 zhi1 dao4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 you2 yi3 jing1 hao3 le5
cues.en: then you know the oil is ready.

cues.zh: 拿出来的时候呢
cues.pinyin: na2 chu1 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 ne5
cues.en: When taking it out,

cues.zh: 我们可以把它放到这个纸上
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 fang4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 zhi3 shang4
cues.en: we can place it on this paper

cues.zh: 把这个油吸干

cues.en: to soak up the oil.

cues.zh: 前两天呢我的朋友 N ina
cues.pinyin: qian2 liang3 tian1 ne5 wo3 de5 peng2 you3 N ina
cues.en: A couple of days ago, my friend Nina

cues.zh: 问我说会不会做虾多士
cues.pinyin: wen4 wo3 shuo1 hui4 bu2 hui4 zuo4 xia1 duo1 shi4
cues.en: asked me if I could make shrimp toast.

cues.zh: 那我就做了我的版本给她吃
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 zuo4 le5 wo3 de5 ban3 ben3 gei3 ta1 chi1
cues.en: So I made my version for her to try.

cues.zh: 她吃了之后呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 chi1 le5 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After she ate it,

cues.zh: 觉得是最赞的
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 shi4 zui4 zan4 de5
cues.en: she thought it was the best.

cues.zh: 那所以今天呢也跟大家分享了这个食谱
cues.pinyin: na4 suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 ne5 ye3 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 le5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 pu3
cues.en: So today I'm also sharing this recipe with everyone.

cues.zh: 希望你会喜欢
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ni3 hui4 xi3 huan1
cues.en: I hope you'll like it.

cues.zh: 那也别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: na4 ye3 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: And don't forget to subscribe and like.

cues.zh: 我们下集见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ji2 jian4 ge1
cues.en: See you next episode.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一个时代的精气神

cues.zh: 只用了 20 年我就参与设计了近
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yong4 le5 20 nian2 wo3 jiu4 can1 yu4 she4 ji4 le5 jin4
cues.en: In just 20 years, I've taken part in designing nearly

cues.zh: 千个建筑项目
cues.pinyin: qian1 ge4 jian4 zhu4 xiang4 mu4
cues.en: a thousand architectural projects.

cues.zh: 这样的工作量是很多人都无法想象的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 gong1 zuo4 liang4 shi4 hen3 duo1 ren2 dou1 wu2 fa3 xiang3 xiang4 de5
cues.en: A workload like that is beyond what most people can imagine.

cues.zh: 巨大工作量的背后是我们不再盲目崇拜
cues.pinyin: ju4 da4 gong1 zuo4 liang4 de5 bei4 hou4 shi4 wo3 men5 bu4 zai4 mang2 mu4 chong2 bai4
cues.en: Behind that enormous workload is the fact that we no longer blindly worship

cues.zh: 西方建筑美学
cues.pinyin: xi1 fang1 jian4 zhu4 mei3 xue2
cues.en: Western architectural aesthetics,

cues.zh: 而是逐渐觉醒将中国设计的哲
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zhu2 jian4 jue2 xing3 jiang1 zhong1 guo2 she4 ji4 de5 zhe2
cues.en: but have gradually awakened to weave Chinese design philosophy

cues.zh: 学思想融入到
cues.pinyin: xue2 si1 xiang3 rong2 ru4 dao4
cues.en: and thought into

cues.zh: 当代设计之中
cues.pinyin: dang1 dai4 she4 ji4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: contemporary design.

cues.zh: 在不断的崛起中展现中国人独有的精气神
cues.pinyin: zai4 bu4 duan4 de5 jue2 qi3 zhong1 zhan3 xian4 zhong1 guo2 ren2 du2 you3 de5 jing1 qi4 shen2
cues.en: Through constant rising, we show the unique spirit of the Chinese people.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一个时代的精气神

cues.zh: 小时候生活在一汽厂附近
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shi2 hou4 sheng1 huo2 zai4 yi1 qi4 chang3 fu4 jin4
cues.en: As a child I lived near the FAW factory,

cues.zh: 常常看见大红旗从家门口经过
cues.pinyin: chang2 chang2 kan4 jian4 da4 hong2 qi2 cong2 jia1 men2 kou3 jing1 guo4
cues.en: and often saw big Red Flag cars pass by my front door.

cues.zh: 印象最深的就是那一抹鲜艳的红色
cues.pinyin: yin4 xiang4 zui4 shen1 de5 jiu4 shi4 na4 yi1 mo3 xian1 yan4 de5 hong2 se4
cues.en: What left the deepest impression was that vivid shade of red.

cues.zh: 车身庄重而典雅
cues.pinyin: che1 shen1 zhuang1 zhong4 er2 dian3 ya3
cues.en: The car's body was dignified and elegant,

cues.zh: 仿佛是时代的符号
cues.pinyin: fang3 fu2 shi4 shi2 dai4 de5 fu2 hao4
cues.en: as if it were a symbol of the era,

cues.zh: 也是红旗的精神符号
cues.pinyin: ye3 shi4 hong2 qi2 de5 jing1 shen2 fu2 hao4
cues.en: and also the spiritual symbol of Hongqi (Red Flag).

cues.zh: 红旗红是中国红
cues.pinyin: hong2 qi2 hong2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 hong2
cues.en: Red Flag's red is China red —

cues.zh: 它是红旗的精髓所在
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 hong2 qi2 de5 jing1 sui3 suo3 zai4
cues.en: that is the essence of Red Flag.

cues.zh: 承载着时代的技艺和荣耀
cues.pinyin: cheng2 zai4 zhe5 shi2 dai4 de5 ji4 yi4 he2 rong2 yao4
cues.en: It carries the craftsmanship and glory of its era,

cues.zh: 不仅是对东方美学的致敬
cues.pinyin: bu4 jin3 shi4 dui4 dong1 fang1 mei3 xue2 de5 zhi4 jing4
cues.en: paying tribute not only to Eastern aesthetics,

cues.zh: 更是一种时代精神的传承
cues.pinyin: geng4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 shi2 dai4 jing1 shen2 de5 chuan2 cheng2
cues.en: but also passing on the spirit of the times.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一个时代的精气神

cues.zh: 中华文化之所以渊源流长
cues.pinyin: zhong1 hua2 wen2 hua4 zhi1 suo3 yi3 yuan1 yuan2 liu2 zhang3
cues.en: The reason Chinese culture runs so deep and far

cues.zh: 我觉得很重要的一点是包容
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 hen3 zhong4 yao4 de5 yi4 dian3 shi4 bao1 rong2
cues.en: I think one very important point is inclusiveness.

cues.zh: 所谓带万物以和
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 dai4 wan4 wu4 yi3 he2
cues.en: As the saying goes, embrace all things in harmony.

cues.zh: 在我设计的木兰围场项目中
cues.pinyin: zai4 wo3 she4 ji4 de5 mu4 lan2 wei2 chang3 xiang4 mu4 zhong1
cues.en: In the Mulan Hunting Ground project I designed,

cues.zh: 结合传统蒙古包的特点
cues.pinyin: jie2 he2 chuan2 tong3 meng3 gu3 bao1 de5 te4 dian3
cues.en: we combined the features of traditional Mongolian yurts,

cues.zh: 从平面立面到装饰纹样
cues.pinyin: cong2 ping2 mian4 li4 mian4 dao4 zhuang1 shi4 wen2 yang4
cues.en: and from the floor plan and façade to the decorative patterns,

cues.zh: 都将传统文化融进了现代设计之中
cues.pinyin: dou1 jiang1 chuan2 tong3 wen2 hua4 rong2 jin4 le5 xian4 dai4 she4 ji4 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: traditional culture was woven into modern design throughout.

cues.zh: 设计可以跨越时间的尺度
cues.pinyin: she4 ji4 ke3 yi3 kua4 yue4 shi2 jian1 de5 chi3 du4
cues.en: Design can span the scale of time

cues.zh: 实现古今交融
cues.pinyin: shi2 xian4 gu3 jin1 jiao1 rong2
cues.en: and achieve a fusion of past and present,

cues.zh: 呈现出更为丰富深远的美学
cues.pinyin: cheng2 xian4 chu1 geng4 wei2 feng1 fu4 shen1 yuan3 de5 mei3 xue2
cues.en: presenting a richer, more far-reaching aesthetic.

cues.zh: 红旗在内饰中融入了中式飞鹤羽翼纹
cues.pinyin: hong2 qi2 zai4 nei4 shi4 zhong1 rong2 ru4 le5 zhong1 shi4 fei1 he4 yu3 yi4 wen2
cues.en: Hongqi wove Chinese-style flying crane wing patterns

cues.zh: 样和山水纹理
cues.pinyin: yang4 he2 shan1 shui3 wen2 li3
cues.en: and landscape textures into the interior.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一个时代的精气神

cues.zh: 作为建筑师
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 jian4 zhu4 shi1
cues.en: As an architect,

cues.zh: 我从未停止关于技术社会人的思考和探索
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 wei4 ting2 zhi3 guan1 yu2 ji4 shu4 she4 hui4 ren2 de5 si1 kao3 he2 tan4 suo3
cues.en: I've never stopped thinking about and exploring technology, society, and people.

cues.zh: 一直希望所有人都可以有尊严地
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 xi1 wang4 suo3 you3 ren2 dou1 ke3 yi3 you3 zun1 yan2 di4
cues.en: I've always hoped everyone can live with dignity

cues.zh: 生活在城市里
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 zai4 cheng2 shi4 li3
cues.en: in the city.

cues.zh: 让设计真正可以做到改变使用
cues.pinyin: rang4 she4 ji4 zhen1 zheng4 ke3 yi3 zuo4 dao4 gai3 bian4 shi3 yong4
cues.en: Let design truly be able to change the user's

cues.zh: 者的生活状态
cues.pinyin: zhe3 de5 sheng1 huo2 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: living conditions.

cues.zh: 车作为人的第二个家
cues.pinyin: che1 zuo4 wei2 ren2 de5 di4 er4 ge4 jia1
cues.en: The car, as a person's second home,

cues.zh: 是一个可以回归本心的舒适空间
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 hui2 gui1 ben3 xin1 de5 shu1 shi4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: is a comfortable space to return to one's true self.

cues.zh: 我们应该以人为先
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ying1 gai1 yi3 ren2 wei2 xian1
cues.en: We should put people first

cues.zh: 再将功能设计化
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiang1 gong1 neng2 she4 ji4 hua4
cues.en: and then design the functions around them.

cues.zh: 通过生态的设计
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 sheng1 tai4 de5 she4 ji4
cues.en: Through ecological design,

cues.zh: 冰冷的科技也可以传递温暖和人性关怀
cues.pinyin: bing1 leng3 de5 ke1 ji4 ye3 ke3 yi3 chuan2 di4 wen1 nuan3 huo5 ren2 xing4 guan1 huai2
cues.en: even cold technology can convey warmth and human care.

cues.zh: 红旗的每一步都在见证时代
cues.pinyin: hong2 qi2 de5 mei3 yi1 bu4 dou1 zai4 jian4 zheng4 shi2 dai4
cues.en: Every step Red Flag takes bears witness to the era,

cues.zh: 在钢筋铁骨的工业作品上
cues.pinyin: zai4 gang1 jin1 tie3 gu3 de5 gong1 ye4 zuo4 pin3 shang4
cues.en: and on industrial works forged of steel,

cues.zh: 重新解读并传承那些古老而辉煌
cues.pinyin: chong2 xin1 jie3 du2 bing4 chuan2 cheng2 na4 xie1 gu3 lao3 er2 hui1 huang2
cues.en: it reinterprets and carries forward that ancient and glorious legacy.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事1｜过新年笑话｜钱之呼吸法｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 嗨我是大大我是小小
cues.pinyin: hai1 wo3 shi4 da4 da4 wo3 shi4 xiao3 xiao3
cues.en: Hi, I'm Dada, I'm Xiaoxiao.

cues.zh: 快过新年了在这里先跟大家拜个早年
cues.pinyin: kuai4 guo4 xin1 nian2 le5 zai4 zhe4 li3 xian1 gen1 da4 jia1 bai4 ge4 zao3 nian2
cues.en: Chinese New Year is coming soon, so let's wish everyone an early New Year greeting here.

cues.zh: 祝大家新的一年心想事成裁员滚滚来
cues.pinyin: zhu4 da4 jia1 xin1 de5 yi1 nian2 xin1 xiang3 shi4 cheng2 cai2 yuan2 gun3 gun3 lai2
cues.en: I wish everyone a year where everything goes as you wish, and may the layoffs keep rolling in.

cues.zh: 今天我们要聊什么呢
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 yao4 liao2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What are we going to talk about today?

cues.zh: 快要过年了我们就来聊过年最常听见的话
cues.pinyin: kuai4 yao4 guo4 nian2 le5 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 liao2 guo4 nian2 zui4 chang2 ting1 jian4 de5 hua4
cues.en: Since New Year is coming soon, let's talk about the things people say most often during New Year.

cues.zh: 你来啦期末考考的怎么样啊有没有被当啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 lai2 la5 qi1 mo4 kao3 kao3 de5 zen3 me5 yang4 a5 you3 mei2 you3 bei4 dang1 a5
cues.en: "You're here! How did your final exams go? Did you fail any courses?"

cues.zh: 过了几年
cues.pinyin: guo4 le5 ji3 nian2
cues.en: A few years passed.

cues.zh: 我一定要把这些话
cues.pinyin: wo3 yi2 ding4 yao4 ba3 zhe4 xie1 hua4
cues.en: I must take these words

cues.zh: 拿去问他的小孩
cues.pinyin: na2 qu4 wen4 ta1 de5 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: and go ask his kids.

cues.zh: 我要把这个痛苦
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 tong4 ku3
cues.en: I want to pass this pain

cues.zh: 一代一代的传下去
cues.pinyin: yi2 dai4 yi2 dai4 de5 chuan2 xia4 qu4
cues.en: down from generation to generation.

cues.zh: 哦阿姨
cues.pinyin: o2 a1 yi2
cues.en: "Oh, auntie!"

cues.zh: 我都毕业好几年了
cues.pinyin: wo3 dou1 bi4 ye4 hao3 ji3 nian2 le5
cues.en: "I graduated several years ago already."

cues.zh: 你人来就好了
cues.pinyin: ni3 ren2 lai2 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: "It would've been fine if you just came yourself."

cues.zh: 干嘛还带这么多礼物啊
cues.pinyin: gan4 ma2 hai2 dai4 zhe4 me5 duo1 li3 wu4 a5
cues.en: "Why bring so many gifts?"

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事1｜过新年笑话｜钱之呼吸法｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 你应该想说
cues.pinyin: ni3 ying1 gai1 xiang3 shuo1
cues.en: "You should be thinking,"

cues.zh: 你礼物来就好了
cues.pinyin: ni3 li3 wu4 lai2 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: "'It would've been fine if you just brought a gift.'"

cues.zh: 干嘛还带这么多人吧
cues.pinyin: gan4 ma2 hai2 dai4 zhe4 me5 duo1 ren2 ba5
cues.en: "Why bring so many people too?"

cues.zh: 没什么啦
cues.pinyin: mei2 shen2 me5 la5
cues.en: "It's nothing much."

cues.zh: 只是一些饼干礼盒
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yi1 xie1 bing3 gan1 li3 he2
cues.en: "Just some boxes of cookies."

cues.zh: 待会可以大家一起吃啊
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui4 ke3 yi3 da4 jia1 yi4 qi3 chi1 a5
cues.en: "We can all eat them together later."

cues.zh: 啊有找到对象了吗
cues.pinyin: a5 you3 zhao3 dao4 dui4 xiang4 le5 ma5
cues.en: "Oh, have you found a partner yet?"

cues.zh: 哪天带来给阿姨看看啊
cues.pinyin: na3 tian1 dai4 lai2 gei3 a1 yi2 kan4 kan4 a5
cues.en: "Bring them by for auntie to see sometime."

cues.zh: 你以为我不想吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 yi3 wei2 wo3 bu4 xiang3 ma5
cues.en: "Do you think I don't want to?"

cues.zh: 你叫我去哪追啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiao4 wo3 qu4 na3 zhui1 a5
cues.en: "Tell me where to go chase one!"

cues.zh: 我就去追啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 qu4 zhui1 a5
cues.en: "Then I'll go chase one!"

cues.zh: 哦还不急啦
cues.pinyin: o2 hai2 bu4 ji2 la5
cues.en: "Oh, no rush."

cues.zh: 啊工作薪水怎么样啊
cues.pinyin: a5 gong1 zuo4 xin1 shui3 zen3 me5 yang4 a5
cues.en: "So how's work, how's the salary?"

cues.zh: 什么时候买房啊
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 mai3 fang2 a5
cues.en: "When are you buying a house?"

cues.zh: 那是我的隐私
cues.pinyin: na4 shi4 wo3 de5 yin3 si1
cues.en: "That's my own business."

cues.zh: 关你什么事啊
cues.pinyin: guan1 ni3 shen2 me5 shi4 a5
cues.en: "What's it to you?"

cues.zh: 那你存款有多少啊
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 cun2 kuan3 you3 duo1 shao3 a5
cues.en: "So how much savings do you have?"

cues.zh: 提款卡密码多少啊
cues.pinyin: ti2 kuan3 ka3 mi4 ma3 duo1 shao3 a5
cues.en: "What's your ATM PIN?"

cues.zh: 你怎么不告诉我啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 bu4 gao4 su4 wo3 a5
cues.en: "Why haven't you told me?"

cues.zh: 啊工作还可以啦
cues.pinyin: a5 gong1 zuo4 hai2 ke3 yi3 la5
cues.en: "Work's okay, I guess."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事1｜过新年笑话｜钱之呼吸法｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 等存一阵子再买房
cues.pinyin: deng3 cun2 yi1 zhen4 zi5 zai4 mai3 fang2
cues.en: "I'll save up for a while before buying a house."

cues.zh: 叔叔我已经在工作了
cues.pinyin: shu1 shu1 wo3 yi3 jing1 zai4 gong1 zuo4 le5
cues.en: "Uncle, I'm already working."

cues.zh: 不用再给我压岁钱了
cues.pinyin: bu4 yong4 zai4 gei3 wo3 ya1 sui4 qian2 le5
cues.en: "You don't need to give me New Year money anymore."

cues.zh: 给小孩的叫压岁钱
cues.pinyin: gei3 xiao3 hai2 de5 jiao4 ya1 sui4 qian2
cues.en: "Money given to kids is called 'lucky money.'"

cues.zh: 你的叫单身狗被问津
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 jiao4 dan1 shen1 gou3 bei4 wen4 jin1
cues.en: "Yours is called the 'single tax.'"

cues.zh: 过新年给你讨个吉利啦
cues.pinyin: guo4 xin1 nian2 gei3 ni3 tao3 ge4 ji2 li4 la5
cues.en: "For New Year, I'm just wishing you good luck."

cues.zh: 没关系
cues.pinyin: mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: "It's fine."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事1｜过新年笑话｜钱之呼吸法｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 过年啊都吃海鲜
cues.pinyin: guo4 nian2 a5 dou1 chi1 hai3 xian1
cues.en: "During New Year, everyone eats seafood."

cues.zh: 大鱼大肉要小心得痛风哦
cues.pinyin: da4 yu2 da4 rou4 yao4 xiao3 xin1 de2 tong4 feng1 o2
cues.en: "With all that rich food, watch out for gout."

cues.zh: 以我们家的经济条件
cues.pinyin: yi3 wo3 men5 jia1 de5 jing1 ji4 tiao2 jian4
cues.en: "Given our family's financial situation,"

cues.zh: 要得痛风很难吧
cues.pinyin: yao4 de5 tong4 feng1 hen3 nan2 ba5
cues.en: "it'd be hard to even get gout."

cues.zh: 喔好啦我会少吃一点
cues.pinyin: o1 hao3 la5 wo3 hui4 shao3 chi1 yi4 dian3
cues.en: "Okay fine, I'll eat a little less."

cues.zh: 爸爸我刚刚收到好多红包喔
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 wo3 gang1 gang1 shou1 dao4 hao3 duo1 hong2 bao1 o1
cues.en: "Dad, I just got so many red envelopes!"

cues.zh: 绽放在你手上三分钟
cues.pinyin: zhan4 fang4 zai4 ni3 shou3 shang4 san1 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: "They'll stay in your hand for three minutes,"

cues.zh: 待会就会来到我手上了
cues.pinyin: dai4 hui4 jiu4 hui4 lai2 dao4 wo3 shou3 shang4 le5
cues.en: "then they'll come straight into my hand."

cues.zh: 我要使出我阿公传给我爸爸
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 shi3 chu1 wo3 a1 gong1 chuan2 gei3 wo3 ba4 ba4
cues.en: "I'm going to use the technique passed from my grandpa to my dad,"

cues.zh: 我爸爸在传给我的前肢呼吸法第十四
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba4 ba4 zai4 chuan2 gei3 wo3 de5 qian2 zhi1 hu1 xi1 fa3 di4 shi2 si4
cues.en: "and from my dad to me — the Money Breathing Technique, Form 14:"

cues.zh: 骗小孩吸金素
cues.pinyin: pian4 xiao3 hai2 xi1 jin1 su4
cues.en: "Tricking-Kids Money-Extraction Technique."

cues.zh: 红包爸爸先帮你保管著喔
cues.pinyin: hong2 bao1 ba4 ba4 xian1 bang1 ni3 bao3 guan3 zhu4 o1
cues.en: "Dad will hold onto your red envelope money for you for now,"

cues.zh: 等你长大的再全部给你
cues.pinyin: deng3 ni3 zhang3 da4 de5 zai4 quan2 bu4 gei3 ni3
cues.en: "and give it all back when you're grown up."

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 趣事1｜过新年笑话｜钱之呼吸法｜笑一笑~纾解你一天的疲惫

cues.zh: 过年对我来说
cues.pinyin: guo4 nian2 dui4 wo3 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: "To me, New Year"

cues.zh: 只是一个可以名正言顺
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yi2 ge4 ke3 yi3 ming2 zheng4 yan2 shun4
cues.en: "is just a day I get to"

cues.zh: 肆无忌惮吃东西的节日吧
cues.pinyin: si4 wu2 ji4 dan4 chi1 dong1 xi1 de5 jie2 ri4 ba5
cues.en: "eat without restraint, guilt-free."

cues.zh: 欢迎大家留言
cues.pinyin: huan1 ying2 da4 jia1 liu2 yan2
cues.en: Welcome everyone to leave a comment

cues.zh: 可以聊聊自己过年最常听见的话
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 liao2 liao2 zi4 ji3 guo4 nian2 zui4 chang2 ting1 jian4 de5 hua4
cues.en: and share the things you hear most often during New Year.

cues.zh: 对了提醒大家
cues.pinyin: dui4 le5 ti2 xing3 da4 jia1
cues.en: Oh right, a reminder for everyone:

cues.zh: 过年吃饭前
cues.pinyin: guo4 nian2 chi1 fan4 qian2
cues.en: before eating during New Year,

cues.zh: 晚辈先不要动筷子哦
cues.pinyin: wan3 bei4 xian1 bu2 yao4 dong4 kuai4 zi5 o2
cues.en: the younger generation shouldn't pick up their chopsticks first.

cues.zh: 要等长辈先拍完丰盛的大餐
cues.pinyin: yao4 deng3 zhang3 bei4 xian1 pai1 wan2 feng1 sheng4 de5 da4 can1
cues.en: Wait until the elders finish taking photos of the lavish meal

cues.zh: 才能动手夹菜哦
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 dong4 shou3 jia1 cai4 o2
cues.en: before you start picking up food.

cues.zh: 祝大家新年快乐
cues.pinyin: zhu4 da4 jia1 xin1 nian2 kuai4 le4
cues.en: Wishing everyone a happy New Year,

cues.zh: 发大财
cues.pinyin: fa1 da4 cai2
cues.en: and getting rich,

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: bye-bye.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 脆皮生姜牛肉 | 加拿大必吃 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 大家好我是 C issy
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 C issy
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm CiCi.

cues.zh: 那今天给你带来的是脆皮生姜牛肉
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 gei3 ni3 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 cui4 pi2 sheng1 jiang1 niu2 rou4
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you crispy ginger beef.

cues.zh: 这道菜可是 Can ada Cal gary 中餐厅里面必
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dao4 cai4 ke3 shi4 Can ada Cal gary zhong1 can1 ting1 li3 mian4 bi4
cues.en: This dish is a must-order in Chinese restaurants in Calgary, Canada—

cues.zh: 点的西式中餐
cues.pinyin: dian3 de5 xi1 shi4 zhong1 can1
cues.en: —Western-style Chinese food.

cues.zh: 那我可以保证我们今天的这个版本呢
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 ke3 yi3 bao3 zheng4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 zhe4 ge5 ban3 ben3 ne5
cues.en: I can guarantee that today's version

cues.zh: 绝对比任何外卖店的都好吃
cues.pinyin: jue2 dui4 bi3 ren4 he2 wai4 mai4 dian4 de5 dou1 hao3 chi1
cues.en: is definitely tastier than any takeout place's.

cues.zh: 首先这里我们有一杯玉米粉
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zhe4 li3 wo3 men5 you3 yi1 bei1 yu4 mi3 fen3
cues.en: First, here we have a cup of cornstarch.

cues.zh: 你也可以使用番薯粉
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 shi3 yong4 fan1 shu3 fen3
cues.en: You can also use sweet potato starch.

cues.zh: 生粉马铃薯粉都可以
cues.pinyin: sheng1 fen3 ma3 ling2 shu3 fen3 dou1 ke3 yi3
cues.en: Potato starch works too.

cues.zh: 这里还有一磅的牛肉
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 hai2 you3 yi1 bang4 de5 niu2 rou4
cues.en: Here we also have a pound of beef.

cues.zh: 我们已经把它切成了一条一条的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi3 jing1 ba3 ta1 qie4 cheng2 le5 yi1 tiao2 yi1 tiao2 de5
cues.en: We've already cut it into strips.

cues.zh: 我们把这个牛肉呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 niu2 rou4 ne5
cues.en: We take this beef

cues.zh: 放到玉米粉里
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 yu4 mi3 fen3 li3
cues.en: and put it into the cornstarch.

cues.zh: 然后给它搅拌到均匀为止
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 dao4 jun1 yun2 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: Then mix it until evenly coated.

cues.zh: 现在在一个大锅里
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 guo1 li3
cues.en: Now, in a large pot,

cues.zh: 我们倒进来大概是一英寸高的油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 dao4 jin4 lai2 da4 gai4 shi4 yi1 ying1 cun4 gao1 de5 you2
cues.en: we pour in about an inch of oil.

cues.zh: 然后给它烧热
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 shao1 re4
cues.en: Then heat it up.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 脆皮生姜牛肉 | 加拿大必吃 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 那如果你想要试验这个油好了没有的话
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 yao4 shi4 yan4 zhe4 ge5 you2 hao3 le5 mei2 you3 de5 hua4
cues.en: If you want to test whether the oil is ready,

cues.en: to determine whether they could be treated.

cues.zh: 蓝灯兼任翻译陪着丽姆
cues.pinyin: lan2 deng1 jian1 ren4 fan1 yi4 pei2 zhe5 li4 mu3
cues.en: Landon, also acting as translator, accompanied Lim.

cues.zh: 病人卷猫
cues.pinyin: bing4 ren2 juan3 mao1
cues.en: The patient's name was Juanmao.

cues.zh: 腹部的左侧有一个鸵鸟蛋大的肿块
cues.pinyin: fu4 bu4 de5 zuo3 ce4 you3 yi2 ge4 tuo2 niao3 dan4 da4 de5 zhong3 kuai4
cues.en: He had a mass the size of an ostrich egg on the left side of his abdomen.

cues.zh: 已经一年多了
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 yi1 nian2 duo1 le5
cues.en: It had already been more than a year.

cues.zh: 邻居曾经劝过他去大医院
cues.pinyin: lin2 ju1 ceng2 jing1 quan4 guo4 ta1 qu4 da4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: His neighbor had once urged him to go to a big hospital,

cues.zh: 但是他没什么钱
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 mei2 shen2 me5 qian2
cues.en: but he didn't have much money,

cues.zh: 而且需要上班挣钱养活弟弟妹妹
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 xu1 yao4 shang4 ban1 zheng4 qian2 yang3 huo2 di4 di5 mei4 mei4
cues.en: and needed to work to support his younger siblings.

cues.zh: 没有时间跑那么远
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 shi2 jian1 pao3 na4 me5 yuan3
cues.en: He had no time to travel that far,

cues.zh: 只能趁这次志愿者服务来检查一下
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 chen4 zhe4 ci4 zhi4 yuan4 zhe3 fu2 wu4 lai2 jian3 cha2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: so he could only take this volunteer visit as a chance to get checked.

cues.zh: 丽姆检查的工作报告告一段落后
cues.pinyin: li4 mu3 jian3 cha2 de5 gong1 zuo4 bao4 gao4 gao4 yi2 duan4 luo4 hou4
cues.en: After Lim's examination work reached a lull,

cues.zh: 就开始着手整理病人的资料
cues.pinyin: jiu4 kai1 shi3 zhuo2 shou3 zheng3 li3 bing4 ren2 de5 zi1 liao4
cues.en: she began organizing the patients' files,

cues.zh: 将其分成了三部分
cues.pinyin: jiang1 qi2 fen1 cheng2 le5 san1 bu4 fen4
cues.en: dividing them into three groups.

cues.zh: 不能治疗
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: [Cannot be treated]

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生在线发福利，四十个患者中可以免费治疗十三个人！但是怎么选择却成为了难题

cues.zh: 而且他们是一群创造奇迹的人
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 shi4 yi1 qun2 chuang4 zao4 qi2 ji4 de5 ren2
cues.en: and that they were a group of people who create miracles.

cues.zh: 整理好心情的布朗重新投入工作中
cues.pinyin: zheng3 li3 hao3 xin1 qing2 de5 bu4 lang3 chong2 xin1 tou2 ru4 gong1 zuo4 zhong1
cues.en: Having composed himself, Brown threw himself back into his work.

cues.zh: 这时黑哥和护士小美从布朗身边路过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hei1 ge1 he2 hu4 shi4 xiao3 mei3 cong2 bu4 lang3 shen1 bian1 lu4 guo4
cues.en: At this point Black Brother and nurse Xiaomei passed by Brown.

cues.zh: 他们要去看一个叫做小布的男孩
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yao4 qu4 kan4 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 xiao3 bu4 de5 nan2 hai2
cues.en: They were going to see a boy named Xiaobu.

cues.zh: 小布今年才 12 岁
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 jin1 nian2 cai2 12 sui4
cues.en: Xiaobu was only 12 years old.

cues.zh: 患有幼细胞瘤
cues.pinyin: huan4 you3 you4 xi4 bao1 liu2
cues.en: He suffered from a juvenile-cell tumor.

cues.zh: 他的整个幼脸颊都肿了起来
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zheng3 ge4 you4 lian3 jia2 dou1 zhong3 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: His entire cheek had swollen up.

cues.zh: 他还是一个球迷
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 qiu2 mi2
cues.en: He was also a sports fan.

cues.zh: 黑哥去的时候
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 qu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When Black Brother went to see him,

cues.zh: 他正在画自己喜欢的球员
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng4 zai4 hua4 zi4 ji3 xi3 huan1 de5 qiu2 yuan2
cues.en: Xiaobu was drawing his favorite player.

cues.zh: 小布的肿块使得眼眶必变薄
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 de5 zhong3 kuai4 shi3 de5 yan3 kuang4 bi4 bian4 bao2
cues.en: Xiaobu's mass had caused the wall of his eye socket to thin,

cues.zh: 还向上延伸到了颅底
cues.pinyin: hai2 xiang4 shang4 yan2 shen1 dao4 le5 lu2 di3
cues.en: and it also extended upward to the base of his skull.

cues.zh: 但具体的范围还不能确定
cues.pinyin: dan4 ju4 ti3 de5 fan4 wei2 hai2 bu4 neng2 que4 ding4
cues.en: But the exact extent still couldn't be determined.

cues.zh: 黑哥原本把他的资料
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 yuan2 ben3 ba3 ta1 de5 zi1 liao4
cues.en: Black Brother had originally put his file

cues.zh: 放在不能治疗的一类
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 bu4 neng2 zhi4 liao2 de5 yi1 lei4
cues.en: into the "cannot treat" category,

cues.zh: 但他有些不忍心
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 you3 xie1 bu4 ren3 xin1
cues.en: but he felt a bit reluctant,

cues.zh: 重新将资料翻出来
cues.pinyin: chong2 xin1 jiang1 zi1 liao4 fan1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: so he dug the file back out,

cues.zh: 想要和丽姆讨论一下
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 he2 li4 mu3 tao3 lun4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: wanting to discuss it with Lim.

cues.zh: 拉姆绝对这样不合适
cues.pinyin: la1 mu3 jue2 dui4 zhe4 yang4 bu4 he2 shi4
cues.en: Lim felt this wasn't appropriate.

cues.zh: 他这是把情绪和私人情感
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhe4 shi4 ba3 qing2 xu4 he2 si1 ren2 qing2 gan3
cues.en: She said he was bringing emotion and personal feelings

cues.zh: 带到了工作里
cues.pinyin: dai4 dao4 le5 gong1 zuo4 li3
cues.en: into the work,

cues.zh: 这会影响治疗的判断
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 ying3 xiang3 zhi4 liao2 de5 pan4 duan4
cues.en: which would affect the judgment on treatment.

cues.zh: 但黑哥根本就不鸟他
cues.pinyin: dan4 hei1 ge1 gen1 ben3 jiu4 bu4 niao3 ta1
cues.en: But Black Brother didn't care what she thought.

cues.zh: 他告诉利木
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 li4 mu4
cues.en: He told Lim

cues.zh: 小布的组织内部没有被侵蚀
cues.pinyin: xiao3 bu4 de5 zu3 zhi1 nei4 bu4 mei2 you3 bei4 qin1 shi2
cues.en: that the tissue inside Xiaobu hadn't been eroded.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生在线发福利，四十个患者中可以免费治疗十三个人！但是怎么选择却成为了难题

cues.zh: 爸爸回到男孩身边
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 hui2 dao4 nan2 hai2 shen1 bian1
cues.en: The father went back to the boy's side

cues.zh: 告诉他一切都会好起来的
cues.pinyin: gao4 su4 ta1 yi1 qie4 du1 hui4 hao3 qi3 lai2 de5
cues.en: and told him everything would be fine.

cues.zh: 最终两人离开了医院
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 liang3 ren2 li2 kai1 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: In the end, the two of them left the hospital.

cues.zh: 第二天的筛选还在继续
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 de5 shai1 xuan3 hai2 zai4 ji4 xu4
cues.en: The next day, the screening continued.

cues.zh: 萧恩给放羊人送完治疗真菌的药膏后
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gei3 fang4 yang2 ren2 song4 wan2 zhi4 liao2 zhen1 jun1 de5 yao4 gao1 hou4
cues.en: After Shawn delivered the antifungal ointment to the shepherd,

cues.zh: 回到医院就遇到了病人小胖
cues.pinyin: hui2 dao4 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 yu4 dao4 le5 bing4 ren2 xiao3 pang4
cues.en: he returned to the hospital and ran into a patient, Xiaopang.

cues.zh: 她的胸口和胳膊时常疼痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xiong1 kou3 he2 ge1 bo2 shi2 chang2 teng2 tong4
cues.en: Her chest and arms often hurt.

cues.zh: 有时候还会感觉手冷
cues.pinyin: you3 shi2 hou4 hai2 hui4 gan3 jue2 shou3 leng3
cues.en: Sometimes her hands also felt cold,

cues.zh: 甚至完全没有知觉
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 zhi1 jue2
cues.en: even completely numb.

cues.zh: 萧恩觉得可能是心脚痛或者是栓色
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 jue2 de5 ke3 neng2 shi4 xin1 jiao3 tong4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 shuan1 se4
cues.en: Shawn thought it might be heart disease or an embolism,

cues.zh: 需要做搭桥手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 zuo4 da1 qiao2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: requiring bypass surgery.

cues.zh: 医院没有检查血压的实验室
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 mei2 you3 jian3 cha2 xue4 ya1 de5 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: The hospital had no lab to check her blood vessels,

cues.zh: 但护士大姐有办法
cues.pinyin: dan4 hu4 shi4 da4 jie3 you3 ban4 fa3
cues.en: but the senior nurse had a way.

cues.zh: 她将小胖的胳膊反握住
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiang1 xiao3 pang4 de5 ge1 bo2 fan3 wo4 zhu4
cues.en: She held Xiaopang's arm bent back behind her

cues.zh: 让她凑过头
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 cou4 guo4 tou2
cues.en: and had her lean her head over.

cues.zh: 此时她的手腕处没有脉搏
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 ta1 de5 shou3 wan4 chu4 mei2 you3 mai4 bo2
cues.en: At that point there was no pulse at her wrist,

cues.zh: 但当小胖的脸朝前时
cues.pinyin: dan4 dang1 xiao3 pang4 de5 lian3 chao2 qian2 shi2
cues.en: but when Xiaopang's face turned forward,

cues.zh: 脉搏恢复了
cues.pinyin: mai4 bo2 hui1 fu4 le5
cues.en: the pulse came back.

cues.zh: 这说明不是心脏问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shuo1 ming2 bu2 shi4 xin1 zang4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: This showed it wasn't a heart problem.

cues.zh: 萧恩推断
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 tui1 duan4
cues.en: Shawn deduced

cues.zh: 他患有胸阔出口综合症
cues.pinyin: ta1 huan4 you3 xiong1 kuo4 chu1 kou3 zong1 he2 zheng4
cues.en: that she had thoracic outlet syndrome.

cues.zh: 胸腔和颈部的神经和动脉正被压迫
cues.pinyin: xiong1 qiang1 he2 jing3 bu4 de5 shen2 jing1 he2 dong4 mai4 zheng4 bei4 ya1 po4
cues.en: The nerves and arteries in her chest and neck were being compressed.

cues.zh: 这个情况很罕见
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qing2 kuang4 hen3 han3 jian4
cues.en: This condition is very rare.

cues.zh: 可能会导致栓色或者是血栓
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 hui4 dao3 zhi4 shuan1 se4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 xue4 shuan1
cues.en: It could lead to an embolism or a blood clot,

cues.zh: 但是可以治愈
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ke3 yi3 zhi4 yu4
cues.en: but it can be cured.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生在线发福利，四十个患者中可以免费治疗十三个人！但是怎么选择却成为了难题

cues.zh: 布朗这边遇到了一个比较将的病人
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 zhe4 bian1 yu4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 jiang1 de5 bing4 ren2
cues.en: On Brown's side, he came across a rather tricky patient.

cues.zh: 妈妈小薇胃部疼痛
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 xiao3 wei1 wei4 bu4 teng2 tong4
cues.en: The mother, Xiaowei, had stomach pain.

cues.zh: 布朗问他是否会消化不良
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 wen4 ta1 shi4 fou3 hui4 xiao1 hua4 bu4 liang2
cues.en: Brown asked if she had indigestion,

cues.zh: 痉挛或者是呕吐
cues.pinyin: jing4 luan2 huo4 zhe3 shi4 ou3 tu4
cues.en: cramps, or vomiting.

cues.zh: 他表现得很为难
cues.pinyin: ta1 biao3 xian4 de2 hen3 wei2 nan2
cues.en: She seemed very reluctant to answer.

cues.zh: 说偶尔会
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ou3 er3 hui4
cues.en: She said occasionally.

cues.zh: 女儿会说英文
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 hui4 shuo1 ying1 wen2
cues.en: Her daughter could speak English.

cues.zh: 他告诉布朗妈妈在说话
cues.pinyin: ta1 gao4 su4 bu4 lang3 ma1 ma1 zai4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: The daughter told Brown while her mother was speaking.

cues.zh: 其实妈妈的情况很严重
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ma1 ma1 de5 qing2 kuang4 hen3 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: In fact, the mother's condition was very serious.

cues.zh: 偶尔还会发烧
cues.pinyin: ou3 er3 hai2 hui4 fa1 shao1
cues.en: Occasionally she would also run a fever.

cues.zh: 布朗摸了一下小薇的腹部
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 mo1 le5 yi1 xia4 xiao3 wei1 de5 fu4 bu4
cues.en: Brown felt Xiaowei's abdomen

cues.zh: 感觉到了里面有胆结石
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 dao4 le5 li3 mian4 you3 dan3 jie2 shi2
cues.en: and sensed there was a gallstone inside.

cues.zh: 需要动手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 dong4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: Surgery was needed.

cues.zh: 但是小薇不同意
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao3 wei1 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: But Xiaowei didn't agree.

cues.zh: 她来到这里只是想拿些药
cues.pinyin: ta1 lai2 dao4 zhe4 li3 zhi3 shi4 xiang3 na2 xie1 yao4
cues.en: She had only come here hoping to get some medicine.

cues.zh: 动手术会浪费时间
cues.pinyin: dong4 shou3 shu4 hui4 lang4 fei4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Having surgery would waste time,

cues.zh: 她就没办法工作和照顾女儿了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 mei2 ban4 fa3 gong1 zuo4 he2 zhao4 gu4 nv3 er2 le5
cues.en: and then she wouldn't be able to work and take care of her daughter.

cues.zh: 布朗告诉小薇
cues.pinyin: bu4 lang3 gao4 su4 xiao3 wei1
cues.en: Brown told Xiaowei

cues.zh: 她自己的母亲也有重病
cues.pinyin: ta1 zi4 ji3 de5 mu3 qin1 ye3 you3 zhong4 bing4
cues.en: that his own mother had also had a serious illness

cues.zh: 还试图掩饰自己的病痛
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 tu2 yan3 shi4 zi4 ji3 de5 bing4 tong4
cues.en: and had also tried to hide her pain,

cues.zh: 但是其实儿女能清楚地感觉到
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qi2 shi2 er2 nv3 neng2 qing1 chu3 di4 gan3 jue2 dao4
cues.en: but in fact, her children could clearly sense it.

cues.zh: 如果你不能照顾好自己
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 bu4 neng2 zhao4 gu4 hao3 zi4 ji3
cues.en: If you can't take care of yourself,

cues.zh: 就无法照顾好女儿
cues.pinyin: jiu4 wu2 fa3 zhao4 gu4 hao3 nv3 er2
cues.en: then you can't take care of your daughter either.

cues.zh: 最终在女儿和布朗的共同劝说下
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 zai4 nv3 er2 he2 bu4 lang3 de5 gong4 tong2 quan4 shuo1 xia4
cues.en: In the end, with the daughter and Brown both persuading her,

cues.zh: 小薇的态度松动了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 tai4 du4 song1 dong4 le5
cues.en: Xiaowei's attitude softened.

cues.zh: 初步的筛选工作陆陆续续结束了
cues.pinyin: chu1 bu4 de5 shai1 xuan3 gong1 zuo4 lu4 lu4 xu4 xu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: The initial round of screening gradually came to an end.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 天才医生在线发福利，四十个患者中可以免费治疗十三个人！但是怎么选择却成为了难题

cues.zh: 这样风险会更低
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 feng1 xian3 hui4 geng4 di1
cues.en: That way the risk would be lower.

cues.zh: 可是利姆依旧觉得这个方案十分大胆
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 li4 mu3 yi1 jiu4 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 an4 shi2 fen1 da4 dan3
cues.en: But Lim still felt this plan was very bold.

cues.zh: 移植失败和坏死的风险可能会让小
cues.pinyin: yi2 zhi2 shi1 bai4 he2 huai4 si3 de5 feng1 xian3 ke3 neng2 hui4 rang4 xiao3
cues.en: The risk of transplant failure and necrosis might make Xiaobu's

cues.zh: 布的情况更早
cues.pinyin: bu4 de5 qing2 kuang4 geng4 zao3
cues.en: condition even worse.

cues.zh: 还有一个就是布朗负责的小薇
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 jiu4 shi4 bu4 lang3 fu4 ze2 de5 xiao3 wei1
cues.en: There was also the case of Xiaowei, whom Brown was responsible for.

cues.zh: 小薇的胆结石和间接性阻塞胆管
cues.pinyin: xiao3 wei1 de5 dan3 jie2 shi2 he2 jian4 jie1 xing4 zu3 se4 dan3 guan3
cues.en: Xiaowei's gallstones and intermittent bile duct obstruction

cues.zh: 可能会导致上行性胆管炎
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 hui4 dao3 zhi4 shang4 hang2 xing4 dan3 guan3 yan2
cues.en: could lead to ascending cholangitis,

cues.zh: 败血症甚至死亡
cues.pinyin: bai4 xue4 zheng4 shen4 zhi4 si3 wang2
cues.en: sepsis, or even death.

cues.zh: 药物治愈的可能性非常小
cues.pinyin: yao4 wu4 zhi4 yu4 de5 ke3 neng2 xing4 fei1 chang2 xiao3
cues.en: The chance of curing it with medication alone was very small.

cues.zh: 症状已经很严重了
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zhuang4 yi3 jing1 hen3 yan2 zhong4 le5
cues.en: The symptoms were already quite severe.

cues.zh: 但如果做手术的话
cues.pinyin: dan4 ru2 guo3 zuo4 shou3 shu4 de5 hua4
cues.en: But if she had the surgery,

cues.zh: 还是十分简单的
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 shi2 fen1 jian3 dan1 de5
cues.en: it would actually be quite simple.

cues.zh: 而且他还需要抚养女儿
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 hai2 xu1 yao4 fu3 yang3 nv3 er2
cues.en: Also, he still needed to support and raise his daughter,

cues.zh: 这个手术对他来说很有必要
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 dui4 ta1 lai2 shuo1 hen3 you3 bi4 yao4
cues.en: so this surgery was very necessary for him.

cues.zh: 一个是简单的手术
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 jian3 dan1 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: One option was a simple surgery

cues.zh: 还不怎么需要后续护理
cues.pinyin: hai2 bu4 zen3 me5 xu1 yao4 hou4 xu4 hu4 li3
cues.en: that wouldn't need much follow-up care.

cues.zh: 一个是非常复杂的手术
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 shi4 fei1 chang2 fu4 za2 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The other was a very complex surgery

cues.zh: 而且很可能失败
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hen3 ke3 neng2 shi1 bai4
cues.en: that was also quite likely to fail.

cues.zh: 两者之间选择哪一个
cues.pinyin: liang3 zhe3 zhi1 jian1 xuan3 ze2 na3 yi2 ge4
cues.en: Between the two, which one to choose

cues.zh: 似乎是很明了了
