cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 hu2 lu2 wa2 ying1 gai1 cai3 yong4 shen2 me5 ce4 lve4 qu4 jiu4 ye2 ye2
cues.en: So what strategy should the Calabash Brothers use to rescue grandpa

cues.zh: 才有最大的成功率呢
cues.pinyin: cai2 you3 zui4 da4 de5 cheng2 gong1 lv4 ne5
cues.en: in order to have the highest chance of success?

cues.zh: 下面我们就一起来分析一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: xia4 mian4 wo3 men5 jiu4 yi4 qi3 lai2 fen1 xi1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Let's analyze this problem together.

cues.zh: 首先我们先从一个比较简单的角度去分析
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 cong2 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 jian3 dan1 de5 jiao3 du4 qu4 fen1 xi1
cues.en: First, let's look at it from a simpler angle.

cues.zh: 如果葫芦娃只救爷爷救一次
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 hu2 lu2 wa2 zhi3 jiu4 ye2 ye2 jiu4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: Suppose the Calabash Brothers only attempt the rescue once —

cues.zh: 就是我们不管几个葫芦娃出发
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 bu4 guan3 ji3 ge4 hu2 lu2 wa2 chu1 fa1
cues.en: meaning no matter how many brothers go out,

cues.zh: 反正只救一次
cues.pinyin: fan3 zheng4 zhi3 jiu4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: they only try to rescue him one time.

cues.zh: 如果救不出来他就不救了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 jiu4 bu4 chu1 lai2 ta1 jiu4 bu4 jiu4 le5
cues.en: If the rescue fails, they give up entirely.

cues.zh: 这种情况下葫芦娃应该第几天出发呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 xia4 hu2 lu2 wa2 ying1 gai1 di4 ji3 tian1 chu1 fa1 ne5
cues.en: In this case, on which day should they set out?

cues.zh: 咱们思考
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 si1 kao3
cues.en: Let's think about it.

cues.zh: 假如说他第一天就出发了
cues.pinyin: jia3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 di4 yi1 tian1 jiu4 chu1 fa1 le5
cues.en: Suppose he sets out on the very first day.

cues.zh: 大娃救爷爷的成功率是 1
cues.pinyin: da4 wa2 jiu4 ye2 ye2 de5 cheng2 gong1 lv4 shi4 1
cues.en: The big brother's success rate at saving grandpa is 1.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】葫芦娃救爷爷为啥一个一个上？童年最大疑惑被李永乐老师解开了！

cues.zh: 前两天葫芦娃都歇着攒葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: qian2 liang3 tian1 hu2 lu2 wa2 dou1 xie1 zhe5 zan3 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: For the first two days, the brothers rest and save up Calabash Brothers.

cues.zh: 第三天攒够了三只一起去
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 tian1 zan3 gou4 le5 san1 zhi3 yi4 qi3 qu4
cues.en: On the third day, once there are enough, three of them go together.

cues.zh: 所以解救成功率是三分之七
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jie3 jiu4 cheng2 gong1 lv4 shi4 san1 fen1 zhi1 qi1
cues.en: So the rescue success rate is 3/7.

cues.zh: 此时爷爷还活着
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 ye2 ye2 hai2 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: At this point, grandpa is still alive

cues.zh: 概率是四分之六分之四
cues.pinyin: gai4 lv4 shi4 si4 fen1 zhi1 liu4 fen1 zhi1 si4
cues.en: with a probability of 4/6.

cues.zh: 这样一来解救爷爷的概率就是 12 分之 12 的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 jie3 jiu4 ye2 ye2 de5 gai4 lv4 jiu4 shi4 12 fen1 zhi1 12 de5
cues.en: So the overall probability of successfully rescuing grandpa is 12/42.

cues.zh: 你会发现第三天去解救更好一些对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 di4 san1 tian1 qu4 jie3 jiu4 geng4 hao3 yi1 xie1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: You'll find that going on the third day works out better, right?

cues.zh: 好如果第四天去救呢
cues.pinyin: hao3 ru2 guo3 di4 si4 tian1 qu4 jiu4 ne5
cues.en: Okay, what if they go on the fourth day instead?

cues.zh: 那现在攒了四只葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 zan3 le5 si4 zhi3 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: Now they've saved up four Calabash Brothers,

cues.zh: 然后爷爷还活着的概率是 3 分之 6
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye2 ye2 hai2 huo2 zhe5 de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 3 fen1 zhi1 6
cues.en: and the probability grandpa is still alive is 3/6.

cues.zh: 这样一来成功解救的概率就是 12 分之 12
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 cheng2 gong1 jie3 jiu4 de5 gai4 lv4 jiu4 shi4 12 fen1 zhi1 12
cues.en: So the probability of a successful rescue is 12/42.

cues.zh: 你看第四天救也比较好对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 di4 si4 tian1 jiu4 ye3 bi3 jiao4 hao3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: See, going on the fourth day is also pretty good, right?

cues.zh: 同样道理我们来可以算一下
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 wo3 men5 lai2 ke3 yi3 suan4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: By the same logic, we can calculate

cues.zh: 第五天去救
cues.pinyin: di4 wu3 tian1 qu4 jiu4
cues.en: going on the fifth day.

cues.zh: 攒了五只葫芦娃成功概率 5 分之 7
cues.pinyin: zan3 le5 wu3 zhi3 hu2 lu2 wa2 cheng2 gong1 gai4 lv4 5 fen1 zhi1 7
cues.en: With five Calabash Brothers saved up, the success probability is 5/7,

cues.zh: 爷爷还活着概率 2 6
cues.pinyin: ye2 ye2 hai2 huo2 zhe5 gai4 lv4 2 6
cues.en: the probability grandpa is still alive is 2/6,

cues.zh: 解救成功率 10 42
cues.pinyin: jie3 jiu4 cheng2 gong1 lv4 10 42
cues.en: so the rescue success rate is 10/42.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】葫芦娃救爷爷为啥一个一个上？童年最大疑惑被李永乐老师解开了！

cues.zh: 就是葫芦娃只要没死光
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 hu2 lu2 wa2 zhi3 yao4 mei2 si3 guang1
cues.en: As long as not all the Calabash Brothers are dead,

cues.zh: 只要爷爷还没死
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ye2 ye2 hai2 mei2 si3
cues.en: and grandpa isn't dead yet,

cues.zh: 他就可以继续救是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ji4 xu4 jiu4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: they can keep trying to rescue him, right?

cues.zh: 这种情况下我们有哪些策略呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 xia4 wo3 men5 you3 na3 xie1 ce4 lve4 ne5
cues.en: So what strategies do we have in this case?

cues.zh: 为了分析这个策略我们需要画一个表格
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 fen1 xi1 zhe4 ge5 ce4 lve4 wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 hua4 yi2 ge4 biao3 ge2
cues.en: To analyze this, we need to draw a table.

cues.zh: 好我画了一张表格
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 hua4 le5 yi1 zhang1 biao3 ge2
cues.en: Okay, I've drawn a table.

cues.zh: 我来解释一下这个表格是什么意思
cues.pinyin: wo3 lai2 jie3 shi4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 biao3 ge2 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: Let me explain what this table means.

cues.zh: 这个 12 3 45 6 就是表示
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 12 3 45 6 jiu4 shi4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: This "1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6" represents

cues.zh: 每一天前去解救爷爷的葫芦娃的知数
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 tian1 qian2 qu4 jie3 jiu4 ye2 ye2 de5 hu2 lu2 wa2 de5 zhi1 shu4
cues.en: the number of Calabash Brothers going to rescue grandpa each day.

cues.zh: 因为爷爷最多只能活到第六天
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ye2 ye2 zui4 duo1 zhi3 neng2 huo2 dao4 di4 liu4 tian1
cues.en: Since grandpa can survive at most until day six,

cues.zh: 所以这个第七天就没有意义了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 di4 qi1 tian1 jiu4 mei2 you3 yi4 yi4 le5
cues.en: day seven is meaningless here.

cues.zh: 那么动画片里边的解救方法是这样的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dong4 hua4 pian4 li3 bian1 de5 jie3 jiu4 fang1 fa3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: So the rescue method used in the cartoon is this:

cues.zh: 就是第一天去一只葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 di4 yi1 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: on day one, one Calabash Brother goes,

cues.zh: 第二天去一只第三天去一只
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1 di4 san1 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1
cues.en: on day two one goes, on day three one goes,

cues.zh: 第五天去一只第六天去一只
cues.pinyin: di4 wu3 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1 di4 liu4 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1
cues.en: on day five one goes, on day six one goes.

cues.zh: 这是动画片里边解救方式
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dong4 hua4 pian4 li3 bian1 jie3 jiu4 fang1 shi4
cues.en: That's the rescue method used in the cartoon.

cues.zh: 我们这个就称之为策略一
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 ce4 lve4 yi1
cues.en: We'll call this Strategy One.

cues.zh: 那除了这个策略还有什么策略呢
cues.pinyin: na4 chu2 le5 zhe4 ge5 ce4 lve4 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 ce4 lve4 ne5
cues.en: Besides this, what other strategies are there?

cues.zh: 我们可以这样
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: We could do it like this:

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】葫芦娃救爷爷为啥一个一个上？童年最大疑惑被李永乐老师解开了！

cues.zh: 比如说前四天每天去一只葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 qian2 si4 tian1 mei3 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: for example, one Calabash Brother goes each day for the first four days,

cues.zh: 第五天不去攒葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: di4 wu3 tian1 bu4 qu4 zan3 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: on day five they don't go and instead save up,

cues.zh: 到了第六天一下子去两只
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 di4 liu4 tian1 yi1 xia4 zi5 qu4 liang3 zhi3
cues.en: and on day six, two go at once.

cues.zh: 这也是一个策略对不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ye3 shi4 yi2 ge4 ce4 lve4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: That's also a valid strategy, right?

cues.zh: 我们还有什么策略
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hai2 you3 shen2 me5 ce4 lve4
cues.en: What other strategies do we have?

cues.zh: 比如说我们可以前三天各去一只葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 qian2 san1 tian1 ge4 qu4 yi1 zhi1 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: For example, one Calabash Brother could go on each of the first three days,

cues.zh: 第四天不去
cues.pinyin: di4 si4 tian1 bu4 qu4
cues.en: none goes on day four,

cues.zh: 第五天去两只
cues.pinyin: di4 wu3 tian1 qu4 liang3 zhi3
cues.en: two go on day five,

cues.zh: 然后第六天去一只
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 di4 liu4 tian1 qu4 yi1 zhi1
cues.en: and one goes on day six.

cues.zh: 这是不是也是一个策略对不对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 bu2 shi4 ye3 shi4 yi2 ge4 ce4 lve4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Isn't that also a strategy?

cues.zh: 等等我们可以把这个策略一直写下去
cues.pinyin: deng3 deng3 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ce4 lve4 yi4 zhi2 xie3 xia4 qu4
cues.en: And so on — we can keep writing out strategies like this

cues.zh: 直到最后一个策略
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 ce4 lve4
cues.en: until we reach the very last one,

cues.zh: 那就是前 5 天都不去我们都不去
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 qian2 5 tian1 dou1 bu4 qu4 wo3 men5 dou1 bu4 qu4
cues.en: which is: don't go at all for the first five days,

cues.zh: 一直攒葫芦娃
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 zan3 hu2 lu2 wa2
cues.en: just keep saving up Calabash Brothers,

cues.zh: 到了第 6 天的时候我们一下子
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 di4 6 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 yi1 xia4 zi5
cues.en: and on day six, all at once

cues.zh: 去 6 个对不对
cues.pinyin: qu4 6 ge4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: six of them go, right?

cues.zh: 然后去打妖精解救爷爷
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 qu4 da3 yao1 jing1 jie3 jiu4 ye2 ye2
cues.en: and then go fight the demon to rescue grandpa.

cues.zh: 那么这一共有多少个策略呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 yi1 gong4 you3 duo1 shao3 ge4 ce4 lve4 ne5
cues.en: So how many strategies are there in total?

cues.zh: 我们数出来一共是 13 2 个策略
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shu4 chu1 lai2 yi1 gong4 shi4 13 2 ge4 ce4 lve4
cues.en: We counted, and there are 32 strategies in total.

cues.zh: 13 2 个策略
cues.pinyin: 13 2 ge4 ce4 lve4
cues.en: 32 strategies.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】葫芦娃救爷爷为啥一个一个上？童年最大疑惑被李永乐老师解开了！

cues.zh: 然后第二只葫芦把爷爷解救出来了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 di4 er4 zhi3 hu2 lu2 ba3 ye2 ye2 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: Then, say the second Calabash Brother rescues grandpa.

cues.zh: 概率是 1 分之 7
cues.pinyin: gai4 lv4 shi4 1 fen1 zhi1 7
cues.en: The probability is 1/7.

cues.zh: 所以这第二只葫芦解救出来的概率
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 di4 er4 zhi3 hu2 lu2 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 de5 gai4 lv4
cues.en: So the probability that this second brother succeeds in the rescue

cues.zh: 应该是他们三个数相乘对吗
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 ta1 men5 san1 ge4 shu4 xiang1 cheng2 dui4 ma5
cues.en: should be the product of three numbers, right?

cues.zh: 咱们继续想
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ji4 xu4 xiang3
cues.en: Let's keep thinking.

cues.zh: 那第三只葫芦把爷爷解救出来
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 san1 zhi3 hu2 lu2 ba3 ye2 ye2 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: What's the probability

cues.zh: 的概率是多大
cues.pinyin: de5 gai4 lv4 shi4 duo1 da4
cues.en: that the third brother rescues grandpa?

cues.zh: 第三只解救出来说明前两只都没有
cues.pinyin: di4 san1 zhi3 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 shuo1 ming2 qian2 liang3 zhi3 dou1 mei2 you3
cues.en: If the third one succeeds, that means the first two failed,

cues.zh: 救出来对不对
cues.pinyin: jiu4 chu1 lai2 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 所以 6 分之 7
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 6 fen1 zhi1 7
cues.en: So that's 6/7,

cues.zh: 没有救出来的概率得平方
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 de5 gai4 lv4 de2 ping2 fang1
cues.en: and the probability of failing has to be squared.

cues.zh: 此时第三天爷爷还活着
cues.pinyin: ci3 shi2 di4 san1 tian1 ye2 ye2 hai2 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: At this point, on day three, grandpa is still alive

cues.zh: 概率是 4 6 分之 4
cues.pinyin: gai4 lv4 shi4 4 6 fen1 zhi1 4
cues.en: with a probability of 4/6,

cues.zh: 然后再乘以第三只解救出来的概
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 cheng2 yi3 di4 san1 zhi3 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 de5 gai4
cues.en: and then multiply by the third brother's success

cues.zh: 率 1 7 分之 1
cues.pinyin: lv4 1 7 fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: probability of 1/7.

cues.zh: 咱们继续想
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ji4 xu4 xiang3
cues.en: Let's keep thinking.

cues.zh: 那第四只解救出来的概率呢
cues.pinyin: na4 di4 si4 zhi3 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 de5 gai4 lv4 ne5
cues.en: What about the probability that the fourth brother succeeds?

cues.zh: 说明前三只都没有解救出来 6 7 分
cues.pinyin: shuo1 ming2 qian2 san1 zhi3 dou1 mei2 you3 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 6 7 fen1
cues.en: That means the first three all failed — that's (6/7)

cues.zh: 之 6 的 3 次方
cues.pinyin: zhi1 6 de5 3 ci4 fang1
cues.en: to the third power.

cues.zh: 爷爷还活着 3 6 分之 6
cues.pinyin: ye2 ye2 hai2 huo2 zhe5 3 6 fen1 zhi1 6
cues.en: Grandpa is still alive with a probability of 3/6,

cues.zh: 然后第四只解救出来了乘以 1 7 分之 1
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 di4 si4 zhi3 jie3 jiu4 chu1 lai2 le5 cheng2 yi3 1 7 fen1 zhi1 1
cues.en: and then the fourth one succeeds, multiplied by 1/7.

cues.zh: 对吧继续想
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 ji4 xu4 xiang3
cues.en: Right, let's keep going.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 自闭症医生遇上自闭症病人
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi4 zheng4 yi1 sheng1 yu4 shang4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 bing4 ren2
cues.en: An autistic doctor meets an autistic patient.

cues.zh: 他们会发生什么样的故事呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hui4 fa1 sheng1 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 gu4 shi4 ne5
cues.en: What kind of story will unfold between them?

cues.zh: 这个大爷叫老钱是一名医生
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 da4 ye2 jiao4 lao3 qian2 shi4 yi1 ming2 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: This old man is named Old Qian, and he's a doctor.

cues.zh: 他的右手从一个月以前就开始疼痛
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 you4 shou3 cong2 yi2 ge4 yue4 yi3 qian2 jiu4 kai1 shi3 teng2 tong4
cues.en: His right hand started hurting a month ago.

cues.zh: 然后出现了颤抖
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 chu1 xian4 le5 chan4 dou3
cues.en: Then it started trembling.

cues.zh: 虚弱和轻软的现象
cues.pinyin: xu1 ruo4 he2 qing1 ruan3 de5 xian4 xiang4
cues.en: along with weakness and limpness.

cues.zh: 甚至有次在手术途中不得不下场离开
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 you3 ci4 zai4 shou3 shu4 tu2 zhong1 bu4 de2 bu4 xia4 chang3 li2 kai1
cues.en: Once he even had to leave in the middle of a surgery.

cues.zh: 可想而知这对一个需要拿起手术刀
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiang3 er2 zhi1 zhe4 dui4 yi2 ge4 xu1 yao4 na2 qi3 shou3 shu4 dao1
cues.en: You can imagine, for a surgeon

cues.zh: 的外科医生来
cues.pinyin: de5 wai4 ke1 yi1 sheng1 lai2
cues.en: who has to hold a scalpel,

cues.zh: 说有多么严重
cues.pinyin: shuo1 you3 duo1 me5 yan2 zhong4
cues.en: just how serious this is.

cues.zh: 所以在情况没有缓解之后他立刻来了医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zai4 qing2 kuang4 mei2 you3 huan3 jie3 zhi1 hou4 ta1 li4 ke4 lai2 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: So when it didn't improve, he went straight to the hospital.

cues.zh: 老钱把他手术过程的视频发给了医生
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 ba3 ta1 shou3 shu4 guo4 cheng2 de5 shi4 pin2 fa1 gei3 le5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Old Qian sent the doctors a video of himself operating.

cues.zh: 其中出现的症状看起来像是腕管综合症
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 chu1 xian4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4 kan4 qi3 lai2 xiang4 shi4 wan4 guan3 zong1 he2 zheng4
cues.en: The symptoms looked like carpal tunnel syndrome.

cues.zh: 也就是神经压迫导致的
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shen2 jing1 ya1 po4 dao3 zhi4 de5
cues.en: That is, caused by nerve compression.

cues.zh: 不得不说
cues.pinyin: bu4 de2 bu4 shuo1
cues.en: It has to be said,

cues.zh: 老钱的脾气是够臭的
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 de5 pi2 qi4 shi4 gou4 chou4 de5
cues.en: Old Qian's temper is quite nasty.

cues.zh: 先是要求医生给他做一系列检查
cues.pinyin: xian1 shi4 yao1 qiu2 yi1 sheng1 gei3 ta1 zuo4 yi1 xi4 lie4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: First he demanded the doctors run a whole series of tests on him,

cues.zh: 排除可能的病症
cues.pinyin: pai2 chu2 ke3 neng2 de5 bing4 zheng4
cues.en: to rule out possible conditions.

cues.zh: 然后又给他们一份清单
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you4 gei3 ta1 men5 yi1 fen4 qing1 dan1
cues.en: Then he handed them a list,

cues.zh: 对住院条件吹毛求疵
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhu4 yuan4 tiao2 jian4 chui1 mao2 qiu2 ci1
cues.en: nitpicking over the hospital conditions.

cues.zh: 要求这要求那的
cues.pinyin: yao1 qiu2 zhe4 yao1 qiu2 na4 de5
cues.en: demanding this and that.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 搞得医生们的心情也很不愉快
cues.pinyin: gao3 de2 yi1 sheng1 men5 de5 xin1 qing2 ye3 hen3 bu4 yu2 kuai4
cues.en: This put the doctors in quite a bad mood.

cues.zh: 虽然老钱脾气不好
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 lao3 qian2 pi2 qi4 bu4 hao3
cues.en: Although Old Qian has a bad temper,

cues.zh: 但是他在医学上还是很有建树的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 zai4 yi1 xue2 shang4 hai2 shi4 hen3 you3 jian4 shu4 de5
cues.en: he's actually quite accomplished in medicine.

cues.zh: 既然人家都要求了
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 ren2 jia1 dou1 yao1 qiu2 le5
cues.en: Since he insisted on it,

cues.zh: 那就只能一项一项排除隐患
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 zhi3 neng2 yi1 xiang4 yi1 xiang4 pai2 chu2 yin3 huan4
cues.en: they had no choice but to rule out risks one by one.

cues.zh: 不过老钱最开始说的是
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 lao3 qian2 zui4 kai1 shi3 shuo1 de5 shi4
cues.en: But what Old Qian first mentioned was

cues.zh: 是什么糖尿病啊
cues.pinyin: shi4 shen2 me5 tang2 niao4 bing4 a5
cues.en: things like diabetes,

cues.zh: 骨髓瘤啊
cues.pinyin: gu3 sui3 liu2 a5
cues.en: myeloma,

cues.zh: 免疫问题都没检查出来
cues.pinyin: mian3 yi4 wen4 ti2 dou1 mei2 jian3 cha2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and immune issues — none of those turned up.

cues.zh: 大家还是认为是腕管的问题
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 hai2 shi4 ren4 wei2 shi4 wan4 guan3 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Everyone still thought it was a carpal tunnel issue.

cues.zh: 不过肖恩看着老钱的手术视频时
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao4 en1 kan4 zhe5 lao3 qian2 de5 shou3 shu4 shi4 pin2 shi2
cues.en: But when Shaun watched Old Qian's surgery video,

cues.zh: 发现他最后一次手术时
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 zui4 hou4 yi1 ci4 shou3 shu4 shi2
cues.en: he noticed that during his last surgery,

cues.zh: 进行了 11 3 次缝合
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 le5 11 3 ci4 feng2 he2
cues.en: he made 113 stitches,

cues.zh: 其中的一半
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 de5 yi2 ban4
cues.en: and for about half of them,

cues.zh: 他的手都有轻微的抖动
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 shou3 dou1 you3 qing1 wei1 de5 dou3 dong4
cues.en: his hand trembled slightly.

cues.zh: 但是抖动只出现在他直着手腕的时候
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dou3 dong4 zhi3 chu1 xian4 zai4 ta1 zhi2 zhuo2 shou3 wan4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But the tremor only appeared when his wrist was straight.

cues.zh: 他弯着手腕时很正常
cues.pinyin: ta1 wan1 zhuo2 shou3 wan4 shi2 hen3 zheng4 chang2
cues.en: When his wrist was bent, it was completely normal.

cues.zh: 所以这不是腕管的问题
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 bu2 shi4 wan4 guan3 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: So this isn't a carpal tunnel issue.

cues.zh: 而是肌张力障碍
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 ji1 zhang1 li4 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: It's actually dystonia.

cues.zh: 肌张力障碍是持续的肌肉收缩
cues.pinyin: ji1 zhang1 li4 zhang4 ai4 shi4 chi2 xu4 de5 ji1 rou4 shou1 suo1
cues.en: Dystonia is caused by sustained muscle contractions

cues.zh: 引起的异常运动或姿势
cues.pinyin: yin3 qi3 de5 yi4 chang2 yun4 dong4 huo4 zi1 shi4
cues.en: that produce abnormal movements or postures.

cues.zh: 肖恩认为
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 ren4 wei2
cues.en: Shaun believed

cues.zh: 他的问题只不过是
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 wen4 ti2 zhi3 bu4 guo4 shi4
cues.en: his problem was just

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 热敷之类的
cues.pinyin: re4 fu1 zhi1 lei4 de5
cues.en: something like a hot compress,

cues.zh: 跟康复训练差不多
cues.pinyin: gen1 kang1 fu4 xun4 lian4 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: similar to rehab training.

cues.zh: 但是老钱不同意
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 lao3 qian2 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: But Old Qian disagreed.

cues.zh: 觉得物理治疗太浪费时间了
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 wu4 li3 zhi4 liao2 tai4 lang4 fei4 shi2 jian1 le5
cues.en: He thought physical therapy was too much of a waste of time.

cues.zh: 他要做超声消融术
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 zuo4 chao1 sheng1 xiao1 rong2 shu4
cues.en: He wanted focused ultrasound ablation instead,

cues.zh: 直接在脑袋上操作
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 zai4 nao3 dai4 shang4 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: operating directly on his head.

cues.zh: 这个老钱也是很大胆的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 lao3 qian2 ye3 shi4 hen3 da4 dan3 de5
cues.en: This Old Qian is really bold.

cues.zh: 不过人家表示
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ren2 jia1 biao3 shi4
cues.en: But he said

cues.zh: 只要能挽回自己的职业
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 neng2 wan3 hui2 zi4 ji3 de5 zhi2 ye4
cues.en: as long as it could save his career,

cues.zh: 就算直接裁掉脚趾都愿意
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 zhi2 jie1 cai2 diao4 jiao3 zhi3 dou1 yuan4 yi4
cues.en: he'd even be willing to have a finger cut off.

cues.zh: 那行吧
cues.pinyin: na4 xing2 ba5
cues.en: Well, fine then.

cues.zh: 黑哥还能说什么呢
cues.pinyin: hei1 ge1 hai2 neng2 shuo1 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What more could Shaun say?

cues.zh: 只能安排他去做消融手术
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 an1 pai2 ta1 qu4 zuo4 xiao1 rong2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They had no choice but to schedule him for the ablation surgery.

cues.zh: 手术室里
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi4 li3
cues.en: In the operating room,

cues.zh: 医生将超声波连接到立体定向架上
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 jiang1 chao1 sheng1 bo1 lian2 jie1 dao4 li4 ti3 ding4 xiang4 jia4 shang4
cues.en: the doctors connected the ultrasound device to the stereotactic frame,

cues.zh: 准备开始操作
cues.pinyin: zhun3 bei4 kai1 shi3 cao1 zuo4
cues.en: ready to begin the procedure.

cues.zh: 但是乔恩看着仪器
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 qiao2 en1 kan4 zhe5 yi2 qi4
cues.en: But Shaun, looking at the equipment

cues.zh: 扫描的脑部 CT 图
cues.pinyin: sao3 miao2 de5 nao3 bu4 CT tu2
cues.en: and the brain CT scan it produced,

cues.zh: 思考一阵后
cues.pinyin: si1 kao3 yi1 zhen4 hou4
cues.en: thought it over for a while,

cues.zh: 突然叫停了他们
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 jiao4 ting2 le5 ta1 men5
cues.en: then suddenly told them to stop.

cues.zh: 难道是乔恩发现他的推断错了吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shi4 qiao2 en1 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 tui1 duan4 cuo4 le5 ma5
cues.en: Could it be that Shaun realized his own deduction was wrong?

cues.zh: 当然不是
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Of course not.

cues.zh: 乔恩说
cues.pinyin: qiao2 en1 shuo1
cues.en: Shaun said,

cues.zh: 难道是肖恩发现他的推断错了吗
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 shi4 xiao4 en1 fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 tui1 duan4 cuo4 le5 ma5
cues.en: the dystonia Old Qian shows is just a symptom,

cues.zh: 而病因是她的脊椎
cues.pinyin: er2 bing4 yin1 shi4 ta1 de5 ji3 zhui1
cues.en: while the real cause is his

cues.zh: 动脉出现了异常情况
cues.pinyin: dong4 mai4 chu1 xian4 le5 yi4 chang2 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: vertebral artery having an abnormality.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 能让他回去做手术怎么样都行
cues.pinyin: neng2 rang4 ta1 hui2 qu4 zuo4 shou3 shu4 zen3 me5 yang4 dou1 xing2
cues.en: As long as it lets him go back to surgery, he doesn't care how.

cues.zh: 而病因是他的脊椎
cues.pinyin: er2 bing4 yin1 shi4 ta1 de5 ji3 zhui1
cues.en: Even if he died, he'd have no regrets.

cues.zh: 算了
cues.pinyin: suan4 le5
cues.en: Oh well,

cues.zh: 攀上这么一个病人
cues.pinyin: pan1 shang4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 bing4 ren2
cues.en: having landed a patient like this,

cues.zh: 他们也认栽了
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ye3 ren4 zai1 le5
cues.en: the doctors just accepted their fate.

cues.zh: 医生们聚在一起做术前讨论
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 ju4 zai4 yi4 qi3 zuo4 shu4 qian2 tao3 lun4
cues.en: The doctors gathered for a pre-op discussion

cues.zh: 看有什么办法把风险降到最低
cues.pinyin: kan4 you3 shen2 me5 ban4 fa3 ba3 feng1 xian3 jiang4 dao4 zui4 di1
cues.en: to see how they could minimize the risk.

cues.zh: 最后他们决定做手腕处的饶动脉移植
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ta1 men5 jue2 ding4 zuo4 shou3 wan4 chu4 de5 rao2 dong4 mai4 yi2 zhi2
cues.en: In the end, they decided to do a radial artery transplant at the wrist.

cues.zh: 肖恩去告知老钱这个手术方案
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 qu4 gao4 zhi1 lao3 qian2 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 fang1 an4
cues.en: Shaun went to tell Old Qian about the surgical plan.

cues.zh: 他同意了
cues.pinyin: ta1 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: He agreed.

cues.zh: 不过俩人说着说着又单方面吵起来了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 lia3 ren2 shuo1 zhe5 shuo1 zhe5 you4 dan1 fang1 mian4 chao3 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: But as they talked, Old Qian started a one-sided argument again.

cues.zh: 老钱言语激烈
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 yan2 yu3 ji1 lie4
cues.en: Old Qian's words got harsh,

cues.zh: 就是肖恩自闭症这点不放
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 xiao4 en1 zi4 bi4 zheng4 zhe4 dian3 bu4 fang4
cues.en: fixating on Shaun's autism.

cues.zh: 肖恩虽然无法反驳
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 sui1 ran2 wu2 fa3 fan3 bo2
cues.en: Although Shaun couldn't argue back directly,

cues.zh: 但是可以怼回去
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ke3 yi3 dui4 hui2 qu4
cues.en: he could still fire back.

cues.zh: 肖恩表示他情绪太激动
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 biao3 shi4 ta1 qing2 xu4 tai4 ji1 dong4
cues.en: Shaun pointed out that he was too emotionally worked up,

cues.zh: 因为他在不停地搓在手里的杯子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zai4 bu4 ting2 di4 cuo1 zai4 shou3 li3 de5 bei1 zi5
cues.en: because he kept rubbing the cup in his hand.

cues.zh: 自闭症患者在焦虑不安时
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3 zai4 jiao1 lv4 bu4 an1 shi2
cues.en: When autistic people feel anxious,

cues.zh: 会用其他东西转移注意力
cues.pinyin: hui4 yong4 qi2 ta1 dong1 xi1 zhuan3 yi2 zhu4 yi4 li4
cues.en: they use other objects to distract themselves —

cues.zh: 就像从前自己搓着哥哥留下的那个玩
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 cong2 qian2 zi4 ji3 cuo1 zhe5 ge1 ge1 liu2 xia4 de5 na4 ge5 wan2
cues.en: just like he used to rub that

cues.zh: 具手术刀一样
cues.pinyin: ju4 shou3 shu4 dao1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: toy scalpel his brother left behind.

cues.zh: 再三刺激下
cues.pinyin: zai4 san1 ci4 ji1 xia4
cues.en: After being provoked repeatedly,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 老钱直接让小汉给他拿一份自
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 zhi2 jie1 rang4 xiao3 han4 gei3 ta1 na2 yi1 fen4 zi4
cues.en: Old Qian flatly told Shaun to go get him an

cues.zh: 闭症诊断问卷
cues.pinyin: bi4 zheng4 zhen3 duan4 wen4 juan3
cues.en: autism diagnosis questionnaire.

cues.zh: 可惜问卷结果显示他确实有精神问题
cues.pinyin: ke3 xi1 wen4 juan3 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4 ta1 que4 shi2 you3 jing1 shen2 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Unfortunately, the results showed he really did have a mental health issue.

cues.zh: 这下打脸了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 da3 lian3 le5
cues.en: That backfired on him.

cues.zh: 老钱恼羞成怒
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 nao3 xiu1 cheng2 nu4
cues.en: Old Qian flew into an embarrassed rage,

cues.zh: 和小汉推丧下
cues.pinyin: he2 xiao3 han4 tui1 sang4 xia4
cues.en: and in a shoving match with Shaun,

cues.zh: 不小心摔碎了自己的杯子
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 shuai1 sui4 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 bei1 zi5
cues.en: he accidentally smashed his own cup.

cues.zh: 彻底无法交流了
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 wu2 fa3 jiao1 liu2 le5
cues.en: There was no talking to him anymore.

cues.zh: 老钱让小汉滚出去
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 rang4 xiao3 han4 gun3 chu1 qu4
cues.en: Old Qian told Shaun to get out.

cues.zh: 毕竟是自己理亏碰到了杯子
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 shi4 zi4 ji3 li3 kui1 peng4 dao4 le5 bei1 zi5
cues.en: After all, it was his own fault, breaking the cup.

cues.zh: 小汉只能离开
cues.pinyin: xiao3 han4 zhi3 neng2 li2 kai1
cues.en: Shaun had no choice but to leave.

cues.zh: 第二天
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1
cues.en: The next day,

cues.zh: 小汉又找到老钱
cues.pinyin: xiao3 han4 you4 zhao3 dao4 lao3 qian2
cues.en: Shaun went to find Old Qian again.

cues.zh: 他开始很不耐烦
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 shi3 hen3 bu4 nai4 fan2
cues.en: At first Old Qian was very impatient.

cues.zh: 但是肖安拿出被修好的杯子后
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 an1 na2 chu1 bei4 xiu1 hao3 de5 bei1 zi5 hou4
cues.en: But after Shaun took out the repaired cup,

cues.zh: 突然就平静下来了
cues.pinyin: tu1 ran2 jiu4 ping2 jing4 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: he suddenly calmed down,

cues.zh: 主动对肖安讲起了过去
cues.pinyin: zhu3 dong4 dui4 xiao4 an1 jiang3 qi3 le5 guo4 qu4
cues.en: and voluntarily opened up to Shaun about his past.

cues.zh: 老钱的父亲在他九岁时就去世了
cues.pinyin: lao3 qian2 de5 fu4 qin1 zai4 ta1 jiu3 sui4 shi2 jiu4 qu4 shi4 le5
cues.en: Old Qian's father died when he was nine,

cues.zh: 留下这么一个杯子
cues.pinyin: liu2 xia4 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 bei1 zi5
cues.en: leaving behind this very cup.

cues.zh: 他性格古怪
cues.pinyin: ta1 xing4 ge2 gu3 guai4
cues.en: He has an odd personality,

cues.zh: 没人理解他
cues.pinyin: mei2 ren2 li3 jie3 ta1
cues.en: no one understood him,

cues.zh: 也不愿意和他交朋友
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 yuan4 yi4 he2 ta1 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: and no one wanted to be his friend.

cues.zh: 在努力了但没用之后
cues.pinyin: zai4 nu3 li4 le5 dan4 mei2 yong4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After trying hard but getting nowhere,

cues.zh: 他也不屑再去发展感情
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 bu4 xie4 zai4 qu4 fa1 zhan3 gan3 qing2
cues.en: he stopped bothering to develop relationships.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩一眼看出这个医生也患有自闭症，但他却拒绝承认！医生与医生之间的对决！良医最新一集

cues.zh: 都没有得到血疹的病因
cues.pinyin: dou1 mei2 you3 de2 dao4 xue4 zhen3 de5 bing4 yin1
cues.en: He never found the cause of his rash.

cues.zh: 这个病影响了他工作和生活
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bing4 ying3 xiang3 le5 ta1 gong1 zuo4 he2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: This illness affected his work and his life.

cues.zh: 他甚至连微笑都做不到
cues.pinyin: ta1 shen4 zhi4 lian2 wei1 xiao4 dou1 zuo4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: He couldn't even manage to smile.

cues.zh: 朴医生试着用年轻
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 shi4 zhe5 yong4 nian2 qing1
cues.en: Dr. Park tried using a solution

cues.zh: 清除一下他的脸
cues.pinyin: qing1 chu2 yi1 xia4 ta1 de5 lian3
cues.en: to clean up his face.

cues.zh: 刚一泡
cues.pinyin: gang1 yi1 pao4
cues.en: As soon as it touched his skin,

cues.zh: 小帅就叫了一声
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 jiu4 jiao4 le5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Xiaoshuai let out a cry

cues.zh: 立刻叫停
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 jiao4 ting2
cues.en: and told them to stop immediately.

cues.zh: 一看就是疼痛难忍
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 jiu4 shi4 teng2 tong4 nan2 ren3
cues.en: Clearly, the pain was unbearable.

cues.zh: 医生给小帅做了八项检查
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gei3 xiao3 shuai4 zuo4 le5 ba1 xiang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: The doctors ran eight tests on Xiaoshuai.

cues.zh: 鼻腔没有问题
cues.pinyin: bi2 qiang1 mei2 you3 wen4 ti2
cues.en: His nasal cavity was fine,

cues.zh: 没有浓肿
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 nong2 zhong3
cues.en: no abscess,

cues.zh: 面部肿瘤
cues.pinyin: mian4 bu4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: no facial tumor,

cues.zh: 或是鼻斗炎
cues.pinyin: huo4 shi4 bi2 dou4 yan2
cues.en: and no sinusitis.

cues.zh: 那小帅这到底是怎么回事
cues.pinyin: na4 xiao3 shuai4 zhe4 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: So what was actually going on with Xiaoshuai?

cues.zh: 朴医生想了想
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 xiang3 le5 xiang3
cues.en: Dr. Park thought it over,

cues.zh: 然后立刻去找小美
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 li4 ke4 qu4 zhao3 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: then immediately went to find Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 因为她觉得小帅可能是个瘾君子
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 jue2 de5 xiao3 shuai4 ke3 neng2 shi4 ge4 yin3 jun1 zi3
cues.en: She suspected Xiaoshuai might be an addict,

cues.zh: 来医院只是为了骗止痛药
cues.pinyin: lai2 yi1 yuan4 zhi3 shi4 wei4 le5 pian4 zhi3 tong4 yao4
cues.en: and had only come to the hospital to con painkillers out of them.

cues.zh: 她想要从妻子的那里得到证实
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 yao4 cong2 qi1 zi3 de5 na4 li3 de2 dao4 zheng4 shi2
cues.en: She wanted to confirm this with his wife.

cues.zh: 小美对她坦白
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 dui4 ta1 tan3 bai2
cues.en: Xiaomei confessed to her:

cues.zh: 小帅几年前工作时
cues.pinyin: xiao3 shuai4 ji3 nian2 qian2 gong1 zuo4 shi2
cues.en: a few years ago, while Xiaoshuai was working,

cues.zh: 不小心被射定枪射穿过了手掌
cues.pinyin: bu4 xiao3 xin1 bei4 she4 ding4 qiang1 she4 chuan1 guo4 le5 shou3 zhang3
cues.en: he accidentally had his palm pierced by a nail gun.

cues.zh: 他们没有医保
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 mei2 you3 yi1 bao3
cues.en: They didn't have health insurance,

cues.zh: 所以没有去医院
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei2 you3 qu4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: so they didn't go to the hospital,

cues.zh: 只是去了一家小诊所
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 qu4 le5 yi1 jia1 xiao3 zhen3 suo3
cues.en: just a small clinic instead,

cues.zh: 买了阿片类药品
cues.pinyin: mai3 le5 a1 pian4 lei4 yao4 pin3
cues.en: where they bought opioid medication.

cues.zh: 小美有一天刷牙时发现牙刷有个怪味道
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 you3 yi1 tian1 shua1 ya2 shi2 fa1 xian4 ya2 shua1 you3 ge4 guai4 wei4 dao4
cues.en: One day while brushing her teeth, Xiaomei noticed her toothbrush had a strange smell.

cues.zh: 弟弟你是不是通用我的牙刷刷牙
cues.pinyin: di4 di5 ni3 shi4 bu2 shi4 tong1 yong4 wo3 de5 ya2 shua1 shua1 ya2
cues.en: "Little brother, did you use my toothbrush to brush your teeth?"

cues.zh: 我又没有
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 mei2 you3
cues.en: "I didn't!"

cues.zh: 一定是你不然还有谁
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 shi4 ni3 bu4 ran2 hai2 you3 shui2
cues.en: "It must be you — who else could it be?"

cues.zh: 我又没有用你的牙刷刷牙
cues.pinyin: wo3 you4 mei2 you3 yong4 ni3 de5 ya2 shua1 shua1 ya2
cues.en: "I really didn't use your toothbrush to brush my teeth."

cues.zh: 我是拿去刷洗我的布鞋
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 na2 qu4 shua1 xi3 wo3 de5 bu4 xie2
cues.en: "I used it to scrub my cloth shoes."

cues.zh: 小小我问你
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3
cues.en: "Xiaoxiao, let me ask you something."

cues.zh: 世界上什么人一下子就变老了
cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 shang4 shen2 me5 ren2 yi1 xia4 zi5 jiu4 bian4 lao3 le5
cues.en: "Who in the world suddenly gets old?"

cues.zh: 什么人一下子就变老了
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 ren2 yi1 xia4 zi5 jiu4 bian4 lao3 le5
cues.en: "Who suddenly gets old?"

cues.zh: 妈妈吧
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 ba5
cues.en: "Mom, right?"

cues.zh: 因为妈妈都被小孩子气到都变老了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ma1 ma1 dou1 bei4 xiao3 hai2 zi5 qi4 dao4 dou1 bian4 lao3 le5
cues.en: "Because moms get so annoyed by their kids that they age."

cues.zh: 所以很快就变老了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 bian4 lao3 le5
cues.en: "So they grow old really fast."

cues.zh: 变老妈妈
cues.pinyin: bian4 lao3 ma1 ma1
cues.en: "Mom becomes old."

cues.zh: 对啊
cues.pinyin: dui4 a5
cues.en: "Yeah."

cues.zh: 老妈子
cues.pinyin: lao3 ma1 zi5
cues.en: "An old mom."

cues.zh: 答案是
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4
cues.en: "The answer is..."

cues.zh: 新娘
cues.pinyin: xin1 niang2
cues.en: "A bride."

cues.zh: 因为今天是新娘
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jin1 tian1 shi4 xin1 niang2
cues.en: "Because today she's the bride,"

cues.zh: 明天就变成老婆了
cues.pinyin: ming2 tian1 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 lao3 po2 le5
cues.en: "tomorrow she becomes a wife."

cues.zh: 有一对夫妻出门之后
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 dui4 fu1 qi1 chu1 men2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: A couple went out together one day,

cues.zh: 太太突然对先生说
cues.pinyin: tai4 tai4 tu1 ran2 dui4 xian1 sheng1 shuo1
cues.en: and the wife suddenly said to her husband,

cues.zh: 哎呀糟糕了
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 zao1 gao1 le5
cues.en: "Oh no, this is bad!"

cues.zh: 我忘记把厨房的瓦斯关掉
cues.pinyin: wo3 wang4 ji4 ba3 chu2 fang2 de5 wa3 si1 guan1 diao4
cues.en: "I forgot to turn off the gas in the kitchen."

cues.zh: 万一引起火灾怎么办啊
cues.pinyin: wan4 yi1 yin3 qi3 huo3 zai1 zen3 me5 ban4 a5
cues.en: "What if it starts a fire?"

cues.zh: 先生想了一下说
cues.pinyin: xian1 sheng1 xiang3 le5 yi1 xia4 shuo1
cues.en: The husband thought for a moment and said,

cues.zh: 哦没关系
cues.pinyin: o2 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: "Oh, don't worry."

cues.zh: 我突然想起来
cues.pinyin: wo3 tu1 ran2 xiang3 qi3 lai2
cues.en: "I just remembered —"

cues.zh: 我也忘记关了浴室的水龙头
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 wang4 ji4 guan1 le5 yu4 shi4 de5 shui3 long2 tou2
cues.en: "I also forgot to turn off the bathroom faucet."

cues.zh: 所以不会有危险的
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bu2 hui4 you3 wei1 xian3 de5
cues.en: "So there's no danger."

cues.zh: 珊珊珊珊
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 shan1 shan1
cues.en: "Shan shan shan shan."

cues.zh: 妳说三变牛奶
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 san1 bian4 niu2 nai3
cues.en: "Say it three times and it becomes milk."

cues.zh: 牛奶
cues.pinyin: niu2 nai3
cues.en: "Milk."

cues.zh: 那再说三变豆奶
cues.pinyin: na4 zai4 shuo1 san1 bian4 dou4 nai3
cues.en: "Now say it three times again and it becomes soy milk."

cues.zh: 豆奶豆奶豆奶
cues.pinyin: dou4 nai3 dou4 nai3 dou4 nai3
cues.en: "Soy milk, soy milk, soy milk."

cues.zh: 牛爱喝什么
cues.pinyin: niu2 ai4 he1 shen2 me5
cues.en: "What does a cow like to drink?"

cues.zh: 钱可以买几头牛
cues.pinyin: qian2 ke3 yi3 mai3 ji3 tou2 niu2
cues.en: "How many cows can this money buy?"

cues.zh: 一毛钱还买牛
cues.pinyin: yi1 mao2 qian2 hai2 mai3 niu2
cues.en: "Can a dime even buy a cow?"

cues.zh: 一毛钱可以买一只蜗牛
cues.pinyin: yi1 mao2 qian2 ke3 yi3 mai3 yi1 zhi1 wo1 niu2
cues.en: "With a dime you can buy a snail."

cues.zh: 错是九头牛
cues.pinyin: cuo4 shi4 jiu3 tou2 niu2
cues.en: "Wrong — it's nine cows."

cues.zh: 因为九牛一毛
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jiu3 niu2 yi4 mao2
cues.en: "Because of the saying 'nine cows, one hair' — a drop in the bucket."

cues.zh: 牙医对家长说
cues.pinyin: ya2 yi1 dui4 jia1 zhang3 shuo1
cues.en: The dentist said to the parent,

cues.zh: 拔牙费一共一千元
cues.pinyin: ba2 ya2 fei4 yi1 gong4 yi1 qian1 yuan2
cues.en: "The tooth extraction fee comes to a thousand dollars total."

cues.zh: 为什么那么贵啊
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 na4 me5 gui4 a5
cues.en: "Why is it so expensive?"

cues.zh: 你平常的拔牙费
cues.pinyin: ni3 ping2 chang2 de5 ba2 ya2 fei4
cues.en: "Isn't your usual extraction fee"

cues.zh: 不是每颗只收两百元吗
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 mei3 ke1 zhi3 shou1 liang3 bai3 yuan2 ma5
cues.en: "only two hundred per tooth?"

cues.zh: 因为你的孩子今天拔牙的时候
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 de5 hai2 zi5 jin1 tian1 ba2 ya2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "Because when your child got their tooth pulled today,"

cues.zh: 大哭大闹
cues.pinyin: da4 ku1 da4 nao4
cues.en: "they cried and threw such a huge tantrum"

cues.zh: 把我后诊间里的四个病患都吓跑了
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 hou4 zhen3 jian1 li3 de5 si4 ge4 bing4 huan4 dou1 xia4 pao3 le5
cues.en: "that they scared off the four other patients in my back room."

cues.zh: 嗨我是林佩华英文名字是 J asmine
cues.pinyin: hai1 wo3 shi4 lin2 pei4 hua2 ying1 wen2 ming2 zi4 shi4 J asmine
cues.en: Hi, I'm Lin Peihua, my English name is Jasmine.

cues.zh: 我今年 25 岁
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 nian2 25 sui4
cues.en: I'm 25 years old this year.

cues.zh: 我本身是就读
cues.pinyin: wo3 ben3 shen1 shi4 jiu4 du2
cues.en: I actually attend

cues.zh: 哥伦比亚大学
cues.pinyin: ge1 lun2 bi3 ya4 da4 xue2
cues.en: Columbia University.

cues.zh: 我很喜欢交朋友
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 xi3 huan1 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: I really like making friends.

cues.zh: 像我呢
cues.pinyin: xiang4 wo3 ne5
cues.en: As for me,

cues.zh: 从小在国外
cues.pinyin: cong2 xiao3 zai4 guo2 wai4
cues.en: I grew up abroad since I was little,

cues.zh: 吃好吃的食物
cues.pinyin: chi1 hao3 chi1 de5 shi2 wu4
cues.en: eating delicious food.

cues.zh: 那我今天想要介绍一下我与美食之间
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jin1 tian1 xiang3 yao4 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 wo3 yu3 mei3 shi2 zhi1 jian1
cues.en: So today I want to introduce the relationship between me

cues.zh: 的关系是什么
cues.pinyin: de5 guan1 xi4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: and food.

cues.zh: 这是各地的美食
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ge4 di4 de5 mei3 shi2
cues.en: This is cuisine from all over,

cues.zh: 卤肉饭呢
cues.pinyin: lu3 rou4 fan4 ne5
cues.en: braised pork rice,

cues.zh: 炒饭
cues.pinyin: chao3 fan4
cues.en: fried rice,

cues.zh: 只要好吃就好了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 hao3 chi1 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: as long as it's delicious, that's good enough.

cues.zh: 不怎么挑嘴
cues.pinyin: bu4 zen3 me5 tiao1 zui3
cues.en: I'm not that picky.

cues.zh: 所以这就是我对美食的定义
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 dui4 mei3 shi2 de5 ding4 yi4
cues.en: So this is my definition of good food.

cues.zh: 然后我衣服有一点紧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 yi1 fu2 you3 yi4 dian3 jin3
cues.en: Also, my clothes are a bit tight,

cues.zh: 但是我可以
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 ke3 yi3
cues.en: but I can manage.

cues.zh: 哇你的手超美的
cues.pinyin: wa5 ni3 de5 shou3 chao1 mei3 de5
cues.en: Wow, your hands are so beautiful.

cues.zh: 这么夸张
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 kua1 zhang1
cues.en: That's so exaggerated.

cues.zh: 很软
cues.pinyin: hen3 ruan3
cues.en: Very soft.

cues.zh: 我准备一个才艺叫吹口哨
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhun3 bei4 yi2 ge4 cai2 yi4 jiao4 chui1 kou3 shao4
cues.en: I've prepared a talent called whistling.

cues.zh: 让我吹一下
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 chui1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let me whistle for a bit.

cues.zh: 先认一下我嘴吹
cues.pinyin: xian1 ren4 yi1 xia4 wo3 zui3 chui1
cues.en: Let me test my mouth shape first.

cues.zh: 好笑
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiao4
cues.en: Funny.

cues.zh: 好我吹
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 chui1
cues.en: Okay, I'll whistle.

cues.zh: 吹五月天的恋爱爱恩超
cues.pinyin: chui1 wu3 yue4 tian1 de5 lian4 ai4 ai4 en1 chao1
cues.en: I'll whistle Mayday's "Love Is..."

cues.zh: 现场表演现场的感觉
cues.pinyin: xian4 chang3 biao3 yan3 xian4 chang3 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Live performance, live feeling.

cues.zh: 那你还有其他的才艺吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 hai2 you3 qi2 ta1 de5 cai2 yi4 ma5
cues.en: So do you have any other talents?

cues.zh: 我的舌头会卷三瓣这种算吗
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 she2 tou5 hui4 juan3 san1 ban4 zhe4 zhong3 suan4 ma5
cues.en: My tongue can curl into three sections, does that count?

cues.zh: 你好
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3
cues.en: Hello.

cues.zh: 我这边有一个排骨饭请你吃吃看
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 bian1 you3 yi2 ge4 pai2 gu3 fan4 qing3 ni3 chi1 chi1 kan4
cues.en: I have some pork chop rice here, please try it.

cues.zh: 好我做的
cues.pinyin: hao3 wo3 zuo4 de5
cues.en: Okay, I made it.

cues.zh: 你告诉我一下味道如何
cues.pinyin: ni3 gao4 su4 wo3 yi1 xia4 wei4 dao4 ru2 he2
cues.en: Tell me how the taste is.

cues.zh: 感觉那个肉味
cues.pinyin: gan3 jue2 na4 ge5 rou4 wei4
cues.en: It feels like there's a meaty flavor.

cues.zh: 非常好
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 hao3
cues.en: Very good.

cues.zh: 可是排骨有点老
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 pai2 gu3 you3 dian3 lao3
cues.en: But the pork chop is a bit tough.

cues.zh: 真的吗
cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 ma5
cues.en: Really?

cues.zh: 我用筷子吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 yong4 kuai4 zi5 ba5
cues.en: Let me use chopsticks.

cues.zh: 夹它
cues.pinyin: jia1 ta1
cues.en: Pick it up.

items.title_zh: 超多汁烤羊排的做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 今天给你带来的是烤羊排
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gei3 ni3 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 kao3 yang2 pai2
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you roast lamb chops.

cues.zh: 那首先在这里我们有一整架羊排
cues.pinyin: na4 shou3 xian1 zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 men5 you3 yi1 zheng3 jia4 yang2 pai2
cues.en: First, here we have a whole rack of lamb.

cues.zh: 我们稍微给它腌一下用 6 汤匙的酱油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shao1 wei1 gei3 ta1 yan1 yi1 xia4 yong4 6 tang1 chi2 de5 jiang4 you2
cues.en: Let's marinate it a bit with 6 tablespoons of soy sauce.

cues.zh: 4 汤匙烧心酒
cues.pinyin: 4 tang1 chi2 shao1 xin1 jiu3
cues.en: 4 tablespoons of cooking wine.

cues.zh: 半茶匙盐半茶匙胡椒粉两茶匙孜然粉
cues.pinyin: ban4 cha2 chi2 yan2 ban4 cha2 chi2 hu2 jiao1 fen3 liang3 cha2 chi2 zi1 ran2 fen3
cues.en: Half a teaspoon of salt, half a teaspoon of pepper, and two teaspoons of cumin powder.

cues.zh: 在锅子里我们加入 3 汤匙油
cues.pinyin: zai4 guo1 zi5 li3 wo3 men5 jia1 ru4 3 tang1 chi2 you2
cues.en: In the pan, we add 3 tablespoons of oil.

cues.zh: 然后把这个腌好的羊肉呢放到锅中
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yan1 hao3 de5 yang2 rou4 ne5 fang4 dao4 guo1 zhong1
cues.en: Then put the marinated lamb into the pan.

cues.zh: 给它一直煎到有一种很漂亮的香味
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 yi4 zhi2 jian1 dao4 you3 yi1 zhong3 hen3 piao4 liang4 de5 xiang1 wei4
cues.en: Sear it until it has a lovely fragrant smell.

cues.zh: 每边要煎大概两分钟
cues.pinyin: mei3 bian1 yao4 jian1 da4 gai4 liang3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Sear each side for about two minutes.

cues.zh: 现在我们用铝箔纸把骨头的这个地方包住
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 yong4 lv3 bo2 zhi3 ba3 gu3 tou5 de5 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 bao1 zhu4
cues.en: Now we wrap the bone part with aluminum foil.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超多汁烤羊排的做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 以防止烤的时候过黑
cues.pinyin: yi3 fang2 zhi3 kao3 de5 shi2 hou4 guo4 hei1
cues.en: To prevent it from burning while roasting.

cues.zh: 我们把整个烤盘放入已预热的烤箱中
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zheng3 ge4 kao3 pan2 fang4 ru4 yi3 yu4 re4 de5 kao3 xiang1 zhong1
cues.en: We put the whole tray into the preheated oven.

cues.zh: 温度大概是 4 20 华氏度或者是 21 5 摄氏度
cues.pinyin: wen1 du4 da4 gai4 shi4 4 20 hua2 shi4 du4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 21 5 she4 shi4 du4
cues.en: The temperature is about 420°F, or 215°C.

cues.zh: 我们给它烤十分钟
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 kao3 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: We roast it for ten minutes.

cues.zh: 在这里我们有一杯面包屑和一把香菜
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 men5 you3 yi1 bei1 mian4 bao1 xie4 he2 yi1 ba3 xiang1 cai4
cues.en: Here we have a cup of breadcrumbs and a handful of cilantro.

cues.zh: 我们再加进来少许的盐和一点油
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 jia1 jin4 lai2 shao3 xu3 de5 yan2 he2 yi4 dian3 you2
cues.en: We add in a little salt and a bit of oil.

cues.zh: 我们把它放入一个食物搅拌器
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ta1 fang4 ru4 yi2 ge4 shi2 wu4 jiao3 ban4 qi4
cues.en: We put it into a food processor.

cues.zh: 或者是一个果汁搅拌机也可以
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shi4 yi2 ge4 guo3 zhi1 jiao3 ban4 ji1 ye3 ke3 yi3
cues.en: Or a juice blender works too.

cues.zh: 这个时候呢我们就给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 jiu4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: At this point, we blend it evenly.

cues.zh: 然后它会变成漂亮的绿色
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 piao4 liang4 de5 lv4 se4
cues.en: Then it turns a lovely green color.

cues.zh: 我们取出羊排之后呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 qu3 chu1 yang2 pai2 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: After we take out the lamb chops,

cues.zh: 这边我有一些 D ij on 芥末
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 wo3 you3 yi1 xie1 D ij on jie4 mo4
cues.en: I have some Dijon mustard here.

cues.zh: 然后我要涂两汤匙在羊排上面
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 yao4 tu2 liang3 tang1 chi2 zai4 yang2 pai2 shang4 mian4
cues.en: Then I'll spread two tablespoons on the lamb chops.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 超多汁烤羊排的做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 把涂了 D ij on 芥末的那个面呢
cues.pinyin: ba3 tu2 le5 D ij on jie4 mo4 de5 na4 ge5 mian4 ne5
cues.en: Take the side coated with Dijon mustard,

cues.zh: 放到面包屑上面
cues.pinyin: fang4 dao4 mian4 bao1 xie4 shang4 mian4
cues.en: and place it onto the breadcrumbs.

cues.zh: 然后我们在另外一边呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 zai4 ling4 wai4 yi1 bian1 ne5
cues.en: Then on the other side,

cues.pinyin: zai4 tu2 shang4 liang3 tang1 chi2 de5 D ij on jie4 mo4
cues.en: we spread another two tablespoons of Dijon mustard.

cues.zh: 然后也是一样把这个面包屑呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 mian4 bao1 xie4 ne5
cues.en: Then likewise, take this breadcrumb mixture

cues.zh: 覆盖在羊排上
cues.pinyin: fu4 gai4 zai4 yang2 pai2 shang4
cues.en: and cover it over the lamb chops.

cues.zh: 把羊排放回烤盘
cues.pinyin: ba3 yang2 pai2 fang4 hui2 kao3 pan2
cues.en: Put the lamb chops back on the tray.

cues.zh: 再烤十分钟
cues.pinyin: zai4 kao3 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: Roast for another ten minutes.

cues.zh: 那如果你想要吃三成熟的话呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 yao4 chi1 san1 cheng2 shu2 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If you want it rare,

cues.zh: 烤十分钟就够了
cues.pinyin: kao3 shi2 fen1 zhong1 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: ten minutes of roasting is enough.

cues.zh: 然后如果你拿一个温度计放在这
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ru2 guo3 ni3 na2 yi2 ge4 wen1 du4 ji4 fang4 zai4 zhe4
cues.en: Then if you put a thermometer right here,

cues.zh: 个肉的中间呢
cues.pinyin: ge4 rou4 de5 zhong1 jian1 ne5
cues.en: in the middle of the meat,

cues.zh: 它会显示 125 华氏度
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 xian3 shi4 125 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: it will read 125°F.

cues.zh: 如果你喜欢吃五成熟呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xi3 huan1 chi1 wu3 cheng2 shu2 ne5
cues.en: If you like it medium,

cues.zh: 你就放在烤炉里面多烤个几分钟
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 fang4 zai4 kao3 lu2 li3 mian4 duo1 kao3 ge4 ji3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: just leave it in the oven a few more minutes.

cues.zh: 那温度计呢会显示 13 5 华氏度
cues.pinyin: na4 wen1 du4 ji4 ne5 hui4 xian3 shi4 13 5 hua2 shi4 du4
cues.en: The thermometer will read 135°F.

cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 she4 jiao1 jie2 shu4 zheng4 yao4 kai1 che1 li2 kai1
cues.en: After finishing socializing, Xiao Ao was about to drive off

cues.zh: 就被一个黑妹叫住了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 yi2 ge4 hei1 mei4 jiao4 zhu4 le5
cues.en: when a Black woman called out to stop him.

cues.zh: 黑妹是夏洛特女士家的保姆
cues.pinyin: hei1 mei4 shi4 xia4 luo4 te4 nv3 shi4 jia1 de5 bao3 mu3
cues.en: She was Ms. Charlotte's nanny.

cues.zh: 夏洛特的孩子跟小奥的孩子是同班同学
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 te4 de5 hai2 zi5 gen1 xiao3 ao4 de5 hai2 zi5 shi4 tong2 ban1 tong2 xue2
cues.en: Charlotte's child was in the same class as Xiao Ao's.

cues.zh: 所以小奥也在接送孩子的时候见过黑妹
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 ao4 ye3 zai4 jie1 song4 hai2 zi5 de5 shi2 hou4 jian4 guo4 hei1 mei4
cues.en: So Xiao Ao had seen her before while picking up his kid.

cues.zh: 黑妹知道小奥是律师
cues.pinyin: hei1 mei4 zhi1 dao4 xiao3 ao4 shi4 lv4 shi1
cues.en: She knew Xiao Ao was a lawyer,

cues.zh: 所以才特意来向她求助
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 cai2 te4 yi4 lai2 xiang4 ta1 qiu2 zhu4
cues.en: so she came specifically to ask him for help.

cues.zh: 她说夏洛特太太要以莫须有的罪名解雇她
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 xia4 luo4 te4 tai4 tai4 yao4 yi3 mo4 xu1 you3 de5 zui4 ming2 jie3 gu4 ta1
cues.en: She said Mrs. Charlotte was trying to fire her on trumped-up charges.

cues.zh: 小奥不想让那些妈妈们看到他们在说话
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 bu4 xiang3 rang4 na4 xie1 ma1 ma1 men5 kan4 dao4 ta1 men5 zai4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: Xiao Ao didn't want the other moms to see them talking,

cues.zh: 便决定带住黑妹回汇率所详谈
cues.pinyin: bian4 jue2 ding4 dai4 zhu4 hei1 mei4 hui2 hui4 lv4 suo3 xiang2 tan2
cues.en: so he decided to take her back to the firm to discuss it in detail.

cues.zh: 原来黑妹每周二都带着夏洛特的
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 hei1 mei4 mei3 zhou1 er4 dou1 dai4 zhe5 xia4 luo4 te4 de5
cues.en: It turned out that every Tuesday, she took Charlotte's

cues.zh: 孩子去公园玩
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 qu4 gong1 yuan2 wan2
cues.en: child to the park to play.

cues.zh: 可是被神秘人偷拍了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 bei4 shen2 mi4 ren2 tou1 pai1 le5
cues.en: But a mysterious person secretly photographed them.

cues.zh: 神秘人将照片发到网上
cues.pinyin: shen2 mi4 ren2 jiang1 zhao4 pian1 fa1 dao4 wang3 shang4
cues.en: That person posted the photos online,

cues.zh: 大肆宣扬保姆虐童
cues.pinyin: da4 si4 xuan1 yang2 bao3 mu3 nve4 tong2
cues.en: loudly claiming the nanny was abusing the child.

cues.zh: 那两张照片
cues.pinyin: na4 liang3 zhang1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: Those two photos—

items.title_zh: 75岁老奶奶勇当间谍！女儿死亡的真相即将揭晓！爆火美剧《老练律师》第八集

cues.zh: 打定主意后
cues.pinyin: da3 ding4 zhu3 yi4 hou4
cues.en: Once he'd made up his mind,

cues.zh: 小奥叫上马蒂一起
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 jiao4 shang4 ma3 di4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: Xiao Ao brought Marty along

cues.zh: 去找朱丽安商量
cues.pinyin: qu4 zhao3 zhu1 li4 an1 shang1 liang2
cues.en: to discuss it with Julianne.

cues.zh: 朱丽安提醒小奥要注意影响
cues.pinyin: zhu1 li4 an1 ti2 xing3 xiao3 ao4 yao4 zhu4 yi4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: Julianne warned Xiao Ao to think about the consequences.

cues.zh: 他们儿子那个学校的家长可都是厉害人物
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 er2 zi5 na4 ge5 xue2 xiao4 de5 jia1 zhang3 ke3 dou1 shi4 li4 hai4 ren2 wu4
cues.en: The parents at their son's school were all powerful people.

cues.zh: 一旦知道你帮保姆打官司
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 zhi1 dao4 ni3 bang1 bao3 mu3 da3 guan1 si1
cues.en: If they found out he was helping the nanny sue,

cues.zh: 你不怕咱孩子在学校被霸凌啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 pa4 zan2 hai2 zi5 zai4 xue2 xiao4 bei4 ba4 ling2 a5
cues.en: wouldn't he worry about their son getting bullied at school?

cues.zh: 小奥表示这些他都想到了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 biao3 shi4 zhe4 xie1 ta1 dou1 xiang3 dao4 le5
cues.en: Xiao Ao said he'd already thought of all that.

cues.zh: 所以这次他会让马蒂独自出庭应对
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ci4 ta1 hui4 rang4 ma3 di4 du2 zi4 chu1 ting2 ying4 dui4
cues.en: So this time he'd let Marty handle the court appearance alone,

cues.zh: 自己躲在幕后指挥就行了
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 duo3 zai4 mu4 hou4 zhi3 hui1 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: while he directed things from behind the scenes.

cues.zh: 马蒂一脸懵逼
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 yi1 lian3 meng3 bi1
cues.en: Marty looked utterly stunned.

cues.zh: 这事你经过我同意了吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ni3 jing1 guo4 wo3 tong2 yi4 le5 ma5
cues.en: "Did you even ask my permission for this?"

cues.zh: 他可有二十多年没独自上庭打官司了
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 you3 er4 shi2 duo1 nian2 mei2 du2 zi4 shang4 ting2 da3 guan1 si1 le5
cues.en: She hadn't argued a case alone in court for over twenty years.

cues.zh: 早就生疏了
cues.pinyin: zao3 jiu4 sheng1 shu1 le5
cues.en: She was way out of practice.

cues.zh: 小奥真的要让他独立辩护吗
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 zhen1 de5 yao4 rang4 ta1 du2 li4 bian4 hu4 ma5
cues.en: Was Xiao Ao really going to make her argue the case alone?

cues.zh: 小奥鼓励马蒂
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 gu3 li4 ma3 di4
cues.en: Xiao Ao encouraged Marty,

cues.zh: 相信自己
cues.pinyin: xiang1 xin4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: "Believe in yourself.

cues.zh: 你是最棒的
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 zui4 bang4 de5
cues.en: You're the best."

cues.zh: 可马蒂还是担忧
cues.pinyin: ke3 ma3 di4 hai2 shi4 dan1 you1
cues.en: But Marty was still worried.

cues.zh: 如果诉求是要求网站删除那些照片
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 su4 qiu2 shi4 yao1 qiu2 wang3 zhan4 shan1 chu2 na4 xie1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: If the claim was to demand the website remove those photos,

cues.zh: 就意味着限制言论自由
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yi4 wei4 zhe5 xian4 zhi4 yan2 lun4 zi4 you2
cues.en: that would mean restricting freedom of speech,

cues.zh: 法官不会同意的
cues.pinyin: fa3 guan1 bu2 hui4 tong2 yi4 de5
cues.en: and the judge wouldn't agree to that.

cues.zh: 小奥给马蒂提示
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 gei3 ma3 di4 ti2 shi4
cues.en: Xiao Ao gave Marty a hint.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老奶奶勇当间谍！女儿死亡的真相即将揭晓！爆火美剧《老练律师》第八集

cues.zh: 为了证明此事是有先例的
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 zheng4 ming2 ci3 shi4 shi4 you3 xian1 li4 de5
cues.en: To prove there was precedent for this,

cues.zh: 马蒂特意隐晦地提了一句
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 te4 yi4 yin3 hui4 di4 ti2 le5 yi1 ju4
cues.en: Marty deliberately made a subtle remark

cues.zh: 法官的侄子曾经因为在公共场合醉酒被拍
cues.pinyin: fa3 guan1 de5 zhi2 zi5 ceng2 jing1 yin1 wei4 zai4 gong1 gong4 chang3 he2 zui4 jiu3 bei4 pai1
cues.en: that the judge's nephew had once been photographed drunk in public,

cues.zh: 法官就亲自找人将这照片撤下来的事情
cues.pinyin: fa3 guan1 jiu4 qin1 zi4 zhao3 ren2 jiang1 zhe4 zhao4 pian1 che4 xia4 lai2 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: and the judge had personally had someone take the photo down.

cues.zh: 这足以说明只要照片对当事人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zu2 yi3 shuo1 ming2 zhi3 yao4 zhao4 pian1 dui4 dang1 shi4 ren2
cues.en: This was enough to show that as long as a photo causes

cues.zh: 的伤害足够大
cues.pinyin: de5 shang1 hai4 zu2 gou4 da4
cues.en: enough harm to the person involved,

cues.zh: 照片还是可以被撤下的
cues.pinyin: zhao4 pian1 hai2 shi4 ke3 yi3 bei4 che4 xia4 de5
cues.en: it could still be taken down.

cues.zh: 尽管马蒂说的充满真情识感
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 ma3 di4 shuo1 de5 chong1 man3 zhen1 qing2 shi2 gan3
cues.en: Although Marty spoke with genuine sincerity,

cues.zh: 可法官却不为所动
cues.pinyin: ke3 fa3 guan1 que4 bu4 wei4 suo3 dong4
cues.en: the judge remained unmoved.

cues.zh: 因为美国宪法第一修正案的主要
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei3 guo2 xian4 fa3 di4 yi1 xiu1 zheng4 an4 de5 zhu3 yao4
cues.en: Because the main point of the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution

cues.zh: 内容就是禁止
cues.pinyin: nei4 rong2 jiu4 shi4 jin4 zhi3
cues.en: is to prohibit

cues.zh: 限制言论自由
cues.pinyin: xian4 zhi4 yan2 lun4 zi4 you2
cues.en: restricting freedom of speech.

cues.zh: 而这个法官是第一修正案的忠实拥护者
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 fa3 guan1 shi4 di4 yi1 xiu1 zheng4 an4 de5 zhong1 shi2 yong1 hu4 zhe3
cues.en: And this judge was a staunch defender of the First Amendment,

cues.zh: 自然不会听信马蒂的辩词
cues.pinyin: zi4 ran2 bu2 hui4 ting1 xin4 ma3 di4 de5 bian4 ci2
cues.en: so naturally he wasn't persuaded by Marty's argument

cues.zh: 要求网站删掉那些照片
cues.pinyin: yao1 qiu2 wang3 zhan4 shan1 diao4 na4 xie1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: to have the website remove the photos.

cues.zh: 他当庭驳回了马蒂的申请
cues.pinyin: ta1 dang1 ting2 bo2 hui2 le5 ma3 di4 de5 shen1 qing3
cues.en: He rejected Marty's motion right there in court.

cues.zh: 而且法官说自己侄子的案子
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 fa3 guan1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 zhi2 zi5 de5 an4 zi5
cues.en: Moreover, the judge said that very few people

cues.zh: 知道者寥寥无几
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 zhe3 liao2 liao2 wu2 ji3
cues.en: even knew about his nephew's case,

cues.zh: 所以他已经知道了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 yi3 jing1 zhi1 dao4 le5
cues.en: so he already knew

cues.zh: 马蒂背后的人就是小奥
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 bei4 hou4 de5 ren2 jiu4 shi4 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: that the person behind Marty was Xiao Ao.

cues.zh: 这场官司马蒂是陪了夫人又折兵
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chang3 guan1 si1 ma3 di4 shi4 pei2 le5 fu1 ren2 you4 zhe2 bing1
cues.en: In this case, Marty lost on all fronts.

cues.zh: 不但没撤掉照片
cues.pinyin: bu4 dan4 mei2 che4 diao4 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: Not only did she fail to get the photos removed,

cues.zh: 还暴露了小奥
cues.pinyin: hai2 bao4 lu4 le5 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: she also exposed Xiao Ao.

cues.zh: 果然小奥在去学校的时候
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 xiao3 ao4 zai4 qu4 xue2 xiao4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Sure enough, when Xiao Ao went to the school,

cues.zh: 就被家长们围攻了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 jia1 zhang3 men5 wei2 gong1 le5
cues.en: he was surrounded and confronted by the parents.

items.title_zh: 75岁老奶奶勇当间谍！女儿死亡的真相即将揭晓！爆火美剧《老练律师》第八集

cues.zh: 几个妈妈心事动众地声讨小奥
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 ma1 ma1 xin1 shi4 dong4 zhong4 di4 sheng1 tao3 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: Several moms made a big scene denouncing Xiao Ao.

cues.zh: 小奥一开始还解释说那些照片断章取义
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 yi1 kai1 shi3 hai2 jie3 shi4 shuo1 na4 xie1 zhao4 pian1 duan4 zhang1 qu3 yi4
cues.en: At first Xiao Ao tried to explain that the photos were taken out of context,

cues.zh: 只是一味地指责小奥
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yi1 wei4 di4 zhi3 ze2 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: but the moms wouldn't listen at all.

cues.zh: 只是因为指责小奥
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 yin1 wei4 zhi3 ze2 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: They just kept blaming Xiao Ao.

cues.zh: 小奥的脾气也上来了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 de5 pi2 qi4 ye3 shang4 lai2 le5
cues.en: Xiao Ao's temper flared up too.

cues.zh: 转身就走
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 shen1 jiu4 zou3
cues.en: He turned and walked away.

cues.zh: 这个案子他管定了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 an4 zi5 ta1 guan3 ding4 le5
cues.en: He was determined to see this case through.

cues.zh: 一定要胜诉
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 yao4 sheng4 su4
cues.en: He was going to win it, no matter what.

cues.zh: 如果网站不可能撤掉照片
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wang3 zhan4 bu4 ke3 neng2 che4 diao4 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: If the website wouldn't take the photos down,

cues.zh: 那他们就去找照片拍摄者和发帖子的人
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 men5 jiu4 qu4 zhao3 zhao4 pian1 pai1 she4 zhe3 he2 fa1 tie1 zi5 de5 ren2
cues.en: then they'd go after the photographer and the person who posted them,

cues.zh: 起诉他们诽谤
cues.pinyin: qi3 su4 ta1 men5 fei3 bang4
cues.en: and sue them for defamation,

cues.zh: 逼他们删帖子删照片
cues.pinyin: bi1 ta1 men5 shan1 tie3 zi5 shan1 zhao4 pian1
cues.en: forcing them to delete the posts and photos.

cues.zh: 马蒂知道这案子短时间内无法搞定
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 an4 zi5 duan3 shi2 jian1 nei4 wu2 fa3 gao3 ding4
cues.en: Marty knew this case couldn't be settled quickly,

cues.zh: 就借口说自己要去看医生
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jie4 kou3 shuo1 zi4 ji3 yao4 qu4 kan4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: so she made the excuse that she needed to see a doctor,

cues.zh: 先请假医会
cues.pinyin: xian1 qing3 jia4 yi1 hui4
cues.en: and took time off first.

cues.zh: 小奥欣然准许
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 xin1 ran2 zhun3 xu3
cues.en: Xiao Ao readily agreed.

cues.zh: 马蒂才不是想看孩医生呢
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 cai2 bu2 shi4 xiang3 kan4 hai2 yi1 sheng1 ne5
cues.en: But Marty had no intention of seeing any doctor.

cues.zh: 他是去老猪的办公室偷取资料
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 qu4 lao3 zhu1 de5 ban4 gong1 shi4 tou1 qu3 zi1 liao4
cues.en: She was going to Old Zhu's office to steal documents.

cues.zh: 万幸斯图尔特不在
cues.pinyin: wan4 xing4 si1 tu2 er3 te4 bu4 zai4
cues.en: Luckily, Stewart wasn't there.

cues.zh: 估计是下班了
cues.pinyin: gu1 ji4 shi4 xia4 ban1 le5
cues.en: He'd probably gone home for the day.

cues.zh: 马蒂就按照之前自己偷到的密码
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 jiu4 an4 zhao4 zhi1 qian2 zi4 ji3 tou1 dao4 de5 mi4 ma3
cues.en: Marty used the password she had stolen earlier

cues.zh: 打开了老猪的电脑
cues.pinyin: da3 kai1 le5 lao3 zhu1 de5 dian4 nao3
cues.en: to open Old Zhu's computer.

cues.zh: 找到了自己需要的附件
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3 xu1 yao4 de5 fu4 jian4
cues.en: She found the attachment she needed.

cues.zh: 他打算将文件打印出来
cues.pinyin: ta1 da3 suan4 jiang1 wen2 jian4 da3 yin4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: She planned to print the document out

cues.zh: 自己回家仔细看
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 hui2 jia1 zi3 xi4 kan4
cues.en: and read it carefully at home.

cues.zh: 却不料老猪的电脑连接的 1 15 号打
cues.pinyin: que4 bu4 liao4 lao3 zhu1 de5 dian4 nao3 lian2 jie1 de5 1 15 hao4 da3
cues.en: But unexpectedly, the printer linked to Old Zhu's computer, No. 115,

cues.zh: 印机位置很远
cues.pinyin: yin4 ji1 wei4 zhi4 hen3 yuan3
cues.en: was located far away.

cues.zh: 马蒂也不知道哪台才是 1 15 号
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 ye3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 na3 tai2 cai2 shi4 1 15 hao4
cues.en: Marty didn't even know which one was No. 115.

cues.zh: 而就在这时
cues.pinyin: er2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: And just at that moment,

items.title_zh: 75岁老奶奶勇当间谍！女儿死亡的真相即将揭晓！爆火美剧《老练律师》第八集

cues.zh: 马蒂的那个文件正摆在小奥秘书的桌上
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 de5 na4 ge5 wen2 jian4 zheng4 bai3 zai4 xiao3 ao4 mi4 shu1 de5 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: Marty's document ended up sitting on Xiao Ao's secretary's desk.

cues.zh: 马蒂只好坐在一边想办法
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 zhi3 hao3 zuo4 zai4 yi1 bian1 xiang3 ban4 fa3
cues.en: Marty had no choice but to sit aside and think of a way.

cues.zh: 另一边朱利安找到小奥
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1 zhu1 li4 an1 zhao3 dao4 xiao3 ao4
cues.en: Meanwhile, Julianne went to find Xiao Ao,

cues.zh: 希望他别管这个案子了
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 ta1 bie2 guan3 zhe4 ge5 an4 zi5 le5
cues.en: hoping he'd drop the case,

cues.zh: 否则他们的孩子在学校会被欺负
cues.pinyin: fou3 ze2 ta1 men5 de5 hai2 zi5 zai4 xue2 xiao4 hui4 bei4 qi1 fu4
cues.en: or their son would get bullied at school,

cues.zh: 自己去接孩子也会遭白眼的
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 qu4 jie1 hai2 zi5 ye3 hui4 zao1 bai2 yan3 de5
cues.en: and she herself would get cold-shouldered when picking him up,

cues.zh: 因为那群家长根本不分青红皂白
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 na4 qun2 jia1 zhang3 gen1 ben3 bu4 fen1 qing1 hong2 zao4 bai2
cues.en: because that group of parents didn't care about reason at all—

cues.zh: 你没法跟他们讲道理的
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 fa3 gen1 ta1 men5 jiang3 dao4 li3 de5
cues.en: there was no reasoning with them.

cues.zh: 可小奥铁了心要管到底
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 ao4 tie3 le5 xin1 yao4 guan3 dao4 di3
cues.en: But Xiao Ao was dead set on seeing it through.

cues.zh: 他让助理通过黑客
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 zhu4 li3 tong1 guo4 hei1 ke4
cues.en: He had his assistant use a hacker

cues.zh: 查到了那些照片是从某个邮箱发给
cues.pinyin: cha2 dao4 le5 na4 xie1 zhao4 pian1 shi4 cong2 mou3 ge4 you2 xiang1 fa1 gei3
cues.en: to trace that the photos had been sent from a certain email account

cues.zh: 夏洛特太太的
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 te4 tai4 tai4 de5
cues.en: to Mrs. Charlotte.

cues.zh: 而这个邮箱的主人名叫莉莉
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 ge5 you2 xiang1 de5 zhu3 ren2 ming2 jiao4 li4 li4
cues.en: The owner of that email account was named Lily.

cues.zh: 她的孩子也跟夏洛特的孩子同个班级
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 hai2 zi5 ye3 gen1 xia4 luo4 te4 de5 hai2 zi5 tong2 ge4 ban1 ji2
cues.en: Her child was also in the same class as Charlotte's child.

cues.zh: 莉莉甚至跟夏洛特太太关系很好
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 shen4 zhi4 gen1 xia4 luo4 te4 tai4 tai4 guan1 xi4 hen3 hao3
cues.en: Lily was even on good terms with Mrs. Charlotte.

cues.zh: 既然这样她为什么不亲自把照片给
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 zhe4 yang4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 bu4 qin1 zi4 ba3 zhao4 pian1 gei3
cues.en: So if that was the case, why didn't she just show the photos to

cues.zh: 夏洛特太太看
cues.pinyin: xia4 luo4 te4 tai4 tai4 kan4
cues.en: Mrs. Charlotte herself,

cues.zh: 反而要发什么匿名邮件呢
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 yao4 fa1 shen2 me5 ni4 ming2 you2 jian4 ne5
cues.en: instead of sending some anonymous email?

cues.zh: 小奥找来莉莉询问
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ao4 zhao3 lai2 li4 li4 xun2 wen4
cues.en: Xiao Ao brought Lily in to question her,

cues.zh: 而莉莉也是有律师的人
cues.pinyin: er2 li4 li4 ye3 shi4 you3 lv4 shi1 de5 ren2
cues.en: but Lily also had a lawyer,

cues.zh: 全程只字不言
cues.pinyin: quan2 cheng2 zhi1 zi4 bu4 yan2
cues.en: who said not a single word the whole time,

cues.zh: 就让小奥跟自己的律师聊
cues.pinyin: jiu4 rang4 xiao3 ao4 gen1 zi4 ji3 de5 lv4 shi1 liao2
cues.en: and just told Xiao Ao to talk to her lawyer instead.

cues.zh: 可是那律师实在太不专业
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 na4 lv4 shi1 shi2 zai4 tai4 bu4 zhuan1 ye4
cues.en: But that lawyer was just too unprofessional—

cues.zh: 一边看孩子一边回答小奥的话
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 kan4 hai2 zi5 yi1 bian1 hui2 da2 xiao3 ao4 de5 hua4
cues.en: answering Xiao Ao's questions while also watching the kids.

cues.zh: 莉莉急得没办法
cues.pinyin: li4 li4 ji2 de2 mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: Lily was so anxious she didn't know what to do.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话21｜珊珊还没变回人形😂😂｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜

cues.zh: 嗨我是大大我是小小我们今天要聊什么呢
cues.pinyin: hai1 wo3 shi4 da4 da4 wo3 shi4 xiao3 xiao3 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Hi, I'm Dada, I'm Xiaoxiao, what are we going to talk about today?

cues.zh: 我们今天要聊笑话
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 xiao4 hua4
cues.en: Today we're going to talk about jokes.

cues.zh: 珊珊如果有四只猪掉下水里
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 ru2 guo3 you3 si4 zhi3 zhu1 diao4 xia4 shui3 li3
cues.en: Shanshan, if four pigs fell into the water,

cues.zh: 你会去救还是不救我会去救
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 qu4 jiu4 hai2 shi4 bu4 jiu4 wo3 hui4 qu4 jiu4
cues.en: would you save them or not? I would save them.

cues.zh: 那你救四只猪那我不救呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 si4 zhi3 zhu1 na4 wo3 bu4 jiu4 ne5
cues.en: So you'd save the four pigs, but not me?

cues.zh: 那你不救四只猪那还不是一样
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 bu4 jiu4 si4 zhi3 zhu1 na4 hai2 bu2 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: So if you didn't save the four pigs, wouldn't it be the same anyway?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话21｜珊珊还没变回人形😂😂｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜

cues.zh: 嘻嘻嘻
cues.pinyin: xi1 xi1 xi1
cues.en: Hehehe

cues.zh: 想当年我朋友在外面
cues.pinyin: xiang3 dang1 nian2 wo3 peng2 you3 zai4 wai4 mian4
cues.en: Back in the day, my friend was out somewhere

cues.zh: 被十个人围殴
cues.pinyin: bei4 shi2 ge4 ren2 wei2 ou1
cues.en: and got surrounded and beaten up by ten people.

cues.zh: 我冲过去立刻解决一半的人
cues.pinyin: wo3 chong1 guo4 qu4 li4 ke4 jie3 jue2 yi2 ban4 de5 ren2
cues.en: I rushed over and immediately took care of half of them.

cues.zh: 哇你怎么那么厉害啊
cues.pinyin: wa5 ni3 zen3 me5 na4 me5 li4 hai4 a5
cues.en: Wow, how are you so tough?

cues.zh: 当时有五个人打他
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 you3 wu3 ge4 ren2 da3 ta1
cues.en: At the time there were five people beating him.

cues.zh: 五个人打我
cues.pinyin: wu3 ge4 ren2 da3 wo3
cues.en: Five people were beating me.

cues.zh: 我问你喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 自己的血
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 de5 xue4
cues.en: One's own blood.

cues.zh: 你知道那是什么吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 na4 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: Do you know what that is?

cues.zh: 怎么会有这么恐怖的啊
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 you3 zhe4 me5 kong3 bu4 de5 a5
cues.en: How could something so terrifying exist?

cues.zh: 你杀他还留自己的血
cues.pinyin: ni3 sha1 ta1 hai2 liu2 zi4 ji3 de5 xue4
cues.en: You kill it, and your own blood comes out?

cues.zh: 不知道耶
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi1 dao4 ye2
cues.en: I don't know.

cues.zh: 没有
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3
cues.en: No.

cues.zh: 答案就是蚊子
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 jiu4 shi4 wen2 zi5
cues.en: The answer is: a mosquito.

cues.zh: 你的血就会流出来了
cues.pinyin: ni3 de5 xue4 jiu4 hui4 liu2 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: Your blood will come flowing out.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话21｜珊珊还没变回人形😂😂｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜

cues.zh: 我今天在外面捡到五元
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 tian1 zai4 wai4 mian4 jian3 dao4 wu3 yuan2
cues.en: Today I found five dollars outside.

cues.zh: 不过我还给了掉钱的那个人
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 wo3 huan2 gei3 le5 diao4 qian2 de5 na4 ge5 ren2
cues.en: But I gave it back to the person who dropped it.

cues.zh: 你做得很好
cues.pinyin: ni3 zuo4 de2 hen3 hao3
cues.en: You did a great job.

cues.zh: 那个人有没有跟你说谢谢啊
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 ren2 you3 mei2 you3 gen1 ni3 shuo1 xie4 xie4 a5
cues.en: Did that person say thank you to you?

cues.zh: 没有啦
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 la5
cues.en: No, not really.

cues.zh: 他拿着我的耳朵
cues.pinyin: ta1 na2 zhe5 wo3 de5 er3 duo3
cues.en: He grabbed me by the ear,

cues.zh: 我才把钱还他的
cues.pinyin: wo3 cai2 ba3 qian2 hai2 ta1 de5
cues.en: and that's when I gave the money back to him.

cues.zh: 他怎么可能跟我说谢谢
cues.pinyin: ta1 zen3 me5 ke3 neng2 gen1 wo3 shuo1 xie4 xie4
cues.en: There's no way he'd say thank you to me.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话21｜珊珊还没变回人形😂😂｜9个幽默爆笑笑话｜

cues.zh: 小明妈妈教你挑西瓜
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ma1 ma1 jiao4 ni3 tiao1 xi1 gua1
cues.en: Xiaoming's mom teaches you how to pick watermelons.

cues.zh: 一定要挑躺著的
cues.pinyin: yi2 ding4 yao4 tiao1 tang3 zhu4 de5
cues.en: You must pick the ones lying down.

cues.zh: 不可以挑站著的
cues.pinyin: bu4 ke3 yi3 tiao1 zhan4 zhu4 de5
cues.en: You can't pick the ones standing up.

cues.zh: 为什么还不是都一样
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hai2 bu2 shi4 dou1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Why? Aren't they all the same anyway?

cues.zh: 长孩子这种站了一整天的一定很酸了
cues.pinyin: zhang3 hai2 zi5 zhe4 zhong3 zhan4 le5 yi1 zheng3 tian1 de5 yi2 ding4 hen3 suan1 le5
cues.en: Ones that have been standing all day for sure got sore.

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: Shanshan, let me ask you something.

cues.zh: 把 24 个人按 5 个人排列
cues.pinyin: ba3 24 ge4 ren2 an4 5 ge4 ren2 pai2 lie4
cues.en: Arrange 24 people, 5 people each,

cues.zh: 排成 6 行请问要怎么排
cues.pinyin: pai2 cheng2 6 xing2 qing3 wen4 yao4 zen3 me5 pai2
cues.en: into 6 rows — how would you arrange them?

cues.zh: 没有让人生宝宝的错
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 rang4 ren2 sheng1 bao3 bao3 de5 cuo4
cues.en: There's no fault in people having babies.

cues.zh: 你们知道答案吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 ma5
cues.en: Do you all know the answer?

cues.zh: 欢迎在下方留言告诉大家哦
cues.pinyin: huan1 ying2 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 gao4 su4 da4 jia1 o2
cues.en: Feel free to leave a comment below and tell everyone!

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 锅包肉的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 哈喽你好我是 C iss i
cues.pinyin: ha1 lou2 ni3 hao3 wo3 shi4 C iss i
cues.en: Hello, I'm Cici.

cues.zh: 今天给你带来的是锅包肉
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 gei3 ni3 dai4 lai2 de5 shi4 guo1 bao1 rou4
cues.en: Today I'm bringing you guobaorou (pot-wrapped pork).

cues.zh: 锅包肉是东北的一道名菜
cues.pinyin: guo1 bao1 rou4 shi4 dong1 bei3 de5 yi1 dao4 ming2 cai4
cues.en: Guobaorou is a famous dish from Northeast China.

cues.zh: 我们赶快看一看在家里可以如何做
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 gan3 kuai4 kan4 yi1 kan4 zai4 jia1 li3 ke3 yi3 ru2 he2 zuo4
cues.en: Let's quickly see how to make it at home.

cues.zh: 我这里有一磅的猪通脊肉
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 li3 you3 yi1 bang4 de5 zhu1 tong1 ji2 rou4
cues.en: I have one pound of pork loin here.

cues.zh: 然后我们用刀子旁边的这个部位稍微的
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 yong4 dao1 zi5 pang2 bian1 de5 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4 shao1 wei1 de5
cues.en: Then, using the side of the knife, we gently...

cues.zh: 把每一片猪肉
cues.pinyin: ba3 mei3 yi1 pian4 zhu1 rou4
cues.en: take each slice of pork

cues.zh: 这样子打一下
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 da3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and pound it like this.

cues.zh: 这样子做的好处是它有软化猪片的功效
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 de5 hao3 chu4 shi4 ta1 you3 ruan3 hua4 zhu1 pian4 de5 gong1 xiao4
cues.en: The benefit of doing this is that it tenderizes the pork slices.

cues.zh: 接下来我们稍微的给这个肉片腌一下
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 shao1 wei1 de5 gei3 zhe4 ge5 rou4 pian4 yan1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Next, we'll marinate the meat slices a little.

cues.zh: 我这边有一汤匙料酒
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 bian1 you3 yi1 tang1 chi2 liao4 jiu3
cues.en: I have one tablespoon of cooking wine here.

cues.zh: 少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: a little salt

cues.zh: 少许白胡椒
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 bai2 hu2 jiao1
cues.en: a little white pepper

cues.zh: 然后我们给它就是这样子抓均匀了之后呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 zhua1 jun1 yun2 le5 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: Then we mix it evenly like this, and...

cues.zh: 给它腌个十分钟
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 yan1 ge4 shi2 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: let it marinate for ten minutes.

cues.zh: 那现在我们就来切我们今天会
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 qie4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 hui4
cues.en: Now let's cut the...

cues.zh: 需要到的青菜
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 dao4 de5 qing1 cai4
cues.en: vegetables we'll need today.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 锅包肉的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 一小把香菜
cues.pinyin: yi1 xiao3 ba3 xiang1 cai4
cues.en: a small handful of cilantro

cues.zh: 接下来呢我们来做我们今天所需要的酱汁
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ne5 wo3 men5 lai2 zuo4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 suo3 xu1 yao4 de5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: Next, let's make the sauce we need today.

cues.zh: 在这个碗里我们放进来四分之一杯米醋
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 bei1 mi3 cu4
cues.en: In this bowl, we add a quarter cup of rice vinegar.

cues.zh: 四分之一杯糖
cues.pinyin: si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 bei1 tang2
cues.en: a quarter cup of sugar

cues.zh: 少许酱油
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 jiang4 you2
cues.en: a little soy sauce

cues.zh: 少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: a little salt

cues.zh: 然后给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: Then mix it well.

cues.zh: 在一个大碗里呢我们放进来一杯玉米粉
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 da4 wan3 li3 ne5 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 yi1 bei1 yu4 mi3 fen3
cues.en: In a large bowl, we add one cup of cornstarch.

cues.zh: 然后我们再放进来四分之一杯水
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 si4 fen1 zhi1 yi1 bei1 shui3
cues.en: Then we add a quarter cup of water.

cues.zh: 那或者是你看到它的质地已经变
cues.pinyin: na4 huo4 zhe3 shi4 ni3 kan4 dao4 ta1 de5 zhi4 di4 yi3 jing1 bian4
cues.en: Or, when you see that the texture has become...

cues.zh: 得非常的均匀
cues.pinyin: de2 fei1 chang2 de5 jun1 yun2
cues.en: very smooth and even.

cues.zh: 就是拿筷子调起来的时候它会
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 na2 kuai4 zi5 diao4 qi3 lai2 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 hui4
cues.en: That is, when you lift it with chopsticks, it will...

cues.zh: 这样子往下滴
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 wang3 xia4 di1
cues.en: drip down like this.

cues.zh: 在这个时候我们再放进来两汤匙的油
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 zai4 fang4 jin4 lai2 liang3 tang1 chi2 de5 you2
cues.en: At this point, we add two tablespoons of oil.

cues.zh: 然后也是给它搅拌均匀
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ye3 shi4 gei3 ta1 jiao3 ban4 jun1 yun2
cues.en: And mix it well too.

cues.zh: 这个时候我们把我们的猪肉片也放进来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 zhu1 rou4 pian4 ye3 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: At this point, we add our pork slices in too.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 锅包肉的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 然后就是给它也是用到像是每一个猪肉片
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 gei3 ta1 ye3 shi4 yong4 dao4 xiang4 shi4 mei3 yi2 ge4 zhu1 rou4 pian4
cues.en: And then make sure every pork slice...

cues.zh: 上面都有这个
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 dou1 you3 zhe4 ge5
cues.en: has this...

cues.zh: 淀粉就可以了
cues.pinyin: dian4 fen3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: coating of starch on it, that's all.

cues.zh: 现在在一个锅子里面我们放进来大概
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zai4 yi2 ge4 guo1 zi5 li3 mian4 wo3 men5 fang4 jin4 lai2 da4 gai4
cues.en: Now, into a pot we pour about...

cues.zh: 一英寸高的油
cues.pinyin: yi1 ying1 cun4 gao1 de5 you2
cues.en: one inch of oil.

cues.zh: 然后呢我们给它煮到热
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ne5 wo3 men5 gei3 ta1 zhu3 dao4 re4
cues.en: Then we heat it up.

cues.zh: 那如果你想看说你的油好没好呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 xiang3 kan4 shuo1 ni3 de5 you2 hao3 mei2 hao3 ne5
cues.en: If you want to check whether your oil is ready,

cues.zh: 你也可以用筷子来测试一下
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 yong4 kuai4 zi5 lai2 ce4 shi4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: you can also test it with chopsticks.

cues.zh: 如果你把筷子放进去呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 ba3 kuai4 zi5 fang4 jin4 qu4 ne5
cues.en: If you put the chopsticks in,

cues.zh: 然后它瞬间就有很多小泡泡起来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 shun4 jian1 jiu4 you3 hen3 duo1 xiao3 pao4 pao4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and lots of small bubbles immediately form,

cues.zh: 代表说你的油已经好了
cues.pinyin: dai4 biao3 shuo1 ni3 de5 you2 yi3 jing1 hao3 le5
cues.en: that means your oil is ready.

cues.zh: 那现在我们就一片一片的
cues.pinyin: na4 xian4 zai4 wo3 men5 jiu4 yi1 pian4 yi1 pian4 de5
cues.en: Now, one slice at a time,

cues.zh: 把我们的这个猪肉片放进来
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 men5 de5 zhe4 ge5 zhu1 rou4 pian4 fang4 jin4 lai2
cues.en: we put our pork slices in.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 锅包肉的家庭做法【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 那等到这个猪肉片呢
cues.pinyin: na4 deng3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 zhu1 rou4 pian4 ne5
cues.en: Then once these pork slices...

cues.zh: 你看它每一个都成型了之后
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 ta1 mei3 yi2 ge4 dou1 cheng2 xing2 le5 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: you see each one has set,

cues.zh: 我们就把它捞出来
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ba3 ta1 lao1 chu1 lai2
cues.en: we take them out.

cues.zh: 这个时候我们再继续加热这个油
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 zai4 ji4 xu4 jia1 re4 zhe4 ge5 you2
cues.en: At this point we continue heating the oil

cues.zh: 红萝卜

cues.zh: 它非常的酥脆

cues.zh: 马蒂在律所表现出色

cues.zh: 终于被允许加入制药厂的律师团了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 bei4 yun3 xu3 jia1 ru4 zhi4 yao4 chang3 de5 lv4 shi1 tuan2 le5

cues.zh: 要知道这个制药厂是他们律所最大的客户
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 zhi4 yao4 chang3 shi4 ta1 men5 lv4 suo3 zui4 da4 de5 ke4 hu4

cues.zh: 只有最出色的律师

cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 huo4 zhun3 jia1 ru4 lv4 shi1 tuan2

cues.zh: 马蒂之所以如此努力
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 zhi1 suo3 yi3 ru2 ci3 nu3 li4
cues.en: The reason Marty worked so hard

cues.zh: 等的就是这个机会

cues.zh: 出市场的文件
cues.pinyin: chu1 shi4 chang3 de5 wen2 jian4

cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 dang1 nian2 zhe4 fen4 wen2 jian4 neng2 gong1 zhi1 yu2 zhong4
cues.en: If that document had been made public back then,

cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 de5 nv3 er2 yi3 ji2 hen3 duo1 wu2 gu1 de5 ren2

cues.zh: 都不会因为滥用药物而染上毒瘾

cues.zh: 最后走向无法回头的深渊
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zou3 xiang4 wu2 fa3 hui2 tou2 de5 shen1 yuan1
cues.en: and ended up in an abyss with no way back.

cues.zh: 如今马蒂终于有机会接近制药厂了
cues.pinyin: ru2 jin1 ma3 di4 zhong1 yu2 you3 ji1 hui4 jie1 jin4 zhi4 yao4 chang3 le5
cues.en: Now that Marty finally has a chance to get close to the pharma company,

cues.zh: 他一定要好好表现
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ding4 yao4 hao3 hao3 biao3 xian4
cues.en: he's determined to perform well

cues.zh: 争取获得更多的信任
cues.pinyin: zheng1 qu3 huo4 de2 geng4 duo1 de5 xin4 ren4
cues.en: and earn more trust,

cues.zh: 才能接近机密文件
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 jie1 jin4 ji1 mi4 wen2 jian4
cues.en: so he can get access to the confidential documents.

cues.zh: 所以哪怕是圣诞假期将近
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 na3 pa4 shi4 sheng4 dan4 jia4 qi1 jiang1 jin4
cues.en: So even with Christmas approaching,

cues.zh: 马蒂也没有丝毫松懈
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 ye3 mei2 you3 si1 hao2 song1 xie4
cues.en: Marty hasn't let up at all.

cues.zh: 不能唱歌
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 chang4 ge1
cues.en: No singing.

cues.zh: 马蒂回到办公室

cues.zh: 两人还约定在圣诞派对那天一起
cues.pinyin: liang3 ren2 hai2 yue1 ding4 zai4 sheng4 dan4 pai4 dui4 na4 tian1 yi4 qi3

cues.zh: 共度美好时光

cues.zh: 怪不得沙拉没时间参加演出
cues.pinyin: guai4 bu4 de2 sha1 la1 mei2 shi2 jian1 can1 jia1 yan3 chu1
cues.en: No wonder Sarah has no time for the performance—

cues.zh: 原来是家人有约啊

cues.en: turns out she already has plans with family.

cues.zh: 沙拉赶紧解释
cues.pinyin: sha1 la1 gan3 jin3 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Sarah quickly explains

cues.zh: 自己只是五音不全
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 zhi3 shi4 wu3 yin1 bu4 quan2
cues.en: that she's just tone-deaf

cues.zh: 不想在心上人面前出丑罢了

cues.en: and doesn't want to embarrass herself in front of her crush.

cues.zh: 这时候小奥来找马蒂

cues.zh: 是时候去跟朱丽安会合了

cues.zh: 路上小奥一直叮嘱马蒂
cues.pinyin: lu4 shang4 xiao3 ao4 yi4 zhi2 ding1 zhu3 ma3 di4
cues.en: On the way, Xiao Ao keeps reminding Marty

cues.zh: 工作的时候各种注意事项

cues.zh: 生怕马蒂在朱丽安手下被人欺负了

cues.zh: 马蒂也很感动
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 ye3 hen3 gan3 dong4

cues.zh: 其实不光小奥担心马蒂
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 bu4 guang1 xiao3 ao4 dan1 xin1 ma3 di4

cues.zh: 就连朱丽安都很担心
cues.pinyin: jiu4 lian2 zhu1 li4 an1 dou1 hen3 dan1 xin1
cues.en: even Julian is worried too.

cues.zh: 制药厂那些眼高于顶的家伙
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yao4 chang3 na4 xie1 yan3 gao1 yu2 ding3 de5 jia1 huo5
cues.en: Those arrogant people at the pharma company

cues.zh: 瞧不起马蒂
cues.pinyin: qiao2 bu4 qi3 ma3 di4
cues.en: look down on Marty.

cues.zh: 其实不光朱丽安和小奥担心马蒂
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 bu4 guang1 zhu1 li4 an1 he2 xiao3 ao4 dan1 xin1 ma3 di4
cues.en: In fact, it's not just Julian and Xiao Ao who worry about Marty.
