cues.en: His ability gets full marks.

cues.zh: 终于马蒂见到了原告小美和她的律师泡美
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 ma3 di4 jian4 dao4 le5 yuan2 gao4 xiao3 mei3 he2 ta1 de5 lv4 shi1 pao4 mei3
cues.en: Finally, Marty meets the plaintiff Xiaomei and her lawyer, Pao Mei.

cues.zh: 小美说自己在进行药物试验之前完全健康
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 shuo1 zi4 ji3 zai4 jin4 xing2 yao4 wu4 shi4 yan4 zhi1 qian2 wan2 quan2 jian4 kang1
cues.en: Xiaomei says she was completely healthy before the drug trial.

cues.zh: 参加药物试验后
cues.pinyin: can1 jia1 yao4 wu4 shi4 yan4 hou4
cues.en: After joining the drug trial,

cues.zh: 她开始出现胃疼和精神错乱
cues.pinyin: ta1 kai1 shi3 chu1 xian4 wei4 teng2 he2 jing1 shen2 cuo4 luan4
cues.en: she began having stomach pain and mental confusion.

cues.zh: 当时她就多次将病情上报
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 ta1 jiu4 duo1 ci4 jiang1 bing4 qing2 shang4 bao4
cues.en: At the time, she reported her condition many times,

cues.zh: 但被药厂的工作人员忽视
cues.pinyin: dan4 bei4 yao4 chang3 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 hu1 shi4
cues.en: but the pharma company's staff ignored it.

cues.zh: 现在她的肾脏彻底全完蛋了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 de5 shen4 zang4 che4 di3 quan2 wan2 dan4 le5
cues.en: Now her kidneys have completely failed

cues.zh: 需要换个新肾脏
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 huan4 ge4 xin1 shen4 zang4
cues.en: and she needs a new kidney.

cues.zh: 小美长久以来
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 chang2 jiu3 yi3 lai2
cues.en: For a long time, Xiaomei

cues.zh: 一直梦想成为世界顶尖的大提琴演奏家
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi2 meng4 xiang3 cheng2 wei2 shi4 jie4 ding3 jian1 de5 da4 ti2 qin2 yan3 zou4 jia1
cues.en: had dreamed of becoming a world-class cello performer.

cues.zh: 现在她的手抖得根本无法拉琴了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ta1 de5 shou3 dou3 de2 gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 la1 qin2 le5
cues.en: Now her hands shake so badly she can't play at all.

cues.zh: 也因病从音乐学院退学
cues.pinyin: ye3 yin1 bing4 cong2 yin1 yue4 xue2 yuan4 tui4 xue2
cues.en: She also had to drop out of music school because of her illness,

cues.zh: 彻底失去了前途
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 shi1 qu4 le5 qian2 tu2
cues.en: losing her future completely.

cues.zh: 制药厂毁掉了一个未来艺术家的职业道路
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yao4 chang3 hui3 diao4 le5 yi2 ge4 wei4 lai2 yi4 shu4 jia1 de5 zhi2 ye4 dao4 lu4
cues.en: The pharma company destroyed the career of a future artist.

cues.zh: 所以小美他们的诉求
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 xiao3 mei3 ta1 men5 de5 su4 qiu2
cues.en: So what Xiaomei and her lawyer are demanding

cues.zh: 是制药厂除了支付他们的医疗费用
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhi4 yao4 chang3 chu2 le5 zhi1 fu4 ta1 men5 de5 yi1 liao2 fei4 yong4
cues.en: is that besides covering their medical costs,

cues.zh: 还要支付前途损失费
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 zhi1 fu4 qian2 tu2 sun3 shi1 fei4
cues.en: the pharma company also pay for her lost future.

cues.zh: 朱利安对此嗤之以鼻
cues.pinyin: zhu1 li4 an1 dui4 ci3 chi1 zhi1 yi3 bi2
cues.en: Julian scoffs at this.

cues.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局的审批
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 shi2 pin3 yao4 pin3 jian1 du1 guan3 li3 ju2 de5 shen3 pi1
cues.en: The FDA's approval process

cues.zh: 过程非常严格
cues.pinyin: guo4 cheng2 fei1 chang2 yan2 ge2
cues.en: is extremely strict.

cues.zh: 既然药物能获准上市
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 yao4 wu4 neng2 huo4 zhun3 shang4 shi4
cues.en: Since the drug was approved for market,

cues.zh: 就说明是绝对安全的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shuo1 ming2 shi4 jue2 dui4 an1 quan2 de5
cues.en: that proves it's absolutely safe.

cues.zh: 而且负责跟小美联系的工作人
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 fu4 ze2 gen1 xiao3 mei3 lian2 xi4 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2
cues.en: Moreover, the staff member who was in contact with Xiaomei

cues.zh: 员也可以作证
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ye3 ke3 yi3 zuo4 zheng4
cues.en: can also testify

items.title_zh: 75岁老律师竟被逼到崩溃！获胜后却没有丝毫喜悦！2024最新犯罪美剧《老练律师》第7集

cues.zh: 当初小美没提交过任何药物副作用的报告
cues.pinyin: dang1 chu1 xiao3 mei3 mei2 ti2 jiao1 guo4 ren4 he2 yao4 wu4 fu4 zuo4 yong4 de5 bao4 gao4
cues.en: that Xiaomei never submitted any report of drug side effects at the time.

cues.zh: 两年后小美才说是被药物副作
cues.pinyin: liang3 nian2 hou4 xiao3 mei3 cai2 shuo1 shi4 bei4 yao4 wu4 fu4 zuo4
cues.en: It was only two years later that Xiaomei claimed the drug's side effects

cues.zh: 用侵蚀了身体
cues.pinyin: yong4 qin1 shi2 le5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: had damaged her body.

cues.zh: 两年过去了
cues.pinyin: liang3 nian2 guo4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Two years have passed—

cues.zh: 谁知道小美对自己的身体做过什么呢
cues.pinyin: shui2 zhi1 dao4 xiao3 mei3 dui4 zi4 ji3 de5 shen1 ti3 zuo4 guo4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: who knows what Xiaomei did to her own body in that time?

cues.zh: 马蒂提出制药厂愿意致付 5 万美
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 ti2 chu1 zhi4 yao4 chang3 yuan4 yi4 zhi4 fu4 5 wan4 mei3
cues.en: Marty proposes that the pharma company is willing to pay 50,000 dollars

cues.zh: 元赔偿给小美
cues.pinyin: yuan2 pei2 chang2 gei3 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: in compensation to Xiaomei

cues.zh: 这时就一笔勾销了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 jiu4 yi1 bi3 gou1 xiao1 le5
cues.en: to settle everything once and for all.

cues.zh: 这价格已经大大超过制药厂的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jia4 ge2 yi3 jing1 da4 da4 chao1 guo4 zhi4 yao4 chang3 de5
cues.en: This price already far exceeds the pharma company's

cues.zh: 1 万美元预算
cues.pinyin: 1 wan4 mei3 yuan2 yu4 suan4
cues.en: ten-thousand-dollar budget.

cues.zh: 按理说小美他们应该知足了
cues.pinyin: an4 li3 shuo1 xiao3 mei3 ta1 men5 ying1 gai1 zhi1 zu2 le5
cues.en: By rights, Xiaomei and her lawyer should be satisfied.

cues.zh: 可小美不但不同意
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 mei3 bu4 dan4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: But Xiaomei not only refuses,

cues.zh: 还拿出手机开始录视频
cues.pinyin: hai2 na2 chu1 shou3 ji1 kai1 shi3 lu4 shi4 pin2
cues.en: she takes out her phone and starts filming,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 75岁老律师竟被逼到崩溃！获胜后却没有丝毫喜悦！2024最新犯罪美剧《老练律师》第7集

cues.zh: 并且贴上医疗器械的贴纸
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 tie1 shang4 yi1 liao2 qi4 xie4 de5 tie1 zhi3
cues.en: and sticks a medical-device sticker on it.

cues.zh: 一切准备就绪后
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 zhun3 bei4 jiu4 xu4 hou4
cues.en: Once everything is ready,

cues.zh: 马蒂敲响了小美家的门
cues.pinyin: ma3 di4 qiao1 xiang3 le5 xiao3 mei3 jia1 de5 men2
cues.en: Marty knocks on Xiaomei's door.

cues.zh: 小美举起手机就对着马蒂开拍
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ju3 qi3 shou3 ji1 jiu4 dui4 zhe5 ma3 di4 kai1 pai1
cues.en: Xiaomei raises her phone and starts filming Marty.

cues.zh: 不过蒙面敌马蒂举起了自己的手机
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 meng2 mian4 di2 ma3 di4 ju3 qi3 le5 zi4 ji3 de5 shou3 ji1
cues.en: But Marty calmly raises his own phone

cues.zh: 给她看那个充电宝
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 kan4 na4 ge5 chong1 dian4 bao3
cues.en: to show her the power bank.

cues.zh: 她说我可是装了心脏起搏器的人
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 ke3 shi4 zhuang1 le5 xin1 zang4 qi3 bo2 qi4 de5 ren2
cues.en: She says, "I have a pacemaker,

cues.zh: 你对着我拍
cues.pinyin: ni3 dui4 zhe5 wo3 pai1
cues.en: and if you film me,

cues.zh: 就会影响我的起搏器工作
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 ying3 xiang3 wo3 de5 qi3 bo2 qi4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: it'll interfere with my pacemaker.

cues.zh: 到时候我就死给你看
cues.pinyin: dao4 shi2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 si3 gei3 ni3 kan4
cues.en: Then I'll die right in front of you."

cues.zh: 小美只好收起手机
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 zhi3 hao3 shou1 qi3 shou3 ji1
cues.en: Xiaomei has no choice but to put her phone away

cues.zh: 把马蒂让到房间里
cues.pinyin: ba3 ma3 di4 rang4 dao4 fang2 jian1 li3
cues.en: and lets Marty into the room.

cues.zh: 或许是马蒂的亲和力
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 shi4 ma3 di4 de5 qin1 he2 li4
cues.en: Maybe it's Marty's charm

cues.zh: 让小美放松了不少
cues.pinyin: rang4 xiao3 mei3 fang4 song1 le5 bu4 shao3
cues.en: that puts Xiaomei noticeably at ease,

cues.zh: 没了在律所时候的敌意
cues.pinyin: mei2 le5 zai4 lv4 suo3 shi2 hou4 de5 di2 yi4
cues.en: losing the hostility she had back at the law firm.

cues.zh: 小美用充满 I 7 的语气告诉马蒂
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 yong4 chong1 man3 I 7 de5 yu3 qi4 gao4 su4 ma3 di4
cues.en: In a wistful tone, Xiaomei tells Marty

cues.zh: 生病前
cues.pinyin: sheng1 bing4 qian2
cues.en: that before she got sick,

cues.zh: 自己每天练习十小时的大提琴
cues.pinyin: zi4 ji3 mei3 tian1 lian4 xi2 shi2 xiao3 shi2 de5 da4 ti2 qin2
cues.en: she used to practice cello ten hours a day,

cues.zh: 每天都充满斗志与梦想
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 dou1 chong1 man3 dou4 zhi4 yu3 meng4 xiang3
cues.en: full of drive and dreams every day.

cues.zh: 可是现在她什么都没了
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xian4 zai4 ta1 shen2 me5 dou1 mei2 le5
cues.en: But now she has lost everything.

cues.zh: 有一对乡下来的父子从来没看过电梯
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 dui4 xiang1 xia4 lai2 de5 fu4 zi3 cong2 lai2 mei2 kan4 guo4 dian4 ti1
cues.en: There was a father and son from the countryside who had never seen an elevator before.

cues.zh: 有一次进城逛百货公司
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 ci4 jin4 cheng2 guang4 bai3 huo4 gong1 si1
cues.en: One time they went into the city to visit a department store.

cues.zh: 看到了一个老婆婆走进了电梯
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 lao3 po2 po5 zou3 jin4 le5 dian4 ti1
cues.en: They saw an old woman step into the elevator.

cues.zh: 后来电梯门打开就走出了一位美女
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 dian4 ti1 men2 da3 kai1 jiu4 zou3 chu1 le5 yi1 wei4 mei3 nv3
cues.en: Then the elevator doors opened and a beautiful woman walked out.

cues.zh: 于是爸爸就跟儿子说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ba4 ba4 jiu4 gen1 er2 zi5 shuo1
cues.en: So the father said to his son,

cues.zh: 儿子啊没想到城市这么进步
cues.pinyin: er2 zi5 a5 mei2 xiang3 dao4 cheng2 shi4 zhe4 me5 jin4 bu4
cues.en: "Son, I never expected the city to be this advanced."

cues.zh: 赶快打电话叫你妈妈赶过来
cues.pinyin: gan3 kuai4 da3 dian4 hua4 jiao4 ni3 ma1 ma1 gan3 guo4 lai2
cues.en: "Quick, call your mom and tell her to hurry over here!"

cues.zh: 小美和小明约会小美突然想放屁
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 he2 xiao3 ming2 yue1 hui4 xiao3 mei3 tu1 ran2 xiang3 fang4 pi4
cues.en: Xiaomei and Xiaoming were on a date when Xiaomei suddenly needed to fart.

cues.zh: 你听过布谷鸟的叫声吗没有耶
cues.pinyin: ni3 ting1 guo4 bu4 gu3 niao3 de5 jiao4 sheng1 ma5 mei2 you3 ye2
cues.en: "Have you ever heard a cuckoo's call?" "No, I haven't."

cues.zh: 那我学给你听
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 xue2 gei3 ni3 ting1
cues.en: "Then let me imitate it for you."

cues.zh: 那你听清楚了吗
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 ting1 qing1 chu3 le5 ma5
cues.en: "Did you hear it clearly?"

cues.zh: 放屁声太大声了
cues.pinyin: fang4 pi4 sheng1 tai4 da4 sheng1 le5
cues.en: The fart was way too loud.

cues.zh: 我没听清楚
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 ting1 qing1 chu3
cues.en: "I didn't hear it clearly."

cues.zh: 这样才比较卫生
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 cai2 bi3 jiao4 wei4 sheng1
cues.en: "This way it's more hygienic."

cues.zh: 可是老师说
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 lao3 shi1 shuo1
cues.en: But the teacher said,

cues.zh: 水果的营养很多都在皮上
cues.pinyin: shui3 guo3 de5 ying2 yang3 hen3 duo1 dou1 zai4 pi2 shang4
cues.en: "A lot of a fruit's nutrition is in its skin."

cues.zh: 如果你把苹果皮削了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 ba3 ping2 guo3 pi2 xue1 le5
cues.en: "If you peel the apple's skin off,"

cues.zh: 这样不就没有营养了吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 bu4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ying2 yang3 le5 ma5
cues.en: "wouldn't that mean it loses all its nutrition?"

cues.zh: 那你就吃我刚刚削掉的苹果皮吧
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 jiu4 chi1 wo3 gang1 gang1 xue1 diao4 de5 ping2 guo3 pi2 ba5
cues.en: "Then you eat the peel I just took off."

cues.zh: 因为恶心
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 e3 xin1
cues.en: "Because it's gross."

items.title_zh: 笑话39｜乡巴佬｜QQ软糖｜〝布谷鸟〞叫声｜3+6=10？｜吃苹果皮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 有一天小明和小华去爬山
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 tian1 xiao3 ming2 he2 xiao3 hua2 qu4 pa2 shan1
cues.en: One day Xiaoming and Xiaohua went hiking.

cues.zh: 结果迷路了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 mi2 lu4 le5
cues.en: As a result, they got lost.

cues.zh: 到了晚上
cues.pinyin: dao4 le5 wan3 shang4
cues.en: When night fell,

cues.zh: 我去附近找看看有没有东西吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 fu4 jin4 zhao3 kan4 kan4 you3 mei2 you3 dong1 xi1 chi1
cues.en: "I'll go look nearby and see if there's anything to eat."

cues.zh: 后来小明回来说
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 xiao3 ming2 hui2 lai2 shuo1
cues.en: Later Xiaoming came back and said,

cues.zh: 我有一个坏消息和一个好消息
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 yi2 ge4 huai4 xiao1 xi1 he2 yi2 ge4 hao3 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: "I have one piece of bad news and one piece of good news."

cues.zh: 你要先听哪一个
cues.pinyin: ni3 yao4 xian1 ting1 na3 yi2 ge4
cues.en: "Which one do you want to hear first?"

cues.zh: 我先听坏消息好了
cues.pinyin: wo3 xian1 ting1 huai4 xiao1 xi1 hao3 le5
cues.en: "I'll hear the bad news first."

cues.zh: 这附近没有东西可以吃
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fu4 jin4 mei2 you3 dong1 xi1 ke3 yi3 chi1
cues.en: "There's nothing to eat around here."

cues.zh: 我们要吃土了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 chi1 tu3 le5
cues.en: "We're going to have to eat dirt."

cues.zh: 那好消息呢
cues.pinyin: na4 hao3 xiao1 xi1 ne5
cues.en: "So what's the good news?"

cues.zh: 这附近有很多土可以吃
cues.pinyin: zhe4 fu4 jin4 you3 hen3 duo1 tu3 ke3 yi3 chi1
cues.en: "There's plenty of dirt around here to eat."

cues.zh: 当作是吗
cues.pinyin: dang4 zuo4 shi4 ma5
cues.en: "Is that so?"

items.title_zh: 笑话39｜乡巴佬｜QQ软糖｜〝布谷鸟〞叫声｜3+6=10？｜吃苹果皮｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我和我女朋友分手了
cues.pinyin: wo3 he2 wo3 nv3 peng2 you3 fen1 shou3 le5
cues.en: "My girlfriend and I broke up."

cues.zh: 怎么会呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 hui4 ne5
cues.en: "How could that happen?"

cues.zh: 你没跟他说你爸是亿万富翁喔
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei2 gen1 ta1 shuo1 ni3 ba4 shi4 yi4 wan4 fu4 weng1 o1
cues.en: "Didn't you tell her your dad's a billionaire?"

cues.zh: 有啊所以现在他变成我的
cues.pinyin: you3 a5 suo3 yi3 xian4 zai4 ta1 bian4 cheng2 wo3 de5
cues.en: "I did — so now she's become my..."

cues.zh: 寄母
cues.pinyin: ji4 mu3
cues.en: "...stepmother."

cues.zh: 看什么时候 3 加 6 等于 10 呢
cues.pinyin: kan4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 3 jia1 6 deng3 yu2 10 ne5
cues.en: "Guess when 3 plus 6 equals 10?"

cues.zh: 呃是玩游戏的时候吗
cues.pinyin: e4 shi4 wan2 you2 xi4 de5 shi2 hou4 ma5
cues.en: "Uh, is it when you're playing a game?"

cues.zh: 玩游戏哪会出现什么 3 加 6 等于 10 啊
cues.pinyin: wan2 you2 xi4 na3 hui4 chu1 xian4 shen2 me5 3 jia1 6 deng3 yu2 10 a5
cues.en: "Why would 3 plus 6 equal 10 while playing a game?"

cues.zh: 答案是算错的时候
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 suan4 cuo4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "The answer is: when you do the math wrong."

items.title_zh: 2025最新高能美剧！100多名重刑犯在万米高空集体逃生！美国警察集体懵逼！一口气看完《失序边缘》1-2

cues.zh: 20 25 最新震撼美剧
cues.pinyin: 20 25 zui4 xin1 zhen4 han4 mei3 ju4
cues.en: 2025's newest, hard-hitting American TV series!

cues.zh: 荒无人烟的冰雪山谷意外坠毁一辆运载
cues.pinyin: huang1 wu2 ren2 yan1 de5 bing1 xue3 shan1 gu3 yi4 wai4 zhui4 hui3 yi1 liang4 yun4 zai4
cues.en: In a desolate, snow-covered mountain valley, a plane unexpectedly crashes—

cues.zh: 重刑犯的飞机
cues.pinyin: zhong4 xing2 fan4 de5 fei1 ji1
cues.en: a plane transporting serious felons.

cues.zh: 一百多个穷凶极恶的重刑犯全部逃脱
cues.pinyin: yi4 bai3 duo1 ge4 qiong2 xiong1 ji2 e4 de5 zhong4 xing2 fan4 quan2 bu4 tao2 tuo1
cues.en: Over a hundred vicious, hardened convicts all escape.

cues.zh: 为了保护小镇居民的安全
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 bao3 hu4 xiao3 zhen4 ju1 min2 de5 an1 quan2
cues.en: To protect the safety of the town's residents,

cues.zh: 当地警员只能与中情局特工联手在冰
cues.pinyin: dang1 di4 jing3 yuan2 zhi3 neng2 yu3 zhong1 qing2 ju2 te4 gong1 lian2 shou3 zai4 bing1
cues.en: local police have no choice but to team up with CIA agents in the snow

cues.zh: 雪中追捕囚犯
cues.pinyin: xue3 zhong1 zhui1 bu3 qiu2 fan4
cues.en: to hunt down the escaped prisoners.

cues.zh: 而这些囚犯中最凶狠的莫过于这个戴
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 xie1 qiu2 fan4 zhong1 zui4 xiong1 hen3 de5 mo4 guo4 yu2 zhe4 ge5 dai4
cues.en: Among these convicts, the most ruthless is this man

cues.zh: 着头套的男人
cues.pinyin: zhe5 tou2 tao4 de5 nan2 ren2
cues.en: wearing a hood.

cues.zh: 他的身份十分神秘
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 shen1 fen4 shi2 fen1 shen2 mi4
cues.en: His identity is extremely mysterious.

cues.zh: 足够飞机半途停下专门接他
cues.pinyin: zu2 gou4 fei1 ji1 ban4 tu2 ting2 xia4 zhuan1 men2 jie1 ta1
cues.en: Enough that the plane stopped midway just to pick him up.

cues.zh: 即便这艘飞机上全部都是大名鼎鼎的罪犯
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 zhe4 sou1 fei1 ji1 shang4 quan2 bu4 dou1 shi4 da4 ming2 ding3 ding3 de5 zui4 fan4
cues.en: Even though everyone else on this plane is a famous criminal,

cues.zh: 但他依旧能够获得特殊待遇
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 yi1 jiu4 neng2 gou4 huo4 de2 te4 shu1 dai4 yu4
cues.en: he still gets special treatment.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 其他的重刑犯向他们发动攻击
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 zhong4 xing2 fan4 xiang4 ta1 men5 fa1 dong4 gong1 ji1
cues.en: the other hardened convicts launch an attack on them.

cues.zh: 即便有枪
cues.pinyin: ji2 bian4 you3 qiang1
cues.en: Even though they have guns,

cues.zh: 但他们来的只有三个警员
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 men5 lai2 de5 zhi3 you3 san1 ge4 jing3 yuan2
cues.en: there are only three officers who came.

cues.zh: 根本不是这么多重刑犯的对手
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 bu2 shi4 zhe4 me5 duo1 zhong4 xing2 fan4 de5 dui4 shou3
cues.en: They're simply no match for so many convicts.

cues.zh: 这些重刑犯看准他们子弹不够
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 zhong4 xing2 fan4 kan4 zhun3 ta1 men5 zi3 dan4 bu4 gou4
cues.en: The convicts see that the police are low on bullets

cues.zh: 警力不够
cues.pinyin: jing3 li4 bu4 gou4
cues.en: and short on manpower,

cues.zh: 不断地扑上来攻击他们
cues.pinyin: bu4 duan4 di4 pu1 shang4 lai2 gong1 ji1 ta1 men5
cues.en: and keep charging in to attack them.

cues.zh: 弗兰克只好且战且退
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 zhi3 hao3 qie3 zhan4 qie3 tui4
cues.en: Frank has no choice but to fight while retreating.

cues.zh: 拼命将警察带上了直升飞机
cues.pinyin: pin1 ming4 jiang1 jing3 cha2 dai4 shang4 le5 zhi2 sheng1 fei1 ji1
cues.en: He fights desperately to get the police onto the helicopter.

cues.zh: 另一边中情局得知情况之后
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1 zhong1 qing2 ju2 de2 zhi1 qing2 kuang4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Meanwhile, after the CIA learns what's happening,

cues.zh: 也感觉到大事不妙
cues.pinyin: ye3 gan3 jue2 dao4 da4 shi4 bu2 miao4
cues.en: they also sense something is seriously wrong.

cues.zh: 因为那位神秘的重刑犯犯哈佛洛克
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 na4 wei4 shen2 mi4 de5 zhong4 xing2 fan4 fan4 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4
cues.en: Because that mysterious convict, Haverlock,

cues.zh: 参与他们某项绝密计划
cues.pinyin: can1 yu4 ta1 men5 mou3 xiang4 jue2 mi4 ji4 hua4
cues.en: was involved in one of their top-secret operations.

cues.zh: 可他们都没想到哈佛洛克会背叛
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 men5 dou1 mei2 xiang3 dao4 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4 hui4 bei4 pan4
cues.en: But none of them expected Haverlock would betray them.

cues.zh: 幸好在他入境中国之前被捕
cues.pinyin: xing4 hao3 zai4 ta1 ru4 jing4 zhong1 guo2 zhi1 qian2 bei4 bu3
cues.en: Luckily, he was caught before he could cross the border.

cues.zh: 另外在与此不远的一处山林小屋中
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 zai4 yu3 ci3 bu4 yuan3 de5 yi1 chu4 shan1 lin2 xiao3 wu1 zhong1
cues.en: Meanwhile, not far from there, in a mountain cabin,

cues.zh: 生活着一位职业式气象观测员的老人
cues.pinyin: sheng1 huo2 zhe5 yi1 wei4 zhi2 ye4 shi4 qi4 xiang4 guan1 ce4 yuan2 de5 lao3 ren2
cues.en: lives an old man who works as a weather observer.

cues.zh: 老人常年一个人生活
cues.pinyin: lao3 ren2 chang2 nian2 yi2 ge4 ren2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: The old man has lived alone for years.

cues.zh: 今天他却感觉到屋子里好像多出一个人
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 ta1 que4 gan3 jue2 dao4 wu1 zi5 li3 hao3 xiang4 duo1 chu1 yi2 ge4 ren2
cues.en: But today he senses there seems to be an extra person in the house.

cues.zh: 这时他收到了山下发来的新闻警告
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 ta1 shou1 dao4 le5 shan1 xia4 fa1 lai2 de5 xin1 wen2 jing3 gao4
cues.en: At that moment, he receives a news alert sent up from the town below,

cues.zh: 得知大量重刑犯脱逃
cues.pinyin: de2 zhi1 da4 liang4 zhong4 xing2 fan4 tuo1 tao2
cues.en: learning that a large number of convicts have escaped.

cues.zh: 他下意识想要去拿出自己藏起来的手枪
cues.pinyin: ta1 xia4 yi4 shi2 xiang3 yao4 qu4 na2 chu1 zi4 ji3 cang2 qi3 lai2 de5 shou3 qiang1
cues.en: Instinctively, he wants to grab the gun he's hidden away.

cues.zh: 一个声音却从他身后响起
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 sheng1 yin1 que4 cong2 ta1 shen1 hou4 xiang3 qi3
cues.en: But a voice suddenly speaks up from behind him.

items.title_zh: 2025最新高能美剧！100多名重刑犯在万米高空集体逃生！美国警察集体懵逼！一口气看完《失序边缘》1-2

cues.zh: 哈佛洛克究竟是怎么做到将爆炸物
cues.pinyin: ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4 jiu1 jing4 shi4 zen3 me5 zuo4 dao4 jiang1 bao4 zha4 wu4
cues.en: Just how did Haverlock manage to get the explosives

cues.zh: 转移到飞机上
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 yi2 dao4 fei1 ji1 shang4
cues.en: onto the plane?

cues.zh: 想要做到这一点一定有内鬼帮他
cues.pinyin: xiang3 yao4 zuo4 dao4 zhe4 yi4 dian3 yi2 ding4 you3 nei4 gui3 bang1 ta1
cues.en: To pull that off, he must have had an inside man helping him.

cues.zh: 斯科菲德当务之急就是找出是谁在帮助他
cues.pinyin: si1 ke1 fei1 de2 dang1 wu4 zhi1 ji2 jiu4 shi4 zhao3 chu1 shi4 shui2 zai4 bang1 zhu4 ta1
cues.en: Scofield's top priority now is to find out who's helping him.

cues.zh: 这时警方收到了从气象观测小屋发来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 jing3 fang1 shou1 dao4 le5 cong2 qi4 xiang4 guan1 ce4 xiao3 wu1 fa1 lai2
cues.en: At this point, the police receive a distress call sent by radio

cues.zh: 的无线电求救
cues.pinyin: de5 wu2 xian4 dian4 qiu2 jiu4
cues.en: from the weather observation cabin.

cues.zh: 他们意识到大势不妙
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi4 shi2 dao4 da4 shi4 bu4 miao4
cues.en: They realize something is badly wrong

cues.zh: 立刻出动大量人手围住小屋
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 chu1 dong4 da4 liang4 ren2 shou3 wei2 zhu4 xiao3 wu1
cues.en: and immediately send a large team to surround the cabin.

cues.zh: 可是一进门便被藏在暗处的暴徒偷袭
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 yi1 jin4 men2 bian4 bei4 cang2 zai4 an4 chu4 de5 bao4 tu2 tou1 xi2
cues.en: But the moment they step inside, they're ambushed by thugs hiding in the dark.

cues.zh: 一名警察横死当场
cues.pinyin: yi1 ming2 jing3 cha2 heng4 si3 dang1 chang3
cues.en: One officer is killed on the spot.

cues.zh: 但更多的警察围了上来
cues.pinyin: dan4 geng4 duo1 de5 jing3 cha2 wei2 le5 shang4 lai2
cues.en: But more police close in.

cues.zh: 歹徒见识不妙
cues.pinyin: dai3 tu2 jian4 shi2 bu4 miao4
cues.en: Seeing things are going badly,

cues.zh: 只好挟持老人推到了屋外
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 xie2 chi2 lao3 ren2 tui1 dao4 le5 wu1 wai4
cues.en: the thugs have no choice but to take the old man hostage and push him outside.

cues.zh: 弗兰克上前试图安抚该名歹徒放下枪
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 shang4 qian2 shi4 tu2 an1 fu3 gai1 ming2 dai3 tu2 fang4 xia4 qiang1
cues.en: Frank steps forward trying to calm the thug down and get him to drop his gun,

cues.zh: 但斯科菲德却在这个时候冲上来
cues.pinyin: dan4 si1 ke1 fei1 de2 que4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 chong1 shang4 lai2
cues.en: but Scofield rushes in at that exact moment.

cues.zh: 他不管人质安危
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 guan3 ren2 zhi4 an1 wei1
cues.en: Ignoring the hostage's safety,

cues.zh: 抓住时机直接砍断了一条雪橇犬的狗链
cues.pinyin: zhua1 zhu4 shi2 ji1 zhi2 jie1 kan3 duan4 le5 yi1 tiao2 xue3 qiao1 quan3 de5 gou3 lian4
cues.en: he seizes the moment and cuts loose the chain of a sled dog.

cues.zh: 雪橇犬护主心切扑了上去直奔歹徒的喉咙
cues.pinyin: xue3 qiao1 quan3 hu4 zhu3 xin1 qie4 pu1 le5 shang4 qu4 zhi2 ben1 dai3 tu2 de5 hou2 long2
cues.en: Desperate to protect its owner, the sled dog lunges straight for the thug's throat

cues.zh: 当场将歹徒咬死
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiang1 dai3 tu2 yao3 si3
cues.en: and kills him on the spot.

cues.zh: 斯科菲德冲上来看清歹徒的脸却大失所望
cues.pinyin: si1 ke1 fei1 de2 chong1 shang4 lai2 kan4 qing1 dai3 tu2 de5 lian3 que4 da4 shi1 suo3 wang4
cues.en: When Scofield rushes up and gets a clear look at the thug's face, he's deeply disappointed.

cues.zh: 原来这家伙根本就不是哈佛洛克
cues.pinyin: yuan2 lai2 zhe4 jia1 huo5 gen1 ben3 jiu4 bu2 shi4 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4
cues.en: It turns out this guy isn't Haverlock at all.

items.title_zh: 2025最新高能美剧！100多名重刑犯在万米高空集体逃生！美国警察集体懵逼！一口气看完《失序边缘》1-2

cues.zh: 接着他拿出了一份身份信息
cues.pinyin: jie1 zhe5 ta1 na2 chu1 le5 yi1 fen4 shen1 fen4 xin4 xi1
cues.en: Then he pulls out a piece of ID information.

cues.zh: 上面的照片跟尸体长得一模一样
cues.pinyin: shang4 mian4 de5 zhao4 pian1 gen1 shi1 ti3 zhang3 de2 yi1 mu2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: The photo on it looks exactly like the corpse.

cues.zh: 但是这张身份信息显示此人是一个警察
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 zhang1 shen1 fen4 xin4 xi1 xian3 shi4 ci3 ren2 shi4 yi2 ge4 jing3 cha2
cues.en: But this ID shows the person is a police officer.

cues.zh: 弗兰克这才意识到自己弄错了什么
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 zhe4 cai2 yi4 shi2 dao4 zi4 ji3 nong4 cuo4 le5 shen2 me5
cues.en: Only then does Frank realize what he got wrong.

cues.zh: 他从现场就回来的那个所谓的警察
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 xian4 chang3 jiu4 hui2 lai2 de5 na4 ge5 suo3 wei4 de5 jing3 cha2
cues.en: The so-called officer he brought back from the scene

cues.zh: 实际上就是哈佛洛克
cues.pinyin: shi2 ji4 shang4 jiu4 shi4 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4
cues.en: is actually Haverlock himself.

cues.zh: 看来哈佛洛克杀死了警察
cues.pinyin: kan4 lai2 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4 sha1 si3 le5 jing3 cha2
cues.en: It seems Haverlock killed the officer

cues.zh: 穿上了警服
cues.pinyin: chuan1 shang4 le5 jing3 fu2
cues.en: and put on his uniform.

cues.zh: 他装自己双眼受伤
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhuang1 zi4 ji3 shuang1 yan3 shou4 shang1
cues.en: He pretended his eyes were injured,

cues.zh: 用血污呼住脸导致弗兰克掉以轻心
cues.pinyin: yong4 xue4 wu1 hu1 zhu4 lian3 dao3 zhi4 fu2 lan2 ke4 diao4 yi3 qing1 xin1
cues.en: smearing blood on his face so Frank would let his guard down,

cues.zh: 将他送往了医院
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ta1 song4 wang3 le5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: and had himself sent to the hospital.

cues.zh: 现在这家伙估计早已经脱困了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhe4 jia1 huo5 gu1 ji4 zao3 yi3 jing1 tuo1 kun4 le5
cues.en: By now, this guy has probably already broken free.

cues.zh: 但问题是他的妻子就在那家医院工作
cues.pinyin: dan4 wen4 ti2 shi4 ta1 de5 qi1 zi3 jiu4 zai4 na4 jia1 yi1 yuan4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: But the problem is, his wife works at that very hospital.

cues.zh: 弗兰克非常担心妻子的安慰
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 fei1 chang2 dan1 xin1 qi1 zi3 de5 an1 wei4
cues.en: Frank is extremely worried about his wife's safety

cues.zh: 马上给妻子打去电话
cues.pinyin: ma3 shang4 gei3 qi1 zi3 da3 qu4 dian4 hua4
cues.en: and immediately calls her.

cues.zh: 不料
cues.pinyin: bu4 liao4
cues.en: Unexpectedly,

cues.zh: 这通电话正好被哈佛洛克听见
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tong1 dian4 hua4 zheng4 hao3 bei4 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4 ting1 jian4
cues.en: Haverlock happens to overhear this very call.

cues.zh: 他意识到自己身份暴露
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi4 shi2 dao4 zi4 ji3 shen1 fen4 bao4 lu4
cues.en: He realizes his identity has been exposed

cues.zh: 直接绑架了弗兰克的妻子
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 bang3 jia4 le5 fu2 lan2 ke4 de5 qi1 zi3
cues.en: and immediately kidnaps Frank's wife.

cues.zh: 弗兰克前脚得知自己妻子被绑架
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 qian2 jiao3 de2 zhi1 zi4 ji3 qi1 zi3 bei4 bang3 jia4
cues.en: No sooner does Frank learn his wife has been kidnapped

cues.zh: 后脚就得知自己的儿子翘克不知所踪
cues.pinyin: hou4 jiao3 jiu4 de2 zhi1 zi4 ji3 de5 er2 zi5 qiao4 ke4 bu4 zhi1 suo3 zong1
cues.en: than he also learns his son, Chuck, has gone missing.

cues.zh: 他顿时陷入了崩溃
cues.pinyin: ta1 dun4 shi2 xian4 ru4 le5 beng1 kui4
cues.en: He completely falls apart.

cues.zh: 并且将这一切都甩锅在了斯科菲德身上
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 jiang1 zhe4 yi1 qie4 dou1 shuai3 guo1 zai4 le5 si1 ke1 fei1 de2 shen1 shang4
cues.en: And he dumps all the blame on Scofield.

cues.zh: 因为斯科菲德如果一开始就将哈佛洛克
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 si1 ke1 fei1 de2 ru2 guo3 yi1 kai1 shi3 jiu4 jiang1 ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4
cues.en: Because if Scofield had dealt with Haverlock from the very start—

cues.zh: 哈佛洛克直接毁掉了一个基站
cues.pinyin: ha1 fu2 luo4 ke4 zhi2 jie1 hui3 diao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ji1 zhan4
cues.en: Haverlock goes ahead and destroys a cell tower,

cues.zh: 导致这个小镇几乎陷入了断联的状态
cues.pinyin: dao3 zhi4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 zhen4 ji1 hu1 xian4 ru4 liao3 duan4 lian2 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: leaving the town almost completely cut off from communication.

cues.zh: 网络服务和手机服务全部中断
cues.pinyin: wang3 luo4 fu2 wu4 he2 shou3 ji1 fu2 wu4 quan2 bu4 zhong1 duan4
cues.en: Internet and phone service are both knocked out entirely.

cues.zh: 弗兰克至此才意识到斯科菲德所说的这
cues.pinyin: fu2 lan2 ke4 zhi4 ci3 cai2 yi4 shi2 dao4 si1 ke1 fei1 de2 suo3 shuo1 de5 zhe4
cues.en: Only now does Frank realize what Scofield meant when he said this

cues.zh: 个人非常聪明
cues.pinyin: ge4 ren2 fei1 chang2 cong1 ming2
cues.en: person is extremely clever.

cues.zh: 究竟是什么意思
cues.pinyin: jiu1 jing4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: What exactly did he mean by that?

cues.zh: 他从景生涯中从未遇到过这么大的挑战
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 jing3 sheng1 ya2 zhong1 cong2 wei4 yu4 dao4 guo4 zhe4 me5 da4 de5 tiao3 zhan4
cues.en: In his whole career as a cop, he's never faced a challenge this big.

cues.zh: 中情局的领导得知情况之后
cues.pinyin: zhong1 qing2 ju2 de5 ling3 dao3 de2 zhi1 qing2 kuang4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After the CIA leadership learns what's happened,

cues.zh: 直接用卫星电话对斯科菲德进行斥责
cues.pinyin: zhi2 jie1 yong4 wei4 xing1 dian4 hua4 dui4 si1 ke1 fei1 de2 jin4 xing2 chi4 ze2
cues.en: they directly reprimand Scofield over the satellite phone.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话18｜请大家帮帮忙~帮我们找出〝大扁〞｜7个幽默爆笑笑话｜

cues.zh: 嗨我是大大我是小小我们今天要聊什么呢
cues.pinyin: hai1 wo3 shi4 da4 da4 wo3 shi4 xiao3 xiao3 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Hi, I'm Dada, I'm Xiaoxiao, what should we talk about today?

cues.zh: 我们今天要聊笑话
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 yao4 liao2 xiao4 hua4
cues.en: Today we're going to talk about jokes.

cues.zh: 现在这里有三个杯子

cues.zh: 脆皮烧肉
cues.pinyin: cui4 pi2 shao1 rou4
cues.en: Crispy roast pork belly

cues.zh: 首先五花肉清理干净之后呢
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wu3 hua1 rou4 qing1 li3 gan1 jing4 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: First, after thoroughly cleaning the pork belly

cues.zh: 我们要给它拔毛
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 gei3 ta1 ba2 mao2
cues.en: we need to pluck off the hairs

cues.zh: 我们可以用镊子夹用火烧或者是锅烫
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 nie4 zi5 jia1 yong4 huo3 shao1 huo4 zhe3 shi4 guo1 tang4
cues.en: we can use tweezers, burn it with fire, or scald it in a pot

cues.zh: 接下来我们把五花肉放到冷水里
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 ba3 wu3 hua1 rou4 fang4 dao4 leng3 shui3 li3
cues.en: next we put the pork belly into cold water

cues.zh: 水开了之后呢再继续煮一分钟
cues.pinyin: shui3 kai1 le5 zhi1 hou4 ne5 zai4 ji4 xu4 zhu3 yi4 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: after the water boils, keep cooking for one more minute

cues.zh: 接下来我们用这个尖尖的东西呢
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 wo3 men5 yong4 zhe4 ge5 jian1 jian1 de5 dong1 xi1 ne5
cues.en: next we use this pointy tool

cues.zh: 把猪皮上面扎许多的小洞
cues.pinyin: ba3 zhu1 pi2 shang4 mian4 zha1 xu3 duo1 de5 xiao3 dong4
cues.en: to poke many small holes in the pork skin

cues.zh: 这样子的话呢猪皮就可以把它的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 de5 hua4 ne5 zhu1 pi2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 ba3 ta1 de5
cues.en: this way the pork skin can release

cues.zh: 水分释放出来
cues.pinyin: shui3 fen4 shi4 fang4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: its moisture

cues.zh: 然后猪皮会变得非常的酥脆
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhu1 pi2 hui4 bian4 de2 fei1 chang2 de5 su1 cui4
cues.en: then the pork skin will become very crispy

cues.zh: 在一个碗里我们加一汤匙的绍兴酒
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 jia1 yi1 tang1 chi2 de5 shao4 xing1 jiu3
cues.en: in a bowl, add one tablespoon of Shaoxing wine

cues.zh: 一茶匙的盐
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha2 chi2 de5 yan2
cues.en: one teaspoon of salt

cues.zh: 一茶匙糖
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha2 chi2 tang2
cues.en: one teaspoon of sugar

cues.zh: 一茶匙五香粉
cues.pinyin: yi1 cha2 chi2 wu3 xiang1 fen3
cues.en: one teaspoon of five-spice powder

cues.zh: 现在呢我们把这个酱汁啊涂在肉的上面
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 ge5 jiang4 zhi1 a5 tu2 zai4 rou4 de5 shang4 mian4
cues.en: now let's spread this sauce onto the meat

cues.zh: 注意不要涂到猪皮上
cues.pinyin: zhu4 yi4 bu2 yao4 tu2 dao4 zhu1 pi2 shang4
cues.en: be careful not to get it on the pork skin

cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 ba3 wu3 hua1 rou4 fang4 zai4 kao3 wang3 shang4

cues.zh: 下面的火再烤

cues.zh: 现在把五花肉拿出来之后

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 两个男孩同时中枪，其中一位头部中枪竟也能活下来！这群天才医生实在太bug了！

cues.zh: 一次毫无人性的枪击让两个男孩生命垂危
cues.pinyin: yi1 ci4 hao2 wu2 ren2 xing4 de5 qiang1 ji1 rang4 liang3 ge4 nan2 hai2 sheng1 ming4 chui2 wei1
cues.en: A merciless shooting left two boys in critical condition.

cues.zh: 一个男孩腹部中了好几枪
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 nan2 hai2 fu4 bu4 zhong1 le5 hao3 ji3 qiang1
cues.en: One boy was shot several times in the abdomen.

cues.zh: 另一个男孩被子弹击中头部
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi2 ge4 nan2 hai2 bei4 zi5 dan4 ji1 zhong4 tou2 bu4
cues.en: The other boy was shot in the head.

cues.zh: 男孩的母亲悲痛欲绝
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 de5 mu3 qin1 bei1 tong4 yu4 jue2
cues.en: The boys' mothers were devastated.

cues.zh: 萧恩和她的同事竭尽所能救助伤者
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 he2 ta1 de5 tong2 shi4 jie2 jin4 suo3 neng2 jiu4 zhu4 shang1 zhe3
cues.en: Shawn and her colleagues did everything they could to save the wounded.

cues.zh: 可是萧恩却被孩子的母亲咒骂无能
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 xiao1 en1 que4 bei4 hai2 zi5 de5 mu3 qin1 zhou4 ma4 wu2 neng2
cues.en: But the boy's mother cursed Shawn as incompetent.

cues.zh: 这期间到底发生了什么
cues.pinyin: zhe4 qi1 jian1 dao4 di3 fa1 sheng1 le5 shen2 me5
cues.en: What exactly happened during this time?

cues.zh: 在宽阔的街道旁
cues.pinyin: zai4 kuan1 kuo4 de5 jie1 dao4 pang2
cues.en: Beside a wide street,

cues.zh: 一群人正在进行第 26 6 次示威抗议
cues.pinyin: yi1 qun2 ren2 zheng4 zai4 jin4 xing2 di4 26 6 ci4 shi4 wei1 kang4 yi4
cues.en: a crowd was holding their 266th protest march.

cues.zh: 伊森是一个可爱的小男孩
cues.pinyin: yi1 sen1 shi4 yi2 ge4 ke3 ai4 de5 xiao3 nan2 hai2
cues.en: Ethan is an adorable little boy.

cues.zh: 他对街道上游行的人群不感兴趣
cues.pinyin: ta1 dui4 jie1 dao4 shang4 you2 xing2 de5 ren2 qun2 bu4 gan3 xing4 qu4
cues.en: He's not interested in the crowd marching on the street.

cues.zh: 不过他的母亲认为伊森应该去支持那些人
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 de5 mu3 qin1 ren4 wei2 yi1 sen1 ying1 gai1 qu4 zhi1 chi2 na4 xie1 ren2
cues.en: But his mother thinks Ethan should go support them.

cues.zh: 但此刻伊森内心想的只有游戏和他的伙伴
cues.pinyin: dan4 ci3 ke4 yi1 sen1 nei4 xin1 xiang3 de5 zhi3 you3 you2 xi4 he2 ta1 de5 huo3 ban4
cues.en: But right now all Ethan can think about are games and his friends.

cues.zh: 与此同时
cues.pinyin: yu3 ci3 tong2 shi2
cues.en: Meanwhile,

cues.zh: 梅森和他的母亲也正经过那一片游行区域
cues.pinyin: mei2 sen1 he2 ta1 de5 mu3 qin1 ye3 zheng4 jing1 guo4 na4 yi1 pian4 you2 xing2 qu1 yu4
cues.en: Mason and his mother were also passing through the protest area.

cues.zh: 梅森想去参加游行
cues.pinyin: mei2 sen1 xiang3 qu4 can1 jia1 you2 xing2
cues.en: Mason wanted to join the march.

cues.zh: 为此他还提前花三个小时做了标牌
cues.pinyin: wei4 ci3 ta1 hai2 ti2 qian2 hua1 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2 zuo4 le5 biao1 pai2
cues.en: He'd even spent three hours making a sign for it in advance.

cues.zh: 不过他的母亲卡里娜只想领他去喝点东西
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ta1 de5 mu3 qin1 ka3 li3 na4 zhi3 xiang3 ling3 ta1 qu4 he1 dian3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: But his mother, Karina, just wanted to take him to get a drink.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 两个男孩同时中枪，其中一位头部中枪竟也能活下来！这群天才医生实在太bug了！

cues.zh: 他不想让孩子加入到游行中去
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 xiang3 rang4 hai2 zi5 jia1 ru4 dao4 you2 xing2 zhong1 qu4
cues.en: She didn't want her child joining the march.

cues.zh: 另一边利亚怀有身孕
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1 li4 ya4 huai2 you3 shen1 yun4
cues.en: Meanwhile, Liya is pregnant.

cues.zh: 他需要定期去做各项检查
cues.pinyin: ta1 xu1 yao4 ding4 qi1 qu4 zuo4 ge4 xiang4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: She needs to go for regular checkups.

cues.zh: 此刻的肖恩正以一个医生的角度
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 de5 xiao4 en1 zheng4 yi3 yi2 ge4 yi1 sheng1 de5 jiao3 du4
cues.en: Right now, Shawn, speaking as a doctor,

cues.zh: 向丽雅解释着那些检查的作用
cues.pinyin: xiang4 li4 ya3 jie3 shi4 zhe5 na4 xie1 jian3 cha2 de5 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: is explaining to Liya what those checkups are for.

cues.zh: 就在此时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 ci3 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 电视中插播了一条紧急新闻
cues.pinyin: dian4 shi4 zhong1 cha1 bo1 le5 yi1 tiao2 jin3 ji2 xin1 wen2
cues.en: the TV cut to breaking news.

cues.zh: 刚刚人群在游行时发生了枪击案
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 ren2 qun2 zai4 you2 xing2 shi2 fa1 sheng1 le5 qiang1 ji1 an4
cues.en: A shooting had just occurred during the protest.

cues.zh: 目前已经有两人遭受到了枪击
cues.pinyin: mu4 qian2 yi3 jing1 you3 liang3 ren2 zao1 shou4 dao4 le5 qiang1 ji1
cues.en: So far, two people have been shot.

cues.zh: 肖恩发现游行的地点离医院不到一公里半
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 fa1 xian4 you2 xing2 de5 di4 dian3 li2 yi1 yuan4 bu2 dao4 yi1 gong1 li3 ban4
cues.en: Shawn realizes the protest site is less than a kilometer and a half from the hospital.

cues.zh: 他明白重担者很可能会被送到
cues.pinyin: ta1 ming2 bai2 zhong4 dan4 zhe3 hen3 ke3 neng2 hui4 bei4 song4 dao4
cues.en: He knows the critically wounded will likely be brought to

cues.zh: 他工作的医院
cues.pinyin: ta1 gong1 zuo4 de5 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: the hospital where he works.

cues.zh: 就在这时肖恩被要求立刻去急诊室
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2 xiao4 en1 bei4 yao1 qiu2 li4 ke4 qu4 ji2 zhen3 shi4
cues.en: Just then, Shawn is called to the ER immediately.

cues.zh: 没过多一会儿受伤的人被警察送了过来
cues.pinyin: mo4 guo4 duo1 yi1 hui4 er5 shou4 shang1 de5 ren2 bei4 jing3 cha2 song4 le5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Not long after, police bring in the injured.

cues.zh: 受到枪击的是小男孩梅森
cues.pinyin: shou4 dao4 qiang1 ji1 de5 shi4 xiao3 nan2 hai2 mei2 sen1
cues.en: The one who was shot is a little boy named Mason.

cues.zh: 他的胸腹中枪
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xiong1 fu4 zhong1 qiang1
cues.en: He was shot in the chest and abdomen.

cues.zh: 在急救车上
cues.pinyin: zai4 ji2 jiu4 che1 shang4
cues.en: In the ambulance,

cues.zh: 他已经接受了三轮肾上腺素的注射
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi3 jing1 jie1 shou4 le5 san1 lun2 shen4 shang4 xian4 su4 de5 zhu4 she4
cues.en: he had already been given three rounds of epinephrine.

cues.zh: 不过现在他仍然无脉搏活动
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xian4 zai4 ta1 reng2 ran2 wu2 mai4 bo2 huo2 dong4
cues.en: But he still has no pulse.

cues.zh: 医生们立刻开始对梅森进行抢救
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 li4 ke4 kai1 shi3 dui4 mei2 sen1 jin4 xing2 qiang3 jiu4
cues.en: The doctors immediately begin resuscitating Mason.

cues.zh: 他们一边安排分工
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yi1 bian1 an1 pai2 fen1 gong1
cues.en: As they divide up the tasks,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 两个男孩同时中枪，其中一位头部中枪竟也能活下来！这群天才医生实在太bug了！

cues.zh: 医生们立刻上前查看情况
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 li4 ke4 shang4 qian2 cha2 kan4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: the doctors rush over to check on him.

cues.zh: 伊森的情况非常糟糕
cues.pinyin: yi1 sen1 de5 qing2 kuang4 fei1 chang2 zao1 gao1
cues.en: Ethan's condition is very bad.

cues.zh: 他的瞳孔张开
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 tong2 kong3 zhang1 kai1
cues.en: His pupils are blown.

cues.zh: 按压他的胸部也没有任何反应
cues.pinyin: an4 ya1 ta1 de5 xiong1 bu4 ye3 mei2 you3 ren4 he2 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Pressing on his chest gets no response either.

cues.zh: 更严重的是
cues.pinyin: geng4 yan2 zhong4 de5 shi4
cues.en: Worse still,

cues.zh: 伊森的脑脊液正在流失
cues.pinyin: yi1 sen1 de5 nao3 ji2 ye4 zheng4 zai4 liu2 shi1
cues.en: Ethan is losing cerebrospinal fluid.

cues.zh: 她的格拉斯科昏迷等级为 3 T
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 ge2 la1 si1 ke1 hun1 mi2 deng3 ji2 wei4 3 T
cues.en: His Glasgow Coma Score is 3.

cues.zh: 朴医生见状
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 jian4 zhuang4
cues.en: Seeing this, Dr. Park

cues.zh: 立刻要求伊森的头抬高 30 度
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 yao1 qiu2 yi1 sen1 de5 tou2 tai2 gao1 30 du4
cues.en: immediately orders Ethan's head raised 30 degrees,

cues.zh: 用此来控制他的二氧化碳水平
cues.pinyin: yong4 ci3 lai2 kong4 zhi4 ta1 de5 er4 yang3 hua4 tan4 shui3 ping2
cues.en: to help control his carbon dioxide level.

cues.zh: 随后伊森被推到了手术室
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 yi1 sen1 bei4 tui1 dao4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Ethan is then wheeled into the operating room.

cues.zh: 男孩们在接受抢救手术的同时
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 men5 zai4 jie1 shou4 qiang3 jiu4 shou3 shu4 de5 tong2 shi2
cues.en: While the boys are undergoing emergency surgery,

cues.zh: 他们的母亲悲痛地坐在了沙发上
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 mu3 qin1 bei1 tong4 di4 zuo4 zai4 le5 sha1 fa1 shang4
cues.en: their mothers sit grief-stricken on the sofa.

cues.zh: 丽雅能感受到他们的痛苦
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 neng2 gan3 shou4 dao4 ta1 men5 de5 tong4 ku3
cues.en: Liya can feel their pain.

cues.zh: 为了让他们的心情平复一些
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 ta1 men5 de5 xin1 qing2 ping2 fu4 yi1 xie1
cues.en: To help calm them down a little,

cues.zh: 丽雅关掉了正在播送这条新闻的电视
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 guan1 diao4 le5 zheng4 zai4 bo1 song4 zhe4 tiao2 xin1 wen2 de5 dian4 shi4
cues.en: Liya turns off the TV that's airing the news.

cues.zh: 医生们拼命地做着强救手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 pin1 ming4 di4 zuo4 zhe5 qiang2 jiu4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: The doctors fight desperately through the surgery.

cues.zh: 他们修复了梅森肝脏的损伤处
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xiu1 fu4 le5 mei2 sen1 gan1 zang4 de5 sun3 shang1 chu4
cues.en: They repair the damage to Mason's liver,

cues.zh: 取出了她的皮脏
cues.pinyin: qu3 chu1 le5 ta1 de5 pi2 zang4
cues.en: remove his spleen,

cues.zh: 对她的右心室进行了缝合
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 de5 you4 xin1 shi4 jin4 xing2 le5 feng2 he2
cues.en: and stitch up his right ventricle.

cues.zh: 随后还将她的左心室切开
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 hai2 jiang1 ta1 de5 zuo3 xin1 shi4 qie4 kai1
cues.en: Then they open up his left ventricle.

cues.zh: 可就在这时
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: But just then,

cues.zh: 梅森的血压突然开始快速下降
cues.pinyin: mei2 sen1 de5 xue4 ya1 tu1 ran2 kai1 shi3 kuai4 su4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Mason's blood pressure suddenly starts dropping fast.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 两个男孩同时中枪，其中一位头部中枪竟也能活下来！这群天才医生实在太bug了！

cues.zh: 对他的右心室进行了缝合
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 de5 you4 xin1 shi4 jin4 xing2 le5 feng2 he2
cues.en: It turns out to be the group opposed to the protest.

cues.zh: 医生们一边做手术
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 yi1 bian1 zuo4 shou3 shu4

cues.zh: 一边聊了几句
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 liao2 le5 ji3 ju4

cues.zh: 他们对于持枪的观点
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dui4 yu2 chi2 qiang1 de5 guan1 dian3

cues.en: Xiaodi's little brother very likely has cancer too

cues.zh: 现在需要给小美和弟弟都做个扫描
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 xu1 yao4 gei3 xiao3 mei3 he2 di4 di5 dou1 zuo4 ge4 sao3 miao2
cues.en: Now they need to scan both Xiaomei and the younger brother

cues.zh: 不过小美并不欢迎他
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 mei3 bing4 bu4 huan1 ying2 ta1
cues.en: At this point Xiaomei's brother shows up

cues.zh: 不过小美并不欢迎她
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xiao3 mei3 bing4 bu4 huan1 ying2 ta1
cues.en: but Xiaomei doesn't welcome him at all

cues.zh: 立刻将这人赶走了
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 jiang1 zhe4 ren2 gan3 zou3 le5
cues.en: and has him thrown out immediately

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季01】天才医生肖恩“大婚”！女富婆为了测试医生故意装傻，肖恩的医院终于有金主了

cues.zh: 所以整个治疗时间会很长
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zheng3 ge4 zhi4 liao2 shi2 jian1 hui4 hen3 zhang3
cues.en: So the whole treatment is going to take a long time

cues.zh: 而小儿子只有气管有一处肿瘤
cues.pinyin: er2 xiao3 er2 zi5 zhi3 you3 qi4 guan3 you3 yi1 chu4 zhong3 liu2
cues.en: while the younger son only has one tumor, in his trachea

cues.zh: 做个手术就可以治愈
cues.pinyin: zuo4 ge4 shou3 shu4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zhi4 yu4
cues.en: which a single surgery can cure

cues.zh: 也不着急
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 zhao2 ji2
cues.en: There's no rush with him either

cues.zh: 病程比较慢
cues.pinyin: bing4 cheng2 bi3 jiao4 man4
cues.en: since the disease progresses slowly

cues.zh: 可小美不愿意先做手术
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 mei3 bu4 yuan4 yi4 xian1 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: But Xiaomei refuses to have her own surgery first

cues.zh: 她的恢复时间太长
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 hui1 fu4 shi2 jian1 tai4 zhang3
cues.en: because her recovery time is too long

cues.zh: 那样就没办法照顾两个儿子
cues.pinyin: na4 yang4 jiu4 mei2 ban4 fa3 zhao4 gu4 liang3 ge4 er2 zi5
cues.en: and that way she couldn't take care of her two sons

cues.zh: 她也请不起保姆
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 qing3 bu4 qi3 bao3 mu3
cues.en: She can't afford a nanny either

cues.zh: 所以冒着生命危险
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mao4 zhe5 sheng1 ming4 wei1 xian3
cues.en: So, at the risk of her own life,

cues.zh: 也要医生先给儿子做手术
cues.pinyin: ye3 yao4 yi1 sheng1 xian1 gei3 er2 zi5 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: she insists the doctors operate on her son first

cues.zh: 等她好了再考虑自己
cues.pinyin: deng3 ta1 hao3 le5 zai4 kao3 lv4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: and only consider her own treatment once he's better

cues.zh: 这可愁坏了医生们
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 chou2 huai4 le5 yi1 sheng1 men5
cues.en: This really troubles the doctors

cues.zh: 要真等小美儿子病好的差不多
cues.pinyin: yao4 zhen1 deng3 xiao3 mei3 er2 zi5 bing4 hao3 de5 cha4 bu5 duo1
cues.en: If they really wait until Xiaomei's son has mostly recovered,

cues.zh: 小美的命可能也就差不多了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 ming4 ke3 neng2 ye3 jiu4 cha4 bu5 duo1 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei's own condition might be nearly fatal by then

cues.zh: 为了让小美早早做手术
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 rang4 xiao3 mei3 zao3 zao3 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: To get Xiaomei to have surgery sooner,

cues.zh: 萧嫣想到了一个办法
cues.pinyin: xiao1 yan1 xiang3 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ban4 fa3
cues.en: Shaun comes up with an idea

cues.zh: 可以做内镜下气管粘膜切除术
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zuo4 nei4 jing4 xia4 qi4 guan3 zhan1 mo2 qie1 chu2 shu4
cues.en: They can do an endoscopic tracheal mucosa resection

cues.zh: 小儿子的肿瘤是因为出生时
cues.pinyin: xiao3 er2 zi5 de5 zhong3 liu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 chu1 sheng1 shi2
cues.en: The younger son's tumor is because, at birth,

cues.zh: 在接触患上的
cues.pinyin: zai4 jie1 chu4 huan4 shang4 de5
cues.en: he was exposed to it in the birth canal

cues.zh: 她还年纪小
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 nian2 ji4 xiao3
cues.en: He's still young

cues.zh: 肿瘤范围有限
cues.pinyin: zhong3 liu2 fan4 wei2 you3 xian4
cues.en: and the tumor's extent is limited

cues.zh: 内镜切除应该就可以让她
cues.pinyin: nei4 jing4 qie1 chu2 ying1 gai1 jiu4 ke3 yi3 rang4 ta1
cues.en: so endoscopic removal should let him

cues.zh: 在几天之内回复
cues.pinyin: zai4 ji3 tian1 zhi1 nei4 hui2 fu4
cues.en: recover within just a few days

cues.zh: 而且这个手术也更安全一点
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 ye3 geng4 an1 quan2 yi4 dian3
cues.en: Plus this surgery is also a bit safer

cues.zh: 小美立刻又答应了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 li4 ke4 you4 da1 ying4 le5
cues.en: Xiaomei immediately agrees to it

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季01】天才医生肖恩“大婚”！女富婆为了测试医生故意装傻，肖恩的医院终于有金主了

cues.zh: 派对氛围温馨热情
cues.pinyin: pai4 dui4 fen1 wei2 wen1 xin1 re4 qing2
cues.en: The engagement party has a warm, cheerful atmosphere

cues.zh: 一切似乎都十分完美
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 si4 hu1 dou1 shi2 fen1 wan2 mei3
cues.en: Everything seems just about perfect

cues.zh: 安了心里没底的丽娅的心
cues.pinyin: an1 le5 xin1 li3 mei2 di3 de5 li4 ya4 de5 xin1
cues.en: It eases Lea's uneasy heart

cues.zh: 可伦叔因为和自己的老婆离婚太过伤心
cues.pinyin: ke3 lun2 shu1 yin1 wei4 he2 zi4 ji3 de5 lao3 po2 li2 hun1 tai4 guo4 shang1 xin1
cues.en: But Uncle Kelun, still heartbroken over his own divorce,

cues.zh: 小美的案子就担在了朴医生身上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 an4 zi5 jiu4 dan1 zai4 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1 shen1 shang4
cues.en: says some mood-killing things after drinking too much

cues.zh: 场面一度十分尴尬
cues.pinyin: chang3 mian4 yi2 du4 shi2 fen1 gan1 ga4
cues.en: and the scene gets quite awkward for a moment

cues.zh: 说回小美那里
cues.pinyin: shuo1 hui2 xiao3 mei3 na4 li3
cues.en: Back to Xiaomei's case

cues.zh: 萧恩忙着谈恋爱
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 mang2 zhe5 tan2 lian4 ai4
cues.en: Shaun is busy with his own romance

cues.zh: 小美的众人就担在了朴医生身上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 zhong4 ren2 jiu4 dan1 zai4 le5 pu3 yi1 sheng1 shen1 shang4
cues.en: so Xiaomei's case falls onto Dr. Park's shoulders

cues.zh: 摩根就在一旁看热闹
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 jiu4 zai4 yi1 pang2 kan4 re4 nao4
cues.en: Morgan is just watching the drama unfold from the side

cues.zh: 十分不客气地表示
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 bu2 ke4 qi4 di4 biao3 shi4
cues.en: and bluntly remarks

cues.zh: 如果萧恩都想不出一个合适的方案
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 xiao1 en1 dou1 xiang3 bu4 chu1 yi2 ge4 he2 shi4 de5 fang1 an4
cues.en: that if even Shaun can't figure out a suitable plan,

cues.zh: 就你那脑子还是算了吧
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ni3 na4 nao3 zi5 hai2 shi4 suan4 le5 ba5
cues.en: then with your brain, just forget it

cues.zh: 让他来劝小美
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 lai2 quan4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: What a devoted girlfriend, really

cues.zh: 不过既然科学拯救不了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 ji4 ran2 ke1 xue2 zheng3 jiu4 bu4 liao3
cues.en: But since science can't save the day,

cues.zh: 那就打感情牌
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 da3 gan3 qing2 pai2
cues.en: then it's time to play the emotional card

cues.zh: 朴医生找到了小哥哥
cues.pinyin: pu3 yi1 sheng1 zhao3 dao4 le5 xiao3 ge1 ge1
cues.en: Dr. Park tracks down Xiaomei's older brother

cues.zh: 让她来劝小美
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 lai2 quan4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: and has him try to persuade Xiaomei

cues.zh: 哥哥向小美道歉
cues.pinyin: ge1 ge1 xiang4 xiao3 mei3 dao4 qian4
cues.en: The brother apologizes to Xiaomei

cues.zh: 并将自己七九三月得来的勋章交给她
cues.pinyin: bing4 jiang1 zi4 ji3 qi1 jiu3 san1 yue4 de2 lai2 de5 xun1 zhang1 jiao1 gei3 ta1
cues.en: and hands her the medal he earned from his years of service

cues.zh: 表示自己一定会努力
cues.pinyin: biao3 shi4 zi4 ji3 yi2 ding4 hui4 nu3 li4
cues.en: saying he will definitely make the effort

cues.zh: 再次成为一个合格的哥哥
cues.pinyin: zai4 ci4 cheng2 wei2 yi2 ge4 he2 ge2 di1 ge1 ge1
cues.en: to become a good brother again

cues.zh: 接下来就让他来照顾两个外甥
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 jiu4 rang4 ta1 lai2 zhao4 gu4 liang3 ge4 wai4 sheng1
cues.en: From now on, he'll help take care of the two nephews

cues.zh: 血脉相连的亲情还是十分有用的
cues.pinyin: xue4 mai4 xiang1 lian2 de5 qin1 qing2 hai2 shi4 shi2 fen1 you3 yong4 de5
cues.en: Blood ties and family bonds still prove quite powerful

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季01】天才医生肖恩“大婚”！女富婆为了测试医生故意装傻，肖恩的医院终于有金主了

cues.zh: 小美被哥哥的儿童
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 bei4 ge1 ge1 de5 er2 tong2
cues.en: Xiaomei is moved by her brother's sincerity

cues.zh: 接受了她的群张
cues.pinyin: jie1 shou4 le5 ta1 de5 qun2 zhang1
cues.en: and accepts his persuasion

cues.zh: 愿意立即进行手术
cues.pinyin: yuan4 yi4 li4 ji2 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: agreeing to go ahead with the surgery right away

cues.zh: 手术很成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hen3 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery is a success

cues.zh: 并未出现什么意外
cues.pinyin: bing4 wei4 chu1 xian4 shen2 me5 yi4 wai4
cues.en: with no complications at all

cues.zh: 术后萧恩告诉小美
cues.pinyin: shu4 hou4 xiao1 en1 gao4 su4 xiao3 mei3
cues.en: After the surgery, Shaun tells Xiaomei

cues.zh: 你的哥哥并不完美
cues.pinyin: ni3 di1 ge1 ge1 bing4 bu4 wan2 mei3
cues.en: that her brother isn't perfect

cues.zh: 但有时候我们需要不完美的人
cues.pinyin: dan4 you3 shi2 hou4 wo3 men5 xu1 yao4 bu4 wan2 mei3 de5 ren2
cues.en: but sometimes we need imperfect people

cues.zh: 事情暂告一段落
cues.pinyin: shi4 qing2 zan4 gao4 yi2 duan4 luo4
cues.en: With things settled for now,

cues.zh: 萧恩和丽娅才有时间
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 he2 li4 ya4 cai2 you3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Shaun and Lea finally have time

cues.zh: 重新提及结婚的事情
cues.pinyin: chong2 xin1 ti2 ji2 jie2 hun1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: to bring up the wedding again

cues.zh: 萧恩告诉丽娅
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gao4 su4 li4 ya4
cues.en: Shaun tells Lea

cues.zh: 订婚派对都是你的错
cues.pinyin: ding4 hun1 pai4 dui4 dou1 shi4 ni3 de5 cuo4
cues.en: that the whole engagement party mess is her fault

cues.zh: 因为是你策划的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shi4 ni3 ce4 hua4 de5
cues.en: because she was the one who planned it

cues.zh: 这些都是你的责任
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dou1 shi4 ni3 de5 ze2 ren4
cues.en: so it's all on her

cues.zh: 丽娅还没来得及翻脸
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 hai2 mei2 lai2 de5 ji2 fan1 lian3
cues.en: Before Lea can even get upset,

cues.zh: 小元就有说道
cues.pinyin: xiao3 yuan2 jiu4 you3 shuo1 dao4
cues.en: Shaun adds

cues.zh: 当我们遇到麻烦的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 men5 yu4 dao4 ma2 fan2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that when we run into trouble,

cues.zh: 应该由我们俩共同承担
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 you2 wo3 men5 lia3 gong4 tong2 cheng2 dan1
cues.en: it should be shared by the two of us together

cues.zh: 所以我要帮你策划我们的婚礼
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 yao4 bang1 ni3 ce4 hua4 wo3 men5 de5 hun1 li3
cues.en: So he wants to help plan their wedding too

cues.zh: 即使搞砸了
cues.pinyin: ji2 shi3 gao3 za2 le5
cues.en: and even if it gets messed up,

cues.zh: 我们俩人都有责任
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lia3 ren2 dou1 you3 ze2 ren4
cues.en: they'll both be responsible for it

cues.zh: 直男撩妹最为致命
cues.pinyin: zhi2 nan2 liao1 mei4 zui4 wei4 zhi4 ming4
cues.en: A clueless, straightforward guy's way of flirting hits the hardest

cues.zh: 丽娅心情立刻转情
cues.pinyin: li4 ya4 xin1 qing2 li4 ke4 zhuan3 qing2
cues.en: and Lea's mood instantly brightens

cues.zh: 医院里经面上演了一出翻转闹剧
cues.pinyin: yi1 yuan4 li3 jing1 mian4 shang4 yan3 le5 yi1 chu1 fan1 zhuan3 nao4 ju4
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere in the hospital, another farce unfolds

cues.zh: 金姐经常感到呼吸急促
cues.pinyin: jin1 jie3 jing1 chang2 gan3 dao4 hu1 xi1 ji2 cu4
cues.en: Sister Jin often feels short of breath

cues.zh: 偶尔还会视力模糊
cues.pinyin: ou3 er3 hai2 hui4 shi4 li4 mo2 hu2
cues.en: and occasionally has blurred vision too,

cues.zh: 伴随头疼
cues.pinyin: ban4 sui2 tou2 teng2
cues.en: along with headaches

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医第五季01】天才医生肖恩“大婚”！女富婆为了测试医生故意装傻，肖恩的医院终于有金主了

cues.zh: 哪有时间听她吐槽自家医院
cues.pinyin: na3 you3 shi2 jian1 ting1 ta1 tu3 cao2 zi4 jia1 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: There's no time to hear her complain about her own hospital

cues.zh: 找来了泡妹
cues.pinyin: zhao3 lai2 le5 pao4 mei4
cues.en: so they call the nurse over

cues.zh: 将人带走去做 CT
cues.pinyin: jiang1 ren2 dai4 zou3 qu4 zuo4 CT
cues.en: and take her away for a CT scan

cues.zh: 果然 CT 显示右肾上有个多囊
cues.pinyin: guo3 ran2 CT xian3 shi4 you4 shen4 shang4 you3 ge4 duo1 nang2
cues.en: Sure enough, the CT shows multiple cysts on her right kidney

cues.zh: 这很有可能是个肿块
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 shi4 ge4 zhong3 kuai4
cues.en: which could very well be a mass

cues.zh: 得做个肾活检才能判断
cues.pinyin: de2 zuo4 ge4 shen4 huo2 jian3 cai2 neng2 pan4 duan4
cues.en: They'll need a kidney biopsy to tell for sure

cues.zh: 检查结果显示
cues.pinyin: jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 xian3 shi4
cues.en: The test results show

cues.zh: 金姐的肾脏有异常病变
cues.pinyin: jin1 jie3 de5 shen4 zang4 you3 yi4 chang2 bing4 bian4
cues.en: Sister Jin's kidney has an abnormal lesion

cues.zh: 可能是良性的
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 shi4 liang2 xing4 de5
cues.en: It might be benign

cues.zh: 但结合她的症状
cues.pinyin: dan4 jie2 he2 ta1 de5 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: but combined with her symptoms,

cues.zh: 却像是肾细胞癌
cues.pinyin: que4 xiang4 shi4 shen4 xi4 bao1 ai2
cues.en: it looks more like renal cell carcinoma

cues.zh: 需要对肿块做一个进一步检测
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 dui4 zhong3 kuai4 zuo4 yi2 ge4 jin4 yi2 bu4 jian3 ce4
cues.en: Further testing on the mass is needed

cues.zh: 才能确认
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 que4 ren4
cues.en: before they can confirm it

cues.zh: 就算得知自己有可能得了癌症
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 de2 zhi1 zi4 ji3 you3 ke3 neng2 de2 le5 ai2 zheng4
cues.en: Even learning she might have cancer,

cues.zh: 金姐并不慌张
cues.pinyin: jin1 jie3 bing4 bu4 huang1 zhang1
cues.en: Sister Jin isn't panicked at all

cues.zh: 很愉快地躺平接受
cues.pinyin: hen3 yu2 kuai4 di4 tang3 ping2 jie1 shou4
cues.en: and happily just goes along with

cues.zh: 接下来的检查和手术
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 de5 jian3 cha2 he2 shou3 shu4
cues.en: the upcoming tests and surgery

cues.zh: 胖妹叮嘱她
cues.pinyin: pang4 mei4 ding1 zhu3 ta1
cues.en: The nurse warns her

cues.zh: 从现在洗到肿块活浅之前
cues.pinyin: cong2 xian4 zai4 xi3 dao4 zhong3 kuai4 huo2 qian3 zhi1 qian2
cues.en: from now until right before the tumor biopsy,

cues.zh: 除了水之外
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 shui3 zhi1 wai4
cues.en: besides water,

cues.zh: 不要吃任何东西
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 chi1 ren4 he2 dong1 xi1
cues.en: not to eat anything at all

cues.zh: 金姐表面答应得很爽快
cues.pinyin: jin1 jie3 biao3 mian4 da1 ying4 de2 hen3 shuang3 kuai4
cues.en: On the surface Sister Jin agrees readily,

cues.zh: 但她注定不是个安生的主
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 zhu4 ding4 bu2 shi4 ge4 an1 sheng1 de5 zhu3
cues.en: but she's never been one to sit still

cues.zh: 胖妹一眼没看 N 处
cues.pinyin: pang4 mei4 yi1 yan3 mei2 kan4 N chu4
cues.en: The moment the nurse looks away,

cues.zh: 金姐又溜了
cues.pinyin: jin1 jie3 you4 liu1 le5
cues.en: Sister Jin slips off again

cues.zh: 此刻正缠着丽娅
cues.pinyin: ci3 ke4 zheng4 chan2 zhe5 li4 ya4
cues.en: and is now hanging around Lea,

cues.zh: 边聊边啃着三明治
cues.pinyin: bian1 liao2 bian1 ken3 zhe5 san1 ming2 zhi4
cues.en: chatting while munching on a sandwich

cues.zh: 这下把胖妹吸坏了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 ba3 pang4 mei4 xi1 huai4 le5
cues.en: which makes the nurse furious

cues.zh: 不是不让你吃东西吗
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 bu4 rang4 ni3 chi1 dong1 xi1 ma5
cues.en: Didn't I just tell you not to eat anything?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一朵花换一栋楼？荷兰郁金香狂热和长春君子兰疯狂（经济泡沫系列一）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 有一个小朋友跟我说他的同学开始炒鞋了
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1 ta1 de5 tong2 xue2 kai1 shi3 chao3 xie2 le5
cues.en: A kid told me his classmate started speculating on sneakers.

cues.zh: 把一双运动鞋买回来
cues.pinyin: ba3 yi1 shuang1 yun4 dong4 xie2 mai3 hui2 lai2
cues.en: He bought a pair of sneakers,

cues.zh: 一个月之内价格就上涨了几十倍
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 yue4 zhi1 nei4 jia4 ge2 jiu4 shang4 zhang3 le5 ji3 shi2 bei4
cues.en: and within a month the price shot up dozens of times over.

cues.zh: 他问我说一双运动鞋真的能值这么多钱吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 wen4 wo3 shuo1 yi1 shuang1 yun4 dong4 xie2 zhen1 de5 neng2 zhi2 zhe4 me5 duo1 qian2 ma5
cues.en: He asked me: can a pair of sneakers really be worth that much?

cues.zh: 其实在很短的时间内一个商品的价
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zai4 hen3 duan3 de5 shi2 jian1 nei4 yi2 ge4 shang1 pin3 de5 jia4
cues.en: Actually, for a product's price

cues.zh: 格上涨几十倍
cues.pinyin: ge2 shang4 zhang3 ji3 shi2 bei4
cues.en: to rise dozens of times over in a short period,

cues.zh: 只有两种可能的原因
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 liang3 zhong3 ke3 neng2 de5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: there are only two possible reasons.

cues.zh: 第一种是强烈的通货膨胀
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 zhong3 shi4 qiang2 lie4 de5 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4
cues.en: The first is severe inflation.

cues.zh: 第二种是经济泡沫
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 zhong3 shi4 jing1 ji4 pao4 mo4
cues.en: The second is an economic bubble.

cues.zh: 那么很显然炒鞋是属于后一种
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hen3 xian3 ran2 chao3 xie2 shi4 shu3 yu2 hou4 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: Clearly, sneaker speculation falls into the latter.

cues.zh: 我们准备通过四期节目来给大家
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhun3 bei4 tong1 guo4 si4 qi1 jie2 mu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1
cues.en: We're going to use four episodes

cues.zh: 介绍一下历史
cues.pinyin: jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 li4 shi3
cues.en: to introduce everyone to the history

cues.zh: 上的经济泡沫
cues.pinyin: shang4 de5 jing1 ji4 pao4 mo4
cues.en: of economic bubbles.

cues.zh: 听了这几期节目之后可能会让大家
cues.pinyin: ting1 le5 zhe4 ji3 qi1 jie2 mu4 zhi1 hou4 ke3 neng2 hui4 rang4 da4 jia1
cues.en: After watching these episodes, it may help you,

cues.zh: 他在以后面对各种泡沫的时候有一
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 yi3 hou4 mian4 dui4 ge4 zhong3 pao4 mo4 de5 shi2 hou4 you3 yi1
cues.en: when facing various bubbles in the future, to have

cues.zh: 个清醒的认识
cues.pinyin: ge4 qing1 xing3 de5 ren4 shi2
cues.en: a clear-headed understanding.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说一下人类历史上第一
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 ren2 lei4 li4 shi3 shang4 di4 yi1
cues.en: Let's first talk about the first

cues.zh: 次经济学泡沫
cues.pinyin: ci4 jing1 ji4 xue2 pao4 mo4
cues.en: economic bubble in human history.

cues.zh: 这个叫做郁金香狂热
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 zuo4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 kuang2 re4
cues.en: This is called Tulip Mania.

cues.zh: 说到郁金香大家会想到哪个国家呢
cues.pinyin: shuo1 dao4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 da4 jia1 hui4 xiang3 dao4 na3 ge5 guo2 jia1 ne5
cues.en: When you think of tulips, which country comes to mind?

cues.zh: 那很显然是荷兰对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 hen3 xian3 ran2 shi4 he2 lan2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Obviously the Netherlands, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一朵花换一栋楼？荷兰郁金香狂热和长春君子兰疯狂（经济泡沫系列一）

cues.zh: 因为荷兰是盛产郁金香的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 he2 lan2 shi4 sheng4 chan3 yu4 jin1 xiang1 de5
cues.en: Because the Netherlands produces tulips abundantly.

cues.zh: 荷兰的郁金香特别有名
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 de5 yu4 jin1 xiang1 te4 bie2 you3 ming2
cues.en: Dutch tulips are especially famous.

cues.zh: 但是荷兰的郁金香也曾经让荷
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 he2 lan2 de5 yu4 jin1 xiang1 ye3 ceng2 jing1 rang4 he2
cues.en: But Dutch tulips once also caused the

cues.zh: 兰人损失惨重
cues.pinyin: lan2 ren2 sun3 shi1 can3 zhong4
cues.en: Dutch people huge losses.

cues.zh: 这怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: How did that happen?

cues.zh: 我们先来说一说
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1
cues.en: Let's talk about it.

cues.zh: 这是在 300 年前发生的一件事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 zai4 300 nian2 qian2 fa1 sheng1 de5 yi1 jian4 shi4
cues.en: This happened 300 years ago.

cues.zh: 叫做郁金香狂热
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 kuang2 re4
cues.en: It's called Tulip Mania.

cues.zh: 那么先来说一说这个事件发生的背景
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jian4 fa1 sheng1 de5 bei4 jing3
cues.en: First, let's talk about the background of this event.

cues.zh: 这个事件发生的背景是什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 jian4 fa1 sheng1 de5 bei4 jing3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What was the background of this event?

cues.zh: 首先当时荷兰和西班牙打独立
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 dang1 shi2 he2 lan2 he2 xi1 ban1 ya2 da3 du2 li4
cues.en: First, at the time the Netherlands fought Spain for independence —

cues.zh: 战争荷西战争
cues.pinyin: zhan4 zheng1 he2 xi1 zhan4 zheng1
cues.en: the Dutch-Spanish War.

cues.zh: 后来这个荷西战争荷兰胜利了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 zhe4 ge5 he2 xi1 zhan4 zheng1 he2 lan2 sheng4 li4 le5
cues.en: Later, the Netherlands won this Dutch-Spanish War

cues.zh: 就保持了事实上的独立
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bao3 chi2 liao3 shi4 shi2 shang4 de5 du2 li4
cues.en: and maintained de facto independence.

cues.zh: 也就是说在政治上荷兰独立了
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zai4 zheng4 zhi4 shang4 he2 lan2 du2 li4 le5
cues.en: That is, politically the Netherlands became independent.

cues.zh: 政治独立之后自然要谋求经济利益对吧
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zhi4 du2 li4 zhi1 hou4 zi4 ran2 yao4 mou2 qiu2 jing1 ji4 li4 yi4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: After political independence, it naturally sought economic gain, right?

cues.zh: 于是荷兰就开始发展航海业
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 he2 lan2 jiu4 kai1 shi3 fa1 zhan3 hang2 hai3 ye4
cues.en: So the Netherlands began developing its maritime industry.

cues.zh: 把几个小公司组合起来
cues.pinyin: ba3 ji3 ge4 xiao3 gong1 si1 zu3 he2 qi3 lai2
cues.en: It merged several small companies together

cues.zh: 就组成了荷兰东印度公司
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zu3 cheng2 le5 he2 lan2 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: and formed the Dutch East India Company.

cues.zh: 荷兰的东印度公司
cues.pinyin: he2 lan2 de5 dong1 yin4 du4 gong1 si1
cues.en: The Dutch East India Company.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一朵花换一栋楼？荷兰郁金香狂热和长春君子兰疯狂（经济泡沫系列一）

cues.zh: 这个国家叫什么叫土耳其
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo2 jia1 jiao4 shen2 me5 jiao4 tu3 er3 qi2
cues.en: What was this country called? It was called Turkey.

cues.zh: 这个土耳其它当时在中亚那边
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tu3 er3 qi2 ta1 dang1 shi2 zai4 zhong1 ya4 na4 bian1
cues.en: This Ottoman Turkey, at the time, over in Central Asia,

cues.zh: 占了不少土地
cues.pinyin: zhan4 le5 bu4 shao3 tu3 di4
cues.en: had seized quite a lot of territory.

cues.zh: 后来又打下来了君士坦丁堡
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 you4 da3 xia4 lai2 le5 jun1 shi4 tan3 ding1 bao3
cues.en: Later it also conquered Constantinople.

cues.zh: 14 53 军事坦丁堡沦陷对吧
cues.pinyin: 14 53 jun1 shi4 tan3 ding1 bao3 lun2 xian4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: In 1453, Constantinople fell, right?

cues.zh: 打下君士坦丁堡之后就跟西欧接壤了
cues.pinyin: da3 xia4 jun1 shi4 tan3 ding1 bao3 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 gen1 xi1 ou1 jie1 rang3 le5
cues.en: After taking Constantinople, it bordered Western Europe.

cues.zh: 所以这个土耳其就逐渐地把这个郁金香就
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 tu3 er3 qi2 jiu4 zhu2 jian4 di4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yu4 jin1 xiang1 jiu4
cues.en: So Turkey gradually

cues.zh: 传播到了西欧
cues.pinyin: chuan2 bo1 dao4 le5 xi1 ou1
cues.en: spread tulips to Western Europe.

cues.zh: 传播到了西欧之后就到了法国
cues.pinyin: chuan2 bo1 dao4 le5 xi1 ou1 zhi1 hou4 jiu4 dao4 le5 fa3 guo2
cues.en: After spreading to Western Europe, they reached France.

cues.zh: 那法国人当时就以佩戴郁金香
cues.pinyin: na4 fa3 guo2 ren2 dang1 shi2 jiu4 yi3 pei4 dai4 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: At that time the French used wearing tulips

cues.zh: 为身份的标志
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen1 fen4 de5 biao1 zhi4
cues.en: as a symbol of status.

cues.zh: 这个贵妇们出席各种宴会
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gui4 fu4 men5 chu1 xi2 ge4 zhong3 yan4 hui4
cues.en: Noblewomen attending all kinds of banquets

cues.zh: 都必须要佩戴一份郁金香
cues.pinyin: dou1 bi4 xu1 yao4 pei4 dai4 yi1 fen4 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: all had to wear a tulip.

cues.zh: 所以郁金香的价格就比较高了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yu4 jin1 xiang1 de5 jia4 ge2 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 gao1 le5
cues.en: So the price of tulips became quite high.

cues.zh: 这个就是当时人们对于精神的一个追
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 dang1 shi2 ren2 men5 dui4 yu2 jing1 shen2 de5 yi2 ge4 zhui1
cues.en: This reflected people's pursuit of

cues.zh: 求精神的需要
cues.pinyin: qiu2 jing1 shen2 de5 xu1 yao4
cues.en: a spiritual, psychological need at the time.

cues.zh: 在这样的情况下
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 yang4 de5 qing2 kuang4 xia4
cues.en: Under these circumstances,

cues.zh: 郁金香就成为富人的一种奢侈品一种玩物
cues.pinyin: yu4 jin1 xiang1 jiu4 cheng2 wei2 fu4 ren2 de5 yi1 zhong3 she1 chi3 pin3 yi1 zhong3 wan2 wu4
cues.en: tulips became a luxury item and plaything for the rich.

cues.zh: 好那么这个东西后来为什么变成全民热炒
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 hou4 lai2 wei4 shen2 me5 bian4 cheng2 quan2 min2 re4 chao3
cues.en: So why did this later turn into something

cues.zh: 的一个东西呢
cues.pinyin: de5 yi2 ge4 dong1 xi1 ne5
cues.en: the whole nation speculated on?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一朵花换一栋楼？荷兰郁金香狂热和长春君子兰疯狂（经济泡沫系列一）

cues.zh: 我们成立一个行业协会
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 cheng2 li4 yi2 ge4 hang2 ye4 xie2 hui4
cues.en: They formed an industry association.

cues.zh: 以后就有组织了对吧
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 jiu4 you3 zu3 zhi1 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: After that there was an organization, right?

cues.zh: 这协会可以管我们了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie2 hui4 ke3 yi3 guan3 wo3 men5 le5
cues.en: This association could now regulate us.

cues.zh: 那么加入这个协会是有条件的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jia1 ru4 zhe4 ge5 xie2 hui4 shi4 you3 tiao2 jian4 de5
cues.en: Joining this association came with conditions.

cues.zh: 你私下交易郁金箱是不行的
cues.pinyin: ni3 si1 xia4 jiao1 yi4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 shi4 bu4 xing2 de5
cues.en: You weren't allowed to trade tulips privately.

cues.zh: 你每交易一份裕金箱都要给这个协
cues.pinyin: ni3 mei3 jiao1 yi4 yi1 fen4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 dou1 yao4 gei3 zhe4 ge5 xie2
cues.en: For every tulip you traded, you had to give this

cues.zh: 会一定的佣金
cues.pinyin: hui4 yi2 ding4 de5 yong4 jin1
cues.en: association a certain commission.

cues.zh: 但是这个佣金不太高
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yong4 jin1 bu4 tai4 gao1
cues.en: But this commission wasn't very high.

cues.zh: 又因为这个交易总在酒馆里边举行
cues.pinyin: you4 yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 jiao1 yi4 zong3 zai4 jiu3 guan3 li3 bian1 ju3 xing2
cues.en: And because the trading always took place in taverns,

cues.zh: 所以他们就把这个佣金就叫酒钱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 men5 jiu4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yong4 jin1 jiu4 jiao4 jiu3 qian2
cues.en: they called this commission 'wine money.'

cues.zh: 在酒馆里边交易裕金箱
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiu3 guan3 li3 bian1 jiao1 yi4 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: Trading tulips in the tavern

cues.zh: 同时给这个协会钱就叫酒钱
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 gei3 zhe4 ge5 xie2 hui4 qian2 jiu4 jiao4 jiu3 qian2
cues.en: while paying the association money — that was called 'wine money.'

cues.zh: 那么当时人们在酒馆里边聚集
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 dang1 shi2 ren2 men5 zai4 jiu3 guan3 li3 bian1 ju4 ji2
cues.en: So at the time people gathered in taverns,

cues.zh: 一起交易裕金箱的时候
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 jiao1 yi4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: and while trading tulips together,

cues.zh: 在酒馆里边交易郁金香
cues.pinyin: zai4 jiu3 guan3 li3 bian1 jiao1 yi4 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: someone noticed a problem:

cues.zh: 就是这个价格是在波动的
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 jia4 ge2 shi4 zai4 bo1 dong4 de5
cues.en: the price was fluctuating.

cues.zh: 那么如果我在价格低的时候买入裕金箱
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 wo3 zai4 jia4 ge2 di1 de5 shi2 hou4 mai3 ru4 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: So if I buy tulips when the price is low,

cues.zh: 过一会价格高了我再卖我不就赚
cues.pinyin: guo4 yi1 hui4 jia4 ge2 gao1 le5 wo3 zai4 mai4 wo3 bu4 jiu4 zhuan4
cues.en: and sell later when the price is high, wouldn't I

cues.zh: 钱了吗对不对
cues.pinyin: qian2 le5 ma5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: make money, right?

cues.zh: 于是有人发现了这里面的商机
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 fa1 xian4 le5 zhe4 li3 mian4 de5 shang1 ji1
cues.en: So someone spotted the business opportunity here,

cues.zh: 就有人开始囤积裕金箱然后炒作
cues.pinyin: jiu4 you3 ren2 kai1 shi3 tun2 ji1 yu4 jin1 xiang1 ran2 hou4 chao3 zuo4
cues.en: and people started hoarding tulips and speculating.

cues.zh: 所以这个最狂热的时间是发生在
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 zui4 kuang2 re4 de5 shi2 jian1 shi4 fa1 sheng1 zai4
cues.en: So the most frenzied period occurred

cues.zh: 16 36 年的时候
cues.pinyin: 16 36 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一朵花换一栋楼？荷兰郁金香狂热和长春君子兰疯狂（经济泡沫系列一）

cues.zh: 在 16 36 年 12 月这个时候到了年底了
cues.pinyin: zai4 16 36 nian2 12 yue4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 hou4 dao4 le5 nian2 di3 le5
cues.en: By December 1636, as the year drew to a close,

cues.zh: 当年的郁金箱囚境
cues.pinyin: dang1 nian2 de5 yu4 jin1 xiang1 qiu2 jing4
cues.en: that year's tulip bulbs —

cues.zh: 他们交易的主要是一种囚境
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiao1 yi4 de5 zhu3 yao4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 qiu2 jing4
cues.en: what they mainly traded was a kind of bulb.

cues.zh: 这个囚境你就交易完了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qiu2 jing4 ni3 jiu4 jiao1 yi4 wan2 le5
cues.en: Once you'd traded this bulb,

cues.zh: 没有了
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 le5
cues.en: it was gone.

cues.zh: 但是很多人想那我还是要买怎么办
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hen3 duo1 ren2 xiang3 na4 wo3 hai2 shi4 yao4 mai3 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: But many people thought: I still want to buy, what do I do?

cues.zh: 有人说别着急
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 shuo1 bie2 zhao2 ji2
cues.en: Someone said, don't worry,

cues.zh: 明年不是还有吗
cues.pinyin: ming2 nian2 bu2 shi4 hai2 you3 ma5
cues.en: won't there be more next year?

cues.zh: 我从土里边挖出这个囚境来
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 tu3 li3 bian1 wa1 chu1 zhe4 ge5 qiu2 jing4 lai2
cues.en: I'll dig this bulb out of the ground —

cues.zh: 只是还没有成熟
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shi4 hai2 mei2 you3 cheng2 shu2
cues.en: it's just not mature yet.

cues.zh: 我不能挖对不对
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 neng2 wa1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: I can't dig it up, right?

cues.zh: 于是他们就发明了世界上最早的什么呢
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 men5 jiu4 fa1 ming2 le5 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 zao3 de5 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So they invented what was the world's earliest —

cues.zh: 期货
cues.pinyin: qi1 huo4
cues.en: futures.

cues.zh: 这个最早的期货其实就是用来
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zui4 zao3 de5 qi1 huo4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 yong4 lai2
cues.en: These earliest futures were actually used

cues.zh: 交易郁金箱的
cues.pinyin: jiao1 yi4 yu4 jin1 xiang1 de5
cues.en: to trade tulips.

cues.zh: 他们交易的是 16 37 年 4 月交割
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jiao1 yi4 de5 shi4 16 37 nian2 4 yue4 jiao1 ge1
cues.en: What they traded was for delivery in April 1637 —

cues.zh: 的这个郁金箱
cues.pinyin: de5 zhe4 ge5 yu4 jin1 xiang1
cues.en: these tulips.

cues.zh: 可能有同学对于期货概念不太了解

cues.pinyin: ye3 you3 peng2 you3 ceng2 jing1 bei4 qi2 yu2 ci4 chuan1 guo4 xiao3 tui3
cues.en: A friend of mine once had his calf pierced by a stingray.

items.title_zh: 中国第一人：他花8年拍下绝美影像，很多是人类第一次见到 Chinese Photographer Spends 8 Years Taking Photos of

cues.zh: 经常会是冬天拍摄
cues.pinyin: jing1 chang2 hui4 shi4 dong1 tian1 pai1 she4
cues.en: Filming often happens in winter.

cues.zh: 甚至会打哆嗦会有失温的这种感觉
cues.pinyin: shen4 zhi4 hui4 da3 duo1 suo5 hui4 you3 shi1 wen1 de5 zhe4 zhong3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: You even shiver and feel like you're getting hypothermia.

cues.zh: 很多人说幽闭空间恐惧症
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 ren2 shuo1 you1 bi4 kong1 jian1 kong3 ju4 zheng4
cues.en: Many people call it claustrophobia.

cues.zh: 可能更多的我会感到兴奋
cues.pinyin: ke3 neng2 geng4 duo1 de5 wo3 hui4 gan3 dao4 xing1 fen4
cues.en: But for me, it's more about feeling excited.

cues.zh: 四周都被水所环绕
cues.pinyin: si4 zhou1 dou1 bei4 shui3 suo3 huan2 rao4
cues.en: Surrounded by water on every side.

cues.zh: 一种大失重的环境下
cues.pinyin: yi1 zhong3 da4 shi1 zhong4 de5 huan2 jing4 xia4
cues.en: In an environment of near-total weightlessness.

cues.zh: 浮游生物在夜间它会发出这些点点的星光
cues.pinyin: fu2 you2 sheng1 wu4 zai4 ye4 jian1 ta1 hui4 fa1 chu1 zhe4 xie1 dian3 dian3 de5 xing1 guang1
cues.en: At night, plankton give off these little twinkling, star-like lights.

cues.zh: 跟置身在宇宙一样非常美好
cues.pinyin: gen1 zhi4 shen1 zai4 yu3 zhou4 yi1 yang4 fei1 chang2 mei3 hao3
cues.en: It's as beautiful as being out in space.

cues.zh: 我是在海南长大的
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 zai4 hai3 nan2 zhang3 da4 de5
cues.en: I grew up in Hainan.

cues.zh: 毕业之后我做了一年的游戏工作
cues.pinyin: bi4 ye4 zhi1 hou4 wo3 zuo4 le5 yi1 nian2 de5 you2 xi4 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: After graduating, I worked in the gaming industry for a year.

cues.zh: 我从花鸟鱼虫市场提这条鱼回来
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 hua1 niao3 yu2 chong2 shi4 chang3 ti2 zhe4 tiao2 yu2 hui2 lai2
cues.en: I brought this fish home from the pet market.

cues.zh: 老板就撞上我问我你还想不想干呢
cues.pinyin: lao3 ban3 jiu4 zhuang4 shang4 wo3 wen4 wo3 ni3 hai2 xiang3 bu4 xiang3 gan4 ne5
cues.en: My boss ran into me and asked if I still wanted to keep working there.

cues.zh: 我说干不干都行吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 gan4 bu4 gan4 dou1 xing2 ba5
cues.en: I said either way was fine with me.

cues.zh: 后来就离开了
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 jiu4 li2 kai1 le5
cues.en: So eventually I left.

cues.zh: 我在海上漂泊经常会没有信号
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 hai3 shang4 piao1 bo2 jing1 chang2 hui4 mei2 you3 xin4 hao4
cues.en: Out drifting at sea, I often have no signal.

cues.zh: 家人经常会联系不上我
cues.pinyin: jia1 ren2 jing1 chang2 hui4 lian2 xi4 bu4 shang4 wo3
cues.en: My family often can't get in touch with me.

cues.zh: 我妈就经常跟我说
cues.pinyin: wo3 ma1 jiu4 jing1 chang2 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: My mom often tells me,

cues.zh: 哪怕你是在楼下卖菜
cues.pinyin: na3 pa4 ni3 shi4 zai4 lou2 xia4 mai4 cai4
cues.en: even if you were just selling vegetables downstairs,

cues.zh: 至少我每天能看到你
cues.pinyin: zhi4 shao3 wo3 mei3 tian1 neng2 kan4 dao4 ni3
cues.en: at least I'd get to see you every day.

cues.zh: 从年轻的时候我就有强直性脊椎炎
cues.pinyin: cong2 nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 you3 qiang2 zhi2 xing4 ji3 zhui1 yan2
cues.en: Since I was young, I've had ankylosing spondylitis.

cues.zh: 医生告诉我这个病其实是要远离潮湿
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gao4 su4 wo3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 qi2 shi2 shi4 yao4 yuan3 li2 chao2 shi1
cues.en: The doctor told me that with this condition, I should actually stay away from damp environments.

cues.zh: 潮湿的时候会腿痛
cues.pinyin: chao2 shi1 de5 shi2 hou4 hui4 tui3 tong4
cues.en: When it's damp, my legs hurt.

cues.zh: 一边腿使不上劲
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 tui3 shi3 bu4 shang4 jin4
cues.en: One of my legs loses its strength.

cues.zh: 因为身体的疾病去放弃我自己喜欢的东西
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shen1 ti3 de5 ji2 bing4 qu4 fang4 qi4 wo3 zi4 ji3 xi3 huan1 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: To give up something I love because of a physical illness—

cues.zh: 没有必要
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 bi4 yao4
cues.en: —there's no need for that.

cues.zh: 我们作为一个访问者
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 fang3 wen4 zhe3
cues.en: As visitors ourselves,

cues.zh: 往往是很受包容的
cues.pinyin: wang3 wang3 shi4 hen3 shou4 bao1 rong2 de5
cues.en: we're often given a lot of tolerance.

cues.zh: 那这些海洋生物每天都会有它很规则的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 xie1 hai3 yang2 sheng1 wu4 mei3 tian1 du1 hui4 you3 ta1 hen3 gui1 ze2 de5
cues.en: These sea creatures have their own very regular

cues.zh: 一个生活方式
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 sheng1 huo2 fang1 shi4
cues.en: way of life.

cues.zh: 反而是人类的很多行为对于这些
cues.pinyin: fan3 er2 shi4 ren2 lei4 de5 hen3 duo1 xing2 wei2 dui4 yu2 zhe4 xie1
cues.en: Whereas many human behaviors, when it comes to these

cues.zh: 海洋生物来讲
cues.pinyin: hai3 yang2 sheng1 wu4 lai2 jiang3
cues.en: marine creatures,

cues.zh: 它可能是致命的
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 neng2 shi4 zhi4 ming4 de5
cues.en: can be lethal to them.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 你会为了一种热爱，百分百地投入吗？

cues.zh: 我放弃掉了一个已经是无限期合同的机会
cues.pinyin: wo3 fang4 qi4 diao4 le5 yi2 ge4 yi3 jing1 shi4 wu2 xian4 qi1 he2 tong2 de5 ji1 hui4
cues.en: I gave up an opportunity that was already a permanent contract.

cues.zh: 我想把自己的未来掌握在自己手里
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 wei4 lai2 zhang3 wo4 zai4 zi4 ji3 shou3 li3
cues.en: I wanted to take my future into my own hands.

cues.zh: 当你进入这种状态的时候个人是享受的
cues.pinyin: dang1 ni3 jin4 ru4 zhe4 zhong3 zhuang4 tai4 de5 shi2 hou4 ge4 ren2 shi4 xiang3 shou4 de5
cues.en: When you enter that state, you personally enjoy it.

cues.zh: 有的时候车也是一把钥匙
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 shi2 hou4 che1 ye3 shi4 yi1 ba3 yao4 shi5
cues.en: Sometimes a car is also a key.

cues.zh: 它会开启你不同的一个经历和旅程
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 kai1 qi3 ni3 bu4 tong2 de5 yi2 ge4 jing1 li4 he2 lv3 cheng2
cues.en: It opens up a different experience and journey for you.

cues.zh: 那一定有代价对别人可能一文不值
cues.pinyin: na4 yi2 ding4 you3 dai4 jia4 dui4 bie2 ren2 ke3 neng2 yi1 wen2 bu4 zhi2
cues.en: There's definitely a price to pay — to others it might be worthless.

cues.zh: 但对你来说这就是全部
cues.pinyin: dan4 dui4 ni3 lai2 shuo1 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 quan2 bu4
cues.en: But to you, it's everything.

cues.zh: C C 我在这里祝大家感恩节快乐
cues.pinyin: C C wo3 zai4 zhe4 li3 zhu4 da4 jia1 gan3 en1 jie2 kuai4 le4
cues.en: CiCi here, wishing everyone a happy Thanksgiving

cues.zh: 那今天跟大家分享的是酱油烧全鸡
cues.pinyin: na4 jin1 tian1 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 jiang4 you2 shao1 quan2 ji1
cues.en: Today I'm sharing soy sauce whole roasted chicken with you

cues.zh: 如果你希望我们今天这个鸡肉上色的话呢
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 xi1 wang4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 shang4 se4 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: If you want your chicken to get that nice browned color

cues.zh: 这里有一个小秘诀可以给大家分享
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 you3 yi2 ge4 xiao3 mi4 jue2 ke3 yi3 gei3 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3
cues.en: there's a little secret I can share with you

cues.zh: 就是在洗这个鸡肉的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zai4 xi3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: which is, when you're washing the chicken

cues.zh: 我们可以稍微放一点小苏打粉在鸡皮上
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 shao1 wei1 fang4 yi4 dian3 xiao3 su1 da2 fen3 zai4 ji1 pi2 shang4
cues.en: we can sprinkle a bit of baking soda on the chicken skin

cues.zh: 然后就是这样子搓搓搓
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 zi5 cuo1 cuo1 cuo1
cues.en: and then just rub it like this, rub rub rub

cues.zh: 然后用这个温水给它洗干净
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 wen1 shui3 gei3 ta1 xi3 gan1 jing4
cues.en: then rinse it clean with warm water

cues.zh: 我们把鸡肉擦干之后呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 ji1 rou4 ca1 gan4 zhi1 hou4 ne5
cues.en: after we pat the chicken dry

cues.zh: 我们可以继续使用一张纸巾
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ji4 xu4 shi3 yong4 yi1 zhang1 zhi3 jin1
cues.en: we can go ahead and use a paper towel

cues.zh: 就是把这个鸡肉
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: to take the chicken

cues.zh: 鸡皮表层的一层脂肪给它搓干净
cues.pinyin: ji1 pi2 biao3 ceng2 de5 yi1 ceng2 zhi1 fang2 gei3 ta1 cuo1 gan1 jing4
cues.en: and rub off that layer of fat on the surface of the skin

cues.zh: 这样子做的好处呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 de5 hao3 chu4 ne5
cues.en: the benefit of doing this

cues.zh: 就是等一下我们鸡肉会非常容易上色
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 deng3 yi2 xia4 wo3 men5 ji1 rou4 hui4 fei1 chang2 rong2 yi4 shang4 se4
cues.en: is that later the chicken will brown very easily

cues.zh: 而且这个鸡肉看上去会非常的亮丽
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 rou4 kan4 shang4 qu4 hui4 fei1 chang2 de5 liang4 li4
cues.en: and the chicken will look really glossy

cues.zh: 我们先使用大火
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xian1 shi3 yong4 da4 huo3

cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zhuan3 xiao3 huo3 ji4 xu4 zhu3 wu3 fen1 zhong1

cues.zh: 把鸡肉拿出来先放旁边

cues.zh: 一汤匙老抽

cues.zh: 四汤匙绍兴酒

cues.en: four tablespoons of Shaoxing wine

cues.zh: 两汤匙蚝油
cues.pinyin: liang3 tang1 chi2 hao2 you2
cues.en: two tablespoons of oyster sauce

cues.zh: 少许盐
cues.pinyin: shao3 xu3 yan2
cues.en: a little salt

cues.zh: 三片姜
cues.pinyin: san1 pian4 jiang1
cues.en: three slices of ginger

cues.zh: 一根葱
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1 cong1
cues.en: one scallion

cues.zh: 一根肉桂
cues.pinyin: yi1 gen1 rou4 gui4
cues.en: one cinnamon stick

cues.zh: 两个草果

cues.zh: 三个八角

cues.en: three star anise

cues.zh: 两片月桂叶
cues.pinyin: liang3 pian4 yue4 gui4 ye4

cues.zh: 四分之一杯水

cues.en: a quarter cup of water

cues.zh: 一块黄冰糖

cues.zh: 我们稍微给它煮一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shao1 wei1 gei3 ta1 zhu3 yi1 xia4
cues.en: we'll let it simmer for a bit

cues.zh: 到这个冰糖化了为止
cues.pinyin: dao4 zhe4 ge5 bing1 tang2 hua4 le5 wei2 zhi3
cues.en: until the rock sugar has dissolved

cues.zh: 接下来呢我们把我们的鸡肉
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ne5 wo3 men5 ba3 wo3 men5 de5 ji1 rou4
cues.en: next we take our chicken

cues.zh: 放进来然后用小火
cues.pinyin: fang4 jin4 lai2 ran2 hou4 yong4 xiao3 huo3
cues.en: put it in, then use low heat

cues.zh: 给它慢慢的煮
cues.pinyin: gei3 ta1 man4 man4 de5 zhu3
cues.en: and let it cook slowly

cues.zh: 然后时不时呢就是把这个酱汁
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 shi2 bu4 shi2 ne5 jiu4 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 jiang4 zhi1
cues.en: and from time to time, this sauce

cues.zh: 淋在鸡上
cues.pinyin: lin2 zai4 ji1 shang4
cues.en: we spoon it over the chicken

cues.zh: 这样子做大概五分钟
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 zi5 zuo4 da4 gai4 wu3 fen1 zhong1
cues.en: we do this for about 5 minutes

cues.zh: 然后现在给鸡呢翻一下面
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 xian4 zai4 gei3 ji1 ne5 fan1 yi1 xia4 mian4
cues.en: then now we flip the chicken over again

cues.zh: 然后还是一样把这个酱汁淋在鸡的身体上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 hai2 shi4 yi1 yang4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 jiang4 zhi1 lin2 zai4 ji1 de5 shen1 ti3 shang4

cues.zh: 在这个煮的过程呢

cues.en: during this cooking process

cues.zh: 我们会需要把这个鸡翻几次面
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hui4 xu1 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 fan1 ji3 ci4 mian4

cues.zh: 然后一直把这个酱汁淋在鸡肉上
