cues.pinyin: zhen1 de5 shi4 hao3 chi1
cues.en: it's really delicious

cues.zh: 那如果有什么问题的话呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 you3 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 de5 hua4 ne5
cues.en: so if you have any questions

cues.zh: 随时留言也告诉我
cues.pinyin: sui2 shi2 liu2 yan2 ye3 gao4 su4 wo3
cues.en: feel free to leave a comment and let me know anytime

cues.zh: 这个感恩节你打算要做什么菜
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 gan3 en1 jie2 ni3 da3 suan4 yao4 zuo4 shen2 me5 cai4
cues.en: what dish are you planning to make this Thanksgiving

cues.zh: 我很想知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 xiang3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: I'd love to know

cues.zh: 那也别忘了订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: na4 ye3 bie2 wang4 le5 ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: also don't forget to subscribe and hit like

cues.zh: 我们下期见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 qi1 jian4 ge1
cues.en: see you next time

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: bye bye

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 他是韩国历史上最憋屈的银行劫匪
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 han2 guo2 li4 shi3 shang4 zui4 bie1 qu1 de5 yin2 hang2 jie2 fei3
cues.en: He was the most wronged bank robber in Korean history.

cues.zh: 不是因为计划不周
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ji4 hua4 bu4 zhou1
cues.en: Not because his plan was sloppy,

cues.zh: 而是因为他本来就是一名警察
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 ben3 lai2 jiu4 shi4 yi1 ming2 jing3 cha2
cues.en: but because he was actually a police officer.

cues.zh: 别人演习都是走个过场
cues.pinyin: bie2 ren2 yan3 xi2 dou1 shi4 zou3 ge4 guo4 chang3
cues.en: When others run drills, they just go through the motions,

cues.zh: 胡弄下领导就算了但这哥们可太实在了
cues.pinyin: hu2 nong4 xia4 ling3 dao3 jiu4 suan4 le5 dan4 zhe4 ge1 men5 ke3 tai4 shi2 zai4 le5
cues.en: fooling the boss a little would've been fine, but this guy was way too serious.

cues.zh: 居然真的去研究怎么抢银行
cues.pinyin: ju1 ran2 zhen1 de5 qu4 yan2 jiu1 zen3 me5 qiang3 yin2 hang2
cues.en: He actually went and researched how to rob a bank for real.

cues.zh: 原本一场可以轻松结束的演习
cues.pinyin: yuan2 ben3 yi1 chang2 ke3 yi3 qing1 song1 jie2 shu4 de5 yan3 xi2
cues.en: What was originally a drill that could've ended easily

cues.zh: 竟然变成了无法收尾的真人秀
cues.pinyin: jing4 ran2 bian4 cheng2 liao3 wu2 fa3 shou1 wei3 de5 zhen1 ren2 xiu4
cues.en: somehow turned into a reality show that couldn't be wrapped up.

cues.zh: 你绝对想不到这个站在路口吃灰的交警
cues.pinyin: ni3 jue2 dui4 xiang3 bu2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 zhan4 zai4 lu4 kou3 chi1 hui1 de5 jiao1 jing3
cues.en: You'd never guess this traffic cop standing at the intersection eating exhaust fumes

cues.zh: 就是我们今天的男主杜满
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 jin1 tian1 de5 nan2 zhu3 du4 man3
cues.en: is our male lead today, Du Man.

cues.zh: 他曾经是一名铁血刑警
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 shi4 yi1 ming2 tie3 xue4 xing2 jing3
cues.en: He used to be an iron-willed detective,

cues.zh: 却因查办领导贪污
cues.pinyin: que4 yin1 cha2 ban4 ling3 dao3 tan1 wu1
cues.en: but because he investigated a superior for corruption,

cues.zh: 结果案子黄了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 an4 zi5 huang2 le5
cues.en: the case fell through,

cues.zh: 人也被一撸到底
cues.pinyin: ren2 ye3 bei4 yi1 lu1 dao4 di3
cues.en: and he himself was demoted all the way down,

cues.zh: 下放到了交警队
cues.pinyin: xia4 fang4 dao4 le5 jiao1 jing3 dui4
cues.en: sent down to the traffic police unit.

cues.zh: 这天他刚拦下一辆违章轿车
cues.pinyin: zhe4 tian1 ta1 gang1 lan2 xia4 yi1 liang4 wei2 zhang1 jiao4 che1
cues.en: That day he'd just pulled over a car for a traffic violation,

cues.zh: 没想到开车的
cues.pinyin: mei2 xiang3 dao4 kai1 che1 de5
cues.en: never expecting that the driver

cues.zh: 竟是今天刚上任的警察署署长
cues.pinyin: jing4 shi4 jin1 tian1 gang1 shang4 ren4 de5 jing3 cha2 shu3 shu3 zhang3
cues.en: was actually the police chief who'd just taken office that day.

cues.zh: 署长亮出自己的身份后
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 liang4 chu1 zi4 ji3 de5 shen1 fen4 hou4
cues.en: After the chief revealed his identity,

cues.zh: 心里估摸着杜满总得给点面子
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 gu1 mo1 zhe5 du4 man3 zong3 dei3 gei3 dian3 mian4 zi5
cues.en: Du Man figured he'd surely be given some face.

cues.zh: 可没成想杜满下一秒就按住车窗
cues.pinyin: ke3 mei2 cheng2 xiang3 du4 man3 xia4 yi1 miao3 jiu4 an4 zhu4 che1 chuang1
cues.en: But unexpectedly, Du Man kept his hand on the window the very next second,

cues.zh: 态度还非常坚决
cues.pinyin: tai4 du4 hai2 fei1 chang2 jian1 jue2
cues.en: his attitude extremely firm.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 虽然表现的十分尊重署长
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 biao3 xian4 de5 shi2 fen1 zun1 zhong4 shu3 zhang3
cues.en: Although he showed the chief plenty of respect,

cues.zh: 但该开的罚单一张也不能少
cues.pinyin: dan4 gai1 kai1 de5 fa2 dan1 yi1 zhang1 ye3 bu4 neng2 shao3
cues.en: not a single ticket that needed writing was skipped.

cues.zh: 不得不说
cues.pinyin: bu4 de2 bu4 shuo1
cues.en: Gotta say,

cues.zh: 这哥们是真够勇猛的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge1 men5 shi4 zhen1 gou4 yong3 meng3 de5
cues.en: this guy was truly fearless.

cues.zh: 连署长的面子都不给
cues.pinyin: lian2 shu3 zhang3 de5 mian4 zi5 dou1 bu4 gei3
cues.en: He wouldn't even give the chief face,

cues.zh: 这都不算是公事公办了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dou1 bu4 suan4 shi4 gong1 shi4 gong1 ban4 le5
cues.en: this wasn't just "by the book,"

cues.zh: 简直就是当代包公了
cues.pinyin: jian3 zhi2 jiu4 shi4 dang1 dai4 bao1 gong1 liao3
cues.en: it was practically modern-day Judge Bao.

cues.zh: 结果署长上任第一天
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 shu3 zhang3 shang4 ren4 di4 yi1 tian1
cues.en: As a result, on the chief's very first day in office,

cues.zh: 就攥着这张罚单去开欢迎会了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zuan4 zhe5 zhe4 zhang1 fa2 dan1 qu4 kai1 huan1 ying2 hui4 le5
cues.en: he clutched this ticket and went straight to his own welcome party.

cues.zh: 交通队长一看见这张罚单
cues.pinyin: jiao1 tong1 dui4 zhang3 yi1 kan4 jian4 zhe4 zhang1 fa2 dan1
cues.en: The moment the traffic captain saw this ticket,

cues.zh: 脸瞬间绿了
cues.pinyin: lian3 shun4 jian1 lv4 le5
cues.en: his face instantly turned green.

cues.zh: 赶紧把杜满拉到一边
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 ba3 du4 man3 la1 dao4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: He quickly pulled Du Man aside

cues.zh: 狠狠的训斥了一番
cues.pinyin: hen3 hen3 de5 xun4 chi4 le5 yi1 fan1
cues.en: and gave him a fierce dressing-down,

cues.zh: 麻烦他不懂变通
cues.pinyin: ma2 fan2 ta1 bu4 dong3 bian4 tong1
cues.en: scolding him for not knowing how to be flexible.

cues.zh: 这下奖金怕是要泡汤了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 jiang3 jin1 pa4 shi4 yao4 pao4 tang1 le5
cues.en: Now the bonus was probably shot.

cues.zh: 满心委屈的杜满
cues.pinyin: man3 xin1 wei3 qu1 de5 du4 man3
cues.en: Feeling wronged and upset, Du Man

cues.zh: 只能约上好兄弟到路边喝酒消愁
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 yue1 shang4 hao3 xiong1 di4 dao4 lu4 bian1 he1 jiu3 xiao1 chou2
cues.en: could only ask a good buddy out for drinks to drown his sorrows.

cues.zh: 兄弟一直为他抱不平
cues.pinyin: xiong1 di4 yi4 zhi2 wei4 ta1 bao4 bu4 ping2
cues.en: His buddy kept feeling indignant on his behalf —

cues.zh: 本来就被贬职了
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 jiu4 bei4 bian3 zhi2 le5
cues.en: he'd already been demoted once,

cues.zh: 这下又得罪了新来的署长
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xia4 you4 de2 zui4 le5 xin1 lai2 de5 shu3 zhang3
cues.en: and now he'd offended the new chief too,

cues.zh: 以后日子恐怕会更难过
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 ri4 zi5 kong3 pa4 hui4 geng4 nan2 guo4
cues.en: so life ahead was probably only going to get harder.

cues.zh: 可杜满也没办法
cues.pinyin: ke3 du4 man3 ye3 mei2 ban4 fa3
cues.en: But there was nothing Du Man could do;

cues.zh: 他只是在做自己的本职工作
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 shi4 zai4 zuo4 zi4 ji3 de5 ben3 zhi2 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: he was just doing his actual job.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 新署长屁股还没坐热
cues.pinyin: xin1 shu3 zhang3 pi4 gu3 hai2 mei2 zuo4 re4
cues.en: the new chief hadn't even warmed his seat yet

cues.zh: 就遇上大麻烦了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yu4 shang4 da4 ma2 fan2 le5
cues.en: when he ran into a huge problem.

cues.zh: 侦查科的人来报
cues.pinyin: zhen1 cha2 ke1 de5 ren2 lai2 bao4
cues.en: Someone from the investigation unit came to report:

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 参演角色通过抽签决定
cues.pinyin: can1 yan3 jue2 se4 tong1 guo4 chou1 qian1 jue2 ding4
cues.en: the roles in the exercise would be decided by drawing lots,

cues.zh: 显得公平又神秘
cues.pinyin: xian3 de5 gong1 ping2 you4 shen2 mi4
cues.en: which seemed both fair and mysterious.

cues.zh: 但谁都没想到署长竟公报私仇
cues.pinyin: dan4 shei2 dou1 mei2 xiang3 dao4 shu3 zhang3 jing4 gong1 bao4 si1 chou2
cues.en: But no one expected the chief to use it to settle a personal grudge.

cues.zh: 他悄悄找到杜满指定杜满扮演强盗
cues.pinyin: ta1 qiao1 qiao1 zhao3 dao4 du4 man3 zhi3 ding4 du4 man3 ban4 yan3 qiang2 dao4
cues.en: He secretly found Du Man and assigned him to play the robber,

cues.zh: 还强硬的表示这是命令
cues.pinyin: hai2 qiang2 ying4 de5 biao3 shi4 zhe4 shi4 ming4 ling4
cues.en: firmly stating that this was an order.

cues.zh: 让他想尽办法抢劫银行
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 xiang3 jin3 ban4 fa3 qiang3 jie2 yin2 hang2
cues.en: He told him to find any way possible to "rob" the bank,

cues.zh: 关于抓捕的事情则由警察负责
cues.pinyin: guan1 yu2 zhua1 bu3 de5 shi4 qing2 ze2 you2 jing3 cha2 fu4 ze2
cues.en: while the actual capture would be handled by the police.

cues.zh: 杜满心里满是不乐意
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 xin1 li3 man3 shi4 bu4 le4 yi4
cues.en: Du Man was full of reluctance about this —

cues.zh: 这跟署长之前说的根本不一样
cues.pinyin: zhe4 gen1 shu3 zhang3 zhi1 qian2 shuo1 de5 gen1 ben3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: this was completely different from what the chief had said before.

cues.zh: 可领导都发话了
cues.pinyin: ke3 ling3 dao3 dou1 fa1 hua4 le5
cues.en: But since his superior had given the order,

cues.zh: 他也只能答应
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 zhi3 neng2 da1 ying4
cues.en: he could only agree.

cues.zh: 临走前
cues.pinyin: lin2 zou3 qian2
cues.en: Before he left,

cues.zh: 杜满小声跟署长说
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 xiao3 sheng1 gen1 shu3 zhang3 shuo1
cues.en: Du Man quietly told the chief

cues.zh: 让他当强盗
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 dang1 qiang2 dao4
cues.en: that making him play the robber

cues.zh: 以后指定得后悔
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 zhi3 ding4 de2 hou4 hui3
cues.en: would definitely come back to bite him.

cues.zh: 署长当时并没把这话当回事
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 dang1 shi2 bing4 mei2 ba3 zhe4 hua4 dang1 hui2 shi4
cues.en: The chief didn't take those words seriously at the time,

cues.zh: 等后来明白过来时
cues.pinyin: deng3 hou4 lai2 ming2 bai2 guo4 lai2 shi2
cues.en: and by the time he later understood,

cues.zh: 早就来不及了
cues.pinyin: zao3 jiu4 lai2 bu4 ji2 le5
cues.en: it was already too late.

cues.zh: 自从见了强盗这个角色
cues.pinyin: zi4 cong2 jian4 le5 qiang2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 jue2 se4
cues.en: Ever since learning he'd play the robber,

cues.zh: 杜瞒就开始认真备客
cues.pinyin: du4 man2 jiu4 kai1 shi3 ren4 zhen1 bei4 ke4
cues.en: Du Man started preparing seriously,

cues.zh: 琢磨怎么才能当一个合格的强盗
cues.pinyin: zhuo2 mo2 zen3 me5 cai2 neng2 dang1 yi2 ge4 he2 ge2 de5 qiang2 dao4
cues.en: figuring out how to be a qualified robber.

cues.zh: 他查日大量相关视频和资料
cues.pinyin: ta1 cha2 ri4 da4 liang4 xiang1 guan1 shi4 pin2 he2 zi1 liao4
cues.en: He looked up tons of related videos and material,

cues.zh: 仔细规划逃跑路线
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 gui1 hua4 tao2 pao3 lu4 xian4
cues.en: personally went to scout the bank location,

cues.zh: 仔细规划跑跑路线
cues.pinyin: zi3 xi4 gui1 hua4 pao3 pao3 lu4 xian4
cues.en: carefully planned his escape route,

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 还精心准备了作案工具和强盗服装
cues.pinyin: hai2 jing1 xin1 zhun3 bei4 le5 zuo4 an4 gong1 ju4 he2 qiang2 dao4 fu2 zhuang1
cues.en: and even meticulously prepared his tools and robber costume.

cues.zh: 一切就绪
cues.pinyin: yi1 qie4 jiu4 xu4
cues.en: With everything ready,

cues.zh: 只等演习开始
cues.pinyin: zhi3 deng3 yan3 xi2 kai1 shi3
cues.en: all that was left was for the drill to start.

cues.zh: 行动信号终于来了
cues.pinyin: xing2 dong4 xin4 hao4 zhong1 yu2 lai2 le5
cues.en: The action signal finally came,

cues.zh: 杜满眼神一变
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 yan3 shen2 yi1 bian4
cues.en: and Du Man's expression changed —

cues.zh: 瞬间进入状态
cues.pinyin: shun4 jian1 jin4 ru4 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: he instantly got into character.

cues.zh: 银行里头
cues.pinyin: yin2 hang2 li3 tou5
cues.en: Inside the bank,

cues.zh: 警方早已布下嵌罗地网
cues.pinyin: jing3 fang1 zao3 yi3 bu4 xia4 qian4 luo2 di4 wang3
cues.en: police had already laid out a tight dragnet:

cues.zh: 便衣落屋
cues.pinyin: bian4 yi1 luo4 wu1
cues.en: plainclothes officers in position,

cues.zh: 伪装成客户的老李
cues.pinyin: wei3 zhuang1 cheng2 ke4 hu4 de5 lao3 li3
cues.en: Old Li disguised as a customer,

cues.zh: 还有女警韩素英
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 nv3 jing3 han2 su4 ying1
cues.en: and policewoman Han Suying too.

cues.zh: 几个人刚坐下
cues.pinyin: ji3 ge4 ren2 gang1 zuo4 xia4
cues.en: The moment they sat down,

cues.zh: 全副武装的杜满就推门进来了
cues.pinyin: quan2 fu4 wu3 zhuang1 de5 du4 man3 jiu4 tui1 men2 jin4 lai2 le5
cues.en: a fully armed Du Man pushed open the door and walked in.

cues.zh: 老李最新认出杜满
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 zui4 xin1 ren4 chu1 du4 man3
cues.en: Old Li was the first to recognize Du Man,

cues.zh: 出了名的一根筋
cues.pinyin: chu1 le5 ming2 de5 yi1 gen1 jin1
cues.en: famous for being stubbornly one-track-minded.

cues.zh: 本来还想看热闹呢
cues.pinyin: ben3 lai2 hai2 xiang3 kan4 re4 nao4 ne5
cues.en: He'd originally just wanted to watch the fun,

cues.zh: 却蒙的想起这次交警也参与了筹线
cues.pinyin: que4 meng2 de5 xiang3 qi3 zhe4 ci4 jiao1 jing3 ye3 can1 yu4 le5 chou2 xian4
cues.en: but suddenly remembered that the traffic cop had also been in on the planning —

cues.zh: 难道这次演习是完真的
cues.pinyin: nan2 dao4 zhe4 ci4 yan3 xi2 shi4 wan2 zhen1 de5
cues.en: could this drill actually be for real?

cues.zh: 紧接着老吴想上前盘问
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 lao3 wu2 xiang3 shang4 qian2 pan2 wen4
cues.en: Right after, Old Wu wanted to step up and question him,

cues.zh: 还没等开口问话
cues.pinyin: hai2 mei2 deng3 kai1 kou3 wen4 hua4
cues.en: but before he could even open his mouth,

cues.zh: 杜满先动了手
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 xian1 dong4 le5 shou3
cues.en: Du Man struck first.

cues.zh: 这一下把在场的人都看蒙了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 xia4 ba3 zai4 chang3 de5 ren2 dou1 kan4 meng2 le5
cues.en: This stunned everyone on the scene.

cues.zh: 强盗杜满正式上线
cues.pinyin: qiang2 dao4 du4 man3 zheng4 shi4 shang4 xian4
cues.en: Robber Du Man had officially gone live.

cues.zh: 银行里的工作人员吓得不行
cues.pinyin: yin2 hang2 li3 de5 gong1 zuo4 ren2 yuan2 xia4 de2 bu4 xing2
cues.en: The bank staff were scared out of their minds.

cues.zh: 老吴只好在旁边赶紧解释
cues.pinyin: lao3 wu2 zhi3 hao3 zai4 pang2 bian1 gan3 jin3 jie3 shi4
cues.en: Old Wu had no choice but to quickly explain from the side

cues.zh: 说这是警局搞的演习
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 shi4 jing3 ju2 gao3 de5 yan3 xi2
cues.en: that this was a drill run by the police station,

cues.zh: 让大家配合一下
cues.pinyin: rang4 da4 jia1 pei4 he2 yi1 xia4
cues.en: asking everyone to cooperate.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 这话把老李说得无言以对
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hua4 ba3 lao3 li3 shuo1 de2 wu2 yan2 yi3 dui4
cues.en: That left Old Li speechless,

cues.zh: 只好坐回原位
cues.pinyin: zhi3 hao3 zuo4 hui2 yuan2 wei4
cues.en: and he could only sit back down.

cues.zh: 紧接着杜满把银行的百叶窗全拉上了
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 du4 man3 ba3 yin2 hang2 de5 bai3 ye4 chuang1 quan2 la1 shang4 le5
cues.en: Right after, Du Man pulled all the bank's blinds shut,

cues.zh: 还找了东西贴在监控镜头上
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhao3 le5 dong1 xi1 tie1 zai4 jian1 kong4 jing4 tou2 shang4
cues.en: and even found something to stick over the security cameras,

cues.zh: 把视线挡得严严实实
cues.pinyin: ba3 shi4 xian4 dang3 de2 yan2 yan2 shi2 shi2
cues.en: blocking the view completely.

cues.zh: 署长在外面看着银行的防盗门
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 zai4 wai4 mian4 kan4 zhe5 yin2 hang2 de5 fang2 dao4 men2
cues.en: Outside, the chief watched the bank's security shutter

cues.zh: 缓缓落下
cues.pinyin: huan3 huan3 la4 xia4
cues.en: slowly come down,

cues.zh: 当场就惊呆了
cues.pinyin: dang1 chang3 jiu4 jing1 dai1 le5
cues.en: and was stunned on the spot.

cues.zh: 赶紧又给杜满打电话
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 you4 gei3 du4 man3 da3 dian4 hua4
cues.en: He quickly called Du Man again.

cues.zh: 杜满说真强盗都会这么干
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 shuo1 zhen1 qiang2 dao4 du1 hui4 zhe4 me5 gan4
cues.en: Du Man said real robbers would all do exactly this,

cues.zh: 说完就直接挂了电话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 wan2 jiu4 zhi2 jie1 gua4 le5 dian4 hua4
cues.en: then hung up right after saying it,

cues.zh: 把署长整得一脸蒙
cues.pinyin: ba3 shu3 zhang3 zheng3 de2 yi1 lian3 meng2
cues.en: leaving the chief completely dumbfounded.

cues.zh: 旁边的同事突然凑过来问署长
cues.pinyin: pang2 bian1 de5 tong2 shi4 tu1 ran2 cou4 guo4 lai2 wen4 shu3 zhang3
cues.en: A colleague beside him suddenly leaned over and asked the chief

cues.zh: 有没有跟杜满说演戏该怎么结束
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 gen1 du4 man3 shuo1 yan3 xi4 gai1 zen3 me5 jie2 shu4
cues.en: whether he'd told Du Man how the act was supposed to end.

cues.zh: 署长这才猛地反应过来
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 zhe4 cai2 meng3 di4 fan3 ying4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: Only then did the chief suddenly snap back to reality —

cues.zh: 他只一个劲让杜满尽全力演
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhi3 yi2 ge4 jin4 rang4 du4 man3 jin4 quan2 li4 yan3
cues.en: he'd only told Du Man to go all out acting,

cues.zh: 压根没提过怎么被抓
cues.pinyin: ya1 gen1 mei2 ti2 guo4 zen3 me5 bei4 zhua1
cues.en: never once mentioning how he should get caught.

cues.zh: 这会杜满演的劫匪比真劫匪还像模像样
cues.pinyin: zhe4 hui4 du4 man3 yan3 de5 jie2 fei3 bi3 zhen1 jie2 fei3 hai2 xiang4 mu2 xiang4 yang4
cues.en: By now Du Man's robber act was more convincing than a real robber's.

cues.zh: 过来的媒体记者也越来越多
cues.pinyin: guo4 lai2 de5 mei2 ti3 ji4 zhe3 ye3 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1
cues.en: More and more media reporters kept showing up,

cues.zh: 署长心里咯噔一下
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 xin1 li3 ge1 deng1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: and the chief's heart sank,

cues.zh: 发现事情已经完全不受控制了
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 shi4 qing2 yi3 jing1 wan2 quan2 bu4 shou4 kong4 zhi4 le5
cues.en: realizing things were completely out of control.

cues.zh: 一声令下杜满把所有人的手机都收了起来
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 ling4 xia4 du4 man3 ba3 suo3 you3 ren2 de5 shou3 ji1 dou1 shou1 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: With one shouted command, Du Man collected everyone's phones.

items.title: 外星人探案
items.title_zh: 百亿票房认证评分8.6的韩国0差评犯罪喜剧电影，上映首周突破30万观影人次，影片引发观众对规则与人性的深度思考。

cues.zh: 他毕竟是真警察
cues.pinyin: ta1 bi4 jing4 shi4 zhen1 jing3 cha2
cues.en: After all, he was a real police officer,

cues.zh: 不能真动手
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 zhen1 dong4 shou3
cues.en: so he couldn't actually use force —

cues.zh: 只能靠这一枪震住场面
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 kao4 zhe4 yi1 qiang1 zhen4 zhu4 chang3 mian4
cues.en: he could only fire one shot to shock the scene into order.

cues.zh: 随后他便装出昏迷的样子
cues.pinyin: sui2 hou4 ta1 bian4 zhuang1 chu1 hun1 mi2 de5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Afterward, he pretended to look unconscious.

cues.zh: 杜满刚松了口气
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 gang1 song1 le5 kou3 qi4
cues.en: Just as Du Man breathed a sigh of relief,

cues.zh: 一旁装死的老吴
cues.pinyin: yi1 pang2 zhuang1 si3 de5 lao3 wu2
cues.en: nearby, Old Wu, who'd been playing dead,

cues.zh: 瞅准机会猛地冲过去
cues.pinyin: chou3 zhun3 ji1 hui4 meng3 di4 chong1 guo4 qu4
cues.en: seized the chance and suddenly lunged forward,

cues.zh: 一把抢走了他手里的枪
cues.pinyin: yi1 ba3 qiang3 zou3 le5 ta1 shou3 li3 de5 qiang1
cues.en: snatching the gun right out of his hand.

cues.zh: 还振振有词的解释
cues.pinyin: hai2 zhen4 zhen4 you3 ci2 de5 jie3 shi4
cues.en: He then self-righteously explained

cues.zh: 说自己穿了防弹衣
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zi4 ji3 chuan1 le5 fang2 dan4 yi1
cues.en: that he'd been wearing a bulletproof vest,

cues.zh: 杜满那一枪根本打不死他
cues.pinyin: du4 man3 na4 yi1 qiang1 gen1 ben3 da3 bu4 si3 ta1
cues.en: so Du Man's shot could never have killed him.

cues.zh: 这么做不合情理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 me5 zuo4 bu4 he2 qing2 li3
cues.en: But that explanation made no sense at all.

cues.zh: 老李也在旁边帮腔
cues.pinyin: lao3 li3 ye3 zai4 pang2 bian1 bang1 qiang1
cues.en: Old Li backed him up from the side too,

cues.zh: 可坐在最后面的男学生突然开口
cues.pinyin: ke3 zuo4 zai4 zui4 hou4 mian4 de5 nan2 xue2 sheng1 tu1 ran2 kai1 kou3
cues.en: but a male student sitting in the back suddenly spoke up,

cues.zh: 问老吴头上是不是也穿了防弹衣
cues.pinyin: wen4 lao3 wu2 tou2 shang4 shi4 bu2 shi4 ye3 chuan1 le5 fang2 dan4 yi1
cues.en: asking whether Old Wu's head was also wearing a bulletproof vest.

cues.zh: 紧接着银行之人多会站了起来
cues.pinyin: jin3 jie1 zhe5 yin2 hang2 zhi1 ren2 duo1 hui4 zhan4 le5 qi3 lai2
cues.en: Right after that, people in the bank started standing up one by one,

cues.zh: 说刚才清清楚楚看到杜满开枪
cues.pinyin: shuo1 gang1 cai2 qing1 qing1 chu3 chu3 kan4 dao4 du4 man3 kai1 qiang1
cues.en: saying they'd clearly seen Du Man fire the shot

cues.zh: 打的是老吴的头
cues.pinyin: da3 di1 shi4 lao3 wu2 de5 tou2
cues.en: and hit Old Wu right in the head.

cues.zh: 老吴还想狡辩两句
cues.pinyin: lao3 wu2 hai2 xiang3 jiao3 bian4 liang3 ju4
cues.en: Old Wu still tried to argue his way out,

cues.zh: 有人直接调出了银行的备用监控
cues.pinyin: you3 ren2 zhi2 jie1 diao4 chu1 le5 yin2 hang2 de5 bei4 yong4 jian1 kong4
cues.en: but someone pulled up the bank's backup surveillance footage,

cues.zh: 铁证如山
cues.pinyin: tie3 zheng4 ru2 shan1
cues.en: and the evidence was ironclad.

cues.zh: 老吴没辙
cues.pinyin: lao3 wu2 mei2 zhe2
cues.en: Old Wu had no way out,

cues.zh: 只能乖乖把枪还给了杜满
cues.pinyin: zhi3 neng2 guai1 guai1 ba3 qiang1 huan2 gei3 le5 du4 man3
cues.en: and could only obediently hand the gun back to Du Man.

cues.zh: 这时候特警队也赶到了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 te4 jing3 dui4 ye3 gan3 dao4 le5
cues.en: By this point the SWAT team had also arrived,

cues.zh: 一看这阵仗
cues.pinyin: yi1 kan4 zhe4 zhen4 zhang4
cues.en: and seeing the scale of the scene,

cues.zh: 署长愁的直皱眉
cues.pinyin: shu3 zhang3 chou2 de5 zhi2 zhou4 mei2
cues.en: the chief frowned nonstop with worry.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 5 种水果维他命水的做法 | 增强免疫力 & 美容 |【美食天堂 CiCi's Food Paradise】

cues.zh: 慢慢的看他成长真的是很开心的那种感觉
cues.pinyin: man4 man4 de5 kan4 ta1 cheng2 zhang3 zhen1 de5 shi4 hen3 kai1 xin1 de5 na4 zhong3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Watching him grow up slowly really gives such a happy feeling.

cues.zh: 做母亲了真的是不一样
cues.pinyin: zuo4 mu3 qin1 le5 zhen1 de5 shi4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: Becoming a mother really does make things different.

cues.zh: 那其实我现在还是在为这个母乳嫩椒
cues.pinyin: na4 qi2 shi2 wo3 xian4 zai4 hai2 shi4 zai4 wei4 zhe4 ge5 mu3 ru3 nen4 jiao1
cues.en: Actually, I'm still struggling with this breastfeeding thing right now.

cues.zh: 为母乳其中一个缺点
cues.pinyin: wei4 mu3 ru3 qi2 zhong1 yi2 ge4 que1 dian3
cues.en: One of the downsides of breastfeeding

cues.zh: 我自己觉得啦就是口很容易干
cues.pinyin: wo3 zi4 ji3 jue2 de5 la5 jiu4 shi4 kou3 hen3 rong2 yi4 gan4
cues.en: I personally feel that my mouth gets dry very easily.

cues.zh: 所以今天呢就跟大家分享了这
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 ne5 jiu4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 le5 zhe4
cues.en: So today I want to share with everyone these

cues.zh: 个水果水的各
cues.pinyin: ge4 shui3 guo3 shui3 de5 ge4
cues.en: various

cues.zh: 式各样的做法
cues.pinyin: shi4 ge4 yang4 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: kinds of ways to make fruit water.

cues.zh: 那希望大家可以喜欢
cues.pinyin: na4 xi1 wang4 da4 jia1 ke3 yi3 xi3 huan1
cues.en: I hope everyone will like it.

cues.zh: 我非常喜欢这种做法也可以加热水哦
cues.pinyin: wo3 fei1 chang2 xi3 huan1 zhe4 zhong3 zuo4 fa3 ye3 ke3 yi3 jia1 re4 shui3 o2
cues.en: I really like this method — you can also add hot water.

cues.zh: 好了
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5
cues.en: Alright.

cues.zh: 那如果你喜欢今天的食谱呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 ni3 xi3 huan1 jin1 tian1 de5 shi2 pu3 ne5
cues.en: So if you liked today's recipe,

cues.zh: 订阅按赞
cues.pinyin: ding4 yue4 an4 zan4
cues.en: subscribe and hit like,

cues.zh: 我们下次见咯
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xia4 ci4 jian4 ge1
cues.en: and we'll see you next time.

cues.zh: 拜拜
cues.pinyin: bai4 bai4
cues.en: Bye bye.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友跟我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a young student told me

cues.zh: 他看了一部电影是阿汤哥的雨人
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 le5 yi1 bu4 dian4 ying3 shi4 a1 tang1 ge1 de5 yu3 ren2
cues.en: he watched a movie — Tom Cruise's "Rain Man."

cues.zh: 在这部电影里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 bu4 dian4 ying3 li3 mian4
cues.en: In this movie,

cues.zh: 阿汤哥的哥哥是一个自闭症患者
cues.pinyin: a1 tang1 ge1 di1 ge1 ge1 shi4 yi2 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: Tom Cruise's character's brother is autistic,

cues.zh: 但是他有惊人的记忆力
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 you3 jing1 ren2 de5 ji4 yi4 li4
cues.en: but he has an amazing memory,

cues.zh: 所以两个人在赌场里边大赚了一笔
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 liang3 ge4 ren2 zai4 du3 chang3 li3 bian1 da4 zhuan4 le5 yi1 bi3
cues.en: so the two of them made a fortune at the casino.

cues.zh: 他想问我说自闭症到底是一种
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zi4 bi4 zheng4 dao4 di3 shi4 yi1 zhong3
cues.en: He wanted to ask me what kind of

cues.zh: 怎样的疾病呢
cues.pinyin: zen3 yang4 de5 ji2 bing4 ne5
cues.en: disease autism actually is —

cues.zh: 它一定会有很强的记忆力吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 yi2 ding4 hui4 you3 hen3 qiang2 de5 ji4 yi4 li4 ma5
cues.en: does it always come with a strong memory?

cues.zh: 其实自闭症的孩子在我们周围并不少见
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 zi5 zai4 wo3 men5 zhou1 wei2 bing4 bu4 shao3 jian4
cues.en: Actually, autistic children aren't rare around us.

cues.zh: 我有两个朋友的孩子就是自闭症
cues.pinyin: wo3 you3 liang3 ge4 peng2 you3 de5 hai2 zi5 jiu4 shi4 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: Two of my friends have children with autism,

cues.zh: 所以今天就来给大家介绍一下自闭症
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jin1 tian1 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: so today I'll introduce autism to everyone.

cues.zh: 首先我们先来说一说自闭症
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: First, let's talk about autism —

cues.zh: 它是什么时候被人类发现的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 bei4 ren2 lei4 fa1 xian4 de5
cues.en: when was it first discovered by humans?

cues.zh: 自闭症是在 19 43 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zi4 bi4 zheng4 shi4 zai4 19 43 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Autism was discovered in the year 1943.

cues.zh: 19 43 年的美国有一个精神病学家
cues.pinyin: 19 43 nian2 de5 mei3 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 jing1 shen2 bing4 xue2 jia1
cues.en: In 1943 there was a psychiatrist in America

cues.zh: 名字叫做坎纳
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 kan3 na4
cues.en: named Kanner.

cues.zh: 坎纳
cues.pinyin: kan3 na4
cues.en: Kanner.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 这个坎纳他观察了 11 名儿童
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 kan3 na4 ta1 guan1 cha2 le5 11 ming2 er2 tong2
cues.en: This Kanner observed 11 children,

cues.zh: 结果就发现这 11 名儿童
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 jiu4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 11 ming2 er2 tong2
cues.en: and found that these 11 children

cues.zh: 有一些异于常人的表现
cues.pinyin: you3 yi1 xie1 yi4 yu2 chang2 ren2 de5 biao3 xian4
cues.en: showed some behaviors different from normal people.

cues.zh: 比如说他们不太愿意与人交流
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 ta1 men5 bu4 tai4 yuan4 yi4 yu3 ren2 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: For example, they were reluctant to communicate with others,

cues.zh: 不愿意与人说话
cues.pinyin: bu4 yuan4 yi4 yu3 ren2 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: unwilling to talk to people,

cues.zh: 但是经常的自言自语就在那里嘟囔
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jing1 chang2 de5 zi4 yan2 zi4 yu3 jiu4 zai4 na4 li3 du1 nang1
cues.en: but often talked to themselves, muttering there.

cues.zh: 同时对于环境有很苛刻的要求
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 dui4 yu2 huan2 jing4 you3 hen3 ke1 ke4 de5 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: At the same time, they had very strict demands on their environment —

cues.zh: 比如说物体的摆放
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wu4 ti3 de5 bai3 fang4
cues.en: for example, the placement of objects

cues.zh: 都必须是每天都是一模一样的
cues.pinyin: dou1 bi4 xu1 shi4 mei3 tian1 dou1 shi4 yi1 mu2 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: had to be exactly the same every day.

cues.zh: 所以他就感觉这些孩子非常奇怪
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 gan3 jue2 zhe4 xie1 hai2 zi5 fei1 chang2 qi2 guai4
cues.en: So he felt these children were very strange,

cues.zh: 给这些孩子起了一个名字叫做孤独症
cues.pinyin: gei3 zhe4 xie1 hai2 zi5 qi3 le5 yi2 ge4 ming2 zi4 jiao4 zuo4 gu1 du2 zheng4
cues.en: and gave them a name: "solitary disorder."

cues.zh: 或者就叫自闭症
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 jiu4 jiao4 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: Or just call it autism.

cues.zh: 孤独症和自闭症其实指的是同一种症状
cues.pinyin: gu1 du2 zheng4 he2 zi4 bi4 zheng4 qi2 shi2 zhi3 de5 shi4 tong2 yi1 zhong3 zheng4 zhuang4
cues.en: "Solitary disorder" and "autism" actually refer to the same condition.

cues.zh: 那么他发现的这种孤独症
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 fa1 xian4 de5 zhe4 zhong3 gu1 du2 zheng4
cues.en: So this condition he discovered,

cues.zh: 最典型的这个特征就是在语言障碍上
cues.pinyin: zui4 dian3 xing2 de5 zhe4 ge5 te4 zheng1 jiu4 shi4 zai4 yu3 yan2 zhang4 ai4 shang4
cues.en: its most typical feature is a language impairment —

cues.zh: 就是不爱说话或者不能说话
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bu4 ai4 shuo1 hua4 huo4 zhe3 bu4 neng2 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: not liking to talk, or being unable to talk,

cues.zh: 或者无法理解别人说的话
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 wu2 fa3 li3 jie3 bie2 ren2 shuo1 de5 hua4
cues.en: or being unable to understand what others say.

cues.zh: 那这个我们就称之为这个孤独
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 gu1 du2
cues.en: So we call this condition

cues.zh: 症或者自闭症
cues.pinyin: zheng4 huo4 zhe3 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: "autism" or "loneliness disorder."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 把自己放在对方的位置上去考虑
cues.pinyin: ba3 zi4 ji3 fang4 zai4 dui4 fang1 de5 wei4 zhi4 shang4 qu4 kao3 lv4
cues.en: Putting yourself in the other person's position to consider

cues.zh: 考虑一个问题
cues.pinyin: kao3 lv4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: a problem.

cues.zh: 举个例子
cues.pinyin: ju3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let me give an example.

cues.zh: 比如早上起来了
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zao3 shang4 qi3 lai2 le5
cues.en: Say someone gets up in the morning,

cues.zh: 上学了之后没有交作业
cues.pinyin: shang4 xue2 le5 zhi1 hou4 mei2 you3 jiao1 zuo4 ye4
cues.en: goes to school, and doesn't hand in their homework.

cues.zh: 老师批评这个孩子
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 pi1 ping2 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: The teacher scolds the child,

cues.zh: 就说你们家你作业被狗吃了吗
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shuo1 ni3 men5 jia1 ni3 zuo4 ye4 bei4 gou3 chi1 le5 ma5
cues.en: saying "Did your dog eat your homework?"

cues.zh: 说这么一句话
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zhe4 me5 yi1 ju4 hua4
cues.en: Just says something like that.

cues.zh: 那孩子自然会知道
cues.pinyin: na4 hai2 zi5 zi4 ran2 hui4 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: The child would naturally know

cues.zh: 老师非常生气
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 fei1 chang2 sheng1 qi4
cues.en: the teacher is very angry,

cues.zh: 所以我现在的表现应该是我不说话
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 xian4 zai4 de5 biao3 xian4 ying1 gai1 shi4 wo3 bu4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: so the right response now is to stay silent.

cues.zh: 但是对于自闭症的孩子他不会这么说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 yu2 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 zi5 ta1 bu2 hui4 zhe4 me5 shuo1
cues.en: But an autistic child wouldn't respond that way.

cues.zh: 他会说什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 shuo1 shen2 me5
cues.en: What would they say?

cues.zh: 他会说我们家没有狗
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 shuo1 wo3 men5 jia1 mei2 you3 gou3
cues.en: They'd say "We don't have a dog at home."

cues.zh: 他会这么说
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 zhe4 me5 shuo1
cues.en: That's what they'd say.

cues.zh: 或者说我们家的狗不吃作业
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 wo3 men5 jia1 de5 gou3 bu4 chi1 zuo4 ye4
cues.en: Or "Our dog doesn't eat homework."

cues.zh: 他会说这种话
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 shuo1 zhe4 zhong3 hua4
cues.en: That's the kind of thing they'd say.

cues.zh: 再比如说老师说你快把我气死了
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 lao3 shi1 shuo1 ni3 kuai4 ba3 wo3 qi4 si3 le5
cues.en: Another example: the teacher says "You're driving me crazy."

cues.zh: 正常人也是不说话
cues.pinyin: zheng4 chang2 ren2 ye3 shi4 bu4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: A normal person would also just stay quiet,

cues.zh: 但是对于自闭症的孩子他会说
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 dui4 yu2 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 zi5 ta1 hui4 shuo1
cues.en: but an autistic child would say,

cues.zh: 可是你现在还活着
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 ni3 xian4 zai4 hai2 huo2 zhe5
cues.en: "But you're still alive."

cues.zh: 就是他没有办法理解对方
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 li3 jie3 dui4 fang1
cues.en: That is, they can't understand what the other person

cues.zh: 到底表现的一个什么样的意思
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 biao3 xian4 de5 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 yi4 si5
cues.en: is actually trying to express.

cues.zh: 所以这种我们就称之为社交障碍
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 zhong3 wo3 men5 jiu4 cheng1 zhi1 wei4 she4 jiao1 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: So we call this a social impairment.

cues.zh: 那么这样的孩子
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 yang4 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: As for children like this,

cues.zh: 我们就给他叫做艾斯伯格症
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 gei3 ta1 jiao4 zuo4 ai4 si1 bo2 ge2 zheng4
cues.en: we call them Asperger's syndrome.

cues.zh: 再后来在最近的一段时间
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 zai4 zui4 jin4 de5 yi1 duan4 shi2 jian1
cues.en: Later on, in more recent times,

cues.zh: 人们对于这种相应的疾病的研究
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 dui4 yu2 zhe4 zhong3 xiang1 ying4 de5 ji2 bing4 de5 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: research into these related conditions

cues.zh: 就越来越多了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yue4 lai2 yue4 duo1 le5
cues.en: has grown more and more extensive.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 什么叫障碍呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 zhang4 ai4 ne5
cues.en: What does "impairment" mean?

cues.zh: 障碍咱们换一种说法就是残疾
cues.pinyin: zhang4 ai4 zan2 men5 huan4 yi1 zhong3 shuo1 fa3 jiu4 shi4 can2 ji2
cues.en: Put another way, impairment means disability.

cues.zh: 我们举个例子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ju3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let's use an example.

cues.zh: 比如说我这个手
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 zhe4 ge5 shou3
cues.en: Take this hand of mine —

cues.zh: 因为某些原因我断了两个手指
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mou3 xie1 yuan2 yin1 wo3 duan4 le5 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3
cues.en: say for some reason I lost two fingers.

cues.zh: 我断了两个手指这时候我就残疾了
cues.pinyin: wo3 duan4 le5 liang3 ge4 shou3 zhi3 zhe4 shi2 hou4 wo3 jiu4 can2 ji2 le5
cues.en: Having lost two fingers, I'd be disabled,

cues.zh: 我就障碍了
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 zhang4 ai4 le5
cues.en: I'd be impaired.

cues.zh: 所以我拿东西的时候拿的不方便
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 na2 dong1 xi1 de5 shi2 hou4 na2 de5 bu4 fang1 bian4
cues.en: So it would be inconvenient for me to hold things.

cues.zh: 但是这不是疾病我没有病对吧
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 bu2 shi4 ji2 bing4 wo3 mei2 you3 bing4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: But that's not a disease — I'm not sick, right?

cues.zh: 我也没有药可以治疗这是一种残疾的情况
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 mei2 you3 yao4 ke3 yi3 zhi4 liao2 zhe4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 can2 ji2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: There's no medicine to treat it either; it's a disability.

cues.zh: 同样道理自闭症也是这样的
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 ye3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 de5
cues.en: By the same logic, autism works the same way.

cues.zh: 就是它是一种残疾
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 can2 ji2
cues.en: It is a disability.

cues.zh: 所以它没有办法完全治好
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 wan2 quan2 zhi4 hao3
cues.en: So it can't be completely cured.

cues.zh: 你可以通过一些方法进行训练
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 yi1 xie1 fang1 fa3 jin4 xing2 xun4 lian4
cues.en: You can train through certain methods

cues.zh: 让它能够融入社会
cues.pinyin: rang4 ta1 neng2 gou4 rong2 ru4 she4 hui4
cues.en: so they can integrate into society,

cues.zh: 但这个病永远都不会治好
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ge5 bing4 yong3 yuan3 dou1 bu2 hui4 zhi4 hao3
cues.en: but the condition itself will never be fully cured.

cues.zh: 那么这个自闭症普系障碍是什么意思
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 zi4 bi4 zheng4 pu3 xi4 zhang4 ai4 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: So what does "autism spectrum disorder" mean?

cues.zh: 就是它把几种症状合到一块了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 ba3 ji3 zhong3 zheng4 zhuang4 he2 dao4 yi1 kuai4 le5
cues.en: It means several conditions are grouped together.

cues.zh: 我们画一个光谱是吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hua4 yi2 ge4 guang1 pu3 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Let's draw a spectrum, shall we?

cues.zh: 我们知道光可以分成一个光谱对吧
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 guang1 ke3 yi3 fen1 cheng2 yi2 ge4 guang1 pu3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: We know light can be split into a spectrum, right?

cues.zh: 可以分成七种颜色
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 fen1 cheng2 qi1 zhong3 yan2 se4
cues.en: It can be divided into seven colors.

cues.zh: 其实也不止七种
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ye3 bu4 zhi3 qi1 zhong3
cues.en: Actually it's more than seven —

cues.zh: 你想分多少种都可以
cues.pinyin: ni3 xiang3 fen1 duo1 shao3 zhong3 dou1 ke3 yi3
cues.en: you can divide it into as many as you like,

cues.zh: 你只要切割多切几块就行了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi3 yao4 qie1 ge1 duo1 qie4 ji3 kuai4 jiu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: you just need to cut it into more pieces.

cues.zh: 同样道理自闭症也是这个样子
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 ye3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5
cues.en: Autism works the same way.

cues.zh: 那它把很多症状合在一块
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 ba3 hen3 duo1 zheng4 zhuang4 he2 zai4 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: It groups many symptoms together.

cues.zh: 比如说有一个范围内
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 yi2 ge4 fan4 wei2 nei4
cues.en: For example, within one range

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 我们可以管它叫比如说自闭
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 guan3 ta1 jiao4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 zi4 bi4
cues.en: we might call it, say, "autism."

cues.zh: 那么还有一个范围可能就是我
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 fan4 wei2 ke3 neng2 jiu4 shi4 wo3
cues.en: Then there's another range, which might be what

cues.zh: 们说的第二种
cues.pinyin: men5 shuo1 de5 di4 er4 zhong3
cues.en: we call the second type,

cues.zh: 就是这个艾斯伯格症
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 ai4 si1 bo2 ge2 zheng4
cues.en: which is Asperger's syndrome.

cues.zh: 它说话没有障碍但是与人交流却有障碍
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 hua4 mei2 you3 zhang4 ai4 dan4 shi4 yu3 ren2 jiao1 liu2 que4 you3 zhang4 ai4
cues.en: They have no trouble speaking, but have trouble communicating with others.

cues.zh: 还有其他的几个就是未分类
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 qi2 ta1 de5 ji3 ge4 jiu4 shi4 wei4 fen1 lei4
cues.en: There are also several others that are unclassified.

cues.zh: 这个未分类的一些
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wei4 fen1 lei4 de5 yi1 xie1
cues.en: These unclassified cases involve

cues.zh: 其他的一些类似的症状是吧
cues.pinyin: qi2 ta1 de5 yi1 xie1 lei4 si4 de5 zheng4 zhuang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: some other, similar symptoms, right?

cues.zh: 那么比例大概有多少呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 bi3 li4 da4 gai4 you3 duo1 shao3 ne5
cues.en: So roughly what's the proportion?

cues.zh: 这个自闭症大概占了 20
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zi4 bi4 zheng4 da4 gai4 zhan4 le5 20
cues.en: Autism accounts for about 20%

cues.zh: 在整个谱系里面
cues.pinyin: zai4 zheng3 ge4 pu3 xi4 li3 mian4
cues.en: of the whole spectrum,

cues.zh: 埃兹伯格大概占了 5
cues.pinyin: ai1 zi1 bo2 ge2 da4 gai4 zhan4 le5 5
cues.en: Asperger's accounts for about 5%,

cues.zh: 而为分类大概占了 75 是吧
cues.pinyin: er2 wei4 fen1 lei4 da4 gai4 zhan4 le5 75 shi4 ba5
cues.en: and the unclassified type accounts for about 75%, right?

cues.zh: 每一种自闭症都有相似的地方
cues.pinyin: mei3 yi1 zhong3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 dou1 you3 xiang1 si4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: Every case of autism has similarities,

cues.zh: 但是又不完全一样
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 you4 bu4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: but they're not completely the same either.

cues.zh: 所以有一种说法叫做
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you3 yi1 zhong3 shuo1 fa3 jiao4 zuo4
cues.en: So there's a saying that goes:

cues.zh: 如果你认识了一个自闭症的孩子
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 ren4 shi2 le5 yi2 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: "If you've met one autistic child,

cues.zh: 那么你认识了一个自闭症的孩子
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ni3 ren4 shi2 le5 yi2 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: then you've met one autistic child."

cues.zh: 什么意思呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yi4 si5 ne5
cues.en: What does that mean?

cues.zh: 就是没有两个自闭症的人
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 mei2 you3 liang3 ge4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5 ren2
cues.en: It means no two autistic people

cues.zh: 他们是完全一样的
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4 de5
cues.en: are exactly the same.

cues.zh: 它是一个谱系
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yi2 ge4 pu3 xi4
cues.en: It's a spectrum —

cues.zh: 你可能处于不同的这样的一个位置
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 neng2 chu3 yu2 bu4 tong2 de5 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: you might sit at a different position on it,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】你了解自闭症儿童吗？请关爱“来自星星的孩子”

cues.zh: 但事实上它可能是有这样的一个问题的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 shi2 shang4 ta1 ke3 neng2 shi4 you3 zhe4 yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 de5
cues.en: but in fact you might still have this kind of issue.

cues.zh: 那么为什么美国里面自闭症的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wei4 shen2 me5 mei3 guo2 li3 mian4 zi4 bi4 zheng4 de5
cues.en: So why in America are there

cues.zh: 患者这么多呢
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 zhe4 me5 duo1 ne5
cues.en: so many autism patients?

cues.zh: 主要是因为美国筛查的比较狠
cues.pinyin: zhu3 yao4 shi4 yin1 wei4 mei3 guo2 shai1 cha2 de5 bi3 jiao4 hen3
cues.en: Mainly because screening in the US is quite thorough.

cues.zh: 美国在四岁的时候会对这个孩子
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 zai4 si4 sui4 de5 shi2 hou4 hui4 dui4 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5
cues.en: In the US, at age four, children

cues.zh: 进行这个全面的检查
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing2 zhe4 ge5 quan2 mian4 de5 jian3 cha2
cues.en: undergo a comprehensive examination,

cues.zh: 包括他的生理健康和他的心理健康
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 ta1 de5 sheng1 li3 jian4 kang1 he2 ta1 de5 xin1 li3 jian4 kang1
cues.en: including their physical health and mental health,

cues.zh: 所以通过一个非常非常详细的方法性检查
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 tong1 guo4 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 xiang2 xi4 de5 fang1 fa3 xing4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: through a very, very detailed, systematic checkup.

cues.zh: 那么假如发现这个孩子是有自闭症倾向的
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 jia3 ru2 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 shi4 you3 zi4 bi4 zheng4 qing1 xiang4 de5
cues.en: If the child is found to have a tendency toward autism,

cues.zh: 他就会建议你去更高级的医院进行复查
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 hui4 jian4 yi4 ni3 qu4 geng4 gao1 ji2 de5 yi1 yuan4 jin4 xing2 fu4 cha2
cues.en: they'll recommend you go to a higher-level hospital for further evaluation.

cues.zh: 但我们中国是没有这一套体系的
cues.pinyin: dan4 wo3 men5 zhong1 guo2 shi4 mei2 you3 zhe4 yi1 tao4 ti3 xi4 de5
cues.en: But here in China we don't have this kind of system.

cues.zh: 我们检查基本上都是对生理的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jian3 cha2 ji1 ben3 shang4 dou1 shi4 dui4 sheng1 li3 de5
cues.en: Our checkups are basically for physical health;

cues.zh: 对心理的是比较少的对吧
cues.pinyin: dui4 xin1 li3 de5 shi4 bi3 jiao4 shao3 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: mental health checks are relatively rare, right?

cues.zh: 大部分我们发现的自闭症都怎么发现的呢
cues.pinyin: da4 bu4 fen4 wo3 men5 fa1 xian4 de5 zi4 bi4 zheng4 dou1 zen3 me5 fa1 xian4 de5 ne5
cues.en: How do we usually end up discovering most cases of autism?

cues.zh: 就是把孩子送到幼儿园里去
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ba3 hai2 zi5 song4 dao4 you4 er2 yuan2 li3 qu4
cues.en: By sending the child to kindergarten,

cues.zh: 结果幼儿园老师发现这个孩子很奇怪
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 you4 er2 yuan2 lao3 shi1 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 hen3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: and the kindergarten teacher notices the child is unusual.

cues.zh: 包括比如我那朋友就是这么说
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 bi3 ru2 wo3 na4 peng2 you3 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 me5 shuo1
cues.en: For example, my friend told it this way —

cues.zh: 他说他这个孩子送到幼儿园里去之后
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ta1 zhe4 ge5 hai2 zi5 song4 dao4 you4 er2 yuan2 li3 qu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: he said after he sent his child to kindergarten,

cues.zh: 那老师就说了
cues.pinyin: na4 lao3 shi1 jiu4 shuo1 le5
cues.en: the teacher said,

cues.zh: 我们一共幼儿园里面有三个老师
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi1 gong4 you4 er2 yuan2 li3 mian4 you3 san1 ge4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: "We have three teachers in total at the kindergarten.

cues.zh: 两个老师看剩下的 29 个孩子
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 lao3 shi1 kan4 sheng4 xia4 de5 29 ge4 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Two teachers watch the remaining 29 children,

cues.zh: 有一个老师专门看你们家孩子
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 lao3 shi1 zhuan1 men2 kan4 ni3 men5 jia1 hai2 zi5
cues.en: and one teacher is dedicated just to watching your child."

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 耗时5年，香港故宫终于来了！The Hong Kong Palace Musuem Will Finally Open to the Public Tomorr

cues.zh: 历时五年建造的香港故宫终于在香港回
cues.pinyin: li4 shi2 wu3 nian2 jian4 zao4 de5 xiang1 gang3 gu4 gong1 zhong1 yu2 zai4 xiang1 gang3 hui2
cues.en: The Hong Kong Palace Museum, five years in the making, finally

cues.zh: 归 25 周年之际
cues.pinyin: gui1 25 zhou1 nian2 zhi1 ji4
cues.en: on the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China,

cues.zh: 面向公众开放
cues.pinyin: mian4 xiang4 gong1 zhong4 kai1 fang4
cues.en: opened to the public.

cues.zh: 9 14 件珍贵文物
cues.pinyin: 9 14 jian4 zhen1 gui4 wen2 wu4
cues.en: 914 precious cultural relics

cues.zh: 包括 16 6 件国宝及一级文物来到香港
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 16 6 jian4 guo2 bao3 ji2 yi1 ji2 wen2 wu4 lai2 dao4 xiang1 gang3
cues.en: including 166 national treasures and first-grade artifacts came to Hong Kong

cues.zh: 很多甚至在此之前从未向公众展示过
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 shen4 zhi4 zai4 ci3 zhi1 qian2 cong2 wei4 xiang4 gong1 zhong4 zhan3 shi4 guo4
cues.en: many of which had never been shown to the public before

cues.zh: 它的建筑设计也受到了大家的广泛关注
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 jian4 zhu4 she4 ji4 ye3 shou4 dao4 le5 da4 jia1 de5 guang3 fan4 guan1 zhu4
cues.en: Its architectural design has also drawn widespread attention

cues.zh: 一条连线采访馆长吴志华为我们
cues.pinyin: yi1 tiao2 lian2 xian4 cai3 fang3 guan3 zhang3 wu2 zhi4 hua2 wei4 wo3 men5
cues.en: Yitiao spoke via video call with museum director Wu Chi-wa

cues.zh: 揭秘香港故宫
cues.pinyin: jie1 mi4 xiang1 gang3 gu4 gong1
cues.en: to reveal the secrets of the Hong Kong Palace Museum

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 耗时5年，香港故宫终于来了！The Hong Kong Palace Musuem Will Finally Open to the Public Tomorr

cues.zh: 这个馆是依山建的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guan3 shi4 yi1 shan1 jian4 de5
cues.en: This museum was built into the hillside

cues.zh: 一共有七层楼
cues.pinyin: yi1 gong4 you3 qi1 ceng2 lou2
cues.en: It has seven floors in total

cues.zh: 香港本地的建筑是
cues.pinyin: xiang1 gang3 ben3 di4 de5 jian4 zhu4 shi4
cues.en: The local Hong Kong architecture was

cues.zh: 严迅奇先生做的
cues.pinyin: yan2 xun4 qi2 xian1 sheng1 zuo4 de5
cues.en: designed by Mr. Rocco Yim

cues.zh: 工业风格特点是比较重要的
cues.pinyin: gong1 ye4 feng1 ge2 te4 dian3 shi4 bi3 jiao4 zhong4 yao4 de5
cues.en: The style's distinguishing feature is quite important

cues.zh: 故宫元素怎么样跟现代结合在一起
cues.pinyin: gu4 gong1 yuan2 su4 zen3 me5 yang4 gen1 xian4 dai4 jie2 he2 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: how to combine Forbidden City elements with the modern

cues.zh: 是我们在设计期间的一个挑战
cues.pinyin: shi4 wo3 men5 zai4 she4 ji4 qi1 jian1 de5 yi2 ge4 tiao3 zhan4
cues.en: was a challenge for us during the design process

cues.zh: 最重要一个理念
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong4 yao4 yi2 ge4 li3 nian4
cues.en: The most important concept

cues.zh: 就是北京紫禁城一个纵轴的概念
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bei3 jing1 zi3 jin4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 zong4 zhou2 de5 gai4 nian4
cues.en: was Beijing's Forbidden City central-axis concept

cues.zh: 放在一个垂直空间里头
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 yi2 ge4 chui2 zhi2 kong1 jian1 li3 tou5
cues.en: placed into a vertical space

cues.zh: 有三个很大的庭园
cues.pinyin: you3 san1 ge4 hen3 da4 de5 ting2 yuan2
cues.en: There are three large courtyards

cues.zh: 看完一个展厅
cues.pinyin: kan4 wan2 yi2 ge4 zhan3 ting1
cues.en: After going through one exhibition hall

cues.zh: 我从它玩过以后
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 ta1 wan2 guo4 yi3 hou4
cues.en: once we've walked past it

cues.zh: 中间他一看到香港景观要出来了
cues.pinyin: zhong1 jian1 ta1 yi1 kan4 dao4 xiang1 gang3 jing3 guan1 yao4 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: in the middle, once you see the Hong Kong skyline about to appear

cues.zh: 我们在香港最好的地方
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 xiang1 gang3 zui4 hao3 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: we are in the best location in Hong Kong

cues.zh: 西九龙文化区
cues.pinyin: xi1 jiu3 long2 wen2 hua4 qu1
cues.en: the West Kowloon Cultural District

cues.zh: 从高铁站到我们馆
cues.pinyin: cong2 gao1 tie3 zhan4 dao4 wo3 men5 guan3
cues.en: From the high-speed rail station to our museum

cues.zh: 十分钟时间
cues.pinyin: shi2 fen1 zhong1 shi2 jian1
cues.en: it takes ten minutes

cues.zh: 所以将来大湾区的话
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiang1 lai2 da4 wan1 qu1 de5 hua4
cues.en: so in future, with the Greater Bay Area,

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 耗时5年，香港故宫终于来了！The Hong Kong Palace Musuem Will Finally Open to the Public Tomorr

cues.zh: 内地观众会是非常方便的
cues.pinyin: nei4 di4 guan1 zhong4 hui4 shi4 fei1 chang2 fang1 bian4 de5
cues.en: it will be very convenient for mainland visitors

cues.zh: 大门它是用金色朱红色为主
cues.pinyin: da4 men2 ta1 shi4 yong4 jin1 se4 zhu1 hong2 se4 wei2 zhu3
cues.en: The main gate is mainly gold and vermilion red

cues.zh: 天花用了一个宇宙的天花
cues.pinyin: tian1 hua1 yong4 le5 yi2 ge4 yu3 zhou4 de5 tian1 hua1
cues.en: The ceiling uses a cosmic-themed design

cues.zh: 是参考几政城楼梨瓦形态
cues.pinyin: shi4 can1 kao3 ji3 zheng4 cheng2 lou2 li2 wa3 xing2 tai4
cues.en: referencing the glazed-tile roof forms of the Forbidden City's towers

cues.zh: 变成一个比较动态的
cues.pinyin: bian4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4 dong4 tai4 de5
cues.en: turning it into something more dynamic

cues.zh: 好像一个衣服拉链的感觉
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiang4 yi2 ge4 yi1 fu2 la1 lian4 de5 gan3 jue2
cues.en: like the feeling of a zipper on clothing

cues.zh: 本馆建筑物是一个用来展出文物的地方
cues.pinyin: ben3 guan3 jian4 zhu4 wu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 yong4 lai2 zhan3 chu1 wen2 wu4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: This museum building is a place for displaying artifacts

cues.zh: 功能上来说我们一定要满足
cues.pinyin: gong1 neng2 shang4 lai2 shuo1 wo3 men5 yi2 ding4 yao4 man3 zu2
cues.en: Functionally, we must meet that need

cues.zh: 所以它不是纯粹艺术性建筑物
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bu2 shi4 chun2 cui4 yi4 shu4 xing4 jian4 zhu4 wu4
cues.en: so it's not purely an artistic building

cues.zh: 开幕展有九个
cues.pinyin: kai1 mu4 zhan3 you3 jiu3 ge4
cues.en: There are nine opening exhibitions

cues.zh: 我们的野心比较大
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 de5 ye3 xin1 bi3 jiao4 da4
cues.en: Our ambitions are quite large

cues.zh: 故宫镇馆之宝都拿来了
cues.pinyin: gu4 gong1 zhen4 guan3 zhi1 bao3 dou1 na2 lai2 le5
cues.en: We brought over the Forbidden City's prized treasures

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 耗时5年，香港故宫终于来了！The Hong Kong Palace Musuem Will Finally Open to the Public Tomorr

cues.zh: 在一号展厅里展出了大清受命之宝
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi1 hao4 zhan3 ting1 li3 zhan3 chu1 le5 da4 qing1 shou4 ming4 zhi1 bao3
cues.en: Gallery 1 displays the Qing dynasty's 'Seal of Mandate'

cues.zh: 这是乾隆皇帝亲自整理出的 25 方印中
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 qian2 long2 huang2 di4 qin1 zi4 zheng3 li3 chu1 de5 25 fang1 yin4 zhong1
cues.en: one of the 25 imperial seals personally arranged by Emperor Qianlong

cues.zh: 排名顺位第一等
cues.pinyin: pai2 ming2 shun4 wei4 di4 yi1 deng3
cues.en: ranked first in precedence

cues.zh: 只展三个月
cues.pinyin: zhi3 zhan3 san1 ge4 yue4
cues.en: and is only displayed for three months

cues.zh: 三号展厅里展出的是珍贵陶瓷作品
cues.pinyin: san1 hao4 zhan3 ting1 li3 zhan3 chu1 de5 shi4 zhen1 gui4 tao2 ci2 zuo4 pin3
cues.en: Gallery 3 displays precious ceramic works

cues.zh: 包括了北宋年间的白佑孩儿枕
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 le5 bei3 song4 nian2 jian1 de5 bai2 you4 hai2 er2 zhen3
cues.en: including the Northern Song-era Ding kiln white-glazed 'baby pillow'

cues.zh: 是极为罕见的传世品
cues.pinyin: shi4 ji2 wei2 han3 jian4 de5 chuan2 shi4 pin3
cues.en: an extremely rare heirloom piece

cues.zh: 五号展厅主题是当代设计对话古代工艺
cues.pinyin: wu3 hao4 zhan3 ting1 zhu3 ti2 shi4 dang1 dai4 she4 ji4 dui4 hua4 gu3 dai4 gong1 yi4
cues.en: Gallery 5's theme is a dialogue between contemporary design and ancient craft

cues.zh: 这款乾隆年间的彩色玻璃螺旋纹撇口瓶
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kuan3 qian2 long2 nian2 jian1 de5 cai3 se4 bo1 li2 luo2 xuan2 wen2 pie1 kou3 ping2
cues.en: this Qianlong-era colored glass spiral-patterned flared vase

cues.zh: 像不像现代理发店门口的三色灯
cues.pinyin: xiang4 bu4 xiang4 xian4 dai4 li3 fa4 dian4 men2 kou3 de5 san1 se4 deng1
cues.en: does it look like the three-colored pole outside a modern barbershop?

cues.zh: 8 号展厅里都是被称为国之重宝的
cues.pinyin: 8 hao4 zhan3 ting1 li3 dou1 shi4 bei4 cheng1 wei2 guo2 zhi1 zhong4 bao3 de5
cues.en: Gallery 8 is all pieces called national treasures

cues.zh: 中国书画精品
cues.pinyin: zhong1 guo2 shu1 hua4 jing1 pin3
cues.en: fine examples of Chinese painting and calligraphy

cues.zh: 其中包括大名鼎鼎的洛神赋图
cues.pinyin: qi2 zhong1 bao1 kuo4 da4 ming2 ding3 ding3 de5 luo4 shen2 fu4 tu2
cues.en: including the famous 'Nymph of the Luo River'

cues.zh: 吴馆长说
cues.pinyin: wu2 guan3 zhang3 shuo1
cues.en: Director Wu said

cues.zh: 一般的清代书画展出时间是三个月
cues.pinyin: yi4 ban1 de5 qing1 dai4 shu1 hua4 zhan3 chu1 shi2 jian1 shi4 san1 ge4 yue4
cues.en: ordinary Qing dynasty paintings and calligraphy are displayed for three months

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 耗时5年，香港故宫终于来了！The Hong Kong Palace Musuem Will Finally Open to the Public Tomorr

cues.zh: 一旦出现唐宋时期的都是按天数来计算的
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 chu1 xian4 tang2 song4 shi2 qi1 de5 dou1 shi4 an4 tian1 shu4 lai2 ji4 suan4 de5
cues.en: but once Tang or Song dynasty pieces are involved, display time is calculated by the day

cues.zh: 比如路途中运输要几天
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 lu4 tu2 zhong1 yun4 shu1 yao4 ji3 tian1
cues.en: for example, transport alone might take several days

cues.zh: 能在馆里展出多少天都要严格计划
cues.pinyin: neng2 zai4 guan3 li3 zhan3 chu1 duo1 shao3 tian1 dou1 yao4 yan2 ge2 ji4 hua4
cues.en: how many days it can be displayed in the museum has to be strictly planned

cues.zh: 到期以后这个文物会运回到北京故宫
cues.pinyin: dao4 qi1 yi3 hou4 zhe4 ge5 wen2 wu4 hui4 yun4 hui2 dao4 bei3 jing1 gu4 gong1
cues.en: once the term ends, the artifact is shipped back to the Beijing Palace Museum

cues.zh: 以后他们会换一批新的过来
cues.pinyin: yi3 hou4 ta1 men5 hui4 huan4 yi1 pi1 xin1 de5 guo4 lai2
cues.en: and afterward, they'll swap in a new batch

cues.zh: 所以每一次过来
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 mei3 yi1 ci4 guo4 lai2
cues.en: so each time

cues.zh: 观众可以看到新的故宫文物
cues.pinyin: guan1 zhong4 ke3 yi3 kan4 dao4 xin1 de5 gu4 gong1 wen2 wu4
cues.en: visitors can see new Palace Museum artifacts

cues.zh: 故宫很多好东西
cues.pinyin: gu4 gong1 hen3 duo1 hao3 dong1 xi1
cues.en: The Palace Museum has so many great items

cues.zh: 根本它没有地方展出
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 ta1 mei2 you3 di4 fang1 zhan3 chu1
cues.en: that simply have nowhere to be displayed

cues.zh: 它需要一个机构
cues.pinyin: ta1 xu1 yao4 yi2 ge4 ji1 gou4
cues.en: it needs an institution

cues.zh: 对故宫文物要保护好
cues.pinyin: dui4 gu4 gong1 wen2 wu4 yao4 bao3 hu4 hao3
cues.en: to properly preserve the Palace Museum's artifacts

cues.zh: 我们香港故宫就是这样
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 xiang1 gang3 gu4 gong1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4
cues.en: Our Hong Kong Palace Museum is exactly that

cues.zh: 不单是给香港内地观众
cues.pinyin: bu4 dan1 shi4 gei3 xiang1 gang3 nei4 di4 guan1 zhong4
cues.en: It's not just for Hong Kong and mainland audiences

cues.zh: 还要给国际观众
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 gei3 guo2 ji4 guan1 zhong4
cues.en: but also for international audiences

items.title_zh: 笑话84｜蚊子咬｜换3个男朋友｜老师最会烤肉｜送月饼｜钞票没消毒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小明刚上车就被蚊子咬了一口
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 gang1 shang4 che1 jiu4 bei4 wen2 zi5 yao3 le5 yi1 kou3
cues.en: Xiaoming had just gotten in the car when a mosquito bit him.

cues.zh: 小明马上关上窗户上高速公路
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ma3 shang4 guan1 shang4 chuang1 hu4 shang4 gao1 su4 gong1 lu4
cues.en: Xiaoming immediately rolled up the windows and got on the highway.

cues.zh: 开了三个小时
cues.pinyin: kai1 le5 san1 ge4 xiao3 shi2
cues.en: He drove for three hours.

cues.zh: 下高速公路才把蚊子放出来
cues.pinyin: xia4 gao1 su4 gong1 lu4 cai2 ba3 wen2 zi5 fang4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Only after getting off the highway did he let the mosquito out.

cues.zh: 我要让你尝尝离箱背景
cues.pinyin: wo3 yao4 rang4 ni3 chang2 chang2 li2 xiang1 bei4 jing3
cues.en: "I'm going to make you taste what it's like to be far from home,"

cues.zh: 激离止善的滋味看你下次还敢不敢咬我
cues.pinyin: ji1 li2 zhi3 shan4 de5 zi1 wei4 kan4 ni3 xia4 ci4 hai2 gan3 bu4 gan3 yao3 wo3
cues.en: "the taste of a broken family — see if you dare bite me again."

items.title_zh: 笑话84｜蚊子咬｜换3个男朋友｜老师最会烤肉｜送月饼｜钞票没消毒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 三年的时间我男朋友的车
cues.pinyin: san1 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1 wo3 nan2 peng2 you3 de5 che1
cues.en: In three years, my boyfriend's car

cues.zh: 从丰田到宝马到宾利哇
cues.pinyin: cong2 feng1 tian2 dao4 bao3 ma3 dao4 bin1 li4 wa5
cues.en: went from a Toyota, to a BMW, to a Bentley, wow.

cues.zh: 你男朋友经历了什么啊好励志哦
cues.pinyin: ni3 nan2 peng2 you3 jing1 li4 le5 shen2 me5 a5 hao3 li4 zhi4 o2
cues.en: "What did your boyfriend go through? That's so inspiring!"

cues.zh: 不是他经历了什么
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 ta1 jing1 li4 le5 shen2 me5
cues.en: It's not about what he went through —

cues.zh: 是我换了三个男朋友
cues.pinyin: shi4 wo3 huan4 le5 san1 ge4 nan2 peng2 you3
cues.en: it's that I went through three boyfriends.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话84｜蚊子咬｜换3个男朋友｜老师最会烤肉｜送月饼｜钞票没消毒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 你知道谁都在烤肉啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 shei2 dou1 zai4 kao3 rou4 a5
cues.en: You know everyone's having a barbecue, right?

cues.zh: 我啊我最近烤啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 a5 wo3 zui4 jin4 kao3 a5
cues.en: Me? I've been barbecuing a lot lately too.

cues.zh: 我看要去动物园烤什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 yao4 qu4 dong4 wu4 yuan2 kao3 shen2 me5
cues.en: I'm thinking of going to the zoo — what should I grill there?

cues.zh: 可是我们老师说要是没到的都没假
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 wo3 men5 lao3 shi1 shuo1 yao4 shi4 mei2 dao4 de5 dou1 mei2 jia3
cues.en: But our teacher said whoever doesn't show up doesn't get the day off.

cues.zh: 好了你惨了
cues.pinyin: hao3 le5 ni3 can3 le5
cues.en: "Alright then, you're in trouble now."

cues.zh: 我跟你们老师讲你惨了
cues.pinyin: wo3 gen1 ni3 men5 lao3 shi1 jiang3 ni3 can3 le5
cues.en: "I'll tell your teacher — you're in trouble."

cues.zh: 不要不要不要不要
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 bu2 yao4 bu2 yao4 bu2 yao4
cues.en: "No, no, no, no!"

cues.zh: 前几天我买了一盒月饼
cues.pinyin: qian2 ji3 tian1 wo3 mai3 le5 yi1 he2 yue4 bing3
cues.en: A few days ago I bought a box of mooncakes.

cues.zh: 我把月饼送给了我岳母
cues.pinyin: wo3 ba3 yue4 bing3 song4 gei3 le5 wo3 yue4 mu3
cues.en: I gave the mooncakes to my mother-in-law.

cues.zh: 我岳母舍不得吃
cues.pinyin: wo3 yue4 mu3 she3 bu4 de2 chi1
cues.en: My mother-in-law couldn't bear to eat them,

cues.zh: 把月饼送给了她的小女儿
cues.pinyin: ba3 yue4 bing3 song4 gei3 le5 ta1 de5 xiao3 nv3 er2
cues.en: so she gave them to her youngest daughter.

cues.zh: 她的小女儿又把月饼送给了她大姨
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 xiao3 nv3 er2 you4 ba3 yue4 bing3 song4 gei3 le5 ta1 da4 yi2
cues.en: Her youngest daughter then gave them to her aunt.

cues.zh: 大姨又把月饼送给了小阿姨
cues.pinyin: da4 yi2 you4 ba3 yue4 bing3 song4 gei3 le5 xiao3 a1 yi2
cues.en: The aunt gave them to another aunt.

cues.zh: 小阿姨来我家找我
cues.pinyin: xiao3 a1 yi2 lai2 wo3 jia1 zhao3 wo3
cues.en: That aunt came to my house looking for me

cues.zh: 又把这盒月饼送给了我
cues.pinyin: you4 ba3 zhe4 he2 yue4 bing3 song4 gei3 le5 wo3
cues.en: and gave the box of mooncakes to me.

cues.zh: 最后我发现一个问题
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 wo3 fa1 xian4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: In the end I realized something —

cues.zh: 只有我有出钱
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 wo3 you3 chu1 qian2
cues.en: I was the only one who'd spent any money.

cues.zh: 他们都没出
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 dou1 mei2 chu1
cues.en: None of them had paid for anything.

cues.zh: 就送完了全部的礼了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 song4 wan2 le5 quan2 bu4 de5 li3 le5
cues.en: They just passed the whole gift around for free.

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 笑话84｜蚊子咬｜换3个男朋友｜老师最会烤肉｜送月饼｜钞票没消毒｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 医生对病人说
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 dui4 bing4 ren2 shuo1
cues.en: A doctor said to a patient,

cues.zh: 你得到的是传染病
cues.pinyin: ni3 de2 dao4 de5 shi4 chuan2 ran3 bing4
cues.en: "What you have is a contagious disease,

cues.zh: 所以用过的东西都要消毒
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yong4 guo4 de5 dong1 xi1 dou1 yao4 xiao1 du2
cues.en: so everything you've used needs to be disinfected."

cues.zh: 病人听了不以为然的说
cues.pinyin: bing4 ren2 ting1 le5 bu4 yi3 wei2 ran2 de5 shuo1
cues.en: The patient, unconvinced, said,

cues.zh: 那我给你的钞票
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 gei3 ni3 de5 chao1 piao4
cues.en: "Well, the cash I gave you —

cues.zh: 怎么没看到你消毒就往口袋里面放
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 mei2 kan4 dao4 ni3 xiao1 du2 jiu4 wang3 kou3 dai4 li3 mian4 fang4
cues.en: how come I never saw you disinfect it before shoving it in your pocket?"

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近有个小朋友问我说
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 you3 ge4 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Recently a kid asked me,

cues.zh: 他看到有人能够徒手劈开砖头
cues.pinyin: ta1 kan4 dao4 you3 ren2 neng2 gou4 tu2 shou3 pi1 kai1 zhuan1 tou2
cues.en: he saw someone break a brick with their bare hand,

cues.zh: 他觉得很神奇
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 hen3 shen2 qi2
cues.en: and he thought it was amazing.

cues.zh: 这是不是说明了这个人很厉害
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 bu2 shi4 shuo1 ming2 le5 zhe4 ge5 ren2 hen3 li4 hai4
cues.en: Does that mean this person is really strong,

cues.zh: 或者砖头质量很差呢其实还真不一定
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 zhuan1 tou2 zhi4 liang4 hen3 cha4 ne5 qi2 shi2 hai2 zhen1 bu4 yi2 ding4
cues.en: or that the brick is just low quality? Actually, it's not necessarily either.

cues.zh: 这里面满满都是物理原理
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 mian4 man3 man3 dou1 shi4 wu4 li3 yuan2 li3
cues.en: This is actually full of physics principles.

cues.zh: 今天我就教大家四个江湖绝学
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 jiu4 jiao4 da4 jia1 si4 ge4 jiang1 hu2 jue2 xue2
cues.en: Today I'll teach you four 'martial arts secrets.'

cues.zh: 你不光能学会徒手劈砖
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 guang1 neng2 xue2 hui4 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1
cues.en: You'll not only learn to break a brick with your bare hand,

cues.zh: 还能学会胸口碎大石
cues.pinyin: hai2 neng2 xue2 hui4 xiong1 kou3 sui4 da4 shi2
cues.en: but also learn to shatter a big rock on your chest,

cues.zh: 人体悬浮和下半身消失术
cues.pinyin: ren2 ti3 xuan2 fu2 he2 xia4 ban4 shen1 xiao1 shi1 shu4
cues.en: human levitation, and the vanishing lower body trick.

cues.zh: 那我们首先讲第一个江湖绝学
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 jiang3 di4 yi2 ge4 jiang1 hu2 jue2 xue2
cues.en: Let's start with the first secret skill.

cues.zh: 叫做徒手劈砖徒手劈砖
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1
cues.en: It's called breaking a brick with your bare hand.

cues.zh: 我们知道砖头是很硬的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 zhuan1 tou2 shi4 hen3 ying4 de5
cues.en: We know bricks are very hard.

cues.zh: 那有一些练过的人他们可以徒手劈砖
cues.pinyin: na4 you3 yi1 xie1 lian4 guo4 de5 ren2 ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1
cues.en: Some trained people can break bricks with their bare hands.

cues.zh: 那对于普通人来讲我们能够徒手劈砖吗
cues.pinyin: na4 dui4 yu2 pu3 tong1 ren2 lai2 jiang3 wo3 men5 neng2 gou4 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1 ma5
cues.en: But can an ordinary person do it too?

cues.zh: 咱们先来看一个实验
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xian1 lai2 kan4 yi2 ge4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: Let's first look at an experiment.

cues.zh: 一二开始一二开始再来
cues.pinyin: yi1 er4 kai1 shi3 yi1 er4 kai1 shi3 zai4 lai2
cues.en: One, two, go! One, two, go — again!

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 一二开始一二开始终于成了
cues.pinyin: yi1 er4 kai1 shi3 yi1 er4 kai1 shi3 zhong1 yu2 cheng2 le5
cues.en: One, two, go! One, two, go — finally it worked!

cues.zh: 好为什么我作为一个普通人也能
cues.pinyin: hao3 wei4 shen2 me5 wo3 zuo4 wei2 yi2 ge4 pu3 tong1 ren2 ye3 neng2
cues.en: So why, as an ordinary person, was I also able

cues.zh: 够徒手劈砖呢
cues.pinyin: gou4 tu2 shou3 pi1 zhuan1 ne5
cues.en: to break a brick with my bare hand?

cues.zh: 你听完我这个讲解会觉得这并没
cues.pinyin: ni3 ting1 wan2 wo3 zhe4 ge5 jiang3 jie3 hui4 jue2 de5 zhe4 bing4 mei2
cues.en: After hearing my explanation, you'll realize it's

cues.zh: 有什么神奇的
cues.pinyin: you3 shen2 me5 shen2 qi2 de5
cues.en: not magical at all.

cues.zh: 你也能做到
cues.pinyin: ni3 ye3 neng2 zuo4 dao4
cues.en: You can do it too.

cues.zh: 大家看我是把这个砖放在一个很硬
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 wo3 shi4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 fang4 zai4 yi2 ge4 hen3 ying4
cues.en: Look, I placed the brick on a very hard

cues.zh: 的台阶上对吧
cues.pinyin: de5 tai2 jie1 shang4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: step, right?

cues.zh: 这个砖我让它凸出来一块凸出来一块
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 wo3 rang4 ta1 tu1 chu1 lai2 yi1 kuai4 tu1 chu1 lai2 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: I let part of the brick stick out, stick out a bit.

cues.zh: 如果我只是用手劈右半段的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 zhi3 shi4 yong4 shou3 pi1 you4 ban4 duan4 de5 hua4
cues.en: If I just use my hand to chop the right half,

cues.zh: 那想劈断它是很难的
cues.pinyin: na4 xiang3 pi1 duan4 ta1 shi4 hen3 nan2 de5
cues.en: it's very hard to break it that way.

cues.zh: 但是你仔细观察就会发现
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 zi3 xi4 guan1 cha2 jiu4 hui4 fa1 xian4
cues.en: But if you look closely, you'll notice

cues.zh: 我在劈砖的时候
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 pi1 zhuan1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: that when I chop the brick,

cues.zh: 我实际上把这个砖抬起来了一点对不对
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi2 ji4 shang4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 tai2 qi3 lai2 le5 yi4 dian3 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: I actually lift the brick up a little, right?

cues.zh: 然后用这个手劈的时候顺势往下压
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 pi1 de5 shi2 hou4 shun4 shi4 wang3 xia4 ya1
cues.en: Then as my hand chops, it presses down with the motion.

cues.zh: 这样一来砖块就会具有一个比较
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 zhuan1 kuai4 jiu4 hui4 ju4 you3 yi2 ge4 bi3 jiao4
cues.en: This gives the brick a relatively

cues.zh: 大的一个速度
cues.pinyin: da4 de5 yi2 ge4 su4 du4
cues.en: large speed.

cues.zh: 或者准确说是角速度
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 zhun3 que4 shuo1 shi4 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: Or more precisely, angular velocity.

cues.zh: 什么叫角速度
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: What is angular velocity?

cues.zh: 就是单位时间内转过的角度这叫角速度
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 dan1 wei4 shi2 jian1 nei4 zhuan3 guo4 de5 jiao3 du4 zhe4 jiao4 jiao3 su4 du4
cues.en: It's the angle rotated per unit time — that's angular velocity.

cues.zh: 有了这个角速度之后
cues.pinyin: you3 le5 zhe4 ge5 jiao3 su4 du4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Once it has this angular velocity,

cues.zh: 当砖块遇到了这个顶点
cues.pinyin: dang1 zhuan1 kuai4 yu4 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 ding3 dian3
cues.en: when the brick hits this edge point,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 具体来讲转动定律是这么写的
cues.pinyin: ju4 ti3 lai2 jiang3 zhuan3 dong4 ding4 lv4 shi4 zhe4 me5 xie3 de5
cues.en: specifically, the law of rotation is written like this:

cues.zh: 叫力矩乘以时间等于转动贯量乘以
cues.pinyin: jiao4 li4 ju3 cheng2 yi3 shi2 jian1 deng3 yu2 zhuan3 dong4 guan4 liang4 cheng2 yi3
cues.en: torque times time equals moment of inertia times

cues.zh: 角速度的变化
cues.pinyin: jiao3 su4 du4 de5 bian4 hua4
cues.en: the change in angular velocity.

cues.zh: 这是什么乱七八糟
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 shen2 me5 luan4 qi1 ba1 zao1
cues.en: What is this mess?

cues.zh: 力矩咱们初中学过就是力乘力弊
cues.pinyin: li4 ju3 zan2 men5 chu1 zhong1 xue2 guo4 jiu4 shi4 li4 cheng2 li4 bi4
cues.en: Torque, which we learned in middle school, is force times the lever arm.

cues.zh: 咱们看这个物体在往下转动的过程中
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 kan4 zhe4 ge5 wu4 ti3 zai4 wang3 xia4 zhuan3 dong4 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: Let's look at this object as it rotates downward.

cues.zh: 我们忽略重力
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 hu1 lve4 zhong4 li4
cues.en: We'll ignore gravity.

cues.zh: 那么力就是 F 对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 li4 jiu4 shi4 F dui4 ba5
cues.en: So the force is F, right?

cues.zh: 你是绕左侧的这个 O 点旋转的
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 rao4 zuo3 ce4 de5 zhe4 ge5 O dian3 xuan2 zhuan3 de5
cues.en: You're rotating around this point O on the left.

cues.zh: 所以力 B 就是 B
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 li4 B jiu4 shi4 B
cues.en: So the lever arm is B.

cues.zh: 于是力矩就是 F 乘以一个 B 对吧
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 li4 ju3 jiu4 shi4 F cheng2 yi3 yi2 ge4 B dui4 ba5
cues.en: So the torque is F times B, right?

cues.zh: 再乘以作用时间 T
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 yi3 zuo4 yong4 shi2 jian1 T
cues.en: times the time T it acts for,

cues.zh: 等于一个叫做转动惯量的玩意儿
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 yi2 ge4 jiao4 zuo4 zhuan3 dong4 guan4 liang4 de5 wan2 yi4 er2
cues.en: equals something called the moment of inertia

cues.zh: 转动惯量相当于转动物体的质量
cues.pinyin: zhuan3 dong4 guan4 liang4 xiang1 dang1 yu2 zhuan3 dong4 wu4 ti3 de5 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: The moment of inertia is like the 'mass' of a rotating object.

cues.zh: 质量是 M
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liang4 shi4 M
cues.en: The mass is M.

cues.zh: 那么转动的时候它的质量是 1 MA
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhuan3 dong4 de5 shi2 hou4 ta1 de5 zhi4 liang4 shi4 1 MA
cues.en: So when it rotates, its moment of inertia is 1/3 ML²,

cues.zh: 这是对于一个长杆而言
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 dui4 yu2 yi2 ge4 zhang3 gan1 er2 yan2
cues.en: this is for a long rod,

cues.zh: 以左侧为旋转的转轴的话
cues.pinyin: yi3 zuo3 ce4 wei4 xuan2 zhuan3 de5 zhuan4 zhou2 de5 hua4
cues.en: with the left end as the pivot axis.

cues.zh: 那么它的转动惯量是这么大
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 zhuan3 dong4 guan4 liang4 shi4 zhe4 me5 da4
cues.en: So its moment of inertia is this large.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 地面很硬时间 T 很小
cues.pinyin: di4 mian4 hen3 ying4 shi2 jian1 T hen3 xiao3
cues.en: The ground is very hard, so the time T is very small.

cues.zh: 那这样一来这个 F 是不是就是很大的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 zhe4 ge5 F shi4 bu2 shi4 jiu4 shi4 hen3 da4 de5
cues.en: So that means F ends up being very large,

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 所以我们在这个 P 砖的过程之中
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 ge5 P zhuan1 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: So in this process of breaking the brick,

cues.zh: 我们尽量要保证
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jin3 liang4 yao4 bao3 zheng4
cues.en: we want to make sure of two things.

cues.zh: 首先地面要非常的硬
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 di4 mian4 yao4 fei1 chang2 de5 ying4
cues.en: First, the ground needs to be very hard.

cues.zh: 地面硬的话这个时间 T 就短
cues.pinyin: di4 mian4 ying4 de5 hua4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 jian1 T jiu4 duan3
cues.en: If the ground is hard, the time T is short,

cues.zh: 对不对
cues.pinyin: dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: right?

cues.zh: 好第二就是你尽量让这个砖往下
cues.pinyin: hao3 di4 er4 jiu4 shi4 ni3 jin3 liang4 rang4 zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 wang3 xia4
cues.en: Second, you should try to make the brick fall

cues.zh: 落的速度要快
cues.pinyin: luo4 de5 su4 du4 yao4 kuai4
cues.en: down as fast as possible.

cues.zh: 那怎么让它快
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 rang4 ta1 kuai4
cues.en: So how do you make it fast?

cues.zh: 你就要用这个手辅助它
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiu4 yao4 yong4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 fu3 zhu4 ta1
cues.en: You need to use your hand to help it

cues.zh: 在空中使劲
cues.pinyin: zai4 kong1 zhong1 shi3 jin4
cues.en: exert force while it's in the air.

cues.zh: 不要等到最后这个砖落下来再使劲
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 deng3 dao4 zui4 hou4 zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 la4 xia4 lai2 zai4 shi3 jin4
cues.en: Don't wait until the brick has already landed to apply force,

cues.zh: 对吧那个时候使劲已经来不及了
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 na4 ge5 shi2 hou4 shi3 jin4 yi3 jing1 lai2 bu4 ji2 le5
cues.en: because by then it's too late.

cues.zh: 你在空中使劲
cues.pinyin: ni3 zai4 kong1 zhong1 shi3 jin4
cues.en: You apply force while it's in the air,

cues.zh: 让这个砖转得很快
cues.pinyin: rang4 zhe4 ge5 zhuan1 zhuan3 de2 hen3 kuai4
cues.en: making the brick rotate very fast.

cues.zh: 一个它就断了
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ta1 jiu4 duan4 le5
cues.en: and it breaks in one go.

cues.zh: 这个事其实就跟我们拿着一个砖
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 gen1 wo3 men5 na2 zhe5 yi2 ge4 zhuan1
cues.en: This is actually the same as holding a brick

cues.zh: 然后往那个台阶上磕把它磕断
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wang3 na4 ge5 tai2 jie1 shang4 ke1 ba3 ta1 ke1 duan4
cues.en: and knocking it against a step to break it.

cues.zh: 是一个意思并没有那么难
cues.pinyin: shi4 yi2 ge4 yi4 si5 bing4 mei2 you3 na4 me5 nan2
cues.en: It's the same idea — not that hard at all.

cues.zh: 所以其实每一个普通人都能够做到这一点
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qi2 shi2 mei3 yi2 ge4 pu3 tong1 ren2 dou1 neng2 gou4 zuo4 dao4 zhe4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: So actually every ordinary person can do this.

cues.zh: 当然我们破坏物品是不对的对吧
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 wo3 men5 po4 huai4 wu4 pin3 shi4 bu2 dui4 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Of course, destroying property isn't right, right?

cues.zh: 另外小朋友们不要去做
cues.pinyin: ling4 wai4 xiao3 peng2 you3 men5 bu2 yao4 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: Also, kids, please don't try this.

cues.zh: 因为你做完了这个实验之后
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ni3 zuo4 wan2 le5 zhe4 ge5 shi2 yan4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: Because after you do this experiment,

cues.zh: 你会发现砖头乱飞
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhuan1 tou2 luan4 fei1
cues.en: you'll find brick fragments flying everywhere,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 砸到别的小朋友就不好了对吧
cues.pinyin: za2 dao4 bie2 de5 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 bu4 hao3 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: and hitting another kid would be bad, right?

cues.zh: 我们只是给大家讲一下这个原理
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi3 shi4 gei3 da4 jia1 jiang3 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 yuan2 li3
cues.en: We're just explaining the principle to you.

cues.zh: 好那么第一个江湖绝学咱们就说完了
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 di4 yi2 ge4 jiang1 hu2 jue2 xue2 zan2 men5 jiu4 shuo1 wan2 le5
cues.en: Alright, that's the first secret skill covered.

cues.zh: 下面我们说第二个江湖绝学
cues.pinyin: xia4 mian4 wo3 men5 shuo1 di4 er4 ge4 jiang1 hu2 jue2 xue2
cues.en: Next, let's talk about the second secret skill.

cues.zh: 这个江湖绝学在很多地方都有
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiang1 hu2 jue2 xue2 zai4 hen3 duo1 di4 fang1 dou1 you3
cues.en: This skill appears in many places.

cues.zh: 比如周星驰的电影里边就有
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 zhou1 xing1 chi2 de5 dian4 ying3 li3 bian1 jiu4 you3
cues.en: For example, it's in Stephen Chow's movies.

cues.zh: 叫做胸口碎大石
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 xiong1 kou3 sui4 da4 shi2
cues.en: It's called 'shattering a big rock on the chest.'

cues.zh: 胸口碎大石是吧
cues.pinyin: xiong1 kou3 sui4 da4 shi2 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Shattering a big rock on the chest, right?

cues.zh: 胸口碎大石怎么表演呢
cues.pinyin: xiong1 kou3 sui4 da4 shi2 zen3 me5 biao3 yan3 ne5
cues.en: How is this performed?

cues.zh: 一个人躺着然后大石头放上去
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 tang3 zhe5 ran2 hou4 da4 shi2 tou5 fang4 shang4 qu4
cues.en: A person lies down, and a big rock is placed on them.

cues.zh: 拿锤子里砸石头碎了
cues.pinyin: na2 chui2 zi5 li3 za2 shi2 tou5 sui4 le5
cues.en: Then you hit it with a hammer, and the rock breaks.

cues.zh: 更有甚者是吧
cues.pinyin: geng4 you3 shen4 zhe3 shi4 ba5
cues.en: Some even go further, right?

cues.zh: 底下我们放这个钉子
cues.pinyin: di3 xia4 wo3 men5 fang4 zhe4 ge5 ding1 zi5
cues.en: Underneath, we place nails —

cues.zh: 钉板是不是底下有个钉板
cues.pinyin: ding1 ban3 shi4 bu2 shi4 di3 xia4 you3 ge4 ding1 ban3
cues.en: a bed of nails, there's a nail board underneath.

cues.zh: 然后有一个人躺在这个钉板上
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 tang3 zai4 zhe4 ge5 ding1 ban3 shang4
cues.en: Then a person lies on this bed of nails.

cues.zh: 一个人他躺在钉板上
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 ta1 tang3 zai4 ding1 ban3 shang4
cues.en: A person lies on the bed of nails,

cues.zh: 然后在这个人的胸口上放一个大石头
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 ren2 de5 xiong1 kou3 shang4 fang4 yi2 ge4 da4 shi2 tou5
cues.en: and a big rock is placed on their chest.

cues.zh: 然后拿锤子光击一凿
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 na2 chui2 zi5 guang1 ji1 yi1 zao2
cues.en: then you smash it hard with a hammer,

cues.zh: 结果发现这石头碎了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 fa1 xian4 zhe4 shi2 tou5 sui4 le5
cues.en: and it turns out the rock breaks.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】人能徒手劈断砖头吗？学好物理学，就不会被障眼法给骗了

cues.zh: 举个例子我们首先来研究一下这个锤子
cues.pinyin: ju3 ge4 li4 zi5 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 chui2 zi5
cues.en: For example, let's first study the hammer.

cues.zh: 锤子这是个锤子
cues.pinyin: chui2 zi5 zhe4 shi4 ge4 chui2 zi5
cues.en: The hammer — this is the hammer.

cues.zh: 这个锤子我们假设的质量是 M 1
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 chui2 zi5 wo3 men5 jia3 she4 de5 zhi4 liang4 shi4 M 1
cues.en: Let's assume the hammer's mass is M1,

cues.zh: 在往下落的时候速度是 V 1
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 xia4 luo4 de5 shi2 hou4 su4 du4 shi4 V 1
cues.en: and its speed as it falls is V1.

cues.zh: 结果这么一轮砸到那个大石头了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhe4 me5 yi1 lun2 za2 dao4 na4 ge5 da4 shi2 tou5 le5
cues.en: Then it smashes down onto the big rock,

cues.zh: 这锤子就停了它为什么会停
cues.pinyin: zhe4 chui2 zi5 jiu4 ting2 le5 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 ting2
cues.en: and the hammer stops. Why does it stop?

cues.zh: 因为它受到了石头给它向上的一
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shou4 dao4 le5 shi2 tou5 gei3 ta1 xiang4 shang4 de5 yi1
cues.en: Because the rock exerts an upward

cues.zh: 个作用力 F 1
cues.pinyin: ge4 zuo4 yong4 li4 F 1
cues.en: force F1 on it.

cues.zh: 这个 F 1 会算吗其实不难
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 F 1 hui4 suan4 ma5 qi2 shi2 bu4 nan2
cues.en: Can we calculate F1? Actually it's not hard.

cues.zh: 对吧我们看一下这个锤子
cues.pinyin: dui4 ba5 wo3 men5 kan4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 chui2 zi5
cues.en: Right, let's look at the hammer.

cues.zh: 这个锤子它和石头之间有一个作用力 F 1
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 chui2 zi5 ta1 he2 shi2 tou5 zhi1 jian1 you3 yi2 ge4 zuo4 yong4 li4 F 1
cues.en: There's a force F1 between the hammer and the rock.

cues.zh: F 1 乘以 T
cues.pinyin: F 1 cheng2 yi3 T
cues.en: F1 times T,

cues.zh: T 1 等于什么呢
cues.pinyin: T 1 deng3 yu2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: T1 — what does that equal?

cues.zh: 等于这个石头的动量变化
cues.pinyin: deng3 yu2 zhe4 ge5 shi2 tou5 de5 dong4 liang4 bian4 hua4
cues.en: It equals the change in momentum of the hammer.

cues.zh: 石头本来有速度 V 1
cues.pinyin: shi2 tou5 ben3 lai2 you3 su4 du4 V 1
cues.en: The hammer originally had speed V1,

cues.zh: 后来砸了石板之后停了对吧
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 za2 le5 shi2 ban3 zhi1 hou4 ting2 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: and after hitting the rock, it stopped, right?

cues.zh: 所以动量变化是 M V 1
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dong4 liang4 bian4 hua4 shi4 M V 1
cues.en: So the momentum change is M1V1.

cues.zh: 你通过这件事你就可以算出 F 1 来
cues.pinyin: ni3 tong1 guo4 zhe4 jian4 shi4 ni3 jiu4 ke3 yi3 suan4 chu1 F 1 lai2
cues.en: From this you can calculate F1.

items.title_zh: 笑话93｜8个适合小孩的笑话｜超强读心术｜什么动物最喜欢被贴在墙壁上？｜秃头｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我的车胎没气了一定是有人故意扎的
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 che1 tai1 mei2 qi4 le5 yi2 ding4 shi4 you3 ren2 gu4 yi4 zha1 de5
cues.en: My tire has gone flat — someone must have punctured it on purpose.

cues.zh: 爸爸我知道一定是隔壁的陈叔叔
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 wo3 zhi1 dao4 yi2 ding4 shi4 ge2 bi4 de5 chen2 shu1 shu1
cues.en: Dad, I know it must be Uncle Chen next door.

cues.zh: 他准是嫌你的车放在那里妨碍他过去
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhun3 shi4 xian2 ni3 de5 che1 fang4 zai4 na4 li3 fang2 ai4 ta1 guo4 qu4
cues.en: He's probably annoyed that your car parked there was blocking his way.

cues.zh: 你有看到他扎我车胎了吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 you3 kan4 dao4 ta1 zha1 wo3 che1 tai1 le5 ma5
cues.en: Did you actually see him puncture my tire?

cues.zh: 没有那你怎么知道一定是他
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 na4 ni3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4 yi2 ding4 shi4 ta1
cues.en: No. Then how do you know for sure it was him?

cues.zh: 因为我曾看到你嫌他的车放在那里碍事
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 ceng2 kan4 dao4 ni3 xian2 ta1 de5 che1 fang4 zai4 na4 li3 ai4 shi4
cues.en: Because I once saw you complain that his car parked there was in your way,

cues.zh: 也这样偷偷的扎过几次呢
cues.pinyin: ye3 zhe4 yang4 tou1 tou1 de5 zha1 guo4 ji3 ci4 ne5
cues.en: and you secretly punctured his tire a few times too.

cues.zh: 小美到朋友家做客
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 dao4 peng2 you3 jia1 zuo4 ke4
cues.en: Xiaomei went to visit a friend's house.

cues.zh: 朋友的儿子看着她说
cues.pinyin: peng2 you3 de5 er2 zi5 kan4 zhe5 ta1 shuo1
cues.en: Her friend's son looked at her and said,

cues.zh: 这个阿姨真难看
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 a1 yi2 zhen1 nan2 kan4
cues.en: "This auntie is really ugly."

cues.zh: 小美听得很不高兴
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ting1 de2 hen3 bu4 gao1 xing4
cues.en: Xiaomei was not happy to hear that.

cues.zh: 正准备发飙时
cues.pinyin: zheng4 zhun3 bei4 fa1 biao1 shi2
cues.en: Just as she was about to blow up,

cues.zh: 朋友连忙让儿子认错
cues.pinyin: peng2 you3 lian2 mang2 rang4 er2 zi5 ren4 cuo4
cues.en: her friend quickly made the son admit he was wrong.

cues.zh: 儿子立刻再对小美说
cues.pinyin: er2 zi5 li4 ke4 zai4 dui4 xiao3 mei3 shuo1
cues.en: The son immediately said to Xiaomei again,

cues.zh: 阿姨其实你还是蛮漂亮的
cues.pinyin: a1 yi2 qi2 shi2 ni3 hai2 shi4 man2 piao4 liang4 de5
cues.en: "Auntie, actually you're still quite pretty."

cues.zh: 小美听得很高兴正准备谦虚一下
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 ting1 de2 hen3 gao1 xing4 zheng4 zhun3 bei4 qian1 xu1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Xiaomei was pleased and was about to act modest,

cues.zh: 朋友却大声教训儿子
cues.pinyin: peng2 you3 que4 da4 sheng1 jiao4 xun4 er2 zi5
cues.en: but her friend loudly scolded the son,

cues.zh: 我是叫你认错不是叫你说谎
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 jiao4 ni3 ren4 cuo4 bu2 shi4 jiao4 ni3 shuo1 huang3
cues.en: "I told you to admit your mistake, not to tell a lie!"

cues.zh: 妈妈的生日快到了
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 de5 sheng1 ri4 kuai4 dao4 le5
cues.en: Mom's birthday was coming up soon.

cues.zh: 小明问妈妈想要什么礼物
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 wen4 ma1 ma1 xiang3 yao4 shen2 me5 li3 wu4
cues.en: Xiaoming asked his mom what gift she wanted.

cues.zh: 妈妈说
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 shuo1
cues.en: Mom said,

cues.zh: 只要你乖乖的听妈妈的话就好了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 guai1 guai1 de5 ting1 ma1 ma1 de5 hua4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: "As long as you're good and listen to me, that's enough.

cues.zh: 妈妈什么礼物都不要
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 shen2 me5 li3 wu4 dou1 bu2 yao4
cues.en: Mom doesn't want any gift at all."

cues.zh: 哦既然这样子
cues.pinyin: o2 ji4 ran2 zhe4 yang4 zi5
cues.en: "Oh, since that's the case,

cues.zh: 那等到我生日的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 deng3 dao4 wo3 sheng1 ri4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: then when my birthday comes,

cues.zh: 我也什么礼物都不要
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 shen2 me5 li3 wu4 dou1 bu2 yao4
cues.en: I won't want any gift either.

cues.zh: 只要妈妈听我的话就好了
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ma1 ma1 ting1 wo3 de5 hua4 jiu4 hao3 le5
cues.en: As long as mom listens to me, that's enough."
