cues.zh: 小美到朋友家做客
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 dao4 peng2 you3 jia1 zuo4 ke4
cues.en: Xiaomei went to visit a friend's house.

cues.zh: 非常奇怪他的朋友的小孩
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 qi2 guai4 ta1 de5 peng2 you3 de5 xiao3 hai2
cues.en: She found it very odd how her friend's kid

cues.zh: 为什么那么守规矩
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 na4 me5 shou3 gui1 ju3
cues.en: was so well-behaved.

cues.zh: 于是问
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wen4
cues.en: So she asked,

cues.zh: 你真乖
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhen1 guai1
cues.en: "You're so well-behaved —

cues.zh: 你为什么这么听话呢
cues.pinyin: ni3 wei4 shen2 me5 zhe4 me5 ting1 hua4 ne5
cues.en: why are you so obedient?"

cues.zh: 因为妈妈说
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ma1 ma1 shuo1
cues.en: "Because mom said,

cues.zh: 如果我不嘲笑你很怕
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 bu4 chao2 xiao4 ni3 hen3 pa4
cues.en: if I don't laugh at dad for being fat

cues.zh: 和手臂很粗的话
cues.pinyin: he2 shou3 bi4 hen3 cu1 de5 hua4
cues.en: and having really thick arms,

cues.zh: 他待会就要带我去买玩具
cues.pinyin: ta1 dai4 hui4 jiu4 yao4 dai4 wo3 qu4 mai3 wan2 ju4
cues.en: he'll take me to buy toys later."

items.title_zh: 笑话93｜8个适合小孩的笑话｜超强读心术｜什么动物最喜欢被贴在墙壁上？｜秃头｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 如果我考全班第一名
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 kao3 quan2 ban1 di4 yi4 ming2
cues.en: "If you come first in the whole class,

cues.zh: 你会怎么样啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4 a5
cues.en: what will you do?"

cues.zh: 那我就高兴死了哦
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 jiu4 gao1 xing4 si3 le5 o2
cues.en: "Then I'll be thrilled to death!"

cues.zh: 爸爸
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4
cues.en: "Dad,

cues.zh: 不要担心
cues.pinyin: bu2 yao4 dan1 xin1
cues.en: don't worry —

cues.zh: 我不会让你死的
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu2 hui4 rang4 ni3 si3 de5
cues.en: I won't let you die."

cues.zh: 超强读心数
cues.pinyin: chao1 qiang2 du2 xin1 shu4
cues.en: Super Mind-Reading Trick

cues.zh: 你心里想一个手机号码
cues.pinyin: ni3 xin1 li3 xiang3 yi2 ge4 shou3 ji1 hao4 ma3
cues.en: Think of a phone number in your head.

cues.zh: 记住它最后一个数字
cues.pinyin: ji4 zhu4 ta1 zui4 hou4 yi2 ge4 shu4 zi4
cues.en: Remember its last digit.

cues.zh: 接下来把这个数字乘以 3
cues.pinyin: jie1 xia4 lai2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shu4 zi4 cheng2 yi3 3
cues.en: Next, multiply that digit by 3.

cues.zh: 再加上 3
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 3
cues.en: Then add 3.

cues.zh: 得出答案后再把这个数字乘以 3
cues.pinyin: de2 chu1 da2 an4 hou4 zai4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 shu4 zi4 cheng2 yi3 3
cues.en: After getting that answer, multiply it by 3 again.

cues.zh: 最后你会得到一个结果
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 ni3 hui4 de2 dao4 yi2 ge4 jie2 guo3
cues.en: In the end you'll get a result.

cues.zh: 如果这个结果是两位数
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 zhe4 ge5 jie2 guo3 shi4 liang3 wei4 shu4
cues.en: If the result is a two-digit number,

cues.zh: 就把它拆成十位数和个位数
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ba3 ta1 chai1 cheng2 shi2 wei4 shu4 he2 ge4 wei4 shu4
cues.en: split it into its tens digit and ones digit,

cues.zh: 把它们相加起来
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 men5 xiang1 jia1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and add them together.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近科学家们准备开始着手验证所
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 ke1 xue2 jia1 men5 zhun3 bei4 kai1 shi3 zhuo2 shou3 yan4 zheng4 suo3
cues.en: Recently scientists are preparing to start verifying the so-

cues.zh: 谓的镜像宇宙
cues.pinyin: wei4 de5 jing4 xiang4 yu3 zhou4
cues.en: -called mirror universe.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就问我说他经常看科幻电影
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 wen4 wo3 shuo1 ta1 jing1 chang2 kan4 ke1 huan4 dian4 ying3
cues.en: A kid asked me, saying he often watches sci-fi movies.

cues.zh: 里面有什么反物质武器什么反物质空间
cues.pinyin: li3 mian4 you3 shen2 me5 fan3 wu4 zhi4 wu3 qi4 shen2 me5 fan3 wu4 zhi4 kong1 jian1
cues.en: In them there are antimatter weapons, antimatter spaces,

cues.zh: 还有飞船以曲率飞行
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 fei1 chuan2 yi3 qu1 lv4 fei1 xing2
cues.en: and spaceships flying at warp speed (curvature flight).

cues.zh: 他就想问我说这个反物质到底是什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 xiang3 wen4 wo3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 fan3 wu4 zhi4 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: He wanted to ask me what exactly antimatter is.

cues.zh: 今天就先来给大家介绍一下反物
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 jiu4 xian1 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4 fan3 wu4
cues.en: Today let's first introduce to everyone anti-

cues.zh: 质的这个含义
cues.pinyin: zhi4 di4 zhe4 ge5 han2 yi4
cues.en: -matter's meaning.

cues.zh: 为了介绍反物质我们首先得从一个人就
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie4 shao4 fan3 wu4 zhi4 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 de2 cong2 yi2 ge4 ren2 jiu4
cues.en: To introduce antimatter, we first have to start with a person,

cues.zh: 是狄拉克说起
cues.pinyin: shi4 di2 la1 ke4 shuo1 qi3
cues.en: that is Dirac.

cues.zh: 一个著名的英国物理学家保罗狄拉克
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 de5 ying1 guo2 wu4 li3 xue2 jia1 bao3 luo2 di2 la1 ke4
cues.en: A famous British physicist, Paul Dirac.

cues.zh: 狄拉克他提出了第一种反物质的概念
cues.pinyin: di2 la1 ke4 ta1 ti2 chu1 le5 di4 yi1 zhong3 fan3 wu4 zhi4 di4 gai4 nian4
cues.en: Dirac proposed the first concept of antimatter.

cues.zh: 狄拉克反粒子
cues.pinyin: di2 la1 ke4 fan3 li4 zi5
cues.en: The Dirac antiparticle.

cues.zh: 我们来说一说到底是什么意思
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 yi4 si5
cues.en: Let's talk about what this actually means.

cues.zh: 首先在 19 29 年的时候
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 zai4 19 29 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: First, in 1928,

cues.zh: 狄拉克提出了一个著名的方程
cues.pinyin: di2 la1 ke4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi2 ge4 zhu4 ming2 de5 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: Dirac proposed a famous equation.

cues.zh: 就是狄拉克方程
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 di2 la1 ke4 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: That is the Dirac equation.

cues.zh: 这狄拉克方程是干嘛用的呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 di2 la1 ke4 fang1 cheng2 shi4 gan4 ma2 yong4 de5 ne5
cues.en: What is the Dirac equation used for?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 我们简单的介绍一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jian3 dan1 de5 jie4 shao4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's briefly introduce it.

cues.zh: 首先我们知道 19 05 年的时候
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 19 05 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: First we know that in 1905,

cues.zh: 爱因斯坦就提出了这个狭义相对论
cues.pinyin: ai4 yin1 si1 tan3 jiu4 ti2 chu1 le5 zhe4 ge5 xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4
cues.en: Einstein proposed special relativity.

cues.zh: 狭义相对论就是说这个空间和时间它
cues.pinyin: xia2 yi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 kong1 jian1 he2 shi2 jian1 ta1
cues.en: Special relativity says that space and time

cues.zh: 是相互联系的
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiang1 hu4 lian2 xi4 de5
cues.en: are interconnected.

cues.zh: 我们举一个简单的例子
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ju3 yi2 ge4 jian3 dan1 de5 li4 zi5
cues.en: Let's give a simple example.

cues.zh: 比如说有一辆汽车
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 you3 yi1 liang4 qi4 che1
cues.en: Say there's a car.

cues.zh: 这辆汽车正在以速度 V 0 在地面上奔跑
cues.pinyin: zhe4 liang4 qi4 che1 zheng4 zai4 yi3 su4 du4 V 0 zai4 di4 mian4 shang4 ben1 pao3
cues.en: This car is running on the ground at speed V0.

cues.zh: 而这有一个人他在车上
cues.pinyin: er2 zhe4 you3 yi2 ge4 ren2 ta1 zai4 che1 shang4
cues.en: And there's a person on the car.

cues.zh: 他相对于车有一个速度叫 V 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang1 dui4 yu2 che1 you3 yi2 ge4 su4 du4 jiao4 V 1
cues.en: He has a speed relative to the car called V1.

cues.zh: 注意车相对于地面速度是 V 0
cues.pinyin: zhu4 yi4 che1 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 mian4 su4 du4 shi4 V 0
cues.en: Note the car's speed relative to the ground is V0.

cues.zh: 人相对于车速度是 V 1
cues.pinyin: ren2 xiang1 dui4 yu2 che1 su4 du4 shi4 V 1
cues.en: The person's speed relative to the car is V1.

cues.zh: 那我问人相对于地面的速度是多少
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 wen4 ren2 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 mian4 de5 su4 du4 shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: So I ask, what is the person's speed relative to the ground?

cues.zh: 人对地的速度是多少
cues.pinyin: ren2 dui4 di4 de5 su4 du4 shi4 duo1 shao3
cues.en: What is the person's speed relative to the ground?

cues.zh: 我想问这个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 wen4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I want to ask this question.

cues.zh: 人对地的速度要分两种情况
cues.pinyin: ren2 dui4 di4 de5 su4 du4 yao4 fen1 liang3 zhong3 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: The person's speed relative to the ground splits into two cases.

cues.zh: 第一种情况就是如果是非相对论情况的
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 zhong3 qing2 kuang4 jiu4 shi4 ru2 guo3 shi4 fei1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qing2 kuang4 de5
cues.en: The first case is if it's non-relativistic,

cues.zh: 非相对论情况
cues.pinyin: fei1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: the non-relativistic case,

cues.zh: 那就很简单了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 hen3 jian3 dan1 le5
cues.en: then it's very simple.

cues.zh: 人相对于地面的速度 V 人应该等
cues.pinyin: ren2 xiang1 dui4 yu2 di4 mian4 de5 su4 du4 V ren2 ying1 gai1 deng3
cues.en: The person's speed relative to the ground, V_person, should equal

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 我们可以研究一下
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Let's look into it a bit.

cues.zh: 如果 V 0 和 V 1 都远远小于光速 C 的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 V 0 he2 V 1 dou1 yuan3 yuan3 xiao3 yu2 guang1 su4 C de5 hua4
cues.en: If V0 and V1 are both much smaller than the speed of light C,

cues.zh: 那这个分母基本上就是 1 了
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 fen1 mu3 ji1 ben3 shang4 jiu4 shi4 1 le5
cues.en: then the denominator is basically 1.

cues.zh: 所以这样一来它这俩公式就完全一样了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 ta1 zhe4 lia3 gong1 shi4 jiu4 wan2 quan2 yi1 yang4 le5
cues.en: So in that case these two formulas become exactly the same.

cues.zh: 但是如果说 V 1 和 V 0 比较接近
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 shuo1 V 1 he2 V 0 bi3 jiao4 jie1 jin4
cues.en: But if V1 and V0 are relatively close

cues.zh: 于光速 C 的话
cues.pinyin: yu2 guang1 su4 C de5 hua4
cues.en: to the speed of light C,

cues.zh: 那这两个公式就不一样
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 liang3 ge4 gong1 shi4 jiu4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: then these two formulas are different.

cues.zh: 而且你从第二公式也能看得出来
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ni3 cong2 di4 er4 gong1 shi4 ye3 neng2 kan4 de2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: And you can also see from the second formula

cues.zh: 不管 V 1 和 V 0 是什么数只要不超过光速
cues.pinyin: bu4 guan3 V 1 he2 V 0 shi4 shen2 me5 shu4 zhi3 yao4 bu4 chao1 guo4 guang1 su4
cues.en: that no matter what V1 and V0 are, as long as they don't exceed the speed of light,

cues.zh: 最后的计算结果也不会超过光速
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 de5 ji4 suan4 jie2 guo3 ye3 bu2 hui4 chao1 guo4 guang1 su4
cues.en: the final calculated result also won't exceed the speed of light.

cues.zh: 所以人就算在一个光速的汽车上奔跑
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ren2 jiu4 suan4 zai4 yi2 ge4 guang1 su4 de5 qi4 che1 shang4 ben1 pao3
cues.en: So even if a person runs on a car moving at near light speed,

cues.zh: 人的速度也不会超过光速的
cues.pinyin: ren2 de5 su4 du4 ye3 bu2 hui4 chao1 guo4 guang1 su4 de5
cues.en: the person's speed still won't exceed the speed of light.

cues.zh: 这个就是相对论的变化洛伦兹变化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5 bian4 hua4 luo4 lun2 zi1 bian4 hua4
cues.en: This is the relativistic transformation — the Lorentz transformation.

cues.zh: 那狄拉克方程说的到底是什么呢
cues.pinyin: na4 di2 la1 ke4 fang1 cheng2 shuo1 de5 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what is the Dirac equation actually saying?

cues.zh: 这就涉及到一个量子力学的基本方程了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 she4 ji2 dao4 yi2 ge4 liang4 zi3 li4 xue2 de5 ji1 ben3 fang1 cheng2 le5
cues.en: This involves a fundamental equation of quantum mechanics.

cues.zh: 我们知道量子力学中有一个重要的概
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 liang4 zi3 li4 xue2 zhong1 you3 yi2 ge4 zhong4 yao4 de5 gai4
cues.en: We know that in quantum mechanics there's an important con-

cues.zh: 念就是波函数
cues.pinyin: nian4 jiu4 shi4 bo1 han2 shu4
cues.en: -cept, the wave function.

cues.zh: 它描述粒子位置在什么地方的概率
cues.pinyin: ta1 miao2 shu4 li4 zi5 wei4 zhi4 zai4 shen2 me5 di4 fang1 de5 gai4 lv4
cues.en: It describes the probability of where a particle is located.

cues.zh: 量子力学的波函数方程是由薛
cues.pinyin: liang4 zi3 li4 xue2 de5 bo1 han2 shu4 fang1 cheng2 shi4 you2 xue1
cues.en: The wave function equation of quantum mechanics was proposed by Schrö-

cues.zh: 定谷提出来的
cues.pinyin: ding4 gu3 ti2 chu1 lai2 de5
cues.en: -dinger.

cues.zh: 叫做薛定谷方程
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 xue1 ding4 gu3 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: called the Schrödinger equation.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 写完了大家看这个方程非常复杂
cues.pinyin: xie3 wan2 le5 da4 jia1 kan4 zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 fei1 chang2 fu4 za2
cues.en: Once written out, everyone sees this equation is very complex.

cues.zh: 咱们也不用把它记住
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 ye3 bu4 yong4 ba3 ta1 ji4 zhu4
cues.en: We don't need to memorize it.

cues.zh: 大概的意思就是说
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 de5 yi4 si5 jiu4 shi4 shuo1
cues.en: Roughly, what it means is

cues.zh: 我想知道这个波函数
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 ge5 bo1 han2 shu4
cues.en: I want to know this wave function,

cues.zh: 到底要满足一个什么规律
cues.pinyin: dao4 di3 yao4 man3 zu2 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 gui1 lv4
cues.en: exactly what law it must satisfy.

cues.zh: 他就给了你这么一个规律
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 gei3 le5 ni3 zhe4 me5 yi2 ge4 gui1 lv4
cues.en: He gave you exactly such a law.

cues.zh: 而且这个规律跟薛定谋方程还有不一样
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zhe4 ge5 gui1 lv4 gen1 xue1 ding4 mou2 fang1 cheng2 hai2 you3 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: And this law differs from the Schrödinger equation in one way.

cues.zh: 薛定谋方程是非相对论的
cues.pinyin: xue1 ding4 mou2 fang1 cheng2 shi4 fei1 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5
cues.en: The Schrödinger equation is non-relativistic.

cues.zh: 它是满足相对论的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 man3 zu2 xiang1 dui4 lun4 de5
cues.en: it satisfies relativity.

cues.zh: 所以它比薛定谋方程更加的严格对吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 bi3 xue1 ding4 mou2 fang1 cheng2 geng4 jia1 de5 yan2 ge2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: So it's stricter than the Schrödinger equation, right?

cues.zh: 所以人们就觉得这个方程真是太好了
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ren2 men5 jiu4 jue2 de5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 zhen1 shi4 tai4 hao3 le5
cues.en: So people thought this equation was really great.

cues.zh: 但是还没等人们开心多长时间
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 hai2 mei2 deng3 ren2 men5 kai1 xin1 duo1 zhang3 shi2 jian1
cues.en: But before people could be happy for long,

cues.zh: 紧跟着人们就发现了这个方程的一个问题
cues.pinyin: jin3 gen1 zhe5 ren2 men5 jiu4 fa1 xian4 le5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 de5 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: people soon discovered a problem with this equation.

cues.zh: 这个方程有一个非常严重的反直觉的问题
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 you3 yi2 ge4 fei1 chang2 yan2 zhong4 de5 fan3 zhi2 jue2 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: This equation has a very serious, counterintuitive problem.

cues.zh: 什么问题呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: What problem?

cues.zh: 就是你根据这个方程去求解的话
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 gen1 ju4 zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 qu4 qiu2 jie3 de5 hua4
cues.en: That is, if you solve this equation,

cues.zh: 你会发现这个能极
cues.pinyin: ni3 hui4 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 neng2 ji2
cues.en: you'll find these energy lev-

cues.zh: 电子的能级是存在负能级的
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 de5 neng2 ji2 shi4 cun2 zai4 fu4 neng2 ji2 de5
cues.en: -the electron's energy levels have negative energy levels.

cues.zh: 它会存在电子的负能级
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 cun2 zai4 dian4 zi5 de5 fu4 neng2 ji2
cues.en: Negative energy levels for electrons will exist.

cues.zh: 就是你这个方程一解你就会解出来
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ni3 zhe4 ge5 fang1 cheng2 yi1 jie3 ni3 jiu4 hui4 jie3 chu1 lai2
cues.en: That is, once you solve this equation, you'll find

cues.zh: 电子不光有正能级还有负能级
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 bu4 guang1 you3 zheng4 neng2 ji2 hai2 you3 fu4 neng2 ji2
cues.en: electrons have not only positive energy levels but also negative ones.

cues.zh: 这个事人们是无法接受的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi4 ren2 men5 shi4 wu2 fa3 jie1 shou4 de5
cues.en: This was something people couldn't accept.

cues.zh: 所谓负能级是什么呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 fu4 neng2 ji2 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: So what are these so-called negative energy levels?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 我们知道电子有很多的能级
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 dian4 zi5 you3 hen3 duo1 de5 neng2 ji2
cues.en: We know electrons have many energy levels.

cues.zh: 比如说这个叫基态
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 jiao4 ji1 tai4
cues.en: For example, this one is called the ground state.

cues.zh: 这个叫 N 等于 1 叫基态
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 N deng3 yu2 1 jiao4 ji1 tai4
cues.en: This one, N=1, is called the ground state.

cues.zh: 这个 N 等于 2 叫第一激发态
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 N deng3 yu2 2 jiao4 di4 yi1 ji1 fa1 tai4
cues.en: This one, N=2, is called the first excited state.

cues.zh: N 等于 3 叫第二激发态
cues.pinyin: N deng3 yu2 3 jiao4 di4 er4 ji1 fa1 tai4
cues.en: N=3 is called the second excited state.

cues.zh: 电子可以出于基态
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 ke3 yi3 chu1 yu2 ji1 tai4
cues.en: An electron can be in the ground state,

cues.zh: 也可以出于第一激发态
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 chu1 yu2 di4 yi1 ji1 fa1 tai4
cues.en: it can also be in the first excited state,

cues.zh: 也可以出于第二激发态
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 chu1 yu2 di4 er4 ji1 fa1 tai4
cues.en: or in the second excited state.

cues.zh: 但是根据狄拉克方程
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 gen1 ju4 di2 la1 ke4 fang1 cheng2
cues.en: But according to the Dirac equation,

cues.zh: 它不仅有这个它还有什么
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 jin3 you3 zhe4 ge5 ta1 hai2 you3 shen2 me5
cues.en: not only does it have these, it also has what?

cues.zh: 它还有比这个机态能量更低的状态
cues.pinyin: ta1 hai2 you3 bi3 zhe4 ge5 ji1 tai4 neng2 liang4 geng4 di1 de5 zhuang4 tai4
cues.en: It also has states with energy even lower than the ground state,

cues.zh: 就是负的能级
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 fu4 de5 neng2 ji2
cues.en: that is, negative energy levels.

cues.zh: 这个叫 n 等于负 1 这个能级
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 n deng3 yu2 fu4 1 zhe4 ge5 neng2 ji2
cues.en: This one is called the n=-1 energy level,

cues.zh: n 等于负 2 这个能级是吧
cues.pinyin: n deng3 yu2 fu4 2 zhe4 ge5 neng2 ji2 shi4 ba5
cues.en: n=-2, this energy level, right?

cues.zh: 它会有负能级
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 you3 fu4 neng2 ji2
cues.en: It will have negative energy levels.

cues.zh: 这个人们就无法理解了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren2 men5 jiu4 wu2 fa3 li3 jie3 le5
cues.en: This is what people couldn't understand.

cues.zh: 因为电子的最低能级就在这
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 dian4 zi5 de5 zui4 di1 neng2 ji2 jiu4 zai4 zhe4
cues.en: Because the electron's lowest energy level is right here,

cues.zh: 你如果再往下走的话负能级在哪
cues.pinyin: ni3 ru2 guo3 zai4 wang3 xia4 zou3 de5 hua4 fu4 neng2 ji2 zai4 na3
cues.en: if you go even lower, where is that negative energy level?

cues.zh: 你得给我找出来对不对
cues.pinyin: ni3 de2 gei3 wo3 zhao3 chu1 lai2 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: You have to show it to me, right?

cues.zh: 为了解释这个问题
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 jie3 shi4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: To explain this problem,

cues.zh: 狄拉克提出了一种观点
cues.pinyin: di2 la1 ke4 ti2 chu1 le5 yi1 zhong3 guan1 dian3
cues.en: Dirac proposed an idea.

cues.zh: 这种观点是什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 guan1 dian3 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What is this idea?

cues.zh: 他就说这个负能级的确是存在的
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 fu4 neng2 ji2 di2 que4 shi4 cun2 zai4 de5
cues.en: He said these negative energy levels really do exist,

cues.zh: 但是你平时为什么没看见呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 ping2 shi2 wei4 shen2 me5 mei2 kan4 jian4 ne5
cues.en: but why don't you normally see them?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】反物质是什么？这是宇宙的终极能源！核能和它比都是渣渣

cues.zh: 真空就是狄拉克海
cues.pinyin: zhen1 kong1 jiu4 shi4 di2 la1 ke4 hai3
cues.en: The vacuum is the Dirac sea.

cues.zh: 按照狄拉克的观点狄拉克海分为两个部分
cues.pinyin: an4 zhao4 di2 la1 ke4 de5 guan1 dian3 di2 la1 ke4 hai3 fen1 wei2 liang3 ge4 bu4 fen4
cues.en: According to Dirac's view, the Dirac sea is divided into two parts.

cues.zh: 一个部分是什么
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 bu4 fen4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What's one part?

cues.zh: 一个部分是负能极
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 bu4 fen4 shi4 fu4 neng2 ji2
cues.en: One part is the negative energy levels.

cues.zh: 一个部分是什么
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 bu4 fen4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: What's the other part?

cues.zh: 是天在负能极上的电子
cues.pinyin: shi4 tian1 zai4 fu4 neng2 ji2 shang4 de5 dian4 zi5
cues.en: It's the electrons filled into the negative energy levels.

cues.zh: 电子带什么电带负电
cues.pinyin: dian4 zi5 dai4 shen2 me5 dian4 dai4 fu4 dian4
cues.en: What charge does an electron carry? Negative charge.

cues.zh: 那整体真空带什么电真空肯定不带电
cues.pinyin: na4 zheng3 ti3 zhen1 kong1 dai4 shen2 me5 dian4 zhen1 kong1 ken3 ding4 bu4 dai4 dian4
cues.en: So what charge does the whole vacuum carry? The vacuum definitely carries no charge.

cues.zh: 所以负能级带什么电
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 fu4 neng2 ji2 dai4 shen2 me5 dian4
cues.en: So what charge do the negative energy levels carry?

cues.zh: 他说负能级就带正电
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 fu4 neng2 ji2 jiu4 dai4 zheng4 dian4
cues.en: He says the negative energy levels carry positive charge.

cues.zh: 这就是所谓负能级的概念带正电
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 shi4 suo3 wei4 fu4 neng2 ji2 de5 gai4 nian4 dai4 zheng4 dian4
cues.en: This is the so-called concept: negative energy levels carry positive charge.

cues.zh: 你说你这个负能级填满了电子是吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 ni3 zhe4 ge5 fu4 neng2 ji2 tian2 man3 le5 dian4 zi5 shi4 ba5
cues.en: You're saying these negative energy levels are filled with electrons, right?

cues.zh: 所以电子不能往下掉
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 dian4 zi5 bu4 neng2 wang3 xia4 diao4
cues.en: So electrons can't fall further down.

cues.zh: 但是如果我们外界入射一个电磁波呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 wai4 jie4 ru4 she4 yi2 ge4 dian4 ci2 bo1 ne5
cues.en: But what if an electromagnetic wave comes in from outside?

cues.zh: 那这个电子有可能会吸收电磁波
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 dian4 zi5 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 xi1 shou1 dian4 ci2 bo1
cues.en: Then this electron might absorb the electromagnetic wave

cues.zh: 跑到高能级去
cues.pinyin: pao3 dao4 gao1 neng2 ji2 qu4
cues.en: and jump to a higher energy level.

cues.zh: 换句话说如果我给你能量的话
cues.pinyin: huan4 ju4 hua4 shuo1 ru2 guo3 wo3 gei3 ni3 neng2 liang4 de5 hua4
cues.en: In other words, if I give you energy,

cues.zh: 那这个电子有可能会飞掉
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 dian4 zi5 you3 ke3 neng2 hui4 fei1 diao4
cues.en: then this electron might fly away (get knocked out).

cues.zh: 咱们想一想如果电子飞掉了会有什么结果
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 ru2 guo3 dian4 zi5 fei1 diao4 le5 hui4 you3 shen2 me5 jie2 guo3
cues.en: Let's think about what happens if the electron flies away.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】一个视频讲清2021年河南暴雨成因

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 20 26 年 7 月上学
cues.pinyin: 20 26 nian2 7 yue4 shang4 xue2
cues.en: In early July 2026,

cues.zh: 说在有一个地区因为日照等原因
cues.pinyin: shuo1 zai4 you3 yi2 ge4 di4 qu1 yin1 wei4 ri4 zhao4 deng3 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: suppose in a region, because of sunlight and other factors,

cues.zh: 出现了冷热不均的情况
cues.pinyin: chu1 xian4 le5 leng3 re4 bu4 jun1 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: uneven heating occurs,

cues.zh: 有的地区冷有的地区热
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 di4 qu1 leng3 you3 de5 di4 qu1 re4
cues.en: with some areas cold and some hot.

cues.zh: 那我们想一想会发生什么
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 xiang3 yi1 xiang3 hui4 fa1 sheng1 shen2 me5
cues.en: Let's think about what would happen.

cues.zh: 在热的地区因为空气膨胀所以就会上升
cues.pinyin: zai4 re4 de5 di4 qu1 yin1 wei4 kong1 qi4 peng2 zhang4 suo3 yi3 jiu4 hui4 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: In the hot area, the air expands and rises.

cues.zh: 空气一旦上升了底下因为缺少空气
cues.pinyin: kong1 qi4 yi2 dan4 shang4 sheng1 le5 di3 xia4 yin1 wei4 que1 shao3 kong1 qi4
cues.en: Once the air rises, there's less air below,

cues.zh: 所以就形成了气压比较低的较低压区
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 xing2 cheng2 le5 qi4 ya1 bi3 jiao4 di1 de5 jiao4 di1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: so a low-pressure area with lower pressure forms.

cues.zh: 而在高空的部位因为空气堆积
cues.pinyin: er2 zai4 gao1 kong1 de5 bu4 wei4 yin1 wei4 kong1 qi4 dui1 ji1
cues.en: And up high, because air accumulates there,

cues.zh: 所以就形成了高压区
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 xing2 cheng2 le5 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: a high-pressure area forms.

cues.zh: 同样道理
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3
cues.en: By the same logic,

cues.zh: 在冷的地区因为空气的密度变大
cues.pinyin: zai4 leng3 de5 di4 qu1 yin1 wei4 kong1 qi4 de5 mi4 du4 bian4 da4
cues.en: in the cold area, as the air density increases,

cues.zh: 于是就会下沉
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 hui4 xia4 chen2
cues.en: it sinks.

cues.zh: 下沉了之后在地面附近就会形成高压区
cues.pinyin: xia4 chen2 le5 zhi1 hou4 zai4 di4 mian4 fu4 jin4 jiu4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: After sinking, a high-pressure area forms near the ground,

cues.zh: 气压比较高的高压区
cues.pinyin: qi4 ya1 bi3 jiao4 gao1 de5 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: a high-pressure area with higher pressure,

cues.zh: 而上方缺少空气形成了低压区
cues.pinyin: er2 shang4 fang1 que1 shao3 kong1 qi4 xing2 cheng2 le5 di1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: while above, the lack of air forms a low-pressure area.

cues.zh: 我们知道气压如果大的话
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 qi4 ya1 ru2 guo3 da4 de5 hua4
cues.en: We know that if the pressure is high,

cues.zh: 就会把空气推着向其他的区域运动
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 ba3 kong1 qi4 tui1 zhe5 xiang4 qi2 ta1 de5 qu1 yu4 yun4 dong4
cues.en: it will push the air to move toward other areas.

cues.zh: 两极不能直射的地方就比较冷对吧

cues.en: Also, for example, the influence of land and sea —

cues.zh: 我们知道因为水的比较容大
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 yin1 wei4 shui3 de5 bi3 jiao4 rong2 da4
cues.en: we know water has a larger heat capacity,

cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bai2 tian1 de5 shi2 hou4 lu4 di4 sheng1 wen1 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 kuai4

cues.zh: 那晚上的时候降温就比较快
cues.pinyin: na4 wan3 shang4 de5 shi2 hou4 jiang4 wen1 jiu4 bi3 jiao4 kuai4
cues.en: while at night it cools down faster.

cues.zh: 再比如说像地形的影响
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 xiang4 di4 xing2 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: Another example is the influence of terrain —

cues.zh: 有的地方有山谷形成了这个温

cues.zh: 度差异和气流
cues.pinyin: du4 cha1 yi4 he2 qi4 liu2
cues.en: -ature difference and air currents.

cues.zh: 再比如说还有这个城市的效应
cues.pinyin: zai4 bi3 ru2 shuo1 hai2 you3 zhe4 ge5 cheng2 shi4 de5 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: Another example is the urban effect —

cues.zh: 城市因为有热岛效应
cues.pinyin: cheng2 shi4 yin1 wei4 you3 re4 dao3 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: cities have the heat island effect,

cues.zh: 所以它也会出现这个温度的差异
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 ye3 hui4 chu1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 wen1 du4 de5 cha1 yi4
cues.en: so temperature differences occur there too.

cues.zh: 那我们在这里简单谈一谈前两
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 zai4 zhe4 li3 jian3 dan1 tan2 yi1 tan2 qian2 liang3
cues.en: So here let's briefly talk about the first two

cues.zh: 个重要的因素

cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 tai4 yang2 he2 hai3 du4 cha1 yi4
cues.en: namely the sun and the land-sea difference.

cues.zh: 我们首先来说太阳
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 lai2 shuo1 tai4 yang2
cues.en: Let's first talk about the sun.

cues.zh: 那么太阳的直射会造成一个大范围
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 tai4 yang2 de5 zhi2 she4 hui4 zao4 cheng2 yi2 ge4 da4 fan4 wei2

cues.pinyin: shi4 jie4 fan4 wei2 nei4 de5 yi2 ge4 kong1 qi4 de5 liu2 dong4
cues.en: worldwide movement of air.

cues.zh: 我们可以把这个北半球划分为几个区域
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bei3 ban4 qiu2 hua4 fen1 wei4 ji3 ge4 qu1 yu4

cues.en: First, let's think about where the hottest place is.

cues.zh: 地转偏向力在北半球
cues.pinyin: di4 zhuan3 pian1 xiang4 li4 zai4 bei3 ban4 qiu2
cues.en: The Coriolis force, in the Northern Hemisphere,

cues.zh: 会使得气流向右侧移动对不对
cues.pinyin: hui4 shi3 de5 qi4 liu2 xiang4 you4 ce4 yi2 dong4 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: makes air currents deflect to the right, right?

cues.zh: 所以它就往右偏
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 wang3 you4 pian1
cues.en: So it deflects to the right.

cues.zh: 偏到大约北纬 30 度的时候
cues.pinyin: pian1 dao4 da4 yue1 bei3 wei3 30 du4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When it deflects to around 30 degrees north latitude,

cues.zh: 它就完全平行于尾线了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 wan2 quan2 ping2 xing2 yu2 wei3 xian4 le5
cues.en: it becomes completely parallel to the latitude line.

cues.zh: 就这个风往北吹的过程之中
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zhe4 ge5 feng1 wang3 bei3 chui1 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: So as this wind blows northward,

cues.zh: 因为它是低压空气上升上来到高
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 di1 ya1 kong1 qi4 shang4 sheng1 shang4 lai2 dao4 gao1
cues.en: because it's low-pressure air that has risen up to high

cues.zh: 空之后往北吹
cues.pinyin: kong1 zhi1 hou4 wang3 bei3 chui1
cues.en: altitude and then blows north,

cues.zh: 在往北吹的过程中
cues.pinyin: zai4 wang3 bei3 chui1 de5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: and while blowing north,

cues.zh: 因为地转偏向力的影响它逐渐转向
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 di4 zhuan3 pian1 xiang4 li4 de5 ying3 xiang3 ta1 zhu2 jian4 zhuan3 xiang4
cues.en: due to the Coriolis force it gradually changes direction,

cues.zh: 最终到了北北 30 度左右的时候
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 dao4 le5 bei3 bei3 30 du4 zuo3 you4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: until eventually, at around 30 degrees north latitude,

cues.zh: 它就完全地转成了水平的这个方向了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 wan2 quan2 di4 zhuan3 cheng2 le5 shui3 ping2 de5 zhe4 ge5 fang1 xiang4 le5
cues.en: it has turned completely into this horizontal direction.

cues.zh: 这个我们就管它叫负热带
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wo3 men5 jiu4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 fu4 re4 dai4
cues.en: We call this the subtropics,

cues.zh: 它就不能再往北走了
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 bu4 neng2 zai4 wang3 bei3 zou3 le5
cues.en: it can't go any further north,

cues.zh: 就叫负热带高压区负热带高压区
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jiao4 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 qu1 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: so it's called the subtropical high-pressure area, the subtropical high.

cues.zh: 是吧负热带高压区的成因
cues.pinyin: shi4 ba5 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 qu1 de5 cheng2 yin1
cues.en: Right? The cause of the subtropical high

cues.zh: 就是因为热带低压区形成了气流上升
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 re4 dai4 di1 ya1 qu1 xing2 cheng2 le5 qi4 liu2 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: is that the tropical low causes air to rise,

cues.zh: 上升之后吹到这儿因为地转偏离的影响
cues.pinyin: shang4 sheng1 zhi1 hou4 chui1 dao4 zhe4 er2 yin1 wei4 di4 zhuan3 pian1 li2 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: and after rising it blows over here, and due to the Coriolis effect,

cues.zh: 它不能再往北走
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 neng2 zai4 wang3 bei3 zou3
cues.en: it can't go further north,

cues.zh: 而是在这里形成环流和堆积
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zai4 zhe4 li3 xing2 cheng2 huan2 liu2 he2 dui1 ji1
cues.en: so instead it forms a circulation and piles up here,

cues.zh: 所以气体就会下沉
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 qi4 ti3 jiu4 hui4 xia4 chen2
cues.en: so the air sinks,

cues.en: We call it the subpolar low, the subpolar low-pressure area.

cues.zh: 于是由于日照的影响形成这么几个区
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you2 yu2 ri4 zhao4 de5 ying3 xiang3 xing2 cheng2 zhe4 me5 ji3 ge4 qu1
cues.en: So, due to the effect of sunlight, these zones form:

cues.zh: 热带低压区负热带高压区
cues.pinyin: re4 dai4 di1 ya1 qu1 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: the tropical low, the subtropical high,

cues.zh: 负极力低压区和极力高压区
cues.pinyin: fu4 ji2 li4 di1 ya1 qu1 he2 ji2 li4 gao1 ya1 qu1
cues.en: the subpolar low, and the polar high.

cues.zh: 那么我们知道低压区气体会上升
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 di1 ya1 qu1 qi4 ti3 hui4 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: Now, we know that in a low-pressure area the air rises,

cues.zh: 高压区气体会下降
cues.pinyin: gao1 ya1 qu1 qi4 ti3 hui4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: and in a high-pressure area the air sinks.

cues.zh: 在两个高低压之间就会形成所谓的环流
cues.pinyin: zai4 liang3 ge4 gao1 di1 ya1 zhi1 jian1 jiu4 hui4 xing2 cheng2 suo3 wei4 de5 huan2 liu2
cues.en: Between a high and a low, what's called a circulation forms.

cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 zhe4 ge5 huan2 liu2 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 yang4 liu2 dong4 de5
cues.en: Look, this circulation flows just like this:

cues.zh: 你看从这个热带低压区上升
cues.pinyin: ni3 kan4 cong2 zhe4 ge5 re4 dai4 di1 ya1 qu1 shang4 sheng1
cues.en: you see it rises from this tropical low,

cues.zh: 然后飘到了负热带高压区下降
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 piao1 dao4 le5 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 qu1 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: then drifts to the subtropical high and sinks,

cues.zh: 然后再从地面上吹回来
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 zai4 cong2 di4 mian4 shang4 chui1 hui2 lai2
cues.en: then blows back along the ground,

cues.zh: 形成了一个环
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 le5 yi2 ge4 huan2
cues.en: forming a loop.

cues.zh: 同样道理极力也是一样
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 dao4 li3 ji2 li4 ye3 shi4 yi1 yang4
cues.en: By the same logic, it's the same at the poles.

cues.zh: 这个往南吹的风它会往右边偏
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wang3 nan2 chui1 de5 feng1 ta1 hui4 wang3 you4 bian1 pian1
cues.en: This wind blowing southward deflects to the right,

cues.zh: 于是它会偏向西侧
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 hui4 pian1 xiang4 xi1 ce4
cues.en: so it ends up deflecting toward the west.

cues.zh: 这个风形成了这样的风
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 feng1 xing2 cheng2 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 feng1
cues.en: This wind forms a wind like this,

cues.zh: 形成了这样的风
cues.pinyin: xing2 cheng2 le5 zhe4 yang4 de5 feng1
cues.en: forms a wind like this.

cues.zh: 这个风我们就管它叫什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 feng1 wo3 men5 jiu4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What do we call this wind?

cues.zh: 我们就管它叫做东北信风
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 zuo4 dong1 bei3 xin4 feng1
cues.en: We call it the northeast trade wind,

cues.zh: 东北信风
cues.pinyin: dong1 bei3 xin4 feng1
cues.en: the northeast trade wind,

cues.zh: 因为它是从东北方吹来的对不对
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 shi4 cong2 dong1 bei3 fang1 chui1 lai2 de5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: because it blows in from the northeast, right?

cues.zh: 往这个西南方吹所以叫东北信风
cues.pinyin: wang3 zhe4 ge5 xi1 nan2 fang1 chui1 suo3 yi3 jiao4 dong1 bei3 xin4 feng1
cues.en: blowing toward the southwest, so it's called the northeast trade wind.

cues.zh: 好这是近地面的
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 shi4 jin4 di4 mian4 de5
cues.en: Okay, this is near the surface.

cues.zh: 从负热带高压往热带低压去吹的风
cues.pinyin: cong2 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 wang3 re4 dai4 di1 ya1 qu4 chui1 de5 feng1
cues.en: The wind blowing from the subtropical high toward the tropical low —

cues.zh: 同样你从负热带高压往负极地
cues.pinyin: tong2 yang4 ni3 cong2 fu4 re4 dai4 gao1 ya1 wang3 fu4 ji2 di4
cues.en: likewise, the wind blowing from the subtropical high toward the subpolar

cues.zh: 低压去吹的风
cues.pinyin: di1 ya1 qu4 chui1 de5 feng1
cues.en: low-pressure area

cues.zh: 也要往右偏就是这个样子的对吧
cues.pinyin: ye3 yao4 wang3 you4 pian1 jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 yang4 zi5 de5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: also deflects to the right, just like this, right?

cues.zh: 它是偏东方向的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 pian1 dong1 fang1 xiang4 de5
cues.en: It ends up blowing toward the east.

cues.zh: 那我们就说它叫西风是不是
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 jiu4 shuo1 ta1 jiao4 xi1 feng1 shi4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: So we'd say it's called a westerly wind, right?

cues.zh: 所以这个区域我们就管它叫西风带
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 qu1 yu4 wo3 men5 jiu4 guan3 ta1 jiao4 xi1 feng1 dai4
cues.en: So we call this region the westerlies belt,

cues.zh: 西风带
cues.pinyin: xi1 feng1 dai4
cues.en: the westerlies belt —

cues.zh: 在这个区域会盛行西风
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 ge5 qu1 yu4 hui4 sheng4 xing2 xi1 feng1
cues.en: westerly winds prevail in this region.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 于繁花中，听风的故事

cues.zh: 一百多年前风吹进一战的战壕里
cues.pinyin: yi4 bai3 duo1 nian2 qian2 feng1 chui1 jin4 yi1 zhan4 de5 zhan4 hao2 li3
cues.en: Over a hundred years ago, the wind blew into the trenches of World War I.

cues.zh: 风衣有了初心
cues.pinyin: feng1 yi1 you3 le5 chu1 xin1
cues.en: The trench coat found its original purpose.

cues.zh: 无数经典桥段的演绎
cues.pinyin: wu2 shu4 jing1 dian3 qiao2 duan4 de5 yan3 yi4
cues.en: Through the retelling of countless classic scenes,

cues.zh: 让风衣完成了一场从军用到时尚的蜕变
cues.pinyin: rang4 feng1 yi1 wan2 cheng2 le5 yi1 chang2 cong2 jun1 yong4 dao4 shi2 shang4 de5 tui4 bian4
cues.en: the trench coat completed its transformation from military wear to fashion icon.

cues.zh: 这是一次与风同行的完美体验
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi1 ci4 yu3 feng1 tong2 hang2 de5 wan2 mei3 ti3 yan4
cues.en: This is a perfect experience of moving together with the wind.

cues.zh: 让人不禁期待更多
cues.pinyin: rang4 ren2 bu4 jin1 qi1 dai4 geng4 duo1
cues.en: It can't help but make people look forward to more.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 于繁花中，听风的故事

cues.zh: 或者闯进风里
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 chuang3 jin4 feng1 li3
cues.en: Or rush headlong into the wind,

cues.zh: 感受纵情驰骋的自由
cues.pinyin: gan3 shou4 zong4 qing2 chi2 cheng3 de5 zi4 you2
cues.en: feeling the freedom of racing wild and free.

cues.zh: 对风也可以有要求
cues.pinyin: dui4 feng1 ye3 ke3 yi3 you3 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: You can have demands of the wind too.

cues.zh: 大胆地借用风
cues.pinyin: da4 dan3 di4 jie4 yong4 feng1
cues.en: Boldly borrow the wind,

cues.zh: 也勇敢地迎向风
cues.pinyin: ye3 yong3 gan3 di4 ying2 xiang4 feng1
cues.en: and bravely face into the wind,

cues.zh: 尽兴起舞
cues.pinyin: jin4 xing4 qi3 wu3
cues.en: dancing to your heart's content.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 于繁花中，听风的故事

cues.zh: 不做风的对手
cues.pinyin: bu4 zuo4 feng1 de5 dui4 shou3
cues.en: Not becoming the wind's rival,

cues.zh: 而是把风穿在身上
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 ba3 feng1 chuan1 zai4 shen1 shang4
cues.en: but wearing the wind on your body.

cues.zh: 骄傲地驾驭风
cues.pinyin: jiao1 ao4 di4 jia4 yu4 feng1
cues.en: Proudly commanding the wind.

cues.zh: 这是路特斯从 76 年前就起头的故事
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 lu4 te4 si1 cong2 76 nian2 qian2 jiu4 qi3 tou2 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: This is the story Lotus began 76 years ago.

cues.zh: 现在用阿美亚繁花
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 yong4 a1 mei3 ya4 fan2 hua1
cues.en: Now, with the Emeya, in a flourish of blossoms,

cues.zh: 去写风之美心
cues.pinyin: qu4 xie3 feng1 zhi1 mei3 xin1
cues.en: it writes the beautiful heart of the wind.

cues.zh: 繁花若梦是自由
cues.pinyin: fan2 hua1 ruo4 meng4 shi4 zi4 you2
cues.en: Flowers in bloom, like a dream, are freedom.

cues.zh: 力量与记忆的象征
cues.pinyin: li4 liang4 yu3 ji4 yi4 de5 xiang4 zheng1
cues.en: A symbol of power and memory.

cues.zh: 人车合一
cues.pinyin: ren2 che1 he2 yi1
cues.en: Human and car as one.

cues.zh: 继续遇风绽放
cues.pinyin: ji4 xu4 yu4 feng1 zhan4 fang4
cues.en: Continuing to bloom whenever it meets the wind.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 上一回咱们讲的细菌到底是怎么回事
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 hui2 zan2 men5 jiang3 de5 xi4 jun1 dao4 di3 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4
cues.en: Last time we talked about what bacteria really are.

cues.zh: 有小朋友就跟我说赶紧讲一讲新冠肺炎吧
cues.pinyin: you3 xiao3 peng2 you3 jiu4 gen1 wo3 shuo1 gan3 jin3 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 xin1 guan1 fei4 yan2 ba5
cues.en: A young viewer told me to hurry up and talk about COVID-19 pneumonia.

cues.zh: 听说这个肺炎是由于病毒引起的
cues.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 fei4 yan2 shi4 you2 yu2 bing4 du2 yin3 qi3 de5
cues.en: I heard this pneumonia is caused by a virus.

cues.zh: 病毒跟细菌到底有什么区别呢
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 gen1 xi4 jun1 dao4 di3 you3 shen2 me5 qu1 bie2 ne5
cues.en: What exactly is the difference between viruses and bacteria?

cues.zh: 我们怎么样感染了病毒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zen3 me5 yang4 gan3 ran3 le5 bing4 du2
cues.en: How do we get infected by viruses?

cues.zh: 又怎么样去对付它呢
cues.pinyin: you4 zen3 me5 yang4 qu4 dui4 fu4 ta1 ne5
cues.en: And how do we fight against them?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来研究一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's look into this question.

cues.zh: 我们首先先来说一说病毒到底是什么
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 shuo1 bing4 du2 dao4 di3 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: First, let's talk about what a virus actually is.

cues.zh: 人们是如何发现病毒的
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 shi4 ru2 he2 fa1 xian4 bing4 du2 de5
cues.en: How did people discover viruses?

cues.zh: 病毒发现的时间比细菌要晚
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 fa1 xian4 de5 shi2 jian1 bi3 xi4 jun1 yao4 wan3
cues.en: Viruses were discovered later than bacteria.

cues.zh: 在 18 92 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 18 92 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back in 1892,

cues.zh: 有一个俄国的科学家名字叫伊万诺夫斯基
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 e2 guo2 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 yi1 wan4 nuo4 fu1 si1 ji1
cues.en: there was a Russian scientist named Ivanovsky.

cues.zh: 大家看他把俄国人常见的名字都
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 ta1 ba3 e2 guo2 ren2 chang2 jian4 de5 ming2 zi4 dou1
cues.en: Look, his name is basically made up of

cues.zh: 给组到一块了
cues.pinyin: gei3 zu3 dao4 yi1 kuai4 le5
cues.en: common Russian names all put together.

cues.zh: 这个伊万诺夫斯基他观察一种烟草的病毒
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yi1 wan4 nuo4 fu1 si1 ji1 ta1 guan1 cha2 yi1 zhong3 yan1 cao3 de5 bing4 du2
cues.en: This Ivanovsky was observing a virus found in tobacco,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 叫做烟草花叶病
cues.pinyin: jiao4 zuo4 yan1 cao3 hua1 ye4 bing4
cues.en: called tobacco mosaic disease.

cues.zh: 什么叫烟草花叶病呢
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 yan1 cao3 hua1 ye4 bing4 ne5
cues.en: What is tobacco mosaic disease?

cues.zh: 就是植物它也会感染病毒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhi2 wu4 ta1 ye3 hui4 gan3 ran3 bing4 du2
cues.en: It means plants can get infected by viruses too.

cues.zh: 这个烟草是一种经济作物
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 yan1 cao3 shi4 yi1 zhong3 jing1 ji4 zuo4 wu4
cues.en: Tobacco is a cash crop.

cues.zh: 抽烟的那个烟丝
cues.pinyin: chou1 yan1 de5 na4 ge5 yan1 si1
cues.en: The tobacco shreds people smoke

cues.zh: 其实就是通过这个烟草叶子
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 yan1 cao3 ye4 zi5
cues.en: actually come from the tobacco leaves,

cues.zh: 通过一些处理得到的
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 yi1 xie1 chu3 li3 de2 dao4 de5
cues.en: obtained through some processing.

cues.zh: 那如果得了这种病的话那个烟草就长不好
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 de2 le5 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 de5 hua4 na4 ge5 yan1 cao3 jiu4 zhang3 bu4 hao3
cues.en: If the plant gets this disease, the tobacco won't grow well.

cues.zh: 表面就会皱它就研究这种病毒
cues.pinyin: biao3 mian4 jiu4 hui4 zhou4 ta1 jiu4 yan2 jiu1 zhe4 zhong3 bing4 du2
cues.en: The surface gets wrinkled, so he studied this virus.

cues.zh: 它发现我们可以把这个烟草
cues.pinyin: ta1 fa1 xian4 wo3 men5 ke3 yi3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 yan1 cao3
cues.en: He found that he could take the tobacco

cues.zh: 得了烟草花叶病的这个叶子拿出来
cues.pinyin: de2 le5 yan1 cao3 hua1 ye4 bing4 de5 zhe4 ge5 ye4 zi5 na2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: leaves that had tobacco mosaic disease,

cues.zh: 通过一些方法把它提取出一些液体
cues.pinyin: tong1 guo4 yi1 xie1 fang1 fa3 ba3 ta1 ti2 qu3 chu1 yi1 xie1 ye4 ti3
cues.en: and through some methods extract a liquid from them.

cues.zh: 有一个提取液
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 ti2 qu3 ye4
cues.en: He got an extract.

cues.zh: 那么这个提取液肯定是含有一些致
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 ti2 qu3 ye4 ken3 ding4 shi4 han2 you3 yi1 xie1 zhi4
cues.en: This extract must contain some

cues.zh: 病的元素对吧
cues.pinyin: bing4 de5 yuan2 su4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: disease-causing element, right?

cues.zh: 那它不知道致病的元素是什么
cues.pinyin: na4 ta1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zhi4 bing4 de5 yuan2 su4 shi4 shen2 me5
cues.en: But he didn't know what the disease-causing element was.

cues.zh: 于是它就让这个提取液通过了一个过滤器
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 rang4 zhe4 ge5 ti2 qu3 ye4 tong1 guo4 le5 yi2 ge4 guo4 lv4 qi4
cues.en: So he passed the extract through a filter.

cues.zh: 这个过滤器有一个特点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo4 lv4 qi4 you3 yi2 ge4 te4 dian3
cues.en: This filter had one special feature.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 所以这种致病的物质一定比细菌小
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 zhong3 zhi4 bing4 de5 wu4 zhi4 yi2 ding4 bi3 xi4 jun1 xiao3
cues.en: So this disease-causing substance must be smaller than bacteria.

cues.zh: 应该是细菌的分泌物
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 xi4 jun1 de5 fen1 mi4 wu4
cues.en: It should be a secretion of bacteria.

cues.zh: 然后就给它起个名字
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 gei3 ta1 qi3 ge4 ming2 zi4
cues.en: So they gave it a name.

cues.zh: 叫过滤性病毒或者滤过性病毒
cues.pinyin: jiao4 guo4 lv4 xing4 bing4 du2 huo4 zhe3 lv4 guo4 xing4 bing4 du2
cues.en: Called it a "filterable virus" or "filtering virus."

cues.zh: 当时其实人们并不清楚病毒到底
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 qi2 shi2 ren2 men5 bing4 bu4 qing1 chu3 bing4 du2 dao4 di3
cues.en: At the time people really didn't understand

cues.zh: 是什么玩意儿
cues.pinyin: shi4 shen2 me5 wan2 yi4 er2
cues.en: what this thing actually was.

cues.zh: 就给它起了个名字叫过滤性病毒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 gei3 ta1 qi3 le5 ge4 ming2 zi4 jiao4 guo4 lv4 xing4 bing4 du2
cues.en: So they just named it "filterable virus."

cues.zh: 后来人们才发现这个东西其实并不是
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ren2 men5 cai2 fa1 xian4 zhe4 ge5 dong1 xi1 qi2 shi2 bing4 bu2 shi4
cues.en: Later people discovered this thing actually wasn't

cues.zh: 细菌的分泌物
cues.pinyin: xi4 jun1 de5 fen1 mi4 wu4
cues.en: a bacterial secretion,

cues.zh: 而是病毒病毒的大小比细菌还要小
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 bing4 du2 bing4 du2 de5 da4 xiao3 bi3 xi4 jun1 hai2 yao4 xiao3
cues.en: but a virus — and viruses are even smaller than bacteria.

cues.zh: 小 1 甚至小到 1 那么大
cues.pinyin: xiao3 1 shen4 zhi4 xiao3 dao4 1 na4 me5 da4
cues.en: Ten times smaller, even up to a hundred times smaller.

cues.zh: 所以用光学显微镜我们看得到细菌
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yong4 guang1 xue2 xian3 wei1 jing4 wo3 men5 kan4 de2 dao4 xi4 jun1
cues.en: So with a light microscope we can see bacteria,

cues.zh: 但是却看不见病毒
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 que4 kan4 bu2 jian4 bing4 du2
cues.en: but we can't see viruses.

cues.zh: 怎么办必须依靠电子显微镜
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 ban4 bi4 xu1 yi1 kao4 dian4 zi5 xian3 wei1 jing4
cues.en: What to do? We have to rely on electron microscopes.

cues.zh: 所以 20 世纪初人们发明了电子显微镜之后
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 20 shi4 ji4 chu1 ren2 men5 fa1 ming2 le5 dian4 zi5 xian3 wei1 jing4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: So after people invented the electron microscope in the early 20th century,

cues.zh: 才逐渐的看到了病毒
cues.pinyin: cai2 zhu2 jian4 de5 kan4 dao4 le5 bing4 du2
cues.en: they gradually began to see viruses.

cues.zh: 在 19 35 年的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 19 35 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4

cues.zh: 有一个美国的科学家名字叫斯坦利
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ge4 mei3 guo2 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 ming2 zi4 jiao4 si1 tan3 li4
cues.en: there was an American scientist named Stanley.

cues.zh: 这个斯坦利他去研究
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 si1 tan3 li4 ta1 qu4 yan2 jiu1
cues.en: This Stanley went to research it,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 也可以遗传其实是 RNA 遗传
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 yi3 yi2 chuan2 qi2 shi2 shi4 RNA yi2 chuan2
cues.en: and found it could also be inherited — actually through RNA.

cues.zh: 好他不仅发现了这个组成
cues.pinyin: hao3 ta1 bu4 jin3 fa1 xian4 le5 zhe4 ge5 zu3 cheng2
cues.en: He not only discovered this composition,

cues.zh: 他后来还把这个病毒给结晶了
cues.pinyin: ta1 hou4 lai2 hai2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2 gei3 jie2 jing1 le5
cues.en: but later also crystallized this virus.

cues.zh: 病毒构成了一种结晶体
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 gou4 cheng2 le5 yi1 zhong3 jie2 jing1 ti3
cues.en: The virus formed a crystal.

cues.zh: 他观察到了这种结晶体发现了病毒
cues.pinyin: ta1 guan1 cha2 dao4 le5 zhe4 zhong3 jie2 jing1 ti3 fa1 xian4 le5 bing4 du2
cues.en: He observed this crystal and discovered the virus.

cues.zh: 于是他就获得了在 19 46 年的时候
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 ta1 jiu4 huo4 de2 le5 zai4 19 46 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: And so he was awarded, in 1946,

cues.zh: 获得了诺贝尔化学奖
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 le5 nuo4 bei4 er3 hua4 xue2 jiang3
cues.en: the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

cues.zh: 获得的是化学奖诺贝尔奖
cues.pinyin: huo4 de2 de5 shi4 hua4 xue2 jiang3 nuo4 bei4 er3 jiang3
cues.en: What he got was the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

cues.zh: 好病毒跟细菌相比它不仅仅体积小
cues.pinyin: hao3 bing4 du2 gen1 xi4 jun1 xiang1 bi3 ta1 bu4 jin3 jin3 ti3 ji1 xiao3
cues.en: Compared to bacteria, a virus isn't just smaller,

cues.zh: 最重要的是病毒是没有细胞结构的
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4 bing4 du2 shi4 mei2 you3 xi4 bao1 jie2 gou4 de5
cues.en: the most important thing is that a virus has no cell structure.

cues.zh: 什么叫细胞结构
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 xi4 bao1 jie2 gou4
cues.en: What is a cell structure?

cues.zh: 我们知道生命都是由细胞构成的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhi1 dao4 sheng1 ming4 dou1 shi4 you2 xi4 bao1 gou4 cheng2 de5
cues.en: We know all life is made of cells.

cues.zh: 什么叫细胞你得有细胞膜
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 jiao4 xi4 bao1 ni3 de2 you3 xi4 bao1 mo2
cues.en: What counts as a cell? You need a cell membrane,

cues.zh: 里边得有细胞气
cues.pinyin: li3 bian1 de2 you3 xi4 bao1 qi4
cues.en: and cytoplasm inside it,

cues.zh: 你得完成一些功能
cues.pinyin: ni3 de2 wan2 cheng2 yi1 xie1 gong1 neng2
cues.en: and you need to carry out certain functions.

cues.zh: 这个叫细胞
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiao4 xi4 bao1
cues.en: That's called a cell.

cues.zh: 但是病毒它就是一个蛋白质外壳加
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bing4 du2 ta1 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 dan4 bai2 zhi4 wai4 ke2 jia1
cues.en: But a virus is just a protein shell plus

cues.zh: 一些遗传物质
cues.pinyin: yi1 xie1 yi2 chuan2 wu4 zhi4
cues.en: some genetic material.

cues.zh: 遗传物质可能是 RNA 比如说腥草化学病
cues.pinyin: yi2 chuan2 wu4 zhi4 ke3 neng2 shi4 RNA bi3 ru2 shuo1 xing1 cao3 hua4 xue2 bing4
cues.en: The genetic material might be RNA, like in tobacco mosaic virus,

cues.zh: 也可能是 D NA 可能是单链的
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 D NA ke3 neng2 shi4 dan1 lian4 de5
cues.en: or it might be DNA, which could be single-stranded,

cues.zh: 也可能是双链的
cues.pinyin: ye3 ke3 neng2 shi4 shuang1 lian4 de5
cues.en: or double-stranded.

cues.zh: 它并没有一个完整的细胞结构
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 mei2 you3 yi2 ge4 wan2 zheng3 de5 xi4 bao1 jie2 gou4
cues.en: It doesn't have a complete cell structure.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 而且像细菌这种物质虽然也可以寄生
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 xiang4 xi4 jun1 zhe4 zhong3 wu4 zhi4 sui1 ran2 ye3 ke3 yi3 ji4 sheng1
cues.en: And something like bacteria, although it can also be parasitic,

cues.zh: 但它自己其实是可以活的
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 zi4 ji3 qi2 shi2 shi4 ke3 yi3 huo2 de5
cues.en: can actually survive on its own.

cues.zh: 你把细菌放在培养液里边它就能活对吧
cues.pinyin: ni3 ba3 xi4 jun1 fang4 zai4 pei2 yang3 ye4 li3 bian1 ta1 jiu4 neng2 huo2 dui4 ba5
cues.en: If you put bacteria in culture fluid, it can live, right?

cues.zh: 但是病毒是不行的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 bing4 du2 shi4 bu4 xing2 de5
cues.en: But a virus can't do that.

cues.zh: 病毒必须在细胞内部才能够表现出来活力
cues.pinyin: bing4 du2 bi4 xu1 zai4 xi4 bao1 nei4 bu4 cai2 neng2 gou4 biao3 xian4 chu1 lai2 huo2 li4
cues.en: A virus can only show activity once inside a cell,

cues.zh: 才能够复制才能够活动
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 gou4 fu4 zhi4 cai2 neng2 gou4 huo2 dong4
cues.en: only then can it replicate and move.

cues.zh: 只要你让病毒在细胞的外边
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 rang4 bing4 du2 zai4 xi4 bao1 de5 wai4 bian1
cues.en: As long as you keep a virus outside a cell,

cues.zh: 它就跟灰尘一样是吧
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 gen1 hui1 chen2 yi1 yang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: it's just like dust, right?

cues.zh: 它就跟粉尘一样跟水一样跟石头一样
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 gen1 fen3 chen2 yi1 yang4 gen1 shui3 yi1 yang4 gen1 shi2 tou5 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Just like dust, like water, like a rock —

cues.zh: 没有任何的生命特征它会变成结晶体
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren4 he2 de5 sheng1 ming4 te4 zheng1 ta1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 jie2 jing1 ti3
cues.en: it shows no signs of life at all; it'll turn into a crystal.

cues.zh: 所以你这么看来的话你病毒到
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 zhe4 me5 kan4 lai2 de5 hua4 ni3 bing4 du2 dao4
cues.en: So looking at it this way, is a virus

cues.zh: 底是不是生命
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 bu2 shi4 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: actually alive or not?

cues.zh: 到现在其实人类也没有搞清楚病毒到
cues.pinyin: dao4 xian4 zai4 qi2 shi2 ren2 lei4 ye3 mei2 you3 gao3 qing1 chu3 bing4 du2 dao4
cues.en: Even now, humans still haven't figured out whether a virus

cues.zh: 底是不是生命
cues.pinyin: di3 shi4 bu2 shi4 sheng1 ming4
cues.en: is actually alive or not.

cues.zh: 因为首先它没有细胞结构
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shou3 xian1 ta1 mei2 you3 xi4 bao1 jie2 gou4
cues.en: Because first, it has no cell structure,

cues.zh: 其次它必须在细胞里边绝对寄生
cues.pinyin: qi2 ci4 ta1 bi4 xu1 zai4 xi4 bao1 li3 bian1 jue2 dui4 ji4 sheng1
cues.en: and second, it must be a strict parasite inside a cell.

cues.zh: 一旦除了细胞它就变成结晶结构
cues.pinyin: yi2 dan4 chu2 le5 xi4 bao1 ta1 jiu4 bian4 cheng2 jie2 jing1 jie2 gou4
cues.en: The moment it leaves the cell, it turns into a crystal structure,

cues.zh: 什么都不是跟灰尘一样是吧
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 dou1 bu2 shi4 gen1 hui1 chen2 yi1 yang4 shi4 ba5
cues.en: nothing at all — just like dust, right?

cues.zh: 所以说病毒这种物质是一个介于生
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shuo1 bing4 du2 zhe4 zhong3 wu4 zhi4 shi4 yi2 ge4 jie4 yu2 sheng1
cues.en: So this substance called a virus sits between

cues.zh: 命和非生命之
cues.pinyin: ming4 he2 fei1 sheng1 ming4 zhi1
cues.en: life and non-life,

cues.zh: 间的一个东西
cues.pinyin: jian1 de5 yi2 ge4 dong1 xi1
cues.en: somewhere in between.

cues.zh: 人们管它叫生命的边缘这是病毒
cues.pinyin: ren2 men5 guan3 ta1 jiao4 sheng1 ming4 de5 bian1 yuan2 zhe4 shi4 bing4 du2
cues.en: People call it "the edge of life" — that's the virus.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】病毒是如何感染人体的？新冠肺炎为何会致人死亡？

cues.zh: 它也是 RNA 病毒
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 shi4 RNA bing4 du2
cues.en: It's also an RNA virus.

cues.zh: 但是它为什么叫冠状病毒呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 wei4 shen2 me5 jiao4 guan1 zhuang4 bing4 du2 ne5
cues.en: But why is it called a coronavirus?

cues.zh: 就是它外边有一层包膜
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 ta1 wai4 bian1 you3 yi1 ceng2 bao1 mo2
cues.en: Because on the outside it has a layer of envelope.

cues.zh: 这外边有一层包膜
cues.pinyin: zhe4 wai4 bian1 you3 yi1 ceng2 bao1 mo2
cues.en: This outer layer is an envelope.

cues.zh: 有的这个病毒有包膜有的病毒没有包膜
cues.pinyin: you3 de5 zhe4 ge5 bing4 du2 you3 bao1 mo2 you3 de5 bing4 du2 mei2 you3 bao1 mo2
cues.en: Some viruses have an envelope, some don't.

cues.zh: 而且在包膜上面它还有一些凸起
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 zai4 bao1 mo2 shang4 mian4 ta1 hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 tu1 qi3
cues.en: And on top of the envelope there are also some protrusions,

cues.zh: 还有一些凸起
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 yi1 xie1 tu1 qi3
cues.en: some protrusions,

cues.zh: 凸起
cues.pinyin: tu1 qi3
cues.en: protrusions.

cues.zh: 这个凸起我们管它叫次凸或者叫几凸
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 tu1 qi3 wo3 men5 guan3 ta1 jiao4 ci4 tu1 huo4 zhe3 jiao4 ji3 tu1
cues.en: We call these protrusions "spikes."

cues.zh: 这个次凸或者是几凸是非常重要的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ci4 tu1 huo4 zhe3 shi4 ji3 tu1 shi4 fei1 chang2 zhong4 yao4 de5
cues.en: These spikes are very important,

cues.zh: 因为它一会儿要到达细胞表面
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yi1 hui4 er5 yao4 dao4 da2 xi4 bao1 biao3 mian4
cues.en: because they're what reaches the cell surface,

cues.zh: 那要进入细胞就得靠这个次凸
cues.pinyin: na4 yao4 jin4 ru4 xi4 bao1 jiu4 de2 kao4 zhe4 ge5 ci4 tu1
cues.en: and to enter the cell it relies on these spikes.

cues.zh: 我们一会儿再说
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yi1 hui4 er5 zai4 shuo1
cues.en: We'll talk about that in a bit.

cues.zh: 那这个就是冠状病毒
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 guan1 zhuang4 bing4 du2
cues.en: So that's the coronavirus.

cues.zh: 因为它长得像这个国王的这个王冠
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 zhang3 de2 xiang4 zhe4 ge5 guo2 wang2 de5 zhe4 ge5 wang2 guan1
cues.en: Because it looks like a king's crown,

cues.zh: 所以叫冠状病毒
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiao4 guan1 zhuang4 bing4 du2
cues.en: it's called a coronavirus.

cues.zh: 那么还有比如说我们再举个例子
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 hai2 you3 bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 men5 zai4 ju3 ge4 li4 zi5
cues.en: Now let's take another example.

cues.zh: 警察警察赶快来救我救命啦
cues.pinyin: jing3 cha2 jing3 cha2 gan3 kuai4 lai2 jiu4 wo3 jiu4 ming4 la5
cues.en: Police, police, hurry and save me, help!

cues.zh: 哦别急别急小姐妈妈说出了什么事
cues.pinyin: o2 bie2 ji2 bie2 ji2 xiao3 jie3 ma1 ma1 shuo1 chu1 le5 shen2 me5 shi4
cues.en: Calm down, calm down, miss — tell me what happened.

cues.zh: 刚刚咬一只猫跑资赢了我家里啦
cues.pinyin: gang1 gang1 yao3 yi1 zhi1 mao1 pao3 zi1 ying2 le5 wo3 jia1 li3 la5
cues.en: A cat just ran into my house!

cues.zh: 猫猫没什么可怕的哦
cues.pinyin: mao1 mao1 mei2 shen2 me5 ke3 pa4 de5 o2
cues.en: Cats aren't scary at all.

cues.zh: 猫很可怕快来救我啦
cues.pinyin: mao1 hen3 ke3 pa4 kuai4 lai2 jiu4 wo3 la5
cues.en: Cats are terrifying, come save me quick!

cues.zh: 小姐你听我说
cues.pinyin: xiao3 jie3 ni3 ting1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Miss, listen to me.

cues.zh: 猫真的没什么好可怕的啊
cues.pinyin: mao1 zhen1 de5 mei2 shen2 me5 hao3 ke3 pa4 de5 a5
cues.en: Cats really aren't anything to be scared of.

cues.zh: 你到底是谁啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 dao4 di3 shi4 shui2 a5
cues.en: Who exactly are you?

cues.zh: 我是鹦鹉
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ying1 wu3
cues.en: I'm a parrot.

cues.zh: 我是鹦鹉
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 ying1 wu3
cues.en: I'm a parrot.

cues.zh: 答案是
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4
cues.en: The answer is...

cues.zh: 不会游泳的人
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 you2 yong3 de5 ren2
cues.en: ...someone who can't swim.

cues.zh: 别惹我
cues.pinyin: bie2 re3 wo3
cues.en: Don't mess with me.

cues.zh: 你知道我在高中的时候
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 wo3 zai4 gao1 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: You know, back in high school...

cues.zh: 是个不良少年
cues.pinyin: shi4 ge4 bu4 liang2 shao4 nian2
cues.en: ...I was a delinquent.

cues.zh: 哦真的哦有多不良啊
cues.pinyin: o2 zhen1 de5 o2 you3 duo1 bu4 liang2 a5
cues.en: Oh really? How much of a delinquent?

cues.zh: 身高 140 不到营养不良
cues.pinyin: shen1 gao1 140 bu2 dao4 ying2 yang3 bu4 liang2
cues.en: Under 140cm tall — malnourished.

cues.zh: 咦咋知道就听我妈妈的不要嫁给你了
cues.pinyin: yi2 za3 zhi1 dao4 jiu4 ting1 wo3 ma1 ma1 de5 bu2 yao4 jia4 gei3 ni3 le5
cues.en: Huh, how'd you know? I just listened to my mom and decided not to marry you.

cues.zh: 你是说你妈曾经阻止你嫁给我
cues.pinyin: ni3 shi4 shuo1 ni3 ma1 ceng2 jing1 zu3 zhi3 ni3 jia4 gei3 wo3
cues.en: You mean your mom once stopped you from marrying me?

cues.zh: 对啊
cues.pinyin: dui4 a5
cues.en: Yep.

cues.zh: 哎呀这些年我真是错怪她了
cues.pinyin: ai1 ya1 zhe4 xie1 nian2 wo3 zhen1 shi4 cuo4 guai4 ta1 le5
cues.en: Ugh, all these years I really misjudged her.

cues.zh: 平常吃完晚餐都是爸爸洗碗
cues.pinyin: ping2 chang2 chi1 wan2 wan3 can1 dou1 shi4 ba4 ba4 xi3 wan3
cues.en: Normally after dinner, dad washes the dishes.

cues.zh: 可是今天爸爸为什么吃完晚餐却没洗碗
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 jin1 tian1 ba4 ba4 wei4 shen2 me5 chi1 wan2 wan3 can1 que4 mei2 xi3 wan3
cues.en: But why didn't dad wash the dishes after dinner today?

cues.zh: 因为今天去餐厅吃饭
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 jin1 tian1 qu4 can1 ting1 chi1 fan4
cues.en: Because we ate out at a restaurant today.

cues.zh: 所以爸爸不用洗碗
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ba4 ba4 bu4 yong4 xi3 wan3
cues.en: So dad didn't need to wash any dishes.

cues.zh: 小明你的成绩每次都最后
cues.pinyin: xiao3 ming2 ni3 de5 cheng2 ji4 mei3 ci4 dou1 zui4 hou4
cues.en: Xiao Ming, your grades are always last in class.

cues.zh: 又爱和同学打架
cues.pinyin: you4 ai4 he2 tong2 xue2 da3 jia4
cues.en: And you love fighting with classmates.

cues.zh: 你叫我怎么写成绩单的评语啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 jiao4 wo3 zen3 me5 xie3 cheng2 ji4 dan1 de5 ping2 yu3 a5
cues.en: How am I supposed to write your report card comments?

cues.zh: 老师你可以写该生
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 ni3 ke3 yi3 xie3 gai1 sheng1
cues.en: Teacher, you could write that this student...

cues.zh: 成绩稳定
cues.pinyin: cheng2 ji4 wen3 ding4
cues.en: ...has stable grades

cues.zh: 动手能力强啊
cues.pinyin: dong4 shou3 neng2 li4 qiang2 a5
cues.en: ...and strong hands-on ability.

cues.zh: 你今天为什么在学校打架
cues.pinyin: ni3 jin1 tian1 wei4 shen2 me5 zai4 xue2 xiao4 da3 jia4
cues.en: Why did you get into a fight at school today?

cues.zh: 我没有啊
cues.pinyin: wo3 mei2 you3 a5
cues.en: I didn't!

cues.zh: 我哪有
cues.pinyin: wo3 na3 you3
cues.en: I did not!

cues.zh: 我今天都没有去学校
cues.pinyin: wo3 jin1 tian1 dou1 mei2 you3 qu4 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: I didn't even go to school today.

cues.zh: 怎么能跟同学打架
cues.pinyin: zen3 me5 neng2 gen1 tong2 xue2 da3 jia4
cues.en: So how could I fight with a classmate?

items.title_zh: 笑话98｜7天换一次水｜快来救我啦｜不良少年｜逃课｜富翁破产｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 我们老师出成语的作业我都不会
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lao3 shi1 chu1 cheng2 yu3 de5 zuo4 ye4 wo3 dou1 bu2 hui4
cues.en: Our teacher assigned idiom homework and I can't do any of it.

cues.zh: 你可以教教我吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 ke3 yi3 jiao4 jiao4 wo3 ma5
cues.en: Can you tutor me?

cues.zh: 好啊例如什么
cues.pinyin: hao3 a5 li4 ru2 shen2 me5
cues.en: Sure, like what?

cues.zh: 度日如年
cues.pinyin: du4 ri4 ru2 nian2
cues.en: 'Du ri ru nian' (days drag on like years).

cues.zh: 哦就是日子非常好过
cues.pinyin: o2 jiu4 shi4 ri4 zi5 fei1 chang2 hao3 guo4
cues.en: Oh, that means life is really easy.

cues.zh: 每天就像过年一样
cues.pinyin: mei3 tian1 jiu4 xiang4 guo4 nian2 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Every day is like celebrating New Year.

cues.zh: 那语重心长呢
cues.pinyin: na4 yu3 zhong4 xin1 chang2 ne5
cues.en: What about 'yu zhong xin chang' (words heavy with sincerity)?

cues.zh: 哦别人说的话很重
cues.pinyin: o2 bie2 ren2 shuo1 de5 hua4 hen3 zhong4
cues.en: Oh, that means what someone says carries a lot of weight.

cues.zh: 心理怀恨很长的时间
cues.pinyin: xin1 li3 huai2 hen4 hen3 zhang3 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: ...and you harbor a grudge about it for a long time.

cues.zh: 嗯那这书哪里呢
cues.pinyin: n2 na4 zhe4 shu1 na3 li3 ne5
cues.en: Um, then what about this 'book' one?

cues.zh: 你知道书上的知识是不够的
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhi1 dao4 shu1 shang4 de5 zhi1 shi2 shi4 bu4 gou4 de5
cues.en: You know, knowledge from books alone isn't enough.

cues.zh: 还要学着怎么送礼
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 xue2 zhe5 zen3 me5 song4 li3
cues.en: You also need to learn how to give gifts.

cues.zh: 啊为什么阿姨都不喜欢运动啊
cues.pinyin: a5 wei4 shen2 me5 a1 yi2 dou1 bu4 xi3 huan1 yun4 dong4 a5
cues.en: Why do aunties never like exercising?

cues.zh: 因为他们会留下遗憾啊
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 hui4 liu2 xia4 yi2 han4 a5
cues.en: Because they'll be left with regrets.
