items.title_zh: 谢晖：追回一个非凡的开始

cues.zh: 后来想想它的魅力在飞起的瞬间就
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 xiang3 xiang3 ta1 de5 mei4 li4 zai4 fei1 qi3 de5 shun4 jian1 jiu4
cues.en: Later I thought about it — its charm lies in the very instant it takes flight

cues.zh: 要没有退路地去追
cues.pinyin: yao4 mei2 you3 tui4 lu4 di4 qu4 zhui1
cues.en: You have to chase it with no way back

cues.zh: 人生也是这样的确会错过一些事
cues.pinyin: ren2 sheng1 ye3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 di2 que4 hui4 cuo4 guo4 yi1 xie1 shi4
cues.en: Life is like that too — you really will miss some things

cues.zh: 但去追的机会永远不会错过
cues.pinyin: dan4 qu4 zhui1 de5 ji1 hui4 yong3 yuan3 bu2 hui4 cuo4 guo4
cues.en: But the chance to chase will never be missed

cues.zh: 去追
cues.pinyin: qu4 zhui1
cues.en: Chase

cues.zh: 去忘记掌声和嘘声
cues.pinyin: qu4 wang4 ji4 zhang3 sheng1 he2 xu1 sheng1
cues.en: Forget the applause and the boos

cues.zh: 让自己时刻能听到
cues.pinyin: rang4 zi4 ji3 shi2 ke4 neng2 ting1 dao4
cues.en: So you can always hear

cues.zh: 来自内心世界的回声
cues.pinyin: lai2 zi4 nei4 xin1 shi4 jie4 de5 hui2 sheng1
cues.en: The echo from your inner world

cues.zh: 没有人告诉我们要追多久
cues.pinyin: mei2 you3 ren2 gao4 su4 wo3 men5 yao4 zhui1 duo1 jiu3
cues.en: No one tells us how long we must chase

cues.zh: 才能看清自己的脚步
cues.pinyin: cai2 neng2 kan4 qing1 zi4 ji3 de5 jiao3 bu4
cues.en: Before we can see our own footsteps clearly

cues.zh: 那些没有抢先的第一步
cues.pinyin: na4 xie1 mei2 you3 qiang3 xian1 de5 di4 yi1 bu4
cues.en: Those first steps that weren't taken first

cues.zh: 那些别人眼中的慢
cues.pinyin: na4 xie1 bie2 ren2 yan3 zhong1 de5 man4
cues.en: That slowness in others' eyes

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 谢晖：追回一个非凡的开始

cues.zh: 成就了最终点的快
cues.pinyin: cheng2 jiu4 le5 zui4 zhong1 dian3 de5 kuai4
cues.en: Became the speed at the very end

cues.zh: 除了时间没有追不回的东西
cues.pinyin: chu2 le5 shi2 jian1 mei2 you3 zhui1 bu4 hui2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: Nothing is beyond chasing back, except time

cues.zh: 我们真正要追回来的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zhen1 zheng4 yao4 zhui1 hui2 lai2 de5
cues.en: What we're really trying to chase back

cues.zh: 其实是一个非凡的开始
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 shi4 yi2 ge4 fei1 fan2 de5 kai1 shi3
cues.en: Is actually an extraordinary beginning

cues.zh: 非凡汽车
cues.pinyin: fei1 fan2 qi4 che1
cues.en: Feifan Motors

cues.zh: 成就我的非凡
cues.pinyin: cheng2 jiu4 wo3 de5 fei1 fan2
cues.en: Achieving my extraordinary

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 在之前我们花了三期节目的时间讲述历史
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhi1 qian2 wo3 men5 hua1 le5 san1 qi1 jie2 mu4 de5 shi2 jian1 jiang3 shu4 li4 shi3
cues.en: Previously we spent three episodes telling the history

cues.zh: 上的经济泡沫
cues.pinyin: shang4 de5 jing1 ji4 pao4 mo4
cues.en: of economic bubbles.

cues.zh: 包括荷兰的郁金香泡沫英国的南海股票案
cues.pinyin: bao1 kuo4 he2 lan2 de5 yu4 jin1 xiang1 pao4 mo4 ying1 guo2 de5 nan2 hai3 gu3 piao4 an4
cues.en: Including the Netherlands' tulip bubble and England's South Sea stock scandal,

cues.zh: 以及庞氏骗局和传销等等
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 pang2 shi4 pian4 ju2 he2 chuan2 xiao1 deng3 deng3
cues.en: as well as Ponzi schemes and pyramid schemes, etc.

cues.zh: 也许有些小朋友会说这些跟我
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 you3 xie1 xiao3 peng2 you3 hui4 shuo1 zhe4 xie1 gen1 wo3
cues.en: Maybe some of you kids would say these

cues.zh: 都没什么关系
cues.pinyin: dou1 mei2 shen2 me5 guan1 xi4
cues.en: have nothing to do with me.

cues.zh: 因为我既不买花
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 ji4 bu4 mai3 hua1
cues.en: Because I don't buy flowers,

cues.zh: 也不买股票同时也不参与传销
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 mai3 gu3 piao4 tong2 shi2 ye3 bu4 can1 yu4 chuan2 xiao1
cues.en: I don't buy stocks, and I don't join pyramid schemes either.

cues.zh: 不过今天我们要讨论一个跟每一个人都息
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 yao4 tao3 lun4 yi2 ge4 gen1 mei3 yi2 ge4 ren2 dou1 xi1
cues.en: But today we're going to discuss a problem that is closely

cues.zh: 息相关的问题
cues.pinyin: xi1 xiang1 guan1 de5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: related to every single person.

cues.zh: 那就是房地产泡沫
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 fang2 di4 chan3 pao4 mo4
cues.en: That is, the real estate bubble.

cues.zh: 我们要讲一讲日本的房价是如何崩盘的
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 ri4 ben3 de5 fang2 jia4 shi4 ru2 he2 beng1 pan2 de5
cues.en: We're going to talk about how Japan's housing prices crashed,

cues.zh: 日本人如何失去了 20 年的时间
cues.pinyin: ri4 ben3 ren2 ru2 he2 shi1 qu4 le5 20 nian2 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: and how the Japanese lost 20 years of time.

cues.zh: 要讲日本的问题我们首先还要从美国讲起
cues.pinyin: yao4 jiang3 ri4 ben3 de5 wen4 ti2 wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 hai2 yao4 cong2 mei3 guo2 jiang3 qi3
cues.en: To talk about Japan's problem, we first have to start with America,

cues.zh: 因为日本是美国的小弟对吧
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ri4 ben3 shi4 mei3 guo2 de5 xiao3 di4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: because Japan is America's little brother, right?

cues.zh: 我们要讲一下美国的经济问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yao4 jiang3 yi1 xia4 mei3 guo2 de5 jing1 ji4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Let's talk about America's economic problems

cues.zh: 以及它如何影响了日本
cues.pinyin: yi3 ji2 ta1 ru2 he2 ying3 xiang3 le5 ri4 ben3
cues.en: and how they affected Japan.

cues.zh: 首先美国在战争一战和二战结束之后
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 mei3 guo2 zai4 zhan4 zheng1 yi1 zhan4 he2 er4 zhan4 jie2 shu4 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: First, after World War I and World War II ended,

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 它其实是世界上最大的债权国
cues.pinyin: ta1 qi2 shi2 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 da4 de5 zhai4 quan2 guo2
cues.en: America was actually the world's largest creditor nation.

cues.zh: 就是别人都欠美国钱
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bie2 ren2 dou1 qian4 mei3 guo2 qian2
cues.en: That is, everyone else owed America money.

cues.zh: 它是世界上最大的债权国
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 shi4 jie4 shang4 zui4 da4 de5 zhai4 quan2 guo2
cues.en: It was the world's largest creditor nation.

cues.zh: 首先因为一战和二战
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 yin1 wei4 yi1 zhan4 he2 er4 zhan4
cues.en: First, because of World War I and World War II,

cues.zh: 这个美国都没有本土受到战争的波及
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 mei3 guo2 du1 mei2 you3 ben3 tu3 shou4 dao4 zhan4 zheng1 de5 bo1 ji2
cues.en: America's homeland was never touched by the fighting,

cues.zh: 所以它的工业基础没有被破坏掉
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 de5 gong1 ye4 ji1 chu3 mei2 you3 bei4 po4 huai4 diao4
cues.en: so its industrial base was never destroyed.

cues.zh: 同时还大量的出售武器赚了不少钱
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 hai2 da4 liang4 de5 chu1 shou4 wu3 qi4 zhuan4 le5 bu4 shao3 qian2
cues.en: At the same time, it sold huge amounts of weapons and made a lot of money.

cues.zh: 同时在 19 44 年的时候
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 zai4 19 44 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Also, in 1944,

cues.zh: 美国召集一些国家开会
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 zhao4 ji2 yi1 xie1 guo2 jia1 kai1 hui4
cues.en: America gathered a number of countries for a conference

cues.zh: 就创造了一个体系叫布雷顿森林体系
cues.pinyin: jiu4 chuang4 zao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ti3 xi4 jiao4 bu4 lei2 dun4 sen1 lin2 ti3 xi4
cues.en: and created a system called the Bretton Woods system.

cues.zh: 这个布雷顿森林体系确立了这
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bu4 lei2 dun4 sen1 lin2 ti3 xi4 que4 li4 le5 zhe4
cues.en: This Bretton Woods system established such

cues.zh: 样的一个制度
cues.pinyin: yang4 de5 yi2 ge4 zhi4 du4
cues.en: a system:

cues.zh: 就是美元跟黄金挂钩
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 mei3 yuan2 gen1 huang2 jin1 gua4 gou1
cues.en: that the US dollar was pegged to gold.

cues.zh: 你拿着美元就跟拿着黄金一样
cues.pinyin: ni3 na2 zhe5 mei3 yuan2 jiu4 gen1 na2 zhe5 huang2 jin1 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Holding dollars was just like holding gold.

cues.zh: 你随时可以去美国把这个美元换成黄金
cues.pinyin: ni3 sui2 shi2 ke3 yi3 qu4 mei3 guo2 ba3 zhe4 ge5 mei3 yuan2 huan4 cheng2 huang2 jin1
cues.en: You could go to America anytime and exchange dollars for gold.

cues.zh: 同时其他国家的货币就跟这个美元挂钩
cues.pinyin: tong2 shi2 qi2 ta1 guo2 jia1 de5 huo4 bi4 jiu4 gen1 zhe4 ge5 mei3 yuan2 gua4 gou1
cues.en: At the same time, other countries' currencies were pegged to the dollar.

cues.zh: 所以就确立了美元的这个霸主地位
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 jiu4 que4 li4 le5 mei3 yuan2 de5 zhe4 ge5 ba4 zhu3 di4 wei4
cues.en: So this established the dollar's dominant position.

cues.zh: 再后来美国又通过这个欧洲复兴计划
cues.pinyin: zai4 hou4 lai2 mei3 guo2 you4 tong1 guo4 zhe4 ge5 ou1 zhou1 fu4 xing1 ji4 hua4
cues.en: Later on, America also carried out the European recovery program,

cues.zh: 叫马歇尔计划
cues.pinyin: jiao4 ma3 xie1 er3 ji4 hua4
cues.en: called the Marshall Plan.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 那么这两次石油危机造成了油价的飞涨
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 liang3 ci4 shi2 you2 wei1 ji1 zao4 cheng2 le5 you2 jia4 de5 fei1 zhang3
cues.en: Then these two oil crises caused oil prices to skyrocket.

cues.zh: 油价涨了之后美国有一些原油是从这
cues.pinyin: you2 jia4 zhang3 le5 zhi1 hou4 mei3 guo2 you3 yi1 xie1 yuan2 you2 shi4 cong2 zhe4
cues.en: After oil prices rose, some of America's crude oil was imported

cues.zh: 个国外进口的
cues.pinyin: ge4 guo2 wai4 jin4 kou3 de5
cues.en: from abroad.

cues.zh: 那么油价一旦涨了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 you2 jia4 yi2 dan4 zhang3 le5
cues.en: So once oil prices rose,

cues.zh: 美国内部就会出现通货膨胀
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 nei4 bu4 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4
cues.en: inflation would appear inside the US.

cues.zh: 它的经济形势就不太好影响了它的制造业
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 jing1 ji4 xing2 shi4 jiu4 bu4 tai4 hao3 ying3 xiang3 le5 ta1 de5 zhi4 zao4 ye4
cues.en: Its economic situation wasn't great, which affected its manufacturing.

cues.zh: 那么在 19 73 年的时候
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zai4 19 73 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: So in 1973,

cues.zh: 19 73 年的时候美国有一位总统
cues.pinyin: 19 73 nian2 de5 shi2 hou4 mei3 guo2 you3 yi1 wei4 zong3 tong3
cues.en: in 1973 America had a president

cues.zh: 名字叫尼克松
cues.pinyin: ming2 zi4 jiao4 ni2 ke4 song1
cues.en: named Nixon.

cues.zh: 我们对尼克松的认识可能有两
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 dui4 ni2 ke4 song1 de5 ren4 shi2 ke3 neng2 you3 liang3
cues.en: Our impression of Nixon is probably shaped mainly by two

cues.zh: 件事比较深刻
cues.pinyin: jian4 shi4 bi3 jiao4 shen1 ke4
cues.en: things.

cues.zh: 第一件事就是尼克松访华
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 jian4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 ni2 ke4 song1 fang3 hua2
cues.en: The first is Nixon's visit to China.

cues.zh: 第二件事就是尼克松的水门事件
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jian4 shi4 jiu4 shi4 ni2 ke4 song1 de5 shui3 men2 shi4 jian4
cues.en: The second is Nixon's Watergate scandal.

cues.zh: 但尼克松其实还干了一件大事
cues.pinyin: dan4 ni2 ke4 song1 qi2 shi2 hai2 gan4 le5 yi1 jian4 da4 shi4
cues.en: But Nixon actually did another big thing.

cues.zh: 就是在他的任期里面
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zai4 ta1 de5 ren4 qi1 li3 mian4
cues.en: That is, during his term in office,

cues.zh: 他宣布美元不能再兑换成黄金了
cues.pinyin: ta1 xuan1 bu4 mei3 yuan2 bu4 neng2 zai4 dui4 huan4 cheng2 huang2 jin1 le5
cues.en: he announced that the dollar could no longer be exchanged for gold.

cues.zh: 这个汇率要开始进行浮动了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hui4 lv4 yao4 kai1 shi3 jin4 xing2 fu2 dong4 le5
cues.en: Exchange rates were going to start floating.

cues.zh: 汇率浮动了
cues.pinyin: hui4 lv4 fu2 dong4 le5
cues.en: Exchange rates floated,

cues.zh: 也就是说布雷顿森林体系就崩溃了
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 bu4 lei2 dun4 sen1 lin2 ti3 xi4 jiu4 beng1 kui4 le5
cues.en: which meant the Bretton Woods system had collapsed.

cues.zh: 当时在 60 年代的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 zai4 60 nian2 dai4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back then, in the 1960s,

cues.zh: 美元还可以换成黄金的时候
cues.pinyin: mei3 yuan2 hai2 ke3 yi3 huan4 cheng2 huang2 jin1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: when the dollar could still be exchanged for gold,

cues.zh: 这个法国的总统戴高乐就说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 fa3 guo2 de5 zong3 tong3 dai4 gao1 le4 jiu4 shuo1
cues.en: French President de Gaulle said...

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 但是再次伟大你采用一个什么样的措施呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zai4 ci4 wei3 da4 ni3 cai3 yong4 yi2 ge4 shen2 me5 yang4 de5 cuo4 shi1 ne5
cues.en: But to make [America] great again, what measures did he adopt?

cues.zh: 在他的任期里面就采取了一大
cues.pinyin: zai4 ta1 de5 ren4 qi1 li3 mian4 jiu4 cai3 qu3 le5 yi1 da4
cues.en: During his term in office, he adopted a whole bunch

cues.zh: 堆的贸易措施
cues.pinyin: dui1 de5 mao4 yi4 cuo4 shi1
cues.en: of trade measures,

cues.zh: 希望美国的经济能够进行复苏
cues.pinyin: xi1 wang4 mei3 guo2 de5 jing1 ji4 neng2 gou4 jin4 xing2 fu4 su1
cues.en: hoping America's economy could recover.

cues.zh: 美国的经济到底出了什么问题呢
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 de5 jing1 ji4 dao4 di3 chu1 le5 shen2 me5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: So what exactly went wrong with America's economy?

cues.zh: 首先我们从两个角度来考虑这件事
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 cong2 liang3 ge4 jiao3 du4 lai2 kao3 lv4 zhe4 jian4 shi4
cues.en: First, let's look at this from two angles.

cues.zh: 第一个角度就是美国对外贸易这一块
cues.pinyin: di4 yi2 ge4 jiao3 du4 jiu4 shi4 mei3 guo2 dui4 wai4 mao4 yi4 zhe4 yi1 kuai4
cues.en: The first angle is America's foreign trade.

cues.zh: 美国在 80 年代初期出现了贸易的逆差
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 zai4 80 nian2 dai4 chu1 qi1 chu1 xian4 le5 mao4 yi4 de5 ni4 cha4
cues.en: America developed a trade deficit in the early 1980s.

cues.zh: 所谓贸易逆差就是你从国外进口的东西多
cues.pinyin: suo3 wei4 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1 jiu4 shi4 ni3 cong2 guo2 wai4 jin4 kou3 de5 dong1 xi1 duo1
cues.en: A so-called trade deficit means you import more from abroad

cues.zh: 但是你出口的东西少
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ni3 chu1 kou3 de5 dong1 xi1 shao3
cues.en: but export less yourself.

cues.zh: 所以这样一来的话你就会出现贸易逆差
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 de5 hua4 ni3 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1
cues.en: So this way, you end up with a trade deficit.

cues.zh: 美国每年的贸易逆差大概有 1000
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 mei3 nian2 de5 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1 da4 gai4 you3 1000
cues.en: America's annual trade deficit was roughly 100

cues.zh: 亿美元这么多
cues.pinyin: yi4 mei3 yuan2 zhe4 me5 duo1
cues.en: billion dollars.

cues.zh: 1000 亿美元
cues.pinyin: 1000 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: 100 billion dollars.

cues.zh: 直到现在美国每年还都有贸易逆差
cues.pinyin: zhi2 dao4 xian4 zai4 mei3 guo2 mei3 nian2 hai2 dou1 you3 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1
cues.en: Even now, America still runs an annual trade deficit,

cues.zh: 而且比这个数颗还要大
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bi3 zhe4 ge5 shu4 ke1 hai2 yao4 da4
cues.en: and it's even larger than that amount.

cues.zh: 这个 1000 亿美元
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 1000 yi4 mei3 yuan2
cues.en: This 100 billion dollars

cues.zh: 大概占美国的国内生产种值的 2 7
cues.pinyin: da4 gai4 zhan4 mei3 guo2 de5 guo2 nei4 sheng1 chan3 zhong3 zhi2 de5 2 7
cues.en: made up about 2.7% of America's GDP.

cues.zh: 这个比例是相当高的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 bi3 li4 shi4 xiang1 dang1 gao1 de5
cues.en: That ratio was quite high.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 很多政府是受不了这个比例的
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 zheng4 fu3 shi4 shou4 bu4 liao3 zhe4 ge5 bi3 li4 de5
cues.en: Many in government couldn't tolerate that ratio,

cues.zh: 所以要采取这些措施去降低它对吧
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yao4 cai3 qu3 zhe4 xie1 cuo4 shi1 qu4 jiang4 di1 ta1 dui4 ba5
cues.en: so they had to take measures to lower it, right?

cues.zh: 而且不仅仅是贸易逆差一个问题
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 jin3 jin3 shi4 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: And it wasn't just the trade deficit issue.

cues.zh: 美国还面临一个问题就是通货膨胀
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 hai2 mian4 lin2 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2 jiu4 shi4 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4
cues.en: America also faced another problem: inflation.

cues.zh: 通货膨胀
cues.pinyin: tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4
cues.en: Inflation.

cues.zh: 通货膨胀就是物价越来越贵
cues.pinyin: tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4 jiu4 shi4 wu4 jia4 yue4 lai2 yue4 gui4
cues.en: Inflation means prices keep getting more and more expensive.

cues.zh: 为什么会通货膨胀呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 hui4 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4 ne5
cues.en: Why was there inflation?

cues.zh: 刚才我们说了
cues.pinyin: gang1 cai2 wo3 men5 shuo1 le5
cues.en: As we just said,

cues.zh: 因为这个石油危机
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 you2 wei1 ji1
cues.en: because of the oil crisis,

cues.zh: 这个石油价格疯涨造成能源价格涨
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 shi2 you2 jia4 ge2 feng1 zhang3 zao4 cheng2 neng2 yuan2 jia4 ge2 zhang3
cues.en: soaring oil prices caused energy prices to rise,

cues.zh: 所以它其他的材料价格也就跟
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 qi2 ta1 de5 cai2 liao4 jia4 ge2 ye3 jiu4 gen1
cues.en: so the prices of other materials rose along

cues.zh: 着涨通货膨胀
cues.pinyin: zhe5 zhang3 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4
cues.en: with it too — inflation.

cues.zh: 除此之外还有一个失业率
cues.pinyin: chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4 hai2 you3 yi2 ge4 shi1 ye4 lv4
cues.en: Besides that, there was also the unemployment rate.

cues.zh: 美国当年这个失业率也越来越高
cues.pinyin: mei3 guo2 dang1 nian2 zhe4 ge5 shi1 ye4 lv4 ye3 yue4 lai2 yue4 gao1
cues.en: America's unemployment rate was also getting higher and higher that year.

cues.zh: 所以这些国内的问题都需要进行解决
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 xie1 guo2 nei4 de5 wen4 ti2 dou1 xu1 yao4 jin4 xing2 jie3 jue2
cues.en: So all these domestic problems needed to be solved.

cues.zh: 那怎么进行解决呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 jin4 xing2 jie3 jue2 ne5
cues.en: So how were they going to solve them?

cues.zh: 当时美国有一个财务方面的官员
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 mei3 guo2 you3 yi2 ge4 cai2 wu4 fang1 mian4 de5 guan1 yuan2
cues.en: At the time, America had a financial official

cues.zh: 他就说了这么着吧咱们提高利率
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shuo1 le5 zhe4 me5 zhe5 ba5 zan2 men5 ti2 gao1 li4 lv4
cues.en: who said, let's just raise interest rates.

cues.zh: 为什么要提高利率呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 ti2 gao1 li4 lv4 ne5
cues.en: Why raise interest rates?

cues.zh: 因为提高利率之后大家就愿意把钱存
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ti2 gao1 li4 lv4 zhi1 hou4 da4 jia1 jiu4 yuan4 yi4 ba3 qian2 cun2
cues.en: Because after raising rates, people would be willing to put their money

cues.zh: 到银行里面了
cues.pinyin: dao4 yin2 hang2 li3 mian4 le5
cues.en: into the bank.

cues.zh: 这样就可以控制通货膨胀对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 kong4 zhi4 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: That way inflation could be controlled, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】日本房地产是如何崩盘的？广场协议是美国的阴谋吗？日本“失去的三十年”能给我们哪些启示？（经济泡沫系列四）

cues.zh: 你为了控制通货膨胀你就提高利率
cues.pinyin: ni3 wei4 le5 kong4 zhi4 tong1 huo4 peng2 zhang4 ni3 jiu4 ti2 gao1 li4 lv4
cues.en: To control inflation, you raise interest rates.

cues.zh: 提高利率之后美元就升值
cues.pinyin: ti2 gao1 li4 lv4 zhi1 hou4 mei3 yuan2 jiu4 sheng1 zhi2
cues.en: After raising rates, the dollar appreciates.

cues.zh: 一升值贸易逆差就扩大
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 zhi2 mao4 yi4 ni4 cha1 jiu4 kuo4 da4
cues.en: Once it appreciates, the trade deficit grows larger.

cues.zh: 那你怎么去解决这个问题呢
cues.pinyin: na4 ni3 zen3 me5 qu4 jie3 jue2 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 ne5
cues.en: So how do you solve this problem?

cues.zh: 现在看起来只靠美国国内的政策是不行了
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 kan4 qi3 lai2 zhi3 kao4 mei3 guo2 guo2 nei4 de5 zheng4 ce4 shi4 bu4 xing2 le5
cues.en: It now seemed that relying only on US domestic policy wasn't enough.

cues.zh: 必须对贸易进行下手了
cues.pinyin: bi4 xu1 dui4 mao4 yi4 jin4 xing2 xia4 shou3 le5
cues.en: Trade itself had to be targeted.

cues.zh: 于是美国就想到了他的一个忠实小弟日本
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 mei3 guo2 jiu4 xiang3 dao4 le5 ta1 de5 yi2 ge4 zhong1 shi2 xiao3 di4 ri4 ben3
cues.en: So America thought of its loyal little brother, Japan,

cues.zh: 就从日本开始开刀
cues.pinyin: jiu4 cong2 ri4 ben3 kai1 shi3 kai1 dao1
cues.en: and started making cuts starting with Japan.

cues.zh: 那么这就是著名的广场协定了
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 zhu4 ming2 de5 guang3 chang3 xie2 ding4 le5
cues.en: And that's the famous Plaza Accord.

cues.zh: 广场协定是对日本的房地产崩盘有
cues.pinyin: guang3 chang3 xie2 ding4 shi4 dui4 ri4 ben3 de5 fang2 di4 chan3 beng1 pan2 you3
cues.en: The Plaza Accord bears a large share of responsibility

cues.zh: 很大的责任的
cues.pinyin: hen3 da4 de5 ze2 ren4 de5
cues.en: for Japan's real estate crash.

cues.zh: 虽然它可能并不是主要的原因
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 ta1 ke3 neng2 bing4 bu2 shi4 zhu3 yao4 de5 yuan2 yin1
cues.en: Although it might not be the main cause,

cues.zh: 但是它也是一个导火索
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 ye3 shi4 yi2 ge4 dao3 huo3 suo3
cues.en: it was also a trigger.

cues.zh: 这个广场协定是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guang3 chang3 xie2 ding4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what exactly was the Plaza Accord about?

cues.zh: 我们来谈一谈在广场协定之前日
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 lai2 tan2 yi1 tan2 zai4 guang3 chang3 xie2 ding4 zhi1 qian2 ri4
cues.en: Let's talk about Japan's economic situation

cues.zh: 本的经济情况
cues.pinyin: ben3 de5 jing1 ji4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: before the Plaza Accord.

cues.zh: 日本在 19 45 年战败的时候变成了一片废墟
cues.pinyin: ri4 ben3 zai4 19 45 nian2 zhan4 bai4 de5 shi2 hou4 bian4 cheng2 le5 yi1 pian4 fei4 xu1
cues.en: When Japan was defeated in 1945, it was reduced to rubble.

cues.zh: 这个国家完全是从一片废墟里面
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 guo2 jia1 wan2 quan2 shi4 cong2 yi1 pian4 fei4 xu1 li3 mian4
cues.en: This country was completely rebuilt

cues.zh: 重新建立起来
cues.pinyin: chong2 xin1 jian4 li4 qi3 lai2
cues.en: from a pile of ruins.

cues.zh: 但是日本有很好的经济基础和
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ri4 ben3 you3 hen3 hao3 de5 jing1 ji4 ji1 chu3 he2
cues.en: But Japan had a very solid economic foundation and

cues.zh: 科技基础对吧
cues.pinyin: ke1 ji4 ji1 chu3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: technological foundation, right?

items.title: 大大小小聊天時間
items.title_zh: 动动脑时间2｜谁能最快举手猜对自己帽子的颜色呢？｜大大小小

cues.zh: A BC D 四位小朋友在上体育课
cues.pinyin: A BC D si4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 zai4 shang4 ti3 yu4 ke4
cues.en: Four kids, A, B, C, and D, are in P.E. class.

cues.zh: 老师让他们站在阶梯
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 rang4 ta1 men5 zhan4 zai4 jie1 ti1
cues.en: The teacher has them stand on steps.

cues.zh: D 小朋友的前方被墙挡着
cues.pinyin: D xiao3 peng2 you3 de5 qian2 fang1 bei4 qiang2 dang3 zhe5
cues.en: A wall blocks D's view in front.

cues.zh: 老师从后面帮小朋友戴上帽子
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 cong2 hou4 mian4 bang1 xiao3 peng2 you3 dai4 shang4 mao4 zi5
cues.en: The teacher puts hats on them from behind.

cues.zh: 而且不能回头看
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 neng2 hui2 tou2 kan4
cues.en: And they're not allowed to look back.

cues.zh: 因此四位小朋友都不知道自己头上的帽
cues.pinyin: yin1 ci3 si4 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 dou1 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 tou2 shang4 de5 mao4
cues.en: So none of the four kids know what color

cues.zh: 子是什么颜色
cues.pinyin: zi5 shi4 shen2 me5 yan2 se4
cues.en: the hat on their own head is.

cues.zh: 但 AB 却可以看到前方小朋友的帽子
cues.pinyin: dan4 AB que4 ke3 yi3 kan4 dao4 qian2 fang1 xiao3 peng2 you3 de5 mao4 zi5
cues.en: But A and B can see the hats of the kids in front of them.

cues.zh: 老师告诉他们
cues.pinyin: lao3 shi1 gao4 su4 ta1 men5
cues.en: The teacher tells them,

cues.zh: 大家的帽子中有两顶是黄色两顶是蓝色
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 de5 mao4 zi5 zhong1 you3 liang3 ding3 shi4 huang2 se4 liang3 ding3 shi4 lan2 se4
cues.en: "Among everyone's hats, two are yellow and two are blue.

cues.zh: 谁能最快举手猜对自己帽子的颜色
cues.pinyin: shui2 neng2 zui4 kuai4 ju3 shou3 cai1 dui4 zi4 ji3 mao4 zi5 de5 yan2 se4
cues.en: Whoever raises their hand fastest and correctly guesses their own hat color

cues.zh: 就可以得到一个奖品
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ke3 yi3 de2 dao4 yi2 ge4 jiang3 pin3
cues.en: gets a prize."

cues.zh: 结果有一位小朋友猜对了
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 you3 yi1 wei4 xiao3 peng2 you3 cai1 dui4 le5
cues.en: In the end, one kid guessed correctly.

cues.zh: 请问是 A BC D 中谁呢
cues.pinyin: qing3 wen4 shi4 A BC D zhong1 shui2 ne5
cues.en: So who was it — A, B, C, or D?

cues.zh: 知道答案的可在下方留言哦
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 da2 an4 de5 ke3 zai4 xia4 fang1 liu2 yan2 o2
cues.en: If you know the answer, leave a comment below!

cues.zh: 上一集的答案在这哦
cues.pinyin: shang4 yi1 ji2 de5 da2 an4 zai4 zhe4 o2
cues.en: The answer to the last episode is here!

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从300元出租屋到300㎡房子，搬家13次终于治好了他的焦虑

cues.zh: 住进这么好的房子
cues.pinyin: zhu4 jin4 zhe4 me5 hao3 de5 fang2 zi5
cues.en: to move into such a nice home.

cues.zh: 因为这一路打拼
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 zhe4 yi1 lu4 da3 pin1
cues.en: Because of all the struggling along the way,

cues.zh: 我其实一直处在焦虑当中
cues.pinyin: wo3 qi2 shi2 yi4 zhi2 chu4 zai4 jiao1 lv4 dang1 zhong1
cues.en: I've actually been anxious this whole time.

cues.zh: 很怕稍微一松懈
cues.pinyin: hen3 pa4 shao1 wei1 yi1 song1 xie4
cues.en: I was so afraid that the moment I let my guard down even slightly,

cues.zh: 就会被淘汰
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 bei4 tao2 tai4
cues.en: I'd be eliminated.

cues.zh: 这是我当时
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2
cues.en: This is a letter

cues.zh: 录完节目一年之后
cues.pinyin: lu4 wan2 jie2 mu4 yi1 nian2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: that, a year after we finished filming the show,

cues.zh: 迅姐给我写的信
cues.pinyin: xun4 jie3 gei3 wo3 xie3 de5 xin4
cues.en: Xun jie wrote me.

cues.zh: 他说我希望你也可以找到适合你的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 xi1 wang4 ni3 ye3 ke3 yi3 zhao3 dao4 shi4 he2 ni3 de5
cues.en: She said she hoped I could also find my own way

cues.zh: 面对焦虑和化解它的方式
cues.pinyin: mian4 dui4 jiao1 lv4 he2 hua4 jie3 ta1 de5 fang1 shi4
cues.en: to face anxiety and resolve it.

cues.zh: 这段时间布置杭州新家的过程
cues.pinyin: zhe4 duan4 shi2 jian1 bu4 zhi4 hang2 zhou1 xin1 jia1 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: This process of decorating my new home in Hangzhou

cues.zh: 好像就是一个向内寻找自我治愈的过程
cues.pinyin: hao3 xiang4 jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 xiang4 nei4 xun2 zhao3 zi4 wo3 zhi4 yu4 de5 guo4 cheng2
cues.en: has felt like a journey of looking inward to heal myself.

cues.zh: 第一次看到这个小区的落地窗
cues.pinyin: di4 yi1 ci4 kan4 dao4 zhe4 ge5 xiao3 qu1 de5 luo4 di4 chuang1
cues.en: The first time I saw the floor-to-ceiling windows in this complex,

cues.zh: 我立马就走动路了
cues.pinyin: wo3 li4 ma3 jiu4 zou3 dong4 lu4 le5
cues.en: I was frozen in place right then and there.

cues.zh: 我当时把它那个冰冷冷的大理石
cues.pinyin: wo3 dang1 shi2 ba3 ta1 na4 ge5 bing1 leng3 leng3 de5 da4 li3 shi2
cues.en: At the time I took that ice-cold marble

cues.zh: 换成了木地板
cues.pinyin: huan4 cheng2 le5 mu4 di4 ban3
cues.en: and replaced it with wood flooring.

cues.zh: 立刻整个家的感觉就不一样
cues.pinyin: li4 ke4 zheng3 ge4 jia1 de5 gan3 jue2 jiu4 bu4 yi2 yang4
cues.en: Instantly the whole feel of the home changed.

cues.zh: 选家具的时候
cues.pinyin: xuan3 jia1 ju4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When picking furniture,

cues.zh: 我其实被很多很好看的照片种草
cues.pinyin: wo3 qi2 shi2 bei4 hen3 duo1 hen3 hao3 kan4 de5 zhao4 pian1 zhong4 cao3
cues.en: I was actually drawn in by a lot of gorgeous photos.

cues.zh: 但是一次机缘巧合
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 ci4 ji1 yuan2 qiao3 he2
cues.en: But by a chance coincidence,

cues.zh: 我逛到了大字的展厅
cues.pinyin: wo3 guang4 dao4 le5 da4 zi4 de5 zhan3 ting1
cues.en: I wandered into Dazi's showroom.

cues.zh: 我的天完全和周围的店铺不在一个涂层
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 tian1 wan2 quan2 he2 zhou1 wei2 de5 dian4 pu4 bu4 zai4 yi2 ge4 tu2 ceng2
cues.en: My god, it was on a completely different level from the shops around it.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从300元出租屋到300㎡房子，搬家13次终于治好了他的焦虑

cues.zh: 结果我看他们家就像是在看展一样
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 wo3 kan4 ta1 men5 jia1 jiu4 xiang4 shi4 zai4 kan4 zhan3 yi1 yang4
cues.en: Browsing their place felt just like viewing an exhibition.

cues.zh: 非常有沉浸感
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 you3 chen2 jin4 gan3
cues.en: Very immersive.

cues.zh: 就让我想象到自己理想中的家
cues.pinyin: jiu4 rang4 wo3 xiang3 xiang4 dao4 zi4 ji3 li3 xiang3 zhong1 de5 jia1
cues.en: It let me picture what my ideal home would be.

cues.zh: 不必完美
cues.pinyin: bu4 bi4 wan2 mei3
cues.en: It doesn't have to be perfect,

cues.zh: 但一定要有生命力
cues.pinyin: dan4 yi2 ding4 yao4 you3 sheng1 ming4 li4
cues.en: but it absolutely has to have vitality.

cues.zh: 他们家的沙发灯茶几
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 jia1 de5 sha1 fa1 deng1 cha2 ji1
cues.en: Their sofas, lamps, coffee tables —

cues.zh: 当时光看图片就爱上了
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 guang1 kan4 tu2 pian4 jiu4 ai4 shang4 le5
cues.en: I fell in love just from the photos.

cues.zh: 因为我很喜欢那种不规则的造型和手工感
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 hen3 xi3 huan1 na4 zhong3 bu4 gui1 ze2 de5 zao4 xing2 he2 shou3 gong1 gan3
cues.en: Because I really love that irregular shape and handmade feel.

cues.zh: 就是不会太张扬
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 bu2 hui4 tai4 zhang1 yang2
cues.en: It's just not too flashy.

cues.zh: 来过我家的朋友都说沙发跟我的气质很搭
cues.pinyin: lai2 guo4 wo3 jia1 de5 peng2 you3 dou1 shuo1 sha1 fa1 gen1 wo3 de5 qi4 zhi4 hen3 da1
cues.en: Friends who've visited my home all say the sofa really matches my vibe.

cues.zh: 就它不是那种寡淡的白
cues.pinyin: jiu4 ta1 bu2 shi4 na4 zhong3 gua3 dan4 de5 bai2
cues.en: It's not that bland, flat white.

cues.zh: 很温和而且带有光泽感
cues.pinyin: hen3 wen1 he2 er2 qie3 dai4 you3 guang1 ze2 gan3
cues.en: It's gentle and has a soft sheen.

cues.zh: 这个灯是很有趣的触碰开关
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 deng1 shi4 hen3 you3 qu4 de5 chu4 peng4 kai1 guan1
cues.en: This lamp has a fun touch switch.

cues.zh: 我很喜欢物和人之间可以有种互动
cues.pinyin: wo3 hen3 xi3 huan1 wu4 he2 ren2 zhi1 jian1 ke3 yi3 you3 zhong3 hu4 dong4
cues.en: I really like that there can be a kind of interaction between object and person.

cues.zh: 让家更有温度
cues.pinyin: rang4 jia1 geng4 you3 wen1 du4
cues.en: It makes the home feel warmer.

cues.zh: 比起早期的出租
cues.pinyin: bi3 qi3 zao3 qi1 de5 chu1 zu1
cues.en: Compared to the earlier rentals,

cues.zh: 现在这个家的幸福区一定是厨房
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 jia1 de5 xing4 fu2 qu1 yi2 ding4 shi4 chu2 fang2
cues.en: the happiest spot in this home now has to be the kitchen.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 从300元出租屋到300㎡房子，搬家13次终于治好了他的焦虑

cues.zh: 因为每个人的解压方式多不同
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 mei3 ge4 ren2 de5 jie3 ya1 fang1 shi4 duo1 bu4 tong2
cues.en: Because everyone relieves stress differently,

cues.zh: 那对我而言就是做饭
cues.pinyin: na4 dui4 wo3 er2 yan2 jiu4 shi4 zuo4 fan4
cues.en: and for me, that's cooking.

cues.zh: 哪怕白天参加完所谓的高级晚宴
cues.pinyin: na3 pa4 bai2 tian1 can1 jia1 wan2 suo3 wei4 de5 gao1 ji2 wan3 yan4
cues.en: Even after attending some so-called fancy dinner during the day,

cues.zh: 但晚上回家我也会煮一碗面
cues.pinyin: dan4 wan3 shang4 hui2 jia1 wo3 ye3 hui4 zhu3 yi1 wan3 mian4
cues.en: at night when I get home I'll still cook myself a bowl of noodles.

cues.zh: 把烟火气摆在餐桌上
cues.pinyin: ba3 yan1 huo3 qi4 bai3 zai4 can1 zhuo1 shang4
cues.en: Put that sense of everyday life on the dining table,

cues.zh: 那种再生活的踏实感才能回来
cues.pinyin: na4 zhong3 zai4 sheng1 huo2 de5 ta4 shi2 gan3 cai2 neng2 hui2 lai2
cues.en: and only then does that grounded feeling of real life come back.

cues.zh: 或许因为我身处的行业
cues.pinyin: huo4 xu3 yin1 wei4 wo3 shen1 chu4 de5 hang2 ye4
cues.en: Maybe because of the industry I'm in,

cues.zh: 让我更早意识到
cues.pinyin: rang4 wo3 geng4 zao3 yi4 shi2 dao4
cues.en: it made me realize earlier

cues.zh: 其实环境对人的影响
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 huan2 jing4 dui4 ren2 de5 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: that environment really does affect a person,

cues.zh: 打造家也是在打造自己
cues.pinyin: da3 zao4 jia1 ye3 shi4 zai4 da3 zao4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: and building a home is also building yourself.

cues.zh: 像这幅不及的字画
cues.pinyin: xiang4 zhe4 fu2 bu4 ji2 de5 zi4 hua4
cues.en: Like this unnamed piece of calligraphy

cues.zh: 跟了我很多年
cues.pinyin: gen1 le5 wo3 hen3 duo1 nian2
cues.en: that's followed me for many years.

cues.zh: 每次搬家
cues.pinyin: mei3 ci4 ban1 jia1
cues.en: Every time I move,

cues.zh: 我都会先把它摆在一个
cues.pinyin: wo3 du1 hui4 xian1 ba3 ta1 bai3 zai4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: I always place it first in

cues.zh: 特别重要的位置
cues.pinyin: te4 bie2 zhong4 yao4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: an especially important spot.

cues.zh: 像是给自己定调
cues.pinyin: xiang4 shi4 gei3 zi4 ji3 ding4 diao4
cues.en: It's like setting the tone for myself.

cues.zh: 那我对家的想象
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 dui4 jia1 de5 xiang3 xiang4
cues.en: So my idea of home

cues.zh: 其实一直都很纯粹
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 yi4 zhi2 dou1 hen3 chun2 cui4
cues.en: has actually always been very simple.

cues.zh: 就像大子有一句话非常触动我
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xiang4 da4 zi3 you3 yi1 ju4 hua4 fei1 chang2 chu4 dong4 wo3
cues.en: Just like something Dazi said that really moved me:

cues.zh: 家就是你的私人艺术馆
cues.pinyin: jia1 jiu4 shi4 ni3 de5 si1 ren2 yi4 shu4 guan3
cues.en: home is your own private art gallery.

cues.zh: 爸爸和客人在客厅谈话孩子从里面出来
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 he2 ke4 ren2 zai4 ke4 ting1 tan2 hua4 hai2 zi5 cong2 li3 mian4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Dad was chatting with a guest in the living room when the child came out from the other room.

cues.zh: 想和爸爸说悄悄话
cues.pinyin: xiang3 he2 ba4 ba4 shuo1 qiao1 qiao1 hua4
cues.en: He wanted to whisper something to Dad.

cues.zh: 爸爸教训他说孩子
cues.pinyin: ba4 ba4 jiao4 xun4 ta1 shuo1 hai2 zi5
cues.en: Dad scolded him, saying,

cues.zh: 有话就大声说在客人的面前说悄悄
cues.pinyin: you3 hua4 jiu4 da4 sheng1 shuo1 zai4 ke4 ren2 de5 mian4 qian2 shuo1 qiao1 qiao1
cues.en: "If you have something to say, say it loudly — whispering

cues.zh: 话是不礼貌的
cues.pinyin: hua4 shi4 bu4 li3 mao4 de5
cues.en: in front of a guest is impolite."

cues.zh: 孩子大声地说
cues.pinyin: hai2 zi5 da4 sheng1 di4 shuo1
cues.en: The child said loudly,

cues.zh: 妈妈要你千万别借钱给客人
cues.pinyin: ma1 ma1 yao4 ni3 qian1 wan4 bie2 jie4 qian2 gei3 ke4 ren2
cues.en: "Mom said you must never lend money to the guest!"

items.title_zh: 笑话52｜悄悄话｜报应｜不怕烫｜10块钱｜治疗晕车｜牛排不熟｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 小小我问你哦为什么做坏事最好都
cues.pinyin: xiao3 xiao3 wo3 wen4 ni3 o2 wei4 shen2 me5 zuo4 huai4 shi4 zui4 hao3 dou1
cues.en: "Xiaoxiao, let me ask you — why is it that doing bad things

cues.zh: 要选在中午呢
cues.pinyin: yao4 xuan3 zai4 zhong1 wu3 ne5
cues.en: is best done at noon?"

cues.zh: 选在中午喔
cues.pinyin: xuan3 zai4 zhong1 wu3 o1
cues.en: "At noon, huh?"

cues.zh: 会不会是因为中午的时候
cues.pinyin: hui4 bu2 hui4 shi4 yin1 wei4 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: "Could it be because at noon

cues.zh: 大家比较想睡女觉
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 bi3 jiao4 xiang3 shui4 nv3 jue2
cues.en: everyone tends to want to sleep,

cues.zh: 昏昏沉沉的
cues.pinyin: hun1 hun1 chen2 chen2 de5
cues.en: all drowsy and groggy,

cues.zh: 所以比较不会注意到你做坏事
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bi3 jiao4 bu2 hui4 zhu4 yi4 dao4 ni3 zuo4 huai4 shi4
cues.en: so they're less likely to notice you doing something bad?"

cues.zh: 不是喔
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4 o1
cues.en: "Nope."

cues.zh: 是因为早晚都会有报应的
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 zao3 wan3 du1 hui4 you3 bao4 ying4 de5
cues.en: "It's because sooner or later, there's always karma."

cues.zh: 欸你把手指都泡到汤里了啦
cues.pinyin: ai1 ni3 ba3 shou3 zhi3 dou1 pao4 dao4 tang1 li3 le5 la5
cues.en: "Hey, you've dipped your fingers right into the soup!"

cues.zh: 啊没关系啊
cues.pinyin: a5 mei2 guan1 xi4 a5
cues.en: "Oh, it's fine."

cues.zh: 啊我又不怕烫
cues.pinyin: a5 wo3 you4 bu4 pa4 tang4
cues.en: "I'm not afraid of hot stuff."

cues.zh: 呃小明上床睡蜡烛
cues.pinyin: e4 xiao3 ming2 shang4 chuang2 shui4 la4 zhu2
cues.en: Xiaoming lit a candle before going to bed.

cues.zh: 第二天早上
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 tian1 zao3 shang4
cues.en: The next morning,

cues.zh: 蜡烛竟然还有很长一段没有烧完
cues.pinyin: la4 zhu2 jing4 ran2 hai2 you3 hen3 zhang3 yi1 duan4 mei2 you3 shao1 wan2
cues.en: the candle, surprisingly, still had a long unburned part left.

cues.zh: 这是为什么
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wei4 shen2 me5
cues.en: Why was that?

cues.zh: 因为它原本就是超级长的
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 yuan2 ben3 jiu4 shi4 chao1 ji2 zhang3 de5
cues.en: Because it was originally super long,

cues.zh: 所以烧了一夜也没有烧完
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 shao1 le5 yi1 ye4 ye3 mei2 you3 shao1 wan2
cues.en: so even after burning all night, it still wasn't finished.

cues.zh: 错是被风吹起了
cues.pinyin: cuo4 shi4 bei4 feng1 chui1 qi3 le5
cues.en: Actually, it had been blown out by the wind.

cues.zh: 珊珊我问你喔
cues.pinyin: shan1 shan1 wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Shanshan, let me ask you —

cues.zh: 来加三点水怎么念
cues.pinyin: lai2 jia1 san1 dian3 shui3 zen3 me5 nian4
cues.en: the character 'lai' (来) with the three-dot water radical added, how do you read it?"

cues.zh: 过来的来加三点水
cues.pinyin: guo4 lai2 de5 lai2 jia1 san1 dian3 shui3
cues.en: "The 'lai' in 'guolai' (过来), plus the water radical —"

cues.zh: 还是来啊
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 lai2 a5
cues.en: "Still read as 'lai'?"

cues.zh: 对答对了
cues.pinyin: dui4 da2 dui4 le5
cues.en: "Correct!"

items.title_zh: 笑话52｜悄悄话｜报应｜不怕烫｜10块钱｜治疗晕车｜牛排不熟｜大大小小笑话

cues.zh: 在商店门口小明问小华说
cues.pinyin: zai4 shang1 dian4 men2 kou3 xiao3 ming2 wen4 xiao3 hua2 shuo1
cues.en: At the shop entrance, Xiaoming asked Xiaohua,

cues.zh: 那个老太太弯着腰在那里找什么
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 lao3 tai4 tai4 wan1 zhe5 yao1 zai4 na4 li3 zhao3 shen2 me5
cues.en: "What's that old lady bent over there looking for?"

cues.zh: 你才快钱啊
cues.pinyin: ni3 cai2 kuai4 qian2 a5
cues.en: "Guess!"

cues.zh: 你怎么知道
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: "How do you know?"

cues.zh: 因为我捡到了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 jian3 dao4 le5
cues.en: "Because I picked it up."

cues.zh: 军车最好的方法是什么吗
cues.pinyin: jun1 che1 zui4 hao3 de5 fang1 fa3 shi4 shen2 me5 ma5
cues.en: "What's the best way to cure motion sickness?"

cues.zh: 听说吃口香糖会比较有精神
cues.pinyin: ting1 shuo1 chi1 kou3 xiang1 tang2 hui4 bi3 jiao4 you3 jing1 shen2
cues.en: "I heard chewing gum makes you feel more alert."

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "Nope."

cues.zh: 答案是不要坐车
cues.pinyin: da2 an4 shi4 bu2 yao4 zuo4 che1
cues.en: "The answer is: don't ride in a car."
