cues.zh: 我问你喔
cues.pinyin: wo3 wen4 ni3 o1
cues.en: "Let me ask you —

cues.zh: 为什么三分熟的牛排
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 san1 fen1 shu2 de5 niu2 pai2
cues.en: why does a medium-rare steak

cues.zh: 和一个五分熟的牛排
cues.pinyin: he2 yi2 ge4 wu3 fen1 shu2 de5 niu2 pai2
cues.en: and a medium steak,

cues.zh: 见面都不说话呢
cues.pinyin: jian4 mian4 dou1 bu4 shuo1 hua4 ne5
cues.en: not say a word when they meet?"

cues.zh: 我知道
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4
cues.en: "I know!

cues.zh: 是因为他们都不熟
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 ta1 men5 dou1 bu4 shu2
cues.en: It's because they're both 'not well-done' (not familiar)."

cues.zh: 不是
cues.pinyin: bu2 shi4
cues.en: "Nope.

cues.zh: 是因为牛排本来就不会说话
cues.pinyin: shi4 yin1 wei4 niu2 pai2 ben3 lai2 jiu4 bu2 hui4 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: It's because steaks can't talk in the first place."

cues.zh: 小美看到了一件毛衣
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 kan4 dao4 le5 yi1 jian4 mao2 yi1
cues.en: Xiaomei saw a sweater

cues.zh: 问店员价钱
cues.pinyin: wen4 dian4 yuan2 jia4 qian2
cues.en: and asked the clerk the price.

cues.zh: 大减价
cues.pinyin: da4 jian3 jia4
cues.en: "Big sale!

cues.zh: 一件算你 450 元
cues.pinyin: yi1 jian4 suan4 ni3 450 yuan2
cues.en: I'll give you this one for 450 yuan."

cues.zh: 赚个整数吧
cues.pinyin: zhuan4 ge4 zheng3 shu4 ba5
cues.en: "Let's round it to a whole number."

cues.zh: 哦那好
cues.pinyin: o2 na4 hao3
cues.en: "Oh, okay then —

cues.zh: 那就算 500 元好了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 suan4 500 yuan2 hao3 le5
cues.en: let's just make it 500 yuan."

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3
cues.en: Hello everyone

cues.zh: 我是李永乐清华大学 200 9 届的毕业生
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 yue4 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 200 9 jie4 de5 bi4 ye4 sheng1
cues.en: I'm Li Yongle, a 2009 graduate of Tsinghua University

cues.zh: 我毕业于清华大学电子工程系
cues.pinyin: wo3 bi4 ye4 yu2 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 dian4 zi5 gong1 cheng2 xi4
cues.en: I graduated from the Department of Electronic Engineering at Tsinghua

cues.zh: 是罗毅老师实验室的学生我的
cues.pinyin: shi4 luo2 yi4 lao3 shi1 shi2 yan4 shi4 de5 xue2 sheng1 wo3 de5
cues.en: I was a student in Professor Luo Yi's lab

cues.zh: 导师叫郝志彪
cues.pinyin: dao3 shi1 jiao4 hao3 zhi4 biao1
cues.en: My advisor was Hao Zhibiao

cues.zh: 今天我非常非常荣幸能够再次来到母校
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 neng2 gou4 zai4 ci4 lai2 dao4 mu3 xiao4
cues.en: Today I'm very, very honored to return to my alma mater once again

cues.zh: 来到我这个曾经工作和学习过的地方
cues.pinyin: lai2 dao4 wo3 zhe4 ge5 ceng2 jing1 gong1 zuo4 he2 xue2 xi2 guo4 de5 di4 fang1
cues.en: To come back to the place where I once worked and studied

cues.zh: 然后我来给大家讲一讲我的经历
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jiang3 yi1 jiang3 wo3 de5 jing1 li4
cues.en: So let me share my story with you

cues.zh: 我希望我的经历能够给大家一点启示
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 wo3 de5 jing1 li4 neng2 gou4 gei3 da4 jia1 yi4 dian3 qi3 shi4
cues.en: I hope my experience can give you some inspiration

cues.zh: 我也非常非常的希望能够和在座的
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 fei1 chang2 fei1 chang2 de5 xi1 wang4 neng2 gou4 he2 zai4 zuo4 de5
cues.en: I also very, very much hope to

cues.zh: 各位成为同事
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 cheng2 wei2 tong2 shi4
cues.en: become colleagues with everyone here

cues.zh: 在十年以前我即将从清华大学毕业的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 shi2 nian2 yi3 qian2 wo3 ji2 jiang1 cong2 qing1 hua2 da4 xue2 bi4 ye4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Ten years ago, when I was about to graduate from Tsinghua

cues.zh: 我去过很多公司面试
cues.pinyin: wo3 qu4 guo4 hen3 duo1 gong1 si1 mian4 shi4
cues.en: I interviewed at many companies

cues.zh: 比如说我去过索尼北京总部
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 wo3 qu4 guo4 suo3 ni2 bei3 jing1 zong3 bu4
cues.en: For example, I went to Sony's Beijing headquarters

cues.zh: 当我来到索尼的北京总部的时候
cues.pinyin: dang1 wo3 lai2 dao4 suo3 ni2 de5 bei3 jing1 zong3 bu4 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: When I arrived at Sony's Beijing headquarters

cues.zh: 我看到那富丽堂皇的建筑瞠目结舌
cues.pinyin: wo3 kan4 dao4 na4 fu4 li4 tang2 huang2 de5 jian4 zhu4 cheng1 mu4 jie2 she2
cues.en: I was stunned by how grand and luxurious the building was

cues.zh: 因为我到北京这么多年一直在中
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 wo3 dao4 bei3 jing1 zhe4 me5 duo1 nian2 yi4 zhi2 zai4 zhong1
cues.en: Because in all my years in Beijing, I'd always been

cues.zh: 关村附近活动
cues.pinyin: guan1 cun1 fu4 jin4 huo2 dong4
cues.en: active around the Zhongguancun area

cues.zh: 我从来没有见过那么辉煌的建筑
cues.pinyin: wo3 cong2 lai2 mei2 you3 jian4 guo4 na4 me5 hui1 huang2 de5 jian4 zhu4
cues.en: I had never seen such a magnificent building

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 面试到最后的时候面试官问了我一个问题
cues.pinyin: mian4 shi4 dao4 zui4 hou4 de5 shi2 hou4 mian4 shi4 guan1 wen4 le5 wo3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Near the end of the interview, the interviewer asked me a question

cues.zh: 他说你对工作有什么要求
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 ni3 dui4 gong1 zuo4 you3 shen2 me5 yao1 qiu2
cues.en: He said, "What do you want from a job?"

cues.zh: 然后我说了三个字不加班
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 shuo1 le5 san1 ge4 zi4 bu4 jia1 ban1
cues.en: I said three words: "No overtime"

cues.zh: 然后就没有然后了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ran2 hou4 le5
cues.en: And that was the end of that

cues.zh: 后来我又去了雷曼兄弟面试
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 wo3 you4 qu4 le5 lei2 man4 xiong1 di4 mian4 shi4
cues.en: Later I also interviewed at Lehman Brothers

cues.zh: 在雷曼兄弟面试的时候面试官
cues.pinyin: zai4 lei2 man4 xiong1 di4 mian4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 mian4 shi4 guan1
cues.en: During the Lehman Brothers interview, the interviewer

cues.zh: 问我一个问题
cues.pinyin: wen4 wo3 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: asked me a question

cues.zh: 你怎么处理你自己的零花钱
cues.pinyin: ni3 zen3 me5 chu3 li3 ni3 zi4 ji3 de5 ling2 hua1 qian2
cues.en: "How do you handle your own pocket money?"

cues.zh: 我说我买股票了
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 mai3 gu3 piao4 le5
cues.en: I said, "I bought stocks"

cues.zh: 他说那你是怎么选择股票的
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 na4 ni3 shi4 zen3 me5 xuan3 ze2 gu3 piao4 de5
cues.en: He said, "So how do you pick stocks?"

cues.zh: 我说我是瞎选的
cues.pinyin: wo3 shuo1 wo3 shi4 xia1 xuan3 de5
cues.en: I said, "I just pick randomly"

cues.zh: 然后就没有然后了
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 mei2 you3 ran2 hou4 le5
cues.en: And that was the end of that too

cues.zh: 其实当时我也很迷惘
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 dang1 shi2 wo3 ye3 hen3 mi2 wang3
cues.en: Actually, I was pretty lost back then

cues.zh: 我不知道自己到底要从事一个
cues.pinyin: wo3 bu4 zhi1 dao4 zi4 ji3 dao4 di3 yao4 cong2 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: I didn't know what kind of

cues.zh: 什么样的行业
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yang4 de5 hang2 ye4
cues.en: industry I wanted to go into

cues.zh: 偶然的机会我到海淀黄庄去路过
cues.pinyin: ou3 ran2 de5 ji1 hui4 wo3 dao4 hai3 dian4 huang2 zhuang1 qu4 lu4 guo4
cues.en: By chance, I happened to pass through Haidian Huangzhuang

cues.zh: 我走到人大附中的门口
cues.pinyin: wo3 zou3 dao4 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 men2 kou3
cues.en: I walked up to the gate of RDFZ (the High School Affiliated to Renmin University)

cues.zh: 看到许多同学在穿着校服
cues.pinyin: kan4 dao4 xu3 duo1 tong2 xue2 zai4 chuan1 zhe5 xiao4 fu2
cues.en: and saw many students wearing their school uniforms

cues.zh: 在门口走来走去
cues.pinyin: zai4 men2 kou3 zou3 lai2 zou3 qu4
cues.en: walking around in front of the gate

cues.zh: 我知道这是北京最好的高中
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhi1 dao4 zhe4 shi4 bei3 jing1 zui4 hao3 de5 gao1 zhong1
cues.en: I knew this was the best high school in Beijing

cues.zh: 同学们要是逛街也要相约穿着校服
cues.pinyin: tong2 xue2 men5 yao4 shi4 guang4 jie1 ye3 yao4 xiang1 yue1 chuan1 zhe5 xiao4 fu2
cues.en: Even when going out shopping, students would agree to wear their uniforms

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 还参加过国际大争辩论赛
cues.pinyin: hai2 can1 jia1 guo4 guo2 ji4 da4 zheng1 bian4 lun4 sai4
cues.en: I had also competed in the International College Debate Competition

cues.zh: 是中国队的变手
cues.pinyin: shi4 zhong1 guo2 dui4 de5 bian4 shou3
cues.en: as a debater on the Chinese team

cues.zh: 所以我有优秀的表达能力
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 wo3 you3 you1 xiu4 de5 biao3 da2 neng2 li4
cues.en: So I had strong public speaking skills

cues.zh: 可以在很多小朋友们前讲话
cues.pinyin: ke3 yi3 zai4 hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 men5 qian2 jiang3 hua4
cues.en: I could speak in front of many kids

cues.zh: 而且不怯场
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 bu4 qie4 chang3
cues.en: and not get stage fright

cues.zh: 这些都是我的优势
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 dou1 shi4 wo3 de5 you1 shi4
cues.en: These were all my strengths

cues.zh: 但最重要的是
cues.pinyin: dan4 zui4 zhong4 yao4 de5 shi4
cues.en: But most importantly

cues.zh: 我是一个不善于与人打交道的人
cues.pinyin: wo3 shi4 yi2 ge4 bu4 shan4 yu2 yu3 ren2 da3 jiao1 dao4 de5 ren2
cues.en: I'm not someone who's good at dealing with people

cues.zh: 也许有人很奇怪
cues.pinyin: ye3 xu3 you3 ren2 hen3 qi2 guai4
cues.en: Some might find this strange

cues.zh: 你说你善于表达
cues.pinyin: ni3 shuo1 ni3 shan4 yu2 biao3 da2
cues.en: You say you're good at speaking

cues.zh: 你又不善于与人打交道
cues.pinyin: ni3 you4 bu4 shan4 yu2 yu3 ren2 da3 jiao1 dao4
cues.en: but not good at dealing with people

cues.zh: 这不矛盾吗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu4 mao2 dun4 ma5
cues.en: Isn't that a contradiction?

cues.zh: 但是这其实就是事实
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 zhe4 qi2 shi2 jiu4 shi4 shi4 shi2
cues.en: But that's actually just the truth

cues.zh: 我曾经跟我的同学争论一个问题
cues.pinyin: wo3 ceng2 jing1 gen1 wo3 de5 tong2 xue2 zheng1 lun4 yi2 ge4 wen4 ti2
cues.en: I once argued with a classmate over an issue

cues.zh: 争论的面红耳赤
cues.pinyin: zheng1 lun4 de5 mian4 hong2 er3 chi4
cues.en: We argued until our faces turned red

cues.zh: 后来其他同学跟我说
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 qi2 ta1 tong2 xue2 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Afterward another classmate told me

cues.zh: 在成人的世界里是没有对错的
cues.pinyin: zai4 cheng2 ren2 de5 shi4 jie4 li3 shi4 mei2 you3 dui4 cuo4 de5
cues.en: "In the adult world, there's no right or wrong

cues.zh: 只有利弊
cues.pinyin: zhi3 you3 li4 bi4
cues.en: only advantages and disadvantages"

cues.zh: 我明白他的意思
cues.pinyin: wo3 ming2 bai2 ta1 de5 yi4 si5
cues.en: I understood what he meant

cues.zh: 但是如果你让我在职场上左右逢源
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ru2 guo3 ni3 rang4 wo3 zai4 zhi2 chang3 shang4 zuo3 you4 feng2 yuan2
cues.en: But if you asked me to be smooth and tactful in the workplace

cues.zh: 魅上七下
cues.pinyin: mei4 shang4 qi1 xia4
cues.en: flattering superiors while bullying subordinates

cues.zh: 见风使舵
cues.pinyin: jian4 feng1 shi3 duo4
cues.en: and going with the flow depending on which way the wind blows

cues.zh: 我真的做不到
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhen1 de5 zuo4 bu2 dao4
cues.en: I really couldn't do it

cues.zh: 于是有人跟我说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 you3 ren2 gen1 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: So someone told me

cues.zh: 你这种性格可能只能当一个中学老师了
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 zhong3 xing4 ge2 ke3 neng2 zhi3 neng2 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1 le5
cues.en: "With your personality, maybe you can only be a middle school teacher"

cues.zh: 你当一个中学老师
cues.pinyin: ni3 dang1 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 lao3 shi1
cues.en: "As a middle school teacher

cues.zh: 讲究对错就够了
cues.pinyin: jiang3 jiu1 dui4 cuo4 jiu4 gou4 le5
cues.en: caring about right and wrong is enough"

cues.zh: 我想通了
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang3 tong1 le5
cues.en: That got me thinking it through

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 如果我说我看中的是北京户口
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 shuo1 wo3 kan4 zhong4 de5 shi4 bei3 jing1 hu4 kou3
cues.en: If I said I was after a Beijing residency permit (hukou)

cues.zh: 而且有寒暑假
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 you3 han2 shu3 jia4
cues.en: and the winter and summer vacations

cues.zh: 然后我再偷着出去坐家教
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 wo3 zai4 tou1 zhe5 chu1 qu4 zuo4 jia1 jiao4
cues.en: and planned to secretly tutor on the side

cues.zh: 这样就可以挣钱了
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 zheng4 qian2 le5
cues.en: to make extra money

cues.zh: 这就显得很庸俗
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 xian3 de5 hen3 yong1 su2
cues.en: that would sound rather vulgar

cues.zh: 那如果我说我不在乎工作辛苦
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 wo3 shuo1 wo3 bu4 zai4 hu1 gong1 zuo4 xin1 ku3
cues.en: But if I said I didn't care about hard work

cues.zh: 我也不在乎工资低
cues.pinyin: wo3 ye3 bu4 zai4 hu1 gong1 zi1 di1
cues.en: and didn't care about low pay

cues.zh: 我就是要做人类灵魂的工程师
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 shi4 yao4 zuo4 ren2 lei4 ling2 hun2 de5 gong1 cheng2 shi1
cues.en: and just wanted to be an "engineer of the human soul"

cues.zh: 这显得很虚伪
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xian3 de5 hen3 xu1 wei3
cues.en: that would sound rather hypocritical

cues.zh: 所以这个问题究竟该怎么回答呢
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2 jiu1 jing4 gai1 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 ne5
cues.en: So how should I actually answer this question?

cues.zh: 当时我的脑子里闪现出法拉第的故事
cues.pinyin: dang1 shi2 wo3 de5 nao3 zi5 li3 shan3 xian4 chu1 fa3 la1 di4 de5 gu4 shi4
cues.en: At the time, Faraday's story flashed through my mind

cues.zh: 只上过两年小学的科学家法拉第
cues.pinyin: zhi3 shang4 guo4 liang3 nian2 xiao3 xue2 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1 fa3 la1 di4
cues.en: Faraday, the scientist who only had two years of elementary school

cues.zh: 年轻的时候自己在家里看书做实验
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 de5 shi2 hou4 zi4 ji3 zai4 jia1 li3 kan4 shu1 zuo4 shi2 yan4
cues.en: read books and did experiments at home when he was young

cues.zh: 后来他看到报纸上大化学家戴维
cues.pinyin: hou4 lai2 ta1 kan4 dao4 bao4 zhi3 shang4 da4 hua4 xue2 jia1 dai4 wei2
cues.en: Later he saw in the newspaper that the great chemist Davy

cues.zh: 招实验室助手
cues.pinyin: zhao1 shi2 yan4 shi4 zhu4 shou3
cues.en: was recruiting a lab assistant

cues.zh: 于是就来到了戴维的实验室
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 jiu4 lai2 dao4 le5 dai4 wei2 de5 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: So he went to work in Davy's lab

cues.zh: 戴维问他我告诉你啊年轻人
cues.pinyin: dai4 wei2 wen4 ta1 wo3 gao4 su4 ni3 a5 nian2 qing1 ren2
cues.en: Davy asked him, "Let me tell you, young man

cues.zh: 科学是很辛苦的而且没有多少回报
cues.pinyin: ke1 xue2 shi4 hen3 xin1 ku3 de5 er2 qie3 mei2 you3 duo1 shao3 hui2 bao4
cues.en: science is very hard work and doesn't pay much

cues.zh: 你还愿意来吗
cues.pinyin: ni3 huan2 yuan4 yi4 lai2 ma5
cues.en: are you still willing to come?"

cues.zh: 法拉第当时是怎么回答的呢
cues.pinyin: fa3 la1 di4 dang1 shi2 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 da2 de5 ne5
cues.en: How did Faraday answer?

cues.zh: 他说我觉得科学本身就是一种回报
cues.pinyin: ta1 shuo1 wo3 jue2 de5 ke1 xue2 ben3 shen1 jiu4 shi4 yi1 zhong3 hui2 bao4
cues.en: He said, "I think science itself is a reward"

cues.zh: 法拉第是这么说的也是这么做的
cues.pinyin: fa3 la1 di4 shi4 zhe4 me5 shuo1 de5 ye3 shi4 zhe4 me5 zuo4 de5
cues.en: Faraday said this, and he lived by it too

cues.zh: 他把自己的全部都献给了科学
cues.pinyin: ta1 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 quan2 bu4 dou1 xian4 gei3 le5 ke1 xue2
cues.en: He devoted his entire self to science

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 终于通过自己的努力
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 tong1 guo4 zi4 ji3 de5 nu3 li4
cues.en: and eventually, through his own effort

cues.zh: 成了那个时代最伟大的科学家
cues.pinyin: cheng2 le5 na4 ge5 shi2 dai4 zui4 wei3 da4 de5 ke1 xue2 jia1
cues.en: became the greatest scientist of his era

cues.zh: 于是我对校长说
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 wo3 dui4 xiao4 zhang3 shuo1
cues.en: So I said to the principal

cues.zh: 年轻人不应该把钱看得太重
cues.pinyin: nian2 qing1 ren2 bu4 ying1 gai1 ba3 qian2 kan4 de2 tai4 zhong4
cues.en: "Young people shouldn't value money too much

cues.zh: 更应该注重学习
cues.pinyin: geng4 ying1 gai1 zhu4 zhong4 xue2 xi2
cues.en: they should focus more on learning"

cues.zh: 人大附中能给我一个很好的学习平台
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 neng2 gei3 wo3 yi2 ge4 hen3 hao3 de5 xue2 xi2 ping2 tai2
cues.en: "RDFZ can give me a great platform for learning

cues.zh: 在这里我可以快速地成长
cues.pinyin: zai4 zhe4 li3 wo3 ke3 yi3 kuai4 su4 di4 cheng2 zhang3
cues.en: Here I can grow quickly"

cues.zh: 这是我当时的心理化
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 wo3 dang1 shi2 de5 xin1 li3 hua4
cues.en: That was what was really on my mind at the time

cues.zh: 很荣幸
cues.pinyin: hen3 rong2 xing4
cues.en: It was an honor

cues.zh: 从此之后我就成为了一名人大附中的教师
cues.pinyin: cong2 ci3 zhi1 hou4 wo3 jiu4 cheng2 wei2 le5 yi1 ming2 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 jiao4 shi1
cues.en: From then on, I became a teacher at RDFZ

cues.zh: 我发现面试的时候校长对我说的话
cues.pinyin: wo3 fa1 xian4 mian4 shi4 de5 shi2 hou4 xiao4 zhang3 dui4 wo3 shuo1 de5 hua4
cues.en: I found that what the principal told me at the interview

cues.zh: 他没有骗我
cues.pinyin: ta1 mei2 you3 pian4 wo3
cues.en: he hadn't lied to me

cues.zh: 在附中的工作非常辛苦
cues.pinyin: zai4 fu4 zhong1 de5 gong1 zuo4 fei1 chang2 xin1 ku3
cues.en: Working at RDFZ was extremely hard

cues.zh: 尤其是新老师
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 xin1 lao3 shi1
cues.en: especially for new teachers

cues.zh: 你需要不停地备课上课批改作业
cues.pinyin: ni3 xu1 yao4 bu4 ting2 di4 bei4 ke4 shang4 ke4 pi1 gai3 zuo4 ye4
cues.en: You constantly have to prepare lessons, teach, and grade homework

cues.zh: 找学生谈话
cues.pinyin: zhao3 xue2 sheng1 tan2 hua4
cues.en: and have talks with students

cues.zh: 还要经常上公开课
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 jing1 chang2 shang4 gong1 kai1 ke4
cues.en: and often give open/demonstration classes

cues.zh: 我在人大附中的前几年
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 de5 qian2 ji3 nian2
cues.en: In my first few years at RDFZ

cues.zh: 几乎都是每天备课到 12 点以后
cues.pinyin: ji1 hu1 dou1 shi4 mei3 tian1 bei4 ke4 dao4 12 dian3 yi3 hou4
cues.en: I prepared lessons almost every day until after midnight

cues.zh: 几年以后
cues.pinyin: ji3 nian2 yi3 hou4
cues.en: A few years later

cues.zh: 我的备课量就稍微小了一点
cues.pinyin: wo3 de5 bei4 ke4 liang4 jiu4 shao1 wei1 xiao3 le5 yi4 dian3
cues.en: my lesson-prep workload got a bit lighter

cues.zh: 因为熟练了
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 shu2 lian4 le5
cues.en: because I'd gotten more skilled

cues.zh: 结果学校又给我安排了竞赛的任务
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 xue2 xiao4 you4 gei3 wo3 an1 pai2 le5 jing4 sai4 de5 ren4 wu4
cues.en: As a result, the school assigned me competition coaching duties

cues.zh: 被竞赛课更是辛苦
cues.pinyin: bei4 jing4 sai4 ke4 geng4 shi4 xin1 ku3
cues.en: Teaching competition classes was even more exhausting

cues.zh: 你经常备出一节课
cues.pinyin: ni3 jing1 chang2 bei4 chu1 yi1 jie2 ke4
cues.en: Often, preparing a single class

cues.zh: 就要花两三天的时间
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yao4 hua1 liang3 san1 tian1 de5 shi2 jian1
cues.en: would take two or three days

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】我为什么当中学老师？李永乐老师清华大学演讲

cues.zh: 他们实现了我当初没有实现的理想
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 shi2 xian4 le5 wo3 dang1 chu1 mei2 you3 shi2 xian4 de5 li3 xiang3
cues.en: They achieved the dream I never got to achieve myself

cues.zh: 他们的未来比我更加辉煌
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 de5 wei4 lai2 bi3 wo3 geng4 jia1 hui1 huang2
cues.en: Their future is even brighter than mine

cues.zh: 而且他们还记得我
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 hai2 ji4 de5 wo3
cues.en: And they still remember me

cues.zh: 每当他们回到人大服中的时候
cues.pinyin: mei3 dang1 ta1 men5 hui2 dao4 ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Whenever they come back to visit RDFZ

cues.zh: 会给我讲他自己的所见所闻
cues.pinyin: hui4 gei3 wo3 jiang3 ta1 zi4 ji3 de5 suo3 jian4 suo3 wen2
cues.en: they tell me about what they've seen and experienced

cues.zh: 会给我带了一些小礼物
cues.pinyin: hui4 gei3 wo3 dai4 le5 yi1 xie1 xiao3 li3 wu4
cues.en: and bring me little gifts

cues.zh: 谁说做一个中学教师是没有回报的呢
cues.pinyin: shui2 shuo1 zuo4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 xue2 jiao4 shi1 shi4 mei2 you3 hui2 bao4 de5 ne5
cues.en: Who says being a middle school teacher has no reward?

cues.zh: 教师最大的财富就是学生
cues.pinyin: jiao4 shi1 zui4 da4 de5 cai2 fu4 jiu4 shi4 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: A teacher's greatest wealth is their students

cues.zh: 从这个角度上讲
cues.pinyin: cong2 zhe4 ge5 jiao3 du4 shang4 jiang3
cues.en: From that perspective

cues.zh: 人大服中让我成了一名亿万富翁
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 rang4 wo3 cheng2 le5 yi1 ming2 yi4 wan4 fu4 weng1
cues.en: RDFZ made me a billionaire

cues.zh: 而且人大服中不是一所普通的中学
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ren2 da4 fu2 zhong1 bu2 shi4 yi1 suo3 pu3 tong1 de5 zhong1 xue2
cues.en: And RDFZ isn't an ordinary middle school

cues.zh: 他汇集了全北京市最好的学生
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 ji2 le5 quan2 bei3 jing1 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 xue2 sheng1
cues.en: It gathers the best students in all of Beijing

cues.zh: 你永远不用担心自己的努力白费
cues.pinyin: ni3 yong3 yuan3 bu4 yong4 dan1 xin1 zi4 ji3 de5 nu3 li4 bai2 fei4
cues.en: You never have to worry that your hard work is wasted

cues.zh: 精心准备的课程学生听不懂
cues.pinyin: jing1 xin1 zhun3 bei4 de5 ke4 cheng2 xue2 sheng1 ting1 bu4 dong3
cues.en: on students who can't understand your carefully prepared lessons

cues.zh: 许多孩子的思维能力创造能力都比我强
cues.pinyin: xu3 duo1 hai2 zi5 de5 si1 wei2 neng2 li4 chuang4 zao4 neng2 li4 dou1 bi3 wo3 qiang2
cues.en: Many kids' thinking and creativity are stronger than mine

cues.zh: 人大附中也是一所开放包容的学校
cues.pinyin: ren2 da4 fu4 zhong1 ye3 shi4 yi1 suo3 kai1 fang4 bao1 rong2 de5 xue2 xiao4
cues.en: RDFZ is also an open and inclusive school

cues.zh: 你不需要在学校里过多地考虑如
cues.pinyin: ni3 bu4 xu1 yao4 zai4 xue2 xiao4 li3 guo4 duo1 di4 kao3 lv4 ru2
cues.en: You don't need to spend much time at school thinking about

cues.zh: 何去讨好领导
cues.pinyin: he2 qu4 tao3 hao3 ling3 dao3
cues.en: how to flatter your leaders

cues.zh: 只要你的教学工作被人认可
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 ni3 de5 jiao4 xue2 gong1 zuo4 bei4 ren2 ren4 ke3
cues.en: As long as your teaching work is recognized

cues.zh: 不会有任何人刁难你
cues.pinyin: bu2 hui4 you3 ren4 he2 ren2 diao1 nan4 ni3
cues.en: no one will ever make things difficult for you

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 一个小学学历的父亲
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 xiao3 xue2 xue2 li4 de5 fu4 qin1
cues.en: A father with only an elementary school education

cues.zh: 医术竟然比天才医生还高明
cues.pinyin: yi1 shu4 jing4 ran2 bi3 tian1 cai2 yi1 sheng1 huan2 gao1 ming2
cues.en: actually has better medical skill than a genius doctor.

cues.zh: 自学成才的父亲能否打败医疗权威
cues.pinyin: zi4 xue2 cheng2 cai2 de5 fu4 qin1 neng2 fou3 da3 bai4 yi1 liao2 quan2 wei1
cues.en: Can a self-taught father defeat medical authority

cues.zh: 救下自己女儿的命呢
cues.pinyin: jiu4 xia4 zi4 ji3 nv3 er2 de5 ming4 ne5
cues.en: and save his own daughter's life?

cues.zh: 这一天肖恩接诊了一个特殊的患者
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 tian1 xiao4 en1 jie1 zhen3 le5 yi2 ge4 te4 shu1 de5 huan4 zhe3
cues.en: That day, Shaun took on a special patient.

cues.zh: 患者的父亲指明要肖恩给他的女儿看诊
cues.pinyin: huan4 zhe3 de5 fu4 qin1 zhi3 ming2 yao4 xiao4 en1 gei3 ta1 de5 nv3 er2 kan4 zhen3
cues.en: The patient's father specifically asked for Shaun to examine his daughter.

cues.zh: 他的女儿小丽已经恶心呕吐了整整四年
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 nv3 er2 xiao3 li4 yi3 jing1 e3 xin1 ou3 tu4 le5 zheng3 zheng3 si4 nian2
cues.en: His daughter Xiaoli had been nauseous and vomiting for four whole years,

cues.zh: 上厕所还会便血
cues.pinyin: shang4 ce4 suo3 hai2 hui4 bian4 xie3
cues.en: and would even pass blood when using the bathroom.

cues.zh: 父亲断定她是内脏疾病
cues.pinyin: fu4 qin1 duan4 ding4 ta1 shi4 nei4 zang4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: The father was convinced it was an internal organ disease.

cues.zh: 可他去看了 19 个医生
cues.pinyin: ke3 ta1 qu4 kan4 le5 19 ge4 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: But he had already seen 19 doctors,

cues.zh: 医生们都说只是肠道感染罢了
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 dou1 shuo1 zhi3 shi4 chang2 dao4 gan3 ran3 ba4 le5
cues.en: and they all said it was just an intestinal infection.

cues.zh: 父亲也是实在没办法才找到的肖恩
cues.pinyin: fu4 qin1 ye3 shi4 shi2 zai4 mei2 ban4 fa3 cai2 zhao3 dao4 de5 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Out of options, the father finally turned to Shaun.

cues.zh: 他调查了肖恩的学术论文
cues.pinyin: ta1 diao4 cha2 le5 xiao4 en1 de5 xue2 shu4 lun4 wen2
cues.en: He looked into Shaun's academic papers

cues.zh: 觉得肖恩在小儿肠道研究上颇有心得
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 xiao4 en1 zai4 xiao3 er2 chang2 dao4 yan2 jiu1 shang4 po3 you3 xin1 de2
cues.en: and felt Shaun had real expertise in pediatric intestinal research.

cues.zh: 肖恩看了一下女孩的情况
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 kan4 le5 yi1 xia4 nv3 hai2 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Shaun looked over the girl's condition

cues.zh: 发现她可能只是肠道感染
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 ke3 neng2 zhi3 shi4 chang2 dao4 gan3 ran3
cues.en: and found she might just have an intestinal infection,

cues.zh: 想把她转去内科
cues.pinyin: xiang3 ba3 ta1 zhuan3 qu4 nei4 ke1
cues.en: so he wanted to transfer her to internal medicine.

cues.zh: 但父亲却坚持认为小丽是内脏疾病
cues.pinyin: dan4 fu4 qin1 que4 jian1 chi2 ren4 wei2 xiao3 li4 shi4 nei4 zang4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: But the father insisted Xiaoli had an organ disease.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 肖恩只好无奈地继续给女儿做检查
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhi3 hao3 wu2 nai4 di4 ji4 xu4 gei3 nv3 er2 zuo4 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Shaun had no choice but to keep examining the girl,

cues.zh: 一边提醒老父亲百度看病癌症急步
cues.pinyin: yi1 bian1 ti2 xing3 lao3 fu4 qin1 bai3 du4 kan4 bing4 ai2 zheng4 ji2 bu4
cues.en: while reminding the old father not to just self-diagnose online,

cues.zh: 你别信网上说的
cues.pinyin: ni3 bie2 xin4 wang3 shang4 shuo1 de5
cues.en: "Don't believe everything you read on the internet."

cues.zh: 就在这时
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 zhe4 shi2
cues.en: Just then,

cues.zh: 肖恩发现小丽的肠道运动减弱
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 fa1 xian4 xiao3 li4 de5 chang2 dao4 yun4 dong4 jian3 ruo4
cues.en: Shaun discovered Xiaoli's intestinal motility had weakened —

cues.zh: 她有很严重的肠梗阻
cues.pinyin: ta1 you3 hen3 yan2 zhong4 de5 chang2 geng3 zu3
cues.en: she had a severe intestinal obstruction

cues.zh: 需要马上手术
cues.pinyin: xu1 yao4 ma3 shang4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and needed surgery right away.

cues.zh: 小丽被推进手术室
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 bei4 tui1 jin4 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Xiaoli was wheeled into the operating room.

cues.zh: 医生们切出梗阻部分的肠道
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 qie4 chu1 geng3 zu3 bu4 fen4 de5 chang2 dao4
cues.en: The doctors cut out the obstructed section of intestine,

cues.zh: 再用吻合器缝合就可以了
cues.pinyin: zai4 yong4 wen3 he2 qi4 feng2 he2 jiu4 ke3 yi3 le5
cues.en: then just needed to staple it back together.

cues.zh: 可小莉结肠部分十分薄弱
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 li4 jie2 chang2 bu4 fen4 shi2 fen1 bo2 ruo4
cues.en: But part of Xiaoli's colon was extremely fragile,

cues.zh: 这引起了安德鲁斯医生的注意
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yin3 qi3 le5 an1 de2 lu3 si1 yi1 sheng1 de5 zhu4 yi4
cues.en: which caught Dr. Andrews' attention.

cues.zh: 她让人送去病理科检查
cues.pinyin: ta1 rang4 ren2 song4 qu4 bing4 li3 ke1 jian3 cha2
cues.en: She sent it to pathology for testing.

cues.zh: 很快病理检查结果出来了
cues.pinyin: hen3 kuai4 bing4 li3 jian3 cha2 jie2 guo3 chu1 lai2 le5
cues.en: The pathology results soon came back:

cues.zh: 小莉真的患了内脏疾病
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 zhen1 de5 huan4 le5 nei4 zang4 ji2 bing4
cues.en: Xiaoli really did have an organ disease.

cues.zh: 她父亲的诊断居然是正确的
cues.pinyin: ta1 fu4 qin1 de5 zhen3 duan4 ju1 ran2 shi4 zheng4 que4 de5
cues.en: Her father's diagnosis had actually been right.

cues.zh: 萧恩赶紧回到病房去见老父亲
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 gan3 jin3 hui2 dao4 bing4 fang2 qu4 jian4 lao3 fu4 qin1
cues.en: Shaun rushed back to the ward to see the old father,

cues.zh: 才发现萨伦也在
cues.pinyin: cai2 fa1 xian4 sa4 lun2 ye3 zai4
cues.en: only to find Saren was there too.

cues.zh: 萨伦说老父亲虽然没有学历
cues.pinyin: sa4 lun2 shuo1 lao3 fu4 qin1 sui1 ran2 mei2 you3 xue2 li4
cues.en: Saren said that although the old father had no formal education,

cues.zh: 但是女儿病了四年
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 nv3 er2 bing4 le5 si4 nian2
cues.en: his daughter had been sick for four years,

cues.zh: 她也研究医学专业研究了四年
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 yan2 jiu1 yi1 xue2 zhuan1 ye4 yan2 jiu1 le5 si4 nian2
cues.en: and he had spent those same four years studying medicine himself.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 他想把小丽的右半结肠切除
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 ba3 xiao3 li4 de5 you4 ban4 jie2 chang2 qie1 chu2
cues.en: He wanted to remove the right half of Xiaoli's colon.

cues.zh: 老父亲一听就不干了
cues.pinyin: lao3 fu4 qin1 yi1 ting1 jiu4 bu4 gan4 le5
cues.en: The old father refused the moment he heard that.

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯也觉得切得有点多
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 ye3 jue2 de5 qie4 de2 you3 dian3 duo1
cues.en: Andrews also felt that was too much to cut.

cues.zh: 其实他们只需要把最危险的部
cues.pinyin: qi2 shi2 ta1 men5 zhi3 xu1 yao4 ba3 zui4 wei1 xian3 de5 bu4
cues.en: In fact, they only needed to remove

cues.zh: 位切除掉就行
cues.pinyin: wei4 qie1 chu2 diao4 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: the most dangerous part.

cues.zh: 可这样老父亲还是不满意
cues.pinyin: ke3 zhe4 yang4 lao3 fu4 qin1 hai2 shi4 bu4 man3 yi4
cues.en: But even so, the old father wasn't satisfied.

cues.zh: 他觉得只要让小利肠道蠕动恢复正常就行
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 zhi3 yao4 rang4 xiao3 li4 chang2 dao4 ru2 dong4 hui1 fu4 zheng4 chang2 jiu4 xing2
cues.en: He felt it was enough to just restore normal intestinal motility —

cues.zh: 根本不需要切肠子
cues.pinyin: gen1 ben3 bu4 xu1 yao4 qie4 chang2 zi5
cues.en: there was no need to cut the intestine at all.

cues.zh: 他们可以用利陀西单抗治疗
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 yong4 li4 tuo2 xi1 dan1 kang4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: They could treat it with Lituoximab instead,

cues.zh: 这种意想天开的法子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zhong3 yi4 xiang3 tian1 kai1 de5 fa3 zi5
cues.en: and this far-fetched idea

cues.zh: 引起了奥斯玛医生的不满
cues.pinyin: yin3 qi3 le5 ao4 si1 ma3 yi1 sheng1 de5 bu4 man3
cues.en: upset Dr. Osma.

cues.zh: 利陀西单抗是用于癌症治疗的
cues.pinyin: li4 tuo2 xi1 dan1 kang4 shi4 yong4 yu2 ai2 zheng4 zhi4 liao2 de5
cues.en: "Lituoximab is used for cancer treatment —

cues.zh: 什么时候也能治疗肠道疾病了
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 shi2 hou4 ye3 neng2 zhi4 liao2 chang2 dao4 ji2 bing4 le5
cues.en: since when does it treat intestinal disease too?"

cues.zh: 可老附近说
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 fu4 jin4 shuo1
cues.en: But the old father said

cues.zh: 这样可能会引起小丽更多损伤的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ke3 neng2 hui4 yin3 qi3 xiao3 li4 geng4 duo1 sun3 shang1 de5
cues.en: pediatric trials showed it raised survival rates by 30%.

cues.zh: 肖安也明确反对
cues.pinyin: xiao4 an1 ye3 ming2 que4 fan3 dui4
cues.en: Shaun also firmly objected,

cues.zh: 这样可能会引起小利更多损伤的
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 ke3 neng2 hui4 yin3 qi3 xiao3 li4 geng4 duo1 sun3 shang1 de5
cues.en: saying it could cause Xiaoli even more harm.

cues.zh: 可老附近的坚持最后说服了安德鲁斯
cues.pinyin: ke3 lao3 fu4 jin4 de5 jian1 chi2 zui4 hou4 shuo1 fu2 le5 an1 de2 lu3 si1
cues.en: But the old father's persistence eventually convinced Andrews,

cues.zh: 安德鲁斯拍板定案
cues.pinyin: an1 de2 lu3 si1 pai1 ban3 ding4 an4
cues.en: and Andrews made the final call

cues.zh: 就用利陀西单抗治疗
cues.pinyin: jiu4 yong4 li4 tuo2 xi1 dan1 kang4 zhi4 liao2
cues.en: to go with Lituoximab treatment.

cues.zh: 肖云最害怕的一幕还是发生了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 yun2 zui4 hai4 pa4 de5 yi2 mu4 hai2 shi4 fa1 sheng1 le5
cues.en: The scene Shaun feared most happened anyway.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 如果他早点听肖恩的话
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ta1 zao3 dian3 ting1 xiao4 en1 de5 hua4
cues.en: If he had listened to Shaun sooner,

cues.zh: 女儿日后还是能像正常人一样生活的
cues.pinyin: nv3 er2 ri4 hou4 hai2 shi4 neng2 xiang4 zheng4 chang2 ren2 yi1 yang4 sheng1 huo2 de5
cues.en: his daughter could have gone on to live a normal life.

cues.zh: 小丽却寄希望于肖恩
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 que4 ji4 xi1 wang4 yu2 xiao4 en1
cues.en: Xiaoli, meanwhile, had placed all her hope in Shaun.

cues.zh: 他觉得肖恩是一个很神奇的医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 jue2 de5 xiao4 en1 shi4 yi2 ge4 hen3 shen2 qi2 de5 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: She thought Shaun was an amazing doctor,

cues.zh: 她曾经相信小莉一定有办法治愈自己
cues.pinyin: ta1 ceng2 jing1 xiang1 xin4 xiao3 li4 yi2 ding4 you3 ban4 fa3 zhi4 yu4 zi4 ji3
cues.en: and had believed he would surely find a way to cure her.

cues.zh: 可小莉让她失望了
cues.pinyin: ke3 xiao3 li4 rang4 ta1 shi1 wang4 le5
cues.en: But Shaun let her down.

cues.zh: 小莉再次躺在了手术台上
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 zai4 ci4 tang3 zai4 le5 shou3 shu4 tai2 shang4
cues.en: Xiaoli lay on the operating table once more.

cues.zh: 小莉脑海中也在不断地模拟小莉的手术
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 nao3 hai3 zhong1 ye3 zai4 bu4 duan4 di4 mo2 ni3 xiao3 li4 de5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: In his mind, Shaun kept running through Xiaoli's surgery over and over.

cues.zh: 既然孩子都这么信任她
cues.pinyin: ji4 ran2 hai2 zi5 dou1 zhe4 me5 xin4 ren4 ta1
cues.en: Since the child trusted her so completely,

cues.zh: 她怎么忍心让孩子失望呢
cues.pinyin: ta1 zen3 me5 ren3 xin1 rang4 hai2 zi5 shi1 wang4 ne5
cues.en: how could she bear to disappoint her?

cues.zh: 就在医生们即将切除小莉大肠的时候
cues.pinyin: jiu4 zai4 yi1 sheng1 men5 ji2 jiang1 qie1 chu2 xiao3 li4 da4 chang2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Just as the doctors were about to remove Xiaoli's large intestine,

cues.zh: 小莉疯疯火火地跑到了手术室
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 feng1 feng1 huo3 huo3 di4 pao3 dao4 le5 shou3 shu4 shi4
cues.en: Shaun came rushing frantically into the OR —

cues.zh: 她想到好办法了
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 dao4 hao3 ban4 fa3 le5
cues.en: she'd thought of a solution.

cues.zh: 用 PC 管插入结肠
cues.pinyin: yong4 PC guan3 cha1 ru4 jie2 chang2
cues.en: Insert a tube into the colon,

cues.zh: 这不是为了给她营养
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bu2 shi4 wei4 le5 gei3 ta1 ying2 yang3
cues.en: not to provide nutrition,

cues.zh: 而是作为一种流出机制
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 zuo4 wei2 yi1 zhong3 liu2 chu1 ji1 zhi4
cues.en: but as a drainage mechanism —

cues.zh: 一个人工的应急压力阀
cues.pinyin: yi2 ge4 ren2 gong1 de5 ying4 ji2 ya1 li4 fa2
cues.en: an artificial emergency pressure valve.

cues.zh: 这样就可以保持小莉的肠道生活
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 bao3 chi2 xiao3 li4 de5 chang2 dao4 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: That way Xiaoli's intestine could stay viable

cues.zh: 不需要吸到大部分肠道了
cues.pinyin: bu4 xu1 yao4 xi1 dao4 da4 bu4 fen4 chang2 dao4 le5
cues.en: without needing to remove most of it.

cues.zh: 至于如何恢复小丽的肠道
cues.pinyin: zhi4 yu2 ru2 he2 hui1 fu4 xiao3 li4 de5 chang2 dao4
cues.en: As for how to restore the muscle function

cues.zh: 肌肉活力
cues.pinyin: ji1 rou4 huo2 li4
cues.en: of Xiaoli's intestine,

cues.zh: 萧恩也认可了老父亲的疗法
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ye3 ren4 ke3 le5 lao3 fu4 qin1 de5 liao2 fa3
cues.en: Shaun also endorsed the old father's approach:

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 用促进气和一线胆肩脂面
cues.pinyin: yong4 cu4 jin4 qi4 he2 yi1 xian4 dan3 jian1 zhi1 mian4
cues.en: using a motility-promoting drug together with a certain lipid-related agent

cues.zh: 抑制剂共同作用
cues.pinyin: yi4 zhi4 ji4 gong4 tong2 zuo4 yong4
cues.en: and an inhibitor working in combination —

cues.zh: 就有希望恢复肠道的蠕动了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 you3 xi1 wang4 hui1 fu4 chang2 dao4 de5 ru2 dong4 le5
cues.en: that gave hope of restoring intestinal peristalsis.

cues.zh: 小丽的手术十分成功
cues.pinyin: xiao3 li4 de5 shou3 shu4 shi2 fen1 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: Xiaoli's surgery was a complete success.

cues.zh: 小女孩开心极了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nv3 hai2 kai1 xin1 ji2 le5
cues.en: The little girl was overjoyed,

cues.zh: 尤其是听说自己的治疗方案
cues.pinyin: you2 qi2 shi4 ting1 shuo1 zi4 ji3 de5 zhi4 liao2 fang1 an4
cues.en: especially on hearing that half the credit for her treatment plan

cues.zh: 有一半是父亲的功劳
cues.pinyin: you3 yi2 ban4 shi4 fu4 qin1 de5 gong1 lao2
cues.en: belonged to her father.

cues.zh: 他们萧恩是否觉得爸爸是一个好医生
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 xiao1 en1 shi4 fou3 jue2 de5 ba4 ba4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: They asked Shaun whether he thought her dad was a good doctor.

cues.zh: 萧恩表示老父亲是不是一个好医生
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 biao3 shi4 lao3 fu4 qin1 shi4 bu2 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 yi1 sheng1
cues.en: Shaun said whether the old father was a good doctor

cues.zh: 这点不好评价
cues.pinyin: zhe4 dian3 bu4 hao3 ping2 jia4
cues.en: was hard to judge,

cues.zh: 但是他绝对是一个好父亲
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 jue2 dui4 shi4 yi2 ge4 hao3 fu4 qin1
cues.en: but he was definitely a good father.

cues.zh: 这边小安刚搞定了那对学术妇女
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 xiao3 an1 gang1 gao3 ding4 le5 na4 dui4 xue2 shu4 fu4 nv3
cues.en: Meanwhile, Shaun had just wrapped up with that research-obsessed father and daughter

cues.zh: 摩根医生这里又来了一对问题母子
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 yi1 sheng1 zhe4 li3 you4 lai2 le5 yi1 dui4 wen4 ti2 mu3 zi5
cues.en: when another troublesome mother and son showed up for Dr. Morgan.

cues.zh: 阿菲仪因为呼吸急促来医院就诊
cues.pinyin: a1 fei3 yi2 yin1 wei4 hu1 xi1 ji2 cu4 lai2 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 zhen3
cues.en: Afiyi came to the hospital because of rapid breathing.

cues.zh: 她常年全球到处旅行
cues.pinyin: ta1 chang2 nian2 quan2 qiu2 dao4 chu4 lv3 xing2
cues.en: She had spent years traveling the world nonstop,

cues.zh: 美其名约是寻找精神上的满足
cues.pinyin: mei3 qi2 ming2 yue1 shi4 xun2 zhao3 jing1 shen2 shang4 de5 man3 zu2
cues.en: calling it, in her own words, a search for spiritual fulfillment.

cues.zh: 要不是最近身体不适不得不回国
cues.pinyin: yao4 bu2 shi4 zui4 jin4 shen1 ti3 bu4 shi4 bu4 de2 bu4 hui2 guo2
cues.en: If she hadn't recently fallen ill and had to return home,

cues.zh: 恐怕她还会继续在国外飘着
cues.pinyin: kong3 pa4 ta1 hai2 hui4 ji4 xu4 zai4 guo2 wai4 piao1 zhe5
cues.en: she'd probably still be drifting around abroad.

cues.zh: 摩根给阿菲仪检查
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 gei3 a1 fei3 yi2 jian3 cha2
cues.en: Morgan examined Afiyi

cues.zh: 发现她的左侧肺部已经完全没
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 ta1 de5 zuo3 ce4 fei4 bu4 yi3 jing1 wan2 quan2 mei2
cues.en: and found her left lung had completely

cues.zh: 有气体流动了
cues.pinyin: you3 qi4 ti3 liu2 dong4 le5
cues.en: lost airflow.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 一个只有小学学历的人，医术竟然比天才医生还要厉害！肖恩发飙了

cues.zh: 新鲜的肺很快就能送到这边来进行手术了
cues.pinyin: xin1 xian1 de5 fei4 hen3 kuai4 jiu4 neng2 song4 dao4 zhe4 bian1 lai2 jin4 xing2 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: A fresh lung could soon be delivered for the surgery.

cues.zh: 可就在肺液摘取的时候
cues.pinyin: ke3 jiu4 zai4 fei4 ye4 zhai1 qu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: But just as the lung lobe was being harvested,

cues.zh: 医生们发现捐赠者的器官已经发生了癌变
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 fa1 xian4 juan1 zeng4 zhe3 de5 qi4 guan1 yi3 jing1 fa1 sheng1 le5 ai2 bian4
cues.en: the doctors discovered the donor's organ had turned cancerous

cues.zh: 不能进行移植了
cues.pinyin: bu4 neng2 jin4 xing2 yi2 zhi2 le5
cues.en: and could no longer be transplanted.

cues.zh: 而且阿菲仪也患上了严重的肺动脉高压
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 a1 fei3 yi2 ye3 huan4 shang4 le5 yan2 zhong4 de5 fei4 dong4 mai4 gao1 ya1
cues.en: What's more, Afiyi had also developed severe pulmonary hypertension.

cues.zh: 再过几天就不能动手术了
cues.pinyin: zai4 guo4 ji3 tian1 jiu4 bu4 neng2 dong4 shou3 shu4 le5
cues.en: In a few more days, surgery wouldn't even be possible —

cues.zh: 现在是她肺移植的最后期限
cues.pinyin: xian4 zai4 shi4 ta1 fei4 yi2 zhi2 de5 zui4 hou4 qi1 xian4
cues.en: this was now the final deadline for her lung transplant.

cues.zh: 找新的器官捐赠者显然已经来不及了
cues.pinyin: zhao3 xin1 de5 qi4 guan1 juan1 zeng4 zhe3 xian3 ran2 yi3 jing1 lai2 bu4 ji2 le5
cues.en: There clearly wasn't time left to find a new donor.

cues.zh: 摩根希望亨利可以捐出自己的一片肺液
cues.pinyin: mo2 gen1 xi1 wang4 heng1 li4 ke3 yi3 juan1 chu1 zi4 ji3 de5 yi1 pian4 fei4 ye4
cues.en: Morgan hoped Henry could donate a lobe of his own lung.

cues.zh: 她的呼吸越来越困难
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 hu1 xi1 yue4 lai2 yue4 kun4 nan2
cues.en: Henry said he'd go home and think it over.

cues.zh: 阿菲依的情况恶化得十分迅速
cues.pinyin: a1 fei1 yi1 de5 qing2 kuang4 e4 hua4 de2 shi2 fen1 xun4 su4
cues.en: Afiyi's condition worsened very quickly;

cues.zh: 他的呼吸越来越困难
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 hu1 xi1 yue4 lai2 yue4 kun4 nan2
cues.en: her breathing grew harder and harder.

cues.zh: 这时候亨利来到医院
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi2 hou4 heng1 li4 lai2 dao4 yi1 yuan4
cues.en: At that point, Henry came to the hospital

cues.zh: 他同意把自己的肺捐给母亲
cues.pinyin: ta1 tong2 yi4 ba3 zi4 ji3 de5 fei4 juan1 gei3 mu3 qin1
cues.en: and agreed to donate part of his lung to his mother.

cues.zh: 可没想到阿菲依毫不犹豫地拒绝
cues.pinyin: ke3 mei2 xiang3 dao4 a1 fei1 yi1 hao2 bu4 you2 yu4 di4 ju4 jue2
cues.en: But unexpectedly, Afiyi refused without hesitation —

cues.zh: 他宁可自己死
cues.pinyin: ta1 ning4 ke3 zi4 ji3 si3
cues.en: she would rather die herself

cues.zh: 也不想儿子因为他伤害了身体
cues.pinyin: ye3 bu4 xiang3 er2 zi5 yin1 wei4 ta1 shang1 hai4 le5 shen1 ti3
cues.en: than let her son damage his own body because of her.

cues.zh: 在亨利还是一个婴儿的时候
cues.pinyin: zai4 heng1 li4 hai2 shi4 yi2 ge4 ying1 er2 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Back when Henry was just a baby,

cues.zh: 他并不喜欢喝阿菲依的奶
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu4 xi3 huan1 he1 a1 fei1 yi1 de5 nai3
cues.en: he never liked drinking Afiyi's milk.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: 各位同学大家好我是李永乐老师
cues.pinyin: ge4 wei4 tong2 xue2 da4 jia1 hao3 wo3 shi4 li3 yong3 le4 lao3 shi1
cues.en: Hello everyone, I'm Teacher Li Yongle.

cues.zh: 最近美国的 H BO 拍了一部新剧
cues.pinyin: zui4 jin4 mei3 guo2 de5 H BO pai1 le5 yi1 bu4 xin1 ju4
cues.en: Recently HBO in the US made a new series.

cues.zh: 切尔诺贝利非常火
cues.pinyin: qie4 er3 nuo4 bei4 li4 fei1 chang2 huo3
cues.en: Chernobyl has become very popular.

cues.zh: 很多小朋友问我说
cues.pinyin: hen3 duo1 xiao3 peng2 you3 wen4 wo3 shuo1
cues.en: Many young students have been asking me.

cues.zh: 这个切尔诺贝利核电站是怎么爆炸的呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 qie4 er3 nuo4 bei4 li4 he2 dian4 zhan4 shi4 zen3 me5 bao4 zha4 de5 ne5
cues.en: How exactly did the Chernobyl nuclear power plant explode?

cues.zh: 今天我们就来给大家讲一下这个问题
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 wo3 men5 jiu4 lai2 gei3 da4 jia1 jiang3 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 wen4 ti2
cues.en: Today let's talk about this question.

cues.zh: 为了了解切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸
cues.pinyin: wei4 le5 liao3 jie3 qie4 er3 nuo4 bei4 li4 he2 dian4 zhan4 bao4 zha4
cues.en: In order to understand the Chernobyl explosion.

cues.zh: 我们首先得先来说一下核电站
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 shou3 xian1 de2 xian1 lai2 shuo1 yi1 xia4 he2 dian4 zhan4
cues.en: We first need to talk about nuclear power plants.

cues.zh: 它到底是一个
cues.pinyin: ta1 dao4 di3 shi4 yi2 ge4
cues.en: What exactly is it.

cues.zh: 什么样的原理
cues.pinyin: shen2 me5 yang4 de5 yuan2 li3
cues.en: What kind of principle does it work on.

cues.zh: 核电站是用来发电的
cues.pinyin: he2 dian4 zhan4 shi4 yong4 lai2 fa1 dian4 de5
cues.en: Nuclear power plants are used to generate electricity.

cues.zh: 但是发电你必须得有能量对吧
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 fa1 dian4 ni3 bi4 xu1 de2 you3 neng2 liang4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: But to generate electricity you need energy, right?

cues.zh: 这个能量来源于什么呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 neng2 liang4 lai2 yuan2 yu2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: Where does this energy come from?

cues.zh: 来源于核能它是核裂变产生的
cues.pinyin: lai2 yuan2 yu2 he2 neng2 ta1 shi4 he2 lie4 bian4 chan3 sheng1 de5
cues.en: It comes from nuclear energy, produced by nuclear fission.

cues.zh: 核裂变核裂变它是一种链式反应
cues.pinyin: he2 lie4 bian4 he2 lie4 bian4 ta1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 lian4 shi4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: Nuclear fission is a type of chain reaction.

cues.zh: 为什么叫链式反应呢
cues.pinyin: wei4 shen2 me5 jiao4 lian4 shi4 fan3 ying4 ne5
cues.en: Why is it called a chain reaction?

cues.zh: 比如说比较常见的核电站的反应原
cues.pinyin: bi3 ru2 shuo1 bi3 jiao4 chang2 jian4 de5 he2 dian4 zhan4 de5 fan3 ying4 yuan2
cues.en: For example, the reaction principle of a common nuclear power plant.

cues.zh: 理是用 U 2 35
cues.pinyin: li3 shi4 yong4 U 2 35
cues.en: Uses U-235.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: U 2 35 这种物质它加上中子
cues.pinyin: U 2 35 zhe4 zhong3 wu4 zhi4 ta1 jia1 shang4 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: When U-235 is combined with a neutron.

cues.zh: 用中子去撞击 U 2 35 它就会变成什么呢
cues.pinyin: yong4 zhong1 zi5 qu4 zhuang4 ji1 U 2 35 ta1 jiu4 hui4 bian4 cheng2 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: If you use a neutron to strike U-235, what does it turn into?

cues.zh: 它会变成倍 56 14 1
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 bian4 cheng2 bei4 56 14 1
cues.en: It turns into barium-141.

cues.zh: 还有克 36 92 以及三个中子
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 ke4 36 92 yi3 ji2 san1 ge4 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: And krypton-92, plus three neutrons.

cues.zh: 大家看我用一个中子去撞击 U
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 kan4 wo3 yong4 yi2 ge4 zhong1 zi5 qu4 zhuang4 ji1 U
cues.en: Watch as I use one neutron to strike the nucleus of U.

cues.zh: 2 35 的原子核
cues.pinyin: 2 35 de5 yuan2 zi3 he2

cues.zh: 结果撞出来什么
cues.pinyin: jie2 guo3 zhuang4 chu1 lai2 shen2 me5
cues.en: What gets knocked out as a result?

cues.zh: 撞出来两个碎片以及三个中子
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 chu1 lai2 liang3 ge4 sui4 pian4 yi3 ji2 san1 ge4 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: Two fragments come out, plus three neutrons.

cues.zh: 那么这三个中子又会怎么样呢
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 san1 ge4 zhong1 zi5 you4 hui4 zen3 me5 yang4 ne5
cues.en: So what happens to these three neutrons?

cues.zh: 又会撞击三个 U 2 35 对不对
cues.pinyin: you4 hui4 zhuang4 ji1 san1 ge4 U 2 35 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: They'll strike three more U-235 atoms, right?

cues.zh: 所以又会变出九个中子
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 you4 hui4 bian4 chu1 jiu3 ge4 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: So nine neutrons are produced.

cues.zh: 这样一来形成一个雪崩效应
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 yi1 lai2 xing2 cheng2 yi2 ge4 xue3 beng1 xiao4 ying4
cues.en: This creates an avalanche effect.

cues.zh: 我们称它为炼式反应
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 cheng1 ta1 wei4 lian4 shi4 fan3 ying4
cues.en: We call this a chain reaction.

cues.zh: 而在这个过程中
cues.pinyin: er2 zai4 zhe4 ge5 guo4 cheng2 zhong1
cues.en: And during this process.

cues.zh: 它的这个反应物的质量会比生
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 wu4 de5 zhi4 liang4 hui4 bi3 sheng1
cues.en: The mass of the reactants is greater than.

cues.zh: 成物的质量大
cues.pinyin: cheng2 wu4 de5 zhi4 liang4 da4
cues.en: The mass of the products.

cues.zh: 也就是说它会出现质量亏损
cues.pinyin: ye3 jiu4 shi4 shuo1 ta1 hui4 chu1 xian4 zhi4 liang4 kui1 sun3
cues.en: In other words, there's a mass defect.

cues.zh: 质量整体会减少质量会亏损
cues.pinyin: zhi4 liang4 zheng3 ti3 hui4 jian3 shao3 zhi4 liang4 hui4 kui1 sun3
cues.en: The total mass decreases — the mass is lost.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: 燃料棒是什么呢
cues.pinyin: ran2 liao4 bang4 shi4 shen2 me5 ne5
cues.en: What is a fuel rod?

cues.zh: 就是这个油 2 35
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 zhe4 ge5 you2 2 35
cues.en: It's this U-235.

cues.pinyin: you2 2 35

cues.zh: 我们用作反应的油 2 35
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 yong4 zuo4 fan3 ying4 de5 you2 2 35
cues.en: The U-235 we use for the reaction.

cues.pinyin: you2 235
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 好燃料棒放在什么地方
cues.pinyin: hao3 ran2 liao4 bang4 fang4 zai4 shen2 me5 di4 fang1
cues.en: Okay, where is the fuel rod placed?

cues.zh: 放在一个水管之中
cues.pinyin: fang4 zai4 yi2 ge4 shui3 guan3 zhi1 zhong1
cues.en: It's placed inside a water pipe.

cues.zh: 那这里边有水这个水是这样流动的
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 li3 bian1 you3 shui3 zhe4 ge5 shui3 shi4 zhe4 yang4 liu2 dong4 de5
cues.en: There's water here, and it flows like this.

cues.zh: 水这样流动这样流动
cues.pinyin: shui3 zhe4 yang4 liu2 dong4 zhe4 yang4 liu2 dong4
cues.en: The water flows this way, this way.

cues.zh: 经过燃料磅然后被加热
cues.pinyin: jing1 guo4 ran2 liao4 bang4 ran2 hou4 bei4 jia1 re4
cues.en: After passing the fuel rod, it gets heated.

cues.zh: 加热了之后它又流出来继续往这边流
cues.pinyin: jia1 re4 le5 zhi1 hou4 ta1 you4 liu2 chu1 lai2 ji4 xu4 wang3 zhe4 bian1 liu2
cues.en: After being heated, it flows out and continues this way.

cues.zh: 咱们一直流出来流到了这个地方
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 yi4 zhi2 liu2 chu1 lai2 liu2 dao4 le5 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1
cues.en: It keeps flowing until it reaches this place.

cues.zh: 水我们管它叫冷却剂冷却剂
cues.pinyin: shui3 wo3 men5 guan3 ta1 jiao4 leng3 que4 ji4 leng3 que4 ji4
cues.en: We call this water the coolant, the coolant.

cues.zh: 它是用来冷却这个反应堆同时带走热量
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 yong4 lai2 leng3 que4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 dui1 tong2 shi2 dai4 zou3 re4 liang4
cues.en: It's used to cool the reactor and carry away heat.

cues.zh: 然后就可以用来发电了对吧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiu4 ke3 yi3 yong4 lai2 fa1 dian4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then it can be used to generate electricity, right?

cues.zh: 好那么除此之外它外边有一个很大的框
cues.pinyin: hao3 na4 me5 chu2 ci3 zhi1 wai4 ta1 wai4 bian1 you3 yi2 ge4 hen3 da4 de5 kuang1
cues.en: Okay, besides that, there's a big frame around it.

cues.zh: 这个很大的框是什么是石墨
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 hen3 da4 de5 kuang1 shi4 shen2 me5 shi4 shi2 mo4
cues.en: What is this big frame? It's graphite.

cues.zh: 石墨的作用是什么是减速中子
cues.pinyin: shi2 mo4 de5 zuo4 yong4 shi4 shen2 me5 shi4 jian3 su4 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: What does the graphite do? It slows down neutrons.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: 它可以推动那个涡轮机发电
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 tui1 dong4 na4 ge5 wo1 lun2 ji1 fa1 dian4
cues.en: It can drive the turbine to generate electricity.

cues.zh: 我们就可以发电了
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 jiu4 ke3 yi3 fa1 dian4 le5
cues.en: Then we can generate electricity.

cues.zh: 然后它损失了一部分水对吧
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 ta1 sun3 shi1 le5 yi1 bu4 fen4 shui3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then it loses some water, right?

cues.zh: 我再把这个冷水从这个地方注入
cues.pinyin: wo3 zai4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 leng3 shui3 cong2 zhe4 ge5 di4 fang1 zhu4 ru4
cues.en: I inject cold water back in from here.

cues.zh: 冷水注入
cues.pinyin: leng3 shui3 zhu4 ru4
cues.en: Cold water is injected.

cues.zh: 然后让它这个冷水再这么循环一圈
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 rang4 ta1 zhe4 ge5 leng3 shui3 zai4 zhe4 me5 xun2 huan2 yi1 quan1
cues.en: Then let this cold water circulate again.

cues.zh: 又被上蒸汽又出来了对吧
cues.pinyin: you4 bei4 shang4 zheng1 qi4 you4 chu1 lai2 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: It turns into steam again and comes out, right?

cues.zh: 好这就是基本的一个原理
cues.pinyin: hao3 zhe4 jiu4 shi4 ji1 ben3 de5 yi2 ge4 yuan2 li3
cues.en: Okay, that's the basic principle.

cues.zh: 但是我们如何去控制这个反应的速率呢
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wo3 men5 ru2 he2 qu4 kong4 zhi4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 de5 su4 lv4 ne5
cues.en: But how do we control the rate of this reaction?

cues.zh: 这就涉及到一个很关键的部件
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jiu4 she4 ji2 dao4 yi2 ge4 hen3 guan1 jian4 de5 bu4 jian4
cues.en: This involves a very key component.

cues.zh: 就叫控制棒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 jiao4 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: Called the control rod.

cues.zh: 就是我们会在这个部位我们插入一些棒
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wo3 men5 hui4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 bu4 wei4 wo3 men5 cha1 ru4 yi1 xie1 bang4
cues.en: We insert some rods into this position.

cues.zh: 这些棒它有一个特殊的特点
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 bang4 ta1 you3 yi2 ge4 te4 shu1 de5 te4 dian3
cues.en: These rods have a special property.

cues.zh: 它可以吸收中子
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 xi1 shou1 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: They can absorb neutrons.

cues.zh: 我们管它叫控制棒控制棒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 guan3 ta1 jiao4 kong4 zhi4 bang4 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: We call them control rods, control rods.

cues.zh: 它会插在这个石墨中间控制棒
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 cha1 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shi2 mo4 zhong1 jian1 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: They're inserted into the middle of the graphite — control rods.

cues.zh: 它的作用是用来吸收中子的
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zuo4 yong4 shi4 yong4 lai2 xi1 shou1 zhong1 zi5 de5
cues.en: Their function is to absorb neutrons.

cues.zh: 我们为什么要吸收中子呢
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 wei4 shen2 me5 yao4 xi1 shou1 zhong1 zi5 ne5
cues.en: Why do we need to absorb neutrons?

cues.zh: 那很显而易见
cues.pinyin: na4 hen3 xian3 er2 yi4 jian4
cues.en: Well, it's quite obvious.

cues.zh: 如果你这个反应太剧烈了
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 tai4 ju4 lie4 le5
cues.en: If the reaction is too intense.

cues.zh: 那中子就太多了对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 zhong1 zi5 jiu4 tai4 duo1 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then there are too many neutrons, right?

cues.zh: 我们为了让它反应慢一点
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 wei4 le5 rang4 ta1 fan3 ying4 man4 yi4 dian3
cues.en: To slow down the reaction.

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: 我就要把这个棒往下插一插对不对
cues.pinyin: wo3 jiu4 yao4 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bang4 wang3 xia4 cha1 yi1 cha1 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: We push the rod in a bit further, right?

cues.zh: 所以它的特点就是
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 de5 te4 dian3 jiu4 shi4
cues.en: So the key feature is this.

cues.zh: 我们如果插入这个控制棒
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ru2 guo3 cha1 ru4 zhe4 ge5 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: If we insert this control rod.

cues.zh: 插入这个控制棒
cues.pinyin: cha1 ru4 zhe4 ge5 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: Insert this control rod.

cues.zh: 那么它的这个反应速率就会减小
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 su4 lv4 jiu4 hui4 jian3 xiao3
cues.en: Then the reaction rate will decrease.

cues.zh: 或者说这个反应的温度可能就会下降
cues.pinyin: huo4 zhe3 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 de5 wen1 du4 ke3 neng2 jiu4 hui4 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: Or the reaction temperature might drop.

cues.zh: 就是使这个反应减速
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shi3 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 jian3 su4
cues.en: This slows down the reaction.

cues.zh: 那么如果我想让反应剧烈一点怎么办
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ru2 guo3 wo3 xiang3 rang4 fan3 ying4 ju4 lie4 yi4 dian3 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: So what if I want to make the reaction more intense?

cues.zh: 很显然我把这个棒拔出来
cues.pinyin: hen3 xian3 ran2 wo3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 bang4 ba2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: Obviously, I pull the rod out.

cues.zh: 它就少吸收一些中子
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 shao3 xi1 shou1 yi1 xie1 zhong1 zi5
cues.en: Then it absorbs fewer neutrons.

cues.zh: 少吸收一些中子中子一多
cues.pinyin: shao3 xi1 shou1 yi1 xie1 zhong1 zi5 zhong1 zi5 yi1 duo1
cues.en: Fewer neutrons absorbed means more neutrons.

cues.zh: 那这个反应就变得剧烈了对不对
cues.pinyin: na4 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 jiu4 bian4 de2 ju4 lie4 le5 dui4 bu2 dui4
cues.en: Then the reaction becomes more intense, right?

cues.zh: 所以如果我们拔出这个控制棒
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 ba2 chu1 zhe4 ge5 kong4 zhi4 bang4
cues.en: So if we pull out this control rod.

cues.zh: 就会使这个反应加速
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hui4 shi3 zhe4 ge5 fan3 ying4 jia1 su4
cues.en: It speeds up the reaction.

cues.zh: 这个就是控制棒的一个作用对吧
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 jiu4 shi4 kong4 zhi4 bang4 de5 yi2 ge4 zuo4 yong4 dui4 ba5
cues.en: That's one function of the control rod, right?

cues.zh: 如果我们想紧急停机怎么办
cues.pinyin: ru2 guo3 wo3 men5 xiang3 jin3 ji2 ting2 ji1 zen3 me5 ban4
cues.en: What if we want to do an emergency shutdown?

cues.zh: 我们把这一大堆控制棒都插进去
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ba3 zhe4 yi1 da4 dui1 kong4 zhi4 bang4 dou1 cha1 jin4 qu4
cues.en: We insert this whole bunch of control rods.

cues.zh: 完全把中子吸收掉
cues.pinyin: wan2 quan2 ba3 zhong1 zi5 xi1 shou1 diao4
cues.en: Completely absorbing all the neutrons.

cues.zh: 那么它就不能反应了对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 ta1 jiu4 bu4 neng2 fan3 ying4 le5 dui4 ba5
cues.en: Then it can't react anymore, right?

items.title: 李永乐老师
items.title_zh: 【李永乐老师】切尔诺贝利核电站是如何爆炸的？核反应堆原理是什么？

cues.zh: 它要测一下这个核反应堆它的断电
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 ce4 yi1 xia4 zhe4 ge5 he2 fan3 ying4 dui1 ta1 de5 duan4 dian4
cues.en: They wanted to test this reactor's power-loss.

cues.zh: 保护能力如何
cues.pinyin: bao3 hu4 neng2 li4 ru2 he2
cues.en: Protection capability.

cues.zh: 断电保护能力说怎么个测试法呢
cues.pinyin: duan4 dian4 bao3 hu4 neng2 li4 shuo1 zen3 me5 ge4 ce4 shi4 fa3 ne5
cues.en: How exactly do you test the power-loss protection?

cues.zh: 就是说这个核反应堆
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 shuo1 zhe4 ge5 he2 fan3 ying4 dui1
cues.en: That is to say, this nuclear reactor.

cues.zh: 就算你把这个控制棒完全插进去了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 ni3 ba3 zhe4 ge5 kong4 zhi4 bang4 wan2 quan2 cha1 jin4 qu4 le5
cues.en: Even once you've fully inserted the control rods.

cues.zh: 它的这个核反应链式反应已经停了
cues.pinyin: ta1 de5 zhe4 ge5 he2 fan3 ying4 lian4 shi4 fan3 ying4 yi3 jing1 ting2 le5
cues.en: Its chain reaction has already stopped.

cues.zh: 但是它的生成物像贝克这些还可以衰变
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ta1 de5 sheng1 cheng2 wu4 xiang4 bei4 ke4 zhe4 xie1 hai2 ke3 yi3 shuai1 bian4
cues.en: But its products, like barium, can still decay.

cues.zh: 在衰变过程中还会继续放热
cues.pinyin: zai4 shuai1 bian4 guo4 cheng2 zhong1 hai2 hui4 ji4 xu4 fang4 re4
cues.en: During decay, they keep releasing heat.

cues.zh: 所以它就会出现什么呢出现余热
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ta1 jiu4 hui4 chu1 xian4 shen2 me5 ne5 chu1 xian4 yu2 re4
cues.en: So what happens? Residual heat appears.

cues.zh: 那么这个余热你必须要带走对吧
cues.pinyin: na4 me5 zhe4 ge5 yu2 re4 ni3 bi4 xu1 yao4 dai4 zou3 dui4 ba5
cues.en: And this residual heat must be carried away, right?

cues.zh: 所以你这个循环水必须一直循环着
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 ni3 zhe4 ge5 xun2 huan2 shui3 bi4 xu1 yi4 zhi2 xun2 huan2 zhe5
cues.en: So this circulating water must keep circulating.

cues.zh: 哪怕外界断电了
cues.pinyin: na3 pa4 wai4 jie4 duan4 dian4 le5
cues.en: Even if the power goes out.

cues.zh: 你这个循环水也必须一直循环着
cues.pinyin: ni3 zhe4 ge5 xun2 huan2 shui3 ye3 bi4 xu1 yi4 zhi2 xun2 huan2 zhe5
cues.en: This circulating water must still keep circulating.

cues.zh: 电力的供应必须要保证着
cues.pinyin: dian4 li4 de5 gong1 ying4 bi4 xu1 yao4 bao3 zheng4 zhe5
cues.en: The power supply must be guaranteed.

cues.zh: 但是万一要是电网确实停电了
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 wan4 yi1 yao4 shi4 dian4 wang3 que4 shi2 ting2 dian4 le5
cues.en: But what if the power grid really does go down?

cues.zh: 我这个水轮机没有办法转了
cues.pinyin: wo3 zhe4 ge5 shui3 lun2 ji1 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 zhuan3 le5
cues.en: Then my turbine can't turn anymore.

cues.zh: 那怎么办呢
cues.pinyin: na4 zen3 me5 ban4 ne5
cues.en: So what do we do?

cues.zh: 他们有一个柴油发电机
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 you3 yi2 ge4 chai2 you2 fa1 dian4 ji1
cues.en: They have a diesel generator.

cues.zh: 然后地球绕着太阳转

cues.en: Now, the Earth orbits the Sun,

cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 wan4 you3 yin3 li4 ye3 neng2 gou4 chong1 dang1 xiang4 xin1 li4
cues.en: and this gravity can act as the centripetal force.

cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 yuan2 zhou1 yun4 dong4 dou1 de2 shou4 xiang4 xin1 li4
cues.en: So any circular motion requires a centripetal force.

cues.zh: 那向心力有多大呢
cues.pinyin: na4 xiang4 xin1 li4 you3 duo1 da4 ne5
cues.en: So how large is the centripetal force?

cues.zh: 向心力必须满足一个公式
cues.pinyin: xiang4 xin1 li4 bi4 xu1 man3 zu2 yi2 ge4 gong1 shi4
cues.en: The centripetal force must satisfy a formula:

cues.zh: M V 方比 R

cues.en: mv² / r,

cues.zh: 这里边的 M 就是物体的质量
cues.pinyin: zhe4 li3 bian1 de5 M jiu4 shi4 wu4 ti3 de5 zhi4 liang4
cues.en: where m is the object's mass,

cues.zh: V 是速度
cues.pinyin: V shi4 su4 du4
cues.en: v is the speed,

cues.zh: 而 R 呢就是圆周运动的半径
cues.pinyin: er2 R ne5 jiu4 shi4 yuan2 zhou1 yun4 dong4 de5 ban4 jing4
cues.en: and r is the radius of the circular motion.

cues.zh: 我们在水平面内研究向心力比较简单
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 zai4 shui3 ping2 mian4 nei4 yan2 jiu1 xiang4 xin1 li4 bi3 jiao4 jian3 dan1
cues.en: Studying centripetal force in a horizontal plane is relatively simple.

cues.zh: 那如果说在竖直面内转
cues.pinyin: na4 ru2 guo3 shuo1 zai4 shu4 zhi2 mian4 nei4 zhuan3
cues.en: But what if the motion is in a vertical plane?

cues.zh: 完成圆周运动又需要多大向心力呢
cues.pinyin: wan2 cheng2 yuan2 zhou1 yun4 dong4 you4 xu1 yao4 duo1 da4 xiang4 xin1 li4 ne5
cues.en: How much centripetal force is needed to complete the circle then?

cues.zh: 咱们来考虑在这个竖直面内
cues.pinyin: zan2 men5 lai2 kao3 lv4 zai4 zhe4 ge5 shu4 zhi2 mian4 nei4

cues.zh: 它完成什么情况
cues.pinyin: ta1 wan2 cheng2 shen2 me5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: what situation it goes through.

cues.zh: 那我们来看一下情况
cues.pinyin: na4 wo3 men5 lai2 kan4 yi1 xia4 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Let's take a look at the situation.

cues.zh: 我仍然在画面上兴奋
cues.pinyin: wo3 reng2 ran2 zai4 hua4 mian4 shang4 xing1 fen4
cues.en: I'm still excited by images.

cues.zh: 能画出打动人的一些东西的话
cues.pinyin: neng2 hua4 chu1 da3 dong4 ren2 de5 yi1 xie1 dong1 xi1 de5 hua4
cues.en: If I can paint something that moves people,

cues.zh: 那就是我的荣幸了
cues.pinyin: na4 jiu4 shi4 wo3 de5 rong2 xing4 le5
cues.en: then that would be my honor.

cues.zh: 我希望你每个人真的自己走到这个作
cues.pinyin: wo3 xi1 wang4 ni3 mei3 ge4 ren2 zhen1 de5 zi4 ji3 zou3 dao4 zhe4 ge5 zuo4
cues.en: I hope each of you will truly walk up to this work

cues.zh: 品前面去看它
cues.pinyin: pin3 qian2 mian4 qu4 kan4 ta1
cues.en: and look at it in person.

cues.zh: 感受到那些你心里想
cues.pinyin: gan3 shou4 dao4 na4 xie1 ni3 xin1 li3 xiang3
cues.en: Feel the things you think in your heart

cues.zh: 但却没有办法说出来的东西
cues.pinyin: dan4 que4 mei2 you3 ban4 fa3 shuo1 chu1 lai2 de5 dong1 xi1
cues.en: but have no way to put into words.

cues.zh: 所有的东西 that we have today they will become these archaeological objects
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 dong1 xi1 that we have today they will become these archaeological objects
cues.en: All the things we have today will become these archaeological objects.

cues.zh: 未来通过我的作品能够构建出一个乌托邦
cues.pinyin: wei4 lai2 tong1 guo4 wo3 de5 zuo4 pin3 neng2 gou4 gou4 jian4 chu1 yi2 ge4 wu1 tuo1 bang1
cues.en: In the future, I hope my work can help build a utopia.

cues.zh: 其笔已经落下了终点在哪里
cues.pinyin: qi2 bi3 yi3 jing1 la4 xia4 le5 zhong1 dian3 zai4 na3 li3
cues.en: The brush has already come down — where is the endpoint?

cues.zh: 过去的 20 年是中国我认为年轻人加入推
cues.pinyin: guo4 qu4 de5 20 nian2 shi4 zhong1 guo2 wo3 ren4 wei2 nian2 qing1 ren2 jia1 ru4 tui1
cues.en: I think the past 20 years in China, when young people joined in

cues.zh: 动美学的进展
cues.pinyin: dong4 mei3 xue2 de5 jin4 zhan3
cues.en: to push forward the progress of aesthetics,

cues.zh: 的重要的 20 年
cues.pinyin: de5 zhong4 yao4 de5 20 nian2
cues.en: were the important 20 years.

cues.zh: 建筑是生活的容器
cues.pinyin: jian4 zhu4 shi4 sheng1 huo2 de5 rong2 qi4
cues.en: Architecture is the container of life.

cues.zh: 所有的生活对美的欣赏都是在
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 de5 sheng1 huo2 dui4 mei3 de5 xin1 shang3 dou1 shi4 zai4
cues.en: All appreciation of beauty in life

cues.zh: 建筑里发生的

cues.en: happens within architecture.

cues.zh: 我觉得一个国家除了它的政治经济社会
cues.pinyin: wo3 jue2 de5 yi2 ge4 guo2 jia1 chu2 le5 ta1 de5 zheng4 zhi4 jing1 ji4 she4 hui4
cues.en: I think besides a country's politics, economy, and society,

cues.zh: 接下来其实最重要就是文化

cues.zh: 就是国家它所代表著一种风格一种审美
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 guo2 jia1 ta1 suo3 dai4 biao3 zhu4 yi1 zhong3 feng1 ge2 yi1 zhong3 shen3 mei3
cues.en: That is, a country represents a style, an aesthetic.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 一条美学大赏榜单揭晓：这些爆款背后的人，个个都不简单！YITIAO AWARDS FESTIVAL 2021 Unveils Amazing Works of

cues.zh: 从人类的精神来讲的话
cues.pinyin: cong2 ren2 lei4 de5 jing1 shen2 lai2 jiang3 de5 hua4
cues.en: Speaking from the human spirit,

cues.zh: 艺术和哲学都是一种解放的力量
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 he2 zhe2 xue2 dou1 shi4 yi1 zhong3 jie3 fang4 de5 li4 liang4
cues.en: art and philosophy are both a liberating force,

cues.zh: 把我们从日常的生活里边解放出来
cues.pinyin: ba3 wo3 men5 cong2 ri4 chang2 de5 sheng1 huo2 li3 bian1 jie3 fang4 chu1 lai2
cues.en: freeing us from everyday life,

cues.zh: 在一个精神的高度上来展望我们的生活
cues.pinyin: zai4 yi2 ge4 jing1 shen2 de5 gao1 du4 shang4 lai2 zhan3 wang4 wo3 men5 de5 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: letting us look upon our lives from a spiritual height,

cues.zh: 用一种审美的观点看世界
cues.pinyin: yong4 yi1 zhong3 shen3 mei3 de5 guan1 dian3 kan4 shi4 jie4
cues.en: seeing the world from an aesthetic point of view,

cues.zh: 发现美接近美理解美创造美
cues.pinyin: fa1 xian4 mei3 jie1 jin4 mei3 li3 jie3 mei3 chuang4 zao4 mei3
