items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 给一个哑巴喉咙里按上两片骨头
cues.pinyin: gei3 yi2 ge4 ya3 ba5 hou2 long2 li3 an4 shang4 liang3 pian4 gu3 tou5
cues.en: Two pieces of bone were implanted in a mute boy's throat,

cues.zh: 他就能说话你敢相信吗
cues.pinyin: ta1 jiu4 neng2 shuo1 hua4 ni3 gan3 xiang1 xin4 ma5
cues.en: and then he could talk — can you believe that?

cues.zh: 这个小男孩的上气管在子宫内
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 xiao3 nan2 hai2 de5 shang4 qi4 guan3 zai4 zi5 gong1 nei4
cues.en: This boy's upper airway was already

cues.zh: 就被发育完全
cues.pinyin: jiu4 bei4 fa1 yu4 wan2 quan2
cues.en: fully formed while he was still in the womb.

cues.zh: 上呼吸道被完全阻塞导致他完全没有喉部
cues.pinyin: shang4 hu1 xi1 dao4 bei4 wan2 quan2 zu3 se4 dao3 zhi4 ta1 wan2 quan2 mei2 you3 hou2 bu4
cues.en: His upper airway was completely blocked, leaving him with no larynx at all.

cues.zh: 是在脖子里插一根气管他才能呼吸
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 bo2 zi5 li3 cha1 yi1 gen1 qi4 guan3 ta1 cai2 neng2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: A tube had to be inserted into his neck just for him to breathe.

cues.zh: 不过这会反复引起感染和肺炎
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 zhe4 hui4 fan3 fu4 yin3 qi3 gan3 ran3 he2 fei4 yan2
cues.en: But this kept causing repeated infections and pneumonia.

cues.zh: 今天小男孩来医院就是来检查看看
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 xiao3 nan2 hai2 lai2 yi1 yuan4 jiu4 shi4 lai2 jian3 cha2 kan4 kan4
cues.en: Today the boy came to the hospital just for a checkup,

cues.zh: 有没有感染的
cues.pinyin: you3 mei2 you3 gan3 ran3 de5
cues.en: to see if he had any infection.

cues.zh: 医生给他的父母带来了一个好消息
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 gei3 ta1 de5 fu4 mu3 dai4 lai2 le5 yi2 ge4 hao3 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: The doctor brought his parents some good news.

cues.zh: 他不仅没有感染
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu4 jin3 mei2 you3 gan3 ran3
cues.en: Not only did he have no infection,

cues.zh: 而且还十分符合他们的一个实验手术
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 hai2 shi2 fen1 fu2 he2 ta1 men5 de5 yi2 ge4 shi2 yan4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: he was also a great match for an experimental surgery they were doing.

cues.zh: 他们可以帮助小男孩切除伤疤组织
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 bang1 zhu4 xiao3 nan2 hai2 qie1 chu2 shang1 ba1 zu3 zhi1
cues.en: They could help the boy remove the scar tissue

cues.zh: 并打开气道
cues.pinyin: bing4 da3 kai1 qi4 dao4
cues.en: and open up his airway.

cues.zh: 虽然不能让他说话
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 bu4 neng2 rang4 ta1 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: Although it wouldn't let him speak,

cues.zh: 但是可以不借助气管就正常呼吸
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 ke3 yi3 bu4 jie4 zhu4 qi4 guan3 jiu4 zheng4 chang2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: he could breathe normally without needing a tracheostomy tube.

cues.zh: 虽然这个手术很复杂
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4 hen3 fu4 za2
cues.en: Although the surgery was very complex,

cues.zh: 但是鉴于小男孩长期以来面对的感染风险
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 jian4 yu2 xiao3 nan2 hai2 chang2 qi1 yi3 lai2 mian4 dui4 de5 gan3 ran3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: given the long-term infection risk the boy faced,

cues.zh: 这绝对是最好的选择
cues.pinyin: zhe4 jue2 dui4 shi4 zui4 hao3 de5 xuan3 ze2
cues.en: this was definitely the best option.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 小男孩和他的父母心动了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 he2 ta1 de5 fu4 mu3 xin1 dong4 le5
cues.en: The boy and his parents were swayed.

cues.zh: 同意做这个手术
cues.pinyin: tong2 yi4 zuo4 zhe4 ge5 shou3 shu4
cues.en: They agreed to have the surgery.

cues.zh: 医生们先把小男孩清理阻塞物
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 xian1 ba3 xiao3 nan2 hai2 qing1 li3 zu3 se4 wu4
cues.en: The doctors first cleared out the blockage,

cues.zh: 不过实际操作中发现阻塞程度
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 shi2 ji4 cao1 zuo4 zhong1 fa1 xian4 zu3 se4 cheng2 du4
cues.en: but during the actual operation they found the blockage

cues.zh: 要比影像中的大
cues.pinyin: yao4 bi3 ying3 xiang4 zhong1 de5 da4
cues.en: was worse than what the imaging had shown.

cues.zh: 但并没有多大影响
cues.pinyin: dan4 bing4 mei2 you3 duo1 da4 ying3 xiang3
cues.en: But it didn't make much difference.

cues.zh: 做了缝合之后
cues.pinyin: zuo4 le5 feng2 he2 zhi1 hou4
cues.en: After they finished the sutures,

cues.zh: 手术就结束了
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jiu4 jie2 shu4 le5
cues.en: the surgery was over.

cues.zh: 医生用手指堵住气管
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 yong4 shou3 zhi3 du3 zhu4 qi4 guan3
cues.en: The doctor blocked the tube opening with his finger,

cues.zh: 小男孩尝试着呼吸
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 chang2 shi4 zhe5 hu1 xi1
cues.en: and the boy tried to breathe.

cues.zh: 成功了
cues.pinyin: cheng2 gong1 le5
cues.en: It worked.

cues.zh: 小男孩可以不用再借助气管呼吸了
cues.pinyin: xiao3 nan2 hai2 ke3 yi3 bu4 yong4 zai4 jie4 zhu4 qi4 guan3 hu1 xi1 le5
cues.en: The boy no longer needed the tube to breathe.

cues.zh: 他用手语告诉大家
cues.pinyin: ta1 yong4 shou3 yu3 gao4 su4 da4 jia1
cues.en: He told everyone in sign language

cues.zh: 虽然有点疼
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 you3 dian3 teng2
cues.en: that although it hurt a little,

cues.zh: 但是从未感觉这么好
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 cong2 wei4 gan3 jue2 zhe4 me5 hao3
cues.en: he'd never felt this good before.

cues.zh: 所有人都为他高兴
cues.pinyin: suo3 you3 ren2 dou1 wei4 ta1 gao1 xing4
cues.en: Everyone was happy for him,

cues.zh: 但是肖恩除外
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 xiao4 en1 chu2 wai4
cues.en: except for Shaun.

cues.zh: 他从男孩身上看到了自己
cues.pinyin: ta1 cong2 nan2 hai2 shen1 shang4 kan4 dao4 le5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: He saw himself in the boy —

cues.zh: 那个因为自闭症
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 yin1 wei4 zi4 bi4 zheng4
cues.en: the self who, because of autism,

cues.zh: 无法正常交流的自己
cues.pinyin: wu2 fa3 zheng4 chang2 jiao1 liu2 de5 zi4 ji3
cues.en: couldn't communicate normally.

cues.zh: 肖恩并不满足于小男孩能正常呼吸
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 bing4 bu4 man3 zu2 yu2 xiao3 nan2 hai2 neng2 zheng4 chang2 hu1 xi1
cues.en: Shaun wasn't satisfied with just the boy breathing normally;

cues.zh: 更想让他开口说话
cues.pinyin: geng4 xiang3 rang4 ta1 kai1 kou3 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: he wanted the boy to be able to speak.

cues.zh: 他连饭都不吃了
cues.pinyin: ta1 lian2 fan4 dou1 bu4 chi1 le5
cues.en: He stopped eating

cues.zh: 去找资料
cues.pinyin: qu4 zhao3 zi1 liao4
cues.en: and went off to research it.

cues.zh: 终于在第二天中午的时候
cues.pinyin: zhong1 yu2 zai4 di4 er4 tian1 zhong1 wu3 de5 shi2 hou4
cues.en: Finally, around noon the next day,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 可父母依旧不同意
cues.pinyin: ke3 fu4 mu3 yi1 jiu4 bu4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: the parents still wouldn't agree.

cues.zh: 他们可以通过手语交流
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 ke3 yi3 tong1 guo4 shou3 yu3 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: They could communicate through sign language,

cues.zh: 你们是大错特错
cues.pinyin: ni3 men5 shi4 da4 cuo4 te4 cuo4
cues.en: [Shaun said] you are completely wrong —

cues.zh: 他会永远受到限制
cues.pinyin: ta1 hui4 yong3 yuan3 shou4 dao4 xian4 zhi4
cues.en: he'll always be limited.

cues.zh: 他很难交朋友
cues.pinyin: ta1 hen3 nan2 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: He'll have a hard time making friends

cues.zh: 很难和陌生人沟通
cues.pinyin: hen3 nan2 he2 mo4 sheng1 ren2 gou1 tong1
cues.en: and a hard time talking to strangers.

cues.zh: 肖恩这番话说的没错
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 zhe4 fan1 hua4 shuo1 de5 mei2 cuo4
cues.en: What Shaun said turned out to be right.

cues.zh: 男孩告诉父母
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 gao4 su4 fu4 mu3
cues.en: The boy told his parents

cues.zh: 他在学校确实很难和同学们交流
cues.pinyin: ta1 zai4 xue2 xiao4 que4 shi2 hen3 nan2 he2 tong2 xue2 men5 jiao1 liu2
cues.en: that he really did struggle to talk with classmates at school

cues.zh: 也很难交朋友
cues.pinyin: ye3 hen3 nan2 jiao1 peng2 you3
cues.en: and struggled to make friends.

cues.zh: 他并不想被人忽视
cues.pinyin: ta1 bing4 bu4 xiang3 bei4 ren2 hu1 shi4
cues.en: He didn't want to be overlooked.

cues.zh: 他想能说话
cues.pinyin: ta1 xiang3 neng2 shuo1 hua4
cues.en: He wanted to be able to speak.

cues.zh: 这些事情他在此之前从来没说过
cues.pinyin: zhe4 xie1 shi4 qing2 ta1 zai4 ci3 zhi1 qian2 cong2 lai2 mei2 shuo1 guo4
cues.en: He had never said any of this before.

cues.zh: 而现在父母因为他的遭遇犹豫了
cues.pinyin: er2 xian4 zai4 fu4 mu3 yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 zao1 yu4 you2 yu4 le5
cues.en: Now, because of what he'd been through, his parents hesitated,

cues.zh: 最终决定给男孩做手术
cues.pinyin: zui4 zhong1 jue2 ding4 gei3 nan2 hai2 zuo4 shou3 shu4
cues.en: and finally decided to let the boy have the surgery.

cues.zh: 医生们将男孩软肋骨的一部分取出
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 jiang1 nan2 hai2 ruan3 lei4 gu3 de5 yi1 bu4 fen4 qu3 chu1
cues.en: The doctors removed part of the boy's rib cartilage,

cues.zh: 然后将他们打磨成合适的形状和大
cues.pinyin: ran2 hou4 jiang1 ta1 men5 da3 mo2 cheng2 he2 shi4 de5 xing2 zhuang4 he2 da4
cues.en: then ground it down to the right shape and

cues.zh: 小组装在一起
cues.pinyin: xiao3 zu3 zhuang1 zai4 yi4 qi3
cues.en: size, and assembled the pieces together

cues.zh: 代替喉布放进合适的位置
cues.pinyin: dai4 ti4 hou2 bu4 fang4 jin4 he2 shi4 de5 wei4 zhi4
cues.en: to replace the larynx and put it in the right position.

cues.zh: 可是在最后关头
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zai4 zui4 hou4 guan1 tou2
cues.en: But at the very last moment,

cues.zh: 检测器突然发出警报声
cues.pinyin: jian3 ce4 qi4 tu1 ran2 fa1 chu1 jing3 bao4 sheng1
cues.en: the monitor suddenly sounded an alarm.

cues.zh: 男孩血压垂直下降
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 xue4 ya1 chui2 zhi2 xia4 jiang4
cues.en: The boy's blood pressure dropped sharply,

cues.zh: 手术部位大量出血
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 bu4 wei4 da4 liang4 chu1 xie3
cues.en: and the surgical site was bleeding heavily,

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 而且他们找不到出血点
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 ta1 men5 zhao3 bu2 dao4 chu1 xie3 dian3
cues.en: and they couldn't find where the bleeding was coming from.

cues.zh: 主任让黄姐用止血钳夹住静脉
cues.pinyin: zhu3 ren4 rang4 huang2 jie3 yong4 zhi3 xue4 qian2 jia1 zhu4 jing4 mai4
cues.en: The attending told Dr. Huang to clamp the vein with hemostatic forceps,

cues.zh: 但是依旧没有用
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 yi1 jiu4 mei2 you3 yong4
cues.en: but it still didn't help.

cues.zh: 最后主任意识到
cues.pinyin: zui4 hou4 zhu3 ren4 yi4 shi2 dao4
cues.en: Finally the attending realized

cues.zh: 是在拉钩时用了一根损伤的静脉壶
cues.pinyin: shi4 zai4 la1 gou1 shi2 yong4 le5 yi1 gen1 sun3 shang1 de5 jing4 mai4 hu2
cues.en: a vein had been damaged while retracting with the hook —

cues.zh: 连接了左右颈静脉
cues.pinyin: lian2 jie1 le5 zuo3 you4 jing3 jing4 mai4
cues.en: one connecting the left and right jugular veins.

cues.zh: 于是立刻让肖恩用线
cues.pinyin: yu2 shi4 li4 ke4 rang4 xiao4 en1 yong4 xian4
cues.en: So he immediately had Shaun use thread

cues.zh: 在血口两端打个双重结
cues.pinyin: zai4 xue4 kou3 liang3 duan1 da3 ge4 shuang1 chong2 jie2
cues.en: to tie a double knot at both ends of the wound.

cues.zh: 男孩情况稳定下来了
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 qing2 kuang4 wen3 ding4 xia4 lai2 le5
cues.en: The boy's condition stabilized.

cues.zh: 手术结束后
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 jie2 shu4 hou4
cues.en: After the surgery was over,

cues.zh: 黄姐教男孩如何发声
cues.pinyin: huang2 jie3 jiao4 nan2 hai2 ru2 he2 fa1 sheng1
cues.en: Dr. Huang taught the boy how to make sounds.

cues.zh: 男孩试着去做
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 shi4 zhe5 qu4 zuo4
cues.en: The boy tried it.

cues.zh: 虽然只能用喉部发出模糊的呃呃声
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 zhi3 neng2 yong4 hou2 bu4 fa1 chu1 mo2 hu2 de5 e4 e4 sheng1
cues.en: Although he could only make a vague, muffled "uh-uh" with his throat,

cues.zh: 但爸爸却说
cues.pinyin: dan4 ba4 ba4 que4 shuo1
cues.en: his father said

cues.zh: 这是他听过最动人的声音
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 ta1 ting1 guo4 zui4 dong4 ren2 de5 sheng1 yin1
cues.en: it was the most moving sound he'd ever heard.

cues.zh: 手术十分成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 shi2 fen1 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery was a total success.

cues.zh: 这是一个奇迹
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 yi2 ge4 qi2 ji4
cues.en: It was a miracle.

cues.zh: 男孩向肖恩表达了感谢
cues.pinyin: nan2 hai2 xiang4 xiao4 en1 biao3 da2 le5 gan3 xie4
cues.en: The boy thanked Shaun,

cues.zh: 他拯救了自己未来的人生
cues.pinyin: ta1 zheng3 jiu4 le5 zi4 ji3 wei4 lai2 de5 ren2 sheng1
cues.en: saying he had saved his future.

cues.zh: 另一边
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 大钟和布朗接收了一个昏迷的女消防员
cues.pinyin: da4 zhong1 he2 bu4 lang3 jie1 shou1 le5 yi2 ge4 hun1 mi2 de5 nv3 xiao1 fang2 yuan2
cues.en: Dr. Dazhong and Browne took in an unconscious female firefighter,

cues.zh: 小美
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3
cues.en: Xiaomei.

cues.zh: 她被一只狗袭击了
cues.pinyin: ta1 bei4 yi1 zhi1 gou3 xi2 ji1 le5
cues.en: She had been attacked by a dog.

cues.zh: 左臂被撕咬得血弱模糊
cues.pinyin: zuo3 bi4 bei4 si1 yao3 de2 xue4 ruo4 mo2 hu2
cues.en: Her left arm was torn up and bloody.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 稳定骨盒碎片
cues.pinyin: wen3 ding4 gu3 he2 sui4 pian4
cues.en: They stabilized the bone fragments

cues.zh: 并且还植入了血管
cues.pinyin: bing4 qie3 hai2 zhi2 ru4 le5 xue4 guan3
cues.en: and also grafted in blood vessels.

cues.zh: 结束后小美移植的皮肤和软组织似
cues.pinyin: jie2 shu4 hou4 xiao3 mei3 yi2 zhi2 de5 pi2 fu1 he2 ruan3 zu3 zhi1 shi4
cues.en: Afterward, Xiaomei's transplanted skin and soft tissue seemed

cues.zh: 乎固定的很好
cues.pinyin: hu1 gu4 ding4 de5 hen3 hao3
cues.en: to be holding well,

cues.zh: 而且切口部分看起来不错
cues.pinyin: er2 qie3 qie1 kou3 bu4 fen4 kan4 qi3 lai2 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: and the incision looked good too.

cues.zh: 医生们成功重新接上了二头肌
cues.pinyin: yi1 sheng1 men5 cheng2 gong1 chong2 xin1 jie1 shang4 le5 er4 tou2 ji1
cues.en: The doctors successfully reattached the biceps

cues.zh: 的肌肉和肌腱
cues.pinyin: de5 ji1 rou4 he2 ji1 jian4
cues.en: muscle and tendon.

cues.zh: 只不过良好的术后情况好像只体现在表面
cues.pinyin: zhi3 bu4 guo4 liang2 hao3 de5 shu4 hou4 qing2 kuang4 hao3 xiang4 zhi3 ti3 xian4 zai4 biao3 mian4
cues.en: But the good post-op signs seemed to be only on the surface —

cues.zh: 小美的胳膊没有感觉
cues.pinyin: xiao3 mei3 de5 ge1 bo2 mei2 you3 gan3 jue2
cues.en: Xiaomei had no feeling in her arm.

cues.zh: 梅医生布朗和大钟在办公室讨
cues.pinyin: mei2 yi1 sheng1 bu4 lang3 he2 da4 zhong1 zai4 ban4 gong1 shi4 tao3
cues.en: Dr. Mei, Browne, and Dr. Dazhong discussed

cues.zh: 论小美的情况
cues.pinyin: lun4 xiao3 mei3 de5 qing2 kuang4
cues.en: Xiaomei's case in the office.

cues.zh: 缝合恢复的不错
cues.pinyin: feng2 he2 hui1 fu4 de5 bu4 cuo4
cues.en: The wound had healed up well.

cues.zh: 应该是在骨头和肌肉之间的神
cues.pinyin: ying1 gai1 shi4 zai4 gu3 tou5 he2 ji1 rou4 zhi1 jian1 de5 shen2
cues.en: It must be that the nerve between the bone and the muscle

cues.zh: 经受到了压迫
cues.pinyin: jing1 shou4 dao4 le5 ya1 po4
cues.en: was being compressed.

cues.zh: 这跨度太大
cues.pinyin: zhe4 kua4 du4 tai4 da4
cues.en: But the gap was too large

cues.zh: 难以用移植恢复
cues.pinyin: nan2 yi3 yong4 yi2 zhi2 hui1 fu4
cues.en: to fix with a graft.

cues.zh: 大家提议
cues.pinyin: da4 jia1 ti2 yi4
cues.en: The team suggested

cues.zh: 用硅胶和锯胰胶纸做一个神经导管
cues.pinyin: yong4 gui1 jiao1 he2 ju4 yi2 jiao1 zhi3 zuo4 yi2 ge4 shen2 jing1 dao3 guan3
cues.en: making a nerve conduit out of silicone and a biodegradable polymer,

cues.zh: 用来引导断端神经末梢朝着彼此生长
cues.pinyin: yong4 lai2 yin3 dao3 duan4 duan1 shen2 jing1 mo4 shao1 chao2 zhe5 bi3 ci3 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: to guide the nerve endings at each severed end to grow toward each other,

cues.zh: 让神经沿着通路生长
cues.pinyin: rang4 shen2 jing1 yan2 zhe5 tong1 lu4 sheng1 zhang3
cues.en: letting the nerve grow along the pathway

cues.zh: 并连接起来
cues.pinyin: bing4 lian2 jie1 qi3 lai2
cues.en: and reconnect.

cues.zh: 这样有风险
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 you3 feng1 xian3
cues.en: It was risky,

cues.zh: 但值得一试
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhi2 de5 yi1 shi4
cues.en: but worth a try.

cues.zh: 主管梅医生同意了
cues.pinyin: zhu3 guan3 mei2 yi1 sheng1 tong2 yi4 le5
cues.en: Attending physician Dr. Mei agreed.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 【良医】肖恩太厉害了，一出手便让一个哑巴开口说话，可惜情场失意被分手了

cues.zh: 手术很成功
cues.pinyin: shou3 shu4 hen3 cheng2 gong1
cues.en: The surgery was a success.

cues.zh: 之后小美的力气可能会变小
cues.pinyin: zhi1 hou4 xiao3 mei3 de5 li4 qi4 ke3 neng2 hui4 bian4 xiao3
cues.en: Afterward, Xiaomei's strength might decrease a little,

cues.zh: 但绝对不会影响到正常工作
cues.pinyin: dan4 jue2 dui4 bu2 hui4 ying3 xiang3 dao4 zheng4 chang2 gong1 zuo4
cues.en: but it definitely wouldn't affect her normal work.

cues.zh: 而另一边
cues.pinyin: er2 ling4 yi1 bian1
cues.en: Meanwhile, elsewhere,

cues.zh: 肖恩被分手了
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 bei4 fen1 shou3 le5
cues.en: Shaun got dumped.

cues.zh: 这又是怎么回事呢
cues.pinyin: zhe4 you4 shi4 zen3 me5 hui2 shi4 ne5
cues.en: So what happened there?

cues.zh: 之前因为肖恩和丽雅
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 yin1 wei4 xiao4 en1 he2 li4 ya3
cues.en: Earlier, because Shaun and Lea

cues.zh: 一起去看父亲的事情
cues.pinyin: yi4 qi3 qu4 kan4 fu4 qin1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: went together to deal with his father,

cues.zh: 让小丽有些伤心
cues.pinyin: rang4 xiao3 li4 you3 xie1 shang1 xin1
cues.en: it upset Lea a bit,

cues.zh: 俩人出现了嫌隙
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 chu1 xian4 le5 xian2 xi4
cues.en: and a rift grew between them.

cues.zh: 但后来肖恩让丽雅这个室友
cues.pinyin: dan4 hou4 lai2 xiao4 en1 rang4 li4 ya3 zhe4 ge5 shi4 you3
cues.en: But later, Shaun had Lea's roommate

cues.zh: 搬出了出租屋
cues.pinyin: ban1 chu1 le5 chu1 zu1 wu1
cues.en: move out of the rented apartment,

cues.zh: 再加上偶尔的谈心
cues.pinyin: zai4 jia1 shang4 ou3 er3 de5 tan2 xin1
cues.en: and with a few heart-to-heart talks,

cues.zh: 肖恩和小丽又恢复如初
cues.pinyin: xiao4 en1 he2 xiao3 li4 you4 hui1 fu4 ru2 chu1
cues.en: Shaun and Lea went back to normal.

cues.zh: 尽管丽雅到了医院任职
cues.pinyin: jin3 guan3 li4 ya3 dao4 le5 yi1 yuan4 ren4 zhi2
cues.en: Even though Lea started working at the hospital

cues.zh: 和肖恩经常见面
cues.pinyin: he2 xiao4 en1 jing1 chang2 jian4 mian4
cues.en: and saw Shaun often,

cues.zh: 肖丽雅依旧觉得没关系
cues.pinyin: xiao4 li4 ya3 yi1 jiu4 jue2 de5 mei2 guan1 xi4
cues.en: Shaun and Lea still felt it was fine.

cues.zh: 可是这天
cues.pinyin: ke3 shi4 zhe4 tian1
cues.en: But one day,

cues.zh: 俩人一起去酒吧放松时
cues.pinyin: lia3 ren2 yi4 qi3 qu4 jiu3 ba1 fang4 song1 shi2
cues.en: when the two of them went to a bar to relax,

cues.zh: 碰见了丽雅和她的男朋友
cues.pinyin: peng4 jian4 le5 li4 ya3 he2 ta1 de5 nan2 peng2 you3
cues.en: they ran into Lea and her boyfriend.

cues.zh: 丽雅性格活泼跳脱
cues.pinyin: li4 ya3 xing4 ge2 huo2 po1 tiao4 tuo1
cues.en: Lea, who's lively and unrestrained by nature,

cues.zh: 彻底打乱了这对小情侣之间暧昧的气氛
cues.pinyin: che4 di3 da3 luan4 le5 zhe4 dui4 xiao3 qing2 lv3 zhi1 jian1 ai4 mei4 de5 qi4 fen1
cues.en: completely broke the romantic mood between the couple.

cues.zh: 但是没什么大不了的
cues.pinyin: dan4 shi4 mei2 shen2 me5 da4 bu4 liao3 de5
cues.en: But it wasn't a big deal —

cues.zh: 萧恩他们并没有很介意
cues.pinyin: xiao1 en1 ta1 men5 bing4 mei2 you3 hen3 jie4 yi4
cues.en: Shaun and the others didn't mind much.

cues.zh: 他们还一起上台
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 hai2 yi4 qi3 shang4 tai2
cues.en: They even went up on stage together.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 香港有艺境：这个三月，一起循入香港艺术之境

cues.zh: 当维港的晨雾漫入美术馆的落地窗
cues.pinyin: dang1 wei2 gang3 de5 chen2 wu4 man4 ru4 mei3 shu4 guan3 de5 luo4 di4 chuang1
cues.en: When Victoria Harbour's morning mist drifts into the gallery's floor-to-ceiling windows,

cues.zh: 这座城市的脉搏便与艺术共振
cues.pinyin: zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 shi4 de5 mai4 bo2 bian4 yu3 yi4 shu4 gong4 zhen4
cues.en: this city's pulse resonates with art.

cues.zh: 三月的香港是亚洲艺术版图上的璀璨极光
cues.pinyin: san1 yue4 de5 xiang1 gang3 shi4 ya4 zhou1 yi4 shu4 ban3 tu2 shang4 de5 cui3 can4 ji2 guang1
cues.en: In March, Hong Kong becomes a dazzling aurora on Asia's art map,

cues.zh: 从国际艺术展席卷全球的视觉浪潮
cues.pinyin: cong2 guo2 ji4 yi4 shu4 zhan3 xi2 juan3 quan2 qiu2 de5 shi4 jue2 lang4 chao2
cues.en: from the visual wave of international art fairs sweeping the globe,

cues.zh: 到跨越时空的大师对话
cues.pinyin: dao4 kua4 yue4 shi2 kong1 de5 da4 shi1 dui4 hua4
cues.en: to dialogues between masters across time and space,

cues.zh: 再到弥漫在香港各个街区的艺术氛围
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 mi2 man4 zai4 xiang1 gang3 ge4 ge4 jie1 qu1 de5 yi4 shu4 fen1 wei2
cues.en: to the artistic atmosphere permeating every corner of Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 今年的三月一条艺术
cues.pinyin: jin1 nian2 de5 san1 yue4 yi1 tiao2 yi4 shu4
cues.en: This March, Yit Art

cues.zh: 带您一起寻入香港的艺术之境
cues.pinyin: dai4 nin2 yi4 qi3 xun2 ru4 xiang1 gang3 de5 yi4 shu4 zhi1 jing4
cues.en: invites you on a journey into Hong Kong's realm of art,

cues.zh: 静看这座城市的精神机理
cues.pinyin: jing4 kan4 zhe4 zuo4 cheng2 shi4 de5 jing1 shen2 ji1 li3
cues.en: quietly observing this city's spiritual fabric.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 香港有艺境：这个三月，一起循入香港艺术之境

cues.zh: 跟随我们的镜头漫游城市褶皱
cues.pinyin: gen1 sui2 wo3 men5 de5 jing4 tou2 man4 you2 cheng2 shi4 zhe3 zhou4
cues.en: Follow our camera as it wanders through the folds of the city —

cues.zh: 街角画廊与茶餐厅毗邻而居
cues.pinyin: jie1 jiao3 hua4 lang2 yu3 cha2 can1 ting1 pi2 lin2 er2 ju1
cues.en: street-corner galleries sit side by side with tea restaurants,

cues.zh: 在工业大厦里的艺术实验室
cues.pinyin: zai4 gong1 ye4 da4 sha4 li3 de5 yi4 shu4 shi2 yan4 shi4
cues.en: art labs tucked inside industrial buildings.

cues.zh: 艺术不是殿堂
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 bu2 shi4 dian4 tang2
cues.en: Art is not a temple,

cues.zh: 是香港人抚养极健的日常风景
cues.pinyin: shi4 xiang1 gang3 ren2 fu3 yang3 ji2 jian4 de5 ri4 chang2 feng1 jing3
cues.en: it's the everyday scenery that nourishes Hong Kong people.

cues.zh: 在巴塞尔艺术展香港展会
cues.pinyin: zai4 ba1 sai1 er3 yi4 shu4 zhan3 xiang1 gang3 zhan3 hui4
cues.en: At Art Basel Hong Kong,

cues.zh: 与本土画廊交错的聚光灯下
cues.pinyin: yu3 ben3 tu3 hua4 lang2 jiao1 cuo4 de5 ju4 guang1 deng1 xia4
cues.en: under spotlights crisscrossing with local galleries,

cues.zh: 触摸艺术的蓬勃心跳
cues.pinyin: chu4 mo1 yi4 shu4 de5 peng2 bo2 xin1 tiao4
cues.en: you can touch the vibrant heartbeat of art.

cues.zh: 它是三月的香港最鲜活的生活底色
cues.pinyin: ta1 shi4 san1 yue4 de5 xiang1 gang3 zui4 xian1 huo2 de5 sheng1 huo2 di3 se4
cues.en: It's the most vivid backdrop of life in Hong Kong this March.

items.title: 一条Yit
items.title_zh: 香港有艺境：这个三月，一起循入香港艺术之境

cues.zh: M 家的毕加索
cues.pinyin: M jia1 de5 bi4 jia1 suo3
cues.en: M+'s Picasso,

cues.zh: 与亚洲对话特展暗藏东方密码
cues.pinyin: yu3 ya4 zhou1 dui4 hua4 te4 zhan3 an4 cang2 dong1 fang1 mi4 ma3
cues.en: the special exhibition 'In Dialogue with Asia' hides an Eastern code,

cues.zh: 解密大师笔触与亚洲当代艺术的隐秘对话
cues.pinyin: jie3 mi4 da4 shi1 bi3 chu4 yu3 ya4 zhou1 dang1 dai4 yi4 shu4 de5 yin3 mi4 dui4 hua4
cues.en: decoding the secret dialogue between the masters' brushstrokes and contemporary Asian art.

cues.zh: 两个世纪的灵魂在维港两岸碰
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 shi4 ji4 de5 ling2 hun2 zai4 wei2 gang3 liang3 an4 peng4
cues.en: Souls from two centuries collide on either side of Victoria Harbour,

cues.zh: 撞出新的回响
cues.pinyin: zhuang4 chu1 xin1 de5 hui2 xiang3
cues.en: sparking new echoes.

cues.zh: 他们用画笔钢丝与陶土重构世界
cues.pinyin: ta1 men5 yong4 hua4 bi3 gang1 si1 yu3 tao2 tu3 zhong4 gou4 shi4 jie4
cues.en: They reconstruct the world with brushes, steel wire, and clay.

cues.zh: 我们聚焦女性艺术家
cues.pinyin: wo3 men5 ju4 jiao1 nv3 xing4 yi4 shu4 jia1
cues.en: We focus on female artists,

cues.zh: 请她们分享自己对香港艺术的见解与感悟
cues.pinyin: qing3 ta1 men5 fen1 xiang3 zi4 ji3 dui4 xiang1 gang3 yi4 shu4 de5 jian4 jie3 yu3 gan3 wu4
cues.en: inviting them to share their insights and reflections on Hong Kong art,

cues.zh: 探索她们的思想艺术清单
cues.pinyin: tan4 suo3 ta1 men5 de5 si1 xiang3 yi4 shu4 qing1 dan1
cues.en: exploring their curated list of ideas and art,

cues.zh: 感受香港艺术的独特魅力
cues.pinyin: gan3 shou4 xiang1 gang3 yi4 shu4 de5 du2 te4 mei4 li4
cues.en: to feel the unique charm of Hong Kong art.

cues.zh: 舌尖尝到油彩的酸甜
cues.pinyin: she2 jian1 chang2 dao4 you2 cai3 de5 suan1 tian2
cues.en: The tongue tastes the sweet and sour of oil paint,

cues.zh: 指尖掠过青铜的沧桑
cues.pinyin: zhi3 jian1 lve4 guo4 qing1 tong2 de5 cang1 sang1
cues.en: fingertips brush over the weathered history of bronze,

cues.zh: 耳畔流淌剧场诗的韵律
cues.pinyin: er3 pan4 liu2 tang3 ju4 chang3 shi1 de5 yun4 lv4
cues.en: the rhythm of theatrical poetry flows past the ear.

cues.zh: 艺术从未如此鲜活
cues.pinyin: yi4 shu4 cong2 wei4 ru2 ci3 xian1 huo2
cues.en: Art has never felt so alive.

cues.zh: 香港用多维感官让你沉浸式体
cues.pinyin: xiang1 gang3 yong4 duo1 wei2 gan3 guan1 rang4 ni3 chen2 jin4 shi4 ti3
cues.en: Hong Kong uses multi-dimensional senses to let you immersively ex-

cues.zh: 验艺术及生活
cues.pinyin: yan4 yi4 shu4 ji2 sheng1 huo2
cues.en: -perience art and life.

items.title: 美食天堂 - 美味家常料理食譜 一學就會
items.title_zh: 3道凉拌黄瓜做法～夏日必吃美食！凉拌黄瓜豆腐丝，韩式凉拌辣黄瓜，酸奶油黄瓜沙拉！🥒🥒🥒 【美食天堂】家常料理食谱 一学就会

cues.zh: 你好各位做饭的美食家们
cues.pinyin: ni3 hao3 ge4 wei4 zuo4 fan4 de5 mei3 shi2 jia1 men5
cues.en: Hello everyone, home cooks!

cues.zh: 非常荣幸的又跟大家见面了我是 C isi
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 rong2 xing4 de5 you4 gen1 da4 jia1 jian4 mian4 le5 wo3 shi4 C isi
cues.en: It's a great honor to meet you all again, I'm CC.

cues.zh: 今天想要跟大家分享的是三道凉
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 xiang3 yao4 gen1 da4 jia1 fen1 xiang3 de5 shi4 san1 dao4 liang2
cues.en: Today I want to share with you three recipes for

cues.zh: 拌黄瓜的做法
cues.pinyin: ban4 huang2 gua1 de5 zuo4 fa3
cues.en: cold cucumber salad.

cues.zh: 我相信它们将成为你这夏天最喜爱的凉菜
cues.pinyin: wo3 xiang1 xin4 ta1 men5 jiang1 cheng2 wei2 ni3 zhe4 xia4 tian1 zui4 xi3 ai4 de5 liang2 cai4
cues.en: I believe they'll become your favorite cold dishes this summer.

cues.zh: 首先我们将黄瓜切丝
cues.pinyin: shou3 xian1 wo3 men5 jiang1 huang2 gua1 qie4 si1
cues.en: First, we cut the cucumber into strips.

cues.zh: 先放旁边这个大碗里我们放入豆腐丝
cues.pinyin: xian1 fang4 pang2 bian1 zhe4 ge5 da4 wan3 li3 wo3 men5 fang4 ru4 dou4 fu3 si1
cues.en: Set it aside; in this big bowl we add the shredded tofu.

cues.zh: 再倒入热水搅拌一下
cues.pinyin: zai4 dao4 ru4 re4 shui3 jiao3 ban4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: Then pour in hot water and stir it a bit.

cues.zh: 给它泡两分钟的时间

cues.en: he only committed a minor

cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bi4 xu1 jin3 kuai4 gao3 ding4 jia3 shi4
cues.en: So he must secure parole as soon as possible.

cues.zh: 让老爷假释出狱
cues.pinyin: rang4 lao3 ye2 jia3 shi4 chu1 yu4
cues.en: and get the boss released on parole.

cues.zh: 这是第一件烦心的事情
cues.pinyin: zhe4 shi4 di4 yi1 jian4 fan2 xin1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: That's the first headache.

cues.zh: 第二件烦心的事情
cues.pinyin: di4 er4 jian4 fan2 xin1 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: The second headache

cues.zh: 就是老爷的女明星前妻
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 lao3 ye2 de5 nv3 ming2 xing1 qian2 qi1
cues.en: is that the boss's ex-wife, a female celebrity,

cues.zh: 带走了一起养的狗
cues.pinyin: dai4 zou3 le5 yi4 qi3 yang3 de5 gou3
cues.en: took the dog they used to raise together.

cues.zh: 老爷虽然现在蹲大牢
cues.pinyin: lao3 ye2 sui1 ran2 xian4 zai4 dun1 da4 lao2
cues.en: Even though the boss is now locked up in prison,

cues.zh: 但还是想跟狗儿子团聚一下
cues.pinyin: dan4 hai2 shi4 xiang3 gen1 gou3 er2 zi5 tuan2 ju4 yi1 xia4
cues.en: he still wants to reunite with his "dog son."

cues.zh: 李韩信马不停蹄
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 ma3 bu4 ting2 ti2
cues.en: Li Hanxin wasted no time

cues.zh: 找到了老爷的前妻进行威逼
cues.pinyin: zhao3 dao4 le5 lao3 ye2 de5 qian2 qi1 jin4 xing2 wei1 bi1
cues.en: and tracked down the boss's ex-wife to threaten and pressure her.

cues.zh: 当然来玩硬的
cues.pinyin: dang1 ran2 lai2 wan2 ying4 de5
cues.en: Of course, he played the tough approach,

cues.zh: 也要配合一下软的
cues.pinyin: ye3 yao4 pei4 he2 yi1 xia4 ruan3 de5
cues.en: but also paired it with a softer one.

cues.zh: 只要前妻交出狗儿子
cues.pinyin: zhi3 yao4 qian2 qi1 jiao1 chu1 gou3 er2 zi5
cues.en: As long as the ex-wife hands over the "dog son,"

cues.zh: 他可以帮前妻解决前妻和经纪公司的纠纷
cues.pinyin: ta1 ke3 yi3 bang1 qian2 qi1 jie3 jue2 qian2 qi1 he2 jing1 ji4 gong1 si1 de5 jiu1 fen1
cues.en: he can help resolve her dispute with her talent agency.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 顶级财阀在监狱里无法无天！律师拍马屁获取信任后，癫狂复仇！2024最新高能复仇韩剧《假释审查官李韩信》

cues.zh: 李韩信笑了笑
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 xiao4 le5 xiao4
cues.en: Li Hanxin smiled.

cues.zh: 菜就多练
cues.pinyin: cai4 jiu4 duo1 lian4
cues.en: "If you're no good, just practice more."

cues.zh: 别在这里废话
cues.pinyin: bie2 zai4 zhe4 li3 fei4 hua4
cues.en: Stop talking nonsense here.

cues.zh: 废物律师不信邪
cues.pinyin: fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 bu4 xin4 xie2
cues.en: The useless lawyer didn't buy it.

cues.zh: 他认定李韩信根本无法完成说服调查分
cues.pinyin: ta1 ren4 ding4 li3 han2 xin4 gen1 ben3 wu2 fa3 wan2 cheng2 shuo1 fu2 diao4 cha2 fen1
cues.en: He was convinced Li Hanxin could never manage to persuade the investigation and classification

cues.zh: 类科长的任务
cues.pinyin: lei4 ke1 zhang3 de5 ren4 wu4
cues.en: department chief — that task was impossible.

cues.zh: 毕竟不管多少律师去了都是鲨鱼而归
cues.pinyin: bi4 jing4 bu4 guan3 duo1 shao3 lv4 shi1 qu4 le5 dou1 shi4 sha1 yu2 er2 gui1
cues.en: After all, no matter how many lawyers went, they all came back defeated.

cues.zh: 那个调查分类科长软硬不吃
cues.pinyin: na4 ge5 diao4 cha2 fen1 lei4 ke1 zhang3 ruan3 ying4 bu4 chi1
cues.en: That investigation and classification department chief wouldn't budge for either soft or hard tactics,

cues.zh: 就是一个认死里的老顽固
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yi2 ge4 ren4 si3 li3 de5 lao3 wan2 gu4
cues.en: just a stubborn old fossil set in his own ways.

cues.zh: 可很快
cues.pinyin: ke3 hen3 kuai4
cues.en: But soon,

cues.zh: 废物律师就从上级那里得到了一个平
cues.pinyin: fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 jiu4 cong2 shang4 ji2 na4 li3 de2 dao4 le5 yi2 ge4 ping2
cues.en: the useless lawyer got, from his superior, a piece of

cues.zh: 地惊雷的消息
cues.pinyin: di4 jing1 lei2 de5 xiao1 xi1
cues.en: out-of-the-blue shocking news.

cues.zh: 李韩信竟然曾做过预警
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 jing4 ran2 ceng2 zuo4 guo4 yu4 jing3
cues.en: Li Hanxin had actually once worked in the preliminary investigation department,

cues.zh: 跟调查分类科长是同事
cues.pinyin: gen1 diao4 cha2 fen1 lei4 ke1 zhang3 shi4 tong2 shi4
cues.en: and was colleagues with the investigation and classification department chief.

cues.zh: 私下有交情
cues.pinyin: si1 xia4 you3 jiao1 qing2
cues.en: They had a personal friendship in private.

cues.zh: 这个任务还真的很有可能让他完成
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ge5 ren4 wu4 hai2 zhen1 de5 hen3 you3 ke3 neng2 rang4 ta1 wan2 cheng2
cues.en: So this task might actually be something he could pull off after all.

cues.zh: 不过废物律师实在多虑了
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 shi2 zai4 duo1 lv4 le5
cues.en: But the useless lawyer was overthinking it.

cues.zh: 作为老同事
cues.pinyin: zuo4 wei2 lao3 tong2 shi4
cues.en: As an old colleague,

cues.zh: 科长眼见李韩信为了财罚会长
cues.pinyin: ke1 zhang3 yan3 jian4 li3 han2 xin4 wei4 le5 cai2 fa2 hui4 zhang3
cues.en: seeing Li Hanxin, for the sake of the chaebol chairman,

cues.zh: 老爷上门求情
cues.pinyin: lao3 ye2 shang4 men2 qiu2 qing2
cues.en: come begging on the boss's behalf,

cues.zh: 对他非常失望
cues.pinyin: dui4 ta1 fei1 chang2 shi1 wang4
cues.en: felt extremely disappointed in him.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 顶级财阀在监狱里无法无天！律师拍马屁获取信任后，癫狂复仇！2024最新高能复仇韩剧《假释审查官李韩信》

cues.zh: 之前财阀老爷的人
cues.pinyin: zhi1 qian2 cai2 fa2 lao3 ye2 de5 ren2
cues.en: Previously, the chaebol boss's men

cues.zh: 已经拿着装满现金的饮料盒子来过很多次
cues.pinyin: yi3 jing1 na2 zhuo2 zhuang1 man3 xian4 jin1 de5 yin3 liao4 he2 zi5 lai2 guo4 hen3 duo1 ci4
cues.en: had already come many times carrying drink boxes stuffed with cash.

cues.zh: 这一次科长打开李韩信送来的饮料盒子
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ke1 zhang3 da3 kai1 li3 han2 xin4 song4 lai2 de5 yin3 liao4 he2 zi5
cues.en: This time, the chief opened the drink box Li Hanxin brought,

cues.zh: 看着里面的饮料
cues.pinyin: kan4 zhe5 li3 mian4 de5 yin3 liao4
cues.en: and looked at the drink inside.

cues.zh: 觉得事情至少没有到最糟糕的地步
cues.pinyin: jue2 de5 shi4 qing2 zhi4 shao3 mei2 you3 dao4 zui4 zao1 gao1 de5 di4 bu4
cues.en: He felt that, at least, things hadn't reached the worst-case scenario.

cues.zh: 李韩信要是真的用钱塞满盒子
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 yao4 shi4 zhen1 de5 yong4 qian2 sai1 man3 he2 zi5
cues.en: If Li Hanxin had really stuffed the box with cash,

cues.zh: 他真的会彻底失望
cues.pinyin: ta1 zhen1 de5 hui4 che4 di3 shi1 wang4
cues.en: he would have been utterly disappointed,

cues.zh: 两个人的友情便到此为止了
cues.pinyin: liang3 ge4 ren2 de5 you3 qing2 bian4 dao4 ci3 wei2 zhi3 le5
cues.en: and their friendship would have ended right there.

cues.zh: 李韩信对自己会被拒绝其实也不太意外
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 dui4 zi4 ji3 hui4 bei4 ju4 jue2 qi2 shi2 ye3 bu4 tai4 yi4 wai4
cues.en: Li Hanxin wasn't too surprised that he might be refused.

cues.zh: 以前科长在监狱里对他很好
cues.pinyin: yi3 qian2 ke1 zhang3 zai4 jian1 yu4 li3 dui4 ta1 hen3 hao3
cues.en: Back when he was in prison, the chief had treated him very well.

cues.zh: 不只是科长
cues.pinyin: bu4 zhi3 shi4 ke1 zhang3
cues.en: It wasn't just the chief —

cues.zh: 还有当时他们的顶头上司寓长也是个
cues.pinyin: hai2 you3 dang1 shi2 ta1 men5 de5 ding3 tou2 shang4 si1 yu4 zhang3 ye3 shi4 ge4
cues.en: their direct superior at the time, the warden, was also

cues.zh: 非常亲切的人
cues.pinyin: fei1 chang2 qin1 qie4 de5 ren2
cues.en: a very kind-hearted person.

cues.zh: 对待下属极好
cues.pinyin: dui4 dai4 xia4 shu3 ji2 hao3
cues.en: He treated his subordinates extremely well,

cues.zh: 喜欢给他塞棒棒糖
cues.pinyin: xi3 huan1 gei3 ta1 sai1 bang4 bang4 tang2
cues.en: and liked slipping him lollipops.

cues.zh: 李韩信了解他们
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 liao3 jie3 ta1 men5
cues.en: Li Hanxin understood them —

cues.zh: 知道他们都是坚持正义的好人
cues.pinyin: zhi1 dao4 ta1 men5 dou1 shi4 jian1 chi2 zheng4 yi4 de5 hao3 ren2
cues.en: he knew they were good people who stood firm for justice.

cues.zh: 但这个世界上好人最容易被伤害
cues.pinyin: dan4 zhe4 ge5 shi4 jie4 shang4 hao3 ren2 zui4 rong2 yi4 bei4 shang1 hai4
cues.en: But in this world, good people are the easiest to get hurt.

cues.zh: 上级眼见李韩信都没能说服科长
cues.pinyin: shang4 ji2 yan3 jian4 li3 han2 xin4 dou1 mei2 neng2 shuo1 fu2 ke1 zhang3
cues.en: Seeing that Li Hanxin still couldn't persuade the chief,

cues.zh: 便准备弄点音的
cues.pinyin: bian4 zhun3 bei4 nong4 dian3 yin1 de5
cues.en: his superior prepared to resort to dirty tactics,

cues.zh: 对着科长的孩子下手
cues.pinyin: dui4 zhe5 ke1 zhang3 de5 hai2 zi5 xia4 shou3
cues.en: targeting the chief's child.

cues.zh: 废物律师忍不住在厕所偷偷骂上级下作
cues.pinyin: fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 ren3 bu2 zhu4 zai4 ce4 suo3 tou1 tou1 ma4 shang4 ji2 xia4 zuo4
cues.en: The useless lawyer couldn't help secretly cursing his superior as despicable, in the bathroom.

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 顶级财阀在监狱里无法无天！律师拍马屁获取信任后，癫狂复仇！2024最新高能复仇韩剧《假释审查官李韩信》

cues.zh: 科长私下感谢了李韩信出手
cues.pinyin: ke1 zhang3 si1 xia4 gan3 xie4 le5 li3 han2 xin4 chu1 shou3
cues.en: Privately, the chief thanked Li Hanxin for stepping in,

cues.zh: 但他坚持公私分明
cues.pinyin: dan4 ta1 jian1 chi2 gong1 si1 fen1 ming2
cues.en: but he insisted on keeping personal and professional matters separate,

cues.zh: 一马归一马
cues.pinyin: yi1 ma3 gui1 yi1 ma3
cues.en: treating each matter on its own terms.

cues.zh: 李韩信不得不打断他
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 bu4 de2 bu4 da3 duan4 ta1
cues.en: Li Hanxin had to cut him off.

cues.zh: 他倒是公私分明
cues.pinyin: ta1 dao3 shi4 gong1 si1 fen1 ming2
cues.en: The chief might keep things separate,

cues.zh: 可会长老爷却不是能够公私分明的人
cues.pinyin: ke3 hui4 zhang3 lao3 ye2 que4 bu2 shi4 neng2 gou4 gong1 si1 fen1 ming2 de5 ren2
cues.en: but the chairman was not someone who could do the same.

cues.zh: 今天的事情绝非偶然
cues.pinyin: jin1 tian1 de5 shi4 qing2 jue2 fei1 ou3 ran2
cues.en: Today's incident was no coincidence at all —

cues.zh: 而是会长那边心急
cues.pinyin: er2 shi4 hui4 zhang3 na4 bian1 xin1 ji2
cues.en: the chairman's side had grown anxious

cues.zh: 派人动手
cues.pinyin: pai4 ren2 dong4 shou3
cues.en: and sent someone to act,

cues.zh: 为的就是故意恐吓科长孩子心脏病发
cues.pinyin: wei4 de5 jiu4 shi4 gu4 yi4 kong3 he4 ke1 zhang3 hai2 zi5 xin1 zang4 bing4 fa1
cues.en: deliberately trying to scare the chief's child into a heart attack,

cues.zh: 逼他低头
cues.pinyin: bi1 ta1 di1 tou2
cues.en: to force him to back down.

cues.zh: 这一次科长不低头
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ke1 zhang3 bu4 di1 tou2
cues.en: If the chief didn't give in this time,

cues.zh: 就还会有下一次
cues.pinyin: jiu4 hai2 hui4 you3 xia4 yi1 ci4
cues.en: there would simply be a next time.

cues.zh: 但科长可以相信他一次
cues.pinyin: dan4 ke1 zhang3 ke3 yi3 xiang1 xin4 ta1 yi1 ci4
cues.en: But the chief could trust him just this once:

cues.zh: 就算科长低头了
cues.pinyin: jiu4 suan4 ke1 zhang3 di1 tou2 le5
cues.en: even if the chief gave in

cues.zh: 签字同意
cues.pinyin: qian1 zi4 tong2 yi4
cues.en: and signed his approval,

cues.zh: 他也会保证会长无法走出监狱
cues.pinyin: ta1 ye3 hui4 bao3 zheng4 hui4 zhang3 wu2 fa3 zou3 chu1 jian1 yu4
cues.en: Li Hanxin would make sure the chairman could never walk out of prison.

cues.zh: 科长犹豫了一阵
cues.pinyin: ke1 zhang3 you2 yu4 le5 yi1 zhen4
cues.en: The chief hesitated for a while,

cues.zh: 还是选择相信李韩信
cues.pinyin: hai2 shi4 xuan3 ze2 xiang1 xin4 li3 han2 xin4
cues.en: but ultimately chose to trust Li Hanxin.

cues.zh: 财阀老爷得知李韩信办妥了这
cues.pinyin: cai2 fa2 lao3 ye2 de2 zhi1 li3 han2 xin4 ban4 tuo3 le5 zhe4
cues.en: When the chaebol boss learned that Li Hanxin had taken care of this

cues.zh: 件事非常高兴
cues.pinyin: jian4 shi4 fei1 chang2 gao1 xing4
cues.en: matter, he was extremely pleased.

cues.zh: 他好奇李韩信为什么不要钱
cues.pinyin: ta1 hao4 qi2 li3 han2 xin4 wei4 shen2 me5 bu2 yao4 qian2
cues.en: He was curious why Li Hanxin didn't want money

cues.zh: 也一定要拿到这个假式审察官的职位
cues.pinyin: ye3 yi2 ding4 yao4 na2 dao4 zhe4 ge5 jia3 shi4 shen3 cha2 guan1 de5 zhi2 wei4
cues.en: and instead insisted on getting the position of parole examiner.

cues.zh: 李韩信只是笑了笑
cues.pinyin: li3 han2 xin4 zhi3 shi4 xiao4 le5 xiao4
cues.en: Li Hanxin just smiled,

cues.zh: 并未回答
cues.pinyin: bing4 wei4 hui2 da2
cues.en: without answering.

cues.zh: 因为他的答案有关一段过去
cues.pinyin: yin1 wei4 ta1 de5 da2 an4 you3 guan1 yi1 duan4 guo4 qu4
cues.en: Because his answer was tied to a past event —

cues.zh: 曾经对他很好的顶头上司预长
cues.pinyin: ceng2 jing1 dui4 ta1 hen3 hao3 de5 ding3 tou2 shang4 si1 yu4 zhang3
cues.en: his former superior, the warden who had once treated him very well,

cues.zh: 就是因为不愿意让财阀老爷的杀人犯
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 yin1 wei4 bu4 yuan4 yi4 rang4 cai2 fa2 lao3 ye2 de5 sha1 ren2 fan4
cues.en: had, precisely because he refused to let the chaebol boss's murderer

items.title: 先锋影视
items.title_zh: 顶级财阀在监狱里无法无天！律师拍马屁获取信任后，癫狂复仇！2024最新高能复仇韩剧《假释审查官李韩信》

cues.zh: 儿子保释出狱
cues.pinyin: er2 zi5 bao3 shi4 chu1 yu4
cues.en: son get released on bail,

cues.zh: 所以被财阀陷害入狱
cues.pinyin: suo3 yi3 bei4 cai2 fa2 xian4 hai4 ru4 yu4
cues.en: been framed by the chaebol and thrown in prison himself.

cues.zh: 他要当这个假式审察官
cues.pinyin: ta1 yao4 dang1 zhe4 ge5 jia3 shi4 shen3 cha2 guan1
cues.en: He wanted to become this parole examiner

cues.zh: 就是为了这一次把财阀老爷按死在牢里
cues.pinyin: jiu4 shi4 wei4 le5 zhe4 yi1 ci4 ba3 cai2 fa2 lao3 ye2 an4 si3 zai4 lao2 li3
cues.en: precisely so he could, this time, pin the chaebol boss down in prison for good.

cues.zh: 还要将他一家子作恶多端的亲戚
cues.pinyin: hai2 yao4 jiang1 ta1 yi1 jia1 zi3 zuo4 e4 duo1 duan1 de5 qin1 qi1
cues.en: He also wanted to send the boss's entire family of evildoing relatives

cues.zh: 全部送进监狱
cues.pinyin: quan2 bu4 song4 jin4 jian1 yu4
cues.en: all to prison.

cues.zh: 古代韩信能受胯下之辱
cues.pinyin: gu3 dai4 han2 xin4 neng2 shou4 kua4 xia4 zhi1 ru3
cues.en: In ancient times, Han Xin could endure the humiliation of crawling between someone's legs;

cues.zh: 今日他李寒信一样能为了达成目标屈
cues.pinyin: jin1 ri4 ta1 li3 han2 xin4 yi1 yang4 neng2 wei4 le5 da2 cheng2 mu4 biao1 qu1
cues.en: today, Li Hanxin could likewise endure humiliation to achieve his goal —

cues.zh: 辱的侍奉财阀
cues.pinyin: ru3 de5 shi4 feng4 cai2 fa2
cues.en: serving the chaebol while swallowing the shame.

cues.zh: 不过现在目标达成
cues.pinyin: bu4 guo4 xian4 zai4 mu4 biao1 da2 cheng2
cues.en: But now that his goal was achieved,

cues.zh: 他不会再忍耐下去了
cues.pinyin: ta1 bu2 hui4 zai4 ren3 nai4 xia4 qu4 le5
cues.en: he wouldn't keep enduring any longer.

cues.zh: 这样的理由自然不能跟财阀说
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yang4 de5 li3 you2 zi4 ran2 bu4 neng2 gen1 cai2 fa2 shuo1
cues.en: Naturally, this reason was not something he could tell the chaebol boss.

cues.zh: 另一边刑警安瑞云也是跟财阀家族有
cues.pinyin: ling4 yi1 bian1 xing2 jing3 an1 rui4 yun2 ye3 shi4 gen1 cai2 fa2 jia1 zu2 you3
cues.en: Meanwhile, detective An Ruiyun also had, with the chaebol family,

cues.zh: 不共戴天之仇
cues.pinyin: bu4 gong4 dai4 tian1 zhi1 chou2
cues.en: an irreconcilable blood feud.

cues.zh: 财阀儿子害死了他的妹妹
cues.pinyin: cai2 fa2 er2 zi5 hai4 si3 le5 ta1 de5 mei4 mei4
cues.en: The chaebol's son had caused his sister's death,

cues.zh: 至今仍然逍遥法外
cues.pinyin: zhi4 jin1 reng2 ran2 xiao1 yao2 fa3 wai4
cues.en: and to this day was still roaming free, unpunished.

cues.zh: 安瑞云便像是一条疯狗一样一直追
cues.pinyin: an1 rui4 yun2 bian4 xiang4 shi4 yi1 tiao2 feng1 gou3 yi1 yang4 yi4 zhi2 zhui1
cues.en: An Ruiyun had been chasing after

cues.zh: 着财阀家族咬
cues.pinyin: zhe5 cai2 fa2 jia1 zu2 yao3
cues.en: the chaebol family like a mad dog, biting at them relentlessly.

cues.zh: 这一次他逮捕了一个名叫崔正学的人
cues.pinyin: zhe4 yi1 ci4 ta1 dai4 bu3 le5 yi2 ge4 ming2 jiao4 cui1 zheng4 xue2 de5 ren2
cues.en: This time, he arrested a man named Cui Zhengxue.

cues.zh: 此人被捕的消息传进财阀老爷的耳朵里
cues.pinyin: ci3 ren2 bei4 bu3 de5 xiao1 xi1 chuan2 jin4 cai2 fa2 lao3 ye2 de5 er3 duo3 li3
cues.en: News of this man's arrest reached the chaebol boss's ears,

cues.zh: 把他吓得不轻
cues.pinyin: ba3 ta1 xia4 de2 bu4 qing1
cues.en: and gave him quite a scare.

cues.zh: 赶紧命令手下去捞人
cues.pinyin: gan3 jin3 ming4 ling4 shou3 xia4 qu4 lao1 ren2
cues.en: He quickly ordered his men to go bail the man out.

cues.zh: 这可是废物律师最擅长的事情
cues.pinyin: zhe4 ke3 shi4 fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 zui4 shan4 chang2 de5 shi4 qing2
cues.en: This happened to be the useless lawyer's specialty.

cues.zh: 虽然崔正学涉嫌吸毒贩毒
cues.pinyin: sui1 ran2 cui1 zheng4 xue2 she4 xian2 xi1 du2 fan4 du2
cues.en: Although Cui Zhengxue was suspected of drug use and trafficking,

cues.zh: 但没有明确证据
cues.pinyin: dan4 mei2 you3 ming2 que4 zheng4 ju4
cues.en: there was no clear evidence,

cues.zh: 尿检结果也还没出来
cues.pinyin: niao4 jian3 jie2 guo3 ye3 hai2 mei2 chu1 lai2
cues.en: and the urine test results hadn't come back yet.

cues.zh: 这边让废物律师找到了控制
cues.pinyin: zhe4 bian1 rang4 fei4 wu4 lv4 shi1 zhao3 dao4 le5 kong4 zhi4
cues.en: This gave the useless lawyer a way to take control of the situation.
